novel_info.author: Medieval rabbit

The main content and adjustments of this update are as follows.""New monthly rule 'Active Talent' added: All players must converse with others for a total of 1000 sentences every day..."When an abrupt notification sound echoed in the ears of all humans on Blue Star.The world faced its cleansing.In every monthly version update, a new rule would descend, which all players had to obey....Chen Yi, who had found a massive loophole before the third version update, looked at the six-figure Points Balance in his account and broke into a grin."Tuberculosis Rabbit, this time we might just rise to the top."

chapters.title: Chapter 1 New Monthly Rule "Active Expert" Added!
chapters.content:
Blue Star, Yancheng, 4 p.m.
Chen Yi stood on the roadside with a half-smoked cigarette dangling from his mouth, dressed leisurely in a suit with a floral shirt underneath, hands thrust into his pockets as he casually glanced over at the lightly dressed girls on the nearby sidewalk.
It was the height of summer.
In modern cities, there are no ugly women in summer.
Put on some makeup, a pair of sunglasses, a summer dress, and Feng could be turned into Diao Chan.
If one really wasn't pleasing to the eye, just wear a mask and some eye shadow, and one could suddenly become a dazzling urban beauty.
Some girls who noticed Chen Yi's gaze didn't show any displeasure; instead, they stuck out their tender tongues, licked their lips, and cast him alluring glances, looking exceptionally seductive.
Only the faint terror in their eyes and the red blood vessels filling their pupils,
Made the whole picture lose some of its coquettishness, adding a few touches of eeriness.
Everyone on the street was chatting.
Even two strangers walking side by side to work were continuously talking, as if they were old friends.
He flicked the cigarette butt into the bin next to him and glanced over his shoulder at the two strangers chatting together— their conversation was also quite interesting.
"Have you eaten?"
"Yeah, I have."
"What did you eat?"
"Well, actually I haven't, so have you eaten?"
Their dialogue clearly didn't resemble that of normal people, but nearly everyone on the street was engaging in such meaningless conversations.
Although there were two people talking,
It was obvious that they weren't listening to each other at all, each just talking about themselves, appearing to have even lower intelligence than the AIs in trashy browser games.
The whole world had the feel of a long un-maintained, deserted browser game.
At that moment—
A nearby sanitation worker came over, picked up the cigarette butt Chen Yi had just flicked onto the ground, and kept talking.
"Thank you, you threw that cigarette butt so well."
"Oh, smoking Lotus, eh? That's good stuff."
"Did you know? I'm already 67 this year. I used to be quite proud of that, after all, living long is a good thing, right?"
"But now, I suddenly feel that living too long might not be such a good thing. Have you lived long?"
After finishing,
The old man looked up with a hopeful and urgent stare, fixing Chen Yi with his gaze as if waiting for something.
"..."
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi pulled out another cigarette from his chest, placed it in his mouth, and lit it: "Old man, this is Fu Rong Wang, not Lotus, you're more than just a little blind."
"Go get your eyes fixed."
It wasn't a very polite thing to say.
At least, such words shouldn't be said to an elder.
But after hearing them, the old man didn't get angry. Instead, he let out a sigh of relief, contentedly walked away with his broom: "Lotus is good, Lotus is good, my son also loves smoking this brand."
"You better get your lungs checked too. Sooner or later, it's going to smoke you to death. My son's nearly there."
"If you both die, I can save some money on funeral gifts."
"..."
Chen Yi sighed lightly, somewhat speechless, and looked down at his wristwatch, impatiently flicking the cigarette ash onto the ground.
On the trash bin, there were two conspicuous and glaring slogans.
"Litter must not be thrown into the trash cans, violators bear the consequences!"
"Cigarette ashes must be flicked onto the ground, violators bear the consequences!"
Beyond these slogans, on the outer walls of the skyscrapers throughout the city, there were various other massive slogans.
"You must not refuse to talk to any stranger!"
"When spoken to, you must respond!"
The whole city, amidst its bustle, seemed all the more bizarre!
Most people seemed highly agitated, but the visible red veins in their eyes proved that they were on the verge of a mental breakdown.
Chen Yi stood still, growing impatient as he continued to wait without speaking.
Two months ago, the world had completely changed.
Everyone remembered that day clearly.
Two months earlier.
A voice had resonated in the minds of people all around the globe.
"Game Update Announcement!"
"The new version, Blue Star 4.0, will commence a non-stop update at 00:00 on April 1st. The main content and adjustments of this update are as follows."
"1. Optimize the server for increased stability."
"2. Add a new monthly rule 'Active Talent': All players must engage in conversation with others for 1000 sentences a day. Those who violate this rule will become mute, and this rule will be removed after two months."
"3. Optimize certain map areas for rising sea levels."
"4. Activate the visual personal panel for all players."
"Snow Sea Project Team wishes all players a pleasant gaming experience in version 4.0."
"PS: Preview of the next update – the Project Team has decided to introduce a 'Thriller' element into the next monthly rule. Players, please look forward to it."
-
Just a few simple sentences.
It looked like just another commonplace game update announcement, but the problem was, this wasn't a game, this was happening in reality!
April 1st was, indeed, April Fool's Day.
The abrupt voice and the panel that appeared before everyone's eyes seemed like a cruel April Fool's joke.
At first, most people were bewildered, unsure what was happening.
But when that day passed and the next one dawned.
Nearly twenty percent of the global population had become mute.
And that's when humanity realized that this damnable version update was a genuine supernatural event!!!
Though many completed the daily rule task on the first day, embracing the belief that it is better to be safe than sorry.
But—
Not everyone has the chance to converse with others for 1000 sentences every day.
This included mutes, people in vegetative states, severe cerebral palsy patients, those undergoing emergency treatment in intensive care, and infants who could not yet speak; the list was extensive.
In one day, the global population of mutes had nearly increased by twenty percent.
Fear quickly spread across the planet.
This unknown and mysterious force gave rise to all kinds of conspiracy theories spreading through various channels!
No one knew what was happening, but they were aware of one thing—they had to converse with others for 1000 sentences every day.
Even if it was nonsense.
Otherwise, the consequence would be eternal silence.
No logic applied.
Of course... from a certain perspective, those who were already mute seemed to be exempt from this punishment; after all, they were already unable to speak and couldn't complete the daily rule task, but they also didn't have to accept the punishment.
Was that considered good news?
Even amid such a disaster, humanity quickly adapted, establishing various regulations to ensure that everyone could manage the 1000 sentences of conversation every day.
Those in need could seek assistance from the government, giving rise to an emergency aid hotline.
The upper echelons were eagerly discussing the issue while trying to stabilize society as much as possible, gradually seeking solutions.
The full force of humanity mobilized is a fearsome thing.
The slogans on the exteriors of skyscrapers were the product of that first month.
But… just when humanity had grown accustomed to this way of life, thinking the situation couldn't get any worse.
The second month arrived.
On the first day of May.
That voice once again echoed in everyone's ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 Now everyone in the world has been forced to become a chatterbox.
chapters.content:
"Game Update Announcement!"
"The new Blue Star version 4.1 will start its non-stop update at 00:00 on May 1st, and the main content and adjustments of this update are as follows."
"1. Fixed a bug where some players wouldn't die from high falls, now it's forcibly set that without any protective measures, falls from a height of 18 meters or more will result in certain death."
"2. Fixed a bug where some players could die from a simple fall, now it's forcibly set that falls from a height below 18 meters will not result in death."
"3. Added daily rule task rewards, completing the daily rule tasks will grant certain rewards."
"4. Added the monthly rule 'Calm and Cool': players cannot have specific images of ghosts appear in their minds for more than three seconds or they will instantly die, this rule will be removed after two months."
"5. Added 'Skill Fragment' gameplay."
"When a player dies, a Skill Fragment will drop next to their body, which any player can pick up freely. Five identical Fragments will combine into a complete Skill."
"The Snow Sea Project Team wishes all players a pleasant gaming experience in version 4.1."
"PS: Preview of the next update: The project team has decided to add monthly rules about the 'life' element, players please look forward to it."
-
The moment this voice sounded.
The global population began to plummet at an extremely fast rate.
Normally, if there are no hints, people seldom think about ghosts.
These hints include——
suggestions from related movies and TV programs, folk tales, self-psychological suggestions born from walking alone on a night road due to fear, enforced suggestions from relevant keywords, and unintentional dreaming at night.
Put bluntly.
You can't have ghosts appear in your mind; as soon as they do, death is your fate.
Simple and brutal.
And the instant this game announcement was heard, virtually everyone involuntarily conjured up images of ghouls and other horrifying supernatural entities in their minds.
Human imagination has always been a point of pride for mankind.
But at that moment, no one was proud.
Most people exerted all their strength to redirect their attention, forcibly emptying their minds.
Having gone through the incident last month, no one doubted the authenticity of this game announcement anymore.
But... there were still many people who couldn't control their minds, and the more they feared, the images in their minds exploded like a rapidly playing slideshow!
"Bang, bang, bang!"
When ghosts persisted in these peoples' minds for three seconds, death became an inevitability.
"Ghosts cannot appear in your mind."
It sounds somewhat vague.
But in reality, it's not about the word 'ghost' not appearing in the mind, but rather the images of ghosts.
If the word 'ghost' just flickers through your mind, it's of no great concern. However, if you start unconsciously constructing the figure and images of ghosts in your mind,
That... is not good at all.
Actually, many people lack the ability to construct images in their minds, except for those with rich imaginations, like web novel authors, who were the first to go.
And today, it's already the 18th of May.
It's been 18 days since this update announcement.
In this period, apart from the higher death rate on the first day, humanity also quickly found solutions.
Solution one: keep busy.
For example, the rule that prohibits throwing trash into bins, aimed at increasing the workload for cleaners, keeps people busy and reduces wandering thoughts.
Solution two: Immediately remove all forms of video and film from all platforms.
Initially, just horror videos and movies were removed, but it was soon discovered that even a slightly eerie tune, under the current tense circumstances, could easily trigger the most primal fear in people.
Thus, music and videos across the web were simply and crudely taken down, along with imposing strict control over most communication forums.
The associated censorship keywords totalled at several hundred thousand.
Solution three: Eradicate the roots of anything that might bring ghosts to mind.
Dolls, figurines, mannequin displays were all uniformly destroyed.
Anything that could evoke the uncanny valley effect was destroyed.
Morgues and crematoriums were all closed down.
The entire city's lighting facilities, including those in every household and street lights, were on day and night, to prevent darkness from shrouding any place as much as possible.
Strategy four, divert attention.
Distract oneself by focusing on sexual thoughts, filling one's mind with such trash to avert thinking about those fears.
That's why Chen Yi had been standing on the street whistling at women passing by on the sidewalk, and why these women responded with abnormal enthusiasm.
It was like a large movie studio.
Everyone was on the verge of a mental breakdown, forcefully suppressing the fear inside and letting their inner desires surface to suppress things that shouldn't arise, playing their own roles.
As for the odd conversations heard from the pedestrians on the street.
They were all for the sake of completing the daily task of speaking a thousand words with people.
Talking to oneself did not count; it had to be a conversation with another person.
That's why the cleaner had been staring at him so eagerly, because only if Chen Yi responded would the cleaner's previous words count towards the daily task—otherwise, it was indeed just idle talk.
As for which sentence could be counted towards the daily task.
The progress bar for daily tasks on the panel served as the standard.
...
Chen Yi flicked the spent cigarette from his fingers nonchalantly in front of a man in a suit nearby, then glanced at his personal panel in the upper left corner.
"Player Name": Chen Yi.
"Player Equipment": None.
"Player Skill": D-grade Skill "Calm and Composed".
"Player Title": None.
"Points Balance": 1038.
"Monthly Rule":
1: "Active Talent" task progress: 782/1000.
2: "Calm and Cool" task progress: 0/0.
He had already spoken 782 sentences today and still needed to speak 218 more to complete today's daily task.
As for the points.
Starting from May 1st, for each day the "Active Talent" daily rule task was completed, a reward of 1 point was given, amounting to a total of 18 points to date.
The remaining 1020 points were obtained from the Yancheng Law Enforcement Bureau.
And at that moment—
A young man came racing toward him on a motorcycle, screeching to a stop in front of Chen Yi, whistled long, grinned and said, "Yi, I'm not late, am I?"
"Right, Yi, do you remember that counter boy we met last time we went to buy medical gloves?"
"That guy's dead. I went to get supplies today and he wasn't there, so I asked around."
"Hey, guess what."
"That guy's wife, to keep herself and the men from thinking about that thing, wore a red sexy nightgown, hung red lanterns all over the bedroom, and lit lots of candles all while her husband was off from work and not home."
"She planned to give her man a little romantic surprise."
"As a result, when the guy opened the door and saw this thing in the bedroom, his mind uncontrollably brought up that thing and he died on the spot."
"Sigh, what a pity, huh? What was that woman thinking?"
"She's really doing more harm than good to her man."
"If you ask me..."
"..."
Chen Yi, who had just raised his hand to greet him, could not help but twitch the corners of his mouth slightly as he saw that with the mere lift of his hand, the man before him started babbling endlessly like a babbling brook, making him feel a throbbing pain in his temples.
If the daily rule task "Active Talent", which tortures everyone by forcing all players to speak a thousand words with people every day, were to favor anyone.
It would be this person right in front of him.
A severe chatterbox.
Someone who was despised wherever he went, but now, the whole world was forced to become chatterboxes just like him.
"Hold on a second..."
Stopping him with a somewhat tired voice, Chen Yi said, "If I'm not mistaken, you must have completed your daily task shortly after you got up and opened your eyes, right? You really don't need to talk so much now."

chapters.title: Chapter 3 "Special Event Cleaner.
chapters.content:
However, it would have been better if he hadn't replied at all.
Once he did, the man in front of him got even more excited.
"Yi, I totally forgot until you mentioned it this morning, let me tell you..."
"..."
Seeing that he couldn't interrupt the man in front of him at all, Chen Yi silently took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket and casually dropped it on the ground as if by accident. Then, as he bent down to pick up the cigarettes, he began to speak.
"Tuberculosis Rabbit, get ready..."
According to psychology.
If someone keeps talking non-stop and you can't interrupt, you can drop something on the ground accidentally and start talking while bending over to pick it up.
This way, you can interrupt them without them noticing.
However, he had barely started speaking.
When he was interrupted again.
With a triumphant posture, Tuberculosis Rabbit straddled the motorcycle, laughed with his hands on his hips, and said, "Yi, did you forget that we read 'How to Deal with Chatterboxes' together?"
"Hey, hey, didn't anyone tell society."
"When they publish stuff about how to deal with chatterboxes, chatterboxes themselves can also see the book, right?"
"It's really..."
The voice suddenly stopped.
Chen Yi's face turned grim, and unable to bear it any longer, he picked up the pack of cigarettes from the ground, stuffed it into Tuberculosis Rabbit's mouth, and said word by word.
"This is my last warning to you!"
"If you keep buzzing in my ear like a fly, I'll sew your mouth shut!"
"Now, drive the damn bike!"
"To Zhongdeng Square on Fengcheng Fourth Road, there's a job there that needs doing!"
"...Oh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking somewhat aggrieved, took the pack of cigarettes out of his mouth, wiped off the saliva, and tucked it back into his pocket. Then he twisted the throttle, ready to head onto the main road.
But just before departing, he hesitated for a moment and tentatively asked.
"Yi, I bought several types of medical gloves this time, they're all in the storage box. Do you want to have a look? One of them is even..."
"Shut the hell up!!!"
"Oh... you're so fierce..."
...
Chen Yi, feeling a sense of hopelessness, sat on the back of the motorcycle with an unlit cigarette in his mouth, his eyes blank and staring aimlessly at the traffic around him.
Feeling the gusty wind whistling by on both sides.
Tuberculosis Rabbit.
He was an abandoned baby raised in the same federal orphanage as Chen Yi.
He started talking earlier than other children, and once he started, he always had a lot to say.
And because he had a birthmark resembling a rabbit on his chest.
He was nicknamed Tuberculosis Rabbit.
The name, a bunny that couldn't stop chatting, was simple and clear.
After leaving the orphanage, he always followed Chen Yi, and most of the time, he was a great help; if only he spoke less.
How perfect it would be if there were a rule where every player could only speak ten sentences a day.
...
And heading to Zhongdeng Square on Fengcheng Fourth Road, meant it was time to get to work.
Since the disaster struck, they had gained a new profession.
"Special Incident Cleaners."
To put it simply, it was about collecting bodies, the bodies of those who had dropped dead because of the ghosts that appeared in their minds. The scenes of death were often extremely gruesome, with shattered bodies and blood everywhere.
Just one look could suppress the rising fear in one's heart.
And fear... usually meant that the countdown to the rest of your life had started ticking down from three seconds.
They were employed by the Yancheng Law Enforcement Bureau.
Specifically tasked with cleaning up such death scenes, the typical law enforcement officers, upon seeing this scene, found it hard to control their own fear, and they would have to find some people with tougher nerves and stronger psychological endurance.
Before the disaster, they had worked in a mortuary, so naturally, they were among the first to be recruited by the Law Enforcement Bureau.
The compensation for Special Incident Cleaners was not bad.
Handling a corpse would pay thirty thousand yuan, plus any Skill Fragments that fell near the body belonged to the cleaner.
...
Quickly.
By five o'clock in the afternoon.
Chen Yi and his companion had also arrived at Zhongdeng Square on Fengcheng Fourth Road.
By this time, the area had long been cordoned off with police tape, and quite a few officers from the Yancheng Law Enforcement Bureau were stationed around in uniform, forcing awkward smiles as they chatted with each other.
A few massive speakers nearby were blaring electronic music at deafening volumes.
"If I were a DJ, would you love me?"
"Oh, who's the king of electronic music, I'm the king of electronic music!!"
Everything was done as much as possible to keep the atmosphere onsite from becoming too serious, to prevent triggering certain unwanted crises.
And around the perimeter tape, not a single onlooker was present.
See, it isn't too difficult to change human nature's penchant for rubbernecking.
People can still prioritize what's truly important.
Upon seeing Chen Yi and his partner arrive,
An officer leading the team outside the tape hurried over to Chen Yi, his tone somewhat stern as he spoke softly, "The incident occurred inside a restaurant on the first floor of Zhongdeng Square."
"A customer, for reasons unknown, had images of ghosts flash across his mind and dropped dead on the spot."
"Flesh and blood were splattered everywhere."
"This scene was witnessed by other patrons within the restaurant."
"Fear began to spread rapidly; many customers couldn't suppress their emotions, and images of ghosts involuntarily appeared in their minds, ultimately resulting in their simultaneous deaths."
"Those who die in violation of the May Rule leave behind scenes of extreme strangeness."
"The situation is now somewhat complex."
"We haven't been able to promptly conduct a full sweep of the mall's patrons. While customers on the second, third, and fourth floors have stayed put voluntarily, they were aware of what happened on the first floor."
"What you need to do is to clean up the corpses on the first floor as quickly as possible, and try your best to calm the emotions of customers on the second floor and above."
"And the faster, the better—nobody knows how long the other patrons inside the mall can keep their emotions under control."
"If one customer loses control of their emotions and is completely invaded by fear..."
This captain, his voice trembling with fear in his eyes, said, "Then the entire mall could be entirely invaded by fear and could even let the whole city... those damn..."
"Hey!"
Noticing the captain's growing emotional distress, Chen Yi frowned heavily, clapped the man's shoulder forcibly, and spoke in a magnified, solemn tone.
"Control your emotions."
"Huh!"
At this moment, the captain realized that he had almost lost control of his emotions. He wiped the sweat from his forehead with a sense of relief from having narrowly escaped death and looked at Chen Yi with gratitude before speaking again.
"If you complete this operation successfully, a bonus of five hundred thousand yuan will be allocated to you as a reward."
"No need."
Chen Yi shook his head, "Just stick to the old rules. Convert every ten thousand yuan into 1 Point and transfer it to me."
"This..."
After hesitating for a moment, the captain nodded, "Although I don't know what you need Points for, the higher-ups should agree. After all, those things aren't valuable, and everyone has them."
"It's just that gathering them is somewhat troublesome."
"Speaking of which, it's strange. Recently, many people in the city have started exchanging cash for Points. It's odd because clearly, Points are ostensibly useless, even though for some reason, the higher-ups have also begun collecting them recently."
"Sure."
Chen Yi's brow furrowed slightly, but he didn't speak further. Instead, he pulled out a pair of medical rubber gloves from his carry-on case, put them on along with a mask, and then walked through the cordon with Tuberculosis Rabbit, striding into the Zhongdeng Square ahead.
Fear doesn't naturally bring ghosts to mind.
But under the high pressure of the May Rules, every individual is actually thinking about ghosts deep down. Once someone witnesses another person dying on the spot for violating the May Rule, the fear that has been forcefully suppressed within bursts out uncontrollably.
The imagination then starts to spread!
...
PS: Friends, the new book sets sail. If you find it to your liking, you can support me by adding it to your collection, leaving comments, rewarding, and voting with your monthly tickets.
Thank you for your continued support. I hope to tell a different story and introduce some unique characters in this book.
I also kindly ask you to follow the book daily during the new book period, as the number of daily followers determines the promotion to the next recommendation slot.
As per the old rule, after we successfully make through the new book period...
On the day it goes on the shelves, it will be a torrent of updates with 20,000 words per day until bursting!

chapters.title: Chapter 4 His dictionary contains every word, save for fear.
chapters.content:
"Click."
The crisp sound of a lighter echoed as Tuberculosis Rabbit lit the cigarette at the corner of his mouth, standing at the entrance of Zhongdeng Square, looking towards the gruesome sight inside the mall. His mouth twitched uncontrollably a few times as he muttered softly.
"Yi, I suddenly understand what the experts mean by 'retiring early is good for your health.'"
"If I take on a few more jobs like this, I might start losing control of myself."
"Let's get to work."
Chen Yi didn't speak, just calmly took a folded rubber bucket out of his suitcase.
Then he began to throw the chunks of flesh on the ground into the rubber bucket one by one.
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit squatted to one side, adjusting the concentration of the sodium hydroxide solution and pouring it into a spray bottle, preparing to use it to clean the bloodstains on the floor tiles.
This was the best thing for cleaning blood that had not been there for long.
What needed to be borne in mind was that blood contains protein, and cleaning it with hot water would cause the blood to coagulate.
It didn't take long.
In less than an hour,
Chen Yi and his partner had cleaned up almost all the chunks of flesh and blood scattered in the lobby on the first floor.
Next, Tuberculosis Rabbit transformed into a grout worker, meticulously cleaning the blood that had seeped into the gaps of the floor tiles.
For others, the rule of not thinking about ghosts in their minds could be extremely harsh.
But for Chen Yi, this rule seemed as if it didn't exist.
He was born without the emotion of fear.
In his dictionary, there were all sorts of words, but the word 'fear' did not exist.
Fear does not equate to ghosts.
But a major reason why ordinary people find it difficult to eliminate the image of ghosts from their minds after they appear is because under the influence of fear, it is difficult to control one's emotions.
If there is no fear,
even if one thinks of ghosts, they can easily expel the thought from their brain as if entering a sage-like state.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, lying on the ground, carefully cleaned the bloodstains while casually asking,
"Yi, all the money the Law Enforcement Bureau has given us recently has been exchanged for Points."
"Is that really okay?"
"What if these Points turn out to be useless later on? Or say they don't have much use."
"If we hadn't exchanged the money for Points, that would have been a huge fortune."
After Chen Yi finished cleaning the pieces of flesh from the floor, he began to pick up the Skill Fragments next to the bodies. Whenever a player died, a Skill Fragment would drop next to their body.
Just like looting equipment from a monster.
"It definitely will," he said softly as he busied himself, "It's a simple logic, with two updates in a row happening on the 1st of the month."
"Since this month's update added Points as rewards,"
"next month, there's a good chance that these Points will be used to purchase Skills, or have some other greater function."
"Otherwise, there would be no reason for these Points to exist."
"But..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit hesitated and then said tentatively, "I do think the same, but currently, only a few people in the market are collecting Points, including the Law Enforcement Bureau who seem not to be very aware of it."
Chen Yi shook his head, scooping all the Skill Fragments from the floor into his embrace,
"Do you remember the last time that major nation waged war on the smaller one?"
"The moment the war began, the currency of that major country began to devalue, and almost everyone thought that this devaluation was temporary, that if you only exchanged for this major country's currency now..."
"Once this major country had calmed the storm of war, the currency would quickly return to its original exchange rate."
"That way, you could make a large profit."
"Indeed, that was the case, but how many people actually profited from it?"
"To make a correct judgment is not very difficult, and almost anyone with a bit of awareness could do it."
"But to use one's own hard-earned money to carry out that judgment requires a certain courage,"
"Everyone can make judgments, but not everyone has the courage to act upon them,"
"Just like now,"
"No one is a fool, but... it's just that most people can't afford to lose, they don't want to, like a gambler, put all the wealth they have accumulated over the years on the table,"
"Oh,"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in semi-understanding, then spoke up, "Then isn't the speed at which we are collecting Points too slow? Those companies that have already accumulated a lot of wealth, they can collect more Points than us,"
"..."
Chen Yi fell silent for a while before continuing his task at hand,
"Having the cognition to make judgments is important,"
"Having the courage to execute them is even more important,"
"But more crucial than those two is having the capital to execute on a large scale,"
"And it is the last point we are lacking,"
At that moment——
「Ding, congratulations on obtaining a D-level Skill Fragment "Premeditated Blast Punch" x1.」
「Ding, congratulations on obtaining an E-level Skill Fragment "Prosperous Fireworks" x1.」
「Ding, congratulations on obtaining an E-level Skill Fragment "Heaven on Earth" x1.」
「...」
Chen Yi silently collected all these Skill Fragments into his own backpack,
Backpacks were something each person had,
Provided for free during the first update,
A backpack with a space of 100 slots, where the same kind of items could be stacked infinitely in one slot, but it seemed that only Skill Fragments could be placed inside,
Items like the white gloves he had in his hand could not be fitted into the backpack,
He guessed that only items produced by the game could be stored in the backpack,
He had collected a total of 18 Skill Fragments this time,
The highest level fragment was a D-level one,
Add to that the Skill Fragments he had gathered before,
He now possessed a total of 308 Skill Fragments,
Five Skill Fragments could combine into one complete Skill, but at this time he only had one complete Skill,
「Skill Name」: Calm and Composed,
「Skill Level」: D-level,
「Skill Type」: Passive Skill,
「Skill Effect」: When your heart harbors not a trace of fear, your physical capabilities will double,
「Skill Introduction」: "Knowing full well the dangers of the tiger mountain, one still heads straight towards it,"
A passive Skill that perfectly suited him,
Keeping his physical capabilities doubled at all times,
Chen Yi shook his head without speaking and started to pack his tools to leave the place, having completed his task,
The Law Enforcement Bureau placed great importance on Skill Fragments,
Although the dropped Skill Fragments belonged to the "Special Event Cleaners," a high bounty of 50,000 yuan was still offered for a single fragment,
To be precise,
Some wealthy companies were also collecting Skill Fragments at high prices,
Whether Points will be of use in the future is still unknown, but the existence of Skill Fragments can genuinely alter the world's structure,
Only,
For now, in the whole city, only "Special Event Cleaners" could come into contact with Skill Fragments.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 "Ding, congratulations on discovering the Reincarnation Treasure Box, triggering a special event.
chapters.content:
Soon.
Chen Yi and his companion had cleaned up all the bodies in Zhongdeng Square, leaving the scene spotlessly clean, a testimony to their professional skills.
"Let's go."
Just as Chen Yi was about to leave, he narrowed his eyes and halted in his tracks, peering at a chest that had suddenly appeared not far away.
The floor here had just been washed.
He was certain that there had definitely been no treasure chest here before; he had no idea when it had appeared.
A wooden chest, roughly the size of four stacked shoe boxes, with a few gemstones on top emitting a dazzling light.
And with the chest as the center,
a massive blood-colored pattern like a spider web had appeared at some unknown time.
It almost covered the entire first floor of the square.
"Yi..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit swallowed nervously, "Didn't you just say what ordinary people lack is the ability to execute judgment?"
"So what kind of judgment should we give this chest, and then how should we carry it out?"
"..."
Chen Yi stood in place, staring at the chest in silence without speaking.
It was obvious that this chest was a product of the game.
To approach it and open it, there were only two possible outcomes.
A reward, or... a punishment.
At that moment—
The walkie-talkie on his chest suddenly transmitted the urgent voice of the captain of the Law Enforcement Bureau outside the mall: "What's happening in there?"
"A blood-colored membrane has suddenly risen around the exterior of the mall, just like an eggshell."
"It's rising at an alarming rate, about to envelop the entire mall."
"Hello? Hello? Can you hear me? Evacuate quickly, clear... the survivors... immediately..."
Just as Chen Yi was about to reply, the captain's voice coming through the walkie-talkie suddenly began cutting in and out, followed by a burst of static, and, shockingly, all that could be heard was the buzzing of an electric current.
At this moment.
A panel popped up in front of both Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
'Ding, congratulations on discovering the Reincarnation Treasure Box, triggering a special event.'
'Players who open the chest will receive a reward.'
'When a player's fear level fluctuates between 70% and 100%, there is a 30% chance of obtaining a reward and a 70% chance of releasing a nightmare.'
'When a player's fear level fluctuates between 30% and 69.99%, there is a 50% chance of obtaining a reward and a 50% chance of releasing a nightmare.'
'When a player's fear level fluctuates between 1% and 29.99%, there is a 60% chance of obtaining a reward and a 30% chance of releasing a nightmare.'
'When a player's fear level is at 0%, there is a 100% chance of obtaining a reward, and the reward will double and crit.'
'Before the chest is opened, all present players cannot leave the site.'
'Players may only leave once the chest has been opened by a player.'
'ps1: This event can only be probability triggered in May.'
'ps2: When the death toll in one place due to violation of the May rules reaches more than 10 at once, there is a certain probability of this event being triggered.'
"Reincarnation Treasure Box?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit was initially stunned, but a flicker of excitement passed through his eyes, "Isn't this chest specially prepared for you, Yi?"
Yi naturally had no fear, which he knew.
If they let Yi open the chest, wouldn't they be 100% guaranteed to get the reward?
Chen Yi also slightly raised his eyebrows, apparently surprised; such good fortune falling from the sky was unexpected.
And at that moment—
Footsteps were also heard from the second floor of the mall, clearly those survivors who had hidden on the second floor had seen the panel notification and were coming down to check things out.
He didn't hesitate at all.
He strode forward and opened the treasure chest, and in the instant the reward appeared, he didn't check it carefully but went straight to grabbing his tools and heading outside of the mall.
In the instant they opened the treasure chest.
The membrane that shrouded the outside of the mall also disappeared, and the treasure chest on the ground, along with the bloody patterns, vanished without a trace.
Everything seemed as though it had returned to normal.
...
Seeing Chen Yi and his companion come out safely, the team leader who had been waiting anxiously outside hurried over with a face full of worry and asked in a rushed tone, "What happened inside?"
"Nothing."
At this moment, Chen Yi had no desire to linger, wishing only to leave quickly and check the gains from the treasure chest. He brushed the question off, "Everything inside has been cleared. You guys can go in and check for yourselves."
"Oh, and don't forget to transfer the Points for this operation Into my account."
Players could add each other as friends and freely trade Points.
Having said that, he took Tuberculosis Rabbit, hopped on the motorcycle parked nearby.
A twist of the throttle, and he quickly left the area.
...
Meanwhile, inside the mall.
A man with narrow eyes and a shorter stature stood on the second floor of the mall, witnessing the entire process of Chen Yi and his companion leaving.
After a slight hesitation, he slipped into an unoccupied changing room on the second floor.
He picked up the phone and dialed a number.
"Boss, I've discovered something new."
"Just now, a panel popped up in front of everyone, saying something about triggering an event, with a treasure chest."
"Opening the treasure chest would give a reward, and it said the event could only be randomly triggered in May."
"Right, right, right, then I'll come to report to you in person right now."
After speaking, the somewhat short man stuffed his cellphone into his pocket and squeezed through the crowd, heading toward the first floor.
Those who still came to the mall on such days were either desperate for money or incredibly daring.
After the version update and the game's arrival.
The government ordered supermarkets crucial to people's livelihood to keep their doors open, and they couldn't raise their prices by more than 100%.
Most other shops, like restaurants and luxury boutiques, had long since closed their doors and hidden away at home.
After all, people valued their lives.
But... as the saying goes, the bigger the storm, the more expensive the fish.
The more shops that closed, the better business was for those still operating, and they could arbitrarily hike up their prices. The price of a wrench in the hardware stores had gone up 30-fold, yet it was still in high demand.
Such massive profits led many business owners to keep their doors open, despite the dangers.
Perhaps, in the hearts of most people.
There was the thought of seizing the opportunity to make a fortune.
This event would eventually pass, and by then, they could change their social status with the wealth accumulated during this time.
In fact, there were quite a number of people with this mindset.
Even during this period, there were individuals and funds massively bottom-fishing in the stock market.
A world of chaos.
...
Now back in his rented room, Chen Yi, having shed his outerwear and casually chugged a bottle of mineral water, sat on the sofa, looking expectantly at the system notification.
'Ding, congratulations on receiving the reward from the "Reincarnation Treasure Box".'
'Additionally, since your fear level was at 0% when you opened the box, the reward has been maximized.'
This was a reward for a special event.
It was also his first time triggering a special event, and he believed the rewards would not disappoint his expectations.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 A person without opinions often lives a very happy life.
chapters.content:
"Reward Critical Hit"
"Ding, congratulations on obtaining 1000 Points, which has critically hit for 10k Points."
Gazing at the panel before him.
Chen Yi's breathing became increasingly rapid—this was 10k Points!
He had worked his tail off for the Law Enforcement Bureau for over half a month, and only managed to earn 1000 Points, but now, just by opening a treasure chest, he had a whopping 10,000 Points.
Over there at the Law Enforcement Bureau, they priced them, one thousand yuan per Point.
If calculated at this exchange rate, 10,000 Points amounted to an entire billion yuan.
He had become a billionaire in an instant.
Of course, he wouldn't be foolish enough to exchange his Points for cash. According to his guess, Points would be the mainstream currency in the future, and the world order would be reshuffled.
Whoever had enough Points and sufficient Skill Fragments would have a say in the future.
Cash, it was no good anymore.
"Yi?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting beside him noticed Yi's current state and was slightly astonished, "Is the reward very generous?"
In his mind, Yi had always been the type who, even if he were to die in the next second, could calmly light a cigarette and welcome death in this second.
It was rare to see Yi in such a state, looking... as if he had won a jackpot.
"Phew!"
Chen Yi took a deep breath, crushed the mineral water bottle in his hand, and tossed it onto the floor beside him before turning his head to stare intently at the Tuberculosis Rabbit, "The chest rewarded ten thousand Points."
"The current situation in Yancheng is that a portion of people have already guessed the importance of Points in the future and have begun to buy up Points on a large scale."
"These people probably have the most Points."
"As far as I know, their purchase prices vary significantly."
"There are prices ranging from three hundred to twelve thousand for one Point."
"They've even sent out people to trade eggs for the Points held by the elderly."
"Beneath the entire city, an undercurrent is surging."
"We can't compete with them for two reasons: first, we don't have enough capital, and second, it's easy to draw their attention."
"After we buy a certain amount of Points, they'll slaughter us like pigs and eat our flesh."
"But now... there might be another way for these people to collect Points."
Chen Yi stood up from his chair, paced with closed eyes inside the room, and after a moment suddenly stopped in place, turned his head toward the Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a hint of gloom flickering in his eyes.
"This treasure chest, the emergence of this special event, has two premises."
"1. It can only be probabilistically triggered in May, which is this month."
"2. There's a certain chance this event will be triggered if more than ten people die in one go due to the ghosts appearing in their minds."
"That is to say, as long as this news gets out, there will definitely be some forces deliberately creating the conditions to trigger this special event."
"If we can think of it, there's no reason others can't."
"And our advantage is that we can open chests with a 100% chance, and the rewards are guaranteed to critically hit. That is to say, if we're willing to, we just need to keep intentionally creating these two premises before the new version update comes in June, we will have enough treasure chests, as well as... a large number of Points!"
"This..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit's mouth gradually fell open—he understood Yi's meaning, but he hesitated for a moment before voicing his doubts, "Yi, I think I get what you're saying, but although the city is quite chaotic right now, if we kill on such a large scale..."
"Won't we be gunned down on the spot before the June update rolls out?"
"No, no, no."
Chen Yi, with an unpleasant expression, paused for a while before shaking his head, "In fact, there is no need to kill. Those people just died because they broke the rules by having ghosts appear in their minds. It's enough to create fear and make them think of ghosts."
"I would not do this, but there will definitely be those who will, as long as they go to some more secluded places."
"Like the suburbs?"
```
"Or how about an abandoned construction site?"
"It would be easy to create a scene to trigger that special event, and once the news spreads, there will definitely be a bloody storm."
Chen Yi suddenly fell silent, and after a moment, he sighed lightly, "Alright, I admit that I was actually tempted just now."
"But this is reality, not some game."
"I'm not mad enough to harm ordinary people, especially the good ones, they don't deserve to lose their lives for this."
"Good people should get good returns."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit sneered in disdain, "Yi, you always say good people will be rewarded, but last time when you stopped a couple from arguing, you were stabbed by the man."
"You ended up in the station, and because there were no cameras, the couple's testimonies matched, painting you as a would-be rapist, and the man acted in self-defense."
"I haven't seen you receive any good returns."
"..."
Chen Yi frowned, lit a cigarette, placed it in his mouth, grabbed his coat from the chair, and strode out of the house, "That's exactly why I hope other good people can get what they deserve."
"It's important not to let them down, after all."
"Let's go."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged his shoulders and didn't speak. He didn't care about any of this; whatever Yi did, he would just go along with it.
He was a man with no opinions of his own.
A person without opinions often lives a happy life.
Of course, that's assuming there's someone to follow all along."
...
"Continue."
Inside an office building.
A young man dressed in a suit, draped in a coat, stood emotionless in front of the floor-to-ceiling window. The cigar between his fingers twinkled with a faint crimson glow in the unlit office.
"Yes."
The skinny man inside the office lifted his head towards the young man's silhouette and whispered, "Director Gao."
"These are the only two conditions to trigger the chest."
"Those two guys opened the chest and then left. I don't know what the reward was."
"Hmm."
The young man stood before the floor-to-ceiling window with a faint, almost imperceptible smile. Overlooking the brightly lit city below, he spoke softly, "Give him a hundred thousand and let him go."
"Yes."
A glint of surprise flashed in the skinny man's eyes as he eagerly tucked the stack of cash handed over by the young man's assistant into his chest and then walked out of the office with large strides. He was the one who had witnessed Chen Yi retrieving the chest at Zhongdeng Mall earlier.
After this skinny man left,
The nearly hundred-square-meter office was left only with the young man standing before the window and an old man standing in the corner.
No lights were on in the office.
It looked somewhat gloomy, an odd contrast to the bright cityscape below.
The man didn't speak.
Nor did the old man, who simply stood quietly in the corner, looking towards the young man's silhouette, with a hint of pity involuntarily spilling from the corners of his eyes.
"Uncle Wei."
The young man suddenly spoke up, not turning around but continuing to look down at the brightly lit city below.
"I turned 24 this year."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 7 "Have you heard the saying that if you walk the night road often enough, you will eventually encounter a ghost?
chapters.content:
The elder in the office did not speak.
He knew that his young master didn't need a response right now, but rather needed a listener.
After pausing for a moment, the young man's expression became somewhat absent-minded as he watched the familiar yet foreign city through the pale blue smoke rising from the cigar in his hand.
A quiet voice rang out.
"What should a 24-year-old man be experiencing?"
"Just graduated from college and preparing for an internship, or perhaps already married with a wife and children?"
"And I, Gao Yiming."
"Am already the chairman of a company about to go public, with nearly 1000 employees under me waiting for me to pay their salaries every month—behind these more than 1000 employees are 1000 families!"
"I'm strong, aren't I?"
"Since taking over the company at 16, I have forcefully silenced all objections to take this position."
"Ever since then, I've never failed in any major decision for the company."
"I don't know if it's due to fate's favor, or if I truly have the strength, but under my control, the company has grown bigger and bigger."
"If it hadn't been for this unexpected software update, I should already be preparing for the IPO and the bell-ringing ceremony."
"Uncle Wei, do you think I'm strong?"
"Strong."
The elder leant forward slightly and lowered his head, his voice hoarse and raspy, "In this world, there are not many people stronger than you, young master."
This was not flattery.
He had watched the young master ascend step by step; the young master was a true business prodigy.
Sometimes, he even wondered if the young master could foresee the future, otherwise, how could he always find the right options in each company decision?
"Is that so?"
Gao Yiming's expression was somewhat vacant as he muttered with his head lowered, "Since I was 16, I've been constantly making decisions, constantly making decisions."
"From deciding the company's direction to how to handle a disruptive employee."
"Not one decision was wrong."
"But... the more it's like this, the more I start to fear making decisions."
"Because I know, nobody can make the right decision every single time, and at my current position, just one wrong decision could drag me and the whole company into the abyss."
"I've started to fear making decisions."
"I don't know if my next decision will be wrong, what consequences it could bring."
"And this time..."
"The software update introduced Points."
"I ordered most of the company's cash flow to be utilized, trying all means to have the employees collect Points through various methods."
"Tell me, was this decision right?"
"..."
After the elder was silent for a while, his hoarse voice slowly said, "Young master, you've never doubted your decisions before."
"Hmm."
Gao Yiming nodded, slowly crushed the cigar in his hand into the ashtray, and after pausing for a moment, he said softly,
"Send someone to find Chen Yi."
"Clarify what the rewards for the treasure chests are."
"If the rewards are generous... then we should be able to manually create treasure chests, right?"
"Just let ten people die, and there's a chance to get a treasure chest."
"Only ten people, in the scheme of things today, their disappearance won't attract too much attention, right?"
"Uncle Wei, arrange this for me."
"Understood."
The elder nodded, casually made his way slowly to the door, gently leaving the office, and closed the door behind him.
...
After the elder left.
The spacious office now had only Gao Yiming.
Gao Yiming let himself be enveloped by darkness, feeling the chill to his bones. He tightened his overcoat around him and curled up in his executive chair in a daze, murmuring, "This year is my zodiac year, isn't it?"
"The Year of the Rabbit."
"Pretty good."
It was May, strictly speaking just the threshold of summer.
But the temperature in Yancheng was extremely high, already resembling the heat of midsummer.
The air conditioning in the office was set very low.
The temperature was quite cold.
He didn't know when it had started.
He liked it this way, setting the air conditioning's temperature extremely low, then putting on a thick coat and curling up in the boss's chair, always feeling... there was a strong sense of security in doing so.
...
"Captain Li."
Uncle Wei, after walking out of Director Gao's office, his murky old eyes stared at the dossier handed up by his subordinate about Chen Yi. After a glance, he dialed the phone of a small team leader in the Law Enforcement Bureau.
"Garden District, Chen Yi."
"This man is within your jurisdiction. Director Gao wants to find him."
"Bring him here."
After that, he hung up the phone.
Such a minor figure didn't even warrant the security department of the company to take action.
When a company gets to their size, they have to support more than just employees.
...
Inside the Garden District.
Chen Yi, who had just left the rental house and hadn't yet left the district's gate, was stopped.
"..."
Chen Yi, with a calm expression, stared at the man in plain clothes in front of him. After a brief pause, he spoke softly, "Captain Li, long time no see. Looking at this situation, it seems like you're here for me."
"Mhm."
Captain Li, somewhat impatiently, took a pair of handcuffs off his waist and shook them in the air, "Having to operate in the middle of the night really pisses me off. Are you coming with me willingly, or do I have to cuff you?"
"No need for small talk either."
"I've always had no fondness for rapists like you."
"..."
Chen Yi slightly raised his eyebrows and suddenly laughed, "Are you talking about that night?"
"That night, the Law Enforcement Bureau had already investigated the scene, based on the footprints there."
"I was just passing by."
"And the disorderly footprints beneath that couple were all caused by the couple themselves."
"My suspicions have been cleared, yet you still call me by such things as a rapist, which leaves me somewhat unhappy."
"So what?"
Captain Li, annoyed, glanced at Chen Yi, "Not planning to rape, but when a couple is fighting, why do you give a damn?"
"Are you that noticeable?"
"..."
Chen Yi lifted his head to sweep a look at the empty security room and the camera that had long been abandoned, then rested his gaze on the plain clothes of Captain Li, nodded casually, and said, "You do have a point."
"You came in plain clothes, huh? You didn't drive your flashy little car either."
"And you came alone."
"Looks like it's a personal action. If it's a personal action, would you make a trip report to the bureau?"
Captain Li's brow furrowed, a sudden sense of unease rising within him as his hand slowly reached inside his lining.
"Do you have the right to inquire about my schedule?"
"Mhm."
Chen Yi, looking satisfied, nodded and suddenly laughed again, "Looks like you didn't make the report."
"Captain Li."
"Have you ever heard the saying that if you walk the night long enough, you're bound to encounter ghosts?"
The next second—
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had slipped behind Captain Li at some point, was holding a towel-wrapped stick high with a fierce and excited expression, leaping into the air!
Aiming for home plate.
"Bang!"
A silent striking sound arose, much like a person walking in the night deliberately heading to a dark corner to release a somewhat muffled fart.
...

But I... forgot what my author number is.
I tried for a long time but couldn't find my author account, which is a bit distressing.

chapters.title: Chapter 8 "Sweet as Honey 520" special limited-time event is officially launched!
chapters.content:
```
Following that,
Captain Li, without any hesitation, just fell asleep.
Meanwhile, Chen Yi and his companion silently headed towards the basement, carrying Captain Li.
Garden District.
An old neighborhood that had seen many years, where most of the residents were tenants.
Each house was subdivided into several units and rented out to recent university graduates who were not yet financially well-off.
There was no property management.
The property management company had long since withdrawn.
The security cameras were broken and nobody bothered to fix them; even the streetlights within the neighborhood had been sabotaged a long time ago, leaving only the lights from individual households still shining.
Under the rule of "Calm and Cool,"
even the most frugal person wouldn't dare to sleep with the lights off.
Nearly every household was noisy.
The shared rental homes that were disliked on normal days now became a lifesaver.
With more people, the fear within one's heart would diminish a bit.
Gathering together to sing, drink, and watch movies, it was indeed hard to remember the existence of ghosts.
Almost each family had already smashed all their mirrors.
A normal person,
just by staring in the mirror for a minute, would not expect to sleep well that night.
And under the May rules of "Calm and Cool," it wasn't just a matter of sleeping poorly anymore, it was a matter of whether you'd still be able to see the sun rise the next morning.
No one noticed the commotion downstairs.
Or rather, even if someone did take notice, they wouldn't meddle in others' affairs; under such special circumstances, it was better to look out for oneself first.
...
"Huff."
Having finally moved Captain Li into an abandoned basement, Chen Yi wiped the sweat off his forehead, took a deep breath, and looked around: "The weather has been getting hotter lately."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood nervously at the entrance of the basement, constantly peeking outside: "Are we going to kill him?"
This basement had no door.
Just the frame of cement.
Never sold during the original housing sales, it had since remained vacant.
Dust had accumulated on the floor, and cobwebs stretched from the ceiling to the floor.
Chen Yi didn't respond, instead searching through Captain Li's belongings to find his phone and checking the last call record.
"Uncle Wei."
"Hmm."
Chen Yi took out a cigarette from his pocket, put it in his mouth, and casually dialed the number listed under the name Uncle Wei.
Soon,
the call connected.
A voice of an elderly man soon came through.
"Have you brought the person?"
"No."
Chen Yi shook his head, casually glancing at Captain Li not far away: "There was a bit of a hiccup, but that's not important. I hear you're looking for me."
There was a sudden silence on the other end of the phone, and after a moment, the elderly man's voice could be heard again.
"Rising Group, 29th floor."
"Our boss is waiting for you. Come over soon; it's in your best interest as well as ours."
The call was then hung up.
"Rising Group?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit frowned and said uneasily: "I know of this group; they are involved in various businesses including real estate, municipal investment, finance, and so on."
"What do they want from me?"
```
Chen Yi pocketed Captain Li's phone, paused for a while, and then said softly.
"What else could it be for?"
"We didn't interact much in the past, and now they suddenly ask us over in such an impolite manner. Naturally, it can only be because of the chest just now."
"The other party is quite well-informed."
"Should we go then?"
"Go to hell."
Chen Yi disdainfully glanced at Captain Li lying on the ground. "Most likely, they want to snatch our reward. I heard that Rising Group's security department has several hundred people."
"Would we fare well if we went over?"
"Although Yancheng is rather chaotic now, some semblance of order still exists. They wouldn't dare to be too blatant, but if we went there voluntarily, it'd be no different than walking into a trap."
"So, what should we do with this Captain Li?"
Just then—
As time ticked into the early hours of the morning, a voice suddenly rang out in the ears of everyone in Blue Star.
"Game event announcement!"
"May 19th to May 21st, the '520 The Sweetness of Love' special limited-time event officially begins!"
"All players can participate in this event during these three days."
"Event One: Event gift pack."
"All players can purchase a gift pack priced at 88 Points, originally 648 Points."
"The pack includes the following contents: random Prop x1, random Skill Fragment x5."
"This pack is limited to one purchase per player."
"Event Two: The Sweetness of Love."
"During the event, if you say 'I like you' to someone you truly have feelings for, you will receive the special limited rare title 'Lucky Child of the God of Love'."
"This title has the following attribute: there is a one in ten chance that when you face certain death damage, it will transfer the damage to the person you like."
"Event Three: Cupid's Mischief."
"During the event, Cupids will appear randomly, each with a significant amount of health and quite impressive attacks."
"Cupid will only stay for 2 hours each time."
"Within these two hours, those who succeed in killing Cupid will divide 'Cupid's Gift Pack' according to the ranking of damage dealt, receiving a large amount of rewards."
"Whoever lands the finishing blow will receive additional rewards."
"The Snow Sea Project Team wishes all players a fun time in this limited-time event."
"Oh my god..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the panel before him and couldn't help but slowly open his mouth wide: "How does this thing look exactly like those pay-to-win games, with limited-time events and packs."
"Such a familiar strategy."
"The mastermind behind this global game must be a domestic game manufacturer, right?"
"Just missing a pay-to-win panel."
"But I have to say, the event for 88 Points seems like a good deal, and it even rewards a random prop. You know, we haven't even seen a hint of a prop up until now."
"This must be the first time the game is releasing props."
As he got caught up in the topic, the Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but continue somewhat compulsively, "Especially the second event, The Sweetness of Love, rewarding a special title for completing the event task."
"Isn't this Title Effect a bit too strong?"
"A one in ten chance of avoiding certain death?"
"Although the probability is low, when you're actually facing certain death, even a one percent chance is still hope."
"It's just that..."
He continued with a hint of wistfulness: "I probably won't be able to get that title. confessing to someone you truly like—that task seems a bit too difficult."
"Don't look at me."
Chen Yi shrugged his shoulders, sighing somewhat helplessly: "I can't get it either."
"If I had known there would be rewards like this, I should have at least liked someone. Just not sure if it's still time to start liking someone right now."
"Forget it, let's deal with Captain Li first, then go out and see what the situation is like."

chapters.title: Chapter 9 Title Name Lucky Child of the God of Love.
chapters.content:
And just as Chen Yi and another person were still in the basement dealing with Captain Li.
Yancheng.
A man hiding in a rental room reading a book was startled by a prompt sound in his ear and instantly, a trace of ecstasy flashed through his eyes as he hurriedly turned over to unlock his phone.
He located the contact list.
Immediately, he sent a text message to Goddess No. 1.
"I like you."
The next second—
「Ding, congratulations on completing the limited-time event "The Sweetness of Love" and obtaining the rare permanent title "Lucky Child of the God of Love".」
「Title Name」: Lucky Child of the God of Love.
「Title Effect」: When facing certain death damage, there is a one in ten chance that the damage will be transferred to the person you like.
The man then nervously, gingerly, with a face full of excitement and anticipation, looked over the 399 contacts in his phone.
The remarks were all uniformly consistent.
「Goddess No. 2.」
「Goddess No. 3.」
Sent "I like you." with a single button press.
The next second—
「Ding ding ding...」
The incessant dinging by his ear kept on ringing.
Following that.
The title panel changed again.
「Title Name」: Lucky Child of the God of Love.
「Title Effect」: When facing certain death damage, there is a one in ten chance that the damage will be transferred to the person you like.
「Transfer List」: Xiao Yali, Li Peiqi, Hu Jiaye, Zhang Shaohua...
「Title Introduction」: When you face certain death damage, there is a one in ten chance for each person on the transfer list to block that damage for you.
The specific algorithm is as follows.
When you encounter certain death, the system starts checking whether Xiao Yali triggers the chance to block the damage for you.
If yes, then Xiao Yali dies.
If no, it skips Xiao Yali and starts checking whether Li Peiqi triggers the chance to block the damage for you, and so on until the list has been completely checked.
-
The man read over the title introduction again and again, overcome with excitement, and when he was sure it was exactly as he had imagined, he couldn't help but burst out laughing boisterously.
"Hahahahaha!!!"
He was a bootlicker.
To be precise, the King of Bootlickers!
Even since he was young, he had a bad habit—seeing a girl meant liking a girl.
Regardless of their appearance.
He felt like he just simply liked girls; if a girl spoke to him more than three sentences, he would feel like he had fallen for her.
No matter how they looked, he always managed to find something appealing about them, leading to an irretrievable infatuation.
So...
He saw one, he loved one.
Just like that, his contact list grew by a whole four hundred girls.
Initially, at best, he could have just been the King of Bootlickers.
But now... suddenly, he felt as though he was covered with many layers of resurrection armor; 400-plus people were queued up in front of him—how on earth could he die now!!
"Hahahaha!!!"
The man couldn't help but leap off the bed, one hand on his hip, as he pointed up at the ceiling and roared.
"I, Li Yide, am destined to become the supreme king among bootlickers!!"
This sudden global event stirred quite a commotion worldwide.
It almost instantaneously shattered the existing structure.
It made those who were still hesitating about the usefulness of Points suddenly firm in their belief that Points would become the main currency of the future.
Originally, Points were only distributed as daily activity rewards.
No place could use Points, nor could they be obtained elsewhere, making them seem like Commemorative Coins.
But now, Points could be used to buy gift packs, which meant that Points had already acquired one of the fundamental properties of a currency.
Then, in the future,
whether Points could buy other gift packs or be used for spending was beyond question!
Within merely an hour,
streets and alleys were swarming with countless people using cash to buy Points!
From fund managers at certain companies to fishmongers, everyone stood on the streets, waving cash in their hands, shouting out offers to buy Points at high prices.
Just that, there were very few sellers.
Those selling Points weren't fools; originally, when they were useless, everyone sold them, but now... the potential of Points was laid out on paper, so who would be willing to sell them.
...
"I have 18 Points here, I'll give them to you."
In a three-bedroom apartment in Yancheng,
About eight or nine people were gathered in the center of the living room.
An elderly grandmother with dim eyesight trembled slightly as she tapped on her panel, then turned her head towards her grandson in his twenties.
"Child, I'll give you these 18 Points."
"The world changes too fast, we don't understand it, and don't know how much longer we can live."
"But you said these Points can be exchanged for some gift pack that will make you strong, so I'll give them to you."
"I'm close to the grave, and these won't be of any use to me, but if you can live happily, my heart will be content."
"Granny."
A man in his twenties tearfully accepted the 18 Points transferred by his grandmother, and then turned to look at the others in the room: "Mom and Dad, don't worry."
"This gift pack of 88 Points is an opportunity!"
"Most people only have 18 Points right now, rewarded from the daily rule activity tasks, and even some have sold their Points long ago."
"Most can't afford this gift pack of 88 Points."
"And this limited-time gift pack lasts for only three days."
"As long as we pool our money and buy this gift pack, getting a prop and a few random Skill Fragments, no matter how things develop later, we would be ahead of others."
"Ahead of those who can't afford the gift pack."
"Rest assured, I will protect you all in the future."
"Hmm."
The father, lying on the sofa with a cigarette in his mouth, drew a deep breath with some helplessness and sighed, "First, the three generations pooled money for you to buy a house, and now, three generations are pooling again for you to buy this gift pack with Points."
"Just handle it."
"You understand more about games, we don't know how things will change in the future, and you youngsters are better at adapting to new things, with a greater chance of survival."
"Dad."
The young man's tears paused briefly before he continued, "Don't worry."
"Alright, alright," the mother standing aside began tying on an apron and complained, "Stop the whining, show some manliness. Since everyone is awake, let's have some supper."
"Suddenly, with this special event, I guess no one will be able to sleep for a while."
"Speaking of which,"
the woman hesitated for a moment but turned her head towards the middle-aged man smoking on the sofa, "Hey Dad, why don't you confess to me? In 'The Sweetness of Love' event, confessing to someone you truly like comes with a Title Reward."
"Hmm."
The man closed his eyes with some annoyance and said hoarsely, "There is a Title Reward."
"The Title Effect is that when you are about to die, there is a one in ten chance that the person you love will die in your stead."
"What kind of reward is that?"
"Utter nonsense."

chapters.title: Chapter 10 In this world, there is no one who can withstand my 34 bullets.
chapters.content:
The title reward for this event was indeed a bit strange.
Its effect entails that when you confess to someone you truly like, in the face of certain death, there's a one in ten chance that the person you like will take the deadly blow for you.
Is this love, or is it enmity?
The woman remained silent, not speaking.
She couldn't be sure whether her man refrained from confessing because he didn't want to put her in danger,
or because he was worried about being exposed as not truly liking her and therefore not confessing to her.
But she didn't dwell on it for long.
She quickly found her answer as she also didn't want to confess to her own man. She was certain she truly liked her man; she just didn't want to put him in any danger.
The woman who understood this no longer cared that her family was around, bent down, and kissed her husband's cheek before promptly scurrying into the kitchen with a flushed face.
"I'll go make you a bowl of noodles."
"Cough."
The grandfather, who sat to the side smoking his dry pipe, silently closed his eyes, his voice full of a wistful sigh, "I'm old now, but in my youth, I, too, had my fun."
"Pfft."
The son, who witnessed it all, couldn't help but laugh out loud when he saw his father's somewhat embarrassed, suddenly reddened face.
And at that moment—
"Boom!"
Suddenly, fireworks exploded outside the window.
Incredibly dazzling.
Extremely gorgeous.
The fireworks were so beautiful, lighting up the entire sky, their colorful display truly mesmerizing.
The son, looking at the fireworks filling the sky, couldn't help but become lost in thought.
As for the future, he was uncertain.
All he knew was that at this moment, he really wanted to protect his family.
...
"So beautiful."
Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit, stepping out of the residential area, looked toward the young people setting off fireworks in the street, and stood still, silently admiring the fireworks display.
It must be said.
The resilience of humankind seems very strong.
Even after such a catastrophe, they still had the mood to set off fireworks. These bundles of fireworks dispelled much of the gloom over the city and lessened the fear in many people's hearts.
"That's pretty nice."
Chen Yi casually took out a cigarette, placed it in his mouth, and after lighting it, pulled out another one and handed it to Captain Li: "Have one too."
"Thanks."
Captain Li's expression looked a bit dreadful as he took the cigarette. He did not light it but instead put it in his pocket. After a long silence, he finally said, "It was Rising Company that told us to catch you. Since I failed here, they will continue to send people after you."
"This company has quite a bit of power."
"Hmm."
Chen Yi nodded nonchalantly, patted Captain Li on the shoulder, "Go on, it's probably not going to be a quiet night. Go and be with your family."
"Alright."
Captain Li nodded with a complicated look, hesitated for a moment, and then said in a deep voice, "Thanks for this time. If there's anything in the future, you can count on me. I'll definitely help if I can."
"Got it."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked strangely at Captain Li's retreating figure, then turned to Chen Yi, "Yi, what were you talking to him about alone in the basement just now?"
"It's as if you turned him into a different person all of a sudden."
Chen Yi shook his head with a light chuckle, draped his arm over the Tuberculosis Rabbit's shoulder, and stood in place looking up at the sky full of fireworks, "I had a chat with him about the declarations made before joining the force, reminded him to find his original resolve."
"Oh, I don't buy it, do you, Yi?"
Just as Chen Yi was about to say something more.
"Boom!!!"
Suddenly, a loud crash resounded beside them. The powerful shockwave made the asphalt road under their feet tremble violently, even cracking it.
And then—
A voice rang out in the ears of Chen Yi and his companion.
"Ding, area horn."
"A Cupid has appeared in your vicinity, please eliminate it as soon as possible. In two hours, Cupid will escape."
"Killing Cupid will reward players based on their damage ranking with a large split of 'Cupid's Gift Bag.'"
"The last hit will grant an additional reward."
As the voice faded,
they saw a Cupid as tall as a three-story building appear at the end of the street.
The image was exactly the same as Cupid's image.
Bare-chested, with blond curly hair, holding a giant bow and arrow, and the arrowhead was shaped like a red heart.
The only difference was that it was much bigger than the Cupid in Western mythology.
A three-story high creature indeed had a shock factor.
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes slightly, discarded the cigarette butt at his feet, firmly stamped on it a few times, and then looked up towards a vantage point not far away with a light chuckle.
"This damn reality is getting more and more interesting."
"In real life, you can fight boss battles."
"Go to that building's rooftop."
"Alright."
...
Chen Yi, who took the elevator to a rooftop not far from Cupid within a few minutes, slowly pulled out a sniper rifle from his embrace.
For 88 Points, one could purchase a limited-time gift bag of 520, which contained five random Skill Fragments and a random prop.
This sniper rifle was the prop obtained from the random draw.
It could be stored in a backpack, very convenient, and didn't take up space.
'Prop Name': Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle.
'Prop Level': B-level prop.
'Prop Effect': Each bullet inflicts fixed true damage equal to 3% of the enemy's Maximum Health Value, with an execution effect that can kill an enemy whose Life Value is less than 5% with a single bullet.
'Prop Restrictions': Unlimited bullets, but each shot costs 100 Points.
'Prop Introduction': In this world, no one can withstand my 33 bullets.
A B-level prop, which is a nice prop.
This sniper rifle, it's as if it was made for boss fights.
The greater the health, the higher the damage.
But if you were thinking of using it to kill a normal person, that would be tougher, as a bullet would only cause 3% of the target's Maximum Health Value in damage.
Firing a bullet at the forehead at close range might only make the person vomit blood.
Be it man or god, 33 shots would prove fatal.
One hundred Points a bullet, for 33 bullets that's 3,300 Points.
That meant using this rifle to kill someone would cost 3,300 Points.
And at that moment—
A huge leaderboard appeared above Cupid's head.
The glowing characters were clear enough for people hundreds of meters away to see.
'Damage Leaderboard'
'First Place: Zhang Kaiqiang'
'Damage Dealt: 782 points.'
'Second Place: Li Qiqiang.'
'Damage Dealt: 679 points.'
'Third Place...'
Over thirty people were already on the leaderboard.
But the damage each had caused was not high. Through the sniper scope, he observed that inflicting a cut near the toe amounted to around 100 points of damage.
And at that moment, the rumble of tank treads was approaching from not far away.
Clearly, the military had been deployed.

chapters.title: Chapter 11 "Old Rules, Combined Plan!
chapters.content:
And the health bar above Cupid's head showed no change at all.
It remained at one hundred percent.
Although the specific Life Value of Cupid could not be seen, the event description had already made it clear that Cupid had a high Maximum Health Value, including strong attacks.
"Bang."
Chen Yi propped the sniper rifle on the edge of the rooftop and lay on the ground, without any hesitation, pulled the trigger.
The enormous recoil left his right shoulder slightly numb.
As a bullet about the thickness of a flashlight battery, with a red tail flame, rushed towards the gigantic Cupid at a speed hard to capture!
Immediately after.
A painful roar came from the mouth of Cupid.
And a huge blood-red number of five digits burst forth above Cupid's head.
'-30000'
One shot took away thirty thousand Life Value.
And on the damage ranking, Chen Yi almost instantly climbed to the top spot and left the second-place and others far behind.
"Thirty thousand Life Value,"
Chen Yi muttered softly, then started to reload and prepare the next bullet.
Thirty thousand Life Value represented three percent of Cupid's Maximum Health Value.
That is to say, Cupid had a total of one million Life Value.
Based on the calculation of losing 100 drops of blood per hit, one million Life Value would need... a lot of hits.
"Even the numbers are showing."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, lying beside him, couldn't help but speak in a complex tone, "The more I look at it, the more it feels like a game, it always seems a bit absurd."
"Deep down, there's always a sense that something like this couldn't possibly be happening in reality."
"But reality is indeed unfolding this way."
Just as Chen Yi was getting ready to fire the second shot.
His face suddenly changed drastically, and he bellowed.
"Run!"
Then, without any hesitation, he rolled several times, moving far from his current location, and Tuberculosis Rabbit also reacted in an instant.
The next second——
"Boom!!!"
A gigantic arrow was seen shooting directly at them, plowing a trench three meters wide into the rooftop, almost collapsing it.
Faintly, they could hear the screams of terror from the household below.
"Damn it."
Chen Yi was just about to pack up the sniper rifle and continue running when he suddenly noticed that Cupid didn't seem to be shooting a second arrow, but rather, was attacking the people nearby with the bowstring of the massive bow in hand.
By now, many people had gathered around Cupid, attacking him with all sorts of weapons.
There were those wielding axes, chainsaws, and machetes.
There was even someone driving a steamroller, continuously running over Cupid's big toe with the massive steel cylinder.
And someone else operating a crane, manipulating the mechanical arm, hooking the giant hook onto Cupid's groin, and then continually raising the mechanical arm.
Unbeknownst to when,
Many people had already surrounded Cupid.
