Everyone was attacking Cupid in front of them in their own way.
But... it seemed to be effective.
Although Chen Yi was still in the unshakable first position, the second place had already dealt ten thousand damage, only less than twenty thousand damage behind him.
The second place was the one operating the crane.
It was apparent that Cupid's groin was a weak point.
The immense hook dealt not insignificant damage to Cupid.
And Cupid's attack method was also somewhat simplistic, just continuously attacking nearby people with the bowstring.
As long as one was quick and made accurate predictions, it was possible to dodge.
Just... not every prediction could be correct.
And then, a scream emanated from the crowd; a man was swept by the bowstring and froze on the spot, even managing to let out a scream.
Immediately after.
The body then split into two halves, blood spattering all over the scene.
Chen Yi took a deep breath and found a new spot, his heart gradually forming a suspicion.
Cupid presumably would only use his bow and arrow to counterattack against long-range attacks, or to say, attacks with high-damage, in other situations, he would only use the bowstrings in his hands to attack people nearby.
"Bang."
The dull sound of a gunshot erupted.
'-30000'
A huge blood-red damage number once again appeared above Cupid's head.
"Boom."
Another arrow struck right after.
The rooftop was blasted into a three-meter-wide trench again, and the family downstairs had long evacuated, they weren't fools, how could they stay here continuously.
After this attack fell, Cupid no longer paid them any attention and continued to attack the people around him.
Having a count in his heart, Chen Yi took another deep breath, found a new spot, and fired his third shot.
"Bang."
'-30000'
...
"Out of the way."
Two young men riding motorcycles, looking somewhat alternative, with fierce and excited expressions, shouted at the dozen men in front of Cupid, then raised the steel wire in their hands, "Let us handle this!"
As their words fell.
The dozen men in front instantly cleared a space.
Immediately afterward.
The two young men exchanged glances and tied the ends of the few millimeters thick steel wire to the rear seats of their motorcycles.
Then with expressions of fear and excitement, they tremulously said,
"Old rules, fusion plan!"
It was a game they often played where two motorcycles would accelerate from 30 to 180 miles per hour at the same time, maintaining a steady parallel course no matter the speed of travel.
This required a firm grasp of motorcycle control and mutual understanding between them.
"Damn it."
One of the young men, hands trembling slightly, lit a cigarette for himself, straddled the motorcycle with the cigarette in his mouth, put on his helmet, and lifted his feet off the ground.
He slowly placed his hand on the throttle.
"Never underestimate a man."
"This is damn crazy."
The next second—
The two helmeted young men fiercely twisted the throttle with their right hands.
Almost simultaneously, the two motorcycles roared like wild beasts breaking free from a cage, charging straight ahead!!!
80 mph, 120 mph, the speed quickly reached 180 mph!
The boys, with excitement and fear, yelled as they twisted the throttle to its limit.
The two motorcycles zoomed past Cupid's side, and the tense steel wire between them, like a sharp blade, carried a huge force directly towards Cupid's lower leg.
Almost instantly!
Blood gushed forth.
'-120000'
A colossal blood-red damage number emerged from Cupid, a full 120,000.
Unfortunately,
The steel wire did not sever Cupid's leg, it only cut deeply into it, causing Cupid to stumble to the ground.
"Roar!!"
Along with Cupid's painful roar, the wire snapped.
As the two motorcycles were racing at high speeds, they met a sudden halt due to the snagged wire rope, losing control and crashing into a nearby green belt on the road.
The motorcycles tumbled through the air seven or eight times before they heavily hit the ground.
Everyone instinctively paused what they were doing in their hands and looked up in unison to the excessively exaggerated damage number above Cupid's head!
A full twelve thousand.
This was the damage caused by the two young men riding the motorcycles.

chapters.title: Chapter 12 "Ding, congratulations, a Cupid that appeared near you has been successfully taken down.
chapters.content:
"This can actually work..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit still crouched on the rooftop stared at the huge damage number above Cupid's head with a stunned expression.
He really didn't expect that Cupid could be attacked in such a way.
Those two men riding motorcycles really had some wild ideas.
"It is quite impressive,"
Chen Yi, also lying on the rooftop, glanced at the damage leaderboard.
He was still at the top.
The 120,000 damage was split between those two boys.
Each was credited with causing 60,000 damage, which had landed them on the leaderboard as well.
Without pausing, he silently took another shot.
"Bang."
As the gunshot rang out again and just after pulling the trigger, he skillfully rolled several times, evading the arrows fired at them.
He had already figured out the pattern.
Cupid only retaliated with arrows when facing ranged attacks.
In other situations, he would only use his bowstring to counterattack.
And at this moment—
No less than four tracked armored vehicles and fully armed soldiers arrived at the scene.
But they did not fire immediately.
Firstly, there were too many civilians crowded around Cupid; firing at this point would not be accidental harm, it would be a mass burial.
Secondly, this was a city's bustling district.
Many high-powered weapons couldn't be used here due to the excessive danger they posed.
Among those surrounding Cupid, only a portion left after seeing the military arrive, while many others, instead of leaving, clenched their teeth and focused their attention. They dodged Cupid's attacks while constantly striking at him with their weapons.
The most strenuous among them was a young man in his early twenties.
This man was biting his lips hard, wielding a short dagger in his hand, dodging and repeatedly stabbing his dagger into Cupid's feet.
He was the young man who had gathered his entire family's Points to buy an 88 gift package.
From the package, he drew a C-grade Prop, a dagger.
The effect of this dagger was to cause continuous bleeding damage.
And with each attack, the bleeding effect would stack another layer.
In other words, as long as he attacked sufficiently often, he could inflict enough bleeding buffs on this monster to cause substantial damage!
He was not a smart man.
But he could clearly feel that the world order was slowly changing; although it was a disaster for humanity, it also presented an opportunity to change the class structure.
Reflecting on history,
Every widespread disaster always shifted the classes.
He knew that if he wanted to have enough strength to protect his family in the future, he needed to seize as many opportunities as he could now.
"Slash!"
An evasion that wasn't timely led to Cupid's bowstring grazing past his scalp.
The young man, feeling a sting and with a look of fear and disgust, touched the top of his head, then realizing it was just a scalp wound with no serious harm, bit down on his teeth and charged back into the fray without any hesitation.
...
"This kid."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit curiously looked at the damage leaderboard above Cupid's head and the young man darting around with a dagger between Cupid's feet, uttering in surprise.
"Based on the live combat stats, the young man wielding the dagger should be Han Yu, who is third on the leaderboard."
"This kid must have a Prop or something like a Skill Fragment, I guess,"
"The damage value he's causing on the leaderboard keeps rising, and it seems like each attack causes more damage than the last."
And at this time—
This Cupid had only less than 47% of his health left.
The health was dropping rapidly.
Chen Yi had caused the most damage among them.
And the soldiers below had also taken to the field with combat knives, as they realized that ranged attacks not only risked harming civilians but would also provoke Cupid's arrow retaliation.
A loss not worth the gain.
Better to just engage in close combat.
Although they had shouted for the civilians to leave, leaving the battlefield to them, the situation was sadly that no one wanted to leave, and they could not resort to force.
Finally.
Cupid's health bar had dropped to 7%.
Chen Yi lay prone on the riddled rooftop, resting the sniper rifle on the Tuberculosis Rabbit's shoulder, rubbing his own sore shoulder, eyes fixed on Cupid's dwindling health bar.
This thing really does have some serious recoil.
"Understood, understood."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit silently took out a cigarette, placing it in his mouth, and propped his shoulder against the butt of the sniper rifle, finding a comfortable position before he mused.
"After all, Yi, you've fired so many shots, the recoil is huge, it does indeed make the shoulder hurt."
"Using my shoulder to bear the recoil is only right, I totally get it," he said.
"The only thing I don't understand, Yi, is why you made me lie on the ground, and then you on top of me?"
"Honestly, it's not really about the pain."
"It just feels a bit awkward, even though we grew up together in the orphanage and aren't that squeamish, it's just that I always feel..."
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to keep rambling on.
Chen Yi, eyes locked on Cupid's health bar now at 5%, didn't hesitate and pulled the trigger then and there!
"Bang!"
The huge recoil instantly shut Tuberculosis Rabbit up.
And at that same instant.
A voice rang in the ears of everyone nearby.
"Ding, congratulations, Cupid nearby has been successfully killed."
"Next, according to the damage ranking list, we will divide 'Cupid's Big Gift Pack.'
-
'Damage Ranking'
'First place: Chen Yi'
'Damage caused: 530,000 points.'
'Second place: Han Yu.'
'Damage caused: 122,399 points.'
'Third place: Li Shipeng.'
'Damage caused: 60,000 points.'
-
'The player who dealt the final blow, "Chen Yi," will receive an additional reward package.'
'We hope you all enjoy the game.'
-
The top damage dealer was undoubtedly Chen Yi, despite the two boys on the motorcycle causing a terrifying 120,000 damage in one hit.
But it was just a one-time thing.
Not like Chen Yi, who might only cause 30,000 damage at a time, but could do so consistently.
The second place, Han Yu, was the young man wielding a dagger.
With his sustained bleeding damage, he also caused a total of over 100,000 damage.
The third place was the boy on the motorcycle, with a full 60,000 damage.
The middle-aged man manipulating the crane to hook Cupid's crotch did not do low damage either, it just wasn't sustained; once his mechanical arm was cut off by Cupid's bowstring, he was somewhat out of commission.
And at that time.
Chen Yi had already vanished from the rooftop, appearing in an unoccupied underground chamber.
It wasn't that they knew which nearby residential building had an underground chamber.
But for some special reasons.
Most of the basements in this residential area had not been sold or rented out, the developer hadn't allocated them to tenants, so they remained empty.
They had become the secret bases of many children.

chapters.title: Chapter 13 Congratulations to the player on obtaining the title "Fatal Strike"!
chapters.content:
At this moment, Chen Yi's ears were filled with a barrage of notification sounds, unceasingly ringing.
"Ding, you used a B-grade prop, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle, fired a total of 17 shots, consuming 1700 Points, your current Points Balance is 9338."
-
"Ding, you participated in the 'Cupid's Mischief' limited-time event, successfully assisted in killing Cupid, and caused 530,000 damage, topping the 'Damage Dealt Leaderboard' in first place, earning the following rewards."
"Reward 1: Earn 1 Point for every 100 damage dealt, totaling 5300 Points."
"Reward 2: Earn 1 Skill Fragment for every 10,000 damage dealt, obtaining a total of 53 random Skill Fragments."
"First place exclusive rewards: 1 C-grade random prop, 10 C-grade random Skill Fragments, and 3 C-grade Universal Skill Fragments."
-
"Ding, congratulations for landing the final hit on Cupid during the 'Cupid's Mischief' limited-time event, earning the following rewards."
"Reward 1: One spin on the roulette wheel."
"Reward 2: You have earned the title 'Fatal Strike.'"
-
"Ding, congratulations on being the 7th to kill Cupid in the global 'The Sweetness of Love' limited-time event, and have earned the following rewards."
"Reward 1: One chance at the roulette wheel."
"Reward 2: 1000 Points."
-
The dense succession of notification sounds kept ringing by Chen Yi's ear, clearly showing a bountiful harvest this time.
Chen Yi first summed up his Points earnings, a total gain of 6300 Points, and after deducting the cost, he still made a good profit.
With the Points, he broke even completely.
Next, there were the 53 random Skill Fragments, which were certainly a substantial fortune.
It's known that only when a player dies does their corpse spawn a random Skill Fragment.
Moreover, the random Skill Fragments were not just randomly graded but also the Skill Type was completely random.
He had collected Skill Fragments for so long, and so far, he had only been able to successfully synthesize the skill "Calm and Composed."
Besides that, he was also rewarded with 10 C-grade random Skill Fragments and 3 C-grade Universal Skill Fragments.
He had never come across Universal Skill Fragments before.
Just as he was preparing to take a closer look at what these Universal Skill Fragments meant,
a sudden prompt popped up beside his ear again.
"Ding, detected that the player's backpack contains Skill Fragments that can be synthesized, automatic synthesis completed."
"Congratulations to player for acquiring the E-grade Skill 'A Cup of Coffee.'"
"Skill Name": A Cup of Coffee.
"Skill Level": E-grade.
"Skill Type": Active Skill.
"Skill Effect": When the player drinks a cup of coffee, for the next 24 hours, their urine will turn into fragrant, delicious, full-bodied coffee.
"Skill Limitation": None.
"Skill Introduction": "A scientist forced to survive in the wilderness developed this skill after being rescued and spent three years researching it."
"..."
Chen Yi stared at this skill with a somewhat expressionless face, wanting to come up with an applicable scenario for this skill.
But...
He really couldn't think of any situation where this skill could be useful.
He didn't remember picking up any Skill Fragments of this kind.
It couldn't be that among the random Skill Fragments just now, there happened to be five fragments of this particular skill, could it?
And the notification sounds didn't stop there; they continued.
"Ding, detected that the player's backpack contains Skill Fragments that can be synthesized, automatic synthesis completed."
"Congratulations to player for acquiring the D-grade Skill 'Mirror Man'"
"Skill Name": Mirror Man.
"Skill Level": D-grade.
"Skill Type": Active skill.
"Skill Effect": Once the skill is used by the player, they will enter the Mirror World within the mirror, lasting for ten minutes.
"Skill Limitation": Within the duration, if the player doesn't return to the real world through any mirror, they will be left in the Mirror World forever. After using the skill once, it will go into a 24-hour cooldown period.
"Skill Introduction": "In a certain sense, if every player had this skill, you could all move into the Mirror World and establish a new civilization. Of course, it's possible your ancestors already did this a long time ago."
"This skill is not bad,"
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully. It was a decent escape and infiltration skill, useful in many scenarios, much more practical than that 'Call for a Coffee' skill.
No prompt for skill synthesis sounded again.
It seemed that this time, the random Skill Fragments only allowed him to synthesize two Skills.
Then he looked at the 10 C-grade Skill Fragments.
All of them looked good, but none could be synthesized. Only by collecting five identical Skill Fragments could he synthesize a complete Skill.
And that's when he turned his attention to the C-grade Universal Skill Fragment.
"Prop Name": C-grade Universal Skill Fragment.
"Prop Level": C-grade.
"Prop Effect": Can replace any C-grade Skill Fragment and be used for synthesis.
"Skill Introduction": Much like a four-block piece in Tetris, this can fit anywhere and is applicable to all C-grade Skill Fragment syntheses.
"This is a good thing,"
Chen Yi stared at the three C-grade Universal Skill Fragments in this backpack, somewhat astounded. With this item,
it meant he only needed two identical C-grade Skill Fragments to use the three C-grade Universal Skill Fragments and synthesize a complete C-grade Skill.
He indeed had two identical C-grade Skill Fragments in his backpack at the moment.
But he hesitated and chose not to use them for synthesis.
It seemed a bit wasteful to use them like that.
It might make more sense to save them until he had four identical Skill Fragments and then use one Universal Skill Fragment to make the most of it.
He decided to save them for later.
In dire situations, where he absolutely needed to synthesize, he could still do it easily and without much effort.
Then he turned his attention to the other rewards.
A C-grade random prop x1, two spins on the roulette draw, and a title "Fatal Strike".
He first looked at the title "Fatal Strike".
It wasn't for any particular reason.
It was simply too conspicuous in the inventory, flashing constantly, as if fearing it wouldn't be noticed.
As his attention focused on it, the panel emerged.
"Title Name": Fatal Strike.
"Title Level": Blue.
"Title Effect": When equipped, each attack has a 3% chance of dealing a critical hit.
"Obtaining Method": Complete the final blow on Cupid during the "520 Limited-Time Event".
"ps1: Once equipped, it cannot be removed. Do you choose to equip it?"
"ps2: This item can be freely traded among players."
"Confirm."
Is that even a question? A thing that can enhance combat strength, of course, I'll equip it.
The next second—
Chen Yi looked up somewhat befuddled at his forehead, at the four large characters flickering with blue light above his head.
"Fatal Strike!"
Wait a second!
This title wasn't supposed to appear in the character panel, was it literally appearing above the player's head?
And so big at that?! p>And it emits light!!
And flickers!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 14 "308 Deities Battle the Dragon King's Third Prince.
chapters.content:
"Um..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up, somewhat bewildered, at the four large characters emitting blue light above Chen Yi's head, and couldn't help swallowing his saliva muttering, "I don't know why, but I just feel a very strong sense of discomfort."
Ever played a web game?
In those games, the player's avatar always had some flashy, shining titles, some of which you had to spend a lot of money to acquire.
Yes, that's right.
The title currently hovering over Chen Yi's head looked exactly like the ones over characters' heads in web games.
"Shoot me now."
Chen Yi looked up at the title shining with blue light above his head, his lips uncontrollably twitching slightly. Could it be any more glaring?
The title wasn't really big; the size of the font was about the size of a shoebox.
And it was in 3D.
But it was unclear how it existed; no matter the angle you looked from, you could clearly see the three-dimensional title, even if he just stood there and looked up, he could still see it.
"Sigh!"
He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressed the speechlessness in his heart, and then began to look for the button to turn off the title's special effects.
Once a title is equipped, it cannot be removed.
Comprehensible.
But they should at least give him the option to turn off the special effects, right?
Thirty minutes later.
Chen Yi stood there expressionless in silence. After a while, he took out a cigarette from his pocket, took a deep drag, and then sat down on a stone pillar nearby, gazing vacantly into the dark corners of the basement.
He had found the entrance to adjust the title's special effects.
There were only two options.
'Make the title start to blink'
'Keep the title constantly illuminated'
Yes.
He had only two choices: to keep the title lit up all the time, or to have it blink like the laser lights in a nightclub.
As for turning off the special effects?
Don't even think about it.
No chance.
"Um..."
After hesitating for a moment, the Tuberculosis Rabbit still squatted next to Chen Yi, consoling him, "Look on the bright side, at least we'll be the hottest guys in the club the next time we go to a bar."
"Hmm, that's indeed true."
Chen Yi nodded, looking down at the flickering blue light at his feet through the swirling smoke.
Having a permanent flashlight, with a little added critical hit chance.
Guess that's a pretty good perk.
Although it means going out will be far too flashy — from now on, stealth is out of the question. Can you imagine an assassin, dagger in hand, with a huge title above his head?
He let out a light sigh and could only accept this reality, turning to look at the other rewards he had received.
C-grade random prop x1, two chances for the roulette draw.
'Prop Name': Live Streaming Ticket.
'Prop Grade': C-class.
'Prop Effect': Initiate a live stream that can accommodate up to 100,000 players. When the user initiates a live stream, 100,000 players around the world will randomly receive notifications to enter the live stream room. If the players choose to join, it will cost them 6 points.
'Prop Restriction': The live stream can last for a maximum of 3 hours, the user will only receive half the points earned, and it's a one-time use prop. If not used within 24 hours, the prop will automatically disappear.
'Skill Introduction': "Come on, initiate a live stream that's all about you!"
"What's this...?"
Chen Yi stared at the prop's effects for a moment and then nodded with some insight.
This prop sounds pretty powerful.
Entering the live stream room requires 6 Points per person, so for a hundred thousand people, that would be 600,000 Points.
Even if only 300,000 Points could be collected, it would still be an enormous number!
But there are two limitations.
The first is an explicit restriction, if the Prop isn't used within 24 hours, it will disappear.
The second is a hidden limitation, when the live broadcast starts, only one hundred thousand players will receive a notification asking if they want to spend 6 Points to enter the live stream.
The limited time event on May 20 has made everyone realize the importance of Points.
At this point, spending 6 Points to watch a live stream, I guess not many people would be willing.
In the end, the actual number of people who enter the live stream room may not even reach ten thousand.
"How about we put on a really exciting show?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit standing by thoughtfully pondered, "Since ancient times, gorgeous visuals have always brought in more traffic. We could stage a battle of 308 heavenly beings against the Dragon King's Third Prince."
"Surely everyone, old and young, would be willing to spend 6 Points to enter the live stream room to see what's going on, right?"
"Who could resist that?"
"Would anyone be able to resist such an enticing show as 308 heavenly beings fighting the Dragon King's Third Prince?"
"Wait a second... What if it was 308 Dragon Kings' Princes fighting against one heavenly being, would the viewership be even higher?"
"No use."
Chen Yi shook his head, "Do you know about Maslow's hierarchy of needs?"
"Physiological needs like food, clothing, shelter, and transportation rank first, and safety needs rank second. The kind of need you're talking about is third."
"After one's belly is full, then they can think about lust."
"At the moment, many people are anxious and fearful."
"Right now, what's most important for them should be the need for security."
"We should do some sort of strategy guide, and have the live stream title say something like, 'How to get a head start in the event in one minute'."
"That's not enough, it needs to be more eye-catching, like... 'I'm a transmigrator, I know the content of the next version update, come into the live stream and listen to me talk'."
"Let me think it through."
After mulling over for a while, Chen Yi looked at the countdown until the Prop's disappearance and decided to use his two chances at the roulette lottery first.
Suddenly, a huge virtual roulette wheel appeared in front of him.
There were roughly a hundred slots on it.
He couldn't see the Props and panels within the slots, but he was able to judge the rarity of the items in the slots by their size.
Generally speaking.
The smaller the slot, the rarer the items inside.
Suddenly, the pointer in front of him started spinning, and after going around dozens of times, it slowly came to a stop.
It landed on a slot that was considerably large.
Chen Yi shook his head, somewhat disappointed. Lotteries were indeed too enticing, but it was free anyway, so it was good to get anything at all.
Then, the next second—
A panel popped up before his eyes.
'Prop Name': B-grade Enchantment Stone.
'Prop Level': B-grade.
'Prop Effect': Can endow a single B-grade Prop with a random new effect through Enchantment.
'Prop Restriction': Single-use Prop.
'Prop Introduction': "Warrior, you must believe, Enchantment is the final destination for all players!"
He only had one B-grade Prop, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle.
To be precise.
It was also the only Prop he had on him at the moment.
This B-grade Enchantment Stone could only be used on that Prop, but he didn't use it right away. Instead, he first used his second lottery chance.

chapters.title: Chapter 15 "I don't know why, but I feel full of zest for life.
chapters.content:
Immediately after,
another panel appeared.
"Prop Name": Red Moon Claw Knife.
"Prop Level": C-level Prop.
"Prop Effect": This knife is extremely sharp, capable of destroying nearly everything before your eyes, and it can be charged.
The charging rules are as follows.
After you speak one sentence, your Claw Knife will begin to charge, and for every ten sentences spoken thereafter, one charge progress is added.
Once charging ends, you can unleash a blade light that cuts through everything before your eyes.
Its power has no limit.
In theory, as long as you charge long enough, you could even split an entire planet in half with a single strike.
"Prop Restrictions": You must expend the charged blade light before you can start charging again.
"Prop Introduction": "You know? I really hate those silent types who don't say a word."
"..."
Chen Yi was somewhat speechless and helplessly turned to look at the Tuberculosis Rabbit squatting in front of him at some point, its watery eyes and expectant face staring up at him.
To be honest,
this weapon was very suitable for the Tuberculosis Rabbit's chatty nature.
He believed it wouldn't take long for Tuberculosis Rabbit to charge this weapon to an outlandish level.
But...
He really didn't feel like giving it to Tuberculosis Rabbit.
It's not that he was stingy; after all, all the Points they had earned from being cleaners this month were with him, and his money was Tuberculosis Rabbit's money—naturally, there was no reluctance to part with it.
It's just... even without this prop, Tuberculosis Rabbit was already a chatterbox that gave him a headache all day long.
With this prop, wouldn't that be... like holding the imperial sword, chattering on a mandate?
He could already foresee his days to come.
Would those be days a person could endure?
"Yi."
As if sensing Chen Yi's inner resignation, Tuberculosis Rabbit solemnly raised three fingers, "If you give me this weapon, I will not chatter unnecessarily, and even if I do, I definitely won't chatter too much in front of you, Yi."
"...Alright, alright."
Chen Yi sighed helplessly and passed the handle of the knife to Tuberculosis Rabbit, "Take it; you don't have any suitable weapons, and this will be good for self-defense."
"I was planning to use some Points later to buy someone else's gift package eligibility, to get you a weapon for self-defense, but now that we have one that suits you, you might as well use it."
The gift pack sold for 88 Points in the "520 Limited-Time Event" has, to be honest, a pretty high drop rate.
It gave him a B-level weapon prop.
Tuberculosis Rabbit also got a C-level lifestyle prop.
And below the C-level props, there are still D-level props and E-level props.
During the attack on Cupid just now, the second-ranked Han Yu's dagger prop was probably not low-grade, likely obtained from the gift pack.
After all, up to now, other than the 520's limited-time gift packs, there are no other places to acquire props.
This indicates the gift pack's drop rate is not low.
Although each person is limited to one purchase,
they can transfer Points to others, allowing those who cannot afford the limited-time gift packs to buy them using their eligibility and then give the packs to them.
...
"So cool."
Drooling with excitement, Tuberculosis Rabbit admired the Claw Knife in its hands, and right after its sentence ended,
a panel popped up in front of it.
"Your Red Moon Claw Knife begins to charge; one progress can be charged for every ten sentences spoken."
It took a deep breath and then started blurting out ten sentences of nonsense like a relentless barrage.
Immediately after,
"Your Red Moon Claw Knife is currently at a charge progress of '1'."
He spoke another ten sentences.
"Your Red Moon Claw Knife, the current Charge progress is '2'."
"Hehe."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, having understood the rules of Charge, couldn't help but fondle the blood-red, crescent-moon-like Claw Knife in his hands.
He was very satisfied with this weapon.
Even if someone offered him a stronger Grade B Prop to exchange, he wouldn't trade it.
He had a little quirk, he liked to hoard.
Normally, when he played games, he never used the various gift packs and exchange vouchers he received from daily activities, he just kept them in his warehouse.
It wasn't for any other reason.
He just liked the feeling of collecting.
And this Claw Knife gave him that sense of hoarding, watching the Charge progress slowly change from '0' to '2', he felt an indescribable sense of achievement and satisfaction.
Even if, hypothetically, the Charge progress had no use, he would still be happy, just watching the Charge progress increase made him feel content.
"..."
Chen Yi looked helplessly at the Tuberculosis Rabbit squatting in the corner with a silly, happy grin, shook his head without saying a word but placed the Grade B Enchantment Stone on his Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle.
The next second—
A flash of white light.
His Grade B Enchantment Stone began to melt slowly, and a new special effect appeared on his Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle.
"Enchantment Special Effects: Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle can transform into Santa Claus's cane at any time. In cane form, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle loses the ability to shoot, but grants the user's eyes the ability to see through one barrier."
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi was somewhat puzzled by this skill and tried it out, only to see the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle in his hand suddenly turn into a long, red and white striped cane.
It looked very festive.
And it was quite handy, comfortable to hold.
Just as he was about to see if there was anything unusual, he suddenly spotted the Tuberculosis Rabbit's white, chubby belly under the clothes and the underwear with a Patrick Star print.
"..."
Chen Yi fell silent.
He was starting to understand what the Enchantment Special Effects were, in shorthand; in cane form, it bestowed X-ray vision.
After several attempts,
he discovered that the X-ray effect was permanent; there were no usage limits or costs associated with it. As long as his Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle was in cane form, he could use X-ray vision.
However, it could only see through one barrier.
For instance, a wall, a piece of clothing.
No matter the obstacle, it could only be one layer.
That's why he could only see the Patrick Star underwear, since the underwear plus pants counted as two layers.
Not bad at all.
Chen Yi nodded in satisfaction, deciding it was a pretty good Enchantment Special Effect, helpful in many situations.
And just then—
The Tuberculosis Rabbit beside him filled his lungs and contentedly announced, "The Charge progress is now 23."
"I don't know why, but I feel full of motivation in life."
Chen Yi didn't say anything. He knew about the Tuberculosis Rabbit's hoarder habit, but since it usually didn't cause any trouble, he didn't mind it.
As long as he could talk less, that would suffice.
He looked at his Points Balance, hesitating for a moment, wondering whether to go on a spree buying the 88 Points gift packs.
Honestly, the price was very tempting.
For just 88 Points, one could exchange for a random Prop and five random Skill Fragments.
So far, apart from this 520 limited-time offer, there was no other way to acquire Props.
It was just that...
He frowned slightly, lost in thought, and remained silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 16 "My name is Tuberculosis Rabbit, you can call me Tu, or you can call me Tu'er.
chapters.content:
"Yi, what are you thinking about?"
Seeing Chen Yi furrow his brows, Tuberculosis Rabbit asked out of curiosity, "Is it that troublesome?"
"Yeah."
After pondering for a while, Chen Yi finally spoke, "This 520 limited-time gift package for 88 Points is currently the only way to get Props, and it even comes with five Skill Fragments."
"It could be said to be a very cost-effective package."
"We also have nearly 10,000 Points on hand. If we were to broadly buy up other people's purchase rights, subtracting the handling fees, we could still get about a hundred packages for free."
"Then what's the hesitation for?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes sparkled with excitement, "Such a good deal, go ahead and buy it."
"That's exactly where the problem is."
Chen Yi shook his head, sighed in resignation, and continued, "Haven't you noticed that all the things that have happened so far are too similar to those in a domestic web game?"
"Whether it's this title with a special effect that you simply can't turn off."
"Or the familiar feeling of a 520 limited-time event, or even the exaggerated damage numbers above the boss's head."
"They all look exactly like a domestic web game."
"And there's a particularly bad thing about domestic web games: right before they release a very special offer, game planners will often come up with an event that is better than the usual offers."
"They use this event to deplete all the Points players have saved up."
"Then, when the special offer comes around, if the players want the event rewards, their only option is to top-up again."
"That's true."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement, "But it never tricked me. When I used to play games, I was like the Pixiu, always hoarding stuff in my backpack, never spending or using anything."
"According to your guess, Yi, is there going to be a more favorable event with the June 1st update, and our current move should be to save up Points?"
"Yeah."
Chen Yi brushed the dust off his clothes and then added, "That's what I'm thinking, but it's really hard to let go of this event... let's just buy ten."
"Go for a ten-draw."
"And the remaining Points will definitely not be spent, we'll save them all for the June 1st update."
"Oh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit tucked the Claw Knife into his chest and muttered as he got up and followed behind Yi, "This conversation sounds eerily familiar."
"What did you say?"
"Nothing, nothing. Let's go, Yi."
...
Walking on the street from the basement, Chen Yi looked at the noisy crowd on the street and stood there without saying a word, expressionless.
The situation outside was pretty much as he had expected.
After Cupid died, his body turned into white light and disappeared, leaving no corpse behind.
I heard that some Props were dropped.
They were taken by the officials.
During the entire boss raid, only a very few people were injured. Medical staff came and applied simple dressings before leaving, as there weren't enough hospital beds.
But several hearses from the crematorium did show up.
If anyone was even slightly touched by Cupid's bowstring, there was no such concept as 'injured' for them; they could just be buried on the spot.
At this moment, those who had just fought in the battle were trembling uncontrollably in their legs, yet their faces were flush with excitement and pride as they loudly shared the process of the fight with those around them.
Enjoying the worshipful gazes from the people.
No one knew for sure what drove these folks to rush into battle fearlessly against the boss.
But from the violent trembling of their legs, it was clear that their adrenaline was still surging, and they were probably feeling some aftershock.
The entire street was bustling.
Many who had hidden in their houses came out to find out what had happened.
Of course, it was originally very lively.
But when Chen Yi came out, everything completely changed.
The street suddenly quieted down in a few seconds, and then everyone's gaze turned uniformly towards Chen Yi, or more precisely, towards the title above Chen Yi's head!
Blue and glowing words in the night.
Like a firefly with a face full of stubble, it was startlingly conspicuous!!!
Everyone on the street slowly opened their mouths, looking at Chen Yi with expressions of shock.
"What… what is this?"
Clutching a dagger, Han Yu, who was surrounded by his family, looked enviously at the title above Chen Yi's head, silently clenched his fist, and whispered, "One day, I will get that title too."
Han Yu was the one who had ranked second in the recent damage rankings.
The dagger in his hand possessed the ability to inflict limitless bleeding damage.
"Don't talk nonsense."
A quite charming middle-aged woman standing behind Han Yu tapped his head with a hint of anxiety, "I just want you safe; from now on, don't do such risky things."
"Mom."
Han Yu, somewhat dissatisfied, pushed the woman's hand away and retorted while standing tall, "Ever heard the saying? Those who don't dare to sit at the gambling table will never lose, but also will never win!"
"The world's structure is clearly about to change, starting from today, I have to take a seat at the gambling table for this family!"
"I want to keep winning."
"And didn't I just win? I got the second spot on the leaderboard and received a lot of rewards."
"It's just—"
He looked enviously at Chen Yi, "It's just that I didn't land the final blow and didn't get that title, that's all."
"You child."
The woman, with a slightly anxious expression, said, "No one can keep winning forever, your father is just..."
"Alright."
The man behind her, with a calm expression, interrupted her saying, placing his hand on Han Yu's shoulder, "You're quite right, the structure of the world is about to change."
"From today on, your dad and you will sit at the gambling table together."
"Never mind your mom, what would a woman understand? We still don't know how things will turn out later."
"If we don't become stronger now, we might face unthinkable hardships later."
"You guys..."
The woman was slightly angry but didn't want to show it in front of her child, so she just turned her head away to show her displeasure.
She wasn't oblivious to these things.
She just didn't want her family to die; after all, several people had just died.
...
Chen Yi let out a soft sigh, didn't say much, and started to direct the Tuberculosis Rabbit to find people willing to sell their time-limited gift pack rights.
It must be said.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit might not be a good salesman, but it was definitely a good, annoying salesman.
You could see the Tuberculosis Rabbit bursting into the midst of several people with a face filled with excitement, and words shot out of its mouth like rapid-fire.
"Let's start with a simple introduction."
"My name is Tuberculosis Rabbit, you can call me Tu, or you can call me Tu'er."
"Have you bought that time-limited gift pack for 88 Points?"
"If you haven't, could you transfer the gift pack rights to us?"
"As a reward, I'll give you some compensation, um... how about 3 Points?"
"Too low? Then how about 5 Points?"

chapters.title: Chapter 17 "How much has your Claw Knife's charge progressed?
chapters.content:
For the Tuberculosis Rabbit, this was a great way to make a living.
It didn't matter even if it didn't acquire the qualification.
After all, it still increased the Charge progress of its Claw Knife. How could there be such a good way to make a living.
...
Half an hour later.
Chen Yi, with ten gift packages bought for 88 Points each, returned to his rented room.
The night had deepened.
Yet the outside was anything but quiet, clearly, this sudden limited-time event had struck a chord with many people.
But there was also a bright side; at least for tonight, with so many activities going on, you could barely see anyone violating the May rules and dying on the spot.
Under such circumstances, it was also difficult to remember the presence of ghosts.
The ten-draw began.
Subsequently, 50 Skill Fragments quietly lay in his backpack, along with ten Props.
Just spending 980 Points in exchange for ten Props was definitely a relatively cost-effective deal.
If they didn't look at the Prop information, that is.
'Prop Name': Absolute Itch-Relieving Ear-picking Spoon.
'Prop Level': E-tier.
'Prop Effect': This ear-picking spoon can automatically relieve any itching in your ear canal.
'Prop Limitation': It only has an itch-relieving effect when inserted into the ear canal.
'Skill Introduction': "Do you often have itchy ears? This Prop will help you a lot."
Outrageous, isn't it?
No, there's more outrageous stuff.
'Prop Name': Automatic Coffee Machine.
'Prop Level': E-tier.
'Prop Effect': This is a coffee machine; you just pour coffee into it, and hot coffee appears.
'Prop Limitation': Only coffee can be poured into it.
'Skill Introduction': "Now you can have hot coffee anytime, anywhere~"
Yes.
These ten Props were all the kind of Props that are not entirely useless but are somewhat useful daily life Props.
All were E-tier Props.
You might say they weren't worth much; getting such a Prop for 88 Points wasn't a loss.
But to say they were valuable,
Compared to the B-tier and C-tier Props that the two of them pulled from the gift packages, the disparity was just too great.
"Um..."
Curiously, the Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke up, "If this Prop is combined with the 'A Cup of Coffee' Skill, wouldn't you be able to have hot coffee forever?"
"..."
Chen Yi, weary, tossed the Props to the Tuberculosis Rabbit, quickly washed up, and then lay down on the bed and closed his eyes.
"I'm going to sleep first."
"It's been a tiring day, we'll talk about anything else tomorrow."
"Oh, okay."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a joyful grin, carefully arranged these Props in his own spatial backpack.
He loved collecting these kinds of useful, yet not really useful, trinkets.
After also washing up, he lay down on the other bed next to Chen Yi, ready to drift off to sleep.
...
An hour later.
Chen Yi, lying flat on the bed, opened his eyes expressionlessly and looked up at the ceiling.
How could he have forgotten this point.
How could he sleep in the same room with the Tuberculosis Rabbit?
The Tuberculosis Rabbit and he rented separate rooms in the same complex, and they usually slept in their own rooms. Today, because he was too sleepy, he had forgotten this point.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit's incessant talking was actually bearable during the day... the most terrifying part was at night.
"Is that so? You're also born in the year of the rabbit? What a coincidence."
"Hehe, I'm born in the year of the rabbit too,"
"Me? I'm called the Tuberculosis Rabbit. People say I talk too much, which is why I got this nickname."
"But I don't think I'm a chatterbox at all."
"What, you're asking me why I don't work in customer service?"
"I did work in customer service, but because I kept sending messages to customers, they got annoyed by the constant pop-up notifications and complained. After that, I was let go."
Indeed.
The scariest thing about Tuberculosis Rabbit is his habit of talking in his sleep.
And it's the kind that doesn't stop all night long.
As for the April rule "requiring everyone to talk with others for a thousand sentences," it was practically non-existent to Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Every time Tuberculosis Rabbit was in a dream, he would complete this rule task.
Though it is unclear why the system counts Tuberculosis Rabbit's sleep-talking as having conversations with people.
Perhaps it's because he talks to people in his dreams.
That's also why, when Tuberculosis Rabbit came over to pick him up this afternoon, Chen Yi said without surprise that Tuberculosis Rabbit's daily rule task was probably automatically completed the moment he woke up from sleep in the morning.
Pretty good.
Chen Yi silently took out earplugs from his pocket, inserted them into his ears, closed his eyes, and began to try to force himself to sleep.
...
Soon, several hours passed.
It was daylight.
"Yawn~"
As Tuberculosis Rabbit slowly woke up from his sleep and stretched comfortably, he then saw Chen Yi, who was already dressed and calmly smoking in a chair, and said with some surprise.
"Yi, you woke up this early?"
"Hmm."
Chen Yi paused for a moment, calmly flicked the ash from his cigarette into an ashtray nearby, "How much progress does your Claw Knife have on its Charge?"
"Why are you suddenly asking about that?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit, puzzled, took out his Claw Knife and the next second exclaimed excitedly, "Yi, the Charge progress on my Claw Knife has reached 328!"
"Surprised?"
Chen Yi, with two dark circles under his eyes, looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit somberly: "You forgot about your sleep-talking problem, didn't you?"
"Hehe."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat embarrassed, scratched the back of his head: "I kind of forgot, so you didn't sleep well last night, did you?"
"What do you think?"
"How about I treat you to some mutton soup?"
"Let's go."
Chen Yi didn't linger, he directly grabbed the jacket on the chair and prepared to head out the door; he was hungry, and it was time to find a restaurant to eat.
Both of them knew how to cook.
But the food they made was beyond description...
So every day they had to find restaurants that were open at such an hour, places that took money but not lives, and have a hearty meal.
...
"Congratulations, young master, you've won again."
Uncle Wei looked at the young master standing in front of the floor-to-ceiling window and spoke admiringly in his heart: "The tradability of Points has been proven by yesterday's limited-time event."
"Before this event, we had already collected a substantial amount of Points."
"Last night alone, we collected a total of 892 '520 limited-time gift packs'."
"We've opened a lot of Props as a result."
"Among them, there are 6 B-grade Props, 78 C-grade Props, and even more below D-grade."
"Our people are still continuing to buy."
"Hmm."
Gao Yiming, wearing a coat with his hands in his pockets, stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, looking at the rising Chaoyang and smiled contentedly: "This is the charm of capital."
"What is the charm of capital?"
"It's that when some people can't even afford a single gift pack, we can buy nearly a thousand of them!"
"They think that with the advent of this game, they've had a chance to turn their lives around."
"How naive..."

chapters.title: Chapter 18 "Brother, do you want to try collecting payments with Points?
chapters.content:
"Truly a miraculous unknown power."
Gao Yiming stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, staring at the red wine glass in his hand with a sentimental expression, and murmured, "It won't be long before the old powers will face a real upheaval."
"Whoever has more props and skill fragments will have more say in this new world."
The wine glass in his hand was an item that had come out from the "520 Limited-time Gift Pack" – a B-tier prop.
Its effect was extremely powerful.
"Prop Name": The Gentleman's Red Wine Glass.
"Prop Level": B-tier.
"Prop Effect": When activated, the rim can spout out a large amount of blood, enough to fill a small warehouse.
"Prop Restrictions": Before each use, one must treat the wine glass to a bottle of good red wine.
"Skill Introduction": "If you're a vampire, then this prop would be the treasure of your dreams."
A rather good prop.
If one used this prop to kill someone, it could drown a person to death in anything but a very large room, and the Law Enforcement Bureau would be completely unable to detect any traces.
But this prop, coupled with another one, becomes interesting.
Another prop from the "520 Limited-time Gift Pack".
"Prop Name": Holographic Projection.
"Prop Level": C-tier.
"Prop Effect": When activated, a holographic projection of a Night Parade of One Hundred Demons will appear within a hundred square feet, lasting thirty seconds.
"Prop Restrictions": Using it once will consume 200 points.
"Prop Introduction": "Specially developed by the Ghost Realm wedding company, so you can have enough flair at your wedding in the Ghost Realm."
Gao Yiming slowly placed the two props on the table and turned his head to look at the elder standing behind him.
"Take them."
"For every ten people who die by violating the May rules, there's a certain probability of triggering that random event."
"You see the title above Chen Yi's head?"
"An ordinary person who managed to get the highest kill damage in the Cupid event, and also land the final blow, is that luck?"
"No."
He shook his head slightly, "Rather than luck, I believe that he got a powerful prop from that treasure box, like that sniper rifle."
"Go to the village."
"These days, the disappearance of several villages can't make any waves at all."
"Understood, Young Master."
Uncle Wei's wrinkled face showed no emotion as he nodded, lowered his eyelids, and picked up the two props from the table, ready to leave.
"Wait a minute."
Gao Yiming suddenly interrupted, "Don't forget, a random event can be triggered if ten people break the May rules at the same location. Don't kill too many at once."
"To avoid waste."
"Kill them ten by ten."
"Don't worry, Young Master."
Just as Uncle Wei was preparing to leave, he suddenly stopped, turned his head back to Gao Yiming, "Young Master, we've lost contact with Captain Li, and I reckon he's fallen prey to Chen Yi or got imprisoned somewhere."
"If Captain Li were not in trouble, he would surely contact us."
"Should we send someone after Chen Yi?"
"Chen Yi, huh..."
Gao Yiming sat down in the chair, leaned back against the chair back, and slowly closed his eyes, tiredly saying, "The world has truly changed, hasn't it? Just because an utterly ordinary person gained some power in a game."
"He dares to kill people."
"And not just any people but officers."
"Truly not to be underestimated."
"No need to look for him now, other companies are also laying out their strategies, and not many people know the rules for triggering random events yet. We can gain an early advantage."
"What we need to do now is to acquire more props and skill fragments as soon as possible."
"As for Chen Yi... let's hold off for now. If he knows what's good for him, there's no need to bother with him for the time being."
"Investigate this person for me, and send me the information."
"Understood."
The rule for May is "Calm and Cool."
Every player cannot think of ghosts in their minds, or they'll die instantly if they do so for over three seconds.
When the number of people who die at a certain location due to violating the May rule reaches more than ten at once, there is a certain probability that a Reincarnation event will be triggered.
And you can open a Reincarnation Treasure Box.
The 1w Points that Chen Yi had, were from a Reincarnation Treasure Box he had opened.
And these two Props, if you want to make someone think of ghosts, it's just too easy.
...
"Whew!"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked satisfied as it put a piece of flatbread into its mouth, followed by a chopstick-full of spicy shredded potatoes with slices of lamb, chewing vigorously.
As it gulped, the Tuberculosis Rabbit contentedly pulled out a napkin to wipe the grease from around its mouth and patted its stomach.
"I'm full."
"Nothing beats the taste of this stuff."
Meanwhile, Chen Yi sat on the side, lifting his bowl to drink the last sip of the lamb soup, oblivious to the strange and envious stares of the passersby.
He had grown accustomed to them.
If he couldn't change it, he could only get used to it.
After all, no one would willingly have a title above their head that glowed blue in reality.
He had even checked the title system in his panel.
From lowest to highest, they are:
"White, Green, Blue, Yellow, Purple, Red, Black, Rainbow."
A total of eight levels.
The rank of the title varies according to the rarity of the title and the difficulty of obtaining it.
And his "Deadly Title" was of the blue rank.
The glow that came with the title was also blue.
The most important thing was that he saw something else in the title rules.
There is no limit to the number of titles you can wear.
That means, if you wish, you could even wear 99 titles.
Thinking about this, Chen Yi couldn't help but feel somewhat lost as he leaned back in his chair, looking up at the sky above.
With 99 titles on his head, each emitting different colored lights, blue, green, rainbow, what kind of picture would that be?
Is this reality even normal?
If these things are happening in the real world, isn't that a bit too incongruent?
And at that moment—
Chen Yi's phone suddenly rang. After picking it up and talking for a while, he put the phone back in his pocket, stood up, and walked over to the motorcycle parked on the side of the street.
"Let's go, there's a new job."
"Oh, alright."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit quickly got up to pay for the meal, and just as it was about to leave, it suddenly saw the owner's daughter helping behind him, probably just graduated from high school. After a moment of hesitation, it still turned to the owner and said.
"Brother, why don't you try taking Points for payment?"
"Anyone who comes for your lamb soup would have to pay with Points."
"Cash... it probably won't be of much use in the future."
"Points?"
The owner was stunned for a moment, then gave a subconscious smile: "We don't plan on fighting, these things are for you guys, we just earn some money to get by."
"Someone just came to buy my Points, I sold them all."
"I know that stuff is useful, can buy gift packs, can draw powerful weapons."
"But to put it bluntly, we don't plan on killing people, never thought about killing, why do we need that stuff, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 19 "Prop Name" The Cat with Its Tail Held High.
chapters.content:
"But I have to say, little brother, you're a good person too."
The boss seemed quite emotional as he wiped his hands on his apron, "Those who came to collect Points always said that these things were useless and not worth a penny."
"Those people really think I'm a fool, but I'm just old, not senile..."
"It's just that our aspirations are different."
"We're just ordinary folks who want to live our days in peace. Alright, little brother, I won't chat any longer; I've got more customers to attend to. I'll get busy now."
"Next time you come to eat, I'll add some extra slices of meat for you."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the boss's retreating figure, hesitated as if he wanted to say something, but still quickly pulled out a cigarette from his chest and hurried toward Yi."
"I'm here, Yi."
"Wait for me!"
...
"This time, we must call on you."
At the entrance of Zhongdeng Mall, a uniformed enforcement officer spoke wearily, "Besides you, no one dares to take this job."
"Chen Yi, right?"
"We've investigated your records. In your medical history, you have absolutely no emotion of fear."
"In the whole of Yancheng, you're the only one with this illness."
"This means that you can completely ignore the Calm and Cool rule of May."
"There is currently a group of people in Yancheng who have begun to deliberately spread some horror films, and today, quite a few people have died."
"As you know, these past few days have been the '520 limited-time event', where the Cupid Monster will randomly appear in the city. The Law Enforcement Bureau's manpower is spread thin putting out fires everywhere, simply overwhelmed."
"In the movie theater on the fifth floor, nearly hundreds of people have died in every screening room."
"Someone... someone..."
At this point, the enforcement officer suddenly raised his voice in anger, "Someone has gone mad and kidnapped a bunch of people, forced them into the theaters, and then played horror films on the big screen!!!"
"We checked the security footage, but the recordings for this area were all lost today, and there isn't a single eyewitness."
"We're currently searching vigorously for this group of people."
"But the most important thing now is to clean up all the corpses in the theaters. Otherwise, if all those bodies rot, the consequences will be unimaginable!"
Chen Yi furrowed his brow, paused for a while, and then said, "You mentioned that someone deliberately kidnapped people, then forced them to watch horror films."
For some reason, he thought of someone.
The so-called CEO of the Rising Group.
This person had sent Captain Li to catch him, just to find out what reward he had gotten from the chest.
And obviously, the other party was also aware of the prerequisite for triggering that special event.
He pondered for a while before nodding his head.
"Alright, I understand. But the Skill Fragments next to those bodies must have been picked up by now, right?"
"How will the payment be?"
"A flat rate of 3000 Points."
"Deal."
...
Chen Yi carrying his package, led Tuberculosis Rabbit to the entrance of the cinema.
The lights inside were all on; the environment wasn't dark at all.
Yet just standing at the entrance of the movie theater, one could see blood flowing out from seven or eight theaters visible in front, like rivers, slowly streaming.
The stench of blood was extremely pungent as it invaded one's nostrils.
"Goodness."
Tuberculosis Rabbit muttered in shock, "How many people died, Yi? These people must have been doing it to trigger that special event, right?"
"In the past, I feel even wiping out their nine clans wouldn't have been too much."
"Hmm."
Chen Yi frowned, pulled out a stack of body bags from his package, and took out a set of isolation gear to start putting on.
"I can go in by myself this time."
"You just wait outside, it's different from before, you probably can't handle it?"
"Wait outside?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit was stunned for a moment, and subconsciously swept his gaze around the empty fifth floor and the blood-filled movie, suddenly feeling a chill breeze from somewhere, causing his body to shiver instantly.
"Forget it, Yi, I feel like I'm more likely to get into trouble if I'm out here alone."
"Following behind you, Yi, I'd feel a bit safer, as long as we don't get separated."
Chen Yi glanced at the Tuberculosis Rabbit and said nothing, just took out another isolation suit from his bag and threw it over: "Put it on, and take out that Prop you've been daydreaming about too."
"Right."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes lit up, hastily pulling out a Prop from his bosom.
This Prop was one they had drawn from the "520 Limited Time Gift Pack" yesterday.
It fell under the category of life Props.
Initially thought to be of little use, it turned out to be quite handy at this moment.
'Prop Name': Cat with Tail in the Air.
'Prop Level': E-grade.
'Prop Effect': It allows your mind to be filled with lewd thoughts for 3 hours straight, while maintaining an aroused state constantly.
'Prop Restrictions': After each use, you will enter a 3-day period of weakness.
'Prop Description': "Do you know why it's E-grade? Because after using this Prop, your body will emit a scent that a female cat gives off when seeking a mate, which might attract some male cats."
This Prop, to tell the truth, was rather useless.
At least for the two of them it was.
But using it here was different.
It could keep his mind filled with the thought of mating, so he wouldn't think of ghosts.
However, if he could find the right customer, it might actually sell for a good price.
...
"Did you find anything?"
Gao Yiming leaned on the desk with a somewhat gloomy expression, talking to Uncle Wei on the phone.
"No."
Uncle Wei's hoarse voice came through the phone quickly: "Didn't find anything, but it's likely not the work of the former hooligans in Yancheng, they've had no moves last night or today."
"But to do such a thing, it must be no minor force."
"Still investigating."
"Hmm."
Gao Yiming looked displeased, the veins on the back of his hand stood out slightly as he flattened a silicone toy on the desk: "Idiots, they're complete idiots."
"Although Yancheng is chaotic now, the system of the Law Enforcement Bureau and the military is still fundamentally intact."
"Under such circumstances, to commit such an act so openly is simply seeking death!"
He wasn't feeling sorry for the people at the cinema, but these people acting so reckless could easily drag him down with them!
Why else would he send Uncle Wei to the village?
Complete idiots!
Then he forcibly suppressed the anger in his heart, trying to calm his tone: "How's the progress on your end?"
"Not very good."
The voice on the other end of the phone hesitated for a moment before continuing: "The person who opens the treasure chest must maintain absolute fearlessness in their heart to unlock rewards, or there's a certain chance of drawing out a nightmare, resulting in instant death."
"We've tried to open four treasure chests so far, only one has been opened successfully, the rest exploded."
"However..."
"The file on Chen Yi you asked me to look into today, I've got it."
"This person is naturally void of fear."
"That is to say, as long as we let him open the treasure chests, not only can we be 100% certain of opening the chests, but the rewards may also be exceptional!"

chapters.title: Chapter 20 "Today is already May 20th, and there's not much time left until the end of the month.
chapters.content:
"Born without the emotion of fear."
Gao Yiming's eyes narrowed slightly as he leaned against the desk, tilting his head to look out the window without speaking.
Under the rules of May.
Players were not to form any images or pictures of ghosts in their minds, lest they die violently after just three seconds.
Of course, merely thinking the word "ghost" wouldn't pose any problem.
Throughout the month, the globe used various methods to deal with this situation, including the unrestricted amplification of human desires to keep the mind in a state of constant arousal, with no time to think of anything else.
The foremost of the three poisons, lust.
At this moment, it had become a lifesaving medicine.
Beyond that, there were a series of measures like state-organized open-air disco parties.
Apart from an increased number of deaths a few days ago, the situation has gradually come under control, with massive fatal incidents largely avoided.
Despite the information blackout.
But to his knowledge.
There are already 14 cities around the world that have become ghost towns, empty of people.
When a city is filled with chunks of mangled corpses, when half-bodies can sometimes be seen high atop buildings, and when the sewers overflow with blood.
Even if there are many survivors left in the city.
Come the dead of night.
Nerves stretched to breaking—it might only take a gust of wind to be the last straw that breaks the camel's back.
There are already 14 empty ghost towns—of course, that term might not be accurate, as some children with no concrete concept of ghosts and some people with mental illnesses may still be clinging to life in some corner.
But how long they can survive is anyone's guess.
Those who reacted quickly did well to begin with, and the current order is still somewhat preserved, but many places are said to have already descended into chaos, each fending for themselves in a state of panic.
Being without fear meant that even if one thought of the image of a ghost, one could quickly purge it from the mind.
Essentially, one could be completely immune to the rules of May.
If Chen Yi were to open the chests, he could guarantee the opening of every chest and that the rewards would be critical hits!
His eyes, faintly tinged with red, licked the corner of his mouth and brought the phone to his ear, whispering,
"Bring the person back."
"Understood."
It's true that some basic order can still be maintained for now, but what about after the third version update? The fourth?
The inevitable outcome will be the collapse of order!
When that time comes!
On the ruins, a new set of rulers will rise!
And these rulers will be those like him, who started planning early!
...
At the cinema,
Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit were stuffing the body fragments in the theater into body bags, piece by piece, then tying the bags and throwing them down from the fifth floor.
Down in the lobby, someone was waiting to load these body bags into a vehicle and haul them away.
"Yi,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit took a breath, wiping the sweat from his forehead, and casually said, "Today is May 20th; it won't be long before the end of the month."
"We're about to face the version update on June 1st."
"Who knows what the rules for the month will be after the June 1st update."
"It happens to be Children's Day on June 1st, too."
Chen Yi casually tied up a body bag, stood up to stretch and limber up before replying.
"The April version update said a 'thrilling' themed rule would be added in May."
"So May added a 'Calm and Cool'."
"In the May update, it said they would add a 'Life' themed rule in June."
"So the rule for June should be related to life, like ... one must eat a thousand kilograms of rice every day."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit said somewhat speechlessly, "If that's really the rule, I think it would be easier to just kill all the humans in the world. It's like not leaving any chance for survival at all."
"That's not known."
Chen Yi shook his head, "I'm not exactly sure what the rule would be, but it will definitely be about life, and it should be rather gentle; there won't be cases of dying for violating the rules."
"But April's rules will be going offline by the end of May."
"Finally, no need to converse with people for a thousand sentences every day, that rule is seriously lethal."
"Oh?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit, seemingly not yet satisfied, smacked his lips and said, "I didn't feel the presence of April's rules at all. If it were ten thousand sentences, then it might've been somewhat challenging."
"..."
Just as Chen Yi was about to say something with a displeased look, he suddenly frowned, remembering something, "Wait, did you just say that June 1 is Children's Day?"
"If we base it on the limited-time event on May 20, then it's very likely that a special, limited-time event will happen on June 1, Children's Day."
"You don't say..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with some hesitation, "After all, there were no limited-time events for April Fools' Day on April 1 and Labor Day on May 1, right?"
"It's being perfected."
Chen Yi took a deep breath and suddenly felt as if he had come to a realization.
"This global game that has enveloped the entire world is slowly being perfected."
"From the initial rules of April, to Points and Skill Fragments appearing in May, to the limited-time event gifts, titles, and props of May 20."
"It's apparent that this game is gradually becoming more comprehensive. The absence of limited-time events in the past is very likely because the Snow Sea Project Team hadn't developed that aspect yet."
"If my guess is correct."
"Then Children's Day on June 1 will definitely have a limited-time event, and it will also be based on the monthly theme of 'Life' rules."
He stopped talking and just stood there, frowning deeply in thought.
"What rule could be related to both life and Children's Day?"
But after a moment, he put the thought aside. There was too little information, and it wasn't something that could be forcibly figured out this way.
By now, the corpses inside the cinema hall had been almost completely cleaned up.
Not a single Skill Fragment.
All had been picked up by the perpetrators.
The bodies were fine, but cleaning up the blood was a bit troublesome; there was simply too much of it.
...
Four hours later.
Chen Yi stood in the almost completely cleaned cinema hall, breathing slightly wearily; the job had indeed been quite demanding.
If not for the passive Skill 'Calm and Composed,' he would have probably collapsed by now.
The Skill Effect of 'Calm and Composed' allowed him to double his physical attributes as long as he was completely fearless inside.
Just as they were preparing to leave.
A familiar notification sound suddenly rang in everyone's ears.
'Online patch update notice!'
'Effective immediately, all firearms with kinetic energy exceeding 1.8 joules per square centimeter are unusable.'
Gone.
The patch notice was just that simple sentence.

chapters.title: Chapter 21 "It's hard to know how powerful the Claw Knife will be with a charge level of only 389.
chapters.content:
```
The concept of kinetic energy greater than 1.8 joules per square centimeter might be unclear to many.
Let's give an example, shall we?
A person with gastroenteritis, who'd held in gas all day, finally couldn't hold it in any longer and let out a loud fart!
In the moment of farting, imagine lighting a lighter placed behind the butt.
The force unleashed in that moment.
would be greater than 1.8 joules per square centimeter.
That is to say, the instant this rule came into effect, all the firearms in the world turned into paper tigers, completely useless.
Chen Yi's brow furrowed as he quickly pulled out his own sniper rifle from his embrace.
Only after confirming it could still be used did he breathe a slight sigh of relief.
It seemed that this restriction only applied to the existing firearms on the planet; props that were firearms were not affected at all.
His sniper rifle could transform into a Christmas candy cane, which, once transformed, had the ability to see through objects.
The reason he wasn't using it as a cane here was simply because the place was too dirty, and he didn't want to soil his only reliable treasure.
"All firearms have become useless?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit first froze, then couldn't help but swallow silently, turning to look at the sniper rifle in Chen Yi's hand and muttered, "Doesn't that mean this sniper rifle in our hands is the only firearm in the world that can still be used?"
"Even if it's not the only one, it should be one of the few,"
Chen Yi shook his head. "But what can be certain is that in the future, weapon props that are firearms, due to their range advantage, should be stronger than props of the same level."
"And... once all firearms around the world become ineffective, it will be hard to maintain order."
"The former military, without firearms, will just be ordinary people with better physical fitness and discipline."
"I think I understand the intent of the Snow Sea Project Team now."
"This team intends to completely disrupt the existing order, making every player fight for themselves, like... in a browser game."
"If that's the case, then the next move from the team should be..."
Before Chen Yi could finish speaking, a new notification suddenly exploded in their ears!
Listening to the notification beside their ears,
Chen Yi said the words he hadn't finished earlier in a complex tone,
"...Monsters are attacking."
'Activity Update Announcement!'
'This event is a global-scale event, specially launched for the version update—a brand-new event!'
'Event Name: Extraterrestrial Invader!'
'Bravely pick up the weapons in your hands, and kill the enemies before you!'
'Defeating different monsters will yield different points!'
'Based on the points obtained by players, a global ranking will be carried out!'
'Opening - "Extraterrestrial Invader Event Global Leaderboard"!'
'Additionally, a Points Store is introduced, where players can use the points they've earned to purchase various props or Skill Fragments, as well as exchange for Points.'
'The Snow Sea Project Team, wishing you a pleasant game.'
One has to say, the Snow Sea Project Team rolls out events faster than domestic browser game activities.
The 520 limited-time event hasn't even ended, and the Extraterrestrial Invader event is already upon us.
The next second—
The ground shook and the mountains quaked!!!
They even felt the floor underneath their feet swaying.
Immediately following,
Chen Yi suddenly saw a flat map appear on his personal panel.
In the middle was a little yellow dot, which should be his location.
Nearby were quite a few green dots, likely the locations of other players.
Zooming in on the map and pulling back further, one could see a dense array of red dots.
These red dots, should all be monsters.
```
But...
Chen Yi's complexion was somewhat off, the event had already happened, and it was definitely unavoidable now.
However, his strongest reliance right now was the sniper rifle in his hands.
When used to kill bosses, it was absolutely a godsend!
No matter how high the boss's health was, every shot would inevitably deal true damage amounting to three percent of the opponent's maximum health value!
It could certainly be called a divine weapon!
But when it came to fighting smaller monsters, it was somewhat embarrassing; even the weakest monsters would need about thirty or so shots to be taken down!
And those densely packed red dots seemed to all be smaller monsters.
At that moment, these monsters were gathered outside Yancheng, advancing towards the city, and by the looks of it, they would soon make contact.
After pondering for a brief moment, Chen Yi removed the isolation suit from his body and walked briskly towards the first floor.
"Let's go."
No matter the situation, it was best to make it to the edge of the city first.
While one could naturally gain a measure of safety in the city center... one could also say that there was virtually no harvest at all.
Risk and profit are always proportional.
If you find that your risk and profit are not proportional, then that means... you've been tricked.
After leaving Zhongdeng Square, they found that the law enforcement officers who should have been waiting for them outside the building had disappeared, probably off maintaining order somewhere.
But there was no time to worry about the 3000 Points reward now; they would claim it later.
At that moment, the streets had already devolved into total chaos.
If the version updates of the past four or five months had left some people feeling hopeful, believing that things weren't that serious,
then the two announcements just now had thoroughly convinced everyone of the severity of the situation.
This was an apocalypse.
Chen Yi frowned as he scanned the noisy crowd, mounted the motorbike, and after glancing at the fuel gauge, asked, "How much progress has your Claw Knife Charge reached?"
"389."
"We might need it in a bit."
"Mhm, mhm."
With an air of anticipation, the Tuberculosis Rabbit stuffed the Claw Knife into its embrace and climbed onto the back seat of the motorbike, "I wonder how powerful a Claw Knife with only a 389 Charge progress can be."
As the words fell.
"Boom!!!"
The roaring sound of the throttle suddenly erupted, driving down the street towards the outskirts of the city!
"Ahh!!!"
The panic-stricken scream of the Tuberculosis Rabbit accompanied the constantly flickering scenes in front of them, never ceasing!!
Yi's riding skills were actually very good.
He used to be a professional stunt motorcyclist.
But generally, during travel, it was Yi who would sit at the back, with him driving.
Why?
Because Yi was utterly fearless, and when he drove, his heart was exceptionally calm; he would twist the throttle to the limit and weave through traffic as if threading a needle!
The speed was fast.
But for the Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting in the back, it felt like its heart rate had also risen.
Upon reaching the outskirts of the city, they could see a large portion of people, families in tow, rushing towards the city center.
Clearly, everyone understood that the suburbs of Yancheng would soon face the onslaught of countless monsters!
Staying in the suburbs at this time was no different from waiting for death!
The streets were basically completely blocked.
Chen Yi took a deep breath and lifted the front of the bike, driving over the rooftops of the jammed cars!
These cars had already brought the streets to a standstill, immovable.
In a way, the tops of these cars, linked together, were just like a slightly bumpier smooth road!
Only a small fraction did as they did.
Going against the flow of people.
Carrying various weapons and using various means, they rushed to the outside of the city, ready to face the upcoming battle!

chapters.title: Chapter 22 "Extraterrestrial Invader Global Rankings!
chapters.content:
It was getting closer and closer.
On Chen Yi's personal panel's flat map, there wasn't much distance left to those dense red dots.
This was a monster tide.
To put it accurately, it was a monster siege.
The next second——
"Screech!"
The grating sound of brakes filled the air as Chen Yi brought his motorcycle to a halt in an open area, looking towards the nearly deserted streets with a solemn expression.
At this moment, there was almost no one on the street in front of him.
The streets were completely blocked by vehicles, making them impassable.
Apart from that, there was a strong smell of fish.
It was like the scent of the sea breeze in the evening in a coastal city.
Yet Yancheng was a bona fide inland city; smelling the sea breeze here wasn't exactly normal.
Chen Yi didn't stay put for too long, quickly making his way up to the high floors of a nearby office building.
At the height of 39 floors, he could almost completely overlook the entire suburb.
Standing at the edge of the rooftop, Chen Yi gazed at the edge of the city with a complex expression, observing the throngs of monsters slowly advancing towards the city like a tidal wave.
There were too many, too dense.
He couldn't even make out what these monsters looked like.
"No way..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked dumbfounded at the monster tide not far away, then glanced down at the Claw Knife in its hand.
"That is, although I don't know how powerful my Claw Knife with a charge progress of over 300 is,"
"even if it's powerful, it's probably not going to take out this monster tide in one strike, right?"
"There aren't many people here, and with just the few thousand of us, thinking of holding off so many monsters seems a bit like a pipe dream, doesn't it?"
They also came to understand the game's concept at this moment.
The project team probably wanted all the players in the city to unite against these monsters, but... it was clear that everyone had been in peace for long enough, and couldn't adapt quickly to taking up arms and going to battle.
If they wanted to safely withstand this wave of beasts, all the players in the city needed to come together and resist.
"Huh."
Chen Yi took a deep breath, looking a bit ill, before he took out a sniper rifle from his bosom, lay down on the rooftop floor, and observed the monster tide through the sniper scope.
He couldn't think too much about it.
First, he needed to look for any boss-level monsters.
Just then——
Suddenly, a rumbling sound erupted.
