A long line of armored vehicles, tanks, and cloak trucks came pouring out towards the outskirts of the city.
Then, before everyone could react,
large numbers of soldiers jumped down from the vehicles and began constructing the first line of defenses, a process fluid and disciplined.
At a glance, there were nearly ten thousand people!
"Is this... has the military arrived?"
A trace of surprise flashed in the Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes, followed by a relieved sigh, "This feels much safer. Otherwise, just relying on us volunteers to stop this tide would be a real pipe dream."
"Only..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked puzzled at the variety of weapons in the soldiers' hands: "There are knives, bows and arrows, guns, and even mortars."
"These must be props, right?"
"Does the military have so many props?"
"I don't remember the Law Enforcement Bureau in the city intending to collect Points this month, do I?"
"No, they haven't,"
Chen Yi's eyes narrowed slightly, and after a pause, he chuckled meaningfully, "but that doesn't mean that the people in the military haven't been collecting Points."
"I understand now."
"From the beginning, the military or rather the state, had already realized the importance of Points."
"They had already dispatched a large number of people to secretly collect Points and Skill Fragments."
"But in order not to give some restless people any other ideas, they ordered the Law Enforcement Bureau not to collect Points, so even those who felt that Points might be very useful later on and wanted to collect them."
"Upon seeing that even the Law Enforcement Bureau's people showed little interest in Points, they would abandon the thought."
"They trust the nation's actions more than their own judgment."
"Is that so?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in sudden realization, "Well, I'll be, so that's how it is."
The next second—
'Extraterrestrial Invader Yancheng Rankings!'
'Extraterrestrial Invader Global Rankings!'
Two golden and enormous leaderboards appeared in the sky above Yancheng, clear for everyone to see.
At this moment, the top hundred names on the global leaderboard were already filled.
The first place already had 38 points.
Meanwhile, the Yancheng ranking had not a single person listed, as no monsters had yet made formal contact.
At that moment.
Chen Yi, lying prone on the rooftop, suddenly noticed that many of the military personnel setting up the first line of defense kept looking back at him.
Had he been discovered so quickly from his concealed position?
Chen Yi quickly realized and, somewhat speechlessly, looked up at the huge title above his head.
With this thing following him, it indeed seemed quite hard to stay hidden.
He was like a firefly in the dark.
And at this moment, the monsters were about to make contact with the military forces constructing the defensive fortifications ahead.
They were now getting a clear view of what the monsters looked like.
About half human height, they resembled enlarged bugs.
Writhing bodies, sharp Claw Knives, and little heads with seven or eight eyes.
The monsters, all of the same kind, surged towards Yancheng.
Chen Yi didn't hesitate any longer and turned to look at a Prop in his backpack.
'Prop Name': C-grade Universal Skill Fragments x3
'Prop Level': C-grade.
'Prop Effect': Can replace any C-grade Skill Fragment and be used for synthesis.
'Prop Introduction': Like a four-block piece in Tetris, it fits anywhere and can be used in the synthesis of all C-grade Skills.
This was a Prop he had acquired last time.
He could synthesize a C-grade Skill Fragment, but he had not used it, wanting to maximize its benefit.
But now, obviously, he didn't have the luxury of choice.
Immediately, the next second—
'Skill Name': Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!
'Skill Level': C-grade.
'Skill Type': Active Skill.
'Skill Effect': When you use firearms to kill a person, if the target is a player, the player's next three generations will die along with them.
If the target is a monster, then the next nine hundred and ninety-nine generations of that monster will die as well.
'Skill Limitation': Using it once incurs a cooldown period of 48 hours.
'Skill Introduction': "One day, a tyrant suddenly found the order to annihilate nine clans too troublesome, so he developed this Skill."
He had not exchanged for this Skill last time.
On one hand, he wanted to maximize the benefit of the Universal Skill Fragment; on the other hand, he felt this Skill wasn't all that useful.

chapters.title: Chapter 23 Fire one shot, and nine generations of your family will be executed!
chapters.content:
A shot goes off, and your whole nine clans are annihilated!
It sounds good.
But... it's not of much use to him.
It wasn't until he saw that all the monsters were squirming worms that a somewhat crazy and gamblers-like idea began to surge in his heart.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, forcibly suppressed his emotions, learned the skill, then tightly gripped the sniper rifle in his hand, stood up at the edge of the roof, and looked down at those monsters.
"Since they are all Insect Race monsters."
"There must be an Origin, right?"
"So that's what you mean, Yi!"
At this moment, the Tuberculosis Rabbit also realized it, a glint of ecstasy flickering in its eyes: "Doesn't that mean, as long as we find the Origin of this Insect Tide, we can kill off all these insects with one shot?"
"Just... Yi, are you sure that this Insect Tide really has an Origin?"
"Not sure."
Chen Yi transformed the sniper rifle into a Christmas Cane and held it in his hand as he stood at the edge of the rooftop and shook his head: "But if everything is going according to the game, there should be an Origin."
"This Origin will likely appear as the biggest boss."
At that moment—
An earth-shattering roar could already be heard coming from ahead!
Only then did Chen Yi realize that the crossbows in the soldiers' hands were not props but modern industrialized weapons!
That's right, firearms were unusable, but that didn't mean mechanical weapons like crossbows couldn't be used.
Almost every soldier had one.
The dense steel crossbow arrows, like a sky filled with flying feathers, suppressed the first wave of monsters, those with hateful expressions, silently fell to the ground riddled with arrows.
Besides that.
There were about a dozen military men standing in the middle of the defense line, sprinkling something with their hands continuously, and with each wave, a burst of colorful light would sprinkle onto the soldiers in combat.
Obviously, they were applying buffs and the like.
There was even a middle-aged man in a military uniform who blew a horn, and the crossbow arrows stuck in the monsters' bodies actually returned the same way they came.
Perfect retrieval of crossbow arrows during battle.
Then there were nearly a thousand military personnel holding various melee weapons, standing by coldly, ready to take over at any moment.
Chen Yi was somewhat shaken by this.
He had assumed that the military people were all sticklers, maybe not quite able to adapt, to a world that had suddenly been saddled with something as absurd and outrageous as a game.
Looking at it now.
The military had not only adapted quickly but had adapted very well!
Through various props and skills, they had already developed a set of tactics that, while still a bit immature, would definitely evolve more and more as time went on.
"Bang."
Chen Yi also took a shot out of curiosity.
A bit of blood appeared on the head of a monster in the midst of the Insect Tide, obviously without serious harm, not even bothering to glance in Chen Yi's direction.
Completely useless.
His sniper rifle, in this situation, was utterly useless.
But he did notice one interesting point.
There were no damage numbers popping up over the monster's head, and he wondered if it was only when attacking a boss that blood-red numbers representing damage would float up.
But... there were just too many in the Insect Tide.
The crossbow arrows alone were not enough to stop these densely packed insects.
It soon came to close combat, these fearlessly fierce monsters wildly charged toward the military ranks!!
Casualties occurred quickly.
Without any hesitation.
The nearly one thousand people wielding melee weapons who had been on standby rushed to meet the monsters, and colorful lights sprinkled on these people, while those with crossbows quickly retreated, continuing to look for the right opportunity in the rear.
Three minutes later.
Those with melee weapons also quickly retreated, providing enough shooting space for their comrades in the rear with crossbows, as a volley of arrows continued to shoot straight through.
It's a pity they weren't bows and arrows.
In terms of area attack.
The penetrating power of crossbow arrows was still not as effective as the splatter damage bows and arrows could provide.
The players who had volunteered to come and defend were now each charging toward the monsters they had found alone.
Urban combat was the most brutal.
The players used all kinds of means to bury those monsters that had rushed into the streets right where they were.
They were going to let these monsters know that this steel jungle was a forbidden area for all monsters.
Casualties kept occurring.
Perhaps the existence of version updates, props, and Skill Fragments made everyone subconsciously think this was just a game, but when the former comrades appeared before their own eyes.
Only then did everyone realize that this was not a game but a war.
It was a war where failure would mean the annihilation of their kind.
...
"Did you find it, Yi?"
At this point, the war had fully escalated.
The military personnel were retreating step by step, and they didn't even have time to collect the bodies anymore, with no reinforcements left!
You should know that the Insect Tide was not only attacking Yancheng from this direction but was coming from all sides, and the battles in other directions were equally intense, leaving no chance to send more help.
The Law Enforcement Bureau was already in the city center, loudly urging capable men over loudspeakers to go to the front lines for support!
It was quite obvious.
The only way to save Yancheng now was for all the players in the city to unite and fight against those monsters.
With the mobilization, indeed, many men, looking fearful but roaring fiercely, grabbed all sorts of weapons and headed from the city center to the edges to join the battle.
They were afraid to come, but many were aware that if Yancheng couldn't be held, everyone would die.
They fled back to the city center to protect their families.
They picked up weapons and went to the front lines for the same reason—to protect their families.
"No."
Chen Yi stood at the edge of a rooftop, his expression slightly grim, his eyes unwavering as he continually searched within the Insect Tide but found no monster that stood out from the rest.
Could his conjecture have been wrong?
There was no Insect Race Queen or anything like that among these monsters?
If he could just find the Insect Race Queen, he could activate the Skill he had just acquired and instantly deal with all of these Insect Race monsters.
However...
Just as Chen Yi was preparing to climb to a taller building not far away to find a better vantage point.
His eyes suddenly lit up as he stared at a monster in the beast tide nearby, a creature as tall as three men, emitting a blissful growl.
This monster was much larger than the other Insect Race monsters and had a bloated off-white rear.
Standing motionless in the midst of the Insect Tide, yet monsters charging forward by its side would automatically move slightly to the side when passing by, indicating that this monster's status in the Insect Tide was certainly not low!
Immediately after, without any hesitation, Chen Yi transformed the sniper rifle into a Christmas Cane, ready to go down the building and find a way to that Insect Race Origin.
But it was just as he glanced at the Insect Race Origin before leaving.
A panel suddenly appeared before his eyes.
'Monster Name': First-Level Insect Race Matriarch.
'Monster Ability': Able to continuously produce 'Worms' and control the 'Worms' it generates.
'Monster Introduction': Can simultaneously control ten thousand worms, serving as the First-Level Insect Race Matriarch in the 'Extraterrestrial Invader' event, acting under the orders of a Second-Level Insect Race Matriarch.
'PS': A Second-Level Insect Race Matriarch can control one hundred First-Level Insect Race Queens. The highest leader for this 'Extraterrestrial Invader' event is a Ninth-Level Insect Race Matriarch.
Chen Yi, staring at this suddenly emerged panel, slowly widened his mouth as a somewhat insane idea popped into his head.
His C-level Skill 'Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!' could kill any monster when activated, and all of that monster's clan members down the line would be instantly killed.
This meant that if he killed that 'First-Level Insect Race Matriarch', then the ten thousand worm monsters controlled by this Insect Race Matriarch would all die instantly.
But the First-Level Insect Race Matriarch was under the rule of the Second-Level Insect Race Matriarch.
Chen Yi stood still, his body slightly stiffening as he swallowed dryly, looking down at the Christmas Cane in his hand.
Did that mean if he killed that Ninth-Level Insect Race Matriarch!
All the monsters in this global event would instantly die?
One shot, Annihilate Nine Clans?
This was clearly—
One shot, Annihilate an Entire Race!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 24 "My name is... Tie Chui, but you can call me Hammer.
chapters.content:
Tuberculosis Rabbit also reacted.
Swallowing nervously, his eyes gleamed with insane excitement as he abruptly turned to look at the monstrous tide, his voice trembling with agitation.
"Yi,"
"Does that mean if we can find the ultimate origin of this wave of monsters, we could kill all the monsters in the global event with one shot?"
"How much reward would that be?"
"Wouldn't the planet have to be renamed Chen after this?"
"Theoretically, that's correct."
Chen Yi stared intently at the Insect Race Origin in the midst of the insect tide, a creature twice as large as the others: "But this Insect Race Origin is just a level-one Insect Race Matriarch, controlling only ten thousand Insect Race members."
"The one controlling the global Insect Race is a level-nine Insect Race Matriarch."
"Let alone a level-nine Insect Race Matriarch, in such a dense insect tide, it's difficult to even find a level-two Matriarch."
If we find it, can we kill it?
Yes.
His sniper rifle is capable of percentage-based real damage.
No matter if it's a level-one Insect Race Matriarch or a level-nine Insect Race Matriarch.
Just get hit by 33 of his bullets, even if the Jade Emperor himself showed up, he'd show you a death.
Even if a god showed up, as long as they dared to show their health bar, they'd have to suffer a few major blows.
But if a level-nine Insect Race Matriarch really appeared before him, would he dare to shoot?
Definitely not!
He could break the defense, but that didn't make him invincible. Facing such a boss-level entity, a single glare might be enough to finish him off.
So he wasn't crazy enough to go looking for a level-nine Insect Race Matriarch to see who was tougher.
Especially when the world is so vast.
Who knows where that level-nine Insect Race Matriarch is hiding?
Meanwhile.
The leaderboard above Yancheng showed that the top ranker already had nearly 237 Kill Points!
Killing one Insect Race monster earns one Kill Point.
To kill so many in such a short time, it was a situation where one man held the pass against ten thousand others.
While Chen Yi was pondering.
"Boom!!!"
The roaring sound suddenly rose from far to near, resonating by their ears.
Glancing over, they saw an unarmed helicopter slowly landing on their rooftop.
A middle-aged man in military uniform jumped down from the co-pilot seat and stood in front of Chen Yi, saluting before speaking hoarsely.
"My name is Li Guo."
"I am here on a special operation that requires your participation."
"Through satellite, we have spotted an extremely large Insect Race creature on the outskirts of Yancheng's insect tide, and we suspect this Insect Race Origin might be the leader of the other creatures."
"If we kill it,"
"those monsters might lose control and scatter in panic, allowing Yancheng to survive this disaster."
"We have taken note of your performance in the Cupid event, and you possess a Weapon capable of inflicting percentage damage. We now invite you to join us in this decapitation operation."
"Of course—"
Seeing that Chen Yi wasn't speaking, the middle-aged man paused and continued, "If you don't wish to fight, you may lend us your Prop temporarily."
"When we return successfully, we will return it to you and pay you a substantial reward."
Chen Yi's brow furrowed slightly, and after a moment of silence, he pointed towards the Origin in the insect tide that he had been watching: "Are you referring to that one?"
"No, one that's even bigger."
"Bigger? Then it's at least a level-two Insect Race Matriarch, right?"
Licking his slightly dry lips, Chen Yi narrowed his eyes and began to calculate silently in his heart.
A level-two Insect Race Matriarch can control 100 level-one Insect Race Matriarchs.
A level-one Insect Race Matriarch can control 10,000 Insect Race monsters.
That is to say, killing a level-two Insect Race creature would be equivalent to killing 1 million Insect Race monsters.
Dangerous, yes, it was a bit dangerous.
But the benefits were truly significant.
He took a deep breath and patted Tuberculosis Rabbit's shoulder, "I'll go alone on this operation, you should stay back, your abilities won't be of any use if you follow."
"How can that be possible?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit immediately became anxious, speaking hurriedly with a worried look on his face, "Yi, we're a team, how can you leave me behind?"
"Without you, I'll feel really insecure."
"Listen to me."
Chen Yi shook his head calmly and then leaned in to whisper in his ear, "Stay here and come to pick me up later, understand?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit was stunned for a moment, subconsciously prepared to glance at the middle-aged man in uniform next to him, but quickly stopped himself. After a pause, he hoarsely said.
"Understood."
"Don't worry, Yi, with me here, there won't be any problems."
"Mm, as long as you understand."
Chen Yi patted Tuberculosis Rabbit's shoulder, said nothing more, and followed the middle-aged man to the helicopter.
Firearms couldn't be used anymore.
But vehicles like tanks and armed helicopters that had their firearms removed could still be used normally, they just lacked offensive capabilities now.
At this moment, inside the helicopter cabin, besides him, there were two other people.
One was a towering giant of a man.
The other was a loli who was less than one and a half meters tall.
Only, she wasn't dressed in typical loli attire, wearing a short black crop top and hot pants on the lower half of her body.
Her figure wasn't bad.
She stood out quite markedly.
Even Chen Yi subconsciously took a few more glances.
"What are you looking at?"
As if she sensed Chen Yi's gaze, the little loli slowly opened her eyes and spoke with an icy, crisp voice, "Surprised to see a loli not dressed in loli clothes?"
"What kind of perverted old man would like loli clothes?"
"Stereotype!"
And at that moment—
"Hehe."
The towering man sitting inside the helicopter, whose muscles seemed almost ready to burst out, squeezed out a friendly yet awkward smile and stuttered loudly.
"She... my sister, cute, right?"
"My name... Tie Chui, you can call me Hammer."
Chen Yi furrowed his brows and remained silent, simply putting on his noise-cancelling headphones, noticing that the towering man's facial expressions seemed a bit off, his head twitching uncontrollably when he spoke.
At this time, the helicopter had already taken off.
The loud noise echoed in everyone's ears.
After hesitating for a moment, he still took out a cigarette from his pocket and offered it to the giant.
A glint of light flashed in the giant's eyes, just as he was about to accept the cigarette with both hands, he was abruptly stopped by the loli beside him.
"Don't take it!"
"I don't like you smoking!"
Seeing this, Hammer obviously became anxious, blocking the loli with a worried and stammering urgency.
"You... what do you know?"
"This is the highest form of courtesy between men, this brother... respects me... that's why he's offering me a cigarette."
"Quick... give it to me."
Chen Yi, noticing this, turned his head to look out of the cabin with a somewhat complex expression, remaining silent. The towering man in front of him was likely suffering from pathological cerebral palsy, his intelligence probably stuck in childhood, with some motor coordination issues.
Such people, before the game arrived, might not have been bullied terribly, but it was all too common to receive disdainful looks.
It was only after the game arrived.
Through some means, he must have acquired some rather powerful Skills to be considered valuable enough to be brought along on this beheading operation.

chapters.title: Chapter 25 A symphony of dense reward notification sounds echoed.
chapters.content:
"You...!"
The little loli was obviously a bit angry, but seeing her brother like this, she hesitated for a moment before handing the cigarette to Hammer, "Here, don't make a habit of it. The doctor said you should try not to smoke."
"Okay."
Hammer, excited, took the cigarette and carefully placed it into his jacket pocket before grinning at Chen Yi, "Brother, thanks, man!"
"Heh heh."
Chen Yi also laughed, didn't speak, just took a lighter out of his pocket and stuffed it into the brawny man's jacket pocket.
He had only casually handed out a cigarette, after all.
He didn't know why, but this brawny man seemed to be excited about it, maybe in the eyes of the man, being given a cigarette was a recognition of his manhood.
Instead of treating him like a mentally challenged person with the intelligence of a several-year-old child.
It's just...
He looked down calmly at the endless Insect Tide below, this time he might be getting sold out.
This beheading operation was essentially a suicide mission.
Although that man didn't spell it out.
But some things were obvious at a glance.
Sitting in a helicopter, going to the center of the Insect Tide to kill the Insect Race Origin sounded simple, but how were they going to get back?
It was basically a one-way mission.
However, if everything went smoothly, perhaps they wouldn't need to land the helicopter; they could use a sniper rifle to kill the Origin right from the air.
Provided that the Origin didn't have any long-range attacks from a great distance.
They flew for almost ten minutes.
They had finally seen the massive Matriarch amidst the countless Insect Tide on the plains!
It was as tall as two small buildings.
At that moment, Chen Yi held the Christmas Cane in his hand and looked down at this gigantic Matriarch. Sure enough, a panel appeared before him.
'Monster Name': Second-tier Insect Race Queen.
'Monster Ability': Can continuously produce 'First-tier Insect Race Queens' and control the 'First-tier Insect Race Queens' it produces.
'Monster Introduction': Capable of controlling 100 First-tier Insect Race Queens at the same time. The Second-tier Insect Race Queen in this 'Extraterrestrial Invader' event, obeying the commands of the Third-tier Insect Race Queen.
Just as he had anticipated.
His sniper rifle, when transformed into the Christmas Cane, had the ability to see through one layer of obstacles, which was essentially X-ray vision.
But if it was a monster that didn't wear clothes, without any obstructions in the middle, then the panel would be directly visible.
It was a kind of hidden effect.
"Fire!"
At that moment, Chen Yi's earpiece carried the loud command from the man in the co-pilot's seat.
Clearly, the military's plan was simple and crude.
First, fire directly to see what the effect would be.
Chen Yi looked up at the middle-aged man in the co-pilot's seat, his eyelids drooping, not speaking, just slowly raising the sniper rifle, aiming at the Matriarch in the middle of the Insect Tide below.
"Bang!"
The muffled sound of the gunshot rang out!
'-60000!'
A huge number in blood-red appeared above the Insect Race Matriarch!
His single shot could deal true damage equal to 3% of maximum health value, implying that the boss's life value was a whopping 2 million health!
That's double the health value of Cupid!
Thankfully, the sniper rifle in his hands was a prop, unlike a real sniper rifle. As long as the target was in the scope, not too distant, and not too small, it would hit.
No need for professional sniping skills!
"Exactly!"
The middle-aged man in the co-pilot's seat saw this and yelled with some enthusiastic information, raising his fist firmly, "It's definitely percentage damage!"
"Don't stop, keep firing!!!"
"..."
Chen Yi lightly massaged his shoulder which had been jolted slightly sore by the shot, his expression calm as he scanned the man in the co-pilot's seat. Without a word, he took aim again with the sniper rifle at the monster below.
He didn't want to kill people.
But the red glow in that man's eyes made him think he might really have to kill a bunch of people this time.
He considered himself a good person, but that didn't mean he would allow others to take his possessions.
No matter who that other person was.
"Bang!"
The second shot rang out again!
A terrifying red number indicating damage appeared once more above the head of the Insect Race Origin!
And at this moment—
The Insect Race Origin seemed to realize the attack was coming from above, and with its somewhat bloated head, it emitted a piercing shriek that made Chen Yi and the others, despite wearing noise-cancelling headphones, feel a ringing in their ears and a sense of discomfort in their bodies.
But other than that, there was no other reaction.
It didn't even attack the helicopter that was continuously circling above its head!
"Huh?"
Chen Yi had a hint of surprise in his eyes; this monster actually had no long-range attack capabilities.
If that was the case!
Then he would not hold back!
One shot, another shot, and yet another!
This time, there was nothing to absorb the recoil!
The recoil from more than thirty shots was completely borne by him, and now both of his shoulders were so sore and numb that he nearly couldn't feel them anymore.
During those thirty-plus shots, other than the Origin emitting ear-piercing screams and having monsters of the Insect Race huddle around it, attempting to shield it from damage, it made no other retaliatory moves.
This situation made Chen Yi feel a tinge of regret.
If every Insect Race Origin lacked long-range attack abilities, then if he could find a level nine Insect Race Origin, wouldn't he be able to easily kill even the level nine Insect Race Matriarch!
Finally—
After thirty-plus shots, the life value of the Insect Race Origin had dwindled to 5%.
Just one more shot!
Under the effect of the slaying blow, he would be able to kill the level two Insect Race Origin with one shot, annihilating the 999 clans beneath it completely!
Essentially, he would kill a million Insect Race monsters with one shot!
But just as he was about to activate the "Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!" skill.
The man sitting in the co-pilot's seat suddenly shouted with slight excitement through the headset: "That's enough, no more shooting."
"Your task is now finished."
"You did well, there will be a reward for you when you get back."
Then, staring straight at Hammer, he spoke word by word: "Do you remember what I told you before boarding the helicopter?"
"It's your turn to act now."
"Just place that crystal bomb on top of that Insect Race Origin's head below, and your task will be complete."
"Hurry..."
Before the middle-aged man could finish his sentence.
Chen Yi calmly fired the final shot.
"Bang!"
Next second—
A flurry of reward notifications, like a symphony, crazily erupted around Chen Yi's ears!
Global announcements also followed one after another.
The middle-aged man speaking stopped in surprise and then, angry, pointed at Chen Yi and yelled, "Didn't I tell you to stop shooting? Are you fucking insane?"
"Do you realize whose reward you've stolen?"
"You're courting death!!!"
Chen Yi didn't speak, simply took out a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and held the sniper rifle in one hand with the barrel pressed against the middle-aged man's forehead. After exhaling a puff of smoke, he spoke softly.
"Quit your bullshit act of being a big shot."
"Even if the Heavenly King came down, he couldn't steal my kill."

chapters.title: Chapter 26 "Wait, does this make sense?
chapters.content:
"You!!"
The middle-aged man sitting in the helicopter co-pilot seat stared at Chen Yi with a hateful expression and growled word by word, "Someone as selfish and despicable as you should have been executed immediately!"
"When you left Yancheng, did you see those soldiers?"
"They were charging to the frontlines, risking their lives, just to protect you weak and useless citizens!"
"If the reward for this boss were given to the military, it would mean so much more than in your hands, including that sniper rifle you're holding. A fixed-percentage damage weapon should not be in your hands!!"
"Sure talk a lot."
Chen Yi sighed lightly, tapping his finger on the trigger, tossing the cigarette that hadn't burned out yet onto the dense cluster of lights below, and whispered.
"Your confidence comes from knowing that my gun deals percentage damage."
"Can't a single shot kill a person?"
The next second—
"Zzt!"
Chen Yi's right arm forcefully thrust the sniper rifle straight into the man's eye socket, piercing right through!
Under the effect of the passive skill "Calm and Composed," his physical attributes had been maintained at a two-time enhancement for a long time.
Calling it Qilin Arm was no exaggeration.
Guns have more ways to kill than just bullets.
Blood erupted violently, and with a slight flex of his arm, he flung the middle-aged man's corpse from the chopper right as he was ready to switch with the helicopter pilot.
Suddenly, he realized the helicopter was losing control, spiraling downward.
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi frowned, lifting the pilot's helmet with the gunpoint, only to discover that the pilot was actually a wooden figure, resembling a puppet of some sort, definitely not a living person.
After the middle-aged man died, it started to lose control.
"This is bad."
He glanced uncertainly towards the distance, pulling out a small mirror from his chest, and hurriedly said to the two people beside him, "Follow me, I'll take you with me."
This was his original plan.
This mission, it was hard to ensure a safe return.
After all, the plan had seemed rudimentary and resigned to death from the very beginning.
In case something went wrong.
He would activate his own skill, dive into the mirror, then quickly head towards Tuberculosis Rabbit.
And Tuberculosis Rabbit would also have a mirror, riding a motorcycle towards him.
To ensure that they could leave the mirror world within 10 minutes.
Otherwise, they would be overdue and trapped in the mirror world forever.
"No need."
Iron Hammer, sitting beside him, chuckled dumbly a couple of times, grabbed the little loli's legs, swung her around in the air, and then hurled her forcefully down towards the ground below the helicopter.
"Brother, watch this."
The little loli hadn't even had the chance to speak before she started spinning rapidly in the air and shot straight towards the ground.
The moment Chen Yi took out the mirror, ready to activate his skill, he subconsciously froze upon seeing this scene. He looked up at Tie Chui in front of him, his expression somewhat baffled.
Didn't you say she was your sister?
And you just threw her out like that?
As if she was a hand grenade?
The next second—
Iron Hammer suddenly extended his right hand, grabbing his arm, and just as Chen Yi was about to drive the sniper rifle into this man's skull, he suddenly saw a flash of white light in front of his eyes.
When his vision returned,
His feet were already on the ground.
And the helicopter above was still slowly falling, crashing to the ground a few seconds later with an explosion and bursting into fierce flames.
Chen Yi scanned the dense array of props on the ground around him, still not quite catching up,
Only to see Tie Chui pulling out a Rubik's cube from his chest and handing it to him.
"Here, this is the crystal bomb that guy mentioned..."
"You're my brother... How could I possibly steal your monster?"
"He's too dumb."
"That's not important, we'll talk about it later."
Chen Yi put away the sniping rifle he was holding and looked at the two people in front of him with a frown, asking subconsciously, "Just now... what was that?"
He really didn't understand what had just happened.
"It was a skill."
The little lolita crossed her arms in front of her chest, slightly raising her eyebrows with a hint of pride, "I have a skill that's a C-grade skill."
"It allows me to ignore distance, with no consumption, and instantly draw a bound player to my side."
"And Tie Chui's skill... nevermind, Tie Chui, you show him."
"Hehe, okay."
Tie Chui chuckled, and a skill panel appeared above his head.
'Skill Name': Malphite's Brain.
'Skill Level': C-grade Skill.
'Skill Type': Passive Skill.
'Skill Effect': When the brain is not thinking, the following effects can be obtained:
Body defense effect, greatly enhanced.
Limb strength effect, greatly enhanced.
'Additional Effect': This skill is limited to 1000 pieces, 38 of which have already been acquired.
When all 1000 pieces of the skill are acquired, a hidden effect will be activated.
(Brain Share): When one of the players starts thinking, the IQ of the remaining 999 players will slightly decline, but their body defense and limb strength will increase.
When 999 players start thinking, the remaining one player's IQ will sharply decline, but body defense and limb strength will receive an epic enhancement!!!
'Skill Introduction': "Firm as a rock, charge!!!!"
"..."
Chen Yi stared at the skill panel floating above Tie Chui's head, remaining silent and speechless.
That's pretty good.
This was his first time seeing a limited-edition skill.
And it was globally limited to 1000 pieces.
Even though it's just a C-grade skill, it's already being limited.
But the skill effect... it seems really suitable for Tie Chui, essentially a permanent enhancement of physical quality—like a godly skill!
It feels even stronger than his own Calm and Composed skill.
No, his Calm and Composed is stronger.
At least his godlike composure isn't gained through fear.
And after all 1000 pieces of the skill are acquired, a hidden effect can be activated, which although has a big drawback, the payoff sounds quite good.
He felt a bit of pain in his teeth, subconsciously took out a cigarette and put it in his mouth to cover his embarrassment, then gestured as he spoke.
"So you mean—"
"Your just-now process was, Tie Chui threw you to the ground, then just before you landed, you drew Tie Chui to your side?"
"Having Tie Chui in mid-air to help you offset the impact force?"
"And then you stood on Tie Chui's shoulders to land safely?"
"Wait, does that even make sense?"
"What is this?"
The little lolita standing aside with her arms crossed, somewhat disdainful yet proud, spoke up, "That's nothing, wait till you see our combination move!"
"Tie Chui, combine!"
"Got it!"
The next second—
All they saw was Tie Chui grabbing the little lolita's legs, swinging her around in the air a few times before tossing her straight up into the sky!
Whoosh!

chapters.title: Chapter 27 The brilliance of those five titles is really dazzling.
chapters.content:
Whoosh!
Like daytime fireworks, they rocketed straight into the sky!
Immediately afterward, just as the little loli was about to fall in mid-air, the hammer was drawn back to her side.
Then Tie Chui grabbed the little loli's legs again and flung her even higher!
The little loli, thrown to greater heights, summoned the hammer back to her side once more.
After several rounds of this.
In the sky, these two had become tiny black dots that were nearly shoulder to shoulder, about to vanish from Chen Yi's line of sight.
"Gulp."
Stunned in place, he swallowed hard as he gazed at the two dots that seemed about to fly out of the atmosphere. His face was vacant as he unconsciously lit the cigarette at the corner of his mouth.
In the midst of the light blue wisps of smoke, he rubbed his neck, which was a bit sore from looking up for so long, and murmured.
"Not bad."
"This is a skill combination effect I never thought of."
Looking at their manner, it seemed they only needed a spacesuit and the two could head straight to the moon to settle down.
Are they just going to escape from Blue Star?
Isn't this just a C-level skill? Was it necessary for its effect to be this exaggerated?
And this speed... To be honest, he felt it was much faster than a helicopter.
If nothing unexpected happened, these two should be able to survive for a long time, even if they fell into the Insect Tide, they should be able to escape easily.
He took a deep breath and looked down at his surroundings, rubbing his somewhat sore neck again.
Snakes have snake paths, and rats have rat trails.
This world is becoming crazier and crazier.
At this moment, there were no longer any Insect Race monsters to be seen around him.
All were lying motionlessly on the ground as corpses, which were beginning to fade and slowly disappear.
The ground, however, was scattered with many shimmering dropped items.
They were dropped by the Second Level Insect Race Matriarch.
Other lesser monsters don't drop items upon death.
As for the First Level Insect Race Matriarch's death, it did drop items, but they were too scattered. He definitely wouldn't be able to pick them all up. Maybe he should...
Just give them away.
He looked thoughtfully at the scene before him, preparing to first use the prop that could be broadcast live. After all, the scene before his eyes was not common. It should be eye-catching enough.
It could earn a big wave of Points.
As for his backpack, it was almost stuffed full. The backpack had only 100 slots, and 78 slots were already occupied at this time.
One prop took up one slot.
One type of Skill Fragment took up one slot.
100 slots seemed somewhat insufficient.
But, before going live—
Chen Yi, with a serious expression, pinched out his cigarette and prepared to start sorting through his gains!
Firstly, there were the dense system notifications.
There were just too many.
After he killed the Second Level Insect Race Matriarch, the dense system notifications began to sound incessantly.
It felt like this global event was more about getting players accustomed to or warming up for the June version update, because these Insect Race monsters didn't seem as strong as he had imagined.
An ordinary person wielding a weapon could also kill an Insect Race monster.
Even the Insect Race boss monsters didn't have very powerful attacks; they just had a bit more health.
It was a bit like a welfare event.
And these system notifications completely filled the notification page of Chen Yi's personal panel on the left side.
Firstly, there was the global announcement that all players could see.
'Global Announcement:' Central Hua Region's Yancheng became the first city to resolve the "Extraterrestrial Invader" crisis during this global event. All Yancheng affiliated players will receive a 50 Points reward and 3 random Skill Fragments.
"Global Announcement": In the Central Hua Region's Yancheng, the player with the most Kill Points in the "Extraterrestrial Invader" event is—Chen Yi, hereby awarded the title (Invincible Under the Heavens)!
Then there was the personal announcement that only he could see.
"Ding, you have killed 1 second-level Insect Race Matriarch, 95 first-level Insect Race Matriarchs, and 920,000 Insect Race monsters, earning a total of 970,000 points!"
"Friendly reminder, the global event lasts for three days. Please spend your points in the 'Extraterrestrial Invader' event shop before the event ends; failure to do so will be treated as forfeiture."
"Ding, you've single-handedly killed 900,000 of your kin, earning the extremely rare title (Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans)!!!"
"Ding, you have killed over 500,000 Insect Race monsters, earning the rare title (Nemesis of the Insect Race)!!!"
"Ding, you have become the first player to appear in the global announcement, earning the rare title (Peerless Under the Sky)!!!"
"Ding, you have successfully picked up a C-level prop..."
The flood of system messages made Chen Yi's eyes hurt.
But he didn't feel the slightest bit of annoyance.
After all, these were all his rewards, the things that would determine what heights he could reach in the future world!
How could it feel tedious.
After briefly reviewing the rewards he had received this time,
Chen Yi suddenly fell silent where he stood.
Moments later, he lit a cigarette and put it in his mouth, his expression distant as he looked at the "Fatal Strike" title above his head glowing with blue light, and after a moment, he exhaled softly and whispered.
"You have companions now."
"You won't be alone anymore; let me count... you have a total of... 4 companions."
Yes.
Among these dense rewards, he was directly awarded 4 more titles!
They were—
"Invincible Under the Heavens!"
"Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!"
"Nemesis of the Insect Race!"
"Peerless Under the Sky!"
Four neat titles—he could even imagine how they looked floating above his head.
These titles were tradable before they were permanently bound, meaning he could trade them to other players for Points.
But... the effects that came with these titles were very tempting.
Trading them for Points would be a waste.
That being said,
Chen Yi still couldn't help but slightly twitch the corners of his mouth; it felt a bit ridiculous to wander around in the real world with 5 titles over his head.
At least, he could no longer work as a sniper.
What kind of lucky outfit could conceal those 5 titles that glowed continuously in the dark?
Pretty good.
He could even imagine the rate at which people turned their heads on the street.
Essentially 99%.
The remaining 1% must be blind.
Afterward, he took a deep breath and firmly resolved to bind all 4 new titles and wear them.
Lucky he hadn't completed that mission for the Cupid title, otherwise, there would be one more "Lucky Child of the God of Love" title over his head.
And at that moment—
Tie Chui finally crashed down from the air.
"Uh... bro."
Just as Tie Chui got up from the ground and tried to say something, he looked up at the nearly two-meter stack of titles above Chen Yi's head and was stunned where he stood.
So dazzling.
The light from those 5 titles was really dazzling.

chapters.title: Chapter 28 "Does light pollution really need to be this excessive?
chapters.content:
"Gulp."
Tie Chui looked up admiringly and longingly at the row of titles above Chen Yi's head.
"Brother, you... you're really amazing!"
In the midst of his words,
the man's neck spasmed uncontrollably a few times.
Chen Yi also let out a sigh but didn't speak, instead starting to ponder.
The effects of these four titles were all quite good.
They were—
'Title Name': Invincible Under the Heavens.
'Title Level': Yellow.
'Title Effect': You can activate a supreme yellow semi-transparent staircase that leads to your desired destination, with a maximum climbing height of 300 meters and maximum length of 1000 meters. After use, it enters a 24-hour cooldown period.
'Obtaining Method': Achieve first place on the kill score leaderboard in the "Extraterrestrial Invader Event" for a certain city!
-
'Title Name': Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!
'Title Level': Red.
'Title Effect': When you hold a cane-like prop, a 2-meter diameter red patterned light circle will appear at your feet, and you can rise from within the circle on a scarlet Frozen Throne on the spot, entering a 30-minute cooldown after use. Activating the chair grants special effects.
'Special Effects': When the Frozen Throne is activated, you can summon a fully obedient heavy-armored soldier at the cost of 10 Points, with no limit on summon quantity.
'Obtaining Method': Kill 900,000 or more monsters of the same kind in one go.
-
'Title Name': Nemesis of the Insect Race.
'Title Level': Blue.
'Title Effect': No bug dares to come near you, as you will have an aura that instils extreme fear in all insects around you.
'Obtaining Method': Kill a total of more than 500,000 Insect Race monsters.
-
'Title Name': Peerless Under the Sky!
'Title Level': Yellow.
'Title Effect': After activation, your pupils will flash with lightning for ten seconds, with no cooldown time.
'Obtaining Method': Become the first player to appear in a global announcement.
Yes.
These were the effects of his four titles.
Chen Yi, his face expressionless, leaned on the slightly out-of-character Christmas Cane in his hand, and a red patterned light circle appeared around his feet, looking particularly eye-catching.
He tentatively activated the title effect of Peerless Under the Sky.
Instantly—
His deep pupils flashed rapidly with streaks of lightning like a serpent.
He picked up a mirror and placed it in Tie Chui's arms.
Then he saw his current state in the mirror.
After sighing lightly, he murmured in a low voice,
"Does the light pollution really need to be cranked up this high?"
His current state!
He was even a bit embarrassed to look at himself!
He always felt that the development team of this game seemed to have some sort of wicked sense of humor, always liking to add some flashy stuff.
However, that red title's special effect was kind of interesting and could be useful in certain situations... maybe.
He shook his head helplessly, turned to look at the little loli standing next to Tie Chui, and suddenly held his breath.
This little loli was wearing only a tight crop top and a pair of denim shorts.
And his cane's effect... included seeing through obstacles.
After being silent for a while, he put the cane back into his backpack without any change in expression, and then continued to look at the two people in front of him.
"There should be quite a few good items around."
"You guys go pick them up."
"They're a bit far, so I'll pass."
Then, without continuing the conversation, he turned and walked in the direction of Yancheng, pulling out the live streaming prop from his bosom as he went.
If I don't use it soon, this prop is going to disappear.
Let's take it out first and circle back to the tickets afterward.
"Prop Name": Livestream Ticket.
"Prop Level": Grade C.
"Prop Effect": Can initiate a livestream that can accommodate up to 100,000 players. When the user starts the livestream, 100,000 players globally will receive random notifications about whether they can enter the livestream room. If players choose to enter, they need to pay 6 Points.
"Prop Restrictions": The livestream can last up to 3 hours at most. The user can only keep half of all the Points they earn, and the prop is single-use only. If it's not used within 24 hours, it will automatically disappear.
"Skill Introduction": "Come and start a livestream that belongs to you!"
Originally, he was thinking about what kind of content to broadcast to attract more people into his livestream room to earn as many Points as possible.
Now it seems that it might not be so complicated.
After all, he's somewhat famous now.
The first player to appear on the global announcement, and the one who killed the most during the Extraterrestrial Invader event in Yancheng.
Once he revealed his name, who wouldn't want to spend 6 Points to come and take a look at him?
Who wouldn't want to come in and ask how he did it?
Without any hesitation,
he immediately set the livestream title to—
"Chen Yi, Rank One player globally, answering your questions live."
The moment the livestream room opened!
"Whoosh whoosh whoosh!!!"
The number of viewers began to skyrocket!!!
It didn't stop until it hit 78,000.
Only 22,000 people didn't enter his livestream room; those people might either think that 6 Points is too expensive, unwilling to spend it, or they just didn't have 6 Points to spare at all.
But regardless of the reason, he was already quite satisfied with this number.
Questions started rolling across the screen like crazy.
He casually picked a few that he knew the answers to and replied. Just like that, half an hour went by, and when he looked up again, he saw Tuberculosis Rabbit leaning on a motorcycle, smoking a cigarette.
"That's it for today's livestream."
"See you when fate allows it."
He casually turned off the livestream room, and at the same time, 216,000 Points were successfully credited to his account.
He finally understood why traffic is money.
If it wasn't for the fact that he, Chen Yi, had just been featured on the global announcement, he wasn't sure if he could have attracted so many viewers.
Only then did he look up at Tuberculosis Rabbit leaning on the motorcycle in front of him and spoke with some annoyance, "Weren't you coming to pick me up? You were just waiting here?"
"Hehe."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, eyes filled with excitement, grinned: "I was going to go, but seeing Brother Yi shoot up to the global announcement with just one shot, I knew you weren't in danger."
"So I just waited here for you."
"To give you the feeling of a triumphant return."
Chen Yi glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit and shook his head, "Enough with the nonsense, let's head back to the city."
"Roger that."
...
A few minutes later.
They rode the motorcycle back to Yancheng.
At this time, the military on the outskirts of Yancheng had already started cleaning up the battlefield.
The bodies of the monsters didn't need to be dealt with, as they would turn into white light and vanish on their own after a few minutes. However, the human corpses did need to be cleared.
And... with nearly a hundred Level 1 Matriarchs of the Insect Race dead, a lot of good stuff had dropped.
It looked like the military had already sealed off the exits of Yancheng and began sending people to collect these spoils of war.
And with the arrival of Chen Yi and his companion.
All eyes couldn't help but focus on Chen Yi.
It couldn't be helped.
Those five titles were simply too eye-catching; it was impossible to pretend not to see them.
Meanwhile,
inside the military headquarters, two elders were staring solemnly at a scene being transmitted by satellite.

chapters.title: Chapter 29 "When it comes to background checks, you still have to count on us.
chapters.content:
In the satellite imagery,
they could clearly see the helicopter, hovering above the monster, continuously attacking the Insect Race Matriarch.
Accompanied by the final blow,
the Insect Race Matriarch collapsed with a thunderous crash!
Immediately afterward!
Nearly a hundred red beams burst forth from the corpse of this Insect Race Matriarch, shooting in all directions at almost impossible speeds!
They struck directly into the bodies of nearly a hundred first-level Insect Race Matriarchs.
As these first-level Insect Race Matriarchs were hit by the red beams,
they had virtually no ability to resist and died on the spot.
But it wasn't over!
Falling like dominoes!!!
The entire scene looked incredibly shocking!!!
Just a moment ago, the millions of monsters surrounding Yancheng had all died in unison within three seconds!!!
This was a scene that even movie special effects would struggle to create, yet it was happening in reality.
"Huh!"
One of the two elders standing in front of the table, a short old man with thinning hair and wearing a gown, murmured in shock, "Such terrifying power."
"Even if our firearms had not been banned,"
"with our capabilities, we would also struggle to clear a million monsters within three seconds."
"This can already be called a power belonging to the gods."
"Hmm."
The other elder in formal attire and an icy expression pointed to the next part of the scene in the imagery, "This young man killed a soldier."
"He should be sent to a military tribunal."
"In special times, he should be executed by firing squad directly."
"No."
The short elder tightened the gown around him, signaling his subordinates to turn down the air conditioning before he spoke hoarsely, "Without firearms, our military isn't much stronger than the civilians."
"Most importantly, he has now become a hero of Yancheng."
"Killing a hero during war is a major taboo in military strategy."
The elder in formal wear nodded first, then spoke.
"But we can take away all his props and skills. These are different from titles. Titles cannot be lost once bonded, but props and skills have a high chance of dropping upon killing."
"Then what?"
The short elder lifted his eyelids to look at the man before him, "Are we to do this every time citizens have such an opportunity? Are we to kill everyone and take what they have?"
"How are we any different from bandits then?"
"I will report this matter, it's not for us to decide."
"However, inform the other cities first, Yancheng has made a significant discovery. If you kill the origin of the Insect Tide, the other monsters will die as well."
"..."
The elder in formal attire stayed calm, not speaking anymore, just looking at the plane that was slowly falling from the sky in the image, his eyes gradually narrowing without a word.
A national weapon,
can only be called a weapon when it is in one's own hands.
...
Meanwhile, as Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit entered Yancheng,
they were stopped by someone.
"Hello."
A young man in a suit appeared in front of Chen Yi with a respectful expression, accompanied by 18 women dressed in black stockings.
"Allow me to introduce myself, we are from Yancheng Mutual Entertainment KTV."
"Our boss would very much like to invite you to join our power."
"As long as you join our power."
"These... are just meeting gifts."
Chen Yi cast a thoughtful glance at these people and then looked towards the heavily guarded military presence nearby, nodding, "You guys should be classified as an illegal organization, right?"
"Let's not beat around the bush."
The young man smiled wryly, shaking his head, "It's only the second global update, and it's already like this. If it weren't for you, sir, who knows how many people in Yancheng would have died this time."
"Joining a power at least makes things more convenient for future actions."
"Besides, since Skill Fragments and Points have appeared, who knows if a Guild system might show up in the future? We're just getting a head start."
"I understand."
Chen Yi nodded, randomly sweeping his gaze around, "Go back and tell your boss, no need, I appreciate his kindness."
"Sorry."
The young man took a few steps back, tightened his tie, and looked at Chen Yi with a calm expression, "Our boss has a message for you, and you don't have the right to refuse."
"Join or die, you must choose one."
"Don't think the military can protect you. In the current situation, the death of a person is no different from that of a rat."
"..."
Chen Yi looked at the man in front of him with a slightly odd expression, instinctively raising his head to look at the five titles above his head, noting that they were still there and shining brightly.
He then looked at the young man in front of him with a bit of a toothache.
"Do these five titles on my head not intimidate you at all?"
"See them?"
"Look, that's the 'Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans' title."
"Doesn't that title look imposing and bloody?"
"At least give me the respect I deserve, and can you not threaten me to my face? It makes me feel like only I can see these titles on my head."
"They're still somewhat effective in deterring ordinary people."
As the young man retreated, he spoke softly with a calm expression, "We've investigated, you have a sniper gun that can deal a set percentage of damage."
"No matter the boss, as long as a certain number of shots are fired, any boss can be killed."
"And the rules for this 'Extraterrestrial Invader' event happen to be that if you kill the Insect Race Origin, those Insect Race monsters will also die."
"Your prop made you stand out in this event."
"But... good for killing bosses, not so much for killing people, right?"
"And to kill you, we only need one shot, we might not even need to fire. Do you know about May's rule?"
"Do you know how easy it is to kill someone using May's rule?"
"You have one day to think it over."
"Ask around, you should be able to find out which building Mutual Entertainment KTV is in, don't delay beyond the time limit."
"You... wouldn't want anything to happen to your family, would you?"
Having said that.
The young man swiftly left with the dozen or so women behind him.
...
"..."
Chen Yi stood in silence, somewhat at a loss for words, pulling a cigarette from his chest and lighting it as he turned to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit.
"Do I look that easy to bully?"
"I've got five titles on my head, and yet I'm being threatened so blatantly to my face?"
"Indeed."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in strong agreement, "He actually threatened us with family, doesn't he know we're classic orphans?"
"Where do we even have families?"
"This background check is obviously non-professional."
"Indeed."
Chen Yi let out a light sigh before nodding in agreement.
"In terms of background checks, they should learn from us."
"Let that Mutual Entertainment KTV boss understand the meaning of my title."
"That smug little brat is so annoying, he's given me a full-blown case of annoyance."

chapters.title: Chapter 30 "Player 'Liu Yishou' has activated the prop 'Arena'.
chapters.content:
This scene was witnessed by quite a few people.
After all, given the current status of Chen Yi, one could say he was the focal point of the crowd, and no one could resist taking a few extra glances at the man with five titles above his head.
Men, women, young, and old alike were interested.
Apart from Chen Yi, there were also many others in the crowd with titles above their heads.
However, they were all white.
"Lucky Child of the God of Love!"
You could earn this title by confessing your true feelings to a member of the opposite sex during the limited-time event on May 20th.
As to how sincerity was judged, the game had its own standards, similar to how it could determine if a player's thousand words spoken to others met the requirements of the daily "Active Expert" mission.
And as of today.
It just happened to be May 20th.
There were 11 days left until June 1st, and the month had 31 days.
At this time, the sky was gradually darkening.
People around started to shift their gaze away from Chen Yi and the others, beginning to busily tend to their own affairs.
Meanwhile, not far away.
Loud collision sounds were constantly resounding through the city.
Work had begun to clear the vehicles accumulated in the middle of the streets, and behind that, a small number of construction teams were seen slowly following.
It seemed preparations were being made to build some sturdy defense structures outside the city walls.
Fortunately, the last patch update had only restricted human firearms, but did not completely ban all of the existing technological achievements of humanity.
Nobody knew whether a monster siege like this would happen again.
The entire city started to get busy.
Authorities were shouting through loudspeakers on the streets, calling for construction workers to join them; in the chaos just now, the city's information system seemed close to collapsing, if not completely.
To look for someone in such circumstances,
was truly no small feat.
Besides that, it seemed like there was a lot more being said, but they were too far to hear clearly.
"Hmm."
Tuberculosis Rabbit took out a cigarette from his embrace and threw it into his mouth, hands in his pockets as he glanced around, tongue-clicking ruefully, "Maybe we should stock up on more cigarettes; who knows if the factories can continue running smoothly."
"The price of cigarettes has been going up recently."
"The amount we have stashed might not be enough."
"Hmm."
Chen Yi nodded slightly, then shrugged and took out his phone, opening the navigation app to start searching for the route to Mutual Entertainment KTV in Yancheng.
"That kid's words were strange too. He even told me to go and ask around."
"Doesn't he know there's something called navigation?"
"Let's go. It's best to deal with these people early. The world is becoming increasingly dangerous, and if any of them has some special prop or skill and ambushes us out of the blue, that wouldn't be good."
"That's true."
Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes narrowed as he drew the Claw Knife from his embrace, holding it in a reverse grip, and said in a cold tone, "What I hate most is people disturbing my sleep; those sneaky people will definitely attack me while I'm asleep."
"By the way—"
Chen Yi suddenly furrowed his brows and turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit, "What kinds of dreams do you have? Why were you talking to someone all night in your dreams?"
"And so clearly at that?"
"I've never seen anyone move their mouth during a wet dream, and if they do, it's certainly not like that."
"I don't know about that..." Tuberculosis Rabbit appeared somewhat confused, scratching the back of his head with a clear glint of foolishness in his eyes, "Every time I wake up, I've forgotten it completely."
"The only impression left is it's sort of like giving a speech or something."
"Forget it."
Chen Yi shook his head and did not speak further; instead, he focused on the navigation route and straddled a motorcycle, "Let's go, we've got some trouble to deal with tonight."
"Oh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit first nodded, then patted the motorcycle beneath him with some regret, "Yi, do you still remember our dream to buy the most expensive motorcycle?"
"Given the current global situation, it looks like that dream of ours will be hard to realize. Those manufacturers will probably be out of business for a long time."
"That's nothing to worry about."
Chen Yi, putting on a helmet nearby, said casually, "Judging by the patience of this game project's team, it wouldn't be surprising if they introduced vehicles later on."
"I even suspect we'll see outrageous vehicles like the Kowloon Coffin, the Heavenly Throne."
"Hold tight."
"You make sense, but I feel that with the speed you ride at, wearing a helmet is pretty much meaningless."
"It's for sound insulation, you talk too much."
"Oh."
...
"We're here."
In an office building opposite to the Mutual Entertainment KTV in Yancheng, Chen Yi and his companion stood on the 6th floor looking out at the short building.
That six-story building was the Mutual Entertainment KTV.
Chen Yi hid behind a pillar, peering out at Tuberculosis Rabbit who stood by with binoculars, "How is it, any movement inside that KTV?"
Yes.
He didn't dare stick his head out to check.
The reason was simple.
He was too conspicuous.
The five huge, glowing titles above his head nearly wiped out any possibility of reconnaissance, stealth, or assassination.
Can you imagine, while you're sitting in the KTV office leisurely sipping tea with your legs crossed, suddenly through the glass you spot five giant, shiny titles inside a room of the office building across the street?
Even an idiot would know someone had arrived.
"They should be in."
Tuberculosis Rabbit reported hurriedly with a mix of nervousness and excitement, "Floors one to five show no signs of life, the lights are off, but the sixth floor is brightly lit, though the curtains are drawn so I can't see clearly."
"But I can see many people moving on the sixth floor through the curtains."
"Understood."
Chen Yi breathed a sigh of relief and promptly took out a mirror from his bosom, preparing to enter the KTV through the mirror and deal with these people without alerting anyone.
After all, the city was in chaos at the moment.
But if he handled some matters too openly, it was still easy to be identified as a destabilizing element and be dealt with.
Especially the fact that only he had returned from the mission involving the helicopter, and not the middle-aged man.
The military hadn't inquired about this incident, which gave him a slight sense of unease.
It defied logic, and when something defies logic, it indicates a deeper logic within.
Just as he was about to act—
"Boom!!!"
A luminescent circle like an eggshell suddenly rose around the office building, enveloping both the building and the Mutual Entertainment KTV!
Following this—
A zone announcement suddenly blared in Chen Yi's ears!
"Player 'Liu Yishou' has activated the prop 'Arena.'"
"There are two factions within the Arena."
"Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit as one faction, and all others as the remaining faction."
"The Arena will only open when all members of one faction have been wiped out."
"Arena effect: All skills and props owned by players within the Arena cannot be used!"
"ps: A true Gladiator never relies on external forces!"

chapters.title: Chapter 31 "Come, let me see what tricks you still have up your sleeve.
chapters.content:
The next second—
A large group of people suddenly appeared on the rooftop of Mutual Entertainment KTV, and three massive searchlights shone directly into the room where Chen Yi and his companions were hiding.
The blinding light exposed the Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been concealed in the darkness, for all to see.
Right after that—
A bald man with his upper body bare arrogantly pulled out a megaphone and burst into loud laughter.
"Hahahaha!!!"
"Stop hiding, come on out!"
Chen Yi looked at the props in his backpack, which had turned gray, along with the skills on his personal panel that were also grayed out, and after a moment of silence,
he slowly walked out from cover and stood beside the floor-to-ceiling window, facing the piercing light as he looked towards the source.
He couldn't see those people.
But he could hear their voices.
"Surprise, isn't it?"
The bald man stood on the rooftop of Mutual Entertainment KTV, taking a cigar passed to him by a subordinate and putting it in his mouth, confidently staring down Chen Yi.
"I thought someone who achieved what you have would have some brains."
"But it turns out you're really quite stupid."
"Didn't you think that someone who could build up Yancheng's Mutual Entertainment KTV to this scale could be a fool?"
"Would I, like an idiot, send someone to provoke you brainlessly before I fully understood your background?"
"Foolish!"
"It was all just to lure you here, because this Arena prop can only be used in this place. I had to draw you here!"
"I know, I know, you want to know how I found you."
"Because when the Arena is semi-activated, it can obtain the exact coordinates of the player being declared war on in real-time. Your movements were really quite conspicuous in my eyes."
After saying all this,
the bald man somewhat reluctantly ordered his men to turn off the spotlight and looked towards Chen Yi and his companions standing in front of the office building's floor-to-ceiling window: "Don't you have anything to say?"
"You can try begging for mercy, or flatter my intelligence a bit. If I'm in a good mood, maybe I won't kill you."
"Although killing you to take your props is indeed tempting."
"But if you're willing to hand over your props voluntarily, that would be even better. After all, you know killing a player only has a high chance of dropping some props, and there are always losses."
"Oh right, I forgot to introduce myself."
"My name is Liu Yishou."
"I always hold something back in whatever I do, so don't even think about having a chance to escape."
"If I don't get an answer within three minutes,"
"then this game of cat and mouse is going to start. I have over thirty men here, and you can't use props or skills."
"Do you think you two ordinary people can beat my gang of thugs behind me?"
"..."
Chen Yi stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window without speaking; his expression calm as he took out a cigarette from his chest pocket, lit it, and through the faint blue smoke, he looked at the bald man,
and the young man they had encountered once before, who was now grinning malevolently and gesturing a cutthroat with his hand.
With a soft sigh, he muttered,
"Consider this a lesson, that before doing anything in the future, one must thoroughly investigate the other party's background."
"Yi!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a look of urgency and ferocity, picked up a steel table leg from the floor beside him and was forcefully hitting it on the ground to sharpen its end.
He spoke hastily,
"I know this is a lesson, but right now we need to get ready with whatever weapons we can find."
"I'll use this table leg, and I'll give you my Claw Knife, Yi. We can't use its special effects, but it can still be used as a knife."
"Staking our lives might give us a chance, otherwise, there won't be an 'afterward'."
"No."
Chen Yi slightly shook his head and flicked the half-smoked cigarette from his mouth to the side, calmly saying, "The lesson isn't learned from our own experiences, but from those on the other side."
The next second—
Two streaks of lightning, like thunder snakes, began to surge wildly in Chen Yi's eyes!
They were so glaring in the darkness!
Immediately after, Tuberculosis Rabbit hadn't even had time to react before a noble yellow, semi-translucent staircase suddenly appeared before them, shattering the floor-to-ceiling window into pieces!
The staircase then rapidly extended toward the rooftop of Mutual Entertainment KTV with an uncatchable speed!
It was just a blink of an eye.
A noble yellow, semi-translucent staircase, like a Sky Ladder, appeared between the two buildings, hanging in mid-air, incredibly eye-catching!
But it wasn't over yet.
Chen Yi's hand suddenly held a Christmas Cane, and a red patterned light circle with a diameter of 2 meters appeared beneath his feet.
Title: Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!
Special Effects activated.
Right after, a crimson Frozen Throne slowly emerged from the red patterned light circle!
The moment Chen Yi sat down!
An earsplitting, blood-tinged, aged voice filled everyone's ears in the Arena, like 3D surround sound, suddenly erupting!
"Let me personally tell you, when everything is over, you will beg for my forgiveness... and I, will deny you!"
"..."
A twitch involuntarily flickered across Chen Yi's icy face.
He knew that activating the blood-red Frozen Throne had special effects and had checked what those were.
But he hadn't expected that the special effects would also include an entrance BGM.
Such a chuunibyou-style catchphrase was truly hard to keep a straight face.
The next second—
Nearly a hundred heavily armored soldiers, wielding sharp blades, emerged from the shadows behind Chen Yi. They stepped in unison onto the Sky Ladder and boldly advanced towards the rooftop of Mutual Entertainment KTV!
And this was the Special Effect that came with his title.
For the cost of 10 Points, he could summon a heavily armored soldier to fight for him.
This effect could only be used when the crimson Frozen Throne was summoned.
A hundred or so heavily armored soldiers were just a thousand or so Points, just a trifle for him at this moment.
Props and Skills could no longer be used.
But the Special Effects associated with the title could still be activated normally.
The opponent in the Arena had indeed become an ordinary player, but he... had not.
Don't think that the five titles above his head were just for show!
After doing all this.
Chen Yi, with a sense of remaining vigor, looked to his empty sides, having become accustomed to the light pollution, he even felt the special effects were somewhat lacking.
There should be a pair of huge, multicolored wings on both sides at this moment.
Better yet, the kind with light swirling and dancing around the wings.
One word.
Expensive.
Two words.
Luxuriously expensive.
Only then did he raise his head to look at the group of people on the rooftop of Mutual Entertainment KTV, who were frozen in place with eyes full of terror, and he began to smirk.
"Liu Yishou, right?"
"Come, let me see what other tricks you've got up your sleeve."
...
ps: Thank you to the boss "Hey, Why It's Cold" for the reward of 5000 Starting Point coins, as well as the monthly tickets and rewards from other bosses, thank you very much!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 32 "Do not fail to do something just because it is small, do not...
chapters.content:
As he spoke, he seamlessly continued with the Thunder Snake lightning effects in his eyes.
The Title Effect offered no enhancement to his combat ability.
But its advantage was the lack of a cooldown, allowing it to be used continuously.
With the mindset "why not use it if it's free?" he casually renewed his Thunder Eye special effects.
"Yi... this..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit by his side looked towards Chen Yi sitting on the crimson Frozen Throne, mouth slowly agape and after a long while, murmured.
"This is absolutely ridiculous."
The scene before them.
It left the talkative Tuberculosis Rabbit somewhat at a loss for words, not knowing how to express his emotions.
Meanwhile, Chen Yi, in good spirits, sat upon the Frozen Throne and chuckled as he looked towards the crowd on the opposite rooftop, their expressions filled with terror and ferocity as they picked up their weapons, ready to fight to the death.
Fight then.
Even if he were to lose this batch of heavily armored soldiers, he could instantly summon another batch.
Just eighteen hundred Points, he wasn't short on such a trivial amount of Points now.
"Brother!"
Liu Yishou, holding his great sword high, slowly backed away, his lips trembling as he yelled, "Don't be rash, let's talk about this peacefully!"
"Let's sit down and talk first."
He had never expected, with props and skills being restricted, how Chen Yi could conjure up so many things?
It was illogical!
Unscientific!
But now he had no time to ponder that question, as a hundred heavily armored soldiers were already advancing up the Sky Ladder towards them.
A battle was about to break out!
No... more accurately, a slaughter was about to commence!
The heavily armored soldiers charged into the crowd, completely ignoring the machetes falling upon them, merely swinging their blades and sending these enforcers flying aside!
And the machetes striking the soldiers did nothing, completely unable to breach their defense!
They only produced clangs of steel upon steel, with the added sparks making the scene even more desolate.
In just a short minute's time.
The enforcers following Liu Yishou had all fallen to the ground with severe injuries, unable to rise. There were those who pleaded for mercy, but these heavily armored soldiers didn't have their own consciousness.
They couldn't understand pleas for mercy.
Kneeling on the ground didn't elicit sympathy from the soldiers; on the contrary, it made it easier for them to keep chopping.
One strike per person, crisp and clean.
Liu Yishou's face filled with despair as he lay in a pool of blood, looking at the heavily armored soldiers surrounding him, his eyes brimming with hopelessness and unwillingness.
He... was somewhat resentful.
The obstacles he had overcome on his journey were countless, and he had managed to get through all of them.
So why had he fallen here today?
And without any power to resist.
Just then—
The soldiers encircling him suddenly stepped aside and gradually dissolved, and he saw the man stepping up the Sky Ladder with five title icons floating above his head, slowly walking towards him; hope flashed through Liu Yishou's eyes, and he tucked away his resentment.
He instantly got up, knelt in place, and bowing continuously towards Chen Yi, he said with a trembling voice.
"Brother!"
"I, Liu Yishou, have been making my way in Yancheng for so long, I'm somewhat clever and strong."
"Don't kill me, I'll follow you from now on!"
"My men will be at your disposal from now on, too. The situation will become increasingly severe in the future, having a group of people is always good."
"From now on, you're our boss, and we swear to be loyal to you unto death!"
"Brothers, wouldn't you agree?"
The enforcers lying injured on the ground, who still had the strength to speak, mustered their last bit of energy, enduring the pain to shout, "Yes!"
"..."
And at this moment—
Chen Yi had just walked up to the rooftop of Mutual Entertainment KTV along the Sky Ladder, leaning on the Christmas Cane with one hand, stepping on a red light ring, his face filled with sentiment as he looked down at these people on the ground.
"Don't do it because it's a small kindness,"
Chen Yi hadn't finished speaking when a thicker hope sparked in Liu Yishou's eyes, his face excited, nodding continuously with contempt hidden deep in his gaze.
"Right, don't commit a small evil either."
"Brother's perspective is admirable, it was us who offended you at the start!"
Chen Yi, with a slightly odd look, glanced at Liu Yishou lying on the ground and said with a faint voice, "...The rest of the saying is actually, 'don't give up on a small advantage.'
"Seems like you're a bit lacking in your repository of poems and verses."
"Tuberculosis Rabbit, bring them together, I'll tell them a ghost story, and you work on some real-time special effects on the side."
"Sure thing."
...
Half an hour later.
Chen Yi, with a satisfied expression, clapped his hands together and looked at the treasure box that appeared in front of him, smiling happily.
"This is also making the best use of things."
'Special Event: Reincarnation Treasure Box'
'When the number of people who die in one location due to breaking the May rules reaches over 10, there's a certain probability this event will be triggered.'
Lucky, the event had been successfully triggered.
Maintaining a state of zero fear, one can open the treasure box 100% of the time, and the rewards will be a critical hit!
Just like last time.
10,000 Points in the bag.
His current Points Balance is 230,209, with just the livestream contributing 216,000 Points.
Plus, he still had 970,000 Kill Points left unspent.
These points could be exchanged for rewards in the "Extraterrestrial Invader" event.
Furthermore, points could be exchanged for Points, at a 1:1 ratio.
He had planned to find a safe place after returning to Yancheng to deal with all these points, but his time was delayed a bit by these people from Mutual Entertainment KTV.
However, it was good that it was all settled now.
The moment this group of people died,
The Arena's light circle also dissipated.
Chen Yi casually glanced downstairs, suddenly felt something was off, furrowed his brows and looked at the watch on his wrist, then he realized!
He had been in the Arena for nearly an hour.
And in the outside world, only a second had passed.
Does this mean when the Arena opened, the outside time was paused?
To say that seemed a bit illogical, it was more like when the Arena opened, they were thrown out of the timeline, and only after the Arena ended were they thrown back into this moment in time.
"Hmm..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit also seemed to realize something, thoughtfully nodding his head: "In that case, no matter how many crises this game has, humans will never go extinct."
"Why?"
"Think about it, Yi, when humans face a crisis, just collect 1,000 Arena Props, then stock up on food and water resources, and allocate 1,000 strong men and 1,000 beautiful women to each Arena."
"Let these people have children inside."
"After 100 years in the Arena, only a few seconds will have passed in the outside world."
"Once the 1,000 Arenas are done, hundreds of thousands of youths can return to the battlefield with them!"
"And thus, the cycle of life will continue endlessly!"
