Chen Yi looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit a bit speechlessly, then proceeded to take all the Skill Fragments and props from the corpses next to them.
He left the place quietly.
If nothing unexpected happened, he should be making another trip here.
After all, when the Law Enforcement Bureau discovered this place, they would still need him to come over to collect the bodies, and then he could make another profit.
He could also settle the 3,000 Points from last time at the movie theater.
They say the best side job for a forensic investigator is being a hitman.
Earning money from the employer as a hitman at night.
Dissecting the very people killed the night before to earn a salary by day.
And it's uncertain if the salary system for forensic medicine is based on a piecework basis.

chapters.title: Chapter 33 "The children will like this vehicle.
chapters.content:
Chen Yi returned to his rented apartment in Yancheng.
Downstairs in the residential complex, he already saw numerous posters plastered in the announcement board.
They were generally recruitment notices for some people to go to the edge of Yancheng to build defensive structures.
The salary was quite good.
Three Points per day.
And this information had almost completely eliminated the circulation of cash; the state had stepped in and begun transactions with Points, thus cash had completely lost its purpose.
Starting from today.
Points would become the official currency in circulation.
The night had already fallen.
But the complex was unusually bustling tonight, with many people gathering around, discussing animatedly.
From the topics of their discussions, it was clear that everyone had realized something.
That was, hiding all the time might not solve the problems anymore.
One must become stronger to have a sense of security.
And when Chen Yi arrived, everyone shut their mouths instantaneously, their expressions slightly tense, and their eyes filled with a mix of fear and respect as they watched Chen Yi walk away.
Once Chen Yi was far away.
The crowd started to discuss animatedly once again.
"Is it really him alone who killed all the monsters outside Yancheng?"
"Isn't that obvious? Haven't you seen the title above his head, Invincible Under the Heavens? Currently, only Chen Yi has that title, right?"
"Who knows how strong he is now?"
"That, no one knows, but the title Annihilate Nine Clans makes one feel slightly apprehensive to approach him."
"It's my first time realizing Chen Yi lives in our complex. So... from another point of view, is our place not one of the safest in Yancheng?"
As the words fell.
All exchanged glances, understanding the message in each other's eyes.
...
Chen Yi first set aside the props he had found on Liu Yishou, sighing regretfully that he hadn't found the Arena prop he wanted.
That prop would have been perfect for him.
With it, he could basically do as he pleased.
But it hadn't dropped.
He wasn't sure if it was a one-time use prop or for some other reason, in any case, it hadn't dropped.
He had found four props on Liu Yishou and the others, which were some life props with not very powerful effects. Only one prop was a bit interesting.
'Prop Name': A small and cute plum.
'Prop Level': E-level prop.
'Prop Effect': When you are in an extremely hungry and thirsty state, just one glance will make the feeling of hunger and thirst instantly disappear, with no cooldown, and it can be used repeatedly.
'Prop Restrictions': It can only eliminate psychological hunger and thirst, not the physical state of hunger and thirst.
'Prop Introduction': "The hunger and thirst referred to here are solely in the literal sense."
It's a pretty good prop for survival in the wilderness.
Being able to not feel hunger and thirst when lacking food and water is beneficial, but the downside is significant. With repeated use, it's very possible to die of hunger and thirst even without feeling it.
Then he took a deep breath and opened the Points Store with eager anticipation!
970,000 Points, that was basically the total number of Points a city could get!
He wanted to see if there were any good items.
The first thing that caught his eye were the Skill Fragments.
'E-Level Random Skill Fragment x1': 5 Points.
'E-Level Universal Skill Fragment x1': 50 Points.
'...'
From E-level to C-level Skill Fragments, there was a complete range.
Right now, his urgent task was to exchange for some defensive skills or props to prevent being shot in the back.
He glanced at his personal panel with slight hesitation.
He currently had two skills.
One was a D-grade Skill "Calm and Composed," and the other a C-grade Skill "Annihilate Nine Clans."
Each player could equip a maximum of eight Skills.
Once equipped, it could not be removed. If removed, it would be lost forever and could not be re-equipped.
In other words, if he removed the Calm and Composed Skill from his skill slot, the Skill would disappear from his backpack, and he would not be able to equip it again in the future.
Killing players might drop certain items randomly, but skills would not drop.
Therefore, he had to be cautious every time he equipped a Skill, to avoid a situation in the future where he ran out of skill slots and had to painfully part with one.
He felt somewhat reluctant to part with either of these two Skills.
Calm and Composed may be low level, but it could permanently enhance his physical fitness.
As for Annihilate Nine Clans, there was no need to say more; whether he was slaying monsters or exterminating threats, it was exceptionally useful.
He turned his attention to the "C-grade Universal Skill Fragment" in the store.
"C-grade Universal Skill Fragment x1": 20,000 Points.
"..."
Seeing the price of this item, Chen Yi's mouth twitched slightly, but he said nothing.
What does 20,000 Points mean?
An ordinary person would only earn 1 Point for killing an Insect Race monster, meaning they would need to kill 20,000 monsters just to exchange for a C-grade Skill Fragment.
The difficulty was not small.
The price for a "C-grade Random Skill Fragment x1" was much cheaper, requiring only 2,000 Points, which was a full ten times less expensive than the Universal Skill Fragment of the same level.
"There should be a trading platform," Chen Yi said without speaking.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit by his side licked its lips with some emotion and said, "Everyone could put the Skill Fragments they don't need on the platform and then trade for the Skill Fragments they do need."
"It's possible to pay a little extra in Points, but it's definitely much cheaper than buying Universal Skill Fragments directly from the store."
Chen Yi nodded in agreement without speaking; Tuberculosis Rabbit's words were not wrong.
But to establish such a platform, a good reputation and the ability to quickly transport Skill Fragments to other cities were needed.
So far, it seemed the only entity capable of doing this was the nation itself.
As for whether the game would release such a feature, he was not optimistic. If they were going to implement this feature, they wouldn't have priced the Universal Skill Fragment so much higher than the Random Skill Fragment.
Right now, he had eight different C-grade Skill Fragments in his hand, all rewards from the last event, and each was just in a quantity of one.
Looking at it this way, the rewards from that last 520 limited-time event were quite generous.
By killing a Cupid and achieving number one on the kill ranking, one could obtain C-grade Random Skill Fragment x10, C-grade Universal Skill Fragment x3.
Converted into Points, that was nearly a 100,000 Points reward.
Difficulty-wise,
Securing top damage against Cupid was much easier than killing 100,000 monsters.
This was almost no different from his guess; the 520 limited-time event was a welfare event with generous rewards, allowing players not to be powerless against the "Extraterrestrial Invader" event!
That day... Yancheng must have spawned nearly a dozen Cupids.
Then, he continued scrolling through the Points Store, first taking a general look at everything, before considering what he needed to buy.
The next second—
His gaze stopped on a particular item.
"Vehicle Name": Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh!
"Vehicle Level": C-grade Vehicle.
"Vehicle Effect": Can accommodate 8 people simultaneously, maximum speed 280km/h, capable of low-altitude flight, modifiable, consumes 300 Points per hour when activated!
"Vehicle Introduction": "Kids are going to love this Vehicle."
"Vehicle Price": 500,000 Points.
"ps: When the first player acquires the Vehicle, it will trigger a patch update."
"The contents of the update will mainly include the following: opening the Global Vehicle Leaderboard, a Vehicle Modification Panel, and more... etc."
What attracted him most were the few words of the Vehicle's introduction.
"Kids are going to love this Vehicle."
The update on May 1 teased that the new rules added after the June update would concern "life."
And June 1 is Children's Day!
This Vehicle appeared timely in the "Extraterrestrial Invader" Points Store, coupled with that intriguing Vehicle introduction!
Really... it's hard not to speculate!

chapters.title: Chapter 34 "Let's go, I'll take you for a spin.
chapters.content:
"Buy!"
Chen Yi made the decision to purchase without any hesitation.
The price of 500,000 Points was indeed very high.
To understand, in the current "Extraterrestrial Invader" event, there were only a mere 1 million Insect Race monsters outside Yancheng, as for the situation in other cities and in some counties and rural areas, he had no idea.
Whether the same number of monsters existed or if the number would decrease with the player population in counties and rural areas was unknown.
But no matter the case.
Gathering 500,000 Points was an exceedingly difficult task; on the "Extraterrestrial Invader Global Points Leaderboard," his ranking was first.
As for the second place, they had only 160,000 Points.
Not even half of his total.
Still, that was pretty impressive. To be able to kill 160,000 monsters on one's own in such a short time, they must have some powerful Prop or Skill.
In other words, right now, he was the only person in the world who could afford this Prop.
He even felt that the project team probably didn't expect anyone could afford this Vehicle, it was likely just there in the Points Store for everyone to take a glance at, just so people knew such a thing would be available in the future.
Without any doubt, he looked at the purchase button for the Vehicle.
The next second—
"Ding, player Chen Yi has spent 500,000 Points to purchase the C-class Vehicle - Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh."
Immediately after, he saw a Prop with a sleigh avatar appear in his backpack.
Before he could take a closer look, the sound of a system patch update rang in his ears.
"Ding, global announcement!"
"Due to a player obtaining the world's first Vehicle, a patch update has been triggered; the following are the contents of this patch update—"
"1: The Global Vehicle Leaderboard is now active. Vehicles will be ranked based on their Vehicle Rating, and the top 1-100 on the leaderboard will receive non-permanent title rewards."
"2: All 'non-Prop Vehicles' globally are now unusable, and the removal of related map debris has begun."
"3: The Vehicle customization feature is now active. Players can use Points or Props to customize their Vehicles to a certain extent."
"4: From now on, opening any gift pack or monster drops will have a chance to yield Vehicle Props."
This announcement resonated in the ears of everyone around the world.
"Yi!"
Just then, Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned on the window, looking down at the street below with a shocked and urgent expression, "You've got to see this!"
Chen Yi frowned, walked over to the window, and looked down as well!
All he saw were the vehicles that had been causing traffic jams due to chaos, and now those vehicles had all disappeared.
Public buses, intercity coaches, shared bikes had all vanished, even children's push-scooters had disappeared from the world with the announcement.
That map debris removal from the patch update... that was what it meant.
Meaning.
From now on, people's means of travel would only be their own legs and Vehicle Props.
The entire city seemed somewhat empty and unusually clean. Many pedestrians stood incredulously on the streets, staring at the now-empty roads they had just witnessed the disappearance of cars from.
"It really is thought-provoking,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with a complex tone, "Once upon a time, everyone was guessing that the end of the shared bikes could be due to the abandonment by capital, due to policy impacts, or because a competitor took over the market."
"Everyone thought of various possibilities, but no one expected that the end of shared bikes would be so swift and decisive."
"That saying is indeed correct; what defeats you is often not your competitor, but it's very possible... a patch update announcement."
"But actually, I'm still a bit saddened about our motorcycle..."
Chen Yi shook his head, no longer concerned about this matter.
Instead, he left the room with Tuberculosis Rabbit and went up to the rooftop.
...
On the rooftop, Chen Yi took out his Vehicle from the backpack and activated it.
Accompanied by a faint puff of white smoke, it exploded.
A C-class vehicle, the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh, officially appeared before their eyes.
Before them, an elongated red sleigh with eight seats suddenly materialized.
At the head of the sleigh,
were four pure white mechanical elks, harnessed together to the sled by reins.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, curious, walked up to the mechanical elks and touched them up and down, clicking his tongue and saying, "Real leather, these little eyes are also quite pretty when they sparkle."
"But this thing doesn't even have a canopy, it's not rainproof or windproof, and there are no seat belts. It feels risky."
At this moment, Chen Yi took out a cigarette and put it in his mouth, his eyes eagerly fixated on the Christmas Sleigh in front of him as he started grinning.
"Let's go, I'll take you for a spin."
"...Be careful, drive slowly, Yi."
...
At this time, all over the world,
countless people were watching the Global Vehicle Leaderboard before them.
「Global Vehicle Leaderboard」
「First place: Chen Yi.」
「Vehicle: Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh.」
「Rating: 1000.」
There was no second place.
So far, Chen Yi was the only one to top the Global Vehicle Leaderboard.
"..."
Gao Yiming stood calmly in the office building, diverting his gaze from the Global Vehicle Leaderboard and looking towards the Christmas Sleigh flying above the city.
After a long silence, he then spoke softly,
"Uncle Wei."
"It seems Liu Yishou's side has failed."
"Mhm."
The elder standing in the shadows, his voice weary and hoarse, replied, "People have already been sent to check. Liu Yishou and others died violating the May rules."
"But some of the corpses and flesh bear distinct knife wounds."
"Chen Yi must have taken advantage of his ability not to fear, creating enough fear, then charged up and took down Liu Yishou and the others."
"After all, the Arena prop we provided for Liu Yishou should have been enough to beat Chen Yi."
"Sigh."
Gao Yiming sighed softly, rubbing his temples with some irritation as he whispered, "Send someone again, still do not expose our identities. If he can't be killed this time,"
"then kill all those who know, and then try to befriend him."
"An enemy that can't be killed should, if possible, be turned into a friend of the company."
"Understood, young master."
He had initially planned to capture Chen Yi and use his fearlessness to open the treasure chest.
But... after learning that Chen Yi had slain all the monsters outside the city,
he changed his mind.
How many Points could a treasure chest contain?
Chen Yi surely had some powerful props on him, like that sniper rifle. If he could get those items, the future would be promising indeed!
In their line of work, even before the game arrived, their hands hadn't been free from blood.
After all, many times the compensation for a lifetime disability is much higher than for an accidental death.
Society has rules, but within those rules, there is also a taste of blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 35 "Obtained the Non-Permanent Title - 'Your Cars Are All Super Weak!
chapters.content:
```
Yancheng, military headquarters.
A short old man in a coat put down the satellite phone in his hands and looked at the Global Vehicle Leaderboard before him, his expression dazed.
After sitting in the command center and staring blankly for a long time,
he couldn't help but shake his head and chuckle to himself.
"I'm too old, in the end, it's still up to the younger generation to take over the world."
Then he picked up a comb from the table and carefully combed what little hair he had left, suddenly breaking into laughter.
"But I must say, it's quite good to have such characters during these chaotic times."
"The human race really is lucky, every time there's chaos, someone stands up."
He had already discussed with those above.
And had reported the opinion of the argumentative old man to them as well.
The answer from above was simple.
Every man for himself, protect the younglings.
It meant that the nation no longer had the ability to protect everyone, advising each city to fend for themselves.
The notion of protecting the younglings meant that if any player rose to prominence within the city, they should not harbor any malcontent toward them.
If possible, try to incorporate them into the military. This wasn't mandatory, but it was essential not to discipline them with military systems.
Instead, form a separate army.
Without any system, whose only rule is to kill monsters to protect the rear.
He had also passed on his compatriots' ideas, which was that national treasures are only considered national treasures when in the hands of the nation!
The response he received about this statement... was also weird.
He sighed lightly and expertly pressed a button under his desk, prompting the camera in the room to play the previously recorded footage in a loop.
He then unbuttoned his shirt, took out a homemade cigar from the breast pocket, lit it, put it in his mouth, crossed his legs, and began to smoke nonchalantly in the chair, devoid of any image.
His doctor had expressly told his personal guard that his health was too frail for smoking.
It made sense, but he didn't listen.
Reclining in the chair, he gazed at the slightly yellowed ceiling through the light blue smoke and suddenly curled a smile on his lips.
"Props can be taken, but luck can't."
That was the response from above.
It also meant that those who could rise at this stage were blessed with the luck to protect the human race. A prop could be taken, but the luck they carried could not.
Opposing this for too long would surely backfire.
"What a pain in the ass... and you guys were the ones who said no to feudal superstitions."
...
While almost all the players were looking up at the Global Vehicle Leaderboard with complex and envious expressions,
Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit were already having a blast riding a snowmobile in the skies above Yancheng.
Finally!
Chen Yi brought the snowmobile back to the rooftop of his community, happily jumped off, and clapped his hands as he looked at the still shell-shocked Tuberculosis Rabbit with a smile.
"Not bad, this thing is really fun to ride."
"Hehe."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit gave a lifeless chuckle, walked stiffly to the edge of the rooftop, paused for a second, then without hesitation bent forward ninety degrees!
"Blegh!!!"
"Ew."
Chen Yi took a few disgusted steps back, then suddenly noticed that a few more lines of text had appeared on the Vehicle panel after his purchase.
'Basic Score: 1000 points.'
'ps: On December 25, Christmas Day, this vehicle can be flown all day without any consumption, and special effects will be activated.'
Basic Score wasn't interesting to look at.
But the last point was intriguing, on Christmas Day, the vehicle would trigger special effects, though it was unknown what the effects would be.
However, it made sense for the Christmas sleigh to have some effects on Christmas Day.
As long as it didn't involve him playing Santa Claus and delivering gifts stuffed in stockings to children.
"..."
Chen Yi abruptly froze, then after a moment of silence, he helplessly exclaimed, "Damn it!"
There was actually a chance of that happening!
But it was too early to worry about this since it was only May, still far away from December.
He also noticed that he had a few unread system notifications.
'Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for becoming the first player in the world to acquire a vehicle!'
'You've earned the title - "Yay, I Got a Car!"'
-
'Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi's vehicle for topping the Global Vehicle Leaderboard!'
```
「Acquired non-permanent title - "Your cars are all super weak!"」
Chen Yi looked expressionlessly at his own backpack, and sure enough, there lay two titles, quiet and still.
After a moment of silence,
he calmly wore the two titles above his head.
He was used to it, having already had five, it didn't make much difference to have two more.
He then looked at the Tuberculosis Rabbit, which had almost recovered, and turned to walk towards the rooftop iron door.
"Let's head back, you get carsick pretty badly, huh."
"Actually... I only get carsick when Yi drives."
Backpack slots were starting to run low on space.
Skill Fragments took up too much room.
But it seemed like he saw a prop in the Points Store that could expand the backpack slots.
...
The night had grown deep.
Chen Yi had completed the "Active Expert" quest for the day on the sled with Tuberculosis Rabbit, and as for Tuberculosis Rabbit... it had finished its tasks in its dreams before even opening its eyes each day.
This might just be the son of the version.
After all, engaging in 1000 conversations a day was actually quite tiring.
Speaking of which, he wasn't sure if stuff like "it hurts," "pinch me," "that's fast" counted as conversation. If they did, then this task wouldn't be too difficult.
Tuberculosis Rabbit had already fallen asleep beside him.
As usual, it was mumbling in its dreams.
He could only hear fluent speech, but when he really listened, he realized it was all nonsense.
It was just idle chatter, not a single serious word at all.
He wondered why Tuberculosis Rabbit thought it was giving a speech in its dreams; who would talk about such things in a speech? It sounded more like speed dating.
Meanwhile, he lay in bed, finding a comfortable position, and kept flipping through the Points Store.
Spending his remaining points, little by little, until they were all gone.
Buy, buy, buy!
It must be said, this feeling of shopping was quite pleasant.
They say men don't like shopping, but it's really just that there aren't many things they want on the streets; you haven't seen how focused and delighted men are when they browse through a game's prop shop.
...
Meanwhile,
in the apartment above Chen Yi's,
a young couple sat on their bed, knees hugged to their chests, expressionlessly gazing at two titles poking up from under the bed.
「Yay, I bought a car!」
「Your cars are all super weak!」
"Um..."
After a long while, the young man finally spoke in a sigh, "Is it because there are too many titles, so they came up from the floor below?"
Then he reached out to touch the title, but there was no sensation; his hand went right through it.
"Although it doesn't have any form, it still somehow feels... weird."
"Should we keep going?"
The woman tightened the air conditioning blanket around herself and asked weakly.
"How can we keep going?"
The man shook his head helplessly, "It always feels like we're being watched."
"Is that bad?"
Upon hearing this, the man began to breathe more rapidly, and the next second, he tossed aside the air conditioning blanket and pounced like a hungry tiger!
In the midst of the chaos, a pale and tender hand reached out and began to gently caress that title.
...
Chen Yi, who had already fallen asleep, sat up expressionlessly from the bed.
He lit a cigarette and put it in his mouth, staring blankly out the window.
He couldn't see what was happening upstairs, but he could hear it.
He was about to fall asleep; with such a disturbance, who could sleep?
Seeing that things showed no sign of quieting down, Chen Yi silently switched the option that kept the title alight to one that made it flash repeatedly!
This should quiet things down a bit.
The next second—
"Damn, why is the noise even louder now!"
"Are they crazy!"

chapters.title: Chapter 36 "Has the outside world changed so much just overnight?
chapters.content:
The night passed slowly.
Chen Yi picked up the remote and turned up the temperature of the air conditioner in the room slightly.
Sitting cross-legged on the bed, wrapped in a robe, facing the window, he poured a little hot water from the thermos cup and sipped it lightly.
It was already dawn.
This night, many people probably had trouble sleeping.
Fortunately, so far electricity and drinking water are still functioning normally, but many factories have been shut down for a long time, and if this issue isn't resolved soon, humanity will have to slowly revert to an era where each household has to cultivate their own food.
"Yi."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, lying on another bed, rubbed his eyes and said in a drowsy voice, "You're awake? I didn't disturb you last night, did I?"
"No."
Chen Yi's face remained calm as he set the thermos cup aside, lit a cigarette, took it to his mouth, and with a faint dark circle under his eyes, he remained silent without speaking.
Then he shook his head and got up to walk to the bathroom.
"I'm going to take a shower first."
"After I'm done, you brush your teeth, and then we'll prepare to go out today."
"Oh."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, still looking a bit reluctant, wiped the drool from the corner of his mouth, then took the Claw Knife from under his pillow and looked at its charge progress, grinning satisfactorily.
"The charge progress is already at 762."
"Tomorrow it should be able to break a thousand."
He had intended to use it in this swarm of creatures, but in the end, he didn't get a chance to act, so the charge progress just kept accumulating.
The next time he gets a chance to take action, he would try to see what kind of power the Claw Knife would have after being charged for so long.
...
Standing under the spray, stark naked, Chen Yi looked at the "Global Vehicle Leaderboard" in the steamy bathroom.
Only the top 100 could make it onto the leaderboard.
At the moment, the 100th position was filled with players, but most of them were E-level vehicles, with only seven or eight D-level vehicles; his C-level vehicle was still in first place.
However, how long it could retain that position was unclear, given that there were so many people worldwide, and there was no telling when some lucky player might suddenly appear.
Most E-level vehicles were uniformly the Bright Brand Pedal Bicycle.
'Vehicle Name': Bright Brand Pedal Bicycle!
'Vehicle Level': E-level vehicle.
'Vehicle Effect': Can seat two people at the same time, with no upper limit to maximum speed. Unlike typical bicycles, this bicycle theoretically can reach subluminal speeds if you pedal fast enough.
'Vehicle Introduction': "Remember to have a fat person sit in the backseat so that your chances of survival greatly increase when being chased."
'Basic Score': 10 points.
'Vehicle Price': 100 Points.
This prop was explicitly priced in the Points Store during the global event "Extraterrestrial Invader."
This prop didn't exist before, but after he obtained the C-level vehicle yesterday, it triggered a vehicle patch update, and then this vehicle appeared in the Points Store.
100 Points.
Not too expensive, but not cheap either.
Just kill 100 of the Insect Race monsters, and you can earn 100 Points.
The majority of players on the current vehicle leaderboard who made it onto the list own this vehicle, but their scores are not the basic 10 points; some have even reached a score of 80, which probably means the vehicles were modified to increase their scores.
So far, the Points Store only has this one vehicle.
As for the remaining seven D-level vehicles on the leaderboard, they are completely different vehicles, likely obtained by killing Insect Race monsters or opening gift packages.
Last night.
There must have been many players killing Insect Race monsters and purchasing limited-time 520 event gift packages, but in the end, only seven managed to get a vehicle.
This demonstrates just how low the drop rate for vehicles is.
With this in mind, perhaps in the future, most players will only have their own two feet as their mode of transportation.
"However..."
Chen Yi, expressionless, fell silent as he stared at the details of the vehicle ranked sixth on the vehicle leaderboard, at a loss for words for a moment.
Can this thing really be called a vehicle?
"Vehicle Name": Orange-flavored Exploding Beads
"Vehicle Level": D-level Vehicle.
"Vehicle Effect": Embed it at the back, and it will absorb all your emissions, storing them for later use. You can activate the Exploding Beads at any time to enable low-altitude straight-line flight.
"Vehicle Introduction": "It can fly close to the ground or take off from a standstill, but keep in mind that it can only fly in a straight line. You cannot control it to turn."
"Basic Score": 100 points.
"Current Score": 189 points.
"Owner": Li Yide.
"..."
After a long while, Chen Yi let out a sigh, slowly closed his eyes, and enjoyed the comfort of the hot water showering down on his head.
Early in the morning, he really didn't feel like seeing these eyesores.
A basic score of 100 points and a current score of 189 implied that the player had made some modifications to the vehicle. What kind of person would make modifications to such a vehicle?
Despite being somewhat of an eyesore, it would indeed be a precious commodity if it could save your life at a critical moment.
But this modification function—
He curiously glanced at the modification panel to see what kind of alterations he could make to his own vehicle.
Suddenly!
A long panel appeared before his eyes.
"Self-Controlled Double-Barreled Rifle": 500 Points.
"Nitrogen Injector": 1000 Points.
"Jump Ejector": 800 Points.
"..."
"Falling Star Spear": Unknown.
Simple and clear.
Apparently, as long as you have enough Points, you can purchase these items and install them on your own vehicle. He even saw an option for a nuclear missile silo.
In other words.
Theoretically, he could even mount a nuclear missile silo onto a bicycle.
If he so desired.
Quite absurd.
Chen Yi didn't look any further, but instead quickly wiped down his body and shaved off the stubble that had grown over the past few days before exiting the bathroom.
Today was May 21st.
It was the last day of the "520 Limited-Time Event".
After today, the title "Lucky Child of the God of Love" would become a permanent limited edition, and the "520 Limited-Time 88 Points Gift Pack" would no longer be available for purchase.
He wasn't particularly interested in the gift pack.
But he was somewhat interested in the title. After all, it was a permanent limited edition title, and today was the last day to get it. Once today passed, he would never be able to get that title again.
Although it wasn't very useful, but… he kind of wanted to collect it.
Only now he couldn't find someone he genuinely liked to confess to.
For him, that was still a difficult task.
Soon.
The two of them brushed their teeth and washed up, then walked out of the residential complex onto the street.
However...
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit stepped out of the complex, his mouth slowly gaped open in shock, muttering to himself.
"Did I sleep for seven or eight days in one go?"
"Has the outside world really changed this much overnight?"
Last night.
They triggered a patch update which caused all vehicles to disappear.

chapters.title: Chapter 37 "Limited Edition Title 'Lucky Child of the God of Love,' for Sale!
chapters.content:
Not a single vehicle was visible on the street.
No matter if the loan had been paid off or not, your car was gone.
But this morning, not even nine o'clock yet, the streets were bustling with traffic once again.
One after another, rickshaws whizzed by, propelled by... humans.
Yes.
Overnight, the city had somehow filled with throngs of hardworking individuals pulling rickshaws.
Chen Yi reached out to hail a rickshaw, handed a cigarette to the bare-chested middle-aged man with a towel around his neck, and then began to inquire.
"Who organized you guys?"
"What's the charge?"
He asked bluntly, and the middle-aged man was just as straightforward with his reply.
"A big boss found us last night."
"That big boss has many companies under his control and even has some connections with the Law Enforcement Bureau. It's said he's a person with influence high above."
"He gave us the rickshaws and told us we'd split the day's earnings fifty-fifty."
"By the way, where do you want to go?"
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully and then shook his head, "Nowhere in particular."
It was quick.
These capitalists, upon seeing a sudden vacancy in the market, were like wolves spotting a chunk of meat, relentlessly seizing the opportunity.
"Our boss said, if the customers don't know where to go, we can recommend a place,"
"The Chongyang Bird Market."
"A lot of people are there trading Skill Fragments they don't need, along with some props and whatnot. You might want to check it out; it's also owned by our boss."
"Oh?"
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow with interest, "Then, how do you charge?"
"2 Points, I'll take you anywhere in the city, no distance restrictions."
"As long as we don't leave the city."
"Fine, let's go."
"Right away, please sit tight, sir."
The rickshaw puller, somewhat excited, wiped the sweat from his forehead with his towel and started running, pulling the rickshaw with vigor!
The man before him had a total of seven titles above his head!
Clearly, he was an important figure.
Pulling such a person around the city, that adds to one's face, doesn't it?
...
About twenty minutes later.
Chen Yi successfully arrived at the Chongyang Bird Market that the man had mentioned.
By now, there were already quite a few people here.
Vendors sat cross-legged at both ends of the street, holding up signs with the names of their Skill Fragments, calling out loudly, while pedestrians stood in the center of the street, stopping to ask for the price.
This scene before him had already become a fairly well-established barter market.
And none of this was here yesterday.
"They're really fast," said Tuberculosis Rabbit, clicking his tongue, "I gotta say, sometimes these capitalists do get some human things done."
"Having such a place benefits all the players in Yancheng. It's actually a piece of good news."
To form a complete Skill, one needs five identical Skill Fragments.
But the Skill Fragments each person obtains are random.
Here, you can trade your surplus Skill Fragments for those you actually need.
Chen Yi frowned slightly, without saying anything else.
Leaning on his cane, he walked towards the entrance of the street, ready to see if there was anything he needed inside.
As Chen Yi set foot in.
All around the Bird Market, everyone's breath hitched, and within a matter of seconds, the previously bustling market fell utterly silent.
There was good reason.
The glaringly bright red patterned circle with a two-meter diameter beneath Chen Yi's feet, along with the seven massive titles above his head that shone even in the daylight, were simply too eye-catching.
It would have been difficult for him to go unnoticed.
Almost instantly, everyone had figured out who this person was, none other than Chen Yi, the very same who single-handedly killed the Insect Race monster in Yancheng the day before.
The silence lasted only a few seconds.
An even louder commotion erupted!
"Brother Chen Yi, look over here, I definitely have the Skill Fragments you need!!"
"Yi bro, Yi bro, I've got a limited-edition prop here, come take a look, no one else but you is worthy of it!"
"I've got a limited edition title here, I see you don't have it, Yi bro. Do you want it? I'll sell it to you for... oh no, I'll give you a good deal, Yi bro!"
Chen Yi didn't speak; instead, he squatted in front of a vendor, bending down to take a closer look.
Because... there truly was something he needed.
Written in big letters on the vendor's whiteboard was the following line.
'Limited edition title "Lucky Child of the God of Love", cheap!'
"You're selling this title?"
Chen Yi looked up at the middle-aged man who appeared somewhat older, and casually said, "Name your price?"
The middle-aged man, hesitating for a moment upon seeing Chen Yi stop at his stall, finally extended a shaky finger.
"What's that price?"
"I want an E-class, Bright Brand Pedal Bicycle from the Points Store."
As his words fell.
The listening vendors and passersby nearby burst into laughter.
"I say, brother, just because you see Brother Chen Yi isn't short on money, it doesn't mean you can fleece him like this?"
"Exactly, and to think you would even sell a title like that, it's downright shameful, to be honest, I look down on you from the bottom of my heart!"
A young man, with a look of scorn and disdain, leaned forward and spat a thick gob of spit at the middle-aged man.
"Brother Chen Yi, you might not be aware."
"It's true that titles can be traded, but the effect of this title is when you face certain death, there's a one in ten chance that the crisis is transferred to someone you truly love."
"Titles can be traded, but their effects cannot."
"That means if you, Brother Chen Yi, buy this title, when you encounter certain death, there's a one in ten chance this man's true love will take the hit for you."
"What do you say, isn't this equivalent to selling his wife's life?"
"Shouldn't he be scolded?"
"It's simply worse than a beast."
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully, unaware of this effect, but he didn't say much more. Instead, he quickly exchanged for an E-class Bicycle from the Points Store and traded it to the middle-aged man.
He bought the title.
The transaction was complete.
The middle-aged man, without even packing up his stall, squeezed through the crowd and fled from the scene amidst the laughter of everyone around.
Yancheng had allocated almost all the points to Chen Yi for this event.
Hence, at this point, very few people in Yancheng had the points to buy an E-class vehicle; those who did were either rich or noble.
Just then—
A woman with an above-average figure suddenly burst out from the crowd, striding quickly up to Chen Yi, staring intently and excitedly into Chen Yi's eyes with a trembling voice as she urgently said.
"Look into my eyes."
"I like you, I like you, I like you, I..."
Before she could finish—
"Go like your Mom."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, with an unpleasant expression, put away the wooden stick in his hand, looked at the woman who had fainted in front of him with a hint of disgust and said.
"Lucky for me, I reacted quickly, otherwise Yi bro, you might have fallen for her trap."

chapters.title: Chapter 38 "But we need that piping hot coffee.
chapters.content:
Before the crowd could react,
the woman who had burst out from among them was knocked to the ground by the Tuberculosis Rabbit with a single blow, falling to the ground and staying utterly motionless, as if asleep.
Chen Yi, however, frowned deeply, taking a sharp breath with a somewhat unhappy expression, and stared at the woman lying on the ground without speaking.
The thing he had feared the most had still happened.
In the 520 limited-time event, if you confessed to someone you truly liked, there was a one in ten chance of transferring a fatal crisis onto them if you were destined to die.
He didn't have anyone he truly liked.
He couldn't participate in this event.
There was nothing to regret about this.
But now he had appeared in a global announcement once and had made it onto two global leaderboards, making his fame far from small.
What he had been worried about was the possibility that if someone were to confess to him at this time… wouldn't he become their scapegoat?
Originally, today was the last day of the event. Once today was over, this 520 limited-time event would be no more, but the sudden appearance of this woman had really made his heart skip a beat.
Although he was not sure if it was possible to truly like someone in just a day or two, he couldn't afford to gamble on such odds.
After that, he did not hesitate at all.
He kicked the woman lying on the ground away.
Activating the C-grade Vehicle.
Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh.
Then without any hesitation, he quickly flew into the clouds with the Tuberculosis Rabbit, leaving the place behind.
...
In the Garden District, inside a rental apartment.
Chen Yi let out a small sigh of relief as he stood by the window. He only felt somewhat safe after returning home.
To confess to someone you truly like.
There needed to be an act of confession.
That is to say, as long as he didn't check his phone messages and hid, even if someone wanted to confess to him, they wouldn't be able to find him, and he would be safe.
"Tuberculosis Rabbit."
Chen Yi, still feeling uneasy, spoke up, "Keep an eye out for anyone who shows any sign of wanting to confess to me, and use your Claw Knife to strike first before anything else."
"Don't worry, I get it. Interrupting casting spells, I'm used to it," replied the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Soon,
a day passed just like that, and when the sun rose again it was already May 22nd.
Yes, Chen Yi, for the sake of safety, had stayed in his rental apartment for an entire day, going nowhere.
It wasn't until the 520 limited-time event officially ended that he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
This event was really too much trouble; it made one feel quite insecure.
He hadn't eaten for quite a while.
To keep a low profile, Chen Yi did not use the Christmas Sleigh but instead walked with the Tuberculosis Rabbit, planning to find a restaurant discreetly to grab something to eat.
But when he saw the way people were looking towards him, Chen Yi's expressionless face fell silent for a while before he finally took out the Christmas Sleigh.
It seemed whether he took out the Christmas Sleigh or not, he was conspicuous.
...
Chen Yi leisurely parked the sleigh in front of a shop selling small steamed buns.
"Boss, give me two baskets of meat-filled buns, one basket of glass noodle buns, and two bowls of seaweed soup."
"All right, that will be 8 Points," replied the boss.
"Okay."
Chen Yi nodded, a flicker of surprise passing through his eyes. They've started charging with Points for transactions? Weren't the prices a bit high?
It's important to know that for most people, their source of Points was now limited to just daily tasks.
Each day one could only receive 1 Point.
And here, 8 Points would be gone on just a meal.
As if seeing the confusion in Chen Yi's eyes, the boss explained while busying himself, "Now everyone can earn Points from the official sources, it's not too shabby."
"Like going outside the city to build the defensive structures, you can get Points every day."
"And now for things like pork, they're all stock from before and the prices are really expensive."
"I hear the officials have already started looking for props and skills related to living, planning to clear some wasteland outside the city for self-sufficiency."
"Fortunately, this area of Yancheng is suitable for both farming and breeding."
"Anyway, I'm not clear on the specifics of the troubles, so let's have some buns. You eat first."
Soon.
Steaming hot buns were served.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, immediately picked up a bun with his chopsticks, dipped it in the spicy broth, and put it in his mouth, chewing contentedly before finishing.
Then he held the piping hot seaweed soup to his lips, blew on it a few times, and slowly took small sips.
So blissful.
Who knows if in the future, one would still be able to sit so leisurely in a shop, eating dumplings and drinking seaweed soup like now.
What used to be an extremely ordinary activity now seemed somewhat blissful.
Just then—
"Brother."
A bald, sturdy man suddenly appeared from the side, with a silly smile on his face, looking straight at Chen Yi and scratching the back of his head while smiling.
"Tie Chui?"
Chen Yi was startled for a moment before recognizing him, about to say something when he suddenly saw a half-smoked cigarette protruding from the pocket of Tie Chui's shirt.
That cigarette looked very familiar, wasn't it the one he gave to Tie Chui on the helicopter?
He hasn't smoked it yet?
But still, he raised his hand towards the owner, "Two more bowls of seaweed soup, and four more baskets of buns, please."
"Alright."
"Come on, sit down."
Chen Yi glanced at Tie Chui and the little girl following behind him, gesturing for them to sit down.
He hadn't been in contact with them since they parted on the outskirts last time and didn't expect to meet them again today.
The little girl's outfit today was similar to the last time.
She was still wearing a black tight short sleeve top with denim shorts on the bottom.
Despite her small stature, she carried herself like a little adult.
The little girl stood in front of Chen Yi, her expression serious as she extended her hand and crisply said,
"My name is Jiaye."
"Pleased to meet you properly, my brother likes you a lot."
"Uhm..."
Chen Yi paused for a moment, then put down his chopsticks and took Jiaye's hand awkwardly, "Oh, my name is Chen Yi. Have a seat."
They had met once before.
His impression of the two was still not bad.
There was a combination machine that could ascend to the heavens with a left foot stepping on the right; Tie Chui seemed a bit slow-witted, while Jiaye appeared to always be taking care of her brother.
They seemed to be a pair of troubled souls.
"I am Tuberculosis Rabbit."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting next to Chen Yi swallowed the bun in his mouth, then grinned and said, "Yi told me about you guys, your combination skill is pretty strong."
The buns were quickly served.
Chen Yi pushed the buns toward the two sitting opposite him, "Are you guys out looking for food too?"
"No."
Jiaye shook her head somewhat gloomily, propped her elbows on the table and let her head droop onto them, her voice low, "Actually, we're looking for a coffee shop."
"One that can make hot coffee."
"But we've been searching for a long time and haven't found any coffee shops, only instant coffee or coffee powder."
"But we must have that kind of hot coffee."
"That..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand, holding a bun, suddenly froze in place, his expression odd as he spoke, "Hot coffee?"
"Somehow, that sounds very familiar."

chapters.title: Chapter 39 "Prop Name" A Treasure Chest That Likes to Drink Coffee.
chapters.content:
```
"Mm-hmm."
```
After nodding his head several times, Jiaye then pulled out a treasure box roughly the size of a napkin from his bosom.
It was made of metal.
It looked like copper.
And there was a funnel embedded on the top of the treasure box.
"Yi, last time in the outskirts, didn't you tell us to pick up the props dropped by those minor bosses?"
"We were quite slow and only picked up a little."
"Most of the rest were picked up by the officials."
"One of the props was this one, Yi, take a look."
Jiaye also started to call Chen Yi "Yi" just like Tuberculosis Rabbit did.
Tie Chui had been sitting on his stool, somewhat restrained since sitting down, not sure what he was thinking.
And the panel of this treasure box was shared right before their eyes.
"Prop Name": A treasure box that loves to drink coffee.
"Prop Level": D-Level.
"Prop Effect": To open this treasure box, you must let it drink hot, freshly ground coffee for 30 continuous seconds, not some rubbish instant coffee, and you can't interrupt the process.
"Prop Restriction": Remaining opening time - 00:26:29.
"Prop Description": "You mortals simply do not understand the beauty of coffee!"
"It's this one."
Jiaye, somewhat downcast, leaned on the table: "There is less than half an hour left, and this treasure box will never be able to be opened again. Yet we looked all day yesterday and couldn't find a single coffee shop that was open."
"We thought about breaking in to do it ourselves, but after going in and studying for a long time, we still didn't know how to do it."
"Before we figured it out, we were surrounded by people outside."
"In the end, we had no choice but to leave."
"Gulp."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the treasure box before him, swallowing unconsciously and murmuring, "I don't know why, but I have a bad feeling about this."
Chen Yi also looked at the treasure box with a strange expression, shaking it in his hand.
"Loves to drink coffee?"
"Tuberculosis Rabbit, take this treasure box to the kitchen and try opening it, I'm curious to see what's inside as well."
"Understood."
Tuberculosis Rabbit twitched the corners of his mouth slightly, nodded, picked up the treasure box, and headed for the kitchen: "Can I have a room with no one in it?"
"You can open it?"
Jiaye paused, a glint in his eye, looking at Chen Yi with a hint of excitement, "That would be great, not being able to open this treasure box has been killing me."
"But Yi, don't worry, whatever props come out will be yours."
"After all, the treasure box was dropped by the boss you killed, and you will be the ones opening it. We definitely won't fight over props with Yi, it's just that seeing the treasure box right before my eyes and not being able to open it is very frustrating."
Chen Yi didn't respond and just began to focus on eating his meal.
Buns don't taste good once they're cold.
And seaweed soup is even worse when it's cold.
...
A moment later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit walked out of the kitchen looking relaxed, setting aside an opened treasure box he seemed somewhat disgusted with onto a table.
"Only one prop came out of it."
"Here."
"Prop Name": Wilderness Pass.
"Prop Level": D-Level.
"Prop Effect": When the "Wilderness" map opens up, players with this prop can enter the Wilderness unhindered.
"Uses": 3/3.
"Prop Introduction": "The Wilderness, that's a place that even saints can hardly resist."
"Wilderness Pass?"
Chen Yi stared at the small card that had popped out of the chest, his brow furrowed in thought without speaking.
A Wilderness Pass?
When was the "Wilderness" map opened up?
What does it mean, does it imply that Blue Star will open up new maps?
To be honest, it didn't sound like a very good thing.
"I'm going to hang onto this for now."
After pondering for a moment, Chen Yi stuffed the Wilderness Pass into his backpack, then took out another defense prop, also of D-class, and handed it to the two people in front of him.
"This is for your compensation."
Each player's backpack slots were limited to 100, but he had recently bought a Backpack Expansion Coupon from the Points Store, upgrading his backpack to 300 slots.
It was more than enough for him to carry a lot of stuff.
Besides that, he also bought a whole mess of stuff in bulk from the Points Store last time.
Like the Star Upgrading Coupon, he didn't even know what it was for.
But he still spent a hundred thousand points to buy all the Star Upgrading Coupons from the Points Store, for one sole reason: they were limited items.
His principle was to buy out whatever was limited first and talk about it later.
After buying them, the prop only showed a sentence that it could "star up," and he tried to use it on props without any effect, it seemed not something to be used at the current stage.
"Alright, then."
Just as Chen Yi was about to get up and leave, he saw Tie Chui's expectant look and after a momentary pause, he smilingly dug out a cigarette and offered it to Tie Chui.
"Want one, brother?"
"Sure, heh heh."
Tie Chui immediately stood up, took the cigarette with both hands with great reverence, and placed it carefully into his coat pocket, then similarly pulled out a pack of cigarettes from his pants pocket, took out one, and handed it to Chen Yi.
"Here, brother, have one."
"Alright."
Chen Yi smiled as he took the cigarette, then waved goodbye and turned to leave the shop.
...
"Yi."
Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a belch and then casually said, "That big brother, is he brain-damaged? Seems like people with that condition wouldn't last long in the current environment."
"Probably is."
Chen Yi shook his head softly, "He probably has some intellectual disabilities, still at the level of a few years old kid, but they can survive quite long, though."
"After all, with their skill combination that lets them touch the sky by stepping on their own feet, they can run away quite effectively. Unless they're facing guided missiles, it's very hard to keep them down."
Just then—
Chen Yi's eyebrows suddenly raised as he got a prompt that 3000 Points had been added to his account. He looked closely at the source of the transfer; it was the Law Enforcement Bureau settling their compensation from the last time they cleaned the movie theater.
He had thought that after the incident at Mutual Entertainment KTV, the Law Enforcement Bureau would call them for clean-up, but they hadn't, which seemed to mean that they found someone else.
And as they were about to leave...
Suddenly, a wave of panicked, noisy clamor came from a foot massage shop next door.
A man with the title "Fatal Strike" above his head appeared to be anxiously and fearfully rushing out of the shop, holding onto his pants.
The shop was filled with continuous sounds of panic.
"What is this?"
Curious about what was happening, Chen Yi was just about to ask when he heard continuous shouts of alarm from inside the shop.
It seemed like a technician had been made to bleed by that man.
He suddenly fell silent, guessing what might have happened.
If he recalled correctly, the "Fatal Strike" title should have a 3% Critical Hit Rate.
It looked like the service just now was unlucky enough to land a critical hit.
...
ps: Those who haven't joined the fan group can enter through the introduction. The entry threshold is "1" fan value. And by the way... please support with monthly votes.

chapters.title: Chapter 40 "Selling 300t data hard drives for 20 Points each, limited to 100 units.
chapters.content:
"Impressive."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the man running away in panic, his face filled with amazement, and couldn't help clicking his tongue.
"What's the time now, and you still have the mind to think about this?"
"Think if you want, but can this also be considered as a critical hit? What will you do in the future, Yi?"
He then looked toward the entrance of the foot bath shop, where several security guards, with anxious expressions and hurriedly wielding batons, were looking around for the person who had fled: "Hey, stop looking around blindly, he ran into the alley behind that internet café."
However.
The security guards seemed as if they hadn't heard anything, continuing to stand at the entrance of the foot bath shop, anxious and angry, still looking around.
"..."
After a moment of speechless silence, Tuberculosis Rabbit raised his voice.
"Are you deaf? I said he ran into that alley!"
As his words fell.
The security guards finally reacted, first glaring at Tuberculosis Rabbit to indicate he should mind his own business, but upon seeing Chen Yi standing beside Tuberculosis Rabbit with a head full of title banners, they froze on the spot.
A flicker of fear crossed their eyes as they looked at Chen Yi with a helpless gaze, their hands joining in a praying gesture in the void.
Before Tuberculosis Rabbit could react.
He saw a tattooed strongman who weighed over 200 pounds and was dressed in a suit walk out of the foot bath shop.
"Where is he?"
The strongman's voice was dark and deliberate: "I'm asking you, where is he?"
"Don't... don't know."
The security guards looked at each other, then spoke in a trembling voice: "That guy ran too fast, we didn't see where he went."
"A bunch of useless trash."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a blank expression, took a cigarette from his pocket and put it in his mouth. If it were so easy, wouldn't he have understood already?
These security guards didn't really want to catch up.
After all, it was a man with the title 'Fatal Strike' above his head. If they actually caught up to him, who knew what might happen? They were just out to make some money; there was no need to risk themselves.
"Let's go."
Chen Yi glanced around and without lingering, pulled out the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh from his pocket and shot towards the distance.
No one dared to provoke him.
After all, the deterrent power of those seven, oh no, eight titles above his head was still there.
...
"Where are we going?"
Seated in the back of the Christmas Sleigh, Tuberculosis Rabbit held onto the railing tightly, his face pale as he yelled into the wind: "Yi, next time can we at least add something wind-shielding?"
"The wind's really strong!!!"
"I'm really scared!!!"
"Yi, have you forgotten the rule that falling from over 18 meters is certain death, it's very dangerous!!"
"Eh, those two sentences of mine were quite rhyming."
With a face white as a sheet and fear in his eyes, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly licked the corner of his mouth with a sense of unfinished business, feeling that the two sentences he just said were quite symmetrical and rhymed well.
"There's nothing to be afraid of."
Chen Yi, unconcerned, looked down at the navigation device in his hand and spoke casually: "You talk as if without this rule, you wouldn't die from falling 18 meters anyway."
Today was the second day of the 'Extraterrestrial Invader' event.
Yancheng was the first globally to solve the Insect Race assault, as for the situation in other cities, they had no channels to understand, only able to pick up bits and pieces of news online.
The world was already like this.
Information systems hadn't collapsed, the internet still existed.
If I remember correctly, dozens of miles away from Yancheng lays "Sunset City". I wonder what the situation is like there now. He tried searching for the local forum of this city, looking for any available information.
Soon enough.
A post caught his eye.
"For sale: 300t data hard drive, 20 Points each, only 100 available, transaction in person."
"...6"
"Someone knows how to seize a business opportunity, huh."
Admiration shone in the eyes of Tuberculosis Rabbit, who leaned in and said, "To speak or not to speak, under the current circumstances, a 300t data hard drive for 20 Points is indeed not expensive."
"But that's for us."
"The average person probably doesn't have many Points left in their pockets now, right?"
"Hmm."
Chen Yi nodded and didn't say much more, at least indicating the city hadn't fallen yet and, from the looks of it, wasn't in a state of imminent destruction.
Afterward.
He pushed the snow sled to its top speed, charging straight towards the location of the city from low altitude.
His plan was simple.
To kill more bugs before the Extraterrestrial Invaders' activity ended.
In doing so, he could save a few more lives while earning some extra Kill Points for himself.
The Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh had a top speed of 280 km/h and a fixed Point consumption of 300 per hour.
Before long.
The sun had only just risen halfway, and Chen Yi and his companions were already hovering above Sunset City.
Along the way, they had seen quite a few villages and towns.
These rural areas and towns were also surrounded by Insect Race monsters—not only the cities. It seemed that wherever there were people, these bug-like monsters would appear.
He didn't lend a hand.
Because... it didn't look like they needed his help.
With the help of buildings and cold weapons, those people managed the Insect Race monsters quite handily, keeping them constantly at bay, without breaking their defenses.
In the skies above Sunset City now.
The Insect Race monsters were quietly lying in large numbers outside the city perimeter, while the players inside the city hadn't rushed out yet, creating a surprisingly peaceful scene.
And on the "Extraterrestrial Invaders Sunset City Points Leaderboard" floating above the city, the first place already had nearly 29,000 Kill Points.
"Is there going to be a break in combat?"
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully.
He had always been curious; if every city was under attack by nearly a million Insect Race monsters, without sufficient mental preparation, how could they possibly hold up?
Now he understood.
Under normal circumstances, after attacking for a while, the Insect Race monsters would start to rest, and the players could use this time to regroup and adjust.
That way, they wouldn't be wiped out in one fell swoop.
What Chen Yi didn't know was.
Many players in Sunset City were now looking up in shock at the sleigh hovering above their city.
The sleigh, gleaming with a fluorescent glow and led by four crystal-clear mechanical elk, looked shiny and extraordinary—a mark of something beyond normal.
Add to that the eight shining titles above Chen Yi's head.
Forget the dark, even in broad daylight, this scene was exceptionally conspicuous.
It made the players of Sunset City, who had just returned from the front line and were in the throes of an adrenaline rush, glance at each other with embarrassment.
This situation was like, they had just struggled in Newbie Village for a long time and finally succeeded, about to celebrate,
When they saw a high-level character come to inspect their Newbie Village.

chapters.title: Chapter 41 "Ding, Player Chen Yi, hello.
chapters.content:
"Since there's nothing wrong, I'm off."
Chen Yi urged the sleigh on, and immediately left Sunset City, shooting off into the distance.
There were mainly two purposes for this trip.
First, to see if he could find a higher-level Insect Race Queen, such as a Level 3 or even a Level 4 Matriarch...
Second, the 'Wilderness Pass' prop had him feeling slightly uneasy; he planned to go out and see if Blue Star had suddenly acquired some new maps, otherwise the introduction to this prop was rather suggestive.
Just as his sleigh had left Sunset City not long before, he suddenly noticed something odd within the city.
An abrupt stop.
He halted the sleigh mid-air and turned to look back at Sunset City, finally spotting what was amiss.
Within Sunset City, there were no fewer than nine enormous old men dressed in Christmas attire.
Each stood as tall as a three-story building.
A nearly ten-meter-tall mini-boss.
And these nine old men in Christmas attire stood in the middle of Sunset City like statues, motionless, with players occasionally approaching to chat with Santa Claus.
"Hm?"
Chen Yi's brows slightly furrowed, and he squinted in confusion without speaking.
What the heck was this?
In Yancheng, he had never seen such a thing.
It was only during the limited-time event on May 20th that some Cupids made an appearance.
Afterward, he glanced at a prop in his pack to make sure there were no issues before he relaxed and prepared to go down for a closer look.
The last time he killed a Level 2 Insect Race Matriarch, a defensive prop dropped.
'Prop Name': A cigarette that won't light.
'Prop Level': C-grade.
'Prop Introduction': When you have this cigarette in your mouth, you will possess a strong premonition of danger, and upon activating this prop, you will have one second of Invincible Time. After use, it cools down for 24 hours.
'Prop Introduction': "One second of invincibility is pretty strong."
Defensive props seem to be rarer than offensive and functional ones.
They're not even sold in the Points Store.
So far, he had only seen this one, dropped by the Insect Race Queen, and even though it was just one second of invincibility, it was enough.
As for the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
It was best to grip the Claw Knife in reverse and strike; the best defense was offense, and he had been charging up for so long without testing its effect yet.
He brought the sleigh to a halt in the center of the city.
With the prop in his mouth, Chen Yi gave the surroundings a look. Feeling no sense of danger, he breathed a sigh of relief and approached the giant Santa Claus nearby, leaning on the Christmas Cane.
If he remembered correctly, Christmas Day was in December, which was still a long way off.
Why were there so many Santa Clauses showing up here? He was puzzled. It was definitely a product of the game, but what confused him was why Yancheng didn't have this.
"Uh..."
Chen Yi suddenly stopped, looking towards the bystanders who were staring at his title with shock.
Sometimes, it wasn't that he wanted to peek intentionally, but the cane's innate ability always made him see things he shouldn't, tempting him to take a closer look despite himself.
He shook his head, no longer dwelling on it, and strode towards Santa Claus. Before he could even ask the people around him what was happening, a panel popped up in front of him.
'Ding, player Chen Yi, hello.'
'We are Santas who have accidentally traveled from the future to the present. Can you help us return to the future, which is December 24th?'
'If you help us, we can offer you a little something in return.'
'You can assist us in the following ways.'
'1: Pay 1 Point to exchange for 1 Santa Claus exclusive point.'
'2: Give 1 E-grade prop to exchange for 100 Santa Claus exclusive points, and so on...'
'3: Give 1 E-grade Skill Fragment to exchange for 20 Santa Claus exclusive points, and so on...'
"4:..."
"We're just a pinch of energy away from successfully returning."
"Total progress: 91889/100k"
"..."
Chen Yi looked at the panel in front of him with a somewhat expressionless face, became silent for a moment, and felt at a loss for words.
The last time he saw this copy, it was from the mouth of a scammer.
If he remembered correctly, that scammer claimed to be the First Emperor of Qin, promising that for just a few hundred bucks, you could get the title of Chiliarch when the terracotta warriors come back to life.
But he still opened the shop on this Christmas panel in front of him.
He decided to check out what kind of things the so-called exclusive Santa Claus Points could buy in the shop.
Although he didn't know why Blue Star didn't have this Santa Claus, now wasn't the time to worry about that.
"Hmm... There are quite a few good things."
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully, and most importantly, he could exchange tasks for the Christmas Points inside.
For example, 10 exclusive Santa Claus Points could be exchanged for a task from Santa Claus.
The content of these tasks varied widely; it could be running a lap around the city or killing 5 creatures from the Insect Race.
In any case, after completing the task,
you would get a random gift package, as well as 30-80 random Points.
In the gift package, random items such as Skill Fragments and props could be found.
When you think about it, this could actually greatly speed up most players' growth.
After all, for average players, the fastest way to improve their might is by doing tasks, and such high-return tasks are favored by most of them.
No wonder there are so many players gathered around here, it turns out they've all come to take on tasks.
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi's attention was suddenly drawn to a prop in the Santa Claus Store.
Title Name: Patron of the Lonely Elderly
Obtaining Method: Exclusively obtained after successfully helping Santa Claus return home.
Title Price: 1000 Santa Claus Points.
1000 Santa Claus Points, amounting to 1000 Points, was practically like a sprinkling of light rain for Chen Yi.
"Buy!"
Without even checking the other items, he decided to purchase this title first.
After all, the title was limited to three purchases per person.
And so far, no one had bought one.
Forget it, he'd buy all three, give one to Tuberculosis Rabbit, and keep the rest for appreciation in value later.
Since he had suddenly come into a large sum of Points, he found he'd developed a habit: he couldn't help but buy out items that were limited for purchase in the shop.
If they were limited, they had to be good.
Just then—
Chen Yi suddenly froze for a second; his Christmas Cane had a feature that allowed seeing through obstacles!
And when he had looked up at Santa Claus just now, he suddenly saw through the disguise of his Christmas outfit.
Underneath the costume wasn't an old man, nor a beauty, but astonishingly a reindeer with plum blossom-shaped antlers.
The name above its head read...
"I am a little reindeer, I stole Santa Claus's package, snuck back to the past to sell it, I'm so clever, surely no one will find out. If by chance someone does, and since I have no means of attack, all they could do is rob me. But luckily under the name of Santa Claus, no player would attack me."
"..."
This reindeer's name is awfully long.
Chen Yi's expression grew increasingly strange as he looked at the reindeer inside the Santa Claus outfit. Instead of reaching for his cane, he slowly rolled up his sleeves.
It looked like he wouldn't need to pay after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 42 "They've kidnapped Santa Claus?
chapters.content:
The Santa Claus before their eyes was a towering three-story high, standing in the city, clearly a colossal figure!
However...
After seeing through the obstruction, one could find that inside this Santa costume, there was surprisingly just a tiny reindeer.
Not much bigger than a husky, really.
How exactly the reindeer was controlling Santa, that was unclear.
But that was no longer important.
Chen Yi sneered, rolled up his sleeves, and after taking a deep breath while standing still, he finally growled.
"Invincible Under the Heavens!"
The next second——
The "Invincible Under the Heavens" Title Effect was activated.
A supreme yellowish translucent staircase appeared abruptly in front of Chen Yi, with the other end stretching directly towards Santa's waist and then stopping right at Santa's belly button.
After all, this Santa was more than ten meters tall.
Without some ingenuity, he really wouldn't be able to reach Santa.
Then.
Chen Yi's eyes twinkled with a fearsome gleam, and he chuckled fiendishly as he climbed the stairs, reached the end, and placed his hand on the waistband of Santa's pants in front of him.
Bowing his head, he started to untie the waistband seriously.
Oho, it's a dead knot.
Quite meticulous.
"Gulp!"
The crowd of onlookers nearby swallowed hard, their eyes filled with shock and horror, feeling as if their bodies were frozen in place, unable to move.
No wonder this guy had so many titles and was announced globally.
Indeed... he's no ordinary person.
"That..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, holding the Claw Knife, glanced at the onlookers' gazes and whispered with an expression full of embarrassment and disbelief: "Yi, maybe we should get out of here."
"If it doesn't work out, we can go to a foot massage parlor to find one, but this is too outrageous, it's embarrassing."
"Although I've always done whatever you do, Yi, this time it's a bit too much for me, I'm having a hard time accepting it."
"And..."
Before he could finish.
Chen Yi, standing on the staircase, swung his arm and yanked Santa's waistband off with a single pull.
Suddenly——
Pants five or six meters tall tumbled down towards the ground.
"Whoosh!"
There was a commotion all around, everyone's eyes unblinking as they watched the scene unfold.
A petite reindeer appeared, its forked antlers looking especially appetizing.
The reindeer's eyes anthropomorphically filled with terror and panic.
"Very good."
Chen Yi nodded with satisfaction, jumped down from the staircase, and reached out to the tiny reindeer in front of him. Before he could start talking,
he saw the reindeer suddenly open its mouth, spitting a box out from its stomach.
「Prop Name」: Santa Claus's Gift Box.
「Prop Tier」: No Tier.
「Prop Effect」: Contains various gifts from Santa's collection, can be opened once a day, and will randomly drop 10 items from inside the gift box.
「Prop Description」: "Did you know that the nuclear bomb in the hands of the little girl selling matches was a Christmas gift from Santa Claus?"
"Hmm?"
A glint of light flashed through Chen Yi's eyes, he couldn't help but smile with a satisfied grin.
So proactive, huh?
These are Santa's gifts inside this box?
However, he did not immediately open the gift box.
Instead, he picked up the reindeer with one hand, tossed it onto the sleigh, and then the two of them dashed off into the distance.
When the reindeer came into contact with the sleigh.
A system notification sounded slowly in Chen Yi's ears, but the excited Chen Yi did not notice this notification; he had more important things to do now!
The next second—
The sleigh shot up into the sky.
It vanished from everyone's sight.
Just before leaving, the huge Santa Claus suit instantly shrunk to a few small props that flew into the reindeer's backyard.
What no one noticed was this.
The other eight Santas in the city had also disappeared at some point, gone without attracting any attention.
...
"That..."
After Chen Yi and the others had flown away,
the onlookers standing nearby finally came to their senses, staring blankly at the small black dot disappearing into the horizon.
"Did they just kidnap Santa Claus?"
"Seems like it... should we call the police?"
"Probably not necessary..."
"..."
...
"Spill it now!"
Chen Yi's eyes were ablaze as he hovered the sleigh midair, staring intently at the little reindeer before him, "What are the update rules for June?"
"What about July? And August? What about September, October, November, December?"
"Is there any event during these months? Hand over all the details of the event rules."
"Tuberculosis Rabbit, you take notes."
"Understood."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit also immediately snapped to attention, quickly pulling out a sheet of white paper and a pen from his bosom, his expression serious and full of anticipation as he prepared to take notes.
This was no ordinary paper.
It was one of the many props he had collected.
'Prop Name': Memory Paper.
'Prop Level': E.
'Prop Effect': Record the information on this white paper and swallow the paper; the information on it will then forever be in your mind, never to be forgotten.
'Prop Description': "I hope you use it to record happiness, not hatred."
All the useful and useless props they had obtained these days were neatly placed in the Tuberculosis Rabbit's backpack.
A collector might look at the array of neatly organized props in their backpack,
and even if most of the props were basically useless, there would still be an intense sense of satisfaction.
Plus, sometimes they could come in handy.
Like... that coffee machine, and this Memory Paper.
...
Chen Yi gazed eagerly at the little reindeer in front of him. This reindeer had traveled from December, so if he could get even a tiny bit of information about the future updates,
he would gain a significant advantage.
Not to mention the distance,
even if he only knew what the rules for June's update were, he could start preparing in advance.
But...
Bling bling.
The little reindeer before him blinked several times, staring at Chen Yi with an innocent face and shaking its head as if to say that it's just a small reindeer, how could it possibly speak.
As Chen Yi's brow furrowed, thinking about how he might communicate with the little reindeer to obtain crucial information about the future,
he suddenly noticed that his personal panel's system notification had a small speaker flashing.
Out of nowhere, a new system notification had appeared,
continuously reminding him.
"Huh, is there something good?"
Chen Yi's attention was diverted, looking towards the flashing system notification.
The next second.
He expressionlessly lit a cigarette and put it in his mouth.
"Good death."

chapters.title: Chapter 43 "I want the December Christmas event to have no Santa Claus anymore!!!
chapters.content:
"System Notification: 'Santa Claus' 9 reindeer have stolen Santa Claus' gift box and have fled back to the 'past' to secretly sell them."
"You've apprehended one of Santa's reindeer, No. 2378; now, the remaining eight reindeer have run back to squeal on you."
"Now Santa Claus is on his way to kill you."
"Countdown to Santa Claus' arrival: 09:22:21"
"For player's information—"
"1: 'Santa Claus' is the neutral boss of December. Except when he or his reindeer are attacked or captured, he won't hurt any player, but his strength is equivalent to that of December's boss and far beyond the abilities of players in May."
"2: 'Santa Claus' can only act at night and cannot move during the day."
"3: Santa Claus can stay in the past for a maximum of 24 hours. If players survive for 24 hours, Santa Claus will return empty-handed."
"PS: If you successfully evade the pursuit, you'll receive a large number of rewards, including limited edition titles, a large amount of Points, rare props, etc."
"..."
With a blank face, Chen Yi stared at the system notification in front of him, and after a long silence, he slowly exhaled a puff of smoke, muttering in a trance.
"Tuberculosis Rabbit, Yi is sorry."
"Yi promised to take you to live a good life."
"Now it seems I'm going to break my word."
"What happened now?"
Startled by his words, Tuberculosis Rabbit's face flashed with panic. He drew a cigarette from his bosom with the fastest speed he had ever mustered, lit it, took a quick drag, then laid back in the chair with a look of relief, looking up at the sky casually.
"So tell me, when do I die?"
"I'm ready."
"I remember, when watching movies, every time I saw those people who, with their last bit of strength, lit a cigarette and then died before they could take a puff."
"Back then, I vowed to myself—"
"Before I die, I must light a cigarette as fast as possible, so I won't leave behind such a bloody regret."
"For that, I've worked hard for a long time."
"Finally—"
"From reaching for a cigarette to lighting it and inhaling, this complex series of actions, I can complete in only 0.7 seconds!"
Afterward, Tuberculosis Rabbit smacked his lips with some emotion, took another satisfied drag and said, "This is the second puff, I've made a profit; even in death, it's not a loss."
"This is what effort means."
"..."
Chen Yi swept a peculiar glance over Tuberculosis Rabbit, then looked at that countdown timer with 9 hours left, took a deep breath, and his eyes flashed instantly with ferocity and ruthlessness, as he fiercely tossed the cigarette butt outside the sleigh.
He pulled out the sniper rifle, holding it in his hand, his voice hoarse and threatening as he said,
"It's just Santa Claus, isn't it?"
"Even if it's a god, as long as there's a health bar, I'll show you how I can slaughter them!"
"Forget Santa Claus, not even a god could withstand my 33 shots."
"Today—"
"I will make sure the December Christmas event has no more Santa Claus!!!"
"From now on, no gods in the world!"
Just then,
a new system notification popped up on his personal panel.
"Supplementary Notification: Santa Claus can recover 100 percent of his Maximum Health Value every second, and his health bar has over a hundred million points."
"..."
"Oh, got it; no problem then."
Chen Yi once again fell silent, and after a while, he took out a notebook and began to chew on his pen, deep in thought,
"Tuberculosis Rabbit, what do you say we should do if we only have 9 hours left to live?"
"Find some girls."
"That direct?"
"Should I be more subtle?"
After a moment of thought with his head tilted, Tuberculosis Rabbit finally said, "Get a few more, I've always wanted to experience what Daughter Country is like."
"Sure."
Chen Yi sighed softly, his voice a bit low,
"I'll take 99, you take 98; is that enough?"
"Should be about right."
"Alright, then that's the plan, but you have to lend me that prop."
"Which prop?"
"Cough."
