Chen Yi held a fist to his mouth and coughed lightly, "It's that one that can make you think about nothing but dirty stuff for three hours and keep you up the whole time."
"No way!"
"Hey..."
Chen Yi immediately rolled up his sleeves, ready to enlighten the Tuberculosis Rabbit about who the king of the hill was.
But at that moment—
He suddenly noticed the sun overhead, which was at its zenith.
He paused, a glint of revelation flashed through his eyes, and with a voice trembling with fragile hope, he said urgently.
"Quick, quick, check for me, what's the rotational speed of Blue Star?"
"466 meters per second, equivalent to 1667 km per hour."
"Yes, exactly like that!"
"Although we're in the northern hemisphere, where the speed may vary a bit, the difference isn't that significant."
Chen Yi stood up excitedly from the sleigh, his eyes filled with anticipation and excitement, his voice rapidly quivering, "What does this imply?"
"It implies that if we fly over the surface of Blue Star at this speed, against the direction of rotation, we will maintain the same relative position to the sun and thus keep the sky as it was at the start."
"Which means we can keep the sky above us bright all the time!"
"And that Santa Claus guy can only move around in the dark, which means he can't possibly catch us if we keep the sky above us lit!"
"After 24 hours, Old Man will have to return empty-handed!"
"But..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a puzzled look, touched the sleigh beneath him: "Yi, do you really plan to get this thing up to a speed of 1667 km per hour?"
"Is that even possible?"
"Of course, it is!"
Chen Yi, looking at the nine hours left on the countdown, opened the sleigh's modification panel with hope in his eyes, "Don't forget, vehicles can be modified."
"As long as we have enough Points, it's not impossible to upgrade the speed to 1667 km per hour!"
"Let me see, let me see..."
Soon—
He found exactly what he was looking for.
'Modification Options': Supersonic Nitrogen Injection Cylinder.
'Modification Effect': Add one, which can increase the maximum speed of your vehicle by 100 km per hour.
'Modification Price': 20,000 Points.
'Modification Limit': Up to 100 per single vehicle.
"Yes, this is it."
Chen Yi started to calculate, fingers pinching.
The current maximum speed of the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh is 280 km per hour.
"Which means I only need to add about 15 to boost the sleigh's top speed to 1780 km per hour, already above the rotational speed of Blue Star!"
"15 units, that's 300,000 Points."
"Let me check my Points Balance, 229,599, almost 230,000."
"Hmm... still short by 70,000 Points."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting in the backseat of the sleigh with an emotional face, looked towards the rear of the sleigh, pondering how to fit 15 Supersonic Nitrogen Injection Cylinders onto the back of this sleigh.
The sleigh's rear doesn't have a shrinking feature, is there a place to stick 15 nitrogen cylinders?
Even if it had this feature, fitting in 15 would still be somewhat abstract.
A moment later.
He still spoke up to remind.
"Yi, I have to remind you of something."
"If the speed hits 1780 km and you haven't got a windshield or something..."
"Then our demise might resemble Lao Gan Ma with added diced chicken."
"By the way, Yi, do you like eating Lao Gan Ma?"
"Especially the kind with diced chicken."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 44 "At this time in the Arctic Circle, it should be the midnight sun, right?
chapters.content:
"What's this about Lao Gan Ma and not Lao Gan Ma?"
Chen Yi didn't even lift his head, constantly flipping through the modification panel to see what options were currently available and tallying up the total Points needed.
First of all,
protective glass was definitely needed.
Next, whether the sled could withstand the unknown stresses of such supersonic speeds was a complete unknown.
There were other additions needed as well.
At this moment,
the Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at the sun above and hesitated before speaking, "Say, can we go to the Arctic?"
"Around this time in the Arctic Circle, it should be the midnight sun, right?"
"Wouldn't that allow us to avoid Santa Claus?"
"In theory, it's possible."
Chen Yi sat in the sled's seat, pondering while gently rubbing his temples before replying, "At the end of June, the entire Polar region will enter the period of midnight sun."
"Today is May 22nd. Some areas within the Polar Circle have indeed already started the midnight sun period."
"But that's just in theory."
"There are several problems that we can't resolve."
"First, our sled can only fly at low altitudes."
With a sense of helplessness, he spread his hands and continued, "Do you want to see how many mountain ranges there are from where we are now to the Arctic Circle? This isn't a game where you can just fly straight through."
"Especially at low altitudes, visibility isn't that far, with such a supersonic sled."
"Just a second after you spot mountains through the mist, you'd be crashing into them."
"Too many unknowns."
"The best solution would be to head towards the Arctic Circle, but not in a straight line. Instead, follow the direction of the sun diagonally, making it easier to maneuver around some obstacles."
"Gradually increasing latitude while getting closer to the Arctic Circle."
"That would be a bit safer."
"And..."
After a moment's hesitation, Chen Yi decided to voice his concerns, "If I had a choice, I actually wouldn't want to get close to the Arctic Circle because, in the backstory of Santa Claus on Blue Star,"
"Santa Claus's hometown is in the Arctic Circle."
"Since the project team chose this backstory, no one knows if they'll incorporate this setting into it or what we'll encounter in that area of the Arctic Circle."
"As for the Antarctic, that's even less feasible; it's polar night there right now."
Then he shook his head and shared the modification panel in the air.
"We need 15 supersonic Nitrogen Injection Cylinders to give our sleigh enough speed, and this item will cost 300,000 Points."
"Next, we need a protective shield, which costs 30,000 Points."
"A Big Dipper Star Positioning and Cruise System is also 30,000 Points."
"After all, at a speed of 1,780 km/hour, we can't possibly navigate with one hand and control the direction with the other, right?"
"If we get into an area with no network and the navigation fails to update, it'd be game over instantly."
"By uploading the map to the Big Dipper Star Positioning and Cruise System, control becomes much safer."
"Aside from these, we also need to install an air conditioning system inside the sled, which will cost 3,000 Points."
"Even in summer, the latitude close to the Arctic Circle isn't exactly warm."
"In total, we need to spend 363,000 Points."
"And we only have 230,000 Points at the moment."
"We're short by 133,000 Points."
He pulled out a cigarette from his pocket, put it in his mouth, glanced at the countdown for Santa Claus's impending arrival, then looked off into the distance, "The Kill Points from the last time, we still have 20,000 unspent."
"1 Kill Point can be exchanged for 1 Point."
"That means we're still short by 113,000 Points."
"Getting all those Points is definitely beyond our reach in the short term, but 113,000 Kill Points is quite simple."
"Let's go, time to make some money."
The next second—
"Swoosh!"
The Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh shot towards the distance with a whooshing sound!
...
Half an hour later, they appeared outside a city.
At the edges of the city, players could be seen everywhere fighting against the Insect Race monsters.
After the initial fear had passed, people slowly discovered that these monsters weren't that hard to deal with.
Gradually, more and more players came out to battle the monsters.
Human adaptability is truly terrifying.
Such an absurd situation had only been around on Blue Star for a mere two months, yet it seemed like people had almost adapted to it.
Chen Yi did not observe the city too much, but instead controlled the sleigh to circle constantly above the monsters, searching for the second-level Insect Race Queen.
He only had the chance to fire one shot.
'Skill Name': Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!
'Skill Level': C level.
'Skill Type': Active Skill.
'Skill Effect': When you kill a person with a firearm, if the target is a player, then the player's subsequent three clans will die along with them.
If the target is a monster, then the subsequent nine hundred and ninety-nine clans of that monster will die as well.
'Skill Limitation': Using it once will result in a 48-hour cooldown.
'Skill Introduction': "One day, a tyrant suddenly found the order to annihilate nine clans too troublesome, so he developed this skill."
If he wanted to quickly earn 100,000 points in a short amount of time, he could only rely on this skill.
He had to kill a second-level Insect Race Queen to utilize the effect of this skill and swiftly gain a hundred thousand points, because a first-level Insect Race Queen simply wouldn't be enough.
After that, the skill would fall into a 48-hour cooldown, which would be dangerous.
The sudden appearance of such a figure in the city's skies couldn't help but be conspicuous.
Many people looked up at the figure on the sleigh with some confusion in their eyes—wasn't the title above his head a bit too much? It was so bright even in the daylight.
Just after ten minutes!
Chen Yi's eyes lit up as he looked at a plump Insect Race Queen monster in the midst of the Insect Tide, his expression revealing a hint of joy.
Found her.
The familiar second-level Insect Race Queen.
She was hiding within the Insect Tide, commanding the Insect Race monsters to attack the city in front of her.
Without saying another word,
Chen Yi positioned the sleigh directly above the head of the second-level Insect Race Queen, pulled out a sniper rifle from his bosom, aimed, and pulled the trigger.
"Bang!"
Accompanied by the gunshot, a terrifying scarlet damage number popped up from the top of the second-level Insect Race Queen's head.
One shot, another shot, and another.
Chen Yi was like a cold-blooded butcher, calmly and rhythmically firing shot after shot.
Especially the cigarette butt held between his lips, its faint flickering scarlet glow casting sinister and distinct shadows over the stubble on his chin.
Finally.
In the instant that the second-level Insect Race Queen's health bar was about to disappear,
Chen Yi silently activated the skill 'Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans' and fired off the final shot.
"Boom!"

chapters.title: Chapter 45 "Let's go, I'll take you on a trip around the world.
chapters.content:
With the final gunshot ringing out!
The second-level Insect Race Matriarch, who had always been helpless against Chen Yi, let out a few pained shrieks. Then, her corpulent body burst open instantly!
And this scene.
Was clearly witnessed by the players standing on the high-rise buildings in the suburbs of the city.
Just as these players were inwardly marveling at someone so powerful.
The very next second—
The moment the bloated body of the Insect Race Matriarch exploded, numerous red beams thick as forearms shot straight toward several first-level Insect Race Matriarchs within the nest!
Like red lasers, they cleanly cut through the battlefield!
Before anyone could react!
They saw those red beams piercing the bodies of the first-level Insect Race Matriarchs. Each Matriarch only had time to look up and let out an agonized howl before their bodies also exploded!
And even more red beams were densely shooting toward nearly all the remaining Insect Race monsters on the battlefield!
In an instant.
If one looked down from the sky, they would see thousands of red beams continuously shooting and spreading among the crowd of monsters below, as thousands of Insect Race monsters exploded without a chance to resist.
The crimson blood, like a smashed strawberry burst cake, covered the entire battlefield.
It was disgusting, and yet, one thought it might taste better with a bit of cheese added.
Meanwhile, a series of system reward notifications also kept ringing in Chen Yi's ears.
"Let's go."
Chen Yi briefly scanned the system notifications beside his ear, lowered the sleigh to the ground, and casually stuffed the loot dropped by the second-level Insect Race Matriarch into his backpack.
Then he didn't linger any longer.
As for the loot dropped by the first-level Insect Race Matriarchs, there was no time to pick them up.
'Ding, congratulations to the player for killing one second-level Insect Race Matriarch, ..., a total of 360,000 Kill Points obtained.'
That's equivalent to 360,000 Points.
That's enough for now.
Instead of leaving immediately, he maneuvered the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh towards the city. It was going to be several days' journey, and he decided to stock up on water and food first.
"Let's go, Tuberculosis Rabbit."
"Oh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit first nodded and then looked strangely towards a few surviving Insect Race monsters nearby: "There are still some alive, are they wild breeds?"
"Did other Insect Race Matriarchs birth them?"
...
Soon.
Chen Yi and the others had supplied themselves with the things they wanted from the city. It didn't take much effort, and no inconspicuous figure came forward to challenge them.
After all, their recent achievements and the titles above their heads were quite eye-catching.
Many players.
Standing on the buildings at the edge of the city, watched with complicated expressions as the sleigh departed; that man...just one-shot all the monsters?
It was exaggerated.
Could they report this to the project team for cheating?
Where's the reporting channel? Customer service?
Is there no customer service?
Well then, never mind, it truly has the familiar style of a domestic online game.
...
Soon.
Chen Yi and his team stopped the sleigh in a plain and began their modification journey.
'Supersonic Nitrogen Injection Cylinders' x 15.
'Protective Shield' x 1.
'Big Dipper Star Positioning and Cruise System' x 1.
'Circulating Wind Energy Air Conditioning System' x 1.
A total of 363,000 Points was spent.
After all the modifications were completed, they still had 247,000 Points left.
And after the modifications, the sleigh had completely changed.
Firstly, the backside of the sleigh now had 15 Supersonic Nitrogen Injection Cylinders inserted, making the back of the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh look like a peacock flaunting its feathers.
It no longer had the neat aesthetic of a mechanical product.
It looked a bit messy.
At the same time, a huge glass dome now enveloped the entire sleigh.
It looked as if several eggshells had been placed on top of the sleigh.
Furthermore, inside the sleigh, there was an additional row of dashboard instruments, which was the newly added navigation system.
"Well..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood beside the sleigh with a touch of emotion, patting the air conditioning unit mounted on the side with a sigh, "It's hard to believe that a circulating system bought for 3,000 Points could come out looking so shabby."
"Believe it or not, I could get something better for 3,000 in cash," Yi said with confidence.
As for the quality of the sleigh,
there was no need for upgrade.
Once the "Supersonic Nitrogen Injection Cylinder" modifications exceeded 25 units, the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh would reach its maximum speed tolerance and risk disintegration.
The quality of the vehicle couldn't be enhanced; to achieve greater speed, a higher-class vehicle was required.
But for now, this velocity was more than sufficient for their needs.
"Phew."
Chen Yi glanced at the five-hour countdown and the sun gradually descending to the mountainside, nodding his head in satisfaction as he let out a breath of relief.
Everything was in place.
Next up, it was time to race against the sun.
A mere December neutral boss giving chase—nothing to worry about.
He scoffed at the sight of a small elk inside the sleigh, blinking and staring at them to earn their affection.
"Stop looking; your Santa Claus can't save you now."
"Once this is over, you'll obediently pull the sleigh for me."
"Nine to six, that's not too abusive."
He didn't linger any longer, needing to leave a five-hour buffer.
After discerning the direction, he boarded the sleigh, turning to Tuberculosis Rabbit who was still outside, "Let's go, I'll take you on a trip around the world."
"Where life doesn't cease, romance never ends."
"Never in my life did I imagine I'd get to travel the globe."
"Pretty nice."
...
"Boom!"
With a piercing sonic boom,
the sleigh shot forward at a low altitude with a speed the naked eye could not catch!
Low-altitude maneuvering is a highly dangerous act.
Especially at nearly 1,800 km/h.
Basically, if any mishap occurred, one could close their eyes and upon reopening them, see the King of Hell grinning right before them.
"Ah!!!!!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit clutched the railing tightly, looking at the fast-moving scenery blurring past on both sides, yelling in fright, "Hold on, Yi, did you maybe overlook something?"
"Damn, all the elks have fallen behind us!!!!"
"Can we still steer this sleigh?"
The sleigh was indeed fast at that moment.
But... the source of the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh's original speed was the mechanical elks in front. Now, the speed provided by the Nitrogen Injection Cylinder at the back of the sleigh had completely exceeded the pace set by the mechanical elks.
The consequence was...
The mechanical elks, dangling like pendants, were strung out behind, trailing the Christmas sleigh.
What was once a neat Christmas sleigh,
now, after such a modification, looked disastrously pitiful.
A heap of scrap metal.
"Don't panic, don't panic."
Chen Yi, with slight urgency, began trying to regain control using the dashboard; the mechanical elks were initially supposed to provide both speed and steering.
Now they weren't needed for speed,
but since they had swung to the back, steering had become difficult too.
At that point, the entire sleigh was essentially careening out of control in a straight line!
And the navigation map showed a mountain range ahead, a full kilometer high.
In no more than a minute, they'd hit it straight on.
Just then—
Chen Yi suddenly had an idea, turning his head to look at the innocent-looking little elk blinking beside him.
"Santa's sleigh must be quite fast, shouldn't it?"
"After all, he has to deliver so many gifts in one night."
"If he was slow, he wouldn't make it in time, right?"
...
ps: Typos will be corrected post publication.

chapters.title: Chapter 46 "Shall we go to the Arctic Circle and kill his grandfather?
chapters.content:
"..."
The little elk blinked its eyes a few times, its face innocently silent, without speaking.
Soon after.
Santa's sleigh gradually came to a halt.
Chen Yi removed the mechanical elks from the sleigh and harnessed the little elk, then reached into his pocket and pulled out a carrot, looking seriously at the little elk.
"Do you understand what you need to do?"
"If you do well, you'll get this carrot as a reward."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed with his palm on his forehead, speechlessly saying, "Yi, it's an elk, not a rabbit, carrots won't work to tempt it."
The next second—
The elk, only slightly bigger than a Husky, gulped down the carrot from Chen Yi's hand, chewed it a few times, and then raised its head to swallow it.
Crunchy.
Afterward, it nodded several times with bright eyes and willingly put on the harness, its face brimming with confidence, as if steering the sleigh was no challenge at all.
"..."
After a long silence, Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a cigarette from his pocket, put it in his mouth, and took a deep breath, then stared at the little elk with a complicated expression.
"How tough must your past have been?"
"That old man Santa Claus isn't abusing you every day, is he?"
Then, the sleigh took off again.
This time, it was much better.
The reins between the elk and the sleigh were taut, the elk seemed fully in control at this speed, and a rainbow glow could even be seen under the hooves of the running little elk.
Chen Yi tugged at the left rein.
The elk steered to the left in coordination, and the sleigh followed suit.
When Chen Yi connected the reins to the automatic cruising system—
The cruising system began to control the reins automatically according to the mapped route.
"This is kind of absurd."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting inside the sleigh, turned to look at the fifteen nitrogen injection cylinders at the rear of the sleigh, with their fifteen red flames continuously sprayed backward, forming circles of Mach cones that looked like stars, exceptionally dazzling.
And in front, a little elk with a harness, stepping on rainbow starlight.
The scene in front of them seemed very strange.
"But then again,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit hesitated before speaking, "If the elk is capable of handling this speed, what's the need for these injection cylinders? Why not just use the elk as the initial power source?"
"No,"
Chen Yi shook his head, pointing at the instrument panel in the cockpit: "The current speed is still provided by the injection cylinders. I did ask the elk to speed up just now, but obviously, it couldn't exceed this top speed."
"It seems that the elk possesses the power to handle the speed rather than create it. After all, this elk has a four-digit number, and Santa Claus's sleigh has more than just this one elk."
The scenery outside the window flew by.
In fact, if they were just counteracting Blue Star's rotation, they wouldn't need the sleigh to be this fast.
But their journey wasn't a straight path.
They had to circumvent many obstacles along the way, which meant they couldn't simply rely on straight-line acceleration; also, they needed to allow for some margin of error to avoid being too pressed.
Most importantly, they were not short on Points.
...
Soon.
There was only one minute left until Santa Claus's arrival.
And Chen Yi and the others were fully prepared.
Could a mere Santa Claus turn the world upside down?
"Ding, Santa Claus has arrived, and his real-time coordinates will now appear on the players' map. Please prepare to escape."
"Let me see where Santa Claus has landed."
Chen Yi slightly raised his eyebrows as he opened the map, and when he saw where Santa Claus had landed, he sighed with slight regret.
Santa Claus had landed at the Equator, right behind them at that moment.
Originally, he had thought that if it went by the background story of Blue Star, the Arctic Circle should be Santa Claus's home. If Santa Claus had landed in the Arctic Circle,
Since it was polar day there, Santa Claus wouldn't be able to move in accordance with the setting that Santa Claus can't move during the daytime.
That would have been fun.
Unfortunately, it seemed there were no loopholes to exploit.
"Then we run."
Chen Yi snorted coldly with a face full of disdain, "I'd like to see if you can catch up to me within 24 hours."
A grand and mighty escape journey officially began.
You flee, I chase.
I chase, you flee.
Chen Yi controlled the snow sled, chasing after the sun continuously; the little red dot of Santa Claus always remained far behind them, unable to draw near.
A full five hours went by.
The sun above Chen Yi's head showed no signs of setting, perfectly embodying what it meant for the sun to never set.
And that formidable Santa was unable to so much as touch a single hair of theirs in those five hours.
"What a pity."
Chen Yi stood on the snow sled, looking at the little red dot of Santa Claus on the map, and shook his head with regret, "It's a pity we don't have some powerful offensive means; otherwise, we could kill the neutral boss of December in May."
"That would be a lot of rewards."
"Yi."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, after mulling over for a while, finally began to suggest, "Perhaps there's not no way."
"Let's assume, according to the setting, that Santa Claus's home really is in the Arctic Circle."
"Wouldn't he also have a grandfather or something?"
"What if we go to the Arctic Circle and kill his grandfather? With your skill, wouldn't that also take care of this Santa guy?"
"No, that's wrong, Annihilate Nine Clans works on 999 clans."
"To wipe out this Santa guy's entire lineage."
"..."
Chen Yi, with a strange expression, pondered for a long time before shaking his head, "It's not feasible; a tiger's grandfather isn't a soft tiger, Santa's grandfather is also probably not something easy to mess with."
"Most importantly, my Annihilate Nine Clans skill has a 48-hour cooldown, and I already used it when I just collected enough Points; it's still cooling down now."
"Okay then."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded seriously, "But now I have a more important issue, Yi, I need to use the toilet, and you seem to have not included any in-flight toilet options."
"Uh..."
Chen Yi looked at the distance between them and Santa Claus on the map and controlled the snow sled to slowly stop, landing in an open area.
"This place will do."
Three minutes later.
"Why is it black?"
"... You forgot, Yi, that this morning, to open Tie Chui's treasure chest, I used the 'Have a Cup of Coffee' skill, right?"
"That skill lasts for 24 hours, and it's still in effect now."
"Oh... It's my first time seeing something like this, kind of peculiar; no worries, carry on."
After taking care of business,
They once again mounted the snow sled and started their escape.
Soon, a full 23 hours had passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 47 "Reward Hidden Title - 'That's it? Laughable!
chapters.content:
On the way,
Chen Yi and the others went from being tense at first to relaxed at the end, and now completely at ease.
"In another hour, Santa Claus will have to slink back home,"
Chen Yi casually glanced at the map, lay back in his chair leisurely, picked up a glass of juice next to him, sipped it, and popped a piece of Time Seaweed into his mouth, savoring the chew.
The scenery along the way was pretty decent.
Thanks to the sun, they could clearly see the beautiful rivers and mountains around them.
"It's really beautiful."
Tuberculosis Rabbit had gotten used to this speed, leaned on the window enjoying the scenery below, and said with great enthusiasm, "This world is so beautiful, and we used to be confined to the mortuary all day, working long hours."
"What a waste of the first half of my life."
"But working in the mortuary has its perks, you can talk a lot with those people, and they never get tired of it."
"And after people die, that's when they show their truest selves. Everyone is too fake on a regular basis, not real at all, feels like there's something missing when you chat."
"Here."
Chen Yi casually took out a cigarette, tossed it to Tuberculosis Rabbit, and was about to say something nonchalantly.
Suddenly, a notification sound came to his ear.
'Ding, December's neutral boss 'Santa Claus' invites you to a video call.'
"..."
Chen Yi, with a slightly strange expression, looked at the panel in front of him and hesitated for a moment before choosing to hang up.
Let's forget it.
What if Santa himself bursts out from the video?
It's quite frightening.
After all, having led Santa on a 23-hour chase and stolen his little reindeer, Santa's mood must be at its peak of anger now. Who knows what he might do at this point.
Better to play it safe.
'Ding, December's neutral boss 'Santa Claus' invites you again to a video call.'
Hang up.
'Ding, December's neutral boss 'Santa Claus' invites you to a video call for the last time.'
Hang up.
'Ding, Santa Claus has given you a gift and left a message on it.'
The next second—
"Jingle."
Suddenly there was an extra prop in the backpack.
Chen Yi's eyes flashed with surprise as he looked at the prop in his backpack.
'Prop Name': Santa Claus's Feed Box.
'Prop Level': None.
'Prop Effect': This feed box produces 10 carrots of various flavors every day that reindeer particularly enjoy eating.
'Prop Introduction': "Includes cheese flavor, cream flavor, five-spice flavor, spicy flavor, sweet and sour flavor, etc..."
'Prop Message': "Take good care of my stupid reindeer; its number is 2378, named Five Spice. Keep it alive until December, or... bear the consequences. Return it to me then, and I will reward you handsomely."
"Is this... backing down?"
Chen Yi let out a sigh of relief, it seemed he was truly out of danger now. He was really afraid that Santa Claus might suddenly come up with some trick to catch up, which would be quite scary.
Then he looked at the Santa Claus's Feed Box in his hand.
A glowing box about the size of a shoebox with a small hole on top.
Curious, Tuberculosis Rabbit reached into the hole to fumble around for a moment, pulled out a carrot, and tentatively crunched it in his mouth, then nodded in satisfaction.
"Strawberry-flavored, not bad."
"I like it."
Soon the last hour passed as well.
When the red dot belonging to Santa Claus on the map disappeared.
```
Multiple system voices continuously rang in his ears.
"Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully avoiding Santa Claus's pursuit, adding yet another notable and celebratory event to your life's milestones."
"Reward: 1 x random fashion component."
"Ding, it's been detected that player Chen Yi has been under the sunlight for a full 24 hours."
"Reward: hidden title—'Kuafu Chasing the Sun!'"
"Ding, it's been detected that player Chen Yi has survived the pursuit of a cross-dimensional boss."
"Reward: hidden title—'Is that all? Laughable!'"
Several system prompt sounds followed one after another, Chen Yi was stunned for a moment as he looked at the random fashion component, wondering how he had never seen such a thing before.
Fashion?
'Fashion Name': Teddy Bear Pajama Suit - Onesie.
'Fashion Level': C-grade.
'Fashion Effect': When wearing any piece of this suit, your daily excretions will be molecularly expelled through your pores, freeing you from the need to use the bathroom, allowing you to be an elegant gentleman. Collect all pieces of the suit to obtain the complete set effects.
'Fashion Set': 1/6
'Fashion Introduction': "An elegant gentleman only squats down when he pities the losers."
'PS: This fashion is currently not usable. It will become available when the fashion system is updated in the June version.'
"..."
Chen Yi looked at the fashion prop panel in front of him somewhat oddly, and had to admit that the pajama fashion looked quite nice just from the prop icon.
Onesie pajamas.
There's also a little bear hood on the back, all in brown.
It looks quite nice, giving off a laidback and warm feeling, much like a cozy man at home on a winter's day.
But even so.
Chen Yi expressionlessly stuffed the prop into the Tuberculosis Rabbit backpack, to store it for now or to see if it could be sold later for some Points or something.
He would absolutely, definitely, and resolutely not walk down the street wearing a brown teddy bear onesie.
Not a chance.
No matter how powerful the fashion set effects were, he would not allow himself to be seen in public in such attire, as it would be an affront to his image.
The remaining rewards were the title rewards.
'Title Name': Kuafu Chasing the Sun.
'Title Level': Yellow.
'Title Effect': After wearing this title, every time you say the word "sun," the surrounding area within a hundred meters will be instantly illuminated.
'Obtaining Method': Stay under the sun for 24 consecutive hours.
"Eh?"
Chen Yi thoughtfully nodded, this title was of no use to him, but it might be quite useful for people living in the Arctic Circle.
People living in the Arctic Circle should easily obtain this title.
The Arctic Circle not only has the midnight sun but also polar night.
With this title.
When the Arctic Circle falls into polar night, the local residents only need to have several people constantly shout "sun, sun, sun" on the rooftops, and they can turn the polar night into daylight.
Perhaps in the future, this might even lead to a new profession.
'Lamp Lighter.'
Working 9 to 5, just like a civil servant.
Indeed, a new era always gives rise to new job positions.
As for the other title effect, it's a bit odd...
Whether to mention it or not.
Such a provocative title, worn atop one's head, isn't it a bit too much of a hate magnet?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 48 "Husband, the name hasn't moved, he must have fallen asleep.
chapters.content:
The name of this title sure feels provocative, and the title effect seems even more so.
"Title Name": Just this? Laughable!
"Title Level": Red.
"Title Effect": You can summon a "Mouthy Phantom Shadow" that lasts for thirty minutes, which uses all kinds of filthy language to taunt the player or boss in front of you; if taunting a boss, then the boss will definitely target you first for an attack. After use, it goes into a 24-hour cooldown.
"Obtaining Method": Survive 24 hours when a boss from another time and space is pursuing you.
"..."
After thinking for a while, Chen Yi silently nodded; this title could still be quite useful in certain situations.
However, he seemed to have a good grasp on the ranking system for titles now.
The hierarchy of title levels from low to high goes as follows:
White, Green, Blue, Yellow, Purple, Red, Black, Rainbow.
A red-level title already counts as one of the strongest.
It is clear that the classification of a title's level is not based on the effects of the title but based on the rarity of how one obtains it.
Besides these two titles,
there is also the title he bought from the little elk.
"Title Name": Assisting Lonely Elders
By now, he had nearly 11 titles:
"Fatal Strike," "Invincible Under the Heavens," "Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!," "Nemesis of the Insect Race," "Peerless Under the Sky," "Yay, We've Got a Car!" "Your cars are all super weak!" "Lucky Child of the God of Love," "Kuafu Chasing the Sun!" "Just this? Laughable!" "Assisting Lonely Elders"
Eleven titles, all stacked on top of his head, were indeed quite intimidating.
The height of a title was about 40 centimeters, so all 11 titles together were over 4 meters tall, taller than he was.
It is worth mentioning that,
the title always floated above him, meaning that even if he bent over to tie his shoelaces or did a handstand, the title would still be directly above him.
It wouldn't be that bending over made the title smack into someone's face,
or that doing a handstand would push the title into the ground.
Tuberculosis Rabbit now also had three titles above his head:
"Kuafu Chasing the Sun," "Just this? Laughable!" "Assisting Lonely Elders"
"What to say?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed with a somber expression, tightened his belt, and looked up at the titles towering 4 meters high above Yi's head: "We must never have enemies in the future."
"Otherwise, it's just too eye-catching, practically broadcasting our location in real time."
"All right then."
Chen Yi glanced around and had no intention of staying long: "Let's head home first."
"Okie-dokie."
...
One day later.
Chen Yi and the group made their leisurely way back to Yancheng, and it was already the 24th of May.
"It's getting dark already."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at the sky: "Finally, I can have a good sleep. The sleigh is great and all, but it's somewhat uncomfortable to sleep on."
"Speaking of which, next time we upgrade it, can we add another bed?"
Chen Yi didn't reply, instead, he parked the sleigh on the rooftop of their apartment building and looked at the Global Vehicle Leaderboard.
"Top Player": Chen Yi.
"Vehicle Name": Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh
"Vehicle Level": C-level.
"Vehicle Rating": 4630
Originally, his vehicle's basic score was only 1000, but after this haphazard modification, it had reached a rating of 4630, a full 3630 points higher.
He glanced at the elk sprawled on the rooftop not far away, panting aimlessly with a dazed look in its eyes, and his mouth twitched slightly without saying anything.
Can this still be called a Mechanical Elk?
Can the name of this vehicle be changed?
Afterward, he looked toward the 7th place on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard.
'Ranked 7th Player': Zhou Ziqiang.
'Vehicle Name': Bright Brand Pedal Bicycle
'Vehicle Level': E-class.
'Vehicle Rating': 782.
If he wasn't mistaken, didn't this bicycle have a Basic Score of only 10 points?
How have you modified a bicycle with a Basic Score of just 10 points into one with a rating of 782? What did you do to this bicycle?
He shook his head, didn't say anything more, and headed toward his own house.
In the last few days, he was indeed a bit tired.
Wash up, go to sleep.
Just as he had barely fallen asleep, he suddenly heard a voice by his ear,
"Ding, the global event 'Extraterrestrial Invader' has officially ended, beginning the reward settlement."
'The global Kill Points leaderboard begins the official settlement.'
'Ranked 1st: Zhou Ziqiang.'
'...'
'Ranked 7th: Chen Yi.'
'All players, please spend your Kill Points at the event marketplace within 24 hours. Failure to do so will be considered a voluntary forfeiture.'
"Seventh?"
Chen Yi looked at the global kill rankings in front of him with slight surprise; he remembered that this morning, he was ranked first.
With more than a million Kill Points, a comfortable lead in first place.
Unexpectedly, in just one day's time, he was knocked down the ranks.
Zhou Ziqiang's Kill Points reached more than 2 million, almost touching 3 million, more than double his total.
Can so many Insect Race monsters be killed in just one day?
Chen Yi shook his head and thought no more; probably it was some even more perverted prop. In this world now, a beggar you see one second could suddenly start a killing spree the next, and it wouldn't be surprising.
Opportunities are everywhere.
But let's think about all this tomorrow. Now it's time to sleep.
Tuberculosis Rabbit's sleep talking started as usual.
And Chen Yi, now somewhat accustomed to it, slowly closed his eyes, thankful that Tuberculosis Rabbit only talked in his sleep and didn't sleepwalk. Otherwise, with that charged strike he's been holding back for who knows how long.
If it got unwittingly unleashed by Tuberculosis Rabbit during sleepwalking.
Now that would be a big problem.
...
Shortly after Chen Yi fell asleep.
The young couple living above Chen Yi, upon seeing the title that had emerged from the floor and hadn't moved for a while, began to whisper to each other.
"Honey, the title isn't moving. He must be asleep," the woman said.
"Then... shall we continue?" the husband asked.
"Yeah, yeah. Look, there are a few more titles, and they're getting higher. I bet in a few days, they'll go through our floor and poke up to the upper story."
"Let's not worry about that for now," the husband said.
The man, somewhat urgently, removed his socks and tossed them aside: "Let's take care of some important business first."
"Be gentle."
Ten minutes later.
The man suddenly stiffened, took a deep breath, and just as he was about to collapse into sleep, he noticed the title behind him staring at him.
'Is that all? Laughable!'
The bright title seemed to mock him openly.
The man's face immediately darkened, and after a moment's gritting of his teeth, he climbed out of bed once more.
"Again!"

chapters.title: Chapter 49 "Does your coffee shop only have freshly ground coffee?
chapters.content:
A night quickly passed by.
Chen Yi yawned and climbed out of bed, casually finished his ablutions, and then leaned on the windowsill with a cigarette in his mouth, looking down at the scene outside.
Today was already May 25th.
Time flew by.
In a few more days, it would be two full months since this game had arrived.
There was some good news worth celebrating.
In a few days, the rule that required everyone to speak 1,000 sentences a day would be going offline.
There was also bad news.
The removal of the rule wouldn't affect the Tuberculosis Rabbit's verbosity.
From this angle, the rickshaw business on the streets didn't seem very good.
After all, not many people were willing to spend their preciously acquired Points to enjoy such a service; most would rather tire out their own legs.
On the other hand, the vegetable shops seemed to be doing well, since everyone still needed to eat.
So far, all the Points in everyone's hands were essentially obtained from the government.
Like cleaners, construction workers outside the city, law enforcement officers, factory workers, and so on.
Many positions could acquire Points from the government.
"Hey, Yi."
At the same time, the Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had also finished washing up, took a spiced carrot out of his pocket, crunched into it, and looked up at the residents below.
"Where does the government get so many Points to distribute to these people?"
"The sources for obtaining Points are basically those few, right?"
"Complete daily missions, then there's killing monsters and exchanging Kill Points for Points, aside from that, are there any other sources for getting Points?"
"Even if the government killed a massive number of Insect Race monsters and exchanged them for a large number of Points, that still wouldn't be enough for a few days' distribution, right?"
"I've heard that the factories outside the city that specialize in producing crossbow arrows and other iron tools have started to recruit on a large scale, cranking up production. The amount of Points distributed in a single day isn't small."
"If you ask me,"
"The current phenomenon of using Points as a circulating currency must still be something the government is pushing behind the scenes, right? After all, if the government were to forcefully decree that cash must be used as the circulating currency, there should at least be a grace period."
"Given the current situation, the government must be tight on Points too, since they're not something that can just be printed off by machines on a whim."
"I have no clue."
Chen Yi furrowed his brow and pondered for a moment before shaking his head, "Perhaps the nation has some source of Points that we don't know about, and there might be some deep meaning behind their push to quickly popularize Points as a circulating currency."
"There's no need to think about it; it's beyond our understanding."
"After all..."
He suddenly thought of something, looking thoughtfully at the badge in his hand. It was a pass that had come out of Tie Chui's treasure chest, officially named the Wilderness Access Badge.
It could be used to go to the wilderness three times.
The item's effect stated that when the "Wilderness" map was opened, players who held this item could enter the Wilderness without hindrance.
But so far, he had no idea where this "Wilderness" map was.
No hints whatsoever.
There was also no information about it on the personal panel map.
Perhaps... the government's reserve of Points came from a certain map, something like the existence of a pass?
Otherwise, it was hard to explain where this continuous and large reserve of Points came from.
And why the government didn't keep these Points for themselves but instead used this form of employment, settling accounts with Points.
Chen Yi shook his head and decided not to think about these things anymore, as they were beyond his level of understanding. It was better not to ponder over them.
"Let's go, let's head downstairs to grab something to eat first."
...
"Hot coffee coming up!!"
Outside, the streets were still bustling, seemingly no different than any other day.
Although not many shops were open, there were still a few scattered businesses with their doors ajar.
And not far away, a café was energetically hawking its wares.
Unlike the typical exquisite décor inside most cafés, this one was clearly more rudimentary, with just a table set up at the entrance and nothing but a price list on top of it.
"Freshly ground coffee coming up, only 10,000 Yuan a cup!!!"
The man's hawking was loud, and there was a long line of people at the door.
The reason was simple.
Because this was one of the few shops that still accepted cash—everyone knew that soon cash would be worthless. Even though the price was far beyond that of normal coffee, no one cared.
It wouldn't be long before this cash would be mere waste paper.
The kind that lies on the ground no one bothers to pick up.
"Eh?"
A flash of surprise crossed Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes, and he couldn't help but walk towards the café: "Paying with cash? That's pretty interesting."
Standing in front of the table, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked curiously at the price list, then at the man behind the table: "Do you only have freshly ground coffee?"
"No other varieties?"
"No."
The man looked up and glanced at the title above Chen Yi's head that resembled a telephone pole, his face breaking into a smile as he cheerfully said, "Real good coffee always comes with nothing added. Those toppings like milk foam are just for inferior coffees."
"Why not try our freshly ground coffee?"
"It's definitely tasty."
"And it's cash only, so why not buy a few cups to try? You won't lose out, right?"
"If you want, I can make a few cups for you right now."
"Rest assured, the taste will definitely not disappoint you."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stared expressionlessly at the café that didn't allow entry and the price list that only offered freshly ground coffee. For some reason, he suddenly felt an extreme sense of familiarity.
This sense of familiarity evoked a possible realization growing within him.
"Yi..."
"Hmm."
Chen Yi also looked at the man with a complex expression, tilting his head towards the crowd nearby who had just bought their coffee and were squatting to the side, slowly savoring their cups. He was momentarily at a loss for words.
"Such a swindler."
Taking a deep breath and with a serious look, Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the man and said word by word, "I have to tell them that the coffee they're drinking... is produced using your 'Skill for a Cup of Coffee.'"
The words were not yet finished.
Instantly, the man's face changed and he covered Tuberculosis Rabbit's mouth with his hand. He quickly called someone over to guard the spot and promptly ushered Tuberculosis Rabbit and his companion into the café. Standing behind the curtain, he spoke with a bitter expression.
"Fellows, let's do it this way, according to rules of the Mart."
"How about I give you two some hush money?"
"Name your price."
"No need."
Chen Yi shook his head, glanced around the shop at the twenty or thirty men standing motionless with cups in their hands, grinding coffee non-stop, and the corner of his mouth twitched slightly. After a moment, he regained his composure and spoke complexly.
"Just answer two questions."
"First, why are you collecting cash?"
"Second, where did you get so many of the same Skill?"
"The E-Level Skill, A Cup of Coffee, though of a lower grade, getting dozens of that Skill wouldn't be easy, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 50 "Did that title just... flash brightly?
chapters.content:
```
"This..."
The man in front of them stammered, glanced at the group of men queuing up to buy coffee outside the shop, and then raised his head to scan the string of titles piercing through the ceiling above Chen Yi's head, his voice trembling slightly with a crying tone.
"Look, brother, I really don't want to say it."
"But I'm scared you'll just kill me right on the spot, what should I do?"
"Especially with the current public order not being very good, and someone like you, brother, with titles bursting through the roof, I simply can't afford to offend."
"But... but I really don't want to say it."
"Tsk."
Tuberculosis Rabbit took out a watermelon-flavored carrot from his bosom with a look of resignation, stuffed it into his mouth, and regarded the man in front of him with some curiosity.
"Do you want to listen to what you're actually saying?"
"It's rare to see someone this honest."
"So."
Tuberculosis Rabbit beckoned with his hand, pulled out a Claw Knife from his chest, gestured with it a few times, then looked seriously at the man: "Have you made your choice?"
"Yes."
The man nodded solemnly, stepped aside, and pointed to a room not far away: "Right this way, please."
"Hmm."
Chen Yi nodded slightly, seemingly nonchalantly took out the Christmas Cane from his backpack, leaned on it, and eyed the room not too far off.
He could see through one layer of barrier.
There were no traps behind the wall.
Only then did he slightly relax and followed the man forward, taking out the cigarette prop that would give him invincible frames from his backpack and putting it in his mouth for safety's sake.
And had Tuberculosis Rabbit follow behind him.
It was indeed strange, not knowing how the cane's ability to see through one layer of barrier was determined.
Normally speaking, a wall wouldn't have just one layer of barrier.
But it was indeed judged as a single barrier.
...
Inside the room.
After pouring a glass of mineral water for both Chen Yi and himself, the man hesitated for a moment before opening his mouth: "Brother, you were asking why I only accept cash, right?"
"I could say, let's all make a fortune together."
"But we better not let too many people know, or else everyone's interests would be damaged, right?"
"You say."
Chen Yi leaned back in his chair, placed the cane across his lap, took the Mei Cai Kou Rou-flavored carrot Tuberculosis Rabbit handed him and began to crunch on it: "Tastes not bad."
"Right?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit triumphantly shook the feed box from Santa Claus in his bosom, laughing contentedly: "I can eat ten of these a day, and the flavors are quite unique."
"Phew!"
The man looked oddly at the two men in front of him; if it wasn't for the glaring titles above their heads that told him these were the two who had slaughtered the Insect Race monsters outside Yancheng, judging by their conversation, they really didn't seem like any sort of experts.
He took a deep breath, calmed himself, and then began to explain.
"Everything that happened these last two months, you both have seen."
"A game descended."
"The team behind it calls itself the Snow Sea Project Team, and it has disrupted the original order on Blue Star."
"Making many people start to use various methods to collect Points."
"Everything is looking more and more like a domestic web game, including titles, boss systems, skill systems, item systems, and so on."
"But... didn't you notice what key system a domestic web game typically has is missing?"
"The 'pay-to-win' system!"
At this point, the man couldn't help getting excited, flailing his arms around as he laid out his vision: "A web game without a 'pay-to-win' system is like the West without Jerusalem."
```
"So, I boldly predict!"
"The June version update will definitely introduce a microtransaction system!"
"Since there will be microtransactions, what will we use to recharge Points?"
"Gold? Jewels? Or cash?"
"My guess is gold and cash, one is a long-term currency, the other is a current short-term currency, and I'm intentionally collecting both, regardless of which it is."
"When the June version update arrives and the microtransaction system becomes available, I will be able to get a lot of Points from it!"
"Even... ascend to godhood through microtransactions!"
The man was clearly infected by the vision in his mind, his tone growing more and more excited as he stood up, "Now those companies that were once glorious are all collecting Points, treating cash as worthless!"
"But they don't know!"
"This cash, once the microtransaction system arrives, will become an invaluable weapon!!!"
"..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been sitting off to the side with legs crossed enjoying the scene, was momentarily lost after hearing this. After forcefully swallowing the last bite of carrot, he shakily lit a cigarette and put it in his mouth.
He exhaled a long puff of smoke.
As he slowly sank into thought amidst the pale blue smoke, after a moment, he suddenly slapped the table.
"Damn!"
"That makes sense!"
As soon as the words fell—
A blinding white light suddenly flashed from the "Kuafu Chasing the Sun" title above the Tuberculosis Rabbit's head, illuminating every dark corner of the room, far more effective than any shadowless lamp.
"What's this...?" Continue your journey with empire
The man who was caught off guard rubbed his slightly sore eyes and took a while to react; he then looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit and murmured towards the title above his head that had just flashed brightly.
"Did that title just... flash brightly?"
"Oh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, waved his hand nonchalantly, and said casually, "Seems like it."
"A title that doesn't flash is like a Civic that doesn't flash; it's not presentable."
"Forget it, that's not important."
"Yi, what do you think of this brother's speculation?"
"Feels like there's something to it."
"Let me think."
Chen Yi rested his chin in one hand and leaned back in his chair without speaking, but furrowed his brow and fell into deep thought.
This man's speculation... it seems not unfounded.
Microtransaction system...
A web game should indeed have a microtransaction system, and it's quite possible that it will appear in June's version update.
But he does not agree with the idea of using cash for microtransactions.
Cash, as long as you don't consider financial affairs, is something you can print at will with printing machines; how much could it possibly cost.
If it really were cash for microtransactions, then the leaderboard would overflow with max-level players by the next day.
But... if it's gold, then perhaps there's some possibility?
Some currency without much inflation and yet a common consensus?
It can't be BTC, can it?
Chen Yi's mouth twitched slightly without speaking; he could imagine that sight in the future. It might really be the Power of Faith brought by long-term holding, a relic of the old celebrations from the devoted disciples of BTC.
Then he exhaled lightly.
"I got it, second question, where did you get that E-grade Skill for making coffee?"
The speculation about microtransactions planted a seed in his heart.
But now wasn't the time to consider it.

chapters.title: Chapter 51 Welcome to the "Chanel Amusement Park"!
chapters.content:
"This,"
the man no longer hesitated but pulled out a card from his bosom and placed it on the table, "Here, this is it."
Since the biggest secret had already been spoken, there was nothing left to be secretive about.
Chen Yi looked at the somewhat familiar card on the table, raised his eyebrows slightly, took the card in his hands, and examined it closely.
It was a prop.
To be precise, it was a pass.
'Prop Name': Chanel Amusement Park Pass.
'Prop Level': D-grade.
'Prop Effect': When the "Chanel Amusement Park" map is unlocked, players holding this prop can enter Chanel Amusement Park unimpeded.
'Number of Uses': ∞.
'Prop Introduction': "It is said that in Chanel Amusement Park, every item you see has a hidden price tag."
"A Chanel Amusement Park Pass?"
Chen Yi slightly narrowed his eyes and played with the card in his hand without speaking. This item was somewhat familiar to him; he also had a Wasteland Pass, which he had so far been unable to use.
To be accurate, he did not know how to use it.
"Chanel?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit curiously leaned over and looked, "This is now touching on infringement, what a pity, if only it were Disney Amusement Park."
"I believe the next day Disney's legal department would bankrupt and reorganize this so-called Snow Sea Project Team."
"I do not know why it is named this way either."
The man shook his head, equally puzzled, "Because there is nothing in that amusement park that bears any Chanel logo element."
"You're saying—"
Chen Yi paused for a moment, put the card on the table, and looked up at the man, speaking softly, "You've already entered this amusement park with the pass?"
"How did you unlock the 'Chanel Amusement Park' map?"
"Well, it's a long story."
The man nodded, telling the whole story, "I got this pass from a limited-time gift pack at 520, completely unusable at first, not good for anything."
"But the day before yesterday, suddenly there was a system notice."
"It notified me that 'Chanel Amusement Park' had been unlocked by a player, saying I could enter with the pass."
"Then I chose to go in."
"Next thing, a glowing circle appeared before me, I stepped through it, and there was Chanel Amusement Park."
"There are a total of six amusement attractions."
"This E-grade 'Have a Coffee' skill of mine was acquired from one of the attractions, the 'Spinning Coffee Chairs,' which really was just a carousel, but with the horses replaced by round coffee chairs enclosed in a ring."
Your next on empire
"As for the other five attractions... I dare not touch them."
"Hmm,"
Chen Yi pondered for a moment, then lifted his head to look at the man before him, and placed the Christmas Cane on the table, "Take me to see it?"
"This..."
The man obviously hesitated.
"I won't use you for nothing; I will pay you in Points as compensation."
"No need for that, no need,"
the man's head shook like a rattle-drum, "What I mean is, if you, big brother, can take down the other five attractions, could you share a bit of the loot with me?"
In fact, he had been looking for strong players for the past few days to help him through those five amusement attractions.
But he had not found any suitable candidates.
And he couldn't make too much noise about such a matter.
The man before him was definitely the best choice, with the title that had pierced through the café ceiling giving off an immense sense of security. Even though the share of the gains would be less, it was still better than just looking and not being able to touch.
A bird in the forest is not as good as one in hand, he understood this principle.
If he could have ten birds, that would be even better...
"Of course,"
Chen Yi slowly stood up, leaning on the cane with both hands. As he stood, the title above his head jumped up a notch, jabbing into the ceiling, and he looked at the man in front of him, smiling calmly.
"It seems we've now come to quite a decent cooperative intention."
"How should I address you?"
"My name is Li Tianchou, but you can call me Little Chou."
"Little Chou?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged its shoulders, casually flicked the spent cigarette butt onto the floor and stepped on it to snuff it out before saying, "It's rare to see 'Chou' in someone's name."
"Uh... it's fine, I guess."
"Can we go to the amusement park now?"
"Yes."
"Then let's go in now."
"Alright."
...
A few minutes later.
Li Tianchou, holding a Chanel Amusement Park pass, activated the prop, and a three-meter wide rotating white circle of light slowly appeared in front of him, "Uh, guys, do I go in first?"
"Sure."
"Alright."
Just as Li Tianchou was about to step forward, he paused again, turned around, and looked up at the towering title above Chen Yi's head with some hesitation, "Big bro, can you get in?"
"It won't get stuck, will it?"
"No, it's non-physical."
"Then I'm going in first."
Li Tianchou breathed a sigh of relief, didn't say much, and confidently stepped into the white circle.
"Can't see through it?"
After the man went in, Chen Yi looked at the white circle in front of him with slight disappointment, his Christmas Cane's ability apparently couldn't see through this white light circle.
What a pity.
He had thought that not being able to see through a treasure chest was bad enough, but he couldn't even see through a white circle.
So much for its reputation!
"Let's go in."
Chen Yi reached out to stop Tuberculosis Rabbit from continuing to grab carrots from the feed box, sighing with a touch of helplessness, "Eat less, will you? If you eat them all, what will the elk eat?"
"I've prepared fresh carrots for it. They're much cleaner than these technologically augmented carrots from the feed box."
"What if it only likes carrots with a flavor?"
"Hey, no worries, I'll get some coffee-flavored carrots for it. It has probably never had those before."
"... Just come in with me first."
"Okay, boss."
...
After stepping through the white circle.
Chen Yi first felt a sudden sensation of weightlessness beneath his feet, which disappeared in a flash, and then he found himself standing firmly on the ground.
They appeared in front of the gates of an amusement park.
The surroundings were a void, empty, like a white black hole, with only an audaciously colored amusement park in front of them.
The place was entirely pink.
The walls, the gates, the façade of the ticket booth, the protective barriers outside the rides—all were painted in a bright pink.
The stone steps on the ground were black.
The overhead roller coaster was red and green.
Not far away, the Spinning Coffee Chairs were brown.
It looked... oddly eye-catching.
The whole scene seemed like someone took a picture of an amusement park, cut it out, and placed it on a white canvas, then started to smear it with bold colors.
Completely ignoring the client's feedback.
It's almost like a masterpiece penned by someone on the brink of a meltdown, about to resign and lash out in fury, as if insisting the first draft would be the final one anyway.
And moreover—
This amusement park didn't seem to host just the three of them.
There were quite a few players, who were already turning their heads to look at them.

chapters.title: Chapter 52 "It's a bit of a fluke, but so far I haven't gotten one wrong.
chapters.content:
```
Inside the amusement park, there were roughly twenty to thirty people standing around. At this moment, these players were all standing in place, looking bewilderedly towards Chen Yi and his two companions who had suddenly appeared.
As well as the string of titles above Chen Yi's head.
Where did this big shot come from?
Chen Yi did not speak; he simply stood there leaning on his cane, quietly observing this amusement park, the scene before him giving him a faintly unreal feeling.
Is this still Blue Star?
Is this still the Blue Star Federation?
This must be a space that's been specially sectioned off.
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi suddenly arched his eyebrows and looked up above the amusement park, where he saw a giant lollipop rotating slowly at the center.
On the lollipop was a Little Sprite flapping its tiny wings, continuously licking the lollipop, which by now was half gone.
"I saw him as soon as I came in,"
Li Tianchou, walking ahead, followed Chen Yi's gaze towards the giant lollipop and explained, "But when I first came in, that lollipop was still whole."
"It's only been 2 days, and he has licked away half of it."
"As for what will happen after it's completely licked, no one knows, but my plan is to leave this amusement park before the Little Sprite finishes licking."
"It's better to be safe."
"Bro, over here, that's the Spinning Coffee Chairs I told you about."
"Hmm."
Chen Yi nodded slightly and shifted his gaze away from the Little Sprite, which had the words "Little Sprite" floating above its head—
as if it were afraid people wouldn't know its name.
Li Tianchou then strode into the amusement park and headed straight for the Spinning Coffee Chairs, which were currently unoccupied by any players.
Seeing Chen Yi approaching, the surrounding players also moved aside with complex expressions, quietly staring at Chen Yi and refraining from any superfluous actions.
When entering the amusement park,
Chen Yi had specifically taken note of the ticket hall; it was empty.
"Bro, look, here's the introduction to the attraction,"
Li Tianchou stood in front of the Spinning Coffee Chairs, pointing to the screen in the air that was filled with densely packed small words.
'Attraction Name': Spinning Coffee Chairs.
'Attraction Description': Once the Spinning Coffee Chairs come to a stop, you can sit on them and proceed gently forward to soft music, enjoying your own afternoon tea break.
'Game Rules':
1. The attraction starts every 30 minutes and lasts for 5 minutes.
2. Within 5 minutes, players must quickly answer 30 math puzzles; answering all correctly will allow them to take away a prize, while each incorrect answer will deduct '1 point of Amusement Park Points'.
3. When a player has negative Amusement Park Points, they cannot leave the amusement park.
'Attraction Output': For each ride on the Spinning Coffee Chairs, you will receive one 'Specific Skill Fragment'.
"This is it."
"This Specific Skill Fragment is the E-level skill 'A Cup of Coffee.' I rode the Spinning Coffee Chairs many times to farm this many 'A Cup of Coffee' skills."
"Farming math puzzles?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a cheese-flavored carrot from his bosom and tossed it into his mouth, chewing vigorously with a slightly unpleasant expression: "Isn't this a bit too targeted at me?"
"You get all 30 math puzzles right every time?"
"Cough."
Li Tianchou placed a fist against his mouth to cough lightly, his voice betraying a hint of pride: "To be honest, it's a bit of luck, as I haven't gotten a single one wrong so far."
"Actually, the math puzzles here are relatively simple."
```
"It's just a combination of four-digit or less addition and subtraction, without even involving multiplication or division."
"Generally speaking, it's quite hard to make a mistake."
"Oh."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, then turned to the other players who were watching the excitement, "What about you guys? The Spinning Coffee Chairs are currently at a standstill, about to start up. Don't you want to give it a try?"
As the words fell.
The dozens of players standing by watching the spectacle exchanged glances and simultaneously took a step back, clearly not many were willing to get on.
Only a tall man who didn't step back in time was left standing there. He glanced at his sides and was forced to meet the Tuberculosis Rabbit's gaze, somewhat embarrassed he stiffly began to speak.
"Well, big brother, my math has been bad since I was a kid. This kind of thing is no different from a decisive battle to me."
"Besides, if you win the reward is average, but if you lose you have to deduct Amusement Park Points."
"It really seems like a losing proposition."
"Let this brother have a go, I heard he runs a coffee shop, he needs this gadget."
Just then—
'Beep beep beep,' the alarm signaling the imminent start of the Spinning Coffee Chairs sounded, and Li Tianchou, who had become interested, rolled up his sleeves and found a chair to sit on.
After taking a deep breath, he turned to Chen Yi and company, "I'll demonstrate for you."
The next second.
The Spinning Coffee Chairs began to move slowly.
And that holographic screen that originally displayed the game's introduction went dark, then when it lit up again there was a math problem on it.
'129+239=?'
'10,9,8...'
A familiar problem that wasn't very difficult.
It was just an addition and subtraction within three digits, equivalent to a primary school level question.
You needed to provide a precise answer within ten seconds, or one Amusement Park Point would be deducted. All players start with zero Amusement Park Points.
"368!"
Li Tianchou's confident voice came from the chair!
And at that moment, there were still four seconds left in the ten-second countdown.
'328-123=?'
'10,9,8...'
"205!"
Perhaps due to the many eyes on him, Li Tianchou's voice on the rotating chair grew louder, faintly filled with unmistakable pride.
"This problem doesn't seem that hard either, it's just a primary school question, right?"
"Well..."
The tall man standing not too far away touched his nose with some embarrassment, "This question might be just right for primary school students, but for people like us, it's seriously out of our league."
Continue reading at empire
"Usually, I'm one of those people who need to use a calculator on my phone for any math over 10, whether it's addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division."
"What if you tried answering with AI, or use a calculator? Would that be considered cheating?"
"That wouldn't count as cheating."
The man shook his head, "But there's a chance of error whether you use AI or a calculator. Once you make one mistake, it means deducting one Amusement Park Point."
"Although ten seconds is more than enough time to solve the problem with a calculator, and you'd still have time to spare, it's impossible for anyone to maintain such a high level of concentration for a long period without making mistakes."
"The risks outweigh the benefits, primarily because the reward just isn't worth much."
Just then—
An ear-piercing voice suddenly rang in their ears.
"Incorrect answer!"

chapters.title: Chapter 53 "Sweet Talker!!!
chapters.content:
This voice attracted everyone's attention.
"It's over now,"
the tall man who had just spoken looked at Li Tianchou, still seated in his coffee chair, with eyes full of pity.
Li Tianchou, sitting in the coffee chair, turned visibly pale, but he quickly adjusted his mentality. He didn't make any more mistakes, although his complexion remained ghastly and his voice lacked the pride it had before.
Soon, five minutes passed.
One error.
No rewards, one Amusement Park Point deducted.
When a player's Amusement Park Points fall below zero, they cannot leave the amusement park.
And judging by Li Tianchou's expression, if things were as expected, his Amusement Park Points had always been the initial 0 points, and now, with one point deducted, they had become -1.
"Is it difficult to obtain Amusement Park Points?"
When Tuberculosis Rabbit finished speaking,
everyone's gaze simultaneously turned towards a black house not far away, their eyes revealing a hint of fear and dread.
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow, leaning on his Christmas Cane, and walked straight towards the black house.
The light screen in front of the black house clearly stated the gameplay.
'Game Name': Haunted House.
'Game Description': Seeking thrills in the Haunted House is as exhilarating as searching for a plank in the waves.
'Game Rules': All entities within the Haunted House cannot harm players. It's a one-minute journey. Players who walk from start to finish will successfully clear the game.
'Game Rewards': After clearing, players will be awarded 3 points.
Quite simple.
But Chen Yi knew why these players were somewhat fearful of this haunted game. If it were any other time, the worst that could happen would be a scare, but now was different.
Under the high-pressure rules of May, entering the Haunted House and getting scared a few times would most likely mean you never make it out.
You would just lie there inside.
At this moment, Li Tianchou also approached with a slightly pale face and an air of tragic resolution, clearly ready to enter the Haunted House, and the surrounding players tactfully cleared the way for him.
Preparing to send off this brave soul on his final journey.
To earn points in this amusement park, there was only one option.
Enter the Haunted House.
If you succeed, you get 3 points.
As for whether you can come out alive, no one knows.
"Brother,"
Li Tianchou's voice trembled slightly with a hint of a cry, "I'll go in first, let's meet again if fate allows it."
At that moment, his heart was full of regret. Earlier, he was just showing off unnecessarily.
He became distracted for a moment and made an error in his calculation.
Leading to his current predicament of having to enter the Haunted House.
He had never made a mistake in so many attempts; who would have thought he would slip up this time?
"Don't rush,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit frowned and shook his head: "What if you just closed your eyes and covered your ears?"
"If you can't see or hear, there wouldn't be any impact, right?"
"Actually, it's not very useful,"
Li Tianchou took out a pair of noise-canceling headphones from his pocket, put them on, his complexion becoming less flushed, and his voice began to tremble uncontrollably: "But you could say it has a minimal effect."
"It's mainly a psychological suggestion."
"Once your mind is anchored with fear, even if nothing is there, just a tap on the back can send a shiver down your spine."
"I'll try my best."
"I've never been in before. These past few days, I've seen quite a few players go in, but only about three or four out of ten make it out alive."
"No need for that trouble,"
Chen Yi glanced around, took out his Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh from his bag, and placed it on the ground.
The elk was stuffed into the backpack with him.
Logically, a living thing like an elk shouldn't be able to fit into a backpack, but for some reason, the backpack seemed to have judged it as part of the vehicle.
It usually sleeps in the backpack when there is nothing else to do.
And it seemed to be sleeping rather soundly.
Now called out, drool was still hanging from the corner of its mouth, and it stood there with a lost look in its eyes, scanning the surroundings, clearly not yet aware of what was going on.
"Get in."
Chen Yi tilted his head and sneered toward Li Tianchou, "It's not like they said we can't drive. Just drive straight through it. After all, you are the one who brought us here."
"It would be difficult for us if you were to die here because of these matters."
"I'll give you a ride."
"Close your eyes, don't worry about anything else. Isn't this haunted house straight? It's just a few hundred meters, we'll get through it in a few seconds."
"This?"
Li Tianchou was stunned for a moment, then a glimmer of hope flashed in his eyes, and with an excited and trembling tone, he hastened, "Then I'll trouble you, brother. Whether it works out or not, I'll owe you one for this favor."
As his words fell,
Li Tianchou quickly put noise-cancelling headphones on himself, then took a sleeping bag out of his backpack and got inside of it.
Hopping and bouncing, he hopped into Chen Yi's sleigh.
Then he pulled out an incense stick from his chest, threw it deep into the sleeping bag, and sealed the opening. Soon after, deafening snoring sounds came from within the sleeping bag.
"Huh?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked toward Li Tianchou's smooth actions with some surprise; ordinary items usually couldn't be placed into a game backpack. This meant the sleeping bag, the noise-cancelling headphones, and even that incense stick must all be game props.
And they seemed to come with not so small effects.
He always loved collecting these small miscellaneous props.
Never did he expect to meet a kindred spirit today.
"That was pretty smooth."
Chen Yi nodded appreciatively, then sat in the sleigh, turned the vehicle around, aimed it at the nearby haunted house, took a deep breath, and pressed the accelerator to the floor, charging straight towards it!
"Boom!!!"
No fewer than fifteen red tail flames exploded from the back of the sleigh!
The next second—
The somewhat odd-looking sleigh burst forth with a speed invisible to the naked eye, charging directly toward the gates of the haunted house!
It was almost the blink of an eye.
Tuberculosis Rabbit hadn't even had a chance to see what was inside the haunted house when he felt the world go dark for a moment before finding himself outside it again.
And a voice in his ear announced the successful completion of the haunted house challenge, rewarding 3 Amusement Park Points.
However,
The accelerator might have been pushed too hard.
Chen Yi looked up at the huge lollipop that was slowly falling over after being whacked hard by the elk's head, and then back down at the elk's head that didn't show any sign of damage, and he couldn't help but say,
"It's really impact-resistant."
The next second—
The Little Sprite, which had been licking the lollipop, watched the lollipop slowly fall and its clear eyes gradually replaced by a bloodthirsty gleam.
「Ding, the Little Sprite has turned into the Great Demon due to the destruction of its lollipop.」
「Note: The Great Demon's mode of attack is to play idiom word-chain.」
「There are a total of 30 rounds.」 Discover stories with empire
「If you don't respond within ten seconds, you die according to the rules.」
「If you complete all 30 rounds, the Great Demon will return to clarity and revert back to the Little Sprite, and you will receive a special reward.」
The voice in the ear had barely finished,
Chen Yi heard the Great Demon, now fully transformed and hovering over the amusement park, bellow in anger,
"Sugared tongue, honeyed mouth!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 54 "Tuberculosis Rabbit, didn't you say you've never been to school?
chapters.content:
"What the heck is this?"
Chen Yi, who had already turned the sleigh around and was ready to crack the whip on the reindeer, was stunned for a moment, somewhat failing to react right away. The boss's attack method turns out to be a game of Chinese idiom solitaire?
Isn't that a bit too childish?
Since when does a boss attack by playing idiom solitaire?
Shouldn't becoming a boss mean being a bit more bloody and brutal?
Read exclusive adventures at empire
But the countdown in the void had not stopped; it had already begun counting down.
'10, 9, 8...'
Chen Yi had no time to think further, and without any hesitation, he blurted out.
"A glib tongue!"
Playing idiom solitaire with an idiom that starts with "mouth" was relatively easy, but now it should be the boss's turn to respond. What idioms start with "river"?
As he was pondering this.
He suddenly realized the boss's bloodthirsty eyes had shifted direction and were staring straight at Tuberculosis Rabbit beside him, and the countdown had begun anew.
And the idiom displayed in the midair screen had changed as well.
'A glib tongue!'
This...?
This damn thing turns out to be a boss with an area-of-effect attack?
A slight twitch emerged at the corner of Chen Yi's mouth; he felt like he had figured out the boss's attack method. This boss actually had an area-of-effect attack, which meant every round required each person to take a turn?
There are only so many common idioms, and there were dozens of people here. If dozens of people each took turns, after 30 rounds, they would probably all be wiped out.
Not one would survive.
Just as he was about to speak and remind Tuberculosis Rabbit of some idioms that start with "river," he saw Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly stand up, raise his right hand, and roar,
"The river runs to the sea and dries up!"
"Huh?"
Chen Yi was slightly stunned, then asked reflexively, "Tuberculosis Rabbit, didn't you never go to school?"
"Oh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit touched his nose, looking slightly embarrassed as he said, "Funny story, one website I used required a CAPTCHA that involved arranging jumbled idioms into correct ones."
"I had to log in more than a dozen times daily."
"Gradually I got to know quite a few idioms. Don't worry, Yi, leave the rest to me. I'll take care of him."
"But why did you raise your hand?"
"Cough, I don't know why I did that. Anyway, Yi, stop fretting about that and go check on the kid in the sleeping bag. He seems unable to wake up!"
At that moment—
The boss's eyes began shifting targets, staring intently at Li Tianchou lying in the sleeping bag, and the countdown commenced.
'The river runs to the sea and dries up!'
'10, 9, 8...'
Li Tianchou inside the sleeping bag was oblivious to what was happening outside. To get through the Haunted House, he had used a magic item for sleeping and was now snoring thunderously inside the bag.
Unaware that his life was entering a ten-second countdown.
"It looks like... he's beyond saving."
Tuberculosis Rabbit said with a somewhat sentimental expression of regret, "There's nothing that can be done. We can't answer for him; he's sleeping too soundly, and can't be woken up."
"Everyone has their destiny, and his is not good."
By this time, the countdown had already reached 5.
The players standing not far from the Haunted House were also casting their gaze with slightly pale faces at the giant white sleeping bag on the sleigh.
Everyone knew Li Tianchou was doomed.
But what they were more concerned about was whether the boss was only attacking the three who had collided with the lollipop, or whether they were also included in the area of effect.
Each person took a turn, for a total of 30 rounds.
"..."
