The tall man at the front of the crowd, his complexion ugly, his voice wavering with a hint of a sob, said, "I can accept any form of death, but I can't accept dying because of a lack of knowledge!"
"This cause of death is too humiliating!"
"How will I face my ancestors after I go down!"
"I've passed the age where I stood in the classroom hallway, hands in pockets, head tilted back, having memorized the Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng first thing in the morning!"
"When it's your turn, try not to use idioms with an overly obscure last character. Leave some room for survival for both parties."
The people around exchanged glances. Although there was still some fear and panic in their eyes, they reached a basic consensus, which was to try not to use idioms with an overly obscure last character.
And then, when the countdown had come to the last 2 seconds.
"That's it? I'm laughing!"
Chen Yi roared, and a shadow of a faceless man suddenly rose up behind him.
The shadow, roughly five meters tall, stood in the air behind Chen Yi's head, one hand on his hip, the other pointing at the bloodthirsty demon in the sky, began furiously insulting it with his head tilted back.
"Your mother... stupid dog..."
"Mom... Dad..."
The countdown that was originally hanging in the sky with only 1 second suddenly stopped, accompanied by the boss' head slowly turning to look at Chen Yi, with a hint of cruelty and anger in its bloodthirsty eyes.
The brutal voice rang out again in the sky above the amusement park!
"The river dries up and the sea withers!"
"10, 9, 8..."
It worked!
Chen Yi breathed a sigh of relief in his heart. His Title Effect "That's it? I'm laughing!" allowed him to summon a mouthpiece to insult the boss, and forcibly taunt the boss.
He was initially uncertain if this taunting effect would work on a boss whose attack method was a game of word chain with idioms.
Unexpectedly, it was actually effective.
In that case, Li Tianchou in the sleeping bag also managed to avoid disaster in his sleep.
"Clouds cover the sun!"
As he finished speaking, a burst of white light also suddenly flashed above Chen Yi's head, illuminating the area around him brightly.
The lighting effect of this title wasn't too bad, actually.
"That..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit frowned and looked up at the shadow behind Chen Yi: "Yi, isn't your mouthpiece a bit too filthy with its insults?"
"Shouldn't it be more skillful, like beating around the bush, using allusions, or being satirical or something?"
"This thing is outright insulting, as if it's going to desecrate someone's entire lineage."
"Day ends, path exhausted!"
Indeed, the boss didn't target Tuberculosis Rabbit or Li Tianchou again, but once more turned its gaze to him!
This Title Effect is really strong!
After Chen Yi breathed a sigh of relief, he thought for a while before speaking again.
"Militarism!"
The idiom chain went round after round.
With the help of Tuberculosis Rabbit, Chen Yi narrowly made it through over twenty rounds, and when it came to vocabulary of idioms, Tuberculosis Rabbit was even slightly better than him.
After all, he did not frequent little websites that required jumbled idioms as CAPTCHA codes.
But it seemed like the boss's vocabulary in idioms was very substantial, as it didn't get stuck at all.
Soon—
An idiom emerged once again on the screen in the sky.
"Consistent!"
This time, Chen Yi didn't hesitate for a moment and blurted out."One counts as two!"
"One counts as two" is a black hole in idioms.
There are no idioms that can follow "one counts as two".

chapters.title: Chapter 55 "It's not clean, but eating it won't make you sick. Maybe you should try persuading her?
chapters.content:
However, the next second—
"Ding, 'one top two' isn't a proverb, please player Chen Yi replace the option!"
"Damn."
Chen Yi shook his head with some regret before continuing, "Take the lead!"
Not long after.
The thirty rounds of proverbs were successfully completed.
And once again, a prompt sounded beside Chen Yi's ear.
"Ding, the Great Demon has now regained clarity and returned to being a Little Sprite, players Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit will receive a special reward."
And the demon floating above the entire amusement park began to shrink rapidly until it turned back into a little sprite, sitting atop the broken lollipop.
Read latest stories on empire
About halfway the height of a person.
Curling up its legs, burying its head in its arms, its transparent wings wrapped around itself, softly sobbing.
The whole scene seemed especially sad.
It's starkly different from the bloodthirsty and frenzied Great Demon that had been hovering above the amusement park just moments before, impossible to associate the two together.
And at this moment.
The verbal shadow behind Chen Yi, still unabated, continued to wave a single hand at the waist and loudly scold the Little Sprite squatting on the lollipop, with an excited expression.
"You... little... dog..."
"..."
Chen Yi turned and glanced at the verbal shadow behind him, feeling somewhat speechless. That cursing was too dirty; he was almost unable to keep listening.
This thing could persist for a full thirty minutes.
But thankfully, it could be turned off voluntarily.
Just as he chose to turn off this Title Effect,
The verbal shadow seemed reluctant to leave, wiping its mouth before slowly fading away.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, witnessing the slow disappearance of the verbal shadow, couldn't help but speak up with emotion after it dispersed, "I originally thought that his forced taunt attack was some kind of game judgement, belonging to the rules."
"Now it seems, it's completely on a physical level of mockery."
"It's entirely through physical ridicules to taunt the enemy."
"It reminds me of the time when I played games before, and I typed to tell the Dragon Turtle support to taunt the opposing ad, and the guy opened the public chat channel and went on a tirade for thirty minutes."
"In the last team fight, the five enemies didn't care about anything but to kill the Dragon Turtle. The next day, the public chat feature was removed."
After the boss regained clarity.
The players watching from a distance all let out a sigh of relief at the same time. Their hearts had been in their throats just a moment ago, with each proverb the boss said, they all silently pondered in their hearts, seeing if they could follow up.
The conclusion they reached was... certain death.
Fortunately, the brother with a dozen titles on his head stood until the end.
If that brother had fallen, they would have been implicated, and they were not confident that they could withstand that many rounds of proverb chains.
As expected of a man who could acquire so many titles, even his vocabulary of proverbs was so abundant!
The eyes of many looking at Chen Yi held a hint of gratitude. From a certain perspective, Chen Yi had also saved their lives.
...
"Uh..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit fumbled in his trouser pocket and pulled out a cigarette, gripping it between his fingers and hesitantly pointing towards the Little Sprite squatting on the lollipop not far away.
"What should we do about this?"
Ever since the Little Sprite regained clarity, it had no aggression, squatting on the lollipop and sobbing quietly. The crying wasn't loud but was enough for the two of them to hear.
It was truly moving, making it hard to control the softness in their hearts.
Chen Yi looked down at the giant lollipop lying on the ground, hesitating with some uncertainty, "The lollipop isn't shattered either, it's just fallen on the ground, covered in a bit of dust."
"As the saying goes,"
"What's not clean won't make you ill if you eat it, so why don't you try and console her?"
"Me?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit's face immediately dropped, his voice carrying a whine, "I've done all sorts of things in my life, but this is truly my first time trying to console a child."
"I really don't know how."
"Give it a try."
"Well... okay then."
Tuberculosis Rabbit hesitated for a while, fumbled in his arms, took out a honey peach-flavored carrot, and walked towards the Little Sprite not far away with large strides.
As Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out that carrot,
the moose that had been lying on the ground suddenly flashed a look of awakened terror in its eyes, jumped up, and buried its head directly into the sleigh.
Chen Yi, who noticed this scene, nodded thoughtfully without speaking.
...
"Hey."
Holding the carrot in his hand, Tuberculosis Rabbit squatted in front of the Little Sprite and tentatively spoke, "Stop crying, okay? We apologize. Uncle has a tastier carrot here for you."
"Do you want to eat it?"
"It's definitely a flavor you've never tried before!"
The sobs of the Little Sprite suddenly stopped, and a small gap appeared between the translucent wings that enveloped her; a small, cute head gently lifted to look at the carrot in Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand.
She sniffed lightly, and a clear longing to taste it welled up in her eyes.
Then she looked up with begging, watery eyes at Tuberculosis Rabbit, her face saying, "I want it."
"Uh..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit was a bit caught off guard, but still quickly handed over the carrot, "Here, try the flavor. It's unique in this world."
He couldn't help but be amazed afterward.
"Are all kids this easy to appease? I always thought kids were a handful."
"Had I known a carrot could solve everything, why did you have to turn hostile earlier, scaring the heck out of us? Speaking of which, you're so young, yet you know so many idioms, did your parents enroll you in a lot of extra classes or something?"
In almost just ten seconds,
the Little Sprite had finished munching on the carrot in her hands. She got up contentedly, patted her belly, and then took out a new lollipop from her embrace and stuffed it into her mouth.
However, this lollipop wasn't that big; it was just the size of a normal one.
She also took out a small card the size of a bank card from her embrace, handed it to Tuberculosis Rabbit seriously, patted her chest, and nodded emphatically with slightly puffed cheeks.
It was extremely earnest.
「Prop Name」: The Little Sprite's Singular Delight.
「Prop Level」: No Level.
「Prop Effect」: When you encounter a crisis, you can activate this card once, and the Little Sprite will transform into the Great Demon to help you attack the enemy in front of you.
「Prop Usage Count」: 1/1
「Prop Introduction」: "Collect three 'Little Sprite's Delight', and you can exchange for one 'Little Fairy's Mom's Delight'."
Right after that, before Tuberculosis Rabbit could say anything more, the Little Sprite in front of him turned into a shadowy figure and disappeared on the spot.
And all players heard another notification in their ears.
「Chanel Amusement Park will close in three hours. Please ensure you leave in time.」
"It's closing soon?"
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow and called out to the players watching not far away, "Anyone with negative points?"
A group of seven or eight players with previously pale faces filled with fear suddenly rose up with hope as they heard this and began shouting urgently.
"Me, me!!"
"Tuberculosis Rabbit, you go."
Chen Yi nonchalantly took a cigarette from his embrace, put it in his mouth, and said casually, "Knock them out and throw them into the sleigh, take them to earn some points."
"Those without negative points too, knock them out. Let them earn some points in other attractions, to claim some rewards."
"We can't finish all the rewards ourselves anyway, so let's let everyone get some. It'd be a waste to leave them here."
As these words fell—
All the players looked ecstatically at Chen Yi, full of gratitude as they unanimously roared.
"Bro, you rock!"
"Thank you, bro. If there's an afterlife, I'd be willing to be your ox and horse!"
"If we meet again outside, I'll definitely help wherever I can!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a wooden stick from his embrace, skillfully wrapped the head of the stick with a towel, slung it over his shoulder, and looked at the group of players still reveling with a gleam of gratification in his eyes, slowly beginning to grin sinisterly.
"Thank you all, my brothers."
"Line up properly, and you, the tallest guy, you go first!"

chapters.title: Chapter 56 "Special Limited Title x1, Naixue's Tea x1.
chapters.content:
"Bang, bang, bang!"
The increasingly skilled Tuberculosis Rabbit, with one swing of his club, knocked out all the players present and then stuffed them into the sled.
The sled had only 8 seats.
There was definitely not enough room to sit that many people, so they had to be stuffed in. A little on top, a bit in the front, and some more in the back, and almost dozens of people could be crammed into the sled.
Afterwards, the reindeer began to pull the sled on its own, aiming for seven ins and outs of the Haunted House.
Pretty intelligent.
At least much better than the original Mechanical Elk; sometimes, living things are indeed a bit more useful than non-living ones.
Meanwhile, Chen Yi stood in front of the Haunted House, checking the special reward he had just successfully secured from surviving the Great Demon's clutches.
"Ding, the Great Demon has regained clarity and returned to being a Little Sprite. Players Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit will receive a special reward."
"Special Limited Title x1, Naixue's Tea x1."
"Title Name": Idiom Solitaire King
"Title Level": Blue.
"Title Effect": When you speak idioms, your voice will become clear and sonorous.
"Title Source": Successfully cleared thirty rounds of Idiom Solitaire with the Great Demon.
"Hmm."
Chen Yi nodded silently, casually placing the title atop his head. The title wasn't very useful; just by looking at the effect, it was pretty much on the same level as the "Lightning Reflexes" title effect.
As for the Naixue's Tea, that was a bit strange.
"Prop Name": Naixue's Tea.
"Prop Level": E-grade.
"Prop Effect": You can taste 12 cups of fruit tea with different flavors. After using it 12 times, the prop will automatically destroy itself.
"Prop Introduction": "You know? Holding a cup of milk tea in your left hand and brandishing a long sword in your right hand while slaying monsters, that's really cool!"
"Hmm."
Also a somewhat useless item, it seems that the threat level of this boss isn't very high, so the rewards given out seem a little weak?
As Chen Yi pondered, he brought the straw of his cup of milk tea to his mouth.
"Hmm? Strawberry mulberry flavor, not bad, just a bit too much slush."
And just at that moment—
The endlessly spinning sled finally came to a stop.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, walking down from the sled, looked up at Chen Yi and was about to speak when he saw the milk tea in Yi's hand and felt a bit puzzled, instinctively glancing around.
"Does the delivery rider even reach here?"
"It's a system reward. Check your system notifications, you'll have one too."
"Really? I'll have a look."
A moment later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, also holding a cup of milk tea in his hands, contentedly squatted next to Yi, "Sour citrus flavor, I like it, but there's a bit too much slush."
At this time.
The players who had been knocked out on the sled also woke up one after another.
When they saw Chen Yi standing there drinking milk tea, and Tuberculosis Rabbit squatting next to Chen Yi drinking milk tea, they were all a bit puzzled, and for a moment, they couldn't look away, looking confused.
"These kids."
Tuberculosis Rabbit was somewhat speechlessly spitting out the orange seeds from his mouth to the side before looking up at those players on the sled still in a daze, saying with slight annoyance.
"What are you waiting for standing there? Waiting for me to come over and share it with you?"
"You've racked up so many points, go use them."
"What are you looking at?"
As the words ended.
The players who had just woken up on the sled also realized what was happening and hastily rushed into the other amusement activities to start earning rewards.
The rules for all amusement activities were basically the same as the Spinning Coffee Chairs.
As long as you successfully complete them, you will get a reward.
Failure, however, would result in points being deducted.
That is to say, points couldn't actually be directly exchanged for rewards but could be simply understood as something akin to a ticket.
They had looked over them.
There wasn't anything good.
But driven by the principle of "not wasting a free offer," Tuberculosis Rabbit still rushed over excitedly and started to claim rewards from each of the attractions.
It was a pity for Li Tianchou, who still lay in his sleeping bag, missing such a good opportunity to rack up rewards as he continued to sleep soundly.
...
Three hours later.
Chen Yi and his party left the amusement park before the countdown ended.
And as they were leaving,
those gamers who had received Chen Yi's kindness all looked towards him with gratitude on their faces, continuously thanking him while declaring that if they ever met again, as long as they could be of use, they would definitely lend a hand.
Chen Yi didn't mind, he just waved his hand and left.
After all, they came from all corners of the world to this amusement park. It was uncertain whether they would ever meet again, so he didn't have any expectations about being repaid or not.
But the rewards were there for the taking, and it would be a waste not to take them.
It wasn't much trouble, just a little effort.
As for Li Tianchou... he remained asleep, still in the sleeping bag. They left Li Tianchou in that coffee shop, explained the situation to his subordinates who were the baristas there, and then they departed.
When they stepped out of the coffee shop.
The sky had reached the afternoon.
The sun had begun its descent.
"Huuh."
Standing on the street, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked towards the crowd, pulled out a cigarette from his pocket, put it in his mouth, and with a contemplative look on his face, he smacked his lips at the somewhat hot air around him.
"The weather is getting hotter, huh."
"Yeah."
Chen Yi nodded. He, too, took a cigarette from his pocket and was about to put it in his mouth when suddenly he saw a black dot in the distance moving at a very fast speed from above the city, heading inward.
The progression was of a stop-and-go kind.
Looking closely,
the rapidly moving black dot was unmistakably a scantily clad little lass, and following her, also in a stop-and-go shooting fashion, was a brawny man well over two meters tall.
The two were like quantum entangled,
pulling and dragging each other from the outskirts at a very fast speed towards Yancheng.
If they weren't Tie Chui and that little lass, who else could they be?
So far,
he had only seen this duo deploy such a combo move.
Though without a vehicle,
they were better than a vehicle.
It could be said to be a higher level of flight than Sword Flight, Manned Flight!
Perhaps it was Chen Yi's 12 constantly shining titles above his head that were especially conspicuous in the crowd, creating a visual effect similar to that of navigation lights at an airport when seen from the high altitude.
The sibling pair, who were previously rushing toward the city's interior, turned their heads and dove straight towards Chen Yi.
"Snap!"
All he saw was a flash before his eyes.
The scantily clad little lass was tossed straight down in front of Chen Yi by Tie Chui from mid-air, just before hitting the ground.
Tie Chui's figure once again appeared out of thin air beneath the little girl's body.
He landed securely, at the same time catching the girl unharmed on his shoulder.
Quite a move... combo technique.
They really ought to be given spacesuits and tasked with the mission of exploring the outer edges of the universe.
Chen Yi internally made a sarcastic comment.
"Yi, there's trouble!"
The little lass sitting on Tie Chui's shoulder looked somewhat anxious as she stared at Chen Yi and waved her hands frantically, saying, "There's trouble outside the city!"

chapters.title: Chapter 57 "Come to think of it, there's no rule that says Blue Star can't have children, right?
chapters.content:
"..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit silently pinched out the cigarette in his hand and tossed it underfoot, pointing toward the nearby patrolling Law Enforcement Bureau: "If there's trouble, look for them."
"It's no use coming to us."
"No, that's not it!"
The little loli jumped down from Tie Chui's shoulders urgently and looked up at Chen Yi with a worried expression, "Have you ever cooked instant noodles?"
"Yeah."
"Then you must have fried sunny-side-up eggs, right? The ground outside the suburbs looks just like a cracked open sunny-side-up egg!"
It took Chen Yi a while to grasp the awkward metaphor before he couldn't help but twitch the corners of his mouth slightly.
"I think I understand. You're saying there's a patch of ground that's cracked open?"
"Yes, yes."
"Like a sunny-side-up egg?"
"Exactly."
"Got it."
Chen Yi dug out the sleigh from his backpack and threw it on the ground: "Come on, get in the car, let's go have a look together."
"This?"
The little loli hesitated while staring at the sleigh, "Isn't this the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh from the Global Vehicle Leaderboard?"
"Is this thing fast?"
"Let me take you instead."
"I'm a bit faster."
"No need, get on, just point the way."
"Alright then."
The sleigh ascended slowly with Chen Yi and everyone on board, floating above the city, and turned the vehicle's nose toward the hill that the little loli was pointing at.
The next second—
It was as if time had stopped!
The scenery around them swiftly became unreal and flew past them!
It only took a short dozen seconds or so.
The sleigh then floated above a large mountain.
"Is this the place?"
Chen Yi sat on the sleigh, sticking his head out to look down, only to see that the plain at the foot of the mountain indeed showed signs of cracking.
A crack about three meters wide and nearly several hundred meters long suddenly appeared on the plain.
And this crack was continuing to widen.
It appeared extremely eerie.
"This is the place."
The little loli's expression was clearly anxious as she worriedly said, "It wasn't this big when we left. At this rate, it feels like it won't be long before the land beneath our feet is split in two."
"Really?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat disagreeing, pulled out a chocolate-flavored carrot from his chest and crunched into it: "No matter how I look at it, this thing resembles giving birth."
"Come to think of it, nobody has ruled out that Blue Star can't give birth, right?"
"Maybe in the next second, a little Blue Star, covered in blood, will jump out of the crack."
"Bro…ther."
Different from the little loli's full-faced worry, Tie Chui was completely unconcerned about the crack below. He only took out a cigarette and offered it to Chen Yi after seeing Chen Yi had a moment to himself.
He stuttered with a smile on his face: "Cigarette, good cigarette."
"Thanks." Read latest chapters on empire
Chen Yi took the cigarette, held it in his hand, and met Tie Chui's gaze with a smile, nodding his head without saying anything superfluous.
And at that moment—
The crack on the ground suddenly spurted out a large amount of bloodwater, which was not very thick, looking more like blood mixed with a lot of pure water.
"Good grief."
Witnessing this scene, the Tuberculosis Rabbit nearly choked to death on the carrot in his mouth, coughing violently a few times before expressing his disbelief with utter shock.
"No way, did it really give birth?"
Following that, the crack suddenly widened horizontally again, and it only stopped when it had reached about 20 meters in width.
Then, under the watchful eyes of Chen Yi and the others.
A pyramid slowly rose from the ground, completely covering the entire crack and standing perfectly on the surface.
It was said to be a pyramid.
But it might be a bit different from the pyramids people are familiar with; this pyramid was about 200 meters long, 20 meters wide, and looked like a triangular prism-shaped hot dog.
It felt more like something that should be displayed in a showcase rather than on the ground.
"Let's go."
Chen Yi hesitated only slightly before making a decision, "Let's go down and have a look."
The sleigh gently landed on the ground.
It stopped right in front of the entrance of the pyramid.
Yes, as they descended, they discovered that this pyramid was not completely sealed and symmetrical; there was a rather tall stone door on one of its sides.
It looked like an entrance.
The entire pyramid was brown in color, made up of huge square stones piled upon one another; it appeared quite ancient under the setting sun.
The small amount of blood that had sprayed out from the crack before was now completely pressed under the pyramid, leaving no trace to be seen.
Chen Yi, standing at the entrance of the pyramid with one hand on his cane, scanned his surroundings.
There were no signs of change to be seen here.
This pyramid had perfectly merged with the ground, making it seem as if it had always been here since ancient times.
The entrance of the pyramid in front of them was about ten meters high, occupying about a quarter of the pyramid's total height.
Its width was around five meters.
It was large enough to allow a hundred-ton vehicle to pass through easily.
However, there was no door at the entrance, just an empty space, and since there was no light inside, it was impossible to see what was there.
One could only feel a continuous cool breeze blowing out from the entrance.
On the wall of the pyramid to the left of the entrance, there was a huge screen displaying clear information about the pyramid.
'Map Name': Sands of Time.
'Map Level': D-level.
'Map Content': It is said that tens of thousands of years ago, this pyramid already existed here. After it was built, it protected the local safety for a thousand years, but for some reason, it was buried deep underground after that period, and many people were entombed alive within the pyramid.
'Map Introduction': This map is in an unexplored state. The player who successfully opens this map will receive a pioneer reward, and after the pioneering, all players with a 'Sands of Time Pass', regardless of location, will be able to freely enter the Sands of Time.
"An unexplored map?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully, "Sounds like it's something similar to Chanel Amusement Park."
"But then again, we've completed the Chanel Amusement Park map, and I didn't see anything to do with the word 'Chanel'."
"But the Chanel Amusement Park map is D-level, and this is also D-level."
"That map wasn't much of a threat; this one should be about the same."
"Yi, shall we go in and try it?"
Chen Yi furrowed his brow, leaning on his cane with one hand, he glanced subconsciously at the little loli standing beside him, then silently put his cane away and pondered for a moment before speaking softly.
"Let's go, have a look inside."
It wasn't that he was arrogant, but he truly felt that with his current strength, pioneering a D-level map should not be a problem.
The entrance before them was quite dark, as if it swallowed all the light; logically, with the sun not yet set outside, the entrance shouldn't be so dark.
Although his title had a lighting effect, it could only illuminate the surrounding area for a certain distance, and could not light up very far.
They had penetrated about fifty meters into the entrance, but the visibility remained very low; there was nothing around to gather any useful information from.
There was also no sound of any prompts in their ears.
"Damn it!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit shouted confidently, and the title above his head emitted a burst of white light, illuminating a large area around them.
The next second—
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced around at the nearly a hundred dried corpses that had been originally hiding in the shadows, their eyes staring straight at him, and his body stiffened slightly as he said in a low voice without expression.
"Damn."

chapters.title: Chapter 58 "Strike the Darkness with Thunder!!!
chapters.content:
And in that moment when the Dried Corpses were illuminated by the light shining from Tuberculosis Rabbit's title above their heads.
Before Chen Yi and the others had time to take a closer look at the Dried Corpses, they heard a prompt in their ears.
"Ding, you have discovered the existence of the Dried Corpses. The Dried Corpses will start to move in one minute; please escape to the first Activation Point within ten minutes."
"The following are some basic rules within this map; please read them quickly and remember them by heart as soon as possible."
"1: This map is in dark mode. Without external intervention, all players' visibility is limited to about '1 meter.' Beyond one meter of vision, darkness prevails."
"2: The Dried Corpses' walking or running is silent, and they are not hindered by darkness; they can see the players' figures clearly and move at a speed roughly equivalent to that of an adult male."
"3: The Dried Corpses have a breathing sound. When a Dried Corpse is within five meters of a player, the player will hear a clear breathing sound."
"4: After coming into contact with a player three times, the player will become a Dried Corpse and be permanently imprisoned within the map; they will remain conscious and become one of the Dried Corpses until they successfully infect three other players, after which they can resume their player status and leave the map."
"5: After a player becomes a Dried Corpse, titles, Props, Skills, etc., cannot be used anymore."
"6: Once a player who has become a Dried Corpse successfully infects three other players, they can choose to resume their player identity or continue playing as a Dried Corpse to infect players entering the map, thereby obtaining substantial rewards and the privilege to resume player identity at any time."
"7: Dried Corpses within the map, as well as players who have become Dried Corpses, will possess the ability to resurrect indefinitely."
"8: Within the map, any illumination Props, non-Prop lighting devices, and lighting Skills, etc., cannot be used."
"9: Players who fail to reach the Activation Point within the designated time, or do not successfully clear the map, will become Dried Corpses."
A full list of 9 rules clearly explained the copy's rules.
"Damn!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit roared, feeling less fear in his heart after reading all the rules. He took a deep breath and then clicked his tongue, "You scared me, I thought I'd encountered a mummy."
"But speaking of which, didn't you two think of that thing?"
He turned his head to look at Tie Chui and Jiaye beside him and asked with some curiosity.
His inability to think of it was due to his naturally thick nerves.
Those who could be friends with corpses were already immune to such things.
"Nope."
The little loli sitting on Tie Chui's shoulder shook her head, patted Tie Chui's head, and muttered, "I hypnotized myself to think of those drunk people vomiting on the streets whenever I think of ghosts."
"That's disgusting."
"I hate it when I'm happily wearing my favorite dress, strolling in the evening, only to see such a disappointing scene in the tree pits on the street."
"As for Tie Chui—"
"He can't use his brain. If he does, it hurts, so he can't think of these things at all."
"Heh heh."
Tie Chui chuckled with a simple smile, nodding his head without knowing if he understood or not, but he seemed genuinely fearless.
"Oh, I see."
"Damn!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit roared again and then slightly discomforted, rubbed his throat, pulled out a fruit tea from his chest, and took a big gulp before he finally relaxed.
"Damn!"
"By the way, didn't you tell us your names at that bun shop last time? I kind of forgot."
"Jiaye."
"Good name, not bad."
Tuberculosis Rabbit licked the corner of his mouth, then looked around as darkness closed in again, and roared without temper.
"Damn."
As his words ended, the surroundings were lit up once more.
And now, as the one-minute countdown ended, the Dried Corpses also began to move.
Almost a hundred Dried Corpses ran straight towards them.
There was not a sound.
The entire scene looked extremely eerie.
Under the effect of the title "Tuberculosis Rabbit," the character for "sun," though it could illuminate the surroundings within a hundred-meter radius almost instantly, like a flare with excellent effect, could only last for about less than a second.
This meant that.
Even if Tuberculosis Rabbit shouted "sun" repeatedly, with the stamina of a normal person, it was very hard to achieve an uninterrupted effect, akin to a video with a dark background interspersed with several frames of pure white, playing on.
The entire scene probably looked like this.
Every time the light dispelled the darkness, those Dried Corpses would be a little closer to them.
This process easily led to certain associations.
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit rubbed his throat, drank down his fruit tea expressionlessly, pocketed the milk tea cup into his chest, and then sneered before starting to warm up by moving his body.
"This scene reminds me of some of the pointless videos that people used to share in the group chat."
"But that's not important."
"Yi, you guys focus on getting through this map."
"As for the illumination, just leave it to me, Tuberculosis Rabbit."
"Don't ever think that this is all there is to my strength."
"The warm-up has just begun!"
With those words!
Discover hidden stories at empire
Tuberculosis Rabbit took a deep breath, then his facial expression turned icy as he began to roar in a rapid-fire manner like a machine gun.
"Sun, sun, sun, sun, sun, sun, sun!"
One second, seven "sun" shouts!
Without any interval of darkness, the entire space was lit up brightly!
If this scene were captured by a high-definition camera and broken down frame by frame, one would find that there was not a single frame of darkness!
This was his high-end game!
He had never considered himself strong in any area, but in this respect, he didn't think anyone could surpass him!
Where Tuberculosis Rabbit was, darkness would be devoured, and light would surely cover the land!
Darkness shrouds all things, and he would be that last glimmer of dawn in the darkness.
With thunder—
Shatter the darkness!
Gaia!!
"Sun!!!!"
At this time, those Dried Corpses surrounding them were only about less than 50 meters away. The Dried Corpses did not completely encircle them; there were quite a few gaps.
In the night, players naturally couldn't discern where the gaps were, but under Tuberculosis Rabbit's continuous illumination, the gaps within the Dried Corpses were crystal clear!
Chen Yi took out the Christmas Cane from his chest and leaned on it; at the same time, a two-meter diameter red patterned light ring appeared under his feet, looking particularly conspicuous.
"Walk forward."
Without the slightest hesitation, Chen Yi chose a spot where there were fewer Dried Corpses and boldly took the lead!
On the map not far from their position, there was a flickering Greenpoint.
This Greenpoint should be the Activation Point mentioned in the rules that needed to be reached within ten minutes.
However, the map was pitch dark, only the vicinity of their few blue points was cleared.
As they moved forward, this cleared distance on the map proceeded with them.
Which meant that no matter how bright they illuminated the interior of the pyramid, the visibility on the map was still within one meter as per the rules.

chapters.title: Chapter 59 "Invincible Under the Heavens." (Congratulations to 'Riddle_' for becoming the second ally of this book!)
chapters.content:
"Yi."
Having only taken a few steps, Jiaye, sitting on Tie Chui's shoulders, made a suggestion, "There's no need for such trouble. Why don't I let Tie Chui send us there?"
"We'll be there soon," Chen Yi replied.
With Jiaye and Tie Chui's abilities, one toss and retrieval was all that was needed to instantly move a considerable distance.
They indeed arrived quickly.
Most importantly, their combo move didn't even have a cooldown.
As long as Tie Chui's strength wasn't exhausted, they could keep using it.
"No need."
Chen Yi shook his head, having his own plans in mind. However, he still asked, "That skill of yours that can disregard distance and terrain to pull people to your side, how many people can it bind?"
"One," Jiaye replied, holding up a finger and speaking with a serious and clear voice. "And once bound, it can't be changed."
"Hmm," Chen Yi hummed, nodding his head. His eyes narrowed slightly as he observed the path of the Dried Corpses in front of them—these Dried Corpses didn't seem to be advancing with them as their center point.
They had their own tracks of movement.
For example, those three Dried Corpses behind them were running farther and farther away from a spot ten meters behind them, completely ignoring them.
This meant that if players did not directly bump into the Dried Corpses face-to-face, the Corpses would not actively pursue the players.
But the visibility for normal players was only a meter, so the frequency of unfortunate face-to-face encounters should not be low.
Chen Yi looked down at the patterns beneath his feet, nodding thoughtfully.
This clearing was made up of 100cm x 100cm dark tiles laid throughout.
Each dark tile bore a unique pattern, different from tile to tile, likely functioning to determine the direction of advancement to avoid the tracks of the Dried Corpses.
This was the thought process for a normal player to clear the level.
After all, normal players couldn't have an eternal light bulb by their side like he did, which, other than being a bit noisy, had no drawbacks.
Information on the movement tracks of the Dried Corpses could be found through the patterns on these tiles.
But it was unclear whether players who were infected and became Dried Corpses would follow these movement tracks. If not... the map would become chaotic in the future.
The prospect of such a device being pioneered didn't feel quite right, to be honest.
After gathering the rough information,
Chen Yi finally glanced around and uttered softly, "Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!"
As he spoke, the red patterned circle beneath exploded with light, suddenly expanding to twice its size before beginning to slowly rotate.
A blood-red Frozen Throne slowly rose from beneath Chen Yi's feet, elevating him into the air.
The armrests of the throne were covered with opaque, blood-red ice spikes, presenting a rather harrowing sight.
As Chen Yi sat down,
A voice carrying weary undertones, yet not sounding elderly but instead full of authority and bloodthirst, echoed within the pyramid's interior, ethereal as a voice from another world,
"You insects have injured me! I've played enough with you, now taste the Undead's vengeance!"
This was punctuated by an intimidating burst of mad laughter!
All these were special effects and entrance BGM accompanying the activation of the title "Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans."
After all, it was a red-level title.
Having a few extra special effects was quite normal.
While seated on the Frozen Throne, he could spend 10 Points to summon a suit of armor-clad, longsword-wielding soldier, completely obedient to his commands, with no limits to the number of summons.
The next second—
Ten white orbs of light slowly emerged around the throne, solidifying along with the light to reveal ten soldiers clad in heavy armor and holding longswords, who gradually landed on the ground.
Following the direction pointed by Chen Yi's staff, they marched forward in formation.
"Boom, boom, boom!"
The uniform and muffled footsteps added a sense of oppression to the space.
It didn't take them long.
The soldiers approached several Dried Corpses.
Draw sword, slash, sheath sword.
Simplicity and crispness marked their uniform actions; the heads of the Dried Corpses were cleaved off almost without resistance, and their bodies collapsed powerlessly to the ground and were slowly absorbed by the patterns there.
In just a few seconds, the bodies of the Dried Corpses had vanished.
The ten soldiers remained entirely unharmed and continued their unemotional advance.
Soon, they had carved out a clear path.
"This..."
Sitting on Tie Chui's shoulders, Jiaye looked on in shock at the red circle of light at Chen Yi's feet, the thoroughly crimson Frozen Throne, as well as the dozens of soldiers he had summoned, with the grandiose sound effects of the throne's arrival still echoing in her ears.
Her gaze was slightly hazy as she looked towards Chen Yi, who sat expressionless on the throne, and murmured softly.
"What is this feeling of being both embarrassing and cool..."
"Damn!"
Noticing Jiaye's subtle expressions, the Tuberculosis Rabbit standing beside the throne excitedly clenched its fist and roared with a triumphant air, "Damn!"
"Roar!"
Infected by Tuberculosis Rabbit's emotions, Tie Chui couldn't help but laugh excitedly as he lifted Jiaye's legs in his hands and, like a shot put, began to energetically spin her around!
"Roar, Roar, Roar!!!!"
It was some time later, when Jiaye finally stopped spinning, she took a breath, casually straightened her bangs, and continued to sit on Tie Chui's shoulders as if nothing had happened.
No big deal, she was used to it.
She comforted herself vigorously in her mind.
Tie Chui wasn't very smart, so to coordinate with him and use their combo move, she had to employ some trickery, convincing Tie Chui that swinging her around by the legs was a very affectionate game she enjoyed.
Only by doing so could she ensure that Tie Chui would throw her out at a critical moment.
But clearly... there were some side effects, like Tie Chui seemingly becoming addicted to this game.
Having such a brother, she really had a tough fate.
Soon—
The Dried Corpses on the path from the throne to the first Activation Point had already been cleared, and no matter how many times they attacked the soldiers, they could not convert them into Dried Corpses!
It seems that summoned creatures or puppets could not be infected and turned into Dried Corpses!
However, the Dried Corpses did revive quickly and began to move again along their track towards a certain direction, but this time protected by two rows of soldiers, five in each row.
This ensured that the path between the Frozen Throne and the first Activation Point remained unobstructed!
Thus, Chen Yi had practically obtained all the information about the first challenge.
And at this moment.
Jiaye, who had successfully reached the Activation Point while sitting on Tie Chui's shoulders, turned and looked back over a hundred meters to Chen Yi, who was still sitting on the Frozen Throne, waving her hand with a puzzled expression and calling out loudly, "Yi?"
"Aren't you coming?"
Chen Yi sat on the Frozen Throne, silent and expressionless, not speaking.
The situation was a bit awkward.
The soldiers he had summoned could only exist as long as the throne existed.
But the problem was the throne couldn't move, and when he stood up to move, so did the throne, causing the soldiers to vanish, and the path that had been clear was no longer so.
If it had been just Tuberculosis Rabbit alone, it might have been okay.
But the problem was that there were two pairs of eyes watching him, and he didn't want to find himself in too embarrassing a position.
After a long silence.
Chen Yi stood up from the throne with a calm expression, support himself with his staff as he stepped onto the red patterned ring of light and looked towards the nearby Activation Point, speaking softly.
"Invincible Under the Heavens."
The next second—
A supreme and semi-transparent yellow staircase sprawled from the throne as the starting point to the Activation Point as the end, spreading wildly!
He paused for a moment,
then, relying on his staff, with a hint of a mysterious smile playing on his lips, a straight figure with one hand in his pocket, he stepped onto the suddenly appeared staircase, moving towards the Activation Point in measured and rhythmic strides.
The instant Chen Yi stepped onto the staircase,
the throne behind him also began to slowly crumble into crimson fragments and disappear on the spot.
At the same time,
a sudden flash of deep blue lightning streaked through Chen Yi's eyes, adding a touch of mystery and aloofness to his demeanor.
Power may be lacking.
But special effects must... be maxed out!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 60 One minute on stage takes ten years of practice off stage.
chapters.content:
```
"Ding, all players have arrived at the first stage activation point."
"Please proceed to the second activation point within 10 minutes."
"Let's go."
Chen Yi, with one hand in his pocket and leaning on a cane, stood still and looked nonchalantly at Jiaye on Tie Chui's shoulder.
"Ah?... Oh, yeah, sure."
Jiaye, who hadn't reacted at first, felt his ears turn slightly red as he stammered an uncertain response, eyes flitting about.
When Chen Yi and the others were all standing at the activation point,
"Bang!"
A sound, not too loud or soft, like a muffled fart, exploded in the space, and instantly the darkness that filled the space retreated, and light from an unknown source illuminated the entire area.
Chen Yi absorbed every detail of his surroundings.
The activation point they were standing on was a cylinder about one meter high from the ground, capable of accommodating about a dozen people simultaneously.
The cylinder was covered in patterns, lending it a mysterious aura.
The entire space was about the size of four football fields put together in a 2x2 arrangement.
While they stood upon this cylinder,
the dried corpses below suddenly stopped in their tracks, turned their heads in unison towards Chen Yi and his group, their eyes beginning to glow red.
The next second—
without any hesitation, the dried corpses charged towards Chen Yi and the others!
At the same time!
The light in the entire space vanished in an instant, and darkness once again enveloped the land. In the moment before darkness fell, their last glimpse was of the dried corpses rushing towards them.
Darkness had returned.
No sound was heard, no dried corpses were seen.
But everyone knew in their hearts that a horde of dried corpses was racing towards them in the darkness.
And this time, these dried corpses didn't seem to follow any fixed trajectory; instead, their target was much clearer—their target... was them!
The visibility of their vision was once again restricted to just one meter.
Accompanying this change, the cylinder beneath their feet began to tremble slightly.
Soon after—
a passage built entirely of stone bricks rose slowly from the ground, appearing before their eyes, with an entrance right in front of them, flush with the surface of the cylinder.
The entire passage inclined upwards.
According to the direction of the second activation point on the map, the meaning was clear.
"Run."
Without any hesitation, Chen Yi was the first to dive into the passage.
The passage was full of steps.
Each step was about half a meter wide and around twenty centimeters high, quite large steps, fortunately without moss or anything that might cause slips.
"Damn!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a terse growl before quickly lighting up a cigarette and taking hurried puffs. After several more shouts and a glance at the dried corpses rapidly pursuing them below the cylinder,
he cursed under his breath and hurried into the passage to catch up with Yi's pace.
It wasn't that he was complaining about the close chase.
He just found the dark rules of the map utterly nasty. Though a chatterbox, it didn't mean he enjoyed talking non-stop, especially repeating the same meaningless monosyllable.
He didn't even have the time to take a drag from his cigarette.
Luckily, he had practiced this skill, the speed of lighting a cigarette and taking a drag taking only 0.7 seconds, allowing him to sneak a puff between two curses.
This skill was almost as simple as performing a light-speed QA.
That's the meaning of hard work.
One minute on stage requires ten years of work offstage.
...
The passage was not low in height, at least allowing Tie Chui, with his stature, to move forward without any obstruction.
```
It was just a bit oppressive.
They were surrounded by stone bricks on all sides, and although there was plenty of oxygen, the psychological pressure was still immense.
The passageway was a straight ascent with no sign of turning.
"Damn."
After growling softly, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned to look back. The Dried Corpses had already entered the passage and were rushing toward them in a crowded frenzy.
Their running speed seemed faster than during the first level.
At least, if they continued running straight forward without any special measures, and if there was still a long way to go in this passageway, they would definitely be overtaken.
"This can only happen to us."
With a somewhat emotional click of his tongue, Tuberculosis Rabbit said, "Not many other players have a title like 'Kuafu Chasing the Sun', especially in complete darkness."
"Knowing only that Dried Corpses are chasing you, but having no idea how far away they really are."
"Surrounded by silence, with vision obstructed, and no idea how long the passageway will go on."
"That's a lot of psychological pressure."
"It's probably terrifying to the extreme."
At this moment, the Dried Corpses were only less than 50 meters away from them in a straight line.
And looking at the location of the second Activation Point on the map, there was still a long way to go in this passageway; continuing to run was not an option, they would be caught sooner or later.
They had to stop and deal with these Dried Corpses before doing anything else.
At this time, Chen Yi suddenly halted and looked at a red control lever on the wall of the passageway ahead.
There was also a small screen next to it.
'Activate this control lever to lower a stone wall behind you, which can block the Dried Corpses for 10 seconds.'
"Is that so?"
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully, grabbed the control lever with one hand, and pulled it down forcefully.
Immediately—
A stone wall fell behind them in the passageway, blocking the Dried Corpses' path.
He didn't say much but continued to lead the way forward. In fact, if he wanted to get through this passage quickly, he had many ways to do it.
For example, have Jiaye use their combo to easily carry them out.
Or use a mirror.
And so on.
He just wanted to understand more about the rules of this map.
It wasn't long before the stone wall retracted, and that group of Dried Corpses continued their relentless chase, seemingly moving even faster.
After just one hundred meters.
Chen Yi found three small, glowing objects on the floor of the passage.
Only upon approaching did he realize they were several grenades.
'Prop Name: Dried Corpse Grenade'
'Prop Level: None.'
'Prop Effect: Can cause high damage to Dried Corpses or other monsters, but can't harm players.'
'Prop Restriction: Can't be taken out of the map, only usable within the Sands of Time Map.'
'PS: For every Dried Corpse killed, you will receive 1 Sands of Time Point. After clearing the map, Sands of Time Points can be exchanged for rewards in the shop.'
And at this time—
The Dried Corpses behind them were now less than five meters away.
Chen Yi picked up a grenade, weighed it in his hand, pulled out the pin, and threw it at the feet of the group of Dried Corpses deep in the passageway.
The next second—
"Boom!!!"
A tremendous explosion rang out suddenly deep within the passage!
Under Tuberculosis Rabbit's illumination, those Dried Corpses were visibly blown to pieces by the massive shockwave, turning into flesh that scattered on the steps of the passage and slowly got absorbed into it.
A series of rapid kill notifications kept sounding urgently next to Chen Yi's ear.

chapters.title: Chapter 61 "Solid! As! A! Rock!
chapters.content:
Just one strike!
The dried corpses that had been chasing them were completely obliterated, and the huge shockwave that swept past them was as gentle as the spring breeze.
It wasn't harmful in the slightest, but instead, there was a refreshing sensation.
"They're coming back!"
A hint of strangeness flashed across Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes as he pointed towards the steps around fifty meters behind them. The dried corpses they had just killed were resurrecting themselves once more, fifty meters away from them.
And they continued to sprint towards them.
Ordinary players might not catch this information due to limited vision, but they could see everything clearly.
Chen Yi pocketed the remaining two grenades carelessly and sprinted forward again.
...
Finally—
After the last two grenades had been utilized, they also saw the end of the passageway.
The resurrecting dried corpses were only less than 20 meters away from them now.
Emerging from the end of the passage, they saw a platform suspended in mid-air.
At the end of the platform, there was a pole, from which a cable connected it to another pole on a higher platform.
Beneath the cable was a cable car that looked like it could hold dozens of people.
The cable car was quietly stationed at the platform's departure point, constantly flickering with white light, and even without Tuberculosis Rabbit's illumination, it was clearly visible in the darkness.
It was almost as if it had the words "Hurry up and ride me" engraved on its surface.
"This map doesn't seem very difficult, does it?"
Chen Yi glanced at the dried corpses sprinting towards them from behind and stepped towards the cable car. He pressed the green departure button inside the cable car once Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others had boarded.
"It feels like even ordinary players would have a good chance of passing easily if they just coordinate a little better."
Although they passed the first level by relying on their own abilities, if it were ordinary players, by following the patterns on the ground, they could have easily avoided the dried corpses.
After all, the dried corpses in the first level had fixed movement patterns.
Being a little careful and concentrating a bit shouldn't pose much of a problem.
As for the second level, they didn't use any of their own abilities at all,
but relied on the control lever that could lower a stone wall and the three Dried Corpse Grenades they found in the depths of the corridor, successfully escaping from the passage.
And they made it onto the cable car successfully.
The moment he pressed the departure button, the cable car trembled slightly and then started ascending slowly along the cable towards the higher platform.
"Not bad."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, peering over the edge of the cable car and down below: "Just didn't see where the power source for this cable car is."
"But then again, this map must be an unauthorized expansion, right?"
"From what we saw outside, the pyramid doesn't seem like it could contain such a large map, does it?"
"And also... uh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly stopped, his expression a bit odd as he pointed behind them at the cable: "It looks like those dried corpses have some skills."
The dried corpses that had chased them out of the passageway were now bouncing onto the cables, rushing towards them at twice the speed of the cable car, if not more.
Meanwhile.
The darkness gradually dissipated, and light once again swept over the entire space.
It was as if it was intended for them to witness this scene.
This was not a good situation.
If things continued like this, the dried corpses would catch up to them before the cable car reached the next platform.
The attack of the dried corpses was a rule-based attack; if a player's body was touched three times by them, the player would be turned into a dried corpse.
Even they couldn't dodge this kind of attack.
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi's brows furrowed slightly as he looked back at the group of dried corpses chasing them along the cable, preparing to rise and take action.
"Hehe."
Suddenly, Tie Chui chuckled on the side, standing up from the cable car like a solid tower. He looked towards the dried corpses on the cable with simple and honest eyes and rubbed his right shoulder, his voice booming.
"Brother... watch me."
The next second—
Before Chen Yi and the others could react,
a sudden roar erupted beside their ears.
"Firm as a Rock!!!"
Immediately after, they saw a shadow that was over seven meters tall appear behind Tie Chui, looking almost identical to him. As soon as this shadow materialized,
it didn't pause at all.
It jumped with both feet.
Its whole body, like Mount Tai crushing down, leaped into the air, and then directly slammed into the Dried Corpses on the steel cable!!
"Bang!!!"
The massive collision sound echoed continuously throughout the space!
Under the strong impact, the steel cable began to shake violently, and even the cable car under their feet swayed incessantly.
The power of this attack!
Was nothing less than that of a hundred-ton vehicle crashing into you at a hundred kilometers an hour!
And it was from out of the sky too!
"This..."
Chen Yi was momentarily stunned by the shadow that had suddenly emerged behind Tie Chui, and subconsciously muttered in a low voice, "This Skill, truly a... Firm! As! A! Rock!"
Jiaye, originally proud on behalf of her brother, heard Chen Yi's voice and suddenly became a bit dazed. With her hands gesturing aimlessly in the air, she turned her head towards Chen Yi with a puzzled look and asked,
"Yi, why did you suddenly start talking like that?"
When Yi was speaking the first half of the sentence, his voice was still a whisper, but when he came to 'Firm as a Rock', his tone suddenly became forceful and resonant.
And for some reason, the four words 'Firm as a Rock' that Yi had just said seemed to be very intimidating, carrying a kind of inexplicable authority which made her feel a tremor in her heart for a moment.
The contrast was too stark.
It sounded very strange,
as if a shallow stream had suddenly led into a deep abyss.
"It's nothing."
Chen Yi shook his head with a calm expression and didn't speak; instead, the corner of his mouth twitched slightly. This was the first time he had felt the impact of his title as the Idiom Solitaire King.
Not bad at all.
It's just that the timing of use was a bit off.
Just then, they noticed that the Dried Corpses on the steel cable, having been hit by the strike, simply flickered with yellow light and didn't stop for a moment, continuing to rush towards them!
Tie Chui's attack had not caused the slightest damage to these Dried Corpses.
'Ding, the Dried Corpses on the steel cable are in an unattackable state.'
A timely notification sounded in their ears.
In other words,
at this moment, the Dried Corpses were invincible.
And at this point, the Dried Corpses were only about six or seven meters away from them, seemingly only a few steps away from jumping into their cable car.
Chen Yi couldn't help but sigh. His only option was to activate the Mechanical Elk Christmas Sleigh and leave the cable car, hovering in mid-air while staring at the somewhat dazed Dried Corpses standing on the cable car.
He had wanted to experience what the normal player progression was like in this dungeon,
but it seemed now as though he was trapped in a no-win situation.
If it were an ordinary player without a flight vehicle, faced with this situation, they could do nothing but wait to become Dried Corpses.
"Just a D-level map."
"There shouldn't be a no-win situation like this."
He glanced casually at the Dried Corpses on the cable car, looking up at them anxiously yet helplessly, furrowed his brows, picked up a cup of fruit tea, and took a sip. His brows slowly relaxed, he took a deep breath with relief, nodded with satisfaction,
"Hmm, this time it's the domineering lychee flavor."
"Not bad."
"Just a bit too much slush."

chapters.title: Chapter 62 Do They Really Treat Them as Little Carla?
chapters.content:
Chen Yi sat on the snow sled and lowered the glass shell above him. He then casually rested his arm on the edge of the window frame and glanced down at the dried corpses standing cluelessly on the cable car. He curled his lip and remained silent.
Did they really think they were little Carla?
To be toyed with, they couldn't possibly believe they could take them down.
Apart from Santa Claus, no monster has been able to chase them this far.
Just speaking of Santa Claus irritated him; the guy had chased them for a full 24 hours.
He's just a neutral boss for December, right?
But here he is in May, strutting around.
By the time December comes and he's grown stronger, if he doesn't chase Santa Claus around Blue Star for 30 days, he simply won't be satisfied.
But, on the other hand...
The glass shell of this sled is quite human-friendly; it can be raised and lowered freely, similar to a convertible's top.
As for those dried corpses below...
They're completely helpless, only able to stay on the cable car, lifting their heads and looking around blankly at Chen Yi and his team, clearly unsure how to handle the situation.
The speed of the sled they're on below is said to be unrivaled, the fastest vehicle to date.
It's just the blink of an eye.
The snow sled smoothly came to a stop on the high platform.
Meanwhile, those dried corpses were still leisurely making their way towards the platform on the slowly moving cable car.
"Eh, what is this?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit who hopped off the sled, looked at a short column on the platform with curiosity and approached it.
At the edge of the platform, there was a quadrangular column about a meter high and on the flat top of the column was a button flashing a green light.
There was also a light screen beside it.
"Activate button, and the cable car will make another round trip."
"And the speed of the cable car this time will be three times faster than the first."
"I get it now!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly realized and nodded, then turned to look at the dried corpses on the cable car below the cables: "I know how ordinary players should get through this level."
"If ordinary players did what we did, they'd be wiped out by now."
"The dried corpses climbing the cables are not only faster than the cable car, but also in an unattackable state, almost a certain death situation."
"Let's say ten players reach this level."
"The correct way would be to have only one person get on the cable car, let this player come to the platform to press the button, causing the cable car to make another round trip, and this time three times faster than before."
"The remaining nine players simply hold the lower, shorter platform's entrance and prevent the dried corpses from rushing out."
"As long as the players have certain offensive props and skills, they can definitely hold the entrance."
"After all, these dried corpses have no defense attributes as long as they don't come into contact with the players."
"In this way, they can keep watch until the cable car returns again, and then board the cable car together. The cable car will be very fast this time, and the dried corpses won't be able to catch up at all."
"Consequently, they would successfully escape this level."
"This must be the correct way to clear this level!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit's face showed trace excitement explaining his thought process, feeling just now as if he were Sherlock Holmes himself, with the spirit of Conan and Kudo Shinichi on his shoulders, undeniably smart!
With his current logical state!
Without exaggeration, if he were placed in a Werewolf Kill game room right now, he could confidently claim the role of Prophet and deceive the villagers to the point of losing their socks.
He suddenly started enjoying this kind of brain-powered feeling!
"Yi, what do you think?"
"Hmm."
Chen Yi stood on the spot, gazing down at the dried corpses still on the cable car, and after pondering with his staff for two seconds, he spoke softly, "This level is actually somewhat of a trap."
"The dried corpses on the steel cables are invincible, and there's a button on the high platform that makes the cable car go back and forth again. Both these pieces of information are hidden; they're not explicitly written in the rules."
"In other words, if it's a player's first time on this map, almost ninety percent would likely be killed here."
"Until someone discovers this information and manages to take it out alive, then later players will slowly start to avoid this."
"This must be where the difficulty of pioneering a new area lies."
"Under normal circumstances, we would probably be dead by now."
"Luckily, we're not normal."
"However—"
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes towards the corridor on the lower platform: "The revival point for these dried corpses has always been behind us. When we stood at the entrance of the corridor, the dried corpses kept respawning inside."
"That means... we can totally farm points here."
"The kind that goes on for three days and nights."
"Killing one dried corpse grants you 1 Sands of Time Point, which can be exchanged for rewards in the shop after clearing the level."
After thinking in place for a while, he turned to look at a white circle of light on the platform behind them.
On the platform behind them.
There was a white circle of light clinging to the ground, slowly flickering every three seconds as if reminding players to step in.
And now the map had shown that they had entered the second Activation Point.
But the prompt to proceed to the third Activation Point had not yet sounded in their ears.
Does that mean you only truly reach the second Activation Point if you step into that circle of light?
After pondering briefly, Chen Yi made up his mind and stepped back onto the sled: "Let's go, time to farm points."
...
Chen Yi controlled the sled, hovering in mid-air, without any movement, patiently waiting for more than ten minutes.
His title.
The special effect of "Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!" would be on a 30-minute cooldown after one use, and there was still a little time left before it was over.
Once the cooldown had completely elapsed.
He maneuvered the sled back to the lower platform, and by this time, the dried corpses had all made their way up to the higher platform via the cable car.
Seeing Chen Yi head back again.
The dried corpses scrambled once more to climb the steel cables, hurrying towards Chen Yi and the others on the lower platform.
Just as the dried corpses were about to jump down from the steel cables.
"Apocalypse! (Maniacal laughter)"
A crimson Frozen Throne slowly rose from beneath Chen Yi's feet, and at the same time, an old man's crazed laughter suddenly echoed in the air, as if coming from beyond the heavens.
"The lines are much fewer this time,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit licked his dry lips with some emotion and clicked his tongue: "Just two words? His script isn't impressive."
Following that—
20 heavily armored soldiers slowly emerged from the white light in front of them, blocking the path of the dried corpses.
In less than ten minutes' time.
The hundred-odd dried corpses on the steel cables were all wiped out.
Immediately after, the heavily armored soldiers, having cleared the remaining dried corpses, did not pause but hurried towards the cave entrance to offer support.
Meanwhile, at the entrance.
Four heavily armored soldiers were already standing in line inside the corridor, emotionlessly swinging and slashing their swords nonstop.
A slaughter... had begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 63 To wear the crown, one must bear its weight!
chapters.content:
The strongest attack of the dried corpses was the utterly unreasonable rule attack!
There was no need to kill or wound you!
If their bodies made contact with you three times, you were inevitably transformed into a dried corpse.
Such formidable rule-based ability, however, was completely ineffective against these soldiers; deprived of their rule attack, the dried corpses had no choice but to revert to more primitive methods of assault.
But... the heavy armor worn by the soldiers made it difficult for the dried corpses to breach their defenses, and only during the intervals between the soldiers' sword swings could they manage to inflict minimal damage.
Groups of four soldiers sealed the corridor tightly.
It took a full ten minutes for these four soldiers to be obliterated, but before the dried corpses could get excited, another four fresh soldiers surged forward from the rear.
And outside the corridor entrance, there stood densely packed hundreds of soldiers, waiting to enter.
...
"Comfortable."
Tuberculosis Rabbit lay contentedly in a rocking chair, cradling a milk tea in his left hand and gnawing on a roast chicken with his right, continuously rocking in the chair and humming an unknown tune.
The roast chicken in his hands was a grade E prop.
It had been drawn by Brother Yi during his first ten-consecutive pull.
"Prop Name": Air Roast Chicken.
"Prop Grade": Grade E.
"Prop Effects": You will have an everlasting chicken to eat, made from air, which cannot satiate hunger or stimulate stomach movement, but it can offer you an almost absolutely authentic taste and feeling of fullness.
"Prop Restrictions": You may freely switch between the following flavors only—original, spicy, five-spice, extra spicy, salt and pepper, honey...
"Prop Introduction": "A scientist, frustrated with a decade of failed dieting, invented a total of 289 air food props in a rage. These props can satisfy your cravings without causing weight gain, and Air Roast Chicken is just one of the 289."
They had been grinding for a full three hours now.
Right on this platform, they hadn't gone anywhere else.
During this time, he rode a sled all over the area, observing every inch of space, which turned out to be uninteresting – nothing but stone walls.
With no entertainment activities available, he could only lie on the rocking chair and munch on roast chicken.
Oh right, this rocking chair was also a prop.
These seemingly useless props could actually be quite useful at times, like... the current situation.
After all, life isn't filled with battle every moment; it wouldn't be right to claim that only combat-useful props are good. Just like the Air Roast Chicken which was trying so hard to please him – how could he say it wasn't a prop? That would be rather hurtful to the feelings of the Air Roast Chicken.
"Gulp."
Tie Chui stared at the roast chicken in Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand, swallowing his saliva in longing. Seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit's gaze, he turned his head awkwardly towards his sister, his face showing a mix of helplessness and confusion.
"This thing..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Tie Chui, then back at the roast chicken in his hand: "It's not that I won't let you have some, but this item is somewhat private, isn't it? Aren't you disgusted by all the saliva on it?"
"Even if you're not, if you chew on it and then hand it back to me, I'll find it repulsive."
Chen Yi, on the other hand, had been sitting on the Frozen Throne from start to finish, resting with closed eyes and crossed arms against the back of the chair.
It was a bit chilly.
It was the height of summer, and by all accounts, it should have been hot.
But for some reason, within this Sands of Time Map, there was always a breeze, making it feel somewhat brisk.
The Frozen Throne beneath him came with very buggy special effects.
As long as he did not leave the Frozen Throne, the soldiers he summoned could exist indefinitely unless killed in battle, and with enough Points, he could even summon soldiers as densely packed as an Insect Tide.
For these three hours, he had not left the Frozen Throne, and the summoned soldiers kept fending off dried corpses at the entrance of the corridor on his behalf.
And the cost to summon one soldier was merely 10 Points.
The value for money was extremely high.
But... the catch was that he couldn't leave the Frozen Throne.
Once he did, all the summoned soldiers would return to dust, leaving him, after sitting for three hours, with a numb backside.
It's tingling.
Indeed, the old saying was true: heavy is the head that wears the crown, and to sit upon the throne one must... suffer discomfort.
Out of boredom.
He opened his personal panel, starting to read through each word and sentence, since he had nothing better to do anyway.
So far,
he had collected nearly 1,200 points.
Although he wasn't sure about the purchasing power of the points, after grinding for three days and nights, he should be able to buy quite a few things.
"Have some of this."
Tuberculosis Rabbit once again pulled out an air roast duck and air mantou and handed them to Tie Chui and Jiaye, "We'll need to grind for another two or three days, so you'll have to bear with it a little longer."
"After all, once this map is open for exploration, probably only players with a 'Sands of Time Pass' will be able to enter. We don't have that thing, so we would lose this great opportunity to farm rewards."
"This thing can make you feel full, so going hungry for two or three days isn't a big deal; at most, you'll just feel a bit dizzy."
"As for thirst, I've got coffee and sour plums. The sour plums can help you quench your thirst visually, so you won't feel thirsty."
"I've also got milk tea here. Conserve it and it should last you about two or three days."
"No worries."
Jiaye shook his head and leaned on Tie Chui, mumbling in a daze, "My brother and I often went two or three days without eating before, so we're used to it."
"Then it's all good."
...
May 26th.
It had been a full three days since Chen Yi and the others entered the Sands of Time Map.
At this time,
the outside of the Sands of Time instance was crowded with people.
Many Yancheng players and Law Enforcement Bureau personnel with serious expressions gathered at the entrance of this triangular, pyramid-shaped entrance, waiting patiently.
The triangular, pyramid-shaped structure had only appeared recently, and the Law Enforcement Bureau noticed it soon afterward.
But they couldn't enter.
Clear words were written on a screen at the entrance:
"This map 'Sands of Time' is currently being explored by players. There are 4 players exploring: Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Tie Chui, Jiaye."
"Please wait patiently for the exploration to finish."
"Other players cannot enter until the exploration is over."
It's just... isn't this exploration taking a bit too long, a full three days!
One must know that among those four players was Chen Yi!
Who in Yancheng doesn't know this pro player with numerous titles above his head? If a big shot like him is spending three days and still hasn't finished exploring, then what hope does a regular player have of completing this map...
Two days ago,
the Law Enforcement Bureau and the military had completely merged into one; from now on, there would only be the Law Enforcement Bureau.
This was how the whole Federation was being reorganized.
Behind these law enforcement officers were a dozen or so cannon beds.
They were cannons that had been hastily manufactured over the past few days.
Similar to a gun turret.
A crossbow arrow as thick as a forearm was fixed to a lathe, with an electric motor at the back connected to the arrow.
When the motor was activated, the crossbow arrow would thrust forward and retract at a high frequency.
When a dozen of these cannon beds were lined up, they were very effective against the Insect Race - monstrous creatures that came in waves, like the tide.
There were two wheels installed underneath the lathe for towing.
It wasn't classified as a vehicle, so it could be used normally.
...
ps: Following old traditions, a few points are declared.
This book is completely fictional, and the name Yancheng was chosen at random; it was never intended to be a real city name.
Blue Star signifies a federal structure.
The Law Enforcement Bureau will be the only official combat organization from now on. The official side is not the main melody and can basically be ignored. Just a little imagination is needed, and it should be understood, so there's no need to elaborate further.

chapters.title: Chapter 64 "It seems that we'll need to prepare some dry food for exploring new maps in the future.
chapters.content:
"Still not out?"
A uniformed captain stood before the crowd with an unsightly expression, gazing at the light screen at the entrance to the Sands of Time Pyramid, feeling somewhat uneasy inside.
He actually had some connection with Chen Yi.
In recent times, he was the one who contacted Chen Yi every time there was a job to collect corpses, and the Points from the Law Enforcement Bureau given to Chen Yi also came from him.
During the last global event of the Extraterrestrial Invader, even though the Insect Race monsters were taken care of by Chen Yi, resulting in very few casualties for Yancheng in that disaster.
But... from a certain perspective, most of the rewards from that event also went to Chen Yi.
This meant that the players in Yancheng generally had much weaker strength compared to players from other cities.
And now with Chen Yi's fate uncertain within the map, if he were to die there, another such event would likely prove too much for Yancheng players given their current strength.
It could be said that anyone in Yancheng could afford an incident, but Chen Yi could not.
"Not yet."
A subordinate standing beside Captain Wang spoke up, reporting, "We've already made contact with other cities. So far, about seven or eight cities have discovered this kind of map that abruptly changes terrain."
"They've all sent people in for map exploration."
"But... the death rate is very high, it usually takes several groups of people to completely explore a map."
"Once a map is explored, players can teleport into the map from any corner of the globe with a global travel pass, but if they can walk to the entrance of the map, they can enter without needing a pass."
"It's just..."
The subordinate hesitated a moment before speaking cautiously, "But even if map exploration fails, it usually only takes 2.3 hours at most. We haven't gathered any information on a map that requires a full three days for exploration like this one."
"Hmm, got it."
Captain Wang's pupils carried a shade of gloom, and the feeling of uneasiness in his heart grew stronger. If Chen Yi were to die in the exploration of this map... the situation in Yancheng would turn dire.
...
Meanwhile, other players who had come to observe the commotion were also gathering and discussing among themselves.
"How come even a map has appeared, it's like playing a real game. If only there were a resurrection system, this crappy game doesn't even have that, not fixing such a big bug."
"That's not the important part. The important thing is that even Chen Yi took three days. If the map is released, do we dare to enter it?"
"We don't dare, but we have to."
A middle-aged man nearby tapped his pipe on the ground, speaking feebly, "The Vehicles are all gone, all the supplies in Yancheng are starting to run short."
"Just yesterday, the Law Enforcement Bureau was recruiting people to pull rickshaws to the granary for food."
"Now everything requires Points, it's hard to get by without them. There are definitely Points to be earned within the map, we have no choice but to enter."
"Now we can only hope that Chen Yi passes smoothly. Later on, if we can gather some Points, we can ask Chen Yi if there's anything we need to pay attention to regarding entering the map."
"Can Chen Yi really care about the few Points we have?"
"That's not an issue, we have numbers on our side. Surely we can gather a few thousand Points between so many of us."
"That's true."
With that, the people around stopped speaking, all looking up together at the light screen of the Sands of Time Pyramid entrance, unsure when Chen Yi would finally complete the exploration of the map.
Or if... he wouldn't come out at all.
...
Inside the Law Enforcement Bureau of Yancheng,
Several elders sat in front of a table, seriously staring at a light screen panel on the wall.
'Main city task.'
