'Task objective: Establish a Point ticket trading system, ensuring every player in Yancheng has spent and can earn Points, making Points circulate within the city.'
'Task reward: Activate the city task system, enabling players who enter Yancheng to take on corresponding tasks to earn Points.'
'Task requirement: One-tenth of the city's players have spent Points, and one-fifteenth of the city's players have earned Points.'
'Overall progress: 63%'
'Fund management: 1 million Points.'
"Director,"
An elder by the table sighed, turned off the air conditioner, and continued, "So far, we have several issues."
"We've allowed some shops to start accepting Points as payment, for example, selling a basket of meat buns for 1 Point."
"But the problem is, we only distribute 3 Points per day to the workers, which means the Points we give to the workers per day are only enough to buy them three baskets of buns."
"This is unreasonable."
"To resolve this, there are only two methods."
"First, increase the salary of the workers."
"Second, reduce the price of the buns."
"But we can't increase the workers' salary at all since our goal is for a large enough number of people to successfully earn Points, and our operation fund is only 1 million Points."
"If we raise the salary of the workers, it means we can't allow more people to earn Points."
"Reducing the price of buns is even less feasible, as that's already a subsidized price. Otherwise, with the current situation in Yancheng, the price of buns should have started skyrocketing."
"This also leads to very few people willing to spend their earned Points on these processed goods, and the progress required for this task is also the slowest."
"Most people go for rice or flour, something basic to fill the stomach, but our supply is limited now due to the vehicle restrictions."
"Enough,"
The Director furrowed his brows, pondered for a long while, and then spoke, "Can't you even cheat off someone else's work? How do other cities do it?"
"Other cities... the Extraterrestrial Invader event and the Insect Race provided many players with Points, so they could at least ease up a bit. But nearly all the Points generated from the Extraterrestrial Invader event in Yancheng are in Chen Yi's hands."
"I understand, I'll think of a solution for this,"
"The pressing matter is to complete the main city task as soon as possible. Only after activating the task system quickly can the players have enough sources of Points income. We can't raise the workers' wages for now, so let's focus on meeting the target number of people first."
...
At this moment, Chen Yi and his group had arrived in front of the white circle of the fifth Activation Point.
By stepping into this white light circle,
The Sands of Time Map would be considered fully explored.
They had farmed the second stage for a whole three days, and if it wasn't for their bodies barely being able to take it anymore, they had planned to farm for another day and night.
"Looks like we'll need to pack some dry food for future map explorations."
Tuberculosis Rabbit mumbled dizzily on the spot.
His stomach wasn't hungry, nor was his mouth thirsty.
All of these could be solved with Props, but the dizziness and slow thinking caused by not eating for a long time couldn't be helped.
They needed to get out.
If they didn't leave now, they might end up dying here.

chapters.title: Chapter 65 "Turns out the 'Sands of Time' we've been pioneering is just the basic version?
chapters.content:
"Baa."
The reindeer pulling the sled flashed a hint of panic in its eyes, bleating softly as it tucked its head under the sled.
Probably frightened by the occasional glimpses of desire in the Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes.
"Don't worry, can't eat you."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked somewhat regretful as it drew its gaze away from the reindeer, wiping the drool from the corner of its mouth, then glanced at Tie Chui not far away, "Speaking of which, you're quite resistant to hunger. It's been three days, and you look like nothing's wrong."
Jiaye, lying on Tie Chui's head, murmured weakly with her head drooping, "Whether he eats or not, his mind stops working, so you can't really tell the difference from the outside."
"Let's go."
Chen Yi was the first to walk forward, stepping onto the white light circle and immediately a notification sounded in his ear.
'Ding, congratulations to the player and others for successfully reaching the fifth activation point.'
'Success escaping from the pursuit of the Dried Corpses.'
'As the Sands of Time Map has been cleared by players for the first time, congratulations to the players for successfully pioneering, please claim your pioneer rewards and exchange for the required props at the Points Store.'
'Following the successful pioneering, all players holding a "Sands of Time Pass" can teleport into this map from anywhere in the world unobstructed. Players who manage to reach the 'Sands of Time Map Entrance' through various means can also enter without a pass.'
As the notification ended.
The platform under their feet suddenly began to emanate a gentle glow, followed by the sound of soft music coming from somewhere.
Seven or eight fireworks shot into the sky all around the platform, bursting open within the pyramid's inner space without any smell of gunpowder!
Utterly spectacular!
It was as if they were celebrating their successful clearance.
At the same time—
Two massive leaderboards slowly emerged in front of them. Half-transparent panels hovered in mid-air with a sense of weightiness.
'Sands of Time Dried Corpse Players Infection Leaderboard!'
'Rank one: Vacant!'
'Rank two: Vacant!'
'Rank three: ...'
-
'Sands of Time Human Players Kill Points Leaderboard!'
'Rank one: Chen Yi, Kill Points 16702.'
'Rank two: Vacant!'
'Rank three: ...'
-
Two leaderboards, one for Dried Corpse players and the other for human players.
Chen Yi gazed thoughtfully at the two lists in front of him and nodded without speaking, noting there was also a leaderboard specifically set up for Dried Corpse players. It seemed likely that many players would deliberately become Dried Corpses to gain rewards by infecting human players.
"Actually, I think this map is pretty good."
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly spoke up, "We could just throw all the dying elderly, severely ill patients, or some disabled people into this map."
"Let them get infected into Dried Corpses."
"Dried Corpses in this map have the ability to resurrect indefinitely, meaning these people, as long as they don't leave the Sands of Time Map, will have the ability to resurrect endlessly. If children miss their elders, they can even come to the Sands of Time Map from time to time to see their family."
"In a way, it's like attaining immortality, effectively eradicating the separation of life and death."
Next to him, Jiaye, who had been listless and unclear-minded, suddenly regained clarity in her eyes upon hearing Tuberculosis Rabbit's words, looked up at the earnest Tuberculosis Rabbit, and realized what it meant to be half-demon, half-saint.
"Uh... Have you considered that some people might prefer to die rather than live endlessly as a Dried Corpse confined to one place?"
"I know."
Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged casually, "I never said we were going to do that; it's just a thought that suddenly popped into my head. It at least provides one more option for those about to leave this world."
"It's unclear whether Dried Corpse players and human players can communicate."
"Whether players who have turned into Dried Corpses can avoid chasing human players and just rot from the start, staying in some corner to build their own small Dried Corpse society."
"Or even negotiate with human players to keep boosting each other's points or something."
"Anyway, it feels like there are quite a few operable aspects in this instance."
"If you have a pass, you could also use it to teleport into the Sands of Time for a temporary escape whenever you face a fatal crisis."
...
Chen Yi withdrew his gaze from the leaderboard.
16702, that's the total number of points he had accumulated in three days.
There were in total only about a hundred Dried Corpses within the Sands of Time Map.
That meant, in these three days, he had averaged killing each Dried Corpse about 100 times; it was just too bad these Dried Corpses had no memory and no intelligence, otherwise, just the sight of Chen Yi would've made them quake in their boots.
Anyone who'd been killed over 100 times by the same person would probably have a bit of a psychological shadow.
And next—
It was naturally time to enjoy the spoils of these three days!
He took a deep breath, finished the last sip of milk tea, and licked his somewhat dry and cracked lips before turning his head to look at the Points Store next to him.
In these three days, he had only drunk fruit tea, not a single drop of water.
After all, fruit tea is just a beverage and not something that can be drunk in place of pure water for long term—too much sweetness, it only made you thirstier, and there was also the feeling of a sticky throat being blockaded.
Very uncomfortable.
Once out, he'd have to hug a water tank and drink for three days straight.
The Points Store in front of him, however, had everything from low to high exchange points available.
"1 Point: 1 Point."
"Small Speaker: 3 Points."
"Anti-Infection Energy Shield: 5 Points."
"Mini Steel Cable: 6 Points."
"Stone Brick Landmine: 10 Points."
"..."
Many of the items were exclusive for use within the Sands of Time Map.
For example, that Small Speaker would allow your next sentence to echo in the ears of all Dried Corpse players and human players within the Sands of Time.
Another example is the Anti-Infection Energy Shield, which could defend against being infected by a Dried Corpse player once.
And then there was the Stone Brick Landmine, which could be set as a landmine embedded within stone bricks, quite effective if used in the corridors of the second level.
In addition, there were even props prepared for Dried Corpse players.
"Eye of Truth: 3 Points."
"Might of the Steel Claw: 4 Points."
"Bouncing Shoes: 5 Points."
"Disguise Clothes: 10 Points."
"..."
These props could be purchased by anyone, but would only become effective when one became a Dried Corpse player, and their effects were quite powerful.
The Eye of Truth allowed Dried Corpse players to see which human players had the "Anti-Infection Energy Shield" and which didn't.
The Might of the Steel Claw extended the Dried Corpses' arm reach, making it more effective for Dried Corpse players to infect human players.
Bouncing Shoes boosted the Dried Corpse players' jumping height.
Disguise Clothes allowed a Dried Corpse player to disguise themselves as a human player for a short time, thus sneaking into human player teams and starting a massacre!
All of these were just the basics; besides them, the Points Store had many more props for both human and Dried Corpse players to use in the map.
What could be foreseen was.
Once these props fell into the players' hands, the scene of passing through the Sands of Time would undoubtedly be chaotic.
"Damn it..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the various props in the Points Store in front of him, straightening up with a somewhat shocked expression and murmured in astonishment.
"It turns out that our pioneer run of 'Sands of Time' was just the basic version?"
"With so many 'Sands of Time'-exclusive props added, even if we were to go through the map again, it feels like it would be a challenge."
"Dried Corpse players without intelligence and who can't use props, versus Dried Corpse players with intelligence who can use props."
"These are completely two different things!"
"I can even imagine those fully-armed Dried Corpse players in the 'Sands of Time', wearing Disguise Clothes and holding Might of the Steel Claw, strutting around arrogantly!"
...
PS: The novel will be available for purchase at midnight on March 15th, which is tomorrow night.
There will be a launch note after the regular update tomorrow, followed by the pay-to-read chapters at midnight.
Fellow readers, you can get your Points ready for subscription as Tuberculosis Rabbit's updates after the launch... are fierce.
Also, tomorrow at midnight there will be a Starting Point app splash screen recommendation and a launch first subscription event. I'm not clear about the details of the launch event, but there should be some rewards or something, so stay tuned (laughs).

chapters.title: Chapter 66 "Fashion Name": The Emperor's New Clothes - Short Sleeved.
chapters.content:
There were many such props in the Points Store, all of them little gadgets.
But they were the practical kind.
"A human player killing a Dried Corpse rewards 1 point."
"So how many points does a Dried Corpse player get for infecting a human player?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked thoughtfully at the Points Store in front of him and said, "After all, the map seems to give a bit more of an advantage to human players; human players can camp and farm points at the second level."
"But Dried Corpse players don't have the ability to farm points."
"With just those few players, even if all were infected, that's all the points there would be."
"So Dried Corpse players should get more points for infecting humans, right?"
Chen Yi didn't respond.
He just looked at the rewards in the Points Store in front of him and began to calculate which ones he could buy.
He started with the most expensive one and looked down the list.
The most expensive items were two props.
'Exclusive Title': Sands of Time Human Hero
'Exchange Price': 10,000 points.
'Limit of 5 per person.'
-
'Exclusive Title': Sands of Time Dried Corpse Pharaoh
'Exchange Price': 2,000 infection points.
'Limit of 5 per person.'
-
He could definitely buy the first title, as he had enough points.
But he couldn't buy the second title; it had to be purchased with infection points, and one infection point was awarded for infecting one player. To amass 2,000 infection points, he would have to infect 2,000 players.
He had never been a Dried Corpse, so he couldn't obtain that title.
Without much hesitation,
he secured the first title.
With the sound of a ding, his remaining points dropped to 6,702.
Then he continued to look further.
-
'Prop Name': Rainbow Tail Flame Trail.
'Prop Level': C-grade.
'Prop Effect': Can be embedded only in vehicles, making your vehicle leave behind a slowly dissipating rainbow tail flame trail in the air as it moves forward, extremely dazzling.
'Prop Introduction': The expensive things in this world are often useless, like... this prop.
'Exchange Price': 3,000 points.
"Buy!"
Without hesitation, Chen Yi waved his hand in satisfaction and embraced this prop even though it did not help improve his combat ability one bit, but he was very happy with it.
What could be more delightful than bringing game effects into the real world?
He was eager to see the rainbow tail flame trail his sleigh would leave behind in the sky as it took off.
It was all about making a splash!
If only he could beautifully decorate those 15 nitrogen cylinders at the back of his sleigh.
Just 3,000 points!
He had toiled hard in the map, sleeping on the Frozen Throne for a full three days, what was it all for, if not for this moment?
To appear saintly in public, one must endure hardships in private!
Besides, there was another tail flame trail that was quite flashy.
'Hundred Ghosts Tail Flame Trail'!
As the vehicle moved, it left behind a trail of mist, and in that mist, hundreds of Skeleton Soldiers surged and slowly dissipated.
He watched the special effect preview.
Very nice.
Only, he couldn't buy it; it required 600 infection points to buy this thing.
There were a number of props in the Points Store that could only be bought with infection points, which meant they were exclusively for Dried Corpse players. These props were just for him to look at, not to buy.
Up to now, he had no desire to turn into a Dried Corpse to grind points on the map.
However, these props were tradable, so maybe he could buy them from other players later on if he spent some Points.
It's just that he wasn't sure if anyone would be willing to sell, since players who could afford to buy these with spare infection points probably weren't short on Points either.
His gaze continued to wander the Points Store, and stopped hesitantly over an item.
"Prop Name": Fashion Component.
"Prop Level": C grade.
"Prop Effect": Can randomly obtain one component of a C grade fashion set.
"Prop Introduction": "Treat yourself, buy a few more skins."
"Exchange Price": 100 points.
"Limit of 5 per player."
He stared at the prop in front of him, hesitating without saying a word. He actually had a component of a fashion set in his hands—a bear onesie pajama that had been lying quietly in his backpack.
Not yet usable.
It could only be used after the fashion system update in June.
Of course.
Even after the fashion system update, he had no plans to walk down the street wearing a bear onesie pajama set.
He was fine with letting his character wear all sorts of odd and quirky outfits in the game, and the stranger they were, the happier he was.
But he would never, ever accept wearing weird and quirky fashions down the street in real life.
Still... he saw this item on sale in the shop for the first time, and it wasn't expensive, so was there any reason not to buy it?
None!
Buy!
Even if he really did get the bear onesie pajama, he certainly wouldn't wear it, but selling a complete set could fetch a high price.
After mentally making up his mind, he bought all 5 fashion components!
And with that, he only had 3202 points left!
Without any hesitation, he began to open the boxes.
He opened all 5 fashion component boxes.
"Ding ding ding..."
As the sounds of box opening rang out.
Chen Yi breathed a sigh of relief, slightly relaxed, yet his gaze turned to the results before him with a hint of disappointment—there were no bear pajama fashion components.
Luckily.
But...
His gaze suddenly turned weird, as if he got something strange.
"Fashion Name": The Emperor's New Clothes - Short Sleeved.
"Fashion Level": C grade.
"Fashion Effect": When wearing an item of this suit, it keeps the body at a constant temperature at all times. Collecting all pieces of the set will unlock the full set effect.
"Fashion Introduction": "A qualified emperor should learn how to cultivate his people's sense of fashion."
This item... was exactly like The Emperor's New Clothes that he had imagined.
The so-called short sleeves.
Were completely transparent, looking like they were made out of plastic.
Completely. Transparent!
Chen Yi suddenly fell silent, beginning to think that maybe the bear pajama wasn't that bad after all. At least compared to The Emperor's New Clothes, he felt the bear pajama to be somewhat more acceptable.
But the effect of this fashion was really strong.
Much stronger than his bear pajamas.
Keeping the body at a constant temperature meant that no matter how cold or hot the weather was, one could easily get through it without ever worrying about hypothermia or similar conditions.
Hypothermia could be very dangerous at times.
It was much better than his effect that allowed him not to need bathroom breaks.
Right at that moment, Jiaye beside him suddenly let out an excited exclamation of joy.
"I got a fashion set!"

chapters.title: Chapter 67 "I knew it; how could Tie Chui's sister possibly be called Jiaye?
chapters.content:
Chen Yi glanced curiously toward Jiaye, who was not far away.
He had thought that Tie Chui and his companion would possibly exchange their points for some Points or perhaps buy some items to boost their combat strength, but he didn't expect them to go straight for buying a Fashion Treasure Box?
That was indeed quite extravagant.
In the second level, only he and Tie Chui continued to farm points.
He relied on the Frozen Throne to farm points, while Tie Chui would occasionally use "Firm as a Rock" to charge headlong, and managed to farm quite a lot of points as well.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit didn't join the fight at all.
After all, the Rabbit's single strike was overkill for this place, there was simply no need for it.
Jiaye also didn't have any points.
This girl seemed to have no attack skills, but she must possess skills that enhance physical abilities; otherwise, being thrown around by Tie Chui every day like she was, her body would need to be strengthened or her brain might get shaken out.
It looked like Tie Chui used his own points to buy Jiaye a Fashion Component Treasure Box.
But speaking of which,
Jiaye was petite but had a nice figure, curvy, with quite a large chest.
She seemed to easily entice the destructive desires in men's hearts.
He had once heard a theory suggesting that men who prefer petite women have a strong subconscious desire to dominate and destroy, enjoying the feeling of conquest and obliteration.
He had forgotten where he read that, some marketing blog post, perhaps.
"Thank you."
Jiaye, who seemed somewhat lethargic from not eating for a few days, looked toward the Fashion panel in front of her, her smile blossoming like smoke, her eyes squinting into crescents.
Full of anticipation, she carefully tucked the prop into her backpack.
"I'll wear it after the update in June."
"What's the Fashion Name?"
The Tuberculosis rabbit, seemingly curious, casually spoke as he pulled out a pepper-flavored carrot from his chest and stuffed it into his mouth, "Yi also has a Fashion Component, his outfit looks pretty good as well."
And as the Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out the carrot,
A deer hiding under the sled flashed a visible panic in its eyes and dove under the sled, its hind legs struggling on the ground.
"Don't worry, I won't feed it to you this time."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit munched on the carrot with some displeasure, "If it weren't for worrying about you starving these past few days, who would give you such tasty carrots to eat?"
"Speaking of which, just how many of these carrots did you eat at Santa Claus' place?"
"Eating one of these carrots is like going to the gallows for you."
"I thought you just liked eating carrots, but it turns out you're simply not fond of these fancy flavored ones. I personally think they taste quite good, crunchy and they don't stick in your teeth."
"By the way, Jiaye, what's your Fashion?"
"Here."
Jiaye waved her hand, projecting the Fashion Component from her backpack into the air.
'Fashion Name': Blazing Summer - Spaghetti Strap Sundress.
'Fashion Level': C.
'Fashion Effect': When wearing one piece of this set, each step taken will cause waves to ripple underfoot, and upon collecting the entire set, the full set effect will be unlocked.
'Fashion Introduction': "Have you been to the beach? Go take a look. The breeze by the sea can easily stir men's ambitions and women's romantic feelings."
"This outfit is called Blazing Summer, and this is one of the components, a spaghetti strap sundress."
"..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was munching on a carrot, upon seeing the Fashion displayed in the air, suddenly stiffened and fell silent.
After a while, he gulped down the remaining carrot in his mouth all at once.
"It's pretty nice, do you plan to wear it?"
"Yeah, I will," Jiaye replied earnestly, her voice crisp as she cocked her head to the side, "Don't you guys think this style is very refreshing and simple?"
"It looks cute, but it reveals just a tiny bit too much."
"I might be criticized as someone edging on inappropriate."
"But even if it's edgy, it doesn't matter."
"The world has come to this, who knows when we'll die; might as well try things I've never tried before while I can."
Then she looked toward the Tuberculosis Rabbit's shocked expression and couldn't help but laugh.
"Tuberculosis Rabbit, could you manage your shocked look a bit?"
"I grew up orphaned, living a tough life with a handicapped brother, never really had much luck. Now that the end has come, I should at least try some things I've never had the chance to try before, right?"
"I've longed to wear some clothes I've never worn before, not like before when I had to drag my brother to the market to sell fish during the day, stinking and soiled."
"It was only at night that I could secretly put on the little dress I bought and stroll down the streets with my brother, but..."
Jiaye suddenly sniffed and mumbled with slight dissatisfaction, "It's just that often, I'd see some drunk man's vomit in the tree pits, which really ruins the mood."
"We only live for about 30,000 days, shouldn't we live the life we desire?"
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stayed silent where he was, not understanding but deeply shocked; however, he did understand one thing, Jiaye would really wear that dress.
"We must meet up in June."
"What's going on?"
"There's going to be a new rule in the version update in June. I'm afraid you won't get it, so let's meet up and Yi and I will explain it to you."
"I see."
Jiaye nodded with crescent eyes and couldn't help but smile, "That would be great."
"Alright."
Chen Yi cast a weird glance at Tuberculosis Rabbit before saying, "I've spent all the points, it's time to prepare to leave. I need to rest well for a few days, these past days have felt more exhausting than if Santa Claus chased me for a whole day."
"Why do I keep thinking about being chased by Santa Claus for a day?"
He frowned slightly, pondering for a moment before sighing, "Seems like I'm quite a grudge-holder, aren't I?"
"Okay, time to go."
With the remaining points, he exchanged them for some boxes with props and Skill Fragments.
He didn't exchange any Points.
Exchanging for Points was definitely not worth it, as 1 point could only be exchanged for 1 Point.
Definitely a loss.
Killing a Dried Corpse in this map is not so easy.
After all, it's the black mist mode.
...
And just stepping out from the Sands of Time Map, Chen Yi shielded his eyes with his hand, adjusting to the glaring sunlight outside, before he noticed that, somehow, so many players had gathered at the entrance to the Sands of Time Pyramid.
At this moment, all the players were staring at him with piercing eyes.
In the background.
He seemed to hear these players collectively let out a sigh of relief.
"Um... we're going to head off, okay?"
Seemingly afraid of being stared at by so many people, Jiaye tugged at Tie Chui's clothes, then turned his head towards Chen Yi, "I've sent both of you friend requests. If you need anything in the future, you can contact us. Let's help each other out."
"Yeah, go ahead."
"See you, Tie Chui."
The next second.
Tie Chui grabbed Jiaye around the waist, took a deep breath, and with a pitcher's backward throw motion, hurled Jiaye high into the air.
"Alright, Iron Nail."
Then he turned to Yi with a naive smile, saying in a deep voice, "Well... brother, I'm off..."
Suddenly—
Before Tie Chui finished speaking, he was forcefully pulled back by Jiaye using a skill from mid-air.
A voice that seemed somewhat frustrated and embarrassed could be faintly heard.
"How many times have I told you, don't call me Iron Nail when we're out, call me Jiaye!!!"
"Ah, you're so annoying!!!"
"It's so embarrassing, okay!!!"
...
"Tsk."
Tuberculosis Rabbit shielded his eyes with his palm and, watching the two small dark spots disappear at the horizon, couldn't help but remark admiringly, "That's a truly unique way to travel."
"And to think Tie Chui hasn't eaten for three days, yet he still has so much strength."
"Also..."
Out of sudden contentment, Tuberculosis Rabbit smiled broadly, "I just knew there's no way Tie Chui's sister would be called Jiaye."
"Calling her Iron Nail sounds more reasonable."
"I'm very pleased with that name."

chapters.title: Chapter 68 Shelf Remarks!!!
chapters.content:
On-the-Shelf Speech.
Well, it finally happened, getting on the shelf... Writing 4000 words each day is truly challenging, it has left me exhausted.
This book has done quite well, from the moment it got recommended it has been pretty much first among its peers, and you, dear readers, have passionately followed it, pushing it to the second spot at the highest point on the new book rankings, and steadily in the fifth spot.
I am truly honored.
The competition in this period's new book rankings is still fierce, with Squid's book in first place...
Being suppressed by a giant is reasonable.
To be honest, the pressure has been immense.
After being on the new book rankings for 30 days post-signing with the contract, I sighed in relief; being sandwiched between so many titans was quite nerve-wracking.
Let me just briefly talk about the update volume after going on the shelf.
Let's set a simple and crude military order.
If the initial subscriptions are 6000, 8000 words will be updated daily after being on the shelf, taking it easy.
If the initial subscriptions are 7000, 12,000 words will be updated daily after being on the shelf, being a bit more serious.
If the initial subscriptions are 8000, 16,000 words will be updated daily after being on the shelf, it's time to squint.
If the initial subscriptions are 9000, 20,000 words will be updated daily after being on the shelf, it's time to turn on the screen.
Initial subscriptions refer to the number of people subscribing within 24 hours to the first chapter that charges fees after going on the shelf.
I am an octopus monster as an author, as long as I keep up the daily quota, the quality won't be bad; I can type 3000 words in an hour, so 20,000 words is just about 7 hours of work.
Including breaks and thinking about the plot and such, it's at most 10 hours.
For a full-time author, working 10 hours a day isn't too strenuous.
Let's also talk about the additional update rules.
On top of the daily updates.
Starting from 500 monthly tickets, for every additional 500 monthly tickets, 1 large chapter will be added.
For the Alliance Master, add 1 large chapter.
For Silver Alliance Masters, add 10 large chapters, Gold Alliance Masters... let's go with 100 large chapters.
After getting on the shelf, each chapter's update will be between 3000 to 4000 words, equivalent to 2 chapters of the free chapters before being on the shelf.
For the rewards and additional updates, dear readers, please do as much as you're comfortable with.
The two Alliance Masters before going on the shelf, after the shelf, will get additional updates, totaling 2 chapters.
Well... that's roughly all I have to say.
Last but not least, I'm asking for an initial subscription, begging for an initial subscription.
Initial subscriptions are crucial to the success of a book.
Dear readers, please support me with an initial subscription; those who want to nourish the book can subscribe first and then nourish it, as it will thrive the more it is nourished.
Give an initial subscription, and after reaching the daily update standard of 20,000 words.
After a month of nourishing, this book will have reached a million words, and that is a reasonable way to nourish a book.
-
Updating on the shelf will happen tonight at midnight, starting with 3 chapters, which is about ten thousand words.
Then, from midnight tonight, the updates will continue intermittently until midnight the following night.
Thank you for your support, dear readers, and by the way, I'm asking for a wave of monthly tickets, as I'm a bit eager to rush the new book monthly ticket rankings after getting on the shelf, there are cash prizes for the top ten.
At home, my wife is counting on this bonus money to scrape by, and it's becoming a bit hard to afford meals.
Sob sob.
Love you guys.

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 69 - 68: We Need a Cook (First Order Requested!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 69 – 68: We Need a Cook (First Order Requested!)
And after Chen Yi and the others walked out from the Sands of Time Pyramid map,
the light screen at the entrance slowly changed.
“The Sands of Time map has been successfully pioneered by—Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Tie Chui, Jiaye, a four-man team.”
“Players can gain entry by obtaining the ’Sands of Time Pass’ and reaching the entrance of Sands of Time.”
“A maximum of 50 human players may enter at the same time.”
“This map is a parallel map, and up to 100 Sands of Time maps can be opened at once, available for human players to challenge.”
It can be roughly understood that.
At any moment, a maximum of 5000 people can enter this map simultaneously; once these people have either completed the challenge or are wiped out, the next batch of players can enter.
This actually reduces the chances for collusion between dried corpse players and human players to farm points.
After all, with 100 parallel Sands of Time maps, it’s hard to ensure you’ll end up in the same one together in a room.
“Chen Yi.”
Just as Chen Yi was seeing off Jiaye and another person, a man in uniform with a serious expression quickly approached from a short distance, stopping in front of Chen Yi and letting out a slight sigh of relief.
“It’s good that you’re okay. You’ve been in the map for three days, and a lot of people have been quite worried about you.”
“About that…”
Before Chen Yi could respond, the man hesitated slightly before continuing, “Could you roughly talk about what you encountered in the map, like the general content of the map, were there any deadly traps and such?”
“You won’t be talking for nothing, the Law Enforcement Bureau is willing to pay you 3000 Points for the information, although it’s a bit less for someone like you, but now…”
“Captain Wang,”
Chen Yi looked at the middle-aged man in front of him, took out two cigarettes and handed one over. After the middle-aged man took one, Chen Yi put the other one back into the pack, interrupting what he was about to say, and then smiled.
“No need, it’s all just some minor tricks which I was planning to share with the players in Yancheng anyway.”
“This map is quite easy to farm for points in, the only issue is that it’s rather dangerous.”
“After I go back, I’ll make a forum post in Yancheng, so everyone can see it.”
“Before the post is out, perhaps hold off on sending anyone else in.”
“Really?”
Captain Wang was taken aback, looking at Chen Yi with excitement briefly lighting up his eyes, “That would be much appreciated, all the players in Yancheng will remember this favor.”
“And…”
He hesitated slightly before speaking further, “Let’s put the past behind us, shall we? Every department has a few of those types of people, it’s unavoidable.”
“The Law Enforcement Bureau and the military have now merged, and the person who took action against you last time has been transferred elsewhere.”
“It’s fine.”
Chen Yi waved his hand dismissively and then climbed onto the sled, “I’m heading out, just wait for my post.”
With those words,
the sled slowly levitated into mid-air.
The 15 nitrogen cylinders at its rear began to emit a pale yellow flame, and then abruptly, the flames turned a light blue, shooting off into the distance like an arrow released from its bow in the next second!
It disappeared in an instant!
Leaving behind a long, colorful tail of flame across the sky that slowly dissipated.
…
“Damn, what on earth is that?”
“Isn’t that a bit over the top?”
The players gathered around the entrance of the Sands of Time Pyramid looked up at the colorful tail of flame in the sky, feeling a surge of shock inside.
This thing… must cost quite a few Points, right?
No, they had never even seen this thing for sale.
Could it be a reward from the Sands of Time Pyramid?
…
“Phew!”
Han Yu, holding a dagger in the crowd, looked enviously at the colorful phantom and clenched his fists in a silent vow.
One day!
He too would own a vehicle and procure such a phantom for himself!
Carrying his family, he would fly stylishly over the heads of the crowd!
…
“Hmm…”
Li Yide, thoughtful, stroked the fox tail behind his buttocks and turned his head to look at the entrance of Sands of Time, beginning to ponder.
The fox tail behind him was a vehicle well-known on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard.
A Grade D Vehicle “Orange Flavor Exploding Beads.”
Once activated, it provides the capability of straight-line flight for a short period of time.
And that fox tail was an accessory he had added, acting much like a tail rudder.
It allowed him to slightly adjust the turning direction in mid-flight by controlling the sphincter, making the vehicle much more agile rather than just charging forward as before.
If he added such a colorful rainbow flame tail effect to his vehicle, it would look pretty cool, wouldn’t it?
This prop seemed to be obtainable from the Sands of Time map.
Above his head was a large title.
“Lucky Child of the God of Love”
“De,”
Standing beside Li Yide, a gaunt man spoke with a tremble in his voice, “Are we really going into the Sands of Time map?”
“Chen Yi himself took 3 days to clear it, it feels like our chances are slim.”
“What if we get wiped out?”
“What’s there to be scared of?”
Li Yide shrugged nonchalantly, luxuriously swished his fox tail behind him, and then laid his hands behind his head, leisurely saying, “My Lucky Child of the God of Love has bound so many people, it’s hard to die.”
“Don’t panic, let’s see what the situation is like for others who have gone in before making plans.”
At that moment—
The Law Enforcement Bureau informed the players gathered around that Chen Yi was about to organize the strategy into a post on the Yancheng forum for everyone to view for free.
Suddenly.
Everyone burst into excited cheers.
With such a strong player willing to selflessly share their tips for clearing the game, many felt gratitude towards Chen Yi in their hearts.
…
“Boss!!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking exhausted, threw himself on the table at a covered rice dish restaurant and bellowed, “Give me an egg and tomato covered rice bowl!”
“Extra eggs, extra tomatoes, extra sauce, extra rice.”
“Hurry!!”
“I’m starving to death.”
Chen Yi, sitting beside him, wasn’t faring much better, merely waving his hand, “Two dishes for me, one stir-fried garlic sprouts with cured meat, and one twice-cooked pork with potato slices.”
“Alrighty!”
The bored and agitated owner of the restaurant, seeing no customers, brightened up when Chen Yi and his companion entered, and immediately sprang up and dashed into the kitchen.
“Just a moment, it’ll be right up!”
These days, there weren’t many people who would spend Points to come to his restaurant for a meal.
…
“Satisfied!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shoveled the last bite of rice soaked in soup into his stomach and then slumped in his chair, lighting up a cigarette with a lifeless gaze and murmuring.
“Feeling full is such a blessing.”
“This won’t do, Yi, we can’t cook, and stockpiling food is no use.”
“We can usually find a way to manage it.”
“But in cases like this map that takes days to complete, we’re seriously going to starve, and though there are props to fend off hunger, they’re just filler and utterly useless.”
“My suggestion is we find a teammate.”
“Someone who can cook, and we’ll bring him along every time we enter a map. He won’t need to do anything else, just carry all the necessary gear on his back.”
“Everything like the gas stove, the ingredients, pots, and pans.”
“That way, next time we encounter a life-threatening dungeon like Sands of Time, we can leisurely enjoy the delicacies made by this cook.”
“What do you think?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly sat up straight, turned his head with a serious look, and earnestly said to Yi, “Let’s find a cook. We need a cook.”
“Chaos is upon us, relying on just the two of us is insufficient.”
“We need to form a team.”
“And the first step for this team is to find a cook, a cook who makes delicious food.”
“Er…”
Chen Yi mulled it over, quite tempted, and didn’t speak immediately. Honestly, he didn’t just want a cook; he wanted a masseuse as well.
These three days inside Sands of Time had been tough.
Although he hadn’t sat on the Frozen Throne continuously, occasionally getting up to rest on a sleigh for a while—after all, the Frozen Throne’s cooldown was only 30 minutes—it wasn’t that long.
Still.
After these three days, he felt his back was sore and stiff. If he had a masseuse, the next time he faced this kind of situation, a masseuse could help relieve his muscle fatigue.
“You make sense.”
After musing for a moment, Chen Yi scooped up the last spoonful of rice with cured meat sauce into his mouth, savoring the chew, and waited until he had swallowed it all.
He then took the mineral water from the table, drank it all in one go, lit a cigarette, sighed deeply, leaned back in his chair, and propped his arm on the chair backrest, sitting sideways.
“It’s time to start forming a team, we indeed need a cook.”
“But we need to pick the right person, first and foremost, someone honest, not the backstabbing type.”
“And next…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit seriously took over, “Next, the cooking must be delicious.”
“Exactly.”
After settling the bill with the owner, Chen Yi walked briskly towards the sleigh parked at the front of the shop, “Next, the cooking must be delicious.”
At the restaurant’s entrance.
Many players were circling the sleigh nearby, gaping in awe and gingerly observing this top-ranked vehicle on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard.
Those 15 nitrogen cylinders looked particularly eye-catching!
The moose lying on the ground, listlessly dangling its ears, also seemed irresistibly touchable to anyone passing by.
However, the air conditioning unit hanging off the side of the sleigh seemed somewhat out of place.
Yet, not a single player dared to touch the sleigh with their hands.
A few mischievous children were eager to try touching the sleigh, but their parents held them tightly in their arms, unwilling to let go no matter how much the kids cried or fussed!
Are you kidding?
If they scratched this sleigh, it would be far more serious than scratching some Ferrari in the past.
This was the world’s top vehicle; what could possibly compensate for it?
Who could afford that?
Besides… this was no longer just a matter of compensation, but one that could potentially cost lives if handled carelessly.
“What’s up?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood at the doorway, a cigarette in his mouth, hands in his pockets, and grinned at the players surrounding the sleigh, “Like it, huh? Do you want it, should I give it to you guys?”

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 70 - 69: "If you do not abandon me, I am willing to acknowledge you as my sworn father." (Second upon release!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 70 – 69: “If you do not abandon me, I am willing to acknowledge you as my sworn father.” (Second chapter upon release!)
Along with the sound of the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s voice.
The players surrounding the sleigh scattered in all directions, exchanging glances without a word, merely hiding to one side with snickers.
Naturally, no one took the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s words seriously.
Nor was there anyone audacious enough to speak up and say, “I want it.”
“Hey.”
Looking at the scene before him, the Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in satisfaction, “Now I can finally understand the feeling of those who drive luxury cars to dinner.”
Yi was about to store the sleigh back in his backpack, but the Tuberculosis Rabbit insisted that he must park the vehicle in front of the door.
Which is the current situation.
Indeed, it turned out as he expected.
Many people were observing their sleigh, checking what made this world’s first vehicle so special.
“It’s just a bit of a pity.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked around regretfully, “The restaurant’s class is a bit low, there’s no valet to park the car, and I’ve got a classic line left unsaid. I wonder when I’ll have the chance to use it.”
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yi casually patted a child’s head by the roadside, playfully tweaked his nose, then strode towards the sleigh and slowly ascended under the watchful eyes of the public.
He then shot off into the distance, leaving behind a long, colorful trail of rainbow flames.
Just like a rainbow after a rain.
Quite spectacular.
…
Before long, they returned to their own neighborhood and, as usual, parked the sleigh on the rooftop of their building.
“Here you go.”
Chen Yi pushed the twice-cooked pork and potato rice he had been carrying towards the reindeer, “You gonna eat this?”
He bought two servings of food, ate one himself, and took the other with him.
He decided to pack a serving for the reindeer after seeing it seemed to resist the oddly flavored carrots in the Sands of Time Map, which led him to a theory.
Maybe the reindeer didn’t actually like those ordinary carrots.
Maybe it would eat anything that didn’t have an odd flavor.
That’s why he tentatively took a serving of rice for the reindeer to try.
The previously listless reindeer suddenly looked up at Chen Yi with disbelief and bright eyes when it saw a portion of twice-cooked pork rice being slowly pushed in front of it.
Seeing Chen Yi nod and gesture for it to start eating,
The reindeer’s eyes instantly reddened, tears welling up, and it let out a long howl to the sky.
“Meh!!!”
Then, with a flash of human-like excitement and exhilaration in its eyes, it buried its face in the lunchbox and started gobbling up the food, looking as ravenous as a ghost that had been suppressed under Five Fingers Mountain for five hundred years.
“You really like it that much?”
A look of surprise flashed in Chen Yi’s eyes, and he couldn’t help but laugh, “It seems that aside from those carrots, you’re quite fond of everything else?”
“Our future teammate cook might have to prepare a meal for the reindeer as well.”
When he stored the reindeer along with the sleigh in his backpack, the creature would fall asleep but wouldn’t be in absolute time stasis, meaning even when inside the backpack, the reindeer could still get hungry.
He had to take care of the reindeer’s diet.
After all, if the reindeer had any issues due to hunger, that meant the vehicle would be out of commission.
It wouldn’t be easy to catch another Santa Claus’s reindeer again.
Luck doesn’t come knocking on the door every time.
“Well, how do I put this…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit stood still with hands in pockets, looking at the content reindeer with a strangely colored expression, and murmured, “If only the reindeer could speak, I feel like it would be on its knees thanking you right now and preparing a little speech.”
“Adrift in life, lamenting not meeting a great master.”
“Should you not reject me, I wish to acknowledge you as my adoptive father.”
It must be said that the reindeer’s current state really does fit this little speech.
You could see it.
If this No. 2378 reindeer known as Five-Spice told the other Santa Claus’s reindeer about its treatment with Chen Yi, they would probably all defect and come to Chen Yi’s side the next day.
Then they would wait eagerly at his doorstep every day for him to feed them.
After the reindeer was satisfied with its meal, burping contentedly and collapsing back on the ground,
Chen Yi only then put the reindeer and sleigh back into his backpack and headed downstairs, “Let’s go, when we get back we’ll upload the post, and then get ready to sleep.”
…
However, as they arrived at the door of their home, they suddenly saw the hallway in front of their door blocked by about seven or eight people.
All holding machetes with unfriendly looks, as if ready to start a fight at any disagreement.
“Get lost.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit took a step forward, flicking away his cigarette butt at Scarface, who was leading the group, with irritation, “Do you understand me? I’m tired and want to sleep.”
“I don’t want to kill anyone before sleeping; it tends to lead to nightmares, get it?”
Scarface’s face went cold as he looked at the cigarette butt that fell at his feet. He said nothing, but stepped slightly back, revealing a middle-aged man in a suit standing behind him.
“Good afternoon to you both.”
This middle-aged man in a suit casually pulled out a property certificate from his suit with a mischievous smile, “We are all civilized people; we should talk reasonably. This certificate is for this house of yours.”
“You two have struck it rich now.”
“But have you forgotten that you’re renting this house?”
“I’ve come to collect the rent; that wouldn’t be a problem, would it?”
“No matter where this issue is taken, even if it’s to the Law Enforcement Bureau, I’m in the right. Isn’t that correct?”
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was taken aback for a moment, then immediately rolled up his sleeve and pulled out a Claw Knife from his chest, pointing it at the middle-aged man in front of him, “Have you come here to cheat your Grandpa Rabbit?”
“We paid the rent for a whole year at the beginning of the year, and there’s still over half a year left before it expires. What are you coming here demanding rent for now?”
“Big brother.”
The middle-aged man in the suit spread his hands with a helpless look and said, “Go out and have a look, brothers. You need Points for practically everything these days, right?”
“Not everyone has so many Points on hand. We’re all tight for them.”
“Can you still pay rent with cash now? Of course, it has to be calculated in Points!”
“5000 Points for a year’s rent.”
“As soon as you two pay the rent now, I’ll leave immediately. Otherwise, you two definitely won’t be able to return home today and will have to move out temporarily.”
“…”
After Chen Yi glanced at the other tightly closed doors on both sides, he looked up with slight weariness at the few people in front of him, “You weren’t our landlord before, were you?”
“Hmm, I just bought this property a few days ago, so I’m the landlord now.”
“Alright, 5000 Points, right?”
“Come here, I’ll transfer it to you.”
The middle-aged man in the suit froze for a moment, but without overthinking, he walked over immediately. However, to be on the safe side, he added another sentence, “I have relatives working at the Law Enforcement Bureau.”
“Everything I’m doing now is legal.”
“I believe you know how to make the right choice.”
“Hmm, I know.”
Once the middle-aged man was close enough,
Chen Yi heaved a sigh and pulled out a sniper rifle from his chest with an arm as straight as a Sword Cultivator’s, and fiercely aimed straight at the man’s eye socket and thrust!
“Bang!”
Under the enhancement of doubled physical fitness, the middle-aged man barely caught sight of something stabbing at him and had no time to react,
While his body immediately stiffened and fell straight backwards, heavily crashing to the ground.
However, just as Chen Yi pulled out the sniper rifle and calmly held it to walk toward the remaining people in the corridor, the middle-aged man who was lying on the ground suddenly stood up shakily.
“Dammit…”
The middle-aged man in the suit, clutching his blood-gushing eye socket with a ferocious and hysterical expression, stared at Chen Yi with bulging eyes and screamed, “You killed Ya!!!”
“You killed my Ya!!!”
Chen Yi frowned, but upon seeing the “Lucky Child of the God of Love” title above the man’s head, he understood what had happened.
The judgment must have taken effect.
The man’s woman had taken the Fatal Strike for him.
The woman died, and the man was revived.
“What a hassle.”
Chen Yi sighed lightly, weighed the sniper rifle in his hand a few times, and then again stride towards the middle-aged man!
So, he was alive again? No problem.
Just kill him one more time.
The doubled physical fitness made killing these little Carlas as simple as slaughtering chickens.
He definitely wouldn’t open his mouth for 5000 Points, let alone 5000 Points, he wouldn’t give these people even 50 Points.
He could easily give away 50 Points, but he wouldn’t let himself be extorted for even 10 Points.
Open his mouth once, and there would be many more times after that, and these people would cling to him like persistent plasters.
Since they had planned to extort him, they must have been prepared for death, right?
“I only wanted to collect some rent; I didn’t plan on killing anyone!”
The middle-aged man in the suit screamed uncontrollably with a voice swelled with pain, “Yet you killed my Ya, and now you want to kill me!”
“Then let’s die together!”
As his voice fell,
The Prop the man had been keeping in the right pocket of his trousers was abruptly activated!
Then—
The hallway suddenly plunged into darkness, as a somewhat sinister woman’s laugh echoed intermittently in everyone’s ears.
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi stood still with a slight frown and calmly said, “Damn.”
But this time… his title seemed to have failed, as no light erupted from it.
The surroundings remained pitch-black.
Before he could make any more moves, he heard the laughter suddenly go from distant to near by his ear.
“Giggle… giggle.”
Immediately after, he felt a warm breath by his ear and a cold hand abruptly placed on his back, creeping towards his neck.
Chen Yi didn’t turn his head; he just weighed the sniper rifle in his hand and then thrust it full force behind him!
“Pfft!”
It was as if he stabbed something, and yet it felt like he hit nothing.
But soon, the darkness dissipated, the woman’s laughter ceased, everything returned to silence, and the real scene before his eyes was revealed.
Along the corridor,
The middle-aged man in the suit and the seven or eight men with machetes had all shrunk into a corner, their bodies violently trembling, clutching their necks and screaming incessantly.
“Get out, get out!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 71 - 70: "Oh, the hand is quite slippery." (Three more s up!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 71 – 70: “Oh, the hand is quite slippery.” (Three more chapters up!)
The men huddled in the corner, their eyes almost bulging out, stared straight ahead.
They clutched their necks tightly with both hands.
The fear on their faces seemed almost ready to spill out of the pages.
Their bodies trembled so violently that a scientist might consider whether they could be a sustainable energy source—except their pupils were clearly lifeless, unfocused, and their gazes somewhat scattered.
They continued to mutter to themselves in low, panicked tones, laced with fear.
“Don’t come any closer, I command you speedily, may Buddha bless me.”
“Quick, think of something else, right, I once had a breakup, and it was really tough!”
“That was an experience from my high school days; it was about the girl who sat next to me whom I really liked—we used to bunk classes together and go out to eat.”
“During nap time, when we’d rest our heads on the desks, I’d casually let my elbow touch hers, even if it was just a small contact.”
“But it made me incredibly nervous inside, that ambiguous feeling that just thinking about it made it hard to resist sinking into the memories.”
“I knew she wasn’t asleep either, both of us savoring that ambiguous sensation.”
As he spoke to himself, the fear on the face of the man huddled in the corner with a knife began to slowly fade, replaced with a hint of tranquility and remembrance.
Chen Yi, deep in thought, squatted not far from this man, listening intently to his monologue, realizing it was a way to force himself not to conjure images of ghosts in his mind.
But how can you control it when that thing is right behind you, touching you with its hands?
He could control it because he had no fear.
It wasn’t that he couldn’t visualize ghosts in his mind; rather, he had no fear and could easily banish any mental images of ghosts.
As the man in the corner resumed his monologue, the fear visibly diminished from his face, but his hands continued to protect his neck tightly, exuding a stronger sense of calm.
“Later, we got together—that was a truly happy time.”
“But then the breakup happened, after which I was really in pain.”
“Let me think about what she said when we broke up.”
“I remember now, she said I was as ugly as a ghost.”
“Uh… a ghost?”
The man curled up in the corner suddenly froze, his hands around his neck loosening subconsciously, and in the next instant, terror flooded his pupils.
“A ghost!!!”
And then—
“Bang!”
The man’s body exploded in the corridor, tearing apart, with his blood and flesh smearing the whole hallway, leaving behind only a Skill Fragment on the ground.
Chen Yi, having foreseen this scene, had already taken cover in the opposite corridor before the explosion.
After the explosion, he emerged again, glancing with some distaste at the bloody scene around him, then looked thoughtfully at the remaining people.
He might understand now why his title wasn’t lighting up.
The incident just now occurred in his mind, an illusion—which means the title would light up, but it was invisible to him.
His vision was trapped within his own mind.
This prop… under the May rules, is indeed a mutually destructive tool.
At least for others, it’s usually a death sentence.
Chen Yi, glancing at the Tuberculosis Rabbit beside him, remained silent without speaking. He was initially quite concerned about the Tuberculosis Rabbit when he first came out, but after a glance at it and the others, he suddenly felt that worrying about the Tuberculosis Rabbit was a fundamentally wrong choice.
Not far off, the men huddled in the corner were yelling hysterically.
“Don’t come here, get away from me!”
If it wasn’t spoken words forcibly shifting the attention from their minds, then what was it?
Meanwhile, the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s situation appeared rather odd…
“Yo, pretty smooth hands.”
“Don’t run, let me touch you, I’ve never felt a female ghost before.”
“Tsk tsk, this feels so real, is this an illusion or what? Amazing.”
“That shy laughter, I like it.”
“…”
Chen Yi silently shifted his gaze from the Tuberculosis Rabbit and strode toward a middle-aged man dressed in a suit huddled in a corner, pulling a prop from his pocket.
That man was the one who activated the prop, causing everything that had happened.
’Prop Name’: Banshee’s Feast.
’Prop Level’: C-class.
’Prop Effect’: Upon activation, pull everyone nearby into an illusion where a personal Banshee will provide you with a massage lasting half an hour.
’Prop Limitations’: Using it once will result in a 24-hour cooldown.
’Prop Description’: “Banshees don’t have offensive capabilities; they don’t even have teeth.”
“No offensive ability?”
Chen Yi was taken aback for a moment, looking at the introduction panel on the prop and then realizing the cold, delicate hand that had reached for his neck in the illusion.
It wasn’t planning to attack him.
It was about to give him a massage.
Damn it… should’ve said that earlier.
He had killed that Banshee already.
Which means the Banshee’s massage service could’ve lasted half an hour, but if it were killed, then the Succubus would disappear.
And this rule wasn’t mentioned on the prop’s panel.
At this moment—
Those huddled thugs in the corner, unable to contain their inner terror and the increasingly vivid images of ghosts in their minds, exploded one after another!
“Boom, boom, boom!!!”
Soon, only the Tuberculosis Rabbit was left in the whole corridor.
Chen Yi glanced at the Tuberculosis Rabbit, his mouth twitching slightly, and still without a word, he walked to the side staircase, lit a cigarette, and leaned against the wall, waiting patiently.
…
A full half hour passed.
“Is it over?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit’s gaze suddenly cleared, looking down somewhat blankly at the space in front of him, which was empty and desolate surrounded by bloodstains everywhere.
“That’s it, huh.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, feeling slightly unsatisfied, pulled up his pants: “That was kind of fun.”
But when he scanned the surroundings and didn’t see Yi, he immediately became anxious, searching among the chunks of flesh on the ground and shouting with a trembling voice, “Yi, Yi, where are you?”
“Yi, don’t scare me, man!”
“Yi!”
“Over here.”
Chen Yi, with a cigarette in his mouth and expressionless, walked out from the neighboring corridor: “I’m not dead, stop your wailing.”
“Phew!”
Seeing this, the Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a long sigh of relief, then put down a chunk of flesh he was holding and looked around: “Are they all dead? All died right at our doorstep, how unlucky.”
“Yi, wait for me, I’ll go inside to grab some tools and clean this place up before I go to sleep.”
…
Dozens of minutes later.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, slightly out of breath, stood up and wiped the sweat from his forehead, looking toward the body bags piled up against the wall, he finally breathed a sigh of relief: “Finally done, now I can sleep.”
“First, let’s throw the trash to the outskirts.”
Upon activating the sled, within a few minutes, the two of them had dumped the trash at the garbage plant in the suburbs, which was still operating.
As the vehicle disappeared.
Many of the city’s basic public services had gone, such as… waste disposal.
To date, the amount of waste generated within the city each day is not insignificant, and transporting it out of the city to waste facilities is a laborious task for humans.
It can only be moved by a handcart, pulled by people.
Very exhausting.
But, one point of relief is that the waste produced in the city has decreased significantly compared to before, after all, there’s not much left to consume, and the city is still barely functioning.
But there’s no time to worry about that now.
After all, there are far more pressing matters at hand, so all that can be done is to urge the reduction of waste and the manual transportation of trash out of the city as much as possible.
Currently, there are not enough Points to pay wages, and many are willing to work for just food.
Former bank savings have become worthless paper.
Everyone must seriously consider two issues.
Food and safety.
…
Finally.
After sorting everything out, Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit finished washing up and lay in their own beds.
Chen Yi, while organizing his Sands of Time strategies to post on Yancheng forum, casually asked, “Hey Tuberculosis Rabbit, when you were pulled into the illusion, didn’t you think of ghosts at all?”
“Ghosts?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, still feeling the thrill of the experience, shook his head while lying on the bed: “No ghostly images came to mind at all, who could think of ghosts in such a slippery situation?”
“This Prop is really something.”
“I’ve collected it.”
“Later on, when we’re roughing it in some map for a few days, we can use this Prop in the middle to take a break and relax.”
“True.”
Chen Yi nodded, finished organizing the strategy, and uploaded it before lying exhausted on the bed and closing his eyes: “I’m off to sleep.”
Not long after.
The sound of Chen Yi’s faint snoring filled the room.
Perhaps due to exhaustion, the usually non-snoring Chen Yi started snoring today.
“Oh.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded and soon fell into slumberland.
And soon, the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s sleep talk echoed in the room.
“We meet again, ha, hey, let me tell you about something interesting I encountered today.”
“A female ghost, no laughing, I’m serious.”
“Today, when Yi and I were heading home…”
The sun gradually set.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit’s sleep talk and Chen Yi’s snoring created an atmosphere in the room that made one want to fall asleep immediately.
…
And as Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit entered their dreams,
the Yancheng forum was still buzzing!
Many people commented and liked Chen Yi’s post, and the moderators promptly featured and pinned it!
All players planning to venture into the Sands of Time were studying the guide earnestly.
And at the entrance to the Sands of Time, players who had been waiting for a while stared at the guide, seriously starting to discuss it.
“The map is in black fog mode with only one meter of visibility.”
“Lighting Props, non-prop lighting tools, and lighting Skills are unusable.”
“This is dangerous, it means we can only see the Dried Corpses when they’re within a meter of us, which is way beyond the safe range.”
“The first stage’s Dried Corpses follow set movement patterns, and we need to determine the path based on the patterns on the floor.”
“There’s also a point-farming spot in the second stage.”

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 72 - 71: "It’s time for the third version update in June." (Four updates released!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 72 – 71: “It’s time for the third version update in June.” (Four updates released!)
The entrance to the Sands of Time.
Captain Wang of the Law Enforcement Bureau watched the strategy on the forum before him with a stern face, and only when he saw the score-farming point in the second level did a flash of light suddenly cross his eyes.
“When you reach the first level’s Activation Point, a prompt will sound in your ear, instructing players to hurry to the second Activation Point within ten minutes.”
“But in reality, as long as you take the cable car to the second Activation Point’s platform within ten minutes, you’ll have successfully completed the mission. At this point, don’t immediately enter the white light circle to trigger the next stage of the mission.”
“You can choose to block the Dried Corpses at the exit of the corridor and farm a large number of Points.”
“…”
“The Dried Corpses on the steel cables are invincible; not everyone can take the cable car or the Dried Corpses will catch up for sure. Only send one person up to complete the mission while the others hold the exit of the corridor.”
“…”
“There’s a deep pit in the fourth level, which is a Dried Corpse respawn point. If you time it well and have a large-scale destructive Prop, you can farm a large number of Points.”
“…”
The strategy is very detailed.
From the first level to the fifth level, all the things to watch out for, as well as some hidden rules, including where to farm Points and a series of tricks, are all on this post.
“Without reservation!”
Captain Wang looked somewhat complexly away from the post before him. Chen Yi had asked for no benefit at all, telling them about his life-for-map pioneering experience with no reservations.
Such vision… at least he might not have been able to do it.
All players in Yancheng owed Chen Yi a favor.
After taking a deep breath, he turned to his subordinates behind him and instructed in a low voice, “Pick fifty brothers with good skills and head down to this map together.”
Then he looked somewhat regretfully at the nearby artillery bed.
It’s a pity the artillery bed couldn’t be brought into the map, otherwise putting a few artillery pieces at the corridor exit would mean any Dried Corpses coming there would be killed, creating a huge score-farming opportunity!
The crossbow arrows driven by the motor, thick as arms, stabbed continuously forward without any sense of fatigue.
Blocking such a cramped corridor exit couldn’t be more appropriate.
But the artillery bed was too bulky. According to Chen Yi’s description, the corridors in the map consisted of staircases laid out in an ascending trend, complete with platforms and the like.
The artillery bed just couldn’t be brought in.
Yet he had already sent this information back. Presumably, the Law Enforcement Bureau would soon arrange for factories to produce some corresponding quick-farming tools.
…
The glaring sunlight poured onto Chen Yi’s face, pulling him from his sleep.
He sat up, leaning against the head of the bed, rubbing his bleary eyes, and knocked on his head slightly dizzy. After drawing the curtains and looking out of the window, he paused slightly in place.
Outside the window, everything had completely changed.
Buildings were adorned with streamers, with nearly a hundred meters of streamers falling straight from rooftops to the second or third floors.
There were colorful balloons tied on the streetlamps.
The whole city looked a bit less desolate and a bit more lively.
“Have they gone mad?”
Chen Yi frowned, washed up briefly, and then stood by the window while brushing his teeth, looking down at these scenes. Only the Law Enforcement Bureau could mobilize the entire city like this.
Not to mention the transportation and distribution of so many materials.
Just the dismantling afterward would consume a lot of manpower.
But after pondering for a bit and cleaning out the foam from his mouth, he sighed slightly and helplessly tapped on his head.
Had he slept too long?
Just getting out of bed, his head felt a bit fuzzy; he didn’t immediately realize that it was almost June 1st, Children’s Day. These preparations were probably for the Children’s Day celebration.
Was it an anticipation of some rules, thus the early preparations?
He turned his head and glanced at the Tuberculosis Rabbit, which was also slowly waking up, and then noticed the message Captain Wang had sent him through friends.
“Yi.”
“A new event has descended. Nearly a hundred vending machines have suddenly appeared in Yancheng, similar to those self-service drink dispensers.”
“You can accept tasks in front of the vending machines.”
“For instance, hanging a streamer or tying a balloon to a streetlamp.”
“Buying a streamer or balloon costs 3 Points each, and completing a task rewards you with 6 Points. Many players have already started doing tasks.”
That was the message from Captain Wang.
Chen Yi looked strangely at the time the message was sent, May 27th, 01:29 AM?
He then looked at today’s date.
May 27th, 09:28 AM.
Wait a minute!
If his memory served, he had only exited the Sands of Time Map on the afternoon of May 26th, right? How long had he been asleep?
Almost 20 hours!
Chen Yi lit a cigarette, bringing it to his lips, and couldn’t help but knock on his head and sigh, “Next time I can’t be this exhausted when pioneering a map. Having pioneered a map, I need to sleep a long time to recover my Vitality.”
Once the Tuberculosis Rabbit was done with its morning routine.
The two didn’t speak, having slept too long, their brains weren’t completely clear yet.
They just went down the stairs together.
…
When they reached the ground floor.
Standing amidst the steel jungle, one could truly feel the shock brought by the city’s transformation.
Looking up, almost every tall building was draped with streamers.
But there were limits, it seemed.
Each building only had 10 very long streamers.
After casually stopping a passerby to inquire, they learned that each building could only hang a maximum of 10 streamers, and each streetlamp could only have 10 balloons tied to it.
“Like this, huh.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, hands in his pockets, glanced around at the tall buildings, “In this case, it eliminates the possibility of score farming, otherwise these tall buildings would definitely be strung with at least a few hundred streamers.”
“Mm.”
Chen Yi casually nodded, his eyes sweeping past a vending machine on the side of the road. This should be the place where Captain Wang said tasks could be received.
But only these two kinds of tasks could be received; no other tasks were available.
He didn’t bother checking them.
It seemed like the Snow Sea Project Team had started preparing for the Children’s Day on June 1st.
As for what would happen on the Children’s Day on June 1st, that was anybody’s guess.
After wandering around with the Tuberculosis Rabbit for a while, Chen Yi found a restaurant to grab some food, and then headed back to his home.
After all, there wasn’t much worth wandering around for on the streets.
And wherever he went, he was the absolute center of attention, with nearly everyone looking his way, making it difficult to enjoy a leisurely stroll.
…
In the following days, Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t go anywhere.
They just passed the time eating when they were hungry, sleeping when they were tired, and getting massages when they were bored.
Time quickly advanced to May 31st.
23:49 in the evening.
Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit were each lying on their own beds, enjoying the massage from the Banshee.
The curtains were drawn, and the lights were off in the room.
A scented candle had been lit on the desk, its comforting fragrance spreading throughout the room.
“Looks like it’s about to hit midnight.”
Lying in the darkness, the Tuberculosis Rabbit savored the massage from the delicate and smooth hands pressing on his shoulders, before speaking wistfully.
“Too bad I can’t chat with Yi; it takes away a third of the fun.”
“It would be so comfortable if I could chat with Yi.”
He and Yi had activated the “Banshee’s Feast” prop that they had recently confiscated and were now enjoying the Banshee’s massage.
This prop was quite interesting.
Once activated, they were pulled into an Illusory Realm, where a Banshee exclusive to them would massage their entire body for 30 minutes, helping to relieve physical fatigue.
But it had many drawbacks.
For instance, it was only an enjoyment for the mind, and after the massage, one could only feel mentally refreshed, while the physical fatigue was hard to remove.
And… it was impossible to communicate with other players who were pulled into the Illusory Realm.
This was quite annoying.
You can imagine the feeling of eagerly dragging your best buddy shoulder-to-shoulder to the third floor of a bathhouse, finding a double room, each ordering a masseuse.
Preparing to enjoy an aromatherapy spa while shooting the breeze with your buddy,
When suddenly you two are assigned to different rooms.
It’s utterly deflating.
The pleasure is halved.
…
Chen Yi, lying on the other bed, also contentedly enjoyed the massage from the Banshee.
Actually, the setting was quite eerie.
In pitch darkness, unable to see the Banshee’s face.
Only able to feel the Banshee’s body, those delicate and soft hands, and occasionally hearing the moist breathing and that giggling laugh like a bell right by your ear.
Under the oppressive rules of May, more than half of the people thrust into this environment,
Forget half an hour—would have an emotional breakdown in less than three minutes.
But for Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit, this turned out to be the perfect leisure and entertainment prop.
With one fearless, the other so insensitive he couldn’t even imagine a ghost, they could just feel the smoothness.
This prop could only serve its intended purpose for these two people.
It proved the saying.
One man’s poison, another man’s meat.
It wasn’t long before.
The darkness before their eyes began to visibly dissipate, and that feeling of comfort also started to fade.
“Is time up?”
Feeling the diminishing force of the feet on his back, the Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a sigh of regret as he sat up, tightening the towel around his lower half a bit, lit a cigarette, took a deep draw, then spoke reluctantly.
“Half an hour, how is that enough? I want to add more time!”
“It’s just Points, and I’m not short on Points. At least give me a chance to add more time. What kind of lousy prop is this?”
“But I must say, the Banshee has some strength. The back stepping was pretty powerful.”
“Just that my Banshee is too skinny; if it were a bit fatter, that’d be better, I’m struggling here.”
Meanwhile, Chen Yi also got up from the bed, glanced at the clock beside the bed, then took off his towel, got dressed in his normal clothes, and stood by the window.
He looked out at the city below.
“It’s 23:59.”
“In just one more minute, it’ll be time for the third update of June.”
“Mm.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, also having changed into his clothes and standing next to Yi, looked out at the brightly lit city with a serious expression. After pondering for a moment, he spoke up.
“Yi, how did you think of taking a bath, wrapping in a towel, lighting some incense, and then activating the Banshee prop?”
“The experience is indeed much more enhanced.”

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 73 - 72: June Version Major Update, New Rules Added (Five More Updates!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 73 – 72: June Version Major Update, New Rules Added (Five More Updates!)
Chen Yi stood by the window, silent, merely lifting a glass of apple-flavored carrot juice to his lips.
He took a peaceful sip.
Clasping the glass in his hand, he gazed out the window.
In one more minute, the June game update would arrive.
Tonight, most people would probably be unable to sleep, as no one knew what the new rules coming with June would be.
There was only one piece of good news.
That was that all players finally didn’t have to speak 1000 sentences daily with people anymore.
He glanced at his personal panel.
There were 230,000 Points, the entire Points Balance he had accumulated over the month.
Chen Yi shifted his gaze away from the personal panel, placed the glass on the windowsill, and lit a cigarette between his fingers, unfastening the first button of his floral shirt.
Hands propped on the edge of the windowsill, he calmly looked out the window.
Looking down, it was clear to see that many people were standing in front of their balconies, waiting for the June update.
It was unclear why everyone had to stand at the windowsill.
Perhaps at such a time, seeing more of their own kind provided some sense of security.
And at that moment—
The time reached 00:00.
June 1st, had come.
“Game Update Announcement!”
“The new version of Blue Star 4.2 will start a non-stop update at 00:00 on June 1st. The main contents and adjustments of this update are as follows.”
“1. Fixed the prohibition of gunpowder weapons, some players began to develop electromagnetic weapons and other bugs. Effective immediately, both gunpowder and electromagnetic weapons are banned.”
“2. Fixed bugs in some maps, this bug fix includes the following maps”
…* Fixed the bug where players could infinitely farm points at the ’Sands of Time’ map’s second level *…
…* Fixed the bug where ’Little Sprite’s Mom’ frequently intrudes on various maps *…
…* Corrected bugs such as the December neutral boss Santa Claus and his reindeer intruding into the May timeline *…
…*$%##%$#%%#*…”
“3. Fixed the bugs performed by some players in May, such as escaping from Blue Star, force-pulling them back, and adding an impenetrable air wall around the outer layer of Blue Star.”
“4. Added ’Fashion’ gameplay. Starting from June, players will have more ways to obtain various Fashion Sets, and these sets contain different magical effects. Be a unique you!”
“5. Public testing of ’Map Secrets’ gameplay. In May, we conducted a small-scale internal test of the ’Map Secrets’ gameplay, with 90% of player feedback being extremely satisfied.
In June, we are publicly testing ’Map Secrets’ gameplay. In June, players will encounter more maps and can venture into them to receive generous rewards.”
“6. Introduced ’Happy Silver Party’ gameplay. Over the past two months, we noticed many players engaged in unfettered actions relying on their strength; we detest this behavior and believe it tramples on personal dignity!
Therefore, we launched the ’Happy Silver Party’ gameplay. You can choose to buy a ’Silver Party Ticket’ and be transported into a huge banquet hall. Here, all players are anonymous and will wear masks that cannot be removed.
Before entry, you will be invited to fill out an xp survey, and big data will assign you to the Silver Party hall that suits you best.
You are free to choose your social interactions, with mutual selection leading to a shared journey. We hope this reduces some malicious actions.”
“7. Added a ’Shop’ feature. Players can spend Points to buy some basic props from the shop template in their personal panel, such as Vehicles, Fashion, Passes, Food, Pure Water, Household Items, and Silver Party Tickets.”
“8. Over the past two months, we found many players wishing for customer service in the game. Hence, the Snow Sea Project Team decided to invite 10,000 players to serve as customer service representatives.
We will provide simple training for customer service, and when players find obvious bugs, they can report to customer service. Reporters will receive different rewards depending on the order of reporting.
Players who successfully serve as customer service will receive the Special Limited Title ’Customer Service Messenger.’ Other players, bosses, and monsters cannot attack players with the ’Customer Service Messenger’ title.
