Players with the ’Customer Service Messenger’ title will permanently lose their ability to attack other players while serving as customer service, and cannot enter maps or attack bosses, monsters, etc.
They can receive 3,000 Points monthly, with a 9 to 5 schedule, weekends off, and triple paid leave during holidays, anniversaries, and major global events.”
Players can briefly outline their competitive advantages and send their resumes through the chat channel to the Snow Sea Project Team. The team will select 10,000 customer service representatives within 3 days.”
“9. Near larger player gatherings, there will be constantly respawning monster waves. These monsters will launch an attack on the gatherings when they accumulate in sufficient numbers. Players should clear these monsters in a timely fashion.”
“10. Between August to October, depending on project progress, we might initiate a player deployment operation to otherworldly battles. Please strengthen yourselves to ensure survival in these events.”
“11. Added the June rule ’Good Rest Habits’:
*. Players must sleep from 21:00 to 22:00 and wake up at 06:00 or before every day.
*. Eat three meals a day at 8 a.m., 12 p.m., and 6 p.m.
*. Prohibited from using self-comforting methods to deplete spiritual energy when alone.
Players who breach any rule three times by the end of the month will receive one permanent debuff corresponding to the rule breached.
*. You will always feel overwhelmingly sleepy, yet never be able to sleep.
*. You will always feel hungry, yet never be able to eat.
*. You will lose all desires, but your body will automatically expel spiritual energy five times a day.
Should you breach all three rules three times each, you will have the honor of possessing all three permanent debuffs simultaneously.
And receive the Special Limited Title ’Tuberculosis Rabbit!’
“`
And the title will be forcibly equipped and bound.
The duration of this rule is one month, and it will be permanently taken offline after the next version update.
“12: Due to different time zones, the zones will unify in June, and afterwards, all players’ personal panels will have the accurate game time. Please adjust your schedules according to the time on your own personal panel and actively follow June’s rules.”
“13: The global Children’s Day event on June 1 will officially start at 8:00 AM on that day.”
“The Snow Sea Project Team wishes all players a happy gaming experience in version 4.2.”
“Ps: Preview for the next update – The project team has decided to add monthly rules concerning ’emotions’. Please look forward to it.”
00:05.
00:10.
00:15.
Finally, after a full 15 minutes, Tuberculosis Rabbit had gone over the contents of this version update word by word. His gradually widening mouth finally closed slowly.
With a slightly dry mouth, he swallowed some saliva, unconsciously picked up the cup next to him, and took a big gulp of water.
Then, tremblingly, he lit a cigarette and brought it to his lips.
After taking a deep drag,
he managed to calm the turbulence in his heart a bit, and with a complex expression, couldn’t help but say, “A full 13 items of update content!”
“13 items of update content, wow!”
“Even browser games don’t add this much stuff in one update.”
“So, did the Snow Sea Project Team do nothing in May except think about how to add content for the June update?”
“Couldn’t you pace it out a bit?”
“With so much content updated in one month, what are you going to update next month?”
“Yi, I just counted, this version update has a full 2000 characters. Do you think that when the Snow Sea Project Team was typing this many characters into the world announcement, their hands didn’t get tired?”
“And some of the rules are just nonsensical!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but express his indignation: “Especially the new rules for June, the so-called ’good daily routines’, are really trapping people.”
“What if we are clearing a map and it takes a little longer, but when it’s time, we must go to sleep?”
“If the boss isn’t dead yet and is right beside you, do you sleep or not?”
“And that thing about three meals a day.”
“So if we get into a fight at 11:59 AM, and then it hits 12:00 PM, do both sides have to put down their weapons and get together for a hotpot?”
“Continue the fight after the hotpot meal, right?”
“And if you don’t eat, you get a permanent debuff?”
“What if the fight hasn’t finished by 10:00 PM? Does that mean the people who were just frenziedly waving their swords around will now all have to snuggle under the covers together?”
“Then sleep until 6:00 AM and get up to continue the fight?”
“This is too absurd. What kind of ridiculous rule is this? I think it’s even worse than the ’Calm and Cool’ rule of May.”
“If it were possible, I’d prefer to have the active player rules of April back. This update is no good.”
“Lousy designers!”
“…”
Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed in silence, not speaking, as he kept tapping his fingers on the windowsill, leaning on his cane and looking out at the silhouettes in various windows.
After a moment, he suddenly spoke.
“We need to find a cook as soon as possible.”
“At least for this month, we must have a cook. If we don’t have one in the wilderness or the map or in any place, and we don’t have food when it’s time, that would be bad.”
“We can’t possibly have food ready at all times.”
“If things go as expected, I guess many powers or individual players will start to recruit cooks they know.”
“We must act quickly!”
“The hidden condition for visiting the map this month is that you must bring a cook. Without a cook, you wouldn’t dare go into the map.”
“Up until now, we still aren’t clear on what ’food’ is supposed to be.”
“Whether it should be freshly cooked food or if fast food products or rations would suffice.”
“But a cook is definitely the most standard answer.”
“We need to act immediately, right now.”
“If we’re a bit late, perhaps all the cooks in Yancheng will have been recruited by others. Actually, it doesn’t have to be a cook, as long as they can cook food.”
“But…”
He turned to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit and saw the silence in each other’s eyes.
Neither of them knew how to cook.
Who could have imagined that a day would come in the future when a cook would become an extremely popular and necessary profession?
It’s utterly absurd.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 74 - 73: Character Actions (Six more s to be released!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 74 – 73: Character Actions (Six more chapters to be released!)
The time now is the early hours of June 1st.
Technically, they had already violated the June rules, but maybe because it was the first day, the violation count in the personal panel about the June rules was still 0.
Quite humane.
At least it wouldn’t have all players violate the June rules just because the version had just updated.
Chen Yi also first looked towards the new feature added in this version update, the store.
Opening the store, there were all sorts of dazzling items for purchase, but they were all some basic functional props; things like attack skills and attack props were not available in the store.
Which was understandable.
After all, there’s always been an unwritten rule in web games.
The really good stuff was never directly for sale in the store.
What could be directly sold in the store were only some functional props with not particularly strong effects.
For example, the fashions in the store were only of E level, there were none above D level.
“Fashion Name”: Beach Warmth – Sunglasses
“Fashion Level”: E level.
“Fashion Sale Price”: 10 Points.
The price wasn’t too steep.
An E-level fashion set would cost around 100 Points, and purchasing a single component would only cost 10 Points.
This price was acceptable to most people.
It wasn’t expensive, and there were no issues with wearing it as everyday clothing.
However, at this moment—
Chen Yi and his companion suddenly noticed a dazzling white light exploding in the skies above Yancheng, followed by the light falling at a speed too fast for the naked eye to catch, straight into the depths of Yancheng.
The shockwave of the white light surged rapidly in all directions!
In almost an instant, it once again enveloped the entire Yancheng.
As quickly as it came, it went.
Just as Chen Yi had activated his sled from the backpack, preparing to jump on and start fleeing for his life, the white light suddenly dissipated.
And they found that their bodies had not suffered any harm.
It didn’t seem like an attack.
“Wait a minute—”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly exclaimed, looking down at his body with shock on his face, his hands covering his chest as he couldn’t help but shout, “Where the hell did my clothes go?!”
Following the dispersal of the white light just now.
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s clothes had vanished without a trace.
Completely bare, he only had a pair of white underpants.
Even his shoes were gone!
Chen Yi was in the same situation, his floral shirt dissipating with the wind, leaving only a pair of white underpants on his body.
He looked down at the underpants and remained silent without speaking—it turned out to be a fashion item.
“Fashion Name”: Beginner’s Briefs (Male)
“Fashion Level”: None.
“Fashion Effect”: Used to cover new players’ modesty, no set effects, only covers the body.
“Fashion Introduction”: “Players can only wear clothing deemed as fashion, and players with experience in clothing design can design their own fashions and send the drawings to the Snow Sea Project Team. If selected, they will receive a substantial Points reward.”
Yes.
Just like when the vehicle function was activated and all the vehicles in the world disappeared.
When the fashion function was activated, all the clothes in the world disappeared as well.
Chen Yi stood by the bed and looked towards a woman standing at the window of the building opposite.
Just like them.
She was also devoid of clothes, wearing only a white bandeau and white underwear.
That must be the beginner’s fashion for female players.
“Wrapping cloth around oneself?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit tentatively pulled out a bedsheet and wrapped it around himself, wanting to see if this could be considered wearing something other than a fashion item. The answer was… it really could be.
So although clothes had disappeared, using sheets, towels, and stuff like that was still a way to cover oneself.
“That’s enough.”
Chen Yi shook his head unamusedly and transferred 2000 Points to Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Go buy yourself a set of fashion in the store, we’re not short of that bit of money.”
“But the store only has E-level fashions now, just make do with them for now, and when we get a chance later, I’ll get you a better set.”
“Alright, thanks Yi.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit responded and immediately jumped onto the bed, sitting cross-legged against the headboard, constantly swiping through the store panel in front of him, considering which fashion set to purchase.
Meanwhile, Chen Yi hesitantly looked at the teddy bear onesie in his backpack.
C-level fashion.
It was his only fashion item that had both a top and bottoms.
He had also purchased 5 Fashion Treasure Boxes during the Sands of Time event and had obtained 5 fashion components.
One among them was The Emperor’s New Clothes, an item that simply couldn’t be worn, not even worth considering.
The remaining four were some decorative pieces from fashion sets, like sunglasses and such, none included tops or bottoms.
The teddy bear onesie was the only thing that covered the body and was of C-level.
It was just sleepwear, that shouldn’t be a problem, and besides, it was brown, still quite masculine.
The only issue was the teddy bear hood, which looked a bit cute, with two pink and white colored bear ears.
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi chose to silently activate the item.
Accompanying a flash of white light.
The fashion was now worn on his body.
Standing in front of a full-length mirror, holding the Christmas Cane in his hand, he looked at his reflection and slightly arched an eyebrow, feeling that the sense of incongruity wasn’t that strong after all, huh.
It was just below the ankle where things got a bit bare.
After that flash of white light, even shoes and socks had disappeared.
What else could he do?
Buy.
He silently opened the store panel, looked at the fashion option, and found the shoe category in the fashion list.
A series of icons dazzled his eyes.
In the end, without much deliberation, he chose a pair of ordinary white sneakers.
No special effects, an E-level fashion with no additional effects, just a piece of clothing.
Clothes get dirty.
If you want to clean your fashion, you can spend points to do so, and the cost varies with the fashion level.
That should do it.
He didn’t buy too many fashions, as long as he was presentable.
With shoes and a jumpsuit.
What more was needed?
It’s better not to dress up too flashy as a man, Chen Yi silently lowered his own baseline a bit more towards the low-key.
And just at that moment—
The excited voice of Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly rang in his ears.
“Yi, look at me!”
“Huh?”
Chen Yi shifted his gaze from the mirror where his handsome self was reflected and turned to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit standing in the living room, a hint of bafflement flashing in his eyes, not quite knowing what to make of it.
There was Tuberculosis Rabbit, his head topped with a beach hat, wearing a white undershirt, over which he donned a red and yellow warm-toned palm tree shirt, along with a big red and yellow pair of beach shorts!
His feet were in a pair of flip-flops.
He also hung a pair of sunglasses on his white undershirt.
Around his neck was a necklace that looked like something a rap artist would wear.
But what was most outrageous—
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s legs were suddenly covered with tattoos, the two ink-filled legs were rather striking to the eye!
“Where did you get these tattoos from?”
“Tattoos are also a fashion component, didn’t you see them in the fashion store, Yi?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit curiously flicked through his backpack panel: “I bought two sets of tattoos, one is this kind of flowered legs, to act like a gangster.”
“The other is a sunshine series, a part of this outfit’s set.”
“Let me switch to it and show you, Yi.”
With a virtual tap in the air with his finger,
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s leg tattoos faded away swiftly, quickly replaced by new ones.
The new tattoos didn’t cover the entirety of both legs.
Featuring SpongeBob, waves, the sun, starfish, the moon, and other such sun-soaked patterns sporadically adorned Tuberculosis Rabbit’s legs.
It indeed… matched Tuberculosis Rabbit’s outfit quite well.
The whole person looked like a tourist on vacation in Hawaii.
“…”
Chen Yi was silent and didn’t speak; he had to admit that Tuberculosis Rabbit really got the hang of the fashion feature, and he indeed hadn’t noticed that there were tattoos when browsing the fashion store.
“There’s more, there’s more.”
Seeing Yi distracted, Tuberculosis Rabbit hurriedly waved his hands to pull Chen Yi’s gaze back.
“Yi, check this out.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood still and snapped his fingers lightly.
His lips suddenly curved upwards, his feet staggered forwards and backwards as he slowly leaned backward, tilting to nearly 45 degrees while his hands stretched out to balance his body, pupils shining with a challenge to nature as he gazed into the distance beyond the house.
And the next second—
A white circle of light, two to three meters in diameter, unexpectedly appeared under Tuberculosis Rabbit’s feet and a 3D surfboard phantom sprang up beneath him. The waves could be seen rolling right under his feet, as if he was actually surfing.
And you could even hear the sound of the waves and smell the slightly fishy scent of the ocean.
That wasn’t all.
Behind Tuberculosis Rabbit, a translucent light wall gradually emerged, displaying a 3D animation of waves. From the front, it looked as though Tuberculosis Rabbit was truly surfing on a board, challenging hundred-meter high waves.
About seven or eight seconds later,
The light circle behind Tuberculosis Rabbit finally dispersed, the sea water under his feet vanished, and he slowly straightened up.
“How’s that?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes sparkled with excitement and mischief as he began to smile, “This thing is also from the fashion store, called character action.
“The cheapest character actions start at 1000 Points.”
“Once activated, our bodies can strike certain poses, which will then bring up background special effects.”
“There is also Michael Jackson’s signature move for sale in the store, with a background effect featuring a huge dance hall and even includes backup dancers in the effect.”
“This one is a bit pricier; it costs 10,000 Points.”
“There’s also an upgraded luxury version of Michael Jackson’s dance, including a full set of dance moves, as well as background music and such, priced at 50,000 Points.”
“When I get more Points later on, I’ll buy one to play with.”
“There’s also a character action of dribbling a ball between the legs for just 1000 Points, and the luxurious upgrade version with background music and the like is a bit more expensive, costing 5,000 Points.”
“This version update has brought many fun new things.”
“Yi, aren’t you going to try it out?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked outside the window with some reluctance: “Isn’t there a bunch of monster surges outside the city? Why don’t we go kill some monsters now?”
“I can’t wait to earn more Points.”
“That way, I can unlock more fashion sets, as well as character actions and background effects.”

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 75 - 74: "A Glimmer of Cold Light Arrives First, Then the Spear Strikes Like a Dragon!" (Seven updates upon release!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 75 – 74: “A Glimmer of Cold Light Arrives First, Then the Spear Strikes Like a Dragon!” (Seven updates upon release!)
“`
As Chen Yi was about to say something.
Suddenly the chat channel on his personal panel trembled.
“Jiaye: Yi, are you asleep? There are quite a few more monsters outside the city. My brother and I are fighting them outside. Do you want to join us, Yi?”
Chen Yi’s eyebrows slightly raised as he turned his head to look at his reflection in the mirror, pondering for a moment before replying.
“Okay, send me the exact coordinates.”
Soon.
Jiaye sent over the exact coordinates, followed by a playful expression with a sticking-out tongue.
“Let’s go.”
After Chen Yi got ready, he glanced at the Tuberculosis Rabbit next to him still browsing the Fashion Store: “I’m heading out to fight monsters in the suburbs. Jiaye and the others are there too.”
Before leaving.
Feeling a chill around the crotch area, he bought an E-grade underwear from the Fashion Store to wear.
The underwear didn’t belong to any Fashion Set; it was a standalone piece.
It was an optional purchase.
But he was used to wearing it, so he bought a pair anyway since it wasn’t expensive—just 10 Points.
However, most players in Yancheng didn’t have spare Points to spend, which meant that for a long time, most players in Yancheng would have to experience a period of going commando.
Sled activated.
In just a few minutes, Chen Yi arrived at the coordinates provided by Jiaye.
At first glance, there were quite a few monsters sprawled across the plains and forests on the outskirts of the suburbs, but each monster was spaced out, about 1 meter apart from the next, not as dense as an Insect Tide.
Minotaur Monster.
Standing about two meters tall, these muscle-bound bovines wielded enormous stone axes, dotting the plains with a formidable presence.
Many players had also made their way over throughout the night.
Almost all the players were uniformly clad in white boxer shorts, clutching all sorts of weapons, attacking the monsters either solo or in groups.
The monsters’ aggro was determined by distance and damage.
Monsters would target the player who stepped into their territory and dealt the most damage to them.
This also meant the possibility of kiting was present, and there was no need to worry about attracting the aggro of all the monsters by attacking one.
By the time they arrived.
Quite a few players were looking admiringly at a certain player among the monsters, clapping and shouting continuously.
“Awesome, bro, your moves are slick!”
“Kite another one, kite another one!”
“Be careful, brother, don’t get too greedy!”
The player who had garnered the attention of many was seriously wielding a dagger, eyes keenly watching the monster’s attacking motion, and at the moment a strike was launched, the player quickly rolled under the monster!
During the roll, the player lifted a hand and stabbed under the monster!
While this player was bending and rolling, another Minotaur Monster happened to catch up from behind.
The full-force strike meant for the player in the front landed heavily on the head of the chasing Minotaur Monster from behind!
Although the health bar was not visible, the scream of the monster hit conveyed that a significant amount of health had been lost.
This player had impressively drawn the aggro of 4 monsters at once!
With agile movements, the player continuously dodged, causing the 4 monsters to attack each other, gradually wearing down their health bars.
The dagger in hand was opportunistic, targeting the monsters’ vital areas with each stab.
Every heavy blow from the monsters was narrowly avoided by the player.
This player was Han Yu.
“Well done!!!”
The surrounding players were once again impressed by the scene, and a group of players in white boxer shorts started clapping and cheering again!
As Han Yu heard the applause, the corners of her mouth twitched slightly; her heart was not at ease but was even more tense.
Finally, after one minute.
All four monsters collapsed almost simultaneously.
Han Yu quickly gathered the items dropped by the monster corpses into her arms, heard the notification sound of Points reward for killing a monster in her ear, and stood in place taking a relieved breath.
Hearing the cheers from the crowd, pride flashed in her eyes as she looked towards her parents in the crowd, raising her dagger high into the air, her mouth opened in a silent shout!
She was dressed in a “black suit” that she had bought for less than 100 Points, and had also bought a set for her parents so that at their age, they wouldn’t have to stand in front of everyone in newbie briefs.
During the fight with Cupid, she had earned quite a few Points.
This amount of Points was not much for her.
Just at that moment—
Standing among the crowd, Han Yu suddenly noticed the crowd fall silent and looked up at the sky, pausing for a moment before also looking over her shoulder in the direction everyone was staring.
Suspended in mid-air was a massive Christmas sled.
And sitting on the sled were two men.
One dressed in a teddy bear onesie, sporting more than a dozen titles over his head.
The other clad in a beach outfit, with three or four titles floating above.
Seeing the two men who had appeared behind her without notice, Han Yu froze for a second without speaking, just gripping her dagger tighter and with lips firmly pressed, eyes filled with tenacity and aspiration.
She knew that man.
Chen Yi.
Although Chen Yi didn’t know her, she had known about him for a long time.
During the fight with Cupid, Chen Yi was ranked above her.
When the Insect Tide came, Chen Yi single-handedly killed all of the Insect Race monsters.
When the Sands of Time Map appeared in the Yancheng suburbs, Chen Yi spent 3 days clearing the dungeon and left behind a guide for others.
This man… seemed like a mountain looming over all players in Yancheng, and also a mountain over her.
Someday!
She too wanted to be like Chen Yi, basking in the awe and admiration of all players, putting her own parents in the place that Chen Yi now occupied.
…
“This kid looks familiar.”
“`
Sitting in the sleigh, the Tuberculosis Rabbit turned its head to look at Han Yu and couldn’t help but click its tongue, “I feel like I’ve seen it several times already; being able to afford a Fashion Set at this stage means their strength mustn’t be lacking.”
“Why would they buy a suit if the main hand weapon is a dagger, though.”
“It feels a bit out of place, doesn’t it? As an assassin, opting for a white robe, like the one from the Assassin’s Creed series, might look cooler.”
“This black suit seems more suitable for someone whose main hand weapon is a spear, and then, upon launching the spear, they’d yell out—”
“One gleam of cold light arrives first, followed by a Spear Like a Dragon!”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, perhaps imagining something, started gesturing in the air with its hands.
Meanwhile.
Chen Yi raised his eyebrows slightly and noticed Jiaye in the crowd; she was not hard to find.
Amongst the newcomers in uniform white underpants, Jiaye sat on Tie Chui’s shoulder in a suspender dress, barefoot, swinging her feet in boredom; she was quite the eyesore.
With Tie Chui’s build, it wasn’t the least bit awkward for Jiaye to sit on his shoulder.
Just like Nunu.
It was clear that Jiaye had changed into the Fashion Set she had drawn in the Sands of Time; for some reason, she wasn’t wearing shoes, and she had a bracelet made of willow branches on her fair wrist.
She had a number of small accessories on her person.
It looked like she had taken her time picking things out from the Fashion Store.
And rightly so.
Girls tend to be more interested in Fashion Stores, of course, though the Tuberculosis Rabbit also had a considerable interest in them.
Chen Yi casually glanced at the players below who were looking up at him.
Only then did he rise from his seat, resting one hand on his staff as he stood at the edge of the sleigh and said softly,
“Invincible Under the Heavens!”
In the next second—
The “Invincible Under the Heavens” Title Effect activated, and a supreme yellow translucent staircase, starting from the edge of the sleigh, quickly extended towards Jiaye in the crowd, until it reached the ground in front of her.
Then Chen Yi, with a calm expression, single-handedly leaned on his staff and stepped onto the staircase with steady and rhythmic strides, like a descending deity, walking towards Jiaye amidst the crowd.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit also stood up, bringing a fist to their mouth to cough lightly, then changed its leg tattoos to floral patterns, dressed up in Hawaiian style, and followed behind Yi with a proud and upright posture.
When this scene unfolded,
The players below, looking up at Chen Yi, were stunned into silence, gazing at the Sky Ladder above their heads, awestruck.
Was this thing… also a Prop?
Why hadn’t they ever seen it before!
But upon seeing the endpoint of the Sky Ladder, that delicate girl in a suspender dress sitting on the broad-shouldered man, barefoot,
The envy and jealousy in the eyes of the others intensified!
A fine woman had fallen for some brute!!
…
Upon seeing the girl in the crowd who stood out so prominently, Han Yu felt a touch of quiet inferiority as he lowered his head, but the dagger in his hand gripped a bit tighter.
Only a powerful man is worthy of such a woman.
He too must grow stronger quickly!
He too must find his own fair lady!
The times were different now.
Classes were no longer fixed; as long as one was willing to fight and had a bit of luck, anyone could leap across classes.
He, Han Yu, would have his chance too!
…
“So showy.”
Li Yide, also standing amidst the crowd, couldn’t help but feel irked as he shook the Fox Tail at his backside, lighting a cigarette and putting it to his lips, “Everyone knows he’s formidable, but does he have to flaunt it like this?”
“It’s really irritating.”
“Look at those girls, their eyes are practically sparkling, and no one even notices the Fashion Set I bought for a hefty price.”
“This feeling of being upstaged is really unpleasant.”
“But on second thought, is that Sky Ladder a Prop or a Skill, and how did he get it? Do we have a chance of getting one too?”
“I’ve never seen this thing in the ’Invincible Under the Heavens’ Points Store event.”
…
“Sorry to keep you waiting.”
Chen Yi descended the Sky Ladder, silently deactivated the staircase effect behind him, and as the ladder turned into a faint yellow dust that dissipated into smoke, he then looked towards Tie Chui and Jiaye in front of him, his lips lifting into a smile as he said,
“Let’s go, together to slay some monsters.” Find more to read at empire
He then pulled out a cigarette and offered it to Tie Chui, “Long time no see, brother.”
“Brother… you look so commanding…”
Although Tie Chui was a bit slow, for some reason, he was very receptive to the gesture of being offered a cigarette, his eyes lighting up as he took the cigarette from Chen Yi’s hand.
He then looked at Chen Yi with a simple smile and gave him a thumbs-up.
Chen Yi chuckled softly and didn’t reply; he had understood the principle of showcasing one’s best while working hard behind the scenes since he was young.
“How about it?”
And then—
Jiaye, who sat on Tie Chui’s shoulders, wiggled her red nail-polished, delicate feet, drawing Chen Yi’s gaze towards her. She looked at him expectantly and asked, “Does this Fashion Set look good?”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 76 - 75: "This is truly f**king pretentious.
chapters.content:
Chapter 76 – 75: “This is truly f**king pretentious.
The cool spaghetti strap dress was a bit loose on Jiaye, giving off a hint of laziness while also not lacking in sexiness and innocence.
The dress was purely white as its base, devoid of any lace edges or gradient layers.
Its silk-like material allowed it to cling naturally to the body while also hanging down to reveal the figure.
The neckline was not low, but a glimpse of allure could vaguely be seen, igniting endless imagination without being frivolous.
A bracelet made of willow branches on the wrist added a splash of color to the otherwise simple spaghetti strap dress, while the pure gold thread in her right ear lost some innocence but gained some charm.
A light makeup accompanied by long hair, which was loosely tied back with a rubber band.
Any man faced with such a woman’s full-eyed expectant inquiry would blurt out two words.
Beautiful.
“The fabric choice is quite bold.”
Chen Yi swept a surprised glance over the spaghetti strap dress on Jiaye, “Generally speaking, we would call this kind of silk-like material a sleep dress, it’s rare to see it used for spaghetti strap dresses.”
“It’s pretty.”
“After all, it’s a Grade-C Fashion, not bad.”
Jiaye, sitting on Tie Chui’s shoulder, was taken aback, her mouth opening and closing a few times, just as she was about to say something else.
Suddenly, there was an outcry from around them!
Chen Yi turned his head towards the source of the noise.
He saw a man flying towards them, more precisely, a man standing on a flying sword.
To be even more precise.
It was a middle-aged man with an icy expression, his left hand behind his back, his right hand pinching the Sword Decree, dressed in a white Tang suit, standing on a green longsword.
The speed of the flying sword was not fast.
It seemed intentional.
The man standing on the flying sword descended slowly from above their heads, and even in the night, he was strikingly conspicuous.
The title above the man’s head was even more glaring.
“I have a sword, who dares to respond?”
The middle-aged man landed slowly on the ground, simply pinched a sword technique with one hand, and the Green Peak Longsword under his feet trembled rapidly as if it had life, emitting a clear and soul-shaking sword cry!
It then began to spin around the man’s side, fast like a swimming dragon!
Ever since the middle-aged man appeared, everyone who was fighting monsters in the night was shocked still, mouths agape, even those engaged in combat quickly pulled away hostility and stood on tiptoes to gaze at this unexpectedly appearing figure.
The man’s white Tang suit, paired with old-fashioned black cloth shoes, sparsely scattered beard around his lips, and his firm and icy countenance.
That title over his head, along with the Three-Foot Qingfeng as lifelike as any living being.
Made the man the focal point of everyone’s attention from the moment he appeared, the noisy chatter also faded away in an instant, as if suppressed by the man’s invisible aura.
At that moment—
“Go!”
The man, with one hand behind his back, suddenly gave a cold order. His right hand, pinching the Sword technique, thrust sharply at a Minotaur Monster not far ahead!
“Clang!”
The Three-Foot Qingfeng hovering by the man’s side vibrated wildly again and, with a sharp ring of the sword, it shot towards the Minotaur Monster at a speed invisible to the naked eye!
Leaving behind only a misty white trace carving through the air.
When the crowd followed the direction the man pointed and looked at the Minotaur Monster, they noticed its pupils were slowly dilating and a tiny bloody hole on its forehead was oozing blood.
The Three-Foot Qingfeng had already returned to the man’s side at some unknown time.
It stood erect in the air, vibrated slightly as if it were a prized little treasure presenting its merits.
In front of all eyes, the Minotaur Monster with a tiny hole in its forehead, its pupils dilating, and its body rigidly falling backwards, until it crashed onto the ground, kicking up a cloud of dust.
“Wow!”
The crowd was suddenly abuzz!
The Minotaur Monster, which they had been struggling against for a long time, was killed in one strike by this man!
They couldn’t even track the trajectory of the Three-Foot Qingfeng!
If the target of the Three-Foot Qingfeng had been them, who could have dodged it?
But it wasn’t over yet!
Suddenly.
The middle-aged man, with one hand behind his back and standing in place, with no joy in his eyes as if he were used to it, gave a measured and respectful shout without any change in his expression.
“Sword, rise!”
The next second—
The man’s posture straightened even more, his eyes gazing into the distance, an unwarranted air of composure settled upon him, with one hand behind his back and the other pinching the Sword Decree across his chest.
Shortly after.
Suddenly, the sound of a light and rhythmic DJ-style ancient music with a Jianghu flair began to play.
“Three feet of ice, how much frost and cold is required?”
“A fleeting glance, how much hardship is needed?”
“On this journey, do not forget the road one came from—”
As the rhythm started to quicken, and when the music reached a climactic moment!
Nearly a thousand Three-Foot Qingfeng swords emerged suddenly behind the man.
A sky full of Green Peak Longswords that blocked out the sun made many people scream and retreat in fear!
Right then!
Countless ferocious Monster Beasts with heads raised and silently roaring with rage in their eyes appeared suddenly within dozens of meters of the middle-aged man!
Accompanied by the right hand gently lowering the Sword Decree of the middle-aged man.
“Sword, fall.”
Nearly a thousand Three-Foot Qingfengs behind the man started to tremble in unison, then, with a piercing sound, fell like an immense pressure from the air towards the raging Monster Beasts below!
At this moment—
The background music reached its climax, the sound growing louder, and the beats faster!
“Brocaded flowers bloom on the way home, do not hesitate!”
“The swan takes flight, breaking through clouds and mists, among thousands of rivers and mountains!”
“Feasting on frost, drinking the snow, forging for ten years, honing a single sword!”
“And see, as I stand alone at the pass, I dare to make tens of thousands unable to crack a smile!”
Explore stories on empire
The countless Monster Beasts surrounding the man, in their silent roar, were turned into a bloody mess by the Green Peaks raining down from the sky!
Nearly a thousand Green Peak Longswords, of varying heights, surrounded the man.
They were akin to a Sword Tomb.
And like vassals encircling their Emperor, they slightly trembled their hilts in submission.
Willing to slay all enemies in the world for their Emperor.
At this moment, the background music also began to slowly fade, until several seconds later, the scene gradually dissipated.
There was dead silence!
All the players present even held their breath, daring not to speak loudly for fear of startling the immortals above!
It was only now that these players realized that the countless Three-Foot Qingfengs in the sky, along with the sudden appearance of the Monster Beasts, were all but illusions.
Unknown when.
Within a hundred meters of the man, there had long been no one.
Only leaving behind that still standing Three-Foot Qingfeng trembling slightly in mid-air next to the man.
The man, with an easygoing look in his eyes, glanced over the crowd, and then chuckled lightly.
“My fellow daoists, good night.”
“…”
After a moment of silent glances all around, the players began to whisper to each other uncontrollably.
“Is this still a human? Could it really be an immortal?”
“I don’t know, dammit, give me a moment. I always thought the world had turned into a game, but now you’re telling me that the spiritual energy has revived and immortals have descended!?”
“What do we do then? According to the old rules, is this immortal here to test our Spirit Roots?”
“That’s excellent; the fortune-teller has said since I was a child that apart from the Fire Attribute, I lack the other four elements. This means I’m definitely that one in ten thousand with a pure Fire Attribute Spirit Root!”
…
Meanwhile, in a corner among the crowd.
Li Yide stood silently with no expression on his face. After a long while, he took out a cigarette from his pocket with a light sigh, slowly lit it, and put it to his lips.
With a look full of melancholy and a distracted spirit, he stared into the distance and murmured.
“The road ahead is long and far-reaching indeed.”
“He’s really f*cking good at pretense.”
“I thought Chen Yi was pretentious enough, but now there’s someone even more ostentatious.”
“What the hell are you guys doing?”
“I thought I was well-prepared, planning to make a grand appearance tonight while many people were gathering outside the city. I didn’t expect that there would be such huge mountains ahead of me!”
He absent-mindedly swished his Fox Tail. After a moment, he couldn’t help but lower his head in dejection and said.
“If Yu was born, why was Liang born as well?”
“Shouldn’t showing off imply inadvertently revealing one’s badass side, then with everyone in shock, you just give a slight smile to show it’s just a basic maneuver?”
“Isn’t it popular anymore to pretend to be a pig to eat a tiger?”
“Are we now into this kind of straightforward showing off?”
“The type that unleashes their Ultimate Move upon meeting someone.”
“When did the times change without letting me know?”
…
“…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit also stood in silent, expressionless contemplation, with his hand halfway to lighting a cigarette, only resuming after the effects and background music had completely ended.
But he did not proceed to light the cigarette.
Instead, he took the cigarette from his lips and held it in his hand.
He paused for a moment before he said faintly.
“There is no such character action in the Fashion Store. I don’t know where this man got it, but the cost must not be small.”
“With the range of effect this has, even including an appropriate background music and plot for the effects.”
“This effect must be worth at least 50,000 Points.”
“But I can’t take it anymore. This man is too good at pretense.”
“Since I was born, I have never seen such a master of pretense!”
Chen Yi also stood there with a complex expression, looking towards the middle-aged man who was standing by himself in the clearing, leaning on his walking stick without speaking.
Damn it.
That character action is truly awesome.
No, he too must get a character action that’s as cool as that one.
The kind you can buy from the store that everyone has, the common merchandise, definitely won’t do. He must get a character action that’s as rare as the one this man has, which isn’t available in the store.
However, just at this moment—
The middle-aged man turned around, smiled at Chen Yi, then proceeded to walk straight towards Chen Yi and the others, with the Three-Foot Qingfeng floating behind him following as though it were his shadow.
He came to a halt two meters away from Chen Yi and the others, then stood there with an amiable expression, chuckling lightly.
“My young friends, I…”
Before the man could finish speaking.
“Hold it!”
Standing beside Chen Yi, the Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly stood up straight, her face cold as she gave a soft shout, then bent her knees slightly and leaped straight up on the spot, pulling out the Crimson Claw Knife, which had been charging up to nearly 5000 points, from her bosom while in mid-air.
Before the leap, she flicked the cigarette in her palm with the handle of the knife, sending it flying through the air.
Her body bent like a bow at the extreme angle, catching the lit cigarette in her mouth and stretching out her arm holding the Claw Knife like a whip, lashing it through the air towards a distant Minotaur Monster!
“Knife, cries!”
“And see how I cut down all the devils in this world!”
“Give me—”
“Extinction!”

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 77 - 76: Global! Unique! Character Action!
chapters.content:
Chapter 77 – 76: Global! Unique! Character Action!
The tuberculosis rabbit leaping in midair became increasingly frenzied, his voice tinged with a hint of contempt for life, his eyes flashing with ruthless brutality.
The crimson glow of the cigarette butt at the corner of his mouth, shrouded in the light blue smoke, began to spread gradually, exploding in an instant!
In a flash—
A crimson blade light, tens of meters wide, abruptly appeared in midair!
The intense crimson light illuminated half the sky outside the city in an instant.
And with that, the night was dispersed.
The dark clouds retreated.
As if a red moon had descended upon the world, even the ground was bathed in the scarlet glow, and the players who stood agape, looking up at the blade light in the sky, seemed eerily immobile, as if their minds were affected by the red moon.
Before the crowd could react!
The tens-of-meters-wide, crimson crescent blade light, like Mount Tai bearing down, plunged toward the distant minotaur monster!
All players’ pupils captured the same astonishing scene at this moment!
A crimson crescent blade light that nearly filled their entire field of vision!
As the crescent blade light crashed mightily into the group of minotaur monsters, those that had been strutting arrogantly just moments before burst open like balloons filled with blood, becoming a shower of gore in the air!
The crimson blade’s momentum was unabated!
After annihilating countless minotaurs and even carving a shallow pit into the ground, the light slowly faded away in midair.
Where there had been a large group of minotaur monsters at the outskirts of the city, the tuberculosis rabbit had brutally cleaved a clearing, making the scene look like a middle-aged man’s bald spot!
The blood splatter from the fallen minotaur monsters stained the clearing like tomato sauce slathered on a middle-aged man’s bald head, with scattered cheese sprinkles added instantly.
“…”
The middle-aged man, who had just started to speak and was cut off, looked at the scene before him, involuntarily swallowing his saliva unconsciously, with a flash of shock in his eyes!
His once upright back bent slightly without him noticing.
“Do you need something?”
He heard an abrupt voice next to his ear.
The middle-aged man snapped back to his senses, his voice stammering as he looked towards the tuberculosis rabbit and said subconsciously, “That… I’m looking for the person who was standing next to you just now, eh?”
“Where did he go?”
The man from before was clearly standing right beside this fellow.
Just as he was sweeping his gaze around the tuberculosis rabbit, preparing to look around—
He suddenly heard a steady and powerful male voice beside his ear!
“Is there something you need?”
The middle-aged man, looking in the direction of the voice, was about to speak when the shock in his eyes intensified, and he seemed a bit lost and helpless for a moment, not knowing what to do.
Only a few dozen meters away,
A throne swathed in crimson, exuding dominance and majesty, had risen without notice!
And the man he was looking for, who had just been wearing a one-piece bear pajama set, was now clad in a blue robe with a cold expression, sitting on the throne and playing with an agarwood bracelet.
His pupils flickered with lightning serpents that no one dared look directly into.
From high above, looking down at him with a gaze full of disdain.
And below the throne!
Nearly a hundred heavy-armored soldiers, wielding giant blades, stood like statues on both sides of the throne, exuding an air of iron-blooded ruthlessness, as if they were dead soldiers, ready to protect their emperor!
They looked straight ahead, unwavering!
Though silent, the pressure they emitted was not to be underestimated!
And beside the man seated on the throne was a petite girl in a strappy long dress and bare feet, cradling a jar of wine, head bowed as she filled a bronze flagon with wine.
Like a queen, she gently handed the flagon to the man beside her.
After taking a sip from the flagon, the lightning serpents in the man’s eyes became more violent, and he spoke coldly with a slight dissatisfaction in his tone.
“Why art thou here?”
“Glug.” Your journey continues at empire
The middle-aged man swallowed hard and looked toward the man sitting on the throne, as well as the several titles almost breaking through the sky, shocked, while he glanced at the surrounding players who were all staring in this direction.
With some embarrassment, he jogged his way toward the throne.
The heavy-armored soldiers standing on both sides of the throne stomped their blades heavily on the ground as the middle-aged man ran toward it, their eyes fixed on him intently.
It seemed as if they were ready to draw their blades at the slightest provocation.
The middle-aged man didn’t care but ran to the foot of the throne with his head down, looking up at the man sitting above him and said in a low and awkward voice.
“Ah, brother, it seems we share the same hobbies.”
“Cut me some slack; I’m having a hard time saving face here.”
“Oh.”
Chen Yi nodded expressionlessly, looking down at the man standing before his throne and said coldly, “Now you realize you can’t save face, what about earlier?”
“Flitting about with your Sword Flight, Thousands of Swords Flying Together.”
“Are you cultivating or did you come specially to show off before me?”
“Yancheng hasn’t seen anyone like you before.”
“Are you from another city who came all this way to perform in front of me?”
“Your special effects cover nearly a hundred meters; those Three-Foot Qingfeng swords are nearly sticking out of my forehead, and now you’re running over here asking for a favor?”
“This is difficult, you know.”
“Cough…”
The middle-aged man stood there, feeling the gazes of countless other players on him, fidgeting uncomfortably and said, trying to maintain his composure, “I was somewhat out of line.”
“Actually, I’m here specifically to find you, I’m almost done collecting a set of fashion components, only missing the final fashion component.”
“But it’s very hard to get this component, uh…”
He paused momentarily before continuing, “Well, it’s not too hard to obtain per se, it’s just a bit difficult… not really difficult to obtain, actually quite easy to get, just a touch hard to lay hands on.”
“`
“I learned through a certain prop that you have this fashion component, so I rushed over without stopping.”
“I hope to make a trade with you.”
“I’m willing to offer a fair price to buy that fashion component from you, I’m here with the sincere intent to trade, don’t worry, I’m definitely not thinking about strong-arming you for it.”
“Which one?”
Chen Yi’s eyelids twitched slightly as he glanced at the middle-aged man seated below the throne, his mind already covertly contemplating how to make his offer. If he hadn’t misunderstood, how many were missing, just one?
A fashion set composed of multiple fashion components, and he’s just missing one?
And that one is in his hands?
Did he really come all this way just to find him?
Then he’d have to give the price a good thought.
“Ah… the Agarwood Bracelet you have there.”
“Oh?”
Chen Yi looked down at the Agarwood Bracelet in his hand, an item he’d obtained from the Sands of Time Fashion Chest the last time, which belonged to the wrist accessory category within a fashion set.
He hadn’t really paid it much attention.
He had just taken it out earlier on to assert his presence, just for show.
But now, it seemed like it might actually be valuable?
Fashion Name: Under One Person – Agarwood Bracelet.
Fashion Level: C-class.
Fashion Effect: When wearing any single item from the set, it greatly enhances the wearer’s sense of balance, and collecting all items of the set will unlock the complete set effects.
Fashion Introduction: “Below only one person, yet Invincible Under the Heavens, and that person shall be tomorrow’s me.”
For fashion sets ranked D-class and above, wearing an item from the set will provide some effects.
C-class is the same, only that C-class sets add a set effect.
The set effect is something that E-class and D-class sets lack. As for E-class sets, they don’t even have individual item effects—they are purely a set of clothes.
The green robe he was wearing was just hurriedly picked out from the Fashion Store as a temporary replacement for his little bear pajamas.
When equipped with different fashion items, not every fashion item’s effect will be triggered, but priority will be given to the one with the highest level.
As for two C-class fashion items, how the system determines which item has the higher level is something the player won’t see, but the system knows.
Just like how there’s a difference between C-class skills, even though they’re all C-class.
“You’re talking about this?”
Chen Yi swayed the Agarwood Bracelet in his hand and, after seeing the middle-aged man in front of the throne nod, he chuckled: “Sure thing, 100,000 Points.”
“…”
The middle-aged man stood there, stunned, a touch of disbelief flickering in his eyes, raising his voice involuntarily: “Are you crazy? A C-class fashion single piece for 100,000 Points?”
“My life isn’t even worth that much!”
But immediately after, when he saw Chen Yi’s eyes gradually turning cold, he bit his lip and hesitated where he stood. If he could get this fashion component, he would complete the set!
To a collector!
Missing just one piece from a complete set and being unable to find it, that’s something that could keep him awake all night!
And with the June rules forcing you to sleep between 9 and 10 p.m., if he couldn’t sleep, that would be a serious problem.
He didn’t want another title saying “Sick unto death!” to appear above the one on his head that reads “I have a sword, who dares respond?”
But 100,000 Points, that was just too much.
Not to say he wasn’t willing, even if he was, he couldn’t possibly have that many Points!
After hesitating for a long while, the middle-aged man ventured: “Let’s make it a deal, how about 2,000 Points?”
“Look up to the sky.”
Chen Yi’s face remained calm as he pointed towards the multitude of glowing, glittering titles above his head: “See that? You think I’m short of just a few Points?”
“…”
The middle-aged man looked up at the pillar-like titles above, then froze again, realizing that indeed, Chen Yi probably wasn’t short on those 2,000 Points, but those 2,000 Points were nearly all his savings.
Earning Points in May is no easy feat, okay?!
“How about this.”
He suddenly exhaled a long breath, looking up gravely at Chen Yi: “I’ll give you a pass, this pass allows you to go to a special map.”
“That map, it poses significant risks to your life.”
“As for the map reward… others might not be interested, but I believe you definitely will be.”
“My unique character action that has an effect within nearly a hundred meters was obtained from that map.”
“It’s a globally unique character action.”
“The reward for that map is just one type, character actions, with the highest-level reward being a globally unique character action.”
“This price should be enough to satisfy you, right?”
Chen Yi sat on the throne, leaning back slowly in his chair, his expression placid without speaking, slowly closing his eyes and fiddling with the beads of his Agarwood Bracelet, unconsciously tapping the armrest of the chair.
At this moment, his mind was filled with just a few repeating words.
Globally! Unique! Character action!
What a joke!
He bloody needed that thing!
…

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 78 - 77: "You like to carry with one hand behind your back, right?
chapters.content:
Chapter 78 – 77: “You like to carry with one hand behind your back, right?
Chen Yi, seated on the Frozen Throne, did not speak.
He just leaned back in the chair, his eyes tightly closed, his mind uncontrollably conjuring the image of himself appearing before the public with a special effect spanning a hundred meters.
What a sight that was.
The swagger, if not displayed several times in one’s life, would surely be a life lived in vain.
He did not know how much time had passed.
A cautious, probing voice finally came from beneath the throne.
“Uh… are you not satisfied?”
“Show it to me.”
Chen Yi slowly opened his eyes and looked down calmly at the man standing before the throne.
“Okay.”
The middle-aged man took out a card-like pass from his bosom and suddenly, with a serious expression, barked, “Go!”
The next second—
His wrist flicked violently, and the pass was flung several meters into the air above his head.
As the surrounding players lifted their gazes unconsciously toward the teal card suspended mid-air,
“Clang!”
A crisp sword chime suddenly rang out!
The Three-Foot Qingfeng sword, like a swimming dragon, soared upwards from behind the middle-aged man, its blade catching the pass steadily before shooting towards Chen Yi with force!
And it stopped abruptly less than three fists away from him.
“Please, friend, take a look!”
“Hmm.”
With a demeanor neither servile nor overbearing, Chen Yi sat on the throne as if he had no intention of dodging at all, merely retracting the cigarette in his palm that provided one second of invincibility back into his sleeve unnoticed.
And internally, he made a mental note of this middle-aged man’s actions.
A challenge, is it?
He did not say much, but reached out to take the pass on the sword’s edge and looked at its panel description.
「Prop Name」: “Life Theater Pass.”
「Prop Level」: C-Class.
「Prop Effect」: With this pass, one can go to the map “Life Theater” from any location. Each player can only receive a reward once inside the map; after receiving the reward, one cannot enter the map again.
「Prop Restrictions」: Remaining uses (5/10).
「Prop Introduction」: “Life is but a play, but who knows that your life is of the restricted kind?”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow and did not speak. A C-Class map?
A map that could produce a globally unique character action, and it’s just a C-Class?
But then he thought that at this point in time, most people probably wanted things to enhance their combat power, not character actions that were utterly useless for combat power.
It made sense then why this map was only a C-Class, as gimmicky items were superficial, while only those that could enhance one’s combat power were truly substantial.
Even if the special effects covered a larger area,
They were just special effects, after all.
Unable to inflict even the slightest damage on the enemy.
For the lone wolf players who prize strength, risking their lives to enter the map and struggling to obtain such a reward was simply an insult to their intelligence.
But for the show-off faction…
As long as the map was not certain death, they had to break through it, regardless of the consequences.
However, this remaining count of 5?
Before Chen Yi could ask,
The middle-aged man beneath the throne began to explain, “A person can only receive a reward once in this map.”
“Not only is there a globally unique character action in this map.”
“There are also other character actions.”
“I gave up the reward for ordinary character actions four times in a row, and finally obtained the globally unique character action reward on the fifth attempt.”
“But I can no longer enter this map, once a reward has been taken, one cannot re-enter, as it is a single-player map that only allows one player at a time.”
“Good.”
After pondering for a moment, Chen Yi tossed the Agarwood Bracelet in his hand to Tuberculosis Rabbit to pass it to the middle-aged man below, and pocketed the pass, saying softly.
“The trade is complete.”
The middle-aged man who received the Agarwood Bracelet finally let his heart settle down, a trace of gratitude flashing in his eyes as he looked at Chen Yi: “Thanks, I took a bit of an advantage in this trade, consider it a favor I owe you.”
He originally thought that Chen Yi would attempt to haggle further.
After all, although the pass was valuable, he could no longer use it, which meant he had effectively exchanged a prop he could not use for one he desperately needed.
No matter how one looked at it, he was making a huge profit.
In this situation, Chen Yi’s choice not to haggle further, avoiding making the trade any more difficult, left him feeling grateful.
Then the middle-aged man stood in place, with his left hand behind his back and his right hand forming a sword technique, gazed upward solemnly at Chen Yi and declared, “Before coming here, I did not know this prop was in your possession.”
“I know your name.”
“Chen Yi, the first player to appear on the global announcement, the top person on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard.”
“My name is Sword Without End.”
“Let’s say we’ve met this time, and I’ll throw in an additional piece of news for you. It seems you might not be aware of this, but there’s a player team formed spontaneously in later times that is recruiting powerful players globally.”
“Its purpose is for players to unite, tackle those high-difficulty maps together, and assist each other in the struggle to survive.”
“I’m also a member. Perhaps someone will find you later.”
“Till we meet again!”
With the end of his words—
There suddenly came a deep drumming sound from beyond the horizon, striking at the heart of every player, instantly quieting the scene!
And overhead, clouds had gathered, nearly covering all the players!
It felt as if dark clouds were looming over the city, threatening to break it apart.
Sword Without End stood with one hand behind his back, proudly lifting his gaze to the black clouds above, then suddenly spoke in a dramatic and powerful tone, clear as if it were ringing right beside every player’s ear, proclaiming!
“Thirty thousand daos, the sword is supreme!”
“Grasping the sun and moon to pick the stars, in this world, there is none other like me!”
The next second—
Countless Thunder Dragons, their expressions fierce, burst forth from the clouds, carrying a world-ending force and a terrifying pressure as they hurtled straight toward Sword Without End amidst the crowd!
Under the overwhelming might between heaven and earth!
Human strength seemed incredibly insignificant!
Many players were temporarily unable to discern reality from illusion, fleeing frantically in all directions with terrified expressions.
And once again, Sword Without End’s shout echoed!
“A sword’s chill spans nineteen provinces, sword qi cutting across thirty thousand miles!”
“Sword, come forth!”
Thousands of Three-Foot Qingfeng swords appeared beside Sword Without End, and as he clenched the sword technique in his right hand, he thrust violently towards the countless Thunder Dragons in the sky!
The thousands of Three-Foot Qingfengs soared like dragons, spiraling upward!
Slaying Thunder Dragons, tearing through dark clouds.
The dark clouds were suddenly ripped apart, blinding light piercing through as if the moon shone brightly after piercing the dark clouds.
Immediately following, Sword Without End, who had been standing in place, now had a trembling Three-Foot Qingfeng under his feet, shooting forth at a speed too fast to catch, towards the distance.
Leaving behind only a slowly fading streak of green afterglow.
And that solemn and powerful parting phrase.
“Fellow daoists, good night.”
It was only several seconds later when everything slowly dissipated and returned to normal, including the Minotaur Monsters below who seemed somewhat dazedly looking up at the sky.
They were somewhat unclear about the situation.
“Fourth on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard, Traceless Green Peak.”
“C-class Vehicle.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked towards the Global Vehicle Leaderboard, and spoke expressionlessly: “The Three-Foot Qingfeng under Sword Without End’s feet is named Traceless Green Peak, with a rating of 2890.”
“It’s just over 1000 points lower than your vehicle’s rating, Yi.”
“It must be a special vehicle, capable of not only transporting people but also being used for attacks, and it even seems to have some sword-flying techniques. The basic score for a C-class prop is only 1000 points.”
“He must have upgraded it for it to reach a score of 2890.”
“But I can’t see any signs of modification, don’t know what options were modified.”
“That green afterglow, it must be similar to the colorful flame tail you have, Yi, and belongs to one of the vehicle’s trailing effects. As for his departing special effect,”
“whether it’s character action or title effect, it’s a bit hard to tell.”
“But his title seems to hold some substance, likely not a weak effect.”
“For such an ostentatious title, it must be backed by some solid qualities.”
After a brief pause, Tuberculosis Rabbit then sighed deeply: “I’m starting to get annoyed, this person is just too pretentious.”
Chen Yi didn’t say anything, just waved his hand to have the soldiers flanking the throne move out to surround and attack the Minotaur Monsters. Then he turned to look at Jiaye standing beside the throne, a smile suddenly curling the corners of his mouth.
“Why did you suddenly decide to improvise?”
There was no time earlier.
He had to complete changing costumes, creating distance, managing expressions, and other meticulous actions all while Tuberculosis Rabbit was drawing everyone’s attention, leaving no time to communicate with Jiaye.
The act of Jiaye pouring wine for him had been completely improvised by Jiaye himself.
But it must be said, the effect was excellent.
“Hehe~”
Jiaye stood next to the throne’s armrest, clutching the hem of her dress with smiling eyes, letting out a bell-like laugh before raising an eyebrow: “Because I guessed what you were thinking, that’s why.”
“How was it, did I play the role of the Queen convincingly?”
“The Queen?”
Chen Yi looked surprised as he turned to look at Jiaye: “You were playing the Queen? I thought you were a maid.”
“…”
Jiaye’s smile suddenly froze in place, with a flash of speechlessness in her eyes, a bit unsure how to respond.
At this moment, Chen Yi also noticed the anomaly beneath Jiaye’s feet.
He saw that Jiaye’s feet had never actually touched the ground; when she was in the air, she was barefoot, but upon walking on the ground, there would appear two spontaneously manifesting waves, carrying Jiaye forward.
Any dust that sometimes settled was quickly washed away by the water waves.
It turned out they were real waves, not just effects.
“What do you think?”
Noticing Chen Yi’s gaze, Jiaye’s eyes curved like crescents. She looked down at the two constantly rolling waves under her feet with satisfaction and smiled happily.
“Do they look nice?”
“This is the fashion effect of my C-class strappy dress. No need to wear shoes, no chance of getting sore feet, and it even increases movement speed.”
“Is it freshwater?”
Chen Yi asked, his brow slightly furrowed.
“Ah?”
Jiaye paused in place for a moment, not quite understanding what he meant.
“I mean, are those two rolling waves under your feet freshwater or saltwater?”
“If it’s freshwater, it’s no problem—could even be used as a water resource in critical times.”
“But if it’s saltwater, that’s a bit troublesome, as prolonged soaking in saltwater can erode the skin.”
“Freshwater is sweet, saltwater is salty.”
“Taste them, and you’ll know if it’s freshwater or saltwater.”
“…”
Jiaye stood silently in place, her body slightly rigid, not speaking or knowing what to say.
And just then,
The players finally started to come to their senses as if waking from a dream and resumed the previous commotion, chatting while raising their cleavers high to face the nearby Minotaur Monsters.
…
“Isn’t that nice.”
Li Yide stood in place, one hand behind his back, musing dreamily: “Everyone likes to keep one hand behind their back, huh?”
“Is it like your arm’s broken and in a cast, unable to come back out?”
“Got hemorrhoids itching or something?”
“Why not tuck all your limbs behind your back instead?”
“Little Liu, we need to start acting too, otherwise, look at those mountains ahead, they’re pressing down on people so much they can barely breathe.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 79 - 78: Is This Too Open? (Added for ’Little Bear’ Clan Leader He!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 79 – 78: Is This Too Open? (Added for ’Little Bear’ Clan Leader He!)
The crowd bustled about.
After the liveliness of days gone by had faded, although players were still chatting incessantly, their hands were earnestly combating the Minotaur Monsters before them.
At 8 am, the June 1st Children’s Day event would officially kick off.
Grinding for more Points tonight would also provide more leverage to deal with the fresh challenges of June.
Beyond that, there were many things to test out.
Like the definition of food: does it have to be cooked, or can dry and fast-food products also qualify?
Or the meaning of having dinner at 8 pm: does it have to start at 8 pm, or is it just after 8 pm, and are there any specific rules about dinner timing?
Then there’s the June rule that mandates sleep must be between 9 pm and 10 pm and waking before 6 am,
So, can one start sleeping at 3 pm and wake up at midnight?
After all, that also fits the element of being in dreamland between 9 and 10 pm and getting up before 6 am.
Players need to try out these somewhat ambiguous rules themselves, but fortunately, they have three chances to err, which greatly reduces the cost of trial and error.
Of course, all that needs to be put off until June 2nd.
On June 1st, due to the rules taking effect in the wee hours, all players have a one-time exemption from the rules, meaning on the first day, the June rules do not apply.
There is now a lot that can be purchased in the personal panel’s store.
That includes food, water resources, and so forth.
People no longer worry about the lack of fresh food sources, but these items must all be purchased with Points; so far, the only way to acquire Points has been by slaying the monsters outside the city.
There used to be another daily task under the April rules called ’Active Expert’, which awarded 1 Point per day.
But now that the April rules are offline, that source of Points can be said to have completely dried up.
Luckily, these monsters outside the city refresh incessantly, utterly impossible to wipe out, and in the short term are quite a decent source of Points.
Just then—
All players near Yancheng suddenly heard a prompt by their ears!
“Ding, congratulations to Yancheng for successfully completing the main city task!”
“All players may proceed to the task window at Yancheng’s central square to receive tasks; complete them actively for a generous reward.”
“Hm?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, pulling out a cigarette from his pocket and casually lighting it, exhaled a long puff of smoke before speaking with some confusion, “Yancheng successfully completed the main city task?”
“What main city task? How come we don’t know anything about this?”
“But when we head back later, we can see what tasks there are.”
Afterward, he glanced at Jiaye, who was idly swinging her legs at the side of the Frozen Throne, hesitated for a moment, then pulled out a small card from his pocket and quickly stuffed it into Yi’s hands.
He kept winking and signaling with his eyes.
“What?”
Chen Yi glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit’s peculiar expression, suddenly thought of something, coughed lightly, and turned his body slightly away from Jiaye to look at the small card in his hands.
’Prop Name’: Silver Party Ticket.
’Prop Rank’: E-grade.
’Prop Effect’: After activation, it can transport the player to a venue and comes with an unremovable mask, with a maximum stay of 12 hours.
’Prop Description’: “Whether absurd or ridiculous, when the moonlight unfolds before your eyes, to not appreciate it would seem somewhat charmless.”
’Prop Price’: Sold directly in the store for 100 Points.
“…”
Just as he suspected, it was indeed the thing he had thought of. Chen Yi looked up at Tuberculosis Rabbit with an awkward expression, noting the eagerness in his eyes. Wait, that’s not just eagerness—it was practically impatience!
With this thought, he shifted his position again so as not to draw Jiaye’s attention.
After all, it’s better to avoid such matters in front of the girls.
However, just then—
A crisp voice from Jiaye came from behind, “A Silver Party Ticket? I bought one the moment the store arrived. It wasn’t expensive, just 100 Points.”
“Ah?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit froze, his jaw dropping to the ground, his mouth wide open in disbelief, he turned his head to look at Jiaye, who was serious and wearing dungarees, and his throat went dry, unable to utter a word!
“You… you… you…”
“This… this… this…”
“I… I… I…”
What the hell is going on!
Even Chen Yi felt as if he’d been struck by lightning, first kicking Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dropped jaw back into place, then turning around stiffly to face Jiaye.
It was as if he were seeing the girl before him in a new light.
Isn’t she a bit too open-minded?
“What are you thinking?”
Jiaye saw the looks from Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit, her brow furrowing with slight dissatisfaction before she hesitated on the spot, taking a while before she said,
“I bought one for my brother.”
“I want him to have some fun; he was born with cerebral palsy, not only is his thinking on par with a child’s, but his speech is also unclear, preventing him from finding a wife.”
“He’s so old and still doesn’t have a wife.”
“Every time I think of this, I remember the dog I used to have; I never let him taste meat in his life, which is kind of sad.”
“So that’s why I thought of letting my brother go in and have fun.”
“Besides, it’s a two-way selection, so it can’t be considered disrespectful to the other ladies, right?”
“And if we’re not considering being together for long, at nearly two meters tall, my brother should be quite popular in there.”
“…”
Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit stood silent, not saying a word.
Seconds later.
Both lit up a cigarette and brought it to their lips, inhaled deeply in unison, and then gazed together, with a glassy look, up at the bright moon in the night sky at a forty-five-degree angle, before exhaling a puff of pale blue smoke together.
In their shared melancholy, they remained silent.
All was understood without words.
To speak or not to speak, that is the hesitation.
That’s exactly the situation right now.
“Hey!”
Jiaye’s tone carried a hint of dissatisfaction as she stressed, “You guys, don’t make those faces, okay? He’s really pitiful, you have no idea what someone with cerebral palsy has to go through on a daily basis.”
“Otherwise, why do you think my brother felt so close to you the first time he met you?”
“Isn’t it because you gave him a cigarette?”
“When selling fish, regular customers often give cigarettes to other vendors and chat a bit about everyday things, but no one has ever given my brother a cigarette, and even when they talk to him, it’s in a mocking tone.”
“Customers often come to mockingly ask my brother what seven plus eight is.”
“Every time someone gives other vendors a cigarette, my brother just sits on the stool staring, hoping someone would offer him one too.”
“In his heart, offering a cigarette is a brotherly form of recognition.”
“So that’s why he felt so close to you the first time he met you on the helicopter, because you gave him a cigarette right when you met.”
“My brother doesn’t actually smoke at all; those few cigarettes you gave him, he’s kept them all hidden in an iron box, tucked away in the deepest pocket against his chest.”
“He’s already so pitiful, what’s wrong with letting him have a little fun inside?”
“Besides, isn’t it a mutual choice in there? Have I done something wrong?”
“Why are you looking like that!”
At this point, Jiaye’s voice trembled slightly, faintly carrying the sound of tears, evidently overwhelmed by the accumulation of past events before the game transformed her.
“…Well.”
Chen Yi hesitated, raising his hand halfway, his mouth opened and closed a few times in reticence before he let out a sigh of resignation, “You’ve misunderstood us.”
“The reason we did that, it’s a little game Tuberculosis Rabbit and I often play where we mimic each other’s actions to see how in sync we are.”
“I wholeheartedly approve of this, no objections.”
“Tie Chui is my brother too.”
“This way.”
Chen Yi threw the ticket he had in his arms to Tuberculosis Rabbit and earnestly instructed him, “I’m giving you a task, take brother Tie Chui to play inside tonight.”
“Just make sure to return by 7 a.m. tomorrow.”
“Make sure brother Tie Chui has a blast.”
“Ah?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused, looking toward Tie Chui not far away who was forcefully tossing a Minotaur Monster high into the air, then leaping up on the spot and, while bellowing, punched the Minotaur’s head straight into a deep pit in the ground.
Swallowing hard, a glint of confusion flashed in his eyes.
Isn’t that a bit too fierce?
“Are we… really going?”
“Otherwise?”
Chen Yi sat calmly on the Frozen Throne and said softly, “Don’t you want to go?”
“I want to, it’s just that I…”
“Never mind.”
Biting the bullet, Tuberculosis Rabbit gripped the Silver Party Ticket in his hand and strode toward Tie Chui, who was still fighting in the distance!
Actually, he wanted to go with Yi.
Chatting and playing together, what could be better?
Going with Tie Chui somehow felt less fun; he preferred the conversations with Yi, as the others didn’t quite get the points he was trying to make.
But since Yi had instructed him, there was no reason to not follow through.
…
Three minutes later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui vanished in a flash of white light, not drawing any attention.
“So this is the place?”
As the sensation of weightlessness beneath his feet slowly dissipated, Tuberculosis Rabbit opened his eyes and surveyed his surroundings.
He saw a massive hall in front of him, about half the size of a soccer field.
It looked very elegant.
There was even a full orchestra performing on the stage, the elegant violin music almost subconsciously made one think of fastening a bow tie.
Beneath were several small round tables.
The round tables were laid with a variety of exquisite desserts, and from time to time waiters in suspenders passed in between, carrying trays laden with various beverages.
Many handsome men and beautiful women, dressed in formal attire and wearing masks, were seated in small groups at the tables, engaging in lively and cheerful conversations.
No one was dressed provocatively.
Everyone’s attire was tidy, and unlike what he imagined, there were no raucous sounds of partying or any risqué jokes upon entering.
Everything looked nothing like a Silver Party but rather like a gathering for upper-class socialites.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 80 - 79: "Isn’t this too presumptuous of you?" (Extra for Leader ’Riddle_He’)
chapters.content:
Chapter 80 – 79: “Isn’t this too presumptuous of you?” (Extra for Leader ’Riddle_He’)
“…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit felt slightly awkward as he tightened his belt once more and hastily looked down at the event ticket in his hand.
That’s right.
He hadn’t gone to the wrong place.
But the scene in front of him wasn’t just a bit different from what he had imagined, it was a completely different world.
Just then—
A waiter strode toward them, his face unseen, but his voice was soft and gentle.
“Welcome both of you to Hall 188 of the Silver Party.”
“There are ten minutes left before the official start. Please find a suitable table and take a seat. Shortly, a host will guide everyone to begin the activities.”
“Ho?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was a bit shocked and paused; there was a host, so professional!
You could tell it was high class!
True to a game’s hosting, it had fully transcended lowbrow tastes, focusing on elegance.
And that was just perfect for him, as he was naturally allergic to vulgarity and had a fondness for refinement.
Soon after they had taken their seats,
the lights in the hall dimmed.
The band on stage also gradually ceased playing, and the entire venue fell silent. Suddenly, spotlights from the ceiling shone onto a man in a red suit who had appeared on the stage at some point.
The man, holding a cane in one hand and gesturing with his other arm toward the crowd beneath, spoke in a voice as soothing as a spring breeze.
“Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.”
“I am the host of the Silver Party event in Hall 188, and I will lead you to experience what true paradise is.”
“Please follow my rhythm, and I promise you an experience like no other.”
“Now…”
Sitting at the round table, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked sentimentally toward the host on stage while continuously stuffing the free desserts on the table into his mouth.
It was all free.
Eating more could mean earning back the ticket cost.
Such a bargain!
Was the Snow Sea Project Team doing charity now?
At that moment, he suddenly heard a familiar male voice next to his ear.
“Good evening, madam. Have you ever heard that beyond this world, there exist immortals?”
“Do you believe in the existence of immortals in this world?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was startled for a moment. He instinctively stuffed the last dessert into his mouth and turned to look at the next table. Though surrounded by darkness, he still recognized the middle-aged man trying to strike up a conversation.
“Damn, you’re that Sword Without End who ran off after showing off!”
“Didn’t you leave? Why did you come here?”
Although he couldn’t see through Sword Without End’s mask, and because the lounge blocked all props, skills, and even titles, he couldn’t even see the title above Sword Without End’s head.
But that voice was too familiar!
He had just heard it; how could he possibly forget!
“So you ran off so hastily just to make it to the Silver Party?”
“Has the Hehuan Sect started training Sword Immortals too?”
Sword Without End, who was trying to flirt, stiffened momentarily, then, without turning his head, abandoned his current target and strode into the darkness to find a new one.
“Teehee.”
The woman who had just been approached by Sword Without End covered her mouth and let out a silvery laugh, her eyes gleaming as she looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit: “Brother, you certainly are a character.”
Although he couldn’t see her face clearly, judging by her curvaceous figure and those watery, soul-hooking eyes,
he guessed her looks wouldn’t disappoint and she was probably in her early thirties.
A tight-fitting cheongsam accentuated her figure beautifully.
Quite the picture of femininity.
“Gulp.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit unconsciously swallowed, his eyes struggling to move away from the woman in front of him: “Are we starting now? Didn’t the host say to wait?”
“Damn it, I forgot to use a prop before coming in.”
Just then—
