The woman slowly stood up and walked to Tuberculosis Rabbit’s side, her body limp as a boneless chicken foot, and she collapsed into Tie Chui’s embrace with a dazed look, lightly dragging her finger across his chest.
“Such a sturdy body could really crush someone to death.”
“Yes,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded gravely, “He could crush someone. Come here to me; I’m skinny. If you were really crushed to death, that wouldn’t be a joyous occasion at all.”
Looking up with eyes brimming with seduction at Tie Chui, who appeared somewhat perplexed, and feeling his body suddenly tense and rigid, the woman couldn’t help but chuckle softly, her fingers trailing across Tie Chui’s slightly prickly stubble.
Her voice growing increasingly hazy, she murmured,
“My body is soft, though.”
“It can take the pressure.”
Meanwhile—
It seemed as if the host on stage had signaled the start, and the lights throughout the venue suddenly went out.
Lively music played in the darkness as many social butterflies began to dance to the beat.
Tie Chui’s anxious cries for help could be heard in the dark.
“Brother Tuberculosis Rabbit, help me.”
“Help your mom.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat alone on a small sofa beside the round table, puffing on a cigarette he had lit with irritation, engulfed in smoke.
The venue had thought of everything.
There were cigarettes on the table, might as well smoke one more if possible.
Since he hadn’t successfully paired up before nightfall, he was left with no choice but to recoup his expenses with desserts and cigarettes.
As Tuberculosis Rabbit was brooding by himself,
a soft and tender white hand suddenly rested on his shoulder in the dark, and the damp breath close to his ear made a woman’s voice softly ask,
“Aren’t you the one from the Garden District in Yancheng?”
“Hm?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit narrowed his eyes and said coldly, “How do you know that?”
“I definitely know.”
The woman’s voice was as gentle as a fly buzzing, “I wonder if next time, could you also bring that man with many titles above his head? I really want him.”
The next second—
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s breathing suddenly became slightly obstructed, a look of shock flashed across his eyes, and he couldn’t help but exclaim, “No way, isn’t that too damn presumptuous!”
“Damn it! Are you out of your mind?”
“Can’t you be a bit more normal?!”
“What kind of people are you all!”
But immediately after, he was at a loss for words because the woman had somehow managed to curl up into his arms, burrowing into his short sleeves and nestling her head into his chest.
Silently and without expression, Tuberculosis Rabbit paused for a moment before bringing a cigarette to his lips for a fierce drag, then pinched the cigarette butt between his fingers and flicked it aside.
“Looks like I have to learn to adapt to this presumptuous world.”
…
Time ticked away until it reached 5 a.m.
The number of people killing monsters on the outskirts of the city hadn’t decreased; in fact, they were only increasing.
Chen Yi sat on the throne in silence, saying nothing.
With the 100 soldiers he had summoned to kill Minotaur Monsters for him, he didn’t need to lift a finger, even if the Minotaur Monsters’ profit was pretty low.
Defeating a Minotaur Monster yielded only 2 to 4 Points.
A single soldier could barely defeat a Minotaur Monster; it was often a fight to mutual destruction, and the Minotaur Monster’s One Stone Axe coming crashing down was pretty lethal.
At least his heavy-armored soldiers couldn’t quite handle it.
It took at least two heavy-armored soldiers to gang up on a Minotaur Monster to succeed.
Although the profit was a bit low, he didn’t have much else to do.
A mosquito may be small, but it’s still meat.
Moreover, occasionally a small Prop would drop, which was better than nothing.
If only he had a chef with him right now.
He could be eating some hot midnight snacks.
Although food could be bought from the store, it was all basic dry rations; definitely filling, but one shouldn’t expect too much in terms of taste.
As for the Life Theater map that awarded the unique global character action, he didn’t plan to go right now, waiting instead until the Child’s Day event was over.
At 8 a.m., the Child’s Day event would officially begin.
Now that it was already 5 a.m., it was almost upon them.
At this moment, Jiaye was sitting on the edge of the throne, legs dangling in the air, her little head bobbing like a tumbler, clearly on the verge of dozing off.
Chen Yi leaned back in his chair, without a sense of tiredness, as he had only recently awoken.
Just as he was about to organize the Props in his backpack.
A sudden double flash of white light appeared before him.
When the white light faded.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui were suddenly standing there.
“Oh?”
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow and leaned back in his chair, smiling, “How was it, did you have fun?”
“Whether it was fun or not is another question,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit wiped the cold sweat from his forehead with a somewhat wistful click of his tongue, “But brother Tie Chui here is genuinely sincere, a keeper.
“At the end of the venue, brother Tie Chui was hugging a woman and wouldn’t let go for the life of him.”
“He insisted on bringing this woman back for you, Yi, to have a taste.”
“In the end, a bolt of lightning split from the ceiling of the venue, and only then did Tie Chui let go and fainted. He’s just woken up now, probably still a bit confused.”
“Uh…”
Chen Yi looked toward Tie Chui, who was still a bit dazed, jumped down from the throne, and handed him a cigarette, patting his arm and grinning.
“Thanks for the thought, bro.”
“You’ve had a tough trip, brother. Go rest, rest up a bit.”
“The Child’s Day event is about to start.”
“I should head back and get some more rest myself.”
Meanwhile, Jiaye, who was slowly waking up at the side, with sleepy eyes, stretched out her hand to pull Tie Chui over, then sat on his shoulder and looked up at Chen Yi.
“Well, Yi, we’ll be heading back first then.”
“We’ll come find you when the event starts.”
“Sure, go ahead.”
Chen Yi stood there with his staff, watching Jiaye and the others leave with a calm expression.
Perhaps because they both wore strappy dresses, they didn’t fly but started walking instead.
Of course, Tie Chui’s walking speed wasn’t slow either; he moved at a brisk pace.
After watching the two leave, Chen Yi placed one hand behind his back, covertly rubbing his butt and muttering a complaint.
“Next time I’ll make sure to get a softer cushion; this Frozen Throne really stiffens one’s butt.”
“Let’s go, still can get three to four hours of rest back home.”
“I still don’t know what this Child’s Day event is going to be.”
Afterward, without saying more, he activated his sleigh and, with Tuberculosis Rabbit in tow, shot towards Yancheng, heading straight for the Garden District.
…
“…”
Li Yide watched the scene of Chen Yi leaving with one hand behind his back, a satisfied nod on his face: “Sure enough, those who like to keep their hand behind their back are all a bit itchy in the butt.”
“Lucky for me, mine’s just fine.”
He shook his own Fox Tail with a slight sense of smug satisfaction.
…
In the Garden District, a certain building.
“Where did you go just now?”
A man’s voice, slightly anxious and hurried, rose, “I’ve been looking for you for a long time.”
“I…”
The woman, a bit flustered but trying to sound calm, explained in a low voice, “I went for a night run, you see, trying to improve my fitness to face emergencies, right?”
“Feel here, my neck is still sweaty.”
“It’s tiring, okay?”
…
ps: There will be another update in the early morning.

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 81 - 80: "Children’s Day" Special Limited-Time Event Officially Begins! (Extra update for 1000 monthly tickets)
chapters.content:
Chapter 81 – 80: “Children’s Day” Special Limited-Time Event Officially Begins! (Extra update for 1000 monthly tickets)
“Ding-ling-ling, ding-ling-ling!”
The grating sound of an alarm clock abruptly rang out in a room in the Garden District.
It was 07:30 in the morning.
“Is it time already?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit rubbed his bleary eyes, stretched languidly, and after a yawn of epic proportions, he got up and ran to the bathroom to wash up.
While washing up, he looked towards the breakfast on the table and asked somewhat curiously.
“Yi, did you make this food?”
“Wasn’t it said that the ’June Rule’ doesn’t take effect on the 1st? Why are we suddenly eating this morning?”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi stood by the window looking outside without turning around and replied softly, “We still don’t know whether the eating mentioned in the June Rule refers to fast food products, or if it specifically requires cooked food straight from the pot.”
“We haven’t found a cook yet.”
“So, I made some breakfast myself first, in case fast food products don’t fulfill the task of the rule tomorrow, we’ll be better prepared.”
“And to get used to the food I make ahead of time.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s body suddenly stiffened, he took a long time to finish washing up with slow, hesitant movements and then reluctantly approached the table, looking at the two steaming bowls of egg noodles without a word.
He didn’t have the courage to pick up the chopsticks for a while.
After a long silence, he finally looked up at Yi’s back.
“Yi, why is the noodle black?”
“I added soy sauce.”
“You added a bit too much, didn’t you?”
“Hmm, I did add a bit too much.”
“Yi, do you know the difference between soy sauce and dark soy?”
“I don’t, do you?”
“I don’t either.”
“Then let’s eat.”
After a prolonged silence, Tuberculosis Rabbit finally mustered enough courage and sat down on the stool, cautiously chewing on the noodles that had turned too dark to be properly seen.
He chewed carefully.
“Hm?”
After a few bites, Tuberculosis Rabbit expressed his mild surprise, “It’s actually not bad, eh? It’s got more bite than last time, and I can finally tell it’s actually noodles.”
“Really?”
Chen Yi, standing by the window with his back to Tuberculosis Rabbit, spoke with a faint trace of pride in his voice, “I looked up some strategies, I rinsed the noodles with cold water before taking them out of the pot, that’s why they’re chewier.”
“It is much better than last time, but Yi, why is it so sour?”
“The strategy said that if you add too much soy sauce, you should add some vinegar.”
“So?”
“After I added too much soy sauce, I put in some vinegar, then realized the vinegar was too much.”
“And then?”
“Then I looked up more strategies, which said if there’s too much vinegar, add more soy sauce.”
“Alright, Yi, you don’t need to say any more, I can imagine what it was like when you were cooking.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyelids twitched a few times as he set his chopsticks rest on the bowl. He could already picture Yi holding a soy sauce bottle in his left hand and a vinegar bottle in his right, standing by the pot continuously seasoning the dish.
To his knowledge,
this type of behavior often occurs with witches concocting potions in the antagonists of fairy tales.
He couldn’t stomach the food anymore.
But not to dishearten Yi, he took a deep breath, pulled out a spicy carrot from his chest pocket, and started chewing vigorously.
Then he held the bowl to his lips, closed his eyes, and shoveled the noodles into his mouth with his chopsticks.
…
Fifteen minutes later.
Chen Yi, dressed neatly, was standing at his front door ready to head out when he hesitated and looked towards Tuberculosis Rabbit, who wore a somewhat sickly expression.
“There’s no perfect person in this world, everyone has their flaws.”
“You can understand that, right?”
“I get it, Yi, you don’t need to explain, we’re brothers.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit forced a smile, with only one thought in mind – this stuff couldn’t possibly be toxic, right?
“Let’s go, we’ll meet up with Jiaye and the others.”
“It’s time to get ready for the Children’s Day event.”
With less than 20 minutes left until the Children’s Day event,
as they were walking out of the building heading towards the rooftop, they suddenly heard voices in the fire escape, sounding like a couple coming downstairs.
You could faintly hear their conversation.
“Who knows how long the natural gas will last, what will we do about cooking if it gets cut off?”
“What’s there to be afraid of? If it gets cut off, it won’t just be us affected; with so many people cut off, how will others cook, how will we cook—same deal.”
“That’s true.”
As the voices grew clearer,
they saw the couple at the corner of the fire escape, looking like a young husband and wife.
The man wore a smart shirt and vest and carried black-rimmed glasses, looking like a cultured individual.
The woman was in a retro-styled long dress with sandals, tying up her ponytail while walking down the stairs, portraying an efficient air about her.
The makeup was light, and her looks were ordinary.
But there was a strong professional vibe about her, kind of like a teacher.
“`
Speaking of which, for some reason, the occupation of female teachers seems very recognizable. When you walk down the street and see a woman who feels like she might be a teacher…
Chances are, you can trust your gut because she’s probably a primary school teacher.
Perhaps it’s childhood DNA kicking in, that familiar aura suddenly awakening a deep fear within.
The young couple had been chatting as they came downstairs, but as soon as they saw Chen Yi and his companion at the bottom of the stairs, they froze, a flicker of panic passing through both their eyes.
“You guys go ahead.”
Chen Yi casually stepped aside to make way, his expression calm. He was completely accustomed to strangers reacting like this upon seeing him, especially with more than a dozen titles floating above his head that were indeed quite eye-catching.
This was normal.
“Thank you, thank you.”
The man with black-framed glasses frantically grabbed the woman’s hand and dashed downstairs, as if fearful that making this big shot wait would provoke his anger.
And the woman, ever since seeing Chen Yi and his companion, had been keeping her head down, clutching her man’s arm tightly, closely following him down.
When she moved past Chen Yi and his companion, there was no eye contact, seemingly afraid of strangers.
“Eh?”
As the woman passed by the Tuberculosis Rabbit, it suddenly sniffed and said in mild surprise, “This shampoo smells so familiar, isn’t it Sassoon?”
The woman, almost at the corner, stiffened, still holding tightly to her man’s arm, not looking back.
“We have similar tastes; I also like Sassoon. It smells really nice, doesn’t it?”
The woman responded perfunctorily and then quickly headed downstairs, still clinging to her man’s arm.
Chen Yi and his companion didn’t linger.
They went straight to the rooftop and activated the sleigh, setting a bowl of egg noodles in front of the reindeer.
He made two bowls of noodles.
One for the Tuberculosis Rabbit to eat, and the other was placed here.
The reindeer, just pulled out of sleep, was still half-awake with its eyes barely open, but its nose twitched as if it had caught a scent.
Then, its eyes snapped open, glistening with eagerness as it looked at the bowl of egg noodles and started gobbling it down.
“…”
With hands in his pockets, the Tuberculosis Rabbit stood by with a somewhat emotional expression and said, “Times are tough for everyone. Look at Santa Claus, who knows how he’s been mistreating this poor reindeer.”
“And yet, it’s enjoying the meal so much.”
“Sticking with us, it gets to enjoy some good times for a while.”
Soon after finishing its meal…
Chen Yi carried the Tuberculosis Rabbit and flew straight to the coordinates sent by Jiaye.
They had barely exchanged a few words…
When 8 o’clock arrived.
A notification sounded in the ears of all players!
’Game Event Announcement!’
’June 1st to June 3rd — “Children’s Day” special limited-time event officially begins!’
’All players can participate in this event over these three days.’
’Event One: Children’s Paradise’
’All children under the age of 18 will be transported to a huge children’s paradise filled with chocolate, arcade games, many playmates, talking dolls, and a lot of fun equipment.’
’Children under the age of 18 will spend three days in this huge paradise, unconditionally enjoying themselves and hopefully creating wonderful childhood memories.’
’Event Two: Limited-Time Store.’
’Players can purchase various rare and typically hard-to-obtain props in the limited-time store over these three days using Points.’
’Event Three: Rose Guardian.’
’Male players can buy roses with Points and gift them to a female player to obtain corresponding guardian points, which can be exchanged for exclusive props in a special store.’
’Female players can use Points to buy a dedicated Small Speaker to canvass for themselves, thereby increasing the number of roses received and earning corresponding charm points based on the quantity, which can also be used to trade for exclusive props in the special store.’
’There will also be two exclusive global ranking lists for limited-time events!’
’”Gentleman’s Guardian List” and “Lady’s Charm List”.’
’The top ten on the Guardian and Charm Lists will receive different exclusive limited-time titles, a global announcement broadcast, and an event-exclusive unique character action.’
’Event Four: Spells Come True.’
’During the event, every player will possess the ability where anything they say might come true.’
’Based on the difficulty of the wish, the chances of it coming true range from one in ten million to one in a thousand.’
’Event Five: Rambunctious Little Monsters.’
’During the event, many giant brats carrying gift packs will randomly appear in corners around the world; defeating them will allow players to share in the lavish rewards!’
Voices resonated deep within the hearts of all players.
Neither the deaf nor the blind need to worry about missing out on the event announcement.
The five events comprised the entirety of the Children’s Day event.
Just as the announcement ended…
The once quiet Yancheng suburbs, attentively listening to the event details, suddenly exploded with a cacophony of urgent voices.
“My account has 1 million Points!!!”
“My account has 100 billion Points!!!”
“I’ll freaking punch the entire Snow Sea Project Team to death!”
What was once a peaceful Monster Brushing Square suddenly became a wishing district.
Perhaps, never before had so many wishes been made in unison at a single moment globally.
This could be a moment worthy of the history books.
If Heaven has a server and it suddenly received such a frequent, intense influx of wishes, it just might think it was under a DDoS attack from Satan.
…
ps: It should still be considered the early hours of the morning, right?
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 82 - 81: "Then I wish for your wish to fail.
chapters.content:
Chapter 82 – 81: “Then I wish for your wish to fail.
A one in ten million chance sounds very low, almost unattainable.
But that probability is based on the premise that every word you speak has a one in ten million chance of coming true.
Which means.
If you start off making 10,000 wishes a day, in a way, you can greatly increase that probability.
The Monster Brushing Square, originally silent and abiding by the rules, was now like a concert scene, filled with countless noisy and excited voices all converging in the hope that the God of Fortune would descend upon them.
The April rule “Active Expert” required every player to converse 1,000 sentences with others every day.
Although many people had accomplished this rule back then.
They lived in anxiety every day, like having the Sword of Damocles over their heads, dreading any accident might occur and render them mute.
And now, the June event “Kids Say the Darndest Things.”
It didn’t force anyone.
Yet, it made all players throw all caution to the wind, their faces excited and their eyes brimming with hope as they fervently and rapidly made wishes, words flying out at breakneck speed, before even closing their mouths from the last sentence, the next one would already be out.
…
“Let my mom return to normal, let my mom return to normal,” a young man in a tracksuit, kneeling on the ground, looked up solemnly and devoutly to the sky and muttered rapidly.
“Let my mom return to normal.”
“Please cure her illness and muteness.”
When the April rule came, his mother had just completed full anesthesia to prepare for surgery.
The surgery was hastily completed due to various accidents.
But because of violating the April rule, she had become mute and to this day could not speak.
…
“Let a million players buy a bouquet of Roses for me later.”
A woman standing in the crowd, her hands clasped in front of her chest, kept whispering softly.
Her thought was simple.
Instead of something intangible, she wanted something simple; if a million players each sent her a rose, she would surely top the “Charm List”!
She would then receive a large number of rewards!
After all, the simpler the wish, the greater the probability of success!
At least she believed that it was much simpler to get a million players to send her a bouquet of Roses than to magically have a million Points show up in her account.
…
“Let 10 Points appear in my account.”
“Let 10 Points appear in my account.”
Hearing the clear wishes nearby, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked surprised as he glanced towards the source and watched a young wisher with interest, unable to help but crack a smile.
“You’re not too greedy, huh?”
“You came out with a wish for just 10 Points?”
“Cough… better safe than sorry, 10 Points seems more realistic.”
“Interesting, then I’ll make a wish for your wish to fail.”
“…”
The young man stared blankly at Tuberculosis Rabbit and fell silent for a moment, after looking at the title above Tuberculosis Rabbit’s head and the dozen titles above the man next to him.
He didn’t speak.
He just silently walked away.
Seconds later, a faint curse could be heard amidst the surrounding noise.
“What a fucking idiot.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit wasn’t upset, he shook his head with a sense of unfinished business and looked around; he loved chatting with people and hadn’t been in such a lively environment for a long time.
Just as Chen Yi was about to get up and head to a quiet place, he suddenly heard a wish coming from behind him.
“I hope my brother’s cerebral palsy can be cured.”
Chen Yi’s steps faltered slightly as he turned to look at Jiaye standing behind him with her head bowed, hands clasped, and barefoot on the ground, his eyes narrowed slightly but he said nothing.
He just watched as Tie Chui stood beside her, grinning foolishly, making Jiaye look particularly tiny by comparison, like the arrival of a thunder god.
He couldn’t help but shake his head and smile helplessly, reached into his pocket to pull out a cigarette and offered it to Tie Chui, saying, “Everyone’s making wishes, don’t you want to make one too?”
“Although it’s a long shot, this is genuinely an opportunity that might happen.”
“Don’t you have any wishes of your own?”
Tie Chui’s eyes lit up with joy as he carefully accepted the cigarette, smoothing it before tucking it away inside his jacket’s inner pocket: “What’s a wish?”
“It’s something you really want in your heart but find hard to achieve.”
“Ah… I want my sister to have lots of clothes to wear, is that possible?”
“Of course, it is.”
Chen Yi was slightly stunned for a moment, but then said nothing, merely patted Tie Chui on the arm, signaling that it was time to follow him and leave this place, to find somewhere quiet.
No wonder that in the Sands of Time Map, Tie Chui had thought of using Points to buy a Fashion Treasure Box for Jiaye; turns out, this thing had become Tie Chui’s dream.
This brother and sister pair were quite interesting.
He wondered what the trajectory of their lives would be if the future had not unfolded this way.
After leaving the noisy Monster Brushing Square via a sled, Chen Yi stopped on the rooftop of a tall building.
He first looked towards the second item of the Children’s Day event.
“Event Two: Exclusive Store.”
According to the event description, this exclusive store contains many rare and hard-to-acquire props which can be purchased with Points.
And what he has in abundance is Points.
His current Points Balance is a little over 220,000, not reaching 230,000.
He’s not sure how much Points everyone around the world has, but he feels that the quantity he possesses is definitely not small. He should at least be ranked within the top one hundred thousand, right?
As for those unknown forces that started using various methods to hoard large quantities of Points from the moment they were introduced, who knows how many Points they have amassed.
He didn’t give it much thought but instead looked towards the exclusive store in front of him, ready to search for some rare and powerful props.
It must be said that the exclusive store indeed has quite a few rare props. Many props were not only unseen by him before but he hadn’t even heard of them, having no idea such things existed.
For example—
“Prop Name”: Rule Exemption Coupon.
“Prop Grade”: C-grade.
“Prop Effect”: Upon use, grants exemption from any rule within the current month for the next 24 hours.
“Prop Description”: “The purpose of a rule’s existence is to let privileges go unhindered.”
“Prop Price”: 200 Points.
“Prop Limitation”: 19238/1 million.
“This prop.”
Chen Yi’s eyes lit up slightly. This is definitely a good thing!
The June rule isn’t very threatening. Even if one violated all the rules, at most they would get a new title. And who knows, some people might even like it. After all, even though always in a state of fatigue and hunger,
they would no longer need to sleep or eat.
In some sense, for some people, it’s not really a punishment.
There are many who haven’t slept for years and some haven’t eaten a single grain of rice for years. How these people survive is a mystery; the world never lacks such Aliens.
He could almost completely immunize himself against the May rule as well.
But no one knows what the rules for the coming July to September will be. Hoarding a bit of this kind of thing is a precaution. Most importantly, it’s not expensive!
It’s just 200 Points!
That’s equivalent to twice the price of a Silver Party Ticket!
And it could be a life-saving item at a critical moment.
There’s a global limit of 1 million, and nearly 20,000 were already bought shortly after the event started.
“Buy!”
His shopping principle has always been not to buy expensive items or cheap ones, but to buy the limited ones!
This was why he bought a large stack of ’Star Upgrading Coupons’ during his first Extraterrestrial Invader event in the Points store because they were limited purchases. These items were still quietly resting in one of his inventory slots.
Currently unusable and their purpose unknown, but he thought it was better to buy first and ask questions later.
Unfortunately, the quantity of these ’Rule Exemption Coupons’ up for sale was quite large, and he didn’t have the means to buy them all, which somewhat unsettled him as he usually liked to buy out all of a limited item.
“Let’s start with a hundred.”
With the deduction notification, 20,000 Points vanished just like that.
His account Balance dropped to over 200,000 Points, and his inventory gained a stack of Rule Exemption Coupons. He didn’t put these items in his backpack; instead, he gave them all to Tuberculosis Rabbit.
A hundred should be nearly enough, and there are many more good items later. He cannot spend all the Points he has saved for so long here.
“That’s fantastic!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking serious, neatly placed these hundred Rule Exemption Coupons into a slot of his backpack. He gazed at the number ’100’ at the top left corner of the Coupons and couldn’t help but express his contentment comfortably.
“I don’t know why, but just seeing so many items neatly placed in the inventory brings such a pleasant feeling.”
“If it wasn’t the wrong time, I could stare at them for ten minutes.”
Back when he used to play games with Yi.
As soon as Yi would log in, he’d go brush dungeons, whereas he’d open his own inventory, lean back on the couch, and light a cigarette between his fingers.
With a satisfied and pleasurable expression, he would admire his inventory through the swirling blue smoke.
And occasionally, he would click on a prop to read its detailed information for a while.
He could do this for an entire afternoon.
The more useless the items, the more he liked them.
Chen Yi didn’t linger and continued to quickly browse further down because otherwise, there was a risk that any limited prop could be sold out completely, and it would be his turn to feel distressed.
Soon—
He discovered another prop that interested him.
“Prop Name”: Vehicle Renaming Coupon.
“Prop Grade”: E-grade.
“Prop Effect”: Allows one to change the name of their Vehicle to a preferred name within 306 characters.
“Prop Description”: “We always advocate for players to develop their unique sense of aesthetics.”
“Prop Price”: 100 Points.
“Prop Limitation”: (22/100,000).
With a limit of 100,000 and after about fifteen minutes since the event start, only 22 have been sold. However, not many are willing to spend Points to rename a vehicle at this time.
It’s no different from throwing Points into the water.
You can’t even hear a splash.
But even so, 22 people have purchased this prop, and the 23rd willing buyer has appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 83 - 82: Gunshots Ring Out, Divine Soul Annihilation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 83 – 82: Gunshots Ring Out, Divine Soul Annihilation!
“Buy!”
Chen Yi once again waved his hand grandly and bought 20 Vehicle Renaming Coupons to toss into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s backpack.
He would rename that vehicle of his when he got back to it.
What “Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh”, it sounds awful and it’s a mouthful, plus that mechanical moose is utterly useless, it would just dangle there as a sleigh ornament.
A mechanical moose that can’t even handle speeds over 1000 kilometers per hour, what a piece of junk.
It’s not even as good as his Five-Spice Milu Deer.
A bowl of noodles a day keeps your energy at bay.
Even if he had to name it, it would be “Five-Spice Milu Deer Christmas Sleigh”.
Or it could be.
“Santa Claus, that Old Man has been chasing me for a whole day, I remember this grudge. Wait till I level up in December, I’ll capture all your 2000-plus deer to pull my sleigh, and make you deliver gifts on Christmas Day by climbing down chimneys on foot.”
Or it could be.
“All the Vehicles ranked below me on the leaderboard, what kind of trash are they? Oranges-flavored Exploding Beads, Traceless Green Peak, and all sorts of messy vehicles, can you even compete? Could you please just blow up the top rank for me?”
After all, the limit for renaming a vehicle is 306 characters, not to mention changing a name, even writing a short essay of over a hundred words would be enough.
What exactly he would rename it to, he still had to give it some thought.
One thing for sure was that he was definitely changing the name. He had been enduring it for too long already.
As for why he bought 20.
…Renaming things can be addictive after doing it once you start thinking about the second, third time. If not for the lack of Points, he would have bought at least 50.
Not lingering any longer.
He continued to look down the list.
“Prop Name”: Area Horn.
“Prop Level”: C Grade.
“Prop Effect”: Allows one’s voice to be heard by all players in a main city and its nearby regions, and will appear in front of players as a banner lightscreen.
“Prop Restrictions”: Can only be used in the main city, which is defined as the city where the ’Main City Mission’ has been completed.
“Prop Price”: 1000 Points.
“Prop Limited Sale”: None.
“This…?”
Chen Yi hesitated slightly, finding himself somewhat indecisive. Actually, this prop was quite attractive to him; he had already thought about how he would use it.
When Yancheng once again faced a beast tide.
He would activate the horn.
Say something like a four-character idiom that’s filled with vigor, cultural level, and also loaded with profound meaning. Anyway, the point was to have a sonorous voice resounding in the ears of all players in Yancheng, and then he would ascend above Yancheng in the sleigh.
Then pull off a unique global character action.
Make a dazzling entrance.
That display would simply max out his presence; his philosophy was that even if his combat power was lacking, his style must be full-blown!
The problem is… the price is a bit steep.
1000 Points for a horn, isn’t that a bit extravagant?
After pondering for a moment, he nodded and decided that he should focus on increasing his fighting power, for only with sufficient combat capability could he survive in this chaotic world.
All these showy things are just temporary solutions, not long-term plans.
So, he chose to buy only 3.
3000 Points to show off was a price he could accept; at worst, he would make himself grind for 10 hours outside the city later.
Grinding was really hard for him.
Even though he didn’t have to lift a finger, his butt would truly get stiff.
After adding these three horns into his backpack, he looked again at the other props.
“Hmm?”
His gaze was suddenly drawn by a prop, and his eyes immediately shot out a burst of bright light!
“Prop Name”: Septagon Badge!
“Prop Level”: B Grade.
“Prop Effect”: This prop is an accessory for firearms, with specific effects as follows:
1. When the Septagon Badge is embedded in a firearm, every bullet will carry the black shine special effect, leaving behind a black luster as the main tail flame effect in the air.
2. Every shot fired towards an enemy will invariably hit the heart chamber.
3. Whenever the Septagon Badge hears discussions about its owner from those around, it will start to vibrate slightly, constantly drawing power, and once charged, it can activate its special effect.
“Special Effects”: After activating the special effect, the Septagon Badge will create 100 gun barrels according to the main prop of the firearm it is embedded in, launching a 10-second annihilating assault on the enemy in front.
Each gun barrel can normally fire bullets.
If there is only one enemy, all 100 gun barrels will target that enemy.
If there are multiple enemies, the 100 gun barrels will spread and randomly target the enemies.
“Prop Restrictions”:
1. When the Septagon Badge has heard a total of 10,000 remarks concerning debates about its owner, it is fully charged and can activate the special effect at any time.
2. If the firearm in which it is embedded consumes Points for each bullet fired, then upon activating the special effect, the Points consumed will increase by a hundredfold.
3. This prop can be freely removed and attached to other firearms.
“Prop Introduction”: “If someone has to stand up, then… I hope that person is you.”
“Prop Price”: 150,000 Points.
“Prop Limited Sale”: (0/1.)
Only one for sale.
So far, not a single person has made a purchase.
And next to the prop panel, there was a usage effect video.
In the video.
A middle-aged man clad in black, with a stern and icy face, pulled out a revolver commonly used by cowboys from his bosom and aimed at a giant Minotaur Monster not far away, activating the Special Effects.
The next second—
In the air, suddenly emerged a total of 100 gun barrels, all pointing directly at that Minotaur Monster.
A full 100 bullets with black glittering special effects burst forth towards the Minotaur Monster!
The special effects looked exceptionally beautiful and dazzling.
There was no sensation of lightness, but instead a profound sense of deterrence and shock!
The 100 bullets, like shooting stars, passed straight through the heart of the Minotaur Monster, shattering its flesh into the sky, which became the conclusion of the video.
This was a firearm-enhancing Prop.
Taken alone, it wasn’t much use, but combined with firearm-related props, it could have an effect that was unstoppable!
After watching this promotional video, Chen Yi did not hesitate in the slightest to choose to purchase.
His account balance decreased by another 150,000 Points.
This prop, in combination with his sniper rifle, would have an effect where 1+1=3, significantly amplifying his power.
His sniper rifle, with every bullet, could inflict true damage worth three percent of the target’s Maximum Health Value!
In other words, after activating the Special Effects,
he could instantly cause true damage equal to 300% of the enemy’s Maximum Health Value!
With this level of damage, to put it bluntly,
would you dare Santa Claus to stroll by again? Isn’t it just recovering 100% of the Maximum Health Value every second? Then what?
If there are no countermeasures,
one shot brings them down!
It can be said that this item greatly improved both his single-target attack strength and his AoE (Area of Effect) ability.
Whether it’s the neutral boss in December or the boss after 80 years.
As long as they are not in an invincible state and have no defenses whatsoever,
“Bang.”
The sound of the gun meant Divine Soul Annihilation!
The game was all about crushing with overwhelming numbers.
As for that Special Effects Charge, that wasn’t a challenge for him either. He just needed to show his face in front of everyone. With over a dozen titles above his head, that alone was enough to keep everyone talking for a while.
And before long, the Charge was complete.
Just then—
From the square not too far away, came bursts of exclamations.
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi raised his eyebrows lightly and turned his head to look down at the plaza below.
He saw a child-sized figure at least six meters tall who had appeared on the square, brandishing a bulging gift sack in his hands, continually swinging it and attacking the players around him.
That huge gift sack, in the hands of the child-sized figure, was like a heavy hammer!
Each impact on the ground left a deep pit!
If someone were directly hit, they likely wouldn’t have a chance of getting rescued.
At this moment,
Quite a few players had already started to collectively use their abilities to besiege this child-sized boss, and over time, everyone had figured out that the bosses in these limited-time events weren’t all that strong.
As long as you concentrated hard and dodged the boss’s attacks in time, there wouldn’t be any problems.
Moreover, the rewards would be distributed based on a ranking of damage dealt to the boss!
And the method of distributing rewards was extremely fair.
Even if you only had assist Skills and were just dodging on the sidelines, giving some speed buff to a player engaged with the boss, you could still share in certain rewards after the boss died.
Though you didn’t cause any damage,
you had Contribution Value.
For example, someone who constantly held the boss’s aggro would also receive additional rewards. In short, every player’s effort was guaranteed to be rewarded appropriately.
“Let’s go, let’s check it out down there.”
Chen Yi boarded the snow sled, beckoned Tuberculosis Rabbit and others onto it, and then shot towards the ground below.
…
“Hurry, hurry, get ready.”
Near the child-sized boss, three bald men in newbie shorts, bare-chested, were running excitedly from a distance towards this place, their eyes filled with anticipation.
The child-sized boss had arrived!
Time to farm for rewards!
When they were about fifteen meters away from the boss, they stopped well before getting closer.
At this distance, until the boss killed all the players in front of it, it was an absolutely safe spot where they wouldn’t be attacked.
Exceptionally safe.
Of course, without ranged props or Skills, it would be hard to deal damage to the boss.
“Big Brother.”
One of the men, a young man with a slightly immature face and three tufts of mustache under his nose, could barely contain his excitement as he spoke, “The usual rules?”
“Nonsense.”
The leading man, who had only one tuft of mustache under his nose, pinched it to breathe more comfortably before scoffing.
“It’s foolish to run up front and trade your life for rewards, while we can just use assist Skills from afar to lightly take part in the assistance, with no threat to our lives and still get rewards!”
“That’s the path to long-term survival!”
“Our ancestors told us long ago,”
“Fortune comes with risks, but so does loss.”
“The fruits of reckless bravery are not worth boasting about. Only a steady, sustainable approach is the path to true development.”

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 84 - 83: "Event Announcement: Player ’Chen Yi’ grandly gestures with a face full of boldness...
chapters.content:
Chapter 84 – 83: “Event Announcement: Player ’Chen Yi’ grandly gestures with a face full of boldness…
“Brother is brilliant!”
The man with two tufts of mustache below his nose, crouching in the corner, said with a serious expression as he cupped his fists in salute, “Yi and I have relied entirely on Brother’s wise decisions all along!”
“Of course, we’ll listen to Brother,”
And just then—
The bratty bear boss not far away suddenly roared, as if enraged, twirling the gift sack in his hand like a massive hammer.
He then violently smashed it towards a player who was shooting arrows a dozen meters away!
The player’s face changed instantly, and he turned and ran like mad!
But obviously, the gift sack was coming at him faster, and it seemed about to crush the top of the player’s head!
Just as the gift sack’s shadow had enveloped the player.
“It’s our turn to enter the stage.”
Watching this scene unfold, the leading middle-aged man snickered, then turned to his two younger brothers behind him, exchanging glances before they stood shoulder to shoulder and pointed at the player frantically dodging the attack, shouting loudly.
“Go!”
As soon as they spoke!
Three jade-like beams of light shot out from their hands simultaneously, intertwining in mid-air to form a fist-sized jade orb, which, with an almost untraceable speed, surged into the body of the player.
This was their skill.
It was a support skill.
Once this jade-like light entered a player’s body, it would slightly increase their movement speed for three seconds—a buff skill.
The cooldown was an hour, and it was an E-grade skill.
But if the three brothers stood together, they would trigger the special effects of the skill, “Mind as One!”
Only when the triplet brothers possessed this skill simultaneously would this special effect emerge.
If used on the same player at the same time, the three light orbs would merge into one, giving the target player a significant boost in movement speed for 10 seconds.
And the cooldown would be reduced by ninety percent.
It was indeed an exceptional support skill.
The three brothers had obtained these skills by a fluke.
During the 520 Valentine’s Day event with Cupid in disarray, they used this support skill to rake in quite a few rewards.
It was safe and rewarding.
Could there be anything better?
And that combined jade orb, under the expectant eyes of the three brothers, drilled straight into the body of the player who was sprinting for their life.
Suddenly—
The speed of the running player tripled!
Like thunder tearing through clouds, he charged along the street directly towards his target!
He was saved!
Many players who were watching this scene breathed a sigh of relief for the sprinting player, who had received assistance. With such a high increase in movement speed, he would surely dodge that gift sack flying straight at him.
However… the next second.
People looked somewhat puzzled at the gift sack that had flown over the head of the darting player.
The bear child boss seemed to have overexerted and missed.
But then—
Everyone saw the sprinting player, like the first thunder of spring, shooting straight forward with his legs nearly smoking from the speed.
Even his newbie underpants were nearly flung off.
Finally.
The sudden burst in movement speed allowed the player to catch the gift sack thrown by the boss at the very last moment!
“Bang!”
A loud collision resonated!
People’s jaws dropped in surprise, staring blankly at the quiet gift sack lying on the cracked street, momentarily stunned.
By then, the player had been buried under the gift sack.
After a moment of silence.
Someone finally muttered in bewilderment.
“Did the boss seem to have aimed poorly?”
“It should have, if I saw correctly. If the player hadn’t run, it seems he wouldn’t have been hit at all.”
“Even if he ran, it wouldn’t have mattered. Without that sudden boost in movement speed, he couldn’t have caught it.”
“If the movement speed buff had been a bit stronger, that brother would have just run past; a little slower, and the gift sack would have landed right in front of him.”
“But… right on the mark, not too fast, not too slow, just perfect.”
For a moment, many people looked toward the three bald men standing a few meters away from the gift sack with strange expressions, the same thought dawning on all of them.
You did that on purpose, didn’t you.
…
Sitting on the sleigh and witnessing the scene below, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but be taken aback, “Are they serious?”
“Can these players really coordinate together to fight a boss?”
Chen Yi glanced at the gift sack and then turned his attention to the boss with only 7% health left.
Although he could no longer claim the reward for the highest damage inflicted, the reward for the last hit wasn’t bad either.
Two bullets were fired in succession.
“Bang!”
He successfully secured the last hit.
So far, no one had managed to outdo his last-hitting skills!
’Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully killing boss number 28822, securing the last hit.’
’Last-hit reward: 99 roses.’
’Damage reward: 121 Points.’
“99 roses?”
Chen Yi looked at the prop that had suddenly appeared in his backpack, which also had a three-day countdown on it, clearly indicating that after three days, the prop would expire.
It belonged to the limited-time consumable props.
That’s when he remembered the “Rose Guardian” event from the Children’s Day activities, which he really had no interest in.
Spend Points to buy Roses and then send them out.
Did he think he had so many Points in his pocket that it weighed him down?
Did he have too much money with nowhere to spend it?
But since they gave him 99 for free, it would be a waste not to use them, so he immediately followed the activity path guide and found the option to send flowers in the chat with Jiaye.
There were several levels, too.
“1 Rose.”
“9 Rose Bouquets.”
“99 Rose Baskets.”
“999 Rose Rain.”
“9999 Rose Sea.”
“99999 Rose Planet.”
“…”
Chen Yi glanced at the different flower-sending levels with some speechlessness. The highest level, Rose Planet, required a whopping 99999 Roses, which is a total of 100,000 Points!
Spending nearly 100,000 Points to buy a Rose Planet to give away, has he gone mad?
What was the point of having such an event appear?
If anyone could send this thing, he’d stand on his head and wash his hair!
Even if someone really collected a huge number of Points in May, they wouldn’t lose their senses and spend 100,000 Points on something so utterly useless.
If the Snow Sea Project Team can’t plan an event, they shouldn’t bother planning at all. What was the point of creating such an event that nobody would participate in? It was simply an insult to their intelligence.
If it really came to it, let him be in charge of planning.
At least when you plan an event, you should know what players want, evoking their desires.
New n𝙤vel chapters are published on Novgo.cσ๓.
Chen Yi selected the 99 Rose Basket option without much enthusiasm.
The next second—
A cascade of Roses suddenly appeared above Jiaye’s head, as 99 dew-kissed Roses fell from the sky and landed on her white camisole dress.
The combination of red Roses and the white camisole dress was nothing short of perfect.
Enveloped in a waterfall of Roses, Jiaye looked somewhat dazed as she lifted her right hand to touch the Roses in the air, her earlobe tinged with a faint blush. She pursed her lips pretending as if nothing had happened and tried not to let her joy show too obviously.
But her eyes, almost squinting into crescents, and the joy in her pupils betrayed Jiaye’s thoughts completely.
Eventually.
Jiaye could no longer hold back the joy in her heart; she failed to manage her expression again as she involuntarily smiled, stopped pretending, and, with great openness, stood amidst the falling Rose petals, spinning in place.
With an expectant expression, her hands clutched behind her, she tiptoed and leaned forward, looking up at Chen Yi.
“Does it look good?”
“It looks good.”
Before Chen Yi could respond, Tie Chui clapped his hands with a simple-minded smile and said, “It really does look good.”
At this moment, Chen Yi had not noticed any of this, but his mouth slowly widened as he looked dazed and incredulous at the light screen panel in front of him.
Seeing Chen Yi not paying attention to her,
and with the Rose Rain now stopped, the Roses that had fallen on the white dress turned into red dust and dissipated in the air, Jiaye slightly lowered her head with a bit of disappointment and turned to look down without speaking.
The toes that had been pointed also drew back into their normal position.
She pursed her lips, and her pale and tender hands unconsciously fiddled with her dress.
The air was quiet for a moment.
Tuberculosis Rabbit lightly coughed with one hand in a fist to ease the awkwardness and then nudged Yi with his elbow as if to say, “Come on, man, show some romance!”
Even Tie Chui, who had the brain of a patient with cerebral palsy, managed to blurt out “You’re as beautiful as the moonlight” last night.
How could Yi be even less impressive than Tie Chui?
When was he not able to look at the panel?
Why didn’t he just look at it some other time?
Tuberculosis Rabbit felt a bit embarrassed for Jiaye, but obviously, he couldn’t say it looked good; that wasn’t his line to pick up.
Though he was a chatterbox who liked to talk,
he still knew when he could contribute to the conversation and when he couldn’t.
However, even after Tuberculosis Rabbit nudged Yi with his elbow, Yi still did not react, staring blankly at the panel in front of him as if he was seeing something fascinating.
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but sigh in disbelief, looking at Jiaye who had completely turned away, he nudged Yi a bit harder with his elbow.
But Yi still did not respond.
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to increase his effort once again.
“Hey!”
Chen Yi suddenly shouted loudly, his eyes shining as he looked up at Jiaye’s figure from behind with pupils filled with intense excitement and eagerness, and his face nearly spilling with impatience!
“What the!?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was startled by the roar, looking confusedly at Yi who seemed not quite right, and asked blankly, “Yi, what’s wrong with you?”
But then, the next second—
Above Jiaye’s head suddenly appeared a Rose Sea spanning hundreds of meters in diameter!!!
Immediately after that—
World announcements kept scrolling as banners across the screens of all players!
“Event Announcement: Player ’Chen Yi’ has flamboyantly and lovingly sent a 9999 Rose Sea to Miss ’Jiaye’. Let us send our sincere wishes to them!”
“…”
The same world announcement scrolled across the screens of all players in banner form, not once but three times!
…
PS: More coming tonight, probably around chapters three, four, five, six, seven, eight will be posted before morning.

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 85 - 84: A Sky Full of Blossoms, All for Her! (Congratulations to Little Bear for his Silver Achievement 1/10)
chapters.content:
Chapter 85 – 84: A Sky Full of Blossoms, All for Her! (Congratulations to Little Bear for his Silver Achievement 1/10)
Three consecutive global announcements swept past all players in the form of banners, slowly flashing before their eyes.
The banners were even wrapped with roses around the edges.
It’s important to know that global announcements are rarely made for a single player!
Up until now!
There has been only one player for whom a global announcement has been made, and that is Chen Yi, the only one!
That time was when Chen Yi helped Yancheng become the first city to solve the Insect Calamity during the Extraterrestrial Invader event, which led to Yancheng being featured in a global announcement.
As he killed the most enemies in Yancheng, he also made it onto the global announcement and was awarded the title Invincible Under the Heavens.
Aside from that time, there has never been another global announcement made for a particular player.
There was only once because of a Vehicle, which led to the Vehicle patch update that Chen Yi obtained, which also triggered a global announcement, but it did not mention a name; it simply referred to him as a certain player!
In strict terms!
So far, global announcements have been made for an individual player only twice, once calling out his name, and once triggered by him but without mentioning his name.
And now—
It was the second, third, and fourth times that global announcements were officially made for a certain player.
Multiple global announcements sounded in succession.
At this moment, all players around the world took note that Chen Yi sent three gifts of 9999 Rose Seas to a woman named Jiaye!
Worth a total of 30,000 Points!
To spend 30k Points just to express one’s love, how foolish… I misspoke, how extravagant!
…
Meanwhile, above Yancheng.
Hovering above Jiaye, a rose sea made up of flowers—hundreds of meters in diameter—slowly spun for a while before gently falling towards the ground.
Suddenly.
The entire square.
Every player witnessed a sea of roses made up of flowers.
A sea of roses worth 30k Points.
Tens of thousands of roses floated down from the sky, and all the players stood there, their expressions one of awe, looking up at this once-in-a-century sight.
At this moment, even the most stoic of men could feel the presence of romance wafting through the air.
Even numerous couples among the players had reddened eyes, holding each other tightly, embracing and kissing with closed eyes.
These times have been so hard on everyone.
Such a romantic scene could easily tug at the softest strings of people’s hearts.
…
“How romantic,” sighed Li Yide, looking up at the rose sea above with a dazed expression, his Fox Tail instinctively perking up. Through the gaps in the rose sea, he seemed to see his first love.
It was as if he once had a girl he really liked, only for her to walk away in the end.
Since then.
It seemed as if he started liking every girl in the world.
If she were still here, could he also send out a sea of roses now?
Forget it, not a sea of roses.
That’s too extravagant, but a 999 Rose Rain might be manageable.
…
Han Yu silently clenched the dagger in her hand, looking up at the sled in the sea of flowers above, biting her lip without speaking.
“Stop looking,” said a charming matron standing behind Han Yu, holding her into her embrace and leaning on her husband’s head, whispering with a face full of happiness.
“Actually, compared to witnessing someone else’s rose sea.”
“I prefer the two bundles of roses you and our son sent me.”
“Little Yu is very strong now too, although he’s not on par with that Chen Yi, but he’s much stronger than the average player, and we will have our own little happiness in the future.”
“You sure are content with what we have,” the man said somewhat helplessly, holding his wife as he looked up at Chen Yi, who stood on the sled amidst the rose sea, and couldn’t help but sigh, “This kid sure knows romance, but isn’t the cost a bit too high?”
“30,000 Points, wouldn’t it be better to use them for something else?”
“There’s even a Rose Guardian event on Children’s Day, so a Chrysanthemum Ancestor Worship event on Tomb-Sweeping Day seems normal too, right? Could it be that when the time comes, he’ll also have to send a giant wreath of 9999 chrysanthemums to honor his ancestors?”
…
“Do you like it, wife?” said a middle-aged man straddling a Bright Brand Pedal Bicycle in a corner of the square, resting his foot on the ground and murmuring as he looked up at the rose sea in the sky.
“It’s beautiful,” said the bald woman behind the middle-aged man, wrapped in a bedsheet and sitting on the back seat of the bicycle, her arms tightly embracing the man’s waist, as if afraid he would disappear.
Resting her head on the man’s back and looking sidelong at the rose sea, she spoke in a faint voice, “If only we could see this every day.”
The man said nothing, just gritted his teeth, his eyes full of sorrow.
The title “Lucky Child of the God of Love” floating above Chen Yi’s head belonged to him; he had exchanged it for a bicycle from Chen Yi.
He traded it to Chen Yi at the time because he thought such a character wouldn’t die easily and wouldn’t let his wife lose her life.
Now Chen Yi is indeed still alive, but his wife will not make it that long.
In the past few days, he rode his bicycle with his wife to many places in Yancheng, visiting all the attractions they never had time to visit before because of busy work schedules.
He hated his own powerlessness.
Before the calamity, he had no capabilities, and after the calamity descended, he still lacked any power.
Several times, even the bicycle was nearly stolen from them.
…
Such is the variety of life.
Just like the joys and sorrows of humans do not resonate with each other.
Right when all the players were looking up in awe, admiring the sea of flowers.
The Bald Trio, panting heavily, worked together to move the gift bag heavy as a small mountain to the side, their eyes flickering with excitement and guilt as they looked at the barely breathing player underneath.
The middle-aged man with a tuft of a mustache didn’t say a word as he hoisted the player onto his back and ran quickly towards another player not far off that had healing skills, shouting urgently as he went.
“Someone needs saving!!!”
“Save him!!”
“Stop freaking looking!!”
The sea of roses covered a vast area.
It enveloped the entire square, allowing the players around, though not receiving the flowers themselves, to also enjoy the sensation of being amidst the floral expanse.
…
“It’s so beautiful…”
Jiaye stood there with a dazzled look, fiddling with her skirt, suddenly too shy to meet Chen Yi’s gaze. She could only sneak peeks at the flower-filled sky evasively.
She was just a little fishmonger.
Only after packing up her stall could she carefully change into a new dress and go for a walk with her brother.
That was the most romantic thing she had ever experienced.
As for receiving flowers.
She had only seen that in movies, never imagining that one day it could happen right before her eyes.
With her ears turning a slight red, she tried her best to look natural, yet she could still faintly hear her own quickening heartbeat.
She had never thought that she could enjoy such treatment in her life!
A sea of flowers!
All for her!
Even the heroines in movies didn’t get treated like this.
Her heart dreamt up various scenarios, and the more she fantasized, the harder it throbbed.
How could she accept a proposal!
It’s only been a handful of days since they met!
Yi, how can you be so frivolous!
…
“Heh heh.”
Tie Chui stood immobile on the sled like a sculpture, looking up at the rose sea above, scratching his head with a goofy smile as if lost in thought.
“It’s really nice.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Yi, who had a smile on his face, and then at Jiaye, who stood in the corner of the sled with flushed ears, and couldn’t help but nod in satisfaction, his smile revealing a touch of maternal pride unbidden.
If Jiaye became his sister-in-law, he would be quite pleased.
At least with Jiaye’s temperament, she didn’t seem like the type to drive a wedge between him and Yi.
He was afraid Yi would find a domineering woman who wouldn’t allow Yi to play with him or who would control Yi strictly, not letting him go out to meet with him.
That would make him very angry.
But if it were Jiaye, it wouldn’t be an issue. Jiaye definitely wouldn’t stop Yi from playing with him.
Then, unable to restrain himself, he smiled with satisfaction again, turning to Yi and said, “What are you waiting for? First time confessing and don’t know how to proceed? You’ve already given the flowers, hurry and confess.”
“What are you waiting for? Jiaye won’t make the first move, right?”
As these words were spoken, Jiaye tensed slightly, turned her head to look the other way, and her earlobes visibly reddened a bit more, pretending not to hear the conversation.
But it was all a bit too exaggerated.
The sled wasn’t that large.
If she couldn’t hear, then she might as well be diagnosed as deaf.
“Yi?”
Seeing Chen Yi still smiling and motionless, watching Jiaye’s retreating figure, and completely ignoring him.
Tuberculosis Rabbit waved his hand in front of Chen Yi’s eyes, perplexed.
Seeing no reaction from Chen Yi still,
he silently stood there, his eyes complex as he finally said softly,
“Yi, please don’t tell me that all this while you’ve been staring at the interface.”
At that moment—
Chen Yi, looking satisfied, pulled out a blue card from his bosom and gave it a shake in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“Look what this is, I just exchanged for it.”
“This is a real bargain.”
“Give a bouquet of roses, and you get 1 Guardian Point.”
“And Guardian Points can be exchanged in the ’Rose Guardian’ event’s exclusive store for props.”
“It seems not many people noticed this exclusive store in the Rose Guardian event.”
“I just spent 30k Points to get this prop; this time I made a huge profit.”
“Oh right Jiaye, I just sent you 3 bouquets of 9999 roses; you should have nearly 30k Charm Points, which can also be used in the exclusive store of Rose Guardian to purchase props.”
“In the exclusive store of Rose Guardian, some props can only be exchanged with Guardian Points, and some can only be exchanged with Charm Points. Take a look at what prop you want and exchange it yourself.”
“Since we’ve known each other for so long, consider it a gift from me; whatever prop you exchange for, keep it for yourself.”
“Oh.”
Jiaye stiffened slightly, without turning around, she simply ran her fingers through her hair in the breeze, looking at the gradually fading rose sea in front of her, and stopped talking without looking at the store.
She just stared at the rose petal that had fallen at the edge of the sled and was turning into dust.
Like the curtain falling in a theater, everything was over.
Nothing happened.
Nothing at all.
Even though, it had never even begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 86 - 85: The boss is generous, the boss gives another one. (Congratulations to Little Bear, Silver 2/10)
chapters.content:
Chapter 86 – 85: The boss is generous, the boss gives another one. (Congratulations to Little Bear, Silver 2/10)
“`
…
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently pulled out a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and put it to his lips, his arms resting on the edge of the sled, gazing into the horizon with a sense of helplessness.
The situation was too awkward for words.
He somewhat didn’t want to turn back.
He could already imagine the state of Jiaye’s toes by now, probably beginning to curl and scrunch up in discomfort.
He felt embarrassed on behalf of Jiaye.
He took a heavy drag from his cigarette and couldn’t help but speak up to remind, “That Yi, are you sure it’s really worth it?”
“Do I even need to think about it?”
Chen Yi held up the blue card in his hand with a serious expression, “This is a global exclusive character action, limited to the Rose Guardian event, and it’s only 30,000 Points.”
“Think about it, ’global, ’exclusive,’ ’character action,’ ’event limited!’”
“Don’t these terms put together justify 30k Points?”
“There’s only one in the store, and it was I who snatched it up with quick reflexes. Plus, I’ve watched the preview video of the character action. It’s really worth it.”
“30k Points, and it’s not worth it?”
“How is this any different from snagging a great deal?”
“Hmm…”
After hesitating for a while, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly seemed tempted and spoke up, “It does seem quite worth it, are there any more? I want to get one too.”
“All those character actions in the personal panel shop are too common.”
“No more.”
Chen Yi shook his head with a touch of regret, “There was only this one character action limited for sale in the event shop. But there are many other great items in the event shop that need to be exchanged with Guardian Points.”
“Too bad 1 Guardian Point is equivalent to 1 Point.”
“There are so many great items, but they’re too expensive; we don’t have enough Points anymore.”
“We only have 18,000 Points left for now.”
“However, I did see character actions for sale in the limited-time shop, though they’re not globally exclusive, they are still limited.”
“But the prices aren’t cheap either.”
“The Points are a bit tight.”
Chen Yi frowned, leaning on the edge of the sled and looking down, pondering where to quickly gather some Points. After saving for so long, it felt like they were spent before they were even used.
These Points don’t seem to last very long.
After pondering for a while, he steered the sled toward the city center plaza and shot off.
“Wasn’t there a main city mission activated, where I can pick up tasks in the plaza and earn high rewards?”
“Let’s see if there are any tasks with high rewards.”
To see so many desirable items right in front of him but not have the Points to afford them was truly distressing.
…
“Husband.”
In front of the floor-to-ceiling windows of a certain office building, a voluptuous and scantily clad woman writhed like a serpent, cooing as she nestled in Gao Yiming’s embrace.
“I want a sea of roses too.”
“Won’t you buy one for me, please? It’s just 9,999 Points, and for you, husband, that shouldn’t be a problem at all, right?”
“Slap!”
The moment the words were out.
Gao Yiming struck her with a slap, and the crisp sound of it echoed on the spot.
Fear flashed in the woman’s eyes as she fell to the floor, but she dared not speak further. Quickly getting up, she adjusted her clothes and hurried out with her head down.
“Uncle Wei.”
After the woman left, Gao Yiming calmly pulled a handkerchief from his pocket to wipe his right hand, “I think I’ve figured out a way.”
“After all, Chen Yi is just an ordinary person, even if he stumbled upon power in the future world, that’s all there is to it.”
“How many Points he has in total, to actually spend 30k Points just for a smile from a fair lady.”
“It’s naive.”
“I thought he just wanted Guardian Points, but he didn’t choose any of the dozen or so props that could enhance his strength from the event shop, instead exchanging for a character action that adds no strength at all.”
“It’s ridiculous.”
“It seems he really is a man captivated by the allure of women, willing to lavish gold for a smile; how interesting.”
“Send that woman just now to him. In terms of femininity, she is much stronger than that so-called Jiaye.”
“Better yet, she could end up in Chen Yi’s bed.”
Gao Yiming paused slightly, then squinted his eyes and suddenly smiled, “Then, we can control Chen Yi by manipulating this woman.”
“Right, tell the woman to act more innocent.”
“Chen Yi seems to like that pure and innocent type.”
In the Rose Guardian Exclusive Shop, there was a global unique character action that required nearly 30k Guardian Points to purchase.
And just now, the prop was marked as sold out.
Who else could have bought it but Chen Yi, the only one now with nearly 30k Guardian Points?
Most of the props in the Rose Guardian Exclusive Shop are flashy but impractical, and few would be willing to spend Points on such things.
He lifted a glass of red wine to his lips with a slight uptick at the corner of his mouth.
He was curious to know if Chen Yi could refuse a woman who threw herself at him.
If he’s not experienced enough, it’s actually quite difficult for a regular man to refuse a woman who offers herself, especially an assertive and voluptuous beauty.
…
Just as Chen Yi and his companions had just landed in the central plaza, a global announcement abruptly rang in the ears of all players.
「Event Notice: Player ’Sword Without End’ grandly and lovingly sent ’Jiaye’ 9,999 Roses, creating a sea of flowers above her. Let’s extend our sincere blessings to them!」
Chen Yi and the others hadn’t even stabilized themselves.
A sea of roses floated up once more above Jiaye’s head.
The players around the central plaza, who hadn’t seen much of the world, were left stunned and gaping at the scene, standing there in shock.
Meanwhile, Jiaye frowned slightly, looking up at the sea of flowers above, with a flash of displeasure and confusion in her eyes.
…
“`
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with an expressionless face, “Sword Without End, I remember him, the one who likes to pose as a sage, I just saw him last night at the Silver Party.”
“This kid is being a bit too provocative.”
“What I mean is we should just go and annihilate his entire clan.”
Provocation!
Barefaced provocation!
This simply can’t be called provocation; it’s like throwing Chen Yi’s face on the ground and stomping on it hard.
Whom could you possibly send flowers to, and you choose Jiaye?
And to send a sea of 9999 roses?
What’s the deal, what is that supposed to mean?
Carve out a path then.
Chen Yi lightly raised his eyebrows and looked weirdly at the Vehicle Leaderboard in front of him.
Just to see that the Vehicle ranked fourth in the Global Vehicle Leaderboard.
Its original name was “Traceless Green Peak,” but now it had suddenly changed to——
“Don’t misunderstand, I need to send some flowers to get some Guardian Points, but I don’t have many female friends around, and I was a bit lost as to whom to send them, sending them randomly seems a bit of loss. So I just sent them to that little girl by your side, this can also earn the young lady some Charm Points, consider it thanks for your easy surrender last time.”
That is if the Global Vehicle Leaderboard had enough space.
Otherwise, with such a name wanting to be on the leaderboard, it would indeed be a bit awkward to handle.
He stared at the name of this Vehicle, and the corner of his mouth twitched slightly, not because the Vehicle name was too long.
It was because when Sword Without End sent the rose sea to Jiaye just now,
He suddenly thought about something, that if Sword Without End suddenly sent a rose sea, there must be something up, and if he were Sword Without End, without adding as a friend, how would he get in touch with himself.
The first thing he thought of was to change the name of his Vehicle.
Sure enough, when he looked at the Vehicle Leaderboard, the other party had indeed changed the name of his Vehicle.
Feeling as if there was an unexpected understanding between them.
Chen Yi shook his head casually and changed the name of his own Vehicle as well.
“Boss is generous, send another one, boss.”
After that, he didn’t bother with it anymore and glanced at the group of players queuing for tasks not far away, queuing up and naturally leaving a clear path.
He strided toward the sculpture at the end of the road to see what tasks were available.
The central square was already in Yancheng.
More precisely, it seems like every city has a central square.
The sculpture was not there originally; it appeared in Yancheng after the main city task was completed, where players could check the task interface in front of the sculpture and accept the tasks they desired.
There are eight sculptures.
Each sculpture can accept tasks.
…
“Global Vehicle Leaderboard”
Rank 1 Vehicle: “Boss is generous, send another one, boss.”
Owner: Chen Yi.
Vehicle Rating: 4630.
–
Rank 4 Vehicle: “Don’t misunderstand, I need to send some flowers…”
Owner: Sword Without End.
Vehicle Rating: 2980.
Li Yide, who had just killed a bratty boss, looked strangely at the Global Vehicle Leaderboard in front of him, feeling that the normally fine Vehicle Leaderboard.
Had become a bit odd after the name changes of rank one and four Vehicles.
The style seemed a bit off.
But it looked like ranks one and four were passionately interacting, chatting casually like big shots.
Which made the other serious Vehicle names on the leaderboard seem a bit odd.
For example, the rank three Vehicle “Eternal Night Monarch,” originally a cool name, placed between the two, suddenly gave a rather strange impression, as if it didn’t fit in with the big shots.
Li Yide hesitated briefly before deciding to join the fun; after all, his Vehicle also had a ranking, and this would show they were all big shots.
Soon.
The Vehicle Leaderboard, rank ten Vehicle underwent a change.
–
Rank 10 Vehicle: “The two bros are really extravagant, using a 100 Points Vehicle Renaming Coupon so casually.”
Owner: Li Yide.
Vehicle Rating: 1392.
“Cough.”
Feeling the envious glances of the surrounding players toward him, Li Yide’s Fox Tail naturally drooped as he waved his hand indifferently, “Get on with your things, we’re just messing around with nothing better to do.”
“People at our level are very casual about these things.”
…
Black Trench City.
A player dressed in a suit looked at the Global Vehicle Leaderboard in front of him weirdly, feeling a bit perplexed, as if the big shots on the leaderboard seemed to have their own little groups.
Why didn’t they call him?
Did they look down on his low rank?
That couldn’t be, if that butt plug kid ranked ten could get into the circle, why couldn’t he.
He hesitated slightly but decided to also change the name of his Vehicle to see the attitude of this little group first.
Although the Global Vehicle Leaderboard is not a combat power leaderboard.
It can generally reflect a person’s strength and wealth.
Those who can make it to the leaderboard are not ordinary by any means.
Except for that butt plug kid ranked ten.
God knows how that butt plug kid managed to modify that thing to over a thousand points.

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - 87 - 86: "Giving You a Rose Planet to Check Out the Special Effects." (Congratulating Xiaoxiong on Silver 3/10)
chapters.content:
Chapter 87 – 86: “Giving You a Rose Planet to Check Out the Special Effects.” (Congratulating Xiaoxiong on Silver 3/10)
Soon—
There was a change on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard again.
“Rank 3 Vehicle: ’Being pressed between a few tycoons, I’m really feeling some trepidation. Might as well pay my respects to the Rank 1 big shot for the New Year.’”
Owner: Wang Gou.
Vehicle Rating: 3128.
Following closely.
It was as if someone had poked a hornet’s nest.
The previously not-so-popular Vehicle Renaming Coupons in the store suddenly saw a surge in sales.
The vehicles in the top hundred of the leaderboard had almost all changed their names.
The names were more nonsensical and weird than the next.
“Rank 6 Vehicle: ’Ahem, actually I just came up to join in the fun.’
“Rank 12 Vehicle: ’Let’s test the one below, the next line to the phrase ’Scattered flowers are about to dazzle the eyes’ is?’”
“Rank 13 Vehicle: ’Don’t know, next one.’
“Rank 14 Vehicle: ’Can’t afford it, pass.’
“Rank 18 Vehicle: ’…’
The entire Global Vehicle Leaderboard had gone off the rails, veering toward the direction of a chat channel.
Everyone’s conversation was harmonious.
Everybody knew that the vehicle names they changed could be seen by players around the globe.
Which means—
Players around the world were watching these top hundred vehicle leaderboard players socialize in their small circles through this method.
This sense of superiority made many feel secretly exhilarated.
Even though it cost 100 Points to change a name once, no one cared.
Everyone tried to show off their strengths and continuously display their awkward humor.
They also vaguely revealed their amiability and wealth.
No one used foul language, nor were there any passive-aggressive comments.
After all, this was essentially a global broadcast, and it was important to maintain a certain quality.
It was quite amusing.
On the Global Vehicle Leaderboard, everyone was clear about what the other ranked players were thinking, but no one spilled the beans, quietly savoring this time of superior feelings exclusive to the big shots.
“What are they up to?”
Standing in the central plaza, Tuberculosis Rabbit somewhat boredly took out a cigarette from his pocket and tossed it into his mouth, casually glancing at the Global Vehicle Leaderboard in front of him.
Yi had gone in to accept a mission.
He was waiting outside.
But for some reason, Yi had been inside for quite some time. Was accepting a mission that difficult?
Or was it because there were too many missions and it was hard to choose due to the wide variety?
He wondered if there were any high-reward missions, but satisfying Yi’s expectations seemed a bit difficult.
Yi’s expectation was to buy everything in the store.
At this moment, those on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard had already started playing Idiom Solitaire.
“Rank 6 Vehicle: ’Let’s do Idiom Solitaire, Do As One Pleases.’
“Rank 7 Vehicle: ’Heartless despite wealth.’
“Rank 8 Vehicle: ’An army with a just cause.’
“Rank 9 Vehicle: ’A teacher known for his/her accomplishments.’
“Rank 10 Vehicle: ’A name that will last for all eternity.’
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the people on the Vehicle Leaderboard with a strange expression. He could faintly sense what they were up to.
They were showing off.
And it was that hidden kind of showing off.
The so-called hidden showing off is when someone appears normal, but you just feel like they are showing off.
He could even guess what the Rank 11 Vehicle owner was doing—probably frantically searching Baidu for idioms starting with the word ’ancient’, afraid to be a step too late and appear uncultured.
Just then—
A series of world announcements suddenly rang out.
“Event Notice: Player ’Zhou Ping’ generously and lovingly sent out 9999 Roses to Ms. ’Liu Xiaoqi’ with a grand gesture. Let’s send our heartfelt congratulations to them!”
It played five times in a row.
That wasn’t all.
Then, players suddenly noticed an unfamiliar name that had made it to rank one hundred on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard.
“Rank 100 Vehicle: ’Let me announce to everyone, today is the 30-day anniversary for me and my love Ms. Liu Xiaoqi. My goal is to take down the number one spot on the Charm Leaderboard for her and give her the limited-edition Title that comes with it. I hope other brothers can bear the pain and let it go, and not compete with me for the spot, especially the big brother in the top spot, I’m counting on you to do me this favor.’
Owner: Zhou Ping.
Vehicle Rating: 193.
Right after that, the rating of this vehicle started climbing rapidly.
And its ranking on the leaderboard was quickly moving up as well.
It stopped only after reaching the 10th place.
Just enough to knock down that Butt Plug kid a notch, turning him into the Rank 11 Vehicle.
“Charm Leaderboard?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit thoughtfully looked toward the two exclusive event leaderboards.
“Rose Guardian Leaderboard.”
Rank 1: Zhou Ping, 49995 Guardian Points.
Rank 2: Chen Yi, 30096 Guardian Points.
Rank 3: Sword Without End, 9999 Guardian Points.
“Peerless Beauty Charm Leaderboard.”
Rank 1: Liu Xiaoqi, 50012 Charm Points.
Rank 2: Jiaye, 40095 Charm Points.
Rank 3: …
And being on the leaderboard came with exclusive Titles.
The number one Titles respectively were “Godly Rich Gentleman!” and “Peerless Beauty!”
Second to third place Titles respectively were “Rich Tycoon!” and “Great Beauty!”
Fourth to tenth place Titles respectively were “Tycoon!” and “Beauty!”
Depending on the Title Level, the effects varied, and without a doubt, the top rank Titles were the best.
And this man who suddenly appeared on the Vehicle Leaderboard was after exactly these two number one Titles.
There are actually quite a few people who can spend 50k Points.
But not many are willing to do so.
