After all, if you have that many Points, it would be better to buy props that can enhance combat power in the limited purchase mall. Why waste them on the Rose Guardian event?
Even if sending Roses earns you Guardian Points, they aren’t very useful.
In the exclusive store for the Rose Guardian event, most of the items are flashy props; frankly speaking, they’re all sorts of special effects props whose function is to make you look more flamboyant.
Props that enhance strength are scarce.
Therefore, this Zhou Ping, coming in with 50k Points to dominate the leaderboard, had pretty much already reserved two number one Title Levels for himself.
After all, not many people are willing to compete for this leaderboard.
Not a single person on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard responded to Zhou Ping, who suddenly popped up. Clearly, they were dissatisfied with Zhou Ping’s untimely leaderboard challenge, which interrupted their fun game of word chains.
In just a short ten minutes or so,
the people on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard seemed to have already formed a small clique, beginning to subtly reject Zhou Ping, the outsider.
No one changed the name of their Vehicle in response to Zhou Ping.
The Vehicle Leaderboard that had been buzzing just now had suddenly become eerily quiet.
It felt somewhat awkward.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi was frowning, standing in front of a statue, propping his chin with one hand in deep thought and not uttering a word, totally unaware of what was happening outside.
He had originally planned to come over and see if there were any high-reward quests.
But he had hardly moved closer,
when a prompt sounded by his ear.
“Ding, player Chen Yi detected, the individual from Yancheng who killed the most Insect Race monsters during the Extraterrestrial Invader event, and as Yancheng is the first city in the world to resolve the Extraterrestrial Invader event.”
“Player Chen Yi will be granted one-time free quest publishing rights.”
“As a reward for player Chen Yi’s bravery in the first battle.”
Indeed.
There are many quests in this quest center.
Some are released by the game, such as killing Minotaur Monsters outside the city, etc.
Some are officially released by Yancheng, such as the need for ten men to transport garbage from inside to outside the city.
Completing a quest can yield Points, props, and more.
The specific rewards depend on how the quest publisher sets them.
The rewards for quests released by the game are naturally fixed.
But for quests published by people, the rewards are set by the quest publisher themselves.
For instance, if Chen Yi wants to publish a quest, he needs to specify on the quest requirements: how many people he needs, what rewards he can offer, what kind of people are needed, and so on.
And his right to publish a quest for free,
means he can publish a quest that theoretically all players in Yancheng can accept, and he doesn’t need to pay any reward; the game will pay it on his behalf.
Whether players actually accept the quest, however, will depend on their willingness.
It’s just that…
He couldn’t think of a suitable quest to publish for the moment.
What he needed most right now was Points.
So figuring out a way to publish a quest that could earn him Points was his priority.
Thus, the first quest requirement he thought of was…
“Quest requirement: All players in Yancheng to transfer 1 Point to Chen Yi immediately.”
He wasn’t asking for much.
1 Point should be fine, right?
Yancheng currently had over a million people.
If each person gave him 1 Point, he would have a million Points, making a fortune instantly!
Unfortunately, the quest was rejected; it didn’t pass the review process.
Just then, Chen Yi’s eyes lit up, suddenly thinking of something.
Without any hesitation, he tried entering the task target.
…
A system alert suddenly rang out in the ears of all players in Yancheng and abruptly a quest panel popped up in front of them.
“Ding!”
“A city-wide quest from Yancheng’s first battle hero ’Chen Yi’.”
“Quest target: ’I wish for player Chen Yi’s account to suddenly have an additional 100,000 Points.’ Repeat this sentence 1000 times.”
“Quest reward: After completing the quest, you may collect 50 Points.”
“Would you like to accept the quest?”
Many players, seeing this panel that suddenly popped up, were stunned in place. Weren’t quests supposed to be accepted voluntarily at the statue in the central square?
How could it pop up like this?
But this quest target…
Many started calculating quietly inside their heads.
If they were to wish for their own account to have an extra 100,000 Points, they’d likely get nothing even after a full day of effort, but if they wish for Chen Yi’s account to have an extra 100,000 Points, they’d at least have a guaranteed 50 Points after repeating the sentence 1000 times.
50 Points wasn’t a small amount.
How many monsters would they have to kill to get 50 Points?
Killing one Minotaur Monster only rewarded a few Points.
Between dreaming and a sure thing, most people chose the latter.
Meanwhile, prompts kept sounding in front of Chen Yi.
“Ding, 180,000 people have accepted the quest.”
“Ding, 220,000 people have accepted the quest.”
“…”
“Yi, you’ve finally come out.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was getting a bit anxious waiting outside, flicked his cigarette butt to the ground and stamped it out, striding up to meet him.
“Is this city-wide quest your doing, Yi?”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi tilted his head to glance at Jiaye standing behind Tuberculosis Rabbit and chuckled lightly with a lifted corner of his mouth.
“I’ll gift you a Rose Planet later, let’s check out the special effects together.”
…
ps: 10 o’clock counts as early morning, right? Added 3 chapters, 10,000 words.
In three days since launch, updated with 60,000 words, can I ask for some monthly tickets?
Wuuwuu.

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 88 - 87: This is a special effect that covers the whole world!
chapters.content:
Chapter 88 – 87: This is a special effect that covers the whole world!
“`
He heard the constant sounds of players accepting tasks ringing in his ears.
Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed as he looked toward the Rose Guardian’s event store and the limited-time marketplace, already thinking about how to spend the Points he would soon acquire.
After the Points were credited.
First, he wanted to get a defensive Prop for himself, which was on sale in the limited-time marketplace, and get one for the Tuberculosis Rabbit as well.
The only pity was that in neither marketplace were there any Skill Fragments available for purchase.
Only Props were being sold.
Even the Minotaur Monsters outside the city didn’t drop Skill Fragments—just Props and Points rewards, and the probability of dropping Props was extremely low.
Additionally, Props could now also be obtained from the Sands of Time Map outside the city.
In summary, the means to obtain Props were considerably more numerous than those to obtain Skill Fragments.
Currently, it seemed the only way to acquire Skill Fragments was through the five that players dropped upon death; beyond that, there were no other sources of Skill Fragments, except for the previous 520 gift packet for 88 Points that could yield five random Skill Fragments.
Of course.
In Yancheng, there had already emerged a Bird Market where Skill Fragments could be traded.
One could use Points to buy surplus Skill Fragments from other players or sell their own excess and unwanted Fragments.
Overall, the avenues to acquire Skill Fragments were still far fewer than those for Props.
Soon—
Already a full 400,000 people had accepted the task, and more and more players were continuing to do so, though the pace had slowed and was nearly saturating.
Yancheng was a small city to begin with. Once the trouble started, many people fled back to their rural homes for refuge.
Given the erosion of the May rules, having 400,000 people take on the task was quite impressive.
There were still many who were unwilling to accept the task.
Meanwhile, Chen Yi could also hear the constant sounds of wishing around him.
“10,000 Points will be added to the account of Yancheng task publisher Chen Yi.”
“10,000 Points will be added to the account of Yancheng task publisher Chen Yi…”
The whole scene looked particularly bizarre.
Hearing so many people chant his name in unison for the first time, Chen Yi, with a strange expression, returned to his sled uneasily, and started the Vehicle, stopping it on the rooftop of a tall building.
It must be said, the feeling was quite strange.
The Vehicle he had just acquired, “Septagon Badge,” was already fully Charged. This Prop would start charging whenever someone talked about him nearby and would be fully Charged once 10,000 sentences had been spoken.
After several deliveries to the sea of flowers for Jiaye, it easily reached full Charge.
Being the subject of 10,000 sentences from nearby people.
Frankly, for the average player, that was quite difficult. After all, even if you defecate in the street, you won’t attract many onlookers to stop and stare, let alone discuss the matter.
Internal thoughts don’t count; it must be spoken out loud, and moreover, by nearby people.
But for him…
Being the subject of public gossip was all too common. Even if he did nothing, simply walking around the city would nearly suffice to Charge it, given the numerous titles hovering above his head—it was hard for people not to talk.
Even hiding away wouldn’t work.
The titles would break through the ceiling and still evoke discussion.
That was also why he didn’t live in a bungalow. Other homes have chimneys on their rooftops, but his bungalow would be topped with a shining column of light, visible from far away.
The light from his titles was concentrated such that it hardly illuminated the surroundings—it didn’t disperse.
If he walked through the dark night, the titles above him hardly lit the path ahead.
But the penetrating power of this light was exceptionally strong.
Even from hundreds of meters away, one could clearly see a pillar of light approaching—a beacon in the deep, unmanned sea engulfed by the darkness of the night, as if even the rocks were forced to emit a painful scream.
In the distance, a lighthouse was slowly creeping closer toward you.
Coming to rescue you.
However, although his “Septagon Badge” was fully Charged, it couldn’t be recharged again until the current Charge was used up; only then would the count reset and allow it to Charge again.
There was no way to save up multiple Charges at once.
As long as people around him talked about him, it could Charge. In theory, if the Tuberculosis Rabbit muttered his name in his sleep, even if both of them were asleep, the badge could be Charged.
Unfortunately, the Tuberculosis Rabbit had his own words to say at night, and didn’t talk about him. That couldn’t be controlled, could it?
Even if it could be controlled, it was still better not to.
Enduring the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s sleep-talk all night, as though sleeping in a card game room, was already the limit of his endurance. If he also had to listen to the rabbit discussing him all night while asleep, that would be unbearable.
Anybody trying to sleep at night would be unable to if they heard someone continuously talking about them right next to them.
And especially in a dream.
That’d be too eerie.
Just then—
A notification sound suddenly rang in Chen Yi’s ear.
“Ding, 10,000 Points have been credited to your account.”
Simple and to the point.
With just 22 characters, but the information conveyed made Chen Yi extremely satisfied.
“That fast?”
“`
Chen Yi’s eyes flickered with a hint of astonishment as he gazed at his Points Balance in disbelief. How much time had passed since the first player started making a wish? Barely ten minutes at most!
Just ten minutes and the first 100,000 Points had already been credited?
When he saw his account balance, the corners of his mouth involuntarily curled up, resembling an author who, having finally received his royalties, could afford to splurge on a hotpot meal downstairs.
“Account Balance: 118023.”
Nearly 120,000 Points.
“Did it really come through so quickly?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing next to him on the edge of the rooftop, perked up its ears at his words, leaned forward and looked at Yi’s publicly displayed personal panel. Seeing the Points Balance, it too felt somewhat moved and said, “So it really works. I’ve thought about something like this before but never expected it could actually be done.”
“What kind of thing?”
Chen Yi responded casually without turning his head, his eyes brimming with anticipation, wondering if there would be a second arrival of 100,000 Points.
He had no cost for releasing this task; the officials would cover the task rewards on his behalf.
He was making pure profit.
The players were also earning pure profit.
Both parties were making a killing.
“I shall name it ’Morally Binding Bundle Wish Technique’.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit smacked its lips and then gazed into the distance, sighing deeply before continuing leisurely.
“On Blue Star, aren’t there several religious beliefs? Every day, there are believers who pray, but few prayers are answered. I was thinking they should coordinate.”
“Gather all the believers from around the world.”
“For example, if it’s Monday today, headquarters would issue a command: all believers are to pray for a certain person’s work to go smoothly.”
“In this scenario, it would be difficult for God to pretend He didn’t hear, even if He wanted to. It would greatly increase the chances of prayers being answered successfully.”
“Moreover, a variety of pay-to-win services could be developed, like paying for a VIP queue or skipping the line with a yearly VIP… I think that would be much more interesting.”
“…”
Chen Yi glanced at the Tuberculosis Rabbit somewhat speechlessly, too lazy to respond verbally. He had grown accustomed to the Rabbit’s erratic thought process.
“Oh right.”
Seeing that Yi didn’t respond to him, the Tuberculosis Rabbit wasn’t embarrassed. Instead, he skillfully changed the subject, a talent of his that ensured conversations never fell flat.
“While you were off accepting the task, someone mentioned they wanted to hit the leaderboards, hoping you would let him take the two top spots of the Rose Guardian.”
“He changed his Vehicle’s name, but no one paid attention to him.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi frowned slightly and started browsing the Global Vehicle Leaderboard. He saw a Vehicle with a rather lengthy name listed at the tenth spot.
“Just making an official announcement to everyone, today is the 30-day anniversary of my beloved, Ms. Liu Xiaoqi… Especially the big brother at rank one, please do me the honor.”
He glanced at it casually before looking away.
“Don’t bother with him. Let him do whatever he wants. If he wants the top spot, let him pay for it.”
“It’s my first time seeing someone beg for a spot on the leaderboard.”
He didn’t linger on the thought, instead, he turned around to open Jiaye’s chat box. After a few seconds of heartache, he decided to send a Rose Planet.
100,000 Points, oh!
Such a luxury, this was the second time he had ever spent so much in one go!
The next second—
A global announcement appeared before everyone’s ears and, as a banner, conspicuously appeared above every player’s view.
It was impossible to focus on anything else.
Even players entangled in a boss fight couldn’t help but turn to look at the floating announcement.
“Announcement: Player ’Chen Yi’ stands leisurely on a high spot, enjoying the worship and envy of all players with a smile that says ’money is no object,’ as he sends Ms. Jiaye 99,999 Rose Planets. Let us extend our utmost respect and honor to both of them!”
A banner framed in dazzling lights and adorned with Roses appeared before the eyes of all players.
Following that—
Before Jiaye, standing behind Chen Yi, could react, she suddenly felt herself lifted into the air.
Beneath her feet, the rooftop surface split, and a pillar composed of Roses rose steadily, only stopping after reaching several tens of meters in height.
Looking around, she now stood atop the Rose pillar, at the highest point of Yancheng.
She could even feel gazes from every direction in Yancheng looking up at her, causing her eyes to betray a hint of panic, and her heart was slightly overwhelmed by the sensation.
Then, Roses began to appear out of nowhere in the sky, slowly falling, covering the sky. The Roses raining down upon those on the ground made everyone realize what magical reality looked like!
But—
If Chen Yi were to stroll around other places, he would discover.
It wasn’t just above their heads where flowers rained down.
Instead, a shower of Roses had begun to fall from the skies all over the world!
This was an effect that enveloped the entire globe!
All players could witness this grand spectacle because of the 100,000 Points Chen Yi had spent!

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 89 - 88: "Giving You Face, Calling You ’Big Bro’.
chapters.content:
Chapter 89 – 88: “Giving You Face, Calling You ’Big Bro’.
“`
But it wasn’t over yet!
A pillar made of roses suddenly rose beneath Chen Yi’s feet at the same time, lifting him into the air alongside Jiaye, standing side by side, less than a meter apart.
Then a prompt sounded in his ear.
“Ding, after a ten-second countdown, Chen Yi, you will have a 10-second global broadcast right. During these 10 seconds, every move you make will be watched by all players around the world, and your voice will also be heard by all players worldwide.”
“Please think of your declaration of love during these 10 seconds.”
Immediately after, a world announcement once again appeared before all players’ eyes.
“Event Announcement: Player ’Chen Yi’ is about to declare his love to the lady ’Jiaye’. Let us all witness this beautiful moment together!”
…
“Is this how you show no respect?”
Zhou Ping, who was chatting with his underlings with a smile, had his smile freeze on his face when he heard the prompt by his ear, and slowly sank into contemplation as he looked towards his vehicle’s name on the leaderboards.
After a long while, he said in an emotionless soft voice.
“I’ve already been very humble, haven’t I?”
“Give you face, call you ’big bro’.”
“Give no face, what are you?”
“Really losing face here.”
…
At the same time as the prompt sounded in his ear, Chen Yi was slightly stunned, and then he quickly reacted.
Immediately after—
He activated all the fashion props in his backpack at lightning speed, putting them on, and then frantically wiped his face a few times with his hands, adjusting his facial expression to the best state.
Only then did he take a deep breath and looked towards the countdown, which was at its last second.
…
As the sky countdown was about to end.
Almost all players simultaneously looked up at the sky, gazing at the giant screen beneath the sky filled with flowers.
As the countdown on the screen came to an end, the screen first went black, then suddenly brightened.
Immediately after—
All players saw Chen Yi and Jiaye standing on top of the light pillar. Many players had heard of Chen Yi’s name, but this was their first time seeing him in person.
And look at Jiaye: petite and pretty-faced, in a naturally draped and form-fitting camisole dress, which made people feel a surge of protectiveness, while also wanting to pinch her cheeks that seemed almost pinchable enough to squeeze water out of.
Is this the person someone is willing to throw away 100,000 Points for?
In fact, most players were more curious about what a woman that could compel a patron to toss away 100,000 Points looked like. Although seeing her in person didn’t disappoint them, they still felt a bit of a letdown.
After all, she was pretty, but she was not quite at the level of a fairy.
When everyone’s gaze fell onto Chen Yi standing on the floral pillar, however, they were left puzzled and frozen in place.
They saw Chen Yi, dressed in a green robe, holding a folding fan, his posture as straight as a pine tree, calmly gazing into the distance.
His deep pupils seemed to hide deep thoughts about this era.
Underneath his calm face seemed to be buried endless contemplation about the world.
His left hand hung naturally by his side, right hand holding the fan at his chest.
He looked just like a scholar on his way to the capital city for an examination.
From beginning to end, Chen Yi in the screen maintained that pose without any movement, until in the final second of the footage, he withdrew his gaze from afar.
HHis pupils were deep; his bearing seemed to carry a magnanimous concern for the people of the world. He gazed directly at them through the screen and gave a slight nod.
The angle of the nod was just right.
It was as if a deity was looking down upon the mortal realm, giving a polite nod in response to the gaze of the common folk.
The next second—
The screen went dark!
From beginning to end, there was not a single sound in the footage; Chen Yi didn’t utter even a syllable, it was all silence.
Many players exchanged bewildered glances, not sure why, but they felt they had sensed something in Chen Yi that they themselves lacked during that moment.
Although he didn’t speak… for some reason, it felt so cool.
If it were them with the opportunity to be seen globally, they definitely would have been so excited that they’d stutter and tremble, but look at Chen Yi, it seemed as if he didn’t care about the global exposure at all. He was even too lazy to say a word.
With a light touch, he had moved past the event.
What was this? This was status!
…
“Use your ultimate move, your ultimate move!!!”
In some suburban area, Sword Without End stood on a flying sword hovering in midair, squatting on the blade, butt sticking out and holding a tissue, looking at the scene on the screen with anger surging within him!
He couldn’t help but roar in a burst of rage!
“Where’s your throne? Your soldiers?”
“Get your character actions together!”
“This is a chance for global exposure, and only you have it in the whole world, do you realize how precious this opportunity is? And you just finished so casually!”
He looked despondently at the screen as it gradually darkened, unable to help but punch fiercely into the air with his fist.
Such a waste!
If it were him, he would definitely show the world what it means to be Sword Immortal!
What it means to have presence!
Thinking this, Sword Without End, squatting on the blade, could not help but frown and began to hesitate furiously in his mind: a gift of 100,000 Points for 99999 Roses from the Rose Planet could actually get a chance for global exposure.
This was global exposure!!!
It’s one thing for a player to be on a global announcement which was already impressive, but for all players to see themselves on a screen was an extraordinary honor!
But the price, wasn’t it a bit too expensive?
“`
A full 100,000 Points!
Feeling an urge within himself, Sword Without End shook his head fiercely with a serious face, as if to warn himself, and said in a deep voice,
“You must not act rashly!”
“Remember, you almost lost your life for these 100,000 Points in that map!”
“If these Points are gone, are you really going to risk your life there again?”
Sword Without End, with a resolute expression, turned his head to look into the distance, his eyes brimming with coldness.
If he were still 24, he would have spent the 100,000 Points without hesitation.
But at 34, he wouldn’t waste the Points he had risked his life to earn for a moment’s fame.
That would be downright foolish.
He would not do something as foolish as suffering for vanity’s sake.
But… this was a global appearance, and who knows if such an opportunity would come again in the future.
Even if there were another chance later, it wouldn’t be as stunning as this time because, until now, players had no idea that global appearances were even a thing.
Moreover… although that map was a matter of life and death, he had already made it out alive once; the success rate for a second entry would surely be much higher, making it not as dangerous.
Besides, the Points wouldn’t be spent in vain; he would also gain 100,000 Guardian Points.
Guardian Points could also fetch quite a few attractive and special Props in the shop.
After all, wealth is external, while fame is something that accompanies a person for life.
“…”
After several seconds of contemplation, the firmness on Sword Without End’s face slowly faded away. He quickly wiped his behind clean before abruptly standing up with his pants pulled up.
“Damn it, a true man born between heaven and earth should not waver over a mere pittance!”
…
“Not bad at all.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked towards Chen Yi, who was slowly descending with the pillar of Roses and back to the ground, and spoke with some astonishment, “The outfit looks good, quite like a scholarsy type.”
“It has a certain… hmm, a scholar who could slay dragons vibe.”
“It’s not bad, right?”
Chen Yi slightly raised his eyebrows and said, “It’s quite fun, isn’t it?”
He then turned his head to look at Jiaye beside him and asked with a smile,
“How does it feel, having a global appearance?”
“A bit nervous.”
“It’s okay, you’ll get used to it. I should be able to send you another.”
However, just at that moment—
A pillar of Roses surged up under Jiaye’s feet once again!
Following that, a world announcement once again rang in everyone’s ears!
「Event Announcement: Player ’Sword Without End’ stands aloof and high above, enjoying the worship and envy of all players, with a smile that says money is no object, sending 99,999 Roses to Miss Jiaye. Let us pay our utmost respect to both with our gaze!」
As the screen lit up!
Everyone was startled to find that only Sword Without End appeared on the screen; Jiaye was nowhere to be seen, just Sword Without End standing alone atop the Rose pillar in mid-air.
But before people could understand why only Sword Without End was on the screen!
In the scene—
Sword Without End, dressed in pure white Tang attire, lifted his head with an icy expression, staring directly at them with eyes full of murderous intent, and beside him stood the quivering Three-Foot Qingfeng in mid-air!
Before people could react, they suddenly heard a thunderous sound that shook the heart, explosively resounding out of the clear sky in the scene!
The so-called bolt from the blue was nothing more than this!
Immediately, thick dark clouds suddenly gathered above Sword Without End, even pressing down upon the joyful Stars above, making the previously festive scene seem a bit sinister!
Countless lightning dragons tumbled within the clouds, as if at any moment a world-ending bolt could strike down!
This made many players who were looking up at the screen instinctively hold their breath, feeling a subtle, invisible pressure in their hearts!
“Agh!”
A roar filled with fury and bloodlust suddenly erupted in the scene!
Sword Without End was seen soaring into the sky, floating in mid-air, standing right below the dark clouds that overshadowed the sun, as if the whole world only contained these dark clouds and Sword Without End holding the Green Peak!
In the scene.
The man, with a cold expression carrying a scorn for the heavens, stood out in his white Tang attire. In the next second, countless bolts of lightning began emerging from the Green Peak in his hands!
Electricity gathered and extended the length of the blade while rapidly spreading!
In less than two seconds, the blade astonishingly stretched to nearly a kilometer!
From afar.
One could only see a man wielding the nearly kilometer-long Heaven Opening Sword formed from countless bolts of lightning.
“Without Sword Without End, the path of the sword would be eternally like a long night; today, one sword will open the Celestial Gate, and the world shall know Sword Without End!”
Accompanying the man’s deep, powerful voice tinged with a scent of blood in the scene.
The very next second—
The scene suddenly switched to a wide angle, revealing Sword Without End holding the thousands of feet long Green Peak, roaring as he slashed at the dark clouds covering the sky above.
“Open Heaven!”
“Break!”
One sword, cleaving the skies!
The dark clouds were immediately cleaved in half by Sword Without End’s sword!
As sunlight spilled through,
The screen slowly faded out.

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - 90 - 89: "You little brat, today I really want to see what kind of stuff you’re made of!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 90 – 89: “You little brat, today I really want to see what kind of stuff you’re made of!!
“Phew!”
Feeling somewhat unfulfilled, Sword Without End sat atop his sword, constantly flipping through forums from various regions, checking out other players’ comments about him.
When he had just sent the Rose Planet to Jiaye.
The system reminded him that since he was sending flowers from a distance during the global live broadcast, they would splice his and Jiaye’s images together, and he could freely choose how much of the screen Jiaye would occupy.
The default was to have each take up half of the screen.
Thus, he directly moved Jiaye out of the screen, since he had a choice, why bother asking how much of the screen the girl should occupy.
Obviously, his solo performance was better.
“So handsome…”
“Is there really such a thing as immortals in this world?”
“I’m still poking Minotaur Monsters with a spear, how come someone’s started to split the sky with a sword, I thought we were all alike.”
Sword Without End kept browsing through various regions’ forums, nodding in pleasure and silently liking every praise-filled post.
“Such a poser, I can’t stand it anymore, that arrogant, presumptuous, slick demeanor of his is so uncomfortable to watch, I don’t know why you all praise him so much.”
“Truly powerful people are stable, with Sword Without End’s impetuous look, do you really think he could be some kind of boss?”
“…”
Sword Without End looked at this post on the forum, expressionless, and turned his gaze towards the city IP to which the forum belonged.
Black Trench City forum.
He silently clicked on the avatar of the person who made the post and flipped through their history of posts.
“Annoyed to death, walking to the company every day takes ten minutes.”
Below it was a location tag for the company.
Quietly opening the map, he located the office building in Black Trench City and kept zooming in, beginning to check the surrounding communities to see which one would take about a ten-minute walk to the company.
“I recommend you try Liu’s buns, they’re really delicious, I eat them every day.”
Right, there are roughly three routes that take ten minutes by foot, only one of which passes by Liu’s bun shop, that is, in the Changxin Community.
“I’m never living on the top floor again, it leaks whenever it rains, so annoying.”
Right, a top floor in Changxin Community.
“Guys, how do you like my hairstyle today?”
And a selfie.
Ten minutes later.
Sword Without End, with an expressionless face, rode his Three-Foot Qingfeng and shot off into the distance.
…
After an unknown amount of time,
a voice filled with towering rage, resounded over the skies of Black Trench City!
“Meet your doom swiftly!”
“You little brat, I’ll see what kind of stable stuff you’re made of today!!”
“Your daddy is coming for you!!!”
…
“This old coot.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit spread his hands helplessly and sighed, “I don’t know why, but this old thing, who’s at an age to settle down, still plays so hard.”
“Dropping 100,000 Points just to show off in front of global players.”
“What’s the point.”
At this point, Jiaye was first on the Charm leaderboard, while Chen Yi naturally sat at the top of the Guardian leaderboard.
As for Zhou Ping, who had originally declared his intention to fight for the top spot, he had entirely ceased to make a move.
No one knew if he simply didn’t have enough Points.
In any case, all had gone quiet.
Chen Yi raised his eyebrows slightly and, standing still without speaking, was sliding through the limited-time shop, silently memorizing the Props he planned to buy later on.
Then he glanced at the customer service system that had already appeared on the bottom right corner.
It seemed that the customer service staff were already on duty.
They were quite fast.
He casually opened the customer service feedback and left a message.
“The shopping mall lacks a shopping cart function, which is extremely inconvenient.”
With a shopping cart function, he could add all the Props he wanted to buy to the cart, and when the Points were credited later on, he could buy everything in one go.
Instead of like now, having to silently memorize the Props he wanted.
But as for whether he would receive any Points later,
he was somewhat anxious.
A one-in-ten-million chance doesn’t mean that you’ll definitely hit it once out of ten million tries; it could also be that you wouldn’t hit it even after ten billion tries.
From this perspective,
domestically produced web games are actually quite conscientious.
At least if a domestically produced web game announces a one-in-ten-million chance, it means that when you reach the ten millionth time, they will definitely give you a minimum guarantee.
At least you won’t be left hanging for the ten-million-and-first time, of course, before you reach ten million tries, don’t even dream of winning anything.
“Huh?”
Chen Yi suddenly furrowed his brows and looked at the panel that had just popped up in front of him.
“Ding, it has been detected that a sufficient number of players now possess the ’Wilderness Pass’, and the Wilderness map will officially open on June 2nd at 09:00 AM.”
“At that time, players holding the Wilderness Pass may bring a maximum of one companion into the Wilderness to start reclaiming.”
“This map is a large-scale map.”
“Please prepare for reclaiming.”
“Wilderness Pass?”
He nodded thoughtfully, having obtained the Wilderness Pass a long time ago but never having had the chance to use it.
He had originally thought it would be like the Sands of Time, where only after someone had started to reclaim the Sands of Time, would subsequent players holding the Sands of Time Pass be permitted to enter the map.
But this Wilderness Pass,
it turned out that only players holding the pass are qualified to start reclaiming?
Chen Yi shook his head and didn’t think further, without any concrete information, there was no way he could make any preliminary preparations.
All he knew for now was that it was a large-scale map, and presumably, there wouldn’t be a small number of players involved in reclaiming it.
There was a brief introduction on the Wilderness Pass.
“Wilderness, that’s a place where even a saint can’t help but fall.”
“`
But there’s not much to glean from this introduction.
It sounds like the wilderness must be a pretty dangerous place, especially if even a saint can fall there.
It’s only just before noon on June 1st.
All of that is tomorrow morning’s problem; there’s no point in thinking about it now.
9 hours later.
All the players had completed their tasks.
In total, they had earned 300,000 Points.
Out of which, 100,000 Points were spent to gift Jiaye a Rose Planet, and the remaining 100,000 Points were all thrown into the exclusive store purchases, 200,000 Points were just enough to buy everything they wanted from the event store, and the other 100,000 Points were just enough to buy all the props needed by both him and Tuberculosis Rabbit. It was just perfect.
…
“Phew!”
Inside a hotpot restaurant, Tuberculosis Rabbit shoved a scalding piece of lamb freshly scooped from the pot into his mouth, with the steam carrying the fragrant aroma hitting the back of his throat.
“Huff, huff!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit kept panting, blowing air from his mouth until the heat from the lamb slice in his mouth subsided slightly before chewing it a few times and swallowing it, savoring the lingering taste of lamb in his mouth before contentedly reaching out his chopsticks again for another slice of lamb floating at the bottom of the clear soup pot.
“Yi, you should try this. It’s really delicious.”
“So satisfying, so satisfying, it’s really too satisfying.”
“I haven’t eaten so delightfully in a long time.”
Ever since food began to be sold in personal panels, many restaurants had opened for business.
After all, personal panels only offer dry food; no problem if you want to buy steamed buns, rice, or eggs—even lamb is available.
But if you think about buying a hot plate of fried rice with eggs, that’s just nonsense.
With a stable source of food ingredients, many restaurants in Yancheng had opened for business.
Currently, the pricing is quite chaotic, with no reasonable pricing system in place.
But there is generally a rough price range.
For simple meals like fried rice with eggs or rice with toppings, a serving is roughly between 4-8 Points.
The price of a bowl of noodles is also between 3-5 Points.
As for a big meal like hotpot, that’s over 100 Points per meal.
It’s definitely expensive.
Even the cheapest simple meal is beyond the means of many players.
The solution is simple.
If you can’t afford it, don’t eat it.
In the store, 1 Point can buy 10 steamed buns that can fill you up; a bag of such steamed buns can last for two or three days. You can’t expect me to lower the price because you can’t afford it, right?
If you don’t even have 1 Point, then you’ll have to figure out a way yourself.
“Hm, I’ve almost spent all of my 200,000 Guardian Points.”
“Apart from your character action, I also bought a few character actions for myself.”
“I also acquired several vehicle trails and… I snatched up most of the limited Wing Exchange Coupons from the store.”
Chen Yi picked up a piece of lamb with his chopsticks and swished it through his sesame sauce dipping dish before putting it into his mouth, satisfied, he also took a deep breath, “Refreshing!”
It had been nearly two months since they last had hotpot.
This time was truly gratifying.
“By the way, Jiaye, what did you buy with all those Charm Points?”
He looked up curiously and turned to Jiaye who sat across the table and asked.
He had 200,000 Guardian Points.
Jiaye had even more, a whopping 300,000 Charm Points.
“That…I,”
After hesitating for a moment and pausing, Jiaye finally spoke, “There was nothing in the Rose Guardian Exclusive Shop that could enhance combat power, so I bought two character actions as well.”
“They’re unique character actions from a global exclusive event.”
“Geared towards females.”
“And they seem to be couple’s character actions, quite like the two you bought, Yi.”
“Really?”
Surprise flickered in Chen Yi’s eyes as he looked at his personal panel’s character action introduction information and, after carefully reading through it, found indeed a line of fine print.
Then he smiled satisfactorily and nodded his head.
“Well, that’s indeed nice. Next time we’ll have the chance, we’ll try out what the effects are like.”
“Who knows, there might even be some interactive effects.”
Character actions have cooldown times.
Basically, most character actions have cooldown times ranging from 1 hour to 48 hours.
Some character actions even come with a usage limit, like the most expensive character action he had purchased this time—it was limited to three uses.
Just then—
The owner of the hotpot restaurant came over to them, bowing respectfully and speaking in a low voice, “Good evening, Yi.”
“Our Little Fatty Sheep Hotpot Restaurant is honored to have Yi visit on our grand opening day.”
“All expenditures of Yi at our shop today will be on the house.”
“We’ve recently added a new service since the reopening.”
“I wonder if Yi would honor us by trying it out?”
“What service?”
Chen Yi picked up another piece of lamb, dipped it in the spicy chili oil next to him and put it in his mouth. After swallowing, he turned to look at the approaching owner.
“Let’s hear it.”
Then he tapped the cigarette box on the edge, popping out a cigarette with only half of it sticking out of the box, and passed the box to the owner.
“Here, have one.”
“Ah, thank you so much, Yi. You’re too kind.”
The owner, bowing with respectful hands, took the cigarette out of the box and then turned to signal outside with a clap of his hands.
“Didn’t you hear Yi’s order? Hurry up and get in here.”
…
PS: There are two additional chapters, and the plot is being revised.
I’ll release three chapters first, and after dinner, I’ll finish editing the remaining two and then publish them. There will be a bonus update this afternoon, and probably another one in the evening as well.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 91 - 90: Please Call Me, King Malphite! (Congrats to Xiao Xiong Silver on 4/10)
chapters.content:
Chapter 91 – 90: Please Call Me, King Malphite! (Congrats to Xiao Xiong Silver on 4/10)
As the boss finished speaking,
three girls dressed as football babes entered in single file and stood in front of Chen Yi, bowing in unison as they crisply said, “Good afternoon, boss.”
“Only three?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit slightly scorned and pursed his lips toward the people at the next table, “It would make others think we can’t afford more, bring ten more!”
“Ten per person.”
“Uh… brother might have misunderstood.”
The boss wiped the nonexistent sweat from his forehead with a slightly embarrassed expression, stepped aside to reveal the three girls behind him, and then spoke, “Our services are legitimate here. Each one has been obtained through a large number of Points, three is already the limit our store can handle. Any more would be a bit too much for us to afford.”
“Come on, give the boss a dance.”
As these words were said,
the three girls suddenly stood erect, and in unison, raised their right arms to gaze into the distance. With soft music playing, the trio began to dance gracefully.
A background resembling that of an ancient tavern appeared behind them.
Their clothing was not revealing.
They looked like three art students who had been studying dance for a long time.
Five minutes later, the dance ended.
“How was it?”
The boss standing by looked at Chen Yi expectantly, waiting anxiously on the spot.
“Not bad at all.”
Chen Yi gave a brief glance and then diverted his attention back, checking the time on his personal panel and began to contemplate what to prepare for a trip to the wilderness map.
Let’s bring some coffee first, this thing might come in handy.
In case of a life-and-death situation, the perpetual motion machine could also save Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“If Yi likes it, that’s good.”
“That… umm…”
The boss hesitated for a moment with some unease, then tentatively whispered with a flattering smile, “Yi, I have an idea, please hear me out.”
“The dances of these girls are actually character actions, 1500 Points each, a total of 4500 for three.”
“My idea is that in the future, customers can ’order’ a dance for 100 Points to watch once.”
“In this way, customers can enjoy the dance for a minimal cost of Points, and the restaurant can recoup its costs quickly. Furthermore, the girls can earn Points, potentially even more than from hunting monsters; it is a win-win-win.”
“We want to recruit a few more girls like this and provide them with character actions as well… as it stands, we’re a bit short on Points, I was wondering if it’s possible to…”
“Heh heh.”
The boss chuckled with a face of appeasement but did not continue.
“I understand.”
Chen Yi, having caught on, glanced sideways at the boss and then retracted his gaze, immersing all the new mutton slices into the pot with a smile, “Looking for investment, are we?”
The boss gave a sheepish laugh, seeming a bit embarrassed, but soon he became serious, “2000 Points. If Yi would invest 2000 Points, from then on, this restaurant would give Yi a 20% dividend every week, and all of Yi’s future expenses here would be waived, counted as part of the restaurant’s operating costs.”
“Just don’t know if Yi is willing or not.”
“It’s your turn.”
Without saying much more, Chen Yi casually transferred 2000 Points to the boss and waved his hand, “If you don’t have anything else, you may go.”
“2000 Points is not a lot for me, but if these 2000 Points can help you run this restaurant better, then they’re worth it.”
“Go on.”
“Thank you, Yi, thank you so much.”
Excitement flashed in the boss’s eyes as he bowed his thanks repeatedly and then quickly retreated with the girls. Soon, a waiter came over with several plates of fresh meat dishes.
…
Chen Yi looked at the hot broth in front of him, where the slices of mutton were bobbing up and down, gradually changing from red to white, patiently waiting with evident enjoyment.
He had a habit when eating hot pot.
He pursued the ’Four Tastes’.
First, the original flavor, with the light taste of mutton lingering in the mouth.
Second, the sesame sauce, the rich sesame paste fully enhancing the flavor of the mutton.
Third, the spicy oil, wrapping the mutton in the enticing, freshly boiled hot chili oil, perfectly marrying the spicy heat with the flavor of the meat.
Fourth, the vinegar sauce, with sesame sauce as the base, touched with spicy oil, and complemented by fragrant vinegar, making the entire sauce bowl refreshing and appetizing, another distinct flavor.
With each bite of mutton, a new method of eating emerged, creating a variety of tastes, a satisfying feast.
An hour later,
Chen Yi put down his chopsticks, wiped the grease from the corners of his mouth with a napkin, stood up, looked at the boss who was waiting at the side, and gave a casual pat on his shoulder, “Keep the restaurant running well.”
“I really like the flavor. Don’t let me find the place closed or something else wrong next time I come; that would be quite disappointing.”
“Rest assured, Yi,”
the boss nodded solemnly, “As long as Yi comes, this restaurant will definitely be open.”
“Then that’s settled.”
Chen Yi waved his hand nonchalantly before getting up and walking out of the shop, “I’m off then, wish the boss booming business.”
…
Standing at the door watching Chen Yi leave, the boss breathed a sigh of relief when he saw Chen Yi’s receding figure and the increasingly invisible glow of the title above his head. But the very next second, he couldn’t help but jump up with excitement in his eyes!
“Nice!”
“Perfect!!”
He then dashed to the cashier’s desk, his face full of excitement, instructing his cashier, “Print out a notice first thing tomorrow, just eight characters.”
“Yi’s investiture, quality assured!”
“No, wait, go print it now, go with the back kitchen to find those abandoned print shops, and then sneak in to operate the machines and start printing.”
“Hurry, go now, right now.”
After the cashier left, the boss let out a slight breath of relief, feeling like he was walking on clouds as he leaned back in his chair, a hint of excitement crossing his face.
It wasn’t that he really needed the 2000 Points from Yi’s investment.
But with Yi’s investiture, the shop was as if under a real protective umbrella. Before Yi came, quite a number of people had already come looking for trouble under various pretenses.
Once the words “Yi’s investiture” appeared at the entrance, he wanted to see who would dare to cause trouble!
Especially today, several customers had come in and only ordered the pot base, then bought ingredients on their personal panels. What a joke, if all the customers of a hot pot restaurant did this, wouldn’t it be a loss?
But he didn’t say much about it, after all, it was the first day of business, and those customers looked strong, with the leader bearing a “Fatal Strike” title.
Presumably, they would be even harder to deal with.
But such things won’t happen in the future; from now on, no matter who comes knocking, seeing the words “Yi’s investiture,” they’d have to sit down quietly.
“Giving Yi a 2000 Points dividend in the first week, is that too conspicuous?”
The boss hesitated, standing still without speaking. He was pondering how to quickly return the 2000 Points to Yi, and then to send some extra Points his way.
…
“Bye-bye.”
Chen Yi looked toward Jiaye and said with a smile while resting on his cane, “If I have a chance, I’ll see you another day. Tomorrow Tuberculosis Rabbit and I are going to explore a new map, so I won’t be joining you for the grind.”
“Oh.”
Jiaye nodded, her mouth slightly agape but not speaking, her lip glossed – under the moonlight – tempting enough to make one want to give her a big smooch. Her slightly plump cheeks were enough to evoke the desire in any man to pinch them.
She hesitated for a moment, then lifted her head to meet Chen Yi’s eyes, “I might have to go out tomorrow.”
“Go out?”
Chen Yi looked slightly puzzled, his eyebrows raised as he glanced around, and upon confirming he hadn’t time-traveled, he turned to Jiaye with a curious expression, “What are the times coming to? Is there still talk of business trips or vacations?”
“It’s not that.”
Jiaye shook her head, her pupils serious and worried as she said, “My brother is going to participate in the King Malphite’s arena competition.”
“Do you guys remember my brother Tie Chui’s C-level ’Malphite’s Brain’ Skill?”
“This Skill is a global limited edition, with only 1000 available. Once all the Skills are obtained by players, it will activate a hidden Skill Effect.”
“So far, 100 of the Skills have been acquired by players.”
“The system prompted my brother that he needs to use a pass to go to an arena map and compete with the other 99 players who have that Skill.”
“The winner will become the King Malphite of the remaining 99 players.”
“They will have three chances per month to gather the intelligence of all 99 players onto themselves, as well as distribute their own intelligence among the 99 players in exchange for high defense and damage abilities.”
“My brother is going to participate in this competition tomorrow, and I want to accompany him.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit gave Tie Chui, who was standing next to Jiaye, a strange look, “Well… good luck, try to bring back the title of King Malphite. I think with your brother’s strength, others probably won’t be a match for him.”
He had witnessed Tie Chui’s strength.
The Minotaur monsters outside the city were like toys in Tie Chui’s hands.
Tie Chui’s Skill made it so, the lower his intelligence, the stronger he was.
You could say it was a perfect match for Tie Chui, at least his Claw Knife without Charge probably wouldn’t beat Tie Chui.
Of course, it can’t compare to Yi himself.
“I see.”
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully and then waved his hand with a smile, “Then I wish you both a smooth and triumphant return, see you next time.”
“We also wish Yi a triumphant return.”
“Mhm, it’s getting late, you should head back.”
After Jiaye and the others had left, Chen Yi stowed his cane back into his backpack and mounted the nearby sled. He turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit and casually said, “Let’s go. We rest tonight and prepare for tomorrow’s wilderness journey.”
“Oh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Yi’s hands with a puzzled expression; if he remembered correctly, Yi’s cane had the effect of seeing through one layer of obstacles.
But… seeing how Yi acted all serious, he probably didn’t have that in mind, and was just casually resting on it.
Indeed, those with filthy minds see others as filthy too.
He subconsciously chastised himself in his mind and then hurriedly hopped onto the sled.
“Here we go, here we go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 92 - 91: "Are you crazy, calling this a wilderness?!!" (Congratulations to Silver Bear 5/10)
chapters.content:
Chapter 92 – 91: “Are you crazy, calling this a wilderness?!!” (Congratulations to Silver Bear 5/10)
“`
June 2nd, 5:39 AM.
The jarring ring of an alarm abruptly went off.
Chen Yi’s eyes snapped open as he gazed at the countdown in his personal panel.
“21 minutes until wake-up time.”
He let out a slight sigh of relief; today was already June 2nd, and the June rules had officially taken effect.
You must wake up before 6 AM.
Just as he was about to get up and wash up, he suddenly realized that the room was occasionally illuminated by a blinding flash of light.
Following that, he then heard a voice incessantly echoing in his ears.
“Damn it, don’t you doubt me, my Yi was so imposing today, you should’ve seen him.”
“Forget it, if you don’t believe me, there’s nothing I can do. One of these days I’ll bring Yi down for you to see.”
“Or I could take you up there.”
“You still don’t believe me, but you should know…”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit!”
Chen Yi extended his leg emotionlessly and kicked towards the bed where Tuberculosis Rabbit was sleeping.
“Thump!”
With a dull thud, Tuberculosis Rabbit also stirred from his sleep, groggily rubbed his eyes looking at Yi standing at the foot of his bed, yawned forcefully, and sat up muttering.
“Is it time to get up, Yi?”
“That’s not important.”
Chen Yi, expressionless, stood still and gazed at the bewildered Tuberculosis Rabbit, saying word by word, “You just said you were going to take me down to show me off, which ’down’ were you referring to?”
“What do you mean by taking people up here?”
“You better explain yourself today.”
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, completely baffled and helpless, looked up at Yi, and after a long while, he finally realized and helplessly slapped his mouth: “I must’ve been talking nonsense in my sleep again, Yi, don’t take it seriously, even I don’t understand what I say in my dreams.”
“…”
After a long silence, Chen Yi walked to Tuberculosis Rabbit’s bed, spoke seriously, “Don’t take me down just because of a moment’s animosity.”
“You can come back up if you go down, but if I go down, I might not be able to come back up.”
“Don’t bring anyone up either, I might fear nothing, but I don’t really want to see some ominous stuff, at least not while I’m alive.”
“Um… Yi, what are you talking about?”
“Nothing.”
Chen Yi shook his head, sighed lightly, and went to the washroom somewhat irritably to freshen up. Usually, he wouldn’t take Tuberculosis Rabbit’s sleep talking seriously.
But today’s seemed a bit too eerie.
To take him down.
Damn it, anyone who heard that wouldn’t act as if nothing happened.
…
Soon, the time reached 8:00 AM.
Chen Yi, who was sitting ready at the dining table, nodded thoughtfully only after seeing the prompt that popped up in front of him.
“Breakfast time: Please start eating within five minutes.”
This meant he had to start eating breakfast before 8:05. Experience more tales on empire
First, he took a bite of the steamed bun on the table, which was dry food he had purchased from the market through his personal panel. He needed to know if these dry foods would be classified as a meal.
Quickly.
A steamed bun with pickled vegetables went down his throat.
And on the panel, a check mark appeared next to the breakfast time, signifying task completion.
“Dry food works too.”
Chen Yi breathed a sigh of relief. In that case, there wasn’t too much pressure, the only things to watch out for was not to oversleep and to avoid severe injuries.
Like passing out, for example.
The June rules were relatively relaxed; as long as you completed the tasks at each time point, that was sufficient.
But if possible, he still needed to find a cook.
After all, the dry food offered in the store certainly wasn’t as tasty as what a chef could cook on the spot.
Imagine going down to the map later.
Other players nibbling on dry food while their chef prepares a full banquet right next to them—just thinking about the envious looks of other players made him secretly thrilled.
He had to find one.
A chef was a must!
Quality of life needed a slight improvement.
But right now, the most important thing was to sort through his inventory and then prepare to head to the wilderness map.
In the Rose Guardian’s exclusive store, he had grabbed quite a few Wing Exchange Coupons, but he wouldn’t need them for now.
“Prop Name”: Wing Exchange Coupon.
“Prop Level”: E.
“Prop Effect”: After the July version update of the fashion feature, players can use Wing Exchange Coupons to redeem their favorite wing fashion components in the marketplace.
“Prop Description”: “A player can’t be without shiny golden wings, just like a hero can’t be without a gleaming Chelsea!”
“Prop PS: 5 E-level Wing Exchange Coupons can be combined to form a D-level Wing Exchange Coupon, which can be used to purchase D-level wings, and so on.”
“Prop Quantity”: 68.
A total of 200 were available in the marketplace.
With quick reflexes, he managed to get 68, and he doesn’t know who else swiped away the remaining ones, but on second thought, he could guess who they might be.
It’s either Zhou Ping or Sword Without End.
After all, only these few people had a large number of Guardian Points.
“`
“`
He was more inclined to believe it was Sword Without End who had stolen them; others might not purchase these flashy but useless special-effect fashions, but for Sword Without End, these were must-steal items!
To snag them was to profit.
He didn’t know whether these 68 Wing Exchange Coupons could be used to redeem even a single E-grade wing, or if it was possible to redeem three or four.
It would be best if they could redeem 68.
Change one every day.
Next were several self-defense props he had purchased for himself.
「Prop Name」: Rikk’s Fifth Generation Pendant.
「Prop Level」: D-grade.
「Prop Effect」: When you hang this pendant around your neck, you’ll sense and even know who’s cursing you under their breath or in their minds whenever they hurl insults your way.
「Prop Introduction」: “The Rikk forces are expanding continuously, with profanities filling their discourse top to bottom!”
This item was very useful; those who cursed him in secret were potential enemies.
Knowing who cursed him in secret and then finding them only to shoot them down.
That would keep him safe.
This self-defense prop could be said to be extremely useful.
Of course, in order to cherish his life, he also spent a good deal of money on another self-defense prop.
After all, the limited-time store was full of great treasures, and having finally experienced the feeling of a big spender in the game, of course, he had to cover himself head to toe in expensive gear.
「Prop Name」: Man’s Vest.
「Prop Level」: C-grade.
「Prop Effect」: When worn inside your fashion, it integrates seamlessly with your outfit, providing a cool and warm feeling while protecting your abdomen and back. When damaged, the damage received will be reduced based on your Fashion Scoring.
「Prop Limitation」: This vest can only be worn along with a fashion outfit.
The higher the Fashion Scoring, the less damage received.
「Prop Introduction」: “A man’s vest, the last line of defense.”
This prop could indeed be called a lifesaving artifact.
His little bear onesie was a C-grade fashion, the highest-scoring Fashion Component he owned, with a full 200 points.
Plus, other fashion items.
Like earrings, pendants, bracelets, and other small fashion items purchased in the store, which could push his Fashion Scoring up to nearly 300 points.
Although this mix-and-match look might seem odd, it was the highest score and the safest!
Between looking good and being safe, he silently chose safety.
Thus, the little bear onesie replaced the blue robe he had been wearing.
This prop was a bit pricey; only 300,000 were for sale in the store, but many people bought it. When he checked last night, there were only 20,000 left.
He bought one for Tuberculosis Rabbit too.
It could be said that this significantly enhanced their defense so they wouldn’t suffer a great loss due to carelessness.
As for offensive measures.
The already Charged Claw Knife and the fully Charged Septagon Badge.
Plus, Frozen Throne and so on. If worst comes to worst, let the elk pull the sled and crash into the enemy head-on.
With the speed of a thousand kilometers per hour, whatever it hit would surely die.
It’s just that he would rather not do that unless it were absolutely necessary since he was a bit worried about accidentally killing his elk.
And with all the other random props he had bought in the store.
Two words unbeatable!
In any case, the fully equipped duo exchanged a silent glance before patiently starting to wait.
When the clock struck 09:00.
A panel popped up in front of Chen Yi.
「Ding, a Wilderness Pass has been detected. You are hereby invited to participate in pioneering this map. In one minute, you will be teleported into the wilderness.」
「Please make the necessary preparations.」
Chen Yi scanned the two lines in front of him, did one final check of his backpack to ensure everything was correct, and then sat down to wait.
“Just over 300 Charge.” Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out his Claw Knife to check its Charge progress: “To reach the power of the last strike, it’ll take over ten days of Charging.”
He had unleashed that long-Charged strike last night for two reasons.
One was to outshine Sword Without End and draw attention, giving Yi a moment to change outfits.
And the other was to test the strike’s power.
To have a general understanding of the Charge power, lest he face actual life-threatening danger in the future and be clueless about the extent of his Charge’s power, possibly causing a huge blunder.
A minute went by in the blink of an eye—
Chen Yi and his companion only saw a flash of white light before their eyes.
When they came to their senses, they found that there were already many players standing around them, each one observing their surroundings just like them.
Tuberculosis Rabbit composed himself, looked up at the scene before him, and couldn’t help but slowly open his mouth in shock and disbelief.
“Are you insane, calling this a wilderness?!”
…
ps: It’s quite a story.
I went downstairs for lunch at noon, and my wife’s phone got stolen. We used Apple’s location service to look for it for a long time, but calls to it went straight to voicemail.
Only later did we find out from the internet that those locations aren’t accurate at all, and the phone has probably changed hands several times by now. The internet says that in a few days, there will be some industry insiders pretending to be Apple officials asking for your ID and password.
I’m not sure if that’s true.
It was really tiring to deal with all day. I had just bought it last month, and it’s not the money I’m upset about, but my wife has been feeling guilty and crying, saying she lost it so soon after buying it. It broke my heart to see her like that, and I’ve been trying to console her.
Finally, I bought another one, hurried home, and finished revising these two chapters before uploading them.
Sorry for the delay, I hope you all understand.

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 93 - 92: "Maybe we could try... level push?" (Congratulations to Little Bear Silver for 6/10)
chapters.content:
Chapter 93 – 92: “Maybe we could try… level push?” (Congratulations to Little Bear Silver for 6/10)
The scenery around could neither be said to be entirely unrelated to wilderness, nor could it be said to be related.
The definition of wilderness.
Generally seen as barren, desolate, countryside.
Yet the scene before was quite the opposite.
Explore stories at empire
An oasis.
Countless pine trees towering into the clouds densely packed, it was hard to resist the urge to lie comfortably beneath them, enjoying the comfort of the shade in the harsh sunlight.
Of course.
If you didn’t mind the fist-sized spider dropping from the treetops into your clothes the moment you closed your eyes.
Or a grass snake silently slithering up your pant leg amidst the underbrush.
By comparison, the sudden appearance of a brown bear with a gaping maw behind you was relatively more acceptable, at least to some people.
Forget it, suicide was a quicker and cleaner way out.
They had just steadied themselves when a panel materialized before them.
“Welcome, players, to the pioneer ’Wasteland’ map. Below are the map details and rules; please read carefully.”
“Players have one minute to review the map details.”
“1. The map is vast, allowing plenty of room for exploration. Within the map, all player Skills, Props, and Titles can be used normally.”
“2. Felling pine trees will drop wooden resources, which have many uses, such as building houses, and constructing defense structures like walls and arrow towers.”
“3. Man-faced beasts will appear on the map, and by killing these monsters, players can obtain rare resources, which can be used to build exclusive items, like fur for warmth or a sofa bed.”
“4. The map features many animals for players to hunt. Besides the dry provisions in their backpacks, they cannot purchase any food resources from personal stores while on the map, including purified water and dry provisions.”
“5. The pioneer phase of the map lasts 10 days and will feature a building score event with exclusive leaderboards. The top-ranked player after map pioneering will receive an extra exclusive Title reward.”
“6. Once pioneering is completed, the map will open to all players. At that time, any player holding a ’Wilderness Pass’ can freely enter the Wasteland map. Players will attack the structures built within the past ten days, and those who successfully capture a structure will be rewarded. If a player’s structure isn’t successfully captured, the owner of the building will receive a reward.”
“7. During these 10 days, the map will announce tomorrow’s weather every day. Players, please take timely countermeasures.”
“8. Within the map, players can respawn indefinitely, but all resources gathered such as wood or fur will be dropped upon death.”
“9. For more fun gameplay, players should explore proactively.”
“10. After the pioneering phase, players will be evaluated based on their performance on the map, and corresponding rewards will be given out.”
“Sounds like… we’re supposed to build houses?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully, then glanced around with an increasingly strange expression. There were nearly 100 players in total, and aside from a dozen or so players in beginner gear.
The rest were essentially in fashion wear.
Only that each fashion wear was weirder than the next.
To the left, one was dressed as a clown with a cockscomb on their head, and social canvas shoes on their feet, looking extremely bizarre.
The one in the distance was even stranger, dressed as Ultraman. He had seen this outfit in the store but never thought anyone would actually buy such a thing.
Although everyone shouted for the light, dressing up as Ultraman was quite odd, to say the least.
The rest were hardly normal by comparison.
Next to them, Yi’s bear pajamas were surprisingly tame, at least they were meant for humans.
“Wait.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly spotted a familiar player, not too far away, the one draped in a trench coat with a fluffy fox tail swishing about. It seemed they had seen them several times before.
They must be players from Yancheng, right?
Before the players had the chance to interact,
They suddenly felt lighter underfoot, and a strong sense of weightlessness came over them.
When they opened their eyes again, they were in a forest.
…
“Wow.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at the many pine trees around, each over 30 meters tall or more, and couldn’t help but exclaim in awe, “All these trees would sell for so much.”
The pine trees around were very dense, blocking out more than half of the sunlight above.
“Looks like it really is a wilderness survival series?”
Chen Yi looked around and said thoughtfully, “Before we entered the map, we just stocked some provisions in our backpacks, along with a few props that can stave off hunger and thirst, and the game’s available game.”
“Surviving 10 days shouldn’t be a problem.”
“It seems the biggest challenge of this map might be the food resources, and… the threat of savages.”
At that moment, he discovered that a new Prop had appeared in his backpack, shimmering brightly.
’Prop Name’: Logging Axe.
’Prop Grade’: None.
’Prop Effect’: Used for chopping wood, spend 20 logs to upgrade it to a ’One-Star Logging Axe’ to greatly increase logging efficiency.
’Prop Introduction’: “One must first sharpen his tools if he is to do his work well.”
“For logging?”
Chen Yi murmured to himself and nodded, hefting the Logging Axe in his hand and weighing it a few times—it was pretty heavy. He took a trial swing at the root of a pine tree next to him.
Suddenly.
A panel popped up in front of him.
’1/15.’
Did this mean it would take 15 swings to fell the tree? Deciding that practice would reveal the truth, he didn’t waste any more words but rolled up his sleeves and began to vigorously hack at the root of the pine tree.
“Hmm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood by, looking at Yi, who was wearing a little bear onesie and chopping down a pine tree with a Logging Axe, feeling like the scene was just a bit odd.
Chopping wood in a little bear onesie was incredibly discordant.
It was like when you catch a glimpse of your girlfriend cooking instant noodles in the kitchen wearing a nightgown, and the image that comes to mind isn’t the delicious instant noodles that are about to be done.
Just then—
“Boom!”
The pine tree in front of Chen Yi suddenly collapsed, not to the sides but as if splitting down the middle, ten round logs fell to the ground and turned into streaks of light that flew into his body.
Not a single leaf or twig was left on the ground, just an extremely flat cross-section of the pine trunk.
“Ding, darkness will descend in 12 hours.”
“After darkness descends, wild people will start moving and hunting players, please build a defensive structure to protect yourself as soon as possible.”
A notification sounded in the ears of all players.
Chen Yi looked at the ten round logs in his backpack, and a building panel popped up in the air.
10 logs could be used as a foundation laid on the ground.
Or they could be piled up to make the walls of a house.
Alternatively, they could be used to construct defensive structures like arrow towers.
Wait a second.
By that calculation, constructing the most rudimentary house would require about 30 logs, and with defenses, probably around 100 logs.
Chopping down a pine tree yielded 10 logs, so 100 logs would just mean chopping down 10 pine trees, which could be done in a couple of hours if one had decent stamina.
It looked like the survival difficulty shouldn’t be too hard.
“Yi, I’m going to start now, huh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit lit a cigarette, took a deep drag, then pulled out a Logging Axe from his embrace and eyed a pine tree before him, swinging down hard!
“1/32.”
“Huh… why do I have to chop 32 times?”
“It must be different depending on physical strength; different people need different numbers of swings, but don’t rush it.”
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes with a thoughtful expression, “Perhaps we could try… a level push?”
…
“This…”
Li Yide stood in his trench coat, having read through all the content and rules of the map. His Fox Tail couldn’t help but shake wildly behind him as the corners of his mouth lifted uncontrollably into a broad laugh.
“Heaven is truly aiding me!!!”
He looked at a Prop in his arms, with eyes sparkling with excitement.
Before coming here, he had seen Chen Yi as well.
That handful of titles was exceptionally noticeable among the players. After being suppressed by Chen Yi in Yancheng for so long, it was time for him to turn the tables on Chen Yi.
With the Prop in his embrace, he was set to be the strongest player on this map. At the very least, his building’s score would definitely rank first on the leaderboard!
“Prop Name”: Bald Qiang’s Logging Chainsaw.
“Prop Grade”: D-grade.
“Prop Effect”: An unstoppable chainsaw that could instantly slice through any hard tree.
“Prop Introduction”: “You know, I have a wish to chop down all the trees in the neighbor’s yard that block the sunlight in my own yard.”
“Heh.”
Li Yide’s eyes shone; he glanced at the building score leaderboard, which was still empty, and tossed the One-Star Logging Axe that the system had gifted him into the hands of his Little Rascal.
“Here, this is for you, Little Rascal.”
“Now, watch my performance.”
“A true man stands between heaven and earth; how can he be content living under others for long!”
The next second—
Li Yide leaned forward slightly, grabbing the whirring chainsaw between his hands, his face resolute and his eyes full of anticipation for the future, and let out a low roar.
His Fox Tail began to tremble ferociously.
Suddenly!
The Fox Tail emitted an exceedingly bright light, and Li Yide’s body shot straight forward, leaving an orange fiery trail behind!
“Heaven is aiding me!”
In almost the blink of an eye, Li Yide had shot hundreds of meters away.
Little Rascal, who had been standing behind Li Yide, could only gape as the trees along the way were all chopped down by Li Yide, with the logs turning into streaks of light and flying into his body before they even hit the ground.
In a matter of seconds!
More than thirty pine trees were chopped down in the blink of an eye!
His backpack instantly filled with a whopping 300 logs!
A visibly clear path had suddenly emerged in the dense forest!
While other players needed nearly ten minutes to chop down a single tree, Li Yide had felled more than thirty pine trees in a matter of seconds!
The difference was incomparable.
“Excellent!”
Stopping on the clearing, Li Yide turned around to look at the cleared space behind him, smiling uncontrollably as he admired his handiwork.
Then, he became somewhat hesitant as he looked at the panel of his Fox Tail Vehicle.
While his Vehicle could burst with speed, it wasn’t very long-lasting.
The fuel he had been saving up for so long had just been used up by one-fiftieth in that moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 94 - 93: "You sure can eat a lot!" (Additional for 1500 monthly votes!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 94 – 93: “You sure can eat a lot!” (Additional chapter for 1500 monthly votes!)
“`
“No problem.”
Li Yide quickly breathed a sigh of relief, his vehicle’s fuel was quite special, it didn’t consume points, it only required his own poop as fuel.
The forest was so big.
Mushrooms were everywhere, and there were always some that would upset one’s stomach and cause diarrhea.
Just eat whatever.
As long as he remained in a state of diarrhea, gathering fuel was pretty fast.
He didn’t need to worry about eating poisonous mushrooms and killing himself, since he could be revived.
“Keep it up!”
With a serious expression, he took a deep breath, glanced at the neatly packed logs in his backpack, and with a determined look, adjusted his posture, grabbed the chainsaw, and sped off towards the distance!
This time!
He was going to win!
…
“Uh.”
In the forest, a young man dressed in a clown suit hesitantly squatted in place, tapping the ground with his hand.
He constantly felt the ground was unsafe.
He wondered whether he could dig a deep hole underground and bury himself in it to be safer.
He just needed to dig the hole deeper and leave a hole for breathing.
After pondering for a while.
“Mm.”
The man with a determined look nodded, rolled up his sleeves right there, and started digging his own grave.
…
“Whoosh!”
A player dressed in an Ultraman costume lazily spat out a strand of webbing to latch onto a distant pine tree, and as the webbing snapped back, he swung forward propelled by the webbing.
“Awooo!”
Excited howls occasionally echoed through the forest!
He felt like he didn’t need to build any shelter at all.
He had a prop that allowed him to spit out webbing, thereby pulling himself along, similar to Spider-Man’s powers; with this ability, he was invincible in the forest.
That so-called wild man couldn’t even touch a single hair on him.
As for why he didn’t buy the Spider-Man costume… of course, it was because it wasn’t sold in the store, so he had to settle for an Ultraman costume. Anyway, he was still a superhero.
He really wanted to own a Spider-Man costume; it would match so well with his web-slinging prop.
And it would fulfill his lifelong dream of being a superhero.
…
A hundred players were scattered throughout this vast forest, using their own methods in every corner to cut down trees or find their own unique ways to survive.
You could say the approaches were varied.
Everyone employed different tactics.
No one was willing to fall behind.
On Chen Yi’s side, however, the style was slightly bizarre.
In the midst of the forest abruptly appeared a crimson Frozen Throne, and Chen Yi was sitting leisurely on the throne, casually holding a cup of milk tea and savoring it slowly.
Around him.
A hundred soldiers clad in heavy armor, wielding giant blades, were tirelessly chopping pine trees.
Swing their blades, chop down.
Swing their blades, chop down.
Their movements were uniform and crisp, filling the scene with a chill of ruthlessness!
In just a few dozen minutes.
A football field-sized clearing emerged in front of Chen Yi’s throne, and the hundred soldiers were still steadily and tirelessly advancing.
“Mm.”
Chen Yi, looking at this scene, took a satisfying sip of milk tea, swallowed the juice, spat out some random QQ candy balls, and then nodded appreciatively, “This speed has picked up quite a bit.”
“Mm…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the soldiers marching away like a military expedition, hesitated for a moment before turning its gaze towards Yi, “This is much faster indeed, but Yi, you can’t just stay on the throne for the whole ten days, can you?”
“You’ll get hemorrhoids that way.”
“I’m also thinking about this issue.”
Chen Yi sat on the throne, took out and activated the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh from his backpack, looked at the reindeer lying on the ground blinking rapidly, pondered for a while, and then pointed to a nearby pine tree.
“What would happen if you were to crash into that at a thousand kilometers per hour?”
“…”
The milu deer, as if understanding, silently buried its head under the sleigh,
“It seems he is quite aware of his own limits.”
“Wait a second—”
Tuberculosis Rabbit watched the deer’s exposed bum, thoughtfully saying, “If I remember correctly, when we took the deer with us, the Santa Claus outfit shrank and flew into his backside.”
“The deer’s backside is a storage space?”
“Moreover, we’ve been with the deer for so long, I don’t think I’ve ever seen it go to the toilet or anything like that, which is clearly different from normal animals.”
As he finished speaking.
The deer’s body shivered slightly, but it did not make any moves, just covering its behind with its fluffy, short tail, still keeping its head buried under the sleigh.
“Perhaps…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s gaze began to grow strange, “If I reached in, could I find some props, like taking them out of a backpack?”
“There actually might be that possibility.”
“Otherwise, how could we explain the Santa Claus suit incident?”
He hesitated, walked to the front of the deer, took out a pair of plastic gloves from his pocket, put them on with a contorted face and a furrowed brow, baring his teeth and grimacing as he tried to reach in!
The very next second—
“Damn, there’s so much space inside, it really is a storage space!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit excitedly pulled something out, glanced at it, and tossed it aside, “It’s that Santa Claus suit.”
The suit, originally only the size of a fist, rapidly expanded upon hitting the ground, until it returned to the size they had seen in the city that day.
“`
“`
“Prop Name”: Santa Claus Suit
“Prop Level”: E grade.
“Prop Effect”: Once worn, allows the user to disguise themselves as a Santa Claus several meters tall.
“Prop Introduction”: “Just a toy.”
“And there’s more!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, as if discovering a treasure trove, excitedly kept pulling out one prop after another and threw them on the ground.
“Prop Name”: Special Milu Deer Chew Stick.
“Prop Level”: E grade.
“Prop Effect”: Can be used for Santa Claus’s milu deer to grind their teeth.
“Prop Introduction”: “If you’re willing, it can also be used as a chew stick for a puppy.”
“And there’s more, there’s more.”
“That’s enough.”
