“You damned players, just kill me if you dare! You won’t escape either!”
“Let’s go to hell together!”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood frozen in place for a moment before finally straightening up and taking out a mirror from his embrace. He looked at the handsome face in the mirror that now sported a glob of thick phlegm.
His expression calm, he carefully wiped it off with a wet wipe.
After ensuring it was completely clean, he reached out, grabbed the middle-aged man’s mouth, and smiled.
“Brave.”
Then he pulled out a Claw Knife from his embrace, the blade pointing directly at the man’s gums, and stabbed fiercely into them.
Blood gushed forth.
He then levered it upwards sharply, prying out a bad tooth just like that.
“Ahhh!!!!”
The middle-aged man’s scream of agony quickly filled the room; the resentment in his eyes turned to fear at this moment.
Standing aside, Sword Without End looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a complex expression, feeling a bit out of place. It would make sense if these things were happening to Chen Yi.
After all, Chen Yi’s expressionless, cold demeanor made such acts hardly surprising.
But Tuberculosis Rabbit, who usually seemed playful and harmless, had such a ruthless side to him, which Sword Without End had not anticipated.
Not far away, the woman kneeling at the door saw this scene and felt a chill, burying her head in the floor as if to pretend she hadn’t seen it, her body trembling slightly.
“The teeth are a bit yellow.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out the Claw Knife, casually wiped it a few times on the middle-aged man’s body to clean off the blood, then inserted the Claw Knife back into the man’s mouth.
“You must smoke quite a bit. I’m in a good mood today, I’ll help you pull out your teeth.”
Before his words fell, he stabbed the knife again into the man’s gums.
With a little effort, another tooth was pried out.
Incredibly swift and decisive.
Compared to those dentists who use water jets and hammers for a wisdom tooth removal, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s movements were much simpler and more straightforward, almost like a qualified dentist.
“I was wrong, let me go, please.”
The middle-aged man’s body trembled from the severe pain, his eyes red with fear as he knelt on the ground, looking up at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a shaky voice, he said unclearly, “I was wrong, I beg you.”
Large amounts of fresh blood mixed with bubbles spilled from the corner of the man’s mouth.
Lying on the floor were two lonely teeth with bits of flesh on them.
“Wrong?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit raised his eyebrows, then with a satisfied expression, wiped the Claw Knife on the man’s body a few more times and put it back into his embrace, signaling the man to look at Yi sitting in a chair nearby.
“If you had admitted your mistakes earlier, it would all have been fine. Mostly, I’m very amiable.”
“It’s just that you are too rebellious.”
“It makes me look like some sort of violent criminal, which really ruins my image in front of the ladies.”
“Yi has some questions for you. Answer them obediently, and your life will be spared.”
“Really, you can’t be that naughty in the future.”
Then he turned to Yi sitting in the chair nearby, “Yi, I’m done here.” Find your next read at empire
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded, his head down without speaking. The woman who had been kneeling at the door had crawled in front of him at some point, placing his feet on her back as if serving as a footrest.
The woman demeaned herself, perhaps in relation to this abnormally deformed city.
He paid her no mind.
Instead, he crossed his legs on the woman’s back and turned his head to look at the middle-aged man kneeling on the ground. After pondering for a while, he finally spoke.
“Tell me about players, I’m quite curious about your definition of players.”
The middle-aged man, who was full of fear, heard the word “players” and couldn’t help but show a strong loathing in his pupils again, but he quickly suppressed it.
After a long while, he spoke with a hoarse voice, unclearly saying.
“Shouldn’t you know better than us? After all, you are players.”
“You treat us as NPCs and slaughter us at will.”
“But what I want to tell you is, don’t be too happy too soon. Long ago, we were also players; we just lost in the end and became what you call NPCs now.”
“You don’t think you can keep winning, do you?”
“You will lose too!”
“The day you lose, your planet will be like ours, with only one place where you can barely survive, becoming a map for other players to freely enter and trample!”
“You damned players, one day you’ll taste the consequences, don’t be too arrogant too soon!!!”
As he spoke, the middle-aged man’s emotions gradually became agitated, his tone filled with intense anger and hatred!
“What a pity.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed helplessly, then took out the Claw Knife from his embrace, ready to stab toward the middle-aged man’s mouth again.
But before Tuberculosis Rabbit could make his move.
The middle-aged man’s body suddenly lurched forward, his neck striking directly against the sharp edge of the blade. It pierced through immediately, and vast quantities of blood spurted out from the wound on his neck!
“Rip!”
Along with the man’s body collapsing onto the ground, copious amounts of fresh blood swiftly stained the surface red.
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked silently at the middle-aged man on the ground who had chosen suicide and then, somewhat admiringly, clucked his tongue, “Alright, you really do have guts.”
“Actually, I just wanted to peel an apple for you to eat?”
“Do you like apples?”
However, the man lying on the ground didn’t even look at Tuberculosis Rabbit. Instead, his eyes were fixed on Chen Yi as blood and bubbles continuously emerged from his throat, his expression fierce and forceful as he delivered his last words one by one.
“We used to be players too!”
“Our planet had also gone global before, and we even felt grateful to this game for giving us such powerful individual combat abilities, having a lot of magical stuff, and even many events were just fun, without any danger!”
“We gradually let our guard down towards this game!”
“But as the difficulty increased step by step, more and more people died, and in the end, we lost and failed to advance.”
“After our failure, the remaining players were gathered in one place to become a map for you players from who knows which planet to slaughter at will!”
“No one will be a winner forever!”
“You will lose too, and on the day you lose, you will hate the players just like us!”
“I will be waiting for you in hell!”
As his words died away.
The middle-aged man lay in a pool of blood, his eyes filled with a desire to split wide open, staring tightly at Chen Yi, his lips pressed shut without saying a word!
One second.
Two seconds.
Three seconds.
Half a minute quickly passed.
“Um…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit slightly embarrassed, touched his nose, and said to the man lying on the ground who was not yet dead, “According to your script, you’re supposed to spout some fierce words and then die gloriously, right?”
“But now that you’re not dead, isn’t it tiring to keep striking a pose?”
The middle-aged man lying in the pool of blood turned his head with difficulty to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit but didn’t speak; the anger in his eyes intensified even further.
“Do you think it might have something to do with that mechanical heart of yours?”
“Do you want me to help you out?”
The middle-aged man nodded vigorously, then regained his emotional composure and looked at Chen Yi with an angry face, “You damned players, there will come a day when you will regret this. I will be waiting for you in hell!”
“Then, I will take your head…”
The voice suddenly stopped dead.
Tuberculosis Rabbit slowly withdrew his foot from the man’s chest, shook his head looking at the mechanical heart he had just crushed, “This quality is not good, it broke with a single stomp.”
“What if one day you fall and smash your own heart?”
“Shouldn’t we be concerned about what this man said before he died?”
Sword Without End spoke up, his expression serious.
“Oh, that thing?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged indifferently and spread his hands, “Isn’t it all pretty clear? It’s all a bunch of messy conspiracy theories, nothing to be too surprised about.”
“Isn’t this kind of thing pretty normal?”
“After all, the May rules are still in effect. No one thinks the group that came up with these rules is some kind of charity organization, right?”
“As for players failing and turning into NPCs or whatever, who cares.”
“Anyway, I’m with Yi. These issues are for Yi to think about, not me. I’m just an executor; thinking is not my job.”
“…”
Sword Without End fell silent, not knowing quite how to respond.
This was clearly a serious issue, so why did Tuberculosis Rabbit not care at all?
But if asked to explain specifically what was serious about it, he felt as though he couldn’t articulate it…
After a long while, he gave up thinking about it.
Not having to think felt really good.
He then turned his gaze together with Tuberculosis Rabbit to Chen Yi, who was sitting in a chair.
Let Chen Yi do the thinking.
“So…”
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes, pondering, and began, “So, there are actually countless props in this city? Then, from another perspective, could we not loot some of the city’s props to take back with us?”
From the man’s words, he had roughly figured out what this city was about.
And perhaps… he had also grasped the specifics of future version updates.
After musing for a moment, he then pointed with his cane to lift the head of the woman on the ground and asked, “Did you all hear him, do you know what he was talking…”
Before he could finish, he fell silent in place.
This woman, who had previously knelt on the ground very docilely, now had an incredibly eerie expression, staring at him with a smile that was not quite a smile.
It looked exceedingly creepy.
“…”
Chen Yi silently lit a cigarette, placed it in his mouth, and quickly used his cane to press down the woman’s head again, then let out a light sigh.
“What’s this about? It’s somewhat frightening.”

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 110 - 109: "As long as you kill 10 players within the map, you can be successfully revived?
chapters.content:
Chapter 110 – 109: “As long as you kill 10 players within the map, you can be successfully revived?
The woman on the ground, who had been obedient from beginning to end, suddenly revealed an extremely eerie smile at the corner of her mouth when she just lifted her head.
It looked extremely unsettling.
But fortunately, he wasn’t afraid.
“Transform.”
In the instant he pressed the woman’s head down, the staff in Chen Yi’s hand suddenly thrust out like a spear, aiming directly at the woman’s head in an attempt to kill her with one strike.
He didn’t understand what had happened to this woman, but the sudden and unexpected change led him to quickly deduce that she had become an unstable and potentially explosive element.
Eliminating her at the first opportunity was the only thing he should do.
“Crack.”
Successful hit.
The woman’s head, as fragile as cheesecake, was successfully pierced by the staff.
But the next second—
Her head suddenly split into two, and grew wildly, turning into two terrifying saw-toother heads full of fangs, which bit furiously towards Chen Yi’s head like man-eating plants!
“Swoosh.” Read new adventures at empire
At the critical moment, a blue streak of light swiftly slashed across the woman’s neck.
The two horrific, fanged heads suddenly froze in place, then lost their source of power, and their body slowly fell to the ground. The fanged heads slowly merged back into the woman’s original head on the ground.
After rolling a few times on the ground with eyes full of unwillingness, they then stared straight at Chen Yi.
Her mouth opened and closed a few times, but before she could say a word, the light in her eyes quickly faded.
Dead beyond doubt.
“Are you alright?”
Sword Without End retracted the blue light—it was he who had acted, killing the woman who had suddenly mutated.
Chen Yi stood still and did not speak, only the staff in his hand, which had reverted to a sniper rifle, once again transformed into staff.
He had a prop known as the Septagon Badge.
When activated, it could instantly transform into a hundred gun muzzles, dealing a fatal blow to the enemy.
Based on the special effects of his sniper rifle, it could essentially form a guaranteed deadly attack.
It’s just that Sword Without End was a bit too fast. Before he had time to activate the Septagon Badge, Sword Without End had already killed the suddenly mutated woman.
This also saved him a sum of Points and the charge of the Septagon Badge.
“What’s going on here?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood puzzled in front of the woman’s body, continuously poking at the cross-sectional wound on the woman’s neck with chopsticks, “What’s with this woman? Why did she mutate all of a sudden?”
“There was not even a sign, isn’t it too abrupt?”
“Hmm?”
Just then, he seemed to have thought of something, took off the woman’s clothes, and looked at the immaculate corpse in front of him.
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in silence.
On the woman’s stomach, he saw a row of text tattooed like markings.
“Hell Player.”
“After killing 10 players within the map, a revival to Blue Star is granted.”
The string of text, as if freshly branded, was red-hot on the woman’s pale abdomen, but then it slowly disappeared, as if it had never existed.
“This line of text wasn’t here before.”
Chen Yi shook his head and began with a slight frown, “It appeared after she died.”
He had been standing with his staff the whole time and had observed the woman several times, never spotting any tattoos on her abdomen, which indicated that this text appeared only after the woman’s death.
Hell Player?
Can revive and return to Blue Star after killing 10 players within the map?
Does this mean that this woman was already a dead player from Blue Star?
Is there really such a world as Hell, where the dead can exist?
And by completing certain tasks, one can even revive?
These two lines of text contained a lot of information.
“Is that even possible?”
A hint of strangeness flashed through Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, “I think I understand what’s happening. It means this woman was a player who had died on Blue Star and became a Hell Player.”
“We belong to opposing camps.”
“So just by killing enough players within the map to reach the count of ten, she could have been revived?”
“But the problem is, this woman had a watch unique to this map, is it something a player could obtain? It looks like she was an original resident of this map.”
“Maybe… she had just logged on recently.”
Chen Yi interjected suddenly with a chill, he began to vaguely understand some of the hidden rules of this map.
The woman had been acting normally at the start, and it was likely that her sudden mutation was due to the Hell Player logging on.
This also explained why their abrupt arrival at the café had not caused any commotion.
Before the three of them arrived,
Three people were sitting inside the café. After their arrival, they took control of the bodies, and since it was just the consciousness switching, naturally, it didn’t raise any alarm.
To outsiders, they had been sitting there from the start to the end.
But the problem was, he had already considered this possibility and meticulously checked his own body, which was definitely his own, even down to the small hair in his right atrium.
It was unique to him, irreplaceable.
For some reason, a small hair had started growing at his right atrium, about half a finger long, protruding starkly from the skin and appearing extremely conspicuous.
“Is there really a hell?”
Standing aside, Sword Without End’s body froze on the spot. His previously indifferent eyes suddenly blossomed with unprecedented brilliance. He abruptly turned his head to look at Chen Yi and the other person, “Doesn’t that mean I have the chance to resurrect some people who died in the past?”
“Like my lover?”
“Um…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pondered for a while before speaking, “Although I don’t want to crush your hopes, I think this Hell Player probably only refers to players who have died in the past few months.”
“People who died before probably don’t count as Hell Players.”
“Otherwise, think about those historical figures. If they appeared on the same map as us, how much hope do you think we would have to win?”
“Not to mention anything else.”
“Just like in City 13, where the class distinction between the Upper City and Lower City is so solidified and clear. If you let that art student who failed his college entrance exams become a Hell Player and come to this map, do you believe it wouldn’t take many days before City 13 starts preparing for an uprising?”
“That’s kind of scary.”
Sword Without End was stunned for a moment, a bit disappointed, but the light in his eyes didn’t completely fade away; he still held onto a sliver of hope.
What if?
What if there was such a possibility?
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yi didn’t plan to dawdle. He intended to personally check out this map for himself. With the sled’s speed, no matter how big the map was, he could investigate it thoroughly before leaving.
In the upper left corner of his personal panel was a plan view of this map.
His location was marked as Greenpoint, while the Law Enforcement Bureau in District 78 was marked as a red dot, a few blocks away from them—and also their target destination.
They needed to kill a prisoner inside the Law Enforcement Bureau.
“Get in.”
The next second—
“Bang!”
Leaving behind a chaotic scene, Chen Yi and his companions smashed through the floor-to-ceiling windows with the sled, burst out of the building, quickly gained altitude, and started sprinting towards the edge of the map at high speed!
Only dozens of minutes later!
They saw the edge of the map.
An imposing air wall with a viscous liquid inside, yellowish and mixed with white granules.
Just like the air wall in the wilderness map.
“What… what is this?”
Sword Without End, seeing this scene for the first time, was somewhat shocked and stood rooted to the spot.
“Just an air wall.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit casually glanced at it and said, “It’s nothing to be surprised about. It looks like this map also has an air wall. After hearing what that man said, I actually thought we’d see some sort of desolate planet.”
Chen Yi didn’t speak, but simply controlled the sled to start circumnavigating the perimeter of the map at high speed.
Without any exceptions.
The entire city was enveloped within this air wall, with numerous armed helicopters rising to chase after them, but regrettably, they simply couldn’t catch up.
Even the rocket launchers fired at them failed to see their exhaust, making it impossible to accurately lock on to their targets.
The speed gap was too large.
No fighter jets or missiles were seen, whether they hadn’t taken off, or they simply weren’t there.
Two hours later.
They had driven at high speed around the perimeter of the map by the edge of City 13.
It was a completely enclosed city.
Completely self-sustaining.
At the same time, they also saw what was called the Upper City.
A large stretch of farmland.
There, a vast number of crops were grown, and every household seemed to have some livestock and poultry, which looked somewhat similar to the rural areas on Blue Star—this was the so-called Upper City.
People here didn’t need to eat artificially produced food but could enjoy the original taste of food.
The coffee they drank was also made from freshly ground coffee beans.
Not some human coffee maker.
The meals they ate were also cooked from the vegetables and poultry in their backyards.
Not some human food preparation machine.
Each household had a standalone courtyard, but actually, if you put aside the food, according to the concepts on Blue Star, these buildings looked more like slums.
…
Inside the city library.
Chen Yi kept flipping through paper books, then suddenly laughed, turning to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Do you know how hard it is to create a real world?”
“Uh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, squatting in the corner puffing on a cigarette and indulging in comic books, suddenly paused and looked puzzled, “What do you mean? I don’t understand.”
“It’s quite simple.”
Chen Yi tossed the paper book he was holding back into the shelf and then picked up another one, “If you want to build a real planet, that planet must possess its own unique culture.”
“Including philosophy, historical stories, myths and legends, and so on.”
“All these things are different on each planet; different planets cannot give birth to the same culture.”
“And the philosophical thought on this planet is almost a carbon copy of Blue Star’s. The historical stories are either missing or also simply emulating Blue Star. Several history books, when opened, turn out to be blank; they are merely white paper with not a single word on them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 111 - 110: "Attention all players, the world boss is about to appear.
chapters.content:
Chapter 111 – 110: “Attention all players, the world boss is about to appear.
“Myths and legends can’t be said to be exactly the same as those on Blue Star, but one might say they’re wholly identical.”
“According to that man, this used to be a thriving planet that now barely clings to existence, yet I failed to find even a trace of exclusive culture or mythology belonging to this planet.”
“What do you mean, Yi?”
“What I mean is quite simple.”
Chen Yi opened the book he was holding and tossed it in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit, revealing that its pages were blank, not a single word recorded, though the title was ’Five Thousand Years Above and Below the Lone Star’.”
“Contrary to that man’s story, I’m more inclined to believe that this map was fabricated, just another map created by the Snow Sea Project Team, like the wilderness maps.”
“The supposed story background is also designed.”
“But to design such an expansive story background is really a massive undertaking, so they took some shortcuts in the details, for instance, almost copying the Blue Star story background verbatim, only changing some planetary names.”
“The man’s words, I’m more inclined to view them as lines pre-designed for NPC characters.”
“Could also be interpreted as… hidden tasks?”
“Just like when Sword Without End first joined the map, those Law Enforcement Bureau agents were chasing him and they shouted, ’You damned players still dare to come here!’ At that moment, if Sword Without End had not continued to flee but instead had taken some action, perhaps he could have triggered a hidden task.”
“I think I understand why this map is called the Pioneer Map. Previous maps didn’t have NPCs, but this one has added them.”
“This is an experimental innovation by the Snow Sea Project Team, which is why it’s called the Pioneer Map.”
“The aim is to bring in Hell Players, and I can make a bold guess that future maps will probably have more and more NPCs, and there will be more Hell Players forming an opposing faction against Blue Star players.”
“This might be what the Snow Sea Project Team actually intends.”
Discover stories with empire
“Is it… really like that?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked down at the somewhat juvenile-looking comic book in their hands, the smile that had spread from excitement now fading, and pretended to shove the book carelessly back into the shelf.
Then, resting their chin in one hand while deep in thought, they said, “So, Yi, how did you reach this conclusion?”
“Quite simple.”
Chen Yi leaned on his cane with one hand and scanned the nearly empty library before speaking, “You just have to put yourself in the shoes of the Snow Sea Project Team, and you can see a lot more.”
“At first, I indeed entertained Sword Without End’s hypothesis, especially since the June version update did seem to have quite a few elements that related to this place.”
“But as I got to know more about City 13, I started to feel that something was off. If the objective of the Snow Sea Project Team were as suspected, then they should have sent another group into City 13 to eliminate the captured player.”
“That would create an information barrier.”
“Instead of allowing the same group of players to enter, making it almost too obvious what their purpose is.”
“Here, one could already start to become suspicious. With the introduction of Hell Players, the answer becomes even clearer—this map is a trial by the Snow Sea Project Team, or rather, a hidden update.”
“You know how it is, domestic online games often have a very unique tactic. They call it an ’unannounced update,’ just like what’s happening now.”
“Actually, validating this idea is very straightforward.”
“If we can take on the related hidden tasks, then my guess would be proven correct.”
“Hmm, I understand.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up with a serious expression and rasped, “So how do we take on these hidden tasks?”
“I think—”
After a pause, Chen Yi turned his head to look at Sword Without End who stood leaning against a bookcase beside him and suddenly started to smile, “You must have already received it, right?”
“My Sword Immortal?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was stunned and, though somewhat puzzled, still quietly stood behind Yi with the Claw Knife in hand, its blade pointing directly at Sword Without End.
“…”
Sword Without End stiffened suddenly, his lips twitching slightly. After a long silence and looking into Chen Yi’s unquestionable eyes, he raised his hands and sighed, saying with a bitter, resigned smile.
“Actually, I think there’s a sixty percent chance you’re bluffing me.”
“After all, for you to deduce all this is rather outrageous.”
The words fell.
A panel was shared by Sword Without End in mid-air.
’Hidden Task: Eliminate all Hell Players in City 13 (1/10)’
’Hidden Reward: Two C-grade Prop Chests.’
“Don’t look at me like that.”
Sword Without End raised his hands, somewhat embarrassed as he spoke, “This hidden task only popped up after I killed that Hell Player in the hotel. I didn’t know about it before entering the map.”
“Actually, I didn’t mean to hide it, okay, but even if I did, it would be quite normal, right?”
“I was planning to follow you out of the map and then come back in at a later time to slowly complete the hidden task.”
“After all, although it’s a bit unethical, wanting to hog the rewards all to oneself is understandable, isn’t it?”
“It’s human nature, right?”
“But now that you’ve discovered it, naturally we’ll split it— one Prop Chest each.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit crossed their arms and scoffed before speaking, “Well played.”
“To think I even felt a moment of sympathy for you outside, Yi took a risk accompanying you into this map, and now you’re actually pulling off an act of hoarding? Really makes Yi and I feel cold.”
“That’s more like it.”
Chen Yi didn’t seem to care about that detail and, with a light chuckle, nodded his head, “That’s correct, the words that man said before he died were meant to mislead us, or maybe we just started off thinking in the wrong direction.”
“When you first entered the map, the ’player’ that the Law Enforcement Bureau was roaring at shouldn’t refer to us, but to the ’Hell Players’.”
“In other words, the background story of this map suggests that Hell Players have been wreaking havoc in the 13th City this whole time.”
“To trigger this hidden mission, we probably need to first go to the Law Enforcement Bureau to try to get crucial information and their trust. Then prove we are not Hell Players so that we can track and kill Hell Players with the help of the Law Enforcement Bureau.”
“That is the standard protocol for regular players to clear this hidden mission.”
“If I’m not mistaken, your hidden mission should show the real-time coordinates of the remaining 9 Hell Players, right?”
“Mhm.”
Sword Without End, somewhat helplessly, continued with his hands raised, “You’re right about everything. The two chests are all yours, I don’t want them.”
“Although I wasn’t planning on going solo, it’s pretty embarrassing to be called out like this. Let’s not talk about it, if we keep up this conversation I won’t be able to save face.”
“If this isn’t going solo, then what is?”
Standing behind Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit sneered coldly, his face full of scorn.
“It’s just that I’m used to eating alone every day because I don’t have friends, it’s a subconscious thing.”
“Heh.”
…
What followed was much more straightforward and brutal.
Sword Without End took the lead, while Chen Yi and the others followed, slaughtering their way through on sleds.
In less than an hour’s time,
All the Hell Players in the 13th City were dealt with.
And they went straight to the Law Enforcement Bureau, killing the criminal that was held captive.
The prisoner wasn’t the player who had been captured alive by Sword Without End during his first descent into the map.
They completed the mission smoothly and exited the map.
On reflection, the challenge of this mission map lay in how to deal with the Law Enforcement Bureau and successfully complete the mission, while the key to the hidden mission was negotiating with the Law Enforcement Bureau and obtaining valid information.
Of course,
Chen Yi and the others skipped all these steps.
This means that although their method of clearing the mission might have been unorthodox, they indeed cleared it successfully, accomplishing both the set mission and the hidden mission.
…
“This is for you.”
Atop the rooftop of a building in the Garden District, Sword Without End, knowing he was at fault, awkwardly handed over the two C-rank Prop Chests awarded for the completion of the hidden mission to Chen Yi.
“This time it was indeed a bit humiliating for me, so I’m giving all the rewards to you.”
“No need.”
Chen Yi shook his head, tossed one of the Prop Chests into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s arms, then tossed the remaining Prop Chest into Sword Without End’s arms, “After all, it was your mission and you did contribute. You should take this.”
It was 6 a.m. at the time.
By now, they had nearly finished analyzing the rules for June.
As long as they sleep between 9 pm and 10 pm, the rest of the time slots were flexible and free, which was more accommodating for the night owls.
“Alright… then thank you,” Sword Without End said, somewhat awkwardly accepting the Prop Chest. He hesitated for a moment, then stepped onto his Traceless Green Peak and shot off into the distance, leaving behind a parting word.
“I’ve sent you a friend request. If you ever need my help in the future, just give me a shout.”
“Yi,” Tuberculosis Rabbit said, noticeably dissatisfied as Sword Without End walked away, “Are we just letting him go like that? We went into the map with him and he tried to hoard all the loot, shouldn’t we give him a taste of his own medicine?”
“Isn’t it pretty normal?” Chen Yi leaned tiredly against the sled, lighting a cigarette between his fingers, and spoke in a low voice, “Everyone has selfish desires, going solo is pretty normal, isn’t it?”
“It’s human nature, understandable.”
“I wouldn’t.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said sternly, his voice hoarse.
“That’s what makes you precious, Tuberculosis Rabbit,”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly froze in place. Although it felt a bit odd, he had to admit Yi’s words made sense.
And just then—
A prompt suddenly resounded in the ears of all players.
“Attention all players, the world boss is about to appear.”
“All players will be transported at 12:00 pm into one million separate boss spaces to fight and kill the boss together.”

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 112 - 111: "-10w!
chapters.content:
Chapter 112 – 111: “-10w!
“Attention all players, the World Boss is about to appear.”
“All players will be transported into a vast and huge space to attack the boss together; rankings and rewards will be based on the damage dealt.”
“The World Boss will officially appear at 12:00 PM.” Stay connected with empire
“World Boss?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit’s train of thought was interrupted by the sudden announcement ringing in his ears, and he said somewhat dumbfounded, “All players attack a single boss? And in one space?”
“Isn’t it unreasonable if this doesn’t cause a stampede?”
But soon the two looked at each other, each catching the emotions in the other’s eyes.
Better sleep on it.
Damn tired to death.
They had been going through several maps in succession without any rest.
Go home, wash up, undress, sleep.
Time flew quickly.
Until 08:00 AM.
The piercing alarm woke the soundly sleeping Chen Yi and his companion.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit turned over, grabbed a bun from the table and stuffed it into his mouth, and after a punch to force the bun into his stomach, he mumbled a few words before drifting back into slumber.
Chen Yi, lying on another bed, did the same.
Without even opening his eyes, he grabbed a bun and shoved it into his mouth, chewed it mindlessly a few times, swallowed, and then continued to sleep.
The June rule isn’t dangerous, just purely annoying.
You must eat at eight in the morning.
They were really too tired these days.
So tired that Chen Yi and his friend didn’t wake up until half-past eleven, and were still not fully awake, their minds groggy.
They barely finished washing up.
Before they could speak a few words to each other,
they heard the announcement sound again.
“The World Boss has officially arrived!”
“All players, prepare yourselves, teleportation will begin shortly!”
The next second—
With a flash of white light before their eyes, they found themselves in a massive white space upon reopening them. In this boundless, horizonless white space, numerous players stood crowded together.
Countless players jammed upon the white ground, resembling ants densely packed on a piece of paper.
At this moment, almost all the players were performing the same action in unison.
That was, holding a bun and stuffing it into their mouths.
They were all eating.
The arrival time of the World Boss just happened to be at 12:00 PM, right at mealtime.
Thus, a bizarre scene unfolded.
Push the history of Blue Star back a few million years,
and it’s possible that such a spectacle of nearly everyone on Blue Star eating buns at the same time has never occurred.
Before Chen Yi and his companion had a chance to carefully observe their surroundings,
a gigantic screen popped up in mid-air.
Large enough for every player below to see clearly.
“3 minutes until the World Boss arrives!”
“Number of surviving players (1,000,000/1,000,000).”
“World Boss name: Bull Demon King with a Giant Hammer.”
“The player who deals the most damage will advance and join other players of equal strength to attack a stronger World Boss.”
“Inside this map, damage dealt by players to other players is ineffective.”
“Damage dealt to the boss will earn corresponding points, which can be exchanged for rewards in the World Shop. Many special props, such as Enhancement Stones and Protection Talismans, have been added to the shop for this event.”
“Is this mandatory participation? Can I opt out? I’ll let someone else have the rewards.”
“This World Boss must have AOE attacks, with so many people crowded together, there’s bound to be a stampede!”
Many voices of discussion suddenly rose around them, instantly making the whole white space as noisy as a morning vegetable market!
“Enhancement Stone?”
Chen Yi, on the other hand, was more interested in the new item mentioned in the announcement. For some reason, that term seemed to trigger many shadows for him.
He vaguely remembered that in some game, he had spent a long time accumulating resources, only to finally “enhance” a +13 weapon down to +7.
Yes.
He had used up all his resources, and not only failed to reach his goal of +15, but ended up at +7.
He spent the resources, and his combat power actually decreased.
From then on, he loathed and despised the enhancement feature in browser games. But now, it seemed this feature was appearing in reality.
And then there were the words ’Protection Talisman’.
He could almost confirm it now.
After this World Boss event, the enhancement function would be introduced.
Soon there would probably be a lot of angry players who’d poured all their savings into enhancing their equipment, only to find their combat power dwindling with each attempt.
Or they may have finally enhanced their C-grade item to +12.
All confident and ready to wreak havoc.
Only to suddenly discover that the base attributes of a B-grade item were stronger than their +12 enhanced C-grade prop.
Enhancement layers couldn’t be transferred.
Then they would fall into the trap of deciding whether to continue enhancing the B-grade prop, the vicious cycle of Reincarnation.
But now was not the time to think about that. Just as Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit had finished exchanging a few thoughts, the World Boss arrived!
A Minotaur Monster, over thirty meters tall, wielding a giant hammer, descended from the sky!
And then—
Chen Yi suddenly found that the countless players around him had disappeared in an instant, leaving him alone in the vast white space.
Next to the gigantic Minotaur Monster, a huge leaderboard screen, a hundred meters long, appeared.
“Damage Leaderboard”
“1st Place: Li Deyi, damage dealt: 211.”
“Rank 2: Zhang Jiayi, damage dealt 192.”
“Rank 3: …”
And there were countless players continuously joining the ranks, with the numbers on the damage leaderboard constantly changing.
At this moment, the chat box also popped up with Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dialogue.
“Yi, suddenly I’m the only one here, what’s happening on your end?”
“Same here, be careful.”
Chen Yi quickly figured out the situation, it seemed to be a measure to prevent a stampede accident; although the million players were attacking the same boss, they had been separated into a million different spaces.
He easily accepted this reality.
After all, when playing games in the past, such occurrences were common—the servers couldn’t bear such large pressure, so they would take this measure to let all players attack the world boss together.
He took a deep breath, pulled out a sniper rifle from his embrace, and began sizing up the huge boss in front of him.
A full thirty meters high.
What concept is that?
It’s the height of a ten-story building.
Can you imagine a monstrous creature the size of a ten-story building, wielding a hammer as tall as itself, standing before you?
Most people really wouldn’t have the courage to attack it.
And at that moment—
A huge red circle suddenly appeared beneath his feet, and at the same time, four huge red numbers emerged in the air surrounding him.
East: 288 meters.
West: 291 meters.
North: 1232 meters.
South: 78 meters.
And there was also a flashing countdown in the air.
“23, 22, 21…”
Thanks to his past gaming experience, Chen Yi almost instantly deduced what this huge red circle meant—the world boss’s attack would fall when the countdown ended.
This red circle was the attack range.
And the numbers in the air towards the four directions were the distances to escape from the red circle in different directions.
Normal players would, of course, choose the south side, the 78 meters distance.
To run 78 meters in 20 seconds was, frankly, a bit of a strain for many people, especially when they couldn’t make the right judgment promptly.
You have to remember, among these people are the elderly, the seriously ill, and so on.
Without the slightest hesitation, Chen Yi immediately drove the snow sled out of the range of the red circle and at the same time aimed his sniper rifle at the huge world boss in front of him.
“Bang!”
The gunshot sounded!
A huge damage number appeared above the head of the world boss!
“-100k!”
A shot, 100k health!
He instantly took the top spot on the damage leaderboard, and the previous first place had only dealt less than 5,000 damage!
This sniper rifle usually put him in an awkward position!
For example, if he wanted to kill other players, it was too hard to do with a gun—30 plus shots were needed to kill someone.
He could even only use it as a spear!
But when it came to boss fights, this weapon was incredibly strong.
The concept of dealing fixed 3% of the Maximum Health Value as true damage—the higher the boss’s health, the higher his damage, ignoring defense!
In other words, this creature had a whopping 3.3 million health.
And at this moment—
The countdown above the light circle finally reached zero!
You could only see the huge Minotaur Monster bellowing and lifting its massive hammer high into the sky, then smashing it down towards the ground—the area of attack being precisely where the red circle covered before!
Without further delay, Chen Yi sat on the snow sled, positioned the sniper barrel on the Bull Demon King’s skull, and pulled the trigger again.
“-100k!”
At this stage, the boss had no ability to attack him.
With the speed of the snow sled, it was simply impossible for the boss to hit him.
For other players, even with only a few dozen meters distance, they would have to run on their own feet, but he could simply sit on the sled, which was quite convenient.
With the sniper rifle’s damage, it was just a matter of pulling the trigger a few more times to take down the boss.
Though a bullet cost 100 Points.
But he wasn’t short on Points right now.
…
“Damn it!”
A young man looked back at the huge hammer crashing down behind him, his heart couldn’t help but skip a beat—he wasn’t hit, but it was still frightening to have a hammer the size of a small building graze the top of his head!
The man didn’t have time to think any further; instead, he worked hard to maintain a certain distance from the boss, his hands holding a constantly glowing longbow. He took a deep breath before shouting.
“Piercing Arrow!”
A red light arrow slowly materialized in the middle of the longbow, and as the man released his fingers, the red light arrow shot out towards the boss with a speed beyond the naked eye’s capture!
“-19282!”
A massive blood-red number appeared on the boss’s head, almost instantly taking the second spot on the damage leaderboard!
Seeing the huge damage number,
The young man’s self-satisfied smile slowly curved upward, but then he felt a bit annoyed. This skill was inherent to the prop and had a 24-hour cooldown after one use.
To use this skill again, he had to wait until tomorrow.
Although it dealt high damage, it could only be used once.
There was no chance to use it a second time during the world boss fight.
This was already the highest damage he could deal. He just wondered how that person… managed to inflict up to 200k damage within just a few minutes?
The man looked at Chen Yi, who was ranked first in the player damage leaderboard, and shook his head helplessly.
The gap was too wide.
Unreachable.
If he could have unlimited cooldowns, he might be confident to chase after, but unfortunately… he didn’t.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 113 - 112: "I poke, I poke, I poke!" (Bonus update for 2000 monthly votes!)
chapters.content:
Chapter 113 – 112: “I poke, I poke, I poke!” (Bonus update for 2000 monthly votes!)
However, it seemed as though the screen before him responded to his inner thoughts.
A light screen panel suddenly popped up.
“Buff available for purchase.”
“Reset the cooldown time of a prop or skill, price 1000 Points.”
“A shield that can block one attack from the boss, price 500 Points.”
“Leave the boss space, price 10 Points.”
So far, there were only these three purchase options.
The cheapest one was only 10 Points, which allowed one to leave the boss space; it was relatively friendly for those physically impaired.
At least it wasn’t a surefire death sentence.
But if, by any chance, the balance was less than 10 Points, or if one couldn’t survive the first strike, then it might be of no use at all.
1000 Points, huh.
The young man hesitated slightly. He did have 1000 Points in his account, but that price seemed too exorbitant. Although the world boss event allowed damage dealt to be converted into corresponding points…
No one was clear whether the points exchanged with these 1000 Points would be worth the cost.
Chances were it probably wouldn’t be enough.
After some thought, the young man reluctantly shook his head to give up and once again raised his long bow, condensing an ordinary white light arrow in the middle of it.
As the young man released his fingers.
A damage number appeared above the boss’s head.
“-329!”
The damage plummeted, nothing when compared to the nearly 20k damage from before!
But it wasn’t on cooldown and could be used continuously.
…
“I poke, I poke, I poke!”
Han Yu excitedly wielded a small dagger, squeezing beneath the Bull Demon King’s crotch, aiming for the giant boss’s little toe, and repeatedly stabbing it with his dagger!
The speed was extremely fast!
His arms were even waving afterimages in the air!
His dagger had a special effect: it could stack bleeding damage!
Each attack might not inflict high damage, but it could stack a continuous bleeding effect on the adversary, and this effect could be stacked indefinitely!
In other words, what he needed wasn’t the strength of his attacks, but rather the speed and frequency!
Having stacked less than 100 layers of bleeding effect, he was already first on the damage leaderboard, leading by a substantial margin with 47k damage!
This was his first time feeling the thrill of being at the top of the ranks—fantastic!
Even more exhilarating was that he wasn’t allocated to the same boss space as Chen Yi!
Without that towering figure above him, he suddenly felt the air was a bit sweeter!
Now with positive feedback, Han Yu waved his dagger even faster. He had specifically purchased an expensive skill that allowed him to swing his dagger more swiftly.
Combined with his prop, the effect was simply too powerful to describe.
As for the buff shop that popped up, he just glanced at it and then ignored it.
A cooldown reset?
Useless to him, what he needed wasn’t a cooldown reset but a faster attack speed.
A shield that can block one boss attack?
Even more useless, he could completely dodge those attacks.
And leaving the boss space was utterly pointless for him. How could he leave when he had finally become top rank?
As he continued to rapidly stab with the dagger in his hands, the gap between him and second place on the leaderboard also grew larger and larger!
Damage numbers never ceased to emerge above the world boss’s head, densely popping up.
“-42!”
“-892!”
“-35!”
“-923!”
Two-digit damage from his dagger stabs, while the four-digit numbers were from the bleeding damage.
Initially, the bleeding damage wasn’t so high, but with the stacking of the bleeding layers, the numbers rose higher and higher.
…
“Ugh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit squatted on the toe of the gigantic Bull Demon King, dangling a cigarette and idly passing the time.
“Speaking of which, I wonder if other players have noticed that the boss’s attack range is always by its side; if you just stay under the boss’s crotch, you won’t get hit by its attacks.”
“They must have realized it by now since it’s not a particularly hard mechanic to notice.”
Bored, he casually drew his Claw Knife across the boss’s toenail.
“-67!”
“So low.”
He couldn’t help but roll his eyes—only 67 points of damage. It would be a laughing stock if word got out!
Actually, he really wanted to try and see how much damage his Claw Knife’s charged attack could do.
In those ten days on the wilderness map, aside from building houses, he hadn’t stopped charging it, so his Claw Knife’s charge was even higher than last time.
But he held back, not unleashing the strike.
After all, if that strike accidentally stole Yi’s top rank, it wouldn’t be good; only the highest damage dealer in each boss space could advance.
If he advanced without that strike, he wouldn’t be able to deal any significant damage.
That would be a waste.
He’d rather let Yi safely advance.
Of course… it might also be possible that he was being presumptuous, and that one strike wouldn’t be enough to overtake Yi, but it still felt like a waste.
Better to skive off here.
He was ready to cheer for Yi’s rampage.
…
“One shot, two shots, three shots!”
Jiaye, dressed in a tight t-shirt and denim shorts, aimed his handgun at the boss and shot earnestly.
Every shot could inflict a decent amount of damage.
“-348!”
“-421!”
She had just obtained a prop, a golden Desert Eagle that had no recoil, which even she could wield perfectly.
Now it had just turned pinkish-white.
She had spent a certain amount of Points to buy a dazzling skin for the prop, transforming its somewhat tacky golden hue into a cheeky and cute pinkish-white.
It suited her better.
Even though it looked cuter, its damage had not decreased.
Unlimited bullets, the bullets didn’t require Points to use, but they did need time to create.
In a minute, she could produce one bullet, sixty in an hour, with permanent storage.
In the past two days, she had accumulated nearly 2000 bullets, which was enough for world boss use.
As for the firing rate, it depended on how fast she pulled the trigger; theoretically, if she pulled it quickly enough, she could even achieve a Gatling effect.
Of course, that was just a theory.
At least she didn’t have that fast of a firing rate, and the speed of bullet accumulation wasn’t very fast. Though each bullet didn’t require Points, they also couldn’t reach the point where, as long as she had enough Points, she would have infinite bullets.
Once the bullets ran out, there was nothing to do but stare blankly.
Even with such frequent high damage, she only ranked seventeenth on the damage leaderboard.
The top spot was a stranger’s name.
“Wang Yimei.”
She had never heard of him, but he was strong; his damage was three times hers.
Just then, a red circle suddenly emerged beneath her feet.
Her expression became serious, and she scanned her surroundings before sprinting rapidly in one direction.
Although the white suspender dress looked good.
During combat, short sleeves and jeans were more convenient.
…
“Huff!”
With the title “King Malphite” above his head, Tie Chui looked up at the giant boss towering thirty meters tall before him, then took a deep breath and instantly activated King Malphite’s ability.
As King Malphite, he had three chances each month to gather the intelligence of the other 99 players onto himself, or to distribute his own intelligence among the 99 players, in exchange for high defense and damage capabilities.
He chose to distribute his own intelligence among the other 99 players!
It was almost instant.
The only clarity in his eyes instantly faded, and he stared somewhat vacantly at the giant boss’s toes in front of him.
And the ability of that skill was.
The lower the intelligence, the stronger the attack.
When combined, it was comparable to one plus one being greater than two.
“Roar.”
Suddenly, Tie Chui roared and raised his fist, aiming it forcefully at the boss’s toes!
“-3293!”
The terrifying number popped up above the boss’s head!
Immediately after, Tie Chui’s arms, as if fitted with electric motors, pounded tirelessly and furiously at the boss’s toes.
One punch, another punch, and yet another punch.
“-4281!”
“-3912!”
Each punch dealt three to four thousand in damage!
One could imagine that if these punches hit an ordinary player, they’d easily turn each one into a Little Carla with no problems!
Such frequent massive damage quickly put Tie Chui at the top of the leaderboard!
…
“Bang!”
Chen Yi fired the last shot with a calm expression!
“-123818!”
A 5% threshold execution attack!
And by this time, the boss’s health bar was less than 5%.
Right after, the giant boss suddenly stiffened, then collapsed heavily onto the ground with no strength left!
As the boss died.
The surroundings once again became lively.
The players who had vanished before appeared around her again, and the enormous noise of discussion erupted like a marketplace.
Many people talked while casting glances in Chen Yi’s direction.
The distance was a bit far, so they couldn’t see Chen Yi.
But that didn’t stop them from seeing the dozen or so titles in the air, noticeable even in a crowd of nearly a million players, where tens of thousands could clearly make out the titles among the crowd.
They stood out like lighthouses.
Meanwhile, countless system notifications sounded in his ears repeatedly!
“Ding, you have inflicted a total of 21.24 million damage, successfully topping the damage chart, and you have been promoted!”
“After the other boss spaces have finished their battles, you will proceed to a higher-level boss space to join other players in attacking a higher-level world boss!”
“Ding, you have inflicted a total of 21.24 million damage, which has been converted into 21.2 thousand Points.”
Experience exclusive tales on empire
“After the world boss event ends, players can use Points to buy related props in the exclusive world boss store.”
“Ding, the boss space you are in is the first to kill the world boss, please wait patiently for other boss spaces to finish their battles.”
“Ding, as you landed the final kill on the world boss, you receive an additional bonus of 5000 Points!”
Following that was a system announcement that could be heard by all players in the boss space.
“Ding, congratulations to everyone for successfully killing the world boss, the Bull Demon King. The top ten players who inflicted the highest damage are: Chen Yi, Li Zide, Hao Shengqi, You Chaosheng, Wang Zhongbang, …”
“The player promoted from this space is: Chen Yi!”
“The other players will enter spectator mode when the higher-level boss space opens.”
“And have the right to interact from the sidelines.”

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 114 - 113: "King of the Grass!
chapters.content:
Chapter 114 – 113: “King of the Grass!
“Tuberculosis Rabbit, let’s go to a KTV and sing for a bit after we finish with the world boss,” Yancheng suggested.
“Ah, sure, no problem,” Tuberculosis Rabbit replied.
Amusement tinged Tuberculosis Rabbit’s expression as he gently urged the envious crowd around him with modest hand gestures, signaling them not to be too surprised—it was no big deal. Instinctively, he gave a noncommittal response.
Suddenly, it dawned on him that something was amiss. He turned to Yi, his bewilderment clear as he asked, “Yi? What are you talking about?”
“Go to a KTV to sing?”
“Don’t you see where we are right now? We are in the middle of fighting a world boss, and it’s almost your turn to take the stage. How could you suddenly think of going to sing?”
“Isn’t your train of thought jumping a bit too fast?”
“Felt like singing.”
Chen Yi stood calmly, leaning on his staff with an inscrutable expression, like a pine tree standing upright among the crowd.
“Oh, okay then,” Tuberculosis Rabbit finally said, stroking his nose contemplatively before dropping the subject.
He had known Yi for a very long time.
Without any exaggeration, no one knew Yi better than he did. Whenever Yi’s thoughts were in disarray, he liked to drag Tuberculosis Rabbit along to the KTV.
Then they would find seven or eight princesses.
But Yi neither sang songs nor frolicked with the princesses.
He would just sit on the sofa and quietly light a cigarette, leaning against the chair back, listening to the deafening music in the private room while drinking juice.
According to Yi, when ambient noise is loud, the brain subconsciously drifts into a state of emptiness, achieving a sense of tranquility.
Then, he would become the life of the party.
He was responsible for playing with the princesses and singing songs, keeping the atmosphere lively.
Yi must feel tired too, sometimes.
After all, Yi was in charge of decision-making, while he executed those decisions.
Which role came with more pressure was hard to say, but he felt it was probably Yi who was more worn out.
But where could they find a KTV now? If any KTVs were even open. Just recently, the owner of some KTV in Yancheng had approached them, but they had wiped them out.
Thinking about it now, it seemed a bit regrettable. They should’ve left it there.
He wasn’t sure if there were still any KTVs open in Yancheng. Princesses, undoubtedly, would be hard to find now.
Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged and didn’t dwell on it any longer but continued to greet the people around him with a beaming smile and nodding acknowledgment.
Less than an hour had passed.
A notification sound rang in the ears of all the players.
“Ding! All world bosses in the boss spaces have been slain. All advancing players will proceed to the Second Layer World Boss Space.”
“Players who remain in the First Layer Boss Space will retain the rights to spectate and interact.”
“Players who have left the Boss Space will lose the rights to spectate.”
“The Second Layer World Boss Space features 27 zones, each accommodating 100 advancing players.”
“The top three damage dealers in the rankings of each Second Layer World Boss Space will advance to join 81 players in the Third Layer World Boss Space, facing off against the ultimate world boss!”
“Players who successfully clear the Second Layer World Boss Space will each receive a World Boss Gift Pack (Small) *1, 5000 Points, Level 1 Enhancement Stone *10, and a Protection Talisman *1.”
“Additionally, players will be awarded points corresponding to the damage they inflict, which can be spent in the World Boss Points Store after the event.”
“Players are now invited to take their places.”
Before Chen Yi could react, a flash of white light burst before his eyes and a sudden sensation of weightlessness made his feet feel unsteady. When his vision returned, he found himself already in the Second Layer World Boss Space. Discover more stories at empire
There were significantly fewer people around.
About only a hundred or so.
Unlike the players in the First Layer, who were loosely crowded together, players here stood with space between them. Interestingly, almost every player here had two or more titles floating above their head.
Many of these titles were unfamiliar to Chen Yi.
Like the title above one nearby player’s head.
“Heaven-Shattering Fist!”
The title itself sounded awesome, though it seemed to give away one’s fighting style—certainly belonging to a player proficient in hand-to-hand combat.
Then there were the two interesting titles above another man’s head further afield.
“King of the Grass!”
“Back-Stabber, Hehe!”
At first glance, this one seemed like a scheming lowlife who never confronted enemies head-on—always lurking in brush or hiding around corners. Dealing with someone like this meant you could never turn your back on them—it was too dangerous.
But the most eye-catching were undoubtedly the consecutive titles gleaming above Chen Yi’s own head.
There was not much time left for the players to interact with one another.
A voice echoed in the ears of all players present.
“The boss of the Second Layer World Boss Space is: Enchanting Demon Warrior Princess.”
“The boss will descend in three minutes—please prepare yourselves.”
“Is that Chen Yi?”
“It seems so, did we end up in the same space as him?”
“I have to say, having more than a dozen titles over your head does look a bit flashy, haha.”
Many whispers arose from the crowd, and it was clear that everyone had noticed the man with over a dozen titles above his head, even though players could not see each other’s names.
But people still easily recognized him.
’What a show-off, trying too hard every single day.’
“`
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi, who had been standing calmly and waiting patiently, suddenly heard cursing nearby. He raised an eyebrow and turned his head to see a young man dressed in a tracksuit standing there.
Seeing Chen Yi look over,
a look of admiration immediately appeared on his face, and with eyes full of respect, he said, “Yi, nice to see you.”
“Hmm, hey.”
Chen Yi’s gaze lingered on the young man for a moment before he suddenly smiled and fell silent.
He had a prop.
It allowed him to hear the inner curses of people around him when they were secretly cursing him.
The young man had just been cursing him in his heart.
Quite a good acting performance.
“Yi, my name is Wang Yimei, you can call me Little Wang or Mei.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded noncommittally and said nothing more, feeling a bit too lazy to deal with this two-faced person.
Seeing that Chen Yi wasn’t paying him any attention, Wang Yimei awkwardly forced a smile, then turned away and continued to pace in place, waiting for the World Boss to arrive.
’Really putting on airs, fuck your mother’s fucking act.’
“…”
Chen Yi sighed, the passive skill of this prop could be quite annoying at times.
…
Meanwhile, as Chen Yi and the others entered the Second Layer World Boss Space,
a system alert that only players in the First Layer World Boss Space could hear rang out again.
“The Second Layer World Boss will descend in 3 minutes!”
“Players from the First Layer World Boss Space will have the rights to spectate and the following interaction privileges!”
“1: Players can send bullet-screen comments directed to a specific boss space while spectating and can converse during the battle. These comments will only be visible to spectating players.”
“2: Players can send colored banner bullet-screen comments directed to a specific boss space while spectating. These comments will be visible to both spectating players and players in the Second Layer World Boss Space. Sending one costs 50 Points.”
Three minutes passed in the blink of an eye!
And the boss descended!
Chen Yi was in the number 18 Second Layer boss space.
A huge blue circle suddenly appeared in the air, and a Succubus dressed in a black bodysuit slowly descended from the circle, hovering in the air, black miasma swirling around her and a malevolent gaze sweeping over the surrounding players.
It was a female Succubus.
Her beauty was breathtaking,
the kind that makes one’s physical desires outweigh the urge to fight at first glance.
Only… she was extremely huge.
So large that one could only look up at her. If you stood close enough, you wouldn’t even be able to see her face when looking up, just two mountainous peaks.
This Succubus was over thirty meters tall, towering like a giant, looking down upon the players below.
Her chest boasted two alarmingly wide and prominent features, each several meters in diameter, which created a rather intimidating sight.
Her double ponytails fluttered in the wind behind her head.
The whole sight was somewhat discordant, as seeing double ponytails on a Succubus could inevitably feel somewhat indecent.
Before the players could even react,
the Succubus launched her attack, grabbing the two ponytails from behind her head and, like two black whips, she slammed them heavily into the group of players!
“Smack!”
The sound of impact was immediate!
With just one strike,
three players who were too slow to evade and had not yet reacted were immediately flattened on the spot.
Their bodies were nowhere to be found, only an indistinct pool of blood and flesh, like a crushed strawberry cake beneath a boot.
“Damn it!”
Many players, their faces filled with rage, rapidly retreated to the sides and shouted frantically, “This boss doesn’t have attack warnings!!! Everyone, be careful to dodge!!”
Clearly, this boss was more difficult than the First Layer World Boss!
Just the first strike had already resulted in the deaths of 3 players!
And these weren’t ordinary players; those who had advanced from the First Layer World Boss Space were among the cream of the crop in a million, put simply, some of the strongest people in the world.
In their respective cities, they were privileged individuals who stood at the very top.
Yet, even such figures were swatted down as easily as flies.
And the crowd also realized the difference between the Second Layer World Boss and the First Layer World Boss.
The First Layer World Boss’s attacks came with damage warning circles, a red circle would indicate where the boss would attack next, giving you enough time to escape the red zone beforehand.
If you weren’t in the circle, the boss couldn’t possibly hit you.
However, the Second Layer World Boss didn’t have this advantage, attacking randomly without any pattern. You had no idea what the boss’s next attack would be or its range!
You could only rely on prediction and extreme reflexes!
Inside World Boss Space number 18.
Many players who had previously been lighthearted and smiling now turned serious, their eyes firmly fixed on the boss, every move it made. It was clear to everyone that,
If they didn’t get serious,
they would die here.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 115 - 114: He, Zhong Kui, Specializes in Defeating Female Bosses!
chapters.content:
Chapter 115 – 114: He, Zhong Kui, Specializes in Defeating Female Bosses!
Chen Yi had no particular opinion on this matter.
After all, his sled was very fast, and his sniper rifle had a very long attack range. He had already flown hundreds of meters into the sky, far from the boss. At this distance, the boss’s limb attacks would certainly not be able to touch him.
He was pondering one thing.
Whether to take out this boss instantly.
With the existence of the Septagon Badge, all he needed to do to instantly kill the boss in front of him was to pull the trigger.
But then he shook his head and dismissed the idea.
The charging conditions for the Septagon Badge were quite difficult, requiring 10,000 statements of discussion about him. There were only 100 players in total here, and it was not certain that everyone would verbalize their opinions about him.
It would be difficult to have it fully charged again when entering the third layer World Boss space.
If killing the second layer World Boss would lead back to the first layer space, with the number of players in the first layer space, it should be easy to fully charge it up again, but that was uncertain.
No one knew whether after killing the second layer World Boss, they would return to the first layer space or stay in the second layer space.
So, the best choice would be to save the Septagon Badge to kill the third layer World Boss.
As for the second layer.
The sniper rifle was sufficient.
Each shot dealt real damage worth 3% of the boss’s maximum health value, which was more than enough.
He aimed at the huge humanoid boss not far away and gently pulled the trigger!
A bullet with a blinding white tail flame shot straight towards the succubus’s abdomen!
“-3w!”
Immediately after, a slightly terrifying damage number popped up above the boss’s head!
“Only 3w?”
Chen Yi frowned in confusion. Did that mean the second layer World Boss’s life value was even lower than the first layer World Boss’s?
But he quickly came to a realization.
The life value was indeed lower, but the attack had significantly increased.
And it might also take into account that there were only 100 people in the second layer World Boss space, compared to the whopping one million in the first layer World Boss space!
…
“Hey! It’s actually a female succubus!”
Inside boss space number 18!
A muscular man in a tank top looked excitedly at a skill equipped on his personal panel!
「Skill Name」: Premeditated Blast Punch.
「Skill Level」: D grade.
「Skill Effect」: Upon activation, for the next ten seconds, your punching speed will be extremely fast, and your damage will significantly increase. If your target is female, the damage dealt will triple!
「Skill Limitation」: After use, it enters a 24-hour cooldown.
「Skill Introduction」: “Punch, young man!”
That wasn’t all; he also had a special title.
「Title Name」: Heaven-Shattering Fist!
「Title Level」: Blue.
「Title Effect」: Upon activating this title effect, you will triple all damage dealt to females in the next 30 seconds!
「Title Restriction」: After use, it enters a 24-hour cooldown.
「Obtaining Method」: Become the Arena Overlord in the ’Fist Overlord’ map!
“Hey!”
The man took a deep breath, his expression full of excitement, then looked up at the huge succubus lying on the ground in front of him and chose to activate the skill, along with the title effect.
He raised his fist, as large as a cantaloupe, and with a ferocious and excited expression, he hammered down on the succubus’s toes!
“Feel the power of this punch!”
As the words fell.
“-4820!”
A fearsome damage number popped up above the boss’s head!
And that wasn’t the end of it!
His back suddenly split open, and two thicker and bluer arms stretched out, striking at the toes of the succubus in front of him!
All four arms clenched into fists, hammering down on the toes like a violent storm!
The speed of the punches was so fast they almost left behind afterimages!
For a moment, other players around were shocked, staring blankly at the War God with four arms!
One terrifying damage number after another popped up above the boss’s head!
“-4920!”
“-4720!”
“-3902!”
Each punch caused nearly 5000 points of damage!
In ten seconds, he threw about thirty punches!
This amounted to a terrifyingly nearly 14w damage!
He went straight to the top of the ’Player Damage Rankings,’ securing the second place!
The first place was Chen Yi.
With a damage value of 15w, he dominated everyone like a mountain!
And just then.
The pace of the man’s punches visibly slowed down.
The damage dealt decreased significantly too.
“-1573!”
“-1428!”
“-1618!”
Although the damage was still not low, it was no longer as terrifying as the beginning, and the speed of the punches had also slowed down a lot.
But even so, it was still enough to draw attention!
The barrage in space number 18 began to flood the screen!
“What kind of demon is this? If that damn punch lands on me, would it leave my body intact?”
“Probably turn into a bloody mist, an intact body is definitely out of the question.”
“This big bro’s name is Zhong Kui; he’s from our Ergou City. In the ’Extraterrestrial Invader’ event, he punched an Insect Race Matriarch to death with one punch, freaking awesome!”
“Zhong Kui is the man!”
“No way, didn’t you guys notice that Chen Yi’s damage is even higher? What’s up with his sniper rifle? Each bullet deals 3w damage? And it looks like there’s no cooldown? What level is that prop, isn’t that a bit too buggy?”
“Chen Yi, him taking first place is pretty normal, right? I’m already used to it, haven’t you?”
“Chen Yi is from our Yancheng. The sniper rifle in his hands has a percentage-based true damage; the more life the boss has, the higher the damage. As for the cooldown, I’m not exactly sure.”
“I know Chen Yi, he’s my neighbor, lives just downstairs from me.”
“I know him too; I used to work with Chen Yi at the same company.”
“I’ve shown Chen Yi the way before.”
The comments kept rolling on the barrage, as the spectators shared their opinions, and the number of players gathered in space number 18 was the highest.
After all, Chen Yi was in this space.
Most players wanted to see what sort of power this player, who frequently made global appearances, possessed.
“Huff.”
Zhong Kui, the muscular man, let out a slight sigh of exhaustion when he saw his damage had dropped to around 500, and knew that the effects of his title and skill had passed.
He then noticed the other players staring at him with shock.
His mouth curved upwards uncontrollably, and he raised his fist and laughed with a grin.
“I, Zhong Kui, specialize in hitting women!”
“Might not be so good against men, but when it comes to women, I’m a master!”
He was very satisfied with these two skills; he had always believed that specializing in one thing yields the best results!
Just like these two skills, they can only deal multiple times damage when attacking female characters, with no damage boost when attacking males. It may seem underwhelming, but he can choose maps with female bosses, right?
Like the Insect Race Matriarch, or the Succubus right in front of him!
The idea of a skill effect boosting damage threefold, coupled with a title effect that boosts damage another three times, is astounding!
A regular punch of his could deal 500 damage; that’s the damage a normal-force punch could inflict on a Succubus.
Boosted threefold by skill effect, it’s now 1500 damage!
Then tripled again by the title effect to about 4500 damage!
Compared to the initial damage value, it’s a staggering nine times more damage!
Moreover, any further damage multipliers will start calculating from that 4500 damage base!
If he had another skill that could triple the damage, each of his punches could deal nearly 2w terrifying damage to the Succubus!
That’s his potential!
So, he’s been collecting skills that can increase his damage against females, aiming to fill all 8 skill slots with skills boosting damage against females!
With so many damage multipliers stacked!
He might even be able to kill some future female bosses with one punch!
Such skills are rare, though, and despite looking for a long time, he’s only managed to get these two so far!
This is the path he’s chosen!
He believes that in the future, he can become someone who makes all female bosses in every map tremble at the mere mention of his name!
He does not aspire to kill all bosses with one punch, just the female ones will do.
Specialization beats the mainstream!
In these times, it’s the specialists who are in demand!
He, Zhong Kui, specializes in taking down female bosses!
…
“Not bad in terms of damage,” Chen Yi commented as he glanced at the muscular man with the ’Heaven-Shattering Fist’ title and pulled the trigger again nonchalantly, with another terrifying damage figure exploding above the boss’s head.
“-3w!”
Compared to the man’s hard-punching attacks!
His own seemed much simpler and straightforward.
All that was needed was to pull the trigger.
No need to even aim; such a big thing standing there, even someone who’s never handled a gun couldn’t miss.
Even a blind person could use sound to locate and know where to aim the gun.
“Yi, go for it!!!”
Just then—
A colorful barrage banner suddenly appeared above the whole of space number 18.
Chen Yi glanced at the banner and felt slightly speechless; that barrage was sent by the Tuberculosis Rabbit, wondering if it cost any Points.
He didn’t pay it any more attention but pulled the trigger again.
“-3w!”
Simple and steady in damage.
No flashy special effects, no complex attacking motions, only aiming, pulling the trigger, and firing bullets.
One shot, another, and yet another! Find your next read on empire
Just then—
Not far away, the huge Succubus boss suddenly stood up straight, then its clothing began to drop to the ground, one after another, transforming into numerous two-meter-tall mini Succubus minions wielding forks and knives, attacking the players!
It was summoning underlings, starting a group AoE attack.
But it was already too late!
Before the mini Succubi had even landed a few attacks on the players,
“Bang!”
Chen Yi, with a calm expression, looked at the boss’s health bar that was under 5%, and pulled the trigger once more.
“-41293!”
“Ding, congratulations to space number 18 for being the first to kill the Second Layer World Boss, with the top three players dealing the most damage being: Chen Yi, Zhong Kui, Wang Yimei, and the player who landed the killing blow is Chen Yi.”

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 116 - 115: "You’re thinking too small.
chapters.content:
Chapter 116 – 115: “You’re thinking too small.
“`
“All surviving players in World Boss Space 18 will receive the following rewards: World Boss Gift Pack (Small)*1, as well as 5000 Points, Level 1 Enhancement Stone*10, Protection Talisman*1.”
“Chen Yi, Zhong Kui, and Wang Yimei, the three players, will stay in the Second Layer World Boss Space, waiting for other players to proceed to the Third Layer World Boss Space to confront the final boss!”
“The other players will return to the first layer to begin spectating.”
The first notification rang in the ears of all players.
Whereas the following notifications were heard only by the players in World Boss Space 18.
Chen Yi swept a glance around him, only to see the brawny man with the title “Heaven-Shattering Fist” above his head, and that young man with the not-so-convincing acting skills still there.
The rest of the players had been sent back to the first layer.
And they three were left in the second layer, waiting for the battles of other second layer spaces to end.
Seeing this.
Chen Yi let out a sigh of relief; luckily, he had thought carefully and hadn’t used his Septagon Badge on the second layer, or else relying on these two to finish charging his badge would have been a pipe dream.
“Yi.”
The young man named Wang Yimei looked towards Chen Yi with a smile that was anything but smooth, looking quite ridiculous.
This time, Chen Yi didn’t even bother to nod his head, completely ignoring the man. People like him should be dealt with when there’s a gap in one’s schedule—otherwise they keep bothering you and it’s really annoying.
Sure enough.
In the next second, he heard Wang Yimei cursing him internally.
’Utter fool of a dog, if it weren’t for the rule that players can’t attack each other within World Boss Space, I’d be the first to kill you!’
’What’s so great about having a sniper rifle that can deal percentage damage? Who do you think you are?’
’I give you face and call you Yi, but without that, what are you?’
’If it were a real fight with live ammunition on the outside, could your percentage damage sniper rifle really kill me?’
“…”
After being silent for a while, Chen Yi opened his eyes for the first time and looked at the young man: “Which city are you in?”
“Ah?”
Caught off guard by Chen Yi’s sudden question, Wang Yimei hesitated for a moment before answering respectfully and ingratiatingly, “Black Trench City.”
“Hmm, got it.”
Chen Yi silently memorized the name of the city and the man’s name; it looked like he’d have to take a stroll later on—this was something to do after singing at the KTV.
After singing, he’d have a heart-to-heart talk about life with this Wang Yimei.
Seeing that Chen Yi had stopped talking after that one question, Wang Yimei felt embarrassed and turned to the side to look at Zhong Kui: “Big bro, which city are you from?”
“Hehe.”
Zhong Kui chuckled a few times without saying anything but cursed internally, ’You idiot, what are you doing, coming over here to check household registrations?’
Seeing that Zhong Kui also ignored him.
Feeling humiliated, Wang Yimei’s eyes flickered with a sullen shade but said nothing. Who knew how many players outside were watching them? Being ignored by these two made him lose face!
But it wasn’t a good idea to erupt in anger.
He could only suppress this incident and wait for his chance to get back at them in the future.
However, at this moment—
“Ding, all players in World Boss Space 6 have been annihilated.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi’s drooping eyelids suddenly lifted as he squinted at the prompt that popped up, his eyebrows furrowing without a word. All players in Space 6 were annihilated?
How could that be!
None of the players who had made it to the second layer were weak!
And the Second Layer World Boss was only attacking without warning; how could they all be annihilated if they had been careful?
All the players in the second layer were already among the top players in the world. To be wiped out just like that, many cities would feel the pain.
The loss of such top-tier powers could be a huge blow to a city!
Just like if he were to suddenly die.
It would be a tremendous blow to Yancheng.
Top-tier powers sometimes also represent a kind of faith. If Chen Yi were to die, then all the players in Yancheng would start feeling anxious. If even Chen Yi was dead, how much longer could they survive?
What Chen Yi didn’t know was that, at this moment, the bullet screens in other spaces had already begun to run wild!
’Are you kidding me, isn’t the attack of this Second Layer Space boss a bit too insane? Those Lesser Charm Demons that split off can even grow? They’ve reached the same size as the boss in just a few minutes?’
’This is like simultaneously facing hundreds of bosses!’
’They should have ignored the boss and killed all those Lesser Charm Demons right away!’
