’That’s easy to say, but no one knew this beforehand, and there’s not much reward for killing Lesser Charm Demons, nor do their damages count toward the leaderboard. Who would pay attention to those demons at first? Who would have known they could grow? By the time they realized, it was too late!’
And then—
Colorful bullet screen banners started drifting across the sky in the other boss spaces!
’Kill the Lesser Charm Demons first, they can rapidly grow into Greater Charm Demons within minutes!’
’Quickly, forget the boss for now, kill the small ones first!’
’Space 6 was annihilated because of those Lesser Charm Demons!’
“`
Countless colorful bullet comments streamed continuously across the skies of the other boss spaces!
The reason Space No. 6 suffered a total defeat was that the players in this space fought the boss too quickly!
This skill would only trigger when the boss’s health dropped below 30%, and the players in Space No. 6 quickly reduced the boss’s health to 30%, triggering the skill!
The power of this skill was evident to many players!
Meanwhile, in the other boss spaces, the fastest progress was at 38%; the boss hadn’t reached the health threshold to trigger the skill, giving the other players the chance to warn them.
To avoid more tragedies from happening.
As for Chen Yi’s Space No. 18…
It was super fast.
When the boss triggered the skill at the 30% health line, the children had only just been born, but Chen Yi had already reduced its health to less than 5%, leaving no chance for the boss to show off its skills before being finished off with a single shot!
It’s fair to say that the boss in Space No. 18 didn’t get to show its true power at all!
When its health dropped below 80% and it could finally unleash its first ultimate move, its health was quickly reduced to 60%.
Consequently, the World Boss in Space No. 18 had to forcibly interrupt its first ultimate move to start releasing its second one, but just as it assumed the charging stance, its health dropped to 40%, time for the third ultimate move.
So the second ultimate move was forcibly interrupted as well.
The third ultimate move barely started before it was time to release the finishing ultimate move.
And by the time the finishing ultimate move had begun, the boss was dead.
Therefore…
Unlike the other World Boss spaces, where the Succubus bosses were unleashing a dazzling array of skills and moves that kept the spectating players on edge,
the Succubus boss in Space No. 18 just swung her ponytail a few times, kicked a bit, spawned some children, and then died.
Most of the time, she was caught in a cycle.
Starting an attack, getting interrupted, becoming stiff.
Starting again, getting interrupted again, becoming stiff again.
This cycle repeated over and over.
To the audience, it felt like even they could handle it.
…
“Hurry, don’t focus on the boss, kill the small ones first!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sent out this message as colorful bullet comments in all the other World Boss spaces immediately, so that players in other boss spaces knew to target the Lesser Charm Demons first.
This was to prevent the Lesser Charm Demons from growing into numerous large bosses in a matter of minutes and slaughtering the players.
After doing all this, he finally let out a sigh of relief and wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.
Luckily he was spectating, and luckily he kept checking the battle situation in each World Boss space; otherwise, there would have been a disaster.
Sword Without End was in Space No. 7.
Tie Chui was in Space No. 11.
Jiaye didn’t go in.
If he hadn’t warned them right away, those two might have died right there, and because Jiaye didn’t warn anyone, she probably stayed in Space No. 18 watching Yi the whole time, not knowing what was happening in the other spaces.
Her nerve was something else.
Do Tie Chui and Sword Without End owe him a favor then?
Tuberculosis Rabbit propped his chin with one hand, deep in thought.
“You have friends in there?”
Perhaps it was his action of sending colorful bullet comments in each space that caught some attention; a middle-aged man standing beside Tuberculosis Rabbit asked curiously, “I saw you sending colorful bullet comments in every space. Do you have friends in all of them?”
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at the middle-aged man beside him and waved his hand dismissively, “I have friends in two of the spaces; I don’t know the people in the other spaces.”
“Why would you warn the others if you don’t know them?”
The middle-aged man asked with a puzzled curiosity: “Sending one colorful bullet comment costs 50 Points; that’s a total of 1000 Points for so many spaces. Isn’t that a waste?”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at the man with a slightly speechless expression: “Do you know what it means if no one warned them and all these players died? It means Blue Star’s strongest players are all gone.”
“If there’s a global event like the Extraterrestrial Invader again, and these people are gone, do you realize how many more would die?”
“Can’t you tell what’s heavier, 1000 Points or the lives of these people?”
“You’re thinking too small.”
Maybe it was the righteousness emanating from Tuberculosis Rabbit, but the middle-aged man explained with some embarrassment: “No, not at all. I was just curious, after all, the 1000 Points are yours, and those who die are others.”
“I originally thought you had friends in every space.”
“Tsk tsk.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head with a sense of melancholy; there weren’t many with his broad-mindedness. But it was mainly because he had plenty of Points, a six-digit sum – losing a thousand or so didn’t matter much.
If he and Yi only had a little over 1000 Points between them,
He would have to think twice about sending the colorful bullet comment.
His life principle had always been to do only what was within his capabilities, never to overreach unless Yi instructed otherwise.

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 117 - 116: "Special effects are the facade, strength is the confidence.
chapters.content:
Chapter 117 – 116: “Special effects are the facade, strength is the confidence.
Under the reminder of the colorful barrages from countless others,
players in other World Boss Spaces weren’t foolish enough to greedily chase that bit of extra damage and target the Greater Charm Demon over the Lesser Charm Demons.
After all, which was more important: life or rewards?
It was still quite easy to discern.
Soon, a prompt sounded in the ears of all players.
“Ding, the Second Layer World Boss Space has been entirely cleared. Now, we invite all players who advanced from the Second Layer World Boss Space to proceed to the Third Layer World Boss Space to face the final boss!”
“The total number of players advancing is 78.”
As the voice fell,
Chen Yi suddenly felt a flash of white light before his eyes, sighed softly, and closed his eyes. When he opened them again, he was surrounded by nearly a hundred players—all the players who had advanced from the second layer.
Ready to welcome the final boss.
The only thing that puzzled him was why there was always a flash of white light with every transition?
Were there no other methods?
A one-trick pony?
“Ding, the ultimate World Boss of the Third Layer is: the Xuanwu Turtle.”
“The boss will descend in 3 minutes. Please prepare yourselves accordingly.”
The system’s prompt had just finished,
when a man’s voice rang beside his ear.
“Everyone, look my way, I have a few words to say.”
Wang Yimei’s legs suddenly stretched to three meters, as he looked down at all the players and shouted through a megaphone, “I believe everyone’s skills should be off cooldown by now, right?”
“For 1000 Points, you can eliminate the cooldown of one Skill or Prop. I hope that no one will be stingy and will clear their cooldowns.”
“Nonsense, do we need your reminder, showing off yourself?”
A sultry figure in tight clothing sneered at Wang Yimei from the crowd, apparently with a temperament as fiery as her figure.
“…”
Wang Yimei was startled for a moment, a trace of gloom flashed in his eyes before a forced smile appeared on his face, and he waved his hand as if to show he didn’t take it to heart. He then reverted his legs back to normal and stood back on the ground, looking down at the floor without speaking.
Why… were so many people trying to make him lose face today?
It was really embarrassing.
Embarrass him, and one must be prepared to lose their life.
After Wang Yimei’s opening act, the other players also started to interact with each other. After all, they were usually the strongest people in their cities, with little chance of communication, and such an opportunity naturally called for more interaction.
“Long time, no see.”
Sword Without End, with a cigarette in his mouth and hands in his pockets, strolled over to Chen Yi, and grinned, “We meet again, huh?”
“Yeah.”
Chen Yi lifted his eyelids and casually glanced at Sword Without End standing before him: “Didn’t expect to see you here. I thought you only had those flashy effects for show.”
“Effects are for show, but strength is for confidence.”
“To get those rare effects, you need strength as a basis. Ordinary people don’t have the chance to get them.”
“Like your effects, could you have gotten them without strength?”
“The more rare effects one has, the stronger that person is.”
Sword Without End pointed to the woman who had just spoken: “See that woman? The one with the fiery figure and temper? She’s not someone to take lightly.”
“I’ve dealt with her before.”
“Her name is Yan Niang.”
“She’s a character who likes to sleep with men. It’s said that before the arrival of the later era, she was working in a KTV as a hostess, the kind that goes out with clients.”
“After the later era began, she had a stroke of luck and started using her strength to look for handsome men and forced them into bed with her. Reportedly, once she found a male celebrity idol.”
“Quite handsome.”
“Unfortunately, that male celebrity idol was bound by the ’Lucky Child of the God of Love,’ and during the act, the death penalty suddenly triggered, and that celebrity idol just died like that.”
“It made quite the joke in certain circles.”
“But many men she’s been with say it was torture.”
“How so?”
Chen Yi, leaning on his cane with one hand, casually surveyed the surrounding players patiently waiting for the boss’s arrival, and casually asked, “She’s pretty hot, looks good too, how could it be torture?”
“That woman has a foul mouth.”
Sword Without End seemed somewhat contemplative as he clicked his tongue: “She likes to curse while riding, very loudly and dirtily, things like ’I’ll f*** you to death’ and such.”
“In short, those who’ve been with her say it’s just too much torture, the cursing is intolerable.”
“Oh, I forgot to introduce her most important identity.”
“Remember the organization I told you about? ’Skywake,’ an organization formed by a group of stronger players after the later era, its name also has a clear connotation.”
“And this Yan Niang is the vice president of Skywake.”
“Ah… it seems she’s heading our way.”
“Are you Chen Yi?”
Yan Niang walked directly up to Chen Yi, arms crossed, her ample bosom almost spilling out as she looked him up and down before speaking coldly.
“I’ve heard about you from Sword Without End, about your desire to join Skywake.”
“Initially, I was against it. Someone who spends a large amount of Points to buy fancy effects in the Guardian Shop doesn’t deserve to join ’Skywake.’”
“Skywake needs some truly strong players, not those who like to buy flashy effects.”
“But since you were able to get here through the Second Layer World Boss Space Station, it shows that you also have some skills.”
“I’ll give you a chance.”
“There are a total of 78 players here, just make sure you rank in the top 40 in terms of damage dealt, and I’ll allow you to join Skywake!”
“…”
Chen Yi looked at the woman almost as tall as herself and paused for a moment before turning her head calmly to glance at Sword Without End.
“Um…”
Sword Without End looked slightly embarrassed and shifted his eyes uncertainly before lowering his head and saying, “I didn’t say Chen Yi wants to join ’Skywake.’ I just said Chen Yi is quite strong, and you guys could recruit him.”
“Look, Yan Niang, don’t twist my words.”
“Plus, ’Skywake’ is just a spontaneously organized group. When did it have such a high entry barrier, asking for top 40? As far as I know, Skywake currently has over 30 members, and only about 5 of them are standing here, right?”
“Many members have been eliminated.”
“The threshold can be low for others.”
Yan Niang stared at Chen Yi, her eyes full of disdain as she licked her fiery red lips, “But for someone like you who likes to show off, it’s only natural that the requirements are higher.”
“To put it bluntly, I just don’t respect you.”
“You want me to regard you highly?”
“Fine, show me all your strength. Rank in the top forty, and I will naturally take notice of you.”
“If you can rank in the top ten, I might even kneel and serve you, it’s not impossible.”
“Do you dare?”
“Sigh.”
Chen Yi let out a light sigh, looked down at the ground, and remained silent for a while before rubbing her temples tiredly: “The vice president of ’Skywake’, huh?”
“Which city are you from?”
“What, you fancy me? Well, I’m in…”
The voice suddenly came to an abrupt halt!
Sword Without End rushed over anxiously, covered Yan Niang’s mouth with his hand, and looked back at Chen Yi with apologetic eyes.
“That Chen Yi… this has nothing to do with me. If you have issues, just talk to her.”
“I’m innocent, and this ’Skywake’ thing has nothing to do with me either.”
“I’m going to have a word with her.”
“You go ahead with your business.”
Ignoring how fiercely Yan Niang struggled, he forcefully dragged her off towards the distance. Only after they had walked away did he turn to her with an angry face and whisper sharply.
“Are you freaking out of your mind?”
“I know you’re a bit blunt normally, but you’re still sane. Did you even think before you spoke just now?”
“Are you trying to recruit or offend someone to death?”
“Are you crazy? I don’t want to offend Chen Yi. Can’t you just stop saying stupid things while I’m around?”
“Chen Yi will think I’m as brainless as you!”
He could say he understood Chen Yi relatively well.
Chen Yi was like him, the type that was willing to expend effort and time on a vendetta.
When Chen Yi asked which city Yan Niang was from.
He knew Chen Yi was angry, and after the World Boss ended, a long pursuit would probably begin.
“What are you doing!”
Yan Niang angrily shook off Sword Without End, rubbed her slightly aching arm, and said with dissatisfaction, “Don’t you get it? It’s reverse psychology. No man likes being looked down upon by a woman.”
“I worked in a KTV for three years.”
“Don’t I know men better than you do?”
“In the private rooms, the more you say those men have no money, the more they’d go into debt just to buy you expensive flowers.”
“By provoking him like this, he’ll want to show off in front of me. Don’t you understand?”
“…”
Sword Without End suddenly fell silent. After a while, he said in a low voice, “Do you think because you’ve worked in a KTV for three years, you understand all men?”
“So what if I did?”
“Then it’s settled.”
Sword Without End looked somewhat speechless as he lit another cigarette and put it to his mouth, “Tell the president, I’m out of ’Skywake.’
“From now on, I have nothing to do with ’Skywake’ anymore.”
“Quit?”
Yan Niang was stunned, a flash of panic in her eyes, she bit her red lip and said word by word, “Don’t forget, when you joined ’Skywake,’ there was a rule. If you quit halfway, all the Contribution Value you accumulated in ’Skywake’ would be reset to zero!”
“Weren’t you always saving up Contribution Value to exchange for the Sword Immortal effect from the president?”
“You don’t want it anymore?”
“No, I don’t.”
Sword Without End shook his head and waved his hand as he walked away, “It’s just a Sword Immortal effect, although it looks nice, I’m more worried about being dragged down by you and getting killed by Chen Yi as well.”
“I’m somewhat afraid of him.”
“I don’t know why, but I just don’t want to be on the opposite side of him. Just the thought of it is scary, and I don’t want to be crushed to dust by a thirty-meter-long blade in my sleep.”

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 118 - 117: "Is this a male or a female?
chapters.content:
Chapter 118 – 117: “Is this a male or a female?
“`
“Really, how can someone as dumb as you become the vice president, huh.”
“And don’t think all men are controlled by their lower half.”
“At least I’m not.”
“I’m a pure love player, I only love my wife, and I’m not interested in women like you.”
“Even if you were standing naked in front of me, I wouldn’t give you a second glance.”
“Okay, maybe as a man, I’d instinctively take a quick look, but I definitely wouldn’t look twice.”
“Even if I did take a second look, I wouldn’t look a third time.”
“So——”
“Let’s meet again if it’s fated.”
“Bye-bye.”
Sword Without End waved his hand and said goodbye to Yan Niang, then found himself a spot at the edge of the players to patiently wait for the boss to arrive, without going near Chen Yi. This matter was no longer explainable to Chen Yi.
Who knew that although Yan Niang usually acted crazy, she was normally sane, but today, she just went totally nuts.
…
Yan Niang, with a dark look on her face, stood still, contemplating how to report this matter to the leader. After all, Sword Without End was one of the stronger players in Skywake, and his departure was no small impact.
Although “Skywake” was a voluntarily formed organization that allowed freedom of entry and exit.
But if it really was a free-for-all, what would be the difference between “Skywake” and a public market?
Just then, a voice sounded in her ear.
“Skywake?”
Wang Yimei approached with a face full of feigned kindness, smiling, “I just happened to overhear your discussion about Skywake. I’ve heard of this organization; they say it’s a group of highly skilled players who gathered together on their own initiative.”
“Are you from ’Skywake’?”
“Do you think I could have the opportunity to join Skywake?”
“You?”
Yan Niang turned her head to look, and upon seeing this man in a tracksuit approaching, a flash of surprise crossed her eyes. She hadn’t expected him to be willing to join ’Skywake’!
Anyone standing here was among the world’s top players, so naturally, it was a good thing if they wanted to join ’Skywake’.
She verbally lashed out at this man just now because she always disliked those men who loved to show off, like Chen Yi and this man who has just spoken. But if he was willing to join Skywake, then naturally everything was negotiable.
She looked up at the retreating figure of Sword Without End, and with a bite of her teeth said resentfully, “Agreed, from now on, you’re with ’Skywake’, but you must surpass Sword Without End in the rankings!”
“Sword Without End, huh?”
Wang Yimei quickly searched his memories and soon found what he was seeking; during the Children’s Day limited event on June 1st, that guy who showed off by giving out flowers, and liked to buy special effects and costumes.
Surpassing that man shouldn’t be a problem.
“Has that man joined?”
Instead of responding immediately, he looked towards Chen Yi’s back not far away.
“Chen Yi?”
Yan Niang’s eyes flickered with irritation. She ground her teeth and said fiercely, “He’s not worthy.”
“He’s not worthy?”
Wang Yimei suddenly felt a secret thrill of pleasure and couldn’t help but laugh. An organization Chen Yi wasn’t worthy of joining, yet he was allowed in so easily—it was a pleasant feeling indeed.
However, he wasn’t actually here to join Skywake.
His gaze casually swept over Yan Niang, his pupils hiding a shadow as he remembered how this woman had embarrassed him. He hadn’t forgotten.
Anyone who made him lose face had to pay with their life as compensation.
And just then——
A purple-red circle of light suddenly emerged on the ground, followed by a huge turtle slowly rising from the depths of the earth to the surface.
The turtle’s shell was nearly a hundred meters long and wide, truly colossal!
Before all the players could react——
They saw the massive turtle suddenly pull its head and limbs into its shell, and then scales grew inside the shell, sealing the openings!
It had completed a perfect defensive posture in an instant!
Before the players could react!
A man holding a long spear tentatively stood under the giant turtle, raised his spear, took a deep breath, and with a loud shout, “Go!”
Then, the spear in his hand flashed with lightning, thrusting straight at the turtle’s shell!
“Clang!”
A jarring metallic clash sounded!
And the sharp point of the spear grazed the turtle shell, sparking off showers of sparks!
An exaggerated amount of damage appeared above Xuanwu’s head.
’-1!’
“One point of damage?!!”
The man stood frozen in place, forgetting to thrust his spear again. He looked up in disbelief at the damage above the boss’s head, rubbing his eyes. Once he confirmed he had really only inflicted one point of damage, he was completely dumbfounded on the spot!
What the hell!
One point of damage? What’s the joke here?!
Are they messing with me?
It was his all-out attack, yet it had resulted in only one point of damage?
He looked up at the boss’s health.
One zero, two zeros, three zeros… a total of 1 million health!
“`
Its health isn’t too high.
It’s not even as high as the First Layer World Boss, but isn’t this defense a bit too exaggerated?!
He somewhat incredulously took a deep breath, raised his long spear high, and activated his D-grade Skill “Spear Like a Dragon”.
Suddenly, a silver dragon appeared, wrapping around the man’s spear, its tip bursting with blinding yellow light. With the swiftness of lightning and under the man’s roar, the spear thrust straight toward the turtle shell!
“-18!”
“…”
The man stood on the spot, somewhat dazed yet somewhat relieved, feeling unsure of what to do next.
His Ultimate Move had only dealt 18 points of damage, yet to chip away at this 1 million health pool.
Heh.
Don’t tell me they expect us to fight until nine o’clock in the evening? At that time, they would all be forced to sleep, and it’s during their slumber that this boss would shed its shell’s defense and start attacking the players relentlessly?
Could it be that this boss’s method of attack is actually based on the June rules?!
Meanwhile, the spectators chatting in the barrage were coming to realizations as well.
“1 million hit points, and normal attacks only cause 1 point of damage, probably a mandatory damage value, how long is this going to take?”
“Before dark, we might not even manage to defeat it, right?”
“I suddenly understand now, did you see that the boss wasn’t fully coiled inside its shell when it appeared? It means that the boss isn’t just in this one form, it’s currently in a defensive state. Everyone knows the June rules, right? You must sleep forcibly from nine to ten at night. This World Boss might just keep hiding until all players are asleep, and then start attacking!”
“Damn, that’s really possible, you mean to say this boss’s attack method is actually based on the June rules?”
“It’s not too bad I think. With three mistakes allowed by the June rules, even if we don’t sleep tonight, there are still two chances left, not particularly a tough challenge. If this is all the World Boss has to offer, at most it’ll cost these players one chance.”
“Thank goodness it’s the June rules and not the May rules. If a boss appeared under the May rules, these 78 players would be done for instantly.”
“The one who mentioned the May rules just now, did your family registry get wiped clean? If you can’t talk properly, just shut your mouth. No one thinks you’re mute.”
“If that kind of boss appears, not only these 78 players would be GG, but all the spectators watching would be G too.”
“I’m not willing to accept this!”
Han Yu was watching the battle within the First Layer World Boss Space, his eyes full of unwillingness as he had successfully advanced to the Second Layer World Boss Space first in line.
Yet he missed the chance to enter the Third Layer World Boss Space.
With his capabilities, even if he could only deal 1 point of damage at a time, what of it? His bleeding damage could stack continuously. When others had no means, he could inflict considerable damage!
His Skills and Props were incredibly suited for tackling the Third Layer’s World Boss!
Just he had no chance to enter!
If he were allowed inside, he would show everyone what bleeding damage meant!
He would definitely be the first.
No, wait… rather, the second.
Han Yu suddenly looked complicatedly towards the man who was in the Third Layer World Boss Space. That man held a weapon capable of dealing percentage damage. It was uncertain, however, how effective it would be against a boss with such high defense.
But even if it were only half as effective, that man would definitely be stronger than him!
It seemed that this time, the show would belong to that man. While other players could only deal a mandatory 1 point of damage per attack, that man could easily deal nearly ten thousand points of damage with a single spear thrust!
The gap was too huge.
He suddenly felt somewhat relieved that he didn’t make it in. Rather than being a background character, it was better to be an audience member.
…
“Is it male or female?”
Zhong Kui stood underneath the huge turtle, scrutinizing it carefully for anatomy that would indicate its sex, but he was truly having a hard time telling whether the turtle was male or female. There were no organs to be found.
Were they hidden inside the shell?
He really wasn’t clear on the anatomical structure of a turtle’s reproductive organs, as school hadn’t taught him this.
He shook his head shortly after, not pondering any further.
Male or female, a punch would reveal the truth.
D-grade Skill, “Premeditated Blast Punch” activated.
Title Effect, “Heaven-Shattering Fist” activated.
He took a deep breath, his expression fierce as he punched straight toward the turtle’s belly: “This punch at nine times the damage, what will you use to block it?!!!”
“-9!”
“Uh…”
An awkwardly low damage number popped up.
Nine times one is nine.
It was perfectly logical, and it seemed that the turtle was likely male. Had it been female, it surely wouldn’t have been just a mandatory damage.
“What a pity.”
Zhong Kui shook his head helplessly. Since it was a male turtle, there was little he could do; his Skills were all designed for female bosses. With a male, he genuinely didn’t have many good options.
Yet he understood the principle of accumulation. Though each hit was a small amount of damage, they could amount to something considerable over many hits. As long as he attacked more times than other players, his ranking would be higher and the rewards better.
…
Yan Niang pulled out a fan emblazoned with flames from her embrace. With a light flick toward the massive turtle, a dragon-like blaze surged through the air and slammed heavily into the boss!
The scorching heat wave made the other nearby players feel their faces warm up!
“-273!”
The damage appeared above the boss’s head!
She was the first player to inflict three-digit damage.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 119 - 118: "God says, all beings are equal.
chapters.content:
Chapter 119 – 118: “God says, all beings are equal.
Yan Niang slightly arrogantly placed one hand on her hip and closed her fan, waving to the other players to perform.
With attacks dealing three-digit damage, she indeed had reason to be proud compared to other players.
Many players looked at Yan Niang with a hint of dread in their eyes.
Following that, other players also took to the stage one after another to try their own methods.
“-1!”
“-7!”
“-23!”
“-78!”
Basically, no player’s damage number exceeded three digits; the defense of this boss named Xuanwu Turtle was just too high. If you didn’t use a skill, you couldn’t even break through its defense!
“-482!”
At that moment, an extremely eye-catching number popped up!
A whopping 482 damage, which was the highest damage inflicted by any player so far.
“Excuse my poor performance.”
An elderly man carrying a birdcage grinned with a knowing smile, nodding to the crowd in greeting.
All the players’ eyes were now focused on the red sparrow beside the elderly man, filled with dread and wariness. Just moments before, it was this same sparrow, which had flown out of the cage and pecked lightly at the turtle shell of the boss, causing a terrifying 482 damage.
An action that seemed devoid of any attacking power had caused the highest damage!
If encountered outside!
Nobody would dare to say with confidence that their head could withstand such a hit.
If this sparrow were used for an assassination, whoever it targeted would die; most likely, they would lose their life in their sleep.
Just as everyone’s gaze was fixated on the old man,
a low shout suddenly rang out in everyone’s ears.
“Stop!”
It instantly drew everyone’s attention yet again.
There stood Sword Without End amidst the crowd, now clad in a green robe, coldly taking a step into the air with one hand behind his back.
As Sword Without End took that step, a Green Peak shortsword, roughly the size of a palm, appropriately materialized under his foot, staying firmly in place like a step.
When Sword Without End lifted his foot again, another new palm-sized Green Peak shortsword appeared beneath it.
It was as if he were climbing a Sky Ladder.
Under the watching eyes of everyone, Sword Without End ascended step by step into the high sky, looking down at all the players, including that giant turtle.
Immediately after—
Dense clouds suddenly filled the entire sky above the World Boss Space!
Numerous lightning bolts pulsed through the clouds, barely visible!
“Sword, rise!”
Sword Without End stood high in the sky, his right hand forming a sword technique, his expression cold as he glared at the Xuanwu Turtle below and gave a sharp command.
The next second.
A gigantic ’SLAY’ character appeared above Sword Without End’s head!
The area was even half as big as the Xuanwu Turtle!
Blood-red, with a sharp and aggressive font!
Suspended below the dark clouds, right above Sword Without End’s head!
It was so menacing that merely looking up at it filled one’s heart with boundless fear, and their knees involuntarily grew weak; such was the might of an immortal’s maneuver!
Before the crowd could exclaim,
a flicker of coldness passed through Sword Without End’s eyes, and he pointed his sword technique directly at the Xuanwu Turtle below, “Go!”
Suddenly,
the Three-Foot Qingfeng that had been circling Sword Without End, as if commanded, soared up like a Blue Dragon, piercing the clouds and splitting them open!
It passed right through the center of the huge, crimson ’SLAY’ character!
In the moment that Three-Foot Qingfeng passed through,
the gigantic, crimson ’SLAY’ character also began to melt rapidly, merging with the Three-Foot Qingfeng.
And the Three-Foot Qingfeng, now trailing a crimson tail flame and emitting a clear dragon’s roar, then precisely targeted the Xuanwu Turtle’s shell and struck fiercely!
“Clang!”
Read new chapters at empire
“-9829!”
A massive and terrifying damage number slowly emerged above the Xuanwu Turtle’s head.
The clouds dispersed.
Sword Without End slowly descended to the ground, waving the hem of his sleeve and, with a smile, stood before the Xuanwu Turtle, bowing low in a very gentlemanly manner to all the players.
“I hope I have not made myself a laughingstock.”
“I am Sword Without End, known as the foremost Sword Immortal of the age.”
And the Three-Foot Qingfeng that had been circling Sword Without End, as if understanding human behavior, mimicked Sword Without End’s movements and bowed charmingly and cutely to the crowd as well.
The synchronicity of man and sword’s movements was quite remarkable.
“…”
Utter silence.
No one spoke, and everyone opened their mouths in disbelief, looking up at the terrifying damage number above the BOSS’s head!
Nearly 10k damage?!
Was this some kind of joke!
Before Sword Without End stepped forward, dozens of players had tried, and the highest damage they could inflict was just over 400!
The difference between over 400 and nearly 10k—wasn’t that a bit too much?
And by this time, the live comments had already started going crazy.
“I declare that from now on Sword Without End is the number one Sword Immortal of our time, I acknowledge it, and I am willing to step down to be the second Sword Immortal.”
“So cool… The last time Sword Without End appeared on a global live stream, I just thought this guy was being showy, although he’s still showy this time, I don’t know why but he seems much more appealing now…”
“Before, I thought this guy was just showing off, but I later realized that he’s actually awesome!!!”
“No way, all that flashy stuff actually deals damage? I always thought Sword Without End’s purchases were just for show, with visuals but no damage.”
“We all started from the same starting line, so why have they become Sword Immortals while we’re still knocking on Minotaur heads?”
“Do you guys think it’s possible that Sword Without End was actually the last Sword Immortal from the period when spiritual energy was declining, and just happened to encounter the globalization of the game, using props as a cover, but they were actually all his own Sword Immortal techniques?”
“You upstairs should write a book, I’ve even thought of the name for you, it should be called ’The Last Lone Sword Immortal on Blue Star’.”
“The person upstairs is obviously not a professional, nowadays the longer the book title the better, it should be called ’When the Last Sword Immortal on Earth Encounters Global Game Transformation’.”
“Upstairs is even more amateurish, it should be called ’Lone Sword Immortal’, only then will it have both the aura and the gimmick.”
The barrage continued to flood the screen.
Meanwhile, Li Yide inadvertently wiggled the Fox Tail behind him and stared silently at the image of Sword Without End with one hand behind his back, secretly swearing in his heart.
When he made a name for himself later on.
He would definitely break the arms of all those who liked to carry their hands behind their backs, then put them in a cast and tie it to their back.
He didn’t know why, but he was really annoyed with those who carried their hands behind their backs.
It’s itching like hemorrhoids; can’t you go to the proctology hospital to see a doctor?
Then he turned to look at Chen Yi in the screen and shook his head with a slight hint of regret. As someone from Yancheng, he naturally knew that Chen Yi possessed a sniper rifle capable of percentage damage.
It was just a pity that he was destined to be overshadowed by Sword Without End this time.
The damage was certainly higher than Sword Without End’s.
But it was useless.
Firing a sniper rifle shot, even with high damage, was just too plain and simple.
It couldn’t compare to the coolness of Sword Without End with all effects on with that one slash.
…
Sword Without End stood with one hand behind his back, smiling at the players in front of him whose eyes were bulging with disbelief, nodding his head in satisfaction with the effect. It was very satisfying.
Quite nice.
Then he looked towards Chen Yi standing among the crowd and made a gesturing sign.
“Yi, please.”
And the eyes of the other players followed Sword Without End’s gesture, looking at Chen Yi standing in the crowd, filled with faint anticipation.
A person highly regarded by Sword Without End should be a strong player, right?
They weren’t unfamiliar with the name Chen Yi.
He had appeared several times in global announcements, showed up a few times during the limited event on June 1st Children’s Day, also quite showy, thinking to themselves, he must belong to the same category as Sword Without End.
Chen Yi stood still and saw the gazes cast by the crowd, calmly leaning on his cane and walking towards the Xuanwu Turtle through the path made by the players.
And the Christmas Cane, being used as a walking stick, slowly transformed into a sniper rifle.
In just a few steps.
Chen Yi stood before the Xuanwu Turtle, holding the sniper rifle with one hand, his expression calm and natural as he aimed the muzzle at the Xuanwu Turtle!
The next second—
The entire World Boss Space suddenly turned visibly crimson!
All players were stunned for a moment, then instinctively looked up, only to find that a red blood moon had appeared above the space at some unknown time.
New n𝙤vel chapters are published on Novgo.cσ๓.
Without the slightest feeling of eeriness, the blood moon instead filled the atmosphere with mystery.
Just like the Ruby Bayonet in CSGO, it involuntarily filled one with longing and an unattainable desire.
Below the blood moon.
A female angel with an indistinct face, wearing only a few pieces of cloth to cover her form, raised her head and chest under the moonlight and slowly spread her arms. A gentle and magnetic voice arose beside the ears of all the players present and watching.
“God said, all beings are equal.”
The next second—
The Septagon Badge activated, the trigger was pulled!
Suddenly, 100 sniper rifles’ phantoms appeared above Chen Yi’s head, their muzzles aiming directly at the Xuanwu Turtle, and a hundred crimson bullets fired simultaneously!
“Bang!”
A somewhat dull gunshot echoed in the boss space!
At the same time, an extremely exaggerated damage figure popped up above the boss’s head.
’-3,030,000!!!’
’-3.03 million!!!’
3.03 million???
Sword Without End, who was about to offer mutual praise, suddenly froze, his jaw dropped to the floor, his eyes bulging in disbelief looking at the horrendous and exaggerated huge damage number above the boss’s head!
What’s going on?
Were his eyes playing tricks on him?
3.03 million damage?
Isn’t the total health bar of this boss only 1 million?
However, before he had time to rub his eyes and look again at that number to confirm whether he was seeing things, he suddenly heard a notification sound near his ear.
’Ding, the ultimate World Boss has been killed, the top three damage-dealing players are: Chen Yi, Sword Without End, Zhong Kui. All players who cleared it will…’
Immediately after.
A gateway to the outside world suddenly emerged within the space.
While all players were still frozen in place, their brains completely stopped working, unable to comprehend what had happened.
Chen Yi had already calmly stepped through the gateway, leaning on his cane with one hand, without even looking back he lazily waved his hand and said softly.
“All flash, no substance.”

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 120 - 119: Zhong Kui, Third, Ptui!
chapters.content:
Chapter 120 – 119: Zhong Kui, Third, Ptui!
The next second—
Chen Yi stepped through the light gate, disappeared from the Third Layer World Boss Space, and returned to reality.
Meanwhile, the other players in the Third Layer World Boss Space all stood frozen in place with stiff expressions, not even hearing the notification sound that rang in their ears.
“Ding, the Ultimate World Boss has been killed, the top three players in causing damage are: Chen Yi, Sword Without End, Zhong Kui. All players who cleared the boss will receive a World Boss Gift Pack (Large) *1, as well as 10000 Points, Level 2 Enhancement Stone *10, Protection Talisman *1.”
“The top three players in causing damage will receive additional rewards.” Explore more at empire
“The first place will additionally receive a limited exclusive title, 10000 Points, Wing Exchange Coupon *50, Unique Prop Gift Pack *2.”
“The second place will additionally receive a limited exclusive title, 5000 Points, Wing Exchange Coupon *30, Unique Prop Gift Pack *1.”
“The third place will additionally receive a limited exclusive title, 3000 Points, Wing Exchange Coupon *20, Unique Prop Gift Pack *1.”
“The World Boss Points Store will open for 24 hours, and the damage dealt by players in the event will be converted into points at a ratio of 1:100. Players can spend points in the Points Store, with any remaining points automatically deducted after the expiration.”
“Players in the Third Layer World Boss Space, please return to reality through the light gate within 10 minutes.”
“Players remaining in the First Layer World Boss Space will be sent back to reality after 10 minutes.”
“Due to the excellent performance of all players, the World Boss that was preparing to invade reality was successfully killed in the outer domain space, defending the peace of Blue Star. We hope all players will continue to keep up their efforts.”
“Until we meet again.”
“Three million…”
At this moment, Sword Without End couldn’t utter a word, standing blankly in place with his eyes staring in the direction Chen Yi had disappeared, his lips trembling slightly, unable to produce a single term.
Say what?
What’s there to say?
It came, one shot, killed.
What else is there to say.
One shot with three million in health, and that World Boss still had two million health short of Chen Yi’s attack.
It’s a joke, every player standing here is the cream of the crop, to put it unpleasantly, in their own cities they are like Local Tyrants, and those with the inclination have even started forming their own harems; the traditional monogamous system has long been disregarded.
Yet, these were the players who could only deal a forced damage of one point, which showed just how terrifying the defense of the Xuanwu Turtle was!
He was proud to be able to deal nearly five digits of damage!
If it weren’t for Chen Yi’s existence, he would have become the focus of this event!
Of course, he knew Chen Yi must be stronger than him; after all, he knew Chen Yi could summon the Vehicle with a 30-meter-long blade and hit at the highest speed from a distance, certainly not dealing less damage than him.
But he hadn’t expected… Chen Yi to kill it with one shot?
He knew Chen Yi was formidable, but he hadn’t anticipated he would be this formidable.
In his mind, Chen Yi was definitely going to place in the top ten of this event, and he might even compete for the top three; the first place was hard to predict, considering there were too many hidden dragons and crouching tigers.
But unexpectedly, Chen Yi took the first place in such an overwhelming and unstoppable manner.
Leaving no room for pursuit, a despair-inducing crush.
Sword Without End, with a dazed expression, silently looked up above his head, already imagining what it would look like to have that string of damage numbers appearing overhead, pondering how many times he would have to die to fill the hole of three million.
Suddenly recalling something, he turned to look at the crowd. Seeing Yan Niang standing pale-faced among them, he couldn’t help but smile contentedly.
Although he was shocked, he bore no grudge against Chen Yi; in fact, they had even ventured into maps together, and could be considered somewhat acquainted.
But Yan Niang was a different story.
This time, she had somewhat offended Chen Yi, and he wasn’t sure how Chen Yi would handle it, but what he did know was that Yan Niang was probably going to have sleepless nights.
Thinking of this.
He felt instantly balanced, clearing his throat with a single-fist cough, attracting everyone’s attention before shaking his head and saying with a smile, “Yi is still as strong as ever.”
Then he strode towards the light gate.
“Yi, wait for me, let’s drink together tonight, ha.”
And then he disappeared into the light gate.
The other players also looked at Sword Without End with complex expressions, noting the seemingly good relationship between him and Chen Yi. With such a powerful friend, Sword Without End could, unpleasantly said, walk sideways in the future.
But soon, they realized, even without Chen Yi, based solely on that one sword strike, no one would dare to provoke Sword Without End.
Hiss…
So infuriating!
…
“Damn it!”
Yan Niang’s pupils showed slight panic, looking up at the guild leader amidst the crowd, momentarily unclear on how to report this situation.
She hadn’t expected Chen Yi to be so strong.
She had set a goal for Chen Yi to be in the top forty, but not only did he enter the top forty, he also took first place, and it was a hopeless and unstoppable crushing victory; the guild leader didn’t even have a chance to make a move!
Now, the problem arose.
Her previous rhetoric might work against an average player, but for a player of this strength, it could very well be taken as a challenge.
Add to that Sword Without End’s resignation and his parting words.
It made her feel a slight unease.
…
“Third?”
While hiding under the belly of the Xuanwu Turtle, continually swinging his fists, Zhong Kui suddenly noticed that the boss turned into light points and vanished. Before he could react, he heard a prompt sound by his ear.
“Ding, the ultimate World Boss has been killed…”
“What the hell? The World Boss is already dead?”
Still not fully comprehending, Zhong Kui then discovered to his surprise that he was actually in third place, not only featured in the world announcement but also receiving extra rewards.
Then—
When he saw the terrifying damage Chen Yi inflicted on the boss damage panel, everything suddenly made sense to him.
After putting everything together, Zhong Kui couldn’t help but laugh uproariously, his face flushing with excitement as he proudly placed one hand on his hip and threw his head back.
“Hahahahahaha!”
“I’m number three on the leaderboard!”
“My mom was right, heaven never shortchanges those who work hard in silence!”
This Xuanwu Turtle was a male.
Even with a ninefold damage bonus, his punches could only inflict 9 points of damage each, but he never stopped. After all, while his damage was low, so was that of other players. With just a bit more effort, his ranking could potentially rise.
So.
While Yan Niang was setting the turtle on fire, he hid underneath its belly, silently throwing punches.
While other players looked toward Yan Niang with jealous eyes, he hid underneath the turtle’s belly, silently throwing punches.
While other players stepped up, tested their damage, then politely stepped back to let others have their turn, he hid underneath the turtle’s belly, silently throwing punches.
While an old man began to display his skills modestly, he hid underneath the turtle’s belly, silently throwing punches.
While Sword Without End started to show off, he hid underneath the turtle’s belly, silently throwing punches.
When everyone started to fear Sword Without End’s strength, he hid underneath the turtle’s belly, silently throwing punches.
When Chen Yi prepared to take down the boss with one shot, he hid underneath the turtle’s belly, silently throwing punches.
But then… there was no “when” left, because the boss was instantly killed.
A punch, another punch, and yet another punch.
Though the damage was low, the frequency of his punches more than made up for it!
And so… somewhat comically, the third spot on the leaderboard was his.
In reality, Zhong Kui had never even dreamed of placing third. His initial thought was simple: the early bird catches the worm. With low damage, there was no point in stopping. Who would have thought the boss would be killed in an instant, and he would end up in the third spot just like that.
With a grin stretching ear to ear, Zhong Kui put on the newly acquired title over his head, waved goodbye to all the players present with a smug look on his face, and said, “Farewell till we meet again, everyone.”
Then he turned around and stepped into the light gate with an almost celestial gait, disappearing on the spot.
All the players watched Zhong Kui’s retreating figure with complex and unwilling expressions, feeling a rush of frustration building inside!
Chen Yi, ranked first, they acknowledged!
Respectfully and without any grievance!
Sword Without End, ranked second, they also acknowledged!
Outmatched in strength, they admitted defeat!
Zhong Kui, ranked third, pah!
What the hell was that?! Seeing Zhong Kui’s smug look, they just wanted to rush over and tear that smug expression off his face!
This boss had strong defenses and did not possess attack abilities during its defensive phase. Besides, almost all players around the world were watching their livestream, so instinctively, nobody really teamed up to attack the World Boss.
Rather, they began to show off their skills one by one—a demonstration of gentlemanly conduct.
With the boss’s high health and defense, attacking it for a few more minutes would not make much difference. It wouldn’t significantly increase their damage, so they might as well create a gentlemanly image for themselves.
Thus formed a scene where all players stood still and watched others take turns displaying their skills.
This was all normal!
Nothing about it was abnormal!
The only abnormality was that they hadn’t noticed a sneaky character had been hiding under the belly of the Xuanwu Turtle from the start, silently throwing punches, and he hadn’t stopped until the very end.
The worst part was that the boss was finished off by Chen Yi in an instant, and naturally, this sneaky one quietly claimed the third place for himself.
“Heh heh.”
The old man with the birdcage, standing in the crowd, couldn’t help but smile wryly and shake his head at the scene before making his way to leave the area.
“You’re not angry?”
A player next to him, with a somewhat instigating tone and narrowed eyes, whispered, “This Zhong Kui stole your spot. If he hadn’t been sneaking around under the belly of the Xuanwu Turtle throwing punches all the time, that third place would have been yours.”
“The third-place prize would have been yours as well. If I were you, I’d do whatever it takes to find Zhong Kui in real life and get all the rewards back.”
“What will be, will be; what won’t, won’t,” the old man replied, his face free of resentment, simply shaking his head with a smile, “I practice fate reading. What’s not meant to be yours cannot be obtained forcefully. This is also the young fellow Zhong Kui’s fortune.”
“Fortune cannot be seized by force; it would carry karmic consequences.”
“Until we meet again, young friends.”

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 121 - 120: "Dislocated?
chapters.content:
Chapter 121 – 120: “Dislocated?
“`
Although the old man had left with flair,
his words from just before had been heard by many. Players’ eyes started rolling with thoughts.
That’s right.
The unique prop gift pack was something they also coveted.
They didn’t have the guts to snatch from Chen Yi and Sword Without End, but they dare try their luck with a crafty villain like Zhong Kui who only knew how to punch in silence.
At that moment,
the players who were spectating in the First Layer World Boss Space hadn’t left yet, and the bullet screen was still crazily rolling in the sky.
“Yi is awesome, Yi will be my god from now on!!!”
“The final World Boss? Yi one-shotted it with a sniper bullet, what’s the point of playing? What’s there to enjoy?”
“No shutdown means it wasn’t even opened, right? I suggest that the Snow Sea Project Team should investigate Chen Yi.”
“Selling a critical hit cheat just like Chen Yi’s, yours truly is a top-notch programmer. This cheat can perfectly avoid detection by the Snow Sea Project Team, only 999 Points needed, only 100 available, when they’re gone, they’re gone.”
“For real?”
“But I have to say, I think Zhong Kui will make something of himself in the future, he’s earnest and steady and most importantly, he has a calm mind, though his damage per hit is low, he never loses hope, and in the end, he successfully took third place on the leaderboard.”
“Right, compared with Chen Yi, I think Zhong Kui is the true role model. Chen Yi is too high up for us to learn anything from, but Zhong Kui’s spirit of perseverance in the face of adversity is what we should really be learning from.”
“…”
The bullet screen rolled frenetically, with gamers from all over the world gathered here discussing.
Every gamer could only see a limited number of bullet comments, so they wouldn’t miss out due to the screen being overwhelmed, as most would be automatically filtered out.
And there wasn’t a small number of discussions about Zhong Kui.
Even many players had silently made Zhong Kui their idol.
Chen Yi had put too much distance between himself and the average players; they dared not learn or even dream about his level. But Zhong Kui was different; his attacks only caused a little damage, just like them fighting the Minotaur Monster outside the city.
But unlike them, Zhong Kui never gave up from the beginning to the end, quietly working hard in the shadows, and in the end, he was also graced by good fortune.
Suddenly—
Quite a few people even took Zhong Kui as their own goal to strive toward.
Explore new worlds at empire
…
Inside the First Layer World Boss Space,
Jiaye stood in place, her eyes lit with joy as she scrolled through the bullet screen. Seeing comments praising Yi, she smiled knowingly, happy for him.
But when she saw comments cursing at Yi, anger flashed in her eyes.
However, soon, the joy in her eyes dissipated, and she stood despondently, staring at her feet in silence without a word.
Yi had been off the map since June 2nd, going in for ten days straight.
Having finally come out, he didn’t come to find her but went off the map again.
Up to today, Yi hadn’t sought her out.
She had invited Yi out of the city to hunt monsters twice, but he never came; she couldn’t possibly invite him a third time; it would be too embarrassing…
During this time, she finally accepted something she hadn’t wanted to accept before.
That is…
Yi had a girl he liked.
Yi had a title “Lucky Child of the God of Love” floating above his head, a title that could only be obtained during the limited 520 event by confessing to one’s beloved of the opposite sex.
Since Yi had this title, it implied he must have a woman he likes.
She had selectively ignored this fact because there was no sign of any woman around Yi, but now it seems…
Jiaye lowered her head to look at the ground, her lips pressed tightly, and she didn’t utter a word.
…
Ten minutes passed quickly.
All players were forcibly teleported out of the World Boss Space.
“That’s just epic!”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked towards Yi standing by the window and couldn’t help but thrust his head forward excitedly, “Yi, you wouldn’t believe those bullet screen reactions, they cracked me up!”
“When you shot the boss, a whole section of bullet comments just vanished instantly, everyone was flabbergasted.”
“Heh, that’s really amusing.”
“Just thinking about their stunned faces makes me find it funny.”
“I bet they never expected this World Boss to show up for a few minutes and then get one-shotted.”
“Uh… Yi, what are you doing?”
Chen Yi, who was standing by the window, was grimacing as he rubbed his right arm. Seeing the Tuberculosis Rabbit come over, he just stretched his right arm toward him: “It’s dislocated, kind of painful, come help me with it.”
“Dis… Dislocated?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, still in the throes of excitement, looked bewilderedly at Yi’s right arm.
“No kidding.”
Chen Yi, hurt so much that he involuntarily sucked in a breath of cold air, rolled his eyes in annoyance: “You know how powerful the recoil on that sniper rifle is, firing it with one hand, it’d be a miracle if it didn’t dislocate.”
“Ah, right, right, I’ll help you, Yi.”
Three minutes later.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit wiped off the non-existent cold sweat from his forehead, speaking sheepishly, “That should do it, just let it recover a bit and it’ll be fine after a while, Yi, you should be more careful when you fire next time.”
“Shooting single-handedly with a sniper rifle like that, it is indeed easy to dislocate an arm.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi moved his arm around and didn’t respond. Instead, he looked up at the rewards for this world event.
The rewards for this world event were quite generous.
“`
First came the Points.
A total of a whopping 62,600 Points.
His Points were undoubtedly the highest among all players, and most importantly, these Points were entirely based on the damage dealt.
During the final boss battle, he dealt 3.03 million damage with a single shot, which converted to 30,300 Points.
This was truly an exceptional case.
The final boss in the last level had a total health pool of only 1 million, which theoretically meant that this boss could provide a total of 10,000 Points to the several dozen players in this space.
After all, its health was limited.
However, an anomaly like him came along, directly causing the points provided by this boss to far exceed its available Points.
If you wanted to get the most Points,
you should have used the Septagon Badge in the First Layer World Boss Space.
The First Layer World Boss had about 3 million health, and a single shot could deal 9 million damage, which meant 90,000 Points!
This way, you could maximize the Points gained and the benefits!
But the downside was that you couldn’t use a single shot to instantly kill the final boss in the Third Layer World Boss Space. I guess there were pros and cons, but even so, over 60,000 Points were more than enough for Chen Yi to purchase whatever he wanted in the store.
Keep in mind that other players might only have a few hundred, a few thousand, or even just tens of Points at most. Single digits weren’t impossible either.
60,000 was already an exaggerated figure.
You could buy a lot of stuff in the World Boss Points Store with that, but Chen Yi didn’t check the World Boss Points Store immediately, instead, he looked at his other rewards first.
First was a limited special Title.
Title Name: Great Demon King!
Title Level: Red.
Title Effect: The effect of this Title seems to be obscured by some dust, perhaps using a “clean grey stone” could remove the dust to reveal the Title Effect.
Title Origin: Obtained by dealing the highest damage to the final boss during the “World Boss” event.
The Title Effect was hidden behind dust.
Chen Yi looked at the Title Effect of this Title with some bewilderment. It was the first time he had seen something like this; he had acquired red-level Titles before, but none of them had this remark on their effects.
clean grey stone, a Prop he had never heard of before.
But without surprises, it should be available for sale in the Points Store or in the Points Store for this event.
It felt like a new money-making tactic devised by the Snow Sea Project Team.
From now on, to see the Title Effect, do you have to first purchase a clean grey stone?
That’s really absurd!
He didn’t immediately check the Title Effect but continued to look at the other rewards.
World Boss Gift Pack (Small) *1
World Boss Gift Pack (Large) *1.
Would you like to open them?
“Yes.”
Immediately, a notification sounded in his ear.
Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for opening World Boss Gift Pack (Large) *1, World Boss Gift Pack (Small) *1, obtaining the following Props—
Level 1 Enhancement Stone *10, Level 2 Enhancement Stone *10, Protection Talisman *2, C-grade random Skill Fragment *5, Silver Party Ticket *5.
C-grade Skill Fragments and Silver Party Tickets were nothing new, as they were Props seen before, but the Enhancement Stones and Protection Talismans were new items that had emerged with this world event.
Prop Name: Level 1 Enhancement Stone.
Prop Level: E-grade.
Prop Effect: Can enhance E-grade Props, with varying attributes after Enhancement depending on the Prop’s effect.
Prop Limitation: Maximum enhancement level for E-grade Props is +6; at +6, the Prop will have special visual effects and Special Effects. Three Level 1 Enhancement Stones can be combined into one Level 2 Enhancement Stone.
Prop Introduction: “May your deities bless your Enhancement success, but my advice would be to purchase a few Protection Talismans instead.”
–
Prop Name: Protection Talisman.
Prop Level: None.
Prop Effect: Can protect your Props from downgrading or being destroyed upon failure during Enhancement.
Prop Introduction: “Not taking chances is the choice of a wise individual.”
Chen Yi furrowed his brow as he looked at the probability panel for the Enhancement Stones, which was a long list and straining on the eyes.
The probability of enhancing from +1 to +2 is 100%.
The probability of enhancing from +3 to +4 is 40%.
The probability of enhancing from +5 to +6 is 20%.
Failure to enhance below +6 does not result in downgrading.
Failure to enhance from +6 to +12 will result in downgrading back to +6.
If enhancement fails above +12, the Prop will be destroyed.
The odds weren’t bad.
The lowest probability was 20%, which could be considered very high. Compared with certain browser games with enhancement probabilities as low as 0.1%, a 20% enhancement probability was quite generous.
E-grade Props could only be enhanced up to +6.
But what he didn’t quite understand was,
those browser games had enhancement mechanics because the equipment had values, like defense, health boost, etc., and the effects of enhancement could be seen directly.
But what’s the use of enhancing a Prop?
Props don’t have values, do they?

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 122 - 121: "That Yi, I haven’t read many books.
chapters.content:
Chapter 122 – 121: “That Yi, I haven’t read many books.
“`
For instance, take the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s food series prop, this kind of prop itself is meant to satisfy hunger, and it doesn’t have any numerical values, so how to enhance it?
What’s most important is this.
The reason enhancement is so critical in browser-based games is that each player can only carry a limited number of equipment pieces, and naturally, the higher the enhancement of the equipment, the stronger it becomes.
But the problem is that they can carry many props with them, and instead of using Points to enhance a prop, it might be more cost-effective to buy a new one, getting a higher value for money.
Unless…
Chen Yi’s eyes slightly narrowed, and he fell silent in contemplation, unless the introduction of this enhancement system was paving the way for a large map.
Just at that moment—
A notification sounded in the ears of all the players.
“Ding, a player has enhanced a C-grade prop to +12, the global enhancement ranking is officially launched!”
“The ranking will be based on the sum of enhancement layers of the six props with the highest enhancement level each player has.”
“For instance: possessing three E-grade props at enhancement +6 and three C-grade props at enhancement +12 would total 54 enhancement layers.”
“Players on the ranking will have a limited-time title, as well as daily enhancement gift package rewards.”
Chen Yi looked at the global enhancement ranking in front of him, his eyes narrowing without a word.
At that moment, the top player on the ranking was Zhong Kui.
With an enhancement layer count of 26.
This player’s name was quite familiar to him, seemingly the one who attacked with his fists, and also the third position in the current global event.
“Tuberculosis Rabbit, find an E-grade prop and try enhancing it.”
“Alright.”
After rummaging through his bag, Tuberculosis Rabbit took out a coffee machine: “How about this?”
Chen Yi didn’t say much and directly slapped an Enhancement Stone level 1 onto it.
The next second—
Along with a flash of white light.
The Enhancement Stone instantly melted into a silvery liquid and fused with the coffee machine.
And the coffee machine’s prop panel underwent some subtle changes.
’Prop Name’: Automatic Coffee Machine +1.
’Prop Grade’: E-grade.
’Prop Effect’: This is a coffee machine, simply pour in coffee, and a cup of even hotter coffee at roughly 120 degrees Celsius will appear.
’Enhancement Direction’: The temperature of the coffee.
’Prop Restriction’: Only allows pouring in coffee.
’Skill Introduction’: “You can now enjoy piping hot coffee anytime, anywhere~”
Chen Yi took a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and placed it in his mouth, looking at the prop panel in front of him, and roughly understood what the enhancement effect was, just as the Enhancement Stone stated.
For different props, there are different Enhancement Effects.
And the Enhancement Direction of this coffee machine is the temperature of the coffee.
Originally it could only pour out a hot cup of coffee, but now it can pour out an even hotter cup, with a temperature of about 120 degrees Celsius.
He didn’t say much, but rather, he threw several more level 1 Enhancement Stones at it again.
“Ding, enhancement successful, upgraded to +2”
“Ding, enhancement failed, remains at +2”
“Ding, enhancement failed, remains at +2”
“Ding…”
“Ding, enhancement successful, upgraded to +6”
After using 18 level 1 Enhancement Stones, Chen Yi finally enhanced the coffee machine to +6.
That was the limit for an E-grade prop.
Chen Yi couldn’t help but sigh helplessly, he hated enhancement, he had only planned to enhance a little to check the effect, but he couldn’t help but continue enhancing after repeated failures.
In the end, even with such high odds of success, it still took him 18 level 1 Enhancement Stones to enhance it to the max.
But he didn’t mind too much, after all, his more than 60,000 Points could buy plenty of Enhancement Stones from the Points Store, enough to enhance all his equipment.
And now the name of the coffee machine had changed too.
’Automatic Coffee Machine +6.’
There was a +6 added to the end, and for some reason, it looked quite pleasing, there was no reason for it, just a sudden sense of satisfaction in his heart.
And the Prop Effect had changed as well.
’Prop Effect’: This is a coffee machine, simply pour in coffee, and a cup of even hotter coffee at roughly 220 degrees Celsius will appear.
220 degrees Celsius.
If previously this thing could only be used as a drink vending machine, now the liquid at 220 degrees Celsius already had quite a bit of destructive power.
“Yi, I haven’t read much,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked oddly at the coffee machine panel that Yi had shared: “But I know that under normal pressure, water boils at around 100 degrees Celsius, and if it gets a bit hotter, it turns into steam, right?”
“Although coffee and water are a bit different.”
“`
“But wouldn’t coffee at 220 degrees Celsius just evaporate?”
“Don’t ask me, go consult the customer service team from the Snow Sea Project Team, I’m also unclear.”
Chen Yi shook his head without addressing that question and instead looked towards Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Hand over your Claw Knife, I’ll try to enhance it.”
“Oh, alright.”
The Claw Knife of Tuberculosis Rabbit was a C-grade prop, which required a level 3 Enhancement Stone.
Three level 1 Enhancement Stones could be combined into a level 2 Enhancement Stone.
Three level 2 Enhancement Stones could be combined into a level 3 Enhancement Stone.
A single level 3 Enhancement Stone, equivalent to nine level 1 Enhancement Stones, was quite expensive.
Without much hesitation, Chen Yi immediately slapped the level 3 Enhancement Stone he was holding onto the Claw Knife handed over by Tuberculosis Rabbit.
A flash of white light.
The Enhancement Stone turned into a silvery-white liquid that seeped into the Claw Knife.
And the panel of the Claw Knife started to change.
’Prop Name’: Red Moon Claw Knife+1.
’Prop Grade’: C-grade prop.
’Prop Effect’: This knife is extremely sharp, almost able to destroy everything before your eyes, and the knife can Charge.
The rules for Charging are as follows.
Stay tuned for updates on empire
After you speak a sentence, your Claw Knife will begin to Charge, and afterward, for every additional ten sentences you speak (starting from enhancement +3, this number decreases), the Charge progress will increase once.
After completing the Charge, you can swing a blade light that cuts through everything before your eyes.
The power is limitless.
In theory, if you Charge for long enough, you could even cut an entire planet in half with a single slice.
’Enhancement Direction’: Charge time.
’Prop Restriction’: Once Charge is interrupted, the stored blade light must be used before beginning to Charge again.
’Prop Introduction’: “You know what? I really hate those tight-lipped guys who won’t say a word.”
The prop panel was not much different from before, the only change being that now after enhancement +3, the number of sentences needed to Charge was reduced.
Originally, saying ten sentences counted as one Charge. After enhancing to +3, perhaps nine sentences would count as one Charge.
This significantly reduced the time needed for Charging.
This method of enhancement was indeed very good.
It suited Tuberculosis Rabbit’s prop very well. After buying enough Enhancement Stones later, I could enhance this prop for Tuberculosis Rabbit to the max, thus also reducing the charging time for his trump card.
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s prop could definitely be used as a trump card in many situations.
Looking at it this way…
The enhancement setting introduced this time was rather good, more reflective of the effects after enhancement compared to the numerical enhancements of browser games. However, the control over the Enhancement Direction is unpredictable, adding a touch of randomness.
“Wait a minute!”
Chen Yi suddenly thought of something and looked up at Tuberculosis Rabbit, “I remember you also have an Automatic Coffee Machine, which you picked up next to a corpse last time, right?”
“Hmm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, confused, “That is true, what about it, Yi?”
“Bring it to me.”
Chen Yi looked at the unenhanced E-grade prop Automatic Coffee Machine in front of him, already guessing something. He took out a level 1 Enhancement Stone and smashed it down again.
’Ding, enhancement successful, upgraded to +1’
As expected!
The Enhancement Direction had changed!
Just now, the Enhancement Direction of the coffee machine was the coffee temperature!
Each enhancement would increase the temperature of the coffee that poured out!
But now, the Enhancement Direction was the quantity of coffee!
Every enhancement would increase the amount of coffee that could be poured out, with an enhancement to +1 yielding two cups, and enhancement to +2 yielding three cups of coffee!
Just as he had thought.
The Enhancement Direction of each prop was completely random!
This meant that two identical props could vary greatly in price due to different Enhancement Directions!
And the Enhancement Direction could not be changed; once an Enhancement Direction appeared, it was fixed!
This also determined the future potential of a prop.
If a prop got an extremely poor Enhancement Direction, its value would also greatly diminish.
“…”
Chen Yi, who had originally planned to check the Enhancement Direction of his B-grade prop sniper rifle, suddenly hesitated.
It might end up with a useless Enhancement Direction.
He decided to first take a look in the World Activity Points Store to see if there were any props related to this.

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 123 - 122: A Punch with 60,000 Times the Damage, What Will You Fight With?
chapters.content:
Chapter 123 – 122: A Punch with 60,000 Times the Damage, What Will You Fight With?
“`
He carefully examined every prop in the World Activity Points, but there were no props that could determine the direction of enhancement, which meant that the enhancement direction was completely random up to this point.
At least for now it was.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, his mouth twitching slightly before he synthesized a level 4 Enhancement Stone and slapped it onto his sniper rifle prop, ready to see what the enhancement direction of his sniper rifle would be.
The enhancement direction he desired was naturally percentage-based damage.
Originally, each shot could deal 3% of life value in true percentage-based damage, and if possible, he hoped to enhance this value even further.
However…
“Ding, your B-grade prop Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle has been enhanced to +1, enhancement direction – Points reduction.”
“The current Points cost per shot is 95.”
Chen Yi slightly frowned with dissatisfaction and remained silent. This enhancement direction was a letdown; though firing a shot required 100 Points and killing someone nearly amounted to 3000 Points. Explore more stories at empire
But he never cared about that.
Anything that led him to pull the trigger was essentially guaranteed to pay for itself.
As for the targets that wouldn’t pay off, he generally had no need to fire at them.
He shook his head and decided not to worry about it. After all, it was better than nothing, and without further hesitation, he began to make large purchases with World Activity Points!
Level 1 Enhancement Stones, 3 Points each.
First, he bought 10,000 of them!
Enhancement Talismans, 50 Points each.
First, he bought 400 of them!
In total, he spent 50,000 Points, leaving a balance of 12,600 Points as a reserve. This many Enhancement Stones should be about enough.
He planned to enhance the main props he used as well as the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s props.
It was a pity he couldn’t enhance vehicles.
Enhancement, begin!
…
“Is enhancement this simple…?”
Zhong Kui looked at the C-grade prop in his hand with some hesitation; he had just rapidly enhanced this C-grade prop to +12.
It should be noted that he didn’t have many Points, and enhancing a C-grade prop once required one level 3 Enhancement Stone, equivalent to nine level 1 Enhancement Stones for synthesis, costing 27 Points per enhancement.
That was no small cost.
Being able to enhance to +12 under such circumstances meant that his every enhancement attempt was a success.
He didn’t use even one Enhancement Talisman, merely gambling that if any enhancement failed below +12, the prop wouldn’t be destroyed – it would merely drop to +6, so he decided to give it a try.
And just like that, he succeeded all the way to +12.
The probability of enhancing from +11 to +12 was only 2%.
“Damn it…”
Zhong Kui looked worriedly above him, somewhat concerned that he might have exhausted his good fortune for the rest of his life on this? It wouldn’t affect his lifespan, would it?
He didn’t dwell on this for long; instead, he turned his attention to the unique Prop Chest he received for ranking third on the leaderboard, which was globally exclusive, meaning whatever prop came out of it would only be owned by him in the entire world.
It could no longer be described as rare – it was a collector’s item!
A flash of white light passed, and a sparkling prop appeared in his hand.
“Prop Name”: Kitten Pendant.
“Prop Level”: Unique.
“Prop Effects”: When the prop is activated, your next punch will have its damage increased threefold, and it will come with a blinding light.
“Prop Restrictions”: Using it once will result in a 24-hour cooldown period.
“Prop Description”: “This is a pendant shaped like a kitten. Legend has it that a long time ago, a cute cat fell into amber and eventually became this prop.”
“Damage increase threefold?!”
Zhong Kui leaped up from the ground, his eyes full of excitement and ecstasy as he stared at the prop in front of him, his hands trembling constantly.
It could make his next punch’s damage three times more powerful!
He already had a skill that could triple his damage and a title effect that could do the same!
This increase wasn’t additive; it was multiplicative!
That means a total damage increase of 27 times!
The prop didn’t specify that it was only effective against female bosses, but he could activate these three skills simultaneously when facing a female boss. Then his next punch could potentially instantly take out the boss!
Zhong Kui, without any hesitation, quickly hung the pendant around his neck, pressing it against his chest with great care. His damage multiplication system was incredibly outrageous!
If he could acquire one more skill or prop that could triple damage,
then at that time, his punch would have an 81 times increase in damage!
He calculated a bit; he had seven empty skill slots, and if all seven could possess this kind of threefold damage increase, coupled with the title effect and prop effect,
At that time,
His punch could achieve, a 59,049 times increase in damage!!!
A punch with 60,000 times the damage, how could anyone compete with that!
Zhong Kui stood there, his expression one of excitement, his eyes filled with longing and aspiration for the future. This was the charm of the multiplier system!
By that time, even if he had to face a god, how could it not be slain?!
“`
“`
But soon, he stood silently in place, expressionless.
He had just silently calculated that when fighting the third layer world boss without activating any skills, his normal punch would deal a forced 1 point of damage.
Even if multiplied by 60,000, that was only 60,000 damage.
Even while fighting the second layer world boss, his punch would only deal a base damage of around 400.
After being multiplied by 60,000, that was merely 24 million.
It was still far from matching Chen Yi’s single shot of 3 million damage.
Was the gap between people really that huge? The peak strength he aspired to couldn’t even compare to Chen Yi’s current stage.
…
“Big brother.”
A somewhat skinny underling next to Li Yide spoke with a bit of worry, “Could the enhancement fail? The success rate has dropped to only 5% now.”
“Huh!”
Li Yide took out a D-class prop that had been enhanced to +3 from his chest, his expression grave, “Don’t worry, I have experience. In this situation, we just need to pad it a bit.”
“Let’s deliberately fail some enhancements first; then, after a sequence of failures, we can enhance our real target, this C-class prop.”
’Ding, not enough Enhancement Stones.’
“Out of Enhancement Stones?”
The prompt pulled Li Yide back to reality. He shook his head with a somewhat absent-minded emotion. He had gotten too carried away with enhancing just now and hadn’t paid attention to the number of his Enhancement Stones. He had actually run out, even for padding.
And at this time,
he noticed that the Points store in his personal panel, without knowing when, had also listed a new product.
Level 1 Enhancement Stone, 10 Points each.
Buy?
Buy!
Li Yide clenched his teeth and bought 200 Level 1 Enhancement Stones, continuing the enhancement process. Today, he must enhance this C-class prop to +12!
When enhanced to +12, not only would the prop be much stronger but it would also gain a Special Effect, and most importantly, a very dazzling light effect!
When a prop is enhanced to +6, a faint white light effect will appear on its surface.
And enhanced to +12, the entire surface of the prop will have a bright white light effect, which is very eye-catching.
In Yancheng, amongst the players, he prided himself on being a high-level player, second only to Chen Yi. How could he step out without a +12 prop now, where would he put his face?
…
Players around the world were trying out this new enhancement feature, even those without points wanted to spend a little to buy an Enhancement Stone to give it a try.
It’s not expensive.
At 10 Points each, nearly everyone could afford it.
Whether it’s taking quests in the city’s quest hall or going outside to kill monsters, earning 10 Points is not a hard task.
The first-time enhancement chance for an E-class prop is a hundred percent success, so most players were willing to give enhancing a shot.
On Chen Yi’s side, his own enhancement journey was also completed.
Points spent to the last.
All the reserved points were exchanged by Chen Yi for Enhancement Stones; he even bought 20,000 Points’ worth of Enhancement Stones and 10,000 Points’ worth of Protection Talismans from the store.
After spending who knows how many Enhancement Stones and Protection Talismans,
he had finally finished enhancing all of his props!
’Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle +21!’
’After enhancement, each percentage-based bullet costs 0 Points.’
’New Special Effect added at +6: “Gentleman’s Cane.”’
