’When the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle is transformed into the Christmas Cane, and you’re leaning on the cane, you can activate this effect to shoot a flare bullet with an explosive effect towards the depths of the earth. Then, this bullet can be controlled by your mind, shooting out from any underground angle, catching the enemy off guard with a fierce attack!’
’This bullet has no percentage-based damage effect; its damage strength is roughly equal to an armor-piercing bullet from a heavy sniper.’
’No cooldown, but activating this effect once will cost 100 Points.’
His most frequently used primary weapon was enhanced to +21, not because it was his limit, but because a B-class prop could only be enhanced up to +21!
He was quite satisfied with the newly added Special Effect. Despite lacking any percentage damage, it had the power of an armor-piercing bullet from heavy armor. This meant that in the future, if he faced any small fry provoking him,
he wouldn’t have to aim the gun barrel into their eye sockets anymore.
He just needed to point the barrel at the ground and fire a shot, after which, a bullet would burst from the ground beneath the enemy!
This greatly resolved the issue of not being able to deal with minor threats quickly and efficiently.
He was very fond of this Special Effect.
After enhancing to +21, his sniper rifle was covered in a dynamic light effect like a black shooting star, making it extremely eye-catching, like a luxury item.
And when the sniper rifle transformed into a cane, the dynamic light effect, similar to that of a black shooting star, still enveloped the cane. This turned the Christmas Cane, which might have seemed somewhat frivolous, into something looking very noble and elegant.
While Titles are forced to show, this light effect can be freely turned on or off by the player.
“Not bad.”
Chen Yi naturally chose to turn it on. He leaned on the cane that used to be a sniper rifle in his hand, looking at the flowing black meteor light effect on the cane’s surface, he nodded in satisfaction.
Quite good-looking.
He liked it.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 124 - 123: "+6 New Special Effect: ’Ravenous Wolf’s Fanged Tooth.
chapters.content:
Chapter 124 – 123: “+6 New Special Effect: ’Ravenous Wolf’s Fanged Tooth.
And this thing had cost him more than 8,000 level 1 Enhancement Stones and over 70 Enhancement Talismans.
“…”
Remembering the entire enhancement process, Chen Yi couldn’t help but feel a toothache, this thing was too expensive, even with his resources, he was starting to feel the strain.
Every time the enhancement failed, it was like throwing a large sum of points into the water.
Continue your adventure with empire
Even so, he considered himself lucky.
He hadn’t failed too many times.
After all, enhancing a B-level prop once required 27 level 1 Enhancement Stones, and from +6 onwards, each enhancement required an Enhancement Talisman.
Besides that, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s Red Moon Claw Knife had also been enhanced.
’Red Moon Claw Knife +16’
’After enhancement, every three sentences spoken will increase the charge progress by one.’
’+6 new Special Effect: “Ravenous Wolf’s Fanged Tooth.”’
’When this effect is activated, the Red Moon Claw Knife will transform, covering the two canines in your mouth with a silver glow, greatly enhancing your biting force.’
’No cooldown time; if you wish, the Red Moon Claw Knife can permanently cover your canines.’
This enhancement effect was very significant, greatly shortening the charge time. Like the last time, the blade aura they unleashed outside the city required more than ten days of charging.
But now, if they wanted to unleash that level of blade aura again, it would only take three or four days of charging.
Coupled with Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dreaming ability, even if they had just used it up during the day, they would have a decent charge after just one night.
The new special effect seemed a bit mysterious in its use.
It greatly increased biting force, but in most cases, they probably wouldn’t need to use their teeth as weapons against enemies; the only usefulness might be that one wouldn’t need to wear dentures to enjoy meat crisply in old age.
+16 is the enhancement limit for C-level props.
It cost nearly 5,000 level 1 Enhancement Stones and over 50 Enhancement Talismans in total.
Besides that, there was his Septagon Badge.
’Septagon Badge +21’
’Enhancement Effect: Charging progress bar reduced from the original 10,000 to 2,000.’
’+6 new Special Effect: “Crocodile’s Tears.”’
’Each time you activate the Septagon Badge’s prop effect, you will collect a tear from a crocodile.’
The enhancement direction was somewhat similar to Tuberculosis Rabbit’s Red Moon Claw Knife, significantly increasing the charge speed.
This prop took the most Enhancement Stones to enhance, depleting his remaining Enhancement Stones and all his Protection Talismans.
With this, he also made a name for himself on the Global Prop Enhancement Leaderboard.
’Rank 28: Chen Yi, with 58 enhancement layers.’
But the number of enhancement layers for rank one was a bit exaggerated.
A full 117 layers.
“Liu Xiangzi?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit furrowed his brows and turned towards the top of the Global Prop Enhancement Layers Leaderboard with some confusion, “I’ve never heard of this name before. I just checked the system announcements, and this person doesn’t exist in the third layer of the World Boss Space.”
“Which means this person doesn’t have many points at all, and all the Enhancement Stones must have been bought with Points.”
“But the Prop Enhancement Leaderboard only counts the six props with the highest number of enhancement layers for each player. If this player has 117 layers, it means he must have six B-level props enhanced nearly to +21.”
“To have six B-level props is already unbelievable, Yi, you only have two B-level props, not to mention how many Points it would cost to enhance six B-level props to +21.”
“Anyone with that many Points and so many B-level props must be strong, so why haven’t we seen him in the third layer World Boss Space?”
“And…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced over the Global Prop Enhancement Leaderboard, “There are a lot of names on the leaderboard I have never heard of. I didn’t see them on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard, didn’t see them during the June 1st Children’s Day Limited Event, and also didn’t see them in the World Boss Space.”
“They are all rather unfamiliar names, yet these players have all found a good position on the enhancement leaderboard.”
“It feels strange, as if they’ve found some kind of bug?”
After carefully observing for a while, Chen Yi couldn’t come to a conclusion and could only shake his head, “There are always extraordinary people in this world; maybe it’s someone who is extremely lucky or perhaps someone who has quietly amassed a fortune of Points.”
“Who can be sure?”
Just as he was about to say something else.
He suddenly saw the message box on his personal panel flashing incessantly.
It was a message from Jiaye.
After scanning the chat and pondering for a moment, Chen Yi finally spoke, “Let’s leave the city first, Jiaye is looking for us.”
“Oh.”
…
He had also obtained two unique Prop Chests.
Regrettably, these two unique props couldn’t be used for enhancement, which caused him quite a bit of disappointment.
The enhanced Septagon Badge and the Christmas Cane were not only powerful in effect but also extremely fashionable items.
The two props had a surface effect of flowing black luster that looked glaringly eye-catching and very pretty.
“We’ve arrived.”
Chen Yi landed outside the city, stopped the sled on the ground, and walked briskly towards Jiaye, who was sitting on Tie Chui’s shoulder, supporting himself with a cane.
“That… that’s the light effect of a +21 enhanced prop?”
“Definitely, I’ve seen it in the prop light effect preview screen before, it looks really nice.”
As soon as these words fell, they instantly drew the attention of everyone present, with most players looking towards Chen Yi and whispering amongst themselves.
Whether it was the lighthouse-like title, the eye-catching sled, or the extremely cool prop light effect, it was destined that he would be the subject of discussion wherever he went.
And at this time.
The charge progress bar on the chest prop, the Septagon Badge, also started to soar. As long as there were people discussing him nearby, the charge progress bar of his Septagon Badge would increase.
For a moment, Chen Yi harvested numerous envious and admiring gazes.
“Not bad, so-so.”
Just as Li Yide, who was showing off his +12 reinforced C-grade prop Saint White Light effect to a girl, had not yet reveled in his pride for long, he suddenly saw everyone’s eyes looking towards one place.
This familiar scene made him gulp.
Sure enough, he turned around and saw Chen Yi’s figure.
To be precise, he didn’t actually see Chen Yi’s body, but the towering title. In all of Yancheng, no one but Chen Yi had that title.
After being silent for a while, he quietly retreated to the back of the crowd, already accustomed to it.
It’s just a pity that you can’t enhance a vehicle.
He actually really wanted to add a layer of this flowing light effect to his own vehicle, as it looked quite attractive.
…
By the time Chen Yi walked up to Jiaye, the charge of the Septagon Badge had already been completed, and he could activate the Septagon Badge at any moment. The charge speed of the enhanced Septagon Badge had significantly increased.
“Long time no see.”
Chen Yi walked up to Tie Chui, pulled out something from his embrace, handed it over, then lifted his head to look at Jiaye seated on Tie Chui’s shoulder and smiled, “It’s almost noon, shall we go have some lunch together first?”
“Sure, I’ll treat you, my brother and I have made quite a bit of Points recently.”
Jiaye, sitting on Tie Chui’s shoulder, brimmed with joy, her delicate, fair little feet beginning to sway back and forth irresistibly.
She had been feeling somewhat melancholic before seeing Chen Yi, her mood inexplicably low.
But for some reason, upon seeing Chen Yi, those melancholic feelings disappeared instantly, leaving only joy in her heart.
…
“Yi, this way please!”
It was still that hotpot restaurant.
The boss personally came out to greet them, pushing aside the waiting staff who were about to receive Chen Yi and his companions and stood beside Chen Yi with a bowed waist and a smile, “Yi, shall we sit at the same spot as last time?”
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi nodded, looked around the interior of the restaurant with a smile and said, “It’s much livelier than last time, it was a bit quiet when I came before, but this time there’s more of a bustling atmosphere.”
“All thanks to Yi’s patronage. Without your support, my little restaurant wouldn’t be doing so well.”
The boss stood respectfully beside Chen Yi, fully aware that Chen Yi had seen his own sign hanging at the entrance when he entered the restaurant, and this maneuver of his was somewhat like a fox taking advantage of a tiger’s might, and he could only hint at Chen Yi to see if he was willing to let this fox borrow a bit of prestige.
“Quite good.”
Chen Yi didn’t say much but instead walked towards an empty table not far away: “Let’s take a seat.”
They had been to this hotpot restaurant before, and the last time they had sat at this very table.
“Alright, please take a seat. I’ll arrange for the kitchen to prepare the pot and ingredients.”
After exchanging a few courteous words, the boss tactfully retreated.
“Jiaye.”
After sitting down, Chen Yi looked at Jiaye sitting across from him and asked, “Where did you go to earn Points these past few days?”
“Oh, that’s a long story.”
Jiaye sat on the bench, her eyes filled with excitement, wearing a white sundress, fiddling with her fingers as she began to expound at length, “Recently, my brother and I went to a map.”
“We discovered…”
The scene gradually became warmer.
Jiaye happily went on about her experiences over the past ten days.
Tie Chui sat beside Jiaye, not sure if he understood, with a silly grin on his face, occasionally glancing at the pack of cigarettes that Chen Yi had placed on the table, as if waiting for Chen Yi to offer him another cigarette.
Chen Yi, on the other hand, nodded continuously, serving as a good listener and occasionally giving natural exclamations of admiration and emotion at the right times.
As for… the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
He had been grinning foolishly ever since he sat down, flipping through his phone without stopping, seemingly engrossed in something.
…
The Tuberculosis Rabbit continued scrolling through the forums, checking the latest news while his belly heaved with suppressed laughter, holding it in his throat time and again!
The forums were filled with lots of news.
For example, the Sands of Time map they had pioneered.
This map now had many players from Yancheng and those from other cities with passage permits entering it, resulting in many interesting episodes.
For instance, there really were elderly and terminally ill people setting up residence in the Sands of Time Map.
They volunteered to be infected, turned into Dried Corpses, hid in the corners of the Sands of Time to retire, even building their own small ecosystems.

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 125 - 124: "I heard you cursing me.
chapters.content:
Chapter 125 – 124: “I heard you cursing me.
After becoming a Dried Corpse.
No need to eat, sleep, or drink.
No feelings of hunger or fatigue.
Being in an emotional state for 24 hours a day might be somewhat tormenting for most people, but for the elderly who were originally not well-adapted to the globalization of gaming, the Sands of Time was indeed a perfect retirement place.
Bring a set of chess, mahjong, or playing cards before entering the Sands of Time!
Then a series of ridiculous and far-fetched scenes ensued!
In the first layer of the Sands of Time, the entire map was engulfed in darkness, and the visibility for human players was only 1 meter!
Human players ran forward wildly with apprehensive expressions, constantly reading the information on the ground!
Following behind were countless younger Dried Corpse players, bursting with energy and ambition as they charged towards the human players, intent on infecting a few more to earn more points.
The whole scene looked extremely thrilling!
But there were other scenes in the dark.
Two old men who had become Dried Corpses sat in front of a chessboard, debating fervently, surrounded by numerous other Dried Corpse elders who were just as enthusiastically giving advice.
“Move the knight, if you don’t there’ll be double cannons!”
“Old Li, do you even know how to play chess?”
The ancients said, a true gentleman watches chess without speaking. Perhaps in ancient times, people were already aware of the existence of something terribly nasty known as ’pressure monsters.’
Meanwhile, in another dark corner, three old men and an old woman were gathered around a table.
“Four twos with a pair of jokers, anyone taking the four with two?”
“I’ll take it, I have five kings with sixes, five with six, I’ll cover you.”
At this point, the human players desperately running for their lives couldn’t hold back anymore. One of them looked angrily towards the source of the noise in the dark.
“Do you even know how to play cards? What kind of hand is five kings with sixes?”
“Can’t you see we’re running for our lives? Can’t you keep it down?”
Yet, the absurdity didn’t end there.
“The endless horizon is my love; at the foot of the rolling Green Mountains, flowers bloom. What rhythm sways the most, what song brings out the joy.” Find adventures at empire
An elegant melody slowly drifted from the dark.
Upon a closer look.
It turned out to be a group of Dried Corpse old ladies dancing a square dance in the dark, led by a group leader!
Is there a better place than the Sands of Time Map for square dancing?
Plenty of space, no one to complain about disturbing the peace, and even if someone did, there’s no need to pay any mind.
Moreover, there was no need to watch the time to go home to cook for their granddaughters, how carefree.
Just like that.
The style of the entire Sands of Time Map was distinctly split in two.
The east side was filled with an air of murderous intent, replete with cunning, internal strife, and bloody vendettas in a mad dash for survival.
On the west side, however, the air was imbued with a relaxed atmosphere, almost like a peaceful haven.
“Hahahaha!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t hold back his laughter any longer, he burst into laughter looking at those human players on the forums incessantly complaining about the increasing number of Dried Corpse old ladies causing disturbances in the Sands of Time Map!
Besides that.
Players also developed many ways to play on the Sands of Time Map.
For instance, some bet on human nature, picking up the Dried Corpse Grenades meant to clear the second level’s passages but not using them, instead saving them to score big points in the Corpse Pit of the fourth level.
Without Dried Corpse Grenades, it was inevitable that the second level’s passageway wouldn’t be cleared quickly, resulting in several more players getting infected.
But these players clearly didn’t care, adopting the attitude of, let a companion die rather than a poor one.
Beyond that, there were other derived styles of play such as ghost leading the way, traitorous insider, never looking back, adding more randomness to the map, making it much more interesting than their first time pioneering it.
Then there was the wilderness map.
Before entering the map, the rules stated that when they left the map, the next batch of players would invade as attackers targeting the houses built by the first batch of players.
The first batch of players had already come out.
But clearly, these people were quite ticked off, angrily ranting on the forum, piling up thousands of posts!
Other players, realizing what had happened to this batch, couldn’t help but sympathize with them.
According to the rules, these players would be teleported into the wilderness, then they were to chop down trees to make tools such as trebuchets to attack the players’ buildings. But the reality was—
No sooner had these players been teleported into the map than they found a wall of air behind them and a tall wall in front of them.
Moving forward or backward was out of the question.
Even turning around was extremely difficult.
A look at the map revealed that among the previous batch of players who built houses in the wilderness, one player named Tuberculosis Rabbit built a house as big as the wilderness map itself.
And they couldn’t land inside the house.
So they dropped down in the space between the air wall and the tall wall.
To make matters worse, behind the wall was a series of arrow towers constantly attacking them, making them thankful that they could revive on the spot, yet hating the fact that they could revive on the spot!
They were shot to death by the arrow towers in this tight crevice, only to resurrect in the very same place!
The talk of chopping wood and making tools was pure nonsense—were there even any trees left on the map? Nothing but emptiness, as if the enemy had swept through the village!
And the duration of the map was 24 hours.
Thus, these players spent 24 hours dying and resurrecting in the tight gap, lying there as if in a water dungeon. The moment they were let out, they immediately logged onto the Yancheng forum and began to furiously and ferociously curse at Tuberculosis Rabbit!
Tuberculosis Rabbit, while laughing merrily, flipped through the posts cursing him, nodding with satisfaction.
That was the effect he desired.
He got exactly the effect he wanted.
“What are you laughing at?”
Chen Yi glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit who sat beside him, amusing himself, and asked curiously.
“Nothing, nothing at all,”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit’s abdomen heaved as he tried to suppress his laughter, waving his hand to indicate everything was alright.
Chen Yi didn’t press further but stood up and headed towards the bathroom. “I’m going to use the restroom, help me mix the dipping sauce.”
“Oh, sure, no problem.”
Upon hearing this, Tuberculosis Rabbit put down his phone and walked toward the sauce station.
Yi had a habit when eating hot pot; one round would be plain, and the remaining three required different dipping sauces for seasoning.
…
“Ah.”
Just as Chen Yi had left the restroom, he saw a woman in a tight skirt, fishnet stockings, and high heels who seemed to have twisted her ankle, tumbling toward him.
“Bang.”
Chen Yi’s expression changed, and without the slightest hesitation, he pulled out a sniper rifle from his embrace, pressed it against the woman’s body, pulled the trigger, and immediately fired a shot her way.
A slightly muffled gunshot abruptly rang out in the space.
“…”
The woman, about to speak with an apologetic look, suddenly stiffened, feeling the sharp pain inside her and the warm muzzle against her abdomen. She was stunned for nearly ten seconds.
Only after confirming she wasn’t dead but merely had a nosebleed, did a flicker of fear and bewilderment cross her eyes as she looked at Chen Yi and asked in a trembling voice, “What are you doing?”
She had no idea what was going on.
Why had Chen Yi suddenly fired his gun?
Were there any signs?
Had there been no signs at all?
“Who are you?”
Chen Yi’s eyes twinkled coldly, the gun still firmly against the woman’s abdomen as he stared into her eyes and spoke word by word.
“Don’t you know who I am?”
“If you don’t know who I am, why the hell did you shoot?!”
The woman looked at Chen Yi with an expression close to breaking down, feeling somewhat lost on how to proceed, “I just accidentally fell, why did you suddenly shoot?”
“Take off your clothes.”
Chen Yi said emotionlessly to the woman before him.
“What did you say?”
“Take off your clothes, my patience is limited.”
The woman looked up and glared at Chen Yi, seeing his serious expression and remembering the man’s command. She bit her lip, closed her eyes with a sense of humiliation, and removed her tight skirt.
At that moment, she just hoped no one would pass by to spare her some dignity.
Chen Yi’s expression told her that if she did not comply, she might indeed die there today.
She didn’t want to die.
“Your underwear too.”
With her eyes tightly closed and no resistance, the woman’s chest heaved as she removed all her clothing and then covered her chest with her arms, “Are you satisfied now? What exactly do you want?”
Chen Yi didn’t speak but used his sniper rifle like a cane, scanning the woman’s body. After confirming she wasn’t hiding blades in her hair, clothes, or other places, he nodded.
He didn’t hear the woman cursing him in her heart.
Although there was still a possibility she had aggressive props in her backpack, the likelihood she was here to assassinate him was now very low.
If she had come to assassinate him, the prop would have been on her person, and she would have only a moment to act after falling. Taking a dagger out of a backpack to attempt an assassination would waste too much time.
The instant the woman fell towards him, he had only one thought: this woman was here to kill her.
There was no deduction.
He was well aware his profile had been quite high lately, and it was normal for someone to make a move on him; he had been on guard for such an eventuality.
After ensuring there was no issue,
Chen Yi turned and walked back towards the main hall, leaving behind a remark.
“Be more careful when you walk next time.”
“…”
The woman crouching on the ground, clutching her clothes to her chest and curling up in the corner, watched Chen Yi’s departing figure with resentment and anger flashing in her eyes, and cursed inwardly.
Madman, nothing but a madman!
Wait until the day I make you fall in love with me, I’ll get my revenge by shitting and pissing on your head!
Just having a few props doesn’t make you the Local Tyrant!
Gao Yiming, that bastard, has the nerve to make me deal with such a freak. Does he not realize I almost died here?
Just then—
The woman suddenly noticed Chen Yi had returned. A hint of hope appeared in her eyes, and an imperceptible gleam of joy as she deliberately shifted the clothing covering her private areas down a little.
Stretching out her fair arm, she rubbed her ankle with a voice tinged with complaint and allure.
“Now you realize you should come and apologize?”
However, the young man stood in front of her, one step away, with no expression on his face as he said quietly, “I heard you cursing me.”
“What?”
The woman was stunned, disbelief and fear flashing in the depths of her eyes as she denied instinctively, “I didn’t, I really didn’t, I swear.”
“I heard it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 126 - 125: "I Confess, I Confess, I’ll Confess Everything!
chapters.content:
Chapter 126 – 125: “I Confess, I Confess, I’ll Confess Everything!
Chen Yi didn’t speak further; instead, he stood in front of the woman, raising the cane in his hand and aimed it at the kneeling woman’s head before bringing it down fiercely.
“Bang.”
She fell asleep instantly, neat and tidy.
He glanced at the woman who had fainted on the ground, squatted down to lightly stroke her pale nape, and then rose to his feet without another word and left.
He wasn’t clear about the woman’s real purpose in approaching him.
But two things were certain.
First, the woman had intentionally bumped into him to create the opportunity for contact.
Second, the woman cursed him in her heart.
From these two facts, it could be inferred that the woman had ill intentions towards him. Knowing this was enough. The current environment was unstable. People died and no one cared, and some even were unaware of such incidents.
When one’s own safety was uncertain, who had the leisure to pay attention to others?
The so-called ill intentions naturally had to do with the Props in his possession or Points or somesuch; in any case, none of it was good.
Upon returning to his seat, Chen Yi had just sat down when the owner approached with a food cart full of dishes, greeting them with a full-face smile, “Gentlemen, please.”
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi waved a hand to signal for the cart to be placed beside the table before looking up casually at the owner, “There’s a woman by the restroom who was about to attack me. I knocked her unconscious.”
“On your turf, I didn’t lift a finger.”
“You deal with it.”
“Ah?”
The owner first looked startled, then nodded solemnly, “Don’t worry, Yi. I will take care of it seriously.”
“Mhm, go on.”
After the owner had left.
Tuberculosis Rabbit dropped a plate of lamb into the boiling red oil pot. The red and white slices of meat surged up and down in the hot oil, looking particularly appetizing.
The air was filled with the aroma of chili oil and lamb.
Several pieces of green vegetables floated in the adjoining clear broth pot.
On the table, there were also a few bottles of chilled Sour Plum Soup, the condensation on the glass bottles was so tangible that just one glance would make one feel the coolness; drinking a chilled bottle of Sour Plum Soup in the scorching summer heat was an extreme relief.
Then, with a slight expression of surprise, she spoke, “Someone actually tried to harm you in the restroom just now, Yi? And it was a woman? Didn’t she see the string of titles above your head?”
“Let’s not talk about that.”
Chen Yi picked up a piece of meat with his chopsticks and placed it in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s bowl, shaking his head, “Let’s eat first. It’s not easy to get a break, relax your mind a bit.”
It was precisely noon, and the daily task for June’s rules had arrived.
He left the woman to the owner because if she could lie in wait for him in the restroom of this hotpot restaurant, it was very strange. He suspected that the woman had been sent by the owner or had some connection with him.
The hotpot restaurant’s food was quite good, and if the situation wasn’t true, he didn’t wish to send the owner to hell.
After all, he planned to come back a few more times in the future.
After knocking out the woman, he had hidden a small eavesdropping device in her hair, an E-grade Prop that was quite useful. He could listen in on how the owner dealt with the woman and gather information to help him make judgments.
Meanwhile, Jiaye was staring blankly at the lamb in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dish.
When Yi picked up the piece of lamb with his chopsticks, she was all set to graciously say thank you, but the next second she saw Yi put the lamb into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s bowl!
She lifted her head, her eyes weakly focusing on the piece of lamb in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dish, knowing that her journey of pursuit would be long and expecting many obstacles along the way!
Such as a certain elegant and dignified woman who was betrothed to Yi before the apocalypse.
Or perhaps the childhood sweetheart who grew up with Yi.
But she hadn’t expected…
That the barrier would be Tuberculosis Rabbit!
Jiaye bit her lip lightly, holding her chopsticks while looking toward the boiling lamb slices in the red oil pot, unable to utter a word for a long while, finally managing to look up at Yi and cautiously ask.
“Yi, do you remember the limited-time event on May 20th?”
“What about it?”
Chen Yi placed a bottle of chilled Sour Plum Soup in front of himself, a bit puzzled, “I remember. It wasn’t that long ago; how could I forget?”
“During that event, there was a limited-time title, wasn’t there? One could get a title just by confessing to their loved one. I suddenly thought of a bug in this event—it didn’t specify the opposite sex, right? Do you think it’s possible to get a title by confessing to someone of the same sex you love?” Experience new stories with empire
She suspected that the title above Yi’s head was acquired from Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“Perhaps.”
Chen Yi responded with a wry twist of his mouth, casually saying, “Maybe, I’m not sure and don’t care to delve into it. I don’t have any aversion to the same sex, but no particular fondness either.”
“Oh.”
Jiaye relaxed slightly, reassured that it wasn’t Tuberculosis Rabbit. Otherwise, she really wouldn’t know how to deal with it.
It must’ve been her overthinking.
After all, Tuberculosis Rabbit had taken her brother to Silver Party last time; it couldn’t possibly be him.
…
Meanwhile, the hotpot restaurant owner, looking at the woman he had moved to the kitchen, kept his face somber and silent.
He didn’t know who had sent the woman or if she had acted on her own, but in any case, she indeed tried to harm Chen Yi on his turf.
This put him in a very bad situation.
Any normal person would certainly think right away that this woman was sent by him.
If he offended Chen Yi, without Chen Yi’s backing, his hot pot restaurant would definitely not be able to remain as peaceful and trouble-free as it is now, or even worse, it might not just be about the restaurant—he himself might end up dead.
So this matter had to be handled neatly, efficiently, and cleanly!
Then he looked at the woman lying on the tiles in front of him, a long-legged beauty dressed in a tight miniskirt, and shook his head regretfully, “Such a beautiful woman, why are you so careless when you act?”
“You think you can mess with that guy?”
“Xiaoliu, do it neatly, kill her.”
He had never killed anyone before in his previous life.
But after his return to this world, he had killed four or five people.
No choice.
If he didn’t kill, they would kill him.
Many were jealous of his hot pot restaurant; nighttime attacks, a scenario that should only exist in stories, actually happened in reality. Those four or five people were ones who sneaked into the hot pot restaurant at night trying to attack him and ended up being silently taken down by him.
In such chaotic times, human life became cheap.
Then he prepared to turn around and leave the kitchen to hand over the task to Xiaoliu. Xiaoliu had been detained once before the tumultuous times began, and after being released, he had difficulty finding work and had been following him around ever since, proving fairly loyal.
After the troubled times began, he had also blocked quite a few knives for him.
This man was near perfect—hardworking, brave, meticulous, extremely loyal, desireless, and without requests—except for one fatal flaw.
Xiaoliu was lecherous.
Not just any lechery, he was obsessed with women.
“Qiang!”
The bald man, who was wearing an apron and picking vegetables, leaped up from the bench, looked at the woman lying on the floor with some excitement in his gasping breath.
“Hmm.”
The boss turned to look at the bald man, furrowed his brows and said, “Be quick and clean about it, this woman must die. This matter was ordered by Yi. If this woman escapes alive…”
“Yi will definitely assume we were in cahoots with this woman, and then there will be trouble.”
“Rest assured, Qiang, I know how to be discreet.”
“As long as you know, I’ll leave first. Make it quick.”
He didn’t know where Xiaoliu got that flaw, but he knew that the reason Xiaoliu ended up in detention after the troubled times began was because of this. That fool broke into the morgue.
Just as he was about to step away,
Xiaoliu suddenly spoke again, “Qiang, didn’t you say this woman was trying to harm Yi? Shouldn’t we interrogate her first, find out who sent her?”
“No need. Yi didn’t give us that order, so let’s not complicate things. We don’t need to know too much; after all, we are just a hot pot restaurant.”
“Understood.”
After the boss left,
The bald man stepped forward without any hesitation, his hands forcefully covering the woman’s mouth and nose. The woman quickly woke up and struggled fiercely in resistance.
“Bang!”
In desperation, the struggling woman suddenly kneed the bald man in the stomach. The bald man, in pain, instinctively hunched over, his hands loosening, allowing the woman a gasp of breath!
“I confess, I confess, I’ll tell everything!”
“Gao Yiming sent me here, Gao Yiming told me to get close to Chen Yi, to sleep with Chen Yi, to make Chen Yi fall in love with me, so that he could control Chen Yi through me.”
“I’ve told you everything, please don’t kill me, I beg you!”
The woman looked at the man straddling her with eyes full of fear, her voice whimpering, her body struggling continuously.
However… the bald man didn’t hear a thing.
“Who asked you, really, why can’t you just keep quiet and not disturb me,”
The bald man complained a bit annoyedly, then bent down to hold the woman in his arms, wrapping his arm around her fair neck, and whispered in her ear.
“Relax, it will be over soon.”
“Don’t be nervous, it will only hurt for a little while, then you won’t feel a thing.”
As the man’s arms slowly tightened, the woman’s initial fierce struggle due to suffocation gradually subsided until her toes tensed and her gaze became vacant. Minutes later, she was completely still.
After confirming she was gone, the man glanced around and seeing no one was around, he took out a custom-made mask from his bosom and put it on the woman’s head.
“So beautiful…”
He stared dreamily at the familiar yet strange face on the mask, gently stroking it while he unbuttoned her clothes.
“I missed you.”
…
“…”
Chen Yi silently chewed on a piece of mutton he had picked up with his chopsticks; he could confirm that this hot pot restaurant had no connection to that woman. But he also overheard that there was a pervert in the kitchen of this restaurant.
But that was none of his concern.
Nor did he have any thoughts of heroically proclaiming justice on behalf of heaven and leaping out to kill the pervert on the spot.
Yet, he did pick up an extra piece of information: the woman had been sent by Gao Yiming.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 127 - 126: "+6 Enhancement Special Effect: Final Retrospect.
chapters.content:
Chapter 127 – 126: “+6 Enhancement Special Effect: Final Retrospect.
Gao Yiming.
A somewhat unfamiliar name, it seemed like he was a company boss who had sent people to capture him once after the apocalypse descended, but then there was silence.
Hmm, I’ll slaughter him after dinner.
After making the decision casually, Chen Yi stopped paying attention to the matter. There was another person in Black Trench City waiting to be slaughtered anyway; he would take care of it after finishing his meal.
An hour and a half later.
“Phew!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit exhaled deeply, slouching in his chair with a lack of image and gazing at the ceiling with a vacant look, “I don’t want to eat hotpot again within a month; it’s too greasy.”
“Let’s eat something light for a while.”
“Or, Yi, should we maybe check on the neighbors upstairs? Their cooking is quite tasty, and if we give them some Points every month and have them deliver meals to us daily, that should be good for them too.”
“After all, getting Points from us is much easier than fighting monsters outside the city.”
“That…”
Jiaye hesitated and spoke uncertainly, “How about I deliver meals to you guys every day? I can cook.”
“You can cook?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was momentarily stunned, then suddenly perked up, his eyes shining brightly as he sat up, “Well, that would be great, but we still need to see what Yi thinks.”
“No.”
Chen Yi shook his head, “There’s also some distance between where you live and where we live. It would be quite troublesome to do this every day, not necessary.”
“Okay then.”
Jiaye lowered her head; there was no disappointment in her eyes but rather a slight excitement.
After Tuberculosis Rabbit’s suggestion, she had just come up with a fantastic idea. Why not just move next to Yi’s place?
With Tie Chui around, who would dare not to free up a room for her?
I’ll beat you up.
…
After the meal.
Chen Yi and his companion said goodbye to Jiaye, driving the sled to hover above Yancheng, landing on the rooftop of a tall building.
“That office building opposite is Gao Yiming’s.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood at the edge of the rooftop, looking towards the office building across and introduced, “However, after the apocalypse arrived, the office building lost its original commercial attributes and is basically a residential building now.”
“It’s unclear whether Gao Yiming will come here.”
“To find one person among so many players in Yancheng, honestly speaking, it’s actually a bit troublesome, probably even the Law Enforcement Bureau would find it hard to precisely locate a person here now.”
However, just then—
They suddenly saw a man in a suit holding a wine glass, slowly walking in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows on the top floor of the opposite building, looking down outside.
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood silently with a peculiar expression, not knowing what to say.
“Is that man Gao Yiming?”
Chen Yi looked down at the photo in his hand, then raised his head to look at the young man in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows, comparing carefully.
“It seems like it is.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t know what opinion to express for a moment. He hadn’t expected to find the man so quickly, nor why the man would stay in the office building after the apocalypse descended.
But anyway, they had found him.
Now the question was what to do about it.
“If we crash the sled directly into it, a lot of bystanders are going to die.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the pedestrians around the building with his tongue in cheek. They could indeed control the sled and roll over with that 30-meter-long blade, but then countless pieces of debris and concrete bricks would shoot down from high, like bullets.
It would likely kill quite a few bystanders.
“No need for such trouble.”
Chen Yi stood still, changed his Christmas Cane back into the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle in his hand, activated the Septagon Badge, aimed at the young man beside the window, and gently pulled the trigger.
Hundreds of barrels suddenly appeared beside him.
“Bang!”
A hundred gunshots merged into one, echoing heavily on the rooftop.
A hundred bullets, each trailing a dark glow like a comet, shattered the glass and headed straight for the young man’s chest…
Then, Tuberculosis Rabbit saw the young man who had been standing by the floor-to-ceiling window suddenly vanish on the spot, and when he reappeared with a flash, he had actually dodged the bullets and was now on the roof of the building.
His eyes held a trace of fear and anger as he looked towards them.
“Yo, he’s not dead?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was a bit surprised. He hadn’t expected the man to have the ability to teleport and managed to dodge the bullets and run to the rooftop. He immediately jumped into the sled, ready to throttle down.
But just then—
The bullets that had apparently missed suddenly turned around and burst out from the top floor, shooting straight at Gao Yiming’s chest on the rooftop.
“Thump!”
Until they hit!
Gao Yiming, who had just been standing on the rooftop of the office building, exploded into a mist of blood in the air.
“…”
Watching the scene unfold before him, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly fell silent and turned to look at Yi. “Yi, your bullets can turn corners now? How come I didn’t know?”
“I didn’t know before either.”
Chen Yi shook his head. “Let’s go and take a look,” he said.
Only then did he step onto the sleigh.
He knew that his Septagon Badge had a prop effect that ensured all bullets would definitely hit the enemy’s heart, which was akin to a damage-locking effect, but what he was unclear about was whether this effect also came with a tracking ability.
This wasn’t clearly indicated in the prop effects.
And how it determined the effect was also unknown.
Could it be that even if he fired the gun into the sky, the bullets would still track and shoot into an enemy’s heart?
Later on, when he got to Black Trench City, he would experiment with that guy called Wang Yimei to see what the situation was. His name was too hard to remember.
He only knew this was a man who smiled at him on the surface but constantly cursed him in his heart.
Such men often tended to do harm behind others’ backs.
Maybe one day in the future, something bad might come from this guy’s hands.
It was better to eliminate him early and thereby remove a potential security hazard ahead of time.
…
“Here.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood atop the rooftop of an office building, picked up a prop from the bloodied ground, carefully wiped it several times with a handkerchief from his pocket, and then handed the prop over to Yi.
“A few props dropped. The probability for props to drop is too low; almost none fall out of the backpack. Only the props that are carried have a higher chance of dropping.”
“That Gao Yiming must have survived thanks to this prop.”
’Prop Name’: Extreme Escape +16.
’Prop Level’: C grade.
’Prop Effect’: When you are about to receive a fatal strike, this prop will activate automatically and teleport you to any random point within a hundred meters.
’Enhancement Direction’: Number of uses!
’Prop Limitation’: Number of uses (4/7).
’Prop Introduction’: “Survive!!!”
Chen Yi looked thoughtfully at the prop in his hand. It was a great life-saving prop with a total of seven uses; Gao Yiming had used it four times, meaning it could be used three more times.
It was also a C-grade prop enhanced to +16.
The enhancement limit for C-grade props is +16.
The limit for B-grade props is +21, for D-grade it is +12, and for E-grade, it is +6.
As for the enhancement limit of A-grade props, he was not sure.
At that moment, there was an additional piece of information on the props panel.
’+6 Enhancement Special Effect: Retrospective Gaze.’ Upon being killed, you will turn into nothingness, circling above your body for 30 minutes. During this time, you can take one last look at the world that bore you and reflect on your life, so you can die peacefully without regrets.’
’+12 and +16 Enhancements, the Special Effects title seemed to be covered by some dust, which might be removed using a “clean grey stone” to see the Special Effects title.’
The +6 enhancement special effect of this prop, aside from whether it was of any use.
Just the +12 and +16 enhancement special effects, covered by dust and requiring a “clean grey stone” to remove the dust and reveal the title effect, was information he had seen in many places.
For instance, his own ’Septagon Badge,’ ’Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle,’ and Tuberculosis Rabbit’s ’Red Moon Claw Knife.’
All these props were fully enhanced, but only the +6 special effect could be viewed; the other special effects were obscured, and only a “clean grey stone” could reveal them.
Different levels of props have different enhancement limits, which also determines how many special effects a prop can have.
For example, his ’Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle +21’ was enhanced to four tiers: +6, +12, +16, +21.
In theory, it should have four special effects, but only the +6 enhancement special effect is visible; the remaining three tiers of special effects are covered by dust.
Such crappy settings.
A prop panel covered by dust? What kind of dust is that powerful?
Even if they said it was obscured by an unknown mysterious force, he could accept it, but to come up with dust…
He had seen this text elsewhere as well.
That was the ’Great Demon King’ title he obtained from the world boss event. The special effect of that title was also obscured by dust and required a “clean grey stone” to be revealed.
But neither in the points store from the world boss event nor in the Points Store did he find this prop.
He was also unclear about the production path of the “clean grey stone.”
It meant that many of his fully enhanced props were not able to exhibit their full power.
Chen Yi shook his head and said nothing more, instead handing the prop back to Tuberculosis Rabbit. “You keep this prop. You don’t have any means of self-defense, and with this prop, you will have an extra means of survival.”
“Yi…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit initially looked at Yi with a feigned expression of gratitude and then, upon seeing Yi’s displeased expression, retracted his poor act. “You take it, Yi. I’m really careful and always hide behind you, so I’m hardly in any danger.”
“If there really is a danger you can’t handle, Yi, having this prop won’t do me any good.”
“At best, like Gao Yiming, I’ll just change locations before I die, finding a good spot with nice feng shui for my grave.”
“No need.”
Chen Yi shook his head, unwilling to elaborate further on this matter, and continued to look down at the few remaining props in his arms. “I have that man’s vest defensive prop; it’s enough for me.” Find exclusive stories on empire

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 128 - 127: "Prop Storage Room!
chapters.content:
Chapter 128 – 127: “Prop Storage Room!
“Oh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, somewhat hesitantly accepting the prop and stuffing it into his chest. He knew the prop Yi was referring to.
A man’s tank top.
It could protect a player from damage based on their fashion scoring.
The higher the player’s fashion scoring, the more damage they could withstand.
It was a limited-edition prop, which was snatched up during the June 1st Children’s Day limited-time sale event. He had one as well.
He actually wanted to say that he also had this prop.
But after some thought, he decided not to say anything because he knew Yi didn’t like this kind of push-and-pull. He simply accepted the prop into his possession.
Although he thought he didn’t really need the prop since he was almost always running behind Yi.
If he ever reached a crisis where he needed to use this prop, Yi would probably be in trouble too. If Yi couldn’t escape, there would be no point in him doing so.
Then he suddenly thought of something, looked up into the sky, and said with a grin, “Almost forgot about you, Gao Yiming. Where are you? Make some noise, let’s see.”
“Let me feel it?”
“If not, perhaps you can haunt my dreams tonight and give me a scare?”
The “+6 enhancement special effect” of the “Extreme Escape” prop was kind of nonsensical. It allowed a player’s ghost to hover over their body for 30 minutes after death so they could reflect on their life and take another look at the world that raised them.
Continue your adventure at empire
A special effect that offered no help in combat.
Even an effect that couldn’t be used while alive.
But whether to mention it or not, for many people, perhaps this effect was acceptable. After all, having 30 minutes after death to summarize one’s life was a nice thing.
However, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t accept this special effect at all and secretly made up his mind to throw away this prop before he died.
He had an obsession.
It was to smoke a cigarette before dying. He absolutely couldn’t end up like those characters in movies who shake as they lift a cigarette to their lips before dying, never getting a chance to light it. That would be way too annoying.
This prop was the nemesis of his obsession.
Could he even light a cigarette as a ghost?
Definitely not!
Tuberculosis Rabbit secretly resolved to practice hard when he got back, hoping to improve the series of actions from lighting to smoking a cigarette from 0.7 seconds to 0.6 seconds.
But then he looked around somewhat unenthusiastically, saying with a click of his tongue, “No reaction, huh? Can’t interact? So the ghost doesn’t have any ability to affect reality, right?”
“That’s really dull.”
“Was hoping to hear you spout a few harsh words at us. I mean, you couldn’t be idle. You had to send a woman to assassinate Yi, as if you were looking for trouble.”
“Sending her was fine, but we were pondering how to find you, and then you showed up in front of the floor-to-ceiling window as if you were afraid we wouldn’t see you.”
“Really, it’s as if we would be doing you a disservice by not killing you.”
“Pfft!”
Above Gao Yiming’s body, a spectral figure glared down at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a ferocious face, roaring loudly, “Damn it, damn it!!”
However, Tuberculosis Rabbit showed no reaction, evidently not hearing the man’s words.
The so-called separation of the worlds of the living and the dead might just be this.
He never expected that the woman he sent out would dare to assassinate Chen Yi. He had clearly ordered her to seduce Chen Yi. He didn’t dare to assassinate Chen Yi himself. How could that woman have the gall?
That damn woman, ruining his plans!!!
What he hated most was why he had to be in front of the floor-to-ceiling window. Had he not been there, it would have been much harder for Chen Yi to find him, and that time would have been enough for him to hear about it and prepare.
But then he still watched Tuberculosis Rabbit with eyes full of hatred and resentment, the corners of his mouth slowly curling into a cold smile.
And he looked at a prop panel in front of him.
’Prop Name’: Vengeful Spirit+1.
’Prop Level’: C grade.
’Prop Effect’: When you die, you don’t die immediately. Instead, you can become a demon and enter any player’s dreams, but you cannot cause any real harm to the player. Once the player wakes up, you will die completely.
’Enhancement Direction’: Number of players (At +3, you can enter the dreams of two players as a demon after death).
’Prop Restriction’: Only activates after the player’s death.
’Prop Description’: “Some people are dead yet still alive, others are alive yet have long since been dead.”
This prop was one he got from the limited 520 Valentine’s Day promotion, an 88 Points gift pack!
A pretty useless prop!
It could only be used after death; totally useless while alive!
He thought he would never have to use this prop in his lifetime, but now, unexpectedly, he had found a use for it. Before Chen Yi and others arrived, he had even tried to enhance it.
Originally, he hoped that the enhancement direction would allow the prop to be used while alive.
Under the influence of the rules in May, this prop, capable of intruding into a player’s dreams and creating nightmares, could be said to be invincible.
Unfortunately, the enhancement direction was the number of players.
Not what he had in mind.
He only enhanced it once and left it at that, but now… this prop really came in handy.
The spectral image of Gao Yiming, filled with resentment, glared at Chen Yi one last time and then, with regret, locked his target onto Tuberculosis Rabbit. He activated the prop and his body dissipated into a wisp of blue smoke.
Leaving behind only an arrogant and refreshing laughter!
He had no qualms with Chen Yi; he knew that Chen Yi was fearless, and this prop couldn’t affect Chen Yi.
But Tuberculosis Rabbit was different.
According to his investigation, Tuberculosis Rabbit was just a bit thick-skinned and bold, not entirely fearless.
As long as he infiltrated the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dreams and created terror, the Tuberculosis Rabbit would surely die. Under the May rules, if a person thought of something bizarre in their sleep for more than 3 seconds, they would explode on the spot.
Although he couldn’t kill Chen Yi, he could let Chen Yi experience the agony of a brother’s death.
…
After yelling for a while with no response, Tuberculosis Rabbit yawned out of boredom: “No reaction, huh? Is this prop really effective? Will Gao Yiming truly turn into a phantom circling above in reality?”
“Not a peep.”
“I personally think there should be some interaction, like, even though he’s dead and turned into a phantom, he should still be able to interact with people.”
“Otherwise, although I know he’s watching us, not being able to see the expression on his face really is quite dull.”
“I’d really like to see him panicked yet only able to stomp his feet right now.”
After checking the few remaining props that had dropped, and finding none that were particularly useful, Chen Yi casually tossed them into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s arms before saying carelessly, “Maybe the guy will come scare you in your dream tonight.”
“That’s actually an issue.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stroked his chin solemnly and said seriously, “I might be thick-skinned, but I might really get scared if I see those things in my dreams.”
“…”
Chen Yi rolled his eyes at Tuberculosis Rabbit without any good humor: “Maybe others will, but you definitely won’t. Every night, your dreams are a mess of things. It’d be best if he haunted your dreams first and then mine, so you can tell me what you dream about every night.”
“As if there’s that much to talk about.”
“Let’s go downstairs and take care of some fish that slipped through the net.”
Perhaps they had made a bit too much noise.
By now, rapid footsteps were echoing from downstairs, evidently ready to check if their boss, Gao Yiming, had run into trouble.
After the end times arrived, ordinary staff had long fled. Those still following Gao Yiming through the apocalypse were truly loyal to the core.
These people still needed to be dealt with sooner rather than later.
To prevent problems in the future, they needed to cut the weeds and dig out the roots.
Especially an old man, it was this very man who had called him initially; the old man must be Gao Yiming’s confidante. Others might be let go, but this old man had to die.
They effortlessly descended to the top floor office on a sled.
As soon as they steadied themselves.
An old man with an anxious expression burst in with a few burly men armed with weapons.
“Young Master, are you alright?”
Upon seeing the shattered floor-to-ceiling window and the two figures standing inside, Chen Yi and his companion, the old man only stood there, slightly dumbfounded for a moment. Then, without any hesitation, he pushed the burly men in front of him and bellowed.
“Kill them!”
Right after, he turned and ran away at great speed.
“Bang.”
Chen Yi couldn’t be bothered with idle talk and simply tapped the ground lightly with the palm of his hand.
The Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle’s +6 Special Effects activated, several bullets burrowed into the ground and vanished, followed by the sight of several bullets with a black, shimmering tail flame burrowing straight up from beneath the feet of the burly men and the old man!
The burly men who had just charged forward with raised swords, hadn’t made it far when they suddenly stiffened, their eyes dull and blood spilling from their mouths, they collapsed heavily in place!
And the old man, after only running a few steps, also fell down.
Just then, a piercing alarm filled the entire office.
More footsteps surged from outside the door.
Chen Yi didn’t mind, just kept walking with one hand on his cane towards the office hallway, facing the hired muscle who surfaced out of nowhere with long knives, rushing at him.
He went straight to meet them.
With one hand in his pocket, leaning on his cane, his facial expression remained calm and unperturbed, without any movement from his body.
Yet with every step he took forward, a batch of men in front of him fell dead.
With each step, another batch perished.
Gradually, no one dared to approach, and the last burly man wielding a long knife looked around, saw that he was the only one left standing. Fueled by fear and with a roar, he smashed through the nearby glass and plunged straight down from the building!
In extreme fear, this burly man chose to end himself rather than face the demon before him.
However, the next second—
“Bang.”
A bullet shot out from the side of the high-rise, hitting the man who was still falling, ending his life in mid-air.
When Chen Yi reached the end of the corridor, no one was standing anymore; the blood pooling on the floor had made it difficult to find a place to step, and the piles of bodies lay everywhere, presenting a ghastly sight.
“Gao Yiming is impressive, too.”
With a cigarette dangling from his mouth and hands in his pockets, Tuberculosis Rabbit followed behind Yi, and couldn’t help but express his admiration after scanning the surroundings: “Gao Yiming really had talent. Being able to gather so many people to work for him after the apocalypse wasn’t an easy feat.”
He had seen many things in Gao Yiming’s office.
For instance, there was a large flat map on the wall.
It was the Sands of Time Map.
Below it were detailed texts outlining how to utilize mechanisms to farm Points and so forth.
Meanwhile, Chen Yi was standing at the door of a room at the end of the hallway, squinting, and feeling somewhat odd inside without saying a word.
Clearly written on the room’s nameplate were a few blue characters.
“Prop Storage Room!”
“By the way, why did you use the phrase ’I personally think’ earlier?”
Staring at the nameplate, Chen Yi narrowed his eyes slightly, cautious, and slowly took a few steps back while asking nonchalantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 129 - 128: If I die, others can’t live well either.
chapters.content:
Chapter 129 – 128: If I die, others can’t live well either.
Chen Yi stared at the room marked “Prop Storage Room” in front of him, his body slowly backing to the window in the corridor, ready to jump up and flee at any moment.
A Prop Storage Room?
Bullshit!
Who doesn’t keep props in their backpack and finds a room to store them instead?
Are they out of their minds?
It’s not that some major powers wouldn’t have too many props to fit in their backpacks and need to store them in a room so that people below can exchange for them with Contribution Value, having certain rewards and punishments in place.
But he didn’t believe Gao Yiming had that kind of power.
Judge others by oneself.
He would only set up a Prop Storage Room under one circumstance: when facing a great enemy. That way, if he were to be defeated by his nemesis and died, the enemy would push open the doors of the Prop Storage Room filled with expectation only to discover the myriad of traps he’d left inside the room.
“If I’m going down, I’m taking you with me.”
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was taken aback, then sheepishly replied, “What’s wrong? Did that sound too formal? I’ve just learned it recently. All those cultured people like to say ’privately I think’ so I thought I’d try to be like the cultured folks.”
’Privately I think’ is just a more humble way of saying ’I think.’ It’s commonly used in written language, with few people speaking that way in real life. A synonym for it is ’secretly I think.’
“It’s nothing.”
Chen Yi glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit and chose not to continue speaking. Instead, he leaned back and fell straight out the corridor window onto the sled below before speaking, “Come on.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit had given him a scare just now.
The phrase ’privately I think’ wasn’t something that should have been in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s vocabulary; for a moment, Chen Yi almost thought Gao Yiming had some prop that allowed him to take control of others after death.
He looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had just hopped onto the sled, and suddenly asked,
“What’s the biggest unexpected income we’ve gotten since we started working?”
“The biggest unexpected income?”
After thinking for a while, Tuberculosis Rabbit replied, “Some bald guy rushed into the mortuary we were guarding, trying to assault a female corpse when we weren’t paying attention. We stopped him in time, and the family of the corpse gave us a thank-you fee of 100,000.”
“Aside from our usual job of sewing corpses, that should be our biggest source of income, right?”
“Yeah.”
Chen Yi nodded slightly and breathed a sigh of relief. That should exclude the possibility that Gao Yiming had left anything inside Tuberculosis Rabbit. There was no way Gao Yiming could have known about that incident.
When Chen Yi thought about it carefully, the existence of a prop that allowed revival from death was also unlikely. After all, death was a taboo; if such a prop existed, it would have to be at least A-level, not something current players could possess. He didn’t have it, so how could Gao Yiming?
However, just at that moment——
“Boom!!!”
A huge explosion erupted from inside the Prop Storage Room at the top of the office building, followed by a burst of yellow light that exploded from within the room!
Almost instantly, it enveloped Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit.
And at that moment.
A voice also came from inside the storage room.
“Within one minute after my heart stops beating, the mechanism I’ve hidden in the Prop Storage Room will be activated. Whoever you are, please be prepared to accompany me in death. It’s really just a passage for a map, there’s no need to be so scared; it just comes with a little forced invitation effect.”
“The difference is, the death rate on this map is the highest at the moment. According to incomplete statistics, the death rate is as high as 97%.”
“Of course, I’m aware that if I’m dead, the person who killed me is most likely Chen Yi. Is it you, Chen Yi?”
“I know you’re strong, but unfortunately, on this map, none of those props you’re proud of can be used.”
“I wish you good luck, and if nothing unexpected happens, we can meet in hell.”
The voice was heavy with electronic distortion, clearly a pre-recorded message.
The next second——
A panel appeared in front of Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“Ding, Gao Yiming has used ’Werewolf Kill’ map forced invitation order on you. In 10 minutes, you will officially enter the map.”
“Please prepare for map entry as soon as possible.”
“PS: Inside this map, all props, skills, titles, costumes, vehicles, etc., cannot be used. Players need to rely on their expressions and means for a battle of acting skills.”
Chen Yi stood on the sled with a rather unpleasant expression, silent. He thought he had been cautious enough, yet he was still trapped by Gao Yiming before his death. It seemed he had to be even more careful in the future.
A map where no props could be used, with a death rate as high as 97%, was indeed perfect for setting a trap.
At least he didn’t feel very confident about getting through this map.
“Werewolf Kill?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, hearing the name, thoughtfully nodded and then confidently grinned, saying, “Yi, I know how to play Werewolf Kill. Have you forgotten that my win rate used to be as high as 80%?”
“I barely ever lost, with me here, there’s no problem.”
Chen Yi glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit and sighed helplessly without speaking.
Werewolf Kill is a rather niche game, or rather, known by many but played by few.
The rules can be understood as each person having a different identity, then through verbal combat and logical reasoning to spot the flaws in the opponent’s words, eliminating the members of the hostile camp through various means, and finally achieving victory; that’s the kind of game it is.
Different from the usual gameplay.
Tuberculosis Rabbit used to have an incredibly high win rate when playing this game, but it was not because of his chatty nature or any kind of reasoning.
It was based on two things.
One was his orphan identity, and the other was his unlimited cheek-to-cheek off-field tactics.
Other players who brazenly declared themselves as the Prophet at least pretended to say something to gain the trust of other players.
But the way Tuberculosis Rabbit claimed to be the Prophet was unique: he would just declare that he was definitely the Prophet and if he was not, his whole family would drop dead that very night and his household registration would be wiped out.
It was quite a distasteful strategy.
A cancerous presence. What was supposed to be a logical deduction game became completely different with Tuberculosis Rabbit in the room; the atmosphere was utterly changed.
And the real Prophet, upon hearing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s poisonous oath, would also feel wronged and angry. There was no helping it, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s solemn oaths indeed managed to sway some votes in his favor unless the real Prophet also made that kind of poisonous oath.
But for normal people, even if they knew they were the real Prophet, they would not want to make such a poisonous oath, as some words, once spoken, might have some kind of cosmic impact.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, on the other hand, was utterly unscrupulous, casually bringing up his never-seen family members to make his case. Under this tactic, he truly managed to achieve a not-so-low win rate amidst countless curses.
“Your tactics won’t work on this map, no one here will believe that kind of poisonous oath, especially when we’re unclear about the map’s rules,” Chen Yi said.
“But there’s something we need to handle first.”
Chen Yi turned his head toward his personal panel’s countdown and silently switched over to Sword Without End’s chat window: “I was suddenly pulled into a map, there’s something I couldn’t attend to in time, I might need your help with it.”
“What’s up?”
The response came swiftly, practically instant.
“There’s someone called Wang Yimei in Black Trench City, take a run over and off him for me,” Chen Yi ordered.
“Did he curse at you?”
“How did you know?”
“Just a guess.”
“You guessed right; thanks for making the trip.” Experience tales with empire
“No worries, if Yi asks, I’ll be sure to deliver.”
Having settled a concern, Chen Yi then turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit: “If props can’t be used, that probably means the backpack is out too. Prepare extra knives, steamed buns, bottled water, and stuff like that. It’s hard to say if this map is a war of attrition.”
“Mhm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded earnestly, “We’re family, no matter what identity other players have, we can trust each other. I think the biggest trap of this map is that you and I, Yi, might end up in the hostile camp.”
“If that really happens, I hope, Yi…”
“Enough,” Chen Yi calmly interrupted, “don’t speak of such unlucky things.”
“Oh.”
“Wang Yimei?”
Sword Without End squatted atop Traceless Green Peak, hovering in midair, cupping his chin, and ponderously musing with a puzzled face. He actually knew the person, who had emerged from the Second Layer World Boss Space with Chen Yi. He had even paid extra attention to him afterward.
Later, this person had been chatting with Yan Niang, likely about to join “Skywake.”
This man had no interaction with Yi during the Third Layer World Boss Space, meaning he must have cursed out Chen Yi in the Second Layer World Boss Space?
What a daring guy.
Yet the fellow didn’t look like someone who had the guts to utter such audacious words.
“Forget it, forget it.”
Sword Without End shook his head, got up, and, pulling up his pants, stepped onto Traceless Green Peak and blasted off towards Black Trench City. He needed to be quick, to take out this guy before Wang Yimei officially joined “Skywake.”
If not, once the man joined “Skywake,” it would be somewhat problematic to move against him. Although he didn’t want to offend Chen Yi, “Skywake’s” boss was not someone he wanted to provoke either.
As long as the kill was quick.
It wouldn’t be seen as seriously offending “Skywake.”
Is there a prop that can cure constipation?
Sword Without End stood on Traceless Green Peak, hands clasped behind his back, rubbing his bottom discontentedly, muttering into the roaring wind, “Feels like my digestion’s getting worse lately, what’s with all this constipation?”
“The ten-minute countdown is over; players Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit will be transferred to the ’Werewolf Kill’ map.”
“Ding. It has been detected that Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit are acquaintances, therefore, they will be transferred to different maps, teaming is prohibited on this map”
A notification rang simultaneously in both Chen Yi’s and Tuberculosis Rabbit’s ears.
When the white light fell,
Chen Yi found himself standing on green bricks, Tuberculosis Rabbit nowhere to be seen, surrounded by 9 unfamiliar players who were inquiring among each other.
And he stood there, his complexion somewhat darkened, worry flashing through his eyes.
Tuberculosis Rabbit went into the map alone?
Without him, could Tuberculosis Rabbit manage?
Despite knowing that such thoughts were unlucky, images of Tuberculosis Rabbit dying in this map kept surfacing in his mind – a 97% death rate was no joke!

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 130 - 129: "I majored in Psychology in college!
chapters.content:
Chapter 130 – 129: “I majored in Psychology in college!
“Huh!”
He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the anxiety and concerns in his heart, and continuously hypnotized himself.
It’s okay, it’s okay.
The scenes he had seen in that movie theater showed that Tuberculosis Rabbit would die in an Insect Tide attack in the future, and moreover, behind him. He shouldn’t die on this map.
However… the movie theater had also said that these scenes were only a possible branch in their future lives, not the final outcome.
That is to say, Tuberculosis Rabbit could still possibly die on this map.
Just when Chen Yi’s heart first became unsettled, and he began to feel incessant anxiety and worry, a system prompt sounded in the ears of all players.
「Map Name」: Werewolf Kill.
「Map Level」: C-level.
「Map Rules」: The map can accommodate 20 players, with ten players in one camp, totaling two camps that are hostile to each other.
Players must kill each other in this small town in front of them. When all the players in one camp are dead, the survivors of the other camp will be declared the winners.
The town is approximately the size of 10 soccer fields.
The town has different environments like absolute darkness, absolute silence, absolute blindness, absolute falling, etc., and it has some extremely rare props for everyone to compete for.
Each camp has 3 identities.
1: Spy (one person.)
As a spy, you will be born among the hostile camp when you land on the map. No one knows your original identity unless you tell them yourself. Your goal is the death of all players from the opposing camp and your camp’s leader, and you will have special abilities.
2: Leader (one person.)
As a leader, you can get more generous rewards than others. However, your victory goal is higher as well. When all players except you and another leader are dead, you will achieve ultimate victory, and you will have special abilities.
3: Ordinary people (eight people.)
As an ordinary person, your victory goal is very simple: just rush into the town and kill all players from the hostile camp and your own camp’s leader to win, without any special abilities.
Players in the same camp will have a dedicated chat channel, and spies will also hide in the chat channel of the enemy camp.
Within this map, the May rules and June rules will temporarily take effect.
If no winner emerges within 16 hours, all players will be declared dead.
「Map Introduction」: “In a town enveloped by night, perhaps you need a game that combines cunning and violence to become alert.”
Chen Yi looked at the identity popup in front of him without speaking.
「Player Name」: Chen Yi.
「Player Identity」: Spy.
「Identity Ability」: You can speak in your camp’s chat channel under the title ’Mysterious Person,’ but you only have three opportunities to speak, each up to 15 words maximum, and you also have the ability to pass through walls three times.
「Identity Goal」: “Kill all players in the enemy camp.”
An identity with special abilities, but whether it’s a good thing or a bad thing was hard to say, at least his situation was certainly not good. Standing next to him, nine players were from the hostile camp.
Which means the moment his identity was exposed, these nine would immediately tear him to shreds.
Right now, he was unable to use skills, naturally lacking the passive effect of double physical attributes. Facing nine opponents, he didn’t have that kind of capability.
However, there should be one player feeling even more anxious than him, namely, the player with the identity of the leader.
As a spy, lurking within the enemy camp naturally meant being surrounded by crises.
But as a leader, your enemies are all the players present, doubling the difficulty.
Chen Yi stood still, carefully observing the nine players around him.
On the far left appeared to be two female college students, dressed quite fashionably, probably having bought their outfits from the store. Even though the Fashion Effect could no longer be used, the clothes could still be worn, so the players wouldn’t have to enter the instance naked.
Maybe it was the attraction between young women.
Right now, these two girls were leaning on each other, filled with fear and panic in their eyes, their bodies trembling as they continuously scanned the other players, their specific identities unknown.
One in blue clothes, one in pink.
Let’s just call them Fen and Lan for now.
To the right was a middle-aged man who was squatting on the spot, staring at the ants in the crevices of the green bricks on the ground, seemingly lost in thought with a cigarette in his mouth.
This man posed a significant threat.
Chen Yi silently upgraded this man’s threat level for a simple reason—in a situation where props couldn’t be used, this man’s physique seemed to be strong.
But the good news was that you could bring cigarettes into this map, which meant if Tuberculosis Rabbit were to die in the map, at least he could light up a cigarette before dying, not leaving with any regrets.
Damn, how could he think of such things.
It’s bad luck, pah.
Moving further to the right was a young and middle-aged man in a suit, looking like a lawyer or something similar. At the moment, he had his hands in his pockets and a smile on his lips as he watched the two girls next to him, seemingly enjoying the spectacle.
Looking further back, there was a middle-aged woman, an old man, and a child.
The middle-aged woman was around forty-something, currently speaking a dialect that was somewhat hard to understand with an anxious look on her face, calling out continuously, but no one responded.
The old man looked to be about 70 years old, his face so wrinkled it was almost flowering, but his body seemed quite robust. At this moment, he was smilingly leering at the middle-aged woman’s buttocks with impunity.
It was unclear whether he was intentionally presenting himself in this manner to establish the image of a lecher.
If he was really lecherous, wouldn’t the two young girls next to him be more tempting? What was so interesting about a middle-aged woman’s buttocks?
As for the kid, he appeared to be about 16 years old. Wearing a hoodie, he had his head down and hadn’t uttered a word since the beginning.
On the far left stood two young men.
One young man in shorts and a T-shirt had fear in his eyes, but he was still biting his lip, forcing himself to calm down.
The other young man… was an old acquaintance.
Dressed in sports attire, staring at him, he even put on an ingratiating smile and nodded his head in greeting when he saw him looking over, appearing extremely easy to bully.
If it wasn’t Wang Yimei, who else could it be?
It seemed Sword Without End had arrived a bit late.
“…”
Chen Yi remained silent and expressionless, not speaking. He just raised his hand and lightly tapped his forehead, vowing to get rid of such damned people as soon as possible in the future!
Before entering the map, he had decided to deal with Gao Yiming and then take care of Wang Yimei.
People like him, who smiled to his face while constantly cursing him behind his back, were typical sycophants. Although the chances were slim, he still worried that if he ended up in the same map with such a person, they might ruin his plans.
But a sudden incident had delayed this matter.
Unexpectedly, he had really encountered this slim chance.
He turned his head to scan the surrounding environment.
They were in a courtyard, with green bricks on the ground and walls all around. The moon overhead was obscured by clouds, giving the scene a somewhat hazy look.
Without much delay.
Chen Yi was the first to speak out, saying, “Have you all finished reading the map rules? I think we should have some simple exchanges, so that we can better work together to achieve our objective.”
He was preparing to take control.
Being a spy was too passive. To avoid being eliminated early, the best strategy was to take a prominent position and assume control.
Remaining silent and hidden behind others made one an easy target of suspicion.
However, no sooner had he finished speaking,
The young man standing next to Wang Yimei pointed his hand at Chen Yi, his eyes filled with fear, his lips quivering as he raised his trembling voice to say loudly,
“I majored in psychology at university!”
“According to psychology, in this kind of situation, the first person to stand up and speak is either a spy or a power player, because only such people can assess the situation around them swiftly.”
“If you were a common person, you would be just like us right now, unsure of the identities of others and afraid to speak out rashly.”
“This is the law of the hunting forest!”
“In the forest, the first to speak is always the hunter, not the prey!”
“I suggest we get rid of this person first. His identity is definitely either a spy or a power player!”
As the young man’s voice faded,
The others looked at each other, seeming to agree with what he said. Even the middle-aged man who had been crouching down was already standing up, his hand tucked into his chest and looking at Chen Yi with a smirk on his face.
“…”
Chen Yi stood calmly in place under everyone’s gaze, not showing any sign of retreat, simply noting the young man who had spoken in his heart.
So he liked studying psychology, huh? Good.
After all eyes remained on him for three seconds, Chen Yi continued to speak without any change in his expression, “There are ten of us here, with eight being on the good side, leaving two from the hostile camp.”
“It’s normal for us to suspect those around us.”
Explore more at empire
“My suggestion is that we move together, which can minimize the chances of spies sabotaging and absolutely avoid any opportunities for two people to be alone together.”
“When a spy is alone with an ordinary person, there’s a significant chance the spy will act.”
But even after he said this, there was no reaction from the people present.
And just then,
A flicker of cold laughter appeared in Wang Yimei’s eyes, and then, with an annoyed tone, he turned to the others and said in pretend anger, “What’s with that attitude? Don’t you know who he is?”
“He’s Chen Yi!”
