“He’s the one who’s appeared in many global announcements, ranked first on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard, and dealt 3 million damage in the world boss event—that Chen Yi!”
“It’s an honor for us to have such a powerhouse lead us through the map. How can you still doubt him?”
Following that, Wang Yimei turned to look at Chen Yi, his face earnest and his voice steady and forceful as he said,
“Big bro Yi, others might not trust you, but I do.”
“I don’t care what others think; I’m with you. Anyone who doubts you is definitely a spy or a power player!”

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 131 - 130: "Can you not say psychology is useless just because you’re uneducated, okay?
chapters.content:
Chapter 131 – 130: “Can you not say psychology is useless just because you’re uneducated, okay?
After Wang Yimei finished speaking,
not only did the trust in Chen Yi not increase amongst those present, but the suspicion in the depths of their eyes intensified.
The opening was somewhat disadvantageous.
It was just the beginning, and Chen Yi’s identity was quickly becoming the target of everyone’s attention.
Standing still, Chen Yi faced Wang Yimei’s earnest eyes silently without speaking, merely clenching his right hand, which was in his pocket, slightly — this was the first time he really wanted to twist someone’s head off.
Wang Yimei’s words had almost instantly turned his identity into a focal point card.
Originally, the others did not recognize him.
But since Wang Yimei had revealed his identity, the identity of a super big shot, this would make the other players even more cautious and skeptical, thinking that if such a person deceived them, they would all die.
In such a map, the identity of a super big shot would definitely not become an endorsement of trust.
Instead, it would attract even more attention.
When he wanted to make some small moves, countless pairs of eyes would be watching him.
Most importantly, Wang Yimei forcefully linked his own identity with Chen Yi’s — what does unconditional alliance mean?
A duo?
It was simply harming him.
He simply didn’t speak anymore, standing silently; it was already inappropriate to say more now. Since he didn’t seize the initiative at first, it had brought about suspicion, so it would be improper to speak further.
Stay tuned for updates on empire
“Heh heh,”
And just when the atmosphere turned awkward, the middle-aged man who was taking a puff of his cigarette mocked and said, “We don’t need to make the situation so tense, regardless of whether this big shot is a spy or a villain.”
“Among the 10 of us, there will definitely be spies and villains.”
“This is unavoidable.”
“I say there’s nothing wrong with what the big shot said; the 10 of us should move together and kill those lone hostile camp players, so even if we have spies within us, it’d be useless.”
“They can only watch helplessly as we kill their fellow camp players, and as we take down enough hostile camp players, they will naturally reveal their slip-up in their haste. Right now, suspecting blindly without any information is illogical.”
“And let’s not place too much faith in psychology, especially the psychology learned in universities,”
Although the middle-aged man didn’t sneer, his words still carried a hint of clear disdain, “That stuff is good enough to deceive HR on a resume, but surely you don’t really believe you’ve got a grip on psychology after four years of college, do you?”
“Moreover, shouldn’t it be this older lady who should have spoken first?”
“This older lady was talking quite a bit before the big shot said anything.”
“Is that the same?”
The young man in shorts and a T-shirt was somewhat angered by the middle-aged man’s contemptuous tone, his voice involuntarily rising, “That older lady was just speaking nonsense, whereas this so-called big shot clearly took over the initiative when he spoke!”
“An ordinary person, would they dare to fight for the initiative when their identity is unknown on the field?”
“Only spies and villains have the audacity to do so because their perspective is different from ours. Our perspective is complete chaos, not knowing who is friend or foe. Their perspective is that everyone on the field is an enemy, which is why they dare to speak up like that.”
“If you’re uneducated, can you please not say that psychology is useless?”
“Hey, hey, hey, hold on there.”
The middle-aged man said seriously with a straight face, “I’ve never said psychology is useless; I’m just saying that the psychology you learned in college is useless.”
“You’ve graduated, right? How’s the job market for you? Would you choose to stay as a teaching assistant or work as a nurse in a psychiatric hospital?”
“You…!”
Just as the two were about to continue arguing,
“Ah!”
A shrill scream came; the middle-aged woman covered her buttocks in horror and jumped to the side, pointing at the old man behind her and yelling, “Pervert!”
During the conversation just now, the old man couldn’t help but reach out with his lecherous hand towards the middle-aged woman’s butt.
“What are you up to now?”
The middle-aged man looked at the old man with some irritation, “At your age to be doing this? Aren’t you ashamed? Judging by your frailty, one hit would probably put you down, and yet here you are, making a move.”
Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed as he looked towards the middle-aged man who was not far away, who had somehow subtly taken over the lead in the discussion. He began to suspect that the man’s identity might be a villain.
If this man’s identity was that of an ordinary person,
then upon seeing his teammates being either old men, young girls, or women, he should have felt at least a bit irritated, given that such teammates with weak combat capabilities would definitely be a drag.
But he didn’t see a trace of irritation on the man’s face.
It’s as if he didn’t care at all about the weakness of his teammates.
To say one is so strong as to not care about the weaknesses of teammates is simply unrealistic.
It is very likely that this man’s identity is that of a villain, and he doesn’t care whether the players are weak or strong; in fact, the weaker they are, the happier he is.
His goal is to eliminate all players of the hostile camp,
including the villains of the hostile camp as well as those of his own camp.
After the debate, the atmosphere became somewhat more lively; it was not as stagnant as it was at the beginning.
The group finally decided to move together.
Soon, they all pushed open the courtyard gate; outside was a road paved with green bricks, about three meters wide, not very spacious.
The ground was slightly damp as if it had just rained.
The rain had not long ceased, leaving some puddles on the ground.
Under the moonlight, the puddles faintly glinted.
The moon hid behind the dark clouds.
The ancient town, full of blue bricks, didn’t exude an overly eerie atmosphere. Instead, it felt like an ancient town after the rain. If it weren’t for participating in a Werewolf Kill map but rather walking hand in hand with a loved one on the town’s blue brick streets, it would have been quite romantic.
Not a soul was on the blue brick streets.
But it was far from silent.
One could occasionally hear the sounds of birds singing and cicadas chirping, reminiscent of a hidden paradise.
However, once everyone left the courtyard, they were somewhat at a loss for where to start looking for the players from the hostile camp. The small town was not tiny by any means, covering the area of around 10 football fields.
Twenty people thrown into it wouldn’t even make a ripple.
In such a situation, without a map or indication of the enemy’s location, finding the enemy was no easy feat.
After stepping out of the courtyard, the group stood on the street, looking at each other in bewilderment, as if blindsided by the fact that, despite discussing moving as one unit for quite a while, they were indeed all together but had no clue which direction to move towards.
Then, at that moment—
“Look over there!”
At the far end of the blue brick street, there was a signpost.
It bore four bold characters.
“Absolute Darkness Silence!”
Upon closer inspection, the group realized there were a few additional words written below.
“Upon entering the courtyard to the left, you will be enveloped in absolute darkness and silence. There is a Prop inside that players may collect.”
“We can’t go in,” Wang Yimei immediately judged and shook his head in denial, “This ’absolute darkness and silence’ is basically akin to the loss of all senses. Once you enter this courtyard, the chances of finding your way out are virtually nil.”
“It’s easy to go in, but coming out will be difficult.”
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes slightly while standing still, his mind rapidly weighing the pros and cons. To be honest, he wasn’t very keen on acquiring any Prop. He always felt that there might be a Prop that could directly reveal the identities of the other players.
If such a Prop exists,
his situation would be extremely dangerous.
But after pondering for a moment, he still spoke up, “We must go in. Every Prop is a foundation for our victory. Our strength is already weak, including two young girls, a middle-aged woman, an old man, and a child.”
“It’s as if the fighting strength of five people is weakened.”
“If among these five people there’s a spy or a mastermind, it could actually be beneficial for us. But if not, our situation as ordinary people becomes very tricky.”
“We don’t know the strength of the players from the hostile camp, but our overall combat strength is weak. To win, we need to rely on Props for help.”
“Although the courtyard is pitch-black, there’s a way to deal with it.”
“Get a rope. Nine people hold onto the rope outside the courtyard while one person holds onto the rope and searches for the Prop in the darkness inside, then brings it out successfully.”
“This method is relatively safe.”
As his words fell, the middle-aged man with the cigarette spoke up first, “I think this method is viable, but the question is, where do we find a rope?”
The group scanned the surroundings and couldn’t spot any rope within their field of vision.
To look for a rope, they would have to go door to door.
Whether they could find one was uncertain.
“Take off your clothes and tie them together to use as a rope,” Wang Yimei offered his suggestion.
The two girls who had been silent from the start objected for the first time.
“Impossible!”
“Are you a pervert? You’re actually asking us two girls to take off our clothes in front of so many men?”
“Did nine years of compulsory education produce a pervert like you?”
“Hmmph.”
Wang Yimei, seemingly indifferent, put his hands in his pockets and shrugged, indicating that he was just making a suggestion.
“Hold hands then,” Chen Yi offered his suggestion, “One person stays outside, and the remaining nine go into the courtyard, hand-in-hand, forming a human rope. The last person in line is responsible for controlling the direction of the human chain and finding the Prop.”
“The issue now is deciding who stays outside.”
“You stay,” the young man majoring in psychology stared intently at Chen Yi and said assertively, “All you have to do is let go and kick a few times, and the nine of us could get lost in the courtyard and never find our way out.”
“It’s not that serious,” Chen Yi shook his head, “It’s just a courtyard. Even with absolute darkness and silence, you can still follow the walls to find the exit. At most, it would just take some time.”
“Even if the person staying outside is a spy, it won’t affect us. On the contrary, it would be more advantageous, potentially helping us to identify the spy or mastermind among us.”

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 132 - 131: "I Hate the Darkness.
chapters.content:
Chapter 132 – 131: “I Hate the Darkness.
After saying this, Chen Yi stopped talking and looked up, patiently waiting for everyone else’s response.
He had already found the solution to this map.
Being a spy required disguise, but… in this map, disguises were completely meaningless. Even if you disguised your identity well, if the players from the hostile camp didn’t all die, you’d die in the map yourself.
So the main mission of this map was to kill all enemy players.
Whether you were a commoner, a spy, or a hero, as long as you achieved this, you could win.
In a situation where nobody could use props, there was no need to bother with the two little girls and the old man could be ignored for the time being, as could the middle-aged woman and that young man.
First, take out this middle-aged man, Wang Yimei, that college student studying psychology, and the guy in a suit who looked like a lawyer.
In this tense atmosphere, it was rare to find an opportunity to attack someone who was alone.
But in absolute darkness, there was a perfect chance to strike.
A common misconception about this map was that a spy didn’t need to worry too much about revealing their identity. Even if exposed, what of it? You couldn’t be voted to death, just run for your life, and as long as you weren’t caught, it didn’t matter if your identity was revealed.
Moreover, the spy had the ability to walk through walls three times.
The only thing that made him somewhat uneasy was that he didn’t know what the Heroic Skill was.
Soon, everyone had come up with a plan.
They left the two little girls outside to hold each other in check, while the other eight people entered the courtyard holding hands to search for the prop.
The two little girls were at the forefront of the human chain, and the middle-aged man was at the end.
Chen Yi did not object to this arrangement. Instead, he subtly shifted the blade hidden on his shoulder, letting it fall naturally into the little pocket at his sleeve. When he learned that props could not be carried into this map, he brought along some small blades.
After all, efficiency was key when it came to killing.
Then, everything proceeded according to plan.
The two little girls stayed outside while the remaining eight people entered the courtyard hand in hand and started groping around in the dark.
…
“Ah, how boring.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat bored, squatted on the eaves of a house in the little brick town, idly smoking a cigarette and gazing at the foggy horizon. He and Yi had been separated.
This made him, who had been slightly hopeful about this map, instantly lose interest.
“Forget it.”
A moment later Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed softly and shook his head, “Better just stay alive and get out of here first.”
At that moment, a young man with his right hand behind his back and a smile on his face came and sat down next to Tuberculosis Rabbit, “How’s the view? If you don’t consider the danger of this map, the scenery is actually quite nice, isn’t it?”
“Indeed, it’s not bad. Want a smoke?”
“Sure, I’ll take one, thanks.”
“No problem.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded casually and then reached into his chest, seemingly to take out a cigarette. As he extended his arm, a dagger that was very black in the night was pulled out.
Without any hesitation.
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up and stabbed the dagger into the neck of the young man sitting next to him, immediately twisting the dagger repeatedly, and then, looking at the young man’s rapidly fading eyes and the gushing, blinding fresh blood, he pushed the body into the house behind him.
He glanced at the dagger in the man’s hand without talking much, then rubbed his blood-stained hands against the rainy eaves before reaching for another cigarette to put into his mouth.
Thinking he was alone and coming to kill him?
The enemy was either a spy or possessed the Heroic Skill.
Another identity ruled out.
He actually did not know what the young man’s identity was. His own identity was just a commoner, but it was fine to attack anyone who approached him. After all, striking first was the best strategy.
In a situation with no props and no skills, it was all about who could strike more fiercely and more steadily.
Even if he had killed the wrong person, if the other was just a teammate with no ill intent, it didn’t matter.
As long as he survived.
“I wonder how Yi is doing.”
His approach to the map was simple; just kill everyone except himself. As long as he wasn’t being ganged up on, he was confident he would not lose to anyone in a 1v1 situation.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi had started forming a human chain to enter the courtyard.
The courtyard was pitch black, the kind of absolute darkness where not a sound could be heard, and the only reassurance was the contact of holding hands with your fellow players, affirming that you were not plunged into the darkness alone.
The middle-aged man at the front was constantly searching for the so-called prop in the darkness.
It was no easy task.
There were no clues to the prop’s location, and the courtyard was not small, so they had to keep groping on the ground.
“…”
Chen Yi felt the darkness around him, the silence unnerving enough to make one’s skin crawl. He quietly let go of the hands of the players on both sides. Although he couldn’t hear their cries, he could feel two pairs of hands desperately trying to grab towards him in the dark.
Experience tales at empire
There was no sound of cutting through air.
But when his hand brushed against his clothes, there was still a sensation.
He immediately took the blade from the cuff of his sleeve.
And at that moment—
A hand suddenly grabbed his clothes and clung tightly without letting go.
Chen Yi didn’t hesitate too much; he grabbed the hand and quickly slid it up the arm, and when he could roughly judge the position of the neck, the hand with the blade lunged forward and viciously sliced!
Immediately after, he could feel some warm liquid spraying onto his hand, and the grip on his clothes gradually weakened.
Still not completely reassured, he slashed several more times in the darkness before quickly moving away from his original position.
By this time, the courtyard had already descended into chaos. The other player leading the corpse obviously knew something had gone wrong and turned around to leave the courtyard first, but the other player tied to the deceased was unaware of what had happened.
In the darkness, absolute silence was mandated; even the squad channel couldn’t be used.
Transferring information was extremely difficult.
The other player, mistaking that the player wanted to make a move, retaliated immediately, plunging the whole courtyard into immediate disarray.
After killing one person, Chen Yi didn’t continue to fight; instead, he slowly backed away in the opposite direction, trying his best not to bump into any player in the dark.
This was because getting injured posed a great risk on this map, and getting hurt wasn’t a good thing at all.
The person he had been pulling on his left was the one dressed in a suit, looking like a lawyer. Unless something unexpected had happened, that person should be dead or, at the very least, critically wounded and close to death.
He had to be cautious.
Until he knew what the Heroic Skill was, he had to avoid being in a direct one-on-one, let alone a one-against-multiple, situation as much as possible.
Suddenly there was an extra corpse, and the rope tying the group broke in the middle, leaving the rest not necessarily panicked but definitely thrown into disarray.
Chen Yi planned to take this opportunity to quickly locate the Prop hidden in the courtyard.
He bent his arm slightly and stretched it out, ensuring that if he did bump into another player, he could strike faster than the opponent could.
Being fearless by nature, he didn’t feel any apprehension in the all-encompassing darkness, only that it was slightly inconvenient due to the low margin for error.
He sped up his pace slightly, moving away from the other players behind him and groping in the dark of the courtyard.
And just then—
He suddenly saw a glowing white dot on the ground about three steps away.
Chen Yi was startled, his brows furrowed as he stepped back. The glowing white dot immediately vanished from his sight, but as he stepped forward again, the dot reappeared in his field of vision.
This must be the so-called Prop hidden in the courtyard.
It seemed that one could only see the Prop if they were within a few steps of it.
He didn’t rush over immediately. Instead, holding the knife in his hand, his body tensed like a bow, he carefully felt his way forward step by step. And at that moment—
Chen Yi suddenly stepped on an animal trap in the darkness, and the severe pain made him let out an involuntary grunt.
An animal trap hidden on the ground in the darkness.
The intense pain made Chen Yi instantly alert, and with gritted teeth, he moved his body and held the knife, slowly searching around the Prop. The very next second, he suddenly felt like he had touched a strand of hair.
Without any hesitation.
In the darkness, he pounced forward, raising the knife and wildly stabbing at the player he had pinned down!
“Puchi!”
Once, twice, three times!
Warm blood splattered on Chen Yi’s cheeks, but he didn’t stop; he stabbed even more vigorously!
Only when the player underneath him no longer moved did he grab the Prop on the ground and, moving with some difficulty, continued to walk step by step into the darkness until he touched a wall.
He let out a slight breath of relief and leaned on the wall to look at the information of the Prop in his hands.
’Prop Name’: Dark Vision.
’Prop Level’: None, exclusive to the ’Werewolf Kill’ map, cannot be taken out of the map.
’Prop Effect’: Once activated, this Prop allows one to have normal vision in absolute darkness, can be used six times, each time lasting ten seconds.
’Prop Description’: “I hate darkness, just as I sleep with the light on, I’m genuinely worried about how many people might be hiding under my bed, staring up at me through the boards.”
He didn’t activate the Prop immediately, but instead felt for the animal trap on his shin.
It hurt.
With his strength, he couldn’t manage to open or pry the trap apart; it simply wouldn’t budge.
After trying for a long while.
Chen Yi simply stopped bothering with it, and as his constant blood loss made his body increasingly weak, he took off his jacket and used the blade to cut it into strips of cloth.
He wound the cloth strips around the animal trap and his wound together, which at least could reduce the speed of bleeding.
Feeling his body growing weak, Chen Yi bit his lip and leaned against the wall, gasping for air through his pain!
He must receive treatment within 30 minutes!

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 133 - 132: "I’m a spy, I killed 9 players.
chapters.content:
Chapter 133 – 132: “I’m a spy, I killed 9 players.
If he still hasn’t received treatment within 30 minutes, his life will be at risk, and he may die here.
That is to say, he must clear this level within 30 minutes and leave the map successfully.
The bear trap must have been left by that middle-aged man, only his clothing could have hidden such a thing, and he must have been the one to lay the traps near the prop, waiting patiently for his prey to take the bait.
He had already anticipated that someone might find the prop first and then set traps around it.
But because of the complete darkness, he was still unlucky enough to get caught.
However, this was already a very fortunate situation.
The middle-aged man, out of caution, didn’t touch the prop right away but set traps near it instead and waited patiently, preparing to catch his prey.
It was this caution that cost the man his life.
If the man had touched the prop immediately, he would have discovered its night-vision ability, which was almost like a bug-level existence in this utterly dark space.
One can imagine, had the man got his hands on the prop, it would have been very difficult for him to avoid the fatal attack from this man in absolute darkness.
It’s just an injury to one leg, a small problem.
As long as he quickly takes out the remaining players, he can leave the map and tend to his wounds, as he has a small healing prop.
After briefly treating his wound, Chen Yi stood up, pressed against the wall, and stood back in the darkness, activating the prop. Suddenly, the darkness before him dissipated, and the small courtyard, once shrouded in darkness, appeared before him as if it were daylight.
The courtyard wasn’t big.
Just over a hundred square meters or so, but even a space this small was enough to fumble around in complete darkness.
There were still 3 players in the courtyard.
They were Wang Yimei, the middle-aged woman, and the old man.
There were also three corpses on the ground.
The middle-aged man who appeared to be a hunter, a young man in a suit, and a child.
The first two were his kills, but the last one he didn’t know when happened; it seemed like the middle-aged man’s doing.
In that case, it was pretty much confirmed that the middle-aged man was “Fatal Strike”.
A total of 10 players.
He killed 2, Fatal Strike killed 1, and there were 3 left in the courtyard, meaning there were also 3 players outside.
Apart from the 2 players who stayed outside at the beginning, only one player had run out.
After activating the prop, Chen Yi could clearly see Wang Yimei, slightly panicked, frantically waving his hands in the dark, carefully groping forward, and his direction was precisely where Chen Yi stood.
The distance was less than two steps away.
Chen Yi stood still, and after Wang Yimei took another step forward, Chen Yi’s arm holding the blade aimed at Wang Yimei’s neck and stabbed out furiously.
“Puchi!”
Almost instantly, thick blood spurted out from Wang Yimei’s neck!
The silent stealth kill in the absolute darkness was unavoidable.
A fatal blow.
But to be sure, Chen Yi still stabbed a few more times, because only when all these hostile players were dead could he survive and leave the map, lest a slippery fish survive and hide somewhere.
When he realized that he wanted to find the player due to too much blood loss but his body was too weak to search, it would truly be a big joke.
After taking out Wang Yimei, the prop’s effect also ended.
Basing on the last image he saw, he continued forward in a certain direction in the dark, and along the way, he stabbed the corpses a few more times, as he truly feared that a player might suddenly come to life and hide to play cat and mouse with him.
He didn’t have that much time to look for people.
Intense pain from his leg kept transmitting signals, but thanks to the constant adrenaline, it was barely within the tolerable range.
When he activated the prop’s effect again.
The pitch-black courtyard was bright as day, and Chen Yi saw the middle-aged woman and the old man right in front of him.
The two were barely two meters apart, moving in the same direction, about to bump into each other.
He could also see the middle-aged woman’s mouth moving up and down, and although he couldn’t hear anything, he could roughly guess what she was saying.
Chen Yi didn’t linger.
Lifting his foot with the bear trap, he moved slowly towards the two of them, then thrust the knife forcefully.
First kill the middle-aged woman, then the old man.
Two strikes, two deaths, swift and decisive.
Attack like this in the dark was simply unavoidable, even if one is always on alert.
With this!
These 9 players were almost annihilated!
Only 3 people were still alive, two girls who stayed outside and the university student studying psychology.
Chen Yi, taking advantage of the prop’s effect not yet fading, scanned his surroundings one last time, and after confirming that there wasn’t a single person standing in the courtyard anymore, he slightly relaxed, and with some difficulty, moved towards the entrance of the courtyard, step by step.
“`
However, he did not leave the courtyard through the entrance.
Instead, he stopped in front of a wall about two meters from the entrance, silently activated his espionage abilities, and instantly the wall, previously solid and impenetrable, became like a liquid that he could easily pass through.
This was the spy’s ability, to pass through walls three times.
Without hesitation, he passed through the wall, left the courtyard, and appeared on a street of green bricks soaked with water stains, immediately turning his head to look towards the entrance of the courtyard.
As expected!
At that moment, the two girls and the college student stood at the entrance, holding daggers, their eyes fixed on the door, bodies slightly bent, ready to pounce at any moment!
Meanwhile, he had quietly passed through the wall and stood in their blind spot, unseen.
The group was completely unaware that someone was standing behind them.
He could even clearly hear the college student explaining tactics.
“As soon as anyone comes out from inside, make them raise their hands and tie them up for questioning. If there’s any resistance, regardless of who it is, we’ll stab them without hesitation!”
“The spy and the overlord are both inside!”
“We must…”
The voice suddenly cut off.
The neck of the college student was pierced suddenly, blood spurting out in great gushes. The frozen body of the student, eyes rapidly growing dim, desperately tried to turn his head to look, but as the dagger buried in his neck twisted, his life faded swiftly, and within seconds, his head drooped to the side.
Without a sound, Chen Yi moved behind the group, delivering a Fatal Strike.
As he pierced the neck of the college student, he used his left arm to tightly wrap around the nearest girl’s neck, squeezing forcefully, while she, in pain, stabbed blindly behind her with her dagger.
But before she could stab many times,
Chen Yi pulled the dagger from the college student’s neck and thrust it viciously into the neck of the girl in his embrace. Seconds later, her breath, too, swiftly ebbed away.
He casually threw the girl’s body aside and frowned slightly as he looked over at the glaring blood holes in his right shoulder and chest.
Earlier, when he had seized the girl, she, in her pain, stabbed behind her mindlessly with the dagger, hitting him right above the right chest, just below the shoulder.
Luckily, the girl must have been hurried; the dagger did not penetrate straight into his chest and missed his internal organs, leaving only a few deep flesh wounds.
The clothing was torn, and through the thick blood, it was possible to glimpse the layer of fat and tender flesh that resembled budding flesh within the wounds.
Chen Yi moved his right arm, thankful it was not injured to the bone, not affecting his performance. He didn’t hesitate, raising his dagger once again to strike at the other girl, who was frozen in terror and unable to move.
A kill with a single blow.
The strike was quick and not too painful.
People differ from one another.
Some freeze like lead when faced with danger, unable to move, while others scream and run in panic.
Clearly, the remaining girl was the former type.
This made his task much easier. Despite the injury risk, he was determined to deal with Wang Yimei and the first girl together because he didn’t want any of the players to escape.
If these players managed to flee, in their terror, they would certainly find a hidden corner to hide in.
He didn’t have the time to search for them.
So a few more injuries didn’t matter as long as he could leave this map quickly. Right now, time was of the essence!
After taking out the nine players, Chen Yi immediately used another of his spy abilities without any hesitation—sending three messages on his own camp’s chat channel.
“I am the spy; I’ve killed all nine players.”
“Everyone come, next to the red pillar by the black courtyard.”
“Don’t let anyone escape, watch the people, the spy, and the overlord.”
Experience exclusive tales on empire
After sending all three messages in one go, he stood still and took out a cigarette, lighting it and blowing the smoke towards the wounds on his right chest, the smoke providing some analgesic effect.
He also cut several strips of cloth from a girl’s body and wrapped them around his right chest area, a process that was taxing and required the use of both his hands and mouth.
Once done,
he leaned against the wall, trying to bear the pain, smoking his cigarette with an almost trance-like expression as he gazed at the water stains on the street of green bricks.
In fact, he wanted to sit down and rest for a while.
But he knew he couldn’t.
Already weakened from blood loss, if he were to squat down, trying to stand up again would cause a momentary stoppage of blood flow, resulting in him potentially losing control of his body and fainting.
He had to keep pushing himself, as long as he could make it off the map.
He had killed nine players from the hostile camp, but two were still alive.
One was the spy from the hostile camp, and the other was the overlord from his own camp.
Only after these two were dead could he leave the map successfully. So his current priority was to call back all the players from his own camp, then identify the spy and the overlord.
Luckily,
next to the courtyard there was a very conspicuous red pillar, which would at least allow him to accurately communicate his location within the limited number of words possible.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 134 - 133: 10 people, exactly one no more no less.
chapters.content:
Chapter 134 – 133: 10 people, exactly one no more no less.
As a spy, he could only send three messages in his own camp’s channel under the guise of a mysterious person.
He had to convey all the information he wanted to express with a few carefully chosen words.
And at that moment—
Messages suddenly appeared in the squad’s chat channel.
“The spy has revealed your location, will arrive soon.”
“Move quickly, red pillars.”
These two messages were sent by the enemy camp’s spy; obviously, this spy didn’t believe what he was saying, nor did he think that all his nine teammates would be killed at the start of the game.
He had to promptly inform his teammates to allow them to quickly leave the area and head to a safe place.
Chen Yi lifted his eyelids for a glance but didn’t speak. He just tossed the burnt-out cigarette aside, lit another one, and tried to clear his mind as much as possible.
The feeling of drowsiness was getting stronger.
He had to keep his brain constantly working to fight this sleepiness, and by then, the cloth wrapped around his right leg was soaked with blood.
About 10 minutes passed.
10 players appeared belatedly on the street paved with green bricks and cautiously approached Chen Yi.
“Phew!”
Seeing this, Chen Yi let out a sigh of relief, tossed the cigarette butt aside, and braced himself for the final battle. He was in luck, the God of Fortune had favored him.
10 people, not one less.
What he feared most was the spy escaping.
That would spell disaster.
He hardly had the energy to scour the map for that unknown location.
“Are they really all dead?”
These 10 people walked up to Chen Yi and the first thing they saw was the nine corpses at Chen Yi’s feet and the dozen or so cigarette butts. They stood there, somewhat shocked and wary, not speaking a word.
With these nine corpses present, there was no doubt about Chen Yi’s identity.
He definitely was the spy.
Anyone other than a spy wouldn’t have killed all nine of his teammates, although a warlord might have the motive to do so, but a warlord couldn’t appear in their squad channel as a mysterious person.
“Stab them each once.”
These people didn’t immediately respond to Chen Yi but instead avoided him deliberately. After ensuring that they stabbed each of the bodies on the ground several times, they felt relieved and turned their attention to Chen Yi.
Continue your journey with empire
“All 10 of us are here; how do you plan to find out which one of us is the spy and the warlord?”
“Interrogation?”
They had been worried that these corpses were feigning death and would suddenly attack as they approached, but after all were stabbed, they were reassured: they were indeed dead, deader than dead.
“No need.”
Chen Yi, leaning against the wall, weakly lifted his eyelids and pointed toward the entrance of the yard: “Inside this yard, there is an effect of absolute darkness.”
“Once inside, you can’t see or hear anything.”
“Stay inside for ten minutes, and a game will begin.”
“Each person will receive a word, but the spy and the warlord will have different words from the others. Everyone will need to describe the word they received with short sentences, and through this method, we’ll filter out who the spy and the warlord are.”
“That’s how I was exposed just now.”
“As long as everyone goes in, take about seven or eight steps and then wait patiently for the game to begin, we will quickly filter out who the spy and the warlord are.”
“Oh?”
One of the 10, a bearded man with narrowed eyes, stayed silent for a long time before speaking: “So there’s such a trap. No wonder you killed 9 enemy players at the start. It seems like it was a desperate choice after your identity was exposed.”
Finally, after a brief discussion, the 10 people didn’t linger and stepped into the yard one by one.
When Chen Yi saw that all 10 had entered the yard, the constant worry in his heart finally settled.
He could feel his condition deteriorating.
He lit another cigarette, and about four or five seconds after the last person entered the yard, he pressed the glowing cigarette end against the flesh between his thumb and forefinger to keep himself sufficiently alert.
Afterward, Chen Yi, blood-stained, shuffled his legs and slowly entered the yard with a dagger in hand.
Prop activated.
The absolutely dark yard became as clear as daylight in Chen Yi’s eyes.
Without the slightest hesitation, he walked directly toward the nearest person. Under the cover of darkness, this person had no chance to react, no premonition of what was to come, and life swiftly faded from him as he fell into a pool of blood.
After dealing with this person, Chen Yi did not relax. He moved toward another nearby person.
His thinking was simple.
To find out who among the 10 was the spy and the warlord was not easy; interrogation was ludicrous, as anyone who knew revealing themselves meant death, would not speak.
And who would do the interrogating?
Any other method would consume a lot of time.
What he lacked the most was time.
The simplest and most efficient method was to start killing from the first person until both the warlord and the spy were dead. The mission objective would naturally be completed, and he could leave the map in the shortest time possible.
As for collateral damage to teammates, he could no longer afford to care.
The reason he concocted such a reason to lure these people into the yard was because only there, with the prop he had just obtained, could he kill them in this place.
And he couldn’t allow the spy to think it was a no-win situation; otherwise, the spy would just run away, leaving him dumbfounded. No matter what the method, he had to lure them in first.
If the scenario were different.
“`
Forget about 1v10, even 1v1 would be tough for him given his current physical state.
Within just a few minutes, four players had already fallen in the darkness.
However, the mission target was still not completed.
This meant that there was at least one spy or boss still alive, perhaps even both.
Chen Yi had anticipated this outcome and was not at all discouraged; instead, he raised his dagger and continued towards another person in the dark.
…
“Puchi!”
The eighth player fell.
Chen Yi, already staggering, stared calmly at the slowly fading life in the player’s eyes and patiently waited for what would happen if the mission target was not completed upon this player’s death.
There would be a problem then.
The usage limit for Dark Vision Prop had been reached.
This was his last time.
Without the Dark Vision Prop, it would be difficult for him to find the remaining two players in the courtyard.
When the player at his feet breathed his last, and Chen Yi had still not heard the prompt, he let out a sigh and looked up, taking advantage of the last few seconds of the Dark Vision Prop’s effect.
He quickly looked towards the other two players.
At this moment, these two players had accidentally encountered the bodies on the ground and realized something was amiss; with frightened expressions, they clung to the walls, wildly waving their daggers through the air.
These were his final seconds of light.
He had to make a quick decision between the two on whom to kill first; if he made the wrong choice again, and the remaining player managed to grope their way to the courtyard entrance and escape, he wouldn’t have the strength to pursue them. Death seemed almost certain then.
He memorized the positions of the two players.
Both were sticking to a corner of the wall, waving their daggers through the air, with no apparent intention to move anytime soon—a good sign for him.
At least the spy was likely dead; the one still alive was probably the boss.
If it were the spy, they would have already fled through the wall by now. Although he wasn’t sure about the boss’s ability, it probably wasn’t wall-passing.
After memorizing their positions, Chen Yi didn’t linger and walked straight to the courtyard wall to activate the spy’s wall-passing ability for the second time, leaving his original spot and standing on the cobblestone street.
Immediately after.
Following the imprint in his mind.
He walked along the courtyard wall to one side, stopped at a spot, and stared at the courtyard wall in front of him, slowly raising the dagger in his hand.
The two surviving players.
One was the slightly leading bearded man, the other a young girl.
Although the psychology student had died, Chen Yi found the young man’s words quite reasonable; whoever stepped up to take control at this time was most likely not of a good identity.
Only with enough information obtained from one’s own identity perspective would one dare to take control.
He chose to gamble that the slightly leading bearded man was the remaining boss player.
If he guessed right, he could leave the map immediately; if wrong, he would have to go through the trouble of killing the remaining girl too.
He took a deep breath and activated his spy’s wall-passing ability for the last time.
The wall, once solid, now seemed to flow like liquid, and Chen Yi, without any hesitation, aimed his dagger at the spot in his memory and stabbed straight through!
“Tear!”
He felt the resistance of the blade piercing flesh!
The position was correct.
In the abdomen.
The neck was too small a target, and he didn’t aim there; the margin of error was too low, while the abdomen allowed for a much higher margin of error.
And the next second.
He suddenly felt a slightly rough hand grab his wrist tightly, preventing the dagger from stabbing any further!
“Puchi!”
Chen Yi didn’t bother with his right hand but kept stabbing wildly with the dagger in his left hand through the wall.
Once, twice, three times.
He didn’t know how many times he stabbed.
When he felt he could barely exert any more strength in his thrusts,
a prompt finally sounded in his ear.
’Ding, it has been detected that all players from one faction and all boss players are dead.’
’The remaining surviving players will leave the map and receive map rewards and view map evaluations.’
’Number of surviving players 2: Chen Yi, Li Xiali.’
As the prompt ended,
a flash of white light suddenly passed in front of Chen Yi’s eyes, and when he opened them again, he was already in the familiar rented room in his neighborhood.
Looking at the familiar surroundings, Chen Yi slightly arched his eyebrows and looked at the reward panel, his lips unconsciously curling into a smile.
No matter the process, he had made it out alive.
And the rewards were quite generous.
Of course, the most important thing now was to heal his injuries first.
Fortunately, injuries weren’t a big deal once he was out of the map, as he possessed several Props for treating injuries. Diseases like leukemia were incurable, but superficial wounds were still very treatable.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 135 - 134: "Why hasn’t the map ended yet?
chapters.content:
Chapter 135 – 134: “Why hasn’t the map ended yet?
After emerging from the map, Chen Yi first scanned his surroundings and did not spot any trace of the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
He couldn’t help but feel some inward anxiety, uncertain about the situation.
However, now was not the time to think about that.
“Prop Name”: All-Purpose Bandage.
“Prop Level”: D Level.
“Prop Restriction”: One-time use.
“Prop Effect”: Wrap the bandage around the wound, and the wound will heal very quickly, provided there is no debris inside the wound, such as shrapnel. It must be removed beforehand.
“Prop Introduction”: “Make do with it.”
There were a total of four, obtained previously, but he had forgotten specifically where he got them from; he just tossed them into his backpack.
Since he had never been injured before, he didn’t pay much attention to it, but unexpectedly, he got hurt on this map.
Chen Yi first cleaned his wounds with antiseptic, then wrapped his right chest and right leg with the bandages, using a total of two bandages.
With doubled physical strength, although it still took some effort to remove the animal trap, he eventually did it.
He then heaved a sigh of relief, changed into a clean outfit, and looked completely uninjured from the outside; the bandage’s effect was quite good too.
It had only been wrapped for a few minutes when he started to feel an itch on the wound, and he could even faintly sense the granulation tissue at the wound site growing rapidly, and the flesh knitting back together bit by bit.
Only then did he have time to look at the map evaluation.
“Map Evaluation”: You are not a qualified spy. A spy should rationally use his ability to pass crucial information back to his own camp to mislead players from the hostile camp, then use the ability to pass through walls to create an alibi to confuse one’s identity.
Therefore, you have earned the title “Reckless Spy.”
“Map Reward”: Clean grey stone x1, 5000 Points, Level 2 Enhancement Stone x10, Random C-Level Prop Chest x1.
No doubt about it, the rewards were quite generous.
Especially that clean grey stone, which he was seeing produced for the first time.
He had several props in his arms that needed a clean grey stone to unlock new effects, such as those props that were fully enhanced, and then there was that World Boss activity Title Effect.
After pondering for a moment, Chen Yi eventually decided to use the clean grey stone on the Title first. After all, using it on any prop would only unlock one Enhancement Effect and would not unlock all the Enhancement Effects completely.
It was better to use it on the Title, which at least meant that this Title would not need a clean grey stone in the future.
Then he looked at the Title “Great Demon King” in his personal panel, confirmed without hesitation the use of the clean grey stone, and applied it to the Title, Great Demon King.
Soon enough.
The special effects of the Great Demon King title materialized before him.
“Title Name”: Great Demon King!
“Title Level”: Red.
“Title Effect”: As the Great Demon King, you should have the aura of one. You can reject all compulsory invitations without any cost, and can spend 1000 Points to help your friends equally reject compulsory invitations.
“Title Source”: Earned by dealing the most damage and killing the final boss during the “World Boss” activity.
Looking at the effect of this title, Chen Yi was momentarily stunned, a hint of pleasure and surprise flashing in his eyes.
Can reject all compulsory invitations?
This was extremely useful for him.
He had been summoned to a map twice against his will, once by Zhou Ping who forced him into a map where the Insect Race was invading—though he was not hurt that time and even received some rewards, he was still annoyed by the involuntary nature of the summons.
It’s like he actually likes eating hot pot, but if someone forces him to eat hot pot with some kind of prop, he would be very displeased.
I’m doing this because I want to, but if you force me, then we’ll have to see if your life is tough enough.
So after that map was over, he made his first move to send that Zhou Ping to Hell.
The second time was when Gao Yiming, after his death, pulled him into this Werewolf Kill map—a map where no player could use Skills, and also the first time he got such a serious injury. Although Gao Yiming was already dead, the more he thought about it, the angrier he became.
It was clear that the anger was not something he could easily swallow.
He had to vent it, or he’d be very uncomfortable.
Although the rewards were not bad, he still greatly disliked being forcibly invited to a map, especially ones that were disadvantageous to him.
With this title, he wouldn’t have to worry about being forcibly dragged into a map in the future.
And spending Points could also help others evade compulsory invitations, so he no longer needed to be concerned about Tuberculosis Rabbit being compelled into some death-trap map.
The remainder of the Points and Enhancement Stone rewards were, to say the least, better than nothing. The random C-Level Prop Chest yielded a prop that was quite useful in special moments, a lifestyle prop, which might come in handy later on.
As for this awarded title, it was somewhat interesting.
“Title Name”: Reckless Spy!
“Title Level”: Purple.
“Title Effect”: When you stand still in one place for ten seconds without any action, everyone around you will subconsciously overlook your presence, but those with special props or a stronger will might still take notice of you.
“Title Source”: Earned in the “Werewolf Kill” map for single-handedly killing all players from the hostile camp while acting as a spy.
An invisibility title.
Quite interesting under certain circumstances.
After Chen Yi finished up everything, he lit a cigarette and stood by the window with a burning crimson at his fingertips, silently gazing into the distance against the dimming sky without speaking.
He was still somewhat worried about Tuberculosis Rabbit.
And… he knew there were Hell Players in that urban map.
Players who arrive in the afterworld after death become Hell Players, and there is interaction between them; in some maps, Hell Players might exist.
If a Hell Player kills ten ordinary players on a map, they can be resurrected.
This means Gao Yiming must have become some kind of Hell Player.
Since Hell Players can come here, then he must also have a way to go to hell, right? He didn’t know whether there was a way to go to hell and completely eliminate that Gao Yiming, erasing him from this world forever.
On one hand, it was to prevent future troubles.
On the other hand, he really couldn’t swallow this affront.
He glanced at the calendar next to him; it was already June 16th. In just over ten days, it would be July, and he had no idea what kind of curveballs the new rules of July would throw.
Although the rules of June were torturous, at least they weren’t life-threatening from a certain perspective.
Meanwhile.
He also saw the message in the chat box from Sword Without End; it had been a while.
“Uh, sorry, Yi, I might have screwed things up.”
“I’ve searched all over Black Trench City, and I haven’t seen a trace of Wang Yimei.”
“Even those who know him well say they don’t know where he went. I’m still looking, and I’ll let you know the moment I have any news.”
It was normal not to find him.
Wang Yimei had run off to this map; it was truly normal for him to be unfindable.
“No need, he ran over here, and I’ve already slaughtered him.”
After Chen Yi casually replied, he frowned in thought without speaking. Without mentioning that person, he would have forgotten; probably, that guy had become some Hell Player as well and might one day encounter him again, pestering him like a rabid dog.
But how to go to hell, he really had no clear idea.
…
Meanwhile.
In the Werewolf Kill map where Tuberculosis Rabbit was, corpses were strewn everywhere.
“Hm-hm.”
With a nearly burnt-out cigarette in his mouth, Tuberculosis Rabbit sauntered around the bodies with his hands in his pockets, stepping here and there indifferently, his clothes already soaked with blood. The air was thick with the scent of gore.
“Tch.”
He squatted down, picked up a clot of blood with his forefinger, and as he scrutinized it, he spoke with some emotion, “Tell me, why does the blood from a dead person look just like the clots from my hemorrhoids?”
At that moment—
An anxious and puzzled voice suddenly echoed in his ears, “Why hasn’t the map ended yet?”
“The other 18 players are all dead, and only the two of us, the mighty, remain.”
“According to the victory conditions for the mighty, the game ends and the mighty win if there is only one or two mighty left on the map. Why hasn’t it ended yet?”
“Did you not finish off someone properly? Is there someone who didn’t die thoroughly? Are the 18 players not fully dead?”
Next to Tuberculosis Rabbit, a middle-aged, strong man, also clad in blood-soaked clothes, squatted unsteadily on the spot, looking anxiously at Tuberculosis Rabbit and speaking rapidly.
“I’m too gravely injured; I have to get treated immediately, there’s no delay.”
“You need to go and confirm that all the players we killed other than us two mighty are completely dead by giving them another stab.”
“Go quickly!”
Seeing that Tuberculosis Rabbit did not move and was chatting to himself next to the bodies, the middle-aged man couldn’t help but angrily shouted, “Are you fucking deaf? I told you to go and finish them off quickly, if we don’t leave the map and get treated, I’m going to die here!”
“Dammit.”
Finally, Tuberculosis Rabbit reacted, showing annoyance as he slowly stood up with the cigarette in his mouth. He glanced around and then fixed his gaze on the staggeringly squatted middle-aged man not far away.
Find more to read at empire
Approaching the man, he squatted down and took a deep drag on his cigarette, exhaling a stream of smoke over the man’s face discontentedly.
“What are you yapping about? Don’t you see I’m talking with them? Don’t you know I hate it when someone interrupts my chats?”
“They’re all dead; what the fuck can you talk about with corpses?”
The middle-aged man was practically driven mad with irritation, his voice rising uncontrollably.
“You don’t know shit; talking with the dead is the most fun, at least they don’t argue with you.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced around somewhat uninterested, wondering how Yi was doing, then weighed the dagger in his hand and naturally stabbed it into the belly of the middle-aged man in front of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 136 - 135: "You’re Not a Hero?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 136 – 135: “You’re Not a Hero?!
Naturally, it was as if a couple madly in love were embraced and kissing under a street light in the night, unable to restrain their affection.
The whole process was smooth and flowing.
“Down.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit stepped back a few paces, squatted on the ground with a cigarette in his mouth, and looked expectantly at the middle-aged man who was now even more unsteady after being stabbed in the abdomen, wondering when the man would finally fall.
“You…”
The middle-aged man, who’d never expected the Tuberculosis Rabbit to attack him, was now on his knees, powerless in a pool of blood after such a Fatal Strike, and with anger and confusion in his eyes, he struggled to look up at the Tuberculosis Rabbit, just about to say something.
Then he suddenly realized something, disbelief flashing in the depths of his eyes, and his voice trembled with frustration.
“You’re not a hero?!”
He had thought the reason the map hadn’t ended was due to the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s sloppy finishing blows, but it turned out that the real reason the map hadn’t ended was simply because the Tuberculosis Rabbit wasn’t a hero.
That was the real reason the map hadn’t ended.
“Ah, indeed I’m not.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit casually nodded, tilted his head with an air of nonchalance and said, “Sorry for deceiving you. I’ll apologize to you in the next life.”
“My identity is that of an ordinary person.”
“Once you die, the map should be able to end.”
“How… How is this possible!”
The middle-aged man, covering the stab wound in his abdomen with a dagger plunged deep into him and blood gushing unstoppably through his fingers, stared straight at the Tuberculosis Rabbit with an incredulous and ferocious look.
“If you’re not a hero and just an ordinary person, why didn’t your expression change at all when I killed players from your team, and moreover, why did you even kill with your own hands?”
“The victory goal for an ordinary person is to kill all enemy players, isn’t it? Why did you kill your own teammates too?”
“Oh, that thing?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, a bit bored, spit the burned-out cigarette butt into a pool of blood to the side, and while trimming the hangnail on his index finger with the dagger, he said absent-mindedly, “You weren’t killing me, so why should I be perturbed?”
“As for why I killed teammates?”
“I had no idea which one among the teammates was the spy; it was simpler just to kill them all, ensuring the spy would be among the dead.”
“Although the victory goal is to kill all enemy players, killing all teammates should also allow for a successful exit from the map, I suppose. Since I’d killed already, I just went a little further.”
“If that made you mistake my identity for that of a hero, then I’m sorry.”
“…”
The middle-aged man’s body slowly tensed and, unwilling to the end, he collapsed heavily into the pool of blood.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a hint of meaningful amusement in his eyes, slowly stood up and walked towards the body of the middle-aged man.
Just as the Tuberculosis Rabbit approached the middle-aged man’s side.
The next second—
The supposedly dead middle-aged man suddenly lifted his head, eyes full of spite and venom as he clenched the dagger in his hand, grabbing the leg that had stepped in front of him, and with the last of his strength, he made a stab!
He simply didn’t have the strength to stand.
He couldn’t aim for a vital spot.
But he was satisfied to inflict a severe injury on his assailant before death; if someone was going to kill him, they were going to lose some teeth doing it!
“Psh!”
The dagger buried itself to the hilt in the ankle and blood gushed forth. A flicker of satisfaction crossed the middle-aged man’s eyes. He tried to lift his head to see the expression on the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face, but before he could fully raise it, his body suddenly stiffened.
That strike had drained all his Vitality.
His head fell powerlessly into the pool of blood.
“Tsk.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit crouched down, turned over the middle-aged man’s body, and looking at his mouth corners turned up in triumph from a successful plot, he murmured, “This kid doesn’t think he achieved some great feat before dying, does he?”
Then he shrugged, tossed the corpse with the dagger still in its ankle to the side, patted off his clothes, and stood up as if nothing had happened.
The middle-aged man’s dying blow hadn’t landed on him, but on the dead body he was holding in his hand.
The middle-aged man’s act of playing dead was too obvious, and he had also noticed the man pulling out the dagger from his stomach and hiding it in his palm.
So he decided to toy with the man a bit, not expecting that the man would excitedly die before the game was up.
After doing all this.
He stood still and stretched, moving his limbs amidst the bodies, yawning a long yawn and smacking his lips, “It’s time to head home, I wonder if Yi has returned.”
The next second—
A voice prompt eerily echoed in his ear.
’Map Evaluation’: As an ordinary person, you’ve killed all the players and successfully exited the map, congratulations for reducing the death rate of this map a bit more.
Your identity isn’t that of a hero, but your actions exceed those of a hero.
Therefore, you receive the title ’Public Enemy.’
’Map Reward’: clean grey stone*2, Points 5000, Level 2 Enhancement Stone*10, Random C-class Prop Gift Pack*1.
With a flash of white light,
when the Tuberculosis Rabbit opened his eyes, he found himself back in the familiar rental room, and the first thing he saw was Yi’s silhouette standing in front of the window not far away. He couldn’t help but excitedly call out. Read new chapters at empire
“Yi!”
“Mmm.”
Hearing the noise behind him, Chen Yi turned around to look and subconsciously responded. When he saw that the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s clothes were completely soaked with blood, a flicker of panic crossed his eyes, and his voice became slightly anxious, “Where are you hurt?”
“Are the injuries severe?”
“Quick, take off your clothes. I have healing items here.”
“I’m not hurt anywhere.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in place with a trouble-free demeanor and spread his hands, casually saying, “Besides some superficial skin abrasions, there are no other injuries. Although this map prevents the use of skills and props, it should not be very difficult for us to clear.”
“This is someone else’s blood on me; it’s sticky. I need to take a quick shower.”
“Yi, are you injured?”
“…”
Chen Yi retracted his foot that he had initially extended, and stood calmly in place, casually covering the bandages completely by shaking the hem of his trousers, “I’m not injured either. A minor map like this would find it a bit difficult to injure me.”
“But you can’t have this kind of overconfidence in the future. You still need to be as careful as possible.”
“Don’t worry, Yi, I understand. Can I go take a shower now?”
“Yes, go ahead. I’ve already taken one.”
“Okay.”
…
Only after the Tuberculosis Rabbit returned safely did Chen Yi breathe a sigh of relief. The heart that had been in his chest finally settled down.
This kind of map, where no one can use skills, undoubtedly creates the greatest distance between weak players and those like themselves in terms of skills and equipment.
But for players like them, such maps are just a nuisance.
Luckily, with the title of Great Demon King, they no longer need to worry about being forcefully invited into this kind of cursed map.
At that moment, he also received another reply from Sword Without End.
“Yi, I haven’t found Wang Yimei in Black Trench City, but I discovered some other things. I think it’s necessary to come and talk to you face to face. It’s important; I am already on my way.”
Chen Yi looked at the message without lingering on it for too long, just quickly giving the Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was still in the bathroom, a few instructions before getting up and heading towards the rooftop patio.
Not long ago, the Law Enforcement Bureau came to their door and offered them a spacious garden villa in the urban area, but they didn’t accept it.
In reality, it was unnecessary for the Law Enforcement Bureau to intervene.
Strong players from various cities had already used their means to move into houses that they couldn’t afford on a normal day.
However, Chen Yi and his companion were not particularly interested in this. They had grown accustomed to living here; moving would be troublesome. Besides, where one sleeps doesn’t change much, and there really wasn’t a need to move to a villa for this reason.
Real estate had become worthless.
With the number of surviving players, the entire city was full of empty houses. As long as you’re willing, you could pry open any door and move in without paying a penny.
As for things like property titles, they had long since become useless paper.
Standing on the patio, Chen Yi, with one hand in his pocket, leaned on his cane and overlooked the city. The wind tonight was quite strong, with not a hint of heat but rather a coolness that made his clothes flutter loudly.
The weather tonight was also quite unusual.
It was only seven in the evening, yet the sky had already completely darkened, with large swathes of dark clouds gathering above the city, the howling wind hinting that a storm was on the horizon.
The weather forecasts had long since ceased operation.
But even without referring to the weather forecast, one could sense that a downpour was imminent.
It wasn’t long before,
Chen Yi saw Sword Without End, riding atop the Green Peak, speed towards his direction against the backdrop of the sky.
In a matter of seconds,
Sword Without End landed steadily on the patio, stepping off the Three-Foot Qingfeng, he took a deep breath before nervously starting, “I managed to arrive safely at last. If the matter weren’t so critical, I really wouldn’t have wanted to make the trip today.”
“I don’t know what’s going on, but today, the skies over every city I visited were filled with pitch-black clouds, with relentless wind and clear signs of an approaching downpour.”
“There were even continuous explosions of thunder in the black clouds.”
“Under such conditions, flying in midair really made me worry about getting struck down by lightning.”
“I wonder if other cities are like this, too. This kind of weather feels so oppressive, making it very clear that under the power of nature, those things that humans take pride in are actually quite fragile.”
Sword Without End stood beside Chen Yi, gazing at the horizon and reflecting on this sentiment.
Chen Yi glanced at Sword Without End and then offhandedly said, “Didn’t the world boss event reward you with a title?”
Above Sword Without End’s head, there was only the title he had seen the first time they met.
“I have a sword, who dares to respond?”
In theory, there should be two titles above Sword Without End’s head. During the world boss event, Sword Without End had also received a limited-edition title.

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 137 - 136: "Isn’t it a bit unlucky?
chapters.content:
Chapter 137 – 136: “Isn’t it a bit unlucky?
“Oh.”
Sword Without End seemed unfazed, realizing something as he spoke with one hand behind his back, “You mean the ’Second Devil King’ title, right? I sold it, sold it to a pretty wealthy player.”
“Tsk, that player really was willing to pay the price, and it was a very tempting offer.”
“That player also asked me to contact you. He said he wanted to buy your title as well, but I didn’t pass the message because I knew you wouldn’t sell it even if you knew.”
“The name of this title is too silly; who would want to have ’Second’ above their head? Moreover, the Title Effect is invisible, said to be obscured by dust; you need a clean grey stone to see it.”
“Apart from the title I’m currently wearing, I’ve sold all the others.”
“I prefer something purer, and the title I have now suits me just fine.”
“By the way, I have something important to tell you this time.”
Sword Without End’s expression suddenly turned serious as he turned to face Chen Yi and said word by word, “Do you still remember the Hell Player we encountered on the map of the 13th city?”
“In that map, we learned of the existence of Hell Players.”
“Players who die after the coming of the next world become Hell Players, and Hell Players can be revived by killing 10 players on the map.”
“Today, when I went to Black Trench City to look for Wang Yimei, I discovered a terrifying thing.”
“Not long ago, I killed a trash-talker in Black Trench City. Today, I suddenly found that the trash-talker I killed appeared alive again, killing monsters outside the city, and he even had several strong props, already followed by a few minions.”
“I suspect that this player is a Hell Player who revived by killing 10 players.”
“I thought this matter might be important, so I came to find you right away.”
“After learning this, I made a somewhat crazy decision; I’ve decided to take a trip to hell.”
“Though I’m not sure if only players who die after the next world comes can become Hell Players, or if players who died earlier will also be transformed, I still want to go down and see.”
“I want to go find my wife.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi raised his eyebrows slightly. This matter was indeed very important. He too had been pondering over it and only after a moment did he softly say, “Have you found a way down to hell?”
“Hmm.”
Sword Without End took a deep breath, his face set with determination as he nodded, “Just commit suicide.”
“…”
Chen Yi suddenly fell silent.
Indeed, that was the most direct way to hell; dying would naturally lead one there. But after a moment, he still advised out of kindness and good intentions.
“I suggest you give up this idea for the time being. We don’t know much about Hell Players.”
“First of all, we’re not sure if one’s memory is lost after becoming a Hell Player, whether we remain our true selves upon revival, and whether killing 10 players in the map guarantees a successful revival.”
“Many factors are uncertain.”
“This idea is too radical.”
“It won’t do.”
Sword Without End sighed somewhat helplessly, “Before I knew this information, I could get through each day as if nothing happened, but when I saw someone actually reviving from hell and returning.”
“The thought has been embedded in my head.”
“If I give up today and hesitate, I’ll live the rest of my life in endless guilt.”
“You and I seem alike, but we are fundamentally different.”
“You’ve been an orphan since childhood, never having felt the warmth brought by a family or a loved one, whereas I have enjoyed all of these, but in the end, I watched as they all left me.”
“If a person has never owned something, they won’t be overly obsessed with not having it.”
“I’ve had it, so I plan to go find it back.”
“You’re one of the few friends still alive to me, maybe you’re just tougher, so before I go, I wanted to say goodbye to you. If I don’t come back, at least it won’t be a disappearance without reason.”
“And I interrogated that trash-talker from Black Trench City who came back from the dead; no part of his memory had changed, he was still himself, and I killed him again, not sure if he can turn into a Hell Player this time.”
“…”
Chen Yi suddenly stood in silent expressionlessness, wait a second; something suddenly came to his mind!
Before meeting Sword Without End, he couldn’t say that everything was smooth sailing, but at least he hadn’t been injured!
But since meeting Sword Without End, he’d nearly died in that Werewolf Kill map, and although he was lucky enough to survive, the injuries he sustained were not minor; he was in pain all over.
He personally didn’t believe much in superstitions.
But now, he was also starting to wonder if Sword Without End could be someone born under some cursed star, with people around him ending up dead or crippled. If his own fate wasn’t tough enough, might he not have been injured, but instead lying dead in the map?
By that logic, Tuberculosis Rabbit must have an even tougher fate.
Apart from a few scratches, Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t have any injuries at all.
That’s true.
In the movie scene, Yi was the one who died in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit. Even more so in that scene, Tuberculosis Rabbit committed suicide. If Tuberculosis Rabbit hadn’t actively jumped into the Insect Tide, Yi might not have died at all.
Chen Yi’s mouth twitched slightly, and for a moment he no longer dared to speak to Sword Without End to dissuade him, “Since you’ve made up your mind, then go ahead. When will you make your move?”
“Now.”
With one hand behind his back, Sword Without End stood at the edge of the rooftop, gazing at the dark clouds on the horizon. His white Tang suit fluttered in the fierce wind, and his eyes, filled with tenacity, spoke solemnly.
“This journey, I do not know when I will be able to return. If I can come back, I’ll bring you a little something from hell.”
“Don’t rush.”
Chen Yi shook his head and interrupted, “Since you are determined, there are some things I need to ask of you. After you go to hell, help me find Wang Yimei and kill him.”
“…”
Sword Without End looked at Chen Yi with a strange expression and after a long pause spoke eerily, “To kill him again, huh? Can’t you ask for something new for a change?”
“I went all over Black Trench City looking for him and didn’t find him. Now I have to go to hell to find him?”
“Why do I suddenly feel like my quest to find my wife has turned into a business trip on public expense?”
“There actually is something new.”
Chen Yi took out a small notebook from his bosom and began to read off a list of names: “Zhou Ping, the one from the Vehicle ranking list. Gao Yiming, the one who started a company in Yancheng, and there’s someone who opened Mutual Entertainment KTV in Yancheng too, and…”
“These people should all be Hell Players. Since you’re set on descending to hell, I’ll leave them in your hands. Please take care of them.”
“You set your price.”
Sword Without End accepted the small notebook that Chen Yi handed over with a complex expression, feeling somewhat the weight of the notebook. He hadn’t expected Chen Yi to have actually written down all these names.
And judging by his demeanor, it seemed that even if he hadn’t shown up, Chen Yi was prepared to find a way to kill these players again in hell.
Suddenly, he felt that being an enemy of Chen Yi seemed very dangerous.
Even in death, one could not rest in peace.
Luckily, he was not on bad terms with Chen Yi. He definitely did not want to be listed in that notebook—that would truly be suffering.
After a moment of silence, he put the notebook in his pocket and looked up at Chen Yi with a serious face, “Don’t worry, I’ll take this matter to heart and handle it carefully.”
Experience more content on empire
“The reason I came to you in person…”
“Is another important matter.”
Sword Without End took out a Prop from his bosom and activated it, causing a coffin large enough for one person to appear on the ground: “I will commit suicide in this ice coffin, and I hope you can place this coffin somewhere safe.”
“Although I tore that blabbermouth from Black Trench City to pieces, he still managed to revive intact. It seems that having one’s body completely destroyed doesn’t affect resurrection.”
“But if possible, I still wish for my body to be intact, not torn apart.”
“I don’t have any living friends, you are the only one. I can only ask you. Can you do it?”
At this moment—
Tuberculosis Rabbit had finished washing up, wearing loose clothing with her hair not completely dry, and headed onto the rooftop wrapped in a towel. She waved casually at Sword Without End standing on the edge of the rooftop and then spoke.
“Yi told me you have something important to discuss, what’s it about?”
After understanding everything, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Sword Without End with admiration and gave a thumbs up, “You’re a real man. Although I’ve never been in love, a man who is as devoted to love as you deserves a thumbs up.”
“What kind of death have you chosen?”
“Slitting my throat.”
Sword Without End looked towards Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit for one last nod of farewell, and then he lay down in the ice coffin with a solemn, resolute face and a firm flick of his hand.
The floating Three-Foot Qingfeng outside the coffin was tucked into Sword Without End’s backpack.
He then took out a small sword from his bosom and without hesitation plunged it with full force directly into his own neck. His body jerked a few times, and as bubbles of blood emerged from the wound, Sword Without End gradually grew quiet.
The blood filling up the bottom of the ice coffin began to still.
He had clearly died.
“That was a clean and decisive move.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit rested her arms on the edge of the coffin, looking down at Sword Without End lying within, and couldn’t help but feel moved, “They say that people find it hard to carry through with suicide, often leaving several superficial cuts around the fatal wound. What do they call those cuts in medical terms? I forget.”
“But Sword Without End didn’t seem to hesitate at all. He was swift and resolute.”
“A tough guy.”
“This brother is actually quite pitiful. With no family, wife, or friends left, living in this world, all the bustling of life has nothing to do with him.”
“But then again, should we really keep this coffin in our house?”
“Although we’re not scared, isn’t it a bit inauspicious?”

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 138 - 137: Are these humans... Are they all Gods and Demons?
chapters.content:
Chapter 138 – 137: Are these humans… Are they all Gods and Demons?
An ice coffin lay quietly on the rooftop terrace.
Dark clouds filled the sky above Yancheng, and the wild wind howled, causing the clothes of Chen Yi and his companion to flutter noisily. The air lacked yesterday’s summer heat and instead carried a slight, chilling sting.
Visibility was poor.
A large amount of blood pooled at the bottom of the ice coffin, soaking Sword Without End’s white robes to a crimson hue. His slightly green lips exuded an air of desolation.
“June’s weather sure changes quickly.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with one hand in his pocket and a cigarette in his mouth, looked up at the black clouds overhead and said in a daze, “I actually like this kind of weather, it always gives a really comfortable feeling.”
“If we were in an Immortal World, the next scene should be Sword Without End’s ice coffin suddenly struck by a bolt of heavenly thunder. Not only would it allow Sword Without End to be reborn from the ashes, but he would also undergo a transformation and acquire an extremely pure Sword Spirit Root, fulfilling his dream of becoming a Sword Immortal,” he mused.
Chen Yi did not speak, simply standing at the edge of the rooftop, leaning on his cane and gazing into the distance.
For a while, neither of them spoke, merely enjoying the quiet before the storm.
After some time had passed.
Tuberculosis Rabbit flicked away the cigarette in his hand, which had long since gone out, “Yi, didn’t you say you wanted to go to KTV and sing after getting out? Are we still going?”
“No, we’re not.”
Chen Yi shook his head, turned around with his cane, and started walking downstairs. “Let’s go back. We’ll rest at home tonight.”
“Okay.”
The ice coffin was somewhat heavy, but Chen Yi and his companion still managed to move it into their rented apartment. After all, since they had promised Sword Without End to take care of his body, they naturally wouldn’t let it be washed away by the rain on the rooftop.
…
Inside the house.
Chen Yi lay on his side on the bed, staring out the window, lost in thought and silent.
The environment always affects one’s mood.
He didn’t really agree with what Sword Without End said today. Sword Without End mentioned that he never experienced the feeling of family, that he had been alone since he came to this world—seemingly carefree but like a transient guest, never really part of this world.
He was an orphan, indeed, without parents since childhood.
But he wasn’t without family.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was his family.
As for the lover…Chen Yi’s expression drifted as he thought of Jiaye. It seemed like the girl had feelings for him, and she did fit his aesthetic, but he couldn’t quite imagine what it would be like to be with a woman.
Go on a date?
Was he supposed to leave Tuberculosis Rabbit alone at home while he went out on a date with Jiaye? Impossible.
But if he took Tuberculosis Rabbit along, wouldn’t it be strange for three people to go on a date?
Express feelings of love?
Everything was fine when they were just friends; suddenly becoming lovers felt odd.
Besides, the reason he never wanted to have a pet was that he would be sad when it died. If he got together with Jiaye and she died, wouldn’t he end up distraught like Sword Without End, living in a daze?
Lost in these chaotic thoughts, Chen Yi didn’t even notice that his mood at the moment was completely different from usual. He just lay there, looking at the oppressive dark clouds, letting his mind wander.
At this time, Tuberculosis Rabbit had already entered work mode.
