Dressed in work clothes and surrounded by an array of tools, Tuberculosis Rabbit lay at the edge of the ice coffin, looking at Sword Without End’s pale face, and sighed, “You’re lucky. I normally charge quite a bit.”
“I’m feeling a bit itchy to do some work today, so I’ll serve you this once.”
He then proceeded to remove all the residual blood from the bottom of the ice coffin with a tool, followed by suturing the wound, injecting preservatives, undressing, cleaning, changing clothes, applying makeup, etc.
After this whole process.
Sword Without End in the ice coffin no longer looked disheveled. Instead, he lay there in clean and tidy clothes, exuding a dignified presence as if he were ready to open his eyes and strike down anyone at a moment’s notice.
“Not bad.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stretched his shoulders, looking somewhat satisfied at his handiwork in the ice coffin. After admiring it for a while, he couldn’t help but feel a bit regretful, “It’s a shame the wound is too small; the body is intact, not really showcasing my true skills.”
“I once restored a corpse that weighed only 5 pounds, modeled on the deceased’s 3D rendering to replicate their appearance perfectly. That was my real craft.”
Then, suddenly thinking of something, he turned to Yi, “Yi, you better die before me. That way, I can take care of your body, making sure your burial is dignified, and spare you a lot of disgrace.”
“…”
Chen Yi, who had been absorbed in his thoughts, was snapped back to reality by Tuberculosis Rabbit’s words. He lay back expressionlessly, not glancing at Tuberculosis Rabbit, and instead grabbed a pillow and covered his face with it.
“It’s almost 9 o’clock. Time to sleep.”
“Can’t expect you to be cultured, but wish you’d speak like a normal person.”
“Oh.”
Seeing that Chen Yi was ready to sleep, Tuberculosis Rabbit pursed his lips, took off his gloves and threw them into the trash bin, glanced contentedly at his trophy in the ice coffin one last time, then hurriedly washed up and lay down on his bed to sleep.
…
Half an hour later.
Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit both fell into deep slumber.
The windows were tightly shut, and one could even faintly hear the howling wind outside and the rat-a-tat of raindrops fiercely pelting the glass. The sky was extremely dark, making the environment quite conducive to sleep.
If it were during their student days, encountering such weather during the last evening self-study session would indeed be a fortunate thing.
It is human nature to subconsciously seek the comfort of the group in times of crisis.
Youthful ignorance.
In stormy weather, staying in a slightly damp classroom, with the air filled with the fresh scent of mud brought by the heavy rain, if fortunate enough to experience a power outage, the darkness enveloping everything, a mere casual touch of the arm with the person you have a budding crush on could give rise to a thrill and a sense of happiness right from the bottom of your heart.
Regrettably, time waits for no one.
In one’s youthful years, an unintentional touch of the arms would send shivers down the spine.
Yet, by the time one reaches middle age, only at the moment of drawing a sword does one shiver.
Indeed, it has become far less interesting.
However, Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit were both sleeping especially soundly.
Perhaps they were tired from the day’s events, even Chen Yi let out a series of steady and quiet snores, which was an extremely rare occurrence for him. As for Tuberculosis Rabbit, his mouth never stopped moving.
It made the room less silent, but more lively.
“I’m beat today, my first time killing so many people. I was planning to repent before going to sleep, but I forgot.”
“Sword Without End died today.”
“How did he die, if not by suicide? He had to go on about descending to hell to see his deceased wife and family.”
“But then again, since there are Hell Players, there should also be Heaven Players, right?”
“What if Sword Without End hadn’t done anything bad in his life and instead of going to hell, he went to heaven?”
“That’s unlikely. Sword Without End said he killed someone in Black Trench City. Since he committed murder, he’s definitely going to hell. But the question is, did his wife ever do anything bad in her life? What if she ended up in heaven?”
“And why is it…”
In the silence of the room, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s voice kept sounding.
Just then,
Right above Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit, a barely visible phantom emerged, none other than Gao Yiming.
“A gentleman seeks revenge; it is never too late!”
Gao Yiming floated above the two men, gazing at the sleeping Chen Yi with a look of deep resentment before letting out a particularly hearty and vindictive laugh.
“You killed Uncle Wei, you killed my subordinates, and you even killed me!”
“Today, I will kill your brother and let you taste the pain of losing a dear comrade!”
“I can’t believe you two actually managed to make it out of the Werewolf Kill map alive, dodging a 97% death rate. It seems your luck is really good, but I wonder if it will continue to favor you this time?”
After that, he didn’t linger any longer.
With eyes full of spite and hatred, he shot directly towards Tuberculosis Rabbit, plunging into his dreamscape. He planned to scare Tuberculosis Rabbit to death in the dream, to have him die under the rules of May!
The very next second—
Tuberculosis Rabbit, already deep in sleep, suddenly started speaking with a hint of surprise: “Hey, isn’t that Gao Yiming? You’re not dead? What are you doing in my dream?”
At that moment,
Gao Yiming stood in the same place, completely baffled and looking around, unclear of the situation at hand. Explore more stories at empire
He had transformed into a ghastly spirit covered in blood, with a head full of eyes, and dived into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dreamscape, ready to commit his dreadful deed. Everything had gone smoothly until now, but Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dream seemed somewhat strange.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was sitting atop a low stone on the peak of Green Mountain, with dark clouds piling up endlessly in the sky, and the constant howling of fierce winds around him.
The moment he appeared, Tuberculosis Rabbit recognized him.
Below Tuberculosis Rabbit was a throng of people… wait, could they even be called people?
The figure to the far left was a giant skeleton without a trace of flesh, with ghostly flames flickering in its eye sockets and its large head tilting as it stared right at him.
It looked like a huge skull.
At this moment, the skull was simply seated at the foot of the mountain, gazing up at Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting at the peak.
This skull was so massive it seemed taller than Green Mountain itself. Rough estimates would put it at thousands of meters in height!
There was also a woman in a red Soul Garment standing next to the skull, wearing a veil and staring at him. Unlike the skull seated at the base of Green Mountain, this woman was standing at its foot, suggesting she was shorter than the skull.
But she too was a few thousand meters tall, at least.
Her eyes, larger than his entire body, turned towards him like two bloody moons in the sky.
Upon his sudden appearance, she let out a giggle that seemed both coy and thunderous, as if her voice boomed across the entire world, deafening to the ear.
Looking further aside, there was a colossal Gundam. Yes, a Gundam. He had never thought that something he had seen in the movies would one day be witnessed by his own eyes.
The arms of the Gundam were mounted with rocket launchers, which, on rough estimate, each had calibers over 30 meters. A Gundam of such colossal stature likely didn’t rely on the rocket launchers as a primary mode of attack; they were probably just for show, like fireworks.
Are these people… Are they all Gods and Demons?

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 139 - 138: "June 17th.
chapters.content:
Chapter 139 – 138: “June 17th.
The surrounding gods and demons as tall as these numbered in the dozens, and at this moment, these towering gods and demons were all staring straight at him with wide-open eyes, causing his breath to involuntarily catch.
But soon, he forcibly calmed himself down, it’s no big deal, this is just a dream, everything is fictitious. This can only suggest that Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dream tonight seems quite lively.
That’s normal.
He must not be distracted, his mission is to scare Tuberculosis Rabbit to death.
But quickly, he suddenly realized something and immediately turned around, staring at Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting on the peak of Green Mountain, and said word by word, “How do you know I am Gao Yiming, and how do you know you’re dreaming? And you also know this is your dream?”
In order to scare Tuberculosis Rabbit in the dream, he had transformed himself into a monster covered in blood with a head full of eyeballs. With this appearance, let alone his mother, even he wouldn’t be able to recognize himself in a mirror.
But Tuberculosis Rabbit could actually recognize him at a glance?
And how did Tuberculosis Rabbit know this is her own dream?
Who knows they are dreaming while dreaming? Unless it’s sleep paralysis!
“Look at you all.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t pay any attention to Gao Yiming, instead, she looked somewhat bored at those towering gods and demons and waved her hand: “You’ve scared my new guest. Return to normal now, stop messing around.”
“Oh.”
The dozens of towering gods and demons surrounding Gao Yiming all nodded together, their voices resounding deafeningly throughout the heavens and earth.
Immediately afterward—
These dozens of towering gods and demons suddenly began to disintegrate, then transformed into little specks of light that fell upon Green Mountain.
This was on a slope of Green Mountain that wasn’t very steep.
Tuberculosis Rabbit herself was sitting at the summit, and as these little specks of light fell on Green Mountain, they turned back into individuals sitting cross-legged on the mountainside, listening intently with serious expressions, like devout disciples.
At this moment, not only did Gao Yiming not feel the slightest relief, but he also felt his heart rate skyrocket, his body stiffening on the spot, and his eyes filled with a thick sense of fear as he stared at the tens of thousands on the mountainside!
These tens of thousands of people were all men, and moreover, they all looked exactly like Tuberculosis Rabbit!
Their faces bore no difference!
Only their clothing was different.
“This, this, this…”
Gao Yiming, who had originally planned to sneak into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dream to scare her, was now the one scared stiff. He felt as though he couldn’t breathe anymore. Being stared at by tens of thousands of eyes, the hair on his back had long stood on end.
The next second—
Gao Yiming suddenly found that quite a few Tuberculosis Rabbits had encircled him. Before he could say much else, he watched as they all approached him, grabbed him, and then tore the flesh from his body indiscriminately, stuffing it into their mouths.
“No!”
He could only let out a wretched scream before feeling his Vitality rapidly diminish. At that moment, he just wanted to die quickly; the feeling of being devoured alive by a crowd was too excruciating, driving him to the brink of despair!
Just as his Vitality vanished in an instant.
He faintly heard a notification sound in his ear.
“I regret to inform you that you have been officially eliminated from the Ascension Game at 21:38 on June 16th; you will now become a Hell Player.”
“In the SSS-level map, Hell, you will continue to eke out an existence and have the opportunity to return to the Ascension Game by completing tasks.”
“If you die again in the SSS-level map, Hell, you will be permanently eliminated with no chance to return to the Ascension Game and will become a janitor.”
“Please listen carefully to the following instructions…”
The commotion on the mid-slope of Green Mountain quickly subsided, and all became quiet again, with tens of thousands of Tuberculosis Rabbits continuing to sit on the mountainside and silently looking up at Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“Hmm…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting cross-legged on a low rock at the summit of Green Mountain, propped her chin in thought: “Let me think, where was I?”
“Oh right, I remember now.”
“Talking about Sword Without End’s death, then Yi told Sword Without End to help kill Wang Yimei and Gao Yiming once more in Hell.”
“Not sure if they can be found…”
The wind howled incessantly.
The calm and unhurried voice of Tuberculosis Rabbit echoed on the summit, as it did in the outside world within a house.
The weather in both worlds was somewhat similar.
Dark clouds loomed overhead in both, with ceaseless howling winds, but the outside had already seen a torrential downpour, whereas in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dream there was no rainstorm yet.
After some time passed.
A portion of the people sitting midway up Green Mountain began to rise and queue up to approach Tuberculosis Rabbit at the peak.
“Your eyeball fell out again, huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit twisted the man’s head in front of her for a look, then forcefully stuffed the eyeball back into its socket and gave it a good punch before patting his head to signal him to move back.
“There, that should do it. If you don’t look down at the ground too much, your eyeballs won’t fall out. Try to look straight ahead and upwards more often.”
“Next one.”
“What’s wrong with you? Your abdominal wound split open again?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a pile of tools from her bosom and gestured for the man to come closer before she began stitching him up, and while doing so, she said, “Eat less of your own intestines, try some others’, and maybe change up your diet now and then, hm?”
The man in front of her had an abdominal wound so gruesome it practically split him in two, which would have been fatal to a normal person, yet this man could still walk and even nodded seriously upon hearing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s advice.
Eerily, this man’s face was identical to that of Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Even if Chen Yi were here, he wouldn’t be able to tell any difference between the two Tuberculosis Rabbit’s appearances.
The tens of thousands of people halfway up the mountainside all had faces identical to the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
The whole scene looked especially unsettling.
But the Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting at the top of Green Mountain seemed to have no reaction to this, just continually picking up tools and starting to sew the wounds of the men lined up and walking in front of him.
He mumbled to himself as he stitched.
It was all nonsensical chatter.
Such as what had happened today, what he had eaten with Yi, which maps he had visited today and what he had done there—it looked like a country housewife moving her stool to her front door to gossip with the neighbors.
Perhaps after a long time had passed.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit stopped what he was doing in his hands, stretched after standing up and then looked towards the line of people halfway up the mountain, “Alright, it’s time for me to wake up, I’ve slept enough.”
His words trailed off.
All the people on the mountainside stood up, their pupils filled with sadness and a faint hope, staring straight at the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“That look again.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit pursed his lips with some boredom and impatience, “Annoying, every time I see you guys like this, it feels like my own dirge is about to start playing.”
“I’m off.”
…
Dawn had not yet broken.
But under the rule of June, everyone should also be awake by now. Going to bed at nine in the evening and getting up at six in the morning meant nearly nine hours of sleep, which was enough.
Chen Yi washed up simply, and when he came out and saw the Tuberculosis Rabbit was also awake, he casually sat down on the sofa to light a post-wake-up cigarette, trying to move his right leg.
“Awake?”
The effect of that bandage prop seemed really good. Just one night had passed, and he felt like the injury on his right leg had almost healed; he could walk normally, with only a slight pain and an itchy feeling from the wound healing.
At this rate, it was estimated that the injury would be almost completely healed by the next day.
“Yep.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, groggy, rubbed his sleepy eyes, gave himself a hasty wash in the bathroom, and then sat back down on the sofa opposite Yi, casually tearing off a page from the calendar.
’June 17th.’
“It’s already the 17th, huh? I need to find some time to go to that wilderness map and finish building my house.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly remembered the unfinished house on the wilderness map, somewhat confused. But then something else came to mind, his thoughts jumping swiftly as he raised an eyebrow to signal Yi to look towards the ice coffin by the wall, grinning and saying, Read chapters at empire
“How about it, Yi, did you take a look this morning?”
“My handiwork is quite decent right? I’ve cleaned up Sword Without End thoroughly.”
“Pretty good.”
When he got up, Chen Yi saw that Sword Without End inside the ice coffin had been tidied up extremely cleanly. But then he grew curious and casually said, “Speaking of which, where did you learn this skill from? It feels like you knew it even without studying.”
“For someone to self-learn restoring a body using 3D modeling techniques, that’s usually quite hard, isn’t it?”
“How advanced is the internet, of course I learned it online.” The Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged, a touch smug, “Back when I was watching over corpses in the morgue, I studied earnestly every night, indulging in learning, unable to extricate myself.”
“I have to say, the internet is a wonderful thing, in the past, if you wanted to learn a skill, you had to seek teachers everywhere.”
“Now you can learn it all on the internet.”
“Pretty good.”
Chen Yi stopped bringing up the topic, and just as he was about to say something, he suddenly heard a knock at the door.
“Bang, bang.”
“I’ll check it out.”
Before Chen Yi could stand up, the Tuberculosis Rabbit sprang from the sofa and rushed toward the door.
He swung open the security door.
Seeing the person standing outside, the Tuberculosis Rabbit hesitated for a moment and then said, “Yi, maybe you should take a look?”
“Hmm?”
Seeing the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s reaction, Chen Yi squinted his eyes and took his cane out of the backpack, leaning on it as he headed towards the entrance, ready to shoot at any time.
“Jiaye?”
But soon, Chen Yi saw that the visitor was actually Jiaye, holding a thermal container that looked like he was delivering food, followed by Tie Chui with a beaming smile on his face.
“Come in, come in.”
Though Chen Yi was somewhat puzzled, friends coming to the door meant there was no reason not to welcome them, “Find a place to sit, the place is a bit messy, please excuse it.”
“No worries.”
Seeing that Chen Yi didn’t shut him out, Jiaye’s eyes curved like crescent moons as he walked in with the thermal container, first quickly scanning the room. Only after seeing there were no women’s items, did he feel an even greater internal thrill.
Even if Yi had someone he liked,
with no women’s items in the house, it clearly meant he either broke up or divorced.
The only question was whether he had children or not.

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 140 - 139: "I remember now, you are paying social security, aren’t you?
chapters.content:
Chapter 140 – 139: “I remember now, you are paying social security, aren’t you?
“I only made some light dishes early this morning, not sure if they’ll suit your tastes.”
Jiaye sat at the dining table and began setting out the dishes from his thermal container one by one, “This is steamed yellow croaker, the real deal. You can’t buy this in the System Market; I got it from a fellow fishmonger.”
“If we weren’t former fish sellers ourselves, ordinary people wouldn’t have a chance to buy a real yellow croaker at a time like this. There’s just no way to find it.”
“There’s also millet porridge, eight fried eggs—four with salt, four without.”
“Not sure if you folks like your fried eggs with or without salt, so I made both.”
“Plus meat buns, vegetarian buns, plain soy milk, sweetened soy milk, salty doufu nao, spicy doufu nao, sweet doufu nao, and crullers. Here, we also have some pickles to go with the porridge.”
“And there’s fermented black bean yellow croaker—it’s a bit more flavorful than the steamed one; see which you prefer.”
“My brother also has some dim sum left, which are mostly sweet. Not sure if that’s to your liking.”
“Everything here is homemade by me, not a single item was bought.”
Jiaye’s eyes curved into crescents, and although there was no hint of boasting in her tone, the sense of pride was nearly spilling from her eyes.
Only then did Chen Yi notice that the container Jiaye was holding was just the appetizer, while the real feast was in the giant thermal box that Tie Chui was shouldering.
At this moment, Jiaye was continuously pulling dish after dish out of the massive thermal box.
“…”
Just after pouring water for the two and about to offer Tie Chui a cigarette, Chen Yi stood there, somewhat bewildered, “Isn’t this a bit much for just breakfast?”
The quantity of food before him was no exaggeration—one could have fed all the employees of a twenty-person company.
“A bit unsure which dishes and flavors you like, I thought I’d make a bit of everything. Now that I know what you like, I won’t bring so much next time.” Continue your adventure at empire
Quickly taking out all the dishes from the thermal box, Jiaye and Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at Chen Yi with anticipation shining in their eyes, “Yi, have a taste and see how it is?”
“Ah, uh, sure sure.”
Though a bit stunned, Chen Yi didn’t want to let the kindness of someone bringing food to the door go to waste. He first handed the cigarette he held to Tie Chui, who had been eagerly waiting for a while, and then he began to gesture everyone to sit down.
From the moment Tie Chui entered, his eyes never left the cigarette in Chen Yi’s hand.
It was somewhat inevitable, feeling an extreme sense of helplessness.
His face was nearly inscribed with the words “Just give me the cigarette.”
After receiving the cigarette from Chen Yi, Tie Chui contentedly tucked it into his metal cigarette case inside his pocket and sat down cheerfully, looking at everyone.
With Tie Chui’s size, when he sat down, one could barely see the edges of the chair from the side; he had completely sunk into it.
When entering, he even had to duck his head.
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi picked up a piece of stir-fried green vegetable with his chopsticks and after chewing and swallowing a few bites, he couldn’t help but give a thumbs up to Jiaye while nodding in approval, “The taste is really good, your cooking skills are quite impressive.”
“Don’t just watch, everyone eat.”
“Alright.”
With a bowl of porridge in front of her, Jiaye sipped it with a spoon, but the smile in her eyes was hardly containable.
She had gotten up at 2 AM the night before and worked until 5:30 AM, then rushed over to find Chen Yi as soon as possible.
The June rule stated that you just needed to get up before 6 AM; if you wanted, even getting up at 12 midnight was fine; no problem at all.
Though she had labored for over four hours, seeing how much Chen Yi enjoyed the food and the high praise he gave, she felt it was all worth it; all her fatigue seemed to have vanished.
The group chatted leisurely while eating breakfast.
“How did you find out where I live?”
After finishing the porridge in his hand, Chen Yi looked up at Jiaye sitting across from him.
“Hey.”
Jiaye tilted her head helplessly, “Don’t you know how famous you are in Yancheng? At least half the people in Yancheng know where you, Yi, live.”
“No need to ask around.”
“The Law Enforcement Bureau moved their base next to your neighborhood a few days ago. You guys didn’t know about this?”
“It’s clear to anyone with eyes that the Law Enforcement Bureau wants to be able to seek your help at the first sign of trouble.”
“Is that so?”
Chen Yi was actually quite surprised by this information; he really wasn’t aware, only knowing that the Law Enforcement Bureau hadn’t asked him to collect bodies for a long time. As for the Bureau moving to the building downstairs, he was rather clueless about that.
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit had completely stuffed himself, with a vegetarian bun in his left hand and a meat bun in his right.
One bite on the left, one bite on the right.
He chewed with immense satisfaction, not having enjoyed a meal this much in a long time, truly fulfilling. But then, he suddenly realized something, “Wait, isn’t it not even 7 AM yet?”
“According to the June rules, aren’t we supposed to eat breakfast at 8 AM?”
“No worries, we’ll just have another meal then.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly felt a bit choked up, looking seriously at Jiaye, he felt like this woman had come to doom Yi. This woman planned to kill Yi by stuffing him alive.
Such an assassination method was unheard of!
Who eats one meal at 7 AM and another at 8 AM?
Even pigs don’t eat like that, right?
“What’s that?”
“`
Jiaye suddenly noticed an ice coffin leaned against the wall inside the house and expressed his confusion, “Is this a coffin?”
“Yeah, an ice coffin.”
After taking a sip of porridge and catching his breath, Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke without much concern, “Sword Without End died and was put in there, and now it has become an ornament. How about that? Looks pretty good, doesn’t it?”
“Sword Without End is dead?”
A thread of confusion surfaced in Jiaye’s mind, and he asked with subconscious concern, “He didn’t hurt you guys, did he?”
Sword Without End’s strength was not weak, proven by his ranking on the vehicle leaderboard and his performance in the world boss activities, which demonstrated he was a player of considerable strength.
Although she knew Yi was also strong, she thought that killing Sword Without End would likely have resulted in injuries, right?
“No.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit waved his hand and explained, “You’re mistaken; Sword Without End committed suicide. After the afterlife descended, people who die become Hell Players. Sword Without End thought he could find his wife in hell, so he killed himself to become a Hell Player and went there.”
“Let us keep his body temporarily.”
“I tidied up his body on a whim, and now it looks much better, like a piece of art. But you’d better not get too close to see it, lest it scares you.”
The group chatted idly while eating breakfast.
Soon, the time reached 8 am.
They all took a few bites of steamed buns, symbolically dealing with the June rule, and then they parted ways. Chen Yi had planned to see Jiaye off, but Jiaye firmly declined, so he let it be.
…
After leaving Chen Yi’s house and seeing that Chen Yi didn’t come out:
Jiaye purposefully created the sound of leaving in the corridor, then sneakily, with a heart full of stealthy joy, opened the door to the room next to Chen Yi’s in the corridor and slipped inside.
And she quickly pulled her brother inside as well.
She had already moved next to Chen Yi’s place the night before.
But she did not plan to tell Yi about this. What if Yi asked her to leave?
She intended to create some coincidental encounters.
…
“Huff!”
After Jiaye left, Tuberculosis Rabbit lay on the bed with a round belly, murmuring in a trance, “It’s been a long time since I’ve been this full. I never imagined having so many different kinds of food for breakfast.”
“There’s a variety of flavors.”
“It’s really nice.”
Just as Chen Yi was about to say something:
A prompt suddenly sounded in their ears.
’Ding, game activity announcement!’
’From June 17 to June 19, the “Father’s Day” special event is open!’
’The start time is June 17 at 12:00 noon, specific event rules will be published at 12:00 noon, and the event deadline is June 19 at 12:00 noon.’
’Please prepare, all players!’
A prompt rang out leisurely in the ears of all players.
“Father’s Day?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was momentarily stunned, then jumped up from the bed, picked up the calendar on the bedside table and glanced at the few lines of small text below. After a moment he somewhat blankly said, “Today is actually Father’s Day?”
Neither he nor Yi had fathers. Naturally, they never celebrated Father’s Day and had no concept of the holiday.
It was the same with the Qingming Festival; they did not celebrate it either.
“Wait a minute.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s thoughts suddenly shifted to the Qingming Festival, and he furrowed his brow, deep in thought, “Yi, I just thought of something.”
“On Qingming Festival, everyone burns paper money for their deceased relatives so that they can have money to spend below, right?”
“Suppose a person can live to be 60 years old.”
“Couldn’t they start burning paper money for themselves every Qingming Festival when they’re 16, so that when they die, they could collect all that money at once?”
“…”
Although Chen Yi was somewhat resigned, he still responded dryly, “If no one’s down there to collect it, who’s burning the paper money?”
“True, ha. But we could think about it differently.”
“Like, if everyone burns paper to a specific institution while alive, then after they go down, they could receive a fixed amount of money from that institution every month.”
“That way, you wouldn’t have to worry if your descendants stop burning paper for you and you ran out of money below, right?”
“What you’re talking about sounds familiar.”
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi said somberly, “I remember now, you’re talking about social security.”
“Paying social security while alive, then receiving social security funds monthly after you’re gone?”
“Alright, let’s not think about this ridiculous nonsense anymore.”
“Prepare for the Father’s Day limited event at noon and see what it’s all about.”
Then Chen Yi turned his attention to his only two props, which he had obtained from a world event. One of them seemed like it might be useful for this Father’s Day event.
However, the specifics of the Father’s Day event rules and content were still unclear.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 141 - 140: "Event One: In the Name of the Father.
chapters.content:
Chapter 141 – 140: “Event One: In the Name of the Father.
“Prop Name”: In the Name of the Father.
“Prop Level”: Unique.
“Prop Effect”: When you activate the prop and hum the song In the Name of the Father, all listeners who have not purchased the single before the descent of the latter days will fall into an hour of sadness.
“Prop Limit”: After one use, it will enter a 24h cooldown.
“Prop Introduction”: “Support the genuine, starting with you and him.”
This was one of two unique props he obtained in the world boss event. He had thought that unique props were all very powerful, but in terms of offensive power, this prop was not as good as his B-grade prop, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle.
The only notable point was that there was only one of this prop in the whole world.
Whether its effect was powerful or weak, there was only one in the whole world.
The rarity of a global unique prop lay in its uniqueness, not in its combat effects.
However, when he first obtained this prop, he actually had no idea how to use it properly. The effect of the prop was somewhat ambiguous; falling into an hour of self-reproach and penitence, he had no clear concept of what it actually entailed.
As for whether this prop was related to the Father’s Day event, he couldn’t be certain.
After all, the only similarity was the word “Father.”
Forget it, he would know the answer at 12 o’clock.
Chen Yi decided not to think about it anymore, instead turning his head to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit. “Have you heard In the Name of the Father?”
“In the Name of the Father?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit tilted his head in thought for a moment before he spoke, “It seems familiar, why do you suddenly ask?”
“Did you buy this single?”
“Of course not, I always listen to pirated versions.”
“…”
Chen Yi fell silent and said no more. The prop was an indiscriminate attack, meaning that if he used it, Tuberculosis Rabbit would also be affected. The main point was… he didn’t really know how to sing the song.
It was somewhat difficult to sing.
He had bought the single; what was the situation back then? It seemed like he was planning to help the bodies in the morgue pass on peacefully, so he used this song, intending to let the bodies of the morgue depart in peace in the name of God.
The effect was not bad.
No corpses suddenly jumped up.
Unexpectedly, to this day, he was once again dealing with this song.
Afterwards, Chen Yi stood up, took the coat off the chair, and left Tuberculosis Rabbit alone as he went up to the rooftop terrace: “I’m going out for a bit. Wait for me here.”
…
The terrace.
The sky was still dark; dense black clouds were still pressing over the city, making the entire city appear particularly oppressive.
The overnight downpour had stopped, and the entire city was permeated with the fresh scent of post-rain, with puddles on the ground reflecting the light like moonlight, highlighting this steel jungle.
The air was slightly humid.
Chen Yi, alone, walked to the top of the terrace, and after scanning his surroundings to ensure no one was around, pulled out a music-playing prop, an MP3, found the song In the Name of the Father, and played the accompaniment.
He then took a deep breath, feeling a little nervous in his heart, and began to hum along.
“The crisp morning dew moistens the black tuxedo.”
“Stone paths are foggy, Father whispers softly.”
“…”
At first, his voice was low, but after humming several times and getting the rhythm, his voice gradually grew louder.
He even bought a black tuxedo from the shop and got an illusionary skin for the Christmas Cane he held, turning it into a sleek black cane.
In the morning dew under the dark clouds, he gently swayed and hummed softly.
“Helpless despair only leads to more cruelty.”
“All for the journey to the church.”
“…”
If the camera angle were raised, one could see a young man in a black tuxedo, holding a sleek black cane, standing on the terrace of a steel jungle under a sky of heavy clouds, constantly swaying and humming In the Name of the Father.
It had a sense of… refreshing purity.
The somewhat complex and sorrowful tune began to resonate above the neighborhood.
Elegance and desolation coexisted.
Like a pianist playing unconcerned in the center of a town bombed by missiles, confronting war with art, seeking tranquility amidst death.
In order to use this prop better, he did put in a lot of effort, learning how to sing this song specifically, and even bought a black tuxedo to be more immersed.
Although the prop wasn’t lethal,
causing listeners to fall into an hour of sadness could still significantly help in combat against enemies, nearly halving their fighting strength… maybe?
Besides, the other unique prop was also quite absurd.
“Prop Name”: Center of the Universe
“Prop Level”: Unique.
“Prop Effect”: When you activate this effect, you can choose any music or accompaniment to play over the area of a city. Everyone within this range will clearly hear the song or the accompaniment sung by you, and your singing will be optimized.
“Prop Introduction”, “Your voice deserves to be heard by more people.”
Yes, it’s also a unique item, the kind where there’s only one in the whole world.
These two props can be used together, their combined effect can plunge a large area of players into a state of sadness.
Beyond that, there are no other effects.
Unique items cannot be enhanced or enchanted.
After about an hour of practice, Chen Yi finally relaxed a little, changed back into his original clothes, and headed to the rooftop, returning to the rental apartment.
He wasn’t a man of vanity.
But he still found it hard to accept that when he was prepared to use this prop against enemies, he would hum a song out of tune, so he decided to practice the song in advance.
In fact, he always felt that it was illogical for the song to make people sad.
In his heart, the song “In the Name of the Father” always had a hint of religious color, meant to conduct a service for the dead, to let those who had died depart quietly and not linger and cause trouble in the human world.
After all, the lyrics included lines like, “Merciful Heavenly Father, please forgive the sins of humanity and let them rest in peace.”
If it was meant to induce sadness, there should be better song choices.
But on second thought, it made sense; if the enemies were all plunged into sadness and unable to fight at full strength, it would then be his turn to step in and let the enemies rest in peace.
…
Before long, the clock hand pointed to 12:00.
Outside, it was still dim, just a touch brighter than early morning, but overall very dark, as a heavy blanket of clouds almost entirely blocked out all light, making it impossible to feel a single ray of noontime sunshine.
“Ding, game event announcement!”
“June 17-19, ’Father’s Day’ special limited event officially begins!”
“All players can participate in this event during these three days.”
“Event One: In the Name of the Father.”
“During the three days of the event, you can claim another player as your godson. Your godson will never be able to attack you, either actively or passively, and each time they return from the map, they must offer up one-tenth of all earnings as a sign of respect to their godfather.”
“Each player can claim one godfather at most and up to ten godsons.”
“Additionally, a godson has the ability to summon their godfather. No matter where the godfather is, as long as he accepts the summons, he will be instantly transported to his godson’s side to aid in battle.”
“Event Two: Goodness of Heart.”
“During these three days, all players can use music to influence others’ emotions by singing or playing the piano. Making one person feel sadness will earn 1 Sadness Point. Achieving Sadness Points will unlock a limited-time leaderboard – the Global Musicians’ Ranking.”
“The judges for this event are—”
“Little Sprite, Little Sprite’s Mom, Little Sprite’s Dad.”
“The three judges will constantly observe the top ten players on the leaderboard and give extra points and special additional rewards based on their performance.”
“Event Three: Emotion Shop.”
“All Sadness Points earned during the event can be used to purchase special limited props in the Emotion Shop.”
“Event Four: Expressions of Love.”
“Telling your biological father ’I love you, Father’ will grant you the Special Limited Title ’Father’s Love is Like a Mountain’.”
A voice rang out in the ears of all players.
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit opened his mouth in shock, looking down blankly at the Red Moon Claw Knife in his hand, which he had been charging up for a long time. He had been prepared to go on a killing spree in this limited event! Experience tales with empire
But who would have thought that this limited event didn’t have any monster-killing part at all?
A godfather adoption, singing, and expressing love composed this Father’s Day’s limited event?
What the heck did any of that have to do with him and Yi?
Neither of them even had a father!
Wasn’t this targeting a bit too blatant?
Didn’t whoever designed the event take into account the feelings of orphans like themselves?
Chen Yi, on the other hand, frowned and carefully looked at the event rules. The two unique items he had gotten from the world boss recently seemed to have little use, but now it looked like they could be useful in this event.
He had just practiced singing for an hour this morning, and now it seemed he could use it right away?
…
In the instant that the event announcement went out.
In a residential complex in Yancheng, Han Yu’s eyes suddenly reddened. Turning to look at the family sitting on the sofa, he stared intently at his father with a trembling voice close to tears.
“Father.”
Then, Han Yu began to sing a cappella. His song slowly filled the room.
“Always taking from you, never stopping to say thank you.”
“Only after growing up do I realize how hard you had it.”
“Every time I leave, I pretend to be nonchalant.”
“…”
The song resonated with ups and downs, soft yet heavy, echoing in the room like the bell of a temple, striking each person’s heart, while Han Yu quickly became emotional, his eyes turning red and his voice hoarse as he sang out loud.

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 142 - 141: "Prop Name": The Little Sprite’s Joy.
chapters.content:
Chapter 142 – 141: “Prop Name”: The Little Sprite’s Joy.
“`
“Time, time, slow down, don’t make you grow old anymore.”
“I would trade all that I have for your everlasting youth.” Explore more at empire
“Dad, always so strong, what can I do for you?”
“…”
Han Yu soon finished singing a song called Father, and at this moment, the family sitting on the couch each had visibly moved expressions, fighting back tears while nodding towards him.
This scene made Han Yu’s heart tremble, feeling so touched that tears couldn’t help bursting from his eyes. He then subconsciously looked at his personal panel.
But he found that he hadn’t gathered any Sadness Points at all.
“…”
Han Yu, originally moved, suddenly fell silent with a blank expression. After a moment, he wiped the tears from his eyes and looked up to his family on the couch, “So my song only moved me, is that it?”
These people had put on a convincing act of being moved, but since he hadn’t collected any Sadness Points, it was clear that their hearts were utterly still.
“Ahem…”
The middle-aged man who was just sitting on the couch pretending to be moved, now awkwardly wiped away the tears he had forced out, and sheepishly said, “Well, son, although I’d really like to be moved so you could get the Sadness Points reward…”
“But… it’s really hard to feel moved.”
“Back in my day, I sang Father to my dad every day, and now in your generation, you’re still singing Father. Can’t you come up with something new? The times are progressing, and we can’t fall behind.”
“And not to say or not say, the way you looked just now, it was really hard to keep a straight face.”
Following that, the few people sitting on the couch exchanged glances, seeing the barely contained laughter in each other’s eyes, and couldn’t help but burst into collective laughter.
“…”
Han Yu stood silently for a long while before reluctantly accepting the reality. Maybe he needed a different method; this was too abrupt. For now, he thought, he’d better secure the limited-time title and then see.
Then he turned to his father, his expression serious, and said, “I love you, Dad.”
“I love you too, son.”
Seeing his son become serious, the middle-aged man responded earnestly.
Seconds later.
Han Yu’s expression went from serious to bewildered, then to disbelief, and finally to a somewhat vacant gaze as he murmured faintly, “I didn’t receive the title reward.”
“How is that possible?”
The middle-aged man was stunned for a moment before shaking his head in confusion, “Didn’t the event rules say that all you have to do is tell your biological father ’I love you’ to…”
The voice suddenly cut off.
Everyone present fell into silence, and suddenly the room plunged into a profound quiet.
Speechless.
…
“Are you sure about this…?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in the central square of Yancheng, looking around at the players coming and going, taking on quests, and couldn’t help feeling a shiver, “To be honest, I feel a slight sense of awkwardness.”
Yi had brought him to the center of Yancheng to sing a song that would move everyone, thereafter harvesting a large amount of Sadness Points.
Yi’s singing wasn’t bad, he knew that, but it wasn’t professional level.
Feeling realistic about moving everyone in the square to tears was one thing, but honestly, it felt rather embarrassing.
“It should be no problem.”
Chen Yi, with a serious expression, wore a black Tuxedo, held a shiny black cane in hand, and stood among the crowd with more than a dozen titles above his head. He flipped a card between his fingers.
’Prop Name’: Little Sprite’s Delight.
’Prop Level’: No level.
’Prop Effect’: When you find yourself in a crisis, you can activate this card once, and the Little Sprite will turn into the Great Demon to attack the enemy before you.
’Prop Usage Count’: 1/1
’Prop Introduction’: “Collect three ’Little Sprite’s Delights’ to exchange for one ’Little Fairy’s Mom’s Delight’.”
This was a Prop he had obtained in an amusement park in the past. At that time, there was a little girl sitting on a giant lollipop constantly licking it. He had crashed into and smashed that lollipop with his sled.
After that, the little girl turned into a Demon.
It was an extremely vivid memory, and after all this time, that little girl was the only boss he had ever seen whose way of attack was playing word connection games – disregarding defense and attack, connecting the phrase meant life, failing meant death.
Such Rule Kills were a massacre for those with lower cultural knowledge!
And the jury for this event was the Little Sprite’s family. He and Little Sprite were somewhat acquainted; after all, he had treated them to a fruit-flavored carrot, and they had given him a Little Sprite’s Delight.
He planned to summon the judges to himself before harvesting Sadness Points using those two Props. This should allow for additional points and exclusive rewards.
After all, the judges only paid attention to the top ten players, but he wasn’t in the top ten yet. It was too late to enter the top ten and get Little Sprite’s attention; he could only sing once and would enter a 24-hour cooldown afterward.
The next second—
“`
Prop activation.
Suddenly, a light gate appeared in the sky above the square.
Immediately afterward, a cute little girl with braided pigtails, carrying a lollipop bigger than herself, stepped out with anger in her eyes: “Wow, look what I’ve sensed!”
“A player who has experienced the joy of Little Sprite once has summoned me, who dares to bully my joyous player!”
“It’s you, the player who gave me the fruit-flavored carrot!”
“I like you a lot!”
“Tell me, who is bullying you, I’ll kill them for you!”
This little girl is Little Sprite, sporting the name above her head, looking extremely tender and cute. Even if she’s talking about killing, her voice is childishly soft and seems very immature.
But perhaps only Chen Yi and another person knew that once this little girl turned dark, her style of attack was truly a bit difficult to resist. Defense? No use even if you have all your defense props, a pure Rule Attack, how do you block that?
After that incident.
He had been secretly memorizing idioms, poetry, classical Chinese, mathematics, history, geography, and so on.
Not afraid of anything else, just afraid that one day he would encounter a similar Rule Attack.
The kind where if you don’t keep up, you die.
That was truly without any complaint, only hating why I didn’t study more in the past.
The little girl is about one meter tall, but she’s holding a lollipop taller than herself in her arms.
Following behind the little girl was a woman, about 1.7 meters tall.
With a mature woman’s charm, wearing a qipao that accentuated her curvaceous figure, looking particularly seductive, with seven words above her head, Little Fairy’s Mom, holding a lollipop taller than herself in her hand, almost completely ruining her mature charm.
And next to her stood a man, around 1.9 meters tall.
The image of a tough guy with a cold expression wearing a loose black robe, eyes emitting an aura of murderous intent as if he could erupt into violence at any moment, with the same seven words above his head, Little Fairy’s Dad.
The consistent point was that this man also held a lollipop taller than himself in his hand, almost completely destroying the image of a tough guy, staring at Chen Yi with intense eyes, licking the lollipop in his hand from time to time.
“Alright.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at what was unfolding before him and touched his nose sheepishly: “It seems to run in the family.”
It seemed like the whole family had a thing for lollipops, and for some reason, they all insisted on ones taller than themselves. The lollipop was bigger than their heads and couldn’t fit in their mouths at all.
They could only lick it from time to time.
It looked quite peculiar.
“Hmm?”
Seeing that Chen Yi wasn’t speaking, Little Sprite put her hand on her hip and pointed her lollipop at Chen Yi somewhat angrily: “Why haven’t you said who you want to kill yet, Little Sprite’s joy is about to expire.”
“We’re not killing anyone.”
Chen Yi shook his head, stood in place, and calmly looked at Little Sprite, speaking softly, “I heard the three of you are the judges for this event, I plan to sing a song, and I specifically invited the three of you to be the judges.”
“Oh, is that so.”
Little Sprite nodded thoughtfully and then sat down cross-legged on the ground, her face serious as she propped her little head with her hand, looking at Chen Yi: “Then start singing. Although it’s a bit irregular, according to the rules, we can only visit those top ten ranked players, and your current rank isn’t in the top ten.”
“But since you have a Little Sprite’s joy card, Mom, Dad, you don’t mind, right?”
“It’s no problem.”
The mature woman in the qipao smiled at Chen Yi: “Since you possess a Little Sprite’s joy, it’s certainly no issue to make an exception for you this time, but I must remind you that not many players can earn Little Sprite’s joy even once; three instances of Little Sprite’s joy can be exchanged for one Little Fairy’s Mom’s Delight.”
“Hmph.”
The man in the robe snorted coldly and licked his lollipop, speaking icily: “Three Little Fairy’s Mom’s Delights can be exchanged for one Great Demon’s Delight.”
“Alright, then I’m ready to start.”
Afterward, Chen Yi took a deep breath, slowly closed his eyes, and put himself in the right state, preparing to bring out his best performance in front of the three judges to earn enough points and a special reward from the judges.
Even if the content of the event was a bit ridiculous.
But since he was doing it, he naturally aimed for the first place.
At this moment, other players taking on the task in the square were already flabbergasted, whispering among themselves.
“Isn’t this cheating?”
“How could it not be, we were told judges can only watch the top ten players, but as soon as the event started, Chen Yi has roped the judges into his place, how can this not be cheating?”
“Going through the back door, that’s definitely going through the back door! It must be exposed!”
“This is privilege. From the beginning, privileges have always existed, isn’t this normal? What are you so shocked about?”
“How can this not be shocking? It’s like you go to a college entrance examination and after other students have handed in their papers, they go home to wait for the results, but when you go home, you find the exam marker sitting with your dad having tea and casually awarding you full marks. This is a flagrant insult to us hard-working players!”
“If effort could always lead to victory, there would be no such thing as social classes.”
“It’s not completely implausible. Last time my friend wrote an essay titled ’My Father, the Head of the Federation,’ and just like that, he easily got full marks.”

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 143 - 142: "Absurd.
chapters.content:
Chapter 143 – 142: “Absurd.
However, Chen Yi didn’t pay attention to the surrounding murmurs, doing his best to calm his emotions as he looked up at the gathered dark clouds overhead and silently activated the unique prop of the Center of the Universe.
The next second—
“Dang, dang, dang…”
An accompaniment of music suddenly rang in the ears of all players in Yancheng.
Almost instantly, players in the middle of the square fell silent, their expressions vacant as they looked up at Chen Yi standing in the center of the square. Was this music produced by Chen Yi? It felt as though it was playing right next to their ears.
Was there a sound system with such good quality?
Little Fairy’s Mom also had a flash of surprise in her eyes, folding her arms with interest as she stood behind Little Sprite, fixating on Chen Yi dressed in a black tuxedo.
Jiaye, seated on Tie Chui’s shoulders, was looking at Yi’s silhouette with stars in her eyes, her adoration almost spilling out of them.
Tie Chui just bowed his head and pulled a metal cigarette case from his chest, counting softly to himself.
“One, two, four sticks.”
“No, no, it should be three after two.”
“One, two, three sticks,…”
Even Tuberculosis Rabbit had not expected Yi to possess this prop. For a moment, he straightened up his back a bit, looking as if Yi had come prepared, not just to make a fool of himself.
The accompaniment grew louder bit by bit.
Chen Yi, holding a cane in one hand and wearing a black tuxedo, stood in the center of the square, arms opened wide as he tilted his head back to look at the city’s dark clouds overhead, his lips slightly parting.
The gentle song slowly started to play in the ears of all players in Yancheng.
“The cool morning dew wets the black formal attire.”
“There’s fog on the cobblestone road as father whispers low.”
“…”
…
“In the name of father, I pass judgment.”
“That feeling, there are no suitable words.”
“It’s like laughing while tears fall.”
“Firmly embodying complete darkness.”
“…”
…
The song continued to play in the ears of every player in Yancheng.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had initially been standing straight, suddenly felt emotions stirring within, a newfound sorrow surging to the forefront of his heart. His eyes reddened as he looked at Chen Yi’s silhouette, his fists clenched tight, overwhelmed with sudden sadness.
It was as if… Yi was about to die.
Jiaye, who had been sitting on Tie Chui’s shoulders full of admiration, also stiffened suddenly, feeling her eyes moisten as if tears were tracing down her cheeks, her heart filled with sorrow. It felt like… Yi was about to die.
And Tie Chui, who had been counting his cigarettes, stopped his actions, feeling an uncomfortable surge looking at Chen Yi’s silhouette. Was Yi… about to die?
Why did he suddenly feel so sad?
Most players in the middle of the square fell into a sea of sorrow, their eyes red as they looked up at the dark clouds overhead, tilting their heads at a 45-degree angle, trying not to let the tears in their eyes fall.
Each person recalled the saddest memory in their heart.
Little Fairy’s Mom, who had previously been folding her arms with interest, now buried her face in tears into Little Fairy’s Dad’s chest, sobbing uncontrollably, no longer bearing the semblance of a mature woman, looking more like a little girl.
Explore hidden tales at empire
Little Sprite, who had been sitting cross-legged on the ground, also rushed into her dad’s arms, crying out loud.
And the middle-aged man, his eyes also red, looked up at the sky as he embraced his wife and daughter, trying not to let his tears fall.
In a house in Yancheng, Han Yu’s silent family, upon hearing the song, couldn’t help but hold each other and burst into uncontrollable sobbing.
…
“I…”
Li Yide, who was originally repairing the sound system, suddenly froze in place the moment he heard the music start playing, then after a moment, he sat on the ground somewhat disoriented, lighting a cigarette with sadness filling his heart, holding it between his fingers as he stared into the distance with a vacant expression.
“What exactly have I lived my life for?”
“Am I still me?”
“Why have I suddenly become so sad?”
Even the fox tail that was always perked up behind him seemed to sense its owner’s mood, hanging limp and lifelessly.
…
Half the progress of the song was sung through quickly.
Chen Yi, dressed in a black tuxedo and holding a jet black cane, stood in the puddles on the plaza, calmly and vaguely continuing to sing as he looked at the three judges in front of him who were now holding their heads in agony.
“We are all guilty.”
“Sinning in different ways.”
“…”
And he sang while stepping the dance steps at the same time.
The dance steps were simple.
One step forward, one step left, one step right, one step back.
Four-beat steps for a beginner dancer.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing behind Chen Yi, couldn’t hide his sadness, with tears streaming down his face, began to follow Yi’s rhythm and dance beside him, even though the two had not rehearsed in advance, their movements appeared to be almost the same.
One reason was that the dance steps were indeed simple, the other was that their tacit understanding was indeed not low.
Jiaye, who was sitting on Tie Chui’s shoulders, also jumped down and ran to Chen Yi’s side, her eyes slightly red, she followed Yi’s rhythm and stepped the four-beat dance steps rhythmically with her mouth firmly shut to the sound of music.
After standing in place for a moment, Tie Chui also walked over to Chen Yi’s side, following everyone’s rhythm and stepping the four-beat dance steps.
The scene was extremely consistent and harmonious.
Under the boundless black clouds, Chen Yi and his three companions stood in the middle of the plaza full of puddles, witnessed by numerous players, and under the erosion of the music, stepped their four-beat dance steps that belonged to them.
Then,
More and more people were moved by Chen Yi’s emotions, and other players in the square couldn’t help but stand behind Chen Yi with tears in their eyes, following Chen Yi’s rhythm and stepping the four-beat dance steps, humming the song Chen Yi was singing, titled “In the Name of the Father.”
The scene on the plaza looked decidedly like that of a concert.
The Sadness Points Chen Yi was accumulating were increasing at a terrifying speed, climbing to number one on the global leaderboard in almost less than a few seconds, and the gap with the second place was growing larger and larger!
Elegance and vulgarity have never been two words with an especially clear dividing line!
You could use vulgarity to describe the scene before you, and you could equally call this scene elegant!
The height of elegance is vulgarity, the peak of vulgarity is elegance.
But… at least at this moment, in the hearts of these players, it was elegant.
Utterly elegant.
The song ended.
Everyone came out of their emotional trance slowly, standing in place without speaking for a long time, not quite snapping out of it.
“Bravo!”
Not knowing how much time had passed, Little Sprite’s mom, with her figure accentuated by her cheongsam, was the first to continuously applaud with teary eyes.
Then, the other players in the center of the plaza also came to their senses, all of them tearfully looking at Chen Yi and continuously applauding.
The scene suddenly became lively.
Chen Yi slowly lowered the jet black cane he had been holding up, looked around at everything, and spoke softly with a calm face as he held the cane in his hands.
“Absurd.”
That was the period he put at the end of this farce.

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 144 - 143: "Agreed, the dance moves are great.
chapters.content:
Chapter 144 – 143: “Agreed, the dance moves are great.
“Ding, you have harvested 242 Sadness Points.”
“Ding, you have harvested 321 Sadness Points.”
A myriad of system notifications blinked incessantly at the Small Speaker section on Chen Yi’s personal panel.
At this time, the Sadness Points that Chen Yi had collected already firmly secured his position at the top of the leaderboard.
“Global Musicians’ Ranking Leaderboard.”
“Rank 1: Chen Yi, 729,201 Sadness Points.”
“Rank 2: Li Jiayi, 238 Sadness Points.”
With over 700,000 Sadness Points, he absolutely crushed the second place, leaving practically no hope for anyone to catch up.
The event had just begun not long ago.
Having collected 238 Sadness Points in just over ten minutes was already quite commendable, regardless of the method used, but securing a temporary top spot was enough to demonstrate prowess.
Unfortunately, they ran into Chen Yi’s unreasonable tactics.
In just four to five minutes, Chen Yi scooped up 700,000 Sadness Points.
But Chen Yi didn’t feel much about it, merely thinking that 700,000 Sadness Points should be enough to exchange for quite a few limited props in the Emotion Shop. Also, the whole scene did feel somewhat ridiculous.
How to put it, it was beyond words.
It was something that could only be understood and not explained.
“Special rewards must be given to you!”
Little Sprite, with tear-filled eyes, clutched her mother, Little Fairy’s Mom’s, cheongsam, raised the lollipop in her hand high, and looked up at Chen Yi!
“Agreed, the dance moves were great.”
Little Fairy’s Mom also raised the lollipop in her hand.
“Seconded, the atmosphere was really good.”
Little Sprite’s dad also raised the lollipop in his hand.
Following this, Chen Yi heard another notification by his ear.
“Ding, the three judges unanimously agree to bestow upon you the ’Father’s Day Event Exclusive Special Gift,’ congratulations on obtaining ’Father’s Day Limited Event Special Gift Box (Large) x 1.’
As Chen Yi listened to the notification by his ear and let out a sigh of relief—effort did pay off after all. He didn’t open the gift box right away but instead stuffed a few strawberry-flavored carrots into Little Sprite’s arms.
“Here, your favorite fruit-flavored carrots. Just come find me next time you want more.”
“Okay.”
Little Sprite squinted her eyes into crescent moons and pulled out a card from her bosom to hand to Chen Yi, “I’m also giving you a one-time ’Delight of Little Sprite.’
“You’ve earned my approval, this ’Little Fairy’s Mom’s Delight’ is for you.”
The woman in the cheongsam, curves in all the right places, also pulled out a small card from her neckline and handed it to Chen Yi.
Stay tuned with empire
“This ’Delight of Little Sprite’s Dad’ is also for you.”
As the voice fell, Little Sprite’s family left without lingering, leaving not a cloud behind, only three cards.
The effects were basically the same.
Whoever’s delight card was activated, could summon them to face the enemy.
If all three cards were used at the same time, they could summon the entire Little Sprite’s family over.
And… three ’Delight of Little Sprite’s Dad’ could be exchanged for one ’Delight of Little Sprite’s Grandma.’
Chen Yi silently placed the three cards into his backpack; although he didn’t know what attack methods Little Fairy’s Mom and Dad had, they presumably had Rule Kill like Little Sprite, which at certain moments would be a weapon against enemies.
However, Little Sprite’s family made him think of something else.
Could it be that Little Sprite’s family and Santa Claus from December were both neutral bosses? They seemed to have their own independent thinking and didn’t appear like NPCs. Were these bosses created by the Snow Sea Project Team, or did they pop up from somewhere else?
Chen Yi pondered quietly without speaking. However, now wasn’t the time to think about this. He glanced at the numerous players around him who were still emotionally overwhelmed and hadn’t come to their senses.
Silently, he stepped onto the sleigh, taking Tie Chui and others, and left the place.
At this moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit had already recovered, leaning on the sleigh with a puzzled look, trying to figure out why he had been so sad. The sudden surge of emotions was beyond his control.
As for Jiaye, the admiration for Chen Yi in her heart grew even stronger. Not only was he so powerful, but he also sang so well; wasn’t he a little too perfect?
No, that can’t be right; there’s no such thing as a perfect man in the world. There must be something imperfect about Chen Yi.
A moment later.
Jiaye suddenly leaned back in her chair expressionlessly, silent. She had figured out the one imperfection about Chen Yi—’Yi’ wasn’t very interested in her.
Unfathomable blind spot.
“You two… also don’t have fathers, right?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit tentatively said.
“Mm-hm.”
“Then that’s completely nonsensical.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed resignedly, “This Father’s Day event has nothing to do with us. We won’t be able to get that limited title either. Looks like I’ll have to spend Points to buy it again, not even sure if the title effect is strong.”
“As for the activity of recognizing a godfather, it’s even less related to us.”
“However, Yi just now collected a large number of Sadness Points. He should be able to exchange for quite a few props in the Emotion Shop, which is a bit of consolation.”
“Buy a title?”
Jiaye was startled and then suddenly focused intensely on Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Are you saying the title can be bought?”
“Yeah, didn’t you know?”
After a title is chosen to be worn, it cannot be dropped, traded, or removed, but before it is worn, players are free to trade it among themselves.”
“For example, the ’Lucky Child of the God of Love’ title above Yi’s head was bought by Yi with money, or more precisely, exchanged for a bicycle.”
“Understood.”
Jiaye’s eyes narrowed into crescent moons, and the sadness in her heart vanished in an instant. So that’s how Yi got his title, she had actually thought Yi had someone he really liked.
It seemed that Yi was thoroughly single now.
Chen Yi stopped the sleigh on the rooftop and stood at the edge of the roof, flipping through the Emotion Shop to see what limited props he could purchase with so many Sadness Points.
’Prop Name’: Life Editor.
’Prop Level’: C-grade.
’Prop Effect’: You can input a script and confirm the cast members, then the cast will follow the script perfectly to perform what you have entered.
’Prop Restrictions’: Cannot forcibly invite cast members, must be cooperated with by the cast members.
’Prop Description’: “In the far distant future, the worth of screenwriters will undergo a leapfrogging surge.”
’Prop Price’: 10,000 Sadness Points.
This prop is an output from the Emotion Shop.
Honestly, its effect seems a bit ambiguous.
Could it be interpreted as, as long as he inputs a script and then confirms the cast members, they will perform the script perfectly without considering their acting skills, bringing the script to life perfectly?
Bought it.
Although he didn’t know exactly what use it had, its price was not high, so he decided to buy it first and think later.
Besides, this prop might really come in handy.
Chen Yi looked thoughtfully towards another prop in his item bag.
’Prop Name’: “Life Theater Pass.”
’Prop Level’: C-grade.
’Prop Effect’: With this pass, you can go to the map ’Life Theater’ at any location, and each player can only receive a reward once within this map. Once a reward has been obtained, you will not be able to enter the map again.
’Prop Restrictions’: Remaining Usage (5/10).
’Prop Description’: “Life is said to be like a play, but who knew your life would be so explicit.”
This prop is a map access pass, given to him by Sword Without End. He hadn’t gone inside yet, but when he browsed the Emotion Shop earlier and saw the Life Editor prop, he suddenly remembered the map access pass.
Maybe the Life Editor prop could be used inside this map access pass.
He glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit, pondering over trying the Life Editor prop first to see what its effects were.
He soon entered a brief script into the Life Editor and then invited Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui to be his cast members.
“Hmm?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at her personal panel with some confusion: “Chen Yi invites you to star in his new work ’Mart,’ will you confirm your participation?”
“What is this for?”
“Just confirm it, I’m trying out a new prop.”
“Okay.”
The next second—
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly stood straight as an arrow in the cold wind, her clothes fluttering wildly, standing with her hands behind her back as she turned to gaze at the horizon, lightly speaking with her head slightly raised.
“You’ve come.”
Tie Chui stood beside Tuberculosis Rabbit, also gazing into the distance with the same posture. His voice, devoid of his usual stutter, was indifferent as he said, “I’ve come.”
“After all, you’ve still come.”
“After all, I’ve still come.”
“You shouldn’t have come.”
“But I’m already here.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t respond, stood silently facing the wind with her hands behind her back for a long while before speaking hoarsely, “What are you here for?”
“I’ve come to kill.”
Tie Chui’s expression was cold next to Tuberculosis Rabbit, and his tone seemed to carry the indifference of a February dagger as he spoke.
“Kill whom?”
“Kill the ones who should be killed.”
“Who should be killed?”
“You should be killed.”
With those words, Tie Chui and Tuberculosis Rabbit fell into silence, standing still. After about three seconds, they both relaxed their bodies, and everything returned to normal.
And in Chen Yi’s mind, a voice emerged that only he could hear.
’Cut, end of the play!’
“Yi!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked down at herself in surprise and then looked up at Chen Yi with shock, saying, “What kind of prop is this? In that moment, a script suddenly appeared in my mind.”
“Then there were many prompt boxes in front of me, guiding me how to act, to make the character portrayal more convincing.”
“And if I messed up, not meeting the prompt box requirements, or if I made some other movements—”
“The prompt box would advise me to reshoot. That look of weather-beaten age and the mix of loathing, nostalgia, and reluctance for the martial world in my be eyes—I had to reshoot over seventy times before the prompt box finally indicated it was satisfactory.”

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 145 - 144: C-level Map?
chapters.content:
Chapter 145 – 144: C-level Map?
“`
“This prop is pretty interesting, it’s a pity that it’s from the future. If we had this prop before, then anyone could have been an actor.”
“Over seventy times?”
Chen Yi slightly raised his eyebrows, nodded thoughtfully without saying a word. In his eyes, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Tie Chui, and others all seemed to have performed fluently in one go.
But in reality, Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui had already rehearsed each expression and line countless times.
What eventually unfolded before him was a flawless performance.
He understood the use of this prop now.
It was powerful.
No matter whether a person had a natural talent for acting or not, as long as they were chosen by him to be actors, they would deliver a perfect performance, and it could even help them overcome certain physiological defects.
For instance, Tie Chui was born with cerebral palsy, but during the recent role-playing, there seemed to be no apparent symptoms of cerebral palsy. Instead, his eyes were incredibly sharp, and he spoke clearly and articulately.
“Yi… Yi.”
Tie Chui stuttered, pointing towards the prop in Chen Yi’s hand with a trembling hand, “Next time… don’t invite me to be an actor, okay? It… made me reshoot 60,000 times, I… I almost couldn’t make it out, thought I’d die in there.”
“…”
Chen Yi stood in silence with an expressionless face. It seemed that overcoming physiological defects was not perfect, like making a cerebral palsy patient play a normal person. This would cause the patient to keep reshooting until the prop was satisfied.
Just like Tie Chui, who had reshot 60,000 times.
To the outside world, that seemed like just a few seconds had passed.
But for Tie Chui, it probably felt like half his life had gone by. Being able to remember his name after reshooting 60,000 times at least meant his name was deeply impressed in Tie Chui’s memory.
This means that when designing a script for an actor, the script’s persona needs to match as closely as possible to the actor themselves.
If a mute was given a script to participate in and win a stand-up comedy show, would they have to reshoot countless times, and if they can’t ever satisfy the prop, they’d be trapped forever?
In this light, the prop seems to only serve as an entertainment prop indeed. There’s no use in combat situations since no enemy would accept such a bizarre invitation.
If you want to play role-playing games in the middle of the night, this prop could serve a different purpose.
The prop ensures that the performance it produces is perfect.
If you want, this prop could give your wife 108 different personalities ranging from aloof to mature ladylike to innocent to cute.
Hmm… that’s quite creepy when you think about it.
Chen Yi cast this thought aside and tucked the Life Editor prop into his pocket without dwelling on it any longer. He was planning to check out the Life Theater map in a few days since the rewards for this map were substantial, and it seemed a waste that no one was claiming them.
He continued to browse the Emotion Shop.
The Emotion Shop had many props that were very cheap, for example—
’Prop Name’: Bunny Hair Clip.
’Prop Level’: E-grade.
’Prop Effect’: This is a hair clip that will never fall off. Once used, it will always hold your hair in place.
’Prop Introduction’: “A cute and adorable hair clip.”
’Prop Price’: 3 Sadness Points.
–
’Prop Name’: Intra-Cranial VR Imaging.
’Prop Level’: E-grade.
’Prop Effect’: You can imagine any scene in your mind and then experience it as if you were right there.
’Prop Introduction’: “Try not to use this prop when the June rule is in effect.”
’Prop Price’: 10 Sadness Points.
–
’Prop Name’: Blunt-Edge Nail Clipper.
’Prop Level’: E-grade.
’Prop Effect’: A nail clipper that won’t cut your flesh even if you deliberately target it.
’Prop Introduction’: “Don’t you know what it means when I clip your nails before bed? You blockhead!” — a girl complained somewhat resentfully.
’Prop Price’: 5 Sadness Points.
–
There were many such trinkets in the Emotion Shop that could be exchanged for just a dozen or even single digits of Sadness Points, and many players could afford them.
If every prop was priced starting in the tens of thousands,
then this Father’s Day limited event would have completely lost its meaning for casual players.
And these small props, Chen Yi bought dozens of each without hesitation since they were inexpensive. Some he gave to Tuberculosis Rabbit for collection, and you never know when they might come in handy one day.
Like that nail clipper that will never cut your flesh, that’s really useful.
No more worrying about accidentally cutting yourself and bleeding while clipping your nails.
His main focus was on those pricey props.
’Prop Name’: Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom.
’Prop Level’: B-grade.
’Prop Effect’: Once you activate this prop, over three thousand Flowers of the Other Shore will rise up from the ground surrounding you, float in the air, and any player touched by these flowers will rapidly lose health and upon death be turned into one of the Floral People for eternity.
“`
“`
“Prop Restriction”: After one use, it will enter a 24h cooldown period.
“Prop Introduction”: “When the Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom, a massacre descends upon the mortal realm.”
“Prop Price”: 300,000 Sadness Points.
An extremely expensive area-of-effect B-class prop, costing a full 300,000 Sadness Points, and he indeed lacked some area-of-effect methods.
Without hesitation, he immediately pocketed the prop, thus compensating for the lack of area-of-effect capabilities.
“Prop Name”: Forever Pure.
“Prop Level”: B-class. Explore more at empire
“Prop Effects”: After activating this prop, all negative effects on you will be removed, including but not limited to bleeding, deafness, blindness, injuries, near death, weakness, etc., and also when you are unconscious, comatose, or in any other state where you cannot activate the prop yourself.
The prop will first ask the player three times, and if no response is received and 30 seconds have passed, the prop will automatically activate.
“Prop Restriction”: Number of uses (3/3).
“Prop Introduction”: “I hope you remain forever pure, even if purity means being purely filthy. I can accept darkness, I can accept light, but what I despise the most is a mix of the two, it is utterly loathsome.”
“Prop Price”: 300,000 Sadness Points.
With the same price of 300,000 Sadness Points, the price is incredibly high. There are only a few B-class props in the Emotion Shop, with starting prices all at 300,000 Sadness Points. As for the other more expensive B-class props, although their effects are strong, none are more suitable for him than these two.
After some consideration, he still took both B-class props into his possession.
One defensive prop, one area-of-effect prop.
It greatly made up for his shortcomings.
The remaining tens of thousands of Sadness Points were also quickly spent, buying some suitable props for Tuberculosis Rabbit, Jiaye, Tie Chui, and others, with a total of over 700,000 Sadness Points spent in just over ten minutes.
It seems they really weren’t that hard to spend.
Beyond these items, he also purchased some trinkets, like this sticker.
“Prop Name”: Sticker^*TeamHai (Shiny)^*June Limited Edition Crowned Skull.
“Prop Level”: E-class.
“Prop Effect”: You can stick it on your prop, giving it a unique appearance.
“Prop Introduction”: “There are many things in this world worth paying for.”
“Prop Price”: 10 Sadness Points.
For 10 Sadness Points you can buy a shiny sticker, with a maximum of four stickers on a single prop, without giving the prop any Special Effects.
The only effect is that when sunlight shines on the sticker, it will make the sticker glow, which does indeed look quite attractive.
It does look quite nice.
He bought a bunch of them to play with.
For example, he stuck four of these June-limited shiny skull stickers on the back of his sleigh, which indeed looked pretty good, a small trinket he brought back for fun.
These kinds of trinkets, available both in the Emotion Shop and Points shop, are things that don’t improve one’s strength but are pure wastes of money.
Generally speaking.
Nobody would buy these.
Except for someone like Chen Yi who isn’t short on Points. After all, they are not expensive, and buying them for fun is not a bad idea.
“Thanks, Yi,” Jiaye said, her eyes brimming with joy as she stuffed the prop Chen Yi gave her into her backpack. It was the first time Yi had formally given her a gift, and it counted as one.
Once he had settled everything.
Chen Yi turned his head towards Tuberculosis Rabbit, “What do you say, should we check out the single-player map from Sword Without End that was given to us for the Life Theater?”
He had kept that Map Access Pass in his backpack for a long time and planned to visit the map today. Although the Father’s Day limited-time event wasn’t over, the remaining events had little to do with them.
“Okay,” Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded but then hesitated, “But if I remember correctly, the Map Access Pass given by Sword Without End is for a single-player map, right?”
“Seems like it. I’ll go in first to check it out, to see what the situation is like inside.”
Without further delay, Chen Yi activated the Map Access Pass in his hand. Then everything turned white, and a notification sounded in his ear.
“Ding, you have activated the Life Theater Pass and are entering the ’Life Theater’ map.”
“Please note, this map is a C-class single-player map with a high level of danger. Players, please be prepared.”
“In the next five minutes, you will have time to listen to the rules of the map. Remembering the rules of the map can maximize your chances of staying safe.”
“Rule One:…”
Chen Yi glanced around, raised an eyebrow but said nothing.
A C-class map?
The highest difficulty map he had tried before was just a C-class map.
If he remembered correctly, the reward for this map was some kind of character action?
This was his first time in a single-player C-class map, which was somewhat interesting.
…
PS: Only these two chapters today, organizing subsequent plotlines.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 146 - 145: Next, you will become a janitor.
chapters.content:
Chapter 146 – 145: Next, you will become a janitor.
“Next, you will have five minutes to listen to the map rules. Please remember the map rules, as they can ensure your safety to the greatest extent,”
“Rule one: You must maintain your identity at all times—remember, at all times.”
