His belly had also grotesquely enlarged to the point where he could no longer touch his own navel, nor see his legs—he had become a monster. He didn’t understand how he had turned into such a thing!
Wasn’t he supposed to have become a cleaner? Why had he turned into a monster!
At that moment, he suddenly realized his body was out of control, drifting through the void ahead, and a monster’s corpse floated in the empty space before him.
He had barely approached when he clearly smelled the rot emanating from the corpse, as well as the maggots squirming over it.
Then uncontrollably, Gao Yiming flew straight toward the monster’s corpse and swallowed a portion of it in one gulp.
A third of the monster’s corpse entered his mouth.
His mouth uncontrollably began to chew.
The strong stench of decay and the wriggling of insects in his mouth made Gao Yiming throw up involuntarily—yet his jaw kept grinding without his control, closed tightly.
The vomitus mixed with the chunks of monster in his mouth, continuously chewed against his will.
Gao Yiming couldn’t speak with his mouth clenched shut, but the expression on his face suggested immense discomfort, his eyes brimming with tears.
All he could do was refuse incessantly as his body swallowed forcefully without his consent.
…
“That’s more like it.”
Wang Yimei, standing to the side with his arms resting on his massive belly, looked at the pitiable state of Gao Yiming with satisfaction and nodded. He had come here specifically to welcome newcomers, finding some twisted comfort in watching them in their miserable and broken state upon arrival.
See, it wasn’t just him who had suffered such a fate.
How great would it be if Chen Yi could come here too. To see such an arrogant man, if he became a cleaner and arrived here, the thought alone was amusing.
He no longer harbored hatred towards Chen Yi.
Or rather, it was pointless now.
Upon learning that this was the final stop in life, from where there was no escape, he let go of everything from his life. One of the few pleasures he had now was earning enough points to exchange for some fried chicken and a cola—
to enjoy something a normal person would eat.
And to balance his inner discomfort by coming to see the newcomers’ misery.
As for Chen Yi, it would be great to run into him here, but if not, there was nothing to be done.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi sat atop the rooftop of the Garden District, chatting by the campfire with Jiaye and others.
“It’s actually quite good already. For you siblings to support each other in the afterlife and set up a fish stall is quite an achievement. Tuberculosis Rabbit and I were just morgue attendants before the next life,” he said.
“Come to think of it, you siblings made more than we did.”
“At least you didn’t resort to illegal ways.”
The base salary of a Morgue Attendant, normally speaking, was definitely lower than that of selling fish, but Tuberculosis Rabbit was not normal, steadily expanding the business.
Until the afterlife descended.
They had diversified their services.
Though they were just two corpse guardians, they already possessed the initial potential of a funeral service company.
Not to mention, in the entire Yancheng, Tuberculosis Rabbit was the only one capable of restoring deceased bodies with 3D modeling from before the afterlife.

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 154 - 152: I, Tuberculosis Rabbit, a Born Mortician!
chapters.content:
Chapter 154 – 152: I, Tuberculosis Rabbit, a Born Mortician!
“`
As for the purpose of this, it doesn’t really serve much of one, it simply allows the deceased to be buried or sent to the cremation furnace with a bit more dignity.
Instead of being buried as a pile of minced meat.
That would be too unsightly.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was a born mortician, without any formal education, yet possessed an innate artistic sense when it came to stitching bodies back together.
A regular mortician would at most clean the body of the deceased, change their clothes, and maybe apply some makeup.
That’s pretty much the limit.
But the bodies that passed through Tuberculosis Rabbit’s hands, no matter how mangled, even if only a fingernail remained, could be restored to perfection.
That’s skill.
According to Tuberculosis Rabbit, this was the work of top-tier, all-around rare talent.
Although it didn’t seem like a proper job, it was indeed quite rare, and not low on profit.
As for Tie Chui and Jiaye, these siblings, it was quite an accomplishment for them to not have turned to illegal activities before the descent of later ages, let alone set up their own stall, which already showed great capability.
“It’s not like we haven’t done anything illegal…”
Jiaye, feeling cold, hugged her knees to her chest while sitting in front of the bonfire, the howling of the wind making her speak in a low voice, “I once took over a phone number, and its previous owner was involved in compensated dating.”
“She probably washed her hands off the business and got out, canceling the phone number without telling her regular clients.” Find adventures at Novgo
“After taking over that number, I’d get several calls a day asking if I was taking clients for the day. At first, I was angry, feeling harassed, but then I came to realize that it might not be a bad thing.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi lightly raised his eyebrows and put a skewer of grilled pork belly into his mouth, speaking in surprise, “You became a middleman? Contacting clients on one hand and connecting them with service providers on the other and taking a cut?”
He had never thought Jiaye would have such a story.
“To be honest, the thought did cross my mind at the time.”
Jiaye leaned on Tie Chui’s arm, looked up into Chen Yi’s eyes, a bit embarrassed, “Yi, don’t laugh at me, okay? I was so poor at that time, I didn’t care if it was illegal as long as it made money.”
“But then I looked into it.”
“It counts as organizing prostitution, a crime that comes with a minimum of five years in prison. And I did some research on this business, only to find that the middlemen aren’t just taking a cut for nothing.”
“They need to acquire clients, ensure the girl’s safety when clients are difficult, seek compensation afterward, and they need connections; it’s not a business just anyone can get into.”
“It seemed too difficult, so I gave up on that idea.”
“Later, I found a girl new to compensated dating who didn’t have many clients. I sold her the phone number for 10,000 yuan.”
“She even came back specifically to thank me a year later, saying that we had helped her a lot. Once, during the New Year, she brought gifts to pay us a visit, saying we were the most significant benefactor she met when she entered the business.”
“She’s a… good person.”
And Tie Chui, who had been quietly eating next to her, put down his skewers, looked at Chen Yi with a serious expression, and with a deep voice gave a thumbs-up, “That girl… she’s a good person, she gave me… a bottle of liquor and a pack of cigarettes.”
“Respect… me a lot.”
Perhaps in Tie Chui’s mind, anyone who gave him cigarettes was a good person.
“I see.”
Chen Yi, with a chuckle, placed the empty skewer stick aside and said with a laugh, “That’s quite interesting, I definitely wouldn’t have thought of that.”
“What would you do with a phone number like that, Yi?”
Jiaye suddenly became interested, her eyes full of anticipation as she intently looked at Chen Yi, waiting for his response.
“Me?”
“Not sure about specifics, but if I actually got such a phone number, I’d probably cancel it and get a new one.”
“But if Tuberculosis Rabbit got hold of that number, I bet he’d sell it to a men’s clinic, since most of these callers would be essentially precise potential clients.”
Chen Yi shrugged helplessly.
“Giggle.”
Jiaye couldn’t help but laugh at Chen Yi’s response, leaning against Tie Chui’s shoulder as her eyes shone with amusement and relaxation.
“Why didn’t I think of that? Tuberculosis Rabbit really knows how to make money.”
She was thoroughly enjoying the moment.
Yancheng, enshrouded by dark clouds, was incredibly dim at that time, and the few people sitting around the bonfire on the windy rooftop appeared to be enjoying their barbecue.
Her brother was by her side, and Chen Yi was there too.
Despite the harsh surroundings, she felt extremely content.
She used to hate this kind of weather; their business always slumped during such times, but now, she loved it. Even if the weather was nasty, she could feel an ample sense of security.
If only this moment could last forever.
Yet, if anyone else heard her thoughts, they’d likely be so infuriated they couldn’t help but laugh—in her company sat a man who could deal a million damage with a single shot and defeat the world boss, how could she not feel safe?
The perspective slowly rose.
Under the dark cloud-filled sky, the few people sitting on the ground around the bonfire on the rooftop indeed looked rather cozy.
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit wasn’t having such a great time.
“`
“Ding, your performance as the Wife Murderer has achieved a 32% degree of perfection, resulting in a failure to leave the map without any prop losses, which is a silver lining.”
“Map Evaluation”: It’s evident that you have your own methods for cleaning up a crime scene, and you could be a perfect criminal.
In just 4 minutes, not only did you remove all the bloodstains in the house, but you also used white vinegar to clean up all DNA and fingerprints belonging to the mistress on the bed linens and clothes in the master bedroom.
And you checked every corner of the living room for fingerprints and dandruff using an ultraviolet light.
And you were preparing to chop up the mistress’s body into pieces to hide in the outdoor unit of the air conditioner. It’s hard to imagine why you are so proficient at dismembering a body; Pao Ding’s butchery is nothing compared to this.
Unfortunately, while you were dismembering the body, the police arrived and witnessed the entire process of you cutting up the body, leading to your immediate capture and imprisonment.
Although you were convicted by the police as soon as you entered the map.
At least you provided what could be considered a perfect answer in cleaning up the crime scene. If given enough time, I believe you could restore a flawlessly pristine crime scene.
However, you veered off-topic.
Please note that the main task is to play a Wife Murderer, and the Wife Murderer you portrayed does not possess such proficient body disposal skills. Please review the requirements carefully.
“Map Reward”: None. Please note that when a player’s performance score is below 30%, they will lose a random half of the props they are carrying upon settlement evaluation.
Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the evaluation board in front of him with an ugly expression, his face almost dripping with gloom!
Damn it!
In those 4 minutes, he had exerted every skill and knowledge he had acquired over his lifetime, not daring to pause for a second, employing every trick in the book to get the crime scene nearly straightened out!
And yet he was told his performance rating was only 32%!
The reason being that his actions did not match the identity he was supposed to portray.
But the role he was playing was of a newbie who even had to search online for how to clean up blood—such a greenhorn wouldn’t stand a chance at cleaning up a crime scene properly.
Four minutes was just too little time!
In that time frame, you had to choose between cleaning up DNA and blood, or dismembering the body, not both. There simply wasn’t enough time.
If he had been given an hour.
He could make the body disappear from this world without a trace, never to be found by anyone.
With only 4 minutes, the only place he could hide the body was inside the house, with no time for intricate disposal, let alone transporting the body out of the house.
“Ding, you have 3 more uses of your Life Theater Map Access Pass. Would you like to enter again?”
Standing in the white space, Tuberculosis Rabbit gazed at the images on the wall that depicted his experiences within the map, contemplating internally how to better conceal the body and clear himself of criminal suspicion.
Yi had already told him that the reward for completing the hidden tasks was substantial, while merely perfect performance in the role would only grant a globally unique character action reward.
He could have temporarily hidden the body inside the water heater, as according to Yi’s experience, it was a spot that the police were unlikely to discover immediately.
But just as he was about to stuff the body into the water heater.
A panel suddenly popped up in front of him.
“Ding, the previous player who received a perfect evaluation had hidden a body in the water heater; this spot is no longer an overlooked spot and the body hidden here will be discovered immediately.”
The hiding place that the last perfectly performing player used could no longer be utilized by the next player entering, an unknown piece of information to them.
Which also meant that the plan he and Yi had discussed was thoroughly ruined.
Originally, he had planned to follow Yi’s method, clean up the traces in the house, and then hide the body in the water heater before going to the police station to play the part of someone with split personality disorder.
But since he couldn’t hide the body in the water heater, he had no choice but to chop up the body and hide it elsewhere, which was completely impossible to do within a 4-minute time frame.
The most fatal part was.
After failing to leave the map, he wouldn’t return to reality but would stay in this white space, with only the option to re-enter the map available.
Meaning he couldn’t discuss midway with Yi.
And he must achieve a high enough performance perfection in the following attempts, or he would risk losing a random half of his props.
The biggest challenge now was figuring out how to properly conceal the body within the 4-minute timeframe.
Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the scenes flashing across the wall, his brow furrowed in deep thought.
The next second—
A glint of light suddenly appeared in his eyes.
Wait?
What was his goal? To complete the hidden task, clear the criminal suspicion, and receive the hidden reward!
But to clear the criminal suspicion, it wasn’t the only method to hide the body and then pretend to have a split personality!
Could he stage a home invasion instead?
No need to clean up any blood or deal with the body at all.
Some burglar could have broken in, killed his wife, left him gravely injured—that would make sense, right?
If he became the victim, he could naturally clear the criminal suspicion, right?
…
PS: Hehe, could I ask for some monthly votes, it’s my first time asking this month.

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 155 - 153: "The scene was too clean, so clean it seemed like it had been deliberately staged.
chapters.content:
Chapter 155 – 153: “The scene was too clean, so clean it seemed like it had been deliberately staged.
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t think much and chose to enter the map again!
When the Map Access Pass fell into Yi’s hands, it had a total of five uses. Yi used it once, he used it once, now there were three chances left!
After reentering the map, what met his eyes was the same familiar scene.
A somewhat cramped bedroom with a computer desk and a computer on it. The computer screen was on a browser page, as if searching for something.
The ashtray on the desk was piled high with ashes, and several cigarette butts had even spilled out.
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced around and, with a distracted look, began gnawing at his fingernails, holding the mouse with panicked and hurried eyes, constantly flipping through the browser pages on the screen.
He didn’t, like last time, start cleaning the bloodstains as soon as he landed.
Instead, he first used the information in the computer diary to learn that the identity he was playing had a habit of biting his nails when nervous, trying to boost his performance rating a bit.
He put himself in the shoes of the character he was playing and thought about what he would do in this situation.
After all that was done.
Tuberculosis Rabbit finally rushed to the living room. Instead of cleaning up the bloodstains and starting to dismember the body immediately, like last time, he looked at the female corpse lying in a pool of blood in the living room.
Instead, he lifted his head to glance at the clock on the living room wall and swiftly began a series of actions!
Firstly, the signs of struggle in the room needed some basic handling. They didn’t need to be entirely dealt with, just a bit of manipulation was enough.
Once his line of thought changed, things became much simpler.
The blood didn’t need to be cleaned, nor did the corpse.
Tuberculosis Rabbit then looked down at the bloodstained dagger on the coffee table. It was the dagger the original owner of the identity he was playing had used to kill his wife, covered with a lot of the woman’s blood and the original owner’s fingerprints.
Last time he’d entered the map, he cleaned off all the blood and fingerprints from the dagger.
But this time he didn’t do anything to it.
Instead, he gripped the dagger in reverse, took a deep breath, and stabbed himself in the abdomen multiple times!
He was too familiar with the wounds on the body. A person stabbing themselves in the stomach and a wound inflicted by someone else were very different, and could easily be distinguished with the naked eye.
And because he understood wounds so well, he was able to make the self-inflicted wound on his stomach look like it was inflicted by another person.
He could also roughly fabricate the height, force, and weight of the assailant by the way he used the dagger.
After everything was done, he twitched slightly at the corners of his mouth from the pain, and then he leaned against the sofa, lying on the ground as if half-dead.
And the next second—
“Police, open up!”
The door was suddenly forced open, and a flood of police officers in uniform, holding guns with serious faces, rushed in. As soon as they entered, they saw such a bloody scene before them.
Their expressions shifted dramatically.
“Homicide, we have two victims.”
“Wait!”
“One seems to be still alive, request an ambulance!”
…
More than twenty hours passed.
Tuberculosis Rabbit slowly opened his eyes, looking somewhat dazedly at several uniformed police officers standing in front of his hospital bed, full of incomprehension.
He had awakened a long time ago, to be precise, he should have never lost consciousness.
Although the wound in his abdomen wasn’t small, he always felt as if such injuries were trivial, as if he had suffered more severe wounds before. Yet, he could not recall ever being seriously injured.
Maybe it was because he was naturally tough and had a high tolerance for pain with such injuries.
Still, he pretended to be comatose on the hospital bed for a long time, letting those clumsy doctors sew his stomach with needle and thread. After the bandaging was done, these officers had been guarding by his bedside.
He had intended to wait for these officers to leave, and then naturally clear his suspicion to smoothly exit the map, but now it seemed that if he did not wake up, they intended to keep standing there.
“Sigh.”
After silently sighing in his heart, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up with white lips at the police officers in front of his bed and said with a trembling voice, “How is she? Did she wake up?”
“…”
The middle-aged man leading the officers in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit’s bed fell silent for a long while with an expressionless face, then stared straight into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes and said word by word.
“I’m sorry, your wife died at the crime scene, resuscitation was ineffective.”
“No trace of a third person was found on the scene, only you and your wife’s traces were in the entire room.”
“There were no significant damage marks on the security door, nor traces of ropes on the windows.”
“And only your fingerprints were found on the dagger.”
“Additionally, before the crime, someone heard you having a vehement argument with your wife. We also found your diary in your computer.”
“In your diary, you wrote that you failed in your business, and after the failure, your wife’s attitude towards you changed drastically. We have ample reason to suspect that, dissatisfied with your wife’s attitude, you killed her after a violent argument.”
“You have sufficient motive for the crime, and all the clues at the crime scene point directly to you.”
“Impossible!!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes filled with disbelief as he shoved his fingernails into his mouth, enveloped by grief and an inability to accept the situation, his body shaking uncontrollably as he curled into a ball.
It seemed like he fell into profound grief after his wife’s death.
He did not offer a single word of rebuttal to the accusations of the officer in front of him, but rather, he sank into endless sorrow following his wife’s passing.
After a long while,
Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking a bit better, finally raised his head to look at the officer standing in front of the hospital bed, “Have you caught him?”
“Who?”
“The murderer.”
“Based on the current clues, all the pointers are directed at you. You are the prime suspect.”
“Get out!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit surged with anger, paying no heed to his own injuries as he sat up and hurled the pillow from the hospital bed at the officer, “A bunch of idiots!!!”
…
An hour later.
The middle-aged officer stood outside the hospital room, leaning against the wall with furrowed brows, deep in thought, before he spoke hoarsely after a moment.
“I believe what he said.”
“The scene is too clean, so clean it seems deliberately arranged.”
“Let’s make an assumption.”
He turned his head towards the young trainee officer beside him, “If you were someone whose business failed and, in a fit of emotional breakdown, killed your own wife, how would you handle it?”
“Me?”
The trainee officer trailing behind the middle-aged one hesitated slightly before replying, “I’m not married yet, I don’t quite understand that kind of emotional collapse, but if it were me, I might first wipe off the fingerprints on the murder weapon.”
“That’s right.”
The middle-aged officer nodded expressionlessly, “That step is important. Almost everyone, whether in a state of emotional breakdown or having accidentally killed the person beside them in bed, will subconsciously perform some actions to conceal evidence.”
“Like wiping off fingerprints, destroying crime scene traces, or even disposing of the body.”
“It’s a subconscious reaction from people’s self-preservation systems.”
“Even if most criminals who turn themselves in after the crime, before surrendering, they would have taken these actions. There are various reasons why they surrender, whether they can’t stand their conscience’s condemnation, are weary of fleeing, or longing for a sound sleep.”
“But regardless of the situation, these criminals would have subconsciously made some changes to the crime scene to hide the fact that they are murderers.”
“However, our case’s crime scene is too perfect.”
“The suspect’s fingerprints on the murder weapon, the suspect’s footprints at the crime scene, the suspect’s motive detailed in the computer diary, the external witness who heard the argument, arriving at the scene to find the victim and the suspect, and so forth.”
“The whole process looks as if someone is hand-feeding us the perpetrator’s case.”
“If I didn’t know my father wasn’t the bureau chief, I would almost suspect that my father deliberately created the crime scene to hand me a meritorious case.”
“The entire crime scene coincides almost perfectly with the cases we studied at the police academy.”
“Uhm…”
The young officer standing beside, leaning against the wall, touched his nose somewhat awkwardly, but his eyelids began to droop, and he started to harbor some doubts.
Put like that, it indeed seemed rather strange.
Could it really be that his bureau chief father constructed this merit for him to ascend the ranks more quickly?
Isn’t this manner of feeding merit a bit too crude?
Next time, set up something with drugs, that would bring even greater merit.
“So Captain, what are you implying?”
“My implication is simple.”
The middle-aged officer lit a cigarette, his eyes heavy with the weight of the world, and put it to his lips, speaking hoarsely, “Every medical student understands a principle, that in reality, it’s nearly impossible to see a case that mirrors those in textbooks exactly.”
“The cases in the textbooks are perfect cases, but reality has many variables.”
“Once you encounter a case that’s as perfect as the textbook cases, nine times out of ten, it’s already buried.”
“We should also understand a principle, that in reality, it’s nearly impossible to have a perfect case consistent with the textbooks. There should also be various variables, and if encountered, there must be doubt.”
“Based on the information we’ve gathered, I have a deduction, that the criminal suspect is someone else, somebody who entered the room, killed, destroyed the crime scene, and fled.”
“Uh…”
The young officer leaned against the wall in deep thought without speaking. He was a bit reluctant to let the captain continue investigating. After the captain’s reminder, he began to suspect that perhaps his own father, the bureau chief, was involved in foul play. If the investigation led back to his father, that would be quite the spectacle.
He cleared his throat softly, tentatively beginning to speak.
“Captain, so far except for the suspect’s testimony, all evidence points towards the suspect. Technically, we could already convict him, and the merit from a homicide case is not insignificant.”
“You’re the main officer handling this case, and the lion’s share of the merit would go to you.”
“Isn’t it a bit wasteful to create additional complications?”
His intention was clear; whether or not this man was the true murderer, since the evidence pointed to him, they might as well pin the murder on him and secure the merit for themselves.
“Do you realize what you’re saying?”
The middle-aged man swept a cold glance at the young officer beside him, “Remember the oath you took when you joined, our goal is to uncover the truth and seek justice for the people, not to wrongly convict on false charges.”

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 156 - 154: "Calm down first, sir.
chapters.content:
Chapter 156 – 154: “Calm down first, sir.
“Alright, alright.”
Seeing the captain’s gaze, the young officer raised his hands helplessly, “Everything you say is right, Captain. I was just mentioning it casually. According to what you’ve said, Captain, there should be traces of a third person at the scene.”
“But we didn’t find any trace of anyone other than the suspect and the victim at the scene.”
“You should know that the average suspect wouldn’t notice the presence of things like hair and dandruff, which are difficult to observe with the naked eye.”
The middle-aged officer sneered upon hearing this, then stubbed out his cigarette in the crease of his hand, “This further proves that the real murderer has the ability to clean up the crime scene far beyond an average person. Someone with these capabilities has a very obvious professional characteristic, and it’s clear they’re no ordinary person.”
“This allows us to quickly label the real killer.”
“But only the suspect’s fingerprints were found on the murder weapon.”
“That’s too easy. The real killer simply had to clean their own fingerprints off the fruit knife, then put the dagger back in the suspect’s hands to get it covered in fingerprints.”
“So, Captain, do you mean that the suspect’s abdominal wound wasn’t self-inflicted out of guilt, but was inflicted by the suspect?”
“Correct.”
At this moment, the middle-aged officer seemed to transform into the detective Conan, once again lighting a cigarette. A wise light shone upon him, as if a beam from heaven descended and illuminated his face, making it overflow with confidence and conviction.
“I was once a top-rated officer in the capital. Do you know why I came to this small city to be a police officer?”
“Um…”
The young officer was somewhat bewildered, not understanding why the captain suddenly switched topics from discussing the case, but still subconsciously replied.
“Because you offended someone?”
“No, it’s because I once handled a wrongful case, and after it happened, I was demoted in a roundabout way. Since then, I have secretly vowed never to handle a wrongful case in my life.”
“If it were for the sake of accolades, I could naturally take the path of least resistance and convict the suspect directly, but for the sake of justice, to make up for past mistakes, I’m not going to do that.”
“The medical examiner just sent me a message. The wound on the suspect’s abdomen wasn’t self-inflicted. When a person normally stabs themselves, the wound doesn’t look like this, this kind of wound could only have been inflicted by another person.”
“Unless the suspect twisted their own arm into a pretzel.”
“Most importantly, there are several wounds on the suspect’s abdomen. Based on my years of casework experience, I’ve encountered many who self-inflict injury to avoid guilt, but these individuals typically have only one wound.”
“After inflicting one wound on themselves, the intense pain and fear of death prevent them from having the courage and strength to stab themselves again.”
“And the wounds aren’t very deep.”
“However, the wounds on the suspect’s body are deep, clearly aimed to be fatal with every strike.”
“And… most murderers stab their victims multiple times upon killing them, even if the first stab is fatal, they will follow with several attacks.”
“According to criminal psychology, this is an unconscious reaction of the body in extreme fear, loss of reason, and an adrenaline surge. Apart from hired killers who make a living this way, ordinary murderers typically don’t leave just one wound on their victims.”
“Your teacher must have taught you that, right?”
“Based on these two points, we can clearly deduce that the wounds on the suspect’s body were caused by the murderer, and moreover, the murderer is skilled at cleaning up the crime scene and is ruthlessly vicious.”
“The only issue now is that there are no signs of forced entry on the security door. How did the murderer get into the house?”
“We need to interrogate the suspect about this.”
…
Lying on the hospital bed, Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking weakly at the two officers standing in front of his bed, murmured powerlessly, “It was my wife who opened the door, I was inside playing video games at the time.”
“I just knew someone was knocking, and then my wife went to open the door.”
“At first, I thought it was the delivery man, so I didn’t go out and continued playing games in the room because I was holding a sniper rifle I’d saved up for over three rounds—a focused and intense guard over ’A’ site—naturally, I had no time to go and check.”
“Then, I heard what seemed to be an argument outside.”
“When I went to check, I found my wife already lying in a pool of blood, and the murderer, holding a dagger, charged at me. After being stabbed several times, I lost consciousness.”
“The person was wearing a mask, I couldn’t see his face.”
“…”
The middle-aged officer squinted his eyes, staring at Tuberculosis Rabbit lying on the bed, “Your wife doesn’t go out all year round, and knowing clearly that she didn’t order any delivery, upon hearing someone knocking, wouldn’t she look through the peephole first?”
“If through the peephole she saw a man wearing a mask, or if the peephole was intentionally blocked, knowing that she might be in a dangerous situation, why would she still open the door personally?”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit fell into a speechless silence; how could he know, he was just making it up, he hadn’t thought through this part.
What are you doing, Yi? Do you really think you’re Holmes?
You’re just an NPC in a map, alright?
That’s enough.
He sighed softly, no longer speaking, preparing himself to silently wait for the mission to fail, then re-enter. There was something wrong with the strategy this time, he had to think about what method to use next time he entered the map.
Was the difficulty of this map so high?
And just then—
The middle-aged police officer’s tone shifted, and he said with an icy expression, “Unless the person at the door was someone your wife was extremely familiar with, someone she could recognize at a glance even with a mask on, and someone she trusted implicitly, she wouldn’t have opened the door for them.”
“Did your wife have much of a social life?”
This is off-script, way off-script!!
Tuberculosis Rabbit muttered to himself inwardly. This part of the script had gone beyond his planned storyline, but he had no choice but to brace himself and say, “No.”
In the diary background, his wife was a woman with virtually no social life.
But just as he was about to say something to salvage the situation, a young police officer suddenly burst in, his voice urgently whispering, “Captain, we’ve found the entire chat history between the victim and a man on her messaging app on her phone.”
“Our preliminary assessment is that they were lovers, and the chat content was very explicit… The victim said in WeChat that she liked the feeling of being his dog, that she enjoyed the sensation of kneeling on the ground, abandoning all dignity, and relishing being trampled upon.”
“And the victim would go out every month to meet this man, book a hotel in advance, and check in on the same day.”
“But in the last few messages, the two had a significant quarrel, and the victim deleted the man from her contacts.”
“The chat content was deleted by the victim before her death, but our tech team has just now fully restored it.”
As he said this, the young officer finally noticed Tuberculosis Rabbit lying on the bed; his body stiffened slightly, and he said somewhat awkwardly, “Uh, I’m sorry, but you’re about to be executed, so I guess you wouldn’t care about one more hat on your head, right?”
“Really?”
A flicker of shock flashed in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, and his body involuntarily straightened up a bit, his eyes filled with the thrill of gossip and excitement. He was about to ask for more details, but he remembered that he was role-playing and should make a reaction befitting his character.
Almost instantly, his eyes swelled with rage and anger, and he bellowed furiously, “That damn wench, that despicable woman!!”
“I gave up everything for her, she lived off me every day, how dare she treat me like this!”
“Who is that man? I’m going to kill him, kill him!!!”
“Those cheating dogs!”
“Calm down for a second, sir.”
The middle-aged police officer cast a sad glance at Tuberculosis Rabbit lying on the bed, then led the other officers out of the ward, giving Tuberculosis Rabbit some space to be alone.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, lying on the hospital bed, looked at the backs of the departing officers, gradually stopping his exaggerated expression and licked the corner of his mouth with some lingering satisfaction.
Was there such a backstory?
The diary of the original person didn’t mention these things.
It looks like the original person really didn’t know he was being cuckolded.
That kid is kind of pitiful.
A moment later, the middle-aged police officer came back in with a few officers, looking seriously at Tuberculosis Rabbit on the bed, “I sympathize with your situation, but I hope you can calm down first.”
“The suspicion on you has been partially cleared, and I suspect your wife’s lover is the real murderer.”
“Your wife opened the door because she recognized the man and believed he wouldn’t harm her, and she feared that he would make a scene, so she opened the door.”
“You also said that you were engrossed in gaming at the time, and your wife probably knew that too, so she opened the door to try to talk things out with him, to keep him from making too much noise.”
“Before the lover came to the door, your wife had an argument with him and deleted him from her contacts, mainly because he wanted her to divorce you, and she didn’t want to, which led to the quarrel.”
“We’ve obtained this man’s home location and sent people to arrest him. We believe we will have results soon. If the evidence shows this man is the murderer, then sir, you can be discharged once you have recovered from your injuries.”
“Ah? Oh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked perplexed and didn’t quite know what to say for a moment. This plot twist was completely off from what Yi had briefed him on; Yi hadn’t mentioned any of this part of the story.
Was there really a scapegoat like this?
An hour later.
A young officer strode into the room.
“He’s confessed. The lover admitted that he killed the victim and cleaned up the crime scene thoroughly, erasing all traces of himself.”
“But he denied many things.”
“For instance, he denied stabbing the suspect, uh… denied stabbing this gentleman, insisting he didn’t see this gentleman in the house, and didn’t intentionally frame this gentleman. He said he just killed the victim and then left the scene.”
…
ps: Another coming in a few dozen minutes.

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 157 - 155: Exclusive Limited Title "True Plot Detective"!
chapters.content:
Chapter 157 – 155: Exclusive Limited Title “True Plot Detective”!
“`
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit had already fallen silent in his place.
What’s the situation?
How could that lover have really confessed? Did you guys resort to torture for a confession?
It was clearly him who killed her, yet he hasn’t confessed. How come the other guy has?
“Hmph.”
A glint of coldness and satisfaction flashed in the middle-aged police officer’s eyes: “Continue the interrogation.”
Only then did he turn his head towards Tuberculosis Rabbit and said with a serious expression, “I’m very sorry to have alarmed you, sir. Your suspicion can now almost be cleared, and we express our deepest sorrow for your wife’s death.”
“But we still hope that you can recover as soon as possible and strive to carry on with life.”
“Ah.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded his head somewhat blankly, hesitated for a long time, really couldn’t understand, “Did he really confess?”
“Yes, he admitted unabashedly to killing your wife, and I am sorry to tell you, sir, that he lives in the same building as you. In the murderer’s home, we found a large number of erotic photos, chains, whips, and other training tools, a special chemical agent that can only be used for destroying corpses, and on the murderer’s communication software…”
“We found that someone had been in close contact with the murderer.”
“That unknown mysterious person was teaching the murderer how to use some tools to…find some fun, and also imparted a lot of experience on how to destroy evidence.”
“In addition to his statement, this is enough to prove that the murderer is indeed this lover, and he was at the time preparing his tools, ready to return to the crime scene to completely obliterate all traces.”
“We are now investigating the identity of this mysterious person, but the murderer has been confirmed, it’s this lover.”
“He admitted that he had a quarrel with your wife over an argument, went over to confront her but was once again rejected by your wife, resulting in a dispute, and ultimately, accidentally killed your wife.”
“The argument that the reporter heard should be the argument he had with your wife.”
“When you went out to check, you discovered this scene and subsequently were likewise murdered. Is that correct?”
“Ah? Oh!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded vigorously and looked at the middle-aged police officer earnestly, giving a thumbs-up, “You’re brilliant, officer. The situation at the scene is without a single error from your deductions, as if you personally witnessed the whole event.”
“Ha.”
The middle-aged police officer shook his head with some disdain, “Every net has its mesh, the criminal’s attempt to frame you was too obvious. We will not wrongly accuse a good person.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded again vigorously and gave the middle-aged police officer another high rating in his heart. It seemed he could perfectly complete the hidden mission and pass through the game.
Although the process wasn’t quite as he expected, the outcome was surprisingly good for some reason.
And at that moment—
The scene in his eyes suddenly froze as if paused, then started to shatter like glass, accompanied by a flash of white light, he found himself in a white space, and a prompt sounded in his ear.
’Ding, congratulations to player Tuberculosis Rabbit for perfectly acting out the role of the Wife Murderer, acting perfection 100% (Role-playing rating 54%, passing through reward rating 46%).’
’Map Evaluation’: You have perfectly achieved the hidden plot of this map, just as you wrote in your diary, you are a failed entrepreneur, unable to accept your fall from grace after experiencing past glory.
Your thoughts gradually became warped night after night. Your wife’s cold treatment towards you filled you with even more rage.
One night, on a whim, you assumed the identity of a mysterious person and found a middle-aged man living in the same building, manipulating him into seducing your wife, slowly making your wife fall into his tender trap.
You taught him many tricks from afar, turning your extremely cold and mocking wife into a mere tool in his eyes.
He would send all of your wife’s erotic photos to you.
Seeing your usually contemptuous and scornful wife, now kneeling on the ground in stark contrast in the photos, you felt an unspeakable sense of revenge and pleasure, relishing the sight of your wife’s usual cold facade.
But gradually, the situation spiraled out of your control.
One day, the man suddenly came over, had a fierce argument with your wife, and killed her. Hearing the commotion inside the house, you hid under the bed in utter fear and clamped your hand over your mouth, thereby avoiding the murderer’s search.
After the murderer left, you walked into the living room, looked at the bloodstained dagger on the coffee table and your wife lying in a pool of blood, never having anticipated this turn of events.
After a long time, you felt you couldn’t let this matter come to light. You hurried back to your room, contacted the man again as the mysterious person, started to search online for ways to destroy evidence and sent it to him.
You urged him to return to the scene of the crime quickly to dispose of the body cleanly so as not to involve yourself.
The first time he returned to the scene under your direction, he cleaned all traces of himself from the living room, then went back to his home, preparing the chemical agent to destroy the evidence.
But at that moment, a neighbor downstairs reported the argument between the man and your wife to the police, leading the police to be on their way.
You also deleted all the chat records and friends with the man, ensuring that if the incident was exposed, it wouldn’t implicate you.
And at that moment, due to extreme fear and tension, you suddenly suffered a brief memory loss and when you came to, you saw your wife’s body in the living room and the contents displayed on your computer screen, mistaking it for your having killed your wife.
Thus, you had a mental breakdown.
You are a natural Plot Explorer, able to uncover the true plot through the slightest clues.
’Map Reward’: Because your role-playing perfection rate is 100%, you have received the ultimate reward for this map, the globally unique character action “Blood Pigeon Covers the Sky”.
’Hidden Reward’: Because you have completed the hidden mission of this map, you will receive the exclusive limited title “True Plot Detective”, as well as two clean grey stones, 10,000 Points, and one Grade B random Prop Chest.
Immediately thereafter, a series of scenes started rolling and playing on the walls.
“`
The screen displayed the first-person perspective of the amnesiac original identity’s portrayal, as well as the scene where his wife went downstairs to see her lover and headed to the hotel, while he remotely guided her and continually received videos and photos sent by the lover.
And when the wife returned with a cold demeanor toward the original identity, the sneer that came from off-screen by the portrayal of the original identity.
Scenes after scenes reshaped his understanding of this map.
After a long while.
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in place with a blank expression, utterly at a loss for words.
He had figured out the true plot of the map.
When he entered this map, the timeline was precisely when the original identity briefly lost his memory and believed he was the killer, and the map content also suggested the murder was his doing.
Therefore, naturally, he had considered himself a criminal suspect from the beginning, but who would have thought that he wasn’t the killer at all, and he shouldn’t have been a suspect in the first place.
According to Yi’s narration, the original identity’s computer had a large number of adult site browsing records, which was one of the main pieces of evidence for Yi’s portrayal of split personality; he had even taken special note of this detail.
Looking at it now, the reason the original identity’s computer had so many browsing records was probably due to a few specific keywords.
This was a complete pervert.
From the beginning, it was hinted through this characteristic that the original identity was secretly controlling a man to flagellate his own wife, but nobody would think in that direction; how can a normal person judge whether someone would actually do such a thing solely based on their browsing history?
This means.
The woman was indeed killed by that man, and the traces in the living room were cleaned up by that man under his guidance; he avoided the man’s first murder search by hiding under the bed.
Moreover, the man had prepared a chemical solvent at home and planned to return to completely destroy the evidence. Before the incident, the man had a fierce quarrel with his wife, causing the neighbors to call the police.
There were probably no fingerprints left on that dagger, or rather, there were never his fingerprints to begin with.
Thinking of this, the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
The first thing he did when he descended the map for the first time was to wipe his fingerprints off the weapon. Now it seemed that there might never have been his fingerprints on the weapon to begin with, or they were never his.
But who could have thought of that at the time?
A normal person would find it quite difficult to discern with the naked eye whether a fingerprint belongs to themselves, right?
He had just subconsciously followed the map’s prompt to wipe the fingerprints from the dagger; looking back, it seems it was an unnecessary move. Had the lover already cleaned the fingerprints from the dagger?
The first time he descended the map, had he painstakingly cleared a crime scene he hadn’t caused?
And then, did he force himself into the identity of the murderer?
As the white space shattered, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s figure slowly appeared on the community rooftop.
“Back already?”
Chen Yi turned and glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had suddenly appeared beside him, and smiled at the new title above his head, “Looks like you’ve successfully completed the hidden mission, and you must have used a different method than I did.”
“True Plot Detective, that’s quite a nice title.”
“Yi.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat down cross-legged next to Chen Yi with a complex expression and after a pause said complicatedly, “Do you still remember what this hidden mission was?”
“Clearing oneself of the suspect identity.”
Chen Yi cast a suspicious glance at Tuberculosis Rabbit, “What’s wrong? Did something extra happen in the map?”
“Hmm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, sighed with emotion, and lamented, “Actually, the identity we were playing wasn’t the real murderer at all, we were misled by the pre-entry content and the scene.”
“The killer was someone else.”
“The specifics would take a long time to explain, but in short, it’s extremely melodramatic, and whoever came up with this plot has a brain that is definitely a little sick. The general situation is like this…”
Several minutes later.
On the rooftop.
The wind howled, and the sky grew darker.
Chen Yi and his companions remained silent without saying a word.
After a moment, Chen Yi broke the silence, “I understand my 96% map evaluation now, and where the remaining 4% falls short.”
“It’s hard for a normal person to dig into this kind of plot.”
“How did you uncover it?”
“Yi, you might not believe it, but I hadn’t thought about this at all. It was an overly helpful NPC who dug it out for me, and I completed the perfect evaluation while being completely baffled.”
“Then I figured it out.”
“I didn’t need to create those scenes, didn’t need to stab myself, didn’t need to smudge the dagger with my fingerprints, and didn’t need to create a scenario where I was framed.”
“From the moment I was discovered, if I had just stubbornly kept denying, absolutely refusing to admit it, the NPC would probably have helped us uncover the real truth.”
“So to complete this map’s hidden task, it might actually be quite simple, just keep denying till the end.”

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 158 - 156: "Hopefully the July rules will be more player-friendly.
chapters.content:
Chapter 158 – 156: “Hopefully the July rules will be more player-friendly.
As Tuberculosis Rabbit’s words faded away, Chen Yi and the others fell into a heavy silence without speaking.
This map scenario is indeed a bit tricky to figure out.
Which means Tuberculosis Rabbit is actually the perfect fit for this map. Players don’t need to do anything after entering the map; they just have to be stubborn. As long as they keep up the stubbornness, they can achieve a perfect evaluation.
When the map access was passed to them, there were only five entries available. Sword Without End had already entered five times, yet had not completed the hidden mission.
Although it was unclear what exactly happened to Sword Without End inside the map.
One could guess that Sword Without End probably wanted to complete the hidden mission, therefore cleaning up the crime scene and concealing his own criminal behavior.
However, what was unexpected was that the more intact the crime scene was preserved, the more beneficial it would be for oneself. Actively cleaning the crime scene actually singled out the real culprit, trapping himself even deeper.
After a long while.
Only then did Chen Yi let out a long sigh, rubbing his temples with a sense of helplessness: “I was saying how could a Grade C map be so complex? Normal people shouldn’t be able to pass the hidden mission by playing a role with split personality like I did.”
“After all, it’s a highly difficult task to process the crime scene exceedingly clean within four minutes, even for professionals.
“Now it seems that probably the map didn’t anticipate anyone could actually clean up the crime scene within those four minutes.”
“Originally, I thought that although it was a Grade C map, the difficulty increased a bit because it was a hidden mission, but now it seems like we raised the difficulty ourselves.”
“Then this map should suit Tie Chui the best, simply acting in character would be enough to complete the hidden mission.”
“I’m afraid that’s not possible anymore.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head: “After I completed the game, the system indicated that the map had been successfully cleared with 100% perfection by a player and no further entries are allowed. The remaining two entry tries were also voided.”
After he came out from the map, players could no longer enter this map.
“What a pity.”
Chen Yi glanced regretfully at the dark clouds in the sky before asking, “How’s the Title Effect of your title?”
“Wait, let me check it with the clean grey stone.”
The next second—
A Title Effect was shared in front of everyone.
’Title Name’: True Plot Detective.
’Title Quality’: Red.
’Title Effect’: On your first entry into any map, you will receive a piece of hidden information about that map.
’Title Source’: “Available from clearing a Grade C map in Life Theater with a hidden mission and obtaining a 100% perfect evaluation.”
“This Title Effect is somewhat strong.”
Chen Yi, gazing at the Title Effect shared by Tuberculosis Rabbit, nodded thoughtfully: “With this Title Effect, it’s like getting more hidden messages when we enter a new map, which will be very helpful for us in clearing new maps.”
“For example, in this map scenario, if we had this Title Effect, we could probably get a higher evaluation.”
He then looked down at the time, stood up, and turned to Jiaye and the others sitting by the campfire, saying, “It’s getting late, Tuberculosis Rabbit and I will head back first; you guys should also head home and rest early.”
“Okay.”
Jiaye nodded, looking at Chen Yi: “You guys go ahead, my brother and I will sit here for a while longer.”
“Alright.”
Chen Yi didn’t say much but smiled and waved his hand at Tie Chui before heading downstairs with Tuberculosis Rabbit. It was almost nine o’clock; time to get ready for bed after washing up.
…
In the following period, the lives of Chen Yi and his companions seemed to enter the proper track.
They ate three meals a day in a very standard manner, rested at sunset and got up at sunrise, and after waking up they would go outside the city to hunt for a while. Up to now, they really weren’t lacking Points from monster drops.
But if you don’t use the Props on you, they’ll ’rust’, although rusting is a bit of an exaggeration. However, taking them out and using them often can indeed provide better ways to handle crises when they arise.
There were no global events during this time, nor were there any limited-time events.
Every day they ate meals sent over by Jiaye, occasionally went to the hotpot restaurant they invested in for a meal, savoring the charm of spicy boiled beef tripe, and then they would need to eat modestly for several days afterward.
Hotpot is certainly delicious, but in the end, it isn’t as comforting as light food for the stomach.
And today, it’s already June 30th.
It’s also the last day of June.
They maintained this stable and leisurely lifestyle for about 11 days straight, all the way until the end of this month. Clearly, this stable life was about to be disrupted.
“It’s finally going to be July.”
It was around three o’clock in the afternoon.
The black clouds had dissipated, and the sun was once again enveloping the earth, filling the air with a languid heat that made it difficult for a normal person not to feel sleepy.
Tuberculosis Rabbit lay lazily on the beach chair under the rooftop garden’s sun umbrella, dressed in a Hawaiian vacation outfit complete with sunglasses. He listlessly took a chilled natural coconut water to his lips, took a deep sip, then exhaled deeply, reveling in the pleasure.
“Should we go to Hawaii in July?”
The idea of global travel, which once sounded supremely luxurious, now seemed mundane to them. If they desired, they could reach any corner of the globe in a short amount of time using their sleds.
That included commercially famous destinations like Hawaiian beaches or natural sites such as a certain canyon.
But the reason they chose not to go was that June was simply not a suitable month to be out and about; the rules of June required them to maintain an extremely standard daily routine.
Time zones had been unified across the globe, so when it was 6 a.m. in the eastern hemisphere, it was also 6 a.m. in the western hemisphere.
However, daylight hadn’t been unified.
Which is to say that players in the other hemisphere had to go to sleep and eat according to the unified time this month, regardless of whether it was daylight; if the time was nine in the evening, they had to prepare for bed.
For players in some regions, this was initially uncomfortable, but they gradually got used to it.
After all, human adaptability is among the best in the animal kingdom, and such setbacks couldn’t even be called significant hardships.
Still, they had turned the rooftop of their apartment complex into a vacation paradise, where they would come up to enjoy life whenever they had nothing else to do. They hadn’t asked anyone’s permission, but then again, no one tried to stop them.
Perhaps it was because they didn’t like conflict and loved peace, or maybe just out of pure fear of death.
“We’ll see when the time comes,”
Chen Yi lay on a sun lounger next to him, also under an umbrella and wearing sunglasses, lazily enjoying the gentle breeze, “Let’s first see what the rules for July are.”
The end of June in Yancheng brought blistering hot days.
All electrical appliances, including air conditioners, had been thoroughly switched off, as there was no electricity supply anymore; now, the only way to cool down in Yancheng was through props, some of which had cooling effects.
Like their air conditioning unit.
The effect was quite good – they had bought it from another player for more than two thousand Points.
“I hope the rules for July will be more player-friendly,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, lying on the sun lounger, lit a cigarette with some irritation and put it to his lips, “June’s rules were truly too perverse. Although I know having meals three times a day and going to bed at dusk and rising at dawn are good habits, strictly adhering to this schedule for an entire month is indeed torturous.”
“It’s nothing for those who strictly follow this routine on a daily basis, but for us, it’s a bit too much to bear.”
“The May rule ’No ghosts in mind’ continued for two months, and the limitation of this rule will also end at the beginning of July.”
“That means in July, only the rule of that month applies, with May’s and June’s rules becoming invalid, which should give many players a sigh of relief.”
“There aren’t any holidays in July, right?”
According to the features of this game, every holiday is accompanied by a limited-time event.
Such as 520, Father’s Day, Children’s Day, and so on.
“July.”
Chen Yi furrowed his brows in thought for a moment before he began to search the forums, “July doesn’t have any highly renowned holidays. The only moderately famous holiday is July 11, which is Maritime Day.”
“But it’s relatively low-profile, so the chances of there being a holiday-specific event are quite small.”
“There probably won’t be any holiday-specific events in July.”
Holiday-specific events in the game thus far have centered around well-known holidays like 520 or Children’s Day, with lesser-known holidays not being chosen.
“However, August and September have several holidays, including Qixi Festival, Teacher’s Day, and Mid-Autumn Festival – these well-known holidays are likely to have exclusive limited events.”
“I’ve just seen in the forums that some people are already buying props related to teachers, mooncakes, and family reunions, which seems like preparation for the upcoming months.”
“With several months to go, they’re really getting their preparations underway.”
“Is that so?”
After stretching a long stretch in the sun lounger, Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with a hint of drowsiness, “This weather really makes it hard not to feel sleepy. Speaking of which, Sword Without End has been in Hell for quite a while now and hasn’t returned.”
“He hasn’t become unable to return, has he?”
“That shouldn’t be the case. His strength is still commendable. After all, he was able to inflict nearly five-digit damage on the world boss. His abilities are not to be underestimated.”
“Maybe not the second in the world, but certainly invincible to most people.”
“He’s probably still in Hell, searching for his wife. That’s really quite romantic.”
Today was the last day of June, and the two of them had no plans to leave the city to hunt monsters but had given themselves a day off instead, lying on the sun loungers and basking in the sunlight.
Time slipped away by the minute.
People say time is precious, but sometimes squandering time can bring a strong sense of pleasure, especially if it doesn’t lead to guilt.
Time slowly arrived at 21:00 on the last day of June, with the rules of June still in effect.
And there were less than 3 hours left until July.
…
ps: There will be two more chapters later tonight. I need to modify the setup for July’s rules and meticulously design the new gameplay. If you have any good suggestions for July’s rules and the new game features for July, feel free to leave them in the comments section so I can take note.

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 159 - 157: July Rules Descend.
chapters.content:
Chapter 159 – 157: July Rules Descend.
Most players had already fallen into slumber, preparing to wake up at 23:30 to listen to the July rules and make corresponding preparations.
The June rules stipulated that players must be asleep between “21:00” and “22:00”.
However, Chen Yi and his companion didn’t sleep, sitting in their house patiently waiting for the advent of the July rules.
Clearly, they were violating the June rules.
But every player had three chances to violate the June rules without consequence, and they still had two opportunities. Since it was the last day and unused chances would be wasted anyway, they simply decided to go against the June rules and await the July rules.
Tonight was sure to be a sleepless one.
Many players who had violated the June rules stood by their windows with complex expressions, gazing at the moonlight with trepidation, awaiting the July rules.
Numerous players without any tolerance chances left could only sleep, but even in their dreams, they were preoccupied with the July rules, dreaming about them.
There were also plenty of players who looked at their clocks frantically and anxiously; in a few hours, the May rules would no longer be in effect!
They wouldn’t have to worry about dying from thinking about ghosts anymore!
This rule, hanging over their heads like the sword of Damocles, was finally about to disappear. They would no longer have to live in constant fear every single day!
Finally… the time slowly reached midnight.
A notification sound abruptly echoed in all players’ ears.
“Game Update Announcement!”
“The new Blue Star 4.3 version will begin a non-stop update at 00:00 on July 1st, and the main content and adjustments of this update are as follows.”
“1. Fixed a bug where some players began to develop plasma weapons after firearms and electromagnetic weapons were prohibited. Effective immediately, all kinetic weapons including firearms, electromagnetic weapons, and plasma weapons are banned.”
“2. Fixed bugs on some maps, including the following:
…*Fixed a bug on the ’Bizarre Land’ map where players could encounter a boss with gastroenteritis who would refuse to battle in the fifth stage*…
…*Fixed a bug at ’Pirate Castle’ where pirates would often oversleep, ignoring players’ break-ins*…
…*$%##%$#%%#*…”
“3. Added a ’Couples’ feature—starting from July, players will be able to authenticate their couple status, accessing couples-exclusive maps, completing couples-exclusive quests, shopping at couples-exclusive stores, and learning couples-exclusive skills.
Once a player purchases a ring from the Points shop, they can propose to any player of the opposite gender. If the other party accepts, they will become a couple.
The rings are priced in four tiers:
999 Points, 9,999 Points, 99,900 Points, 999,900 Points.
Different priced rings offer different levels of couple effects.
For now, same-sex, beastfolk, human-NPC, cross-dimensional, and other non-heterosexual human couple authentications are not supported.”
“4. Introduced a ’Squad’ feature—starting from July, players can obtain ’Squad Creation Orders’ through various ways such as purchases from the Points shop or as loot on maps.
The maximum squad capacity is 10 people.
After forming a squad, members will have access to an exclusive squad voice chat channel, squad shop, squad warehouse, and real-time status analytics for teammates, among other functions.
Squads start at Level 1.
The squad leader can unlock exclusive squad maps to lead their team to higher scores and level up their squad, thereby gaining more squad privileges and surprise rewards.
Furthermore, the ’Global Squad Leaderboard’ will officially launch, ranking squads worldwide based on their level.”
“5. Introduced a ’Guild’ feature—starting from July, players can acquire the precious ’Guild Creation Order’ prop through rare means, such as map drops.
Upon establishing a guild, members will have access to an exclusive guild voice chat channel, guild warehouse, and as the guild levels up, the ability for a one-click summon of guild members, or to conquer land and erect their own Guild Territory.
There are also exclusive functions such as posting guild quests, defeating guild-exclusive bosses, entering guild-exclusive maps, and more.
Guilds start at Level 1.
Guild leaders can level up their guilds through contributions to the guild warehouse, Points for experience, leading members through guild maps, killing guild bosses, defeating other guilds in guild battles, and more.
The ’Global Guild Leaderboard’ will also officially launch, ranking guilds worldwide based on their level.”
“6. Fully launched the ’Player Main City’ feature—with a total of 678 main cities worldwide, inside which players can take on main city quests among other functions. Non-main city players cannot take on main city quests, but have more opportunities to enter secretive areas of the map.”
“7. Introduced the July rules: ’No Smoking’ and ’Rejecting Love’.
’No Smoking’: All players are prohibited from smoking indoors. For the purpose of this rule, any space that doesn’t have the sky as its ceiling is defined as indoors.
For the first three violations, each will result in a deduction of 1,000 Points.
Upon the fourth violation, the offender will die.
’Rejecting Love’: All players are prohibited from expressing love, including but not limited to phrases like ’I love you’ and ’The moonlight is beautiful tonight’, whether explicit or implied. The judgement will depend on the player’s inner emotions when speaking, and the system will determine accordingly.
For the first three violations, each will result in a deduction of 1,000 Points.
Upon the fourth violation, the offender will die.
If there are insufficient Points for deduction, the offender will die immediately.
The July rules will last for a month and become invalid at 0:00 on August 1st.”
“The Snow Sea Project Team wishes all players a joyful gaming experience in version 4.3.”
“ps: In our next update, the project team has decided to introduce a monthly rule about the ’battle’ element. Please look forward to it, everyone.”
This announcement echoed in the ears of all players simultaneously.
Even those who were asleep woke up because of it.
“No smoking and rejecting love?”
Chen Yi, deep in thought, looked at the long pop-up notification panel in front of him and nodded, raising an eyebrow, “Isn’t that two rules? Are there two rules for July?”
“That’s an understandable perspective.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting beside him, took out a cigarette and put it in his mouth, “Trains can be delayed, bullet trains can be delayed, love can be delayed, and so can web novel authors.”
“Animals can have twins, humans can have twins, so it’s perfectly normal for the July rules to have twins. It’s completely understandable.”
“However, the July rules seem to be an epic nerf for me.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t light the cigarette in his mouth but just kept it there, his face showing a complex expression as he looked up at the ceiling, “Not allowed to smoke indoors? What a ridiculous rule!”
“Not even as good as the rules from April or May.”
“Yi, would you mind if we make a hole in the roof?”
“We’re on the 13th floor of a 29-floor building. If we drill a straight hole from the roof of the 13th floor to the 29th floor, it would not only ventilate but also bring in daylight, which would be great.”
Chen Yi didn’t reply but turned his attention to the “Squad Creation Order” in the Points store.
’Prop Name’: Squad Creation Order.
’Prop Level’: None.
’Prop Effect’: The owner can create a squad that holds a maximum of 10 players and act as the captain.
’Prop Description’: “Unity does not necessarily mean strength, but at least it gives you the courage to struggle when faced with crisis.”
’Prop Price’: 1000 Points.
The price of the prop isn’t cheap; it’s a full 1000 Points. Not to exaggerate, but about 70-80% of people worldwide probably can’t afford it.
Although there are indeed a lot more ways to earn Points, a person’s energy per day is limited—once used up, it’s gone. Spending an entire day’s effort, one could at most earn fifty to sixty Points.
Spend a little on food or buy a prop, and basically, all those Points are gone.
Generally, it’s hard to save up.
Unless one encounters special adventures, like gaining a large amount of Points on a certain map, accidentally entering a map and getting a decent rating, or getting special rewards in a limited-time event, ordinary methods like completing tasks in the Player Main City or venturing outside the city to kill monsters would let most people earn only about 100 Points after a hard day’s work.
If you wish to quickly earn a large number of Points.
Maps are naturally a good means. As long as you get a good rating inside a map, you’ll generally receive a hefty Points reward.
But the problem is, there are basically two ways to enter a map.
Obtaining a Map Access Pass or seeking out a map entrance in the wild.
The first requires both chance and Points. An Access Pass is not an extremely rare prop, but it’s also not that easy to obtain. The second requires luck and is fraught with many unknown risks in the wild.
After all, the 520 gift package for 88 Points isn’t available all the time; if you’re lucky, a single package like that could get you off the ground.
Whether it’s either method, they aren’t easily accessible to the average person. Even if one is lucky enough to find a map entrance, the crises inside the map usually far exceed those posed by monsters outside the city.
The question is whether you can make it out alive, let alone obtain a large reward inside the map.
The price of 1000 Points itself means that this prop wasn’t designed for the average person.
Of course, for Chen Yi, saying that the price is a drop in the bucket might be an exaggeration, but calling it a small matter shouldn’t be too big a problem.
Without much hesitation, he purchased the prop.
’Ding, you have spent 1000 Points to purchase a ’Squad Creation Order’.”
’Would you like to use it?’
“Yes!”
’Ding, you have successfully created a squad with yourself as the leader. You are the captain of this squad, possessing more privileges than your members. Please name your squad.’
Sitting on the sofa with squinted eyes, Chen Yi began to ponder what to name his squad.
“How about ’Night Walkers’ for the name?”
As soon as the topic of naming came up, Tuberculosis Rabbit got excited and stood up with enthusiasm, “The name sounds mysterious and intimidating. Or how about ’Heavenly Court’?”
“Brocade Army seems pretty good too.”
“…”
Chen Yi gave Tuberculosis Rabbit an amused look, and after seriously pondering for a moment, he decisively said.
“Let’s call it, ’Rabbits Do Not Kill’!”

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 160 - 158: "Art Piece: The Slumbering Sword Without End.
chapters.content:
Chapter 160 – 158: “Art Piece: The Slumbering Sword Without End.
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully establishing the 18th squad in the world, named ’Rabbits Do Not Kill!’”
“…”
“Ding, Chen Yi invites you to join the squad ’Rabbits Do Not Kill!’. Do you accept?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked expressionlessly at the system prompt in front of him and remained silent for a long time without speaking.
After a long, long while, he spoke softly.
“Yi, I can understand that you think the name I chose is too tacky, and that’s completely understandable.”
“But, Yi, do you really think the name you picked for the squad sounds good?”
“When we appear on the global squad rankings in the future, this name will definitely be embarrassing.”
“Embarrassing?”
Chen Yi shook his head seriously: “You lack a bit of aesthetic sense; this squad name might seem a bit nonsensical at first glance, but if you read it carefully twice, you will appreciate its unique charm.”
“Alright, enough talk, let’s see what this squad is good for.”
He then carefully looked over his squad panel.
’Squad Name’: Rabbits Do Not Kill.
Explore stories on
’Squad Level’: lv.1
’Current Features’: Squad chat channel, real-time status check of squad members.
’Promotion Requirements’: All squad members must collectively possess 3 C-Rank props, 10 D-Rank props, 3 C-Rank skills, any one prop with +12 enhancement or above, and clear 1 Squad-Exclusive D-Rank Map.
Currently, the squad only had these two features. The first feature was straightforward, while the second feature was mostly useless in most cases; it just let you see the green and red dots on the right upper corner of squad members, so you clearly know if your teammates are alive or dead.
As for more detailed status.
For example, whether your squad members are injured or how serious their injuries are, this was completely undetectable.
Only the status of life and death was discernible.
It was like the life tokens in xianxia novels.
As for the promotion conditions, they sounded somewhat complex, but they had already met most of these requirements and even exceeded them significantly.
The requirement for C-Rank props and C-Rank skills were all met; the only condition not yet fulfilled was clearing a Squad-Exclusive D-Rank Map once.
This promotion criteria was a collective total of all the members’ props and skills.
For a typical squad, theoretically, the more members there were, the easier it should be to fulfill the promotion conditions.
The ’Global Squad Ranking’ was still empty at the moment, not a single squad had been listed, as they were all in the initial state. Presumably, only when a squad advanced first would it be able to claim the top spot on the global squad ranking.
As for the ’Global Guild Ranking’, not a single guild existed either. Unlike ’Squad Creation Order’ which could be directly purchased in the Points store, ’Guild Creation Order’ had no direct sales channel.
But the existence of a Guild Creation Order inevitably meant that some forces with weak cohesion before would organize more clearly and have stronger cohesion and team execution.
Chen Yi squinted his eyes as he looked at the squad map in front of him, deep in thought and remaining silent.
Unlike normal maps requiring a pass or walking to the map entrance to enter, squad maps appeared one by one in the squad map panel based on map difficulty from lowest to highest.
In front of him, the squad map panel displayed a dense array of map previews, but almost all of them were greyed out and not viewable, except for three E-Rank maps.
’Map Name’: Tetris.
’Map Synopsis’: Don’t ever think this is a map for playing a single-player video game.
…
’Map Name’: Human Centipede Version of Snake Game.
’Map Synopsis’: We are willing to give some rewards to players with big hearts.
…
’Map Name’: Night Widow Village.
’Map Synopsis’: Try your luck. As you carry a lantern towards a dim village, guess whether the door will be opened for you by a full-figured widow or a ghost draped in human skin.
…
For now, he could only view these 3 maps, all E-Rank. Each map had just a cover, a name, and a map synopsis that didn’t reveal much information.
According to the prompt,
you only needed to complete one E-Rank map to unlock D-Rank maps.
Clearing any D-Rank map would allow his squad to level up successfully and gain more squad features.
There was also a separate squad leaderboard behind each map, ranking all squads based on their best performance in that map.
After pondering for a moment, Chen Yi selected the third map as the first E-Rank map they would venture into.
“Let’s go, Tuberculosis Rabbit, let’s take a look in the squad map.”
“Alright.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed helplessly: “Although I still find it hard to accept this squad name, who am I to argue when you’re the boss? But it’s just the two of us in our squad right now, right?”
“Isn’t two enough?”
“Well, it’s enough.”
“Ding, the leader of the squad ’Rabbits Do Not Kill,’ Chen Yi, has chosen to enter the E-Rank map ’Night Widow Village.’ Each player in the squad must submit 2000 Points as a deposit.”
“Successful clearance will result in the deposit being returned; failure to leave will result in the forfeiture of the deposit.”
“Please prepare, the teleportation will begin after 1 minute.”
“Eh?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with a hint of surprise, “This squad map is quite interesting. If you fail to clear it, it only deducts 2000 Points instead of wiping you out or something. It sounds like the risk would be much lower.”
“With such low cost, it should attract quite a number of squads to try.”
Not long after these words fell,
a flash of white light signalled their teleportation.
Yancheng had carefully considered the choice of this map.
The first one, the Tetris E-rank map, sounded like a map with an uncertain purpose, one from which you couldn’t infer any information about its content.
The second map, the Human Centipede Version of Snake Game, by its name and the brief introduction, you could easily guess that it wasn’t a map a normal person would choose, so it was immediately passed over.
As for the third map, it sounded somewhat supernaturally thrilling, but for him and the Tuberculosis Rabbit, one fearless and the other with nerves of steel, the scariest parts of this thriller map were not an issue, which meant the difficulty plummeted for them.
Under these circumstances, the third map was naturally the best choice.
…
July 1st, around 00:30 A.M.
It had been about 30 minutes since the rules of July came into effect. Everyone had read through all the regulations for July and had started to revel.
Screams sounded with reckless abandon in the skies above Yancheng!
Many players hid in their rooms, enjoying the freedom of their own minds!
Some rushed into the bathroom, stared at their own reflections in the mirror, and roared viciously, shouting Ghost, Ghost, Ghost, I’m the ghost, come and kill me if you dare, I just love ghosts!
Others turned on the TV in the living room, watching horror movies with excited laughs, challenging, if you have the guts, come out and finish me!
Some stuck their heads under their beds, looking at the empty space and swearing angrily, Come on out, come out, you know how I’ve lived through these months, why don’t you come out now? Face me directly!
And then there were those who found ways to dress up as ghosts and ran amok in the streets at midnight, shouting with glee, clearly in the mood for an early Halloween celebration.
These past few months, all the players had suffered. They had to keep tense, not daring to relax for a moment, not allowing themselves to think about ghosts or any specific rules regarding them.
Now, they were finally free.
Everyone was indulging in the freedom of thought, like those watching horror movies, who actually had no interest in that genre at all; it was purely vengeful watching.
It was just like a vengeful obsession with ghosts after being banned for two months.
It wasn’t that people wanted to see ghosts.
They just wanted to release all the pressure from the past two months and let their brains construct images of ghosts in their minds without any restraints.
Soon enough, a number of players discovered that even though they could try to recklessly conjure images of ghosts in their minds now, they suddenly realized they seemed to lack the ability to do so.
Completely incapable of constructing any image…
