And not too long after Yancheng and his people entered the map, an angry roar suddenly erupted inside the house, “Tuberculosis Rabbit, are you freaking insane?!”
…
Sword Without End, just returned from hell and relieved to find himself still in Yancheng’s room, breathed a sigh of relief, which meant his body was still intact and undamaged.
But right after, he sensed something wrong.
Why was his point of view standing up? He should be lying in a cryo-coffin, shouldn’t he? His first sight upon opening his eyes should have been the ceiling or a closed coffin lid. Why was it the room?
The next second—
he understood his situation.
Both his hands and feet were shackled, and the chains were nailed to the wall. His body was posed in the manner of the Thinker statue by Rodin, affixed to the wall.
He was firmly fixed on the wall.
Sword Without End struggled to twist his head around and survey his surroundings, noticing a circle of mahogany frame that enclosed him.
In the bottom right corner, there was a small wooden plaque.
A few lines were written clearly on it.
“Artwork: The Slumbering Sword Without End.”
“Art Anchor Point: Art needs to be appreciated with sensibility. When your thoughts begin to wander, that’s when you can clearly experience the charisma emanating from the artwork.
When a corpse lies here and might resurrect at any moment, it exists in a superposition of life and death. None of us can predict which state will collapse first. While both states coexist, we can comprehend the fragility of life’s end and the wonder of its inception through the appreciation of this artwork.”
“Artist: Mr. Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
This allowed him to thoroughly understand his situation; his corpse was actually turned into an art piece by Tuberculosis Rabbit and hung on the wall, even framed with a mahogany border.
Below was a wooden plaque introducing the artwork and its maker!
He had never imagined that a trip down to hell would lead to his return as an art piece!
Thankfully, he came back early. He had no doubt that if he had returned even later, he might have ended up on display in some art exhibition for the public to view.
Now, fully aware of his predicament, Sword Without End couldn’t help but burst into laughter at the absurdity of Tuberculosis Rabbit’s actions.
What kind of brain circuitry does this brother have, like an earthworm?
This shit’s pure insanity, isn’t it?! Ah?!
I asked you to take care of my body, not to frame it and hang it on the wall!
Hanging a corpse on the wall, aren’t you creeped out by that when you sleep?

chapters.title: Chapter 161: 159: "You're a widow, aren't you?
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 159: “You’re a widow, aren’t you?
“Ding, ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team, has successfully entered the E-level map ‘Night Widow Village’. Below are the specific map rules; please read them carefully.”
With a flash of white light.
The two had appeared before a village at dusk.
It’s getting dark within the map, the sun had set, and the moon had risen; the pitch-black sky didn’t have a single star to embellish it, creating an extremely oppressive feeling.
They stood at the entrance of the village, before them lay a stone bridge covered with moss. The water flowing beneath emitted a faint fishy odor; looking past the bridge, they could see the village ahead.
All were single-story houses, not even one had a second floor.
Nestled amidst a forest of leafless trees, these branches trembled slightly in the night wind, and at first glance seemed like grimacing specters sneering at them.
The air was eerily quiet, only the occasional crow’s caw prevented it from being deathly still.
“Map content”: This is a forgotten village, consisting of 13 households. All the men from these families had gone out to work and only the women were left behind.
But after a long, long time, not one man returned home, and eventually, all these women became widows, earning the village the name Widow Village, home to 13 widows.
However, at some unknown time, the village began to be invaded by ghosts. Some of the widows were slowly replaced by these ghosts until your arrival; there was only one normal widow left in the village, with the remaining 12 replaced by ghosts.
Your task is to find that one normal widow.
“Map rules”:
1: There is no discernible difference between widows and ghosts in appearance; only when you remove their clothing can you see a clear difference.
Underneath their clothing, a widow has a full-bodied figure, whereas a ghost has a ghastly mass of gory flesh.
2: Before ghosts reveal their identity, they will significantly lower their attack and defensive power to camouflage themselves. Once their identity is exposed, they will unleash their full strength.
3: All widows bathe at midnight.
4: Ghosts will never turn their backs to you.
5: When you believe you’ve found the real widow, you can say to her, “You’re the widow, right?” If you’re correct, you’ll pass the level successfully; if you’re wrong, you’ll fail.
6: If you don’t clear the map before dawn, you’ll be deemed to have failed.
7: You will earn additional points for every ghost you kill. The speed of completion, the player’s inner SAN value, and other data will also affect the map’s score in various ways.
“Good luck to the players.”
“It’s so beautiful.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood at the entrance, gazing dreamily at the village in front of him, murmuring, “Yi, do you remember how we once wanted to buy a piece of land in the village to build such a house and live the rural life? Unfortunately, the land there wasn’t for sale.”
“People in the countryside always dream of buying a house in the city, to live in the big city.”
“And those in the city yearn to run to the countryside, to live in the village.”
“In the end, neither side can make the switch, kind of like a siege.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi casually said a word, not really talking but rather looking at his personal panel. The time inside this map was the same as the outside world; it was thirty minutes past midnight.
Taking seven o’clock dawn as the reference, they had less than seven hours left in this map.
Just based on the map rules, the most obvious way for players to clear the map would be to find a way to peek at the widows bathing to determine whether or not they were ghosts, of course, there would likely be some hitches along the way.
However, he had misunderstood something earlier.
Indeed, failing the map didn’t pose a threat to life, only deducting 2000 Points, but that didn’t mean one wouldn’t die within the map; when those ghosts reveal themselves and bring out their full strength, there’s a good chance they could directly kill the player inside the map.
Just by looking at the current map rules, it was very advantageous for him.
The only uncertainty was how many layers of clothing the supposed widows would be wearing in this map. If they wore only one layer, his sniper rifle’s enchantment abilities would allow him to easily determine whether the other party was a real widow. But if they wore more, there would be no way to tell.
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yi didn’t ponder too much on the spot and instead strode across the stone bridge into the village.
“Right behind you. Oh, Yi, my Title Effect just kicked in, said there’s some additional information about the map.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit quickly followed up.
“Title Name”: True Plot Detective.
“Extra Information”: When you accept an invitation from the real widow to sleep with her, you will become the widow’s husband and be forced to remain in this map for one year.
That was the Title Effect he earned in ‘Life Theater’. Upon entering a map, he would receive a piece of hidden information about that map.
“Yeah, got it.”
Chen Yi replied nonchalantly.
Anyone seeing the scene before them would feel a tinge of fear in their heart, but he was born fearless, naturally lacking any sense of terror.
As for Tuberculosis Rabbit… He had an exceptionally strong heart.
What would seem like a horrifying scene to others became a beautiful depiction of rural life through Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes; it would be odd if he felt any sense of horror.
Soon, they arrived at the front door of the first house and knocked three times.
A woman dressed in a silk nightgown opened the door with a seductively flirtatious face, leaning against the door frame as she looked at Chen Yi and his companion, biting her lips and whispering softly, “There are no men at home, you two aren’t bad people, are you? A little woman like me couldn’t possibly resist.”
Chen Yi lightly raised an eyebrow, his lips curling slightly upward.
It seemed this map was quite a bit easier, which made sense, after all, it was just an E-level map, so the difficulty wouldn’t be too challenging.
His walking stick had a prop effect that allowed him to see through one layer of obstruction while leaning on it. Under this prop effect, he easily saw through the woman’s nightgown to the bloody, mangled flesh on her abdomen—a ghostly creature without a doubt.
He couldn’t be bothered to engage in much dialogue with the specter, gently tapping the ground instead.
The next second—
A bullet shot out from the bottom of the walking stick, burrowing into the ground and erupting from beneath the woman’s feet, straight for the crown of her head!
The woman, who had moments ago been draped in allure, didn’t even have time to react before her gaze began to dim, falling heavily to the floor with a face full of unwillingness.
‘Ding, you have successfully killed a ghost posing as a widow.’
“Let’s go, on to the next house.”
“That’s it? So easy.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit propped his arms behind his head with a hint of boredom, “Bring on some more challenging maps. My Red Moon Claw Knife has been charged for quite a while now, I even think I could slice Yancheng in half with a single cut.”
“I really want to see the effects.”
Chen Yi didn’t speak but turned and walked away toward the next house.
After the ghost disguised as a woman died, the previously pristine decorations inside the house slowly dissipated like a fantasy, with dense cobwebs covering the cornered skeletons in the room.
Less than ten minutes later,
Chen Yi had cleared out all the ghosts posing as widows, leaving the real widow for last. In fact, they had found the real widow by the fourth house they visited but didn’t stop and left right away.
Killing ghosts provided an additional score bonus for the map, and naturally, they wanted to achieve a high map score. After clearing all the ghosts, they circled back to the front door of the genuine widow.
He looked at the real widow and said softly,
“You’re the widow, right?”
The woman in the nightgown in front of him froze for a moment, a flicker of joy flashing through her pupils as she looked up at Chen Yi and his companion, “Thank you. I can feel that you’ve killed all those filthy things, and the village has regained its peace from days past.”
“It’s a pity my sisters can’t come back.”
“I want to give you a reward.”
“Just don’t know what you need.”
‘Ding, congratulations to the “Rabbits Do Not Kill” team for completing the hidden mission—killing all the ghosts and leaving only the real widow alive, thereby earning a reward from the widow.’
‘1: To spend a night in precious springtime company, the true widow before you will accompany all members of the team to sleep beneath the same quilt until dawn.’
‘2: Many disputes lie at the widow’s front door, and you will receive a prop reward of unknown grade.’
‘3: Richly adorned, begging along the way, the widow will bestow upon you a certain amount of Points as a reward.’
‘Please, Captain “Chen Yi,” make your choice.’
This was a hidden reward for achieving the hidden mission, obtained within the map.
As the woman in front of him spoke, the strap of her nightgown seemed to slip unintentionally a bit, revealing a fragrant and smooth shoulder. The nightgown drooped at her bosom, implying that with just a bit more sliding down, one could feast on an infinite spring scenery.
It was like the sea breeze one senses before seeing the ocean; even without witnessing the sea, just by smelling the breeze, one could imagine the sea’s magnificent vastness.
Her pitiful look made one unable to resist the urge to hold her tightly in their arms and squeeze firmly.
Gone was some of the charm, but surged a sense of protectiveness.
Chen Yi calmly glanced at the woman before him and then at the reward panel, choosing the second reward option without much hesitation—an unknown grade prop reward.
It was clear that this woman wasn’t a ghost, but she wasn’t anything good either.
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s title made it clear this map held a hidden detail—if one accepted the real widow’s invitation to sleep and spent a night of springtime pleasure, they would become the widow’s husband and be forced to remain in the map for a full year.
What sort of reward was that?
It was a trap within the rewards.
As for the third reward of Points, he wasn’t exactly short on Points, and a few thousand more wouldn’t be of much use to him, especially not in an E-level map which likely wouldn’t offer tens or hundreds of thousands of Points.
The unknown grade prop, on the other hand, was quite attractive to him.
“Alright then.”
As if discerning Chen Yi’s choice, the widow standing at the door glanced at him with some reproach, appearing to complain about his lack of romantic flair. Afterward, she bent down slowly in front of Chen Yi and his companion.
She pulled out the threshold of the door and handed it to Chen Yi.
“I’m giving this to you. Anyhow, I’m very grateful to you for restoring peace and tranquility to this village.”
“Thank you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 162: 160: "Daring to smoke, aren't you aware that smoking is completely banned in July?
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 160: “Daring to smoke, aren’t you aware that smoking is completely banned in July?
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded slightly, stuffed the threshold he was holding into his backpack, and prepared to take a closer look once he left the map.
Meanwhile, the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s breathing had become somewhat rapid. Looking at the widow standing straight in front of him, his eyes were slightly red. Initially, he didn’t feel much, but when the widow bent over in front of him just now, it was somewhat unbearable.
The nightgown was made of silk and very loose.
Bending down, it left almost nothing to the imagination.
He had seen everything that was supposed to be seen—and even what wasn’t.
Right at that moment—
Accompanied by a flash of white light before their eyes, a prompt sounded in both of their ears.
“Ding, congratulations to the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team for successfully clearing the E-class map, Night Widow Village.”
“Now beginning map evaluation.”
“Map evaluation: 100% perfection rating. You killed all the ghosts within seventeen minutes and found the real widow. Your speed and efficiency in clearing the map are worthy of this rating.”
“Map Reward: 100% Rating Reward—8000 Points, D-class Prop Chest*2, Special Reward Widow’s Threshold*1.”
“PS: Map scores range from 1% to 100%. The first team to clear a map will always receive a 100% rating, which is the initial perfect score.
Subsequent team scores will be based on the rating of this first team.
If another team later scores higher than this first team, their rating will be 100% and will become the new standard for the perfect score.
Future team ratings will be scored based on the new standard set by that team.”
When the prompt concluded, the two were transported back to their own rental homes.
“A 100% rating, huh?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke thoughtfully, “If it’s this kind of scoring mechanism, then theoretically, the earlier you enter a new map, the easier it is to obtain a better rating.”
The mechanism was simple.
When few people enter a map, a perfect score might be 10 points, but as more people enter, it could become 100 points.
If you get 5 points when few people have entered, it translates to a 50% map rating.
But if you get 5 points when many people have entered, it only equals a 5% map rating.
The same score, but different percentage ratings, due to different standards of a perfect score.
Chen Yi didn’t speak but looked towards the special reward he had obtained from the map, a D-class prop.
“Prop Name”: Widow’s Threshold.
“Prop Level”: D-class prop.
“Prop Effect”: Place this prop at the entrance of a building, and any life form with carnal desires will be unable to cross the threshold and enter.
“Prop Introduction”: “I am a wandering Taoist, roaming the world. One day, after receiving poor treatment from the brothel madam, I placed this prop at the entrance of her establishment—a wandering blind Taoist.”
A rule-based prop.
Under most circumstances, it wouldn’t be of much use, as it only prevents entry through the door, not through windows, roofs, walls, underground, etc.
Moreover, it has a high prerequisite—it affects only lifeforms with carnal desires.
But in certain special cases, it could be quite useful.
For example…
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes, beginning to ponder how to maximize the use of this prop.
And just then—
The Tuberculosis Rabbit noticed there was one more person in the room and, somewhat surprised, turned his head towards Sword Without End, who sat on the couch smoking, “You’re back? When did you get back?”
“…”
Sword Without End remained expressionless and unresponsive, not even glancing at the Tuberculosis Rabbit. Instead, he turned his head towards Chen Yi: “Yi, I’ve done all the things you asked me to do.”
“Those people you mentioned are all thoroughly dead.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded and walked to the front of the couch, stood opposite the coffee table looking at the two extinguished cigarette butts in the ashtray, then at the one Sword Without End was holding, nearly burnt out. He was silent for a while before saying softly,
“That’s quite an expensive smoke, 1000 Points a stick.”
“Ah?”
Sword Without End was taken aback, a bit bewildered, “What do you mean? These cigarettes aren’t expensive, they’re from the pre-cataclysm era; they don’t cost Points.”
“That’s not what I mean.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a look of realization squatting in front of the coffee table, staring at the two butts in the ashtray, remarked, “Didn’t you see the July rules when you came back? Even if you didn’t check the rules, shouldn’t you have received a system prompt?”
“Is it already July?”
A flicker of shock passed through Sword Without End’s eyes as he hastily browsed his unread notifications: “I didn’t know; the map I was revived on had days that felt very long, and I lost track of time.”
Soon, he saw the three system prompts for smoking deductions of 1000 Points each.
As well as the July rule—No Smoking.
“…”
Sword Without End looked down at the cigarette in his hand about to burn out and then glanced up at the ceiling before muttering.
“So, you’re saying that I’ve used up my three chances?”
“If I smoke again indoors in July, I’ll just drop dead on the spot?”
“That’s correct.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up, hands in pockets, and clicked his tongue, “You’ve got guts, smoking when there’s a total ban in July.”
“No worries.”
Although Sword Without End was somewhat grieved about losing 3000 Points, he quickly recovered, “As long as I don’t smoke indoors in July, it’s fine. It just means I have no room for error now.”
“It’s still a bit tough to come back from down there.”
“Even with my strength, it’s somewhat troublesome, not to mention regular players.”
“Resurrecting from hell, for the average player, is like the carrot dangling in front of a tethered donkey: visible but unattainable.”
“Luck and strength, you can’t lack either.”
“Moreover, if it’s the second death, the difficulty of resurrection doubles.”
“Let’s go up and chat.”
Chen Yi took the lead and walked towards the door.
…
On the rooftop, under the night sky.
Chen Yi dismantled the sunshade on the roof, sat down on a beach chair, lit a cigarette, and looked towards Sword Without End as he casually opened his mouth and asked, “So, have you found your wife?”
“No.”
Sword Without End spoke in a somewhat depressed tone, “Only players who died after the game update appear on the map. My wife is not in hell.”
“I had thought of this possibility before.”
“But facing it for real is still a bit upsetting. The hope that had just risen is now shattered.”
“I really miss my wife. I really want to take her to see the auroras at the Antarctic, something I promised her.”
“That…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit started to speak with a strange expression, “I hate to remind you, but you might have just lost another 1000 Points. There are two rules for July: aside from the ban on smoking, there’s also a ban on expressing love.”
“Ah?”
Sword Without End was stunned for a moment, then scrutinized the rules for July again, looking somewhat distressed as he picked up a cigarette and fiercely put it to his mouth. Before lighting it, he made sure to confirm once more that the sky was overhead and there were no obstructions above.
Then he spoke, trying to suppress his anger.
“Fine, just deduct them. What kind of ridiculous rules are these?”
“I’m going back first. There are some things to take care of at home.”
“Sure.”
Chen Yi nodded.
As the words fell,
Sword Without End stepped onto the blade of Three-Foot Qingfeng and turned into a streak of light disappearing into the horizon.
…
“What a pity.”
Looking in the direction of Sword Without End’s departure, Tuberculosis Rabbit lay back on the lounge chair and said with a bit of regret, “Once Sword Without End wakes up, won’t my artwork be ruined?”
“Yi, you know me well. I actually really liked that piece of art.”
“I had to look at it several times a day in the living room.”
“And I put quite a bit of effort into making that artwork. Having it ruined like this really hurts.”
“Why don’t we just kill Sword Without End again?”
“…”
Chen Yi glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit disapprovingly, “Listen to yourself. Stop doing these unkind things. When Sword Without End dies on his own, I’ll find his corpse for you to frame on the wall.”
“That works.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement, “Looking at the situation, it shouldn’t take long. The allowance for mistakes in the July rules has almost been used up by Sword Without End. A smoker and lover like him won’t last long under July’s rules.”
“Smoking and confessing love at the same time; it’s hard to live even a few more days.”
“But Yi, I’m planning to go to the Silver Party Club to have some fun. That widow in the nightgown got me interested. Do you want to come along?”
“You go ahead, I won’t join,”
Chen Yi shook his head, declining Tuberculosis Rabbit’s invitation, “It’s fine to play with those things once in a while, but finding a girlfriend sooner is the right way.”
“Not happening.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head and walked to the edge of the rooftop with a serious look, “Forget about girlfriends. It’s better with these mask-wearing types; after the deed, no one owes anyone, and everyone goes their separate ways.”
“I can’t smoke inside the Silver Party Club; it’s indoor. I need to smoke a few more before entering.”
“These July rules don’t pose much risk; they’re just annoying. They’re too uncomfortable for an uncouth person like me.”
After several cigarettes.
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a Silver Party Ticket and activated right there, turning into white light and vanishing on the spot.
…
“Ladies and gentlemen!”
“Let us indulge in the ultimate pleasures brought by revelry on the first day of July without restraint!”
In the enormous ballroom, a host in a white suit was standing on stage, presiding over the progress of the party.
“Not bad.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in satisfaction and unbuttoned his shirt.
The lights gradually dimmed.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a gentleman’s gait, slowly approached a tall girl in a gown and mask, extending his hand with utmost chivalry, “Miss, may I have the honor of this dance with you?”
The girl, wearing high-heeled shoes, stood very upright, of equal height to Tuberculosis Rabbit.
She was clearly dressed up, having changed into a fancy gown that hugged her figure closely.
Seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit approaching,
The masked girl, eyes brimming with mirth, put up a finger and said softly with a smile,
“1000 Points for one night, dear.”

chapters.title: Chapter 163: 161: "Do you think I'm an ordinary person?
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 161: “Do you think I’m an ordinary person?
“…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had originally bent over in a gentlemanly fashion to extend an invitation, slightly stiffened. After a moment of silence, he straightened up emotionlessly to face the girl before him and calmly said.
“Miss, I didn’t catch your meaning. Could you please be more direct?”
“Of course.”
The girl seemed to have a good attitude. She leaned her head close to Tuberculosis Rabbit’s ear and whispered softly, “1000 Points for one night, the full package. Whatever you want, I’ve got it.”
“All you need to do is lay down, and I’ll take care of the rest.”
“I’m really good at it.”
The humid breath in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s ear didn’t arouse any desire in him; instead, it made him even colder.
“No thanks.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit calmly pushed the girl away and strode toward the other girls outside the venue.
What the hell!
They even charge for this!
Isn’t the Silver Party Club where everyone wears masks and as long as you like each other, that’s enough?
Why are there still people charging here?
He knew something was off about how elegantly this girl was dressed for a Silver Party, turns out she was a high-end product.
Ten minutes later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat on an empty sofa, staring at the fruit on the coffee table, his gaze distant and blank.
The morals of society have declined!
Times have changed!
All the girls here are charging now! It used to be free, but this time, not a single one came without a price—cheap ones a few hundred Points, expensive ones even over a thousand!
A few hundred Points… for an average player, that means killing monsters outside the city day and night for days to earn just one night.
He could afford the money.
But he didn’t want to spend money on this. It made him feel sullied. He preferred the old times when everyone came simply to blow off steam, without the complications of financial interests.
Just then—
A girl in a white dress and mask suddenly sat down next to him on the sofa in the dark, a hint of panic in her eyes, her voice trembling slightly as she whispered.
“Sir… do you want me?”
“1000 Points for one night. It’s my first time, so it’s a bit more expensive.”
Before she could finish speaking, sensing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s impatience, the girl hastily added, “If you think that’s too much, sir, 800 Points is also okay. The price is negotiable.”
“Get lost.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled his arm away from the girl with annoyance. As he was about to scold her, he caught sight of the tears in her eyes and paused, the swear words on the tip of his tongue held back.
After a moment, he muttered somewhat helplessly.
“What are you crying for?”
“I’ve killed more people than you’ve lined up eggs. If you think that’ll soften me up, you’re mistaken.”
“The thing I hate most is a woman’s tears, the nagging will drive me nuts.”
“Will 800 do?”
The girl didn’t leave; she just sat on the sofa, her eyes still wet with tears, but her voice was somewhat firm as she trembled, “Although it’s my first time, don’t worry, sir. I’ve watched videos to learn, and I’ll make sure you’re comfortable.”
“What the heck.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit heaved a sigh, leaned back on the sofa, and helplessly placed a hand on his forehead, “I speak so filthily, and it doesn’t faze you at all?”
“Look at you, I bet you’re about to say your father is sick and you’re just short of the 800 Points for treatment.”
“Do I look like someone who would fall for that?”
“Yes.”
“Where do I look like it? Tell me, I’ll change it.”
The girl didn’t speak any further but sat beside Tuberculosis Rabbit, clutching the corner of his clothes and looking up at him with her watery eyes.
“…”
After a moment of silence.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, feeling somewhat helpless, rested his feet on the coffee table, “Just give me a foot massage. If you do a good job, I’ll give you the 800 Points. You wouldn’t expect me to just hand over the Points for nothing, would you? That would be a total loss.”
“Forget about it for you, I’m not interested. You’re too skinny.”
“Also, don’t come to a place like this in the future. If you want to earn Points, there are other ways. Why come here of all places?”
“Damn it; I even told Sword Without End the routine was wrong last time, and now I’m wrong too.”
“So, your father really is sick? Did I guess right?”
“Yes.”
The girl kneeled on the floor, hope flickering through the tears in her eyes. She gently placed Tuberculosis Rabbit’s legs on the coffee table and cautiously began to massage them after taking off his shoes and socks.
“It’s not that he’s sick, but when my father was killing monsters outside the city, he accidentally entered the territory of a gang. They demanded 1000 Points to release him, or they wanted me to submit to the gang leader.”
“I didn’t want to submit to that villain. Hearing that one could make a lot of money at the Silver Party, I bought a Silver Party Ticket in hopes of earning 1000 Points tonight.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed, rubbing his forehead in frustration, “What a clichéd situation. But that’s still not enough if you only have 800. Why did you say the price was negotiable just now?”
“I was hoping to get 800 Points with you and then find someone willing to pay 200 in the second round.”
“Second round?”
“Those sisters told me that some people don’t want to spend money, so they keep waiting. When the Silver Party is about to end, and most of the guests have left, that’s when the price is really low. Those are the guests of the second round.”
“Fine.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit subconsciously took out a cigarette from his pocket and was about to put it into his mouth, but then he looked up at the banquet hall ceiling and silently put the cigarette back into his pocket and continued.
“Then why bother with all this?”
“I followed that gang boss, and came out… to do this, what’s the difference?”
“There is.”
The girl lowered her head, tears sparking in her eyes as she rubbed Tuberculosis Rabbit’s legs, her voice quivering slightly with a hint of crying, “That bastard wanted to sleep with me in front of my father, saying that would be more thrilling.”
“I’d rather sell myself than let my father witness that.”
“It’s all dirty anyway, but at least my father can’t see it.”
“If it happened in front of my father, even if I managed to save him, he would definitely go back and fight with those people again.”
“How can you be worse than me?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit frowned with some dissatisfaction and said, “I thought I was an animal, but it turns out there are bigger animals than me. But girl, haven’t you thought about it? What if, after you return with the Points, not only do they swallow your Points, but they also don’t let the person go?”
“I’ve thought about it. If it really comes to that, I’ll fight them to the death.”
“Fight to the death?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t say anything more and simply let the girl in the white dress kneel on the ground and massage his legs. It was obvious that the girl had dressed carefully before entering the Silver Party.
The white dress was just the cheapest kind of attire from the store, worth only single-digit Points. It had no Additional Effect and wasn’t particularly attractive. It only served to cover the body.
Though she wore a mask, her eyes were watery and extremely alluring, her hair adorned with a sparkling hair clip.
Afterward, the two of them stopped talking.
The girl earnestly knelt on the ground serving Tuberculosis Rabbit, while Tuberculosis Rabbit drooped his eyelids as if dozing off.
The number of people in the banquet hall gradually dwindled.
It was now entering the second round.
The girl looked up with hopeful eyes at Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Is that it, sir? It’s time for the second round, I need to go find another client.”
“No need to look.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit put on his shoes and socks, stretched his limbs, and then stood up and yawned, “Your massage felt really good; I quite liked it. Yi often tells me I should do good deeds. Today, I’ll help you out.”
“Which city’s gang is it? I’ll go have a chat with them.”
“Black Trench City.”
The girl hesitated for a moment before she reluctantly said, “I appreciate your kindness, sir, but there’s no need. That group is very strong. A boss appeared outside the city last time, and it only took the people from that gang a little over ten minutes to kill it.”
“We ordinary people can’t afford to provoke them.”
“Ordinary people?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said irritably, “Do you think someone like me, who can spend a Silver Party Ticket just to come here, is an ordinary person?”
“But I just saw you talking to many sisters, and you didn’t want to spend any money.”
“Is that stinginess? I just don’t want to spend money on that kind of thing! You little greenhorn, what do you know? I seek the kind of spiritual communication that comes from art, like two particles floating in the universe, attracting each other in a profound way.”
“Not some so-called one-night stand. That low-level taste is too vulgar.”
“Enough talk. What’s the name of the power in Black Trench City, and what’s the gang called? Blink, and I’ll be there the moment you step out.”
“I…”
Although the girl was somewhat skeptical, since Tuberculosis Rabbit hadn’t paid yet, she didn’t want him to lose face and reluctantly lowered her head and said softly, “The Black Kill Gang from Black Trench City, their boss calls himself Seven Kills Old Ghost.”
“What a non-mainstream gang name.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit mumbled disdainfully before looking at the girl in the white dress, “Alright then, go back. I’ll be there right away.”
“My name is Tuberculosis Rabbit, just remember my name.”
“For real, I’ll take Yi along. Once that Black Kill Gang you mentioned sees Yi, they’ll be begging for mercy.”
“You’re lucky I’m in a good mood today.”
Seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit so confidently assure her, the girl in the white dress couldn’t help but believe a little and hesitantly said, “For real? Shall I wait for you in Black Trench City?”
“Of course, no problem. Go on.”
“Okay, I’ll be going back then.”
…
With a flash of blinding light.
The girl in the white dress was back in reality. Just as her vision restored, she heard several women’s voices chirping away near her ear.
“Oh look, our Little Qiu has returned. How did it go tonight, did you make the 1000 Points?”
“I bet it’s hard for her. Little Qiu’s figure isn’t great and her clothes aren’t nice. How could she possibly sell for such a high price? Only a newbie like her would fetch that price.”
“If you don’t have 1000 Points before dawn, then Seven Kills Old Ghost from the Black Kill Gang will be coming for you, Little Qiu. What will you do then?”
Several scantily-clad women surrounded her, currently sitting inside on stools painting each other’s toenails. Seeing Little Qiu return, they all started to inquire.
Some looked maliciously joyful, some looked sympathetically, while others seemed to be waiting eagerly for the drama to unfold.
This was a brothel, a gathering place spontaneously organized by several older sisters. She ended up here because she desperately needed money and had been referred by them. These older sisters taught her many ways to please men before she entered the Silver Party.
They didn’t charge her any fees.
They also helped her a lot.
“I didn’t… make any money.”
Little Qiu hesitated before telling the truth. Only then did she realize that the client from before didn’t even give her the promised 800 Points, just told her he would come personally to Black Trench City to have a talk with the Black Kill Gang.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: 162: "Tsk, such sweet talk; could it be a family trade from your ancestors?
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 162: “Tsk, such sweet talk; could it be a family trade from your ancestors?
“Didn’t make any money?”
As the words fell, several sisters sitting around Little Qiu were taken aback, then all looked at Little Qiu with sympathetic eyes.
“Qiu, we’ve done right by you. You didn’t have enough Points to buy a Silver Party Ticket, and it was us who lent them to you, wasn’t it?”
“We didn’t ask you to repay it right away; we told you to first rescue your father and then pay us back.”
“But now you haven’t made any money, there’s nothing we can do about the Black Kill Gang, you’re on your own.”
“But there’s a big brother who said he would help me.”
Little Qiu hesitated for a moment, but still went ahead and spoke in detail about everything she had seen and heard at the club: “I met a man wearing a floral shirt…”
…
After her explanation.
A few scantily clad women exchanged glances, each seeing disbelief in the other’s eyes.
“Come on, Little Qiu, you’re a college student, you should have some basic understanding of society, don’t you know men like to boast about themselves in front of women?”
“Exactly, saying he’s coming to Black Trench City to have a chat with the Black Kill Gang for you? Think about it, does that even sound realistic? Even if he could make it here, let’s assume that man does show up, would the Black Kill Gang give face to someone from a different city?”
“Even a powerful dragon doesn’t oppress the local snake, you should know this, Little Qiu. Besides, that guy is probably just deceiving you. He didn’t even give you the 800 Points he promised, how can you still believe him?”
Little Qiu clutched the hem of her skirt with her head lowered, not speaking anymore, just retreating into a nearby small room. She sat at the makeup table, staring at her reflection with eyes full of despair and lifelessness.
Meanwhile, on her personal panel, the chat panel was intermittently flashing with messages from Seven Kills Old Ghost, the leader of the Black Kill Gang.
‘Seven Kills Old Ghost’: You don’t have much time left, I hope you will make a wise choice.
‘Seven Kills Old Ghost’: What’s this about pride in such an era? So many women on the streets don’t even have clothes to wear, rummaging through trash bins for food. What’s the point of caring about your face?
‘Seven Kills Old Ghost’: Think about it, I don’t like to use force. If you make me happy, you won’t be second in Black Trench City, but you’ll definitely be influential. My Black Kill Gang has some clout in Black Trench City.
‘Seven Kills Old Ghost’: Do you know about Wang Yimei from a few days ago? A big shot in Black Trench City, participated in the world boss activity, made it to the last level. That guy has been missing for a while now, do you know where he went? Our Black Kill Gang took him out.
‘Seven Kills Old Ghost’: Nobody who the Black Kill Gang wants to kill has managed to escape so far. For the sake of your father, come on, I’m fast.
‘Seven Kills Old Ghost’: Remember the time we agreed on. If I don’t see you when the time is up, then prepare to claim your father’s corpse.
“…”
With tears welling up in her eyes, Little Qiu looked at the chat panel and the perverted, filthy language of that degenerate. She pulled a dagger from the drawer of the makeup table and gripped it tightly in her hand, then concealed it inside her underwear.
She had decided to keep the appointment.
There was no other choice. She still harbored a sliver of hope for the man from the club. If he had intended to deceive her just to exploit her, then he should have taken advantage of her in the club.
But the man hadn’t touched her; he just asked her to massage his feet.
This made her feel that the man wasn’t deceiving her or boasting. Maybe he really did have some connections with the Black Kill Gang in Black Trench City and could possibly plead on her behalf.
It’s just… there wasn’t much time left until the appointed time. If she didn’t keep the appointment, she would only be able to claim her father’s corpse.
But she wouldn’t let that degenerate humiliate her in front of her father; she had already decisively determined to stab him in the throat when he let his guard down.
Little Qiu sat in front of the makeup mirror, repeatedly practicing how to stab the degenerate in the throat. When the time was about right, she hid the dagger in her underwear, put on a white dress, wiped away the tears from the corners of her eyes, and left the place alone under the pitying gazes of the women in the room.
…
At that moment, Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit were already aboard a sleigh headed for Black Trench City.
“Black Trench City again?”
Chen Yi lay on the sleigh, opened the glass hood above his head, and lit a cigarette as he leaned back in his seat, yawning casually and enjoying the wind rushing past him on both sides.
“I don’t want to sound like I’m discriminating based on location but don’t you feel like Black Trench City always has some weird stuff happening?”
“Wasn’t Wang Yimei from Black Trench City last time?”
“And that Zhou Ping guy too, if I remember correctly.”
“Seems like it,” Tuberculosis Rabbit said, leaning on the railing of the sleigh, facing the nearby sunrise with arms open wide, loving the sensation and remarking, “Is this what a morning feels like? The glow of the rising sun on your body feels really nice.”
“Just that it’s a bit hotter than usual.”
“But Yi, why haven’t you asked me why I’m going to Black Trench City to save that girl?”
“Can’t be bothered to ask.”
Chen Yi replied lazily while lying down, “Just saving someone, why ask so many questions? Just get it done quickly, we need to prepare for leveling up the team after clearing the map.”
The team’s promotion from lvl. 1 to lvl. 2 required clearing a D-grade map once.
After clearing an E-grade map, they would be able to see the many D-grade team maps that were unlocked.
Having cleared the ‘Night Widow Village’ E-grade map, they naturally could now see those D-grade maps that were once in shadow. Until now, no team has made it to the ‘Global Team Rankings’.
That indicates that, up to this point, no team has cleared a D-grade map yet.
“`
Of course, the separate squad rankings for the first three E-level maps had already been populated by various teams, and there was a noticeable difference in these three maps’ squad rankings.
For example.
“Rank one”: 100% rating.
“Rank two”: 94% rating.
“Rank three”: 86% rating.
These are the squad rating rankings for the “Tetris” and “Human Centipede Version of Snake Game” maps, where the gap between each team wasn’t as big as one might imagine.
However, the gap in the squad rankings for the “Night Widow Village” map was extremely large.
“Rank one”: ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’, 100% rating.
“Rank two”: ‘Skywake Second Team’, 23% rating.
“Rank three”: ‘Sin Department Third Team’, 8% rating.
…
“…”
Atop a city’s rooftop, dozens of individuals dressed in black stood in the center, with an incredibly oppressive atmosphere hanging in the air. All heads were bowed as no one dared to speak up, until the man at the forefront, a middle-aged man with a face full of scars, broke the long silence with a measured tone.
“An 8% rating?”
“Captain of the Sin Department Third Team, step forward and explain to me how such a low score came about. Do you think the Sin Department isn’t famous enough, and you’re trying to make a name for ourselves?”
“That…”
A young man in a suit stepped out from the crowd and began to explain with a bitter expression, “It’s really not our fault. The first-place team on this map is ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’. They’ve set the standard for scores so high. Look, even the ‘Skywake Second Team’ only got a 23% rating.”
“Rabbits Do Not Kill? Never heard of them. Who can tell me where this unknown team came from?”
“Why should they be allowed to ride over you like this?”
“Uh… Boss, the leader of this team is Chen Yi, and among their members, there’s one called Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
“…”
The scar-faced middle-aged man suddenly fell into a silent, expressionless contemplation before finally speaking in a deep voice, “So Chen Yi’s team is called ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’, huh? Truly the first among escapists, with a team name so profound, it’s hard for others to fathom.”
“Since it’s Chen Yi, that makes sense. No worries then, everyone can disperse.”
“Right, ask our PR department to hype up the results of the ‘Sin Department Third Team’. Ranking in third place, with only Chen Yi and Skywake above us, this achievement is actually quite respectable and should attract plenty of ambitious individuals to join us.”
“Yes.”
…
“We’re here.”
Chen Yi landed the sled on the rooftop of a tall building in Black Trench City and slowly stepped off the sled. Looking over the edge at the city below, he casually asked, “Where’s this Black Kill Gang located?”
“Uh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly realized something – he hadn’t even asked that girl where the Black Kill Gang was located, hadn’t added her as a friend, and didn’t even know her name.
All he knew was it was the Black Kill Gang from Black Trench City.
At this moment, they were indeed fumbling in the dark, but it wasn’t a major issue, as they were already accustomed to asking for directions in Black Trench City.
Heading down to the ground floor, Tuberculosis Rabbit randomly stopped a passerby and began to ask, “Do you know where the Black Kill Gang is? Lead us there and there’ll be a reward—”
His voice suddenly cut off.
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked the thin young man he had stopped up and down with a strange expression, “Have we met before? Why do you look familiar?”
“Sirs, we meet again.”
The young man’s eyes lit up as he looked at Chen Yi and his companion, bobbing his head and grinning obsequiously, “Last time you came to Black Trench City to find someone, it was me who showed you the way.”
“I know all about what goes on in this part of Black Trench City. The Black Kill Gang’s base is in a complex of little western-style buildings in the east of the city; I can take you there right now.”
“Oh, it’s you!”
Recognition dawned on Tuberculosis Rabbit as he drew out his words and began to laugh, “I remember now, you’re the one who showed us the way when we came to kill Zhou Ping in Black Trench City last time, right? Not bad, kid, you have a talent for being a traitorous guide.”
“Good genes, good genes,” replied the young man with modesty, before leading the way and smiling ingratiatingly again, “Shall I show you the way, gentlemen?”
“Let’s go, you know the drill. Lead us and you won’t be shortchanged for your troubles.”
“Such words, it’s my honor to guide you, sirs… ah, no, grandpapas. I would never dare to expect any reward.”
“Tsk, sweet talker, aren’t you? Wouldn’t be surprised if your ancestors were in the business.”
“You have a sharp eye, sir.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 165: 163: "With this little strength, you've already started to learn to forcibly take young women?
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 163: “With this little strength, you’ve already started to learn to forcibly take young women?
“Has it arrived?”
On the lawn below a small western-style building in Black Trench City.
A middle-aged man was holding a golf club, aiming at a distant hole, and swung forcefully.
The golf ball on the lawn arched through the air after a forceful strike and flew into the distance.
The man placed his palm above his eyes, looking at the golf ball that gradually disappeared from his view, chuckling in satisfaction before casually tossing the golf club into the hands of a subordinate next to him.
He had just turned around to speak to Little Qiu, who was standing by his side in a white dress.
“Do you know what this place used to be?”
“It was a flat land, and after the descent of the new world, I had people lay a large expanse of turf here; do you know how expensive the turf specially used for golf courses is? Very few people could afford it before the new world came.”
“Most people are now outside the city, struggling with those Minotaur Monsters to earn some meager Points.”
“And yet I can leisurely play golf here.”
“This is class difference.”
“It’s also a product of the new world’s reshuffling, and people like me are the new kings after the descent of the new world.”
“Just as you see—”
The man casually took off his white glove and threw it onto the grass nearby, slowly walked over to Little Qiu, and looked at her eyes full of panic and fear; he licked the corner of his mouth and smiled.
“I actually don’t care whether that ball goes in the hole; I don’t even like this boring sport.”
“But that doesn’t matter.”
“This sport tells everyone my status very well, doesn’t it?”
“Let me guess, you haven’t earned 1000 Points, have you? So you decided to redeem your father with your body, or maybe you have some kind of sharp weapon hidden under your dress, planning to make a desperate stand against me.”
“Look over there.”
The man pointed toward a middle-aged man tied up with ropes and kneeling under a big tree nearby, his eyes flashing with excitement: “Let’s begin. In front of your father, take off that dress that symbolizes purity.”
“I can’t wait to start enjoying your expression.”
“…”
Little Qiu’s lips were tightly pursed; she closed her eyes and took a deep breath, and when she opened them again, all the panic and fear in her eyes had disappeared, leaving only resolute determination as she said, word by word.
“There are too many people here, let’s change to a place with fewer people.”
The man who promised to come seemed to be lying to her after all.
Indeed, she didn’t even know which city that man was from, she just believed him when he said he would come.
Maybe she was really naive.
“Change places?”
The man raised an eyebrow curiously and reached out towards Little Qiu’s chin: “No, no, no, I…”
At that moment—
“Bang!”
A muffled gunshot suddenly rang out.
A bullet shot from beneath the man’s feet, and before his arm could touch Little Qiu’s chin, it directly blasted his arm in half.
Blood mist exploded.
The severed arm fell onto the grass.
“Ahhh!!!”
The man’s heart-wrenching scream sounded ear-piercingly on the spot, his eyes filled with fear and rage, he yelled, “My hand, my hand!!”
“Ah!”
Little Qiu was equally frightened by this scene, covering her mouth in horror as she staggered backward several steps and then unsteadily fell onto the grass.
“Who, who is it!!”
The man quickly took out a Prop from his chest and smashed it on his severed arm to barely stop the bleeding, then proceeded to frantically scan around, shouting in anger, “Who is the coward striking from behind, show yourself!”
The next second—
His expression suddenly stiffened a bit with disbelief in his eyes, as he looked towards the two men approaching him slowly at the end of his sight.
One of the men wore a floral shirt under a black casual suit jacket, and below, casual black suit pants, leisurely walking towards him with one hand in his pocket and leaning on a cane.
Following this man was another man, who was also wearing a floral shirt with several buttons undone at the chest, revealing a low neckline, and wearing beach shorts below.
Just by making an appearance, the two men immediately made one feel that they were extraordinary.
Not because of their attire.
But because of the dense, dazzling array of titles above their heads like a lighthouse!
The man with the cane had over 20 titles above his head, each one almost bluntly declaring his strength.
This attire, these titles, and that familiar face.
He knew this man.
Chen Yi.
In the world boss event, a man who could inflict several million damage with a single shot.
He had quietly become a representative of the top player worldwide.
“I…”
The man’s face, previously contorted with rage, suddenly cleared of anger when he spotted who was approaching, a shadow of dread flickering in the depth of his eyes as his lips twitched into a forced smile.
“Chen Yi, I know you, I never imagined I’d see you here.”
“Just tell me what you want, I’ll handle it immediately.”
“In Black Trench City, I still hold some sway, I should be able to help you out.”
Since these two clearly spelled trouble, he needed to let them know early on that he had some influence, to instill a sense of wariness in their hearts, after all, even if you did manage to deal millions in damage at the world boss event.
It was merely the effect of a skill or prop.
You couldn’t possibly always hit with such terrifying damage, could you?
He had nearly a hundred men under his command, if they really swarmed over, they had the ability to kill Chen Yi right there and then.
But with only seven or eight men by his side at the moment, he had to buy enough time, to let his subordinates spread the word, to drag things out until reinforcements arrived.
However, the next second—
“Bang, bang!”
The sound of several muffled gunshots rang out once more, and the man’s followers all around stiffened, only to slowly collapse into pools of blood, leaving just the man with the golf club beside him, who was trembling nonstop.
Chen Yi slowly walked over with the aid of his cane, lifted the man’s chin with the cane and gazed into his eyes silently for a moment before speaking calmly, “With this little strength, you’ve started to abduct and bully women?”
“Call your people, I’ll wait for you.”
“Chen… Chen Yi, boss.”
The man swallowed hard, not daring to look at the dead forms of his subordinates around him, feeling the cold of the cane on his chin, he humbled himself with a trembling voice, speaking in a lowly manner.
“Let’s talk this out, these men are dead, it’s no big grudge.”
“It’s our first meeting, there shouldn’t be any bad blood between us, is there anything we can’t discuss openly?”
“You…”
Little Qiu, who had given up hope, looked towards Tuberculosis Rabbit’s familiar figure and attire with a glimmer of surprise, and somewhat incredulously said, “You… you’re that man from the club?”
“Yeah.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, hands in pockets and a cigarette in mouth, shrugged indifferently, “That’s me, didn’t I say I would come to Black Trench City to have a word with that old ghost?”
“I won’t go back on a promise.”
“It’s just that you left in a rush, without leaving any contact information or a specific location, so it took a bit longer to find you.”
“But fortunately, it looks like I haven’t arrived too late.”
Seeing Little Qiu and the middle-aged man tied up beneath a tree, Tuberculosis Rabbit also let out a small sigh of relief, not for Little Qiu’s safety, but glad that she hadn’t lied to him and was genuinely in trouble.
If Little Qiu had been a swindler, concocting a story just to jack up the price, then he would have really lost face in front of Yi.
“I…”
Little Qiu, overwhelmed with emotion at her narrow escape from death, covered her mouth, too agitated to speak. She didn’t know who these two men were, only that this pervert, who normally did as he pleased in Black Trench City, didn’t dare to utter a harsh word in front of them, clearly not on the same level.
“Go on, talk.”
Chen Yi casually sat down on a chair nearby, pulling out a bag of sunflower seeds, cracking them open while looking at the man standing still with his arm severed, “On the way here, I heard that Wang Yimei from Black Trench City was killed by you.”
“I am quite curious about that. Did you kill Wang Yimei?”
The man’s expression shifted unpredictably as he hung his head silently, teeth clenched before finally mustering the courage to say, “No, some time ago Sword Without End came to Black Trench City looking for Wang Yimei and asked one of my men for directions.”
“Afterward, there was no word from Wang Yimei, and I suspect Sword Without End killed him, then seeing Sword Without End not proclaiming this deed, and he himself no longer in Black Trench City,”
“I secretly put the word out that Wang Yimei was killed by the Black Kill Gang, simply to enhance the gang’s reputation.”
“If you are here for revenge on behalf of Wang Yimei, I can only say you’ve got the wrong person. The real killer should be Sword Without End; we were just boasting.”
At this point, the man was already filled with regret. When Chen Yi brought up Wang Yimei, he had a clear idea of why Chen Yi had suddenly come looking for him.
Having never met Chen Yi, and with no reason for enmity, the only explanation was seeking vengeance for Wang Yimei.
He wished he could slap himself for merely talking big, never expecting anyone to seek revenge for Wang Yimei, especially someone he dared not to provoke.
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the man with a bemused expression, “Did you not hear my conversation with this young lady? We’re here to provide justice on her behalf, play the hero who defends the helpless. Get it?”
“Wang Yimei’s death has nothing to do with it.”
“But you’re somewhat correct; Wang Yimei indeed met his end at the hands of Sword Without End, that guy personally descended to hell to hunt him down. However, don’t worry, when you head down there, Sword Without End is likely to pay you another visit.”
“After all, Sword Without End’s chances for errors under the July rules are all used up, he doesn’t seem like the kind to live much longer, probably going down again before long.”
And at that moment—
Many black-clad figures had already begun to surge out of the villa towards the grass, wielding weapons to support their boss, the members of the Black Kill Gang.
A quick glance showed there were quite a few, perhaps several dozens.
Not a small number indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 166: 164: "When Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom, Humanity is Wholly Slaughtered.
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 164: “When Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom, Humanity is Wholly Slaughtered.
“`
A swarming crowd brandishing all manner of weapons charged at Chen Yi and his companions, which honestly looked quite intimidating.
Chen Yi admitted that his abilities were not bad, but he usually kept a very low profile.
First, he inherently disliked drawing attention, and second, there were too many rules and props in the game, leaving everyone unclear about which prop’s peculiar rules might cause him to capsize in the gutter.
His approach to these dangers had always been to snuff them out into ashes before the other party could even get close to him.
“Boss Chen Yi.”
The man turned his head to glance at his underlings, who were getting closer and closer, then covered his severed arm and slowly backed away from Chen Yi, “Since you all came for this woman, that simplifies things a lot.”
“Take this woman away, and I won’t hold a grudge against you, Boss Chen Yi, for my fallen men. We have no grievances, and from now on, let’s keep to our own paths.”
“I was merely pursuing her normally. If I had wanted to use force, do you think she could still stand here with her clothes intact?”
“We are the strongest players who came after the next era began; we should unite, not waste time fighting over a woman here.”
“Moreover, no matter how impressive Boss Chen Yi is, it’s just two of you against nearly a hundred men on my side. If it really comes to a fight, you won’t come out on top.”
The man’s voice contained a hint of threat, and as he continued to retreat, his eyes fixated on Chen Yi, ready to burst out at any moment. He wasn’t completely defenseless.
Everyone who made a name for themselves in Black Trench City was formidable.
“…”
Chen Yi, leaning on his cane, stood still, calmly watching the black mass rushing towards him, silent and unmoved.
“Maybe you guys should run first.”
Little Qiu, who somehow managed to stand behind Tuberculosis Rabbit, looked anxiously at his father tied up under the tree with a bit of fear in his eyes, “They are too many for us; we’re not their match. I can’t leave my father alone to flee; you go first.”
“Run?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up to make sure there were no obstacles above his head before lighting a cigarette and putting it in his mouth, “Do you mind if I smoke a cigarette?”
“Uh… I don’t mind, but is this really the time for that?”
“I’ve been reading a book where the protagonist always asks if people mind him smoking before lighting up. It’s become a bit of a habit.”
“What?”
Little Qiu, not quite following Tuberculosis Rabbit’s train of thought, impulsively asked, “What book?”
“Serial Killer’s Confession of Crimes.”
“Serial killers are that polite?”
“Hmm, he always asks the person he just killed if they would mind him having a smoke. It’s taken for granted that they don’t mind.”
Little Qiu looked bewilderedly at Tuberculosis Rabbit, and after a pause, he spoke urgently again, “If you don’t run now, it’ll be too late, I’m grateful that you came all the way to Black Trench City, but things have escalated too much, I don’t want…”
Before he could finish speaking.
Chen Yi, standing to the side, lightly tapped the ground with his cane and gazed at the group of black-clothed men wielding weapons and charging at him, whispering, “Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom—”
Immediately following.
The originally lush green grassland suddenly began to redden at a visibly rapid pace, as if one were standing in a sea of blood. Countless vibrant, blood-red Flowers of the Other Shore rose from the ground, floating in mid-air and rotating ceaselessly.
In an instant.
It was as if one had arrived in a sea of flowers.
The skies were still dimly lit, but the scene was, in fact, hauntingly beautiful.
The many Flowers of the Other Shore drew the eye as they floated all around.
“—the mortal world is all but slaughtered.”
As the calm voice of Chen Yi fell with these last four words.
The next second—
Thousands of crimson and vivid Flowers of the Other Shore shot out at an untraceable speed towards everyone around, burrowing into every black-clothed person’s body and beginning to rapidly take root and sprout.
In almost the blink of an eye.
These black-clothed men, who had just been charging forward, now stood frozen in place. They were covered in countless wounds as fresh, watery crimson Flowers of the Other Shore grew from their corpses’ wounds.
Nearly a hundred black-clothed people turned into Floral People in a moment.
The whole scene looked eerily unsettling.
The leader of the Black Kill Gang, Seven Kills Old Ghost, didn’t even get a chance to react before he, too, became Floral People, clutching his severed arm and standing still. His last vision of this world was filled with shock and horror in his eyes.
From beginning to end, this so-called leader of the Black Kill Gang only used a healing prop and did not activate any other props or use any skills.
Not that he didn’t have any.
Rather, the leader of the Black Kill Gang, who always wanted to make peace as much as possible, didn’t dare to activate his props first and didn’t want to engage in a Life-Death Battle with Chen Yi. His tiptoeing resulted in becoming Floral People without resisting at all.
After all, he too had made a name for himself in Black Trench City, yet even at the brink of death, he didn’t utter any particularly harsh words.
‘Prop Name’: Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom.
‘Prop Level’: B-level.
‘Prop Effect’: Once this prop is activated, more than three thousand Flowers of the Other Shore will emerge from the ground around you and float in the air. Players touched by Flowers of the Other Shore will experience rapid, continuous loss of blood and turn into Floral People upon death, eternally sustained.
‘Prop Restrictions’: After one use, it will enter a 24h cooldown period.
‘Prop Introduction’: “When Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom, the mortal world is all but slaughtered.”
Chen Yi looked at the scene before him, glanced at his prop panel, slightly raised his eyebrows in a somewhat satisfied smile, and remained silent. He had exchanged this prop for 300,000 Sadness Points during the Father’s Day event.
A B-level prop.
Extremely rare.
Now it seems its effect was quite remarkable, an AOE (Area of Effect) prop.
“`
Once I have enough Enhancement Stones, I’ll enhance this Prop to full and see what the Enhancement Effect is.
Up until now, the effects of enhancing his few items had not been checked with clean grey stones, mainly because the clean grey stones were too rare; including the ones from Tuberculosis Rabbit, there were only four clean grey stones in total.
“Alright.”
Chen Yi glanced around casually, saw nothing that needed packing up, and climbed onto the sled, “Everything’s settled; we’re ready to head back. There’s also a D-class squad map waiting for us.”
“Oh, okay.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked toward the Floral People standing not far off, strode over quickly, “Yi, wait for me. These people have dropped some Props after they died, I’m going to pick them up; let’s not waste them.”
…
“This… this is…”
Little Qiu was completely frozen in place, her eyes full of shock and disbelief as she stared at the scene before her, unable to recover her senses for a long while. The Black Kill Gang, which was nearly a dominant force in Black Trench City, had been annihilated just like that?
And… with just one strike!
That man…
She turned her head to look at Chen Yi, who was sitting on the sled, her heart filled with an indescribable shock. She didn’t usually pay attention to world announcements and activities, as she simply didn’t have the energy to concern herself with other people’s lives – just keeping herself and her father alive was exhausting enough.
So she really had no idea who Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit were.
She never imagined that a person she had met by chance in the club was so strong.
No, ‘strong’ wasn’t quite the word to describe it, was it?
“Thank you, thank you!”
Little Qiu, finally coming to her senses, looked gratefully at Chen Yi in the sled and kept bowing in thanks.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi gave a non-committal grunt, which amounted to a response, but he was contemplating another matter – whether or not to pull Sword Without End into his own squad. The guy was strong and wouldn’t be dead weight, and could even become a valuable breakthrough force in special situations.
It was just… they hadn’t spent much time together.
You can see someone’s face, but not their heart; he was still a bit unclear about this person’s temperament.
And just then—
He suddenly saw Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a serious expression, carrying a Floral Person on his shoulder, jogging over.
“Yi, don’t you think this Floral Person looks pretty? I want to take it home as a potted plant.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi looked up with a peculiar expression at the Floral Person Tuberculosis Rabbit was carrying on his shoulder. He had dealt with Tuberculosis Rabbit’s unpredictable trains of thought for too long. Although he believed he had completely adapted to them, every so often, Tuberculosis Rabbit would still manage to sucker-punch him with something unexpected.
Like now.
From a certain angle, this Floral Person indeed looked pretty.
After all, those Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom which grew from inside the corpse were extremely vivid and fresh; the petals and branches were all a bright red, looking quite enticing – it wouldn’t be a bad idea to bring them home for display.
Only, if they were to use a corpse as a pot, the entire image might seem a bit macabre.
He wasn’t sure how normal people might think, but he guessed that when a normal person saw a corpse covered in Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom, the words ‘pretty’ would definitely not spring to mind.
Rather, words like ‘fear’ and ‘horror’ would probably come to the fore much more readily.
After a silent pause, Chen Yi waved a hand, “Fine, bring it up. But I’m warning you, if I smell even a hint of corpse rot in the living room, I’ll throw these things out immediately.”
“Don’t worry, Yi, you know my methods. I can’t take care of the living, but I make sure the dead are spick-and-span, not a whiff of odor.”
“It’s just that…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit first confidently made a promise, then added a bit sheepishly in a softer voice, “I want to move all these Floral People back home – Yi, don’t you feel they have an artistic vibe to them?”
“I plan to transport all these Floral People back to Yancheng, then find an empty lot to display them as my first major art piece, open for public exhibition.”
“I’ve even thought of a name for it.”
“It’ll be called – ‘Art Piece: Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom at the End of Humanity.’
“…”
Chen Yi, who had been about to light a cigarette, stiffened for a moment and looked up at Tuberculosis Rabbit. It was only after a long silence that he finally spoke, “Does your artwork always have to involve corpses?”
“Not necessarily. It’s just that my recent pieces all revolve around themes of death.”
“Sigh!”
Chen Yi let out a long sigh, massaging his temples before speaking, “Then bring them all; but the sled can’t carry that many at once, can it?”
“It’s alright, Yi, you rest at home. I’ll drive the sled back and forth a few times.”
Afterward, Tuberculosis Rabbit rushed off excitedly towards the Floral People. As he passed by Little Qiu, he suddenly slapped his forehead, as if just remembering, “Look at me and my memory, I almost forgot about you.”
“Why are you still standing here? It’s safe now; you can take your father home.”
“Ah? Oh, right, right.”
Little Qiu stood there, somewhat adorably nodding her head several times in succession.
“By the way, what’s your name?”
“Little Qiu.”
“Your full name?”
“Qiu Xiao.”
“Your dad sure has a knack for naming; probably has the same level of education as me. Say hello to your uncle for me – actually, maybe not. Nearly everyone I greet ends up dead.”
With that casual remark, Tuberculosis Rabbit excitedly rolled up his sleeves and charged into the cluster of Floral People.
“I’ve got to get busy now; you do as you please.”

chapters.title: Chapter 167: 165: "I will go to hell and bring you up.
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 165: “I will go to hell and bring you up.
“`
Time often slips away quickly.
Like today.
After six hours had passed, the clock struck twelve noon.
At 12 PM on July 1st, even the sun seemed exceptionally warm, and Tuberculosis Rabbit and Chen Yi were standing in front of a huge gallery entrance, above which hung a wooden plaque bearing several large characters.
“Mr. Tuberculosis Rabbit’s Art Gallery.”
“What do you think?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the gallery that had been cleaned until it was spotless and bright, turning to Chen Yi with satisfaction and pride, “Not bad, right, Yi? The gallery is just one floor, but it covers thousands of square meters.”
“This place used to be an esports competition venue, designed specifically for CSGO matches. After the game world descended, it was abandoned.”
“This morning, I had people clean up the venue thoroughly, and then I took over this property. It will serve as my art gallery and exhibition hall for future generations to visit.”
“The hundreds of Floral People this morning have already been turned into artworks and placed inside, as the only exhibit in the gallery for now.”
“But speaking of which, why do they call this a ‘game world’? It sounds just like the college entrance exam upgrade, and I hope there’s no postgraduate exams or civil service exams to follow, leading up to a final destination of a state job.”
Chen Yi stood calmly in place, leaning on a cane with one hand, looking at the gallery that stood out amongst the grimy surrounding buildings without saying a word.
The name “game world” had been heard from Sword Without End.
Once a player died and became a Hell Player, they would learn the true name of the game—
“Game World.”
He found the name strange as well; it indeed carried certain ambiguities.
But one thing was certain: the so-called game should be about advancement, and the ‘rise’ implied in the word alluded to leveling up and promotion. As for the ‘foundation,’ it was harder to understand and could be some term beyond their comprehension.
In other words, after the game ended, whether players would advance to this ‘foundation’ would be decided based on their performance.
This was his speculation.
Although he could not be certain, he could firmly assume so. Otherwise, there was no need to choose such a suggestive name when any random noun would suffice as a game title.
He didn’t dwell on this and instead casually said after glancing at the gallery, “It must have been difficult to clean this gallery in six hours. Where did you find the people?”
“Heh heh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked smug as he crossed his arms and raised his head, “Of course, I posted a task at the main city’s task center. Just with some Points, many companies took on various small projects.”
“It was cleaned up quickly. How about it, Yi? Shall we go in and take a look?”
After the descent of the later world, many small forces organized spontaneously. Some called themselves companies, others gangs. Though their names differed, they were essentially the same thing.
They didn’t have specific projects, mostly engaging in whatever made money.
Like this cleaning project, many famous teams on the map came over with their tools. Although the Points were not much, after all, there was no danger.
Moreover, there was a chance to meet Tuberculosis Rabbit and Yi, two big names from Yancheng, so there were no shortage of companies signing up.
“Let’s take a look.”
Chen Yi didn’t reject the idea, not wanting to dampen Tuberculosis Rabbit’s spirits. He just looked at an item on the team panel for a D-level map and sent a message to Sword Without End in the chat panel.
“I’ll send Sword Without End a message first, asking him to join us for a dungeon run to check out the situation.”
“By the time we finish looking around, he should be about to arrive.”
“Sure, you’re the boss, Yi.”
“Let’s go in then.”
“Alright.”
…
“Whew!”
Sword Without End rose, somewhat out of breath, from atop the man before him, rubbing his slightly sore right arm, gasping, “Do you know where you went wrong?”
“I know, I know!”
The man knelt on all fours sobbing, with a trembling voice full of tears, “Sword Master, oh no, Endless Master.”
“My only crime was being harsh to your sister-in-law at the market back then. I am guilty, my crime is unforgivable, but… I should not be the one to die!”
“These years, you’ve come to beat me up every now and then, always asking me if I know what I’ve done wrong. I’ve answered this question countless times already, of course I know where I went wrong. I was wrong for not daring to stand up to your sister-in-law back then.”
“If I could turn back time, even with eight hundred guts, I shouldn’t have spoken harshly to your sister-in-law!”
“Whew!”
Sword Without End, still standing, stretched and yawned casually, “You are the only person in this world, apart from me, who has ever seen my wife and remembered her. Of course, I need to visit you often.”
“Someone once told me that people don’t truly die when they pass away; they truly die when the world no longer remembers them.”
“I think there’s much truth in that statement.”
“So, to keep my wife alive, please keep remembering her. Don’t worry about forgetting; I’ll make sure you always remember.”
He then looked at the message Chen Yi had sent in the chat panel and suddenly laughed, “Let’s stop here for now. I’ve got something to take care of. Keep living well; I don’t want to hear news of your death.”
“`
“Forget it, you dying wouldn’t matter much.”
“I’d go to hell and bring you back up.”
…
“Where’s the exhibit?”
Chen Yi stepped into the entrance of this huge exhibition hall, and all he saw was emptiness, no exhibits in sight, giving off a barren vibe.
“Hey.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit’s lips turned up slightly with a hint of mystery, pointing overhead: “Yi, look up.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi quirked an eyebrow and followed the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s hand gesture to his own overhead.
Hanging from the ceiling of the exhibition hall by steel cables were about a hundred Floral People, swaying slightly under the draft, as if they might come to life at any moment.
Above them, a huge white wooden frame encircled all the Floral People on the ceiling, and next to this large frame, another smaller sign clearly detailed the entire art piece’s description.
“Artwork”: At world’s end, Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom.
“Art Anchor Point”: Look straight to see people, look down to see corpses, look up to see loved ones.
The moment you look up in remembrance, tears will be retracted.
“Artist”: Mr. Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“How about that?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking entranced, gazed up and whispered, “The reason why I placed this piece at the entrance and arranged it above is because I wanted the upcoming guests to appreciate my art from different angles, not just by looking straight forward.”
“And there’s something else I wanted to express through it.”
“Why do we instinctively look up when we miss our loved ones? Because we’re afraid the tears will fall.”
“I hope that when everyone looks up to see this artwork, it prompts deep reflections in their hearts, rather than just being seen as a simple arrangement of Floral People.”
“Hmm…”
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi gave his opinion, “It’s quite beautiful.”
At that moment—
A familiar voice suddenly came from behind them.
“Brother Chen Yi, I heard you were looking for me, so I came.”
Sword Without End approached with a smile, arms outstretched: “I’ve never been into a team map, and though I don’t know what’s it like inside, you can rest assured, I definitely won’t hold you back.”
“Maybe, I could even surprise you guys a bit.”
“The last time the three of us went on a map journey together was pretty enjoyable, wasn’t it?”
“By the way—”
He paused, then looked up at the ceiling with a somewhat sentimental expression, saying amazedly, “Say, Yi, you actually made a special place for Tuberculosis Rabbit as an art gallery, huh? This place isn’t small, that’s quite the grand gesture.”
“You’re here.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket, casually took one out and tossed it into Sword Without End’s chest, glancing toward a part of the wall: “See that empty white frame? That’s for you.”
“Tsk.”
Sword Without End caught the cigarette thrown by Tuberculosis Rabbit, tossed it in the air with a half-smile, “You think I’m stupid? I’ve already committed the July rules to heart. This month, there’s no way I’d smoke indoors.”
“Let’s talk about the map first.”
…
Chen Yi gathered a few people, sitting on the rooftop of a tall building, explaining, “The difficulty of the D-level team map should exceed our imagination.”
“E-level maps don’t pose too much of a challenge in passing, at most they require some effort to get a higher map evaluation score, but there’s generally no serious risk to life.”
“But it’s been nearly twelve hours since the D-level maps appeared, and in these twelve hours, not a single team has successfully cleared a D-level map.”
“The global team leaderboard is still empty.”
“We must choose a map that suits us well, play to our strengths while avoiding our weaknesses, and try to minimize danger while maximizing our map score.”
“The three of us have known each other for some time now, and today Sword Without End officially joins the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team. Let’s introduce ourselves briefly to each other, and I hope you’ll introduce yourselves with some sincerity.”
Chen Yi’s gaze shifted from Sword Without End, as he lowered his staff slowly to the ground.
“I, Chen Yi.”
“Possess several B-level props, with types for attack, defense, and escape among them. This staff is the transformed shape of the B-level prop, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle.”
“The Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle’s ability is that each bullet inflicts true damage equal to 3% of the target’s Maximum Health Value.”
“My specialty is dealing finishing blows on bosses. The higher the enemy’s health, the more damage I deal.”
