“I also own the top-ranking Vehicle in the global rankings, which is extremely fast and can instantaneously change my position, allowing me to”
“The downside is I lack strong camouflaging and escape capabilities, and I don’t have many good solutions when facing large numbers of enemies.”
These words were quite sincere indeed, the first time Chen Yi had ever introduced his possessions to someone.

chapters.title: Chapter 168: 166: "What a Worded Book.
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 166: “What a Worded Book.
But he didn’t lay out everything at once—trust between people has to be built through continuous adjustment and interaction, so revealing one’s representative props and skills should be sufficient.
“As for me.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged his shoulders, lit a cigarette, popped it into his mouth, and tossed another one to Sword Without End: “My name is Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
“Before we descend into the map while there’s nothing obstructing overhead, we’d better smoke as many as possible since we don’t know what the environment below will be like or if we’ll even be able to smoke.”
“My skill ceiling is very high; I can say that in many instances where Yi can’t sort something out, I can.”
“But in most cases, I serve a default role; of course, you can also understand that I’m not of much use in most situations.”
“…”
Sword Without End glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit somewhat speechlessly, carefully scanned the surroundings before finally lighting a cigarette and taking a drag, then, after a moment of thought, he spoke: “My main abilities come from a title and a prop.”
“My title, which is what you see now, allows me to control all sword-type vehicles and sword-type props.”
“Even the sword-type props in the hands of enemies can be controlled by me, but I can’t activate their special effects, only use them as swords.”
“Another prop I have is… I can turn the visual effects of any character action into a real, damaging area attack, but the cost is that the character’s action must be an attack animation, and that character action will be consumed, never to be regained.”
“At present, these two things are the main source of my damage.”
“Turning character actions into real and harmful attacks?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, in contemplation, began: “So the attack that dealt nearly ten thousand damage during the world boss event was done using this method?”
“That wasn’t the case.”
Sword Without End shook his head and denied: “In the world boss event, that damage was due to a skill effect of mine. As for the special effects animations at the time, they were a combination of twelve character actions and effects activated simultaneously to create that scene.”
“For example, the effect that made the blade of the sword turn red was one of the activated weapon effects; used alone it’s not particularly stunning, but combined with other character actions, it creates a very cool image that looks great.”
“Impressive…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently raised a thumbs-up; no wonder Sword Without End’s effects always looked so impressive, and why each action was always different and never repeated—it was his own combination.
“Made your choice—”
Meanwhile, Chen Yi had chosen from the numerous D-level maps: “Let’s go with this map.”
A map information display appeared in front of the group.
「Map Name」: Destiny’s Adversary.
「Map Level」: D-level.
「Map Introduction」: Heaven has a road, yet you do not travel it; Hell has no gate, yet you break in. Pick up the weapon in your hand, and kill those noisy enemies before you.
“This map is most likely a team versus team map. Upon entering, we should face off against other squads, which is a map that works to our advantage.”
“With our combined strength, we should be able to breeze through regardless of the squad we encounter.”
“Okay.”
Sword Without End nodded, indicating no objections. Although Tuberculosis Rabbit’s self-deprecation was extreme, he did not really take Tuberculosis Rabbit for granted.
After all, during their first meeting, that one slash from Tuberculosis Rabbit had stunned him.
Perhaps the cooldown on that attack was long, but once deployed, its power was immense—it was akin to a strategic nuclear weapon.
The next second—
A flash of white light engulfed them, and when they next opened their eyes, they found themselves in a corner of a white space.
It looked like a giant cubic white space with 10 meters on each side, the vast whiteness giving an impression of emptiness, with walls all around showing a countdown timer of ten minutes.
「00:09:59」
「00:09:58」
“A countdown is indeed the most effective means to impose a sense of urgency.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced around casually, saying that although it was unclear what would happen when the countdown ended, just the existence of a countdown induced a subconscious pressure on people.
Just then—
A voice sounded in their ears.
「Ding, team leader Chen Yi of the team ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ has chosen to enter the D-level map ‘Destiny’s Adversary’. Each player in the team must submit 2000 Points as a deposit.」
「Team players are: Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Sword Without End.」
「Following are the map’s content and specific rules, please read carefully and bear them in mind.」
「Long, long ago, Heaven and Hell waged a huge battle, during which countless angels and demons fell into eternal slumber. At this moment, you stand in a corner of Hell, surrounded by a dense mass of demons.」
「The moment the House of God vanishes, you will meet an onslaught like the tide. Should you withstand for 24 hours, you will be victorious.」
「Map Clearance Rules: Survive for 24 hours OR eliminate all demons.」
「Map Rules」:
1: Within this map, all titles, skills, props, vehicles, etc., can be used without any restrictions.
2: Inside the House of God secret props unique to this map are concealed; unearthing normal props will be advantageous for clearing the map.
3. All demons are unable to cross over the tops of their companions’ heads or stand on their companions’ heads.
4. If the challenge is failed, 2000 Points will be deducted from the player, but if it is completed successfully, they will be returned via the original path.
5. Before the House of God opens, players cannot step on the white tiles, or they will be immediately deemed to have failed.
The map rules are pretty simple, with just four easy ones.
Chen Yi’s brows furrowed slightly in confusion. He had guessed wrong; the content of this map wasn’t about team combat but rather resembled an Insect Race attack map they had previously encountered.
It belonged to a tower defense genre.
The information given before entering the map was too scarce, and the map’s name had misled his thinking.
“Look at the ground.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit squatted on the ground, gazing complexly at a black tile: “This must be the hidden Prop mentioned in the map rules.”
This immense white space was the House of God referred to in the prompt.
A pure white cubic space, with nothing inside but the crimson countdown on the four walls and the floor covered in white and black tiles.
The group’s location was in the bottom left corner of this white space.
They were standing on nine red tiles, which likely served as the starting point.
Adjoining this red square beneath their feet were two black tiles, one directly in front, the other directly to the right.
The black tile in front had several lines of text on it.
‘1+1=?’
‘A.1, B.2, C.3, D. Infinity.’
‘Answer correctly to step on this black tile and receive a Special Prop.’
The black tile to the right also had two lines of text.
‘In right triangle ABC, ∠C=90°, BC=a, AC=b, and 3a=4b, then ∠A’s degree is approximately=?’
‘A.53.7°, B.53.13°, C.53°13′, D.53°48′.’
‘Answer correctly to step on this black tile and receive a Special Prop.’
“Quite the Worded Book,” Tuberculosis Rabbit muttered as he stood up, hands in his pockets, staring down at the mathematical problem on the black tile: “I’ve said before that we absolutely must have a mathematician in our team. Look, now we need one, don’t we?”
“Anyway, I can’t solve this. See if any of you can.”
Sword Without End sighed heavily, his face serious as he scanned the surroundings and spoke earnestly, “The situation is now quite clear; we have ten minutes in the House of God—that is, in this white space—to dig up sufficiently powerful Props.”
“After the countdown ends, this seal will be lifted, and we will face a deluge of demon attacks. If we can’t dig up powerful enough Props within these ten minutes, we definitely won’t be able to hold out for 24 hours.”
“We are now in the bottom left corner of the white space; these nine red tiles are the starting point. With only ten minutes, we don’t have enough time to dig up all the Props, so we must make targeted choices.”
“Choose either the path made by the black tiles directly in front or the path made by the black tiles to the right.”
“Personally, I prefer the path to the right. The difficulty of the math problem on the black tile to the right is much higher than the one in front about what one plus one is. The higher the difficulty, the more powerful the Prop should be.”
“What do you think?”
“I think you make sense,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement: “So what do you think is the answer to the black tile to the right?”
“I don’t know.”
“You don’t know? Aren’t you a college student? Don’t tell me you can’t even solve this problem?”
“I returned that knowledge to my math teacher long ago.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit rolled his eyes at Sword Without End speechlessly and turned his head to look at Chen Yi, waiting for Yi’s instructions.
Chen Yi stood calmly in place, not making an immediate choice, but instead looking at the paths following the two black tiles. The black tile in front had three junctions after it, adjoining 12 black tiles.
The black tile to the right had seven junctions, adjoining 32 black tiles.
In other words,
Theoretically, choosing the black tile in front would yield at most 12 Special Props, whereas the path to the right could yield up to 32 Special Props.
Without much thought,
He glanced at the countdown—now only nine minutes—calmly stepped onto the rightmost black tile.
‘Ding—’
A sound echoed in the ears of the small team.
‘Player Chen Yi’s answer is B.53.13°, correct, this black tile may be stepped on.’
The next second—
The black tile under Chen Yi’s feet suddenly turned bright red, and a Prop floated up from below ground, gently hovering midair, its panel appearing before everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 169: 167: "Which organ has the longest muscle in the human body?
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 167: “Which organ has the longest muscle in the human body?
“Prop Name”: Angel’s Wings.
“Prop Level”: None.
“Prop Effect”: Upon activation, every member of the squad will have angel wings appear on their backs, allowing free flight for ten seconds.
“Prop Restriction”: Number of uses (1/1)
“Prop Description”: Can only be used on the squad map ‘Destiny’s Adversary,’ cannot be taken out of the map, and will automatically be destroyed upon leaving the map.
Answering correctly, they successfully obtained a prop.
“My guess was right.”
The scene unfolding before him confirmed the thoughts in Sword Without End’s heart, making him more confident as he spoke with a slightly hasty tone, “The key to this map lies in whether or not we can obtain enough props before the House of God disappears.”
“These props are also crucial for us to last the full 24 hours.”
“The tougher the questions, the richer the prop rewards.”
“Wait a second—”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood at the starting point with a somewhat strange expression, looking toward the black square directly in front at the start, hesitatingly said, “Maybe we can split up?””
“I might not know the answer to the other questions, but I do know 1+1.”
He tentatively stepped onto the black square that was right in front of the starting point.
The next second, a prompt sounded in everyone’s ears.
‘Ding, you may only choose one fork in the road. Once a player in the squad chooses a path, the others cannot attempt to take any other forks.’
‘Player Tuberculosis Rabbit, please leave within three seconds, or you will be immediately deemed to have failed the challenge.’
The moment Tuberculosis Rabbit stepped on it, the black square beneath his foot began to flash wildly.
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit withdrew his right foot with some annoyance, looking toward Chen Yi’s back, “It won’t work, Yi. Map rules don’t allow splitting up; we can only take one path.”
“But when we first entered the map, I received an additional piece of information.”
“There’s a white square on this map that, if stepped on, allows you to receive a hidden question and a hidden reward.”
The map’s rules explicitly prohibit stepping on the white square.
Yet, by virtue of his Title Effect, Tuberculosis Rabbit knew about this hidden information on the map – a rather important piece of information that no player from any team would step on the white square without knowing about it beforehand.
Stepping on it means failure – who would do that for no reason?
Chen Yi didn’t speak; he just frowned slightly and looked at the question on the next black square in front of him.
‘How many bones does a normal human have?’
‘A. 163, B. 206, C. 198, D. 112.’
‘Answer correctly to step on this black square and receive a special prop.’
He seemed to remember Tuberculosis Rabbit mentioning it once, but he hadn’t listened closely at the time, and he was actually quite unsure about the answer.
“It’s 206!””
Standing behind Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit raised his hand with utmost confidence and said, “Pick B. This is my specialty, isn’t it? I might not know the rest, but I’m super familiar with this one.”
“When I have nothing to do, I like to take all the bones out of a corpse, mix them up, and then piece them back together into a skeleton.”
“It’s like puzzles, very stress-relieving.”
“…Why would you have a hobby like that?”
Looking sideways at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a somewhat unpleasant expression, Sword Without End asked, “How did you develop such a habit? It’s only been a few months since the aftermath arrived; could these few months have changed your personality so much?”
Before the aftermath, the laws were very strict; nobody would allow Tuberculosis Rabbit to play with corpses in his spare time.
“Everyone needs to have their own hobbies to prove they’re not just the walking dead,” Tuberculosis Rabbit responded.
“But speaking of which, Yi, I remember you never went to school. How did you figure out the answer to that math question earlier?”
‘Ding—’
‘Player Chen Yi’s answer was B. 206 bones, which is correct. The black square may now be stepped on.’
Accompanied by the black square turning blood red as well, a prop wrapped in white light emerged from beneath the ground and floated in front of Chen Yi.
“After coming out of that idiom solitaire amusement park last time, I started cramming all this knowledge, so I would at least know the basics and avoid getting into that kind of predicament again.”
Chen Yi replied nonchalantly, then turned his attention to the prop that was floating before him.
He had been self-studying for a long time now, not just math, but including physics, chemistry, language, and more, not for any other reason but the fear of encountering a rule attack similar to idiom solitaire again.
No matter how high your defense is, no matter how much damage you deal, if you can’t continue the idiom chain, you die. This kind of rule attack makes anyone nervous.
Such attacks can’t be defended against; you can only try to make yourself into a jack-of-all-trades fighter.
These days, whenever he had free time, he was self-studying these things, and now it seemed to come in handy.
‘Prop Name’: Demon’s Resentment.
‘Prop Level’: None.
‘Prop Effect’: Once activated, the player who activated this prop can forcibly attract all the demons’ hatred around them onto themselves.
‘Prop Restrictions’: Number of uses (1/1)
‘Prop Description’: Can only be used within the team map ‘Destiny’s Adversary’, cannot be taken out of the map, automatically destroyed after leaving the map.
He casually stuffed the prop into his pocket and turned his gaze back to the black cube in front of him.
A crossroads appeared.
To the left was a black cube.
To the right was a… colorful cube.
The question on the black cube was:
‘Which organ has the longest muscle in the human body?’
‘A. Tongue, B. Male genitalia, C. Calf, D. Abdomen.’
‘Answer correctly to step on the black cube and obtain a special prop.’
But next to the colorful cube was only a question mark and a simple line of text.
‘Stepping on this colorful cube will lead to some unknown events. Whether it’s a blessing or a curse is completely unknown, but one thing is for sure, there is nothing inside the colorful cube that will cause certain death.’
“…”
Chen Yi sighed, lifted his hand to rub his temples, and felt a bit weary for a moment. The unpredictability of this map was too strong, and he didn’t like this feeling.
Just like this colorful cube.
No one knew what was inside this colorful cube; this intense uncertainty gave him the feeling of gambling.
He had no worries about whether he could clear this map.
With the incredibly high speed of his vehicle, all he needed to do was activate the vehicle to maintain high mobility. There was no way those demons could catch up, and if their moving speed was faster than his sled’s.
Then there’s no point in talking about holding out for 24 hours. Other teams would all die upon arrival.
No matter how you look at it, it’s just a Level D map. It’s not supposed to wipe teams repeatedly.
What he wanted was a higher score for the map, and…
Clearing the map wasn’t just about surviving for 24 hours; there was also the option of annihilating all the monsters.
…
ps: Regarding the absence of an update yesterday and the lack of notification, I’d like to offer an explanation.
I went to the park yesterday, and my backpack fell into the lake there, with both my laptop and phone getting soaked.
I didn’t dare to turn them on for the whole day.
After keeping them in rice for a full day and night, I tried turning them on, and thankfully, they booted up without damage. I was unreachable for a whole day, with no updates or leave notices.
My fault, I apologize.
(I put them in rice because I’ve heard that rice can absorb water, helping the laptop and phone to boot up normally.)
(Yesterday was my birthday. Since both my phone and laptop were water-damaged and I was out of touch all day, I was concerned that I might’ve missed any birthday wishes, but as it turned out… after booting up, there were no birthday wishes to respond to.)
(Instead, I found quite a few messages urging an update, asking if I’d become a eunuch, gone inside, or died, as well as other kind messages of concern.)
(Thank you all, I appreciate that you remember me.)
(Will correct typos after posting. As I couldn’t make an update yesterday, I took the opportunity to organize the upcoming outline, which will lead to some exciting developments in the storyline…)

chapters.title: Chapter 170: 168: The Tuberculosis Rabbit has a habit of talking in its sleep, but you'll get used to it.
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 168: The Tuberculosis Rabbit has a habit of talking in its sleep, but you’ll get used to it.
“Yi, do we step on this colorful square?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit hesitated for a moment before speaking uncertainly, “I know the correct answer for that black square on the left, choose C, the calf.”
“The longest muscle in the human body is in the calf. Although I don’t know the specific scientific name of that muscle, I have stripped and compared all the muscles.”
“There’s also a widespread notion that the tongue is the longest muscle in the human body, but it actually isn’t.”
“As for that colorful square, I’m not sure what we’ll encounter.”
“…”
Sword Without End glances at Tuberculosis Rabbit with an odd look, not knowing why, he feels this person is a bit creepy. Which normal person would be so curious about human anatomy, even medical students aren’t as passionate as Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Chen Yi looked up at the countdown, which had a little over 7 minutes left, and after a moment of silence, he decided to step on the colorful square.
The next second—
‘Ding, player Chen Yi stepped on the colorful square, triggering a special event!’
‘Random draw for a special event in progress…’
‘All members of the team will be transported to the Lin Yin Artistic Foot Bath Shop for a mandatory one-hour massage!’
A prompt sounded in everyone’s ears.
Before Chen Yi and the others could react, the scene before their eyes suddenly went dark. When they came to their senses again, they found that at some point, they had changed into loose bathrobes and were lying on three sofas in a private room.
Three long-legged girls holding small bags, dressed in short skirts, black stockings, and high heels, stood in front of them and bent over to greet them softly.
“Good evening, sir, masseuse number 117 at your service.”
“Good evening, sir, masseuse number 520…”
As they bent over, the view was like branches and leaves in a spring courtyard, uncontrollably breaking over the wall and bursting forth.
Before they could even speak, the long-legged beauties began to squat down, placing everyone’s feet into foot bath buckets.
“What the hell!!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was stunned for a moment, then raged, “Who the hell has time to get their feet washed here? Aren’t we mapping? Forced foot bath for one hour?”
“By the time we get out, the House of God’s countdown will have already ended!”
“What kind of crappy random event is this?!”
He did like foot baths, and he liked these beauties, he liked Silver Party even more. He was no Liuxia Hui, the man known for his resistance to temptation, but it still depended on the situation, dammit!
Everyone was busy mapping, who was in the mood to care about this?!
Chen Yi got up with an unpleasant expression, put on his slippers, walked to the room’s door in the private room, and tried to see if he could open the door to leave. But as soon as he was about to turn the doorknob.
Some lines of light text suddenly appeared on the wall.
‘Please have players return to the sofa. Leaving the sofa for more than one minute or forcibly breaking out of the private room will result in a failure to clear the level and a permanent ban from entering the team’s map as punishment.’
‘During this hour, we hope that the players will earnestly enjoy this moment of respite amidst your busyness.’
There was also a countdown below.
’00:59:37′
“…”
After standing at the door in silence for a while, Chen Yi let go of the doorknob quietly, lay back on the sofa, rested his arms behind his head, closed his eyes, and spoke softly, “Go easy, I can’t take too much pressure.”
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit turned to look at Chen Yi beside him, somewhat anxiously said, “Yi, you’re just going to leave it at this? We’re in the middle of a map, how can we get a high enough map score if we don’t collect enough props before the House of God finishes?”
“Don’t you care at all?”
“What use is worrying?”
“Um… seems like it’s useless, but at least it would show our sincere attitude, right…”
“If it’s useless, then just continue lying down. We’ll see what happens when we get out.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit also lapsed into silence. After a moment, he stripped off the upper part of his bathing suit, lay bare-chested on the sofa, and slowly closed his eyes, “Press harder, I can take it.”
He felt that Yi made sense.
They couldn’t leave anyway. What good would worrying do? Better to calm down and enjoy this so-called foot massage.
Sword Without End, lying on the far left, saw that Tuberculosis Rabbit and Chen Yi had both given up trying, and he too relaxed, imitating their positions by resting his arms under his head.
“Don’t make it too strong or too weak, I like the pressure to be just right.”
Half an hour later.
They were all feeling a bit drowsy by then. The private room was undoubtedly pleasant, with modern decor and cozy, intimate lighting.
In the dim light, the shadows seemed to dance endlessly.
Despite being an enclosed space, the air was exceptionally fresh. There were no ventilation fans to be seen; perhaps they were using some air purification method unknown to them.
And at that moment, they still had 30 minutes left before leaving this unusual event.
Out of boredom, Tuberculosis Rabbit casually took out a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and started puffing smoke carelessly as he spoke nonchalantly, “Hey, bro, there’s something I’ve never understood.”
“You always give me the impression that you’re deeply devoted to your wife, but why did I see you at Silver Party on my first visit?”
“You were even hitting on a woman.”
“Don’t you know that makes me feel like your character is very inconsistent?”
“Can deep love and patronizing prostitutes coexist?”
“…”
Sword Without End turned his head and stared intently at the cigarette in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s mouth, feeling a bit of an itch to smoke himself, and after a while, he finally spoke up, “Is it allowed to smoke in this room? Aren’t there any July rules restricting it?”
“There are.”
“Then why are you smoking?”
“Oh, isn’t there a three-strike leniency? I have a habit of smoking while getting a foot massage, so I’ll just use one of those chances.”
“Can you stop smoking? It’s making me crave a smoke.”
“Can’t do, but you can light one up too. Take your time and smoke in hell. My art gallery always has a space reserved for you, right in the center.”
“I’ve even got a two-meter-high cross ready to go; once you die again, I’ll nail your corpse to it.”
“You haven’t answered my question yet. If you love your wife so much, what were you doing at Silver Party? Is that a place for a Pure Love Warrior like you to be?”
After a long silence, Sword Without End finally spoke softly, “It’s true that I love my wife, but I also have physical needs to fulfill. I know this might make me seem disgusting and scummy, but humans are inherently dual-sided and contradictory.”
“I love only my wife and won’t fall for another woman, so I won’t remarry, nor will I find a new girlfriend.”
“But… I also desire women.”
“Often, I feel like a hypocritical Pure Love Warrior. I was in a lot of pain before because of various things—because I couldn’t control myself from seeking women after my wife’s death, because I didn’t have the money to save her, because I felt worthless.”
“But later, I came to terms with myself.”
“I stopped overthinking it and just lived in a daze. Maybe only when facing the true moment of death will I wake up to the true meaning of my life.”
“What about you, why did you go to Silver Party?”
“With your status and fame, you don’t need to spend money on such places. Just a wave of your hand, and countless women would throw themselves at your feet for your protection.”
He turned his head towards Tuberculosis Rabbit, but what he heard were fragmented, incoherent mumblings.
“Having a foot bath, with Yi and Sword Without End.”
“It’s that Sword Without End I made into an art piece. He suddenly came back to life and joined our team. We encountered a special event while exploring the map, and that’s how things turned out.”
“Yes, the kid’s had it rough. We should really look out for him. If not for us, he wouldn’t have such a lonely and doomed fate.”
“Still, I feel like he’s more suited to be an art piece mounted on a wall.”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit?”
Sword Without End sat up, looking somewhat bewildered at Tuberculosis Rabbit, whose eyes were tightly shut and mouth moving without pause. He couldn’t quite grasp the situation—what was Tuberculosis Rabbit saying?
Why couldn’t he understand?
“He’s talking in his sleep.”
Chen Yi didn’t open his eyes, speaking in a lazy tone, “Tuberculosis Rabbit has a habit of sleep talking. Just get used to it, no need to worry about it.”
“He falls asleep quickly; just keep talking about your thing.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 171: 169: "Let me know in advance next time you run away.
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 169: “Let me know in advance next time you run away.
“Uh… should I continue? Can he hear me?”
“He can’t hear you, but you were baring your heart, right? It would be quite awkward to stop now, so just keep going, I’m listening.”
“Oh…”
Sword Without End lay down awkwardly again, not speaking further as the air fell silent once more. Minutes later, suddenly sitting up and looking towards Chen Yi, who was lying on the far right, he said, “Um, Yi, do you think I’m too much of a beast?”
“Not really.”
Chen Yi, with his eyelids drooping, quietly enjoyed the comfort and casually said, “I don’t really care about that, there’s no need to say it to me. I don’t care about these things.”
“I care about something else.”
“I have a small notebook here with over a hundred names in it. Next time you go to Hell, help me take care of them.”
“Over a hundred?”
Sword Without End’s mouth slowly opened wide, incredulously asking, “Yi, I’ve only just come back not too long ago, and you’ve already got over a hundred names in your notebook again?”
“Yeah, those you saw on the ceiling at Tuberculosis Rabbit Art Gallery. It took me quite an effort to find those names.”
“What I mean is I won’t be going down there for a while. After all, my wife isn’t in Hell, and I’m not going to be running to Hell all the time.”
“No problem, there’ll be a chance.”
Soon.
The next half-hour quickly passed amidst Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dream talk, and with only a minute left, they were about to leave this special space.
Chen Yi had become immune to Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dream talk, it went in one ear and out the other without lingering in his mind.
But Sword Without End was hearing it for the first time.
The more he listened, the more Sword Without End felt something was off. He sat up abruptly, turning to Chen Yi with a serious expression, “Yi, I don’t think this can still be considered simple dream talk, right?”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit was just discussing killing all the players on Blue Star and then using their corpses to build a Sky Ladder to Heaven. These logical statements don’t seem like the nonsense of dreams.”
“Oh, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s dream talk has always been very logical.”
Chen Yi said nonchalantly, without much concern.
“How can dream talk possibly be logical!”
“Haven’t you seen already? It really does make sense.”
“But he also said in his dream that he wants to dismember me and use my blood to lay out some sort of big formation on the ground.”
“It’s just dream talk, don’t mind it.”
“…”
Sword Without End, without speaking, turned his head with a complex expression to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit. Just as he was about to say something, he suddenly saw Tuberculosis Rabbit open his eyes, seemingly still craving more as he wiped the drool from his mouth.
“Is it time? Then get ready for battle. The countdown in the House of God outside should have ended by now.”
“How did you suddenly wake up?”
“Because the countdown to the special event is almost over.”
“You can tell the countdown to the special event is almost over in your dream?”
“Nope.”
“Then how did you suddenly wake up?”
“Because the countdown to the special event is almost over, didn’t I just say that?”
“Smack!”
Sword Without End slapped himself expressionlessly, then, after a moment, somewhat unsatisfied, he slapped himself in the mouth again, feeling that his decision to join this team might have been a bit irrational.
Previously, he had only seen Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit demonstrating strong abilities, and they seemed to carry good temperaments as well.
But after today’s close interaction, he suddenly felt that not only were their strengths formidable, but their mental states seemed a bit abnormal too.
The peculiar sleep talk from Tuberculosis Rabbit and Chen Yi’s complete lack of reaction were baffling. With Chen Yi’s intelligence, it was impossible for him to be indifferent to such an obvious oddity, yet it truly didn’t seem feigned.
And Tuberculosis Rabbit was even stranger. Who talks so logically in their sleep, and can become aware of an external countdown nearing its end and wake up?
Can clearly understand the outside world and speak so logically.
Is this really dreaming?
You must have gone running off to a meeting in Another World!
“Ding, special event ‘Forest Hidden Foot Bath’ has come to an end, returning to the map now, please prepare yourselves, players.”
Vision fading to black, and upon opening his eyes again, he found himself back in the House of God.
At this point, the walls and ceiling had disappeared, and the floor below had been replaced with red tiles.
Clearly, the ten-minute countdown in the House of God had finished long ago during their hour in the special event.
They hadn’t even begun to assess the situation in the House of God when,
they saw the periphery of the House of God packed with a dense, endless crowd of Demons who, upon seeing them, charged rapidly towards them with red eyes and howling!
“Seeking death!”
Sword Without End’s expression hardened, his eyes flashing with cold light, and the Three-Foot Qingfeng beside him shot out, striking straight into the demon horde. In the blink of an eye, dozens of demons’ heads were neatly severed.
But what followed were even more demons, swarming up like locusts, bringing an oppressive sensation that made it hard to breathe.
“Yi, we…”
He took a deep breath, his eyes filled with determination, ready to fight to the death. He turned to consult Chen Yi on their defensive strategy but was suddenly shocked to find Chen Yi and his companion had vanished from his side.
He stood there somewhat stupefied, unsure of what to do.
“Hey, look up.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s voice sounded by his ear.
Instinctively looking up, Sword Without End noticed a sled floating in the air, which he hadn’t seen before, and Tuberculosis Rabbit sat in the seat, leaning out to look down at him.
His lips twitched slightly, but without delay, he glanced at the demons just a few meters away from him, then slowly stepped onto his Three-Foot Qingfeng and rose next to the sled, looked up at Tuberculosis Rabbit on the sled and said with some resignation,
“Give a heads up before you run next time.”
“Sorry about that, we didn’t expect you to not run. We’re still lacking some understanding between us, next time we’ll be sure to remind you.”
After Sword Without End and the others ascended, the demons below suddenly came to a standstill. Every demon looked up toward the three in the air, their faces contorted with rage as they howled continuously and brandished their pitchforks.
“It seems like they lack the ability to fly, as well as measures to counter airborne attacks,”
Chen Yi observed the demons below and, seeing no further action from them, came to his conclusion.
These demons looked a bit like gnolls, their weapons resembling pitchforks, their skin was a bright red, riddled with numerous cracked wounds, through which one could see the scalding red blood churning beneath.
“If that’s the case, then this Destiny’s Adversary on the D-level team map will be much easier. All you need is the ability to fly for an extended period, and it’s very easy to clear this map.”
“One might say, as long as you have a flying vehicle, this map can be cleared with a hundred percent certainty.”
Chen Yi once again supplemented his conclusion with further information.
“But without the ability to fly or a flying vehicle, to survive for 24 hours amidst such an overwhelming tide of monsters is nearly a pipe dream, unless one acquires sufficiently advantageous props in the House of God.”

chapters.title: Chapter 172: 170: "No matter how fast those two kill, can they be faster than the ten of us together?
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 170: “No matter how fast those two kill, can they be faster than the ten of us together?
“Is it that simple?”
After listening to Chen Yi’s conclusion, Tuberculosis Rabbit curled his lips, “That being said, this map doesn’t seem very difficult, either. It lacks any real challenge.”
“The threshold is already very high.”
Chen Yi gazed into the distance, “Among so many players worldwide, there aren’t many who own a vehicle, let alone a flying one.”
“This map has two conditions for a pass: one is to last for 24 hours, and the other is to wipe out all the demons.”
“But the demons below nearly overlap with the horizon, and at a rough estimate, there must be at least a million of them. With so many demons, there’s no way any team could kill them all within 24 hours.”
“We couldn’t either.”
“But since they’ve set up this kind of condition for passing, it means there must be a way. We just haven’t discovered it yet. This thing might be hidden inside the House of God or somewhere in this map.”
“Let’s go take a look.”
“Okay.”
Sword Without End nodded, jumped off his Three-Foot Qingfeng, and landed on Chen Yi’s sled, finding a comfortable seat to sit down.
The next second—
The sled shot towards the distance.
However, just after they had started,
Chen Yi suddenly slammed on the brakes with a glint in his eyes. Leaning on his cane, he looked down at a larger demon within the tide of demons and smiled with the corners of his mouth lifted.
“Congratulations, gentlemen, it looks like we’ve hit the jackpot.”
This demon was larger than the others, appearing more robust and intimidating. It was now looking up at the three of them in the sky with an angry face, repeatedly raising its dung fork and roaring.
But more importantly was the demon’s information panel.
“Monster Name”: Level 1 Mother of Demons.
“Monster Introduction”: All the little demons you see are the children of the Level 1 Mother of Demons. These children obey their own mother’s orders, just as these Level 1 Mother of Demons obey their mother’s—the Level 2 Mother of Demons—orders.
“Monster Introduction”: “It is said that the biggest difference between Heaven and Hell is that Heaven enforces family planning while Hell encourages the breeding spree.”
“All the demons here have mothers, and their mothers are the Level 1 Mother of Demons; the Level 1 demons also have mothers, whom are the Level 2 Mother of Demons.”
“Do you know what this means?”
“Really?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit froze for a moment, then stood up excitedly with a fist pump, “Doesn’t that mean we can annihilate all these monsters with one shot?”
“Won’t this map’s difficulty rating directly skyrocket?!”
“Wait a minute…”
Sword Without End was somewhat baffled, “What does that mean? I didn’t quite catch it.”
“Ah.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit grabbed Sword Without End by the shoulder and explained excitedly with a hurried voice, “Yi’s skill can not only see through one layer of clothes but also see the basic information panel of some bosses that don’t wear clothes.”
“The information panel on that little boss down there clearly writes that these demons are born alive, not spawned—they all have moms.”
“And Yi has a skill that, if he kills an enemy with his firearms, and if the enemy is a monster, then he will annihilate their entire 999 clan along with it!”
“This means Yi just needs to find the biggest demon mom, kill it, and all the demons here will die because of Annihilate Nine Clans!!!”
“One-shot screen wipe!”
“This, this, this…”
Sword Without End took a moment to process before also turning red with excitement, “Doesn’t that mean we don’t need to last 24 hours, and just need to find the biggest demon mom to pass with the second method?!”
“Exactly!”
“Damn, that skill is too sick! Annihilate 999 clans, I love it! So, how do we find the biggest demon mom?”
“The larger the size, the higher the level of momhood, so the largest one should be the biggest demon mom!”
“What are we waiting for? Let’s go!”
Sword Without End, unable to wait, rubbed his hands together and looked ahead eagerly.
“…”
Chen Yi glanced back at the Tuberculosis Rabbit and corrected with some reluctance, “Please refer to Matriarch, do not use the word ‘mom.’ It sounds very strange.”
“Then now, let’s set off!”
Chen Yi paused for a moment before shouting excitedly!
The next second—
The sled shot towards the distance, continuously weaving through the air above the demon tide, in search of that ultimate Mother of Demons!
…
At this moment.
In another map of Destiny’s Adversary.
The Sin Department Team One, led by the man with a scarred face, stood with the Sin Department’s most elite nine members atop a Flying Boat hovering above the demon tide, each team member using their own means to continually attack the demons below.
Every minute, dozens of demons died as a result.
“Brothers, let’s go all out!!”
Scarface wiped the sweat from his face, raised the RPK machine gun in his hands, and shouted from the edge of the Flying Boat, “The difficulty of clearing this map isn’t high, as long as you have the ability to fly for 24 hours you can clear it!”
“The several squads that entered with us are not weak teams; they should all have the ability to fly!”
“To get a high map evaluation score and more rewards, we must kill enough demons on top of enduring for 24 hours!”
“This time, our Sin Department Team One must get 100% map evaluation score, and take the first place in the map team ranking! Even the Skywake Squadron has to bite the dust behind us!”
“There are only 16 hours left until the end, give it your all, brothers!”
Only then did Scarface hug the golden RPK in his arms and aim its barrel at the dense demons below, his finger firmly on the trigger.
Bullets tore through the air like a storm, shredding the demons below into mincemeat!
Only the sound of Points being deducted buzzing in his ears was a bit painful to hear.
Although the weapon was excellent, it was a bit too costly in terms of Points.
At this moment, a squad member beside him, slightly out of breath, leaning on his knees in exhaustion, spoke up, “Boss, what if Chen Yi’s Rabbits Do Not Kill chose this map too?”
“Last time, Chen Yi’s team got a 100% map evaluation in Night Widow Village, while our Sin Department Third Team only got 8% of the map evaluation score,” the member continued.
“Chen Yi’s completion of the map sets a very high standard for full map evaluation. If Chen Yi’s team comes to this map, we might also get a low score, maybe not even reaching 30%.”
“Scared of what?!”
Scarface roared with confidence, “Even if Chen Yi’s team really comes to this map, they will still be below us on the score ranking. This map mainly tests the ability to remain airborne and the capacity for area attacks.”
“For staying aloft, Chen Yi’s team naturally does not lack.”
“But, when it comes to area attack abilities, Chen Yi’s team only has two people. Our Sin Department Team One is a full squad of ten members, and I am personally present. The other nine are also the strongest players of the Sin Department.”
“This lineup can be called a Galaxy warship; no matter how fast those two kill, can they kill faster than our ten?”
“Everyone go all out, we must take first place on this map!”
The nine other team members exchanged glances, their hearts filled with confidence, and they all shouted excitedly, exerting their utmost capabilities to minimize the demons even a little.
So far, no lv.2 squad has appeared on the global team leaderboard.
To qualify for a promotion to the leaderboard, one necessary condition is to clear a level D map.
All ambitious teams are now striving to be the first to make it onto the leaderboard!
Especially ambitious teams like the Sin Department, Skywake, and Langya.
Establishing a reputation early on means that when the Guild Creation Orders are later obtained, they can use their early fame to recruit more powerful members to join their own guilds, thus strengthening their power in the game!
When it comes to rewards, Scarface’s golden RPK machine gun, which he never ceased firing for 24 hours straight, consumed far more Points than it earned from the map.
It was entirely a loss-making transaction.
Why bother with a map at a loss? Wasn’t it to achieve a good score, take the top spot on the map’s team ranking, and get quickly onto the global team leaderboard to gain fame and lay the groundwork for guild creation?
In this day and age, no one is a fool—fools have long since passed away.

chapters.title: Chapter 173: 171:
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 171:
“Another second-tier.”
Chen Yi’s brow furrowed as he withdrew his gaze from the dense demon horde below. After searching for a full hour, he had encountered plenty of first-tier Mothers of Demons, and second-tier Mothers of Demons weren’t too rare either.
But so far, he had not seen a single third-tier Mother of Demons, let alone the Matriarch of the Mothers of Demons.
There were simply too many demons, swarming and nearly blotting out the sky, and there was no good way to search for the Mother of Demons. He had no choice but to keep looking in this dead-end way.
Just then—
“Over there!”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes shone as he pointed excitedly toward a noticeably taller demon in the distance and spoke rapidly, “Yi, check the information of this demon?”
“This demon is clearly bigger than the second-tier one we encountered before!”
“Let me take a look.”
Hope surged once more in Chen Yi’s eyes as he focused his gaze.
A moment later, he shook his head slightly in disappointment, “No, it’s just a third-tier Mother of Demons. If I’m not mistaken, the fourth-tier Mother of Demons must be the ultimate progenitor of all demons.”
“We have to find the fourth-tier Mother of Demons.”
“Sigh!”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed dejectedly, lighting a cigarette with a hint of fatigue and putting it to his lips, “My eyes are starting to hurt from looking at all these swarming demons.”
“Let’s keep searching.”
…
After a full three hours.
Chen Yi and his group stood on the sled, eyes filled with anticipation, looking down upon a massive demon.
“Confirmed.”
Chen Yi slowly took out his Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle from his embrace and aimed the muzzle at the giant demon below, revealing, “I can confirm that this demon is the Mother of all the demons here.”
“Bang!”
With no nonsense, a bullet shot forth.
They had spent a full four hours to locate this Mother of Demons, definitely not for a reunion, but to bury the bullet harshly into the demon’s body.
A burst of blood bloomed atop the demon’s head, no damage numbers burst forth, just the enraged roar of the Mother of Demons.
But aside from the roar, there was nothing else.
None of the demons on this map had the means to fly, nor did they have any countermeasures against aerial attacks, even the bosses among these demons were the same; they just had thicker health bars, higher defenses, and stronger attacks.
As bosses, they had no way to retaliate against players in the air.
And the rules didn’t allow these demons to use ladders, so they were utterly helpless.
“Bang, bang!”
Chen Yi fired shot after shot after shot, thoroughly enjoying himself as if he was shooting at targets.
Without a health bar on the boss, he could only watch its bodily condition deteriorate, counting silently in his head how many shots it would take to kill it.
But as the saying goes, rules are rigid, people are flexible.
Under Chen Yi’s relentless and storm-like assault, the Mother of Demons in the horde couldn’t take it any longer. With an angry roar, it picked up a Little Demon by the feet, spun it around in the air a few times, and then hurled it directly at Chen Yi’s sled below!
“Whoosh!”
The speed was so fast it even created a sonic boom!
If captured by a high-speed camera, one could even see a faint blue flame caused by the high-speed air friction around the Little Demon!
Chen Yi quickly controlled the sled to dodge the strike with no hesitation, continuing to aim his Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle at the Mother of Demons below and pulled the trigger again.
An unartistic battle.
Rudimentary and brutal.
But practical.
The Mother of Demons below barely struggled for less than ten seconds before it fell to the ground with a wail, eyes full of tears and injustice!
“Bang!”
As the last bullet fired off, the C-level skill “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans” activated!
Dozens of crimson beams, like red threads, shot towards the third-tier Mothers of Demons in the distance, and almost at the moment the red lines reached them, these third-tier Mothers of Demons also died a violent death!
And the instant these third-tier Mothers of Demons perished, more red lines shot out from their corpses, targeting the second-tier Mothers of Demons in the distance!
First-tier Mothers of Demons, Demons.
It was like this—
In just three seconds, countless red lines spread instantaneously through the bodies of all the demons below them, much like a laser grid.
“Bang!”
The next second.
All the demons froze in place and, after a second’s pause, simultaneously exploded!
Countless streams of crimson blood burst in the air like magma!
Strikingly gorgeous!
Even the moon hanging in the sky seemed to be tinged with a faint blood-red hue.
With one shot, the entire field was cleared!
One shot, soul extinguished.
“So beautiful…”
Standing beside the sled, the Tuberculosis Rabbit gazed down at the scene below with a look of rapture on his face, resting his arms on the railing and murmuring, “Seeing such a beautiful view makes the more than four-hour run worthwhile.”
Next to him, Sword Without End, with a slight twitch at the corner of his mouth, looked at Chen Yi’s back and then down at the sea of blood and mountain of corpses below, muttering under his breath.
“What a perverted skill.”
The Three-Foot Qingfeng, which had been coiling around him, quivered slightly, as if agreeing with what Sword Without End had said.
At that moment—
‘Ding, the “Rabbits Do Not Kill” squad, led by squad leader Chen Yi, has successfully cleared the “Destiny’s Adversary” map, and it has been detected that you are the first squad to clear this map.’
‘All squad members individually receive the following first-clearance rewards!’
‘Points*5000, Level 1 Enhancement Stone*20, D-Rank Random Skill Fragment*2.’
‘Below is the squad map evaluation—’
‘You spent 5 hours clearing the map and did not choose to survive for 24 hours but chose to kill all the monsters, which is an extremely extreme and highly strength-and-luck demanding way of clearing.’
‘It’s hard to believe, but you actually did it.’
‘As a reward, you will receive a 100% map evaluation, and since it has been detected that the squad has obtained a 100% perfect reward for this map for the first time, each squad member will receive a Star Fragment as a special reward.’
‘And as a regular clearance reward, each player will receive the following rewards.’
‘Points*5000, Protection Stone*5, D-Rank Random Skill Fragment*1.’
A prompt sounded in the ears of every squad member, accompanied by a blackout and a sudden intense feeling of weightlessness. When everything returned to normal, they were standing on the rooftop of a building in the residential area.
And another prompt sounded in their ears.
‘Ding, it has been detected that every member of the “Rabbits Do Not Kill” squad owns more than 3 C-Rank props, more than 10 D-Rank props, more than 3 C-Rank skills, has a prop enhanced to +12, and has cleared a squad-exclusive D-Rank map.’
‘All promotion conditions are met.’
‘Congratulations to the “Rabbits Do Not Kill” squad for successfully advancing from lv.1 to lv.2!’
‘And for successfully making it onto the “Global Squad Leaderboard”!’
Chen Yi arched an eyebrow and looked up at the “Global Squad Leaderboard.” Currently, theirs was the only squad listed, which seemed to indicate that, so far, no other squad had cleared a D-Rank map.
And with the squad leveling up, they had gained a new function.
‘New function for Squad lv.2: Injury Sharing.’
‘Injury Sharing: When a teammate suffers a severe injury, the squad leader can choose to distribute the injured member’s wounds among the remaining teammates, pulling the injured member back from the brink of death. The cost is that all squad members will sustain a certain degree of injury.’
‘PS: This new function cannot be used in the event of instant death.’
This function was newly added after the squad’s advancement, and it could play a vital role in a life-saving situation under special circumstances.
“100% evaluation.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the map evaluation panel with a satisfied air, unable to stop himself from grinning, “Spending five hours killing all the demons in the map to get a 100% evaluation score—when those other squads that clear by surviving 24 hours come out and see their map scores are only 2.30, they might wonder why there’s such a huge gap.”
“Indeed.”
Sword Without End also nodded in agreement, “When I first entered the map, I never imagined annihilating all the demons. I thought it was about using the props obtained from the House of God to survive a challenging 24 hours.”
“Wasting an hour on a special event without acquiring enough map props, I thought the survival would be difficult.”
“But we just forcefully cleared it.”
“Now it seems that this isn’t a map that absolutely requires cultured people. As long as one is brutal enough, even if one’s cultural knowledge is somewhat lacking, a perfect clearance is possible.”
As Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit were enthusiastically discussing,
Chen Yi shook his head slightly with a trace of dissatisfaction on his face, “It’s not enough.”
“The speed was too slow. It took us a full 5 hours to annihilate all the demons in the map.”
“We wasted too much time looking for that Demon Matron.”
“If I were to go in again, knowing the location of the Demon Matron and including the time spent in the House of God, we would need less than 20 minutes to clear this map perfectly.”
“Then, we can raise the upper limit of the map evaluation scores even higher.”
“Um…”
Somewhat bewildered, Tuberculosis Rabbit hesitated and touched his nose, saying, “But each squad map only offers rewards on the first clearance. There’s no reward for clearing it a second time.”
“I know, but there’s no loss, is there?”
“We can perform stronger, better, and more perfectly on this map. It would be a bit regretful if we stopped here.”
“Okay, no need to talk further.”
“Everyone prepare to enter the map again, and this time, let’s aim to annihilate all the demons within 20 minutes. When we aim for a map, we go for the highest evaluation score!”
“To be the best, we have to do our best.”
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit exchanged glances and did not continue talking. As Tuberculosis Rabbit basically followed Chen Yi’s orders unconditionally, he wouldn’t object, and Sword Without End, who had just joined the squad and greatly admired Chen Yi, naturally would not object either.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 174: 172: “Last time the deputy head of this organization tried to recruit you.”
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 172: “Last time the deputy head of this organization tried to recruit you.”
“Hurry, hurry, hurry!!!”
This time, Chen Yi and the others, within the ten minutes inside the House of God, not only did they not head for the colored blocks, they didn’t even step on any black blocks to obtain any props, patiently waiting for ten minutes afterward.
They sped off toward the direction of the Matriarch they remembered, controlling the sled at full speed!
Not delaying a single moment.
Three minutes later.
A gigantic Demon Matriarch appeared before them. Without any hesitation, Chen Yi stopped the sled right on top of the Insect Race Queen’s head and almost jammed his sniper rifle into the Matriarch’s mouth, furiously pulling the trigger.
“Bang, bang…!”
Rapid and muffled gunshots rang out continuously!
Thirty seconds later.
‘Ding…’
The sound of completing the challenge rang in their ears.
Chen Yi’s figure reappeared on the rooftop, he glanced at the map rating in front of him and the watch on his arm, nodding slightly with satisfaction, “Total less than fourteen minutes, including ten minutes delayed in the House of God.”
“This speed is decent.”
At this moment, the ‘Global Squad Leaderboard’ already had the second squad listed.
Rank two: ‘Skywake First Team’, lv. 2 squad.
“Yi.”
Sword Without End glanced at the Global Squad Leaderboard and curled his lip, “This Skywake First Team is that organization I told you about last time, the Skywake Organization, formed by a bunch of players.”
“The organization’s vice president even tried to recruit you before.”
“That counts as recruiting?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, hands in his pockets, shrugged contemptuously, “If you hadn’t mentioned it, I would’ve thought it was a provocation.”
“That female vice president has some issues in the head, but I have to say the strength of this organization is not weak. They seem ready to lower the entry threshold and go the guild route.”
“There are not a few powers planning to go the guild route, including ‘Sin Department’, ‘Wolf Fang’, they all seem to be heading that way.”
“Do you have any thoughts about this, Yi?”
“Currently, you are the most prominent player globally, and the player with the highest fame is also you. You’re first on both the Global Vehicle Leaderboard and the Global Squad Leaderboard. If you decide to go the guild route, there will likely be no shortage of players willing to follow you.”
“No.”
Chen Yi shook his head calmly, “I don’t have such plans for the time being.”
“Let’s continue with the next map, we can rest after one more map today.”
The conditions for a lv. 2 squad to advance to lv. 3 are quite strict.
The squad needs to possess a B-rank prop, pass a D-rank map three times, and achieve a map rating score of over 70% at least once.
For the next map, Chen Yi had already made his choice. After browsing through the team map, he fixed his gaze on one particular map.
“Let’s go with this one.”
‘Map Name: Silent Deserted Island.’
‘Map Description: It is said that after night falls on this secluded island, it will welcome some mysterious visitors.’
“Alright.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit had no objections, but he couldn’t help feeling a bit of pity for the squads still struggling in that map as he looked at ‘Destiny’s Adversary’ on the team map panel.
Yi had pushed the score limit for this map to an absurdly exaggerated extent.
He was a bit curious to see what those squads would react when they exited the map and saw their incredibly low map ratings.
On the surface, this map’s rating and that of another cleared map both show a 100% map rating, but in reality, if the full score of the other cleared map was 100 points, then their map’s full score would be 10,000 points.
No matter how well the other squads scored, even if they got a 100, it would only amount to a 1% map rating.
Simply… outrageous.
And just as they were about to enter the map on the eve of their journey, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly realized something as he looked at the team map’s panel and hastily spoke up, “Wait a minute, Yi, the map we’re going to has already been cleared, ‘Skywake First Team’ got a 100% map rating score on this map.”
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi nodded, speaking softly, “Let’s go in and see how many points we can get, to see how big the gap is between us and this Skywake Squadron.”
“This…”
Sword Without End seemed hesitant to speak.
He knew Chen Yi was very strong, but clearing new maps wasn’t just about strength.
It required considering multiple factors, including attention to detail, reasoning of the plot, discovery of clues, and it also had a lot to do with the number of people in the team; not every map could be dominated by strength alone.
For instance, ‘Skywake First Team’ had a full roster of ten, while they only had three. That was certainly a significant difference.
Now, many outsiders were paying attention to the pioneering of team maps, and among them, their ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team and the ‘Skywake First Team’ were the most watched. In such a scenario, if they ended up with a lower score than Skywake First Team, the impact would be hard to recover from.
This was a risky venture, less profitable than choosing an uncleared D-level map.
But before he could say more,
In the blink of an eye, their vision darkened, and their bodies disappeared from the spot, having been teleported into the map.
…
It was still daytime, still the first day of July, in the afternoon.
Around six o’clock.
Only an hour or two left before nightfall.
“Sis… sister.”
Inside the Garden District, Tie Chui carefully opened a can of beer and whispered to Jiaye, who sat by the window, “You… don’t be sad. Maybe Yi… didn’t want to invite you because he thought the team map was too dangerous…”
Jiaye didn’t speak, only tilted her head towards the beer in her brother’s hand, took it with pursed lips, tilted her head back and gulped down a bottle, wiped the beer from her lips, and looked out the window, silent.
She knew Yi had formed a team and had been waiting.
Waiting for Yi to invite her to join the team.
But even as Yi’s team topped the global team rankings, she still hadn’t received an invitation from Yi.
She thought that after making three meals a day for Chen Yi and delivering them, even if he didn’t have feelings for her, they should at least be considered friends, right?
Did he think she was too weak?
Did he worry that she would hold them back?
Even Sword Without End had joined Yi’s team, yet she hadn’t heard a whisper of an invitation.
After a long time.
“Brother.”
Jiaye’s calm voice drifted into the room with the breeze through the window, “That map access pass is still with you, right?”
“Ah?”
It took a moment for Tie Chui to come to his senses, then he realized and said, “Sister, are you talking about… the Death Domain map access pass? Weren’t you the one who said that map was too dangerous… advising me not to give it to Yi… worrying that Yi would be impulsive?”
“I didn’t tell you to give it to Yi, the two of us are going in.”
“If we go in… we might die, right? That’s a… B-level map.”
“Are you afraid of dying?”
“I…”
Tie Chui looked down at the cigarette case hidden in his chest, keeping silent for a long time before stammering softly, “I’m not afraid… I’m afraid for my sister’s life.”
“But we need to become stronger; if we keep going like this, even if we don’t die in the map, we will gradually be eliminated for not keeping up with the strength growth of the average player.”
“The two of us have the strongest skill combination for escaping; as long as we don’t separate, we can almost escape any danger.”
“Then… okay.”

chapters.title: Chapter 175: 173: "This is definitely a trap.
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 173: “This is definitely a trap.
“Ding, the team leader of ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill,’ Chen Yi, has chosen to enter the D-level map ‘Silent Deserted Island.’ Each player in the team must pay a deposit of 2,000 Points.”
“Team players are: Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Sword Without End.”
“Below are the map content and specific rules.”
“You have been imprisoned in a secret room deep within the deserted island by some mysterious people, and there is a time bomb set to explode in 4 hours beside you. The bomb is powerful enough to level the entire island to the ground, and you must escape the island within 4 hours.”
“Map clearance rule: Successfully escape from the deserted island secret room.”
“Map rules”:
1: On this map, all titles, Skills, Props, Vehicles, etc., can be used normally without any restrictions.
2: There is a hidden passage in the secret room that leads directly to the outside of the deserted island, but a password must be entered. If the password is entered incorrectly three times in a row, the bomb’s countdown will be reduced to 30 seconds.
3: Players may choose to exit the map early, but they must pay a fine of 5,000 Points in addition to the deposit. If there are not enough Points, they cannot exit the map early.
4: The evaluation score of the map mainly depends on the team’s clearance time.
With the sound of the prompt falling,
Chen Yi and his companions slowly regained their vision, and as they steadied themselves, they immediately began to look around. Being seasoned veterans, knowing their surroundings at first glance had become a subconscious act.
A small room of about 30 square meters.
The distance from the ceiling to the floor, roughly estimated to be between 2.2 to 2.4 meters.
There’s a bed, a table, and on the table, an oil lamp alongside some scattered books.
It just looked a bit simple, the bed was constructed from wooden planks, the oil lamp emitted the smell of animal fat, and the room’s lighting relied mainly on this somewhat dim oil lamp.
Of course, after Chen Yi and the others arrived, there were many more sources of light.
The dense mass of titles above their heads was enough to brightly illuminate the small room, although it looked colorful, a bit like the atmosphere in a disco.
The room was completely enclosed on all sides.
There was only one closed wooden door.
“Is this the secret room?”
With a cigarette in his mouth and hands in his pockets, Tuberculosis Rabbit walked aimlessly in the room, observing every item casually and said, “No offense, but I feel like I could even kick that wooden door down with one foot!”
“Sword Without End, do you want to give it a try?”
“Why don’t you do it?”
Sword Without End frowned and gave Tuberculosis Rabbit a look: “Do you think I’m stupid? Even an idiot could guess that if we were to forcefully kick open that wooden door, it would definitely trigger some crisis, right?”
“And can you stop wandering around in the room with a cigarette in your mouth? I’m worried for you. Please keep the rules of July in mind.”
“Got it, got it.”
With some annoyance, Tuberculosis Rabbit picked up a book from the desk and flipped through it randomly: “What kind of crappy rule is that for July, not smoking feels like my combat power has plummeted.”
“Better not to smoke, be a civilized person indoors.”
“Do I look like a civilized person to you?”
Meanwhile, Chen Yi had also surveyed the room and had a rough understanding of the situation, there were two passages.
One was that closed wooden door, and the other was a password door on the wall.
If the correct password is entered, the password door can be opened allowing passage through the secret tunnel to leave the deserted island. According to the display on the password door, it’s a 6-digit password.
A 6-digit password.
Without any information, guessing a 6-digit password correctly is virtually a fairy tale.
There are a million different combinations, with a one-in-a-million chance of guessing correctly on three tries, barely better than the odds of winning the lottery.
As for that wooden door, it was most likely locked from the outside, and there must be some information or tool within this room to help them unlock the wood door and leave the room.
So far, however, no clues have been discovered.
“Hmm?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes suddenly lit up as he noticed a slight bulge under the blanket on the bed. He strode over, lifted the blanket with one swift motion, and pulled out a somewhat yellowed leather-bound book from underneath.
“We’ve got information!”
Chen Yi and Sword Without End, who had been exploring separately, instantly hurried over to join Tuberculosis Rabbit in examining the diary for any useful information. It seemed this map was designed for an intelligence challenge; they couldn’t use force and had to find critical information to proceed.
A while later.
The group had finished reading all the information recorded in the leather-bound book; it was a diary.
But everyone fell silent, standing still.
After a while, Tuberculosis Rabbit quietly offered his assessment.
“Another idiot.”
“I once saw a TV show about a game. In it, the protagonist, a team captain of an esports game, could talk to a man from the future.”
“Whenever the protagonist talked to that man from the future, they only discussed women, the game, and whether his team had won the championship.”
“When I saw that scene, my head was filled with curses.”
“With that ability, why care about your crappy game team? Why not ask about the lottery? Stocks? Or even just go into cryptocurrency? But no, he asked nothing but whether his team had won the championship in the future.”
“At that time, I kept thinking about what kind of brain-dead screenwriter would come up with such a plot. Now it seems like that screenwriter must have been involved in designing the background for this map.”
The owner of the diary, who was also the owner of this house, recounted his bizarre and brief life.
Basically, he had drunk-driven and killed someone, then attempted suicide out of guilt, but didn’t die and instead was reborn in the past—an almost protagonist-like situation.
But this person didn’t use his ability to change his life; instead, he saw it as a chance for redemption given by God.
In his faith, murder was a grave sin, and suicide was an ever greater sin!
So, this person found an isolated island and confined himself there.
He hoped that by doing so, he could atone for his sins and cleanse himself of his wrongdoings.
“You can’t say it like that.”
Sword Without End actually felt some admiration: “People who are so steadfast in their faith are actually quite admirable. If I had that ability, I could go back and save my wife.”
Chen Yi didn’t comment but frowned and bent down to continue searching under the bed. He hadn’t expected to find anything, but this look indeed led him to discover something new.
Lying beneath the bed was a body that didn’t seem very fresh, with an identity card still in its mouth.
Chen Yi took out gloves from his pocket, put them on, and then removed the identity card from the corpse’s mouth.
The long string of numbers on the identity card made Chen Yi squint unconsciously, looking at the password door that led to the secret passage inside the room.
Sword Without End also noticed this scene and chimed in at the right time.
“According to big data, nearly 34% of people use their own birthday as a password; 26% of people have some numbers that are significant to them, such as their identity card number, phone number, etc.”
“And a few sentimental types use their girlfriend’s or ex-girlfriend’s birthday as their passwords.”
“We could try the birthday; it might just be the correct password.”
“The birthdate on this person’s identity card is March 27, 1989, so the password could very likely be 989327.”
“No, that won’t work.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head seriously in denial. “That’s definitely a trap. If it were that simple, more than just the ‘Skywake First Team’ would have cleared this map.”
“So what do we do?”
Sword Without End spoke with a hint of helplessness: “We don’t know the password for the password door, and we haven’t found any clues to open the wooden door. How are we supposed to get out of this secret room?”
“We can’t just go straight over and push the wooden door open to leave the secret room, right?”
…
