chapters.title: Chapter 176: 174: "Does the Corpse Guardian Even Know About These Things?
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 174: “Does the Corpse Guardian Even Know About These Things?
“You can try.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit rolled his eyes at Sword Without End, “Just by thinking with one’s butt, you’d know it’s impossible for it to be that simple. If it were, there wouldn’t be just the Skywake Squadron that had cleared the game.”
And at that moment.
He also received the extra information on the map that came with the title.
The title allowed him to receive an additional piece of information about the map each time he entered, but whether it was due to some delay or not, he always had to wait two or three minutes after entering the map before getting that extra information.
“Yi, there’s information.”
“The new information says that the walls in this map cannot be destroyed, the walls will perfectly return any damage dealt to them by the players.”
Chen Yi nodded to indicate he understood; the message wasn’t actually surprising.
Upon entering the map, he had surmised that this sealed room was probably not simple and definitely had its mysteries, the walls certainly couldn’t be rashly destroyed. Otherwise, wouldn’t players just smash their way through? What would be the need for decryption then?
“Continue searching for useful information.”
He issued the command expected from a team leader.
…
Soon, 30 minutes had passed.
Chen Yi and the others sat silently on several chairs in the room, not speaking. In that half an hour, they found almost no clues on how to leave the room.
They heard only one piece of information that may or may not be useful.
The owner of the secret room was a person of deep faith.
And it was a murder, not suicide.
This conclusion was reached by Tuberculosis Rabbit after conducting an autopsy on the body.
Beyond that, there were no answers on how to leave the secret room, and the entire scene looked like a closed-room murder case.
Sword Without End looked toward the body that had been disassembled like building blocks not far away, a slight twitch at the corners of his mouth, and he chose not to say too much.
Guess you found yourself an opportunity to perform, right? Is it necessary to remove the fingernails too, just to investigate the cause of death?
As if seeing the questioning look in Sword Without End’s eyes, Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting on the chair, began to explain expressionlessly.
“At most murder scenes, victims would struggle violently before death, and under most circumstances, skin and flesh from the perpetrator can be found under the victims’ fingernails.”
“Almost all perpetrators’ first thought after committing the crime is to leave the scene, and even some professional criminals may overlook this clue, leaving a crucial breakthrough for the case.”
“In the past, nearly eighty percent of murder cases were born out of grudges or for profit; they were simply too easy to investigate.”
“If you go to a strange city, find a secluded village away from cameras, randomly stab a passerby to death, then quickly clean up the crime scene and leave, there’s practically no chance of being caught.”
“Fingernails are a crucial clue that the police will definitely search for in an investigation.”
“Although we don’t have the equipment to analyze the DNA in the flesh under the nails, with the naked eye, we can still tell if it’s a suicide or a homicide. There’s dried flesh under the victim’s fingernails.”
“This alone clearly indicates that the victim was murdered.”
“Even though it seems like the victim died from poisoning, the autopsy revealed that only a part of the victim’s esophagus was cyanotic, showing signs of chemical burns, but no related traces were found in the stomach.”
“This suggests that the victim was force-fed the pesticide after death, and the cause of death should be asphyxiation. Although there are no signs of fingers around the victim’s neck, the victim’s nose is slightly skewed, and the area around the nose and mouth is somewhat pale.”
“There are obvious injuries in the mouth left by teeth, and the lividity is purplish-red.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused briefly, then calmly adjusted his glasses on the bridge of his nose and picked up the empty pesticide bottle from under the bed: “This is weed killer, and practically all weed killers contain potassium chlorate, which is also clearly labeled on this one.”
“Deaths from potassium chlorate poisoning will have brown or yellowish-brown lividity.”
“But the lividity from asphyxiation is typically purplish-red.”
“The body may look old, but it’s not been more than three days since death; there are obvious signs that it was aged artificially.”
“The crime scene at the time becomes very clear, someone smothered the victim with a pillow while he was sleeping, leading to death by asphyxiation. The victim struggled and left the perpetrator’s flesh under his fingernails.”
“After the victim suffocated to death, the murderer took this bottle of pesticide, pried open the victim’s mouth, and poured it down force-fully.”
“They then stuffed the victim’s ID into his mouth to create the scene of a suicide.”
At this point, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but shake his head with some emotion: “The way the scene was handled is too amateurish; this level is not even qualified to be an apprentice to Yi and me.”
“Such obvious clues that the police would definitely search for are just ignored.”
“It’s simply unprofessional.”
“And you, Sword Without End, I’m the professional in this area, even Yi is slightly inferior to me. You shouldn’t question me on this.”
“…”
Sword Without End was silent, completely silent. He looked down at the dismembered pieces of flesh beside him and remained absolutely silent.
He was convinced, truly convinced.
What in the world was all this?
After a long while,
he couldn’t help but speak, “Tuberculosis Rabbit, didn’t you tell me this morning that before the afterworld arrived, you and Yi were working in the morgue as Corpse Guardians?”
“Corpse Guardians know this stuff?”
“Well,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit smacked his lips and said, “Normally, Corpse Guardians wouldn’t know this, but as you know, Yi and I were both orphans, struggling to survive alone in this highly competitive big city. Naturally, we needed to have some side businesses.”
“That just means learning a few extra things, having more skills can never be a bad thing, right?”
“Your side business…”
Sword Without End thought about it but decided not to continue asking. He knew without a doubt it probably wasn’t any ordinary side business. However, he suddenly remembered something and hurriedly said,
“Wait, I once gave you a ‘Life Theater’ Map Access Pass, the one that grants access to the unique, effective map. There’s a hidden task in that map, to clear one’s own criminal suspicion.”
“Did you complete that hidden task?”
Originally, he had never thought about this matter, after all, that hidden task was simply too perverse.
Only 4 minutes of time given, a body lying in the living room, a dagger on the coffee table, it almost went as far as carving the words ‘suspect’ on one’s forehead. It would be surprising if someone could clear their criminal suspicion in such a short time!
Though he admitted Chen Yi was strong, he didn’t believe Chen Yi could complete such a twisted hidden task.
But Tuberculosis Rabbit’s comments just now made him suddenly think that if it were Tuberculosis Rabbit, perhaps he really could have a chance to clean up the crime scene within 4 minutes.
“Oh, you’re talking about that one, Yi and I both completed it,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Chen Yi, who continued to search for clues nearby, and casually said, “Yi hid the body, then found out through the diary that the deceased had only social relations and didn’t officially exist—an unregistered recluse woman with autism.”
“So he played the role of having split personality disorder, stabbed his own stomach, and made the police believe that Yi had killed another one of his personalities.”
“Just like that, he successfully cleared his criminal suspicion.”
“This…”
Sword Without End stood there, shocked, never having considered that completing the hidden task this way was possible. At first glance, it seemed feasible, but on further reflection, it made no sense at all!
“This is impossible, you only had 4 minutes—how could you clean all the blood in the living room? That blood belonged to the victim, and a simple test would reveal that. And there’s the body to hide; how could there be enough time for that.”
“Tsk…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit grinned: “That requires a professional to do—cleaning up a crime scene, Yi and I are professionals at that, ordinary people certainly can’t manage it.”
“And you, did you pass the level in the same way?”
“Not me, I passed by refusing to admit it to death.”
“What does ‘refusing to admit it to death’ mean?”
“It means that I’d rather die than confess it was me who killed the person.”
“…”
Sword Without End, with a twisted expression, sighed, “You’re not treating me like a fool, are you? If all it took to clear one’s own criminal suspicion was to stubbornly deny it, then aren’t the police in that map all fools?”
“Because it wasn’t you who killed the person?”
“It wasn’t me who killed the person?”
Sword Without End paused, confused, and said, “That’s impossible. When I entered the map, the computer showed me how to dispose of the body. The woman in the living room was lying in a pool of blood, there was the sound of police sirens downstairs, and the weapon was on the coffee table.”
“Under these circumstances, if it wasn’t me who killed the person, then who could it have been?”
“Indeed, it wasn’t you who killed her. Basically, the story goes, you were bored with life with your wife, then you secretly hired someone online to ‘discipline’ your wife. That person was your neighbor Old Wang.”
“In the end, Old Wang entered your house and killed your wife.”
“You hid under the bed and narrowly escaped this disaster. After Old Wang left, you hurriedly crawled out from under the bed, and as a mysterious person, you kept educating Old Wang on how to clean up the crime scene, trying to make him go upstairs and clean the scene quickly.”
“But since you didn’t know how, you could only search online.”
“Worried that the incident would implicate you, you deleted your contact with the other party, and then you lost your memory. What follows is you entering the map and starting to play this role.”
“This hidden task isn’t that difficult; as long as you keep steadfastly denying it and give the police enough time to investigate, you could pass easily.”
“The reward is quite generous too; what, you didn’t complete it, did you?”
“…”
Sword Without End felt somewhat dispirited, turned his head expressionlessly to the side, his heart continuously bleeding. He would never have imagined the method to complete the hidden task could be this simple!
The person wasn’t killed by him!
What kind of joke is this?!
And is the real plot of this map too abstract or something? Are any of this edition’s map designers sane?
Meanwhile, Chen Yi walked straight to the wooden door, without hesitation, grasped the doorknob, and pushed hard.
“Bang.”
The wooden door was pushed open.

chapters.title: Chapter 177: 175: "The 6-Digit God Code.
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 175: “The 6-Digit God Code.
“The door… the door opened?”
When they saw Chen Yi effortlessly push open the wooden door that had trapped them for half an hour, both Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit stood there, dumbfounded.
What’s happening?
Was the door unlocked? Could it really be opened just by pushing?
Upon stepping outside the wooden door, Chen Yi couldn’t help but twitch slightly at the corner of his mouth, feeling embarrassed.
He had searched every corner of the room but couldn’t find the slightest clue about the wooden door.
Only after making sure nothing was overlooked did the possibility cross his mind that perhaps the wooden door was not locked at all.
Once all possibilities are excluded, the last one, however implausible, must be the truth.
They had assumed that leaving the room would require some mechanism to open the wooden door, but to their surprise, it just needed a simple push.
“Well…”
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit, momentarily speechless, grimaced at each other in silence, grateful that no one had witnessed the scene, or they would have been utterly humiliated.
“Wait for me, I’ll try the password.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit immediately turned around and headed back toward the coded door inside the room. Originally, he did not plan to try entering the password because that ID card was too conspicuous and looked like a trap.
But now he wasn’t so sure anymore.
Perhaps this map was really simple, and they had just overestimated it.
‘989327’
‘Ding, password incorrect, two attempts remaining, after three consecutive errors, the bomb will begin a 30-second countdown.’
“That’s not right.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit frowned, expressing disappointment.
At that moment, Sword Without End leaned in from behind and tentatively said, “Try reversing it to 327989.”
“Reverse it?”
“Yeah, according to social engineering statistics, a significant portion of people use their birthdays as passwords, for instance, 989327. But since payment software and banking passwords can’t be the same…”
“Many people’s other common password is their birthday reversed, to make it easy to remember.”
“Makes sense. I’ll try again.”
‘327989’
‘Ding, password incorrect, one attempt remaining, after three consecutive errors, the bomb will begin a 30-second countdown.’
“Still incorrect.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head in disappointment, stood up, and quickened his pace to catch up with Chen Yi: “Let’s go. There’s no hope of passing the level by opening the coded door to leave the corridor; let’s aim to clear the level normally.”
The corridor was not short.
They reached the end after just a few steps.
At the end of the corridor was a small room with a sign hanging above it.
‘Push open the wooden door to enter the first challenge, after clearing the sixth challenge, all players can leave the island safely.’
This glaring sentence virtually slapped each of the three onlookers in the face.
“…”
A blank-faced Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the wooden sign and said, “So the three of us were searching the room for half an hour, but actually, there was nothing in that room, just a starting point for players, right?”
“The challenge officially begins after you push this wooden door open, right?”
“Interesting.”
Chen Yi did not speak but simply pushed open the door in front of him.
A rather spacious room was revealed, with a wooden sign on the wall marking the first challenge.
Four display screens were hung on the wall, each with an English letter beneath it: A, B, C, D.
Each display screen showed a looping video.
On the first screen, a man was seen crying as he drank pesticide and lay down under the bed.
The second screen showed a man being suffocated to death by a figure in black covering his mouth and nose.
The third screen displayed a man being smothered to death with a pillow in bed by someone in black.
The fourth screen depicted a man being knocked out with a hammer and then forcibly poisoned with pesticide.
Another line of text was on the wall.
‘Question: Which of the following death methods applies to the victim at the starting point? The captain must make a selection.’
‘Answer correctly to proceed to the next challenge. Answer incorrectly, and the bomb countdown will be reduced by two hours.’
“Well, isn’t this special?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was momentarily taken aback before turning to look back and discovering that the wooden door through which they had entered the room had vanished. He then broke into a grin: “Looks like our time wasn’t wasted at the starting point. The first challenge of this escape room fits right into our previous experience.”
“Do we even need to ask? It’s obviously C, smothered to death with a pillow.”
The escape room was a one-way trip.
That is to say, if they hadn’t carefully searched the starting point and had just pushed open the wooden door to come to the first challenge and wanted to go back to check when they saw this question, they would have found no way back.
Then it would have been over; they would have had to make a wild guess.
It seemed that spending half an hour at the starting point wasn’t such a dumb move after all; instead, it led them to stumble upon plenty of valuable information.
“Wait!”
Sword Without End interrupted, speaking seriously, “Tuberculosis Rabbit, you just deduced that the deceased didn’t die from strangulation but from suffocation. Then option B could also be possible, after all, we can’t tell whether they were smothered with a hand or a pillow.”
“Sigh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed helplessly, “When I explore the map with Yi, he never asks me these questions. If someone was suffocated with a palm, there would be clear abrasions around the nose and mouth. Even killing a pig would involve some struggle, let alone a person.”
“Only by smothering with a pillow could you avoid leaving abrasions around the nose and mouth.”
At this point, Chen Yi had also made his choice.
‘Ding, congratulations to the “Rabbits Do Not Kill” team for answering correctly. The correct answer is C, answer successively to enter the next round.’
A wooden door slowly appeared on a wall inside the room, indicating for people to enter.
Chen Yi and the others exchanged glances, and instead of entering immediately, they cautiously searched the room they were in for clues, in case there was no turning back.
The room was relatively empty, apart from a display on the wall, there wasn’t much else.
In the corner of the wall, there was a homemade cross.
And in front of the cross, there were two distinctly pale marks.
“The victim must have often knelt here to pray in this house,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit mused aloud, “When I examined the body just now, I noticed that the knees were slightly deformed, a sign of prolonged kneeling.”
“Such deformity couldn’t have happened without a long accumulation of time.”
Having found no other useful information, Chen Yi entered the wooden door to the next round, and as they entered the next room, the wooden door behind them also slowly disappeared.
There was no way back.
On the wall was an obvious bomb countdown timer.
’03:19:42′
With a little over three hours left, the bomb would explode, and if players couldn’t successfully leave, they would have to spend Points to do so, or else, the price would be death by explosion.
This level also had four display screens.
On the wall hung a wooden sign with “Second Level” and a line of question written on it.
‘Question: Why did the original victim confine themselves here?’
The display screens listed four answers.
1: To avoid debt collectors.
2: Committed something wrong years ago and fled to this small island.
3: Knew the depth of their sins and sought redemption here.
4: Asocial by nature, unwilling to deal with the outside world, preferring a reclusive life.
‘Answer correctly to enter the next level, answer incorrectly and the bomb countdown decreases by 2 hours.’
“This answer is also very simple, pick C,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke somewhat emotionally, “It seems the clues at the starting point are very important, but the mechanics of this map are quite interesting—the bomb countdown starts at 4 hours.”
“Answer incorrectly once, and it decreases by 2 hours.”
“It looks like there are two chances of making mistakes, but in reality, there’s only one. Once you answer incorrectly, there’s less than 2 hours left on the countdown.”
“If you answer incorrectly again at this point, the bomb will explode immediately, leaving no chance to leave the map in advance.”
“So after one incorrect answer, the second chance turns into a gamble. If you answer incorrectly, the bomb explodes right away, leaving no chance of escape. It’s like betting your life for a chance.”
“I just don’t know if all six levels of this escape room are in the form of Q&A like this?”
Sword Without End looked around and picked up the conversation, “If that’s the case, there could be a possibility of cheating, right? Just tell the answers for the six choices to others, then they can get through too, and the map rating would then just be about who runs faster.”
“It’s completely unrelated to the clues.”
“That’s true.”
Chen Yi didn’t join the conversation, calmly chose C, answered correctly, and smoothly moved on to the third level.
The third level’s question—
‘When is the victim’s birthday?’
“March 27th, choose D.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit quickly gave the answer, raising his eyebrows slightly with a touch of pride, “It’s very simple, isn’t it?”
Then he turned to Yi beside him, started to speak with some confusion, “Yi, what are you thinking about? Ever since we started at the initial point, I’ve felt that you haven’t been quite right. Do you sense something off about this map?”
Chen Yi stared at the options on the wall in front of him silently for a while before speaking, “Do you remember when we entered the map, the rule mentioned that by inputting the correct starting point password, one could use the secret passageway at the starting point to leave the uninhabited island and pass the level successfully?”
“Of course, I remember.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head helplessly, “But with a six-digit code, there are a million possible combinations. Without enough clues, there’s no way to guess what the password is.”
“I think I may have figured out the password to that door.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was stunned for a moment before speaking incredulously, “Yi, are you serious? How did you figure out that password? Sword Without End and I have already tried, it’s not the birthday.”
“It’s normal that it’s not the birthday.”
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes calmly and continued, “Someone who drank themselves into a murderous rage, reincarnated to the past, found a small island for redemption, doesn’t seem like someone who would care about their own birthday.”
“Such a person naturally wouldn’t use their own birthday as a password.”

chapters.title: Chapter 178: 176: "Total Dimensional Suppression!!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 176: “Total Dimensional Suppression!!!
“A person’s password is often a reflection of the most important thing to them.”
“We’ve actually gathered quite a few clues, including that diary, the cross at the first checkpoint, and the white marks on the ground from kneeling for a long time, all of which are enough to prove that the deceased was a devout believer.”
“Many devout believers often use a password that is—”
“God’s code.”
“God’s code?”
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at each other and hesitated before asking, “What do you mean? What is God’s code? I’m a bit lost.”
“392766.”
“This sequence of numbers is a common password among devout believers.”
“The Old Testament of the Bible has 39 books, the New Testament has 27 books, making a total of 66 books in the entire Bible.”
“Put together, it is 392766.”
“Some devout believers frequently use this sequence of numbers as a code, and you can even find a forum dedicated to 392766, which signifies that God will forgive your sins.”
“The reason the deceased came to this deserted island was to seek redemption, and if a devout believer were to set a six-digit password, it’s highly likely they would choose 392766.”
“Unfortunately, there’s no way to go back the same way we came; this map has no retreat.”
“392766…”
After Sword Without End murmured the numbers softly, his eyes suddenly lit up, “Even though I don’t understand all this, I think Yi, your analysis is very logical. God will forgive your sins. This meaning almost perfectly aligns with the purpose of the deceased coming to this island.”
“Let’s try this map again later.”
“Let’s head to the fourth checkpoint first.”
“All right!”
…
Meanwhile—
In a corner of a city conference room.
The President of Skywake looked solemnly at the nine people below and instructed, “We just spent an hour and a half to clear the D-level squad map ‘Silent Deserted Island’ with a 100% score, which not only earned us a lot of rewards but also boosted our fame significantly.”
“But—”
“It’s not enough!”
“Chen Yi’s ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ squad made it onto the ‘Global Squad Rankings’ earlier than us, and they are ranked higher as well.”
“In the E-level map ‘Night Widow Village,’ Chen Yi’s team scored a 100% map rating, while we, ‘Skywake Second Team,’ only scored a 23% rating. Such a huge gap has made the public quite optimistic about Chen Yi’s squad.”
“This is unfavorable for us, ‘Skywake’ must be first.”
“We need to create a significant gap between us and any other squads that will clear ‘Silent Deserted Island’ in the future.”
“We need to enter it again, and this time we won’t need to waste time searching for information.”
“The answers to the first three checkpoints are CCD, and we’re already familiar with the safe path for the last three checkpoints.”
“This time, we can definitely clear this map within 30 minutes, by then our map rating will be significantly higher than other squads.”
“Did everyone get that?”
“Understood!”
In the conference room, the other nine people responded in unison.
Only a red-haired woman, whose face bore a complex expression, remained silent. She was Yan Niang, the Vice President of Skywake.
In a world event, she had interacted with Chen Yi once.
That interaction had been unpleasant.
Afterward, with a single shot dealing a million damage, Chen Yi dragged her reputation through the mud, and to this day, Chen Yi’s reputation has only grown while Skywake never got another chance to recruit him.
If she had not resorted to reverse psychology back then, and instead had kindly invited him, perhaps she could have pulled Chen Yi into their team.
At that time, Chen Yi hadn’t shown enough strength, only that he was lucky, but now it seems Chen Yi is not only exceptionally strong but also has his own unique methods for clearing maps.
“Push on, push on!”
After encouraging the team, the President of Skywake re-entered the map, ready to aim for an even higher map rating!
First place?
No, nowhere near enough!
The very purpose of Skywake’s existence is to drive the second place to despair!
If a map claimed by Skywake as first place allows the second place to score even 30% rating, it’s a disgrace to them!
This is their confidence!
Even before the team feature was released, Skywake had organized many powerful players; first place was theirs by right and necessity!
…
“Ding, ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ squad, led by Captain Chen Yi, has successfully cleared the map ‘Silent Deserted Island,’ and each team member will receive the following rewards!”
“Points*5000, Level 1 Enhancement Stone*10, Wing Fragments*5.”
“Here is the team map rating—”
“You spent two hours and eighteen minutes to clear this map, with a map rating of 87%!”
“Your team ranks second on the map’s squad leaderboard.”
Soon after, the remaining three checkpoints were cleared smoothly.
Chen Yi and his team reappeared on the rooftop of the residential building.
At this moment, only two teams had cleared ‘Silent Deserted Island’: ‘Skywake First Team’ and ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ squad.
“87% map rating?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit raised an eyebrow lightly, “It seems that ‘Skywake First Team’ must have taken less time than us.”
“Yi, try the method you just mentioned again.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yi pulled a cigarette from his pocket, glanced at the sky above, then lit it up and put it to his mouth, “Let’s have a smoke before going in. You can’t smoke in the game map. Let’s take a break, no rush for these few minutes.”
“That’s true.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit took out a pack of cigarettes, tossed one to Sword Without End, and also lit up one for himself.
The three sat on the rooftop and started puffing away, but it wasn’t long before Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face turned odd.
They saw that apart from their own tall building, the rooftops of all the other high-rises were filled with people. Many smokers had gathered on the rooftops, unapologetically blowing smoke into the air.
Clearly, due to the influence of the July rule change, many smokers had taken to using rooftops as smoking areas.
This scene… well, it was rather spectacular.
No one had come to their building; apparently, the locals knew these few liked to hang out on this building’s rooftop and didn’t dare to come up and compete for the spot, to avoid trouble. Hence, the rooftops of other tall buildings had all become smoking areas.
Meanwhile—
Online discussions had already started ramping up.
“Did you see that? Chen Yi’s team also entered the Silent Deserted Island map, but their map rating score isn’t as high as Skywake’s.”
“Saw it. They say Chen Yi really has skills. In such a short time, he’s already cleared 3 maps consecutively, 2 with 100% rating scores, and one with an 87% rating score.”
“Indeed. For the Night Widow Village map, Chen Yi set the bar for the map score too high, the second place only has a 23% map rating score, you can’t even see the tail lights.”
“I know the second place on that map is ‘Skywake Second Team’. The Second Team’s strength isn’t on par with Chen Yi’s, but on the Silent Deserted Island map, ‘Skywake First Team’ got a 100% map rating score, while Chen Yi’s team only got 87%.”
“Even though Chen Yi is strong, his team has only three members. The overall strength of their squad should be above Skywake Second Team, but below Skywake First Team.”
“That’s not necessarily true, Chen Yi’s team also got 100% on the ‘Destiny’s Adversary’ map.”
“That’s because Chen Yi is the only one who’s cleared that map so far, so of course the rating score is full. If Skywake First Team were to try that map, Chen Yi’s rating might immediately drop below 50%. Everyone who clears a map first gets 100% rating. Don’t you even know that? Don’t embarrass yourself, you’re making me laugh.”
“If you think it’s so easy, why don’t you go get a 100% rating?”
“I don’t wanna get it. What’s it to you?”
“Come on then, name the place. Where are you from? I’ll come have a word with you face to face.”
“Black Trench City, No. 781, 9th Street. Come on, look for your daddy. If you don’t come, you’re a coward. Yelling on the internet like you’re calling your mom, huh?”
Meanwhile, Chen Yi and his teammates, oblivious to all this, finished their cigarettes, nodded to the smokers on the surrounding rooftops, and then re-entered the map.
They returned to that familiar chamber.
The moment they touched down,
Chen Yi didn’t hesitate to rush to the password door and entered a series of numbers.
“392766”
“Ding, password correct. Players may clear this secret passage to leave the deserted island early, and…”
Chen Yi and his team’s eyes lit up, then without another word, they hopped onto a sled and shot along the straight, bright passage ahead!
Before the prompt finished, the sound of clearing the map rang in their ears.
“Ding, ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team, led by captain Chen Yi, has successfully cleared the ‘Silent Deserted Island’ map. Since it’s already been cleared once, there are no rewards this time.”
“Here is the team map rating—”
“You spent 7 seconds to clear this map, which is simply unthinkable… among a million numerical combinations, you found the correct password, and you have an extremely fast vehicle that swiftly took you through the passage.”
“Under all these factors, you have created a miracle.”
“Perhaps this miracle will never be broken.”
“Map rating score is 100%.”
As their vision went dark for a moment and then returned, Chen Yi and his teammates reappeared back on the rooftop and exchanged glances, each seeing the amusement in the other’s eyes.
A 7-second clear.
Think you can surpass us? Good luck figuring that out.
Yi didn’t guess wrong; the password really was 392766.
By this time, the ‘Silent Deserted Island’ map’s team ranking had been updated, and the rankings had changed.
“Silent Deserted Island Team Rankings”
First place team: “Rabbits Do Not Kill,” map rating 100%.
Second place team: “Skywake First Team,” map rating 1%.
Meanwhile, a smoker on a nearby building, who had just been looking in the direction where Chen Yi and his team disappeared, said, “Did you see? Just now, big shot Chen Yi even nodded at me. They probably went to play another map, they’re so dedicated, plus…”
But before he could finish,
He suddenly found that Chen Yi and his team had reappeared in the same spot.
Standing there stunned, he rubbed his eyes and said somewhat dazedly, “Did they come back? Which team’s map clear time is so short? A few seconds to clear?”
Another smoker nearby, also puffing on a cigarette, expressed his disbelief in shock, “Quick, look at the Silent Deserted Island map’s team ranking. Big shot Chen Yi’s team is already in first place!”
“And the former first place, Skywake First Team, went from a 100% rating to 1%!”
“A complete dimensional crushing!”
By this time, the internet had completely exploded!!!
Innumerable people in disbelief and frenzy kept posting and scrolling discussions!!!
What a joke!!!
Are you fucking cheating at the game? Can’t you at least try to hide it?
…
ps: I’ve posted 5 chapters tonight. The first 2 make up for yesterday, and the last 3 are the regular updates. I’ll correct any typos after posting.
I’m really amazing, the promises I made I’ve actually kept.
Can I get some monthly votes to encourage me a bit!
I, Wang Xin, am a man of my word!
When I say I’ll update, I never stand you up!
Definitely got to buy a cake to celebrate!

chapters.title: Chapter 179: 177: "Don't wait until your face is slapped to know pain.
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 177: “Don’t wait until your face is slapped to know pain.
The direction of the wind on the forum was changing at a speed visible to the naked eye!
Before Chen Yi and his team entered the map for the second time, people on the forum were discussing how “Skywake First Team” had achieved a 100% map rating, while Chen Yi’s “Rabbits Do Not Kill” had only received an 87% rating!
Many were saying that Chen Yi’s team was stronger than Skywake Second Team, but not quite as strong as Skywake First Team.
But no one expected to be proven wrong so quickly.
It was just the time it took to smoke a cigarette.
Chen Yi’s “Rabbits Do Not Kill” refreshed their record, obtained a 100% map rating, and pushed “Skywake First Team”‘s rating down to a mere 1%!!
“Am I seeing things, or did Skywake First Team’s map rating just drop to 1%?”
“What else could it be? Obviously, Chen Yi and company went in again, and this time they got a map rating so exaggerated that it crushed Skywake First Team’s score to 1%.”
“Even so, isn’t that a bit too exaggerated? How can a 100% rating turn into 1%? Isn’t that a bit too preposterous?”
“You think that’s exaggerated? Chen Yi’s team got a 100% rating because that’s the highest possible score, and Skywake First Team got a 1% rating because the lowest possible score is just that, 1%. The gap between them isn’t simply 99.”
“Paying a lot for Chen Yi’s secret to clearing the game!”
Suddenly, the forum online was in an uproar.
Chen Yi stood on the rooftop, looking at the prompt in front of him, raised an eyebrow slightly with a smile, and said nothing. Seeing such a rating was much more pleasing.
“This really pushed Skywake First Team’s face to the ground for a good rubbing, eh.”
Sword Without End was scrolling through the forum discussions and commented, “If the President of Skywake were even a bit petty, they’d have taken an instant dislike to us.”
“No, they wouldn’t.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit lit a cigarette from his pocket, took a drag, patted Sword Without End on the shoulder, and said with a wide grin, “Yi and I have always been well-liked, never had any enemies.”
“…”
Sword Without End’s lips twitched slightly but he said nothing.
Yes, no enemies.
Perhaps it’s more accurate to say there are no enemies left alive?
Those who offended you were all sent to hell by you, weren’t they? Is there even one left jumping around on Blue Star?
The enemies you have in hell, weren’t they also taken care of by him?
Right now, there are more than a hundred adorable little ones waiting for him to deal with down there. Although he really didn’t want to go down another time, for some reason the look in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes always made him feel like he was about to drop dead the next second.
“Hmm?”
Suddenly, Sword Without End’s eyes lit up and he looked at the forum with a strange expression, “Someone from Skywake has spoken up.”
“Take a look.”
“Oh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned in curiously, “What did they say?”
‘Skywake’s declaration of war!’
‘My name is He Chaowei, the Director of Public Relations for Skywake. We acknowledge the strength of Chen Yi and his team; they are among the top players. We’ve always admired the capabilities of Chen Yi and his team.’
‘But Skywake is the strongest player organization in the world. As of May, we had already started taking shape, and under the leadership of our President, we’ve gathered a formidable array of players. Our strength is not to be underestimated.’
‘Out of the top hundred on the Global Vehicle Leaderboard, 17 are members of Skywake.’
‘A 1% map rating does not reflect the true strength of Skywake. Chen Yi discovered how to clear this map, and naturally, so did we. The President has already led Skywake First Team back into the map.’
‘When the President comes out, perhaps everyone will then see Skywake’s true strength.’
‘Those who are kicking Skywake when it’s down should be charitable with their words; don’t wait until it’s your own face getting slapped to start feeling the pain.’
Beneath the post, the comments section exploded.
There was support, skepticism, ridicule, admiration, insults, and flattery.
Reading all manners of comments is like observing all the vicissitudes of life.
“Yi?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with a somewhat odd look on his face, “Looking at this statement, the President of Skywake has also guessed the six-digit password, right?”
“Probably.”
Chen Yi didn’t seem to pay it much mind and casually said, “After all, the password 392766 isn’t that hard to guess, as long as you have a bit of a curiosity for peculiar knowledge, you can pretty much nail it.”
“But even if they guess the password correctly, they shouldn’t be able to get a higher score than us. After all, our vehicle’s speed ranks first in the world, and no one has surpassed it yet.”
“If their vehicles are slower than ours, it’s destined that they’ll take more time to clear the map than we do.”
“Let’s go, that’s it for today.”
“It’s getting late, time to go to sleep.”
“As for you…”
Chen Yi turned his head to look at Sword Without End, pausing for a long while before saying, “You’ll be staying in Yancheng during this period. Just find yourself a house. That’s fine.”
“Okay.”
Sword Without End nodded, seemingly without much thought.
“Or you could come to our place if you want.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, seemingly not yet satisfied, licked the corner of his mouth, “We even have a spot on the wall for you, come over anytime you like.”
“…”
Without expression, Sword Without End glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit and, without a word, stepped onto his Three-Foot Qingfeng and sped off into the distance.
…
Three minutes later.
Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit had already gone back to their room to prepare for bed.
“Hasn’t come back yet?”
Wearing a bathrobe and lying in bed, Tuberculosis Rabbit scrolled through the team rankings on “Silent Deserted Island”: “The map score for ‘Skywake First Team’ is still at 1%. If they guessed the password, they should have come back by now, right?”
“Could it be that they didn’t guess the password?”
And just then—
The team rankings on “Silent Deserted Island” finally showed a change for ‘Skywake First Team’!
“It moved, it moved!”
The map score for Skywake First Team quickly rose, climbing from 1% to 1.28% in a matter of seconds and then stopped…
“1.28%?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit strangely looked at the number, and after being sure that he wasn’t seeing the decimal point incorrectly, he turned to the hottest thread on the forum.
As expected.
As he had anticipated.
A barrage of mockery began swiftly flooding the thread.
‘A whopping 1.28%? You made me laugh. So much for the strongest organization in the world. Go home and raise pigs instead.’
‘I approve of the aggression from the post above.’
‘This quote should be classic: “Don’t wait until your face is hit to realize it hurts.”
‘Hey, does it hurt? It’s the first time I’ve seen someone offer their face up for a slap. Chen Yi hasn’t said a word, and you from Skywake willingly put your faces out there to get slapped. What are you trying to achieve?’
“Wasted.”
“To think I assumed Skywake would have also guessed the password. If they didn’t, why talk so tough?” Tuberculosis Rabbit laments, smacking his lips.
“Really.”
“Let’s sleep.”
Chen Yi wasn’t paying much attention to all this and instead lay on his own bed, picked up an eye mask from the side, and put it on to prepare for sleep.
“Why don’t you take out that massage prop of yours and use it? It’s been a tiring day, could use some relaxation before sleep.”
“Oh, okay.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit quickly opened his prop backpack, looking at the neatly categorized props as he searched, “Just a second, Yi. I’ll look for it; it’s been a while since I’ve used it.”
…
ps: Yesterday, to celebrate the five chapters, I ate a cake and accidentally upset my stomach.
The remaining two chapters are being revised, and I’ll post them as soon as I’m done with the bathroom—very soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 180: 178: "Petty and Malicious!
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 178: “Petty and Malicious!
“Found it!”
A dozen seconds later, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly pulled out a prop from his bosom, held it in his hand, and turned his head to look at Chen Yi, “Yi, should I activate it now?”
“Yeah, activate it.”
‘Prop Name’: Banshee’s Feast.
‘Prop Effect’: Once activated, it can draw everyone nearby into an illusion. In that illusion, a dedicated banshee will massage you for half an hour.
‘Prop Description’: “Banshees have no attacking capabilities, not even teeth.”
A white light flashed, and the prop was activated.
In the illusion, Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit enjoyed the massage from the Banshee and quickly relieved the fatigue of the day.
Soon, both of them drifted off into a deep sleep.
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s sleep-talking timely subsided.
Chen Yi, who was frowning slightly in his sleep, relaxed his furrowed brows upon hearing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s murmurs and entered into a sound sleep.
The two were completely unconcerned with the ruckus outside.
…
Skywake Headquarters.
Inside a spacious meeting room, dozens of people were seated while several more stood on both sides.
Everyone present was a strong core member of Skywake.
The peripheral members recruited over the last few days had no right to enter this meeting room, as they were only part of the foundation for the future establishment of the Guild.
However, the atmosphere inside the meeting room seemed somewhat tense.
The President of Skywake, his eyelids drooping, sat silently in his chair for a while before speaking softly, “Let’s hear it, He Chaowei. What was your original intention in posting that message?”
His voice sliced through the air like a cold blade, causing everyone’s hearts to skip a beat, fearing that they might be the next target.
“I…”
He Chaowei, looking somewhat uncomfortable, slowly rose to his feet. He did not dare to look at the President of Skywake but instead mumbled, “After you all went in, Chen Yi suddenly pushed Skywake’s map review score down to 1% on the ‘Silent Deserted Island’.”
“The online reputation of Skywake is very poor. Skywake never used to show its face publicly, so naturally, we didn’t care about our reputation.”
“But President, didn’t you say our next step is to establish a Guild and attract more powerful players? We need to establish the concept that Skywake is the world’s first of this kind.”
“Seeing you all enter the map with full confidence, I posted an announcement, hoping to salvage Skywake’s reputation.”
“Hmm.”
After a long silence, the President of Skywake, who still hadn’t opened his eyes, nodded lightly in his chair. He didn’t reprimand He Chaowei but continued, “Chen Yi must have found the six-digit password.”
“There are a million combinations for a six-digit password; guessing is definitely not an option. There must be some clues within the map that we missed. Yan Niang, you take Team Three and review the clues thoroughly to see if we can deduce this six-digit password.”
“Yes.”
Yan Niang, with her fiery red hair, nodded seriously before hesitating, “The current trend on the forums isn’t looking good for Skywake. Should we get rid of Chen Yi?”
“This would let people know that when it comes to strength, Skywake is definitely stronger than Chen Yi.”
Upon hearing this suggestion…
The President of Skywake, the middle-aged man, opened his eyes for the first time, gazing emotionlessly at Yan Niang as he asked word by word, “What did you say? I didn’t hear clearly.”
“I…”
Yan Niang, hesitant to meet the President’s gaze, murmured uncertainly, “I said, should we get rid of Chen Yi…”
“Bullshit!”
The President of Skywake suddenly changed his expression, rising from his chair and slamming the table ferociously, he glared at Yan Niang and roared, “Since ancient times, figures like Xiang Yu, Liu Bang, Zhu Yuanzhang, which great personalities have ever claimed they’ve never been defeated? Never failed?”
“Failing once is normal and nothing to fear, but if we react to a defeat by assassinating Chen Yi, do you know how the world would view Skywake?”
“Petty and malicious!”
“What kind of organization would we be if we form a Guild like that? How can we attract people of integrity?”
“It’s sheer stupidity!”
“We’ve just lost once. Instead of hiding it, why not acknowledge it openly? So what if Skywake lost on this map? As long as we can secure 100% review scores on other maps, we can regain our reputation!”
“Assassinating Chen Yi is not even a last resort; it’s an idiotic plan!”
“He Chaowei, you go and release a new announcement. Yan Niang, you’re temporarily stepping down from Team One to take Team Three and review this map. The captain of Team Two will move up to Team One, and we head to the next map.”
“Did everyone get that?”
“Understood!!!”
Everyone in the meeting room responded loudly in unison.
“Dismissed.”
Yan Niang, who had just been scolded viciously, felt the prickly gazes around her and sat down with a sullen face, saying nothing.
…
Inside a study in the meeting room.
“Knock, knock, knock.”
The President of Skywake, who was diligently reviewing every detail of the ‘Silent Solitary Island’ at his desk, heard a knock and said without raising his head, “Come in.”
Quickly.
The door opened.
A tempting figure walked into the room and stood before the desk without speaking.
Seeing that the visitor remained silent, the President stopped his movements and looked up. Upon recognizing it was Yan Niang, he frowned slightly, “What is it.”
“President.”
Yan Niang fell silent for a moment before forcing a seductive smile and licked her lips, “With so many people in the meeting room today, why were you so fierce, huh? You made me lose face.”
“It’s been a long time since I’ve serviced you. Do you want me today?”
“No need.”
The President stared expressionlessly at the woman before him and spoke word by word, “The last time you tried to recruit Chen Yi, you not only failed but also caused a conflict. This led to Sword Without End leaving the Guild, and even Wang Yimei, who just submitted his application, has vanished.”
“You should be held responsible for this incident, but I let it go considering your status.”
“But your suggestion this time was truly foolish. I’ll say it again, if we want to grow our influence, we must think about the big picture. Do you think killing Chen Yi will make you the number one in the world?”
“If you really have that ability, you might as well kill me and become the President of Skywake.”
“…”
The resolute stance of this middle-aged man stiffened Yan Niang’s forced seductiveness on her face. After a long while, she too became colder and said word by word,
“Zhou Ziqiang, don’t bite the hand that feeds you. Are you starting to play your President’s game now?”
“Do you have any idea what my sister’s feelings would be if she knew that you, night after night, ride on top of me, pulling my hair while galloping wildly?”
“A man who indulges his own wife’s sister day and night is now pretending to be a gentleman?”
“Fine, if you have the guts, kill me today. After I die, I will have a good talk with my sister about how you vent your beastly desires on me usually.”
The previously expressionless middle-aged man suddenly fell silent upon hearing this, his eyes slowly closed and he didn’t speak. After a long while, he softened his voice and said, “You can leave now, I was wrong in this matter.”
“Tomorrow, I will help you regain your face in front of everyone.”
Yan Niang let out a cold laugh, did not speak, but turned and left.
…
After Yan Niang had left,
The President of Skywake leaned back in his chair with eyes closed, and from the desk drawer, he pulled out a pack of cigarettes, lit one, and placed it between his lips, completely disregarding the rules of July, and with the mist of smoke around him, he looked up at the ceiling with an absent gaze.
He once had a very beautiful wife, a university graduate from a family of scholars.
She was adept in both the literary gatherings and the kitchen.
You could say she was the perfect woman.
But perfect women often have short lives; before the next era arrived, his wife had died.
Her death was ridiculous.
One day when she went out to buy groceries, the road suddenly collapsed. She fell down and died on the spot.
During that time, he almost completely gave up on life, not even going to the company he had worked so hard to develop. His partners became desperate and left one by one, and the company’s projects came to a full halt.
He spent his days in his house drinking and staring blankly, like a vegetative person without thought.
During this period, his wife’s younger sister, Yan Niang, took care of him every day, attempting to emulate his deceased wife in tidying up the house, shopping, and cooking.
Yan Niang and his wife were twins.
During those days, he gradually came back to life, and an inappropriate affection developed between him and Yan Niang.
He knew it was the behavior of a beast.
But… they looked too similar. He missed his wife too much and couldn’t help but treat Yan Niang as his wife.
The company gradually resumed its operations, and everything went back on track.
He knew the ulterior motives of Yan Niang, who ran away from home before his wife’s death and served as the “princess” in a club, simply approaching him for money.
She led an extremely chaotic personal life.
Even later, she would spend his money on insignificant young men, and after the new era began, she would still take advantage of the props he gave her to find men everywhere.
But he didn’t care.
They were simply too similar.
He hypnotized himself into believing his wife hadn’t died, but was Yan Niang.
However, Yan Niang lacked his wife’s wisdom. Instead, she exuded the unmistakable air of a club ‘princess’: short-sighted, selfish, petty, vain, and concerned about appearances—all qualities he disliked.
“…”
Zhou Ziqiang remained silent for a long time before he slowly found another Vice President of Skywake in the chat panel, Zhang Chu.
“Tomorrow, I will hold a meeting and remove Yan Niang’s position as Vice President.”
“You have the Storage Department come up with some reason in advance to take back the props on Yan Niang.”
Fake will always remain fake.
No matter how similar they look, Yan Niang is not his wife.
Having someone like this with power in the Guild was bound to bring chaos to Skywake sooner or later.
Maybe it was time for him to wake up.
As for the disgraceful events of these days, perhaps it was something he would have to apologize for to his wife in person after his death.
He looked at the most conspicuous photo of his wife on the desk and once again slowly closed his eyes, leaning back in the chair without a word, feeling extremely weary in his heart.
As for Chen Yi, he had his own thoughts.
So far, there was no enmity between Skywake and Chen Yi; even the unexpected contest this time was not a grudge. If handled properly, perhaps they could join forces—creating a story worth telling.

chapters.title: Chapter 181: 179: "This battle will surely spread the great name of the 'Sin Department'!
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 179: “This battle will surely spread the great name of the ‘Sin Department’!
Shortly after leaving the president’s office, Yan Niang, walking alone in the corridor, was suddenly pulled into a room by a door that flung open violently.
“Ah!”
Yan Niang, who let out an instinctive cry of alarm, quickly had her mouth covered by the man in front of her, but upon seeing his face clearly, she couldn’t help but smile seductively and tapped his chest lightly.
“Are you crazy? This is the Skywake Headquarters, how dare you make a move here.”
“The president’s office is less than 200 meters from here.”
“What is there to be afraid of?”
The man who had Yan Niang in his arms grinned wickedly and buried his head in her bosom, taking a deep breath, “Isn’t it more thrilling this way?”
“Besides, half of the people in Skywake have been with you, haven’t they?”
“The president is well aware of this.”
“If he doesn’t care, what are you scared of? Even if he caught us in the act, he might not blame us but join in instead.”
“Then you’re probably dreaming.”
Yan Niang, slightly irritated, raised her hand and tapped the man’s forehead, “The president doesn’t care because he only considers me a substitute for his wife at night, and he knows my private life has always been a mess, so he’s reluctant to delve into it.”
“If he were to catch us red-handed, you might not live past today.”
“I’ll die then. Dying beneath the peony, a ghost would also be romantic.”
The man seemed impatient as he ripped open Yan Niang’s clothes, panting heavily, “I can’t wait any longer, let me have my pleasure first.”
“Pleasure my ass.”
Yan Niang, in a sour mood, shook her head, “Did you not hear how the president yelled at me in the meeting room just now? I’m really not in the mood for this.”
“Hey.”
The man, his hands wandering, said carelessly without thinking, “That’s just the president’s temper. If you’re unhappy, I can kill the president for you and let you be the president.”
The initially feigning resistant Yan Niang suddenly squinted her eyes, allowing the man in front of her to continue his advances, her mind suddenly racing with a crazy idea, trying out the idea, “Really? You dare to lay a hand on the president?”
“What’s there not to dare? I was recruited by you to join Skywake, I’m here for you. Whatever you say, I’ll do it.”
“However…”
The man, somewhat greedily licking the corner of his mouth, said, “If you really want me to deal with the president, you’ll let me have fun with you afterward.”
“Get lost!”
Yan Niang’s face turned cold, “Do you really take me for a prostitute?”
Seeing that Yan Niang seemed a bit angry, the man sheepishly touched his nose, “Don’t be mad, Yan Niang. I was just speaking off the cuff.”
“But if you really want to take action against the president, I alone obviously won’t be strong enough. However, many in Skywake were recruited by you. If you can get them on board, it should be no problem for you to become the president.”
“But… it’s quite risky after all. You’re well aware of the president’s strength. If you want us to risk our lives, you need to give us some incentive.”
“Don’t you think?”
“…”
Yan Niang remained silent, her head lowered as she quickly calculated the feasibility of this plan, the man’s words a reminder!
All along, she had relied on men as her support!
But… if she killed the president and became the president of Skywake herself, she would be her own pillar of support.
How did that saying go?
A woman who depends on a man can only ever be a princess.
But if she relies on herself, she could be a queen!
It’s just… she knew these men’s mentality all too well. If their desires were truly satisfied, they would surely renege. To keep them working for her, she must keep them on the hook.
After pondering for a while with narrowed eyes, Yan Niang suddenly smiled coyly and slowly traced her finger across the man’s chest, “Fine, I agree. Once the president is dead, you’ll get your turn.”
“But… first, help me kill someone as a pledge of commitment, how about that.”
“A minor girl within Skywake, the president’s assistant. Lately, this little girl has been getting cocky because of the president’s favor.”
“After you kill this girl…”
“I’ll reward you with something else.”
“Like what?”
The man, consumed by desire, stared at Yan Niang, whose clothes were disheveled, and waited anxiously.
“Like… the thing you’ve been wanting, my mouth.”
“Really… really?”
“Kill the girl and you’ll find out.”
“Deal!”
The man, unable to control himself, charged forward and pulled Yan Niang into his arms again, “I promise you, but let me have my fun first, I can’t hold back any longer.”
“Giggle.”
Yan Niang laughed teasingly with a coy refusal, not saying a word, but the light in the depths of her eyes grew colder. Zhou Ziqiang, you were the first to be unjust, don’t blame me for being ruthless in return.
There was no shouting.
She knew how to use her voice to stir the demons in a man’s heart.
In front of important people, she could make them experience a sublime peak unmatched by other women.
It was only in front of those young fresh meats that she would indulge in contemptuous tirades, freely venting the frustrations in her heart.
There are many women in this world.
Many are willing to sleep with men.
But the only woman who can make a man insatiable is her, Yan Niang!
…
The night passed swiftly.
At 7 am.
Chen Yi and his companion slowly woke up, having pulled an all-nighter to clear a map yesterday and had gone to bed early around seven or eight, sleeping for a full twelve hours.
The refreshed Tuberculosis Rabbit stood by the window and stretched, just about to light up a morning cigarette when he glanced at the ceiling and began to seriously consider whether to drill a hole in this building.
He found the rules for July rather uncomfortable.
He glanced down at his Claw Knife.
“28832.”
The Charge progress was already at 28832. The last time he brandished the knife outside the city, the effect was quite impressive. That Charge had been close to 5000, accumulated over more than ten days.
And since that time, he had not used the prop for a full month.
Normally, the Charge progress wasn’t so rapid.
But after the last Enhancement of the Claw Knife to +16, the Charge progress tripled, hence the nearly 30,000 Charge Value. He wondered if a single cut could create an opening in Yancheng.
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked down at the Claw Knife in his hands and marveled, thinking if he kept charging it until his death, the knife might just split Blue Star open.
He then glanced again at the dining table in the restaurant, feeling something was off—as if something was missing.
Was it Sword Without End missing from the wall?
After several double-takes,
He finally realized what was wrong and turned his head sharply towards Chen Yi, who was perusing some materials on the side sofa, and said seriously, “Yi, Jiaye didn’t bring breakfast over today.”
“Usually, Jiaye would knock on the door and bring breakfast by this time.”
“Could something have happened?”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi now also realized this matter, setting down the materials in his hand and frowning as he looked at the bare dining table with some hesitation, “Could it be that the June rules have expired, and there’s no longer a daily breakfast requirement?”
But perhaps he found this reason a bit far-fetched.
He quickly opened the chat channel to find Jiaye’s conversation box and sent several messages in a row.
…
Meanwhile,
“Keep it up, guys, we’re about to clear the game!”
On a Flying Boat in the “Destiny’s Adversary” map, the Head of the Sin Department, with dark circles under his eyes, excitedly shouted at the nine other people on board.
“Don’t drop your guard, just hold on for 3 more minutes, and we’ll have survived the full 24 hours.”
“We might become the first team to reach the global rankings!”
“Don’t rush to celebrate. In the final three minutes, we need to kill as many demons as possible. Our goal isn’t just a simple 100% map completion rating!”
“The first team to clear the map is sure to get a 100% completion rating. That’s certain!”
“We were almost the first team to enter this map, and a 100% completion rating is definitely ours. We want more than just a 100% completion rating; we want to push the upper limit as high as possible!”
“So that even if other teams manage to survive 24 hours and clear the map, they can only get 60% or 50% completion ratings!”
“Did everyone get that!”
“This battle must spread the grand name of ‘Sin Department’ far and wide!”
“Yes!”
Though tired in body and spirit, the nine other members aboard the Flying Boat still forced themselves to stay energized in the last three minutes, striving to kill more demons.
Everyone was anticipating the sight of being listed on the global team rankings after clearing the level.
…
At the same time, the “Destiny’s Adversary” map was also a hot topic on the forums.
“There are already 17 teams on the global rankings, and several maps have been cleared, but so far, only Chen Yi’s team has cleared the ‘Destiny’s Adversary’ map. Is this map difficult?”
“Not sure, we can’t see the specific details of the map from the outside, and no news has come out yet about the actual content of the map.”
“Man, Chen Yi’s team is really strong. They’ve got three 100% map completion ratings.”
“The ‘Night Widow Village’ and ‘Silent Deserted Island’ both have valuable 100% ratings, but how much the ‘Destiny’s Adversary’ map 100% rating is worth is unclear since only Chen Yi’s team has made it through so far. Maybe once a second team clears it, Chen Yi’s team’s rating will instantly drop to 50% or 60%.”
“That’s a possibility, but as it stands, these are indeed three bona fide 100% map ratings, dominating the top of the team rankings for three maps.”
Three minutes passed quickly.
Inside the Destiny’s Adversary map.
Headed by Scarface, the Head of the Sin Department, the nine team members could hardly contain their excitement as they listened to the system notification, eagerly beginning to fantasize about what was to come.
“Ding, ‘Sin Department Team One,’ led by team captain Scarface, has successfully cleared the ‘Destiny’s Adversary’ map. Each team member will receive the following rewards:”
“Points *5000, Level 1 Enhancement Stone *20, D-class random Skill Fragment *2.”
“Here is the team map rating—”

chapters.title: Chapter 182: 180: "Damn it, throwing a celebration for a mere 1% map completion rate.
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 180: “Damn it, throwing a celebration for a mere 1% map completion rate.
“You’ve successfully survived 24 hours and slain 23,201 level one demons and 23 level two demons, achieving an extremely impressive score, which has brought you a distinguished map evaluation score,”
“Your map evaluation score is… 1%.”
“Ranked second among the squads on this map’s leaderboard.”
“Nice!!!”
“Epic!!!”
The moment the notification sounded, the ten members of Sin Department Team One couldn’t contain their excitement and probably roared out their emotions!
“We are the champions!!!”
“Sin Department rocks!!”
“So epic, we successfully snagged a whopping… one percent?”
The voice suddenly came to an abrupt halt.
The few who were celebrating suddenly looked at the prompt panel with somewhat stiff expressions. After reading it several times and making sure they weren’t seeing things, the excited look on their faces gradually became rigid, and they stood still like wooden statues.
The rating doesn’t seem to be 100%?
But… 1%?
The Head of the Sin Department, Scarface, who was the most ready to celebrate, almost popped his eyes out at this point, staring fiercely at that percentage figure!
A face full of disbelief!
If he wasn’t seeing things, didn’t the map evaluation panel clearly state that their score was excellent?
You give an excellent score like this a 1% evaluation?
Are you freaking human?
The Head, after all, was the head. Scarface suddenly thought of something, trembling as he opened “Destiny’s Adversary” squad leaderboard, and when he saw “Rabbits Do Not Kill” squad at the top with a 100% map evaluation score.
Everything suddenly made sense.
With a face full of perplexity and helplessness, he looked up to the sky and with shaky hands lit a cigarette and brought it to his lips, not quite knowing what to say.
Did anyone tell him what he was supposed to do now?
What on earth did Chen Yi do in the map to pull the scoring limit to such an outrageous extent, leading his team to survive 24 hours and killing that many demons?
That’s already pretty stellar, right?
But such a performance only got a mere 1% map evaluation score?
Is this… normal?
Chen Yi couldn’t possibly have killed all the demons in the map, right?
Impossible, the map’s demons were countless, beyond the sight’s limit; he’d rather believe Chen Yi had convinced the demons to repent and become angels in the map than accept that Chen Yi had killed every single demon there.
“Hea… Head.”
A team member next to him spoke with a tremor of despair: “What do we do now? We were planning to make a name for ourselves, and now we’ve got a 1% map evaluation score; our reputation is completely shot.”
“How are we supposed to recruit for the Guild when we set it up with this on our record?”
They didn’t understand what was going on either, or what Chen Yi actually did in the map, but now wasn’t the time to think about that, it was about how to manage public opinion on this crisis so as not to embarrass Sin Department too much.
“Let’s come up with an excuse, say we were actually going on a team building trip in the map?”
“Hold on.”
Scarface finished the cigarette in his mouth in confusion, then mustered up the courage, still shaking, to open up the forums: “Let’s see what everyone is saying first, then consider how to handle this PR crisis. That excuse is a bit lame; we’ll think of a better one in a meeting later.”
However, seeing the posts on the forum, he suddenly fell silent with a bizarre expression.
There were quite a few posts discussing Sin Department, but the direction of the discussion was somewhat different than they expected.
“Sin Department, which squad is that? Never heard of them before, they’re so bad-ass, the second squad to clear ‘Destiny’s Adversary.'”
“Indeed bad-ass. You know, since Chen Yi cleared this map, no other squad managed it, didn’t expect Sin Department to do it. Skywake is so cocky, yet they haven’t cleared this map until now, have they?”
“It seems that Sin Department should be considered the second strongest squad in the world, right? Weaker than Chen Yi’s squad but much stronger than Skywake Squadron.”
“Yeah, Skywake is so full of themselves, claiming to be the world’s number one squad, but now it looks like they can’t even match up to Sin Department.”
“…”
Scarface’s hands suddenly stopped trembling, and his body straightened up abruptly as he scrolled through the forum posts with an extremely odd expression. After a long while, he gave his expectant teammates an odd look.
“You might not believe this, but we’ve become the second strongest squad in the players’ eyes globally…”
“It seems like it’s because when we were completing the map, Skywake Squadron went to show off in front of Chen Yi and got brutally face-slapped and crushed, and now the whole internet has a poor view of Skywake.”
“Then, we’re the second squad to clear this map, plus we didn’t show off or say any arrogant words, so in the netizens’ hearts, we’ve become a low-profile yet capable squad…”
“The world is getting weirder, my brain can’t keep up, give me a moment to process this.”
Thirty minutes later.
A post suddenly went viral on the internet.
‘Head of the Sin Department’s personal account!’
‘Today, I truly experienced the terrifying strength of Chen Yi and his team, I led Sin Department Team One and gave it our all in the ‘Destiny’s Adversary’ map, yet we only got a 1% map evaluation score.’
‘This shows just how terrifying the strength of Chen Yi is.’
‘Respect.’
‘The entire Sin Department bows down, we’re not as skilled, this 1% map evaluation score is already the limit for the Sin Department.’
‘We hope that in the next map, the Sin Department can achieve a lot more outstanding results.’
‘Below is a free guide to the ‘Destiny’s Adversary’ map, it seems to be a tower defense map, there’s a House of God before you enter the map…answering questions grants Props…some answers to the questions I’ve organized and put below…’
‘…to pass this map, one must have a flying Vehicle that can stay airborne for 24 hours, otherwise, it’s impossible to survive for 24 hours…’
‘We survived 24 hours, and killed nearly 30,000 Demons but still only got a 1% map evaluation score, based on the timestamps provided by everyone and the terrifying map completion score of the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team, the Sin Department has made a guess that’s hard to believe but very close to the truth—’
”Rabbits Do Not Kill’, in just a few hours, likely slaughtered millions of Demons within the map.’
‘With such a terrifying strength, the Sin Department bows down!’
The post quickly went viral, and the comments section was continuously flooded with new messages.
‘The Head of the Sin Department really has an impressive outlook!’
‘Indeed, even with the same 1% map evaluation score, the reactions of the Sin Department and Skywake are like heaven and earth, these two powers are simply not on the same level.’
‘This is the magnanimity a man should have.’
‘And they even shared their strategies for clearing the map for free, when does the Head of the Sin Department recruit? I want to join you too.’
…
“…”
Sitting on the rooftop, Scarface, looking at the countless flooding comments below the post, couldn’t help but heave a long sigh of emotional relief, “In this day and age, it’s the first time I’ve encountered netizens spoon-feeding us.”
“We did no PR, and suddenly the reputation is so good.”
“Turns out doing a good job is not as good as being in contrast to others.”
“Had I known it was so simple, we wouldn’t have made such an effort, could’ve just taken a nap on the Flying Boat on the map and come out with a 1% score, without spending any Points.”
“We should also thank Skywake; otherwise, it might be us getting criticized right now, not Skywake.”
“Come on, let’s have a victory feast!”
At this, Scarface couldn’t help but laugh at himself, “For fuck’s sake, a 1% map rating and we’re holding a damn victory feast.”
“But for some reason, this victory feast feels particularly satisfying.”
“Brothers, raise your glasses, cheers!”
“Today, we feast on skewers!”
…
ps: These two days I kept having stomach issues, leading to several delayed updates. Though I made up for them, I did end up posting a few hours later than usual.
Even though no one scolded me, I still felt guilty.
Today, for the extra chapter, I feel much better inside.
I hope everyone can forgive my stomach.
To reward myself for the extra update today, I’m going out for some barbecue. Good night everyone, get some rest early.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: 181: "You don't really want to go to hell on a business trip at the public's expense again, do you?
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 181: “You don’t really want to go to hell on a business trip at the public’s expense again, do you?
While the Sin Department was throwing a celebration party, other teams continuously cleared this map.
The team leaderboard for “Destiny’s Adversary” map kept refreshing nonstop.
What was amusing, though…
Aside from the first place, Chen Yi’s team “Rabbits Do Not Kill” with a map evaluation score of 100%,
the scores for the teams from second to seventh place were all 1%.
It looked oddly neat.
Originally, Scarface felt a bit embarrassed about throwing a celebration party for a mere 1% map evaluation score, considering that even though the outside world had a good opinion of the Sin Department now, a score of 1% was, after all, quite literal.
But after seeing the teams that followed and cleared the map also scoring a uniform 1%, he felt much more balanced internally.
Apart from helplessly remarking that Chen Yi was truly too abnormal, there was nothing left to do but raise his glass even higher and celebrate with even more gusto.
1%?
Bullshit!
This is second place! Second in the world!
That’s enough to take pride in!
Don’t worry about how far behind the first place I am; just tell me if the current number two on the leaderboard is not their Sin Department?
It is? Then that’s it!
Drink up! Why fuss over such nonsense?
As long as you meet the threshold of having a flying vehicle, clearing this map isn’t hard; it just takes a bit more time, as you must survive for 24 hours within the map!
The first batch of teams that entered this map have also all come out by now, and with the scattered updates from various teams spreading out, more and more teams will clear this map.
Ascending from a lv.1 team to a lv.2 team requires one important condition: clearing a D-class map once.
This map is expected to become the most frequently cleared map.
The additional effects gained from a team’s promotion are quite useful.
There are two effects.
One is damage transfer, which allows the division of a severely injured teammate’s damage among all the other team members, potentially saving a dying teammate from the brink of death at the crucial moment.
The other is a skill reset, which gives three chances a week to reset the cooldowns of any team member’s prop, skill, title, etc.
Both effects are very practical.
However, it’s already July 2nd today, and there has yet to be news of any power establishing a guild, nor whispers of a Guild Creation Order being circulated, suggesting that this prop is not easy to come by.
…
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit was sitting on a beach chair on the rooftop, looking at the “Destiny’s Adversary” team leaderboard with a contemplative expression and exclaimed, “Brother Scarface’s mentality is pretty good. Even like this, he hasn’t been beaten down, and it looks like he’s quite satisfied.”
“Yi, are we going to continue with map exploration?”
“If we clear one more D-class map, our team will advance to lv.3.”
Chen Yi didn’t speak; he just slightly furrowed his brows, looking at his chat box with Jiaye with a sense of unease.
He had sent Jiaye more than a dozen messages, and Jiaye hadn’t replied to a single one.
He didn’t know if something had happened to him.
If he had known, he would have pulled Jiaye into the team. After joining a team, one could immediately see the vital status of teammates; he would then know whether Jiaye was dead or alive, unlike now when he had no idea about Jiaye’s status.
“Ah well.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit lay on the beach chair, dressed in a colorful coconut-patterned beach outfit holding a chilled coconut water, wearing sunglasses, and enjoying a natural sunbath. He spoke carelessly, with a cigarette in his mouth.
“Yi, you don’t need to worry too much. Jiaye might have gone to explore a map, or he might just not have woken up yet.”
“Even if we think of the worst, if she really is dead, that’s still not a big issue.”
“In this game, when players die they all go to hell, so we can just have Sword Without End go down there and bring Jiaye back up. With Sword Without End’s strength, bringing two people up shouldn’t be much of a problem.”
Chen Yi’s brow didn’t relax, he just turned his head and stared into the distance for a while before speaking softly, “I’m feeling a bit uneasy. If she went to a lower map, she should have told me, but now there’s no message at all. The likelihood of something bad happening is a bit higher.”
“What’s more, what if she died in hell, too?”
“If she died in hell, then she can’t be brought back.”
He was somewhat anxious.
But even with the anxiety, it seemed futile; he had no idea where to look for Jiaye.
“That shouldn’t be possible.”
Seeing that Chen Yi still hadn’t relaxed, Tuberculosis Rabbit sat up straight, took off his sunglasses, and expressed his doubts, “Considering Jiaye and Tie Chui’s sibling combo, even if we wanted to kill them… well, it’s quite easy for us to kill them.”
“But not everyone is as strong as we are, and it should be difficult for others to kill the sibling duo, shouldn’t it?”
“Moreover, Tie Chui is not weak either, she’s already King Malphite, and there aren’t many who can beat her in close combat.”
“Let’s say there wasn’t even a chase, they should have had the time to send us a message, right?”
“Unless they didn’t have time to react and were killed instantly.”
“Huh!”
After pondering for a moment with squinted eyes, Chen Yi finally spoke, “Contact Sword Without End and see if he has any prop that can pinpoint a player’s exact coordinates.”
…
“Looking for someone, eh?”
Sword Without End, who suddenly understood, stood on the rooftop and looked at the two people in front of him, “I’m familiar with this. You just need to pass the Social Engineering test. Did you see someone bad-mouthing you online?”
“I actually suggest you don’t even bother looking.”
“Just go to Black Trench City, kill anyone randomly, and maybe you’ll just happen to kill that trash-talker.”
“That place is infested with trash-talkers.”
“Even if it’s not the one targeting you, they’ve definitely trashed someone else, so killing them wouldn’t be a mistake.”
“No, it’s not that.”
Chen Yi, leaning on his cane, stood still, staring into Sword Without End’s eyes, and spoke softly, “Jiaye has gone missing; she might be in trouble. I need her exact coordinates.”
“That girl? If that’s the case…”
Sword Without End hesitated a little before speaking tentatively, “I actually do know someone who has such a prop. It’s a C-class prop with a limited number of uses, you just need to enter the player’s full information.”
“You can clearly find out the player’s coordinates, as well as their physical condition, and other relevant information.”
“Then what are we waiting for?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit leaped into the sled parked on the rooftop, waved at Sword Without End, and urged, “Go find that person. What are you waiting for? You don’t want to make another public-funded trip to hell on business, do you?”
“It’s urgent.”
“It might be a bit dicey.”
Sword Without End spread his hands helplessly, “That prop is in the hands of Zhou Ziqiang, the President of Skywake.”
“Skywake just had their faces slapped hard by us, going there now to borrow that prop is pretty much hopeless and if we’re talking about breaking in… it’s going to be tough.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 184: 182: "Mainly because I left Skywake last time, and I spoke too firmly...
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 182: “Mainly because I left Skywake last time, and I spoke too firmly…
“President of Skywake, Zhou Ziqiang?”
Chen Yi’s eyebrows furrowed slightly but he did not speak. Jiaye could be considered a friend he acknowledged; not to mention, under the rules of June, three meals a day were delivered on time.
With Jiaye in trouble right now, he couldn’t just sit by and do nothing.
But handling this prop in the hands of the President of Skywake was indeed tricky.
