Not to mention, they had just inadvertently slapped Skywake in the face. Skywake was probably thinking at this time not only about how to deal with them but also about how to regain face. Approaching them for help at this point was basically out of the question.
“We should be able to beat them, right?”
Sitting on the edge of the sled, Tuberculosis Rabbit propped his chin with one hand and pondered before speaking, “With our strength, we should have some deeper calculations against Skywake too, right?”
“It depends on the situation.”
Sword Without End shook his head helplessly, “If Skywake sends someone to kill us, not to mention anything else, with Yi’s sled vehicle, we can basically stand our ground.”
“Employing guerrilla tactics, there’s actually a good chance we can take down Skywake.”
“But if we go to the Skywake headquarters, our hopes are slim. Not to mention anything else, there is a B-grade area defense prop inside the headquarters, and once activated, it’s very difficult to penetrate.”
“As for the specific prop effect, since I was new to Skywake back then and wasn’t eligible to access those, I only know it was said to be from a mysterious treasure chest, and that prop could not be moved or put into a backpack.”
“It could only be used at the drop location, and afterwards, Skywake established their headquarters there.”
“If we want to break in… honestly, it’s going to be tough.”
“Hmm-hmm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit hummed noncommittally and turned to look at Chen Yi, “Yi, what do you think?”
Although Sword Without End was introduced to everyone’s skills and props before he joined the team, it was just a brief introduction. Sword Without End was unclear about Yi’s true strength.
He only knew roughly.
In Sword Without End’s eyes, rushing into Skywake headquarters was impossible.
In his eyes, it wasn’t something not worth trying.
He just wasn’t sure if it was worth it.
He was also unclear about Jiaye’s place in Chen Yi’s heart.
He held a reasonably friendly attitude toward Jiaye, but this friendliness came from Jiaye being interested in Yi and Yi not rejecting this friend. However, if it meant risking their lives to rescue Jiaye…
He could only smile and stay silent.
As for Jiaye’s own life and death, he wasn’t particularly concerned; alive or dead, either was fine.
Chen Yi looked down in silence without speaking, then turned to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit. Meeting Tuberculosis Rabbit’s inquiring gaze, he paused for a moment before looking at Sword Without End.
“We might need your help this time. You were once part of Skywake, so you should have the President’s contact information,” he said.
“Talk to him.”
“Whatever the price, you can put it forth.”
“If he wants the fast-clear password for ‘Silent Deserted Island,’ we can give it to him.”
What Skywake most likely wanted now was a quick way to recover their face, and the best way to do so was to get back up where they fell down.
With this 392766 passcode, although it’s not enough for Skywake to achieve a 100% map evaluation score, a score of over 90% should be no problem.
This was a transaction beneficial to both parties.
At least that’s how he saw it.
The only unforeseeable aspect was if the President of Skywake was the vengeful type, he would definitely refuse the trade or demand an outrageous price.
Jiaye was his friend, and if she was in trouble, he would definitely have to save her.
But he did not want this situation to endanger Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“Alright.”
Sword Without End felt some trepidation as he opened the chat panel with the President of Skywake, saying awkwardly, “I’ll give it a try, mainly because when I left Skywake, I spoke too assertively…”
…
“Hm?”
At his desk, Zhou Ziqiang, who was working, heard the message alert in his ear and casually opened the chat window on his personal panel. A flash of surprise crossed his eyes when he saw the message was from Sword Without End.
This person was one of the earlier members of Skywake.
He was the one who had recruited him into Skywake.
He attracted Sword Without End with a character action effect exclusive to the Sword Immortal to join them.
After some minor conflicts between Yan Niang and Chen Yi, Sword Without End left the guild and later joined Chen Yi’s ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team.
This event had always been a regret for him.
But he hadn’t gone back to Sword Without End to talk about it since the situation was somewhat complicated, so he just left it unaddressed, never expecting Sword Without End to reach out to him proactively.
“Borrow a prop?”
Zhou Ziqiang read Sword Without End’s message, did not speak, and sat back in his chair, indifferently massaging his temples.
The light in the room was dim.
The desk was covered in detailed descriptions of each prop from the guild’s warehouse, including their enhancement effects. He had just been considering whether any props could be combined to exert greater power when used together.
Some props only exhibit their maximum potential when combined with other props.
He would never underestimate any prop, even an E-grade one, since no one could know whether an E-grade prop would prove critical in a special situation or coordinate well with other props.
E-grade props, although often underwhelming and nearly useless…
For instance, the Air Food series of props had no effect other than giving a sense of fullness.
But… E-grade props have one important feature.
That is, E-grade prop features, no matter how trivial, are unique and not something C-grade or even B-grade props possess.
At least that’s what his findings indicated so far.
And studying the combination uses of these props was one of his duties as Guild President.
Zhou Ziqiang leaned back in his chair and remained silent for a long time, almost as if he were asleep, before finally sending a reply to Sword Without End.
…
“Agreed…?”
Sword Without End looked at Zhou Ziqiang’s reply with a somewhat strange expression, momentarily bewildered, “Zhou Ziqiang agreed, willing to lend us the prop, but he will not hand it over to us.”
“Instead, he wants us to send over the relevant information of the player who will be using it, and then he’ll pass the specific details to us.”
“But… there’s a condition.”
“It’s not the clearance password for ‘Destiny’s Adversary’.”
“What is it then?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyebrows furrowed slightly, “A few B-grade props, or a hundred thousand points? Don’t be too greedy, it will cost lives.”
“That’s not it.”
Sword Without End hesitated for a moment before he cautiously said, “It’s about signing a contract with Yi. The content of the contract stipulates that Chen Yi must not make any move, directly or indirectly, against any player who joins ‘Skywake Squadron’.”
“I’ve shared the specific content of the contract, take a look.”
“All players of ‘Skywake Squadron’ will also not make any direct or indirect moves against the players from ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill Squadron’.”
“Unless they’re on the same map and in an adversarial faction relationship, they are not allowed to attack each other in any other situation.”
“The contract will last for 3 months.”
“If either side breaches these rules, each player from that faction will be fined a hundred thousand points. If the points are insufficient, they will die suddenly.”
“Signatory: Zhou Ziqiang (representing Skywake Squadron)”
“Signatory: (blank).”
“This contract is a C-grade prop, and its contents will take effect under the witness of the game upon signing. Should one party violate the agreement, the game will enforce the stipulations.”
“A peace treaty, huh.”
After giving Zhou Ziqiang’s intent a cursory glance, Tuberculosis Rabbit understood and said nonchalantly, “Zhou Ziqiang is scared, he plans to sign a peace treaty with us to prevent us from going after Skywake in the future?”
“The breach of contract penalty is too high.”
“And it has drawbacks.”
“What if we accidentally kill someone from Skywake during an area attack? Aren’t we just inviting death, or at the very least losing several hundred thousand points?”
“We’re not even clear about who all the specific members of Skywake Squadron are.”
“This is clearly a contract trap.”
After mulling over it for a moment, Chen Yi looked up at Sword Without End, “Convey what Tuberculosis Rabbit just said, let him send over the names and photos of all the current members of Skywake’s teams.”
“And base the contract on these individuals, any new members added to the teams after the contract is signed will not be included in the agreement.”
“Alright.”
Sword Without End nodded, then quickly looked up at Chen Yi again, “I’ve communicated it, Zhou Ziqiang has agreed and sent over the basic information of all nine squads currently at Skywake.”
“So, do we sign the contract now?”
“Let’s sign it.”
Chen Yi nodded without saying much more.
Actually, even without the contract, he had no intention of going after Skywake; this President was truly overthinking it. Why would he, a man with no grudges, bother to seek out Skywake for no reason?
Just because that Vice President Yan Niang cursed at him?
Wait, he just remembered that this woman had cursed him in the World Event Space last time.
How could he forget that incident.
He missed killing one person.
But the contract had already been signed and there was no chance for regret now; after all, the agreement would only last three months, so he could always kill her later.
Soon enough.
He also received the relevant information of Jiaye at this time.
‘Player Name’: Jiaye.
‘Player Location’: B-grade map Death Domain, 781.231.78.
‘Player Status’: On the brink of death.
“Alright then.”
Seeing Jiaye’s information, Tuberculosis Rabbit lit a cigarette with a resigned shrug and did not put it in his mouth, instead offering it to Sword Without End, “Bro, want one? Looks like we’re going to trouble you to head down and pick someone up again.”
“We’ll reimburse your round-trip travel expenses.”
“Make it an official invoice.”
“Just put ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill Squadron’ as the invoice title.”
“You’re familiar with the way by now, aren’t you?”
“I doubt it.”
Sword Without End shook his head, his expression slightly troubled, “It’s not that I don’t want to go to hell—I mean, I also really don’t want to die—but what I mean is that even if I go to hell, I can’t bring Jiaye back.”
“Didn’t I say last time that in order to return to Blue Star from hell, you need to get through a map?”
“The difficulty of that map is not low, and even my return was quite a struggle, taking almost a week of time inside the map.”
“If I bring Jiaye along, let alone Jiaye, even I can’t guarantee a safe return.”
“However…”

chapters.title: Chapter 185: 183: "Why blame yourself for something that you can blame on others?
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 183: “Why blame yourself for something that you can blame on others?
Chen Yi was just about to say something when he suddenly saw Sword Without End pulling something out with a backhanded motion.
“But I have this.”
He looked closely.
In Sword Without End’s palm lay a silver-white card.
The effect of the prop was also shared.
‘Prop Name’: Death Domain Pass.
‘Prop Level’: B-level.
‘Prop Description’: This is a world filled with death everywhere; here, you can experience the feeling of death firsthand—a map with an extremely high level of danger, but correspondingly, the rewards are extremely generous.
‘Prop Restrictions’: Number of Uses (1/1)
It is the Heaven for the brave, the Hell for the cowards—
Death Domain!
“A Death Domain Pass. I have a map access pass for this map too, obtained by luck.”
“A B-level map, and the description of the map is enough to creep someone out. I barely considered entering this map, at least not at this stage.”
“I never thought Jiaye and her team would go in.”
“That’s really…”
Sword Without End touched his nose and swallowed the words that were almost blurted out.
He actually wanted to say that it was brainless. Even he, who could barely make a name for himself globally, did not dare to enter, yet Jiaye and Tie Chui, two players who hadn’t even entered the last layer of the world event, dared to venture into a B-level map alone.
It was somewhat irrational.
But then he remembered Jiaye was Chen Yi’s friend, so he forcefully swallowed the words—it wasn’t appropriate to say them.
“I’ll go in by myself. Thanks for this,” Chen Yi said as he took the prop from Sword Without End’s hand and began to check the cooldown times of the props on him and to inventory some props he didn’t usually use in preparation for entering the map.
He had a sled with him.
Basically, he was in an invincible position and was not likely to run into trouble easily.
“Hey, Yi, you’re not planning to go in alone, are you?” Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly grabbed Chen Yi’s arm, staring at him with some dissatisfaction, “This is a B-level map. The most difficult map we’ve ever been to was only C-level.”
“We finally get to go to a B-level map. How can you not take me with you?”
Chen Yi turned his head to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit and, after a long pause, nodded, “Alright, you’ll come with me.”
“I want to go too.”
Sword Without End also raised his right hand excitedly, “This is a B-level map, the second B-level map I’ll be entering. I’ve never dared to enter this map before, but now with Yi’s support, I have the courage to have a look.”
“Besides, the map access pass can only be used once.”
“If I don’t go in, wouldn’t that be a waste?”
“What do you mean?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, keenly catching the information in Sword Without End’s words, spoke with some surprise, “You’ve been to another B-level map before?”
“Yes, a smaller B-level map. The title above my head was obtained from that B-level map.”
“Nice.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sized up Sword Without End, gaining a new understanding of his capabilities. When they first met Sword Without End, he already had that title.
It seemed to be the beginning of June then.
If he remembered correctly, it should have been the early morning of June 1st.
Now it’s July 2nd.
Having solo-cleared a B-level map a month earlier, his abilities were not to be underestimated.
Neither he nor Yi had been to a B-level map to this day.
Chen Yi didn’t delay any further. Since the other two wanted to go, he didn’t waste any more words and activated the prop right away.
…
‘Ding, Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Sword Without End have successfully entered the map.’
‘The map has a high degree of freedom; players are to explore on their own.’
‘Clearing conditions: A total of 7 ruins; after passing through 3 ruins, players may leave the map within 1 minute. Besides this, there are various random special events in the map.’
Unlike other maps which present a long description and numerous rules before entering, this map had just a brief three sentences.
Without any delay.
Chen Yi sat on the sled, looking at the string of coordinates, and took off with Tuberculosis Rabbit!
In just one minute, they arrived at the coordinates.
And at this moment, they were just beginning to get a glimpse of the map’s general features.
The entire map was a vast wasteland with not a single green plant in sight, and the ground was cracked everywhere, as if it hadn’t rained for at least three years.
Above them were extremely low-hanging black clouds, seemingly just a few hundred meters above the ground, almost as if they were about to press down on their heads.
The thick black clouds made the whole wasteland seem somewhat gloomy.
And at the coordinates…
There was a brightly lit café standing out oddly, as if someone had opened a Starbucks in a no-man’s land.
A single-story café of about 200 square meters.
Numerous lights hung on the exterior walls of the café, looking very bright and somewhat out of place in the dim wasteland.
Just as Chen Yi and his group landed and hadn’t yet made any move…
They saw Tie Chui standing at the café, his body covered in horrific wounds like a rock, and on Tie Chui’s shoulder sat Jiaye, covered in blood and dazed, yet there seemed to be a smile on her face, as if, despite her body’s poor state, her mood was quite good.
“Did we find them this easily?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes flashed with surprise, “It seems we can return soon, finally able to enjoy sunbathing again.”
However, just then—
Jiaye also saw Chen Yi and his companions in front of him, the smile on his lips instantly stiffening in place.
The joy in his eyes disappeared in an instant.
Instead, he was trying to endure the pain from his wounds, and a hint of despair emerged in his eyes as he spoke with a quivering, tearful voice, “Yi, how did you get in here?”
But then, as if suddenly remembering something,
He spoke in a rush.
“It’s safe while flying in the air, but once you land, you must stick to the official road.”
“Don’t try to open any treasure chests you see, a very high chance of special events are negative.”
“Ruins number 4 are combat-based, the opponent’s strength is greater than your own, and you can’t use props or skills.”
“Ruins number 3 are nightmare-based, they will target your…”
However, before Jiaye could finish speaking, they could only see Jiaye’s mouth moving up and down without hearing any sound. Soon after that, they saw the figures of Jiaye and Tie Chui slowly fade and disappear on the spot.
At the same time.
A notification sounded in their ears.
‘Ding, a player has successfully cleared the map, the difficulty of clearing this map has increased.’
‘The clearing condition has been raised from passing 3 ruins originally to passing 5 ruins and experiencing 2 special events.’
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, still waving his hand to signal, had his smiling expression slowly solidify and then emotionlessly lit a cigarette, put it to his mouth, and spoke softly, “That Yi, in a way, our mission has been perfectly accomplished.”
“We successfully rescued Jiaye from this B-level map.”
“But… it seems like we have put ourselves in it.”
Chen Yi also realized the situation they were in, and only after confirming that Jiaye and the others had left the map, did he slightly raise his eyebrows, a bit surprised in his heart.
This is a B-level map after all.
With the strength of Jiaye and Tie Chui, they actually managed to clear a B-level map.
Although they had quite a few injuries, being able to speak fluently meant there was still hope for them.
Moreover, Jiaye’s condition just now didn’t seem to be on the verge of death, right?
But before he could think any further,
He suddenly felt a breeze, and the gloomy winds on the wasteland were indeed a bit chilling, like working in front of your computer desk in the dark of night, feeling a breeze blowing behind you as if a beautiful ghost was standing right there, staring at you.
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but feel goosebumps and shivered.
At this moment, the wooden door of the café not far away seemed to be blown open by the wind, revealing the bright tables and chairs inside, making one unable to resist the urge to hide in the café to avoid the cold wind.
And a screen gradually appeared above the café.
‘Ruins number 3, Café.’
‘This is a café where you can buy a cup of coffee to get a moment’s warmth on the some cold, piercing wasteland.’
‘You can drink coffee while talking to a psychologist about the trauma in your heart.’
‘Perhaps she can help you soothe it.’
‘Clearing condition: Face your inner Heart Demon and either accept it or slay it.’
Chen Yi looked at the Death Domain Map on his personal panel, they were located at ruins number 3 in the bottom left corner of the map. Apart from this, there were 6 other points of light on the map, which were ruins numbers 1 to 7, excluding number 3.
It looked just like a Disneyland map.
The vast wasteland had 7 amusement attractions.
But from Jiaye and the others, it was clear that these attractions were probably not very friendly, at least the wounds on Tie Chui’s body looked quite chilling.
“Heart Demon?”
Sword Without End spoke with a grave expression as he looked at the screen above the café, “The last time I cleared a B-level map, it was also one about Heart Demons.”
“B-level maps seem to like featuring Heart Demons as content.”
“I have experience with this, Heart Demons tend to be idealistic.”
“For example, my Heart Demon was the disgust for the past me who couldn’t make money and had to watch my wife die before my eyes. To clear that map, I had to completely sever this Heart Demon.”
“That is, to accept that part of my life’s journey and let go of that obsession.”
“I killed myself more than a hundred times and still didn’t sever that Heart Demon.”
“But later, I cleared it.”
“Because I shifted the object of my disgust, I changed from loathing myself to questioning why among so many people in the world, there wasn’t a single one willing to lend a hand to save us. And so, I severed the Heart Demon of loathing myself and thereby cleared the map.”
“But… if things go as usual, it may make me sever the Heart Demon of loathing the world again.”
“What to do then, despise yourself once more?”
“Hmm, that’s the plan.”
Sword Without End nodded earnestly, “When it comes to Heart Demons, which are relatively idealistic, if you can’t find a way to resolve them, you can try other methods.”
“So you mean Heart Demons arise from self-blame over something?”
“Roughly, you can understand it that way.”
“What if one has never blamed oneself?”
“Impossible, everyone makes mistakes in life, and as long as you make mistakes, you will blame yourself more or less, all of which are Heart Demons, unless you have never made a mistake.”
“Well…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit opened his mouth hesitantly, “I have made mistakes, but I’ve never blamed myself.”
“I’ve always blamed others, never myself.”
“Why blame oneself for things you can blame others for?”
…
ps: Misspellings to be corrected later.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: 184: "All Actions Follow the Heart.
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 184: “All Actions Follow the Heart.
“…”
Sword Without End silently touched his nose, not speaking further. This was a state beyond his imagination.
He could not imagine someone who had never reproached themselves.
Is that normal?
It isn’t!
After hesitating, he couldn’t help but ask, “Brother Tuberculosis Rabbit, there’s something I’m not sure whether I should say. Everyone has moments of youthful folly and ignorance. Haven’t you ever rewarded yourself?”
“When you reward yourself, you don’t feel guilty.”
“Hehe.”
With an expressionless face, Tuberculosis Rabbit coldly chuckled twice, “Refuse to answer.”
Having said that, he was the first to head towards the coffee shop, with Chen Yi and another not speaking further, but following him closely.
The coffee shop wasn’t very large.
There were about seven or eight tables. There was no one at the bar, just a self-service ordering menu with some items like lattes and coffees. The prices weren’t high, all about 100 Points per cup.
In the outside world, that was expensive—a cup of coffee for 100 Points was like a robbery.
But if it was situated in a B-grade map, it didn’t seem so conspicuous.
The rule of this ruin was that after purchasing a cup of coffee, one could go to the psychological counseling room next door to seek advice from a psychological counselor.
With the guidance of the psychological counselor, one who successfully cuts off their Heart Demon would be able to pass through the ruin.
The three sat at a round table, each ordering a cup of coffee. Soon, a cylindrical robot approached, its top carrying three cups of coffee to them.
“It’s much more comfortable in here.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit casually sipped his coffee, furrowed his brows slightly, and put the cup back on the table, “Can’t get used to this bird stuff. Drinking this always makes me think of some weird things.”
“Come on, we have to pass through a total of five ruins. This is only the first one.”
“I’ll go set an example for everyone first.”
After speaking, Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t linger and went straight into the psychological counseling room, hidden behind a door.
Pushing the door open, it automatically closed behind him.
In front was a room of about thirty square meters. A good-looking woman was sitting behind a desk, staring at him and crisply said, “Please sit down. I’m the psychological counselor Nana.”
“Nana?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit thoughtfully pulled out a chair and sat down, resting his arms in front of him. He scrutinized the woman before him and suddenly asked, “What’s your relation to the game of ascension?”
“Are you an employee of the game?”
“Or were you dragged into this against your will, or are you simply an NPC filled with a segment of consciousness and not a living person by nature?”
“What kind of existence are you?”
The woman in front of him, dressed in a black suit exuding professionalism, showed no change in her facial expression. She just took out a mirror from her bosom and placed it on the desk.
“You need to stare at the mirror continuously for 3 seconds, and afterward, it will display your greatest Heart Demon from your memory.”
“Hmm?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stopped talking and withdrew his gaze from the woman, looking intently at the mirror. He was actually curious about what his greatest Heart Demon might be.
The three seconds quickly passed.
The mirror began to change. It turned white as if a computer had frozen, with nothing visible beyond it.
“What’s this supposed to mean?”
“…”
The woman, who had been impassive until that moment, suddenly leaned forward a bit. After a moment of silent furrowing of her brows, she spoke with a serious tone, “In your memory, you have no Heart Demon.”
“Everything you do, you do with a clean conscience.”
“Heh.”
Upon hearing this, Tuberculosis Rabbit grinned, leaning back in his chair, “So it’s over now?”
“Yes, you are free to leave.”
As Tuberculosis Rabbit left the room, a voice rang near his ear.
「Ding, congratulations on successfully clearing Ruin No. 3…」
…
“Very simple.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in front of Chen Yi and the other, spreading his arms and shrugging casually, “Basically no challenge. I just talked to that so-called psychological counselor for a few sentences and then walked out.”
“This must be the easiest of the seven ruins in this B-grade map.”
“If the difficulty of the map is all like this, it doesn’t deserve to be labeled as a B-grade map.”
“I’ll give it a try.”
Chen Yi stood up and, leaning on his cane, strode in. Seconds later, he emerged again, “The psychological counselor said I have no Heart Demon. Everything I do is in accordance with my heart.”
“…”
Sword Without End, standing aside with an ugly expression, remained silent in place. He knew these two were not normal. How could anyone live a lifetime without experiencing even a hint of guilt?
Good people?
No, as far as he knew, most so-called good people were motivated by excessive guilt inside, seeking to do good deeds to soothe their conscience.
In the case of a person with absolutely no sense of guilt in their heart, there was only one possibility.
Extreme self-interest.
Apart from themselves, they cared for no one else, indifferent to anything that happens in the world, only caring about themselves.
In such a situation, it was natural that they would not feel any remorse.
Such individuals are often modeled as villains. And he had two of them right beside him—damn… He remembered that he was supposed to be on the side of righteousness, wasn’t he?
He had heard of villains turning good halfway, but never good guys turning bad!
His mouth twitched slightly, and without saying much, he steeled himself and stepped into the psychology consultation room before him.
Following the procedure, he stared at the mirror for three seconds.
Suddenly, he felt as if the ground beneath his feet had lightened, and when his vision cleared, he was in a void.
Chaos was all around him.
Images flashed by him, one after another.
There were images of his wife bedridden with a serious illness, images of her being scolded by vendors in a market, and images of him, powerless, sitting in a hospital corridor, holding his head and crying.
Voices were echoing in his ears as well.
There were his own heart-wrenching screams, his wife’s agonized cries, the doctor’s helpless declarations, the bank’s cold refusals, and the funeral staff’s rapid-fire presentation of their services.
A myriad of sounds and a multitude of images.
Enveloped him.
It was like being thrown into an uninhabited area; amidst the cacophony, he felt an almost suffocating silence.
Sword Without End slowly lowered his head, looked at his feet, and remained silent.
He knew all too well what his Heart Demon was.
This hurdle, he’d never overcome in his life.
He couldn’t let go, didn’t want to, and more so, was unwilling to let go.
After a long silence, he spoke in a calm, soft voice.
“I’ve let go, it’s not the world to blame, but myself.”
“If I hadn’t been a failure who couldn’t earn money, my wife wouldn’t have died.”
“If I hadn’t been a failure who couldn’t earn money, my wife wouldn’t have been humiliated over a few cents at the market.”
“If…”
Sword Without End murmured, his expression dazed.
The last time he faced his Heart Demon, he shifted his self-loathing towards the world.
This time, to conquer his Heart Demon again, he must shift his loathing of the world back to himself.
He couldn’t completely sever his Heart Demon.
Only through displacement.
But the void remained all around him, offering no feedback, only the images playing on a loop, and the cries of his wife growing sharper in his ears.
Sword Without End, initially lost in a daze, began to unravel into hysterical madness.
With a crazed and fearsome howl, he shouted, “Didn’t I say it? It’s all my fault, all my fault, all because I’m such a waste!”
“I am a waste, less than a dog!”
“It has nothing to do with the world; I can’t blame anything or anyone, everything is because of me.”
“…”
…
Half an hour later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat at a round table, stirring the coffee in front of him with a glass rod, casually glanced at the psychology consultation room behind the bar and said, “Sword Without End hasn’t come out yet?”
“It’s been half an hour.”
Chen Yi didn’t reply, just studied the contents of the other six ruins on the map; he couldn’t make out the specific content of a ruin but could only grasp some vague information.
For instance, the description for Ruin No. 3 on the map was just a brief sentence.
“A café deep in the Wasteland, is it salvation or a mirage for you?”
Regular players would likely find it difficult to infer the specific content of Ruin No. 3 from this sentence.
Just then—
“Bang.”
The door to the psychology consultation room was violently pushed open. Sword Without End, his clothes somewhat disheveled and his face deathly white, his back completely soaked with sweat, stumbled out weakly.
Until he stepped outside the café.
With his back to the howling wind, he lit a cigarette and took a deep drag before collapsing heavily to the ground in a spread-eagle position, gazing blankly at the dark clouds overhead.
“Hey?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stepped out of the café, looked up above the doorway, then took a cigarette out of his pocket, inserted it into his mouth, and with hands in pockets, casually asked Sword Without End, lying on the Wasteland, “Doing alright?”
“You look like you just went through a tough battle in there.”
“I know that incident hit you hard, but after so long, you should be pretty much over it, right?”
Sword Without End did not respond, just lay there with a vacant stare, letting the newly lit cigarette be whipped away by the fierce wind without any reaction.
After lying there for a good three to five minutes.
He slowly regained some spirit, got up from the ground, glanced around, then turned to Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit with a wry smile, “Sorry, I must have been quite a sight.”
“This Heart Demon is a hurdle I find very difficult to overcome. Every time I think about it, it’s hard to get past.”
“I really loved her.”
‘Ding, friendly reminder, this is the second time this month you’ve violated Rule No. 2 of July by publicly expressing affection.’
Sword Without End’s voice suddenly stopped short.
“You’ve just violated the July Rules right?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Sword Without End quizzically, “There’s not much margin for error left now, stop declaring your love rashly; I really doubt you’ll make it to August.”
“But there’s something I’m curious about,”
“Would merely watching your wife die before your eyes really create such a powerful Heart Demon?”
“Hmm.”
After a brief pause, Sword Without End nodded, his complexion still pale and unseemly.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: 185: This can no longer be called a Heart Demon, it should be called the Heart Demon Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 185: This can no longer be called a Heart Demon, it should be called the Heart Demon Emperor
“Actually, I’m one of the lucky ones.”
Sword Without End had almost fully recovered by now and lit another cigarette; he didn’t put it in his mouth but just clamped it between his fingers, “I’ve told you that the title I bear was earned in a B-level map, right?”
“That was a map that focused on Heart Demons.”
“The process was much more complicated than this time.”
“It would throw you into the memories that trigger your Heart Demon, repeatedly, until you let your guard down slightly before moving on to the next stage.”
“There was another man who entered that map with me.”
“From Black Trench City.”
“His Heart Demon, I remember it vividly to this day!”
“His Heart Demon was getting locked up.”
“Getting locked up?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit raised an eyebrow in confusion, “That can count as a Heart Demon?”
“Yeah, the specific story is quite complex, involving a rather niche community, internally known as the Alphabet Circle.”
“‘S’ as in ‘Skill’ and ‘M’ as in ‘Cat’.”
“In this community, the ‘Cat’ often feels safe and stimulated through accepting whips, slaps, choking, and other methods from their ‘Skill’.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit swept a glance at Chen Yi, who hadn’t noticed their conversation, and cleared his throat with a quick cough, “I do have some understanding of this area, but I never got too deep into it, mainly because Yi doesn’t quite fancy it.”
“But what does that have to do with getting locked up?”
“Don’t rush, let me tell you the story slowly. After a lot of trouble, this guy finally found a ‘Cat.’ They arranged their first meeting in a park at night to start the training.”
“On the night before, this brother was so excited!”
“He was searching for techniques online, grooming his appearance.”
“The only thing he found puzzling was that this ‘Cat’ never chatted with him online, preferring to say, ‘Let’s talk when we meet in person.'”
“Without any suspicion, he met the girl in the park, and right on seeing her, she said, ‘Hit me, slap me across the face.'”
“Who could resist that?”
“Especially a vigorous young man.”
“This guy was trembling with excitement, and in front of the camera, he slapped her several times. The girl’s cries sounded especially pitiful, and she fainted, which led to her calling the police.”
“In the end… for provoking trouble, it took 20,000 for the settlement.”
“He was incarcerated for 15 days.”
“After getting out, this guy was almost in a half-monk state, avoiding girls and skipping out of their way. In that map, he went through his Heart Demon ordeal many more times than I did.”
“…”
As Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face froze in anticipation of the story to come, it suddenly stiffened into an expressionless silence. He paused for a moment before saying, “It makes sense for such an experience to leave a Heart Demon.”
“There’s another guy whose story is even more bizarre.”
Sword Without End, seemingly addicted to storytelling, eagerly began, “There was another guy who entered the map with us, I like to call him Old K.”
“After the game upgrade came out, a lot of people started to let loose, and he styled himself after a character from CS:GO called Old K, pulling a flesh-toned stocking over his head as if he was a bandit.”
“Let me interrupt, the thing on Old K’s head wasn’t a stocking.”
“I know, but this guy had a stocking on his head, do you know what his Heart Demon was?”
“This guy had it the worst; out of all of us who went into that map, he was the most miserable one.”
“He was an emergency room doctor. One day, he received an unconscious female patient in a rush to the emergency room.”
“On closer inspection, he realized the patient was his own wife.”
“On even closer inspection, he saw that his otherwise courteous and traditional wife had a tail inserted behind her, which had caused a tear and led to her unconsciousness.”
“After an investigation…”
“His wife had only married him to complete a task set by her ‘Skill’.”
“After the incident, they chose to divorce. The wife left without taking anything, not even the children. She had indeed grown to have feelings for Old K over the years and felt ashamed to face him and his family.”
“After the divorce, she committed suicide by jumping off a building.”
“But that’s not the end of it.”
“When this guy talked to the one from the story before, he shockingly discovered that Old K’s wife was the same woman who had blackmailed the previous guy. That woman had blackmailed the other man because her ‘Skill’ ran out of money and needed some cash.”
“Still not the end, soon after the divorce, the ‘Skill’ was found, and it turned out to be Old K’s colleague.”
“But that colleague had died in a car accident years earlier, so how could he have been remotely controlling Old K’s wife? There was no way he came back from the dead. Upon further investigation, it turned out that Old K had found his colleague’s phone years ago and discovered a very compliant ‘Cat’ on it. He couldn’t resist and started playing along.”
“To avoid exposing himself…”
“Over the years, Old K never used voice messages, video calls, or photos, and always used a voice changer.”
“So it was that Old K, still single, remotely controlled this former colleague’s ‘Cat’ to marry a decent man, and the ‘Cat’ obediently approached Old K, leading to their marriage.”
“On one hand, Old K was indulging in marital bliss, while on the other, he continued to remotely control his wife to…”
“Stop right there!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit abruptly interjected with a cold voice, “You fuck, let me get this straight! I’ve lived for decades, and for the first time, I feel completely out of my depth!”
“I know reality is magical, even science fiction, but nobody told me reality is like a fantasy, right?”
“And then?”
“In the end, the whole thing became Old K’s Heart Demon.”
“Makes sense.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently nodded, “It makes too much sense for it to be a Heart Demon, it should be called the Heart Demon Emperor. Did that guy ever come out in the end?”
“Don’t know, before I left the map, that guy was still there battling his Heart Demon. I don’t know if he’s finished now, but I guess it’s unlikely.”
“Sigh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently nodded again, lighting a cigarette and gazing distantly at the dark clouds with a faraway look, he sighed and said, “Your lives are all so rich, compared to you guys, it makes the life I’ve lived these years seem a bit dull and boring.”
“This plot is even more convoluted than the one I encountered last time I entered the Life Theater map.”
“Alright.”
Chen Yi, who had been examining the map, was the first to speak, breaking the conversation between the two, “Get ready to head to the next ruin, Ruin No. 4, which is the combat-type map Jiaye mentioned.”
After Jiaye and Tie Chui and the others successfully cleared this map, they increased its difficulty a bit, making the requirement to clear 5 ruins and trigger a special event.
Currently, the first ruin, which is the No. 3 Cafe Ruin, isn’t considered very difficult.
At least, for him and Tuberculosis Rabbit, it’s almost no challenge at all.
This map is also a level-based map.
A level-based map means that there are various levels within the map that players need to clear in order to achieve final victory and clear the map ultimately.
And like the other maps.
Such as “Night Widow Village” and “Destiny’s Adversary,” these maps aren’t considered level-based; they only have one condition for clearing.
It’s more accurate to say they are Fragmented maps than level-based maps.
They were all standing on a road paved with blue stone bricks, which stretched across the entire Wasteland; this must be the official road mentioned by Jiaye. Stepping off the official road would lead to a random special event.
If one were to fly, they’d be unaffected.
Ordinary people would, of course, try to avoid this special event as much as possible, but since their clearing condition requires that they trigger a special event, they still have to bite the bullet and walk onto it.
Just as Chen Yi activated the sled, preparing to shoot towards the nearest 4th ruin.
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly spoke up.
“Yi, the additional map information from my title has come through.”
“The information says that if all seven ruins are cleared, each player who passes through the seven ruins will receive a unique mystery reward from the map, with the lowest reward level being… at least B.”
“The specific level will be based on the player’s performance in clearing the seven ruins.”
“The specific reward will also depend on the player’s performance.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow, his interest piqued by this reward. The lowest level was B, so there might be A level rewards?
Until now, he had not seen any A-level Props or Skills.
It seemed that this hidden reward was only achievable after the Map Difficulty was raised.
Such as Jiaye and his team, who, after clearing three ruins, would be forced to leave the map, even if they wanted to continue and clear the remaining ruins, they would no longer have the chance.
Only after the Map Difficulty was raised would they have a chance.
Because as long as they didn’t trigger a special event, they were not worried about being forced to leave the map after clearing five ruins.
Even if they cleared five ruins and met the condition to be forcibly removed from the map, if the condition wasn’t fully met, they would continue to stay on the map.
So the next steps required focus on two points.
First, have the best performance possible within the ruins.
Second, absolutely do not trigger a special event, otherwise, after clearing five ruins and being forced off the map, they’d be forever barred from the ultimate mystery reward.
“Let’s go!”
Having clarified this point, Chen Yi didn’t hesitate any longer. He activated the sled, nearly parallel to the dark clouds, and shot towards the direction of the 4th ruin!
“Awoo!!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in the center of the sled, his arms outstretched and face excited, shouting against the howling wind.
He loved this weather.
This weather that made others feel stifled and breathless gave him a feeling of sheer exhilaration!
A few minutes passed.
The sled gradually stopped at the entrance of a movie theater.
This movie theater was also a single-story building, covering a larger area than the cafe, the similarity being that it stood out starkly and sharply against the backdrop of the Wasteland.
The bright strip of lights on the walls of the movie theater appeared particularly warm.
There were no other customers around, only the few of them.
Dark clouds loomed overhead, almost touching the ground.
Chen Yi and the other two stood in front of the theater entrance, looking up at the gigantic screen above the movie theater.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: 186: "Watch me, I will come out within three minutes!
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 186: “Watch me, I will come out within three minutes!
“Site 4 Ruins, Cinema.”
“As you can see, this is a cinema. You are welcome to participate as specially invited guests.”
“You will need to kill a replica in the cinema whose strength is greater than your own.”
“Perhaps, in the midst of life and death, your combat experience will breakthrough.”
“Clearing condition: Kill your opponent.”
“This must be the Site 4 Ruins that Jiaye mentioned.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood with his hands in his pockets, facing the howling wind as he looked toward the deserted entrance of the cinema: “A combat-type map where props and skills can’t be used, killing a stronger replica sounds quite challenging.”
“The injuries they had, a large part must have been sustained here.”
“I’ll go in first.”
Chen Yi, with a calm expression on his face, walked into the cinema with one hand on his cane. Following the markers on the floor, he quickly came to the auditorium.
The pitch-dark auditorium suddenly lit up as he entered, and the darkness was chased away in an instant!
In the center of the auditorium stood a man who looked exactly like him.
Clothes, build, facial structure—completely identical.
The man was holding a Tang Blade, and the cane in his own hand had somehow been swapped for a Tang Blade as well.
Chen Yi stood still, looking at the man in front of him who bore his likeness. He did not take the initiative to attack; instead, his eyes narrowed with a hint of curiosity—perfectly replicated.
Stronger than him?
Sounds interesting.
How much stronger?
Without staying put, he slowly approached the man close by with the Tang Blade in hand. The man also moved towards him.
“Clang!”
The first slash.
Chen Yi immediately felt where the strength of the replica lay: slightly quicker speed, a bit more strength.
“Clang!”
The second slash.
Chen Yi looked at the man before him who was parrying with his blade, a slow smile spreading across his lips.
So it seems he’s only replicated the offensive techniques and physical abilities.
As a replica, to actually wield the blade in defense—does it fear death?
Seeing the man swing the blade a third time, Chen Yi did not parry this time but almost simultaneously lifted his blade and slashed at the man’s neck!
Both parties swung their blades at each other’s necks!
A posture that seemed intent on mutual destruction!
Just as Chen Yi’s Tang Blade was about to strike the neck of the replica, the replica suddenly stopped and retreated quickly, avoiding the Fatal Strike.
But it was already too late.
Although the vital spot was avoided,
a ghastly wound was left across the chest, skin and flesh rolling out over the clothing.
Because of the sudden retreat, the replica’s blade did not hit Chen Yi’s neck. There was no mutual destruction or mutual injury, only a terrifying wound opened on its own chest.
“Fear and pain are important protective mechanisms for the human body.”
Chen Yi, with a placid face, twirled the Tang Blade in his hand and calmly approached the injured replica: “Without fear, it means you can’t protect yourself as well.”
“But it allows for a more effective assault on the enemy.”
“At the moment where life and death intersect, the one who grips their blade tighter will be the victor.”
“As a replica, you actually fear death more than I do.”
“If you don’t die, who dies?”
As his words ended,
Chen Yi did not delay, his two hands gripped the Tang Blade and he leaped up on the spot, slashing down with the force of a mountain!
“Clang!”
The Tang Blade sliced straight into the replica’s head, sticking into the skull and getting lodged by the cranial bones.
Chen Yi casually released the handle of the blade and turned to walk toward the light gate at the back. His cane somehow reappeared in his hand, and as he turned, the body of the replica with the Tang Blade stuck in its head slowly fell to the ground.
A thud sounded.
The replica’s physical capabilities might have been slightly better than Chen Yi’s, but it did not leave a single wound on him.
When it comes to close-combat fighting experience,
Chen Yi had no fancy techniques to speak of, but killing didn’t require much skill.
Fighting skills are prepared for combat.
And for killing, you only need to know a few vital spots.
When determining victory in life and death, psychological warfare is a significant factor.
…
“Is it over?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Chen Yi, who just walked out of the cinema, rubbing his hands eagerly with a hint of desire to try: “Yi, you cleared it in one minute and forty-five seconds. Let me see if I can beat your time.”
“Sword Without End, you go first. I want to see how long it will take you.”
“Good luck.”
Chen Yi nodded, without mentioning that he had spent most of that minute and a bit walking.
The actual clearing time was probably less than thirty seconds.
The fight was over in the time it took to deliver four slashes.
“Alright.”
Sword Without End took a deep breath, then stepped into the cinema with a stern face and an air of facing death with calm, as if braving the chilling winds of the Yi River.
…
In the auditorium, under the spotlight.
Sword Without End, holding a Tang Blade, looked at the replica opposite him. After sizing each other up for a moment, he took another deep breath, held his breath, and with a fierce glint in his eyes, charged straight forward!
The replica, also armed with a Tang Blade, rushed at Sword Without End with even greater speed.
Both lifted their Tang Blades simultaneously, slashing at the other. They were about to crash into each other in close combat!
Sword Without End suddenly spoke with an urgent voice, “Your wife is dead because you had no money; your wife died from illness.”
“You’re a failure, why are you still here? Why not just go kill yourself?”
With those words spoken.
The Sword Without End who was initially hurtling towards the real Sword Without End flashed a look of grief and anger in his eyes, and his speed suddenly decreased. The ferocity in his eyes dimmed considerably, along with the murderous intent.
Indeed, it worked.
With great joy in his heart, Sword Without End did not hesitate, striking while the iron is hot—he aimed the Tang Blade in his hand at the Replica before him and swung with all his might!
“Slash!”
A one-strike kill!
Looking at the Replica lying in a pool of blood, Sword Without End saw the face that looked exactly like his own, giving him the creeps. He shuddered before turning to walk toward the light gate behind him.
On seeing the contents of Ruin No.4, he had thought, since it was his Replica, shouldn’t it possess the same Heart Demon as himself?
The Replica might not have his memories.
But it would certainly have his Heart Demon.
Because Ruin No.3 had extracted his Heart Demon; if the databases for Ruins No.3 and No.4 were the same, when cloning his original body, the data of his Heart Demon would surely be left in the Replica’s database.
As expected.
“Humph.”
Sword Without End hummed with some satisfaction before he put his hands behind his head and walked towards the exit of the cinema.
A weakling who had not even slain his own Heart Demon dares to contend with him!
But just as he was about to leave the cinema, Sword Without End suddenly glanced down at the time on his personal panel, and after a brief moment of thought, he decided not to leave immediately but stayed a few more minutes inside the cinema.
…
“Not bad at all,” commented Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking at Sword Without End who came out rather quickly, “Three minutes and forty seconds, barely slower than Yi, you’re quite capable.”
“Just luck, pure luck,” said Sword Without End, scratching the back of his head somewhat sheepishly, “The Replica was quite strong, and I only managed to kill it after a long struggle. Yi came out so quickly because his strength is far superior to mine.”
“That’s true,” nodded Tuberculosis Rabbit, and then he headed for the cinema with enthusiasm and confidence: “Watch me, I’ll be out in under three minutes!”
…
In the cinema, under the spotlight.
Carrying a Tang Blade confidently, Tuberculosis Rabbit froze emotionlessly on the spot as soon as he entered. He didn’t say a word before attempting to flee, but as soon as he set foot inside, the exit behind him disappeared.
The light gate to leave the cinema would only appear after killing the Replica.
Seeing no way out, Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a somewhat fierce and crazy expression, ran towards the far side of the cinema, yelling, “Let me out, dammit, do you know your system’s bugging out?”
“What?”
“Did you even see what crap you put in the cinema?”
“Where’s the promised passionate one-on-one brawl?!”
“Did you get senile while copying and pasting and hit ‘paste’ a hundred times by mistake?”
In the cinema, under the spotlight, a hundred emotionless and cold-faced Replicas of Tuberculosis Rabbit were holding Tang Blades and looking towards the Tuberculosis Rabbit who was running and screaming. Without any hesitation, they encircled and advanced upon him!
It turned out to be… 1v100!
“Fuck your mother!!!” yelled Tuberculosis Rabbit, seeing himself being blocked in the front and having no escape in the back, as he was flanked from the right. In a complete frenzy and with eyes red with murderous intent, he charged straight towards one of the Replicas in front!
And the Replica in front also coldly swung his blade in an attack.
As they were about to clash,
Tuberculosis Rabbit swung the shirt he had stripped off earlier, trapping the Tang Blade that was about to slice into him, and in that brief moment, he plunged his own Tang Blade straight into the chest of the Replica before him!
A one-strike kill!
“One!”
The following attackers were almost stepping on the heels of the first, and Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t even have time to pull the Tang Blade out of the corpse. He had to abandon the blade and flee, using his shirt to roll up the Tang Blade he had just entangled and continue his mad dash forward.
Racing back and forth across the seats at the back of the cinema, Tuberculosis Rabbit did not forget to taunt in anger:
“Can’t you play this game properly, huh?”
“A hundred of you against me, and you still got taken down by me!”
“Go home and eat shit!”
However, the physical abilities of the Replicas were slightly superior to those of the players, not to mention… there were a whole one hundred of them.
The cinema wasn’t roomy either; there wasn’t much space to escape.
Seeing that he was about to be surrounded,
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes scanned quickly, his gaze turning bloodshot as he found a breakthrough only guarded by two Replicas.
He had to break through!
His only chance of survival was to hit and run; once he was surrounded in the middle, nine lives wouldn’t be enough to spare.
“Slash!”
Using his shirt, Tuberculosis Rabbit wrapped up the blade that was striking from the left, then ducked and chopped off the blade swinging from the right. During the ducking motion, he swung his blade in a chopping motion himself, killing another before breaking through this point of attack.
He was now out of immediate danger of being encircled.
But this time, the shirt didn’t catch the incoming Tang Blade properly, and it left a bloody, nearly bone-deep wound on his left palm.
Tuberculosis Rabbit tried moving his left hand; the wound looked frightening, but at least it was a flesh wound that hadn’t reached bone. Aside from some pain and bleeding, there were no other issues.
Staring at his blood-soaked left hand,
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly stopped, his eyes narrowing slightly, a look of confusion flashing across them.
“This injury…”
“Why does it feel so familiar?”
…
PS: My stomach feels better, I didn’t drag the update today, it’s on time.
It’s the end of the month, and your monthly tickets are about to expire. Instead of letting them go to waste, why not cast them for me…

chapters.title: Chapter 189: 187: "Can You Give Your Grandpa Some Challenge?
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 187: “Can You Give Your Grandpa Some Challenge?
“This feeling…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out his Tang Blade and glanced at the wound on his left hand with a hint of confusion in his eyes.
It was as if he had been wounded like this before.
Yet, in his memory, his left hand had never suffered such a severe injury—why then did it feel so familiar?
But at that moment.
The sound of the Tang Blade cleaving through the air from behind was already ringing beside his ear. There was no time to ponder these trivial matters, as Tuberculosis Rabbit took a deep breath and pushed his body to its peak condition.
A clumsy somersault dodged that strike.
He then casually wrapped his shirt around his left hand for an extremely rudimentary bandage. There was no time to worry about infections. What was most crucial was preserving his left hand’s maximum fighting ability.
…
“Hey.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in a pool of blood, covered in countless gruesome wounds with the flesh turned out. He leaned on the Tang Blade, his body slightly swaying. His eyes, filled with blood, looked blurrily towards the Replica standing a few meters away.
The corners of his mouth twitched slightly from the pain, and he breathed heavily, his chest heaving, sounding like a bellows. His voice weak, he broke into a wry smile.
“So this is your strength, huh?”
“Aren’t you my Replica? I remember not being this weak.”
“Could you please give your grandpa a bit of a challenge?”
“Beating the weak is so boring.”
Standing on the spot, Tuberculosis Rabbit held his stomach with his left hand, where there was the most terrifying wound of all.
A horizontal cut.
Almost enough to bisect his body at the waist.
Several intestines were already slipping through the gaps in Rabbit’s fingers, dangling in the air, a ghastly sight to behold.
Blood spread across the entire auditorium, turning the scene horribly bloody. The auditorium was littered with numerous bodies, and Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing amidst the bloodbath, looked like the fierce Gods and Demons descended, unbearable to look upon!
The Replica standing opposite Tuberculosis Rabbit was the only one left.
At this moment, this Replica too was severely wounded, its entire left arm chopped off. Thick blood flowed down from the sleeve of the left arm onto the ground, dripping and tapping in the silent auditorium.
Hearing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s scorn.
The Replica didn’t respond, more precisely, it seemed to lack the ability to speak.
It just gripped the Tang Blade tightly and charged at the wobbling Tuberculosis Rabbit for one final assault.
“Clang.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit raised his right arm and blocked the Replica’s descending blade with his Tang Blade. However, already exhausted, he didn’t completely block the attack, and his right arm was dislocated, losing its fighting power for the moment.
But he stopped the Replica’s life-risking strike.
“Heh.”
The disadvantaged Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the last Replica, who had already rushed right in front of him. Far from despairing, he grimaced again with a smirk; his left hand, which had been holding his belly, suddenly stabbed out straight towards the eyes of the Replica in front of him.
“Bang.”
The sound of an eyeball bursting echoed.
Under severe pain, the Replica did not hesitate and immediately dropped its blade and retreated. However, Tuberculosis Rabbit was not about to give it the chance. He was at his last stand, and if the Replica managed to evade him for just a bit longer, he would surely die.
The taunts he had thrown out before were also in hopes that the Replica would not delay any longer. He wanted it to attack him before he passed out from excessive blood loss.
This was his last chance.
And his only chance.
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s two fingers hooked tightly around the Replica’s eye sockets, his body following through, tackling the Replica to the ground.
In the instant before landing, propelled by inertia, he aimed for the Replica’s groin and lifted his knee to smash forcefully!
“Thud!”
Though the Replica didn’t scream out loud from the pain, its suddenly pale expression, the contorted face, and the way its body curled up like a shrimp gave away how much pain it must have been in.
Without his weapon and at the end of his strength, Tuberculosis Rabbit took a heavy breath, spat out a mouthful of bloody phlegm, and didn’t release the left hand hooked in the Replica’s eye sockets. With his right hand, he fiercely grabbed the Replica’s groin.
Then, a fierce light flashed in his eyes as he squeezed hard.
“Aaah!!!”
He thought he could faintly hear the Replica’s painful scream.
The next second—
The Replica that had been frantically struggling suddenly convulsed a few times and then fell still, apparently passing out from the pain.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, lying on top of this Replica, took several deep breaths before managing to stand up again with effort. He picked up the Tang Blade that had fallen nearby and looked at the Replica lying on the ground, now unconscious from the shock.
Both hands grabbed the hilt of the blade.
Aimed at the neck, and thrust down fiercely!
“Pshht!”
Blood spurted out!
At the same time, an alert sounded right in his ear.
“Ding, congratulations on successfully clearing Ruin Number 4…”
And, slowly emerging on the wall of the auditorium was a white light door allowing exit.
“Cough cough cough.”
Choking on his own blood, Tuberculosis Rabbit coughed violently a few times before spitting another thick glob of phlegm. He then bent down to stuff the protruding intestines back into his abdomen.
Afterward, he stood still, sweeping a glance around him.
He threw aside the Tang Blade in his hand.
Clutching his stomach with one hand, his body trembling slightly, Tuberculosis Rabbit shuffled step by step towards the exit of the cinema hall.
Behind Tuberculosis Rabbit, the pools of blood, corpses, and the Tang Blade slowly turned into white light and dissipated.
A voice slowly echoed throughout the entire cinema hall.
“With such a big bug going unchecked, this game is bound to cool off sooner or later.”
“Damn, it hurts like hell.”
“Speaking of which, I’ve got a tough life, not dying from this.”
…
As soon as Tuberculosis Rabbit stepped out of the cinema hall, he saw Chen Yi and Sword Without End standing at the entrance. He paused and then cracked a smile, “Yi, what are you guys doing here? Weren’t you waiting at the entrance of the cinema?”
“How did you end up inside?”
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi frowned slightly, nodded without saying much, and quickly inspected Tuberculosis Rabbit’s injuries before looking towards a new feature that was added to the squad upon leveling up.
「Squad lv.2 added feature: Injury Share.」
「Injury Share: When a teammate suffers from extremely serious injuries, the leader can choose to distribute those injuries among the remaining teammates, pulling the injured teammate back from the brink of death. The cost is that all squad members will sustain a certain degree of injuries.」
And at that moment.
The tight string in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes that had been holding firm shattered at the sight of Chen Yi, and afterward, he suddenly lost consciousness and collapsed backward.
“Motherfucker!”
Sword Without End, with quick reflexes, reached out and caught Tuberculosis Rabbit, preventing him from crashing to the ground. He gazed at the terrifying wound on Tuberculosis Rabbit’s belly with fear in his eyes!
The wound had nearly sliced Tuberculosis Rabbit in half!
As Tuberculosis Rabbit fell, his legs remained standing in place without budging, while his upper body toppled backward. If not for Sword Without End’s quick reaction to catch him, Tuberculosis Rabbit would probably have turned into a ‘pancake’ split in half and pressed back together.
The severity of the injury was truly frightening.
Even Sword Without End, who was often carefree, couldn’t help feeling a shiver, his voice trembling, “Yi, it seems like he isn’t breathing…”
Without any hesitation, Chen Yi quickly activated the lv.2 squad’s new feature.
「Injury Share!」
The next second——
The wounds on Tuberculosis Rabbit’s body began to heal rapidly, but correspondingly, wounds appeared on Chen Yi and Sword Without End as well!
Wherever Tuberculosis Rabbit was injured, they were injured in the same places.
However, the severity of the injuries was not as significant anymore, only turning what had been fatal into serious injuries.
Just like that, Tuberculosis Rabbit who was nearing his descent into hell was pulled back from death’s door.
…
After bandaging Tuberculosis Rabbit’s wounds, Chen Yi took off his upper garments and sat at the entrance of the cinema to bandage himself.
Even though the severity was distributed among the three of them, the injuries were still severe.
After finishing, Chen Yi tossed a bandage prop into Sword Without End’s arms, “Treat your wounds.”
“Okay.”
Sword Without End caught the bandage prop and pulled another prop from his bosom, placing it on the ground, “I’ve got some more here, with anti-inflammatory, regenerative panda blood, and flesh-regeneration properties.”
“Thanks.”
Chen Yi didn’t fuss and began to activate and use these props.
He had similar props, but they were all in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s backpack, and since Tuberculosis Rabbit was unconscious, he couldn’t retrieve them.
Half an hour later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been unconscious, slowly opened his eyes and glanced around. Seeing Chen Yi and the others sitting cross-legged in the Wasteland, roasting barbecue on a makeshift grill, he realized what was happening and said excitedly with a chuckle,
“We’ve got barbecue, haven’t had that in a long time.”
“Awake?”
Chen Yi glanced at the now-awake Tuberculosis Rabbit, casually picked up a grilled pork intestine from the grill, and handed it over, “Have some intestine, you’ve lost a good deal of yours; eat some to compensate.”
“The movie theatre is closed now. Once all players in the map have cleared it, the theatre can’t be entered anymore.”
“We’ll have to stay out here in the Wasteland.”
“But with the sleigh for protection, there isn’t too much wind.”
“Alright then.”
Disregarding his injuries, Tuberculosis Rabbit took the grilled intestine from Yi and bit into it, nodding in appreciation as he chewed, “Nicely roasted, firm and flavorful.”
“It just hurts a bit because I’ve got too many cuts in my mouth, and the chili powder stings them when eating.”
“That’s Sword Without End’s handiwork.”
Chen Yi pulled out a box of chilled beer from his chest and threw it on the ground, “Rinse your mouth with a bit of this. Alcohol numbs the pain, drink some, and it won’t hurt as much to eat.”
“No rush this time on the map, no time limits.”
“Let’s heal up properly before moving out.”
They leaned against the sleigh, with the grill in place, the sleigh blocking almost all the wind.
Across the endless plain of the Wasteland, and the thick clouds hanging low in the sky, blotting out the sun, the atmosphere felt incredibly oppressive.
It wasn’t dark, but it was dim.
A sense of extreme greyness permeated.
But for the three seated behind the sleigh, there was a sense of tranquil leisure often stolen amidst fleeting life.
Utterly relaxed.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: 188: Turns Out Love Has a Flavor.
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 188: Turns Out Love Has a Flavor.
“`
“Hiss!”
When the chili powder suddenly hit the wound in his mouth, Sword Without End couldn’t help but gasp. Hurriedly, he grabbed a glass of chilled beer and guzzled it down, “First time eating barbecue with injuries like these, still not quite used to it.”
After slamming down a cup of beer, Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t reach for another skewer but instead lit a cigarette and took several deep drags before speaking through the thin blue smoke with a laugh.
“At that final moment, my deepest regret was not lighting a cigarette before blacking out. It would have been too pitiful if I had died.”
“But Sword Without End, you kid, not many can handle the habits Yi and I have.”
“Most people would avoid smoking, drinking, greasy, and spicy foods after being injured.”
“I did put you in a tough spot, sharing the injury with me.”
“It’s nothing,”
Sword Without End shook his head, looking at Tuberculosis Rabbit with some confusion, “But did something happen in there? How did you get so badly injured, and you were in there for almost an hour?”
He was stunned when he saw the extent of Tuberculosis Rabbit’s injuries.
He admitted the map was challenging.
A replica exactly like you, with slightly superior physical abilities.
If it weren’t for the fact that he managed to break the replica’s psychological defense with his Heart Demon, he might have also ended up injured to get out alive, or it wasn’t impossible to even die in there.
But… Tuberculosis Rabbit’s injuries were too exaggerated.
It was only after sharing the injuries could he truly grasp how severe Tuberculosis Rabbit’s wounds were.
Small and large all over, nearly fifty different cuts.
There were almost three through-and-through wounds on the shoulders.
Some of the skin wounds were considered just scratches compared to the rest.
To walk out with such injuries was nothing short of a medical miracle. Normally, a person would be dead already, not able to walk out at all.
Even to speak normally with a smile before passing out.
It felt like he had been getting tortured for an hour.
Chen Yi didn’t speak, just filled another glass of beer for Tuberculosis Rabbit and, lighting a cigarette of his own, leaned against the snow sled, patiently waiting for Tuberculosis Rabbit’s reply.
However, the fluctuation in his eyes hinted that he wasn’t as calm as he appeared.
He and Tuberculosis Rabbit had suffered many injuries before.
But this time was definitely the worst of them all, no contest.
He thought back to those scenes he had seen in the cinema.
In that Life Cinema.
Tuberculosis Rabbit died, Sword Without End died, he died, Tie Chui and Jiaye died, everyone died.
Although he was aware that was just a possible future scene.
But at the moment Tuberculosis Rabbit blacked out, his heart had abruptly stopped.
No pain, no grief.
It was just a sudden stop of the heart, making him feel like everything he would do after Tuberculosis Rabbit’s death would become meaningless.
If he were an actor,
Then Tuberculosis Rabbit was his only audience.
With the audience gone, there was no longer any need for the actor to remain on stage.
“Hey.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit cursed under his breath, clearly irritated, “This damn upgrade in the game, so full of bugs. They fix bugs every month, and yet there are still so many.”
“A game based on realism, and it has so many bugs!”
“What a joke!”
“Right after I went in, there were like a hundred replicas in that cinema, each holding a Tang Blade in their hand!”
“You guys know, the replicas’ physical abilities are slightly better than ours.”
“Man, this is like 1v100, straight to a royal flush from the start!”
“I saw this and scoffed, thinking a mere hundred dares to be unruly before me. Then I started a massive spree, taking down four or five replicas with every swing of my blade!”
“`
“They’re just a bunch of chickens and mutts, not worth mentioning!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was on a roll, a cigarette wedged between his fingers as he excitedly waved his arms about, boasting with effort—he was shirtless, his upper body wrapped in bandages, looking like a street bum who just came back from a brawl at a barbecue stand, bragging over a drink.
“Impressive!”
Sword Without End also gave a thumbs up, his face full of admiration as he timely flattered!
Chen Yi’s mouth twitched into a slight smile as he leaned against the sled, his left hand resting on his drawn-up knee, holding a glass of wine and gazing into the distance, drinking to himself intermittently.
All three of them were shirtless.
Their bodies were completely wrapped in bandages.
They looked quite comical.
The group had no intention of continuing on to the next ruins. Instead, they planned to heal their injuries first, after a generous application of healing props had been spread out and their wounds had been distributed evenly.
Tuberculosis Rabbit had already completely escaped the risk to his life and everyone’s injuries were healing quickly.
…
“Please, let nothing happen, please, let nothing happen.”
Jiaye kneeled on the ground with a worried face, his eyes brimming with anxiousness as he looked at a rabbit doll on the altar in front of him, his voice hurriedly praying nonstop.
“Blessed Rabbit God, please keep Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit safe and sound.”
“If you really need company down there, take Sword Without End. He’s good with words, and if you take him down, he’ll keep you entertained with his chatter.”
“Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit both have sharp tongues; they’ll probably just end up annoying you.”
Jiaye, not even aware of what he was saying, continued to pray lowly and anxiously, full of concern.
“Sis… sis.”
While bandaging his own wounds, Tie Chui looked towards the rabbit doll on the altar with a somewhat vacant gaze: “I… am slow-witted, but I… know how to use Baidu.”
“I just searched… there’s no such thing as a Rabbit God.”
“Did you… pray to the wrong deity?”
“No.”
Jiaye didn’t even lift his head: “Both Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit have the character for ‘rabbit’ in their names, they’re family. It should be appropriate to pray to the Rabbit God for them.”
“Oh… but don’t you like Chen Yi? Why pray for Tuberculosis Rabbit as well?”
“If Tuberculosis Rabbit died, Yi would be upset, and I don’t want him to feel sad.”
“Oh.”
Tie Chui nodded silently. It seemed Sword Without End’s status wasn’t that high, after all.
He said no more but continued to bandage himself in silence. Even though he worried about Yi, without a pass, he could no longer enter the Death Domain Map, so all he could do was wait outside for the outcome.
He just wasn’t in a rush, that’s all.
The strength of Yi far surpassed his own; if Tie Chui could clear a map, there was no reason for Yi to encounter trouble inside one.
In his eyes, Jiaye’s worries were completely unnecessary.
“Tie Chui!”
Jiaye suddenly realized something, turned around sharply, and looked at Tie Chui behind her: “Do you think Yi suddenly entered the Death Domain to save us? Otherwise, they should be passing through a squad map right now. It makes no sense for them to suddenly come to a B-level map.”
“I don’t know.”
Tie Chui shook his head gravely.
He truly didn’t know; Yi hadn’t said anything, so how could he possibly know.
Jiaye, who had just shown a flash of joy, once again looked forlorn as he knelt on the ground staring at the rabbit doll on the altar, lost in thought for no telling how long, before suddenly speaking up.
“I’ve made up my mind. Once Yi comes out of the map this time, I’m going to confess my feelings to him.”
“Oh.”
Tie Chui nodded and said nothing further, but suddenly he remembered the experience Tuberculosis Rabbit had taken him to at Silver Party—perhaps this was the taste of love? It turned out love had a flavor.
It tasted somewhat salty, like the sea breeze.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: 189: "I think people can be perverted, but there should be a limit to how perverted,
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 189: “I think people can be perverted, but there should be a limit to how perverted,
Seven to eight hours later.
Although Chen Yi and his companions’ injuries had not fully healed, they no longer significantly impeded their movements. After a brief preparation, they sat on a sled and shot toward the nearest ruin.
Fortunately, this time the map had no time limit.
If there had been a time limit while still bearing such severe injuries, without time to recover, the danger would have increased significantly. Even so, they felt the danger brought by the B-level map.
To be precise… it was Tuberculosis Rabbit who experienced the crisis brought by the B-level map.
A brush with death.
After the cigarette in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s mouth burned to the end, they safely arrived at Ruin No. 2.
“Ruin No. 2, an abandoned school.”
“As you can see, this is a long-abandoned school. Rumor has it that at the dead of night, there appear to be some unusual entities.”
“Anything that appears will not harm you, at least not physically.”
“You need to follow the guide and walk through every specific corner of the school–classrooms, playgrounds, bathrooms, etc.”
“Clearance condition: psychological fluctuation peak below 30%.”
This was the largest ruin they had come across.
The area it covered… was vast.
What met their eyes was a somewhat dilapidated school gate, with the guardroom at the entrance long deserted, clearly having been unattended for a while. Beyond the gate was a playground meant for students to run on.
Behind it stood a four-story teaching building.
Each floor could accommodate about six classrooms.
Beyond this, there were no other main buildings, no staff buildings, no dormitories–it looked like a rather rudimentary school.
“This ruin is simple.”
With his hands in his pockets, Tuberculosis Rabbit stood at the entrance of the campus and laughed, “It seems to be a paranormal type of ruin. Once we enter the map, something should come to scare us. As long as the psychological fluctuation peak is below 30%, we’ll pass successfully.”
“I hope the subsequent ruins will be as simple as this one.”
“…”
Sword Without End felt a slight twitch at the corner of his mouth and said nothing. Somehow, he felt this map had some hostility toward him. Although he had managed to get through the May rule of not thinking about ghosts,
that didn’t mean he wasn’t afraid of this.
It was just forcibly suppressing his own thoughts.
He actually found it difficult to ensure that his psychological fluctuation peak would be below 30%, especially since there was no concrete concept of what 30% was. Who knew how scared one would have to be to reach 30%?
“Let’s go inside.”
Chen Yi, limping with a cane in one hand, walked ahead, crossing the guardroom to enter the school.
The guardroom had been abandoned, the gate left completely open as if inviting everyone to enter.
The sky was the same as when they entered the map.
It was predominantly dark.
But not pitch-black.
There was still some light.
The sky of this map seemed to be fixed, or at least it hadn’t changed for now. From time to time, a gust of wind would lift sand into their eyes, which was quite annoying.
The campus was spacious and eerily quiet.
Chen Yi didn’t head straight to the teaching building, instead walking toward the playground first, planning to circle it. For him, this ruin was like a fighter jet pilot going on a roller coaster ride.
It wasn’t just pressure. It was a total dimensionality reduction attack.
After circling the playground without finding anything noteworthy, they headed straight for the teaching building.
“The scenery isn’t bad.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with his arm resting on the balcony of the fourth-floor corridor, looked down at the schoolyard, appreciated the view for a while, and then casually entered the first classroom on the fourth floor, ready to check each classroom one by one.
Chen Yi and Sword Without End followed behind Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“Huh?”
This classroom was much brighter than the outside world. Three huge light bulbs illuminated the entire classroom extremely brightly, the only one in the entire teaching building with the lights on.
“Cough.”
Feeling a sense of foreboding, Sword Without End coughed lightly and, subconsciously, moved closer to Chen Yi. If it weren’t a bit embarrassing, he would have liked to grab the hem of Chen Yi’s clothes.
Based on his years of experience watching horror films, something was about to happen right here.
The brighter the place, the more troublesome it would be.
Tuberculosis Rabbit searched the classroom but found nothing scary, shaking his head in some disappointment. If he had designed this map, it would have been much more interesting.
As he prepared to leave the classroom, he turned off the lights on his way out.
“Don’t you know about saving electricity?”
However, upon casually glancing back, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked toward the depths of the classroom with a somewhat strange expression.
In the dim classroom, a disheveled and blurred figure stood silently there.
“Huh?”
