Curious, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned the lights back on. Once the brightness filled the room again, the shadowy figure at the back of the classroom disappeared.
He somewhat defiantly turned off the lights again.
The blurred figure re-emerged in the depths of the classroom, only now it seemed to be slightly closer to them.
“…”
Sword Without End felt a twitch at the corner of his mouth before suggesting, “I think we can leave now. We’ve already checked this room, no need to look for trouble, right?”
“No way.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head seriously, “After passing all seven ruins, you get a unique special reward, and the level and contents of the reward are determined by our performance in these ruins.”
“Obviously, we can’t just pass through simply; we have to trigger as many things in this map as possible to get a high perfect score.”
“Besides, these ghostly things can’t hurt you, so what are you afraid of?”
“You make sense.”
Sword Without End nodded silently in agreement, not refuting anymore. However, he couldn’t help but take a step back to stand behind Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit. Only then did he feel a sense of safety again as he peered through the gap between the two at the vague figure in the depths of the classroom.
Seemingly interested, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned the lights on again.
The figure disappeared.
Upon turning off the light again, the figure had come another step closer, now less than six meters away.
“Heh.”
With a grin, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked toward the blurred figure in the depths of the classroom and flipped the light switch on and off again.
“Ah!”
However, at that moment—
The figure, which had been at the back of the classroom, zoomed towards them like a shadow, screaming with a pale face and bloodshot eyes, “Ahh!!!”
The piercing scream echoed throughout the classroom and lingered above the whole school.
But the next second, the scream of the female ghost came to an abrupt halt.
“Don’t you know how to play?”
With a swift movement of his right hand, Tuberculosis Rabbit grabbed the neck of the female ghost in front of him and spoke discontentedly, “According to the procedure, we need to turn off the lights a few more times before you can rush out to scare us.”
“Don’t you know how to play?”
“This was only a few times, and you’re already jumping out from so far away. Who are you trying to scare?”
Then he stared at the female ghost in his hand, suddenly lifted her long sideburns, and twisted her chin, examining her curiously, “You’ve got quite a fair and delicate look.”
Glancing down at the female ghost’s white robe, he shook it off casually as if shaking off chicks, stripping the clothing from her body.
“Hey, not a bad figure either.”
“Are you really a ghost woman? Or are you a masseuse from Lin Yin Foot Bath Shop?”
They had once stumbled into a special event, which was the Lin Yin Foot Bath Shop where they were forced to get a massage for an hour.
The memory was still fresh.
“That…”
Sword Without End glanced over unintentionally before saying, “Tuberculosis Rabbit, she’s a ghost woman. Look how pale the corpse has gotten; you’re not planning on doing that sort of thing, are you?”
“I think a person can be perverted, but there should be a limit to how perverted. If you really intend to do that, I will despise you.”
“Unless you bring me one.”
“I’m planning to dissect her. I’ve always dissected dead people, but I’ve never dissected a female ghost.”
“Let’s see what’s the difference between a female ghost and a dead person.”
“But… but the content of Ruin No. 2 says that the female ghosts in this school can’t harm us.”
“Hm, but it doesn’t say we can’t harm them.”
“”

chapters.title: Chapter 192: 190: "Why did you want me to create the Heaven's Will Gang?
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 190: “Why did you want me to create the Heaven’s Will Gang?
“Let me see what this is, huh, even as a ghost it has the same bodily organs as a human.”
“Strange… this body’s been dead for so long, yet its organs are still active.”
“Even after all the organs were removed, it somehow still maintains consciousness.”
“…”
Sword Without End stood at the classroom entrance, his expressionless face gazing intently at Tuberculosis Rabbit who was eagerly dissecting the female ghost with a scalpel, falling silent without speaking.
Following Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit through the map felt completely different from his previous experiences.
“Um… Yi, aren’t you going to do something about this?”
“Don’t you think Tuberculosis Rabbit is a bit too obsessed with dissection?”
Chen Yi leaned against the corridor wall, his eyelids lifted slightly as he spoke casually.
“Smoking is harmful to health, everybody understands that.”
“Everything should be done in moderation, this is also common sense.”
“There is a distinction between right and wrong actions, but not with people; striving to be a ‘right’ person is just too exhausting and too difficult.”
“This is pretty good, everyone should have some hobbies to keep life from being too empty.”
“Besides, I think this hobby is quite nice; it doesn’t harm the body or affect society, and it can play a decisive role at critical moments.”
“Oh…”
Sword Without End nodded a bit helplessly.
After a moment.
A still excited Tuberculosis Rabbit, throwing the blood-soaked gloves aside on the ground, slowly walked out of the classroom: “Alright, let’s continue. The body structure of that female ghost was quite interesting, it felt a bit like a zombie.”
“We’ve encountered ghosts with corporeal bodies, I wonder what those without corporeal bodies are like.”
…
The journey that followed became monotonous and tedious.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, full of enthusiasm, led the way, searching the school for ghosts hidden in corners, while Chen Yi quietly followed her with his walking stick. As for Sword Without End… from the initial panic and unease, he now felt nothing at all.
Fear spreads.
In a group, if everyone else is extremely frightened, even someone with a big heart can’t help but become scared too.
But if the people around are all very brave, even someone who is easily frightened can become stronger.
At that moment, Sword Without End glanced at his personal panel, seeing his psychological fluctuation peak was only at 5%, far below the required 30%; it wasn’t that he was insensitive, it was just difficult to be frightened.
With such two people leading the way… it was really hard to be afraid.
“Hey.”
After Tuberculosis Rabbit pushed a ghost hiding in the bathroom headfirst into the toilet, the map was declared to be completely explored.
Ruins No. 2, successfully cleared.
It was only now that the real difficulty of this B-level map became apparent; first, the information that straying from the main path would trigger special events wasn’t openly available, it was Jiaye who told them.
Without knowing this information, one would certainly stumble into these special events accidentally.
Furthermore, the challenge of each ruin was not low at all, testing the overall capability.
For example, the Replica melee combat in Ruins No. 4.
A replica slightly stronger than oneself, if one’s psychological strength was a bit weaker, it would be normal to die in that ruin.
And then there’s Ruins No. 3, where you had to slay your Heart Demon.
Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit had no Heart Demons at all, Sword Without End had gained experience from slaying his Heart Demon; if it were someone else with unresolved issues, they would probably be stuck at this obstacle for a long time.
Not to mention anything else, forcing that Old K, who remotely controlled his own wife, into these ruins, with such a degree of Heart Demon possession, it would be hard for him to come out in less than a decade or eight years.
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yi stepped out of the campus, boarded a snow sled, glanced at the map, and shot off in a certain direction, “Time to head to Ruin Number One, with four more ruins to go, seven in total will be cleared.”
“Let’s see how difficult the other ruins are.”
…
Inside Black Trench City.
Little Qiu sat in front of the dressing table in her room, looking somewhat dazed at the somewhat unfamiliar reflection in the mirror, her thoughts inevitably drifting.
Do I really lack charm… that much?
That man saved me, didn’t leave a word, and just like that, left.
Tuberculosis Rabbit.
That was the name the man left for her.
Only after doing some research afterward did she realize the weight of the name Tuberculosis Rabbit, which had appeared on the global notices multiple times, and the young man who accompanied Tuberculosis Rabbit.
It was none other than Chen Yi, the captain at the top of the Global Vehicle Leaderboard and the Global Squad Leaderboard, who dealt millions of damage with a single shot and killed the world boss instantly!
She had never imagined she would have a chance to get involved with such people, let alone that she was almost in a position to spend a spring night with such a man.
Just then—
Suddenly, there was a knock on the door outside.
Little Qiu’s expression instantly turned cold.
“Come in.”
“It’s me, Little Qiu.”
A middle-aged man pushed the door open and sat down on a chair inside the room, looking at Little Qiu in front of the mirror with some pity as he spoke, “The Tiger Fang Gang has come. They’re ready to discuss with you, the leader of Heaven’s Will Gang, about some industrial distribution issues in District 13.”
“Father…”
Seeing that it was her father, Little Qiu’s expression softened, and she looked at him with some grievance, “I never wanted to be the leader of the Heaven’s Will Gang. Didn’t you always say that these gangs were nothing but beasts?”
“Why did you have me create the Heaven’s Will Gang?”
After Tuberculosis Rabbit left.
Her father suggested she also start a gang and subtly let out the rumor that Little Qiu, leader of the Heaven’s Will Gang, was the girlfriend of Chen Yi’s brother, Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Taking advantage of the rumor and the scene that many had witnessed that day.
She quickly pulled together a nascent gang.
Many players came forward to join.
But to avoid spreading the rumors too widely and making it difficult to justify, it was kept within a small circle and they didn’t recruit too many people.
Even so, it was enough.
The girlfriend of Chen Yi’s brother Tuberculosis Rabbit—that status alone was enough to get a lot done, as Chen Yi was now widely recognized as the world’s top player.
Hearing his daughter’s questioning, the middle-aged man was silent for a while before he said with a bitter smile.
“I know this affects your reputation, but… there was no choice. Today Tuberculosis Rabbit could save you once, but what about next time? Can Tuberculosis Rabbit save you again?”
“You know the state of the world now.”
“During peaceful times, your looks could have been an advantage in many ways, but in these turbulent times, being too attractive is like an unguarded treasure, something everyone wants to plunder.”
“The ones who threatened you this time are dead, but what about next time?”
“We can’t always expect others to come to our rescue. We must seize this rare opportunity. The Heaven’s Will Gang is here to ensure your safety.”

chapters.title: Chapter 193: 191: "You went to college, you're educated.
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 191: “You went to college, you’re educated.
“I’m not capable of much, and the best I can do is to use the little tricks I’ve learned from years of struggling in society to help you make the most of your resources. It might not be honorable, but… at least it could help you live a little longer.”
Little Qiu didn’t speak again but instead turned to look at the somewhat unfamiliar reflection of himself in the mirror, and with a touch of sadness, lowered his head and whispered quietly.
“I know what to do; father, please leave first.”
After his father left, Little Qiu remained silent for a while before he finally took a dagger from the desk drawer and stuffed it into his sleeve.
His expression slowly grew colder.
Gone was a hint of vulnerability that invoked pity, replaced by a faint and almost imperceptible murderous aura.
Of course.
It didn’t quite seem like him.
After all, it was only his first day as the boss, and he was still feeling a bit uncomfortable.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi had already arrived at the No. 1 ruins.
‘No. 1 Ruins, Amusement Park.’
‘This is an amusement park where you can enjoy life, feeling long-lost passion in excitement and speed.’
‘But you must not scream, as this will alarm the gods and demons within the park.’
‘Remember this well.’
‘Clearance conditions: Ride the roller coaster, Pirate Ship, pendulum, and drop tower, and you must remain silent throughout the experience of these attractions.’
The area of these ruins was a bit larger than that of the previous school ruins.
They now stood at the entrance of the amusement park, sizing up the amusement park in front of them.
There were only four attractions in the amusement park.
Roller coaster, Pirate Ship, pendulum, and drop tower.
Once they clearly understood the clearance conditions of No. 1 ruins,
Sword Without End was the first to laugh, “Can this even count as a challenge?”
“It seems that even a B-level map isn’t much.”
“I ride on Traceless Green Peak every day, flying around; how could I be afraid of these?”
“Indeed.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit also sneered with some disdain: “It does sound a bit stress-free, not just for us but also for any ordinary person who comes here—they wouldn’t scream.”
“Normally in amusement parks, everyone screams on roller coasters to relieve stress.”
“But if there was a rule where making a noise meant death, even the most timid person wouldn’t make a sound, would they?”
“Not necessarily, I’ve seen many people who don’t scream when they’re on roller coasters at amusement parks. When you’re extremely scared, you can’t scream.”
“That’s true too.”
“Let’s go, let’s head in.”
After taking a good look at the amusement park before him, Chen Yi, leaning on his cane with one hand, stepped into the amusement park. Less than a hundred meters in, they arrived at the first attraction.
‘Roller Coaster!’
‘Ding, proximity to the player detected, please have players take their seats. The attraction will start in one minute and will last for 2 minutes, please prepare yourself mentally.’
‘This attraction will only be activated once; if missed, there will be no second chance to ride.’
‘During the attraction experience, all props, titles, and skills may not be used.’
The group didn’t waste any words and immediately found empty seats to sit down.
Sword Without End took a seat in the very front car of the roller coaster, and after groping around for a while, he suddenly fell silent, turned around, and looked back at Tuberculosis Rabbit: “Um… Does your car seat have a seatbelt? It seems like there are no safety measures in this car.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was also, at that moment, slowly opening his mouth in surprise and looking bemusedly at the empty seat.
Normally, a roller coaster has two safety measures.
One is a steel bar dropping down from overhead to securely fix a person in their seat, and the other is a seatbelt that provides double protection.
However, the roller coaster they were on had no safety measures—the only thing that might be considered a safety feature was a steel pipe in front of the seats.
Passengers could hold onto it with both hands.
As long as they held tight enough, it was safe enough.
Tuberculosis Rabbit swallowed nervously, looking along the roller coaster track toward the several 360-degree loops nearby, and murmured, “That Sword Without End, I’m not very educated.”
“You’ve been to university, you’re educated.”
“Tell me, at what speed would we have to be on the roller coaster so that we can still hold onto the steel pipe with the centrifugal force at play?”
With the roller coaster set to launch in less than 30 seconds, Sword Without End, with a hint of urgency on his face, jumped off the coaster, squatted on the ground, and vigorously rubbed his hands on the dirt.
“Quick, rub some dirt on them so you won’t slip because of sweaty palms,” he said.
“Right, and if we end up in hell later, there’s a city called ‘Jiumen City’, we’ll meet up there.”
“Quit talking about unlucky stuff.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit took a deep breath, jumped off the roller coaster as well, rubbed some dirt on his hands, and then climbed back on, grasping the steel pipe in front of him tightly.
This was to be his only safety measure.
In the upcoming 360-degree loops of the roller coaster, the steel pipe in front of him was the only assurance that he wouldn’t be flung out of his seat.
Damn.
This roller coaster could probably be considered the most thrilling in the world.
“Don’t use your hands.”
Chen Yi, sitting next to Tuberculosis Rabbit, wedged the steel pipe in the crook of his elbow and used his right hand to hold that arm tightly against his chest, making a motion similar to a cross-armed kill.
“Hands definitely won’t hold; wedge yourself in with the steel pipe using your elbows; it’s a bit more reliable that way.”
“Got it, got it.”
Seeing this, Tuberculosis Rabbit hurriedly copied the motion, wedging the steel pipe into his own elbow crooks for slightly more of a sense of security.
Sword Without End, too, for the first time, mimicked the action seriously.
At that moment—
“Beep!”
The piercing sound of a whistle signaled their roller coaster was starting to move, the speed was not fast, as it was still climbing upwards.
Slowly ascending along the track in front of them to a hundred meters high in the air, it was only after reaching this point that the roller coaster would start its thrilling sprint.
The experience was beginning.
Each person shut their mouths, not uttering a word.
The rule of the map was that during the experience, everyone had to keep their mouths shut and not make a sound.
The roller coaster began its slow climb, this process not causing too much physical discomfort, but for some reason, there was a sense of dread, akin to the anticipation before an execution.
Soon.
The roller coaster reached the top of the track and paused for a moment.
“Whoosh!”
It accelerated fiercely!
The earsplitting sound of the blast and the rush of wind against the face!
The coaster was now diving toward the ground at nearly a 90-degree angle.
Sword Without End turned pale and looked back at his body, which was already floating in mid-air, and for the first time realized how terrifying a roller coaster could be.
Even so, he kept his teeth clenched tightly, refusing to make a sound.
The diving roller coaster reached the first 360-degree loop.
“Whoosh!”
The roller coaster whizzed past the loop at breakneck speed.
The intense sensation of weightlessness made Sword Without End feel a tightness in his chest; he clearly felt that for a moment, he had been flung off the coaster, suspended in mid-air.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: 192: "Let's go, jump off a building.
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 192: “Let’s go, jump off a building.
But before he could think further…
The second 360-degree loop came.
Yet, as the roller coaster reached the top of the huge loop… it suddenly came to a slow halt, stopping at the highest point.
“…”
Sword Without End expressionlessly tightened his grip on the steel pipe with his elbow, feeling his body suspended in midair, and looking down at the entire amusement park in silence without speaking.
Pretty good.
It was his first time experiencing this kind of roller coaster, and it wasn’t bad.
Fortunately, he had already adapted to the sensation of weightlessness. If it were just that, it wouldn’t be too difficult.
The corners of Tuberculosis Rabbit’s mouth twitched slightly as his mouth opened and closed, wanting to say something biting but then swallowing the words back.
They weren’t suspended for too long.
It was only about five or six seconds.
The roller coaster then began to move again, gradually speeding up, and the group fell back into the carriage. Although it hurt a bit, luckily none were thrown out.
Just then—
Chen Yi’s eyes suddenly narrowed. From both sides of the steel pipe he was holding, small nozzles appeared, similar to those of a teeth cleaner. But before he could react, these nozzles started to spray some kind of liquid onto the steel pipe.
Upon feeling the liquid…
He slightly furrowed his brow, squeezed the steel pipe tighter with his arm, and held onto his right arm that was gripping the pipe even more firmly.
That liquid… was lubricant.
Sword Without End, realizing what the liquid was as well, went pale instantly, cursing internally.
‘What the hell is this crap!!!’
This steel pipe was their only safety measure, yet even so, they added difficulty to it. With the lubricant applied, the pipe in their elbows became as slippery as a slick rod, sliding back and forth continuously.
The one thing to be thankful for was that they were holding onto the steel pipe with their elbows, not their hands. Otherwise, they would have been flung off long ago due to the lubricant.
The roller coaster underneath them continued to pick up speed.
The group got to experience what a real roller coaster felt like, their bodies barely staying in the seats, practically airborne the whole time, akin to the delightful sensation of flying freely.
…
The thrilling 2-minute journey soon ended.
Sword Without End climbed off the seat with somewhat shaky legs, plopping down at the finish, looking at the chafed marks inside his elbows, and exclaimed with a feeling of surviving a calamity,
“Can’t believe I made it down alive.”
“That was exhilarating.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at the abrasions on the inside of his own elbows and, similarly full of emotion, clicked his tongue and said, “Several times, I felt like I was about to be thrown off. If Yi hadn’t been holding onto me, I might have actually been flung away.”
“Right.”
At this, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned his head in confusion towards Chen Yi, “Yi, how were you able to free your hands to grab me in that situation?”
“Stay more composed inside, and you won’t be thrown off so easily. Don’t fight the inertia; just go with it and hold on tight. It’s not that difficult,” Chen Yi said as he shook his head, not explaining too much.
In fact, it truly wasn’t difficult.
He was innately fearless. Without fear, riding an unprotected roller coaster was only a matter of whether he could hold on tight enough.
Even without a prop, holding onto something tightly wasn’t a very difficult task for him.
“Let’s rest a bit, then move on to the next one.”
…
There were four attractions within the No. 1 ruins.
They had already experienced one attraction, leaving three more to go.
The second attraction.
“Pirate Ship.”
Once again taking the lead, Sword Without End sat in the middle of the ship and, upon inspecting his surroundings, said with some surprise, “There are actually safety belts, Yi, this attraction has safety belts, that makes it quite a bit easier.”
Relieved, Sword Without End buckled himself in tightly with the safety belt and began waiting for the Pirate Ship to start.
Chen Yi and the others also found their seats and sat down.
With safety belts, the Pirate Ship attraction seemed to lose some of its pressure. They had just tested the strength of the safety belts and found them to be fairly reliable, unlikely to snap open easily.
The Pirate Ship was essentially a giant swing.
However, it was shaped like a pirate ship, with many seats that people could freely choose from. Then, it would start swinging back and forth, tilting up to nearly 80 degrees at its peak.
The repetitive sensation of weightlessness and its outwardly undemanding appearance made the Pirate Ship seem like an amusement park ride meant for kids. But in reality, it was an extremely thrilling attraction, known as the amusement park assassin.
Just after the group had taken their seats for a short while,
the Pirate Ship started.
It began rocking from side to side, slowly rising and then falling.
Just as Sword Without End was contently enjoying this relatively easy attraction, he suddenly heard a notification.
“Ding, a Pirate Ship has initiated a cannon fire attack on you, please evade the enemy’s cannon fire to the best of your ability.”
In the airspace next to them, a translucent Pirate Ship appeared out of nowhere, floating in midair, with its cannons uniformly aiming at them.
Underneath the seats of Chen Yi and others, a red circle that kept flashing appeared.
This red circle indicated the precise landing point of the cannonballs.
This meant they had to unbuckle their safety belts immediately and move to safety, but they were still on the swinging Pirate Ship. Where could they escape to?
Chen Yi’s expression grew slightly serious as he quickly undid his safety belt, and taking advantage of the moment when the downward motion lessened the sensation of weightlessness, he swiftly left his seat and ran to an adjacent one, gripping the handle on the seat firmly.
Moving on the operating Pirate Ship.
This was a novel experience many people would never have in their lifetime.
And now, three people were enjoying this experience all at once.
Soon.
The Pirate Ship gradually came to a halt.
Sword Without End’s legs felt weak again as he leaned against the wall, murmuring weakly in his eyes, “Let’s rest for a while, rest for a while, I’m a bit overwhelmed.”
“After all these years, this is the first time I felt my heart pounding so intensely.”
“Don’t get me wrong, it’s not that I’m scared of this amusement park ride, it’s just that the safety measures are too rudimentary—in fact, there are none at all.”
“No big deal.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, already getting used to it, began to grow excited, “Haven’t you noticed that when we ride these rides without safety measures, we play with more focus and also find it much more thrilling?”
“Yes, focus, you’d see a ghost if you weren’t focused.”
“The sentence I just said had no inflectional particle, it’s completely literal.”
“If you’re not focused, you’d end up seeing a ghost. Now tell me, who isn’t focused?”
Chen Yi didn’t rush them and only after both had rested for a while did they head towards the next attraction.
“Let’s go, let’s jump off a building.”

chapters.title: Chapter 195: 193: "Brother, the times have changed.
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 193: “Brother, the times have changed.
“Ding, congratulations on successfully clearing Attraction No. 1…”
As an alert sounded in their ears, Sword Without End finally felt his body lightly touch down to the ground, somewhat disoriented as he stood at the entrance of the amusement park, turning to look back at attraction No. 1 behind him.
“Finally… cleared it.”
He had never seen such terrifying attractions before!
Especially the drop tower, not only did it make you experience an intense sensation of weightlessness, but it also had something like a feather mercilessly tickling your soles when you least expected it, trying to keep your mouth shut and not scream was no easy feat.
The big pendulum was even more excessive.
A completely enclosed single-person pod that started to rotate irregularly at 720 degrees at high speed as soon as he sat inside. At certain moments, he felt like his brains were being thoroughly shaken.
“Three ruins left.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the map with a lingering sense of dissatisfaction, “I have to say, a B-level map really has some difficulty. Normal people coming in would indeed find it tough to clear, but it seems like there are not too many numerical stages, and most are rule stages.”
Numerical stages require certain combat power to clear.
For example, a boss with 3 million HP, if you do not have sufficient attack power, no matter how hard you try, you can’t kill that boss.
There is no way to clear such levels by cunning or any other means.
You must have a certain level of combat power.
Rule stages, like Attraction No. 1, the amusement park, or Attraction No. 3, the cafe, as long as you can ensure you do not make a sound, or cut down your own Heart Demon, even without strong combat power, you can still clear it.
This was also why Jiaye and the others could clear this B-level map. For these rule stages, as long as you have certain corresponding abilities, even if your combat power isn’t very high, you can still clear it.
If this B-level map were a numerical map, Jiaye and his partner, even if they fought to death, wouldn’t be able to leave it alive.
Comparing numerical maps and rule maps, it’s hard to say which is inherently stronger.
For some players with extremely high combat power, numerical maps are very easy to clear, but it’s precisely some rule maps that hit their weak spots making it impossible for them to clear.
To these people, naturally, rule maps are stronger than numerical maps.
Whereas for those who don’t have high combat power but possess the abilities to pass certain rule maps, for them, numerical maps are stronger than rule maps.
There isn’t a clear-cut distinction on which is stronger between the two; it really depends on the player’s situation.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded slightly, not saying much more but sitting in the sled and shooting off toward the distance once again. Three ruins left, and it seemed success wasn’t as far off as it once appeared.
…
“Attraction No. 5, Wasteland Arena.”
“As you can see, this is an extremely bloody arena, situated at the throat of the Wasteland. If you wish to travel deeper into the Wasteland, you must defeat your opponent in the arena.”
“This map doesn’t restrict the players’ titles, props, skills, or any other equipment; you need to exert all your strength to kill the enemy before you.”
“Victory condition: Kill your enemy.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the entrance to Attraction No. 5’s arena, speaking with an odd expression, “This should be a combat stage, right? But… are the people on the arena really serious?”
Standing on the arena was a ferocious-looking brute, nearly two meters tall, whose muscles looked particularly intimidating.
But… he was unarmed.
In fact, he was barehanded.
After pondering for a moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit was the first to step onto the arena.
“Player Tuberculosis Rabbit has stepped onto the arena; please prepare both parties. The battle will officially begin in three seconds!”
“There is no scoring system; as soon as one side dies, the other may leave the arena.”
“Roar!”
The contest had barely started when the ferocious thug on the stage, waving his fists, roared and rushed towards Tuberculosis Rabbit!
“Bang.”
A somewhat piercing gunshot slowly echoed over the arena.
Tuberculosis Rabbit slowly withdrew his hands that were holding the Type 92 handgun horizontally, lightly blew on the smoke drifting from the barrel, and looked somewhat wistfully at the corpse sprawled on the ground, its body full of bulging muscles.
“Brother, times have changed, huh.”
“Bulging muscles aren’t effective anymore.”
‘Ding, congratulations on successfully clearing Ruins No. 5.’
After stepping down from the stage, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned to Chen Yi and the others, shrugged, and said, “There was no pressure at all, not even as much as the Ruins No. 4 movie theater gave.”
“To put it bluntly, if Tie Chui came to this ruin, he could probably smash the opponent into mincemeat alive.”
“It’s strange to see such ruins on a B-level map.”
Chen Yi didn’t talk much either and walked onto the stage.
A bullet shot into the ground, then burst out from the top of the thug’s head.
Dead on the spot.
Successfully cleared.
Sword Without End was the last to take the stage, a flash of green light passed by, and then he turned and walked off the stage, while the figure behind him had already dropped his head to the ground, dead beyond dead.
This level of ruins was, for them, simpler than bullying a kindergartner.
As for primary and secondary school, forget it.
Kids of that age are truly daring enough to stab with a knife.
“Let’s go.”
Having smoothly cleared Ruins No. 5, only Ruins No. 6 and No. 7 remained in the entire map.
Just as they were steering the sled away from Ruins No. 5, they saw some words behind the light curtain above the ruins.
‘Ruins No. 5 rules.’
‘1: The Arena Master’s strength will double every three seconds after 10 seconds from the start of the battle.’
‘2: The Arena Master’s wound healing speed will double every three seconds after 10 seconds from the start of the fight.’
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but click his tongue and said, “There’s actually such a rule? Who can see this rule written behind the light curtain?”
Ruins No. 5 is situated at the throat of the wasteland.
In the middle of a canyon.
And Ruins No. 6 and No. 7 are located behind Ruins No. 5.
To go to Ruins No. 6 and No. 7, one must first pass through Ruins No. 5, even flying isn’t an option, as there are invisible walls around.
And these two rules are marked behind the light curtain of Ruins No. 5.
That is to say, they could see this rule only after clearing Ruins No. 5.
But… they had already cleared it, so even seeing the rule at this point was pointless.
“I was wondering why the difficulty of this ruin felt suddenly reduced, turns out it was a nail left here, luckily we dealt with it quickly enough, otherwise after dragging it out for a few dozen seconds, this thing’s strength would’ve increased by more than tenfold, and then it really would have become difficult to handle.”
They didn’t stay here any longer.
Anyway, they had already cleared it and were too lazy to discuss it any further here.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: 194: "Have you forgotten what Jiaye said when he left?
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 194: “Have you forgotten what Jiaye said when he left?
But whether the next player to come to this map will be killed by a trap is hard to say.
The Arena Master’s strength isn’t too high; Tuberculosis Rabbit, with just a C-grade prop pistol, could kill it in one shot.
As long as you’re not too weak or deliberately provocative by delaying the kill, you basically won’t give the opponent a chance to start doubling their strength.
…
Soon, the 6th and 7th ruins were successively cleared by Chen Yi and his companions.
Now they were just one condition away from a perfect clear.
Trigger a special event!
As long as they successfully triggered a special event, they would receive a unique reward, starting from B-grade; the rewards were indeed very generous.
Chen Yi and his two companions stood on the official road, gazing at the wasteland beside it. After a brief pause, they resolutely stepped into the Wasteland!
Stepping off the official road and into the Wasteland would trigger a special event.
The next second—
A prompt sounded in their ears.
“Ding, special event triggered—Hundred Demons Peach Garden!”
As the words ended.
They found their vision shift, and by the time they realized what was happening, they were already in a peach garden.
Dark clouds above, mud underfoot.
All around were peach trees without fruit, without leaves, just barren trunks.
The only strange thing was.
Some peach trees were brown, others black, looking somewhat out of place.
“This is a deserted Hundred Demons Peach Garden, no ghosts come here to collect fruit anymore, but before they evacuated, they left behind some dangers.”
“Those dangers will arrive in an hour.”
“You need to solve the crisis and escape successfully before then.”
“Beneath each peach tree, there are some props hidden; you can use these to confront the impending dangers.”
“PS: This Peach Garden cannot be exited by force, nor can flying props or vehicles be used.”
“Clearance condition: Escape from the Peach Garden within one hour.”
“Looks a bit like Destiny’s Adversary,” Sword Without End observed as he circled the surroundings and didn’t find anything special, then looked towards the nearest peach tree, “Except that map was about getting props in the House of God and fighting the enemy after ten minutes.”
“This map is about getting props from under the peach trees and fighting the enemy after an hour.”
“We’re given even more time here, so it should not be too difficult.”
“What a pity.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head in regret: “The special event we triggered last time in Destiny’s Adversary was so nice, the Lin Yin Foot Bath Shop, no dangers just rest easy for an hour.”
“I thought this special event would allow us to trigger something good like that again.”
“So what do you think, Yi, should we start digging at the trees?”
“How about we split up and dig? To get rich, first cut down trees.”
“Hold on.”
Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly as he looked at the rules given for this special event.
This special event seemed similar to Destiny’s Adversary, but there was one significant difference, and that was the pass condition.
The condition to pass Destiny’s Adversary was either to survive 24 hours or to kill all the monsters.
However, the condition to pass this special event was to escape the map within one hour.
No further conditions for resolving a crisis or killing a crisis-related entity were added.
This meant that… even if they killed that unknown danger after an hour, they still could not leave the map because it did not meet the clear conditions.
The only condition to clear was to leave the map within the time limit.
As for any props buried under the peach tree specific to that map, they were useless, because once the crisis came, whether they resolved or killed the crisis, they could not leave the map.
Chen Yi, suddenly thinking of something, commanded Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End to rapidly dig out the nearest peach tree beside them.
And sure enough, there was a Prop Chest hidden in the tree pit.
“Ding, congratulations on discovering a Prop Chest.”
“Please recite the numbers 1-100 out loud, without missing any number, and without pausing for more than one second.”
“Successfully meeting this condition will allow you to open the chest and obtain an exclusive prop that can be used on this map.”
“This prop has an extremely powerful suppressive effect on the unknown danger.”
“This is the simplest Prop Chest unlocking condition I’ve ever seen.”
Sword Without End, somewhat eager, spoke up, “How about I try first?”
“Don’t bother.”
Chen Yi glanced at the Prop Chest in the tree pit without the slightest nostalgia, then walked away toward the distance, holding a piece of paper and a pen in his hand, casually speaking as he walked.
“Do you know what the biggest difference between men and women is?”
“Ah?”
Sword Without End, standing beside the tree hole and not understanding why Chen Yi abandoned the chest and left, glanced regretfully at the Prop Chest in the tree pit before quickly following behind Chen Yi, speaking with a tone of confusion.
“Yi, why are you suddenly asking this?”
“Most women, when they receive a confession from an extremely handsome and wealthy stranger, have many thoughts such as whether this man is the one, how quickly their own shining points have been discovered, or how there are indeed discerning people who can truly appreciate them.”
“Whereas most men, when they receive a confession from an extremely beautiful and wealthy woman, have only one thought in their minds.”
“What?”
Sword Without End asked blankly out of reflex.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing next to him, couldn’t help but grin and said, “Of course it’s ‘damn scammer, get lost.’ What normal man would believe that a beautiful wealthy stranger would confess her liking for them out of nowhere?”
“Seems right, haha.”
Sword Without End scratched the back of his head in a bit of disarray, following the steps of Chen Yi and the others, “But what does this have to do with that chest just now?”
“Of course, it does.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit patted Sword Without End’s shoulder with a bit of pity, “Only a woman would believe that good fortune could favor her, men never believe in pie falling from the sky.”
“A girl, from childhood to adulthood, if she is rather attractive, will receive lots of preferential treatment. These treatments can create a delusion that there are unearned gains in this world.”
“As for a boy growing up, any wealth he has comes from his own hard work. For men, something for nothing is the stupidest scam.”
“Just like you said just now, the condition to unlock that Prop Chest was extremely simple.”
“Doesn’t it feel like pie falling from the sky?”
“That’s clearly a trap!”
“Yi means to say you lack a man’s self-restraint, he’s scolding you, don’t be dumbfounded, you can’t even understand when you’re being insulted.”
“You’re hopeless.”
With a look of speechlessness, Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Sword Without End, then continued, “Have you forgotten what Jiaye said when he left?”

chapters.title: Chapter 197: 195: God says, it's the end of the world!
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 195: God says, it’s the end of the world!
“Don’t go opening the treasure chest when you see it; there’s a high chance it’s a negative event.”
“How long has it been, and you’ve already forgotten?”
“Ah?”
Sword Without End only then came to his senses, patting his chest with a sense of having narrowly escaped disaster, and looked forward with a bit of a sigh toward Chen Yi’s back, “Yi, are you suggesting that the chest just now was actually a trap?”
“Yes and no.”
As Chen Yi zigzagged through the depths of the Peach Garden, he sketched on a piece of white paper in his palm without turning back and said casually, “Jiaye mentioned not to open the chests recklessly when he left.”
“He was referring to the chests on the official road.”
“When we were flying in the sky, we did indeed see many treasure chests on the road below, and those chests are the ones Jiaye was talking about—they will likely trigger negative events upon opening.”
“But the chest we’re at now is in the map, and it’s not the same thing as what Jiaye was talking about.”
“Opening the Prop Chest inside that tree hollow will likely yield an exclusive prop for this map, which, if all goes well, is quite powerful and even the sort that would make others envious.”
“But… that’s the trap.”
At this point, Chen Yi slowly stopped and turned around to look back at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a light chuckle, “The conditions for passing clearly stated that you must escape from the Peach Garden within an hour.”
“It didn’t say that if a crisis comes after one hour and you solve it, you’ll pass.”
“The Prop Chests inside those tree hollows may indeed be effective in resolving crises, but by the time the crisis hits, even if we resolve all of them, we can’t leave the Peach Garden and will be trapped here forever.”
“That’s the trap.”
“There are no negative special events, and it’s not a lie, as long as you meet the conditions, you can open the chest, and everything appears normal.”
“It just wastes a few minutes of your time, and… makes you focus on the wrong approach, causing you to miss the real escape route.”
“Take a look.”
He casually handed over the white paper he had been sketching to Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“This…”
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the word on the paper, puzzled and frozen in place: “What does this mean?”
‘Death!’
The paper bore only this word.
Chen Yi leaned casually against a peach tree, hands in pockets, explaining, “There are two types of trees in the Peach Garden, one black and one brown, which is clearly observable.”
“And the distance between each peach tree is extremely standard.”
“It looks just like a chessboard.”
“I walked around the Peach Garden just now, and the black peach trees are not randomly distributed within it but follow a pattern; all the black peach trees form a word.”
“That word is ‘death’.”
“You can’t fly in this map, but if you could, looking down from the sky would make it evident.”
“Every map rule can be deduced.”
“For instance, the rule of this map forbids the use of Flight Props. At this time, one should think about why it’s forbidden and after considering this point, combine it with other information to come up with a speculative hypothesis in your mind.”
“Then, look for ways to confirm this hypothesis.”
“Make bold assumptions, and verify with caution.”
“So, the Prop Chest you saw just now wasn’t actually a trap, but it indeed serves the function of a trap.”
Sword Without End, with a vacant look in his eyes, focused on the white paper in his hands, then incredulously started digging up a peach tree beside him, beneath which there was another Prop Chest.
The opening condition was the same as the previous one.
Recite from 1 to 100.
“1, 2, 3…”
Sword Without End began to recite loudly with a grave expression.
“Ding, you have opened a Prop Chest and obtained a Prop.”
“Prop Name”: God said, let there be annihilation!
“Prop Level”: None.
“Prop Effect”: Once activated, anyone within your line of sight will die instantly, regardless of any defense, and this will last for 10 minutes.
“Prop Restriction”: Cannot be taken out of the Hundred Demons Peach Garden, and can only be used after a crisis occurs.
“Prop Introduction”: “Everyone knows that God created the world, but who knows that annihilation came before creation.”
“Wow.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the prop panel shared by Sword Without End, and couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth wildly: “Isn’t this prop a bit too strong? A Rule Kill Prop that disregards all defenses, as long as you are seen, you die.”
“This prop must be the strongest one we have seen so far.”
“If we could take this prop out of the map, that would truly make us invincible.”
“But if the enemy has this prop, there should still be ways to counter it, right?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, propping his chin with one hand, thoughtfully said, “For example, being fast enough to always dodge behind the enemy? You just need to avoid being seen, right?”
“Or what about invisibility? Invisibility props should make it ineffective, right?”
“Or using a giant mirror? The prop effect is that you will die instantly once seen, so if the enemy sees themselves in the mirror, wouldn’t they also die instantly?”
“Although there seem to be many methods to counter it, this prop still seems ridiculously powerful.”
“Yi, you really guessed it right.”
Sword Without End looked up at Chen Yi with a complex expression: “This prop is really powerful, but it can only be used after the crisis strikes in an hour.”
“Without your reminder, Yi, I… alone…”
He didn’t dare to continue that thought.
Isn’t that obvious?
What normal person could control themselves upon seeing such a powerful artefact right before their eyes?
He wasn’t sure about others, but he felt somewhat out of control.
Imagine digging up a bunch of props excitedly, waiting for the crisis to show off their might, only to suddenly realize that the condition for clearing the level seems to require escaping from the map before the crisis strikes.
All for naught.
“No problem.”
Chen Yi shook his head and didn’t say much but continued, “Based on my current guess, there seems to be only one way to leave the Peach Garden within an hour.”
“That is to move these black peach trees and form a new character.”
“The number of strokes for ‘death’ is 6.”
“The corresponding character should be ‘survive’ or ‘life’. The stroke count for ‘survive’ is 9, which probably isn’t enough for these black peach trees to form the character, but ‘life’ has 5 strokes, which is totally sufficient.”
“Follow my command and prepare to start digging.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 198: 196: "This is the best gift for the cowardly.
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 196: “This is the best gift for the cowardly.
The following process was much simpler.
All the black peach trees were dug up, and a portion of the brown peach trees were excavated as well, then arranged to form the character for “life”.
As Chen Yi had anticipated,
the special event came to a successful conclusion.
When their vision returned, they found themselves on the rooftop of a building in the Garden District.
A series of prompt sounds rang in the ears of Chen Yi and the others.
“Ding, congratulations to player Tuberculosis Rabbit for successfully passing the B-level map ‘Death Domain’. Here are your map evaluation and reward.”
“Map Evaluation: In most of the ruins, you were just average.”
“But inside Ruin No. 4, the movie theater, you displayed extreme resilience and madness. It’s hard to imagine that facing a hundred enemies each physically stronger than you, you ended up being the last one standing.”
“If this question were a math problem, then you have forcefully carved out a path to survival from an otherwise unsolvable equation.”
“In Ruin No. 2, the abandoned school, the peak fluctuation in your emotions was 2%, no fear could cause even the slightest ripple in your heart; instead, the fear you induced in those things was even greater.”
“You have received your own exclusive reward—a B-level Prop, Whisper of the Ancient God.”
“Heh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked forward to his newly obtained prop with some anticipation. This was a B-level one, and he hadn’t owned any B-level prop thus far.
“Prop Name”: Whisper of the Ancient God.
“Prop Level”: B-Level (Unique globally)
“Prop Effect”: While you possess this prop, your physical attributes will constantly be at a five-fold increase, and you can pray to the Ancient God; in exchange for a certain price, you will receive unprecedented strength.
“Prop Restriction”: You will be in a state of torment for long periods of time and may even suffer from mental breakdown or psychosis. The Ancient God imprisoned in the prop will continuously whisper its grievances and pain into your ear, every second of every day and night.”
“Prop Introduction”: Once you choose to wear this prop, it cannot be removed, unless in death. Even as you sleep, that grievance-filled voice will penetrate deep into your soul.”
“It seems pretty good.”
After pondering for a while, Tuberculosis Rabbit chose to wear the prop, not particularly concerned about its side effects. An Ancient God that would constantly babble in his ear?
It sounded kind of charming.
24-hour companionship, always online, and free of charge? What more could one ask for?
“Ding, congratulations to player Sword Without End for smoothly passing the B-level map ‘Death Domain’. Here are your map evaluation and reward.”
“Map Evaluation: You had no notable performance in any of the ruins.”
“Yet you successfully passed through seven ruins, completing a hidden achievement. In the face of most dangers, your reaction was often to retreat behind your teammates.”
“It’s clear that you greatly trust your teammates and are very cautious.”
“You have received your own exclusive reward—a B-level Prop, ‘Let me take a step back and see what’s happening’.”
“Prop Name”: “Let me take a step back and see what’s happening.”
“Prop Level”: B-Level (Unique)
“Prop Effect”: When you step back, you will enter a state of invisibility, undetectable by any prop, skill, or title, but this effect only applies when moving backward. Moving forward or standing still will negate it.”
“Prop Restriction”: When you move directly toward a boss or monster, you will be automatically designated as the primary attack target.”
“Prop Introduction”: “This is the best gift for the cowardly.”
“…”
Sword Without End stood still without expression, his mouth twitching slightly in annoyance.
What’s called the best gift for the cowardly?
Is he cowardly?
He’s not cowardly at all, alright?
He only hid behind Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit in a few ruins, okay?
That abandoned school ruin, he was scared, so what?
Does that make him a coward?
Ridiculous!
However, although that’s what he says, this effect seems pretty good, enabling forced invisibility, unable to be detected by any skill, but it seems to only take effect when retreating.
Combined with that prop of his, maybe a lot of strategies could be developed.
‘Prop Name’: Drop Dead on the Spot.
‘Prop Level’: C-level.
‘Prop Effect’: When you activate this prop, a corpse that looks exactly like you will quickly appear at your feet, the specific manner of death can be freely decided by the player, and the corpse will exist for 10 minutes.
‘Prop Limitation’: After use, it will enter a 10-minute cooldown period.
‘Prop Introduction’: “People can hold weddings for themselves, but cannot hold funerals for themselves, which is a great regret for many. With this prop, you can hold a funeral for yourself while still alive, to make up for that regret.”
These two props combined.
Sword Without End’s thoughts drifted off, images surfacing in his mind, he couldn’t help but rub his hands together in anticipation, not even knowing what images were coming to mind.
‘Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully passing the B-level map ‘Death Domain’, below is your map assessment and reward.’
‘Map Assessment: You possess a keen investigative ability, and in the ruins of Cinema No. 4, successfully found the Replica’s weakness, which is the lack of a player’s mental experience and fear of death.’
‘The key to deciding a battle’s outcome is not just physical fitness, but is determined by a variety of dimensions, and you chose the most normal way to pass.’
‘Like your other two teammates’ ways of passing, they were a bit baffling for the map designer as well.’
‘In the ruins of Amusement Park No. 1, you found the trick to ensure passing, thus not being thrown off the roller coaster.’
‘In the ruins of Abandoned School No. 2, your psychological fluctuation peak was 0% throughout the entire time, no matter how frightening the environment, nothing could cause a ripple in your heart, you were like a gentleman in the apocalypse, maintaining elegance in the face of death.’
‘Even if tomorrow I am broken limb from limb, today my collar must remain straight.’
‘In the ruins of No. 6, you found the thief amidst a thousand wax figures by following the merest of clues.’
‘In the special event ‘Hundred Demons Peach Garden’, you successfully avoided traps and found the correct path to pass in a short time.’
‘Only in the ruins of Cinema No. 4 did you show extreme resilience and madness, it’s hard to imagine, facing a hundred enemies all physically stronger than you, and yet you were the last one standing.’
‘You’ve obtained your own exclusive reward — B-level costume, Bleeding Rose.’
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow lightly, a hint of confusion flashing in his eyes, his exclusive reward turned out to be a costume?
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End both got unique prop rewards.
So why was his reward a B-level costume?
It sounded a bit underwhelming.
…
ps: There are two more chapters to come.

chapters.title: Chapter 199: 197: "One cannot possess youth and the feelings for youth at the same time.
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 197: “One cannot possess youth and the feelings for youth at the same time.
“Fashion Name”: Bleeding Rose.
“Fashion Level”: B-grade (Unique)
“Fashion Effect”: This is a globally unique fashion item, a bunch of white roses soaked through with blood, turning crimson all over. When you wear it, all other fashion items on you will be forcibly elevated to B-grade.
Other fashion items forcibly elevated to B-grade will only come into effect when the Bleeding Rose is worn.
Additionally, by wearing a suit and placing this prop in the left breast pocket,
a hidden effect will be activated.
Any illusions, phantasms, nightmares, or other mental side effects will be unable to affect you, and it will greatly strengthen the defensive power of your left chest, securing your heart in an extremely safe position.
“Fashion Restriction”: When you experience intense negative emotions such as extreme pain, extreme sadness, or extreme anger,
the prop will passively activate its full form. The Bleeding Rose will take root in your left chest, pierce through to your heart, and begin to spread rapidly, creating a second Bleeding Rose on your body, a third one… until it covers your entire body.
During this period, all your skill effects and prop effects will be tripled.
This process is irreversible until the Bleeding Rose has spread across the whole body, which signals death.
“Fashion Introduction”: “People cannot have youth and the perception of youth at the same time, they always romanticize those memories, slowly defining them as regrets.”
“This fashion component…”
Chen Yi, with one hand in his pocket, leaned on his cane, slightly furrowing his brow in thought.
It forcibly elevates all other fashion items to B-grade.
That effect is actually very powerful.
He had a prop called Men’s Tank Top, which could increase a player’s defensive power based on the level of fashion they wore.
If all his fashion items were B-grade, it could raise his defense to a very high level.
Especially when paired with a suit, he would have the ability to see through deception and illusions, and his left chest’s defense would be fortified again, ensuring a very good defense.
But there were side effects.
The side effect was that in extreme pain, he would die as his body burst into roses.
Yet, upon careful consideration, it seemed he had never experienced such extreme pain and sadness since birth.
Unless Tuberculosis Rabbit died.
Otherwise, it would be difficult for him to fall into a state of extreme pain.
But if Tuberculosis Rabbit were dead, it seemed his life wouldn’t have much meaning left.
No audience, no need for the actor to remain on stage.
Just as he pondered how to maximize the use of this fashion item, he suddenly felt a breeze in his face and, before he could react, someone embraced him.
“Yi!”
Chen Yi was about to activate a prop when he smelled the familiar fragrance of a young girl and felt the somewhat soft body in his arms, momentarily stiffening.
Jiaye’s voice, filled with tears and joy, sounded in his ears.
Jiaye had been waiting for him on the rooftop, knowing that Yi often liked to leave the map from there. The moment Chen Yi returned, she rushed up to him.
Chen Yi looked at Jiaye hugging him tightly, burying her head in his chest, his hands hanging awkwardly in the air, turning towards the two beside him for help.
“Sigh.”
With a serious face, Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed and, wrapping an arm around Sword Without End’s shoulder, started walking downstairs: “We’ve been delayed by the map this long, should we celebrate properly?”
“How about hotpot?”
Sword Without End suggested gravely.
“Hotpot? No, that won’t do, we just had it a few days ago and it was too greasy.”
“What do you want to eat then?”
“How about barbecue? I suddenly feel like having Zibo barbecue.”
“Sure, shall we get ready to fly to Zibo then?”
The two continued their casual conversation, walking further and further away, completely ignoring Chen Yi’s pleading gaze, and even forcibly dragged Tie Chui down from the entrance of the rooftop.
Now, only Chen Yi and Jiaye were left on the rooftop.
The atmosphere became somewhat ambiguous and awkward.
It was deep into the night in Blue Star.
The weather was exceptionally good tonight, and the sky was filled with stars, looking extraordinarily beautiful.
Before the arrival of the game “Rising,” society had been making continuous progress, to the point where the starry skies that were visible every night in childhood had gradually become something that existed only in textbooks and legends.
The starry sky hung overhead, twinkling continuously.
Meanwhile, on the other tall buildings around the one beneath their feet, there were hundreds of crimson lights twinkling non-stop.
Those were the numerous smokers who couldn’t sleep at night and climbed up to the rooftop to light up a cigarette, inwardly cursing the “July Rules.”
At this moment, these people were all secretly swallowing their saliva, looking towards Chen Yi and the young girl in his arms with eyes full of anticipation.
This was big news…!
And just then—
Jiaye also felt the atmosphere was a bit off, suddenly let go of Chen Yi, stepped back a few steps with her cheeks slightly flushed, and said in a voice as soft as a fly’s, “Yi, you’ve been in the map for too long, I thought something had happened to you, it’s so good that you’re back safe.”
“Uh…”
Chen Yi also couldn’t help feeling a bit awkward, touched his nose and paused for a while before he finally spoke, “Uh, how about we go downstairs for a meal first?”
“I haven’t eaten since I was in the map, and I’m getting a bit hungry.”
“Okay.”
Jiaye looked down with her cheeks a bit flushed and didn’t speak, but just as Chen Yi was about to step away, she suddenly looked up at Yi with her eyes closed, her voice a bit hurried.
“Yi, I like you.”
“You don’t have to rush to reject me, I know this might be abrupt, but I just wanted to make my feelings clear, and to ask if you could tell me your standards for choosing a partner, so I can work towards that.”
“I’m afraid… I’m afraid I won’t have the chance to say this later.”
Jiaye lowered her head with a bitter smile, revealing a seal on her arm, “I might only have three more days to live, I’m not afraid of death, but I’m afraid of dying without making my feelings for you clear.”
“Hm?”
Chen Yi stopped in his tracks, turned around, walked over to Jiaye, picked up her arm to look at the cross-shaped seal on it and frowned, “Where did you get this?”
When focusing on this seal, a semi-transparent screen would appear out of thin air,
‘God Race Cross-Border Pursuit Mark!’
‘You have killed the God Race’s Third Master, and because of this, the entire God Race is furious, deciding to mobilize everyone to Blue Star to launch a cross-border war in three days!’
‘There is only one target!’
‘Kill the murderer to avenge the Third Master!’
‘After the objective is achieved, they will immediately withdraw from Blue Star.’
“In the Death Domain, we strayed from the official path and came across a special event,”
Jiaye said in a low sorrowful voice, “In that special event, we killed a man in the map to clear the level, not knowing that man was a Third Master from some God Race.”
“After that, I got this mark.”
“The entire race pursuing me across bounds, I know I won’t live long, if it wasn’t for these three days, I probably wouldn’t have dared to say what I just did in my entire life.”

chapters.title: Chapter 200: 198: "The Grand Ghost Marriage of Yi and Jiaye!
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 198: “The Grand Ghost Marriage of Yi and Jiaye!
“…”
Chen Yi stared at the mark on Jiaye’s hand and remained silent for a while before he pulled Jiaye’s hand, found a stone bench on the rooftop, and sat down, “It’s not a mark of certain death, just a bounty.”
“I’ll block it for you.”
“Don’t.”
Jiaye shook her head, her eyes filled with resolute denial, “The God Race is crossing realms just to kill me. As long as I die, everyone else will be fine.”
“If I don’t die, others will be affected because of me.”
“I’d rather die unnoticed than become a sinner through the ages.”
Chen Yi couldn’t help but be amused, shaking his head lightly, “I never realized your awareness was so high before.”
“I…”
Jiaye stuttered a bit, paused for a while, then lowered her head and whispered, “I just don’t want Yi, oh right, and Tuberculosis Rabbit, to be affected because of me.”
“We can’t block a clan pursuit.”
“It should be fine.”
Chen Yi looked around at the old smokers on the rooftops of high-rises who were all ears, his eyes narrowed slightly as he scanned the area before continuing, “There’s always a way, besides, even if you died and went to hell, I’d bring you back.”
“Don’t be afraid, it’s a small matter.”
Seeing Chen Yi glance over, the smokers on the surrounding rooftops almost simultaneously snuffed out their cigarettes, extinguished the eagerness in their hearts, and scooted off the rooftop in a flash.
In the blink of an eye, the rooftops of the other buildings were empty.
Chen Yi’s influence was fully displayed in this moment.
“Pfft.”
Seeing this, Jiaye, who had been a bit sad, couldn’t help but laugh, then tilted her head, looking a bit nervous as she gazed at Chen Yi’s sharply defined profile and muttered, smitten.
“Yi, you haven’t told me what kind of girl you like yet?”
“Hmm…”
Chen Yi thought seriously for a moment before speaking, “This is a bit difficult to say, to be honest, I’ve never thought about this question.”
“First, she must have a good figure, a pretty face.”
“Although it sounds a bit tacky, I’m not exactly refined, and if I were to find a wife to grow old with, I’d still hope she could be a bit beautiful.”
“And then…”
As he was seriously pondering, Chen Yi’s voice suddenly stopped abruptly, and after a long while, he shook his head weakly, “I can’t think of anything else, I’m not very familiar with this sort of thing, I feel it’s still about the chemistry.”
“Do you think I’m pretty?”
Perhaps because she didn’t have many days left, Jiaye gathered the courage to ask.
Upon hearing this, Chen Yi fell silent for a while before turning to look at Jiaye, seeing her for the first time with true consideration.
Her figure was nice, with the delicate charm of a southern girl.
Her face was also very beautiful, long days of selling fish had not left any trace of weathering on her face; on the contrary, her skin was extremely smooth and fair.
She could be described as a very pretty girl.
To say she was pretty would be an understatement.
“Pretty.”
He gave an exceedingly honest and sincere answer.
“Then can you date me?”
“No.”
“Why?”
Jiaye’s eyes dimmed a little, her hands clutching the hem of her clothes tightened unconsciously, tears starting to well up in her eyes.
“I grew up an orphan, without a father or mother, in an orphanage. My childhood memories are nothing to be proud of, and even after I became an adult, I’ve been hunkering down in the morgue, living day by day. My life hasn’t had any outstanding moments.”
“I’m an orphan too. I grew up with my brother. We’re no different.”
“What I mean is, growing up in that environment has made my character a bit paranoid at times, which most people can’t accept. Only Tuberculosis Rabbit can accept it.”
“I can completely accept it. We’re on the same path.”
“I…”
Just as Chen Yi was about to say something more.
Jiaye suddenly interrupted Chen Yi with some annoyance, “I just want to ask you one question, do you have even the slightest flutter of the heart towards me?”
“There is a bit, but…”
Before Chen Yi could finish speaking, he suddenly felt something warm and moist forcefully touch his lips.
“…”
Chen Yi’s eyes widened suddenly as he looked down at the girl who had rushed into his arms and kissed him; his hands frozen in mid-air, completely at a loss of what to do.
He saw Jiaye with her eyes tightly closed, her lips a bit stiffly pressed against his, making no further move, seemingly having no idea about kissing beyond the mere action of lips touching lips.
The trembling of her eyelashes clearly indicated that Jiaye’s heart might not be as courageous as her actions suggested.
Chen Yi couldn’t help but swallow hard, observing the girl before him from such a close distance for the first time, even faintly hearing the rapid beating of his own heart. This… this was his first time being this close to a girl.
He felt as if his whole body had been electrified, continuously tingling.
Time seemed to have been paused at this very moment.
Even the twinkling stars in the sky shone brightly without blinking, as if they didn’t want to miss this scene.
…
“Tsk, tsk.”
Unbeknownst to him, Tuberculosis Rabbit had sneaked onto the rooftop of the building opposite Chen Yi, hiding behind a stone wall with a cigarette in his mouth, peering covertly over at Chen Yi kissing Jiaye and couldn’t help but sigh emotionally.
“It’s over, Yi has fallen.”
“Now we can only hope that Yi and Jiaye’s relationship progresses quickly.”
“How so?”
Sword Without End, his face full of excitement, hiding in the shadows, couldn’t help stomping his feet as he watched eagerly: “What does that have to do with anything?”
“Jiaye is going to die in three days; if their relationship progresses quickly, they might be able to have a wedding.”
“If it’s slow, they can only hold a ghost marriage.”
“The grand ghost marriage of Yi and Jiaye does sound somewhat interesting.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at the assassin’s mark on Tie Chui’s wrist with some emotion and spoke seriously, “Tie Chui, rest assured, when you die, I will definitely give you a funeral shrouded in utmost grandeur, to send you off in style!”
“Alright.”
Tie Chui nodded slightly, his mood evidently low, clearly a bit sad.
Although he wasn’t clever.
He knew that with the whole race crossing worlds to chase him, he definitely wouldn’t survive.
“Say something nice for once.”
Sword Without End glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit with dissatisfaction, “Don’t wish for death every day; it’s just an assassination order, not a certain death crisis. And until it’s upon us, we can’t really say for sure.”
“Besides, even if he dies, what of it? If need be, we could just drag him back from hell.”
“Hell?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit cast a strange glance at Sword Without End: “Do you think the God Race that can cross worlds to come to Blue Star can also cross into hell?”
“If we want Tie Chui and Jiaye to live, it all depends on whether Yi decides to save them.”
“If Yi decides to save them, the God Race couldn’t lay a finger on them even if they come.”
“Hm?”
Sword Without End furrowed his brows and pondered for a while before expressing hesitantly, “You mean if Yi decides to lend a hand, Tie Chui and Jiaye could survive? That’s the entire God Race in action.”
“Yi’s Annihilate Nine Clans Skill wouldn’t be useful, right? Annihilate Nine Clans can only eradicate one clan line, but with the entire race acting, who knows how many clan lines there are.”
“No.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head and took out a cigarette for Tie Chui, lit another one for himself, with the crimson light of the cigarette glowing in the dark. He grinned at Chen Yi on the rooftop opposite and said,
“What I mean is, if Yi decides to take action, then I will too.”
“Aren’t you curious about how I survived in Ruin No. 4?”
“Don’t underestimate me.”
“I’m quite strong, you know.”

chapters.title: Chapter 201: 199: Women are the Best Item for Men.
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 199: Women are the Best Item for Men.
“Ah?”
Sword Without End tilted his head to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit and was startled for a moment. For some reason, just now, he had felt an unprecedented sense of dominance from Tuberculosis Rabbit, a sensation… that really didn’t fit with Tuberculosis Rabbit’s usual goofy persona.
He was genuinely curious about how Tuberculosis Rabbit managed to fight his way out of Ruin No. 4.
Despite being severely injured.
Put anyone else in that situation, not to mention severe injuries, they wouldn’t even be able to make it out alive.
One against a hundred.
And each one stronger than you.
What’s there to fight for, betting on a small cosmic burst?
Even if you bet on a little cosmic burst, that’s not the way to do it.
“So how did you make it out?”
Sword Without End couldn’t help but ask.
“Shh!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit put a finger to his lips and shushed softly, looking towards Chen Yi on the opposite high-rise roof with eyes full of anticipation and some urgency. “Put your arms down and wrap them around her, how can you be so clueless about affection?”
Under the night sky opposite, Jiaye had already burrowed tightly into Chen Yi’s embrace, burying her head into his chest, her eyelashes trembling slightly, not daring to look up.
Chen Yi’s arms were slightly stiff in the air, making him seem a bit awkward.
“Sigh.”
Chen Yi let out a silent sigh, and after a brief silence, he slowly lowered his arms and hugged Jiaye close, gently patting her back without saying a word.
Just standing together under the starry sky.
He could stand in obscure places to admire the moonlight, but even with the moonlight in his arms, his indifference seemed to indicate a lack of romantic flair.
Just let things take their course.
After a while.
He spoke up to remind her, “I must remind you, you’ve broken the July rule.”
“How many times did you just break it?”
“Twice,” Jiaye said softly, her face reddening as her heart pounded with her head buried in Chen Yi’s chest.
“That’s not too bad, you still have one mistake allowance left.”
“Be careful not to break the rules and bite the dust before the God Race even descends.”
“Sword Without End only has one mistake allowance left too, right?”
“You two are different. He smokes, you express love.”
“Then I will probably break the rule three times before Sword Without End does.”
“Why’s that?”
“Because…” Jiaye lifted her head, gazing at Chen Yi with determination in her soft voice. “Smoking can be restrained, love cannot be suppressed.”
“…”
Chen Yi looked down expressionlessly at Jiaye in his arms, remaining silent for a long time before finally speaking softly. “Did that sentence just break the rules?”
“No.”
“Then don’t say it again, can you be normal for once? You sound like a lovesick fool.”
“At the brink of death, you tend to be bolder with what you say and do.”
“That’s good.”
Without saying more, Chen Yi released Jiaye from his embrace and, leaning on his cane, started walking toward the edge of the roof. “Let’s go get something to eat; we’ve been in the Death Domain Map for too long. I’m getting hungry.”
“As for you, you’re not going to die.”
“Okay.”
Jiaye’s eyes curved into crescents as she quickly trotted a few steps and latched onto Chen Yi’s arm, following him downstairs.
…
“Quick, quick, quick!!”
Watching from the shadows on the opposite high-rise roof, Tuberculosis Rabbit and his companions scrambled downstairs. “Hurry and wait for Yi downstairs, we absolutely can’t let him find out we were spying on them.”
“If we’re discovered, just say it was Tie Chui who dragged us up here.”
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit, panting, finally made it to the ground floor and stood outside the residential unit’s entrance of Chen Yi’s building, hands on knees and looking up to say something as Yi emerged from the doorway, his body suddenly froze, his eyes flickering with bewilderment.
There he saw Yi in a black, simple, yet casual suit, standing tall and straight as a pine, leaning on a black lustrous cane, with a blood-tinged rose pinned to his left chest.
The whole person seemed exceptionally… high-class?
This word suddenly popped up in his mind.
The suit’s inner lining was a floral shirt with a few buttons undone, appearing both gentlemanly and rough, and rather than looking incongruous, it added a hint of roguish charm to Yi.
By his side, Jiaye was in a white luminescent evening gown, barefooted and towering over the waves at his side, clutching Yi’s left arm.
The two golden ear threads, and the fine diamond bracelet on her slender jade-like arms, also matched perfectly, making Jiaye seem a little less girlish but a bit more mature.
A woman is a man’s best accessory.
He couldn’t remember where he had heard that phrase.
But now he suddenly understood it; with Jiaye by his side, he felt that Yi looked even more handsome and had more presence.
Having changed outfits at some point, they looked as though they were off to attend a grand soirée, and ‘high-end’ was the only word he felt could describe them—not for lack of desire to use something else, but simply because his vocabulary was a bit lacking.
“…”
Silently, Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End exchanged a glance before turning sharply and darting into the shadows of the neighboring building. When they reemerged,
Everyone changed into different outfits.
“Yi.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing straight, walked up to Chen Yi in a black tuxedo, gave a slight bow, and then spoke softly, “We’re prepared to go to Zhong Bo City for barbecue. I’ve heard that the barbecue in Zhong Bo City is delicious, famous far and wide.”
“What do you think, Yi? Shall we go there, or would you prefer to eat something else?”
“…”
Chen Yi looked Tuberculosis Rabbit up and down with a strange expression. “Are you cosplaying as a butler?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s body stiffened once more, and as he lifted his head to look Chen Yi in the eye, he said deliberately, “Yi, don’t I look like a gentleman about to attend an evening party?”
“Uh… yes, you do.”
Chen Yi gave a definite answer, “So where is Sword Without End? We should get going. We have other things to do after dinner.”
“Here.”
Sword Without End, in a pink suit, was rolling up his sleeves while stepping out of the shadows. Looking up at everyone, he smiled and said, “Sorry to keep everyone waiting.”
“What’s this now?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked over at Sword Without End emerging from the shadows, his mouth twitching slightly.
It was the first time he had seen Sword Without End in a suit.
Usually, Sword Without End would be in a green robe or a Tang suit, always going for that ancient-style look, portraying a Sword Immortal.
But this time was an exception.
Without any shirt underneath, the suit was buttoned only at the top two buttons, leaving his chest bare for all to see, even with a glimpse of his curled chest hair.
It must be said, Sword Without End did have something going for him, with a decent amount of muscle on his frame that didn’t look too dried up, but rather taut.
His right wrist was complemented by a watch, plus hair and a beard that had been purposefully groomed.
He surprisingly projected the forced, rugged beauty of a middle-aged man.
But that wasn’t all.
Even Tie Chui had changed into a new set of clothes at some point, also a suit, but a very large one.
Tie Chui was nearly two meters tall, and his muscles large and firm, making the whole suit look puffed up as if it was about to burst at any second.
He stood beside the others, holding a massive blade on his shoulder, smiling goofily at them.
The blade was consistently wide from hilt to tip, about 50 cm wide.
The length of the blade was around 1.8 meters.
To call it a massive blade would be somewhat of an understatement; it would be more fitting to call it a giant ruler.
The so-called blade was blunt, at least 10 cm thick, so thick that not even deities could probably sharpen it easily.
With such a weapon, killing someone by hacking them might take some effort, but crushing someone to death?
That would probably just take a blink of an eye.
Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a long sigh before looking at Tie Chui with a complex expression, “Everyone says you’re silly, but I don’t think you’re silly at all. You even know how to change clothes and strike a pose. Where did you get that blade? I haven’t seen you use it before.”
“Hehe.”
Tie Chui chuckled and while bearing the blade on his shoulder, declared in his deep voice, “Death Domain… Map Reward… Grade C Prop.”
“Nice.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced over the other four once more, then looked down at his own oddly matched outfit, feeling perhaps he had the worst fashion sense among them; the tuxedo looked indeed strange and didn’t suit his style.
Without further thought.
He ran into the shadows to change back into his usual floral shirt and board shorts, then came out wearing flip-flops, hands in pockets and a cigarette dangling from his mouth, “Much better now.”
The tuxedo was a bit restrictive.
The shorts were not.
Being too big was also a hassle.
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yi didn’t say anything more, but began walking toward the exit of the residential area with a cane, with Jiaye following close by, arm in arm.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End followed immediately on either side behind them.
Tie Chui, shouldering the massive blade, walked at the back, towering like a mountain, overseeing the surroundings.
They quickly left the residential area, found an open space, sat on a sled, and headed towards Zhong Bo City.
For them.
Cross-city to eat barbecue isn’t any more time-consuming than going downstairs to eat barbecue at home.
After all, the sled’s speed had already reached four digits.
