Although it wasn’t the fastest vehicle created by humans before the arrival of the ascended game, after the game’s arrival, it had become the fastest vehicle in the world.
…
Before long.
They reached Zhong Bo City and found a barbecue stand that was still open.
Surprisingly.
The city seemed extraordinarily vibrant, with young people bustling about on the streets, most of them either on missions or on their way to hunt outside the city.
Seemingly noticing the puzzlement in Chen Yi and his companions, the owner who came over to skewer the meat explained with a smile full on his face, “Before the arrival of the latter days, a lot of college students came to Zhong Bo City for barbecue.”
“After the latter days came and the rules took effect, the city was strictly controlled, and these college students couldn’t leave.”
“Later on, when all vehicles became obsolete, even if they wanted to, they couldn’t leave, so they all stayed.”
“I must say, these college students are quite capable, once even causing the Minotaurs outside the city to run out of spawns.”
At this, the owner couldn’t help but add sentimentally, “Luckily we have these college students, otherwise Zhong Bo City wouldn’t be as lively as it is now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 202: 200: The World's First Guild Creation Order!
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 200: The World’s First Guild Creation Order!
Afterward, Chen Yi and his companions refrained from discussing any somber topics, as if they were ignoring the impending invasion of the God Race three days later.
Instead, they sat by the barbecue stall, immersed in the festive smoky atmosphere.
They skewered their servings, folded their pancakes to dip in the sauce, added a bit of green onion, rolled them up, and gobbled them down in a few bites.
They were thoroughly satisfied.
Then they had a bucket of ice-cold freshly brewed beer.
It was particularly pleasant.
Although the weather was a bit hot, and even the deep night didn’t offer much coolness, the temperature quickly dropped after Tuberculosis Rabbit took out a high-powered outdoor air conditioner from his bag and activated it.
The group raised their glasses and drank freely.
They had the wine of the immortal poet Li Bai, but couldn’t compose the poetry of Li Bai.
Until the patience of a table nearby ran thin, and a man was sent over. He first glanced up at the dense array of titles above Chen Yi’s head, then hesitated before asking, “Uh, big brothers, do you think you could move that external AC unit… so it’s not blowing directly in our faces?”
Where there’s an air conditioning unit, there must be an external component.
Tuberculosis Rabbit aimed the cooling unit at themselves but carelessly placed the external unit beside them, directly facing a table of people eating barbecue.
“The weather’s terribly hot, and your external AC unit is like adding heat to heat.”
“Why are you making such a fuss?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, whose mood was disrupted, frowned, ready to say something in dissatisfaction but was cut off.
“Alright.”
With a somewhat resigned motion, Chen Yi waved his hand: “Move the external unit somewhere else. It’s too much to blow it in people’s faces; we should be more considerate.”
“Oh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit grumbled displeased and then stood up to relocate the external unit to an unoccupied area, before sitting back down and resuming the spirited drinking with Yi and the others.
This meal was exceptionally hearty.
No one came to disturb them.
And there were no myopic souls who insisted on provoking them.
Of course, the dense collection of titles above Chen Yi’s head was simply too conspicuous; any sensible person seeing those would know to give them a wide berth.
It’s often said that a wise man does not stand beneath a shaky wall.
If you still insist on provoking someone like this, showing off your bravery, dying would be a pointless self-inflicted end.
And while Chen Yi and his friends were indulging,
…An unexpected incident occurred at the headquarters of Skywake.
…
“You all…”
Zhou Ziqiang, President of Skywake, was presently sitting in the chair of his study, his complexion tinged with purple as he clutched at his chest, gasping for air, staring at the seven or eight people standing before him!
Large amounts of blood, turning purple and black, were continuously flowing down through the gaps between his fingers.
His eyes were filled with a mix of unwillingness and confusion, but seeing the mockingly playful look in Yan Niang’s eyes, he gradually calmed down and began to accept his impending death.
After a brief pause,
he said softly,
“I know you all fancy Yan Niang, but I didn’t expect you’d strike at me for her sake.”
“Do you think she can lead you, lead Skywake, to greater heights?”
“Boss.”
A man standing behind Yan Niang scratched the back of his head with some helplessness: “You can’t blame me for this. Although I agreed to help Yan Niang, I never intended to lay a hand on you.”
“It was Yan Niang who told me she had already poisoned you to death, that’s when I came over to see for myself.”
“I didn’t expect to find that you weren’t dead, just gravely injured.”
“But things have come to this point, and you’d hold us accountable if you survived, so we had no choice but to act.”
“If there’s anyone to blame, it’s that you chose the wrong woman. Yan Niang was quite ruthless in dealing with you.”
“Heh.”
Zhou Ziqiang leaned back in his chair, closed his eyes, and suddenly laughed. Without another word, he silently awaited death, when suddenly he remembered something!
The contract hadn’t been renamed!
He and Chen Yi had signed a contract stating that for three months, players from the Skywake Squadron weren’t allowed to harm players from Chen Yi’s team, and vice versa!
This contract was a prop, governed by the game.
The signature was his.
If he died, the contract would be invalidated.
He must rename the contract before he died, or else with Yan Niang’s petty nature, she would undoubtedly strike at Chen Yi, and the hard-won three-month period of safety he had secured for Skywake would be lost!
Chen Yi… was invincible.
At least, he shouldn’t be made an enemy!
He had completely let go of Yan Niang and his own obsession.
His wife was gone for good, and Yan Niang was not his wife – even though they looked almost identical, they were not the same person.
But he couldn’t let go of Skywake.
Skywake was the organization he had built from the ground up; he couldn’t bear to see it fall to ruin!
Having closed his eyes in resignation to his fate, Zhou Ziqiang suddenly burst his eyes open and reached under the table, his voice becoming urgent: “Wait, here’s something…”
However, the few people in the study nearly panicked at his action.
Unleashing all their strength!
They rushed him en masse and finished off Zhou Ziqiang, who was already hanging on to life by a thread, in his study!
With that,
Zhou Ziqiang died.
The once President of Skywake, a notable figure on the global stage, had just perished.
Upon confirming Zhou Ziqiang’s death, the few people in the study exchanged glances and breathed a sigh of relief in unison.
Don’t be fooled by their calm demeanor during their conversation with the President just now.
But everyone had been keeping a tight string in their hearts.
No one dared to let down their guard, and no one dared to deliver the Fatal Strike to the President, fearing his counterattack before death, which none of them could withstand—they knew the President’s strength.
When the President was about to explode in anger.
Without any communication, the men stepped forward almost unanimously and terminated the old President right there.
They all knew that if the President managed to activate some kind of Prop before his death, it would be an almost fatal crisis for them.
And at that moment.
Their gazes shifted toward the drawer under the desk, ready to see what Prop the old President had been about to activate.
“Hm?”
But when someone took the Prop from under the table, they were somewhat bewildered and said, “It’s a contract?”
The contents of the contract…
“All players of ‘Skywake Squadron’ shall not attack the players of ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill Squadron’ either directly or indirectly.”
“‘Rabbits Do Not Kill Squadron’ shall likewise abstain.”
“Unless on the same map and in opposing factions, attacks are otherwise forbidden under all conditions.”
“The contract’s duration is three months.”
“If any party breaks this rule, they will lose one hundred thousand Points per person; if Points are insufficient, they will die explosively.”
“Signatory: Zhou Ziqiang (on behalf of Skywake Squadron)”
“Signatory: Chen Yi (on behalf of Rabbits Do Not Kill Squadron)”
But at this moment… the signature of Zhou Ziqiang on the contract was gradually fading away and turning into nothingness.
A notification echoed in their ears.
‘Ding, signatory Zhou Ziqiang has passed away, the contract signed by both parties has been invalidated without the original signatory’s presence for the transfer, please be informed.’
‘It is hoped that both parties are aware.’
“…”
The several men in the study looked at each other with complicated expressions and stayed silent without speaking.
It turned out…
The President’s earlier actions were not meant for a counterattack but to transfer the contract.
When had the President and Chen Yi signed this contract?
They had no idea.
But certainly, the President must have paid a hefty price for it, and now the contract, which hadn’t lasted for even several days, became null and void.
“What’s wrong?”
At this time, Yan Niang, who had been standing in the corner with her arms crossed, first scanned Zhou Ziqiang’s corpse with triumphant satisfaction, then looked at the other people in the room with a sneer and said, “Isn’t it good that the contract is invalid?”
“With the contract not in effect, each of us would have to forfeit one hundred thousand Points if we attacked Chen Yi; but now, there’s no cost to attacking Chen Yi.”
“Invalid? It’s better that it’s invalid!”
“I knew Zhou Ziqiang was a coward, but I never thought he’d be so weak as to make a humiliating agreement with Chen Yi behind the backs of everyone in Skywake.”
“If it got out, it would be laughable, making it seem as if Skywake was afraid of Chen Yi.”
These sharp, resentful words reminded the men in the room that there was also a woman present.
They exchanged looks, then their eyes gleamed with greed and malice as they started to surround Yan Niang step by step.
“Talking to us in this tone? You don’t really think you’re the President now, do you?”
“The things you promised us, seems like it’s not impossible to take them by force, after all; in fact, it might be more… entertaining.”
“I’ll take the back door; today, I want to properly break her in, make it so she won’t be able to pass anything solid afterward.”
“We didn’t force you before because you were the President’s woman, but now that your backing is dead, I really want to know what kind of confidence you have to stand here and talk to us?”
“On your trifling little tricks?”
However, Yan Niang, who was encircled, showed no fear and merely sneered before sharing the information of a Prop: “See what this is?”
‘Prop Name’: Guild Creation Order.
‘Prop Level’: None.
‘Prop Effect’: This Prop can be activated to create a Guild, with an initial maximum of 500 members.
‘Prop Introduction’: “A single chopstick is easily broken, but a bundle of chopsticks holds strong.”
“The first and only Guild Creation Order in the world, and right now, it’s in my inventory.”
“Once I activate this Prop, Skywake will become the first official Guild in the world!”
“A Guild voice chat channel, Guild warehouse, Guild bosses, Guild maps, even the right to erect a Guild’s main city on a swath of empty land, along with the glory and hefty rewards of being the first ever Guild in the world!”
“Consider it for yourselves.”
“If you accept me as your President, I can establish this Guild based on all of Skywake’s players; then, everything I’ve mentioned above will be yours!”
“But if you kill me, you get nothing.”
“And don’t think this Prop will drop; we bought insurance for it specifically. If I die, the Prop will definitely self-destruct.”
With these words falling,
The eyes of the several men in the study turned red with desire as they stared at the Prop panel shared in the air.
The first Guild Creation Order in the world!
They were fully aware that the former President Zhou Ziqiang had been searching for the means to obtain this Prop and was preparing for it; they hadn’t expected that Yan Niang had somehow gotten hold of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 203: 201: "Whatever you want, they can do it.
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 201: “Whatever you want, they can do it.
What a joke!
All over the world, countless powerful teams with all sorts of capabilities had tried every means to find out how to obtain a Guild Creation Order, only to end up in failure.
They knew exactly what Yan Niang was capable of.
Besides having a juicy body, a sweet voice that gasps and pants, the ability to suck and discuss, and a supple, bending waist with a figure that was both tall and curvy, what other strengths could she have?
As much as they were fascinated by these qualities, they didn’t believe for a second that Yan Niang could use them to acquire a Guild Creation Order.
Don’t even mention trading her body for it.
Even the most libidinous man wouldn’t trade the world’s first Guild Creation Order for a night of pleasure, not even if it were Chang’e descending from the heavens, they would have to say: “No, not today.”
That’s the first Guild Creation Order we’re talking about here, even if you don’t plan to build a power, you could sell it for at least 500,000 Points. That’s considering players don’t own many Points yet—otherwise, it would be priceless!
Not to mention,
If you were the first to create a guild, then the guild territory, guild bosses, and such, nobody would compete with you for them, allowing you to reap the rewards over and over.
This is not about just being one step ahead; it’s about the entire guild being way ahead!
The men in the study room had eyes reddening with greed, licking their parched lips, their eyes filled with avarice.
But this time, it was not the woman they lusted for.
It was the Guild Creation Order.
Still, they didn’t want this woman to be their guild leader, to rule over their heads. They could compel her to submit through punishment after all—how much willpower could a woman have, and how long could she withstand?
Yan Niang looked at the covetous gazes of the men before her and let out a cold laugh. She might not understand anything else, but she knew men.
What do men want? Women, power, money.
What’s the difference from a dog? Give a dog a bone, and it will follow you, and men are no different.
“I need to remind you, I have a prop on my body that will let me die instantly if I endure a certain level of pain,” she said.
“So if you’re thinking of torturing me to get the Guild Order, don’t bother thinking about it.”
“If I die, the Guild Creation Order dies with me.”
“And moreover—”
She paused, her gaze sweeping over everyone in the study room: “Even if I handed over the Guild Creation Order, who among you would become the guild leader? Do you think any of you can command everyone’s respect?”
“You?”
“Or maybe you?”
“Or do you think those outside, still unaware of the situation, could?”
“Who do you think should be the guild leader, then?”
“Why don’t I take up the role for now, and once one of you really gains everyone’s support, I’ll transfer the position to them.”
“Besides…”
She ran her tongue lightly around her lips, a seductive glint in her eye: “If I succeed in becoming the guild leader, it’s not out of the question for several of you to come together, isn’t that what you guys have been wanting all along?”
“I do have many holes, after all.”
Her words extinguished the remaining cunning thoughts in the hearts of the men in the study room. Although they were well aware that Yan Niang was using her wiles,
what she said was indeed quite reasonable.
Although Yan Niang might not be the best choice for guild leader, they were less inclined to accept one of their peers becoming the guild leader and ruling over them.
If Yan Niang were the guild leader, at least she’d be somewhat easier to bully.
Furthermore, the Guild Creation Order was still in Yan Niang’s hands—if they wanted to be the first guild in the world, they had no choice but to agree to Yan Niang’s terms.
Shortly afterward, one of the men in the study room slowly approached Yan Niang, cornering her against the wall.
He slapped her lifted buttocks forcefully, then pressed his head close to Yan Niang, his eyes shimmering with suggestive intent: “Congratulations to the new guild leader,” he said playfully.
“You know, riding the guild leader herself feels a bit more thrilling than riding the guild leader’s wife.”
“Our guild leader has such a soft waist, impossible to break no matter how you ride. Truly something all the brothers would adore.”
“That feeling is to savor for life.”
Yan Niang did not refuse, instead slowly caressing the man’s chest with her fingertips: “What you desire, honey knows all too well.”
“But I hope everyone will get their stories straight, whether it’s to other Skywake players or outsiders, we must insist that Chen Yi secretly killed the old guild leader Zhou Ziqiang.”
“Got it?”
“Don’t worry, we all understand,” they replied.
…
Half an hour later.
In the meeting hall of Skywake, under the angry and perplexed glares of all Skywake players, Yan Niang, dressed in a combat outfit and looking exceptionally dashing with her hair rolled up—a stark change from her usual attire—slowly activated the Guild Creation Order.
Yan Niang’s usual attire was a dress.
And she never wore underwear, always going commando.
That was something most Skywake players knew; if you wanted, you could reach out and touch her as she passed by.
Any chair she sat on would end up with a small puddle of liquid.
This was the first time they saw Yan Niang in a combat suit, and her usual shoulder-length hair was now rolled up out of nowhere, indeed she looked a lot less alluring and much more efficient.
They were infuriated because the old guild leader Zhou Ziqiang, who had always led Skywake and treated them like brothers, had been killed by a scumbag like Chen Yi!
Confused about how the death occurred without any sound, and moreover, why Yan Niang became the president?
Although Yan Niang served as the vice president of Skywake, she didn’t possess even one-tenth of Zhou Ziqiang’s authority, and everyone was clear on how Yan Niang had become the vice president.
Half of the players in Skywake treated Yan Niang like a public bus, coming over to vent their desires whenever they pleased.
The other half of the players disdained to associate with such a woman and didn’t even want to give Yan Niang a second glance.
But what no one had expected was.
Yan Niang had actually become Skywake’s new president.
However, before they had time to think more about it, a prompt sounded in everyone’s ears at once.
“Ding, global announcement!”
“Congratulations to player ‘Yan Niang’ for establishing the world’s first guild and naming it ‘Skywake’. The list of initial guild members is as follows: Zhang Yibo, Li Ping’en, Master Wang…”
“As the world’s first successfully established guild, the initial guild members will receive an exclusive title—(Skywake·Elders)”
“And a one-time 50% discount on building Guild Territory.”
“Plus a reward of 10,000 Points as startup funds for the guild.”
“Let’s congratulate them.”
A prompt resounded in everyone’s ears.
“Roar!!”
Downstairs in the conference hall, a crowd of Skywake players couldn’t help but erupt into celebration, despite the old president being murdered, Skywake had still become the world’s first guild!
Moreover, their names were now listed in a global announcement.
They had also obtained the exclusive title “Skywake·Elder,” which was a matter of great honor, and they had accomplished something even the old president had not.
The old president could rest in peace now.
“Quiet down.”
Just as the people were roaring in celebration of the guild’s establishment, Yan Niang, standing on the platform, spoke calmly. Her voice might not have been loud, but passed through the loudspeakers and echoed from the speakers on the walls of the vast conference hall, it resounded next to everyone’s ears.
And after being transmitted through the speakers, the voice became extremely loud.
Several men at the forefront of the crowd downstairs frowned and remained silent. How come Yan Niang turned the volume up so high? The old president never adjusted the volume to be this loud when he spoke.
The conference hall was very large.
It was nearly 1,000 square meters, as the old president had once envisioned that it could accommodate up to 1,000 people at the same time!
This was the old president’s blueprint. He had always hoped that one day Skywake could grow into a massive guild with 1,000 core members!
Looking down, the noisy crowd suddenly became quiet.
Standing on the platform, Yan Niang felt the tension within her gradually ease, but externally she showed no sign of it and spoke to the crowd below in an even tone, word by word.
“Skywake has become the first guild established in the world, and that is an extremely glorious achievement.”
“But—”
“I just can’t bring myself to be happy.”
“Do you know why?”
The voice was extremely loud, resounding deep in everyone’s ears.
Her identity was sensitive, and her reputation within Skywake was not good, which she knew well. As for authority, she had none at all.
But she knew one thing.
That was when she spoke for the first time as president, she had to dominate the room; otherwise, she would never have the chance to establish her authority as president!
Turning up the speakers was just a little trick.
A basic human instinct made most people instinctively shut up in such situations. And when they realized everyone else was quiet, a bit of her authority as president gradually started to establish itself in their minds.
Everyone was aware they kept quiet because of the loud volume, but… in their hearts, they wouldn’t think that way.
People are strange beings.
Oftentimes, the brain operates separately from the body.
It’s like what many normal universities teach new teachers: when you arrive at a new class as a newly hired teacher, don’t rush to show your friendliness. Instead, find an excuse to stare at the students with a blank expression for a minute.
Looking straight into the students’ eyes.
When in the first lesson, students bow their heads and submit to you, your authority is established.
Otherwise, it becomes very difficult to manage those students later.
The first thing you do in a new role nearly completely determines how others will see you in that role from then on.
Friendliness is to be used like a jujube.
Furthermore, under the influence of the deafening sound, the people below completely lose the chance to whisper to each other, left only to listen to her speak.
Such times are actually the most dangerous.
When a group of people stand below the stage, unable to talk to each other, only able to listen to one person speak,
Brainwashing often begins.
The mob is just like that.
Even the smartest person becomes half as intelligent in a crowd.
Many people like using this method to brainwash those below them, such as some pyramid sales organizations, or things like “Although it’s dark at six in the morning, a score of 600 is really dazzling.”
Although basic,
It’s practical and easy to use, and many people really fall for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 204: 202: "This battle, fight to the death!
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 202: “This battle, fight to the death!
And Yan Niang’s words…
cast a shadow of desolation and sadness in the eyes of the members below, who had originally been revelanteing.
Although the Guild had been successfully established,
the old guild leader was not there to witness the moment. If only the old guild leader could stand here now, he would definitely revel with them, celebrating “Skywake” as the world’s first officially recognized top Guild!
“Do you want to know where this Guild Creation Order in my hand comes from?”
“It was given to me by the old guild leader.”
Standing on the high platform, Yan Niang looked down at the members below, her face cold as she enunciated each word, “It was the old guild leader who, before he died, stuffed the Guild Creation Order into my hands.”
“The Guild Creation Order was covered in blood.”
“It was the old guild leader’s blood.”
“At that time, the old guild leader was already unable to speak. His body was trembling, but he still shakily pushed the Guild Creation Order into my arms, entrusting me to officially establish the Guild in his stead!”
“Because he knew that becoming the top Guild in the world was not only his dream but the dream of every Skywake player!”
This is called endorsement.
The meaning of endorsement can generally be understood as a medium that makes people trust you.
A long time ago, people enjoyed using this to play tricks.
For example, for a long period in history, being a disciple of Guigu was a very strong endorsement. Many people used this title to run from the east to the west, telling everyone they were disciples of Guigu.
When you want someone to trust you, you have to give them something to trust you with.
And what she offered was the dying entrustment of the old guild leader!
This was her endorsement.
Of course, she knew that even so, these members wouldn’t listen to her, which is why she didn’t set herself apart completely. Instead, she placed herself in the perspective of the old guild leader.
That way, when she gave an order, the members would subconsciously feel they were following the old guild leader’s commands, not hers.
The compliance would be higher, and resistance would be lower!
Gradually, these members would become accustomed, and habit is a frightening word.
Human adaptability is strong among the animal kingdom.
In most cases, this is a good trait, but in some rare instances, it is not a good thing. It means that if a person is manipulated long enough, they might not even feel they are being manipulated and may even think the manipulator has their best interests at heart.
And the ultimate artistry of manipulation is built on the foundation of “everything I do is for your own good.”
All manipulators must stand on a moral high ground.
Making you unable to argue until you comply, adapt, and become accustomed.
And then you accept it, starting to resist and disdain those who have not yet been assimilated as enemies.
Many who claim to engage in deep thought every day are really just reorganizing their prejudices, making them even more biased.
Yan Niang’s words had already brought tears to the eyes of many below. Clearly, quite a few were reminded of the old guild leader’s kindness.
“Do you want to know how the old guild leader died?”
With a cold expression and clear enunciation, Yan Niang continued, “You only know that Chen Yi killed him, but do you know why Chen Yi wanted to kill the old guild leader?”
“Because Chen Yi wanted to snatch this first Guild Creation Order in the world!”
“The old guild leader had many chances to abandon the Guild Creation Order and flee, but he chose not to. He chose to sacrifice his own life to bring back the Guild Creation Order for you!”
“Because he knew that becoming the top Guild in the world has always been what the brothers wanted the most!”
“He didn’t want to let the brothers down!”
“He didn’t want the brothers to think he was incapable!”
“Knowing he would die, he exchanged his life for you to become the world’s top Guild!”
By then, the members below had tears in their eyes, and as they pictured in their minds the old guild leader’s tragic final moments, their hearts grew heavier with sorrow.
Watching the scene below, Yan Niang’s heart relaxed once again, and she clenched her fist slightly at her side, feeling a silent triumph that everything was going smoothly.
This speech was also a common manipulation tactic.
It’s divided into two steps.
The first, deepening the sense of glory.
The second, stirring up feelings of guilt.
In practice, it’s pretty simple. For instance, although the members of Skywake wanted to become the number one Guild in the world, they didn’t have the resolve to achieve it at the cost of their lives. To put it plainly, it was optional for them.
It was just about being the first to establish a Guild.
It wasn’t about being the strongest Guild.
It wasn’t something they needed to stake their lives on.
But she wanted to deepen their sense of glory, to make these Guild members realize how glorious it was to be the first Guild established globally, something many could only dream of!
Then, by using the death of the old guild leader, she would trigger their feelings of guilt.
This sort of rhetoric is actually very common in real life.
For instance, think about how much effort your parents put into getting you a secure job; can you really not work hard and still face them?
Deepen the glory, stir up the guilt.
This can make newly graduated students feel overwhelmingly guilty, driving them to overwork themselves.
Or consider the scenario where a woman could remind a man, “I had so many wealthy men pursuing me, but I chose you, a worker. How can you treat me this way now, do you think you are worthy of me?”
Deepen the glory, stir up the guilt.
This can make simple-hearted men instantly feel like monsters.
Or take the example where an editor says, “Do you know how long I fought with other editors to get this daily reading recommendation for you? Is this little update each day really worthy of my efforts?”
Deepen the glory, stir up the guilt.
For some naive authors, hearing their editor say this may make them want to churn out 20,000 words a day in gratitude!
“`
Society is truly treacherous.
The Skywake members below also reacted well, their eyes red with fervor, clearly immersed in a state of grief.
Yan Niang, seeing this, knew the time was almost right and took a deep breath before speaking.
“The old Guild Leader’s last wish, I have fulfilled it, and so have all of you.”
“Skywake has become the first Guild to be established globally!”
“But the old Guild Leader’s vengeance, we have yet to claim!”
“That Chen Yi is still at large, tell me, should we or should we not avenge the old Guild Leader!”
“Avenge!”
A man below, his eyes already crimson, raised his arm and roared, “We must avenge him! Kill Chen Yi, avenge our Guild Leader!!!”
Yan Niang paid no attention to the man’s words but, her eyes also brimming with red, she screamed, “Has everyone else gone mute? Do we, or do we not avenge the old Guild Leader!”
“Avenge!!”
This time, nearly half of the people spoke up.
“Louder, do we, or do we not avenge the old Guild Leader!!!”
“Avenge, we must avenge!!”
This time all the Skywake members below responded.
“I can’t hear you, do we, or do we not avenge the old Guild Leader!!!”
“Avenge, avenge, avenge!!”
After several rounds of questioning, all the Skywake members below, with fierce expressions and eyes red, raised their arms and roared repeatedly, their voices almost breaking through the ceiling!!!
This is the charm of a mob.
Asking four times whether to seek revenge wasn’t just about stirring up the atmosphere.
It was more about increasing interactivity.
Understanding applause is a common tactic used in pyramid schemes—is it really the applause they need? No, but after several interactions, the audience will gradually link up with the speaker in their hearts.
It’s a subconscious behavior of the body.
Although the brain knows very well that this is illogical, the body will truly subconsciously link itself to the speaker, feeling a close connection with them.
As mentioned earlier, the brain and body often operate independently.
Ridiculous but effective.
And after complying with simple commands several times, when the speaker on stage issues another command, it will also gradually be subconsciously accepted.
And in the next second—
A voice rang in the ears of everyone around the world.
「Global Announcement: Skywake’s old Guild Leader, Zhou Ziqiang, was hunted down and murdered by Chen Yi after obtaining the Guild Creation Order, dying a tragic death at the hands of Chen Yi!’
‘All players of Skywake Guild deeply mourn and are infuriated by this!’
‘Hereafter, the Skywake Guild and Chen Yi are irreconcilable enemies, and any player who gets close to Chen Yi is our enemy!’
‘A global bounty has been issued!’
‘To the person who brings Chen Yi’s head, a reward of 1 million Points!’
‘Although the old Guild Leader had no blood ties with all the players of Skywake Guild, he regarded us as his children, and we regarded him as our father. After mourning for the old Guild Leader for three days, the entire Guild will mobilize to pursue Chen Yi globally!’
‘Until death!’
‘For this battle, we will not rest until it’s done!’
This global announcement is a Guild privilege.
Any Guild Leader who has created a Guild can use this feature.
It costs ten thousand Points for one use.
Although the price is a bit steep, it’s worth it for the chance to speak directly into the ears of players worldwide.
And her urge to hunt down Chen Yi without delay.
One reason is because Chen Yi had publicly humiliated her before, causing her to lose face; she must avenge this humiliation!
Another reason is that the Skywake Guild is newly established, and as a Guild Leader, her foundation is not yet stable. Even though she temporarily pacified these people with her speech, a lot of internal conflicts still remain.
For example, many of the old Guild Leader’s Props were gone, having followed him to hell.
And those few people who used to manage the team’s Props and Points are avoiding her.
Some even doubt the death of the old Guild Leader.
Or are eyeing the position of Guild Leader for themselves, etc.
There are too many internal conflicts, and she can’t resolve each one individually.
And the best way to solve internal conflicts is to intensify them and then transform them into external conflicts!
Just like how the Skywake Guild currently has many internal issues that can’t be managed, why not leave them unmanaged and instead escalate the conflict into killing Chen Yi? She doesn’t actually expect to succeed in a short period of time.
But once there is an internal conflict, many things can be resolved much more easily.
For instance, some people… can die.
Yan Niang, standing on the stage, narrowed her eyes slightly, a hint of ruthlessness flashing in them, as she looked towards the few men standing at the very front; only these men knew that the old Guild Leader was killed by her.
If these men died.
Then this secret would never be revealed, and as for Chen Yi’s rebuttal.
Who would believe the defense of a suspect?
And just then—
One of the men standing at the front frowned and spoke with a subdued voice, “Guild Leader, are we certain we want to move against Chen Yi?”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 205: 203: "Playing Mind Games with Us? Are You Worthy?
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 203: “Playing Mind Games with Us? Are You Worthy?
This man was one of the men who had just been standing in the study.
Named Li Pei.
He had not expected that Yan Niang, who usually seemed coquettish, would change her presence so dramatically once she took the stage, and her speech indeed somewhat shook them.
Especially since she lied without a hint of blushing.
The old Guild Leader clearly died because of your conspiracy, yet you righteously claimed it was by Chen Yi’s hand.
He actually did not advise taking action against Chen Yi and did not understand why Yan Niang would say that the old Guild Leader died at Chen Yi’s hand. They hadn’t gone over this script before taking the stage.
Before his death, the old Guild Leader had even signed a peace treaty with Chen Yi.
Though the contract was currently invalid.
But at least it showed that the old Guild Leader had established some sort of cooperative relationship with Chen Yi. If they steadied themselves and then approached Chen Yi, he presumably would not refuse.
He didn’t understand why Yan Niang suddenly dragged Chen Yi into this.
“What’s up?”
Yan Niang stood on the stage, her expression cold as she looked down at Li Pei, “Do you not wish to avenge the old Guild Leader? Have you forgotten the old Guild Leader’s kindness to you?”
As her voice fell.
The people surrounding them looked at Li Pei with angry expressions, like they were staring at a traitorous ingrate.
“…”
Feeling those angry gazes around him, Li Pei found himself momentarily speechless. He really wanted to shout out, “Avenge your mother’s revenge, the person who killed the old Guild Leader is standing on the stage, are you all idiots?”
But he couldn’t say that. He had to suppress his resentment and eventually roared out reluctantly.
“Avenge, we must avenge!”
“The old Guild Leader’s favor towards me is as heavy as a mountain. If I don’t seek revenge, am I still human?”
“Good!”
A cold smile flashed in Yan Niang’s eyes, “Then three days later, when we hunt down Chen Yi, you, Li Pei, will lead the charge. Do you have the guts?”
Li Pei’s face instantly darkened as he glared at Yan Niang. Was she sending him to his death?
But feeling the gazes around him, he remained silent for a long time before finally saying hoarsely.
“I am honored.”
…
“What do you mean by today’s actions?”
After the meeting.
Li Pei and the others surrounded Yan Niang in the study, speaking with icy faces, “Pushing me like that in front of the assembly today, did you want me to die?”
“Are you trying to get rid of us?”
“Do you think if we died, we would not spill all your dirty secrets?”
“Trying to silence us? Expose all your deeds of sleeping with your brother-in-law, your shamelessness, then murdering him to usurp power, and framing Chen Yi?”
“Think you can outsmart us? Are you even worthy?”
“How hurtful.”
Yan Niang’s eyes seemed watery as she glared at Li Pei and pouted, “Do you know this kind of talk really hurts me? I’m considering this for your good.”
“After the Guild’s official establishment, there will be one formal Vice Guild Leader position and five Elder positions.”
“I intend these positions for those who are close to me.”
“But you also know I used to be nothing but a loose woman at Skywake. Where would I find close confidants?”
Upon hearing this.
The displeasure on the faces of Li Pei and the others suddenly vanished, their eyes lighting up, “Isn’t that obvious? Us!”
“We’re all in this together. Other than us, who else could you choose?”
“I also want to pick you, but you didn’t accomplish anything particularly notable in Skywake before. Even if I chose you, you wouldn’t be able to command respect. That’s why I wanted to create some achievements to make you respected.”
“And here you are thinking I want to harm you. It’s like biting the hand that feeds you, not recognizing a good heart.”
Yan Niang reproachfully rolled her eyes at Li Pei before reaching out to slowly slide her finger across his chest, “Why so fierce just now? You really scared me.”
“The achievements you mentioned, do they involve killing Chen Yi?”
Li Pei quickly caught on and looked at Yan Niang emotionlessly, word by word he asked, “Do you think I’m stupid or you’re stupid? If I had the ability to kill Chen Yi, what would I need you for?”
“Silly!”
Yan Niang softly tapped Li Pei’s chin with her finger, “How could I really send you to your death?”
“In three days, I’ll pretend to find Chen Yi’s location, and then lead all Skywake members there.”
“Then, when everyone is a bit fearful, you guys, without any sign of fear, shout out your vengeance for the old Guild Leader and charge forth first.”
“What do you think will be the effect?”
“It will show the other Skywake members your loyalty to the old Guild Leader and your fearless courage. If you’re willing to lead the charge, it surely means you’re very confident in your own strength.”
“Later, I’ll give you some other achievements. Tell me, will you be able to win over the crowd then?”
“When we actually face the real Chen Yi, we’ll let others step up then.”
“Do you understand?”
As her voice fell.
Li Pei and the others exchanged glances, their eyes all flashing with insight. If things really went according to this plan, indeed there would be no problem.
“Never knew you were this smart before.”
“Where’s that?”
Yan Niang coquettishly stepped back, her eyes full of seduction as she licked her lips, “In the past, I was very stupid. Ever since brother last nourished me, I’ve felt much smarter.”
“Hahaha.”
Feeling quite pleased, Li Pei laughed out loud, then slowly advanced and began to strip away Yan Niang’s clothes, “Then, how about letting your brothers nourish you again?”
“Don’t rush it.”
A flicker of unease crossed Yan Niang’s heart, but she forced a smile, “We’re in mourning for the old Guild Leader, it’s not good to do this during the mourning period.”
“Mourn my ass, you take the bullshit you feed to those people and use it on us?”
“You did promise us.”
“You wouldn’t want to go back on your word, would you?”
By this time, Yan Niang was somewhat disheveled, looking at the man in front of her within the study, whose eyes shone with greed and excitement. After a moment of silence, a trace of sorrow flashed through her heart before she squeezed out a seductive smile once more.
“How could I, I can hardly wait.”
“I wonder who will go first.”
“I will. I want to see just what this little vixen can do today.”
…
Three hours later.
Only then did Li Pei and the others slowly leave the study, pulling up their trousers.
Yan Niang, on the other hand, lay naked on the office desk inside the study, her gaze somewhat vacant and dazed as she stared at the ceiling, somewhat lost in thought.
These people must die.
She reaffirmed her decision in her heart.
These people had no respect for her; as long as they were alive, she could never truly control Skywake.
After a long while.
She slowly climbed up from the desk, her legs and waist sore and aching, and slowly walked to the full-length mirror in the study. She looked at her body that was like white jade, now covered in dried, brown-yellow spots, resembling a piece of Hetian jade of less than perfect quality.
She stared into the mirror at her reflection, lost in silence.
Time passed once more before she casually picked up a cigarette from a table nearby, lit it, and put it to her lips, her expression vacant as her thoughts drifted away.
Then, she remembered.
When she worked as a hostess, her sister had always looked down on her.
Her sister was better than her at everything.
Better at studies, better at work, even the men she found were better than hers.
But what about later? Her sister’s man, who she had been so proud of, wasn’t he stolen away by her?
What does it matter if she was filthy and despicable?
She was the one who stood at the end.
Those who laughed at her, where were they now?
She wanted to show those who looked down on her that the person they despised the most was now at the very top of the world.
She, Yan Niang, President of the Skywake Guild!
How many in the world could compare to her status?
Thinking this, she suddenly began to laugh again, even reaching down to pick a brown-yellow spot off her body and bringing it to her mouth, staring at her ugly self in the mirror with satisfaction brimming in her heart.
What was this humiliation compared to everything else?
Since ancient times,
Has there been any great figure who hasn’t been humiliated before they achieved greatness?
If Han Xin could crouch between another’s legs, then what does it matter if she, a woman, does the same?
Once she reaches the top of the world, she would write about these things in her memoir, and like Han Xin, leave behind a name that would be remembered for generations.
Only then did she walk to the desk with graceful steps and sat in the executive chair once occupied by the former president, Zhou Ziqiang, and picked up a book from the drawer, her lips slowly curling into a smile.
“As a manager, you must understand the weaknesses of human nature.”
The book title was a bit long.
Before the next era began, and after she had been with Zhou Ziqiang for a considerable time, Zhou Ziqiang had given her a book with this title, suggesting she read it to learn how to manage and eventually take part in the company’s affairs.1
She obediently did so.
Though she was impure, she knew to recognize who were powerful people, and her brother-in-law Zhou Ziqiang, who started a company from scratch, was one such person.
She listened to what he said.
She really did read night and day, constantly thinking and learning in her heart.
The book he had given her was now worn from her frequent reading.
Yet the one here, it still looked brand new, as if it wasn’t read often.
Yan Niang’s lips turned up slightly as she casually flipped to a page marked with a bookmark and murmured, “Brother-in-law, oh brother-in-law, you asked me to study diligently, and I did. But it seems you didn’t study hard enough, did you?”
“No wonder I won and you lost.”
However, the next moment—
She suddenly looked at the book in her hands with disbelief, her eyes filled with horror.
On the page held by the bookmark lay a piece of white paper.
On it was written a single sentence.
“Yan Niang killed Xiaohui. I’ve found out, but I regret finding out.”
Xiaohui was the name of Zhou Ziqiang’s wife.
This was the biggest secret in her heart.
Zhou Ziqiang’s wife had died suddenly one day when she went out shopping for groceries and fell into a collapsed ground.
In fact, after continuous rainfall, that spot had already been identified as problematic.
Caution tape and warning signs had been put up to prevent pedestrians from using that route, and preparations were underway for further detailed inspections and to get the construction team on site.
That path was the very one her sister always took when going grocery shopping.
The day her sister died, Yan Niang had just finished her shift at the club and was heading home. Noticing the road closure, she complained a few words. Almost reaching her own home, she happened to see her sister about to go shopping with her basket in hand.
Long-standing jealousy inspired a mischievous thought in her heart.
She quickly retraced her steps and, after ensuring there were no cameras around, swiftly stole the caution tape and warning signs.
Just like that.
Her sister walked the familiar path, and, as fate would have it, met with the ground collapse.
And easily lost her life.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: 204: "Who the Fuck Asked If You're Willing?
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 204: “Who the Fuck Asked If You’re Willing?
She had never anticipated that the road surface would really collapse.
After all, it was just a warning line; logically, it should have merely posed a risk, been unable to support traffic flow, but not collapse just because one person stepped on it.
But it actually did collapse.
When she saw her sister fall in, her heart was filled with fear at that very moment, and she turned and ran.
And when she heard the news of her sister’s death, she found it even more unbelievable, never expecting her to die like that.
She admits that she hated her own sister, if it weren’t for her sister outshining her in every aspect, she too could have been the darling of the family instead of just a backdrop.
Ultimately leading to a life of disgrace.
The reason she ended up in disgrace, apart from money, was not as the outside world claimed, that she liked sleeping with men, but to let her parents and sister know.
You all thought I was rotten, right?
Then I’ll show you just how rotten I can be.
I’m a whore, so are you saying you raised a whore?
How about that?
But she never truly thought about killing her own sister; she just wanted to play a prank and get some revenge.
After her sister died, she took a long time to recover, not working at the club for a while and only trying to approach her brother-in-law after she was sure no one would find out about her.
And she successfully developed feelings for her brother-in-law, and they got together.
What she didn’t realize was that her brother-in-law had already discovered that she was the one who had killed her sister.
Yan Niang wasn’t wearing any clothes, sitting naked on the office chair, her expression vacant as she stared at the page of white paper tucked within the book in her hands.
Many things she couldn’t understand before, suddenly all made sense to her in an instant.
Her brother-in-law used to be very good to her.
He was also very possessive and wouldn’t allow her to interact with any man.
But since a certain period before the descent of the future world, he seemed to have become a different person, completely indifferent to her, never showing her a good face, yet still giving her a lot of money to spend, and also not letting her leave him.
He didn’t even mind her contact with other men.
It was like keeping a canary.
If the brother-in-law had already found out before the future world descended, why didn’t he report to the police?
If he reported, she would definitely be jailed.
Didn’t he want to avenge his wife?
She suddenly recalled the exact moment her brother-in-law gave her the book, when he placed two identical books on the desk and asked her with a complex expression which one she wanted with a complex expression.
At that time, she even joked.
These two are the same, aren’t they? What’s the difference?
In the end, she chose the one on the left, but just as she was about to pick up the left-hand book, her brother-in-law suddenly held down her left hand, fell silent for a long time, and then said something about how he had been reading that one and told her to take the other one on the right.
Although she was a bit puzzled,
She obediently took the right-hand book anyway.
Now she realized, her brother-in-law’s intention wasn’t for her to read the book at all, but he was struggling whether to reveal the truth, and in the end, he chose to conceal it.
She suddenly understood why he did that.
Once the truth was revealed, she would have to go to prison and leave him.
The brother-in-law didn’t want her to leave or, perhaps, didn’t want the person playing his sister to leave.
Even knowing that she was the murderer who killed his wife, he was unwilling to send her to jail, preferring instead to imprison her like a canary.
But ever since then, her brother-in-law’s attitude towards her had completely changed.
The brother-in-law… really seemed to love the sister.
Yan Niang sat silently in the chair, staring at the book in her hand for a long time without uttering a word, having never thought her brother-in-law knew her secret so early, and less so the real implication of him giving her that book was not for her to study.
Why had her sister been loved by so many people since childhood?
Why hadn’t she?
Just where was she inferior to her sister?
After a while, she suddenly let out a cold laugh, slowly stuffed the book into the drawer, and swallowed the paper in her mouth before heading towards the bathroom in the study.
“Brother-in-law, you should have paid more attention to this book.”
“What’s in here is very useful.”
“If you had read this book, perhaps you wouldn’t have failed to notice that I’ve wanted to kill you for a long time.”
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi and his friends, who were enjoying a barbecue feast in Zhong Bo City, suddenly heard a notification sound in their ears and uncharacteristically fell silent with strange expressions.
“Ding, signatory Zhou Ziqiang has died. The contract signed by both parties cannot be transferred without the original signatory’s witness, and therefore, the contract is invalidated.”
“Please be informed.”
“Zhou Ziqiang is dead?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stuffed a skewer of grilled tendon into a roasted pepper, added some grilled potato slices, and then swallowed it, speaking with some unclear confusion.
“Zhou Ziqiang was a President of Skywake, right? His strength shouldn’t be weak.”
“How could he just die like that?”
Sword Without End also spoke with a hint of regret, “Zhou Ziqiang was my old President too. While that Vice President Yan Niang of Skywake is quite annoying, Zhou Ziqiang himself was actually not bad. He was kind to me and decent to those below him.”
“Didn’t think he would suddenly die, there must have been some accident.”
“But with his strength, he should be able to crawl out of hell, so there’s no need to worry too much.”
“It’s good that it’s invalidated.”
Chen Yi, on the other hand, didn’t react much, simply saying, “That Yan Niang from Skywake once cursed at me, and I’ve always remembered it. I thought I’d have to wait three months before I could kill her, but I didn’t expect I could do it now.”
“Sword Without End, take note, if you go down to hell in these few days, remember to take out that Yan Niang.”

chapters.title: Chapter 207: 204: "Who the hell asked if you were willing?"_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 204: “Who the hell asked if you were willing?”_2
“…”
Sword Without End’s expression was a mix of emotions as he said, “Yi, why do you think I might end up in hell these past few days?”
“I said ‘if’.”
“But you and Tuberculosis Rabbit keep talking like that.”
“Because you always give me the impression that you could kick the bucket at any moment.”
Sword Without End was momentarily speechless, choked up and unsure what to say. He had never realized he could give off such an impression but then he became curious and asked,
“Yi, if I remember correctly, that Yan Niang only had contact with you once, right? Although that contact wasn’t pleasant, I don’t recall any cursing.”
“There was cursing, pretty filthy at that.”
After casually finishing the slip of paper in his hands, Chen Yi stretched out and exhaled with relief, “I have a prop that lets me hear the curses others think of me. That Wang Yimei whom you killed cursed me quite a lot.”
Just as expected.
Sword Without End nodded silently without speaking. Long ago, he had wondered if Chen Yi possessed a prop that allowed him to hear the curses directed at him from people’s hearts, and now it seemed that was indeed true.
Fortunately, he had never cursed Chen Yi in his heart.
That was truly a close call.
Mainly because he didn’t have the habit of cursing others.
He considered himself to be of relatively high quality; previously he thought his own standards were low, but after encountering Tuberculosis Rabbit, he realized he had set his reference too high, which made him believe he was of low quality.
If he used Tuberculosis Rabbit as the benchmark, his quality was obviously much higher.
“Oh, right.”
Chen Yi turned his head toward Jiaye, “I’m going to add you and Tie Chui to the team first. From now on, you two will be members of our Rabbits Do Not Kill team.”
“Also, I have some good news for you.”
“What good news?”
After clinking glasses with Chen Yi, Jiaye squinted her eyes into crescent moons, full of anticipation as she spoke. She hadn’t expected things to go so smoothly; Yi didn’t seem to resist her that much.
That sister was right after all.
If you like a man, you should just go up and kiss her!
Mouths can lie, but bodies can’t.
“I’ve found a way to save you.”
Chen Yi wiped his mouth clean of the wine he’d just drunk and glanced up to see if there was anything overhead. Seeing nothing, he lit a cigarette and took a deep drag, peering through the light blue smoke at Jiaye in a soft voice, “You don’t mind me smoking next to you, do you?”
“You’re already smoking…”
“So do you mind?”
“Can I mind?”
“No, those who don’t listen to me end up dead.”
“Oh.”
Jiaye’s response was somewhat meek as she nodded.
“Back to the point. I have a Title that can almost guarantee a hundred percent chance of saving you, but it comes with a heavy price.”
“It requires… true love.”
“True love?”
Jiaye looked a bit lost, turning her head to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End, only to see them both shrugging with equally clueless expressions.
Without wasting more words, Chen Yi shared the effects of a Title.
Title Name: Wife-Killing Maniac.
Title Quality: Red.
Title Effect: When you truly fall in love with a woman and kill her by your own hands, you will gain a potent buff for the next hour where all props and skills have no cool-down and no consumption.
Title Restriction: Uses (3/3).
Title Origin: “Obtainable by completing hidden tasks on the C-level map of the Life Theater.”
“Once I activate the effect of this Title, for the next hour, all my props and skills will enter a state of absolute zero cool-down and zero consumption.”
“For example, in the world boss event, I dealt a million damage with the B-grade prop, the Seven-Star Badge!”
“C-grade skill, Annihilated Violators!”
“Or my B-grade prop, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle+6 Enhancement’s Special Effect, the Gentleman’s Cane.”
“+6 New Special Effect: ‘Gentleman’s Cane.'”
“When the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle transforms into the Christmas Cane, and you lean on the cane, you can activate this effect to shoot a bullet with an explosive flame effect deep into the ground. Then, you can control this bullet with your mind, shooting it out from any angle on the ground, giving your enemy a sudden and fierce attack!”
“And the B-grade prop, Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom.”
“Prop Name”: Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom.
“Prop Effect”: When you activate this prop, more than three thousand Flowers of the Other Shore will emerge from the ground, floating in the air around you. Any player touched by the Flowers of the Other Shore will experience rapid continuous health depletion and, upon death, will turn into Floral People, eternal and everlasting.”
Chen Yi shared the information about each prop with the group as he spoke.
“These props can be used repeatedly without cooldowns or consumption within an hour.”
“Together with my C-grade vehicle, the Christmas Reindeer Mechanical Sled’s high mobility speed, as long as the enemy isn’t too spread out, I can entirely wipe out the God Race within an hour.”
“With so many unlimited area attacks, plus the effect of Annihilated Violators on each bullet I shoot, every bullet carries the effect of annihilating an entire family.”
“Wiping out the God Race is not difficult.”
At this moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others were standing in shocked disbelief, with faces that could hardly accept what they were hearing.
Especially Sword Without End, his mind went blank when he saw Chen Yi pulling out one prop after another.
He knew that Chen Yi had held back when he had introduced himself.
That was normal.
No one reveals everything they have to someone they aren’t close with.
But he hadn’t expected Chen Yi to have held back so much.
B-grade props were almost as common as ordinary props in Chen Yi’s possession, with no sense of being special at all!
“I don’t know why…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit also lit a cigarette, biting his fingernail hesitantly, “I suddenly feel like wiping out a race doesn’t seem that difficult.”
“Yes.”
Chen Yi nodded seriously, “The prerequisite is activating this Title Effect, but to activate this Title Effect, I must kill a woman I have truly fallen in love with.”
“Only by activating this Title Effect will I have a future to speak of.”
“The God Race will arrive in three days.”
“So Jiaye, our mission for the next three days is to develop genuine feelings, and then when the God Race arrives…”
Sword Without End suddenly caught on, his expression turning odd as he interjected, “Then when the God Race arrives, Yi, you’re planning to personally kill Jiaye?”
“Why does it feel like something isn’t right?”
“Our goal should be to protect Jiaye, not to wipe out the God Race, right?”
“According to what you’re saying, Yi, it’s like Jiaye is doomed to die, with no chance of survival, and all this effort is just to give Jiaye another way to die?”
No sooner had the words left his mouth than a crisp voice was heard from beside him.
Jiaye was staring at Chen Yi with eyes full of joy, her voice trembling slightly with excitement, “I’m willing!”
“‘Willing’ what the hell?”
Sword Without End swept a glance towards Jiaye feeling somewhat speechless, then looked towards Tie Chui, “Bro, look at your lovesick sister, what’s she become.”
“I’m willing too.”
Tie Chui said earnestly, with a deep voice.
“The hell are ‘you’ willing for?!”
“Who the hell asked if you were willing?”
“A lovesick sister and retarded brother, huh? You two are really a match made in heaven.”
Sword Without End was left gasping for air from frustration at Tie Chui’s response, the world was too crazy for him to comprehend.
…
PS: Today a 20,000 word update.

chapters.title: Chapter 208: 205: "Ding, global announcement, the entire God Race from Black Eagle Star is mobilized!
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 205: “Ding, global announcement, the entire God Race from Black Eagle Star is mobilized!
“Yi, I think I might understand what you’re talking about.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully, “Yi, do you mean to kill Jiaye first to activate the Title Effect, then deal with that God Race butcher, and after that pull Jiaye back from hell?”
“Yes.”
Chen Yi, looking calm, slowly took out a small button from his chest and placed it on the table: “Since the God Race can go to Blue Star to launch a cross-world war, it means they can also go to hell.”
“At first, I thought of sending Jiaye to hell before the God Race arrived, but after thinking it over carefully, it seemed not quite right.”
“So, in the end, I chose this method.”
“It’s basically foolproof.”
“The only problem is whether we can develop true feelings within these three days. Without true feelings, the Title Effect can’t be activated.”
“I understand.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded and said with a sigh, “If this plan works, it will be an unprecedented feat, after all, we’re dealing with an entire race.”
“But this also indirectly indicates the existence of other races, right?”
“Just don’t know the relation between this race and the game upgrade, what the game’s attitude towards this race is, and what their attitude towards us is?”
“Did this race come to Blue Star with the permission of the game upgrade, or did they just forcefully cross over?”
“Not sure.”
Chen Yi shook his head and placed the small button from the table into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s hand: “But what can be anticipated is that in the future battles, it may not be dominated by a particular guild or a team, but by a certain race.”
“If there’s a chance, we should still try to improve the overall strength of human players as much as possible.”
…
After that, the few of them returned to Yancheng and dispersed.
Leaving Chen Yi and Jiaye alone together.
The most difficult task in these three days lay with these two. If they couldn’t develop real feelings, then the only outcome for Jiaye and Tie Chui was to wait for death, with no deity able to save them.
Eating, watching movies, shopping.
Although many shopping districts had become quite simple due to the arrival of the game upgrade, the traces of civilization were still visible, meeting some normal spiritual needs.
During these three days.
The two of them were almost inseparable, doing whatever a little couple would do.
Lying on the grass in the park, watching the stars at four o’clock in the morning.
Sitting on a rock at the mountain top, admiring the sunrise emerging from the clouds.
Going to popular spots, learning how to take photos and check-in like couples from the past.
They were very much like a couple in the heat of their romance.
…
As for the Tuberculosis Rabbit, he almost slept the entire time, inexplicably tired, able to sleep 23 hours a day, only waking for an hour to eat and relieve himself.
“…”
Sword Without End looked with a complex expression towards the Tuberculosis Rabbit who was mumbling while eating at the table, a trace of incredulity surfacing in his eyes.
“Enough, what’s your little issue compared to mine? Let me tell you, I’ve been through way worse.”
“It’s not like I’m boasting, but your little issues wouldn’t make even a ripple compared to what I’ve dealt with.”
“So what if someone sucked out your Divine Body and stuffed your soul into this prop?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit scooped up a large chunk of spicy pork with his spoon and stuffed it into his mouth, chewing vigorously: “Besides,”
“I’ve even had my skull cracked open and hot oil poured inside.”
“No lie. What’s there to bluff about? Let me tell you, I didn’t even frown when that happened. A man’s gotta remain elegant even in the face of death.”
“That…”
Finally, Sword Without End couldn’t hold back anymore, looking at the Tuberculosis Rabbit who was talking to himself at the table: “I only knew you talk in your sleep; I didn’t know you’d talk daydreams, uh… nonsense during the day.”
“What nonsense and daydreams?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Sword Without End without amusement: “Didn’t I get a prop called Whisper of the Ancient God when I came back from Death Domain? This guy’s been yakking to me about how miserable his past was.”
“I’m just trying to give the guy some advice.”
“Lest he decides to end it all.”
“…”
Sword Without End kept a poker face and kept silent on the spot, no longer speaking, but he added a mental commentary to the scene.
‘Ding, congratulations to the Ancient God for obtaining an SSS-class prop (Tuberculosis Rabbit’s Whisper)’
Time flew by.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
With only three minutes left on the countdown, Chen Yi and his group stood on the rooftop of the Garden District, all silent, not knowing what to say, not a word from anyone.
Chen Yi’s eyes were slightly lowered as he looked at his personal panel, the “Wife-Killing Maniac” Title Effect still unusable, which meant the system determined that he didn’t truly like anyone at the moment.
He had done his best.
He admitted he quite liked Jiaye, but clearly, his feelings weren’t considered love in the eyes of the system.
“Sigh!”
A moment later, he let out a sigh, gazing into the distance calmly as he awaited the imminent enemy forces. He tried his best to prepare himself for the peak condition; what was coming would be a bloody battle!
Meanwhile, Jiaye stood next to Tie Chui with a downcast look, fiddling with the edge of her clothing, her head turned away, not speaking. It was hard for anyone facing immediate death to maintain good spirits.
She was a bit reluctant to part with Yi, her brother.
And even Tuberculosis Rabbit, with his loose tongue, as well as Sword Without End, the taciturn middle-aged man.
These people were all very good.
It’s just… there was no chance to see them again.
Saying goodbye is easy, but wanting to meet again is hard.
Just then—
“Ding, global announcement!”
“The entire God Race from Black Eagle Star has mobilized and initiated a cross-realm pursuit to kill on Blue Star!”
“Targets of the pursuit: Jiaye, Tie Chui.”
“Once the God Race from Black Eagle Star personally accomplishes the assassination of the targets, they will withdraw from Blue Star.”
“The assassination order used by the God Race this time is a B-level Race Assassination Order, and they can stay on Blue Star for up to three months.”
A notification sound simultaneously rang in everyone’s ears.
“Not bad.”
Seeing the mood a bit oppressive, Sword Without End tried to ease it by saying, “The God Race can only stay for up to three months. With Yi’s sled speed, avoiding them for three months shouldn’t be too hard, right?”
“Uh… well, it sounds like there might still be a bit of difficulty.”
“If the rules in August don’t allow flying, then we’re screwed.”
Chen Yi didn’t speak; he just stood at the edge of the roof, leaning on his cane, gazing into the distance. He was pondering another matter: if the God Race could cross realms to his Blue Star, could he cross realms to the God Race’s Black Eagle Star?
It seemed they came over through some kind of Race Assassination Order?
Too bad he had never laid eyes on such a prop.
Before he could think further, he heard another notification around him.
“Global megaphone: I am the God Race Chieftain, Sky Fiend!”
“You lowly beings from the most inferior planet dare to kill my God Race’s Third Master. It’s audacious beyond belief, even using the soul of my God Race’s Third Master to forge a blade so he cannot enter the God Race’s hell.”
“Today, let everyone witness that those who insult the God Race will be punished, no matter how far away they are!”
“If there is a next time, no matter the cost, I will surely exterminate your entire race!”
“Everyone, watch closely.”
Another notification sound suddenly rang out, not just in the ears of everyone on the planet, but in the ears of many more.
“Ding, God Race Chieftain Sky Fiend has activated the A-level prop ‘Heaven’s Eye’.”
“All players may enter the livestream for free and pay to comment!”
As the voice faded,
a prompt appeared in front of all players, asking if they wanted to enter the livestream. Upon entering, what filled their vision were the God Race’s forces, spread across the wilderness as far as the eye could see!
It was unclear on which wasteland!
A glance revealed nothing but endless troops.
These members of the God Race were about 2 meters tall, each one large and wearing uniform crimson armor, carrying heavy weaponry.
A lofty flag in the midst of the army fluttered in the wind, giving the scene an especially bleak aura.
In the livestream at this moment, plenty of messages were flitting by as chat commenced, clearly indicating that many people had entered the room.
Only… there were many they hadn’t heard of before.
“Player Li Taiping”: Yo, it’s just a dead Third Master, right? The God Race really went all out this time, did they bring out the entire army? (IP: White Son Star)
“Player I Love Bai”: This seems to be a power display. Everyone knows the God Race recently failed to level up to Twofold Planet and suffered some heavy losses. They’re being eyed by many planets; probably this is a show of teeth to prevent targeting. It’s a shame for this little Blue Star chick though, being made an example out of. (IP: Bamboo Shoot Star)
“Player Watt”: Blue Star? Looks like they haven’t even passed the newbie tutorial, right? Shouldn’t they still have half a year before they get to try leveling up for the first time? (IP: Walker Star)
“Player Unique Life”: Yeah, seems like they just launched not even four months ago, and there’s still eight months before they finish the newbie tutorial. By the way, let’s see if there’s any noteworthy new talent on Blue Star that could pose a threat to us. (IP: White Son Star)
“Player King Gou”: Give it a rest, folks. Isn’t your White Son Star already preparing to level up to Twofold Planet? Blue Star still has eight months before its first leveling attempt. What threat could they pose to you? Besides, what kind of threatening player could emerge from a planet that’s been open less than four months? Judging by progress, most players are probably weaker than a Minotaur. No offense to Minotaurs, of course. (IP: Number Nine Star)
“Player Li Peiqi”: Yo, isn’t this King Gou? Aren’t you still alive? I thought you died during the last leveling trial on Number Nine Star. Oh right, there’s no need for the folks on Blue Star to worry. Planets that haven’t completed the newbie tutorial have a Newbie Protection Period.
The God Race can only kill their assassination targets; if they kill other players, there are penalties. At most, they’ll kill a few hundred or thousand, not conduct a massacre as he claimed. The God Race can’t afford such a cost right now.
To exterminate a planet still under Newbie Protection Period, even a Twofold Planet couldn’t afford the consequence, let alone the God Race. (IP: Neutron Star.)
Everyone had their say, and the entire livestream room turned incredibly lively.
SEND GIFT
1

chapters.title: Chapter 209: 206: Unless my God Race is wiped out, we will chase you to the ends of the earth!
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 206: Unless my God Race is wiped out, we will chase you to the ends of the earth!
“`
Many Blue Star players, looking at the chat of the big shots in the live broadcasting room, found themselves stunned on the spot.
Through the casual chat of these big shots, a lot of information was revealed.
For example… Blue Star is still in the tutorial, and the Novice Period lasts for a month?
That means until April next year, Blue Star won’t officially leave the Novice Period.
Start the upgrade?
At least through the chat in the live broadcasting room, it can be deduced that there is Onefold Planet and Twofold Planet, just not sure if there is a Threefold Planet.
As for why there are no Blue Star players speaking in the live broadcasting room, the reason is simple.
To speak once costs ten thousand Points.
Those who want to speak don’t have that many Points.
Those who do have don’t want to spend them, and they also don’t want to be the first representing Blue Star to step out, in case they become a target. After all, the chat in the broadcasting room makes it seem like the outside world is very dangerous.
What if someone comes to rob their Points?
…
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit stood silently on the rooftop, lighting a cigarette and bringing it to his lips: “I’ve always said there were aliens, and the netizens on the forum insisted on arguing with me, saying there’s no evidence of aliens so far.”
“The universe is so vast, it wouldn’t be surprising if anything appeared, let alone aliens.”
“Only, I didn’t expect there to be so many aliens, and now everyone’s even chatting together.”
Sword Without End narrowed his eyes and said, “Listening to these people talk, after a year of the Novice Period, everyone will have to work hard for their planet’s upgrade.”
“From the information we’ve gotten so far, there are Onefold Planets and Twofold Planets, and whether there are Threefold or Fourfold Planets is a bit uncertain.”
“And the God Race that came to kill us is from a Onefold Planet that just failed to upgrade to Twofold.”
“Even though they’ve just failed an upgrade, their strength is definitely stronger than ours.”
“So far, it looks like the other planets are not independent, but are based on the same upgrade system, using the same Points and Prop system from the upgrade game.”
“Looking at it this way, the capabilities of this upgrade game are far beyond our imagination.”
They had two guesses in their minds.
One was that only their Blue Star had the upgrade game, and the God Race was simply invading aliens; the other was that the God Race and Blue Star were both in the upgrade game.
But the answer was the second option.
It means the end of the upgrade game is farther-reaching than they had imagined.
And at this moment, the chat in the broadcasting room continued unabated.
‘Player King Gou’: Tsk, I just casually flipped through Blue Star’s launch data and found that the death rate is a bit high. How can the Novice Period have such a high death rate?
Continuing to flip through the several rules that Blue Star has gone through in less than four months since the launch, one of them was actually the S-tier Novice Period rule—Calm and Cool.
Randomly landing on this rule, no wonder the Novice Period death rate is so high. Blue Star really is somewhat unlucky.
(IP: Number Nine Star)
‘Player Li Mo’: Unlucky? Not necessarily. As far as I know, planets that randomize this rule during the Novice Period, as long as they successfully pass the Onefold trial, basically they all make it to at least a Threefold Planet in the end, right?
Those who survive with this rule, with just a bit of training, they’re all valiant soldiers who don’t fear death on the battlefield!
Their psychological quality is maxed out.
Plus, it’s a huge advantage for many map instances.
This time the God Race has provoked the wrong party. Blue Star clearly has the potential to be a future Threefold Planet. If Blue Star seeks revenge one day, the God Race won’t end well.
(IP: Deep Sea Star)
‘Player Sky Fiend’: Heh, no need to worry for me. Do you think I, Sky Fiend, am green and inexperienced? You also said planets that randomize this rule just need to successfully pass the Onefold trial, and in the end, they’ll at least reach a Threefold Planet.
But what you didn’t say is that planets that randomize this rule almost ninety percent fail to make it past the Onefold trial.
The Onefold trial requires numbers the most, and with such a high death rate, it’s simply impossible to clear.
I don’t believe this planet will make it through.
Not every planet can be that lucky.
All I know is that murderers must pay with their lives. Since they dare to kill our God Race’s Third Master, they must pay with their lives. This fight is to the death!
Unless my God Race is extinguished, as long as one of us is still breathing, we will pursue them to the ends of the earth and sea!
(IP: Blue Star)
Sky Fiend was originally the chieftain of the God Race, so his IP should have been Black Eagle Star, but now that he is on Blue Star, his IP has also changed to Blue Star.
That makes sense.
‘Player Li Peiqi’: Really putting on a show, bullying a planet that hasn’t even finished the tutorial, and still acting so high and mighty. You want to hunt us down? Then go ahead, what are you wasting your breath here for?
Besides, your God Race’s Third Master chose to work part-time as an NPC in the map, so whose fault is it if he died?
Are you an idiot?
You can’t even understand the game rules. What are you playing at?
If a grand Third Master of the God Race has fallen to working part-time as an NPC in the map, then stop pretending to be a strong race.
(IP: Neutron Star)
There seem to be a lot of people chatting in the live broadcasting room, but it’s actually just about a dozen people.
Perhaps these are the only dozen who are willing to spend Points to chat. Even for players from Onefold and Twofold Planets, ten thousand Points must not be an easy thing to come by.
…
‘Ding, global broadcast.’
‘I am Yan Niang, President of Blue Star’s Skywake Guild, the people who your race is hunting—Jiaye and Tie Chui—are Chen Yi’s subordinates. This group has committed all kinds of evil deeds on Blue Star, and they killed our former President Zhou Ziqiang of Skywake in a bid to steal Props.’
“`
“Annihilate him!”
“This is retribution!”
“I am willing to provide the exact coordinates of Chen Yi for your race to easily hunt him down and vent the collective frustration of all Blue Star players.”
“Exact coordinates: Yancheng, 7814.12391.21.”
“Chen Yi and Jiaye Tie Chui are both locals of Yancheng. As long as you head to Yancheng and threaten the lives of all its players, Chen Yi and Jiaye will have no choice but to show themselves.”
“I wish you all a triumphant return.”
Once again, a voice resounded in the ears of all players—a global broadcast, a privilege exclusive to the President of a Guild which costs 10,000 Points to use each time.
Currently, only Yan Niang has the authority to utilize this feature.
No one else is qualified.
After sending out this broadcast, Yan Niang leaned back in her office chair with a somewhat satisfied expression, resting her feet on the desk and the corners of her mouth turned up, reveling in a moment of pleasure.
It truly seems like divine assistance! She never expected that killing Chen Yi would be so easy!
Chen Yi should have kept a tighter rein on his subordinates. Now look, he has angered the wrong people—the entire God Race is mobilizing to hunt him down. How can he possibly escape?
Meanwhile, the other Skywake players watched their President’s global broadcast with complicated expressions on their faces.
Although everyone wanted to kill Chen Yi to avenge their old President,
