But… with a foreign enemy at their doorstep, the actions of their President made a certain word come to their minds.
Traitor.
Such despicable behavior is something most people would rather die than engage in.
Even if someone were to do it, they would do so secretly, but to say such things in front of the whole world was truly a loss of face for Skywake.
And sure enough,
Opening the forum, they saw the whole internet lambasting the Skywake Guild.
Just a few days ago, there were many people cursing Chen Yi for abusing his power to kill the former Skywake President and seize treasures, but now the online sentiment had suddenly shifted—all the criticisms were aimed at the Skywake Guild.
No matter how inhumane Chen Yi was, that was still an internal matter of the human race.
But the actions of the Skywake Guild—this was the epitome of a treacherous act. Still harping on “noble race,” even coming up with new vocabulary, all to fawn over a master. You’re sparing no effort.
Providing the enemy with coordinates is, no matter where you are, a vile act.
…
Inside Black Trench City.
A young man sat on the sofa in his house, looking at the broadcast banner in front of him with a furrow of his brows and a flicker of displeasure in his eyes.
The actions of the President of Skywake are truly off-putting.
Although his family had traitors in the last three generations,
But that was out of desperation. Back then, it was either bow down or lose your life on the spot, with no second choice. When a gun barrel is pressed against your head, do you submit or not?
If you don’t submit, they will really shoot.
What could he do?
But if anyone says his grandfather was a traitor, he never once led the enemy to any correct village or base, always leading them in circles, deceiving them.
Bowing down on the spot was to save his wife and children, to later find an opportunity to settle them somewhere safe.
But bringing those curses into a village to let them slaughter at will—such behavior is worse than animals!
He had led the way for Chen Yi twice.
In his heart, Chen Yi was a good person. Not to mention anything else, the people Chen Yi killed on his two visits to Black Trench City were people who always caused trouble. Most importantly, every time Chen Yi asked for his services, he was always given a benefit in return.
In this day and age, people like Chen Yi were hard to come by.
Others with more power than him, when asking him to do a task, wouldn’t think of giving him benefits. If they didn’t beat him up, it was already considered a mercy.
After leading the way for Chen Yi last time, he even added Chen Yi as a friend.
After hesitating for a moment, he still decided to send Chen Yi a message.
“Yi, why not come to Black Trench City and hide out?”
“On the outskirts of Black Trench City, there’s a secret base akin to an abandoned and partially destroyed air-raid shelter that only I know about. I can take you there.”
…
Chen Yi stood on the rooftop, glancing over the new message he received, unable to recall who this person was for a moment. It wasn’t until a bit later that he remembered—it was the Little Traitor who led the way in Black Trench City.
He chuckled lightly and replied,
“No, thanks.”
He then walked down from the rooftop and left the Garden District.
With one hand on his cane, he slowly walked towards the outskirts of the city along the streets.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others followed behind silently, each of them standing tall and straight, showing no signs of fear or timidity.
Along the way, many Yancheng players stood on the side of the road with complex looks on their faces as they watched Chen Yi and his group pass.
Everyone knew.
Where Chen Yi was headed.
With the God Race army soon to arrive, Chen Yi was naturally going to run.
If he didn’t run, was he supposed to just wait for death?
All players in Yancheng recognized Chen Yi, there wasn’t a single player who didn’t know him. Everyone knew Chen Yi lived in the Garden District, and even as his strength grew, he refused to change his residence, still living in this old district.

chapters.title: Chapter 210: 207: "Today is the most exhilarating battle of my life as Sword Without End.
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 207: “Today is the most exhilarating battle of my life as Sword Without End.
He liked to rest on the roof.
He liked to go to a hotpot restaurant to eat hotpot.
Sometimes he would go outside the city to kill Minotaurs.
Most of the time he stayed in the Garden District, and only on rare occasions would he stand guard over Yancheng like the Seal of the Sea God Needle, such as during an Extraterrestrial Invader event.
Yancheng became the first city in the world to completely exterminate the Insect Race.
But… no one is speaking up to ask Chen Yi to stay.
Everyone knows in their hearts that even if Chen Yi stayed, he couldn’t stop it, asking him to stay is just asking him to wait for death.
…
Chen Yi didn’t activate the sled but walked slowly out of Yancheng with Jiaye, his expression calm, leaning on his cane and strolling along the street.
Looking ahead.
His eyes showed no ripples, it was unclear what he was thinking.
More and more Yancheng players, carrying weapons, followed behind Chen Yi—one to see him off on his last journey, the other to defend their homeland.
Most of these people were born here, lived here, and had no intention of dying elsewhere; dying here was the best outcome.
There weren’t enough vehicles.
Nobody could escape.
If escape was impossible, then they might as well kill a few more of the God Race before dying.
If their ancestors could fight for this land with their lives, they could likewise defend it with theirs.
Gradually.
Chen Yi reached the outskirts of Yancheng, with plains stretching out before him and no tall buildings in sight, just a few scattered bungalows.
Not far away was the pyramid map.
It was the first map where Chen Yi shared tips on how to clear it.
And now behind him filled with Yancheng players, each carrying various kinds of weapons.
The chief of the Law Enforcement Bureau, followed by a large group of players, looked at Chen Yi’s retreating figure with complex expressions. No one had anticipated that Chen Yi would rise so quickly, and he had almost become the strongest player in the world.
And such a player was one of their own from Yancheng.
It must be said, this was an honor for Yancheng.
Only, after all, they had provoked someone they shouldn’t have.
Not a single person spoke, and the atmosphere became somewhat oppressive for a moment.
After taking a deep breath, the chief of the Law Enforcement Bureau finally spoke, “Chen Yi, we’ll accompany you this far. Next, we’re going to face those bastard dogs of the God Race.”
“Don’t worry about us, didn’t Li Peiqi in the live broadcast say it? The God Race will be punished for killing other human players besides their target, they can only kill a few hundred or thousand at most.”
“Yancheng has never let its city gates be breached in the face of great enemies, and this time will be no exception.”
“If the God Race wants to kill a few hundred of us, they’ll have to lose thousands.”
“It’s a sure win.”
“When you become stronger in the future, Chen Yi, slaughter more of those God Race bastards and avenge our brothers who die today.”
The players from Yancheng standing behind didn’t say a word, just crowded together en masse. Plainly speaking, those who had survived until now were no cowards.
They might cherish their lives, but when the great battle came, they were not afraid to die.
Chen Yi didn’t respond, but continued standing in place, gazing into the distance across the plain, lost in thought, just standing there leaning on his cane like a pine tree standing between heaven and earth.
Proud, erect, and stubborn.
…
“It’s no use.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out his Claw Knife from inside his clothes, flexing his muscles and bones to prepare for the upcoming battle. He turned his head to Sword Without End and smiled, “So, is this your first time experiencing such a major event? Are you scared?”
“Let’s see who kills more when we meet in hell later.”
“Don’t be too nervous, you have to die twice, after all.”
“After dying once here, those of the God Race will probably chase us down to hell to kill us again, and our second death in hell will be the real one.”
“This is just an appetizer.”
“Is there really no way out?”
Sword Without End looked unwillingly at Chen Yi’s back and said, “If Yi activated that Title Effect, it might change the whole situation completely.”
“Is it really impossible?”
“Here.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit held the Red Moon Claw Knife in his hand and said somewhat helplessly, “Obviously it’s not possible. Although Yi is fond of Jiaye, it hasn’t reached the point of love.”
“I actually saw this ending coming from a mile away, after all expecting someone like Yi to fall in love with a woman… it’s a bit far-fetched.”
“But Yi almost fell in love when he was a child.”
“That was back at the orphanage; Yi and I often lay on the wall of the orphanage, watching the kids outside play with their sandbags.”
“`
“At first, I thought Yi wanted to go out and play with sandbags too, so I egged him on to jump out and join me.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Chen Yi’s retreating figure and saw that Yi had not noticed them, then continued in a hushed, stealthy voice, “But later I realized that during those days, Yi would always be punctually perched on top of the wall, and he was actually there to watch those kids play with sandbags.”
“It was actually every day, punctually, a little girl would appear, carrying a sack to the nearby square to pick up empty bottles. That little girl was filthy with dust all over her face, and for some reason, she never even washed her face.”
“I asked Yi why he was watching that little girl.”
“Yi said he felt sorry for the little girl. While other girls could wear pretty clothes, only this one was dressed in tattered garments that seemed picked from garbage. Every time he saw the girl standing in the park waiting to pick up bottles after people had finished with them, in contrast to the other girls carefreely swinging on the swings, he felt a desire to protect her.”
“That makes sense, doesn’t it?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded helplessly, “Actually, I really wanted to say, Yi, don’t you realize we’re also orphans here? But I didn’t say that at the time. Instead, I suggested we jump down and join her.”
“Yi didn’t say a word.”
“During those days, Yi still believed that his biological parents would come to find him, and he stayed at the orphanage every day, afraid he would miss them if they came looking.”
“So in the following days, Yi would climb up to the wall on time every day, watching the bottle-picking girl.”
“Later, maybe because the girl was too dirty, she upset those boys playing with sandbags. They told the little girl to get lost, and she, being timid, started crying on the spot.”
“The boys dumped all the bottles from the girl’s sack and kicked them around for fun, laughing all the while.”
“Yi and I jumped down immediately.”
“Bang, bang!!”
With some excitement, Tuberculosis Rabbit gestured with his fists, “One punch for each little rascal, had them all crying for their mothers. Later, that little girl didn’t say a word and just ran off.”
“After that, she never came back to our area to pick up bottles again.”
“Yi and I lay on top of the wall every day waiting, but nothing happened. Those boys didn’t come here to play with sandbags anymore, and the girl stopped coming to pick up bottles, leaving only the aunties who still danced in the square.”
“But a week later, there was suddenly a noise saying that a package had been thrown over the wall.”
“We rushed over and snatched the package.”
“Inside was a brand new sandbag and a note with a message in crooked handwriting.”
‘Thanks for last time, this is a sandbag I bought for you with my zan money. It’s new, so you can play with it by yourself and don’t have to watch others.’
“Yeah, the handwriting was quite ugly, and she didn’t know how to write ‘saved,’ just the pinyin.”
“It was sent by that little girl.”
“After that… Yi seemed to have fallen in love, spending most of his time every day on top of the wall, but since then, the girl never showed up again.”
“Until Yi took me away from the orphanage, the girl never appeared again, and eventually, Yi gradually forgot about the incident.”
“But that sandbag and the note are still kept in Yi’s room.”
Then, with some sighs, Tuberculosis Rabbit said, “That was probably Yi’s first love, although it seems it ended before it even started. Feelings during youth are always like a tornado, coming quickly and fleeing just as fast.”
“Originally, Yi only needed to wait for his own parents at the orphanage. Later, he added another wait, for that little girl.”
“And then he left the orphanage without waiting for either.”
“What started as a single sorrow ended up doubling.”
“I always say, women are trouble. Did you see how even such a young girl could have Yi spend his entire days lying on the wall?”
“I wanted to play with the sandbag, but Yi wouldn’t let me.”
“It infuriates me. Aren’t sandbags meant to be played with? Keeping it beside the bed all the time, is it supposed to sprout another sandbag or something?”
“Don’t you think so?”
“If we could find that girl, perhaps Yi could truly fall in love with a woman and thereby activate the Title Effect, solving Jiaye smoothly.”
“But with no information at all, finding someone out of thin air is immensely difficult.”
“That is true.”
With a helpless sigh, Sword Without End slowly drew the Three-Foot Qingfeng from the scabbard on his back, gripping it in his hand, pointing it to the ground, and squinted with ferocity towards the booming noises that had begun not far off.
“If that’s the case, then let’s fight!”
“Three million Sword Immortals in the sky, all must bow low at my sight!”
“Today shall be the most exhilarating battle of my life as Sword Without End.”
The God Race army had already arrived.
They could already hear the thunderous thumping of the massive force running across the ground, and through the live stream, they could see the God Race army rapidly advancing in a certain direction.
Their destination was none other than Yancheng.
Even though it was a march.
Somehow, their pace was incredibly fast, even reaching speeds of hundreds of kilometers per hour, much faster than some vehicles on the highway.
Is this really the speed of an army on foot?
The means was unknown, perhaps some prop or another method.
Chen Yi, standing at the forefront of all players in Yancheng, had been motionless from the start, as if transformed into a statue.
Just then.
Tie Chui, who had been standing beside him lost in thought for a long time, suddenly stammered.
“Tuberculosis Rabbit… bro, the girl you… talked about… seems to be my… sister.”

chapters.title: Chapter 211: 208: At this moment, Sword Without End seemed like a true Sword Immortal.
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 208: At this moment, Sword Without End seemed like a true Sword Immortal.
“What the hell?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was taken aback for a moment before looking incredulously towards the inconspicuous Tie Chui: “Are you sure that dirty little girl carrying a sack is your sister?”
“Don’t joke around.”
“I think… it is.”
Tie Chui scratched his head uncertainly and spoke, “Iron… nail, no, Jiaye used to save money… bought a sandbag… said it was for a friend.”
“Don’t know… if it was Yi.”
“How about… we have a cigarette first?”
“If we die later… we won’t be able to smoke.”
“Smoke your mom’s head.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face tensed as he prepared to go forward and inform Yi of this news.
However—
Just at that moment!
Vast swathes of dark clouds suddenly swept over the skies of Yancheng from afar!
And at the end of the line of sight, an endless god-like army covered the skies, even more numerous than the previous Insect Race attack, with even more of the divine army continuously pouring forth from behind.
It looked extremely oppressive.
And the players standing outside the suburbs of Yancheng, originally prepared to face the battle, couldn’t help but step back at the sight, but they suppressed the fear and didn’t continue retreating. Instead, they took a few bold steps forward while roaring to spur themselves on.
“Huh?”
Chen Yi was about to make a move when he suddenly heard Tuberculosis Rabbit behind him, his face somewhat anxious. He turned to look, and just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to speak with a furrowed brow, Chen Yi’s ears were suddenly assaulted by a myriad of loud noises!
In an instant, blood began to flow from his ears.
‘Ding, the God Race player Sky Fiend has used a C-grade prop on you: Thousand-Mile Ear.’
‘During the effect of this prop, you will have hearing ten times stronger than usual; you will even be able to hear the sound of a leaf falling from a kilometer away clearly.’
‘The prop effect lasts for one minute.’
Noises as loud as thunder pierced his mind like countless needles, causing such pain that he almost lost consciousness. Barely into the encounter, he nearly collapsed.
Chen Yi almost subconsciously activated one of his B-grade props, Forever Pure.
This prop could remove all negative effects from him.
‘Ding, activating this prop can heal the player’s ear injuries, do you wish to continue activation?’
‘No.’
Chen Yi chose to forgo activation, as it would be useless now. Even if his ear injuries were healed, they would just collapse again immediately.
He had intended to remove the effect of Thousand-Mile Ear.
But who knew that Thousand-Mile Ear wasn’t a negative effect, and so the prop Forever Pure couldn’t remove this kind of beneficial effect.
His ears couldn’t hold on for long before they collapsed.
He couldn’t hear any external sounds at all.
At this moment, Sky Fiend was leading the grand army within less than a thousand meters from Chen Yi and others. He sneered once and without uttering any cruel words, he waved the battle flag.
Instantly, the divine army charged straight towards Chen Yi and the others!
A bunch of lowly commoners who hadn’t even finished their Novice Period.
He simply didn’t care.
The biggest goal this time was only one: to show off their fierce fangs to the world so that some wouldn’t get any funny ideas about targeting them, as for why they chose Blue Star.
The reason was simply perfect; otherwise, arbitrarily troubling a planet that hadn’t passed its Novice Period would have been laughable.
But with a valid reason, everything started to make sense.
The reason for targeting a planet that hadn’t passed its Novice Period was primarily because they had failed to ascend to Onefold Planet, and the losses were quite severe. They didn’t dare to provoke a Onefold Planet, so they could only vent their anger and frustration on planets that hadn’t even reached Onefold status.
As the two forces were about to clash.
Chen Yi glanced at the anxious-looking Tuberculosis Rabbit. Though he knew Tuberculosis Rabbit might want to convey some information, he couldn’t hear anything at that moment and there was no time left to ponder over it.
Looking at the tide-like divine army in front of him.
He activated the sled, placing Jiaye on it, and let the sled hover in a relatively safe position mid-air. He then took a deep breath, looked towards the approaching army, and prepared to activate his prop once they moved closer.
The Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom is a group attack prop.
Closer now, only a few dozen meters left!
Chen Yi fiercely activated the Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom; three thousand flowers of the other shore materialized out of thin air around him and shot towards the divine army.
He had used the Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom once before.
That was in Black Trench City.
He had turned an entire gang of dark forces into Floral People, which were still displayed in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s art gallery to this day.
However… this time the effect didn’t seem as he intended.
Just as these flowers of the other shore were about to touch the crimson-armored soldiers not far away, a net suddenly burst forth from the midst of the army, ensnaring all the flowers inside.
Not a single person was hurt or killed.
Chen Yi’s strike was utterly futile, and after using the prop, it would enter a 24h cooldown period. Obviously, there wouldn’t be enough time to wait for the prop’s cooldown to finish.
Just then—
“Die, all of you damn bastards!”
A roar erupted from behind. Tuberculosis Rabbit was seen leaping midair, his hand charging up the Red Moon Claw Knife with nearly 40,000 points of power, and he ferociously cleaved sideways at the God Race army!
As the words ended.
A crimson crescent moon blade beam shot out from the Claw Knife in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s hand, rapidly growing immensely vast midair, stretching over a hundred meters wide!
It was comparable to a soccer field!
Before most people could react, the light beam pierced through the God Race army, causing countless deaths and injuries!
It advanced hundreds of meters before it gradually dissipated!
The once dense God Race army now had a glaring and obvious gap, noticeable as the bald spot on a middle-aged man, hard to overlook.
The ground was littered with fragments of armor and a ghastly mix of crimson blood and flesh!
Having halted the God Race’s advance with this slash, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked anxiously towards Sword Without End: “Yi, something seems off on Yi’s side; he can’t hear us talking.”
“You go protect Yi and buy some time; I’ll type a message to Yi in the chat box,” Sword Without End said seriously.
“Okay.”
Sword Without End nodded earnestly, then checked his inventory for those unique global effects. No longer caring about the cost, he selected his favorite unique global effect.
He took a deep breath and activated it on the spot!
The next second—
Sword Without End was seen forming a sword technique with his hands, standing in his blue robe on the Three-Foot Qingfeng that floated diagonally above Chen Yi’s head, and bellowed with a heavy voice.
“Sword come!”
Following the command, a hole abruptly opened in the black clouds over Yancheng, letting a beam of sunlight through; then the clouds above thicken even more!
Countless light swords, like hail, pierced through the clouds descending from the sky!
One, two!
Until countless light swords rained down from the high skies piercing through the clouds above the God Race army, did the people around feel the awe of the sight.
Each light sword wreaked tremendous death and injury among the God Race soldiers.
At this moment, Sword Without End was like a true Sword Immortal.
With a wave of his hand, heavenly Spirit Swords were summoned to mete out slight punishment.
It was originally just an effect; none of the light swords were supposed to cause damage—it was a unique global effect that was made to look impressive without any other use. However, it had the power to turn the effect into real damage.
The price, though, was steep!
Yet… it wasn’t over.
Sword Without End, standing atop the Three-Foot Qingfeng midair, looked out at the endless God Race army, catching his breath before his eyes bulged. Suddenly, all the sword-like weapons among these God Race soldiers flew into the air, heeding his call!
Once again causing considerable injuries.
It was just a pity that not many of the God Race soldiers used sword-like weapons; the damage was not staggeringly excessive, and his ability could not reach too far.
He couldn’t confiscate all the sword-like weapons from the hands of the God Race soldiers.
The next second—
“Boom!!!”
Nearly a thousand God Race soldiers gathered and thrust a spear towards Sword Without End from afar, and suddenly, several crimson dragons flew from their spearheads, converging in the air into an even larger scarlet giant dragon, rapidly stabbing towards Sword Without End’s chest!
Unable to dodge in time, Sword Without End could only protect his vital parts with the Three-Foot Qingfeng, when the scarlet giant dragon slammed into him full force, making him spew blood from the severe injury as he fell to the ground next to Tuberculosis Rabbit.
By that time, Tuberculosis Rabbit had successfully sent the message to Chen Yi.
With a face full of urgency, he couldn’t help but roar, “Yi, dammit, check your messages!!!”
However, at this moment, Chen Yi couldn’t hear the outside world, nor could he spare a moment to check who sent the message. His area of effect abilities were limited; apart from Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom, he didn’t have many.
At that moment, Chen Yi had already summoned the Frozen Throne!
He was continuously spending points to summon Puppet Warriors, using them to delay the advance of the God Race army.
However, puppets are clearly different from real people.
Obviously, the puppets he summoned were almost routed by the God Race army—after all, they were overwhelmingly outnumbered.
Tie Chui also activated his Malphite little overlord Title Effect, completely abandoning his reason and intelligence, and roared as he charged into the God Race army!
“Earthshattering!”
Tie Chui’s body suddenly swelled in size seemingly activated some skill, exploding to a height of six or seven meters!
His muscles were as hard as rock!
Then, like a small titan among the God Race army, every punch and every stomp brought countless deaths and injuries!
The attacks of the God Race soldiers couldn’t even penetrate Tie Chui’s defenses!
The long spear jabbed at Tie Chui’s leg without even leaving a mark.
His defenses were excessively high.
By this time, the chat in the live streaming room was once again buzzing with comments.
‘Player Li Peiqi’: Sky Fiend is also considered an old player, and he’s quite adept at using these buff effects that can’t be dispelled. He’s just being a bit too cautious—for a player who hasn’t finished the Novice Period, it’s unlikely they have any props to remove negative effects.
(IP: Neutron Star)
In this game, if you have some rare props or skills, you can dispel negative effects.
But there’s also an unwritten rule in this game.
That is, negative effects can be dispelled, but positive effects, whatever the method, cannot be removed.

chapters.title: Chapter 212: 209: This is a funeral made up of roses.
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 209: This is a funeral made up of roses.
This rule was exploited by many players.
Some veteran players would use this to produce effects stronger than debuffs in special situations, and it is a must-learn for every player.
“Player Li Mo”: That sword-wielding player is quite strong, seems to have the ability to turn special effects into actual damage, and to control other players’ weapons. If Blue Star can successfully get through the Novice Period with a trial book, this player deserves more attention, probably a formidable opponent. (IP: Deep Sea Star)
“Player Li Taiping”: I think the player using the Claw Knife isn’t bad either, that attack looks very eye-catching, probably the result of a charged effect, but then the player didn’t make any more moves.
Not sure if they didn’t equip themselves with a set of skills and props that could make a combo.
If there’s only one prop that can charge, no matter how powerful it is, it’s not very useful.
(IP: White Son Star)
“Player I Love Bai”: Didn’t you guys notice the little Titan below? Wow, each punch is powerful, just like their Green Giants.
Seems like there are still several strong players on Blue Star, not like a server that’s been open for less than four months.
It’s just a bit of a pity.
They’ve caught the attention of the God Race.
Although they have potential, they’re still in their seedling stage. Being targeted so early, and they’re coming to extinguish you, it’s definitely hard to escape.
(IP: Bamboo Shoot Star)
In a corner of the universe, Li Peiqi, with her golden wavy long hair, had her feet propped up on a table beside her, surrounded by a pile of plush toys, and was holding a bag of chips in her arms.
She was engrossed in watching the live broadcast.
You could tell.
The chips were tasty, and the live broadcast was very engaging.
The young man in a black suit seemed to be the leader of these people, but he didn’t seem to be showing much strength, his few attacks were all blocked.
None of those Spider Lilies even touched anyone before being confiscated.
The summoned puppets also didn’t look very tough.
Seems a bit underwhelming.
…
Chen Yi, sitting on the Frozen Throne, didn’t come down, but was continuously creating puppets while pulling the trigger of the sniper rifle in his hand, attempting to inflict more damage.
Just then—
The buffs disappeared.
After using a healing prop, his ears healed quickly, and he began to hear sounds from the outside world, brimming with vitality like bamboo shoots after rain.
“Yi!!!”
Having regained his hearing, Chen Yi heard Tuberculosis Rabbit’s anxious roar behind him and instinctively looked back!
And just at that moment—
Sky Fiend, who had been sitting calmly on his horse among the God Race army, chuckled coldly. Turning around in battle, such a move is a major taboo, utterly foolish!
But it must be said, the props in the hands of these people were indeed not weak.
They did indeed cause him some losses, but fortunately, those who were injured or died were just some expendable troops, not a big loss.
He drew his bow and nocked an arrow.
Aiming at Chen Yi’s chest.
The three fingers pinching the arrow suddenly released!
An arrow with a golden tail flame shot through the crowd, aiming straight for Chen Yi’s heart on the left side!
“Whoosh!!!”
As Chen Yi turned his head, even if he tried to look back, it was too late to react, and the arrow was bound to hit!
“Be careful!”
Jiaye, who had been sitting on the sled paying attention to the battle, couldn’t help but change color at the sight and drew a Soft Sword from her sleeve, jumping straight down from the sled!
She positioned herself directly in front of Chen Yi, fearlessly facing the incoming arrow with anger on her face!
With a fierce wave of her hand,
she instantly attracted Tie Chui, who was fighting in the crowd, to her side.
Sky Fiend’s full-force arrow was shot into the chest of Tie Chui!
“Clang!”
Even the sound of metal clashing was heard; Tie Chui looked down at his abdomen in bewilderment and casually pulled out the arrow that had barely penetrated, throwing it aside.
He didn’t even bleed much.
No, that’s wrong; there was a lot of blood lost, which would have been critical for an average person.
But the problem was that Tie Chui was now six or seven meters tall, and the blood lost seemed like nothing more than a mosquito bite in comparison to his whole body!
Seeing she had successfully blocked the attack for Yi,
Jiaye finally breathed a sigh of relief, no longer paying attention to Tie Chui as he continued to rampage through the crowd. She knew her brother was in a state of utter irrationality, unable to comprehend a word she was saying.
She didn’t say much more.
Just drew her Soft Sword, jumped down, and fought alongside the puppets against the God Race army in the crowd!
The war had somehow begun to get chaotic.
Many players from Yancheng had joined the battle.
The death toll was not small.
“Yi, Jiaye is the little girl you used to watch every day on the orphanage wall, the one who picked trash!”
Seeing that Yi had finally regained his hearing,
Tuberculosis Rabbit yelled anxiously!
Damn it, he was so frustrated!
He had shouted himself hoarse, and the message had finally gotten through!
“Jiaye?”
At the mention of that name, Chen Yi was taken aback for a moment, instinctively looking at Jiaye fighting in the crowd, whose blood-soaked figure gradually overlapped in his mind with the girl who used to carry a sack and pick up bottles every day.
His expression gradually became hazy.
He seemed to remember.
A long time ago, he was always waiting for someone.
Waiting for his parents, waiting for a girl.
But he never saw them, and since then, he became extremely impatient with waiting for anyone, even Tuberculosis Rabbit; if he had to wait a little, he would become restless.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: 209: This is a funeral made up of roses. _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 209: This is a funeral made up of roses. _2
Jiaye also heard Tuberculosis Rabbit’s roar at this moment, and similarly turned to Chen Yi with disbelief, “Yi? The two little boys who saved me that day were you and Tuberculosis Rabbit?”
“Yeah.”
Chen Yi’s face, marked with complex emotions, fell silent for a while before he reached out to Jiaye below and said softly, “It was me. Why did you never come back after that day? I left a lot of bottles for you.”
“I…”
Jiaye, grasping Chen Yi’s hand, flew up onto the Frozen Throne, gasping slightly, “Someone bullied me in that area that year, of course I never went back. If I did, I’d just get scolded again, and I’m not stupid.”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit and I would have protected you.”
“Big brother!”
With a grave look, Jiaye covered Chen Yi’s mouth, pointing to the God Race army that darkened the skies, and said word by word, “Have you considered the situation we’re in right now? Can we not talk about these things first?”
“Are we fighting or fleeing? Yi, give me a word first.”
“If we live through this, can we chat about it then, slowly?”
“Hmm…”
After pondering for a moment, Chen Yi finally said, “Aren’t you love-struck? Why are you so lucid now?”
“Because we’re in a battle, big brother!”
“Didn’t you see that guy is about to split Tuberculosis Rabbit in two?”
“Impossible. In my memory, Tuberculosis Rabbit has never died. He won’t have any trouble.”
“Nonsense!”
Jiaye, usually tempered, couldn’t help but burst into laughter, “In your memory, who has ever died, huh? Can anyone just die multiple times?”
“True that.”
Chen Yi nodded, finding it odd why he would say such a thing, as if it had slipped out of his mouth without thought. Reflecting on it carefully, it indeed felt strange.
And the viewers watching the live stream were dumbfounded at this scene.
What are you doing?
Are you flirting?
Do you not see what’s right in front of you? It’s the damn God Race army!
When is flirting not okay, and you choose to flirt now?
“Huff!”
Chen Yi stretched his body slowly, standing on the Frozen Throne. Looking at Jiaye, who was facing away from him, something crossed his mind, and he began to smile, “Back then, did you deliberately pick up the bottles in front of me just to see me? After all, I was quite good-looking back then.”
Standing on the edge of the Frozen Throne, Jiaye held a Soft Sword and gazed at the puppet soon to be overrun by God Race soldiers. Just as she was about to leap down and fill the gap, she heard Chen Yi’s words from behind and turned her head, her expression dripping with sarcasm as she said,
“Big brother… why have you suddenly changed your personality?”
“I was nearly starving to death back then. How could I think about that? It was because there weren’t many bottles in that area, and no one was there to compete with me for business, so that’s why I went.”
“Besides, I was so young back then, why would I think about those things?”
She hesitated for a moment, then smiled with her head tilted, “But you and Tuberculosis Rabbit jumping down from the wall, beating up a group of people – that did look pretty cool.”
“Makes sense.”
Chen Yi nodded, then casually took out a dagger from his coat and stabbed Jiaye in the back.
There was no sign of resistance.
Blood splattered everywhere.
Jiaye, who was just speaking, suddenly staggered and fell into Chen Yi’s arms. A trickle of blood leaked from the corner of her mouth, and her eyes, losing their spark, looked towards Chen Yi and murmured, “Big brother, warn me before you do it next time…”
“Give me some time to prepare mentally.”
“It’s okay.”
Chen Yi kissed Jiaye’s forehead lightly before slowly closing her eyes, “Wait for me in hell for a while. I’ll be there to bring you back up soon.”
“I’m not dead yet. You got the process wrong. You’re supposed to close my eyes after I’m dead.”
“It’s my first time doing this; I’m a bit clumsy.”
“You want there to be a next time, but…”
Jiaye didn’t finish her sentence before Chen Yi stabbed her six more times in the back.
Afterward, he gently placed Jiaye’s body on a sled and turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was already engulfed by the enemy, and muttered an apology, “Sorry, I didn’t mean to stab her more, but you were dying too slowly.”
“If you don’t die soon, Tuberculosis Rabbit will.”
…
And at that moment, the viewers in the stream were stunned.
If they were not mistaken, that girl was the target of the God Race’s pursuit, right?
What’s the meaning of this?
One’s woman can only die by his own hand.
Not by someone else’s?
Overbearing CEO much?!
Officer, the Overbearing CEO trope has been out of vogue for years now, outdated!
And after Jiaye died.
A prompt sounded in Chen Yi’s ear.
“Ding, you have killed the woman you love with your own hands, activating the Title Effect: Wife-Killing Maniac.”
“For the next hour, all your Skills and Props will be without any consumption or cooldown period.”
Chen Yi exhaled deeply.
Wearing a black suit, he stood upright on the Frozen Throne. The rose in his chest pocket was especially conspicuous. Opening his arms and looking at the army of millions, a sliver of coldness flashed in his eyes as he said softly,
“Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom!”
As soon as the words were spoken.
Three thousand Flowers of the Other Shore appeared in the air around Chen Yi and shot towards the army. Sky Fiend chuckled within the ranks, activating a net Prop again to capture the thousands of Flowers of the Other Shore.
His prop had a cooldown period of one hour.
But nobody said he could only have one such prop.
Though he failed miserably in the twofold trial, bullying a Novice Planet was still well within his means.
