After using a healing prop, his ears healed quickly, and he started to hear the sounds of the outside world, filled with vitality like bamboo after a spring rain.
“Yi!”
Chen Yi, having regained his hearing, heard Tuberculosis Rabbit’s anxious roar from behind and instinctively looked back!
And just then—
Sky Fiend, who had been sitting calmly on a horse in the God Race army, sneered, thinking that turning around in a battle was a big taboo, sheer stupidity!
But it had to be said, the Props in the hands of these few people were truly not weak.
They indeed caused him some losses, but fortunately, the dead and injured were just some grunts, not too bad a loss.
With bow drawn and arrow nocked.
He aimed at Chen Yi’s chest.
The three fingers pinching the arrow suddenly released!
An arrow with a gleaming tail streaked through the crowd and shot towards Chen Yi’s heart on his left chest!
“Whoosh!!!”
The arrow was loosed just as Chen Yi turned his head. Even if he turned back now, it was too late to react—the arrow was sure to hit!
“Be careful!”
Jiaye, sitting on a sled and focusing on the battle, couldn’t help but change his expression drastically. Pulling out a Soft Sword from his sleeve, he jumped off the sled right away!
He stood directly in front of Chen Yi, faced the incoming arrow with no fear, his face filled with anger!
With a fierce wave of his hand.
He pulled Tie Chui, who was fighting in the crowd, right next to him.
Sky Fiend’s full-powered arrow ended up striking the chest of Tie Chui!
“Clang!”
There was even the sound of metal colliding, and Tie Chui, somewhat confused, glanced at his abdomen and the arrow that only entered a bit, casually pulled it out, and threw it aside.
He didn’t even bleed much.
“`
SEND GIFT
1

chapters.title: Chapter 215: 209: This is a funeral made up of roses. _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 209: This is a funeral made up of roses. _4
No, actually, a lot of blood had been lost, which would be serious for an average person.
But the problem was that Tie Chui’s height was a full six to seven meters tall, so the amount of blood he lost seemed no more significant than a mosquito bite when looked at in its entirety!
Seeing that he successfully took the hit for Yi.
Jiaye finally breathed a sigh of relief, no longer concerned about Tie Chui as he rampaged through the crowd, she knew that her brother had completely lost his reason in his current state and couldn’t understand a word she was saying.
So she didn’t say much more.
She just drew a Soft Sword and leaped down to join the fray, fighting alongside the puppets against the God Race’s army in the crowd!
The war had somehow become chaotic.
Many of Yancheng’s players had joined the battle.
The casualties were not few.
“Yi, Jiaye is the little girl from the garbage dump that you used to watch every day from the top of the orphanage’s wall!”
Seeing that Yi finally regained his hearing.
Tuberculosis Rabbit shouted anxiously with an urgent expression!
Shit, he was so anxious!
His throat was almost hoarse from shouting but he finally got the message across!
“Jiaye?”
Chen Yi paused when he heard this, subconsciously looking towards Jiaye fighting in the crowd, the blood-soaked Jiaye slowly overlapped in his mind with the little girl who used to carry a sack and pick up bottles every day.
His expression began to grow distant.
He seemed to remember.
A long time ago, he was always waiting.
Waiting for his parents, waiting for a girl.
But he didn’t end up waiting for anyone, and since then, he had become extremely impatient with waiting, even becoming irritated after only a short wait for Tuberculosis Rabbit.
At that moment, Jiaye also heard Tuberculosis Rabbit’s shout, and turned her head towards Chen Yi with disbelief, “Yi? The two boys who saved me that day were you and Tuberculosis Rabbit?”
“Mm.”
Chen Yi fell silent with a complex expression for a while before reaching out his hand towards Jiaye below him and said softly, “It was me, why didn’t you come again after that? I left you a lot of bottles.”
“I…”
Jiaye, pulling on Chen Yi’s hand, flew up to the Frozen Throne, a bit out of breath, “Someone was bullying me in that area back then, of course I stopped going there, right? If I went, I’d only get scolded, I’m not stupid.”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit and I would protect you.”
“Big brother!”
Jiaye, looking serious, covered Chen Yi’s mouth and pointed her hand towards the God Race’s army that covered the sky and ground, word by word, “Have you looked at our surroundings? Can we stop talking about that for now?”
“Whether we fight or run, Yi, give me a word first.”
“After we survive this, can we slowly talk about those things?”
“Um…”
Chen Yi thought for a moment before saying, “Weren’t you romance-brained? Why are you so clear-headed now?”
“Because we’re in battle, big brother!”
“Didn’t you see Tuberculosis Rabbit is about to get killed over there?”
“That’s not happening, in my memory Tuberculosis Rabbit never died, he won’t get into trouble.”
“Nonsense!”
The usually good-tempered Jiaye couldn’t help but feel a bit laughed at by frustration, “In your memory, who has ever died, huh? Can they come back to life several times?”
“True.”
Chen Yi nodded his head, also feeling puzzled about what he had just said, like it had slipped out without thinking. After carefully reviewing it, it did seem quite strange.
And the audience watching the live broadcast was somewhat dumbfounded at this scene.
What are you doing?
Exchanging banter and verbal jabs?
Do you not see what is in front of you? It’s the damn God Race’s army!
When is flirting not good, and you choose to flirt now?
“Huff!”
Chen Yi slowly stretched his body, standing on the Frozen Throne, and looking towards Jiaye who was standing in front of him with her back towards him, he smiled lightly, revealing an upward curve on his lips.
“Back then, did you intentionally pick up bottles in front of me just to see me? After all, I was quite good-looking back then.”
Standing on the edge of the Frozen Throne in front of Chen Yi, Soft Sword in hand, Jiaye was about to jump down to fill the breach as the puppets were about to be overwhelmed by the God Race soldiers. Hearing Chen Yi behind her, she couldn’t help but turn back with an exasperated look and retorted.
“Big brother…how come you suddenly change your personality like that?”
“Back then I was nearly starving to death, how could I have thought about that? It’s because there were fewer bottles in that area, and no one specifically collecting bottles to compete with me, that’s why I went there.”
“Besides, I was so young back then, how could I think about such things.”
She hesitated for a moment but still tilted her head and smiled, “But when you and Tuberculosis Rabbit jumped down from the wall, the two of you fighting a group of people really was quite cool.”
“Makes sense.”
Chen Yi nodded, then casually took out a dagger from his chest and stabbed it into Jiaye’s back.
Without feeling any resistance at all.
Blood splattered in all directions.
Just as he was speaking, Jiaye suddenly slumped into Chen Yi’s arms, a thread of blood leaking from the corner of his mouth, his gaze somewhat scattered as he looked at Chen Yi and murmured, “Big brother, next time before you make a move, say something…”
“Give me some time to mentally prepare.”
“It’s okay.”
Chen Yi bent down, kissed Jiaye’s forehead lightly, and then slowly closed his eyes, “Wait for me in hell for a while, I’ll come to take you up soon.”
“I’m not dead yet, you got the process wrong, you should wait for me to die, and then close my eyes.”
“It’s my first time doing this, I’m a bit unskilled.”
“You still want there to be a next time, but…”
Jiaye hadn’t finished speaking when Chen Yi once again added six stabs to the back of his heart.
He then slowly placed Jiaye’s body onto the sled, turned his head to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit already surrounded, and apologized in a low voice, “Sorry, I didn’t intend to stab you again, but you were dying too slowly.”
“If you don’t die, Tuberculosis Rabbit will.”
…
Meanwhile, the audience in the live broadcast was dumbfounded.
If they weren’t wrong, that girl should be the target of God Race’s manhunt, right?
What does this mean?
Your own woman can only die at your hands.
She must never die at the hands of another?
Overbearing CEO, huh?!
Officer, the overbearing CEO template is an N-year-old product, it’s outdated already!
After Jiaye’s death,
Chen Yi heard a series of notification sounds in his ear.
“Ding, you have personally killed your beloved woman, triggering the Title Effect, Wife-Killing Maniac.”
“For the next hour, all of your Skills, Props will have no consumption or cooldown time.”
Chen Yi exhaled softly.
Standing straight in a black suit atop the Frozen Throne, the rose in his left chest pocket seemed particularly conspicuous. He spread his arms and looked toward the army of millions in front of him, a hint of icy determination flashing in his eyes as he whispered,
“Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom!”
No sooner had he spoken,
Three thousand flowers of the other shore appeared floating around Chen Yi, shooting toward the army ahead. Sky Fiend in the army scoffed, activating his prop net again, gathering the three thousand flowers into it.
This prop of his has a one-hour cooldown.
But no one said he could only have one such prop.
Although he suffered a serious loss in the twofold trial, bullying a Novice Planet was still well within his means.
Even the people in the live broadcast began to discuss when they saw this.
“It looks like this guy is pretty much at the end of his rope, with no tricks left.”
“Seems like it. He even killed his own woman by hand. Is he preparing for a lovers’ suicide, or does he think that he can evade the manhunt by running to the underworld?”
…
Seeing that the three thousand flowers of the other shore had no effect, being gathered up again, Chen Yi was not discouraged. Instead, he grinned and opened his arms wide, roaring once more,
“Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom!”
“See you on the Road to the Underworld!”
The next second—
Three thousand! Thirty thousand! Three hundred thousand!
Three million! Thirty million! Three billion!
Billions of flowers of the other shore descended from above the God Race army’s heads!
More dense than rain, larger than hailstones, faster than snow!
Numerous scarlet flowers of the other shore fell from the sky, turning the whole world into a sea of scarlet as if a blood moon had descended upon the earth!
And it wasn’t over yet!
As Chen Yi’s words fell!
Countless bullets!
Tens of billions of bullets erupted like a volcanic blast, firing from beneath every soldier of the divine armies!!
Every bullet carried the effect of Annihilate Nine Clans!
The world seemed to plunge into the apocalypse in an instant!
A blanket of Skills turned the Yancheng suburbs red in a flash.
Looking up, one couldn’t see the moon, only a bloody sky formed by the scarlet flowers of the other shore!
This was a funeral, composed of roses.
Perhaps, as Tuberculosis Rabbit had said,
There was no chance for a wedding.
But a ghost marriage was a certainty.

chapters.title: Chapter 216: 210: Today is the most glorious day for the Frozen Throne.
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 210: Today is the most glorious day for the Frozen Throne.
The surroundings now truly resembled hell itself.
As far as the eye could see,
there was an endless expanse of mangled flesh and pools of blood, as well as a carpet of flowers from the other shore covering the entire ground.
The whole scene looked like a lot of rose petals had been sprinkled over a slab of unbled minced meat.
All these were the corpses of players from the God Race.
At this moment, the corpses of these players from the God Race were gradually turning into white light, melting into the ground and vanishing, which saved quite a bit of trouble; otherwise, with so many bodies lying around for Yancheng to clean up, it would have been virtually impossible to deal with them all.
The term “littered with corpses” no longer seemed merely a hyperbolic idiom, but had become a reality.
But if all these corpses had been left unattended, the resulting plague would have spread, and the players in Yancheng wouldn’t have survived much longer either.
It was just that things were much easier now.
“However, I have a question,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit propped his chin with one hand and looked solemnly at the corpses that were gradually disappearing as he spoke, “Yi, don’t you remember the first thing they said when they appeared?”
“They said Jiaye had killed their Third Master of the God Race and forged the Third Master’s Divine Soul into a heavy sword, preventing them from reincarnation and entering hell.”
“This means that players from the God Race can also go to hell after they die, right?”
“Logically, all these players from the God Race should have descended into hell by now, right? Why are they directly declared as having been annihilated?”
“Won’t they be restored if they all crawl back out of hell later?”
“Feels like a conflict.”
Sword Without End, who had crawled out from a pile of dead bodies, took off his blood-stained robe and threw it aside carelessly, then put on a brand-new robe before responding.
“Is there a possibility that when the death rate of the players on a planet reaches a certain ratio, the players of that planet lose the qualification to enter hell?”
“Would the players who have previously entered hell also be forcibly eliminated?”
“I’m just speculating, since there isn’t much information, but based on the current situation, my guess doesn’t seem too far off.”
Chen Yi did not reply.
Instead, he quickly glanced through the dense flurry of system prompts; he had more significant matters to attend to.
The no-cooldown buff boost still had 30 minutes to go.
There was a lot he could accomplish in the next 30 minutes.
There was a woman who had reported his location and was waiting for him to deal with her—if he was late, she might have run off who knows where by now, so he needed to act quickly.
First was the special supreme achievement of the third star system, “One Man Exterminates a Clan”.
This was the first time he had heard the word “achievement” from a system announcement, as it was usually about obtaining titles or something similar.
So far, he couldn’t see any particular effect.
Just an extra line of text on his personal panel.
“For annihilating over 95% of a Race’s players single-handedly, you are awarded the special supreme achievement ‘One Man Exterminates a Clan’ of the third star system.”
It had no other effects apart from being a record.
Perhaps it would be of use in the future, but at least for now, he could not see any practical use for it.
Chen Yi shook his head and quickly moved his gaze towards the other system prompts.
There was also a Starry Level supreme title—”One Man Exterminates a Clan!”
Titles are ranked as follows:
“White, Green, Blue, Yellow, Purple, Red, Black, Rainbow.”
This was the first time he had seen a level beyond these, the Starry Level.
And when this title appeared, another slot for titles, the Starry Level, was added to his panel.
Above the Rainbow Level.
It seemed that Starry Level titles should only be obtainable after leaving the planet and reaching the star system, as there was simply no way for players on a planet to earn titles of that caliber; hence it was never mentioned.
Who could have imagined the emergence of unique characters like Chen Yi and the God Race?
Normally, players from other planets would not bother to come to a planet that hadn’t even completed the novice tutorial, not just because of the many restrictions that made them tread lightly, but also due to the lack of worthwhile rewards.
Except for the God Race, this peculiar race chose to come to a novice planet that had been open for less than four months, to showcase their dominance and bare their fangs.
They inadvertently provided Chen Yi with an opportunity to obtain a Starry Level title even while he was still in Newbie Village.
And Chen Yi was another unusual character.
When they dared to come, he really dared to kill them all.
Not only did he slaughter those who came, but he also casually killed those who hadn’t—wiping out the entire clan remotely.
This led to a tacit cooperation between the two parties, whereby Chen Yi obtained a Starry Level title, which would normally be impossible to achieve while still in Newbie Village.
A good actor deserves an extra drumstick for his performance.
The power of a Starry Level title had already surpassed what one would expect from Newbie Village. After all, apart from the Starry Level title, the rarest titles were Rainbow and White.
Yes, White.
Rainbow titles are rare due to their high-level; currently, not a single player from Blue Star, including Chen Yi, has obtained a Rainbow title.
It’s expected that players may only be able to obtain this title towards the end of the Novice Period, perhaps in the eleventh or twelfth month.
Meanwhile, white titles are even rarer, truly because the Title Level is simply too low, so far very few people have seen a white title.
It’s known that any title, even those awarded during mass activities, has a color grade, such as “Lucky Child of the God of Love”; so far, no one has seen a white title.
This is like having a boyfriend over 2 meters tall might be rare, but having a boyfriend 1 meter tall is rarer.
One you kiss standing up, the other you kiss bending down.
‘Title Name’: One Man Exterminates a Clan!
‘Title Level’: Starry.
‘Title Effect’: Alien Race players that die by your hand will not be able to descend to hell and will instead turn into Fierce Ghosts that hover around you, which you can summon to manifest and fight for you. Regardless of the outcome of the battle, they will permanently disappear from the world one hour after being summoned.
The terrifying slaughter imbues you with a strong and glaring aura of killing intent, which is so intense that others can’t even look you in the eye. You can freely choose to withdraw or release this killing intent with no cooldown.
The more the number of undead you hold in your hands, the heavier the killing intent on you becomes.
Each time you kill five million Alien Race players, you can reset an item or Skill and Title, including the reset of cooldown and consumption count (currently can be reset 3 times).
This effect does not consume the number of Fierce Ghosts around you.
‘Title Source’: Destroying over 95% of a Race’s players on a planet single-handedly.
‘PS: Ding, detecting millions of Alien Race player souls that you have killed. They have all turned into Fierce Ghosts surrounding you, invisible to the naked eye when not summoned.’
The title effect is somewhat complicated, but not too difficult to understand.
The ability to reset the consumption count of items is rather useful. Many powerful items or Skills have a limited number of uses; you feel genuine pain each time one is used up.
For example, the Skill “Absolute Purity” has a very buggy effect.
It can cleanse all negative effects on oneself, and even if one is on the brink of death, can resurrect with full health instantly.
But using it is still not as satisfying as the no-cooldown effect brought by “Wife-Killing Demon”. After all, you can only reset the consumption count and not activate it seven or eight hundred times a second like you could in a cooldown state.
If the almighty Heavenly King came, he wouldn’t be able to die either.
After selecting and equipping this title.
Chen Yi’s head now bore a new title, which also had an exceptionally nice design that was clearly a cut above the rest at first glance.
Unlike other red or blue titles that only feature a single color hue.
This title was composed of starry patterns, set against a void-like black base with countless silver-white stars moving continuously over it, flowing like mercury, wrapped in a layer of shimmering light.
It looked particularly dazzling and beautiful.
However, he suddenly recalled something: those God Race players he encountered earlier didn’t have any titles over their heads, meaning there must be a way to hide one’s title?
It’s just that they hadn’t come across it yet.
Chen Yi didn’t ponder too long on it and continued to look towards the system prompt.
His previous red-level title “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!” had been upgraded to a black-level title “Violators, Annihilate the Whole Clan!”
The upgraded effects were entirely different.
The original title effect was that walking with a cane would create a red light circle under foot and activating the title effect would allow for the summoning of a Crimson Frozen Throne, and Points could be spent to summon armored soldiers.
After the upgrade, it was completely different.
‘Title Name’: Violators, Annihilate the Whole Clan!
‘Title Level’: Black.
‘Title Effect’: When you hold a walking stick-class prop, a black shimmering floral pattern light circle with a diameter of 2 meters will emerge under your feet, and a black shimmering Frozen Palace will rise from where you stand.
This Frozen Palace can exist permanently unless you activate the effect at another location, which causes the previous palace to disappear.
This is your very own palace.
The defensive power is strong.
Any prop or Skill below Grade C is unable to affect the palace in the slightest.
Even effects of Grade C props or Skills on the palace will be greatly diminished.
And you can still summon armored soldiers, each summon costing 10 Points, with no time limit if you stay within the palace. As long as the palace exists, the summoned armored soldiers won’t disappear.
But if summoned outside the palace, they can only last for a maximum of one hour.
‘Title Source’: With the red-level title “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!” as a prerequisite, achieving “One Man Exterminates a Clan” allows for the upgrade to the black-level title “Violators, Annihilate the Whole Clan!”
The title effect, one might say, has been completely revised.
Once the title is upgraded, it cannot be reverted, and the original red title can no longer be obtained. This means that his Frozen Throne is no more.
And it will never be again.
Today.
Is the Frozen Throne’s most dazzling day.
Countless players through live broadcasts saw Chen Yi sitting on the Frozen Throne.
With a casual wave of his hand, he watched three billion Roses on the other shore.
The spectacle could not be described as anything less than magnificent.
Many players remembered Chen Yi and also the central image of the Frozen Throne.

chapters.title: Chapter 217: 211: "The buff duration has 19 minutes left, don't waste it.
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 211: “The buff duration has 19 minutes left, don’t waste it.
It’s a pity, though.
Today is the most glorious moment of the Frozen Throne, and also the moment it officially exits the long river of history.
Of course.
In the future, one should still be able to see Chen Yi, sitting on the rooftop of the Frozen Palace.
These are basically all the rewards from this time.
Beyond that, there aren’t any rewards worth paying much attention to.
Oh no, there’s also an A-level random prop chest and 500,000 points.
500,000 points is a lot, but in most cases, it’s not decisive.
For example, although there’s now a player’s store on the personal panel, it only has some basic things like food, fashion, some basic props, and some auxiliary props like set effect map access passes.
The really powerful props won’t be directly sold in the store.
If you want to obtain props that can really change the battlefield, you still need to get them from maps, or when there’s a limited time store for a special event, then you can get quite a few powerful props from there.
But this A-level random prop chest does make him look forward to it, as it will be his first A-level prop chest.
Last time in the Death Domain, he had a chance to get an A-level prop, but in the end, he didn’t get an A-level prop and only got a B-level fashion single item component.
But he did not open this prop chest.
Instead, he leapt onto the snow sled and shot off into the distance, not having much time left; he was preparing to quickly deal with some things and then go to Hell to fetch Jiaye back.
…
“Based on our current speed, it should take roughly 12 minutes,”
Sword Without End looked down at his watch, “this is already with your sled in full activation state, Yi, and it’s not even certain whether Yan Niang is at the Skywake Headquarters.”
“If the other party has escaped, then searching for the person will take more than a moment.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Yi slightly frowned and didn’t say anything more, sitting in the sled and looking at the remaining duration of his cooldown-less buff, 19 minutes left.
Although he is currently in a state without cooldowns.
He… can’t increase his speed.
The speed limit of their vehicle was already reached here; 12 minutes was already quite fast. If they were to drive an ordinary car, it would take at least a few hours on the highway.
However… he did recall something he should do within these 12 minutes.
“I still have 19 minutes left on the buff duration, don’t waste it.”
“Go to the team map.”
Following that, Chen Yi set the sled to auto-cruise, with a simple setting method. He only needed to pat the little reindeer’s head and tell it to keep flying in a certain direction.
The little reindeer was now very obedient and docile towards Chen Yi, for some unknown reason.
Perhaps it’s because Chen Yi feeds it various delicious snacks from time to time.
Or maybe it’s because it has been with Chen Yi for a while and has grown emotionally attached.
Of course.
A more likely possibility might be that just now the little reindeer, while pulling the sled hovering in mid-air, witnessed Chen Yi sitting and observing as three billion Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom killed tens of millions of Alien Race players.
Rebellion? Disobedience? Stubbornness?
No no no, the adorable little reindeer didn’t have any of these, reindeers are always the most obedient.
So, in front of the December boss Santa Claus, who had never seen such docility, the reindeer nodded obligingly like a little cotton-padded jacket, looking especially cute, nothing like the rebellious behavior when it first met Chen Yi.
Obedient to the extreme.
Following that, the sled-pulling little reindeer nodded its head in an unprecedentedly docile manner, strenuously pulling the sled forward at high speed, looking as if it was the sole power source for the sled and not the numerous Nitrogen Injection Cylinders behind its behind.
It seems that the little reindeer also understands workplace savvy.
Work being tough isn’t really tough; it’s letting the boss see you working hard that’s really tough.
…
“Ding, ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ squad has entered the D-level map ‘Desert Scorpion Emperor’.”
“Map Introduction: It is said that there was once a bustling ancient city here, eventually buried beneath the sands of the desert.”
“Beneath the desert lies countless scorpions with deadly poisonous stingers.”
“You need to carefully traverse the desert to reach the endpoint to successfully clear the map.”
“Or you can also clear it by exterminating all the desert scorpions.”
There are many types of team maps, and only some maps can be cleared by eliminating all monsters. Chen Yi specially chose this type of map.
The moment they entered the map.
Chen Yi didn’t waste a word.
“Whoosh!”
Three billion Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom smashed down!
The sandy desert in front of him instantly turned into an oasis-like sea of sand!
Accompanied by countless bullets frantically careening underground.
Three seconds later.
“Ding, congratulations to the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ squad for successfully clearing the D-level map ‘Desert Scorpion Emperor’.”
“Map Evaluation”: In three seconds, you killed all the monsters and even NPCs on this map… starting to check for suspicion of cheating…
…there’s no trace of invasion in the underlying code of the map… no modifications found in the player’s prop skills or titles… evaluation determines no traces of invasion… the numbers are normal and traceable…
The comprehensive judgment is that the players cleared the map through normal means, without any suspicion of cheating. The evaluation continues.
In three seconds, you killed all the monsters and even NPCs on this map… you guys… you guys are awesome!
You’ve obtained a 100% evaluation score for this map.
“Map Reward”:…
Chen Yi and the others didn’t care about the reward at all and immediately left the map to return to the sled. Only when they actually made it back to the sled did they breathe a sigh of relief.
Every time they entered a map, they would return to the place where they’d entered.
But they never understood exactly how this was determined.
For instance, if they entered the map from the sled, the question was whether they would return to the sled or to the exact space from where they accessed the map, which wouldn’t have a sled since it had flown away.
It was like marking a boat to locate a sunken sword.
Now, it seemed the determination was probably made based on objects—leave from a place, return to that place.
“This determination is kind of interesting,” Chen Yi mused. “Later, if we see any player descending into a map, we just need to quickly dig out the ground beneath their feet, stuff it into a safe, and then toss the safe into the sea.”
“I wonder where that player will end up when they return from the map.”
And at that moment—
“Ding, congratulations to the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team for their successful promotion to a level 3 team, the first globally to reach level 3, and you are hereby rewarded…”
Before entering this map, they had already cleared several maps. They just needed to clear one more D-class map to advance to a level 3 team.
Time waits for no one.
Chen Yi didn’t bother checking what the reward was but entered another C-class map instead.
The conditions to advance from a level 3 team to a level 4 team.
The team needed to have two B-class props and clear a C-class map three times while also obtaining a map evaluation score of more than 60% at least once.
B-class props weren’t something they lacked, and as for the map evaluation scores, they didn’t even have to think about it.
As long as they cleared it, the score would definitely be 100%.
Even without a no-cooldown buff, it would be the same, as so far, they were the only level 3 team worldwide. The C-class team maps were all untouched; no one else was competing with them.
The rule for team maps was that the first team to clear the map would surely get a 100% evaluation score; subsequent teams’ evaluations would be based on that first team’s score.
Take the D-class map “Desert Scorpion Emperor” they just cleared, for example. No team had cleared that map before them, so after they did, they secured a 100% evaluation score. Of course, when other teams cleared it later on, they didn’t have to wonder—their scores could only be 1%.
It’s not that they had 1% of Chen Yi’s strength.
It’s that the minimum map evaluation score was… 1%.
1% isn’t your limit; it’s the map’s limit. 100% isn’t his limit; it’s the map’s limit.
It seems like there’s only a 99% difference, but how many zeroes that actually is, perhaps only heaven knows.
Clearing a map in 3 seconds is something not many people can accomplish.
…
Meanwhile, Jiaye was sitting in a café in hell, sipping on a juice and watching a live stream with a smile of happiness and pride unsuspectible in her eyes.
In the live stream.
Chen Yi was sitting on the Frozen Throne, watching the decline and extinction of an entire race with indifference, as if life was of no importance.
That sort of detachment was very alluring.
Other players in the café were also visibly shocked and in disbelief at this scene, even forgetting to breathe.
The atmosphere in the live stream reached a climax with the announcement in the star system.
Then the live feed cut off.
After all, the live stream had been initiated by the God Race leader, Sky Fiend, and with the leader gone, naturally, the stream ended too.
And so.
Jiaye, who patiently waited on her café chair for Chen Yi to come and fetch her, was met with a series of notification sounds.
“Ding, congratulations to the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team on their successful promotion to a level 3 team…”
Jiaye’s smiling lips gradually stiffened.
Yi… After dealing with the God Race, went to clear team maps?
Didn’t anyone remind Chen Yi?
Here someone was waiting for him in hell, wasn’t there?
No matter.
She silently comforted herself, thinking it was probably just an impulse to clear a team map, as Chen Yi couldn’t have possibly left her in hell and just kept clearing maps with Tuberculosis Rabbit and the rest.
Chen Yi cared about her.
The next second—
“Ding, congratulations to the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team for successfully clearing the C-class map ‘Nightmare Tribute’…”
Jiaye’s breathing paused for a moment; then she took a deep breath to comfort herself once more. No big deal, maybe they had just impulsively cleared two team maps. They surely wouldn’t continue to a third, right?
“Ding, congratulations to the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team for successfully clearing the C-class map ‘Bullshit King vs. Thunder Serpent’…”
“Ding, congratulations to the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team for successfully clearing the C-class map ‘Laser Buoyancy’…”
“Ding, congratulations to the ‘Rabbits Do Not Kill’ team for smoothly advancing to a level 4 team, the first globally to achieve this, and are hereby rewarded…”
“…”
Jiaye fell completely silent.
A moment later, she took a sip of her juice from the table and began to search on an online forum.
“What are the signs a man shows before breaking up?”

chapters.title: Chapter 218: 212: Whoever comes will piss their pants!
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 212: Whoever comes will piss their pants!
And at this time,
Chen Yi and his companions had already swiftly passed through 3 C-rank maps; it was already quite rare in the C-rank team maps to find any where clearing all the monsters would lead to map clearance.
They had managed to find three such maps with difficulty.
But upon advancing to level 4, there were basically no B-rank team maps where the condition for map clearance was the annihilation of all monsters, and the conditions for clearing each map sharply increased.
It was not something that could be resolved quickly.
Naturally, there was no time to deal with these issues now.
After consecutive promotions of the team, a number of new functions were added, some of which were indeed very handy, but they were not applicable to the current situation.
And at this time,
The sled had finally arrived at Skywake Headquarters.
“We’ve arrived.”
Sword Without End pointed to the cluster of buildings ahead and said, “This here is the headquarters of Skywake. I’ve told you before, outside of Skywake Headquarters there’s a huge defensive prop. Of course, to Yi in his current condition, that defense is no different from paper mache. We just need…”
“Huh?”
He suddenly stopped mid-sentence, looking somewhat bewilderedly ahead of the buildings and said, “They… seem to have surrendered?”
In front of the buildings,
A mass of people were kneeling on the ground.
The throng was bustling, and the ones kneeling at the front were seven men who were currently tying up a woman and four men, then throwing them to the ground.
Upon the arrival of Chen Yi and his group,
The leading man did not dare to delay and quickly knelt down, his voice trembling as he spoke, “Yi… Brother, listen to our explanation!”
“We were deceived; that wretched woman told us that you grievously injured the old Guild Leader and were about to snatch the Guild Creation Order from him, and she was appointed as the Guild Leader by him in his dying breath. That’s why we acknowledged that wretched woman as our Guild Leader.”
“But today, after watching the livestream, we instantly understood that with Brother Yi’s strength, if you had struck the old Guild Leader, how could he have been grievously injured and escaped back here? There’s no way he could have left last words in a grievous injury!”
“Thus, we, the other members of Skywake, instantly seized control of that wretched woman and awaited your arrival to hand her over for you to deal with. It was then this woman confessed the old Guild Leader was killed by her and she colluded with five other Skywake members.”
“Everyone’s here.”
“After this woman said those words, we immediately took control of her. Although we previously thought the old Guild Leader was killed by you and were preparing to move against you, we definitely never thought of leaking your location to Alien Race players.”
“Such behavior is too heinous, no different from traitors.”
“It’s just too much!”
“Even though we may have had some minor disputes, we should distinguish right from wrong in major matters!”
“How could we report your coordinates to Alien Race players!”
“If possible, Brother Yi, please spare the lives of the other brothers of Skywake; they really didn’t know anything. I’m willing to lay down my life as atonement for my brothers; they all gathered together after the apocalypse, none have committed any vile deed too horrendous. They are guilty, yes, but truly their crimes do not warrant death, Brother Yi.”
Chen Yi’s performance in the livestream today had thoroughly awakened all of Skywake’s or Blue Star’s players.
Black Eagle Star, God Race.
A Onefold Planet.
Although their advancement to a Twofold had failed and they were greatly weakened, it was still truly a Onefold Planet.
Far stronger than Blue Star, which had yet to leave Newbie Village.
And yet, a Race from such a planet was completely annihilated by Chen Yi alone—it took less than about half an hour from start to finish.
If someone had claimed before this that Chen Yi was the world’s top player, many would have been skeptical.
But from now on, there would be no dissenting voices.
There was no room for dissent.
To dissent, you would need to put someone up for comparison with Chen Yi.
Yet on the forums today, those few people who used to be compared to Chen Yi were posting openly, saying that if that bastard dared claim to be stronger than Chen Yi, they would hunt him down and end him!
“Your goddamn bragging is just bragging; don’t drag us into your bullshit!”
They were afraid, too.
Because, if Chen Yi became fixated on them, they would die unjustly—it had nothing to do with them; it was all due to fans dragging them into boasting.
And Skywake, although the first power to create a Guild in the world, was afraid, too.
After the man finished speaking,
Chen Yi didn’t respond, but walked with his cane straight over to Yan Niang, who was tied up and thrown on the ground. He squatted down, his expression calm as he pinched the woman’s chin in front of him, staring into her eyes in silence for a while before then speaking softly,
“Do you know? I hate those who play dirty tricks behind others’ backs the most.”
“If you could really bring the Skywake members to face me head-on, maybe I would’ve thought higher of you.”
“Heh.”
Knowing there was no hope for survival, Yan Niang let out a bitter laugh before she stared at Chen Yi, her voice hoarse as she asked, “Tell me, where did I go wrong?”
“From beginning to end, I did nothing wrong. Even if I did, it was for killing my brother-in-law that I was wrong, not anything to you.”
“We’re adversaries; what’s wrong with me revealing your location to the Alien Race?”
“It’s merely that I’ve lost now. As the victor, do you want me to admit my mistake? Am I wrong? My only mistake is that I have lost!”
“Ridiculous!”
“Pah!”
“Kill or slaughter as you please; why the pretense of a saint?!”
Chen Yi nodded, said nothing more, and slowly stood up, pressing down the head of Yan Niang, who lay on the ground, under his foot.
“You seem like a reasonable woman. It’s just in your eyes you’re all in the right.”
“`
“Foolish.”
Without wasting another word, his right foot struck with ferocious strength.
“Boom!”
Yan Niang’s head burst open like a watermelon, instantly shattering!
The white brain matter and crimson blood mixed together, like a cheese-filled strawberry candy exploding in the mouth.
After doing all this, Chen Yi slowly lifted his head to look at the crowd before him and said softly,
“Do I have a grudge against any of you?”
“Uh…”
The man who had just spoken in plea for the other Skywake players, hearing this, quickly shook his head vehemently: “No grudge, not at all!”
“I never thought I had any grievances with Skywake, moreover, your former guild leader Zhou Ziqiang once helped me. We even had a bit of a connection.”
“But for some reason, you seem to think you have a great grievance against me.”
“Tell me, should I exterminate you all to remove the weed, or should I spare you?”
Upon hearing this,
The man standing in the front row of the Skywake group turned pale and knelt down, kowtowing several times: “It’s all that damn woman’s fault, that damn woman had a vendetta against you, Yi, and she dragged the entire Skywake down with her.”
“Yi, as long as you let the brothers off the hook,”
“wherever you say to fight next time, we will do so without the blink of an eye.”
Chen Yi, staring at nearly a hundred players kneeling before him, fell silent for a while before continuing, “You all saw today’s live broadcast, we are now in Newbie Village.”
“It will be another 8 months before we leave Newbie Village and enter the real contest.”
“Sparing your lives is not entirely impossible.”
“But you need a new guild leader.”
“Go to Black Trench City, find someone…”
He suddenly paused, realizing that he didn’t know the name of that person, and after a moment continued, “Go find a man called Little Traitor, he is my man, and from now on, he will be your guild leader.”
“How to proceed, I need not say.”
“Don’t even think about any tricks. If he dies, for any reason, all of you will join him in burial.”
Having said that,
Chen Yi did not speak again but turned and stepped onto the sled.
He still had to pick up Jiaye from hell.
He was quite busy.
Before boarding the sled, Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out the Claw Knife from his bosom and casually slaughtered the few men tied up on the ground, all of whom had participated in the poisoning of the old guild leader.
Only then did he glare fiercely at the remaining members of Skywake and hurriedly follow Yi onto the sled.
Chen Yi maneuvered the sled towards the distant Wasteland, preparing to check out hell.
He didn’t kill the remaining members of Skywake.
On one hand, he really had no great grudge against them. It seemed unreasonable to kill people for no reason; the gravest grievance he had was solely with Yan Niang from beginning to end. The old guild leader of Skywake even had a bit of camaraderie with him and couldn’t be considered to have a deep-seated hatred.
On the other hand, Skywake members were indeed among the stronger players globally. If all of these people died,
there would be a significant void among Blue Star’s top individual fighters.
In the future trials of ascending Onefold Planet, or stepping into the Star System to compete with players of the Alien Race, these individuals were needed as vanguard forces.
Dying at the hands of one’s own would be regrettable.
And a waste.
Better to implant one of his own to keep a better check on this power.
He didn’t really know many people anyway.
The Little Traitor in Black Trench City was one.
Although he didn’t know his name.
But someone who was brave enough to suggest he seek refuge in Black Trench City while being surrounded by the God Race’s army was someone with a sense of loyalty. He was bestowing a chance upon him.
Whether he had the ability to manage a guild was now up to Little Traitor’s skills.
Often, when given the opportunity, whether one could seize it depended on their usual accumulation.
…
“Phew!”
After Chen Yi and the others left, the man who had knelt in the forefront slowly got up, looking at the six or seven corpses before him, his legs somewhat weak. Remembering how he had just scampered at the threshold of death, he angrily charged forward.
He kicked Yan Niang’s abdomen forcefully!
“You bitch, the old guild leader was so good to you, and yet you could still bring yourself to do such a thing!”
“Beast!”
“And you nearly dragged all of Skywake down with you!”
The other Skywake members behind the man were also sweating profusely; many of them only realized that they had lost control of their bladders once they got up. It wasn’t that they were cowards, but anyone who had watched the broadcast could understand what they had just been through.
It was as if you were watching a horror movie and suddenly found out that the big boss from inside it had come to your house for a cup of tea.
Wouldn’t you wet yourself?
Anyone would fucking wet themselves!
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 219: 213: "If nothing unexpected happens, no one should dare to wander around Blue Star without reason anymore.
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 213: “If nothing unexpected happens, no one should dare to wander around Blue Star without reason anymore.
At this moment, other members of Skywake were also glaring angrily at the corpse of Yan Niang.
The more they thought about it, the more suffocated they felt, so they all rushed up and started furiously kicking away!
Because of this bitch’s global announcement, not only did they almost die at the hands of Chen Yi, but Skywake’s reputation was utterly ruined!
By now, the curses against Skywake on online forums were overwhelming!
They even dragged out the ancestors of Skywake’s members eighteen generations back!
Every dirty word involving reproductive organs and family members kept being heaped on the heads of Skywake.
They were truly aggrieved and could not voice their suffering.
How could they say it was the guild leader who said those things, that they did not think this way, that the guild leader didn’t discuss it with them before making the global announcement?
Impossible.
A guild leader represents the entire image of the guild, which is inseparable.
Just like how a legal person slandering a competitor online and then the company claiming ignorance is the same.
That’s just bullshitting.
But the most important thing now was to first go to Black Trench City and bring back their new guild leader, who was a candidate designated by Chen Yi, so naturally no one dared to object.
“It’s just…”
The man who had been leading the group hesitated for a moment before speaking up, “Little Traitor… what kind of name is that?”
“Forget it, let’s head to Black Trench City first. It should be some sort of famous alias or something.”
“It shouldn’t be too hard to find.”
“Hurry up, everyone, don’t delay for too long. We don’t want Yi to think we have other intentions.”
And so—
For the first time since Skywake was established, all its members mobilized!
They headed straight for Black Trench City!
Their goal, to bring back their new guild leader, codenamed Little Traitor.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi and his group were already standing on a vast wasteland, beginning to prepare… for a grand suicide event.
“You guys are going down too, Yi?”
Sword Without End looked at Chen Yi and his friends in surprise, “Actually, if it’s just Jiaye alone, I think I could bring him back by myself. It would only take ten days to half a month.”
“No need.”
Chen Yi shook his head, “Everyone’s been working hard these past few days. It’s time for a team-building exercise.”
“Consider it team-building in hell. Stay down there for a few more days and relax.”
“Oh…”
Sword Without End responded with a strange expression and said no more. The selection of the site for team-building was quite the choice, just like one his former bosses.
He had a boss once who chose a farm stay for a team-building session.
The activity was to simulate work.
So, they ended up working an extra day at the farm stay just like in the office.
“Then I’ll go down first.”
Sword Without End didn’t dawdle any longer, instantly pulling out an umbrella to hold over his head and lighting up several cigarettes at once from his bosom.
He didn’t even get a few puffs in.
Before he suddenly stiffened and fell heavily to the ground.
Breaking the rules of July, he died on the spot!
“Finally dead!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing nearby with an excited face, rushed up and hoisted the corpse of Sword Without End onto his shoulder, ready to place it in his art gallery in Yancheng on the sled, but when he saw the look in Chen Yi’s eyes, he suddenly came to his senses and sheepishly placed the body back on the ground, saying, “Sorry, I forgot.”
“No problem, carry on, carry on.”
“You go first, Tie Chui.”
Chen Yi turned his head to look at Tie Chui standing to the side.
“Alright.”
Tie Chui nodded solemnly, then without any hesitation, lifted his football-sized fist and smashed it down on his own head!
“Bang!”
With a thunderous sound, Tie Chui’s head was smashed right into his chest.
He looked just like Xing Tian.
Though he died instantly, his body stood unwavering on the spot.
“Wouldn’t choosing a painless way to die be better?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, taken aback, looked questioningly at the now deceased Tie Chui.
Then he glanced around before asking, “Yi, there’s an issue.”
“After we go inside, who will look after our bodies?”
“Although our revival won’t be affected even if the bodies are damaged, it’s still a bit irritating.”
Chen Yi did not speak, only silently activated the black title “Violators, exterminate the clan!” title effect.
The next second—
A colossal luxurious palace, covering an area as big as an entire soccer field, emerged abruptly on the wasteland!
The structure was a glimmering black, accented with crimson.
The material looked icy, yet had a hint of metallic gloss.
“Let’s go inside.”
Chen Yi slowly walked through the main entrance, placed the bodies of Tie Chui, Sword Without End, and the others from the sled in the courtyard, and set Jiaye’s body in a single room with a complete bed set.
He then summoned a thousand heavily armored soldiers to stand guard in every corner of the palace.
Although these soldiers lacked sentience and could not think for themselves, their presence seemed to instantly add a bit of life to the place.
After all this was done.
Chen Yi didn’t dally any longer, and walked into a room, lighting several cigarettes in a row before collapsing onto the bed.
“Mmm-hmm.”
Seeing Yi had left with such flair, Tuberculosis Rabbit also hurried into the room and, following suit, lit a few cigarettes and then sprawled out on the floor.
…
“Everyone’s here, huh.”
In the depths of hell, standing on a street corner, Sword Without End looked towards Chen Yi and the others beside him, and like a seasoned host, began to explain, “Let me introduce you to the basic rules of hell.”
“The map of hell roughly corresponds to the map of Blue Star.”
“Because we died in the same area, we also appear in the same area in hell. There’s no set spawn point or anything like that; we just randomly appear on the streets.”
“Then, most of the players on the streets are from Blue Star, with a minority being…ghosts.”
“They are a special product of hell.”
“Do you see the shops on both sides of the street?”
“In hell, most shops don’t allow fighting or causing trouble. Of course, there’s no such restriction on the street, so many Hell Players like to refer to the shops on both sides of the street as safe zones.”
“In hell, the monthly rules still apply, but as you can see, the count for the July rules has been reset.”
“You must never die in hell because if you do, you’ll be truly dead, beyond the reach of even the gods to bring back.”
“Jiaye died in Yancheng, so if we want to find Jiaye, we’ll need to fly in that direction.”
“The city corresponding to Yancheng in hell is called Jiumen City.”
“Got it.”
Chen Yi nodded, reached into his sleeve, and handed a small notebook to Sword Without End, “Then let’s go our separate ways for now. Please handle the names on this list as soon as possible.”
“And Yan Niang and the Skywake members are also nearby; take care of them quickly.”
“We’ll meet up in Jiumen City.”
Sword Without End, who was enthusiastically introducing Chen Yi to the novelties of hell, gazed at the notebook that suddenly appeared in his hands, standing there somewhat puzzled, and before he could say much else, he saw Chen Yi and the others already on a sleigh, disappearing into the distance.
“…”
After a long, expressionless silence, he let out a sigh, “Really now.”
“You and my previous boss are hardly different.”
“The previous boss made me work overtime at the farm stay; you make me work overtime in hell, all under the guise of team-building.”
“It’s infuriating.”
“What happened to team-building?”
Without dwelling on it, he glanced at the list in the notebook and decided to first go find Yan Niang nearby.
…
Chen Yi, leaning on his cane, stood outside a coffee shop, looking through the glass at the girl sitting by the window and suddenly chuckled quietly without speaking.
After the Squad Level upgraded, a new function was added.
The captain could now know the real-time locations of the team members.
Finding Jiaye was not a difficult task for him.
At this moment, Jiaye sat in the café, propping her head with one hand and stirring the juice in her hand, seemingly also searching for something on a webpage.
Chen Yi’s curiosity was piqued, so he walked up to the glass wall, wanting to see what Jiaye was looking at.
But when he saw it clearly, the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
‘How to win back a man’s heart when he no longer loves you?’
“…”
Indeed, women mostly think about three things most of the time.
The first thing, what to wear today? How come there’s nothing to wear again.
The second thing, what to eat today? How come I feel like I’ve gained weight recently.
The third thing, where’s my boyfriend? Has he stopped loving me again?
After a slight twitch of his mouth, Chen Yi no longer watched through the window. He stepped into the coffee shop and sat across from Jiaye, apologizing as he began, “Does it hurt?”
“What do you think?”
Seeing Yi suddenly appear before her, Jiaye’s eyes showed a flash of joy, then a touch of reproach, “That thing was so big, so sharp, and it went right into my body, how could it not hurt?”
“My fault. Next time I’ll get you an anesthetic.”
“Local anesthesia?”
“General anesthesia.”
“Oh.”
Jiaye first nodded, then with a hint of guilt, looked at Chen Yi, “Yi, I’m sorry for troubling you this time. I didn’t expect that just killing an NPC in the game would get me chased by a whole clan.”
“No worries.”
After Chen Yi signaled to the waiter to bring a cup of hot water, he continued, “If all goes well, from now on, no one should dare to roam around Blue Star so casually.”
“At least not without such a big fuss.”
“How does it feel in hell?”
“Well…”
After thinking for a while, Jiaye began, “It doesn’t feel much different from Blue Star. There are modern cities, even more modern than Blue Star in some ways, since many things have stopped there.”
“It’s just that the air is always hazy, and it’s a blood-red color.”
“It looks kind of uncomfortable.”
“Other than that, I haven’t felt much else. There are quite a few players here, but it seems that few want to go back to Blue Star; they’ve already settled in hell or are planning to.”
Just then, Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui also walked into the shop, carrying a KFC chicken bucket.
“Yi, you might not believe it, but there’s a KFC in this city. Apparently, the KFC owner came down here and went back to his old trade straight away, planning to open this chain in all the cities in hell.”
“I asked the owner why he doesn’t think about going back.”
“Do you know what the owner said?”
“The owner said, there are definitely more dead players than living ones, and dying in Blue Star is much easier than the difficulty of going from hell back to Blue Star.”

chapters.title: Chapter 220: 214: "Are all those cancelled accounts from Black Trench City?
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 214: “Are all those cancelled accounts from Black Trench City?
“This means that Hell is an incremental market, with a constantly increasing population.”
“Whereas Blue Star is a stock market, with a constantly shrinking population.”
“From an economic standpoint, the profit of opening a store in Hell is greater than the profit of opening one on Blue Star.”
“The boss said that after he has expanded his industry all over Hell, he’ll find a professional manager to take over, then he’ll return to Blue Star and occasionally come back to collect money.”
“Earn money in Hell, spend it on Blue Star.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit casually threw a chicken nugget into his mouth and muttered, “You say all these people behave the same way, it used to be that many people would earn money domestically and spend it abroad.”
“Alright.”
Chen Yi didn’t pick up Tuberculosis Rabbit’s thread, but instead, seeing that everyone had gathered, stretched out his hand and said, “Since everyone is here, let’s get ready to depart. Everyone has worked hard recently, so let’s have a team building event.”
“Let’s discuss where we all want to go.”
“The desert.”
Jiaye placed his hand on top of Chen Yi’s, his eyes filled with anticipation as he spoke, “I want to ride desert motorcycles.”
“I want to see the ocean.”
Tie Chui put his hand on Jiaye’s, his voice buzzing, “Tuberculosis Rabbit hasn’t taken me to the seaside to feel the taste of the sea breeze for … a long time.”
“What’s this about sea breezes?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was initially a bit confused, suddenly caught on and looked at Tie Chui with a somewhat odd expression, “I say Tie Chui, aren’t you naturally brain-damaged with poor intelligence? How can you say such a euphemistic thing?”
“Since you’ve said it, brother, I must take you there in these next few days!”
“Thanks … thank you, Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
“No need to thank me, we’re brothers.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit added his hand on top of Tie Chui’s and looked up at Chen Yi, “I also want to go to the desert, but I want to dig a huge swimming pool in the middle of the desert, the size of half a soccer field, filled with freshwater, and then jump in and swim.”
“A desert swimming pool?”
Jiaye voiced his doubts, “Is it possible to find a desert in Hell to build such a big freshwater pool? And isn’t the cost a bit too high? It feels like …”
Before he could finish,
Chen Yi spoke up with a smile on his face, “A desert swimming pool, arranged!”
“Then this team building event will be the desert swimming pool!”
“Unanimously approved!”
“Hehe.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit rubbed his hands together with a face full of excitement and anticipation, smiling, “But, won’t it be too extravagant?”
“Money is no object!”
Chen Yi gestured grandly and stood up to go outside, ready to look for a desert spot on the outskirts of the city.
“I want another thing.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit hurriedly stood and followed, “I also want a water slide over ten meters high, one that goes directly into the pool.”
“No problem.”
“I also want some of those little ducks that can float on the water.”
“Sure.”
“After swimming, let’s do some barbecue in the desert. What do you think, Yi?”
“I think it’s a great idea.”
“How about we add some entertainment equipment? Mahjong tables, swim rings, beach volleyball, things like that?”
“If we’re team building, we should have fun, so of course we’ll need those.”
The two chattered on, each speaking in turn as they walked away until, after a while, Tuberculosis Rabbit came back, poking his head into the cafe with a puzzled look at Jiaye and Tie Chui, “Why didn’t you two follow?”
“…”
Jiaye took a deep breath, patted his chest to catch his breath, and then managed to squeeze out a smile as he followed, “I spaced out for a moment, coming now.”
Only, his hand secretly pinched the corner of his clothes.
The enemy is right beside me.
Damn it, she refused to believe it, with her chest this big, could she really not attract the same attention as Tuberculosis Rabbit, to be liked by others?
…
Over Black Trench City.
Nearly a hundred members of Skywake hung in the air above Black Trench City, their faces cold as ice!
There was a group Prop that allowed each of them to have the ability to fly at low altitudes for a period of time.
The nearly hundred members of Skywake hovering above Black Trench City were extremely conspicuous, and the identities of these people were recognized by the players below almost immediately.
That uniform attire, as well as that uniform title.
At a glance, one could tell that these people were all from the “Skywake” Guild.
Each had several titles above their heads, but there was one title that every one of them had.
“Skywake Elder!”
At the moment these people appeared.
Almost half of the population of Black Trench City was doing the same thing!
…
“Quick, quick, quick, delete all the posts you’ve made!!!”
“Skywake is at our doorstep, damn it, delete everything fast, if you’re slow we’re both dead!”
“Cancel all the accounts, hurry!!”
“Hold on, I’m already cancelling them, but I registered too many accounts, I might not make it in time!”
“First, just fucking delete all the posts!”
“Later, just deny everything stoutly, if asked, just play dumb, you didn’t know anything, you didn’t do anything!”
“Don’t worry, bros understand, there have been over a dozen waves of people coming to Black Trench City seeking revenge, they know the drill.”
There were no visible reactions on the surface of Black Trench City, but nearly half of the people were unanimously doing one thing—rushing into their homes to delete all of their online posts!
And that Little Traitor who had once shown Chen Yi the way had a look of urgency as he rapidly deleted his posts!
“Discussing the entire Skywake membership, when will they all drop dead?”
“Isn’t it like betraying the human race, joining a Guild like this willingly, aren’t they just beasts?”
“Some say I’m jealous? I laugh, in my whole life, even if I starve to death, I would never join Skywake!”
“Yes, Skywake doesn’t appreciate my strength, but do you think I can admire a Guild that’s like a traitor?”
“Where are the people from Skywake? Come out for a talk, or are you just cowering in your mom’s trousers playing grandson?”
“…”
He had posted dozens of similar posts!
Now, he was deleting posts with a speed he had never experienced since leaving his mother’s womb!
He was undoubtedly the person in Black Trench City who realized the severity of the situation the most!
He had guided Chen Yi twice!
Both times were when someone had verbally attacked Chen Yi online, and Chen Yi had found them!
He knew all too well why Skywake had appeared here.
Though everyone was having a blast slinging insults online, in a real face-to-face encounter, Skywake members could beat them like they were children with barely any difference.
He just didn’t expect that, although he had claimed to be from Qilin City when he insulted people, they could still find him in Black Trench City?
…
Meanwhile, Wang Qiang, levitating above Black Trench City, frowned as he pondered how he might find that Little Traitor mentioned by Yi.
Just then.
A member behind him, who had been paying close attention to Skywake’s online reputation, suddenly expressed surprise, “Hey? Just now, many posts that were insulting us got deleted, and those accounts that had been constantly bashing us were cancelled.”
“The online noise has died down a lot.”
“It’s gotten much quieter all of a sudden.”
“Hmm?”
Wang Qiang suddenly realized something and scanned Black Trench City: “Were those cancelled accounts all from Black Trench City?”
“No, not one. ”
“Those accounts had all revealed their identities at some point; the rest are from Qilin City, Seven-Mile City, and all sorts of other places, each city has them. There are even some claiming to be from villages.”

chapters.title: Chapter 221: 215: "We Have a Big Prize for You.
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 215: “We Have a Big Prize for You.
Meanwhile, deep in Hell.
In the midst of a vast desert, countless players were operating all kinds of excavator machines or using various props and different skills to dig holes in the middle of the desert.
Digging holes in the desert wasn’t an easy task.
Sand is fluid.
To make a pit stable required a certain level of technical skill, something he didn’t understand.
But it didn’t matter, others understood, and as long as Points were thrown out, plenty of knowledgeable people would come to tell us how to do it.
Chen Yi was lounging on a beach chair, hands behind his head, watching Jiaye speed by on a sand motorcycle not far away with a light laugh, not speaking. He guessed that everything would be set up in half a day.
He could stay here permanently.
In the future, he might come here for team building when there was nothing else to do.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was playing beach volleyball with Tie Chui nearby, their feet bare against the scorching sand, thoroughly enjoying themselves.
After taking a sip of juice from the table beside him, Chen Yi didn’t join them, instead continued lying in the beach chair, watching the scene unfold before him.
It was as if he were an elderly person who, with the advent of twilight, would lie in a bamboo chair in front of his house, happily watching over the grandchildren playing at the doorstep under the faintly dim light overhead and the slightly lulling sound of cicadas.
At that moment—
“Ding.”
He received a message from Sword Without End.
After a cursory glance, his brows furrowed in thought.
“Yi, I’ve found Yan Niang, but… Yan Niang has been taken in by the old president of Skywake, Zhou Ziqiang. Zhou won’t let us kill her.”
“What should we do now?”
“I can’t handle them both if we kill together.”
“Wait for me.”
Chen Yi glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others playing, didn’t say goodbye, activated his sleigh, and shot towards Sword Without End’s location.
A few minutes later.
He stepped off the sleigh and looked at Sword Without End, who was waiting on the side. A shadow crossed his eyes, “Where is the person?”
“I want to see what’s going on in Zhou Ziqiang’s head.”
“After all that woman has done, joining with other men to poison you, and he still wants to protect her?”
“Is it really about love above all else?”
“Keep protecting her, and we’ll kill them together. There’s no way I can let this woman have a chance to return to Blue Star and backstab me at a crucial moment, even though it’s not a serious harm, it’s quite disgusting.”
“Hmm…”
Sword Without End pointed hesitantly to Zhou Ziqiang, who was busy not far away, “There!”
Zhou Ziqiang was seen standing in front of a shop on the street, wearing a red robe and currently decorating with red streamers the street lamp in front of him, looking as if he was opening a new store.
“You must be Chen Yi.”
Seeing Chen Yi, a touch of emotion appeared in Zhou Ziqiang’s eyes as he came over and stood in front of Chen Yi, “We’ve had some dealings before, right? Although there have been some grudges, I never thought it would be you who would avenge me.”
“I’ve heard a lot about you.”
“I saw your fight with the God Race, insanely powerful.”
“You look outstanding, no wonder you handle matters so properly.”
“Although I’m a bit older than you, I always respect the strong, so I’ll take the liberty of calling you Yi. You can just call me Xiaoqiang.”
“…”
Chen Yi’s eyelids drooped slightly, swallowing down some of the words he had been ready to say. It’s said that one should not strike a smiling face, and since the other side kept flattering him, it would be somewhat inappropriate to slap him all of a sudden.
But he couldn’t help looking puzzled at Zhou Ziqiang, then at Yan Niang behind him, who was staring at the ground, and murmured softly.
“Brother, do you need me to remind you how you died?”
“Since you watched the livestream, you should also know who the first one to reveal my coordinates to the Alien Race when the God Race descended, and who pointed out that they could threaten me with the players of Yancheng, right?”
“In this situation, you want to protect her?”
“Can you really protect her?”
“I’ll protect her even if I can’t.”
A trace of sorrow flashed in Zhou Ziqiang’s eyes, “She looks too much like my late wife, exactly the same, so… Yi, can we step aside to talk?”
Chen Yi nodded and turned to walk toward a corner.
…
“I understand.”
Chen Yi nodded to Zhou Ziqiang standing in front of him, “So you want to hold a wedding, reminisce about your wedding day with your wife one last time, and then kill her afterward?”
“Yes.”
Zhou Ziqiang nodded with a complex expression, “The things she did determined that she could not survive. Even if you didn’t come, Yi, I wouldn’t let her live either. But I want to keep her face as a memento.”
“Let’s not tell her for now. Let her enjoy the wedding without too much fear, and then we’ll take care of her.”
“How long?”
“Starting from now, no more than 8 hours.”
“Alright.”
Chen Yi nodded, giving his consent to the plan, and after a pause, he looked at Zhou Ziqiang and spoke, “You’ve also seen the chat of the Alien Race players in the livestream, right?”
“We don’t know the specifics.”
“But what is clear is that after the Novice Period on Blue Star ends, a more brutal trial will come.”
“In that trial, we’ll need some mid- to high-tier players to withstand the first wave of strength.”
“I didn’t kill the other members of Skywake.”
“I have no grudges with them. What are your thoughts? Are you planning to go back?”
After a long silence, Zhou Ziqiang nodded, “I need to go back. I brought Skywake together with my own hands. Actually, everyone there is on the same path with a goal, and initially, the atmosphere was very good.”
“But… ever since Yan Niang started messing around in Skywake, the atmosphere there went bad.”
“Fine.”
Chen Yi didn’t say more but patted Zhou Ziqiang on the shoulder and said softly, “Skywake backstabbed me this time, and I spared Skywake because of the importance of Skywake to Blue Star, as well as the fact that the betrayal was solely the doing of Yan Niang.”

chapters.title: Chapter 222: 215: "We Have a Big Prize for You."_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 215: “We Have a Big Prize for You.”_2
“I’ve placed someone inside your Skywake,” said Yi.
“Let’s call him Little Traitor for now.”
“After you return, you continue to be the president, and he’ll be the vice president.”
“What do you think?”
“I think that’s entirely possible,” Zhou Ziqiang said with a wry smile and a helpless shrug. “After what happened this time, I’d already secretly decided that anyone could be vice president, just not a woman.”
…
“Bow to the high hall! Bow to the heaven and earth! Husband and wife bow to each other!”
Zhou Ziqiang, wearing a large overcoat with a big red flower stitched onto the chest, and Yan Niang, veiled in red, stood inside a room, partaking in a makeshift wedding ceremony.
The grin on Sword Without End’s face twitched uncontrollably as he played the role of the officiant.
It seems that nowadays, a man isn’t ashamed to step outside unless he’s killed a wife or two.
Yi kills his wife, and then you, Zhou Ziqiang, must also kill yours—after the wedding, no less.
With this thought.
He suddenly thought of his own wife, and his complexion turned a shade paler instantaneously, his gaze drifting distantly towards Yan Niang’s silhouette.
His wife had been seriously ill, with no money for treatment.
On the eve of her death, she writhed and howled in pain all night, the sound grating and heart-wrenching to hear.
Unable to bear seeing his wife suffer so, he took a pillow in the night while she convulsed in agony, and he ended her suffering.
He had done nothing wrong.
But he was still sad.
No wonder the three of them could get along; they were all of the same unsavory kind.
…
“Why do you need a camera?”
Yan Niang, wrapped in a thin veil lying on the bed, glanced uneasily out the window before turning to Zhou Ziqiang, who was taking off his pants by the window: “Will Chen Yi really listen to you?”
“Am I really safe?”
“You’re safe now, don’t think too much about it.”
Zhou Ziqiang, having removed his pants, positioned a camera by the window, angling it for the best view of the large bed. Then, he climbed onto the bed and pulled Yan Niang into his arms.
“I’m sorry,” he murmured.
Yan Niang pushed down the fear in her eyes, then caressed Zhou Ziqiang’s chest and whispered back, “I shouldn’t have done those stupid things before, I didn’t mean to cheat deliberately, it was those men, they forced me.”
“I didn’t plan to poison you either, I was just a bit resentful that after being with you for so long, you always treated me as a substitute for your sister.”
“I just wanted you to like me, that’s all.”
“Can you forgive me?”
“Of course, I can,” said Zhou Ziqiang, nodding silently before he stood up in front of Yan Niang, who was half-reclining on the bed, and hushed her mouth: “Don’t say such depressing things, let’s leave the past in the past.”
“Today we’re officially married, let’s be happy.”
The rain blended with thunder, lightning flashing.
Outside the window, it began to rain.
Even hell gets rain; how lively. Meanwhile, inside, the world was turned upside down!
Perhaps aware that to survive one must play certain games, Yan Niang could be said to have used all her life’s learning to its fullest, reaching a pinnacle of performance!
…
Standing outside under the eaves to shelter from the rain, Sword Without End turned his head somewhat helplessly to Chen Yi: “Look, Yi, there’s no need for you to watch over me, is there? It’s not like I could let anyone escape.”
“You never know,” said Chen Yi, shaking his head as he leaned against the wall with his arms crossed. “With you lovesick people, it’s not surprising what you might do. If you were moved by the love between Zhou Ziqiang and Yan Niang, it wouldn’t be strange for you to let them go.”
“How could that be?” Sword Without End spread his hands in exasperation. “Besides, there’s no love between those two; one’s a rbq, and the other’s an old man who uses the excuse of searching for his late wife, but in reality, he’s after rbq. That can hardly be called love.”
“It’s simply an insult to love.”
Chen Yi nodded and remained silent. After a moment, he asked unexpectedly, “What does it really mean to fall in love with someone?”
“Friend!” Sword Without End responded earnestly, nodding. “The best lover is definitely your best friend!”
“You can tell her everything; all the people around you may leave you, but only she won’t.”
“You can let down your guard in front of her, and you share the same values, beliefs, and common goals!”
“You won’t feel heartache spending money on her because you want her to have better things. You want to fulfill all her wishes if you can.”
“I think, that’s what it really means to fall in love with someone,” he concluded.
Chen Yi nodded silently, pondering deeply within.
“`
The best friends are the ones who stick around, who allow you to be yourself without judgement, whose values align with yours, and whose requests you strive to fulfill.
Isn’t that exactly Jiaye…Rabbit?
Suddenly, the corner of his mouth twitched, and he pulled out an umbrella from his embrace before stepping out into the rain, turning away and walking off: “Bootlicker strategist, you know jack about love.”
“Hey, Yi, where are you going?”
“There’s a sweet shop that way, going to buy some treats for Jiaye.”
“Oh.”
…
“How much is it?”
“That’ll be 778 points.”
After paying, Chen Yi stuffed all the desserts into his backpack. This store was a part of Blue Star Hell’s operations, and all its staff were what Sword Without End had dubbed “ghosts.”
Items purchased in a Hell-managed store could be directly packed away.
And within, players were not allowed to attack each other.
He didn’t know what flavors Jiaye preferred, so he just bought one of each.
Just as he was about to step away.
The woman behind the counter, dressed in professional attire and wearing a businesslike smile, suddenly stopped him: “Sir, congratulations, you are our 88th customer today.”
“We have a grand prize for you.”
“No need.”
Chen Yi shook his head and didn’t bother to pay attention, turning to leave the sweet shop. To think that such a low-level scam existed even in Hell, and in a Hell-operated store too.
Nowadays, even ghosts are getting into the scamming business.
Seeing Chen Yi take off without a second thought, the woman at the cash register, still in her professional wear, had her smile freeze on her face. Situated like that for a moment, she then deflated into her chair.
She took off her work badge and laid it on the table beside her.
Her name was on the work badge.
“Li Peiqi.”
After watching that livestream, she had resolved never to meet with Chen Yi again in her life, but due to some special circumstances, she had no choice but to come… and no choice but to see him.
She could only resort to working part-time as an NPC in Blue Star Hell to catch a glimpse of Chen Yi.
But it seemed their first encounter wasn’t very pleasant.
Just then.
Chen Yi, already having walked back into the rain, suddenly re-entered the sweet shop, umbrella in hand, and strode straight to the cash register, glanced at the employee badge on the table, then turned his gaze to the woman in front of him and raised an eyebrow.
“You just said… there’s a grand prize, right?”
“Huh?”
Li Peiqi, deflated in her chair and pondering her next move, saw Chen Yi return and quickly recomposed herself, stood up, and explained with a fully professional smile.
“Yes, sir, I must say, you’re quite lucky.”
“This is your grand prize.”
She placed a card on the table and slid it towards Chen Yi.
Chen Yi picked up the card from the table, gave it a look, then said, “Thanks.”
After that, he said nothing more and turned back into the rainy night.
Li Peiqi, having successfully handed over the item, sighed deeply, slumped in her chair, and looked up at the ceiling in a daze: “I got freaked out by a novice player; the world really has changed.”
“Even a mouse can rape a cat now.”
But regardless, the item had been delivered; the rest was up to Chen Yi’s reaction.
Since that livestream had ended,
a storm had swept across the outside world.
Every planet would go through a 12-month novice period, during which the items, skills, and titles that could be produced were pretty much the same.
Take for instance the “Shore Flower” prop; they were aware of it.
It was indeed a powerful prop that could be obtained during the novice period.
But 300 million Shore Flowers was beyond their understanding. Was such a prop or skill ever produced during the novice period? How come they had never seen it?
…

chapters.title: Chapter 223: 216: "Are You Sure You Want Yi to Give You a Ride on His Motorcycle?
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 216: “Are You Sure You Want Yi to Give You a Ride on His Motorcycle?
Li Peiqi collapsed into a chair, staring blankly at the ceiling for a long while before muttering to herself.
“What a pity.”
Only then did she turn and enter the back kitchen of the dessert shop.
“I’d like to request an early termination of my part-time job.”
‘Ding, your part-time position is as a cashier and shopping guide at the Happy Come dessert shop on 13th Street in Blue Star Hell, Kowloon City. The monthly salary is 6,000 Points, with a one-year contract. Early termination of the part-time job is a breach of contract and will result in a fine of 10,000 Points as a penalty.’
‘Would you like to proceed with terminating your part-time job?’
“Yes.”
‘Ding, your early termination of the part-time job has been successful. Someone is expected to replace you within ten minutes. After you complete the job handover, you may return to Neutron Star.’
There were more than a few God Race players killed by Chen Yi.
