Not to mention, simply on Blue Star alone, the number of God Race players who died reached millions.
When players die, Skills do not drop.
All Props carried on the body will drop, and some Props in the backpack will randomly drop as well.
Although the chances are slim, the death of so many God Race players here could result in a large amount of Props dropping, which is undoubtedly a vast treasure!
Unfortunately…
They died on Blue Star.
In the base game, there are several universal rules for all planets!
1: No player shall enter a Novice Planet still in its Novice Period, nor shall players who enter through certain Props cause indiscriminate killing.
2: No player may transfer any Props or Skills unrestricted in the Novice Period to Novice players by any means or method.
3: Any player holding a part-time job on a Novice Planet must not reveal any information about the base game.
4: Any player who divulges information such as the monthly rule pool, upcoming events, maps, Props, etc., to players of a Novice Planet will be subject to severe punishment!
Beyond these, there are a few additional miscellaneous rules.
Essentially, one is that players must not interfere excessively with players on Novice Planets, including revealing information or leaving behind Props.
This is why the group of God Race players who died on Blue Star didn’t drop a single Prop.
The rules don’t allow it.
But… players affected by the Skill “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans” are not impacted by this rule.
At this moment, Black Eagle Star of the God Race.
Is like a treasury without a guardian.
The planet is deserted, but it possesses a huge amount of fallen Props and various treasures.
It’s simply too tempting.
Originally, there were still some God Race players who had not died, but when their Race was annihilated, they too were forcibly erased.
Another rule of the base game.
If a Race is annihilated, the remaining players will also be erased.
Including players who had died and fallen into Hell earlier, they too were erased together.
Even the map of their own Race’s Hell was forcibly shut down.
As to whether being annihilated means complete extinction, or descending to an even deeper level of Hell to become Scavengers, that remains unknown.
Nobody has yet revealed this news.
To be precise, very few players know about the existence of Scavengers, and most players are unaware of where Hell Players go after death. It’s undoubtedly a history more tragic than complete death.
And what about emerging after becoming a Scavenger?
There’s no coming out.
Once a Scavenger, always a Scavenger.
In general, there are only a few ways for such veteran players to travel to a Novice Planet.
One of them is, as with the God Race, to directly activate a Race-targeted bounty order. Going to a Novice Planet and killing a few Novice players poses no problem.
Although the cost is somewhat high.
After all, you can’t take away any Props or Skill Fragments from the Novice Planet, meaning it’s completely a loss-making act.
In most cases, no one would choose to do so.
Only under special circumstances, such as the God Race looking to establish their might, would someone do this. And of course, they ended up sealing their own fate.
The second way is through a part-time job.
But one cannot choose which Novice Planet to go to with a part-time job.
The system will randomly assign you.
It’s highly probable you’ll be sent to a Novice Planet in another Star System.
And the fact that she could arrive at this dessert shop just as Chen Yi arrived was due to a special Prop. That’s to say, she was the only one who could deliver the message to Chen Yi.
Otherwise, she definitely wouldn’t want to have anything to do with Chen Yi.
This man, too frightening.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi
Was leaning on a black umbrella, standing beside a street being pounded by heavy rain, looking at the card in his hand with a calm expression, not saying a word.
The content of the card was simple.
On “Black Eagle Star”, lies a vast wealth.
Many factions want to swallow it.
But… none dare to.
It’s Chen Yi’s spoils of war. Although Chen Yi is currently on a Novice Planet and cannot leave, posing no threat to them.
But… he will always come out.
No one doubts that Chen Yi will die in his Novice Period.
Nor does anyone doubt that with Chen Yi on Blue Star, passing the base assessment will be impossible.
It’s all just a matter of time.
Once Chen Yi emerges from the Novice Planet after eight months, the faction that rashly took possession of his spoils of war will have to pay a price for it.
After watching the livestream, no one has the audacity to guarantee they can withstand Chen Yi.
No, forget about guarantees.
Not even boasting, they dare not do so.
Though they dare not touch the wealth on Black Eagle Star, the sight of such immense wealth lying unclaimed is truly agonizing. Therefore, a certain faction sent Li Peiqi to convey a message to Chen Yi.
The gist of it was,
This faction wants the wealth on Black Eagle Star.
As recompense.
They were willing to offer an A-level Prop, 1 million Points, and three favors from their power when Chen Yi left the Novice Zone.
If he agreed, he should burn this card.
Feedback would then be received on the other side.
“…”
With a calm expression, Chen Yi stood on the street corner, staring at the card in his hand for a long time before lighting a cigarette and placing it in his mouth, gazing through the pale blue smoke at the bead-like raindrops before him.
The terms were not very tempting.
An A-level Prop and merely 1 million Points.
It certainly couldn’t compare to the wealth of Black Eagle Star.
But he found such an approach from the other party quite acceptable; at least they had the decency to ask.
No matter how much wealth Black Eagle Star had, he couldn’t take it with him, so as a trade, there was nothing inappropriate.
As for the name of this power, it was rather interesting.
‘Black Dragon Guild.’
It sounded like the name of a crime syndicate, yet their conduct was quite orderly.
A moment later.
He lit the card in his hand, letting it turn to ash and disperse in the rainy night, the deal was properly concluded.
The three favors from the ‘Black Dragon Guild’ would be useful.
And at that moment—
Not far away, Sword Without End, carrying a black umbrella, came over with Zhou Ziqiang.
“It’s done, Yi.”
“Ah?”
Chen Yi, whose thoughts had drifted, looked toward Sword Without End and Zhou Ziqiang under the black umbrella and instinctively glanced at his watch, a bit stunned, “So soon?”
“…”
Zhou Ziqiang silently remained expressionless for a while before he finally spoke softly, “It’s actually been quite a while.”
“Really?”
Chen Yi looked at Zhou Ziqiang strangely, as he seemed to have only stepped out for a trip to the dessert shop and then for a smoke…
Never mind.
It was understandable.
A middle-aged man.
“Is it over?”
He looked up at Sword Without End.
“Yes, I personally took action.”
Sword Without End nodded, clearly aware of what Chen Yi was asking.
“I couldn’t bring myself to do it; her face resembled my wife’s too closely.”
Zhou Ziqiang touched his nose, standing in the rain with half of his body revealed, adding a comment.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded without saying anything, just walked past the two of them under the black umbrella, and entered into the crudely erected marriage chamber.
Inside the marriage chamber, decorated mainly in red.
Yan Niang was lying on the bed in an ancient-style wedding dress, her expression calm, with a bright red mark on her fair neck.
It seemed like she had been given a respectful end.
He walked directly to Yan Niang, took out a dagger from his bosom and picked at her cheek a few times, confirming that she hadn’t had a face swap or plastic surgery, and then took out a giant ax.
He lifted it high.
“Bang!!!”
After dozens of strikes.
Chen Yi casually threw the giant ax aside and reached out his bloodstained hands through the window to be washed by the rain before wiping them dry with a bedsheet.
Then he strode out of the room, heading toward Sword Without End and Zhou Ziqiang on the street nearby.
Leaving behind a room filled with flesh intermingled with wedding dress Fragments.
“Let’s go, time for a team-building outing.”
“All the brothers are there.”
It wasn’t that he didn’t trust Sword Without End, but given Sword Without End’s experiences, he was a bit worried he might go easy and let Yan Niang go.
After all, a man deeply in love can always give the impression of being impulsive in action.
…
The weather in hell is always strange.
For example, it was raining heavily over Kowloon City, yet there were no signs of rain on this patch of sand.
By now, the players who had been building the swimming pool had retired.
A swimming pool, not half the size of a football field but still a quarter of one, lay quietly in the middle of the sandy ground.
The sky above Kowloon City had darkened to night.
But here, the sky was still clear, without sunlight but still bathed in daylight.
“Yo-ho, you’re here?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was in beach shorts doing a breaststroke in the pool, poked his head out of the water, wiped off the water on his face, waved, and grinned, “I was wondering why someone was missing. Today’s team building, come down and play together.”
“Haven’t you seen Jiaye going crazy on a motorcycle over there?”
Not far away.
Jiaye, dressed in denim shorts, was straddling a sand motorcycle, revving up excitedly on the unobstructed desert terrain, seemingly very happy.
She genuinely wanted to ride a desert motorcycle.
And just then—
Jiaye suddenly drove over from a distance, parked the motorcycle in front of Chen Yi, a hint of anticipation in her eyes.
“Yi, can you ride the motorcycle for me?”
“I want to sit behind you.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, still in the pool, pushed his wet hair back and looked at Jiaye with a strange expression.
“Are you sure you want Yi to ride the motorcycle with you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 224: 217: "Under what circumstances would you kill me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 217: “Under what circumstances would you kill me?
“`
“What’s wrong?”
Jiaye tilted his head toward the swimming pool where Tuberculosis Rabbit was, “Yi, can’t you ride a motorbike?”
“That… yes.”
After pondering for a moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit buried his head in the water and stopped talking.
That takes guts.
Riding on Yi’s motorbike would make him vomit, so Jiaye must be very brave.
…
“Alright.”
Chen Yi looked at the expectant Jiaye in front of him and nodded.
He mounted the motorbike.
The throttle was twisted to the max.
Five minutes later.
Jiaye, pale-faced, crawled up from the motorbike and collapsed into a nearby beach chair.
She had been literally floating in the air just now, clutching Chen Yi’s waist with both hands to prevent being thrown off!
Even though this was the first physical contact between them.
It was far from the romance she had imagined.
She only felt… she might be dying.
…
Time always flies.
Chen Yi and the others didn’t intend to rush back.
They had team building for more than ten days.
Time quickly advanced to July 25th.
Zhou Ziqiang started by playing with them for a few days, but then he also left. With Zhou Ziqiang’s strength, returning to Blue Star was not an issue.
“It’s time to go back.”
Lying on the beach chair, Chen Yi picked up a calendar nearby and held it in front of his eyes, “If we don’t go back now, the August rules will be updated.”
“Okay.”
The Sword Without End on the neighboring beach chair glanced at the shop panel, “There’s a Map Access Pass for return to Blue Star on sale in the shop, 5000 Points each.”
“This pass only allows for one-time entry.”
“Team formation is not allowed for multiple people, with a maximum of two people per team.”
“How should we arrange ourselves?”
“I’ll pair up with Jiaye.”
Chen Yi was the first to speak, “Jiaye is weaker in strength, I’ll take her along.”
“Okay.”
Jiaye’s eyes squinted into crescents, her little hands clasped behind her back, and she stood beside Chen Yi, nodding lightly, her eyes full of laughter and joy.
“Then I’ll team up with Tie Chui.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a cigarette from his chest and tossed it to Tie Chui’s lap, “Brother, is it okay if we are on the same team?”
“No… no problem.”
“What about me?”
Sword Without End was startled, asking subconsciously.
“You go solo, you’ve returned once already, so you should have the experience.”
“…”
Sword Without End fell silent and emotionless, no longer speaking.
…
「Map Name」: Indistinguishable Human from Ghost.
「Map Level」: C-level.
「Map Content」: All players will appear in a bustling modern city, and their task is to destroy the city’s library.
There is a time bomb inside the library.
Players can go there and activate the bomb.
The bomb will explode in one hour.
During this period, enemies will surround the library and launch attacks, and players need to resist the attacks from the outside.
Thirty seconds before the explosion.
A portal will appear, please players evacuate in time, successful evacuation will lead to a smooth clearance.
Moreover, the fewer surviving players at the time of leaving, the higher the reward for the players who clear the level.
It is worth noting that among the players, there are two ghosts disguised as players, whose goal is to kill other players.
Please be cautious of them.
「Map Introduction」: A night parade of a hundred ghosts, hard to differentiate humans from ghosts, the one beside you may be the dearest.
Chen Yi sat on a bus, tilting his head to scan the scenery whizzing by outside, a few glances at the map content and he understood what kind of gameplay this map was.
This is the return map for him and Jiaye.
Unlike other players.
They have an additional condition to clear.
They need to kill 10 players.
The two of them are the ghosts hinted at in the map content.
They appeared on this bus upon entering the map, and at this moment there were twenty other players in the bus, the other players for this map.
“Yi.”
Sitting next to Chen Yi, Jiaye cautiously glanced at him, “What should we do?”
Chen Yi shook his head without saying a word, just signaling her to wait patiently.
The return mission was indeed not simple.
There were only twenty players total here, meaning he and Jiaye must each kill ten to successfully return.
They also had to ensure not one of these twenty players died.
If even one died.
One of them would fail the return mission.
“Chen… Chen Yi?”
At this point, players in the bus had recognized Chen Yi.
Although Chen Yi’s title protruded through the bus roof, they still recognized this player with the biggest reputation currently on Blue Star.
Chen Yi.
One Man Exterminates a Clan!
His fame could not be ignored!
“`
And the girl next to Chen Yi, wasn’t she the one being pursued for assassination by the God Race?
Upon recognizing Chen Yi, the remaining 20 players can be said to have instantly huddled together, gathering in a group, watching Chen Yi with faces full of vigilance.
The content on the map made it clear.
When leaving the map, the fewer surviving players there are, the greater the rewards for the remaining players after clearing the map.
If this were any other map and they had encountered Chen Yi, that naturally would have been a fortunate event, as they could have been carried by a “big leg,” but in this map, it was far from fortunate.
Chen Yi was most likely going to kill them all and then monopolize a large number of rewards.
“Chen Yi.”
A man with a full beard, standing inside the bus holding onto a handrail, watched Chen Yi with eyes full of vigilance and malice, word by word.
“Brother, we all know you’re very strong.”
“But I think that to use your ‘Manifold Otherworld Flowers,’ you must pay a significant price, right? Such a powerful Skill, it could even be a one-time thing, couldn’t it?”
“Can you still use it now?”
“Of course, we don’t mean to provoke you. After all, even without the ‘Manifold Otherworld Flowers,’ we are clear that we’re no match for you.”
“We’re just hoping that in this map, can you spare us a path to live.”
“Don’t be utterly ruthless?”
“You’re already so powerful, taking fewer rewards shouldn’t be an issue for you, right? There’s no need to bury us all here just for a bit more reward, right?”
“This is a C-level map. Since we dared to enter a C-level map, it’s not like we don’t have some tricks up our sleeves. If you really corner us, it won’t end well for you either.”
“What do you say, Yi?”
The other players also stood unanimously behind the bearded man, watching Chen Yi with vigilance.
Clearly, everyone was a bit worried that Chen Yi might suddenly lash out.
Chen Yi didn’t speak, just pulled Jiaye into his arms, turned his head to look out the window, and remained silent.
Without lust.
Just worried that these people, in a moment of impulse, might suddenly attack Jiaye.
This city… he seemed to have been here before.
The bus soon stopped.
It stopped in front of the city library, and that was when everyone reacted to the fact that the bus actually had no driver—it was self-driving for the entire journey.
And on the map.
Inside a room on the minus first floor of the city library, a shining question mark icon was flickering incessantly.
Without thinking, it was obvious that this icon represented a timed bomb.
…
Just as everyone had just entered the basement, ready to activate the bomb,
“Bang bang bang!”
Several unexpected gunshots suddenly rang out.
Ten players died instantly, falling into a pool of blood motionless.
The remaining ten players had their limbs broken and lay on the ground, screaming in pain.
Well-prepared, Jiaye charged up wielding a big knife.
One knife for each.
The two had successfully completed their return mission.
What they needed to do next was to activate the bomb and then hold out for an hour.
With Chen Yi’s current strength, accomplishing this task was incredibly easy. There was absolutely no need to kill his spouse to obtain a no-cooldown buff.
Chen Yi glanced at the bodies beside him, did not speak, but activated the timed bomb.
Sword Without End hadn’t mentioned that during the last return, he had stayed in the map for several days, had he? It didn’t seem like it was supposed to be difficult.
After the bomb was activated.
Numerous monsters started attacking from the ground, the roof, the walls surrounding them, similar to spiders but covered with a viscous liquid, looking disgusting and fierce.
However, they could not get within three meters of Chen Yi.
Bullets flew everywhere in the air.
Even without Chen Yi making any shooting motions, these monsters died from unknown attacks.
A B-level Prop, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle’s Enhancement Effect, when propped up with a Firearms class weapon.
He only needed to fire at the ground, and the bullets would shoot out from beneath the enemy’s feet.
Although each shot consumed some Points,
Chen Yi currently had a total of nearly 600,000 Points in his account; he really wasn’t short of this slight drizzle.
Jiaye sat behind Chen Yi, looking dazedly at the silhouette of Chen Yi propped up with his cane inside the room, a bit infatuated.
Chen Yi, however, didn’t speak, standing silently in the room, lost in thought.
He had been off all day today.
He had a dream last night.
That dream disrupted his mental state all day, his thoughts flitting about chaotically.
He rarely dreamt, whereas Tuberculosis Rabbit had dreams every day, but his dreams occurred very infrequently.
Last night, he dreamed that he had died.
His neck had been slashed with a deep cut by a dagger, his breathing was difficult, and he was acutely aware that his life was down to its last few seconds.
The pain was distinct.
He even felt that his head was close to becoming detached from his body.
In the dream.
Jiaye stood aside, dressed maturely, looking at him with a smile in her eyes, appearing very pleased.
He forgot the rest of the plot.
After waking up, people tend to forget the content of their dreams, only this detail was vivid in his mind.
Although he knew dreams had no connection to reality,
But… abruptly dreaming of such a scene made him wonder if his subconscious was hinting something to him or giving him some kind of signal.
After standing silently in the middle of the room for a while with his cane, Chen Yi finally turned to look at Jiaye behind him, stretched out his hand to caress her cheek, then slowly slid it down to Jiaye’s pristine neck.
It lingered there and did not continue downward.
“Yi…”
Jiaye involuntarily tightened her legs a little, fidgeting with the hem of her clothes, her cheeks reddening slightly as she looked up at Chen Yi and whispered, her eyes somewhat teary, begging to be devoured in a single bite.
Chen Yi stared at the pale neck, then after a while, he finally asked, “Did it hurt you that day?”
“A little…”
Jiaye instinctively whispered back in a soft voice, but, fearing Chen Yi might misunderstand, quickly added, “But the sensation was gone quickly; it only hurt for a moment.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded, then tilted his head and suddenly popped a very strange question.
“Under what circumstances would you kill me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 225: 218: "Revive, My Lover!!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 218: “Revive, My Lover!!!
“Ah?”
Jiaye stood dumbfounded, staring ahead, and looked up at Chen Yi’s expression. Seeing that Chen Yi didn’t seem to be joking, he asked in confusion, “I would never kill you, Yi, under any circumstances. Why would you suddenly ask such a question?”
“I dreamed yesterday that you killed me.”
“So I just got a bit curious about what it would take for you to kill me.”
Chen Yi didn’t try to hide anything but just came out with it directly like it was a casual chat.
“Kill…?”
Jiaye was completely flabbergasted and after a long pause, he murmured, “If there ever was such a situation, it’d definitely be because killing me would result in a better outcome for you.”
“Like maybe you’d get millions of Points, and then you would come back from hell or something.”
“Otherwise, under no circumstances would I ever kill you, Yi. What kind of terrible dream is that? Anyway, I couldn’t beat you even if I tried.”
“True.”
Chen Yi nodded and said no more. His mind was indeed a bit scrambled today.
An hour passed quickly.
The countdown on the time bomb entered the final thirty seconds.
A gate of light appeared.
The moment they stepped through the gate, they returned to Blue Star.
…
‘Ding ding ding…’
Right after returning to Blue Star, they heard countless voices ringing in their ears.
Most of the messages were from that Little Traitor—oh, that’s wrong, he had introduced himself by name, something like Chu Ge.
The messages from the past few days were all inquiries about the status of the President of Skywake.
The ones from the following days seemed to show that he had figured out his position within Skywake.
Every move of Skywake, such as which maps were being worked on today, what type of Props were being collected, and how many new members had joined, were all reported daily.
It looked like a civil servant summarizing their work.
Chen Yi briefly scanned all the messages sent by Chu Ge and responded offhandedly.
‘No need to be so detailed, just let me know if there is any movement inside Skywake against me or against you. No need to report anything else.’
‘Understood, received.’
The response came quickly, an instant reply.
In the global team rankings, despite having spent so many days on team-building, they were still first.
At Lv.4, they held firm at the top of the global leaderboard.
However, there were many new Lv.3 teams now, over thirty of them.
Development was indeed fast.
In the few dozen days they’d spent, the players on Blue Star had not rested, and their overall strength had improved by a notch.
That was because Chen Yi had shown restraint back then.
You see, for a Lv.2 team to advance to Lv.3, one of the requirements is to have 50% or maybe it was 60% of the map evaluation score on a certain map.
At any rate, you must have a high evaluation score on some map.
A Lv.2 team, the D-level maps they could clear were just those few, and if Chen Yi had cleared all the D-level maps and secured 100% map evaluation scores on them,
And raised every map’s evaluation score to an extremely high level,
Then… all the teams in the world would probably have been stuck at Lv.2.
Not a single team would’ve made it to Lv.3.
Besides the ‘Skywake’ Guild, three more guilds had emerged worldwide.
They were ‘Sin Department,’ ‘Ganges,’ and ‘First Under Heaven.’
July was nearly over, and so far, only four guilds had appeared. It seemed that the Guild Creation Orders really weren’t easy to come by.
He had no intention of forming a guild himself.
With his current strength,
He feared neither one-on-one fights nor group fights.
If it came down to a group fight, just kill Jiaye, and it would be done.
However…
Chen Yi looked at Jiaye, who was standing beside him, admiring their Frozen Palace, and squinted his eyes slightly, keeping silent without speaking.
His ‘Murderer of his Own Wife’ title seemed invincible,
But its flaw was obvious.
He must kill Jiaye in order to gain a one-hour no-cooldown buff.
On Blue Star, naturally, it could be used at will.
But what about in hell?
He couldn’t really kill Jiaye there in hell, could he?
That would mean actual death.
The biggest flaw was that if he ever found himself in a life-or-death crisis in hell, he simply couldn’t activate that title unless… unless he could make sure the enemy didn’t know how his no-cooldown buff was activated, right?
That way, even in hell, the enemy wouldn’t dare to make a move.
This also meant that the next time they killed Jiaye, they might need to put on a performance or have Jiaye die secretly in the dark, unseen by others—otherwise, this flaw was just too obvious.
The enemy wouldn’t even need to attack him in hell; they just had to assassinate Jiaye to discard his most powerful trump card.
He could protect Jiaye for a moment but couldn’t possibly protect him at all times.
“Is this palace permanent?”
As Jiaye walked back and forth within the palace, he touched the slightly chilly walls and exclaimed in amazement.
“Not exactly.”
Chen Yi shook his head and explained, “This palace is an upgraded version of the original Frozen Throne; after activating that title, the palace can rise on the spot.”
“It has a certain defensive power and can exist permanently as long as it doesn’t move locations.”
“It should be considered semi-permanent.”
“So pretty.”
“It’s okay.”
Chen Yi glanced at the personal marketplace and, after pondering for a moment, pulled out a ring from his pocket and handed it to Jiaye: “This is for you.”
Jiaye instinctively turned to look at the ring in Chen Yi’s hand, her body suddenly stiffening slightly.
“Is this… so sudden?”
“Yeah, it’s the Gold and Jade Ring for 99,900 Points, can’t afford the one for 990,000.”
The ring was a new product added in July.
Players could purchase a ring from the Points store and use it to confess their love to any member of the opposite sex. If the other party accepted, they would become a couple.
After forming a couple, players could enter a couples-only map, complete couples-only quests, have access to a couples-only store, learn couples-only skills, and other privileges.
There were four price tiers for these couples’ rings.
Wood and Copper Ring for 999 Points, Silverstone Ring for 9,999 Points, Gold and Jade Ring for 99,900 Points, Divine Honor Ring for 990,000 Points.
990,000 Points.
Quite interesting, he was curious whether the system believed someone could actually afford this price point.
He felt that, even if his Points weren’t the highest on Blue Star, he could still rank in the top ten, right?
If he couldn’t afford it, who could?
If the Black Dragon Guild from Neutron Star made good on the promise of 1 million Points, he could afford it, but sadly he couldn’t get that money until he left Newbie Village.
“I… I’m willing.”
Jiaye covered her mouth excitedly, her white and soft hand extended for Chen Yi to slip the ring onto her finger.
The ring was very pretty.
It had a hollow-out pattern design, with a glaze-like appearance of white jade amidst gold, and atop that, a white luminescent glow ebbed and flowed around the ring, which was topped with a pair of tiny angel wings fluttering continuously.
The next second—
A notification rang in Chen Yi’s ear.
“Ding, you and Jiaye have successfully become a couple, congratulations on your union.”
“The two of you will have access to a couples-only map. Inside the map, you can gain Couple Points, which can be exchanged in the couples’ store for couples’ skills, props, vehicles, titles, and special effects.”
“Couple Points can also be earned through completing couples’ quests and other methods, and they are a completely separate currency system from Points; there is no interchangeability between them.”
“Based on the accrued Couple Points, there will be a global couples’ ranking.”
“Every day, the global number one, top three, and top ten couples will receive different limited-time special titles with special effects.”
“Ding, it has been detected that player Chen Yi’s ring of proposal is worth 99,900 Points, the Gold and Jade Ring.”
“Therefore, you will start with 1,000 Couple Points and be rewarded with a special random couple skill.”
“Ding, it has been detected that you have reached 1,000 Couple Points, thus you have been promoted to a Three-Star Couple and obtained an exclusive Three-Star Couple Skill.”
A series of notifications kept ringing out next to Chen Yi’s ear.
“Couples have levels too?”
Chen Yi looked at the pop-up notification panel in front of him with some surprise. It took some effort on the global couples’ leaderboard to find his and Jiaye’s position, ranking 1078th globally.
Strange.
He didn’t even know when this leaderboard had appeared; it must have been while he was on ‘vacation’ in hell.
A global couples’ leaderboard sounded really odd.
After getting promoted to a Three-Star Couple, they also received a special Three-Star Couple Skill.
“Skill Name”: “Revive, My Love!”
“Skill Level”: None.
“Skill Effect”: When your other half is on the brink of death, and you shout “Revive, My Love!”, your partner’s injuries will heal rapidly. However, it will cost 10,000 Points. If Points are insufficient, a random C-grade prop will be deducted. If there are no sufficient props, you will nearly die in place of your other half.
“Skill Limitation”: No cooldown. Theoretically, as long as you have enough Points, your other half will not die.
“Skill Introduction”: “The economic foundation determines the superstructure. Education is delayed. As when in your youth, you never understood why when the bald political teacher on the stage in the lazy and sultry air of a high school afternoon read this sentence, his face carried a complex expression.”
“Skill Source”: An exclusive skill obtained upon being promoted to a Three-Star Couple.”
This skill was an exclusive one granted upon reaching Three-Star Couple status.
To be honest…
Apart from the activation being a bit embarrassing, the skill effect was indeed quite good.
Jiaye also saw the skill. Her face was tinged with embarrassment, but she curiously asked, “What about mute couples?”
“There were quite a few mutes due to the April rules.”
“Can sign language activate it?”
“It should be possible.”
Chen Yi pointed at the small line of text at the bottom of the skill panel: “It looks like it’s even more thoughtful than we considered.”
“PS: Sign language can also activate this skill.”
“Feels like signing to revive my love has a higher acceptance than shouting it out loud.”
“Seal of reincarnation, that’s kind of interesting.”
One-Star Couples and Two-Star Couples didn’t have any exclusive skills.
But getting promoted to a Four-Star Couple apparently came with an exclusive feature.
However, to be promoted to a Four-Star Couple required a whopping 10,000 Couple Points.
So far, the highest-ranking couple on the global leaderboard has just over 6,000 Couple Points—they’re also a Three-Star Couple, with no Four-Star Couples yet.
It seems the 99,900-Points ring he bought has some extra benefits beyond just looking good.
Like that special random skill.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: 219: "In this world, there will always be many surprises.
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 219: “In this world, there will always be many surprises.
“Skill Name”: “The moon is beautiful, but you are more beautiful.”
“Skill Level”: None.
“Skill Effect”: When you activate the ring in your hand, you can teleport to your lover’s side under any circumstances, including within the map or in a state of imprisonment.
“Skill Limitation”: After using once, it will enter a 24-hour cooldown period, with no consumption required.
“Skill Introduction”: “Men who are clueless about romance are as boring as bricks.”
“Skill Source”: Obtain this special skill randomly after purchasing the Gold and Jade Ring for 99,000 Points. This skill can only be generated in this way.
Not a bad skill.
It could be quite useful at critical moments.
For example, next time he goes to hell to find Jiaye, he wouldn’t need to commit suicide; using this prop would be enough.
And when returning, he wouldn’t need to bring Jiaye back with him through the return map.
He would arrive at Blue Star first, then let Jiaye activate the ring.
The only point of concern is.
If it’s a 10-person limited map, and suddenly after activating this skill, an extra person appears on the map, how would the mission progress, whether there would be any completion criteria, or whether it might cause a bug.
But he didn’t think about these issues.
Instead, he looked at the “Couples’ Quest” interface, ready to see what was available.
But it was better not to look.
Upon seeing, Jiaye’s cheeks instantly turned red as apples, and she lowered her head to look towards her toes, fiddling with the corner of her clothes without a word.
These tasks are way… too adult for children.
“Couple’s Daily Tasks.”
“Task One: Embrace once, reward 1 Couple Point.”
“Task Two: Kiss once, reward 2 Couple Points.”
“Task Three: Hold hands once, reward 1 Couple Point.”
“…”
The earlier are normal, small actions that not only earn Couple Points but also increase intimacy between couples.
“…”
“Task Seven: Spend a passionate night together, reward 10 Couple Points.”
“Task Eight: Rise to the occasion twice in a passionate night, reward 20 Couple Points.”
“Task Ten: Rise to the occasion seven times in a passionate night, reward 300 Couple Points.”
“…”
Chen Yi touched his nose and looked at the couples’ tasks, not quite knowing what to say. He and Jiaye hadn’t gone that far yet, so it looks like they could only complete the first few tasks daily.
As for the later tasks, indeed, they were a bit more challenging.
“Let’s take a look at the couple’s shop first.”
“Okay.”
Jiaye’s whisper was as soft as a fly.
But when they looked at the couples’ shop, Jiaye let out a sharp yelp and ran into the next room covering her face.
And when Chen Yi looked at the couples’ shop, he was somewhat speechless, unsure of what to say.
The first page of the couple’s shop featured couple props.
He thought it would be props, and indeed it was props.
“Prop Name”: Intoxicating Lipstick.
“Prop Effect”: After applying this lipstick, it will significantly stir up each other’s deepest desires.
“Prop Price”: 20 Couple Points.
–
“Prop Name”: Black Lace Silk Sexy Nightgown.
“Prop Effect”: No special effects, but this prop doesn’t need any to be worthwhile.
“Prop Price”: 10 Couple Points.
–
“Prop Name”: Ram Stick.
“Prop Effect”: A small prop that substitutes for your tongue and vibrates at a high frequency.
“Prop Price”: 30 Couple Points.
–
“Prop Name”: One-Sided Wall.
“Prop Effect”: This prop will alter one wall you designate, where there will be a hole for sticking out your head, with other uses to be explored by users themselves.
“Prop Price”: 100 Couple Points.
–
“Prop Name”: Bouncing Egg.
“Prop Effect”: Remote-controlled at any distance, strength under your control, an artifact for long-distance relationships.
“Prop Price”: 50 Couple Points.
–
Most of the props basically fall into this category. There are many other props he didn’t quite dare to look closely at. It can be said that the props here satisfy everyone’s fantasies!
Whether they fancy black stockings, high heels, a height difference,
or even some kinky behaviors like NTR, SM, etc.
There’s a prop for everything.
What’s the point of calling it a couple’s shop?
Just call it an adult shop and be done with it, right?
Chen Yi was somewhat speechless as well, as in his worldview, these kinds of things should be found in unmanned shops tucked away in alleyways.
Deserted by day.
At night, there would always be some couples, sneaking in like thieves, then rushing back out.
This is the first time he’s seen these items so openly displayed.
Just as he was about to close the couple’s shop and check something else,
suddenly a system notification sounded in his ear.
“Ding, your lover Jiaye has spent 10 Couple Points to purchase an item called ‘Black Lace Silk Sexy Nightgown’ from the couple’s shop.”
“Your remaining balance is 990 Couple Points.”
“Friendly reminder, the global couples ranking and the qualification for couples’ promotions is determined by the total Couple Points couples have earned. Spending Couple Points will not affect the ranking on the global couples leaderboard or the couples’ promotion.”
“…”
Chen Yi fell silent again, swallowing instinctively, and looking at the closed door of Jiaye’s room nearby, his heart started to flutter for the first time.
Why did Jiaye… buy that?
Wait a minute.
He wasn’t quite ready yet.
However, when a girl has hinted this strongly, wouldn’t he be less than an animal if he still hesitated at the doorstep?

chapters.title: Chapter 227: 219: "In this world, there will always be many surprises."_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 219: “In this world, there will always be many surprises.”_2
But they’ve only been together for a few days, their relationship isn’t there yet.
He even felt his palms starting to sweat.
Standing still, Chen Yi for the first time felt there was such a difficult problem to solve in life, hesitatingly glancing toward the bathroom to the side, should he go wash up first?
He couldn’t smell bad.
Just at this moment—
Jiaye walked out from the room, looking quite normal, and turned his head to say, “Yi, they haven’t come back yet, shall we go check out a Couple Map first?”
It looked as if nothing had happened just now.
“…”
Chen Yi silently stopped himself from heading to the bathroom and nodded calmly, “Okay.”
“Yi, why did you take off your suit jacket?”
“It’s a bit hot.”
“Oh.”
A playful glint flashed in Jiaye’s eyes, he leaned forward with his hands behind his back and asked, “Then, Yi, which Map shall we go to?”
Chen Yi paused for a moment, shifting his gaze away from the cleavage in front of Jiaye to the side before he spoke, “Just choose any.”
Her body is not that tall, so how can that be so big.
Wasn’t it said that she was malnourished as a child?
…
‘Map Name’: Truth or Dare Adventure.
‘Map Level’: Three-Star Map.
‘Map Content’: A total of five couples of players love to join this map.
Inside the map.
There are three stages.
In the first stage, the system will randomly issue a question about the other partner, answer correctly to score points, fail to do so, and points will be deducted.
Second stage, truth.
Third stage, dare.
Rankings will be given based on the points, as well as Couple Points and Prop rewards, with the fifth-placed couple losing Couple Points.
‘Map Introduction’: “The thing I hate most in my life is pretentious couples!”
“Like that.”
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully, looking at the Map in front of him and more or less understood what a Couple Map was about, it didn’t sound like there were any too cruel crises.
Of course, the rewards weren’t too generous either.
It seemed like a Map designed to foster the affection between couples.
Strange.
Why would the system create such a couples system and Couple Maps, and those items in the couple store looked as if they were eagerly expecting couples to hasten the spring night.
Could it be they’re worried about the population not growing if players died out?
“…”
All of a sudden, Chen Yi fell silent, feeling like he might have guessed the truth.
The map was not big.
He and Jiaye stood on a stone pillar about ten square meters in size, surrounded by a wooden railing, which, unless deliberately jumped over, should prevent one from falling off.
Below the stone pillar were clouds.
No one knew what would happen if they fell.
In front was a giant screen that was currently playing.
‘Loading…’
At this time, there were four other stone pillars around, each with a couple standing on it, making up five couples in total.
But the couple to their right was a little strange…
A young couple.
The two of them seemed to be reciting lines from a script, with the man yelling out, “Revive, my lover!”
Then his face turned deathly pale, and he fell to the ground, violently vomiting blood, looking like he was about to die.
Right after that, the woman who was just pale and on the ground, suddenly stood up fully revived and roared, “Revive, my lover!”
Subsequently.
This woman also immediately fell to the ground, wildly vomiting blood, clearly not having long to live.
Before they could react, the man stood up again and shouted, “Revive, my lover!”
Chen Yi was somewhat dumbfounded, what were these two doing?
“Yi!”
And at this time.
The girl from the couple on their left suddenly noticed Chen Yi and excitedly waved, saying, “My name is Yue, I’m your fan!”
“When they were accusing you of killing Skywake’s old chief online, I was defending you!”
Upon seeing Chen Yi noticing that special couple to the right, she hurriedly started explaining.
“Yi, those two are regulars on this map.”
“The man was critically injured and near death during one Map run, and the woman used the Three-Star Couple’s exclusive Skill to revive him, but the problem is they don’t have 10,000 Points or a C-grade Prop anymore.”
“In that Map run, they not only got critically injured but also lost a lot of Props and Points.”
“And without enough Points and C-grade Props, when using the Three-Star Couple’s exclusive Skill to revive the partner, they would end up in a dying state themselves.”
“`
“Fortunately, this skill doesn’t have a cooldown, so these two just keep using this method to exploit the bug.”
“Both of them are constantly on the verge of death, a state that definitely won’t allow them to go to normal maps, so they can only come to this one. The Points awarded by this map are a little less, but at least there’s no danger.”
“Save up for a while and they can almost gather 10000 Points to completely resurrect the other person. If you ask me, at this rate, they might as well go to hell.”
The girl shrugged her nose and muttered, “I feel like becoming a Hell Player would be better.”
Skywake’s old chairman’s return.
Left many players somewhat bewildered.
And Skywake also posted a thread to inform about the Hell Players.
An issue this system had never explicitly mentioned before.
So almost the majority of players got to know about the existence of Hell Players and became a little less fearful of death, though they knew that returning to Blue Star after becoming a Hell Player wouldn’t be easy.
But at least there was some anticipation.
And besides the weather being a bit unpredictable in hell, there weren’t any major differences from Blue Star.
It was as if living in Blue Star had no issues, actually.
As long as you could deceive yourself a bit.
But this girl’s boyfriend seemed a little dissatisfied that his girlfriend was so heartbroken over Chen Yi, and he frowned slightly, nudging her with his elbow with a trace of displeasure.
He looked at Chen Yi with a hint of hostility in his eyes.
The girl quickly caught on, gave Chen Yi an awkward smile, then turned her head and started whispering with her boyfriend.
This couple seemed quite young.
They appeared to be just over 20 years old.
Before the descent of the game, they might have still been in college.
And at this moment—
The map officially started.
Several lines of text quickly appeared on the screen.
‘Each player sees different questions, a total of 6 questions, three for the male and three for the female.’
‘Please have the female answer first.’
‘The male must not interrupt or give any hints, otherwise, points will be deducted as a penalty.’
‘Q1: Did your loved one commit murder before the descent of the game?’
“Before the descent of the game?”
Jiaye looked at the question on the screen, puzzled as to why such a question would appear, but still confidently said,
“Of course not.”
“Before the game descended, Yi definitely didn’t commit murder. Murder is against the law; if he had killed someone, Yi would have been in jail before the game descended.”
‘Ding, incorrect answer.’
“Huh?”
Jiaye stood frozen, a little confused, and it took a long moment before he shockingly turned to Chen Yi: “Yi… did you kill someone before April?”
“Uh…”
Chen Yi touched his nose with a bit of embarrassment: “I guess there was such a thing; you know, sometimes people die accidentally for various reasons.”
“Like when I’m cutting fruit, and suddenly someone runs into the tip of my knife.”
“This world is full of accidents.”
“But… isn’t killing people a crime? How come you weren’t in prison, Yi?”
“It’s only a crime if you get caught.”
“…makes sense.”
‘Moving on to the second question.’
‘Please have the male answer.’
‘Q2: Did your loved one commit murder before the descent of the game?’
“No.”
Chen Yi shook his head with conviction, knowing that Tie Chui might be believable, but Jiaye, no way. Considering Jiaye’s personality, he probably would have been scared to kill a fish before the descent of the game, let alone a person.
‘Ding, incorrect answer.’
“…”
“…”
Chen Yi fell silent, Jiaye fell silent.
“Isn’t murder illegal? How did you not end up in jail?”
“You said it, Yi, it’s only illegal if you get caught.”
“I had no idea you had that kind of experience.”
“Well, you never talked about your experience either.”
“It’s all good…”
“All is well.”
…
ps: This a long one, ha. The new rules for August are coming out tomorrow.
I hope that under this comment, readers can give some suggestions about the rules for August.
And also about the new gameplay and some functions to be added in August.
Please speak up, not being able to copy the comments would be painful.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 228: 220: "Planning to use Chen Yi to get rid of your relative?
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 220: “Planning to use Chen Yi to get rid of your relative?
Answering two consecutive questions incorrectly, the couple’s score plummeted to the bottom.
Fortunately, they weren’t participating in this couple’s map for the rewards; considering the punishment wasn’t severe, they treated it as a fun experience.
This type of couple’s map is considered to have the lowest danger coefficient among the game’s maps.
Not to mention the Sands of Time Dried Corpse map near Yancheng, even an E-grade map was more difficult than this couple’s map.
The first level passed quickly.
The couple only answered three questions correctly.
It seemed that neither of them knew much about the other, especially Chen Yi, who couldn’t imagine how Jiaye, a seemingly frail girl, could have killed someone before the revelation of the game.
It was incomprehensible.
The second and third levels.
The couple’s map ended swiftly.
“Ding, congratulations to the two of you for securing fourth place in the Three-Star Couple’s map of Truth or Dare Adventure, rewarded with 10 Couple Points and 1 Point.”
The reward was meager, to say the least.
He had been in this game for a full four months now.
It was his first time seeing a reward of 1 Point.
…
Above the palace.
Chen Yi lay back on the rooftop, calmly gazing at the dense and brilliant starry sky, which twinkled as if wrapped in a silvery veil over the night.
As for Jiaye, she rested her head on Chen Yi’s stomach, her expression somewhat dazed as she murmured softly.
“That was a long time ago.”
“I told you, Yi, that my brother and I set up a fish shop, but that was later on; before that, we made do through various means.”
“But we never did anything unscrupulous.”
“It was just that a vagrant had been harassing us for a while; not just me, but also my brother. He would follow us and throw stones, laughing loudly at us.”
“The vagrant was filthy, with tattered clothes and an abnormal mental state.”
“Tie Chui wanted to beat him up, but I stopped my brother because I didn’t want things to escalate.”
“So, for a year, that vagrant continued to follow and harass us.”
“Until one time, we had the chance to rent a space in a seafood market and pay later, presenting us with an opportunity to start a small business—an opportunity for my brother to turn our lives around.”
“But… to enter the seafood market, we needed proof of identity, and neither my brother nor I had such documents. I wasn’t sure if we could get them in time. But it was definitely too late; we had only three days to move in, or the market management would find someone else.”
Jiaye suddenly hesitated as if holding something back, then after a pause, she continued quietly, “Every chick stands on its own, as the saying goes, rough as it might be, it’s true in many situations.”
“My brother and I got fake IDs. The seafood market only registered them and didn’t check for authenticity, so we moved in smoothly.”
“However, that vagrant somehow got wind of this.”
“He kept following us, screaming arrogantly and jumping around: ‘Fake IDs, they got fake IDs!'”
“Yi, you know.”
“Moving into that seafood market represented the first chance at a new life for my brother and me after so many years.”
“When someone stands in the way of your chance at a new life, perhaps anyone would take drastic measures.”
“My brother and I killed the vagrant.”
“We tied the body with stones and threw it into the river.”
“Then, coincidentally, it rained heavily for three days, the river rose, and until today, the body’s whereabouts are unknown.”
“What about you, Yi?”
“Me?”
Chen Yi lay on the roof, arms propped behind him, looking up at the twinkling stars overhead, silent and not speaking.
After a while, he finally said softly.
“I’ve forgotten.”
“Impossible. Something like this would certainly leave a deep impression; how could you forget?”
“I truly have forgotten.”
“Alright then.”
Jiaye seemed slightly unsatisfied with the answer, pursed her lips, and said nothing, expressing her discontent.
And at that moment—
“Yi, Yi!?”
A voice from within the palace echoed like the howl of a Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow slightly, shifted Jiaye’s head from his stomach, got up, and walked towards the lower part of the palace: “Let’s go, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others are back.”
…
“Yi!”
Seeing Chen Yi coming from outside the palace, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t contain his excitement and blurted out, “Let me tell you, Tie Chui is unbelievably strong in the map!”
“It’s outrageous, he’s knocking out Little Carlas with a single punch!”
Chen Yi stood still, turned his head to look at Tie Chui beside him, and nodded with a light laugh: “Good work.”
Tie Chui didn’t say anything but stood there, eyes fixed on Chen Yi as if waiting for something.
“Here.”
Chen Yi also timely took out a cigarette from his pocket and handed it to Tie Chui.
“Hehe.”
A simple smile spread across Tie Chui’s face, and he received the cigarette with joy, placing it into his cherished metal box.
July was soon coming to an end.
The rules of July were also ending, and the timeline was swiftly approaching August 1.
According to what they said in the live broadcast room, it meant their Novice Period was about to officially pass the four-month mark.
There were no special limited events throughout the whole month of July.
It seems that less famous holidays weren’t necessary to celebrate with events in the eyes of the game’s developers.
But there was one thing that puzzled me.
Since each planet’s culture is different, naturally, their holidays would be different too. So how are holiday events held on other planets?
Are specific holiday events designed according to the different holidays on each planet?
…
Meanwhile, in the outside world.
After a coalition of multiple forces, Chen Yi’s battle footage in the live streaming room was forcefully blocked, not a bit of it leaked out.
Aside from the audience present in the livestream at the time, barely anyone outside knew about this incident.
The Third Star System, comprising 38 planets.
It’s huge.
How many people were there in the livestream that day? Many were Blue Star players. Even though entry to the livestream was free, not every player received a notification, nor did every player who received a notification choose to join the livestream.
Compared to all the players in the Third Star System, those in the livestream room were just a drop in the river.
The coalition of forces quickly identified the audience in the livestream that day and went through the process of interviewing and warning each, and to this day, no news has leaked to the outside world.
In a virtual conference hall at the moment.
Dozens of people were sitting together as if they were in some kind of meeting.
There was even a banner hanging in the background, looking like the theme of the meeting.
“Expel the Wolf, Swallow the Tiger!”
The middle-aged man sitting in the leading position began with a serious expression, “According to our statistics, on that day in the Third Star System, twelve planets did not enter the livestream.”
“Meaning these twelve planets have no idea about this incident.”
“All we need to do next is make a few small moves. When Chen Yi leaves the Novice Planet, we can have someone from these twelve planets provoke or insult him.”
“In short, use various methods to enrage Chen Yi, prompting him to annihilate one or two more planets. Then a planet’s wealth will become available, and at that time, we can join together with Chen Yi and take a share, can’t we?”
“For example, when Chen Yi takes action, we can also send people, under the guise of supporting Chen Yi. Even if Chen Yi wanted to attack us, he wouldn’t have much of a reason, as we would ostensibly be his reinforcements.”
“That way, picking up some props afterwards would be reasonable, right?”
The others in the meeting room had no objections and nodded, each offering what they thought were reasonable suggestions. The topic had already been agreed upon by everyone; this time was merely to discuss the specific details.
Originally, no one had thought of these things.
But… the sudden extinction of the God Race on Black Eagle Star shocked everyone.
And the immense wealth on Black Eagle Star quickened everyone’s breathing.
Only then did people realize that being a bandit was much more thrilling than laboriously exploring maps.
Once was not enough; they wanted more.
“…”
The leader of the Black Dragon Guild, sitting on the side of the meeting room, kept a grim face and didn’t say a word from beginning to end.
After Chen Yi annihilated Black Eagle Star, none of those present dared to step foot on it to collect the ownerless wealth, as timid as cowering dogs, acting as if they couldn’t see the riches beside them.
Fearing Chen Yi would come out of Blue Star to settle scores with them.
But when the Black Dragon Guild struck a deal with Chen Yi and sent people to collect the wealth, these same people popped up like hungry wolves smelling meat, rushing over in a group.
Their rationale was very simple.
The wealth was originally Chen Yi’s, and they didn’t dare to touch it.
But now that the wealth belonged to the Black Dragon Guild, how did they think the Guild’s strength measured up?
It was nothing but damn robber’s logic!
But it had to be said, it was a perfect logic!
And so, the wealth on Black Eagle Star was split among multiple forces, and the Black Dragon Guild only managed to acquire one twenty-seventh of it.
But even that small share of wealth was enough to make all the forces greedy.
Clearly, the process of amassing a fortune without paying much of a price had become somewhat addictive and intoxicating for everyone.
At that moment—
Li Peiqi, sitting beside the Black Dragon Guild’s leader, was restless and anxious throughout, and immediately after the meeting ended, he dragged the Guild leader into a separate small room.
With a somewhat panic-stricken urgency, he exclaimed, “My lord Guild leader…!!”
“I find that you all dare to scheme against anyone. That’s Chen Yi we’re talking about, did you not see what happened that day?”
“Three billion Bleeding Hearts, smashing down like a blizzard!”
“Countless bullets ricocheting everywhere in the air, each one with the effect of Annihilate Nine Clans. To make an enemy of someone like that, Guild leader, do you have some issue with your relatives?”
“Are you using Chen Yi’s hand to rid yourself of your relations?”

chapters.title: Chapter 229: 221: New Rules in August.
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 221: New Rules in August.
“Even if you, President, want to get rid of your relatives, there’s no need to go through all this trouble. Just give me the word, and I’ll take care of it for you.”
At this moment, Li Peiqi seemed to transform into the Hurried King, with just three characters written all over her face.
Hurried. Hurried. Hurried.
Her face, which was once as lovely as the bright moon, now crumpled up due to extreme anxiety, forgetting all about managing her expressions as a beauty.
When a woman forgets about managing her expressions, you know she’s really got some serious problems.
After eating chips on the horizon and watching that live broadcast.
She internally marked Chen Yi as an SSSSSSSSSSS level threat. It’s not just about being enemies, if possible, she would prefer not to encounter him for the rest of her life.
But… in the end, out of the many years of friendship with the President, she steeled herself and went to Blue Star Hell to deliver a letter to Chen Yi.
That was already her limit.
But now, President, you’re actually starting to prepare to deal with Chen Yi.
Seeing the President didn’t speak, just furrowing his eyebrows as rigid as if constipated, Li Peiqi fell silent for a while, then emotionlessly took off her badge from her chest: “Screw it, I’m quitting the guild. You all are too scary.”
“The biggest dream of my life is just to lie in bed carefree, eating chips and watching TV dramas.”
“And you just have to throw me into a living hell.”
“I really don’t understand you guys. Even if we don’t use Chen Yi to wipe out other planets, would it really slow us down that much to just go level up on the maps honestly?”
“So what if it’s a bit slower? Do you really have to put yourselves in such perilous situations?”
“Humph!”
After a long while, the President of the Black Dragon Guild finally let out a long sigh, his expression complex as he shook his head: “You don’t understand men.”
“Men and women have different traits.”
“Most women, when they notice a guy looking at them, will feel secretly pleased, thinking that they must be dressed well today, or that someone has noticed a particular detail about them.”
“That’s a woman’s trait.”
“Whereas most men, when facing wealth that’s floating on a crisis, tend to think they’re the Child of Heaven’s Will, who can successfully evade danger and take all that wealth into their arms.”
“That’s the inexplicable confidence of men.”
“An average Joe will believe that if he were to become a pirate, he’d certainly be the last man standing, accumulating a vast fortune and becoming the Pirate King.”
“Men never believe they will be the ones to die.”
“In the face of wealth, they always feel like they’ll be the protagonist, cutting through brambles and avoiding all dangers, grabbing the final prize.”
“And those who are able to sit in this meeting hall have essentially taken this path in life, which only reinforces their belief that they are the Child of Heaven’s Will.”
“In many people’s eyes, no matter how strong Chen Yi is, it doesn’t matter. After all, even if he’s very strong, the crisis he brings is nothing more than death.”
“Without experiencing such crisis a hundred or so times, they’re not qualified to sit inside this meeting room.”
“…”
Li Peiqi, her face full of speechlessness, looked at the usually very composed President: “So, President, you also think you’re the protagonist?”
“No.”
The President of the Black Dragon Guild shook his head: “I’ve thought it over carefully just now, and all of us coming together, scheming on how to use Chen Yi to deal with other planets, we seem more like a bunch of villains.”
“It feels a bit ominous.”
“So I’m backing out this time. We’ll stay out of this matter.”
“Humph!”
Li Peiqi let out a long sigh of relief and patted her chest: “Wise decision, President! This will be the most correct decision of your life. Being an enemy of that kind of person is too terrifying.”
“You have to trust a woman’s sixth sense, it’s best not to get close to Chen Yi.”
“Too dangerous.”
“Hmm.”
…
Time trickled by.
When they came to their senses, it was already the late night of July 31st.
22:12.
In just over one more hour, it would be August.
Tuberculosis Rabbit lay listlessly on the rooftop of Yancheng Garden District, with a cigarette dangling from his mouth, murmuring in a daze: “Feels like it’s been a long time since I’ve had hot pot.”
“What, craving it?”
Chen Yi sat on a chair nearby, trimming his nails. He once obtained a prop, a nail clipper that would never cut the flesh.
In most cases, the prop was a mere trifle and useless.
But in a few specific situations, like now, the prop seemed very practical.
On the rooftop, there were only the two of them, Sword Without End, Jiaye, and the others were staying in their rooms.
“Kind of.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit licked the corner of his mouth, a longing in his throat: “Let’s get more tripe and duck intestines; I haven’t had something spicy in a while.”
“I just don’t really want to go to the hot pot restaurant. I wonder if it’s possible to have the restaurant deliver here, so we can eat on the rooftop?”
“I’ll ask for you.”
Chen Yi contacted the owner of the hot pot restaurant on his list.
The response was quick and straightforward, practically instant.
Being the number one person in the world, also an investor, it’s not just about delivering a hot pot restaurant to the rooftop. Even if you were in hell, they’d have to send people to bring the hot pot to hell.
…
Very quickly, in just twenty minutes.
The steaming spicy broth was already quietly set up in front of Chen Yi and the others, surrounded by a variety of fresh ingredients.
They also provided various small dishes for preparing dipping sauces.
There were also drinks, bowls, utensils, and napkins.
“`
Make the best use of everything.
It was clear that the boss had put a lot of thought into this, and Chen Yi had noticed that the owner of the hotpot restaurant occasionally transferred him several thousand Points, with a note for “profit sharing”.
Although he had never asked for it.
But the hotpot restaurant owner seemed to understand the situation quite well and shared profits weekly.
“Really nice.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit quickly picked up a crisp slice of beef tripe coated in red oil with his chopsticks and stuffed it into his mouth, puffing a few breaths to rapidly cool it down, then chewed contentedly.
“This tripe is tender, perfectly crunchy. Yi, you’ve got to try it.”
Without waiting for Chen Yi’s response, he hastily picked up a slice of lamb roll, blew on it lightly, and stuffed it into his mouth.
After chewing a few times, he swallowed and followed it with a swig of chilled Sour Plum Soup.
The taste.
Indescribable.
Tonight, there would be no sleep again. On the rooftop of the adjacent high-rise, a pair of old smokers stood, cigarettes in mouth, gazing up at the night sky.
Finally… after tonight, they would no longer need to worry about suddenly dropping dead from a smoke.
An hour or so passed quickly in the enjoyment of hotpot.
「Ding!」
A sudden notification sound grabbed everyone’s attention!
「Game Update Announcement!」
「The new version of Blue Star 4.4 will commence a non-stop update at 00:00 on August 1st. The main contents and adjustments of this update are as follows.’
「1. Fixed several player interaction bugs. The bug fixes are as follows:
…*Fixed the bug where only players of opposite genders could verify as a couple. From now on, same-sex players can also verify their couple status*…
…*Fixed the player forum bug. Now players can speak their minds on city forums or global forums through their personal panels and enjoy increased anonymity. Anonymous players can completely hide their information, including IP, when posting*…
…*$%##%$#%%#*…」
「2. Fixed some map bugs. The bug fixes include the following maps:
…*Fixed the bug where the ‘Place of Burial’ map’s boss would often space out, ignoring players who enter*…
…*Fixed the ‘Forsaken Sea’ map’s boss bug where it would frequently deliberately smash its axe into the wall and pretend it was stuck, allowing players to pass through easily*…
…*Fixed the ‘Death Domain’ map, the 2nd ruins abandoned school bug where all ghosts due to special reasons started to flee*…
…*Fixed the ‘Rapid Racing’ map, where in the fourth level, a time-space rift could appear, allowing cars to keep accelerating until reaching tens of thousands of kilometers per hour*…
…*$%##%$#%%#*…」
「3. Added a “Lucky Draw” feature, starting in August, a prize pool will be added.
There are three prize categories: grand prize, second prize, and consolation prize.
The prize pool is shared among all players. 100 Points for one draw, and until the grand prize is won by a player, all Points spent on the draw will continuously upgrade the prize in the pool.
There will only be one grand prize winner.
This means that as long as no one wins the grand prize, the items for the grand prize and second prize in the pool will keep upgrading.
The initial grand prize is a C-grade Prop, which can be upgraded to a maximum of a B-grade Prop.
The player who wins the grand prize will receive the title of Child of Heaven’s Will for one day!
And this title will be forcibly worn; the player cannot choose whether to wear it or not.」
「4: Added the “Deadly Tower” feature. From August, players can form teams to enter the Deadly Tower, the limited-time map for August.
Players without a Squad Creation Order can also enter by forming a team or as a single player, and the system will automatically match teammates.
Each team has a limit of 5 players.
Once a team of 5 is assembled, they will enter the Deadly Tower.
The Deadly Tower has a total of 100 floors, and the first team to clear it will be awarded extremely rare Props and Skills.
For each floor cleared, players will be awarded Deadly Points.
Deadly Points can be used to exchange for Props or Skills in the Deadly Tower shop.
The first 100 teams to clear the tower will receive special rewards.」
「5: Added the ‘Squad Challenge’ feature. If your squad has disputes with another squad, then you, as the squad leader, can initiate a challenge to the other squad.
If the opposing team accepts,
then the other squad will begin selecting the map, and both squads will fight within the map’s rules.
When an entire squad is defeated, the map challenge ends.
PS: A squad can reject another squad’s challenge without any cost. We do not encourage violence, but if you really must solve problems through violence, please do not harm innocent bystanders. Within the map, you are free to showcase your strength unreservedly.」
「6: Added the August rules “No Lying” and “No Backstabbing”.
“No Lying”: All players are not allowed to lie. As adults, you should take responsibility for your own words. However, if your subconscious truly believes that you did not lie, then you are not deemed to have lied.
For example: If you once lost a phone but had amnesia from a car accident and therefore forgot about it, then saying you’ve never lost a phone is not considered lying.
The first three violations will deduct 1000 Points each time.
The fourth violation will result in instant death.
“No Backstabbing”: All players are unable to attack those who show their backs to you. If you attempt to attack a player showing their back to you, your attack upon landing will fail and cause no damage.
As a knight, you should defeat your enemy face-on, not by attacking from behind.
That is the behavior of cowards.
The August rules will last for one month and expire at 00:00 on September 1st.」
「The Snow Sea Project Team wishes all players a happy gaming experience in version 4.4.」
「PS: In the next update preview, the project team has decided to include monthly rules related to “life” elements. Please look forward to it.」
…
PS: Today’s update owes more than ten thousand words, but I’m too sleepy, let me nap a bit and then continue.
Ugh, so sleepy.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 230: 222: "The Hungry Ghost Festival is the ghost festival, what kind of special limited activities could there be?
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 222: “The Hungry Ghost Festival is the ghost festival, what kind of special limited activities could there be?
Over 1000 words of the August update announcement.
One each month, from the very beginning of April, May, June, July, after four consecutive months of update announcements, the August update announcement also arrived.
This also meant that they had officially entered the fifth month of the novice period.
“Phew!”
Hearing the system prompt in his ear, Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a long sigh, lit a cigarette, put it in his mouth, and savored the moment.
“Damn July rules are finally over.”
“Rules like these that go against human nature shouldn’t exist.”
“Every time I looked at version updates in the past, I could never understand why, in the map bug fix list, there would be cases of map bosses slacking off.”
“Now I kind of get it.”
“Turns out some of the NPCs on those maps are old players making cameo appearances, which sounds way more plausible. They’re all on a fixed salary, so why work so hard?”
“How could anyone not slack off at work? It suddenly feels much more reasonable.”
“But the new August rules… Hmm.”
Folding his arms and resting his chin in one hand, Tuberculosis Rabbit pondered for a moment before speaking, “Can’t tell lies? Honestly, this rule feels like it could be triggered so easily.”
“Sometimes lies come out subconsciously. Who can guarantee every word they say is the truth?”
“Unless they’re mute.”
“And that rule about not being able to attack players from behind, that sounds pretty tricky.”
“It’s just as well the God Race arrived in July. If they came in August, it might really be difficult to handle, because…”
The voice of Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly stopped. He had been about to say that not being able to attack from behind could be a bit of a hassle since God Race players could just lie down on the ground and be pretty much invincible.
But then he remembered something.
Bin’s Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle had an enhancement effect that could make bullets shoot up from the ground.
Under the August rules, lying down on the ground might be an invincible tactic for other players, but for Yi, it was like choosing an excellent feng shui spot for himself.
Right at that moment—
Sword Without End came up to the rooftop gasping for air and wiped off the non-existent sweat beads on his forehead, “Phew, I’m exhausted, the August rules have been announced.”
“So, Yi, what do you think? Do you have any ideas?”
“Eh, Yi, why are you two eating hot pot here?”
“And… you didn’t invite me?”
“Sit down.”
Chen Yi took out a new set of disposable bowls and chopsticks from under the table and put them on the table, casually saying, “We were just about to call you, but you came up on your own.”
“Mm-hmm.”
Sword Without End didn’t press further, and instead sat down with a carefree attitude, picked up a chopstick full of tripe covered in chili oil, eagerly put it into his mouth, and chewed with a content expression.
There’s no need to question things too deeply sometimes.
Like when Laffey Cat got lost and was sold to a pet store, and after a week, the owner walked into the store.
Laffey Cat would never ask its owner what made them walk into the pet store that day.
“Yi.”
While he took out a bowl of white rice from his bosom and gulped down the lamb soaked in chili oil, he spoke somewhat unclearly with his mouth full.
“I checked, and there are quite a few well-known holidays this month.”
“For example, The Founding of the Army Day on August 1st, Start of Autumn on August 8th, Qixi Valentine’s Day on August 22nd, and the Hungry Ghost Festival on August 30th.”
“These festivals are quite widespread and should have corresponding special limited-time events. Should we do some preparations in advance?”
“The Hungry Ghost Festival?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully, “The special event for Qixi Valentine’s Day, I can roughly guess the content. Probably not much different from the May 20th Valentine’s event, overall more or less the same.”
“But the Hungry Ghost Festival is Ghost Festival, it’s about ancestors’ worship. What could the special event possibly be?”
“Surely they won’t have Blue Star People and Blue Star Hell players teaming up for a major event, where whoever presents the most gifts to their deceased ancestors takes number one on the leaderboard?”
“Global Number One Filial Child?”
“I have no idea.”
Sword Without End quickly finished his bowl of rice, then picked up a bottle of chilled Sour Plum Soup from the table, guzzled it down, and finally wiped the oil stains from his lips contentedly, “But when I came out from Hell, I got a new Map Access Pass. What do you say? Shall we go in together?”
“Previous special events always started at eight in the morning, and we still have over seven hours until then. We have some time to kill anyway, so why don’t we go download a map first? The Map Reward is a character effect.”
“I’m running low on effects.”
“I’ve nearly crafted them all.”
“If you guys aren’t coming, I’m going on my own.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t speak, but put down his bowl and chopsticks, wiped the oil from the corners of his mouth, and looked up at Chen Yi, waiting for his response.
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yi stood up and looked toward Sword Without End, signaling that he could activate the Map Access Pass.
The next second—
“Whoosh.”
Accompanied by a flash of white light.
「Map Name」: Hide and Seek.
「Map Level」: C-level.
「Map Content」: Players will be divided into two groups, one as Cats, the other as Rats, and will be dropped into a relatively large map to start the chase.
If all players who are playing as rats are captured within the time limit, then the players who are playing as cats win.
And vice versa.
Players who enter the map in a team will automatically be divided into one group.
Each group consists of 20 players.
Players who are playing as cats score by capturing rats, while players who are playing as rats score according to their survival time.
In this map, player death does not mean actual death, but rather they will turn into a ghost and float in the air to watch the ongoing match.
The top five scoring players will receive a reward, while the bottom five will have 500 Points deducted.
“Map Introduction”: In the world of cats, mice are the best plaything, and vice versa… or so it seems.
“It’s like a semi-entertainment map.”
After hearing the prompt in his ear, Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at the seemingly vast map in front of him and casually commented.
An entertainment map is one with no lethal danger.
In the leveling-up game, some maps pose no deadly risk, like the wilderness map they visited before, where players could also revive after death. Such maps are considered semi-entertainment maps.
The reason it’s called semi-entertainment is that there’s still a penalty of losing Points.
Like those couple’s maps, which are pretty much purely entertainment maps.
These kinds of maps usually don’t cause much psychological pressure, and the overall atmosphere is relatively harmonious.
But before they had the chance to fully observe the map before them, they heard a prompt in their ears.
“Ding, there are a total of three rounds in this map!”
“All players will play as cats for one round, as rats for one round, and in the third round, all players will play as rats.”
“During the third round, some NPCs with rich experience in this map will play as cats to capture the players who are playing as rats.”
“The first round, officially begins!”
“Players who are playing as rats, begin to hide!”
“One minute later, players who are playing as cats will open their eyes.”
“Vehicles are not allowed on this map, and when players playing as cats kill those playing as rats, it is considered a successful capture, whereas players playing as rats are not allowed to use attack props or title skills.”
“The capture time limit is fifteen minutes.”
“Turned into a rat, huh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit took a glance around, noticing rows of neatly standing players behind him, each with a small cat doll on their shoulders, all with their eyes tightly closed—these were the players playing as cats who would open their eyes and begin the chase after one minute.
In front of him lay a scene resembling an abandoned castle with moss-covered walls, crumbling bricks, and even several fallen pieces from the castle’s ceiling.
Only the castle gate looked rather majestic.
It must have been around four or five meters high.
By now, quite a few players who had turned into rats were already rushing into the castle to find suitable hiding spots.
The game mode was simple and unrefined.
It wasn’t much different from the hide-and-seek they played when they were younger.
“Hehe.”
Standing aside, Sword Without End’s figure flickered in and out of sight as he moved back and forth, his eyebrows cocked in a self-satisfied manner, “The Prop I got from Death Domain allows me to remain absolutely invisible when I move backwards.”
“Oh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded expressionlessly, “I get it, but can you stop your body from flickering in and out? It looks like a video buffering.”
“Let’s go in.”
Chen Yi glanced at the cat players still closing their eyes behind him. Without lingering, he walked towards the castle entrance with his cane. As a player playing as a rat, he was not allowed to retaliate. Being killed by a player playing as a cat meant he was captured successfully.
Honestly.
He thought the rule was unfair.
Why weren’t the players playing as rats allowed to fight back?
In nature, rats could defend themselves, so why couldn’t they in this map?
Otherwise, why would he even need to hide? All he needed to do was stand at the entrance of the castle, and which cat player could come in?
One man holds the pass, ten thousand are unable to open it.
Knocking down all those players playing as cats right there.
“I’ll go ahead.”
Sword Without End grinned and didn’t head for the entrance to the castle. Instead, he took a step back and disappeared in front of the two, entering a state of Absolute Invisibility.
The most dangerous place is the safest place.
There was really no need for him to find a place to hide inside the castle.
Although the outside of the castle was a vast expanse of grassland with nowhere to hide, who needed to when he could turn invisible? For him, this map was not exactly a walk in the park, but it certainly posed no great difficulty.
Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit paid no attention to Sword Without End and walked confidently into the castle. Inside, the visibility was dim.
At first glance, there were many potential hiding places.
