Like a dilapidated fireplace, cracked floor layers, a recessed alcove in the entrance’s top, or inside the body of a medieval armor statue near the entrance.
All these places were good spots to hide.
And at that moment, indeed, each of these spots was occupied by a player.
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently scanned the meticulously crafted medieval armor statue next to him, and without a word, he remained silent.
That was just too easy to find, wasn’t it?

chapters.title: Chapter 231: 223: "In the face of absolute violence, disguise is useless.
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 223: “In the face of absolute violence, disguise is useless.
This ancient castle had clearly been abandoned for a long time, covered in a thick layer of dust.
The traces left by these players after breaking in were a bit too obvious, like the several large handprints on the medieval armor statue beside him, practically shouting “There’s someone hiding in here.”
Perhaps Tuberculosis Rabbit had stood here too long, which the player inside the statue noticed.
“Stop fucking standing here. Go find a place to hide, and don’t drag me down.”
The player hidden inside the medieval armor statue, although unable to see the outside world, still sensed the commotion and spoke in an annoyed and embarrassed tone.
“Oh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently nodded.
Chen Yi took a quick glance at the interior of the ancient castle, then took out a few small mirrors from his bosom, hiding them in the floor’s interlayer, beneath the door gap, and other places before stepping straight into a mirror.
It was like entering a portal, he stepped through smoothly.
He had a skill that allowed him to pass through mirrors into the Mirror World.
It was a skill he obtained a long time ago, but he had only used it once during the Insect Tide and hadn’t had the opportunity to use it since. Now, using this skill to hide in the Mirror World seemed like a good idea, for what could be used to search for him?
Use their heads to search.
The only thing he was somewhat uncertain about was whether, besides the copper mirror in the first-floor hall of the ancient castle, there were other mirrors in various rooms.
Logically, there should be, but after being deserted for so long, no one knew for certain what the situation was like.
If it turned out that this was the only mirror in the entire castle and a Cat player happened to consume this mirror, then they would be trapped in the Mirror World, unable to leave.
There was a significant restriction to using this skill, which was that he must leave the Mirror World within 10 minutes, or else he would be stuck there permanently.
A mirror is still a mirror, even after it’s shattered.
He wasn’t worried about the other players smashing the mirror; his concern was if a player who had nothing better to do swallowed the copper mirror in one bite and digested it instantly. Although the chances were slim, even a small probability posed a great risk.
So, to be safe, he hid several small mirrors throughout the ancient castle.
That way, even if some lunatic player did swallow the large copper mirror in the first-floor hall, they wouldn’t be permanently trapped in the Mirror World.
“Wait for me, Yi.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit hurriedly followed after him, disappearing in a puff of smoke.
Soon, the two of them vanished in front of the copper mirror, without a trace.
…
“Hmm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, staying in the Mirror World, supported his chin in thought and looked through the mirror at the ancient castle’s hall outside: “This skill really has strong voyeuristic qualities. Lucky it’s in your hands, Yi. If it fell into the hands of some crook, it could be pretty bad.”
Although Chen Yi maintained a calm expression, he still nodded in agreement.
The voyeuristic aspect of this skill was indeed a bit too strong.
The Mirror World was pitch black.
There was a feeling of solidity beneath his feet, yet he couldn’t see anything, and the mirrors were like skylights in a dark room, allowing a clear view of the ancient castle’s interior through the mirror.
But the people outside the mirror couldn’t see into the Mirror World at all.
If… some sicko decided to hide inside the mirror on a girl’s dresser to peep, well, there would be nothing one could do about it.
Especially since some bedrooms have a big mirror installed on the ceiling, it would offer a perfect immersive angle for their enjoyment.
It wasn’t long before—
The one-minute countdown ended!
The players acting as Cats had already rushed in to catch people!
“Ding, player Li Ping has been eliminated first!”
Almost immediately as the Cat players broke in, a player wielding a huge axe chopped down the player hiding at the entrance inside the medieval armor statue!
Not much time had passed since the start.
A brutal, immediate death.
“See.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit clicked his tongue with a hint of emotion: “I told you that spot was too eye-catching. It’s like they were begging to be found.”
Then.
The fireplace inside, broken interlayers in the floor, the recessed secret compartment above the entrance door.
The players hiding there were also successively discovered, as normal people would feel these spots were possible hiding places upon first glance and naturally wouldn’t pass up searching them thoroughly.
In just 5 minutes of the official pursuit.
11 players had been eliminated.
Only 9 players were still hiding.
Among these 9 players, Chen Yi and his companions accounted for three.
By continuously moving in the Mirror World, they also discovered that the ancient castle was filled with many mirrors, so they were not worried about the time limit or finding a mirror to leave the Mirror World when necessary.
At that moment.
They were in a conference hall on the second floor of the ancient castle.
The hall looked like a wax figure exhibition.
About twenty or thirty wax figures were crowded inside.
At that moment, three players disguised as cats were chopping away at the statues with their weapons, one by one.
Indeed.
This map had many rules, but it never said that players impersonating cats couldn’t destroy the environment.
So these players didn’t even bother to distinguish whether any of the wax figures hid new players—they simply hacked at each one.
It was exceedingly crude and simple.
“Ding, player Wu Ermao has been eliminated.”
Another player was eliminated.
“Tsk.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head with some regret, “Actually, that player’s disguise was pretty good; I couldn’t tell which were wax figures and which were real people just now. But it can’t withstand indiscriminate attacks.”
“In the face of absolute violence, disguise is useless.”
Now, only 8 players remained.
The number of hiding players was dwindling, step by step.
…
Meanwhile, in the sky above the castle, 12 players who had been eliminated were engaged in discussion.
“Chen Yi is in the same map as us?”
“I saw him, he and Tuberculosis Rabbit seem… to be hiding inside a mirror? They must have used some prop, I always knew that for players of their level, such a difficulty map couldn’t possibly challenge them.”
“Then there’s Sword Without End, also a member of Chen Yi’s team. That guy’s been moonwalking like Michael Jackson outside the castle the whole time, continuously sliding backward and staying invisible. Those people haven’t noticed him at all.”
“Isn’t that obvious, if he’s invisible, how could they notice.”
“The few people on Chen Yi’s team, two are hiding inside a mirror, and one is invisible; it feels like they are using props designed for peeping.”
“Eh? What about that person in the backyard?”
A voice drew everyone’s attention there.
In the backyard of the castle, on the grassy grounds, there was a hole about half a meter deep.
In the pit at that moment, a player disguised as a Rat was laying flat, sticking close to the ground inside the hole.
Around the pit, three or four players impersonating Cats stood with faces full of confusion and speechlessness, somewhat at a loss for what to do.
…
“How do we handle this?”
By the pit in the backyard of the castle, a player impersonating a Cat squatted in front of the pit, poking helplessly with the long sword in his hand towards the Rat player lying face-down inside, his eyes filled with frustration.
They had found him, but they couldn’t kill him.
According to the game rules, they had to kill this player for the capture to count.
But their swords, which normally could kill a Minotaur Monster with a single stroke, were completely ineffective against the player lying in the pit.
New rules for August.
All players couldn’t harm those who had their backs towards them.
The player in the pit laid there so brazenly, without a way for them to do anything; any attack was unable to harm him.
They did try to pull the player out of the pit.
If they couldn’t attack, surely a little pull wouldn’t hurt, right?
It turned out to be feasible.
But the problem was, the Rat player in the pit must have used some prop that made his body as heavy as a thousand pounds; they simply couldn’t drag him out.
Unless… unless they dug a deep hole next to it, then tunneled through, the tunnel’s exit coming up right under the player’s belly.
That way, they could successfully attack him.
But the issue was… with only 6 minutes left until the end of the first round, there definitely wasn’t enough time for them to do so.
“Bury him.”
After a moment of contemplation, another Cat player standing by provided a solution. Since they couldn’t harm or forcibly drag him out, why not just bury him directly? This didn’t violate the August rules.
They hadn’t attacked the player in the pit.
They simply shoveled a bit more dirt onto his body.
“Ding, player…”
“Another one down.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit clicked his tongue with some regret, about to say something, when once again, a prompt sounded in his ears.
“Ding, in 30 seconds, there will only be five minutes left for capture time.”
“Players impersonating Rats can choose to transform into any of the items displayed on the panel in front of them during this time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 232: 224: They are actually in the same map with this perverted new player.
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 224: They are actually in the same map with this perverted new player.
As this prompt faded.
Darkness suddenly enveloped everyone’s vision.
The players acting as cats stayed put in pitch-blackness and were all teleported to the entrance of the ancient castle, unable to make any moves for 30 seconds.
Meanwhile, players acting as rats were presented with a series of items to choose from for their disguise.
Some chose to become a piece of chewing gum, which, despite being out of place in the medieval-style castle, was so tiny that it was virtually impossible to find when hidden in a secluded corner.
Others transformed into a load-bearing wall and hid inside a room, mumbling to themselves that “the bigger, the more reasonable.”
Even more audacious was the player who turned into a towering tree, even taller than the castle, planted just outside the fortress walls.
And so—
A game of cat and mouse, a playful hide and seek, began.
As for Chen Yi…
Chen Yi looked at one of the options with a peculiar expression.
“Disguise Option – Play as the player acting as a cat.”
Choosing this option would allow one to disguise as one of the players acting as cats, infiltrating the enemy’s ranks.
For other players, this option might be viable.
But for him,
This disguise option was no different from a trap.
After all, the titles above his head were like beacons, clearly visible even in the darkness of night, and his face—well-known to almost every player in Blue Star, if not etched into the memory of all of them.
Under these circumstances,
Choosing this disguise option was tantamount to seeking death.
Yet, he still chose it.
There was one reason for that.
Below this option was an additional line of text.
“After choosing this disguise option, you will possess the ability to use offensive props or skills.”
And when Tuberculosis Rabbit saw Yi choosing this disguise, he also couldn’t help but crack a smile and silently followed along.
…
30 seconds quickly elapsed.
Sword Without End became a Cangtian Giant Tree, eyes tightly shut, standing at the entrance of the castle, his mind full of the sage words of a hide-and-seek champion he once knew!
The bigger, the more reasonable, the bigger, the more reasonable!
“We’re back!”
All the players playing as cats, who had been teleported to the entrance of the castle, grinned wickedly and rolled up their sleeves. After exchanging glances, they prepared to enter the castle to root out those rats disguised as objects!
However, it was in this glance,
Some sharp-eyed individuals thought they noticed something odd.
“Uh… do we have a player with so many titles on our team?”
A player, puzzled, tilted his head to look at the player by his side, whose nearly 20 titles were so high that it made his neck sore from craning. Meanwhile, the other players, hearing his voice, all turned to look at this player with the 20 titles.
“Isn’t that Chen Yi?”
Someone quickly recognized Chen Yi.
“Is Chen Yi on our team?”
Before these players could fully grasp the situation,
Chen Yi, leaning on his cane with one hand, slightly lifted the corners of his mouth and began to smile kindly.
The next second—
A massive Crimson Ice Palace crashed from the sky, enveloping all the players in front of him.
“Boom!!!”
The thunderous impact resounded in every player’s ears!
The ground itself couldn’t help but tremble several times.
Paste-like flesh and blood slowly seeped out from beneath the palace.
“Tsk.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat regretfully squatted down, extended a hand to pick up a strip of shredded flesh, and remarked, “This paste-like minced meat is perfect for making canned cat food.”
“Ding, detection of the entire team of players acting as cats, all deceased. Thus, the team of players acting as rats has claimed victory in the first round.”
“Player Chen Yi is awarded MVP of this round!”
“Now playing your MVP anthem to all, knock2–Impact Star*(StatTrak)*”
…
“…”
“…”
As all the players returned to the entrance of the castle to await the arrival of the second round,
The expressions on everyone’s face could generally be categorized into three types:
Calm, grinning, and bewildered.
Chen Yi was the calm one, Tuberculosis Rabbit was the grinning one, and all the others belonged to the bewildered category.
Whether they were the rat players who had just watched from above or the cat players who had been outright suppressed in the blink of an eye, including Sword Without End, who had played as the Cangtian Giant Tree, they were all somewhat bewildered now.
What happened to the hide and seek we were promised?
Did it need to be this brutal?
However, they weren’t given much time to react.
A prompt once again sounded in the ears of all players.
“The second round now officially begins!”
“Players acting as rats, please begin your hiding!”
The roles have switched!
This time, Chen Yi and the others became the players acting as cats, while those who were cats in the first round were now the second team of players.
After one minute.
Tuberculosis Rabbit slowly opened his eyes, ready to search the castle for the hiding rats. Suddenly though, his body stiffened, and with a strange look on his face, he walked to a pit that had appeared out of nowhere at the entrance of the castle. He looked down at the bottom of the pit, where twenty players lay on the ground, holding hands in perfect order.
“Did you dig your own grave?”
The players posing as Rats didn’t hide inside the ancient castle but instead dug a hole at the entrance and jumped in to hide.
Clearly, they were planning to use the August rule to avoid Chen Yi’s pursuit.
“Brothers!”
And at this time—
The player lying on the bottom of the deep pit shouted, “Listen to me, all we have to do is lie flat on the ground, exposing our backs, and he can’t do anything to us, Chen Yi’s palace can’t cause us the slightest harm!”
“But we can bury you alive,” Tuberculosis Rabbit said somewhat oddly.
“Ridiculous!”
The player on the bottom of the pit scoffed and replied, “Do you think you’re playing a game? If there’s an action of killing, does the person die?”
“A person buried alive at this depth can breathe through the gaps in the soil for 3-5 minutes!”
“Even longer if they’re not panicking!”
“After 5 minutes, they’ll fall unconscious, note that it’s not death, but unconsciousness!”
“Generally speaking, the time limit for a person buried alive is 15 minutes, as long as it doesn’t exceed 15 minutes, there’s still hope for rescue, meaning that being buried alive for 15 minutes won’t result in death, only continuous unconsciousness!”
“And I have a prop that can maintain a high oxygen environment for 5 minutes!”
“I don’t even need to be unconscious to easily survive the burial crisis!”
“They say Chen Yi is the god among Blue Star players.”
“But, sorry—”
“This time, we are going to slay a god!”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit squatted expressionlessly next to the deep pit, looking at the boastful player lying at the bottom, and fell silent, scratching his head. It had been a while since he had encountered someone so arrogantly vocal.
“Not only do we want to slay a god, but we also want to…”
The player in the pit, as if realizing this could help stall for time, didn’t wait for Tuberculosis Rabbit to speak and continued to taunt. However, he had barely begun when his voice abruptly stopped!
Suddenly, seventy to eighty bullets shot out from the bottom of the pit.
And with them, sprays of blood.
Everything… went quiet.
‘Ding, detection of the complete death of the team playing as Rats, hence, the team playing as Cats wins the first level.’
‘This level’s MVP is the player Chen Yi!’
‘Now playing your MVP triumphal march knock2—Impact Star* (StatTrak)*’
…
All the players once again gathered at the entrance of the ancient castle.
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced sentimentally at the player who had just made big claims and was now utterly baffled. If these kids had just hidden, they would have needed to spend some time searching for them, but they dug their own graves instead.
Really… so thoughtful.
He suddenly realized there was an extremely sinister aspect to the August rule.
Attacking a player’s back is not allowed, and all hits landing on a player’s back would be ineffective.
It sounded very powerful.
Basically, all players, when encountering danger in August, would likely instinctively lie down on the ground to avoid other players’ attacks.
But if at that moment, a player happens to have a prop or skill that allows them to attack from below the ground.
Then basically… it would be a sure hit.
Chen Yi looked around without much reaction. The map was rather boring, and the rewards were mediocre. If it hadn’t been for Sword Without End’s invitation, he wouldn’t have come to this kind of map. It felt like playing with little kids.
And at this time—
‘The third round officially begins!’
‘All players will play as the Rats, and some NPCs familiar with this map will act as Cats to catch the players acting as Rats.’
‘NPC transfer in progress!’
As the voice ended,
Several beams of white light suddenly flashed before them!
Before seeing anyone, a sinister laugh rang out.
“Finally, I’ve managed to snatch this NPC slot on the map where we bully the newbies again.”
“Exactly, getting beaten up outside every day, only by bullying newbies can we find any pleasure.”
“Go hide, newbies, but just a kind reminder, we are very familiar with this map. No matter where you hide, we will find you.”
“Hehehe, no wonder the villains in novels like to laugh like this; laughing this way really feels great.”
Following this, seven NPCs appeared in front of them, dressed in various outfits. Three of them even had lizard heads.
The NPCs who were previously sneering froze upon seeing the title above Chen Yi’s head.
The first reaction.
This newbie player has quite a few titles above his head.
The second reaction.
Let me see what worthless titles there are… one ‘One-Man Exterminates a Clan,’ one ‘Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans.’
As expected, they’re all… Huh?
The third reaction.
That face looks familiar, like I’ve seen it in a live stream somewhere.
The fourth reaction.
“…”
The seven NPCs that had just landed turned pale in an instant, their mouths twitching crazily, bodies involuntarily stepping back, their eyes filled with extreme fear as they looked at Chen Yi standing in the front of the crowd!
Isn’t this the new player freak who just wiped out a clan not long ago?!
They considered themselves old players!
But it was the first time they heard of a clan being wiped out!
And it was done by a new player.
What’s terrifying is that they ended up in the same map as this freak of a new player.
What’s even more terrifying is—
They were on the opposing side.
SEND GIFT
1

chapters.title: Chapter 233: 225: "Prop Name": Last Words.
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 225: “Prop Name”: Last Words.
“Exit, exit, exit…”
Among the seven NPCs that had just descended, one of them, with trembling fingers, kept pressing the dim exit button in the void, but to no avail. Clearly, this map was not designed to allow NPCs to exit easily.
“It’s fine, it’s alright!”
At this moment, one of the seven NPCs, a man whose stature was rather burly, steadied his breathing, took a deep breath, and with determination in his eyes, spoke slowly and firmly as he held his weapon and focused on Chen Yi.
“No problem!”
“Remember, we are the Cats, and he is but a Rat!”
“No matter how strong he is, within this map, he’s at our mercy!”
Chen Yi nodded calmly, lifted his eyelids to glance at the NPC who seemed strong-willed, and instantly activated his Starry Level title “One Man Exterminates a Clan”!
The next second—
The terrifying killing intent accumulated from exterminating a clan, as if made tangible, suddenly compressed the entire space!
It was as if Mount Tai was bearing down on them, pushing towards those seven NPCs!
The temperature in the air plummeted to several degrees below zero in an instant!
What was once a somewhat hot climate now felt like being thrown into the Arctic in a split second!
The Blue Star players nearby, while not the primary targets of the murderous aura, were affected nonetheless, and even that left them all huddled together, shivering uncontrollably!
It was their first time feeling killing intent as something that had substance!
In the past, when they read novels that described how a protagonist’s killing intent would terrify enemies to the point of wetting themselves, they always thought it was an extremely exaggerated writing technique. Now it didn’t seem exaggerated at all—this was realism!
“Thud, thud.”
Sword Without End instinctively felt his teeth chatter and silently changed his position to stand behind Chen Yi, grabbing hold of Tuberculosis Rabbit’s chest, and suddenly felt much better.
How to describe that feeling?
It was like having a thousand-pound hammer pressing against your chest, unable to breathe, gasping for air, extremely oppressive and uncomfortable.
It was like standing on the edge of an abyss, ready to fall at any moment.
Too terrifying…
Sword Without End and the Blue Star players were just collateral damage.
The seven NPCs who were the main targets were now on their knees on the ground, heads buried deep in the dirt, their shivering bodies at a frequency that would stir the heart of a middle-aged woman.
If only… it was always this rapid, that’d be great.
“Get up, all of you!!!”
It must be said, there was never a shortage of people with backbone. The NPC who had first spoken, despite not being able to withstand the pressure of the killing intent and falling to his knees, didn’t dare meet Chen Yi’s gaze. His voice trembled but was surprisingly powerful as he roared.
“Don’t all act like cowards!”
“The third phase is about to begin. When Chen Yi turns into a mouse and can’t attack, wouldn’t that give us the chance to do whatever we please?!”
“We are at least…”
He couldn’t finish his words before hearing a voice as light as a feather by his ear.
“Friend, from which planet are you?”
“…”
The burly man who had been encouraging his comrades to struggle just now stiffened abruptly, and with difficulty lifted his head to meet Chen Yi’s gaze. He gave a wry smile, drew a dagger from his bosom, and without a word plunged it fiercely into his own chest!
“Sir Yi, I was wrong.”
“I’m an orphan, just popped out into the universe, without a planet.”
“May we meet again if fate allows.”
Then, fearing that he might die too slowly, he pulled out the blood-soaked dagger and stabbed himself in the chest a few more times, before finally lying satisfaction in a pool of blood. In his dying moments, he had only one thought.
Never again would he come to this map to be an NPC.
It wasn’t that he lost his nerve.
He simply didn’t want to drag his own planet into this mess.
If an ordinary person asked this question, it was definitely because they planned to seek vengeance on his planet; to this, he certainly wouldn’t cower. Let them come; what was there to fear?
Whoever flinches is a grandson!
But when Chen Yi asked this question, it wasn’t for vengeance, it was with the intention of casually dealing with the planet altogether.
His dying once was no big deal, but he couldn’t allow himself to be tortured into revealing his planet, thereby bringing trouble to it.
He was a hero!
The six NPCs behind this man now moved in unison, raising the daggers in their hands, drawing a circle in the air, and then driving them straight into their own chests.
“Ding, detecting that all players of the Cat faction have died, players of the Rat faction win the first phase.”
“The MVP of this round is player Null!”
Looking enviously at Chen Yi’s retreating figure, Sword Without End suddenly felt that he had gained a new understanding of seeking vengeance.
Worthy of Yi, life was full of lessons.
“Map ending, commencing settlement…”
…
“Hey, Li Peiqi!”
Li Peiqi sat cross-legged on her pink bed, leaning against the headboard with a vacant look towards the ceiling. Hearing someone call her name, she absentmindedly hugged a doll to her chest, her voice low and listless.
“What’s up? Can’t you not call me? Don’t you see I’m really annoyed?”
“Annoyed about what?”
“What do you think?”
Li Peiqi swept a glance at her close friend with annoyance, “What else could it be? It’s Mr. Sun, of course. Mr. Sun invited me to dinner again; what should I do?”
“Tsk tsk,”
The woman in the room wearing a camisole dress said, laughing while she patted foundation onto her face, “Mr. Sun is truly devoted to you. In my opinion, you might as well just accept him, considering the Sun Family Guild’s influence is no small matter.”
“It ranks among the top on Neutron Star.”
“Besides, haven’t you always just flat-out refused before? You’re not some lowly underling in the Black Dragon Guild; Mr. Sun wouldn’t dare force himself on you. Why are you so troubled today?”
“Ah!!!”
Li Peiqi suddenly became restless and started clutching at her hair, about to cry in her frustration, exclaiming, “This time it’s a big deal!!!”
“Mr. Sun’s family has made it clear in this meeting that they want to participate in the plan to use Chen Yi to pit the wolves against the tigers!”
“You know!”
“My sixth sense has always been accurate. According to my sixth sense, it’s not just about being an enemy to Chen Yi – it’s best not to have any contact with him at all to stay safe!”
“The chairman asked me to deliver a message to Chen Yi in Blue Star Hell, and that was already the limit of what I could handle. I finally convinced my chairman not to make a move against Chen Yi, thinking I was finally in a safe situation; and now the Sun Family’s power has freaking barged in!”
“You tell me—”
“If Chen Yi comes out and finds out he’s been used, what will he do?”
“Would he also take care of the person Mr. Sun has been fond of along the way?”
“Yes.”
The woman sitting at the foot of the bed in a camisole nightdress thought for a moment and then nodded seriously, “That’s a logical conclusion. So, what do you plan to do, openly declare your rejection?”
“That way, when Chen Yi settles scores later, he could spare you?”
“But I need to remind you that by openly declaring your rejection, there’s a very high chance you’ll offend the Sun Family Guild behind Mr. Sun.”
“One is a crisis that looms before you; the other is a crisis that lies in the future.”
“Personally, I’d say avoiding the immediate crisis is more important, right?”
Li Peiqi slowly closed her eyes, staring at her nest-like hair, and after a long silence, she suddenly opened her eyes, shining with determination.
“I’ve thought of a solution!”
“What solution? Casually finding a man to announce a love affair, tactfully rejecting Mr. Sun?”
“No, I’ve decided to kill Mr. Sun. That way, there will be no future for Mr. Sun to provoke Chen Yi and involve me in that chain of causality. The best way to sever a potential future causality is to cut off the chain of causality before it begins!”
“…”
The woman beside her suddenly stiffened, her mouth twitching for a while before she managed to speak somewhat incredulously, “Are you serious? If you kill Mr. Sun, you’ll be facing big trouble. It feels like maybe you’re too afraid of Chen Yi.”
“He might be strong, but is he worth being so fearful of?”
“You don’t understand.”
Li Peiqi suddenly got her spirits up, got ready to go out, and said, “Any causality that will lead to Chen Yi killing me in the future must be severed!”
“Do you remember that prop of mine?”
“You mean…”
The woman’s eyes narrowed suddenly, tentatively responding, “Last Words?”
“Exactly.”
Li Peiqi, now dressed in business attire, shook her head somberly and shared the prop panel with the woman before her.
‘Prop Name’: Last Words.
‘Prop Level’: A-Level.
‘Prop Effect’: This prop reveals how you will die in the future, updating daily at midnight.
‘Prop Introduction’: “A life without regrets is an imperfect one.” — Blinded by Poverty said.
‘PS: You will die at the hands of Chen Yi of Blue Star, time unknown.’
“You know,”
Li Peiqi looked earnestly at her best friend, “This prop is the only A-Level prop I have. With it, I’ve avoided numerous crises. Not even the chairman knows about it; I’ve only confided in you.”
“I will not provoke Chen Yi!”
“Absolutely not!”
“The only reason I would die at his hands is if some damn beast drags me into it!”
“So Mr. Sun must die!”
Before meeting Chen Yi, her manner of death often changed as well.
For example.
‘Death from kidney failure due to diabetes.’
During that time, she quickly reduced her sugar intake, and soon enough, the manner of her death changed.
‘Death from choking due to vomiting while drunk.’
She gave up drinking altogether!
Or for instance, she only entered the map at 23:59 each night and at no other time would she go into the map.
When she prepared herself mentally to enter the map, she would focus intently on the ‘Last Words’ prop panel, and if the updated cause of death after midnight was—
‘You will die on the xxx map.’
She would simply choose not to enter that map and wanted it to roll as far away as possible!
If the cause of death was unrelated to that map, she would confidently enter it.
Relying on this, she had managed to live well so far.

chapters.title: Chapter 234: 226: "You will die at the hands of Blue Star player Chen Yi, time unknown.
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 226: “You will die at the hands of Blue Star player Chen Yi, time unknown.
Although she knew that the death mentioned here meant falling into hell and becoming a Hell Player, not actual death—after all, only dying as a Hell Player is true death—she never wished to become a Hell Player.
Fighting her way back out would be no simple matter.
But…
Ever since she left Chen Yi’s live stream not long ago,
her predicted death for the next entire half-month had only one description!
“You will die at the hands of Blue Star player Chen Yi, time unknown.”
It never changed!
She swore!
She wouldn’t provoke Chen Yi for any reason, absolutely not, things like provocation were out of the question; having no family, there wouldn’t be any revenge plot. So why would she die by Chen Yi’s hand?
There was only one reason!
She was dragged into this by that damn beast!
Someone must have provoked Chen Yi, and then Chen Yi conveniently killed her too!
This kind of death was unclear and extremely unjust.
It made her irritable during this period. She did nothing, so why should she die at Chen Yi’s hand?
“…”
The best friend who was about to say something fell silent for a moment then nodded quite seriously, “It must have been Mr. Sun who dragged you into this. I’ll go with you.”
“That’s what I think too.”
Li Peiqi nodded emphatically, agreeing wholeheartedly.
All her relatives had passed away; the Annihilate Nine Clans skill couldn’t possibly drag her into this, which meant she wasn’t affected by some unknown AOE but was specifically targeted and killed by Chen Yi.
No matter how fearsome, Chen Yi wouldn’t kill without reason; there had to be a causality thread somewhere.
She had to sever all possible causality threads that could involve her before Chen Yi left Newbie Village!
This Mr. Sun was the first one!
Just as she was preparing to leave,
“Thump.”
She suddenly noticed a cell phone had fallen out of the cabinet.
“Hmm?”
Li Peiqi picked up the cell phone subconsciously, wiped the dust off it—it was from seven or eight years ago. After the screen broke back then, she bought a new one, and she had no idea where she had tossed the old one. It unexpectedly fell out today.
On a whim,
she plugged the charger into the cellphone and turned it on. Inside the gallery, she found many photos she took seven or eight years ago and some diary entries.
“Hey, I won’t show you!”
She pushed away her best friend who tried to peek over her shoulder.
“I remember now.”
Her best friend, with mischief sparkling in her eyes and the corners of her mouth turned up, teased, “I recall you were in university then, and you teased a middle school boy, using this phone, didn’t you?”
“Seems like it, indeed.”
Reminded by her best friend, Li Peiqi also recalled such an incident when she met a cute young boy at 14 in a game during her university days.
When gaming, she kept teasing that young boy,
saying things like, “Sister likes you, be my boyfriend, okay?”
and the like.
Later, after switching phones and messaging apps, she forgot about the incident, and a few years later, the realm of games ascended.
She instinctively opened the messaging app on the phone.
“Ding-dong, ding-dong!”
Suddenly, tens of thousands of messages popped up densely!
“Peiqi, today marks the 36th day since you disappeared. I’ve made it to King rank, you’re so bad at this. ”
“…”
“I saved up a month’s allowance and got you a yearly membership. You’ll see it when you log in, huh, I’m so good to you.”
“…”
“The membership’s about to expire, and you haven’t gone online. Did you vanish?”
“…”
“I reported to the police, but they said there wasn’t enough identity information for a case, and they suggested you might be a scammer. I don’t believe it; what scammer has time to play games every day?”
“…”
“Baby, didn’t you tell me to be your boyfriend? I did accept, so why did you disappear all of the sudden?”
“…”
“I’ve been working out recently, already got an eight-pack. Check out my current photo, it’s devastatingly handsome, let me tell you. Many girls chase after me, but I rejected them all; none looks as pretty as you, sister.”
“…”
“Sis, it’s been 721 days since you disappeared; I have no idea where you went. But today, all of a sudden, a voice rang out by everyone’s ears around the world, saying something about the ‘April Rule’ descending and a lot of people dying. Are you safe, sis?”
“…”
“Peiqi, I can’t wait for you anymore. This boss is way too strong; I might die. I’m dying with so much regret, I haven’t found you yet.”
“…”
“Hehe, Peiqi, I’m alive again. I just found out that after dying, you become a Hell Player and there’s a chance to return to Neutron Star. I’m going to keep looking for you.”
“…”
“It’s over, I’m going to die again. The rules of this map are far too twisted. But it’s okay, I should be able to climb out of hell soon, after all, I haven’t found my sister yet.”
This was the last message.
Left from one year and three months ago.
Obviously, the little boy who had been leaving messages on the screen didn’t make it out of hell for the last time.
After reading all the messages, Li Peiqi sat on the edge of her bed, a bit dazed, not knowing what to say.
She was only joking at the time—who would date an underage boy?
During the time she switched accounts, that boy shared what happened every day with her, without fail, until one year and three months ago.
“…”
Sitting next to her on the bed, her best friend couldn’t help her eyes from reddening slightly: “Why haven’t I met such a devoted boy? I would definitely cherish him. Peiqi, you seem to owe quite a big debt of love this time.”
Li Peiqi, after being lost in thought for a while, suddenly snapped back to reality, turned her head to her best friend, and spoke urgently.
“I’ve got it!”
“In the future, I’m bound to meet this boy in hell again, and I’ll be moved by him and end up together with him!”
“But by then, this boy would have already become an enemy to Chen Yi, who casually killed me along with him!”
“Do you think there’s a chance there’s a causal thread where I die at Chen Yi’s hand?”
“Could this boy possibly still be in hell right now, just not able to climb out?”
“…”
Her best friend, moved a moment before, suddenly stiffened, wiping away the tear at the corner of her eye, and spoke expressionlessly with a faint voice: “So you plan to run to Neutron Star’s hell, have this infatuated boy killed, and thus sever a potential love thread that could lead to your death by Chen Yi’s hand?”
“Isn’t that a bit too heartless?”
“No, my point is, we could talk to him, ask him not to provoke Chen Yi in the future, to avoid this causal link.”
“I’ll contact ‘Ghost Exterminators’ right now, to help us find this boy in the Neutron Star’s hell.”
‘Ghost Exterminators’, a special force on Neutron Star!
Its main business includes seeking revenge in hell, searching for people, and so on—basically undertaking only tasks in hell.
The core members of the force are all in hell, with only a few peripheral members taking orders on Neutron Star. This force possesses a special prop, enabling Hell Players to communicate with players in the living world.
The woman in the slip dress sitting on the bed turned to Li Peiqi, who was beginning to be bewildered, couldn’t help but sigh, looking up at the ceiling helplessly.
Sometimes, learning about the way you will die is actually not such good news.
Like Li Peiqi.
Anxious from tens of days ago and still is now.
She just couldn’t figure out how she would end up dying by Chen Yi’s hand.
But… aren’t there many things in the world that don’t make sense?
…
Meanwhile—
Chen Yi and his companions had successfully returned to the rooftop.
The hotpot on the rooftop, which was still hot but lighted, hadn’t solidified together; they didn’t really like spicy hotpot, preferring clear oil hotpot instead.
Afterward, the few of them sat on the rooftop, chatting idly.
Until, the time reached eight in the morning.
“Ding, global announcement.”
“The special limited-time event ‘The Founding of the Army Day’ starts at…”
…
ps:
I slacked off for a day yesterday, took a day off the day before.
And yet, no one scolded me, which made me feel much better…
As for comments in the comment section like, talking is as useless as farting, threatening to delete the book and rest, promises about the monthly tickets being as good as farts.
I always take such comments as compliments.
At least it shows that everyone likes reading, hence the outrage. I checked your IPs, and you’re indeed all original residents of Black Trench City.
This hide and seek map was actually due to a lack of inspiration, forcibly produced. I thought everyone would berate the map for being abrupt and boring.
But I only got berated for the update, which makes me feel much better.
I’ll make up with three more chapters today to find a bit of my writing rhythm, and slowly it’ll get better.
Love you all, your little treasure, Wang Xin.
Trojan horse.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: 227: "The Extraterrestrial Event!
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 227: “The Extraterrestrial Event!
“Ding, global announcement!”
“Special limited event ‘The Founding of the Army Day’ is officially starting from August 1st to August 3rd, at 08:00 AM!”
“All players can participate in this event during these three days.”
“Event one: ‘Military Might Unstoppable!'”
“Crackle crackle crackle crackle crackle…”
The event announcement had only sounded halfway when it suddenly stopped abruptly, and a piercing noise began to sound as if a radio had suddenly developed a fault and stuck.
“Uh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was somewhat bewildered as he fiddled with his ears, nudging Sword Without End who was sitting beside him, “Did your event announcement finish playing?”
“Mine suddenly got stuck halfway through the announcement and turned into a piercing noise.”
“Even the event panel suddenly got covered with a mosaic.”
“I only had time to see that there were three activities in this special limited event, I hadn’t yet looked closely at what they were before it all got covered up by a mosaic.”
“Same here.”
Sword Without End also scratched his head in confusion, “I thought it was a bug on my end, I was about to contact customer service.”
“Could it be the same for everyone?”
The two exchanged glances, then simultaneously turned to look towards Chen Yi, who was lying on a lounge chair nearby.
Chen Yi lay there lazily with sunglasses on, casually lifting his hand to indicate that the same had happened to him.
If it was the same for all of them,
Then it wasn’t a problem specific to the three of them. Clearly, it was the same for everyone.
And at that moment—
Jiaye and Tie Chui pushed open the anti-theft door to the rooftop and came up, “Yi, we’ve checked the forums, and all players are experiencing the same thing. It’s been stuck for a minute now.”
“So far, there have been no changes.”
“The consensus on the forums is… it’s a bug.”
“After all, the Snow Sea Project Team doesn’t seem to be entirely run by AI. It seems reasonable for a bug to occur, but no one knows exactly what’s happening so far.”
“There are also new suspicions.”
Jiaye hesitated for a moment but still sat down on a low stool next to Chen Yi, leaning on his knees, with hands supporting his head as he looked towards Chen Yi.
“Some people on the forum say that it’s because you, Yi, exploited some bug to obtain props that shouldn’t be obtainable at this stage, triggering a game bug.”
“They say the game is trying to figure out how to ‘kill you off,’ i.e., fix the bug that you are.”
“Mmm.”
Chen Yi nodded lightly, lying calmly in the chair, gently patting Jiaye’s head without speaking. He knew all too well that every prop he had obtained was legitimate for players to have at this stage.
He had never exploited any bugs to gain props that shouldn’t have been obtainable.
The only title that seemed somewhat outrageous was the ‘Wife Slayer’ title.
It allowed him to have an hour of cooldown-free super abilities.
He had acquired this title from the ‘Life Theater’ map after completing a hidden task.
He had thought he would never have the opportunity to use this title.
But he couldn’t escape the so-called ‘True Fragrance Law.’
The only thing that puzzled him was that although the hidden task on this map was difficult and not so easy to complete, with so many planets out there, surely someone else must have completed the hidden tasks on this map, right?
Unless…
Unless the ‘Life Theater’ map was exclusive to Blue Star?
That seemed somewhat unlikely.
After all, acquiring the Map Access Pass for this map didn’t take much effort. It was basically handed to him when Sword Without End came to trade for a C-grade or D-grade Fashion Component.
Wait a second—
A possibility suddenly surfaced in Chen Yi’s mind. He slid his sunglasses up to his forehead and turned to Sword Without End with a raised eyebrow.
“Do you remember our first meeting?”
“Of course, I remember.”
Sword Without End looked at Chen Yi questioningly, “Why are you bringing that up all of a sudden? Does it have anything to do with the event bug?”
“No, I just wanted to know if the real reason you came straight to me back then was just to exchange for that Fashion Component I had?”
“Of course, what other reason could there be?”
Sword Without End said helplessly with a shrug, “The map showed that the last Fashion Component was with you. To complete a set of fashion, I obviously had to get it from you.”
“Yi, why are you suddenly asking this?”
“It’s nothing. Where did you get that ‘Life Theater Pass’ you traded with me for the Fashion Component?”
“Oh, that thing? Didn’t I mention it to you last time? I got it as a reward after completing a B-grade Heart Demon map.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded, eyes narrowing slightly without a word, but there was a thoughtful glint in the depths of his gaze.
He was not given much time to think.
The event announcement, which had been crackling with static noise, finally resumed, and the event panel in front of him no longer had any mosaics—except the list of event activities had disappeared, leaving only a brief message.
“Ding, due to some unforeseen circumstances, the special limited global event scheduled for August 1st to August 3rd has been temporarily cancelled. We hope all players understand.”
“To make it up to all players, we invite everyone to plan an event that belongs to all of us.”
“In the next 8 hours, all players can plan a limited global event and vote at the window. After the countdown ends, the event with the most votes will replace The Founding of the Army Day event as the special limited global event.”
“Players can only plan content, not event rewards. The Snow Sea Project Team will prepare corresponding rewards based on the content of the event.”
“We hope you all enjoy the game!”
“What the hell?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit straightened up in confusion, pointing at the event panel in front of him, “The event disappeared? There’s such a thing?”
“What caused it to be temporarily cancelled? I already saw the first event called ‘Military Might Unstoppable’.”
“Not sure.”
Sword Without End was equally baffled by what had happened but still stuffed his index finger into his mouth to nibble on his nails, then began to ponder deeply with his head down, “Letting players plan their own events?”
“No matter whose event is eventually chosen, it’s certain that the event will greatly favor the planner, that goes without saying.”
“There is a very obvious disadvantage.”
“That is, there are currently no events on the voting panel. Predictably, as soon as any event pops up, no matter the content, it will instantly gain a massive number of votes.”
“You have to realize there are so many players around the world. If every player designs one, that’s hundreds of millions of event ideas. Do you think anyone would seriously go through hundreds of millions of events and then vote carefully?”
“That’s simply impossible. Most players would just vote randomly for the first place.”
“At most, they might look through the top ten events and then vote for one that seems advantageous to themselves. That means—”
“If you want your planned event to be voted first and become the global limited event, the standard is not how perfect the planning is, or how rich the content is, or how beneficial it is for the players!”
“There’s only one standard!”
“That is to be fast enough!”
“Whoever is the first to send out the global planning event will most likely become the first in the vote!”
“I can bet on it, the global event that ends up number one in the votes will definitely be one of the first 100 players who planned an event.”
“So—”
Sword Without End, satisfied with himself, clicked send: “While I was explaining to you guys, I planned this event, and sure enough, I was the first to publish the event on the voting panel.”
“Speed is king.”
“Let me see?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat skeptical, glanced at Sword Without End and, with a critical eye, looked towards the temporarily ranked number one event on the voting panel.
‘Event Name: “Visitors from the Sky!”‘
‘Event Content: All players will make a drop from a hundred meters up in the air, and there will be a plastic basin on the ground. Each player has ten aerial drop opportunities, with rewards determined by the accuracy of the drops.’
‘Event Description: You’re like that unexpected visitor from the sky, abrupt and hard to accept.’
‘Event Planner: Sword Without End.’
“…”
After reading the entire event content, Tuberculosis Rabbit stood silently expressionless, then after a moment, lit a trembling cigarette and placed it between his lips.
“Bro, you do realize this is under your real name, right? Don’t you think having your name there is kind of embarrassing?”
“What kind of event have you designed?”
“If your event actually becomes the first in the vote, Yi and I definitely won’t participate, no matter how generous the rewards.”
Indeed.
He had to admit, this oddly shaped event did have the potential to be voted number one; it had already gotten over 8,000 votes in just a few minutes.
Just as Sword Without End had said.
Even though there were two new event ideas since, the difference in votes had widened significantly.
Chen Yi also quietly planned an event.
His event was very simple.
All players would encounter a variety of strange incidents over the next three days.
Like…suddenly a pair of hands reaching out from under the bed.
Or when turning over in bed to sleep, suddenly finding a cold corpse behind them, smiling creepily at them.
Or suddenly noticing some unusual behavior from the person next to them in bed, as if they had become someone else entirely.
Then, based on the players’ psychological fluctuations over the three days, rewards would be given.
Yes, perfect.
That is what a global event should be like. After a quick design, he uploaded it.
…
4 hours later.
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was sitting on the edge of the rooftop, tossing the watermelon rind he’d just finished eating aside, and looked at the voting panel with some surprise.
“Yi, the event you designed actually became number one in the vote.”
“That’s strange, this event doesn’t seem like a relaxing one, players should prefer to vote for something more laid-back, not something that looks so eerie.”

chapters.title: Chapter 236: 228: "Don't rush, let me see who is real.
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 228: “Don’t rush, let me see who is real.
“It must be for three main reasons,”
Jiaye, sitting to one side with his head tilted, guessed, “Firstly, it’s definitely because of Yi’s reputation. Everyone sees that the event is designed by Yi and is more willing to cast a vote.”
“After all, Yi should be the most famous player on Blue Star at the moment.”
“Secondly, even though the event sounds creepy, there’s no actual threat to life; those spooky elements are just for scares and won’t harm the players’ lives.”
“Which means that this global event poses no life-threatening danger to the players.”
“Among the top ten ranked events in the current voting, only four are non-lethal for players.”
“One is Yi’s Thrilling World, another is Sword Without End’s Heavenly Dancing Object, one by the Lycra twins called ‘Who Can Pee the Farthest’, and one by Zhu Ergou called ‘Who Can Last the Longest’.”
“Only these four events are safe for players’ lives, but the last three are too crude, and naturally repellent to female players, so in the end, the event designed by Yi is indeed the best solution.”
“The last reason is, after surviving the Calm and Cool rules of May, the remaining players all feel that they have a decent resistance to these supernatural events.”
“Those who get scared easily should already be down in hell by now.”
“These three reasons determine that the event designed by Yi will become the top vote-getter, of course, it also has something to do with Yi releasing it early enough, capturing a large volume of votes in the early stage.”
“It should be like that.”
After finishing his earnest analysis, Jiaye turned his head to look at Chen Yi expectantly, prompting an almost irresistible urge to protect him.
“Makes sense.”
Chen Yi nodded and then, after a pause, casually picked up a paper fan from the table beside him to shield his face from the glare of the sun, speaking in a nonchalant manner.
“Blue Star is just a novice planet in Star System No. 3. According to the veteran players from the last livestream, Blue Star will have to ‘level up’ after finishing the novice journey.”
“First volume, second volume, third volume.”
“Who knows what the future holds, or if we can ever go back to the old days on Blue Star.”
“Speaking of which, if everything goes back to normal, what do you guys want to do?”
“Me?”
Full of interest, Jiaye, who was sitting to the side clutching his legs, thought for a few seconds before assertively saying, “I’ll probably start a proposal planning business. I’ve already thought of a brand name: ‘Jiaye Proposal Planning’.”
“Wedding ceremonies?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Jiaye with some confusion, “That line of work is exhausting.”
“Not wedding ceremonies, proposal planning is different from weddings, but it is somewhat similar to the wedding industry.”
Longing appeared in Jiaye’s eyes, as he gazed into the horizon under the somewhat scorching sunlight and turned his head away from the fierce sun, softly saying.
“Not every couple is happy at their wedding; there are too many forced marriages.”
“But proposal sites are different, most of the couples are there voluntarily and are happy. I think if I could help couples plan a unique proposal or anniversary, it would be a very romantic thing.”
“I like to see those romantic events.”
“If I were in this line of work, I’d feel like the world was all rosy.”
“What about you, Tuberculosis Rabbit, if everything goes back to normal, would you still want to be a morgue attendant?”
“That depends on Yi,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, pulling out a cigarette from his pocket and flicking it carelessly into his mouth, said, “Whatever Yi does, I do. I’m fine with anything; I’m not particularly interested in these things.”
“How about you, Sword Without End?”
“I want to open a breakup museum,”
Sword Without End murmured with a trace of melancholy, thinking of something, “There are too many lovers in this world who cannot be together. I want to create a museum dedicated to preserving objects from couples who have broken up.”
“Like a towel once handwoven.”
“Or the stars painstakingly folded over several days and nights.”
“Or even a box of round-trip tickets.”
“I could also take a photo of the man proposing at Jiaye’s event, and as soon as they break up, the album would immediately go into my breakup museum.”
“I want my breakup museum to be like a work of art.”
“Heh heh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly grinned: “Speaking of museums, I almost forgot, I’m gonna open a huge art exhibition hall, and then I’ll frame your breakup museum and put it in mine, and display you right beside it.”
“I even have the perfect name for the art piece.”
“It’s called—’These Are Two Works of Art’.”
“Heh heh.”
Sword Without End gave a hollow laugh without amusement, clearly unimpressed by Tuberculosis Rabbit’s attempt at humor.
Time quickly passed as the group chatted leisurely.
Eight hours flew by quickly.
And so it was four o’clock in the afternoon.
The top vote-getter was Chen Yi’s Thrilling World.
The moment the clock pointed to four in the afternoon, a notification sounded in the ears of all players!
‘Ding, global announcement!’
‘The special limited event “Thrilling World” will officially start on August 1st to August 3rd, at 16:00!’
‘All players can participate in this event during these three days.’
‘Event description: A world transformed by the strange and eerie.’
‘Throughout the event, players will encounter supernatural occurrences at random, which will not harm the players; at least, they won’t cause physical harm.’
“At the start of the event, players will be rewarded based on the fluctuations of their inner emotional state over these three days,”
“There are a total of 1024 hidden achievements in this event.”
“When a player is the first to achieve a certain achievement, they will receive a special exclusive reward.”
“PS: This event was temporarily canceled as a ‘The Founding of the Army Day limited event,’ and it was modified from an event planned and designed by player Chen Yi.”
A new global event has appeared!
It’s not exactly the same as what Chen Yi designed; it even included many changes, like those 1024 hidden achievements, which Chen Yi had never planned.
The event has already started.
But…
“It seems like there’s no reaction at all.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced around tentatively, everything was the same as before, with no changes at all.
The same people were still there, nothing more, nothing less; the weather was the same, even the stifling heat in the dry air remained unchanged.
There was no obvious difference.
“Is this the altered world?”
“It feels…like there’s no response.”
Just then—
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly froze, looking at Jiaye next to Chen Yi, and with a slightly odd expression he blurted out, “Yi, there’s…another Jiaye?!”
Jiaye had always been sitting quietly on the little stool beside Chen Yi, never moving from Chen Yi’s left side.
But somehow, there was now another Jiaye sitting on a stool to Chen Yi’s right.
At this time, Sword Without End and the others also noticed this eerie phenomenon, and they all wore serious faces as they readied their weapons and aimed at the Jiaye on Chen Yi’s right, prepared to strike at Yi’s command.
They clearly remembered that Jiaye had always been sitting to the left of Yi, so the one on the right had to be a ghostly impostor.
Something was off.
How did this happen without them noticing?
“Yi!”
The Jiaye on the left, looking anxious and flustered, pointed at the Jiaye on Chen Yi’s right: “She’s fake, I’ve always been sitting here; you know that, Yi.”
“She’s the one transformed by a ghost!”
“Yi, she’s the one changed by a ghost, I don’t know why I suddenly moved to the right side.”
The Jiaye on the right, her face filled with an impatient urgency, stared at Chen Yi as he lay in the rocking chair with pleading sincerity: “Yi, you have to believe me, she’s the fake one!”
“I was switched to this place on the right by some trick of hers, she’s taken over my identity!!”
“Yi, you have to trust me!”
“Mom, I can’t tell them apart, I really can’t!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a heart-wrenching yell on the side and then cleared his throat, facing Sword Without End’s odd look and snorted: “What, you’ve never read Zuowang Dao?”
“No, what’s it about?”
“I haven’t read it either, I’ve only heard this phrase.”
Chen Yi partly slid down the sunglasses on his forehead and stretched out his arms to embrace both Jiayes indifferently, his voice lazy and casual.
“Don’t worry, let me see who is the real one.”
Soon, everyone present watched Chen Yi solemnly, ready to kill the other fake Jiaye on the spot.
Games aside, they really can’t let a ghost mingle among them.
But…after a while, snoring sounds came from Chen Yi.
Both Jiayes were encircled into Chen Yi’s arms, resting on his chest, glaring fiercely at each other, with no discernible difference in their appearances, clothing, expressions, or usual mannerisms.
It was indeed very difficult to tell them apart.
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to suggest trying to ask about past memories, he heard Yi’s snoring, remained expressionless and silent for a while, then suddenly lit up a cigarette and, without looking back, walked down towards the rooftop exit.
It dawned on him.
It seemed that there was no need to distinguish which Jiaye was real and which was fake.
After all, the chance to have twin sisters wasn’t something every man had the opportunity to enjoy.
And it wouldn’t even count as cheating.
This wasn’t a terrifying creature at all; this was clearly a blessing.
Clearly, Sword Without End also realized this, silently putting an arm over Tie Chui’s shoulder and following Tuberculosis Rabbit down from the rooftop.
Indeed, it’s only children who choose.
Adults want to have it all.
It’s obvious that Yi is a qualified adult.
…
The moment the “Thrilling World” event descended!
While the world seemed unchanged on the outside, a revolutionary transformation had taken place behind the scenes.
“I’m not even in first place.”
Li Yide lay somewhat dazed on his bed, legs crossed and lost in thought as he muttered, having voted for Sword Without End, feeling that Sword Without End’s event was very suitable for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: 229: "Are You Called Sadako?
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 229: “Are You Called Sadako?
But unfortunately,
the chosen event was Chen Yi’s Thrilling World activity.
Why would this event be voted number one? Are people not afraid of ghosts? He never wanted to see such things in his life, how would he survive these three days?
He lacked courage and couldn’t withstand a scare!
Lost in his thoughts, the Fox Tail swishing unconsciously behind him also shook.
Just as he subconsciously turned to roll over, he suddenly touched an icy-cold arm beside him.
Li Yide, who was just daydreaming, became instantly rigid on the spot.
“Gulp.”
In the empty room, Li Yide’s forehead was instantly covered with cold sweat, and he swallowed hard, certain that there was no one else in his room, but now he had suddenly touched a freezing arm!
Needless to say, what was going on?
He had encountered a ghost!
The event details just mentioned that players would randomly experience supernatural occurrences, and just his luck, it happened to him—damn it, he knew his luck had never been good.
He unconsciously swallowed again and slowly tucked his hand into his chest to ensure he could activate the Prop at any moment, before mustering the courage, albeit trembling, to slowly turn his head to look beside him.
“Ahh!!!”
Li Yide almost jumped out of the bed and huddled into a corner, his body uncontrollably shivering madly, pulling out a dagger from his chest and pointing it at the female ghost who had somehow appeared on his bed, his voice trembling as he said.
“You… don’t come any closer!!!”
“I warn you… you… you… eh? You’re actually quite pretty.”
Li Yide, who had been in fear, stared at the uninvited female ghost, suddenly becoming somewhat transfixed.
The ghost was about 1.77 meters tall, a bit taller than him, with a slender figure and a trim waist but large hips.
Her skin was pale white.
She wore a strappy slip dress, lying on her side at the edge of the bed, her lips curled up as she stared at him, and her nearly perfect toes were painted with red nail polish.
As tempting as cherries.
Her face was also extremely beautiful.
White skin and beauty—this described the woman before him.
No, this was a ghost.
Li Yide quickly suppressed the improper thoughts that surfaced in his mind; she was a ghost and he shouldn’t think otherwise. After taking a deep breath, he once again worked up the courage to look at the uninvited guest.
“You… you…”
Li Yide, who had been about to spout some harsh words, suddenly fell silent.
After a while,
tears involuntarily slid from the corners of his eyes.
He had chased so many goddesses, gave gifts, sent red envelopes, bought breakfast, but none had ever looked at him as much as this female ghost, who even lay in his bed.
Although he knew he shouldn’t have such feelings,
but… this female ghost was indeed very beautiful.
He was still green.
“I warn you one last time, leave this room within three seconds, or else… or else…”
Li Yide faltered for a moment, a brief flash of madness in his eyes, as he stripped off his short-sleeved shirt and leapt like a starving tiger pouncing on its prey!
“Damn it, don’t say I didn’t give you a chance!”
“This is your own doing.”
…
30 minutes later,
Li Yide lay in the empty room, lighting a cigarette with satisfaction, lying on the bed and looking at the lingering smoke on the ceiling, he mused,
“I am grateful for nature’s bounty.”
“Thanks to Yi’s planning.”
“Thanks to the existence of this game.”
“I never thought that one day I would be so close to a goddess.”
Only then did he look at the system notification that had popped up during the event.
「Congratulations on being the first player to achieve Thrilling World event achievement number 072 and number 012, with specific rewards to be issued after the event.」
「Achievement Name」: Daring to Try New Things.
「Achievement Number」: 072.
「Achievement Source」: Spending a spring night with a ghost of the opposite sex.
“Achievement Introduction”: Just as human beings have discovered the phenomenon of reproductive isolation, there must always be some brave pioneers in this world; otherwise, who would know about such a phenomenon? This world belongs to the brave.
–
“Achievement Name”: Puffing Up.
“Achievement Number”: 012.
“Achievement Source”: Puffing up seven consecutive times.
“Achievement Introduction”: You are a strong one.
“Why does it feel…”
Li Yide felt a bit embarrassed as he glanced around, and only after making sure no one was watching did he quickly close the system notification, feeling a tad shy.
How could this kind of thing be considered an achievement to be announced.
But it has to be said.
He liked this event.
…
“I put out… a fist.”
“You lost.”
Tie Chui looked at himself in the mirror, laughing heartily as he raised his right hand: “You’re so silly, I’ve already beat you ten times in a row.”
And the Tie Chui in the mirror just helplessly shrugged his shoulders, not convinced, and raised his right hand, signaling for another round!
“Come on, come on!”
Tie Chui was obviously having fun, confidently raising his right hand again.
“Rock, paper, scissors!”
“Haha, I won… again!”
He hadn’t been this happy for a long time, this was a friend he was playing with.
Even though Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit were also his friends, they never came to play with him, and his sister wouldn’t play with him either; he really wanted to play with someone.
It wasn’t easy to find a friend who was willing to play with him, who didn’t mind that he stuttered and slurred his words, making Tie Chui so happy that he couldn’t stop grinning.
“I’ll… give you a handicap… you’re too weak.”
“Are you sure?”
…
The entire world was thrown into chaos after this event started, with different supernatural events popping up all over the globe.
Players went from initial fear, screaming!
To finding out that these ghosts indeed couldn’t cause any physical harm to them.
Their expressions almost uniformly turned bizarre.
What makes a ghost strong?
Being immune to physical damage, with unknown methods of attack, and the ability to greatly impact people psychologically!
But if they can’t attack, then… are they still ghosts?
Aren’t they just experience babies?
Soon, a portion of players began to gradually let loose their true nature.
“Eh? It won’t go in?”
A two-meter tall muscular behemoth, holding a female ghost dressed in a white gown like a small chicken, forcefully slammed her head against the television screen!
“Bang, bang!”
It’s uncertain if it’s because of the television’s good quality, but the screen didn’t show even a hint of cracking under such force.
“How could it not go in, you clearly just crawled out from here.”
“Crawl out again so I can have a closer look, I was too nervous just now and didn’t see clearly how you did it.”
“By the way, is your name Sadako?”
“Why do you have that name?”
“Don’t you have a surname?”
All at once—
Players worldwide were having a blast, and what should have been a global event where everyone was engulfed in fear suddenly turned into a global celebration!
Many players were venting the psychological shadows left behind by the May rules.
…
ps: The editor urgently called a halt to the special event planned by the military, saying it can’t be written… oh, 5000 words wasted for nothing.
I’m almost losing my mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 238: 230: Sorry, His Vision Was Too Narrow.
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 230: Sorry, His Vision Was Too Narrow.
“`
“Let’s go, let’s go, the event is about to start.”
“Did you all bring yours? I only brought one, not sure if it’s enough.”
“I didn’t bring any, couldn’t find where to get one, but I heard you can get in for free with just a 50 Points ticket.”
Before they knew it, the event had already been going on for a day, and players were gradually getting used to this “Thrilling World” global activity, from initial fear to abruptness.
It was around 23:00 on the night of August 2nd.
Standing on the street corner and getting some fresh air with Sword Without End, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the hustle and bustle on the streets with a bit of confusion, holding a burning cigarette between his fingers, he gazed at the crowd with bewilderment.
Everyone seemed… to be hurrying in a particular direction.
Hurrying along, they talked to each other about something.
It looked like some sort of underground gathering of Esoteric Buddhism.
And some players even had a leash behind them, tied to a… female ghost?
That was wildly off the charts.
He had seen people walk dogs, and even walk cats, but it was the first time he saw someone walking a ghost.
It’s a big world out there, with no shortage of wonders.
“Hey.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stopped a middle-aged male player who was hurrying along with a female ghost, and with a look of curiosity, he gestured at the ghost trailing behind the player and asked,
“What’s this all about?”
“What is this event you’re talking about?”
“You…”
The player, who was about to lose temper after being stopped so abruptly, shrunk back upon seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s title and face, and with a flattering smile said sheepishly, “That… it’s an event organized by Qiang, called Russian Roulette.”
“If you bring a female ghost, you can enter for free; if not, you have to pay 50 Points for entry.”
In this day and age.
Players in Yancheng might not know the name or face of the head of Yancheng Law Enforcement Bureau.
But they absolutely wouldn’t fail to recognize Chen Yi’s close companions.
Players from other cities might at most have some impression of Chen Yi’s face, and may not remember much about Tuberculosis Rabbit and others, but Yancheng was different—it was Chen Yi’s stronghold.
If they even failed to recognize the people involved, they might inadvertently offend someone and be done for good.
“Oh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s lips curled into a thoughtful smile, “Russian Roulette? That’s impressive, didn’t expect you to be such a blood-hearted brother.”
“Come on, I’ll go with you to check it out.”
Russian Roulette.
He knew it too well.
A game that existed in both violence and bloodshed.
Two players, one revolver, with only a single bullet loaded. They take turns pointing the gun at themselves until one dies, and that’s the end of the game.
Simple rules.
It’s a test of the player’s psychological resilience, to maintain composure in the face of death.
A game with an extremely high mortality rate.
Of course, you could give up early, but that would merely prove that you chickened out, earning the boos of the crowd.
“Uh… this.”
The player that was stopped looked around hesitantly and, seeing nobody coming to his aid, braced himself to speak, “Our version of Russian Roulette is probably a bit different from what the public understands it to be.”
“But since Tuberculosis Rabbit wants to go, naturally there’s no problem.”
However, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s expression grew colder, and the player, deciding it was best not to say anything unnecessary, promptly moved to the front saying, “I’ll lead the way, please follow me, Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
…
“Are you really going?”
Sword Without End, dressed in a flashy pink suit with his thick chest hair on display and sporting a sleek, greasy hairdo, hands in his pockets, walked beside Tuberculosis Rabbit while speaking through a cigarette in his mouth.
“It’s just a game for kids. Why would we want to join in the fun?”
Indeed.
In front of them, players from Yancheng could indeed be referred to as kids.
After all, even if they had a revolver at their temples, they had plenty of ways to make sure they wouldn’t die.
And if they did die, it would just be a bit of effort climbing out of hell.
From this perspective, Russian Roulette really was a child’s play.
“Just join in for fun.”
Although Tuberculosis Rabbit looked down on this so-called extremely bloody Russian Roulette game, he still followed along casually and said indifferently,
“Yi is still upstairs amusing himself with those eight Jiayes. We’ve got nothing better to do, might as well join in the fun and see what kind of entertainment Yancheng players have.”
At their level,
Their own entertainment activities were definitely superior to those of Yancheng players.
Like you’d have your exclusive desert swimming pool in hell—could Yancheng players do that?
Clearly not.
Deep down, they didn’t expect these Yancheng players to come up with anything extraordinary either; it was just a matter of who would be the first to admit defeat in the face of death.
Child’s play.
…
After about ten minutes,
“We’re here.”
The leading player signaled to a ticket hall ahead and explained, “You can go in here, there are four halls in total.”
“You can pick any hall you like to play in.”
After saying that, the player dove into the crowd, clearly feeling too much pressure being around Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“`
In front of me stood a massive villa.
This detached villa looked to be at least a thousand square meters. It shouldn’t even be called a villa—it deserved to be referred to as a manor.
Before the rise of the core game, they had no idea there was such a huge detached villa in the Yancheng suburbs, with signs all along the road indicating private property.
The ticket booth was a newly constructed small pavilion at the entrance to the villa—somewhat reminiscent of the old newspaper kiosks.
“Oh.”
With a nod, Tuberculosis Rabbit, dressed in a floral shirt and beach shorts, casually glanced around before heading straight for the ticket booth, tapping the glass to enter.
“Open the door, let’s go inside and have some fun.”
“It’s packed, entry is restricted now. Queue over there, the estimated waiting time is 3 hours.”
“Look up, and see who I am.”
“Nobody’s an exception.”
The middle-aged woman in the ticket booth retorted irritably, and as she lifted her head ready to shout, she froze upon recognizing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face. Her complexion turned pale instantly and her voice trembled,
“Tuberculosis… Tuberculosis Rabbit, I’m so… I’m sorry…”
“Can I go in now?”
“Yes, yes, of course!!”
The middle-aged woman took a deep breath, then quickly grabbed a walkie-talkie from under the table and shouted, “A VIP has arrived!”
Whatever response she got seemed to be a refusal, making the woman urgently lower her voice to add another line,
“It’s Tuberculosis Rabbit, the one by Chen Yi’s side!”
“Get the hell out here quickly!”
No more than thirty seconds passed after her words fell.
The grand doors of the enormous villa burst open as six men in black suits and sunglasses ushered out a man in a red suit.
“Sorry, sorry, my apologies for keeping you waiting, Tuberculosis Rabbit,” the man in the red suit said, bowing continuously with a face full of regret, “It’s really my bad, the staff below don’t understand, please be forgiving, Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
“It’s fine.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t lose his temper but instead looked up into the villa with a thoughtful expression, “Is this a casino? I heard there was something to play here and came to experience it especially.”
“Lead the way.”
“Right this way, please!”
The man in the red suit dispersed his subordinates and led the way down a corridor into the villa, starting to introduce, “I never expected Tuberculosis Rabbit would come to a place like this to play, please forgive any lack of hospitality. There are four lounges in total here.”
“Through this corridor lies our Number One Lounge.”
“The current activity in the Number One Lounge is Russian Roulette.”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit, you could give it a try.”
As the man’s explanation concluded, the doors at the end of the corridor were also pushed open, and the noisy sounds of a crowd suddenly filled the air.
Before us was a huge hall.
It looked to cover at least four to five hundred square meters.
In the center of the venue were eight conspicuous rings with shouts of encouragement and hollering all around, sounding extremely lively.
They appeared on the second floor of the hall,
offering a bird’s-eye view of the entire venue.
“…”
Without expression, Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned on the railing of the second floor, overlooking the scene in the hall below. After about five minutes of silence, he finally said softly,
“Explain it? I’ve braced myself sufficiently already.”
The scene below was indeed hard to accept for the average person,
not related to blood or violence.
But it was something that a normal person simply couldn’t believe existed in this world.
There were eight rings below.
Each ring had ten seats, and on each seat, a woman knelt with her head inwards, buttocks outwards.
It looked just like a sunflower.
And surrounding the sunflower were ten bees, busily at work, with intensity—and the venue even had a conductor. Whenever a gunshot was heard,
all the bees would stop their labor, withdraw, and then rotate clockwise to the next flower for nectar.
“This is called Russian Roulette.”
Seeming to realize Tuberculosis Rabbit was unfamiliar with these activities, the leading man carefully chose his words before speaking cautiously,
“The basic rule of the game is ten men standing behind the wheel; upon hearing a gunshot, they must pull out and move to the next woman, and so on clockwise.”
“Those who ‘discharge’ get eliminated.”
“The last man standing is the ultimate winner of the Russian Roulette.”
“…”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit remained silent.
Sword Without End remained silent and appeared lost in thought.
Time passed again before Tuberculosis Rabbit, with an indifferent expression, pulled out a pack of cigarettes, offering one to Sword Without End, and lit one for himself. He took a long drag and then observed the scene below through the thin blue smoke, remaining deep in thought.
Even though he considered his tolerance quite high, he was momentarily dumbfounded.
The sight before him, even by the explosive standards of their world, was extremely shocking.
He originally thought the games these kids played wouldn’t amount to much fun.
None of them could compare to their Hell Desert Swimming Pool in terms of style. But now, it seemed,
I’m sorry.
It was he who thought too small.
It’s still you guys who know how to play. You might be weak, but the games you play are anything but weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: 231: "Lord Rabbit is done acting, the massacre begins!!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 231: “Lord Rabbit is done acting, the massacre begins!!!
“`
“Where do all these young and beautiful girls come from? They are captured.”
Sword Without End expressionlessly put his hand on the shoulder of the man in the red suit next to him, “I really hate the act of forcibly abducting women.”
“I hate it very much.”
“Do you understand what I’m saying?”
“No, no!!”
The man in the red suit, with a flash of fear in his eyes, hastily shook his head and explained, “The girls on the roulette are not human; they’re all female ghosts.”
“Originally, this Russian Roulette was a very expensive activity, but didn’t Yi organize the global event of Thrilling World?”
