“Everyone found out that the female ghosts in the event were very pretty, and they wouldn’t attack people. Aside from appearing out of strange places, they posed no threat.”
“So… embodying the principle of resource reuse, everyone started capturing female ghosts to bring here, for everyone to enjoy together.”
“…”
Sword Without End fell silent again, female ghosts… female ghosts… this world is becoming more and more terrifying.
But he quickly recovered his thoughts.
“Do you mean there are real people?”
“There are… but you can rest assured, Wuya, they all volunteer, and in fact… the act of forcibly abducting women only happens in novels. We offer a high enough price.”
“Working here for a month can earn at least 10,000 Points, which is a lot of money. If I weren’t a man, I would want to earn this money too.”
Sword Without End nodded silently.
10,000 Points, indeed not a small amount.
To earn 10,000 in a month, this temptation cannot be said to be large, it’s actually huge.
Just like before the Ascension game descended, he always felt sorry for the club girls who had lost their way, feeling that these women had wasted their youth.
But since his wife died of illness without money for treatment and he inadvertently learned that these lost women were earning around 50,000…
He lost all sympathy for these club girls.
Only hating that he had no sister.
Otherwise, his wife wouldn’t have died before his eyes.
During their conversation.
The door of a private room nearby was pushed open.
“The Russian Roulette here is played with real people, and the girls are all blindfolded.”
“Women can experience the sensation of being invaded by different strangers while blindfolded, and the men get a sense of competition, with rankings based on duration here.”
“The last one standing will be the top of this session’s Russian Roulette.”
“There’s also a historical ranking list, with the current record holder at 48 minutes.”
“Would you two like to have a try?”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End fell silent once more, believing that with their strength, there were no secrets left in this world to them.
Wherever they want to go…
There is nowhere they cannot go.
But… this time they had truly entered a new world.
After a while longer.
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked down at his fingertips, where the cigarette had burnt out, his lip twitched slightly before he shook his head lightly, “No thanks.”
“Alright, if you walk further, it’s Room 2.”
“Room 2 has a threshold requirement; only couples or married partners can enter, and we carry out background checks.”
“We make sure every couple and spouse is genuinely certified.”
“This prevents single men from hiring a female partner with money to sneak into the event. Of course, for you two, there are no such barriers. You’re welcome to enter anytime you wish.”
Another large door at the end of the corridor was pushed open.
They emerged onto the second-floor corridor of Hall 2.
The lighting in this hall was somewhat dim.
There must have been dry ice sprayed in the air, giving off a cool feeling, and there was an indescribable scent that was somewhat intoxicating when inhaled.
There were about forty or fifty people in the hall.
Every person, whether male or female, was wearing a mask.
Dancing gracefully in the hall…
“This is Room 2, and tonight’s event is ‘Eden.'”
“All the players here are verified couples or spouses, with many certified by the Ascension game. The death rate in this world is increasing.”
“Everyone is under a lot of pressure and tend to choose this way to vent.”
“As you see, everyone has put on masks, but… this is precisely when they take off their masks.”
“The pain people feel comes from always wearing a mask. But here, they have half a day to take off their masks, to come to know themselves, to know others.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned over the second-floor corridor railing, staring into the scene in the hall, once again silent on the spot.
All he could think of was a single thought.
He didn’t care.
His Hell Desert Swimming Pool was the highest-end.
All these were child’s play to him; how would he not know about them? He simply disdained to participate.
“Next is Room 3, the current project there is ‘Deep Sea Bomb’.”
“…”
“Over here is Room 4, accessible only to our VIP clients, and the current project is ‘Pirate Pendulum.'”
“…”
“…”
…
“…”
An hour later.
Under the respectful gaze of the man in the red suit, Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit left the villa expressionlessly, silent the whole way, quietly retracing their steps along the street.
Only when reaching the entrance to Garden District.
Tuberculosis Rabbit finally came to and lit a cigarette, looking dazedly at Sword Without End, “Are we back?”
“Yeah, we’re back,” Sword Without End replied, equally dazed.
Today.
It was like a sharp knife had given them a harsh revelation.
They had indeed seen the world.
That Deep Sea Bomb… simply unimaginable!!!
Especially the Pirate Pendulum, it was an eye-opener; had they not witnessed it with their own eyes, their minds could not have conceived that such practices exist in the world!
He used to think such practices only emerged after the Ascension game, as people gradually became more twisted.
“`
But only after the introduction did they realize that the promotion game was something that had existed before its descent, and that everyone who took part in it was either rich or noble.
“Sigh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit took a deep breath and gently massaged his temples before heading into the district, “Let’s go, find Yi and listen to the Great Compassion Mantra, to take the edge off.”
He and Sword Without End had not gotten involved.
Although they were not exactly upstanding individuals and had played at Silver Party events in the promotion game.
But…this was a bit too advanced for them here.
They were not yet able to accept it.
“But how come you didn’t join in the fun? I remember you like to play these games, don’t you?”
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to enter the district, he suddenly turned his head to look at Sword Without End and asked curiously.
“No thanks.”
Sword Without End shook his head seriously, a look of disdain in his eyes, “This is way beyond what I can tolerate. The people who go to such places often can’t control their lower halves.”
“A man who can’t control his own lower half, what do you think he can achieve?”
“A man without self-control is doomed to achieve nothing.”
“Why? Are you thinking of going, Tuberculosis Rabbit?”
“Me?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head, showing no interest and pursed his lips, “Forget it. I can accept the level of Silver Party in the promotion game where everyone has some form of relationship, but not this.”
“It feels like pure physical desire.”
“It’s kind of disgusting.”
“Humans can have desires, but they should not act like animals.”
“I’m definitely not going. Just looking at it a few times made me feel sick.”
“Let’s go, find Yi first.”
“I’m a bit sleepy, it’s past midnight, time to sleep.”
..
“Yi.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End arrived at the rooftop and looked towards Chen Yi, who was dozing off in the rocking chair.
“Tired from a whole day, feeling sleepy.”
“I’m going downstairs to wash up and sleep, ha.”
“I’m heading back too.”
Standing aside, Sword Without End also waved goodbye, “Nothing to do here for now, I’m going to sleep. Call me if you need anything, Yi.”
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi nodded slightly, not saying much more.
Soon after, Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End both went their separate ways.
…
Twenty minutes later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit cautiously poked his head out from the alley, and seeing that no one was around, took off excitedly sprinting down the street.
“Deep sea bomb, Lord Rabbit is here!!!”
“Lord Rabbit is done acting, time to start the slaughter!!!”
“The stage is mine to blow away!!!”
“Gaga gaga!!”
Just as he was about to sprint to the villa entrance, he suddenly heard an excited panting voice drawing closer.
“The King of Russian Roulette, that must be me, Sword Without End!”
“No Sword Without End born under the heavens, a thousand years of Russian Roulette without anyone daring to claim kingship!”
“I have one sword!”
“Who can stand against me?!”
The next second—
Sword Without End, who had just jumped off his flying sword and landed with an excited expression, was gearing up to rush toward the big villa in front of him.
Then he saw Tuberculosis Rabbit sprinting in the shadows.
“…”
“…”
Their eyes met and they fell silent.
“Weren’t you going to sleep?”
“Weren’t you going home?”
The two asked almost simultaneously.
After a while.
Sword Without End tentatively asked, “Together?”
“Okay.”
“Just never thought you were such a person, your loving-deceased-wife persona has already crashed several times, hasn’t it?”
“I also thought you really looked down on these things.”
“Some of it I do scorn. Yi has always taught me to be good since I was young, to avoid these things if possible.”
“So did you learn well?”
“What do you think, constantly following Yi how can I learn well? Who’s there to learn from? There are no good people around.”
“That’s true.”
…
The night passed quickly.
Tuberculosis Rabbit left the villa feeling refreshed, and made a beeline for the Garden District before dawn, dashing all the way home to find Yi already up and washing.
A bit embarrassed, he touched his nose, “You’re up, Yi?”
“Yeah.”
Chen Yi stretched and yawned, looked out the window, and casually responded.
“Try to avoid those kinds of places. Although I don’t despise that behavior, I really don’t have much of a liking for it.”
“Oh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit replied in a weak voice, “How did you know, Yi?”
“What do you think, where else could a grown man go without returning home at night?”
“Seems like it ha… Sword Without End dragged me there; I actually didn’t want to go.”
Chen Yi shook his head, not intending to proceed with this line of conversation.
“This event is ending soon. Get ready, after the event ends we’re moving to the next map.”
“Got it.”
…
PS: Two more chapters later tonight.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: 232: "Unless Chen Yi wants to destroy the entire Neutron Star!!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 232: “Unless Chen Yi wants to destroy the entire Neutron Star!!!
Three days quickly passed.
The timeline had reached August 3rd, 4:00 PM in the afternoon.
Everything was over.
After three days of chaos, Blue Star finally returned to normal, with no more occurrences from the paranormal world. However, some lingering issues remained.
For instance—
“Has she returned?”
Li Yide, with a distant look in his eyes, leaned against the headboard of the bed, gazing at the empty room, feeling somewhat hollow inside.
Everything was gone.
She had left too, returned to her own world.
Even though she had departed, her fragrance still lingered in the room, and her traces remained.
People on the forums claimed that these ghost women were emotionless, even mindless, like Minotaur Monsters, simply products of creation.
But he didn’t believe that.
He felt that his Xiaoqian was different from the other ghost women.
Other ghost women indeed lacked consciousness and intelligence, only appearing to startle people according to rules and then being captured by players.
But his Xiaoqian was different; she would perch on his headboard and watch him with blinking eyes as he slept.
Xiaoqian seemed not to need sleep, looking mentally about six or seven years old, filled with curiosity about the world.
Once, when he woke up, he saw Xiaoqian crouched by the window, gazing at the world outside with constantly blinking eyes. Watching her silhouette, he felt an indescribable emotion in his heart.
Too many things had happened during these three days.
He had collected a fuzzy doll for Xiaoqian, and although she could not speak, he still saw joy in her eyes.
He sat on the couch with Xiaoqian, cuddling chips and cola, watching comedy movies for a day and a night.
Xiaoqian leaned on his shoulder, taking out chips and feeding them into his mouth.
He bought several beautiful outfits for Xiaoqian, taking her to experience the world, shopping in malls.
He had never felt this way before.
A feeling of being in love.
If at first he had pounced on Xiaoqian due to inner beastly desire, then in the following three days, he truly understood what love was.
Li Yide wandered absently to the living room, looking at the somewhat messy couch, suddenly feeling a sourness in his nose and a lump in his throat.
Since he had taught Xiaoqian how to watch TV, he would wake up to find her sitting there, engrossed in the television by herself.
He also remembered how Xiaoqian loved to play with his fuzzy tail, her eyes bright with excitement as they blinked.
But… now everything was gone.
At that moment—
“Boss, we had a date with the Mantis Gang from Yancheng a few days ago to race cars outside the city. It’s almost time, I’m already at the spot. Why haven’t you arrived?”
“Huh!”
Li Yide wiped away the tears brimming in his eyes and took a deep breath, “No, I’m not going!”
“Down map.”
For the first time in his life, he knew what love felt like, saw that his life wasn’t empty but meaningful.
For the first time, he felt he wasn’t a bad person.
There was someone who trusted him unconditionally.
He didn’t know where Xiaoqian had gone.
He also didn’t know from which world Xiaoqian came to Blue Star, but he knew one thing: if he became strong enough when Blue Star’s Novice Period ended, whether in Neutron Star’s Number 3 Territory—
Step by step, reaching the top!
One day, he would uncover the true secrets of this world!
He would unravel the mysteries that the upgrade game had always hidden!
And then, he would find Xiaoqian!
He needed to be strong enough so that when he met Xiaoqian again, he would have the skill to protect her!
If his life had been aimless before, the rest of it would now be full of purpose.
At this moment.
He finally understood that saying—
When you meet a girl you want to protect with everything you have, only then will you understand the saying, “A sense of responsibility is a man’s epitaph.”
One day, he would break through all dangers and embrace Xiaoqian in his arms.
That day wouldn’t be too far away!
…
“Dead?”
Li Peiqi’s beautiful brow furrowed as she looked at the chat window. The little boy who had been leaving messages on her phone had died in hell; in other words, this line was completely cut off.
Since this line was completely severed, why on earth was Chen Yi so hell-bent on killing her? Was he out of his mind?
Crazy!
These few days, she couldn’t even enjoy her favorite cucumber-flavored chips.
Every time she saw the A-level Prop “Last Words” on her panel, predicting her death at the hands of Chen Yi, she felt like she was losing her mind.
Can she get a reason?
Even an emperor has to give a reason for an execution—does Chen Yi have no reason at all for his killings?
She had completely severed all the lines around her; it shouldn’t have been possible for her to be implicated, unless…
Li Peiqi suddenly stiffened, a flicker of terror surfacing in her eyes. She looked up at her best friend beside her, whose complexion was also looking rather terrible. Clearly, both of them had come to the same realization.
“Unless Chen Yi is going to destroy the entire Neutron Star!!!”
“Chen Yi is going to target Neutron Star!!”
The two of them spoke almost in unison!
“It’s over.”
Li Peiqi slumped onto the sofa, her face ashen. If she died at Chen Yi’s hand for this reason, then she really had no way out.
She had no relatives.
She wouldn’t be affected by the ‘Annihilate Nine Clans’ Skill, but even if she hid, it wouldn’t matter. If a certain number of players on a planet died in one go, that planet would be forcefully ejected.
The rules are cruel.
What does ejection mean?
It means death.
Having lived under the game’s rules for who knows how many months, she was acutely aware that within the game, the rules are inviolable, an oppressive force above all.
If she was to die because Chen Yi massacred the entire Neutron Star, it meant that everything she was doing now was pointless, and no matter how much she tried to avoid being implicated, there was no escaping this eventuality.
There are so many people on Neutron Star.
Who knows if a player with a few loose screws would suddenly provoke Chen Yi and lead to the annihilation of the entire planet?
This was completely out of her control.
“Does that mean my death is certain?”
Li Peiqi picked up the calendar from the bedside in a daze and murmured after a long moment, “Just 8 more months to live. I always thought I’d been careful enough in my life, never setting foot in even slightly dangerous places.”
“But why has it come to this end.”
She looked at the line of text on the ‘Last Words’ A-level Prop and felt a deep sorrow in her heart.
There were so many things she hadn’t finished yet.
So many bags of chips left uneaten, so many movies left unwatched, and even… she had yet to experience what men taste like.
“It’s not like there’s no way.”
Just then, Liu Xiaochan sitting nearby, looking equally troubled, spoke up, “I have a good idea that might be useful to you.”
“Really?”
Li Peiqi, not holding much hope, nevertheless showed a glimmer of hope in her eyes. She turned towards her best friend who had grown up with her, staring intently, waiting for an answer.
“Let’s hear it!”
At that moment, she was like a tourist who had fallen into the water, and even if there was only a straw in front of her, she would grab it without hesitation, not missing any chance of rescue.
“Become the King of Neutron Star!”
Liu Xiaochan looked seriously at Li Peiqi: “It has pretty much been confirmed that your death is due to some force on Neutron Star provoking Chen Yi, leading to the extermination of the entire planet!”
“But if… you become the King of Neutron Star, then you can ensure that Neutron Star doesn’t provoke Chen Yi, and you can avoid the catastrophe of being wiped out by association.”
“This is the best strategy, bar none.”
“What the heck.”
Li Peiqi collapsed onto the sofa, her face expressing disbelief as she said weakly, “And here I thought you had some good strategy. You think I can be the King of Neutron Star?”
“I’m just a girl who likes to eat cucumber-flavored chips and spends her days curled up on the sofa watching TV shows, how could I possibly achieve that.”
“Become the King of Neutron Star, you say it like it’s nothing!”
“Why don’t you try? I think you have a better shot.”
“I’m not joking.”
Liu Xiaochan sat down next to Li Peiqi seriously, took the pillow from Li Peiqi’s arms into her own, and, holding Li Peiqi’s hands, said earnestly.
“To become the King of Neutron Star is a one in ten million chance.”
“But, as the second-in-command of the Black Dragon Guild, one of Neutron Star’s major powers, you should know that achieving that position is also a one in nine million nine hundred ninety-nine thousand chance.”
“For ordinary people, to want to become the King of Neutron Star, naturally, they have to bet on that one in ten million odds, but you are different, you are just one in ten thousand odds away from that one in ten million chance.”
“One in ten thousand odds is not hopeless.”
“Think about it, the first step is to take control of the whole Black Dragon Guild.”
“…”
Li Peiqi, who had initially taken these words as a joke, fell silent. After a while, a strange look flickered in her eyes as she muttered, “There seems to be some sense in what you’re saying.”
“If I become the King of Neutron Star, naturally I can avoid the incident of provoking Chen Yi from happening. But there are so many players on Neutron Star, I can’t watch over these players day and night. What if one of them doesn’t watch out?”
“Easy.”
Liu Xiaochan continued to suggest ideas.
“Once you become the King of Neutron Star, just print and distribute Chen Yi’s photos everywhere, making sure even newborn babies engrave Chen Yi’s face in their minds.”
“Assure no one offends Chen Yi unwittingly.”
“Then spread the terrors of Chen Yi daily, the more frightening the better, portraying him as a Great Demon King, whose gaze alone would wipe out an entire family.”
“Finally, when Chen Yi leaves Blue Star, pledge allegiance to him immediately!”
“In such a scenario, Peiqi, you will definitely be safe.”
“Although it sounds challenging, we still have eight months, right? I think, Peiqi, you can manage this within these eight months.”
…
ps: I will only have one chapter up later tonight, I’ll make up the remaining chapter tomorrow. A friend has invited me out to get a foot bath, and it’s hard to refuse when someone else is treating.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: 233: "As the curtain rises and falls, who is the guest?
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 233: “As the curtain rises and falls, who is the guest?
“Peiqi, I believe in you.”
Liu Xiaochan looked at Li Peiqi with a serious expression, clenching her small fists and nodding her head.
Li Peiqi, appearing somewhat dazed, was still for a moment before suddenly snatching back the cushion from Liu Xiaochan’s arms, jumped to her feet and stared straight ahead!
“What you said makes sense, I can’t just sit here waiting for death, I must plot my own path!”
“Starting today, I, Li Peiqi, shall take on the role of king of Neutron Star!”
“The first step is taking control of the entire Black Dragon Guild!”
“But the guild leader is a good person, isn’t it bad to kill him?”
“Then subdue him.”
“I’m not as strong as he is.”
“Then first improve your own strength.”
“Makes sense, let’s go down to the map together!”
…
And in a certain world.
At this moment—
A girl in a strappy nightdress was slowly materializing on the spot, looking a bit unresponsive and dazed.
Scanning her surroundings and not seeing that familiar figure, a hint of disappointment unwittingly flashed in the depths of her eyes.
“Xiaoqian!”
Just then, a low shout rang in her ears.
“Why are you playing mute? Didn’t you hear your master calling you?”
A middle-aged woman walked up furiously, sizing up Xiaoqian, noticing the absence of the Cinnabar on her wrist, her expression suddenly changed drastically.
“Where’s your Virgin Mark?”
“Have you given yourself to a man?”
“You filthy whore, don’t you know that as a maid of the royal palace, you must remain a virgin for life?
The woman’s words fell!
Her face twisted into a fierce scowl as she slapped Xiaoqian’s cheek!
“Slap!”
“Don’t think just because you were selected by the main game to go to a Novice Planet and serve as a template, you can rise up!”
“Let me tell you, you are a dog belonging to the royal palace for the rest of your life!”
“According to the rules of the royal palace, maids who have lost their virginity should be submerged in a pig cage, you’re finished, I’m telling you!”
Xiaoqian tilted her head, considering the middle-aged woman before her for a moment, then her red lips parted slightly: “Mom.”
“Want me to plead for you? Let me tell you, for a bitch like you…”
The voice suddenly stopped short!
The middle-aged woman froze in place, incredulously looking down at the jade arm piercing through her own chest, blood churning in her mouth, the vitality in her eyes gradually fading away.
“You… you dared to attack me… you’re dead for sure… filthy… filthy whore…”
She couldn’t finish her sentence, her life cut off, her head slumping to one side.
Xiaoqian slowly withdrew her arm from the chest of the middle-aged woman in front of her, crouched seriously beside the well, and scooped up a bucket of water to clean it, dark red blood dripped into the well water.
She had been chosen to be the template for Blue Star.
Such opportunities were not common.
The main game selected randomly.
Its main function was to use her as a template to create many female ghosts, then give them some basic operational rules, and deploy them to Blue Star.
In other words.
In the entire Thrilling World activity of Blue Star, she alone had thoughts, the other female ghosts were just puppets made of who knows what.
“Li Yide…”
Xiaoqian silently repeated this name in her heart, earnestly cleaning the blood on her arm, feeling as if her worldview had shifted—so, hating someone meant you could kill them?
Before this, she never knew she could kill.
In their world, one’s status was determined by their surname.
She was Xiaoqian.
Without a surname, her status was the lowest—no one would even bother to collect the body if she were beaten to death in the street.
Only for it to be carried away by stray dogs or for its decaying flesh to be pecked at by vultures.
The surname determined one’s social standing in this world.
No matter how strong you were, within this mountainous surname system, even if you were beaten to death alive, you couldn’t fight back. Otherwise, not only would your entire family suffer the consequences, enduring unbearable torture, but masses of the lower class would also be punished because of you.
This was a person from a caste system of extreme severity.
She had lived in a daze, serving as a maid in a royal mansion without even knowing how she arrived there or how she became a maid; she had forgotten everything.
Only remembering to listen to Mom’s words.
But… on that planet called Blue Star, a person named Li Yide had told her.
If you don’t like someone, you can kill them.
As long as your strength is greater than theirs, that’s all that matters.
There is no need for your surname to be of a higher status than theirs.
“…”
After cleaning off the bloodstains, Xiaoqian stood motionless in the same spot, silently lost in thought for a long time. She suddenly felt that in these short three days, she had learned a lot; in the worlds of others, this was the way it was.
That person named Li Yide would bring her lots of delicious things to eat.
Would hold her in his sleep.
Would place her legs on his shoulders.
Would call her baby.
Would… take her to see something called a movie, and would teach her many things.
It’s just that she seemed unable to find Li Yide now.
She was only chosen as a template by the levelling-up game for a chance to meet her benefactor; next time? No one knows when the next opportunity will come. This being that calls itself the levelling-up game only shows itself when selecting templates.
And it was at this moment—
Xiaoqian suddenly noticed that the area around her had suddenly filled with many people… or should it be said, many ghosts? That was how her benefactor referred to her.
Ghost.
A term that sounded rather pleasant to the ear.
“Who did it?”
A ghost with a large belly, dressed in embroidered finery, walked up to a few steps away from Xiaoqian, his eyes boring into her as he coldly demanded in a low voice, “Why do you not kneel upon seeing your master? Who gave you the courage?”
“Kneel!”
Following the large-bellied ghost were a multitude of Fierce Ghosts, each wielding various weapons, their expressions ferocious and their motions threatening, the enforcers of the royal mansion.
It was normal for a maid to be killed on any given day.
The surnames of those who could become guards were basically the same as those of maids, both belonging to the lowest level.
But the rules of this world were clear, men of the same surname status hold a higher position than women.
Mockery, beatings, and killings were permitted; no talking back, no retaliation.
Otherwise, the entire family would be killed.
The ones who raised their hands were not people from the royal mansion but all those upholding this caste system.
“Everyone’s come.”
The finally composed Xiaoqian looked around at the familiar faces, yet she felt as if they were from a different era, as if this place was the false world, and her lips unintentionally curled into a light smile.
She began to hum softly.
“Passers-by move on, the old colors unseen.”
Her ethereal and clear voice rang out abruptly over the oppressive and gloomy skies of the royal mansion.
It was a song taught to her by her benefactor.
The first line of the song ended.
The sky above the mansion suddenly turned into an extremely glaring blood-red color, and Xiaoqian, wrapped in a dress of red blood, didn’t know when it had happened.
“The one on stage sings, her heartbreaks in a farewell song.”
Suddenly, countless rose petals floated in the air, Xiaoqian twisted her neck slightly, and dozens of heads quickly spread out from her body, each one blood-red and with eyes that were eerily reddish.
About sixty or seventy heads covered Xiaoqian’s body.
They sang in unison.
Their melody was eerie and bone-chilling.
“The word ‘love’ is hard to set in ink; she sings with blood as her blend.”
The crowd that had just gathered began to flee in terror, but it was already too late.
“The curtain rises, the curtain falls, who is but a guest.”
As the fourth line of the song finished.
There was not a living thing left; the grand mansion was silently desolate, with a thick stench of death hanging over it.
The ground was like a river of blood, as if the blood moon had melted.
“Whitewashed.”
After who knows how long, a soft murmur of a girl’s complaint resounded in the silent mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: 234: "Map Name": Prisoner's Dilemma.
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 234: “Map Name”: Prisoner’s Dilemma.
Time always flies swiftly, unnoticed.
It was August 4th.
The afternoon sun was just right.
The global event of “Thrilling World” had long ended, but its impact remained significant, leaving many players still catching their breath.
Chen Yi was lying in a rooftop rocking chair, wearing sunglasses, enjoying the sunbath with Tuberculosis Rabbit and others, about to enter the next map, which was a bit strange with a fixed opening time.
It was only open from two in the afternoon until three.
There were still about ten minutes left until two o’clock.
“Yi.”
Next to Chen Yi, Jiaye knelt with a grievance in her voice, “Is playing one hundred and eight Jiayes fun?”
“It’s fun.”
Chen Yi nodded seriously, picked up a chilled coconut water, and spoke with a hint of emotion, “I also didn’t expect them to keep popping up; it’s quite strange and a new experience in life.”
Perhaps seeing her lack of reaction,
The game decided to increase the difficulty for him, so during those three days, almost every moment a new Jiaye would pop out from various hidden spots to startle him. He didn’t refuse any, placing them all on the rooftop as if they were figures.
Quite interesting.
The sight of one hundred and eight Jiayes arranged on the rooftop was truly magical, but unfortunately, after the Thrilling World event ended, these female ghosts dissipated. Otherwise, it would have been fun to collect them and place them inside the house as figures and mess with enemies’ vision.
“What a pity.”
…
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End were both leaning on the rooftop railing, gazing distantly with a lost expression.
“I kind of miss it.”
“I know, right.”
“I seem to remember the Russian Roulette game being quite popular recently.”
“Now that you mention it, it does ring a bell.”
After saying that, Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head, clearing his vision, “A man who can’t control his lower half is doomed to accomplish nothing. Let’s not think about this anymore and talk about something serious.”
“I did control it.”
“You? If you had control, would you still go?”
“I went there precisely because I controlled my lower half. Do you think it can go there on its own?”
“…”
“Let me sort this out.”
After a moment of silence, Tuberculosis Rabbit, not knowing how to refute Sword Without End’s logic, forcibly changed the subject, “The map we are about to enter is new, from a Map Access Pass that appeared in the store.”
“It must be for the August rule, ‘Unable to Lie,’ specially designed for this map.”
“Today is the first time it’s being opened.”
“At that time, there will probably be a lot of players entering this map.”
“You be prepared. I…”
The voice abruptly stopped.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, impatient, pushed Sword Without End aside and stood up to leave, “Forget it, I can’t continue this with you. Now when I see your face, I can’t have a normal conversation.”
“Get lost!”
…
The time of several minutes quickly passed.
Then the Map Access Passes in the backpacks of Chen Yi and his group turned into a white light and disappeared at almost the same time, followed by a notification sound in their ears.
‘Ding, you have entered the map – ‘Prisoner’s Dilemma”
‘Map Name’: Prisoner’s Dilemma.
‘Map Content’: This map can accommodate ten players. Before entering the map, each player will experience a sequence of events in the first-person perspective. Then they will gather in a room to identify the murderer among them who killed someone in the sequence.
Out of ten people, only one is the murderer.
Within one hour, discover the true murderer through voting.
The remaining innocents will pass if done so.
If the true murderer is not found through voting within one hour,
The murderer passes.
There are three voting opportunities. If all are used up, the murderer wins.
‘Map Reward’: Depending on the players’ performance in this map, exclusive rewards will be issued.
‘Map Introduction’: “I’m so sleepy, I feel like sleeping, but I still have to write this introduction for this damned map. When will the boss die? Oh, this is a map that evaluates acting skills, good luck to you all.”
‘PS: Detecting Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, and other players are in a party, they will automatically be separated and distributed to different maps. This map is for single players and will distribute players who have had interactions with each other to different maps based on big data.’
As the system notification sounded,
Chen Yi found himself in a room resembling a cinema, surrounded by darkness, with only a shaft of light visible not far away.
His perspective quickly moved towards that light.
Soon, he saw an image of a modern villa study, coming into view from the distance.
Without much time to think, he began to carefully observe every image within his line of sight.
He couldn’t control this perspective.
He could only passively receive it.
It seemed like a first-person real-life VR movie.
Before the game’s arrival, Blue Star also had this VR movie technology, but it hadn’t spread quickly in cinemas; instead, it was quite popular on certain platforms.
This image could only be seen once, so he had to pay attention to every piece of information to ensure he wouldn’t miss any clues later.
The owner of his perspective seemed to be the lord of the modern villa, currently writing something in the study.
Writing… a will?
He seems to be quite old, in his sixties or seventies, right?
The owner of this identity appears to be an old man.
The content of the will is very simple.
All his estate is to be donated to charity.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi followed the perspective toward the will written in black on white paper on the table, and nodded thoughtfully. It seemed that the identity he was playing came with a storyline, donating all his estate to charity, how noble.
“Wait a minute…?”
He suddenly realized something was wrong.
Although he couldn’t see his own appearance in this identity and could only gather information at first glance, the forearms of his identity that were lying on the desk didn’t seem to belong to an old man; there were no liver spots or wrinkles, but they were very smooth, and hairless.
They were obviously the arms of a young person, and… hairless at that.
But why would a young man be writing a will?
Soon he figured out what was going on, the owner of this identity was not writing a will, but modifying one.
The new will was quickly amended.
“Donating all my estate to a charity organization, I definitely can’t do that. I’ve decided to leave all my estate to my eldest son, Chen Yi.”
“…”
Chen Yi looked expressionlessly at the modified will, his mind filled with frustration. Was the identity he was playing an idiot?
With the will modified in such a way, could the lawyer possibly accept it?
Even if it were accepted, wouldn’t his suspicion as a murderer be all too evident?
At this moment, he caught sight of an elderly man’s corpse lying next to the desk from his somewhat panicked vantage point. The corpse was in a pool of blood with a noticeable head wound, and beside it lay a candlestick smeared with blood.
It was clear.
In this identity, he found the will left by his father and decided to kill his father and falsify the will.
Nice.
This might well be his first failed map.
How could this possibly be whitewashed?
There’s no way to whitewash it.
Not at all.
If this identity he was playing had even a bit of intelligence, he would have split some of the inheritance in the will to make it less obvious, leaving everything to himself seemed to truly take others for fools.
The will was quickly modified.
Chen Yi silently watched from the first-person perspective as the identity he was playing carefully and meticulously put everything on the desk back in its place. Then he bent over again to take a closer look at the elderly man’s corpse lying in the pool of blood.
After pausing for about three seconds,
he then focused his gaze on the candlestick.
“Not too dumb.”
Chen Yi silently nodded to himself; at least he knew to take away the murder weapon.
Although things seemed dire from the start, as long as he wasn’t discovered on the spot, and if he cleaned up any unmistakable clues like fingerprints that he couldn’t talk his way out of, there was still room for maneuver.
If it weren’t for the August rule, the inability to lie, he would have even more leeway.
Of course… in some cases, having this rule actually expands the operational space. After all, it means that everything someone says carries a high level of credibility, and credibility… can deceive people.
Just as his viewpoint was about to bend down, there was suddenly a knock on the study door from outside.
“Father, are you alright? I’m coming in.”
As that voice fell, the identity he was playing had no time to tidy up the scene and quickly hid behind the curtain, holding his breath and daring not to make a sound.
Soon—
the door lock was turned.
From Chen Yi’s first-person viewpoint, he couldn’t see who was entering, only knowing it was a woman. He could only see the thick curtains in front of him.
“…”
At that moment, his mind was filled with one word.
Silent.
Just caught red-handed, wasn’t there supposed to be a storyline? The current plotline is practically forcing him to confess.
Isn’t this a bit too targeted at him?
Perhaps feeling a bit nervous, the identity he was playing stared intently at the curtain in front of him, not even glancing at the floor. He actually wanted to know if the curtain could cover his feet or if the shoes were sticking out.
But the viewpoint simply would not move downward, just staring straight ahead.
Just as Chen Yi was internally sighing in resignation, preparing to face his first map defeat, he suddenly furrowed his brows, squinted, and listened intently.
It was very quiet.
No screams.
Logically, a normal person opening the door to discover a crime scene would scream, right?
Even if it were a mute, there should still be some sounds of panic, or some noise from trying to flee in a hurry, right?
But at this moment, the study was extremely quiet.
Something was off.
And soon, he heard the study door being slowly closed through the curtain; the woman who knocked earlier seemed to have walked into the room and then a rustling sound followed.
After listening for a moment,
Chen Yi was certain of one thing: that damn woman was also here to modify the will.
About five minutes passed.
Only then did the woman in the study leave and close the door behind her.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: 235
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 235
“`
At that moment, the identity he was portraying finally emerged from behind the curtains. He quickly scanned the room and swiftly pocketed the bloodstained candlestick from the floor, then leaped out the window and rapidly escaped from the study.
The old wall clock showed the time had reached 9:57 PM.
The screen gradually went dark.
The plot had come to an end.
This part of the plot was all the information his assumed identity could provide him.
And the once dark cinema began to brighten gradually, with the outlines of other players becoming faintly visible around him.
“Snap!”
The sound of lights being turned on echoed in his ears.
The space was instantly filled with brightness.
Chen Yi could now clearly see the space around him; they were sitting at a rather large dining table, with nine other players seated as well.
No one spoke right away.
Obviously, everyone was contemplating the plot they had just witnessed.
But Chen Yi closed his eyes tightly, quickly conjuring up the last image he had seen upon leaving the study and immediately comparing it in his mind with the scene before the woman had entered the study.
Three seconds later,
his eyes snapped open, a glint of sharpness flickering within.
After the woman left, the room had been swept of one particular item, something he had initially overlooked.
It was a plate on the desk, holding three small pastries.
This was very strange.
A woman barges into a murder scene, doesn’t scream, remains extremely calm, alters the will, and then takes away the plate with the pastries—does that make sense?
It makes no sense at all.
Clearly, this woman also wanted the deceased out of the way, or perhaps she played some role in the scenario—she might even have colluded with his character to commit murder?
That’s impossible.
Otherwise, there’d be no need for his character to hide.
So there was only one possibility left.
The woman also planned to kill the old man—her method was poison, hidden in those pastries, and her entering the study was likely to see if the poison had taken effect.
And since there were four indentations on the plate but only three pastries, it meant that one had been eaten by the old man.
So… it was now unclear whether the victim died from his candlestick or from the poison.
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes in thought for a long time before suddenly chuckling—this map was somewhat intriguing. It seemed there was not just one murderer; no, there should be only one murderer, but there were more than one person with murderous intent who took action.
More than two, in fact.
There had to be at least three.
Only the player who inflicted the fatal injury upon the old man would be the real murderer.
In this case, even he could not be sure whether his character was the murderer, since his perspective did not include the actual striking of the old man, nor was he certain where the fatal injury was inflicted.
This was interesting.
At that moment, there were ten players sitting at the dining table, including him. Among these, only three were female. Among these three female players, one was likely the suspected murderer.
His seat was on the left side of the dining table, the first one.
He was in a relatively advantageous position—at least he knew about the woman’s existence, and she had not noticed him, provided… his character hadn’t exposed his shoes from under the curtains.
Just then—
The blond youngster sitting at the last seat on the right side of the dining table suddenly slapped the table, his face full of disdain as he loudly declared, “What’s so difficult about this map? Let me do the reasoning. According to the August rule, all players cannot lie.”
“All we have to do is start from me and each say ‘I am not the murderer’ four times, and that’s it.”
“With the August rule, anyone who lies more than four times will die on the spot.”
“The one who dies will naturally be the murderer, and the rest of us can easily pass the level,” he said triumphantly.
“I’ll start. I am not the murderer, I am not the murderer, I am not the murderer…”
After repeating several times.
“`
The brash young man with yellow hair turned his head provocatively toward the besuited middle-aged man beside him, “I’m done talking, it’s your turn. If you’re too scared to speak, then you’re the killer, and we’ll simply vote for you.”
The middle-aged man in the suit didn’t speak; he just closed his eyes tightly and leaned back in his chair, his facial expression somewhat displeased, without uttering a word.
He utterly ignored the young man with yellow hair.
“Hey!”
Seeing this, the young man with yellow hair rolled up his sleeves, stood up on his chair, and looking down at everyone with excitement, said, “You see, he doesn’t dare to speak. What does that tell you? It means he’s definitely the killer!”
“I want to start a vote!”
“He’s the killer!”
The young man with yellow hair pointed straight at the middle-aged man in the suit beside him.
“Ding, a player has initiated a vote. Please decide whether to start this vote. If more than three people agree, the first round of voting for this game will begin.”
“There are only three voting opportunities in a game, so please be cautious with your chance.”
“Players, please make your choice within 10 seconds.”
However—
When the countdown reached the last second, apart from the young man with yellow hair, not a single person raised their hand.
“Ding, the number of votes is insufficient. The voting has not been initiated, and there are still three voting opportunities in this round.”
“What do you mean by this?”
The young man with yellow hair was momentarily stunned, then standing on the chair, he roared in anger, “He’s the killer! I’ve already figured out who the killer is, why aren’t you voting?”
“Are you covering for him?”
“Could it be that you’re all killers?”
“Alright.”
At that moment.
A student wearing glasses, sitting opposite the yellow-haired young man, spoke expressionlessly, “Stop barking like a dog. I always thought that the kind of yellow-haired youngsters in novels who bark excessively were just the result of the author’s lack of creativity, but here it turns out to be completely realistic.”
“He doesn’t want to talk, not because he’s admitting to being the killer, but because he’s utterly uninterested in engaging with you. He thinks you’re stupid.”
“Everyone knows this map is specifically created for the August rules. Do you think you can clear it that easily? Do you take the Snow Sea Project Team for fools?”
“I can even guarantee that even if all ten players here declare four times each that they are not the killer, no one would drop dead.”
“You believe me or not?”
“The August rule of not lying is idealistic, not materialistic.”
“Judging whether you lie or not is not based on the material form of things, but on your inner judgment of the matter.”
“Do you understand this statement?”
“Dyeing your hair yellow, you look like you’ve never been to school for a day, as if your brain is filled with nothing but crap. Did your mother give birth to you just so you could dye your hair yellow, or is it that your mother’s hair is yellow and she passed on the color to you when you were born?”
“…”
After these words fell, all the players looked stiff where they stood.
“Brother…”
Next to the glasses-wearing student, a young man dressed in work overalls and pants, his face showing an odd expression, said, “You’re really aggressive, but… isn’t your mouth a bit too dirty?”
Mart rules dictate that when you insult someone, you don’t bring in family members.
Clearly, this guy didn’t adhere to Mart rules.
“I lack refinement.”
The glasses-wearing student adjusted his collar calmly and said, “I’m a native of Black Trench City, I’ve been this way since I was a child.”
“Cursing is just a dirty mouth.”
“But if you swallow the curse words, that’s a dirty heart.”
Then, looking rather provocatively at the opposite yellow-haired man, who was already livid with rage, the student sneered, “What about your mom?”
And at that moment—
A notification rang in the ears of all the players.
“Ding, the first round of clue collection begins.”
“All players must state one sentence with a clue that is truly useful to the case.”

chapters.title: Chapter 244: 236: This map is a dead end!
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 236: This map is a dead end!
“Ding, the first round of clue collection begins.”
“Each player, please state one clue you observed from your own storyline.”
“Starting with the last player on the right side of the dining table, we will proceed counter-clockwise.”
And the last player on the right side of the dining table was that blond kid.
At this moment, the blond kid seemed to be so irritated by the other students of Black Trench City that he was almost at a loss for words, his face red and panting heavily. It was clear that if it weren’t for the map’s rule preventing players from physically attacking each other, he’d probably have charged forward the next second!
After taking several deep breaths to suppress his anger, he sat down, his expression dark as he spoke, articulating every word carefully.
“I don’t have any clue.”
“I spent the entire scenario hiding in a wardrobe in a study room, and I could only see the dead body of an old man through the gap at the bottom of the wardrobe. Other than that, I have no other information.”
“I couldn’t see anything.”
“But I could hear footsteps in the study intermittently, whoever the culprit is, it definitely wasn’t.”
“That’s not necessarily true.”
The male student dressed like a bespectacled scholar casually tightened his collar, “The scenarios we’ve seen all have gaps, you just saw yourself hiding in the wardrobe of the study room.”
“But why hide in there?”
“Could it be that after killing someone, when you found there was no time to escape, you hid in the wardrobe instead?”
“Bullshit!!”
Upon hearing this, the blond kid finally lost control and stood up, pointing at the bespectacled student and yelling angrily, “How long have you been on my case, huh? What are you trying to pull here?”
“Do you find it amusing to falsely accuse people?”
“I think it’s you who is the murderer. Otherwise, why do you keep trying to shift the focus on me? Isn’t it just to eliminate someone quickly and to create more space for yourself?”
“Alright, that’s enough.”
Just then,
The middle-aged man in a suit sitting beside the blond kid, still leaning back in his chair with his eyes closed and a displeased look on his face, spoke up.
“My scenario appears to be as a gardener pruning branches in the villa. All I heard during my story was some arguing in the study room.”
“Curtains concealed the view into the study, and the distance was too far for me to see or hear anything specific.”
“But I saw someone walk into the study room holding a medieval candlestick, and then the arguing began.”
“That person…was him.”
The middle-aged man, who had been keeping his eyes closed, suddenly opened them and pointed the finger at the blond kid sitting next to him, “In the story, everyone’s appearance replaces that of their character, and this kid’s blond hair is very conspicuous, hardly requiring any effort to recognize him.”
Before the blond kid could say anything,
A girl in a camisole dress sitting next to the middle-aged man suddenly had an epiphany and spoke up, “No wonder!”
“My role should be the daughter of the deceased. I took some pastries to my father in the back kitchen, and about half an hour later, when I went back to the study to fetch the pastries for my father, I found… my father dead in a pool of blood.”
“There was a major wound on his head, and next to him was a bloodstained candlestick.”
“Which means…”
The girl’s voice trailed off, and even though she didn’t finish her sentence, the implication was quite clear, pointing directly at the blond.
However, her gaze seemed to sweep casually over the other players present,
Pausing slightly longer on Chen Yi before moving on.
Instantly—
Everyone turned their eyes toward the last blond player on the right side of the dining table.
Testimony and physical evidence, both were present.
Who is the murderer—it doesn’t even need to be said, does it?
Chen Yi didn’t look up, still earnestly eating his steak, the only one in the room who was seriously enjoying the meal.
He wasn’t sure why the others weren’t eating.
But he figured, since he had nothing better to do, why not eat?
However, when the girl began talking about delivering pastries to the deceased in the study, Chen Yi, who had been focused on his meal, slightly curled his lips into a faint smile and remained silent.
This girl must be the one he had interacted with in the study room.
There were two very interesting points.
The girl’s last sentence was—
“Which means…”
The sentence was supposed to continue, suggesting the blond kid was the murderer, although it wasn’t said outright, everyone understood the implied meaning.
But why not say it directly?
He leaned toward one possibility.
It was that the girl dared not say it.
Why the hesitation?
Because of the existence of the August rule.
Meaning, the girl also doubted in her heart that she might be the murderer and didn’t dare to explicitly claim someone else was, lest she violate the August rule.
Although the August rule allowed for three errors, no one would want to waste one unless absolutely necessary, especially since the month had just begun.
Even knowing about the existence of the Hell Map, nobody wanted to migrate to hell.
The second interesting point—
Was that even though he didn’t look up, he could still feel the girl scan the players after she finished speaking, meaning she knew her words would catch the attention of those listening with intent.
She was looking for a fellow actor.
The person she shared a scene with—that is, the girl knew or sensed someone was in the room or that there was some activity when she went to retrieve the pastries.
While suspecting herself of being the murderer, the girl also suspected whether the real murderer could be someone else.
The true way to play this map.
Is not to find out who the murderer is.
But to judge whether you are the real killer or not.
Chen Yi put the last piece of steak into his mouth, sighed with relief, and then turned his head to look at the girl next to him, who was wearing a court dress.
“If you’re not going to eat that, give it to me.”
“Ah? Oh, sure, you can have it.”
“Thanks.”
Chen Yi took the girl’s steak without any ceremony and tucked it into his embrace, continuing to eat in his lackadaisical way. He wasn’t particularly hungry, just a bit bored.
Having nothing better to do, might as well have something to eat.
And at this moment—
The other players had already initiated the vote.
‘Ding, three or more players have agreed to start the voting.’
‘The first round of voting for this game begins, players, please vote for who you believe is the murderer.’
“Player number 1.”
“Player number 1.”
“Player number 10.”
As soon as the voting started, two players cast their votes for the blond kid, player number 1.
But there was also one player who voted for player number 10, Chen Yi, and that player was the girl who had just claimed to have gone to the study to tidy up the desserts.
“I…”
The blond kid was sitting on the chair, white as a sheet, his mind racing through the whole story. He hadn’t expected that he could be the murderer.
How could he argue against that?
This map was a complete dead end!
In his point of view, he never saw himself committing the murder; naturally, he felt like he must be one of the good guys.
But soon enough, other players claimed they saw him holding a candelabra arguing with the victim and they also witnessed a candelabra covered in blood near the victim on the floor.
How could he possibly clean this up?
There was no way to clean it up.
He, himself, damn well felt like confessing. Would confessing earn him some kind of consolation prize?
Wasn’t the difficulty of this map supposed to be manageable, given that the access pass could be bought in a store and wasn’t supposed to be too challenging?
Oh, the difficulty indeed wasn’t too high.
For the good players, the difficulty wasn’t high; with just three or four people speaking up, they had already identified the murderer. But for him, as the player with the identity of the murderer, wasn’t the difficulty a bit too much?
At this moment, the blond kid leaned back in his chair, his face the picture of despair, his eyes tightly closed. He didn’t utter a word, just patiently waiting for the game to end.
No more acting, he was ready to concede.
“What’s the matter?”
The student wearing glasses sitting opposite the blond kid cut a piece of beef elegantly, put it in his mouth, and chewed slowly. After some time, he wiped the grease from his mouth with a handkerchief and spoke softly,
“Do you still dare to say ‘I am not the killer’ four times now?”
“Have you felt the difference between the rules of August that forbid lying and the principle of materialism versus idealism?”
“A dumb dog trying to pose as garlic.”
“I vote for player number 1.”
‘Ding, 3 players have voted for player number 1, 1 player has voted for player number 10, the remaining 6 players abstain.’
‘Player number 1, with the highest number of votes, is out!’
‘Player number 1 is not the murderer, the game continues. Gentlemen, you have two more opportunities to vote, please use them wisely.’
“Hmm?”
The student with glasses was slightly taken aback, and furrowed his brow in confusion, “The blond kid isn’t the murderer?”
Obviously, everyone present was also somewhat bewildered. After all, all the evidence had pointed to the blond kid just a moment ago. Logically, it shouldn’t be like this.
“No, that can’t be right.”
At that moment, the old man who sat a person away from the woman in the strappy dress, player number 5, looked seriously at player number 3 and shook his head, “You’ve withheld some information. If you went into the room and saw the victim, how come you had no reaction whatsoever?”
“I clearly saw you dump a platter of desserts into the trash can in the backyard. When I asked where they came from, you said they were leftovers the master didn’t like, taken from the study.”
“That doesn’t make sense.”
“You didn’t display any fear at the time, plus you never mentioned that the master didn’t like this specific dessert.”
“Oh.”
The number 3 player in the strappy dress, who didn’t seem flustered at all, nodded and said, “That’s because I saw someone hiding behind the curtains in the study room.”
“So I kept quiet, worried about alarming the murderer and getting myself killed as well.”
“Perhaps you’re also curious why I voted for player number 10 just now.”
“The answer is simple. When entering the study room, I saw someone hiding behind the curtain. Even though they were well-hidden, I still noticed that person wearing a pair of black rain boots.”
“Just now, I peeked under the table and noticed that only player number 10 was wearing rain boots.”
“I believe the answer is now quite clear, isn’t it? Since player number 1, the blond kid, is not the murderer, it can only be player number 10.”
All players’ gazes shifted back to Chen Yi.
Their eyes filled with suspicion.
This was almost a direct face-to-face accusation.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: 237: "The Truth is Clear, Does Anyone Still Have Doubts About Whom to Choose?
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 237: “The Truth is Clear, Does Anyone Still Have Doubts About Whom to Choose?
Feeling all players’ eyes converging on him, Chen Yi silently put down the knife and fork in his hand and sipped some red wine from the glass beside him. Only then did he wipe the grease from his lips and looked up at everyone.
“Why are you all looking at me?”
“When I entered the scene, I found the victim’s body. Just as I was about to take action, a knocking sound from player number 3 came from outside the study.”
“There’s something I need to remind you.”
“Player number 3 threw away three pastries, yet the plate could hold four. One of the pastries had already made its way into the stomach of the deceased.”
“Don’t you think the actions of player number 3 seem like destroying evidence?”
“Would a normal person, upon discovering their father’s death, firstly remove the pastries and then go to destroy them?”
“Even if you use the excuse of suspecting the murderer is still in the study and not daring to act rashly, it is still quite abrupt, because you could have just left the study and called the police, or yelled for help.”
“But you didn’t do anything, you were merely destroying your pastries.”
“If nothing unexpected happens—”
Suddenly, Chen Yi straightened up, leaned back in his chair, and with a light laugh, he said to everyone, “The murderer should be you, shouldn’t it, player number 3?”
“Let’s recreate the scene at the time.”
“First, player number 1, Huang Mao, entered the study with a candlestick, argued with the victim, and placed the candlestick on the desk.”
“At that moment—”
“The victim, having eaten the pastries brought by player number 1, suddenly suffered a poisonous reaction, collapsed and died. His body went limp and fell towards the desk, and he happened to smash his head on the candlestick that was on the desk.”
“And then he fell into a pool of blood.”
“The candlestick belonged to Huang Mao, and Huang Mao has already been confirmed not to be the murderer.”
“That means, although it appears that the victim was killed by being hit with the candlestick, in reality, the true cause of death was poisoning by you, player number 3.”
“And the reason Huang Mao hid was simple; in a panic, he heard someone entering the study and instinctively hid in the closet.”
“What do you all think of my deduction?”
“Does it make sense?”
The words were finished.
All the other players present again directed their gaze at player number 3, the girl in the spaghetti strap dress, after player number 10 analysed things like this, the suspicion on player number 3 was enormous!
The logic is sound!
Who destroys pastries immediately upon witnessing a murder? Is that something a normal good person would do?
“Heh.”
Player number 3 suddenly let out a cold laugh, raising her head to look at Chen Yi: “That’s quite a clever defense, but you have a fatal weakness.”
“In the safe in the study, I saw traces of the will having been tampered with.”
“And the tampered will leaves all the victim’s inheritance to you.”
“You are the main beneficiary, and the main beneficiary is the murderer, you understand this logic, right?”
“I understand all too well.”
Chen Yi nodded seriously, his expression earnest: “You’re right, the identity I’m playing is that of a ‘beast’; seeing my father dead, I didn’t first call 120, instead, I altered the will.”
“But what of it?”
“That can only prove that my role is not a good person, but it cannot prove that my role is the murderer.”
“After all, I didn’t feed the deceased any pastries or anything of the sort.”
“You!”
Just as player number 3 in the spaghetti strap dress was about to say something, player number 4 spoke up, “Let me share my clue.”
“In my scene, I fell in the kitchen, and just as I was about to get up, I saw player number 3 sneak into the kitchen with a somewhat sneaky expression.”
“Originally planning to get up, I decided to secretly observe.”
“I saw player number 3 frantically pouring a packet of white powder into the flour.”
“That packet of white powder could be poison.”
The words ended—
Player number 3 in the spaghetti strap dress showed a flicker of panic deep within her pupils, fidgeting uneasily as her mouth slowly opened as if attempting to argue.
She didn’t have this part of the story in her perspective!
Originally she just suspected that she might have poisoned the victim!
Now it seemed like she really was the one who poisoned the victim!
Damn it, was her role too foolish, not even checking for people around before poisoning?
Not searching the packet; are you brain-dead or what!
And the other players looked towards player number 3 with peculiar expressions on their faces; this evidence was too strong.
“But—”
Just as some players were about to start voting, player number 4 spoke up again: “Player number 3 put these flour mixtures with the white powder at the entrance to a rat hole in the kitchen.”
“It must have been intended to poison rats.”
“Phew!”
Player number 3 breathed a sigh of relief, it seemed her pastries were probably fine after all, and then she looked at everyone boldly and sneered, “The truth is clear, does anyone still have doubts about who to vote for?”
The other players also cooperatively looked back at Chen Yi.
“Don’t rush it, wait till I finish.”
Player number 4 continued to speak: “Soon enough a rat was caught, it ate the flour and quickly died on the spot, and then player number 3 nodded in satisfaction, using the remaining flour mixed with white powder to make a batch of pastries.”
“…”
Player 3’s smile suddenly froze on his face.
And once again, the other players turned their gaze toward Player 3.
“The pastries will soon be out of the oven.”
Player 4 continued to narrate in a leisurely tone, “After taking the pastries out of the oven, Player 3 just sniffed them and then placed them back at the entrance to the rat hole, mumbling something about how making them look better would attract more rats to eat.”
“Why are you all looking at me?”
Player 3 tried to regain her composure, scoffing as she spoke, “I was just trying to poison rats in a different way; you don’t think I poisoned the deceased, do you?”
“I said vote for number 10!”
The other players looked toward Player 10 again.
“It’s not over yet.”
Player 4 didn’t wait for everyone to react and continued, “After doing all that, Player 3 placed the remaining four poisoned pastries on a plate and left the kitchen.”
“…”
Player 3’s smile, the female with the sling, once again stiffened on her face, and she stiffly turned her head to look at Player 4, gritting her teeth as she spat out, “Can’t you just say it all at once?!”
She felt like she was about to be driven to madness!
Even she wasn’t sure whether she was the murderer!
Life is full of ups and downs, but it wasn’t supposed to be this constant, was it? This wasn’t a rollercoaster, was it?
“I’ve finished.”
Player 4 nodded, “After that, I didn’t see Player 3 again. The last image I had was of her walking out with a plate of poisoned pastries.”
“…”
Player 3 fell silent for a long time before speaking, “Leaving the facts aside, even if I did poison them, it’s not necessarily me who killed them; after all, it takes time for the poison to take effect.”
“It’s also possible that the victim was killed by a candlestick.”
“I suggest you give me a chance to live a little longer; after all, you only have two more chances to vote, don’t you?”
…
Three hours swiftly passed.
“Ding…”
The sound of successfully clearing the challenge rang in Chen Yi’s ears.
“Phew!”
The surrounding lights quickly dimmed, and Chen Yi, who survived to the end, stretched lazily, signifying the end of the map.
He truly wasn’t interested in this type of map.
If he had known it would be such a dull map, he wouldn’t have entered in the first place. He preferred maps that allowed him to wreak havoc. He could only hope the rewards for this map would compensate for his three hours of boredom.
How to describe the overall plot?
It was melodramatic.
It was about the ten players in the house who unanimously made a shocking decision upon learning that the deceased’s will was to donate all his wealth.
That was to kill the deceased and then alter the will.
Truly, they were all cut from the same cloth.
He left the room, which was a study, at 21:57, but at 22:02, Player 6 received a message from the deceased.
It was just two words—
“Help!”
Player 6 went there and upon arriving at the scene, found the deceased lying in a pool of blood. In a panic, they noticed the will on the table, hesitated for a moment to add their own name to it, and then ran out of the study in a flurry.
This scene was witnessed by Player 7.
After Player 7 entered the study and realized the deceased was still breathing and not completely dead, they too altered the will and were about to leave when they suddenly noticed the deceased opening their eyes and looking at them.
Without any hesitation, they knelt down and strangled the deceased then and there.
The message that Player 6 received was actually sent by Player 8.
Player 8, a lawyer, discovered the deceased, their boss, lying in a pool of blood as well as signs of alteration on the will while reporting to them.
So… they too added their own name to the will.
After all, it was their legal team that would decide whether the will would be valid or not.
But to be safe, Player 8 took the deceased’s phone and sent a message to Player 6, luring Player 6 to the crime scene.
And this scene, in turn, was witnessed by Player 7.
What was fatal was that when Player 6 entered the study, they were hiding a knife, clearly not with the intention to save anyone, but to finish the job.
Although the knife wasn’t used, it was still hidden in the trash can.
And the pastries in the trash can, along with the knife, were discovered by Player 5, the deceased’s butler, who was also loyally devoted upon realizing that the family was planning to kill their master.
They slipped quietly into the study and upon finding the master lying in a pool of blood, added their own name to the will; at the same time, they saw the deceased lying on the floor suddenly open their eyes and struggle to raise their right hand to call for help.
In their panic.
The loyally devoted butler lifted their foot and heavily stamped on the deceased’s chest.
With that stomp.
The deceased stopped moving completely, and only then did the butler sneak out.
Next, it was Player 8’s turn to make an appearance, the deceased’s wife, or more precisely, the kind who had been together for over a decade without an official marriage, a wife in name only.
She seemed only thirty years old.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: 238: At such a young age, who taught you to spout nonsense?
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 238: At such a young age, who taught you to spout nonsense?
This one was also dissatisfied that the deceased didn’t leave the will to them. In the middle of the night, preparing to go to the study to have a good talk with the Master, they discovered the Master laying in a pool of blood.
While stunned in place,
they hastily added their own name to the will.
Only after that did they quietly leave, but just as they were about to go, the Master opened his eyes again.
Yes.
This Master really had nine lives, going through all this without dying.
And each time, he would open an eye, as if afraid that he wouldn’t die.
So this old flame of the Master’s didn’t indulge the old immortal, grabbing the steel pen from the desk and stabbing it into the deceased’s eye.
Quick and neat.
The number 9 player, then, was the elder’s maid.
Having served him from a young age, she too was dissatisfied for not being included in the will and so at the start of the scenario, snuck into the study and poisoned the Master’s cup.
The poison gradually took effect, took effect, took effect… until in the end, it hadn’t completely taken effect.
This woman used a slow-acting poison.
So…
The final answer to the scenario was that player number 8 was the real killer.
Yes.
This hard-to-kill old immortal couldn’t hold out in the end, and a steel pen was driven into his eye socket.
And that candlestick was indeed swung by the identity he played, not by the elder himself falling onto it. As for player number 1, the blond hiding inside the bookcase,
it was entirely because he used a stupefying drug to knock out the Master and was about to amend the will when he heard knocking at the door, causing him to panic and hide in the bookcase.
His role didn’t hesitate.
After seeing his father fall into a stupor, he directly picked up the candlestick on the table and swung it down hard, and the task of amending the will was then what he saw from his own perspective.
But even that was not a fatal blow.
The stupefying drug from player number 1, the poison from player number 3, the kick to the chest from player number 5, the choke-hold from player number 7, the slow-acting poison from player number 9, including his candlestick,
were all not fatal blows.
The fatal blow was the stab in the eye socket from player number 8!
Well… the only few who hadn’t committed a crime were players number 2, the villa gardener, player number 4, Love, and player number 6.
But that’s all it was.
In fact, all three of them had a motive, harboring the thought in their hearts, just that they hadn’t yet acted on their impulse.
There were just too many teammates.
But everyone’s perspective provided only fragments of information.
This led to players number 3, 5, 7, 9, and 8 all somewhat feeling as if they were the real murderers, since from their views, each had delivered the final blow.
Who could have known that the old immortal would stubbornly cling to life, enduring so many attacks, waiting for the last steel pen in the eye?
As for players number 2, 4, and 6, including himself, although they didn’t explicitly see themselves taking action, the hints in their scenarios suggested they were the culprits.
Like player number 6.
In the scenes he saw, there was a shot of himself holding a knife and running frantically from the study, even tossing the knife into the trash can, which pretty much made him suspect himself of being the murderer.
Therefore, within three hours,
basically, everyone was playing with the mindset of ‘I am the real murderer, and I must confuse them to win.’
The scene was truly chaotic.
Originally it was 8 good people vs. one murderer.
But it turned out to be…
9 murderers against each other.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t have stalemated for so long as three hours.
There were all sorts of demons and ghosts making appearances, and the things they said… really made one’s scalp tingle!
In the end, after 3 hours, he still achieved victory.
As part of the good guys, he won successfully.
In the last voting opportunity, under his firm leadership, they voted out player number 8 and secured the final victory.
He hadn’t thought much at the time.
He just felt too tired, a bit worn out in both body and mind, wanting to quickly end this map. It didn’t matter to him who won, but by sheer fluke, his wild guess was correct.
When player number 8 was voted out, he too was somewhat stunned, clearly not expecting that he actually was the murderer.
There was really no need for such surprise.
Who could have survived with that steel pen thrust down?
“Ding, as a good person, you have successfully achieved victory.”
“Up next is your exclusive map evaluation.”
“Map Evaluation: In this map, you ate six steaks, showing that you have quite an appetite. Moreover, in the most crucial round of voting, you firmly trusted your judgment and led the team to victory.”
“Accordingly, we are awarding you the exclusive title—’Resolute Carnivore.’
The complete notification sounded in his ears.
“Title Name”: The Unyielding Carnivore.
“Title Level”: Green.
“Title Effect”: When you eat meat, you can simulate any flavor you have tasted before in your mouth, even if you’re eating a boiled white meat, you can savor the taste of grilled lamb chops.
“Title Source”: ——Map ‘Prisoner’s Dilemma’.
“Phew!”
Chen Yi let out a breath, stretched lazily, and glanced around, finally back on the cool rooftop, out of that damn map.
If there really hadn’t been anything else to do, he wouldn’t have eaten six steaks.
He didn’t even like steak that much.
Rather than steak, he preferred throwing a handful of barbecued tendons on top of a white bun and stuffing all the tendons inside.
Yup.
That felt way better than eating steak.
“Digging in the tiny garden, dig ah dig ah dig.”
“Planting tiny seeds, blooming tiny flowers.”
Suddenly, a humming voice came to his ears.
He took a closer look.
He saw a small girl wearing a lolita dress, sitting on the edge of the rooftop holding a lollipop bigger than her, idly swinging her legs and humming a somewhat familiar tune.
“In the big garden…”
“Oh, you’re back?”
Halfway through her song, the little girl suddenly caught sight of Chen Yi, clambered up from the edge of the rooftop, and bounced over to him, handing over an invitation.
“Here, this is for you.”
“During the Start of Autumn Festival on August 8th, as part of the time-limited global event, the organizers asked us to find a player to be a guest.”
“You’re the only player I know, so naturally, I came to invite you.”
“What do you say, want to come?”
“A guest?”
Chen Yi, with an odd expression, leaned on his cane with one hand, looking down at the tiny lolita not as tall as his thigh, and tentatively asked, “The organizers? Can you say who they are?”
This little girl was Little Sprite.
The one who had given him the joy of Little Sprite, that little lolita.
Last time, she managed to get him a top spot by pulling strings during a global event.
“Do you even have to ask?”
Little Sprite looked at Chen Yi with some disdain: “The organizers are naturally the Snow Sea Project Team, mentioned many times in the global announcements, haven’t you seen?”
“I get it, but what exactly is the Snow Sea Project Team?”
“The project team is responsible for a planet’s projects, what else could it be? Oh my, you ask too many questions, I really hate answering questions.”
“So are you going to be the guest or not?”
Chen Yi, looking down at the invitation in his hand with gold trim and silver paper, raised his eyebrows and asked, “Is there any risk to my life being a guest?”
“Hmm…”
Little Sprite thought deeply for a moment before shaking her head: “No, but there might be certain demands on your body’s flexibility.”
“In the Start of Autumn Festival event on August 8th, one of the activities is to choose a player to be a guest.”
“Then this player has to perform an action, and all players worldwide have to follow that action. If the players succeed…”
“The fewer players who succeed, the more the reward is divided among everyone. And of course, the fewer players who succeed, the higher the reward you get.”
“There are five chances.”
“Which means, players worldwide will have to mimic you doing five actions.”
“If you can perform an action that no player worldwide can copy, then the reward… tsk tsk, let me tell you, it’s high.”
“Because as far as I know, the Snow Sea Project Team hasn’t prepared any rewards for this, but if you actually manage it, they will surely provide a higher reward than the previous tier. You can look forward to it.”
“For example, if you were to take off your head, kick it like a ball and make it fly into a soccer goal in the Southern Hemisphere, and it’s also a curveball that flies half around the globe back onto your neck, followed by a 180-degree backward somersault, planting your head into the ground and your legs entwining and spinning like a propeller up to ten thousand meters high, before disassembling and landing to reassemble.”
“If you can do an action like that, I believe not a single player worldwide could copy it successfully.”
“Then you would definitely get a very powerful reward.”
“…”
Chen Yi held the invitation, his face expressionless as he looked at the earnest Little Sprite before him, suddenly feeling the urge to slap her.
So young, and already full of nonsense?
At that moment.
Sword Without End, who had returned at some point, curiously leaned in: “If that’s the case, then could I eat a pile of crap?”
“You can try.”
Little Sprite pinched her nose with a look of disgust: “But I think it’s just psychologically unacceptable. If it’s for the reward, there might not be nobody willing to do it.”
“What if I eat while defecating for an hour?”
“Then you’re awesome.”
This time, it was Little Sprite’s turn to be expressionless.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: 239: "You want other players to imitate this?
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 239: “You want other players to imitate this?
“Anyway, I’ve left the item here for you,” it’ll be up to you whether you want to take on this guest. If time runs out, I will randomly select from all the players.”
Having said that,
