Little Sprite then stuffed the lollipop, as tall as himself, between his legs and shot straight into the blue sky, disappearing from everyone’s sight while leaving behind a trail of orange-red tailfire.
“Here you go.”
Chen Yi weighed the invitation in his hand, stuffed it into Sword Without End’s chest, and patted his shoulder with a serious look, “Although Little Sprite snubbed the suggestion you made earlier, I won’t. I believe that if you truly did such a thing, no player in the world would be able to replicate it successfully.”
“Do you want to prepare in advance?”
“Maybe take some laxatives?”
“A looser consistency should circulate better, won’t cause any traffic jam, and is a bit more unobstructed.”
“Don’t…”
Sword Without End’s face turned instantly dark, and with a bitter expression, he respectfully handed the invitation back to Chen Yi, “Yi, you do it. I was just joking earlier; if you really made me do something like that, I’d rather be killed.”
“My mouth has a mind of its own sometimes, Yi, please don’t take it seriously.”
“Tsk.”
At that moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit emerged from the map, hands in his pockets and a face full of emotion, “Lost. This seems to be the first time I’ve tasted defeat in a map, right?”
“No temper at all.”
“Really no temper. In my scenario, I clearly saw myself killing that old man, so of course I thought I was the murderer. I painstakingly disguised myself for three hours and finally voted out three innocent people.”
“I thought I had won, but damn it, I wasn’t actually the murderer.”
“After I smothered the old man, he was still left with a breath and was killed by someone else later, the fatal wound wasn’t mine.”
“This is just messed up.”
“It turns out all my hard work performing for three hours was just for others’ amusement.”
“So stupid, I’ve never seen such a stupid map before, really, if I lost I would accept it, unless I was given the right answer from the start, otherwise, there’s no way I would have cleared it.”
“By the way, Yi, did you clear it?”
“I cleared it.”
Chen Yi nodded, tucked the invitation into his chest and didn’t go on about it. Instead, he went over to a lounge chair by the rooftop and sat down, “But my clearing it was also a stroke of luck. Initially, I too couldn’t distinguish if I was the murderer or not. Only as the final clues gradually unfolded did I narrow it down to three suspects.”
“But there were no more clues, and I could only randomly choose among these three.”
“Luckily, I guessed the right one, and that’s how I cleared it.”
“What about you, Sword Without End?”
“Me?”
Sword Without End shrugged, leaning casually against the table, “Cleared it. I always thought I was a good guy, seriously deducing for three hours and trying hard to lay out the logic for everyone.”
“Finally, I voted out the three people who were likely the murderers.”
“And then I found out, I was the murderer all along.”
“The system informed me that since the murderer hadn’t been successfully voted out in three rounds, the murderer won.”
“Although the process was a bit off, the outcome was correct.”
“This might be the difference between society and school.”
“What are you talking about?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Sword Without End curiously, “What are you getting at, suddenly bringing up school and society?”
“Think about it. In school, if your process is wrong but your answer is correct, you get zero points, at most some sympathy points.”
“But in society,”
“If your process is wrong but your answer is correct, you get full marks.”
“In the adult world, who cares about the process? It’s all about the outcome.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently glanced at Sword Without End, who had suddenly become contemplative, and didn’t continue to pay attention to him. Instead, he turned his head towards Chen Yi, “Yi, I just saw Little Sprite. What did she want with you?”
“Here.”
Chen Yi casually pulled out the invitation tucked in his arms and handed it to Tuberculosis Rabbit, “She said she’s inviting me to be a guest at the Start of Autumn Festival in August. Are you interested?”
…
“To perform a movement that no one else in the world can do?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at the information on the invitation’s panel, his brow furrowed in thought, “This is not an easy task. The first and more superior solution would naturally be yoga.”
“Many yoga poses are impossible for an ordinary person to perform.”
“For example, stuffing your head between your legs.”
“But first off, Yi, you can’t do that move, and you haven’t leveled up in the yoga skill tree. Secondly, even though not many people can do it, there is still a considerable portion of people who can.”
“Which also means, we won’t be getting the best reward.”
“The best reward, naturally, would be performing a movement that absolutely no one else can do.”
“But what kind of movement is there that only you, Yi, can perform?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit found himself in a bit of a difficult ponder.
“Wait a minute—”
Just then, Sword Without End suddenly spoke as if he had an epiphany, “I’ve suddenly got a great idea. Our goal is to try to perform an action that only Yi can do, right?”
“We can actually start by eliminating a bunch of people on a physiological basis.”
“For example, peeing while bending over.”
“Don’t look at me like that. Although I think the example is a bit crude, you guys should understand what I’m getting at. We can filter out a bunch of people based on physiological characteristics.”
“For instance…”
Sword Without End suddenly brightened up, “I saw a video on the internet before the game update came, of a guy giving himself a—”
Before he could finish,
“Slap!”
A sudden slap landed squarely on Sword Without End’s head.
Tuberculosis Rabbit emotionlessly withdrew his right arm and then turned to look at Yi, “I suddenly have an inspiration. We can start with props.”
“The only uncertainty is whether the ‘movement’ mentioned in the rules is a still shot or a clip.”
“If it’s a clip, then we can completely rely on props to do something that other players can’t possibly do.”
“Like—”
“Exterminate!”
“You think other players can imitate that?”
“They definitely won’t be able to.”
“Wouldn’t that mean, Yi, that you’re the only one in the world who has done that movement?”
“But if it’s a still shot, then it’s a bit more challenging.”
“How about trying suicide?”
“After all, coming back from hell doesn’t take much effort for you, Yi. I suppose not many players would be willing to visit hell just for this, right?”
“That won’t work either.”
Sword Without End shook his head seriously, “That’s even more absurd!”
…
ps: There’s only this one chapter today. Stomach flu’s got me running to the bathroom again. I’ve been on the toilet for three hours, my face has gone pale.
Whimper.
I’ve taken my leave for the day, and that’s the last time off for this month.
I’m so miserable. Finally, I can sit on the toilet and have a solid hour’s relief. These few thousand words were written while I was holding it in, whimper.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: 240: "Start of Autumn Festival Special Limited Event Officially Begins!
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 240: “Start of Autumn Festival Special Limited Event Officially Begins!
“What should we do then?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit plopped down on a chair next to him with a bit of resignation, “Well, you tell me what to do.”
“I’m not sure.”
Sword Without End shook his head, “I’m a bit clueless too. We really need to base our strategy on the specific rules of the event on the day.”
And then—
Jiaye and Tie Chui emerged from the map.
“Did you fail?”
“Yeah.”
Jiaye massaged his temples with a look of exhaustion, “It’s so difficult, I feel like I’ve used up all the brain cells I have in this lifetime. I didn’t even realize I wasn’t the murderer until the last vote ended.”
“Do you guys get that feeling?”
“I do.”
Sword Without End nodded earnestly, “I have a friend who went to the hospital for a check-up one day and overheard some nurses gossiping. They said a female patient cheated on her husband with three men the day before her wedding.”
“She got pregnant by accident.”
“Normally that wouldn’t be a problem; she could just have raised the child as her husband’s without a paternity test, and that would have been the end of it.”
“However, it just so happened that her husband had recently been diagnosed as infertile, which made things rather complicated.”
“How does a woman get pregnant when her husband is infertile? She couldn’t possibly be the Virgin Mary with a miracle baby, right?”
“She had to sneak away and get an abortion without her husband knowing.”
“My friend was eating melon seeds, really getting into the gossip, going on about how outrageous the woman’s behavior was.”
“Until three hours later, when a woman who had just had an abortion came out, clutching her belly and limping along the wall… When my friend saw the woman, he froze on the spot.”
“It was his wife.”
“I guess that’s the feeling—a whole time you’re munching on melons, only to find out you’re the main character.”
“….”
Jiaye stared blankly at Sword Without End for a while before he sat down next to Chen Yi, took an apple out of his pocket, peeled a bit and fed it to Chen Yi, mumbling.
“What a mess.”
“How about you?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a cigarette from his bosom and tossed it casually to Tie Chui, “No need to ask, you definitely failed too, right? After all, this kind of brain-dead map is like a demotion for you.”
“Thanks… thanks.”
Tie Chui caught the cigarette with both hands and then scratched his head with a goofy smile, “I cleared it though… Is this map hard? Isn’t it just about always denying that you were the killer…?”
“Pfft!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit spit out the juice he had just sipped, wiped the residue from his mouth, and looked incredulously at Tie Chui, “How is that possible?”
“You cleared a map that even I didn’t clear?”
“Not… well, only…”
Just as Tie Chui was about to explain something, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly cut him off, “Alright, you don’t have to say it, I think I’ve got a pretty good idea of how you cleared it.”
The biggest difficulty of this map was this—
All the good guys thought they were the murderer, concealing information and confusing logic, thereby muddling the clues of the other good guys and making the whole situation messier.
What was originally a 1v9 game ended up becoming a free-for-all.
But if someone, without using their brain or thinking at all, just claims they are not the murderer, then it’s not so easy to deal with.
After all, there are only three voting opportunities, and Tie Chui’s suspicion was indeed not as strong as that of others.
You have to say, that’s some good luck.
…
Time passed by bit by bit.
Soon it was August 8th.
Just in time for the Start of Autumn Festival.
“August 8, prosperity, prosperity, prosperity.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, after freshening up, stood by the window, looking out at the setting sun and stretched a supremely satisfied yawn before saying comfortably, “Today’s a good day.”
“But it’s the Start of Autumn already, and the temperature hasn’t dropped at all; in fact, it’s getting hotter. This weather is torture.”
“Even staying in an air-conditioned room feels particularly torturous.”
“I really admire how the people in ancient times managed to endure it.”
At that moment.
Standing on the Green Peak, his arms crossed, Sword Without End faced the rising sun and casually remarked, “I remember in ancient times there were quite a few ways to escape the summer heat, right? Like the emperor would store huge blocks of ice in winter and keep them in ice cellars to use during the hot summer days.”
“Many people would dig a cellar under their house or something. It’s quite cool down there.”
“Hm?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, lying on the edge of the windowsill, looked out at Sword Without End hovering in midair and asked in confusion, “How did you get here?”
“Isn’t today the Start of Autumn Festival?”
Glancing down at his wristwatch, Sword Without End replied, “Of course, I had to come. There’s a Start of Autumn event today. It’s now 07:59.”
“By exception to the usual practices, there’s one more minute, and the Start of Autumn Festival event should be starting.”
Hardly had his voice faded when.
A notification rang in the ears of all players!!!
“Ding, game activity announcement!”
“August 8-10, the ‘Start of Autumn Festival’ special event is officially launched!”
“All players can participate in this event during these three days.”
“Event One: Out with the Old, In with the New.”
“The scorching weather is about to end, and a cool autumn is coming. Grasping the tail end of the summer heat, let us cherish this last bit of summer together.”
“Players can write a 3,000-word essay to express their feelings about the summer heat leaving us, and judges will score these essays. Players who score over 90 will receive a special small gift pack.”
“The top hundred players worldwide will have the chance to win a special large gift pack.”
“PS: The plagiarism rate must not exceed 13%.”
“Event Two: Pool Party.”
“Let’s welcome the end of the scorching heat with a grand pool party. All players will find an extremely exquisite swimming outfit in their inventory.”
“This swimming costume is free to wear but will automatically disappear after the event.”
“Players can choose whether to wear this pool outfit; those who do for three consecutive days will receive a reward of 200 Points.”
“Players can DIY their pool outfits according to their own preferences. Strive to exercise your fashion talent!”
“And the Player Main City of all players will each fall into a huge swimming pool, providing the chance for the players to experience a pool party in Heaven.”
“Players can buy water guns, bubble machines, and electronic fireworks props to make this party a bit more fun.”
“Event Three: I Challenge Too.”
“All players can spend 1,000 Points to become an Arena Master.”
“As a guest, a player must perform a move they consider to be of high difficulty, allowing players worldwide to attempt it. Those who succeed will win a reward, and the fewer the successful challengers, the greater the prize for the Arena Master.”
“On the last day, our special guest player, Chen Yi, will make an appearance to pose a challenge for everyone.”
“The move performed by the Arena Master should not exceed thirty minutes in length.”
“The judges for this event are—”
“Little Sprite, Little Fairy’s Mom, Little Sprite’s Dad.”
A voice rang in the ear of all players.
“Write an essay…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit licked the corner of his mouth somewhat speechlessly as he lay by the window, looking down at the building below: “I’ve never written an essay in my life, and now there’s a global event making me write one.”
“It’s really odd.”
“And why are the judges always Little Sprite’s family? Aren’t there any other judges?”
“How can they manage to read so many essays from all over the world?”
“But I must say, they sure got that pool party started quickly.”
By now, the ground floor had been submerged in a vast sea.
The water was not murky but extremely clear, and you could see all the way to the bottom.
It appeared to be about half a meter deep.
And there were no signs of water backflowing into the first floor, which seemed to indicate some sort of protection for it.
Pool party.
Sounds pretty good.
All of a sudden, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s expression turned bizarre as he observed the street below, now transformed into a pool. Many girls had already changed into bikinis and dove into the pool, enjoying this rare pleasure.
It was quite… pleasing to the eye.
However, it wasn’t long before he witnessed an even more outrageous scene.
…
PS: More to come later.

chapters.title: Chapter 249: 241: "Tuberculosis Rabbit, you just missed the Arena Master leaderboard, didn't you?
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 241: “Tuberculosis Rabbit, you just missed the Arena Master leaderboard, didn’t you?
Suddenly, the Arena Master rankings began to show some truly capable players taking the stage.
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the temporarily number one ranked Arena Master whose stunt was sword swallowing.
A sword about half a meter long.
The system confirmed that it was genuinely swallowed without the use of any props.
It took roughly half a minute.
The whole process didn’t take much time, but the difficulty was anything but low.
So far no one else had completed this stunt, though there definitely are more than just one player in the world who could do it. It’s just that the event had only just begun and many people hadn’t finished reading the details of the event yet.
Or maybe they hadn’t even gotten out of bed.
After all, if not for Little Sprite’s reminder, they wouldn’t have been sure whether there would be a special event for the Start of Autumn Festival.
“That’s pretty impressive,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but click his tongue in amazement, “If it were me, I definitely wouldn’t be able to do it. But it seems this event isn’t just for Yi alone, we have a chance to participate too.”
“Yi is appearing as the finale guest.”
“That being said, I also have a special skill.”
“In ancient times there was Pao Ding carving up an ox, today we have Tuberculosis Rabbit chopping up people.”
“Give me a minute to dismember a corpse for everyone to see. I bet there won’t be many who can mimic this stunt. Even a forensic pathologist wouldn’t be as smooth as me.”
“The only problem is finding a fresh cadaver.”
His gaze gradually focused on Sword Without End outside the window and he spoke thoughtfully, “It seems it’s not that hard to find one after all.”
“Screw off!”
Sword Without End shouted angrily with an ugly expression, “Don’t get any ideas about me; I have no plans of going to hell yet, and even if I do, you better not do anything messy to my body.”
“What are you afraid of? It won’t affect your respawn even if the body is destroyed.”
“Still no, it somehow feels revolting.”
At this moment—
Chen Yi walked out of the bathroom, removing the bath towel from his body, wiping his damp hair while looking up towards Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others.
“Let’s go up to the rooftop to talk.”
“Okay,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Chen Yi’s beach shorts and expressed his surprise, “I never noticed before but Yi, you actually look quite handsome in beach shorts.”
“Mm, it’s the outfit given for the pool party event. I just put it on casually.”
…
On the rooftop.
Chen Yi lay under a sun umbrella in his beach shorts, while Jiaye lay on another rocking chair next to him, dressed in swimwear.
Jiaye wasn’t wearing a bikini.
Instead, it was a more conservative piece of swimwear that, despite covering more, gave off a particularly lazy charm that was extremely enticing.
As for Sword Without End and the others, they were uniformly dressed in beach shorts, with their upper bodies bare.
The swimwear for men seemed to be just that, a pair of beach shorts.
And nothing else.
It was rare to see men’s swimwear with a top.
“Ah, refreshing!”
Sword Without End, with his hair still dripping wet, stared at the fountain shooting up from the lower floors and splattering onto the rooftop, grinning with satisfaction, “I have to say, it’s been a long time since I swam. It feels really good.”
“It’s just that it gets a bit murky underwater; once you go in, you can’t see the bottom.”/p>
“Murky?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, puzzled, sat on the edge of the rooftop looking toward the tower, “It looks pretty clean to me, how could it be murky if it’s crystal clear to the bottom?”
“You’d know when you jump in; once you’re in the water, it’s all butts and legs, you can’t see the bottom at all.”
“…”
Just as Sword Without End was about to say something, he glanced at the Arena Master rankings and suddenly froze, his mouth twitching slightly before he spoke.
“Tuberculosis Rabbit, you didn’t check the Arena Master rankings just now, did you?”
“No, what’s up?”
“Just take a look.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the Arena Master rankings, somewhat puzzled. But when he saw the current rankings, his expression turned blank as he froze in place, falling silent without a word.
As expected.
Given the rewards at stake, players from all over the world were showcasing their talents!
The player who had swallowed the sword was now ranked beyond a hundredth place.
Over 4,000 players had successfully performed the sword swallowing stunt.
Some players did it with skill, having been acrobats before the game went online.
Others were more brute about it.
With powerful healing props, they simply forced the sword down their throats and then pulled it back out to heal themselves.
Did they complete the stunt?
Yes, they did.
What else could be said?
The first player to do so was named ‘Walker.’
Below the sword-swallowing Arena Master in the Challenger rankings, this player named ‘Walker’ was ranked first in terms of likes.
Pulling a long sword out from his bosom, he lifted his head and without a word, stabbed it down his throat.
That determination, that cold expression, spoke volumes of his ruthlessness.
To inflict such harm on himself without flinching, let alone on others.
After stabbing it in, he quickly yanked it out and sprayed a bottle of something from his bosom at his bloodied mouth with vigor.
The challenge was successful.
Below each Arena Master, there’s a Challenger ranking board where spectating players can give likes to the challenger’s videos. There are no rewards, it’s just to acknowledge the more impressive challengers.
A stunt with such high difficulty had already wrapped up the top hundred spots.
One can only imagine what sorts of beings occupied the top ten.
In tenth place—
‘Arena Master’: Wang
‘Stunt’: Single-finger push-ups.
The duration of the stunt was thirty minutes.
The content was simple.
Using a single finger and in an inverted position against the wall, perform 2,000 push-ups within thirty minutes.
So far, only 281 players had completed this stunt.
“This one’s tough.”
Sword Without End nodded in strong agreement, “I could never pull off this stunt. This guy deserves the reward. Probably using some prop or skill to boost his physical attributes.”
“Yi should be able to do this one.”
He remembered Yi had a skill that allowed him to double his physical attributes while in a fearless state.
“But I don’t really agree with the ninth place.”
Tenth place—
“Arena Master”: Ren Guishan
“Skill”: Immovable as a Mountain.
The action also lasted for thirty minutes.
On the screen, a naked man sat cross-legged on the bed, surrounded by three masked women who persistently teased the man.
This process continued for thirty minutes.
Throughout the entire process, the man remained calm, his body showing no reaction whatsoever.
Action complete.
The system named it— “Immovable as a Mountain”.
What a fitting name.
So far, a total of 271 players have completed this challenge.
“Erectile dysfunction ranks ninth?”
Sword Without End was quite indignant, “As far as I know, there must be at least ten million men with erectile dysfunction worldwide. How come only 271 players have completed the challenge?”
“Maybe not every man is willing to admit that he has erectile dysfunction.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked on silently with a complex expression, glancing over at the sixth-ranked Arena Master.
“Arena Master”: Wang Jiaofeng.
“Skill”: Great Tolerance.
The action lasted only thirty seconds, and then a durian was shoved in.
A total of 34 players have completed this challenge.
“Doesn’t this upgradable game have any reviewers?”
“Is this kind of footage even allowed to be shown?”
“Not sure, maybe the reviewers are soaring high right now.”
Fifth place—
“Arena Master”: Gu Yongyin
“Skill”: Self Drinking and Pecking.
It was a man.
His flexibility didn’t seem bad, he had practiced yoga; this man took himself into his own mouth.
A total of 14 players have completed this challenge.
“What else can be said?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit lit a cigarette in a daze and brought it to his lips, “This scene is extremely explosive even in the explosive world, too explosive.”
“Don’t…”
Sword Without End’s mouth twitched wildly as he looked at the highest-ranked challenger under this Arena Master “Walker”: “You should watch this Walker’s challenge video; you will find there’s something even more explosive.”
“Walker? The one who swallowed the sword under the Arena Master?”
“Um…”
“Let’s take a look.”
The next second—
Tuberculosis Rabbit lit five cigarettes at once and stuck them all in his mouth, his gaze vacant as he stared off into the horizon, muttering, “This world is so illusory, what’s real in this world?”
“False, false, all are false.”
“There’s nothing real.”
“All are false.”
One cigarette was not enough to suppress his complex feelings at that moment; he needed five, one less wouldn’t do.
The top-ranked Walker then chopped it off himself.
And put it in his mouth.
Challenge successful.
Badass.
Tuberculosis Rabbit fell silent for a long time and finally gave a weak comment, long ago he thought the word badass was an uneducated person’s reaction to shock.
It was only now that he realized.
When one’s mind is shocked to a blank, only these two words can express one’s feelings.
What else can be said?
Only that if you have a medical prop you are arrogant, may you never grow back!
Such intense skills, yet still only ranked fifth.
Fourth place was even more badass.
“Arena Master”: Ma Hailei
“Skill”: Soaring into the Skies.
It was a young lad.
A Flower-Shaking Hand.
His hands almost shook out afterimages above his head, and then he shook himself up into the sky; exactly how he flew up.
It’s not clear.
Maybe he had some skill or prop of some kind.
Anyway, so far, only 13 players have successfully taken the challenge.
The third place is somewhat more normal.
“Arena Master”: Jin Haitao.
“Skill”: Super Long Jump.
In the video, a man grabbed two protruding steel rods on the ground, and then his body quickly retracted backward.
While his body pulled back, his hands did not leave those two bars.
His arms were stretched nearly a kilometer long.
It’s hard to imagine that a normal human body could be stretched to such an extent.
And then…
“Whoosh!”
As if stretched to the limit, the player’s arms snapped back like a spring, and the player shot toward the sky, even emitting a sonic boom.
As if to add difficulty,
Mid-air, the player reached into his arms and pulled out an induction cooker and a pot.
In the process of high-speed flight.
He started cooking rice with fire.
Five minutes later.
The player landed, and there was an extra plate in his arms, with three dishes and a soup he cooked in mid-air.
“Badass.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently gave his own evaluation in his heart, this was more than a gathering of talented people, it was the beginning of mutations.
Even more badass, however,
Was that there were 7 players who had completed this action.

chapters.title: Chapter 250: 242: "Their Ambitions, Always Inappropriately Swelling.
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 242: “Their Ambitions, Always Inappropriately Swelling.
“If the several ranks behind the top ten are all considered people with special abilities from among the populace, then those in the top few ranks can no longer be considered just talented individuals, right?”
“Should they be considered mutants instead?”
“This Jin Haitao who is ranked third, is he even human?”
“Using his arms as the sole power, he soared in the air for 5 minutes before landing and serving a dish with three courses and a soup?”
“Is that something achievable with props?”
“Did he steal Luffy’s Gum-Gum Fruit from One Piece?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked emotionlessly at the player ranked third on the leaderboard, momentarily at a loss for words.
Indeed.
Even the existence of the internet hasn’t fully unearthed the attributes of humanity.
Just like in the past, although the internet was so widespread, he had no idea there were so many extraordinary people and events.
But now with the leaderboard, it’s different.
It reveals many things that were not visible before.
Sometimes one has to admit, the diversity of biological species is vast.
“As for the first place…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the current first place on the leaderboard, his mouth twitching uncontrollably, unable to help but state.
The most ruthless people are numerous.
‘Arena Master’: Li Hen.
‘Action’: Crimson Rose.
The video content was simple.
A man, wielding a somewhat rudimentary craft knife.
In just 30 minutes, this man carved himself into a gigantic rose with that very craft knife.
No head, no limbs to be seen.
When the final cut severed his last remaining arm, all that was left on the video was a rose over a meter tall continuously dripping with blood.
The texture was intricately detailed, not roughly carved into the shape of a rose, but every vein, every branch detail was meticulously sculpted.
Real flower petals were used as materials in the middle of the process.
Half an hour later.
A more than one-meter-tall rose continuously dripping fresh blood appeared in the frame.
Dead or alive?
That was unclear, as after the last cut was made, the man in the video made no additional movements; whether he was still breathing was even more uncertain, as his face was no longer visible.
The whole person was carved such that he no longer resembled a human.
Whether viewed from a distance or up close, all one could see was a bleeding rose.
Number of players completed…0!
Yes.
So far, this move has not been completed by any player worldwide.
“This move…”
Sword Without End spoke with a complicated expression, “First of all, to complete this move, you must possess medical skills or a medical prop, and the level must not be too low.”
“At minimum a C-grade prop, even a B-grade for safety, to ensure that carving oneself like this won’t lead to death halfway through.”
“Secondly, it requires an extremely strong psychological endurance. Most people can’t bring themselves to harm their own body, let alone carve themselves into such a thing without anesthesia, enduring severe pain.”
“However, it seems that this person didn’t suffer at all; when his expression was still visible, he was even smiling, showing no signs of pain.”
“Lastly, it demands superb sculpting skill.”
“Even though the video seems gory and shocking, one has to admit that carving a living person, on the basis of some real petals, into a gigantic bleeding rose requires high technical prowess.”
“And to simultaneously meet so many criteria, there aren’t many players worldwide, no, to be precise, there has been no other player aside from him up until now.”
“Otherwise, he wouldn’t have maintained the top spot on the leaderboard without any successful challengers.”
“You make a valid point.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement, his eyes slightly squinting as he whispered, “But this rose is truly beautiful. If it could be displayed in my art gallery…”
“That would certainly be interesting.”
Upon hearing this.
Sword Without End suddenly shivered as if recalling some shadow, silently moving to the side without speaking further.
Chen Yi had been lying on the rocking chair from beginning to end, with his eyelids drooping as if pondering something.
In front of him, there was a prompt box only he could see.
‘Ding, due to some unknown changes, you have been granted the right to directly challenge the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower. Please decide whether to take the challenge!’
Chen Yi was aware of the Deadly Tower.
It came out alongside the new rules in August, part of the new gameplay in August.
Starting from August, players were allowed to form teams and venture to the Deadly Tower, a map exclusive to August.
Each team’s size was limited to 5 people.
Assemble a team of 5, then enter the Deadly Tower.
The Deadly Tower had 100 floors in total, with the first team to clear it earning extremely rare prop and skill rewards.
Clearing each floor would grant a certain amount of Deadly Points.
Deadly Points could be exchanged for props, skills, or anything else in the Deadly Tower shop.
Up to now, the strongest team had only reached the 27th floor; it seemed there was still a long way to go to clear the tower.
He had planned to lead his own team into the fray after the Start of Autumn Festival.
His team had exactly five people.
Let’s see what the rewards are.
But just now, as the Start of Autumn Festival special event was announced, this prompt box also abruptly appeared before their eyes—due to some unknown reasons, they could directly challenge the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower?
Which means, if they clear this level,
They will immediately acquire the rewards for completion and become the fastest team globally to clear the Tower.
It just… looks a bit eerie.
What does it mean by “due to unknown changes”?
What are the unknown changes?
He was a bit suspicious if this was a backdoor opened by Little Sprite for him, after all, Little Sprite had opened a backdoor for him last time, and it felt quite good. He wondered if it was Little Sprite’s doing this time as well.
Anyway, this choice has no time limit.
So there’s no rush to make a decision.
They will wait to get in touch with Little Sprite and see what the specifics are.
…
Meanwhile, on Neutron Star!
“Phew!”
Li Peiqi, covered in blood, climbed out of a map, placed her hands on her hips, looked up to the sky, and laughed excitedly, “Chen Yi, I freaking love you!!!”
“Hahaha!!!”
“What doesn’t kill me makes me stronger!!!”
“This is the real charm of a Rule Prop!!!”
This time, the gains from the map were enormous, unprecedentedly so. It had been a long time since she got so much from a map, especially after gaining some power within the Black Dragon Guild.
She rarely went down to the maps anymore; her resources came more from the Black Dragon Guild’s stipend.
It was a little less but it won in safety.
There were no risks of sudden death.
At this moment, her best friend, Liu Xiaochan, was patting her chest in relief, her eyes full of terror as she spoke with a trembling voice, “Thank goodness you were here, otherwise, if I entered this map alone, I’d probably be gone without a place of burial by the third challenge.”
The death rate in this map was extremely high.
Much higher than she imagined. Out of 109 players that entered the map, only 17 emerged alive.
That shows the cruelty of the death rate.
But although the death rate was high, the rewards were exceptionally generous, especially for the two of them, who received nearly perfect clearance ratings and thus got the highest rewards among the survivors.
“Peiqi,”
Liu Xiaochan was still not over the shadow of death, looking at Li Peiqi with eyes full of the joy of survival, “In the last three challenges, how did you figure out which were the paths to life and which were to death?”
“There were only thirty seconds. There was no chance to make many judgments based on the information around us.”
“Simple,”
Li Peiqi said with a bit of smugness, hands on her hips, “Before entering this map, I timed it to enter at 23:59, and my method of death hadn’t changed.”
“It was still being killed by Chen Yi.”
“Not dying in this map.”
“So naturally, I didn’t need to worry as much. This is a weapon of cause and effect; in a certain sense, before I get killed by Chen Yi, I am almost an undying entity.”
“Unless I deliberately seek death.”
“Or some unexpected accident occurs.”
Her A-class Prop “Last Words” death method only updated every night at midnight, meaning even the next day, the Prop’s designated method of death would still be by Chen Yi’s hands.
However, there was still a chance of being crushed to death by a meteor from the sky.
If the Prop’s death method could update in real-time.
Then…
It wouldn’t be an A-class Prop anymore.
At the very least, it would have to be an S-class Prop; no, it might even touch upon SS-class Props.
To know in real-time one’s method of death, what a terrifying existence that would be—meaning one could skirt the edge of death and amass rewards with abandon.
And aside from dying of old age, there would virtually be no risk of death at all.
There would be no need to time map entries meticulously; no matter how difficult the map, she could enter blindly and without a second thought.
And it was at that moment—
She suddenly saw the Guild Leader’s message.
‘Li Peiqi, that gang has started to act. Everyone used some tricks to link up Chen Yi and Sky Demon Star, wanting to test the effect and see if they could use Chen Yi as a lethal weapon.’
“…”
Li Peiqi’s smile, which had just brightened her face, suddenly froze. After a moment, her expression cooled down; she calmly changed out of her blood-stained clothes and into a clean white dress, murmuring softly,
“Sometimes, I really admire these men.”
“They clearly know the risks of great death, yet they still take the gamble to conquer and control a man stronger than themselves.”
“Why?”
“The people who can make it to this position shouldn’t be too stupid.”
“Their ambitions always expand inappropriately.”
“It’s very normal,”
Liu Xiaochan said somewhat helplessly, “Anyone who’s made it this far has climbed out from a sea of corpses, having lingered on the edge of death hundreds of times.”
“They won’t be afraid.”
“So what do we do now?”
…
ps: Something unexpected came up these two days, damn it, I’ll focus on writing first. Tonight I’ll make up for the updates from the past two days, and then in the last chapter, I’ll talk about what happened these days—it’s simply shocking!!

chapters.title: Chapter 251: 243: "This should be called, the capable are busy.
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 243: “This should be called, the capable are busy.
“What else can we do?”
Li Peiqi didn’t hesitate at all and stood up, striding towards the distance, “Of course, we need to persuade our old Chairman.”
“It’s really frustrating.”
…
“Don’t look at me with that kind of eyes.”
The Chairman of the Black Dragon Guild, facing Li Peiqi whose eyes were blazing with fire, spread his hands helplessly and said, “I just know about this matter, I didn’t participate in it.”
“I already said last time that I withdrew, the Black Dragon Guild won’t get involved in any activities related to Chen Yi.”
“Yes.”
Li Peiqi nodded coldly, “You may not have been involved, Chairman, but you also didn’t stop the other forces on Neutron Star from getting involved.”
“How can I stop them?”
The Chairman of the Black Dragon Guild was somewhat dumbfounded as he said, “I’m just the Chairman of the Black Dragon Guild, not the big boss of the whole Neutron Star, how can I stop those forces?”
“Moreover, several of those forces are stronger than our Black Dragon Guild. Even if I say something, who would listen to me?”
“Have you forgotten again?!!!”
Li Peiqi stood up with a sense of frustration, looking at her troublesome Chairman, “That Chen Yi wiped out an entire race during a live broadcast!!!”
“Wiped out an entire race! ”
“Think with your head, even if the Black Dragon Guild doesn’t make a move, what if Chen Yi wipes out a race on Neutron Star after the other forces act?”
“Could we run away?”
“Don’t you have family, Chairman? Aren’t you worried about them being implicated?”
“Even if you don’t have a family, when a large number of Neutron Star players die at the same time, we, the surviving players, will have to be buried with them.”
“Have you considered that consequence?”
“I have.”
The Chairman of the Black Dragon Guild nodded seriously, “They’re also seriously discussing this matter. In fact, this probe was to find out the prerequisites for that Skill of Chen Yi’s.”
“What the cost is.”
“Or rather, if it’s a one-time cost.”
“I don’t want to be enemies with Chen Yi, partly because of your advice, and also because the operating style of the Black Dragon Guild is to make more friends and fewer enemies; we don’t want to establish formidable enemies without significant benefits.”
“But… Chen Yi isn’t as scary as you imagine.”
“The God Race that got wiped out by Chen Yi was already reeling from a catastrophic promotion failure and went to Blue Star to establish dominance, only to be devoured in one gulp.”
“But Neutron Star hasn’t experienced a promotion failure, nor has it faced major losses at the ‘dining table.’ One could even say that Neutron Star has been preparing for the promotion and is still potent.”
“Plus, a Skill that powerful definitely has some fatal usage condition or limitation in the number of times it can be used; it can’t possibly be used an unlimited number of times.”
“I just don’t want to be enemies with Chen Yi.”
“And that doesn’t mean I’m so afraid of Chen Yi that I can’t sleep at night.”
“Even if the other forces on Neutron Star offend Chen Yi and he wants to take action against Neutron Star, it won’t be as easy to conquer as the God Race was.”
“Moreover—”
The Chairman of the Black Dragon Guild paused before continuing, “They won’t come into direct contact with Chen Yi; Chen Yi might not even know they exist. As long as they don’t send a massive number of Neutron Star players to Blue Star,”
“Chen Yi simply won’t have the opportunity to target Neutron Star.”
“It’s in the game rules.”
“It’s part of the Newbie Protection Period, rules that can’t be violated.”
“At least for another 8 months, Chen Yi won’t be able to leave Newbie Village. By then, Neutron Star may have already succeeded in promotion—what is there to fear?”
“I’m not afraid of him; I just don’t want to make more enemies.”
“…”
After a long silence with an expressionless face, Li Peiqi barely spat out a number through clenched teeth, “6.”
Other than saying 6, what else could she say?
It’s like that saying: men are born entrepreneurs!
It’s not that men are particularly successful at starting businesses, but that every man, even facing numerous obstacles, believes he will overcome all difficulties and succeed.
Always believing they will succeed in the future, always thinking it won’t be them who die.
It’s a kind of innate and inexplicable confidence buried deep within most men.
Just like these people.
She only wished her own strength were stronger; if Neutron Star were under her unilateral control, such things would never happen.
Life is hard.
She didn’t speak again but instead turned around and walked outside the house, ready to dive into the map once more, to make her strength as formidable as possible.
And not long after Li Peiqi had left,
the Chairman of the Black Dragon Guild turned his head toward Liu Xiaochan, who was walking out from a corner, “Has the death method involving Peiqi’s A-level rule prop remained unchanged?”
“Mhm.”
The dopamine-dressed Liu Xiaochan nodded somewhat helplessly and said, “It’s been going on for over ten days now, every day she dies at the hands of Chen Yi.”
“This situation has almost become Peiqi’s Heart Demon.”
“Let me think.”
The Chairman of the Black Dragon Guild sat in the chair, sighed lightly, and with slightly drooping eyelids, felt somewhat weary as he massaged his temples.
The reason he withdrew,
was actually just one.
That was, the death method of Li Peiqi’s A-level rule prop was dying by Chen Yi’s hands.
Just as Li Peiqi had said.
Chen Yi was indeed very strong.
Could it really be as Li Peiqi said, that Neutron Star was implicated and annihilated, and Peiqi was likewise buried in oblivion?
“That… Chairman?”
Just then, Liu Xiaochan, who stood by his side, hesitated before finally speaking up, “Should we tell Peiqi that you are actually her biological father?”
“Peiqi has always thought she was an orphan.”
“No need.”
The middle-aged man sitting in the chair shook his head, “She’s been alone for too long, kinship for her isn’t a tonic, rather it could be a poison.”
“It’s quite good this way.”
“Wait a second…?”
The man suddenly realized something, “Li Peiqi’s death method is to die by Chen Yi’s hands?”
“And I am Li Peiqi’s biological father, could it be that I will die at Chen Yi’s hands and my three races get wiped out along with me?”
“Eh… Chairman, that seems possible.”
After frowning and remaining silent for a long time, the man finally said, “You go down first, no need to specifically come to report to me, your main task is to protect Peiqi’s safety.”
“Understood.”
…
Meanwhile, in a corner of Neutron Star,
led by Solar Star, the leaders of the major forces from three planets including Neutron Star and King Gou Star gathered in a virtual meeting room.
“The situation has become very clear.”
“We have already sent Chen Yi an invitation to ‘Deadly Tower’; the rule update of Blue Star this month has just added Deadly Tower as a gameplay.”
“This gameplay is one of the few in the Novice Planet that can be invaded by external bugs.”
“Sky Demon Star is a map planet of Star System No. 3, and this planet has no players, only myriad monsters.”
“Although the rewards are plentiful, the danger level is extremely high.”
“It is said that after completely pioneering this planet, the entire No. 3 Star System will change, but so far, the pioneering progress of this planet isn’t even 5%, the monster respawn rate far exceeds our killing speed.”
“If Chen Yi can activate that Skill on Sky Demon Star, then he won’t be able to take any dropped Props with him; we can distribute them according to the proportions set in advance.”
“Of course, if Chen Yi fails to activate that Skill and dies on Sky Demon Star,”
“that’d be a good thing for us too.”
“We wouldn’t have to worry about a monster emerging from the Novice Planet after eight months.”
“No matter the outcome, it would be all profit and no loss for us.”
With the conversation concluded,
the leader from a faction of Solar Star slowly stood up, his expression calm with a hint of a smile, “I appreciate everyone complying with Solar Star’s leadership this time around. A long time ago, in the culture of Solar Star, there was never any talk of invincibility.”
“Whatever it is.”
“Sunlight, rules, the ocean.”
“Anything.”
“Objective existence, subjective existence.”
“It can all be utilized.”
“Chen Yi is no exception. If such power isn’t used to pioneer, it’s truly a waste. According to a saying from Blue Star,”
“This should be called, ‘the capable take on more work.'”
…
ps: Making up for a chapter here, these days everything has been handled, will slowly catch up with updates.

chapters.title: Chapter 252: 244: "Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!" (10,000-word )
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 244: “Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!” (10,000-word chapter)
“But—”
The person in charge of the Neutron Star Sun Family Guild furrowed his eyebrows and began to ask, “So far, the only way to invade Blue Star is through the Deadly Tower, and it’s not even a forced entry; it requires Chen Yi’s consent.”
“What if Chen Yi doesn’t agree?”
“Then there’s nothing we can do.”
The person in charge of the Solar Star Tianxia Pavilion helplessly spread his hands and said, “The game’s protection level for planets in their Novice Period is very high. We have already exerted all our capabilities, but we can only achieve so much.”
“If Chen Yi refuses, then we can only wait for the next opportunity.”
“But…Chen Yi probably won’t refuse.”
“After all, this is a chance to go directly to the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower. As long as he agrees and clears it, it means he can instantly receive the rewards for clearing the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower and become the first squad in the world to clear it.”
“The reward is quite tempting, isn’t it?”
This plan is simple.
The map of the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower isn’t naturally the Sky Demon Star; by some special means, they swapped the map of the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower with the map of the Sky Demon Star, making Chen Yi work for them.
As long as Chen Yi uses that skill again, he may not wipe out all the monsters on the Sky Demon Star, but he’ll certainly advance the pioneering progress on the Sky Demon Star, and many props will drop for them to pick up.
And they don’t need to worry about risking their lives.
They won’t actually enter the Sky Demon Star.
They’ll only enter after Chen Yi has left the Sky Demon Star.
You could say this plan is all gain and no loss, of course, only if Chen Yi accepts the invitation. Otherwise, it’s all in vain.
“…”
As the voice faded.
After mutual glances among the people present, nobody spoke further, and they began to wait patiently.
There wasn’t much they could do now.
The only thing they could do was wait.
Whether the plan would succeed or not depended on whether Chen Yi was willing to be caught in the net.
…
Meanwhile, on Blue Star.
The Start of Autumn Festival event on August 8th was still in full swing.
This time-limited event wasn’t too dangerous; the whole globe turned into a huge pool, and many players were happy to release the stress they had accumulated for so long at the pool party.
In fact.
The players who have survived until now might be said to have the strongest psychological resilience and stress tolerance among Blue Star players.
But having strong resilience doesn’t mean there’s no need to vent stress.
A global pool party with no stakes and no competition became the best way for most players to relieve their stress.
Of course.
Many players were currently focused on the Arena Master leaderboard.
After paying 1000 Points, some players set high-difficulty moves and waited with relish to see if anyone would succeed in the challenge.
Other players were checking the leaderboard to see which moves they could attempt to complete.
If at first everyone was after the rewards.
But as things developed.
It started to feel like a bit of a competition.
Not possible? Who’s not capable? Isn’t it just a mid-air somersault move? I have to nail it!
So, at this time, the Arena Master leaderboard could be said to be a wild muddle. All kinds of devils, ghosts, and monsters were present.
“Ladies and gentlemen!”
In a video on the seventh place of the Arena Master leaderboard, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s mouth curved upward slightly, arms outstretched in front of a pile of neatly patterned minced meat, his eyes carrying a hint of smug pride as he spoke.
“68 seconds, I have shown my silly skill.”
Unable to contain his loneliness, Tuberculosis Rabbit also paid 1000 Points and released his Arena Master video. His ranking quickly rose, and in no time, he became seventh.
After all, dividing a complete human corpse into small, neat pieces of meat according to the patterns of the meridians within 68 seconds is not an easy task.
Currently, there are only 78 players in the world who can do it.
…
“No way?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked displeased at his ranking on the Arena Master leaderboard, “78 players have done it? When did I not know that there are so many people in this world who possess skills like mine?”
He always thought he had an absolute talent in this area.
Not to say no players could do it.
But there shouldn’t be so many, right?
A total of 78 players completed his move within 68 seconds, with many players even faster, so much so that the blades couldn’t be seen; only a brilliant light could be noticed on the corpse as fleeting flashes.
This was because blades passed through the air, leaving behind residual gleams from the reflection of sunlight.
He went through a lot of trouble to find that corpse, yet he didn’t achieve a satisfying ranking, making him quite discontented.
“Eh?”
Just then, Tuberculosis Rabbit noticed Chen Yi, who had originally been lying on a deckchair, but had now stood up and was bending over the table, swiftly moving his pen as if writing something on a piece of white paper.
Moved by curiosity, he leaned in and asked, “Yi, what are you writing over there?”
“I’m writing a guaranteed strategy for victory.”
Chen Yi took a long breath, straightened up, and put down the paper and pen in his hand, massaging his neck, which had grown sore from writing for almost an hour, and said tiredly and casually, “Just from writing for less than an hour, my neck is so sore it’s unbearable.”
“Before the game rewarded sitting, those web novel authors who sat in front of their computers all day long must’ve had a tough time.”
“During the Start of Autumn Festival event, I’m the final special guest. I can perform five moves, and players around the world have to mimic my moves. The more players that replicate them, the less my reward will be; the fewer the players who can replicate them, the greater my reward.”

chapters.title: Chapter 253: 244: "Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!" (10,000-word )_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 244: “Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!” (10,000-word chapter)_2
“And the first move, I’ve already thought of it,”
“Let’s name it ‘The God of Mathematics.'”
Chen Yi pushed a few sheets covered with numbers in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit with some satisfaction, “Take a look.”
“3.14159 26535 89793 23846…”
Upon glancing at the sheets, Tuberculosis Rabbit felt momentarily puzzled, but quickly realized, “Is this pi?”
“Correct.”
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow and let out a light chuckle as he activated the prop effect of the papers.
‘Prop Name’: Memory Paper.
‘Prop Level’: E-grade.
‘Prop Effect’: Record information on this piece of paper and swallow it, and the information on the paper will forever exist in your mind, never to be forgotten.
‘Prop Introduction’: “I hope you use it to record happiness, not hatred.”
“These papers have the digits of pi following the decimal point to 4000 places recorded on them. Once I swallow them, the information will be enshrined in my mind forever.”
“So, my first move is to memorize the 4000 digits following the decimal point of pi within thirty minutes.”
“Who in the world has such an ability?”
“How many people in the world can memorize the subsequent 4000 digits of pi?”
“Right!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused, then excitedly clapped her hands and said, “How did I not think to use this prop? Although it’s just an E-grade prop and not very valuable, it can be very effective in a pinch.”
“Even if other players also have this prop,”
“But for the Arena Master’s move, players must start the challenge within ten minutes. Who has the time to look up pi and record it on Memory Paper? You could say, Yi, your move is likely one that no player in the world can complete.”
“Let me search and see if anyone has memorized 4000 digits before.”
Five minutes later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit touched her nose and said somewhat sheepishly, “Uh, Yi, based on the information I found, before this game descended, there was a Guinness World Record set by a man named Lv Chao, who memorized pi to 67890 places.”
“Besides, there are 50,000, 40,000, 30,000…”
“There are too many to count.”
“There’s even a sixth grader who memorized over 9000 digits.”
“It seems like a lot of people can memorize over 4000 digits.”
“…”
Chen Yi, who was eating the paper, stiffened his movement slightly and fell silent for a while before continuing to chew with an unchanged expression, “No matter. Eliminating a group of people is enough.”
“Even if many people can complete this move, the reward won’t be too bad in comparison.”
“That’s…”
Just then, Sword Without End, who had been listening silently, suddenly leaned in with a doubtful face and looked at the virtual screen in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Are you sure the information you searched is accurate?”
“Memorizing pi to 70 thousand places?”
“That would have taken almost 30 hours straight in a day, right? Not to mention the difficulty of memorization, just reciting for 24 hours would be a huge strain on the body, wouldn’t it?”
“You’re right,” Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, clicking open the article titled ‘Guinness World Record: Memorization of Pi to 67890 Places’, “This guy really did recite for 24 hours non-stop.”
“No, that’s not it,”
Sword Without End looked at the Guinness World Record on screen, utterly unable to comprehend, “What does this guy do in his free time? For what reason would he memorize more than 70,000 digits of pi?”
“I don’t know that, but if you flip through the Guinness World Records, you’ll find a lot more things that don’t make sense,” said Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“But I think there’s still a chance,”
After pondering for a moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit said thoughtfully, “At least so far, we haven’t seen any Arena Master’s move that involves reciting pi. This means it’s very possible that everyone who could have recited pi is dead.”
“If that’s the case, then Yi’s first move could still fetch a fair amount of rewards.”
…
After deciding on his first move, Chen Yi lay back on the rocking chair, beginning to contemplate his second move.
And at that moment.
A prompt box popped up once again.
‘Ding, due to some unknown changes, you now have the right to directly challenge the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower. Please decide whether to accept the challenge!’
Chen Yi glanced briefly at the prompt, not paying much heed. He had already decided that his fifth move would be a speedrun of the Deadly Tower.
Many of his moves could be imitated,
Even the one involving memorizing pi. But there was one move that absolutely could not be replicated by anyone, which was him going all out.
Within an hour,
All skills, props, and titles, no cooldowns, no casting delays, no limit on uses.
Within a hundred miles, nothing would grow.
Who else could copy that?
All he needed was to ensure he claimed appropriately high rewards for the first four moves, and then secure the highest reward with his fifth move.
He was quite looking forward to the special reward that the Little Sprite mentioned.
Something that even the Little Sprite found special.
Could it be… a carrot-flavored lollipop?
Therefore, he planned to enter the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower on the third day of the event, during his turn as a guest. After all, there was no time limit on this invitation; entering later would not make a difference. It was just that the prompt kept popping up as if afraid he would miss it.

chapters.title: Chapter 254: 244: "Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!" (10,000-word )_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 244: “Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!” (10,000-word chapter)_3
Just.
Feeling somewhat embarrassed, Chen Yi turned his head to look at Jiaye, who was sitting beside him. After a moment of hesitation, he still spoke up, “Jiaye.”
“Hmm?”
As soon as he finished speaking, Jiaye, who was peeling an apple, straightened up like a startled cat, her face full of wariness as she looked at Chen Yi: “Yi, what’s up? My intuition tells me you’re in a very dangerous state right now, like you’re about to snap and kill someone.”
“Your intuition is pretty sharp.”
“I plan to ‘kill’ you in three days, to activate the Title Effect and get that mysterious special reward.”
“Ah.”
Sitting on a little stool nearby, Jiaye scratched her head with a troubled expression, “Try to use anesthesia if you can, I’m a bit afraid of pain.”
“It’s truly sad, everyone else is doing it, doing it, doing it, and that’s normal, but why do you, Yi, always use a knife?”
“…”
“…”
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit, who were chatting nearby, stiffened instantly upon hearing Jiaye’s words. Their mouths twitched wildly. After being frozen for three seconds,
they almost simultaneously acted as if nothing had happened, casually continuing their conversation as they walked towards a corner of the rooftop, and casually dragged Tie Chui away with them, who was still sitting there, listening intently.
Jiaye is getting more and more audacious when she speaks.
They no longer dared to listen.
“…”
Even Chen Yi, who was about to respond, was stunned by these words. After a while, he turned to look at Jiaye, who was sitting beside him, and then calmly asked in a soft voice, “So how do you want to do it?”
Realizing that she had misspoken, Jiaye’s face blushed as she buried it in her arms, flailing her hands desperately trying to explain something. But when she heard Yi’s words, she froze again, incredulously looking up at Chen Yi: “Yi…?”
In her impression,
Yi never joked about adult topics, not even going to Silver Party.
She thought Yi was one of those who abstained from women and devoted himself wholly to his career.
But the sudden comment from Yi… it gave her a strong sense of contrast, like a person you immensely admired and who was always deadly serious towards you suddenly decided to come down and dote on you.
Feeling helpless, Jiaye glanced around, clutched the hem of her skirt tightly, her legs coming together as she rubbed them unconsciously and pleaded in a trembling voice: “Yi, I just… I just blurted it out.”
“No, I heard it all,” Chen Yi said as he suddenly stood up, lifted Jiaye in a princess carry, and turned towards the stairs: “You have a point; always using the knife does seem a bit disrespectful to you.”
“Wait!!!”
Jiaye’s face flushed as she buried her head into Chen Yi’s chest, her voice trembling as she said: “I’m not ready yet, and it’s daylight. How about we wait for the evening? Everyone is still watching.”
“Yi, Yi—I was just talking nonsense, really talking nonsense.”
“Using the knife is enough, really enough.”
Without responding, Chen Yi carried Jiaye downstairs. Just as they were about to enter his room, Jiaye in his arms finally came to terms with the situation. Her eyes welled up with tears and her body softened as she pointed towards another room in the corridor,
“Go into that room… I’ve been decorating it for a long time… our bridal chamber.”
“Your room… smells too much of smoke.”
“Oh?”
Chen Yi opened the door at the end of the corridor, next to his room with slight astonishment.
What caught his eye was a room delightfully decorated with surprises.
A 2-meter wide bed stood in the center surrounded by many decorations, the whole room tinted in pink hues. It was clear Jiaye had secretly prepared a lot, and there was even a schedule on the wall.
First step, gentle kisses on the ears, eyelashes.
Second step, move down slowly, stop at the chest, the tongue starts to roam.
Third step, mouth agape, start sucking.
Fourth step…
“…”
Chen Yi closed the door with his foot, looking somewhat bemused at the schedule on the wall, feeling like something was a bit off.
By this time, Jiaye also realized it. Because she had come in so suddenly, she hadn’t taken down the schedule, and she couldn’t help but call out, covering her cheeks with her hands and giving up on struggling, her voice filled with a crying tone as she explained.
“It’s my first time, I have no experience, so I thought I’d do my homework in advance, so you wouldn’t find it boring, Yi.”
“Just kill me, Yi.”
“I want to die.”
This is so embarrassing.
She had never felt such an embarrassing moment before.
She swore, since the day she was born, she had never felt as embarrassed as she did right now.
“It’s okay.”
Chen Yi turned his gaze from the wall to Jiaye behind him, kissing her shoulder gently: “Where’s that black lace nightgown you bought last time? Put it on.”
“Okay…”
A moment later.
Jiaye, dressed in a black lace nightgown, stood in front of Chen Yi, her face blushing as she knelt down slowly.
…
Just like dry wood eventually ignites a spark,
a lone man and a lone woman shared a room.
And considering that both had harbored affection for each other for some time, one can easily guess what might happen next.
Jiaye, lying on the bed with her head suspended in the air, looked up water-eyed and full of allure at Yi, who was standing before her. Her mouth unconsciously opened slowly.
“Doesn’t this hurt?”
“No, it’ll be deeper, and you’ll enjoy it more, Yi,” she said.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, eased in gently, and leaned down to kiss Jiaye’s navel tenderly, his movements filled with gentleness and love.

chapters.title: Chapter 255: 244: "Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!" (10,000-word )_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 244: “Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!” (10,000-word chapter)_4
Only his body occasionally trembled slightly, obviously he had never experienced such a scene before.
…
Jiaye hugged her own legs tightly, her head tilted to look at the legs draped over her fragrant shoulder, her eyes full of confusion as she breathed unconsciously light and heavy.
She spread her arms around Yi’s back, burying herself tightly into Yi’s chest.
Her body seemed boneless, melting entirely into Chen Yi’s body.
Yi…
So powerful.
…
I don’t know how much time passed.
The sky darkened.
Chen Yi let out a long sigh, lying on the bed with a complex expression, cradling Jiaye in his arms, lighting a cigarette in silence without speaking.
The Jiaye in his arms seemed to have fallen halfway asleep, her eyes tightly closed, lying motionless in the arms of Chen Yi.
There was something a bit off.
The title that had essentially never been triggered since he obtained it suddenly activated.
“Title Name”: Fatal Strike.
“Title Level”: Blue.
“Title Effect”: After wearing the title, each attack has a 3% chance of critical hit.
“Obtaining Method”: In the “520 limited-time event,” complete the last strike of Cupid.
He had obtained this title a long time ago, during the 520 limited-time event, almost three months had passed since then, and this title had never been triggered since he got it, but… now it suddenly activated.
So, Jiaye… just like that, died in the land of tenderness.
And because he killed Jiaye, another title was triggered.
“Title Name”: Wife-Killing Maniac.
“Title Quality”: Red.
“Title Effect”: When you truly fall in love with a woman and kill her with your own hands, you will have a strong buff effect with no cooldown and no consumption for all props and skills for the next hour.
“Title Source”: “Obtain by completing a hidden mission in the Life Theater C-level map.”
“Title Restriction”: Usage chances (1/3).
This title had been actively used once in the last confrontation with the God Race, and now it had been used passively once, leaving only one chance left, which was completely wasted this time.
He hadn’t expected it to directly land a critical hit.
Although it was a bit of a waste, he didn’t get too upset because the Starry Level title he obtained from exterminating the God Race, “One Man Exterminates a Clan,” had a Title Effect—
For every 5 million Alien Race players killed, you can reset the cooldown and usage count of one prop or skill, as well as a title (currently resettable 3 times).
Which means, even if the Wife-Killing Buff ran out of uses, it could be reset once, and the usage count would be restored to three.
It can be understood that the Wife-Killing Manic can still be used ten more times.
It’s just that this time, it was completely wasted.
“Sigh!”
Chen Yi, feeling somewhat guilty, kissed Jiaye’s forehead, pinched out the cigarette in his hand, and prepared to hurry off to Hell to fish Jiaye back, otherwise if his brother-in-law Tie Chui found out he had literally thrust his sister to death, the guy with a slow brain would definitely come at him desperately.
But just as he was about to move,
His body suddenly tensed slightly, hesitating as he looked at Jiaye in his arms; though Jiaye had already stopped breathing, she gave him an unusual feeling, which was hard to describe in words.
But…
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi climbed on top of her again.
Just this once.
No one would know anyways, just this once, he would definitely not do this kind of thing again; although somewhat twisted, he really wanted to try the feeling.
As long as he didn’t tell anyone, no one would know he ever did such a perverted thing.
His image wouldn’t collapse.
…
“Sigh!”
Half an hour later, Chen Yi carefully placed the slightly chilled Jiaye on the bed, hurriedly took a shower, got dressed and then took out a sniper rifle from his bosom and aimed it at his forehead, firing several shots in a row.
It must be said,
The two experiences felt completely different.
If the first time was accompanied by pleasure produced by cooperation, then the second time was excitement produced by going against morals under stimulus.
And… you could use force as you pleased.
Move freely.
Without worrying about critical hits.
Without worrying about unseemly positions.
Just this once, never again.
After making a promise deep down, Chen Yi’s body fell to the floor.
…
In Hell,
Sitting in the coffee shop, Jiaye looked up guiltily at Chen Yi across from her, “Yi… sorry, I didn’t expect to die halfway, forcing you to stop on your first time.”
“It must have been tough, right?”
“…”
Chen Yi’s eyelids drooped, not daring to look directly into Jiaye’s eyes, somewhat sheepishly saying, “It’s okay, well, my Wife-Killing Buff still has 18 minutes left, how about we head back and talk?”
What could he possibly say?
Could he admit that not only had he not stopped, but after the first round, he went for another?
Was he even human?
That was the behavior of a beast!!!
Jiaye, seeing this, couldn’t help but grip tighter the hands Chen Yi had placed on the table, mustering the courage to speak up, “Yi, you don’t have to force yourself, I know it’s hard for a man to stop halfway.”
“Here’s what we’ll do, when we get back, I’ll give you another go, okay?”
“This time I’ll move. If I do, your Fatal Strike title probably won’t trigger.”
“Cough.”
Chen Yi almost lost his composure, coughing lightly into his fist, glanced around, stood up, and taking Jiaye’s hand, started walking out of the shop, “Alright, alright, let’s not talk about this anymore, I don’t have much need for that sort of thing.”

chapters.title: Chapter 256: 244: "Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!" (Part 5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 244: “Awesome, a grand opening upon meeting!” (Part 5)
“As long as the feelings are in place, there’s no need to actually go out.”
“About that, let’s first return to the home map and talk about going back to Blue Star.”
…
‘Map Name’: Arena Stage.
‘Map Level’: C-class.
‘Map Content’: All players will duel in an ancient arena stage, each player will battle against other players once, points are awarded based on victories and draws to determine the overall ranking.
The top three surviving players will receive additional rewards.
Eliminations will earn extra points as a bonus.
It is noteworthy that among the group of players, there are two ghosts clothed in player garments, whose goal is to eliminate other players and secure the top two spots.
Defeating or eliminating these two players will grant extra exclusive rewards.
‘Map Introduction’: Actors take the stage, there’s a craft to every trade.
Accompanied by a flash of white light.
Chen Yi and Jiaye appeared hand in hand in a certain map, and at the moment of landing, the other twenty-plus players in the map cast their gazes towards Chen Yi.
That ‘One Man Exterminates a Clan’ Starry Level title was indeed a bit glaring!
Blue Star player celebrity, Chen Yi.
Who doesn’t know him?
To think that one would end up in the same map as Chen Yi, and it’s even a combat map, this is a bit troublesome.
“Chen Yi.”
One of the players with a heavy beard took a deep breath and stepped forward with a hostile look, “I admit you’re strong, but… is this lady beside you also strong? You can certainly defeat us on the stage, but we can also defeat this lady beside you on the stage, or even kill her.”
“If you don’t want it to come to a situation where both sides suffer, I hope…”
Before he could finish speaking.
The bearded strong man saw countless red spider lilies suddenly floating in the air, filling up the entire arena map.
“…”
The voice came to a sudden halt.
The bearded strong man turned towards his friends with an expressionless face, “Badass, starting the show with a grand move!”
The next second—
Countless red spider lilies blossomed across the map.
The system’s voice introducing the map content hadn’t even finished ringing in their ears before a new prompt sounded.
‘Ding… Congratulations to players Chen Yi and Jiaye for being the last two surviving players in this map, clearing the level successfully.’
‘Successfully return to Blue Star and receive the following rewards.’
At this moment, Chen Yi was the complete embodiment of the Wife-Killing Buff.
Let alone a C-class map.
Even if a real A-class map were to come, it would probably be cleared in seconds.
Unless it’s the kind of map where the rules prevent one from taking direct action, any other combat map would be simply crushed and cleared.
…
Having returned to Blue Star, Chen Yi appeared in the new house meticulously prepared by Jiaye, and as he looked at the resurrected Jiaye, he felt a bit guilty and was just about to say something when he suddenly stiffened, frozen in place.
“What is this?”
Jiaye touched the sticky substance on her body with a bewildered look, and after a long while she incredulously looked up at Chen Yi, “Yi… Yi, I’ve died, and you actually didn’t stop?”
“And… it even came out?”
Chen Yi stood emotionlessly, sighing and looking up at the ceiling with a distant look, his eyes filled with resignation.
What’s the point of still being alive?
Maybe it’s better to die.
Living is too shameful.
Before going to hell, how could he forget to give Jiaye a bath first, was he too nervous, and that’s why he even forgot to clean up the scene?
How was he going to explain this to Jiaye?
It’s over, his image in Jiaye’s heart has completely shattered.
“It’s over!”
Jiaye suddenly collapsed, looking up at Chen Yi with despair in her eyes and a tremble in her voice filled with tears, “Could it be someone else’s? After we went to hell, did… did someone else barge in here?”
“I… I should just die.”
“What?”
Chen Yi, who had already been contemplating death, suddenly snapped back to reality upon hearing Jiaye’s cries, shaking his head as he explained, “No, before leaving I had enveloped this house with Frozen Palace.”
“With Froze Palace’s defense, most players can’t break through.”
“Even if someone wanted to force their way in, Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End on the rooftop would come down to meet the enemy.”
“It’s not someone else’s?”
“Is it?”
Jiaye breathed a sigh of relief, wiped the tears from her eyes, “That’s good, although I’m quite envious of Little Dragon Maiden’s affection, but I wouldn’t want a Yin Zhiping suddenly popping up. If it’s not someone else’s… then is it really yours, Yi?”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi once again fell silent with a blank expression, then after a moment took out a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and put it in his mouth, trying to stay as calm as possible before speaking up with clear embarrassment, “It’s mine, but it wasn’t on purpose. It sort of flew out on its own.”
“But… but there are two patches.”
“I have a split stream problem when I pee, it split into two patches on its own when it came out.”
“Oh… okay.”
Jiaye, half-convinced, touched her mouth and stomach before wrapping herself in a bath towel and entering the bathroom, “Then Yi, you should get that split stream treated, it’s split a bit too far. Alright Yi, you go up first, I’m going to take a bath and put on makeup before coming up.”
“Okay.”
…
It was already dark outside.
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit silently set up the barbecue grill on the rooftop, and when they saw Yi climb up to the roof, they handed him a freshly grilled skewer.
“Just cooked, want to try it, Yi?”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi calmly ate the meat skewer, and after a brief silence, he said, “You guys eat too, Jiaye will come up later.”
“Okay.”
Sword Without End nodded seriously, and then went back to earnestly grilling meat.

chapters.title: Chapter 257: 245: "Yi Really Knows the Rules Too Well." (Long Chapter)
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 245: “Yi Really Knows the Rules Too Well.” (Long Chapter)
Sword Without End seemed completely oblivious, seriously and earnestly brushing oil onto the skewers of meat in his hand.
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked off into the distance with an emotional expression and took a light sip of beer.
Although it may be inappropriate to say this,
it really did feel like watching one’s own cabbage being devastated by someone else.
Such a great Yi,
to be taken down just like that.
After establishing this sort of relationship, would Yi be able to unleash his full strength in the future?
Before long, Jiaye walked up to the rooftop.
The group of five got along quite well, eating barbecue and drinking beer on the rooftop, all while enjoying a chat about life.
…
“Ding, let us invite our special guest player Chen Yi, to be the highlight of this Start of Autumn Festival event!”
“Next, player Chen Yi will perform five moves for the vast number of players to learn and imitate.”
August 10th, 8:00 PM.
A prompt sounded in everyone’s ears.
Before realizing it,
the three days had nearly passed, and today was the last day of the Start of Autumn Festival event.
During these three days,
players across the globe enjoyed the pool party immensely without any crises, finally getting a chance to relax and nobody felt unhappy.
The Arena Master leaderboard was also extremely lively.
As the majority of players participated, the rankings were constantly refreshed. Amidst numerous newly-joined eccentrics, some Arena Masters who were initially highly ranked were now nowhere to be seen.
Like that self-contained Arena Master.
Initially ranked very high, shocking many, even the abstract world hadn’t seen such abstraction; it was even believed that no normal man could perform such moves.
Now, the ranking has fallen beyond the global 300.
Over 2000 players had managed to perform the move.
Of course,
there should be more players worldwide who could perform this move, but some players would rather forgo the reward than to act out such moves.
For some with a mental aversion to such things, self-containment is quite disgusting.
Even a gay would likely find it unacceptable to contain himself.
Of course, there is no certainty in that; after all, it’s too abstract, and so far, there has been no related information or shared experience from insiders on the internet.
With so many odd characters joining in, the current Arena Master leaderboard can be said to have an absurdly high level of credibility!
Not to mention anything else,
just taking the top three.
“Third in the rankings”: Zhang Shiping.
“Move”: Shadow Clone!
The move didn’t last long, just half an hour,
but was worth savoring for a lifetime.
The male protagonist in the video gestured with his hands in front of him, then instantly shadows emerged from his body, creating a brand-new clone.
It looked like a simple clone prop,
albeit rare, it wasn’t enough to rank third.
It’s just… the gender of the clone was female.
Afterward, the male protagonist and his female clone began their nuptial night, and three minutes later, they parted, the female clone’s belly began to rapidly swell.
Three minutes later,
a baby was born from the female clone’s belly, falling to the ground.
And the baby’s growth rate was very fast, turning into an adult in just a minute.
That wasn’t all.
Immediately following, the male protagonist summoned another male clone and a female clone, swapped, and two more babies were born.
Twenty-nine minutes swiftly passed,
and there was already an 18-person combat squad on the screen, each one holding a long sword and looking coldly at the camera, appearing very stern.
“Insect Race?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit speculated thoughtfully, “In a previous space game I played, the Insect Race had a rapid breeding rate and complete obedience to commands.”
“This man seems to have acquired a prop or skill related to the Insect Race.”
“It’s just unknown whether these clones have any attack power or what price needs to be paid to activate this prop or skill.”
“If the cost isn’t too high, and the clones do have attack capabilities, then this player’s strength should be re-evaluated. Logically speaking, with such power, we should have heard of this name before.”
“Zhang Shiping.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit repeated the player’s name, then turned to look at those around him, “Sounds unfamiliar, do you all remember him?”
“No.”
