Sword Without End shook his head and frowned as he spoke, “But I’m more concerned about another issue, which is whether these clones can enter a map that limits the entry to a maximum of 20 players along with their player, and whether they would take up a player slot.”
“If they can, that does seem a bit excessive, just keep on producing offspring, bringing your own army into the map, who could withstand that?”
Chen Yi didn’t speak, only squinting his eyes as he looked toward the number one player on the Arena Master leaderboard.
“Arena Master”: Gu Shengping.
“Move”: Title Materialization.
The video was only three minutes long.
This player named Gu Shengping had about seven titles floating above his head. In the video, facing a Minotaur Monster,
he bent at the waist.
Titles that were always perpendicular to the ground now ran parallel to it as Gu Shengping bowed.
Then he was seen sprinting, those hard and sharp titles acting like special Minotaur horns, slicing the Minotaur Monster in front of him in two.

chapters.title: Chapter 258: 245: "Yi Really Knows the Rules So Well." (Long Chapter)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 245: “Yi Really Knows the Rules So Well.” (Long Chapter)_2
Unmatched sharpness.
It looked extremely useful.
This move must definitely be the effect of some Skill or Prop title, but the source of acquisition was unknown, and so far, only 3 players globally had completed this move.
This move also had the fewest completions.
Which means, there are only 4 players who currently possess this skill worldwide.
However…
A glint of something different flickered in Chen Yi’s eyes as he nodded slightly without speaking.
It seemed that the materialization ability of this title had its drawbacks too.
At least for now, he had seen that the title above the player named Gu Shengping was constantly in a materialized state, never weakening. If it were to remain like this for long, it would indeed be rather inconvenient.
Even going home would be a problem, going home would mean bringing the house down.
But there was no more time for him to be distracted.
The next second—
A large screen emerged in front of all players.
And Chen Yi’s figure prominently appeared in the golden ratio position on the big screen.
There was also a one-minute countdown on the screen.
After the countdown ended, Chen Yi would have to make the first move for players worldwide to mimic.
The more players who managed it, the lesser his reward would be.
The fewer players who managed it, the greater his reward would be.
The one-minute countdown quickly ended.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, looked towards the nonexistent camera in front of him, and said softly with one hand on his cane, “My first move is to recite pi.”
As soon as he finished speaking.
All players around the world were momentarily stunned.
Everyone had been prepared for Chen Yi to make some incredible move that would be impossible for others to mimic. That would be normal since Chen Yi was now globally recognized as the strongest player. It wouldn’t be strange for him to do so.
But… pi?
That seemed a bit childish.
Not too hard, but too easy.
Isn’t it just 3.1415926…? Even someone who never went to school could recite a part, right?
But nobody thought Chen Yi was a fool, and naturally, they didn’t believe he would only recite a few dozen digits. At the very least, it would be a few hundred, if not a few thousand.
Without any communication.
But most players hastily started searching for pi, eager to memorize a bit.
Cramming at the last minute, isn’t it too late… I’m always cramming, why do I always procrastinate?
Meanwhile in a corner.
A middle-aged man who was cooking heard Chen Yi’s voice and was momentarily puzzled, then he turned his head to look at the screen beside him. After confirming he’d heard correctly, a supremely confident smile crept across his face.
After straightening a non-existent tie at his collar, he put down the spatula in his hand and walked leisurely yet confidently toward the sofa in the living room.
He poured himself a glass of red wine and waited patiently.
At that moment.
A woman burst out of the bedroom, somewhat excited and in a hurry, looking at the man on the sofa, “Honey, weren’t you the record holder for pi memorization before this game descended upon us?”
“Could you succeed in challenging what Chen Yi just did?”
“If there aren’t many who succeed in the challenge, we could get a pretty good reward, enough to make our lives a bit better now.”
“Don’t worry.”
The man chuckled lightly, resting his arm on the edge of the sofa, “I have been honing my skills for ten years, waiting for this day.”
“Everyone laughed at my obsession, thinking what’s the use of memorizing pi to 70,000 digits?”
“Little do they know, I’m ahead of them by more than a dozen versions.”
“This day is all within my expectations.”
Then, the man drank the wine in his glass in one gulp, his face turning slightly red as he stood up straight and stared intently at Chen Yi on the screen, his voice a bit hoarse as he said.
“Bring it on!”
“Let me see how strong you are!”
…
After a short pause, Chen Yi continued.
“The pi I will recite next is divided into seven segments.”
“The first segment is from the millionth to the million and two thousandth digit of pi.”
“The second segment is from the seven millionth to the seven million and three hundredth digit.”
“…”
“The seventh segment is from the ninety-third million seven hundred thousandth to the ninety-three million seven hundred and twelve thousand two hundred and twenty-eighth digit.”
“51058209749445…”
‘Special guest Chen Yi’s first action is complete, the system names it – Math Sovereign.’
‘Players have ten minutes to choose to challenge or give up.’
‘If no choice is made after ten minutes, it will be considered a forfeit.’
After these words, all players around the world went silent.
Are you even human?
Can you act like a human?
Reciting pi is reciting pi, but is this how you recite pi?
You don’t start from the beginning, but from the middle?
And then you break it into seven segments? Even if they tried to search for those seven segments of pi now, it would take plenty of time.
Even with the book open, it’s useless.
For a time, many players who had been ready to cram gave up in speechlessness, as the difficulty of the task was too great; it was utterly impossible.
Unless they were given more time to prepare.
If they had 24 hours to prepare, perhaps the task could indeed be accomplished, but a mere 10 minutes was simply not enough.
…
In a corner, the man who had just finished his wine with a red face gazed intently at the screen. Upon hearing the ranges Chen Yi was going to recite, he suddenly became somewhat dumbfounded.
“Who… who memorizes like that?”
“So?”
The woman sitting next to the man asked anxiously, “Honey, have you memorized those parts?”

chapters.title: Chapter 259: 245: "Yi Really Knows the Rules Too Well." (Long Chapter)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 245: “Yi Really Knows the Rules Too Well.” (Long Chapter)_3
“No, a normal person wouldn’t be able to memorize a million digits either.”
“However—”
“That doesn’t mean there’s no way to do it.”
The man’s movements were swift as he quickly searched for the one million digits of pi and rapidly explained, “To memorize so many digits of pi, one would need at least 30 minutes, plus another 10 minutes to prepare.”
“Which means—”
He glanced up at the screen where Chen Yi had already started rapidly reciting pi, then buried his head again in the search: “All we have to do within 40 minutes is to find all the digits of these seven segments of pi, and then memorize them all.”
“We would then complete the challenge.”
“It’s very difficult, I need a mnemonic device, quick, go and peel some more fruits for me.”
“Okay, you can do it, husband.”
The woman didn’t say any more, but quickly grabbed the fruit knife and ran to the fridge, bringing out all the fruits they normally hesitated to eat and rapidly peeled them.
Her husband had a peculiar quirk.
His memory was incredibly sharp when eating fruits; everything he heard or saw during the process, could be said to be etched in his mind.
But there was a downside.
That is, when he wasn’t eating fruits, his memory was terribly poor, and he could hardly remember anything. He might forget a statement as soon as he had made it.
So whenever she quarreled with her husband, she wouldn’t let him eat fruits, and whenever she prepared a surprise for him, she would have him eat fruits.
After so many years of marriage,
Her husband remembered only the good about her and never any bad.
That was the reason for their enduring affection over the years.
This was her husband’s superpower!
Her own superpower was that she could peel fruits smoothly, quickly, and perfectly.
…
Soon, seven minutes passed.
A total of 11,092 players globally had chosen to take on the challenge, without exception all had failed, and the countdown to the end of the challenge was just three more minutes away.
Since the challenge cost nothing, anyone who was free decided to give it a try.
In another three minutes, if no player succeeded, this action would be rated as a divine move, with exceedingly rich rewards.
Chen Yi, patiently standing in place, couldn’t help but smile lightly at the situation. It looked like a promising start.
Originally, he had expected that if just one of the five actions achieved the divine move status and secured the special reward, it would be enough.
He had thought that quickly passing 100 floors of the Deadly Tower would surely reach the divine move status, but it appeared that the first action might just achieve it.
The initial plan was to recite pi to beyond the 4,000th digit, but Tuberculosis Rabbit’s reminder made him realize that there were too many players globally capable of that.
So he altered his plan.
With the help of Memory Paper, he didn’t have to start from the beginning, but could simply recite a few segments.
That’s how the situation of reciting seven segments of pi came about.
But—
Memory Paper is only an E-level prop and isn’t rare. Claiming that everyone has one would be an exaggeration, but it’s not uncommon.
From the start of his recitation, players had nearly 40 minutes to prepare.
For this reason, he prepared three steps.
The first step, he selected seven segments, and apart from the initial few, the later ones didn’t start at whole numbers, like starting with the 9821321st position. Looking up pi in such positions would take quite an effort.
That greatly increased the difficulty of the search.
The second step.
To write down thousands of digits on paper, 40 minutes of time wouldn’t quite suffice.
The possibility of continuously writing a few thousand digits without mistakes is even smaller.
These two steps had essentially barred all challengers at the gate.
But… what if, by some chance, someone managed to do it?
For this eventuality, he prepared a third step!
While reciting the sixth and seventh segments,
He deliberately made mistakes in 13 digits. This didn’t break the rules, as the rules only required him to perform an action, and the specific segments of pi he mentioned reciting were rules he set for himself.
So—
The actual content of the action would be,
“Recite seven segments of pi following the one-millionth position and deliberately make mistakes in 13 digits during the sixth and seventh segments.”
Want to succeed in the challenge?
A sly smile appeared in Chen Yi’s eyes; he suddenly felt an urge to see the expression on the faces of those unique and remarkable characters who actually memorized those seven segments of pi, only to find they failed the challenge.
“Yi really knows the rules too well.”
In the corner of the rooftop, Tuberculosis Rabbit clicked his tongue full of emotion, “So cunning and astute.”
“I bet nearly all the players think that Yi really did earnestly memorize the seven segments of pi.”

chapters.title: Chapter 260: 246: "Child, since the questions are all wrong, the answers are naturally wrong as well.
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 246: “Child, since the questions are all wrong, the answers are naturally wrong as well.
“Indeed.”
Sword Without End also nodded helplessly. He had thought that Yi simply planned to rely on swiftly clearing the hundred levels of the Deadly Tower to claim the special rewards. The first four actions were just a formality, but to his surprise, Yi set the difficulty to the maximum on the first action!
Assuming.
Assuming there was a normal person with excellent memory who heard the range of Pi that Chen Yi intended to recite. Their first reaction would definitely be to quickly search for these seven segments of Pi on the internet.
And try to memorize them as quickly as possible.
That’s certain.
Not to listen to Yi recite everything word for word, and then start to memorize.
There wouldn’t be enough time for that.
This is the most efficient use of time.
But this is exactly the trap Yi had laid.
Really… cautious.
…
“In this day and age, do you know what technology is?”
In a corner, a player sneered as he looked at the Pi document he had already searched for online, his eyes filled with disdain.
And by his side.
There was a printing machine and a large stack of E-level Memory Paper.
It’s just Memory Paper, isn’t it? An E-level prop, is it that hard to get? It isn’t worth much, but generally, no one buys this stuff.
But he was different.
A few days ago, he had spent a sum of Points to gather a huge pile of Memory Paper. His original intention was to collect enough Memory Paper to record the entire history and culture of Blue Star, hoping that when the game ended one day, Blue Star’s heritage wouldn’t be lost.
At least history would be passed down.
If the culture continues, the heritage won’t be lost.
Currently no one has realized this yet, but when he accidentally acquired a piece of Memory Paper, the idea of creating a human library emerged in his heart. He wanted to pass down the entirety of Blue Star’s five thousand years of culture.
It’s too much to say it’s for the benefit of the world, but at least he wants his unborn son to know about the splendid history and culture Blue Star had before the game came along.
However, it just so happened that the large stash of Memory Paper he’d collected was unused when he encountered Chen Yi’s Arena Master challenge.
“Phew!”
He took a deep breath, sneered at the continuously calm reciting Chen Yi, and with a resolute click, downloaded the Pi document from the computer screen.
As long as he downloads this Pi document and prints it onto the Memory Paper with the printing machine, he can perfectly meet the challenge.
To date, no player in the world has succeeded.
He will be the first.
The biggest difficulty for him in this challenge was being unable to flawlessly write so many numbers on the Memory Paper in a short time, nor could he guarantee that there would be no mistakes, so the printing machine was a very good thing.
As long as it can be downloaded!
As long as it can… be downloaded…
“…”
The man suddenly became expressionless and silent, staring at a white pop-up that appeared on his computer for a long time without speaking.
‘This content has been made VIP-exclusive for you, unlock immediately with VIP!’
‘VIP members enjoy privileges like text download, text copy, cloud transfer, format conversion, and more.’
‘This document is provided by Baidu Wenku.’
Unabled to download.
To download this document, he needed to become a member.
What a conundrum.
WeChat and Alipay had long since ceased operations, so where would he pay? What era is this anyway?
The internet no longer uploads new information, so the timeliness of the information currently found online is basically three to four months behind. The internet hasn’t collapsed only because the game developers intervened, giving players a place to search for information.
So as not to be completely cut off from information.
But all other internet companies have already disbanded.
At this point in time, who would expect someone to dedicate themselves to a 996 work schedule.
Now, all players use the internet as an information pool, with the game-created forums serving as the main communication platform for strangers, while channels like friends, team, and guild channels are used for communication among acquaintances.
In other words.
At this time, seeing paywalled information on the internet, there’s simply no way to pay for it; there’s no method or pathway to do so.
“Find another one.”
The man spat lightly and began to open the browser to click on the next page, clicking through thirty-four pages.
The man broke down.
Eighteen of the pages were Baidu Wenku’s paywalled pages.
Nine were paywalls from other websites.
The rest were incomplete pages that didn’t cover the full length of Pi he needed.
Finally, after flipping through countless pages, he found a free and complete page and without any hesitation, downloaded the entire document.
The printing machine started up.
Five minutes later.
The man, with a serious expression, stuffed several pieces of Memory Paper into his mouth, chewing them as he looked at the 3-minute countdown for the challenge.
To this day, no one has succeeded in the challenge.
He will be the first.
“Hmph.”
Confidently, the man sneered and chose to begin the challenge.
The challenge would last thirty minutes, after all, reciting so many numbers couldn’t be done in just a few minutes, but it didn’t matter. He believed that the victory would be his after thirty minutes.
…
In a corner of Blue Star,
a woman held a plate of neatly sliced fruit, looking worriedly at her husband on the couch whose eyes were bloodshot. Her mouth opened and closed several times but in the end, she said nothing, afraid of disturbing her husband’s concentration.
Time passed.
SEND GIFT
1

chapters.title: Chapter 261: 246: "Child, if the questions are wrong, the answers will naturally be wrong as well."_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 246: “Child, if the questions are wrong, the answers will naturally be wrong as well.”_2
With only 2 minutes left in the countdown to the challenge,
the man sitting on the sofa suddenly broke into a grin, “Wrong by 13 digits—I knew my judgment wouldn’t fail me. Memorizing thousands of digits in one go, errors are bound to happen.”
Seeing her husband suddenly speak up, the woman let out a sigh of relief but still spoke anxiously, “So that was why you insisted on listening to Chen Yi recite while checking it against the pi document online?”
“That’s right.”
The man nodded, glanced at the last remaining two minutes of the countdown, then slowly closed his eyes as he leaned back on the sofa, picking up a grape from his wife’s lap and popping it into his mouth, murmuring tiredly.
“I could’ve just searched for those seven sections of pi and memorized them, but… as I said, I couldn’t be sure whether Chen Yi would make a mistake during his recitation.”
“Once he made a mistake, then even if I recited the seven sections of pi perfectly, the challenge would still end in failure.”
“So I had to follow along with the pi document the whole time, comparing and memorizing at the same time. The mental pressure is immense, but it is indeed effective.”
“My guess was correct, Chen Yi indeed made 13 errors in the last few sections.”
“This is a fatal issue.”
“Luckily, I caught it, or else I would have failed this challenge.”
“Actually…”
After hesitating for a moment, the woman still spoke, “Actually, it wouldn’t matter if you failed. I mean, although I really want the high reward, I don’t like seeing you so stressed. It makes me feel bad. We’re already living quite well as it is. Many people can’t even afford fruit.”
“No way.”
The man abruptly opened his eyes, looking at the countdown that was less than a minute away, his voice hoarse.
“I’ve never been much capable in my life, always mediocre, causing you to suffer alongside me. Now that an opportunity has appeared before us…”
“I must win, I have to win.”
“At least—”
“This time, I must win!”
“Player Lv Chao, challenge confirmed!”
…
Soon, the ten-minute challenge time had expired.
No more challenges could be initiated.
Up to this moment, not a single player had succeeded in the challenge.
However, this did not mean that the challenge was over.
The system indicated that there were still 170,000 players continuing to challenge, with half an hour of challenge time remaining, and only after half an hour would it be known whether any players had succeeded.
The number of players still challenging rapidly decreased.
From 170,000, to 150,000, then to 130,000.
The count was dwindling.
Chen Yi, leaning on a cane in the middle of the rooftop, smiled lightly as he looked at the panel in front of him without speaking. Suddenly struck by a thought, he glanced at Jiaye who was standing beside Tie Chui, continuously watching him.
Their gazes met.
He saw the deep, watery ponds in the depths of her eyes.
The corners of his mouth lifted slightly; having more bonds was actually quite nice.
He was a bit luckier than Tuberculosis Rabbit; Tuberculosis Rabbit only had one family member, while he now had two.
Everyone grows.
Just as he used to wait by the wall of the orphanage every day, hoping for his parents to take him home, everyone’s growth begins with the realization that their longstanding wait has been nothing but a bubble.
Thinking about it more closely,
Back then, Tuberculosis Rabbit never mentioned his parents, nor had he ever hoped for them to take him home.
Perhaps Tuberculosis Rabbit understood from a young age that no one would ever come for him.
In that respect, Tuberculosis Rabbit matured even earlier than he did.
But now…
Chen Yi’s gaze returned, his brows slowly furrowing as he pondered a serious matter.
How to resolve the drawback of Fatal Strike?
The title had an effect that allowed attacks to critically hit by chance.
The odds were small.
He hardly ever encountered it, which, of course, had something to do with most of the people he personally killed being taken down effortlessly.
But he did witness an incident recently on the streets, where he saw a man critically hitting a girl in a club, resulting in blood and a subsequent fight.
Bedroom affairs were judged as attacks.
There was a chance of a critical hit.
He didn’t know how this ruling system came about, but that’s just how it was.
So, in the past few days when he first became intimate with Jiaye, they did it from behind.
That could be considered taking advantage of the rules of August.
August rules, backstabs can’t do damage.
With that, even if you have a Fatal Strike’s Critical Hit Rate, there’s no worry about suddenly dying.
But… August will eventually end.
What about September? October?
August sweetheart?
And maintaining this angle is getting tiresome too.
Isn’t there a good way to solve this problem?
Chen Yi found himself lost in thought, momentarily at a loss for how to best tackle this issue, unless he obtained a corresponding Prop, title, or Skill.
For instance, a Skill that could temporarily disable a certain title.
Or perhaps a Prop that makes a player invincible for thirty minutes.
Give such a Prop to Jiaye, and naturally, he would have nothing to fear, but an invincibility for thirty minutes Prop would have to be at least S-Class, right?
That’s way too out of reach for him.
If he could acquire that Prop, this wouldn’t be much of a problem anymore.
“Huff!”
Chen Yi let out a sigh, regretting for the first time that he chose this title; it was quite inconvenient, mainly because this judgment mechanism was just outrageous. How could that thing be judged as an attack?
It’s unreasonable.
Of course, in an upgrade-based game, there isn’t much reason to speak of.
At that moment.
TWenty-five minutes had passed since the challenge time ended, meaning in five more minutes, even the players who issued a challenge at the last second would complete it.
Just five minutes left.
But so far, not a single player had succeeded in the challenge.
There were still 173 players attempting.
Just a challenge video saw a swift increase in click rates, and the likes were skyrocketing too.
The video showed a buzz-cut man, reciting seven segments of Pi steadily and seriously, then receiving a challenge failure notification. He stood there in disbelief and then, frustrated and furious, yelled in the video.
“Impossible!!!”
“I used an E-Class Prop, Memory Paper, how could I have possibly made a mistake?!!”
“BUG!!!”
“You guys have a bug, I’m going to file a complaint. Either the upgrade-based game has a bug, or it’s the E-Class Prop, Memory Paper, that’s bugged. There’s no way I recited it wrong!”
“I printed all seven segments of Pi on the Memory Paper and swallowed it, how could it still go wrong?”
At the end of the video, the man also shared the information of his Memory Paper Prop.
The video caused quite a stir.
Because according to what the man said, he shouldn’t have failed the challenge.
Unless… there really was a bug.
It wasn’t an exaggeration; every month’s version update for the upgrade-based game did fix a lot of bugs, so one more bug wasn’t seen as a serious issue.
But then—
More and more players began to claim that they were one hundred percent certain they hadn’t made a mistake, yet they received a challenge failure notification; it was a major blunder!
“Tsk tsk.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the information on the forum and the comments section below those challenge videos and couldn’t help but grin, “These people, really, are just too cute. Whatever Yi says, they believe.”
“Did none of these people ever consider the possibility that Yi might have made a mistake?”
“No.”
Sword Without End shook his head with a complex expression, “Haven’t you noticed that the ones currently claiming they should have succeeded in the challenge are all who used the Memory Paper, the E-Class Prop?”
“What does that indicate?”
“It indicates that these people probably also believe that Chen Yi used the Prop, so they basically believed from the start that Chen Yi couldn’t possibly make a mistake, after all, a Prop doesn’t make mistakes.”
“It’s like when you go to take an exam, and your first reaction is never to doubt whether the questions on the paper are wrong.”
“But when you copy directly from the answers and still get marked wrong by the teacher, naturally, you feel unjustified.”
“I literally copied from the answers, why did I get zero? Are you blind in marking, teacher?”
“Then the teacher, with a kind expression, tells you, child, the questions are all wrong, so naturally, the answers are too.”
“Yi’s practically played these people to death.”
Just then—
A notification sound rang in everyone’s ears.
「Ding, congratulations to player Lv Chao for being the first to succeed in the challenge!」
「Let’s give him a round of applause!」

chapters.title: Chapter 262: 247: "I can't believe it, how is this possible?
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 247: “I can’t believe it, how is this possible?
“Congratulations?” The tuberculosis rabbit, still grinning, suddenly froze in place, looking somewhat bewildered at the system prompt in front of him. Had someone actually succeeded in the challenge?
Did he see that wrong? Or hear wrong?
But seeing Sword Without End beside him with an expression of disbelief, the tuberculosis rabbit finally came to his senses—it was true, a player had actually succeeded in the challenge.
“This is impossible!!” The tuberculosis rabbit’s voice rose in disbelief, eyes filled with shock, “A full seven segments of pi, each segment randomly extracted from within pi’s sequence, thousands of digits, even including 13 deliberately memorized incorrectly.”
“How could anyone succeed under these circumstances?”
“I don’t buy it, how is this possible?”
“Unless there is one possibility.”
Sword Without End spoke with a complicated expression, “Unless someone memorized these several thousand digits of pi within these forty minutes, and the mistakes just happen to be in the exact places Yi made them, even the digits that were deliberately memorized incorrectly were exactly the same.”
“The probability of this is not non-existent, just very small.”
“But if it happened, then you have to accept it.”
Chen Yi looked thoughtfully at the name of the successful challenger without saying a word.
Lv Chao? That name felt familiar. Wasn’t that the player who had achieved a Guinness World Record right before the upgrade game descended, one adept at recollection, who after listening continuously for half an hour finally noticed the 13 deliberately incorrect digits?
That’s quite impressive.
And at this time—
The video of this player named Lv Chao challenging was quickly upvoted to the top of the list, and a phrase at the end of the video began to circulate rapidly.
One could see Lv Chao on the couch, having narrated the thousands of digits of pi and getting the challenge success prompt, looking into the camera with a smile, “Hello, Chen Yi.”
“Before the successful challenge, I had thought about something—it’s virtually impossible for a normal person to recite thousands of digits in a row without errors, even for me.”
“Although you said before the Overlord video that you were going to recite these seven segments of pi, I wasn’t sure you wouldn’t make mistakes.”
“So I watched that video in full, and as I expected, you got 13 digits wrong.”
“That’s why I succeeded.”
“The success was quite lucky, but I have to say, Chen Yi, your memory has already surpassed ninety-nine percent of the global population.”
“In fact, before the challenge, I too wasn’t sure if I could recite the whole sequence flawlessly, but luckily, I succeeded. The rewards I’ve received are enough for my wife to live comfortably for a while, thank you, Chen Yi.”
As the words fell, all players were in an uproar.
No wonder many players who recited correctly failed—it turned out it was not because those players recited incorrectly, but because Chen Yi did.
The rule was to mimic Chen Yi’s actions, regardless of whether his actions were wrong, just follow them and that’s it.
…
The man who was fixing the printing machine, suspecting it was broken, sat on the ground expressionless after seeing this segment, giving up on his adjustments.
He had thought his printing machine was broken, causing errors when printing on Memory Paper.
Now it seemed that there was nothing wrong with his machine; it was simply Chen Yi who had recited incorrectly.
Lv Chao…
Was this player sick in the head? Did this player even know of the existence of Memory Paper?
With the existence of Memory Paper, how could one possibly think Chen Yi could recite wrong?
Damn it, could it be this player didn’t rely on Memory Paper and truly memorized several thousand digits in forty minutes on their own memory?
That had to be the case.
This player must not know about Memory Paper, otherwise, they would never doubt the possibility of Chen Yi reciting incorrectly.
And Chen Yi was even more outrageous. With the existence of Memory Paper, why would he get it wrong?
Unless…unless it was intentional.
The man sighed helplessly and discarded the tools in his hand, abandoning his efforts. There was nothing more he could do with such limited time. If the challenge was a failure, then so be it.
In the journey of life, success is accidental; failure is the main theme.
But just then—
“Ding, congratulations to player Wang Buer for being the second successful challenger!”
“Let’s give him a round of applause!”
Another player managed to complete the challenge.
But before everyone could marvel at that, the prompt tone started to ring one after another.
Until three minutes later, when the challenge time was completely over.
A total of 12 players challenged successfully.
And on the panel in front of all the players, there was only one image to see.
“Challenger Chen Yi, the first movement math king.”
“12 players have challenged successfully.”
“…”
The tuberculosis rabbit lit a cigarette somewhat resignedly, letting out a sigh, “There’s no way around it. If it had been only one player who succeeded, I could still be a little reluctant, but with so many players succeeding, perhaps this move wasn’t that difficult after all?”
“Heh.”
Sword Without End’s mouth twitched slightly, unable to control a smirk. It’s bullshit that it wasn’t hard. If he had been unaware of this move, he would never have been able to complete it—he could only say that everyone has their own strengths.
And Yi is now taking advantage of his strength to challenge global players, so naturally, it’s fraught with difficulties.
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow slightly and looked at the prompt panel that popped up.
“Ding, congratulations on your first Overlord action, with only 12 players succeeding in the challenge.”
“Being in the 10-20 range, you will be rewarded with an SS-level reward.”
“Reward: One random B-level skill.”
“Skill?”

chapters.title: Chapter 263: 247: "I refuse to believe it, how is this possible?"_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 247: “I refuse to believe it, how is this possible?”_2
Chen Yi looked at the skill panel with some surprise. Skills were quite difficult to obtain. Aside from the skill fragments dropped by other players upon death, there was no direct sale channel for skill fragments; they could only be accumulated through skill fragments from some activities.
But skill fragments are too varied, and unless you collect five of the same kind, you can’t exchange for a complete skill.
Once you finally put together a complete skill, the skill’s level of strength isn’t guaranteed either.
To this day, he didn’t have many skills, and not a single B-level skill.
In terms of rarity, skills of the same effect and level are definitely stronger than props.
Firstly, skills are instantly activated, unlike props that need to be activated from the backpack. In moments of imminent crisis, skills allow for a faster attack, which means faster killing of the enemy or avoiding being killed by the enemy.
Moreover, while props may have a chance of being dropped upon death, skills do not.
However, there are also downsides.
There are only eight slots for skills, meaning each player can only equip up to eight skills. Any additional skills cannot be used, and one installed skill cannot be removed. If forcibly taken down, the skill will turn to powder and can never be equipped again.
Unlike props.
As long as you have them, as long as you can use them, as long as you have enough backpack space, even carrying tens of thousands of props is without issue.
In terms of rarity, a skill of the same level is stronger than a prop.
But just in terms of rarity.
In some cases, a prop may be stronger than a skill.
Each prop and skill level only represents the rarity of the prop or skill, not their strength. Of course, in most cases, the rarer ones are stronger.
Except for exceptions.
Like the E-level prop Memory Paper, isn’t this prop strong?
It’s strong.
The reason it’s rated an E is that it’s not rare.
He currently had three skills in his skill slots.
“D-level skill, Calm and Composed.”
“D-level skill, Mirror Man.”
“C-level skill, Annihilate Nine Clans!”
Among these three, the most frequently used is Calm and Composed, a passive skill that doubles physical abilities as long as there’s no fear.
Mirror Man is an escape skill that he hasn’t had many chances to use.
The last skill was more familiar, used more often, a be-all and end-all skill. He used it while exterminating the Demon Clan and found it very handy.
There are two other skills.
One he gained after becoming a Three-Star Couple with Jiaye, granting him the special exclusive skill “Revive, My Love.”
This skill is quite powerful. By offering 10,000 points or a C-level prop, you can revive a dying lover. If not enough points are available, you’ll fall into a dying state as the price.
The other was the skill “The Moon Is Beautiful, But You Are More So” that came with the couple’s ring he bought for 99,000 points.
This skill has a cooldown of 24 hours and can instantly teleport you next to your loved one.
Both of these skills don’t take up a skill slot.
In other words, he has only three skills equipped now, with five open slots remaining in his skill bar.
Of course, with the acquisition of this new skill, there will be only four slots left.
“Skill Name”: Requesting the Mandate of Heaven.
“Skill Level”: B-level.
“Skill Effect”: A rule-based skill. Upon activation, you can directly converse with the head of the Snow Sea Project, expressing your requests or wishes. The project leader will fulfill any of your requests, though you may need to pay a corresponding price.
“Skill Restrictions”: The Snow Sea leader won’t chat with you, only provide a price for your request. After one use, it will enter a cooldown period of six hours.
“Skill Introduction”: For the strong, we are willing to grant some privileges.
“Hmm?” Chen Yi looked at the skill panel before him, frowning slightly without speaking. This was his first B-level skill, and he had expected it to be strong—only to find it was just such a thing?
It sounded impressive, being able to speak directly with the Snow Sea Project leader.
But to put it plainly, wasn’t it just a dedicated customer service?
His first hard-earned B-level skill turned out to be a dedicated customer service?
Is that appropriate?
Chen Yi was somewhat speechless. After some thought, he still equipped the skill to his skill bar. A B-level skill is a B-level skill, after all, and he still had five empty slots. Might as well equip it for now and discard it later if it proves useless.
Just wanted to see the effect first.
“Ding, player Chen Yi has activated the B-level skill, Requesting the Mandate of Heaven.”
“Now please enter your request in the text box in front of you.”
A very plain page.
It looked like the Snow Sea Project leader had taken the 5 million points budget for UI design and then outsourced it to a Taobao studio.
“In the novice period of a planet, what are the ways to obtain an A-level item?”
After hesitating for a while, Chen Yi still posed this question. He was originally going to ask some questions about the background of the upgrade game, like its origins, or what the end would be, and if Blue Star had a chance to restore peace, as it was before.
But in the end, he didn’t ask these questions. They were too broad.
For his current stage, it’s better to have stronger props to protect himself, so he can survive better in the chaotic world.
But he didn’t directly ask for an A-level item, as that would be asking for too little. He just needed to know the ways to get an A-level item during the novice period, and that would be enough.
With a clue, he could make some targeted responses.
“The answer to this question requires a payment of 50,000 points.”

chapters.title: Chapter 264: 247: "I Refuse to Believe This, How is This Possible?"_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 247: “I Refuse to Believe This, How is This Possible?”_3
“50,000 points…” Chen Yi fell silent. The price was not low—just for answering a question, they dared to ask for 50,000 points. Aren’t you the official? Since when does the official charge players for answering their messages? In Blue Star, such a company would go bankrupt, wouldn’t it?
*Sigh.* He took a deep breath and chose to pay anyway.
“In the novice period, players are almost unable to obtain an A-level item. In certain B-level and above maps, if a super perfect achievement is obtained, there is a small chance of obtaining an A-level item. In the last three months of the novice period, if a super perfect achievement is obtained during the event, there is also a small chance of obtaining an A-level item.”
“In some random item chests without level restrictions, there is also a chance to obtain an A-level item, with a probability of one in a hundred trillion.”
“Starting in the sixth month, a new alchemy gameplay will be introduced, where combining 5 B-level items for alchemy could result in an A-level item. The success rate will be much higher, probably one in a million.”
“Other than that, players almost have no other ways to obtain an A-level item during the novice period.”
“Answer complete, entering a cooldown of six hours.”
“PS: The chance of obtaining an A-level item during the novice period is extremely low, meant to protect other players. After the novice period, the chance of obtaining an A-level item is significantly increased.”
Chen Yi was not satisfied with the answer. He felt like he wasted 50,000 points for nothing.
“Dead Zone” map descriptions did mention that obtaining a super perfect achievement could lead to a B-level or higher item reward, a pity he didn’t achieve it there.
Other than that, a few ways to get an A-level item are presented.
In the last three months of the novice period, one has a chance to get an A-level item.
Random item chests without level restrictions can possibly contain an A-level item, but the chances are terrifyingly small. And such chests are rare, not something you can easily find everywhere.
As for the alchemy gameplay introduced next month—that seems like a version preview, doesn’t it?
Alchemy with 5 B-level items has a one-in-a-million chance of creating an A-level item.
Hah, that’s not even gambling.
That’s called disposing of trash with too many items.
Besides, B-level items are rare alright. He doesn’t even have five B-level items. Where would he find five to use for alchemy?
Chen Yi shook his head and remained silent, not caring about the skill for the time being but looking at the prompt that popped up.
“Ding, guest Chen Yi, please begin your second Overlord action, entering a one-minute countdown for preparation.”
The one-minute countdown soon ended.
…
The second action, the third action, the fourth action.
All quickly completed.
Chen Yi’s second action was sitting in front of the TV, fully focused on watching a half-hour extremely terrifying suspense short film, with the system determining a zero fear value.
The system named this action “Chewing Wax.”
The name is always in a strange perspective from the system, but it makes sense. For instance, after watching a horror thriller, if you feel no fear, it’s indeed like chewing wax.
After all, the purpose of watching horror movies is to seek thrills. If you don’t find thrills in horror movies, why watch them?
That’s purely a waste.
A total of 19,289 players completed this action.
Probably due to the population advantage, you never know the guy sitting at the desk next door might have some unique skills you weren’t aware of.
This action, awarded a random E-item from the air food series due to the high number of successful challengers, was true only in name.
The third action “Walking Alone” was even more straightforward. Chen Yi killed himself, went to hell, then swiftly returned to Blue Star within thirty minutes via the return map.
Although the action content is simple, the imitation is not simple.
With Chen Yi’s strength, he didn’t need to spend so much time in the return map last time if it wasn’t for looking after Jiaye; a blink of an eye was enough for a return.
This action posed a direct increase in difficulty for the challengers.
The fourth action “Stand Out” was just Chen Yi standing still and silent for three seconds.
Almost all players completed it.
The reward was ten points.
Not much, but better than nothing.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 265: 247: "I Refuse to Believe This, How is This Possible?"_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 247: “I Refuse to Believe This, How is This Possible?”_4
“Yi, why did you suddenly change the plan?”
Tu, scratching the back of his head in confusion, spoke, “Yi, you could have just picked a slightly more difficult move. Even if many people could complete it, it wouldn’t only be worth 10 points, would it? Why did you suddenly come up with such a move?”
Standing silently for three seconds.
This move, it could be said, lacked any challenge.
Aside from those with amputated legs and those who couldn’t move in bed, almost everyone had completed it.
This was equivalent to aimlessly throwing out rewards, ignoring the rewards and insisting on those 10 points—this was a loss-making deal. It was strange; when had Yi started to engage in such profitless transactions?
“We’re running out of time.”
Chen Yi shook his head and shared a system prompt with everyone.
“Ding, due to some unknown changes, you have the right to directly challenge the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower. Please decide whether to challenge!”
“This is the last prompt, and if you do not make a choice within 30 minutes, you will be deemed to have automatically forfeited.”
“This prompt was supposed to be for the fifth move. It never had a time limit before, so there was no rush but suddenly now there’s a 30-minute time limit.”
“This means we can’t delay any longer. We must skip past the fourth move as quickly as possible.”
“Otherwise, we will be further and further away from the special prize.”
“Jiaye.”
Chen Yi paused for a moment, turned his head towards Jiaye standing beside him, and looked at him with a complicated expression but did not speak.
Jiaye did not open his mouth but simply closed his eyes and raised his head slightly while his eyelashes trembled slightly, clearly ready for what was to come.
Although he could come back to life.
But the process always involved some pain.
“Don’t worry.”
Chen Yi took out a syringe from his arms, disinfected Jiaye’s arm, then slowly inserted it, slowly injecting, “I especially found a D-level prop for you last time.”
“You can go under full anesthesia within 1 minute.”
“That way, you won’t feel any pain.”
“I’m a bit moved, but not much.”
“Good, come back soon.”
Chen Yi hugged Jiaye, kissed his forehead, and after the drug took effect and he completely lost consciousness under full anesthesia, he then thrust the dagger into Jiaye’s back.
Four stabs in a row.
No reaction.
Chen Yi looked puzzled, leaned in towards Jiaye’s back unscathed from the wound, then realized that the August rules did not allow backstabbing—how had he forgotten this fact?
Withdrawing the dagger, he thrust it into the neck.
Seven slashes in a row, and the body slumped down.
And Chen Yi also promptly received the system prompt.
“Ding, since you killed your beloved with your own hands, you have activated the title ‘Wife-Killing Maniac’. For the next hour, all your skills, titles, and props will have a buff effect of no cooldown and no limit on usage times.”
“Phew!”
Chen Yi slowly exhaled and laid Jiaye’s body in a coffin already prepared to the side, then turned his gaze towards Sword Without End. “This time I will probably take a bit longer in the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower. I’m worried about Jiaye being alone in Hell, so go down to take care of him for me.”
“…”
As Sword Without End was enjoying the show, his mouth suddenly stiffened, and after a long pause, he twitched and nodded, “Okay, Yi, you can rest assured, I’m quite familiar with Hell.”
“Hm.”
Chen Yi nodded, then looked at the invitation prompt before him. He was not planning to bring Tu and the others along.
The Deadly Tower can be entered as a team.
Which means he could have brought Sword Without End and the others along.
But the reason he didn’t was, firstly, if he did, it would not be considered a Lord’s Action. A Lord’s Action must be done solo.
Secondly, if teammates are present, his skills would not be able to fully unleash their power; he had to worry about accidentally harming his teammates.
Those all-encompassing Flowers of the Other Shore do not have eyes.
In fact, all those messy skills would involve him too, but he had the use of an unlimited use of an Absolute Plan, which would heal any injuries before they could develop. Sword Without End and the others didn’t have that capability. He had to make sure that Sword Without End and the others were not involved, and this would greatly diminish the overall damage.
The next second—
Two prompts sounded simultaneously in his ears.
“Ding, congratulations on entering the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower.”
“Ding, you have started the fifth Lord Action.”
…
Elsewhere on a certain planet, outside of Blue Star, the responsible person of the Son Family Guild of the Neutron Star looked at the responsible person of the Tianxia Pavilion of Solar Star, asking, “Are you sure that adding a time limit will make Chen Yi choose to enter the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower?”
“Wouldn’t it make Chen Yi more wary, as if you were in a hurry to make him enter?”
“It shouldn’t.”
The responsible person of the Tianxia Pavilion of Solar Star, Qiu Hao, smirked confidently, “Since Chen Yi has been considering entering but hasn’t refused yet, it means he has some reservations.”
“We don’t know what concerns they have.”
“But adding a time limit would make him decide faster, and the decision will lean towards acceptance.”
“He won’t refuse.”
“The temptation is simply too great.”
“Even if he refuses, it doesn’t matter. Once the time is up, we can send it again, given the player’s outstanding performance, and give another 30 minutes as the final chance to show off.”
Just then—
Qiu Hao’s eyes suddenly lit up, and he quickly opened the large screen and looked eagerly at Chen Yi who appeared in the center of the screen, “The prey has entered!”
“Chen Yi has chosen to enter!”

chapters.title: Chapter 266: 247: "I Refuse to Believe This, How is This Possible?"_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 247: “I Refuse to Believe This, How is This Possible?”_5
“We replaced the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower with the map of Sky Demon Star. As long as Chen Yi shows his strength as he did last time, many monsters killed by Chen Yi will drop items that Chen Yi can’t take with him, and they will all be ours.”
“The items dropped by the monsters on Sky Demon Star are extremely rich!”
“What’s more, if Chen Yi kills enough monsters, it can greatly increase our progress in pioneering the Sky Demon Star!”
“At present, the pioneering progress of the Sky Demon Star is less than 5%.”
“When pioneering is completed, the entire System Three will undergo change; it will be a new version.”
“Honestly, I don’t really hope Chen Yi dies on the Sky Demon Star; it’s no benefit to us at all. I just hope Chen Yi can show a stronger power than last time, that’s what matters to meet our expectations ah!”
Just at that moment—
Li Peiqi rushed into the conference room with the President of the Black Dragon Guild, and as soon as she saw Chen Yi appearing in the center of the screen, her face turned pale with both rage and fear, staring at everyone in attendance.
“You’re crazy, you’re really crazy!”
“Did you consider the consequences of this?”
“Let me tell you, you’re all doomed, even old Mother is going to be dragged down by you, a bunch of dumb dogs!”
“Didn’t any of you think about calculating someone so much stronger than you?”
“…”
The room was filled with top individuals from their respective star powers, and they were all startled by a young girl glaring and scolding them without restraint. It took a moment to process.
But soon.
The leading responsible person of the Tianxia Pavilion of Solar Star, Qiu Hao, calmly looked at the President of the Black Dragon Guild and said, “I remember you; you’re the President of the Black Dragon Guild from Neutron Star. When you withdrew, I agreed.”
“Your cowardice has been despised by us already.”
“Now, you bring a shrew here to make a scene; do you think you didn’t shame yourself enough?”
“And—”
He paused for a moment before pointing at Li Peiqi’s nose and said quietly, “Let me tell you, young lady, only women like you would fear the high mountain; men never will.”
“The mission of a man is only one, which is to conquer.”
“Conquer the high mountains, conquer the sea, conquer all the enemies before you.”
“Fear?”
“That word doesn’t exist in the dictionary of a true man, for you women should stay home with the children, this world isn’t yours to meddle with.”
“Please, quietly sit aside; don’t think that with the President of the Black Dragon Guild backing you, you can be unrestrained in front of me.”
“I, Qiu Hao, am the responsible person of Tianxia Pavilion!”
“Tianxia Pavilion is Solar Star’s only power, the largest power, while your Black Dragon Guild is simply one of the few strongest powers on Neutron Star, you and I are not on the same level, you’re not yet qualified to talk to me.”
“Okay, get lost, and don’t cause more trouble.”
“Alright, alright.”
The responsible person of the Son Family Guild sitting aside, feeling the mocking looks from around, couldn’t help but feel ashamed and stiffly said, “Now, President Li, please take your people and leave. You’ve embarrassed everyone from Neutron Star, do you want cowardice to be the synonym for your people?”
“Even if Chen Yi knows we did it, so what?”
“He has 8 more months before he can get out of Blue Star, and during that time, as long as we don’t go to Blue Star ourselves, he can’t do anything about us. I don’t know why you are so scared.”
“Really.”
“Not just us, I think President Li, you’ve been too cowardly. Perhaps it’s because you’ve been in a high position for a long time that you’ve forgotten how you used to disregard death on every trip down into the map.”
“You’ve lost that vigor.”
“To put it harshly, the world is getting more and more dangerous, it’s not certain if we could live past 8 months, why bother worrying about what happens after 8 months? Besides, the resources in the newbie period planets are limited, while ours are unlimited.”
“Yes, currently, we may indeed not be Chen Yi’s opponents, but after 8 months, Chen Yi may not even dare to fart loudly in front of us.”
“There’s nothing more; you better hurry up and leave.”
“…”
The President of the Black Dragon Guild, Li Shengping, stood there and patiently listened to everyone finish, then took out a declaration of war from his bosom, placed it on the table, and pushed it across to the responsible person of the Son Family Guild. He calmly said.
“From today onwards, the Black Dragon Guild formally declares war on the Son Family Guild.”
“The entire Black Dragon Guild will join this war.”
“Do or die.”
“This is a declaration of war, we wanted to inform you in advance, I hope that the Son Family Guild can prepare ahead of time.”
“War?”
The responsible person of the Son Family Guild was stunned for a moment, picked up the declaration of war on the table, looked at the red fingerprints on the war declaration, apparently all the Black Dragon Guild’s high levels had agreed, and uttered in disbelief with a pale face.
“Has the Black Dragon Guild gone crazy? You should know that the overall strength of the Black Dragon Guild is inferior to the Son Family Guild; where did your confidence come from thinking you could devour the Son Family Guild so easily?”
“We have no confidence.”
The President of the Black Dragon Guild, while rolling up the cuffs of his shirt, said nonchalantly, “Chen Yi slaughters by race.”
“Since the Son Family Guild, as a part of Neutron Star, participated in this operation, it means that Chen Yi, when settling scores later, will include Neutron Star as well.”
“To avoid the Black Dragon Guild being held accountable at that time.”
“We must completely eradicate all members of the Son Family Guild. This war is a fight to the death. We don’t need a complete victory; a tragic victory will suffice.”
Afterward, the President did not speak further and waved his hand casually and left the conference room, “Prepare for the battle, President Sun; in this war, let you see the blood of the Black Dragon Guild.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 267: 247: "I Refuse to Believe This, How is This Possible?"_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 247: “I Refuse to Believe This, How is This Possible?”_6
After leaving the conference room, the President of the Black Dragon Guild immediately left in a hurry, signaling the Black Dragon Guild members already prepared in every part of Neutron Star to launch a comprehensive attack on the Son Family Guild’s foundation.
Li Peiqi was just eyeing President Li with adoration, muttering.
“So handsome.”
“Didn’t expect the President could also have such a handsome day, President was so resolute just now, President Sun’s face turned all black.”
“Suddenly feel like the President isn’t completely useless.”
“Even though he’s a bit old, if he pursues me, I might consider it.”
“Pfft!”
Liu Xiaochan, who was standing beside Li Peiqi, couldn’t help but spit out the water she just drank, looking dyspeptic as if she ate a dead fly, she said anxiously, “Li Peiqi, you must not fall for the President!”
“Why?”
Li Peiqi looked at Liu Xiaochan curiously, “The age is not the problem, I don’t care about these things.”
“It’s not that, it’s not…”
“How is that? Are you afraid I’ll snatch him away? Are you in love with the President?”
“That’s not it either…”
Liu Xiaochan looked distressed as if about to cry, the first time feeling that the role of an inside agent was so hard, how could she say that in fact, the President is your biological father.
If you two get together, it would be incest, right?
The President contacted her in secret, gave her a lot of points to protect Li Peiqi in secret.
She should not be in charge of this matter, but if she knew and did not stop it, and when it really came out, and Li Peiqi really developed feelings for the President, he would surely kill her!
What kind of mess was this?
“Aww, what is the reason, tell me.”
Li Peiqi looked curiously at Liu Xiaochan.
“I like the President.”
After pausing for a moment, Liu Xiaochan said as if eating a dead fly, looking upset and tearful, “I, Liu Xiaochan, like the President. I must marry the President in this life, no one can take him away!”
“Only I can love the President!”
“Really?”
Li Peiqi looked at Liu Xiaochan in surprise, “Then when I was discussing with you the assassination of the President of the Black Dragon Guild, you were enthusiastic, was that to test me?”
But soon her expression turned odd and she looked behind Liu Xiaochan, “President, when did you come back?”
“Please tell me you didn’t hear anything just now.”
Liu Xiaochan stiffened in place and turned to see the President behind her, falling into a long silence.
The President was also silent at the moment.
His biological daughter is plotting in secret to kill her father, and the inside agent he sent is fond of him?
It seems, it’s not entirely out of the question.
…
Back in the conference room, shortly after President Li left.
The responsible person of the Son Family Guild began to frequently receive messages from responsible persons below.
“President, a combat squad dispatched by the Black Dragon Guild launched a kamikaze attack on our Kaidi Palace at Jinming City. Members of the Son Family Guild stationed in Jinming City were almost completely out of the fight.”
“President Sun, the Sun Family Shop at Gaoshou City suffered an indiscriminate attack by the Black Dragon Guild; brothers… almost all died in battle.”
“President, the guild’s station has been surrounded by members of the Black Dragon Guild, the other side has launched a comprehensive attack, request to unlock level three defense Apocalypse authority!”
“President…”
“…”
Sitting at the bottom and silent for who knows how long, the responsible person of the Son Family Guild took a long breath, his expression impassive and calmly said, “I’m withdrawing the Son Family Guild from this operation.”
“No matter how many items you gain on the Sky Demon Star, the Son Family Guild doesn’t want a penny.”
“The initial investment, the Son Family Guild does not require compensation.”
“But this operation has nothing to do with the Son Family Guild, after this, the Son Family Guild will never be enemies with Chen Yi, everyone look after themselves.”
After speaking, he walked towards the outside of the conference room.
“Wait a minute!”
At this moment, Qiu Hao stopped President Sun and frowned, “If I remember correctly, isn’t the Black Dragon Guild’s overall strength inferior to the Son Family Guild? Are you scared by their threat?”
President Sun turned to look at Qiu Hao, pausing for a moment before he said.
“It is stronger than the Black Dragon Guild, but not by much.”
“I am not afraid of Chen Yi.”
“What I fear is that the Son Family Guild will no longer exist before Chen Yi emerges, the Black Dragon Guild will fight to the death once they start a war.”
“None of the members of this guild are normal people.”
“I’m not very concerned about provoking Chen Yi, but you see if your guilds can hold up against the full-scale war of the Black Dragon Guild.”

chapters.title: Chapter 268: 248: "Is this the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower?
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 248: “Is this the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower?
“`xml
“Let him leave,”
Qiu Hao, the person in charge of the Tianxia Pavilion on Solar Star, scanned the departing President Sun of the Sun Family Guild from Neutron Star with an emotionless gaze, “With one less person sharing the profits, we can take a bit more.”
“Just as the rewards for pioneering new lands always belong to the brave forerunners.”
“Cowards do not deserve to taste the delight of the first crab.”
Only then did he look towards Chen Yi, who was in the center of the conference room’s large screen, with a mix of expectation and scorn in his eyes, whispering softly, “Even the strongest ant cannot raise its head to see beings of a higher dimension. I hope you can use that skill one more time and bring us endless surprises.”
…
“Is this the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower?”
Above Sky Demon Star.
Chen Yi furrowed his brows as he surveyed his surroundings. He did not act rashly but instead looked towards the map on his personal panel in the top-left corner, feeling somewhat puzzled.
Wasn’t the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower a bit too large?
At first glance, the area on the map seemed to have no boundaries; he had never entered such a vast map before, one that was countless times larger than the Wasteland map he had been to.
A mass of black clouds hung in the sky, the distance to the ground appearing to be less than a hundred meters, giving off an immensely oppressive vibe as if the sky might collapse at any moment.
The visibility was also very low.
You could even see dense red particles of dust floating in the air, thickly scattered throughout, and just taking a single breath felt as if you had swallowed a mouthful of quicklime, causing an intense burning sensation in the throat.
The ground was a blood-red color,
As if perennially drought-stricken, like a farmer’s hands, riddled with unrepairable cracks.
The whole map emanated a choking sense of oppression.
And just then—
A monster suddenly burst from the ground. Its head was triangular, with an eye at each tip. The moment it saw Chen Yi, it let out a piercing scream and then almost invisibly transformed into a red light, rocketing towards Chen Yi!
B-level Prop “Forever Pure” activated!
B-level Prop “Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom” activated!
B-level Prop “Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle” activated!
B-level Prop “Seven-Star Badge” activated!
C-level Skill “Annihilated Violators” activated!
C-level Prop “…”
The instant the monster charged at him, Chen Yi didn’t hesitate to activate all the props and skills on his person—whether they were useful or not, he activated them all.
He even activated skills meant for daily life.
Unlimited cooldown anyway, no worries about usage limits.
One more activation didn’t make any difference.
And that monster, which had turned into a red stream of light charging toward Chen Yi, barely started its attack when it turned to ash and dispersed in the air, dead without a place of burial!
At the same time, Chen Yi heard a notification by his ear.
“Ding, congratulations on killing a unique monster of Sky Demon Star—a lv.1 Cave Demon, you are hereby rewarded 10 points.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi’s brows furrowed slightly as he looked at the notification that popped up with a bit of confusion. Sky Demon Star? Sounds like a planet? But wasn’t he on the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower? What’s the deal with Sky Demon Star?
But soon,
He no longer had the luxury to muse on this matter, as perhaps the dying scream of the first monster attracted more. Ten monsters sprang from the ground around him, all shrieking upon their emergence and lunging forward in a sprint!
However, before their voices hit the ground,
All ten monsters were reduced to ashes.
In front of Chen Yi, with all his firepower unleashed, no matter how many of such monsters came, it was like courting death.
The notifications of point rewards for killing monsters sounded in his ears once more, while another new notification also chimed in.
“Ding, survive for 30 minutes and kill no fewer than 10 monsters to successfully clear the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower.”
This notification echoed leisurely in his ears.
But it was a bit late.
By rights, the rules for passing the level should be announced as soon as one entered the map. However, the task seemed to have eased a bit—killing no fewer than 10 monsters? He had already killed 11, and now only needed to survive for 60 more minutes to pass this floor of the Deadly Tower.
It would also allow him to complete his fifth action as a specially invited Arena Master.
Still, something didn’t seem quite right.
He looked down at a prop emitting a white light not far from his feet and reached out to pick it up, only to discover that the prop was like an illusion, beyond his ability to pick up, nor could he scatter it into his backpack.
At the same time,
A notification popped up.
“Ding, it has been detected that the player is in the Newbie Protection Period. Players in the Newbie Protection Period cannot acquire props from outside their own planet by any means.”
This notification was red, followed by several glaring exclamation points.
Props from outside their own planet?
“…”
Chen Yi’s expression remained calm as he stayed silent. He just turned his head toward the floating camera that had been following him, a dedicated camera to capture his Arena Master actions, beyond his control.
But he knew.
“`
Everything here is being broadcasted live to all Blue Star players.
For Blue Star players to imitate and challenge.
If this place isn’t Blue Star, then why did he appear here? The Deadly Tower is Blue Star’s August event, so why would the 100th floor of the Deadly Tower not belong to Blue Star? Why can’t Blue Star players claim the items dropped within the Deadly Tower?
The game mode of the Deadly Tower had already been around for over a dozen days, and he had never heard that items dropped during this event couldn’t be picked up.
Unless… he was not on Blue Star.
But on Sky Demon Star.
There were two possibilities, the first one being:
The 100th floor of the Deadly Tower was actually one of the myriad Sky Demon Stars.
The second possibility was that he had been set up.
If it was the second possibility, then there was something fishy about the Deadly Tower’s 100th floor notification that kept popping up in front of him.
But now, there was no time left for him to think further!
Almost at once, close to a hundred monsters appeared beside Chen Yi, screaming and launching attacks on him. These monsters moved incredibly fast, and their bodies were in a semi-ethereal state, greatly reducing the impact of any physical attacks against them!
Needless to say, they were exceedingly difficult to deal with!
Of course, this didn’t really affect Chen Yi.
Once the numbers reached a certain threshold, it was enough to change the equation. Even if most of your attacks are weakened upon hitting the target, if you attack frequently enough, no amount of defense can withstand it!
The number of monsters around him was growing.
In just about ten minutes, nearly millions of monsters surrounded Chen Yi from all angles, launching deadly attacks. Chen Yi couldn’t even stand on the ground and had to hover in the air.
The camera could no longer capture close-up images of Chen Yi.
It could only ascend and use a wide-angle to film everything below.
But… there were too many monsters.
The swarming creatures engulfed Chen Yi like an Insect Calamity, and all one could see were countless monsters turning to ash and scattering in the air every moment, to the point where even Chen Yi’s silhouette was no longer visible.
Facing a horde alone, he fought against a tribe!
As the number of monsters continued to increase, even Chen Yi, on full firepower, seemed to be struggling, mainly because his C-level skill, Annihilated Violators, was ineffective against these monsters.
Though the monsters looked the same, they had no blood ties.
In other words, these monsters were created individually, not born from a maternal creature.
For this situation, his C-level skill was utterly useless, which greatly weakened his AOE attack. Moreover, these monsters not only had immunity to most physical attacks, they were also extremely fast and highly damaging.
“Puchi!”
In a moment of distraction.
Chen Yi suddenly felt a sharp pain in his back. Looking down, he saw a blood-red bone spur had pierced through his body from behind, chilling him to the core. Subsequently, the monster that had ambushed him quickly turned to ash and died.
The bone spur also turned to ash.
But the wound remained.
“Absolute Purity.”
The wound had only just appeared when it instantly healed perfectly, as if nothing had ever happened apart from the pain.
As long as the damage wasn’t instantaneously fatal, he feared nothing.
Even decapitation didn’t matter. If a shred of consciousness lingered the instant his head was severed, which lasted only a brief period, it was enough time to activate “Absolute Purity.”
And instantly, everything was restored.
For him, in full open-fire mode, only a direct beam of cosmic light turning his body instantly to ash could inflict a fatal injury. Any other fatal damage was ineffective against him at this moment.
But even if the wound could heal instantly and perfectly, the pain couldn’t be eliminated.
And the monsters were bringing considerable pain.
These monsters had far surpassed the capability ceiling of Blue Star players; no wonder they only required the killing of 10 monsters. For an average Blue Star player, killing even one would be challenging.
As he killed more and more monsters, even more began to appear around him.
He didn’t know how many monsters he had killed.
He only knew that his Points Balance was skyrocketing at an exaggerated pace, earning 10 Points per monster killed, and the monsters that died by his hand numbered well over a million!!!
His vision was now obscured by blood, and he could hardly see his surroundings, already accustomed to the occasional stabbing pain.
Eventually…
He didn’t know how much time had passed.
The number of monsters around him dwindled until, after slaying hundreds, no new ones emerged.
Unlike at the start, where killing one monster would bring forth more.
Three minutes later.
The surroundings finally cleared up.
Wearing his tattered costume and covered in blood, Chen Yi floated in mid-air, his hair matted with dried blood, looking extremely disheveled but no one watching dared to look down on him.
Even if they were enemies.
Such power… was nothing short of terrifying.
No monster corpses could be seen around, having all been reduced to ash, while the ground was covered with slowly glowing items, almost like a blanket of snow.
This represented a fortune that would make anyone extremely envious.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: 249: "I wish you success in upgrading, we will meet again.
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 249: “I wish you success in upgrading, we will meet again.
At this moment, there was less than a minute left until the end of Deadly Tower.
No more monsters were spawning.
The space had fallen into absolute silence.
Only Chen Yi, suspended in mid-air, hung his head low without any movement, as if he were extremely exhausted and had sunk into a deep sleep.
…
The Blue Star players watching the live stream fell into silence.
This was Chen Yi’s fifth and last action as the Arena Master.
Presently, the likelihood of success seemed as improbable as calculating the final digits of pi.
There was simply no chance of overcoming the challenge.
But… it was also the first time they learned just how high the difficulty of the 100th floor of Deadly Tower was, and at that moment, nearly every player had one thought in mind: let whoever wants to attempt the Deadly Tower do so—they wouldn’t go.
With such difficulty, the moment they entered, they might as well be declared dead.
“Huh!”
“Even though I’ve seen this scene once before,” said Zhou Ziqiang, the president of Skywake, sitting in his chair and looking at the scene on the screen, his eyes filled with shock as he murmured, “it’s just as astonishing every time. Is this truly the level of power a player should have at this stage?”
“How should one deal with a person like this?”
“What kind of strategy would it take to kill someone like him?”
Standing by his side, Chu Ge silently listened to the president’s words and opened Chen Yi’s chat panel. He composed a message and sent it over.
‘Reporting to Yi, Zhou Ziqiang is contemplating how to strategize and kill you.’
He was the local resident of Black Trench City who had twice shown Yi the way. Later, after an incident at Skywake, he was assigned to Skywake as the vice president, tasked with surveillance to prevent a recurrence of the previous event.
…
Zhou Ziqiang, still in shock, suddenly thought of something and turned his head with a complex look to ask Chu Ge at his side, “Brother, I was just expressing my amazement. You haven’t told Chen Yi that I’m thinking about how to kill him, have you?”
“No.”
Chu Ge seriously shook his head, “I never falsely report.”
“That’s good.”
After replying, Chu Ge silently sent another message to Chen Yi.
‘Zhou Ziqiang just asked if I conveyed his words to you, Yi. I resisted the pressure and chose to deny it.’
…
“Yi seems to have been quite injured?”
Sword Without End frowned slightly as he looked at Chen Yi on the screen.
He rarely saw Yi wounded; it wasn’t a common sight.
Despite being in Hell, he could still see Yi’s Arena Master video, but of course, without the right to challenge — Hell Players do not have the qualification to challenge.
While Hell Players mostly differ insubstantially from Blue Star players, there are still some minor differences.
“He should be fine.”
Jiaye shook her head, and though there was worry in her eyes, she still spoke, “In Yi’s current state, he can use Absolute Purification an unlimited number of times. Even if there are injuries, they would heal instantly, though it might hurt.”
She and Sword Without End were sitting in a coffee shop deep in Hell, watching Chen Yi’s live broadcast.
At this moment, nearly all the players in the coffee shop were also watching the live broadcast.
Although they were not qualified to challenge, this didn’t prevent them from watching.
After all, there were very few entertainment activities deep in Hell.
To be precise, even on Blue Star, entertainment activities were somewhat scarce, not because the advent of the game destroyed most of them, but because in an environment where no one knows when they might die, fewer and fewer players have the heart to participate in such leisure.
…
“Yi is so cool.”
Under the rooftop of the Garden District, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but click his tongue in amazement, “Single-handedly fighting millions of monsters and annihilating them all.”
“Such a feat is outrageous. If this scene were recorded in the annals of history, thousands of years later, our descendants might regard this passage as mythical exaggeration, never imagining it to be a real event.”
Meanwhile, Tie Chui, sitting by his side, though silent, nodded earnestly in agreement.
…
“It’s over.”
In a conference room on Neutron Star, Qiu Hao, the person in charge of Tianxia Pavilion on Solar Star, looked at Chen Yi on the screen with a complex expression, feeling a hint of shock in his heart for the first time.
This Chen Yi… Does he really have the strength of a player still in the Newbie Protection Period?
It was truly frightening.
There was an unspoken rule on Sky Demon Star: after killing a monster, one must immediately move locations.
Otherwise, more and more monsters would swarm in until all the monsters in the area were dead.
Sky Demon Star was divided into twenty regions!
Each region was home to millions of monsters, which would respawn after dying, at a rate every ten minutes. This meant the monsters in a region could never be fully slain.
Unless one managed to kill all the monsters in a region within ten minutes.
Once the monsters in a region were completely killed, no more would respawn there, indicating the region had been completely tamed.
And the spot where Chen Yi just fought was the center of four such regions.
In just half an hour.
Chen Yi had killed all the monsters from these four regions without a single survivor.
Now, the progress of taming Sky Demon Star had reached “25%!”
5% was the progress of taming achieved by all the players of Star System No. 3 over nearly three months before this; Chen Yi had added another 20% all by himself.
The feat was nothing short of terrifying.
But soon, Qiu Hao’s lips curved into a smile. The vast amount of Props piled on the ground like snow, Chen Yi couldn’t take any with him—these were theirs for the taking.
Then the people in the conference room exchanged glances, each seeing the excitement in the other’s eyes.
So many Props, possibly even over a dozen Grade A Props. Even with so many people to share among, they stood to gain a tremendous benefit; the deal was too profitable to pass up.
Chen Yi was much stronger than they had imagined.
But just as Qiu Hao had said, having great strength didn’t mean much; it was one’s position in the dimensions that determined fate.
Subsequently.
Unable to resist the temptation, Qiu Hao controlled a drone on Sky Demon Star, flying it in front of Chen Yi and projecting his own body before him.
…
“Let me introduce myself.”
Chen Yi, still dazed from enduring too much pain, suddenly heard a voice near his ear, and instinctively looked up to see a drone appearing out of nowhere, along with the hologram of a young man in a suit sitting in a chair.
The young man had a smile on his face as he held a glass of red wine and looked at him with amusement.
“I am Qiu Hao, the person in charge at Tianxia Pavilion on Solar Star.”
“Are you wondering why the 100th floor of Deadly Tower is so difficult? Where this is?”
“This is Sky Demon Star, a map with extremely high difficulty within the Neutron Star System for pioneering.”
“I’m sorry to have used you a bit. You’re stronger than we thought and have completely cleared out four areas, dropping over a hundred thousand props, including several A-grade items.”
“We are very satisfied with this wealth.”
“Of course, I know I’ve used you, and you must be angry and frustrated right now. I should have stayed hidden in the shadows to avoid your resentment.”
“But…”
Qiu Hao paused and turned his head seemingly helplessly, “As a victor, it would be too frustrating if I couldn’t proclaim my achievements to the world.”
“So I just couldn’t help but come out and show off a little.”
“And as you can see, I am a young person and naturally lack the maturity and steadiness of middle-aged people.”
“For a young person to have a bit of spirit is quite normal, right?”
Chen Yi, floating in mid-air, lifted his head and calmly looked at the hologram of the young man before him, then suddenly let out a light chuckle, “Qiu Hao of Solar Star? You say you’re using me?”
“That’s right.”
“Ah!”
Suddenly pretending to be scared, Qiu Hao covered his mouth and yelled, “I almost forgot you’ll be leaving Blue Star in eight months. Then you might come seeking revenge; I’m so scared, what should I do!”
