Then his tone changed, and he laughed with contempt in his eyes.
“But I’m sorry, Solar Star has been preparing for a second upgrade recently.”
“With these props in hand, Solar Star can fully upgrade to level three within eight months.”
“At that time, we will leave the Neutron Star System.”
“So what if you do come out? You won’t be able to find me.”
“Just write off this debt.”
Chen Yi nodded calmly and flexed his body, looking at the countdown of only 10 seconds left before getting kicked off the map, he stretched to clear his head a bit, with no visible anger on his face.
“We will meet, and soon. I won’t make you wait too long.”
“When we meet again, I hope you can keep smiling just like now.”
“Solar Star?”
“That planet doesn’t mean much to exist anyhow.”
Qiu Hao was stunned for a moment, a flicker of fear indiscreetly surfaced from beneath, as if Chen Yi’s words truly meant that he could find him very soon. But he quickly regained composure, angry at his lapse.
“Dropping a fierce line because you feel humiliated?”
“Players in the Newbie Protection Period can’t leave Blue Star through any means.”
“You think you can come out?”
“You don’t think so?”
“I wish you success with the upgrade. We’ll meet again.”
Chen Yi smirked, then his body turned into a shadow and left the map.
He was now in an unlimited cooldown state.
In the previous minute, he had used the B-grade skill “Requesting the Mandate of Heaven” dozens of times in succession.
Normally, this skill had a cooldown, six hours. But in this state, he could use this skill with no cooldown at all.
But there was no avoiding consumption.
Ordinarily in this state, using any skill would cost him nothing, but this skill did. Nevertheless, it was understandable given that this skill could grant almost anything for a price; if it had no cost, that bug would be huge.
He had asked “Requesting the Mandate of Heaven” more than a dozen questions.
They were—
“Is this man who claims to be Qiu Hao from Solar Star?”
“How can I leave the Newbie Protection Period planet?”
“How can I kill the man before me?”
“How can I declare war on Solar Star?”
“How to…”
Until the last question.
“Can I make him the map boss when Solar Star undergoes its second upgrade?”
Answer.
“Possible, but the cost is 5 million Points.”
…
ps: These two chapters were meant for yesterday, and there will be more tonight. Originally, I had scheduled them to be auto-published last night, but when I woke up at noon, I realized from a ping in the readers’ group that I had inadvertently set them for tonight instead.
Feeling rather speechless.
I got up without even washing my face, turned on the computer, and hurriedly uploaded the chapters that should have gone live last night.
There will still be updates tonight, and these two chapters aren’t today’s update; they are from yesterday.

chapters.title: Chapter 270: 250: "Times have changed? Eat my Ultra Great Sage 5000-Round Gatling!
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 250: “Times have changed? Eat my Ultra Great Sage 5000-Round Gatling!
“`
“Ding…”
Just as Chen Yi returned and was yet to steady himself, he was greeted by several system prompt sounds.
“Ding, you have killed a total of 3.7 million Cave Demons, earning a total of 37 million Points.”
“Ding, you have successfully cleared 100 floors of the Deadly Tower and received a C-grade random Prop Chest as a reward.”
“Ding, having detected that player Chen Yi is the first on Blue Star to clear the Deadly Tower, you are awarded a B-grade random Prop Chest.”
The 37 million Points were more than the sum total of what he had earned in the past, or one might say nearly equivalent to the combined Points in the accounts of all players on Blue Star.
At his peak, he hadn’t had more than 500,000 Points.
But this surge had brought in nearly 40 million Points.
On Blue Star, there was no chance of earning so many Points—it had to be said, the opportunities in the outside world were more abundant.
However, during the Requesting the Mandate of Heaven just now, he had spent nearly 10 million Points.
The questions he had asked earlier had cost him 5 million Points, and the subsequent request had taken a one-off expense of 5 million Points.
“Ding, you have been selected as the ultimate boss of the Solar Star map for the second realm elevation.”
Even so, he still had nearly 30 million Points in his account.
That C-grade random Prop Chest also yielded a rather good Prop.
“Prop Name”: Lay’s Chips.
“Prop Grade”: C-grade.
“Prop Effect”: This is a bag of chips that will never expire and never run out, offering any flavor you desire. You can hold this bag of chips and watch any movie, including the movie of life.
“Prop Introduction”: “Life needs a few unhealthy hobbies to be less tiresome.”
He could give this Prop to Jiaye, who was very fond of chips.
Although it had no effect in battle, which made it seem a little unworthy of a C-grade rating, in a certain respect, if he were to place this bag of chips on an assembly line, it could even satisfy the basic needs of thousands of people.
From this perspective, the grade of this Prop was far beyond C-grade.
Successfully clearing the Deadly Tower also earned him a B-grade Prop Chest.
Unfortunately, it wasn’t unique.
What’s superior to a B-grade Prop Chest is a unique B-grade Prop Chest.
Props from a unique Prop Chest are all globally unique.
“Prop Name”: Wildfire.
“Prop Grade”: B-grade.
“Prop Effect”: Upon activation, a burning meteorite will descend from the sky and strike the enemy in your line of sight with tremendous force.
“Prop Limit”: After using, it will enter a 48-hour cooldown period.
“Prop Introduction”: “A meteor doesn’t fly quickly, just as my love for you isn’t a spur of the moment.”
After seeing the usage effect of this Prop.
Chen Yi’s eyes gradually narrowed, and his lips curved slightly upwards, clearly very pleased with the Prop.
As an offensive tool against enemies, it fell short. Though powerful, the meteorite descended slowly; red circles even appeared on the ground indicating the impact range of the meteorite.
From the appearance of the red circles to the meteorite’s fall, there was a full minute’s time.
Even an old man with a walking stick could escape the red circle.
It wouldn’t hit the enemy at all.
But if used against buildings or static military installations, it could hit its target spot on—absolutely formidable.
Of course.
In his hands, he had better ways to utilize it.
A 48-hour cooldown?
With his powers full-on, he could cover all the territories in his line of sight with red circles.
One meteorite? That was thinking too small.
He thought, wouldn’t it be better to witness a meteor shower? A sky full of meteorites raining down, and all would be quiet.
He hoped Solar Star would appreciate his twofold trial. Facing a meteor shower wasn’t too excessive for a twofold trial, was it? How would it live up to its name if it wasn’t challenging enough?
Right?
“Yi.”
At that moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit walked over with a somewhat unsightly expression and comforted, “Don’t be too angry. That kid won’t be able to strut around for long. Once we get out, we’ll take our time dealing with him.”
“This kind of scoundrel is all too common. But Yi, don’t rush to take note of Solar Star just yet. I think there’s a high chance this person isn’t from Solar Star; even the name Qiu Hao might be an alias, just to purposefully annoy you, Yi.”
“No need.”
Chen Yi shook his head with a light laugh, “I’m not too angry. After all, the issue can soon be resolved. But you’re wrong about one thing: his real name is indeed Qiu Hao, and he is indeed from Solar Star.”
“He’s actually being honest for once.”
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit scratched his head in confusion, “He’s using his real name? Seems like he’s really not afraid of being remembered by you, Yi. But what did you just mean about being able to handle it soon? Do you have a way to kill Qiu Hao from afar?”
“There’s always a way, but there’s no rush at the moment. Let’s let the bullets fly for a while.”
And just then—
“Ding, the Start of Autumn Festival limited-time event has officially ended, welcoming the arrival of autumn.”
A prompt sounded in the ears of all players.
“`
And Chen Yi heard several different notification sounds by his ear.
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for his fifth arena action, where no player successfully challenged, awarding a unique B-tier random Prop Chest, as well as a special reward, a red title.”
With the conclusion of this notification, the limited-time event also officially came to an end.
Aside from the unique B-tier random Prop Chest awarded for the fifth action, the third action had also awarded a B-tier random Prop Chest, which indicated it could be opened after the event ended, and now it had turned from grey to white, signifying it could be opened.
And he opened both of these Prop Chests at once.
“Prop Name”: Seeking Immortals’ Thirteen Swords.
“Prop Level”: B-tier.
“Prop Effect”: Upon activating this prop, every sword strike you unleash will carry a strong Sword Qi, and each subsequent strike will be more powerful than the last, up to thirteen strikes, with the thirteenth strike reaching peak power.
The power of the Sword Qi depends on the user’s emotions; the stronger the emotions, the more powerful the Sword Qi.
“Prop Restrictions”: After using this prop once, you will fall into an extremely exhausted state for the next three days, and you cannot use this prop again within that period.
“Prop Description”: “Someone once slaughtered their own family to seize the position of Martial Arts Alliance Hierarch. In the midst of extreme emotional turmoil, they united the Martial World and left behind a legacy for thousands of generations. To gain something, one must always give something up.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi slightly furrowed his brows, pondered for a moment, and then tossed the prop into his backpack, planning to give it to Sword Without End for use; in the entire team, besides Sword Without End, no one else used a sword.
This prop could only be given to Sword Without End.
It’s just that its power was somewhat ambiguous, unable to determine roughly how strong it was without using it.
Sword Without End should like this prop.
“Prop Name”: Buddha’s Fury.
“Prop Level”: B-tier (Unique).
“Prop Effect”: Upon activating this prop, a Buddha with a ferocious expression appears before you, seated on a Lotus Platform. In each of his hands, he wields a Fire God Gatling with unlimited bullets, initiating indiscriminate cover fire on the enemy, which can last for up to one hour.
“Prop Restrictions”: Activating this prop once will result in a 24-hour cooldown, and activating it requires 3000 Points.
“Prop Introduction”: “Times have changed? It’s only you who have changed, not me. Take this from me, the Great Buddha’s 5000-RPM Gatling!”
Chen Yi’s eyebrows raised slightly, surprise flashing in his eyes as he didn’t expect the unique B-tier prop obtained would be something like this.
The visual feels a bit odd.
Without much thought, Chen Yi activated the skill.
The next second—
A Buddha over three meters tall sat on a Lotus Platform engulfed in flames, each of his hands holding an exaggerated Fire God Gatling; with a ferocious grimace, he aimed the muzzles towards the sky and firmly pulled the triggers!
“Ratatat!!!”
The jarring sound of gunfire was nearly continuous, deafeningly ringing beside Chen Yi’s ears!
This scene felt a bit odd.
It’s hard to say what exactly was odd, but it was definitely odd.
However, Chen Yi quickly cracked a smile, his eyes narrowing slightly with anticipation gleaming deep within his pupils.
The power not minor.
Most importantly, this was a bullet attack, and bullet attacks could trigger his C-tier skill “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!”
This skill could only be triggered when an enemy was killed by bullets.
“Wildfire” was strong, but it couldn’t trigger this skill.
But “Buddha’s Fury” was different; envision thousands of Buddhas, each wielding a Gatling, seated cross-legged on Flame Lotus Platforms, looking down upon all living beings, from which even God would have to steer clear!
Today, I, the Buddha, shall wield the Gatling and embark on the path of world annihilation!
I hope the players of Solar Star will like the little gadgets I’ve prepared for them.
Only then did he look at the remaining time, not lingering, but heading straight to hell to bring Jiaye back.
At this moment, he was still in the cooldown time.
This buff state could last 1 hour, and only forty minutes had passed, leaving 20 minutes.
…
In a certain return map.
Sword Without End looked somewhat helplessly at the players watching him eagerly from a short distance.
Yi came to pick up Jiaye.
But in the return map, only two people could form a team, so Yi took Jiaye and left him behind, and now he had to go to the return map alone.
“Sigh.”
Sword Without End let out a light and somewhat helpless sigh, “What karma have I created? However, it’s a good chance to try out the new prop Yi gave me.”
Then he looked towards the players surrounding him, cracked a slight smile, and then his expression instantly turned icy. He leaped up, standing above them on the Three-Foot Qingfeng suspended in mid-air, and coldly commanded.
“Seeking Immortals’ Thirteen Swords!”
“The first sword!”
Out of nowhere, a blanket of frost appeared, accompanied by his Green Peak as he pressured the crowd below.
“…”
“The thirteenth sword!”
An almost heaven-covering frost enveloped all objects in sight, and after swinging this final blow, Sword Without End then fell from the sky with a look of satisfaction.
“This prop’s power is truly strong.”
“But… the side effect is too great.”

chapters.title: Chapter 271: 251: "I am not afraid of death, but I am afraid of dying under the Annihilate Nine Clans skill.
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 251: “I am not afraid of death, but I am afraid of dying under the Annihilate Nine Clans skill.
After using this prop, one would fall into a state of extreme fatigue, and that was exactly the state Sword Without End found himself in.
However.
Without personally experiencing it, it is completely impossible to understand the true effect of the words “extreme fatigue.” Only after experiencing it can you understand that it’s a tiredness that seeps down to the bone, like when you can see your perfect attendance slipping away if you don’t keep typing, but you still feel too drowsy to open your eyes.
Extreme, fatigue.
…
But the scene with Chen Yi was a different picture altogether.
On the edge of a certain city wall.
Countless meteors fell from the sky, and tens of thousands of Buddha figures sat cross-legged on Flame Lotus Platforms, holding Fire God Gatlings, conducting a blanket bombardment of all enemies in front of them.
Enemies?
You couldn’t even see where the enemies were.
Besides that, the sky was filled with endless other-shore flowers drifting about.
Outside of the city wall, a large number of the Insect Race were there, their mission was to hold this city for an hour.
But at that moment, not a single one of the Insect Race could be seen, what was visible was just how the wilderness outside the city walls had somehow become four or five meters lower.
“How does it look?”
Chen Yi sat in the rocking chair at the edge of the city wall, holding Jiaye in his arms, he looked at the scene before him, somewhat smugly raised his eyebrows, and smiled, “Not bad, right? These two new props I acquired, they seem pretty impressive.”
“Does it hurt?”
Jiaye looked up, gently caressing his chest with concern, and whispered, “Maybe we should back out of the Solar Star matter, pretend like it never happened. Otherwise, being constantly dragged into it, I always feel like it will be very dangerous later on.”
“Standing out too much will easily get you targeted.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Yi’s smile slowly faded away, and after a long pause, he shook his head calmly.
“You’re mistaken.”
“This matter must be handled perfectly in order to deter the rest of those sneaks.”
“Otherwise, more and more people will harass us in the future. When the Blue Star ascended in the game world, some petty thief even bought the contract for my rental apartment, demanding a large sum of Points from me.”
“Later on, such sneaks would pop up from time to time.”
“That small company boss, the deputy president of Skywake.”
“But now you tell me, do we still have players on Blue Star who provoke us without any reason?”
“Because they are afraid, those petty thieves are scared after seeing our strength.”
“If we had kept a low profile from the start, even now, many such petty thieves would be knocking on our door.”
“And the most perfect solution to this situation is to make the annihilation of the Solar Star the endpoint.”
Jiaye stopped talking and simply lay on Chen Yi’s chest, her expression somewhat dazed as she seemingly contemplated something.
…
“Yi, this time you’ve been used quite badly.”
At Skywake Headquarters on Blue Star, President Zhou Ziqiang looked at the discussion information on the forum with an ugly expression; the internet was all in uproar about this matter.
Everyone knew.
Chen Yi, the number one player on Blue Star, had been used by Qiu Hao of the Solar Star. He had fought monsters to the death, and couldn’t pick up a single prop, everything benefiting someone else.
For a time.
Almost every player on Blue Star was extremely angry on behalf of Chen Yi, aggrieved for him, furious for him, but there was nothing they could do.
Just as Qiu Hao had said.
Even if Chen Yi was very strong, he still had to wait eight months before he could leave Blue Star, and by that time, Solar Star would have already cleared the threefold trial and left the Number 3 Star System.
Being humiliated like stepping on your face, it was hard to swallow such an insult.
But… there was nothing that could be done even if it was hard to swallow.
It was indeed quite suffocating.
…
“Comfortable.”
In a certain conference room on Neutron Star, Qiu Hao slowly stood up, looked at everyone, and smiled, “Now you all can send people to the Sky Demon Star. Of course, the props need to be unified, distributed according to the ratios we agreed upon beforehand.”
“We’ll reconvene on Sky Demon Star in three hours.”
He then stood up and walked out of the conference room, with his assistant hurrying to follow him, her expression somewhat puzzled as she hesitated, “Lord Qiu Hao, I don’t understand why you gave Chen Yi the real information?”
“If Lord Qiu Hao you had used a fake name and a fake star name, wouldn’t that have served as another blow and increased the difficulty for Chen Yi to find you after he leaves Blue Star?”
“Wouldn’t that have been killing two birds with one stone?”
At that moment, Qiu Hao, feeling extremely pleased with himself, rolled up his sleeves, gave a glance at his assistant holding a notebook, and casually smiled, “You’re thinking too low-level, which is why all you see is this much.”
“Just as you say, using a fake name, I would indeed avoid many future risks.”
“But, what I’m telling you today is that, compared to risk, using my real name brings greater benefits.”
“Perhaps you should check out the forums on Solar Star and see how everyone speaks of our Tianxia Pavilion and me, Qiu Hao. Then go to other stars’ forums and see how other players speak of me, Qiu Hao, and Solar Star.”
“That is influence.”
“Since ancient times, all merchants ultimately chase after reputation. Do you think they truly love reputation that much?”
“It’s not that; they understand where there’s reputation, there’s benefit.”
“Such reputation, such influence, is invaluable.”
“And also—”
Qiu Hao paused for a moment, then stopped in his tracks, waiting for his own starship to land nearby, “Anything done in a sneaky and conniving manner won’t last long and has a significant impact on a person’s demeanor.”
“When you do something, it should be known by everyone, recognized by all. This will bring you an influence that makes any future endeavors you undertake smooth sailing.”
“Study hard.”
Qiu Hao patted his assistant’s shoulder, then strode towards the starship’s boarding ramp and gave the command, “Set course for Sky Demon Star.”
The assistant scratched his head in confusion, subconsciously opening the forums of Solar Star and those of other star systems.
‘Qiu Hao is awesome!!!’
‘Haha, wasn’t Chen Yi acting all high and mighty a while ago? In the end, wasn’t he just toyed with by our great Qiu Hao?’
‘Let this country boy see what’s meant by “using a small force to move a heavy weight!”‘
‘Come on, Chen Yi, keep on yelling, or can you only talk tough?’
‘I’m begging you, Chen Yi, come to Solar Star and kill me, please. I’m so sick of living, come and end me.’
The discussion of this matter on Solar Star was immensely popular. The players on Solar Star had become exceptionally unified and electrified because of this incident. After all, Chen Yi had made quite an impression before, but now he was suppressed by Qiu Hao, giving them a rare sense of exhilaration.
When players from other planets talked about Qiu Hao, they did so with a mix of wariness and admiration.
That Chen Yi had wiped out an entire clan by himself, a truly ruthless person.
But even such a ferocious figure showed no temper in Qiu Hao’s hands, forcing other players to adopt a new perspective towards Solar Star.
After reading all this.
The assistant nodded thoughtfully, as if he understood something.
…
“Do you understand now?”
Qiu Hao, seated in the luxurious chair of the starship, leaned back with a smile playing on his lips and spoke in a relaxed tone, “The twofold trial isn’t just about one person or one guild, it’s about all the players on Solar Star.”
“With this incident, the cohesion and pride of all players on Solar Star have become unparalleled and unprecedentedly strong.”
“In such a state, it will greatly increase our chances of successfully passing the twofold trial.”
“And after passing the twofold trial, this momentum will settle down, that sense of cohesion and pride will become even stronger, and then we’ll have the opportunity to take on the threefold trial.”
“And this kind of thing, it can’t be offered by hiding your name.”
“Do you understand?”
“Chen Yi is just a minor issue to me, I don’t care about him. What I care about is the future of Solar Star, the bright future of Solar Star after breaking out of the No. 3 star system.”
“In terms of individual combat strength, I am not as good as Chen Yi.”
“But when it comes to management, Chen Yi is no match for me. He still hasn’t realized that in future struggles, the impact of one person is extremely small. Players from an entire star need to come together as one to survive, to live better!”
Qiu Hao’s voice gradually softened.
He hadn’t slept for several days because of this matter and was really too tired to resist sleep now.
He murmured his last few words.
“Success doesn’t have to come from me.”
“Solar Star will break out of the star system, be remembered across the universe, enduring through thousands of trials unscathed!”
…
“Are you satisfied now?”
Within Neutron Star.
The person in charge of Sun Family Guild looked grim as he stared across the table at the Chairman of Black Dragon Guild, “Are you satisfied now with this mess? Nearly ten thousand players from both our sides have gone to hell, do you know how much it will cost to climb out?”
“You fear Chen Yi, but are you not afraid of me?”
“Now, all the rewards have been snatched away by them, and we haven’t gained any advantage. Is this the outcome you wanted?”
“Hmm.”
The Chairman of Black Dragon Guild, with a calm expression, poured a cup of tea and pushed it forward, “The outcome isn’t too bad. It’s just that I pulled you out of the mire in time. You should be thinking about how to thank me.”
“Chen Yi won’t involve us on Neutron Star when he settles the scores in autumn, will he?”
“Heh.”
President Sun couldn’t help but chuckle coldly, “Aren’t you a little too scared? Chen Yi still has eight months before he can come out, are you that afraid of him?”
“Or are you just afraid of dying that much?”
Chairman Li’s expression remained peaceful, he didn’t speak, just picked up his tea cup. With a somewhat absent look, he turned his head towards the doorway where Li Peiqi was chatting with her best friend and murmured.
“I’m not afraid of death, but I’m afraid of dying under the ‘Annihilate Nine Clans’ skill.”
…
Soon.
A week had passed.
The incident had gradually cooled down on Blue Star as well, as all players realized one thing: Although it was frustrating, there really wasn’t a good solution.
Meanwhile, Solar Star was ceaselessly promoting the incident throughout the No. 3 Star System.
And they announced that the twofold trial would officially begin in three days, inviting players from other planets to join the live stream to watch in real time.
Following this event.
The players of Solar Star, as if invigorated, acted fearlessly determined to protect the honor of Solar Star.
Their current sense of unity and pride was truly unprecedented, never before seen!
Clearly, as Qiu Hao had said.
Compared to some minor side effects, the positive effects were a bit greater.
…
ps: Got the timing wrong again… I really deserve to die, woke up and realized I hadn’t updated after seeing messages in the readers’ group, only then did I remember that I set the wrong time again yesterday.
I was confused when I set the timer yesterday.
Sorry, I really deserve to die, these two chapters are from yesterday.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: 252: This is the Charm of an A-level Prop, Changing the Future,
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 252: This is the Charm of an A-level Prop, Changing the Future,
“Solar Star will officially open the twofold trial in three days, inviting all players to come for the viewing.”
A post.
It quickly spread to the forums of every planet in the #3 Star System.
Almost all players knew that Solar Star would challenge the twofold trial, and their feelings were indeed mixed. They were both looking forward to Solar Star’s successful passage and not looking forward to it.
The anticipation was because, in the future, they would certainly tread this path of the twofold trial. If there was one more successful planet ahead of them, they would feel more confident.
The reluctance stemmed from the fact that if Solar Star successfully passed the twofold trial, its overall strength would greatly increase, undoubtedly squeezing their living space.
If a planet failed in the twofold trial, its overall strength would be drastically reduced.
Take the God Race as a reference.
A race that failed the twofold trial went to Blue Star to establish their dominance and ended up annihilated.
And now,
another planet openly announced it would challenge the twofold trial, naturally attracting the attention of countless players.
…
“Currently there are just a few twofold trials.”
“They are Heaven’s Gate, Nine Linked Stars, Divine Spirit Kingdom, Waterfall Burial Sand Sea, and a newly added one, God of Slaughter.”
In a conference room on Neutron Star.
President Sun looked at the wildly discussed post on the internet with a complex expression and said, “There are a total of five twofold trials, and which one you get is completely up to luck. Each twofold trial requires specific props for preparation.”
“For example, for the Waterfall Burial Sand Sea trial, the map continuously has a large amount of poisonous dust storms, requiring each player to have props or skills to counteract the poison.”
“Again, for Nine Linked Stars, in this map, players’ sense of direction will be completely reversed, commanding the brain to go forward would cause the body to move backward, and commanding to flee would send them charging forward.”
“One must go through long-term training, or have corresponding props and skills.”
“But the twofold trial is not about an individual player, it’s about all players of a planet.”
“The rule of the twofold trial is that at least 70% of players from one Race must enter the twofold map, it’s not an exaggeration to call it a full clan battle.”
“In this situation, it’s necessary to ensure every player is prepared for each twofold trial ahead of time, a stringent test of a planet’s heritage.”
“Last time the God Race challenged the twofold trial, they only prepared for two maps, hoping to take a gamble. If the randomly selected twofold trial happened to be one of the two maps they prepared for, they could had successfully passed.”
“Unfortunately, they lost the bet.”
“They got a map they were completely unprepared for and suffered a crushing defeat.”
“A large number of God Race players died on that map.”
“And now…”
President Sun sighed deeply, leaned back in his chair, and said with a tired and low voice, “According to what Qiu Hao said, they are prepared for all five twofold trial maps.”
“Aiming for a hundred percent success rate pass.”
“Chairman Li, our relationship with Qiu Hao is very stiff now. If Solar Star successfully passes the twofold trial, we will not have easy days ahead of us.”
“One hundred percent?”
Black Dragon Guild’s Chairman Li Shengping calmly poured himself a cup of cold tea, took a light sip, and said indifferently, “The God of Slaughter trial was added after Chen Yi wiped out the God Race on Blue Star, and he was detected by the system as the final boss for the twofold trial.”
“In that twofold trial, there is only one boss modeled after Chen Yi.”
“Are you sure that Solar Star is also prepared for this twofold trial? Facing those endless other shore flowers, can they find a good solution?”
“I actually think that if Solar Star randomly gets the God of Slaughter trial, there might be some fun to watch.”
“Don’t rush it, I feel like Chen Yi won’t let Solar Star advance successfully so easily.”
Li Shengping paused for a moment then set down his teacup with a significant look, “Don’t you find the words Chen Yi said before leaving Sky Demon Star a bit strange?”
“Two sentences.”
“The first, ‘We will meet again.'”
“The second, ‘I wish you a pleasant promotion.'”
“Don’t you think there is something to ponder when you put these two sentences together?”
“Did you catch anything?”
President Sun furrowed his brows tightly, as if he suddenly made a connection, and asked hoarsely.
“My point is simple.”
Li Shengping leaned back in his chair, naturally crossed his legs, and lit a cigarette bringing it to his mouth. Amidst the smoke, he spoke relaxingly, “I think Chen Yi might have a way to ensure that Solar Star will definitely get the God of Slaughter trial, thereby striking a heavy blow to Solar Star.”
“Even if Solar Star is truly prepared in advance, they will surely have a pyrrhic victory.”
“A twofold planet that narrowly avoids defeat is not so intimidating.”
“Hey, Li Shengping,”
At this moment, President Sun finally realized something was off with Li Shengping. His brows furrowed, he asked thoughtfully, “You haven’t been like this before, you suddenly became very calm a few days ago, as if everything is under control. Do you know some insider information that we don’t?”
“Even though our two guilds don’t get along, we are all forces from Neutron Star.”
“If there’s anything concerning the future of Neutron Star, you can’t hide it from us.”
Li Shengping just gave a light chuckle without speaking, his eyes full of playfulness.
He?
He was naturally no longer worried now.
After forcibly starting a war with the Sun Family Guild and having all the forces of Neutron Star withdraw from the operation using Chen Yi, the death scenario of his daughter Li Peiqi, depicted in the A-grade Prop Last Words, had finally changed.
Instead of dying by Chen Yi’s hand, it changed to death at the hands of Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Although it was still unclear who Tuberculosis Rabbit was, or where this player had come from, it wasn’t important. At least it meant she would not die by Chen Yi’s hand, which also meant their move was not mistaken.
Withdrawing in time to avoid being cleared by Chen Yi in the future.
This could also be considered changing the future.
This is the charm of an A-grade Prop, altering the future isn’t just an empty talk.
In other words, the real cause of Li Peiqi’s death recorded in the A-grade Prop Last Words was due to her participation in this operation; as soon as she withdrew from the operation, she would immediately no longer have to die by Chen Yi’s hand.
Now all they needed to do was wait and see how Chen Yi would deal with Solar Star.
Although he was unsure how Chen Yi could interfere with the outside world within a planet with a Newbie Protection Period, he always felt that the two sentences Chen Yi left behind when he left seemed to carry certain implications, rather than just empty threats.
…
“An S-grade Prop.”
“Whew!”
Qiu Hao shared a prop panel in front of him with slightly trembling hands and said in a somewhat shaky voice, “This is probably the first S-grade Prop in Star System No. 3!”
“At least up to now, I haven’t heard of any player from any planet in Star System No. 3 possessing an S-grade Prop.”
“This S-grade Prop will become a critical bargaining chip for us to successfully advance to the Twofold Planet!”
Other players from Solar Star surrounding him were also staring fervently at the S-grade Prop panel in the air.
An S-grade Prop.
That was already a weapon belonging to spiritual deities, to put it accurately, even an A-grade Prop already involved the realm of spiritual deities. An S-grade Prop, to say it was the left shoulder or right arm of a deity would not be an overstatement.
「Prop Name」: The Wall of God.
「Prop Grade」: S-grade.
「Prop Effect」: Once activated, players of your Race will remain invincible, rejecting death for (1-60) seconds, with greatly increased movement speed, unaffected by any control status.
The duration varies with your Race’s unity and sense of honor, and refreshes every day at 24:00.
Today’s duration is (37) seconds.
「Prop Limitations」: Number of uses (1/1)
「Prop Description」: “This Prop is a replica. The original belonged to a Race known as Subaru, famed throughout the universe for their fearless and unyielding nature, ultimately leading to their annihilation. The original Prop was lost in the depths of space, its whereabouts unknown to this day.”
“37 seconds of invincibility for all players.”
Qiu Hao’s face flushed slightly as he stared intently at the information on the Prop panel in front of him, his eyes filled with zeal and excitement as he grinned, “This is why I am not afraid of Chen Yi. Strong attack? So what.”
“I watched Chen Yi’s battle with the God Race. Although his attack power is exceptionally strong, his defense is very weak.”
“Almost non-existent.”
“He only relies on a Prop that continually releases instant recovery from injuries. But with a fatal injury causing instant death, any Prop for recovering injuries is useless.”
“37 seconds of invincibility time, enough to smash Chen Yi to pieces!”
“Chen Yi is nothing but a fighter with strong attacks but weak defenses.”
“If we really get randomly selected for the ‘God of Slaughter’ twofold trial modeled after Chen Yi, we might even achieve an Undamaged Pass. And if I remember correctly, a full team’s Undamaged Pass in the twofold trial will earn a planetary achievement!”
“Not just an achievement for a single player but for the whole planet!”
“The reward for that achievement is probably the greatest in Star System No. 3!”
“I truly hope we get randomly selected for this ‘God of Slaughter’, not only for an Undamaged Pass but also for a massive reward!”
Looking at each other, all the surrounding Solar Star players saw the excitement and anticipation in each other’s eyes.
They had been preparing for this day for far too long.
In three days!
That would be the time for Solar Star to make a name for itself!
…
Meanwhile, the news that Solar Star would be going to the twofold trial in three days had spread throughout Star System No. 3, but Blue Star remained unaware.
Planets within the Newbie Protection Period were almost completely isolated from the outside world.
If not for the invasion of Blue Star by the God Race players, the players of Blue Star might not even know until the day before the end of their Newbie Protection Period that there were so many planets outside, nor that Blue Star had been transported to an unfamiliar Star Sea.
No matter how widespread a message was on external forums, it would not reach Blue Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 273: 253 "Why aren't you smiling anymore? Keep laughing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 253 “Why aren’t you smiling anymore? Keep laughing!
Of course.
Blue Star players had also gradually stopped discussing the matter, after all, the fact that Chen Yi had been used and humiliated wasn’t something to be proud of, and there weren’t any good solutions, so the topic died down.
The main focus on the forums had shifted to discussing bugs in various maps and the best speedrunning strategies.
Of course, bugs were discussed the most.
There even emerged a player who claimed to be the God of Bugs, who, no matter which new map was released, always managed to find its bugs the quickest and exploited them to make a fortune.
But perhaps due to this player’s lofty standards, they would always disclose any discovered bugs freely, so other players could also profit from them.
At first, some players knew the bugs but dared not exploit them.
Afraid of repercussions down the line.
But players gradually got a feel for the Snow Sea Project Team’s M.O., and with each monthly update, they’d only remove bugs, not punish the exploiters.
This apparent encouragement of wrongdoing made players all the more determined to study the bugs without holding back.
It’s unclear if it was a case of misallocated talent.
But Blue Star players had their unique insights when it came to researching bugs.
Some bugs were so bizarre that it made you wonder, what on earth did you do to find this bug?
It was like not understanding how the person who first discovered reproductive isolation did their research on wild animals.
But just like people don’t get why Mr. Krabs’s burger joint uses crab roe as burger patty, there are many things that people simply don’t understand.
Only a few players knew that Solar Star would undergo the twofold trial in three days, and Chen Yi was among them.
But Chen Yi didn’t get his news from the external forums.
It came from his B-level skill, Requesting the Mandate of Heaven.
This skill was very useful. As long as a certain price was paid, it could almost be used as an all-knowing intelligence agency.
He had experimented with it.
The price for asking a question was much less than the price for making a direct request.
For example, to find out the ways to obtain a B-level prop, the cost was only tens of thousands of Points.
But if he made a request for a B-level prop to be given to him, the cost would then be several million Points.
Whether a B-level prop was worth several million Points remained unsure, as he had yet to see a B-level prop selling case on Blue Star, making it priceless.
He had also tried directly asking for a random A-level prop.
The price was 500 million Points.
Impressive.
What else could he say? He even tried to remain in a permanent Wife-Killing Buff state, but the price got scrambled into gibberish.
Yep, the system crashed.
When unreasonable demands were made, the price would turn into gibberish. Clearly, this thing’s best use was to function as an intelligence system providing answers for Points, not as a wish-granting machine.
In three days.
In three days, Solar Star would undergo the twofold trial.
And he, Chen Yi, would become the boss of Solar Star’s twofold trial.
Thinking of this.
Chen Yi couldn’t help but chuckle softly, really wanting to see Qiu Hao’s expression then, hoping it wouldn’t be too shocked.
“That’s too bad.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting beside the rooftop, started with a sense of regret, “Yi, after you go in there, we won’t be able to see the action live. It’d be really interesting if we could live stream the scene.”
“Yi, remember to activate those cameras. We might not be able to watch live, but a recorded broadcast would still be good.”
“If…”
Sword Without End pondered for a moment while fiddling with his fingers before speaking, “If Yi succeeds in annihilating Solar Star this time, that’d be the second race he’s wiped out. We haven’t even left for the Star System 3, and he’ll have exterminated two races already.”
“Man, that’s just too arrogant.”
“Imagine when Yi truly gets past the Newbie Protection Period and heads to Star System 3, do you think the players from the other planets will just kneel in welcome?”
Just then—
A notification rang in the ears of all Blue Star players.
“Good afternoon to all you pitiful Blue Star players, I am Qiu Hao, the manager of Tianxia Pavilion from Solar Star. In three days, Solar Star will undergo its twofold trial, and we have specially applied for a system-wide live broadcast, hoping everyone will watch it live.”
“The price you’ll pay to watch the broadcast is much higher than what players from other planets are paying.”
“But it’s worth it.”
“After all, this might be our last encounter. By the time you leave the Newbie Protection Period, we will have advanced to level three and left for Star System 3.”
“Ah yes, one more thing, Chen Yi—I’m really sorry for using you last time. I hope you can make it to the live broadcast.”
“Of course, it doesn’t matter if you’re not on time, hahaha.”
“Because you must be really angry.”
“Simply click the button to reserve your spot for the broadcast.”
The notification sound started abruptly and vanished just as suddenly, as if nothing had happened.
Except for the pop-up prompt in front of them, declaring that someone had just challenged the entire Blue Star.
And there was a button left to reserve for the live broadcast.
Blue Star’s forums exploded instantly. Qiu Hao’s audacious move nearly made everyone explode with rage, wishing they could grab a knife, burst out of Blue Star, and chop Qiu Hao down with eighty-one slashes upon meeting him.
“Jeez.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the prompt in front of him and suddenly cracked a smile, “We were just saying it’s a shame we can’t live stream, and here’s a pillow thrown our way. I suddenly find this Qiu Hao quite interesting.”

chapters.title: Chapter 274: 253 "Why aren't you smiling anymore? Keep laughing!"_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 253 “Why aren’t you smiling anymore? Keep laughing!”_2
“Hey, have any of you noticed?”
“The last God Race member who was wiped out by Yi, he also actively started broadcasting. Why do these races like to live stream themselves right before they are exterminated, as if to not die in obscurity?”
“Kind of interesting.”
Sword Without End stared regretfully into the distance, wishing he had thought more during his time in the Life Theater map.
If only he had the Wife-Killing Buff.
An hour of non-stop action, how powerful that would be, to show those Alien Race players what a true sword rain is!
…
Three days flew by in the blink of an eye.
“Ding, the twofold trial of Solar Star will officially begin in 30 minutes. All players who have scheduled live broadcasts, please enter your broadcasting room as soon as possible.”
A notification sound echoed in the ears of all players across the Star System No. 3 who had made reservations for the live broadcast.
Suddenly!
A massive influx of viewers rushed into the broadcasting room!
Billions of players from all planets in Star System No. 3 surged into the broadcasting room almost simultaneously, as the twofold trial was a rite of passage for every planet. Naturally, everyone wanted to tune in on time to learn something and see if they could gain any experience from it.
As long as one wasn’t a weak woman or a disabled person, there was no escaping the twofold trial.
A stringent rule of participating in the twofold trial was that at least 70% of a race’s players must engage in battle!
Chen Yi also received the notice; in 29 minutes, he would be transported to a twofold trial map, taking on the role of the ultimate boss of this Solar Star trial.
Just as Chen Yi was preparing to make his move on Chen Yi.
Jiaye suddenly leaned in and whispered in his ear.
“Since we are about to take action anyway, how about trying something that violates the August rules, just for a change of pace?”
“No harm even if you get a critical hit.”
“…”
A flicker of temptation momentarily crossed the calm eyes of Chen Yi, but he soon composed himself and shook his head seriously, “No, that’s not possible.”
“Huh?”
Jiaye frowned in confusion, not understanding his response: “You’re really no fun, I’m not afraid of the pain.”
“It’s not about the pain.”
Chen Yi began to explain seriously, “A critical hit is uncertain; if we happen to get a critical hit now, then the Wife-Killing Buff would start counting down from this moment, meaning I would only have half an hour’s buff when I enter the twofold trial.”
“It’s too risky.”
“Taking action one minute before entering is the optimal solution.”
“Makes sense.”
After Jiaye pondered over it, he dropped the subject and changed the topic: “Could you try strangling to death this time? Every time you stab me with a knife, it feels like you really intend to kill me.”
“Sure, no problem.”
The 29 minutes passed like this, with everyone cutting in.
Chen Yi took a final puff of his nearly finished cigarette, casually flicking the butt aside, before clasping Jiaye’s neck with both hands and slowly lifting his entire body into the air.
…
In the Star System broadcasting room, which Qiu Hao applied for with millions of Points, hundreds of billions of players had already gathered.
To build fame and momentum.
Qiu Hao also didn’t hesitate to spend a fortune.
Finally, the live stream was no longer a black screen.
A man in black clothes, Qiu Hao, his face icy, slowly appeared in the center of the frame. As the camera zoomed out, countless Solar Star players dressed in black swarmed into view, their ranks stretching beyond sight.
Uniform apparel.
Chill on every face.
A silent atmosphere.
With military discipline as firm as iron, the players watching the live broadcast couldn’t help but hold their breath; such an army-style management was indeed capable of exerting great power in an all-race war.
As the camera slowly zoomed out, it ultimately failed to fit all of the Solar Star’s participating players onto the screen.
The camera began to lower.
Qiu Hao stood at the center of the frame, his face cold as he raised his right hand and said in a chilled voice.
“I, Qiu Hao, on behalf of Sun Star, initiate the twofold trial!”
As more than 50% of Solar Star’s players agreed to the trial, all players from Solar Star were transported to a vast Wasteland, and the five twofold trial maps in the sky also started to rotate.
Eventually, they settled on the “Divine Kingdom” twofold trial map.
Seeing this.
Qiu Hao let out a slight sigh of regret; although they had prepared for this twofold trial map, not landing on the “God of Slaughter” map, which was based on Chen Yi, meant they would miss out on the global achievement for an undamaged pass through the star system.
It was somewhat disappointing.
But it was not a major issue.
At this moment, the barrage of comments in the live broadcast room also started to flood the screen with discussions. If memory served them right, the last time the God Race stumbled upon this “Divine Kingdom” twofold trial map, they were utterly defeated and eradicated by Chen Yi.
Some wondered whether Solar Star would be able to succeed this time.
Just as Qiu Hao took a deep breath, preparing to deal with the upcoming “Divine Kingdom” twofold trial map as per the plan,
A huge block of text suddenly popped up in the sky.
“‘Divine Kingdom’ twofold trial map loading…loading…loading…”
“loading…loading…”
“Load failed.”
“The Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team, utilizing Level 1 authority, has temporarily altered the ‘Divine Kingdom’ twofold trial map selected for this occasion by Solar Star, switching it to ‘Wrath of Chen Yi’.”
“Please prepare yourselves, all players of Solar Star.”
With the appearance of this block of text, all the viewers in the live broadcast room were flabbergasted.
“‘What the hell? The twofold trial map can be changed on the fly? Does the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team have a bit too much authority? Why doesn’t our star system’s project team have this kind of power? And why does Blue Star’s Snow Sea Project Team have a say over Solar Star?”‘
“‘Is that important? The real question is, why is this twofold trial map called Wrath of Chen Yi?'”
“‘Wait… I suddenly have a bad feeling about this.'”
Standing at the forefront of all Solar Star players, Qiu Hao’s expression turned dark as he looked up at the message in the sky, feeling slightly uneasy. He disliked when unexpected events disrupted his plans, especially when the name Chen Yi gave him an unsettling feeling.
The next second—
The sky suddenly turned gloomy.
A blinding bolt of lightning fiercely struck the ground.
Making everyone squint their eyes.
When the lightning dissipated.
A vast Crimson Palace was mysteriously suspended in midair, and on the palace’s zenith laid a throne.
Chen Yi, dressed in a crimson suit, rested against the back of the chair, casually swirling a glass of red wine in his hand, smiling as he looked over at Qiu Hao standing on the ground and said softly.
“Hello there, Qiu Hao. Didn’t I say we would meet again soon?”
“I hope you enjoy Sun Star’s twofold trial journey.”
Without waiting for the audience in the live broadcast room to react—
Hundreds of thousands of Buddhas, seated cross-legged on Flame Lotus Platforms, each holding a Fire God Gatling, suddenly appeared in midair, filling the entire sky with their barrels aimed directly at the Solar Star players below, seemingly ready to open fire at any moment.
“Today, it’s time for the players of the third Star System to reacquaint themselves with the name Chen Yi.”
“Why aren’t you smiling?”
“Keep smiling.”
Chen Yi then couldn’t help but laugh himself, took a light sip of the wine, then casually threw the wine glass to the ground, shaking his head and saying, “I’ve waited many days to see that surprised look on your face.”

chapters.title: Chapter 275: 254: "Even if the gods descend, they cannot stop Solar from advancing today!!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 254: “Even if the gods descend, they cannot stop Solar from advancing today!!!
“Wife-Killing Maniac.”
Red title.
But in terms of power, it is not weaker than a black title, or even a Starry Level title.
Usable three times.
When the title is activated, all skills, props, and titles have no cooldown for one hour, and there’s unlimited use with no regard for consumption.
Take “Buddha’s Fury,” a B-level prop for example; using it once requires consuming 3000 props.
However, under the effect of the Wife-Killing buff, using this prop wouldn’t cost a dime, which is why he could make nearly a hundred thousand Buddhas levitate mid-air, as the saying goes: money talks, even Buddhas won’t help you do anything for free, unless you ignore the cost under the Wife-Killing buff state.
This title can be used three times, and this was his third usage; after this, the title’s uses would reset to zero.
But the Starry Level title “One Man Exterminates a Clan” that he obtained from annihilating a clan last time had a title effect—
For every 5 million Alien Race players you kill, you can reset the cooldown and usage count of a prop, skill, or title (current reset count: 3).
This means, if he wanted, he could reset the “Wife-Killing Maniac” title three times!
Resulting in an additional nine uses.
The only pity was…
Under the effect of the Wife-Killing buff, the “Wife-Killing Maniac” title couldn’t be activated without a cooldown; otherwise, theoretically, he could maintain this buff all day or even all year.
…
When Chen Yi appeared mid-air alongside nearly a hundred thousand Buddhas wielding Fire God Gatlings, the air instantly fell into an oppressive silence, and the usually lively chat in the live-streaming room went dead, as if it had crashed.
Not a single person was chatting in the public channel.
It wasn’t until three or five seconds later that the audience in the live-streaming room reacted, and the barrage of messages started to flood the screen.
“?”
“??”
“???”
“????”
The barrage was shockingly consistent, a screen full of question marks swarming the entire live-streaming room. At this moment, it seemed this symbol best expressed the audience’s feelings.
…
“Good show.”
White Son Star’s Unique Life, with a complex expression on his face, looked at Chen Yi floating in mid-air: “He truly doesn’t waste any time taking revenge; a player under Newbie Protection Period has actually become the boss of Solar Star’s twofold trial.”
What means he used, he was unclear.
He was somewhat unable to grasp this aspect, but he vaguely knew that top players receive some preferential treatment from their own star systems’ project teams, and it was said that there were performance assessments for each Star System’s projects, with those assessments based on the players from their own Star Systems.
This might be why the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team used a level-one authorization to change the Solar Star’s twofold trial, right?
He wasn’t sure.
But he was clear on one thing: Chen Yi was extremely confident in his own abilities.
One man against a clan.
He had arrived, but it was unclear if he could win; Solar Star wasn’t the God Race.
The God Race had been disastrously defeated when advancing to twofold, which led to a significant reduction in strength, and many props were even lost, while Solar Star was entering the twofold trial in full state. Moreover, no matter how strong Chen Yi was, he was still a player under Newbie Protection Period.
There was an upper limit to the strength of players under Newbie Protection Period.
To put it precisely, although it was very difficult for them to acquire A-level props, they at least had a chance, but for a player under Newbie Protection Period to get A-level props was basically a pipe dream.
…
“Look.”
Neutron Star’s Chairman Li turned to look at Chen Yi, who had appeared in the live-streaming room, then suddenly turned to President Sun beside him and started laughing, “I told you, Chen Yi doesn’t seem like someone who could swallow his pride. There you go, he’s come out.”
“Who says a player under Newbie Protection Period can’t leave their own Star System?”
“There are always difficulties, and solutions must be sought.”
President Sun, with a shocked expression on his face, clearly did not expect Chen Yi to appear in front of Solar Star in such a manner. He was bewildered; he had never heard of a player becoming a boss in the twofold trial.
Let’s not talk about not having heard of this pathway.
Even if there were such a pathway, who in their right mind would want to be a boss in the twofold trial?
One man against a clan?
Do they really think they’re invincible?
But…
President Sun involuntarily swallowed, a hint of fear flickering in his eyes; it appeared Chen Yi really was that invincible player.
…
“Chen Yi!”
Standing in front of all Solar Star players, Qiu Hao took a deep breath, his expression extremely ugly as he yelled, “Don’t rush; let me explain!”
Despite his ugly expression, his heart was actually elated!
He had already made ample preparations for the “God of Slaughter” twofold trial based on Chen Yi, ensuring an Undamaged Pass, obtaining stellar achievements, and a plethora of rewards!
Although there was a hiccup now.
It was not based on Chen Yi’s likeness anymore; Chen Yi himself had arrived, but there was no difference.
What he needed to do now was to temporarily divert Chen Yi’s attention, then quickly activate the S-level prop, The Wall of God, and under the unbeatable condition of 37 seconds, all the players from his race would rush forward and kill Chen Yi!
“`
Perfectly ascended to twofold trial, and achieved a Star System achievement for an Undamaged Pass!
However, just as Qiu Hao was about to make his move.
Chen Yi, hovering in mid-air, chuckled and snapped his fingers!
The next second—
“Ratatat!!!!”
Nearly a hundred thousand Buddhas, seated on Flame Lotus Platforms and wielding Fire God Gatlings, unleashed a sky full of flames upon the ground, swarming towards all players like sudden thunderbolts from a clear sky!
Yet it wasn’t over.
B-level prop “Starlight Blaze” activated!
Tens of thousands of huge meteors appeared instantly above Chen Yi’s head, like a meteor shower slowly and heavily smashing towards the ground, their orange-red glaring tails fluttering in the air like a swarm of racing tadpoles.
Countless red circles appeared on the ground in an instant.
These red circles were the attack range of the meteors.
Normally, one should quickly leave the red circles to avoid the meteor attacks.
But at this moment, there was no ground left uncovered by red circles; there was nowhere to run, no way to hide!
Almost at the same instant!
Bihanhua flowers, like July’s peach blossoms, flooded the sky above the Wasteland everywhere, drifting with the wind.
April has no snow.
Just as July has no peach blossoms.
Everything was abruptly surreal.
B-level prop “Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle” activated, countless bullets burst from the ground, leaving the entire ground riddled with holes like a pox-ridden wasp’s nest.
C-level skill “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans” activated!
Every bullet that burst from the ground, or those fired from the Buddha’s Gatling, all came with the Annihilate Nine Clans effect!
B-level prop “Absolute Purity” activated!
Chen Yi’s body began to be streaked with lines of white light every second, and any injury could be instantly healed within a fraction of a second; if the damage couldn’t kill him instantly, it couldn’t cause him any harm at all.
The whole scene was extremely abrupt; without a single harsh word or any sign, disaster had struck.
Even God, controlling the flood to end the world, would have to give a thumbs up and say, “And you, my friend, are the real Satan.”
If this scene were to be filmed, every second would represent a massive budget burning away rapidly.
The audience in the livestream nearly made the sign of the cross over their chests upon seeing this scene, already preparing themselves for the news of Solar Star’s total defeat. Under these circumstances, no one held out hope that Solar Star would survive.
However—
“The Wall of God!!!!!”
Qiu Hao’s face darkened extremely, as he held up a wooden staff from his chest, barking fiercely, “Even if the gods descend, they can’t stop Solar’s ascension today!!!!”
“Kill them!”
The next second!
A golden light shot out quickly from the wooden staff in Qiu Hao’s hand, spreading rapidly in all directions. Every Solar Star player enveloped in the light shimmered with a faint golden glow, entering an invincible state.
Even the players of Solar Star who were not engaged in battle flashed with the same golden light.
S-level prop.
Race invincibility.
Full invincibility.
So far, Chen Yi had not encountered a prop that could make a person truly invincible, but now he had seen one that could make all players of a race invincible.
In a race extinction crisis, this prop could even surpass the power of an S-level prop.
The horrifying attacks falling on Solar Star players couldn’t even cause the slightest damage; this was truly invincibility.
Only then did Qiu Hao let out a spiteful laugh, pointing at Chen Yi in the air, “The heritage of a planet is not something a newbie player like you can touch.”
“Ding, you have been bound by Qiu Hao…”
A notification sound rang in Chen Yi’s ear.
But before the voice could finish, a new notification sounded again.
“Ding, you have activated the B-level prop Absolute Purity, dispelling all negative effects.”
And only then did the notification that hadn’t finished earlier catch up, belatedly completing its message.
“…bound on the spot unable to move, lasting one minute, originating from the B-level prop Absolute Binding.”
“Invincible?”
Chen Yi in mid-air, looking down at the players below who were all shimmering with golden light, smirked thoughtfully and then, almost unconsciously, pulled out a mirror from his chest.
Immediately after, he vanished from his spot.
Invincibility must have a time limit, right?
As long as there’s a time limit, then all is good, right? A bug-like prop such as full race invincibility shouldn’t last too long, should it?
…
“It’s over.”
At this moment, many players in the livestream saw this and couldn’t help feeling that the scales of victory were tipping towards Solar Star again. Although Chen Yi’s attack was truly violent, its weakness was evident — Chen Yi’s defensive abilities weren’t as strong as his offensive ones.
Meanwhile, Qiu Hao of Solar Star had obviously used a prop that could make all players of his race enter an invincible state. Under these circumstances, they could withstand Chen Yi’s firepower and advance forward to slay him there!
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 276: 255: "This Is the Blue Star's Way of Doing Things.
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 255: “This Is the Blue Star’s Way of Doing Things.
“`
This is like an AD equipped with Six-God Equipment trading blows in place with a Barbarian King who only has one set of gear.
Though your damage is high,
within my Invincible Time, it’s entirely enough to hack you to death.
I don’t need to be very strong myself, I just need to be able to hack you to death during the Invincible Time.
But…
Soon, people in the live stream noticed something was amiss—where did Chen Yi go?
Somehow, Chen Yi had disappeared without a trace.
The relentless attacks continued to assault the Solar Star player, unable to breach his defense or even inflict a scratch, but they persevered in a dogged and professional manner.
“Where is he?”
Qiu Hao, suddenly aware that something was wrong, felt a deep fear in his heart for the first time. Frantically searching through his inventory, he shouted in the global loudspeaker, “Anyone with a Prop or Skill to locate people, activate it now! If we don’t find Chen Yi within the Invincible Time, we’re all dead!!!”
He naturally knew Chen Yi was hiding somewhere.
But now the problem was, he fucking didn’t know where Chen Yi had hidden.
The guy just vanished into thin air right in front of him.
Damn it, how could he have forgotten this?
He had only considered that although Chen Yi had strong attacks, his defense was weak. With 37 seconds of Invincible Time, they could withstand the firepower and all rush him at once, and just their spit could drown Chen Yi.
But he hadn’t thought about what to do if Chen Yi hid during his Invincible Time.
He hadn’t thought about it at all.
Or perhaps he had, but his subconscious made him avoid dwelling on it. As if by doing so, the issue would never arise.
But the current situation was this.
He had only 20 seconds left!
If he didn’t find Chen Yi and kill him within these 20 seconds, then Qiu Hao, all the players here, and the entire Solar Star would die at Chen Yi’s hands!
“Damn it, damn it, DAMN IT!!!!”
With a ferocious expression, Qiu Hao rifled through his inventory, sweeping over each item in hopes of finding a Prop that could locate people, but without prior preparation, it was far too late!
At this moment, he was like a headless fly, completely losing the standard of rational thought he normally possessed.
Any normal person,
with a countdown of only ten or so seconds on their life, would hardly be able to stay calm enough to think straight!
Just as the Invincible Time was about to run out in a few seconds,
a shout burst forth from among the Solar Star players behind him: “I have one!”
The next second—
A beam of starlight suddenly shot out from behind, targeting a specific spot in mid-air. As the starlight passed, Chen Yi, who was hiding in the Mirror World, was forcibly expelled, returning to reality.
Chen Yi had indeed been hiding in the Mirror World, but now he had been forced out by the beam of starlight.
“Found him!”
Qiu Hao, who had nearly fallen into despair, saw this and his eyes lit up with renewed hope. Without the slightest hesitation, he threw all the offensive Props from his inventory at Chen Yi in mid-air as if they were worthless!
Even the Props that were cherished and seldom used due to their usage limit,
were thrown without a second thought!
Everyone knew that if they killed Chen Yi within the Invincible Time, Solar Star would be reborn and usher in a new era—a one that belonged to them!
But if they failed to kill Chen Yi within that time,
the only thing waiting for them would be extermination.
There were no other options.
No one believed that Chen Yi, after killing Qiu Hao, would think the score settled and quietly leave.
The Solar Star players behind him also threw all the Props and Skills they had in their arsenal at Chen Yi without regard for the cost, with myriad colors of light striking towards Chen Yi in mid-air at lightning speed!
The Blue Star players watching the live stream, without exception, subconsciously clutched the hems of their clothes, their palms sweating profusely.
Even Li Yide, who had his differences with Chen Yi,
was now sitting on the edge of the bed, his hands clasped together and eyes closed, praying fervently.
Although he wasn’t particularly fond of Chen Yi, feeling like Chen Yi stole his limelight, Chen Yi was representing Blue Star at this moment. Frankly speaking, he hoped that Chen Yi would rampage through the enemies, showing those foreign players the power and consistent style of the Blue Star players!
Not to just die here in such a suffocating manner.
“Pretty good.”
Chen Yi glanced casually at the flood of system notifications popping up in front of him. In a fraction of a second, he received thousands of control effects, including curses that could render one infertile.
And some incredibly severe injuries had also mysteriously appeared on him.
However,
‘Absolute Purity!’
Everything restores!
He didn’t even feel the effects of being controlled—Absolute Purity had already removed all negative effects. Only the lingering pain on his body told him that a Prop must have hit him.
Then, before more Props could take effect, he didn’t hesitate upon re-entering the Mirror World.
D-level Skill ‘Mirror Man’
Allows one to step into the Mirror World and stay for ten minutes, during which no attacks can be launched from within, nor can any damage from the outside world be received.
A Skill not considered to be of high rank.
But quite useful in critical moments, like now.
In the level-up game, the power and titles of Props cannot be absolutely measured by their level. A D-level Skill may not necessarily be useless, and an A-level Skill may not necessarily be all-conquering.
The level system only indicates the rarity of the Skill.
Not the power of the Skill.
Rarity can to some extent be indicative of power, but it cannot absolutely determine power.
37 seconds of invincible time.
Merely the time it takes to smoke two cigarettes.
It quickly passed.
When there was only one second left of the invincible time.
Qiu Hao, who still had no way to deal with Chen Yi, looked down at the golden light on his own body that had begun to flicker violently, and at the falling meteor shower above his head, the Gatling Buddha hovering in midair, the overwhelming seas of otherworldly flowers, and the countless bullets erupting from beneath the ground.
His eyes filled with despair, he knew he was beyond salvation!
He didn’t plan thoroughly enough.
The day that Solar Star would be extinguished was today.
In a trance, he seemed to suddenly understand why the Black Dragon Guild Leader from Neutron Star chose to step down so resolutely. Perhaps being against such a person was truly a terrifying matter.
If… if he hadn’t provoked Chen Yi, then Chen Yi wouldn’t have appeared in the twofold trial of Solar Star.
Although without this incident, Solar Star wouldn’t have gained so many props, nor would it have such strong unity, it would still have had a chance to pass the twofold trial, instead of announcing the extinction of its people like now.
If he had another chance, he… might seriously consider the advice given by the Black Dragon Guild Leader.
It’s just.
Just as love doesn’t turn back, he had no chance to choose again.
Qiu Hao’s eyes were full of fear of death and reluctance to leave this world, as he looked up at the sky filled with otherworldly flowers and the bullets showering down like locusts, and he screamed hoarsely with a ferocious expression, neck straining.
“Solar will never fall!!!”
“On behalf of the Solar Tribe, I issue a Hundred Generations Bounty!!!”
As soon as the words were spoken!
The golden light on the body of the Solar Star players instantly shattered, the invincible time was up.
The next second—
Almost instantly, a large number of players burst into blood mists at their locations, with only a few relying on defensive props to struggle on!
It’s just…
The attacks they were enduring were far too many!
And at that moment, those meteors which had been falling from the sky for a minute arrived late, each meteor several tens of meters in diameter, bringing with it a ring of flames, crushing towards the ground unstoppably!
Tens of thousands of meteors, passing through the phantom of the Buddha in the sky, directly smashed towards the Solar Star players on the ground!
“Boom!!!”
“Rumble!!!”
The whole ground was shaking violently, as if half the sky had fallen, and the massive cloud of dust engulfed the entire battlefield.
…
Some Solar Star players were invaded by the otherworldly flowers and began to transform into Floral People, but before losing consciousness, they were blasted into pieces by countless bullets, and before the fragments of their bodies could fall to the ground, they were hit by meteorites!
Accompanied by the blood mist rising!
Not even a bit of flesh could be seen, vaporized instantly in the high temperature!
But it wasn’t over yet.
Several crimson beams shot out at incredible speeds from the far distance, the effect of the ‘Annihilate Nine Clans’ skill, which would trace the bloodline of the deceased three generations down, delivering the same eradication fate!
Annihilate Nine Clans had one flaw, it could only eliminate up to the third generation.
It couldn’t kill the previous generation.
That is to say, if there were many elderly players staying on Solar Star, then these elders could not be cleared away, they would become a future problem.
But with the advent of the upgraded game, the number of elderly players on almost all planets was rapidly decreasing, even nearing zero.
So there was no worry that there would be too many elderly players on Solar Star, the issue of an aging population was roughly and violently solved by the upgraded game.
In just a few dozen seconds!
Only a very few Solar Star players were still struggling on with the props they had!
Chen Yi, sitting in a palace armchair in midair, swung the wine glass in his hand absent-mindedly, twitched his nose slightly, the smell of gunpowder and the iron-like stench of blood was particularly pungent.
What a sin, if I have children someday, I should name my child Chen Shanren.
If I don’t give a good name, I’m afraid my child might not be able to bear the carnage I’ve caused.
The bombardment in the sky lasted a full thirty minutes.
Then it quieted down.
There were no more meteors in the sky, no Gatling Buddha wielding the Fire God Gatling in midair, no more otherworldly flowers in the air, and no more bullets shooting out from the ground.
Everything was quiet.
Leaving behind a wasteland full of craters like a beehive, and a ground covered in a mixture of blood and flesh that looked like a jam concoction made from large quantities of strawberries thrown into a grinding machine.
Solar Star was gone.
Or to say.
All players of Solar Star were gone.
“Clang.”
Chen Yi took out his Zippo lighter from his chest, in front of billions of viewers, lit a cigarette and took it to his lips, exhaled softly, and then with the light blue smoke curling around, he looked at the camera with a light smile and said.
“This is the way Blue Star does things.”
“When we seek revenge, we don’t target just one person.”
The next second—
COUNTLESS system notification sounds abruptly sounded in the ears of all players of Star System 3!
‘Ding, Entire Star System 3 announcement!’
‘The planets included in this announcement are as follows: Blue Star, Neutron Star, Shaved Head Star, Walker Star, Bamboo Shoot Star… and 38 other planets in total.’
‘…’

chapters.title: Chapter 277: 256: "A monster appears in Star System 3, we can't stay long.
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 256: “A monster appears in Star System 3, we can’t stay long.
“…”
As Chen Yi exhaled a puff of smoke, the entire Wasteland fell into silence, and the live stream room followed suit.
Everyone had entered the live stream to see how Solar Star would clear the twofold trial and to glean some experience, but instead, they witnessed Chen Yi exterminate another clan.
“This is Blue Star’s way of doing things.”
This statement echoed in the ears of hundreds of billions of players in Star System 3.
It was simple, brutal, and deeply shocking.
“It really seems… it really seems a bit irrational. Won’t this just expand the scope of retaliation and needlessly make enemies?”
Finally, a player in the live stream room couldn’t help but speak up and ask.
“Heh.”
Seeing this, King Gou from Number Nine Star couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth and said in a low voice, “What enemies are left? Forget nine clans; you’ve wiped out an entire planet, where could any enemy be?”
“Expanding the scope of retaliation, all it does is needlessly make enemies.”
“But as long as the scope is wide enough, there’s no such thing as making enemies anymore.”
“Just like now, do you think anyone from Solar Star could still be out seeking revenge?”
At that moment, the system’s notification voice rang in the ears of all players in Star System 3.
“Ding, entire Star System 3 announcement!”
“The following planets are included in this announcement: Blue Star, Neutron Star, Shaved Head Star, Walker Star, Bamboo Shoot Star… a total of 38 planets.”
“Server changes detected… re-announcing, a total of 37 planets included in this announcement, Black Eagle Star removed.”
“The Solar Clan of Solar Star suffered a bitter defeat in the twofold trial. With an excessive number of player deaths, it has been declared as exterminated and is permanently out of the race for advancement.”
“Let us congratulate Blue Star player Chen Yi for once again achieving a special supreme achievement of Star System 3—’One Man Exterminates a Clan!'”
“And a reward of one A-grade random Prop Chest and 500,000 Points.”
An announcement of extermination identical to the previous one echoed through the star system.
Among them, Black Eagle Star, which was the God Race that had been exterminated last time, was excluded from this announcement. Presumably, if there were to be another star system-wide announcement next time, Solar Star would also be removed.
“…”
Chen Yi, sitting in his chair, looked at the star system announcement in front of him, his mouth beginning to twitch uncontrollably, feeling somewhat numb in the scalp.
He seemed to have forgotten something very important.
After exterminating the God Race last time, he was rewarded with an A-grade random Prop Chest, but since he was preoccupied with picking up Jiaye from hell, he had forgotten about it.
He always thought he didn’t have an A-grade Prop Chest, but seeing this star system announcement, he began to wonder; if he was rewarded with an A-grade random Prop Chest for this extermination, shouldn’t he have had one last time too?
Checking his backpack meticulously.
There was indeed an A-grade random Prop Chest in the corner, which he had always pushed to the bottom of his bag and utterly forgotten about.
It must be said, his memory had been somewhat poor lately.
He had been looking for ways to acquire an A-grade prop, yet he had been unknowingly carrying an A-grade random Prop Chest in his backpack all this time.
Now with the addition of another one from this extermination, he had a total of two A-grade Prop Chests.
Fortunately for him, even though he had forgotten about this detail, it hadn’t affected him much. He could just open them later.
“Ding, the twofold trial is officially over. Player Chen Yi will exit the map in 10 seconds.”
A voice only he could hear gently chimed by Chen Yi’s side.
At the sound.
Chen Yi slowly rose to his feet; the palace chair beneath him dissolved into air and vanished as he floated in midair, gazing tranquilly into the horizon, silent without speaking.
The man appeared to be a thoughtful philosopher, full of contemplation.
A few seconds later.
He sighed quietly.
Then, in an instant, he transformed into countless rose petals that drifted with the wind and scattered in the air.
A standard character action, which when used during an exit, had a nice effect.
It was just a pity about those props scattered thickly across the Wasteland, not a single one of which he could collect, even though this method allowed him to smuggle himself away from Blue Star.
But—
Players within their Newbie Protection Period couldn’t acquire any props from outside Blue Star by any means.
This rule had a very high priority.
It couldn’t be circumvented or exempted by any means, so even though he saw countless props covering the wilderness, he could only watch helplessly without any way to take them into his possession.
Truly a pity.
The live stream hadn’t closed yet.
But everything was over.
The twofold trial was over. Solar Star was no more, Chen Yi had left.
The live stream room was empty, only the Wasteland smeared with strawberry jam stood static like a still image within the room.
…
“Brother!”
Looking like he was barely clinging to life, President Sun immediately knelt before Chairman Li of the Black Dragon Guild, banging his head on the ground with force, his voice trembling and face pale with panic as he said,
“There’s no need for excess words. I’m deeply grateful to Brother for saving every member of the Sun Family Guild, including all players on Neutron Star.”
“I was blinded by short-term interests.”
“Chairman Li, you saw further ahead. But how did you guess Chen Yi would appear in the twofold trial on Solar Star?”
“It’s a guess.”
Chairman Li also had a complex expression as he gazed at the live broadcast on the screen. “When Chen Yi left Sky Demon Star last time, didn’t he almost clearly say he would appear in the twofold trial on Solar Star?”
“It’s just that the matter was so bizarre, not many people believed it.”
“But I didn’t expect that Chen Yi’s strength would have increased again, it’s just… Chen Yi will probably be in danger in the future.”
“Oh?”
Rising from the ground and sitting on the chair, President Sun drank the cool tea on the table in one gulp, let out a long breath of cold sweat, and then questioned with full conviction.
“Impossible. With strength like his, who would dare to make a move against him?”
“No, to be precise, who would even dare to entertain the thought?”
After today’s live broadcast.
He had become an unthinking fan of Chen Yi, and did not believe that any player could pose a threat to Chen Yi, even if all members of the Sun Family Guild were to attack him, it would be in vain.
After all, Chen Yi just faced Solar Star in its full state.
That was quite a bit stronger than his Sun Family Guild.
“No!”
Chairman Li sighed lightly and shook his head uneasily, “If Chen Yi’s last move only made some people ponder, then this time his move almost confirmed these people’s inner speculations.”
