“Chen Yi’s main strength comes from a prop that can make skills or props have no cooldown for a certain amount of time.”
“Like that sky-full of attacks, they were just the effects of a few props being activated, only activated in greater quantities.”
“When Qiu Hao used an entire clan’s Invincible Time prop, Chen Yi could only evade.”
“Although Chen Yi’s position was found in the end, due to the lack of time, they could only announce the extinction of their clan in resentment.”
“If… If Solar Star had anticipated the live broadcast of this twofold trial and prepared a large number of props to detect Chen Yi’s position in advance, there would not be no chance to kill Chen Yi here within thirty seconds of Invincible Time.”
“The reason why Solar Star was exterminated this time was largely because they were caught off guard and unprepared.”
“While Chen Yi showed his absolute strength, he also exposed his weakness, which is that his own defense is not absolutely invincible.”
“As long as it’s not absolutely invincible, there’s a possibility of being killed.”
“Chen Yi is in the light, while the enemy is in the dark; the enemy can devise a detailed plan of attack based on Chen Yi’s three public performances, but Chen Yi knows nothing about the hidden enemy.”
“When someone makes a move against Chen Yi next time, it will definitely pose a threat of death to Chen Yi, or even lead to his execution.”
“…”
After silently being expressionless for a while, President Sun said, “Chairman Li, are you suggesting that someone else might target Chen Yi?”
“It’s not a possibility, it’s a certainty.”
“He’s already exterminated two clans, and Chen Yi alone has cleared 20% of Sky Demon Star. Even so, there are still people who are bold enough to take action?”
“This world never lacks people with boldness.”
“But that’s too bold, isn’t it? Isn’t the saying ‘kill the chicken to warn the monkey’ working on this monkey anymore?”
Chairman Li got up, glanced at President Sun, and walked toward Li Peiqi standing at the door, leaving just a sentence drifting in President Sun’s ear.
“‘Kill the chicken to warn the monkey’ has always been a false proposition since ancient times; the monkey cannot be warned. No monkey will consider itself a chicken, instead it will mock the chicken’s foolishness.”
“Tomorrow I plan to gather all forces from Neutron Star for a meeting, to pass the threefold trial as soon as possible.”
“At this rate, I’m somewhat worried that one day Chen Yi will exterminate all the planets in the Number Three Star System; it’s better to leave the Number Three Star System sooner rather than later.”
“A monster has emerged in the Number Three Star System; it’s not a place to stay for long.”
…
Billions of players in the live broadcast room began to orderly exit the live stream. After leaving, many players whispered in their guilds.
“Don’t provoke Chen Yi.”
“If anyone is named Chen Yi, change the name immediately.”
In such a situation.
They were scared, truly scared.
In the Number Three Star System, each planet competes with the others, but intense competition never led to the extermination of a clan.
How long has Blue Star emerged?
It’s only been a little over four months, and already two planets have been exterminated. That’s still within the Newbie Protection Period. Once Blue Star comes out of the Newbie Protection Period.
How many planets will survive in the Number Three Star System?
Almost instantly.
The majority of forces across all planets made a decision in their hearts, to pass the threefold trial and leave the Number Three Star System as soon as possible.
The failure rates for both the twofold and threefold trials are significant.
In the past, nobody was eager to initiate the twofold trial, always feeling that without a hundred percent certainty to clear it, rashly initiating like the God Race and suffering a crushing defeat would greatly affect their clan’s strength.
Everyone was in no hurry.
After all, there was no time limit.
The overall situation was somewhat slack.
But now it was different.
Without passing the threefold trial and leaving the Number Three Star System early, it’s possible that the next planet to be wiped out could be their own.
The only factor to consider now is how to present a gift to Chen Yi.
To ensure that Chen Yi does not suddenly appear in their twofold trial.
That’d be quite scary indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: 257: "This Is the Blue Star's Way of Doing Things, Understand?
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 257: “This Is the Blue Star’s Way of Doing Things, Understand?
And just then—
A voice once again echoed throughout the entire Star System No.3.
“Solar shall never perish!!!”
“With the fate of the Solar Tribe, I leave the Hundred Generations Bounty!!!”
The sentence Qiu Hao roared before he died resounded in the ears of every player within Star System No.3, filled with valor and despair, such that just hearing it one could imagine Qiu Hao’s state of mind at that moment.
It wasn’t just about his own death at Chen Yi’s hands.
It was also about dragging Solar Star down with him, leading to the Solar Star’s annihilation.
That kind of painful feeling is hard to empathize with for those who haven’t experienced it.
After that voice faded, a system announcement reverberated throughout Star System No.3.
“Ding, Solar Star player Qiu Hao has activated the A-grade prop ‘Hundred Generations Bounty’.”
“This prop can only be used on the eve of a race’s annihilation, and the person who activates this prop must have a certain reputation within their own race.”
“All props and Points of every Solar Star player will be packaged and stored for the bounty.”
“Bounty one: Annihilate Blue Star, and take away all rewards.”
“Bounty two: Completely kill Chen Yi, and take away fifty percent of the rewards.”
“The bounty rewards are as follows: 623.1 million Points, S-grade prop ‘The Wall of God’*1, A-grade props*16, B-grade props*…”
“This bounty will last indefinitely!”
“Any player within the star system, upon completing the bounty, may take away the corresponding rewards, which the system will send to the player’s backpack.”
“If multiple players complete it together, the system will automatically distribute the rewards based on each player’s contribution.”
“ps1: The reputation judgment criterion is that if a player’s name is known by more than seventy percent of their own race, they are deemed to have a certain reputation, and in some cases, can make decisions on behalf of their race.”
“ps2: Some props have already been used up, players can destroy them on their own or use other means to restore the prop’s usage count.”
Hundred Generations Bounty!
This was the mess Qiu Hao left behind for Chen Yi before he died.
The man was dead.
No amount of props and Points would be useful anymore; rather than letting others from different planets pick them up, it made more sense to set up a bounty, as for whether any players would fulfill this bounty.
Qiu Hao didn’t have time to consider all this before his death.
But…Star System No.3 is so vast, there will always be some who are not afraid to die.
Even if they couldn’t kill Chen Yi, just making his life miserable every day would be enough.
…
“Over 600 million Points…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked somewhat tempted as he gazed at the ‘Hundred Generations Bounty’ that popped up before him, and couldn’t help but click his tongue in amazement, “It’s really hard not to be tempted, and there’s that S-grade prop, which I think is the one that can make the whole race invincible.”
“This prop really is a bug.”
“And there are so many A-grade props; the bounty’s rewards are indeed substantial, I’m getting envious just looking at them.”
“But Yi, although you were very cool just now, suddenly I’m contemplating something.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit turned his head to look at Chen Yi, who had just returned, and said seriously.
“In the twofold trial map, there’s one map ‘God of Slaughter’ that is based on the first time you wiped out the God Race.”
“Every planet must go through the path of challenging the twofold trial.”
“Yi, have you thought about what to do if Blue Star unfortunately picks this map?”
“It looks cool to the audience.”
“But from the victim’s perspective, it’s a bit less cool.”
“No worries.”
Chen Yi shook his head, “With the original version like me here, can a knockoff turn the world upside down? I can handle it.”
“Yi, you can handle it, but there are barely any Blue Star players who can…”
“Where’s Sword Without End?”
Chen Yi glanced around, didn’t see Sword Without End’s figure, and asked instinctively.
“Oh, you’re talking about him? He went down to protect Jiaye.”
“He went down again?”
“You forgot…?”
“No, I just didn’t ask him to go down and protect Jiaye, didn’t expect he’d be so conscientious.”
“I sent him down.”
“Thanks.”
“We’re brothers, no need to be polite.”
…
“Would you two like to get a membership card? I see you come here often; you must be local residents, right?”
In the depths of the underworld, within a certain cafe.
A young man dressed as a waiter, holding a tablet in his arms, with a hint of anticipation in his eyes, stood in front of a coffee table looking at the young man and woman opposite him.
…
Sword Without End looked up expressionlessly and glanced at the young waiter standing by, “Young and already with such a small mouth, why do you like to blabber so much?”
“This is fucking hell!”
“Why would I come here if I’ve got nothing better to do?”
“To burn incense for you in person, perhaps?”
“Oh… but if I’m not mistaken, sir, you’ve been here quite a few times this month.”
…
Sword Without End remained silent for a long while before suddenly taking the tablet, “You’re right; I should get a membership card so I can get a discount next time.”
“Rest assured, sir, our current promotions are the most generous.”
Seeing a possible sale, the waiter started explaining with a hint of excitement in his voice, “You only need to make a first-time charge of 1000 Points, and you can…”
Yes.
He had descended into hell again to protect Jiaye.
Instead of asking why he went to hell again, it was better to ask why Jiaye went to hell again.
It was damn annoying.
He felt like he had been sitting in this cafe in hell watching Yi’s livestreams pretty often, it must have been several times now, right?
“Phew!”
A moment later, after finishing the membership, Sword Without End let out a long sigh, leaning back in his seat with a dazed expression and murmuring tiredly, “This is kind of like a business trip, isn’t it? Wonder if anyone’s going to reimburse the travel expenses.”
…
Meanwhile, the posting volume on the Blue Star players’ forum had exploded tenfold in an instant.
Especially the players from Black Trench City, who almost immediately dominated the entire forum.
It was a pity that the players from Black Trench City couldn’t post on the forums of other planets, or else players from other worlds would have witnessed just how arrogant the players from Black Trench City could be.
These trolls unleashed all their combat power.
But this time, their targets were players from other star systems, including Solar Star.
“Come on, you Solar bastards, keep barking for daddy!”
“This is the Blue Star way of doing things, got it?”
“Before you mess with Yi, did anyone bother to check Yi’s historical records? Everyone checks stats when playing games, and you didn’t even look up the stats before doing this?”
They were excited.
The entire Blue Star gaming community was immersed in an intense sense of pride, since everyone had felt frustrated the previous week, but now they were finally able to vent.
As for Chen Yi.
He didn’t rush to hell to pick up Jiaye but instead opened two A-level Prop random chests.
He had forgotten about this last time because he went to pick up Jiaye.
Once bitten, twice shy.
This time he couldn’t forget.
He opened them immediately, without any hesitation.
“Ding, you have opened one A-level Prop random chest, congratulations on obtaining the following Prop—”
“A-level Prop: Cowherd and Weaver Girl.”
“Cowherd and Weaver Girl?”
Chen Yi looked at the A-level Prop in front of him with a slightly odd expression, then glanced at the calendar.
August 19th.
Today was the 19th.
In a few days, it would be Qixi Valentine’s Day on August 22nd, and this A-level Prop seemed to have a certain significance.

chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 258: “Prop Name”: Bikini Beach Chair.
“Prop Name”: Cowherd and Weaver Girl.
“Prop Level”: A-level Prop.
“Prop Effect”: True love can travel between galaxies; upon activation, you and your lover will enter a strange world where both parties will have amnesia and possess a new set of memories.
They will appear in different spaces within a city, and if in this world they fall in love with each other again, they will receive an exclusive title and a high reward.
If they do not fall in love until the end of their lifespan, there will be no reward.
No matter how long you spend in that world, it will only be a moment in the outside world.
We believe that true love is such that even if you forget each other, upon seeing each other again, you will still feel that heart-fluttering sensation as if struck by electricity.
As you can see, I hope you are a Pure Love Warrior.
“Prop Restrictions”: Can be used only once.
“Prop Introduction”: “A unique life experience, it’s an extremely precious existence.”
“Hmm…”
Chen Yi slightly raised his eyebrows and pondered over the A-level prop in his hands without speaking. Well, it didn’t seem like a prop as much as a Map Access Pass.
An A-level prop… is this it?
It didn’t seem very powerful.
Amnesia in a strange world? Honestly, it wasn’t an appealing experience; he wasn’t keen on the idea of staying too long in an unfamiliar world and then feeling totally out of place once back.
And there’s the matter of falling in love with Jiaye all over again while having no memory.
It seemed rather challenging.
Although there are exclusive titles and high rewards after passing the trial, if the Conditions to Achieve are not met, it would mean no reward at all, and thus the A-level prop would be a waste.
He didn’t dwell on it for long and opened the next A-level random Prop Chest.
“Prop Name”: Bikini Beach Chair.
“Prop Level”: A-level Prop.
“Prop Effect”: This is an extremely comfortable beach chair; when you lie down on this chair, you will be in a state of Absolute Defense and invincibility. You cannot be pulled into any map, affected by any rules, and even a planet’s explosion would not disturb your nap.
Of course.
As a price.
While lying on this beach chair, you cannot use any props, titles, Skills, or perform any actions like attacking or defending. Aside from comfortably lounging, you cannot do anything else.
You can’t even receive any friend messages, system prompts, or rule announcements.
We really hate receiving all sorts of junk messages during vacations.
Although this prop won’t let you slay your enemies on the battlefield, it will ensure you have a peaceful holiday.
“Prop Restrictions”: No cooldown; it becomes effective as soon as you lie down, but this prop must be bound. Once bound, it only works for the bound player, and others will not be affected by it. Also, the prop cannot be destroyed.
“Prop Introduction”: “Just as a good novel starts with a mystery, a good vacation should begin with bikini-clad beauties.”
This prop was quite good.
Absolute Defense.
Invincibility.
No cooldown, no price to activate, and no usage limit—just lie down, and the prop takes effect. The only downside was that while it offered Absolute Defense, you could only take hits.
If you wanted to fight back, you had to get up from the chair.
But even so, this prop was still very strong.
Compared to the A-level prop “Cowherd and Weaver Girl,” this “Bikini Beach Chair” was more deserving of the A-level tier. If he had this prop while on the Solar Star twofold trial map, he wouldn’t have to keep awkwardly scrambling into the Mirror World.
All he would need to do is lie on the chair, cease attacking, and patiently wait for the invincible duration of the other race on Solar Star to pass.
The only thing that puzzled him was the prop’s name.
“Bikini Beach Chair”?
What kind of nonsensical name was that?
How could a beach chair be named after a bikini?
“Yi.”
At this moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit curiously poked his head over and asked, “How is it? What did you get this time?”
“Not bad.”
Chen Yi activated the “Bikini Beach Chair” at random, then lied down on it, felt its comfort for a moment before continuing, “I triggered a Star System achievement again, but this time without a title reward—just got two A-level props and 500,000 Points.”
While 500,000 Points was a lot, it wasn’t all that appealing to him anymore.
Last time at Sky Demon Star, he directly received tens of millions of Points in one go.
So many Points were enough to buy everything in the system’s store, but it was a pity that the items appearing in the store were all commonplace. Even if he bought everything, it wouldn’t be very useful. The really good items wouldn’t show up in the store; they would drop in the maps or be obtained through other rare means.
There were plenty of Points, but he really couldn’t spend them all at once.
He could use Points to buy Points from other players, but that was a time-consuming task.
Before Chen Yi could drift too far into his thoughts, his surroundings silenced him.
“…”
He and Tuberculosis Rabbit were originally on the rooftop.
The rooftop of the Garden District.
This was their main base. Everyone in Yancheng knew they liked to hang out here, whether they were descending into the maps or just killing time.
But at this moment, the entire rooftop had somehow transformed into a vast expanse of beach.
Yes, a beach.
Looking down, one could even see the fine, soft grains of sand piled up beneath their feet.
The sandy area was roughly ten thousand square meters in size.
At the end of the beach, the sound of waves lapping on the shore could be heard, and the surf could be seen splashing up white foam. One could smell the briny scent of the sea, and even see fish occasionally leaping out of the water.
Next to them…
Were about a dozen bikini-clad beauties playing and frolicking.
Some were playing beach volleyball.
Some buried their bodies in the sand, soaking up the sunshine.
Others were laying on the ground, having body lotion applied by fellow bikini-clad beauties.
The occasional girlish laughter and chatter made the whole scene extremely lively.
It truly felt like an exclusive experience.
But—
Weren’t they on the damn rooftop?
Chen Yi, somewhat dazed, sat up from his beach chair, stood on the sandy beach, grabbed a handful of sand, and let it slip through his fingers, muttering confusedly, “It’s not an illusion; the sand is real.”
Was this the effect that came with his A-Level prop, the “Bikini Beach Chair”?
It can change the environment?
But there was no mention of this in the prop panel.
“Hold on, I’ll take a look!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, equally baffled, rolled up his trousers and ran toward the edge of the beach. Soon, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s shouting voice was heard: “Yi, you’ve got to see this!”
…
“Does that mean this prop can create a piece of land out of thin air? Or a beach platform?”
After understanding everything, Chen Yi stood at the edge of the sand, slightly shocked as he gazed into the distance.
At the edge of the beach was a stretch of water about ten meters wide, with waves continuously crashing against the shore.
And looking farther out…
There was Yancheng.
They hadn’t been transported to any other world; they were still in Yancheng. Only this time, the prop had conjured a beach out of thin air above the rooftop, and the beach wasn’t an illusion—it could support objects and people, and walking on it posed no issue whatsoever.
The size of the beach covered the entire district.
If one were to stand below the district and look up, they would find the sky seemingly darkened instantly, and above their heads, a platform had appeared out of nowhere, blocking all sight.
This prop’s effect was completely off the panel.
At that moment, Chen Yi saw a system notification pop up.
“Ding, player Chen Yi has left the Bikini Beach Chair, and ‘Absolute Defense’ has been automatically revoked.”
“When player Chen Yi lies on the Bikini Beach Chair, a vacation environment will automatically be activated without any fees.”
“When player Chen Yi leaves the Bikini Beach Chair, the vacation environment will default to being active, deducting 1000 Points per hour. If less than an hour is spent, charges will still apply as if for a full hour. Player Chen Yi is free to choose whether to keep the vacation environment active upon leaving the Bikini Beach Chair.”
“PS1: The vacation environment is fully physical. To add special entertainment facilities, an additional fee is required.”
“Awesome!”
At that moment, Chen Yi heard Tuberculosis Rabbit exclaim excitedly!
Tuberculosis Rabbit took off his shirt, dove into the sea, and then resurfaced, wiping the water from his face as he looked back at Chen Yi on the shore and excitedly said, “Yi, this sea has boundaries. There’s an air wall, so there’s no need to worry about falling off when swimming.”
“And the water isn’t saltwater; it’s freshwater, not salty at all—it’s sweet.”
“The water is crystal clear.”
“There are even many rare plants and fish that you can see underwater. This prop is amazing.”
After a while…
Having familiarized himself with almost the entire vacation environment, Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a towel slung over his shoulder, walked over to Chen Yi, who was lying on the beach chair. Without any hesitation, he lay down on the sandy ground beside him.
His body formed a “big” character.
After a deep breath, he then said with a contemplative look, “This is a good prop indeed. Just like its description, it indeed offers a perfect holiday.”
“Before this, I always thought the main effect of this prop was ‘Absolute Defense,’ but now it seems ‘Absolute Defense’ is just an additional feature, or perhaps an afterthought.”
“Because look, Yi, the main attributes of this prop are all about vacationing. Whether it has ‘Absolute Defense’ or not doesn’t make much of a difference.”
“Let me make a bold speculation.”
“If our props are all designed by a specific designer, then this designer’s original intent for this prop was to create something specially for vacations. But for some reason, he didn’t want this prop to be too low-level or too common.”
“So he added the ‘Absolute Defense’ feature, instantly elevating this prop to an A-Level status.”
“And so we have this product.”
“Of course, this is just a guess, with no basis.”

chapters.title: Chapter 280: 259: With the Pain of My Own, I Grant You Invincibility in the World.
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 259: With the Pain of My Own, I Grant You Invincibility in the World.
“Right!”
Before Chen Yi could respond, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly had an idea, jumped up on the spot, and looked toward the bikini-clad beauties playing beach volleyball not far away with a trace of curiosity in his eyes. He got up and trotted over to them.
He had been studying the marvels of this beach and the water just moments ago.
An aerial platform.
He had forgotten about these bikini-clad beauties who were laughing and frolicking.
What kind of beings were these?
Players from other planets? Employees of the Snow Sea Project Team? Or NPCs?
Soon.
Tuberculosis Rabbit ran up to a bikini girl who was lying on a beach chair, applying body lotion to herself, and coughed lightly like a gentleman before he said, “Excuse me for interrupting, but I want to ask…”
His voice abruptly stopped.
Because Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly remembered something—that girl seemed to have been applying body lotion since the holiday environment had first appeared, right? Had it not already been half an hour?
Still applying?
Having realized this, Tuberculosis Rabbit took another careful look at the bikini beauties on the beach and, after observing them for a while, noticed that although their laughter was sweet and they were frolicking boisterously, they were all repeating the same motions.
Like low-intelligence… NPCs.
The once sweet laughter suddenly sounded a bit creepy.
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit fell silent for a moment before reaching out and waving his hand in front of the bikini girl lying on the chair. As expected, she had no reaction; so he snatched the body lotion from her hands again.
The heist was successful.
He now had a bottle of body lotion in hand.
But the next second, a new bottle of body lotion appeared in the girl’s hands.
“…”
He continued snatching.
In a short while, he had already accumulated more than ten bottles of body lotion.
And the bikini girl on the beach chair still had a new bottle of body lotion, as if nothing had happened, as if she hadn’t seen Tuberculosis Rabbit at all, continuing to apply it to her body.
Despite applying for a long time.
Her skin didn’t look greasy at all but instead seemed refreshingly clean.
“This NPC’s intelligence is just too low.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s mouth twitched slightly, a sign of his helplessness. It had been a long time since he had seen such low-intelligence NPCs, but the next second, his expression turned strange.
It’s just an NPC, so a little pinch is okay, right?
A pinch.
Hehe.
Soft.
Another pinch, hehe, still soft.
What if he reached further in?
Realizing that no matter what he did, this NPC had absolutely no reaction, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s expression grew increasingly more peculiar, and his actions became bolder and more reckless.
It must be said.
This feeling was more thrilling than that of a real person, a sort of… indescribable sensation.
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to take further action, Chen Yi’s voice came to his ears.
“Stop fucking pinching, I don’t have enough Points to cover your crap!”
“Uh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had thought that Yi hadn’t noticed what he was up to, withdrew his hand somewhat sheepishly and quickly ran up to Chen Yi, looking slightly embarrassed and confused. “Yi, what did you mean just now about not having enough Points? Does pinching cost money too?”
“Yeah.”
Chen Yi nodded expressionlessly and paused before saying, “Did you just snatch thirteen bottles of body lotion from her?”
“Uh… seems like it. Does that cost money too?”
“A hundred Points per bottle, that’s 1300 Points in total, touching costs 200 Points per touch, you spent 800 Points.”
“That’s 2100 Points in total from me.”
“We might be quite well-off now and not short on Points, but even so, we can’t afford you blowing them all like this, right?”
In the system notification there was a line.
‘PS1: The vacation environment is entirely physical, and extra fees are required for special entertainment facilities.’
Indeed.
The two things he did earlier are considered special entertainment facilities that require extra payment.
Beyond that, he had examined a bit earlier, and there were many places to spend money.
As small as—
‘Purchase a designated personality for an NPC, equipped with high-level AI, available personalities include: cool girl style, Arrogant Style, Wayward Style, Cute Style… one-time cost of 5000 Points, permanent existence.’
‘NPCs can be killed, buying a new NPC, with specified gender and age, costs 1000 Points each.’
‘Customize an NPC with high freedom in face molding, free design costs 3000 Points per NPC, new NPCs come with low AI.’
‘Add a cola and Sprite soda machine, costing 1000 Points.’
‘Add an onion barbecue tower, costing 500 Points.’
‘Add…’
With four or five hundred options, he had looked for ages and hadn’t seen them all. Among them were many oddly-shaped decorations and structures.
Like that onion barbecue tower for 500 Points each.
It was roughly a huge chunk of lamb kebab, wrapped in onions, standing three meters tall, able to be placed on the beach.
Uneatable.
Serving only as a decoration.
There were quite a few of these uniquely shaped decoration structures.
But he simply couldn’t understand who would spend Points on such useless things.
This is still one of the smaller things.
As for some of the bigger ones, there were even more.
“Can add floating function, priced at 5000 Points.”
“Can add a power system, priced at 5000 Points.”
“Can upgrade the power system, 5000 Points per upgrade.”
“Can activate extravagant fireworks, 10000 Points per launch.”
“Can…”
A mess of things, countless!
The beach they were standing on was floating above the neighborhood as well, but that was because they activated the beach chairs on the rooftop, making the focus point the neighborhood rooftop, without the ability to float, just resting on the rooftop.
But if they bought that floating function—
even if they activated the beach chairs on flat ground, they could still make the beach vacation environment float mid-air, a feature of dubious utility but seemingly somewhat useful.
If they added a power system too, it would become a complete means of transportation.
No, to be precise, a movable large-scale battle platform.
There was a lot that could be added.
But they could not add any weapon systems, supposedly because the prop was designed with vacationing in mind, and the paid features added were meant to enhance the vacation experience. Adding weapon systems would be a departure from its intended use.
“This…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit spent a full 30 minutes to look through all the available pay-to-use options, feeling dizzy and confused, “Why does everything seem to cost money?”
“We’ll talk about it when we get back.”
Chen Yi stood up and walked to the edge of the beach, looked down at the ground, and without hesitation, calmly took a step forward.
He fell freely from the rooftop until he plummeted to the ground.
“Now set to forcefully enforce: falling from a height of 18 meters or above will definitely result in death.”
This rule had been in place for a long time.
The distance from the rooftop to the ground had long exceeded 18 meters. Hanging down from there, no matter how many props he had, it guaranteed death.
Unless he jumped down with the beach chair strapped to his backside—he should be fine then.
Time to pick up Jiaye from hell.
He had never experienced this way of dying; now with the opportunity, he wanted to experience what jumping off a building felt like.
But at the moment of impact, Chen Yi suddenly regretted it.
Jumping off a building hurt too much.
…
Very soon.
Jiaye was brought back, with Sword Without End trailing behind. Sword Without End had to return from the comeback map, so naturally, he wasn’t as quick as the others.
“What’s this…?”
Tie Chui, who had just returned, looked at Tie Chui grilling tendons on the beach, and somewhat confusedly said, “Wasn’t this a rooftop before? Where did this beach come from?”
“It’s a long story, let’s just say it’s the effect of an A-level prop, prepared for vacationing.”
“Alright.”
Chen Yi patted Jiaye’s shoulder, “You’ve worked hard these past few days, and it’s been tough on you, too. This place is perfect for a vacation, so rest for a few days.”
“I’ll take you to see the Northern Lights in the Arctic in a few days.”
“Northern Lights in the Arctic?”
A spark of excitement suddenly flashed in Jiaye’s eyes.
“Yeah, the Northern Lights aren’t always there when you want them. Let’s go have a look first, see how our luck turns out. There’s a chance to see them this season.”
Chen Yi paused and then turned his head towards the little reindeer curled up in a ball and sleeping not far away, lost in thought as he spoke, “And along the way, we can check out that neutral boss Santa Claus in December. It won’t be long now.”
That neutral boss Santa Claus from December had chased him all around Blue Star!
For a full 24 hours!
And to him at that time, this boss was an invincible entity, regenerating a hundred percent of its maximum health value every second. Unless it was an instant kill, it posed no threat whatsoever.
It was quite an embarrassment for him back then.
As for now.
Showing its face would mean certain death, and naturally, it wouldn’t be him dying.
Whether to settle that old score or not would depend on how alert Santa Claus was at the time.
…
“This feels great.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit lies lethargically on top of the bikini-clad girl reclining on the beach chair, resting his head between her peaks, feeling the softness as he lit a cigarette and brought it to his lips, enjoying this moment of pleasure.
Nice.
It’s indeed a fine prop for vacation.
Enabling a high-level AI for an NPC would cost just 5000 Points, and neither he nor Yi were short on Points, but they still didn’t spend them.
Because he had suddenly realized that NPCs with low-level AI were a bit more interesting, giving a sense of complete control—in other words, you could disregard the NPC’s personhood, like now, where he could just use the NPC as a cushion.
Extremely soft.
The NPC wouldn’t resist, nor show any reaction.
But with a high-level AI, there would be lots of issues.
Comparatively, low-level AI was better, perfect in every way except for being unable to take pants off. To do that, a high-level AI was necessary.
It wasn’t long before Sword Without End also returned.
The usual routine.
Time for a barbecue party.
Chen Yi, sparing no expense, purchased an iced draft beer dispenser, with five people gathered around the barbecue grill, alternately eating meat and drinking beer—it was exceptionally lively.
Although Chen Yi was the only one who had gone out to fight this time, the other four seemed to do nothing, but in fact, they were contributing their strength silently from behind the scenes.
Like Jiaye, who provided Chen Yi with his greatest fighting strength.
Through your pain, I grant you invincibility in this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 281: 260: Mainly Psychological Exhaustion.
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 260: Mainly Psychological Exhaustion.
Sword Without End was in hell to protect Jiaye from any mishaps, for if Jiaye ran into trouble in hell, he wouldn’t be able to resurrect, meaning permanent death.
This was Chen Yi’s greatest worry.
The reason he liked Jiaye and could still bring himself to attack him was largely because he knew that even if one fell into hell, they could still come back up, and it wasn’t a true death.
But if one were to die again in hell, there would really be no future at all.
Therefore, he was always concerned about Jiaye encountering any trouble in hell, with some sightless thing annoying or provoking him, which is why he always asked Sword Without End to accompany him. With Sword Without End’s strength, he couldn’t exactly strut around in hell,
but protecting Jiaye from harm was absolutely no problem.
It might seem like Sword Without End wasn’t very strong in their team, everyone could rebuke him a couple of times, and he had an exceptionally good temper, appearing to be an old softie.
But in the world boss event at that time,
all the last layer of players dealt single or double-digit damage, and even the strongest among them just hit the triple-digits, while Sword Without End dealt nearly five-digit damage in one strike, shocking everyone present!
Of course, Chen Yi had dealt a million damage in that battle, but that’s a story for another time.
From this, it was evident that Sword Without End’s actual strength was not weak at all, it was just that he didn’t have many opportunities to make a move normally.
He also collected quite a few globally unique character actions.
These actions could be transformed into real damage attacks in Sword Without End’s hands, considered a stack of trump cards.
Although Sword Without End didn’t take direct action, he played a significant role behind the scenes.
And then there was Tuberculosis Rabbit… and Tie Chui, who neither took any action nor played much of a role, but having someone to welcome them upon their return was an important task right after coming back… probably.
“Anyway, everyone’s been working hard recently, cheers!”
Chen Yi stopped his jumbled thoughts, raised his glass and looked at everyone. He clinked his glass forcefully with the others, and beer foam joyously splashed everywhere.
…
The night passed quickly.
Chen Yi and the others returned to their rooms slightly tipsy to wash up and sleep.
Recently, Jiaye has been sleeping in a room by himself next to Chen Yi, while Chen Yi still shared a room with Tuberculosis Rabbit.
He had already begun thinking about moving to a new house. Continuing to live here wasn’t a great choice. Before, he didn’t have the conditions to move, but now that he had them, there was no need to keep putting himself through this discomfort. He was used to it, no problem.
But it did seem somewhat unclean for Jiaye to live in such an environment with him.
If they were to move to a villa in the suburbs, to be honest, he really wasn’t quite used to that idea. Later, he simply decided to move the palace onto the rooftop.
After the title Annihilate Nine Clans was upgraded to Annihilate Entire Clans,
his Crimson Chair’s effect was changed to the Crimson Palace.
The area was spacious enough, and there were many bedrooms, enough for all of them to sleep. And he could also have his own room with Jiaye. Hmm… falling asleep holding Jiaye felt softer, and without Tuberculosis Rabbit’s sleep talking, it was simply comfortable and quiet.
A somewhat dizzy Chen Yi washed up hastily and fell into a deep sleep, exhausted.
He had indeed felt quite fatigued these past few days.
Mostly, it was psychological fatigue.
…
August 20th.
The next morning, Chen Yi, who awoke and sat on a beach chair on the rooftop, shared a Prop panel with Jiaye next to him and raised an eyebrow, “Want to go in and give it a try?”
At the moment, it was just the two of them on the rooftop.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others were still deep in sleep, as they drank quite a bit last night. He and Jiaye drank less, so they woke up earlier.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End were hard at it later, neither willing to concede to the other as they drank ferociously.
“Cowherd and Weaver Girl?”
Jiaye looked thoughtfully at the Prop panel in front of him and after a long while said, “Yi, do you want to use this Prop for the high rewards? But nobody knows how vast the cities mentioned in this Prop are.”
“In a city, the chance for two strangers to meet is slim, let alone to fall in love,” he said.
“Should we do some preparation before entering the map?”
“Like tattooing key information on our arms, or using Memory Paper to record it?”
“Otherwise, it seems a bit too difficult.”
“Feasible.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Yi took out two pieces of Memory Paper from his bosom, wrote on them for a while, then put one piece into his mouth and handed the other to Jiaye.
“Then let’s go in.”
“Alright.”
Jiaye nodded, feeling somewhat unsure.
Their voices faded.
Chen Yi and Jiaye vanished from the spot in an instant.
…
“Still shutting yourself in at home?”
“It’s just one entrepreneurial failure. Why are you acting like you can’t go on living, so lifeless? If you’re short of money, just say it. I don’t have much, but I can get you tens of thousands to help you make a comeback. Consider it an early investment.”
A nagging voice arose beside Chen Yi’s ear.
“Ah?”
Chen Yi glanced around in a daze, saw the light from the cellphone on the desk, and realized the voice had come from the phone. He said reflexively, “Oh, I know, I’ve got some things to deal with, I’ll hang up now.”
This young man was his good buddy.
He didn’t know why, but he had just zoned out.
It felt like he had been in a long dream and had suddenly awakened, his head somewhat dizzy.
‘August 20th.’
After a while,
Chen Yi silently looked at the calendar on the desk, sitting in the dim room, placing the almost burnt-out cigarette into the ashtray filled with butts. The air inside was extremely pungent, and the trash can was overflowing.
No light was turned on in the room.
It appeared extremely dim.
He was an entrepreneur, or more accurately, a failed entrepreneur.
He had achieved a bit during the startup phase, earning a net profit of more than 30,000 in the first few months. Before starting the business, his salary was about 6,000, so this was quite a qualitative improvement.
But in the fourth month, everything began to go downhill.
Not a slow decline, but a precipitous drop.
A cliff-like plummet.
A startup has no capacity to withstand risks. All the funds for the month were tied up in the advertising budget; when there were no returns for the month, the cash flow broke, and throwing in tens of thousands in loans was futile.
The end result was bankruptcy and a debt of tens of thousands.
He locked himself in the room alone, reflecting on his mistakes. The reason for not turning on the light was simply because he couldn’t afford the electricity bill.
Property management fees, electricity bills, water bills, he couldn’t pay any of them.
The property management would knock on his door daily to collect debts, and every time he would stay silent as if no one was home, narrowly avoiding them.
“Huh!”
Chen Yi exhaled deeply, lit another cigarette, and sat at the desk in the dim room, looking at the laptop screen in silence without speaking.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: 261: "Jiaye is gone too, where did these two run off to early in the morning?
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 261: “Jiaye is gone too, where did these two run off to early in the morning?
“Ding-a-ling-a-ling!!!”
The piercing ringtone suddenly erupted in the dim room.
Chen Yi, who was zoning out, looked at the incessant flashing incoming call alert on his phone screen; there was no contact name, just an out-of-town number.
After a long silence, he eventually decided to answer the call.
“Hello?”
“Good day, Mr. Chen Yi, it seems that the 30,000 yuan you borrowed from PaiPai Loan has been overdue for seven days now. Our colleagues have already made several calls to you. Will you be able to repay it by six o’clock this evening?”
“Today is the last day; if you don’t repay today, I don’t need to tell you about the implications for your credit score.”
“For the first installment you only need to repay 2,000 yuan; can’t you, a grown man, afford even 2,000 yuan?”
“I will try my best.”
“Don’t talk to me about trying your best. It’s you who owes money, not us who owe you. I…”
Before the voice could finish,
Chen Yi ended the call and switched his phone to silent mode.
The other side was pressing hard; just today, he had already received seven or eight calls.
To owe a debt and repay it is only right and proper.
The problem was he had no money at all, not a dime.
“…”
After a long silence, Chen Yi walked out of the room, holding his phone and the data cable, heading downstairs; if he didn’t go down now, the convenience store would close.
…
Chen Yi, holding his mobile phone, laptop, and data cable, arrived at a convenience store. After giving the cashier a few smiles, he brazenly sat down on the store’s chairs, plugged the data cable in, and started charging his phone and computer.
Stealing electricity.
Such behavior wasn’t generally well-received.
But perhaps this cashier had faced hard times too and had quietly told him that as long as they were on shift, he could charge his devices at no cost, but this wouldn’t fly with other staff members.
A good person.
A bit of kindness encountered in desperate times is always remembered for a long time.
Just as he was grateful to this cashier from the bottom of his heart and wanted to give something back, yet he had nothing but empty pockets, he could only offer more smiles to express his thanks.
It seems that for the poor, a smile is the only way to show gratitude.
A man who constantly wears a smile may not necessarily be kind-hearted; he might also be penniless, putting up a smiling face before everyone as if that could hide his inferiority in his pocket.
About an hour later,
Chen Yi stood up, thanked the cashier, then left the convenience store to return to his now power-cut, eerily empty home.
The phone could run out of battery, but the laptop must stay charged.
After his entrepreneurial failure, he lost all sources of income and had many debts to pay. Getting a job wouldn’t suffice; wages were withheld, and he couldn’t wait the nearly one and a half months it would take.
Moreover, the salary would be too low for his capabilities and wouldn’t cover the loans.
So after pondering for a few days, he came up with a new plan: writing novels.
An industry with zero costs but an extremely high mortality rate.
One thousand novelists write, nine hundred and ninety-nine starve to death, and the last one can barely afford some meat.
But he still joined the industry.
Just like when he started a business, he never cared about how high the mortality rate was; he only cared if the returns met his expectations.
Like every man who believes he’ll be the knight who braves the thorns to rescue the princess, he never believed he would fall by the wayside. No matter how high the mortality rate, he would survive.
Confidence is a man’s last dignity.
Maybe luck finally chose to shine on him this time.
On the seventh day after publishing his book, he started earning over 100 yuan a day.
Chen Yi sat in the dim room, scooped a handful of dog food from the bowl and shoved it into his mouth, then leaned over the tap to drink a few gulps of water before patting his loyal dog and murmuring to the computer screen in front of him,
“I’m not trying to compete with you for food; it’s just that the finances have been really tight lately, and I’m getting anxiously hungry.”
“Once I get paid next month, I’ll treat you to a nice meal.”
Earnings were good for each day now, but he wouldn’t be paid until the 15th of next month; over twenty days away. For that period, he still had to persevere.
Next month, if he could get paid 2,000 yuan, he could pay off one installment of his loan and then buy some dry food to last him another month or so.
It’s alright.
Things were moving in the right direction.
…
“Hello.”
A girl walked into the convenience store she had just left a moment ago, looked at the cashier and started speaking with deliberate calmness, “The man who just left seemed pretty familiar to you, do you know him?”
“What about him?”
The cashier glanced up at the girl in front of him and said nonchalantly, “Can’t say I know him. A man who’s been down and out lately; doesn’t even know his name. Comes around this time every day to charge his phone.”
“But I can’t tell if it’s just my imagination—even though the man looks very down and out, can’t even take a dime out of his pocket—”
“I always feel like he could get back on his feet.”
“Do you know why?”
The cashier suddenly grinned like a fortune-teller and said with enthusiasm, “This man, despite his downfall, his clothes not so clean, there’s a sharpness in his eyes. How to put it, there’s this defiant energy in them.”
“He has a straight back.”
“A man who can’t be brought down is quite frightening.”
“Probably going through hard times recently. We’re all workers here, life’s not easy, so if you can lend a hand, why not? Besides, the electric bill is paid by the boss, right?”
“Oh, I see.”
The girl nodded thoughtfully, then hesitated slightly, biting her lip, “I’ll leave my phone number with you. Next time he comes, could you ask him to add me on WeChat?”
“Sure.”
The cashier confidently slapped his chest, promising, “But he comes down every day at this time. If you want to find him, why not wait here for him tomorrow?”
“I’m only here on a business trip today, won’t be around tomorrow.”
“Ah, I see.”
The cashier nodded and tucked the slip of paper with the phone number into a drawer, “I’ve got it, don’t worry. But, I feel obliged to remind you of something. If you’ve taken a liking to this man, now clearly isn’t the best time.”
“A down-and-out man is like a completely vigilant hedgehog.”
“Any kind of affection from the opposite sex will be perceived as a challenge and disdain.”
“What do you mean?”
“Just what it sounds like. Alright, what did you say your name was? I’ll make a note.”
“Jiaye.”
“Alright, rest assured, I’ll definitely hand the note to him personally tomorrow.”
…
The next day.
Chen Yi slept in until late afternoon, got up, cleaned up briefly, then sat on the bed, zoning out.
After a while, he prepared to go down to the convenience store to charge his phone as usual.
“…”
Upon seeing that the cashier had been replaced, Chen Yi was a bit stunned and hesitated before asking, “Excuse me, shouldn’t it be that chubby cashier on duty now?”
“You mean Old Li? Old Li has been fired.”
“Why?”
“Because he let you charge your phone for free every day, and the boss was furious.”
…
Meanwhile.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others had just gotten up and, while yawning, walked up to the rooftop. They rubbed their sleepy eyes and looked around.
“Hey, where’s Yi?”
“Jiaye is gone too; where did these two run off to so early in the morning?”
“Did they leave us behind and go down to the map by themselves?”
The next second—
Chen Yi and Jiaye appeared on the rooftop at the same time.
Jiaye with tears streaming down her face, rushed into Chen Yi’s arms as soon as she saw him. She sobbed uncontrollably, her arms tightly wrapping around Chen Yi’s waist.
Chen Yi’s eyes were also red-rimmed, and he kept his lips tightly sealed as he hugged Jiaye, gently patting her back as if to comfort her.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had just lit a cigarette to wake himself up, saw this, and turning to Sword Without End next to him, he swallowed nervously and asked in a quivering voice, “Yi’s eyes are red?”
“I’ve been with Yi for many years, this is the first time I’ve seen his eyes go red.”
“Even when Yi confirmed that his parents were not coming to pick him up, his eyes didn’t go red. He just sat alone on the wall all night and afterward, he never went back to the wall again.”
“Now…?”
He actually wanted to ask Jiaye, what exactly did you do to Yi down in the map, to get such a tough guy to have his eyes go red?

chapters.title: Chapter 283: 262: The 178th Universe Reboot Vote
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Chapter 262: The 178th Universe Reboot Vote
“Jiaye…”
Chen Yi, still not recovered from his emotions, hugged Jiaye tightly as if he feared she might vanish into thin air the next second. It was the first time that Chen Yi’s emotions had been so visibly apparent.
Before this.
His emotions usually remained hidden.
Or rather, his heart rarely experienced any turmoil.
“That…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a bizarre expression, leaned in and asked bewilderedly, “Yi, what did you guys do? Why is Jiaye crying buckets this early in the morning?”
“Come back!”
Sword Without End, his face expressionless, pulled Tuberculosis Rabbit back, “Don’t stand out here and be an eyesore. Go downstairs, and leave the place to Yi and the others.”
“Phew!”
Chen Yi took a deep breath, patted Jiaye on the shoulder, then turned to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit. He sat down on a nearby chair with Jiaye’s left hand in his, and spoke softly, “We just activated a prop.”
“It’s the Grade-A prop ‘Cowherd and Weaver Girl’ that you saw, Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
“Activating this prop causes amnesia and entry into an unfamiliar world. Jiaye also entered this world, and if we fell in love while amnesiac, we would receive a large reward.”
“If there was no love, then there was no reward.”
“Upon entering this world, my identity was that of a young man in his early twenties who had just failed at starting a business. Actually, before entering the map I had made preparations, such as consuming the Memory Paper.”
“But upon entering this strange world, I was in a state of complete amnesia. This rule had a higher priority than the Memory Paper; even having consumed the Memory Paper, I had no memory of reality, only the character background given by the map.”
“The first time Jiaye and I met in the map was after I left a convenience store. Jiaye handed her phone number to the store clerk and asked them to make sure it was passed on to me.”
“But the next day, due to some accidental factors, the clerk was fired, and the note never reached my hands.”
“They only told me that after I left the day before, a girl had come to leave contact information, but that the note was lost.”
“The second encounter was half a year later. I had restarted a business and succeeded. I saw a woman’s figure in a coffee shop and was so heart-stirred that I followed her, and that woman was Jiaye.”
“But the crowd was too dense.”
“I chased for nearly ten minutes, but still lost her in the throng of people.”
“Looking back now, I don’t know why I chased after her at the time. I just had a nameless premonition in my heart telling me that this girl might be my most suitable partner, which led me to chase after her as if possessed.”
“This was completely out of character for me.”
“The third time we met was when I was boarding a subway car, and I suddenly saw Jiaye outside the car. I was so excited that I wanted to get off immediately, but the train doors had slowly closed, preventing my departure, so I could only wave through the window.”
“And at that moment, I noticed Jiaye outside seemed excitedly waving back at me.”
“I got off at the next station and returned, but Jiaye was no longer there.”
At that moment, Jiaye, leaning on Chen Yi’s shoulder, murmured, “I went to the next station looking for you. I guessed you might get off at the next station to wait for me.”
“But I couldn’t find you after searching for half an hour at the station where you got on, so I guessed you might have gone to the next one, and I went there to look for you.”
“I couldn’t find you at the next station after searching for half an hour, Yi, so I went back to where you got on and waited there.”
“…”
Chen Yi sighed helplessly, then continued looking at Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Anyway, after that, my business got better and better, with my annual income soaring to hundreds of millions. And just when the company was about to go public, I saw Jiaye again.”
“Of course, I missed her again.”
“That was our thirty-seventh missed connection.”
“I don’t know who wrote this script, having the male and female lead miss each other thirty-seven times. Even the most patient female TV viewers would curse at this scenario. And during this time, my business continued to improve, and many high-quality girls began to pursue me.”
“Daughters of scholarly families, innocent backgrounds, delicate and charming, fair-skinned and beautiful.”
“All were actively pursuing me.”
“I turned them all down.”
“Meanwhile, Jiaye’s career was also on the rise. She took over a company called Jiaye’s Marriage Proposal Planning Company, which specialized in serving men and women looking to propose—a very romantic industry.”
“We lived in that map for a full seventy to eighty years.”
“In those seventy to eighty years, we missed each other a total of one hundred and ninety-eight times.”
“Each time, it was due to various reasons.”
“And until the end of our lives, I never married, and Jiaye never wed.”
“It was finally as we were about to die of old age that we met, fell in love smoothly, and kissed to celebrate the regrets of those seventy to eighty years and the grace that heaven granted us to finally be together. After that, we died of old age and returned.”
“That’s the entire story of the map.”
“…”
Nodding with deep understanding, Tuberculosis Rabbit stuffed a chip into his mouth and said thoughtfully, “Marvelous, it’s a pity you skipped too much of the story, Yi. For instance, I really want to know the reasons behind those 198 missed connections.”
“There were so many chances to meet, but to miss each one is just too bizarre, right?”
“It is a bit bizarre.”
At this point, Chen Yi couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth slightly, “In the map, because I accepted the world background, I didn’t find it strange, but after returning and recalling everything again, I realized it was too bizarre to be more bizarre.”
“It was only after returning that I realized the true difficulty of the map wasn’t just falling in love with each other in a strange world.”
“But that the map prevents the two from ever truly being together. However, in the process, countless other better suitors of the opposite sex will emerge. Only by rejecting all of them and maintaining love and anticipation for the other person until the moment before dying of old age do you really clear the entire map.”
“So this map has been preventing Jiaye and me from really meeting and falling in love, and it continuously provided all sorts of high-quality suitors for both of us.”
“At first, the ways the map prevented our meeting were relatively normal.”
“Such as disappearing into the crowd, being separated by the subway, or having to deal immediately with customers who suddenly become difficult over the phone.”
“But perhaps the number of interventions became too numerous, they ran out of normal methods, and the means they used became increasingly bizarre.”
“I remember the 129th time I failed to meet Jiaye, just as I was about to catch up with him, a laser beam shot from outer space melted hundreds of people between us. The news reported an alien invasion.”
“The 138th time, a tsunami erupted, a wave that spanned millions of kilometers and reached inland cities.”
“The 145th time, it was an earthquake, with a very small impact area, about the ten or so meters just between Jiaye and me.”
“The 158th time, I was hit by a Two-way Foil, and the attack’s range was also very small, right in those few meters between Jiaye and me.”
“The 178th time, the universe initiated a restart vote, and every resident had to return home to vote on whether to deny the universe’s restart.”
“The 192nd time…”
“In any case, with such inconceivable obstruction, Jiaye and I missed each other 198 times. On the 199th attempt, we finally met and cleared the level, returning.”
Engrossed in listening, Sword Without End unintentionally wiped away non-existent tears from the corner of his eyes and, with a sobbing tone, said, “That’s brilliant, Yi. It’s got me, a Pure Love Warrior, completely hooked.”
“If my wife was still alive, she and I would definitely make it through this map just like you did, Yi, overcoming all the hardships to end up together.”
“Such a love story is so tear-jerking.”
“Just a friendly reminder, this is an A-level Prop, and it’s highly unlikely that you will possess it.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit added somewhat inappropriately from the side.
After another careful inspection of his surroundings, Chen Yi took a deep breath, having reorganized his memory, activated the Bikini Beach Chair Prop, and lay down on it, lighting a cigarette and drawing it to his mouth.
So tired.
Although to Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others, he had disappeared for only a few seconds.
Less than the time it takes to urinate.
But from his perspective, he had lived another seventy or eighty years in a strange world.
A completely different world, entirely different life experiences.
Even longer than the time he had lived in the real world.
But perhaps the Prop “Cowherd and Weaver Girl” had already anticipated this because as he returned, the deep memories of resting for seventy or eighty years quickly became illusory. While these memories weren’t lost, they lost much of their realness.
The memories of the real world began to take the dominant position.
This prevented him from confusing his identity between illusion and reality.
Still, it left a sense of being in a daze.
Only then did he think to look at the panel that had popped up in front of him for a while. A panel had appeared as soon as he returned, but he hadn’t looked at it then, still not reacting from the return.
‘Map Name’: Cowherd and Weaver Girl.
‘Map Level’: None, derived from the A-level Prop ‘Cowherd and Weaver Girl’.
‘Map Evaluation’: You’ve experienced lows and visited the world’s peak. You’ve looked up at the world’s splendor from the gutter and have also gazed down with pity and mercy from the summit.
Surrounded by countless high-quality women expressing love to you, you rejected all of them without exception, without a single heartbeat.
Always waiting for that woman.
What touched you could be many things, perhaps it was the slight shock when you first found out a girl left you her contact information, feeling surprised that someone should care about such a destitute self.
Or maybe it was when you were extremely destitute, dressed in filthy clothes, squatting on the street corner eating a bun, and suddenly saw her in a business suit passing by. You hurriedly looked down, afraid of being recognized. When she passed by, you knew she recognized you, but she didn’t stop.
You thought she despised your destitution.
But the next time you met, and she showed her excitement again, you realized she hadn’t stopped to protect your dignity, understanding that a man wouldn’t want to be chatted up in such destitute circumstances.
Or maybe it was for other reasons.
In any case, congratulations, you’ve successfully cleared the map!
You faced countless temptations and obstacles, even if the Celestial Immortal Formation was placed before you, it couldn’t make your heart waver. You are soft, yet on matters of pure love, you are firm.
Eventually, you didn’t get lost in the map or the temptations. At the end of your life, you waited for the one you had been searching for all your life.
‘Map Reward’: …

chapters.title: Chapter 284: 263: The Only Prop in the World, It Can't Just Break Like This, Can It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 263: The Only Prop in the World, It Can’t Just Break Like This, Can It?
“Map Reward”: Black Title-“Seeker of the Good in Life”, A-grade limited prop “Galaxy Traction”.
“Map Epilogue”: Upon wearing this title, you will gain great strength and pay a certain price, but after that, you will no longer be an ordinary person.
“Hmm?”
After reading all the map evaluations, Chen Yi raised his eyebrows slightly in surprise.
He remembered that when he first obtained this A-grade prop “Cowherd and Weaver Girl”, he even complained, “What kind of junk prop is this? It’s not even a prop, it’s basically a map access pass.”
An A-grade prop in name only.
But now it seemed that the map brought by this prop, once cleared, came with no small reward.
A black title.
Black titles are considered to be among the highest echelon in the rank of titles within the game.
The title level hierarchy is as follows—”white, green, blue, yellow, purple, red, black, rainbow.”
The top rank is rainbow, followed by black.
His title “Violators Will Have Their Entire Clan Annihilated” is just black level as well, and he doesn’t have a rainbow level title either; the highest one he has is black.
Of course, he also has a Starry Level title “One Man Exterminates a Clan”, but he does not count that one.
On Blue Star, the highest title level a normal player can achieve is rainbow, which is already the limit.
“Starry” level titles are basically unattainable because these titles are not produced on the Novice Planet; they are only produced within the star system and even there, they are among those extremely high ranking titles.
Official players of the No. 3 star system only have a chance to obtain them, but the probability is extremely low. For novice players like them, theoretically, there is a 99.999999% chance they cannot obtain it.
Of course.
As probability theory goes, even if there is a 0.00000001% chance, in the vastness of this universe, it is almost a certainty to occur.
This minuscule probability happened to Chen Yi.
This pure exception.
It’s a behavior that other players can’t replicate.
And the effect of this black title is very strong.
“Title Name”: Seeker of the Good in Life.
“Title Level”: Black.
“Title Effect”: After wearing this title, you will under no circumstances lose your memory of your beloved Jiaye.
And no matter where Jiaye is, you will accurately obtain their real-time location and physical condition, and you can communicate in real time without any distance restriction.
However, from then on, when facing any other person of the opposite sex, your heart will remain undisturbed, and you will feel nothing.
The priority level of this title’s rules is B.98.
“Title Introduction”: “Pure Love Warriors, stand up! Cuckolds and perverts, die!”
“Priority level B.98?”
Chen Yi looked at the title effect with some confusion; he had obtained many titles, but this was the first time he saw such a note. As he pondered, suddenly, a system notification sounded in his ear.
“Ding, a system update announcement.”
“During the novice period, the rules regarding player titles, levels, skills, and such have never clearly indicated priority levels, as this has been the rule for the novice period all along.”
“This rule is intended to lower the entry barrier to the player experience during the novice period.”
“However, recently some players have reported bugs such as being discovered despite having Absolute Invisibility, so we have decided to bring the priority rules from the dark to the light, so that all players are aware.”
“All rules associated with black-level titles, B-rank props, and B-rank maps are B-level rules.”
“All rules associated with purple-level titles, D-rank props, and D-rank props are D-level rules.”
“In the case of lower rule priority, it’s normal for effects to be nullified, so players no longer need to report such incidents.”
“For example, if player Zhang San has a B-rank prop that makes him invisible to everyone, but Li Si has an A-rank prop that can see through all forms of invisibility, then Zhang San would have no trace to follow in front of Li Si.”
“If both Zhang San and Li Si have B-rank props, then their priority levels will determine the outcome.”
“For example, the priority level of Zhang San’s B-rank prop is B.46.”
“While the priority level of Li Si’s B-rank prop is B.56.”
“Therefore, the rule priority level of Li Si’s prop is higher.”
“If both parties have equal props and the priority points are the same, then it’s determined by who goes first, with the player going first having the higher priority,”
“The priority levels under the same rules are as follows—”
“The priority of version updates and monthly update rules is the highest, and except for special map rules not taking effect, they generally supersede all other rules.”
“The effects of titles, props, and skills follow next.”
“Map rules come last.”
“Some bosses come with rules that have variable priority tiers, but their priorities are generally lower than those of version updates and monthly updates.”
It sounded rather complicated.
But it was quite easy to understand.
This was why, in the twofold trial map of Solar Star, Chen Yi had used a D-level skill, “Mirror Man,” and should have been hiding in the Mirror World, undiscoverable, but was still rooted out by a Solar Star player with a prop.
It must have been because the priority level of that prop was too low.
Still, in the end, he was able to reactivate the skill and hide again.
This was thanks to his ability to release skills without limit; even if he got pulled out, it didn’t matter, he could just hide again. After all, his main goal was merely to buy some time.
But if his skill were S-level,
he would not have been dragged out so easily unless there was an S-level detection prop to catch him.
Under the same broad rule level,
the priority of a prop is higher than that of the map.
This means, for example, if the rule of a B-level map causes players to lose their memory upon entry, but one wears the title “Seeker of the Good in Life,” then even if they lose all memories in this map, they will still remember their own and Jiaye’s memories.
This is what’s called rule priority.
Map rules don’t have priority points, only broad rule levels like A, B, C, D, etc., while only titles, skills, and props have specific priority points.
It indeed sounds a bit troublesome.
No wonder all this information is part of the underwater SOP rules and are not directly told to players.
Every game during the Novice Period certainly won’t tell players too much information but will reduce the entry-level experience for players as much as possible. This game has done the same; this is entirely understandable.
So, in that case,
the level system of props indicates not just the rarity of a prop, but also the prop’s rule priority.
Therefore, a D-level prop, no matter how powerful its effect, can’t be sold for a high price.
A D-level prop with a powerful effect but low priority is also unlikely to produce very good results.
For example, Chen Yi’s D-level skill, Mirror Man, is such that, despite its useful effect, its priority is too low, making it easy for Solar Star players to find him.
This is the downside of lower-level props and skills, with bottom-tier priority, their price will also be significantly discounted.
One situation is an exception.
That is when Chen Yi is in the Wife-Killing Buff state, with no cooldowns on all skills, props, and titles, even if the priority is low, it doesn’t matter because he can release them infinitely.
It’s like when he was found using the D-level skill Mirror Man and could just hide again.
For him, as long as the skill effect is strong, whether its priority is high or low, it’s all acceptable.
“How come there’s suddenly such a version update announcement?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit first glanced at the version update announcement with puzzlement, then pulled out his B-level prop, Whisper of the Ancient God, to examine it, and after observing, found a newly added small print on the prop panel.
“Priority B.67.”
Its broad-level is B, and its subdivided points are 67.
“Not bad,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit first expressed his sentiments, then smacked the prop firmly in his hand and said with some confusion, “But isn’t this prop broken? Wasn’t it said that after wearing this prop, an Ancient God would always be whispering grievances in your ear?”
“It’s been a long time since I’ve heard it speak.”
“A B-level prop, also globally unique, can’t just break like that, right?”
“Or is it another bug?”
…
