chapters.title: Chapter 285: 264: "This activity seems quite simple.
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 264: “This activity seems quite simple.
This prop was acquired by him in that B-grade map, “Death Domain.”
It belongs to the globally unique B-grade props.
The effect is extremely powerful.
As long as one wears this prop, their physical fitness will remain at a 5-times amplification over the long term, and if one prays to an Ancient God, one can, after paying a certain price, obtain various powerful strengths.
It is indeed a very powerful prop.
This prop also has an additional effect, which is that after wearing this prop, a buddy called the Ancient God will chat with you nonstop for 24 hours.
Originally, he quite liked this effect.
With Yi absent at times, he could still have someone to talk to. He didn’t have many other quirks, except that he loved to chat—a chatty person by nature.
Not speaking for a day made his whole body uncomfortable.
But no one was there to chat with him all day long; it wasn’t easy to get an Ancient God who was online all the time to chat with him. How nice this had been, but starting a few days ago, this Ancient God stopped speaking.
It’s been silent for several days now.
I wonder if it’s gotten sick or died.
Ancient Gods can die?
After all, they are Ancient Gods; they must be old, their lifespans probably coming to an end.
If it were a new god, surely it wouldn’t die so quickly.
“What a pity.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed somewhat regretfully, stuffing the B-grade prop into his chest. Although the effect of the prop was still strong, its most distinctive feature was gone.
He also probably understood the meaning of this priority now.
His prop’s priority is “B.67.”
That is to say, if there is another prop whose effect is to temporarily nullify the amplification effects on a designated player, and that prop’s priority is “B.68,”
If that prop was used on him, then the physical fitness amplification buff on him would temporarily dissipate.
If it’s lower than this priority, then the prop will have no effect on him.
If the prop has exactly the same priority as his, according to the principle of higher priority for the preemptive side, it still wouldn’t cause any effect on him.
Actually, he didn’t quite understand it either.
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but give a thumbs-up to his own intelligence, and then he started to check the priority of his props one by one to see at what level his props’ priority stood.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi was looking at another prop he had obtained.
“Prop Name”: Galaxy Traction.
“Prop Grade”: A-grade.
“Prop Effect”: This prop can only be used at 23:59 daily; activating this prop will cause the sky to be filled with a myriad of stars that last throughout the night.
The number of stars depends on the player’s fortune for the next day.
The better the player’s fortune, the greater the number of stars.
The poorer the player’s fortune, the fewer the number of stars.
“Prop Restrictions”: Activating it once requires 10,000 Points.
“Prop Priority”: A.23.
“Prop Introduction”: “I was drawn from the edge of the galaxy by your attraction, solely to illuminate the path you’re to take.”
“…”
Looking at the prop panel before him, Chen Yi suddenly fell silent.
What… what kind of garbage prop is this?
Originally, he thought he’d wronged the “Cowherd and Weaver Girl,” an A-grade prop, thinking its generous reward was quite good, but now it seemed that the generous reward was garbage too.
The so-called generous reward.
It was a title that wouldn’t lose Jiaye’s memories and a prop that could predict fortune.
What on earth…?
Just as Chen Yi was feeling speechless, he suddenly arched an eyebrow—wait, it wasn’t completely useless! For example, his A-grade prop “Cowherd and Weaver Girl” was won from an A-grade random Prop Chest. Surely, it wasn’t the best prop in that chest. Why? Because his fortune for the day wasn’t good.
But if he had this “Galaxy Traction” prop,
then he could save up all his Prop Chests and choose a day with the best fortune to activate them. Seen that way, this prop wasn’t so mediocre after all; it was an excellent support prop.
Thinking this way made him feel much more at ease.
Afterward, Chen Yi nodded in slight satisfaction and then turned to look at the panel for the Starry Level title.
–
“Title Name”: One Man Exterminates a Clan!
“Title Effect”: Players of the Alien Race who die at your hands will not be able to descend to hell, and they will transform into Fierce Ghosts that hover around you, which you can summon to manifest and fight for you; whether the battle is won or lost, the summoned manifestation will permanently vanish from the world after an hour.
The terrifying slaughter gives you a strong and blinding aura of killing intent that even makes it difficult for people to look at you directly; you can freely choose to retract or release this killing intent with no cooldown time.
The more undead in your possession, the heavier the killing intent on you becomes.
Every time you kill 5 million players of the Alien Race, you can reset a prop, skill, or title, including its cooldown time and usage count (currently available 13 resets).
This effect will not consume the number of Fierce Ghosts around you.
–
He had received this title after exterminating the God Race.
Solar Star was devastatingly killed by him about 50 million players, and the reset count increased by 10. His title “Wife-Killing Maniac” had been used up and now was the perfect time to reset it.
“Ding, the red-level title Wife-Killing Maniac has been reset. Both the number of uses and the cooldown time have been reset.”
“Reset count -1, remaining 12 times.”
And now, the murderous aura he could release should be even stronger. After all, tens of millions of player ghosts surrounded him, and the murderous aura released was probably enough to freeze the air.
This title did have an attack effect.
It could command the ghosts of players to fight for him, but he hardly ever used it for two reasons: one, there was no opportunity, and two, it was a consumable the less you used it, the less you had, so he had never wanted to use it.
Most times, he didn’t need to use this skill.
When he did need to use this skill, the Wife-Killing Maniac was clearly a better choice.
…
In the following few days, Chen Yi and his group didn’t go to any new maps; they went nowhere at all.
They simply spent their time eating, drinking, and having fun.
These few days they were quite tired, so taking it easy wasn’t a bad thing.
Also, Chen Yi began pondering where to get a higher-priority Burrowing Skill.
The Mirror Man skill, although a D-level skill, was on par with A-level skills under the Wife-Killing Maniac buff.
Yes, the skill’s priority was very low.
Enemies could easily find him.
Just like in the twofold trial, when he was caught numerous times.
But you can’t ignore that in an Infinite Cooldown Buff state, he could repeatedly re-enter an infinite number of times. What does it matter if he got caught? Just burrow back in, right?
Very handy.
But it was somewhat undignified.
This constant cycle of being hit and burrowing again made him feel like a turtle that kept retracting its head.
If there was a higher-level Burrowing Skill, at least he wouldn’t be caught so easily, and he could hide more comfortably.
Pondering this, several days went by.
Until—
August 22nd, early in the morning, 08:00.
A notification rang in the ears of all players.
“Ding, game activity announcement!”
“From August 22nd to August 24th, the Qixi Valentine’s Day special limited-time event officially begins!”
“All players can participate in this event during these three days.”
“Event One: Release the Pressure.”
The summer has been too hot and many players are feeling irritable. Thus, we’ve developed a minigame for players to enjoy.
All players must complete this game within three days, or else 300 Points will be deducted from their account. Those with insufficient Points will be cleared of their remaining balance.
The game environment is realistic and beautiful, the gameplay is simple and easy to learn, with straightforward play and no save function. We hope players can release their stress and alleviate their irritability through this heartwarming minigame.
Players who complete the event during the period will receive a completion gift package.
The top hundred players with the quickest completion times will receive an additional speedrun gift package at the end of the event.
“Event Two: Happy Marriages.”
Players who are couples during the event period will receive a special limited couple’s gift package.
“Event Three: Qixi Limited Gift Package.”
All players can spend 198 Points to purchase a Qixi limited gift package worth 1998 Points, with contents including Props, Skills, and more, all randomly awarded.
“Event Four: Blessed with Offspring.”
During the event period, all players can spend 298 Points to purchase a C-level Prop ‘peace charm.’
When your wife is pregnant, you can activate this Prop.
It guarantees that your wife will have a safe and smooth delivery, and the child will be healthy with all limbs intact and disease-free. Also, before the age of three, the child will not contract any diseases, before fourteen, they will not be forced into any maps, and they are immune to the monthly rules.
ps: This Prop is only sold once during the Novice Period and will never be sold again, and a player can only purchase it once.
A prompt suddenly resonated with all the players.
The special Qixi Valentine’s Day event on August 22nd arrived as scheduled.
“This event seems pretty straightforward.” Tuberculosis Rabbit removed the cucumber slices from her eyes, glanced at the sun that had been up for a while, and said languidly, “It doesn’t sound like there are any maps that need our involvement.”
“What do you think, Sword Without End?”
Seeing that Sword Without End didn’t respond, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned her head curiously to look at him, “What are you staring so intently at? Share with me, let me have a look.”
“Here.”
With a complex expression, Sword Without End shared the screen with Tuberculosis Rabbit, “This is a player from Black Trench City, he has posted a lot on the Black Trench City forum, you know I follow that forum closely because there are many trolls there who flame me.”
“So what?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit casually flipped through the player’s posts with some confusion, “This player hasn’t flamed you, from what I see. His posts are mostly videos with his wife, looking quite affectionate, mostly just everyday life stuff.”
“No issues, right?”
“Hmm.”
Sword Without End nodded with an extremely complex and ugly expression, “Just take a look at his profile. I can’t say it’s explosive, but even among those, it’s off the charts.”
“I’m at a loss for words to describe this player.”

chapters.title: Chapter 286: 265: "Welcome Home!
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 265: “Welcome Home!
“Let me take a look.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t quite understand what Sword Without End’s expression was about and looked puzzled at the brief introduction of this Black Trench City player, silently reading it out loud.
“For sale: an AI modeled after my wife, with thousands of videos for reference, virtually indistinguishable from a real person.”
“Her speech and knowledge are exactly like my wife’s, including her face and body.”
“Nude version supported.”
“You can do anything to her that you want. I hope she can bring you some solace in a world full of danger.”
“Single AI price: 398 Points.”
“…”
After reading this passage,
Tuberculosis Rabbit fell silent.
Sword Without End also fell silent.
“Would this have been illegal before the rise of this game?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was the first to speak.
“Well… according to the legal terms of that time, it wasn’t illegal, but it might be considered unethical.”
“So—”
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused before continuing with an equally complex expression, “The reason this Black Trench City player posted so many daily posts about his wife was to give potential buyers a sense of realism and immersion?”
“Yes.”
Sword Without End nodded with an even more complicated expression, “I’ve done some research, and after buying the 398 Points AI, there’s an advanced version. This advanced version is modeled after the player himself. If you buy this AI, you can see the player kneeling beside you, staring at you full of rage.”
“Explosive.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit slowly straightened up, lit a cigarette, and after exhaling a long puff of smoke, said abstractedly, “Black Trench City really doesn’t spare anyone.”
Meanwhile, the players were starting to explore the Qixi Valentine’s Day limited event game that was supposedly a soothing mini-game.
…
“Let’s see what kind of mini-game it is.”
Dishevelled and in a daze, Li Yide shifted his gaze from the photo on the wall and opened the mini-game. Ever since Xiaoqian had left and disappeared, he felt as if he had truly been through a breakup.
He didn’t even know when he might see Xiaoqian again.
To be precise.
He didn’t even know if Xiaoqian had a soul of her own.
Maybe this so-called soothing mini-game could make him a bit happier; he should really get back on his feet as soon as possible!
In a daze, Li Yide started up the game.
The game was projected into mid-air, with a half-virtual, tangible controller to manipulate his game character.
The game was exquisite.
It was a city that looked like ruins and was quite realistic, with garbage bags and discarded newspapers on the ground appearing as if they really existed, and the character he controlled was a young man in sportswear.
Hm, entering the tutorial.
Li Yide muttered to himself while controlling the character.
“Forward, backward, left, right, sprint, jump, that’s it?”
“Isn’t this game a bit too simple?”
There were just a few buttons – move forward, back, left, right, and jump; that was it.
There wasn’t even an attack button, and as the system announcement said, this was a healing game, so there were no monster-fighting scenarios.
The gameplay was also very simple.
All you had to do was follow the path to the end.
Getting to know the rules of the game, Li Yide began to control the character absentmindedly.
“Hmm, first I need to climb to the roof of the house in front of me, then follow this pipe up to the first platform.”
“This game seems to have many layers; the stages aren’t forward but extend upwards into the sky.”
“Then just follow the pipe forward, and jump when you come to a gap.”
“This is too easy.”
The next second—
His hand slipped, and the character he was controlling fell from the hard-earned rooftop.
“No problem, just start over.”
Li Yide began to take the game more seriously, and after several falls, spending four hours, he finally climbed step by step to the seventh platform, now more than three hundred meters above the ground.
“Phew!”
At this time, he no longer had his initial casual attitude but gripped the controller with slightly sweaty palms, carefully controlling his character’s every move, afraid of falling accidentally because falling meant starting over!
Finally, when he was about to jump to the eighth platform, his character stepped into empty air and started falling towards the ground.
The floorboard he was supposed to land on was fake!
You would fall through if you jumped on it!
You had to jump to the sides!
“…”
Seeing this,
Li Yide’s body stiffened in place, his lips trembling as he watched his character continuously plummet down in the game.
During the fall, the character kept hitting the sixth, fifth, fourth platforms—each level very familiar to him, as he had climbed up with great effort. Yet now, due to a single slip, he plunged from the seventh platform all the way down!
Half a minute passed.
The character he controlled had fallen to the ground, surrounded once again by that familiar ruinous cityscape, with celebratory music playing in the game as if to welcome him home!
The game screen also displayed four big characters—Welcome Home!
Only then did he notice the name of this little game.
“Welcome Home!”
Back to the starting point again, he had to start all over. This game had no saving feature; a fall meant starting from scratch!
After a long while, Li Yide couldn’t restrain himself any longer and let out a frustrated roar, hurling his controller onto the bed with force!
“I %￥￥%￥&*&￥% your mother!”
“*&%…￥ you #￥% mother’s %#￥￥% bitch!”
It was clear to see.
This little game surely didn’t relieve Li Yide’s stress.
…
Meanwhile, around the world, virtually all players of this little game were simultaneously feeling immense irritation and erupting into enraged roars.
What the hell is this shitty game!
Who knows how much effort they had wasted, finally climbing to higher levels, treading carefully at every step and not even daring to run!
And then what?
If it was their own tremble or a mistake in operation, they could accept that!
But all sorts of disgusting traps were enough to make every player want to smash their controllers to smithereens!
A seemingly good road would fail them upon jumping!
Just as they were about to clear the level, suddenly a giant dragon would fly in from the edge of the sky and slap their character off course!
All manner of unexpected incidents would cause countless climbers to fall back to the starting point, making everyone realize that “Welcome Home” might not be a blessing but sometimes a malicious curse or an irritating provocation!
Relieving stress?
Most players weren’t that irritated at first, but after playing this game, the majority were now in a state of extreme annoyance!
No one knew where the hell the Snow Sea Project Team came up with such malevolence.
Not harming, just disgusting.
At this point, many players had already cursed the Snow Sea Project Team to high heaven in their hearts!
No one could accept the sensation of their hours of effort suddenly turning to ashes!
Especially when this sensation was experienced frequently!
It was a constant challenge to people’s psychological endurance!
…
“…”
After a moment of silence, Tuberculosis Rabbit expressionlessly tossed his controller into the sky: “Just 300 points, deduct them if you want, grandpa here isn’t lacking.”
“This damned game, it’s completely annoying.”
At first he really thought it was a casual little game.
Just now, he had climbed to the eleventh level and was walking along a pipe when suddenly a section of the official path vanished, causing him to fall straight from the eleventh to the first level.
Four large characters appeared on the game screen.
Welcome Home.
That was when he knew it was a damn irritating game.
The fall alone took 1 minute.
Who knows how long he had climbed?
Unplayable, completely unplayable; it couldn’t relieve any stress at all. The more he played, the more annoyed he became. Yi was smart; after trying a few times, he threw the controller aside, without any thought of challenging further.
Even if you succeed in the challenge and get the fastest completion gift pack,
The multiple failures along the way are enough to screw with your mentality.
Just ignore that reward like it never existed.
And at that moment—
Jiaye, who was lying on a beach chair nearby, glanced at the somewhat distressed Tuberculosis Rabbit and said with a laugh, “Not really, I find this game quite relaxing. You just don’t go climbing those things.”
“If you just look at the scenery, it’s actually quite well done.”
“I think this game is trying to tell us that if we’re not so driven by gain, the scenery around us can be beautiful too.”
“No.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head and said flatly, “I think this game is just challenging us, wanting to see us turn red in the face with frustration.”
“Can’t stand it.”
SEND GIFT
1

chapters.title: Chapter 287: 266: "Star System 3 is becoming more and more rubbish.
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 266: “Star System 3 is becoming more and more rubbish.
Chen Yi was lying on a beach chair, flipping through the announcements for the limited-time Qixi Valentine’s Day event. As for that healing game, he had only tried it a few times before he lost interest.
A rather boring game.
Though it didn’t frustrate him, from an entertainment perspective, the game was a spectacular failure.
If it weren’t for the penalty of deducting 300 Points for not passing within 3 days, many players probably wouldn’t spare this game a glance.
For him, however, what really caught his attention was a new Prop mentioned in the announcement.
“Peace Charm”
A C-grade Prop.
It belonged to the category of lifestyle Props. Once used, it ensured that a newborn could safely come into the world and wouldn’t be forcibly pulled into the map until they were 14 years of age, and it made them immune to the monthly rule updates.
From a combat perspective, this Prop was incredibly insignificant.
But, in terms of the continuation of the human race, this Prop was comparable to an S-grade Prop.
For a race to perpetuate itself, the most critical factor was the survival rate of newborns; the current birth rate on Blue Star could be said to be the lowest in history, with almost no one daring to conceive.
It wasn’t because they were worried about the children dying after birth.
But because they were worried about dying during pregnancy themselves.
Who would walk into a dangerously unpredictable map with a big belly?
How was that any different from waiting for death?
Or have the husband go into the map to earn Points while staying at home as a housewife? This approach was viable in most situations, but in some cases, it failed, especially during certain global events that pulled all players into the map.
Take the world boss, for instance.
In such global events, a pregnant woman’s fate was almost always death.
However, with this Prop, that detail could be ignored. As long as the peace charm was activated, you could be sure the child would be born safely and without issue.
At least, that’s what the description on the Prop panel claimed.
Whether or not an unborn child would still be protected if the mother sustained a fatal injury was unclear. Did the Prop’s protection extend to assuming that the child would still be born successfully even if the mother died?
He didn’t know.
But one thing he was certain of.
If this Prop was truly sold only once during the Novice Period, then its worth was far more than the 298 Points it cost—a fortune indeed!
Yes.
After passing the Novice Period and completing the twofold trial, becoming a regular player boosts the overall strength of one’s race significantly.
But there’s an inevitable fact: during the entire process, a large number of one’s fellow players died.
Just like on Solar Star.
He almost completely wiped out the population of Solar Star, and yet he only killed over 50 million players. A planet surely had more players than that. So where did the other players go?
Some might have fallen into hell.
But it’s more likely that many had already perished for good.
Even if Solar Star successfully passed the twofold and threefold trials, they would still face one problem: the number of players was continuously decreasing, and those players were a non-renewable resource. Gradually, as the numbers dwindled, a race could become extinct due to the scarcity of its population even without any external enemies.
Despite this Prop’s rarity, he expected that not many players would buy it, as he had anticipated.
And the reality was as he thought.
Hardly any players spent 300 Points to get this Prop.
In the current environment of Blue Star, no one had the inclination to think about childbirth or raising children when survival itself was uncertain; taking a child along only made death come quicker.
No one took the perspective of the race into consideration, considering how the race would continue or be passed down if no one gave birth.
At such a critical juncture, everyone was solely focused on self-preservation, unable to think on such a grand scale.
This was normal.
Chen Yi spent 298 Points to purchase a peace charm. Lying on the rocking chair, he toyed with the peace charm in his hand, his eyes slightly narrowed in silence, not speaking for a long while. It was only after some time that he contacted the president of Skywake, “Zhou Ziqiang”.
He was ready to buy a batch of peace charms.
A single player could only buy it once.
He asked Zhou Ziqiang to contact those players who were unwilling to purchase the “peace charms” and use their quota to buy the Prop.
A budget of 10 million Points then.
Enough to buy 30,000.
He currently had no shortage of Points. In most situations, Points couldn’t directly enhance his strength, so it was better to stockpile such limited-time Props. With 30,000 peace charms at least,
It would ensure the birth of 30,000 healthy human babies.
This too would be a deed of merit.
…
What Chen Yi didn’t realize was this.
In the No. 3 Star System, this Prop wasn’t worth much—it could be obtained for just over a thousand Points.
After all, no one in the No. 3 Star System was concerned about childbirth; people were more invested in boosting their own strength or, for those with a bit more vision, focused on their planet’s trial to ascend.
But beyond the No. 3 Star System, the buying price for this Prop had risen to more than 10 Points!
And even then, it was scarcely available!
Difficult to procure.
When people eventually settled down and started wanting children, or rather, when players outside the No. 3 Star System realized that without a peace charm, it was nearly impossible for a baby to grow up to adulthood—
But… this Prop, only sold once during the Novice Period, became exponentially more difficult to acquire once one left the No. 3 Star System.
There were hardly any players who still had this Prop, and even if they did, they weren’t willing to sell it. It was no longer a matter of price.
There are always many opportunities in life that when we look back, we only then understand.
Like this 298-point peace charm.
Or the bitcoins that were worthless for thousands of years on Blue Star.
…
Lying on the beach chair, Chen Yi dozed off without speaking, quietly enjoying the pleasant moment. He had to admit that this prop was very much to his liking.
Lying on this chair, there was absolutely no need to worry about any external attacks.
His eyes were closed and he was extremely safe.
He had originally planned to give this prop to Jiaye, so that after Jiaye went to hell, all he would need to do was to lie on the beach chair and wait for Chen Yi to pick him up. Regrettably, the moment the prop came into his possession, it bound to him automatically.
It couldn’t be traded or removed.
And just then—
A notification sound suddenly rang in his ear.
“Ding, as a targeted individual with a bounty placed by the human race on Solar Star before their eradication, player Chen Yi is kindly reminded to be extra cautious since a player has accepted the assassination mission.”
No player’s name was given.
Just that abrupt notification.
Chen Yi didn’t even bother to open his eyelids, showing no reaction whatsoever.
It had to be said.
With a growing population, there would always be a few who were incredibly audacious.
He had already eradicated two races, and still, there were people not afraid to die.
Did these people truly have no fear of death?
Or did the player have some kind of unwavering confidence to absolutely deal with him?
Whatever tricks they had, he would just have to wait and see.
Of course, as a consequence, the planet behind this player could also vanish from the world. With so many players of one race, killing one would lead to ten seeking revenge, killing ten would lead to a hundred, and killing a hundred would lead to a thousand.
It was never-ending.
So his style had always been to eradicate future troubles completely.
Once an entire race was exterminated, naturally, no one would come seeking revenge.
But it must be said, the bounty left by Solar Star was truly enticing. Even he was somewhat tempted to make a move against himself, what with one S-ranked prop, more than a dozen A-ranked props, and hundreds of millions of points. The reward for the bounty was undeniably tempting.
…
“Mr. Qiang.”
The person in charge of the Sun Family Guild looked inside as if he had eaten shit but maintained a respectful demeanor as he invited the player before him to the main seat, “We didn’t have much contact with Chen Yi, only did some investigation, and we too withdrew from this operation at the last moment.”
“But since you have spoken, Mr. Qiang, I will certainly tell you everything I know.”
“I have already ordered my subordinates to gather all the information regarding Chen Yi. In a moment, I’ll compile it into digital data and send it to you.”
“Hmm.”
Sitting across from the person in charge of the Sun Family Guild, a man in a crimson suit lowered his head in silence, fiddling with a red jade ring on his thumb. After a while, he carelessly lifted his head and glanced at President Sun.
“A player with some kind of no-cooldown buff, and yet you all are so scared that you dare not even mention his name.”
“Star System 3, truly becoming more and more of a disappointment.”
The man’s appearance was extremely charming. He lacked the masculine beauty of men but was extremely gentle in appearance.
His skin was pale.
He looked somewhat feminine, and if you just considered his face, he could enchant many young girls.
“…”
President Sun’s mouth twitched slightly without a word, only bowing his head and respectfully speaking, “Mr. Qiang is right. It is an honor for Star System 3 to have the presence of Mr. Qiang.”
But then,
he hesitated for a moment before tentatively speaking, “I was just wondering if Mr. Qiang might be willing to disclose what the situation is like outside?”
The so-called Mr. Qiang represented Logitech Star.
He was from the outside.
That is, a player from outside of Star System 3.
To be precise,
when they on Neutron Star had just finished their Novice Period and broken through the twofold trial to become official players, they had interactions with Logitech Star. At that time, Logitech Star had already broken through the twofold trial and was preparing for the threefold trial.
Not three months later,
Logitech Star had cleared the threefold trial, and the entire planet, along with all its players, left Star System 3 for the outside world.
Since then, they had received no further news.
Unexpectedly, after about six or seven months, players from this planet had sent someone back again.
“The outside world?”
The man sitting in the chair, dressed in a crimson suit, proceeded to extinguish a nearly burnt-out cigarette in the mouth of a kneeling girl beside him, nonchalantly watching her expression of pain but not daring to make a sound.
He laughed wickedly.
Squeezing the girl’s neck forcefully, he pressed the cigarette butt down hard, stuffing it into the girl’s throat.
Then he kicked the girl away and glanced disdainfully at President Sun, mockingly saying, “Do you even have the right to know?”
“You want to know, huh? It’s simple. As soon as Neutron Star breaks through the threefold trial, you’ll be in the know.”

chapters.title: Chapter 288: 267: "As long as you don't make me accompany Sand Star players, everything is negotiable.
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 267: “As long as you don’t make me accompany Sand Star players, everything is negotiable.
“Almost a year has passed, and you people on Neutron Star still haven’t cleared the twofold trial, truly a bunch of useless trash.”
Having said that, the man stood up, patted the creases on his suit, and swept a look around him with a flash of disgust and disdain in his eyes.
“A bunch of country bumpkins.”
“Only after leaving the Number Three Star System do you realize what kind of trash heap it is.”
“If not for the Hundred Generations Bounty being somewhat interesting, such a filthy place wouldn’t even deserve my presence.”
He then stood up and walked straight towards the door.
Leaving President Sun with nothing but a tall silhouette.
“…”
After a moment of silence, President Sun waved to summon a subordinate: “Take this girl away, get her injuries treated, and then compensate her with 3,000 Points.”
“Understood.”
Soon a subordinate stepped forward and helped the girl who had been kicked away by the man.
This girl was a public relations officer raised by the Sun Family Guild.
Or to put it more bluntly,
She sold smiles and companionship.
In dealings with some forces, public relations are always essential, and this is also a universally acknowledged form of courtesy.
I can abstain from it, but you can’t fail to prepare.
When Mr. Qiang came to visit this time, he naturally let the public relations team send up their best girl, but this Mr. Qiang really underestimated the players of Neutron Star too much.
Even with indignation,
they dared not show it.
This Mr. Qiang was from Logitech Star, and the players of this planet claimed to be the Sharu Clan.
The population was extremely small, with fewer than 100,000 players.
Whether the population was already small before the advent of the level-up game, or because too many died during the Novice Period, was unclear, but the former seemed more likely. Even if many died during the Novice Period, it wouldn’t amount to this many.
The players from this planet only had single-character names.
No surnames.
Just like the man’s name earlier, which was Qiang.
Only the strongest, the king of the planet, has the surname—Sharu.
The players of this planet were hermaphroditic, all sporting a male figure but with fair skin, each with a distinctly gentle aura, making them easily recognizable in a crowd.
Each person had two sets of reproductive organs.
One male, one female.
No need for marriage.
Self-impregnating and self-giving birth.
The way these players inherited their lineage was to self-impregnate, transferring the life fluid from their own prostate gland to their own womb, thereby becoming pregnant and giving birth.
In the natural world, many races have such methods of inheritance, self-sufficient, a single individual capable of giving birth to an entire race.
This is not unusual.
In the Number Three Star System, there is a race whose method of inheritance is also self-sufficient, but that planet is a complete opposite existence, with an extremely large number of players who reproduce almost daily.
The entire planet has nearly six billion players.
That is, Sand Star.
The Number Three Star System inhabited roughly ten billion players, and this planet alone accounted for six billion of them.
This planet had also passed the twofold trial last month and was currently preparing for the threefold trial. In the Number Three Star System, Sand Star could be considered one of the top-tier planets in terms of strength. However, although there were numerous players, the disadvantages of this planet’s players were quite apparent.
That is, all the players on this planet were blind.
It is said that their planet has been shrouded in darkness throughout the years, and since the race’s inception, they had been without sight. Through countless years of evolution, the players of this planet evolved to have numerous tendrils on their bodies.
Each player had hundreds of fine tendrils continuously touching all sorts of objects in the external world, which was their main source of information.
That’s why, during the Solar Star’s twofold trial live broadcast, there were numerous Sand Star players, but not a single one made a comment.
Sand Star players simply could not see the live stream and had to rely on the sound to imagine the scene; as for sending bullet comments, that was completely out of the question.
The players of this planet didn’t even have their own language.
To communicate, they relied solely on the vibrations of their tendrils to convey messages.
Of course, Sand Star players could completely understand the livestream, as well as system announcements. All system announcements and sounds within the broadcast were transformed by the evolution game, resonating through their tendrils to convey the information to them.
The evolution game could translate announcements into all languages for every player to hear.
No need to worry about this.
Apart from Sand Star and Logitech Star, he had never seen players from any other planet who followed a self-procreation heritage path.
Some found it hard to accept.
But now, the most important thing was that he needed to consult with the Black Dragon Commerce Guild on Neutron Star to discuss countermeasures.
The sudden return of Logitech Star was clearly a sign of ill intent.
…
“I’m sorry you had to go through that.”
Inside the Sun Family Guild Public Relations Department, a girl embraced another girl, her face full of pity as she sheltered the latter, who had just been forced to put a cigarette butt in her mouth, leaving her with a mouthful of scars: “That man is really too perverted, and President Sun as well, how can he meet with just anyone.”
“Alright, alright.”
The girl in the pink dress, after retching and spitting out the cigarette butt from her throat, showed a flash of sadness between her eyebrows, but forced a smile to comfort in return: “It’s just a cigarette butt, it’s not a big deal at all, not even a first-degree injury.”
“The President has his difficulties too; if we don’t treat such characters well, the whole Neutron Star would be at a loss.”
“There’s no helping it.”
“Being in this line of work, you should get used to such things, it’s no big deal. People have to keep living.”
“As long as I don’t have to accompany players from Sand Star, everything else is negotiable.”
“I really can’t accept that.”
“Yikes…!”
Seeing that the girl in the pink dress wasn’t so distressed, the girl who had been comforting her let out a sigh of relief, then shivered with goosebumps as she continued: “Don’t even mention Sand Star players to me. I once heard from a girl on Number Nine Star about it.”
“She had been arranged by their leader to accompany a Sand Star player.”
“It was disgusting.”
“I always thought that Sand Star players were self-procreating, and it’s true that they are, but they also pair with other players of their kin. They just don’t allow the other party to get pregnant, that’s all. Players on this planet firmly believe this is the only way to ensure that the children are truly their own.”
“It is said that a long time ago, infidelity on this planet was frequent.”
“Nearly everyone’s children were not their own, which outraged the people on the planet. As a result, the practice evolved so that the players on this planet would not inject the Fountain of Life into any other player; they would inject it only into themselves, each giving birth from their own stomach to ensure that the child was undoubtedly theirs.”
“According to that girl, the Sand Star player was not rough but rather gentle. However, the hundreds of tendrils continually touching her body made her very uncomfortable.”
“The feeling… The feeling… It felt like having an encounter with a giant cockroach covered in tendrils.”
…

Let’s save the remaining chapters and wait until tomorrow when the editor is back at work and approves them, then we’ll release them all at once.
After all, reading discontinuously and releasing too many chapters doesn’t make sense, and it becomes incomprehensible.
Summary of the previous chapter’s plot: Mr. Qiang is from Logitech Star, similar to the players from Sand Star within the 3rd Star System; their race is hermaphroditic. After President Sun received notice of danger, he went to seek a strategy with the Black Dragon Commerce Guild.
…
“Ugh!”
The girl in the pink dress, who hadn’t finished vomiting, couldn’t help but bring up whatever little food was left in her stomach after hearing those words!
She would rather have her mouth stuffed full of cigarette butts than climb onto a bed with a giant roach covered in feelers!!
She genuinely hoped those damn Sand Star players would be exterminated by Chen Yi soon!!!
“The first time I heard about this, I had the same reaction as you,” said the girl next to her, her expression somewhat unpleasant, but she added, “Although Sand Star players’ appearance is a bit poor, they are actually quite gentle. Before their interests are touched, they are generally gentlefolk.”
“Of course, even if they are gentlefolk, they are still roach gentlefolk.”
…
“Chairman Li.”
With a grim face, President Sun sat across from the chairman of the Black Dragon Guild and said word by word, “You can’t blame me this time. Mr. Qiang came to find me, and I couldn’t keep hiding information for that Chen Yi whom I’ve never met.”
“Even if it means offending Chen Yi, that’s a problem for later.”
“But if I had been stubborn then, I probably wouldn’t be able to see you now.”
“And you used to tell me, players who leave the 3rd Star System never return, right? How did Mr. Qiang come back?”
“In principle, that’s the case,”
said the chairman of the Black Dragon Guild with a hint of helplessness: “Players who leave the Star System go to a place called the Starfield, a vast land where many races compete with their own kind.”
“It’s also an extremely cruel place.”
“Any player who leaves their Star System never returns, firstly because it requires paying an exorbitant interstellar ticket fee, and secondly, because there’s a rule in this level-up game.”
“Any player who returns to their own Star System cannot take away any prop, Skill Fragment, Points, or even a speck of dust.”
“Because of these two reasons, players who leave their own Star Systems almost never return to their own planets. It’s an action devoid of benefit and remarkably foolish.”
“But—”
Chairman Li hesitated for a moment before sighing, “But before Qiu Hao of Solar Star died, he left a Hundred Generations Bounty, which made the players who had left the 3rd Star System salivate like hungry wolves at the sight of fat meat.”
“According to the bounty rules,”
“even players from outside the 3rd Star System can claim this bounty and successfully take it out of the 3rd Star System.”
“Hundreds of millions of Points, an S-grade prop, over a dozen A-grade props, even for those who have left the 3rd Star System like Logitech Star, it’s a significant temptation. Their purpose for coming here is very clear, it is to deal with Chen Yi.”
“It shouldn’t involve us since that brings them no benefit whatsoever.”
“However, we need to consider that only players who have left the 3rd Star System can return. For example, players who leave the 4th Star System cannot possibly go to the 4th Star System, but from the 3rd Star System, it’s not just the Logitech Star.”
“If… if too many forces return to the 3rd Star System, then the conflicts that arise among these forces could very likely affect us.”
“What should we do?”
With a somewhat flustered expression, President Sun asked.
“Two options.”
“The first one, let Chen Yi take action quickly to eliminate Logitech Star, which could also deter forces that have not yet entered the 3rd Star System.”
“The second one, make Logitech Star eliminate Blue Star as soon as possible, and then leave the 3rd Star System with the bounty; this way, any subsequent wars won’t break out within the 3rd Star System.”
“The best solution is still the second one. Even if Chen Yi takes action against Logitech Star, there will always be forces continuing to enter the 3rd Star System, but once the bounty is taken away, the 3rd Star System will finally find peace.”
“Are you suggesting…”
President Sun narrowed his eyes and stared at Chairman Li, enunciating every word, “Are you saying we should help Logitech Star against Chen Yi?”
“Mhm.”
The chairman of the Black Dragon Guild slowly set down his teacup and nodded slightly.
“But haven’t you always advocated not to offend Chen Yi?”
“No.”
Chairman Li calmly shook his head, “No gambler will place their bets on one option forever. When Chen Yi and Solar Star were at odds, we naturally bet on Chen Yi. But when Chen Yi’s opponent is an old power that has left the 3rd Star System, our bets naturally cannot remain on Chen Yi.”
“Facing such an old force that has already passed the threefold trial, Chen Yi’s chances of winning are not great.”
“I have analyzed all of Chen Yi’s battles.”
“Based on my judgment, Chen Yi’s no-cooldown buff likely comes from the woman with him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 290: 268: "I'm idle anyway; might as well feed data to the foundational AI."_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 268: “I’m idle anyway; might as well feed data to the foundational AI.”_2
“Oh?”
President Sun forcibly subdued his inner unrest and spoke up, “What do you mean by that?”
“Do you remember when Chen Yi first made his move?”
“Of course, it was during the God Race invasion of Blue Star.”
“Exactly.”
The chairman of the Black Dragon Guild rose slowly and walked to the window, gazing out at the scenery. After a long silence, he finally spoke, “That battle was broadcasted live, and there was one very strange detail that caught my attention, when the God Race was going all out.”
“Sitting on the throne, Chen Yi suddenly started to exchange sweet nothings with a girl fighting for him with a sword.”
“At that moment, the viewers of the live broadcast were baffled, wondering why they were flirting in the face of an imminent war.”
“After a few words…”
“Chen Yi killed the girl he loved, stabbing her seven times in succession.”
“Resolute and decisive.”
“As if he was afraid she wouldn’t die fast enough.”
“After that, Chen Yi unleashed his full power and eradicated the God Race in one fell swoop, making a name for himself in that battle!”
President Sun narrowed his eyes in thought for a while before speaking in a low voice, “Are you suggesting there’s a cause-and-effect relationship between these two events?”
“It’s only speculation.”
“After that war, one of our Black Dragon Guild members used some method to take on the role of an NPC in a cake shop in Blue Star Hell, and at the time, Chen Yi came into the store to buy a lot of sweets for his girl. From this, it can be seen that Chen Yi’s killing of the girl wasn’t because he discovered another identity for her or that she had betrayed him.”
“Rather, he had another purpose.”
“And why did Chen Yi descend into hell? The war was already over, so why go to hell? There’s only one answer: the cost of using that Skill was death, and not just for one person but possibly for both Chen Yi and that girl.”
“If all of this is just speculation…”
“Then, when Chen Yi destroyed Solar Star, I had another member of our Black Dragon Guild take on the role of an NPC in Blue Star Hell once again, and sure enough, we found the girl Chen Yi killed in hell. And not long after, Chen Yi went to hell too.”
“From this, we can basically infer…”
“To activate that buff state without cooldown, Chen Yi must meet one requirement: to kill the girl he loves. And the choice of victim must be highly specific; no other woman would do, otherwise there’d be no need to always kill the girl he loves.”
“To be precise, it must be a girl he deeply loves.”
“And after the buff ends, he himself will die.”
“This is why twice in a row, when Chen Yi was on a killing spree, that girl was found in hell. You might want to think about this: with Chen Yi’s strength, he is almost invincible on Blue Star, who could possibly deliver Chen Yi’s woman to hell under his protection?”
“An unknown enemy is extremely terrifying.”
“But an enemy whose clues are clear is not so frightening.”
A hint of ruthlessness flashed in the eyes of the Black Dragon Guild chairman: “As long as we act before Chen Yi and kill that woman first, Chen Yi will not be able to activate his buff, and then his strength will naturally fall apart.”
“Just leak this information to Logitech Star.”
“The end of Chen Yi is visibly right in front of us.”
“Unless Chen Yi is willing to kill his own woman in hell, it’s true he could activate the buff without cooldown once again, but is he really willing to kill his woman?”
“Even if he is, he will then never be able to activate that Skill again.”
“When people stare directly at a tiger, all they can see is the call of the Grim Reaper, but when they stare at a tiger without fangs, they can see something different, such as… a valuable tiger skin.”
“…”
After a long silence, President Sun finally spoke up, “Chairman Li, you once reminded me of a saying, and now I remind you the same: just in case, if Chen Yi doesn’t die at the hands of the audience of Logitech Star…”
“Then it will be you and I who are doomed.”
“No one wants to see Chen Yi in the trials of the second map of Neutron Star.”
Truth be told, he was also somewhat baffled.
When he was fearless of Chen Yi, Chairman Li was filled with fear.
After such an ordeal…
When he only had fear for Chen Yi left in his heart, it was the beginning of Chairman Li’s turn to be fearless.
It can’t be that others are fearful and I am greedy…
Before he could finish his thought, Chairman Li, who was standing by the window, turned around, looked at him and coldly laughed, “Others fear and I am greedy, when others are greedy I fear, this maximizes interest.”
“…”
President Sun’s mouth twitched involuntarily, refraining from speaking.
He knew this saying.
Before the leveling game descended, quite a few people had gambled all their wealth on the stock market, succeeding in accruing millions in debt because of this very saying.
When you think it’s at its peak, it can climb higher.
When you think it’s at rock bottom and time to buy in, it can sink even lower.
This saying has no idea how many it has ruined.
Just as he was about to say something else.
Chairman Li spoke again.
“Of course, to avoid risks, we have to send a trustworthy person to secretly transmit the message to Mr. Qiang under the guise of a mysterious figure,” he said.
“This way, even if the secret is revealed, it won’t implicate us.”
“…”
President Sun didn’t say another word; he just remained silent, inscrutable, with his thoughts unknown.
To be frank.
He felt this was not sensible, taking such a big risk with little personal gain.
The only benefit might be that it could put an end to this matter quickly, preventing more powers from getting involved in the Star System 3 and affecting their Neutron Star.
But when the time came, it wouldn’t just be the Neutron Star that would be affected.
There were over thirty planets in Star System 3.
The benefits were for the public, but the risks were shouldered by their Neutron Star.
He thought the plan was somewhat foolish.
But he did not voice his opposition on the spot; he just silently left the Black Dragon Guild.
…
“Bud, yo.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help rolling his eyes, took a deep breath, threw the controller aside, and leaned back in his chair, mumbling, “Don’t be angry, don’t be angry, no one can take your sickness away.”
He swore.
He would absolutely never play this so-called healing game again.
From this Qixi Valentine’s Day game, he sensed immense malice; the game had nothing to do with decompression or warmth.
Yes.
The gameplay was indeed simple and monotonous.
But the feeling of spending four or five hours only to see all one’s efforts go to waste in an instant; it made him want to storm the Snow Sea Project Team and chop off the designer’s head!
Right at that moment—
“Don’t sprint and jump, you’ll get stuck, slow down a few steps before the jumping point and then jump, and you’ll clear the level,” a voice suddenly rang out by his ear.
It sounded somewhat aged and exasperated, as if the speaker reluctantly gave advice after witnessing too much to bear.
“Hmm?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced around, saw no one speaking, was slightly confused, and then suddenly realized, speaking with surprise, “Is that you, Ancient God?”
“You haven’t appeared for so long, I thought you had died inside a prop, I was just feeling a bit of bad luck and considering whether I could ask customer service to clear out the corpse from the prop.”
“And here you are again.”
“How have you been lately?”
“Oh right, didn’t you tell me last time that you had been betrayed? I actually had so much to tell you back then, but you disappeared afterward. Let me tell you, life is full of ups and downs, and this kind of thing…”
“Enough!!”
Before Tuberculosis Rabbit could finish,
the voice by his ear spoke up again, sounding rather frustrated, “Shut your damned mouth!! How can a man have so much to say?!!”
“Eh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit lit a cigarette with a hint of surprise and said, “You can hold a normal conversation now? Before, you were like a non-sentient AI, just babbling in my ear, completely ignoring whatever I said. And now you can actually respond to me?”
“You knew I couldn’t talk normally before, and you still talked back to me? Even had a chat with me?”
“I had nothing better to do, might as well have been feeding data to a basic AI.”
“…”
After a long silence, the Ancient God spoke again, “War Star Beasts have entered your star system, I’m temporarily back to normal, showing up to tell you that this group is probably targeting your Solar Star System.”

chapters.title: Chapter 291: 270: "There's No Turning Back Now.
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 270: “There’s No Turning Back Now.
The Ancient God couldn’t hear what Chen Yi was saying, and Chen Yi couldn’t hear what the Ancient God was saying either.
The only way for them to communicate was to have the Tuberculosis Rabbit act as an intermediary.
“Tell the truth.”
“This is the truth.”
“Since you just said that Starfield players cannot take any props, Skill Fragments, or Points out of their Star System, why would they come to the Threefold Star System?”
“The Hundred Generations Bounty is an exception.”
“Just give me a rough idea of this Race’s information, and I can clarify their general situation in the Starfield. Many of this information will be useful to you… for example, their fatal weaknesses.”
“…”
Chen Yi stopped talking and just continued to lie on the beach chair with his eyes closed, unconsciously tapping his knuckles on the armrest.
Not long ago.
Someone indeed accepted the Hundred Generations Bounty left by the Solar Star.
He also received the notification.
He originally thought it was someone bold from the Number 3 Star System, but he never expected outsiders to come.
Starfield.
What kind of place was this?
A group of veteran players showed no mercy to them newbies.
“Isn’t there a Newbie Protection Period? What kind of protection is this?”
“In exchange for a certain price, even planets under newbie protection are not absolutely safe, it’s just that most people are unwilling to do so, as the cost is usually not worth the reward.”
“But if… there’s a huge bounty, then the cost becomes acceptable.”
Chen Yi remained silent.
He thought he could take a vacation, but now he’s faced with another war, and this time the enemy is incredibly powerful—the Threefold Planet of the Starfield.
As for the War Star Beast, it was not the weapon of this Race.
It was a kind of interdimensional transport used in levelling up games, for traversing between worlds, and players could ride it by paying a certain amount of Points.
Of course, it didn’t go just anywhere.
It could only carry you to places you were authorized to visit.
And the Number 3 Star System was precisely a location within the rights of Logitech Star to visit.
As the saying goes, strike first to gain the upper hand.
But the problem now is that Chen Yi had no idea who the enemy was, where they were, or how to deal with them.
This Race didn’t participate in the twofold trial.
So, naturally, that tactic was useless.
And a Threefold Planet… even if he went all out, he wasn’t guaranteed to avoid fatal risks.
Besides, his battle videos were always broadcast live, and it was certain that these Race Players thoroughly studied his fighting methods and fatal weaknesses before taking action.
Not knowing who the enemy was, where they were, and not being able to strike first but just passively take hits.
It had to be said,
this time it was truly troublesome.
…
“Boss.”
Within the Sun Family Guild, a bald man continuously sucked in cold breaths as if he were in pain, hesitantly looking towards President Sun, who was seated, and spoke up with a forced expression.
“Are you sure we want to contact Chen Yi, to reveal both Chairman Li’s intentions and the existence of Mr. Qiang?”
“If this is discovered, our Sun Family Guild will have to endure the onslaught from multiple powers.”
“Even if Chen Yi is grateful to us, he’s on Blue Star and can’t intervene immediately, right?”
“Don’t rush.”
President Sun’s eyes narrowed as he savored a sip of tea, a fierce glint suddenly appearing in the depths of his gaze as he laughed, “Chairman Li made a point that has awakened me; no gambler will forever bet all their chips on one option.”
“If we side with Chairman Li and Mr. Qiang this time, what do we stand to gain? There’s no benefit at all, only the possibility that the Number 3 Star System won’t be invaded by external enemies.”
“But what kind of crappy benefit is that!”
“All the benefits of so many planets in the Entire Star System, why should I risk my neck to do this alone?”
“However, if we stand with Chen Yi, then the benefits are different. Think about it, right now Chen Yi surely doesn’t know about this affair, if we pass on the information beforehand.”
“If Chen Yi can avoid this catastrophe, then the Sun Family will be his most steadfast friend.”
“The benefit of that would far exceed standing on Mr. Qiang’s side.”
“Moreover—”
The somewhat plump President Sun twisted his chubby body in the chair, a shadow crossing his sullen eyes.
“Those who bully me right in front of my face.”
“And expect me to be their dog.”
“Do they think I have no temper?”
Although when Mr. Qiang shoved a cigarette butt into the mouth of a girl under his command right in front of him, he showed no change in expression nor dared to show any.
But that indignity wasn’t easy to swallow.
If he had to continue enduring that and serve as Mr. Qiang’s dog, he truly felt outraged.
“This…”
The confidant beside him hesitated before speaking again, “Boss, since you’ve made a decision, we won’t change it, but we don’t have the means to contact Chen Yi directly like the Black Dragon Guild does as the Sun Family Guild lacks that capacity.”
The Black Dragon Guild had contacted Chen Yi the last time by sending a member to a shop on the Blue Star map to meet with Chen Yi as an NPC.
This ability to be appointed to a star as an NPC was something only the Black Dragon Guild possessed.
The Sun Family Guild definitely did not have it.
“Don’t worry.”
President Sun shook his head and said, “Although Chairman Li didn’t name names, I know he sent this message through Li Peiqi, and that Prop that could be used to appoint someone to a star to act as an NPC, is also in Li Peiqi’s hands.”
“You might have forgotten.”
“The Black Dragon Guild was initially on our side, but the reason they are now forcefully pulling out is because of Li Peiqi’s staunch opposition to this matter.”
“Despite Li Peiqi being from the Black Dragon Guild, if we secretly contact her, she might agree to help us and covertly pass the message on to Chen Yi.”
“Understood!”
…
“What!!!”
A flicker of fear passed through Li Peiqi’s eyes. The chips she had been holding in her arms fell to the floor as she stared incredulously at President Sun. After a long moment, without any hesitation, she grabbed her coat and rushed toward the door.
“I’m going to talk to the Chairman. Has he lost his mind!!!”
“How dare he backstab Chen Yi!!!”
“There’s no need to go.”
President Sun pulled Li Peiqi back, his complexion somewhat ugly as he shook his head, “Before coming here again, I had already asked Chairman Li once more, and he was very determined.”
“And he already sent the message to Mr. Qiang.”
“Chairman Li strongly believes that although Chen Yi is powerful, this time he will definitely die on the Threefold Planet set up by Mr. Qiang.”
“There’s no turning back now.”
“We’ve approached you because you have a way to contact Chen Yi. We hope you can pass on this information to him so he can prepare in advance. And the Sun Family Guild from Neutron Star wishes to gain Chen Yi’s friendship.”
“This has to be kept secret. Don’t tell anyone, understood?”
“…”
After a long, extremely uncomfortable silence, Li Peiqi nodded and said, “You can go back. I understand. I’ll send the information to Chen Yi as soon as possible.”
“Chairman Li… is doomed.”
“Good, then we’re counting on you.”
After the Sun Family Guild had left, Li Peiqi finally sat down on the sofa with a rather somber expression. Since the start of the day, she’d been somewhat distracted.
Originally, her death as indicated by the A-level Prop “Last Words” had been at the hands of the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
It started out as by Chen Yi’s hand.
But ever since Chen Yi destroyed the Solar Star, it had always been at the hands of the Tuberculosis Rabbit. She barely breathed a sigh of relief when, this morning, habitually checking the A-level Prop “Last Words,”
her cause of death changed back to being at the hands of Chen Yi.
She hadn’t done anything, so why would she die at Chen Yi’s hand again?
As she pondered why this was happening, President Sun showed up, and she finally understood the reason.
While she had been so cautious and vigilant before, her dear Chairman had stabbed her in the back once again.
And at that moment—
A knock on the door rang out again.
Distracted, Li Peiqi instinctively asked, “Who is it?”
“It’s me, Peiqi.”
The moment the voice from outside rang out, Li Peiqi’s heart instinctively calmed down; it was the voice of her best friend Liu Xiaochan.
When the door opened,
Liu Xiaochan, standing at the doorway holding a large bag of snacks, curved her eyes like crescent moons upon seeing Li Peiqi, lifting the snacks in her hands, “Look what we’ve got; it’s all your favorites. I’ve come to watch a movie with you, to finish the one we didn’t complete yesterday.”
“Hey, you look a bit pale?”
“I…”
After hesitating for a while, Li Peiqi couldn’t help but tell Liu Xiaochan the secret she was supposed to keep about what President Sun had told her.
She could keep secrets from others.
But Liu Xiaochan was her best friend, the one who had risked her life to save her on several occasions on the map. She didn’t believe Liu Xiaochan would hurt her. Keeping this matter to herself felt suffocating; she couldn’t keep it to herself.
“…”
After listening, Liu Xiaochan looked a bit pale, but managed a stiff smile while passing the snacks over, “Geez, this Chairman Li, huh? He was just supporting Chen Yi, so why all of a sudden decide to backstab.”
“No matter which side he stands on, this constant switching of stances is never a good thing.”
“That…”
But Liu Xiaochan suddenly fell silent mid-sentence, unable to maintain her forced smile any longer. It took a long while before she spoke again.
“There’s something I need to tell you. I’m actually planted by Chairman Li to be close to you, but our feelings for each other are real. It was after we became best friends that Chairman Li approached me.”
“The main purpose was to ensure your safety.”
“Don’t be too rushed.”
“I won’t report this to Chairman Li, but I need to tell you something. Haven’t you always said you have no family?”
“Well, you actually do.”
“Chairman Li is your biological father, and since he didn’t dare to acknowledge you, he asked me to protect you secretly.”
“I want you to know this.”
“Because if you reveal this message to Chen Yi, then you and your father will be on opposing sides. I fear that maybe Chen Yi really won’t survive the ordeal on the Logitech Star.”

chapters.title: Chapter 292: 269: "Arrogance is death's best friend.
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 269: “Arrogance is death’s best friend.
“War Star Beast?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit blinked in astonishment and glanced over at Yi, who was feigning sleep on a beach chair not far away, before getting up and finding a clean patch of sand.
After sitting down cross-legged, he took out a packet of cigarettes from his chest and placed it on the ground.
He lit a cigarette and took a deep inhale before lighting another one and sticking it in the sand.
“Come on, take your time, no rush, get your thoughts in order before you speak.”
“What’s the deal with that cigarette you lit—what does it mean?”
“I’m offering you a smoke, of course. I never hog things to myself, haven’t you realized after all this time that I’m a generous guy?”
“Then why stick it in the sand?”
“Idiot, you don’t have a physical form, how am I supposed to put the cigarette in your mouth with you being just a voice?”
“…”
After a moment of silence, the Ancient God spoke with a somewhat aged tone, “I haven’t had control over myself for very long, so I’ll cut to the chase.”
“My name is Xie Bi’an.”
“I was once a player from a Threefold Planet.”
“I used to belong to Star System No. 18, but of course, by the time I ascended to the Threefold Planet, I was already beyond the Star System, heading to Starfield, an extremely vast continent.”
“The continent has various complex secret realms, mind-boggling traps, and all sorts of strange environments, and at the same time, countless races from numerous planets fight for survival on that continent.”
“These details aren’t important; with the current strength of Blue Star, or should I say, with Chen Yi’s strength, leading Blue Star to ascend as a Threefold Planet and head to the Starfield Continent shouldn’t be a problem at all.”
“However, because I did some wrong things, I was forcibly imprisoned within this Prop, all my consciousness wiped out, turning into a ghost that can only bemoan endlessly.”
“Let’s just describe myself as a ghost for now. I’m not sure what I am, unable to see my own body, but I can vaguely see the world around me.”
“It’s… it’s like watching the world through a condom; there’s always this very clear sense of blurriness.”
“Your description is spot on.”
“Thank you.”
The Ancient God paused for a moment before continuing, “Before this, when I was conversing with you, it wasn’t really my true consciousness, but rather my subconscious.”
“So you’ve been avoiding me all this time on purpose?”
“It’s not that I’ve been avoiding you on purpose; it’s my subconscious making me avoid you.”
“Why’s that?”
“Your chatter is too much, kind of annoying.”
“…Aren’t you supposed to talk incessantly inside the Prop, any punishment for going silent so many days?”
“Yes, I get electrocuted every day, and it hurts a lot.”
“Hurts and you still play hide-and-seek?”
“Between enduring your babbling and getting electrocuted, my subconscious chose the electrocution.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit remained expressionless for a while before speaking again, “Why use the word ‘endure’? Even though we’ve never met, I’ve always thought of us as friends.”
“That’s not the point.”
The Ancient God didn’t pick up on that but continued, “Actually, several hours ago, a War Star Beast entered your Star System, and that’s when I recovered my true consciousness.”
“I originally didn’t want to show up and reveal this.”
“After all, that could likely attract the attention of the ascension game. Although I still can’t leave this Prop, having recovered consciousness, at least it’s better than continuing to be imprisoned in a hazy state without consciousness.”
“But it wasn’t long before I realized that I hadn’t permanently regained my true consciousness, but temporarily.”
“And the reason I momentarily recovered consciousness, I suspect, has a lot to do with the War Star Beast breaking through from Starfield into Star System No. 3, which created a temporary portal between the two realms.”
“Through this portal, I felt the prayers of countless followers on Starfield, and it was this Power of Faith that temporarily restored my consciousness.”
“If… if I could return to Starfield, maybe I could permanently regain my consciousness, and even potentially escape from this Prop, constructing a true body of my own.”
Just as the Ancient God finished speaking, he waited somewhat nervously for Tuberculosis Rabbit’s response.
After all, there was only one way for him to return to Starfield.
That was for Blue Star to ascend to a Threefold Planet, and for Tuberculosis Rabbit to either not fully deplete his soul’s power before heading to Starfield or not trade or exchange the Prop.
‘Words of the Ancient God!’
This Prop had an effect that allowed for a trade with the Ancient God at some cost.
With each trade, Tuberculosis Rabbit could obtain immense physical strength.
But his Power of Faith would be greatly depleted until it was all gone.
As for the cost Tuberculosis Rabbit paid, they never reached him; they all went to the damned intermediary of the ascension game!!!
But at that moment—
He noticed Tuberculosis Rabbit flipping through a novel at high speed, which made him somewhat perplexed, “What are you looking through?”
“Right!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly nodded vigorously, closed the novel he was holding, and set it aside, lamenting, “No big deal, I was just thinking about a novel I read once. It had a similar plot.”
“Basically, the protagonist obtains a ring, and inside the ring, there’s an old man. This old man was once powerful but now only has his soul left.”
“He promised great rewards, assuring the protagonist that a favor now would be repaid in the future. Just when the protagonist had gone to great lengths to reshape a body for the old man, the old man emerged from the ring and consumed the protagonist’s soul power to repair his own,”
“Just like you.”
“…”
The Ancient God silently fantasized about the name of the novel beside Tuberculosis Rabbit.
‘The Dark Version of Battle Through the Heavens’.
“I never thought of that. I genuinely wanted to cooperate with you. I can help you avoid this catastrophic crisis. One of the Threefold Planets from the Starfield Continent is coming to trouble you. Without my guidance, Blue Star is likely to face an extinction-level calamity,”
“Just like Solar Star.”
“I’ve seen too many races get exterminated, and there’s a glaring commonality: not one of them ever thought they would be exterminated soon.”
“Arrogance is Death’s best friend.”
“Hmm…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, appearing to ponder seriously before asking, “You just said that because War Star Beasts temporarily opened a channel between Star System 3 and the Starfield Continent, you received the prayers of your followers and briefly regained consciousness.”
“Are you really an Ancient God?”
“I suppose so.”
The Ancient God fell silent, as if reluctant to delve into that part of history.
“You have to tell me first, what led to your confinement within a Prop? If it was a mistake, why wasn’t death the consequence, but instead confinement?”
After saying this, Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke no more, patiently waiting instead.
He didn’t immediately report the matter to Yi.
He was concerned that this might bring trouble to Yi.
Whom do you have to offend to end up confined within a Prop? Naturally, it’s offending the higher powers of the game.
A player confined within a Prop for offending the higher powers of the game, and them wanting to cooperate?
This is more than just a hot potato; it’s a matter of life and death.
If the Snow Sea Project Team finds out about this, will there be any repercussions for them?
No one can say for sure.
Yi is very strong, but that’s under the rules of the upgraded game. If the higher powers of the game decided to target Chen Yi, no matter how many Props he had, they could become useless in an instant.
After all, those Props were issued by the higher powers of the game.
The Ancient God seemed to dread revisiting his past and, after a long silence, finally said in a hoarse voice, “You should be able to guess who I offended, right?”
“It’s apparent.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded and glanced at Yi, who was still feigning sleep on the nearby beach chair. He brought the nearly spent cigarette to his lips for a deep drag, gazing through the pale blue smoke at the horizon with extreme contentment.
“It can’t kill me.”
“Are you its father or something?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but burst into an angry laughter. Was this a childish joke?
“I have a Prop that grants me 200 years of life, and as long as my life isn’t up, I cannot die by any means.”
“The priority of this rule is extremely high.”
“SS.98.”
“It can’t break this rule to kill me, so it had no choice but to confine me, intending to deplete my lifespan before finishing me off.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly fell silent. The information in that statement was beyond his comprehension. After a moment, he hesitantly said,
“Do you mean the higher powers of the game cannot directly invalidate your Prop?”
“Yes.”
The Ancient God replied, “Although the Prop comes from the higher powers of the game, they cannot control any Prop that has already been distributed to players, such as rendering a player’s Prop ineffective.”
“Conflict between player Props and the game can only arise in one scenario.”
“For instance, the higher powers of the game might lure a player into a trap they’ve set in advance, but the player has an invincible or undying Prop on them.”
“In such a case, it boils down to whose rule has higher priority.”
“The higher powers of the game are just a general term; the project team for Starfield is called the Starfield Project Team. They can’t directly kill players or use the map to trap and kill them.”
“But the highest level of map issued by Starfield is SS level. At the same level, a player’s Prop rules take precedence over the map’s rules, which means the Starfield Project Team can’t kill me through map rules they control. That’s why they had to go to greater lengths to imprison me in a Prop, hoping to exhaust my lifespan.”
“Alright,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, stood up, and walked over to Yi: “Let’s not talk about this for now. Yi needs to hear this; it’s beyond me.”
…
Ten minutes later.
Having understood the situation, Chen Yi didn’t open his eyes but casually said, “So, what did this Ancient God do to offend the Starfield Project Team?”
“What made them pay such a high price to imprison you in this Prop?”
“I don’t know. One day I went to sleep and suddenly found myself forcibly thrown into a map, and then it turned out this way.”

chapters.title: Chapter 293: 271: "Someone has started to act shamelessly, and I'm powerless to do anything about it.
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 271: “Someone has started to act shamelessly, and I’m powerless to do anything about it.
“If you’re merely terrified of Chen Yi because of the A-level Prop ‘Last Words,’ then I honestly find it somewhat unnecessary.”
“More than Chen Yi, I think what’s more important is to avoid turning you and your father against each other.”
“Chairman Li is my father?”
Li Peiqi’s mouth fell open in shock, and after a long moment, she burst out in furious rage, “So that’s how it is, that’s how it is!!!”
“I just knew it! Despite being so careful, why did I still die at Chen Yi’s hands!!!”
“So there was such a calamity lurking outside!”
“I must have been caught up in Chen Yi’s ‘Annihilate Nine Clans’!”
“No matter how much you guard against it, it’s hard to fend off a traitor within your own home!!!”
During her investigation recently, she had found out that the brother by Chen Yi’s side was called Tuberculosis Rabbit. Although she didn’t know why she died at the hands of Tuberculosis Rabbit,
It wasn’t Chen Yi who made the move.
That is to say, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s killing was point-to-point, and there is always a way to avoid and mitigate a point-to-point kill.
But to die by Chen Yi’s hand meant that one was simply caught in the crossfire, and it’s very likely they didn’t even face him.
“No way!”
Li Peiqi immediately flew into a rage, rolled up her sleeves, and strode towards the door, “I’m going to kill that waste of a father right now!”
“Huh?”
Liu Xiaochan, with a confused face, stood frozen in place, then hurriedly went out the door to grab Li Peiqi’s arm, “Wait, you’ve got it wrong, that’s your biological father.”
“Yes, it is!”
Still in a fury, Li Peiqi was determined to storm out, but she quickly came to her senses, furrowed her brows, turned to look at Liu Xiaochan: “Are you certain that Chairman Li is my biological father?”
“I specifically used a Prop to check my parentage, and it clearly indicated that my parents died long ago.”
“That makes things less certain, but that’s what Chairman Li told me.”
Gradually, Li Peiqi’s anger subsided, and after a moment she spoke up with a solution, “I’ll go send a message to Chen Yi first.”
“You try to get some of Chairman Li’s skin flakes or hair; blood would be best. We’ll do a paternity test.”
“If Chairman Li truly is my father, it can be considered as him atoning for his deeds, and perhaps one could offset the other.”
“But if Chairman Li isn’t my father, then don’t blame me for being ruthless.”
“Okay.”
…
Chen Yi sat up straight in the beach chair, and as he was about to say something, an alert suddenly rang in the ear of every Blue Star player.
‘Ding, system announcement!’
‘Twofold Planet Logitech Star has issued a forced Race Duel Battle against Zerofold Planet Blue Star!’
‘Due to the substantial level difference between the two planets, this battle will be limited to one hour. After one hour, no matter the state of the war, it will be forcefully concluded.’
‘All players from both planets will be forced to participate in this battle.’
‘The war will begin on August 23rd at 12:00 PM.’
‘Please prepare accordingly!’
‘We wish you all good luck.’
“August 23rd?”
Chen Yi, who had just sat upright, preparing to say something, suddenly froze in place. That was tomorrow noon.
It was already 9:21 PM on August 22nd.
About half a day remained.
An all-race war.
That means all players from the Blue Star will participate, fighting a life-and-death battle with players from a Threefold Planet.
It would be a brutal fight.
Chen Yi fell silent for a moment, then turned his head to look at Jiaye, who brimmed with determination. He suddenly felt as if he had made a mistake; he had never intended for so many Blue Star players to die because of him.
He might not die.
But from this battle, countless Blue Star players might perish.
This wasn’t what he wanted.
…
At this very moment,
In some part of the clouds above Blue Star,
A man with an eye on his forehead, dressed in a suit, stood within the spacious office and roared at the telephone icon on the screen.
“Is the entire Starfield Project Team just slacking off?”
“Starfield Threefold Planet has gone to the 3rd Star System to launch a Race Duel Battle against Blue Star—didn’t you see it?”
“Blue Star is still in the Newbie Protection Period, has your database been hacked or what?”
“Are you blind?”
“This fucking goes against the rules—how dare you?”
The man was extremely tall but skinny, as if a gust of wind could knock him over, with the only exception being that the eye on his forehead flickered with a scarlet glow, seemingly expressing his inner rage.
Inside this huge and wide office, numerous employees looked towards the man’s back with complex expressions, waiting for a reply.
On the wall, five large characters were embedded.
“Snow Sea Project Team!”
And there was a huge logo.
A bright red Demon’s eye.
Soon, a voice came through from the gigantic screen in front of the man.
“If Blue Star weren’t targeted by the Hundred Generations Bounty, people from Starfield wouldn’t have gone there. Didn’t you bring this upon yourselves? Why are you so resentful?”
“The team responsible for Solar Star had their planet annihilated after years of running behind, and even they didn’t have such a strong reaction.”
“This is our own fault?”
The man standing in front of the screen couldn’t help but laugh angrily as he spoke, “Every action taken by Chen Yi was within the rules. Which behavior broke the rules?”
“Regardless of the Hundred Generations Bounty!”
