“Starfield Continent’s Threefold Planet can’t initiate a Race Duel against planets still in the Newbie Protection Period. This is an SSS grade rule—how dare you violate it?”
He learned of this upon arriving at the Logitech Star in the 3rd Star System.
But he wasn’t worried; after all, planets from the Threefold Planet couldn’t initiate a Race Duel Battle against those still in the Newbie Protection Period. If it wasn’t a Race Duel Battle, he believed Chen Yi could handle any minor shenanigans.
However, if it was a Race Duel Battle, Chen Yi wouldn’t be able to withstand it!
He was all too aware of what a Race Duel Battle entailed—if it weren’t for deep-seated hatred, races would not initiate such a thing!
At this time, another voice came from the screen.
“We are within the rules just as you are.”
“Please check the system announcement. Logitech Star is a Twofold Planet, not a Threefold one. It demoted itself from Threefold to Twofold recently and is no longer a Threefold Planet.”
“There isn’t a single rule stating that a Twofold Planet can’t initiate a Race Duel against a planet still in the protection period.”
“We understand how you feel, however—”
“Please accept our condolences.”
“Just like the Solar Star Project Team that was wiped out by Blue Star’s player Chen Yi.”
“…”
The man was stunned for a moment, hastily gesturing in the air to call up the system announcement that had just sounded in the ears of the players from Blue Star.
After reading it carefully,
his face went grim with silence.
The announcement indeed showed that Logitech Star was a Twofold Planet!
Threefold Planets couldn’t initiate a Race Duel Battle against those still in the protection period, but Twofold Planets could—this was actually a loophole in the rules.
Because the A-grade prop “Race Duel Order” required to initiate a Race Duel Battle can only be obtained in Starfield, meaning, only Threefold Planets could acquire this prop.
Naturally, there was no need to specify a rule forbidding Twofold Planets from initiating Race Duels against protected planets.
But who could have foreseen Logitech Star would downgrade itself, thereby exploiting this loophole?
This loophole would soon be closed in the next update, but so what? By that time, Blue Star would no longer exist.
Upgrade games have always been like this, fixing bugs with every update, without regard for players who have benefited or suffered from them.
Thus, everything would be reasonable and within the rules.
The man who had been standing tall suddenly crumpled, a hint of despair flashed across his eyes, he let out a wry laugh and sat down in his chair without speaking again.
“Chen Yi, oh Chen Yi.”
“When people start to lose their shame, I am helpless.”
…
ps: More to come later.

chapters.title: Chapter 294: 272: Now, everything is about to come to an abrupt end.
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 272: Now, everything is about to come to an abrupt end.
Just then,
a female voice rang in the man’s ear.
“Manager, what should we do?”
A young woman in uniform walked up behind the man, her voice hesitant as she asked, but her brows inevitably betrayed a hint of gloom.
She, too, had a crimson eye on her forehead.
Just like the logo on the wall, everyone here had a crimson eye on their forehead, which looked exceedingly eerie.
At this moment, the office was silent, no longer filled with the usual bustle of chatter; no one was in the mood to small talk or joke around at a time like this.
The entire office was suffused with a stifling atmosphere, and many employees had already packed their belongings, ready to go home.
Blue Star had been annihilated.
The Snow Sea Project Team, responsible for the Blue Star project, would not die with it.
But they had to go home.
Similar to when Solar Star was annihilated, the project team for Solar Star went home too.
It also meant that all their efforts in recent days had been in vain, and there was no telling when they would have such an opportunity again.
Everyone looked at the manager’s back, their expressions complex and silent.
This problem was almost insoluble.
It was a Race Duel Battle launched by a Threefold Planet against Blue Star.
Although it had been demoted to a Twofold Planet,
it was only nominally reduced to a Twofold, and some of the Threefold exclusive Props could no longer be used, but it still had the strength of a Threefold Planet in essence.
Of course, since some of the Threefold exclusive Props had been sealed, it was much weaker than a true Threefold Planet, but it was still far stronger compared to a Twofold Planet.
For such a planet to initiate a Race Duel Battle against Blue Star, which was still in its Newbie Protection Period and had only been open for four months, there really was no way to counter it.
Even with Chen Yi there, it was hopeless.
The outcome was almost self-evident.
They were powerless.
As a project team, they had no way to directly help the players, they lacked the authority, as well as the power; it was impossible to simply drop some SSS-grade Prop and hand it to Chen Yi.
They lacked the ability.
All they could do was to be responsible for the monthly version updates, the extraction of the monthly rules, and the planning of special limited-time events, some map designing, and so on.
Anything else was beyond their jurisdiction.
Blue Star had high potential.
Though it was still in the Newbie Protection Period, being responsible for many planets, they could clearly judge that Blue Star was likely the most promising planet they had overseen.
First off, Blue Star had gone through the ultimate rule of “Calm and Cool,” which, for a Novice Planet, was nearly a fatal blow.
Planets that went through this rule often saw a drastic drop in their player numbers.
But on Blue Star, the drop in player numbers was much less than they had anticipated, and the players who survived were far stronger in resilience compared to other novices who hadn’t experienced this rule.
They weren’t even on the same level.
And it even catalyzed a player like Chen Yi, whose individual power was off the charts.
It was foreseeable that Blue Star would at least grow to become a Threefold Planet and perhaps even carve out its own territory in Starfield.
By then, the Snow Sea Project Team would rise with the tide.
But—
Now, everything was about to be prematurely cut short.
“…”
The man, who was neatly dressed in a suit, sat on the sofa, his head bowed in silence for a long time without speaking. He did not know how to help Blue Star overcome this crisis.
Leak some key information to the players of Blue Star?
He lacked the authority.
Grant a multitude of Props to the players of Blue Star?
He lacked the authority.
Or to give Chen Yi some preferential treatment, he even lacked that authority.
As the head of the Snow Sea Project Team, he could mostly act only as an observer; the rules of the game did not allow him to directly or indirectly interfere with the players’ development.
As the person in charge, within the first twelve months of a planet’s Novice Period,
he had only three privileges that he could actively make use of.
The first was to replace a Prop or Skill a player was supposed to obtain, limited to exchanges within the same level.
He had already used this privilege.
In that Dragon Boat Festival event, he used this privilege to give Chen Yi a B-ranked Skill “Requesting the Mandate of Heaven,” which allowed direct dialogue with him and granted certain rewards at a certain cost.
Originally, Chen Yi was supposed to receive a B-ranked Skill “World Frost,” which he had replaced using his authority.
In fact, this Skill was customized over half a month. He first roughed out the Skill’s effects and limitations, then submitted them to the Skill designer of the game for ranking, testing, rule restrictions, and a series of complicated processes.
Only then was the Skill designed, and its level restricted to a B-ranked Skill.
It was a Skill he had specifically prepared for Chen Yi, but still within the rules. For instance, the 5 million Points Chen Yi spent to travel to Solar Star for the twofold trial map, that was deducted by the game.
He could not give Chen Yi a discount or reduce the price; those were set by the game. This was a Skill he designed especially for Chen Yi, whom he felt needed such a Skill or Prop at the time.
The reason it was designed as a Skill rather than a Prop,
was to prevent it from being dropped.
This was his first privilege.
The second privilege was the ability to initiate a global announcement at will.
All the global announcements that had been heard on Blue Star were edited by them, while the game was responsible for pushing them out. This privilege allowed him to make one global announcement freely.
The third privilege was… to set off fireworks that would cover the globe.
This privilege was often used at the end of the Newbie Period.
These three privileges were the only three actions he could autonomously do as the head of the Snow Sea Project Team during Blue Star’s Novice Period.
For everything else, he had to work within the rules.
The first privilege had been used, and the second and third had yet to be exercised.
After a long silence, the man raised his head and looked at Chen Yi sitting in the center of the screen on a beach chair. He sighed deeply, and he seemed to have aged decades in an instant.
He got up and walked towards his own office.
“I’m going to announce a farewell to Blue Star; everyone, pack your bags and prepare to go home,” he said.
“Prepare yourselves mentally for this project’s failure; no one will avoid the punishment that comes with it.”
The game was a highly mysterious entity.
Even up to now, no one knew what the game truly was, even the employees who appeared to be working for it from the players’ perspective outside had no idea what it was.
It was unclear which power it belonged to.
Nor was it clear if it was part of some mysterious civilization in the cosmos.
What was known was that the game had layer upon layer of rules, controlling all the players and countless Races.
Encouraging these Races to fight each other,
As if it were a form of entertainment.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: 273: "The moonlight is nice tonight.
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 273: “The moonlight is nice tonight.
And their Snow Sea Project Team belonged to an alien race known as the “Oak Race,” a somewhat tongue-twisting name with distinctive racial characteristics.
Members of the race were all tall and slim, with no overweight individuals, and each had a crimson eye on their forehead.
Before reaching adulthood, this eye remained closed.
After reaching adulthood, the eye would open.
Through this eye, they could process the images before them more rapidly, as there was a transformation process from vision to the brain, which they could speed up.
In simple terms, this means,
when a bullet is fired at them, they can react and take evasive actions faster than others.
But whether they could actually dodge it was another matter.
After all, being quick to react is one thing, but compared to the speed of a bullet, this advantage might seem almost pointless.
The “Oak Race” had a huge Points deficit when they attempted to advance from the Threefold Planet to the Fourfold Planet and signed a gambling agreement with the leveling game.
In the end, they lost the bet.
All members of the race were forced to work unpaid for the leveling game until their Points debt was repaid before they could regain their freedom.
Therefore, their race was utterly divided, working in various locations for the leveling game.
Some served as bosses in certain maps.
Others, like this team, formed project groups, responsible for updating the versions for new Novice Planets and sticking with them through it all.
If a planet managed to level up to a onefold, twofold, threefold, or even fourfold, they would receive a substantial Points reward and certain hidden benefits.
But if a planet failed to survive even the Novice Period for any reason, they would be punished.
In the layer below the depths of hell, that sunless space, they would serve as Scavengers for a year.
They had failed several times before.
And had served as Scavengers for a number of years.
It was not a pleasant experience.
They feared death, but even more, they feared not being able to truly die.
In fact, players enveloped by the leveling game cannot truly die; if they die in hell, they will continue to serve as Scavengers in that dark space.
Desiring to truly die, they found it was impossible to achieve.
Compared to being a Scavenger, they’d rather die.
These momentarily imprisoned players were actually the most tormented, knowing they could get out, that they could return to a normal life, so they greatly despised the inhuman treatment reserved for Scavengers.
Unlike those players who died in hell and knew there was no possibility of leaving, eventually they adapted to the life of a Scavenger.
Even occasionally buying some chicken legs or a cola with points made them happy.
Completely assimilated.
Except for the “Gluttonous” race, this race was originally an extremely powerful one within the leveling game, hailing from the Fourfold Planet.
Once they learned of the Scavengers’ existence,
Without any hesitance,
All members of the race committed suicide en masse in hell, voluntarily plunging into that dark space to become Scavengers.
This race’s players always had an internal desire to eat, anything would do, but they had to eat incessantly, never feeling satiated, always remaining in a state of hunger.
They lived in a state of extreme anguish.
For them, being a Scavenger might not be a punishment but rather a chance to enjoy an endless buffet endlessly.
In the world of leveling games, these perplexing events that outsiders couldn’t understand were constantly unfolding.
The leveling game was too vast.
Even Starfield was an extremely minute existence within the leveling game.
…
About two hours passed.
August 22, 23:23.
A global announcement rang in the ears of all Blue Star players.
“Global announcement!”
“Hello, Blue Star players, my name is Jin Buhuan. On behalf of the Snow Sea Project Team, I would like to extend our thanks and apologies to all the Blue Star players for your cooperation over the past four months and for the disruption to your previously peaceful lives.”
“As you can see, a Twofold Planet, Logitech Star, has launched a Race Duel Battle against Blue Star.”
“In fact, not long ago, this Twofold Planet was a Threefold Planet, but it downgraded itself to avoid certain rules.”
“A Race Duel Battle is a war involving all members of both races, where everyone—whether elderly, weak, sick or newly born infants—must take up arms and step onto the battlefield.”
“It’s utterly brutal.”
“What’s more lethal is that the battlefield is set on an extremely vast plain with no cover available. Members of both races will face each other at close range for a relentless exchange of fire.”
“It’s a primitive and savage form of warfare that’s steeped in bloodshed.”
“Often used between two races with deep-rooted hatred.”
“Facing the entire Race Players from a Threefold Planet, it’s with great regret that I tell you, Blue Star will have 95% of its players instantly killed, and if more than 95% of the players are killed instantaneously, the Blue Star Race will be forcibly exterminated.”
“Permanently erased from the leveling game.”
“This is a battle that cannot be won, a war instigated by small-minded individuals, an unfair war.”
“But we can’t stop it.”
“I’m so sorry everyone, we tried our best, but… we are truly powerless.”
“If fate allows, we might meet somewhere again soon.”
“I wish you all good luck.”
“—Yours sincerely, all members of the Snow Sea Project Team, with our final message.”
As the message ended,
all Blue Star players fell into silence, no one spoke, they all just ceased what they were doing.

chapters.title: Chapter 296: 273: "The moonlight is good tonight."_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 273: “The moonlight is good tonight.”_2
But it didn’t take long.
The Blue Star players once again continued their actions.
In fact.
Since the first announcement, when the racial duel station was announced, the Blue Star players had already anticipated the outcome.
But deep down, there was still a faint glimmer of hope because Chen Yi was there.
It was just the Snow Sea Project Team’s announcement that snuffed out that last bit of hope in their hearts.
Chen Yi wouldn’t die.
But 95% of the Blue Star players would be instantaneously killed; at that time, Blue Star would be forcefully exterminated, and even if Chen Yi were powerful, he’d have to die with them.
Yet even so, they had no intention of giving up.
Even if death was certain, shouldn’t they struggle a bit?
…
“Hey, my Xiaoqian.”
Li Yide, with a somewhat vacant expression, kept tying TNT Prop onto himself while glancing at the couch where Xiaoqian had left her half-eaten potato chips.
He still missed Xiaoqian a bit.
That female ghost.
It was just a pity that it seemed there was no chance to see her again.
After that, he unconsciously shook his Fox Tail and looked in the mirror at his own smile wrapped in bombs, “Ever seen a missile before?”
He was ready.
Using the high maneuverability of Fox Tail, he would rush into the enemy’s midst at the start of the battle, then activate the TNT Prop on him, and like a missile, inflict massive damage among the enemies!
He was afraid of dying.
But faced with certain death, he didn’t mind playing the hero, to give the enemy a little Fox Tail shock.
…
Over at Skywake.
All the members were expressionlessly organizing their Props, not a single one considered surrendering—or rather, everyone knew that the enemy would not accept any surrender.
This was a war where there were no prisoners, no surrender, no negotiation.
There were only two outcomes.
Either Logitech Star would be exterminated, or their Blue Star would be.
There was no third option.
“Scared?”
Zhou Ziqiang was sitting on the back of a chair, turning his head to his deputy leader Chu Ge and smiling, “Does it feel like you’ve just gotten used to being the deputy leader and now the end of the world is upon us?”
Chu Ge was sent by Chen Yi to act as the deputy leader of Skywake.
“Scared?”
Chu Ge shook his head indifferently, “It’s just death, who’s afraid of that? I’m just a bit worried about not having someone to take down with me before dying, that would truly be a regret.”
“I wonder how strong that Logitech Star really is.”
“It must be very strong. Didn’t you hear that even the Snow Sea Project Team came out? The tone of that announcement was practically writing our Blue Star’s obituary.”
…
“Dad, Mom.”
Han Yu’s eyes shimmered with tears as he knelt in front of a middle-aged couple, his voice was hoarse as he roared, “Your son is incompetent, I can’t take care of you in your old age.”
“What the hell are you talking about.”
The middle-aged man looked at his son kneeling on the ground with some disbelief, “I’ve lived over 20 years more than you. Why are you crying here? If anyone should feel cheated, it’s you. Look at your grandfather, he lived nearly forty years more than you, and he’s the one who really profited.”
“It’s just a shame.”
The middle-aged woman standing at the dining table, while tying a class-C Prop longsword to her arm to prevent it from falling off due to impact, looked at Han Yu with a heartache and reluctance.
“Before dying, I couldn’t even find you a daughter-in-law.”
“That Snow Sea Project Team isn’t any good either, coming out with their fake goodbyes. If it had not been for the Scholar Sea Project Team, our Blue Star would still be at peace now. We wouldn’t have been dragged into this high-level game.”
“It’s better to die. Living every day with constant fear is exhausting. When the time comes, don’t worry about us. Try to break out and kill as many as you can. They’re riding roughshod over us, we can’t let the other side be too comfortable. There should be a few who should accompany us in death.”
…
“I’ll give you a chance then.”
The girl, who was sitting silently on a park bench with her childhood friend, spoke up first.
“Huh?”
The boy was stunned, glancing incredulously at the side profile of the girl beside him.
“What, you’re not willing?”
“I… I am willing, but how did you know I liked you?”
“Only a fool wouldn’t know that. Do you know why I always stressed that we’re just friends?”
“Because you don’t like me?”
“No, it’s because I’m not clean. Remember when you asked how I got that 200,000 when my father was seriously ill? A middle-aged man approached me and asked me to be his business travel companion, seven days for 200,000.”
“…”
The boy’s body, which had been somewhat clueless, suddenly stiffened on the spot, and after a long while, his lips trembled slightly as he asked, “Did you give it to him?”
“Heh.”
The girl, bracing herself with her hands on the chair, couldn’t help but shake her head and chuckle, “200,000 in seven days, huh? Do you think I wouldn’t have given it to him?”
“How many times?”
“Numerous times, I’ve lost count. That old man brought six clients in total.”
“Seven days, I accompanied them the whole time.”
“You…”
The boy couldn’t quite accept this, his lips turning pale and trembling, “You lost it to six clients in seven days?”
“Including that old man, it makes seven.”
“Don’t bother thinking about it. Everything you know, I gave. North, South, East, West—there wasn’t a hole I hadn’t given to. Those people knew exactly how to extract maximum value from 200,000. For a long time after returning, I didn’t suffer from constipation.”
After a moment of silence, the girl braced herself on the back of the chair, looked deep into the pitch-black park, and started swinging her legs, “Before that incident, I actually did consider being with you, getting married and settling down.”
“But suddenly my father fell seriously ill and needed 200,000. As his daughter, I couldn’t just watch my father die in front of me.”
“After I came back, I gradually distanced myself from you.”
“I wanted you to find a good home. I just didn’t expect you to like me for so long.”
“Will you hate me for telling you these things?”
“I could have stayed the pure childhood friend in your heart, but I thought continuing the lie till I die would be too beastly.”
“…”
After a long silence, the boy stiffly reached out his hand and gently placed it on the girl’s hand, gazing into the depths of the park and murmured.
“I don’t hate you. I only hate that I couldn’t help you at that time.”
“That sounds so much like a lovestruck fool. Don’t ever talk like that again.”
“Is there a future for ‘again’?”
“Right, I’m supposed to die at noon tomorrow.”
Without a sound, the girl gripped the boy’s hand tightly, rested her head on his shoulder, and sitting on the park bench, she shook her feet hanging in the air and suddenly laughed.
“You really don’t want one last time? You won’t have another chance.”
“If I never gave you even once before dying, I would actually feel quite regretful.”
“This world is so screwed up. It’s good to die. Whether the main game comes or not, this world hasn’t been kind to me. I’ve been wanting to leave for so long. I’m so tired.”
“You could be a bit rougher with me, not love me so gently. Actually, a big reason I always wanted to get away from you is because you loved me too much, were too good to me, which put a lot of pressure on me because I knew I couldn’t bear such immense love.”
“You could really just treat me like a worthless…”
Before she could finish,
The boy kissed her, his arms wrapping tight around her waist, their parched lips colliding in the night.
Like the last kiss before the end of the world.
…
Chen Yi remained silent from beginning to end, sitting quietly on the beach chair until the time reached 23:59.
He activated his A-level prop, “Galaxy Traction.”
This prop would decide the night sky based on his fortune for the next day.
The better the fortune, the more stars there would be, a sky full of stars.
The worse the fortune, the fewer the stars.
The prop activated quickly.
The scattered stars in the night sky all disappeared without a trace after 00:00.
The vast sky was completely devoid of stars.
A clean pitch black, as if the darkness swallowed all sounds.
A look of fear flashed in Jiaye’s eyes as she clung tightly to Chen Yi’s waist, as if in the next second he would disappear from her world forever.
While Tuberculosis Rabbit, Sword Without End, and the others looked up at the night sky above with grim faces, remaining silent.
Not a single star meant Chen Yi’s fortune for tomorrow would be extremely poor.
It was the kind of poor that was at its utmost extreme.
From a certain perspective, it could represent death.
No, it’s not quite right to say it could represent death. To be accurate, it already meant death.
The fortune was so poor that there wasn’t a single star.
“…”
Chen Yi looked up at the sky, and after a long silence, he lit a cigarette to his lips, stretched lazily, laid back on the beach chair, and suddenly laughed.
“Have you noticed that without the stars, the moon seems brighter?”
“The moonlight is nice tonight.”
…
ps: Misspellings will be corrected after publishing.

chapters.title: Chapter 297: 274: This Grudge, He Feng Yuan, Will Never Forget.
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Chapter 274: This Grudge, He Feng Yuan, Will Never Forget.
“…”
Sword Without End and the others remained silent, not speaking a word. They just stood still, continuously checking the props in their backpacks. This battle was completely different from any they had encountered before.
No matter how strong Yi was, he could only ensure his own safety.
He couldn’t keep them safe.
They could only rely on their own strength, but that was the Threefold Planet, an existence that had left the star system.
Starfield.
An existence they had never heard of, one they hadn’t even seen in the Number Three Star System, but now they had to face enemies from the Starfield.
Really.
Sword Without End shook his head with a helpless smile, gave up organizing the props in his backpack, and instead lit a cigarette and placed it in his mouth, hands in his pockets as he looked up at the distant sky.
Maybe it would be better to be dead.
That girl… she must be thinking of him too.
There was no need to organize the props anymore; he wasn’t even sure he’d have time to activate all the props in his backpack.
The neckline was very low, the black chest hair exposed, strikingly garish.
He was hairy, his forearms covered in sweat hair where his rolled-up suit sleeves exposed them, exuding a wild and untamed aura.
“Okay.”
Chen Yi seemed quite relaxed, lightly patting Jiaye, who was huddled against his back, before standing up from the beach chair and glancing at the others.
“Go back and rest, stop looking so gloomy.”
“There’s nothing in this world that can’t be resolved.”
“Yi.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit finally couldn’t help but open his mouth to say something. But after his lips parted and closed a few times, he murmured hesitantly, “Goodnight, Yi.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yi glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit and couldn’t help but laugh. He patted his shoulder, slowly squinting his eyes as he spoke softly.
“I remember I had you read the Bible; there’s a saying in it, ‘If someone strikes you on the left cheek, turn to them the other cheek also.'”
“Do you remember?”
“I do.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit responded in a confused whisper, “Back then, you pointed to that line and told me to think it over, to act less rashly in life and to be more benevolent.”
“You’re wrong.”
Chen Yi looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit and laughed softly.
“The meaning of that saying is, if someone wants to deal with you, you should handle yourself the way they intend to deal with you, and then get up and cut their head off.”
“Alright, go to sleep now.”
Having said that,
Chen Yi no longer paid attention to the others and instead stood up and walked towards the Crimson Palace.
…
Sword Without End and his companions looked at Chen Yi’s retreating figure with some bewilderment.
After exchanging looks, Sword Without End hesitantly spoke first, “I think I understand what Yi meant. For instance, when facing a thug with a knife, running away or resisting would just lead to a worse beating.”
“But what if, before the thug makes a move, you stab yourself first? Because the enemy wouldn’t anticipate that, and then you seize that opportunity to counterattack?”
“Is that what he meant?”
“I don’t know.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head, also puzzled, “That can’t be right. If you stab yourself before the enemy moves, isn’t that just nonsense?”
“Let’s go, time for sleep.”
“You still want to sleep? We’ll have plenty of time to sleep later.”
“Shouldn’t we strengthen ourselves for the final battle?”
“True.”
…
Tonight, many Blue Star players were unable to sleep.
No one could fall asleep.
All players from the Number Three Star System had their eyes focused on Blue Star tonight.
Blue Star had recently attracted a lot of attention, a planet still in its Novice Period had wiped out two races!
But as the saying goes, tall trees catch much wind, even attracting the Threefold Planet was truly beyond help.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, usually talkative in his sleep, didn’t say a word tonight, just lying quietly in bed.
All of Blue Star was exceptionally silent.
The night quickly passed.
As the sun slowly rose, the time arrived at 08:00 on August 23rd, with only four hours left until the battle began.
They hadn’t even experienced the Qixi Valentine’s Day special event.
A sudden announcement interrupted the thoughts of the players in the Number Three Star System.
「Star System Announcement!」
「Ding, Twofold Planet Logitech Star will officially launch a Race Duel Battle against Blue Star on August 23rd at 12:00. This battle is to the death, lasting one hour.’
「Moreover, this battle will be broadcast live.」
「Sponsored and live-streamed in its entirety by the Solar Star Project Team.」
Soon after,
A massive number of players flooded into the live stream. When many saw that the Solar Star Project Team was sponsoring the entire broadcast, they seemed to understand something.
Solar Star, wasn’t that the planet Chen Yi had wiped out?
The live stream was currently showing battle footage from the history of Logitech Star.
The players from this planet called themselves the Sharu Clan. They weren’t many, just over a hundred thousand, but they were extremely powerful, as could be seen from the footage playing in the stream.
A colossal beast, a kilometer long, roamed through the starry sky, swinging its tail with impunity, occasionally devouring a solitary Star Beast.
But soon, they were surrounded by players from the Sharu Clan, each holding an identical prop in their hands.
The next second—
Countless laser beams burst forth, instantly shattering the beast, which was a full kilometer long, into dust.
As if to deter the Blue Star players.
Within the live broadcast, the Sharu Clan’s battle footage repeated continuously.
…
Actually, the Blue Star players had already woken up, even those usually fond of sleeping in didn’t feel like wasting these precious minutes dozing off.
They stared indifferently at the Sharu Clan’s battle footage in the broadcast, remaining silent.
These were their enemies.
Four hours later, they would face them.
But just then—
As if deeming the camel hadn’t died quickly enough, more straw was piled on!
“Ding, system announcement!”
“Twofold Planet Terra Star has issued a forced Race Duel Battle to Zerofold Planet Blue Star!”
“…”
“The war will begin on August 23rd at 13:00 noon.”
–
“Ding, system announcement!”
“Twofold Planet Meiju Star has issued a forced Race Duel Battle to Zerofold Planet Blue Star!”
“…”
“The war will begin on August 23rd at 14:00 noon.”
–
“Ding, system announcement!”
“Twofold Planet Red Plum Star has issued a forced Race Duel Battle to Zerofold Planet Blue Star!”
“…”
“The war will begin on August 23rd at 15:00 in the morning.”
–
“Ding, system announcement!”
“Twofold Planet Duoga Star has issued a forced Race Duel Battle to Zerofold Planet Blue Star!”
“…”
“The war will begin on August 23rd at 16:00 in the morning.”
…
Four consecutive star systems rang abruptly in the ears of all players in the Number Three Star System!
Almost instantly, the players in the broadcast room exploded into chaos!
“Terra Star? Isn’t that the planet that advanced to the threefold trial alongside Logitech Star and left the Number Three Star System? They’ve also demoted themselves to the twofold planet level?”
“The same goes for Meiju Star, which even advanced earlier than Logitech Star, a veteran threefold planet; this time Meiju Star has also demoted itself down a tier to join us in the Number Three Star System?”
“All these planets are ones that ascended from the Number Three Star System, haven’t been seen for many years, and now they’re back!”
“Wait, how come you all seem familiar with them, and we’ve never heard of any?”
“Nonsense, you from Number Nine Star just left the Novice Period not long ago; naturally, you wouldn’t have heard. We have been in the Number Three Star System for quite some time, and even had dealings with players from these planets before, though we’ve never actually fought them.”
“This Duoga Star and Red Plum Star are from the same era as Meiju Star, and now they’ve all taken the step down to rejoin the Number Three Star System, declaring a race extermination war against Blue Star.”
“It’s outrageous!!! From noon till 16:00 in the afternoon, what are they playing at? Afraid one planet can’t kill Chen Yi, so they’re resorting to a wheel war?”
“I can’t make heads or tails of it either. Is the Hundred Generations Bounty really worth only a few hundred million Points? Is it worthy of so many planets demoting a tier to come to the Number Three Star System and exterminate Chen Yi for the bounty?”
“That’s not quite right, it doesn’t look like a wheel war, it’s more like… a show of force.”
A politically savvy player felt something was amiss and spoke up, “To deal with Blue Star, one Logitech Star would be enough, even more than enough. It looks like they’re making a show of force against certain individuals.”
“As if to say, this is the fate of those who offend him.”
“Blue Star seems to be made an example of.”
“It’s probably not just about the bounty anymore. The following planets’ Race Duel Battles probably won’t actually happen, as it won’t even be their turn. Blue Star won’t survive past Logitech Star. It’s more of a formality, to show those in the shadows that this is the consequence of crossing us.”
“This Chen Yi… still doesn’t quite get it. It’s not just about being powerful in the twofold game; it’s all about relations and social conduct.”
…
“Thank you, everyone.”
At a platform somewhere in the Number Three Star System, a young man with a rather youthful face, raising a glass of red wine in his hand and looking down at the crowd below, said with a smile.
“I’m honored that you’ve all chosen to attend this time, giving face to Mr. Feng.”
“The losses incurred by demoting this time will be triple-compensated by Mr. Feng to all of you.”
And the crowd below was quick to flatter, raising their glasses in agreement.
“Mr. Feng, what are you saying? For us, demoting a tier is virtually no loss. After all, with our strength, even if we go through the threefold map trial again, it’s just a process.”
“If we want to return, we can do so in minutes.”
“Exactly, it’s our honor to serve Mr. Feng, and we hope that when Mr. Feng returns to the Starfield Project Team, he will provide us with more support.”
“Certainly, certainly.”
The young man smiled and nodded, then turned his head to look at the broadcast’s screen, a flash of coldness and ruthlessness crossing his eyes. He took a sip of his red wine and remained silent.
He was the person in charge of the Solar Star project.
Solar Star was cultivated by his own hands, a work which took several years, and it was about to pass the twofold trial and ready to tackle the threefold trial map.
And then it was annihilated by Chen Yi.
Years of hard work wasted in an instant, gone.
This grudge, he, Feng Yuan, couldn’t forget.

chapters.title: Chapter 298: 275: Known to All, Feared by the World for the Killings!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: Chapter 275: Known to All, Feared by the World for the Killings!!
The only saving grace was,
though Solar Star had been wiped out, at least, it passed the trial of the Newbie Protection Period for Twofold Planet. Although they had to face punishment, they wouldn’t be demoted to become Scavengers.
But the Snow Sea Project Team on Blue Star wasn’t so lucky.
A project team that didn’t pass the Newbie Protection Period would all be demoted to serve as Scavengers in the deeper depths of hell for a whole year.
That certainly wasn’t a pleasant time.
Thinking of this, the corners of his mouth couldn’t help but turn upwards slightly, his heart feeling a surge of pleasure.
Chen Yi, a damn newbie player, relying on some luck to destroy his years of foundations!
He really deserved to die!!!
After the extinction of Solar Star’s race, having paid a certain penalty, his project team was disbanded, and with his family’s influence, he joined the Starfield Project Team.
Starfield was different from the Third Star System.
In the Third Star System, the project teams didn’t have very close relationships with the players.
But in Starfield, it was different.
There, the interests between the project teams and the players were closely intertwined. The teams relied on their planets leveling up to gain massive amounts of Points and status, while the planet players relied on the teams for some leaks on the gaming rules.
They had a mutually beneficial relationship.
Both in the struggle to rise up within the game.
And while Feng Yuan had joined the Starfield Project Team through his family connections, he was still a newcomer there with no foundations and wasn’t in charge of any planet of his own.
At this moment—
These Twofold Planets from the Third Star System approached him.
After all, no matter what, he had emerged from a Twofold Planet, and, by rights, these Twofold Planets felt somewhat closer to him, almost like kin. They wouldn’t cheat him, right?
On the family front,
there was considerable opposition to him. The family had provided him with the utmost resources, yet the planet he was shepherding hadn’t even managed to pass the Twofold Planet trial.
This not only caused him to lose face completely but also posed a slight threat; more and more people were eyeing his position as successor.
He had to kill Blue Star and that damn Chen Yi in the Third Star System with a thunderous approach!
And he must bare his fangs!
Only by doing so could he quiet the outside voices of criticism a bit. He had to kill, and do so conspicuously, so that his actions were known by all, feared by the world!!!
Just then—
A communication interface suddenly flashed in front of him.
After the communication was connected,
Feng Yuan instantly returned to his usual composure, looking respectfully at the middle-aged man on the screen: “Uncle.”
The middle-aged man in the screen was also a member of the Starfield Project Team but not in charge of managing planets; instead, he was the person in charge of external affairs. Complaints from all other project teams in different star systems ended up in his hands.
“Just now, the Snow Sea Project Team from Blue Star has filed another complaint to me, and I have sent it back to them.”
“Complaints are useless, everything we do complies with the rules of the leveling game.”
“Or rather, if something doesn’t comply with the rules, we can’t do it; we won’t even be able to.”
“Once this loophole in the rules is used, it will be patched up in the next update, and you know a rules loophole is not something the Feng Family can afford to waste.”
“Since we’ve used it, it has to be splendidly executed, to show the petty ones what fate awaits those who offend the Feng Family. Understand?”
“Understood, Uncle, rest assured!”
Feng Yuan nodded solemnly and earnestly before ending the communication.
The Feng Family.
A considerable force within the Starfield Project Team, which, through years of accumulation, had nearly a quarter of the Starfield Project Team under its control.
The members of the Starfield Project Team usually advanced from the Star System Project Team.
For instance, his failed Solar Star, if it could’ve advanced to become a Threefold Planet, he would have legitimately become a member of the Starfield Project Team, rather than using some tricks.
This so-called loophole in the rules referred to specialists hired by his family to research loopholes in the leveling game’s rules, which were then collected for use against enemies, striking a Fatal Blow.
Any loophole in the rules would typically be patched up after being used once in the next version update.
Which meant that any such loophole was essentially one-time use.
Although the Feng Family had a significant influence in the Starfield Project Team, due to the rules limitations, they couldn’t even take the initiative against a player weak to the extreme.
They could only use such methods to remove some enemies.
Strictly speaking, project teams were supposed to remain absolutely neutral and not have too much contact with players, but as the saying goes, where there are people, there’s a Mart.
With interests involved, absolute neutrality is impossible.
…
*Sigh!*
In the Snow Sea Project Team office above Blue Star, Jin Buhuan leaned back in his chair and exhaled slowly. After remaining silent for a while, with a calm face, he abruptly stood up and threw an ornament from the desk against the wall with substantial anger and a ferocious roar.
“A den of rats and snakes!”
“The way that Starfield Project Team’s external affairs officer speaks, it’s beyond favoritism; he’s outright standing with Logitech Star!”
Even a fool could see,
this time, it wasn’t just for the bounty that Logitech Star and the other planets had come—they were also seeking revenge for the Solar Star Project Team and even sending a warning!
Five whole Threefold Planets taking action against one that hadn’t even seen the end of its Newbie Protection Period!
You really went all out!
You guys really have the nerve to do such shameless things!
But then he suddenly grinned, his eyes squinting with malicious gleam as he looked at the live stream, as if he could see right through the screen and make out the few people behind it.
Perhaps, I’m going to disappoint you.
You have no shame.
But someone doesn’t value their life.
He had stayed up all night, waiting, waiting for Chen Yi to use the A-grade Skill “Requesting the Mandate of Heaven,” and he had guessed some of the questions Chen Yi would ask.
Like, is there an invincible race Prop that can be obtained? Like Solar Star has.
Or is there a way to avoid this war?
Or how to obtain more powerful Props.
He was already prepared to respond with resignation that these things could not be provided, no way.
Although the A-grade Skill “Requesting the Mandate of Heaven,” in theory, can accomplish anything as long as a price is paid, the definition of anything is within the capabilities of the Snow Sea Project Team.
An invincible race Prop, they in the Snow Sea Project Team truly did not have the authority.
Like altering the trials of Solar Star’s Twofold map, as long as Chen Yi was willing to pay 5 million Points, they could submit an application for the game leveling up, that was in accordance with the rules, as long as a price was paid.
But—
Last night, Chen Yi did indeed ask him a few questions, but not one of them was among the ones listed above — rather, they were seemingly trivial ones.
He even spent less than tens of thousands of Points.
Yet from these questions, he had roughly discerned Chen Yi’s plan, and if Chen Yi’s plan succeeded, then Blue Star really could overcome this calamity!
If they could just overcome this calamity!
Let Chen Yi and Blue Star slowly develop, he believed that one day in the future, these Threefold Planets that dared to offend them would all be annihilated in the cosmic river of history!
Like Solar Star!
Completely exterminated!
…
Consecutive declarations of Race Duel Battles by four planets could not stir even a ripple in the hearts of Blue Star players, or it could be said that they had become desensitized over the course of a single night.
The majority of Blue Star players had come to terms with the notion of death.
What they considered was only one thing — how to kill as many enemies as possible before dying.
And so, time slowly ticked to 12:00.
The moment the clock hand hit 12:00!
The announcement rang out!
“Ding, 12:00 has arrived, Twofold Planet Logitech Star has officially declared a Race Duel Battle against Zerofold Planet Blue Star, considering the slight disparity in power between the two planets, the battle will last for at most one hour.”
“Please players from both sides enter the battlefield!”
“During the Race Duel Battle, the monthly rules are invalidated.”
As the voice faded!
All players from Blue Star, including the old, weak, sick, and disabled were transported to a vast plain!
A teeming mass stood on the plain, from a high vantage point, they resembled an ant colony sprawled below!
Not far on the opposite side stood about one hundred thousand Sharu Clan players, with ruthless light flickering in their eyes as they stared intently at them, these Sharu players had lanky bodies and extremely bizarre faces, androgynous in appearance and eerily peculiar to look at.
The number of Blue Star players was far greater than that of the Sharu Clan.
But no one thought that Blue Star would win this battle.
Barring the players from both sides was a towering barrier, on which a glaring and blood-red ten-minute countdown was displayed.
“10:00”
“09:59”
“09:58”
This ten-minute period was given for both sides to prepare, and when the countdown ended, the brutal slaughter would officially begin!
There were no complex terrains!
Just a face-to-face slaughter on an open plain!
In reality, due to the overwhelming power disparity, Blue Star was already given some consideration — the battle would only last one hour. In a true Race Duel Battle, it ends only when one race is completely dead and the battlefield barrier can be opened.
Of course, when the discrepancy in strength is too vast, there isn’t much difference between battle lasting one hour and three hours.
And most of the time, when a Threefold Planet receives the call to a Race Duel Battle, they would choose to decline.
But only a Threefold Planet has that privilege.
Zerofold Planets do not.
After all, initiating a Race Duel Battle against a Zerofold Planet is fundamentally an exploitation of a loophole in the rules, and Blue Star could only be forced to accept.
“It’s starting, it’s starting.”
The viewers in the live stream held their breaths, not knowing why there had been frequent live broadcasts recently, but this one might be Chen Yi’s swan song.
And Li Peiqi also stared at the live stream, her eyelashes trembling slightly as she clutched the corners of her own clothes tightly.
She hadn’t been able to contact Chen Yi.
She could only go to Blue Star Hell, or act as an NPC on some map, but since Chen Yi hadn’t entered any map and hadn’t gone to hell, she had no chance to meet him.
Unable to deliver the message!
But it seemed Logitech Star also hadn’t taken her father’s advice — her father’s advice was to kill Jiaye beforehand.

chapters.title: Chapter 299: 276: "You try to take down me?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Chapter 276: “You try to take down me?!
Whether it was confidence or a sheer inability to heed advice, Logitech Star had disregarded her father’s recommendation and initiated the Race Duel Battle based on his own methods.
Li Peiqi looked at her A-level Prop “Last Words” with a complex expression crossing her face.
As of last night at 00:00.
Her Prop had updated.
No longer would she die “at the hands of Chen Yi.”
But rather… “in the jaws of a certain Star Beast.”
This updated prediction left her somewhat at a loss. Did this mean she wouldn’t encounter Chen Yi in her future anymore?
Or did it mean… Chen Yi wouldn’t survive today?
“Huff!”
Li Peiqi let out a sigh. For a moment, she didn’t know quite how to feel—somewhat relieved yet also concerned. The Sword of Damocles that had hung over her head had finally vanished. She should be feeling relieved.
But for some reason,
The thought of Chen Yi dying made her feel strangely conflicted inside.
How could he just die like that?
But the A-level Prop “Last Words” never erred.
Perhaps Chen Yi was really just a memory, soon to be forgotten by all players, until many years later.
No need even for many years.
A few months would suffice.
In the upgradable game, with its ever-fresh happenings, no one would continuously remember the name of a dead man, no matter how powerful he had been in life.
…
At this moment, the countdown had reached “08:53.”
In another eight minutes, the protective barrier would vanish and the battle would truly begin.
“Boss!”
Standing behind Li Yide, a subordinate with shaky legs and a tearful voice spoke up, “Do we really have to stand at the very front? Can’t we move a bit to the back?”
“I’m a bit scared.”
“Scared?”
Li Yide tightened the bomb strapped to his body and took firm steps toward the protective barrier; when his face pressed against it, he was ready to initiate a suicidal charge as soon as the barrier dispersed.
Staring intently at the Sharu Clan players on the other side of the barrier, he whispered.
“Our only chance to live is to charge fast enough.”
“Dying now means plunging into hell. If Chen Yi kills all those bastards on the other side, Blue Star won’t face extinction. If we’re not extinguished, we have a chance to crawl out of hell.”
“But if Chen Yi doesn’t kill faster than the other side, and Blue Star is extinguished, then we’re truly dead.”
“Do you get it?”
“This battle is basically a race between Chen Yi and the enemy to see who kills faster. If 95% of a Race’s players are killed in one go, that Race will be forced into extinction.”
“What we have to do is to kill one more enemy with our lives before 95% of the Blue Star players are dead, to help Chen Yi.””
“By killing one more enemy,”
“We reduce the chances of Blue Star’s extinction a bit more.”
“And we also increase our own chances of survival a bit more.”
“Fear at this time is not cowardice but folly.”
“Understand?”
After a long silence, the subordinate following Li Yide finally pulled out his Prop, pressing his cheek against the barrier while fiercely staring at the Sharu Clan players opposite them.
“I understand, boss. Today, I’ll be a hero too.”
…
“I’m going!”
Han Yu let go of his mother’s hand and exchanged a glance with his father; both firmly holding their weapons, they fixed their gaze on the Sharu Clan players across the barrier, ready to strike the moment it fell.
…
“Let’s go.”
The young couple, who had confirmed their relationship in the park the night before, looked at each other and took their stand hand in hand in front of the barrier, at the very forefront.
This spot, once the war began, was usually the first to fall.
One by one, more and more players stepped out of the crowd and took their places at the forefront.
Emotions are contagious.
Players who had initially felt some fear were now clenching their teeth, eyes filled with rage and ferocity, glaring at the Sharu Clan players across from them.
…
“These Blue Star players seem to have a good spirit, not showing much fear even in the face of a race extinction battle.”
“After all, they’re from the Novice Planet that went through ‘Calm and Cool’s’ monthly rule. Players who’ve survived that during their Novice Period tend to be mentally strong.”
The live streaming room was bustling with discussions.
“It’s just a pity that Blue Star is still in the Novice Period; even with Chen Yi’s strength, it’s useless. As soon as 95% of the players are killed, Blue Star will be forced into extinction, and Chen Yi will be forcibly erased.”
“What’s the use of being strong then?”
“If Blue Star could just have a little development time, then the outcome of this war would be completely uncertain.”
“You’re saying ‘if.’ There are too many ifs.”
“It’s a pity.”
“What’s there to pity? Better dead. Otherwise, once Blue Star successfully makes it past the Novice Period and into the third Star System, aren’t we the ones who would suffer?”
“That’s true too.”
…
“What are those ants doing? Do they think that dying at the front will be less painful?”
On the opposite side of the barrier,
Mr. Qiang stood with his hands in his pockets, a derisive sneer at the corner of his mouth, shoulder shrugging, not taking this group of Blue Star players seriously at all.
Though their numbers were indeed substantial.
But if the number of players determined the strength of a Race, then the Insect Race would have become Invincible Under the Heavens!
At this moment,
a hoarse voice suddenly reached his ear.
“Less than six minutes to go until the barrier drops, activate Apocalypse, prepare to Charge,”
The moment this voice faded,

chapters.title: Chapter 300: 276: "Try and snuff me out?!"_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Chapter 276: “Try and snuff me out?!”_2
Mr. Qiang’s disdainful expression disappeared, and he spoke reverently, “Understood!”
It was an order from Sharlu·Enzyme.
In the Sharu Clan, only one individual carried a surname, and that was their king.
In a Race Duel Battle, setting aside the Hell Players, all players, no matter where they were, would be forced into the battle!
And Apocalypse was an A-class Prop.
More precisely, it was a part of an S-class Prop.
A complete S-class Prop was an armed starship, and Apocalypse was the main cannon of this starship. Although classified as an A-class Prop, the power it unleashed was far from inferior to an S-class Prop.
With one shot!
At least half of the Blue Star players would be wiped from the screen. Plus, with their other means, they could almost exterminate over 95% of the Blue Star players within ten seconds!
So what if Chen Yi was extremely powerful?
If Blue Star was forced into extermination, you, Chen Yi, would also drop dead.
Under this rule, individual strength was meaningless no matter how formidable one was.
Mr. Qiang sneered, took out the Apocalypse from his bosom and activated it. Instantly a main cannon with a caliber of a hundred meters wide appeared, its muzzle constantly flickering with starlight as it charged up. It aimed to deliver a fatal blow to the inferior race on the other side of the protective shield after it fell.
Prepare to be baptized by the artillery fire.
Although using such a Prop against a planet player still in the Novice Period was somewhat unreasonable, there was no help for it. The core rule of the upgrade game had, from beginning to end, really only been one.
The law of the jungle.
If you’re weak, you deserve to die.
…
Chen Yi, who had been standing in the same place since entering the battlefield, was unusually dressed in a white suit today, leaning on a cane with one hand, looking at the Sharu players behind the protective shield who were smirking at them.
His expression was calm, not saying a word.
“Want one?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit took out a cigarette and threw it into Sword Without End’s chest, “Did I ever tell you that I’m really scared of dying without having had a smoke?”
“You’ve mentioned it.”
“Have I? I don’t remember ever telling you that?”
“You’ve said it many times.”
Before Tuberculosis Rabbit could continue speaking.
Chen Yi slowly laid the corpse of Jiaye next to him on the ground. The Wife-Killing Maniac buff had been activated, and then he turned his head to look at Sword Without End.
“Can you manage the next five hours?”
Sword Without End glanced at Jiaye’s corpse next to him and after a moment of silence spoke, “Every time we come out of hell, the difficulty doubles. Jiaye and I have gone in many times, and the difficulty keeps doubling.”
“But Yi, rest assured, I’ll risk my life to bring Jiaye back.”
“Good.”
Chen Yi nodded slightly, took a deep sigh, and after a long silence looking down at Jiaye’s peaceful face, his gaze gradually firmed up. He raised his head to look at the Sharu Clan players behind the protective shield.
He took a slow step forward and spoke softly.
“The humiliation of today shall be scrubbed clean with the blood of tens of millions from the Alien Race.”
“Insult our human race.”
“You all… deserve to die.”
His lightweight voice, filled with intense bloodlust, transmitted into the ears of every player watching the live broadcast, as well as into the ears of the Sharu Clan players on the other side.
There were only 5 minutes left on the protective shield!
Before the audience in the live broadcast room could react.
The next second—
B-class Prop “Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle”!
B-class Prop “Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom”!
B-class Prop “Forever Pure” activated!
B-class Prop “Seven-Star Badge” activated!
C-grade Skill “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans” activated!
B-grade Prop “Buddha’s Fury” activated!
B-grade Prop “Wildfire” activated!
Countless props and skills were activated in an instant, and the originally empty plain was suddenly filled to the brim with otherworldly Flowers of the Other Shore. The Blue Star players, yet to react, began transforming into Floral People upon contact with these flowers!
Bullets filled the sky, dancing wildly in the air!
Every single bullet carried the effect of “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans”!
Countless Buddha figures sat cross-legged on Lotus Platforms, holding Fire God Gatlings in their hands, and began indiscriminately spraying down at the Blue Star players on the ground!
Meteors trailing blazing flames descended rapidly toward the densely packed Blue Star players!
It was almost in the blink of an eye!
The Blue Star players were mostly dead or injured!
And the live stream room was already flooded with question marks.
“?”
“??”
“What the hell is going on? The shield hasn’t even disappeared yet, and Chen Yi has almost killed his own people?”
“What does this mean? He’d rather wipe out his own race than let it be exterminated by an alien race? What kind of samurai spirit is this?”
“Could it be a blunder? Did Chen Yi forget that the protective shield hadn’t ended and activated the prop to strike first, then accidentally involved his own people?”
“I don’t know, man. I was trembling a bit from Chen Yi’s words just now, but then the next second, he started wiping out his own race. I’m totally dumbfounded.”
“Wait a minute—”
Suddenly, a player in the live stream room’s pupils shrank violently and spoke in a trembling voice, “If a player is killed in one blow by an alien race player, it’s considered a forced extermination of their race. But what if they are killed in one blow by a player of the same race?”
Silence fell. Everyone was staring straight at the screen inside the live stream room. Although they had seen this scene several times already, each time they couldn’t help but marvel at how there could be such a twistedly powerful newcomer.
The Sharu players on the other side of the protective shield began with sneers and disdain, thinking Chen Yi had lost his mind, until their expressions gradually turned ugly.
It seemed like the situation was beginning to look wrong.
A few minutes quickly passed.
The protective shield between the two races slowly faded.
At this point, Chen Yi, disheveled, his hair covered with sticky blood and utterly messy, his originally pure white suit was already soaked crimson with thick blood.
After the smoke had cleared, only Chen Yi stood in the same spot like a crazed demon.
At Chen Yi’s feet lay a horizon of Blue Star players’ corpses, drenched by the sticky pool of blood, making the plain seem soaked through.
The entire scene looked like Hell itself. Those of weaker disposition who saw this scene would bear an indelible psychological shadow for life.
Except for Chen Yi, not a single Blue Star player was left standing.
The Blue Star Race had been exterminated.
By Chen Yi himself.
But not completely, for Chen Yi was still alive.
As if feeling the protective shield dissipate, Chen Yi, standing amidst countless corpses, slowly lifted his head, his pupils filled with red blood vessels stared directly at the nearby Sharu players, his mouth slowly curling into a smile.
He raised his staff towards the alien race players and sneered.
“Exterminate my Blue Star Race?”
“Try it, I dare you!”
“Come on, I’ll play with you slowly, you like exterminations, right?!”
“Every race that declared war today, I, Chen Yi, swear in this life not to rest until I’ve wiped out your entire race, or I’m no better than a son of a bitch!”
…
PS: Typographical errors will be corrected post-publishing.

chapters.title: Chapter 301: 277: So close, just a little bit more.
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: Chapter 277: So close, just a little bit more.
An endless aura of killing intent was released from Chen Yi’s body, even materializing in the air and causing the surrounding temperature to drop rapidly!
There wasn’t a single intact corpse around, countless fragments of bodies stretched beyond sight, and the thick blood on the ground resembled strawberry jam stirred with cheese, viscous and nauseating.
All the players who were watching this scene in the livestream couldn’t help but inhale sharply, their expressions a mix of disbelief and a hint of fear as they looked at the scene on the screen.
The temperature across Star System 3 had risen a few degrees because of this.
Before Chen Yi’s arrival, they had never seen such a ruthless person capable of annihilating an entire race.
Then Chen Yi came, and they witnessed it.
They originally thought this was the limit, but Chen Yi soon made them realize that something more ruthless than exterminating another race was exterminating one’s own.
“Oh my God…”
A player from System Nine, looking at Chen Yi standing amidst the fragments of corpses, swallowed subconsciously, experiencing such intense fear over a player for the first time.
It wasn’t just about the gap in strength.
It was also a fear of mindset.
They had originally thought that Logitech Star wiping out Logitech Star was an unquestionable outcome, especially when one was a Threefold Planet and the other was just a Zerofold Planet that hadn’t even passed the Newbie Protection Period. The difference between them was huge.
But looking at it now, the outcome seemed uncertain.
The Blue Star Race had been exterminated by Chen Yi himself, and the plan to instantly kill 95% of Blue Star players to cause the race to be annihilated was now completely foiled. The only option left was to face Chen Yi head-on.
But Chen Yi… was not so easy to kill. This was a man who had singlehandedly exterminated two races.
…
“…”
Looking at the scene on the screen, Li Peiqi’s breathing nearly came to an uncontrollable halt. Moments later, her eyes flickered with unshakable fear, almost breaking into tears as she muttered with a sob in her voice.
“Chan, how did I get involved with someone like him when I haven’t done anything?”
She considered herself the most tragic.
From beginning to end, she really hadn’t done anything, even trying everything possible to avoid Chen Yi. But for some reason, she always ended up dying at his hand.
Her Last Words, updated early yestermorning, had already changed the death outcome from being by Chen Yi’s hand, and the huge weight in her heart had finally lifted. But now, it seemed that Chen Yi was going to be hard to kill.
Suddenly feeling very tired.
This wasn’t fair.
…
“It’s okay.”
After a moment of silence, the leader of the Black Dragon Guild shifted his gaze away from the screen and closed his eyes before speaking softly, “Although Chen Yi’s actions maximally avoided the annihilation of Blue Star, it has also placed him on the needle’s point.”
“Strictly speaking, the Blue Star players are now only Chen Yi.”
“As long as Chen Yi dies, Blue Star will be exterminated.”
“The players from Logitech Star can now concentrate all their energy on Chen Yi for the next hour. If they kill him, everything ends.”
The voice was calm.
But one could still faintly sense a hint of regret. He felt he might have made a wrong bet; Chen Yi was stronger than he had thought. If Chen Yi could indeed survive this crisis, his previous betrayal to Logitech Star would become a ticking time bomb.
He fell silent and didn’t speak again.
In reality, there was no other choice. Everyone hesitates and makes bets at numerous crossroads in life.
No one can be sure they are always right. Since a choice has been made, one can only wait patiently for the result.
Whatever the result, it was a choice they once made.
Moreover, he might not necessarily lose.
…
“Yes!!!”
In the command center of the Snow Sea Project Team above Blue Star, Jin Buhuan’s eyes were bloodshot and red, with an expression both ferocious and excited as he bellowed and punched the air, “Yes!!!”
Although this move greatly harmed Blue Star!
At least they had dodged a near-certain annihilation!
If it came to a head-on fight, Blue Star’s strength was almost certain to be annihilated by Logitech Star instantly, as it wasn’t a battle on the same level.
But the question now was whether Chen Yi could survive this hour.
If he survived, everything would be great!
If not… Blue Star still couldn’t escape the tragic fate of annihilation.
But at least from the beginning of hopeless despair, they now saw a glimmer of hope.
Jin Buhuan stared intently at the livestream, motionless for fear of missing any key information. He wanted to do something, but unfortunately, as the head of the Snow Sea, he could only watch as a third party most of the time.
He couldn’t join the fight.
He couldn’t provide any props or the like either.
He was just an entity acting under the rules, with a level and privileges not much different from Blue Star’s, nothing more than abiding by the rules, with little else he could do.
Everything was left to Chen Yi to handle now.
Nearly a hundred members of the Snow Sea Project Team clasped their hands together, looking toward Chen Yi in the center of the screen and whispering prayers.
They were praying not only for their future but also for their lives.
Win!
Chen Yi’s destiny would soar, and he might even swiftly get through the threefold trial maps after the Novice Period ended, and they would rise with him!
Lose!
They would all be imprisoned in the hellish level below, in that eternally dark space, serving as Scavengers for a year.
…
After spitting out a mouthful of blood-tinged phlegm, Chen Yi took out a cigarette from his chest pocket, put it into his mouth, lit it, and then broke into a sinister laugh.
“Do you like a sea of flowers?”
The next second—
Endless Red Spider Lilies suddenly appeared in mid-air, covering the sky and smashing down, like a sea of flowers, from above the heads of the tens of thousands of Logitech Star players nearby!
At the same time!
Countless meteors burning with flames!
Tens of thousands of Buddhas seated cross-legged on Lotus Platforms, each wielding a Fire God Gatling!
A myriad of bullets whirling around like a violent storm!
Everything in front of them was as blinding as the apocalypse!
It was even impossible to see where Chen Yi and the Logitech Star players were anymore; one could only see the apocalyptic attacks churning incessantly!!!
“Die for me!!!!”
Chen Yi roared fiercely, as blossom after blossom of Red Spider Lilies bloomed non-stop, and bullet after bullet roared as they shot out fiercely!!
However, the next second—
“Boom!!!!”
A laser beam with a diameter of a full hundred meters pierced through the Red Spider Lilies and the myriad of flying bullets, heading straight for Chen Yi!!!
Almost instantly, a silent path was cleared through the chaotic battlefield!
And the laser beam engulfed Chen Yi in the blink of an eye!
“Ah!!”
The affected Chen Yi, clenching his teeth tightly, his eye bulging in a terrifying manner as his body was almost instantaneously beginning to melt from the laser’s touch!
The first to melt was his fashion.
Then his skin, flesh, bones.
His skin and meridians fell off like candles in high heat, like quicksilver dropping swiftly, but immediately under Forever Pure’s effect, they healed in an instant!
The agony of the whole process made Chen Yi roar involuntarily!
This was unbearable pain for a human!
It made even Chen Yi, who had always had a high tolerance for pain, scream out of agonizing pain!
However, Chen Yi’s hands did not stop, the sky-full of attacks continued to swirl, becoming even more frequent, sweeping numerous Logitech Star players into death with no burial place.
And quickly activating the Mechanical Elk snow sled to leave the place, escaping the reach of the laser beam.
But even after having escaped the range of the laser beam, his body was still melting rapidly, the pain not diminishing even slightly, and the speed of melting was even faster now.
Forever Pure could no longer keep up with the speed of melting.
If it continued like this,
At the moment Forever Pure failed to activate in time, he would dissolve into a pool of blood, dying right there, and after his death, Blue Star would be forcibly exterminated.
He was now the only official player of Blue Star.
He died,
Blue Star would be forcibly exterminated; this was the highest rule, with no one exempted.
At this moment—
Countless props and skills came crashing towards him from the hands of the Logitech Star players; there was no time to dodge, and the intense pain even made his thoughts dissipate.
Forever Pure was too late.
Unless.
A trace of unwillingness flashed in Chen Yi’s eyes, he glanced over at the still numerous Logitech Star players, and slowly closed his eyes, activating the Bikini Beach Chair and lying down on it.
He intended to withstand the attack and annihilate Logitech Star right here.
But… he was just a little short.
Logitech Star players had a number of bizarre defensive props, and his level of attack spread across the sky actually killed less than ten thousand Logitech Star players.
Yet, he was slightly unable to withstand the attack of the Logitech Star players. Forever Pure was a skill similar to invincibility, and once activated, it could instantly restore the body to a perfect state.
Even on the brink of death, one could be instantly restored to perfect condition.
But he felt that he had reached his limit. If he tried to withstand that wave of attacks any longer, he probably wouldn’t survive, and whether Forever Pure could activate in time was uncertain.
If it were any other time, he might have taken the chance, at worst, taking a trip to hell.
But not now.
He can’t die now, his death would mean the extermination of Blue Star.
Just a bit more, just a little bit more.
He needed a stronger offensive prop and a stronger defensive prop so that he could wipe out these Logitech Star players right here.
As for now,
He needed to stay alive.
The moment Chen Yi lay on the Bikini Beach Chair, the Red Spider Lilies and all attacks from the Fire God Buddhas in the sky instantly disappeared.
Lying on the Bikini Beach Chair granted the effect of Absolute Defense.
But the price was that one couldn’t leave the beach chair and was unable to attack.
By that time, Chen Yi’s body had almost melted; his legs had long since lost their flesh and blood, leaving only two extremely clean bones.
His abdomen had countless holes as if gnawed by locusts, and in total, the man probably weighed no more than 40 pounds of flesh and blood.
It was a miracle he was still alive.
Forever Pure couldn’t keep up with the pace. In terms of density, the attacks from the Logitech Star players were far denser than those from the Solar Star players, after all, there were only tens of thousands of players from Logitech Star.
But when it came to aggression, it was not at all on the same level.

chapters.title: Chapter 302: 278: "To exterminate the Blue Star, Chen Yi must be killed.
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: Chapter 278: “To exterminate the Blue Star, Chen Yi must be killed.
The props and skills in the hands of Logitech Star players were superior, and almost every attack could deal lethal damage to him, and the Logitech Star players seemed to know that he possessed the “Forever Pure” prop.
All the players were divided into five batches to carry out tactical covering strikes against him.
Even if “Forever Pure” was activated instantly, there would still be a slight delay, which the adversaries exploited.
But even with severe injuries, Chen Yi’s life was not yet in immediate danger.
As he lay on the beach chair, he assumed an “Absolute Defense” posture, ensuring he wouldn’t die from any injury, though whether or not he would survive after getting up from the beach chair was another issue.
Though this prop was an A-level item, its rule priority was extremely high.
Even if the planet exploded, it would remain unaffected.
Before the Blue Star rules patch, this prop had no clear rule priority. But after the patch, its rule priority emerged.
“Rule Priority”: Absolute.
This also let him know that the rule priority of an A-level prop wasn’t necessarily fixed at A-level.
For example, his prop had an “Absolute” rule priority, which meant that as long as he lay on the beach chair, even the mightiest beings couldn’t inflict the slightest harm.
Rule priorities are divided into different grades such as A, B, C, with higher tiers like S, SS, and even SSS.
And at the very top of these priority levels is “Absolute!”
A prop with “Absolute” rule priority, regardless of whether it is A-level or C-level, has invaluable worth.
Just the word “Absolute” can be worth a fortune.
“…”
At that moment, Chen Yi, who was lying on the beach chair, closed his eyes quietly without speaking, lying amidst a pile of corpses, as if he were in a deep slumber, ignoring everything around him.
Before the battle officially began.
He asked the Snow Sea Project Team leader many questions with “Requesting the Mandate of Heaven.”
For instance, would it mean genocide if a player killed more than 95% of their own race in one go?
Or what should race players do to crawl out of hell after the entire race had entered it?
And… whether Logitech Star had SS-level props.
For the last question, the Snow Sea Project Team provided a clear answer.
“SS-level props are not allowed in star systems, regardless of whether Logitech Star has any. When they are brought to the 3rd star system, SS-level props can’t be used.”
This answer relieved him quite a bit.
He prepared two plans.
The first plan was naturally to wipe out Logitech Star then and there.
The second plan was to survive the crisis using the beach chair.
It might be humiliating.
But as long as he was alive, Blue Star could avoid a genocide crisis, and there would always be a chance to make a comeback later. After all, “if the Green Mountain remains, there’s no fear of running out of firewood.”
This wisdom was passed down from the ancestors of Blue Star.
Survive first.
Survive, then talk.
Only those who survive have the right to write history.
Meanwhile, the Logitech Star players nearby, although puzzled by the disappearance of the overwhelming attacks when Chen Yi lay on the beach chair, did not cease their assault and bombarded him for a full five minutes.
Seeing that Chen Yi had no response.
They slowly closed in and surrounded him.
“Chen Yi.”
Mr. Qiang, with a thoughtful flash in his eyes, walked up to Chen Yi, who was reclining on the beach chair, wiped the blood off his cheeks, and with an angry tone, said with a slight curve at the corners of his mouth,
“Killed so many of us? Now you’re playing the coward?”
“If I’m not mistaken, the beach chair under you must be an ‘Absolute Defense’ prop, right? It’s incredible that a newbie player could have such an ‘Absolute Attribute’ prop.”
“But unfortunately, Sharoo, the Enzyme Tribe Leader, holds an A-level prop called ‘Apocalypse’ which also possesses an ‘Absolute Attribute’.”
“Anyone struck by it will suffer perpetual injuries until death.”
“Right now, you certainly can lie on this beach chair that has ‘Absolute Defense’ like a coward, but I wonder, how long can your prop last?”
Tens of thousands of Logitech Star players surrounded Chen Yi as he lay on the beach chair, and many Logitech Star players tentatively launched attacks.
But without exception, none could cause any injury.
Slashing at Chen Yi felt not like striking flesh but like hacking at a steel plate, with even their arms trembling slightly.
It was as if a hero’s shield enveloped Chen Yi, preventing any external attacks from reaching him.
Meanwhile, the live-streaming audience also figured it out.
“I see it now, I finally understand Chen Yi’s thought process. First, he wipes out his own race, then the condition for genocide shifts from killing over 95% of Blue Star players to killing Chen Yi.”
“To commit genocide against Blue Star, Chen Yi has to be killed.”
“But Chen Yi is lying on a prop with ‘Absolute Defense,’ which means if the prop can last one hour—no, precisely 56 minutes—”
“Then this Race Duel Battle will be forcibly concluded, and by then, Blue Star will have dodged a bullet.”
More players understood as well, but still felt uneasy.
“Now, the question is, can Chen Yi’s prop last that long?”
“An ‘Absolute Defense’ prop being able to last more than an hour, wouldn’t that be too bug-like?”
“Props with ‘Absolute Attribute’ are meant to be of bug-level existence. It’s reasonable to be bug-like; it would be unusual if it weren’t bugged.”
…
Meanwhile, Blue Star players watching from hell were looking worriedly and uneasily at Chen Yi on the screen, surrounded by the Logitech Star players.
They now understood Chen Yi’s intentions as well.
They couldn’t exactly hold any hatred for Chen Yi killing them, as it was initially a matter for the whole race, yet Chen Yi took it upon himself alone.
This feeling of being powerless made them feel stifled and anxious inside.
Sometimes, it’s preferable to die rather than wait in such frustration for the outcome.

chapters.title: Chapter 303: 279: Without her, Yi wouldn't even live for three seconds.
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 279: Without her, Yi wouldn’t even live for three seconds.
“Hurry, hurry, hurry!!!”
At this moment, Sword Without End, with bloodshot eyes, was wildly barging through the return map with Jiaye, completely disregarding his own injuries!
He must bring Jiaye back to Blue Star before Chen Yi’s battle with Logitech Star players ended!
This was just the first fight, and there were four more races declaring war without a break. If Jiaye wasn’t brought along, Chen Yi, without the Wife-Killing Buff, was beyond imagining.
This wasn’t just about Yi’s life, but his own, and even the lives of all the players on Blue Star.
With all the players on Blue Star watching the live stream, he had no time to check what was happening in the chat. Instead, he was recklessly crashing through the return map with Jiaye, injuries be damned!
When a planet’s players were few and far between, with not many left for Hell Players to return to, the solution was simple.
External adjustment.
By participating in the return maps of other planets, they could decide whether they could return or not.
The opponents in front of him were players from some unknown planet, with skin red all over and two tentacles growing on their heads; they looked extremely eerie!
Because they were not from the same planet, he and Jiaye were almost immediately recognized when they arrived at this map. The identity of Hell Players couldn’t be hidden, adding yet another layer of difficulty.
Even so, for Sword Without End, it wasn’t too hard!
But the real challenge wasn’t him returning to Blue Star, but taking Jiaye back with him. He could easily kill ten Alien Race players to return to Blue Star!
