But to cripple ten and let Jiaye kill them, then let Jiaye return to Blue Star.
And to do all this within an hour.
That was the real difficulty.
It might be easy to kill a person, but to cripple one without overwhelming superiority in strength, injury was almost inevitable!
“Damn it!”
Sword Without End touched the glaring wound on his arm and winced, his lips reflexively twitching with pain. He didn’t even bother to dress the wound, his right hand thrusting out with Three-Foot Qingfeng!
An Alien Race player on the brink of death was thrown in front of Jiaye!
“The last one, these beasts are slippery to kill.”
Everything from last night, Sword Without End glanced at his watch, saw that less than forty minutes had passed, and he let out a slight sigh of relief.
Good, no delay.
Then he finally took the time to look at the live stream, but the moment his gaze focused on the screen, he suddenly fell silent and turned to Jiaye, who was about to check the stream, saying,
“Jiaye, don’t rush to the live stream just yet, there’s still a task to complete. You better figure out how to solve it quickly, or Yi won’t hold on much longer.”
Jiaye, who was about to open the live stream to check on Yi’s situation, immediately stopped what he was doing. Ignoring his own wounds, he began to anxiously and hastily study the mechanism in front of him.
As long as he cracked this mechanism, he could return to Blue Star.
She was well aware.
Without her, Yi wouldn’t survive three seconds.
After Jiaye was sent off,
Sword Without End’s face darkened as he looked at the scenes within the live stream.
Yi was lying in a beach chair, unrecognizable from his injuries, which looked grievous enough to silence a crying child. And beside him,
those androgynous Logitech Star Sharu Clan players were constantly taunting.
One of the Sharu players even sneered as he pulled down his pants and urinated on Chen Yi’s stomach. The entire scene was crudely offensive.
Even more Sharu players, selecting from the corpses of female Blue Star players, arranged several intact bodies on top of Chen Yi.
And then they began to grossly insult them.
Besides that, more Sharu Clan players tried all sorts of ways to provoke Chen Yi, hoping he would erupt in anger and leave the beach chair.
However, Chen Yi kept his eyes tightly shut, lying on the chair, staying silent from beginning to end, not uttering a word.
As if he couldn’t see what was happening around him.
“Whew!”
Feeling the veins in his forehead throbbing, Sword Without End took a deep breath and forcibly suppressed the anger churning within him.
He fell silent, without a word.
All he could do was to prevent Jiaye from seeing this scene, from seeing Yi in such a dire state.
Yi, if he had a choice, wouldn’t want Jiaye to witness it either.
No man wants to appear completely helpless and humiliated in front of his woman.
This wasn’t just Yi’s great humiliation.
It was a great humiliation for all of Blue Star.
But he knew, no matter what Yi was thinking, he had to lie there quietly and not move, not even an inch.
Any movement would fall precisely into the enemy’s trap.
Then, all of Blue Star would be annihilated in the #3 Star System.
As time ticked away, and the hour was nearly exhausted, Chen Yi still showed no intention of getting up from the chair, while the Logitech Star players were unable to do anything to him.
The Logitech Star Sharu Clan players were starting to become uncontrollably restless. If they kept this up, they would really return empty-handed!
Not only had they lost over ten thousand of their own, but they hadn’t even managed to secure any bounties, and a Twofold Planet exploiting loopholes in the rules couldn’t take down a Zerofold Planet. Their reputation completely shot.
It was a loss on all fronts.
Soon—
An hour had passed.
The battlefield disappeared.
The Logitech Star players had vanished to who knows where, and Chen Yi reappeared on the rooftop, enduring the sharp pain as he struggled to stand with only bone remaining in his legs and swept a glance toward Yancheng.
Not a soul in sight.
This was the first time he saw Yancheng completely deserted, enveloped in a dead-like silence.
And he, with a composed expression, lowered his head to inspect the injuries on his body.
It seemed like he had to die too.
The wife-killing buff had ended.
His Forever Pure could no longer be activated without limit, but the wounds left by the Apocalypse Laser Column from Logitech Star did not vanish, and they absolutely could not heal.
Ordinary medical props were utterly useless against these wounds.
He could only rely on Forever Pure’s unlimited activations to prevent the worsening of his condition.
The Logitech Star’s A-level prop, Apocalypse, also possessed absolute attributes, ensuring that once hit, the injuries absolutely could not heal.
Until death.
True death.
Even if one fell into hell, the wounds would still persist.
He lowered his gaze toward the rapidly deteriorating wounds on his body, already barely recognizable as human, and before he could even lay down on the beach chair,
a notification sounded near his ear.
“Ding, it’s 13:00, Twofold Planet Terra Star has formally declared a Race Duel Battle against Zerofold Planet Blue Star, considering the slight disparity in strength between both planets, this battle will last no more than one hour.”
“Please enter the battlefield, players from both sides!”
“During the process of the Race Duel Battle, monthly rules are invalidated.”
Everything before his eyes turned white.
When his vision was restored, he found himself back in that familiar battlefield.
This time, however, there were no corpses of Blue Star players around; Chen Yi lay on the beach chair, looking through the protective shield at nearly hundreds of millions of Terra Star players.
That protective shield again displayed the familiar ten-minute countdown.
He could only lie on the beach chair now.
At this moment, he no longer had the wife-killing buff, he could no longer leave the beach chair, and without the prop Forever Pure, leaving the beach chair would mean his death with the injuries he presently endured.
Only now,
he was no longer alone by his side.
Sword Without End and Jiaye appeared beside him at some unknown time.
“Yi!”
Upon seeing Chen Yi, Jiaye could not restrain the tears from surging in his eyes. He flung himself onto Chen Yi, who lay on the beach chair, his hands trembling as they touched the disfigured Chen Yi and his wounds, his voice shaky and tearful as he spoke.
“How did you get like this, Yi? Is it… because I was too late?”
“It’s alright.”
Chen Yi lifted his hand to wipe away the tears on Jiaye’s cheek, and then waved his hand toward Sword Without End, “Give me a cigarette to smoke; it’s been over an hour since I had one, and I’m craving it.”
“The attack from Logitech Star was quite strong; the several packs of cigarettes on me were all crushed to dust.”
“What a tragic fate.”
“Alright.”
Sword Without End, with a complex look, nodded, took out a pack of cigarettes, pulled one out, and placed it in Chen Yi’s mouth, then lit it for him before speaking hesitantly after a long pause.
“The players from Blue Star have something to say to you; they asked me to convey a message.”
“What is it?”
Chen Yi, seemingly casually and half-heartedly breathed in the smoke from the cigarette in his hand and then frowned slightly, “The scent of blood is too strong; get me a fresh one, pass the cigarette to Jiaye, let Jiaye hold it for me to smoke.”
Sword Without End looked at the cigarette in Yi’s hand that had turned crimson almost instantly from the blood, paused for a moment, then handed another one to Jiaye.
Yi’s arms were already soaked with blood, creating a terrifying sight. The cigarette hadn’t been held by Yi for three seconds before it turned entirely crimson; it was no wonder smoking it would have an overpowering taste of blood.
He was silent for a while before continuing, “The Blue Star players want me to tell you, Yi, that they are not afraid of dying, and rather than enduring such humiliation from the enemy,
they would rather fight against the enemy to the death, letting these Alien Race players witness the ferocity of our Blue Star players.”
“Seeing you humiliated, Yi, everyone feels helpless and frustrated. They want to do something but are powerless; they’d rather die than continue being humiliated.”
Chen Yi didn’t speak, just deeply inhaled from the cigarette in Jiaye’s hand as if trying to alleviate the pain in his body, then finally shook his head and said softly,
“A bunch of cowards.”
“Do you really think Blue Star players have any guts? They’re just a bunch of cowards.”
And this sentence was also heard by every viewer through the live stream.
Numerous players looked at Chen Yi in the center of the screen with complex expressions.
Although they didn’t have much of a relationship with Chen Yi, and even felt a competitive relationship, from the standpoint of a stranger, they couldn’t help but feel a tragic admiration for Chen Yi.
A man who had exterminated two races, facing such a grand humiliation while under the watchful eyes of hundreds of billions of players.
Putting an ordinary person in Chen Yi’s predicament,
suicide would probably be the best option.
A tree lives by its bark, a person lives by their face; without a face, there’s no point in living.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: 280: "It's really infuriating, it hurts a lot.
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 280: “It’s really infuriating, it hurts a lot.
And that highly critical remark left many viewers perplexed, with Blue Star players watching the live broadcast from Hell erupting in angry roars.
Countless Blue Star players took to the streets of Hell, lifting their weapons high and bellowing with rage.
They were venting their frustrations and suppressions over and over!
If it hadn’t been for Chen Yi killing them, they would at least have taken a bite out of the flesh of the Logitech Star players. Without even giving them a chance to strike, how could they be called cowards?
Only Chen Yi dares to risk his life?
They don’t?
“This…”
Although Sword Without End didn’t understand the meaning of Yi’s words, after a long silence, he still defended the Blue Star players, “Blue Star players are not cowards.”
“It’s just that everyone feels it’s better to perish with the enemy than to suffer humiliation!”
“Still cowards nonetheless.”
Chen Yi sighed lightly and then waved his hand signaling Jiaye to withdraw the cigarette, wisps of smoke drifting out from the riddled abdomen.
“Only cowards would choose to perish with the enemy because of humiliation.”
“Do you think being unafraid of death makes you a warrior?”
“No.”
“Without even the courage to endure humiliation, what are you if not a coward?”
“Only those who don’t believe in their future would choose to perish with the enemy out of humiliation, for they know they have no day of vengeance.”
“Only those who do not believe they can become kings refuse to kneel temporarily, for they fear they’ll never stand again if they do.”
“They are, but I am not.”
“They want to die, I want to live.”
“I must personally step onto Starfield and return all the profound humiliation of today manifold, to avenge this day’s grudge.”
Chen Yi lay in the beach chair, his expression distant as he glanced at the protective shield with less than a few minutes of preparation time left, suddenly cracking a faint smile.
“It really is, very infuriating.”
“One should at least avenge oneself before dying.”
“…”
Sword Without End turned his head following Chen Yi’s realization, looking at the protective shield with less than a few minutes of preparation time left. He took the Three-Foot Qingfeng from his back and held it in hand, slowly stepping forward.
“Yi, there are only three of us official Blue Star players left at this moment.”
“One less of me doesn’t make it 95%, right?”
“I’ve got some pent-up frustration, so how about you hold back and let me vent a bit?”
“Alright.”
Chen Yi nodded slightly and gently stroked Jiaye, who was lying on him crying, then slowly exerted force with his arm to lay Jiaye’s limp body aside.
He stood up from the beach chair.
Forever Pure activated.
Injuries healed instantly.
But immediately afterward, the injuries reappeared, and flesh and bones started melting again!
“Tatatata!”
Countless bullets suddenly materialized out of thin air, shattering Jiaye’s corpse to pieces. Although the Logitech Star players hadn’t found Jiaye’s corpse and hadn’t done anything excessive.
But to avoid the possibility, this time he learned to be smart.
Under the barrage of countless bullets.
Not a single piece of flesh could be seen, only blood drifting through the skies.
And a new round of battle was about to begin.
This time on Terra Star, unlike Logitech Star where there were only hundreds of thousands of players, there were hundreds of millions of players packed onto the battlefield, creating an extremely overwhelming and oppressive atmosphere!
Quickly—
The countdown ended!
In the instant the countdown finished!
An all-encompassing assault headed straight for Chen Yi and his companion who were still standing in their original spot!
“Sword, come!!!”
The moment the protective barrier disappeared, Sword Without End leapt into the air with a fierce expression, completely ignoring the myriad of attacks hurtling toward him, and swung at the Three-Foot Qingfeng in the hands of the teeming Alien Race players nearby!
All of a sudden, a dark cloud appeared in the sky above the battlefield!
Immediately after,
Behind Sword Without End, a man with a stature of hundreds of meters tall and eyes tightly shut, like a god, suddenly emerged, holding a long sword in his hand.
Mimicking Sword Without End’s posture, he swung lightly at the Alien Race players!
The next second—
A gigantic Sword Qi, enveloped in electric light, burst forth from the long sword in the hands of this god-like figure, crashing towards the center of the Alien Race players with an unstoppable force!
“Boom!!!”
For a moment, many Terra Star players who couldn’t dodge in time exploded like balloons filled with blood on the spot!
Just with this one strike!
Tens of thousands of Terra Star players were killed or injured!
But before Sword Without End could swing a second time,
An overwhelming barrage of attacks engulfed Sword Without End, silencing even the faintest screams. When the smoke cleared, only a mist of blood in the air testified to the death of a person here.
A novice player who could kill nearly tens of thousands of Threefold Planet players in one strike!
Was enough to prove the strength of Sword Without End!
Even if the cost of this strike was a globally unique character action being permanently consumed.
But this did not negate the power of Sword Without End, it was just that in face of a Race, especially a Race from Threefold Planet, an individual’s strength couldn’t change the overall situation of the battle.
“Boom!”
At the moment when Sword Without End fell!
The sky was filled once again with blossoming bittersweet flowers, countless bullets shooting in all directions, and those hundred thousand Buddhas seated on Lotus Platforms reappeared, launching a devastating barrage attack on the Terra Star players below!
But what came their way was an innumerable onslaught of attacks!
The scale of these attacks far exceeded the limits that Forever Pure could withstand, especially since there was a wound on him that couldn’t heal.
The Apocalypse Laser Column was causing his body to rapidly disintegrate at all times.
He couldn’t bear so many attacks.
After attempting to make a move, Chen Yi once again chose to lie back on the beach chair, the sky full of attacks dissipated, and a familiar scene re-emerged, just like the battle on Logitech Star.
No difference whatsoever.
Sword Without End could perish with style, but Yi could not.
At this very moment, Yi, lying on the beach chair, even has the luxury to think about something else, thankful that this Absolute Defense beach chair Prop had forcefully bound him.
Otherwise, he really would have wanted to give this Prop to Jiaye at the beginning.
If that had been the case, then the person lying here now could only be Jiaye, and only that would ensure the survival of Blue Star.
He can take a bit of disgrace, after all, he’s a man.
But Jiaye is a girl and shouldn’t have to endure these things.
…
As the Logitech Star players had done.
The players from Terra Star were also provoking Chen Yi, trying to make him leave that damn beach chair. As long as Chen Yi would leave that damn beach chair, everything else would be negotiable.
They could totally withstand Chen Yi’s attacks and kill him!
As long as Chen Yi was killed, Blue Star would be forced to suffer extinction!
Then the substantial bounty would fall entirely into their hands.
It was a considerable fortune.
Even for them from Threefold Planet.
Of course, if this fortune were to be divided among every player, it would be insignificant, but they would not do so. If they got their hands on the bounty, it would naturally only end up with one person.
…
“…”
Blue Star players looked at the live stream, clenching their jaws and red-eyed in silence, not speaking.
All the players knew it was Chen Yi who had endured the enormous disgrace on their behalf.
Yet they were powerless to do anything.
Some who had never been interested in increasing their battle power, who had just been muddling along, were now biting their teeth and watching the scene before them in frustration.
They wanted to vent their inner rage but didn’t know where to release it.
Just like the Terra Star player said in the stream.
“Weak stars deserve to be hit.”
“It’s your own fault for being a weak star.”
Although the cocky expression of that Terra Star player in the stream was nauseating, one had to admit, there was nothing wrong with what he said.
…
An hour quickly passed, and after trying various approaches, Terra Star could only return empty-handed.
Time flew rapidly.
After Terra Star returned without success, “Meiju Star”, “Red Plum Star”, and “Duoga Star”, one after another, initiated relentless Race Duel Battles!
The players from these planets used countless ways to provoke Chen Yi, hoping to get him up from that damn beach chair.
But sadly…
All returned without success.
Until—
Noon, 17:00.
In the live stream, the battered Chen Yi struggled to stand up from the beach chair, using a cane to walk step by step to the edge of the rooftop.
He looked down at the deserted Yancheng.
And lit a cigarette, taking it to his lips, then gently exhaled a puff of light blue smoke.
All the players watching fell silent.
It was undeniable that Chen Yi had created a miracle.
He had kept a Zerofold Planet, Blue Star, alive in the face of a united race duel battle by five Threefold Planets, avoiding an extinction crisis.
Though the process was a bit disgraceful.
But ultimately successful.
Anyone else would have been incapable of achieving this.
If they had feared Chen Yi for his formidable strength before, today there was yet another reason for them to fear.
A person who could maintain such composure after such humiliation was truly fearsome.
It was like provoking a wild wolf that doesn’t howl but stares straight at you, as if to memorize your every scent, ready to launch a vicious and bloody attack at any moment in your future.
At that moment, the live stream fell eerily silent, and the camera slowly zoomed out.
As the camera gradually pulled away.
The frame froze on the silhouette of Chen Yi, standing on the deserted rooftop of Yancheng, quietly smoking.
No outburst, no superfluous actions.
As if nothing had happened.
The live stream ended.
This incident of five major Threefold Planets joining forces only to return empty-handed against a Zerofold Planet was enough to make them the biggest laughingstock in the Starfield.
But for the players in Star System 3, the shock was even greater.
Meanwhile, at the Snow Sea Project Team above Blue Star, members were excitedly and vigorously clapping their hands in celebration.
“Yi is freaking awesome!!!”
A member of the Snow Sea Project Team couldn’t hold back his excitement and shouted aloud.
More members of the Snow Sea Project Team were celebrating Blue Star’s escape from this life-and-death crisis. After such an ordeal, Blue Star’s future prospects seemed even brighter!
Misfortune comes coupled with blessings!
The old saying didn’t deceive!
Even Jin Buhuan, the head of the Snow Sea Project Team, couldn’t help being excited as he looked at the quiet silhouette of Chen Yi in the frame, swinging his fist, his eyes brimming with tears of elation.
Finally… we survived.
I’m sorry for the hardship you endured.
But at that moment—
He suddenly froze in place, his eyes showing disbelief and fear as he read the several questions sent to Chen Yi through Requesting the Mandate of Heaven on the screen. After a long while, he regained his composure, took a deep breath, his pupils filled with fear and the faintest spark of excitement, his body trembling uncontrollably as he replied.
“It… it’s possible.”
…
“It’s possible.”
Chen Yi, scarred and in tattered clothes but standing straight, leaned on his cane atop the rooftop, overlooking the deserted Yancheng. He glanced at the answer he had received from the head of the Snow Sea Project Team.
He looked down and chuckled softly.
Then he brought the nearly finished cigarette to his lips, took one last deep puff, and flicked it into the air.
He watched it drift aimlessly in midair.
Slowly descending to the ground.
The faint crimson glow of its tip struggled for a few seconds before it finally dimmed.
After a pause, Chen Yi raised his head to gaze into the distance, stretched lazily, and murmured.
“I’m so sleepy.”
Then without further delay, he lay back down on the beach chair. The Wife-Killing Buff had ended, and without Forever Pure, he couldn’t leave the beach chair for now.
“It’s really infuriating, and it hurts.”

chapters.title: Chapter 305: 281: "Pack up, we're leaving tomorrow.
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 281: “Pack up, we’re leaving tomorrow.
“`
It wasn’t long before Jiaye and Sword Without End returned as well; for them, returning from hell wasn’t difficult.
“Yi.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had returned from hell, walked up to Chen Yi, who was lying on the beach chair, and after a long silence, finally spoke up, “How about having some barbecue?”
“Sure, let’s eat.”
Chen Yi, lying on the beach chair, chuckled lightly and closed his eyes, enjoying a moment of tranquility.
All of Yancheng was unusually quiet at this time, void of any noise.
There were no hawker’s cries from below the buildings, no chatter of pedestrians on the roads, no players discussing the map.
On the rooftop of the building opposite, the smokers who used to gather, now, were nowhere to be seen.
The entire city of Yancheng had seemingly become a ghost town.
Empty overnight.
Perhaps Solar Star was the same.
But the pain in his body had not subsided, although the injuries were under control as he lay on the beach chair, the pain didn’t disappear.
“Okay.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded with a complex expression, not bringing up the recent alien invasion but instead starting to prepare the barbecue with Sword Without End.
He knew that what Yi needed now was not comfort.
In such a situation, all they could do was to accompany Yi.
Forget about rushing out and fighting with their lives.
During the Newbie Protection Period, they simply couldn’t leave Blue Star.
And right then—
A voice rang out in the ears of all players in the third Star System.
‘Star System Announcement!’
“Ding, let us congratulate Twofold Planet Logitech Star on successfully passing the threefold trial, ascending to a Threefold Planet, and moving on to Starfield to embrace a new future.”
‘Wish you all good luck!’
Then, several nearly identical alerts sounded in succession.
‘Star System Announcement!’
“Ding, let us congratulate Twofold Planets Red Plum Star, Meiju Star, Duoga Star…”
‘…’
The five planets that launched the Race Duel Battle against Blue Star had, shortly after the war, passed the threefold trial map, ascended back to a Threefold Planet, and left the third Star System.
Just as they said they would.
With their strength, even if they fell to Twofold Planets, they could ascend again in a matter of minutes.
They were gone.
But the memory they left for the players of the third Star System would never fade.
The moment Tuberculosis Rabbit heard the announcements, he was startled, then instinctively looked up at Yi, seeing that Yi’s face remained calm without a ripple, and then he breathed a sigh of relief.
Thankfully.
Yi’s psychological resilience was still as strong as ever.
He was genuinely afraid that Yi would be provoked into making some rash move.
As long as the Green Mountain remains, there’s no fear of running out of firewood; the monks can run, but the temple can’t be moved. Those Threefold Planets waiting in Starfield will just have to wait until they break through the Newbie Protection Period and step by step ascend.
One day, the grudge could be avenged.
After that, he eagerly picked up a skewer of meat that was ready and trotted over to Chen Yi, smiling ingratiatingly, “Yi, come eat some meat.”
“Okay, everyone eat, too.”
Chen Yi smiled as he took the meat skewer and gently stroked the back of Jiaye’s head, who was crying softly against him, and whispered softly.
“You’ve been wronged.”
…
Though the live stream had ended, players throughout the third Star System still hadn’t quite recovered yet.
A Zerofold Planet, a planet that hadn’t yet passed the Newbie Protection Period.
It survived against the uninterrupted Race Duel Battle of five Threefold Planets.
Though the process was challenging and the ending was brutal, they had survived.
Blue Star still existed.
That Hundred Generations Bounty was still in place.
No one could claim it.
It was a miracle, one that would be talked about for a long time in the third Star System. As new Novice Planets appear in the third Star System and they leave the Newbie Protection Period, the first story they’ll hear is—
Once, there was a Zerofold Planet that, faced with the joint attacks of five Threefold Planets, still stood unyielding!’
It’s foreseeable that when Blue Star passes the Newbie Protection Period, it will quickly ascend to a Threefold Planet and initiate a bloody and brutal war.
No one doubts that Blue Star won’t be able to ascend to a Threefold Planet; it’s just a matter of time.
And nobody doubts that Blue Star will swallow their pride and forget this grudge—if it were someone else, it might be possible, but for Chen Yi, clearly a man who never forgets a slight, to expect him to forget the grudge for the sake of peace, that’s truly out of the question.
…
“…”
The President of the Sun Family Guild leaned back in his chair, and after the live stream had closed, he stayed silent for a long time before finally letting out a long sigh and murmuring.
“A hero of his times.”
More than admiring Chen Yi’s strength, he admired Chen Yi’s composure in the face of insult, as if he treated it all as if nothing had happened.
Anyone can be arrogant at their peak, but how one behaves when they’ve fallen is another matter of character.
He had thought that a strong man like Chen Yi, who hadn’t suffered much before, would be unable to control his emotions after such a huge humiliation and would rather die than continue being humiliated.
But unexpectedly, Chen Yi’s mentality was far beyond his expectations; only someone who has gone through numerous setbacks in life can face setbacks with a gentle demeanor, as if a breeze just brushed over a calm well.
He had bet correctly; Chen Yi really did survive this ordeal.
It’s just a pity that Li Peiqi didn’t send the message, leaving Chen Yi completely unaware of his favor.
“`
“`
But he quickly remembered another matter.
Shaking his head, he muttered under his breath.
“Chairman Li must be feeling quite uneasy right now.”
…
Just as President Sun had said, the Black Dragon Guild’s Chairman Li was currently sitting before the tea table with a gloomy expression, lifting the teacup in his hand and taking a sip before losing control of his emotions and smashing it furiously onto the ground.
“A bunch of trash!”
He truly hadn’t expected that five Twofold Planets would fail against a single Zerofold Planet, returning empty-handed.
This was a damn joke!!!
But thankfully, everything was still under control.
He had been very secretive about the matter, and few knew about it. Chen Yi had no idea he had revealed his bottom line to Logitech Star. As long as Chen Yi remained unaware of this, he wouldn’t trouble him.
Forget this matter.
As long as he forgot this matter, everything would be as usual. No, President Sun knew about this affair; it seemed like this time he would have to pay a hefty price to shut President Sun’s mouth.
Catching his breath, Li Huzi managed to suppress the turmoil inside him and stood up with a shadowed face to head outside.
Ridiculous!
That the Twofold Planets were so weak was utterly preposterous!
…
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit was diffusing the mood while carefully observing Chen Yi’s expression. Seeing that Yi showed no reaction, he finally let out a sigh of relief, stepping forward and tentatively offering words of comfort.
“Yi, I was always worried that you might do something drastic, but I must say, you’re still Yi.”
“This bit of humiliation doesn’t matter. Didn’t Han Xin crawl beneath someone else’s crotch?”
“It’s all very normal.”
“After all, which hero in history hasn’t faced some injustice, right?”
“It’s normal not to win this time, after all, they’re from Twofold Planets. Once we leave the Newbie Protection Period, and we also advance to Twofold Planets, defeating them will be like child’s play.”
“Don’t lose heart, Yi.”
“Can’t win?”
Lying on a beach chair, Chen Yi glanced casually at Tuberculosis Rabbit and said nonchalantly, “Who said I can’t win?”
“Ah?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was taken aback, exchanging a puzzled look with Sword Without End, and somewhat bewildered replied, “Yi… um…”
He was somewhat confused.
Wasn’t Yi constantly on the receiving end of a beating? Why was he suddenly saying this?
Had Yi been so provoked that something was wrong?
After a pause, Chen Yi slowly closed his eyes and said calmly, “I can’t win because I don’t dare fight back or rather, I don’t dare risk it all.”
“I cannot die.”
“If I die, Blue Star will face annihilation.”
“I am the only surviving player on Blue Star. No matter what, I must live. I cannot die, nor will I let myself die.”
“But you see, before lying down on this beach chair, did I have no chance of killing them?”
“I could kill them.”
“It would just take a bit longer since they have a lot of defensive props, and the power of their props and skills is substantial, too much for my Forever Pure to withstand.”
“If we continued to fight, the final outcome would be me killing a number of Logitech Star players, then getting killed.”
“However—”
“This is because they came to my home ground, knowing that I would not risk it all for Blue Star, that’s why they dared to be so reckless.”
“But what if I were to go to their home ground?”
“One life for a hundred.”
“It doesn’t matter if I die. Blue Star players won’t die because of it, nor will Blue Star face annihilation because of me. I can fight without any worry, unleashing attacks on those Alien Race’s heads until the very last drop of blood is drained.”
“When I climb out of hell, everything will start anew.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s mouth slowly opened wide, his eyes flashed with disbelief, and for a while, he was so shell-shocked that he couldn’t utter a sound.
He understood what Yi meant.
That’s right.
Yi wasn’t incapable of killing those Alien Race players; it was just that he couldn’t afford to die and had to take the beatings passively, but once Yi had settled the Blue Star players and then went to those planets’ home ground!
One life for a hundred!
In theory, so long as the Logitech Star players didn’t climb out of the hell map faster than Chen Yi, Yi had a chance to wipe them out!
Then, the real competition wouldn’t be about the overall strength of the Race but individual strength—who could climb out of the hell map faster.
Speaking of individual strength!
Which player from those Twofold Planets could match Yi’s strength!?
None.
Then, his expression turned excited as he suddenly clapped his hands and exclaimed, “Yeah, Yi, you’re right, I almost forgot about that.”
“Then things are easy to deal with.”
“Once we get through the Newbie Protection Period, then advance to Twofold Planets, and charge onto Starfield, we’ll surely avenge our previous disgrace!”
“We still have over 7 months left in our Newbie Protection Period, plus the time needed for advancement, we can take our revenge within a year!”
“A year?”
Chen Yi leaned back in the chair, found a comfortable position, and lay down again, saying softly, “Too long.”
“Pack up; we leave tomorrow.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 306: 282: The Sin of Today, The Merits Through Ages!
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 282: The Sin of Today, The Merits Through Ages!
“`
“What’s that about? Setting off tomorrow?”
“`
Tuberculosis Rabbit stiffened, and his hand holding a skewer paused unconsciously as he looked up at Yi lying on the chair. Seeing that Yi wasn’t speaking but was instead closing his eyes to feign sleep,
after a long while, he turned in bewilderment to Sword Without End sitting next to him, equally confused. Clearly, Sword Without End had no explanation either.
As for Tie Chui,
his eyes seemed relatively clear at that moment, focusing on the skewers grilling over the stove, drooling without a thought to the meaning behind Yi’s words.
In Tie Chui’s single-minded thinking,
Yi said they were setting off tomorrow.
He agreed.
Then what else was there to think about? Wasn’t everything settled?
But… they were in their Newbie Protection Period. The biggest problem right in front of them was how to leave Blue Star. The last time they went to Solar Star, they had used tricks, and after paying a significant price, they eventually ended up in Solar Star’s twofold trial.
This time it wasn’t about going to the third Star System, but Starfield itself.
That was an existence on a higher plane than a Star System.
Could they even get there?
Moreover, that was the Threefold Planet’s main base. Could they really get anything good out of going there?
He was aware that Yi never held grudges; any grudge would be avenged on the same day. But he had not expected that Yi would choose to retaliate on the same day against such a formidable enemy.
“…”
After a long while of stunned bewilderment, Tuberculosis Rabbit unconsciously picked up a skewer and put it in his mouth, chewing hard as he murmured,
“August is indeed a tourist season, so taking a long trip does make sense.”
…
Meanwhile, Starfield was already in total chaos.
To be precise, Starfield’s full name was Ding Qi Starfield.
Starfield is just a term, while Ding Qi is the actual name or code of this Starfield. In the ascension game, no one knows how many Starfields there are; they just know that their own Starfield is designated Ding Qi.
The full name of the Starfield Project Team is also called the Ding Qi Starfield Project Team.
Some team members hold permanent positions, with no planets to run with, spending their whole lives in the Ding Qi Project Team without the possibility of advancement, but also with no chance of demotion.
Other team members are those who have walked up from their own Star Systems, planet by planet with their planets. These people can gain more points and more opportunities for promotion as their planets ascend. Of course, if they fail to advance, they also face corresponding penalties.
At this moment, the Logitech Star Project Team was working overtime discussing the losses from the recent expedition to the third Star System.
A moment later.
The head of the Logitech Star Project Team, with an expressionless face, looked towards the string of data at the center of the screen and said in a soft voice, “This expedition to the third Star System resulted in 11,209 Logitech Star players dead.”
“Two A-grade props and dozens of B-grade props were dropped.”
“The only consolation is that the drop rate of props was not too high.”
“No benefits from the Hundred Generations Bounty, didn’t manage to get on good terms with Solar Star Project Team members, and in the eyes of other races in Ding Qi Starfield, we’ve become an easy target.”
“All harm and no benefit.”
“This campaign was a tremendous defeat.”
The man’s face appeared expressionless, but his subordinates knew that their manager was on the verge of exploding.
The player population of Logitech Star was already scarce, with just over a hundred thousand players.
And they multiply slowly.
They had struggled along for so long, treating each player as a precious seed, and yet more than ten thousand died in one expedition.
How many of these players can claw their way back from Hell is anyone’s guess.
With each descent into Hell, the difficulty of returning to the map doubles.
Walking up from the Newbie Protection Period to the Threefold Planet, virtually all players had been to Hell at least once, and some even seven or eight times. For these players, the difficulty of returning to the map has become ridiculously hard.
With their power, without external intervention, they would never be able to crawl out of Hell in this lifetime.
They would have to spend their lives as Hell Players.
Hell Players lack many privileges and can’t develop their strength too well. They basically just scrape by in Hell, barely better off than the Scavengers, with just a bit more freedom and human rights.
“So…”
A hesitant subordinate spoke up, “Manager, what do we do now, should we negotiate with Sharlu·Enzyme?”
Sharlu·Enzyme is the chieftain of the Sharu Clan on Logitech Star.
He is also the leader of all players on Logitech Star.
Basically, each planet is like loose sand during the Newbie Protection Period, but as they ascend from Onefold Planet, Twofold Planet, to Threefold Planet, they begin to slowly coalesce into a power.
With only one leader.
Essentially, every Threefold Planet has just one power, one ultimate leader.
Or rather, only under such circumstances can one ascend to a Threefold Planet; with multiple forces intertwined and restraining each other, there is virtually no chance of successful ascension.
By rights, as the project team of Logitech Star, they should not be able to have direct negotiations with players.
And there are rules that clearly state this point.
But as the saying goes, where there are rules, there are loopholes—there’s always a way, it’s just more cumbersome.
“No need.”
The man standing in front of the large screen was silent for a long while before he finally spoke, “The player Sharlu·Enzyme is quite arrogant and conceited; he doesn’t even give us Logitech Star’s project team a second glance.”
“It’s impossible to communicate with him.”
“It’s just a pity that Sharlu·Enzyme didn’t die in that battle, otherwise we could have used some methods to make him stay in hell a bit longer. By the time he climbed out, the Sharu Clan would already have a new chieftain.”
“Despite the great losses this time.”
“It might not necessarily be a bad thing.”
“On Ding Qi Starfield, the planets that ascend from each star system naturally cluster together and unite to confront external threats.”
“For instance, the people from the 8th star system are very united.”
“The seven Twofold Planets that advanced from the 8th star system are exceptionally united. If one planet dispatches troops, the remaining six planets spare no effort in providing military support.”
“Under these circumstances, in the entire Ding Qi Starfield Continent, no one dares to provoke the players from the 8th star system. They are too united. Any player from the 8th star system that gets killed triggers relentless retaliation, no matter the cost.”
“This rule was set by the alliance of the 8th star system when it was first established. To enforce this iron rule firmly, many players from the 8th star system died.”
“Often, in avenging one player, more than a hundred players would die.”
“To seek vengeance for these hundred players, another thousand would die.”
“Those were really lively times. Every day you could hear news about the 8th star system getting into fights. The alliance of the 8th star system was almost constantly seeking revenge or chasing murderers when it was first established.”
“Back then, everyone thought the 8th star system had gone mad, and at that time, the death rate of its players was indeed the highest.”
“But what about now?”
The man paused, folded his arms, and leaned on the table, speaking softly, “You’ve seen it too. The death rate of the 8th star system’s players is so low it’s infuriating.”
“In the wilderness, even if they encounter a lone player, as long as the other party identifies themselves as a player from the 8th star system, usually no one will attack, even if they have overwhelming numbers.”
“What does this mean?”
“For the few founders of the alliance of the 8th star system, this is called ‘sowing crimes in their time, reaping merits for a thousand generations.’
“By contrast, the planets ascending from our 3rd star system have always been quite scattered, with little contact between them. Sometimes they even resort to underhanded tactics against each other.”
“This has put us at a disadvantage in the Ding Qi Starfield Continent, where we can only fight enemies on all sides. However, under the leadership of Solar Star’s project team, although the plan failed and our losses were severe—”
“—it also created some close connections among the five planets ascending from the 3rd star system. If we can seize this opportunity and have the five planets form an alliance, advancing and retreating together—”
“—then the losses this time might be acceptable, perhaps even a small gain.”
The subordinate standing beside the man lit up at these words, “Right, how did I not think of that? It has to be the manager, your work ability is far superior to us lackeys by many times over.”
“Shall I get in touch with the other planets’ project teams first?”
“Mm.”
The man nodded emotionlessly, “After we get in touch, we’ll contact the leading players of our respective planets and try to broker a deal. The losses are already so severe; this alliance must succeed. Only then can we mitigate the losses.”
“The others probably have similar thoughts.”
“Otherwise, once this news gets out, some might think we’re easy targets and come to take a stab at us. Even though they can’t kill us, being pushed around is extremely uncomfortable.”
“Understood.”
…
Ding Qi Starfield.
In an expansive continent, there stood a city right in the middle of a swamp, constructed in a very peculiar way.
The city was not large. At a glance, it could accommodate no more than about one million residents.
It was not considered a very large city.
From high above, the whole city looked like half a shell floating on the swamp, surrounded by semicircular walls akin to a shell.
Inside the city there were towering skyscrapers.
From time to time, you could see maglev trains shuttling continuously between the buildings.
It appeared to be bustling with activity.
Meanwhile, on the streets, a dark-skinned man with dirty braids took a vicious bite of the fried chicken leg in his hand before tightening the loose waistband of his trousers and casually looked at the morning’s news.
“Ding Qi Starfield morning news.”
“The five Twofold Planets that ascended from the 3rd star system, in a joint effort, launched a relentless Race Duel Battle against Zerofold Planet Blue Star, which was still within its Newbie Protection Period, and were soundly defeated!”
“A single newbie player fought alone against all players from the five Twofold Planets and gained the upper hand!”
“As predecessors from the 3rd star system, why did they mobilize such force against a junior?”
“Breaking News: Hundred Generations Bounty, several hundred million Points—that’s the cause of war!”
And so on, a series of news updates kept popping up.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: 283: The Prosperous Times Do Not Produce Heroes.
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 283: The Prosperous Times Do Not Produce Heroes.
This dark-skinned man glanced around carelessly before his eyes flashed with a hint of disdain, and he sneered, “A bunch of trash, the people of Threefold Planet have been thoroughly disgraced by you.”
Just then—
A voice nearby inquired, “For sale?”
“Sell, sell, sell!”
Hearing this, the man hurriedly set aside the chicken leg he was holding and pulled a young boy with the same skin tone, who was tethered with a rope, to the front while apologizing with a smile, “The boys are 30k Points each.”
“That expensive?”
The customer who came to ask for the price slightly furrowed his brow and said, “Why has the price for your Black Race increased again? Just last month, a healthy Black Race boy was only 25k Points.”
“We really have no choice.”
Upon hearing the customer complain about the price, the dark-skinned man lamented with a look of grievance, “The cost of raising a Black Race boy to the point where he can work has nearly reached 7k Points, we’re almost running at a loss.”
“Plus, look at how good the quality is.”
“All limbs intact, and these eyes.”
The man casually pulled a boy who was tied up with a rope from behind, dragging him in front of the customer, and used his hand to pry the boy’s eyelids open, “Look, how bright these eyes are.”
“You can tell he’s not stupid.”
“Not only can he fight for you, but he can also serve you in your daily life, so when you think about it, is 8k Points still expensive?”
“Alright then.”
Perhaps because the quality this time was really not bad, the customer didn’t haggle further; instead, he touched the solitary horn on his forehead, furrowed his brow in contemplation for a while, and then said.
“Give me two.”
“You got it.”
…
The Black Race also belonged to one of the races native to Ding Qi Star.
They were a group that had advanced from the 7th Star System.
On Ding Qi Starfield, they were quite a significant force, and their planet was named Black Star.
Players of the Black Race were easy to recognize in a crowd, with skin that was uniformly dark, except for the palms of their hands and feet, which were pale, and their hair which naturally curled tightly.
Players of this race were naturally strong in combat and fearless of death; they fought with a desperation that seldom failed to intimidate.
But the biggest flaw of this race was the absence of familial relationships.
Or rather, the players of this race didn’t have the ethical relationships other races typically had; their nature was free, or one might say, selfish.
For players of this race, their dictionary did not contain the definitions of “father” and “mother.”
They never cared about who gave birth to them, nor who raised them.
Before the advancement to the new planet had begun, societal civilization had diminished, and children were carelessly abandoned at birth to either survive or perish.
Perhaps it was due to such customs.
The newborns of the Black Race were not as fragile as the newborns of other races; instead, they opened their eyes shortly after birth, yanked their umbilical cords free, and ran off into the forest.
For the following three days, the umbilical cord was their only source of sustenance.
If they couldn’t find water and food within three days, the newborn would be declared dead; if they found them, they would slowly grow up in that place.
It was such a disorganized and almost savage race of players that successfully advanced to Threefold Planet.
There was no other way.
Though disorganized, facing individual trials on the map of Threefold Planet, each fighting for themselves, those from the Black Race were truly fearless in battle, as if they feared dying too slowly.
It must have been by virtue of the individual strength of all players that they successfully advanced to Threefold Planet.
They were now one of the few places in all of Threefold Planet where there was no unified government, and it was extremely fragmented.
After advancing to Ding Qi Starfield.
Everyone slowly figured out the characteristics of this race and started to oppress them without restraint, the primary reason being that there were no worries of retaliation.
No matter how many Black Race Players you killed, you never had to worry about someone seeking revenge.
The selfish nature inherent in the bloodlines of Black Race Players meant that they had no concept of avenging friends, not even bothering to retrieve their corpses, even if they were close friends.
It was because of this.
In the beginning, everyone treated Black Race Players like pushovers, only to quickly realize that they weren’t so soft after all. Although no one sought vengeance for them, these Black Race Players fought with a desperation that was truly difficult to withstand.
These people really had no regard for their own lives.
They would even stab themselves a few times for thrills after not getting their fill of killing, fighting against such individuals was truly frightening.
Later on.
Many players realized that if they captured Black Race Players, whipped them for three months, and then fed them a bit and equipped them with some simple props and skills,
these Black Race Players would fight for them with unwavering loyalty.
And fight with more desperation than any other subordinate.
They didn’t even require a monthly salary, just food was enough.
Most importantly, they had no sense of race, not hesitating to strike even at their own kind.
Once this was discovered,
Black Race Players suddenly became highly sought after; simply capturing one meant acquiring a superb fighting force!
So, during that period, various traffickers emerged one after another!
The entire market was in utter chaos!
Almost all players were eager to capture Black Race Players to then sell them for a high price, but soon enough, various acts driven by profit nearly destroyed the market.
For instance, some painted another race’s players black, pretending they were Black Race Players.
Or, they captured a Black Race Player and meticulously taught them how to escape before selling the Black Race Player to another player.
Once the deal was done, they would let the Black Race Player run back to them.
Lather, rinse, repeat.
It was a veritable money-making scheme that required no capital, and many players engaged in such practices, turning the desire of numerous players from wanting to own a Black Race Player as a battle pet to being reluctant to spend a large sum for a mere three-day trial card.
As the saying goes, chaos breeds heroes.
Prosperous times do not produce great men.
In the midst of the Black Race Players being bullied by everyone and the trading market nearly collapsing, a man known as Hadman stepped forward.
This man was a Black Race Player, a middle-aged man.
Upon witnessing the current plight and experiences of Black Race Players, he resolutely established the “Hadman Commerce”!
There was only one business operation:
Sale and leasing of Black Race youth players.
With the following guarantees—
1: Ensures no disabilities in limbs and a normal IQ.
2: Will be trained before delivery to ensure obedience to all the owner’s commands.
3: Includes after-sales service; if escape occurs within a year of purchase, compensation will be made at the original price.
Under these three guarantees!
Haddman’s “Hadman Commerce” nearly decimated those unprofessional traffickers with a dimensional strike, and the guaranteed retrieval service eliminated the last doubts in the minds of some players.
Thereafter, any player looking to buy a Black Race youth would head to “Hadman Commerce”!
As a result!
“Hadman Commerce” made a fortune overnight; although it still wasn’t the political body of Black Race Players, in the hearts of many players, “Hadman Commerce” had come to completely represent the Black Race Players.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: 284: Made me Laugh, Truly a Clown Act
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 284: Made me Laugh, Truly a Clown Act
But it must be said that the Black Race players are truly steadfast in their original intentions, even though the Hadman Commerce already has a strong influence on the hearts of Black Race players.
However, this Hadman has not the slightest intention of establishing a governing body.
Nor does he think about gathering Black Race players together.
He just wants to be a pure merchant.
They say that once you reach a certain height, you always can’t help but lean toward power, but in Hadman’s case, there’s not even a trace of such thought.
He’s just built a lot of assembly line factories.
Inside there are many female Black Race players who do only one thing in their lives, prepare for pregnancy and become pregnant.
And he has purchased many props that guarantee the ability to have triplets, ensuring these Black Race female players can have three children at once.
Even though having triplets increases the mortality risk a little.
But overall, this rate of loss is completely acceptable compared to the higher returns it brings.
A Black Race player, from birth to growing into a teenager, takes about three years.
The main source of “Hadman Commerce”‘s goods are its own assembly line factories and some newborns sporadically brought in by Black Race players.
Only the number of those brought by Black Race players has dwindled after all.
It’s unclear if those newborns are aware of the outside world while in the womb, but now they run faster and faster after birth, running off without looking back as soon as they hit the ground, gripping their umbilical cords.
They’re simply uncatchable.
It is said that one Black Race player, in order to catch a newborn at the time of birth, specially made a sack and fixed it to his woman’s backside, ensuring the baby wouldn’t run as soon as it fell.
But who knew that the newborn kept holding back and not coming out, seizing the moment the woman went to the bathroom, it quickly crawled out and ran away, dragging its umbilical cord.
Then there’s the kind that waits until everyone has fallen asleep at night, then silently crawls out of the mother’s belly and escapes on the spot.
In summary.
It’s a bit difficult for the average Black Race player to capture a newborn; times are advancing, and the escape methods of these newborns are becoming more and more inconceivable, it’s unknown where they learned them from.
Only in the assembly line factories, with tight security guards, can it be guaranteed that they absolutely cannot escape.
Yes.
It sounds far-fetched, but that’s really how it is.
After Hadman appeared, the Black Race players also gradually settled down on the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star, and no one arbitrarily captured Black Race players anymore because they knew they couldn’t sell them.
No one buys Black Race players from private hands anymore.
After all, at Hadman’s place, the price is cheaper, there’s after-sales service, and there is more variety to choose from, too.
Except for some players who can’t afford it and still try to capture on their own.
And that player who was selling a Black Race teenager on the street just now is one of Hadman Commerce’s own, responsible for roadside sales.
Hadman Commerce has many different sales methods, such as telesales, online sales, face-to-face sales, feed sales, lead sales, trade show sales, resales, and so on; roadside sales are one of them.
Roadside sales, as the name implies, entail hauling goods around, and finalizing the transaction on the spot if someone is interested.
This city happens to be a Unicorn Tribe city, where most players are of the Unicorn Tribe, with only a small part being those like him who come to do business.
He made a sale as soon as he stepped out the door.
The joy made the man couldn’t help but laugh as he picked up the chicken leg he hadn’t finished eating just now and continued to stuff it into his mouth, then went back to reading the news he hadn’t finished before.
After reading the whole thing, he sighed again.
“These Threefold Planets that ascended in the 3rd Star System are really a bunch of trash.”
At this moment—
Almost more than half of the players on Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star were discussing this news.
Five Threefold Planets waging uninterrupted Race Duel Battles against a Zerofold Planet was big news on its own!
But if that were all, people would just scorn these Threefold Planets for lacking any sense of shame.
Bullying the weak is normal.
The fundamental rule of Ding Qi Starfield is the law of the jungle, the survival of the fittest, natural selection.
It’s normal, understandable.
You’re weak, you’d better stand straight when you get hit.
But the difference is too great, aren’t you, after all, a Threefold Planet dealing with a Zerofold Planet that hasn’t even finished its Newbie Protection Period? Even the most shameless person would have to give you guys a thumbs up and say, when it comes to shamelessness, you’re the champs.
And it’s not over yet.
Not only did you do it, but you also lost miserably and had to retreat!
With that, the news suddenly gained a huge point of interest, nearly all players on Ding Qi Starfield were talking about it.
They were ridiculing these planets as complete trash.
Only occasionally, an out-of-step comment would pop up.
“Is it possible that the players on that Novice Planet are actually quite tough?”
Of course, such comments were quickly submerged.
“The guy above is an idiot, case closed.”
“You’d rather believe that the players on a Novice Planet can repel 5 Threefold Planets than believe I’m the mastermind behind the ascension game.”
“We’ve all been through the Newbie Protection Period, can you imagine what it’s like to face Race Duel Battles from 5 Threefold Planets during your Newbie Protection Period?”
“Damn, all you can do is wait to die at that point, what else?”
Countless comments were floating and exchanging on the forums of Ding Qi Starfield.
Although these Race Duel Battles were all live-streamed.
“`
But players in the #3 Star System couldn’t send information to the Ding Qi Starfield, and didn’t even know what was happening there.
Only players from a few Threefold Planets who had screen recordings, but these players weren’t foolish enough to spread videos that were detrimental to themselves.
So.
Even though the news had been brewing all night, players on the Ding Qi Starfield only knew that these planets had suffered a terrible defeat and significant losses, yet they had no idea about the specifics of the battle.
There were many players who were truly curious about how a player from a Novice Planet could withstand the successive attacks from five Threefold Planets.
Logically speaking,
A few area-effect props dropped by the Threefold Planets should have been enough to virtually wipe out the players from a planet with no foundation.
How could they have possibly defeated five Threefold Planets in succession?
Many were truly curious about the footage of the battle, but unfortunately, despite their curiosity, they couldn’t find even a snippet of leaked video material.
Furthermore, many players narrowed their eyes and set their sights on the few Threefold Planets that had ascended from the #3 Star System.
It seemed that these planets were soft targets.
If one could swallow up these planets, the gains would be significant.
Not to mention, just the props that dropped would be no small amount.
Just then—
A piece of news suddenly got pushed to the top!
“Ding Qi Starfield Morning News!”
“Ten minutes ago, five Threefold Planets from the #3 Star System—Logitech Star, Meiju Star, Red Plum Star, Duoga Star, and Terra Star—have officially formed an alliance!”
“And have signed an alliance contract!”
“The alliance is named the Five Fingers Alliance!”
“Alliance slogan: ‘Harm one finger, all five move!'”
“From now on, they will advance and retreat together, striving to create a beautiful homeland!”
This news made many race leaders instantly extinguish the little schemes they had begun to harbor towards these planets—since they had formed an alliance, it was best to put aside any superfluous thoughts.
However, this also made them more certain that these planets must have sustained serious damage; otherwise, they wouldn’t have formed an alliance.
That’s not all.
Soon, another news update was pushed to the top!
“Declaration of War!”
“Five Fingers Alliance leader Sharu·Enzyme: In the future, when the Novice Planet Blue Star ascends to become a Threefold Planet and arrives at the Ding Qi Starfield Continent, the Five Fingers Alliance will join forces to wage a relentless siege campaign against their planet!”
“At that time, anyone who dares to obstruct us will face the fiercest wrath of the Five Fingers Alliance!”
“This battle is a fight to the death, without end!”
“A mere ant, and if we were not restrained by the rules, we would have crushed that ant thousands of times over!”
And below this news,
The comments section was extremely polarized.
One side was—
“Keep it up, well said!”
“Good, that ant who only knows how to play turtle dares to oppose us!”
“The chieftain is mighty!”
If you look at their IP, they’re basically Race Players from these planets.
On the other hand, some comments started to turn malicious—
“You’ve got me laughing, man. They haven’t even reached Ding Qi Starfield Continent yet, and you’re declaring war on them, who are you declaring war on?”
“Can they even see this?”
“Really a clown, so you’re declaring war for us to see, huh? Why don’t you just declare war on us directly?”
“Don’t mess about, upstairs. You’re from Fourfold planet, they wouldn’t dare declare war on you even if you killed them, a bunch of people have fallen so low they’re bullying Zerofold Planets now, kneeling and acknowledging you as daddy when they see Fourfold Planet players?”
Besides those, there were some more reasonable comments.
“You guys stop making a fool of yourselves, didn’t he say they were restricted by the rules? Probably because taking action against a Zerofold Planet is indeed very restricted and disadvantageous for them. Once Blue Star ascends to Threefold Planet, there will be no such restrictions, and we should see their real strength.”
But rebukes quickly followed.
“Are you a stupid dog? Five against one, and you want to see real strength? Look at your mom’s baby.”
“But on the flip side, the Five Fingers Alliance seems to acknowledge the opponent’s strength, at least believing that it’s no problem for them to ascend to a Threefold Planet.”
“True, but I still feel the Five Fingers Alliance’s declaration of war is just clownish. Isn’t this just declaring war for us to see? Lost face in the #3 Star System and now trying to find it back with us?”
“Indeed, truly a clown move.”
But just then—
An announcement suddenly resounded in the ears of all players in both the #3 Star System and the Ding Qi Starfield Continent.
“Star System Announcement/Starfield Continent Announcement!”
“Ding, Blue Star player Chen Yi from the #3 Star System has started a live stream and declared war on the five planets: Logitech Star, Meiju Star, Red Plum Star, Duoga Star, and Terra Star.”
“PS: The Snow Sea Project Team from the #3 Star System has used level-one authority to apply for this live stream, and the live stream has signed a wager contract; the event is technically supported by the Ascension game.”
The next second—
A semi-transparent live stream window suddenly popped up in front of all players in both the #3 Star System and the Ding Qi Starfield Continent.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 309: 285: The Calamity Named After Him, Chen Yi.
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 285: The Calamity Named After Him, Chen Yi.
And in the center of the live broadcast,
stood a young man in a pitch-black suit, his back to the audience. He was seen leaning on a cane, standing on the summit of a mountain peak.
It was as if he was gazing into the horizon, silent, without any movement in his body.
Only the bare skin of his neck and arms could be glimpsed, eroding and melting away, then rapidly restoring itself.
This process was repeating continuously.
It gave off an exceedingly dazzling sense of illusion.
The figure was tall and straight. Although the audience couldn’t see his face, for some reason, all the viewers entering the live stream involuntarily held their breath!
They were acutely aware of one thing: they had hit the jackpot in catching the action live!
Those players who were still asleep or in the map could only watch the recorded footage, but they would get to consume the freshest drama!
Although they had never heard of the name Chen Yi, the announcement stated that this player was from Blue Star!
Boy, this was going to be fun!
The Five Fingers Alliance had just issued a declaration of war to Blue Star on Ding Qi Star, and everyone was laughing at whom the declaration was shown to, as if it were a joke.
Yet, lo and behold, the person in question had shown up!
Even though it was puzzling how a novice player managed to initiate a live broadcast on Starfield, let alone the even greater expense of a system-wide broadcast — which was virtually impossible for a Threefold Planet player —
there was now no time for such concerns.
First things first: enjoy the drama unfolding!
…
“Hurry, hurry, hurry!”
In the city at the center of the swamp on the Unicorn Tribe’s land, a dark-skinned man, desperately holding up his nearly falling pants, excitedly rushed to the fried chicken store beside him.
“Give me ten chicken drumsticks! Immediately! Right now!”
Without any hesitation,
he grabbed the ten drumsticks and found a spot to sit down, eyes glued to the live broadcast, perfectly prepared to enjoy the spectacle!
What’s the point of watching drama without chicken drumsticks? It’s like watching with empty hands!
It had been a while since there was such big entertainment to watch!
…
“Audacious!”
Sharlu·Enzyme looked darkly at Chen Yi in the broadcast from his domain on Logitech Star. He had not expected Chen Yi to be able to initiate a Starfield live stream!
What was worse, Chen Yi must have had a recording of the battle!
He had kept the fight footage secret for fear that other races, seeing their prolonged struggle to defeat a newcomer, might band together and conquer them.
If Chen Yi released the battle recording in the live stream, it would be a severe blow to their reputation and their vested interests!
Damnable!
A despicable act!
Deliberately using this tactic to disgust them.
…
Upon ascending to Threefold Planet and arriving at Starfield, one’s home planet would merge into this continent and sprout a new piece of land.
This new land would become the territory of the newly promoted planet’s player.
The landscape of this territory depends on the original planet’s territory.
It’s basically a 3D to 2D conversion, replicated one-to-one.
This has led to some very strange landforms in the Starfield Continent, such as a vast ocean on the left side and suddenly a land of magma on the right.
This is all normal.
It indicates an intersection of territories from two different planets. The original planet on the left had the ocean, while the planet on the right had the magma, and they just happened to overlap here.
The size of the territory is also based on the size of the planet.
The larger the planet, the larger the territory after conversion.
Vice versa for smaller planets.
Beyond that,
factors such as gravity, air density, climate conditions, and lack of oxygen are all perfectly replicated.
This means that race players feel most comfortable in their own territories, and in battle, they are strongest in their own lands.
After all, that’s where they’ve always lived.
Other territories, due to differences in gravity or lack of oxygen—some planets don’t even have any, and those race players do not rely on it for breathing—won’t have it when converted.
If you go into such a territory to battle, your combat power would significantly decrease.
This is why, unless there’s a great disparity in strength, races rarely invade other races’ territories—the advantage of fighting on home terrain is too great.
Even among Threefold Planets, unless there is an advantage of numbers, victory would come at a huge cost, likely leaving the victor vulnerable to other lurking players.
Regarding the Race Duel Battle,
it’s more of a formal matter, something symbolic.
After all, it can be declined.
In the past on Starfield Continent, this was often used to boast or vent, such as when a race leader had a quarrel online with another race’s leader.
Out of anger, they initiate a Race Duel Battle!
Typically, the other party would decline, and then the instigator could seize on the refusal to ridicule them, which can be extremely satisfying!
But… once, when a race leader initiated a Race Duel Battle as usual during an argument, perhaps the other side was also provoked, and they unexpectedly accepted the challenge.
Thus, all players involved in the duel were dragged into the battlefield, bewildered and incredulous, beginning a fight to the death!
A real Race Duel Battle means one side must be annihilated before the other can leave!
Three days later,
the tribe that initiated the duel emerged, nearly ninety percent dead, the survivors all severely wounded, a horrific sight.
But shortly after they came out, they were surrounded by other players who had long been lying in wait.

chapters.title: Chapter 310: 285: The Catastrophe Named After Him, Chen Yi. _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 285: The Catastrophe Named After Him, Chen Yi. _2
Genocide on the spot.
Because of an argument, two races were exterminated.
After this incident erupted, no race dared to initiate any Race Duel Battle to show off during an argument anymore. There was no specific reason, just fear that the opponent might be a fierce tiger, choosing to accept the challenge.
That really left one without a temper.
Even if it meant dying, they were determined to take you down with them. What could you do about that?
It had been a long time since a duel battle had been witnessed. The recent one involving several planets in the Logitech Star had failed…
It was truly far from expected.
But perhaps due to the Newbie Protection Period or some rules, the Race Duel Battles have ended, and incredibly, not a single planet was exterminated. This would be impossible in a real Race Duel Battle.
Many players on Starfield were fixated on the live stream, staring at the young man’s silhouette in the center of the screen, eager to see what kind of tough talk this man would spout!
The man stepped forward, this man must have had some strength, planning to talk tough first and then formally battle the so-called Five Fingers Alliance when Blue Star advanced to the level of a Threefold Planet.
What a shitty name, Five Fingers Alliance, it’s damn hard to remember.
A player couldn’t help but curse inwardly but still repeated the name several times in their mind—after all, this was a new alliance, and not a small one at that, with five Threefold Planets, not an alliance of merely two planets.
This kind of alliance would certainly impact the landscape of the Starfield Continent.
The name had to be remembered.
Although it was a bit of a mouthful, one still had to vigorously commit it to memory.
And just then—
Chen Yi, in the center of the live stream, slowly turned around to face the camera, standing calmly with his hands resting on his cane at the edge of the cliff.
With the vast blue sky at his back.
Between heaven and earth, he appeared incredibly small yet immensely grand.
His features, while not especially handsome, were well-defined with deep-set eyes. Against the backdrop of his black suit, he looked like a piece of art.
“Good morning, everyone.”
After a moment,
Chen Yi suddenly spoke up, the corners of his lips curling into an unremarkable smile, his hands on his cane as he looked ahead and chuckled lightly, “This is my first time wearing a suit; it might be a bit restraining.”
“I’ve been on such a large stage before, but that has surely caused you all some amusement.”
“But today is important to me and equally so for Blue Star.”
“In Blue Star’s five thousand years, we’ve never suffered such near extinction and disgrace. Today, I, Chen Yi, have come to cleanse Blue Star’s dishonor, and it’s only fitting to dress formally for that.”
“And the best way to cleanse dishonor is with blood.”
“When blood covers the entire Starfield Continent, I think those players who have brought dishonor to Blue Star will find redemption and forgiveness, and you all will know what it costs to offend Blue Star.”
“Or rather, to offend me, Chen Yi.”
“Alright.”
“No one is responding, and monologuing here by myself is pretty boring, so let’s get started for real.”
“Where shall we begin?”
“How about we start with Terra Star first?”
Subsequently,
Chen Yi slightly shifted to the side, fully revealing the scenery behind him, displaying the modern city at the center of the basin below the cliff. With his arms spread wide and a slightly intoxicated expression, he spoke softly,
“The air is still quite sweet; I quite like the greenery of your planet.”
“It looks very healing.”
“It looks like a piece of art.”
And as Chen Yi spread his arms,
The audience in the live stream could see even more clearly Chen Yi’s wrists, exposed to the air and continuously corrupting and melting, the congealed white liquid and blood mixing together as they dropped.
One could even see the white bones gripping the cane.
It was incredibly disturbing.
But the wounds healed quickly; one moment they were melting to the bone, and the next they were restored to normal.
Only the crimson-drenched cuffs, visible even through the darkness, informed the audience that it was no illusion, that indeed, Chen Yi had wounds that were constantly healing and corroding.
「This is the Apocalypse Cannon, an A-class Prop from Logitech Star, boasting Absolute Attributes. Once hit, rapid corrosion begins, and the wounds absolutely cannot be healed until death ensues—it is a fatal strike!」
“Chen Yi’s injuries look exactly like the effects of being hit by the Apocalypse Cannon!”
Soon, experienced players in the livestream room offered an explanation, but quickly, new doubts arose.
“But logically speaking, after being hit by the Apocalypse Cannon, one cannot survive for more than half a minute, as the body will rapidly decay until it turns into a puddle of blood. How are Chen Yi’s injuries healing continuously?”
But soon—
Terra Star players, with some disbelief, commented.
“This is really our Terra Star territory, that mountain is Terra Mountain, and the city below is Mophie City, with about three million player residents at the entrance!”
“Chen Yi is really on our Terra Star territory!”
“What?!”
Only then did the audience in the livestream room shift their focus from Chen Yi’s injuries, and suddenly realized a somewhat unbelievable possibility!
Wait, how could Chen Yi appear on the territory of Terra Star?
Could it be that Chen Yi isn’t just starting a livestream to make threats or to reveal the bad actions of the Five Fingers Alliance to be condemned, but he’s actually preparing to take action?
What a joke!
How does a player still in the Novice Period from Star System No. 3 get to Ding Qi Star?
The hell did you fly here?!
How many planets did you cross, have you fucking counted?
And why the hell do you dare to come, aren’t you afraid of dying?!
Damn, you’re really action-oriented!
Could you at least rest for a day? You’re rushing over to seek revenge without stopping; how eager you must be for vengeance?
You inked a feud yesterday, and today you’re on their doorstep?
They say a gentleman’s revenge can wait ten years, so what, you think you won’t live another decade?
It’s simply unbelievable!
Before this, even though the Starfield announcement stated that Chen Yi had declared war, almost all players thought Chen Yi was just making threats and incidentally exposing the wrongdoings of the Five Fingers Alliance, led by Logitech Star, to get them condemned.
Nobody thought Chen Yi would actually take action!
After all, Chen Yi is just a newbie player; even if you want to fight to your last breath, you’re not qualified. Let Blue Star level up to a Threefold Planet and come to Starfield first!
Who would have thought, Chen Yi not only really came, but it also seemed like he was about to take action immediately!
A ruthless person.
No matter what the outcome, it cannot be denied that Chen Yi is a ruthless person.
And at this moment—
On the territory of Terra Star, beside Terra Mountain, in Mophie City, many Terra Players looked up at the towering mountain next to the city with fear flickering in their eyes.
They could vaguely see a man spreading his arms, his figure ethereal and surreal among the clouds and mist, like a living god on earth.
Before these Terra Players could react.
A somewhat familiar voice, through the livestream room, reached the ears of every Terra Star player present.
“Yesterday, I said that such an unspeakable humiliation would be cleansed with the blood of tens of millions of Alien Race members tomorrow.”
“Today, I have come.”
“You beasts, you all deserve to die.”
His voice was somewhat flat but filled with bloodlust and anger. Although not loud, it was deafeningly echoing in every player’s ears!
The next second—
Under the astonished, incredulous gazes of all viewers in the livestream room!
Meteors wrapped in scorching flames fell like a daytime meteor shower, with unstoppable momentum, directly aimed at the city below!
And this was just the beginning!
The catastrophe, had officially erupted!
Named after Chen Yi himself—the Apocalypse.
…
ps: I’m not quite sure how many words I wrote today; I’ve been typing for a long time, but it should be roughly around 15,000 words. I’m going to sleep now, I’ll continue tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: 286: "Can Chen Yi still survive?
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 286: “Can Chen Yi still survive?
The viewers in the live stream hadn’t reacted yet when they saw countless meteorites, thick with blazing flames, hurtling unstoppably towards the city beneath the cliff!
In the truest sense, unstoppable!
But it wasn’t over yet!
Before the meteorites even touched the ground, the entire city was engulfed by numerous otherworldly flowers, with countless bullets splattering through the air.
Tens of thousands of Buddha figures, sitting cross-legged on Lotus Platforms, each holding a Fire God Gatling, floated in the air, conducting indiscriminate gunfire on the players within the city!
War had broken out!
In the blink of an eye, the city below was engulfed in warfare, plunged into smoke and dust, with various bright explosions occasionally bursting in the city’s heart—those were the Terra Star players’ means of retaliation.
But facing such a level of attack, these means of resistance hardly held up, with many players attempting to break out of the city and launch an assault on Chen Yi atop the cliff.
However, these players received Chen Yi’s special attention.
Just a few minutes was all it took.
This city, home to millions of players, had become ruins!
As the sky rained down meteors, every building in the city was destroyed, the entire city reduced to rubble and mangled corpses strewn amidst viscous blood!
The entire scene was extremely heart-wrenching!
At this moment, the viewers in the live stream, staring at this spectacle, stood there dumbstruck, their pupils filled with shock and disbelief!
No one had anticipated Chen Yi would act so directly!
