Without any negotiations with the Terra Star authorities, he indiscriminately chose a Terra Star player city to unleash his attack, annihilating it in one fell swoop, fully incurring the wrath of Terra Star!
This grudge was essentially irreconcilable!
But it seemed… this guy had no intention of reconciling in the first place!
But it wasn’t over yet—
Chen Yi threw another round of flaming meteorites at the player city below, then, before they could land, he mounted a Christmas sleigh and, not too quickly, set off into the distance!
Attacks continued along the way!
Wherever he went, attacks followed!
Sky-filling otherworldly flowers, Fire God Buddhas, flaming meteorites, and every single bullet carried the effect of “Violators Annihilate Nine Clans.”
The attack never stopped.
His plan was simple, to give the Terra Star territory a thorough cleansing from end to end!
A cataclysmic baptism!
The reason he didn’t initiate a Race Duel Battle was, firstly, because he didn’t have the Prop, which was only obtainable on Threefold Planet, and secondly, because if he did initiate it, he wouldn’t have been able to win.
The “extermination” rule would have greatly restricted him.
Without this danger of extermination, he was free to act more recklessly.
And choosing Terra Star as the first battlefield was a decision he had considered carefully.
With hundreds of millions of players on Terra Star, this meant he could refresh his Starry Level title, “One Man Exterminates a Clan,” by killing Terra Star players and gain enough Prop refresh opportunities!
For every 5 million Alien Race players killed, he would gain one chance to refresh his props!
Logitech Star only had a few hundred thousand players, and if he died too many times and ran out of chances, then he would be unable to keep using his bloodthirsty title.
According to his calculations, starting with Terra Star was the most appropriate choice.
…
“Are the new players nowadays this fierce?”
On Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star, some players who were watching the live stream were bewildered by what was happening on their screens. If they remembered correctly, when they were new players, they were still cautiously avoiding the monthly rules, and mustering the courage to claim props from the maps below.
Even getting the most useless Prop was immensely exciting.
Isn’t that what a normal newbie player should experience? What’s with this newbie player making such a ruckus?
As a newbie, you bypass the whole Star System to stir things up on Starfield?
How the hell did you even get here?
Flew here?!
…
“Awesome!!!”
The Blue Star players who were watching the battles from Hell and Blue Star shouted excitedly as they saw this scene, waving their hands and yelling, “Kill these little bastards!!!”
Regarding Chen Yi’s violent acts, two radically different voices of opposition appeared online.
One was that all the Alien Race players who came to invade them should be wiped out.
The other was that all Alien Race players in the game should be annihilated, for those not of our race must have different hearts.
The frustrations and suffocation of yesterday found their release today in an unreservedly satisfying outburst!
This was the style Blue Star ought to have!
Not fighting back when attacked, not retaliating when insulted—that kind of cowardly behavior was just suffocating to watch!
…
Chen Yi showed no sign of stopping; while sitting on his sleigh, he began circling inside the Terra Star territory, leaving behind nothing but ruins and countless dead and injured wherever he went.
Whether it was player cities or sparsely populated wilderness.
All received his indiscriminate bombardment.
The occasional attacks that did reach him were resolved by his “Forever Pure.”
But just then—
A white portal abruptly appeared in front of him, and before he could even react, countless fully armed Terra Star players charged out, surrounding him in the center.
They unleashed their attacks simultaneously!
“Boom!!!”
A flurry of damage hammered him fiercely, bringing an intense pain that seemed to amplify in an instant, plinking up countless prompt boxes and notification sounds in front of his eyes.
‘Ding, you are attacked by Terra Star players, entering a doubled pain debuff state, lasting one minute.’

chapters.title: Chapter 312: 286: "Can Chen Yi still survive?"_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 286: “Can Chen Yi still survive?”_2
“Ding, you have been attacked by Terra Star players, falling into…”
Countless debuffs and attacks instantly engulfed him, the pop-up alerts in front of him appearing too rapidly to even refresh.
“Forever Pure!”
The attacks had no sooner landed when he activated Forever Pure, purifying all debuffs and forcefully propelling all attacks back toward the Terra Star players in front of him!
However, he was already severely injured by the Apocalypse Cannon from Logitech Star, barely clinging to life thanks to Forever Pure.
And the intensity of this group’s attack suddenly felt like it had ascended a level, almost overwhelming his Forever Pure in an instant.
But this time, he wasn’t lying on a beach chair avoiding damage.
Instead, he casually glanced at the horrific wounds on his body and once again, with a calm expression, unleashed his full power in a counterattack against the group of Terra Star players opposite him.
He had come this time prepared to exchange one life for hundreds.
Death was acceptable.
But before dying, whether he could kill enough Alien Race players was his concern.
The smoky haze of battle quickly enveloped the surroundings.
The viewers in the live broadcast room couldn’t even see what was happening in the center of the battlefield; the smoke was too thick. When everything calmed down minutes later, they could only see the grounds littered with the bodies of Terra Star players.
And Chen Yi, as if nothing had happened, merely glanced around and advanced again.
Everywhere he passed was akin to a site of disaster!
“Gulp.”
All the players from Ding Qi Starfield Continent who were watching swallowed hard at the sight. The group that had suddenly emerged from the Floating Gate, if not mistaken, must be Terra’s main force, right?
But unlike the ordinary players, the main force was a cut above in terms of mentality, execution, and the strength of their Prop and Skill combinations.
And they were all eradicated?
As the news spread, more and more players from Ding Qi Starfield Continent were woken from their sleep or called out of their maps to watch this livestream!
What a joke!
Such an exciting livestream wasn’t available every day!
How many Prop rewards can a map have? Watching the live action is much more thrilling.
Just like that, with a slight delay,
several player cities of Terra Star suffered at Chen Yi’s merciless hands.
Just when everyone thought Terra Star would continue to be steamrolled by Chen Yi without any resistance,
the view in the entire live broadcast room suddenly shot up!
Six crimson light pillars erupted around the periphery of Terra Star’s territory, like flames on a candelabrum!
And in that instant when the six crimson light pillars shot into the sky,
Chen Yi, as if sensing impending danger, instinctively looked up, only to see a massive crimson light pillar plummeting straight toward him!
He was blasted away almost instantly!
And along with that, a prompt sounded in his ear.
“Ding, you have been hit by an S-grade Prop, Heavenly Candlelight, which will cause your body to begin forced aging, and the process will accelerate over time!”
“Boom!!!”
The crimson light pillar struck the ground, blasting a huge crater and spraying up clouds of dust. When the dust settled, people saw Chen Yi lying in the center of the crater, his body dissolving and his face rapidly aging!
His temples turned visibly white, and his skin aged quickly!
But the peculiar part was,
just as he began dissolving and aging, Chen Yi’s body would return to its original state.
Then the dissolving and aging process repeated!
Only now, the aging was accelerating. At first, his hair graying was enough to revert back to normal, but later, age spots appeared before restoration.
Lying at the bottom of the crater, in excruciating pain and unable to move, Chen Yi frowned and touched the injuries on his abdomen, letting out a somewhat helpless sigh.
It hurts too much.
Although he had grown accustomed to this kind of pain, he still had to admit it was truly excruciating.
If he weren’t worried about affecting his thinking and battle readiness, he would have considered giving himself a dose of painkiller.
Then he touched his rapidly aging face and that notification panel, sighed again, and lay patiently at the bottom of the huge crater, waiting.
He was going to die once.
The speed of aging was accelerating, gradually becoming faster than the activation speed of his “Forever Pure” skill, which was about five activations per second, his limit.
He hadn’t expected to die so soon.
Feeling his life rapidly slipping away, Chen Yi fell into silence for a while, then took out a box prop from his backpack and pulled out a pack of cigarettes. He lit one and placed it in his mouth.
Through the swirling light blue smoke, he looked up at the sky above, savoring the tranquility of the moment.
Not bad.
After the last lesson, he wouldn’t put the cigarettes in his trouser pocket anymore; they were too easily reduced to shreds, leaving none to smoke.
But such real-world items could not just be put directly into the backpack.
Unless there was a box-type prop that could hold the cigarettes, and then you could place it in the backpack.
It was evident that Chen Yi had specially researched this matter.
…
Some of the Ding Qi Star players in the live stream squinted as they looked at the combat move that appeared on the screen: “This is an S-rank prop from Terra Star, ‘Heavenly Candlelight’.”
“It possesses tremendous destructive power, and upon hitting, it instantly causes the player’s lifespan to age rapidly, depleting hundreds of years of life in the blink of an eye.”
“I remember when the Terra players first came to the Starfield Continent not long after, the Turtle Race went to look for them. You all know about the Turtle Race. These players have lifespans so long it’s terrifying.”
“As long as they don’t seek death, with their lifespans, they could even live till the end of the world.”
“It took nearly a thousand years for the Turtle Race players to advance from a Novice Planet to Threefold Planet, to arrive at the Starfield Continent. These players simply did not bother with any maps or dungeons.”
“Aren’t there always some limited-time events in the leveling game each month? Occasionally, there are freebies you can snag from the limited-time events without going into any dungeons.”
“Just like that, these Turtle Race players moved on up to the Threefold Planet by snagging these freebies, although it did indeed take an extremely long time.”
“But it was these long-lived players who had a conflict with Terra. After Terra activated this prop, the Turtle Race players have never stepped foot on that territory again.”
“For those long-lived players, this prop is just a trap.”
“Can Chen Yi still survive?”
…
Before the viewers in the live stream could react, they saw countless meteors, dense with fierce flames, hurtling unstoppably towards the city at the bottom of the cliff!
Truly unstoppable!
But it didn’t end there!
Before the meteors even reached the ground, the entire city was enveloped by countless manjusaka, with bullets flying through the air.
Tens of thousands of Buddha figures, seated cross-legged on Lotus Platforms, holding Fire God Gatlings, hovered in the air, indiscriminately strafing the players inside the city!
The war had begun!
In the blink of an eye, the city below was enveloped in the flames of war and plunged into smoke, occasionally lit by explosions of multicolored light at the city center, evidence of the Terra players fighting back.
However, faced with an attack of this magnitude, their method of resistance seemed rather inadequate. Many players tried to rush out of the city to attack Chen Yi on the cliff.
Yet, these players received special attention from Chen Yi.
In just a few minutes.
This city, home to millions of players, had already become ruins!
As a deluge of meteors fell from the sky, every building in the city was destroyed, turning the entire city into a wasteland of rubble, congealed blood, and corpses!
The entire scene was shockingly poignant!
At this moment, the viewers in the live stream looked on at this scene in place, their pupils filled with shock and disbelief!

chapters.title: Chapter 313: 287: The First to Ascend - A Milestone in the Game!
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 287: The First to Ascend – A Milestone in the Game!
Soon after, it did not take long before all players watching noticed.
Chen Yi, lying in the huge pit, gradually stopped breathing, closed his eyes, and his body instantly aged into a hunched old man.
Players from Terra Star who were watching the live broadcast couldn’t help but sigh in relief—they thought, he’s finally dead. Why was this guy so terrifying?
He didn’t seem that strong when he initiated the Race Duel Battle.
At most, they felt that his turtle shell was a bit annoying, but he didn’t have such strength back then. Once arriving at Starfield, it was as if he became a completely different person.
The other viewers in the livestream also chose to leave, one after the other, uninterested, preparing to get back to their own important matters.
They had thought there might be some good drama to watch, but it ended just like that.
That was too fleeting.
However, in less than three minutes, Terra Star players were horrified to find that figure had once again returned to the territory of Terra Star!
And he continued his relentless bombardment of Terra Star territories at full strength!
Other players also excitedly realized Chen Yi had reappeared in the live broadcast, looking as though he’d climbed back from hell; they had almost forgotten about this!
Generally speaking, according to the unwritten rules of Ding Qi Starfield Continent, players who died and fell into hell to become Hell Players would not leave to return to the map.
There were many reasons for this.
For example, the flames of vengeance would be temporarily extinguished; after dying once, people would become much clearer-headed and not so impulsively seek revenge. They preferred to rest in hell for a while before leaving hell.
This was what most people did.
Only if there was some deep-seated hatred would they do otherwise.
Secondly, the difficulty of the return map was not low, and dying in the return map meant there was no chance to become a Hell Player again—it was complete death.
This sense of urgency made Hell Players hesitate when facing the return map.
Last, every successful passage through the return map would increase the difficulty the next time around.
For these reasons, very few people were so eager to delve into the return map immediately upon arriving in hell, as that would lead to a high death rate. Not to mention passing through the return map in three minutes like Chen Yi.
That was even rarer.
Because of this, the majority of Blue Star’s players were still in hell, although there were ways to return. But the difficulty of returning was significant, and Chen Yi could not possibly bring all players back with him. Each passage he made counted as a pass through the hell return map, and if he took thousands with him, the Map Difficulty would be so great it would be akin to scaling the heavens.
Many Blue Star players had already decided to temporarily settle in hell and develop their strength. Apart from not being able to participate in Race Duel Battles and not being officially regarded as Blue Star players, they were no different from Blue Star players in other respects.
Though it was a bit tragic.
But it was much better than being annihilated, and no one blamed Chen Yi for sending them to hell. Everyone was aware that if Chen Yi hadn’t sent them to hell at that time, they might not even have the chance to lift their heads to the sky now.
And Chen Yi, having returned again, did not disappoint the viewers in the livestream. Without any pause, he continued his grand plan of scouring the land!
One, two, three!
All the cities of Terra Star players fell one after the other, toyed with by Chen Yi’s hands!
If the Terra Star players would have gathered together as they did during the Race Duel Battle and attacked him at the same time, he truly would not have been able to withstand it, only able to rely on his beach chair for defense. But scattered around in various cities, primarily among civilians,
they were essentially no threat to him.
In his eyes, they were like toys.
…
Meanwhile, in a certain video conference!
The Leader of Terra Star, with red eyes full of bloodshot veins, hoarsely roared at the other four on the screen, “According to the alliance treaty, Terra Star is under attack, and you should dispatch troops to assist us. Where is your support?”
“Do you really want to watch Terra Star get annihilated with your own eyes?”
“Do you think you’ll fare better when it’s your turn?”
“Have you not heard of the saying, ‘When the lips are gone, the teeth will be cold’?”
“Why so hasty? As the leader of a race, can’t you be a bit more composed?”
Sharlu·Enzyme, the Leader of Logitech Star, gave the Leader of Terra Star a disdainful glance, “You don’t really think that we believe this new player can annihilate your Terra Star, do you?”
“It’s just the deaths of some civilian players.”
“Most of your major combat players have preserved their strength, haven’t they? As long as this group doesn’t die, Terra Star’s strength won’t be greatly impacted.”
“Besides, don’t you have means to deal with this? If I remember correctly, you have quite a few nice ‘Props’ at your disposal, though they seem to be single-use?”
“You’re reluctant to use them? So, you want us to send troops?”
“Moreover, we have sent people; they’re just taking a bit longer to arrive.”
“You call that a bit longer? Nearly an hour has passed, and you’ve only moved five miles? If you’re so half-hearted, then what’s the point of creating this Five Fingers Alliance?”
The Leader of Terra Star, his face dark with anger, glared at the Leader of Logitech Star and uttered each word distinctly.
Indeed.
He did have two powerful ‘Props’ at his disposal, each of significant power but single-use.
Using them would surely deal with Chen Yi.
But he felt it was a waste to use them on Chen Yi; they were meant for the ascension to the Fourfold Planet. So, he had had the idea to let Logitech Star and the other allied planets send troops to help him.

chapters.title: Chapter 314: 287: The First Milestone of Ascending to the Original in the Game!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 287: The First Milestone of Ascending to the Original in the Game!_2
“`
Although this would result in more civilian player deaths, as long as those two props could be saved, it would still be a gain.
But now it seemed his allies were not very reliable!
Just as he was about to say something more.
A prompt suddenly sounded in his ear.
“Ding, your direct relative Tai Ping has been killed by player Chen Yi, and the C-level skill ‘Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans’ has been triggered, you will also face death.”
“What?”
The Leader of Terra Star looked at the pop-up that suddenly flashed before his eyes, his mind went blank, and fear surged in his heart in an instant!
The C-level skill ‘Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans’!
He was well aware of this skill!
Even across the entire Starfield Continent, while the skill’s name wasn’t known to everyone, it was still quite renowned, being akin to a divine artifact in some maps that could clear them with a single shot!
Annihilating the 999 clans of monsters!
For players, though not as strong, annihilating 3 clans was also formidable!
However, this skill could only be acquired during the Newbie Protection Period and only had a chance to be obtained within the first two months of the period.
There were very few players who could bring this skill to the Starfield Continent.
After all, if he remembered correctly, during the first two months of the Newbie Protection Period, the only way to obtain skills was through collecting Skill Fragments, which was not an easy task in the initial months.
As for players, only upon death would a Skill Fragment drop.
During the first two months when social order was still unstable, he remembered the first-month rule of their planet’s Newbie Protection Period, which was no peeing while standing.
Although it seemed somewhat absurd.
It didn’t cause too strong an impact on the overall social order.
At that time, it was rare for players to have a large number of Skill Fragments, and at the same time, to form a C-level skill ‘Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans!’
After the initial two months, fragments of this skill no longer dropped.
To acquire it afterward, one could only purchase the Skill Fragments from other players.
Add to that, the difficulty of leveling up to a Threefold Planet.
And along the way, the survival rate of players for various reasons made this C-level skill relatively uncommon on the Starfield Continent.
It could even be said to be extremely rare.
In leveling up games, many skills and props have acquisition restrictions, for instance, the prop to initiate a Race Duel Battle can only be obtained on the Starfield Continent, and many skills and props can only be acquired during the Newbie Protection Period. Once that time has passed, one would only have the option to purchase them.
Props can be bought.
Skills, on the other hand, cannot be unequipped, and no one can manage to sell a fully equipped skill since they can’t be removed – except in the form of Skill Fragments, which are the only tradeable form.
Equipped skills are not tradeable.
However, this skill resonated thunderously on the Starfield Continent because it still emerged on several occasions, claiming the lives of many incredibly powerful players at the hands of some petty figures, which was deeply lamentable.
This skill is C-level.
Its rule priority is ‘C.27.’
In theory, all you need is a defensive prop with a rule priority higher than ‘C.27,’ and you could completely ignore this skill.
It’s not too hard to find a Rule Defense Prop with a priority of ‘C.23’ or higher, but that’s just theoretically speaking.
The reality of the situation is.
Even S-level defense props can’t prevent the impact of the C-level skill ‘Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans’!
According to the official explanation,
Defense props can only resist damage, while the C-level skill ‘Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans’ counts as a Rule Kill, which cannot be obstructed by defense props.
It was for this reason that the C-level skill ‘Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans’ became a bug-like existence on the Starfield Continent; as long as your direct relatives above you were killed, you had to accompany them in death.
For a long time, this concerned many powerful players who were constantly fearing for their family members’ safety.
The only prop capable of withstanding a C-level skill was one type!
‘Rule Defense Prop!’
Yet, this prop was frighteningly rare, to the point where not even one player across ten Threefold Planets would possess such equipment.
In leveling up games, two types of props are the most terrifying:
‘Props with Absolute Attributes.’
‘Props with Rule Attributes.’
The Leader of Terra Star, now rigid and unable to move, looked unwillingly at the first prop in the first row of his backpack.
But he no longer had much time to think.
The next second—
“Boom!”
His entire body exploded on the spot, and his flesh splattered across the wall.
The others who were in a video conference with him frowned in confusion, not understanding what had happened or why he had suddenly died.
…
Upon resurrecting in hell, the Leader of Terra Star looked grimly at the prop in the first row of his backpack.
‘Prop Name’: Rule Domain
‘Prop Level’: S-level.
‘Prop Effect’: Immune to all Rule Kills.
‘Prop Priority’: S.78
‘Prop Constraint’: Activating this prop consumes 100k Points per second.
‘Prop Description’: “Rules face different people with a tailored algorithm.”
This prop, he had never let anyone know about.
It was his ace in the hole.
But the prop’s consumption was too high; consuming 100k Points per second, it was impossible for him to keep it on at all times. He could only activate it in critical moments for a few seconds, using hundreds of thousands of Points to avoid death once.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 315: 287: The First Milestone in Elevating to the Essence in the Game!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 287: The First Milestone in Elevating to the Essence in the Game!_3
This is well worth it.
But the problem was, he had not been prepared at all when he was suddenly affected by “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans”.
He had no defense whatsoever.
The priority of his prop was “S.78,” which could completely block “Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans” Rule Kill, provided he activated it in advance!
Afterward, without time to ponder further, he quickly and grimly purchased a passage permit for a return map in the Hell Store, preparing to return hastily to Terra Star.
While in hell, it was impossible to contact the players on Terra Star.
Without contact and without his presence to command, the losses on Terra Star would be greater. Without his orders, none of the main station players would make a move, nor did they have the authority to use those things.
However, he had fallen into hell numerous times, and the difficulty of using the return map had increased to an absurd level.
Half an hour later.
The Leader of Terra Star wiped the sweat from his forehead, breathing a tired sigh of relief. He just needed to kill one more Alien Race player to return successfully.
The difficulty of returning was too great.
In the quest to seize this leader position, he had died far too many times.
However, at that moment—
A prompt suddenly sounded in his ear.
“Ding, over 95% of Terra Tribe players have been killed by player Chen Yi, successfully triggering the tribe extermination rule. We thank all players for your support of the ascend-the-base game these days.”
“But unfortunately, our journey has come to an end here. We hope that when you look back on your life, you will feel that the journey was worth living.”
“Three seconds until forced extermination, please prepare the remaining official players and Hell Players.”
“No!!!”
Looking terrified and shocked, the Leader of Terra Star opened the live stream and stared at Chen Yi covered in sticky blood in the image, and at the ground littered with Terra Tribe players, his body uncontrollably trembling!
No, how could this happen!
How could they suddenly be exterminated?
What about Terra Star’s main combat players? Didn’t they kill Chen Yi?
He still had two major killer props unactivated, how could they suddenly be exterminated?
He hadn’t even activated Terra’s heritage yet, how could it… how could it end like this!
He wasn’t ready yet, how could things suddenly move to this stage!
Before the prompt sounded, he had never considered that Terra Star could be exterminated. He was always thinking about other things, never expecting to receive an extermination warning!
Then, almost hysterically trembling and snarling, he yelled, “Activate the S-grade prop ‘Rule Domain,’ activate it!!!”
He didn’t want to die!
Extermination was a Rule Kill, and the only effect of his S-grade prop was immunity to Rule Kills!
The next second—
A new panel popped up.
“Ding, detection of S-grade prop ‘Rule Domain’ on player, which can grant immunity to Rule Kills below S.78, attempting to immunize against the extermination Rule Kill, beginning the assessment…”
“Assessment failed.”
“The priority level of the extermination rule is SS.99, insufficient authority!”
“Extermination authorized!”
“Damn it!!!”
In the last second of his life, the Leader of Terra Star let out a hysterical roar, the same last words as Qiu Hao in his final moments!
“With the fate of my Terra Tribe, I leave a Hundred Generations Bounty!!!”
“I refuse to accept this!!!”
Following that—
An announcement sound echoed in the ears of all players in the Starfield Continent.
“Ding, an announcement from the Whole Starfield of Ding Qi Star!”
“The notifying planets include Logitech Star, Good Cat Star, Black Star, Turtle Star, Zhiwa Star, Egglet Star… and a total of 876 planets.”
“In Star System number 3 of the Ding Qi Starfield, player Chen Yi from Zerofold Planet Blue Star, with his own strength, has killed 95% of the Terra Tribe on Terra Star and has exterminated them!”
“Terra Tribe of Terra Star is declared exterminated, permanently exiting the ascend-the-base game.”
“There will be no further reconnection opportunities.”
“And this act has shocked countless players, the event has been elected into the annals of the ascend-the-base game, where it will permanently leave its name and mark, and will receive a statue representing this event in the Hall of Honor of the ascend-the-base game.”
“And has earned the milestone in the ascend-the-base game!”
“Milestone name: Gods and Demons Descended.”
“Conditions to Achieve: The first to ascend to the Starfield Continent as a new player and exterminate a tribe!”
“Let us congratulate Chen Yi for becoming the first player in the history of the ascend-the-base game to achieve this milestone.”
“And for earning the Stellar Rank title ‘Like a Demon’!”
A long announcement resonated in the ears of all players in the Starfield Continent!
And the players watching from Star System number 3 heard this notification as well.
All the players watching the battle were somewhat dumbfounded and in disbelief, staring at the screen for a long time, unable to snap out of it. This… just like that, a tribe was extinguished?
A new player, ascending to the Starfield Continent and so easily exterminating a tribe?
Why does it feel like Terra Star had barely put up any real resistance from beginning to end?
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi was standing on the edge of a cliff at a high peak in the territory of Terra Star, looking down over the entire Terra Star territory, which by now was like a volcanic eruption, with dense and fierce fire burning everywhere.
This was the scene after being bombarded by numerous meteorites.
The entire territory of Terra Star had been cleansed by him.
Describing it as a hell on earth was no exaggeration.
Apart from the announcement audible to all players of the Starfield Continent, there were several panels in front of him only he could see.
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully achieving the ascend-the-base game milestone ‘Gods and Demons Descended,’ and this feat will be permanently recorded in the annals of the ascend-the-base game and grant you a statue representing this event in the Hall of Honor.”

chapters.title: Chapter 316: 287: The First Milestone in Elevating to the Essence in the Game!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 287: The First Milestone in Elevating to the Essence in the Game!_4
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi on obtaining the Stellar Rank title ‘Like a Demon’.”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for reaching a game milestone and receiving the following rewards: 10 million Points, an S-rank Prop Admission Ticket, and an invitation to the 33 Club.”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for being known and followed by over 30 billion players, earning the Starry Level title ‘Attention of Millions!'”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi on annihilating three races, receiving the Starry Level title ‘Wildfire Burns Out!'”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for achieving a game milestone for the Ding Qi Star’s Starfield Project Team, receiving the following rewards: 2 million Points, and all players from their affiliate planet Blue Star will receive a C-rank Prop Random Treasure Chest, and all Blue Star players will receive the black title ‘Protection of the God Yi’!”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for fulfilling the wager contract with the Snow Sea Project Team and successfully achieving a game milestone, this time with no cross-realm expense!”
At the same time.
Two more announcements resonated in the ears of players across the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Xing!
“Ding, Terra Star player Tai Buping has activated an A-rank Prop ‘Hundred Generations Bounty’.”
“This Prop can only be used on the eve of a race’s extinction, and the activator must possess a certain reputation within their race.”
“All Props and Points of Terra Star players will be bundled and stored for use as the bounty.”
“Bounty one: annihilate Blue Star and Chen Yi and take half of the bounty.”
“Bounty two: annihilate Logitech Star, Meiju Star, Red Plum Star, Duoga Star, and take half of the bounty.”
“The bounty rewards are as follows: 19.341 billion Points, S-rank Prop ‘Rule Domain’ *1, S-rank Prop ‘God’s Cannon’ *1, S-rank Prop ‘Heavenly Candlelight’ *1, S-rank Prop ‘Hundred-Year Prison’ *1, A-rank Props *42, B-rank Props *…”
“This bounty lasts indefinitely!”
“Any player who completes the bounty may take the corresponding rewards, which will be sent by the system to the player’s inventory.”
“If multiple players contribute to the completion, the system will automatically allocate rewards based on each player’s contribution.”
“ps1: The reputation standard is that the player’s name is known by more than 70% of their own race, which means they have a certain reputation and can make decisions on behalf of their race on some occasions.”
“ps2: Part of the Props have been used up, players may dispose of them or use other methods to restore the Prop usage.”
The announcement rang out deafeningly.
Yet the players on the Starfield Continent fell silent.
At the same time.
In the skies above the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Xing, a monumental milestone was slowly ascending and hanging high in the sky!
This was the first game upgrading milestone on the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Xing!
At this time, within the Ding Qi Star’s Starfield Project Team, there were two starkly different attitudes!
Members of the Feng Family-led Ding Qi Star’s Starfield Project Team all had gloomy faces and stayed silent, as it was their ploy that had sent Terra Star to the Solar System #3.
The person in charge of the Solar Star Project Team, Feng Yuan, was one of their own.
Terra Star had intended to follow Feng Yuan, but Chen Yi’s annihilation of Terra Star at the same time had trampled the Feng Family’s dignity severely.
Not everyone was aware.
But anyone with a bit of insider knowledge knew that the assault on Blue Star was orchestrated by the Feng Family, right?
Still, with the Feng Family controlling nearly a quarter of the Ding Qi Star’s Starfield Project Team’s power, no one stepped up to say anything.
However, within the Ding Qi Star’s Starfield Project Team, excluding the Feng Family members, everyone else was ecstatic!
This was a game upgrading milestone, after all!
It’s value far exceeded that of an S-rank Prop!
For the Starfield Continent Project Team of Ding Qi Xing, securing a game upgrading milestone by a player from their affiliate planet during their tenure was the greatest achievement!
If the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team hadn’t proposed the game upgrading milestone as a bet condition when they approached them for a gamble, they never would have let Chen Yi in!
The cost to let a newcomer player reach the Starfield Continent was not small!
…
ps: A 6k-word mega chapter update, and from now on, all updates will be mega chapters for smoother writing.

chapters.title: Chapter 317: 288: "You're the first one I've seen who takes revenge to the level of involving an entire clan.
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Chapter 288: “You’re the first one I’ve seen who takes revenge to the level of involving an entire clan.
“…”
In the live broadcast room.
Chen Yi stood on the edge of a tall peak within the territory of Terra Star, his expression calm as he looked down at the land before him, engulfed in thick, intense flames, silently not speaking.
Only the skin exposed to the outside was continuously melting and healing.
It always gave off an unreal sense of fantasy.
After the entire territory of Terra Star had been thoroughly bombarded by meteoric fire, there was no longer any place to stand.
Undoubtedly.
The Terra Tribe had been exterminated, and the sudden vacancy of such a large territory would surely lead to various powers fighting for control here, but so far, not a single force dared to set foot in the territory of Terra Star.
Or rather.
There was not a single force that dared to enter this territory boldly under Chen Yi’s watchful eyes.
When Chen Yi first emerged from the Novice Planet and came here, although the players paid a lot of attention to him, they mostly did so with the intention of enjoying the show, after all, several Threefold Planets picking on a Zerofold Planet.
Not only did they fail to exterminate him, but they were instead declared war upon by the other side.
This was originally a very amusing matter.
A rather good topic for after-dinner conversation.
But when Chen Yi truly exterminated Terra Star, the nature of the situation changed, it was no longer about just watching a joke unfold, it was an invasion…
A real, tangible invasion.
Although they themselves were not the ones invaded, the oppressive feeling brought by Chen Yi could not be dissipated.
“Ding, the Alien Race player you killed cannot fall into hell, Terra Tribe player Tai Buping activated the S-level prop Rule Domain just before dying, the prop’s rule has a higher priority than your Starry Level Title One Man Exterminates a Clan, therefore, player Tai Buping is currently enjoying his afternoon tea safely in hell.”
Such a prompt popped up before the extermination.
He had a Starry Level title “One Man Exterminates a Clan!”
This title had an effect that meant the Alien Race players he killed would not go to hell, meaning they could not be resurrected, they would die permanently.
But in the Race Duel Battle, this title effect did not manifest.
In a Race Duel Battle, all killed players were forced into hell, immune to his “One Man Exterminates a Clan” Starry Level title effect.
This was because in a true Race Duel Battle, only when one side is exterminated and the other side leaves the battlefield safely, even if they fall into hell and become Hell Players, it does not matter—it’s irrelevant since once a race is exterminated, the players in hell die along with them.
The reason for this rule is to allow the players who died in the Race Duel Battle to cheer on the players of their race from hell.
However, during the invasion of the Zerofold Planet due to the huge disparity in strength and because of the time limit, those players who should have died permanently were able to avoid his Starry Level title effect and had the chance to be resurrected once more.
As for that Tai Buping who used an S-level prop to dodge the effect of his title, Chen Yi did not really care about that, for shortly after the prompt sounded, Terra Star was exterminated by him.
Even the players in hell would be forced to die.
Avoiding it once had no significance whatsoever.
However, the effect of the S-level prop “Rule Domain” looked very powerful, and it seemed he had not missed the opportunity to obtain this prop himself.
Chen Yi squinted his eyes, looking towards the Hundred Generations Bounty left behind by the Terra Tribe.
For exterminating Blue Star and Chen Yi, one could claim fifty percent.
Exterminating the other four stars that had invaded Blue Star would also yield fifty percent.
The latter fifty percent, he should be able to claim, after all, his only purpose here was singular, to exterminate those five stars at all costs.
It’s just that he wasn’t sure how the fifty percent would be distributed, whether it was allocated randomly or by some other algorithm.
The Terra Tribe indeed had some interest.
Backstabbing their allies before death allowed him a chance to pick up a great bargain; after all, the foundation of a race was at stake, and even fifty percent was not an insignificant amount.
It’s just a pity about the other fifty percent.
He probably won’t have a chance to claim it in this lifetime.
Chen Yi shook his head regretfully, thinking that the wealth accumulated by himself and Blue Star was no small sum, and it was truly enviable. Leaving such wealth unclaimed was simply a waste.
After that he sighed in relief and did not immediately head to the territory of Logitech Star but lit a cigarette, attempting to alleviate the pain in his body.
It hurt a lot.
His body was continuously melting at all times, and this injury was absolutely impossible to heal; as of yet, he had no idea how to address this injury.
Under the effects of the Wife-Killing Buff, he could indeed cling to life using Forever Pure, but without the Wife-Killing Buff, he could only lie paralyzed in a beach chair for life, leaving it would mean death.
He didn’t think too deeply about it.
Instead, he turned his head to look at the dense array of system notifications popping up.
The most frequently mentioned phrase was “Elevation Milestone in the Game!”
He looked up at the sky, and at that moment, a giant monument was visible in the sky above Starfield Continent, and even at a distance of tens of thousands of kilometers, the characters on the monument’s face were clearly visible.
Entirely black in color, the font in a blood-red hue.
The blood-red font seemed to be in constant motion, causing pain in the eyes upon careful scrutiny for even a short duration.
Countless beams of light danced around the monument, drawing the gaze of many with their brilliance.
And clearly inscribed on the monument was a line of text.
“Ding Qi Star Continent Monument!”
“Monument Name”: Gods and Demons Descend!

chapters.title: Chapter 318: 288: "You're the first one I've seen who takes revenge on an entire clan."_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 288: “You’re the first one I’ve seen who takes revenge on an entire clan.”_2
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first newcomer player to ascend to Starfield Continent and annihilate a clan.
“Owner”: Chen Yi.
“Also-Ran Project Team”: Snow Sea Project Team.
“Affiliated Project Team”: Ding Qi Starfield Project Team.
“Also-Ran Project Team is awarded one S-tier Free Permission without compensation, all members receive 100 Points, and one punishment-evading privilege.”
“Affiliated Project Team is awarded 100 Achievement Points, all members receive 50 Points, granted with a promotion eligibility lasting for ten years, awarded with a punishment-evading privilege, and the naming rights for Starfield!”
This monument, just like a glaring package, hovered incredibly brightly above the Starfield Continent as if afraid it wouldn’t catch the eye.
He didn’t know if it was only from his angle that it could be seen so clearly.
Or if all players on Starfield Continent could see it clearly as well.
He wasn’t sure about the value of those rewards for the project team; they seemed few. A hundred Achievement Points, fifty Points didn’t feel like much.
The S-tier Free Permission without compensation intrigued him though; he wondered exactly how it worked.
And the Monument in the main game, it didn’t skimp on his rewards either.
10 million Points, S-tier Prop Admission Ticket, 33 Club invitation.
These were the rewards obtained after securing the game’s main Monument; the value of 10 million Points needed no further explanation.
That S-tier Prop Admission Ticket, however, left him slightly disappointed.
“Prop Name”: S-tier Prop Admission Ticket.
“Prop Level”: S-tier.
“Prop Effect”: Upon activating this prop, 10 players with S-tier Prop Admission Tickets will be taken to a map where they have the chance to obtain an S-tier prop.
However, only one player can obtain an S-tier prop, and the other nine will receive A-tier props.
A-tier props are guaranteed; each player will obtain at least one A-tier prop.
The effects of the props inside the map are random and cannot be chosen.
Also, the map can only be opened when all 10 players have gathered. If not enough matching players are found, please wait patiently.
“Prop Restriction”: Can be used only once.
“Prop Description”: “Possessing an S-tier prop is like holding the admission ticket to the true stage.”
There was only a one in ten chance to obtain an S-tier prop.
Which was somewhat disappointing to him.
The main game’s Monument seemed pretty important, but the rewards it endowed felt somewhat sparse and ordinary–shouldn’t they have at least given him an S-tier prop random treasure box?
Wouldn’t that have been much more appropriate?
As for the remaining 33 Club invitation.
It seemed like a circle for networking.
“Prop Name”: 33 Club Invitation.
“Prop Level”: None.
“Prop Effect”: Upon activating this prop, you will be invited to the 33 Club’s group chat, which is only open to players who have won the main game’s Monument.
“Prop Restriction”: Can be used only once; trading is forbidden, as is dropping, discarding, and destroying.
“Prop Description”: “33 Club, a power unknown to the general public.”
Chen Yi frowned as he looked at this prop panel, didn’t ponder much, and activated it right away. Only then did he notice a system announcement he had overlooked, as there had been too many announcements sounding off before.
It was impossible to keep up.
“Ding, as you have captured a milestone Monument in the main game, you have been selected as a Seed Player for the main game. As a Seed Player, you automatically possess the ‘Heaven’s Gift’ privilege.”
“Players with this privilege will have a one-time protection from true death.”
“When a player’s soul is lost and thrown into the depths of hell to serve as a janitor, they will be automatically exempted once and returned to hell.”
“And upon their return, all negative effects including absolute debuffs will be eliminated.”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi’s eyebrows slightly raised in thought but said nothing; this privilege seemed quite useful.
It provided a one-time evasion from true death.
Through the “Requesting the Mandate of Heaven” Skill, he learned that when a player died in hell, they would plummet into the abyss of hell and take on the role of a janitor, with the sole task of devouring the carcasses of dead monsters and players into their stomach.
Some monster carcasses were so decayed they were stuffed with maggots, and yet they had to be forcefully swallowed.
This torture was worse than true death.
But with this prop, one could evade true death once. Moreover, after employing this privilege, the absolutely unhealable wound he suffered would also be healed, something that was particularly useful for him at the moment.
It’s just… such a precious privilege seemed wasted in this way; it felt a bit uneconomical.
Unless there was truly no other option, he definitely wouldn’t choose this method.
But anyhow, it was still a solution, easing the urgency in his heart a little; at least he wouldn’t have to spend the rest of his life lying on a beach chair as a useless person.
And just then—
A virtual chat group panel suddenly popped up in front of him.
Following this, a notification chimed in his ear.
“Ding, your application to join the 33 Club chat group has been approved. Please say hello to everyone!”
The next second—
Several messages popped up on the chat group panel.
Beimu Qi from “North Wind Starfield”: “Yo, finally a newbie joined the group. Let me take a look at the Monument the newcomer completed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 319: 288: "You're the first one I've seen who takes revenge on an entire clan."_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 288: “You’re the first one I’ve seen who takes revenge on an entire clan.”_3
“Li Mu Starfield, Li Mu”: “It seems another Starfield is about to obtain its naming rights.”
“Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi”: “I haven’t heard of any Starfield rushing to achieve a Monument recently.”
Chen Yi didn’t reply, merely sizing up the players posting these messages in the chat group before him, unsure of the situation for a moment. There were a total of 78 players in the chat group.
The name of the chat group was the 33 Club.
But soon.
A flood of messages rapidly began to fill the screen on the chat panel!
“Beimu Qi Starfield, Beimu Qi”: “Damn, this newbie is really a newbie, the Monument this new player completed is one where as a newbie, he eradicated an entire Alien Race, it kind of scared me, give me a moment to process this!”
“Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi”: “Bro, can you tell me how you did it? Aren’t you still in the Newbie Protection Period? How did a player still in the Newbie Protection Period annihilate a Threefold Planet? Are you using cheats?”
“I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi”: “How much are the cheats selling for, is 1 billion Points enough?”
“A Thought Travels Thousand Miles Starfield, Feis”: “There you go flaunting your Points to the newbies again, who doesn’t know you’ve got so many Points your account can’t even hold them all, but I’m more curious about how this newbie did it, this Monument probably wasn’t the result of a Starfield rush, right?”
“Li Mu Starfield, Li Mu”: “No shit, Sherlock, a newbie player can’t even come into contact with Starfield, how could it be the result of a Starfield rush, the value of this is one-to-one high.”
“Beimu Qi Starfield, Beimu Qi”: “The newbie has been in the group for so long, why hasn’t he said a word yet? We’re supposed to help each other in the future.”
Chen Yi frowned as he looked at the players’ IDs in front of their messages in the chat group.
I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield?
What kind of ridiculous Starfield name is that?
Are there Starfield names like this?
Does this look serious to you?
However, he quickly noticed that upon opening these players’ avatars, one could view the Monuments they had obtained.
The Monument for that Beimu Qi was.
“Monument Name”: A Thought Travels Thousand Miles.
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first player to clear 10,000 maps.
“Owner”: Beimu Qi.
“What the hell?”
At a glance at this line, Chen Yi was momentarily stupefied in place—the first to clear 10,000 maps?
Is this for real?
Since descending into this upgradable game, has he even cleared 50 maps?
10,000 maps?
How long do you have to live to have the time to clear 10,000 maps?
How tough must you be to be so lucky to have visited 10,000 maps and not died in any of them?
He felt that the name of this Monument shouldn’t be A Thought Travels Thousand Miles, it should be Tough and Long.
Initially, he thought Beimu Qi was a very ordinary name, but after seeing this Monument obtained by Beimu Qi, the name suddenly became significant in his heart—clearing 10,000 maps… how many Points would you need to carry in your backpack?
A single person was worth the foundation of several Threefold Planets, weren’t they?
But as he continued to click on the avatars of the players posting messages in the chat group, he gradually fell silent on the spot, getting a clearer idea of what this 33 Club was. This club seemed to be a gathering of freaks.
A bunch of freaks with heaven-defying powers.
“Monument Name”: United Hundreds.
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first player to kill 999 different players of the Alien Race.
“Owner”: Wang Qi!
Awesome.
If he remembered correctly, the total number of planets in the Ding Qi Starfield Continent was just over 800, and you’ve killed 999 different Alien Race players; if placed in the Ding Qi Starfield Continent, it would be indebted to you for over a hundred Alien Race players.
It shows what kind of inconceivable feats a collector freak can accomplish after descending into the upgradable game.
“Monument Name”: Eternal!
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first player to fall into hell 198 times.
“Owner”: Li Mu.”
“…”
Each time you fall into hell, the difficulty doubles, falling 198 times.
Guess in the return maps, a bunch of Ninefold Planet players are competing with you?
This is also a supermodel of freaks.
“Monument Name”: Rich Man.
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first player to earn 1 billion Points during the Newbie Protection Period.
“Owner”: Li Yi.”
This Li Yi, the one who just suggested buying cheats for 1 billion Points, as for this Monument, he was really at a loss. With his strength during the Newbie Protection Period, he was already supermodel level, but he was still far from having 10 billion Points.
How did this Li Yi earn 1 billion Points during the Newbie Protection Period?
The Hundred Generations Bounty left before Terra Star was annihilated was just under 20 billion Points, and you, a single person, earned 1 billion Points during the Newbie Protection Period?
Continuing to look down the list, one player in the chat group was more terrifying than the next.
After considering for a moment, he decided to first send out a red packet as a greeting gift to the veterans as a newbie joining the group.
He opened the red packet feature of the chat group, preparing to send a big one, so as not to seem too stingy.
Send a 1 million Points red packet for 78 people to grab.
“Ding, red packet sending failed.”
“For this chat group, the group red packet amount must be set to at least 5 million Points.”
“…”
Chen Yi’s mouth twitched slightly, you want him to send a red packet of 5 million Points?

chapters.title: Chapter 320: 288: "You're the first one I've seen who takes revenge on an entire clan."_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Chapter 288: “You’re the first one I’ve seen who takes revenge on an entire clan.”_4
What a joke?
He had only spent 5 million points when he went to Solar Star to partake in the second-tier map trial of Solar Star; now he had to hand over 5 million points for sending a red packet?
But after hesitating for a moment, he still chose to send a 5 million points red packet.
The amount seemed just about right; any higher would seem a bit ostentatious.
“Ding, red packet sent successfully.”
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “Hi, seniors, I’m new here. Please look after me in the future.”
He kept a humble profile because, after all, these people might already be at the level of four or fivefold planets, and just thinking about the conditions to achieve on that monument gave him a bit of a headache.
Soon after.
Someone in the group chat replied to him.
“I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi”: “Welcome, welcome. But brother, why are you still using the default prefix ID of Ding Qi Starfield? Didn’t they reward you with the Starfield naming rights?”
“Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi”: “I just noticed too, still starting with Ding Qi as the prefix ID. I suggest you change it to Yi Daddy Starfield like mine, it’s more domineering.”
“Ping Daddy Starfield, Beiping”: “Right, join our big family.”
Chen Yi frowned and carefully examined the announcement, making sure there was no mistake before continuing.
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “I double-checked the announcement, and the Starfield naming rights weren’t awarded to me, but to the Ding Qi Starfield project team.”
“Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi”: “Hey, bro, you’re quite straightforward. It’s true it was awarded to your project team, but you’ve captured the monument. Isn’t your Starfield essentially under your control? Don’t worry, soon someone from your Starfield project team will contact you for your opinion on what name to change it to.”
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “Understood, thanks for the clarification. I’ve got some other matters to deal with, so I won’t take up too much of your valuable time, haha.”
“Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi”: “What matters? Aren’t you going to rest for a few days after just capturing the monument?”
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “There are some enemies I haven’t finished off, need to take care of them quickly, or else I’ll have trouble sleeping.”
“Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi”: “That’s true, how many enemies do you have that you can’t sleep easy?”
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “About a billion or so left, I guess.”
Chen Yi seriously calculated the number of players remaining on the other four planets and came up with an approximate figure.
“…”
“…”
“…”
And the chat group was quickly filled with a dense forest of ellipses.
Dad Qi Starfield’s Wang Qi also sent a voice message with a hint of grievance: “Bro, aren’t those a bit too many enemies? It’s the first time I’ve heard of someone killing off enemies by the billion.”
“Or is it that the culture on our planet is different and there’s some discrepancy with the unit ‘billion’?”
“It’s not like people kill by the billion, right?”
Realizing the misunderstanding, Chen Yi quickly explained: “I never kill by the billion; I’m not that kind of bloodthirsty psychopath. I always exterminate by race. Some players of certain races have offended me, so I need to take care of those races.”
“Otherwise, they’ll definitely come after me later.”
“It will affect my peace of mind.”
“…”
“…”
“…”
Once again, the chat group was flooded with ellipses.
“Northwind Starfield, Beimu Qi”: “Bro, I finally understand how you got that monument. But does revenge always have to be by race? Can’t we adjust that range a little?”
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “Do you mean to say by Starfield? That doesn’t sound good. I’m not fond of killing. Others haven’t provoked me; there’s no need to extend the range so broadly, right?”
“Northwind Starfield, Beimu Qi”: “…Brother, you are truly merciful.”
“Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi”: “So, how many more races do you have to kill?”
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “Four more. I’ll try to finish them all by working overtime today, then take a few days off to rest.”
“Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi”: “Are they all from Ding Qi Starfield?”
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “Yes, they’re all from some Threefold Planets.”
“Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi”: “…You’re a real tough one. You’re the first I’ve seen who takes revenge by exterminating races; keep it up.”
Chen Yi suddenly remembered something and directly asked in the group chat.
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi”: “When I received the monument, my racial player group all received a black title, ‘Yi God’s Title.’ Did the players of your races also get it when they obtained a monument?”
Black title.
Every Blue Star player had one.
This left him somewhat confused.
You see, on Blue Star, the highest level of title is rainbow-colored, followed by black. Such rare titles given to everyone? Could this game of advancing realms be so generous?
“Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi”: “You’re talking about that title, everyone has it. It doesn’t have any effect, it’s just symbolic, meaning that when your racial players go out to do things, other Alien Race players will see the title above their heads and know that your racial players belong to someone who has achieved a monument in the advancement game. They might think twice about their little schemes.”
“It’s a symbolic meaning. They might have thought of taking advantage, but after seeing that title, they’d probably drop such thoughts.”
“Other than that, it doesn’t have any other benefits.”

chapters.title: Chapter 321: 288: "You're the first one I've seen who takes revenge on an entire clan."_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: Chapter 288: “You’re the first one I’ve seen who takes revenge on an entire clan.”_5
“Oh, right, when you claim the Monument, you’ll be forced to become the Person in Power for your planet, and from then on, decisions on the planetary level will need your presence. Prior to this, the selection was based on fame and prestige, chosen by the rising game.”
“When you claim the Monument, no matter if players with higher fame and prestige than you appear on your planet afterward, the Person in Power for your planet will be fixedly you.”
“Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi” spoke up, “Got it, thanks for clearing up my confusion, bro. I’ll get going now, don’t want to hold up a big shot like you.”
It has to be said.
This Club 33 still has some use, as he had learned a lot of information from here that was nowhere to be found on ordinary days. This could also be considered a kind of information gap.
The rewards for claiming the Monument in the game were basically just these, but in addition to that, he was also awarded a Stellar Rank title.
“Title Name”: Like a Demon.
“Title Level”: Stellar.
“Title Effect”: Upon activation of this title, you will enter Demonic Body State.
In the Demonic Body State, you are immune to any control, including fainting, dizziness, charm, and so on.
Ignore pain.
And you cannot be directly looked at, defined, or called by name.
All enemies who directly look at you will see an extremely horrifying scene.
“Title Restriction”: Activating this title effect costs 100,000 Points per minute.
“Conditions to Achieve”: Be the first newcomer player to kill your way to the Starfield Continent and annihilate a clan.
“Title Introduction”: “Like a Demon, like a Buddha, as if a Demon Buddha.”
This title effect is very strong!
Activate Demonic Body State, immune to any control!
Before that, he had always used “Forever Pure” limitless to be immune to control, the effect of “Forever Pure” was to purify all negative effects on oneself, including control!
But even with fast purification, there is still a moment of stiffness when a large number of control skills rain down.
But this title effect is different.
This title effect totally ignores control, not even that moment of stiffness.
And the immunity to pain effect is also very useful.
As for the effect of not being able to be directly looked at, he was a bit unclear about what that meant.
It’s just that after activation, the Points consumption is a little expensive, 100,000 Points per minute, which adds up to 6 million per hour… Thinking about it this way, it doesn’t seem too expensive; it’s just enough to send a red packet in the Club 33 chat group.
This “Stellar Rank” title is definitely higher than those of “Starry Level.”
But as to how much higher, he really wasn’t clear.
He had completely strayed from this area.
He hasn’t touched on this topic at all.
Besides, he had obtained two more titles, both of Starry Level.
They were—
“Attention of Millions!” and “Wildfire Burns Everything!”
Both of these titles seemed to have really good effects, it has to be said, the rewards for annihilating the Terra Star clan this time seemed a bit high, far surpassing what he had received for wiping out the God Race and Solar Clan.
After all, when slaughtering pigs, it’s best to pick the fattest.
“Title Name”: Attention of Millions!
“Title Level”: Starry.
“Title Effect”: Upon activation of this title, all players within your field of vision will be forced to stare directly at you for one minute.
And after the title is activated.
Your field of vision will instantly plunge into utter darkness, and only a column of light descending from the sky will envelop you.
This is what it means to be the center of Attention of Millions.
“Title Restriction”: After using it once, it enters a 24-hour cooldown.
“Conditions to Achieve”: Be known and followed by more than 300 billion players.
“Title Introduction”: “I swear, I’m the number one in the world! Yes, my mother ranks first, my grandpa second, and I’m the humble youngest in the family.”
This title is of a functional nature.
There’s no harm in it at all.
It seems like a title suited for giving speeches, forcing everyone’s eyes to focus on oneself. If combined with some props for use, it might have a one plus one equals to a trillion effect.
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes thoughtfully and said.
For example, some props that would petrify all players looking at him.
Combined with this title, the effect would be very strong.
Or his newly obtained Stellar Rank title “Like a Demon,” all enemies who look directly at him will see an extremely terrifying scene. The literal meaning seems simple, but after all, it’s a Stellar Rank title; it probably won’t be treated so carelessly.
This so-called extremely terrifying scene won’t be that simple.
Using these two titles together might have a pretty good effect.
He then looked at the other title.
“Title Name”: Wildfire Burns Everything.
“Title Level”: Starry.
“Title Effect”: Upon activation of this title, you can confer the forced title ‘Target of God Yi’ to any player, ignoring distance, plane, dimension, and the title will be forcibly worn, displayed, without any effects, only for show.
After annihilating the Ten Clans, this title will be promoted.
After the promotion, the effect can confer the forced title to all members of any clan.
“Title Restriction”: Activation costs 10,000 Points each time.
“Conditions to Achieve”: Annihilate three clans.
“Title Introduction”: “Wildfire can’t be burnt out? No, that’s because the spring breeze is too gentle. Have you tried my fire?”
This title didn’t seem quite up to Starry Level, it was even less useful than “Attention of Millions” as it didn’t have any combo to play with.
Chen Yi shook his head.
Finally, he had finished reviewing all the rewards. After such a long time, his eyes were starting to hurt, and it was quite tiring.
For the first time, he felt that receiving rewards was a bothersome task.
Afterwards, he took a deep breath and, taking one last glance at the ruins of Terra Star’s territory, he stepped onto the sled and raced off into the distance.
This stop.
Red Plum Star, perhaps.
…
ps: Nearly a 10,000-word mega-chapter, woke up at seven in the morning and have been typing until now, so tired… Going to eat now, but the good news is my biological clock has finally adjusted.
Also, thanks to the boss “Waiting for Yan Nanfei” for the countless 100 Points tips, the backstage messages kept popping up, and also to the boss “Book Friend 20180523075134012” for the 10,000 Starting Points tip.
There’s no need to go into details here, thank you everyone for the tips and monthly passes.
Thank you.

chapters.title: Chapter 322: 289: Every Era Has Its Scars
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Chapter 289: Every Era Has Its Scars
Red Plum Star had a slightly larger player population.
It was perfect for refreshing his Starry Level title “One Man Exterminates a Clan” cooldown times.
For some unknown reason, the resistance on Terra Star was disorganized and sporadic, lacking the oppressive feeling of a Race Duel Battle.
What he didn’t realize was
that the Chief of Terra Star hadn’t even deployed the main force players. From beginning to end, they scarcely used their main force players, waiting for support from their allies.
Chen Yi was everyone’s problem, why should their race fight to the death alone?
If they used all their main force players and tapped into their reserves, they were confident they could take down Chen Yi, but to what end? Having sustained heavy losses, they wouldn’t last long on the brutal continent of Starfield.
If they were to strike, they should all do it together.
However, what he didn’t expect was that these four allies also harbored plans to let Terra Star suffer heavy losses and then divide Terra Star among themselves to bolster their race’s power after the battle.
In the jungle, a wounded beast couldn’t survive long, as injury spelled impending death.
The same was true on Starfield.
A race that had suffered heavy losses would attract packs of hungry wolves.
There was nothing wrong with this strategy.
But the problem lay in how quickly Chen Yi had acted, obliterating Terra Star before they could even muster a single organized resistance. Such a humiliating extinction was met with resistance only from civilian players.
But what threat could some scattered civilians pose to a fully-powered Chen Yi?
As for the regular army, brought up on the taxes from these people, when Chen Yi began his slaughter,
they strictly obeyed the Chief’s orders, not firing a single shot, not stepping a foot outside the city.
In this obedience, they were certainly compliant.
Until they were hit by falling meteorites or affected by the Annihilated Violators.
A humiliating death.
It was like the Chief of Terra Star, who couldn’t believe that Terra Star would be annihilated so easily, holding back until the end, holding back Terra Star’s true strength, still waiting for ally support, only to face Terra Star’s extermination.
Even the chiefs of the remaining four planets never imagined Terra Star would be annihilated, instantly extinguishing their hidden agendas. They all started to seriously consider one thing: where would Chen Yi go next, and would he continue his assault?
Countless players were watching Chen Yi’s screen in the live broadcast room.
Until Chen Yi, driving a sleigh, stopped at the edge of a peak, with dense jungle covering the land at the mountain’s base.
“Red Plum Star!”
These three words erupted in the chat, and the players in the live broadcast room exploded in an uproar!!
Nobody expected that Chen Yi would not be content to stop there but was planning to continue the massacre!
Yes, a massacre.
This was no longer a battle, but a naked slaughter.
“A lot of ‘Props’ fell within Terra Star’s territory.”
Standing at the edge of the cliff, Chen Yi fell silent for a long while before lighting a cigarette and said softly, “Actually, I’m quite tired. I’d rather just lie back in a rocking chair on the rooftop with friends, eating barbecue and drinking beer, instead of traveling so far to kill so many people.”
“Killing is quite boring, you know.”
“But there’s something I hope to announce to everyone through the broadcast: I can’t pick up those ‘Props’ that fell within Terra Star’s territory. According to the rule of the Newbie Protection Period, new players can’t obtain ‘Props’ from any other planet through any means.”
“Those ‘Props’ can only lie there, abandoned.”
“But eventually, Blue Star will ascend to become a Threefold Planet.”
“And before that happens, any force that occupies these territories, or any that devours my spoils of war, will become my enemy.”
“I don’t like others taking what’s mine. I hope you’ll think over these words when desire overwhelms your reason.”
“Okay, today’s work starts now.”
“I hate working.”
The next second—
Meteorites rained down on the entire jungle below!
The apocalyptic scene once seen over Terra Star was perfectly replicated over Red Plum Star.
This time, Red Plum Star’s players didn’t make the same foolish mistake as Terra Star had, quickly recalling the reinforcements that had yet to set foot in Terra Star’s territory. Fortunately, they were slow; had they been faster, they would have gone down with Terra Star.
They also gathered all their main force players, ready for orders at a moment’s notice!
Most importantly, in angry and hasty tones, they sought help from the other three allied races!
Clearly, he had understood Chen Yi’s overt strategy: with all five races joining forces, Chen Yi was no match for them.
After all, in the Race Duel Battle, Chen Yi alone had struggled to a point of merely defending against one of them; without the restrictions of the Battle, five united races would leave Chen Yi no room for arrogance.
But… after all, the alliance had only been formed that day.
Everyone wanted to see Red Plum Star use all their resources to fight to the death against Chen Yi, and then divide the already severely weakened Red Plum Star.
The battle had barely begun when!
A huge number of Red Plum Star players died!
At that moment, human life seemed worthless.
Chen Yi stood on the edge of the cliff, looking down at the fiery battlefield below with cold, indifferent eyes, and said nothing.
He had no pity for these people; they should have thought of this outcome when they came after him.
…
“Ding!”
As Sword Without End, drenched in sweat and panting, prepared to re-enter the return map with Jiaye, a notification sound suddenly rang in his ear. When he saw the notification panel, his face turned ghostly pale in an instant!

chapters.title: Chapter 323: 289: Every Era Has Its Scars_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Chapter 289: Every Era Has Its Scars_2
Glancing at Yi’s silhouette in the neighboring live streaming room, only two words filled my heart.
Done for!
He didn’t show off in public, but he was the biggest mastermind behind Chen Yi.
The reason why Chen Yi could be so confident at the front was because he always had Jiaye with him when entering the Return Map.
The Wife-Killing Buff could only last one hour.
To extend the buff, one had to kill again!
This meant that he had at most 55 minutes to clear a map. If he surpassed this time, Chen Yi’s Wife-Killing Buff would not be renewed, and he would be dead without a Place of Burial right then and there!
When this plan was executed!
They knew that the key to the success of this plan was whether they could quickly clear the Return Maps with Jiaye.
If they failed to clear a Return Map within one hour, the plan would be declared a failure.
“Ding, it has been detected that you have repeatedly cleared the Return Map with the same player, so the following measures are taken against you: In the next Return Map, you will enter alone.”
“If you successfully clear it, then both you and your teammate will return successfully.”
“If you fail to clear, then you and that teammate player will never be able to team up again.”
Perhaps it detected that I was exploiting a loophole.
The game directly intervened.
The punishment wasn’t severe, but what was, was that this map was a plot map and it was the one forcibly selected!
This was deadly!
To ensure clearance within the time limit, the Return Map Access Passes they chose were the type that could be cleared quickly based on personal strength. But having been detected and forcibly swapped for a plot map was unexpected.
To know, all plot maps basically couldn’t be cleared in less than three hours.
Furthermore, plot maps often ban all props, skills, titles, etc., relying solely on plot to clear, which requires a large number of brain cells and time. There’s no way to finish in an hour!
Three hours!
Without the Wife-Killing Buff, three hours would be enough for Yi to die hundreds of times!
“What’s wrong?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been waiting in hell for a long time, furrowed his brow and asked, “Has the difficulty of the Return Map increased? Use Plan A and switch to me.”
Each time you clear the Hell Return Map, the difficulty increases once.
A maximum of two players can team up to play.
Once two players team up, their difficulties will average out to a mean level.
They had anticipated the possibility of excessive difficulty in the Return Maps and had prepared contingency plans accordingly. The night they headed to Starfield, they did more than just eat barbecue on the rooftop; they discussed a great number of contingencies.
Plan A.
Let Tuberculosis Rabbit take Jiaye into the Return Map. Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t go to hell as frequently as Sword Without End, so once the difficulty level was averaged out between them, it seemed much less insurmountable. With Tuberculosis Rabbit’s strength, clearing it in an hour wasn’t too hard.
Plan B.
Let Yi, when there are about 20 minutes left of the Wife-Killing Buff, intentionally seek death to go to hell, then return with Jiaye under the buff’s effects and keep repeating this process.
Plan A would allow Chen Yi to output damage without restraint upfront.
Plan B was more conservative but would leave many idle periods. These gaps when no overwhelming attacks could be inflicted on the enemy could easily give the enemy enough time to gather strength, contradicting the principle of blitzkrieg.
In a David vs. Goliath battle, speed is of the essence.
Every second counts.
So many idle periods were a lethal issue.
“No way.”
Sword Without End shook his head with a grim expression that was as somber as dripping water, sharing the Return Map forcibly selected by the game in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit.
‘Map Name’: Escape Room 13.
‘Map Level’: Return Map.
‘Map Type’: Plot Map.
‘Map Content’: In this map, the player must play the role of a student with a severe internet addiction, who has been sent by their parents to the Gratitude Rehabilitation Center due to addiction to gaming. Through choices in the plot within this map, the player must successfully leave the Gratitude Rehabilitation Center, and every choice can greatly affect the outcome.
Successfully escaping from the Gratitude Rehabilitation Center constitutes clearing the map.
Within this map, all of the player’s props, titles, skills, etc., will be restricted, and clearing can only be achieved through choices in the plot.
‘Map Description’: “Every era has its scars, just like absolute props, the shadows they leave behind cannot be repaired.”
‘PS: This map is now forcibly bound as you and Jiaye being in the same team. You enter the map alone, if you clear it, then both you and Jiaye will return, if you fail, then you can never team up with Jiaye again to enter the Hell Return Map.’
“Forced binding.”
“A plot map?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face also suddenly turned sour; clearly, he knew that plot maps virtually never allowed for a quick exit. Their selection of Hell Return Maps was entirely about avoiding plot maps.
He swiftly glanced down at his wristwatch, and said urgently, “There are 53 minutes left before Yi’s next round of the Wife-Killing Buff ends. Subtracting some coordination time, you must clear within 48 minutes.”
“Otherwise, Yi will be in danger!”
He knew the betting agreement Yi had signed.
The agreement signed on the way to Starfield was to help Ding Qi Star secure a monument in the game’s promotion.
But on returning to Blue Star, another betting agreement had been signed, and without fulfilling that condition, Yi wouldn’t be able to return.
Without the Wife-Killing Buff, Yi wouldn’t survive an hour in an environment like Ding Qi Star’s.

chapters.title: Chapter 324: 289: Every Era Has Its Scars_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 289: Every Era Has Its Scars_3
Even if Yi was killed back to hell, it would be useless.
The second bet agreement stipulated that if Yi couldn’t complete it in time, even if he safely returned to Blue Star, he would bear a grievous cost, a cost that they could not possibly bear!
Now, the only solution was to clear the level within 48 minutes.
There was no alternative.
“It’s up to you now.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit slapped Sword Without End’s shoulder, not to stress him but to cheerfully say, “It’s fine, just relax. If we fail, it’s no big deal. We’ll just all become Scavengers together and enjoy it.”
“Enjoy my ass.”
Sword Without End cursed bitterly, then wiped the gloom off his face and with a determined gaze, activated the Map Access Pass, and without looking back, dove into the white light gate that appeared before him.
He did not want to become a Scavenger.
Not now at least.
There were distinct hells for each Race, but Scavengers from all races worked in the same place.
Descending at this time, he might run into those exterminated from Terra Star, and it was inevitable to face their taunts and mockery. This disgraceful moment, for him, was more torturous than becoming a Scavenger!
“For Yi, for dignity, I’m all in!”
With a flash of white light,
he appeared in an internet café, the screen displaying a somewhat colorful and vibrant game. Just as he was getting up to check the mission details, an ear-splitting pain stopped him.
A somewhat overweight middle-aged woman, from behind, grabbed his ear and angrily pulled him up from the café seat, yelling furiously.
“The homeroom teacher said you didn’t go to class today, I guessed right away you’d skipped school for the internet café again!”
“Do you realize that games will ruin you? If you don’t study properly now, what will you do when you grow up? Work as a waiter like me?”
“Do you want our whole family, for three generations, to be waiters?”
“You’re really hopeless!”
“Fuck!”
