Taken by surprise by the ear-pulling and scolding, Sword Without End, out of anger, instinctively tried to gesture a sword command and roared, “Sword, come!”
However.
As his words fell, the once obedient Three-Foot Qingfeng did not appear instantly as usual, as if it had vanished.
Sword Without End was stunned for a moment, then realized that Props had been banned.
“Still saying ‘Sword, come’?”
Little did he know that this phrase made the middle-aged woman behind him even angrier: “I think you’ve really gone crazy playing games. Look around this internet café; do you see even one good soul? You trash are contaminating the entire society!”
“I think you really need a good reform. I’ve already spent thirty thousand yuan to enroll you in the three-month Gratitude Rehabilitation Center intensive training camp. Go there and study hard, and when you come out, you will understand the painstaking care we parents have for you.”
“I am your mother, would I harm you?”
At this moment—
After she finished speaking, in Sword Without End’s view, the entire scene suddenly slowed down as if paused, and next to the middle-aged woman, an introduction box popped up.
‘Character’: Ren Ping.
‘Status’: Mother.
‘Introduction’: A middle-aged woman earning a monthly wage of 1,800 yuan by washing dishes, who spent two years of savings to send her child to Gratitude Rehabilitation Center, hoping the child could get rid of internet addiction and focus on studying.
Two options also popped up in front of him.
A: Confront Mother. Spending thirty thousand yuan to send me to that, I think you’re the one who’s stupid. People as stupid as you deserve to only make 1,800 a month! You’re too stupid to control me.
B: Placate Mother. Mom, I know I was wrong. I won’t play games anymore, please cancel that, okay? I’ll behave better in the future.
Clearly,
Different choices would lead to different story progressions.
And his main mission was to escape from the Gratitude Rehabilitation Center; once he escaped, he would pass the level and could leave successfully.
Nothing would happen to Yi, either.
…
ps: I’ve been struggling with writer’s block all day, so there are only these 5,000 words. Feeling frustrated.

chapters.title: Chapter 325: 290: "Dad Yi, what's the situation now?
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 290: “Dad Yi, what’s the situation now?
Without any hesitation.
Sword Without End immediately chose Option B, to appease his mother. The urgent matter at hand was naturally to placate the woman in front of him as much as possible, so as not to be stuffed into that damned place. He had less than an hour.
He must act quickly.
He had only three chances to reselect, to rewind, and he couldn’t afford to waste them.
…
Meanwhile, on the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star!
Chen Yi didn’t stop for a moment, firing with all his might.
All the props in his backpack were activated one after another, bombarding the territory of Red Plum Star just as he had once bombarded the territory of Terra Star.
On the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star, all the players watched the live stream in silence.
Inhumane? No, no, no, in fact, there wasn’t any bloody scene at all, neither the rivers of blood expected, nor corpses strewn everywhere, nor a scene with limbs and flesh flying all over the sky.
What could be seen were only the endless flowers of the other shore, meteorites blanketing the sky, and bullets swarming like a plague of locusts.
As for the corpses?
Not a single one could be seen.
Those corpses simply couldn’t appear in their field of vision through such a dense barrage of firepower.
At first, everyone was shocked when Chen Yi wiped out Terra Star, but now there was only silence.
Chen Yi had extinguished Terra Star so effortlessly. Although they had no particular relation to Terra Star, after all, it was one of the three main planets of the Ding Qi Star Starfield, and it had been so easily eradicated by Chen Yi.
It made them feel as if they had lost face.
Most players didn’t understand the significance of what the Monument in the game represented. It was an existence that most players could not encounter, but even if they were unaware of the Monument’s significance, the sheer size of it hanging over their heads was enough to demonstrate status.
Only a few understood the significance of the Monument, and as they looked at the silhouette of Chen Yi inside the live stream, a hint of wariness and jealousy flowed through their pupils.
With this thing.
Put bluntly,
Chen Yi could basically walk sideways across the entire Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star.
What was lacking was just a bit of seniority.
No matter how you looked at it, Chen Yi was still just a newbie player after all. It was impossible for him to stay long on the Ding Qi Star Starfield Continent, so the threat to the Ding Qi Star Starfield Continent was very limited. Once Chen Yi officially advanced to be a player of the Ding Qi Star Starfield Continent, this place would essentially be under Chen Yi’s control.
It could already be said that he had secured the throne.
The Monument in the game, how many in the Starfield longed for its existence!
Just when all the players in the live stream thought that the Red Plum Star was going to simply follow in the footsteps of Terra Star—
“Bang!”
A mighty noise suddenly erupted from the horizon!
Immediately after, countless gates of light appeared abruptly around Chen Yi!
Numerous fully armed players, dense like locusts, emerged from the gates of light, weapons in hand, surrounding Chen Yi in the middle, each wearing armor that shone with a golden light, looking extremely impressive.
At the same time!
Ninety-nine golden pillars descended from the sky!
Like a cage, they enclosed Chen Yi within!
It was just that the area enclosed was quite large, covering an area as big as three or four cities.
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi, who stood on the edge of a cliff, leaning on his staff, glanced around at the players who suddenly appeared wearing armor. After his gaze lingered on the faces of a few players, he suddenly chuckled.
“Old acquaintances, eh? I have a faint impression of quite a few of you.”
Indeed.
Many of these players had specifically targeted him during the Race Duel Battle.
His memory wasn’t very strong, but he still remembered some.
The players in the live stream also let out a collective sigh of relief.
The main force players of Red Plum Star had appeared.
It was said that the main force players of Red Plum Star had a complete set of Golden Light Armor, which was an extremely rare set of props, almost 100,000 pieces in total.
The familiarity with this prop could be described as extremely buggy.
Any player wearing the Golden Light Armor who sustained damage would have that damage divided into 100,000 parts, spreading it evenly among every player.
This meant that no matter how severe the damage, when it hit a particular player, it was just a triviality.
“Finally, they made their move.”
A player in the live stream couldn’t help but exclaim, “This is the main force of Red Plum Star, the Golden Light Army. That whole set of armor is said to have been wrested by the entire globe of Red Plum Star within an S-rank map, exploiting a bug to grind endlessly, and it took a lot of effort, time, and lives to obtain.”
“It’s said that there were originally only 99 pieces.”
“I don’t know what bug Red Plum Star found, but they managed to grind up to 100,000 pieces, directly elevating what was originally an A-rank prop to an S-rank effect, and perhaps even higher.”
Such a prop, the greater the number, the stronger its power.
A blow with extreme power, even when divided among 99 players, could still result in significant damage to each player.
But now, dividing it among 100,000 players, it was practically zero damage, no different from a mosquito bite.
“It looks like Red Plum Star has learned its lesson, at least not following in the footsteps of Terra Star. Their main force didn’t come out and got annihilated.”
“Exactly, I don’t understand what Terra Star was thinking, getting annihilated like that. Preserving strength? Were they saving strength to dominate in hell?”
“It won’t work, if you get wiped out, even the Hell Players will have to be buried with them.”
“So it’s dominating among the Scavengers?”

chapters.title: Chapter 326: 290: "Dad Yi, what's the situation now?"_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Chapter 290: “Dad Yi, what’s the situation now?”_2
“`
“Scavengers can’t use props and skills, either.”
“Then who knows? Who knows what Terra Star is thinking? Maybe they’re just plain tired of the routine.”
…
Chen Yi glanced at the sudden appearance of hundreds of thousands of players beside him, draped in golden armor, floating in mid-air like celestial soldiers. He arched his eyebrows slightly before saying with a smile, “Attention of Millions.”
It’s always best to strike first to avoid misfortune later.
These people obviously seemed to be forming some sort of formation, and he naturally wouldn’t wait for them to be ready before making his move. This wasn’t some turn-based game, and it was the perfect time to test his newly obtained title.
The next second—
Starry Level title “Attention of Millions,” activated!!!
The skies were dimming towards dusk, not dark yet, but there was still ample light.
But as the title was activated, the sky within Chen Yi’s line of sight abruptly turned pitch-black.
Utter darkness, the kind where you can’t see your hand in front of your face.
As if all light had been swallowed whole.
Wherever Chen Yi’s gaze reached, darkness spread.
If he raised his viewpoint, it looked as though a black swamp had suddenly appeared on the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star.
Then—
A blindingly bright beam suddenly shot down from the sky, enveloping Chen Yi, who stood at the cliff’s edge. The beam served as an outline, casting sharp and clear definition across his features.
The beam didn’t just shoot straight down.
It came at a 45-degree angle.
Creating a stark contrast between light and shadow on Chen Yi’s face.
The players engulfed by the darkness suddenly found their gaze uncontrollably fixating on Chen Yi, along with a voice ringing in their ears.
‘Ding, Player Chen Yi has used the Starry Level title Attention of Millions, and you will be forced to stare at Chen Yi for one minute.’
It seemed to be a minor control ability.
But the leader of the Golden Light Army must have turned pale in fear, as if Chen Yi used a prop or skill that induced a calamity upon anyone who looked at him, then they would all be in trouble!
Luckily it was just a small control, nothing too serious!
They had to act quickly!
“Attack!”
The leader of the Golden Light Army roared and took the lead in the darkness, charging towards Chen Yi’s position!
Although they were surrounded by pitch darkness and couldn’t see the road ahead, Chen Yi’s position was illuminated. As long as they focused on Chen Yi’s location, they could charge straight towards him!
In a moment.
A hundred thousand players, all using their own methods, charged directly at Chen Yi!
In the process, collisions among them were inevitably occurring in the dark; it was truly a difficult path to navigate!
Just as the first Red Plum Star player burst out of the darkness and arrived before Chen Yi, his face brimming with excitement as he leapt in the air ready to swing his blade, Chen Yi casually glanced at him and murmured.
“Seems Like A Demon.”
Stellar Rank title “Seems Like A Demon” activated!
Almost instantaneously as he spoke!
Chen Yi’s skin suddenly became crystal clear, and the blood beneath his skin started to flow like magma. His entire body was covered in black patterns, and two enormous wings struggled to emerge from his back with a roar, bursting out!
Nearly three meters long bone wings, with bits of flesh and blood hanging from them, gently fanned behind Chen Yi.
“Huh!”
Chen Yi pulled out a mirror from his bosom and held it before his eyes, gazing at the translucent skin in the reflection, the magma-like blood flowing beneath, and his now blood-red pupils. He fell silent for a moment before stroking his chin thoughtfully.
It looks a bit chuunibyou, doesn’t it?
So this is the ability of the Seems Like A Demon title?
It feels like a transformational title.
But in the Demon Body state, he was impervious to any pain. The excruciating agony that Logitech Star inflicted on him, which was considered irreparable, was barely perceptible at this point. Instead, it felt as refreshing as drinking a bucket of ice water on a scorching summer day.
Only.
This was how he appeared in his own eyes.
In reality, everyone perceived it differently.
The true Chen Yi had undergone no changes at all. Since everyone’s vision of the demon varied, so did the appearance they saw.
To those without hostility towards Chen Yi, they saw an image of a demon as they pictured it in their own minds.
To those hostile towards Chen Yi, they saw an indescribably terrifying vision!
What’s known as “when one looks at a mountain, it’s not a mountain; when one looks at water, it’s not water.”
The essence of things doesn’t change; it’s the perception that does.
However, Chen Yi forgot one thing—
This was a Stellar Rank title!
“`
“`
Stellar Rank!
It is the highest title that one can obtain on the Ding Qi Starfield Continent, without a second!
Even the top players from the fivefold planet can only achieve titles up to the stellar rank!
On a single Starfield Continent, those who possess a stellar title can be counted on one hand!
Chen Yi, who was not clear about the title level system, had no concept of the term “Stellar Rank,” knowing only that it was significantly more powerful than the effects of a starry level title.
And the “Seems Like A Demon” stellar rank title came with a very explicit title effect.
Every enemy who looks at you directly will see an extremely terrifying scene.
At this moment, he was live streaming.
The next second—
Throughout the entire number three star system, the entire Ding Qi Starfield Continent, hundreds of billions to trillions of players who were watching the battle saw Chen Yi’s silhouette in the live stream room and subconsciously froze for a moment!
Immediately after.
Their faces drastically changed, as if they had seen some unimaginably horrifying scene, their pupils bulged out, and they tightly grasped their own throats!
Immediately after.
A player from the Ding Qi Starfield Continent let out a fierce roar and then suddenly self-destructed!
And this scene was merely an abbreviation within the Ding Qi Starfield Continent!
In the Ding Qi Starfield Continent, a massive number of players, with fierce expressions, clasped their throats and self-destructed on the spot!
For a moment.
Hundreds of billions of players self-destructed at the same time!
“Quick, fucking stop it!”
Just as Chen Yi was admiring the tragic state of the Red Plum Star player who had surged out of the darkness to attack him, a prompt suddenly came through his ear.
Looking carefully, it turned out to be a prompt from the Ding Qi Starfield Continental project team.
‘Ding Qi Starfield Continental project team: “Quick, fucking stop it, this month’s rule for Ding Qi Starfield Continent is ‘Calm and Cool’!!!”‘
“Calm and Cool?”
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully.
He had heard that rule name before; it seemed they had experienced it as well.
The next second—
His ears were then overwhelmed by ceaseless prompt sounds.
‘Ding, you have successfully killed 95% of the players of Red Plum Star; Red Plum Star will be completely exterminated and permanently leave the game.’
‘Ding, you have successfully killed 95% of the players of Logitech Star; Logitech Star will be completely exterminated and permanently leave the game.’
‘Ding, you have successfully killed 95% of the players of Duoga Star; Duoga Star will be completely exterminated and permanently leave the game.’
‘…’
‘Ding, you have killed over 50 billion players in a single day!’
‘And this action has shocked countless players, the event has been selected for the game’s chronicle, where you will permanently leave your name and mark and earn a statue in the game’s Hall of Honor to represent this event.’
‘And you have achieved a game milestone!’
‘Milestone Name: World Slaughterer.’
‘Conditions to Achieve: The first player to kill 50 billion alien race players in a single day!’
‘Let us congratulate Chen Yi for becoming the first player in the game’s history to achieve this milestone.’
‘And for acquiring the stellar rank title ‘Like a Demon’!’
‘…’
‘Ding, you have exterminated the Ten Clans, congratulations on your starry level title ‘Wildfire Burns Out’ beginning its ascension.’
‘Ding, you have killed over 50 billion players in a single day, this deed has started to be announced throughout the whole Starfield.’
‘Ding…’
‘…’
A barrage of prompt sounds kept ringing in his ears.
Chen Yi was instantly confused, wait a minute, what’s happening?
What happened?
He didn’t know.
And at that moment—
The 33 Club chat group completely exploded!
‘Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi: “Dad Yi, didn’t you say you’d only kill a dozen or so billion of your enemies? What’s happening now, an announcement throughout the whole Starfield? I got the notice too, Dad Yi, did you not hold back and slaughter a whole Starfield?”
‘Beimu Qi from the North Wind Starfield: “Dad Yi, when I told you the range could be altered a bit, I really didn’t mean to change it so drastically… Dad Yi, you’re truly impulsive!”‘
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 327: 291: "Teacher Chen Yi, maybe don't kill them first?
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 291: “Teacher Chen Yi, maybe don’t kill them first?
“Ding, an announcement from the Whole Starfield and its subordinate star systems.”
“Let us congratulate the player from Ding Qi Star Starfield Continent’s Affiliate No. 3 Star System, Blue Star’s Chen Yi, for killing over 50 billion Alien Race players in a single day, achieving the game milestone of ‘World Slaughterer’ and obtaining the Stellar Rank title ‘Seems Like A Demon’.”
“And such a feat has been recorded in the great deeds of the promotion game!”
“Let us remember this player’s name; it is this player who has opened up a new era for us!”
“Considering that this player is a novice player, and after system calculations, today’s average strength of novice players has surpassed the events and maps encountered on the Novice Planet. We will adjust the difficulty of all maps and events on the Novice Planet and to some extent reduce the drop rates.”
This announcement echoed simultaneously in the ears of players across a thousand Starfield Continents and hundreds of thousands of star systems!
In an instant!
The name Chen Yi became nearly universally known!
…
“Hurry, hurry!!”
Sword Without End, who was returning to the map, looked emotionlessly at the two options before him, his mind spinning rapidly as he pondered the optimal solution. He couldn’t make the wrong choice; a mistake would put Yi in danger!
At the same time, the star system announcement slowly popped up in front of him.
What a damned announcement. Who has the time to look at it now?
Yi’s life was still in his hands!
He had to focus on navigating the map, otherwise, otherwise… Yi would be in danger, right?
Without giving it much thought, Sword Without End glanced at the announcement and continued to focus on the two options before him. However, a moment later, he felt something was off and sharply turned to look at the announcement next to him.
“What the hell is this?”
After a while,
Sword Without End ignored the two options in front of him, expressionlessly lit a cigarette, put it to his lips, and took a long drag before he faintly looked up at the sky.
Yi didn’t seem to need him that much, after all.
Fifty billion players.
Did he just exterminate all the players from Ding Qi Star Starfield Continent?
Was there even any point in him completing this map then?
Did Yi have any enemies left by his side?
No, wait; did Yi have any living people left by his side?
…
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Jiaye, who were still sweating bullets for Yi in hell, exchanged a silent look when the notification sound popped up, not sure what to say.
In fact, they hadn’t understood how Yi had killed so many players.
In their eyes,
Yi had just turned red-eyed and then grown a pair of wings that made him look like Satan.
Then, the promotion sound suddenly rang out.
But whatever the case, it was a good thing, it should be a good thing, right?
…
“Are you guys insane!! What the fuck, how am I supposed to handle this?!”
“Huh?”
“Tell me how to handle this?!”
In the office of the Snow Sea Project Team above Blue Star, the team lead, Jin Buhuan, turned down the volume of the communication box a bit with some toothache and braced himself to say, “How to handle what?”
“Our Blue Star player Chen Yi has just secured another Monument for you Ding Qi Star Starfield.”
“Continents with two Monuments in the promotion game are few and far between. Ding Qi Star Starfield Continent has obtained two Monuments today; this is a cause for great celebration, far surpassing our initial wager agreement.”
“You might as well celebrate quietly.”
“Celebrate my fucking ass!”
The elder on the other end of the communication box seemed quite irritated, his face flushed red, his hair standing on end, and he shouted with bloodshot eyes: “Half of the players on my Ding Qi Star Starfield Continent have been fucking wiped out, half, you hear me?!!”
“Why don’t you just wipe us all out?!”
“Um…”
Jin Buhuan of the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team propped his chin with one hand, thought for a while, then nodded, “There’s some sense to that. There’s no precedent in the promotion game history for a player to single-handedly annihilate an entire Starfield in one day. If that can be achieved, it’ll surely secure another milestone.”
“Hold on, let me go discuss with Chen Yi.”
“Discuss my ass!”
As Jin Buhuan was about to proceed with this idea, the elder on the communication box went pale in an instant, his voice trembling as he spoke: “You hurry back here; this matter can’t be handled like that!”
“Fifty billion players have been killed!”
“Aside from those who have been clan exterminated, a large number of players are now stuck in hell!”
“You have to come up with a way for these players to return from hell.”
“What’s so hard about that?”
Jin Buhuan of the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team glanced at the elder on the communication box somewhat puzzled: “You’re much more experienced than me, you should understand these things better. When there aren’t enough players from your own star to open the return map in hell, just borrow players from other races.”
“It’s all the same.”
“Just like when there aren’t enough Blue Star players, the promotion game will, based on their respective return difficulties, transport them to different maps of other races.”
“Does that sound difficult to you?”
“No, it doesn’t.”
The elder in the communication box spoke with a grim expression, “However, as far as I know, your planet’s player Chen Yi has already begun preparations for exterminating the entire Starfield race. His rationale is that although it was manslaughter, since he killed, he has made enemies.”
“To make enemies and not deal with them properly will lead to endless troubles.”
“He has already begun preparations to depart.”
“What do you say, what should we do?”
“Uh… about that, I’ll go and talk to him, but I can’t guarantee anything specific. As you know, we’ve always followed the rules and can’t overly interfere with the players’ personal actions, just like when your Ding Qi Starfield Project Team sent five players from Threefold Planet to challenge Zerofold Planet Blue Star to a Race Duel Battle.”
“That was an individual act by the Feng Family! It’s not to be attributed to the Ding Qi Starfield Project Team!”
…
At this moment, Chen Yi had also roughly understood the situation.
The effect of Attracting the Attention of Millions had ended as well.
Right now, a glance over the territory of Red Plum Star revealed corpses and pieces of flesh scattered everywhere, quite the sight of a living hell, completely in line with the death condition of the Title Effect ‘Calm and Cool’.
Players who die under this rule all end up in this terrible state.
What he couldn’t understand was this.
These players, they didn’t die by his hand, so why should their deaths be counted against him?
He merely showed these players a face of great horror, and then they triggered the ‘Calm and Cool’ effect on their own and died explosively. How could that be considered his doing? Why did it feel like sins were being forcefully attached to him?
If it was considered his doing,
Then these players should not be able to fall to Hell! After all, one of the effects of his Starry Level title ‘One Man Exterminates a Clan’ is that alien race players killed by him cannot fall to Hell. But if that’s the case, why did these players end up in Hell?
Could it be that all these players have some kind of Rule Domain immunity artifact?
After thinking for a while and still not getting it, Chen Yi shook his head helplessly.
Although he had accidentally killed a batch of people, the remaining ones still had to be dealt with, after all, this now counted as making enemies. And naturally, making enemies meant it had to be handled cleanly, lest there be endless troubles later—this was the wisdom passed down by the ancestors.
He thought it would just be a bit of extra work, but this time it looked like he was in for a major ordeal.
He just wasn’t sure if he could hold up against the players from Fourfold Planet and Fivefold Planet.
Furthermore, it wasn’t really an accident.
Only those with hostility in their hearts toward him would envision a scene of great horror upon seeing him. Since they harbored hostility, they were enemies, and deserving of death.
The only thing he couldn’t figure out was.
Why so many people felt hostility towards him.
Was he really that repulsive to others?
The continuous notification sounds that had yet to stop buzzing in his ears were giving him a real headache.
Just then, the notification from the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team came through his earpiece.
‘Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team Leader Jin Buhuan’:”Chen Yi, Sir, why don’t you stop killing for now? Blue Star is also supposed to ascend to become a Threefold Planet and join the Ding Qi Starfield. If the power of the Ding Qi Starfield is reduced too much, it will affect Blue Star later on.”
“There is competition between each Starfield, and for external matters, a Starfield should act as a whole.”
“What do you think, Chen Yi, Sir?”
“Sir?”
Chen Yi noticed the somewhat strange form of address: “Why call me ‘Sir’?”
“As a show of respect.”
“Oh.”
Typically, there should be no interaction between the project team and players, let alone interference with players’ actions, and the use of respectful titles is unfounded.
But that’s the general case.
For someone like Chen Yi, who has already defied the norm, things cannot be discussed in the usual way.
To be honest, he was also somewhat puzzled.
He had some reservations about the wager agreement signed between him and the Ding Qi Starfield Project Team, but no one expected Chen Yi not only to complete the agreement but to do so in an exceedingly perfect way.
At one point, the existence of the Ding Qi Starfield Project Team was nearly unnecessary.
All races on Ding Qi Starfield Continent would be exterminated, and all members of the Ding Qi Starfield Project Team would be cast into the depths of Hell to serve as Scavengers.
These members of the Ding Qi Starfield Project Team had thought Chen Yi was just there to exterminate the Five Clans; they didn’t expect that he was coming for them.
“There’s another issue.”
Chen Yi, frowning, spoke up, “These 500 billion players clearly died because of the ‘Calm and Cool’ rule in effect on Ding Qi Starfield Continent in August. Why did the announcement say they were killed by me? This greatly damages my reputation, as many will think of me as a bloodthirsty person.”
“Moreover, with such a great carnage, could my future son bear it?”
“Isn’t it said that the sins of the father must be borne by the son?”
“…”
Then your future son will have to be named Chen Piyan, at least to preserve his skin inflammation.
Jin Buhuan silently snarked in his mind, then began to explain, “Chen Yi, Sir, it should indeed be the case that players who die due to the ‘Calm and Cool’ rule on Ding Qi Starfield Continent in August cannot be blamed on you.”
“We have already reported this matter to the Ascension game.”
“They are processing it.”
“When the result comes out, I will inform you, wait, let me check the processing outcome.”
“The reply from Ascension game is that it sounds better this way.”
“…”
“…”
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi spoke up emotionlessly, “Alright, I understand.”

chapters.title: Chapter 328: 292: "Into the Devil, Become the Buddha, Transform the Devil-Buddha.
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Chapter 292: “Into the Devil, Become the Buddha, Transform the Devil-Buddha.
Although the situation left him somewhat befuddled, the current outcome was all good for him, with no downsides.
He didn’t even make a move on Logitech Star, and it was annihilated outright.
But perhaps the extermination was too abrupt.
Logitech Star didn’t even leave behind a Hundred Generations Bounty or such before dying, which was quite a pity. He had really coveted that absolutely incurable A-grade prop from Logitech Star, although if the bounty target were him, chances are he wouldn’t have been able to get it.
But there was at least a glimmer of hope, wasn’t there? Instead of now, where it’s gone straight to hell with its original owner.
As for the drop chance, that was way too low.
The sudden elimination of over 50 billion players gave him a huge reward, which meant he could start his holiday earlier, but it seemed to have given him a certain notoriety as well. When Blue Star players advanced to Ding Qi Starfield Continent, they probably wouldn’t be very welcome.
The next second—
A new notification sound suddenly rang in his ear.
“Ding, you have completed the Hundred Generations Bounty left by Terra Star, eradicating Logitech Star, Meiju Star, Red Plum Star, Duoga Star, and you will receive fifty percent of the bounty.”
“The total bounty rewards are as follows: 1.9341 billion Points, S-grade Prop ‘Rule Domain’ *1, S-grade Prop ‘God’s Cannon’ *1, S-grade Prop ‘Heavenly Candlelight’ *1, S-grade Prop ‘Hundred-Year Prison’ *1, A-grade Props*42, B-grade Props*…”
“Random drawing in progress…”
“Ding, congratulations, you have been awarded 970 million Points, S-grade Prop ‘Rule Domain’ *1, S-grade Prop ‘Hundred-Year Prison’ *1, A-grade Props 21, B-grade Props*…”
“Ding, it has been detected that the player is a newbie player, still within the Newbie Protection Period, and cannot obtain any props that are not supposed to be obtained during the Novice Period by any means; hence the prop has been temporarily stored in the system warehouse, to be distributed after the player passes the Novice Period.”
Chen Yi’s eyes had just lit up and then dimmed again with a hint of resignation.
He really liked the rewards.
An S-grade Prop ‘Rule Domain’ *1, which was a great life-saving item. He had heard about the rough effect of this prop in the annihilation system announcement, which essentially meant it could immunize against certain Rule Kills.
And there was the S-grade Prop ‘Hundred-Year Prison’ *1, which sounded like a very decent binding prop by its name, not to mention those hundreds of millions of Points, and a whole bunch of A-grade Props. To think that he didn’t have many A-grade Props on him right now, let alone any S-grade Props.
“…”
While he felt somewhat helpless, he had no choice but to accept this reality.
It was at least better to receive it late than to join Terra Star in annihilation.
Above the skies of Ding Qi Starfield Continent, a massive monument had inexplicably risen at some point. It was entirely black with blood-red lettering, oozing a thread of malevolence, profoundly unsettling to behold.
This colossal monument clearly bore several lines of text.
“Ding Qi Starfield Continent Monument!”
“Monument Name”: World Slaughterer!
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first player to kill over 50 billion Alien Race players in a single day.
“Owner”: Chen Yi.
“Consolation Project Team”: Snow Sea Project Team.
“Affiliated Project Team”: Ding Qi Star Main Project Team.
“Consolation Project Team, award one S-grade free privilege without compensation, all members receive 100 points, and a one-time exemption from punishment privilege.”
“The affiliated project team is awarded 100 Achievement Points, all members receive 50 points, and are granted the qualification to advance, with a limited term of ten years, and a one-time exemption from punishment privilege!”
Just yesterday, the Ding Qi Starfield Continent had not a single monument.
In the context of the whole Starfield system, it was classified among the least impressive categories, a little bit embarrassing to show up on the true stage of the main game.
Today, suddenly there were monuments.
Two of them.
One Starfield, two monuments—inside the whole Starfield system, this was a very rare occurrence.
Prestige surged in an instant.
But in terms of overall strength, Ding Qi Starfield Continent was far inferior to other Starfield Continents at this time.
Almost everyone had been massacred, so it was no surprise there was a lack of strength.
This monument also rewarded him with a Stellar Rank title, “Seems Like A Demon.”
“Title Name”: Seems Like A Demon.
“Title Level”: Stellar.
“Title Effect”: Will unlock officially in half an hour.
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first player to kill over 50 billion Alien Race players in a single day.
“Title Introduction”: “Entering demonhood, becoming a Buddha, transforming into the Buddha demon.”
“Unlocking in half an hour?”
Chen Yi glanced over it, a bit puzzled by this, but then he no longer cared and instead turned his attention to the title that had been promoted.
“Title Name”: Wildfire Burns Everything.
“Title Level”: Falling Star.
“Title Effect”: After activating this title, you can bestow the enforced title ‘Target of God Yi’ upon any Race player regardless of distance, plane, or dimension. This title is enforced to wear, enforced to display, without any effects, and is for display purposes only.
This title has been promoted and is the final effect.
“Title Restriction”: Activation requires 1 million Points.
“Conditions to Achieve”: Exterminate Ten Clans.
“Title Introduction”: “Can’t wildfires be utterly extinguished? No, that’s just the spring breeze being too gentle. Why don’t you try my fire?”
This title was originally Starry Level and now, after promotion, it has become Falling Star Level, introducing a new title system that seems to be above Starry Level but below Stellar Rank.
The effect of this title isn’t bad at all.
Forcibly bestowing a title upon a player of a Race.
One can imagine that if his reputation became significant enough in the future, if any Alien Race offended him, he wouldn’t even need to take action himself; he would just need to enforce the ‘Target of God Yi’ title upon all players of that Alien Race.
When these Alien Race players walked around in the outside world, and other players saw the title, they would instinctively keep their distance, fearing they’d get caught in the crossfire.
In this way, it would serve as quite an effective deterrent.
It’s like a diplomatic weapon.
In terms of inflicting damage, it is utterly useless.
Afterward, Chen Yi, who was standing at the edge of the cliff, scanned the quiet territory around him, contemplated briefly, then prepared to get up, clean up, and return to Blue Star; the incident was nearly wrapped up.
Several planets had been wiped out.
And incidentally, a few other planets had been exterminated as a result of the aftermath.
It was strange to say, but only those harboring hostility towards him were able to see the great scene of terror and trigger the Rule of Calm and Cool.
However, the condition for extermination was to reach 95%.
It was improbable that 95% of a Race’s players were hostile towards him; he didn’t even know those Races, nor had he done anything terribly outrageous. These unfamiliar Races seemed pretty united, too.
Moreover, it was more than 95% of players who not only bore him ill will, but were also present in the live streaming room. Quite the coincidence.
He could leave this mess behind; others would clean up the aftermath.
He could return to Blue Star and enjoy his vacation while also sorting through his gains from this event and perhaps obtaining more insider information and details about advancing in the game through the 33 Club.
…
ps: There will be another update in the early morning. My wife has prepared the meals and is urging me to eat, so I’ll grab something to eat first, then continue writing.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: 293: "Once... I had the chance to meet a player from a Ninefold planet.
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 293: “Once… I had the chance to meet a player from a Ninefold planet.
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully fulfilling the conditions of the wager agreement and returning to Blue Star safe and sound.”
“In this journey, congratulations to player Chen Yi for securing two Monuments and being recorded in the annals of significant events in the level-promotion game.”
“And for successfully acquiring the identity of a Seed Player in the level-promotion game.”
“Beginning the return…”
As the voice faded, Chen Yi found himself engulfed in darkness, and when his vision returned, he was back on the familiar rooftop, lounging on the familiar beach chair, on the familiar stretch of beach, surrounded by NPC bikini women laughing and chatting as if nothing had happened.
Everything was back to normal.
He hadn’t even had time to collect his thoughts.
The stinging pain on his body swiftly pulled him back to reality. He looked down to see his abdomen melting quickly, the sharp pain causing him to frown slightly. Without saying much, he lay down on the beach chair beside him.
He had resolved many issues.
But the one injury on his body that could never heal could not be fixed.
His body continued to melt away.
By now, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others hadn’t returned, still in hell. Yancheng, though not as lively as usual, wasn’t as quiet anymore.
The difficulty of returning from hell was not low.
Even for some players who had never died once, the difficulty of returning was only the lowest, but for regular civilian players, this difficulty was already quite high, especially since dying on the hell return map meant real death.
Some players with poor mentality or strength have still not chosen to return but started their new lives in hell.
Just as some players chose to start their new lives in the Dried Corpse map, many have chosen to start anew in hell as well.
After all, living anywhere is still living.
Living in hell is even somewhat safer.
With nothing better to do, he glanced at the 33 Club’s chat group. There were nearly a few hundred messages already; these people sure could chat a lot. In less than half an hour, they had discussed so much.
He skimmed through them.
The topic of discussion was him.
Apparently, the last global announcement for the Whole Starfield was three years and six months ago. Every time a global announcement appeared, it signified the start of a betting game. The chat group seemed quite interested in this betting game, with many bigshots appearing somewhat anxious as if the game posed a great risk.
He observed silently for a while.
Still somewhat unclear about what this betting game was exactly, he only knew that it appeared with each global announcement, and in the last betting game—
About 128 Races were eradicated.
It seemed like an extremely brutal war.
After observing for a while, Chen Yi finally spoke.
“Ding Qi Star, Chen Yi” “Seniors, do you know how long the level-promotion game has been in existence?”
“Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi” “Dad Yi, for this question, you’ll have to ask Elder Qian. His planet has reached Sixfold Planet status; he has the deepest roots in this group. He founded the 33 Club, which later gained recognition from the level-promotion game. The level-promotion game has witnessed countless version updates, and the one from a few years ago is completely different from today’s game.”
A Sixfold Planet?
A flicker of shock crossed Chen Yi’s eyes. Three levels higher than a Threefold? Such a character was in this group?
“Ping Daddy Starfield, Beiping” “Speaking of which, brother Chen Yi, do you know the differences between each Star level’s planets? Your planet is still a Zerofold Planet, right?”
“Ding Qi Star, Chen Yi” “Each time a planet levels up, it must pass a map trial involving all players of the Race, which tests the overall composite strength of a Race.”
“Ping Daddy Starfield, Beiping” “Yes, the Conditions to Achieve for the different Star levels of planets are exactly as you say—for the first three levels, just passing the corresponding map trials is enough. But you probably don’t know the benefits of leveling up. If there were no benefits to leveling up, why would a Race spend so much to level up? Whether it’s a Onefold or Twofold, isn’t it good enough if the Race’s own strength is strong?”
Chen Yi’s expression turned serious, and he responded with great respect, “I’d like to hear more.”
“Alright, first is the Onefold Planet, which you’ll face in a large map trial when your Newbie Protection Period is about to end. Passing this trial will promote you to a Onefold Planet.”
“Upon becoming a Onefold Planet, you can travel to the Star System. At this point, you’ll begin to interact with Race Players from other Races.”
“Blue Star is an exception. Normally, players under Newbie Protection should have no knowledge of the existence of the Star System and only start interacting with the outside world once they leave the Newbie Protection.”
“You will be able to trade freely with players from different Races, battle, or form alliances. The world stage will be a bit larger.”
“And you’ll have the chance to enter S-Class maps.”
“In the Newbie Protection Period, it’s impossible to see S-Class maps, which is something you can gain after leveling up to a Onefold Planet.”
“Ping Daddy Starfield, Beiping” “Then comes the Twofold Planet. Upon leveling up to a Twofold Planet, you will unlock the acquisition permissions for S-Class Props and S-Class Skills. It’s just an unlock, not a guarantee that you’ll obtain them.”
“For example, if you originally had a random Prop Chest, the level is random.”

chapters.title: Chapter 330: 293: "Once... I had the chance to meet a player from a Ninefold planet."_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 293: “Once… I had the chance to meet a player from a Ninefold planet.”_2
“So before reaching the Twofold Planet, you wouldn’t possibly randomly get this prop from the treasure chest, but after advancing to the Twofold Planet, you would have a chance to randomly get an S-rank prop from this chest,”
“Of course, the odds are rather small.”
“What’s really infuriating is, these level-less random treasure chests have an extremely low explosion rate, yet they’re priced exorbitantly.”
“This point can basically be ignored, the most important thing about advancing to the Twofold Planet is that the race will illuminate the ‘Star Map’ permission or feature. Once you have this thing, it means this race has officially set foot in the advancement game.”
“The ‘Star Map’ is a platform where you can see posts published by other race players, and you can also travel to other races’ territories at a certain cost through this platform, experiencing a lot more different things.”
“It’s also a massive trading platform where you can sell Skill Fragments you previously didn’t need, or some other props.”
“Some insignificant props in your possession may look utterly useless to you, but in the eyes of other race players, they could be extremely expensive. If you carefully search, you might find some great items, though the hope is slim.”
“There are quite a few professional institutions that specialize in this, the moment a prop that seems potentially very useful for some race players is listed, it is immediately bought up. Li Yi from that ‘I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield’ group in the chat makes his main business out of this and is the biggest among these agencies. He has made quite a lot of unscrupulous money, and he’s the one who made a billion Points during the Newbie Protection Period.”
“This man has a real talent for business. During the Newbie Protection Period, he enslaved all the players on his planet to work as black slaves for him to earn Points. What’s most significant is that those same-race players who were enslaved by him didn’t feel like slaves at all; instead, they were totally willing.”
“When this Monument came out, many people were shocked. Earning a billion Points during the Newbie Protection Period seemed entirely out of a fantasy tale.”
“Although he’s extremely self-absorbed, one has to admit he’s got quite a lot of capital for his narcissism.”
‘I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi’: “Hey, hey, hey, can you not slander me like this in front of the newbies? Have you forgotten who paid for all the costs last time we had a team building event?”
‘Ping Daddy Starfield, Beiping’: “… My mistake.”
“Alright, these are the things you get after advancing to the Twofold Planet. ‘Star Map’ is the most important among them. Advancing to the Twofold Planet means you’re officially in line with the advancement game.”
“And advancing to the Threefold Planet means you’ll leave the star system and arrive at the Starfield.”
“Props like the Race Duel Battle are only available to players of the Threefold Planet and above. Of course, these are just minor perks; for each planetary advancement, quite a few props and Skills are unlocked and given access to.”
“There’s not much to say about this.”
“The biggest change when advancing to the Threefold Planet is that the planet will merge into the Starfield, becoming its own territory, and the ‘Expedition Pioneering’ function will be unlocked. This function is actually a big map.”
“It can accommodate up to 100,000 people to enter at the same time, opening once a week, with fixed content for each map. Rewards will be issued based on which level these 100,000 players reach on the map.”
“The highest reward is a random S-rank prop.”
“The lowest reward is an A-rank prop.”
“There are a total of 18 levels, and after clearing all 18 levels, you would get a random S-rank prop. When ‘Expedition Pioneering’ is cleared, a new ‘Expedition Pioneering’ map will be rotated in the next week.”
“This map is also the main source for Threefold Planet players to obtain S-rank props.”
“Twofold Planet players also have a chance to obtain S-rank props, but that chance is too small. After all, the Twofold Planet has almost no chance to get S-rank props, whether it’s maps or anything else. That’s why S-rank props are basically on the Threefold Planet.”
‘Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi’: “I once encountered a Onefold Planet race called the Solar Clan that already had an S-rank prop while still on the Onefold Planet.”
‘Dad Qi Starfield, Wang Qi’: “That’s most likely obtained through backdoor methods. Onefold Planets don’t have the authority to obtain S-rank props; neither maps nor treasure chests can give out S-rank props. It’s only attainable through a workaround, which is normal. After all, where there are people, there are human relations. Rules are rigid, but people are alive and with a little effort, there are still quite a lot of ways.”
“Apart from unlocking the ‘Expedition Pioneering’ function, the Threefold Planet will also enable the ‘Territory’ feature. Just by spending Points, one can build cities or defensive structures within the scope of their Starfield territory.”
“That’s what you can get in touch with now.”
“The rest becomes more complicated.”
“The Fourfold Planet will unlock ‘Ranked Match’ and ‘Summit Match’, as well as the authority to obtain SS-rank props.”
“The Fivefold Planet will unlock ‘MUJI’, ‘Interstellar BOSS’, ‘Overlord’, and the authority to obtain SSS-rank props.”
“The Sixfold will unlock ‘Timeline’ and ‘Reincarnation’, ‘Great Brawl’, ‘Mystic Valley’, and the authority to obtain L-rank props.”
“`
“As for level seven, it’s unclear. There are no level seven players in Club 33. Only Elder Qian is at level six, the rest of us are at level four and five, with the highest probably being level nine.”
“Once, I had the fortune to see a player from a Ninefold Planet.”
“Above his head was a title that read ‘Ninefold Player’. He didn’t say a word to me, just gave me an indifferent glance. There was no malice in his eyes, nor disdain, as if he was looking at a weed by the side of the road.”
“That level is an existence we can no longer imagine.”
“…”
Chen Yi memorized all this information in his mind, thanked the others, chatted a little longer, and then lay silently on the beach chair without speaking.
Based on the experience shared by these seniors,
If he had enough Points right now,
then during the Newbie Protection Period, he should buy any props available for purchase, as many things can no longer be obtained after the Newbie Protection Period expires.
And the game keeps internally testing new features and modes.
For example, his Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle had been enchanted and enhanced before.
But upon his inquiry,
there were no Enchantment Stones or Enhancement Stones in the game, meaning these two items were only tested on a small scale within Blue Star. If he could gather enough of these during the Newbie Protection Period, then after advancing to the Twofold Planet, he could sell them at a high price on the “Star Map”!
These were nearly unique and rare props.
And as long as the restrictions were met, Enhancement Stones could not only enhance props from their own planet but also those from other planets.
The game developers loved to conduct internal testing on the planets during the Newbie Protection Period.
Testing during the Newbie Protection Period allows for quicker collection of relevant data, and the new players don’t fully understand the game itself yet, so they can quickly accept whatever new features are being tested.
He also asked whether the monthly update rule was a small-scale internal test on Blue Star.
But the answer he received was that this feature had been in place for a long time.
During the Novice Period, one’s own planet updates a rule every month.
Within a Star System, one’s own star system updates a rule every month.
In the Starfield, one’s own starfield updates a rule every month.
The rules updated are completely random.
“August 25th, 6:38 PM.”
Lying on the beach chair, Chen Yi turned his head to look at the calendar next to him. Today was already August 25th, and September was coming soon. It felt like a lot had happened in these past few days, but in reality, it had only been a day or two.
He had just asked Wang Qi what rules a new player like him, who reached the Starfield by some means, should follow: the rules of his own planet for the current month or the rules of the Starfield.
The answer Wang Qi gave was that it was random.
Yes, random.
Whichever set of rules he randomly had to follow, that set would apply.
During his time in the Starfield, he randomly continued to follow his own planet’s rules for August: “No Lying” and “No Backstabbing,” which is exactly why he had no clue what the rules of Ding Qi Starfield Continent for this month were, some nonsense about “Calm and Cool”.
If he had known earlier, who would bother with so much effort?
He would have just played horror movies in his livestream.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 331: 296: He, a Black Race player!
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 296: He, a Black Race player!
“`
Maybe it was because he hadn’t slept for a long time; he was excessively tired.
Lying on the beach chair, Chen Yi had somewhat forgotten the pain in his body as he dozed off, hazily falling into a dream, where he faintly sensed that he was in a dreamland.
In the dream.
He was adventuring with Tuberculosis Rabbit in a place that looked like a canyon, and it seemed like there were pursuers chasing after them from behind. Both he and Tuberculosis Rabbit looked desperate, fleeing at full speed.
But when he looked back, he saw no one behind him; there was absolutely nothing.
Yet Tuberculosis Rabbit kept urging him to run faster with an anxious expression.
He saw Tuberculosis Rabbit shouting something frantically, but there was no sound at all. He could only see Tuberculosis Rabbit’s mouth opening and closing rapidly. Just as he was about to alert Tuberculosis Rabbit that he couldn’t hear anything,
he saw Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face turn instantly pale, and then he froze on the spot, staring dead behind him.
Chen Yi was startled, and instinctively looked back, finally seeing the pursuers behind him.
There were two people.
One was Tuberculosis Rabbit, and the other was himself…
It was only then that the two figures behind them seemed to notice them, their faces revealing a look of shock and disbelief before suddenly laughing sinisterly and rushing towards them.
With his back instantly soaked, Chen Yi was about to do something when he suddenly heard someone shouting in his ear.
“Yi, Yi!”
Then the scene before his eyes began to blur, and when he returned to reality, he was back on that familiar rooftop.
Somehow, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others had also returned to the rooftop.
The sky had already darkened.
The moon had risen into the sky.
“Yi.”
Standing beside the beach chair, Tuberculosis Rabbit said to Chen Yi with a look of helplessness, “We weren’t going to wake you, Yi, since you’ve been truly exhausted these past few days. You finally fell asleep, so we didn’t want to disturb you. But Yi, you’ve been sleeping here for nearly four hours.”
“It’s gotten dark.”
“We can’t just sleep on the rooftop all night. Aside from the risk of catching a cold when the sun comes up, it’s also not comfortable.”
“Let’s go back inside. Go to sleep, Yi.”
“Am I back?”
Chen Yi lay on the beach chair, glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit, and only then did he come back to his senses from the dream, rubbing his temples with a flash of confusion in his eyes, unclear why he would have such a strange dream.
That image seemed so vivid.
It didn’t quite seem like a dream at all.
He could distinctly feel that this scene was being quickly erased from his mind, and it probably wouldn’t be long before he completely forgot about this dream.
This was also quite normal.
It seemed that everyone quickly forgot their dreams upon waking up, as if there was some sort of automatic deletion function.
Still somewhat dazed, Chen Yi lay on the beach chair and after a long silence finally spoke, “As long as everyone’s back, that’s good. You’ve all worked hard these last few days. Let’s go to sleep, we can talk more tomorrow.”
“Alright then.”
Soon.
The group didn’t talk much more and all returned to their own rooms in the Crimson Palace to enter dreamland; they were indeed exhausted.
Exhausted to the point where they just wanted to sleep soundly for several days.
But they were sleeping.
The other players couldn’t sleep at all.
…
Inside Yancheng.
As one of the few players who had returned from hell, Li Yide was staring blankly at the air in front of him, the live stream had been closed for a long time, but ever since it was shut down, he had been maintaining this pose without any change.
When Chen Yi went to seek revenge on Ding Qi Star for Blue Star!
He was excited.
And filled with the hopeful expectation for Yi to return triumphantly, although he knew that the likelihood was slim. But at the very least, a sense of vindication was desired—to regain some face for Blue Star.
When Chen Yi annihilated Terra Star.
He was thrilled.
Yi had truly done it.
He showed those Alien Race players what the price of provoking Blue Star would be!
But when Chen Yi killed 50 billion players on Ding Qi Star, he was bewildered.
50 billion?
Wasn’t this going off-script?
Normally, when they killed monsters in the game, they counted in units of tens or hundreds. How had it come to billions when it came to Chen Yi?
This was 50 billion!
How many billions of players were there in Ding Qi Star in total? And in just a few seconds, he killed 50 billion of them?
Was he slaughtering pigs?
When you’ve killed one person, people see you as a villain.
When you’ve killed a hundred people, they see you as a demon.
When you’ve killed a hundred thousand people, they see you as a hero.
But when you’ve killed fifty billion people, people start to become perplexed, what exactly are you doing?
He had been holding this baffled pose for a long time, and he didn’t even feel the thrill of Chen Yi avenging Blue Star. He just felt a bit perplexed—it seemed like those 50 billion Alien Race players died a bit too frivolously.
…
“Li Peiqi.”
Liu Xiaochan looked at the entire star system’s announcement, her face completely void of color as she murmured like the buzzing of flies, “I finally understand why you were so afraid of Chen Yi. With someone like this, it’s normal to be afraid of him.”
“Not being afraid is actually the problem.”
“To kill 50 billion Alien Race players at once, killing one a day would take 50 billion days—which is beyond comprehension. The history of our Neutron Star’s race doesn’t even span that length of time if we multiply it by ten or more.”
“But Li Peiqi, you don’t need to worry about provoking Chen Yi anymore. I now seriously doubt if your A-level Last Words prop, which states that you died at the hands of Chen Yi, is because you provoked him, or because Chen Yi felt you were a threat and wanted to eliminate you.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 332: 296: He, a Black Race player! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 296: He, a Black Race player! _2
“The most likely reason is that he had nothing better to do than slaughter all the races in the Number 3 Star System, and incidentally, you got killed too.”
“This guy just doesn’t seem normal.”
“You can’t call this a bloodlust anymore, can you?”
“This is not being able to keep still without killing someone.”
“…”
Li Peiqi’s face looked unsightly as she watched the live broadcast without speaking; Chen Yi’s strength seemed to have become stronger, but actually, there wasn’t much difference from during the Race Duel Battle.
And the reason for the difference between the two was like heaven and earth.
It was entirely because during the Race Duel Battle, Chen Yi dared not die.
Whereas in the Ding Qi Starfield, Chen Yi could fight without any worries, battling until the very last moment of his life, then return from hell to deliver an even more tragic blow to his enemies.
In other words, if one wanted to deal with Chen Yi…
One must ensure that all the other Blue Star players were wiped out, with Chen Yi remaining as the only official Blue Star player. That was the only way to effectively suppress Chen Yi’s strength. As long as Chen Yi didn’t recklessly trade one life for hundreds, his level of danger would be significantly lower.
Or to put it another way, completely kill that woman by Chen Yi’s side.
During the few battles shown on screen, it was clear that most of Chen Yi’s strength came from the woman by his side, or rather from the horrific power he gained after killing the woman by his side.
It must be a Prop or Skill that allowed one to gain power through the sacrifice of a loved one.
The precondition for its use is to kill one’s own loved one.
…
As for the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star, it had fallen into extreme silence.
Most players did not choose to come back from hell immediately, but instead opened the “Star Map” forum to look at the overwhelming number of posts online.
At this point in time, no matter which theme in the forum you look at…
For instance, boards like “Prop Trading,” “Map Strategies,” “Combo Techniques,” “Skill Combinations,” and so on, the topic of discussion was only one!
That is…
the new player Chen Yi going to the Starfield and exterminating 50 billion players in a single day.
An extreme abstraction.
They were just watching a live broadcast, and as they did, the Chen Yi in the broadcast suddenly turned into an extremely horrifying figure, scaring them out of the blue as the rule “Calm and Cool” activated on the spot.
And they were chilled to the bone on the spot.
They were speechless. Who could have known that Chen Yi would suddenly morph into such a terrifying vision?
Or who could have imagined that Chen Yi’s Skills could affect them through the broadcast?
This kind of gaze-based Skill typically has a range limitation.
Like all who look at him within his line of sight catching a cold.
Or perhaps a range of a hundred meters, a thousand meters.
Where is there one like Chen Yi’s, completely ignoring distance, launching a nondiscriminatory area of effect (AOE) attack?
Although they died to the August rule “Calm and Cool,” it seemed that since Chen Yi directly caused this, the number of player deaths was also recorded on Chen Yi’s head.
They had to admit, at that time they did harbor a bit of hostility towards Chen Yi.
But it wasn’t very strong hostility.
It was merely annoyance at seeing Chen Yi stealing the spotlight all the time in the broadcast, thinking he was too arrogant. How could they have known that they’d be caught up in it?
Hell was nearly overflowing.
…
Meanwhile,
in the city of the Unicorn Tribe, located at the center of a swamp on the Starfield Continent of Ding Qi Star, a player of the Black Race stood dumbfounded in the silent city center amidst the scattered flesh and thick blood splatters!
He, a player of the Black Race!
A nomad, making a living by clearing levels and selling young Black Race members, a Black Race player!
Not long ago, he had arrived in this city of the Unicorn Tribe to peddle his wares on the move. As Chen Yi cleansed the Starfield Continent, he excitedly pulled up his trousers and bought ten freshly baked, crispy, and aromatic giant chicken legs in the street.
He planned to chew on the delicious legs while enjoying this quality melon.
Such a drama was usually not something you’d get to enjoy often.
He did not speak in the broadcast; he was just a silent observer. With such a large broadcast, the cost of a single comment in the live chat was beyond what he could afford; his points were not so plentiful that he could squander them.
When he saw Chen Yi wipe out Terra Star, he couldn’t help but roar in support of Chen Yi, and then he looked forward even more eagerly to the scenes to follow in the broadcast.
Following that…
Following that…
Next, he saw the most terrifying scene of his life as the Unicorn Tribe players beside him suddenly exploded like fireworks!
All Unicorn Tribe players in the city streets and buildings burst open!
The entire scene looked as if it were half covered by giant fireworks, appearing incredibly spectacular.
He didn’t even have time to react.
News that the “Unicorn Tribe” had been wiped out immediately reached his ears.
“Ah ha?”
While still gnawing on a chicken leg, he was first dumbfounded, then reluctantly accepted the reality, standing on a deserted street with bodies everywhere, feeling utterly confused inside.
Later, he learned from the Star Map forum.
Chen Yi had activated a skill whose effect was that any player who looked at him with hostility in their heart would see a terrifying image.
At that time.
In his eyes, Chen Yi didn’t seem much different; he just saw an extra pair of eerie wings, that is until the news of the Unicorn Tribe’s extinction spread.
Then he understood why.
What a coincidence.
The “Unicorn Tribe” just happened to have over 95% of their players watching the live stream at the time, and just so happened, these players all harbored hostility towards Chen Yi.
The reason was simple.
Unicorn Tribe players despised all players who did not have a horn on their forehead.
From this perspective, the Unicorn Tribe players were quite united indeed.
So—
Things developed to this point.
After standing silently on the spot for a while, the Black Race player suddenly knelt down on the ground full of flesh and rubble, looking up earnestly into the distance, he said, “Yi is good.”
“Although we have never met, today I, Dark Old Ghost, have indeed received your favor. If there is anything in the future that requires Dark Old Ghost, just say the word, and I shall be there no matter the distance.”
After the incident last night.
He breathed a sigh of relief, his eyes revealing excitement as he fumbled to stuff all the Points that had fallen all around the city streets into his embrace!
The Exclusive Clan had been wiped out.
All of this stuff here is his
Items left by an entire Race for him, it wasn’t an exaggeration to say that these things could make him instantly rich, as long as he could take them out.
This news would spread fast, and who knows how many would come to scavenge for loot.
He definitely couldn’t eat all of the Unicorn Tribe’s “meat.”
He didn’t have the power, nor the time.
But he could manage to take his fill of this city’s “meat” if he tried hard enough.
Speaking of which, he couldn’t help but feel grateful to his own Race. Fortunately, he hadn’t shown too much malice towards Chen Yi; otherwise, he wouldn’t have survived and would have been dragged down with the extinction.
Mainly because his own Race tended to do as they pleased, not even bothering to manage their own children, let alone care about others.
Probably not many of them had entered the live stream, except for him, who enjoyed watching the fun unfold.
And it was a Black Race player that did so.
If it had been another Race’s player, even if they weren’t killed in the live stream for feeling hostility toward Chen Yi, the sight of the fireworks exploding densely around them would have invoked fear and prompted them to recite, “The Rule of August, Calm and Cool.”
It was only the Black Race players, with their thicker skins, who didn’t immediately react to such an event, and by the time they did, they were generally able to control their emotions and thoughts.
…
After a good night’s sleep, a refreshed Chen Yi.
Stretched lazily on the beach chair placed inside his house, he carelessly picked up some toiletries from the bedside and began to brush his teeth while looking at his Stellar Rank title, “Seems Like A Demon.”
He acquired this title when he obtained the second Monument upgrade in the game.
At that time, the prompt was that all content would unlock after half an hour.
By now, half an hour had naturally passed.
The content had been unlocked.
After reading the contents of the title, Chen Yi spat out the mouthwash somewhat inconveniently; perhaps this title could help him heal his injuries, otherwise, maintaining this condition would truly be inconvenient.
He could only sleep on the beach chair at night.
Lying down occasionally was fine, but spending the whole day on it would really wreck his body.
…
ps: I’ve been suddenly too busy recently, and updates have become less frequent. I promise to make up for it later, please excuse me.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: 295: Being killed dozens of times during the menstrual period, this is also a sin.
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 295: Being killed dozens of times during the menstrual period, this is also a sin.
“Title Name”: Seems Like A Demon.
“Title Level”: Stellar Rank.
“Title Effect”: When you activate this title, the whole world automatically plays a BGM exclusive to you based on your mood for all players, causing the world to change with your emotions, and you absolutely cannot be killed by continuous damage such as bleeding, tearing, etc.
“Title Restriction”: After activating this title, 10,000 Points will be deducted every hour.
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first player to kill more than 50 billion Alien Race players in a single day.
“Title Introduction”: “Enter the demon, become the Buddha, and turn into the demon Buddha.”
“…”
Chen Yi raised his eyebrows slightly as he looked at the title effect before him, thinking silently without speaking.
This was a Stellar Rank title.
On the same level as “Like a Demon”.
Far superior to Starry Level.
The first effect was practically useless, letting the whole world automatically play a BGM exclusive to him based on his mood for all players—it was unclear what this world specifically referred to.
For instance, if he was in the Star System 3, did the definition of the world refer to Blue Star or the entire Star System 3?
It seemed more like a major public disturbance Skill.
However, the second effect finally appeared worthy of the “Stellar” level.
Not dying from continuous damage, absolutely.
It was another Absolute Attribute.
So far, he only had one prop with an Absolute Attribute, which was this beach chair, and this “Seems Like A Demon” title would be the second thing he owned with an Absolute Attribute.
As everyone knows.
Any prop with an Absolute Attribute, regardless of its own level, was difficult to assess in strength.
Moreover, generally speaking, props with Absolute Attributes wouldn’t be of a low level either.
Looking at this title effect before him, Chen Yi felt hesitant and did not speak. The title didn’t clarify the specific rule hierarchy, and he wasn’t sure if this title could be immune to the effects of that unhealable wound.
An unhealable wound, and an absolute immunity to death from continuous damage.
Comparing the two.
Like the strongest spear meeting the strongest shield.
Which was stronger and which was weaker, it was truly unknown.
But he couldn’t always lie on this beach chair, so he had to get up and try the effect.
After hesitating for a moment, Chen Yi slowly got up from the beach chair. The moment he stood up, the flesh and blood on his body began to melt rapidly, making him appear as though he was a severely burned patient.
The intense pain made him frown slightly.
Without the Wife-Killing Buff, he had no means to combat this unhealable wound that was continuously worsening.
If it were any other time, he would have lain on the beach chair immediately, but this time he chose not to do so.
Instead, he stood still and activated the “Seems Like A Demon” title.
He decided to test out how effective this title was, at worst he’d just make a trip to hell.
Very soon.
In less than a minute’s time.
Chen Yi watched helplessly as his legs melted into a puddle of blood on the ground; his bones, meridians, and flesh all dissolved into a clear, untainted pool of blood—melting thoroughly indeed.
Chen Yi, without the support of his legs, fell powerlessly onto the floor.
Following that.
His chest began to melt.
His arms began to melt.
His neck began to melt.
His head began to melt.
Chen Yi, with only his eyeballs remaining, lay in a pool of blood, sighing helplessly in his heart. What sin had he committed? He could only sigh internally, as his mouth had already melted away.
To be precise, only his eyeballs had not yet melted away from his entire body.
He couldn’t even control the direction of his gaze.
He was forced to look up at the ceiling.
Furthermore, he felt that his last remaining eyes were melting too. It seemed that the “Seems Like A Demon” title’s effect of being absolutely invulnerable to death from continuous damage could not defeat the Logi Tribe’s unhealable wound effect.
Well then, he’d have to think of another way.
The next second—
His eyes also melted away, and the room was completely devoid of anything but a puddle of blood on the floor, a testament to something that might have happened there.
Chen Yi, who had been ready to report to hell, suddenly felt that his vision became much broader.
He didn’t end up in hell.
Rather…
Chen Yi, somewhat astonished, looked down at his body. There was nothing there; he couldn’t see his own body at all, but it seemed he hadn’t died. His eyes could see things, and his ears could hear things.
He tentatively looked towards a full-length mirror inside the room.
There was nothing in the room.
Had he become invisible?! No, it didn’t seem like invisibility. Rather, his body had completely melted away, but due to the “Seems Like A Demon” title effect being active, he absolutely couldn’t die from continuous damage, so was he now in a spirit state? Or perhaps a state of consciousness?
Was this supposed to be considered a state of invisibility?
This wasn’t invisibility at all!
It was a freaking out-of-body experience!
If that was the case.
Then could some props and Skills that could see through invisibility still see him?
No matter how high the rule hierarchy, it shouldn’t be possible to see him, right? After all, he wasn’t just invisible, he was in a spirit out-of-body state. It felt as if he had inadvertently discovered something incredible.
Seeing that he seemed unable to die for the time being, Chen Yi became interested.
His consciousness controlled his movement through the wall.
He did it with ease.
Having moved through the wall onto the rooftop, Chen Yi hovered in mid-air, looking down at the scenery below with a sense of astonishment. In his spirit body state, he could effortlessly pass through all obstacles.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: 295: Being killed more than a dozen times during the menstrual period, this is also a sin. _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 295: Being killed more than a dozen times during the menstrual period, this is also a sin. _2
What if I try activating the “Buddha’s Fury” prop?
The next second—
A seated Buddha on a Lotus Platform, holding a Fire God Gatling, looked down upon the entire city with a cool expression!
It actually worked; I can activate props while in the Spirit Body State!
There were no effects whatsoever!
Next I needed to test if I could be harmed in this Spirit Body State.
With just a thought, Chen Yi watched the seated Buddha on the Lotus Platform nearby, wielding the Fire God Gatling, suddenly turn the Gatling to aim in Chen Yi’s direction. Accompanied by the swiftly rotating barrel, bullets cascaded towards Chen Yi like a galaxy plummeting to earth.
The dense bullet storm instantly engulfed Chen Yi.
“Absolutely… no effect.”
The shock within Chen Yi’s heart intensified; the attack did not cause him even a hint of pain; he didn’t even feel the assault at all. Those countless bullets seemed to pass right through where he was as if there were no obstruction at all!
Which meant that in this state, he simply did not take any damage?
What about speed?
He experimented again with enthusiasm and quickly concluded that in this state—which let’s tentatively call Spirit Body State—his speed was incredibly fast, far surpassing that of a sled.
Basically, wherever his gaze directed, his consciousness could swiftly appear in that place.
It was almost like teleportation.
But he quickly discovered a drawback.
That was, he couldn’t grasp anything. He couldn’t smoke, couldn’t pick up a pebble, and could only activate props within his backpack; he essentially couldn’t hold props in his hands.
But even so, this state was already unbeatable enough!
You see, his exterior image had always been one of possessing extremely terrifying and deterrent power in his attacks. The downside was apparent too—the weakness in his own defense. If activated, he could still be killed.
But now, that had entirely changed!
As long as he was in the Spirit Body State, he was absolutely invincible!
Attacks simply couldn’t affect him!
Through gradual experimentation, he also roughly understood that soul out-of-body wasn’t quite fitting for describing this state. It was more accurate to say that his body, under the influence of the wound that couldn’t heal, had merged thoroughly.
Yet, under the Title Effect of “Seems Like A Demon,” he forcefully remained alive!
While being alive, it wasn’t specified in what state he needed to be alive.
Thus, he became an existence that lay at the intersection between two and three dimensions.
Three-dimensional attacks could no longer affect him.
The reason was simple.
His three-dimensional body had completely dissolved. Where would a three-dimensional attack land? While others were still pursuing S-ranked props and Absolute Attribute props, how could they compete with him being immune to three-dimensional attacks?
Chen Yi couldn’t help but smirk as he scanned his surroundings; not feeling the presence of his mouth made the smile a bit strange, but the experience was certainly unique.
Maintaining this state costs 10,000 Points per hour.
But it didn’t matter.
He could definitely afford it; he wasn’t short on Points at all.
Besides, there was the Hundred Generations Bounty left by the Terra Tribe before their near extinction. As soon as he left the Newbie Protection Period, that bounty would be credited to his account in an instant—nearly one billion Points, enough for him to spend a very long time, just maintaining this Title alone for several years wouldn’t be a problem.
It was then—
He noticed something.
There had been music playing in his ears all this time, the unmistakable effect of his “Seems Like A Demon” title activation, with a conspicuously steady beat.
In his personal panel, there was also an unread system notification.
“Ding, player Chen Yi of your world has activated the ‘Seems Like A Demon’ title. Your current exclusive BGM ‘Knowing You Don’t Love Me’ will now be played for all players worldwide based on Chen Yi’s mood.”
“Knowing You Don’t Love Me?”
What does this song have to do with his mood right now?
Seems like a DJ version, quite lively indeed.
If forced to make a correlation, it wouldn’t be a problem, as his mood was indeed quite good at the moment. Soon the song finished playing and automatically switched to the next one, “Forgiveness.”
This song sounded a bit emo, and he wasn’t sure how it related to his current mood.
While he was a bit puzzled—
A dialog box popped up in front of him.
“Ding, do you think this song matches your current mood?”
“A: Completely compatible.”
“B: Partially compatible.”
“C: Barely compatible.”
“D: Not compatible at all.”
“Fine.”
Chen Yi shook his head, somewhat speechless. Were they saying that the algorithm destined to play music based on the player’s mood wasn’t ready yet? Did it still need players to provide data for testing?
After all, it was a “Stellar Rank” Title. Could they not hand out a half-finished product?
“D, not compatible at all!”
The volume of the music wasn’t very loud, but it wasn’t exactly quiet either. It rang in the ears of players all around the globe, the kind that wouldn’t disrupt your daily life. But if you wanted to watch TV or play a game to hear footsteps,
That would basically be out of the question.
If you were a light sleeper startled by any little noise, after enduring this for a month, you’d either cure yourself of this condition or die suddenly from sleep deprivation. Essentially, there were no other options.
Want to switch it off?
No dice. Once the Title Effect was activated, it was compulsory.
Not listening wasn’t an option.
Want to adjust the volume?
That wasn’t possible either. Whether you wanted to increase or decrease the volume, you had no permission to do so. As for skipping songs, that was even more out of the question. In terms of being compulsory, this Title Effect truly lived up to its “Stellar” ranking.
Even the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team couldn’t turn off the music if they wanted to; they also had to listen under compulsion.
Chen Yi didn’t pay attention to the random songs playing by his ear; instead, on a whim, he floated into Jiaye’s room. For safety’s sake, he had fitted Jiaye’s room with plenty of defensive props.
But as he barged in, not a single prop was activated.
