chapters.title: Chapter 370: 313: He wiped out Li Yi's Awesome Starfield today!
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 313: He wiped out Li Yi’s Awesome Starfield today!
The next second—
The countdown officially hit zero!
The entire white space began to slowly flicker, and at the same time, a muffled sound came from beside my ear, sounding like a sound engineer had edited a noisy fart and was playing it through a sound card.
Muffled yet not so muffled, carrying a crisp sense of lightness.
A cheerful melody gradually rose to my ear.
At the same time.
...
A wall slowly opened from the middle, retracting to both sides, revealing a corridor lined with flowers, obviously intended for me to walk through.
Chen Yi slightly raised an eyebrow and straightened his clothes, taking a deep breath after confirming that everything was in order, and then slowly stepped onto the floral corridor with his cane.
There was actually something quite important.
He remembered that when he entered the map, he activated the Stellar Rank title: Seems Like A Demon, a title that ensured he would never die from sustained damage, so that the absolutely incurable injury on his body couldn’t kill him.
Every minute, 10,000 Points would be deducted.
This would put him into Spirit Body State.
A state where he could not be attacked, nor even detected.
He had entered the “Rogue Star” map in Spirit Body State, but for some reason, when he came out of the map, his Spirit Body State was lifted, and there were no notifications of any charges, nor was there any setting that his injuries had been cured.
It looked as if everything had been paused.
Everything would return to normal after the premiere of the map was officially over.
Chen Yi didn’t have time to think for too long before he reached the end of the corridor, where a multitude of lights appeared before him, like the center of a stage, with a host standing beside it, smiling brightly.
Below the stage.
A large audience was gathered.
It looked like the live broadcast of a variety show, the kind that’s a talk show.
Seeing this, Chen Yi frowned slightly but did not speak.
And just then—
The host came up to him with a smile, looked at Chen Yi, and said, “Congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully clearing his debut map and achieving a perfect rating; this is a supreme honor that ordinary players can only dream of.”
“The entire process of the map was broadcast live with countless billions of players watching.”
“Moreover, nearly a hundred billion players watched the broadcast from beginning to end within thirty days. What do you think about this, Mr. Chen?”
“None.”
Chen Yi shook his head expressionlessly. Wasn’t this supposed to be the ceremony for receiving an award? So it’s just an interview segment?
He was quite busy, in fact.
The Feng Family was waiting for him.
And it’s important not to keep people waiting.
“Alright, it seems that our Mr. Chen is already completely accustomed to such things, which is normal. According to the information card I have, our Mr. Chen Yi has been a miracle creator since his debut.”
“Perhaps many players are not aware that Mr. Chen Yi is currently just a newbie player, and his planet has not even passed the Newbie Protection Period.”
“But even so, he has already won such high honors.”
“One can imagine, once the planet where Mr. Chen Yi is located passes the Newbie Protection Period, just how much his power will skyrocket. Let’s wait and see.”
“Now then…”
The host beside me spoke excitedly, going on and on about something.
At this moment, Chen Yi pursed his lips somewhat uninterestedly. It seems like it’s just like debuting as a star; he felt nothing about it. Any star will have their day of downfall, no exceptions.
He glanced at a player in the audience with a chicken head.
And pursed his lips again.
If even a chicken that just clucks around and occasionally lays eggs could fall, what couldn’t?
About twenty minutes later.
The host finally finished speaking, licked his lips with satisfaction, and then spread his arms wide and exclaimed, “Now, let’s proceed to the segment we’ve all been looking forward to—the fan question segment.”
He then turned to whisper to Chen Yi.
“Mr. Chen, the players sitting here have all watched your entire live broadcast. They are the most attentive to you.”
“There is always this segment for every player who clears their debut map.”
“The main purpose is to build your fame across the Whole Starfield as much as possible.”
“This will be very helpful for Mr. Chen in his future endeavors.”
“Next, there will be fans asking questions. You can choose five players’ questions to answer. After this segment, a small gift bag will be presented to you, and our segment will officially come to an end.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yi nodded, without any objections. This was his first experience with such a situation, and he was unfamiliar with the procedure. Since it was part of the process, he would go through it.
Then he looked at the audience members raising their hands.
He randomly fixed his gaze on one player: “You.”
“Excellent, the first lucky audience member is player number 7828. Please stand up and ask your question, and you may only ask one.”
In the audience, the player stood up with a somewhat nervous look and turned to Chen Yi on the stage.
“Hello, Mr. Chen Yi, I’ve encountered quite a few powerful individuals, most of whom share a common trait: either they’re very ugly, or they’ve suffered terribly when they were young, or they’ve been bullied from childhood.”
“As far as I know, it’s precisely because they have suffered so much in the first half of their lives that they were able to work hard in the maps after the game’s emergence and become frontline players surpassing their peers.”

chapters.title: Chapter 371: 313: He destroyed Li Yi's Awesome Starfield today!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 313: He destroyed Li Yi’s Awesome Starfield today!_2
“Even though Mr. Chen Yi, your appearance isn’t the least bit ugly—on the contrary, it’s quite handsome—then may I ask if you, Mr. Chen Yi, faced any hardships when you were little?”
“No.”
Chen Yi shook his head calmly, “I’m just lucky.”
“Next question.”
From the audience, another randomly selected player stood up, “You have been advocating for the idea of peace on this map and achieved a perfect evaluation through this method, but to my knowledge, before you entered this map, you had already annihilated the Ten Clans.”
“And it was for this reason that you were awarded two commemorative milestones for leveling up in the game.”
...
“This clearly contradicts the philosophy you advocated on this map.”
“I’m curious about which one truly reflects your ideology? Or is the so-called advocacy for peace just an excuse you came up with to clear the map after your personal power was restricted?”
This question was sharp.
When this question echoed in the live streaming room, many gamers became serious, waiting for Chen Yi’s answer, including Shang Ruxue, the chieftain of the Mao Rabbit Clan, who also stared at Chen Yi’s face, awaiting his response.
She, too, wanted to know the answer to this question.
If Chen Yi had any difficulties annihilating the Ten Clans, then he might not be the hypocritical villain who altered his principles just to clear the map.
…
“Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
Sword Without End, lying on the rooftop rocking chair, looked at Chen Yi on the screen and, equally puzzled, glanced at the Tuberculosis Rabbit beside him, “Do you know the answer to this question? I originally thought that Yi’s talk of peace was just something he said to get through the map.”
“But during the livestream, seeing Yi’s serious expression and occasionally the look in his pupils, it doesn’t seem fake.”
“This…”
Forget the viewers in the livestream.
Even someone like him, who had known Yi for a long time, was somewhat uncertain about this question.
Tuberculosis Rabbit lay on the rooftop lounger, dressed in big boxer shorts, hugging a chilled coconut water, and said carelessly, “Well, Yi does actually prefer peace.”
“No, to be precise, Yi just likes to lie down.”
“The kind of doing nothing, just lying there quietly without anything disturbing him.”
“In Yi’s eyes, peace and slaughter are the same thing.”
“The world is at peace; nobody disturbs him anymore.”
“After everyone’s been slaughtered, it’s quiet too.”
“Which approach he chooses depends on which is more convenient, more efficient.”
At this moment, most players on Blue Star were either lying or sitting somewhere, watching Chen Yi’s livestream; after all, this was a grand livestream by the strongest player on their planet to all Starfield players.
Blue Star players placed the highest importance on it.
Without exception.
“But Yi has been in this map a bit too long this time,” Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed, scratching his itchy scalp, “Before Yi went in, the September rules hadn’t arrived yet. Now, they’re almost over, and he missed a lot of limited-time festival events.”
“It’s a real waste.”
Sword Without End shook his head, disagreeing, “Yi is now rampaging through Starfield, who needs the rewards from the Newbie Protection Period?”
“That’s not necessarily true.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit drank the last of his coconut water in one gulp and casually tossed the empty shell into the nearby trash can, “Haven’t you heard what Yi once said? Some props you can get during the Newbie Protection Period can’t be obtained in Starfield.”
“For example, that ‘peace charm’ prop that ensures the safe growth of infants is only available during the Newbie Protection Period and is invaluable outside. Yi deliberately told us to purchase any limited-time props that come up this month, leaving us plenty of Points for that very reason.”
Whereas Jiaye was just sitting on the bed in her room, leaning against the headboard looking at the livestream on the screen in front of her, with a slight hint of regret in her eyes.
She had been feeling a bit sad these past few days.
Inside the map, when Chen Yi faced that woman’s confession, she almost couldn’t hold back from crying out; he absolutely mustn’t agree—that’s just an NPC!
She wasn’t afraid of Chen Yi betraying her.
She could accept Chen Yi having a second woman.
After all.
If there were a second woman, Chen Yi wouldn’t have to target only her to activate the Wife-Killing Buff in the future, and she could get some peace—being stabbed over and over was truly painful.
Other women get pierced every day for love since they have to have children, but who gets stabbed daily with a damn knife?
It’s really painful, alright!
What’s the use of accepting love from an NPC? You can’t activate the Wife-Killing Buff by running into the map to kill the NPC.
But if it’s receiving love from another player, then that’s much better. In the future, you can just target that player to activate the Wife-Killing Buff, and she, the long-standing legitimate wife, can be the backup energy reserve—it’s not too much to ask, right?
…
“Have you talked to Jiaye these past two days?” Sword Without End glanced around and, seeing that Tie Chui and Jiaye were not present, turned to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“No.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head casually, “Without Yi here, it’s better not to have too much private contact with Jiaye; let’s wait for Yi to come back before discussing anything. Even though I’m close to Yi, there’s still a line that shouldn’t be crossed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 372: 313: He Wiped Out Li Yi's Awesome Starfield Today!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Chapter 313: He Wiped Out Li Yi’s Awesome Starfield Today!_3
“And as far as I know, your plan is not very realistic, Yi. It’s quite unlikely for him to take a liking to a girl, Jiaye is already an exception, and adding another one is basically out of the question.”
“So what do we do?”
Sword Without End frowned and pondered silently. They were faced with an extremely unpleasant reality: Jiaye had died and revived in the game so many times that he had started being matched with players from the Threefold Planet.
Absurd!
A newcomer player’s hell revival map was now matchmaking with players from the Threefold Planet. How many times had he died?
Guiding Jiaye through this revival was becoming exceedingly difficult.
...
If he died a few more times, there would be nothing more I could do.
Moreover, because I always had to take Jiaye with me, my own hell revival map difficulty was also shooting up.
To put it simply.
If Jiaye died a few more times, he would no longer be able to die. Then, only Chen Yi would personally have to delve into hell to retrieve him.
It would be a huge hassle.
It would delay many important matters, like when Chen Yi needs to activate the Wife-Killing Buff before entering a map, and if he can’t exit within an hour, Chen Yi without the Wife-Killing Buff would have a hard time leading Jiaye out of hell.
The best solution would naturally be to find Chen Yi another girlfriend.
Start all over again.
Much simpler.
But Jiaye’s mindset still had to be worked on, considering that the system on Blue Star has always been monogamous.
“Forget it.”
After thinking for a while, Sword Without End sighed helplessly and shook his head, “Let’s not ponder over this for now. We’ll discuss it when Yi returns. No idea when he’ll be back.”
“You do miss him quite a bit.”
“Indeed.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement.
Since he had started following Yi, they had never been apart for this long.
…
On Chen Yi’s side, however, he looked calmly at the player who had asked the question and after a pause, he softly said, “Personally, I aspire towards world peace, regardless of the method, the ultimate goal is always world peace.”
“In our culture, there is a term called ‘Tathagata’.”
“Has the Tathagata come? Tathagata.”
“Did he really come? Tathagata.”
“There’s a saying: All conditioned phenomena are like a dream, an illusion, a bubble, and a shadow, like dew and like lightning, and should be viewed as such.”
“You could broadly understand this statement as, many things in the universe share the same essence; it’s just that our perspectives differ, leading to deviations.”
“Like whether it’s the way I handle my maps, or the means I employed to secure the game Monument for level promotion.”
“The outcomes are the same.”
“The essences are the same; it’s just that your perspectives are different.”
“The world has calmed down into peace.”
“Next.”
“…”
Soon, the series of questions was finished, and this segment officially ended.
After the acceleration of this segment,
The curtain also fell.
The surrounding audience wasn’t physically present at the venue but had projected themselves there by spending Points. As the event ended, these player projections gradually dissipated.
The live stream began to shut down.
In the last ten seconds before closing,
A shower of golden rain fell from the center of the stage.
Standing in the center of the stage, leaning on a cane with one hand, Chen Yi became the final frame in the live streaming room.
And at that moment—
“Hey.”
A somewhat portly man came scurrying up from behind the stage, walked over to Chen Yi, waved, and greeted, “Hi there Yi, I, Li Yi, welcome you to the Awesome Starfield.”
“Awesome Starfield?”
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully, “Is this your Starfield? Isn’t your Starfield’s full name ‘I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield’?”
“Ahem.”
Li Yi touched his nose with a slightly embarrassed expression, “I was a bit too exuberant when I was naming it, didn’t pay attention to these things. Now I can’t change it even if I want to, so I just shorten it to Awesome Starfield. It’s still a bit vulgar, but at least not as wild.”
“Various members of the 33 Club chat group are here, and everyone has prepared a celebration banquet for you.”
“Let’s go, it’s not every day we get a new member, especially not a player of such strength. Tonight, we must drink to our heart’s content.”
“I gotta say, kid, you’re genuinely handsome.”
“You look pretty dashing yourself, Senior.”
Chen Yi looked at the roughly four-hundred-pound, reddish-skinned fat man in front of him and gave a polite, albeit not entirely sincere, compliment. As a junior, it was important to maintain proper manners.
The players in Club 33 were different from those he usually encountered.
Almost every player in this group could be the ultimate warrior of a certain Starfield.
“Hahahaha.”
Li Yi laughed heartily for a moment before turning around and waving his hand, “Alright, alright, let’s not talk about this anymore. Talking too much makes me blush. Let’s go, I’ll lead the way.”
“And introduce you to a few people along the way.”
…
Inside Awesome Starfield.
In the central hotel lobby of a certain city, the décor seemed extremely luxurious, although the aesthetic appeared a bit alien, the kind that was somewhat eerie, like
“…”
Chen Yi furrowed his brows tightly and stared at the creature that approached him, his mouth twitching violently, and his eyelids uncontrollably fluttering.
The creature in front of him was about half a meter tall, completely covered in short tentacles, with no eyes, and no way to tell what it was.
It moved by rolling.
Those tentacles were dripping with a sticky liquid.
Besides, the creature had an extremely long proboscis that stretched out, over a meter long, and at that moment, the creature was bringing it close to Chen Yi, offering him to taste its delicious contents.
“Come on, Yi, have a taste.”
Li Yi, somewhat showing off, patted his plump belly and said, “As the saying goes, a human year is like a hundred years for a Fù. Fù is the name of this creature, and it has a very impressive feature: their bellies are natural fermentation chambers.”
“A wine that would need to be cherished for a hundred years by humans can be produced in just one year inside a Fù’s belly.”
“Before uncorking, our professional wine masters will open the Fù’s proboscis and add some valuable ingredients for blending, and then one simply has to hold the Fù’s proboscis in their mouth and suck hard to taste this precious liquor.”
“This particular Fù has been fermenting for three years, which is like a three-hundred-year-old fine wine in human terms.”
“It’s quite valuable.”
“It’s a specialty of our planet. Come on, Yi, try it and see what you think.”
“…”
Chen Yi steeled himself and leaned back, looking at the proboscis in front of him that was as thin as an infant’s arm and a good meter long, unable to imagine the concept of holding such a thing in his mouth.
He swore!
If Li Yi truly insisted on him holding that thing in his mouth!
He would wipe out Li Yi’s Awesome Starfield today!
Before coming here, he had already thought about the cultural differences between different Races and that he should not show misunderstanding regardless of what he saw.
Respect is key.
Respecting other Races’ cultures is a person’s greatest quality.
But the problem was, this Race’s culture was just too hard to respect!!!
“No, thank you.”
Chen Yi’s mouth twitched again as he shook his head, “I have a Title Restriction that prevents me from drinking. The moment I consume anything with alcohol, I would become instantly immobile and completely paralyzed.”
“Is that so?”
Li Yi nodded with a hint of regret, then grabbed the Fù’s proboscis from in front of Chen Yi, put it in his own mouth, and with a forceful suck, he took a mouthful before exhaling a satisfied sigh.
“Refreshing, satisfying!”
“What a fine liquor!”
Watching this scene, Chen Yi felt his eyelids twitching wildly. There were even tiny tentacles and slimy liquid trembling on that proboscis, and you just put it in your mouth like that??
Does your planet even have such terrifying torture methods?!
What he hadn’t noticed yet
Was a servant wandering around the central hall with a dessert platter. Upon hearing Chen Yi’s claim that his Title Restriction prevented him from drinking, a gleam flashed in the servant’s eyes, and he quickly retreated from the hall with the dessert platter, disappearing into the ether.
Before Chen Yi could even come to terms with this,
A man soon arrived, trailed by a voluptuous, pretty woman in a cheongsam.
“Hello Yi, this is my mom.”
…

chapters.title: Chapter 373: 314: Exclusive Profession "Faceless One"!
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: Chapter 314: Exclusive Profession “Faceless One”!
“Let me introduce.”
As the man approached Chen Yi, Li Yi, who sat next to Chen Yi as the host, smiled and said, “This is Minister Ke Qiu from the Korma planet in the Awesome Starfield. The Korma planet is already one of the Fourfold Planets.”
“He’s also working with me at the moment.”
“He watched your live stream from start to finish and has great respect for you.”
“You can get to know each other, there might be opportunities for cooperation in the future.”
“Sure.”
...
A trade minister from a Fourfold Planet?
Chen Yi’s expression became slightly serious, and just as he was about to stand up with a cup of wine to greet the man, he glanced around and saw no wine cups—just a room full of rollicking Fushis. After a moment of silence, he said awkwardly,
“Minister Ke must find this amusing, I’m not good with alcohol.”
“No worries.”
The man waved his hand generously, excitement twinkling in his eyes as he looked at Chen Yi and said, “Yi, I watched your entire live stream, and I’ve also heard from Lord Li Yi about your achievement of annihilating the Ten Clans.”
“You, a true man.”
“Right up my alley, I hope we have the chance to work together in the future.”
“This is my mother, she will be yours for tonight.”
“Cough, cough, cough!”
Just as Chen Yi was about to light a cigarette to calm down, he was caught off guard by these words and began to choke on the smoke, coughing uncontrollably. It took him a moment to recover and look at the man in front of him with disbelief.
After confirming that the man wasn’t joking,
he turned his gaze to the woman standing behind the man. She was clearly of age, but her figure and looks were impeccable, radiating elegance. She too, was smiling as she looked at him and gave a slight nod.
It was obvious.
This woman hadn’t suffered much; otherwise, she wouldn’t have maintained such an aura.
The players from this planet didn’t seem much different from the human race players of Starfield.
Not much difference at all.
The only noticeable difference seems to be that the players of this race all have snake-like tongues, split down the middle.
At least that was the case for these two.
Whether this was special to these two or common to all players on their planet remained uncertain.
When Li Yi noticed Chen Yi’s shock, he coughed lightly and whispered into Chen Yi’s ear, “This is their cultural way. To show respect and admiration to a distinguished guest, they have their mothers provide the hospitality.”
“It is only for the most respected guests that they do this.”
“…”
Chen Yi didn’t speak, just stared at the two people in front of him as his pupils dilated. For the first time, he found it so difficult to manage his expression, unable to hide his shock. How was this culture respectful?
How was he supposed to show respect?
There was no way he could respect this!!
He knew well that due to different histories and developments, different races were bound to have unique cultural practices, and even within a race, there could be significant cultural differences from one area to another. That was normal.
But he hadn’t anticipated such a vast difference!
He looked into the eager and respectful eyes of the man before him and the smiling mature woman behind him. After a long silence, he said softly, “I have a title that requires me to be faithful, or I’ll explode and die.”
He found this excuse quite handy now.
“I see.”
The man in front of him sighed with slight regret, but then handed a business card to Chen Yi, “Then I won’t take up more of your time, Yi. If ever you have the chance, you must come to visit my planet’s territory.”
“Let me entertain you properly.”
“Definitely, definitely.”
After the man left, Li Yi sitting next to him commented with emotion, “Is it not a bit absurd? At first, I also found it quite absurd, but later I came to understand them. Women on their planet are extremely rare.”
“So motherhood is hereditary.”
“Basically, when your father dies, your mother becomes your wife. This way, they can utilize the reproductive potential of women to the fullest, preventing a fertile woman from wasting her reproductive capacity by remaining a widow.”
“It’s also because of this practice that their race has been able to survive.”
“Not sure if they are cursed or what, but 90% of the children born on their planet are male. There are too many bachelors there.”
“Using a mother as a host is indeed the highest standard of hospitality for them.”
“…”
Chen Yi remained silent, taking a drag from his cigarette. He wanted to go home. The outside world seemed a bit too chaotic; he wanted to return to Blue Star.
Even though Blue Star also had its share of abnormalities,
at least they hid them away in the shadows,
instead of parading them openly as cultural practices.
He had come to realize,
aside from the cultural practices of Blue Star’s race, he couldn’t accept any others. He wondered how Tuberculosis Rabbit was doing; it had been a long time since he had seen them. He didn’t know what the September rule was on Blue Star.
Were Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others still safe?
With their current strength, they should have no problems on Blue Star, as long as they didn’t suddenly enter maps where powers far exceeded their own.
And at that moment—
Wang Qi, who was sitting nearby, held a plate of shelled crayfish and threw them into his mouth one by one as if eating sunflower seeds. He laughed next to Chen Yi and asked, “Does everything around you feel a bit absurd?”

chapters.title: Chapter 374: 314: Exclusive Profession "Faceless One"! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Chapter 314: Exclusive Profession “Faceless One”! _2
“`
“It’s very normal; I was the same when I first arrived.”
“When you come into contact with the cultures of different races, you will definitely not understand it at first, but no culture has popped up out of nowhere; if it has developed, it means that the culture must have its advantages.”
“Maybe we can find a different way to accept that culture.”
“Like this.”
“`
...
Wang Qi casually grabbed a neighboring ‘fù’ and, with a grin, said, “This thing is a specialty from Li Yi’s planet. He has used this thing to entertain me several times, and the idea of putting its bill into my mouth is just too disgusting.”
“Although I’ve tried it once and the drink was indeed delicious, the action remains too disgusting.”
“But later I discovered a different way to use the ‘fù’.”
“For example, like this.”
Wang Qi stuffed a ‘fù’s bill into his pants and murmured dreamily, “Using it this way, it feels like the culture suits my taste.”
“Wang Qi!”
Li Yi, with a somber expression, interjected, “I’ve told you many times not to treat my ‘fù’ like that. It takes a very long time to cultivate a ‘fù’, and each time you do this, you ruin one.”
“…”
Chen Yi sat motionless, taking another drag of his smokeless Mart cigarette like a wooden man.
Afterward, many people came to toast him.
There were also many players from other races who came to introduce themselves, and with each introduction, they would bring forth the highest etiquette from their own races, which often shocked Chen Yi anew.
He couldn’t imagine what kind of environments these races must live in to develop such cultural practices.
One of the players,
actually aimed to lick his backside?
He nearly broke down at that moment, activating his title; a horrifyingly terrifying murderous aura instantly engulfed the entire hall, and he was about to rise in furious and ferocious anger to slay this player on the spot!
At that instant,
everyone in the hall was petrified, trembling slightly in their stiffness.
The murderous aura formed by who knows how many lives was unleashed entirely and almost materialized so much that it caused the air temperature to drop several degrees in an instant.
It was only after Li Yi hurriedly persuaded him that he was stopped, or else there would have been blood splattered all over today!
Sure enough, that player’s culture involved licking the backside of a distinguished guest.
Well, this culture exists on Blue Star too.
But that’s among dogs.
It’s normal for two dogs to sniff each other upon meeting, but having this happen to people is just freaking abnormal!
After that incident, it was only when Li Yi specifically told everyone not to pull out their strange racial cultures when toasting that the problem was resolved, and the atmosphere of the hall slowly warmed up again.
Chen Yi also gradually cooled off, looking at the countdown of less than half an hour on his personal panel; he would be forcibly teleported back to Blue Star after half an hour.
This debut trip to the map was thus coming to a perfect end.
At the same time,
he would revert to his Spirit Body State.
Yes, his absolutely incurable injury has yet to find a viable solution to this day.
He had decided that if there was no good solution within three days, he might as well become a Scavenger; he had achieved two milestones and possessed the rights of a Seed Player twice.
Even as a Scavenger, he could come back.
Moreover, returning as a Scavenger would remove all negative effects from him, including the absolutely incurable injury.
But this was only treating the symptoms, not the cause.
This was why he had not resorted to this measure.
What if he encountered this situation again? He could not simply repeat the process; there must be a way to deal with such tactics.
Soon,
his return countdown was about to hit zero.
Upon departure, Chen Yi said goodbye to each person from Club 33, who had thrown a celebratory banquet for him, before dissipating in front of everyone.
…
Accompanied by a flash of white light before his eyes,
first came several notification sounds in his ear, followed by the familiar sight that filled his vision—the Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End basking in the sun on the rooftop.
Chen Yi cracked a relieved smile at the sight without speaking; this scene seemed much more comfortable than the banquet.
Only his viewpoint was from high above.
After returning,
he had become a Spiritual Body once again.
Due to the activation of his Stellar Rank title “Seems Like A Demon,” random background music began to play throughout the skies of Blue Star according to his mood, and the pop-up indicating the deduction of 10,000 Points per minute from his title reappeared before his eyes.
Meanwhile, the notification sounds kept on ringing.
“Ding, your debut map ‘Rogue Star’ has officially ended, and you will receive an exclusive title and occupation that fit your behavior on this map.”
“This title possesses absolute uniqueness throughout the Whole Starfield and is extremely rare, available only to players who have captured a game Monument.”
“The occupation will offer three choices based on your map behavior, and the player can freely choose according to their situation, available only to players from stars above rank six and those who have captured a game Monument.”
“Exclusive title: ‘God!'”
“Exclusive occupations as follows—”
“Occupation”: Shepherd.
“Occupational Effect”: You can gather the Power of Faith. Whenever a follower truly believes in the god you speak of, all of your Props, Skills, Effects, etc., originating from the advanced game will gain an enhancement of 0.01%.”

chapters.title: Chapter 375: 314: Exclusive Profession "Faceless One"! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Chapter 314: Exclusive Profession “Faceless One”! _3
“Occupational Restriction”: When less than 40% of the players on this planet have faith in the god you speak of, you will not be able to leave your own planet.
–
“Occupation”: Emperor.
“Occupational Effect”: You will randomly receive a buff each day, which is a mandatory negative buff that cannot be removed by any means, but correspondingly, you will also acquire a random S-class Prop every day, with only one opportunity for consumption.
Whether used or not, the Prop will begin to re-randomize at 0:00.
“Occupational Restriction”: You cannot use any Props below S-class.
...
–
“Occupation”: Faceless One.
“Occupational Effect”: You will gain a random occupation every week and will be immune to the restrictions and potential negative buffs that come with that occupation.
“Occupational Restriction”: You will not be able to advance in your job promotion.
–
“Ding, please select your occupation within thirty minutes. Once the occupation is fixed, it will be almost impossible to change, please choose carefully,” said the system.
“…”
Chen Yi frowned as he looked at the three occupational choices that had popped up before him.
None of them were the occupations he desired. His favored occupation was Wang Qi’s—”Bloodthirsty Butcher”—which had an occupational effect that you would be forcibly invulnerable to death within one hour, and when paired with his Wife-Killing Buff, it was incredibly strong.
But it was understandable why he didn’t receive that occupation; after all, based on the way he cleared the game this time, it didn’t look like he would get the “Bloodthirsty Butcher” occupation.
However, the three occupations before him were also very strong.
The first occupation, Shepherd.
It goes without saying, as long as you have one believer, you can amplify the effect of your Prop title by 0.01%. With a sufficient number of believers, increasing the amplification of your Prop title’s effect by several tens of times was not an issue at all.
One can imagine.
With enough believers, an S-class Prop amplified by several tens of times would have what kind of effect.
The strength is simply outrageous.
It’s an occupation with no upper limit and extremely good developmental potential, powerful in the late stages.
The second occupation is not weak either.
Receiving a random S-class Prop every day means you can use an S-class Prop once for free each day. The strength of S-class Props is self-evident; needless to say if you choose this occupation, no matter what the map, there will be practically no difficulty.
An easy clearance.
But the restriction is clear, not allowing the use of any Props below S-class.
In most cases, all players still rely on props below S-class as their main strength; S-class Props are just a trump card. Who else could have so many S-class Props?
Not to mention anything else.
Even he, who had captured two game Monuments, only possessed one S-class Prop—”Longevity as the Southern Mountains.”
The restriction on this occupation is a bit too great.
The third occupation’s effect is more balanced, as you will gain a random occupation each week and will be exempt from the restrictions of that occupation. One can imagine, by then, no matter which occupation is randomized, you will be able to maximize its power.
But the downside is that you will never be able to receive a Job Promotion.
Job Promotion.
He is not clear about this path at the moment; he is unaware that occupations could be promoted, nor does he know the effects after job promotion, so he doesn’t have a concrete concept of this restriction.
These three occupations each have their own advantages and shortcomings.
Choosing which one is quite the dilemma.
After pondering for a while, Chen Yi finally focused his attention on one of the occupations, which seemed more suitable for him.
Most importantly, the restrictions of this occupation are not very strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 376: 315: His life seems to have gotten tougher.
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Chapter 315: His life seems to have gotten tougher.
“Ding, congratulations, you have chosen your exclusive profession ‘Faceless One.’ Since player Chen Yi obtained this exclusive profession through seizing the Monument of Ascension, when the player’s current planet successfully advances to Sixfold Planet, the player’s profession will automatically upgrade once.”
“Please continue to make persistent efforts and keep working hard~”
Yes, he had chosen the Faceless One profession.
Compared to the other two professions, this one suited him better.
Although the Shepherd’s Occupational Effect was very strong and the Occupational Restriction wasn’t too big, requiring only 40% of the planet’s players to worship the true god preached by the player, as long as it spread to a sufficient number of people, the effect of any Prop owned could be amplified by hundreds of times.
Very strong.
...
But he didn’t like it; that wasn’t his path. He didn’t want to be like a charlatan, spending all day promoting a so-called true god he had concocted. Everyone is different, and everyone’s path is different.
This wasn’t his.
As for the Emperor, that was even less suitable. The Occupational Restriction was too severe for him. Though he would receive a time-limited, one-time free-use Stellar Rank Prop every day, he couldn’t use any Props below Stellar Rank, and most of his main firepower came from Props of a lower rank.
If he could only use the “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” Prop, his end would certainly not be longevity like that of the Southern Mountains but rather sudden death on the spot.
“Longevity as the Southern Mountains” was a very handy Stellar Rank support Prop.
But on its own, it was absolutely worthless.
In the end, after thinking it over, the Faceless One profession was more suitable for him.
Soon after, a new notification sounded in his ear—
“Ding, you begin to randomly acquire this week’s new profession… Congratulations, you have randomly acquired the ‘Gold Miner’ profession!”
–
“Profession”: Gold Miner.
“Occupational Effect”: Once a day, you can randomly throw out a hook that will reach out across the entire Ascension game and randomly grab things, with a chance to snatch all sorts of marvelous and unknown items, such as Props, Skill Fragments, project team staff, bosses from certain maps, pebbles, garbage, Scavengers, and so on.
“Occupational Restriction”: After using it once, you will fall into a 24-hour cooldown.
“ps: Due to the effect of the Faceless One profession, this restriction has been removed.”
“ps2: Duration of profession, 7 days.”
–
Chen Yi looked at the Gold Miner profession before him, was stupefied for a moment, then suddenly cracked a smile, his eyes filled with expectation and excitement.
He knew this profession.
During the debut map’s introduction panel, this Skill had been showcased to him as an example of a profession, and he hadn’t expected the first profession he randomly drew would be this one.
The moment he saw this profession that day, he felt it had only one characteristic: it was somewhat luck-dependent.
With extreme luck, you could snatch a Stellar Rank Prop in a day, which wasn’t impossible.
With bad luck, you could grab a grain of sand a day, and even after seventy or eighty years, there’d still be a chance of opening a small sandpit.
But now, the restriction of his profession had been lifted.
In other words, after using this professional skill once, he would not fall into a day of cooldown and could cast the hook again immediately.
That made things much more interesting.
Chen Yi looked down at the Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others below the rooftop, who vaguely felt his return and were searching for him in the air, licked his lips with some expectation, and decided to first deal with the injury on his body that absolutely couldn’t heal—then come back for a happy fishing session.
He had decided.
He had already planned his itinerary for the following days.
One day for fishing.
One day to understand how to farm “Longevity as the Southern Mountains.”
One day to clear the map that required the Stellar Rank Admission Ticket Prop.
And then one day…
He couldn’t plan any further; he seemed a bit busy.
Afterward, he took a deep breath, deactivated the Stellar Rank title “Seems Like A Demon,” and at the instant this title was deactivated, the buff that prevented him from dying to continuous damage instantly disappeared, and almost at that instant, his vision went black.
The familiar voice sounded.
“Ding, you are dead…”
When he opened his eyes again, he found himself standing in a somewhat dim alley on the streets of the deep hell, he glanced down at his body and finally saw his form again, having exited the Spirit Body State.
But the irreparable wound was still unsolved.
His body was still rapidly dissolving.
The bone-piercing pain made him frown involuntarily.
He needed to die in hell now and sink into being a cleaner, to then come back from the depths of hell, refreshing all the negative buffs on his body including the absolutely incurable injury, but this constant dissolving death was clearly too painful.
He took a deep breath.
Summoned the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle, and a bullet fired straight up from the ground.
Not enough.
His life seemed a bit too resilient.
Without any defenses, several continuous bullets finally fulfilled his wish, killing him on the spot.
Everything went black before his eyes.
When he opened his eyes again, he appeared in an immense void that seemed utterly endless, and a new prompt sounded by his ear.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 377: 316: Inspect the Retirement Environment of Your Own Enemy?
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: Chapter 316: Inspect the Retirement Environment of Your Own Enemy?
“On September 28th at 19:21, you were completely eliminated from the SSS-ranked map Hell and will forever lose the chance to return to the ascended game, starting now you will become a janitor, and live out the rest of your life as such.”
“Ding, regretfully Chen Yi, due to your total defeat in the ascended game, you have become a janitor.”
“As a loser of the game, you need to exert the last of your usefulness here until the end of your days.”
“Ding, player Chen Yi detected as a Seed Player in the ascended game, with two opportunities to return to the ascended game to continue the fight without compensation, temporarily retaining the player Chen Yi’s original form. Would you like to use this opportunity?”
“Please respond within ten minutes.”
Chen Yi didn’t immediately use his opportunity, instead, he looked around curiously. He’d always known that players who died in the depths of Hell would become janitors, but he had never seen it for himself.
...
The space before him was somewhat like the universe.
It wasn’t completely dark as there was some light.
But the source of light wasn’t discernible.
It seemed as though the light was randomly floating in the air.
His body was also floating in the air, a bit like the weightlessness of the cosmic vacuum, yet it didn’t affect normal breathing, which was quite marvelous.
At that moment—
He saw a flash of white light next to him, and a new player arrived.
The instant the new player arrived, his body began to expand swiftly, his belly ballooning to a good two meters wide, similar to the vats Li Yi had seen used for fermenting wine.
The figure was incredibly bizarre.
Then the whole person, as if out of control, with a face full of tears and a ferocious expression, stretched his mouth to an incredibly exaggerated extent and shot rapidly towards a monster corpse infested with maggots floating nearby.
In a moment of proximity, he swallowed the maggot-infested corpse in one gulp.
And started to chew forcefully and quickly.
Two streams of bloody tears fell from the player’s eyes, but they seemed somewhat insignificant.
“Ugh.”
Witnessing this scene, Chen Yi couldn’t help but feel queasy, as the food he’d recently eaten threatened to come back up. This was far more disgusting than he had imagined.
Falling to this level was worse than death.
Just as he was about to leave—
A loud shout suddenly rang in his ear.
“Hey, the newbie.”
Turning his head, he saw a man covered in angular scales staring at him with some surprise: “Why do you still retain your original form? What’s the situation?”
And behind this man, there was a chain in his hand, with a chain around someone Chen Yi somewhat recognized.
He didn’t know the specifics.
But he knew it was a player from Logitech Star, the same player that left him with an incurable injury, forcing him to waste a Seed Player opportunity to come to the depths of Hell.
His impression of this player’s race was very deep.
“Chen Yi, it’s that devil Chen Yi!!!”
The player who was chained up, upon seeing Chen Yi, screamed in horror: “Run, he’s Chen Yi, this guy is a devil, kills without blinking!”
“Run, or we’re all dead!”
It was clear that this player didn’t have a good impression of him.
But soon—
The already strangely huge player suddenly realized, first looking at Chen Yi with disbelief, then scanning the surroundings, as if he couldn’t quite believe that a player as powerful as Chen Yi could also be sent to the depths of Hell.
Who could have killed him?
But then his face completely changed, his expression ferocious as he pointed at Chen Yi and laughed with a gleeful triumph: “Hahaha, I almost forgot, this is the depths of Hell.”
“What about it?”
“Chen Yi, weren’t you very strong?”
“Why are you here? Did you find out there are others stronger than you, mountains beyond mountains?”
“Or did you realize that the strength you thought you had seems insignificant when facing the entire Starfield?”
“I told you before, you were just a bit luckier, you’re nothing special in terms of real ability.”
“Chen Yi?”
The man pulling the chain first slapped away the player who was nagging at his side and then turned to Chen Yi with interest: “So it’s you, your name has been quite notorious around here lately.”
“You’ve sent down a large number of players.”
“All at once, you’ve lightened the workload for us old players here, to the point where we’re almost bored with nothing to do.”
“Many in the depths of Hell know of a Killing God from the ascended game, taking revenge and slaying by race.”
“I thought I’d never have the chance to meet you in this lifetime, but here you are.”
Then with some regret, he shook his head: “It’s a pity, but it also makes up for my regrets. We might not have met face to face, but I have long been in awe of you. So why not come work for me? How about becoming the vice president?”
“My influence here isn’t small.”
“Vice president?”
The player chained by the man couldn’t believe it and screamed out: “Why should he be the vice president? No matter how powerful he was before, now that he’s here, he cannot use his props or titles, he’s just a lowly piece of trash. Why should he get to be the vice president?”
“You can’t just go by his reputation, can you?”
The man’s face grew cold, he lifted his elbow and smashed it into the mouth of the player beside him, saying coldly: “It’s precisely because of his reputation, if you say one more word, I’ll stuff your head into the belly of a Pixiu.”

chapters.title: Chapter 378: 316: Inspecting the Retirement Environment of One's Own Enemy?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Chapter 316: Inspecting the Retirement Environment of One’s Own Enemy?_2
Upon hearing this,
the sharp-mouthed player’s face instantly turned deathly pale and he stopped talking.
Pixiu are some of the oldest players, who, after devouring too many corpses, have bellies so distended they cannot be looked at directly. Their minds have also begun to fog up; from the long-term fermentation, the stench inside the belly of such Pixiu players is unspeakably foul!
Here, the most brutal torture
is to stuff someone’s head into the belly of a Pixiu.
It’s undoubtedly a memory that will last a lifetime.
...
“How about it?”
After giving his pet a lesson, the man turned to Chen Yi with a smile and said, “Here, every new player’s first lesson is to swallow 10 corpses, just like what you just witnessed. But if you follow me, of course, you’ll avoid all that.”
“My influence here is not small. With you joining us, we are sure to reach new heights.”
“Don’t worry about our strength.”
“We even have former project staff members who have become cleaners under us. You should know, not every power can boast having project staff members as cleaners.”
“No need.”
Chen Yi glanced around, saw nothing of further interest, and prepared to leave. As he was about to go, he casually asked, “The project staff turned cleaners… I remember players aren’t allowed to kill project staff, right?”
“Hey.”
The man shrugged nonchalantly, “In the Ascension game, there’s really only one rule.”
“That is, every so-called absolute rule can be circumvented.”
“In principle, players absolutely cannot kill project staff members, but there’s always a way.”
“Oh?”
Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed as he looked at the man before him and then glanced at the 6-minute countdown nearby. He asked, “What’s your name?”
“Ping Ye. My people call me Brother Flathead, but you can just call me by my full name—we’re equals.”
“Okay, Ping Ye.”
Chen Yi took a deep breath, then looked earnestly at the man before him: “Tell me about the method you mentioned. If you can indeed propose something I’d consider adopting, I might owe you a favor.”
“There are quite a few methods.”
The man didn’t care about the favor Chen Yi mentioned. No matter how powerful Chen Yi was before, everyone had to start over here. What use was the favor of a new cleaner to him?
What he really admired was Chen Yi himself.
A ruthless man who annihilated the Ten Clans.
He felt that associating with such a person gave him face.
Even though he was starting from scratch now, he had once stood at the pinnacle. Besides, if he weren’t starting over, he would never have had the chance to meet someone like this.
That’s also why he was willing to offer the position of vice president directly, even though Chen Yi was just a newbie.
A major reason was that having someone with a big name serving as the vice president of his force would significantly boost its prestige—or as they would say on his home planet,
it was about enhancing brand influence.
Then, after pausing for a moment, he continued, “In the Ascension game, there is a rule that players are not allowed to kill project staff, as it means directly confronting the Ascension game and will lead to severe punishment.”
“But we only need to kill those who aren’t project staff. What we want is to kill certain individuals, to put it another way, to strip away the project staff status from the individuals we want dead.”
“The method is simple.”
“Firstly, most project staff members are former race players who signed debt-related contracts with the Ascension game and failed. They started working for the game to pay off their debts. If you help clear their debts and let them revert to race player status, they can be killed however you like.”
“Secondly, major punishments, like if you want to kill a project staff member from a certain planet, you just need to annihilate all the players from that planet. Then, due to the grave mistake, the planet’s project staff will naturally be punished and sent to the depths of hell to serve as cleaners for a year.”
“However, this only applies to runner-up planets of three volumes or less, and there is a one-year limit.”
“It does not apply to the Starfield Project Team.”
“If you want to target the Starfield Project Team, you would need to wipe out all the players in the Starfield, and then all the staff members of the Starfield Project Team would be thrown here.”
“Thirdly, is betting.”
“Betting?”
Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed thoughtfully, and he asked, “You mentioned two methods before, none seem very feasible. To massacre the entire Annihilation Starfield? That’s a straight pass for me; I’m not yet powerful enough to be so brazen.”
As for helping the Feng Family regain their race player status…
“That’s disgusting.”
“He was here for revenge.”
“Not to slave away for the other side, or to play the fool.”
“Yes, a wager.”
It was clear that Ping Ye was extremely saddened by Chen Yi and spoke seriously, “As long as a wager agreement can be signed with the members of the project team, anything can be okay in the content of this wager agreement.”
“Just include a clause in the wager agreement that the loser will completely die and fall into the depths of hell.”
“The Ascension game does not allow players to kill the project team members because these members represent the face of the Ascension game; it’s a slap in the face. But, if a project team member privately signs a life-or-death contract with a player, then it becomes a private issue, which is unrelated to the identity of a project team member.”
“At that time, it will all be about personal strength.”
“Understood.”
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes and began to ponder this matter; it seemed quite difficult. How could he make the Feng Family wager with him? And preferably, all members of the Feng Family, without any escapees.
This matter was a bit difficult to handle.
Seeing Chen Yi in deep thought, Ping Ye didn’t interrupt him but simply waited patiently for Chen Yi’s decision.
Who knows how much time had passed.
Chen Yi glanced at the countdown that was about to end, looked up at Ping Ye with a light laugh and said, “Thanks, I think I have some ideas now. I owe you a favor; you can think it over, and just tell me next time we meet.”
“I just came down for a stroll to see how the environment for my enemies’ retirement was. Now it’s time to go back.”
“Meet again?”
Ping Ye’s eyebrows slightly furrowed as he said, “Without the protection of power, a new player here…”
Before he could finish speaking.
He saw Chen Yi’s figure begin to blur gradually, and then the whole person vanished on the spot.
“Snap!”
Almost instantly, Ping Ye’s jaw dropped to the ground in shock, his eyes full of disbelief and amazement. How could it be? He had just heard Chen Yi say he just came down for a stroll, thinking it was a joke.
How could the players who came here return?
This was the highest rule of the Ascension game; those who came to the depths of hell would spend their remaining lives here, with no way to return. How could it be?
But then he seemed to think of something, and the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
He had just said the highest rule of the Ascension game was that any rule could be broken. He didn’t expect this statement to come true so soon; he truly did not anticipate that one could return after coming here.
And from the sounds of it, it seemed so easy.
Inspect his enemies’ retirement environment?
After a long while.
It took a while for Ping Ye to recover. Tightening his belt, with a mix of pain and eager anticipation, he grabbed his pet by the side and shot off into the distance. He couldn’t wait to show off to his old friends about his exchange with the infamous person from hell, Chen Yi!
If Chen Yi had truly died and come to hell, although he would have been excited, he wouldn’t have been this thrilled.
After all, only the reputation remained.
But the situation was different now.
Chen Yi was just passing by for a stroll; that made his conversation with Chen Yi a powerful boasting asset.
After all, there is still a difference between the living and the dead.
And it seemed like Chen Yi was planning to send down a batch of project team members, as if he were an accomplice?
Thinking of it that way felt so thrilling.
…
Meanwhile, on Chen Yi’s side, after deciding to use his eligibility.
He felt a flash of white light in front of him, and when he regained his vision, he was standing on the rooftop looking at Tuberculosis Rabbit and a few others sitting on the stone bench. After a brief pause, he smiled and said.
“Long time no see, my friends.”
“How have you been?”

chapters.title: Chapter 379: 317: "You're actually quite nice." (9K words long )
chapters.content:
Chapter 379: Chapter 317: “You’re actually quite nice.” (9K words long chapter)
“Yi!”
The moment Tuberculosis Rabbit saw Chen Yi appear, he excitedly jumped up from the stone bench, strode up to Chen Yi, gave him a tight hug, then turned to Sword Without End behind him with an excited laugh.
“I told you Yi was back, didn’t I? Otherwise, why would music suddenly start playing all over the world just now?”
“That’s Yi’s Title Effect.”
Chen Yi, chuckling, patted Tuberculosis Rabbit’s shoulder. Given the bond between the two brothers, there was naturally no need for many words. Then he turned to Sword Without End: “Thank you for your hard work.”
“Hey.”
...
Sword Without End scratched the back of his head, feeling a bit embarrassed: “You’re making me blush with such words. I didn’t do much during this time, and it wasn’t hard. The best thing is that you came back safely, Yi.”
“The Feng Family really set a trap for you this time, Yi, by giving you such a disgusting map. Everyone in the live stream thought you were going to make a fool of yourself, but you turned it around and performed a masterpiece in just one month.”
“It’s a pity you didn’t see the barrage.”
“On the last day, when you were about to clear the level perfectly, the players watching the stream were dumbfounded. Those who had mocked you in the beginning all shrank back, and the screen was full of ‘awesome’ comments. Even a player from the Sixfold Planet said that he watched the entire live stream, and if he were thrown into that map, he wouldn’t be able to give a more perfect answer than you did.”
“Sixfold…”
Chen Yi’s pupils slightly contracted. He was still very happy to receive praise from a player of that level.
To a player from the Threefold Planet, a player from the Sixfold Planet is almost no different from a god.
It’s almost as if they’re not even playing the same game anymore.
The most basic difference is this.
Every player from the Sixfold Planet has an occupation, and just this alone is enough to completely overpower players from the Threefold Planet. The enhancement from Occupational Effects needs no further explanation.
But he hadn’t expected that a player from the Sixfold Planet would actually watch his entire stream.
Are players from the Sixfold Planet really that idle?
Afterward, Chen Yi took a deep breath and then turned his head to look at Jiaye, who stood quietly in her sling dress, and said softly with a sense of guilt: “You’ve been wronged these past days. My strength isn’t weak now, even without activating the Wife-Killing Buff.”
“I promise you I’ll try to use that Skill as little as possible in the future.”
“No.”
Jiaye took a step forward, lowered her head, and nestled into Chen Yi’s chest, murmuring: “It doesn’t matter if I die once, it’s no big deal. If that little thing puts you in danger, Yi, that would be really terrible.”
“I just hope you’ll be more careful in the future.”
“Like this time, what if you had died in the map?”
Before Chen Yi could say anything, she looked up at him with tearful eyes and said word by word: “I know you would say that even if you died, you’d just go to hell and come back up again, but what if something unexpected happened?”
“What if the map was a death map?”
“What if dying in the map meant actual death? With your Props and Title Effects restricted, how would you cope, Yi? Have you thought about it?”
Chen Yi didn’t speak, just lowered his head and embraced Jiaye, feeling the warmth of the moment, and whispered: “It won’t happen again. I’ve got a new goal now.”
“What goal?”
“To bring peace to the world.”
“You’re teasing me again.”
“I’m not teasing you. I’ve thought it through. Since we can’t escape the game of progressing through the worlds, then I’ll lead Blue Star to the highest point. We’ll go all the way to the Ninefold Planet, and everything will naturally settle down.”
“Then we can live a normal life.”
Jiaye whispered with her head lowered: “That sounds very far away.”
“It won’t be long.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End exchanged glances, tried to pull Tie Chui, who was grinning foolishly nearby, away to leave some private space for Yi and his companion, but for some reason, Tie Chui just wouldn’t budge today.
After attempting to pull big Tie Chui for a while with no success, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked expressionlessly at him.
“‘Malphite’s Brain’, that Skill of yours, is almost on par with an S-level Skill.”
“Are you going or not?”
Tie Chui didn’t have many Skills.
‘Malphite’s Brain’ was one of them.
The Special Effects of this Skill were extremely straightforward and powerful.
When one player starts using their brain to think about a problem, the intelligence of the remaining 999 players will decrease slightly, but their physical defense and limb strength will increase.
When 999 players start using their brains to think, the intelligence of the remaining one player will greatly decrease, but their physical defense and limb strength will receive an epic boost!!!
It was a limited edition of 1000 globally, and once all 1000 were acquired by players, the Special Effects of the Skill would be activated.
Now they had all been acquired by players.
So the resulting effect was that on normal days, without needing to do anything, Tie Chui’s physical defense and limb strength were already receiving an epic level enhancement.
Like right now.
On other days, if Tie Chui went along with them, they could still pull him, but today Tie Chui had clearly exerted his strength. At this point, not to mention them, even a heavy truck might not be able to drag him away.
Unless heavy machinery was used.
But then again, this wasn’t a fight. What heavy machinery could they possibly use? Or could they take out the greatsword that had been charging for months and give Tie Chui a stab?
Regardless of how hard Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others tried, Tie Chui simply wouldn’t move an inch, just standing in place, grinning foolishly at Chen Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 380: 317: "You're actually quite nice." (9K words long )_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Chapter 317: “You’re actually quite nice.” (9K words long chapter)_2
“Alright.”
After moments of tenderness with Jiaye, Chen Yi lightly patted Jiaye’s shoulder, took his hand and turned to look at Tie Chui pausing for a moment before he smiled, “You’ve worked hard too during this time.”
“Don’t worry, with such a huge base game, we can definitely find some prop or skill to cure brain damage.”
“I’ve already asked a friend of mine to buy it.”
“My friend does business in several Starfields, so he should get it pretty soon.”
Then, noticing the expectation in Tie Chui’s eyes, he looked slightly stunned before he suddenly realized and apologetically tapped his own head, “I’ve been on the map for too long, I even forgot about this.”
...
He took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket and gave one to Tie Chui.
“Thank you, Yi.”
Sure enough, Tie Chui had been waiting for this cigarette. After receiving it with both hands respectfully and excitedly, he hoisted Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End onto his shoulders and ran off towards the rooftop.
“…”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, abruptly hoisted onto Tie Chui’s shoulder, first looked down at Tie Chui’s buttocks that shook with his running, then raised his head to watch Chen Yi’s receding figure, before turning his head to Sword Without End on the other shoulder and said without expression.
“Do you think there’s a chance that Tie Chui isn’t dumb at all and is just deceiving us?”
“I don’t know.”
Sword Without End on the shoulder replied with equally no expression, “I just feel that this is disrespectful to me. It’s him who’s supposed to have brain damage, so why does the way he treats me make me feel like I’m the one with brain damage?”
“In the mind of brain damage, there’s no concept of brain damage.”
“What do you mean?”
“It means in Tie Chui’s eyes, everyone has brain damage.”
“That makes sense.”
“Thank you.”
…
“It’s not even dark yet.”
“I know.”
“Then why are you still touching.”
“Mainly because it’s been a month, I’ve been holding it in for quite long. Don’t you want it to rain after a long drought?”
“Not now, it’s not even eight o’clock yet, it’s not completely dark. Later, everyone is going to have dinner together. If you mess around with me now, I’ll be too embarrassed to see people later.”
“Alright alright, I’ll stop. I take a bath every day; I’m actually clean.”
“Get lost, you.”
Jiaye, who was embraced by Chen Yi from behind, glared at him with annoyance before hesitantly speaking up, “Did you do it with that woman in the map?”
“Eh?”
Chen Yi said with some surprise, “Wasn’t it a live broadcast the whole time? Don’t you know?”
“It’s not that.”
Jiaye shook her head, “It wasn’t a complete live broadcast; some private moments would switch the camera, like when you use the bathroom or take a shower. And there are often rolling cameras that will show other NPCs in the map.”
“It wasn’t focused on you the whole time.”
“So, I don’t know if you did something else when the camera wasn’t on you.”
“No way. You know I have a title that prevents me from feeling anything for any other gender besides you.”
“That seems true.”
Jiaye hesitated for a while before shutting up. Originally, she wanted to persuade Yi to find someone else, as her Hell Return journey was becoming harder and harder. Rationally, this was the correct choice, but when it came time to actually say it, she found she couldn’t let go.
She didn’t want to find another person to share Yi with.
Besides, Yi’s time spent on her was already limited, and it would only decrease with another person.
“Forget it.”
Jiaye shook her head, deciding not to dwell on it and to just go with the flow. But feeling the bulge in the trousers of Chen Yi behind her, she hesitated, “Does it hurt a lot?”
“Not really. I can endure the pain of my body melting, so this is nothing.”
“Well then, never mind. I was actually thinking of helping you out a little first.”
Jiaye stuck out her tongue slightly, a playful glint in her eyes.
“Hm?”
Chen Yi was taken aback for a moment, then it hit him. Suddenly, he lay on the ground, clutching his stomach and pretending to be in agony, “Ah, it hurts so much, it feels like I’ve been poisoned. It must be that bastard Li Yi who drugged me. I feel like I’m about to explode.”
“Stop acting.”
Jiaye turned her head away with embarrassment, “Your acting is too cringeworthy, that line doesn’t suit you. You don’t need to try so hard to cheer me up; just be yourself. Don’t feel guilty.”
“You’ve already been very good to me.”
“If I hadn’t met you, my brother and I might have died long ago, instead of living this well.”
Upon hearing this,
Chen Yi slowly stood up and once more enveloped Jiaye into his arms, resting his chin on her head and whispered, “I will treat you even better in the future. I will make sure you know that I am the best choice you ever made; half of all the glory I, Chen Yi, will achieve in my life will be yours.”
“I can’t announce your merit to the whole world, I can’t let too many people know about the Wife-Killing Buff.”
“But I’ll remember it in my heart, and…”
“Hey, why did you suddenly kneel down?”
While declaring his heartfelt feelings, Chen Yi suddenly noticed that Jiaye, who had been leaning against his chin, gradually seemed to shrink. Just as he was about to say something, his pupils contracted, his body stiffened, and he gasped.
“Screw you, one!”
“Oh, shit!”
“Oh, my god!”
“Qu’est-ce que c’est!”
“Wow!”
…
Before long, more than half an hour passed.
A fully contented Chen Yi called the owner of the hotpot restaurant he had invested in earlier. Soon the owner brought over a large amount of ingredients personally to prepare a grand hotpot feast for them.

Chapter 381: Chapter 317: “You’re actually quite nice.” (9K words long chapter)_3
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood expressionlessly at the entrance of the rooftop’s security door, looking at nearly a hundred people bustling back and forth with various market items and tools. Eventually, he couldn’t help but turn toward the hot pot restaurant owner beside him and speak without showing any emotions.
“Yi, you were supposed to deliver some hot pot, not move your entire shop here.”
“Of course, of course.”
The hot pot restaurant owner was also quick on the uptake, responding attentively and respectfully, “If it hadn’t been for Yi investing in my hot pot restaurant, my business wouldn’t be this good now. Many of my peers have gone under, pursuing business among the dead. As for those serving the living well, I reckon I’m one of the few left.”
“Moreover, Yi endured so much humiliation to protect Blue Star from invasion, having just returned from such a dangerous place.”
...
“The gratitude I owe to Yi, and to the entire Blue Star, is immense.”
“It’s rare that Yi needs me for something, I must ensure that everyone is treated impeccably.”
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing in the shadows, was about to say something,
suddenly two of the hot pot restaurant owner’s subordinates came towards them, carrying a tank of fish. The sound of their conversation drifted over clearly on the night breeze.
“Two people would’ve been enough to deliver ingredients for Yi. Why did the boss close the doors of the restaurant and call all of us over?”
“Who knows.”
“And making us carry this fish tank up and down, this is already the third time we’ve carried it upstairs. He even said we need to make sure Yi sees our service. Even if it’s service, there’s no need to keep carrying the same thing downstairs and upstairs again and again.”
“Maybe because if we didn’t do this, this small job would be finished quickly, and the boss is probably worried Yi might think we are cutting corners.”
At that moment—
The two subordinates suddenly noticed Tuberculosis Rabbit and the owner standing in the shadows.
“…”
“…”
As eight eyes met, the air suddenly became silent.
Tuberculosis Rabbit turned his head, looking expressionlessly at the big crucian carp in the fish tank: “Do people in Yancheng have a tradition of eating fish with hot pot?”
“Well…”
The hot pot restaurant owner said sheepishly, “We could prepare a buttery spicy pot and a side stove. Having fish with a side stove is actually quite good.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed slightly annoyed and then spoke, “Alright, alright, I know you mean well, but you’d better hurry up. Yi and the others are waiting to eat. Don’t delay too long, or your good intentions might lead to a big mistake, that’d be really unjust.”
“Okay, okay, okay.”
The restaurant owner nodded his head like a pecking chicken, then looked somewhat exasperatedly at his two subordinates: “What the hell are you still standing around for? Hurry up and get things ready!”
…
Meanwhile,
Chen Yi was sitting at the edge of the rooftop beach, with a fishing rod perched on the stand in front of him, the line cast into the deep sea, while Jiaye sat by his side, her head resting on his shoulder, smiling contentedly as she quietly savored the intimate moment.
His beach chair could transform the surrounding environment into a beach.
It was tangible.
There was even seawater at the edge of the beach.
At this time, Chen Yi was fishing by the sea, and with each passing moment, he looked more and more like a seasoned fisherman, except the fishing rod in his hand looked like jade.
It was jade-green.
Translucent and shining.
It looked more like a culturally rich art piece rather than a fishing rod, something you might expect to find in an art museum.
This item was one of his latest acquisitions.
An A-grade prop, the Power of Faith.
Leaving aside the prop’s effects, the sheer aesthetic value alone warranted an A-grade. It was near flawless, and the moment he held it, he was reluctant to let it go. Along with it, he also gained three Galaxy Megaphones.
The effects were simple.
They allowed one to broadcast across the entire Annihilation Star System.
The effect was similar to a global megaphone, only with a broader range.
He had been fishing for about fifteen minutes without catching anything, but it was understandable since the thing only looked like a fishing rod, it wasn’t actually one, so naturally, it wouldn’t catch any fish.
Moreover, what normal person would do sea fishing while sitting on a beach?
The reason he arranged this posture was mainly because the occupational pose of the Gold Miner was too unsightly.
Yes, it was too unsightly.
In the night,
Jiaye rested her shoulder against Chen Yi, and the two sat on the beach under the moonlight, creating an incredibly romantic and warm scene, but this moment was somewhat marred by a distracting structure nearby.
Yes, a structure.
Identical to the hook from the ‘Gold Miner’ mini-game.
There was a boxy support frame, with ropes, and at the end of the rope there was a hook that resembled a ship anchor.
This was the effect of his new occupation for the week.
When he activated the occupational effect, this device would appear, even though there was nothing to aim at. As soon as he activated the frame, the hook tied at the end of the rope would shoot out toward the space in front of him on its own accord.
Then, not far from the frame, a white portal would appear.
The occupational effect was clear, the object fetched each time was random.
So no one knew what exactly would be caught next.
At that moment—
The frame started to shake suddenly.
This meant that his hook, which had gone out on a ‘trip’, was finally coming back.
You’ve heard of a traveling frog, now there’s a traveling Gold Miner.
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi looked at the trembling portal with some anticipation, eager to see what the hook would bring back this time. He had activated it five times already, and each round trip of the hook took five minutes.

Chapter 382: Chapter 317: “You’re actually quite nice.” (9K words long chapter)_4
That meant the hook could be cast every five minutes.
In the previous five attempts, he hadn’t managed to hook any good items.
Once, he did hook a small monster.
He killed it effortlessly.
“Life Value +1”
It was a trifle, hardly worth mentioning, so he just considered it as an appetizer before stacking a layer onto the S-grade prop “Longevity as the Southern Mountains.” He had just returned, planning to rest for the night and wasn’t keen on finding ways to stack this item today.
...
But the Gold Miner had forcibly opened his business for him.
On two other attempts, he hooked some stones, which he didn’t discard, but set aside.
After all, who knew from which planet those stones were? They could even be some rare minerals, worth keeping as a souvenir.
The last two attempts did bring him two props.
But they were both E-grade props.
More Air Food series, things of no real importance—he threw them to Tuberculosis Rabbit. Not knowing what he would hook next, Chen Yi looked toward the increasingly trembling and forceful portal with some anticipation.
The next second—
“Ding, congratulations on activating the Gold Miner Occupational Effect. Your hook has randomly pulled a cleaning worker from the entire upgrade game for you to enjoy.”
What emerged was a man with an alarmingly distended belly, looking somewhat baffled as a giant hook secured around his stomach pulled him from the white portal.
It was obvious.
The man was bewildered.
“Eh?”
Chen Yi was equally stunned at first, but soon, with a hint of surprise, he asked, “Ping Ye? What are you doing here?”
This man looked familiar—it was the same man he had encountered in hell, who had told him how to deal with the project team workers.
But he quickly realized he had asked a silly question.
How else could he be here? Clearly, he had been hooked.
This hook… it really could hook anything in the upgrade game, even a cleaning worker.
Too bad it’s entirely random; otherwise, he could have hooked the Feng Family and the others to come right to him.
Startled to find himself yanked to Blue Star, Ping Ye was visibly disoriented, scanning his surroundings and, upon seeing the environment and Chen Yi sitting by the beach, his expression erupted in mad joy.
The entire man bellowed with extreme excitement: “The real world, this is the damn real world!!!”
“I’m back!!!”
“I actually made it back.”
“I’ve finally escaped that damn cleaning worker status!”
“This time I’m sure to survive, even if it means being subservient, I must live on!”
“Yi, did you save me? Thank you so much, thank you…”
But before he could finish, Ping Ye suddenly took an involuntary step back as the shrinking white portal behind him began to expand again, seemingly with a suction force aimed solely at Ping Ye.
“No, no!!!”
“I don’t want to go back!!! I don’t want to go back!!”
Ping Ye, his face pale, desperately lunged forward, trying to escape the pull, but without any props, titles, or skills, how could a mere mortal resist?
No matter how furiously he struggled.
His body kept slowly retreating.
“No!”
With a final roar, Ping Ye unleashed unprecedented strength, rushed to the hot pot prepared by the restaurant owner, grabbed the boiling red oil pot without a second thought, and dumped it into his mouth, then wildly stuffed all the ingredients on the table into his mouth before he was reluctantly sucked back.
“No!!”
“I am a Seed Player from Fivefold Planet, why should I always be a cleaning worker!”
“I can make greater contributions to the upgrade game!!”
Before the words faded away,
Ping Ye was sucked back through the white portal, leaving behind only chaos and his voice filled with reluctance.
“…”
Chen Yi looked oddly at the slowly disappearing white portal. Wasn’t he supposed to enjoy this? He was willing to, if only they gave him something to enjoy.
What he had hooked, why should it be taken back?
Obviously.
You could hook a cleaning worker, but one from the depths of hell had to be sucked back.
Cleaning workers have to spend their lives in the depths of hell; that’s the rule. Even Seed Players from Fivefold Planet are no exception, unless they have gained a Monument, thus becoming a Seed Player, and have that one special privilege.
At that moment.
Tuberculosis Rabbit also came over with a baffled face, standing beside Yi and murmured, “Yi, I just heard that guy calling you, do you know him? His belly sure was huge, and he ate like he hadn’t eaten in a lifetime. Why would he snatch food though?”
“It was just prepared.”
“He’s a cleaning worker from the depths of hell, whom I’ve managed to catch.”
“Prepared as food?”
“…no, caught randomly, I didn’t know it would end up being such a thing.”
Looking at the mess, Tuberculosis Rabbit frowned and said, “Just cleaned it up, and now we have to do it again.”
As the adage goes, some find joy while others sorrow.
The hot pot restaurant owner, who had been worried about running out of tasks, brightened up and eagerly approached, hardly containing his excitement, his voice trembling, “No problem, we’ve prepared ten portions of ingredients, and we can tidy up again right away.”
“Alright then.”
With a sense of resignation, Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke, “Hurry up then, never mind, I’ll have to supervise you. You used to loaf on the job, didn’t you?”
“You have a good eye, sir.”
…
After Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others had left, Chen Yi lit a cigarette, took a deep drag with a tinge of hopelessness, and silently wished for good luck to hurry back before he activated the beachside hook launcher once more.
