chapters.title: Chapter 396: 320: "What's the Wager?
chapters.content:
Chapter 396: Chapter 320: “What’s the Wager?
Chen Yi looked at the two larvae still struggling in their eggs and did not speak, turning his head towards the information panel he had found, which broadly introduced the abilities of the players of this Race.
Players of this Race do not use Props.
Nor do they possess any Props.
This isn’t because the game doesn’t treat these players as formal players, but because when players of the Void Clan obtain any rewards, they will simply swallow those Prop rewards into their stomachs.
Crunch.
Indigestible, filling up the stomach.
...
There was no mention of Props anymore, sometimes they’d get so desperately hungry they’d even eat themselves.
However, the exclusive ability of this Race’s players is to mutate and develop some corresponding and peculiar abilities by consuming a lot of something. As long as these Race players consume a large amount of Props, they would develop abilities similar to special functions.
The effects are random, based on a Prop’s effect, but there is no longer the restriction of the Prop. If activating it once originally cost 1000 Points, now it’s completely free, though it consumes spiritual power, and it cannot be cast multiple times in succession.
This is the Void Clan players’ innate beloved ability.
Even before the game was enveloped by Starfield, these Race players already possessed this power.
It has to be said, such beings becoming Overlords after entering the game was only natural.
Looking at the information on the panel, Chen Yi’s mouth twitched slightly. This was truly too abnormal; the ability could completely serve as a protagonist’s golden finger.
The thing is, every player of this Race had this ability.
It was simply unimaginable.
After hesitating for a while, he consulted in the 33 Club chat group to see if any of the veteran players of the game had a better understanding of the Void Clan, since the name Void Starfield obviously indicated they had taken over a Monument of the game.
Checking to see if they were in the group.
“I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi”: “Void Starfield, huh? We have quite a few in our group who have taken over a Monument but didn’t join the group. There’s at least one from the Void Clan.”
“Players of that Race are somewhat uncommunicative, or rather, they believe they are on a higher plane of existence than us and disdain speaking with us.”
“In the entire Starfield, only the players of the Void Clan exist, which is a terrifying fact. The strength of this Race is incredible, absurdly so.”
“Some even say that if it weren’t for the exorbitant Starfield Shuttle fees that the Void Clan can’t afford, they would have already become the Overlords of all Starfields.”
“This Race doesn’t lack strength, but they are severely lacking Points.”
“Why are you suddenly interested in this? Ever since the Void Starfield was dominated by the Void Clan a few years ago, it’s been a long time since any player has gone to the Void Starfield. You’re not planning to go there, are you?”
“Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi”: “I’ve been there once, I got with one of the Void Clan’s young Matriarchs, back when I had just made a name for myself and feared neither heaven nor earth, I wanted to see just how awesome this feared Void Clan was. Turned out they weren’t all that.”
“They have these plump butts though, which feel pretty good.”
“After I tied her up, she kept screaming, which was quite fun. They communicate through a unique biological electromagnetic wave, and I had to spend a lot of money on a Prop at the time just to understand what that Matriarch was yelling.”
“You know, us men find it hard to watch movies without subtitles, I’m the same, so it’s no big deal to spend a bit more money for that.”
“Now that Prop has been sitting in my storage for a long time.”
“If you need it, I’ll sell it to you cheap.”
“…”
After his mouth twitched for a while, Chen Yi looked down at the two bugs that had broken out of their shells. For a moment, his opinion of Wang Qi changed somewhat; this guy seemed a lot braver, and much more disgusting, than he had imagined.
“I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi”: “…How come I never knew you had such a badass story? Aren’t you afraid of dying?”
“Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi”: “Would I be called Qi Daddy Starfield if I wasn’t awesome? There’s nothing to be afraid of. That Matriarch had barbs inside her happy place, and with the Matriarch’s belly contracting and expanding, the joy kept tightening, it hurt like hell.”
“But I have the job of Bloodthirsty Butcher which makes me immortal, and another Prop that seals my body’s wounds, so I just ignored it. Honestly, it was a different kind of experience, I suggest you guys try it out when you have a chance.”
“I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi”: “…Do the fans who worship you in your Starfield know what kind of person you are?”
“Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi”: “Of course they have no idea, man, don’t spread it around, I only talk about this stuff in the group.”
“…”
Awesome.
True to someone capable of taking over a game Monument.
If he remembered correctly, Wang Qi’s Monument was something like the Great Unity of Hundred Races.
That is, the first person to kill 999 players of an Alien Race.
Now he really had his doubts.
Were those 999 Alien Race players possibly first pleased then killed by Wang Qi?
Oh God!
But something reminded him, and he hurriedly replied in the chat: “I actually do need that Prop, name your price and see what you think is fair for me.”
“Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi”: “Alright, I don’t have any use for that Prop anymore, I never go back to old flames. I spent 6 million Points on it back in the day, since we’re brothers, I’ll let you have it for 3 million Points.”

chapters.title: Chapter 397: 320: "What's the Wager?"_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Chapter 320: “What’s the Wager?”_2
“Deal.”
‘Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi’: “Then send me your personal identification code. It’s a mix of eighty-nine digits and letters, located at the very bottom of each player’s personal panel, those tiny grey letters. With that, I’ll be able to email you the prop, which will be in the attachment and should arrive in about half an hour.”
“By the way, if you go to the Void Clan and you happen to see that Matriarch baby I favored back in the day, remember to say hi for me. It’s been a long time, and I kind of miss her.”
“…Um, are there any distinct features?”
“No, all the Matriarchs of the Void look almost the same. But don’t worry, if you come across the one I favored, you’ll definitely recognize her at first glance. She’s quite conspicuous.”
“…Okay, for sure.”
...
…
Half an hour later.
Chen Yi received an email in the friend mail section of his personal panel that contained the prop he had purchased for 3 million Points.
‘Prop Name’: Hearing Aid.
‘Prop Level’: A-grade.
‘Prop Effect’: Once activated, you can receive and understand the languages of all Race Players, even those that communicate through physical contact.
‘Prop Introduction’: “The desire to eavesdrop is the deepest desire in the heart of every Race Player.”
That was it.
Those four simple sentences cost him 3 million, but Wang Qi probably didn’t cheat him; getting an A-grade prop for 3 million was quite worth it, even though the prop was mostly useless.
When different Race Players communicate, the game automatically translates their languages into ones they each are familiar with.
For instance, Li Yi and Wang Qi don’t speak the same language.
But during communication, the game translates automatically, so there are no obstacles in their interaction.
So, in most cases, this prop is unnecessary, since there’s a free option available. Who would spend money on it? But in certain specific cases, the game is unable to translate the language of the other Race Players into something familiar.
For example, when a Race Player communicates through physical contact.
Then… naturally, the game can no longer translate.
But if you have this prop, as long as you’re close enough, you can know what information is being passed through touch. It can be very handy in certain situations. It’s just that… Wang Qi didn’t use this prop for good purposes.
The image of Wang Qi unavoidably flashed through his mind.
He had just come across the photo of the Insect Race Queen.
A colossal creature several meters long and tall, with a plump, white belly covered in insect eggs. It was astonishing to think of Wang Qi lowering himself to… that.
No more thoughts.
If he kept thinking about it, last night’s hotpot dinner might make a reappearance. In the future, it’s best to steer clear of Wang Qi. Something about the man wasn’t quite right, indulging in a bloodthirsty profession that he coveted so much was simply a waste in Wang Qi’s hands.
Just as he was activating the Hearing Aid and slipping it into his pocket, he approached the two hatching eggs and heard voices he had never heard before.
‘Hatch quickly, then head to a safe… environment, and absorb nourishment… swiftly.’
‘In three days… construct a portal for the Void Clan… let the Void Clan’s army descend… to devour this delicious world…’
‘This will be… the perfect opportunity for the Void Clan’s feast…’
The voice was intermittent, as if drifting from a great distance.
There were also two weaker voices.
‘As you command, Matriarch.’
‘Consume them!’
‘Begin… the feast!’
“…”
Chen Yi looked towards the two small insects emerging from their shells with a slightly odd expression and suddenly felt that the 3 million Points he’d spent were worth it. Otherwise, he would have never known that the Void Clan planned to construct a portal on their Blue Star capable of transporting a massive army.
With the strength of the Void Clan, if they really came to Blue Star, the players of Blue Star would be as good as dead.
It’s also a coincidence, who could have known that the two stones he casually picked up were the larvae of the Void Clan’s Matriarch?
And at that moment.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit walked over with his hands in his pockets, lifted an eyebrow, gave a grin, and said, “So they’re thinking of invading Blue Star? Are they here for an invasion, or have they come to add years to Yi’s life like the Longevity as the Southern Mountains?”
“With the way the Void Clan players reproduce, one mother to many offspring, Yi could easily finish them off with Annihilate Nine Clans, right?”
“Isn’t this just forcing Yi to shoulder another sin?”
Chen Yi chuckled lightly, clearly not disagreeing. Just as he was about to reply, something suddenly occurred to him, his expression shifted slightly, and his face turned stern as he intently stared at the two larvae breaking out of their shells.
He suddenly remembered something!
He remembered!
Long ago, with a D-grade prop, a Life Cinema Invitation, he had entered a room where he saw his own future.
In that future, an invasion of Blue Star by monstrous creatures resembling insects took place.
Sword Without End covered the rear alone, facing the Insect Race creatures that filled the skies like dark clouds, fighting valiantly before being overwhelmed.
And as the Tuberculosis Rabbit lit his last cigarette, he glanced at the darkening dusk from atop the ruins of a city wall, sighed, and jumped into the sea of Insect Race creatures threatening to surge over the wall.
Jiaye lay dying in a cave, cradled in his arms.
Back then, the end of the film implied that this future was just one possibility among many for him. It wasn’t certain to happen, but at that time, he didn’t understand the game very well. Now that he thought about it again…

chapters.title: Chapter 398: 320: "What's the Wager?"_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: Chapter 320: “What’s the Wager?”_3
The entire level-up game, under what circumstances will it allow a Race to launch a large-scale attack on a Race under Newbie Protection Period?
God Race?
The God Race can’t do it either, they are just chasing a few of them, not daring to slaughter the entire Blue Star players at large, they can’t afford that kind of money.
An invasion led by Logitech Star, Terra Star, and other five stars together?
No.
They are only initiating Race Duel Battles in turn, not a single Race leading an army into the territory of Blue Star, as the rules do not allow it, it is the protection for new players. So under what circumstances would this kind of behavior occur?
...
It’s happening now.
He accidently hooked back the egg of the Void Clan player to Blue Star through Gold Miner, and without his notice, these two larvae quickly hatched and started constructing a teleportation gate, allowing the Void Clan’s army to teleport over, thus putting the entire Blue Star on the brink of extinction.
This is the cause of that future scene.
But now, Tie Chui had noticed this, and various issues arose preventing the completion of the teleportation gate, thus leading to its discovery.
The monsters of the Insect Race he saw in the movie were more like mantises and differed somewhat from the pictures of Void Clan players he had collected, but it’s known that the shape of Void Clan players continually mutates and evolves through devouring.
Having realized this.
He could no longer relax and had to be fully alert and extremely careful!
This was a crisis that, in a certain Timeline, had destroyed Blue Star.
He couldn’t be negligent.
The best course of action would be to immediately kill these two larvae, thus the crisis would be resolved instantly, but… he felt somewhat reluctant to do so, as he would never have such a good opportunity to stack up “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” again.
After being silent for a long while.
He still opened the group chat of Club 33.
“Annihilation Starfield, Chen Yi”: “I have a question for the seniors here. I have a teleportation gate, and once activated, a large number of monsters will emerge from it. I don’t want to open this gate on my own planet for fear of affecting my planet.”
“Is there a place that specializes in this service? I can pay the venue fee.”
To confront the threat on Blue Star?
Don’t even think about it.
“I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi”: “Oh, that’s a small issue. I thought it was something big. It’s just spawning monsters, how serious can it be, it won’t possibly affect your own planet.”
“But if you’re really concerned, you can come to my Starfield. I even have a special place for spawning monsters.”
“You can use it for free, but the problem is you are a new player, can you leave your planet?”
Chen Yi didn’t reply but asked instead, “Is it safe?”
“What are you talking about, am I short on money?”
“Understood.”
Seeing Li Yi’s firm response, Chen Yi nodded to himself. True to his wealthy ways, his swagger was convincing. With Li Yi’s assurance, it should be safe. Spawning Void Race on Li Yi’s turf should be free of future troubles. Then, without any hesitation, he activated Requesting the Mandate of Heaven right away.
“I want to apply to go to I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield.”
Snow Sea Project Team: “…”
It took a while to respond.
“In principle, new players cannot leave their planets under any circumstances.”
“I’ve been out several times already.”
“That was a special case, once for a betting agreement, once for a debut map.”
“This time it’s another bet.”
“What bet?”
“I bet I can capture another level-up game Monument.”
“Wait, let me catch my breath, I’m a bit dizzy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 399: 321: "Who the Hell Treats the Void Clan as Trash Mobs to Grind?!" (8k Word Mega Chapter)
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: Chapter 321: “Who the Hell Treats the Void Clan as Trash Mobs to Grind?!” (8k Word Mega Chapter)
After a long while,
the Snow Sea Project Team finally gave him a response. This was the first time he had activated Requesting the Mandate of Heaven, and it had taken so long for a reply. The Snow Sea Project Team usually provided him with answers quickly.
The effect of the Skill “Requesting the Mandate of Heaven” was to communicate directly with the Snow Sea Project Team.
He only needed to spend Points to get answers to most questions.
It was essentially paid consultation.
“You were lucky to have succeeded with the wager last time. We do not know the specific requirements to complete the Monument; we can only guess. Even if you annihilate the entire Void Clan, it might not trigger the Monument’s prerequisite conditions.”
...
“After all, it’s only the destruction of one Race. It’s a bit unrealistic to expect that to trigger the Monument; it has nothing to do with the strength of the Void Clan.”
“If you fail to seize the Monument and the wager is lost, you will have to pay a significant amount of Points—a very large sum.”
“What can be done for me to go to I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield?”
There was silence on the other end once more, before they finally spoke up after a moment.
“The Snow Sea Project Team can send you there. It’s unrelated to leveling up in the game; it’s a private maneuver by the Snow Sea Project Team. We will bear the cost, and in return, we need something from you.”
“What do you need?”
“A favor. In the future, when we need your help, we hope you can assist us with all your might.”
Chen Yi’s eyebrows slightly furrowed as he pondered for a moment before responding, “Alright, I agree.”
“Give me the specifics on the number of people and the timing; I will grant you access.”
…
Meanwhile,
above Blue Star, in a massive office where the words “Snow Sea Project Team” were embedded on a wall, all the staff stood up at their stations with complicated expressions, looking towards the man in front.
“Sigh!”
After an indeterminable time, Jin Buhuan, the person in charge of the Snow Sea Project Team, who was sitting with his feet crossed on the desk, hands in his pockets, sighed lightly as he looked at the reply on the large screen in front of him and shook his head with a sense of helplessness.
“What are you looking at me for? Go process the application, clock it in.”
“Last time, Chen Yi earned two Monuments, which awarded us with two S-grade complimentary free passes, didn’t it?”
“Let’s use one of those now for Chen Yi.”
“Let him go out first.”
“But…”
At that moment, a staff member couldn’t hold back anymore, stepped forward, stood in front of Jin Buhuan, and whispered with a quivering voice, “But if we keep these two S-grade free passes, when Blue Star elevates to a Threefold planet,”
“We can leave the Project Team’s ranks, and all our clan members become regular players again.”
“We won’t have to live this inhuman existence anymore, and won’t have to pay off that astronomical debt.”
“These are S-grade free passes we’re talking about. Without these, when will we be able to revive our Race? Is exchanging one for a favor from Chen Yi really worth it?”
“Alright, alright.”
Jin Buhuan, feeling somewhat irritable, waved his hand saying, “Of course I know that we want to free ourselves from the debt and revive our Race sooner; I want to revive our Race more than any of you. But have you ever considered, that even if we help Blue Star advance to a Threefold Planet and our Race is revived, with our Race having fallen behind for so long, can we really establish ourselves well in the upgraded game?”
“We can’t!”
“To put it bluntly, it’s possible that we might be revived only to be annihilated again immediately afterward!”
“But if we use this chance with the S-grade pass to gain a favor from Chen Yi, when our Race is revived in the future, with Chen Yi watching over us, we will recover our strength quicker, won’t we?”
“That’s when we’ll truly be revived!”
“And it’s just one S-grade pass being used; there’s still another one, right? One is enough. We’d only have to wait another three or four years. We’ve waited this long already; what’s a few more years?”
“Stop looking so gloomy. Since I’m the person in charge, you’ll listen to me; go process Chen Yi’s approval and don’t keep him waiting anxiously.”
“Did everyone get that?”
The employees exchanged looks, understanding yet still begrudgingly muttered in unison with obvious reluctance.
“Understood.”
S-grade free passes.
These were extremely valuable items, only available to the Project Team when a player serving as the runner-up won a Monument in the game’s upgrade. This illustrated just how precious the pass really was.
How many people in the entire upgrade game could capture a Monument?
Even the Annihilation Starfield hadn’t received this privilege, it was only available to the Project Teams.
And now, this privilege was being used for Chen Yi.
While the forces of players during the Newbie Protection Period were generally not very high, the rules of the Protection Period were exceptionally robust, designed to shield new players better or, to put it another way, to make competition among new players more equitable.
Many of the rules during the Novice Period were top-grade permissions.
For example, the bounty for exterminating a race obtained by Chen Yi in the Annihilation Starfield could not be activated to this day because new players cannot receive any offerings from the outside world.
These rules were strict.
And new players cannot leave their initial Starfield, another rule just as strict, so high that except in special cases, specific special methods must be used.
…
Soon, Chen Yi received the information.
After carefully protecting and packing away the two larvae, he called over Jiaye and the others, announcing preparations for an interstellar journey, ready to take them to see worlds unlike any other.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: 321: "Who the Hell Is Farming the Void Clan as Mobs!!" (8k Word Mega Chapter)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: Chapter 321: “Who the Hell Is Farming the Void Clan as Mobs!!” (8k Word Mega Chapter)_2
“Yay!”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit was naturally excited. Going alone would have been somewhat dull, but the idea of exploring fresh and different things with Yi turned the whole journey suddenly interesting and thrilling.
Sword Without End stood to the side, hands in pockets and smiling as he draped an arm around Tie Chui’s shoulder. For him, this seemed like quite a decent trip, though he wasn’t sure how long he could stay on solid ground.
He had the feeling that much of his time would be spent escorting Jiaye back home.
Jiaye, on the other hand, stood quietly next to Yi, arm around his shoulder, eyes full of anticipation for the trip.
Maybe.
...
Traveling was inherently a dull affair.
Moving from a place you were tired of to another place someone else was tired of, sauntering about—where’s the fun in that?
But if there’s someone by your side, someone you’re willing to share everything with, then perhaps the journey might become interesting after all.
“We leave in ten minutes!”
…
Meanwhile, on I’m Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi reclined on his luxurious daybed, absentmindedly grabbing a refreshment from a nearby tray and bringing it to his lips for a few hearty sips, savoring the sweet drink as it slid down his throat.
He couldn’t help but let out a satisfied sigh of relief!
Then, as if something came to mind, he scrolled through his friends list to find Wang Qi’s chat window.
He sent a message.
“Chen Yi is a novice player. To bypass the rules and trade a prop to him, it must cost you quite a bit, right?”
“Not much.”
The response from the other side was quick and simple.
“You’re that generous?”
Li Yi raised an eyebrow and continued inquiring. Novice players couldn’t acquire props from regular players through gifts or trade, a rule with a high priority.
Chen Yi had entrusted a title with him to sell.
That was no issue.
But the prop Chen Yi wanted him to find to repair a brain illness, he’d already found it. It lay in his inventory, waiting for Chen Yi to leave Novice Planet to start the trade, as he couldn’t possibly hand a prop to a novice player himself.
Even if they had already met in person.
He simply didn’t have the ability.
Although he didn’t know what methods Wang Qi used, no doubt it came at a considerable cost, surely more than the three million Points Chen Yi offered.
“Have I ever been stingy?”
Seeing Wang Qi’s reply, Li Yi shook his head and chuckled before speaking again.
“Since you’re selling favors, are you collecting money? What do you really want, the favor or the money?”
“You’re too purpose-driven. I just think Chen Yi is a brother worth making. If I can help within my capacity, I will. Charging money is for the intrinsic value of the prop. As for delivering the prop, that’s because I think he’s a good person and I want to help him.”
“I never give away props for free. Someone who doesn’t even have enough Points to purchase props doesn’t deserve my second glance. Those who have Points but look for a bargain, I despise them the most. Favors or no favors, it’s too messy; I don’t care about that.”
“Hmm.”
Li Yi raised his eyebrow slightly but didn’t reply further, though he roughly understood Wang Qi’s point of view.
Wang Qi was a simple-minded person.
Like Chen Yi, he belonged to a race with strong individual power, and generally, players from his race were frigid, with reproduction almost a mandatory system. Wang Qi was an exception.
He was extremely desirous.
And utterly fearless. As long as there was a hole, no matter what it was, he dared to take the plunge.
Once, he made a bold move.
He caught a player from Sixfold Planet, a Gold Miner, and had him activate Occupational Effect. When a white teleportation gate appeared, Wang Qi inserted himself into it, supposedly for an inexplicable thrill.
Completely unknowing of what was on the other side, it was a surprise, an exciting uncertainty.
Until the sensation traveled to his brain, he had no clue what he was actually doing.
Wang Qi called it Schrödinger’s Pandora’s Delight.
Afterwards.
The Gold Miner from Sixfold Planet went home to complain, confronting Wang Qi, who stood his ground without backing down. It looked like a fight was imminent, but it was Shang Ruxue who arrived in time to mediate the conflict.
Shang Ruxue was the chieftain of the Mao Rabbit Clan. He couldn’t remember which generation it was at the time.
If it came to blows, Wang Qi would surely have died on the spot.
But the Gold Miner’s family wouldn’t have had it easy either. After all, is there an easy player who has won a Monument?
…
By now, Wang Qi had shifted his gaze away from the chat window, his lips curling without a word.
Li Yi was fine in most respects, except he cared too much about money.
Whenever he treated someone, he needed to clarify exactly how much was spent, just as with the valuation he presented to Chen Yi last time.
Wang Qi always thought such behavior was low.
Why be so explicit? To make your guests feel indebted on the spot?
That wasn’t his style.
Though it was a loss to use an authority to send an A-grade prop, since Chen Yi needed it, it was no big deal to him. He liked the idea of Chen Yi eventually realizing how much he silently contributed, then showing heartfelt gratitude.
“Hehe.”
Thinking of Chen Yi’s future shock upon learning not everyone could trade props with him, followed by the realization of his covert support, Wang Qi couldn’t help but feel a gratifying surge, thrusting his body forward with glee!

chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Chapter 321: “Who the Hell Is Farming the Void Clan as Mobs!!” (8k Word Mega Chapter)_3
“Phew!”
Accompanied by the shaking of his body as it quickly cooled down, Wang Qi let out a long breath, slowly climbed up from the ground in front of him, and pulled up his trousers, taking out a huge brush from his bosom.
On the ground, there was a hole about the size of an arm.
At that moment, some white liquid was still around the hole.
Wang Qi, with a satisfied and refreshed expression, pinched the brush in his hand and wrote a line of words flamboyantly around the hole.
“September 30th, Wang Qi was here.”
...
“This place is the nest of the Pocket-Sized Clan, and this experience was simply perfect.”
“Will visit again next time.”
Only then did he step aside, and his figure suddenly vanished from the spot.
Below the ground lived a Race known as the Pocket-Sized Clan; true to their name, the players of this Race were extremely tiny, probably not even the size of his thumb, residing underground and constructing a world of their own.
And this hole was a ventilation hole opened up by the players of this Race.
He had only recently stumbled upon this Race by chance.
And so.
A new and intriguing idea emerged in his mind.
He had never tried, what it was like to have the experience with an entire Race.
It must be quite novel.
So he went.
The experience was indeed novel.
The moment he entered, all the players of this Race furiously attacked his little brother with various weapons. That tingling sensation, like being electrocuted, got him high, especially since it wrapped around from multiple directions.
Especially since he was separated from these Race Players by the ground, invisible to each other, the feeling of lost information was even more thrilling.
Very nice.
He would come again next time.
As for that sentence, it was an old habit of his; every time he had a novel experience, he would leave a message like that on their bodies or nearby, and his giant brush belonged to an S-grade Prop.
One of its effects was of Absolute Attribute.
Any characters written with this brush could absolutely not be erased or wiped out.
Very useful.
Human life is fleeting, but if you can leave permanent marks within that brief lifespan, then in a way, the length of life could be considered limitless and eternal.
…
Having had his fun, Wang Qi left.
Without leaving a trace behind.
Extremely dashing.
However, the Pocket-Sized Clan living underground were all standing with gloomy and fierce expressions, looking towards their devastated city and trying to suppress the rage in their hearts!
The Pocket-Sized Clan had always yearned for peace and lived without contention!
But just a moment ago!
A gigantic whip had disrupted their peace, that whip… it was bigger than their high-rise buildings!
They felt insulted, deeply insulted!
They could accept annihilation, but they absolutely could not stand such humiliation upon the entire Race!
Revenge, they must have revenge!!!
…
“This is it.”
With a beaming smile, Li Yi played the role of a tour guide and led Chen Yi and the others to a vast expanse, which seemed to be as large as a hundred football fields.
He began somewhat boastfully, “See this field? The entire area is secured with an S-grade Prop as the hub and 12 A-grade Props for assistance, firmly protecting the entire field.”
“To put it bluntly, here, no matter what kind of monster you want to farm, you absolutely don’t have to worry about them escaping.”
“I used to love farming monsters here.”
“But now that I’m getting heavier, I’m too lazy to move.”
After a self-deprecating comment, Li Yi turned curiously towards Chen Yi and tentatively asked, “I’m not sure if I should say this, but how did you guys come out of the Novice Planet?”
He had not expected Chen Yi and the group to really come out.
The last time they came out was all thanks to the premiere map.
What about this time?
Flew out?
Chen Yi, now in the Li Yi Starfield having left Blue Star, simply shook his head, ignoring the question while slightly furrowing his brows in silence.
It was the perfect place to let those two little bugs from the Void Clan activate the portal.
But the problem was…
Given the strength of the Void Clan, his current individual power was just shy of enough to wipe them out single-handedly.
Unless.
He awkwardly turned his head to glance at Jiaye. Seeing the smile that was not quite a smile in Jiaye’s eyes, he coughed a bit before remaining silent.
It had only been yesterday that he had promised not to casually kill Jiaye, and here he was, about to make a move today, which was somewhat excessive.
He was a bit at a loss for words.
At that moment.
Jiaye whispered into his ear, “Okay, but it’s been a long time since you’ve been serious. If I’m to die from your Fatal Strike, I want you to be unrestrained. Since I will be dying either way, I might as well enjoy it.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Yi’s entire body stiffened on the spot, his eyelids twitching wildly.
It had been a long time since he had been intimate with Jiaye.
He had always stopped at just teasing, never going further.
The reason was simple: he had a title called Fatal Strike, whose effect was also straightforward. Any attack could potentially land a critical hit.
And that act would be classified as a critical hit.
Therefore…
After thoroughly studying the expression in Jiaye’s eyes, and seeing no joke there, Chen Yi took a deep breath, suppressing the emotions inside, and remained calm and silent for a moment before finally looking towards Li Yi.
“Thanks.”
“I’m going to stay nearby for a few days. I’ll activate the portal after a few days, which will probably take about three days.”

chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Chapter 321: “Who the Hell Is Farming the Void Clan as Mobs!!” (8k Word Mega Chapter)_4
“Right, just to confirm one more time, the defensive measures for this venue are really solid, right? I heard the monsters from that portal are quite powerful…”
Before he could finish speaking,
Li Yi confidently interrupted, “Open it however you want. If any monster from the portal breaks through this venue, I’ll eat my hat!”
“If this place isn’t safe, then the monsters from your portal might as well dominate Starfield.”
“That’s settled then.”
Chen Yi nodded, took another look at the large open space on the outskirts in front of him, where the bare ground didn’t have a blade of grass, and he could vaguely see a translucent film, like an eggshell, enveloping the entire space.
...
It looked very sturdy.
After chatting a bit more, Li Yi left, leaving Chen Yi and his group alone with full access to the venue.
Without a second word, Chen Yi activated the Frozen Palace and a beach chair, thinking to move in first, and then carefully tossed the two larvae in his arms into the center of the field, protected by the eggshell-like shield.
The two larvae lay still in their own eggshells, motionless as if dead.
But after Chen Yi and the others left, the larvae suddenly revived, cautiously peering around. Seeing no strangers, they began to rapidly devour their eggshells and absorb the nutrients.
After consuming their eggshells completely, the two larvae visibly grew larger.
“They grow up so fast,” Chen Yi couldn’t help but remark. Then he turned to Sword Without End and the others, “Go dig up some grass from around here to feed them; this area is so bare, there seems to be nothing to eat.”
“Let them grow up quickly.”
As long as he could pull this off, he wouldn’t have to kill Jiaye anymore. With the buff of several million Life Value, even if he slowly used one Skill after another, he could still pummel someone to death.
He also wondered if the portal could spawn a million players from the Void Clan.
Hopefully not too few.
After going to such great lengths, it would be disappointing to see only a hundred thousand or so players from the Void Clan.
…
Two days later.
The two originally small worms had become extremely large, each over two meters long and with a thick carapace on their back, resembling ladybugs. The two worms were now head-to-head, colliding with each other constantly.
With each collision,
the surrounding space rippled like reflections in water, slowly quivering.
It was a sign that the space transfer gate was being constructed.
It was coming.
Chen Yi took a deep breath and stood earnestly on the raised platform outside the venue, looking down at the two now fully grown Void larvae inside, anticipating the results of several days of effort.
Now what he had to do was to activate buffs.
Prepare to face the enemy.
He then turned his head to look at Jiaye, whose cheeks were slightly reddened, and with a sudden smile, he scooped her up and headed towards the Frozen Palace behind him.
…
“So many critical hits, and not dead yet?”
“Have you forgotten the title you gave me? It added 1700 to my Life Value. Of course, I can’t die from one hit; you need to critically hit me 17 more times.”
Jiaye murmured in a somewhat dazed manner, clinging tightly to Chen Yi, unaware that her nails were digging into his flesh. She felt light and floaty, with her consciousness extremely blurred.
“Understood.”
Chen Yi gasped for air and nodded heavily, his movements not stopping.
Finally…
After an unknown time,
He exhaled profoundly, his Vitality replenished, and walked out from the room, checking the countdown on his Wife-Killing Buff.
’01:29:47′
Another hour and a half until it ended.
Before the beginning, he had used an A-grade Prop, “Power of Faith”—the Jade Fishing Rod—to extend the buff duration by half an hour.
Meanwhile, in the field below,
a huge portal, about ten meters high and five meters wide, was gradually taking shape in the air, through the constant collision of the two Void larvae’s heads.
It was overall pitch-black.
At its center, the portal rotated like a black nebula, looking extremely captivating.
And just then—
Li Yi walked up from below the platform, standing beside Chen Yi, peering down at the massive portal at the center of the venue with a smiling face, saying cheerfully, “I heard from your men you were here, so I came looking for you.”
“How is it, is the portal ready?”
“I wonder how many rewards you’ll get from grinding monsters this time. After all, if the rewards are too small, it doesn’t seem worth the effort.”
“But you, Yi, you’ve always been cautious in your actions, worrying about monsters from the portal affecting your own planet, so you specifically came here to borrow a venue. It seems a bit too careful, to be honest.”
“After all, you are just a newbie player, and the monsters from the portals you get for grinding aren’t that high-level; there’s basically no chance they could affect the entire planet.”
“But being cautious is always good. How long do you think it’ll take? I’ve already prepared a feast to properly host Yi and your friends.”
While Li Yi was still savoring the moment, about to say more and showcase the hospitality of his station, he suddenly noticed the two creatures constructing the portal in the field and paused, stating subconsciously,
“What kind of monsters are those? They look familiar. I think I’ve seen them in some monster manual.”

chapters.content:
Chapter 403: Chapter 321: “Who the Hell Is Farming the Void Clan as Mobs!!” (8k Word Mega Chapter)_5
Immediately following, Li Yi suddenly saw the portal, like a flowing black cloud, as an insect’s head peeked out. After scanning its surroundings, it jumped out from the portal!
Immediately following.
Densely packed like a tidal wave, insect creatures from the Insect Race began to gush out of the portal at a rate of hundreds per second, swiftly flooding the area.
The scene looked like floodgates being opened!
Li Yi first swallowed hard and muttered blankly, “Why do these insects feel like they’re players from the Void Clan?”
“It doesn’t seem just like.”
...
“That number, those mandibles, that shell, that size…”
“…”
Li Yi’s expression gradually turned from blank to fearful, and his face twisted in terror as he leaped up from the ground, losing all of his usual composure. He turned his head to look at Chen Yi beside him and roared angrily.
“Chen Yi, are you fucking crazy?!”
“What?!!”
“I have no grudges against you, and you fucking activate a Void Clan portal on my turf?!”
“What? I’ve even hosted you so many times, answered your many questions in the group, treated you like a brother, and this is how you repay me?!”
“Chen Yi, oh Chen Yi, you really have a cruel heart!”
“No wonder you said you were worried it would affect your own planet, motherfucker, is this how you screw me over?!”
He then hesitated no further and pulled out a walkie-talkie, roaring furiously.
“All units of Awesome Starfield on alert!!”
“Void Clan invasion, Void Clan invasion!!”
“Highest S-level alert, highest S-level alert!!”
“Armory fully unlocked, all permissions lifted, underground forces be ready to join the frontline at any moment, the Foreign Affairs begin immediate external requests for aid, contact Shang Ruxue first, that woman will definitely come, everyone bring your troops and move quickly to the following coordinates, prepare to suppress the first wave of the Insect Calamity!!”
“We must contain the battlefield to one area, only then do we have a chance. Once the Void Clan players expand the battlefield, their terrifying breeding and devouring growth abilities will instantaneously eradicate us!”
“This war is a fight for life and death, if we fail, everyone in Starfield will be buried in a sea of insects!”
“…”
Seeing Li Yi’s extreme reaction, Chen Yi couldn’t help but touch his nose awkwardly, “It was you who said that it was absolutely fine to farm any monsters here, I thought you could hold it.”
“Who the fuck farms the Void Clan as monsters?!”
“What?”
Without bringing it up, it would have been fine, but once mentioned, Li Yi became even more furiously angry and pointing at Chen Yi’s nose, he yelled, “Besides you, who the fuck would farm the Void Clan as monsters, huh?!”
“You fucking…”
“Enough.”
Initially feeling somewhat guilty, Chen Yi frowned slightly upon seeing Li Yi start to curse again. He looked at the finger pointed at him and said quietly, “Out of respect for the help you’ve given me, I’ve tolerated your insults over and over. If there is a next time, I will have used up all this goodwill.”
“Have I told you to be polite when dealing with me?”
“You…”
Li Yi wanted to say something more, but upon seeing the coldness in Chen Yi’s pupils, he suddenly found himself at a loss for words. The curses that were on his lips were retracted, and after taking a deep breath, he forcefully suppressed his emotions and said word by word.
“Fine, I apologize; I shouldn’t have lost control of my emotions.”
“But Chen Yi, what you’ve done this time isn’t right. I will handle this situation, and you, Chen Yi, will have to compensate me for all the losses incurred this time.”
“No need.”
Chen Yi shook his head and calmly took a step forward, walking in the air towards the ground below.
“In the face of absolute individual strength, everything else is inconsequential. Today, I will take on the Void Clan.”
“You only need to deal with any stragglers that get away.”
“Beyond that, there will be no other losses.”
…

chapters.content:
Chapter 404: Chapter 327: “I’m a bit embarrassed.” (Nearly 8k words mega chapter)
It was virtually instantaneous.
They saw a large group of people in seven or eight airborne floating cars appear before them at the speed of light.
It wasn’t an exaggeration, nor was it rhetoric.
Chen Yi only saw what seemed like several beams of light shooting from the sky, and in the next second, seven or eight airborne floating cars appeared in front of him.
“…”
He stared at the cars, slightly stupefied.
...
These cars… aren’t they a bit too fast?
The speed of his Christmas sleigh had always been a point of pride for him, circling Blue Star in no time, but now it seemed their speed had been completely overshadowed. These cars were practically teleporting.
Were these floating cars under Li Yi’s command?
That’s some impressive responsiveness.
One second Li Yi was shouting orders, the next his subordinates had arrived?
But on closer inspection, each floating car bore a line of text.
“Massive Media Television Station, the Awesome Starfield garrison division.”
People from the television station?
Before Chen Yi could react, he saw a balding man in a T-shirt and shorts, bursting out of one car, his expression filled with urgency and excitement, who rushed over and asked briskly, “Where are they? Where’s the Void Clan?”
Then, spotting the large number of Insect Race monsters in the center of the field—
His eyes lit up with an intense glow!
“Quick, quick, get the cameras on those monsters’ faces, this is fucking huge news!!”
“I’m going to be famous this time!”
“Report back to headquarters immediately, the information is correct, at any cost we must secure an S-class broadcasting room from headquarters, with unlimited streaming. This is definitely huge news!!”
“Void Clan invades Awesome Starfield!”
Soon after that, a bunch of professionally dressed staff carrying cameras and various filming equipment rushed out of the floating cars and quickly set up several shooting locations.
A few cameras were trained directly on Li Yi’s face.
One was mounted on a helicopter, offering an aerial view.
And there were angles from every direction.
In total, there were over a dozen cameras, with a team of behind-the-scenes staff sitting at a freshly set-up operating station, feeding all the camera views into the control desk and then constantly switching between angles inside the live broadcasting room.
In their hands were walkie-talkies, through which they were directing the cameramen for close-ups or wider shots.
It was all very professional.
The excited man in the T-shirt and shorts continued to arrange things, “Have the scriptwriting department at headquarters churn out a press release—attack it from three angles!”
“First angle: Void Clan invades Awesome Starfield, Awesome Starfield faces annihilation, Void Clan ascends to greater fame in the game’s universe!”
“Second angle: Under Li Yi’s leadership, Awesome Starfield triumphs!”
“Third angle: Both sides perish together!”
“Whatever the outcome, send out the draft immediately!”
“Right, and tell the design team to get the posters out quickly!”
In the meantime, the man noticed Chen Yi standing to the side. His eyes widened once again with excitement and urgency, “Quick, quick, the recently popular celebrity Chen Yi is here too, a player who has just earned a Monument in the game, a natural influencer.”
“Where’s the camera operator? Zoom in for a close-up on his face, make it the cover of the live stream.”
“To the scriptwriting team, put out another piece featuring Chen Yi’s presence, let those useless pen-chewers think hard about the details!”
“We’re going to make a fortune this time!”
“Right, Chen Yi, you don’t mind, do you?”
“…”
Chen Yi, expressionless, remained silent for a while before glancing at the increasing number of Void Clan monsters on the field below. He silently pulled out a cigarette, placed it in his mouth, and lit it before exhaling a long breath of smoke.
Through the light blue smoke, he turned to look at Li Yi, whose expression was somewhat gloomy, and hesitated, “Are these your people?”
“They’re fucking not!!!”
Li Yi, struggling to contain his emotions, pointed at the middle-aged man who was still giving orders, and cursed, “Why is it that, no matter what happens, it’s always your broadcasting teams that arrive first?”
“Ah?”
“Chief Li.”
Hearing the accusation, the middle-aged man replied seriously, “Our television station spends an amount equivalent to one-fifth of your starfield’s monthly military budget on vehicles.”
“It’s normal that we are a bit faster, isn’t it?”
“Moreover, we’re a veteran television station from the Fivefold Planet, very professional in this regard.”
“Please don’t doubt our professionalism.”
“Chief Li, I would suggest you focus on the Void Clan menace at hand. As everyone knows, the Void Clan is among the top three most terrifying invaders in the entire game universe.”
“As they can’t afford the exorbitant fees for trans-starfield travel, the formidable Void Clan remains confined within the Void Starfield.”
“It’s said the Void Starfield is almost barren now, and some speculate that if they stay constrained there for another six months, the Void Clan will starve.”
“The only way for the Void Clan to invade other worlds—”
“Is to have the Matriarch’s eggs leave the starfield. The Matriarch’s eggs have the ability to establish trans-dimensional portals, but the problem is that this ability is only present immediately after hatching, and it is lost after seven days.”

Chapter 405: Chapter 327: “I’m almost embarrassed.” (Nearly 8k words in a long chapter)_2
“But newly-hatched Matriarch Bug Eggs are not recognized as players by the expansion game; only those that have hatched and have been alive for more than thirty days from the Void Clan are officially recognized as players and have the qualifications to use the Trans-Starfield Transport.”
“Therefore, this issue has become the biggest problem for the Void Clan.”
“This Race essentially cannot expand outward; they can only commit atrocities within their own Starfield. Although terrifying, they aren’t that terrifying.”
“And now…”
The middle-aged man licked his somewhat dry lips, signalling to his subordinate behind to pass the microphone to Li Yi, “We are a bit curious about how Chief Li managed to bring this Matriarch’s Bug Eggs back from the Void Clan?”
“Could it be that during the exploration of the Void Clan, some eggs accidentally stuck to him and he forgot about them?”
...
“But it takes two Matriarch Bug Eggs to construct a Transport Gate, it can’t possibly be that he picked up two at once, right?”
“…”
Li Yi was already somewhat irritable, and the incessant chatter of the man from the television station by his ear was making him even more irritated, but he couldn’t say anything too offensive, since the man represented Massive TV Station, which is an influential Fivefold Planet.”
Not a Starfield planet like theirs.
Though just a planet and a rank lower than a Starfield, it was not an existence to be trifled with.
It was a Fivefold Planet that he would not want to provoke unless it was absolutely necessary.
Looking towards Chen Yi with a grim tone, he said, “You ask Chen Yi, he’s the one who brought it here, I was unaware.”
The microphone was quickly thrust in front of Chen Yi.
“…”
Chen Yi looked at the microphone in front of him and the middle-aged man’s face filled with expectation, pausing for a moment before he spoke softly, “Would you believe me if I said I accidentally snagged it with the Gold Miner skill?”
“Gold Miner?”
The middle-aged man paused for a moment; he was naturally aware of this profession, only available to players from a Sixfold Planet. Their own planet had been striving to advance to a Sixfold Planet throughout the year.
But…
“A Gold Miner can only snag one item at a time, right?”
“Hmm.”
“But you need two Bug Eggs to construct a Transport Gate, and they must both be from the same Matriarch’s litter.”
“The second time, I snagged another one.”
“Also a Bug Egg?”
“Hmm.”
“And from the same Matriarch?”
“Hmm.”
“Did you know they were Bug Eggs at first?”
“No, I thought they were stones.”
“Then what?”
“Then I saw them hatch, and I consulted Senior Li Yi, who told me they were of the Void Clan.”
“Can you continue?”
“I investigated and found that this Race had a large number of players, just enough for me to farm some rewards, so I decided to use the Bug Eggs to activate the Transport Gate, then kill the Void Clan monsters that came through to gain the rewards.”
“So…”
The middle-aged man glanced around hesitantly, “Why didn’t you activate it on your own planet and instead came to the Awesome Starfield to do it?”
“I was worried about my own planet being destroyed.”
“Uh…”
The middle-aged man was momentarily at a loss for words, giving Chen Yi a peculiar look. It seems you activated it here because you weren’t worried about Chief Li’s Awesome Starfield being destroyed, right?
Chen Yi was quite earnest.
At least his answers were earnest.
And at this time—
A large contingent of Li Yi’s military forces arrived and began to station around the perimeter of the venue. The protective barrier around the venue, fragile as an eggshell, might not be able to stop these creatures from the Void Clan.
But to hold them off for a few hours was still possible.
That time was enough for Li Yi’s forces to build a defense line here, readying for a prolonged trench warfare.
If this situation wasn’t handled properly, it could truly lead to the annihilation of a race.
And no one was joking about that.
Just as the middle-aged man was about to eagerly ask more questions, Chen Yi glanced at the field that now seemed to have millions of Void Clan monsters and flicked his nearly burnt-out cigarette to the side.
Standing at the edge of a high platform, he slowly stepped forward.
His body began to drop rapidly in free fall, and at the same time, the world suddenly darkened as a blinding column of light fell from the sky, engulfing Chen Yi.
The next second—
The Starry Level Title ‘Attention of Millions’ activated!
The Stellar Rank Title ‘Like a Demon’ activated!
The Stellar Rank Title ‘Seems Like A Demon’ activated!
B-grade Prop ‘Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle’!
B-grade Prop ‘Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom’!
B-grade Prop ‘Forever Pure’ activated!
B-grade Prop ‘Seven-Star Badge’ activated!
C-grade Skill ‘Violators Annihilate Nine Clans’ activated!
B-grade Prop ‘Buddha’s Fury’ activated!
B-grade Prop ‘Wildfire’ activated!
A plethora of props in Chen Yi’s backpack were being activated endlessly; under the effect of the Wife-Killing Buff, Chen Yi hardly considered the effect of each prop, activating anything that could be activated.
Activate all at once!
Everything activated!
In the blink of an eye, Chen Yi with full firepower plunged into a pile of monsters as he fell.
The Titles ‘Attention of Millions’ and ‘Like a Demon’ had incredibly twisted effects.
The ‘Like a Demon’ Title had an effect that caused all enemies who directly looked at him to see extremely horrifying images.
‘Attention of Millions’ forced all nearby players to look directly at him.
Anyone who harbored malice towards him in their heart was considered an enemy.
And there, in the Annihilation Starfield, he managed to annihilate billions of players during a live broadcast using these two Titles. He didn’t understand why so many people bore malice towards him, especially since the rule for that month in the Annihilation Starfield happened to be ‘Calm and Cool’.”

chapters.content:
Chapter 406: Chapter 327: “I’m a bit embarrassed.” (Nearly 8k words mega chapter)_3
These coincidences combined to present him with a monument right on the spot.
This time was different.
The rule of the month for Awesome Starfield wasn’t Calm and Cool, and as for how many Starfield players would see this livestream and how many of them would have the Calm and Cool as their rule of the month, he wasn’t sure.
Anyway, those without hostility towards him wouldn’t see anything terrifying.
Nothing would happen.
As for those with hostility, well, they might as well be dead.
...
Dead for nothing.
Innumerable Buddha figures, seated cross-legged on Lotus Platforms with Fire God Gatlings in hand, floated in mid-air and began firing relentlessly at the dense mass of the Insect Race below. The even denser hailstorm of bullets hammered down like hail on a steel plate, resounding with loud ‘bangs’.
It must be said that these Void Clan monsters had strong defenses.
Their carapace on the back could actually block the Buddha’s bullets, and a dozen bullets shot over were unable to break through the defense.
However, the Buddha’s bullets were far more than a mere dozen.
And there wasn’t just one Buddha.
Chen Yi’s methods of attack weren’t limited to just this one either.
In the face of absolute numbers, quality seemed like a joke.
This phrase had once been the motto of the Void Clan, as well as their most prideful aspect.
But now.
The phrase belonged to Chen Yi.
Following that, countless meteors with thick tails smashed down from the sky. They first hit the protective barrier on the field and didn’t destroy it, but as the countless meteors continued to fall without interruption, the protective barrier couldn’t hold on any longer.
Li Yi, who had taken a distant position to watch the battle, twitched at the corners of his mouth when he saw this. He hadn’t expected the Insect Race monsters to be able to touch the barrier before Chen Yi began his assault.
Now it seemed that the barrier was a bigger restraint on Chen Yi.
Without the slightest hesitation, he immediately turned off the protective barrier.
And those countless meteors, under the gaze of numerous players, fell like a grand meteor shower, elegantly and brutally destroying every living creature on the ground.
At the same time.
An untold number of dazzling and crimson Other Shore Flowers abruptly floated in the air, firing wildly in all directions.
On the ground, countless bullets burst from the earth like dragons, shooting straight for the softest part of the Void Clan monsters’ underbellies, the part which wasn’t protected by the carapace on their backs!
Almost instantly.
In less than ten seconds.
The Insect Race monsters that had crawled out from the Void Clan were nearly wiped out!
When the smoke slowly cleared.
There were only the mushy corpses of the Void Clan monsters on the ground and the lonely black teleportation portal nearby. Although Void Clan monsters were still being teleported out, their speed was not slow.
But compared to the corpses of the Void Clan monsters all over the ground, it seemed somewhat insignificant.
“Is that it?”
Chen Yi, somewhat unsatisfied, hovered in the air and scanned the corpses all around. He felt that he hadn’t really done much yet, and they were almost all dead.
Wasn’t it said that the Void Clan’s monsters could take a beating?
Seems like they can’t after all.
But the rewards satisfied him.
He turned off the system announcement; the constant Life Value +1 alerts made him feel as if his personal panel was about to crash. He directly looked at his Life Value increase.
‘Life Value’: 129292.
Nearly 130,000 Life Value!
Awesome!
Chen Yi couldn’t help but grin, his eyes filled greedily and excitedly fixated on the teleportation portal that was still continuously spewing out Void Clan monsters. If it weren’t for the timing, he would very much like to test just how much defensive power 130,000 Life Value would grant him!
Unfortunately, the teleportation portal was too slow!
Couldn’t it be a little faster?
It’s utterly insufficient for killing!
Weren’t the Void Clan’s monsters known for their overwhelming numbers in combat? Why did so few come this time?
…
Meanwhile.
Li Yi, who was watching from a distance, held the walkie-talkie up in the air, a bit bewildered as he looked towards Chen Yi in the distance, unsure what to say. He had been ready to dispatch the army to take over the scene at any moment if Chen Yi couldn’t hold on anymore.
But… what was happening now?
Did Chen Yi finish them all by himself? And in just a dozen seconds?
Was this a slaughterhouse?
He knew Chen Yi was extremely powerful individually, but he had not expected him to be this powerful. This was beyond a pro-level, a Sevenfold Planet player couldn’t possibly possess that kind of strength, right?
And Chen Yi was from a Novice Planet?
And now it even seemed like he was not satisfied with the kill?
But there he was, stunned, while the balding middle-aged man of Massive TV Station, who had been excitedly directing the battle through the walkie-talkie, was far from stunned. With an excited expression, he yelled into the walkie-talkie.
“Get the camera on him now!!”
“Close-up, do you understand close-up?!”
“Tell the copy team to hurry up, Chen Yi demonstrates his might, annihilating hundreds of thousands of Void Clan monsters in a second, saving Awesome Starfield from absolute peril – damn, I could write the press release myself. Let those writers who only know how to write press releases go to hell!”
“A press release not out in half a day, are they just eating their salaries?!”
And at that moment—
The livestream was already being broadcast to countless Starfield players through the Massive TV Station’s feed.
Countless players.
Found out about two things.
The first thing, the monsters of the Void Clan were invading Li Yi’s Awesome Starfield.

Chapter 407: Chapter 327: “I’m a bit embarrassed.” (Nearly 8k words mega chapter)_4
The second thing, Chen Yi was defending against these monsters in Awesome Starfield.
Both of these events were bombshells on their own, and together, they were an explosion on top of an explosion, making countless players who entered the live stream unable to tear themselves away, their eyes glued to the screen.
Last time they streamed, they didn’t see Chen Yi’s individual strength, they had only heard that his individual strength was formidable. But he was sabotaged by the Annihilation Starfield Project Team, and that’s why they chose a map that sealed individual strength for his debut.
It wasn’t until they saw Chen Yi, all by himself, wipe out over a hundred thousand Void Clan monsters in just over a dozen seconds—like a bomber with no cooldown—that they finally realized what “incredibly strong individual strength” meant.
Indeed, it was incredibly strong.
If they had chosen a debut map for Chen Yi that didn’t seal his abilities, who would’ve needed a whole month to clear it?
...
Probably just an hour would have sufficed.
He would’ve simply annihilated the map.
Under such an attack, they felt that destroying a map didn’t seem exaggerated at all; it was a bit too brutal, really. They finally understood how Chen Yi had annihilated the Ten Clans—who could withstand such an attack?
…
At that moment.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was standing on a hillside far from the field, leisurely leaning against the back of the chair with a cigarette, enjoying the spectacle before him. Though it wasn’t his first time seeing Yi in action, it delighted him every time.
He and Tie Chui were both here.
Sword Without End naturally had gone where he needed to be.
Pretty pitiful, that kid.
And just then—
He suddenly heard crisp voices talking nearby.
“What should we do? This Chen Yi’s strength seems excessively strong, should we still make our move?”
“Go ahead. It looks like Li Yi will have to throw a celebration for Chen Yi soon. Do you remember the crucial intelligence our top spy brought back last time? Chen Yi can’t drink alcohol, because if he does, his body instantly stiffens up and he becomes paralyzed, unable to move. Let the people at the celebration prepare chocolate that tastes non-alcoholic but contains alcohol. Once Chen Yi arrives at the celebration, we’ll depart and take action!”
“Okay!”
Then, accompanied by rustling sounds, the voices ceased, evidently leaving the area.
“…”
There sat Tuberculosis Rabbit, puffing on a cigarette and listening to the conversation from behind the bushes nearby, his face expressionless and silent, not sure what to say.
So you’re plotting loudly, huh?
Plotting right by my ear?
And speaking so loudly, as if you’re afraid I wouldn’t hear?
But is your intelligence source a bit off? Since when does Yi become paralyzed after drinking? They had just had drinks with Yi the day before coming to Awesome Starfield.
What kind of top spy is this?
The misinformation is preposterously wrong. And don’t you check your surroundings before conspiring?
This is embarrassing for someone like me who prides himself as Yi’s number one fighter.
Should I pretend I heard nothing, or act as if I did?
Tie Chui, standing beside him, clenched his fists in anger, ready to burst out, but Tuberculosis Rabbit stopped him with a shake of his head, signaling there was no need to bother.
They had their own mission.
No need for unnecessary complications.
Besides, according to their plan, there was virtually no chance of success.
The misinformation was ridiculously off base.
…
The Void Clan invaded Awesome Starfield, Chen Yi stepped forward to confront them.
This news quickly spread across several neighboring Starfields.
It also circulated in the 33 Club chat group.
Wang Qi also entered the live stream room the first chance he got, and upon seeing those familiar Void Clan monsters, he couldn’t help but feel nostalgically sentimental, “I wonder what that Void Queen I’ve been with is up to now.”
Daring to enter Void Starfield, there were very few in the entire level-up game.
Not only entering Void Starfield but also daring to engage with the Void Queen, in the entire level-up game, he was probably the only one!
It was his proudest achievement!
Of course, he hadn’t boasted about it to many people, only in the 33 Club and to Chen Yi, for he was arrogant but also knew that this kind of behavior was too twisted for most people.
After all, he was a Starfield namer.
He was also the one who seized the Monument for Dad Qi Starfield in the level-up game and didn’t want to make such matters widely known.
Speaking of which.
Chen Yi’s talk in the group about planning to grind must be referring to this Void Clan, right?
Chen Yi was truly worthy of his esteem, treating the Void Clan like mobs to grind, truly a ruthless man.
Li Yi must be freaking out now, right?
Thinking of how flustered Li Yi must be at the moment, Wang Qi couldn’t help but feel a bit pleased, but the next second, his expression suddenly stiffened, and with a mix of fear and despair, he screamed.
“Chen Yi!!!”
“You’re ruining my reputation, I’m finished!!!”
“You owe me a reputation!!!”
Inside the live stream room.
Out of that black fluidic portal, a massive Matriarch covered in eggs emerged, shrieking as it burrowed out.
The moment this Matriarch appeared, all the players watching the stream instinctively held their breath, feeling an intense pressure even through the screen, but then they saw something written on the Matriarch’s back carapace.
After making out the words, their faces turned to expressions of disbelief mixed with shock, and they stood there dumbfounded.
For a moment, not a single comment appeared in the live stream room.
Everyone was too stunned to type.
“July 12, Wang Qi was here.”

Chapter 408: Chapter 327: “I’m a bit embarrassed.” (Nearly 8k words mega chapter)_5
“This is the Void Queen, very tight, lots of barbs, quite a marvelous experience.”
“Will come again if the opportunity arises.”
Yet such a line with a strange vibe was written on the carapace of the massive and fierce-looking Void Queen.
?
As the first question mark appeared in the live stream chat.
Countless “?” started to densely populate the chat, and for a time, the only type of message in the entire live stream chat was “?”, looking very consistent and unified.
...
…
Li Yi, who was initially overwhelmed, gradually wore a peculiar expression upon seeing those words written on the Void Queen’s back. He coughed lightly and then stood beside the person in charge at the Massive TV Station, suggesting:
“Actually, you could give the Matriarch a close-up.”
“Need you say it?”
Upon seeing the words on the Void Queen, the middle-aged man excitedly grabbed the walkie-talkie, “Close-up, I want a close-up, tell the live stream team to add an overlay on the screen!”
“Add an info overlay about Wang Qi, just say that Wang Qi is the Former Leader of Qi Daddy Starfield!”
“Damn, there’s too much traffic, it’s hard to decide what to promote, when have we ever had such an abundance of action?”
“Aren’t you, Chief Li, going to send your troops to control the situation?”
“Control what.”
Li Yi spoke somewhat irritably: “Yi is about to finish them all. After Yi is done, we’ll just send someone to clean up the corpses to prevent them from stinking.”
If he had referred to Yi as a courtesy before, now it was truly sincere.
Chen Yi’s individual strength was genuinely impressive, no question about it.
…
The moment the Void Queen appeared in the live stream.
The Qi Daddy Starfield players, who had been actively posting in the chat, suddenly fell silent all at once, staring expressionlessly at the line of text on the back of the Void Queen.
They couldn’t comment anymore.
Comments were under a real-name system.
As soon as they posted anything, people would immediately start asking them:
“Are all the players from Qi Daddy Starfield into this sort of thing?”
How to answer?
They couldn’t.
Before this, they didn’t know that their Former Leader dared to take on the Void Queen – and that’s the Void Queen! On the other hand, doesn’t this also demonstrate their Former Leader’s strength?
Which other player would dare? And who would have the ability?
And some troublemakers who loved chaos started to stir things up already.
‘Hook Eight Starfield, Raccoon Planet, Chen JiLi’: “I’m a player from Annihilation Starfield, I’m here touring Hook Eight Starfield, and I can attest, in our Annihilation Starfield, every player’s coming-of-age ceremony is to go alone to the Void Starfield and ascend the Matriarch.”
‘…’
Messy comments flew across the live stream at breakneck speed.
Everyone’s attention was focused on the lines of text on the back of the Matriarch, but they didn’t notice that the moment the Void Queen came out of the portal, her entire body was prostrate on the ground, and she began to tremble violently.
It seemed everyone had forgotten that the Void Queen had not appeared to amuse, but to slaughter!
Maybe Chen Yi handled it too neatly, making many players forget the terror of the Void Clan.
Only Chen Yi noticed.
After all, the Matriarch was right in front of him, he couldn’t ignore it even if he wanted to.
Just as his eyes slightly narrowed, ready to step forward and take action, he saw hundreds of egg sacs shoot out from underneath the Matriarch and quickly hatch, beginning to absorb nutrients from the corpses of the surrounding Void Monsters, growing at an unobservable rate.
And they began to collide two by two!
Very quickly.
Nearly a dozen protoforms of black luminescent cross-realm portals appeared above the countless monster corpses in the center of the arena.
The speed was so fast that all the players hadn’t even had a chance to react before these protoforms appeared.
Chen Yi was slightly startled by the sight but then couldn’t help but break into a grin the next second.
“How polite.”
“I’m a bit embarrassed now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 409: 323: He is not fighting alone.
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Chapter 323: He is not fighting alone.
The Matriarch appeared and immediately began laying eggs in large quantities.
The Matriarch of the Void Clan had no attack abilities at all.
Indeed, to be exact, the Void Queen herself had no attack abilities; before the leveling game began, the sole duty and function of the Void Queen was reproduction, to breed en masse. The only potentially offensive ability might have been her piercing shriek.
Without any defenses, being screamed at from a close range might even have a chance of rupturing eardrums.
Beyond that, there were no attack abilities.
Her movement was slow, making her effectively a sitting duck.
...
But after the advent of the leveling game, that changed. All members of the Void Clan were designated as players and had the ability to obtain Props and Points. It didn’t matter if they had no abilities of their own; having Props was enough.
Of course.
Most players of the Void Race had low intelligence, and regardless of the level of the Props that fell into their hands, there was only one use for them—swallow them whole, crunch them up in one bite.
Only the Void Queen was a bit smarter and would selectively keep some Props.
The Void Race could be considered a complete matriarchal society, with the Matriarchs holding power and occupying an extremely high ruling position, an extremely extreme and ironclad feudal society.
Before anyone had time to react.
Hundreds of eggs were shot out from beneath the Matriarch like feathers filling the sky, falling on the corpses of Void Monsters nearby, and began rapidly drawing nutrients. With the abundant and sufficient nutrients, they grew to adulthood in the blink of an eye.
That’s the horror of the Void Race.
As long as the nutrients were enough, they could grow from egg to adult in just a few seconds.
It was a terrifying logistical force; as long as the war continued, there would never be a shortage of troops.
And in the instant these hundreds of Void Monsters reached maturity, they began to collide with each other, then suddenly, dozens of dark gleaming Void Portals appeared in the center of the field!
Those dark Void Portals looked extremely mysterious and emanated a terrifying aura.
…
“This is not good.”
A player standing next to Li Yi at this moment frowned and said gravely, “I just searched for some information, and the Void Clan has completely occupied two Starfields, one being their original Starfield.”
“The other is the 67 Starfield.”
“Why the 67 Starfield was invaded remains a mystery to this day. Perhaps those who knew are all dead from that disaster, but some combat information has still been passed down.”
“The script for that battle is almost identical to this one.”
“It started with just one Void Portal, and no one took it seriously. When tens of thousands of the Void Bug Clan burst out, it didn’t cause too much trouble.”
“Just like now, those tens of thousands of Void Bugs were quickly dealt with, but at that moment, a Matriarch crawled out of the Void Portal, just like now. The moment that Matriarch appeared, it began to lay eggs.”
“The eggs laid absorbed nutrients from the heaps of Void Bug corpses and grew to adulthood almost instantly.”
“And then began constructing dozens of Void Portals.”
“What followed was like a nightmare.”
“Millions of Void Bugs poured out of those dozens of Void Portals, seemingly endless, on the 67 Starfield where countless players perished fighting the millions of Void Bugs.”
“The real nightmare began.”
“Nearly fifty Void Portals appeared, and a Matriarch emerged from each, just like the first, landing and immediately starting to lay eggs. Like the first Matriarch, their behavior was identical!”
“The eggs, once again, rapidly grew upon further abundant corpse nutrients, building even more Portals. This time, nearly 2000 Portals were erected, but the 67 Starfield by then had caught on. A massive number of players teleported from all over the Starfield to resist this crisis.”
“But by then, the situation was completely out of control.”
“Before the 67 Starfield had the chance to finish off the endless hordes pouring out of those 2000 Portals, another Matriarch emerged from each of the 2000 portals. The moment they landed, they laid eggs and started building even more portals.”
“This time, nearly 100,000 portals were constructed…”
“After that, the video feed was cut off.”
“The last frame of the video showed the Void Bugs filling the space between heaven and earth, and the countless dark gleaming Void Portals continuously flickering amidst the throngs.
The player who was speaking shook slightly as he saw those dozens of quickly forming dark gleaming Void Portals in the center of the field, “That battle truly established the notoriety of the Void Bug Clan!”
“People only knew that the Void Race had dominated the entire Void Starfield, but it was that battle that made everyone truly feel the deterrence and horror of the Void Race.”
“The sense of despair felt by the 67 Starfield players watching the footage, utterly unable to resist, only awaiting death, so much so that they couldn’t even flee… there was nowhere to escape.”
“Even if someone escaped to another Starfield, when their own race was exterminated, they would still be unable to escape death.”
“And now… this script is being played out on our Awesome Starfield.”
The player speaking was Ke Qiu, the Minister of Commerce from Korma Planet who once offered Chen Yi the Matriarch. Korma Planet had become one of the Fourfold Planets and was also one of the strongest planets in the Awesome Starfield.
