chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Chapter 323: He’s Not Fighting Alone._2
To hold the position of Minister of Trade on the Fourfold Planet, one naturally need not dwell on the social status and power at one’s disposal.
But now, such a figure lacked his usual composure and calm, instead trembling inconspicuously, his forehead slick with cold sweat, and his pale, dry-lipped countenance betrayed extreme weakness.
“Chief Li, let’s evacuate some people and retreat,”
“As long as players from each planet escape, at least we won’t face extermination. There’s still a chance. Any later and all opportunities will be lost.”
Yes.
An escaping player, no matter where they fled, could not avoid the grim fate of being wiped out as a race.
...
However, if enough players escaped—not many, just about 10% from each planet—that would be sufficient. Even if the entire Awesome Starfield were destroyed, at least everyone would still be alive.
The players who died would remain in hell.
Rather than being exterminated, without even the chance to stay in hell.
It must be said, it was a good strategy. If the 67 Starfield had thought of this, perhaps their Starfield would not have been wiped out entirely.
“…”
Li Yi said nothing, just looking towards the rapidly assembling Void Portals not far away with a somewhat ugly expression on his face. He understood these matters better than Minister Ke.
He even knew more.
For instance, the Void Portal could not be destroyed. This portal was not a product of the level-up game, but an innate ability of the Void Clan, part of a completely different energy system, not on the same plane.
This portal was accessible only to players of the Void Clan.
Other players were not permitted to enter.
And any Prop or Skill used against this Void Portal would have no effect; it would not suffer the slightest damage because the portal was not a physical entity. It could be roughly understood as a kind of ethereal existence.
But for the Void Clan, it was a solid existence.
Any players from other Races who entered this Void Portal would simply pass through it and not be transported to the Void Clan.
In the level-up game.
Any race with innate abilities was an incredibly strong prospect, as if by birth all players of the same race had an additional Skill compared to players from other planets—an extremely synergistic and high-level Skill for their race.
The Void Clan was among the best of these.
The only way to destroy a Void Portal was to kill the Void Queen.
But…
At this thought, Li Yi looked towards the groveling Void Worm Emperor at his feet, his expression growing ever darker.
The Void Queen, an existence within the Void Clan that had no offensive capabilities apart from reproduction, possessed tremendous defensive power, naturally equipped with a Skill called Absolute Defense.
Absolute Defense that could last for one minute.
To be precise, it was not Absolute Defense in the sense of the level-up game, but rather the ability to link her life with the land beneath her, so any damage inflicted on her would be transferred to the land.
Only by bombarding the entire surface of the Awesome Starfield could one kill the Void Queen within that one minute.
That was even more of a fantasy.
This skill that the Void Queen came equipped with could only be used three times in her life. After using it the third time, she would retire to the backlines to take on the role of nurturing, no longer serving as the Void Queen.
This was the strict hierarchy within the Void Clan.
And those dozens of Void Portals needed less than a minute to be constructed, without even needing a full minute. Once a minute had passed, even if the Void Queen were killed and her respective Portal destroyed, it would be meaningless.
Because more Void Queens would come out, and more Void Portals would appear.
By then, it would be too late for regrets.
“Sigh!”
At this moment, more and more players with anxious expressions were rushing to present their advice. Li Yi just took a deep breath, his face slightly pale as he closed his eyes, looked up to the sky, his lips tightly shut and trembling slightly without saying a word.
Retreat?
Retreat was impossible!
Yes, by retreating, they could indeed avoid the disaster of being wiped out as a race!
But they would never have the opportunity to return to the Awesome Starfield.
Most players would have to stay in the hell of their own planet until their deaths, while the few that remained would drift among other Starfields for the rest of their lives, unable to return home. The Awesome Starfield, which had been a glorious central hub of trade for several surrounding Starfields…
would wither overnight.
If they retreated, all the efforts Li Yi had put in over the years would go up in smoke.
Over the years, he had consolidated all the planets on the Awesome Starfield, sparing no expense to build an external trade chain, tying everyone’s interests to his ship, uniting people’s hearts with a common purpose.
Just as things were gradually improving, how could he just watch his empire of commerce—the blueprint for which had yet to materialize—be destroyed?
Impossible!
With a determined resolve, Li Yi opened his eyes wide; the usual laziness and nonchalance had vanished from his face, supplanted by a ferocious expression and bloodthirsty gleam in his eyes as he growled, “This is our home. Flee? Where would we flee to?”
“Do you want us to live in exile on other Starfields for the rest of our lives?”
“We wouldn’t even dare to die.”
“The moment any of us who fled died, it would trigger the extermination mechanism, and our brethren clinging to life in hell would die with us.”

Chapter 411: Chapter 323: He’s Not Fighting Alone._3
“Escaping is just a delayed death.”
“There’s no escape.”
“Breaking the heavens apart, the Void Clan is nothing but bugs, just a swarm of fearless, numerous bugs!!!”
“If we flee today,”
“we will live the rest of our lives in regret, wondering if things could have been different had we fought!”
“Whole Starfield has issued a conscription order, all players with A-rank or higher props must fight compulsorily, those with B-rank or higher props must stand by for the second wave, and so on!”
...
By now, Li Yi had too much to consider, as the invasion by the Void Clan was irreversible; once it started, it would not stop.
This was no child’s play.
It wasn’t the time for jokes.
Probably only the people from Massive TV Station weren’t worried at this point, since their planet wasn’t in the Awesome Starfield. When it became impossible to resist, they would naturally retreat, and the race extinction mechanism wouldn’t affect them.
On the contrary, they could make a fortune from the traffic generated by this disaster.
On one hand, he desperately sought help from the 33 Club, and on the other, he began to use his past network of connections. The crisis in the Awesome Starfield was too much for their strength alone; they needed to gather all the force they could.
Meanwhile, a large number of military forces began to assemble around the arena, ready to take the frontline at a moment’s notice.
Everyone understood.
This was a battle for racial survival.
No one retreated, perhaps due to the greater good of the race, or perhaps because of the supervising teams watching over them.
Whatever the reason,
when these people held their weapons and took each step toward the arena, it meant they were one step closer to hell.
…
“Better dead.”
On the outskirts of the arena, a captain of a hundred-man squad received an order from his superior through the walkie-talkie. Spitting on the ground, he cleared his throat gracelessly, stood up, and led his teammates with large strides toward the center of the arena!
At this moment, several dozens of Void Portals had fully formed!
Countless members of the Void Bug Clan poured out of the portals like a tide without end, creating an extremely sinister sight akin to the apocalypse, the sky itself turning gloomy as if sensing the coming of the end.
The sun had already vanished.
“Huh!”
The captain exhaled lightly and then pulled a cigarette from his chest, lighting it up and taking a deep breath before he tilted his head nonchalantly and said, “Might as well die first and watch the battle from hell.”
“Otherwise, bearing the responsibility for this calamity of race extinction on my shoulders feels like too much pressure.”
“I’m just a squad leader whose biggest hobby is visiting the third floor. You can’t expect me to save the world, can you?”
…
At that moment, Chen Yi’s attacks on the incoming Void Bug Clan pouring from the portals didn’t hesitate at all; any bug emerging would be barraged and killed on the spot within a few steps.
He had already tried.
Any of his attacks were ineffective against the Void Portal; it was indestructible.
And the Void Queen crawling on the ground, radiating golden light, seemed invincible, immune to his attacks.
The battlefield was far too chaotic.
Otherwise, Chen Yi might have noticed the abrupt appearance of deep pits on the ground – marks where the Void Queen transferred any damage it received onto the nearby terrain.
He glanced at the horizon, as if seeing someone through the space.
It appeared this was going to be a protracted war.
But he was not fighting alone.
…
“Right.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been watching the battle, pulled out the Claw Knife that he had been charging for a long time from his bosom. Licking his lips with eager anticipation, he murmured, “I really want to try out the power after charging for so long.”
There had never been a chance to use it before.
But today seemed like an opportunity to do so.
However, he was also unsure about Sword Without End’s situation. The outcome of the war was now clear; it all depended on the speed with which Sword Without End completed the mission.
…
“La la la.”
Sword Without End, rather irritated, closed the livestream in front of him. He looked at the NPC rattling on ceaselessly in front of him and called out with a bit of neuroticism.
The situation was clear.
Yi was waiting for him.
He swore that no one in the Annihilation Starfield knew the return map better than he did!

chapters.content:
Chapter 412: Chapter 324: “Let’s go together.
But obviously, this was not the time to ponder such thoughts. Sword Without End sighed softly, shook his head somewhat regrettably as if he was reflecting on the past five years, and then looked toward the several alien race players who were watching him warily, slowly advancing with his sword in hand.
“Come at me all at once.”
…
The war raged fiercely.
For now, the others couldn’t intervene just yet.
The situation was still entirely under Chen Yi’s control.
...
Any monster that emerged from the portal was killed by Chen Yi’s exaggerated range of attacks, hardly able to take a few steps before collapsing to the ground.
Chen Yi’s previously furrowed brows also relaxed.
He had initially thought these void portals were entirely indestructible. If that were the case, and if the Void Queen happened to teleport through and began constructing new portals temporarily.
The number of void portals would skyrocket to an outrageous extent.
A single Void Queen could construct about fifty void portals.
While constructing the void portals, the Void Queen was invincible. The Void Queen could only be killed after the portals were finished, and once the Void Queen was slain, the portals she had built would perish.
This was the information Li Yi had passed on to him.
This gave him a bit more confidence, as he genuinely didn’t want to lose control of the situation. If Li Yi’s Starfield were to suffer a catastrophic disaster because of this, he would feel somewhat remorseful.
And just then—
Nearly a million void monsters had already poured out from these newly constructed fifty-odd void portals, and the golden light emanating from the Void Queen, prostrated on the ground, began to fade slowly.
This meant—
The invincibility effect on the Void Queen was about to disappear.
As long as he could kill this Void Queen, these void portals would collapse instantaneously, averting the impending disaster for Awesome Starfield.
Chen Yi naturally wouldn’t miss this opportunity. While the golden light on the Void Queen hadn’t fully vanished, he concentrated his attacks on her, showering her with various offensive moves like rain, sparing no expense.
“Boom!”
The moment the golden light from the Matriarch faded, it suddenly raised its head and let out a piercing scream.
“Screech!!!”
The sound was incredibly shrill, much like the noise of a knife scraping fiercely against a blackboard, amplified countless times through a loudspeaker, then resounding abruptly at your side in the quiet night.
All the players in the vicinity were involuntarily paralyzed on the spot.
Even the players watching in the live stream stiffened slightly.
The Matriarch had self-destructed.
Using the power of self-destruction, its final scream before death, possessed a strong penetration capability, instantly bursting through all players’ eardrums and piercing directly into the soul. It wouldn’t take lives but would cause temporary loss of consciousness.
Unfortunately, in his fully activated state with all titles and props, Chen Yi was completely immune to this last act of self-destruction from the Matriarch.
He possessed several titles and props that granted immunity to negative effects.
And they were not of a low level.
Such sonic attacks were entirely immune to him, and he didn’t even need to use “Forever Pure” to purify them. Seeing the Void Queen choose to self-destruct, Chen Yi’s brows furrowed slightly in pity.
He was just a moment too slow.
Had he been allowed to kill this Void Queen, the effect of Annihilate Nine Clans would have surely led to the direct and indirect killing of many monsters of the Void Clan.
Although the Annihilate Nine Clans skill could only decimate the lower three clans for the Void Clan, it was sufficient.
Given the Void Clan’s hierarchical structure, beneath the Matriarch were several offspring. Even if just one clan was affected, it still constituted a significant number.
But the Void Queen had self-destructed.
And quite decisively at that.
Looking at the situation, this grinding session seemed to be coming to an end. As the Matriarch perished, the initial portal that had been constructed out of the Matriarch’s bug eggs, including the dozens of portals the Matriarch had personally built, dissolved.
The crisis of the Void Clan’s invasion was thus averted completely.
Though feeling somewhat regretful that he had only gained over a million Life Value, it was enough. Once he left the Newbie Protection Period, he could travel freely between Starfields, and a visit to the Void Starfield would suffice.
He was still within his Novice Period after all.
He faced quite a few restrictions.
Unlike official players, who could traverse freely between Starfields by paying Points, this was almost impossible for him. This venture out was made possible only through a favor and the assistance of the Snow Sea Project Team.
It could be guessed—
The Snow Sea Project Team must have paid quite a price to help him out this time.
Without signing any hedge agreement.
Over a million Life Value was definitely enough to handle many crises he could have faced without relying on the Wife-Killing Buff.
The sound didn’t affect the fully primed Chen Yi, but this sudden self-destruction by the Void Queen made Chen Yi slightly lose his focus. It was during this brief moment of distraction that Chen Yi failed to notice—
At the instant of the Void Queen’s self-destruction,
At least fifty more Void Queens rapidly emerged from the fifty portals at the center of the field.
With astonishing speed.
And as this Void Queen died, the fifty central portals also disappeared. But before the crowd could rejoice, they saw these newly emerged fifty-plus Void Queens beginning to lay eggs incessantly, just as their predecessor had done.

Chapter 413: Chapter 324: “Let’s go together.”_2
The eggs laid by the creatures, nourished by the immense nutrients at the center of the arena, grew instantaneously.
Then, in pairs, they collided frenziedly.
Almost instantly!
Before the surrounding people could even react, the embryonic forms of 2,500 Void Portals appeared at the center of the arena. More than fifty Matriarchs, emitting that familiar golden glow, once again entered an invincible state.
This is the Matriarch of the Void Clan.
They have no ability to attack, no combat capabilities.
...
If they do not have eggs or offspring nearby, they can’t even defeat a normal human with a weapon. However, in the Void Clan’s critical battles, the Void Queen always plays a decisive role.
Remember the story about the man who asked the king for a reward and wanted rice doubled in every square on the chessboard?
By the time they amassed such a vast quantity of rice, the entire kingdom’s wealth couldn’t satisfy the old man’s reward.
This is the charm of exponential growth.
And that was just doubling.
After a few progressions, it reaches an extremely exaggerated number.
For the Void Clan, it’s 50 times!!
Just progressing to the third time, we’ve already reached an almost suffocating number of 2,500 portals!
By the fourth progression, it will be 12,500 portals!
The fifth time, there will be over 600,000 portals!
As for the sixth…it will reach the millions.
When a million Void Portals appear in a single Starfield, and each one disgorges a seemingly endless tide of Void Monsters, these creatures not only fight to the death without fear but also the portals continue to grow at a frantic pace of 50 times.
Under such circumstances.
In the base-upgrading game, nearly 90% of Starfields cannot withstand the invasion of the Void Clan.
Before they have time to react, the Void Clan army has already swept through the entire Starfield.
No wonder, then, that 67 Starfield was declared extinct in an incredibly short period of time, with hardly any audio data transmitted.
And now.
These 2,500 embryonic Void Portals quickly took shape amidst the countless corpses of monsters at the center of the arena. There was no stopping the whole process, as the golden light radiating from the Matriarchs building the portals could deflect any attack.
Chen Yi, at this moment, had no option but to wait patiently.
“…”
Chen Yi hovered in mid-air, his eyes narrowed as he gazed down at the more than fifty Void Queens and the thousands of Void Portals below, gradually coming to a solution for breaking the impasse.
He now understood why that Matriarch had self-destructed earlier. The shrill screech emitted from the self-destruction temporarily deprived all surrounding players of consciousness, giving other Matriarchs time to emerge from the Void Portals before they were destroyed.
As for why these fifty Void Queens didn’t come out immediately after the construction of the Void Portals, preferring to send a horde of cannon fodder to their deaths before emerging during the self-destruction of that Matriarch, he also had an answer in his heart.
These fifty Void Queens needed to have enough nutrients after emerging to allow the eggs they laid to grow quickly.
…
But obviously, now was not the time to ponder this. Sword Without End sighed lightly, somewhat helplessly shaking his head, then looked at the few Alien Race players in front of him watching him warily, and slowly advanced with his sword drawn.
“Come at me all at once,” he said.
…
The war was in full swing.
But at this stage of the conflict, others couldn’t yet intervene.
The situation was still completely under Chen Yi’s control.
Any monster that emerged from the portals was slain by Chen Yi’s exaggerated area attacks, hardly making it a few steps before collapsing.
Chen Yi’s previously furrowed brow began to relax.
He had thought the Void Portals were completely indestructible. If such were the case, if the Void Queens were once again transported through these portals and started constructing new ones.
The number of Void Portals would skyrocket to an extremely exaggerated extent in an instant.
A single Void Queen can construct about fifty or so Void Portals.
During the construction of the Void Portals, the Void Queen is invincible, only becoming vulnerable after the completion of the portals. By killing the Void Queen, the portals built by her would be eradicated.
That was the information given to him by Li Yi.
It gave him a bit more confidence as he really didn’t want to lose control of the situation. If the Starfield owned by Li Yi suffered any catastrophic disaster as a result, a part of him would feel uncomfortable.
And at that moment—
Nearly a million Void Monsters had already surged from the newly built fifty-plus Void Portals. The golden glow on the Void Queen lying on the ground began to slowly dissipate.
This meant.
The invincible effect on this Void Queen was about to disappear.
Killing this Void Queen would instantly collapse these Void Portals, and the impending disaster threatening Awesome Starfield would be averted.
Naturally, Chen Yi wouldn’t miss this opportunity. While the golden light on the Void Queen hadn’t completely faded, he focused his attacks on her. Various means of attack rained down on the Matriarch in front of him like a torrential downpour.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: 326: One of the biggest traits of having a low IQ is being prone to anger.
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Chapter 326: One of the biggest traits of having a low IQ is being prone to anger.
He had sought help from many people.
Only Wang Qi came.
But then—
Before Li Yi could say much more, a young man dressed in a tracksuit, with his hands in his pockets, followed by a group of people, walked over slowly from not far away.
“Li Yi.”
The young man stood in front of Li Yi with a hint of helplessness, “I was woken up by the message you sent in the group chat. You know I suffer from poor sleep, right? Suddenly having to get up and make the trip made me feel like I was being forced to work overtime.”
...
This young man was Beimu Qi of the Awesome Starfield, and, like Wang Qi, a player in the 33 Club chat group.
At this moment, he also arrived at the Awesome Starfield with over 5,000 Centaur to provide support!
You should know that the cost of Starfield Shuttle is not low.
Even for a single player, it starts from at least several hundred thousand Points, let alone tens of thousands of players. They were truly sacrificing their fortunes to offer support.
This battle was lost.
Even if Wang Qi and others could escape without being implicated in a clan-annihilation crisis, the huge amount of Points they’d lose would keep them quiet for a long time. They would not make a sound for a considerable period.
This was real support, backing with real resources.
Soon after, many members of the 33 Club arrived at the Awesome Starfield with their troops. None of them replied to Li Yi’s message, but without exception, almost every member of the Club had shown up.
However, the friends that Li Yi had spent a fortune to maintain were nowhere to be seen.
“Everyone has arrived, huh.”
Wang Qi scanned the surroundings and couldn’t help but smile wryly, “The last time we had a celebration for Yi, I didn’t see everyone turn up in such full force, haha.”
The troops they brought weren’t many, but they were some of the top players from their respective Starfields.
In terms of combat power.
They were far superior to the average player.
Even with 2,500 portals here, killing all the monsters that emerged from these portals posed no difficulty whatsoever.
It’s just the subsequent waves of tens of thousands of portals.
They were somewhat unclear about how to handle that.
Deep down, Wang Qi harbored a sense of helplessness, but he hid it well as he patted Li Yi on the shoulder without saying much more. In fact, he knew something before he arrived: whether or not he showed up, Li Yi could not escape this calamity.
The invasion of the Void Clan was unstoppable.
The only option was to await death.
His arrival would merely delay Li Yi’s demise at best.
And he would also incur a huge loss in Points, without anyone to reimburse him for the travel cost.
But he still came.
He could accept Li Yi’s death, but he couldn’t stand idly by watching him die without having tried anything. He had to at least try, so he wouldn’t be left with any regrets.
He didn’t have many friends.
Just Li Yi.
With his quirks, there were few who truly treated him as a friend; most regarded him as a joke. They wouldn’t dare say it to his face, but he couldn’t do anything about the back talk. Li Yi was the only one who genuinely didn’t disdain him.
Although he was somewhat displeased with Li Yi’s habit of being explicit about the value of gifts, it didn’t mean he disliked the person.
Clearly aware of this, Li Yi, amid deep anguish, forced a faint smile and, looking at the group in front of him, said cheerfully, “Don’t worry, I won’t let you all make this trip in vain.”
“If everything is beyond salvage, decided for good,”
“before it all ends, I will divide all transferable resources equally among you all.”
“I am aware of how high the cost for everyone’s Starfield Shuttle is.”
“Alright, let’s not talk about that now.”
Wang Qi gently patted Li Yi’s shoulder without picking up on the thread of conversation, and just as he was about to say something, he saw a figure shooting across the sky towards them.
The person was Chen Yi.
“Wang Qi?”
Chen Yi paused slightly when he saw Wang Qi, and after a polite greeting, without further delay, he turned to Li Yi, “I have a solution, but it requires cooperation from your people here.”
“The Void Queen’s ability to rapidly construct portals comes entirely from the large number of corpses that allow their larva to quickly absorb nutrients and grow.”
“This gives the Void Clan an endlessly expanding and rapidly growing war capacity.”
“…”
He briefly explained his logic in just a few words and took a slight pause before continuing, “Once the 2,500 portals are fully constructed, I plan to deal with the Void Monsters that emerge from these portals,”
“by surrounding them but not killing them.”
“Cutting off the next wave of nutrients the Void Queen needs to absorb.”
“Here, I need your cooperation. I might not be able to stop all the Void Monsters on my own and will need support from the outside.”
“But remember,”
“try to avoid any casualties. Don’t let our people die, and don’t kill any Void Monsters. We just need to wait—wait for the invincible state of the fifty Void Queens to dissipate, turning these monsters into Rootless Waters, easily eliminated.”
“Do you understand?”
The logic he presented wasn’t complex.
Any person with normal logical thinking could grasp the idea, but Li Yi might find it difficult to calm down and think about the issue at the moment. So it was detailed a bit more for his benefit.
But it was apparent that he had underestimated Li Yi.

Chapter 416: Chapter 326: One of the biggest traits of having a low IQ is being prone to anger._2
“`
Although Li Yi’s complexion was not very good, he still instantly understood Chen Yi’s words. Nearly at once, his originally dull pupils shone brightly, and his pale cheeks flushed with a returning glow as he picked up the walkie-talkie and continuously shouted out orders.
“All units heed my command, fall back, fall back ten thousand meters!!!”
“Encircle the entire area!”
“Do not let any of the Void Monsters escape, but don’t kill any of them either. Take out all your Binding Type Items and Skills, get all the Binding Type Items from the warehouse and throw them at those damn creatures!”
“There’s only one target, and that’s to trap all the Void Monsters that will surge out from the portal later on. Don’t kill a single one!!!”
...
He understood it very well.
According to Chen Yi’s plan, if everything went smoothly, this crisis of extermination would be easily overcome!
What’s the most terrifying aspect of the Void Clan? Individual combat power?
Not at all.
The intelligence of those players from the Void Clan is flawed, monsters that take Props for devouring – how could there be any individual combat strength to speak of? The terror lies in their population, which almost floods the entire universe like a tide.
If they could cut off the tidal attack of the Void Clan.
Then this crisis could be easily weathered.
Moreover, surviving the invasion of the Void Clan would greatly boost the reputation of Awesome Starfield. This would be greatly beneficial to his future business ventures, not to mention, through this crisis, he had come to recognize who were worthy of deepening relationships with.
All benefit and no harm.
Apart from some emotional fluctuations, there was no loss.
Wang Qi and the others, who were listening by the side, also had their eyes light up at these words. According to what Chen Yi said, it really was doable!
As long as they could truly accomplish encircling without killing, then the crisis would indeed be averted!
But, to encircle in the face of countless Void Monsters was even harder than killing!
Yet at least there was a way out.
“There’s not much time left.”
Chen Yi glanced at the soon-to-be-completed Void Portal at the center of the site behind him and looked down at his watch, “The portal will be set up shortly, and in about three minutes, the Protective Aura on the 50 Void Queens will dissipate.”
“We just need to hold out for three minutes.”
“After three minutes, the crisis will be resolved.”
“I’m going to the very center of the site, you others surround it from the outside, and if the people below are too frightened, let them evacuate in advance to prevent them from becoming emotionally unstable and starting to attack the Void Monsters.”
“After three minutes.”
“We meet again.”
With that,
Chen Yi did not pause, turning into a streak of white light and rocketing towards the center of the area. Wang Qi and the others left behind exchanged glances, then took their respective Centaur teams to different directions around the arena, starting to stand guard!
Chen Yi was the first line of defense.
They would be the second line of defense.
After them would be Li Yi’s military forces.
Followed by Awesome Starfield players arriving one after another.
As Li Yi’s commands were continually passed down from his standing position, the military formations outside the area also changed constantly, and the only order everyone received was to blockade the advance of the Void Monsters as much as possible!
But the objective was clear: merely to obstruct, not to kill.
Without killing a single Void Monster, to protect themselves to the greatest extent possible.
Just hold out for three minutes, and everything will be over.
Everything began to grow tense and orderly, though the breath of death still hovered over everyone’s heads, no one’s eyes showed despair. Instead, there was a glimmer of hope, passed down through their superiors.
They knew very clearly.
If they could hold out for just three minutes, then Awesome Starfield would completely overcome this crisis.
And every single person who participated in the battle would receive a hefty reward.
Just three minutes.
Normally, they would not think much of three minutes, not feeling how long it could be, barely starting before it ended. But when those three minutes became the decision point for whether they’d be wiped out or not, it suddenly felt incredibly long.
The next second—
“Boom!”
With a thunderous noise that arose out of nowhere,
2,500 portals were fully established, gradually turning into black light and beginning to rotate slowly, countless Void Monsters pouring out continuously from these 2,500 portals, charging crazily towards Chen Yi at the center of the field!
And the 50 Void Queens were still prostrated on the ground at this time, their bodies radiating golden light, which would not dissipate until after three minutes.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, landed on the ground, and let all the murderous aura dissipate from his body, allowing himself to be surrounded by dense Void Monsters. In an instant, Chen Yi was engulfed by the sea of insects.
Countless Void Monsters piled up into a small mountain atop his head.
But Chen Yi was just silently getting hit, not fighting back. With over a million Life Value, the attacks from these Void Monsters tickled him somewhat, and those that could actually hit him were only about a dozen or so right in front of him; many more simply crowded around to watch the commotion.
He had several taunt Skills.
It’s a pity that those taunt Skills were designed to provoke monsters or bosses; the Void Clan was classified as players, so those taunt Skills had no effect on them.
Even though he lay on the ground, attracting quite a few Void Monsters.
Too many were surging out.
There were still a massive number of Monsters rushing out to the sides.
Although he didn’t know if it would work, Chen Yi still tried to activate the red title he had acquired, “Just this, laughed?”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 417: 326: One of the biggest traits of having a low IQ, is being irritable. _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: Chapter 326: One of the biggest traits of having a low IQ, is being irritable. _3
“Title Name”: Is that all? Laughable!
“Title Level”: Red.
“Title Effect”: You can summon a “Mouthy Void Phantasm” that lasts for thirty minutes, using all kinds of filthy language to mock the players or the boss in front of you. If mocking a boss, then the boss will definitely target you as their first attack objective. After use, it will enter a 24-hour cooldown period.
“Obtaining Method”: Successfully survive for 24 hours when a boss crosses time and space to hunt you down.
He had obtained this title a long time ago and hadn’t used it many times since then.
This time, an opportunity had indeed arisen.
...
If it was aimed at a boss, then the boss would forcibly shift its attack target to him.
But it didn’t have the same effect on players.
At this point, there were no reservations, it was a case of trying anything in a bad situation.
The very next second—
A ten-meter-tall phantom of Chen Yi appeared out of nowhere above a small mountain made up of Void Monsters, and Chen Yi himself was crushed beneath this mountain of creatures. The moment the phantom appeared, it began by spitting contemptuously.
Then, after taking a deep breath, it began to curse at the frenzied Void Monsters scampering all around, one hand on its hip.
“You motherless trash, what the hell are you running around for like headless chickens?”
“I… %￥&￥… &”
“… your mom… &&%screw%&… %so.&&”
An array of extremely filthy and vulgar swear words came pouring out of the phantom’s mouth like a barrage of artillery fire.
Immediately after…
The previously aimlessly rampaging Void Monsters around turned their eyes bloodshot and charged at the phantom, actually attracting quite a bit of the monsters’ aggro!
This was no longer the effect of the title.
It was a physical effect.
At this time, Chen Yi also ran out from underneath the mountain of Void Monsters and started to leisurely jog in circles not far away, dragging the monsters behind him.
Being crushed under these monsters was more bothersome than painful.
But the psychological shadow cast by their beetle-like shells and the numerous limbs on their milky underbellies was significant. He wasn’t in much pain, but he was thoroughly disgusted. He hated bugs. Had he ever mentioned how much he detested bugs?
Above Chen Yi’s head, the Mouthy Phantom hovered less than a meter above the ground in the middle of the field, leading the pack of monsters that were hot on his heels in circles around the field.
He couldn’t count how many monsters were following him.
He also had no idea how many monsters’ aggro he had drawn to himself.
Halfway through his run, he saw Wang Qi approaching him from the opposite direction, also with a throng of Void Monsters in tow, and they exchanged a look.
The absurd thing was…
Wang Qi also had a Mouthy Phantom hovering above him.
At the moment, the phantom was masquerading as Wang Qi, with one hand on its hip while incessantly hurling insults at the monsters following him.
When Wang Qi saw the oncoming Chen Yi and the Mouthy Phantom above him, he also paused, clearly not expecting Chen Yi to possess the same thing. The two Mouthy Phantoms even seemed to freeze for a moment upon sighting each other.
At this time, neither had the opportunity to communicate, they just nodded at each other and each continued to lead their own group of Void Monsters in circles in the middle of the field.
Although the title “Is that all? Laughable!” had no taunting effect on players,
in reality… the physical effect was enough.
Especially for players who did not possess particularly high intelligence.
The biggest trait of someone with limited intelligence is irritability.
Like the furiously angry Void Clan monsters chasing after Chen Yi at the moment.
…

chapters.title: Chapter 418: 327: "When ten thousand people rejoice, it becomes a spectacle; when a hundred million people share in the joy, it becomes history!" (10k-word mega )
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: Chapter 327: “When ten thousand people rejoice, it becomes a spectacle; when a hundred million people share in the joy, it becomes history!” (10k-word mega chapter)
The battle situation was temporarily delayed, and the entire scene was extremely chaotic.
Looking down from the sky, one would see the area below in utter disarray.
Countless players were sprinting forward, howling and whimpering, chased relentlessly by hordes of Void Monsters. As players brushed past each other, many of the following Void Monsters would opportunistically switch their chase targets.
It somewhat resembled the situation in a supermarket where people switch queues midway to a neighboring line.
On the periphery, vast armies were using their bodies to block these Void Monsters, neither killing them nor allowing them to escape.
Void Monsters were fearless in the face of death.
...
So were these armies.
Everyone was clear about one thing, if the plan succeeded, even if they died now, there was still a chance to crawl out of hell. If the plan failed, surviving now would not spare them from the fate of being caught in the extinction crisis.
The whole situation seemed to have been held in check.
If they could just keep it up for another three minutes, everything would crumble without having to attack!
What remained was to completely besiege all the Rootless Waters here.
Without reinforcements, even if a billion Void Monsters came, under the siege of all the Awesome Starfield players, they would only be able to wait slowly for death.
What’s the most important in war? Reinforcements.
The side without reinforcements, no matter how numerous their fighters, will inevitably face extinction, especially in such a cross-realm war. Fighting on someone else’s turf naturally comes with a disadvantage.
The most terrifying aspect of the Void Clan was the seemingly endless, tide-like large army, enough to plunge one into the depths of despair.
Li Yi, watching from a high mountain from a distance, also secretly breathed a sigh of relief upon seeing that everything was gradually being brought under control. He didn’t join the battlefield; his combat strength wasn’t remarkable.
He rarely fought.
Even though he had many S-grade Props.
With his wealth, he owned several S-grade Props that other players found extremely scarce.
But he still seldom fought in person, most of his S-grade Props were defensive in nature.
His presence meant that he didn’t need to buy offensive S-grade Props. By the time he had to personally enter the battlefield, having S-grade offensive Props had already become somewhat meaningless.
Meanwhile, players from the Awesome Starfield continued to flock from all directions. Some who were exploring in other Starfields had already returned home to join the battlefield, using various methods to restrain these Void Monsters.
The players across the entire Starfield, when fully mobilized, represented a formidable force.
Although he was the representative of the Awesome Starfield, he didn’t fully have the right to mobilize all the military forces and players on every planet. However, this ordeal had, in a sense, solidified his position considerably.
…
“This is really odd.”
Wang Qi kept up the pace while spewing shadowy taunts, running neither too fast nor too slow towards the not-too-distant future. If he sped up too much, the bugs wouldn’t be able to catch up to him.
If he really ran at full speed,
those bugs wouldn’t even see his shadow.
Li Yi was different.
Li Yi’s Monument stated that he was the first player to earn a billion Points during the Newbie Protection Period.
His Monument, however, stated that he was the first player to kill 999 Alien Race players.
He was quite inept at management and business, to the point of giving up quickly after trying. But in terms of individual combat strength, he was even slightly stronger than Chen Yi.
At least based on Chen Yi’s currently displayed combat strength.
Chen Yi’s strength lay in his almost unlimited area-of-effect attacks, but in terms of single-target attacks, he didn’t seem particularly powerful.
All his titles, Props, and Skills were almost exclusively designed for single-target attacks.
It’s no exaggeration to say,
So far, he hasn’t encountered a boss that gave him trouble.
It was only when these Void Monsters reached the Awesome Starfield that he seemed somewhat destitute. He went alone to the Void Starfield initially, coming and going as he pleased—who could detain him?
He forced himself upon their Matriarch in the presence of millions of Void Monsters.
Did they even scratch him?
In terms of combat strength alone, it was impossible for him to single-handedly wipe out the Void Starfield, but for life, the Void Starfield couldn’t lay a finger on him—unless… the Void Starfield invaded his Qi Daddy Starfield.
Then he could only wait to die, frustrated.
This was the bug of the Void Clan; all Void Monsters had relatively weak individual combat strength. The Clan couldn’t handle players with extremely strong individual combat abilities. The Clan had no aerial defense and lacked aerial attack capabilities.
As long as one flew in the air, except for a few Void Queens with anti-air Props, most Void Monsters could do nothing but stare blankly.
But you can run, and your clanspeople can’t.
When endless Void Monsters pour into your Starfield and slaughter your clanspeople, no matter how strong you are, you’ll be affected by the extinction mechanism and die resentfully.
I can’t kill you, but I can kill your entire family.
That was the philosophy of the Void Clan.
Disgusting.
But it was also frustrating unless you learned from Yi and sent all your clanspeople to hell.
One of the main reasons he admired Chen Yi was precisely because of Chen Yi’s decision to massacre his own people in the face of the invasion by the Five Clans, facing them alone to avoid extinction.

chapters.content:
Chapter 419: Chapter 327: “When ten thousand people rejoice, it becomes a spectacle; when a hundred million people share in the joy, it becomes history!” (10k-word mega chapter)_2
Subjected to all kinds of humiliation, he still maintained silence.
Until the Race Duel Battle ended.
But this silence was deafening.
The next day.
Chen Yi went alone to Annihilation Starfield and purged the invading Five Clans, single-handedly slaughtering them clean.
One can tolerate unfathomable difficulties, endure unbearable humiliation, and revenge an unsettled enmity the next day.
...
That’s a man.
He didn’t have much of a relationship with Chen Yi, but it was this incident that made him feel that Chen Yi was a real man, and he felt a sense of camaraderie with him. That was also why he paid a price to give Chen Yi a prop that wasn’t worth much at the time.
A person he cared about.
He never cared about such so-called benefits.
The only thing that made him feel strange was that Chen Yi also had this mouth relic shadow; this mouth relic shadow was something he got when a boss chased him through time and space on a certain map.
Speaking of which, that was indeed a memory worth reminiscing.
It was the first time he felt that bosses didn’t necessarily need to be killed; they could be used instead.
Could Chen Yi have done the same?
Probably not.
Chen Yi seemed to be much more proper than him.
Wang Qi, while wildly speculating in his heart, dragged the monsters behind him and scurried all around the middle of the field, running towards the less crowded areas.
…
“Binding Arrow!”
An Awesome Starfield player, who arrived first and received the combat instructions, immediately joined the battlefield. Holding a bow and arrow, as the bowstring was drawn, a blue light arrow slowly emerged in the middle of the bowstring.
His fingers pinching the bowstring slowly let go.
“Swoosh!”
A cold light arrow shot towards the group of Void Monsters.
In an instant, more than a dozen Void Monsters were covered in ice, their bodies stiff and frozen in place. Their carapaces on their backs looked like cobblestones thrown on the park grass, only slightly larger.
The player took a deep breath and, without any pause, furrowed his brows.
Constantly drawing the bow, releasing the arrow.
Drawing the bow, releasing the arrow.
Arrows of light shot continuously, freezing many of the Void Monsters in place.
Starfield players, at the very least from Threefold Planet, step by step advanced from novice players to one book, two books, and finally ascending to players of three books.
On this road, who knew how many twists and turns they had experienced.
Most of the surviving Threefold Planet players mostly had their own prop skill systems.
The so-called system included the survival, combat, defense, control, speed systems, etc., a series of props and skills reminders that they matched well.
Binding type props and skills were almost mandatory for every player.
Aside from some extreme players who completely loved combat or defense, they would forgo control props and skills.
At this moment, a large number of players who had arrived were each using their methods, controlling the Void Monsters visible to their naked eyes.
The situation was developing in a good direction.
“Screech!”
At that moment—
The dozens of giant Insect Race Queens, sprawling in the center of the field, suddenly raised their heads and let out a piercing shriek!
The sound waves spread out swiftly from the center of the field, entering the minds of every Void Monster!
This was not a shriek before self-destruction!
The gold glow signifying invincibility was still present on these Insect Race Queens; it was a shriek to convey orders.
After this shriek.
All the Void Monsters in the middle of the field that were chasing players stopped sprinting abruptly, their bodies freezing in place, and then without any hesitation, they started biting at their comrades!
Almost instantly!
The field, filled with a million head of Void Monsters, started tearing each other apart!
Clearly, the Void Queens also realized what Chen Yi and the others were planning. No casualties meant no quick absorption of nutrients, and without quick absorption, the Void Queens emerging from the next 2,000 portals wouldn’t be able to grow their insect eggs quickly and open new portals.
The few Void Queens with normal intelligence of the Void Clan quickly thought of a countermeasure.
Since Chen Yi and his companions won’t kill the Void Players,
Then let them kill each other.
As long as there are substantial casualties, there will be a large amount of nutrients; and the glory of their Void Clan will once again echo across this vast and vibrant continent!
To their Void Clan, all things can serve as nutrients.
Props, Skill Fragments, leaves, soil, concrete, rocks, even air can be used as nutrients.
But there is one type of nutrient they absorb the fastest and grow the fastest.
That is fresh flesh.
Fresh flesh.
Other nutrients can’t achieve the speed at which an egg of the Matriarch breaks its shell upon landing and matures, growing to the stage where it can activate a portal.
And at this moment, there were less than two minutes left before the invincibility of these Matriarchs would end.
A battlefield that had been under control suddenly plunged into chaos again in an instant.
The situation, which had been under control, was teetering on the brink in the blink of an eye.
Is it hard to kill these Void Monsters?
Hard.
Even harder is not to harm them, just to stop them.
Is stopping them hard?
Hard.
But there’s something even harder, and that is to prevent these Void Monsters from slaughtering each other!
Just in the blink of an eye.
The scent of blood, which had gradually faded with the wind, was almost instantly intense again, filling everyone’s nostrils.

“`
This reminded people once again of the two most important characteristics of Void Monsters.
Their fearlessness of death.
And their absolute obedience and discipline towards the Matriarch.
…
“Isn’t this endless?”
...
Wang Qi, who was originally running and walking his dog, noticed the commotion behind him, and he immediately stopped and frowned as he looked back at those Void Monsters that were previously pursuing him but had now started to slaughter each other. He instantly realized what these Void Monsters meant.
They wanted him to venture alone into the Void Starfield for a month.
If he frowned, he was a grandson.
But to stop these Void Monsters from killing each other now, he really felt helpless.
At this moment, there was no time to think about these things.
He could only roar in anger, and with a heavy punch he hit the ground, sending a terrifying shockwave from beneath him towards the front!
Suddenly—
The ground within hundreds of meters around him violently shook!
Thousands of Void Monsters were stunned by the punch, lying motionless on the ground, obviously unable to wake up for half a day.
Many players involved at this time were also stiffened, like electrocuted, falling rigidly to the ground, beginning their sleep.
This was one of his props.
One punch and all living beings nearby had to be knocked unconscious.
But there was no damage.
Pure control props.
Way better than knockout drugs.
But he didn’t have Chen Yi’s ability to release props indefinitely. With this punch, he’d have to enter a 3-hour cooldown period.
He then looked towards the chaotic battlefield, and with some heartache, took out a small vial of powder from his chest, kissed it lightly, and murmured with a dazed expression: “This is the last of it, man, it was supposed to be for the party at my 70th birthday.”
“This is a prop that can only be obtained with an extremely small chance during the Novice Period.”
“Very rare.”
“Damn it, I’m too good to Li Yi. I knew it wasn’t about creating a persona that would take a knife for his bros… Now to maintain this persona, the cost is indeed too high.”
“Forget it, forget it.”
Wang Qi took a deep breath and first took out a pill and swallowed it to prevent himself from being affected by what was to come.
Only then did he resolutely activate the prop vial of powder in his hand.
The next second—
A giant angel suddenly floated in mid-air, with indifferent eyes and an icy visage, wearing only a few strands of clothing covering the main parts, looking extremely sexy but also imposing under the deterrence, making one dare not harbor any extraneous thoughts.
With the flutter of the three pairs of wings behind it.
A bottle was turned upside down by the giant angel, and countless pink powders drifted down from the sky, covering almost one-fifth of the battlefield.
Nearly a million Void Monsters were engulfed in it.
This pink powder, like a heavy snowfall, softly fell onto the carapaces of the Void Monsters and as well as on many players.
Immediately after, it seemed as though the powder melted and almost instantly penetrated into the bodies of the monsters and players.
All monsters and players affected by the pink powder became instantly rigid in place, and their pupils turned a blood-red color. When they regained consciousness, they saw countless Void Monsters gasping for breath with red eyes, mounting the other Void Monsters beside them and starting to move vigorously!
What was a battlefield filled with blood and brutality, suddenly turned into a scene reminiscent of the animal kingdom.
Like a large-scale breeding display.
Wang Qi lit a cigarette, hands in his pockets, standing at the edge, smiling as he surveyed the spectacular sight around him. Although he had used the prop several times, each use always brought a new sensation.
A different sensation.
What a joke.
He was, after all, a player who had conquered the Monument, a representative person of the Qi Daddy Starfield, right?
Could such a minor thing bother him?
But he also didn’t know if he’d ever have the chance to see such a scene again.
‘Prop Name’: Angel’s Love (Ultimate Edition).
‘Prop Level’: C-level.
‘Prop Effect’: After activating this prop, a desire-representing angel will float in mid-air, sprinkling seeds of desire into people’s hearts. Those affected will have their inner desires infinitely amplified, effective within a 5-meter radius centered on the player.
‘Prop Restrictions’: Only players are affected by this prop, which can be used five times and cannot be recharged by any means.
‘Prop Description’: “Enjoying alone is loneliness, seeking pleasure by twos is indulgence, pleasure among thousands is a spectacle, and pleasure in the billions is history!”
This prop can only be obtained during the Novice Period, and even then, only with a small probability, and it’s not even available on every Novice Planet.
The Novice Planet is the most random of stages.
Most props in the Novice Planet are almost phased out after leaving the Novice Period, but some that can only be acquired during the Novice Period become invaluable afterward.
Especially when arriving at the Threefold Planet, their value can multiply several times over.
The cost of trading between the Threefold and Twofold Planets is enormous.
When a prop with an extremely low chance of being obtained during the Novice Period ends up in the hands of a player from the Threefold Planet, its price can be exceedingly high.

chapters.content:
Chapter 421: Chapter 327: “When ten thousand people rejoice, it becomes a spectacle; when a hundred million people share in the joy, it becomes history!” (10k-word mega chapter)_4
Rarity signifies value.
The range of this prop was originally not extensive, but the reason Chen Yi could affect nearly a million Void Monsters with it was entirely because he had upgraded the prop to its Ultimate Edition.
Upgrading a prop to the Ultimate Edition requires a significant sacrifice.
For example, the Starry Level title “Forever Pure” that Chen Yi gave to Jiaye, besides the effect of Health +1800, had another feature that allowed the upgrade of any defense prop below S rank once, turning it into an Ultimate Edition Prop and raising its level by one.
But the price to pay was the ability to carry only 7 offensive props and the incapability of killing.
When over 1000 players or NPCs are killed, all the buffs of that title will become ineffective, and the negative debuffs will be permanently retained.
...
An Ultimate Prop is just an upgraded version of a prop.
Upgrading an ordinary prop to an Ultimate Prop often greatly strengthens its original effects.
Moreover, the lower the original level of the prop, the more substantial the enhancement of effects will be upon upgrading to an Ultimate Prop.
Wang Qi has upgraded the C-rank prop “Angel’s Love” to the Ultimate Edition.
Not only has the range become vast, but the priority of the prop’s rules has also become extremely high, and both the duration and the heat effect have strengthened.
Upgrading a prop to an Ultimate Prop requires a significant sacrifice.
Even for him, it was no small price to pay.
In principle, spending such a great expense to upgrade such a non-combative prop to an Ultimate Edition would be considered highly wasteful, but he couldn’t resist because he liked it.
Money can’t buy happiness.
He saw it very clearly.
As long as he enjoyed his life, nothing else mattered. If he wished, who could stop him?
Moreover, wasn’t this seemingly useless prop proving very useful at this moment?
…
At this moment, just as Chen Yi paused to look back at those Void Monsters beginning to tear into each other, contemplating what means to use to stop them, he suddenly felt engulfed by a vast cloud of pink powder over the entire battlefield.
The next second—
He felt his breath quicken, and Jiaye’s white, slender legs suddenly appeared in his mind.
Jiaye wasn’t tall.
But she had a great figure, making her legs seem long, and he really liked to lift them onto his shoulders, gently caressing them with force.
Shortly after, he suddenly saw Jiaye not far away, wrapped in a wisp of red cloth, languidly lying on the ground, looking at him with amorous eyes, beckoning with a hook of her finger, lightly licking her red lips with a silent smile.
Almost instantly, he forgot who he was, where he was, and what he was doing.
Suddenly, in the whole world, there was only him and Jiaye, so seductive not far away.
At that moment, he wanted nothing more than to rush over and vent the primal urges surging within him.
But just then—
His Stellar Rank title “Like a Demon” saved him.
In Demonic Body State, he was immune to any form of control, including fainting, dizziness, charm, and so on.
Impervious to any pain.
At the beginning of the battle, he had activated the title “Like a Demon.”
Everything before his eyes vanished in an instant, the former scene rapidly returned, and the restless thoughts in his body also dissipated. Looking again, what he had seen was not Jiaye at all.
It was a Void Monster lying on the ground, exposing its soft belly, arching its backside and wailing in heat.
“…”
Chen Yi’s face showed a trifling change. Fortunately, he had been in Demon Body State throughout the battle. Just now, he had been momentarily lost in illusion, and his continuously active “Forever Pure” had ceased along with the sinking of his consciousness.
Fortunately, he had the Demon Body, otherwise, his consciousness would have truly been affected.
This pink powder could turn a person into a slave to their desires, and its rule priority must be very high. His Demon Body was of Stellar Rank, with extremely high rule priority, yet even so, he was led astray for about a second.
It took a second to regain clarity.
Indeed, it was terrifying.
And now, when he looked again, those Void Monsters that had been tearing into each other had all stopped and begun to reproduce en masse, as though spring had arrived.
In some respects.
It did significantly prevent the Void Monsters from attacking each other.
Only…
Chen Yi glanced at the numerous players moving around him and felt an uncontrollable twitch in the corners of his mouth, a wave of darkness before his eyes, his scalp tingling!
Although he didn’t know the origin of this pink powder,
somehow, his instincts told him it was very likely one of Wang Qi’s props or skills.
After all, that was someone who had even taken on the Void Queen.
Having such a prop seemed quite reasonable.
…
Many players affected by the pink powder around him began to pounce on the nearest person, both eyes bloodshot, entwined and kissing with wild abandon.
If it were a player of the opposite sex nearby, that would be okay.
Whether they were acquaintances or strangers, whether they were both single or not, at least it was the opposite sex, and that was somewhat tolerable.
The problem arose if it was the same sex.
Chen Yi looked impassively at two middle-aged men embracing and kissing amidst a crowd of Void Monsters also affected.
Same sex was also acceptable.
As long as it wasn’t an Alien Race player.
He looked again in the direction of twelve o’clock and saw a player with the head of a bull and a hulking frame, steam coming off his head, pressing a female Alien Race player—half-human, half-horse—onto the grass, panting.

chapters.title: Chapter 422: 327: "When ten thousand people rejoice, it becomes a spectacle; when a hundred million people share in the joy, it becomes history!" (10k-word mega )_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: Chapter 327: “When ten thousand people rejoice, it becomes a spectacle; when a hundred million people share in the joy, it becomes history!” (10k-word mega chapter)_5
It looked extremely bizarre.
The aesthetic differences among the Alien Race players were quite severe, and under normal circumstances, these two players would definitely not see eye to eye.
Just like a woman couldn’t accept kissing a minotaur that she usually regarded as food.
And a man couldn’t accept sending his own brother into a horse’s behind.
But under the influence of the pink powder…
The two embraced each other with great passion.
...
Even if with an Alien Race player, it at least couldn’t be from the Void Clan, right?
Chen Yi’s hands slightly trembled as he took out a cigarette from his pocket, placed it between his lips, and with shaking hands, lit it. He took a deep drag with his eyes closed, finally clearing the image from his mind.
He looked around and saw, at two o’clock.
A player who looked much like their Blue Star players was pinning down a Void Monster, vigorously at it with an excited expression.
The Void Monster was cooperative too, exposing its soft underbelly and wrapping its numerous limbs tightly around the man.
The screams were also intense.
Help… Help me.
He felt this image would forever remain in his mind, unforgettable. The last time he had been so disgusted was before the descend of the game, when he had unwittingly clicked on a movie named “Traps” on a website.
He had watched eagerly, until halfway through, when the film’s heroine whipped out a huge treasure.
He had been so disgusted that he hadn’t eaten for three full days.
“Ahh!!!”
Unable to control himself, Chen Yi roared out loud and stomped on the ground, propelling himself high into the sky, arriving at a part of the battlefield untouched by the pink powder, constantly in the throes of battle overhead.
He activated the title “Attention of Millions”!
Instantly—
The whole sky darkened.
Only a beam of light shone upon him, while all the players below were forced to look up at him!
And since he had activated the Star title “Like a Demon” and was in the Demonic Body State, any player looking at him with hostility in their hearts would witness an extremely horrifying sight!
And those Void Clan players below, not one was without hostility towards him.
In just the blink of an eye,
All the Void Monsters below that had been fighting each other were now prostrating on the ground, uncontrollably shaking, emitting whimpers and diving into a state of extreme fear.
This state of fear was even more pronounced for players with lower spiritual intelligence.
The range of “Attention of Millions” was vast, and any player caught within his gaze was forced to see him.
With just this move,
He controlled almost two-fifths of the battlefield.
After Wang Qi and Chen Yi teamed up in such a way, the already chaotic battlefield was instantly brought under control for the most part, leaving only a small fraction untouched, where the Void Monsters continued to fight each other, and countless players desperately trying to intervene.
These players had never imagined they would fight so hard to break up a fight.
…
The “Like a Demon” state allowed players filled with hostility towards Chen Yi to see the most terrifying scene in their hearts.
The scene that each player found most terrifying varied.
Some Void Monsters saw the scene of their most beloved Matriarch being killed by enemies.
Some saw an extremely powerful enemy angrily slaughtering their people en masse.
A small number of Void Monsters saw Wang Qi mounted on their Matriarch, sneering arrogantly, his voice filled with conceit and hauteur, holding a whip in his hand, continuously lashing at the shell on their Matriarch’s back.
No matter what they saw,
Any affected Void Monster lay on the ground, shivering with fear.
Lower spiritual intelligence meant the feeling of fear was more real and harder to resist.
Unlike Wang Qi’s indiscriminate widespread attack, Chen Yi’s attack was selective, not affecting other players on the battlefield. As long as they didn’t harbor hostility towards him, they wouldn’t see anything terrifying,
Only the darkened sky.
And Chen Yi, standing in the light like a god.
…
“A-choo!”
After sneezing loudly, Wang Qi rubbed his nose and muttered, “Is some brat cursing me behind my back?”
Then, glancing around and seeing those players in a stupor atop the Void Monsters, he instinctively shrank his neck back and mumbled quietly, “I’m doing this for your Awesome Starfield, controlling nearly a million Void Monsters for you.”
“This is a good deed.”
“A bit of a price to pay is acceptable, right?”
“You can’t blame the beast for this, can you? It’s an Ultimate Prop, and this is the last use. I didn’t even want to use it when I went to Beauty Country last time.”
The scene before him made him silently decide.
Never to admit that he activated the Prop, preferring to be an anonymous hero – after all, no one saw it; deny it to death. And with so many players, it should be difficult for them to suspect him.
He didn’t mind a reevaluation of the Void Clan’s gamers;
But he knew.
Most other players would probably find it very hard to accept this.
Let’s hope it doesn’t leave them with psychological scars.
Better than extinction, right?
Isn’t it?
After clearing his throat, Wang Qi slowly vanished into the crowd, leaving the land to those Void Monsters caught up in their passion.
…
Wang Qi’s Prop had affected some,
Chen Yi’s title had also affected some.

chapters.title: Chapter 423: 327: "When ten thousand people rejoice, it becomes a spectacle; when a hundred million people share in the joy, it becomes history!" (10k-word mega )_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 423: Chapter 327: “When ten thousand people rejoice, it becomes a spectacle; when a hundred million people share in the joy, it becomes history!” (10k-word mega chapter)_6
And the most tragic was the intersection of the two.
In the darkness, a Void Monster lay on the ground, exposing its soft underbelly, writhing with a mix of fear and desire, cycling continuously between them. Even as it lay there, its gaze was forcibly fixed on Chen Yi aloft in midair.
The same was true for an Alien Race player who was astride this Void Monster.
Both, the player and the beast, forced to stare up at Chen Yi with faces fraught with fear and desire, affected by the powers of both their props and Title Levels, could only be described as utterly miserable.
The war had ceased.
No more blood was shed.
...
But somehow, the entire scene became even more horrific.
…
Outside the battlefield, the man in charge at the site for “Massive TV Station,” clutching a walkie-talkie, now watched the central battle screen with a complex and eerie expression.
He had imagined countless possibilities.
But he had never envisioned this one. In all his years in the industry, this was a first for him.
He could only be thankful that the game’s live broadcasting room didn’t have any R-18 restrictions, otherwise, the station’s live broadcast would have been cut off instantly. What was all this mess? Could this really be aired?
No, he had to talk to his wife and tell her to keep their daughter from watching the live broadcast.
…
After a long silence, bullet comments in the live broadcast room resumed.
“?”
“??”
“???”
Question marks started to flood the screen once more; perhaps in such moments, only question marks could express their current state of mind.
“I’ve thought of countless ways to stop the Void Monsters from fighting, but I never considered this one.”
“I remember when I first opened this live broadcast, it was to watch a thrilling battle. But somehow, my hand ended up in my pants as I watched.”
“No way, dude, you can get off on this? You’re really harsh on yourself, oh, sorry, I didn’t see your IP. Players from the Qi Daddy Starfield, huh? Suddenly it all makes sense. This is probably a pay-per-view for you guys, right?”
“If the Void Clan gets exterminated in this war, they’ll definitely be the first race to be screwed to death.”
“Bullshit, if there were such a thing, the first would definitely be our Pocket-sized Race. Wang Qi, that beast, doesn’t even see us as human. This vendetta must be avenged!!!”
…
Even with the full firepower from Wang Qi and Chen Yi, roughly two-fifths of the battlefield remained unaffected, where the slaughter continued. In a short while, tens of thousands of Void Monsters were bitten to death in the center of the arena.
Blood began to flow.
The acrid scent filled the chests of every player present.
The golden light on the dozens of Void Queens began to flicker, signaling that their Invincible Time was about to end, and self-destruction was imminent; and a new batch of nearly 2000 Queens was about to emerge from the portal.
At this moment, each Void Monster that perished would soon turn into nutrients.
Leaving behind a crisis and hidden danger.
This was no joke.
The viewers in the live broadcast room might make light of it, but only the players in the center of the field knew the true nature of the war and crisis they faced.
No matter how many players employed various methods to mediate forcefully, it was hard to restrain the Void Monsters bent on seeking death. Many of them, finding it difficult to bite their own kind to death, began to harm themselves.
Killing oneself was much quicker than killing one’s own kind.
The expressions of these players, using their lives to mediate, were close to breaking.
They had never in their lives so desperately tried to persuade someone not to commit suicide, but Wang Qi had no other methods at the moment, and Chen Yi was also unable to extricate himself from controlling that area.
Even after the addition of the thirty thousand elites brought by Wang Qi and the subordinates brought by other members of the 33 Club, the situation on the battlefield was dire; it would have collapsed even quicker otherwise. Despite their strength, stopping the Void Monsters from committing suicide was truly difficult.
Moreover,
It wasn’t just one or two of them.
But millions. They were not so easy to handle.
Even if a million pigs were to commit suicide, you simply couldn’t stop them.
…
“What kind of damned mess is this?”
Among the crowd, Beimu Qi from the Northern Wind Starfield, who was leading his subordinates to fervently prevent the Void Monsters, cursed with a somewhat collapsing expression.
Before he arrived, he had never imagined that the battle would be so extraordinary!
He thought he was coming to kill, not to save!
He thought he would be the demon, not the Buddha.
What the hell is all this!
Never in his life had he worried about a monster committing suicide!
The Monument he seized was “A Thought Travels Thousand Miles,” with the Conditions to Achieve being the first player to clear ten thousand maps.
His advantage was the ability to quickly pass through maps, whether they were story-type, challenge-type, or endless-type. He could always find the hidden plot and secret information of the map, and then quickly pass through it with his own means!
He had to clear more than a dozen maps every day!
If his own Starfield maps were not enough, he would continue to clear maps in other Starfields!
That was his advantage!
In terms of combat power or intelligence, he was not too weak, but rather balanced. Most of his Props served the purpose of map clearing, and he truly did not possess any that could prevent someone from committing suicide.
He didn’t have many control Props.
Especially those for wide area control, he had none. Props like the ones Wang Qi and Chen Yi had for large scale control were extremely rare, and he had not obtained even one so far.
He had once had the chance to obtain a wide area control Prop. It was a reward from a top-level map, but he didn’t choose it. Instead, he selected another reward which allowed him to have one more chance to re-randomize each time he received a map reward.
Now faced with this situation, he was really worried and also felt somewhat embarrassed.
As a player who had also seized a game Monument, Chen Yi and Wang Qi had quickly taken control of a large part of the battlefield, while he was still here with his subordinates trying to brute force the Void Monsters into not biting off their own mouth apparatus to commit suicide.
It was downright ridiculous!
Especially when an employee from Massive Media Television Station managed to accurately find him amidst the constantly self-destructing group of Void Monsters, holding a camera right in his face.
Finally unable to suppress his emotions, Beimu Qi shouted angrily, “What the hell are you filming here, you son of a bitch?”
And it was at that moment—
A woman in a white long dress, her eyes full of pity and wrath for the world, stepped into the air above the battlefield.
“Shang Ruxue?”
Beimu Qi was slightly stunned when he saw the woman.
Atop the woman’s head, there was a Title shimmering with deep blue light and dotted with stars, which seemed to be extremely elegant and out of touch with the mundane world.
“The world is full of fools.”
It was a Gleaming Star Level Title, ranked above the Starry Level and below the Falling Star Level.

chapters.title: Chapter 424: 328: "This is a unique cultural exchange between different races.
chapters.content:
Chapter 424: Chapter 328: “This is a unique cultural exchange between different races.
“Fools, all of them.”
This title was extremely offensive, and once players left the Novice Planet, they could choose whether or not to display their title above their heads.
Almost all players chose to hide their titles, as it would reveal a part of their strength. Anyone intent on digging up information could potentially find out the specific effects of that title.
And Shang Ruxue was one of these exceptions.
This woman hid all her titles, displaying only this one.
A title full of offensive meaning.
...
Beimu Qi was only stunned for a moment before quickly recovering. Although somewhat surprised to see Shang Ruxue here, it seemed quite normal—after all, in the entire game, any Starfield that had a large-scale war.
As long as Shang Ruxue could afford the cost of the Starfield Shuttle, she would go there.
And start mediating the conflict.
In terms of mediating, there were few in the entire game who dared claim they surpassed Shang Ruxue.
Shang Ruxue, floating in midair in her long dress, with a trace of dullness flashing in her narrow eyes, let out a sigh. Her voice carried sadness and frustration, as she gently waved her sleeve.
Instantly—
Stars fell from the sky like a galaxy crashing to the ground, enveloping all the players below.
In an instant.
Whether it was players from the Void Clan, the Awesome Starfield, or those he had brought.
Their injuries all healed at an extremely fast rate.
Those Void Monsters that had just committed suicide but had not yet fully expired, were now instantly revitalized, as lively as ever. The revived Void Monsters didn’t hesitate at all and immediately committed suicide again, but the speed of their suicides simply could not keep up with the healing.
This was Shang Ruxue’s exclusive S-class Ultimate Skill!
An extremely large-scale group healing skill!
S-class Ultimate Skill!
The rarity of a skill was inherently higher than that of props of the same level.
Not to mention such a large-scale group healing skill, its rarity far exceeded that of wide-range control skills.
In this battlefield, which Wang Qi and Chen Yi hadn’t had time to manage, under Shang Ruxue’s skill, everyone’s injuries healed quickly, and no one was wounded.
An S-class large-scale group healing skill was already quite extraordinary, let alone an Ultimate Skill. Under Shang Ruxue’s starry rain, death became an extremely luxurious act.
Want to die?
Very difficult.
The already precarious battlefield was completely controlled in the moment Shang Ruxue joined in. The corners left untouched by the conflict were quickly brought under control as numerous players physically suppressed the Void Monsters.
And aggressively stuffed their fists into the mouthparts of the Void Monsters to prevent them from committing suicide.
The entire battlefield was then fully under control.
And now—
The golden glow on those fifty Matriarchs finally flickered out, and perhaps realizing that this invasion might fail, these fifty Void Queens let out a mournful howl. In the moment the golden light dissipated, without waiting for Chen Yi to make a move, they initiated self-destruction!
The majority of players, upon hearing that sorrowful cry of the Void Queens before they exploded, stiffened on the spot.
The Void Queens’ screams before their self-destruction blast penetrated the players’ minds, causing a brief loss of control over their bodies.
And at the same time—
The 2,000 Void Portals, which were still spewing out Void Monsters, shuddered slightly. Upon the death of the fifty Matriarchs, they began to dim slowly. With the Matriarchs’ death, the portals they had created would also fade away.
But before they dimmed completely!
A full 2,000 Matriarchs roared as they emerged from the portals in waves, like relay racers passing the baton. In some ways, the players of this race were indeed very united.
Clear division of labor.
Everyone had their responsibilities and never cared about their individual lives.
The interests of the collective far outweighed those of the individual.
For the collective, individual lives were not worth much.
The moment the 2,000 Void Matriarchs emerged from the portals, they didn’t hesitate to lay eggs en masse, shooting countless eggs from the Matriarchs’ bodies in all directions!
Rapidly absorbing nutrients from the center of the arena!
Attempting to mature instantaneously and begin creating new Void Portals, recreating the scene from five minutes earlier!
Only this time… things didn’t go as they expected.
There were plenty of corpses and flesh in the center of the arena, but such an amount of flesh was far from enough to support the egg development of those 2,000 Matriarchs, like the eggs of the few dozen Matriarchs earlier that had immediately hatched to adulthood.
Of course, while the nutrients weren’t abundant, they could still significantly shorten the time to maturity, to at most one hour!
Much faster than the pace at which Chen Yi and the others initially used weeds to feed the pair of Matriarch larvae.
But now was different from then. One hour?
Chen Yi was not going to wait quietly here for those eggs to spend an hour maturing!
As long as they killed all the newly hatched Matriarch Bug Eggs, they could prevent new portals from appearing!
But they must kill them before they matured!
Once these Matriarch larvae matured and began to collide with one another to create Void Portals, they would share an invincibility effect with their Matriarchs, making it impossible to cause any damage to these Matriarch Bug Eggs, nor to prevent the emergence of new Void Portals.
When those fifty Matriarchs laid their eggs, Chen Yi had thought about killing the larvae, but they grew too quickly – so fast that before any of the players could react, those eggs had become adults.
