chapters.content:
Chapter 425: Chapter 328: “This is a unique cultural exchange between different races.”_2
After that, he could only watch helplessly as those insect eggs constructed the transport portal while in an invulnerable state.
Such a thing was almost unimaginable for the Blue Star Race.
Suppose, just suppose, that a baby required a total of 10,000 kilograms of food to grow to 18 years old.
But if, upon being born, the baby was instantly stuffed with 10,000 kilograms of food, could it become an adult on the spot?
This would be completely nonsensical.
Yet with the Void Clan, this was possible. Perhaps for the Void Clan, this was simply following some law of energy conservation, only that it disregarded the variable of time.
...
Now was different.
At this point, the insect eggs laid by the Void Queen were still rapidly absorbing nutrients to grow, but the speed was controllable.
Chen Yi would certainly not pass up this opportunity.
Or rather, none of the players present would forego this chance.
In an instant—
Numerous players, snarling and swinging their weapons, rushed towards those young larvae of the Matriarch that had fallen to the ground and began rapidly drawing nutrients. They had been waiting for this moment for too long, and although only three minutes had passed, those three minutes were the most frustrating of their lives!!
Unable to fight back, they could only take hits!
As oppressed as oppressed could be!
Now they finally could let loose!
Almost in the blink of an eye, these defenseless larvae were slaughtered by the swarming players. And with the death of these young larvae of the Matriarch, the 2000 empty-bellied Matriarchs could be heard wailing in anger and sorrow.
Not enough flesh!
Not enough nutrients!
Their larvae couldn’t grow quickly; they couldn’t construct new Void Portals!
Why, why, with nearly ten million Void Monsters transported out, could there be a situation with insufficient nutrients?
But soon the Matriarchs noticed that there were hardly any corpses around; the nearly ten million Void Monsters that had been transported out appeared unharmed and orderly on this open ground.
Some were breeding.
Some were crawling.
Some were attempting suicide under the starlight.
Everyone seemed busy, but there was no death.
The plan had gone awry.
The invasion had failed.
The greatest advantage of the Void Clan was numbers, an extreme, exaggerated number of them; without the human wave tactic and the continuous, increasing reinforcements, the Void Clan might just be a Race with slightly more NPCs, the kind used for grinding.
“All players, retreat!”
“All players, retreat!”
“The battlefield will be cleared in ten minutes.”
Suspended midair, Chen Yi spoke slowly, his voice reaching the ears of all the players present; there was a hint of relief in his eyes, and he finally let out a sigh of relief.
It was all over now.
The invasion of the Void Clan had been completely resolved.
Thank goodness.
Otherwise, he might have brought a great disaster to Li Yi.
With the elimination of these larvae of the Matriarch, the Matriarchs themselves had no more eggs to lay; they had lost the capability to build new Void Portals. What followed would be his unmatched stage of reaping the harvest.
The nearly ten million monsters below remained perfectly intact.
He had not forgotten his initial purpose.
With nearly ten million Void Monsters here, he could gain nearly ten million Life Values; he had to hurry and evacuate the players so that the monsters wouldn’t be stolen!
Upon hearing Chen Yi’s voice in their ears,
Revered by the numerous levitating Buddhas seated cross-legged on the Lotus Platforms, wielding Fire God Gatlings, and amidst the restless and descending flurry of flowers from the other shore, almost all players didn’t hesitate to leave the battlefield immediately.
There was no better time to flee than now.
No one was confident they could survive an attack from Chen Yi.
While hidden among the crowd, Wang Qi let out a slight cough in mild embarrassment and quietly issued an order, and the thirty thousand subordinates he had brought quickly converged at his location,
Escorting away those Alien Race players who had still not recovered from their lust.
Inseparable.
Too tightly fused together.
They could only lift two at a time and carry them away in each other’s arms.
For a moment, the scene was incredibly bizarre, as these people had lost their reason and ignored the impending barrage of attacks from above.
As for those players laying on the Void Monsters, they were forcefully pulled out.
All in all, everything was proceeding in an orderly and tightly controlled manner.
Soon.
The majority of the players had retreated from the center of the battlefield, and as for a small portion who were seriously injured, they didn’t plan to run. Their injuries were too severe, and it would be too wasteful to use healing Props; after all, there were no subsequent battles, so it was better to just die and go to hell.
To die and go to hell was to recover from injuries.
It was essentially free treatment.
Although it would increase the Map Difficulty of the next return, the players always weighed their options between increasing difficulty and wasting a healing Prop.
In a situation where the injuries were severe and their own Map Difficulty wasn’t very high, it was more cost-effective to die once.
Chen Yi naturally had no objections to this; he could gain +1 Life Value.
Ten minutes passed quickly.
Chen Yi, floating midair, raised his eyebrows slightly and was ready to start reaping his harvest, when he suddenly saw a woman in a white dress appear before him, with a title “The World is Full of Fools” hovering above her head.
Frankly, it was a bit abrupt.
He rarely saw anyone with a title displayed over their head anymore.
Only players who were new like him were forced to display titles.
“Is something the matter?”
Although Chen Yi had no idea where this woman came from, he had seen her area-of-effect healing Skill and was frankly quite intrigued; the Skill was very powerful, and it would be nice to have one like it.

chapters.content:
Chapter 426: Chapter 328: “This is a unique cultural exchange between different races.”_3
To have such a powerful Skill or Prop, this woman must be something else.
Moreover, this woman had just helped him a great deal, so he wasn’t stingy with giving a smile full of goodwill.
However, this smile seemed to take on a different flavor in Shang Ruxue’s eyes.
The calm-faced woman before him, Shang Ruxue, gazed at Chen Yi and said softly, “Before you’re about to kill nearly ten million players of the Alien Race, you can still afford a smile. Is it because your conscience has been obliterated?”
“Or is it that you actually enjoy the thrill of holding other people’s lives in your hands?”
“Or perhaps you think that the feeling of others’ reverence towards you makes you feel exhilarated?”
...
“…”
The smile on Chen Yi’s face slowly faded as he stared blankly at the woman before him. Suddenly, he guessed the woman’s name: Shang Ruxue.
This must be the person that Li Yi was talking about.
The leader of the Mao Rabbit Clan.
A Race born with a yearning for peace, always putting out fires everywhere.
Before he could speak,
Shang Ruxue continued to stare into Chen Yi’s eyes, her voice full of sarcasm and mockery as she whispered, “The lives of nearly ten million players might be considered many by others, but to you, they’re probably just a post-meal dessert.”
“After all, you’ve killed hundreds of billions of players, haven’t you?”
“You surely think that the title of ‘Exterminator of Entire Races’ that sits atop your head is quite impressive, right?”
“But do you know how many families stand behind these ten million players? Do you know how many families will fall into despair because of this?”
“…”
Chen Yi found himself momentarily at a loss for words, and after a brief pause, he replied calmly, “Are you being an idiot? They are Void Monsters; they don’t even have sentience. What kind of families could they possibly have?”
“Do you mean to say that I should spare these nearly ten million Void Monsters?”
“Sure, no problem.”
He nodded earnestly and, pointing down at the 2,000 Void Matriarchs below, continued, “Then guess what would happen when these Void Matriarchs breed their eggs again, and countless Void Portals appear on the Starfield Continent of the Awesome Starfield.”
“Guess what will happen?”
“All the players on every planet in the Awesome Starfield will be wiped out.”
“Are you saying that because of these nearly ten million Void Monsters, we should abandon all the players in the Awesome Starfield?”
“Is this what you call goodwill?”
…
“That doesn’t sound quite right.”
Wang Qi, who had already withdrawn from the battlefield, stood next to Li Yi, touched his nose, and said with a headache as he looked at Chen Yi and Shang Ruxue in the sky above the battlefield, “Why did this woman show up? Why is it always her causing trouble?”
“Chen Yi wouldn’t get so angry that he ends up killing Shang Ruxue, would he?”
“That would be a big problem.”
“Countless people who owe Shang Ruxue a great debt would certainly rush over to kill Chen Yi.”
Li Yi too rubbed his temples with a headache and didn’t speak. He didn’t need to get close to hear what Shang Ruxue was saying; she was definitely urging Chen Yi not to kill the Void Monsters below.
But how could that be possible?
Isn’t that nonsense?
There’s no way they could come to an agreement, so how is this supposed to end?
Force wouldn’t work, and who could be more persuasive than Shang Ruxue?
…
“The trolley problem, huh?”
Shang Ruxue, calm as ever, continued to stare at Chen Yi without any change in her demeanor despite his words, “I’ve heard about this dilemma a long time ago. If forced to choose between a few casualties and many, I would choose the third option.”
“Neither side suffers casualties.”
“The players of the Void Clan shouldn’t die, they have their own lives; you are the one who brought them to the Awesome Starfield.”
“The players of the Awesome Starfield shouldn’t die either, they also have their own lives; they shouldn’t have to sacrifice themselves because of you.”
“…”
“So you’re saying that I should die?”
“You shouldn’t die either, the dead are gone, and those alive should try even harder to live.”
“Then who should die?”
“Nobody should die; people should not kill each other, everyone should live in peace, everyone should have their own life.”
“Fine, fine, fine.”
Chen Yi gave a serious round of applause as he spoke, “I admire your philosophy. Now tell me a solution; what should we do with these nearly ten million Void Monsters below? Your turn to tell me.”
“Send them home.”
A glimmer of pity flashed in Shang Ruxue’s eyes as she looked down at the Void Monsters, “Have the Void Queens brew the eggs again, rebuild the Portals, and then let all of them go through the Portals back to the Void Starfield.”
“Let them return to their true home.”
“Both sides cease to disturb each other.”
“Killing does not solve any problems; only peace is the best ending to a story.”
“…”
Chen Yi, looking confused, glanced at the equally bewildered Void Matriarchs down below, and after a long while, looked back at the woman before him, suddenly feeling that it was very difficult to respect the cultural differences between Races.
When you said that, were you serious?
Do you really think that when the Void Portals open, these Void Monsters would go home?
They like their true home?
What a joke.
The Void Starfield had been gnawed to the surface; who would want to stay there?
He had heard from Li Yi before that this woman was stubborn, but he had not expected her to be so unyielding. What was most important was that the pity in this woman’s eyes didn’t seem fake. So, she actually felt pity for these Void Monsters?
“Good idea.”
Chen Yi nodded, then began to silently contemplate how to discreetly send the woman before him away.

Chapter 427: Chapter 328: “This is a unique cultural exchange between different races.”_4
Killing him was definitely not an option.
Just as Li Yi had said to him, too many had been indebted to this woman’s great kindness, even the players from Sixfold Planet had benefited from her, and he didn’t really want to be targeted by the players of Sixfold Planet, it was better to keep a low profile.
Yet those nearly ten million Life Value points were truly hard for him to give up.
Afterward, he cast a glance at Wang Qi and Li Yi in the distance, who were patiently waiting for the outcome, and after a long silence, he suddenly cracked a smile.
“You make a good point,” he said.
“Killing indeed solves nothing, and I don’t really want to kill those Void Players either, so let’s do it your way. I’m heading home first.”
...
Having said that,
Chen Yi didn’t linger, he turned around and shot towards Li Yi.
Leaving Shang Ruxue alone in the original spot.
Seeing that Chen Yi had left without a moment’s delay, a flicker of surprise passed through Shang Ruxue’s eyes as she slowly returned the S-level defense Prop she had been clutching in her arms back into her backpack. She hadn’t expected Chen Yi would actually just leave like that.
She had thought it would take a lot of words to persuade Chen Yi.
Now it seemed, Chen Yi wasn’t entirely set on evil; there was still hope for salvation.
It might be the existence of the game upgrade that had changed Chen Yi into this; before the upgrade, maybe Chen Yi was also a youth who aspired to do good.
…
On seeing Chen Yi’s figure, Li Yi quickly stepped forward to greet him, hugging Chen Yi with a radiant smile, he couldn’t help but express his gratitude, “I really want to thank you this time. If it hadn’t been for you, Awesome Starfield might genuinely have faced catastrophe.”
“It’s been tough.”
“Don’t worry, I, Li Yi, will remember this kindness.”
“You can ask around. I, Li Yi, treat my own people well.”
“No worries,”
Chen Yi, feeling slightly embarrassed, touched his nose, “If it weren’t for the activation of the Void Portal here, this mess wouldn’t have happened. I can only say I’ll do my best to make amends. It’s not about kindness.”
Li Yi gave a wry smile of helplessness, “It’s still my fault, I was too confident at the start, I overestimated the capacity of my area, and I misled brother Chen Yi.”
“The blame is on me, too. I should have stated from the beginning that it was the portal of the Void Clan.”
“Indeed, the blame is on you. If you had said this earlier, I would never have agreed to activate it,” Li Yi countered.
As Chen Yi and Li Yi were persistently apologizing to each other, Wang Qi, standing to the side, couldn’t help but join in, hands in his pockets and a cigarette dangling from his lips, he looked at Chen Yi with great curiosity, “Just tell us, how did you persuade Shang Ruxue?”
“Shang Ruxue must have asked you not to kill those Void Monsters, right?”
“I’ve never seen anyone who could persuade Shang Ruxue.”
Anyone who had ever interacted with Shang Ruxue was nearly always infuriated, with a face flushed red, and since Chen Yi came over so nonchalantly, he must have persuaded Shang Ruxue, making him the first person he knew who had managed to do so.
He was quite curious about the specifics.
When they saw Shang Ruxue just a moment ago, he and Li Yi had immediately kept their distance.
Shang Ruxue was definitely not a bad person.
But she was absolutely a headache-inducing individual, and they really didn’t want to deal with her, leaving Chen Yi to enjoy that fortune instead.
“Is that even a question?”
Li Yi shook his plump belly and said with a grin, “Brother Chen Yi must have used the lives of countless Awesome Starfield players to convince Shang Ruxue. After all, the life of nearly ten million monsters and the lives of countless Awesome Starfield players are easy to weigh, which is more important, right?”
“Don’t you think, brother Chen Yi?”
“But even so, it’s already impressive. You’re the first I’ve seen to convince Shang Ruxue.”
“Convince?”
Chen Yi, leaning on his cane with one hand and stretching his muscles, casually lit up a cigarette and took a draw before saying nonchalantly, “I didn’t convince her. She convinced me. She told me not to kill these Void Players.”
“Wait for the 2000 Void Queen to rebrew their eggs and reopen the Void Portal; then have these Void Monsters return the same way to Void Starfield, safely back home.”
“From then on, both sides would be well, without disturbing each other.”
“I thought it made sense, so she convinced me.”
“What the heck?!”
Li Yi’s body trembled uncontrollably as he pointed with fear and disbelief at Shang Ruxue not far away, his voice quivering, “She… Did she really say that? She’s waiting for 2000 Void Queens to brew more insect eggs?”
“Yep.”
Chen Yi nodded casually, “Word for word; that’s what she said. She’s quite a kind-hearted girl, I actually like her.”
Wang Qi, standing beside them, also had his mouth twitch from the remark; it was a type of thought process that, apart from Shang Ruxue, hardly a few could come up with.
“Crazy, just totally crazy!!!”
Li Yi, who had been in a good mood up to that point, suddenly couldn’t sit still any longer. After pacing a few circles on the spot, he couldn’t contain his expression anymore and fiercely stomped on the ground, shooting towards Shang Ruxue in mid-air!
What kind of joke was this, to actually follow what Shang Ruxue had said!
Everyone in Awesome Starfield would be fed to the bugs.
That’s just fucking ridiculous!
What kind of thought process does it take to come up with the idea of sending Void Players home?
…
Seeing the anxious figure of Li Yi leaving, Chen Yi couldn’t help but let out a light chuckle. During his conversation with Shang Ruxue, he had noticed Li Yi’s schadenfreude.
Likes to take pleasure in others’ misfortune, doesn’t he?
Now it’s his turn.
There’s a saying that goes,
When you encounter a problem you can’t solve, find a way to pass the problem onto someone else, and they will solve it for you.
This isn’t his Starfield.
The first to be affected wasn’t his Blue Star, either.
He didn’t need to take on this pressure for millions of Life Value and get into a squabble with Shang Ruxue. If another conflict happened and attracted attention from certain people, that would be bad. This was Li Yi’s Starfield; from every angle, it should be Li Yi to deal with Shang Ruxue.
“Oh right.”
Suddenly remembering something, Chen Yi turned his head to look at Li Yi, who was also taking pleasure in others’ misfortune, and raised an eyebrow, “That Prop was yours, right?”
“Yep.”
Wang Qi first subconsciously nodded, but quickly realized what was happening and immediately turned serious, shaking his head fiercely, “What are you talking about? I don’t understand, what Prop? I used many Props just now, which one are you referring to?”
“The one that makes everything frisky.”
“That one.”
Wang Qi seemed to have an epiphany and nodded, then with an aggrieved roar, “Speaking of that, I’m so pissed! I almost got hit by it too. If I find out who used that Prop later, I’ll skin them alive!”
“Such a beast!”
“What about it? Chen Yi, you didn’t fall for it too, did you?”
“No, I was just curious about what kind of person would buy such a Prop at a high price. After all, the priority rule of that Prop isn’t low, and it has such a wide range. It mustn’t be cheap, yet it only has that single effect of making everything frisky; clearly, the cost-effectiveness isn’t there.”
Wang Qi touched his nose awkwardly, “Surely only a pervert would buy that Prop.”
Yet, in his heart, he couldn’t help but once again feel pain for his Ultimate Prop.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded calmly, “Do you count as a pervert?”
“No way.”
“How about the Void Queen?”
“That’s a unique cultural exchange between different Races.”
“Pretty good.”
…

chapters.content:
Chapter 428: Chapter 328: “Drunken Beauty!
“I remember Li Yi telling me that Shang Ruxue is the chieftain of the Mao Rabbit Clan from Fourfold Planet, right?”
Chen Yi stood still, leaning on his cane with one hand, his narrow eyes slightly squinted, looking with interest at Shang Ruxue who was floating in mid-air and arguing with Li Yi not far away, the corners of his mouth slightly upturned.
He wasn’t worried about his nearly ten million Life Value flying away.
With so many Void Monsters piled up layer upon layer, densely covering the entire field and spilling over the edges as far as the eye could see, large armies were currently engaged in combat with these monsters at the perimeter.
It was impossible for all these Void Monsters to just exist here.
Even maintaining the status quo, the cost of every passing minute would not be small.
...
It was even less possible to send them back to the Void Starfield.
The only outcome would be for him to slaughter these Void Monsters, and the only differences were a matter of sooner or later, and what price Li Yi had to pay to Shang Ruxue.
“Hmm.”
Seeing Chen Yi no longer talking about the Prop, Wang Qi also took up the topic with a serious expression, nodding and saying, “Yes, the Mao Rabbit Clan is quite well-known in the entire ranking-up game for reasons you’ve seen yourself.”
“The Mao Rabbit Clan hasn’t done well in Ranked Matches because they never participated, but that doesn’t mean the race should be underestimated.”
“Their vast connections are the capital they can use to meddle in anything.”
“Their calling card is absolute neutrality, which is why many powers can tolerate their meddling.”
“It’s just that if one day this power stops being neutral and starts having its own preferences and emotions, it would spell disaster for the Mao Rabbit Clan. While the clan has made many allies over the years, including powers from Sixfold Planet…”
“…they’ve offended even more.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded slightly without saying anything. He knew Ranked Match was a feature that could only be unlocked on Fourfold Planet, but he wasn’t clear about the specifics. He had only heard from Li Yi that multiple functions would be unlocked on Sixfold Planet, including:
‘Timeline’ ‘Great Brawl’ ‘Reincarnation’ ‘Professional System’ ‘…’ and so on.
The most well-known of these, of course, was the Professional System. His current profession as a Gold Miner was one of the professions that Sixfold Planet players could obtain, followed by the Timeline.
Yes.
Sixfold Planet players have the ability to modify the Timeline.
They call this Retrospection and Foresight.
Once a planet successfully advances to Sixfold Planet status, players can endow their own eyes with either the effect of Retrospection or Foresight, and if they choose Retrospection, they will see different scenes in their two pupils when looking at the world.
The left eye sees the normal world.
But the right eye sees the world from three seconds ago.
Retrospecting time can be upgraded and extended using Points, and if extended to 24 hours, one could see the actions of any stranger 24 hours ago with the right eye.
Fully synchronized.
One cannot skip through the timeline seen by the right eye at will; it’s not like a surveillance video that can be flipped through at any time, only the real-time status from 24 hours prior can be seen.
It can be very useful in certain situations.
For instance, one might observe some confidential actions or secret talks, conspiracy to poison, and so on.
If Foresight is chosen, it’s still three seconds, and one can also spend Points to extend the duration.
This effect is considerably stronger. During battle, it’s possible to foresee the opponent’s next move, even using foresight to predict the outcome of the battle and decide whether to go all-in until the end.
Besides, Sixfold Planet players can unlock many more functions.
It can be said that after advancing to Sixfold Planet status, there’s a complete qualitative change, which is also why he is somewhat reluctant to provoke players from Sixfold Planet under current circumstances.
Just then—
Li Yi, who was floating in the air not far away, came back, wiping the cold sweat off his forehead and murmuring with a slightly pale face, “Go on, Chen Yi, get it over with quickly, let’s get this matter behind us.”
“I need to rest properly.”
“Suddenly I feel so tired.”
Chen Yi raised his eyebrows slightly, looking curiously at Shang Ruxue who was already flying off into the distance and asked, “How did you persuade her?”
Li Yi was curious earlier, now it was his turn to be curious.
Perhaps this is just the turn of the tides.
“Temptation with benefits?”
After all, Li Yi had enough Points, and if he offered enough benefits, it wasn’t impossible.
“Impossible.”
Wang Qi shook his head firmly, denying it and saying, “This woman is extremely stubborn. It’s not as though people haven’t offered her outrageous amounts before, but she’s completely scoffed at those. She’s very resolute about the path she’s on, almost to the point of obsession.”
“It wasn’t temptation with benefits.”
Li Yi, looking worn out, murmured in a daze, “I spent ages talking to her, telling her that if these players died, they would return to the hell of Void Starfield, from where they could climb back up.”
“That’s the fastest way home.”
“To wait for the Matriarch to breed new eggs will take a long time, and by then the moms and dads of these Void Players would definitely be worried about their kids. It’s better to let them go home sooner rather than later.”
“And keeping these Void Players here would cause even more casualties, so it’s better to send them home early.”
“Shang Ruxue agreed with this reasoning.”

Chapter 429: Chapter 328: “Drunken Beauty!”_2
“Alright, alright, Chen Yi, you go ahead quickly. I feel like I’m about to lose my mind trying to persuade this stubborn woman. Do you know how hard it is?”
“Okay then.”
Wang Qi looked at Li Yi with some amusement, “Your eloquence is not bad at all. It does seem to make some sense after you explain it like that.”
Chen Yi touched his nose and nodded with an inexplicable gleam in his eyes, “Alright, then I’m off.”
With a light step on the ground, his whole body shot forward.
Send back to Hell?
...
That seems a bit unlikely.
Thanks to the Title Effect, Alien Race players killed by him were permanently dead, with no chance of returning to Hell. Why return to Hell at all? Go be a cleaner, since the Void Monsters are never full and not picky eaters anyway. Perhaps after working as a cleaner in the depths of Hell, they would discover just how wonderful this world is.
The next second—
Chen Yi’s whole figure appeared above nearly ten million Void Monsters. Glancing down, the edge was almost invisible, only a vast expanse of darkness could be seen, with no end in sight.
The endlessly surging swarm of insects piled together, looking like a churning sea of bugs.
Extremely vast.
He glanced at the remaining time of the Wife-Killing Buff, 44 minutes left.
That’s enough.
It seemed like a long time had passed, but in reality, from the activation of the first portal to the appearance of nearly ten million Void Monsters, not much time had gone by at all; everything had almost happened in an instant.
He took a deep breath and then countless figures of Buddha seated on Lotus Platforms, each holding the Fire God, appeared out of thin air.
Aiming their guns down at the Void Monsters.
And began to mercilessly open fire.
“Tat-tat-tat!!!”
With piercing and dense gunfire ringing in the ears, the Void Bug Clan below was harvested like ripe wheat.
Unparalleled Mowing Mode activated.
…
After a full half-hour.
The dense gunfire finally came to a stop, and the sky full of other-worldly flowers slowly faded away. All that could be seen was the rain-like dense fragments of Void Monster bodies covering the ground below, no longer a single lively Void Monster in sight.
It was all over.
“Phew!”
Chen Yi let out a sigh of relief, lit a cigarette with a hint of exhaustion, and turned to look at his personal panel.
‘Life Value’: 9.87 million.
9.87 million Life Value, that was enough, beyond his expectations, making the journey worthwhile.
As far as he knew, the Prop that Li Yi had which could add to the Life Value only added a four-digit number, and that Prop was already an S-grade Prop. His 9.87 million Life Value could probably be considered on par with an SSS-grade Prop, right?
Even comparable to an L-grade Prop wasn’t impossible.
L-grade Props were something that only players from the Sixfold Planet and above were qualified to obtain.
Until now, he hadn’t even seen other people possess them, let alone own one himself.
Just then, a panel suddenly popped up in front of him.
‘Ding, S-grade Prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ has been acquired by a player. Detection that both ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ and ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ Props have been obtained by a player. The Destiny Battle officially begins, and the winning player will obtain the other Prop held by their opponent.’
‘And the two Props will combine into a set.’
‘PS: This Prop is the only one in the Entire Star System; the Destiny Battle will officially begin in 90 days.’
“Destiny Battle?”
Chen Yi slightly narrowed his eyes as he looked at the system announcement that popped up in front of him, pondering silently without speaking. He had known about this long ago, when he acquired the ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ Prop, he was already aware that an unavoidable Destiny Battle was impending.
The winner would take all.
The loser would lose everything.
Compared to Longevity as the Southern Mountains, he felt that the ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ Prop was a bit more bug-like. For every creature killed, one could gain one Luck Point. If he could convert his current Life Value into Luck Points…
9.87 million Luck Points, what an appalling entity that would be.
He could probably find an S-grade Prop just by eating rice, right?
The actual effects were speculative, but in any case, killing a player with almost maximum Luck Points would probably not be easy.
90 days later.
Chen Yi took note of this timeframe in his heart, then stopped thinking about it and shot off into the distance.
Today was September 30th.
90 days later, it would be the end of December, which just happened to be the time when Santa Claus comes around.
After a brief handover with Li Yi, Chen Yi went to find Tuberculosis Rabbit.
The war was over, but not completely over.
So many bodies here, cleaning up would be a huge project, it definitely wouldn’t be finished in a day or two. Killing players had a certain chance to drop items from their inventory, but Void Players mostly kept their items unless they were Matriarchs, so there weren’t that many Props dropped.
Chen Yi couldn’t be bothered to look closely.
Regardless of what Props were dropped, he couldn’t take them back with him anyway, so he might as well consider it the site fee for Li Yi.
As for some of the fish that slipped through the net hidden among the corpses, it also brought quite a bit of obstruction to the cleanup, not likely to cause much damage, but always requiring an extra bit of caution.
…
Quite a few people came to participate in the battle this time. Although the casualties were fewer than expected, in a certain respect, it also raised the cohesion of the Awesome Starfield to a new level.
At this moment, Li Yi was gathering all the Awesome Starfield players who participated in the battle, projecting his image onto the blue sky through a loudspeaker and began to speak.
His tone modulated with ups and downs, extremely impassioned, and it was evident that he had prepared the speech with care.

chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Chapter 328: “Drunken Beauty!”_3
“Looking back on this year, the difficulties were greater than expected, the challenges were bigger than anticipated, and the achievements were even better than we could have hoped for. We strategized according to circumstances and proceeded…”
“…In this battle, we created brilliance and also baptized our team…”
“…Worthy of the era, worthy of history…”
“…With a great mission, high difficulty, and numerous tests also come great changes, rapid improvements, and good rewards…”
“…Let’s build and operate a top-class Starfield with Awesome characteristics!”
“Let’s get to work!”
...
In an instant.
The enormous player teams, upon receiving their orders, began to disperse in an orderly fashion back to their respective posts, preparing to clean up the battlefield.
…
Standing on a nearby peak, Chen Yi looked on with interest at Li Yi, who was passionately shouting below, and chuckled, “This brother really seems to have an obsession with managing the Starfield; he must have put a lot of heart into it on a daily basis.”
The players who had seized the Monuments were all representatives of their own Starfields.
Like Wang Qi, like Li Yi, like himself.
But they were just that, representatives.
It didn’t mean that by capturing a Monument, one became the ruler of that Starfield.
Ruler and representative are two entirely different things.
It can only be said that representatives have a significant advantage if they want to become rulers, but that’s all. Just like Li Yi, if he wants to become the real ruler of the Awesome Starfield, he still has many steps to go.
The road is long; just take it step by step.
“Yi.”
Standing behind Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, hands in pockets, looked down at the efficiently cleaning battlefield and casually said, “Just now, a few people were conspiring nearby. They plan to give Yi some chocolates laced with alcohol at the celebration banquet later.”
“I don’t know where they heard it from, but they said that Yi can’t drink alcohol and that if you do, you’ll become weak and collapse on the spot.”
“I didn’t chase them down at the time, worrying about startling the snakes.”
“If we’re going to deal with it, we need to start from the tail and clean up thoroughly to prevent any future trouble.”
Chen Yi nodded with a slightly odd expression, “I understand.”
He can’t drink alcohol?
This message, he seemed to have mentioned only at the last celebration banquet hosted by Li Yi, right?
Was it overheard?
Or did Li Yi inadvertently leak it?
But that’s not important anymore; after all, it’s just a false message. The only thing he was curious about was who these people wanting to deal with him were; he didn’t think he had many enemies.
He carefully considered.
The people who currently disliked him, apart from the Feng Family, should have all been taken care of.
Could there still be some fish that slipped through the net?
And at that moment—
Sword Without End arrived, gasping for breath from afar, leapt off his flying sword, and said in a trembling voice while resting his hands on his knees, “I’m not too late, am I?”
“Here.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged and gestured with his chin toward the battlefield below that was being cleaned up: “It’s all over; this battle ended quicker than expected, so no second round is needed.”
“What, the Map Difficulty on the return trip has increased again?”
“Mhm.”
Having caught his breath, Sword Without End nodded helplessly, “The difficulty of the Hell Return Map has increased a bit again. Clearing it isn’t a problem, but if there’s a time limit, it can get pretty tight.”
“You’ve worked hard.”
Chen Yi patted Sword Without End’s shoulder, while Jiaye also slowly approached from the higher ground nearby, sitting next to Tie Chui.
The group was finally gathered together again.
They didn’t immediately get up to go elsewhere but chose to sit there casually chatting to pass the time. After just finishing a battle, everyone was quite tired, and at this point, they were rather reluctant to exert themselves too much.
…
In another place.
Wang Qi was directing his 30,000 subordinates, forming small teams to search for maps on the Awesome Starfield. For the time being, he had no plans to bring this group back to his own Starfield.
Thirty thousand people!
A full thirty thousand people, who had traveled to Awesome Starfield by spending Points, represented a massive expense!
And it hadn’t served much purpose, making the Points seem somewhat wasted.
Since there was nothing immediately pressing back home, it seemed better to stay in Awesome Starfield and look for maps to run through, to recoup some of the costs.
Similarly, the other members from Club 33 who had come over were doing the same as Wang Qi, letting their subordinates scatter to find maps to clear. You couldn’t run a race and come back empty-handed.
“Exciting, thrilling.”
The person in charge from ‘Massive TV Station’, who stood on the periphery of the battlefield, came back to his senses a while after the war had ended, clapping in a daze, still not over the excitement.
Even though Chen Yi was no longer visible.
But this figure and this name were now eternally engraved in his heart.
When the ‘Void Clan’ launched a massive invasion, just when everyone thought Awesome Starfield was doomed, Chen Yi and several other players stood up, stopping this crisis. It must be said, this broadcast from a profit standpoint was a jackpot.
In terms of content, the broadcast was also thrilling enough.
He was ready to flee at any moment, but nothing had transpired. Not only him, but this event had also shocked all other players.
The live broadcast room was still open.
The public screen was filled with floating comments.
If last time’s debut map let them witness Chen Yi’s emotional appeal and strategy, then this invasion by the Void Clan let them see Chen Yi’s tremendous individual combat strength and quick decision-making.

chapters.title: Chapter 431 328: "Drunken Beauty!"_4
chapters.content:
Crisis can affect the speed of thought.
From the activation of the first Void Portal to the descent of nearly ten million Void Monsters, it took only about fifteen minutes. The time they had to make a decision was less than a minute.
It was only by making the right decision within this minute that the crisis could be averted.
Although there were sporadic comments in the live broadcast pointing out that the crisis could be stopped by surrounding without killing, only a few people mentioned it.
Most people only knew of the horror of the Void Clan but were not aware of the details, and even if they were, they did not think of stopping the continuous replication of the portals in this way.
Moreover, they were watching from the perspective of bystanders.
As for Chen Yi in the center of the battlefield, he quickly made a judgement under crisis. Some people's thinking becomes sharper under crisis, while others become paralyzed with fear, trembling and unable to move. Clearly, Chen Yi was of the former kind.
This war had historical significance and was of strong educational importance in the entire history of the leveling-up game!
Through this war, everyone learned of the terror of the Void Clan as well as the solution!
Just thirty minutes.
Give the Void Clan thirty minutes, and everything would become irredeemable, with no chance for salvation, as countless Void Monsters would occupy the entire Starfield, devouring every object in sight.
If the invasion of the Void Clan could not be resolved within thirty minutes, then all would be lost.
Although Chen Yi provided a perfect solution through this war, it was not a perfect exam paper.
To control millions of frenzied Void Monsters and to only surround them without killing was an incredibly difficult task. Furthermore, as these Void Monsters began to unhesitatingly commit suicide, the scene started to collapse instantaneously, almost leading to the plan's failure.
If it weren't for the crucial moment.
Wang Qi, Shang Ruxue, and Chen Yi stepped forward, and the Awesome Starfield was about to be renamed as the Void Starfield's third division.
The best solution would have been to surround without killing as soon as the first Void Queen emerged through the first portal.
It was obviously much easier to control tens of thousands of Void Monsters than millions.
And that allowed for multiple margins of error.
The most critical point to deliver a perfect answer was to have enough players around when the Void Portal opened, and one who could hold the scene and step forward. If the portal suddenly opened in some desolate wilderness at midnight,
That would be a complete loss.
Direct zero!
With this invasion of the Void Clan, Chen Yi, whose popularity had just begun to decline, became famous again across many Starfields, and even high-level players began to pay attention to this recently renowned rookie player.
The Void Clan.
Not only something feared by low-level players.
These high-level players were also afraid; these creatures were utterly unreasonable, crushing you with absolute and pure numbers, leaving no chance for negotiation.
Nearly all high-grade planets had a common problem: although the strength of players on their own planets wasn't weak, and any one of them was a force to be reckoned with on low-grade planets, their populations were sparse.
A small population was the chronic ailment of high-grade planets.
Having come all the way from the Novice Planet, they had encountered countless near-extinction crises, and fellow race players had died in large numbers. Though each player's quality was high, their numbers were extremely scarce.
Facing a race that overpowered with numbers, high-grade planets had no leverage.
They could only wait for death.
Unreasonable.
But they wouldn't be annihilated. After all, a small population also meant flexibility. Some high-grade planets had only a few hundred thousand official players. Could we fight you and have our entire race escape?
Could you catch up?
If we all fled, how could you trigger an extinction mechanism?
Although this would be judged as a Lone Spirit Planet, it was at least better than extinction, right?
...
"Let's drink, drink!!"
Feeling pretty good, Li Yi promptly initiated a celebration banquet after arranging some business, inviting everyone who had come to support, including Chen Yi and Wang Qi, and set a grand feast!
"..."
Sword Without End played with the delicate spout of a 'Fù' nearby, his pupils full of curiosity, as he was extremely intrigued by the unique winemaking culture of Li Yi's race.
This winemaking method only required one year to produce a fine wine with a century's taste.
If Blue Star had this thing, what would be the need for Moutai?
It just looked somewhat strange and uncomfortable, one had to plug the spout into the mouth and suck hard to taste this wine with its unique, exotic charm. He hadn't dared to drink it, but observing was still okay.
"I told you those friends of yours were unreliable," Wang Qi casually swatted away a 'Fù' that came close to him and looked at Li Yi with disdain, "You're not ready, are you? Did you realize that when it really comes down to it, it's still us who are willing to help you?"
"Delete them all."
"If I were you, I'd curse them out, shame them, and then delete them."
"There's no need for that," Li Yi shook his head with a wry smile, "It's not easy to make enemies of all these people. Deep down they feel a bit guilty for not coming this time, which could be turned into an advantage. But if you curse them out, that's just making enemies for no reason."

chapters.title: Chapter 432 328: "Drunken Beauty!"_5
chapters.content:
"Actually, befriending these people is not entirely useless, as long as interests align and there's not too much danger, they can indeed offer considerable assistance."
"You can only consider them allies, not friends."
"Enough about that, come on, drink up! It's not easy for us all to get together, so let's not talk about these mood-killers anymore."
The banquet was in full swing.
And the aftermath work was also underway.
The aftermath wasn't just about cleaning up corpses, but also dealing with those players who had been charmed by Wang Qi's Prop and had fallen into its thrall.
In the name of humanity.
These players were carried out wrapped in white cloth, and after being brought out, they were all housed in a temporary base set up outside the battlefield, each one allocated to a single room.
It could be said, they preserved the players' dignity to the greatest extent possible.
They were spared the indignity of appearing nude before the cameras.
As time passed, these players were gradually waking up and regaining their lost memories.
...
"..."
Inside a single room in the temporary base, a player with a pale face looked down at his swollen and red privates, his reason having been lost instantly after the pink powder entered his body, and now his memory had fully recovered.
He remembered everything.
He had thrown himself at a Void Monster.
And afterward, he was forcibly pulled out.
And then thrown into this single room.
The nauseating feeling made him itch all over, unable to bear it!!!
"Ahh!!!"
Overcome with despair, the player covered his face with his hands and painfully rushed out of the base, fleeing into the distance.
It's said that years later,
this player became a philosopher, and after reflecting on that night's experience, said with an unfazed expression and wrinkled face, "After that day, I saw through the frivolities of life, and no longer harbored the slightest yearning for worldly desires."
He achieved no small measure of success.
...
Meanwhile, in the adjacent room.
A Minotaur Player and a female Centaur Player hastily disentangled themselves and wrapped their bodies in clothing, each scooting to a corner of the room.
The pupils of the two players were filled with anger, embarrassment, intolerance, and surprise as they looked at each other.
The emotions in their eyes were even more complex and unpredictable than the flavors of a Häagen-Dazs cake.
"You!!"
This female Centaur Player, her face flushed with mortification, was the first to glare fiercely at the Minotaur Player. She hadn't anticipated that merely supporting the battlefield would get her caught in the blast of that perverted Prop!
The war was over!
But she had been defiled, and would've rather it been by a member of her own Race, but it was an Alien Race player instead!
Furthermore, it was by an Alien Race player with the head of a cow!
Oh my god, cow heads are just a snack in their race's cuisine, and she was defiled by a snack!
But at the same time, she couldn't help the strange flicker in her eyes, recalling that the cow's mouth didn't seem to have any fishy taste at all, nothing like the cow heads she usually ate.
And the tongue was exceptionally thick, with light barbs, giving a strong sensation when licked.
The feeling... was completely different.
And the male players of her own Race were so weak, limply devoid of any sensation, but this Minotaur Player was extremely strong!
The Minotaur Player also stared fixedly at the half-human, half-horse player, his nostrils flaring as he breathed heavily, similarly angry. He never imagined his first time would be with a horse!
But...
But that horse's butt was really intoxicating!
All the male players of his Clan possessed Divine Power and were extremely careful during their first time in fear of accidentally crushing their partners, but with this player, there was no need for caution, she could take whatever force he applied.
It was extremely satisfying for him.
The two players, though both belonging to the Awesome Starfield, would normally have no interaction, but now as fate would have it, they cooked the raw rice into a done deal, and the more they looked at each other, the stranger the glances became!
The anger on their faces when they woke up was quickly fading away.
Time passed, indeterminable.
The Minotaur Player was the first to break the awkward silence, hesitating before finally asking cautiously, "Shall we go out together?"
And the Centaur female player, with her head held low and silent for a long while, finally said softly, "Okay."
Long, long after,
these two players, having overcome the myriad obstacles presented by their respective Races, officially got together and to their surprise found out there was no reproductive barrier between the two, successfully giving birth to a son.
He had human legs instead of a horse's behind and was exceptionally strong-limbed.
His head bore small cow horns and a cow nose, rather than a large cow head, which made him look incredibly cute.
During this time, the players of these two Races also began to interact more and more frequently, the more they saw each other, the more they discovered that the other was their dream mate.
The female Minotaur players, thrilled with the weakness of the male Centaur players, no longer had to worry about being crushed to death. The Centaur males were also excited; they had always been considered strong, giving them a sense of accomplishment.
Similarly, the male players of the Minotaur Clan also gave huge thumbs up to the female players of the Centaur Race, and the Centaur women cried tears of joy, realizing that they had always been merely having their ears picked.
As the two Races became more closely associated, they eventually formed one large Tribe.
And the beginning of all this was influenced by two stubborn players who insisted on being together.

chapters.title: Chapter 433 328: "Drunken Beauty!"_6
chapters.content:
At this moment, the Minotaur Player was naturally unaware of the influence he would eventually bring, just feeling a vague sense of affection spreading in his heart.
...
As more and more players woke up and left this temporary base, it gradually became emptier and emptier.
There were quite a few players who, in angry tones, loudly demanded justice, insisting that the player who activated the prop be brought forth!
However, after receiving mental compensation from Li Yi's subordinates, they also left satisfied.
Of course, innocence is priceless.
But it can't beat a fortune.
...
The banquet was in full swing, with everyone in high spirits. Successfully resolving the crisis of the Void Clan invasion without too much casualty was a cause for celebration for the entire Awesome Starfield.
This brush with disaster allowed these individuals, long accustomed to high status, to re-experience the thrill of the constant heartbeat faced with death that they felt during the Novice Period.
Chen Yi didn't drink, nor did he join Wang Qi and the others in conversation.
He just found a quiet table, sat with Jiaye, and looking toward the center of the venue where all sorts of Alien Race players were gathered, said with a light laugh, "What do you think? These Alien Race players are actually quite entertaining, right?"
"Mhm."
Jiaye, curious about everything at the banquet, gently forked a piece of dessert and chewed slowly, resting her chin in her hand and looking tenderly at Chen Yi, "After all, this is my first time leaving Blue Star. Everything is new to me, I've never seen them before."
"I took you to the Annihilation Starfield before."
"That doesn't count. We didn't even stop to properly look at these Alien Race players."
"Alright, alright."
Chen Yi lowered his head to glance at his watch, then lifted his head to look at Jiaye, "Our return time is at midnight on October 1st, and now it's five in the afternoon on September 30th. We still have half a day left."
"Let's spend this half-day touring the Awesome Starfield. How about we treat it as a tourist trip?"
"Okay."
Jiaye's eyes shone with anticipation as she nodded strongly.
"Shall we leave now then?"
"Now?"
Chen Yi looked up at Jiaye with a hint of surprise, but upon seeing the unrestrained anticipation on her face, he couldn't help but laugh and stood up, taking Jiaye's hand and walking towards the direction of Chief Li.
"Then let's go now, just to say our goodbyes."
"We still need to mind our manners, right?"
"I, Chen Yi, am also someone who values politeness."
...
"Off for a stroll?"
Li Yi initially paused, then nodded in understanding, standing up and looking towards Chen Yi with a bit of show-off flair, "Then you two must visit 'Sky City.' Sky City is a city I've spent a tremendous amount of wealth to construct in the Awesome Starfield!"
"It accommodates not just one Race, but a large number of Alien Race players have settled in this city."
"In this city, you can experience extreme luxury, as well as the cultural colors of different races. This city was built with a huge investment by me, it's a must-visit for other Starfield players who come to the Awesome Star. If you only have half a day, trust me, you don't want to miss this place."
"I've sent you the coordinates."
"Wait a moment, Chen Yi, I'll find some people to accompany you, just to avoid any mishaps."
"No need."
Chen Yi shook his head and responded with a smile, "I appreciate the thought, but there's no need for an escort. I shouldn't run into any trouble, and Jiaye finally has a chance to come out and wants to look around."
"I'll take her to have a look, so we'll take our leave from here early."
"That's also true!"
Li Yi slapped his own head and shook his pudgy belly, speaking with a hint of helplessness, "I've been a bit forgetful lately. With Chen Yi's strength, what trouble could possibly occur."
"Alright, then I won't insist on keeping you. We can gather again when there's a chance."
After saying their goodbyes,
Chen Yi took Jiaye to where Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit were imbibing with high spirits, "Let's go, take a look around. It's not every day we get out. Don't just drink, let's visit Sky City."
"And along the way, let's test out what having over 9 million Life Value really means."
Tie Chui, who sat beside them bored out of his mind watching Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit play drinking games, suddenly lit up at these words, immediately standing up behind Chen Yi.
His action clearly indicated where he stood.
"Alright."
After downing the last cup of wine in one gulp, Tuberculosis Rabbit got up with Sword Without End and followed behind Chen Yi as they walked towards the exit of the venue.
"Are you drunk?"
Chen Yi sniffed the wine on Tuberculosis Rabbit's breath and asked with a slightly odd look in his eyes.
"No, who could stomach that stuff? I had the waiter bring me bottled liquor."
"Hmm."
The group didn't say much else and quickly made their way to the venue's entrance.
Just as they were about to leave the venue,
they saw a waiter carrying a tray of chocolates stride in from outside, he seemed a bit startled upon seeing Chen Yi and his group preparing to leave, then his step quickened, obviously anxious as he headed toward them.
Bowing his head with a respectful expression, he spoke.
"Would you gentlemen like to try some chocolates?"
"It's the latest creation by Chief Li's top pastry chef, who spent three whole months developing it. It's rich, creamy, and incredibly sweet on the palate."
"And it doesn't contain a trace of alcohol~"
Despite the respectful tone, one could still detect a hint of anticipation in his voice.
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the waiter, slightly speechless and silent. Why did these people seem a bit slow? Wouldn't that comment about it not containing any alcohol seem a bit like a self-admission?
Were they really that naive, or were they just playing around?
After a pause, Tuberculosis Rabbit still picked a chocolate from the tray and casually threw it into his mouth.
"Thanks, tastes good."
The waiter then offered the tray to Chen Yi, his eyes filled with hope as he hastily said, "Would you like one, sir? No alcohol in it, just pure chocolate, and it's incredibly sweet!"
"..."
Chen Yi rubbed his nose, starting to wonder if he really had such foolish enemies.
Definitely not the Feng Family; they might be a bit annoying, but they were not this stupid. He had only half a day this trip, which he had planned to spend with Jiaye, and he did not want to waste it on this apparently not-so-smart enemy in front of him.
With a casual wave of his hand, he led Jiaye away towards the distance.
"No thanks, I never eat chocolate."
Then, under the waiter's gaze, they left the venue, summoned the Christmas sleigh, ascended into the sky, and shot off into the distance, soon disappearing from the waiter's sight.
Seeing Chen Yi and his group leave without the slightest hesitation to stay,
the waiter regretfully slapped his own face.
"Damn, I was so close!"
"Who knew that Chen Yi wouldn't eat chocolate!"
"How infuriating!"
Then, the waiter, full of regret, sat on the ground and popped all the chocolates from the tray into his mouth, slowly chewing with a satisfied look on his face.
He hadn't lied.
The chocolates were indeed the top pastry chef under Li Yi's best work.
Named,
'Drunken Beauty!'
The flavor was extremely rich and delicious, with no trace of alcohol to be tasted, but in reality, they had a high alcohol content. Just a few pieces were enough to give a tipsy sensation, which is why they were named Drunken Beauty.
If it were not for the plan to deal with Chen Yi, they would not have spent so many points to buy this entire lot of expensive desserts.
Although the plan had failed, the chocolates should not go to waste.
"So delicious."
The waiter, leaning against the wall outside the venue, slightly tipsy, muttered in a daze, "Next time, we'll definitely succeed!"
The first action, a failure!
But that's okay, there's always a second time.
Now the most important thing was to quickly find out where Chen Yi and the others had gone, then swiftly carry out the second operation!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 434 331: "Such valuable things, we dare not touch at all.
chapters.content:
```
"Beep beep beep!!!"
"Beep beep beep!!!"
The diligent little moose emitted strange and rhythmic cries, cheering itself on for the long journey ahead!
Speed had been pushed to the max!
What was this?
This was Blue Star speed!
However, not even ten minutes had passed and Chen Yi retracted the Christmas sleigh back into his backpack and headed towards a shop nearby named "Hangji Starfield Long-Distance."
The speed of the Christmas sleigh was fast, not slow at all.
To circle Blue Star wouldn't take much time.
But unfortunately, it seemed like Awesome Starfield was a little too big; after all, it was created by flattening nearly a hundred planets into one massive continent, this vast land was much larger than he had imagined.
Originally, he had been happily chatting with Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others on the sleigh, looking forward to the journey ahead.
But after traveling for 10 minutes and noticing that the little red dot representing their location on the navigation route to Sky City hadn't moved at all, he realized something was amiss.
And right next to the navigation, there was a clear estimated time of arrival.
About 239 hours.
They only had half an hour. They couldn't wait nearly ten days. Once back, he'd definitely have to upgrade the speed of his Christmas sleigh again—it wasn't quite cutting it.
"Hangji Starfield Long-Distance!"
A company specializing in shuttling between various territorial planets of Awesome Starfield, located at the edge of their city.
After stepping into the company and asking a few quick questions, stating his needs,
he chartered an entire train car.
After paying 370,000 Points,
"Boom!"
Accompanied by the roaring sound, the train car beneath them Soaring into the Skies began traveling at high speeds towards their destination in the stratosphere. The speed was extremely fast, and although they couldn't see the speedometer and weren't sure how fast exactly, the scenery outside the window was completely blurred, as if pixelated.
The materials of the car must be pretty good.
There was no ringing in their ears, no feeling of strong winds or cold, nor any sensation of unstable air pressure.
"Pretty good,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat in a luxurious single seat, leaning back to admire the scenes outside through the window, and exclaimed, "Never in my life did I think I would see a train fly! Those 370,000 Points were well spent."
When they boarded, they saw it.
Outside the train car, there were quite a few weapons that looked extremely fierce, with countless dark barrels that were intimidating!
One could tell at a glance that this train car had not only an extremely fast moving speed but also possessed terrifying firepower.
Of course, before chartering the car, they were asked to sign a confidentiality agreement recognized by the game.
The agreement contained a clause stating that they were not to reveal any information about the contents inside the car.
Well, those fierce-looking weapons outside—those were fake, just props.
The company's explanation was that they were for customer safety, effectively deterring bandits who lived by blockading roads; however, the company couldn't afford the cost of buying so many firepower props, so they used props instead.
Signing the confidentiality agreement was also to prevent this detail from leaking out.
If the bandits didn't believe it and tried to rob them regardless? Well, they'd just have to leave it to fate!
On this point,
Tuberculosis Rabbit had no complaints, only giving a thumbs up and commending their ingenuity.
Meanwhile, the driver seated at the very front of the car kept looking back at Chen Yi vigilantly. He had dealt with many customers but few dared to show their titles.
Even if there were a few who showed their titles, they didn't have as many as Chen Yi.
Dozens of titles—piercing through the roof of the car, touching the skies!
From afar, before even seeing the car, one would see a vertical column of light.
Wasn't that a bit too conspicuous?!
He had a feeling this journey wouldn't be safe; wasn't this just like a lighthouse in the middle of the sea? It was like they were begging bandits to come find them, wasn't it?
But he didn't ask the customer to turn off his titles, after all, professional etiquette taught him not to meddle with a customer's preferences.
...
Although Chen Yi was quite famous throughout Starfield and probably more so in Awesome Starfield, having just repelled the Void Clan there, not everyone knew him.
Not everyone has the time to watch live streams.
Life necessities.
In this world, there are always people too busy to watch live streams or get news from the internet. They seem disconnected from the world, but in reality, they are the ones quietly building it.
The driver had only heard from a colleague that there seemed to have been an invasion of their Starfield by a certain Race, but it had already been repelled.
As for the rest, he knew nothing.
...
Jiaye nestled in Chen Yi's arms, her fingers lightly tracing circles inside his embrace without speaking, simply enjoying the moment quietly.
She rarely had the time to be with Yi like this.
The feeling of traveling together put her in a great mood.
What they didn't know was that danger was silently approaching.
Not far from them, inside a floating house in mid-air, a group of people were sitting inside looking at the central screen, at the train car that was speeding ahead and the column of light from the titles reaching into the clouds.
"..."
The group inside looked at each other with odd expressions on their faces as they observed the column of light from the titles.
"What do you think, boss? Should we make a move?"
A man who had just walked out of the washroom, fastening his belt, walked up to the big screen with excitement, "Just wasted half a day fighting that Void Clan, finally just got back, and we haven't even opened for business today."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 435 331: "We dare not touch something of such value." _2
chapters.content:
"Were you guys saying that you found the long-distance carriage of Hangji Starfield while I was shitting inside?"
"We've never dared to touch this company's carriages; their firepower is terrifying. But didn't you say today, boss, that all the firepower of this company must be fake?"
"Should we make a move?"
"I'll go get the weapons."
"No rush."
The leading man narrowed his eyes and shook his head, "I've been observing this company for nearly half a month now, and according to their unit prices, they're losing money on every single transaction."
"But as it stands, they haven't taken any measures to improve. It's not plausible to say they are using a loss-leading strategy to dominate the market."
"Their expansion is very slow, even tentative."
"Moreover, according to the information I've received, they haven't been invested in by any capital. Personal funds wouldn't last this long."
"So there's only one possibility after looking at everything—that all of their firepower is just for show, not for real combat."
"Then what are we waiting for?"
The man who had just come from the toilet spoke up excitedly, "Let's make our move! What are we waiting for?"
"Not this time."
The leader pointed helplessly at the glowing title column on the screen, "Look at this. What does this look like to you? Doesn't it look like the scythe that the King of Hell uses to claim lives?"
"There's only one place where I've seen a player with this title column."
"And I saw it just earlier today."
"It's the very Chen Yi I told you about."
"Identical, right down to the title name."
"The person sitting in that carriage is Chen Yi. We definitely can't make a move this time."
"Chen Yi?"
Interest immediately filled the man's eyes as he leaned closer to the screen to check it, "Is that the guy you mentioned, boss, the one who almost wiped out the Void Race by himself?"
He had been suffering from gastroenteritis all day, perpetually running to the bathroom, unable to come out at all.
That's why he hadn't joined the boss in the fight against the Void Race.
He had even passed out from diarrhea, missing the livestream.
But he had heard the boss mention on his return that he had seen the real Chen Yi, whose power was extremely terrifying, one man equal to an entire race. He hadn't expected to encounter him today.
"Mhm."
The leader's face took on a wistful expression as he muttered, "You didn't see it with your own eyes; it's a pity. That terrifying individual strength made us completely overlook the fact he's still a rookie player."
"I thought about it a long time and decided we should make a move on this one."
"Are you crazy, boss?"
"Not crazy. There were too many people during the day; we couldn't get close to Chen Yi. Now that we finally have a chance, I want an autograph."
"Forget it, boss. What if you're killed as a brigand before you even get to speak?"
"It's worth a try."
...
"Dudu!!"
The piercing alarm blared through the carriage as the mechanical voice swiftly came through the broadcast, "A maliciously placed Slowing Formation detected ahead. The carriage speed will drop to 0 within ten seconds."
"Please evacuate quickly."
"Warning, warning!"
"Robbers encountered ahead, please evacuate quickly!"
The very next second—
The speed of the carriage visibly began to plummet!
And as the doors of the carriage slowly opened, the fierce wind rushed into the interior. Before Chen Yi and the others could react, they saw that the driver, whose whereabouts were unknown, had already donned an oxygen mask.
He waved to them through the glass of the cockpit.
Without a moment's hesitation, he leapt from the high altitude!
It looked as though he had rehearsed the act in his mind countless times.
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was still enjoying the view, looked at the leaping driver in a daze. After a long silence, he reluctantly pulled out an oxygen mask from his chest and covered his nose and mouth, feeling the wind cutting against his face like a blade, momentarily at a loss for words.
Was the law and order in Starfield really this bad?
It hadn't been long, and there were already robbers?
And these robbers had such means? To bring a high-speed moving carriage to a stop within ten seconds.
"Sigh."
Chen Yi let out a light sigh, feeling a bit speechless as he took an oxygen mask from his chest to help Jiaye put it on before getting ready to step outside the carriage to deal with the robbers who were already closing in.
It was a good opportunity to test out the effects of over 9 million Life Value.
Just not to waste too much time.
He didn't have much time to spare here.
Just as he was getting up, he heard someone shouting outside the carriage.
"Yi, don't fight, we're the good guys!"
"We're your fans, no other ill intentions, just want an autograph!"
"Is that okay?"
"If it's not, we'll leave right away!"
"..."
Chen Yi looked emotionlessly at the empty driver's cabin and the now halted carriage. After a pause, he finally spoke, "Sure, come in."
"Alright!"
The moment the words fell,
A man in a combat suit stepped into the carriage with two small squads behind him, excitedly looking at Chen Yi, "Yi, hello! I fought alongside you today, against the Void Race."
"I'm the one who used the bow and arrows."
"I can shoot arrows with freezing effects, froze quite a few of the Void Race today. I don't know if you remember, Yi."
"Your tactics today were truly admirable, and I didn't expect to meet you here. I took the liberty of coming forward to ask for an autograph."
"I hope you don't mind, Yi."

chapters.title: Chapter 436 331: "Such valuable things, we dare not touch at all."_3
chapters.content:
"No problem,"
Chen Yi casually waved his hand and pulled out a pen from his chest, lifting his chin in a gesture, "Where do I sign?"
"Here, here!"
The leader excitedly presented his back, "Just sign on my back."
He didn't bring too many subordinates, afraid that Yi wouldn't like it.
But it turned out Yi was quite easy to talk to.
He didn't seem as brutal as the internet made him out to be.
Indeed, the internet is full of trolls, where are the normal people?
He quickly finished signing, and the leader, brimming with excitement, bid farewell, "Thank you, thank you, Yi, you're really nice. We won't delay your trip any longer, we'll be taking our leave now."
"You've already delayed it,"
Chen Yi glanced at the empty cockpit, "The driver was so scared by you guys that he jumped ship, isn't that a delay?"
"What?"
The man was taken aback, leaned over the door of the car, and looked down at the pilot who had already disappeared into the clouds, scratching his head in confusion, "Then wait for me, Yi, I'll see if I can find the driver?"
"No need, you drive and take me to the destination."
"We drive?"
The man stood still in shock, then shook his head determinedly, "No, absolutely not!"
"Why not?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting on the side, raised an eyebrow curiously, "Aren't you guys robbers? The driver is gone, and now we're the only ones left on this compartment. This compartment should be worth quite a bit, right? Isn't this a good opportunity for you to just take it?"
"Shouldn't 'a thief never leaves empty-handed' be your motto?"
"That's really not possible."
The man said with a wry smile, "The penal code on Awesome Starfield bases sentencing on the value of the stolen goods. For items worth over 300,000 Points, the sentences are usually not too harsh, mostly fines."
"If it's over 300,000 Points, the sentence gets much heavier, starting at a minimum of 3 years in prison."
"In the Ninefold game, although everyone fears death, they can accept it. At worst, it's just suffering a bit on the map upon return, but 3 years in prison is truly frightening."
"They don't even give you a chance to commit suicide in there."
"Being locked up for three years, you come out practically good for nothing, completely out of touch. Our number one rule in this line of work is that in each operation, the total value robbed must not exceed 300,000 Points."
"The value of this compartment is listed at 12.29 million Points; I saw the valuation record at the Law Enforcement Bureau using some methods. Those damn beasts inflated the value; the compartment is worth at most 3 million Points."
"When they filed the record, they even included those fake firepower molds on the outside of the compartment."
"Such valuable stuff, we wouldn't dare touch."
"If you get caught with something like this, that's at least a 30-year sentence to start with."
"And the most important thing is, the tax office taxes us at 50% of the 12.29 million."
"30 years?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but click his tongue, "Actually, being locked up for 30 years could be a good thing, right? Think about it from another angle; maybe by the time you get out, you might find yourself a Ninefold Star player, right?"
In the Ninefold game, the passage of time isn't very long.
Given 30 years to a planet, as long as it isn't exterminated halfway through, ascending to a Ninefold Star is basically a sure thing.
"You're joking, brother."
The leading man said with a bitter smile, "Yi, we really can't take this job. The risk is too great, unless... you explain the situation to the corporation without revealing our names."
"And we leave before we reach the destination."
"Let the people from the corporation collect the car."
After a moment of thought, Chen Yi nodded.
"Alright."
It seemed that on Awesome Starfield, the various rules appeared to be more comprehensive than on Blue Star.
Even with things like criminal law.
And the various statutes were more or less well-established.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 330: "Is the design concept of this city meant to remind people of the power of natural disasters?
chapters.content:
After a brief discussion, several people confirmed the plan.
There were no delays in execution.
The robbers who came to ask for autographs temporarily took on the role of driver, and the group fell silent. Only the leader, sitting in the cockpit, would occasionally turn to glance at Chen Yi in the back.
He looked quite like a star-chasing fan.
The kind that stakes their life on it.
If caught, decades of imprisonment would be inevitable.
On Awesome Starfield,
there's no death penalty.
No matter the severity of the crime, only imprisonment exists—just locking you up without letting you die, a torture worse than death, even though the control costs are higher. But clearly, for some who like to cross the line, it's also more restrictive.
...
After dealing with this interlude, Chen Yi stopped talking and, with arms crossed, leaned back in the compartment, his eyelids drooping and face calm as he fell into a doze.
He still had half a day.
This time, he had finally reached an agreement with the Snow Sea Project Team to leave Blue Star.
He naturally wouldn't let this opportunity slip away.
He planned to take Jiaye around Sky City in the next half day to experience the culture of the Alien Race. According to Li Yi, as of now, Sky City may not be the most prosperous in Awesome Starfield, but it certainly represents the most characteristic culture.
Cultures of all Races in Awesome Starfield can be seen in this city.
In the last few hours,
he intended to take one more trip to Void Starfield.
The terror of the Void Clan lies in their invasions. When the Void Clan invades other starfields, they are nearly invincible. But if a player with sufficient strength enters the Void Plain, there is virtually no danger.
Like Wang Qi, one can freely enter and leave the Void Starfield without fear of danger.
More than 9 million Life Value was already a lot, but he wanted even more.
People are never satisfied.
He was no different.
New players don't have the right to travel between Starfields. The agreement he made with the Snow Sea Project Team was just to let him come to Awesome Starfield—he still couldn't freely travel between different Starfields by paying Points like official players do.
That's the restriction for new players.
But there's nothing to be done about it, no quick way to pass the Novice Period; one can only wait patiently for a year to go by.
However, just when he left the banquet, Wang Qi found him alone, saying he could take him to Void Starfield if he needed, with no conditions attached, but he needed to wait for four or five hours.
Wang Qi had to go back to his Starfield to get a Prop from his warehouse. The round trip and other matters required some time.
He asked him to wait in Sky City for a while.
Of course, he had no reason to refuse.
Such an opportunity, hard to come by, he wouldn't miss it for any price.
An S-level Prop "Longevity as the Southern Mountains"—killing a living being would permanently increase Life Value by 1 point.
This living being is defined as players, NPCs on the map, or monsters.
He had experimented though.
Killing players had limits to increasing Life Value, but killing NPCs or monsters on the map had a cap of 1000 Life Value.
This detail was not clearly marked on the Prop panel.
When he was on the rooftop, killing that monster brought by the Gold Miner, there was no hint of this either.
It was only before heading to Awesome Starfield, while experimenting on the map, that he received the cap warning.
That's when he found out.
It was somewhat similar to the big bugs in a game he used to play, where killing players would stack Life Value without limit, but killing minions or wild monsters had a maximum Life Value stack.
For him,
the Void Clan was naturally the best choice.
...
The journey passed quickly amidst Chen Yi's daydreams, and as they were about to arrive at Sky City, Chen Yi and his group switched to their own means of transportation and headed to Sky City alone.
The group of robbers, after sending the exact location of their compartment to that company, also quickly left the scene.
"Whoa."
Just stepping into the boundaries of Sky City, Tuberculosis Rabbit gaped at the sight in front of him. He had only seen such a city in his dreams and never expected to see one in reality.
Not far off on the ground,
there was a huge, huge, huge, huge, huge... swing!
Yes.
A swing.
At first glance, it looked as big as a top-tier city on Blue Star, and there sat Sky City right on top of the swing, completely suspended in the air, gently swaying.
So there it was, a city perched on a swing.
And the entire swing was supported by two extremely tall structures planted on the ground, akin to an ordinary swing. From their perspective, the structure seemed to be about three meters wide.
It was these seemingly frail structures that held up a city so colossal in the air.
And they even made the city sway gently at a 15-degree tilt.
This was a city that was forever swaying.
"An earthquake every day?"
Sword Without End wasn't so much shocked as he was puzzled: "Although the existence of this city is impressive, I'm more curious about its design concept. The Leaning Tower of Pisa doesn't even tilt 5 degrees, does it?"
"A 15-degree tilt back and forth, that's pretty much the same as an earthquake."

chapters.title: Chapter 438 330: "Is the design concept of this city meant to remind people of the power of natural disasters?"_2
chapters.content:
"Is the design concept of this city meant to remind people of the power of natural disasters?"
15 degrees.
In a math problem, that might be a very small incline.
One could even determine the degree with the naked eye without any calculation.
But in the context of an entire city, that's a bit of an exaggeration. Even if the shaking is extremely slow, it can still be compared to an earthquake.
And it would bring a lot of hidden dangers to daily life.
For instance, water glasses on tables must be secured, one must also be fixed in place while dining at a restaurant, and one might constantly slip while showering.
If you're cycling, a steep slope might suddenly become even steeper in an instant.
And the originally manual piston action could completely turn into an automatic one, not needing to do anything and leaving it all to fate.
Sword Without End didn't have any fondness for earthquakes.
Because many of his relatives died in a flash flood when he was still young, a disaster triggered by an earthquake and torrential rain.
But even so,
he couldn't help but admire that this city was definitely a remarkable feat of engineering.
