Even those architects and designers on Blue Star who didn't care about the construction team's feelings couldn't design such a city. It simply defied physics, let alone considering how people could live within it.
Just the hardness of the materials needed for those two supports is at an extremely exaggerated level.
Such a grand city, suspended in mid-air, entirely supported by two braces—this demands an extremely high requirement for the hardness of the braces.
And this is without considering the cost.
"They must have used a prop."
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with certainty: "It's just that I don't know which prop could create such an effect."
Jiaye stood next to Chen Yi, also filled with shock as he admired the scene before him, something they would never see on Blue Star.
"Come on, let's go take a look."
Chen Yi didn't hesitate; he immediately started the Christmas sleigh and flew towards the two supports of the swing city. He was quite curious as to how the city was suspended in mid-air, and about the hardness of the materials used for the supports.
...
Distance can be deceiving when it comes to mountains.
It's not a child's play.
The city seemed to be right in front of them, but when they actually reached one of the side supports of the swing city on the Christmas sleigh, 15 minutes had passed.
It's worth mentioning that the air quality in Awesome Starfield was really not bad.
The visibility was quite high as well.
Only when they were close to the support could they truly feel the oppression it brought. From a distance, the thickness of the support seemed to be at most three meters.
But upon closer observation,
they discovered that the support was composed of countless tubes, the thinnest of which was 20 meters in thickness, while what they had thought to be tubes as thick as three meters were actually 570 meters thick.
With the support standing there, it appeared like a massive mountain.
And the shadow beside it, shaking ever so slightly and with no visible edge, was their destination: Sky City.
Around the support,
there was an entire army loaded with live ammunition on alert, clearly worried about someone with malicious intent damaging the support. However, when they saw Chen Yi and his group, there was no attempt to stop them. Instead, they approached and began to explain.
It was obvious they had been instructed by Li Yi.
"This Sky City is one of Chief Li's proudest creations, including these two supports. It's not just as simple as using props. A total of 16,239 props were used as auxiliary, among which there are S-level props and even E-level props."
"Different props work together, combined with other exclusive materials that the Former Leaders acquired at great expense to create this."
"It's said that the construction cost of just these two supports for Sky City has already reached 70 billion Points."
This was a guide dispatched by the army, providing an enthusiastic explanation. During the talk, one could see a sense of pride slowly emanating from the guide's eyes, clearly very proud of the city.
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit touched his nose, and the corner of his mouth twitched slightly without saying anything. 70 billion Points—he found it hard to believe... Could there really be 70 billion Points?
But on the other hand,
it wasn't impossible.
Soon after, he asked the question that concerned him most: "What I'm curious about is, with the city constantly shaking, how are the players supposed to survive inside?"
"You've asked the right question."
The guide flashed a mysterious smile and led the way forward, saying, "Follow me, the puzzle will soon be solved."
Suddenly, a gap opened up in the shadows at the bottom of the city nearby, and a flight of stairs extended out, reaching precisely to the feet of Chen Yi and his companions.
"Follow me."
...
The staircase was electric.
They didn't need to walk.
As soon as they stepped onto the first stair, the lift would automatically retract, quickly bringing them to the very core of the city's bottom.
As the gap closed behind them.
They found themselves deep beneath Sky City.
They were on a steel corridor, both sides of which had been hollowed out, and a simple visual estimate suggested a depth of nearly a hundred meters.
And on both sides—
Countless gears of various sizes filled the space, with the largest gear having a diameter of several hundred meters and the smallest having a diameter no bigger than a pinky finger.
It gave off a simple, rough industrial vibe with a cyberpunk flair.
The air was heavy with the scent of high-concentration lubricating oil.
The lighting was dim.
Walking on the somewhat creaky aerial steel corridor, surrounded by gears filling the space and constantly turning, and listening to their deep sounds, they experienced a strong sense of atmosphere.
The sight of those enormous gears with diameters of several hundred meters also easily evoked a sense of insignificance in one's heart.
"This is the ninth sub-level."
Walking in front, the guide looked back and introduced the surrounding scenery with a smile, "Sky City has nine sub-levels underground. The first to the third levels are mainly facilities that service the city, such as sewers, cables, and so forth."
"From the fourth to the ninth level, it's all about the city's power sources and such."
"This is the ninth level, the source of the city's electricity, with countless mechanical devices that convert the city's constant swaying kinetic energy into electrical energy, from a certain perspective."
"With just a bit of maintenance, this city could become a perpetual motion machine."
"It will never stop, nor will it ever need external power."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with an inexpressive face, leaned in and whispered into Sword Without End's ear, "You went to college. Can you quickly calculate for us, for a city about the size of a first-tier city on Blue Star, how much kinetic energy it generates each day by swaying at a 15-degree angle in the air, and whether that converted electrical energy is enough to supply the industrial and residential needs of the whole city?"
"..."
Sword Without End felt a tingling in his scalp but still cleared his throat and said, "There must be quite a loss in the process of converting kinetic energy to electrical energy, right?"
"That's the case."
The guide, with a smile on his face, walked on the steel corridor and gestured towards a massive machine, "The kinetic energy lost in this process won't go to waste. It gets added back to Sky City, allowing Sky City to keep swaying indefinitely, never ceasing, and moreover..."
"Hmm."
Sword Without End, resting his chin on one hand, followed the guide's gaze and nodded in sudden understanding, taking on the air of a scholar inspecting the site.
Tuberculosis Rabbit paid no further attention to these questions which were clearly beyond his understanding and simply looked at the huge gears beside the corridor, deep in thought and without a word.
With so many gears, if one were to fall in by accident, there probably wouldn't even be scraps of flesh left, right?
"If someone fell down here, would they jam these gears?"
"Not at all."
The guide slapped his chest earnestly and said, "This issue was considered right from the design phase. We once dropped nearly a ton of bodies down, and they were all crushed into a bloody mess. Aside from possibly causing a bit more rust on these gears, it absolutely won't cause a jam."
"You can be completely assured of that."
"Moreover, the fourth to the ninth sub-levels of Sky City are all highly confidential areas. Ordinary players are absolutely forbidden from entering. The defense level is also very high, making it hard to breach. Only revered guests personally instructed by Former Leader Li are allowed free access."
"A ton of bodies?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit's face was marked with question marks.
"We've collected quite a few monster bodies."
"Oh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit then nodded and turned to point at an enormous iron sphere nearby with raised eyebrows and asked, "What's that sphere for?"
It was an enormous sphere.

chapters.title: Chapter 439 331: "Li Yi still hasn't changed this bad habit.
chapters.content:
From their perspective, they could only see the lower half of the sphere, and even that was just a small segment.
"Oh, this thing."
Upon noticing Chen Yi and company's attention on the sphere, the tour guide spoke with some pride, patting his chest: "This is a significant invention by our Former Leader Li Yi. He named it the Gravity Ball."
"This one is number two."
"It runs through levels seven through nine."
"Just like this ball, there are a total of thirty buried beneath the entire Sky City."
"The purpose of these balls is to provide a continuous and stable counteracting force when the city sways, ensuring that, despite how much Sky City may appear to wobble from the outside, the ground of Sky City remains completely unaffected."
"You will get a clearer sense of this when you stand on the ground later."
"..."
With a slightly odd expression, Tuberculosis Rabbit remained silent. He seemed to understand, but he still had some questions.
And since he was a good child who always asked when he didn't understand, he just asked outright.
"I get what you're saying, so you mean regardless of how much Sky City seems to sway from the outside, the actual ground of Sky City doesn't wobble at all."
"There wouldn't be a situation where even a cup on a table couldn't stay put, right?"
"Exactly."
The guide replied with immense pride.
"If that's the case, then why build a city that looks like it's constantly swinging? Isn't it better to just build it on the ground?"
"The swaying produces kinetic energy, which is converted into electrical energy, providing the city with a near-infinite source of power."
"Well said, but now I'm curious about something. The cost of constructing this swing, if used for energy transmission to the city, would easily cover a hundred years' worth, wouldn't it?"
"..."
The guide's mouth opened and closed a few times, and suddenly he fell silent, at a loss for a rebuttal.
After a moment, he scratched the back of his head awkwardly and said.
"It looks cooler this way, doesn't it?"
"Indeed."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement, not bothering to argue further. It did look significantly cooler indeed, at least very eye-opening — something he had never seen on Blue Star.
Following that.
The guide continued to lead the way and gave a tour, walking them from the ninth down to the first level, showing them the entire underground structure of Sky City.
Finally, when they arrived on the ground via the elevator.
The tour guide also bade them farewell.
"For the rest of your journey, I won't be a third wheel. Feel free to explore on your own; your visitor status has been marked as highest priority to ensure the best possible experience. Hope you enjoy it."
With that.
The guide left on his own.
And they stepped onto the ground of the city.
"It really doesn't shake."
Standing on the ground with his hands in his pockets, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked around.
"Not bad."
The road in front of them had eight lanes and was extremely wide, with numerous vehicles whizzing past, all of which varied in type.
There were cars that looked almost like the ones on Blue Star.
Some were riding a donkey.
Others were riding on broomsticks.
And there was even a player riding a motorcycle engulfed in flames, shooting past them.
The vehicles each had their own unique features.
Apart from those driving on the road, there were also paths in the sky.
In the half-space between the towering buildings in front of them, there were quite a few semi-transparent white dashed lines, dictating the routes for flying vehicles, spread across three levels.
Many flying vehicles traveled within these semi-transparent lines.
The topmost layer was above all the buildings, with not many dashed lines to confine them. According to the guide's introduction, the road on the ground and the first two levels of sky roads had speed limits.
And you must follow the designated routes.
The highest level of sky road had no speed limit and no route requirements; it was a free lane.
Of course.
The highest sky lane had no determined liability for accidents, and any mishap needed to be negotiated between the involved parties, making it the most liberal lane.
Meanwhile, other roads were regulated by the city's civil laws.
The whole city appeared incredibly lively, and even though the buildings were tall skyscrapers, each one had its own particular style.
For instance, the office building ahead with over 300 levels took the shape of a player drawing a bow and aiming at the sky.
A short distance away, there was a building that shockingly took the form of a middle-aged man pulling down his trousers and engaging in some manual labor.
Looking to the right, the shape of that office building was just like Sky City, also on a swing. The entire building was fixed to a swing and constantly swaying.
One could guess that the floors inside that office building were probably stable too, likely equipped with some Gravity Ball. This qualified as a Matryoshka style building.
Beyond that, there were some truly creepy buildings, like the high-rise in front of them that shockingly resembled a cockroach. It had two large red LED lights embedded in the sharp, triangular roof, resembling the eyes of a cockroach, and long limb-like tentacles outside the building.
"..."
After taking a look around, Tuberculosis Rabbit found that he couldn't focus on a single building for more than three seconds before something even more astonishing caught his attention. Every building seemed like the main character; there were too many to take in.
In the end, after scanning the surroundings, he fixed his gaze on the high-rise fashioned in the likeness of the middle-aged man—pants down, engaged in handiwork. With a complex expression, he muttered in shock and a trance.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 331: "Li Yi still hasn't changed this bad habit."_2
chapters.content:
"Although that guide already told me that this is District 9, where all the buildings can be freely designed without the need for approval from the Urban Construction Bureau,"
"Still, seeing it with my own eyes, I'm quite shocked."
"These people really dare to design."
This city has a total of 38 districts.
Districts 1-9 all allow freedom in architectural style, with any design permissible, mainly reflecting the cultural heritage of the various Race Players, as well as their creativity and imagination.
However, in Districts 10-38, all buildings must be approved by the Urban Construction Bureau before construction can begin, in order to maintain a cohesive city style and ensure harmony between the structures.
This was an initiative set forth by Former Leader Li.
It serves to preserve the cultural heritage of each Race to the greatest extent while ensuring that the city looks orderly.
"Not bad."
Chen Yi glanced around and, with a light chuckle, looked interestedly at the unique buildings all around. "This is good, too. If it were exactly like Blue Star, there would be no need for us to come here, right?"
So far, he had interacted with quite a few Alien Race players.
But this kind of detailed exchange was a first for him.
It was also the first time he had come to visit an Alien Race player's city with peace in mind, rather than destruction.
"Let's go for a walk."
They didn't really have a destination in mind.
Just strolling around aimlessly.
But they didn't specifically have to seek out any attractions; everything in this city was extremely new and fascinating to them.
And the players they encountered along the way belonged to various Races.
Players who could live normally in this city, no matter how peculiar they appeared, like the player they just brushed past, with Armor Plating all over their body and a tongue as long as their waist, were encountered.
No matter how peculiar these players were, they at least all possessed normal cognitive abilities.
This was an unwritten rule within the game.
For example, members of the Void Clan, though designated as players by the game, were regarded as monsters and not players by everyone, because they largely lacked normal cognition and acted purely on instinct.
There must be the possibility for interaction.
In this city, players also looked bizarre, in all shapes and sizes, but most of them still resembled the Blue Star Players, with upright bodies, two arms, and two legs.
The differences were only in the details.
For example, some had red skin, some had a trunk for a nose, and some had large feet, and so on.
But overall, they looked similar to the Blue Star Race.
Perhaps most Alien Races in the universe share a similar physique to the Blue Star People, perhaps this body type is the optimal one that countless species have evolved toward over millions of years.
Of course, there were also players who looked completely different.
Like the player currently standing in front of them, trying to sell them flowers.
"Wow."
A look of surprise flashed through Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes as he crouched down and gently stroked the head of the player in front of him, his eyes showing a hint of amusement. "How much are the flowers?"
The player in front of them was roughly 40 centimeters tall, about the height of a baby.
And the entire person looked fluffy. Although they had facial features on their face, they didn't look like a normal human, but more like something out of an animation, overall resembling a fluffy bear doll.
Extremely cute.
Even the most bloodthirsty person couldn't help but feel their heart softened by this fluffy doll.
This player belonged to the Chestnut Tree Tribe.
All players from this Race resembled fluffy bear dolls.
As Tuberculosis Rabbit asked, he glanced at his personal panel, prepared to indulge the player in front of him, and looked at the pot of Roses in their arms with a tender smile. "You're in luck today."
"How much is this pot of flowers? I'll take them all."
"Thank you, sir."
The player holding a pot of Roses blinked their cartoon-like eyes, their androgynous voice crisp as they said, "That will be 180,000 Points total."
"..."
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to pay, he suddenly stiffened and fell silent for a moment. He lowered his head to look into the eyes of the player in front of him, and seeing that they did not appear to be joking, he tentatively picked up a bunch of Roses and examined it closely.
"Is this a Prop?"
"No."
"Just ordinary flowers?"
"Yes, that's right."
"...How much for one bunch?"
"One bunch is 10,000 Points."
"..."
After a moment of silence, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned his head to look at Sword Without End beside him, who had a teasing glint in his eye, and calmly stood up and said casually, "10,000 Points, is it? It's been transferred. I'll take one bunch."
"Alright, sir."
...
The transaction was completed.
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood still, took a deep sniff of the Roses under his nose, and then looked dazedly at the fluffy bear doll walking away with the pot. He mumbled, "I don't know if it's my imagination, but these 10,000 Points' worth of Roses seem to smell a bit nicer than the ones on Blue Star."
"Yeah."
Sword Without End moved closer to Tuberculosis Rabbit and said softly, "10,000 Points could buy a whole truckload of Roses on Blue Star."
"Eh? That's really hard to say."
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Sword Without End with a calm face and said, "After the game descended, do you think many people would still cultivate Roses? Even if they do, prices would go up, it wouldn't be that cheap."

chapters.title: Chapter 441 331: "Li Yi still hasn't changed this bad habit."_3
chapters.content:
"You make sense," Yi said.
"Let's go."
Chen Yi didn't pay attention to this little episode as he walked arm in arm with Jiaye down the street, enjoying the surroundings and occasionally whispering something into Jiaye's ear with a smile, while Jiaye likewise leaned on Chen Yi's shoulder, her eyes curving like crescent moons.
"Mhm-hmm."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit shrugged its shoulders without speaking, holding the rose tightly in its hand as it quickly caught up to Yi and followed behind him, occasionally smelling the rose it held.
...
After the group had left,
the fluffy teddy bear just ran into a small alley, took a cigar out of its own fuzzy pocket, placed it in its mouth, and started puffing away while sitting on top of a trash can.
It excitedly counted the 10,000 Points that had just been credited to its personal panel.
"Damn, I knew these people had money!" it exclaimed.
"Screw it, that's a month's worth in one go!"
"Should have asked for 20,000!"
Just as the plush bear was excited about its windfall, it was suddenly grabbed by two black-clothed men from the shadows.
They quickly pressed a handkerchief soaked in anesthetic over the nose and mouth of the teddy bear.
It was knocked out in an instant.
"Hurry, take this one away. The group with Chen Yi earlier showed kindness toward him," one of the men said.
"This might be our best chance to get close to Chen Yi!"
...
Time passed by quickly.
At around 10 p.m., Chen Yi, who was sitting in a street-side restaurant having dinner, received a message from Wang Qi. The other party had arrived at Sky City and was asking for specific directions.
Chen Yi sent the location casually.
A few minutes later, he saw Wang Qi, drenched in sweat, jogging into the noodle shop.
"Phew!"
Wang Qi, barely seated and having yet to wipe the sweat from his forehead, waved his hand and shouted, "Boss, give me a bowl of noodles, extra spicy with lots of cilantro, add noodles, add egg, add tofu skin."
Only after nodding with a smile to the Tuberculosis Rabbit and its party, did he grin at Chen Yi.
"Didn't keep you waiting, did I?"
"No."
Chen Yi swallowed the last bite of his noodles, wiped the grease from the corner of his mouth with a napkin, and then looked at Wang Qi with curiosity. "What did you do to get all sweaty?"
"Ah, don't even mention it," Wang Qi started, still panting slightly. "Didn't I tell you that I had a way to get you to the Void Starfield? There's an A-level Prop that has just the effect. I've seen it before—it's a reward from a map boss."
"But back then, I didn't choose that reward because the Prop was literally useless. The only thing it did was allow a player to travel once across the starfields for free."
"Even though traveling once across starfields does cost a fair amount of Points, it's just a million or so for short distances. Unless you're going to a far-off starfield, this Prop is basically useless."
"And for new players, it's even more useless."
"Because to use this Prop, players must be in a starfield when they activate it, and new players are generally on their own planets, with no chance to use such a Prop."
"Not to mention the qualifications to use it."
"But for you, this Prop is just what you need, because there's no rule that new players can't use it. This Prop can take you to the Void Starfield."
"Only, by the time I rushed back to the Qi Daddy Starfield, the Map Reward had been taken by another player who had cleared it. Then I started to contact that person, and it took me quite a while to track down that player, who said they had sold the Prop through a Star Map."
"I traced it all the way."
"That's why it took me a little while, and I ran all the way back, worried I'd delay things."
"Am I still in time? Didn't delay too long, did I?"
"You're on time."
Chen Yi stood up and took the bowl of noodles loaded with toppings from the boss, placed it in front of Wang Qi, and said seriously, "Thanks."
"This Prop is a big help to me."
"The A-level Prop you brought me last time, the one that lets me hear the language of the Void Clan, was a huge help too. Li Yi said you paid quite a price for that."
"Thanks, I remember this kindness."
"If you ever need anything, just call on me."
"Hey..."
Wang Qi scratched the back of his head with some embarrassment and muttered, "Li Yi still hasn't changed that habit."
Li Yi was good at everything.
He just had a liking to inform others about the value of the gifts he gave. Now that he was promoted, not only did he talk about his own gifts, but he also felt the need to mention those given by others.
He always felt it was a bit awkward to talk about these things face-to-face.
He preferred it when others discovered it inadvertently and saw their shocked and touched expressions.
It gave him a secret thrill.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 332: "Although the World Tree can produce Zenith Radiance, but...
chapters.content:
```
"Okay."
Wang Qi glanced at his watch on his arm and didn't say much else. Instead, he patted Chen Yi's shoulder and said helplessly, "My subordinate called me, they discovered a puzzle in a map that they can't solve."
"I need to contact the Wisdom Group in Awesome Starfield to see what's going on."
"Wisdom Group?"
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow, curious.
"Hey."
Wang Qi suddenly smacked his forehead, "I almost forgot you're still a newbie player and don't know about this."
"Outside, many players who are strong and have plenty of Points tend to keep a Wisdom Group of their own. Those in the Wisdom Group are individuals with a good head on their shoulders or have some accomplishments in their respective fields."
"After all, you must have felt it in the newbie maps, there are often a lot of messy map rules."
"Like this time, the puzzle encountered by my subordinate is one of those brainteasers. In this case, they can reach out to people outside and pass the puzzle on to the Wisdom Group."
"It facilitates a quicker and safer completion of the map."
"Alright, I really can't chat any longer, I've got an emergency here, I've got to run. Contact me if there's anything."
With that said.
Wang Qi didn't delay any further. He quickly swallowed the noodles on the table. Then, without any concern for image, he wiped his mouth with his sleeve, picked up his umbrella, and charged into the pouring rain.
It was raining outside.
The rain was pouring down forcefully.
Just thirty seconds ago it was only a bit windy, and now it had turned into a raging storm.
Looking outside.
The rain wasn't falling straight down but was splashing horizontally under the force of the wild wind.
The dense raindrops hit the buildings under the influence of the violent wind, turning into mist like dry ice, making the scene look no different from a fairyland.
"..."
Chen Yi looked thoughtfully at Wang Qi's departing figure, nodding to himself. The idea of a Wisdom Group was indeed good, but many of the maps he entered couldn't communicate with the outside world.
The chat channels were blocked.
The Wisdom Group was meaningless for him.
He wondered whether it was because the maps on Starfield didn't restrict chat channels and allowed communication with the outside, or if they had some special method to communicate with the outside world in blocked maps.
Which specific reason, he wasn't sure.
But he tended to favor the second point; otherwise, Wang Qi's subordinates wouldn't need to contact Wang Qi and could have directly contacted Wang Qi's Wisdom Group instead, not only saving a step but also addressing the issue more quickly.
Chen Yi shook his head and stopped thinking about it.
He then stood up, paid the bill, and walked into the hotel that had already been arranged for him. He gently kissed Jiaye's forehead, and then he carefully placed Jiaye's somewhat rigid body onto the bed.
Sword Without End who was outside the building had already gone down on his own.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui, though, continued to venture out into the downpour to visit the city that had left a deep impression on them.
They just had to wait for the time to come.
Both of them would be automatically transported back to Blue Star.
There was nothing else they needed to do.
...
"Ding, you have successfully arrived at Void Starfield. This Starfield Shuttle consumed 1.28 million Points. It was detected that player Chen Yi used an A-grade prop 'Free Ticket', therefore this trip is free, and no Points will be deducted."
"Phew!"
With a flash of white light, Chen Yi slowly opened his eyes. He was no longer in Sky City, but in the Void Starfield.
Floating in mid-air, Chen Yi looked down at this extremely barren continent.
How barren was it?
He couldn't see a single plant, building, or even a mountain to obstruct his view in the vast expanse.
Looking down.
There were only densely packed holes on the ground that looked like a face with all the bristles plucked out and magnified, making the pores appear extremely creppy.
The sight before him.
It could easily make someone with trypophobia lose sleep for three days and three nights.
As if they sensed his presence.
From the once-deserted plain, a countless number of Void Monsters began to surge out of those densely packed holes.
One, two, three...
In just the blink of an eye, the originally empty plain was suddenly filled with an uncountable number of Void Monsters, creating an overwhelming black mass as far as the eye could see.
The air also took on a faint stench.
The air in this Starfield burned his throat when inhaled.
This wasn't good news for him, although it didn't affect his combat abilities, it would still be a hassle and require him to wear an oxygen helmet that provided the proper dosage for him.
But for the Void Monsters, it was definitely a good thing.
Living in such an environment over a long period could effectively toughen their internal organs, making them just as hard as their exterior.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and when he allowed his body to drop to a certain altitude.
He let himself free fall into the group of Void Monsters.
He hadn't forgotten the rule updated on Blue Star – all players falling from a height of 18 meters or above would certainly die.
He wasn't sure if other planets had this rule.
But Blue Star did.
He specifically descended below 18 meters before starting his free fall.
Boom!
With a loud noise.
A red number popped up in the upper right corner of his vision.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 443 332: "Although the World Tree can produce Zenith Radiance, but..."_2
chapters.content:
"Life Value -78."
With that fall, he lost 78 Life Value.
Yet, Chen Yi didn't feel a thing, not only was his body unharmed, he didn't even feel the slightest pain, and right now he hadn't activated any Props or titles, relying solely on the bonus from his super high Life Value.
Then he lay among the Void Monsters, slowly closing his eyes.
Immediately after, dense values continued to pop up!
"Life Value -23"
"Life Value -37"
"Life Value -19"
"..."
The dense alert sounds, like a symphony, kept popping up by his ears.
The numerous Void Monsters viciously bit at Chen Yi's flesh, and strived to stab their mouthparts into his skin, but the result was that the mouthparts of these Void Monsters seemed to have struck against something extremely hard, and they broke off one after another.
And they didn't leave a single white mark on Chen Yi's body.
A full ten minutes passed.
Only then did Chen Yi slowly open his eyes, shooting out from the Insect Tide and floating back up into the air.
When Chen Yi ascended, those Void Monsters could only roar unwillingly, incapable of doing anything. The Void Clan had many advantages, but also quite a few disadvantages, with the most significant one being their lack of clear anti-air capabilities.
Except for the Void Queen, who would reserve some Props, among which were some capable of attacking airborne targets.
Only a few individual monsters, which had previously consumed Flight Props and fortuitously evolved the ability to fly, were now brandishing their claws and flying up from the ground, while the remaining Void Monsters started to construct an insect ladder, attempting to reach Chen Yi who was hovering mid-air.
"Only lost less than 150 thousand blood?"
Chen Yi's eyebrows slightly raised as he looked at his blood value with a faint smirk at the corner of his mouth, but he said nothing.
He had waited a full ten minutes just to lose about 150 thousand of his blood value.
And yet, his current blood value was a staggering over nine million.
At this rate, even if he didn't resist, they wouldn't be able to finish him off within an hour.
This time he came to also test just what effect over nine million in blood value would have. Now, the test results satisfied him immensely as he had allowed himself to be attacked by the Insect Tide for over ten minutes without a defense.
The end result was the loss of about 150 thousand blood.
And personally, he didn't even feel the slightest pain.
Of course.
There's another reason, and that was no matter how numerous the Insect Tide was, only so many Void Monsters could actually attack him, since reality doesn't allow for clipping through objects.
If this was in a game where players are allowed to clip through each other.
The entire Void Clan of players ganging up on him, taking one bite each, no matter how much blood he had, they would probably kill him on the spot.
"Very nice."
He was very satisfied with this test result; with this, it seemed he could gradually wean off dependence on the Wife-Killing Buff. Jiaye had died too many times in Hell, and the difficulty of returning from the Hell Map was gradually increasing. If he continued to rely on the existence of the Wife-Killing Buff, he would be in serious trouble in the future.
But now it was different.
With over nine million Life Value, he could just outlast the enemies to death, without needing the Wife-Killing Buff quite so much.
Of course, without the Wife-Killing Buff, his offensive capability would drop significantly.
But it should still be enough.
Nine million Life Value still wasn't sufficient though; he needed more.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, gazing down at the densely packed Insect Race, and slowly closed his eyes as he spread his arms.
The next second—
"Seems Like A Demon!"
"Like A Demon!"
"Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle!"
"Violators, eradicated entirely!"
"Other Shore Flower"
"..."
Numerous titles, Props, Skills, and so on, all the activatable things were instantly activated by him, and he rapidly activated them non-stop!
The originally relatively quiet Void Starfield was almost instantly covered with countless attacks.
He had multiple titles and Props with ranges that extended as far as he could see.
In other places.
Various structures blocked his view, such as buildings, mountains, clouds, and so on.
But the Void Starfield was different.
Here the sky was extremely clear, with no mountains, buildings, or vegetation, and the visibility was very far, which significantly enhanced his combat power!
The effects of many of his Props and titles were greatly strengthened due to this!
For instance, the effect of his Attention of Millions title turned everything within sight into pitch darkness, and on the Void Starfield, this title's effect was greatly amplified.
"Ding, Life Value +1!"
"Ding, Life Value +1!"
"Ding..."
The dense alert sounds started ringing by Chen Yi's ears.
Numerous Void Monsters were dying to myriad attacks.
Meteors burning with raging flames covered the entire sky.
Bullets shot everywhere in the air!
A Buddha seated on a Lotus Platform with the Fire God Gatling, as if heralding apocalyptic scenes.
And Chen Yi had completely turned off the alert sounds near his ears, with only one thought in his mind: to accumulate as much Life Value as possible before being forcibly teleported back to Blue Star, to prepare for the impending destined battle with the player who would obtain the "Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea" Prop.
Just when Chen Yi was on a killing spree.
...
Inside the Annihilation Starfield Project Team.
Patriarch Feng looked calmly at a popup in front of him.
"The ultimate reward for this map is—"
"A non-grade Prop, Zenith Radiance."

chapters.title: Chapter 444 332: "Although the World Tree can produce Zenith Radiance, but..."_3
chapters.content:
"Prop Name": Zenith Radiance.
"Prop Level": None.
"Prop Effect": Can be applied to any title, prop, or skill, upgrading it to an Ultimate Prop, significantly strengthening its original effect.
"Prop Restrictions": Can only be used once and only on props, titles, or skills of rank S or below.
"Prop Description": You deserve better.
It was a moment later when he spoke softly, "Go ahead with the plan, this bait should be enough to attract Chen Yi."
"We need to deal with Chen Yi as soon as possible; otherwise, I can't rest easy."
For some reason, he had been feeling uneasy these past few days, with an appetite that seemed to have lost its flavor, as if something was brewing at the bottom of his heart.
After returning from his debut map, Chen Yi hadn't lodged a single complaint against the Annihilation Starfield Project Team.
He had taken no action either.
But the more he remained silent, the more inexplicably anxious he became.
If Chen Yi had hysterically cursed at the Feng Family, they might actually have been relieved because it would mean that Chen Yi, aside from being angry, had no other options.
Hysteria often means impotence.
If there were a solution to a problem, no one would choose hysteria.
This also indirectly indicated that Chen Yi had his own methods of dealing with the problem or his emotions.
Although he knew that players absolutely couldn't lay a finger on members of the project team, Chen Yi still caused him to feel unstable recently, and he would feel more at peace if they got rid of this player sooner rather than later.
Other baits might not interest Chen Yi.
But this one, Chen Yi would definitely want.
...
Inside Sky City.
A player, with a look of painful reluctance on his face, stared at the prop in his hand: "Are you sure we're using this Zenith Radiance as bait to deal with Chen Yi? Isn't that a bit too costly?"
Upon closer inspection.
This player was the one who had slipped Tuberculosis Rabbit the alcoholic chocolates at the banquet.
The player was dressed in a suit, with a conspicuously large rear end; and if one looked closely, it seemed as if there was something like a tail tucked into his pocket.
Fuzzy ears also topped his head.
He looked rather like a squirrel.
It wasn't hard to guess what was stuffed behind the player's suit trousers—a giant, fluffy squirrel tail.
"Little Seven, can you not listen carefully for once!"
The player standing beside him, dressed in the same outfit, knocked on Little Seven's head with a hint of anger, "Her Majesty the Queen said this isn't bait, it's a reward, understand?"
"Her Majesty's orders are two-fold."
"First, continue to look for ways to feed Chen Yi alcohol-laced food and bring him in front of Her Majesty when he's incapacitated."
"That's the main task."
"But if the plan fails and Chen Yi realizes we're out to harm him and tries to retaliate, we should quickly offer this Zenith Radiance. One, it might save our lives, and two, it could be used to ask Chen Yi for help with that thing."
"Whimper."
Little Seven carefully tucked the Zenith Radiance into his chest, his face full of moved tears as he quivered, "Her Majesty is so kind to consider our lives and offer the Zenith Radiance."
"Though the World Tree can produce Zenith Radiance, but..."
"Shhh!!!"
The nearby similarly dressed player's face changed dramatically, hastily covering Little Seven's mouth and speaking word by word, "Are you crazy? This is the biggest secret of our tribe—if those from other tribes learn that we have the ability to sustainably produce Zenith Radiance!"
"We'll be annihilated!"
"Her Majesty will also be captured!"

chapters.title: Chapter 445 333: "Anyway, it's all just some bluffing gadgets.
chapters.content:
Zenith Radiance.
An item without a grade, but its effect can indeed permanently enhance any prop, title, or skill.
It's extremely difficult to obtain.
Only on a few maps, and with a high evaluation chance, does one have a certain opportunity to obtain Zenith Radiance.
You can hardly see Zenith Radiance for sale on the Star Map Market.
Such coveted items would not be thrown onto the Star Map Market for sale. They are often internally circulated within a small circle and are snatched up before they ever hit the market. Only occasionally, some lucky players who get their hands on Zenith Radiance would list it on the Star Map.
They are usually bought in an instant.
Unless the price is ridiculously high.
The prop that Wang Qi had, the one that once made countless Void Monsters succumb to desire, was enhanced with Zenith Radiance. Even someone like Wang Qi, a spokesperson for an entire Starfield, didn't have too many Zenith Radiance in his possession.
After all.
A spokesperson for a Starfield merely represents that the player has won the Monument to advance the game for that Starfield and possesses the naming rights for the Starfield. Perhaps at some stage, they are indeed among the first echelon of players in that Starfield.
But it doesn't mean that the spokesperson is the strongest player in that planet.
And it certainly doesn't mean that the player will always maintain a significant lead in strength and won't be caught up by others.
If news spread that a Race could continuously produce Zenith Radiance, even planets graded five or six grades higher would not be able to contain their greed. Armies would be sent to exterminate that Race and seize the World Tree capable of continuously producing Zenith Radiance.
"Shh!!"
After being reminded by his companion, the player Little Seven, who had a squirrel tail tucked into his suit pants, also realized the situation. He quickly covered his mouth, carefully scanned his surroundings, and let out a sigh of relief when he saw no one was around, warning,
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
Just then—
Hiding in the alley, the player standing next to Little Seven, his eyes lit up. He pointed at the Tuberculosis Rabbit passing by the alley's entrance and whispered excitedly, "Here they come, Tuberculosis Rabbit is here; Chen Yi must be nearby."
"Stick to the plan!"
"Okay."
Little Seven nodded solemnly, clenching his fist and silently pumping himself up inside.
This time, no matter what, he had to make Chen Yi eat the ice cream laced with alcohol in his hand.
...
Meanwhile, on this side.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui walked aimlessly on the streets of Sky City.
As they walked, they couldn't help but express their amazement.
The torrential rain came quickly and left just as fast, having stopped already.
One could see the traces of rainwater on the ground, but there was almost no standing water, which indicated that the city's sewage system was extremely well constructed, unlike some cities where one would need to go out on a motorboat whenever it rained.
"Really wealthy."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood on the somewhat damp curb with a cigarette in his mouth, one hand in his pocket, looking up at these various high-rise buildings in front of him—office buildings, commercial buildings—each probably worth an astronomical figure.
The cost of building the entire city was probably a number beyond his imagination.
Because he had come to understand.
The city was designed with the concept of not necessarily being the most correct, but certainly the most expensive.
For example, constructing a city on top of a swing had no practical need at all; spending a large amount of Points for it was akin to a waste.
But after wandering around for so long, he had also roughly figured it out.
Many of the city's skyscrapers were not built by individual players, but by a Race.
For instance, the roach office building they had passed by.
It was a structure from the Chestnut Tree Tribe in the Awesome Starfield.
The entire building was owned by the Chestnut Tree Tribe.
Including the accompanying commercial facilities and the surrounding stores, all were industries of the Chestnut Tree Tribe.
They were used for profit on one hand, and on the other hand, to establish and expand the fame and influence of their Race.
Even the weakest Races could easily afford to build an office building. If a Race couldn't even come up with the money to construct an office building, then they were on the verge of extinction.
Besides those from the Awesome Starfield, many Races from other Starfields also came here to build commercial office buildings for their own Races.
This caused the cost of living in the city to be extremely high.
A normal player from a normal Race simply couldn't afford to live here.
Similarly, there were endless streams of tourists from other Starfields or Race Players from the Awesome Starfield who came here to visit.
Li Yi was generous.
All players who spent over 2 million Points could be upgraded to Bronze members, with Bronze members being able to claim a free round-trip travel expense once a month.
You should know, the cost of Points needed for Trans-Starfield Shuttle is not cheap.
Apart from Bronze membership, there are Silver, Gold, Diamond, and Zenith members, among others, forming a complete membership system.
This membership system mainly targets players who travel from other Starfields to visit Sky City.
Those who can afford to travel to other Starfields for a vacation have deep pockets, and their spending expectations are very high. Just let them wander around Sky City for three days, and they would spend tens of thousands of Points.
These people would never praise it as good quality and cheap.
They would only say one thing: a remote and impoverished place.
Some people go out precisely to spend money. The value of things doesn't matter; what they enjoy is the feeling of consumption.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 333: "Anyway, it's all just some bluffing gadgets."_2
chapters.content:
```
He could probably see through Li Yi's plan, which was likely to develop the city into a luxury goods destination for all high net-worth clients from nearby Starfields.
Yes, luxury goods.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a face full of emotion, stood outside a mall's glass wall, looking at the massive transparent glass in front of him, licking his lips momentarily not knowing what to say.
The glass wall in front of him stretched out for hundreds of square meters at a glance.
The mall's first floor had a lofty ceiling height of more than ten meters.
And within this gigantic glass wall, there was just one exhibit.
Just one exhibit.
It was like going to a meal, being served a huge bowl, and finding it contained only a single grain of rice.
The exhibit appeared to be a tooth, somewhat like ivory, smooth-looking, milky white with a jade-like sheen.
There was no price listed below.
Beside it was a small sign that bore the name of the item.
"Milk Tooth"
Beyond that, there was no textual explanation of what this object was, just this single exhibit on display.
Although this item had no price tag, he knew it must be incredibly expensive.
During his visit, he had seen too many such things—none were Props, nor were they products of leveling up in the game, but often they were handcrafted by different Races and would sell here for sky-high prices.
It was an utterly ridiculous affair.
In a game where leveling up mattered, anything that wasn't a Prop should theoretically be worthless.
Even more ridiculous was the fact that people actually bought them.
"Dang dang dang!"
At that moment—
A cheerful rhythm of music erupted from the mall called "Emperor Pool," a tune that seemed pleasing and put one in good spirits. Tuberculosis Rabbit, listening to the song, touched his nose and did not speak.
Before arriving here,
The tour guide had mentioned to him that whenever "Emperor Pool" mall's sales surpassed 100 million Points, this song would be played.
And he had roamed nearby for just under two hours in total, having already heard it twice.
That meant that the Emperor Pool mall had a total sales revenue of at least 200 million Points for the day.
That was at the very least.
After all, he had been here for less than two hours; might the daily sales break the 1 billion mark?
Absolutely ludicrous.
He was aware of Yi's Points Balance, which was around 52 million, so Yi's entire fortune couldn't even prompt the playing of the song.
Should we rob this place?
"Cough."
Realizing that an unsavory thought had popped into his mind, Tuberculosis Rabbit coughed gently into his fist and quickly dismissed the idea. For some reason, he suddenly felt what it was like to be bandits entering a village for the first time.
Everything looked like treasure, everything seemed worth taking.
That wasn't good.
"Tuberculosis Rabbit."
Meanwhile, Tie Chui, who was staring at the ivory-like item on the glass wall, said somewhat blankly, "This looks like it should be a prohibited item, right? I remember learning something about that somewhere."
"Not exactly."
Tuberculosis Rabbit patted Tie Chui on the back and casually explained, "This thing looks like ivory, and ivory is considered a semi-banned item on Blue Star, but that's all it does—look like it. The name here is 'Milk Tooth,' not clear what exactly it is."
"Anyway, it's just some stuff to bamboozle people."
"To fool the idiots."
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to move on, a voice beside him, steady and tinged with contempt, suddenly reached his ear.
"To fool the idiots?"
"It's laughable, don't confuse ignorance for fearlessness!"
"In the eyes of the poor, anything they can't afford is a scam targeting fools."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit froze for a moment, then turned to look towards the source of the voice, only to see a middle-aged man in a suit and shoes looking down at him with a trace of scorn. Next to the middle-aged man hung a tall woman in a strapless gown.
The two looked almost like Blue Star People.
The only difference was the man's dark skin and the three wave-like marks on his forehead.
The woman beside him had a fluffy tail that looked like that of a fox, swaying gently from side to side, highly alluring.
```
"Wow."
Seeing this, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but grin and chuckle, "Pretty good at playing, huh? Over at our place, everyone who plays with these butt plug tails does it in private, and there's only one man who goes around flaunting it."
"Never thought I'd run into another of my kind in Sky City."
"How about I introduce you guys? I have a feeling you'll get along great."
While waiting for Yi, Chen Yi had nothing but time on his hands, and he didn't mind teasing someone who came up offering entertainment.
The combination before him was like those clearly defined villainous groups in TV dramas.
The kind that were bound to be slapped in the face.
And as the standoff continued, numerous law enforcement officers, dressed in uniforms and wearing earpieces, began to approach him without expression, subtly closing in on Tuberculosis Rabbit's side.
The others were unaware.
But these officials of Sky City had all received the order as soon as Tuberculosis Rabbit and his group entered the city: these people were guests of Chief Li, not to be slighted in any way.
Seeing that a conflict was about to arise,
they naturally approached first, to prevent any harm to Chief Li's guests should the situation escalate seriously.
...
Meanwhile, the middle-aged man standing across from Tuberculosis Rabbit noticed the slow encroachment of the law enforcement officers and a flicker of surprise crossed his eyes. He had long known that Sky City was the most upscale among several cities in the nearby Awesome Starfield.
And his visit today confirmed it.
Just look at this service.
A tiny spark was all it took, and the officers were already positioning themselves to control the scene, a service not found in other cities.
Impressive.
Then, with his mood slightly eased, the middle-aged man looked at the approaching law enforcement officers, waved his arms lightly in the air a few times, and with a smile that carried an air of leadership, said, "Thank you for your hard work. Don't worry, there won't be a conflict, my safety isn't threatened."
"I'm just chatting with this bumpkin."
"..."
"..."
The law enforcement officers who were already in position remained expressionless and silent, inwardly rolling their eyes—who's worrying about your safety?
If you so much as make a move, today you definitely won't be leaving Sky City, let alone anything else.
The privileges Chief Li granted these distinguished guests were the highest possible.
What do the highest privileges imply? To put it bluntly, whoever dares to provoke a guest with the highest privileges gets arrested and taken for interrogation.
Those from high-ranking planets with backing might just get fined and let go.
Those from less influential Fourfold Planets could be pulled away to serve life sentences until death.
There's no helping it. It would be troublesome to go to hell to find someone for a death sentence, and it would introduce too many unstable and uncertain factors. Hence on Awesome Starfield, most people tend to prefer imprisonment as a way to deal with their enemies.
"First of all—"
Feeling like he had the situation under control, the middle-aged man glanced around at the onlookers and straightened his collar before pointing at the 'Milk Tooth' inside the glass window, beginning his explanation.
"This object is called Milk Tooth, a specialty of the Lisu Tribe; its very birth..."
"..."
As the middle-aged man was waxing eloquent with his explanations, Little Seven and another gamer who were hiding in the crowd exchanged glances, ready to make their move.
Chen Yi wasn't there.
But by capturing Tuberculosis Rabbit first, Chen Yi would certainly come to the rescue, and then they could catch them all in one fell swoop!
...
The middle-aged man spoke with fervor for five whole minutes.
Then, a bit parched and weary, he turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit: "Do you understand now? Do you realize the value of this item? Is it still something to cheat fools with?"
"Are you from the Lisu Tribe?"
"Indeed."
"I understand now."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully, not getting angry. The man had just spent a lot of time introducing the origins of the item, explaining it takes hundreds of years to form and existed even before the level-up game began. It has a scent that could never be erased.
Placed beside the bed, it could serve to purify one's mind.
However, if that were true, on Blue Star there was no shortage of such items.
Tea leaves, ceramics, and so on.
He wondered if Sky City had them—if not, coupled with Yi's gimmicks, perhaps Blue Star could also open a marketplace here in Sky City and make a fortune.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 335: "There's absolutely no need to spend a Zenith Radiance for this.
chapters.content:
Tuberculosis Rabbit's thoughts raced, and, he had to admit, it was indeed a good idea.
It's just luxury goods, after all.
Blue Star had an abundance of luxury goods, and each one had its own story to tell.
All imbued with cultural depth and the accumulation of time.
He also noticed that the luxury goods sold in Sky City were of intrinsic value or heritage; none were mere brand labels.
There are two kinds of luxury goods on Blue Star.
One kind has cultural significance and is costly to produce, while the other is simply about the label—the brand is what's valuable, not the product itself.
If...
"Hey, are you getting this?"
The daydreaming Tuberculosis Rabbit had completely forgotten about the middle-aged man taunting him; it was only when he heard the man's voice that he snapped back to attention and nodded seriously, "I get it."
He then headed towards the entrance of the mall, intending to give it a thorough look to see if he could find a way for Yi to strike it rich.
But clearly, the middle-aged man had no intention of letting him off easily and grabbed Tuberculosis Rabbit's sleeve, his face unsatisfied as he spoke, "Are you here to enjoy the drama? Do you think I've been talking to you all this time just to let you walk away so easily?"
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat helpless, touched his nose before asking, "What's your name?"
"Oh ho?"
The middle-aged man paused, then holding the woman in his arms, he laughed out loud, amused, "What, you little rascal planning to seek vengeance?"
"Remember this."
"I am of the Li Tribe, Guo Pinggang!"
"What can you possibly do to me?"
"Know who my father is? He's Guo Ligang!"
"The Chief Administrative Officer of the Li Tribe on Threefold Planet!"
Without speaking, Tuberculosis Rabbit just looked at his chat panel and began to message Yi. Yi had a title that he had not had the chance to use yet, so he thought to see how it would work today.
As he sent the message, he muttered to himself,
"What an outdated villain's cliché speech. Back in our Awesome Starfield, even primary school baddies don't talk like that anymore."
"Your dad, you ask? Do you know who my big brother is?"
The next second—
Just as the middle-aged man continued to laugh loudly, he was startled awake by the sudden system notification chime in his ear, and then by the pop-up window that appeared before his eyes.
'Ding!'
'Notification: Blue Star human race player Chen Yi has activated the title - Wildfire Burns Out for the entire Li Tribe players.'
'All Li Tribe players will be forced to wear the exclusive title - Target of God Yi, and it cannot be removed or hidden by any means.'
After reading the system pop-up, the middle-aged man subconsciously looked up at the title that had somehow been displayed above his head without his consent.
'Target of God Yi'
"..."
Almost instantly, the formerly sneering middle-aged man turned deathly pale, his eyes in disbelief as he looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit, "You... you know Chen Yi?"
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit scoffed and sighed before pointing to the title above his head, "Although I rarely show up on camera, I didn't expect to be this inconspicuous. Even if you don't recognize me, don't you think the string of titles above my head looks a lot like Yi's?"
"Okay, I'm off."
"Better hurry home and enjoy a few more hotpot meals with your family."
"After that, your entire tribe will go to hell to work as janitors. Hotpots are quite rare down there; if I remember correctly, a janitor even robbed us of a hotpot meal the other time."
"Till we meet again."
Having said that, Tuberculosis Rabbit ignored the couple and walked straight towards the entrance of the mall with Tie Chui.
As for what followed.
He didn't need to deal with it.
The Li Tribe would figure it out for themselves. Being this brazen on Threefold Planet was no different from courting death.
...
Meanwhile,
In the Awesome Starfield, all the players of the Li Tribe were bewildered, looking up at the title suddenly forced upon them.
Chen Yi.
They certainly knew of him; they had just been watching his live stream.
But they hadn't done anything, so why were they suddenly being targeted?
Targeted by Chen Yi?
The thought of Chen Yi's combat scenes from the recent live broadcast sent shivers down their spines; could one of them have caused trouble outside and been caught by Chen Yi?
Damn it!
...
After wandering around the mall for half an hour, Tuberculosis Rabbit, finally tired, let out a long sigh. On his way, every item he came across had neither tag nor price listed; when he casually inquired about a price,
None were under a million Points.
The highest one, 27 million Points.
Awesome.
Besides awesome, what more could he say?
But having come all this way, he still bought a luxury item; he couldn't just leave empty-handed, could he?
"180k, right?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit nearly winced in pain as he looked at the ear-picking spoon wrapped in an expensive box and asked expressionlessly, "No discount, huh?"
"None."
The saleswoman behind the counter was very professional, her hands crossed in front of her abdomen, as she responded gently, "Our items here don't have any discounts or promotions. Sir can rest assured that we will never reduce prices."
"In any case of a price drop, sir can apply for a tenfold price guarantee."
"Alright."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, expressionless, packed the ear-picking spoon into the box and after paying, prepared to leave. That was when the saleswoman suddenly said, "Sir, there's just a momentary tagging procedure to complete."

chapters.title: Chapter 448 335: "There's absolutely no need to spend a Zenith Radiance for this."_2
chapters.content:
"Branding?"
"Yep, most of the items purchased here, need to be engraved with the 'Yi She' trademark after the customer has completed the purchase."
"This 'Yi She' trademark is specially designed by Chief Li."
"Understood."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully and returned the box. He could understand this; after all, without a brand, how could people tell at a glance that you've purchased something extremely expensive, right?
The point of luxury goods is to let others see at a glance that you've bought something very expensive.
Without a brand, what kind of luxury goods are they?
'Yi She' must be the meaning of Li Yi luxury goods.
But it looked like Li Yi had quite an appetite, demanding all luxury goods of any race be produced without a brand, and then be universally stamped with the 'Yi She' mark upon sale—this was surely a monopolistic practice.
Very soon.
The cashier returned the box to him.
"Sir, the receipt is in the bag. Please keep it safe."
"Oh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit took out the ear-picking spoon from the box and examined it, only to see that the spoon was hand-engraved with the small characters 'Yi She' and next to it was a little star.
"What's this star about?"
"It's like this, sir. All Yi She products in Sky City will have this."
"A single star means the price of your item is below 500k. If there are two stars, it means between 500k and 1 million, and three stars mean between 1 million and 2 million."
"What about four stars?"
"There's no four stars; above three stars is a moon, which represents between 2 million and 5 million."
"Pretty good, it reminds me of the days when I used to hang out at internet cafes, leveling up QQ by staying online."
Tuberculosis Rabbit silently picked up the bag and walked out of the store.
...
When leaving the store and seeing that there was less than twenty minutes until his return, he decided to use this time to go eat a bowl of noodles.
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit walked into the stall, before he could react,
he saw a man in black with a ferocious expression jumping towards him, holding a stick in his hand.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, completely caught off guard, was struck hard on the head with the stick.
"Thud!"
"Roar!!!!"
Tie Chui, who stood beside Tuberculosis Rabbit, let out a roar and immediately threw the bag he was holding, readying his fist to smash at the thief in front of him!
"Tie Chui!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the thrown bag, his face dramatically changing as he shouted. Then he saw the ear-picking spoon he'd bought for a hefty sum fall out of the box and, under momentum, roll towards the storm drain.
"No!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit cried out in pain. It was already too late, and he could only watch helplessly as his brand new, never-before-used ear-picking spoon fell into the drain.
But just as it was about to fall into the drain,
a hand suddenly appeared, grabbing the ear-picking spoon firmly.
A player dressed in a suit, looking uneasy while clutching the ear-picking spoon, looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit: "I caught it for you, can you let my companion go?"
"Huh?"
"Your companion, which companion?"
Only then did Tuberculosis Rabbit notice that Tie Chui, already swinging his fist, had smashed the black-clothed man—who had struck his head with a stick—into the wall.
"Oh right."
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly had a realization, slapping his head: "Someone attacked me just now, and he's with you? Sure, you've got guts."
"You attacked me, huh?"
"Just wait, I'll tell Yi right now and have him wipe out your entire race tomorrow."
"Stop!"
The man in the suit in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit changed color dramatically and immediately knelt, pulling out a prop and lifting it over his head: "This is Zenith Radiance, please don't tell Yi."
"..."
"..."
...
Ten minutes later.
Sitting on a stone in the box with his legs crossed, Tuberculosis Rabbit now understood the whole story.
After making Tie Chui stand at the entrance of the alley to keep unrelated people out,
he finally looked at the two people in front of him.
"You, you're called Little Seven, a member of the White Phoenix Clan."
"\\"We've met several times, haven't we? The waiter giving chocolates to Yi at the banquet entrance today, that was you, right?\\""
"\\"Yeah.\\""
This player named Little Seven weakly nodded his head.
"What's that stuffed in the back of your pants?"
"A tail."
"Show it to me."
"Bro, I'm a guy."
"I don't give a damn whether you're a man or a woman, I just want to see your tail, not do anything else. Why do you have to make it so awkward to talk to you?"
"Oh... okay, don't be mad, bro."
After hesitating for a moment, Little Seven carefully started to lower his pants a bit.
Suddenly—
A huge, incredibly soft tail popped out from his pants, almost half a meter long and very fluffy, looking like a hamster tail.
It was irresistibly tempting to touch.
In fact, Tuberculosis Rabbit did just that. After tentatively feeling it a few times, he couldn't help but express his marvel, "This texture, no kidding, is really something else."
"If this thing was cut off, it'd probably also be a pricey luxury item."
"The name is White Phoenix Clan, so why would there be a hamster tail?"
Only then did he turn his gaze to the other player, kneeling on the ground, dressed in black.
"You, named Wang Ping, you're also a White Phoenix Clan player, right."
"Let's hear it."
"What are you trying to accomplish by going to such lengths against us?"
"If you can't give me a good reason today, don't expect to leave here in one piece."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the tail behind Little Seven, licking his lips with a hint of desire. If he could cut that tail off, it would surely make a comfortable pillow.
There was a group targeting Chen Yi.
He and Chen Yi had long been aware of this.
But their methods were so crude that they didn't seem like enemies at all, more like children messing around.
Especially that determination to make Yi drink alcohol seemed somehow too absurd to take seriously.
If it weren't for the Zenith Radiance in his hand, he really wouldn't bother talking so much with these two.
"An Ultimate Prop without a rank: 'Zenith Radiance'."
"Prop Name": Zenith Radiance.
"Prop Rank": None.
"Prop Effect": Can be applied to any title, prop, or skill, upgrading it to an Ultimate Prop, greatly strengthening the original effect of the prop.
"Prop Limitation": Can only be used once and can only be applied to titles, props, or skills ranked S or lower.
"Prop Description": You deserve better.
"Tsk tsk."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the prop in his hand, and even though he had already reviewed it once, looking at it again still made his teeth ache.
The prop was unranked.
But the value—went without saying.
Even though he had never seen this prop before, he could imagine its allure.
When Little Seven knelt down and begged for mercy just now, he took out this prop without a second thought, leaving him completely stunned. They didn't seem like enemies but more like someone bringing riches.
Moreover, both of them didn't seem too bright.
They both had a bit of a dumb air about them.
And soon enough.
The two provided an answer.
"That..."
After hesitating for a while, Little Seven finally spoke: "The White Phoenix Clan has always remained hidden, unknown to outsiders. Wang Ping and I are among the few from our clan who venture out, and in terms of experience and wisdom, we're among the best in the White Phoenix Clan."
"The mission, mainly carried out by us."
"The Queen's command was to bring Chen Yi to White Phoenix Clan territory, as there's something we need Chen Yi's help with."
"If we happen to be overpowered, we were to hand over the Zenith Radiance to save our lives so as not to be killed by you two."
"That doesn't make sense,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit, weighing the Zenith Radiance in his hand, said doubtfully, "When players die, they go to hell. Even if the two of you get killed, you'll just return to the hell of the White Phoenix Clan and can crawl back out again."
"You wouldn't have to give up something as precious as a Zenith Radiance."
"Do you not know the value of this thing yourselves?"
The cost of these two issues was evident at a glance, not even remotely on the same level.

chapters.title: Chapter 449 336: Fortunately, It's Not May Now.
chapters.content:
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked towards the player with a squirrel tail, his expression strange as he touched the back of his head, somewhat puzzled.
Could it be that his intelligence had undergone a sudden and dramatic leap without him realizing it?
He didn't even know when he had become so smart.
Had he been duped that easily?
It was just a casual remark on his part.
But then he looked at the anxious Little Seven in front of him and Wang Ping beside her, and for the first time, a tinge of remorse surfaced in his heart—he couldn't help feeling like he was deceiving a child.
Was this a bit too much?
These two players belonged to the White Phoenix Clan, which honestly he had never heard of before, but that was normal; the game was huge, and there were too many Races, so it was impossible to have heard of every single one.
This was perfectly normal.
It's just that this Race had always been hidden from the world and had no contact with the outside. They seemed to be a bit naive and not very smart.
"Alright, alright,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit unconsciously started to comfort them, "I won't tell anyone. Can you first tell me what you want Yi to help with?"
"This..."
Little Seven hesitated after looking at Wang Ping, then said, "This matter must be discussed in person with Yi."
"That's probably not possible anymore."
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at the time on his wristwatch, "In another five minutes, I will be returning to my own planet, and Yi is currently on another Starfield. He will be heading home shortly, and you probably won't have the chance to see him again."
"In light of this Zenith Radiance, you can tell me first, and then I'll pass the message to Yi after I get back."
"Of course, whether Yi is willing to help or not, that I can't be sure."
"This..."
After hesitating for a moment, Little Seven finally said, "Our queen watched Yi's live broadcast and noticed that Yi has a lot of experience in dealing with the Insect Race monsters, so she would like to invite Yi to our White Phoenix Clan for the extermination."
"In fact, our White Phoenix Clan has always suffered from the poison of the Insect Calamity. We've tried many methods but haven't been able to completely eradicate these pests."
"We've always been looking for external aid to help us resolve the Insect Calamity."
"In the end, we found that Yi is the best choice, so we would like to ask Yi for this favor."
"Oh?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit asked curiously, "Why Yi? Can't other people do it? Are there any specific criteria?"
"Yes."
Little Seven nodded seriously, "Because we worry that allowing too many people into the White Phoenix Clan's territory might lead to an invasion, so we only allow one player to enter the White Phoenix Clan, which is much safer."
"And the only person who currently has the power to wipe out the entire Insect Race is Yi."
"The reward our queen is offering is five Zenith Radiance."
"This is just a welcoming gift."
"Understood."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, glanced at the countdown on his watch nearing midnight, called Tie Chui over from the mouth of the alley, and then looked at Little Seven, "I understand the situation and I'll convey it to Yi after I go back."
"You can add me as a friend first."
"If there's any progress, I'll contact you."
"By the way, the next time you hit someone over the head, can you not actually use a stick? Can people be knocked out with a stick these days? Is the Fire God Gatling okay?"
"Really, how can you be so boneheaded?"
"Oh..."
Little Seven nodded weakly, then suddenly remembered something and hurriedly said, "You mustn't reveal that the White Phoenix Clan can continuously produce Zenith Radiance, or else our clan will certainly be exterminated."
"Don't worry."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, speaking with significant meaning, "I definitely won't reveal it."
As if it was a joke.
If he did reveal it, wouldn't that invite a whole bunch of people to come and snatch their meat?
Only a fool would disclose it.
Such a juicy tidbit is, of course, theirs to consume.
The next second—
Accompanied by a flash of white light.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui vanished from the spot, without a trace.
...
"Phew!"
Seeing that Tuberculosis Rabbit was gone from the alley, Little Seven breathed a sigh of relief, looked around cautiously, and then looked at Wang Ping, who was still standing there, lost in thought, and asked in confusion.
"Everything has been taken care of, what are you still dazed about here?"
"Let's leave this place quickly, it's dangerous."
"Tuberculosis Rabbit made a good point just now."
Wang Ping, with a distracted expression, stood muttering to himself, "Using a stick to knock someone out is indeed lacking in force; it seems we should also buy a Fire God Gatling. That way, our success rate in knocking people out will improve."
"These days, it's indeed hard to knock someone out with a stick."
Little Seven looked at Wang Ping somewhat helplessly, "Let's talk about this later, for now, let's hurry up and get out of here."
...
"Finally back, huh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked around at the familiar rooftop, let out a long sigh, and collapsed in his beach chair, taking out a chilled beer from the fridge.
He had just taken a sip.
When suddenly he heard a notification sound by his ear.
'Ding, you have violated the October Rule; no drinking allowed. First violation incurs a deduction of 1,000 Points. The third violation results in instant death.'
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the popup window in front of him somewhat helplessly, then glanced at the beer in his hand and froze on the spot.
He had returned at midnight.
It was the stroke of midnight on October 1st.
The October Rules had been updated.
The October Rules included two points:
'All players are prohibited from drinking!'
'All players must perform 200 push-ups every day!'

chapters.title: Chapter 450 336: Fortunately, it's not May now. _2
chapters.content:
All right then.
I didn't notice the updated rules for the month when I got back and ended up violating them right away, but... Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the beer in his hand that he had only taken a sip of, and since the Points had already been deducted, he should be able to continue drinking this unfinished can, right?
He tentatively took a big gulp.
"Ding, you have violated the October rule against drinking, this is your second violation deducting 1000 Points, a third violation will result in immediate death on the spot."
"Damn!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit angrily threw the unfinished can of beer far away!
Now it really meant no drinking allowed.
And at this moment—
Sword Without End and Jiaye had already returned, and seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit fuming, they laughed and said, "What's the matter? Who pissed you off this time?"
"What do you think?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit gave Sword Without End a disdainful glance, too lazy to talk more, and just pulled out Zenith Radiance from his embrace and tossed it to Sword Without End, "Take a look at this."
Then he carefully pulled out the Ear-picking Spoon, which he had spent 180,000 Points on, and lay back on the beach chair, enjoying the feeling of cleaning his ears.
Hey, no kidding.
This 180k Points Ear-picking Spoon really did feel different.
The taste of extravagance.
"This?"
At this moment, Sword Without End looked at Zenith Radiance, the gradeless Prop in his hand, and paused before a flash of intrigue crossed his eyes, "This thing looks kind of strong, but I'm not sure what the enhancement strength is."
"How much can it enhance?"
"That's unknown."
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head with a somewhat proud air, "But it's definitely worth a lot, I got it for Yi, how is it, not bad, right?"
At this point—
Chen Yi slowly appeared on the rooftop.
Just as he landed.
Several notification sounds popped up in his ear.
This included the October rules, over two thousand words, which covered the National Day special activities on October 1, along with some updates on gameplay and maps for the month; he only glanced through it hastily without reading in detail.
He just lingered a bit longer on the rules for October.
Next, there were his gains from the Void Starfield.
Without any disturbance, he freely harvested in the Void Starfield, without any concern for its destruction, making the process extremely comfortable.
It must be said.
Harvesting Life Value in the Void Starfield is much more satisfying than in the Awesome Starfield.
And not only is it more satisfying, but the gains also saw a significant increase.
By now, his Life Value had reached a staggering figure.
'Life Value: 132.7 million!'
In the Awesome Starfield, he had harvested just under ten million in Life Value, but in just over an hour in the Void Starfield, he had harvested even more neatly, bringing his total Life Value to over 130 million!
You must understand, the increase in Life Value by Li Yi's S-grade Prop was only in the four digits.
And now, his Life Value was in a number too huge to account for.
A player's normal Life Value is 100, and with his 130 million, it would theoretically be very difficult for anyone to kill him.
At this time, Chen Yi was standing on the edge of the rooftop, looking down at the building below, with a flicker of strange light in his pupils.
Blue Star had once updated a rule, where a player falling freely from a height of over 18 meters would surely die upon landing.
And now he had over a hundred million in Life Value.
If he were to fall from the roof higher than 18 meters now, would he die?
For some reason.
Once this thought appeared in his mind, it spread uncontrollably like wildfire among dry grass.
It felt as if not trying it out would leave the mind unsettled.
So—
Chen Yi hesitated only for a moment before spreading his arms and jumping off the building.
...
"..."
"?"
Seeing Yi return and just about to step forward to discuss the matter of the White Phoenix Clan, Tuberculosis Rabbit froze in place, glanced at Yi's debonair leap from the building, and turned his head to Sword Without End, "Did Yi just... jump off the building?"
"Seems like it..."
Sword Without End was also somewhat baffled, "But we probably don't need to worry, right? With so many life-saving Props on Yi, it's hard for him to die, right?"
"But it's just from the roof, that's over 18 meters!"
"Yi will probably activate a sled or some sort of hovering prop in mid-air, right?"
"He's not trying to commit suicide because of depression, is he?"
After a quick exchange, they ran anxiously to the edge of the rooftop and looked down, only to see Yi sprawled on the ground with his arms wide open, a pool of blood forming beneath him.
"Is he dead?"
"What's going on!"
Sword Without End's face changed dramatically as he rushed towards the building's base on Green Peak, while Tuberculosis Rabbit also jumped on, grabbing the hilt of Green Peak.
Tie Chui, on the other hand, threw Jiaye straight down the building, and just before hitting the ground, Jiaye summoned Tie Chui beneath him, and they both landed steadily.
Each person employed different methods to quickly make it to the ground.
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to rush forward to check, anxiously.
All of a sudden, Jiaye breathed a sigh of relief and said, "It's alright. Yi sent me a message saying he was experimenting with the effects of a Prop and will be back from Hell in a moment."
"That's good."
