Upon hearing this, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others also let out a sigh of relief.
In reality, they weren't worried about Yi jumping off the building, because with Yi's strength, even if he did jump, he could easily respawn back on the map from Hell. They were just worried Yi might have been subjected to some kind of shock, in case he also decided to commit suicide while in Hell.
That really would have been the end.
Mental illness is the hardest to cure.
Hell Players and regular players can't directly send messages to each other.
But Chen Yi and Jiaye had obtained something before, allowing them to communicate across any distance and location, which eased everyone's concerns somewhat.
However, they soon realized something was not quite right.
"Wait a minute."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the pool of blood under Yi, puzzled: "Does a normal human body even hold that much blood?"
The blood pool under Yi was now the size of an SUV, and Tuberculosis Rabbit knelt down, sticking a finger into the center of the pool of blood.
It sank halfway up her finger.
The blood pool was half a finger deep?
Forget humans, even an elephant wouldn't have that much blood in its body, right?
And the blood still kept flowing incessantly from underneath Yi.
...
Ten minutes later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat atop Sword Without End's Green Peak, hovering four or five meters off the ground with a complicated expression, a stick in her mouth, looking down at the sea of blood: "Has Yi just caused Blue Star to have its period?"
By now, the blood from Yi's body had covered the entire community.
The deepest area had reached a depth of one meter.
The basement had activated its flood defense system, and countless sandbags blocked the entrance to the garage. Doors to individual units in the complex were all shut, and many players started working together to drain the blood from the community into the sewage system.
But the blood kept rising.
It had started to spill out of the community and surge towards the surrounding areas.
If it was a blood pool earlier, now it had become a blood ocean.
Looking at the situation, if it wasn't controlled soon, could Blue Star face its first-ever—"Flood of Blood"?
Soon, another half hour passed.
One-fifth of Yancheng had been submerged by the blood ocean, and from high above, the city looked red as blood, which was, in a strange way, quite beautiful.
A piercing smell lingered in the air.
Luckily, it wasn't May.
If it had happened in May, everyone in the city would have been dead on the spot.
All the players in the city started to gather to fight the flood, and of course, after learning that the blood was from Chen Yi, many people began to entertain some bizarre thoughts.
...
"If we go to the source, with this much blood, could we fill the blood bank and have enough for generations to come?"
That was the thought of a certain doctor.
"Uh... Not sure if Yi would approve of his own blood being made into blood cubes for hot pot?"
That was the thought of a certain hot pot restaurant owner.
"I like blood because blood is sweet. My pillow used to be soaked with saliva/. Now it's soaked with tears/. I've become dark... I love blood... Blood is sweet... I've been through the betrayal of friends... the insults of my parents... Do you know how much my heart hurts... Ha, let the world of blood descend, I have already become dark!"
That was a thought of a certain non-mainstream youth.
Finally—
Just as things were about to spiral out of control, Chen Yi returned.
Chen Yi, who had just awakened, hadn't even started to speak when he saw that almost all of Yancheng was about to be submerged by a sea of blood. He was stunned for a moment before turning his head towards Tuberculosis Rabbit in mid-air and asking.
"What's going on here?"
"Did so many people die?"
"Is there an Alien Race invasion?"

chapters.title: Chapter 451 336: "Why do your eyes look so scary?
chapters.content:
It's no wonder Chen Yi was so bewildered, as the entire residential area was already flooded with blood. When viewed from above, it looked like a flood, with the crimson blood covering the entire ground of the neighborhood.
It looked extremely creepy.
The air was filled with an extremely strong scent of blood.
As pungent as rust.
Several thousand people dying wouldn't create such an exaggerated pool of blood; to have so much blood, at least tens of thousands would have to die, and each person would have had their major arteries cut to produce a sea of blood like this.
But he soon realized something was off.
Because he didn't see a single body.
Nor was there a sense of panic in Yancheng; instead, many players were using various methods to clean up the sea of blood as if they were fighting a flood.
And his clothes were soaked with blood without him noticing when it had happened.
"Shoo!"
His fashion item had a one-click clean feature, and with a flash of white light passing over him, Chen Yi was once again neat and tidy, the bloodstains on his clothes disappearing without a trace, leaving only a hint of blood on his skin.
His hair was wrapped in the viscous blood as well, clumping together.
He looked like a Saiyan who had just taken a bath under a crimson waterfall.
Stiff and upright.
"Yi."
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat on Green Peak, Sword Without End's blade, slowly approaching Chen Yi and started speaking somewhat helplessly: "Don't you know? All this blood is yours."
"When you just jumped off the building, a constant stream of vast amounts of blood began flowing from your body."
"The unstoppable kind."
"It's my first time knowing that a person's body can contain so much blood."
"Here, afterward what happened is what you see now. If you had come back a bit later, maybe the entirety of Yancheng would have been flooded."
At this point, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but click their tongue in awe and admiration: "The last one to bring a flood to wipe out the world was Jesus, Yi, but you're even mightier, you used a blood flood."
"..."
"All this is mine?"
Chen Yi first looked downward with a somewhat strange expression, roughly understanding the situation. He had jumped off the rooftop earlier to experiment if his blood volume of over a hundred million could withstand the certain death from a fall of over 18 meters height.
Clearly, the result was obvious.
Rule Kill was still a notch mightier.
No matter how much blood volume he had, he couldn't withstand the damage brought by Rule Kill.
And now his blood volume had already exceeded a hundred million; could this blood be the manifestation of his blood volume? Would all of it flow out when he's dead?
That probably was the situation.
He had delayed a bit in hell just now. With his strength, he could have returned quickly, but he purposely lingered in the hell return map for a while longer, just to experiment with the effects of his over a hundred million blood volume.
The experimental result could only be said to be amazing.
The opponents in the hell return map were Alien Race players.
The difficulty level of his return now was matched with players from the Twofold Planet.
He sat there for half an hour, while about a dozen players bombarded him wildly for half an hour until all the Props, Skills, and titles the dozen players could use entered their cooldown periods, leaving only some trivial and ineffective basic attacks.
Only then did he stand up, casually dusted off his clothes, and looked at his health bar.
Um...
Lost a tad over 600,000 blood.
Based on this situation, even if he just stood still letting the opposition bombard him wildly, it would take them dozens of days to kill him.
Only one word for that: thrilling.
But there were downsides as well.
The downside was that although he could clear many maps without the help of the Killing Intent Buff under such circumstances.
Without the Wife-Killing Buff, his offensive power would certainly be much reduced.
He could still kill enemies, but not with the usual speed.
His AoE attacks would also be significantly diminished.
For example, under these circumstances, if placed in the Void Starfield, he could single-handedly fend off the entire Void Clan.
But he wouldn't be able to kill as quickly as he just did.
But let's not forget he has an unimpressive B-class Prop—
The Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle.
The most important effect of this rifle is that it deducts blood by a percentage.
Theoretically, with the boost of super high blood volume, as long as he remains alive, he could clear any map.
Even high-level bosses would eventually be worn down by him.
Although certainly not as good as the boost under the Wife-Killing Buff, it's not like before when losing the Wife-Killing Buff would significantly reduce combat power; overall, he would be much stronger.
"Alright."
He shook his head and then turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit, saying, "I'm going to clean up first, you guys go down and figure out how to deal with these players and clean up the blood."
He needed to quickly take a shower; his arms, legs, and hair were covered with bloodstains, and not bathing was rather uncomfortable.
And this blood needed to be dealt with as soon as possible, in the sizzling summer, this stuff would soon dry up.
"Understood!"
...
After the shower, Chen Yi, with his Vitality restored, returned to the rooftop.
By this time, the blood beneath Yancheng was gradually cleaned up.
Thanks to a myriad of players' various wacky Prop boosts, the blood was quickly dealt with.
Like a player holding a Prop that could absorb blood.
And they were excitedly and madly soaking up the blood before them!
'Prop Name': Blood Impulse!
'Prop Level': C-class.
'Prop Description': This Prop can absorb and store blood, allowing for a one-time transformation of all the absorbed blood into a powerful single strike against enemies, with no upper limit to storage, and the stored blood can be used to defend against multiple assaults.

chapters.title: Chapter 452 336: "Why do your eyes look so terrifying?"_2
chapters.content:
```
"Prop Restriction": Only capable of collecting blood from players.
"Prop Description": "The victor should possess the rewards of their victories!"
"Destiny is in my hands, destiny is in my hands!"
At this moment, the player's face radiated excitement as he held an item that resembled a prop from Bala's Little Magic Fairy, frantically absorbing the blood around him, while the blood storage progress on the prop panel skyrocketed!
This was his chance!
Normally, trying to collect blood from players was exceedingly difficult.
He had tried going to the blood bank.
But to no effect.
The blood in the blood bank was mostly donated by people on Blue Star before the upgrade of the game began, and there were no players on Blue Star back then; nor had the game yet arrived, so that batch of blood wasn't considered player blood.
This only increased the difficulty of his collection.
What's most important was that even if he painstakingly gathered the blood to a not-so-low level for this prop, its power was not very great, as it was merely a C-class prop, which made his effort and the return completely disproportionate.
On regular days, he would only harvest it when he happened across it and wouldn't specifically go out of his way to do anything for this prop.
But today was different!
Although the prop's blood-absorbing power wasn't too great!
You can't ignore the sheer amount of blood being absorbed!
The current influx of blood was making the prop's blood storage value soar. On normal days, getting to 100 layers was enough to unleash a blood pulse capable of destroying a bungalow, but now he had already collected a staggering 6200 layers!
And it was still climbing rapidly!
It was foreseeable that when this strike was released, it could probably instantly take out a minor boss.
In the end—
The value stopped at 8900 layers.
"What a pity."
The player looked regretfully at the Garden District, now thoroughly emptied of blood, standing at the entrance of the district, his gaze turning toward Chen Yi's building. His heart fluttered as he licked the corner of his mouth.
If only Yi could die a few more times.
Ideally, die in the wilderness.
Just him alone.
Without so many people competing for the blood, allowing him to collect it slowly by himself.
A few more deaths would let him collect a few million layers.
With that, the next time the Alien Race invaded, maybe there wouldn't even be a need for Yi to make a move; he could just shout about believing in the light and wipe them all out.
This wasn't an impossible scenario.
The most terrifying aspect of props without limits is exactly that: their lack of limits.
Even if it's just a C-class prop with not so high damage!
As long as it has no upper limit, then theoretically, it could unleash power comparable to S-class or even SSS-class props.
...
At this time, Chen Yi was unaware that there was a player greedily eyeing him at the entrance of the district; otherwise, he certainly would've been excited about this C-class prop too.
It's just a few more deaths.
As long as he could charge the prop with enough blood to a sufficiently high number of layers, that would be enough.
What's most important is that this time, since he returned after half an hour, his blood had not yet finished flowing out, thus he had interrupted the spellcasting prematurely.
If he had come back later, after all his blood had flowed out, then it's unclear how much energy a single death could charge.
"Zenith Radiance?"
At this moment, Chen Yi raised an eyebrow as he looked at the prop handed to him by Tuberculosis Rabbit. Upon seeing the prop's panel, his heart was instantly stirred.
This prop had only one function.
And that was to significantly enhance one of his props, skills, or titles.
But since it was a one-time use and its uses couldn't be recharged by any means, otherwise it would be possible to use this Zenith Radiance unlimited times under the Wife-Killing Buff state.
Now, he was hesitating about which of his props or titles to use it on.
What he really hoped for in his heart was that the title "Wife-Killing Maniac" would be upgraded to a zenith title.
```
The title's effect was that after killing a beloved person, you would gain the effect of all skills and props having no cooldown for an hour, which under the enhancement of the Jade Fishing Rod, could be extended to an hour and a half.
If this title could be upgraded to an Ultimate Title.
The effect would be even stronger.
For example, the time could be extended to three hours?
Or maybe you wouldn't need to kill your beloved one and could activate it directly?
Or perhaps the activation conditions could be lowered?
If only the conditions could be changed from killing the most beloved person to killing the most important person.
Chen Yi looked towards Tuberculosis Rabbit with a slightly strange expression, considering that Tuberculosis Rabbit had rarely descended to hell and, in the eyes of all of them, was the one who had returned from hell's maps with the lowest difficulty.
Almost the same as Tie Chui.
"Yi?"
Feeling somewhat hair-raising under Chen Yi's gaze, Tuberculosis Rabbit instinctively shrank his neck and whispered, "Why does your look seem so scary?"
Chen Yi shook his head to dismiss the haphazard thoughts in his mind, then looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit seriously and said with a frown, "You just mentioned that this prop was a gift from the White Phoenix Clan to me."
"They want me to do them a favor by eradicating the Insect Calamity within their race."
"And the reward is five more Zenith Radiance props in addition to this one?"
"And this race has the ability to continuously produce Zenith Radiance but warned us that this news must not be leaked, otherwise, catastrophe would ensue?"
"Yeah."
Helplessly, Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, "That's right. Actually, I'm still a bit confused because these guys came to us on their own, just like picking up something for free, which makes it hard not to suspect a trap."
"But Yi, you haven't met Little Seven and Wang Ping. The cluelessness in their eyes makes it hard for people to suspect a trap. The players of this race seem a bit naive due to their long isolation."
"Kind of dumb."
"Each one also has a squirrel head behind them, which is pretty cute."
"Isolation?"
Chen Yi's brows furrowed slightly as he fell silent. How could there be such a thing as isolation in this upgrade game? As long as you're in Starfield, how could you hide? Where could you hide where you wouldn't be found?
After pondering for a while, he decided to ask about the exact value of Zenith Radiance in the 33 Club chat group.
Before making a decision.
Messages came back quickly in the 33 Club chat group.
'I'm Really Fucking Awesome Starfield, Li Yi': "Zenith Radiance, huh? Wang Qi is familiar with it and is extremely keen on it, always buying Zenith Radiance. This thing is a hot commodity in the entire upgrade game."
"A single Zenith Radiance sells for about 8 to 12 million Points."
"That price is already outrageous."
"In fact, this prop is not worth that much money, but since some player discovered that it could upgrade some rather poor quality props to an awesome level, the value of this prop skyrocketed."
"For instance, a certain C-grade prop, though it has a nice mechanism, is hardly useful due to being low level, low weight, small range, and so on. But if you upgrade that prop to an Ultimate Prop using Zenith Radiance..."
"Then that prop would instantly transform, breaking all limitations, maximizing the potential of the prop's own mechanism."
"This item can occasionally be obtained from some maps or random shops."
"Oh, right——"
"There's also the White Phoenix Clan, this race has the ability to continuously produce Zenith Radiance, but they don't often put it on sale, only occasionally stealthily selling one in the market."
"Too bad this race went into hiding, otherwise it would be an enormous fortune."
"What?"
Chen Yi was stunned for a moment, about to remind everyone that the White Phoenix Clan was a secret and not to leak it carelessly.
He then saw everyone in the group chatting away.
'Wang Qi': Don't even mention it, I searched for the White Phoenix Clan for half a month back then. Thinking about it now, I was such a fool; the hiding place of this race is simply impossible to find.
'Beimu Qi': You're telling me. But then again, it's truly enviable that the White Phoenix Clan has the ability to continuously produce Zenith Radiance.
'Li Ba': If they weren't so well-hidden, this race would have been annihilated a long time ago, how could they have survived until now?
Everyone had something to say.
Directly making Chen Yi confused.
Didn't Little Seven from the White Phoenix Clan say this was absolutely confidential and must not be disclosed?
Why does it feel like it's common knowledge, known to everyone?

chapters.title: Chapter 453 337: "Prop Name": Recoil Armor.
chapters.content:
Chen Yi looked bewildered at the chat history in the 33 Club.
These people were going back and forth so quickly, practically stripping the White Phoenix Clan bare; he had thought the White Phoenix Clan truly was a hidden Race, but looking now, how could this be hidden? Their notoriety was nothing low.
"That..."
Chen Yi couldn't contain his curiosity any longer and finally asked, "How come you all seem to know that the White Phoenix Clan can continuously produce Zenith Radiance?"
"Awesome Starfield, Li Yi": "Hey, the players of this Race are a bit simple, they tell everyone they must not tell others that the White Phoenix Clan can produce Zenith Radiance continuously, otherwise, the White Phoenix Clan would definitely be exterminated."
"They say it to everyone they meet, there's basically no one they don't tell."
"At this rate, many players know that the White Phoenix Clan can produce Zenith Radiance, it's no longer any kind of secret."
"If it wasn't for the fact that this Race truly is absolutely hidden, they would have been exterminated long ago."
"By the way, Chen Yi, you definitely can't imagine where their hidden location is, the kind of place you wouldn't guess even if you racked your brain. Wang Qi specifically looked for this Race, and although he found the location..."
"He simply couldn't get in."
"You should ask Wang Qi about it, all I can say is that in this game, there isn't a single Race that doesn't give you a headache."
"Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi": "Speaking of the White Phoenix Clan, no one in the group knows them better than I do, I've met more Alien Race players than anyone else, and I doubt anyone in this group has had more contact with Alien Race players than me."
"After all, my milestone is being the first player to kill 999 Alien Race players."
"Over the years, I've visited quite a few Race territories and encountered many amazing Races."
"Like one called the Pocket-sized Race — all their players are extremely tiny, extremely fun, and amusing."
"And this White Phoenix Clan is definitely in the top three, their hidden location is something that ordinary people can't comprehend, they're not in any Starfield, but in the Timeline."
"In the past."
"All of this Race's players are hidden in the past on the Timeline."
"I don't know if you can understand it this way, if the Timeline is a train moving steadily forward, then all of us regular players are sitting in the seats of this train, while the White Phoenix Clan is like trailing behind the train, being towed by a steel rope."
"And this Timeline, it's different from the regular Timeline."
"On a regular Timeline, when you go back to the past, you have the chance to see your past self, because every node on the Timeline has a shadow of our existence, right?"
"But on the White Phoenix Clan's Timeline, when you go back to the past, you'll find nothing, just the players of the White Phoenix Clan. As for us, we've already passed through that point on the Timeline, of course we won't linger there."
"This means—"
"The hidden location of the White Phoenix Clan is the entire game, in all of Starfield."
"At that point in time, there is no player except for the White Phoenix Clan, absolutely safe."
"This Race's players are roughly three months behind us on the Timeline, they just follow behind us, feeding on our leftovers. The monthly rules that we get, it takes them three months to update."
"One-time maps that we have completed, they can't complete again."
"Players or NPCs we've killed, they won't be able to see again."
"They are always living behind us, and it's impossible for both parties to come into contact, unless the White Phoenix Clan's players actively seek us out."
"..."
"..."
Standing on the rooftop, Chen Yi's eyes began to show a hint of confusion.
Two Timelines?
After being silent for a long while, he finally raised his head to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others: "Let me ask you something, if you had the chance to cross the Timeline and go back to last year."
"Would it be normal to see the world full of people from last year"
"Or would it be normal to find the world empty?"
This was his most bewildered point.
In his mind, if you traveled through the Timeline to the past, that world should be of that particular point in time; it shouldn't be empty, just like Santa Claus on his sleigh who came to find him last December.
But—
Why is it that with the White Phoenix Clan, it turns out to be, three months prior on the Timeline, the entire world is empty, with only their White Phoenix Clan players?
Wang Qi's explanation was because we've already come to three months later, naturally no one is in the three months prior, right?
Like a train that has already passed a certain scenic spot.
Naturally, it won't leave anyone there.
After this train departs, the White Phoenix Clan leisurely arrives at this empty scenic spot.
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End exchanged glances, both seeing the bewilderment in each other's eyes.
"You're a college student, you explain to us what's going on."
Tuberculosis Rabbit was the first to speak.
"This..."
Sword Without End scratched his head awkwardly: "We didn't study this in university, this should be about the difference between materialism and idealism, right?"
"If it's materialism, that is to say, accepting that a person is an individual entity, then naturally one can only exist at a single point on the Timeline."
"But what about idealism? Maybe one could exist at every point on the Timeline?"
"Maybe... I mean, college students aren't omniscient, damn it, I don't know!"
...
Meanwhile, Wang Qi started explaining again in the chat group.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 337: "Prop Name": Recoil Armor._2
chapters.content:
"Qi Daddy Starfield, Wang Qi," he said, "Actually, it's not as complicated as you imagine. I've encountered a boss who could travel from the future to the present along the timeline. And at my point in time, the whole world was not devoid of people."
"My guess is about the composition of time and space."
"You might broadly understand it as, whenever you travel back to a point on the timeline, the world is as you saw it in the past."
"Meanwhile, your original world continues to operate normally."
"This is on the same timeline, just different spatial worlds."
"Each frame is a spatial world; no matter which point on the timeline you travel back to, there's always a corresponding space waiting for you."
"The White Phoenix Clan traveled to a point in our spatial world that was three months in the past."
"Rather than the spatial world of the timeline three months ago."
"Does that make sense now? If you travel back to the past, in reality, you are not just traversing the timeline, but also the timeline and space. If you only travel through time and not space, staying within your frame's spatial world, you'll end up like the White Phoenix Clan."
"The whole world only has you, without a soul besides yourself."
"Because everybody else is three months ahead in this world, at this point in time, there should be nobody."
...
Ten minutes later.
Chen Yi had figured it out.
He wasn't trying to understand why there were such differences between the two timelines, nor whether his existence on the timeline was unique.
What he realized was that none of that mattered.
He only needed to know one thing, that the White Phoenix Clan's sanctuary was indeed absolutely safe and that most players would be unable to find it.
If...
If he could relocate the human race of Blue Star to a timeline like the White Phoenix Clan's...
Then the safety of the Blue Star Race would be greatly improved, and they could develop slowly and steadily.
But it remained unknown whether such a move was possible.
However, he more or less grasped Wang Qi's point, which was to introduce space as a variable along the timeline. The White Phoenix Clan and themselves were still in the same frame of the world, only separated by a time gap of three months.
In other words,
The rock before him could have been passed by a player from the White Phoenix Clan three months ago, who perhaps even urinated on it.
That is, if players from the White Phoenix Clan could enter the Novice Planet.
"That's good."
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi turned his head to look at the Tuberculosis Rabbit beside him and said, "Tell them I accept the request, but how do I get there?"
How was he to reach the domain of the White Phoenix Clan?
That was a question.
A very complicated one at that.
Although it was complicated, considering the condition of receiving five Zenith Radiance, he decided to give it a try. If he could forge a good relationship with the White Phoenix Clan, perhaps he could acquire more Zenith Radiance in the future.
According to Wang Qi,
The players of the White Phoenix Clan were somewhat naive and, being three months behind on the timeline, they always scavenged leftovers from them.
But the overall strength of the clan was absolutely not weak.
For simple reasons:
One, without natural predators or external enemies, they could expand wildly without any inhibition.
Two, they dominated the entire game of leveling up. At their point in time, there were only players from the White Phoenix Clan. All maps, bosses, rewards, titles, and so forth in Starfield,
They all stood a chance to acquire if they wished.
Even though the best batch had already been obtained by the players on their proper timeline.
Still, there were some missed opportunities and, without any contest, they freely overcame maps left open to them, with no one to challenge them.
Just like the World Tree that could continuously produce Zenith Radiance.
As for how to deduce that the White Phoenix Clan was three months behind them on the timeline,
Wang Qi had provided an answer.
As both were at the same point in time, they could sometimes see the completion records of White Phoenix Clan players on certain maps.
But without exception—
The maps cleared by White Phoenix Clan players were generally those that had materialized three months or more in the present world!
There had never been a new map cleared by a White Phoenix Clan player right away, not even one or two months old. The earliest records were always from three months onwards, which made it easy to discern their position along the timeline from such conquests.
...
Truly a fascinating race.
After Tuberculosis Rabbit had relayed the message to Little Seven, Her Majesty the Queen of the White Phoenix Clan personally added Chen Yi as a friend.
And sent him a friend request.
"Hello, Chen Yi."
"I am the Queen of the White Phoenix Clan, you can call me Xu Yue."
With a semi-transparent screen popping up in front of Chen Yi, he saw the slender woman in the center of the screen wearing a veil. He raised his eyebrows slightly, somewhat surprised.
"Hello, I thought we were separated by a three-month timeline and would have to communicate through some sort of messaging, like writing a note on a rock and you reading it three months later when you get to that rock."
He genuinely thought it would be that way.
After all, they weren't on the same timeline; how was a video call even possible? Could this thing actually cross timelines? Because according to his timeline, there were no players from the White Phoenix Clan in this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 337: "Prop Name": Recoil Armor. _3
chapters.content:
"There's no need for it to be so complicated."
The seemingly young woman in the video shook her head, "Since our White Phoenix Clan has a way to send our people out, naturally we have a method to transmit information as well, we have just been hidden from the world within the timeline of three months ago."
"We are not cut off from the world."
"The reason I'm making this call to you is to show you the sincerity of our White Phoenix Clan."
Then the woman stepped aside, revealing a shelf behind her with five Zenith Radiance orbs neatly placed on it, and she began to introduce, "This is the treasure vault of our White Phoenix Clan."
"As long as you help us resolve the Insect Calamity, these five Zenith Radiance orbs will be yours."
"That is our sincerity."
By this time, Chen Yi's gaze had already locked onto the five Zenith Radiance orbs and couldn't be moved away, which meant he no longer had to make a choice and could upgrade many of his props and titles to the Ultimate Edition.
Just as he was about to ask how to get to the White Phoenix Clan, his attention was suddenly drawn to a piece of ancient-looking chainmail on the shelf, and he casually said with some curiosity, "Is this chainmail of the same grade as the Zenith Radiance orbs?"
He already knew the value of the Zenith Radiance.
And the chainmail displayed alongside the Zenith Radiance must also be quite valuable, right?
"Mhm."
The queen of the White Phoenix Clan didn't elaborate, but simply and cleanly projected the prop panel into the air.
'Prop Name': Recoil Armor.
'Prop Grade': A Grade
'Prop Effects': After donning this prop, all damage sustained by the user can be reflected back to the enemy, regardless of spatial distance, with a reflective efficiency of only 50%.
'Prop Restrictions': This prop cannot reflect fatal attacks, that is, if a player is killed by an attack in one hit, the Recoil Armor cannot reflect or store that attack.
'Prop Description': "You hit me, and it's as if I hit you back—that's the charm of Recoil Armor!"
"An A-grade prop, for now just leave it here, ready to be placed into the A-grade prop treasure vault later."
"If you like it, it can be yours."
"As long as you help us resolve the Insect Calamity."
"..."
The moment Chen Yi saw the Recoil Armor, his eyes went red with excitement—this was the stuff of his dreams!!!
With this item, plus his near-billion hit points!
If he went to the Void Starfield.
He wouldn't even need the Wife-Killing Buff; all he'd have to do was lie down and take a nap, and when he woke up, he would see the notification that he had killed who knows how many Void Monsters.
Simply invincible!
But he quickly came back to his senses, shaking his head in regret, "I do like it a lot, but unfortunately, I am still a new player and cannot acquire any props given by players from the outside world through any means."
He couldn't even claim race rewards, let alone such an item.
But then Chen Yi froze for a moment, subconsciously turning to look at the Ultimate Edition Zenith Radiance in Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand and into Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes, which were filled with bewilderment and confusion.
And at that moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit also realized, looking down at the Ultimate Edition Zenith Radiance in his own hand somewhat perplexedly.
Indeed.
New players cannot accept any props gifted by external players.
So where did this Zenith Radiance come from?
"Heh."
At that time, the queen of the White Phoenix Clan in the video chuckled lightly and said, "Our White Phoenix Clan players, in your timeline, are not regarded as external players because, in your timeline, the White Phoenix Clan simply doesn't exist."
"Indeed, new players cannot receive any props given by players from other worlds besides their home planet."
"But that does not include our White Phoenix Clan."
"As long as you are willing to help, these five Ultimate Edition Zenith Radiance orbs, including this A-grade Recoil Armor, will all be yours."
"This is the sincerity of our White Phoenix Clan, as well as our goodwill."

chapters.title: Chapter 456 338: "Truly Deserving of an SSS-Rank Prop
chapters.content:
"Understood."
Chen Yi nodded, faced with only one option before him.
And that was to help.
He simply couldn't just not help.
Be it the five Zenith Radiances or the A-level Prop, the Recoil Armor, both were extremely enticing to him. He would have to make a trip for these two items no matter what.
However, he had one doubt.
"Is that Insect Calamity very dangerous? So dangerous that the White Phoenix Clan has no means to handle it?"
This was his biggest question.
Logically speaking, given the strength of the White Phoenix Clan, they should be able to deal with an Insect Calamity. If the White Phoenix Clan couldn't handle it, then as a player, he likely wouldn't be able to either.
"Not very dangerous."
The White Phoenix Clan's queen said with a slightly headache-ridden voice, "Although the strength of the White Phoenix Clan is somewhat weak, we are not so incapable as to be unable to deal with a few bugs. The biggest problem is—"
"Those insects are from your Timeline."
"They entered the White Phoenix Clan through a wormhole."
"In our Timeline, the players of the White Phoenix Clan cannot kill these insects. It's a rule of time, or perhaps, an underlying rule of the game's leveling system. Although there is no explicit indication, it is indeed the case."
"We can only watch as those insects wantonly destroy our territory, powerless to do anything."
"The only solution is to have players from your Timeline come to the White Phoenix Clan and kill these insects. That's the best method."
Upon hearing this, Chen Yi nodded. The queen's answer had addressed one of his major concerns, but he couldn't help thinking that the people of the White Phoenix Clan were somewhat naive—although this queen seemed a lot more sensible.
But it was still somewhat odd.
This was his first time encountering a race's spokesperson who was so open and candid when dealing with players of an Alien Race, admitting that their own Race was relatively weak.
Usually, people would exaggerate their Race's might to ward off those coveting their Race.
"How do I go to your Race's territory?"
Chen Yi asked the most crucial question.
How to travel to three months in the past was practically a philosophical problem. At least before the advent of the Ascension game, there hadn't been much research on it on Blue Star.
"We will open a wormhole. Once you step into it, you can come to the White Phoenix Clan's territory."
"It's simple."
"Mhm."
Chen Yi nodded, his eyes narrowing slightly as he spoke, "How can I ensure that I can come back?"
One shouldn't harbor intentions to harm others, but one must always guard against potential harm from others.
That was a Timeline from three months prior, and if he entered and couldn't return, that would be the end for him. It would mean he would never see Jiaye Cai Rabbit and the others again.
Never.
They would be like two lines moving parallel to each other, always side by side, yet never having a chance to cross. They would forever be separated by a gap of three hours.
By that time, even if he wiped out the entire White Phoenix Clan, if they refused to let him return, he would have to swallow the bitter consequence.
"When you enter the wormhole, you'll receive a system prompt. The prompt will state that you'll be forcibly sent back after six hours. There's no need to worry."
"Good."
"Is ten minutes from now convenient?"
"Possible."
...
Chen Yi wasn't eager to resolve this matter too quickly and return in haste.
However, before that, after a moment's hesitation, he looked at the B-level Prop, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle, in his embrace.
He intended to test the effects of the Zenith Radiance first.
According to Wang Qi,
The lower the level and better the mechanism a Prop has, the more cost-effective it is to upgrade to an Ultimate Prop.
The lower the level of the Prop, the greater the degree of Enhancement after upgrading, and a good mechanism means sufficient potential.
The B-level Prop, "Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle", completely met this criterion. Its mechanism was good enough, the forced percentage deduction of Maximum Health Value was very useful, and its level wasn't too high either.
If he had any extra Zenith Radiances, he would also like to upgrade the C-level Skill, "Annihilate Nine Clans", to an Ultimate Skill.
This Skill had a great mechanism but was heavily restricted. It had to be a bullet that killed, and one could only annihilate downward through the lineage, not upward through blood relations.
If it was possible to remove some of the restrictions,
Then his combat power would increase significantly.
But for now, that wasn't his concern. Instead, he took the Zenith Radiance in his hand and slapped it onto the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle, which was transformed into the shape of a cane.
The next second—
Accompanied by a flash of white light,
The panel of the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle underwent new changes.
'Prop Name': Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle +21 (Ultimate Edition)
'Prop Level': B-level Prop.
'Prop Effect': Each bullet inflicts a fixed 10% true damage of the enemy's Maximum Health Value, with an execution effect. When the enemy's Life Value is below 25%, a single bullet can be fatal.
'Prop Restriction': No restriction on bullets, but each bullet requires 0 Points.
'Prop Description': In this world, there is no one who can withstand my nine bullets.
'Enchantment Special Effects': The Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle can transform into Santa's cane at any time. In the cane form, the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle loses the ability to fire, but endows the bearer with the ability to see through three obstacles.
'New Special Effects from Enhancement: 'The Gentleman's Cane.'
'When the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle transforms into the Christmas Cane, and you lean on the cane, you can activate this effect. This prompts the cane to fire a flare bullet with explosive effects deep into the ground. Soon after, you can control the bullet with your mind, shooting it out from any angle on the ground, dealing an unexpected and violent strike to the enemy!'

chapters.title: Chapter 457 338: "Truly Deserving of an SSS-Rank Prop_2
chapters.content:
```
"The bullet comes with a 25% execute effect on health, and if the target's health is above the execute threshold, it counts as a regular armor-piercing bullet."
"There's no cooldown, but activating this effect once will cost 0 Points."
Enhancement complete.
After enhancement, every attribute of the 'Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle' has significantly increased. The percentage damage has risen from the original 3% to 10%, and the execute effect has gone from 5% to 25%."
This is an extremely terrifying boost.
It means, in theory, that any boss hit by nine shots from him is going straight to the grave.
There are also a few other scattered enhancements.
For example, the original enchantment effect allowed the sniper rifle turned staff to see through one layer of barrier, but now it can penetrate three layers. This is a minor improvement, which is useless in most cases, but may be of some use when encountering traps and crises.
There is also an improvement to the special effects gained after enhancement.
Previously, a bullet fired from underground would consume 100 Points and did not carry any special attack effects; it was merely a regular armor-piercing bullet. Now, not only does it not consume Points, but the bullets fired also come with the execute effect.
It saves bullets to a certain extent and enhances the harvesting ability.
"Not bad."
Chen Yi nodded somewhat satisfied. He was quite pleased with the Enhancement Effect of the 'Zenith Radiance' this time. With this, he looked forward even more to the upcoming five 'Zenith Radiances'. He had quite a few Props and Skills worth upgrading to 'Zenith Radiance'.
Only 7 minutes left until the wormhole opens.
Chen Yi, who had just returned from 'Awesome Starfield', barely had time to rest before he had to set sail again.
He looked at the time. Six hours later, he would be forcefully teleported back, which would be 07:57 in the morning.
That would be just in time to catch the 8 o'clock National Day special limited-time event.
...
"Hmm..."
Sword Without End turned his head somewhat helplessly toward Tuberculosis Rabbit, "Brother, I've got to go work overtime again."
"Tough."
Tuberculosis Rabbit patted Sword Without End's shoulder with a bit of emotion, clearly understanding where he was about to go. Yi was heading out for a significant task again, which naturally meant Jiaye would take another stroll through hell. And if Jiaye was going to cruise through hell, then Sword Without End inevitably had to go down again.
Apparently, Jiaye also knew what he needed to do, tilting his head as he pondered which method of death might be the best this time.
Before Jiaye had the chance to speak,
Chen Yi smiled and soothingly patted the back of Jiaye's head, "All right, no need to think about it. You won't be needed this time; I can handle it alone."
"Not needed?"
Jiaye looked stunned for a moment, a hint of concern flashing in his eyes, "Is it okay without the buff? There won't be any trouble, right?"
"No."
Chen Yi's lips curved slightly upward with confidence as he revealed his own health bar of 132.7 million, "With this much health, as long as I don't want to die, who can kill me?"
"Over 100 million health?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit stared at Yi's now black health bar and swallowed hard, a glint of shock in his eyes. He finally understood why Yi was so confident. With such a health buffer, as long as Yi didn't deliberately seek death, like jumping off a rooftop as he did earlier, he was essentially invincible.
He finally understood why Yi had bled so much earlier.
So, a player's blood loss is calculated based on their health?
A normal player's health bar is 100.
Yi's is 132.7 million, which is equivalent to over a million times that of a normal player!
In other words, if Yi died, it would be like over a million players dying at once, and the amount of bloodshed would, of course, be enormous.
"Then I wish you a safe journey, Yi."
Since that was the case, he had nothing more to worry about, and he knew that Yi's trip was inevitable, there were no other options.
For an average player, the A-grade Prop 'Recoil Armor' might really just be an A-grade Prop, not even qualifying as such, since reflecting 50% of the damage caused by enemies isn't that strong an effect.
But for some players with extremely strong defenses, the effects of this Prop could be said to be miraculous.
Especially for someone like Yi with over a hundred million in health, hitting me is like hitting themselves.
That's just too awesome.
...
Only six minutes left until the wormhole opens.
With nothing better to do,
Chen Yi chatted with Jiaye and the others while waiting for the wormhole to activate and sat down by the beach, engaging in the 'Gold Miner' profession.
The 'Gold Miner' profession allows for the fishing up of virtually anything in the game.
It's not limited to Props, including NPCs, players, and even project team staff are all fair game.
Like the Void Queen's worm egg he fished up last time was obtained using the 'Gold Miner' profession.
The interval between hook casts is five minutes.
Just enough time for one fishing attempt.
As time ticked by, finally—
The white portal in front of Chen Yi began to tremble, and shortly after, a gigantic hook retracted through the portal, bringing back something that looked like a worn-out shoe.
It just wasn't clear whether it was a Prop or really just a tattered shoe.
Just as Chen Yi was about to take a closer look at this shoe, the wormhole from the 'White Phoenix Clan' activated, a spinning void abruptly appearing before him.
At the same time, a panel popped up.
'Ding, the White Phoenix Clan invites you to their territory through the wormhole. This journey will forcibly return you in 6 hours, and you cannot stay by any means. Please confirm whether you accept the teleportation within ten seconds.'
```

chapters.title: Chapter 458 338: "Truly Deserving of an SSS-Rank Prop_3
chapters.content:
"Confirmed."
Seeing this, Chen Yi couldn't afford to delay further. He tossed the broken shoes he had hooked into the arms of Tuberculosis Rabbit and his companions, embraced Jiaye for a brief goodbye, and then stepped into the wormhole before him, vanishing on the spot.
...
"He left just like that?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked in the direction Chen Yi had gone, somewhat helplessly curling his lip: "According to the usual rules, after pulling off a big job, we should all get together for a celebration feast."
"Like having a hot pot or something."
"But this time, he had to leave again as soon as he got back. Yi has been strangely busy lately."
It was then that he looked down at the broken shoe in his hands.
The shoe looked like something a pirate would wear, a kind of medieval retro boot, probably belonging to a down-and-out pirate, the cowhide was so worn it was barely recognisable, and the sole had cracked, even the hole at the front was big enough to expose all five of one's toes.
There was also some seaweed hanging from the shoe, and if you got close, you could smell a strong fishy scent.
It was extremely unpleasant.
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit was about to casually toss aside the boot that Yi had pulled in with his Gold Miner's occupational effect, he suddenly noticed that the shoe was actually a prop and then looked at the prop panel with a slight surprise.
"This piece of junk is actually a prop?"
"Let's see, the name sounds pretty nice, 'Boots of the Sea God.' It's quite intimidating, even the Sea God is involved."
"The prop grade is rather auspicious too, an SSS-grade prop."
"That's something... it's actually..."
"..."
Suddenly realizing the importance, Tuberculosis Rabbit's breathing stopped, his body stiffened, and he had a hard time swallowing, feeling as though he couldn't catch his breath, he took another look to make sure he wasn't seeing things.
This broken boot is an SSS-grade prop?
It's actually a fucking SSS-grade prop?
He remembered Yi once telling him.
The Gold Miner's occupational effect has no underlying algorithm, it's completely random, truly random, not pseudo-random fabricated by code. Theoretically, you could even pull an S-grade prop, or an SSS-grade prop, directly with it.
But in the process of randomly selecting a target to hook, there is a certain mechanism.
If the item chosen by the Gold Miner is owned, then there's a chance that the hooked item is currently of some importance to its owner.
Yes, he had said there's a chance to hook an SSS-grade prop.
But fuck, Yi had never even hooked a B-grade prop before, who would have thought he'd actually pull an SSS-grade one.
What's that equivalent to?
It's like opening a lottery where it costs 1000 yuan to play once, and the grand prize is a unique skin for the whole server, with a guaranteed win after a hundred billion tries, and then you just go over there and hit the jackpot on your first shot!
This is just outrageous!
After confirming that the thing in his hand was indeed an SSS-grade prop, Tuberculosis Rabbit's mouth slowly opened wide, his pupils began to whiten, and then he fainted on the spot.
"What's going on?"
Seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly faint, Sword Without End, somewhat confused, walked over, picked up the broken boot that had fallen beside Tuberculosis Rabbit, glanced at the prop panel, and upon seeing the SSS-grade label.
His body suddenly stiffened.
Without any pause, his eyes rolled back, and he fainted right into Tuberculosis Rabbit's arms.
"Tuberculosis Rabbit?"
At this moment, Jiaye, who had been reluctantly watching Yi disappear, also came to her senses and noticed Tuberculosis Rabbit fainting. She looked apprehensively at the old boot and took a cautious step back.
Then, she picked up a bamboo pole nearby and tentatively poked the boot with it.
She suspected the boot carried some virus or curse, causing anyone who touched it to pass out on the spot. She knew that she and Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End were in the same team, and they weren't in life-threatening danger, their condition was normal, they had just simply fainted.
It indicates danger, but the danger isn't too significant.
However, just as her bamboo pole barely touched the boot, suddenly its item panel popped up before Jiaye's eyes.
"SSS?"
Jiaye was stunned for a moment, then felt a rush of blood surge to her brain. Her eyes rolled back, and she collapsed onto the ground.
In the instant she was losing consciousness.
She summoned Tie Chui beneath her, to avoid hitting the ground directly.
"Boom."
Seeing his sister and Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others all unconscious, an angered Tie Chui picked up the shabby boot from the ground. Just as he was about to throw it away, he suddenly saw the SSS-rated item panel.
Startled for a moment, he then carefully tucked the boot into his chest, muttering to himself.
"This... this is some good stuff."
He might be a bit slow, but he knew what an SSS-rated item meant.
But now was not the time to care about that.
Instead, it was about quickly reviving his unconscious sister and Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others.
"Wake up, wake up!!"
Tie Chui was extremely efficient in handling things. With one hand, he grabbed Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End off the ground and started shaking them frantically: "You... you guys... wake up!"
With such brute force.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others slowly came to, still looking dazed.
...
Ten minutes later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others sat cross-legged on a clearing on the rooftop, all staring blankly at the old boot placed in the center. Despite its worn appearance, no one dared to underestimate it.
"Yi, are you silly?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit mumbled in a daze: "Why go to the White Phoenix Clan? What do we need those Zenith Radiance items for? This is an SSS-rated item, if we have this, what do we need a bicycle for?"
He still hadn't snapped out of it.
An SSS-rated item, just like that, hooked back. He still hadn't dared to privately message Yi about it, fearing Yi would explode if he heard about it while dealing with the White Phoenix Clan. It would be bad if something happened.
"..."
Sword Without End, on the other hand, stared at the boot in the middle of the group and said with a complex expression: "Could it be that Yi has used up all the luck for the rest of his life? Won't he be constantly falling whenever he walks now?"
This was no longer about luck.
It was gambling with life.
The King of Hell was probably starting to mark Yi's name.
"Right."
He suddenly remembered something and turned to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit: "What exactly is this item's effect?"
He had only glanced at the SSS-rated item panel before fainting and didn't read further down, so he didn't know the specific effect of the boot.
"Eh..."
This question also choked Tuberculosis Rabbit, who hadn't continued reading either, but he projected the item panel in front of everyone without delay.
Suddenly—
An item panel popped up in front of everyone. It was different from the usual item panels, with a rainbow-colored border and rainbow light flowing around, while the text was all in gold.
Looking at it, two words came to mind: luxurious and high-end!
"As expected of an SSS-rated item, this panel feels different, upscale!" exclaimed Tuberculosis Rabbit from the bottom of his heart. Only then did he start to look closely at the item panel before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 339: "Prop Name": Air Roast Chicken (Ultimate Edition)
chapters.content:
"Prop Name": Sea God's Boots (1/2)
"Prop Level": SSS grade.
"Prop Effects":
1: When you wear these boots, you possess the ability to walk on any water surface, freely dive and surface without being affected by water pressure, and breathe underwater at will.
2: When you wear these boots, your vision in the deep sea will be greatly enhanced, ignoring darkness.
3: When you wear these boots in the deep sea, all marine creatures, such as fish and whales, will avoid you.
4: You will be able to converse with any sea creature. If the creature lacks intelligence or language, you will still roughly understand what they are trying to convey.
5: This ability to converse ignores distance; as long as you are in the same body of water, conversation is possible, even if you are millions of kilometers apart, as long as there is a connection point between the bodies of water.
6: When you are on the water surface or underwater, all your props will be upgraded to "Ultimate Props".
7: When you are on the water surface or underwater, your life will be linked to the water. As long as the sea exists, you shall not perish.
8: When you are exposed to the air, you will take true damage, losing 1% of your Maximum Health Value every minute. The moment you return to the water, your health will fully recover.
"Prop Restrictions": This prop is part of the Sea God's Suit. Possessing only this item activates only the first five effects; you must acquire the complete Sea God's Suit to unlock all effects.
"Prop Introduction": "I, Posidon, am the Immortal and Indestructible Eternal God!"
"..."
"..."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others were dumbstruck as they stared at the prop panel, sitting cross-legged on the spot, their mouths gradually falling open!
Eight effects!
This was the prop with the most effects they had ever seen.
Especially the sixth and seventh ones, which were practically bug-level.
The sixth effect could upgrade all personal props to Ultimate Props. They had already witnessed how powerful ordinary props became when upgraded to Ultimate Props; Yi's Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle, once upgraded, had its power amplified several-fold.
If all props on one's person were upgraded to Ultimate Props, the overall combat power would increase exponentially.
After swallowing hard, Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out an Air Food Series Prop from his backpack and, with a complex expression, stared at it while muttering, "Who knows what the effect would be if an Air Food Series Prop was upgraded to an Ultimate Prop?"
"Could it become real food?"
"An endless supply of food? And with Special Effects?"
"Or maybe the quantity and taste would be enhanced?"
He swore that in the entire game, no one had ever upgraded an Air Food Series Prop to an Ultimate Prop, for one simple reason: Zenith Radiance was valued at around ten million Points.
And that was if you could even find it on the market.
In such a situation, unless one were a fool, no one would ever use such a precious thing on an Air Food Series Prop.
Selling the Zenith Radiance for Points would be enough to eat for a lifetime.
Not just one lifetime, probably the next too, living lavishly every day.
But he also dared not make such an oath. The game world was too vast; who knows, there might really be someone out there with money to burn or someone crazy enough to want to see the effects of upgrading an Air Food Series Prop to an Ultimate Prop, and then just go for it.
When the world is so vast, all types of monsters and demons emerge.
If they ever became rich, he would definitely buy a Zenith Radiance and smash it onto an Air Food Series Prop to see what happened.
"Does that really matter?"
Sword Without End looked at the prop panel in front of him with a complicated expression, "Isn't the seventh effect the most powerful aspect of this prop?"
"As long as you are in the sea, you are immortal and indestructible, your life connected to the ocean."
"Who can withstand that?"
"To destroy an ocean, wouldn't it take a star-destroying level of attack? And that's our concept of an ocean. What if there's a planet millions of times the size of our Blue Star, and the entire planet is water? In that case, to kill a player wearing these boots, wouldn't one have to bet on destroying stars?"
"With that kind of power, wouldn't they first have to bring down the whole game?"
"Nevertheless, it's a pity—"
Sword Without End paused for a moment before shaking his head regretfully, "This is only the left boot, capable of unleashing only half of the effects; the two most powerful effects are out of reach."
"Unless we find the other boot."
"But who knows where the other boot is; if it's an inanimate object, that's still okay. If it belongs to a player or an NPC, then that's interesting. Anyone capable of possessing such a high-level prop isn't someone we can afford to provoke."
"Maybe they're already on their way to hunt us down."
"Damn it, I hope Yi isn't tirelessly pestering the White Phoenix Clan only to suddenly receive a notification that Blue Star has been exterminated."
"Why does that feel like it's not outside the realm of possibility?"
"No way."
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head with a serious expression, then pulled the ragged boot up to his nose, took a deep sniff, and spoke with conviction, "This boot has a strong smell of the sea; I'd bet my bottom dollar that is either ownerless or belonged to someone now dead."

chapters.title: Chapter 460 339: "Prop Name": Air Roast Chicken (Ultimate Edition)_2
chapters.content:
"Let's not even talk about the other stuff,"
"Any NPC or player who owns this prop, no matter how slovenly, wouldn't be so slovenly as to ignore the seaweed growing inside their own shoes, right? Look, there are even eggs here."
"Eggs? Wait, let's kill these eggs first before anything else. Don't fucking tell me another Sea God clan is gonna pop out and slaughter Blue Star like what happened with the Void Clan last time."
"Anyway, trust me, this is definitely an unclaimed item."
"It's unfortunate there's only one. It can only manifest half its effects at most, so it can hardly be considered an SSS-tier prop. At best, it's an S-tier or even an A-tier item, but under certain conditions, it can yield remarkable effects."
"Such a pity."
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but shake his head in regret, before suddenly lowering his head in thought, brow furrowed in contemplation.
He was green with envy over Yi's Gold Miner occupation.
That occupation suited him perfectly.
He had plenty of time to mine slowly, while Yi was too preoccupied with numerous affairs to bring out the best in that occupation.
If only he could have that occupation.
But it was only available to players of Sixfold Planet and above or those who have conquered the Monument in the up-tier game. For the time being, Sixfold Planet was out of reach, Blue Star wasn't quite there yet, which left only the Monument...
Perhaps it was worth a try.
Claiming a Monument didn't necessarily require great strength; just being the first in a certain domain would suffice, somewhat like the Guinness records on Blue Star.
Like Li Yi's Monument, wasn't it granted for earning 1 billion Points within the Newbie Protection Period?
Being number one in a domain... huh, what about eating ten tons of shit?
Ugh.
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly gagged at the thought that sprung into his mind, instantly sickened by his own idea. He wasn't sure why such a thought had occurred to him, but he had a hunch that if he actually did it, he might just snag a new Monument.
And his popularity in the up-tier game would likely soar past Yi's in an instant.
But forget it, he'd rather not have the Gold Miner occupation if it meant doing that. It was just too gross.
Consistency mattered; solid was fine, liquid was too much.
What the hell, why did he even need to compare the two?!
Overwhelmed by the muddle of thoughts in his head, Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up and shook his head frantically, trying to clear his mind of the filth and purify his soul.
Moreover, the Gold Miner occupation actually wasn't that strong; it could only be used once a day, and the outcome was completely random. The time cost was too great.
One could only mine 30 times a month.
And in the up-tier game, where time spans are broad, a month is enough time to change a lot of things.
Yi could keep on mining infinitely only because he held the 'Faceless One' occupation, which randomly granted him a new occupation each week, lifting the usual Occupational Restrictions, thus allowing him to mine without limits each day.
"Ah, what a shame,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat back down cross-legged, shaking his head in disappointment, and carefully tucked the worn-out boot into his bosom, planning to hand it over to Yi when he returned.
At 08:00 in the morning, the National Day limited-time event was set to begin.
Yi would be forced to return around that time, if nothing unexpected occurred.
If something did happen...
"Slap."
With an expressionless face, Tuberculosis Rabbit slapped himself. He realized his tendency to babble might be morphing into something worse. Previously, he just couldn't help talking to people, but now he found himself rambling in his own mind.
And the thoughts were mostly of the ominous sort.
"Let's eat first!"
Sword Without End sounded the trumpet of feasting. They hadn't eaten much in Awesome Starfield, and their stomachs were growling. The exotic dishes of the Alien Race didn't quite appeal to them either.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, on the other hand, just patted his slightly round belly without saying a word. He had eaten two bowls of noodles right before being teleported back to Blue Star.
He wasn't very hungry yet.
But it was late at night, and the breeze was gentle, so not having some drinks and chats would indeed be a waste.
...
Meanwhile—
In some deep-sea location, at a depth unknown, currents swirled.
At the bottom of the deep sea where no light could be seen, it was a pitch-blackness that seemed to swallow anything whole.
In this place, unseen by the eye, many creatures unabashedly grew into monsters that would be colossal by land standards, fit to be the climax of a horror movie.
It was a forbidden zone for many beings.
Under unspeakable water pressure, most beings would be crushed into fragments. When the depth exceeded ten thousand meters, the pressure reached a terrifying level.
If a human were thrown into the sea at ten thousand meters depth suddenly, it would be a death with no pain; the body would instantly be crushed into mush and dissolve into pieces.
One wouldn't even have time to feel the suffocation of inhaling sea water before their vision darkened, and they left this world.
In such conditions.
A body, resembling that of a Blue Star human, floated slowly with the currents, eyes shut as if dead, unclear how long it had been adrift at the sea bottom.
The body was deep blue all over, its skin studded with galaxy-like flecks.
About one meter eighty in height.
Inexplicably durable, the body showed no signs of decay despite floating in the sea for so long.

chapters.title: Chapter 461 339: "Prop Name": Air Roast Chicken (Ultimate Edition)_3
chapters.content:
The clothes on this body were ragged and tattered, covered with seaweed. Upon closer inspection, you could see parasitic creatures hidden in the fabric, obviously having made this body their home.
But—
At this moment, the shoe on the left foot of the corpse had disappeared, making a stark contrast that was immediately noticeable.
And whether this body was truly dead or not it didn't seem to care about its missing left boot; it merely continued to drift.
Who knows how much time had passed.
"Sigh."
A heavy sigh suddenly echoed from the deep sea, and in almost an instant, all the living creatures around this body began to hastily flee. The eyes of the corpse slowly opened, revealing snowflake-like pupils.
The body was actually alive!
The man glanced at his bare left foot, was about to say something as he slowly moved his mouth, but a blindingly fast light from another direction in the deep sea hit him straight on at the speed of light.
"Boom!"
The man was slammed deep into the sea floor, and the galaxy-like specks on his skin began to flash wildly, turning into chains that wrapped around his body, inhibiting any movement.
At the same moment—
A raspy and mechanical voice rang out beside the man's ear.
'"Ultimate Two" map activation conditions have not yet been met. As the final boss of the "Ultimate Two" map, Sea God Posidon, you should behave yourself.'
'Any further disobedience, and you bear the consequences!'
"Huh?"
The man, hurled into the depths of the sea, struggled to twist his neck to make his long-inactive muscles a bit more comfortable. He stopped struggling, not caring where he had been thrown, just closed his eyes, returning to his previous state and murmured.
"Why would you give me the name Posidon? It's really unpleasant to hear. In my hometown, that's the name of a down jacket brand."
"And really, you are quite amusing, asking me to behave myself. Didn't you see someone just stole my boot? Honestly, it's so annoying. I should've become a janitor instead. At least I would be able to move."
"Forget it, forget it. What part of the dream was I at just now?"
He had long lost any concept of time.
How long had he drifted at the bottom of the sea?
He didn't know.
All he could do was feel fortunate that he had experienced enough in the first half of his life to combine various fragments of stories from his past into new tales, constantly creating entertainment for himself.
Memory?
It was long gone. He knew his memory had been incorrect for a long time, so much so that he couldn't recall which version it was anymore.
Just to pass time, he had been breaking up and reassembling stories from his life. Over the lengthy stretch, his original true memories had been obliterated by himself, to the point he even forgot why he ended up here.
He even forgot who he was.
He only remembered that the name Posidon was truly unpleasant to hear, and he really disliked the brand, especially their advertising slogan about being present in 78 countries; so annoying. With such a name, weren't they afraid that Posidon would sue them for trademark infringement?
...
"Really?"
The somewhat bored Tuberculosis Rabbit had just sent Li Yi a message, asking if anyone had upgraded their Air Food Series Props to Ultimate Props. Li Yi replied quickly and sent him a screenshot.
They had exchanged contact info back in the Awesome Starfield.
He just hadn't made it into the 33 Club.
The 33 Club was exclusive to players who had obtained the Monument of the game's upgrade, with no other way to join.
The screenshot was an offer from the "Star Map" platform.
"Star Map" was a feature everyone could access upon their planet's promotion to Twofold Planet—a massive trade platform where players could post unwanted Props for sale, with all players sharing one "Star Map" platform across the entire game's economy.
You could also put out requests to purchase specific Props needed.
'Ultimate Edition Air Roast Chicken, for sale at 100 trillion Points.'
Well, 100 trillion Points. He wondered if selling the entire Annihilation Starfield could fetch such a price.
The reason for the 100 trillion Points tag was not that the prop's owner considered it only worth that much, but rather it was the maximum price allowed on the "Star Map" platform.
According to Li Yi, the player was a rich heir from Sixfold Planet who had no intention of selling the Prop; the listing on the "Star Map" was simply for show.
You could say... it was bragging.
On the "Star Map" platform, there was an option to sort items by price, from lowest to highest or highest to lowest.
When players sorted from highest to lowest, they'd quickly encounter this Ultimate Edition Air Roast Chicken.
On Star Map, Props priced at 100 trillion Points numbered in the hundreds of millions.
Almost none of the Props were worth that amount.
It's just some players boasting about their Props, or just for fun, with no intention of selling.
Others harbored a slim hope, pondering whether some fool might actually buy them.
And so on.
There were too many reasons. With such a large player base in the game, the Props tagged at 100 trillion Points amounted to the hundreds of millions.

chapters.title: Chapter 462 339: "Prop Name": Air Roast Chicken (Ultimate Edition)_4
chapters.content:
Of course.
The price is marked like this, but not a single one has been sold.
100 trillion Points, let alone the fact that not a single player in this game has ever had so many Points, even an entire Race would find it nothing short of a pipe dream to possess such an enormous amount of Points.
This is definitely not a small number.
And Tuberculosis Rabbit, with the aid of this platform, fulfilled a wish, which was to see what effect the Air series food Prop would have when upgraded to the Ultimate Edition.
-
"Prop Name": Air Roast Chicken (Ultimate Edition)
"Prop Level": E-grade.
"Prop Effect": You will have a Roast Chicken that can never be finished, made with high technology. Just by glancing at it, you will feel a real and strong sense of fullness.
The Roast Chicken is 1000 meters tall, 300 meters wide, and you can treat it as a giant figurine placed at the entrance of your community, saving many people a day's worth of food expenses.
Moreover, this Roast Chicken cannot be destroyed by any means, but it won't crush people to death or attack anyone in any form.
"Prop Restriction": You may only switch freely among the following flavors—original, spicy, five-spice, extra spicy, salt and pepper, honey…
"Prop Introduction": "A scientist, who failed to diet for ten years, in a fit of rage, invented a total of 289 Air series food Props. These Props can satisfy your cravings without causing any weight gain, and the Air Roast Chicken is just one of the 289."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a complicated expression, touched his nose. It seems that a junk Prop, even if it becomes an Ultimate Prop, is still junk, or perhaps the nature of the Prop is unchangeable?
He had thought that the Ultimate Edition Roast Chicken would have some different effects.
For instance, an alteration in quantity, or the addition of some offensive capabilities; at the very least, they should have provided a proper teasing chicken, right?
Who knew it would just be a change in size.
1000 meters!
That's not low at all, this is not just about placing it at the community entrance, but in the center of the city, it would definitely be a most noticeable landmark, solving food sources for a good portion of the city's players and saving mealtime.
If you're hungry, there's no need to look for a restaurant, just look up at this Roast Chicken placed in the center of the city.
What a mess of Enhancements.
However, he was still curious about other things, like what effect would Props like "A Cup of Coffee" and "Absolute Itch-Relieving Ear-picking Spoon," which are of not much use but have interesting mechanics, have when upgraded to the Ultimate Prop?
The Skill of "A Cup of Coffee" originally makes a player's urine turn into a delicious and rich coffee for 24 hours after drinking a cup of coffee. If it were upgraded to the Ultimate, maybe… the coffee it produces can treat hypoglycemia???
Ah, ah, ah, it's completely unpredictable!
Suddenly, he really wanted to know, really wanted to know what effect "A Cup of Coffee" would have after being Enhanced into an Ultimate Skill.
Tuberculosis Rabbit's expression twisted together as he sat in place like he had constipation, and even the fruit beer in his hands didn't taste good anymore.
October rules prohibit drinking alcohol, so they could only drink some fruit beer.
Yi would probably bring back 5 Zenith Radiance this time, but such things, worth millions of Points, obviously shouldn't be wasted here; he wouldn't ask for it either. But he really wanted to know, and didn't know when one could be truly Ultimate.
As for the Absolute Itch-Relieving Ear-picking Spoon, the Prop effect is very simple: it can instantly alleviate itching in the ear canal.
After upgrading this Prop to the Ultimate Edition, it's easy to guess the change: it should be able to instantly relieve all itching, which would be useful for sufferers of athlete's foot.
Or for those with skin conditions, during the wound healing phase, and dealing with mosquitoes in the summer, and so on.
As players, the majority of their strength comes from Props and Skills, and those like him, who have Props that directly strengthen physical fitness, are in the minority; even the Props that can strengthen physical fitness don't make it too strong.
In other words.
Players in this game might be able to slay immortals and cut down the King of Hell!
But... they can't stop mosquitoes.
Unless they have the corresponding Props to counteract, they can only resort to the most primitive methods.
Mosquito nets, mosquito coils, floral water!

chapters.title: Chapter 463 463: 340: This is not a power, it is a curse.
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: Chapter 340: This is not a power, it is a curse.
“`
Then, seemingly having suddenly remembered something, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked towards his C-grade prop, the Red Moon Claw Knife.
He had been charging it for quite some time already.
Last time, after charging up 5,000 layers, he had managed to create a huge pit tens of meters long outside of Yancheng. This time, with the layers he had accumulated, he even believed he could perform a caesarean section on Blue Star; perhaps he might uncover a small-scale caesarean section.
For his prop, if it could be upgraded to an Ultimate Edition Prop, the effect would definitely be greatly enhanced.
‘Prop Name’: Red Moon Claw Knife.
...
‘Prop Grade’: C-grade Prop.
‘Prop Effect’: This knife is extremely sharp, capable of destroying almost everything you see before you, and the knife can charge.
The charging rules are as follows.
After you speak one sentence, your Claw Knife will start charging, and for every additional 10 sentences you speak, you will add one more energy charging layer.
After the charging ends, you can swing a blade light, cutting through everything you see before you.
The power is limitless.
In theory, as long as you charge long enough, you could even split an entire planet in half with a single strike.
‘Prop Restriction’: After interrupting the charge, you must expend the charged blade light before you can begin charging again.
‘Enhancement Effect’: For every 3 sentences spoken, one energy charging layer is added.’
‘+6 New Special Effects: ‘Ravenous Wolf’s Fanged Tooth.’
‘After activating this effect, the Red Moon Claw Knife will morph to cover your two canine teeth with a silver light, greatly enhancing your biting power.’
‘There is no cooldown time; if you wish, the Red Moon Claw Knife will permanently cover your canine teeth.’
‘Energy Charging Layers’: 97.21w.
‘Prop Introduction’: “Do you know? I really hate those silent ones who don’t say a word.”
Nearly a million energy charging layers.
Tuberculosis Rabbit licked his lips, feeling a little eager as he fiddled with the Red Moon Claw Knife in his hands, wanting to swing it to see what the effect would be like.
If this prop were upgraded to an Ultimate Edition Prop, it would likely mainly enhance the charge.
From the original, for every three sentences spoken, one layer is charged, upgraded to for every single sentence spoken, ten charges are added.
Yes, that would be perfect.
“You need to be careful,” Sword Without End sitting opposite to Tuberculosis Rabbit said somewhat speechlessly as he looked at the Claw Knife in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s hands, “Can you not swing it towards me? I’m a bit worried about your hand shaking. It’s not easy to have a bit of rest; don’t make me work overtime again, okay?”
If Tuberculosis Rabbit’s strike was delivered,
there was no question that he would have to work overtime in hell again tonight, with no other options.
…
Meanwhile,
with a flash of white light, Chen Yi had already arrived at the White Phoenix Clan’s territory, a boundless plain stretching as far as the eye could see.
The grass was not deep, reaching up to the calves.
There wasn’t the effect of wind blowing the grass to reveal sheep and cows.
It appeared extremely desolate at first glance.
Chen Yi stood still, looking down at his own hands rather than making any superfluous movements, and lightly raised his eyebrows. Is this the world three months prior on the timeline?
Aside from the White Phoenix Clan, there were no other players in the world, which was truly a strange sensation.
And at that moment—
“Mr. Chen, hello.”
A respectful voice rang out beside his ear.
“Yeah.”
Chen Yi turned his head to look at an Alien Race player who had appeared behind him at some unknown time. He scanned him instinctively. The player didn’t look much different from the players on Blue Star, except for the large, fluffy squirrel tail extending from behind him.
It was bigger than the player himself.
It looked so irresistible that one could hardly refrain from reaching out to stroke it.
“I remember you.”
Chen Yi suddenly smiled, “At the celebration banquet in Awesome Starfield, you were the attendant handing me chocolate at the door, weren’t you?”
At those words, the White Phoenix Clan player, somewhat embarrassed, lowered his head and quietly said, “Yes, it’s me. My name is Little Seven. Her Majesty the Queen has sent me to receive you. Please follow me.”
“Sure.”
Then Little Seven walked towards the front, seemingly activating some mechanism, and suddenly, a section of the ground sank, revealing an elevator that slowly rose from underground.
As the elevator doors opened,
Little Seven stood at the door of the elevator, bowing slightly and respectfully said, “Mr. Chen, please.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yi nodded his head and didn’t say much, stepping directly into the elevator.
But he felt somewhat puzzled inside.
