Generally speaking, races or creatures that live underground do so primarily for one reason: there is a predator on the surface, forcing them to live deep underground.
This is the same with Blue Star; many creatures that live in the ocean do so because they have a deadly predator on land that they cannot resist, leading their species to gradually evolve with the ability to survive underneath the sea, escaping land for the ocean bed.
Any race with the power to thrive on land would not hide in the deep sea or deep underground.
In this world,
except for the White Phoenix Clan players, there were no other players of any race; logically, there should be no predators, so why settle down deep underground?
Could it be because of the Insect Calamity spoken about by the White Phoenix Clan?
That shouldn’t be the reason, considering he hadn’t seen any building traces above ground, and as the elevator slowly descended into the depths of the earth, the imposing underground world gradually came into view, clearly not something built overnight.
The elevator was completely transparent.
Chen Yi could clearly see the underground world through the glass of the elevator; the whole underground world seemed to have been hollowed out.
The elevator first descended through the thick ground for about thirty seconds, then suddenly, the view became clear, and a city appeared before him, looking down from his position, about a kilometer from the surface.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 464 464: 340: This is not a power, it is a curse. _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 464: Chapter 340: This is not a power, it is a curse. _2
The sky above this city was completely excavated.
Only a few hundred massive pillars rose from the ground, connecting the city floor to the canopy overhead.
It seemed as if a huge earthen shell had enveloped the city.
On the inner side of this shell, one could see densely packed objects resembling steel plates spread across the underside of the firmament, appearing to play a stabilizing role.
The elevator continued its slow descent.
Chen Yi stood quietly inside the elevator, leaning on his cane and admiring the beautiful scene before him; he had to admit it was pleasing to the eyes. Even if this trip yielded no rewards, it was worth it just for the sightseeing.
...
Below, the city wasn’t particularly modernized.
There were no skyscrapers, only two- and three-story buildings and courtyards that together resembled the ancient city of Chang’an. Although there were no tall buildings, it still looked prosperous and indicative of a golden age!
About two or three minutes passed.
The elevator finally reached the ground.
As the elevator doors opened, Little Seven was the first to step out. He stood at the entrance and used his arm to prevent the doors from closing, bending over to signal that Chen Yi could exit. Once Chen Yi had emerged, Little Seven whispered softly with a trace of solemnity hidden deep in his eyes.
“Mr. Chen, this is the center of the White Phoenix Clan, the city where Her Majesty the Queen resides.”
“It’s quite nice.”
Chen Yi didn’t bother with platitudes but instead expressed his heartfelt impressions.
If this sight were on Blue Star, they’d have to erect a wall around it and start charging admission as a scenic spot.
There are two incredibly profitable businesses on Blue Star.
One is to simply enclose an area with a wall and start charging admission as a tourist attraction.
The other is to enclose an area with railings and collect fees for a parking lot.
“Come with me; Her Majesty the Queen has already prepared a feast and is waiting.”
“Alright.”
As a guest, Chen Yi made no particular requests but quietly followed behind Little Seven, leaning on his cane.
On the streets, many White Phoenix Clan players stopped what they were doing and gazed at Chen Yi with surprised and curious looks. Clearly, it must be rare for White Phoenix Clan players to see members of an Alien Race on a normal day.
No… it’s not just rare; it’s practically certain they don’t.
Because of a three-month gap between the White Phoenix Clan players and the overall game launch, those belonging to the White Phoenix Clan couldn’t even watch live broadcasts, meaning they naturally didn’t recognize Chen Yi.
Indeed, White Phoenix Clan players can’t watch any live broadcasts.
The reason Her Majesty the Queen of the White Phoenix Clan could see Chen Yi in a live broadcast was quite simple—it was done through a video call with one of their own, Little Seven. Little Seven projected the live broadcast into the air and enveloped the live stream within the video call.
Using this method, they could watch broadcasts from the future.
For most of the Alien Race players, seeing players of different Races was entirely unheard of, especially since Chen Yi’s bare buttocks were particularly conspicuous in this city.
All players on the streets had a fluffy and enormous squirrel tail, except for Chen Yi’s bare behind.
Chen Yi chuckled and nodded in response to these astonished glances while the corners of his mouth twitched slightly without uttering a word.
Those surprised looks made him feel as if not having a tail was a mistake.
That’s just ridiculous.
Under Little Seven’s lead, Chen Yi boarded a carriage, which then took off along the street at a brisk pace!
The carriage was fast, clocking in at around 90 kilometers per hour.
There were no cars in this city, giving it a slightly retro feel without a strong modern vibe. It indicated that this Race’s technological development hadn’t focused in the same direction as Blue Star before the game arrived.
Instead, it had diverged in other directions.
After all, having a queen made it feel more like an era of feudalism.
Thinking about the speed, he suddenly remembered something—that he needed to get a new Vehicle or see if the Christmas Sleigh, his current Vehicle, could have its speed further Enhanced, and if there were any limits.
The current speed of the Christmas Sleigh was over a thousand kilometers per hour, roughly the speed of Mach 1.
That was sufficient for use on Blue Star.
Circling Blue Star wouldn’t take long at all.
But after one trip to Awesome Starfield, he suddenly felt an intense inferiority when it came to speed. The Vehicles there could easily hit speeds of 7 or 8 Mach, especially the train he last took to Sky City.
It reached speeds of 30 Mach!
At such speeds, he hardly dared to look out the window for fear of getting dizzy.
If his Christmas Sleigh could reach a speed of 30 Mach, wouldn’t he be able to circle Blue Star in just… oh, at that speed on Blue Star, he probably wouldn’t be circling it at all, but rather flying out of Blue Star.
To Enhance the sleigh to a speed of 30 Mach would likely cost a great deal of Points. It might be more economical to obtain a high-level Vehicle and then start Enhancing that.
But aside from that sleigh, he hadn’t seen any other reward Vehicles on maps or quests.
The recent rewards were all combat-related or in other areas; he hadn’t seen any Vehicles.
If only he had a Vehicle capable of lightspeed.
30 Mach might sound preposterous, a speed that could send one beyond Blue Star’s horizon, but lightspeed is equal to 880,965 Mach.
Most people have no concept of lightspeed; they only know it’s the fastest speed in the universe.
But faster than lightspeed is something called the Star Ray, with a speed approximately 3 trillion times that of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 465 465: 340: This is not a power, it is a curse. _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 465: Chapter 340: This is not a power, it is a curse. _3
But Star Rays were still not the fastest, there were even faster things.
Once it involved the universe, the gaps between entities were often staggeringly vast. If he wanted to enhance his Santa’s sleigh to a speed of 3 trillion times the speed of light, he estimated that even selling the entire Ninefold game wouldn’t amass enough props.
And these limits were also the limits of the props.
One could imagine that the players from the Ninefold planets might already possess light-speed vehicles or even faster ones.
When speed was fast enough, time and space would no longer be obstacles.
As Chen Yi sat in the carriage lost in thought, the carriage slowly came to a stop, and Little Seven’s voice came from outside.
...
“Mr. Chen, we’ve arrived.”
Chen Yi glanced down at his wristwatch; 37 minutes had passed since his arrival. He could only stay for six hours. Why did the queen of the White Phoenix Clan seem in no rush, not anxious to deal with the Insect Calamity?
She didn’t seem hurried at all, still bothering to arrange a banquet.
He smirked, resolutely deciding in his mind that since he had come, if there was no time left to deal with the Insect Calamity, the responsibility would not be on him, and the promised payment must still be made.
Very soon—
Chen Yi, stepping down from the carriage, saw a palace, which fit his imagination of the White Phoenix Clan’s feudal empire quite well.
The palace was very luxurious.
Soldiers in armor filled both sides of the staircase, looking quite imposing.
Guided by Little Seven, he made his way unobstructed to a hall.
At that moment, the hall’s table was filled with food, and the veiled queen of the White Phoenix Clan was seated at the head of the table. When she saw Chen Yi enter, she softly indicated, “Please sit, Mr. Chen.”
Only the queen was present in the hall.
The guiding Little Seven also left.
Chen Yi didn’t suffer from stage fright and casually pulled out a chair to sit down. He glanced over the delicacies on the table before looking towards the White Phoenix Clan queen, who was a good four to five meters away, and raised an eyebrow, “Miss Xu isn’t leaving anyone behind? Aren’t you afraid I’ll make a move? After all, the White Phoenix Clan’s wealth is quite tempting.”
The queen of the White Phoenix Clan had just told him her name was Xu Yue.
So naturally, he referred to her as Miss Xu.
For a modern man, calling someone ‘queen’ was a bit too cumbersome, especially when she wasn’t his queen. Why would he address her as ‘queen’?
“No need,”
Xu Yue stood up, took a decanter to Chen Yi’s side, filled a cup of wine for him, and then sat beside him. She raised her head to look into Chen Yi’s eyes and softly said, “With Mr. Chen’s strength, leaving people behind is meaningless. If Mr. Chen wishes, erasing the entire White Phoenix Clan would just be a matter of time.”
“…”
Chen Yi slightly arched an eyebrow, undisputedly remaining silent. Though he didn’t have the Wife-Killing Buff right now, with his over-billion health points, there would definitely be no problem in leaving alive if a fight broke out.
But to erase the White Phoenix Clan?
He indeed didn’t have that power at the moment.
As Xu Yue sat beside him, he could see her features through the thin veil covering her face; she was quite beautiful.
Unlike Jiaye, who possessed a pitiable beauty,
Xu Yue’s beauty was the kind that incited primal desires to the point of madness.
And accompanied by the fluffy squirrel tail waving gently behind her, it gave off a very peculiar feeling.
This woman was a disaster that could bring nations to their knees, Chen Yi silently defined the queen of the White Phoenix Clan in his mind, though he still felt nothing.
He once obtained a black title—
‘Title Name’: Seeker of the Good in Life.
‘Title Level’: Black.
‘Title Effect’: Upon donning this title, you will, under any circumstances, never lose your memories of your lover, Jiaye.
And no matter where Jiaye is, you will accurately obtain her real-time location and physical status and can communicate with her in real time without distance restrictions.
However, hereafter when facing any other member of the opposite sex, your heart will be unaffected, devoid of any feeling.
‘Title Introduction’: “Pure Love Warriors stand up, green hat freaks go die!”
This title was obtained through an A-Level ‘Cowherd and Weaver Girl’ prop, which allowed him to enter a map where he and Jiaye had lost all memories. After missing each other 198 times, they finally came together on the 199th try and successfully cleared the level, earning this title.
This was also why in his debut map ‘Rogue Star’, he managed to stay unmoved by Qin Le’s naked embrace – one reason was that he genuinely felt no romantic affection for Qin Le, and the second was because this title restrained him, making it impossible for him to feel even if he wanted to.
Only…
Xu Yue, as the queen, was sitting so close to him and personally pouring wine, which somehow felt inappropriate to her status.
It couldn’t be—
Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly as he softly said, “The Insect Calamity is urgent, let’s talk about where it is first, shall we?”
If this woman intended to seduce him as a way of going back on the rewards she promised, she would be gravely mistaken!
“There’s no rush,”
Xu Yue sat beside Chen Yi, lightly lifted a strand of her hair and, pulling out a small box from her bosom, pushed it across the table towards him, “This is your payment for this trip, it has already been prepared for you. Whether or not the Insect Calamity is resolved, the reward is yours.”
“…”
Chen Yi’s eyebrows quirked as he opened the box. Observing the five Zenith Radiance and the A-Level ‘Recoil Armor’ prop placed beside it, he closely inspected for any traps or schemes, then stuffed the Zenith Radiance and the Recoil Armor into his bosom.

chapters.title: Chapter 466 466: 340: This is not a power, it is a curse._4
chapters.content:
Chapter 466: Chapter 340: This is not a power, it is a curse._4
With a satisfied expression, he patted his belly and picked up the chopsticks, looking at the delicacies on the table, he said, “Shall we eat first?”
At this moment, he was in no hurry at all.
If he had previously wanted to quickly address the Insect Calamity, he was now in no hurry whatsoever.
It was like doing a day’s work and worrying why the boss hadn’t assigned any tasks for fear of not getting paid, but once the boss pays in advance, suddenly there’s no rush.
It didn’t matter anymore whether he worked or not.
The money was already in his pocket.
...
Just like his current situation.
“Right.”
Chen Yi picked up a pair of chopsticks with a dish he could name, pigeon meat, chewed it, and swallowed before casually saying, “Speaking of which, since your White Phoenix Clan has the ability to travel through the Timeline, why only go back three months?”
“How long have you been pulled into this game of ascension?”
“If you always travel forward in the Timeline, can’t you just escape the game of ascension? How nice would peace be? After the game descends, people have to keep dying.”
“…”
Xu Yue sat beside him, devoid of the usual majesty of a queen, instead using chopsticks to pick up some dishes Chen Yi couldn’t reach, placed them on a plate in front of him, and said softly,
“The White Phoenix Clan has no power to travel through the Timeline; it is not a power, but a curse.”
“This happened a very long time ago, long before the ascension game descended. We had this curse when our planet had only our Race, and with no comparison, we didn’t take this curse seriously.”
“Thought it was a rumor.”
“Until the ascension game descended and we gradually had contact with players from Alien Races, we then realized the curse was real.”
“Our White Phoenix Clan was indeed forgotten in the Timeline.”
“Our distance from the normal Timeline is three months, and we can neither shorten nor lengthen it, as if an invisible barrier separates us from the normal world forever.”
“…”
Chen Yi suddenly stopped his chopsticks and with a strange look on his face, turned to Xu Yue and said, “Miss Xu, you’re not thinking of asking us to break this curse for you, are you? That task is way beyond my capabilities, and even if it were within my capabilities, it couldn’t be solved just for five Zenith Radiance.”
“If you didn’t come to me to deal with the Insect Calamity but to break the curse, I can only say that I’m sorry, but I don’t have the power to do that.”
“Break the curse?”
Xu Yue was slightly startled, then she couldn’t help but cover her mouth and laugh softly, “Mr. Chen is joking. This curse is the greatest umbrella for our White Phoenix Clan. Our people are naturally kind and foolish.”
“Without this curse, the White Phoenix Clan wouldn’t be able to survive in the brutally competitive ascension game, and probably would have been wiped out long ago.”
“Just like the Races Mr. Chen wiped out.”
“The curse has brought many negative effects to us, but it also has positive impacts. For example, the maps our people have cleared are ones you all cleared three months ago.”
“This means that I can send my people to the normal Timeline to collect a large number of walkthroughs, ensuring that when our people enter the map, they have a detailed guide to it, and therefore can almost guarantee a no-injury clear.”
“And they can also avoid some trap maps.”
“You should be aware that the ascension game has quite a few maps that are deathtraps with a high mortality rate, and we can completely avoid these maps. After all, for us, this three-month curse is like possessing knowledge of the future.”
“What I mean to say is, since the ascension game descended, the White Phoenix Clan has accumulated a large amount of wealth by making use of this curse.”
“If you really decided to take action against the White Phoenix Clan, it might be somewhat difficult.”
“What next?”
Without raising his head from scooping up a mouthful of green vegetables, Chen Yi casually said, as long as they didn’t ask him to break the curse that’s fine—it sounded complicated anyway—and since Xu Yue wasn’t in a hurry, he wasn’t either.
He might as well enjoy the conversation. Speaking of which, how should he distribute those five Zenith Radiance once he gets back?
A Wife-Killing Buff definitely deserved one.
“And then, if you just nod your head, all of the wealth accumulated by the White Phoenix Clan over these days,”
“Will be yours, Mr. Chen.”

chapters.title: Chapter 467 467: 341: You're so good at contrasting, are you going to be a beauty blogger?
chapters.content:
Chapter 467: Chapter 341: You’re so good at contrasting, are you going to be a beauty blogger?
“…”
Chen Yi, who was pondering what dish to pick up with his chopsticks next, suddenly froze slightly, put down the chopsticks in his hand, silently took out a handkerchief from his pocket to wipe his mouth, and then looked up at Xu Yue beside him.
“Experience tells me that what you’re about to say is going to be very weird.”
“Or maybe we should just talk about the Insect Calamity instead?”
As expected.
He knew it, this woman was trying to seduce him.
...
Before coming here, he had guessed countless possibilities, how could a big race like hers be stumped by the Insect Calamity? He had even wondered if this Insect Calamity could be the Void Clan.
Because three months ago, he changed the timeline, which led to the rapid development of the Void Clan in the level-up game.
Perhaps it was some sort of causal relationship with a time loop.
Now it seemed, he’d thought too much; it wasn’t that complex after all. This woman was simply trying to seduce him, aiming to bind his combat power with the White Phoenix Clan.
He was after the Zenith Radiance of the White Phoenix Clan.
The White Phoenix Clan was after him.
Fair enough, it felt like when he used to buy financial products on Blue Star—he was after the interest, the other party was after his principal.
Xu Yue, with a calm expression, didn’t react too much, just leaned back in the chair and stretched lazily, somewhat inelegantly.
“The White Phoenix Clan is abandoned, not on the normal timeline.”
“Here, no matter how much havoc you wreak, it won’t affect your timeline at all. This world exists independently, with no causal relationship with yours.”
“So all those things about the Void Clan you’re thinking of don’t exist.”
“Even if you ran to the territory of the Void Starfield and completely destroyed it, it would remain unaffected when you return.”
“And yes, you’re right about one thing.”
“I really do want to seduce you, but could you not think about that the whole time? Ever since you sat down here, you’ve had only two things on your mind.”
“One is worrying that I’ll seduce you, and the other is worrying that I won’t give you a reward.”
“I would have thought that someone as strong as you would think about bigger issues.”
“…”
Chen Yi silently pulled out a cigarette from his pocket, lit it unconcernedly, leaned back in his chair, took a long drag, then massaged his temple and said softly, “I really hate props or skills that can see through people’s hearts.”
No wonder Xu Yue had suddenly taken out the Zenith Radiance from her pocket earlier; she must have heard his internal grumbling that Xu Yue wouldn’t give him the prop.
After that.
He quickly cleared his mind of all thoughts, allowing his brain to blank out, not dwelling on these messy issues to avoid revealing any information.
Unconcernedly leaning back in his chair and smoking.
It seemed this trip wouldn’t involve bug killing after all. Well, that was fine by him; he truly was tired of killing bugs.
After killing bugs for a whole day in the Awesome Starfield, then another hour in the Void Starfield, running over to the White Phoenix Clan and still having to kill bugs would be too nonsensical. Did he have some sort of indissoluble destiny with bugs in the first half of his life?
But although he wouldn’t be killing bugs, facing a queen’s seduction felt even more headache-inducing.
“Somehow I feel like you’re very resistant to me,” Xu Yue said, leaning back in the chair, hugging her knees to her chest, feet on her chair, looking at the delicacies on the table, and said softly, “Your thoughts from a moment ago told me that you find me beautiful.”
“So why resist so much?”
“…”
Chen Yi, somewhat speechlessly, lifted his left hand, “See, what is this? This is a ring. I’m married, you know.”
“Didn’t you see the girl beside me when we video-called?”
“That’s my wife.”
“You’re trying to seduce a married man and then asking me why I resist? Don’t the White Phoenix Clan have this concept?”
“Is that so?”
Xu Yue calmly slipped her sheer garment down a little, exposing her snow-white shoulders, tilted her head, looked down at Chen Yi’s crotch with a hint of amusement, and teased, “As far as I know, isn’t every man on Blue Star fond of having multiple wives and concubines?”
“Besides, I’ve given you such a good excuse to come here to eliminate the Insect Race.”
“As long as you don’t say anything when you return, who would know, right?”
“As the queen of the White Phoenix Clan, that wouldn’t be too demeaning for you, would it?”
“Of course, I know what you’re thinking.”
“During my audience later, you just watch from the side. You can truly admire my usual coldness and nobility, and then fantasize about pressing me beneath you, panting wantonly, like a boneless little cat, which might pique your interest?”
“Does such a contrast attract you?”
Having said that.
Xu Yue slowly lifted her snow-white leg and placed her foot gently on the table, pulling her skirt up to the top of her thigh, her eyes brimming with allure and teasing.
She was in a state that seemed to reveal nothing and yet everything.
Extremely tempting.
The atmosphere in the room gradually became more and more ambiguous.
And Xu Yue’s gaze never left Chen Yi’s crotch from beginning to end, until, after some time, an apparently tired Xu Yue expressionlessly withdrew her long, snow-white leg from the table and tidied her somewhat disheveled clothes.
After a long silence, she finally said softly,
“Are you… impotent?”
She believed her charm was definitely not lacking, with top-notch figure and facial features, and she also had a very high status. This extreme contrast should provoke the strongest desires in a man’s heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 468 468: 341: You're so great at contrasts, are you going to be a beauty blogger?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 468: Chapter 341: You’re so great at contrasts, are you going to be a beauty blogger?_2
But—
Just now, Chen Yi had absolutely no reaction, not even a tiny bit!!!
She had been observing closely.
Forget about the little tent she had imagined sprouting, his pants didn’t even have a slight bulge, no physiological reaction whatsoever.
According to her script, Chen Yi, although verbally denying it, should have had an honest body by now, and then she would place her foot on his crotch and slide up slowly, teasing him with a line, “Aren’t you interested in me at all?”
This was the script she had in mind.
...
But who would have thought it would turn out like this, that Chen Yi really had no reaction whatsoever.
Impossible!
With her looks, figure, and status, it was impossible not to attract Chen Yi in the slightest—there could only be one explanation, that Chen Yi was impotent!
“…”
Chen Yi, somewhat speechless, turned his head to look at Xu Yue beside him, brought the lit cigarette to his lips, took a deep drag, then slowly blew the smoke onto Xu Yue’s face: “Your whole family is impotent.”
Title in hand.
Apart from Jiaye, he couldn’t muster any interest for any other woman.
His body wouldn’t have any reaction.
“…”
Xu Yue’s brows furrowed slightly, she turned her head to dodge the smoke and softly said, “It’s very impolite to blow smoke in a woman’s face.”
“Is seducing a married man considered polite?”
“As far as I know, you two are only in a relationship and haven’t gone through the marriage process that is officially recognized on Blue Star.”
“Since the game has descended, do you think the civil affairs office is still necessary? Where can we get married?”
“Then what I’m doing doesn’t count as seducing a married man.”
“Alright.”
Chen Yi, with a nonchalant wave of his hand, stood up ready to leave the banquet, heading toward the door without looking back, and casually said, “If that’s the purpose of your visit, then I can tell you clearly, no chance.”
“I’m quite faithful as a man, and I’m truly not interested in you.”
“But since I’ve come, I’m not returning the payment.”
“I’ll just wander around for the next few hours, and when the time is up, I’ll go back on my own. I won’t lay hands on your people, so let’s part amicably and meet again if destiny allows.”
Having said that,
Chen Yi left the hall without a backward glance, his figure quickly vanishing from Xu Yue’s sight.
“…”
Xu Yue sat in place, slightly dazed for a long time before realizing that Chen Yi had truly just left like that. She incredulously pulled at the collar of her dress and looked down at her figure.
So white, so tender.
Isn’t this figure attractive?
Don’t you want to pounce and take a bite? Just walk away like that?
Are you an idiot? The game has descended, and here you are playing the saint. Isn’t it normal for a strong man to have several women?
After a long silence,
She bit her lip slightly, opened the chat with Chen Yi, and slowly typed a message to send over.
‘The White Phoenix Clan can produce one Zenith Radiance every three days.’
Then she sat quietly in place, waiting for three seconds.
Suddenly—
“Whoosh!”
It felt like a gust of wind had swept through the center of the hall, and when the wind settled, Chen Yi was sitting earnestly in his original spot, looking at Xu Yue with a serious expression, “I suddenly feel we have plenty of opportunities for collaboration.”
“You want me, undoubtedly for my combat abilities, right?”
“As long as you provide enough Zenith Radiance, I can help the White Phoenix Clan eliminate all enemies, how about the Void Clan for starters? We can try cooperating once, just give me 10 Zenith Radiance, and I’ll put in extra effort and time to wipe out the Void Clan immediately.”
“How about that?”
“…”
Seeing how quickly Chen Yi returned, Xu Yue felt so angered she nearly laughed, glaring at him with a forced smile, and said word by word, “The esteemed queen of the White Phoenix Clan throws herself at you, and in your eyes, a few Zenith Radiance are more precious?”
“Both are precious, but I’m not fortunate enough to enjoy the former.”
In the face of sufficient Zenith Radiance, even Chen Yi didn’t mind making his words sound more agreeable, not as harsh.
Xu Yue took a deep breath, not continuing on the subject, but after a brief pause, she softly said, “I don’t want a title, listen well, I don’t want any title from you.”
“I don’t need you to publicly claim I’m your wife, or your woman.”
“Nor will I presume that status for myself.”
“I can be your secret lover, and I only have one demand of you—favor me once a month, nothing more.”
“Even though I am a virgin as the queen, I have learned quite a bit in these days, and I won’t let you find it boring.”
“Especially, you can attend court as a listener, believe me, that contrast will absolutely make you obsessed.”
“Even… even after we become comfortable with each other, you can stand in for me at court and announce the day’s decrees, while I can hide under the table, unseen by the ministers, and serve you, how about that?”
“Just think about it.”
“Can you imagine that feeling? It’s an ultimate pleasure for a man.”
“…”
This time, even Chen Yi fell silent.
Chen Yi sat expressionless, his hands trembling slightly as he lit a cigarette and took a deep drag. For the first time, he found that the effect of the title was not absolute.
Normally,
Under the “Seeker of the Good in Life” title effect, he should be completely indifferent to any woman other than Jiaye.

chapters.title: Chapter 469 469: 341: You're So Contrasting, Are You Going to be a Beauty Blogger?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: Chapter 341: You’re So Contrasting, Are You Going to be a Beauty Blogger?_3
After all, the priority level of this title is a solid B.98.
But he now realized that this priority level seemed somewhat incapable of blocking Xu Yue’s words.
Her words were causing a reaction in his body to begin slowly.
Above the court, the queen, draped in imperial garments, took something into her mouth in a place unseen by the ministers and swallowed.
Indeed.
Her words almost broke through the B.98 priority level of the rules.
...
It was too much—how could anyone play like this?
If you keep playing this way, the dedicated persona he had maintained for so long was about to burst.
You’re so good at contrast—are you planning to become a beauty blogger?
“…”
Chen Yi took another deep breath, forcibly suppressing the desire that was about to break through the limits of his title’s rules, and after a long silence, he finally asked hoarsely, “We have nothing left to discuss? You must have a person?”
“Hmm.”
Xu Yue slowly stood up, her face cold as she suddenly shouted to the door, “Golden Guards, heed my command: No one is to come within a hundred paces of this temple, or they will be executed without mercy!”
“Yes!”
With a silent acknowledgment, barely perceptible footsteps echoed instantly outside the palace—the guards who had been stationed outside were clearly retreating a hundred paces away.
Then.
Xu Yue slowly spread her arms, the luxurious imperial garments she wore gently began to fall away, leaving only a piece of thin fabric across her chest and between her legs, as well as a veil over her face.
Aside from her face and key areas, everything else was laid bare before Chen Yi.
The hint of defined abs, a waist-to-hip ratio that could only be described as perfect.
That included the veil that revealed only a hint of her face, and the squirrel tail that swayed gently behind her.
Such a temptingly arranged scene had suddenly emerged in the center of the great hall.
The thin fabric could not completely cover everything—indeed, one could even make out the two small bolts.
“…”
Chen Yi slowly closed his eyes, feeling a headache coming on; this woman may not understand how to govern a nation, but she definitely understood men.
An exposed body doesn’t necessarily hold that much attraction for men.
On the contrary.
The glimpses of flesh shown below the veils could absolutely snatch a man’s soul away.
“Love at first sight is too fake. Tell me, what do you need my help with? Let’s hear it.”
“To make such a sacrifice, it’s not something that a few lives could make worthwhile for you to do, right?”
“You’re wrong.”
Xu Yue shook her head slowly and approached Chen Yi, draping her slender arms over his shoulders and leaning close to whisper in his ear, “I don’t need you to do anything for me.”
“The White Phoenix Clan lives in seclusion at the end of the timeline, without any enemies.”
“All I want is to choose a husband I find suitable.”
“You are the best candidate.”
“Faithful, handsome, you managed to navigate the first show map without erupting in anger at the insult, instead, you completed it perfectly with extreme calm.”
“Powerful enough in battle, with a sufficient sense of security.”
“Faithful?”
Chen Yi suddenly chuckled, stood up from beneath Xu Yue, and moved aside to lean on the edge of a table, eyeing the translucent fabric draped over Xu Yue with raised eyebrows, making a taunting remark.
“Interesting, you like my faithfulness, but you throw yourself at me despite knowing I have a wife—how could I still have any integrity if I accepted you?”
“Is it strange?”
Xu Yue did not approach again but instead leaned forward on the back of a chair looking toward Chen Yi, casually saying with a lazy posture, “As ordinary citizens, we certainly hope that the Law Enforcement Bureau is as strict as possible with criminals.”
“But when we become the criminals, we hope the Law Enforcement Bureau will be as lenient as possible—ideally turning a blind eye.”
“A person’s stance does change depending on where they sit, doesn’t it?”
“As long as you say yes to me today.”
“You may take 20 Zenith Radiance immediately.”
“Twenty?”
“Twenty is quite a lot. The White Phoenix Clan hasn’t had the World Tree that can continuously produce Zenith Radiance for long; it only yields one every three days. These twenty are nearly all of the White Phoenix Clan’s stock. You can think of it as a down payment, and as long as we’re family, all of the subsequent production is yours, isn’t it?”
“That’s not a small amount.”
Chen Yi nodded with some slight shock; the surprise he had shown before was not because he felt it was too little, but because it was too much.
One Zenith Radiance was worth ten million Points.
Twenty equated to two hundred million Points.
And these items were priceless; often, when someone genuinely wanted to buy them and was not lacking money, they would sell at a premium.
But after pondering for just half a minute.
Chen Yi shook his head and said seriously, “Although I am somewhat tempted, I’m sorry, I once promised her I would never be with another woman, so, I apologize.”
“I cannot accept these twenty Zenith Radiance, I don’t want them.”
“If you try to stop me today, then I…”
Perhaps persuaded by him, Xu Yue actually began to slowly dress in the clothes she had shed on the floor.
Before she could finish—
Chen Yi, still not completely recovered, suddenly blacked out and fainted on the spot, his last thought being, damn, how did I capsize here?
And the instant he fainted,
a notification sounded in his mind.
‘Ding, detecting player Chen Yi in a fainting state, activate prop Forever Pure to remove negative status? First inquiry.’
‘…Second inquiry.’
And Chen Yi could no longer hear the notification.
Forever Pure was his most frequently used prop, which could immediately remove all negative effects from him upon activation. However, if he was in a state such as unconsciousness or fainting where he could not activate the prop, it would initiate three inquiries within 30 seconds.

chapters.content:
Chapter 470: Chapter 341: You’re so good at contrasting, are you going to be a beauty blogger?_4
If no choice is made,
the prop will be activated automatically.
Chen Yi had never triggered this effect since he acquired the artifact, but today it was indeed triggered.
…
“Well done.”
Xu Yue, already dressed, looked at Chen Yi, who fainted on the ground, with a hint of mockery in her eyes, then turned to the White Phoenix Clan player behind Chen Yi, and said softly, “Go receive your reward.”
...
“Yes.”
Elated by the Queen’s praise, Little Seven picked up a huge Gatling gun in his hand and trotted out of the palace.
In Sky City, he and his partner Wang Qi once ambushed Tuberculosis Rabbit with sticks, hoping to knock him out, but the plan failed.
He remembered Tuberculosis Rabbit telling him, in this day and age, how could sticks knock someone out, at least a Gatling was needed!
Very logical.
He quietly noted this lesson and acquired a Gatling prop as soon as possible, and only when he had successfully brought Chen Yi to the White Phoenix Clan and received a Zenith Radiance as a reward from the Queen.
Without any hesitation, he smashed the Zenith Radiance onto his newly obtained Gatling.
The power greatly increased.
One of the effects was, when you hit an enemy in the back of the head with the Gatling, it would ignore any effects that prevent control and force a dizziness state for one minute.
Very useful.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was indeed wise, Chen Yi’s brother had perspectives worthy of his learning.
…
Thirty seconds later.
The automatically triggered Chen Yi slowly opened his eyes, and upon regaining consciousness, he immediately tried to escape without hesitation, only to find himself completely bound and unable to move.
Even… even his clothes had been stripped off.
Immediately after, he discovered that four semi-transparent chains were binding him to an extremely luxurious bed.
“Forever Pure” activated!
“Like a Demon” activated!
However, there was no response, and Chen Yi’s expression began to turn ugly.
The “Like a Demon” title had no effect? This title was a Stellar Rank one, almost the highest level in Starfield. By activating it, he could be immune to all control states, but these chains couldn’t be broken?
The rules of these chains actually had a higher priority than his “Like a Demon”?
No need to struggle anymore. Xu Yue, who had changed into new royal robes, slowly turns over and whispers, kissing Chen Yi’s chest, “The White Phoenix Clan has accumulated quite a bit of wealth in these days, even if we only eat the leftovers behind you guys.”
“But the leftovers of the entire game let our White Phoenix Clan feast, and we feasted well.”
“This chain is the highest-level item of our White Phoenix Clan, a triple S-ranked item, so don’t struggle too hard.”
“It won’t hurt you, I just hope you don’t try to escape.”
As Xu Yue explained in a low voice, she slowly slid down.
…
Ten minutes later.
An extremely exhausted Xu Yue slowly got up, sitting on the side of the bed with disbelief and incomprehension on her face, looking at Chen Yi, her tone slightly rising in shock, “You’re really impotent?”
She’d tried for a full ten minutes, using all the tricks up her sleeve, and Chen Yi didn’t react at all?
…
Another ten minutes after that, Chen Yi silently dressed, sitting on the edge of the bed in silence, not speaking.
It seemed the “Seeker of the Good in Life” title had a slightly higher priority.
After a long silence, he stretched out his hand to Xu Yue, “You’re the first one to knock me out which has made me a bit angry, give me ten Zenith Radiance and we’ll call it even.”
“…”
Xu Yue sat silently next to him, her head lowered without speaking. She had prepared for everything, except the possibility that Chen Yi was actually impotent.
No wonder he’s faithful. Perhaps only that girl doesn’t mind Chen Yi’s impotence, right?
“A maximum of three.”
“Don’t you have twenty?”
“If you could’ve gotten up, even for just three minutes, I’d give you twenty. But under these circumstances, I can only give you three.”

chapters.title: Chapter 471 342: "What the hell kind of karma is this!
chapters.content:
"Three is fine, but give them to me first and then we'll talk."
Xu Yue didn't waste any words but obediently took out a box containing three Zenith Radiance from her bosom and handed it to Chen Yi: "Here."
"Good."
Chen Yi took a deep breath, stuffed the three Zenith Radiance into his bosom, and then sat on the edge of the bed. He looked bewilderedly ahead, absent-mindedly taking out a cigarette from his bosom and lighting it.
What the hell is this?
Had the queen of the White Phoenix Clan tried to force herself on him?
Well, even though she didn't succeed, there was still a sense of humiliation from being unable to resist.
"..."
After a moment of silence, he didn't know what came over him, but he reached out and touched Xu Yue's tail, remarking with a slightly amazed tongue: "This thing feels pretty comfortable."
What should he do about this situation now?
That was a good question.
"Um... I don't really know how to say this."
Chen Yi hesitated for a moment before finally asking cautiously, "Where exactly is your tail located? Is it below the door, above the door, or inside the door?"
"..."
Xu Yue's face turned a shade of steel as she enunciated each word: "If your brain is sick, go get it treated! It's in the same location where your Blue Star Race has a tailbone."
"Oh..."
Chen Yi nodded, paused for a moment, but couldn't restrain the burning curiosity in his heart: "Does it get splashed on when you poop?"
"No."
Xu Yue's face darkened as she rasped: "The tail lifts up."
"What about when you have gastroenteritis? Diarrhea makes people spray, and us human race players spray from both buttocks when we have diarrhea. If your tail sprays everywhere, I guess it's probably not easy to clean, right?"
"... Get lost."
"Okay, then I'll head back first. Call me next time you need something."
Chen Yi let out a long sigh. No matter what, this ordeal was over.
The gains from this trip far exceeded expectations, eight Zenith Radiance, plus an A-grade Prop called Recoil Armor.
It was enough.
Although something unspeakable had happened, he believed he would soon be able to forget this memory and then everything would return to normal.
"Wait a minute."
Xu Yue suddenly called out to Chen Yi. After a long silence, she took out a box from her bosom and handed it to him: "You don't have to play dumb, my goal is to find a capable man to be my husband."
"Since that area is not your forte, naturally, you're no longer in my range of choices."
"However, take this. Even though we can't be husband and wife, we should be friends. The resources of the White Phoenix Clan should be able to help you a lot at times, and in some situations, the White Phoenix Clan also needs a strong individual fighter like you."
"It's good that you see it that way."
Hearing Xu Yue say this, Chen Yi's tensed body gradually relaxed. He took the box in his hand, raised an eyebrow curiously, and opened it: "What's this?"
The next second—
"Zap!"
A dazzling white light blinded him, and then he felt a sudden excruciating pain in the back of his head, as if it had been struck hard, and his body uncontrollably succumbed to dizziness.
Damn it!
In the moment before passing out, Chen Yi growled in anger in his heart!
Xu Yue, what the hell was this move again, and who was the bastard that hit me on the head from behind? The same trick twice?
Was it the members of the White Phoenix Clan who were dim-witted, or was it me?
...
"Well done."
Xu Yue sat on the bed, a satisfied expression on her face as she looked at Chen Yi, who had fallen to the ground, and the Gatling-wielding Little Seven with an eager smile, nodding: "That was powerful. Go and practice some more."
"Yes!"
Receiving the queen's praise, Little Seven, her face flushed with excitement, grabbed the giant Gatling and scampered out of the hall.
Her heart was aflutter with excitement.
The queen had complimented her several times today, and the things taught by Tuberculosis Rabbit were really useful.
Then—
After Little Seven had left, Xu Yue, who was seated on the bed, slowly stood up, leaning over to look down at Chen Yi on the floor with a sneer: "Seeker of the Good in Life, huh? Immune to titles, right?"
Afterward.
Without hesitation, she took out a Prop capable of arousing desires from her bosom, and once again another Zenith Radiance, smashing it down on the spot.
She then repeated her previous action, tying Chen Yi to the bed again and activating the Prop in her hand.
This time, she barely touched him a few times before she saw Chen Yi stand erect.
It seemed her charm had nothing to do with it.
...
30 seconds later.
The B-grade Prop 'Forever Pure' automatically activated, and Chen Yi, waking up from the dizziness, immediately found himself once again tied to the bed.
It was that damn SSS-grade binding Prop.
Even his 'Like a Demon' title couldn't break the restraint.
But this time was different, as soon as he opened his eyes, he saw Xu Yue sitting on top of him, her face slightly flushed, her body arching backward with her arms supporting her on the bed, emitting non-sensical hums from her mouth.
Unable to resist.
Chen Yi slowly closed his eyes again, his lips pressed tightly together as two tears of humiliation trickled from the corners of his eyes.
He had over a hundred million hit points, for God's sake!
He didn't consider himself invincible, but he thought it would be very hard for him to die, which was why he confidently came to the White Phoenix Clan alone without activating the Wife-Killing Buff. But who knew the White Phoenix Clan didn't plan to kill him but to humiliate him!

chapters.title: Chapter 472 342: "What the hell kind of karma is this!"_2
chapters.content:
```
No matter how much health you have, you can't block this kind of true damage!
Despite his many Stellar Rank titles and A-rank props, he was powerless against this kind of situation.
He suddenly remembered a prop he had obtained long ago.
"Prop Name": Gecko Severing Arm.
"Prop Rank": E-rank.
"Prop Effect": Once activated, the user can instantly cause any one of their body organs to break off and separate, allowing them to escape from danger immediately.
"Prop Introduction": "Hesitate not at the decisive moment, or chaos will follow!"
It was a prop he had gotten quite a while back during an event on Blue Star. Sadly, he thought it wasn't very useful at the time and gave it to Tuberculosis Rabbit for his collection—after all, his bag couldn't hold that many props.
If only he had kept that prop, it would be coming in handy right about now.
He himself had severed it, leaving it in Xu Yue's body.
To die rather than submit.
That would at least be dignified.
He could be called a true man of iron.
Just as Chen Yi tightly closed his eyes, tears of humiliation hanging in the corner of them, his mind a whirlwind of thoughts.
Xu Yue, sitting atop Chen Yi, slightly opened her eyes with a trace of dissatisfaction: "Could you not constantly think about such strange things in your head?"
"Then stop f*cking listening to them!"
Chen Yi said angrily.
"This prop of mine is passive, I can't control it to not listen."
"Well, I can't control myself to not think, either!"
"Heh."
Xu Yue sneered, tossed her hair back, and sat atop Chen Yi, leaning backward with both hands tightly gripping the sheets, a victorious smirk in her eyes.
...
Three hours later.
Chen Yi sat on the edge of the bed with a deathly pale face, pulling out a cigarette from his pocket to his mouth, rubbing his temples with a headache. After a long time, he finally exhaled a puff of smoke and couldn't help but curse.
"What the f*ck is all this crap!"
"Where the hell are my 20 Zenith Radiance?"
"Was it a free ride?"
"Damn, what am I, a charity?"
Meanwhile, in the bed, Xu Yue lay there, her face slightly pale as if in peaceful slumber, her hands spread across her chest, the very picture of tranquility.
Her eyelashes didn't move; her body didn't move.
Like a damned turtle, she stayed motionless.
"Shouldn't you, as the queen of the White Phoenix Clan, have deep resources? A lot of wealth? In this situation, you don't even have a prop to increase health? At the very least, there should be a defensive prop that activates automatically when you're close to death, right?"
The more Chen Yi thought about it, the angrier he got. Originally, he had thought he would simply come over to kill some bugs and then happily collect some Zenith Radiance and go back.
He thought it was going to be an easy job.
Who knew there'd be so much trouble.
Now, look what happened. An hour ago, Xu Yue probably thought he was getting into it, so she released the chains and set him free.
And he had already been holding back a stomach full of anger; he just turned over and took charge without a second thought.
Many details were then forgotten in the process.
Like his Fatal Strike title.
When he didn't move, this title wouldn't trigger, but once he made a move, it counted as an attack.
So... quite unfortunately, the Fatal Strike title was triggered.
Critical hit.
Xu Yue died on the spot.
After all, anyone who has studied probability knows that even the smallest chances can be inevitable events over enough occurrences and given enough time.
Moreover, the probability of a Fatal Strike's penalty trigger wasn't low.
The end result was that the queen of the White Phoenix Clan now lay peacefully dead on the bed.
For some reason, the current scene suddenly reminded him of a saying from a predecessor.
I came, I conquered, I destroyed.
"Sigh!"
Chen Yi rubbed his temples once more, exhaled another mouthful of smoke, and began to ponder how to handle the situation. First, he needed to figure out a way to bring Xu Yue back from hell, but if he remembered correctly...
Tuberculosis Rabbit had mentioned that White Phoenix Clan players, once they fell into hell, would lose all their memories, essentially being completely dead.
Interesting.
But the problem was how he would even get to the hell of the White Phoenix Clan; players weren't able to travel to the hell of players from other alien races.
Just like how players from alien races absolutely couldn't step into the hell of the Blue Star Race.
Unless...
"Unless it's done through an NPC."
He remembered, during the invasion of Blue Star by the Five Clans in the Number 3 Star System's Twofold Planet, Neutron Star, a player named Li Peiqi who went to Blue Star Hell as an NPC had told him about the Black Dragon Guild or something, who informed the Five Clans about gaining a multiple-power increase by killing Jiaye.
He hadn't paid much attention to that before.
Maybe he could trouble this Li Peiqi player?
After all, Li Peiqi once told him that she was the only one who had the privilege to choose freely which planet's hell to serve as an NPC?
Other players who wanted to become NPC in hell were assigned randomly?
After hesitating for a moment, Chen Yi still started scrolling through his friends list, searching for Li Peiqi. He remembered that they had become friends after that incident.
...
"Ah."
Li Peiqi opened her eyes groggily and glanced at the clock hanging on the wall at the foot of the bed.
It was a little past four in the morning.
After a brief pause, she took a deep breath, not minding her recurring insomnia, before pulling out the A-rank prop "Last Words" from her chest and looked at it seriously.
It had been a long time since she had heard the name Chen Yi.
Ever since Chen Yi killed a staggering 50 billion players in the Annihilation Starfield, she hadn't heard his name again.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 473 342: "What the hell kind of karma is this!"_3
chapters.content:
She naturally was also unaware that Chen Yi's debut map and his livestream on Awesome Starfield weren't open to players from Threefold Planet below. She didn't know about the gap in information between players from Twofold Planet and below within the star system and those from Threefold Planet and above within Starfield.
There was quite a significant difference in information.
However, since then, she had not heard any news about Alien Races from Star System No.3 seeking trouble with Blue Star, presumably Chen Yi handled it very well. The Head of the Black Dragon Guild, who she referred to as her biological father, had also been in a state of panic recently.
Fearing that Chen Yi might come seeking vengeance.
After all, the Head of the Black Dragon Guild had previously divulged some of Chen Yi's confidential information to the Five Clans.
When her best friend told her that the Head of the Black Dragon Guild was her biological father, she didn't believe it, because she had used a Prop to check that all her blood relatives were no longer among the living. But later, after a paternity test, she discovered he was indeed her father.
The Head of the Black Dragon Guild had used some means to shield his blood relation information.
And now she knew why her Last Words Prop still displayed that she would die by Chen Yi's hands—it must be that when the time came for Chen Yi to settle scores, he would include her in the reckoning as well.
'Prop Name': Last Words.
'Prop Level': A-ranked.
'Prop Effect': This Prop displays by which method you will die in the future, updating daily at midnight.
'Prop Introduction': "A life without regrets is not perfect." — So said the blind and thin man.
'PS: You will die at the hands of Blue Star player Chen Yi, time unknown.'
"Hmph."
Li Peiqi glanced at the PS, snorted coldly, and casually tossed the Prop under the bed. Sure enough, the method of death updated at midnight still showed she would die by Chen Yi's hands; she was already fed up with it.
If death was inevitable, so be it.
That was fate.
These days, she had made significant efforts to change her destiny, but to no avail. Now, she didn't want to make any more efforts.
She might as well just wait for death.
At that moment—
'Ding, your friend has sent an unread message.'
"Who sends messages so late at night, how annoying?"
Li Peiqi was somewhat impatient, but when she saw the sender's name, her body instantly froze in place. After bouncing up from the bed, she immediately knelt on the bed and bowed thrice towards the east, her face slightly pale.
The sender was Chen Yi!
Damn it, why would Chen Yi take the initiative to contact her?
Was the reckoning coming so soon? Could he not settle with her father first? She wanted to live a few more hours, at least let her have breakfast first. Even in death, she wanted to die with a full belly.
After taking a deep breath, she composed herself before looking at the message Chen Yi sent.
'Hello, my name is Chen Yi.'
Heh, there's really no need for introductions, okay? I'll never forget your name in this lifetime.
Upon reading Chen Yi's first sentence, Li Peiqi couldn't help but mockingly think to herself.
'I have an Alien Race player friend who accidentally died and fell into hell... um, her situation is a bit troublesome; she can't return from hell by herself, and she lost all her memories after death.'
'I am unable to go to the hell on their planet, but I remember you mentioned you have the ability to freely choose to go to any planet and act as an NPC.'
'I wonder if you could help me find a way to tell my friend how to leave and return from the map?'
'Name your reward.'
"..."
After reading all the messages sent by Chen Yi, Li Peiqi's fear in her eyes gradually disappeared, and looking somewhat excited, she immediately dressed, kicked open the door of her room, jumped on the motorcycle at the entrance, and roared off toward the manor on the edge of the distant city!
Ten minutes later!
"You old bastard!"
Li Peiqi kicked open the manor's main gate excitedly, dashed to the master bedroom, and after punching the enchanting woman sleeping on the Head of the Black Dragon Guild's bed to death, she then turned to look at the Head of the Black Dragon Guild himself.
"You're lucky, your chance to make amends for your sins has arrived!"
"..."
The Head of the Black Dragon Guild, who was awakened from deep sleep, first looked blankly at the wall clock, then at the dark sky outside. Then he lowered his head to look at the woman his daughter had just punched to death in his arms.
After being bewildered for a moment.
He raised his head and looked at Li Peiqi blankly and said, "Why did you kill my woman?"
Li Peiqi was his daughter.
He had hidden this relationship all along until recently he had acknowledged it, but his daughter never called him father, always referring to him as "you old bastard."
"Heh."
Li Peiqi sneered mockingly, "My mom hasn't been dead long, and you've already found someone new? Can you even be considered a man acting like this?"
"But..."
The Head of the Black Dragon Guild continued blankly, "Your mom has been dead for a long time, and you never even saw your mom, did you?"
"None of your business, as long as you claim to be my dad, I will control you, and I will kill every tramp woman I see."
"..."
The Head of the Black Dragon Guild fell silent for a moment, then slowly got up in his pajamas, walked to the window, pulled back the curtain, and lit a cigar to put in his mouth. Just as he was about to say something, when he saw the extremely dark night outside, he suddenly felt disheartened.
After closing the curtain again, he looked at Li Peiqi with some speechlessness.
"Speak if you have something to say."
"Chen Yi contacted me?"
"Chen Yi?"
The Head of the Black Dragon Guild was startled, then his expression changed drastically. He quickly stepped forward and asked urgently, "What did he say exactly, is he settling the score? How about you deal with it while I try to escape for a bit?"

chapters.title: Chapter 474 342: "What the hell kind of karma is this!"_4
chapters.content:
"If I can't get away, you definitely won't be able to either, Chen Yi has the 'Annihilate Nine Clans' skill."
"You could try seducing him, maybe that will work on Chen Yi."
"..."
Li Peiqi, expressionless, pulled out a revolver from her embrace and pointed it at the waist of the Black Dragon Guild leader: "You old fart, if you don't stop this nonsense, do you believe I'll blow your brains out with one shot?"
...
Ten minutes later.
The Black Dragon Guild leader took a deep breath and said hoarsely and seriously, "Since Chen Yi came to us for help, that means there's a chance for our two sides to reconcile. Can we tell Chen Yi that we can help with this, but can he agree not to settle scores with us in the future?"
These past days.
He had been living in constant fear ever since he leaked some information about Chen Yi to those five groups and then witnessed Chen Yi annihilating ten billion players. He was always worried that one day Chen Yi would come to settle the score.
"Heh."
Li Peiqi sneered, "I told you not to snitch, but you insisted on doing it. Now you're scared?"
"What's the point of saying that now? In life, who can guarantee all their choices are correct? Besides, if I hadn't reported you to Chen Yi, would he have ever known it was me who told on you?"
"I didn't know you were my father back then. Who would've thought you'd been hiding and covering it up all this time!"
"Enough, enough, let's not talk about that. First tell me, do you have confidence in completing this task?"
"It's hard to say..."
Li Peiqi frowned and, after pondering for a moment, shook her head: "Chen Yi's friend is a player from Threefold Planet, and helping a player from Threefold Planet clear the hellish return map is not an easy matter."
"Moreover, that player has lost all their memories, probably doesn't even remember what the base game is."
"Under these circumstances, it's going to be very difficult. I can only make sure we can smoothly reach the player's hellish planet, but as for what happens afterward, I really can't guarantee anything, as my props won't support me in this."
"We'll talk about that!"
The Black Dragon Guild leader waved his hand seriously, "You can use all of the resources of the Black Dragon Gang, take any props you want, as long as you can complete Chen Yi's task, everything else is negotiable!"
"If we complete this task, maybe we can avoid future settlements."
"I'll try, but it really depends on how many times Chen Yi's friend has died. If it's less than five, it's still manageable, but if it's more than five, then there's really nothing I can do."
...
"Death count?"
Chen Yi glanced at Xu Yue lying on the bed and replied on the chat panel: "It should be the first death."
Players from the White Phoenix Clan lose all memories after death, which means all the White Phoenix Clan people he's seen should not have experienced death.
Right—
He suddenly remembered something.
The hellish return map prioritizes combat with players of the same clan, but if one falls into hell and loses all memory, perhaps even forgetting the base game, would they still be consciously able to navigate to the return map?
It's likely that not a single player from the White Phoenix Clan has participated in the hellish return map, right?
In the absence of players from the same clan, the system would match them with players from an alien race.
This matter he could only leave to Li Peiqi; no one else had any way to help, and he definitely couldn't enter the hell of the White Phoenix Clan himself, let alone expect the White Phoenix Clan people to go on a rescue mission, which was even more impossible.
Players from the White Phoenix Clan who enter hell lose their memories first, how could they then save someone else?
He hadn't yet told the guards outside that Xu Yue was dead, which was something he definitely couldn't disclose. He had thought of an excuse: the queen suddenly wanted to start cultivation and has gone into seclusion temporarily.
Would they believe it?
They should believe it, right? After all, isn't it said that players from the White Phoenix Clan are naturally dull?
Except for Xu Yue.
Once Xu Yue comes out of hell, he'll consider whether there's a way to restore her memory, and then Xu Yue could pay him some of the remaining Zenith Radiance in advance.
After that, he couldn't help but take another deep breath.
"What kind of karma have I created this time!"

chapters.title: Chapter 475 343: "You are those who once truly killed Deities.
chapters.content:
"Huh."
Chen Yi sat on the edge of the bed, exhaled a puff of smoke, and turned his head to look at Xu Yue on the bed, his eyes full of complexity. It was indeed a bit perplexing to have unwittingly stumbled into such an entanglement.
If it was about feelings, there really weren't any.
Although Xu Yue's methods were somewhat underhanded, she didn't do anything too outrageous to him; to actually act against the White Phoenix Clan because of it felt somewhat heavy-handed.
Idle hands are the devil's workshop.
After pondering for a moment, he got up and began to look around the interior of the palace.
...
"It's quite beautiful."
Chen Yi, leaning on his cane with one hand, stood in front of a wall, his eyebrows raised as he examined the mural, which clearly recorded the changes of the White Phoenix Clan after the arrival of the 'ascending game'.
It recorded not only the game, but also the history that preceded it.
From the information in these murals, he had gained a half-baked understanding of the history of the White Phoenix Clan.
Just as Xu Yue had mentioned.
The White Phoenix Clan had once been cursed to be forgotten in the timeline, a long, long time ago, reportedly because the queen of the White Phoenix Clan at that time had refused a deity's courtship.
Having felt humiliated, the deity cursed the White Phoenix Clan.
The curse made the White Phoenix Clan perpetually three months behind the rest of the world.
Of course, before the arrival of the 'ascending game', the effects of the curse had been almost imperceptible, leading many clan members to believe it was just a legend.
"Deities."
Chen Yi propped his chin thoughtfully with one hand as he stared at the mural on the wall, feeling skeptical, as if he were looking at a piece of mythologized history.
Do deities really exist?
If deities truly existed, would they not use force but choose to curse instead?
Could there be such a weak curse?
Wait a second, Chen Yi suddenly remembered something and stood in place, stunned. Li Peiqi should not be able to see Xu Yue in hell anymore; all the Alien Race players he had killed died instantly and had no chance to go to hell.
While he was in a daze, he suddenly heard a cold voice beside his ear, "Does it look good?"
"Yes, beautiful."
Chen Yi glanced at the source of the voice, and seeing that it was Xu Yue, he responded without much thought, but then he suddenly realized something, his body stiffened, and he turned to look at Xu Yue, only to speak in disbelief after confirming it was truly her.
"You actually came out?"
Just a moment ago, he was thinking that Alien Race players killed by him seemed to have no chance to go to hell, and now she had returned, and it seemed that she did not appear to be suffering from memory loss.
"It seems you are quite surprised by my return."
Xu Yue, dressed in imperial robes that exuded nobility, walked beside Chen Yi and looked at the mural on the wall calmly, "These murals are a historical legacy passed down by the White Phoenix Clan over thousands of years, their authenticity is hard to discern, but they have indeed been passed down since ancient times."
"Maybe you've heard from Little Seven; when a player from the White Phoenix Clan dies and falls into hell, they lose all their memories and start a new life in hell."
"The fact is indeed so."
"Perhaps it's because we were left behind in the timeline, or maybe it's due to some bug caused by a conflict with the 'ascending game', the specific reason is unclear to us."
"But I am the queen of the White Phoenix Clan, and the queens of the White Phoenix Clan are born with the ability to be 'Immortal and Indestructible'."
"As the queen, I am the focal point of the entire White Phoenix Clan's faith. As long as the White Phoenix Clan survives, its queen will not die."
"Throughout history, there have only ever been two ways for the queens of the White Phoenix Clan to die."
"Suicide, natural death."
"Besides these, there are no other ways of death—not by murder, not by disease, not by accident. None can cause the death of a White Phoenix Clan queen, it's an innate power, not one granted by the 'ascending game'."
"Um..."
Chen Yi, unsure of what to say, touched his nose: "That's pretty strong."
"Come with me."
Xu Yue fell silent for a while and then, without another word, turned and walked along the corridor towards the depths. The deeper they went, the sparser the candlelight on the walls became, making the environment seem even darker.
In contrast, the murals became more and more lifelike, to the point where the figures in them seemed to come alive at any moment.
The astonishment in Chen Yi's eyes following behind intensified. The characters and landscapes in these murals were extremely vivid, and the deeper they went, the more murals depicting war there were.
And with each step, the depiction of war became more cruel and brutal.
...
Unwittingly, they had been walking along the corridor for nearly fifteen minutes.
"You just said, after the White Phoenix Clan's queen provoked a deity, why didn't that deity use force, but instead chose to curse? Why would there be such a weak deity, right?"
"I'll tell you the answer."
Xu Yue did not wait for Chen Yi to respond; she simply placed her jade hand on the stone door in front of them, and as it opened...
"Roar!!!"
Countless heart-wrenching roars resounded, one after another!
The almost palpable hatred and killing intent was like the ocean beneath a typhoon, overwhelming in its approach!
And behind the stone door was an immense space!
Large enough to accommodate an entire city!
Numerous monstrous creatures were bound by countless iron chains in the darkness, their blood-red and fierce eyes constantly raging and roaring.
"Because a long time ago, our White Phoenix Clan was not weak."

chapters.title: Chapter 476 343: "You Are the Ones Who Have Truly Killed Deities Before." _2
chapters.content:
"Imprisoning deities is not difficult."
"This is the core area of our White Phoenix Clan, where two deities have been imprisoned for thousands of years."
"..."
Chen Yi almost subconsciously activated his title, releasing all the accumulated killing intent from his body to barely withstand the overwhelming murderous aura and resentment that flooded towards him like a tide.
Even so, he couldn't help but take a slight step back.
On the other hand, Xu Yue stood motionless, her robe billowing in the wind.
"Deities?"
Chen Yi frowned, looking around and starting to wonder if he had picked up the wrong script. Wasn't this supposed to be an upgrading game? Why were there suddenly deities involved?
Behind the stone door, the darkness concealed an immense space.
About a hundred gigantic creatures were bound in midair by countless chains, glaring at him and roaring ferociously.
The smallest of these creatures were about six or seven meters tall.
The tallest even reached thirty-odd meters, roughly the height of a western-style building.
A headache even for Ultraman to deal with.
Each of these creatures had crimson eyes emitting a glow, not too strong, but enough to outline their formidable shapes.
The next second—
Xu Yue slapped the stone wall again.
Chen Yi then saw the dark space instantly lit up by numerous white lights, allowing him to see the truly colossal entities within the darkness!
One of them, a man, was a thousand meters tall.
He stood calmly in the center, with eyes closed and hair tinged yellow, as if in a deep slumber.
Hundreds of chains pierced through the man's body, firmly imprisoning him in place, rendering him unable to move for a millennium.
"This is the God of Knights."
Xu Yue calmly explained, standing next to Chen Yi: "According to our clan's historical records, he descended on the White Phoenix Star in the year 1987 B.C., ruling over the entire White Phoenix Star and demanding regular sacrifices from all members of the Blue Phoenix Tribe."
"No bulls, no sheep."
"Only babies who had just turned one month old."
"The people were suffering terribly."
"One year and three months later, the Queen of the White Phoenix Clan at the time used seductive tactics to lure the God of Knights to the palace, then had her servants knock him out with a club and proceeded to kill him."
"???"
Chen Yi turned to Xu Yue with a bewildered expression, anger tinging his voice: "Is this a hereditary tactic of your White Phoenix Clan? Why does this scene seem so familiar?"
"Have you been popularizing the club-knocking strategy since 2000 years ago?"
"I finally understand why your White Phoenix Clan has been ruled by queens all this time; I thought you were a matriarchal society, but it seems that you simply believe a queen can use seduction as a last resort, whereas a male king can't employ such a trump card of seduction?"
Xu Yue ignored Chen Yi's words and continued on her own.
"We thought it was all over, and the White Phoenix Clan celebrated for three days, but six months later, the God of Knights returned, and that's when we learned deities cannot be killed."
"Just as the White Phoenix Clan was about to be wiped out—"
"A new deity descended upon the White Phoenix Star, striving for the faith resources of the White Phoenix Clan, and got into a fierce battle with the God of Knights. Eventually, our ancestors somehow managed to use the chains you see to permanently imprison both deities right here."
"Oh, right."
"Do you remember the SSS-ranked binding prop that I used to restrain you? That prop has no additional effects, just one: absolute restraint."
"And that chain is a piece that fell from here."
"Over time, these deities gradually broke free from the chains and their strength is slowly recovering. Meanwhile, those chains that fell down turned into SSS-ranked props."
"The one you saw."
"Quite an honor, using something that bound deities to tie me up."
Chen Yi stretched his limbs and looked towards the two deities in the huge crater without speaking, but raised an eyebrow and said, "But 2000 years ago, were upgrade games already in existence?"
"That can't be."
"If upgrade games existed back then, there shouldn't be so few Monuments, with all that time accumulated, there should at least be thousands of players who obtained Monuments."
By his estimation, upgrade games have been around for no more than a hundred years, at the very most.
After all, many clues could be deduced.
Next to the God of Knights was another deity that resembled a gigantic skeleton, also a thousand meters tall, a massive skeletal structure.
The bones emitted a faint blue glow, and within the eye sockets burned a weak undead flame.
It was indiscernible whether it was looking or not, seeming quite eerie— if taken to Blue Star, boiled into bone soup, it could probably serve quite a few people.
Xu Yue shook her head, offering no explanation, and directly leaped into the depths of the crater.
After a moment's hesitation, Chen Yi summoned his Christmas sleigh and followed suit.
However, his reindeer were somewhat disappointing.
No sooner had it been summoned than it affectionately nuzzled Chen Yi's leg. Then, upon glancing at the two deities in the vast space, it stiffened and fainted on the spot.
"Fainted?"
Chen Yi crouched down in befuddlement, shook the reindeer, and appeared somewhat incredulous.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 343: "You Are Those Who Have Truly Killed Deities."_3
chapters.content:
No matter how intense the battles he faced before, or how the Tuberculosis Rabbit threatened to stuff those oddly flavored carrots into the elk's mouth, it never fainted. And now, it fainted just by looking at a deity?
This made him more cautious about the two items.
But he didn't think too much about it, instead, he recalled the elk back into his backpack and summoned the Mechanical Elk.
This unreliable thing, only the Mechanical Elk can be counted on at critical moments.
He didn't stay any longer; instead, he sat on the sled and jumped into the vast space before him, driving towards the ground.
A crazy idea began to emerge in his heart, nonetheless.
His Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle dealt damage based on a percentage of life. He wondered if it could kill these deities and, if they were indeed gods, how many rewards would he get for killing one.
Soon.
Chen Yi reached the ground, looking at Xu Yue's back, who had already landed. Before he could say anything,
he saw Xu Yue pointing at the props scattered all around and said calmly, "This place is littered with props of all levels and effects."
"Do you see that tree?"
Chen Yi followed the direction of Xu Yue's pointing, looking at a tree about ten meters away on a clearing, not even half a meter tall, which looked more like a landscape tree for home decoration: "Isn't that the World Tree of your White Phoenix Clan that can continuously produce Zenith Radiance?"
"Yes."
Xu Yue nodded and picked up a whip about a meter long from the ground, took a deep breath, and whipped towards the huge God of Knights about ten meters away.
The moment the whip was lashed out, it transformed into a whip hundreds of meters in length and struck heavily on the God of Knights' shin.
"Roar!"
The God of Knights, who had been closing its eyes, suddenly opened them upon being whipped and let out a hysterical roar: "Roar!!!"
The sound was so huge it almost made Chen Yi deaf!
The soil at the top of the space also began to crumble due to the sudden loud noise!
The roar seemed more like it was resonating deep in their souls, and covering one's ears did not prevent them from hearing this voice at all.
At the same time, when the whip was retracted, a prop slowly fell from the God of Knights, dropping to the ground and merging with the nearly thousand other props scattered on the surface.
"Do you see?"
Xu Yue threw the whip aside and introduced indifferently, "Just whip once, and you have a chance to drop a prop, the level of which is not limited."
"The World Tree you see was dropped from the God of Knights."
"What?"
A shock flashed in Chen Yi's eyes as he looked at the two deity figures in front of him as one might look at peerless beauties. Having something of value like this in one's home was a true treasure. What Race wouldn't rise quickly with these two things? A treasure drops with every whip.
How could the others even compete?
And the treasures that dropped are all so high-level? Despite not knowing the specific level of the World Tree, it surely must be at least SS-tier, right?
That's something that can continuously produce Zenith Radiance!
One every three days.
One is worth ten million Points.
Just a few more days, and he would have more than all his wealth combined.
"So what are we waiting for?"
Chen Yi glanced at the whip on the ground with a hint of eagerness and said, "Whipping by hand is too slow; your White Phoenix Clan's technology isn't up to par. Wait for me to bring over a giant electric motor, tie the whip to it."
"The kind that spins at 10,000 revolutions per minute."
"One minute, and you'll have whipped ten thousand times. Whip for a day, and the White Phoenix Clan will soon be on par with the Sixfold Planet."
"We'll split the proceeds—nine for me, one for you—as protection fees. With me around, no one will dare lay a hand on your White Phoenix Clan."
"No."
Xu Yue shook her head, a troubled expression crossing her eyes, "We only discovered this recently. Although whipping the deity with this whip does randomly drop props, it also loosens that chain, thereby accelerating the deity's escape."
"However, after carefully studying ancient history these days, I inadvertently discovered the biggest secret of the Rank-Up game."
"A long, long time ago, the White Phoenix Clan occasionally saw deities, and we were cursed by them with many curses."
"Certain curses, for example, dictate that everyone have a tail, that we are not allowed to live on land, or that our descendants will be dim-witted, forever forgotten by the world, among others,"
"But suddenly, one day hundreds of years ago, there was no further sign of any deity."
"Until the recent emergence of the Rank-Up game."
"The props in the Rank-Up game, many of the props and Skills, are very similar to the abilities of the deities. I've been suspecting that the Rank-Up game has been secretly imprisoning many deities and using some method to extract the Divine Power inside these deities to mass-produce props or even maps and things like that."
"..."
Chen Yi fell silent for a while; after confirming there was no pungent smell in the air, he lit up a cigarette and took a long drag before saying casually, "But what does any of this have to do with me?"
"It does."
"From what I've learned, across the entire span of history, very few deities have ever been truly killed off completely. Of course, it's just a legend after all."
"It was recorded by our ancestors based on conversations between deities themselves, impossible to discern truth from falsehood."

chapters.title: Chapter 478 343: "You Are Those Who Have Truly Killed Deities."_4
chapters.content:
"But it does tell us how to recognize those who have truly killed deities."
"One of the signs is—"
"People who kill deities are cursed by the deities with a backlash right before their death, causing their souls to become extremely chaotic."
"I sensed this trait in you."
"...Me?"
Chen Yi, somewhat dazed, raised a finger to point at himself, turning his head in bewilderment toward Xu Yue beside him, trying to discern if Xu Yue was joking.
"Mm-hmm."
Xu Yue nodded calmly, stating indifferently, "Or rather, not just you – your companions Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End also carry this aura."
"You are people who have truly killed deities."
"I don't know by what means you have killed a deity before, but perhaps in this life, you can use the same methods to help our White Phoenix Clan eradicate these two deities."
"I've calculated that, at most, in five years, these deities will break their chains and regain freedom."
