"At that time, these deities who have been imprisoned for thousands of years will unleash an unprecedented brutality, and the White Phoenix Clan will cease to exist."
"I've calculated for a long time and couldn't find a way out."
"I have tried many methods."
"But upon seeing you, I think, perhaps you are the White Phoenix Clan's only chance of survival."
"Anything you see here, including that World Tree capable of producing Zenith Radiance, you can take with you."
"I don't have any demands of you, and I'm not insisting that you must kill the deities, because I'm not sure if the information passed down from our ancestors is true, but if one day the White Phoenix Clan is exterminated by the deities—"
"I hope you will have a child with me."
"I've understood that children born from a union between players of different alien races can freely choose their race. If you choose the Blue Star Race for the child, they won't be affected by the extinction mechanism, leaving a progeny for the White Phoenix Clan."
"And even if you harbor any resentment towards my earlier plan, wanting to wipe out the White Phoenix Clan, you won't be able to."
"That giant skeleton you saw, the God of the Undead, once cursed our White Phoenix Clan with an inability to be exterminated by anyone – only they can bring about our extinction."
"As compensation—"
"I can agree to any one of your requests, with no limitations, and I promise to never use this method again in the future."
...
07:57 a.m.
The ready Tuberculosis Rabbit saw Chen Yi return and excitedly approached: "Yi, you've come back just in time. The National Day event will start in three minutes."
"There are quite a few interesting things in this event."
"Plus, we have an absolutely surprising gift for you, Yi – something beyond your imagination."
"Let's not talk about that now."
Chen Yi, with complex emotions, took out a plant that looked like a potted plant from his embrace and put it on the ground. Then he sat down on the stone bench nearby and silently began to smoke.
"What's this?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned in to take a look and, upon realizing the inconspicuous potted plant was in fact the World Tree capable of producing Zenith Radiance, stiffened on the spot, his eyes rolling back as he fell straight to the ground.
But he quickly got up again.
Dusting off himself, he said with a hint of astonishment, "Looks like my mental capacity has gotten a lot stronger, eh? Didn't faint from this shock?"
"It's true what they say, once you've seen the world, your horizons broaden."
Then, looking up excitedly at Chen Yi once more, he asked: "Yi, didn't you say you'd bring back five Zenith Radiances? How come you've brought the World Tree? Was the reward from the queen of the White Phoenix Clan that generous?"
"Mm-hmm."
Chen Yi remained silent with a complex expression for a moment before saying, "You guys stay here and keep watch. I have something to discuss with Jiaye. Jiaye, come with me."
"Oh."
Jiaye followed after Chen Yi somewhat cluelessly, hands twisting the hem of his shirt as they left the rooftop.
...
"Screwed."
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat down on the stone bench and, looking at the World Tree before him, remarked sentimentally, "Looks like Yi's got some family matters to deal with for a while. Seems we won't be able to join the event this time."
"Family matters?"
Sword Without End was still confused: "What family matters? Did Yi and his wife have a fight?"
"What do you think?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit gave Sword Without End a disdainful glance: "This is the World Tree that can produce Zenith Radiance, after all. Yi bringing this back leaves only two possibilities."
"The first is that he wiped out the White Phoenix Clan."
"But that obviously can't be the case because if the White Phoenix Clan were wiped out, then Little Seven's avatar would show as offline to me."
"So that leaves the second possibility."
"In that case... Yi is quite handsome, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 479 344: "At this moment, just like that moment ah...
chapters.content:
```
"..."
Inside the room.
Chen Yi sat on the edge of the bed, suddenly inhaling sharply due to a toothache and lit a cigarette. He fell into silence amid the wafting smoke, momentarily unsure how to begin speaking. This matter was turning out to be more troublesome than dealing with the clan from the Void Starfield.
What a mess this was.
Seemingly perceiving Chen Yi's awkwardness, Jiaye asked tentatively, "Yi, what's wrong? You look so strange, as if you've gotten involved with another woman or something?"
She had never seen Yi show such embarrassment before. No matter what the challenge, Yi had always been extremely calm.
Even when he was humiliated by the Five Clans last time, he managed to keep a composed expression, as if nothing had happened.
Why was he acting like this today?
Logically speaking, Yi bringing back the World Tree, which could continuously produce Zenith Radiance, should have been a cause for celebration; everyone should have been celebrating. But now, his furrowed brow and pained expression indicated that he must have encountered an extremely thorny problem that couldn't be easily resolved.
"What are you talking about!"
But who knew that just as her words fell,
Chen Yi, like a cat whose tail had been stepped on, suddenly leaped up from where he was, stammering with a pale face, "What kind of talk is that! Do I, Chen Yi, seem like that kind of person?"
"Is that really what you think of me?"
"Am I that kind of person in your eyes?"
"Is that how you see me?"
"..."
Jiaye's expression gradually became odd, "Did I hit the mark?"
"..."
Chen Yi's voice weakened, and he looked down, speaking softly to the person across from him, "You're quite perceptive."
...
Ten minutes later.
Having explained everything from beginning to end, Chen Yi sat quietly on the edge of the bed and murmured, "After that, I came back."
"The queen of the White Phoenix Clan is called Xu Yue, right?"
Jiaye nodded thoughtfully, soon catching the key point in Yi's story, "This woman has the ability to be Immortal and Indestructible, so you mean, Yi, that if you ever want to activate the Wife-Killing Buff, you can just go ahead and kill her?"
"She's the kind that doesn't even need to go to hell?"
"No, I..."
Before Chen Yi could explain, Jiaye spoke up first, "Why don't you take me to meet this sister first, is that okay?"
"..."
Almost instantaneously, chills ran down Chen Yi's spine as he imagined a fierce confrontation and felt a cold shiver through his body, "Umm... well..."
"You don't agree?"
"Agreed."
Without hesitating, Chen Yi jumped off the bed, pulled Jiaye into his arms, and stood there with a resentful face, pointing at the wall ahead and said fiercely, "Let's go, with you here, I need to vent this anger. We must slaughter the White Phoenix Clan today!"
"How dare they scheme against me!"
"Insolence!"
...
"Let's go."
Chen Yi, with a furious expression, walked onto the rooftop, rolled up his sleeves, and turned his head towards Tuberculosis Rabbit, "Come with me to the White Phoenix Clan. They've gone too far. I must go on a killing spree today!"
He then promptly dialed Xu Yue's number.
"Open a portal; I need to go back for a visit."
His voice was very decisive.
So was the response from the other end.
"Okay."
"..."
Chen Yi's body suddenly stiffened. They're actually opening it?
He had thought that she would refuse, but in this moment, he could only bite the bullet and look toward Tuberculosis Rabbit and Jiaye, suddenly feeling like his end was near, and said hoarsely, "Let's go."
"Alrighty."
At this moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit was happier than ever. Not only did he wrap his arms around Sword Without End, but he also couldn't stop smiling at Li Yide, appearing almost ready to set off firecrackers to announce the New Year.
"Yi, this is my new sworn brother, Li Yide."
"We've all met a few times."
"I've brought him along this time to broaden his horizons."
"Yi... Yi, hello everyone, I... my name is Li Yide."
Li Yide stood there with a terrified look and tears in his eyes, looking very wronged as he nodded in greeting to Yi and the others.
Why was he here?
A good question!
How the hell would he know!
He had just been hiding in his room, taking a last look at the photo of his ghost girlfriend Xiaoqian, tucking the photo deep in his chest, preparing to stand up and participate in the weekend National Day event at 8 pm, when Tuberculosis Rabbit had come knocking on his door.
Without saying a word,
just mentioning he was taking him to see the world, and then forcefully dragged him along.
Refuse?
He did refuse, then he got a black eye. Seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit's fist swinging again and the wicked smile on his face, he chose to follow him to 'see the world,' and thus he was forcibly brought here.
He had already envisioned his own end.
He'd probably be used as cannon fodder for scouting in some map, but why pick him? He'd always been well-behaved, and moreover, he had never crossed Yi and the others.
At this moment, Li Yide was quietly weeping inside, feeling incredibly wronged, praying silently that he wouldn't drop any precious Props that could help him claw his way out of hell, so that his strength wouldn't suffer too much when he returned.
...
"Don't be afraid."
As if sensing Li Yide's inner fear, Tuberculosis Rabbit put his arm around Li Yide's shoulder and meaningfully glanced at the fluffy Fox Tail behind Li Yide's back, grinning, "I'm taking you to meet some of your kind, you'll like it."
The reason Tuberculosis Rabbit had brought Li Yide over during the gap when Yi and Jiaye were talking was naturally because his mean streak had kicked in.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 480 344: "At this moment, just like that moment ah..."_2
chapters.content:
Maybe Li Yide doesn't have much of an impression of him.
But his impression of Li Yide is quite profound, it's hard to forget a player who wears a Fox Tail all year round.
And to be male at that, where does one find a man who wears a Butt Plug year-round? He'd probably never have to worry about constipation in his lifetime.
As for how he could guess that Yi would once again visit the White Phoenix Clan.
Heh heh.
Their Jiaye is no pushover, just tender in front of Yi; a woman who climbed up from the bottom with a mentally challenged brother can't be that soft.
Before the level-up game came along, she had already killed a merchant who insulted them, not something a tender woman would do.
There we go, Captain Wang.
We juniors happily munch on melon seeds on the side, isn't it delightful!
National Day limited event? Give me a break, can any event prize compare to the rare sight of Yi getting embarrassed?
Such a rare opportunity!
Although Sword Without End looks serious and acts as if he knows nothing, the occasional twitch of his mouth clearly shows he is struggling to hold back a laugh. The fist bump with Tuberculosis Rabbit behind the scenes reveals the excitement in their eyes.
Awesome!
Those who love to watch the excitement never complain about the trouble!
If there's no trouble, how can there be excitement? Might as well stay at home and poop!
...
Ten minutes.
Chen Yi, with an expressionless face, leads Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others to a familiar grassland, stepping onto the elevator under Little Seven's guidance.
Once again, they slowly overlook the somewhat retro-styled city from above.
"By the way,"
Chen Yi suddenly remembers something, his voice tinged with a hint of coldness as he asks, "Little Seven, do you know if there's any attendant who likes to club people from behind amongst Her Majesty's entourage?"
If he hadn't been clubbed unconscious twice in a row, he would never have let himself fall into such an embarrassing situation.
"I don't know."
Little Seven seriously frowns and thinks for a moment before giving a solemn shake of his head, "I'm not clear on that. I never know anything about what happens around Her Majesty, but it's rare for White Phoenix Clan players to attack from behind with a club."
"Such behavior is considered despicable and is looked down upon."
"At least I never club people like that."
"Hmm."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nods and speaks up for Little Seven, "I can vouch for that; the last time someone clubbed me in the alley, it was a companion of Little Seven named Wang Ping, Little Seven didn't lift a finger."
"But that guy's clubbing skills were terrible, how could a wooden stick knock someone unconscious?"
"And he even jumped out from the front."
"You should at least make some noise on the designated target's side or in front of them to attract their attention and expose their back before quickly approaching and knocking them down with a swift blow—it only makes sense."
"White Phoenix Clan players are generally not sharp-witted and aren't good deceivers."
Standing aside and guiding them, Little Seven thoughtfully nods without saying much.
"Hmph."
Chen Yi snorts coldly and glances at Jiaye's expression out of the corner of his eye before tightening his collar, "A bunch of villains, once I find out who clubbed me, I'll kill his entire family!"
White Phoenix Clan People not good at clubbing? Yeah, right!
Starting from thousands of years ago, the White Phoenix Clan has been luring with the queen's charms and then the attendants would club; he even suspects this has probably become part of the White Phoenix Clan's cultural heritage. Who would consider such a method for God Slaughter disgraceful?
...
At this moment, Li Yide also quickly realizes that it seems he's not brought in to be sent to his death, but rather... there really is no fighting.
And—
A flicker of confusion passes through his eyes as he observes the White Phoenix Clan players walking on the streets around him, why do they all have a fluffy big tail behind them?
And theirs are larger than his?
Seem softer, too?
He roughly understands why Tuberculosis Rabbit brought him along; is it to make their group seem more integrated?
In a semi-dazed state, Li Yide doesn't say much, just mindlessly following behind Tuberculosis Rabbit.
...
Soon—
Under Little Seven's guidance, Chen Yi and his party quickly arrive at that familiar palace.
"Ahead is the Queen's palace where she rests; I am not permitted to enter. I shall leave now."
After a small bow, Little Seven retreats and disappears.
Just as he vanishes in an instant, he runs down the street into a nearby Prop shop. The tactic of diverting gaze he just learned from Tuberculosis Rabbit could surely greatly enhance his success rate with clubbing.
Worthy of being Teacher Tuberculosis Rabbit!
Every move contained the wisdom of the universe!
Just as Chen Yi and his group set foot in the palace, they see Xu Yue approaching with a smile on her face, and a trace of embarrassment in the depths of her eyes. She wraps her arm around Jiaye's shoulder and half whispers, "This must be Sister Jiaye?"
"Just call me sister."
Jiaye sizes up Xu Yue, smiling like the moon, "Based on looks, sister should be a little older than me. I really can't presume the title of 'sister.'
"No no no, it's better to add sister."
Xu Yue, without the attitude she had in front of Chen Yi, now speaks with a lowered stance and some embarrassment, "My little sister did some wrong things and was just about to go and apologize to sister."
"It's nothing."
Jiaye gently pats Xu Yue's shoulder and consoles her with a smile, "It's my man who is not capable enough. Come on, sister, let's go aside and talk."

chapters.title: Chapter 481 344: "At this moment, just like that moment ah..."_3
chapters.content:
"Okay..."
Xu Yue couldn't help but glance at Chen Yi, and for a moment, felt a tingling scalp and weak legs as she walked toward a side room with Jiaye.
What was this situation?
She had just seduced someone else's husband, and now that man was knocking on her door?!
Could it be any more embarrassing?
...
Chen Yi watched as Xu Yue and Jiaye walked away, feeling like the world was going dark as if he was about to faint. His right hand shakily reached into his pocket for a cigarette and brought it to his lips, trying to light it. But due to trembling hands, the flame couldn't catch the tip.
"Clang!"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a kerosene lighter and, with a smooth flick, lit it for Yi, before remarking with a pensive tongue cluck, "Yi has quite the guts, good fortune, and an eye for quality!"
"Heh."
Chen Yi responded with a forced smile, exhaling a long puff of smoke, watching through the haze the retreating figures of Xu Yue and Jiaye, his hand still trembling slightly.
At this time, Xu Yue had already taken off her imperial robe.
She had changed into a set of palace homewear, looking nothing like an emperor, more like an ordinary woman in the palace, less majestic but more approachable.
And she was all smiles, almost a completely different person from the one he had just seen.
Jiaye, on the other hand, was wearing a sling dress, barefoot with waves breaking at her feet.
Compared to Jiaye's petite frame, Xu Yue stood at a lofty 176 centimeters.
Together, they quite resembled a pair of sisters.
"Eh?"
Sword Without End looked at the lighter in Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand with curiosity, "Is that lighter worth 20,000 points?"
"You've got a good eye."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit held up the lighter with a satisfied expression: "Bought it at the 'BCD' store in Awesome Starfield's Sky City. Not bad, huh? You recognize quality."
"..."
Sword Without End's mouth twitched slightly, looking at the engraving on the lighter, at a loss for words for a moment.
'Retail price 20k points.'
Anyone with eyes could see how much this thing was worth.
...
Meanwhile, Xu Yue had already taken Jiaye to an unoccupied side room.
Seeing that they were alone,
Xu Yue dropped her formalities, extremely embarrassed, she lowered her head, unable to look Jiaye in the eye, and whispered, "Jiaye, sister, I..."
"Blood test first."
"What?"
The unexpected command snapped her back to the present, and she looked up instinctively, just in time to see Jiaye already sitting on a stool, and on the table, there were dozens of various medical devices.
"There are thirteen steps in total, let's start with a blood draw," Jiaye said earnestly while fiddling with the devices, "You know, sister Xu Yue, it's not that I have anything against you. It's just that men, when they get carried away, tend to overlook a lot."
"But men can be careless; we women can't afford to be, can we?"
"Since you and Yi have consummated your marriage, I must first check your health, for AIDS, gynecological diseases, syphilis, and so on, right?"
"This way, it's both a precaution for you and protection for Yi and myself. Even if you do have AIDS, don't be scared, what kind of prop can't be obtained in this leveling-up game? Just like this set of medical devices I've got for health checks; wasn't it easy to acquire?"
"AIDS?"
Xu Yue looked at Jiaye with some confusion: "What's that?"
She truly didn't know what AIDS was; she had never heard of it. Was it a serious disease?
How could she possibly be ill? She was the queen of the White Phoenix Clan, an immortal and indestructible being, only capable of dying by suicide or old age, never by illness.
But perhaps, knowing she was in the wrong,
she obediently extended her arm for Jiaye to draw blood.
Half an hour later,
Jiaye looked at the series of test results in front of her, nodding contentedly: "Your body is fairly healthy, no infectious diseases. But sister, you have a bit of hypoglycemia. You need to eat more sugar on a regular basis to maintain good health."
"Oh oh, I'll listen to sister," Xu Yue nodded, her face uncontrollably flushing red. She could hear other people's inner thoughts, including Jiaye's!
She wanted to hear what Jiaye was really thinking!
And Jiaye's true intention was to take revenge for Yi, with the same method she used to bind Chen Yi earlier, she was planning to bind her later and even make her wear the emperor's robe.
The humiliation she made Chen Yi suffer, she's going to return it all back, without any change.
"Right, about this matter."
Jiaye paused, then tilted her head and said, "It's quite inappropriate. You know Yi usually doesn't suffer any grievances, so by plotting against Yi like this, even if Yi isn't angry, I am very angry."
"There must be closure to this affair."
"I..."
Xu Yue lowered her head and, tugging at her dress hem softly said, "I can, listen to you."
"Sigh," Jiaye patted her forehead with some resignation, "I almost forgot about this. You can hear other people's thoughts, so there's no need for me to say more. Go on, hurry and change into your imperial robe, and bring out that SSS-grade prop chain of yours."
...
Meanwhile, Chen Yi, drenched in sweat, was sitting on a stool in the center of the hall.
Like a prisoner awaiting judgment.
"Hey, don't say," the Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned back in his chair, resting his feet on the table, cracking sunflower seeds. He turned his head to Sword Without End with a grin and started chewing the fat.

chapters.title: Chapter 482 344: "At this moment, just like that moment ah..."_4
chapters.content:
"The scenery here is pretty good, isn't it? The air is nice too, and there aren't so many skyscrapers. Living here for a long time wouldn't feel oppressive."
"Coming here for a vacation every now and then would be quite nice."
"It's definitely better than taking a holiday deep in hell."
"You can say that again."
Sword Without End nodded seriously, obviously agreeing with Tuberculosis Rabbit's remarks.
Before Chen Yi and his group arrived, Xu Yue had already ordered the servants in the palace to prepare a large table of food and drinks. At this moment, Tie Chui was feasting alone, eating with great excitement.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End couldn't hide the smiles on their faces as they chatted.
Li Yide, on the other hand, was sitting cautiously on a stool, carefully picking up his food, fearful that any wrong move might upset these big shots. After all, there was no one on the scene that he could afford to provoke.
What's more—
He knew all too well that if he managed to annoy these great lords, even if he fell into hell, he wouldn't survive long there.
These lords were the type to cut the grass and remove the roots.
Just then!
Barefooted Jiaye emerged from a nearby chamber, a smile in her eyes as she trotted to Chen Yi's side, and, standing on tiptoes, whispered into his ear, "I took revenge for you, oh. You owe me this favor, so you must reward me."
"Revenge?"
Chen Yi was taken aback for a moment, looking somewhat bewildered at Jiaye who stood beside him: "Revenge for what?"
"Just follow me."
Without resistance, he could only brace himself as Jiaye pulled him towards the adjacent chamber. He could already predict what was going to happen next; he'd definitely be caught between two women, facing double the scolding.
Damn it!
Just the thought of being stuck between two women later on, unable to move forward or retreat, made his scalp tingle with dread!
Maybe run away if it's really unbearable?
But before he could finish his thoughts, Jiaye had already pulled him into the side chamber, quickly closing the door behind them.
From beside his ear came Jiaye's slightly gratified voice.
"Go on, Yi, pay back all the humiliations you suffered today," she said.
"The man of Jiaye is not someone who can be hit on the head with a blackjacks willy-nilly."
"..."
Chen Yi stood frozen, his eyes almost popping out of their sockets, looking in disbelief at the scene before him.
Xu Yue was dressed in an eminently majestic and high-status imperial robe, his body spread out in the shape of a 'big' character, tied to the bed, with his hands and feet each bound to the bedposts at the head and foot of the bed.
The way he was tied up was exactly the same as when Chen Yi had been knocked out with a cudgel!
On Xu Yue's head was a wind crown adorned with jewels, and the jewelry around his neck, wrists, and ankles was extravagant yet appropriate, lavish without being overdone, perfectly showcasing his status.
Right now, Xu Yue was closing his eyes tightly, lips slightly pursed, and two humiliating tears slowly rolled down his cheeks, hot from the corners of his eyes.
Bound by these chains, Xu Yue had virtually no chance to break free.
These chains were meant for binding deities. For a player, it was a piece of cake, Chen Yi himself couldn't break free from these chains, let alone Xu Yue.
"..."
Chen Yi, as though having a bout of senile dementia, trembled to the extreme as he took out a cigarette from his chest pocket and struggled to light it after several attempts. He finally managed to light it up and took a deep drag.
In the midst of the pale blue swirling smoke, he looked towards Xu Yue, tied in a 'big' character on the bed, and murmured unconsciously.
"This moment right here is just like that moment back there..."
"Just perfect, just perfect."
But quickly he came to his senses again, and turning to look seriously at Jiaye, he raised three fingers and said solemnly, "Jiaye, you've misunderstood me, I'm really not that kind of person."
"I was set up."
"Otherwise, I definitely wouldn't have had any relationship with her."
"You know me, in the debut map you also know what kind of person I am."
"..."
Jiaye pursed her lips without speaking, simply pushing Chen Yi towards the door, making sure it was opened just a crack, enough to see the back of his head, and then she lightly snapped her fingers.
The next second—
The door behind him was pushed open a sliver.
No one was visible, just a somewhat thin arm holding a huge Gatling gun, aimed at the back of Chen Yi's head with no hesitation, and it forcefully came crashing down.
"Crap!"
Before Chen Yi could open his mouth to say anything else, he felt a familiar pain at the back of his head, and in that instant, he couldn't help cursing out loud.
But there wasn't time to say more, as darkness fell before his eyes, and he passed out to the familiar sensation of dizziness.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 345: "Has Yi been maintaining this posture for a long time?
chapters.content:
When Chen Yi woke up again, he found himself lying on top of Xu Yue, and as he opened his eyes, he saw Xu Yue's tear-filled eyes.
"Damn!"
Startled awake, Chen Yi leaped out of bed, hastily put on his clothes which had been removed at some point, and scanned the room shouting, "Jiaye, Jiaye?!"
But looking around, there was no sign of Jiaye.
The room was empty except for him.
Something's wrong.
He looked at his B-class prop "Absolute Purity," whose usage count had dropped to zero. He'd only passed out for 30 seconds—Jiaye couldn't have gone far.
He wasn't worried about his prop usage count running out; after all, he had the title that could recharge prop usage counts. He just didn't want to make a complete fool of himself.
Just as Chen Yi was about to get up anxiously to look for Jiaye,
Before he could even move,
He saw Jiaye coming from the side, pushing him back onto Xu Yue, and lying on top of him whispered from behind, holding his waist, "Actually, little sister Xu Yue is also a person with a hard fate, just like me."
"You've done the deed, you don't plan to just leave without taking responsibility, do you?"
"I can accept that. After all, I don't want to be killed by you every day. With Xu Yue here, you can kill her the next time you want a buff. She won't have to go to hell, being 'Immortal and Indestructible' is just perfect for you."
"Don't talk, I want to hug you."
"..."
"..."
"..."
If emotions could be manifested in text, one would see four huge white exclamation marks hanging above Chen Yi's forehead as he remained rigid, not daring to make the slightest extra move.
Caught between two women like a sandwich cookie.
Before entering this room,
He had imagined the scene he would face, being interrogated by two women, like a millstone being pulled by two donkeys in a Shura Field, a test of utmost mental torture.
But unexpectedly,
Although it was different from what he had imagined, it felt almost the same.
Definitely caught in the middle, a sandwich cookie.
Other than being stiff, he had no clue what he should do now. He even silently recited three hundred Tang poems to expel all the distracting thoughts from his heart and purify himself.
"...why do you keep reciting poems?"
Just then, Xu Yue, lying on the bed with eyes filled with humiliated tears, suddenly opened her eyes and looked at Chen Yi with incomprehension.
"..."
Chen Yi turned his head expressionlessly towards the door; he had forgotten this woman could hear his thoughts. What kind of lousy prop was this.
Dammit, one day!
He would definitely install a camera on the back of his head and soundproof his heart.
...
"Match of three!"
"Match of four!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat excitedly on her chair, slamming down two one-meter-tall playing cards onto the table, and with a grin asked the man sitting opposite her, Li Yide, "Are you going to take them? Speak up, will you take them or not?"
"..."
Li Yide looked helplessly at his hand of cards.
"5, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and two kings."
He could only imagine how to win!
There were no more powerful hands left outside; he could play his pair of kings, followed by a straight from 5 to 9. It was likely that no one could beat his straight, and then he could simply play a 5 on its own to finish his hand.
The odds of winning were high.
But...
He raised his head and saw Tuberculosis Rabbit squatting on the chair opposite him, her excitement clear. With a sense of grievance, he silently threw out a pair of fives.
"Pair of fives, on top."
"Good!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded with satisfaction, "Pair of sevens, your move, are you taking them?"
"Can't beat it."
"Full house!"
As Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up to pull out five gigantic cards from her bosom, preparing to slam them onto the table with force, the door of the adjacent room suddenly opened, and Chen Yi, Jiaye, and Xu Yue, all expressionless, came out together.
Seeing this,
Tuberculosis Rabbit hurriedly dropped her cards and stood up to greet them, her eyes bright with excitement as she smiled broadly, "Good day, Brother Yi, Sister-in-law, ah..."
She paused on Xu Yue and then looked at Jiaye tentatively to ask, "How should I address this lady?"
"Any way is fine."
"Understood."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded meaningfully, then exchanged a look with Sword Without End, who was standing behind her. Both foxes saw the sly amusement in each other's eyes.
"Enough with the nonsense."
Chen Yi, with a cold expression, leaned on his cane and walked towards a table, "Let's focus our minds; we're facing a life-and-death crisis. If we don't handle this properly, our lives will be in danger."
"What are you worrying about at a time like this?"
Perhaps Chen Yi's tone was a bit harsh, as Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End exchanged glances, toned down their smiles, and sat up straight at the table, waiting for Yi to speak.
...
In the hall, before a long table.
Chen Yi, with an icy expression leaning on his cane, looked down at the people sitting on either side of the lower table. He scanned over each one silently, exuding a great sense of oppression and authority.
However, out of everyone's sight,
His legs were trembling at a steady rate.
They were sore indeed.
As everyone looked at him attentively, waiting for him to announce something significant, Chen Yi, on the other hand, felt a chill run down his spine and urged himself anxiously to think of something big to impress them with.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 345: "Has Yi been maintaining this posture for a long time?"_2
chapters.content:
There's no big deal at all!
There hasn't been anything significant lately, the biggest deal is this very issue today!
But today he must come up with something big to keep the situation under control, to prevent it from developing in an unpredictable direction.
About half a minute passed.
Chen Yi's eyes lit up, and he turned his icy gaze toward Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End, "You two, do you know that you've killed deities before?"
"Do you know your crime?"
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, completely baffled, looked at Chen Yi. His innocent eyes blinked, not knowing how to respond. He tentatively said, "Uh, should I acknowledge or deny this?"
"You can acknowledge."
"Then I acknowledge my crime."
"Since you've confessed, take him away and execute him."
"Yes."
Sword Without End stood up expressionlessly to take the order, then grabbed Tuberculosis Rabbit by the neck and walked toward the exit of the hall.
"Wait, wait!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who hadn't yet grasped what was happening and seeing that Sword Without End didn't seem to be joking, was somewhat dumbfounded and cried out loud, "What's happening, suddenly executing me? Wait, Sword Without End hasn't confessed yet, who'll execute him if I die?"
"Tie Chui."
Chen Yi continued in a cold voice.
"Present!"
Tie Chui, like a towering mountain, immediately stood up with a deep voice.
"Take him away and execute him as well."
Chen Yi pointed to Li Yide who was still holding a pair of poker cards, and waved his hand with some irritation.
"Yes!"
"Yi, what about due process? I haven't confessed yet?"
Li Yide said with a bitter face and a trembling voice, "How about interrogation? I'm tight-lipped, definitely won't confess. If I don't confess, you can't execute me, right?"
Tie Chui paid no attention to Li Yide's muttering, grabbed him by the collar, and strode out of the hall like he was dragging a small shrimp, with Fox Tail dragging on the ground behind him, pulled all the way out of the hall.
...
After everyone had left the hall.
Chen Yi finally couldn't keep up the facade any longer and plopped down into his chair. He took out a cigarette from his breast pocket and put it in his mouth, rubbed his temples with a somewhat dazed expression, and muttered softly, "Give me a moment."
"Everyone is tired too, take a break."
A moment later.
Chen Yi suddenly stood up seriously and slapped his forehead, "I just remembered something, I haven't participated in my National Day limited-time event yet. I need to head back for a while, you guys carry on."
"Return not possible before 6 hours, and staying longer than 6 hours will trigger a compulsory return."
He sat back down again and continued in silence.
...
At 14:37 in the afternoon.
As a portal slowly opened on the rooftop, Chen Yi and his group safely returned, including Li Yide, who was also unharmed and safely back.
The journey was enjoyable, at least that's what most people thought.
As soon as he landed, Chen Yi immediately got busy, closely examining this National Day limited-time event.
"Ding, game event announcement!"
"From October 1st to October 3rd, the 'National Day' special limited-time event officially starts!"
"All players can participate in this event during these three days."
"Event One": Monarch of the Nation.
During the three days of the event, a limited-time cranial online game will be released. All players from Blue Star will play as monarchs in this game, where they can spend Points to recruit rewards and armies, and can launch wars to plunder resources from other players.
At the end of the event, the top hundred players with the highest war achievement value will win exclusive titles and special gift packs.
This event is sponsored by 'The Rim of the Land,' the free-to-play real-time strategy mobile game played by three hundred million people.
"Event Two": National Day Vacation.
During these three days, all players will not die for any reason and can enjoy their vacation peacefully.
"Event Three": Double Wages.
During the event, all the rewards that players get from any map or mission will be doubled.
"Event Four": Unrestrained Shopping.
During the event, all players can log into Star Map, a feature available only to those on Twofold Planet, which is a large shared shopping platform for all players, where only one Prop can be purchased. This purchase can break through the restrictions that players cannot receive gift Props from other players by any means.
"Event Five": Crazy Enhancement.
During the event, the Enhancement of all players' Vehicles can break through the limits, without any upper limit.
"Event Six": Limited-Time Gift Packs.
All players can purchase a National Day gift pack worth 199 Points, which includes a National Day firework and a random E-grade Prop. The store has also launched a National Day costume set valued at 1999 Points.
"Unkillable?"
Chen Yi looked at this event and licked his lips regretfully. If only this event had started earlier, with his over-a-hundred-million Life Value plus Recoil Armor, plus a three-day buff where he could not die.
He wouldn't go anywhere for these three days.
He'd just sleep in the Void Starfield.
Slowly reaping Life Value, it would be too awesome. Unfortunately, he no longer had the chance to go to other starfields; the last time he went to Awesome Starfield, it was in exchange for a favor from the Snow Sea Project Team.
And the Snow Sea Project Team had made it clear that their authorization could only be used once.
It's now October.
It's still about six months away from the end of Blue Star's Newbie Protection Period, almost half a year long. With his current strength, he doesn't dare to say he'll bring Blue Star directly to Fivefold or Sixfold Planet.
But he had no problem carrying Blue Star all the way to Threefold Planet all by himself.
As for the trial maps needed to advance to Twofold Planet, they were like toys to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 485 345: "Yi has been maintaining this posture for a long time, hasn't he?"_3
chapters.content:
Long ago, he was already capable of taking on the role of the Boss in the trial maps of Twofold Planet, not to mention now, with his strength greatly enhanced.
Unless he had a sudden brain cramp and insisted on running into the Twofold Planet trial map of Blue Star to play the Boss and intensify the challenge for Blue Star players, there was no way Blue Star's ascension to Twofold Planet could fail.
However, this impulsive purchasing was quite interesting.
He could bypass the restriction that players couldn't acquire any external player props and choose to purchase a prop on the Star Map, which was perfect since he had always had a prop outside that he couldn't retrieve, and now he could take this chance to get it back.
After that, he opened the chat panel with Li Yi.
"Li Yi, brother, remember the prop I asked you to look for last time? I now have the privilege to purchase a prop on the Star Map. Could you trouble brother to list it for me?"
"All set. I've priced it 30% higher than the market price, haha, otherwise, someone else would instantly snap it up. The prop's UID is: 73187238sdaakjsdk, just search for it, and after you've bid, I'll refund the money to you."
"No need, that would be somewhat embarrassing, wouldn't it?"
After exchanging some pleasantries with Li Yi, Chen Yi opened the Star Map panel, entered the prop's UID into the search box, and then chose to purchase.
"98w points deducted."
As the system prompt sounded.
He took out a prop from his backpack and handed it to Tie Chui beside him, smiling, "Here, for you, with this, you can be a normal person again."
"Thank... Thank you, Yi."
Although Tie Chui didn't know what the prop was, he was still excitedly thanking him, and then shared the prop's information panel in front of everyone.
'Prop Name': Head Therapy Device.
'Prop Level': B level.
'Prop Effect': Can cure 99% of brain-related diseases, including cerebral palsy, mental illness, depression, mania, cerebral thrombosis, etc.
'Number of Uses': 1/1.
'Prop Restrictions': This prop can only be used by players shorter than three meters, and requires the skull to fit properly into the Head Therapy Device; if the skull is too large, it cannot be used normally.
'Prop Description': "I say I'm not sick, but they all say I am."
Tie Chui might have been a little slow, but he wasn't dumb; he knew this device was for treating his illness, so he promptly fitted the thing that looked like a motorcycle helmet onto his head.
And he activated it right there and then.
"Zzzap!"
A white light flashed, and the Head Therapy Device suddenly lost its luster and dropped to the ground, looking incredibly ordinary, its use exhausted.
"How does it feel?"
Chen Yi looked at Tie Chui expectantly, waiting for him to become normal and greet them.
But...
All they saw was Tie Chui looking around blankly, without any change, stammering toward Yi, "Wha... What's... what's up?"
"Didn't it work?"
Chen Yi crouched down to pick up the helmet, his brow slightly furrowed as he pondered in silence. Wasn't the Head Therapy Device supposed to cure 99% of brain diseases? Could it be that Tie Chui was so unfortunate as to fall into that 1%?
"Maybe we should just let it go."
At that moment, Jiaye came forward, put an arm around Chen Yi's shoulder and whispered, "Yi, you've done what you could. Maybe my brother really is in that 1%, don't be too hard on yourself."
"Don't worry."
Chen Yi shook his head and activated his Starry Level title 'One Man Exterminates a Clan', restoring the Head Therapy Device's number of uses, before taking out an Ultimate Zenith Radiance from his chest.
He smashed it onto the device right then and there.
With the light flickering, the panel of the Head Therapy Device slowly changed before everyone's eyes.
'Prop Name': Head Therapy Device (Ultimate Edition).
'Prop Level': B level.
'Prop Effect': Can cure 100% of brain-related diseases, including cerebral palsy, mental illness, depression, mania, cerebral thrombosis, etc., and also purifies all negative effects from oneself.
As long as a player has a head, even if the player is dead, just placing this prop on the player's head can instantly pull the player back from hell, without needing to go through the hell revival map. However, it can't pull a player back from the depths of hell if they've become a janitor there.
'Number of Uses': 1/1.
'Prop Restrictions': This prop can only be used by players shorter than three meters, and requires the skull to fit properly into the Head Therapy Device; if the skull is too large, it cannot be used normally.
'Prop Description': "I say I'm not sick, but they all say I am."
You have to admit, the Ultimate Edition is impressively effective.
The enhancement was visible to the naked eye, with two practical and potent additions to its effects. However, the most useful change for them was the increase from 99% to 100%.
Even Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but remark again, "This Zenith Radiance really is a great thing. If only we could have it endlessly."
"Try it on."
Chen Yi, relieved, wearing a smile, stood up and passed the Head Therapy Device to Tie Chui. If it could cure Tie Chui's cerebral palsy, then the expenses were all worthwhile.
"Okay..."
Tie Chui nodded heavily, took the Ultimate Edition Head Therapy Device, and put it on his head.
The white light flashed again.
The light of the Head Therapy Device faded once more, and it fell to the ground again.
"How is it?"
Jiaye looked up at Tie Chui with expectation and tentatively asked, "Do you feel like your mind has cleared a lot all of a sudden? Like a lot of things just made sense in an instant?"
"Err..."
Tie Chui looked around blankly as if feeling the anticipation from everyone, and said in a low voice with some guilt, "It's no use, but I do feel much lighter."

chapters.title: Chapter 486 345: "Has Yi been maintaining this posture for a long time?"_4
chapters.content:
"..."
Chen Yi remained expressionless and silent, propping his chin with one hand and deep in thought without speaking. Weren't we told that a 100% of imagined diseases could be cured? Could the prop panel be deceiving?
"Wait a second!"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, suddenly realizing something with a flash of possible understanding and a somewhat weird expression, spoke up, "Is there a chance that we've been wrong from the start? That Tie Chui isn't mentally handicapped? Could it be that he was simply born with a low IQ and a bit of a stutter?"
Chen Yi also started to catch on and turned to look at Jiaye, "What? Wasn't Tie Chui diagnosed with pathological mental handicap?"
"Not sure."
Jiaye also seemed lost: "We've never had him checked at a hospital. But he has been like this since childhood, and after searching the internet, I thought it was cerebral palsy."
"..."
For a moment, everyone fell silent.
So Tie Chui's brain was never sick?
He was just born this way?
"That doesn't make sense."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, unsatisfied, spoke up, "Even if Tie Chui was born with a low IQ, being mentally deficient should still count as an imagined disease, right? Why can't it be cured?"
"Does a low IQ count as a disease?"
"What else could it be?"
"Then, would a high IQ count as a disease?"
"Of course!" the Tuberculosis Rabbit declared with conviction: "Doesn't the internet say that Einstein had a brain condition, which is why he had a high IQ? That definitely counts as a disease."
Chen Yi didn't pay attention to the argument between the Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End. Given the situation, it seemed Tie Chui's brain couldn't be fixed for now; not even an Ultimate Prop could do it. This was beyond their current ability to deal with.
Perhaps they would have to look for props that could fix IQ in the future.
"Right."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit slapped his forehead, speaking somewhat speechlessly, "Look at my memory, I almost forgot about such an important matter. I was too focused on eating melon. How could I forget such an important thing."
Then he hurriedly pulled out a battered pair of boots from his bosom and jogged over to Chen Yi, handing them over with a sycophantic smile.
"Yi, here, please take good care of the SSS-grade prop, the Sea God's Boots."
"This is the prop you hooked using the Gold Miner profession just before you left for the White Phoenix Clan's territory for the first time, an SSS-grade prop, take a look."
"SSS-grade?"
Chen Yi, not having time to react, was momentarily stunned, looking incredulously at the pair of boots that slightly smelled of the sea. The panel for the boots then popped up.
The series of prop effects listed on the panel.
And the lucent light flowing around the panel.
Caused Chen Yi's breath to catch.
Even his body tensed up—this was an SSS-grade prop! He had actually hooked an SSS-grade prop using the Gold Miner? Could the Gold Miner really hook an SSS-grade prop?
Although the occupational effect of the Gold Miner explicitly stated it could hook props of any grade, with SSS-grade as the upper limit, he had never imagined he'd be lucky enough to actually snag an SSS-grade prop.
...
Six hours later.
It was now nine o'clock in the evening, and the night had turned dark.
"Delicious!"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit sat next to the barbecue grill, fanning the fragrant meat on it with a pu fan, took a deep breath with a satisfied expression, and couldn't help but lament with a face full of happiness, "It's a shame I can't drink alcohol in October; it detracts from the enjoyment. Otherwise, that would really be living the good life!"
"Right."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, suddenly recalling something, looked up at Yi, who was sitting at the edge of the beach, motionless and seriously fiddling with the huge mining hook, and said with a somewhat strange expression, "Yi has been in that pose for a long time, hasn't he?"
"Yeah."
Sword Without End nodded in agreement, grabbed a handful of kebabs and stuffed them into his mouth, and after a hefty chew, shook his head helplessly, "Ever since Yi found out six hours ago that he hooked an SSS-grade Sea God's Boots using the Gold Miner occupation."
"He has maintained that pose."
"He's not eating, not sleeping, not caring about anything else."
"He seems determined to hook another SSS-grade prop before the Gold Miner profession expires."
"The wife tried to persuade him, to no avail."

chapters.title: Chapter 487 346: October 1st, Yancheng, The Fire Dragon Appears.
chapters.content:
"Forget it."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head with a touch of helplessness, "Let Yi do the fishing. It seems that the SSS-level prop has really impacted Yi greatly; I guess he won't be able to stop for a while."
"It's just a pity that the delicious tendon can only be eaten by the few of us."
...
Meanwhile, Chen Yi, sitting by the beachside, was completely devoid of the casualness he usually had when activating the Gold Miner. Instead, his eyes were fixed on the mining hook in the white portal in front of him, eager to inspect whatever it dredged up!
This is an SSS-level prop, isn't it?
Not just a great impact!
It had nearly shattered all of Chen Yi's principles. This was the first SSS-level prop he had ever seen—no, to be precise, the second. The first should be Xu Yue's chain.
But Xu Yue's SSS-level chain prop was a bit too specialized, with only one effect: binding.
Any creature caught by the chain couldn't escape—an absolute bind since it was something even deities couldn't break free from.
The effect was extremely singular.
Although the binding effect was indeed strong, it was generally useless in most cases, unlike the Boots of the Sea God. Its effects were extremely powerful and multifaceted.
Even if there was only one, without a matching boot.
It rendered the most formidable effects of being immortal and indestructible in the sea and upgrading all props to Ultimate Props while in the ocean unattainable.
However, the ability to breathe freely underwater, ignore water pressure, and communicate with sea creatures, these three prop effects were often more than enough.
Just at that moment—
The white portal in front of him began to tremble, and a daydreaming Chen Yi instantly perked up, staring intently at the mining hook about to be retrieved.
"Ding, congratulations on activating the Occupational Effect of the Gold Miner. Your hook has randomly dredged up an E-level prop for you in the game. Please enjoy."
"Prop name": Companion Chat Doll.
"Prop level": E-grade.
"Prop effect": This doll will automatically find topics for conversation, chat with you, and liven up the atmosphere. It's a great companion for alleviating loneliness when you're alone or for avoiding awkward silence at parties.
"Prop restriction": As long as it is placed in your backpack, the doll will cease to operate.
"Prop description": "It is said that a scientist, after spending a considerable amount of money on substandard service at a maid cafe one day, angrily created this prop out of frustration."
"..."
Chen Yi stared at the E-grade prop in front of him in silence, without a word.
An entire afternoon!!!
He had sat here for a whole afternoon, and even used various methods to enhance his luck, such as washing his hands before casting the hook and specially bringing in a feng shui expert from Yancheng to determine the most auspicious direction for casting to haul in a big catch, and so on.
All kinds of methods.
Whether it was superstitious or not, he had used them anyway.
But none of it worked.
It was now past nine o'clock in the evening after a whole afternoon without a single gain; half of the catches were useless junk that he had meticulously examined, including a few bottles of mineral water that had been drunk halfway.
The rest were uniformly E-level props.
Not even a single D-level prop was among them.
He couldn't believe it. When he had nothing to do for five minutes while visiting the White Phoenix Clan and casually cast a line without expecting anything, he ended up hauling in an SSS-level prop?
But now, when he fished earnestly, he couldn't catch anything at all?
What was this called?
Fate sometimes defies persistence; should he accept his lot by noon?
At that moment, the plush bear-like doll in his hand began to move its mouth slowly: "Why aren't you smiling? Don't you like to smile?"
"..."
Chen Yi tossed the doll into the air without a change in expression, then turned and delivered a forceful kick, sending the doll flying towards the Tuberculosis Rabbit—clearly his whole family didn't like to smile.
Then, he took a cigarette out of his pocket, placed it in his mouth, stood quietly gazing into the distance, and heaved a deep sigh.
He was becoming obsessed.
Such things couldn't be rushed; insistence would only lead to undesirable outcomes.
Thinking this, he yearned even more for the "Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea" prop that he hadn't obtained. With it, he could have cast hooks recklessly during the seven-day validity period of the "Gold Miner" occupation.
Just stack the layers of "Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea" high enough.
By then, perhaps one-tenth of all SSS-level props in the entire game would have been his for the taking, right?
What a pity, the destined battle with the player who possessed Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea was not set to start until three months later. There was still a long way to go before the date of the battle.
After this, Chen Yi decided not to dwell on it anymore.
Instead, he took out the "Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh," his old friend and the vehicle, from his backpack and activated it on the roof.
The startled elk, summoned forcibly from the backpack, did not display the usual laziness when it had just been summoned; it quickly scanned the surroundings for any danger before sighing in relief and collapsed on the ground, all limbs giving way.
The recent imprisonment by the White Phoenix Clan appeared to have left a significant psychological scar on the poor creature.
This vehicle was becoming somewhat outdated.
In Blue Star, it was still completely adequate, but after one trip to Awesome Starfield, he starkly realized the weakness of his vehicle, to the point where he felt a bit inferior. Others' vehicles could move at speeds measured in Mach.

chapters.title: Chapter 488 346: October 1st, Yancheng, The Fire Dragon Appears. _2
chapters.content:
As long as his speed was measured in kilometers per hour,
it would be impossible for him to catch up with anyone.
Fortunately, the National Day holiday event had removed the upper limit for vehicle enhancement, giving him the perfect opportunity to give his vehicle a significant boost.
After opening the modification panel, he quickly found what he was looking for.
"Modification Options": Supersonic Nitrogen Injection Cylinder.
"Modification Effect": Add one to increase your vehicle's maximum speed by 100km/hour.
"Modification Price": 20,000 Points.
"Modification Restriction": A maximum of 100 can be added to a single vehicle.
The initial speed of the sleigh was 300km/hour, and in his last modification, he had added 15 Supersonic Helium Jet Tubes to the end of the sleigh, bringing its top speed to 1800km/hour.
That was roughly around 1.4 Mach.
1 Mach is equivalent to the speed of sound, which is 1225.09km/hour.
Chen Yi's Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh could now reach a top speed of 1.4 Mach, which was barely adequate for Blue Star, but those damned TV station interview vehicles on Awesome Starfield had already reached speeds close to 30 Mach.
That's absolutely preposterous!
Enhance!
The more he thought about it, the angrier Chen Yi got, so without a second thought, he rolled up his sleeves and spent 1 million Points in a flash.
"Ding, player Chen Yi has spent 1 million Points to purchase 50 Supersonic Helium Jet Tubes for the modification of the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh."
The allure of money was unparalleled.
After splurging 1 million Points, the maximum speed of the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh shot up to 6,800km/hour, or roughly 5.5 Mach.
And such a commotion naturally drew Tuberculosis Rabbit and others over.
...
"Yi..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, holding a skewer of unfinished tendon, walked up to where Chen Yi stood on the rooftop, looking at the sleigh, which now seemed to have a rear-end collision with numerous rockets, and spoke with some astonishment.
"50 Helium Tubes?"
"Aren't there stronger Helium Jet Tubes in the enhancement shop? Do you have to resort to this method of a quantitative change leading to a qualitative change?"
He naturally knew what Yi was up to - enhancing the speed of the sleigh was quite normal, as on Awesome Starfield, the shortcomings of their vehicle had become apparent. Going to Sky City meant renting a car, which was not only inconvenient but also time-consuming.
It was indeed time for the vehicle to be enhanced.
But...
The modified sleigh was just too ugly; a full 65 Helium Jet Tubes were attached to the back of the sleigh. The sleigh, which could only fit around six or seven people and wasn't a particularly large vehicle, now looked like a peacock about to fan its feathers!
The Helium Jet Tubes, like rocket munitions, were attached to the rear of the sleigh.
Chen Yi ignored the reactions of Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others, frowning slightly with dissatisfaction. A speed of less than 6 Mach was too slow; not to mention Awesome Starfield, even before the upgrade game arrived, many Blue Star aircraft could reach this speed.
Far from enough.
Originally, a Mechanical Elk could only add up to 100 Helium Jet Tubes, which meant a maximum speed of about 10 Mach. But the restriction had been lifted just for this National Day holiday.
That made the speed of the Mechanical Elk limitless; theoretically, as long as one had enough Points, even the speed of light wouldn't be an issue.
Of course.
Whether the Mechanical Elk could withstand disintegration at the speed of light was another matter.
Chen Yi glanced at his Points Balance of 51.28 million.
Without a moment's hesitation,
he made a sweeping gesture!
"Ding, player Chen Yi has spent 20 million Points to purchase 1,000 Supersonic Helium Jet Tubes for the modification of the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh."
After investing 20 million Points, the sleigh underwent a drastic transformation!
And the speed began to soar dramatically.
It reached 106,800km/hour, which is 87.17 Mach!
Bear in mind that 23.5 Mach is sufficient to break out of Blue Star's atmosphere, making 87.17 Mach the fastest speed ever recorded for an aircraft on Blue Star, though this comparison does not include certain space-bound and nuclear-powered technologies.
"Not bad."
Looking at the speed limit of the sleigh, Chen Yi nodded in slight satisfaction. A speed of 87 Mach was remarkably soothing to his spirit. Although it cost 20 million Points, weren't Points meant to be spent?
Moreover, he had learned from Li Yi that vehicle enhancement costs during the Newbie Protection Period were much cheaper, a benefit for newcomers. Once the Newbie Protection Period was over, the costs would skyrocket, and it would be foolish not to take advantage of these discounts.
"..."
And at this moment—
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in place, his body rigid with shock and confusion, his mouth slowly gaping at the sight of the sleigh, at a loss for words!
A whopping 1065 Helium Acceleration Tubes were attached to the sleigh. What did that mean?
He was last this flabbergasted upon discovering a cinematic learning experience that promised an enlightening teacher-student dialogue on a specific website. He had patiently awaited the plot to deepen his immersion, ready to learn, and then silently absorbed 30 minutes of calculus.
Until the movie ended, the teacher remained as responsible as a model citizen, never stepping out of bounds.
The sleigh was now nearly 400 meters long in its entirety.
The original carriage of the sleigh took up about 5 meters, with the remaining 395 meters occupied by the Helium Acceleration Tubes.
As there was no room for them on the sleigh's rear, they were instead attached to other Helium Acceleration Tubes, continuing down the line, resembling a giant Nine-section Whip.

chapters.title: Chapter 489 346: October 1st, Yancheng, The Fire Dragon Appears._3
chapters.content:
"This is so badass."
Having recovered from the shock, Sword Without End swallowed hard and couldn't help but remark, "It's spectacular. If we take this thing to the Awesome Starfield, we'll definitely have the highest rate of turning heads."
"I only have one question, won't the flames from those helium jet tubes in the front melt the ones in the back? Or even cause a chain explosion?"
"The maximum speed has now reached an astonishing 87 Mach. Do you know what 87 Mach means?"
"What does it mean?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit tilted his head to look at Sword Without End, genuinely uncertain about the exact implications of 87 Mach since he had never ridden in a vehicle that fast.
"The concept of 87 Mach is that it's 1 Mach faster than 86 Mach."
"And what's the concept of 86 Mach?"
"It's 1 Mach faster than 85 Mach."
"..."
With an expressionless face, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned to Sword Without End and said coldly, "Do you think you're funny?"
"It's okay, I guess."
Sword Without End touched his nose and sheepishly admitted.
Meanwhile, Chen Yi didn't stop there. The sled's speed was enough, but the exterior's hardness had yet to catch up.
Last time he had modified the sled, he added a "protective shield" to it, a completely transparent dome that resembled glass and could protect the vehicle at high speeds.
Clearly, it was no longer sufficient.
But his solution was still simple: if the quality wasn't enough, he'd make up for it with quantity, especially since there was no limit on enhancements.
"Ding, player Chen Yi has spent 10 million Points to purchase 1,000 protective shields for the modification of the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh."
One protective shield, 10,000 Points.
His solution was simple: if one isn't enough, get 10,000.
So—
Exactly 10,000 huge protective shields wrapped around the entire body of the sled, ensuring its safety at high speeds.
The volume of the sled itself expanded several times, with a whopping diameter of 17 meters, most of which was the thickness of the protective shields.
Not to mention the long dragon-like tail made up of helium jet tubes at the back.
It resulted in a strange sight with a big head, a long, slender body.
"..."
Gazing at the vehicle in front of him that barely resembled a sled anymore, Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with an odd expression, "This thing kind of looks like a tadpole, one with an extremely long tail."
"To be honest, Yi, if it weren't for you, I'd never in my life associate a Christmas Sleigh with tadpoles."
"Nor could I have imagined a Christmas Sleigh being modified to look like a tadpole."
"I bet even if Santa Claus descended in December, he wouldn't be able to recognize that this tadpole vehicle was actually modeled after his Christmas Sleigh."
"Oh, right—"
He suddenly thought of a very serious issue: "Yi, with the protective shields being several meters thick and enveloping the sled so tightly, where's the space for the elk?"
"Uh..."
Chen Yi also realized the problem. Resting his chin on one hand, he began to ponder without a word. The elk had long been unnecessary; even at the previous speed of 1,800 km per hour, the elk couldn't keep control, and once the sled began moving, the elk would be left hanging at the back, suspended in the air.
He had always been using the Mechanical Elk.
Though the Mechanical Elk would also hang in the air, at least it was an inanimate object and wouldn't suffer or die suddenly.
The sled must have an elk to pull it in order to steer, which was the rule of the vehicle, even if the elk was hanging at the end of it.
Of course, under normal circumstances, the elk would not only steer but also provide power.
But times have changed, haven't they?
The numerous layers of the protective shield weren't hollow but rather solid layers fitting tightly one inside another, completely eliminating any space for an elk. Even if someone were to fart inside the cabin, without opening the ventilation, they could enjoy the smell for a long time.
"Put it inside the cabin."
Chen Yi quickly made a decision with no other choice. During the journey, keeping the elk in the cabin would do. As long as there was an elk linked to the sled for traction, it could be activated normally. Although it would take up some space, it seemed to be the only solution.
"All set."
Excited, he stood in front of the vehicle and clicked the option on the panel to open the hatch: "Come with me and feel the speed after the modification."
With the sound of gears turning,
the 1,000 protective shields uniformly opened up a hole big enough for two people to pass through, creating a transparent corridor.
"Get on."
Chen Yi took the lead, cane in hand, stepping onto the corridor.
"Goodness."
Stepping onto the corridor, Tuberculosis Rabbit felt the solidness beneath his feet. He lifted his foot and stomped down firmly, giving him the sensation of boarding a plane. The corridor stretched several meters.
After passing through this transparent corridor, the group finally settled inside the sled.
One had to say, the transparency of the protective shield was impeccable; after passing through 1,000 layers, it almost didn't affect the view at all. Looking up, one could still see the blue sky and white clouds against the night.
"This is great."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking up, couldn't help but express, "I've always felt that blue sky and white clouds in the night are the most beautiful, always giving one the sense that even if they die tonight, it's worth it."
Before he could continue to reflect,
"BOOM!!!"
A deafening roar erupted suddenly, one after another, followed by a powerful thrust that pinned Tuberculosis Rabbit firmly against his seat, rendering him immobile!
Over a thousand helium jet tubes lit up successively with thunderous noise!
Dazzling white flames, like a dragon, burst into the night sky, illuminating half of Yancheng overhead and propelling the huge tadpole's head, soaring into the skies!
It has been recorded.
On October 1st, in Yancheng, a fire dragon appeared to the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 490 347: "Profession": Giant Heavy Armor.
chapters.content:
```
"Boom!!"
Along with the roaring of the engine, the sled carrying Chen Yi and his companions accelerated to over a dozen Mach in just a few seconds, shooting towards the horizon!
This level of acceleration was unprecedented in the entire history of Blue Star.
And that was without Chen Yi flooring the throttle.
Although the prop panel didn't explicitly record it,
he could roughly feel that stomping the throttle all the way down would probably take about a dozen seconds to reach sixty or seventy Mach.
Reaching the maximum speed of eighty-seven Mach would probably take only about half a minute.
"Mother of God..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit's back was stuck to the seat, his hands death-gripped the handrests beside him, as he looked at the swiftly reversing scenery on both sides, already feeling a bit dizzy; with the sled reaching around twenty to thirty Mach, he could hardly tell whether he was moving forwards or backwards anymore.
One moment, the scenery on both sides appeared to move backward, the next, forward, feeling like performing acrobatics.
Unlike the train they took in Awesome Starfield, although it was equally fast, it didn't offer much of an experience, perhaps because they'd modified the sled too crudely, resulting in a strong push-back.
Fortunately, they installed some facilities, like air pressure regulation.
Which prevented them from fainting on the spot as the sled instantly accelerated to over a dozen Mach.
A normal person, without any protective measures, boarding a craft that instantly accelerates to over a dozen Mach, would probably not have many opportunities to reunite with the world in this lifetime.
The current speed was pretty much at the limit for Blue Star.
If they went any faster, their flight path would become elliptical, and Blue Star is spherical...
...
It wasn't long before Chen Yi and his group arrived at the Arctic Circle.
They had incredible luck.
The sky was clear and cloudless that night, visibility was extremely high.
Just as they reached the Arctic Circle, they happened to witness the aurora blossoming on the horizon.
Stunning beauty.
As if an oil painting were recreated in reality.
Chen Yi brought the sled to a hovering stop mid-air, lifted his head to look at the aurora on the horizon with a slight smile, silent, the spectacle was too beautiful. Before the advent of the leveling up game, it's unlikely they would have had the chance to see the aurora in their lifetime.
But with the coming of the leveling up game, they got their chance.
It was a respite amidst hardship.
"It's so beautiful."
Jiaye leaned into Chen Yi's embrace, whispering as she looked up at the aurora in the sky.
No one spoke; instead, they quietly huddled together, silently enjoying this moment of comfort.
Jiaye lay in Chen Yi's arms, Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit huddled together, leaving Tie Chui alone, sitting there, scanning the surroundings with a confused expression, his heart feeling lost.
...
"..."
"Phew!"
Chen Yi tiptoed out of bed and walked toward the rooftop, stretching comfortably as he looked towards the rising sun, then glanced at the clock on the wall.
'October 5th, 07:37.'
It was October 5th.
The National Day event had long ended, that sand table game imitating The Rim of the Land, he didn't play, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others did, but they didn't spend any points, nor did other players.
Although points could make you a big shot, everyone wasn't dumb; in such a dangerous environment, points were extremely precious.
It would be a waste to spend them on points simply for the sake of being a big spender.
Even the most mischievous kids wouldn't spend their points on the game; these days, the truly foolish have all died off, while those still alive were all smart as whips.
The main thing was that the game was only around for three days of play, who would be silly enough to spend their points on it? If it were a permanent feature, maybe indeed some players would be willing to top up for entertainment.
A three-day experience card that costs money? Pure foolishness.
The only useful activities for him this time were two: one was vehicle enhancement with no upper limit, and the other was that players could purchase any item on the Star Map, exempting new players from the rule about not getting items from the outside world.
He took the opportunity to buy a Head Therapy Device for Tie Chui, later upgrading it to the Ultimate Edition, though it didn't have any effect. Tie Chui's imagination had no diseases; why it was so, he couldn't figure out at the moment.
As for Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others, after browsing the Star Map for half a day, they each purchased a prop they fancied.
It was not long since Sword Without End and the others had joined him, and on regular days, they didn't have many opportunities to earn points and didn't have much of a points balance.
Jiaye, Tie Chui, Sword Without End, Tuberculosis Rabbit,
He gave each of them two million points.
Spending eight million.
That was as spending money, giving them enough options on the Star Map.
And with that, his own points balance, which had been over fifty million, was now only 17.88 million.
He had many props, skills, and titles that needed to spend points, he needed to save some for emergencies.
Besides, there were other places where points needed to be used.
He needed to find a way to earn more points.
He was running short on points, and the idea Tuberculosis Rabbit had mentioned about opening a mall in Sky City to make money didn't seem feasible either, only... To open a mall in Sky City would require a lot of money, and his funds were still far from enough.
Chen Yi shook his head, stopped his wild thoughts, and decided to take things one at a time. Of the eight Zenith Radiance devices he brought from the White Phoenix Clan, he had only used one; there were still seven unused.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 491 347: "Profession": Giant Heavy Armor. _2
chapters.content:
Originally, he said there would be more, but he later felt too embarrassed to ask and simply left.
However, he was given the World Tree, able to continually produce Zenith Radiance; it could produce one every three days, so two more were produced in these six days.
This brought his total count of Zenith Radiance to nine.
But—
Before enhancing, there was an even more important matter. Chen Yi looked up at his personal panel, specifically the section for his profession.
The "Faceless One" occupational effect allows for the random change of profession every seven days, and disregards any occupational restrictions.
His previous occupation, "Gold Miner," had already retired, and who knew when he would randomly encounter this profession again, certainly not anytime soon. During these six days, he spent most of his time sitting on the beach casting hooks.
But it seemed his luck had been thoroughly used up on the SSS-grade prop, "Sea God's Boots."
Countless subsequent hook throws yielded nothing of value. The most valuable item he reeled in was a B-grade prop, which could enhance physical fitness—he gave it to Sword Without End.
The rest were all sorts of junk and scrap metal, which he dumped onto Tuberculosis Rabbit for collection.
The most absurd part was.
The air-series food props—he actually hooked over twenty of them.
Tuberculosis Rabbit, on the other hand, was quite happy about this.
There are a total of 289 air-series food props, and he had already collected 129 of them. Only 160 more were needed to complete the full set, and one of Tuberculosis Rabbit's recent goals was to collect the entire series of air-series food props in his lifetime.
And then there's the advanced version.
Once the collection is complete, all 289 food props will be upgraded to Ultimate Props.
As for that, Chen Yi just chuckled dismissively, without much comment. How rich must they be, to spend 300 Zenith Radiance so frivolously?
"Occupation": Giant Heavy Armor.
"Occupational Effect": Upon obtaining this occupation, your Life Value will increase by 1000, and once the occupational effect is activated, you will passively recover 10% of your Maximum Health Value every second for 60 seconds. However, you will be unable to use any firearms class props, titles, skills, etc.
"Occupational Restriction": Using the occupational effect will result in a 24-hour cooldown period.
"Giant Heavy Armor?"
Chen Yi's brow furrowed slightly as he looked at the effect of this profession. The name suggested it was a tank, and indeed the occupational effect confirmed it—a boost of 1000 Life Value, which was quite impressive.
Consider that Li Yi's S-grade prop only added a little over 1000 Life Value.
In a sense, if every player on Sixfold Planet chose this profession, it would mean that each person had an S-grade prop worth a fortune, adding 1000 Life Value. It's not just the additional Life Value that was terrifying, but the fact that it could digitize your Life Value!
To put it in a blunt and straightforward way.
It was as if you had ten extra lives. Of course, this effect was useless to him; with over a billion Life Value at his disposal, 1000 Life Value was inconsequential. But the ability to passively recover 10% of Maximum Health Value every second, that occupational effect was something he coveted.
Normal players had restrictions on this occupation, being able to use it only once every 24 hours. However, his "Faceless One" could ignore all occupation restrictions, which meant he could use this occupational effect infinitely.
All day, every day, he would possess the ability to recover 10% of his Maximum Health Value every second!
Well, now it would be even harder to die.
It had become an almost impossible feat.
The trade-off was being unable to use any firearms class props. His Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle would be useless, only good for leaning on as a cane. Also, he would be unable to use the prop of Buddha sitting cross-legged on the Lotus Platform wielding the Fire God Gatling. His combat power took a slight hit.
But it didn't make much of a difference.
The "Buddha's Fury" prop was mainly strong when the Wife-Killing Buff was active, allowing it to trigger thousands of times instantly and cover enemies with firepower.
Without this buff, the prop wasn't strong at all.
A lone Buddha wasn't enough to generate effective firepower coverage against enemies, rendering it essentially non-threatening.
There was virtually no impact on his combat capability.
The negative restrictions were almost entirely negligible for him.
What remained were all the highly advantageous positive buffs.
Just as he was preparing to contemplate further on which props to spend the remaining Zenith Radiance on, a prompt suddenly popped up before him.
"Ding, an unknown player has invited you to enter the A-grade difficulty map 'Pharaoh's Tomb.' Clearing this map will award you with an unrated Zenith Radiance prop. Do you accept?"
"This map is for solo play."
"ps: It has been detected that you hold the 'Great Demon King' title, and you may refuse this invitation."
"Please make your choice within ten seconds."
"Oh?"
Chen Yi, who had been contemplating how to use the remaining Zenith Radiance, looked at the system panel that had just popped up with a slightly wrinkled brow and remained thoughtfully silent.
An invite from a stranger to enter an A-grade difficulty map?
Somehow interesting.
It seemed to be an invite with ill intentions.
To top it all off, the term "unknown player" was used—it was almost like having the word "villain" written on their forehead.
Normally, he would have flatly refused, as he detested being invited into all sorts of random maps.

chapters.title: Chapter 492 347: "Profession": Giant Heavy Armor.
chapters.content:
But today was different.
Firstly, the reward for this map was a Zenith Radiance, which still held some attraction for him.
Although he already had nine Zenith Radiance in his possession, a single Zenith Radiance was worth around ten million Points. No one would complain about having too much money.
The reason he hadn't sold any of the Supreme Radiance was because, although he was a bit short on Points, he wasn't in dire need, and enhancing his props with the Zenith Radiance could bring him greater profits.
However, it was clear that the player sabotaging from behind had also put in a lot of effort.
Such generous rewards were indeed very tempting.
And there was another important point.
It was the class he had just rolled today: Giant Heavy Armor.
Being able to recover 10% of his Maximum Health Value every second meant that it was nearly impossible for him to die, no matter what dangers lay within the map, he had little to fear.
He had only a few seconds left to make a choice.
There wasn't much time for him to hesitate.
As the saying goes, the bolder the artist, the greater the confidence, and without any hesitation, Chen Yi accepted the invitation decisively.
The next second—
A familiar flash of white light passed before his eyes, and by the time Chen Yi came back to his senses, he had already appeared in a desolate wasteland devoid of even weeds.
In front of him, a complete map panel popped up again.
'Map Name': Pharaoh's Tomb.
'Map Level': A-level.
'Map Content': Players will appear at the entrance of a huge ancient tomb, filled with nearly endless mummies attacking the player, and along the way, there are countless mechanisms.
Players need to pass through the mechanisms and traps, reach the deepest part of the tomb, defeat the final boss Pharaoh, and then they may leave the map.
'Map Reward': Defeating a mummy will earn 1 Point; by clearing the map, one can get a Zenith Radiance, and different rewards will be given based on the performance evaluation within the map.
'Map Introduction': "Many brave adventurers have been devoured here; will you be the next?"
