'ps: Chen Yi, please introduce yourself simply. I am the current head of the Feng Family. Maybe you are too confident and think that an A-level map can't stop you, or perhaps you are blinded by the lure of Zenith Radiance, but regardless of the reason.'
'I regret to inform you that this will be our last contact. This ancient tomb will be your final resting place.'
'You, with only this much cunning, are a disappointment to me.'
The next second—
New prompt sounds came once again.
'Ding, it has been detected that the player entering has a Monument from the base game; therefore, the rewards and difficulty of this map are significantly increased.'
'1: If the player dies within this map, they will die permanently; there is no need to fall into hell but go directly to the depths of hell to become a janitor, and a player who has earned a Monument from the base game dying in an A-level map means that the player is not worthy of a Seed Player spot; thus, they are stripped of their Seed title and cannot use the Seed spot to come back from hell.'
'2: All rewards gained by the player in this map will be doubled.'
'3: The strength of the final boss, Pharaoh, will be tripled.'
'4: After the mummies within this map die, they will transform into two mummies and attack the protagonist again, and they will continue to split indefinitely until the final boss Pharaoh is dead.'
'5: The number of mechanisms within this map will be tripled.'
'6: Players within this map are prohibited from using any title; if a Title Effect was activated before entering the map, that effect will also disappear.'
'7: Players within this map are forbidden from contacting any outside players by any means.'
A series of prompts rang out in quick succession by Chen Yi's ears.
"..."
Chen Yi looked at the series of system panels in front of him with a somewhat odd expression, feeling at a loss for words. Was this someone giving him a pillow as he was about to doze off?
The Feng Family again?
His debut map, designed just for him last time, got him quite a few rare rewards, including the extremely rare class 'Faceless One.' And now this again?
Did they realize he was short on Points and decided to send him some?
Getting 2 Points for killing a mummy? And the mummies kept infinitely splitting after death? Most importantly, this map had no time limit? In other words, as long as he was willing, he could farm up to trillions of Points here and then leave at his leisure?
Was he supposed to just raid the Star Map clean after exiting?
Was the Feng Family too fond of him, almost as if they were his benefactors rather than his enemies? After all, he was an orphan—if he truly had parents, not even they might have been so kind to him.
If the Feng Family kept this up, he might really start to not want to kill them. They weren't enemies; they were more like benefactors.
Afterward, he took a look at the surrounding environment.
An extremely barren piece of land, on a low mountain in front of him was an entrance that could allow a heavy truck to pass through, and inside the entrance was a set of steps that weren't too steep, looking like a black hole that could half-swallow all the light, giving a shudder to anyone who beheld it.
He raised his eyebrows slightly, not entering the cave immediately but instead began to inspect the wasteland around the cave entrance. Although he was confident enough, he still wanted to see if there were any terrain features he could use or any hidden map props.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 347: "Profession": Giant Heavy Armor. _4
chapters.content:
...
What Chen Yi didn't know was.
At the moment he confirmed his acceptance.
The Patriarch of the Feng Family, located at the Annihilation Starfield Project Team, couldn't help but slightly curve the corners of his mouth upward, revealing a smile of a conspiracy triumphing in his eyes. Placing his hands on the desk, he looked at Chen Yi in the screen, feigning a shake of his head and a sigh.
"Young people really are impatient, aren't they? Just seeing Zenith Radiance and a 10-second countdown can easily cloud their judgment."
"I originally thought he was going to be a tough opponent."
"Now it looks like I didn't even need to use seventy percent of my strength, and he's already finished."
"This is quite disappointing."
"Isn't it?"
Standing behind the Patriarch of the Feng Family, Feng Yuan's eyes flickered with the satisfaction of revenge being served. His long-held grudge was finally coming to an end. These past days, Chen Yi had been throwing his weight around in the entire Ascension game.
But his own days were about to get tough.
Originally, relying on the Feng Family's name, wherever he went on any planet's territory, wasn't everyone extremely respectful towards him?
Helping those players, to be honest, was a bit difficult, but wanting to harm a particular player was not hard at all.
However, ever since he suffered a setback at the hands of Chen Yi, and the Five Clans were annihilated by him, his prestige within Annihilation Starfield had greatly diminished, making him feel like he had lost all face.
"Right—"
Suddenly remembering something, Feng Yuan spoke up, "The leader of the Annihilation Starfield Project Team contacted us again. They want us to find a way to cancel this map as soon as possible, and then act as mediators to help us negotiate with Chen Yi."
"Negotiate?"
The Patriarch of the Feng Family sneered, "Negotiate my ass. It's a fight to the death."
"Of course, we don't need to respond so directly. After all, that leader is also my superior. Just keep stalling, that's fine. Once Chen Yi is dead, everything will be easy to discuss. By the way, has the live-stream for the players in Annihilation Starfield started yet?"
"It has."
Feng Yuan hurriedly nodded in agreement, "All the players in Annihilation Starfield can see this live-stream. Chen Yi's death will bring back all the face our Feng Family has lost these days."
"Very good."
The Patriarch of the Feng Family nodded in satisfaction, "That's the way to do it."
He then turned his gaze back to the screen in front of him, ready to start enjoying the look of despair on Chen Yi's face. He had already learned that Chen Yi's main strength came from a title that allowed him to use skills and props without limit.
For this, he had specially found such a prop for Chen Yi.
How's that?
I guess Chen Yi is already starting to despair, never having thought his strongest method would be cracked.
The first map he gave to Chen Yi was a map where all skills and props were restricted, but what annoyed him was that even without any fighting capability, Chen Yi managed to flatter and scramble the NPCs with nonsensical blabbering and successfully cleared the map.
So, this time, the map was specially screened by him.
Pure combat map.
It stripped Chen Yi of his strongest method, but it didn't entirely ban his combat capabilities. From the boss down to the mobs, all were beings without sentience, ensuring that Chen Yi couldn't clear it easily with his nonsensical talk like last time.
Can you really reason with these mummies?
This is a pure combat map. There's no second option but to fight your way out.
And since Chen Yi's strongest method is taken away, I really don't know what kind of tactic Chen Yi has that could keep him alive this time.
...
On the other hand.
Chen Yi had already surveyed the area around him. The map wasn't large, just a stretch of wasteland before his eyes.
The area of the wasteland was about the size of Yancheng. Compared to the maps he had been dealing with lately, this definitely qualified as a small map.
Surrounding the wasteland were walls of air, impenetrable.
In the center of the wasteland, there was a small hill with a tomb entrance on the rock face, and nothing else — a small-sized map.
After surveying the entire map, Chen Yi, with his walking stick in hand, took big strides into the tomb. The tomb was lit with oil lamps, and although the light wasn't dazzling, it was enough to ensure that he could clearly see everything around him.
Directly ahead was a corridor with steps leading downward.
About three to four meters in height and width, perfectly square.
The walls were covered with traces of antiquity and appeared to have some years on them.
Without much time to observe, he saw at the turn ahead of the steps, two mummies wielding rusty iron swords. They creaked towards him, running down the stairs.
They seemed to have a hard time running.
Their skeletons shook as they ran, making it difficult to imagine these bandage-wrapped skeletons possessing much strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 348: Where to Find a 40 Million Deal in One Day?
chapters.content:
In the strictest sense, the two creatures before me didn't quite resemble mummies; they were more like skeleton monsters wrapped in bandages.
As they trotted, their skeletal bodies shook.
It was worrying that they might fall apart before even reaching the enemy.
But thankfully—
that didn't happen. No matter how frail they seemed, they were still minor monsters from an A-level map and wouldn't simply fall apart with a gust of wind. They rattled towards Chen Yi, appearing like sales reps shouting about Thursday's big sale.
"Tssk!"
Chen Yi didn't make any move to dodge and just took the hits from the two skeletons.
'Ding, you've been attacked, HP -67!'
'Ding, you've been attacked, HP -67!'
Two notification sounds chimed in Chen Yi's ears one after another.
"Huh?"
A hint of surprise flickered in Chen Yi's eyes. He hadn't expected these mummies, which looked like they could be toppled by a breeze, to pack such a punch—the base HP for a player was 100.
No matter how physically fit you are, the HP remains at 100,think of it as a percentage-based HP deduction system.
That is to say.
If it were before he acquired the "Longevity as the Southern Mountains" prop, if he hadn't activated any defensive props, these two mummies could have sent him straight to hell.
This damage was seriously high.
Of course, it wasn't of any use against him. In the blink of an eye, his HP was fully replenished.
However, the moment these two mummies swung their blades, they were instantly hit back by the A-level "Recoil Armor" prop on Chen Yi's body, and their skeletons scattered into a loose pile of bones.
'Ding, you've killed 2 mummies, Points +4.'
Got it.
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully. In online gaming terms, these two mummies were high offense but low defense types, with strong attacks but very weak defenses.
Right after that—
The moment the two mummies crumbled into bones, the scattered bones began to reassemble and turned back into 4 mummies charging at Chen Yi!
"Clang!"
Accompanied by the notification of Points +8, 4 mummies turned back into 8 mummies.
"Ha."
A smirk spread across Chen Yi's face, which he could hardly keep from reaching his ears. What a deal; there were no time limits on this map, as long as the final boss wasn't killed, he could just stick around here.
Perfect!
He had a strong hunch that this map would be his greatest opportunity in October, bar none!
Thank you, Feng Family, thank you, Patriarch of the Feng Family. Such good people.
Only about fifteen minutes had passed.
An unending stream of mummies poured out from deep within the corridor. They split into more mummies after dying and swarmed towards Chen Yi. A glance revealed there were already thousands of mummies.
Chen Yi simply didn't step into the corridor; instead, he ran out to a low hill outside of the tomb and found a feng shui treasure spot, lying down on the ground against a tree root, and leisurely pulled out a novel from his bosom to enjoy.
It seemed like a waste not to read a novel during such a time, aside from the dim lighting caused by the besieging mummies, there were no other drawbacks.
"Hey, this is interesting."
Deeply engrossed in his novel, Chen Yi casually glanced at his personal panel and noticed that his Points had risen to 828. Shaking his head slightly in dissatisfaction, he mused, "The speed's a bit slow."
The splitting was indeed happening too slowly.
But it wasn't a big problem, he believed in the charm of exponential growth, he was convinced that in an hour or two, his points would start skyrocketing.
...
Meanwhile—
Many players in the Annihilation Starfield were also entering the live stream, and upon seeing this scene, many began discussing with complex expressions.
'The Feng Family again? Chen Yi is really unlucky to have crossed the Feng Family, it seems they won't rest until they've killed him. Chen Yi might have some incredibly strong methods, but there's not much he can do against the project team.'
'But it looks like Chen Yi has either a reflective prop or skill? He didn't even move, and those mummies died on their own?'
'What can I say? All I can say is Chen Yi is overlooking the exaggeration of exponential growth. Right now, he's completely dazzled by the Points brought by the mummies and thinks he can kill these mummies easily to farm here.'
'But he's completely forgotten that these mummies can split indefinitely. Once they split to a certain extent, even ants can kill a person, let alone mummies from an A-level map. Even if Chen Yi is currently safe due to some defensive prop, he'll realize the huge mistake he's made when the mummies become overwhelming.'
'Chen Yi has really screwed up this time. The best way to clear this map should be not killing any mummies along the way, rushing through the traps, sprinting down the corridor to the end of the ancient tomb, and focusing on killing the final boss, the Pharaoh, to safely leave the map, don't you think?'
'Hmm... I'd like to agree with you, but I always feel that Chen Yi wouldn't overlook something we could think of. By the way, why is the livestream's popularity so low this time? Has Chen Yi lost his appeal? Last time when Chen Yi wiped out the Five Clans, there were a lot of people in the livestream.'
'Heh, that time, watching Chen Yi's stream killed fifty billion players. Who would have thought you could watch a livestream and see yourself die? It's right that the popularity is low, only those with really big hearts would dare to watch Chen Yi's stream now, haven't you noticed there's not a single insult for Chen Yi in the comments? People are afraid that one of Chen Yi's followers is taking notes, and as soon as he comes out of the map, they'll begin settling scores.'

chapters.title: Chapter 495 348: Where to Find a 40 Million Deal in One Day?_2
chapters.content:
...
"Huh?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, ready to jot down names in a little notebook, looked at the comment before her, puzzled and said with surprise, "How does he know I'm taking notes of some trolls in my notebook, planning to settle accounts with them later?"
"Has our way of doing things become so predictable?"
"And why didn't Yi give us a heads-up before entering the map?"
Sword Without End spoke with a complexion that wasn't looking too good, "It must have been too late, but the comment is right. Yi might have been a bit too confident this time. Although Yi's prop, Longevity as the Southern Mountains, grants him over a hundred million in health, even the largest life value is bound to be depleted one day."
"And death on this map means absolute death."
"Not even the privileges of a seed player can be activated."
"Under these circumstances, if anything unexpected happens to Yi, we won't be able to see him again."
"Hey."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit shook her head without a care, "How could we never see him again? Worst comes to worst, Yi will just go to hell to work as a janitor. Then we'll just go to hell and be janitors as well, right?"
"The whole family will be all together."
"Right, Sword Without End, when the time comes, go to the White Phoenix Clan and wipe out that queen. If Yi is dead, she should go down there and accompany him."
"..."
After being silent for a moment, Sword Without End hoarsely said without expression, "The queen of the White Phoenix Clan is immortal and indestructible."
"If you annihilate the clan, she can die. Just wipe out the White Phoenix Clan," she was told.
"Do you think I can annihilate the White Phoenix Clan that's keeping two deities imprisoned?"
"I believe in you."
"Heh, you remind me of my former idiot boss who paid me a 3800 monthly salary to create an app to compete with TikTok."
"Yi has just offered you 2 million though."
"You're right."
Jiaye stood to the side without speaking, but there wasn't much worry in her eyes. Although Yi left in a hurry, he still sent her a message before he left. He didn't say much, but it included a screenshot, which was a snapshot of Yi's newly acquired occupation.
Looking at Chen Yi in the live stream enjoying his freedom, she casually shared the screenshot in front of Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others.
"Whoa."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the occupation panel before her with a strange expression, "Recover 10% of the maximum health value every second? And it ignores any restrictions, meaning there's no cooldown, and this effect happens every single second?"
"No wonder Yi dares to be so overconfident."
"With over a hundred million in health, 10% recovery every minute, that means every minute he regenerates more than 10 million in health. Under these conditions, forget about these mummies, even if tens of thousands of players from fivefold planets attacked him, he'd die clean."
"The last time I saw such a freakish occupational effect was with that Santa Claus who was chasing us."
"There's no comparison."
Sword Without End shook his head with resignation, "Although Yi's occupational effect is pretty freakish, it's nothing compared to Santa Claus's. That Santa Claus also has a life value in the hundreds of millions, and the recovery rate every minute is 100% of the maximum health value, much stronger than Yi."
"There's no way to kill him except for an instant kill."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit shook her head in dissent, "A player's life value and a boss' life value aren't the same. For example, Yi has a prop that could instantly shoot hundreds of bullets, each carrying the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle's attack effect, which can absolutely instant-kill that Santa Claus."
"But if that prop is used on Yi, it'd barely scratch off two or three hundred health points."
"Percentage-based health attacks on players work off a basis of 100 health points. With Yi's life value, he could eat percentage bullets and still be full."
"That's also true."
Sword Without End shrugged his shoulders and didn't argue any further, knowing that a player's life value and a boss's life value were fundamentally different. At this point, he also had no more concerns. There was absolutely nothing to worry about.
"Yi probably won't come out for a while. Seems like he wants to grind in the map until he reaches Desolate Prison."
"It just feels like the efficiency is a bit low."
"Although the number of mummies is rapidly increasing, only about a dozen can attack Yi each second. At this rate, it would take a long time before tens of thousands of mummies could be spawned."
...
At this very moment,
Chen Yi also realized the problem, put down the novel in his hand, and frowned deeply, staying quiet.
There were about 20,000 mummies surrounding him, but only a dozen could attack him at the same time, which meant that he was only earning a few dozen Points each second.
No matter how many mummies there were, the amount of Points he could earn per second was limited to that number.
That was obviously not in line with his plans.
Just as he was contemplating what methods he could use to have more mummies attack him at the same time, a light bulb went on, and he had a great idea.
He didn't have to rely entirely on his Recoil Armor to defeat these mummies. The main reason he hadn't activated props like Buddha's Fury was because without the Wife-Killing Buff, the usage and cooldown of those props were limited, and they couldn't continuously defeat mummies.
But,
It seemed he had a better, more sustainable method of attack!
Without any hesitation, Chen Yi activated the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh from his backpack.
The next second—
A chariot that seemed to have emerged from hell thundered down from mid-air, smashing countless mummies surrounding it to smithereens.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 348: Where to Find a 40 Million Deal in One Day?_3
chapters.content:
Following that, Chen Yi didn't hesitate at all. He followed the transparent corridor to the cockpit and then thousands of helium jet tubes started up at the same time.
"Boom!"
The moment he floored the accelerator, Chen Yi began crashing around. Just a tap on the gas pedal already scattered thousands of mummies, which then split into even more mummies.
But... he had enhanced the speed of the Mechanical Moose Christmas Sleigh too much.
Even though he was going easy on the accelerator, he would shoot off into the distance in a burst of speed, leaving no choice for Chen Yi but to turn around helplessly and charge towards the aimless mummies on the hill.
...
An hour later.
The audience in the live-streaming room began to feel a bit confused.
...
Three hours later.
The audience in the live-streaming room was completely baffled.
...
Six hours later.
The audience in the live-streaming room started looking expressionlessly at that long, dragon-like vehicle weaving wildly through the sea of mummies.
...
After a full six hours, with the index growing dramatically, it was impossible to count how many mummies there were on the map, let alone make an approximate estimate. The entire map was crowded with mummies, even piling up to nearly seven or eight meters in height.
It was like a vast ocean made up of mummies.
It was outrageous!
Chen Yi remained in a state of excitement, maneuvering the sleigh recklessly through the sea of mummies, wreaking havoc wherever he went, only for more countless mummies to rise again.
Just like this.
The depth of the sea of mummies slowly increased before his very eyes.
This map was as big as Yancheng, not particularly large but certainly not small either. However, at this point, the map was completely filled with a thick layer of mummies about seven or eight meters high.
Even if the Pharaoh Boss in the tomb wanted to rush out and actively kill Chen Yi, it would probably face a situation where it simply couldn't move at all.
Chen Yi, who was completely thrilled with his game, watched his points continuously and rapidly increase without caring for anything else. He even excitedly renamed his vehicle.
"Blue Star Dragon!"
Why not?
The hundreds of meters of flame-spewing jet tubes looked like a fiery dragon. It was only because Chen Yi held some status on Blue Star that nobody dared to refute him.
Otherwise, if the Blue Star players saw Chen Yi naming such a flaming tadpole "Blue Star Dragon," they would probably tremble with fury, feeling it an insult to Blue Star culture!
...
Before he knew it, three days had passed.
In these three days, that vehicle never stopped or rested, and Chen Yi had long surpassed that limit, having set autopilot to let the vehicle cruise freely through the sea of mummies.
Meanwhile, he was inside the sleigh, eating, drinking, and sleeping as needed.
It was like a vacation with no disturbances whatsoever.
Of course, due to his experience from the debut map, he had specifically collected some props that allowed him to deal with personal privacy and physiological needs effectively in relatively small spaces, including body cleaning.
The entire map was already filled with mummies.
He had nowhere to poop; he certainly couldn't squat mid-air and poop on the heads of these mummies, right?
To be honest, that would be disgusting.
He couldn't quite handle it personally, but some props were excellent at dealing with these issues, capable of disintegrating the waste in the body into molecules and then collecting them back into the prop for reassembly.
He just hoped that Jiaye and the others weren't worrying too much. He had left a message for Jiaye when he left, so Jiaye probably wouldn't worry about his safety. What Chen Yi did not know was that his current actions in the map were being live-streamed throughout the Annihilation Starfield.
Three days' time.
Had earned him a huge amount of points!
His vehicle started up, and every second it killed about 200 mummies because the density of the mummies was sufficient, and they didn't dodge. Or rather, in a situation surrounded by mummies, there was no space to dodge anyway.
Killing 200 mummies a second meant 12,000 in a minute, 720,000 in an hour, and 17,280,000 in 24 hours.
That's seventeen million!
Of course, this was just an approximate figure, not precise. After he set his sleigh to autopilot, it was designed to work uninterrupted for 24 hours non-stop. Killing one mummy earned 2 points.
This meant that in a day, he could accumulate nearly 40 million points.
In these three days, his total points earnings were 119.2 million points.
Three days ago, he had been considering that his points weren't enough, thinking about maybe going to Sky City to open a store and make some money. Now, three days later, the Feng Family had thoughtfully sent him the earnings.
How considerate!
By this time, the depth of the sea of mummies had reached several tens of meters. With such depth,
even the swimming champions would suffocate to death upon entering, or anyone with high defense would still die of oxygen deprivation if thrown to the bottom of the sea.
A sea of mummies several tens of meters deep was something to marvel at in the entire upgrade game.
"Is this map really this tall?"
Chen Yi looked up at the sky somewhat helplessly, a protective cover overhead. He estimated roughly that the distance from the ground was about 3,000 meters or more. Originally, he had planned to spend some time using the mummies to fill the map to the brim to see what the effect would be.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 348: Where to Find a 40 Million Deal in One Day?_4
chapters.content:
But now it seems unachievable.
If he wanted to fill this map to the brim, he would probably have to stay here for half a year, and by the time he got out, the Novice Period on Blue Star would be over.
"Forget it, I'll stay for another ten days or half a month."
Yes.
Chen Yi had no intention of leaving at all.
Where could he find a job that nearly fetched him forty million Points a day? Why go out? To continue sleeping every day?
It was a pity that the Feng Family acted too late. If they had taken action a few months earlier, and let him accumulate a few hundred billion Points, he could have directly enhanced the Christmas sleigh to pseudo-light speed.
...
What Chen Yi didn't know was that at this moment, in the headquarters of the Annihilation Starfield Project Team at the Feng Family.
The Patriarch of the Feng Family was frantically smashing Props in his office with a fierce look on his face, hysterically roaring, "Why hasn't the map been closed yet? Are these people just eating their fill to no purpose?"
"Close the map, close the map!!!"
"Do I really need to say it again???!!!"
This map was specifically sourced for Chen Yi. In order to achieve the best effect, he added a bit of design, which was the latter part targeting Monument players to increase difficulty, an addition made by him.
However, the rule of the map was that whenever difficulty increased, the rewards had to increase as well.
The original reward for the map was 1 Point for killing a mummy, which was granted by the game itself, but due to an increase in rewards, killing a mummy could yield 2 Points, and this extra 1 Point was provided by the Feng Family.
When he first saw Chen Yi killing mummies, he was sneering. Young people sure can only see benefits right before their eyes.
But he soon couldn't laugh anymore.
What the hell was Chen Yi doing? How could someone play like this!!!
The employees of their project team naturally had no Points. Points were a special Prop for players, deducted by the game based on the conversion ratio between Points and credits, where 100,000 Points were equal to 1 credit.
Meaning, for every 10 million Points Chen Yi earned, the Feng Family had to cough up 100 credits.
And now, Chen Yi had already earned over 100 million Points. Just in credits, the Feng Family had to provide over 1000 credits.
The project team's credits were extremely precious!
They determined various factors such as their resources, permissions, promotions, and even restoration of player status!
And it was extremely difficult for the employees of the project team to earn credits too. The last time Chen Yi won the Monument in the game, a major event, the Annihilation Starfield Project Team rewarded each employee only 50 credits.
They were very happy at the time, after all, it was a gift from the enemy.
But they had never thought that they would have to return those credits entirely, and it seemed that if they didn't stop now, the credits the Feng Family had accumulated over the years would also need to be given back.
And at this time—
Feng Yuan, standing behind the Patriarch of the Feng Family, lowered his head full of terror and whispered softly, "The people below said... once the map is activated, it's entirely managed by the game, we have no authority whatsoever to intervene in closing it!"
"GET OUT!!!"
With his temper flaring, the Patriarch of the Feng Family picked up a vase from nearby and smashed it hard on Feng Yuan's head. He was shaking with anger and pointed at Feng Yuan with a tremulous voice and fierce countenance, word by word he said.
"I don't care by what means or methods you use, just quickly terminate this map for me!!!"
"Otherwise, all of the credits that the Feng Family has accumulated over the years will be lost. Do you know what that means?"
"It means the Feng Family is done for, done, utterly finished!!!"
He actually already knew that the Feng Family was truly finished, because he was fully aware that once the map was activated, there was absolutely no way to close it. The people below would have no means either, but he couldn't just sit and wait for doom.
He had to do something.
"No, this won't do!!"
The frantic Patriarch of the Feng Family suddenly had a bright idea, grabbed Feng Yuan's shoulder tightly, and hysterically whispered in a low growl, "Use all our connections, expend all our resources, launch an attack on Blue Star!"
"As long as Blue Star is destroyed, Chen Yi will also die, and the map will naturally be closed!"
"We can't just watch as the credits accumulated by the Feng Family over the years are lost. Our status in the Annihilation Starfield Project Team is all due to our large number of credits."
"Without credits, our Feng Family will become everyone's target!"

chapters.title: Chapter 498 349: "You really have a long reaction time, huh.
chapters.content:
"Yes."
Feng Yuan replied reluctantly, not daring to say much more. In fact, he desperately wanted to point out that many players had now realized what was going on; to try and repeat the past by waving his hand and leading the Five Clans to invade Blue Star again was basically impossible.
It was clear to anyone with eyes that the Feng Family had been at a disadvantage in their conflict with Chen Yi, and now their cause was lost. At this point, no race dared gamble their race's fate by standing behind the Feng Family anymore.
More fitting—
The Five Clans who had last time gone after Blue Star were now enjoying an all-you-can-eat buffet in the depths of hell. In addition, the utter annihilation of the five billion players last time had left a profoundly deep impression on quite a few players.
Players from the Annihilation Starfield undoubtedly held a more profound impression of Chen Yi compared to players from other starfields, and their recognition was clearer.
After all, Chen Yi first made a name for himself in the Annihilation Starfield. Most importantly, many players from the Annihilation Starfield had died at his hand at least once, so it was no wonder they had such a lasting memory of him.
Under these circumstances, even if they had favors to call from the Feng Family, no one dared to approach Star System 3 to find Blue Star.
Feng Yuan was well aware that an attack on Blue Star was now essentially out of the question, but he also knew that now was not the time to voice any objections. The first priority was to quickly leave this place and then slowly figure out a plan.
...
"Yi had a field day with the killing, huh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned languidly on a lounge chair, glancing at the clock on the wall, idly tossing the expensive Ear-picking Spoon in hand and looked towards Yi in the live stream, who was engulfed in flames and dragons.
"He's just left us here to start getting bored."
"No idea how much longer he's gonna want to stay on that map before coming out."
"Can't be for months on end, right?"
Sword Without End, while looking at an encyclopedia in hand, spoke casually without even lifting his eyelids, "Why not? I've roughly calculated that Yi's daily income is around 30 to 40 million Points. For killing a mummy, the reward is only 2 Points, and Yi hasn't stopped at all."
"Thirty to forty million Points a day, tsk tsk, that's something only Yi can do. Probably won't stay too long since he must miss his lady and will come out soon."
"If it were up to someone like me, with no attachments, I could grind in the map for ten years."
"After ten years with several trillion Points, re-enter the main game!"
"Just buy out all the Props in the Star Map, single-handedly drive the market prices up. The cultivation novel protagonists I read about always retreat for centuries at a time, so what's ten years?"
"Apart from being a bit lonely, there are no downsides."
"True."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, licking his lips with some lingering regret, "Pity killing monsters doesn't increase Yi's Life Value; otherwise, this would've been quite the thrill for him. No need for guns when enemies deliver themselves."
"Too bad the Feng Family didn't act sooner. We would have had far more Points to splurge on the Star Map."
"By the way, Sword Without End, what did you buy from the Star Map?"
"Tsk."
At this question, Sword Without End put down the encyclopedia, lifting his eyebrows slightly in a show-off manner, "A functional Prop."
"Functional?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit asked in confusion, "Why not buy an offensive Prop? Aren't you a bit lacking in offensive strength? Functional ones aren't as cost-effective. After all, this might be our only chance to shop in the Star Map."
"There's no point in getting offensive Props. With Yi around, even if my attack power greatly increased, I couldn't surpass him. It's better to get a functional Prop that can make a decisive impact at crucial moments. Plus, it's also useful in the Hell Map's return journey," Sword Without End said with a bit of pride.
"Remember the B-grade unique Prop 'Let me take a step back and see what's going on' that I got in the Death Domain? It allows me to become absolutely invisible when retreating, impervious to any detection methods or Skills."
"It's very useful. This Prop has played a big role in my many successful returns from the Hell Map."
"There's also the 'Sudden Death' C-grade Prop from the Death Domain. When activated, a corpse exactly like your own suddenly appears at your feet. The player can decide the death's details, and the corpse lasts for 10 minutes."
"Combining these two Props, I can instantly activate both. As the corpse appears, I disappear into invisibility, making the enemy think their attack worked, lowering their guard and coming closer to investigate. That's when I can lurk invisibly and deal a Fatal Strike to the enemy."
"But there's a fatal issue, since walking backward is a bit slow and you can't clearly see the road behind."
"So—"
Sword Without End shared a Prop panel in mid-air.
'Prop Name': Autonomous Organs.
'Prop Level': A-grade.
'Prop Effect': You can freely control any of your body organs, allowing them to change position as you wish, but their strength and size cannot be altered. For example, you could position one of your eyes on the back of your head to achieve a 360-degree field of vision. No matter how you rearrange your organs, you will not die or receive injuries from it. Theoretically, you could even tuck your head into your abdominal cavity.
'Prop Restrictions': No cooldowns, no Points costs.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 349: "You have quite a long reaction time, huh." _2
chapters.content:
"Prop Introduction": "We yearn for freedom, even in our appearance, we demand absolute independence."
"Got it."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked thoughtfully at the prop panel in front of him and nodded, "You want to use this prop in combat to move one of your eyes to the back of your head, so that when you retreat and become invisible, you can quickly see the road ahead without affecting your speed and improving accuracy?"
"Yeah, this prop is really quite suitable for you."
"And you can also stuff your head into your abdomen, turning nipples into eyes, the navel as a mouth, wielding a battle-axe to dance—it's almost like transforming into Xing Tian."
"No, no, no."
Sword Without End grinned and shook his head, "At first, when I bought the prop, I thought the same as you, but after I bought it, I realized there are better ways to use it, like this—"
He snapped his fingers lightly.
Then, his feet began to rotate 180 degrees in an inconceivable manner, and by the time they stopped, the soles were already behind him, looking as if the bones in his legs had fractured.
"Look."
Sword Without End immediately took a step forward, and his body vanished on the spot, plunging into invisibility. When he took a step back, he reappeared exactly where he was.
"See what I mean? All I need to do is reverse the orientation of my feet, and I can become invisible even while moving forward. The mechanism for becoming invisible when retreating is determined by the direction the feet are facing and the direction of movement."
"It's essentially like, during combat with an enemy, maintaining a state of Absolute Invisibility at all times."
"How do you fight me then?"
"As long as I don't run into Yi's outrageous AOE attack, excessive health bar, and some exaggerated health regeneration, who can beat me?"
"Not bad."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked somewhat shocked at Sword Without End's feet, which had rotated 180 degrees, "This set of props seems quite fluid, you're pretty clever."
"I guess."
Satisfied with himself, Sword Without End flipped his bangs, then turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit, "What about you, what did you buy?"
"Uh…"
Tuberculosis Rabbit, slightly embarrassed, steeled himself and said, "What I bought is a prop for the later stages; I can't use it right now."
"Let's see it."
"Prop Name": Manchu Han Imperial Feast.
"Prop Level": A-grade.
"Prop Effect": Every day, you receive one random prop from the 289 Air Food Series Props, prioritizing those not already owned."
"Prop Limitation": None.
"Prop Introduction": "When entertaining guests, one should be bountiful."
"..."
Sword Without End looked at the prop panel in front of him, his expression showing slight astonishment. It took a while before he began to mutter, "Rabbit, how much did you spend on this?"
"1.6 million points, I guess. It had been listed on the Star Map for almost half a year with no buyers; I was lucky to snap it up."
"Do you know why it hung there for half a year without a buyer?"
"Why?"
"Because for 1.6 million points, you could buy the complete set of 289 Air Food Series Props several times over. Who the hell would buy this!!!"
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit also felt he might have been a little wasteful. He touched his nose and said with some embarrassment, "It's different, isn't it? We can only buy one prop on Star Map, Blue Star doesn't produce all of the Air Food Series Props."
"I was thinking of quickly collecting the full set of Air Food Series Props during the Novice Period."
"You know, any full set has Special Effects once collected. I think the Air Food Series Props won't be an exception."
"Impossible."
Sword Without End firmly shook his head, "I checked on Star Map, it's easy to collect a full set of Air Food Series Props in the outside world; you can buy them on the Star Map, and they're cheap. If there really were any Special Effects after collection, a lot of players would have already bought them."
"It's different."
Quite seriously, Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head, "I specifically looked it up for a while, and as far as I know, no player has managed to collect the boxing glove Air Food during the Novice Period."
"I think it might be a new commemorative milestone."
"Just wait and see, I will be the third player in the Annihilation Starfield to achieve a commemorative milestone, and when I join the '33 Club,' don't be jealous."
"Impossible. If that thing could get a commemorative milestone, I, Sword Without End, will run naked from the Arctic to the Antarctic!"
Sword Without End made a scornful oath!
...
"Hehe."
After Sword Without End left, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at his retreating figure with a contented grin. Sword Without End was obviously still lacking in Cultivation—he was internally developing an extremely crazy plan!
He named it!
"Heaven!"
Last time, Li Yi sent him an Air Food Series Prop that had been Enhanced to an Ultimate Edition—the Ultimate Air Fried Chicken!
The effect was to possess an everlasting roast chicken. Just one glance would fill you with a very real and powerful sensation of fullness. It had to be 1,000 meters long and 300 meters wide, indestructible by any means, of course, as long as it doesn't crush anyone, it would be fine.
His idea was simple; he wanted to upgrade all 289 Air Food Series Props to the Ultimate Edition, then he would have 289 massive Ultimate Air Food Props.
Most importantly, he had secretly checked—the satiety effects of two Ultimate Food Props could be stacked.
Which means when he deployed his 289 Ultimate Air Foods, even Yi, with just one glance, would burst from overeating right on the spot!

chapters.title: Chapter 500 349: "You sure have a long reaction time." _3
chapters.content:
The next time there's a large army invasion, or when it's time to exterminate a clan, Yi wouldn't even need to lift a finger. His 289 ultimate Air Food Series Props would be enough to burst them all!
Just think, the whole clan being forcefully expanded to death by players—that scene just feels thrilling to imagine.
When the time comes—
Whether it's the 289 ultimate Air Food Series Props or using this unprecedented method to wipe out a clan, one of them is bound to bring about a Monument achievement to the game's upgrade. Chen Yi had already figured out the path to earning Monument achievements in the game: scarcity.
"Hehe."
Thinking of that future scenario, the Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but excitedly grin and chuckle in secret.
As for how many resources this Heaven project might consume, the Tuberculosis Rabbit hadn't thought about that yet, nor did he consider if using the funds for the Heaven project to buy some more powerful Attack Props might have a stronger effect?
...
Before he knew it.
The date had reached October 15th.
Half a month flew by in the blink of an eye.
It had been 10 days since Chen Yi entered the map, and in those 10 days, he worked diligently around the clock, with the fire-burning Blue Star dragon tirelessly working 24 hours a day.
Each second of advancement brought in hundreds of Points in revenue. While it might not seem like much, the accumulation over time was significant.
His Points earning from this map had already reached a staggering 412.3 million.
Reaching an unprecedented state of wealth, his Points Balance had hit an all-time high.
"Maybe it's time to head out?"
Sitting in the snowsled, Chen Yi looked around at the densely packed mummies surrounding him from all sides and hesitated.
One reason was that he had entered the map hastily and hadn't left too much information for Jiaye; staying in one map for over ten days seemed excessively long, and he started to worry that Jiaye might be concerned.
The other reason was that his snowsled was struggling to hold up.
The snowsled's carriage was protected by more than a thousand protective barriers, but still, it couldn't withstand the dense mummies biting down like ants. Already, 129 protective barriers had been completely declared scrapped.
Most critical was his Helium Jet Tube.
The snowsled might have the protection of barriers, but the Helium Jet Tubes had no such protection and were completely exposed to the mummies. Nearly 300 Helium Jet Tubes had been destroyed, dramatically reducing the snowsled's maximum speed from 87 mach.
One Helium Jet Tube was valued at 20,000 Points, and over 300 tubes amounted to just 6 million Points.
From a value standpoint, the deal was certainly profitable—after all, the earnings were a whopping four hundred million Points—but once the Helium Jet Tubes were destroyed, there would be no chance to add more.
It wasn't always possible to encounter a National Day event where vehicles could be unlimitedly enhanced.
After pondering for a moment, Chen Yi still decided to steer the snowsled out of the sea of mummies, shooting straight up into the sky. In that instant, he retracted the snowsled into his backpack as he broke the surface, unwilling to let his meticulously enhanced vehicle be destroyed just like that.
He then turned and leapt, diving alone into the mummy-filled sea before him.
By now, Chen Yi had lost count of the mummies; there must have been ten billion or more, and the entrance to the tomb had been completely blocked by mummies.
Although his harvesting speed had decreased without the snowsled, it wasn't low.
Any attack that landed on him would rebound, and the mummies killed by the reflection would continue to split into two and attack again.
Chen Yi didn't fall to the bottom of the sea but rather stepped on the heads of the mummies, roaming around with his staff as if he were strolling leisurely in front of his own house.
"It's time to head back."
As Chen Yi walked on the heads of the mummies, he pondered with a lowered glance. Without the snowsled, he could only kill a maximum of seven or eight monsters per second, greatly reducing the speed at which he earned Points.
No choice.
Although there were many mummies, only so many could attack him.
Just then—
"Sizzle!"
An ear-piercing sound of slicing air suddenly came from nearby. Chen Yi instinctively looked over and saw a mummy few meters away howling as it hurled a rusty iron knife towards him.
Before he could react,
The iron knife skimmed past the air three meters away from him and plunged into another mummy's skull, instantly killing it and causing the mummy to split into two more attackers.
Although the throw wasn't effective,
The action seemed like a wake-up call for the other mummies. In no time, hundreds of mummies raised their rusty iron knives and launched them at Chen Yi.
The knives filled the air like a torrent of arrows.
"Right!"
Seeing this, Chen Yi's eyes lit up as he was instantly overjoyed. If all these mummies learned to attack with thrown knives, his harvesting speed would greatly increase.
The next second—
The arrow rain of hundreds of iron knives enveloped Chen Yi completely.
Unfortunately...
Perhaps it was because the mummies lacked intelligence, but the accuracy was too low. Out of the hundreds of knives, only a few dozen hit Chen Yi; the rest missed, not completely, though—they planted themselves into other mummies' heads.
'Ding, you've been attacked, health -67!'
'Ding, you've been attacked, health -67!'
'Ding, you've killed 11 mummies, Points +22.'

chapters.title: Chapter 501 349: "You have quite a long reaction time, huh." _4
chapters.content:
"Hey!"
Chen Yi's smile slowly lifted at the corners of his mouth as he found a new way to farm monsters. If used properly, it might even surpass the speed of using the sled. Without allowing himself too much time to think, more mummies had learned this method of attack, hurling their rusty iron knives through the air towards Chen Yi!
This time, he didn't stay still and wait for death to come.
From the previous two incidents, he clearly knew how incredibly poor the mummies' throwing accuracy was.
If he wanted to improve his monster farming efficiency, he had to make the first move!
Right after that, Chen Yi took a deep breath, his right foot stomping hard on a mummy's skull to catapult himself into the air. He dodged left and right midair with impressive agility, looking extremely dashing. When he landed, his body was already full of knives.
He looked like a living hedgehog.
That wave alone brought him a substantial number of Points!
"Perfect!"
Chen Yi leisurely descended from the air, looking at the system prompts and nodded with satisfaction, "My agility isn't bad at all; I caught most of the attacks."
Yes, he was not dodging.
It was just that the mummies' accuracy was so terrible that it was hard for them to hit him unless he deliberately caught the attacks. With the passive Skill "Calm and Composed" enhancing his physical abilities, he could still easily make these simple movements.
But—
Just one hour later.
Chen Yi stopped his meaningless action of catching the knives. It was pointless now; there was absolutely no need for him to use his body to catch those rusty iron knives thrown at him anymore.
It had to be said, the mummies sure learned quickly.
As soon as the first clever mummy threw a rusty iron knife at him, it was like opening Pandora's Box. More and more mummies learned this trick, until now!
Every second, hundreds of thousands of mummies threw rusty iron knives at him, completely eliminating the need to catch them. All he had to do was calmly wait for the knives to fall like hail from the sky.
...
"What can I say."
Closing his eyes, Chen Yi placed his hands behind his head and lay on the mummies' sea surface, feeling somewhat relaxed as he mused, "Points really do flow to those who don't need them. I've already earned enough, and yet they insist I earn more."
"It's really something."
At that moment, tens of thousands of iron knives fell straight from the sky.
Only a few dozen hit the mark.
Most missed, but it didn't matter, because as soon as that batch of knives hit the ground, a new wave followed right after.
The rest of the rusty knives that missed struck other mummies on the head, causing them to split into even more mummies.
Chen Yi, who was originally planning to return, definitely decided to stay for a while longer.
He could now obliterate nearly 150 mummies a second, which meant earning around 300 Points a second – nearly the same as driving the sled, but with no wear and tear.
Just when Chen Yi thought he could continue farming like this forever,
a prompt suddenly popped up in front of him.
'Ding, the final boss, the Pharaoh, has sensed the presence of an intruder, becoming furious and is charging at the player. Please prepare in advance.'
Immediately after—
He heard a roar filled with rage resonate loudly across the map!
"Sensed the presence of an intruder?"
Chen Yi, who was reclining on the mummy sea surface, looked at the prompt on his screen and muttered in bewilderment, "It's been 10 days; the whole map's been filled with mummies. Only now you noticed?"
"That's one long delay in your reaction."
Then he glanced over the flat mummy sea surface, completely obstructed from the view of the small hill and tomb passageway he saw when he first entered the map – they were all buried beneath countless mummies.
He now seriously doubted.
Whether the final boss, the Pharaoh, would be able to crawl out from the tomb passageway; it was packed full of mummies, utterly clogged.
Even if he shattered the mummies blocking the passage, the additional mummies that split would only clog the passage tighter.
As for him, he wasn't worried at all about not being able to get through the tightly sealed passageway. Even if the mountain collapsed, he could find his way to the Pharaoh Boss – he had over a dozen ways to enter.
But the next second—
"Roar!!!"
A furious roar as if right by his ear, followed by the sight of a boss, six to seven meters tall with a body ablaze, holding a huge scepter and wearing strange regalia, burst forth from the sea of corpses.
The boss's eyes, burning with flames, stared directly at Chen Yi as he swung his scepter down furiously.
A swath of fiery blade light smashed directly onto Chen Yi.
'Ding, you have been hit by a fiery strike from the final boss, the Pharaoh, and suffer a loss of 1.28 million Life Value!'
"1.28 million?"
Chen Yi blinked in astonishment. That high? So if he didn't have the 'Longevity as the Southern Mountains' Prop, one hit could have killed him ten thousand times? That's just outrageous. Could this boss's attack really be that high? Such a high attack could instantly kill most players, right?
But he soon discovered something even more serious.
Above the boss's head, a crimson number also flashed.
'-1280000'
It reduced the boss's life by 12.8%.
Chen Yi, with an expressionless face, watched as the boss unleashed another streak of flame blade light and didn't hesitate for a second—he turned and shot away into the distance.
This damn boss was high in attack but low in life!
1.28 million life points were nothing to him; he could fully recover in the blink of an eye, but for this boss, that represented a tenth of its health!
He wasn't sure about the Pharaoh Boss's rate of recovery.
But one thing he was clear about – if he endured a few more attacks from this boss, said boss would be killed outright by him. He didn't want the boss to die that soon; he wanted to farm Points here a bit longer.
You can't rely on finding another village after missing this one.
It wouldn't be realistic to expect the Feng Family to create another custom map like this for him, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 502 350: "Map Evaluation": Consider yourself formidable.
chapters.content:
"You chase, I run."
"I run, you chase."
"Day after day, never giving up."
"..."
Expressionless, Tuberculosis Rabbit lit a cigarette and took a long drag before finally looking up at the sky at a 45-degree angle with a complex expression. He murmured in a daze, "Yi really has great stamina, running for so long without getting tired."
In the video feed.
Chen Yi was running across a sea of mummies, dodging rusty iron knives falling from above like hail, all the while being chased by the roaring Pharaoh Boss wielding a scepter.
Each of the Pharaoh Boss's furious attacks was cleverly avoided by Chen Yi.
And the attacks from the lesser monsters were taken on by Chen Yi as much as possible.
It had changed, completely changed.
Originally, the difficulty of this map was supposed to be how to break through the traps in the corridor without killing the lesser monsters, making it to the boss to start a face-to-face battle, and being careful to ensure that all your attacks landed on the boss without affecting anything behind you.
Otherwise, the mummies behind, which would split upon death, would swiftly overwhelm the player with exponentially increasing numbers.
But with Chen Yi, the difficulty was completely different.
To Chen Yi, the difficulty of the map was how to kill more mummies without killing the boss. It was obvious that Chen Yi really didn't want to attack the boss, but he couldn't help it because the boss's attacks were too strong.
The damage returned from a single counterattack would take off ten percent of his health. Just a few counters, and the boss would be dead on the spot.
The difficulty had completely changed.
Avoiding the boss's attacks while trying to take on as many attacks from the lesser monsters as possible.
"He's been running for three hours straight without a break, Yi's got some serious endurance," Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but remark once again as he watched the live stream.
And Jiaye, who was sitting barefoot on Tie Chui's shoulder, suddenly blushed. Pretending she heard nothing, she turned her head to look at the sky. She knew all too well about Yi's stamina.
"That's not right, is it?"
Sword Without End frowned in confusion. "I just remembered something. Yi's profession changes every seven days, right? Yi has been in the map for more than ten days now. By rights, that heavy-armor warrior profession which allows him to regenerate health indefinitely should've expired, shouldn't it?"
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been admiring Yi's physical fitness, suddenly paused and realized in puzzlement, "Yeah, you're right, I forgot about that. Yi's profession should have been switched automatically by now."
"But..."
He looked back at Yi in the live stream. Yi was carrying all the damage and dashing through a sea of mummies, not appearing like someone who couldn't regenerate health. Could it be a bug?
"Right."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was deep in thought, suddenly turned to look at Sword Without End. "Is it really necessary for you to annoy me like this? Are you that bored?"
"Why don't you go home and build a grave for your dad, see if he still recognizes you or not?"
Just then, Sword Without End stood on his hands with his feet sticking out of his head like two massive antennas, while his eyes were located in the middle of his big toes, resembling eyes on the ends of the antennas.
His head was where his navel should be, and his mouth was just above the navel, currently smoking a cigarette.
He was beyond being called a monster.
Even the ugliest Void Monsters, upon seeing Sword Without End at that moment, would have to sincerely admit, "You're wasting your talents not being a villain. Why don't you take on the role?"
"Why do you have to speak so unpleasantly?"
Sword Without End replied, with some disdain, puffing out a plume of smoke, "That's jealousy. Even if you wanted to do this, could you manage it?"
The Prop 'Free Organs' not only allowed him to remain Absolute Invisibility during battles but also had many other effects. Since the Prop had no cooldown, it meant he could reorganize his organs anytime and anywhere, making it impossible for anyone to hit his vital points.
Unless he was engulfed in an AOE attack.
Besides that, it gave him many new experiences in life.
For example, he had never experienced existing in this world in such a way before. To be honest, it was quite a novel feeling.
...
Meanwhile—
In the live streaming room of the Annihilation Starfield.
Countless players looking at Chen Yi in the stream all fell into silence.
Players who could stand here, frankly speaking, had all faced countless crises in other Star Systems before successfully advancing to the Threefold Planet, but they had never seen such a scene before.
Was this what it meant to clear the map?
Or was this more like playing a game of eagle catching chicks?
Even an idiot could tell that Chen Yi possessed a Prop that allowed him to reflect damage and that he could easily clear the map. Yet he didn't want to leave. The viewers couldn't see the exact data, but they knew that Chen Yi must have earned an unknown amount of Points on this map.
...
"How much now?"
The Patriarch of the Feng Family sat calmly in a cluttered office, looking at Chen Yi on the screen and asked softly.
"1820..."
Feng Yuan stood behind the Patriarch, his body trembling as he whispered, his voice as faint as a fly.
"Only 1820 points left?"
"Not that, our accumulated points over the years have all been deducted. Now we owe the upgrade game 1820 Points, and we must pay it off within 30 days... otherwise... otherwise..."

chapters.title: Chapter 503 350: "Map Evaluation": You're impressive. _2
chapters.content:
Feng Yuan didn't dare to speak the rest.
"Sigh."
The Patriarch of the Feng Family slowly closed his eyes, and after an unknown period of time, he suddenly let out a bitter laugh, "So be it, let it be."
1820 points were an astronomical figure; it was nearly impossible for all members of the Feng Family to earn 1820 points within 30 days. The consequence of failing to repay was naturally having all family members sent to the depths of hell to work as cleaners.
Every point Chen Yi earned on the map represented half of the efforts Feng Yuan's family had accumulated over many years.
Perhaps this was what they meant by shooting oneself in the foot.
He didn't think his choices were wrong; he just hated, hated that the Feng Family hadn't gone all out when they had rallied the Five Clans to eradicate the Blue Star Race from the 3-star systems. Had the Feng Family mobilized all their power then, they could have killed Chen Yi outright there!
They might have even wiped out the human race of Blue Star forever!
He had never imagined that the Feng Family's first Waterloo would turn out to be their closest brush with killing Chen Yi.
...
"ROAR!!!"
When countless attacks missed Chen Yi, the Pharaoh Boss seemingly grew angry. After letting out a roar, he raised the King's Scepter in his hand and looked skyward. Countless rays of light poured onto the boss's King's Scepter.
After maintaining this pose for about a minute.
The Pharaoh roared and pointed the King's Scepter in his hand straight at the fleeing form of Chen Yi's back, and a red beam of light, tens of meters wide, blasted straight towards him.
Having seen the Pharaoh Boss charging up his ultimate move, Chen Yi naturally didn't ignore the commotion behind him.
Without any hesitation, he activated a skill "Mirror Man" he had acquired a long time ago. In an instant, he disappeared from his original position, only to reappear suddenly from above the Sea of Mummies, a kilometer away.
Instantly crossing a kilometer's distance.
Just when he thought he had easily avoided the strike, as soon as he steadied himself in mid-air, he saw the red beam of light, which had somehow turned around in midair and appeared right in front of him.
The next second—
"-112030230!!!"
An extremely horrifying crimson number popped above Chen Yi's head.
Immediately following, this terrifying number was returned exactly to the boss behind the Pharaoh Boss, depleting the health bar above the boss's head in an instant. Afterwards, all the mummies on the entire map suddenly stiffened, then began to disintegrate in unison, turning into light.
The area around the map also began to dim gradually.
Under this single blow, the final boss of the A-level map "Pharaoh's Tomb," the Pharaoh King, instantly emptied his own life bar. A flash of relief crossed his eyes, and his body heavily leaned backward.
In the instant he fell, Chen Yi even caught a glimpse of the Pharaoh King's upturned lips.
Chen Yi, who was somewhat stunned by the strike, stood still and slowly opened his mouth, swallowing subconsciously before touching his cool scalp and the prickling sensation on his body. His lips trembled slightly beyond his control.
"Damn it, over a hundred million damage from one strike?"
"Are you trying to slay a god?!!"
It wasn't that he was a coward; he was genuinely scared. His life value was already ridiculously high, sitting at a total of 132.7 million, essentially rendering him an immortal existence. And the method for calculating life values for players and bosses differed.
A player and boss with the same life value, the player can sustain countless times more damage than the boss!
Indeed, he was aware that this boss was one with high attack and low defense, but even then, it scared him. This was over a hundred million damage, after all. When had he ever seen such level of damage?
This was just too outrageous!
He was a player with 132.7 million life value, after all!
You are just the final boss of an A-level map; is it really reasonable to have such outrageous damage?
He had seen the Pharaoh Boss charging up his ultimate move, but thought nothing much of it, believing that he could use the opportunity to farm more points. After all, the boss's previous ultimate move had only taken a bit over a million of his life value.
In light of his over one hundred million life value, it was quite insignificant.
Who could have expected that the Pharaoh Boss's ultimate move, charged for a minute, would directly deal 110 million damage to him?
If it weren't for his Giant Heavy Armor profession, which could continuously regenerate health, he would probably already be working as a cleaner in hell. Dying on this map meant not even getting the chance to go to hell, but being sent straight to work as a cleaner.
And that would mean losing the Seed Player slot as well.
The opportunity for a Seed Player to crawl back from the depths of hell would no longer be useable.
That would be true death.
Chen Yi, who had just had a brush with death, felt the sweat on his back, took a deep breath, and shakily lit a cigarette before putting it to his lips, starting to wonder if he had been too complacent.
It seemed that no matter how strong one became, caution was still necessary.
Otherwise, you never knew when you could capsize.
It was terrifying.
He had almost been sent to feast at the buffet deep in hell.
By now, his life value had completely recovered, with the occupational effect of the Giant Heavy Armor enabling his health to regenerate at 10% per second. The recovery was exceedingly fast, and the prickling pain on his body also began to fade slowly.
Chen Yi just glanced at the occupational effect of the Giant Heavy Armor, then immediately pretended as if nothing had happened, retracting his gaze and quickly purging all thoughts about the Giant Heavy Armor from his mind.
He swept his gaze nonchalantly over the blood rain around him.
That single strike had caused the map to flood.

chapters.title: Chapter 504 350: "Map Evaluation": Consider yourself formidable._3
chapters.content:
He had a high health pool, but that didn't mean he couldn't get hurt or bleed. The amount of health he lost was directly reflected in the blood he shed, and that one blow with more than a hundred million damage seemed to have punctured his entire reservoir of blood.
Torrential blood rain fell from the sky to the ground.
It was as if a major artery of a planet had been hit.
About three to five seconds later.
The entire map slowly dissipated, accompanied by a flash of white light before his eyes, Chen Yi returned to the Blue Star platform. As he returned, countless system notification sounds started to buzz in his ear incessantly, like bamboo shoots after a spring rain.
Among those notification sounds, there was one that immediately made Chen Yi feel rather dejected.
"Ding, Player Chen Yi's Faceless One job 'Giant Heavy Armor' has expired. The job rotation for the following week will now commence, your new job for the week is 'Magic Thief Group Envoy'."
"Damn it."
Chen Yi let out a long sigh, somewhat irritatedly lit up a cigarette and placed it in his mouth, not even bothering to check the effects of the new job as a Magic Thief Group Envoy.
On the seventh day in the map, he had planned to leave once the 'Giant Heavy Armor' job expired. After all, without the ability to regenerate health indefinitely, he wouldn't be able to hold out in the Sea of Mummies and would have eventually been worn down to death.
But he quickly discovered, to his surprise, that the 'Giant Heavy Armor' job was still there; no new job had been rotated in.
He understood immediately that this was most likely a bug.
He acted as if nothing happened, not checking the Giant Heavy Armor panel nor thinking about it inwardly, pretending he was unaware of the issue just like an ostrich burying its head in the sand.
Compared to the weekly random jobs of a 'Faceless One', he felt the 'Giant Heavy Armor' was more suitable for him!
132.7 million health was not his limit. Once his health limit reached tens of billions, he could unleash even greater power with the 'Giant Heavy Armor' job—it was perfect for him. If only he could keep this job forever.
But frustratingly, the moment the map ended, the 'Giant Heavy Armor' left him, and the new job arrived just like that.
It was as though it was mocking him: the new job might be late, but it never fails to show up.
It seems this wasn't a bug but a mechanism: when a player is in a map, the Faceless One job effects do not trigger, preventing the player from randomly obtaining a new job in the map. This actually offers more advantages than disadvantages for a player.
The advantage being that while on a long-duration map, players can maintain the job used when entering the map without experiencing a sudden shift in job that could greatly impact the battle.
There are also downsides.
Many maps come with uncertainties. It's possible that a job which couldn't clear the map initially might, after some time, be replaced by a newly randomized job that can clear it. In summary, this means there's less randomness, but more controllability.
As for this outcome.
Chen Yi, though helplessly resigned, could only accept it with a deep sigh. He had no idea when he might randomly obtain the 'Giant Heavy Armor' job again. These past days had almost changed his fighting style; he had grown accustomed to the stand-and-fight method of resisting the enemy's attacks.
Suddenly without this job, he felt at a loss as to how to fight.
He wasn't given much time to think.
Even more system notifications rang out by his ear.
"Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully clearing the A-level map 'Pharaoh's Tomb'. You have created the 'Sea of Mummies', a wonder that has never before appeared in the game; this wonder has now been selected as one of the one hundred and eight wonders of the game and will be randomly distributed in some maps or secret realms, etc."
"Congratulations to player Chen Yi for creating the Wonder 'Sea of Mummies'."
"As a reward, you receive: Wonder Atlas *1, title 'Wonder Creator' *1."
"Ding, it has been detected that within the map, the boss's certain base skill exploded with unprecedented power; as a reward, you are granted the boss's original skill 'Wrath of the Corpse King' *1."
"Wrath of the Corpse King?"
Chen Yi looked bewilderedly at this system notification. He had just been wondering how an A-Level map boss could deal such terrifying damage, almost killing him in one strike—and now they're telling him that hit was one of the Pharaoh boss's basic skills?
Not even his ultimate move?
What kind of joke is this!!
Then, what was that blade light in the beginning that could cause over a million points of damage? Was it just a regular attack? This is an A-level map, isn't it?
If a basic skill already dealt over a hundred million in damage, what would the ultimate move's damage be? Why not just throw this Pharaoh boss at the feet of the two deities of the White Phoenix Clan? He felt that Pharaoh could slaughter gods.
"Skill Name": Fury of the Sea of Corpses.
"Skill Level": B-ranked.
"Skill Effect": After a brief 0.01 second channeling, unleash a red laser to deal lethal damage to enemies. For every additional mummy around you, your channeling time and damage will increase.
There's no upper limit to this amplification. The more mummies surrounding, the higher both the channeling time and the damage will be.
Also, this skill comes with the Absolute Hit attribute, which cannot be dodged by any means until it hits the target.
"Skill Limitation": After use, it enters a 24-hour cooldown.
"Skill Introduction": "My children, lend me your strength!"
"..."
Chen Yi slowly opened his mouth in awe at the skill before him, feeling a chill go through his heart as he finally understood how the A-Level map's boss could unleash such an incredibly powerful attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 505 350: "Map Evaluation": You're impressive. _4
chapters.content:
Was this all his own doing?
If it weren't for him producing so many mummies, that red laser— no, in the Pharaoh's hands it was a gigantic crimson pillar—might not have even tickled if it hit him, right?
Thinking about it, the corners of his mouth couldn't help but twitch slightly, feeling as though he had taken a walk at death's door.
All he could say was he was lucky that the Pharaoh boss showed up early, and even luckier that the Pharaoh used that skill shortly after appearing.
If the Pharaoh had appeared two days later, by then the number of mummies would definitely have been greater, and one hit would have wiped out his health bar, rendering any speed of health recovery useless.
He only pondered for a moment before he learned the skill and placed it in his skill bar.
He had many props, but only a few skills. Although this skill had many limitations and could only unleash its full power when surrounded by a sufficient number of mummies, it was just a tickling skill under normal conditions.
But this skill could be the deciding blow at critical moments.
After so long since the game update, he was fully aware that the value of skills that could change the game in special scenarios was beyond imagination.
As long as he was surrounded by a large number of mummies, the power that this skill could unleash was absolutely comparable to an S-class skill.
Being able to instantly wipe out over 100 million health points of a player meant that even a boss with 10 billion health would melt instantly.
So far, he had not seen any boss with 10 billion health.
In most maps, this skill might not be useful, and this was the first time he had encountered mummies on a map, but the system just notified him that he had created one of the 108 wonders, "Sea of Mummies."
And this wonder would be randomly placed in some maps.
In those maps that had the "Sea of Mummies," he would have a "Fury of the Sea of Corpses" skill that could definitely decide the outcome with one blow!
If it were combined with the "Wife-Killing Buff,"
Then it wouldn't just be one decisive blow anymore; it would be a hundred hammers on the strings, a thousand hammers destroying the heavens, ten thousand hammers wiping out the earth!
He couldn't imagine anyone being able to stop him in those maps with the "Sea of Mummies" wonder in them, even if they were deities, he felt like he could slaughter a god.
Following that—
The new system prompt sounded again.
"Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully clearing the A-class map 'Pharaoh's Tomb.' Since the map difficulty is doubled, all map rewards obtained by player Chen Yi will be doubled."
"Map Evaluation": You're pretty good.
"Map Reward": 428.1 million points, Zenith Radiance*2.
"..."
Chen Yi touched his nose, at a loss for words for the moment. He had received many map evaluations, but this was the one with the fewest words he had ever seen—just four words?
Wasn't that too few?
Previous map evaluations were at least a few hundred words long.
But for some reason, even though it was just a brief four words, it felt pretty good.
Yeah, he was indeed pretty good.
Only then did Chen Yi look contentedly at his backpack. With these two Zenith Radiances, he now had 9 Zenith Radiances. He already had 8 Zenith Radiances before entering the map, but the moment he entered the map, he suddenly remembered something and used one Zenith Radiance on the A-class prop "Recoil Armor."
"Prop Name": Recoil Armor (Ultimate Edition).
"Prop Level": A-class
"Prop Effect": Wearing this prop, any damage the wearer sustains, regardless of spatial distance, can be reflected back at the enemy, with a reflective efficacy of up to 100%.
"Prop Limitation": This prop cannot reflect fatal attacks. If the player is killed by an attack in one hit, the Recoil Armor cannot reflect or store that attack.
"Prop Description": "When you hit me it's like I'm hitting you, that's the charm of the Recoil Armor!"
Upgrading to the Ultimate Edition, the effect brought was extremely simple, enhancing the reflective efficacy from the original 50% to 100%.
This was why he was able to fully reflect the boss's attack in the map and not just half of it.
He was very satisfied with this map's reward, a whopping over 400 million points, enough for a long use.
But every time he thought about it, he couldn't help but admire Li Yi once again. He had earned over 400 million points by fulfilling several difficult conditions, how did Li Yi manage to earn 10 billion points during the Novice Period?
Was that really something a person could achieve?
As for the two Zenith Radiances from the map reward, they were rather inconsequential by comparison. After all, he had stayed in the map for a whole ten days, and today was already the 15th of October.
The World Tree had produced 3 more Zenith Radiances.
With these three, he now had a total of 12 Zenith Radiances. He could give one Zenith Radiance to each of his friends like Tuberculosis Rabbit and enhance quite a few props to Ultimate Props.
Afterwards, he didn't check the effects of his new title or the occupational effect of the new profession, "Magic Thief Group Envoy," right away but turned his head to look at Jiaye and the others.
He started, feeling somewhat guilty.
"I came back late, and I've made you all worry... You guys..."
But just as he was prepared to share a moment of deep eye contact with Jiaye, his body suddenly froze in place, and his voice cut off abruptly. Then, with a dramatic change in expression, he turned towards the extremely disgusting creature standing next to Jiaye and roared.
"Jiaye, be careful!!"
"Wait, Yi!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit immediately realized what was happening and changed his face, raising his hands in sudden urgency to explain.
However, it was a little too late.
The next second—
A Buddha, seated cross-legged on a Lotus Platform, holding a Fire God Gatling, aimed at that extremely disgusting monster beside Jiaye, not hesitating for a moment as he pulled the trigger.
"Ratatat!!"
With the piercing sound of gunfire, bullets spewed forth like flames, hitting the creature without missing a single one.
"What's up? What were you saying just now?"
"It's nothing."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the sparse bits of flesh among the shell casings with a complex expression.
"How about we have dumplings tonight? The filling is all chopped up; it'd be a waste not to use it for dumplings."

chapters.title: Chapter 506 351: "Wonder Name": Tomb of the Gods.
chapters.content:
Three hours later.
"Dumplings with celery and meat filling are the best,"
After chewing and swallowing a dumpling, Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded contentedly, "You have to eat the first dumpling without dipping it in any sauce to truly taste its flavor."
"Here, Yi, try this dumpling and see how it tastes?"
"..."
Chen Yi didn't respond, but turned with a somewhat speechless expression to glance at Sword Without End, who had just returned from hell: "How did you end up looking like this?"
"Well... it's a long story."
Sword Without End scratched his head with an embarrassed smile, "Before you went to this map, Yi, didn't I buy a prop on the Star Map? I forgot to tell you, it's a prop called 'Free Organ,' which allows you to change your organs at will."
"Although it can't change the strength or hardness, it can reorganize the body's organs."
"Then I wanted to experiment with the different uses of this prop to see if I could develop some unique combat techniques, and then..."
Sword Without End didn't finish his sentence.
But the meaning was quite clear; then, he turned into that somewhat abstract monster.
Chen Yi couldn't really be blamed for not recognizing it; even if Tuberculosis Rabbit changed like that, he would hardly recognize it at first glance. It was simply too abstract, and Sword Without End, being completely defenseless, was taken by surprise and had no doubt rushed off to hell. Otherwise, with Sword Without End's abilities, he wouldn't have been killed so easily.
Fortunately, only Alien Race players killed by him would die permanently, otherwise Sword Without End would have been in trouble.
