And his Annihilate Nine Clans was an active skill. When it was not activated, it wouldn't exterminate three clans of players.
Of course, even if he activated this skill, it wouldn't matter.
After all, anyone with even a slight blood relation to Sword Without End was long dead.
Theoretically, in this world, there should be no pure orphans, for if you trace the relationships far enough, you would always find some remote relatives you've never met or interacted with. But Sword Without End was different; anyone even slightly related to him was dead, making him an orphan to the extreme.
Chen Yi sighed with resignation, picked up a small dish of vinegar and took a bite of a dumpling, "Let's eat first."
He vaguely remembered that Sword Without End used to have the image of a suave and literary Sword Immortal, who enjoyed reciting poetry and wore a green robe that gave off an ancient charm.
Like a Sword Immortal who had walked out of a landscape painting.
Now, how had he turned into a Lovecraftian figure?
Could it be that he was influenced by them?
But that should not be the case, as neither of them liked that sort of thing. The only person he knew who was into Lovecraftian stuff was Wang Qi from Qi Daddy Starfield; that guy liked to walk unconventional paths.
Always looking for various Lovecraftian Alien Races and using all sorts of out-of-the-ordinary shortcuts.
...
The meal ended quickly.
Chen Yi began to sit on his familiar beach chair on the rooftop, starting to tally all his gains from this time; over 400 million Points needless to mention, plus his existing Points, his total Points Balance was—
445.98 million Points.
Over four hundred fifty million, more than enough for him to use for quite a while, resolving his urgent needs.
It was just too bad that these Points came a bit late; it would have been nice to have them during the National Day event.
Next were the Zenith Radiance, totaling twelve.
He had given one to each of his friends like Tuberculosis Rabbit, leaving eight, which he planned to use to enhance his commonly used props into Ultimate Props later.
As well as the two rewards he got from creating one of the 108 Wonders, the Sea of Mummies.
One "Wonder Atlas", one title "Wonder Creator".
He first looked at the "Wonder Atlas," an E-grade prop with no special effects, just something akin to a stamp album that would constantly update with the 108 Wonders in the game.
The 108 Wonders in the game were not fixed.
Whenever a new Wonder was created that could rank within the top 108, it would shove the last Wonder off the list to take its place.
It was a system of promotion.
This ensured that all the Wonders listed in the Atlas would always be the most bizarre in the game.
Determined by the game itself, all Wonders were generally created unintentionally or intentionally by players. His Sea of Mummies ranked 78th in the atlas.
"Wonder Name": Sea of Mummies.
"Wonder Ranking": 78th.
"Wonder Effects": A sea of mummies will cover the entire map, with depths reaching up to the rare height of twelve meters, filled densely with mummies like an ocean. Even good swimmers would drown. Players who step on the surface of the mummy sea will sink slowly, as if stepping into quicksand."
"Wonder Origin": Created by Blue Star Race player Chen Yi from the 3rd Star System of Annihilation Starfield's Novice Planet on an A-grade map, Pharaoh's Tomb, after relentlessly killing indefinitely splitting mummies over ten days."
"Wonder Location": This Wonder doesn't have a fixed location and will appear randomly in maps of A-grade and above."
"Wonder Creator": Chen Yi.
"ps: The Wonder is named Sea of Mummies and is judged to be a sea. Thus, props or skills that are limited to use in the sea can also be used in the Sea of Mummies."

chapters.title: Chapter 507 351: "Wonder Name": Tomb of the Gods. _2
chapters.content:
"Rank 78, huh?"
Chen Yi curled his lips with some dissatisfaction. He had never ranked so low before. Although the Wonder he had created was unintentional, and having this rank was already quite good, he couldn't help but look at the Wonder that ranked number one.
He wanted to see just how much stronger the number one ranked Wonder could be compared to his Sea of Mummies.
And when his gaze fell upon the number one Wonder, Chen Yi's body instantly stiffened, his mouth unconsciously dropping open as he muttered in disbelief.
"This is just f*cking outrageous."
The Wonder that ranked first in the Wonder Atlas was enveloped by a border of rainbow light in both its image and description page, making it look more advanced than his Sea of Mummies, which was wrapped in a red border.
And that description, it was even more abstract!
'Wonder Name': Tomb of the Gods.
'Wonder Ranking': First place.
'Wonder Effects': Eleven deities were killed by player Jiang Chenglu on the Starfield, their flesh eternally undecaying. Even in death, they continuously affect their surroundings. All players within the domain of the deities will feel an overwhelming sense of pressure, and all props, skills, and titles within the deities' domain will be significantly reduced.
'Wonder Origin': Created unintentionally by Jiang Chenglu, a player of the Mo Clan from the Desert Star in the 17th Star System of the Deity Starfield, after uncovering the eleven deities buried underneath the Deity Starfield. Following a battle lasting seven days and nights, player Jiang Chenglu single-handedly slaughtered all eleven deities.
The corpses of the deities won't decay but remain immortal, and even in death, the deities refuse to fall due to their divine stature, thus creating this rare Wonder.
'Wonder Location': Deity Starfield, within the Mo Clan's territory.
'Wonder Creator': Jiang Chenglu.
"...."
After a long, expressionless silence, Chen Yi finally closed the Wonder Atlas and tossed it into the arms of Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting beside him.
Before looking at the first-place Wonder, he thought he shouldn't be ranked 78th.
After seeing the first-place Wonder, he felt even more strongly that he shouldn't be at the 78th rank.
What kind of monsters were ahead?
Why was he at rank 78? Just a tiny Sea of Mummies could have been placed at rank 108 and it would still have been a privilege; what right did he have to stay at rank 78?
Look at that Tomb of the Gods!
That's eleven deities, for crying out loud—what kind of joke is this? You're telling me a player killed them?
Do you treat slaying deities like slicing vegetables?
And they fought for seven days and nights, is that really an appropriate description?
Next to this description box, an accompanying picture shows the spectacle of the Wonder. In the boundless desert, eleven incredibly tall deities with countless scars and brandishing a variety of weapons stand in the center of the desert.
Like creations of the heavens.
Some deities have their giant swords plunged into the desert, looking up into the horizon; their eyeballs don't look dead at all. He could even see the unwillingness and blankness in the gaze of those giant eyeballs.
Perhaps even up to the moment of death, this deity refused to believe that it could really die in such a manner.
Another deity, naked and wrapped in whips, looks down at the massive, ferocious wound in its abdomen with puzzlement in its eyes.
As if it's wondering how it could have sustained such a serious injury.
Eleven lifelike and distinct deities each towering a thousand meters high, stand imposingly in the middle of a deserted desert.
And below these deities' feet lies a not-so-small lake, formed from their blood, as if even after the death of these deities, their blood continued to flow ceaselessly.
This place is named the Tomb of the Gods.
"It always turns out to be a player from the Ninefold Star."
Chen Yi shook his head, trying to rid his mind of the shock. There was no comparison. The sense of powerlessness he had felt in his heart upon seeing those two deities in the White Phoenix Clan was strong enough, and those two deities were still bound, yet they had already brought him such immense pressure.
One could only imagine the immense pressure that the player named Jiang Chenglu must have faced when confronting eleven live and unbound deities.
Luckily, he didn't have a chance to interact with players from the Ninefold Star; otherwise, he felt it would be too difficult for him to survive.
He couldn't even begin to imagine by what means Jiang Chenglu killed those eleven deities.
According to the White Phoenix Clan, deities were supposedly absolutely unkillable and could only be bound and imprisoned.
...
Chen Yi stopped contemplating this and looked instead at the second reward he received for creating the Wonder, the Sea of Mummies—a title called 'Wonder Creator'.
'Title Name': Wonder Creator.
'Title Level': Starry Level.
'Title Effect': Wearing this title, the player is immune to all negative Wonder Effects when approaching any Wonder.
'Title Restriction': None.
'Title Origin': Players can obtain this title when they create a Wonder that makes it into the Wonder Atlas.
Looking at the title before him, Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully. It seemed to be a title with significant use in certain environments.
For instance, if he ever had the chance to visit the Tomb of the Gods, he would be immune to the suffocating presence of the Wonder, and in the Sea of Mummies, any player with the title of Wonder Creator wouldn't sink.
Quite a decent title after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 351: "Wonder Name": Tomb of the Gods. _3
chapters.content:
```
However, when the Sea of Mummies mentioned earlier was determined to be an actual sea, it turned out to be good news for him. He possessed an SSS-grade prop, the "Boots of the Sea God", which, while only half-completed, were not very powerful.
Yet with this prop, he could walk, run, and breathe freely in the sea. This meant that there would be no more constraints on him whatsoever coming from the Sea of Mummies.
The Sea of Mummies would be his true home turf.
As long as he had the opportunity to enter a map holding the wonder of the Sea of Mummies, that map only ever had one king, and that would be him, Chen Yi.
It could be said that his home turf combat abilities were a full-on buff.
It was only after that he turned his attention to his new profession, the "Magic Thief Group Envoy".
-
"Occupation": Magic Thief Group Envoy.
"Occupational Effect": You may forcefully rent any random 10 props, 10 titles, or 10 skills from any player within your field of vision.
You can temporarily use them for 3 hours, after which they are automatically returned, and the stolen props don't consume any usage counts, enabling you to use this capability continuously three times without cooldown.
"Occupational Restriction": Using the occupational effect once puts you into a 24-hour cooldown period, and you must pay a certain deposit for renting the props; only if the deposit is sufficient will the rental be successful.
If the deposit is not enough, the rental is deemed a failure and enters the cooldown period.
If the rented player dies, making it impossible to return the prop on time, the deposit will be doubled and returned to you, and the prop will self-destruct.
If the prop is successfully returned, all rented props will be returned to the other party, and your deposit will turn into rental fees given to them.
-
"This is kind of long."
Chen Yi studied his new profession's panel closely; it seemed like he had seen a similar profession before, called Thief, which could also steal players' props without the need to pay any deposit, but as a tradeoff, the player could not carry any props themselves.
This one allows you to steal from others and use your own, but you need to pay a deposit.
No, that's not right; it isn't stealing.
It's renting, albeit forced renting.
You can force-rent ten props from a player, but you must provide a sum of Points as a deposit. If you kill the other person within 3 hours, the deposit is doubled and returned to you, while the rented props will self-destruct.
Conversely, if you do not kill them within the three hours.
Then you've thrown good money after bad.
That deposit will then have to serve as rental fees for the other person.
The profession doesn't seem very powerful; it's not nearly as potent as his Giant Heavy Armor. After understanding the profession, Chen Yi sighed helplessly. It seemed the randomness associated with his Faceless One profession was too great, unpredictable as to whether his next random profession would be useful or not.
If the profession was a good match, his combat power would be greatly enhanced.
Otherwise.
If the profession was useless, his combat power would be greatly reduced.
This caused his combat capabilities to be somewhat unstable.
Wait a minute.
Chen Yi's eyes narrowed quickly as he looked at the line about occupational restrictions, realizing that paying a deposit was listed under occupational restrictions, not occupational effects, and his Faceless One profession could waive all occupational effects.
Including this cooldown time, as well as the earlier deposit effect.
That meant he could completely ignore the cooldown time and not have to pay any deposit.
Then his gaze shifted thoughtfully towards Tuberculosis Rabbit, Sword Without End, and Tie Chui, who were gathered at a stone table chatting.
Magic Thief Group Envoy occupational effect activated.
The next second—
As if a gentle breeze had passed by, the Wonder Atlas, which Tuberculosis Rabbit and company had been discussing at the stone table, suddenly vanished, and they felt a surprising chill.
Glancing down, they realized that all the clothes on their bodies were gone.
In fact, they were completely bare.
Even their underwear was no more.
Upon seeing the prompt from the system, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others looked bewildered and turned their heads towards Chen Yi, who was lying on a nearby beach chair.
"Yi, what are you doing?"
...
"..."
At that moment, Chen Yi was lying on the beach chair with a strange expression, looking at a pile of various props and skills in his backpack; there was the Wonder Atlas, a whole bunch of air series props, the Ancient Green Peak Sword, Malphite's Brain.
And a mess of fashion items, among other things.
All props, skills, and titles from the trio were now in his possession, temporarily stored in a virtual backpack. The items he had stolen were temporarily kept in this limitless virtual backpack, sparing him the worry about his actual backpack's capacity.
Fashion items and vehicles were also considered props and therefore had been stolen by him as well.
Since he could ignore occupational restrictions and there was no cooldown limit, there was no longer a restriction of only randomly stealing ten at a time; he could steal without limits and without paying a deposit, until he had taken all the props from any player within his line of sight.
It seemed a bit... perverse.
This profession was not very useful on the map, and it had no effect on bosses.
But when it came to other players, this skill was almost a death sentence.
As long as the other party had no prop or title that could prevent his theft, he could instantly strip them of all their props and titles.
And after Jiaye had finished eating, he went back to his room, otherwise Chen Yi wouldn't have experimented with the occupational effect.
...
"Um..."
Chen Yi approached the stone table, pulling out three fashion sets he had just bought from the store and tossing them onto the table, "I can't return your props right now, they can only be forcibly returned after three hours."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 509 351: "Wonder Name": Tomb of the Gods. _4
chapters.content:
"You guys go ahead and wear these three sets of costumes."
"Don't catch a cold, just experimenting with the new occupational effect, what's the prompt you received on your side?"
"Here."
Tuberculosis Rabbit somewhat speechlessly projected a system notification into mid-air.
'Ding, player Chen Yi has made a '0' Points deposit to rent 10 of your random props, skills, and titles, which will be returned the same way after three hours, while the deposit will be transferred to you as full rental payment after three hours.'
"That's quite polite."
Chen Yi looked at the system prompt in front of him and couldn't help but laugh.
It seems that the 'Magic Thief Group Envoy' occupation differs quite a lot from the 'Thief' occupation, with Thief being about stealing, whereas his Magic Thief Group Envoy is about renting.
The difference is huge.
One is illegal while the other is not.
Although this prop isn't as strong as the Giant Heavy Armor in enhancing his combat power, it's not weak either. It can often burst out a strong effect when facing players, akin to a forced disarmament.
In the level-up game, most players would have a hard time breaking his defense when stripped of their props, skills, and titles, relying solely on their own strength; they'd probably only knock 1 point off his Life Value with a punch.
Just then—
A message suddenly popped up before his eyes.
'Li Yi': "Chen Yi, do you remember the Lisu you declared war on in Sky City?"
"This race asked someone to pass a message through me to you, saying they want to come and have a one-on-one duel with you. If they lose, they're willing to offer a large compensation as an apology for the last conflict. If they win, they hope you, Brother Chen Yi, will remove the forced title from them and also make a public statement saying you have no intention of being enemies with the Lisu Tribe."
"I'm just the messenger, I don't have that good a relationship with the Lisu Tribe, so how you decide has nothing to do with me."
"The Lisu Tribe?"
Chen Yi frowned slightly, looking puzzled at the chat panel in front of him, searching his memory. He couldn't recall declaring war on the Lisu Tribe.
"The one whose dad is Gangzi."
On the side, Tuberculosis Rabbit quickly remembered and explained: "In the last half hour in Sky City, when Yi and Tie Chui were strolling there while you headed to Void Starfield, someone came over acting tough and looking for trouble."
"They said their dad is the Administrative Head of the Lisu Tribe from Threefold Planet, Guo Ligang's son."
"I told you about it at that time, then you, Yi, used the title 'Wildfire Burns Everything' on all the players of that race over in Void Starfield, forcing all the players of that race to wear the title 'Target of God Yi' above their heads."
"Hmm."
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded seriously: "That's exactly right."
"Ah, them."
Chen Yi finally remembered the incident, slapping his forehead in realization. He was busy in Void Starfield at the time and didn't really pay attention to this matter. Upon learning that Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others weren't in any life danger, he had activated the 'Wildfire Burns Everything' title on the spot to back up Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Unexpectedly, the other party had now come knocking.
And they were even proposing a duel.
A duel... such an ancient way of declaring war.
It traces back to when maternal societies would go to war with each other, neither wanting excessive casualties, but needing to settle a resource dispute, hence resorting to duels.
Or as recent as a challenge in front of the school gates.
Indeed, a method of declaring war that spans five thousand years, and now the Lisu Tribe wants to challenge him to a duel...
"Awesome."
Chen Yi could only give this one response.
It always felt like the Lisu Tribe was eagerly trying to bestow upon him the 'Longevity as the Southern Mountains' Life Value, as if the entire Lisu Tribe combined couldn't beat him, so how could a duel do the trick?
What were they thinking, daydreaming?
Dream on, folks.

chapters.title: Chapter 510 352: "Since you have found me, I won't ignore this matter.
chapters.content:
"So, Yi, are you going to go?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit standing to the side asked.
"Go where? This one-on-one fight?"
Chen Yi shook his head, somewhat speechless, "Definitely not. Who has the time for that? Besides, even if I wanted to go, I'd need to be able to leave first."
"Who doesn't want to leave? I really want to get out."
"But one must be able to leave first."
It's extremely difficult for new players to leave their planet and go to Starfield before the Newbie Protection Period ends.
So far, he had only been to Starfield three times.
Once for a bet initiated by the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team and the Annihilation Starfield Project Team, another time for the debut map, and the last time when he agreed to a future request by the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team—only these three chances to visit other Starfields.
The difficulty of each was not low.
Moreover, if the other party dared to challenge him to a one-on-one, they must have made complete preparations. Not to mention, they might have something that could force an item on a player to become ineffective.
Or even simpler.
Maybe some S-grade prop that has a very simple effect: forced exchange, both parties going hand-in-hand to the depths of hell to become cleaners.
Don't say it's not possible; this possibility is very high.
If the Lisu Tribe directly sends out a player to exchange with him, to whom does he go to reason out if he ends up in the depths of hell?
One shouldn't underestimate the Lisu Tribe just because it's a modest Threefold Planet. If after witnessing his strength, they still dare to speak of a one-on-one challenge, it means the tribe must have a surefire way to deal with him.
The upgrade game is too vast.
So vast that there are all kinds of props and skills he has never seen before. Without going into the far-fetched, just look at the close ones. The A-grade map, Pharaoh's Tomb, which he always disregarded as a place to farm Life Value, would really be overturned if he dragged on the time there.
In that map, death is real death—because of a moment of caution, resulting in a lifetime of regret.
"Absolutely cannot go."
Chen Yi, who had already calculated all possibilities in his mind, nodded seriously, and made up his mind to quickly find a way to eliminate the Lisu tribe.
Originally, he hadn't noticed this race at all.
But now, the situation has changed. This tribe obviously has a prop or skill that can pose an absolute threat to him. If left unattended, it's a huge hidden danger.
The tribe must be eliminated as soon as possible.
However, how to eliminate this race while he can't leave Blue Star is the question.
Chen Yi's brows furrowed slightly as he fell into deep thought.
Soon.
He temporarily gave up thinking, putting this issue aside for now to focus on enhancing all his props to Ultimate Props first.
Then he looked at the eight Zenith Radiance in his backpack.
Currently, he only had the B-grade 'Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle' and the A-grade 'Recoil Armor' enhanced to Ultimate Props; the rest were ordinary props. He had tried to use Zenith Radiance to enhance his class, but unfortunately he concluded that it was not possible to enhance it.
He had also tried to enhance Zenith Radiance with Zenith Radiance, but that operation failed as well.
Without much thought, he looked at the first prop he wanted to enhance.
'Prop Name': Buddha's Fury (Ultimate Edition).
'Enhancement Effect': The power is greatly strengthened. The bullets fired from the Gatling in the hands of Buddha are upgraded to high-explosive burning air bullets, significantly boosting the power and attaching an explosive effect to the bullets.
And after firing 10 bullets, the 11th bullet will be changed to a 'Gold-Reducing Bullet'.
Enemies hit by the Gold-Reducing Bullet will have the amount of Points in their account instantly reduced by 0.01%.
-
"Gold-Reducing Bullet?"
Chen Yi looked at the enhanced 'Ultimate Buddha's Fury', and seemingly reminded of something, he suddenly burst into a grin.
If an ordinary person were to get this prop, it would be of no use at all.
After all, a single Gold-Reducing Bullet would only decrease the Points amount in an enemy's account by 0.01%. To empty an enemy's account of Points, one would need a full 10,000 successful hits with the Gold-Reducing Bullet. The enemies aren't fools; they wouldn't stand still and let you shoot them that many times.
But he has the Wife-Killing Buff.
Under the effects of the Wife-Killing Buff, he can instantly activate more than a hundred thousand Buddha's Fury, which means if he wishes, he could instantly empty a person's account of their Points. This effect is completely useless against ordinary enemies, but extremely useful against someone like Li Yi, who relies on the amount of Points in their account to attack.
It's a skill that can be quite useful in certain situations.
But at least when dealing with players from Sevenfold Planet or higher, this effect could potentially be utilized.
After all, wanting all 10,000 Gold-Reducing Bullets to hit the enemy also has a prerequisite—that the initial 100,000 regular burning bullets also hit the enemy. So far, he hasn't met anyone who could withstand 100,000 of his bullets.
Especially after being enhanced.
Without waiting for the Points in the account to be deducted, the person would have already gone to hell for a free one-day tour.
Chen Yi, who achieved no small success with his first enhancement, nodded with satisfaction and began to enhance in bulk.
-
'Prop Name': Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom (Ultimate Edition).
'Enhancement Effect': Enemies touched by the Flowers of the Other Shore not only lose Life Value rapidly but also experience dull consciousness, body rigidity, and loss of direction.
-
'Prop Name': Forever Pure (Ultimate Edition).
'Prop Effect': Priority is increased, and when the immunity to control effects is successfully determined, the negated control effects will be rebounded to the enemy. Additionally, if a player state of unconsciousness is detected, it will be activated instantly without inquiry and waiting.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 352: "Since you've found me, I won't ignore this matter."_2
chapters.content:
-
"Skill Name": Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans (Ultimate Edition).
"Enhancement Effect": Now enemies killed by non-firearms weapons can also be reduced to annihilating three clans for players and 999 clans for monsters.
-
"Prop Name": Septagon Badge (Ultimate Edition).
"Enhancement Effect": Once activated, the special effects of the Septagon Badge will enable it to unleash a devastating assault with 100 gun muzzles, based on your main firearms prop, for a duration of 10 seconds towards the enemy in front.
Moreover, the conjured gun muzzles will be invisible, undetectable by enemies.
-
"Prop Name": Wildfire (Ultimate Edition).
"Enhancement Effect": The falling time for meteorites, initially requiring 2-3 minutes, is changed to instant casting.
-
"Title Name": Wife-Killing Maniac (Ultimate Edition).
"Enhancement Effect": The buff duration has been increased from the original 1 hour to 2 hours.
-
"..."
Chen Yi, who was frantically enhancing his gear, suddenly stopped his actions and fell into a prolonged silence.
He had consumed 7 Zenith Radiance and had one left.
But he didn't know what to use the last one for.
He indeed wanted to use it to enhance his many Starry titles, including the Stellar Rank titles.
But unfortunately, no chance.
Zenith Radiance could only be used on S rank and below titles, skills, props, etc.
In the title level system, red titles are equivalent to S rank, probably because obtaining titles is significantly harder than obtaining props.
His title of Wife-Killing Maniac was a red title, which was the limit of titles he could enhance. Titles beyond this level could not be enhanced with Zenith Radiance, leaving him with one spare, looking at the props and titles in his inventory.
He momentarily didn't know which prop to use it on.
After a brief hesitation, he decided to use the last Zenith Radiance on the skill that had been with him the longest.
"Skill Name": Calm and Composed (Ultimate Edition).
"Skill Effect": When you have no trace of fear in your heart, your physical attributes will not double as before but will increase fivefold.
"Damn."
Feeling the sudden surge of power within, Chen Yi's eyes flickered with surprise. He swung his arm in a test and heard a somewhat piercing sonic boom. It was the first time he felt his body filled with so much power.
Doubling physical attributes isn't just an increase in strength but a comprehensive improvement in many aspects.
It reminded him of what Wang Qi said, the lower the level of the prop, the better the effect after enhancing it with Zenith Radiance.
Not bad at all.
Chen Yi, with his enhancements complete, looked at his inventory packed full of Ultimate Props, feeling almost overwhelmed by a sense of security. With these Ultimate Props, he suddenly felt that even if the Lisu Tribe had some killer move, it wasn't impossible to make a breakthrough.
The priority of Forever Pure had increased significantly, and it now activates automatically the instant it detects that the player is unconscious, not like before when it needed to wait for 30 seconds. If he were to go to the White Phoenix Clan and encounter that mysterious person who likes to knock people out, there would be a surprise in store for them.
```
Other commonly used props were also greatly enhanced, including his "Annihilate Nine Clans," which can now trigger its effects without needing bullets, and his favorite "Wildfire," which no longer requires a 2.3-minute wait for the meteorite to fall.
It can be cast instantly.
The power of "Wildfire" was always significant, but due to the long fall time, it mostly served as a deterrent under most conditions. Unless it was a chaotic battlefield, the two or three minutes were enough for the enemy to run thousands of miles away.
But soon—
Chen Yi shook off the overconfidence brought by the sheer boost in combat power from the Ultimate Props.
It was better to proceed with caution, remembering the near disaster in the "Pharaoh's Tomb" map.
...
Over at the Awesome Starfield,
Li Yi, seated on the throne, put away the chat panel in front of him, turned his head to the Lisu Tribal Chief beside him, casually lit a cigar, and said, "You guys have really set yourselves up this time."
"From the sounds of it, Chen Yi had already forgotten about this whole affair, and yet you had to come and remind him."
"You didn't accept the one-on-one challenge."
"But knowing Chen Yi as I do, he's probably already thinking about how to wipe out your entire race, since in his eyes, you're already marked as a fierce enemy."
"Why on earth did you come to me to relay a message with nothing better to do?"
"Huh!"
Li Yi let out a long sigh, and then casually stuffed the cigar into the cleavage of a short-skirted maid beside him, patting her cheek with a smile, "Keep it snug. It's a bit bland, give it some flavor for me."
"Chief Li."
The Lisu Tribal Chief, sitting restlessly on the sidelines, spoke with a trembling voice and a mournful face, "We didn't want to actively seek out Brother Chen Yi either, but we had no choice because now, all members of our race are forced to wear the 'Target of God Yi' title above their heads."
"We've already lost half of our partners, as they're terrified of being dragged into this."
"Including our players on some maps, when they try to team up with players of other races, they are shunned like demons, fearing the next second Brother Chen Yi will come for them."
"If this continues, even if Brother Chen Yi doesn't lay a hand on us, we won't last long. In no time, due to a significant drop in our race's overall strength, we'll face extinction."
"Chief Li, I'm begging you, please speak kindly to Brother Chen Yi for us, beg his mercy for us."
"Hey, what are you doing?"
Li Yi looked at the Lisu Tribal Chief kneeling and kowtowing in front of him with pretended anger but inwardly felt smug. This Lisu tribe once snubbed him, presenting one of the obstacles to his control of the entire Awesome Starfield.
Weren't they always acting so high and mighty?
Why are they kowtowing now?
He then put on a show of helping the old man up, speaking earnestly, "Since you've come to me, I won't ignore this matter, but there's something I don't understand."
"If you're coming to apologise and beg forgiveness from Brother Chen Yi, why didn't you simply offer a gift?"
"From what I've observed, Brother Chen Yi isn't taking your Lisu tribe to heart, so it shouldn't be too difficult to settle this."
"Why set up a one-on-one challenge that, after being lost, would then require compensation?"
The bitter-faced old man replied, "It's a long story. The partners who terminated contracts with our Lisu tribe explicitly stated that to avoid risk, they would only continue to work with us if Brother Chen Yi personally declared he had no hostility towards our Lisu tribe and removed the title from our players' heads."
"That's why we had to use such a desperate strategy, just for Brother Chen Yi to give us a chance to clear our name."
"Think about it, with Brother Chen Yi's strength, could any single one of our players stand a chance against him?"
"Certainly not!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 512 353: "Yi... Yi won't... be in trouble, right?
chapters.content:
```
"I understand," Li Yi said, his eyes lighting up with realization. He didn't harbor any major doubts about the matter; after all, the Lisu Tribe was from his Awesome Starfield, and he was fairly aware of their recent situation. Indeed, many partners had canceled their cooperation with the Lisu Tribe over this issue.
Without going into details,
His Sky City had already forced the Lisu Tribe to withdraw from the competition.
The reason was simple; he didn't want to offend Chen Yi over a single Lisu Tribe matter and risk straining their relationship—it wouldn't be good.
Just passing along a message didn't take much effort.
After pondering for a moment, Li Yi nodded and said, "Okay, I'll talk to Chen Yi for you, but whether or not he agrees is uncertain. However, I do need to clarify something with you in advance."
"Chen Yi is still a newbie player. Even if he accepts your duel invitation, he won't be able to come to Awesome Starfield just yet. It might take about half a year; you're aware of this, right?"
"Don't worry, don't worry!"
The Lisu Tribal Chief, visibly excited, rose to his feet and said with a trembling voice, "As long as Big Boss Chen Yi agrees to this matter, we will find a way to get him to Awesome Starfield. Leave these matters to us to handle."
"Then, I thank you, Former Leader Li."
"Don't thank me yet; I'll inquire about the situation for you."
...
"I'm not going."
Chen Yi replied in the chat box with a face devoid of expression, resolute in his response, "Absolutely not going."
At the same time, he felt even more determined to wipe out the Lisu Tribe at the earliest opportunity. If this tribe was so adamant about inviting him to a duel, he wouldn't believe for a second there were no tricks or conspiracies behind it—definitely shady business going on behind the scenes.
As for the idea that letting the duel's compensation process be witnessed by other partners would alleviate the Lisu Tribe's predicament, he trusted that even less.
If that was the intention, there were far too many other methods available; why choose the most complicated one?
Ever since he found out he had almost died in the A-level map of Pharaoh's Tomb, he had become extremely cautious—fearing an unexpected capsize in the gutter at any moment. Even with his hundreds of millions of hit points and status as a Seed Player, he still felt somewhat insecure.
He needed more of a safety net.
Especially since he now had a far more important task at hand.
"Prop Name": S-level Admission Ticket.
"Prop Level": S-level.
"Prop Effect": Upon activation, this prop will allow a group of 10 players who all possess an S-level Admission Ticket to enter a map, where there is a chance to obtain an S-level prop.
However, only one player can obtain the S-level prop, while the other nine players will receive A-level props.
A-level props are guaranteed, and each player will receive at least one A-level prop.
The prop effects within the map are random and cannot be chosen.
The map will only open once 10 players have been assembled. If the number of matched players is insufficient, please wait patiently.
"Prop Restrictions": Can only be used once.
"Prop Description": "Owning an S-level prop earns you a true entrance ticket to the stage."
An S-level Admission Ticket!!!
He had acquired this prop a long time ago during his first trip to Annihilation Starfield to defeat the Five Clans. This prop had been sitting like a lump in his inventory for quite a while.
Either he didn't have the time to go,
Or he had the time, but there weren't 10 players gathered for the map.
And now—
The 10 players had finally come together, and the map could officially be accessed.
As long as he entered the map, he was guaranteed an A-level prop, and if he could be the last one standing, he could obtain an S-level prop.
Up until now, he had only one S-level prop, Longevity as the Southern Mountains. Apart from that, he had no other S-level props—of course, the Sea God's Boots were an exception, being a work in progress.
For him, the most important thing right now was this map at hand. As for the duel with the Lisu Tribe, he hadn't given it a second thought. Once Blue Star's Newbie Protection Period was over, he would seek out the Lisu Tribe for a chat.
"Map Name": Children of the Forest.
"Map Level": None.
"Map Introduction": In an expansive forest, are you confident that you can be the last one standing?
"This map is for the S-level Admission Ticket. The ultimate victor will receive a random S-level prop, while the other players will receive random A-level props."
"PS: This map has randomly been confirmed to be the 'Fury of the Sea of Corpses' in the Wonder Atlas, ranked at 78. Please be prepared."
"PS2: All players will officially enter the map in three minutes."
"Sea of Mummies?"
Chen Yi looked at the map alert that popped up before him, stunned for a moment, then couldn't help but smile.
What kind of luck was this?
It almost felt as if he already possessed the S-level prop "Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea."
With this Wondrous map, it was his absolute home ground. Neither mentioning the agility of the Boots of the Sea God within the map, nor even the "Fury of the Sea of Corpses" Skill could exert an absolute dominant role.
"This is a sure thing."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking at the map, laughed as well, "It seems we can already congratulate Yi for securing the S-level prop in advance. I just wonder what planets the other players come from. As long as there are no players with six or seven books, there shouldn't be any problem."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 513 353: "Yi... Yi won't... be in trouble, right?"_2
chapters.content:
"Right, Yi."
"For this prop, is there any rule that specifies which tier of planet players can enter this map? For example, is it restricted to players from Fourfold Planet or lower?"
"Well,"
Chen Yi scrutinized the details again, carefully checking the S-grade item Admission Ticket's panel, before shaking his head, "No, the panel doesn't specify anything like that. It just says that once 10 players with S-grade item Admission Tickets are gathered, a map for the contest for the S-grade item will open."
"But probably the highest that will appear are Fivefold players."
"If I remember correctly, players from Fivefold Planet and above have more ways to get S-grade items, like farming expeditions and such, and those high-tier players should be focusing on competing for SSS-grade items anyway," he added, shrugging off the importance of the upcoming map. With the Sea of Mummies as a Wonder on the map, it signaled that it was his absolute home field. Forget Sixfold Planet players; even if that Godslaying Ninefold Planet player, Jiang Chenglu, were to show up, he would still take them down.
Just then—
A new prompt popped up before his eyes.
'Ding, the map Children of the Forest is about to open, please prepare for entry, all players.'
'10 players have successfully matched, including Mo Zi Clan's Wang Deyan, human race Chen Yi, Mo Clan Jiang Chenglu, Di Clan...'
"..."
With an expressionless face, Chen Yi fell silent in place, carefully observing the words Mo Clan Jiang Chenglu for a long time before snatching the Wonder Atlas from Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand and flipping to the Tomb of the Gods Wonder, ranked number one.
He then carefully cross-checked the name of the Wonder Creator against the name of this Mo Clan Jiang Chenglu.
Yes, both were Mo Clan, so that was not an issue.
Jiang Chenglu, the name was also correct. The character 録 was a bit tricky to write, so what if it was just a lookalike? Maybe there was some issue with the strokes?
Three seconds later.
He was certain.
He had indeed been matched with this Ninefold Planet player, Jiang Chenglu!
"..."
"Cancel, cancel, cancel!!"
Immediately after, without any hesitation, Chen Yi looked at the S-grade prop Admission Ticket and said in a hurried tone, joking aside, it was just an S-grade item; he didn't know if it was going to cost him his life!
That's Jiang Chenglu from the Ninefold Planet!!!
A being capable of Godslaying!
And not just one deity, but a bunch!!!
In such a situation, to have him confront Jiang Chenglu in the same map was too high an esteem. The moment Jiang Chenglu entered the map, he was likely to sweep-clean everyone, wasn't he? And, if he had something like a title or a skill that prevents alien race players he killed from resurrecting, like him.
Wouldn't his death be too wrongful??
However, there was no option to cancel this map!
'10, 9, 8, 7...'
The countdown to the map entry was already ringing in his ears. Chen Yi, somewhat panicked, was just about to check if his Great Demon King title could refuse the map entry when he suddenly felt a fragrant breeze envelope him in a hug.
Looking down.
He saw Jiaye coming from a distance,stuff a dagger into his hand, then crashing her chest onto the blade, already in her dying moments, she looked up at Chen Yi with trusting eyes and said softly,
"Don't be afraid, Yi, the Sea of Mummies is your home field."
"Even if it's Jiang Chenglu, slay him."
"Go for it, I believe in you."
"..."
Chen Yi looked somewhat stunned at Jiaye in his arms, whose consciousness was fading, and blurted out without thinking, "Didn't I give you several defense props? How did you die from just a touch?"
"..."
Jiaye, clearly not expecting Chen Yi to still have the mood to think about these things at this moment, pursed her lips with slight annoyance, "I stabbed myself a few extra times beforehand."
"I..."
Chen Yi was about to say something when his body froze. He then vanished in a flash of white light, pulled into the map.
Meanwhile, Jiaye slowly collapsed onto a nearby beach chair.
...
"I'll go first," said Sword Without End beside him, his expression complex as he fell into silence for a while. He then removed the cigarette from his lips and extinguished it under his foot. "This time might really be bad; I've got a bad feeling."
"Actually, my premonitions are quite accurate. Maybe, like you said, I do have the constitution of the Lone Star and the Sky Fiend. Whenever someone important is about to leave me, I get this feeling."
"Yi won't run into trouble this time, right? That's a Ninefold Planet player, and not just any, but the strongest from the Ninefold Planet."
"An existence that can slay gods."
"Forget it, forget it, let's not talk about this anymore, lest we jinx it."
"Alright, alright."
Tuberculosis Rabbit swept a glance at Sword Without End somewhat speechlessly, "If you know you might jinx it, then don't talk. Yi won't have any problems, rest assured, and if he really does, I'll step in."
"You? How would you step in?"
"Heh, looking down on people, huh? Believe it or not, as long as I'm not dead, no one in the whole world could kill Yi?"
"Give it a rest."
Sword Without End spoke somewhat irritably, "At a time like this, you're still joking. Your Charged Strike is indeed very powerful now, but no matter how strong, it can't threaten Jiang Chenglu."
"Not to mention Jiang Chenglu is still inside the map."
Following that, Sword Without End no longer spoke but stood at the edge of the rooftop, let out a sigh, and leaped into the air, heading to hell.
He had a very strong premonition.
This small team was about to disband.
Although he never showed it, he actually felt a very deep connection with this team. He had been alone for so many years, anyone who got close to him always ended up dying due to various accidents.
Now, it appeared that Yi was about to be 'killed' by him too.
He refused to believe that he had some kind of cursed Lone Star constitution.
But there was nothing he could do but pray.
Pray that Jiang Chenglu didn't have any way to permanently kill Alien Race players after killing them. Wait, Yi could choose to commit suicide, right?
As long as Yi killed himself quickly, at most it would mean losing the chance to get an S-rank Prop and having to make a trip to hell, but he would have successfully escaped from Jiang Chenglu's grasp.
He could think of this.
Yi should be able to think of it too, right?
Thinking of this, Sword Without End suddenly felt the weight that had hung in his heart drop, and even his free-falling body felt lighter, as if unburdened by something.
...
Under the sunset.
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat alone at the edge of the rooftop, legs dangling over the side, hands propped on the edge, and remained silent, not speaking.
After an unknown amount of time passed,
he finally lit a cigarette, placed it between his lips, and as the smoke curled around him, he looked up at the orange sunset in the sky. After a long pause, he let out a meaningful chuckle.
"Godslaying?"
"The number of deities that have died by Yi's hand is already in the triple digits."
"If those two gods from the White Phoenix Clan who are imprisoned were to truly wake up, the first thing they should do upon seeing Yi would be to bow down and beg for mercy."
Just then—
Tie Chui, a bit perplexed, leaned in: "Tuberculosis Rabbit, what... are you talking about? I... didn't catch that."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, realizing that Tie Chui was beside him, immediately pulled himself out of his reverie, shuffled to throw the cigarette butt off his pants, and turned his head towards Tie Chui with a slightly speechless expression.
"Tie Chui, how come you have no presence at all? With your talent for invisibility, why don't you become an assassin?"
"I... I don't know how to... turn invisible."
"You're already doing it. Your invisibility has a higher priority than Sword Without End's. The kind with maxed-out priority."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat helplessly, got up and patted Tie Chui's shoulder: "Alright, alright, let's go back to eat and sleep. Yi will only come out from the map later."
"Yi... Yi won't be in... trouble, will he?"
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood in place, silent, and looked towards the horizon for a while before speaking hoarsely, "Yi will definitely be okay."
"I just wish to live to the end and see the sea that Yi longs for."
The moment Yi entered the map, I suddenly recovered some of my memory.
In theory, that shouldn't be possible. At this point, my memory should be sealed, only complete in dreams. Suddenly recovering some memory means that, deep down, my sixth sense is telling me.
This time, Yi is going to die.
I've accompanied Yi for many lifetimes, and in each one, my greatest role has been to take a calamity on his behalf.
When I suddenly recovered part of my memory just now, it meant it was time to fulfill my role.
This is my last life.

chapters.title: Chapter 514 354: "It's not that you're too weak, it's that I'm too strong.
chapters.content:
Meanwhile—
At Awesome Starfield, after saying goodbye to Li Yi, the Lisu Tribal Chief left Chief Li's palace, sat in his vehicle, and found a player named "Wang Zhiping" through the chat panel.
And he made a video call.
"Ping, it's settled. Chen Yi should agree to our duel, and I'll need you to step in then," said the Chief.
The man in the video was a player from Sixfold Planet.
Originally, he had no idea how to deal with Chen Yi and was frantically busy when this player named Wang Zhiping found him, saying he could temporarily join his race and then initiate a duel with Chen Yi.
Wang Zhiping would fight the battle.
Such an offer was naturally too good to refuse, especially since it came at no charge, which was most important—he could not possibly offer compensation to Chen Yi.
To offer too little would infuriate the opponent, yet to offer too much was something he couldn't bear to do either.
"But there's something I want to ask about," he said with some hesitation.
"Do you have some sort of grudge against Chen Yi, Ping?"
"No grudge," the buzz-cut man said coldly and expressionlessly in the video. "Just pissed off by his show-off attitude during the live stream. I want to mess with him a bit."
"Oh, okay." The Lisu Tribal Chief nodded and didn't pursue the topic, instead carefully probed, "But Chen Yi has the status of a Seed Player, which allows him to return from the depths of hell without blame once. If we don't eradicate him completely, won't it leave future trouble?"
"Heh," the buzz-cut man seemed amused. "It seems you have no idea the overwhelming advantage Sixfold Planet players have over you. It's just the destruction of a few Threefold Planets. If I wanted to, do you think I couldn't do it?"
"Since I've come to deal with him, I have no intention of letting him reappear before the world alive."
"Let me know when you have news. I'm about to enter a map with an S-level prop Admission Ticket, and by the time I come out, I hope you've already arranged a time with Chen Yi. Don't tell me you lack even that ability to handle things."
"I'm helping you for free; I hope you're aware of that."
Just then—
The man in the video seemed to receive some message and was momentarily stunned before he couldn't help but smile with a rise of his lips, "No need for your help temporarily, it's either my luck or Chen Yi's misfortune."
"Chen Yi and I ended up in the same map."
"Tough luck for him, I guess, and it saves me from using props. Otherwise, it'd be quite troublesome to pull him out of Novice Planet."
"That's quite a coincidence?" The Lisu Tribal Chief was also momentarily stunned but then joyously clasped his fists, "Then I wish Ping an early triumphal return."
"Heh, wiping out a novice player doesn't count as a triumph."
"Easily crushed with a flick of a toe."
...
'Map Name': Children of the Forest.
'Map Level': None.
'Map Details': 10 players will be randomly placed in a vast forest, and any props, skills, or titles that could be used to unlock maps are unusable, including but not limited to vision-enhancing props, satellite props, and the Byakugan Skill.
In this map, a beam of light will shine every 10 minutes.
Under the beam is a temporary prop that can boost one of the player's abilities.
For example, doubling the player's speed, making a prop cooldown-free, unlimited use of a title, and so on.
The map ends when only one player survives.
-
With a notification sound ringing in Chen Yi's ear, when he opened his eyes again, he found himself standing on a platform high in the sky.
Aside from him, there were 9 other players standing in various corners of the platform.
Each player was covered by a thin golden film, and there was a 1-minute countdown in the air.
It seemed to be the initial stand before the start of the map.
Chen Yi instantly spotted Jiang Chenglu in the crowd—he was hard to miss.
Clothed in a black robe, standing at 1.9 meters tall with a broadsword on his back that was as wide as five palms, and with sharp, distinct facial features—even just standing there, anyone could feel the sharpness emanating from him.
Cold as a biting wind.
Although he already knew he and Jiang Chenglu were on the same map, seeing him in person still unconsciously took his breath away; the pressure was too intense.
Chen Yi looked down at the forest below the platform. It seemed endless.
He couldn't even see any mummies; the canopy was too dense, completely obscuring the view of the ground.
At this moment—
The other players on the platform started to move around and probe each other, as this was a battle map where everyone else was an enemy. It was only natural to test out each other's boundaries.
"It's Chen Yi!" exclaimed a player who noticed Chen Yi. His face paled as he raised his voice, "Darn, matched with Chen Yi. He's the ruthless one who's wiped out several tribes on his own!"
"All of us put together probably aren't his match!"
"And as far as I know, Alien Race players killed by Chen Yi cannot come back to life."
"Yi, we have no feud; I'll give you the reward for this map. When the match officially starts, can you spare me first and let me kill myself?"
"I swear I won't pose any danger to you, Yi. Can you give me a chance to off myself?"
"..."
Standing there, Chen Yi, who was without his cane and usually unemotional, looked like a docile little lamb, feeling his scalp tingle upon hearing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 515 354: "It's not that you're too weak, it's that I'm too strong."_2
chapters.content:
If it were any other time, I'd let it go.
But right now, Jiang Chenglu is right there. In this situation, when you say that, are you trying to speed up his death?
Don't even mention suicide.
The instant this countdown disappears, he'll have to commit suicide, and he must do it quickly.
"Are you Chen Yi?"
Just then——
A man with a buzz cut, hands in his pockets and a devil-may-care attitude, walked up to Chen Yi. After a snicker, he spoke, "Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Wang Zhiping, a player from Sixfold Planet."
"I suppose there's no one else here stronger than I am, right?"
"You have quite the reputation. Weren't you quite the hotshot in the live streams? Why are you acting like a little sheep now?"
Chen Yi continued to stay silent, head bowed without saying a word. He had no interest in listening to what the man was saying; he just wanted to quickly commit suicide the moment the countdown ended.
His suicide would be nothing more than a trip to hell, but if he died at Jiang Chenglu's hand, who knows what that would entail.
"Heh."
Seeing that Chen Yi had no reaction, a flicker of boredom crossed Wang Zhiping's eyes: "I thought you were formidable, but it seems just the mention of a Sixfold Planet player scares you into silence, huh."
"I even went to the trouble of arranging a duel with the Lisu Tribe to see your arrogance for myself."
"Fine."
"Since you bore me, you're of no value to me. I'll find you and kill you with my own hands. Oh, right——"
Wang Zhiping suddenly laughed, "The players I kill don't get resurrected either, not even your Seed Player status."
"..."
From start to finish, Chen Yi hadn't given this player a proper look, just using his peripheral vision to keep tabs on Jiang Chenglu, who had stood still since the beginning, not even opening his eyes.
"And you."
Having failed to find entertainment with Chen Yi, Wang Zhiping, following Chen Yi's line of sight, also noticed Jiang Chenglu. He walked over to him, feeling annoyed, jumped up and slapped Jiang Chenglu, saying,
"Trying to act all aloof here, are you?"
"Think you're so cool, huh?"
Shielded by a golden light, players couldn't injure each other, they couldn't even feel pain. But this slap was tantamount to a provocation.
Even Chen Yi was somewhat shocked. Where had this clown sprung from and where did he get the courage?
That was Jiang Chenglu, a player from Ninefold Planet, and not just any Ninefold player - he was capable of Godslaying, the creator of the Wonder, the first Tomb of the Gods, Jiang Chenglu!
But even after such an insult, Jiang Chenglu, who stood perfectly upright, still hadn't opened his eyes, as if he were asleep.
Meanwhile——
The countdown slowly reached zero.
Whoosh!
Chen Yi suddenly felt a strong sense of weightlessness under his feet, and then his body involuntarily flew toward the forest to the east. In the moment he was swept away, he noticed that Jiang Chenglu flew in the completely opposite direction.
"Phew!"
In mid-air, his heart slowly relaxed.
Such a distance was enough for him to commit suicide.
After about a minute, he finally landed in a part of the forest—right on top of the Sea of Mummies that he knew all too well. Its depth was unfathomable, merely visible as it covered the entire forest, a truly magnificent sight!
"Fury of the Sea of Corpses!!!!!"
The moment he hit the ground.
Without the slightest hesitation, Chen Yi bellowed out the command. Then, from mid-air, hundreds of huge red beams, each several meters thick, suddenly appeared, locked onto his body, and shot toward him!
It wasn't that he lacked the courage to fight.
It was that he couldn't afford to make mistakes. If he died, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Jiaye, Tie Chui, Sword Without End, and others wouldn't have good days ahead.
He had too many enemies on Blue Star. If he died, the day Blue Star's Newbie Protection Period ended would be the day of the planet's annihilation.
It wasn't about not daring to die.
But that he had friends and family to protect behind him. He needed to stay alive to better shield his friends and family.
With over a hundred million in health!
Even suicide would take some effort, but in the Sea of Mummies, the Fury of the Sea of Corpses skill could be exponentially more powerful. Not to mention hundreds of Fury of the Sea of Corpses, even ten could easily obliterate him.
But to be on the safe side, he still activated hundreds of Fury of the Sea of Corpses after giving up all of his defenses.
But just as those red beams were about to strike him—
"Clang!"
A broadsword abruptly appeared overhead, absorbing all the red beams.
"..."
Chen Yi was slightly stunned at first but soon his expression filled with panic. That was Jiang Chenglu's broadsword. Jiang Chenglu didn't want him to commit suicide, could it be to make him die permanently?
Damn!
He had barely touched down when he found Jiang Chenglu had found him so quickly. And by the looks of it, it seemed he'd come especially for him. Since when had he offended a Ninefold Planet player?
But before he had time to think more about it, practically in an instant, he activated thousands more Fury of the Sea of Corpses, shooting from all corners towards himself.
But...
Without exception, they were all blocked.
You see, within the map with the Sea of Mummies, the power of the Fury of the Sea of Corpses skill could grow exponentially, but that broadsword seemed indomitable, blocking them all without fail.
"Damn it!"
Chen Yi's eyes flashed viciously. Without any hesitation, he forcefully bit off his own tongue.

chapters.title: Chapter 516 354: "It's not that you're too weak, it's that I'm too strong."_3
chapters.content:
Bite the tongue and commit suicide!
If he wanted to die, who could stop him? Who would dare to stop him?
But very soon.
He found himself sinking into despair, as intense pain surged from the tip of his tongue. Chen Yi realized that he didn't die immediately and that the blood constantly spilling before his eyes was still being tallied on a panel.
'-78!'
'-78!'
Seventy-eight droplets of blood per second?
At this rate, how long would it take for his hundreds of millions of hit points to drop?
"Huff!"
He took a deep breath, mustering his spirits and instantly activated several aggressive props like "Buddha's Fury" and "Wildfire", engulfing himself completely while simultaneously pulling the trigger of the Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle at himself and frantically stabbing his own heart with a dagger.
...
Five minutes later.
Chen Yi looked at his health bar, which was still more than half full, with some despair. He was first discovering just how hard he was to kill.
He finally understood that feeling of utter powerlessness and despair his enemies had felt. How was he so damn hard to kill?
Let alone being killed by someone else. Even killing himself was extremely difficult!
He had tried flying up to a height of 18 meters and then free-falling down, but the problem was that Blue Star's rules didn't work on this map!
And it was at this moment—
Jiang Chenglu emerged leisurely from the depths of the towering forest with one hand tucked into his pocket, stopping a few meters away from Chen Yi and calmly observing him for a while before speaking softly.
"Do you really want to die that badly?"
"Not really that badly," Chen Yi sighed lightly, ceasing his actions. If it really came to a fight, he wouldn't just sit and wait for death. While talking, he first tried to calm Jiang Chenglu down and then said, "How should I put it? I had no idea before, but isn't it magical that I can still speak even though my tongue is cut off? And also..."
The voice suddenly stopped!
"Magic Thief Group Envoy!"
He glared tightly at Jiang Chenglu and instantly activated his Magic Thief Group Envoy occupational skill. If he could steal all of Jiang Chenglu's props, what was there to fear from Jiang Chenglu?
Although his Magic Thief Group Envoy skill could only steal 10 skills, 10 props, and 10 titles at a time.
But his Faceless One occupation could lift Occupational Restriction. Theoretically speaking, as long as he was fast enough, he could strip Jiang Chenglu down to just a pair of underpants!
However... the next second—
'Ding, your account does not have enough Points, rental failed.'
"What?"
Chen Yi's eyes flickered with confusion. Almost 450 million Points in his account and he couldn't even rent 10 props, 10 skills, and 10 titles from Jiang Chenglu?
This meant that even the lowest valued 10 props, 10 skills, and 10 titles on Jiang Chenglu would already exceed 450 million Points when added up?
"..."
Although a bit embarrassed, Chen Yi didn't have time to ponder these things. He roared in defiance to psych himself up.
The next second—
Countless props, skills, and titles went berserk. Thick smoke engulfed Jiang Chenglu.
Tens of thousands of Fury of the Sea of Corpses lashed out like earthen dragons, nearly flipping the entire forest upside down. The trees wherever they passed were instantly vaporized.
30 minutes later.
The forest surrounding Chen Yi and Jiang Chenglu had been completely leveled. Within a ten-mile radius, it became a plain, not a single tree in sight.
And as the smoke cleared.
Jiang Chenglu, as if nothing had happened, continued to stand there, peacefully looking at Chen Yi, "Are you finished?"
"..."
Chen Yi, sitting cross-legged on top of a mummy, flicked his cigarette ash into the mummy's eye socket next to him, and said with a sense of loss, "Thanks for giving me time to smoke before I die."
"Do you want one?"
He pulled out a cigarette from his pocket and tossed it to Jiang Chenglu.
"Giving up?"
Jiang Chenglu caught the cigarette, didn't light it up, but pocketed it, still standing there calmly and continued, "For a rookie player, your strength is already exceptional."
"It's not that you're too weak, it's that I'm too strong."
"Don't be too hard on yourself."
"You're actually a decent person."
Sitting cross-legged on a mummy, Chen Yi flicked the cigarette ash into a mummy's eye next to him and murmured, "You have the knack for comforting people facing death."
"Damn, had I known I was going to die today, I would've gone for the double-decker game with Tuberculosis Rabbit yesterday."
"Tuberculosis Rabbit has always wanted to play this game with me, but I never had the time, nor did I like playing that game, so I never joined him."
"If I end up dying like this."
"The Tuberculosis Rabbit is probably going to be upset for days. That gaming console we got with so much trouble won't have any use then, which is kind of sad to think about,"
"Speaking of which, if you're going to kill me at least let me die clearheaded."
Chen Yi looked up at the man not far away, "Do I have a feud with you?"
"No."
"Any grievances?"
"Nope."
"Then why did you come find me the moment the map started?"
"I need to talk to you."
"What could possibly require the help of a rookie player like me?"
"This is something only a rookie player can help with."
"So why didn't you find someone else?"
"You're the only rookie player who has a chance to meet me in the S-grade Prop Admission Ticket map. Other rookies don't have the chance to come to this map, and the ones they go to, I can't enter,"
"Why does it have to be in this map? Couldn't you find me when I was in the Awesome Starfield?"
"I couldn't. There are rules restricting that."
"I'm not sure I understand. You mean to say you were looking for me to help you with something, not to kill me, right?"
"Right."
"..."
Chen Yi stubbed out the unsmoked cigarette by shoving it into the mouth of the mummy beneath him, then sprang to his feet, looking seriously at Jiang Chenglu, "You should have said so earlier. Look at the mess we've made, isn't it like 'Awesome Star player accidentally flooding the Dragon King's Temple'?"
"Us Blue Star players are always happy to lend a hand."
"Just tell me what you need. If I can help, I certainly will."

chapters.title: Chapter 517 355: Sharing His Nearly 20,000 Waves of Fury of the Sea of Corpses?
chapters.content:
Chen Yi looked at Jiang Chenglu seriously, his eyes brimming with sincerity while his body was extremely relaxed, not showing the slightest bit of tension.
This was his most relaxed moment in many days.
Completely outclassed.
Are players from the Ninefold Planet really this outrageous?
Although Chen Yi had known that Jiang Chenglu was a being capable of Godslaying and his strength couldn't be weak, the fact that Jiang just stood there and took his full firepower for half an hour without any actions was a bit too outrageous, wasn't it?
He even began to suspect that he was under an illusion.
The real Jiang Chenglu was actually somewhere else, and the Jiang Chenglu he had been attacking was just a piece of the Wasteland.
But... even so, he had no way to deal with it.
He had activated "Forever Pure" and "Like a Demon" countless times, but still, the scene before him remained unchanged; that meant that even if he really had fallen into an Illusory Realm.
The Illusory Realm before him was not something he could break through.
"Hmm."
After pondering for a moment, Jiang Chenglu raised his head to look at Chen Yi, "The moment you saw me, it seemed like you recognized me. Do you know me?"
This puzzled him.
Logically, a newcomer player shouldn't have been able to learn about him through any channel.
He was one of the strongest players on the Ninefold Planet, and the leaderboards he frequented were not something Chen Yi, the newcomer player, had access to. He was unclear how Chen Yi recognized him.
"Mm-hmm."
Chen Yi nodded his head somewhat helplessly, "Number one in the Wonder Atlas, Tomb of the Gods, Jiang Chenglu of the Mo Clan from the Ninefold Planet!"
"Wonder Atlas?"
Jiang Chenglu nodded slowly, "I see, that explains it. This means your strength is stronger than I expected. Only those who have created a Wonder can obtain the Wonder Atlas."
"A newcomer player who can create a Wonder and make it into the top hundred before ascending to the higher level game,"
"That's impressive."
Chen Yi didn't speak. He just stood obediently where he was. He was a bit confused about the temperament of the man before him. He seemed to be easy to talk to and his tone wasn't very cold, but he also seemed a bit capricious.
It was hard to discern.
Moreover, he was skeptical about Jiang Chenglu asking him for help. What kind of help could a newcomer like him provide?
Although his strength as a newcomer player was a bit stronger than that of average newcomers.
And Jiang Chenglu didn't beat around the bush any further. He took out the cigarette Chen Yi had just handed him, lit it, and spoke softly, "There's been a complication with my mission chain; it was altered by someone. The last mission requires that I get killed once by a newcomer player."
"This mission chain is very important to me. I must complete it."
"But the last mission is extremely difficult to complete. Under the rules, it's nearly impossible for me to come into contact with newcomer players who are all on their own Novice Planets, with no chance of meeting me."
"In the entire higher level game, you are the only newcomer player who has appeared in the past few days who can meet me."
"And fortunately, your strength is not bad."
"Ah?"
Chen Yi blinked in confusion and, after confirming that Jiang Chenglu wasn't joking, he said with a bewildered tone, "Um, Senior Jiang Chenglu, doesn't the mission seem a bit too difficult? I couldn't inflict any damage on you just standing there; how could I possibly kill you?"
"I was just in defensive mode. I will remove all my defenses in a moment."
"Then why didn't you remove your defensive state the moment you appeared, Senior Jiang Chenglu? Couldn't you have completed the mission like that?"
"There's also a rule for Instant Kill. The definition of a kill within three seconds means that from the start of your attack to my death, the process cannot exceed three seconds."
"..."
Chen Yi fell silent. Killing Jiang Chenglu within three seconds – wasn't this mission requirement a bit too harsh?
Jiang Chenglu had once slain eleven deities. Killing him in three seconds was equivalent to killing eleven deities in three seconds?
But since Jiang Chenglu said he would drop all defenses, then perhaps there was a chance – after all, the power of "Fury of the Sea of Corpses" was terrifying! Each strike dealt billions in damage!
"Senior, how much Life Value do you have? Let me see if my damage is enough."
Normally, players didn't have a Life Value, which only appeared after obtaining an item or a title that could increase one's Life Value.
Other players might not have it, but he certainly did.
"Yes."
Jiang Chenglu shared his Life Value calmly on a panel.
"One, ten, hundred, thousand, ..."
Chen Yi whispered as he began to count the dense numbers above Jiang Chenglu's head. After a moment, his eyes flashed with incredulity and shock, whispering, "Thirty-seven trillion Life Value?"
37 trillion Life Value!!!
What kind of joke is this!
It was said that "Longevity as the Southern Mountains," the S-grade Prop, was the only one in the whole game that had such growth potential to increase Life Value. Without such a growth item, how did you stack up to such a terrifying number???
But he soon figured it out – there must be other growth props or something.
37 trillion Life Value. Even if he removed all defenses and stood still, he wouldn't be able to kill him in 3 seconds!
"..."
After a prolonged silence and a sigh, Chen Yi spoke, "Senior Jiang Chenglu, I'm sorry, but I can't help you with this. Your Life Value is too exaggerated. Even with all my methods, I can't clear your Life Value within 3 seconds."

chapters.title: Chapter 518 355: Sharing His Nearly 20,000 Waves of the Fury of the Sea of Corpses?_2
chapters.content:
"Unless—"
"Unless you drain 99.9% of your own life value, leaving just 0.1% for me, I might try," Chen Yi said.
"No way,"
Jiang Chenglu shook his head, "The task requires that the life value can only be drained by you alone, without the aid of any external force, including myself. Since I've found you, naturally I have my ways."
The next second.
A prop appeared out of thin air in front of Chen Yi.
'Prop Name': Zigong.
'Prop Level': S-grade.
'Prop Effect': This prop can store all your attacks without any upper limit, and when reactivated, it can release all the stored attacks at once. Once activated, it must be completely released and cannot be released in segments.
'Prop Restriction': 1/1
'Prop Introduction': "Do you know the only way for mortals to commit deicide? It's to tenaciously survive through the lengthy river of time."
"I'm giving you this prop; there's no time limit on this map, so I can wait for you here indefinitely," Jiang Chenglu said.
"Until you fill this prop with enough attacks to instantly kill me within three seconds."
"This..."
Chen Yi was somewhat dumbfounded as he looked at the prop in his hands, his heart was stirring. Honestly, the prop was strong, and it tempted him greatly.
It could store his attacks indefinitely.
In theory, its power was unlimited.
He had always been somewhat anxious about his showdown with the player who possessed 'Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,' which was scheduled in a few dozen days. With this prop, he could amass an attack strong enough to kill in one hit during the fight on that day!
It was a pity that the prop was one-time-use only.
"There's another problem,"
Chen Yi suddenly remembered something, "I have a title. Alien Race players killed by me cannot be resurrected."
"Don't worry about that," Jiang Chenglu said.
"Understood," Chen Yi's lips twitched slightly. He knew he didn't need to ask; players from the Ninefold Planet truly evoked envy, didn't they? The props and titles they carried were probably all top-tier. But it seemed there were things they lacked as well.
For instance, this 'Zigong' prop wasn't an Ultimate Prop.
This suggested that even Ninefold Planet players couldn't enhance every prop they owned into Ultimate Props, but with enough time, when he became a Ninefold Planet player, even an ordinary E-grade prop on him would be elevated to an Ultimate Prop.
After all, he had the World Tree that could endlessly produce Zenith Radiance.
...
An hour later.
Chen Yi was visibly gasping for air from exhaustion as he continually activated bursts of Fury of the Sea of Corpses, and each crimson pillar of immense power was absorbed by the Zigong prop in his hands.
For a whole hour.
He didn't stop once.
It was the first time he found battle to be so tedious, while Jiang Chenglu had simply stood there from beginning to end, motionless, seemingly lost in thought.
Not speaking, no gestures. Just standing quietly, looking down at the soil beneath his feet like a philosopher pondering life.
At that moment—
A ghastly sneer suddenly echoed in their ears.
"Heh heh heh!!!"
"Chen Yi boy, I've finally found you. I've always said today would be your end, yet you refused to believe it,"
"I thought you'd quickly commit suicide to escape the map, but it seems you're still hoping for a stroke of luck,"
"Too late to run now!"
"Oh?"
"That big dumb show-off was here, too, perfect; it looks like you've known each other for quite a while. Then today, I'll send you both off together. I, Wang Zhiping, detest show-offs the most at this moment!!!"
As his voice fell, a man wearing a sports suit with a buzz cut, a cigarette dangling from his lips, and a four- to five-meter-long spear on his shoulder walked toward them, stepping on the heads of mummies.
His eyes were full of viciousness and bloodthirst.
The secondary effect of the Sea of Mummies was that players standing on it would uncontrollably sink into it, but it seemed that neither Chen Yi nor Jiang Chenglu, or the approaching Wang Zhiping seemed affected by this.
"Let me introduce myself once again. My name is Wang Zhiping, a Sixfold Planet player!" he declared.
"What now?"
"Chen Yi, do you have any last words you'd like to share before you die?"
"You know, players killed by me can't be resurrected, right?"
"..."
The busy Chen Yi frowned slightly and glanced irritably at Wang Zhiping approaching him: "A jumping clown."
The next second—
Tens of thousands of waves of Fury of the Sea of Corpses, like earth dragons, charged straight at Wang Zhiping with great might!
"Hmph,"
Wang Zhiping scoffed, a trace of disdain flashing in his eyes. He casually stood there with his hands in his pockets, showing no intention to defend, even exhaling a puff of smoke and looking at Chen Yi sadly while shaking his head and sighing.
"Newbie players never realize the difference between themselves and Sixfold Planet players," he said.
"Today, I'll show you the methods of the Sixfold Planet."
"All players of our race share life value completely. You can think of it as our race's players never dying. Any damage sustained by one player gets distributed evenly across all players," he explained.
"Even the strongest of attacks becomes nothing more than a tickle when spread out among everyone," he concluded.

chapters.title: Chapter 519 355: Sharing His Nearly 20,000 Waves of the Fury of the Sea of Corpses?_3
chapters.content:
"And our clan, boasting over ten million players, would find your so-called strongest attack laughable as it's spread across each member."
He didn't take the seemingly overwhelming attack before him seriously. He had seen Chen Yi's attacks before, and could only describe them as average. The only advantage was their ability to be used repeatedly without cooldown due to sheer numbers.
Such an attack, when divided among more than ten million players, was no different from a joke.
However—
When tens of thousands of the Fury of the Sea of Corpses engulfed Wang Zhiping, he suddenly realized something was amiss. Not only did his vision go dark, but he also heard some strange system prompt sounds.
'Ding, unfortunately, Wang Zhiping, you have suffered a complete defeat in the level-up game and have become a cleaner...'
'Ding, over 95% of the Mozang Tribe players have been slain by player Chen Yi, successfully triggering the extinction rule. Thank you for your support of the level-up game these days...'
What was happening?
How the hell had his clan been exterminated!
But he had no time to think when he opened his eyes again.
He saw his own grotesquely bloated and ugly belly, a galaxy-like unfamiliar space, and countless tribe members densely packed around him, all transformed into cleaners, looking around at each other in confusion.
They had no idea what had happened.
How could they have been exterminated without any warning?
...
Chen Yi, who was just a bit irritable from long periods of work, felt regret after making that strike.
Using tens of thousands of the Fury of the Sea of Corpses on a mere buffoon seemed like a waste. He would have been better off funneling those nearly 20,000 Furies of the Sea of Corpses into the "Zigong" prop before him.
But it was about enough.
Chen Yi looked at the prop in his hands, filled with his 700,000 Fury of the Sea of Corpses, and silently did some calculations. The number of mummies here was about the same as in the 'Pharaoh's Tomb' map.
So one Fury of the Sea of Corpses could roughly deal 100 million damage.
700,000 of them would be 70 billion.
Without any defenses, that damage was essentially true damage, and Jiang Chenglu only had a Life Value of 37 trillion. Even if Jiang Chenglu's body was strong, no physical defense could withstand that much.
700,000 Furies of the Sea of Corpses should be enough to take him down.
Just as Chen Yi was about to tell Jiang Chenglu that he was ready, he suddenly heard several prompt sounds by his ear. Staring at the pop-up messages, he was somewhat stunned.
'Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully exterminating the Mozang Tribe of Sixfold Planet and obtaining the 'Longevity as the Southern Mountains' S-rank Prop, Life Value +11.28 million.'
'Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for the Instakill of a clan, earning the Gleaming Star Level title 'Instakill Clan'!'
'Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for the over-leveled Instakill of the Mozang Tribe of Sixfold Planet, earning 10 million Points and a random S-rank Prop reward.'
"What the hell?"
The Mozang Tribe of Sixfold Planet was exterminated, and by him?
Since when was he so awesome, capable of wiping out a Sixfold Planet clan, and doing it with an Instakill?
An Instakill, by definition, has to be within three seconds—an Instakill extermination is hundreds of millions of times harder than a regular extinction!
