He had always steered clear of the Sixfold Planet, knowing his own limits. The Sixfold Planet was not something he could afford to provoke, but now it's gone just like that?
He quickly came to a realization, though.
With a complex expression, he turned to look towards a distant depression in the ground.
He seemed to recall something Wang Zhiping said about his clan's players sharing a common Life Value, claiming they would never die, for any damage incurred would be distributed among all members.
Sharing his nearly 20,000 Furies of the Sea of Corpses?
They were really good at sharing.
Shared with a generous spirit indeed. He had exterminated several clans before, but this instance had left him the most bewildered.
Did the Mozang Tribe know they had such a cursed individual who took the entire tribe down with him?

chapters.title: Chapter 520 356 "Wonder Name: Tomb of the Gods.
chapters.content:
Originally, in a map with the Sea of Mummies Wonder, an attack by the Fury of the Sea of Corpses hitting a player would result in fatal damage unless it was a freak like Jiang Chenglu.
Nearly 20,000 Fury of the Sea of Corpses attacks raining down on a single player.
The damage would be catastrophic.
The overflow damage could fill several ID numbers.
But coincidentally, Wang Zhiping's race just happened to have an ability to share damage, allowing him to perfectly distribute this excess damage.
Nearly 20,000 Fury of the Sea of Corpses, or in other words, 2 trillion damage, spread across more than ten million players meant that each player had to endure more than 200,000 damage.
Players from Sixfold Planet were strong.
But they weren't so strong that every player had a title or prop that could increase their Life Value, nor was he clear about what should happen if the Mozang Tribe player had some kind of death-immunity skills or props backing him up.
Would the damage still be equally distributed?
He just didn't have enough information.
But he knew one thing for certain, the Mozang Tribe player had mysteriously vanished.
"..."
Chen Yi silently lit a cigarette and took a deep drag before he couldn't help but mutter, "The world really is full of uncertainties."
Then he looked up at Jiang Chenglu standing opposite him. "Senior Jiang Chenglu, I'm ready."
He didn't immediately check the rewards for wiping out the Mozang Tribe. Now was not the time for that; the most important thing was to deal with the situation at hand. The incident with the Mozang Tribe made him feel even more intimidated by Jiang Chenglu's power.
The Mozang Tribe!
A Sixfold Planet, an entire race that couldn't withstand nearly 20,000 Fury of the Sea of Corpses. In some ways, this meant that the combined Life Value of the entire race from Sixfold Planet didn't even reach 2 trillion!
Meanwhile, Jiang Chenglu alone had a Life Value of 37 trillion!
That's absurd. Can such a being really be killed?
In the entire ascension game, was there anyone who could kill Jiang Chenglu?
In his lifetime, he doubted he'd ever attain a Life Value of 37 trillion. To get to that number, he would have to kill 37 trillion players, which was a joke... Where would he even find that many players to kill?
And if there really were that many players for you to kill, but you started to crazily slaughter players from all the planets, do you think the players from those other planets wouldn't band together to resist you?
"Hmm."
After a long silence, Jiang Chenglu finally looked up at Chen Yi. "Let's begin."
"Alright."
Chen Yi hesitated for a moment before deciding to not ask his questions. He raised the prop in his hand, Zigong, and looked sincerely at Jiang Chenglu with a hoarse voice, "Senior, get ready, here I come."
He had wanted to ask about the ascension game.
For instance, why was a being as powerful as the senior still constrained by rules, and why did the senior's quest chain suddenly encounter unexpected events, was it targeted by the ascension game?
Or is Ninefold Planet truly the final station of the ascension game?
So many questions.
He didn't voice them. One reason was that he felt he was not in a position to solve the senior's troubles, and the other was that he dared not speak recklessly and disturb the existing balance. Most importantly, he felt that these were things he ought not to ask or know.
If he knew, it might only lead to greater confusion and predicaments.
Some things you come to know naturally when you reach a certain position.
Knowing them before reaching that position serves no purpose.
Chen Yi took a deep breath, remaining silent, and he raised his hand, holding the Zigong prop shaped like a cane, with a half-burnt cigarette between his lips, his expression serious as he activated the prop in an instant.
The next second—
A full 700,000 Fury of the Sea of Corpses, like ferocious dragons roaring competitively, burst forth from his staff, filling the entire forest canopy. Countless crimson beams of light occupied Chen Yi's entire field of vision.
In an instant, they enveloped Jiang Chenglu!
Then, in the blink of an eye, a multitude of prompt sounds exploded in Chen Yi's ears like firecrackers.
At the same time, everything around the map began to fade into illusion.
The map was ending.
The remaining players, unbeknownst to when, had all died off, leaving him as the last surviving player on the map.
As more and more white light filled the entire map, Chen Yi blinked, and when he opened his eyes again, he found himself on the familiar rooftop, surrounded by the extremely excited Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others.
In his hand, he was holding something that looked like a photo album, which seemed to be the Wonder Atlas.
"Awesome!!! Yi, you're awesome!!!"
Sword Without End, who was wearing a green robe he hadn't worn in a long time, carried Three-Foot Qingfeng on his back. His demeanor was somewhat excited and surging as he gestured with both hands. "Yi, you've made a name for yourself today, you're number one, Yi, you are the first!!!"
"And Jiang Chenglu has been stepped on by you!!!"
"Isn't that the truth."
Tuberculosis Rabbit trembled as he held up the Wonder Atlas, excitedly bringing it closer to Chen Yi. "Yi, look quickly, you're number one on the Wonder list, Yi, and Jiang Chenglu has dropped to second!"
Even Jiaye and Tie Chui were standing to the side, their eyes brimming with excitement and pride.
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi, who hadn't yet grasped the situation, looked at the Wonder Atlas in Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand and saw that the first place ranking had changed from the Tomb of the Gods to a new Wonder—

chapters.title: Chapter 521 356 "Wonder: Tomb of the Gods." _2
chapters.content:
"The Tomb of the Gods!"
In the scene.
Within a vast forest lay a vast wasteland that stretched for dozens of miles, the ground swarming with a sea of mummies.
And the photograph captured Yi, holding aloft an item like a staff in his hand, the "Zigong" S-Rank prop.
Nearly a million scarlet beams, fierce as red dragons, occupied over half of the frame, engulfing Jiang Chenglu, who stood still with a broad sword on his back!
In this frame.
Chen Yi had a serious expression, as if facing a great enemy, while Jiang Chenglu was calmly looking down at the dirt at his feet, seemingly lost in thought.
The camera angle, as if from high above at an oblique angle, made the photograph appear immensely grand and spectacular!
On the right side of the photo in the Wonder Atlas, there was a caption.
'Wonder Name': The Tomb of the Gods.
'Wonder Ranking': 1st place.
'Wonder Effects': This wonder has been permanently replicated on the map 'Children of the Forest', where any player who witnesses it will be plagued by nightmares every night, unable to find peace for the rest of their lives.
'Wonder Origin': The player who once created the 1st wonder, the Tomb of Slaying Gods, Jiang Chenglu, was instantly killed and formed by Chen Yi, a player of the human race from Blue Star, Star System 3 of the Annihilation Starfield.
'Wonder Location': Upgraded game, the 'Children of the Forest' map with no level requirements.
'Wonder Creator': Chen Yi.
"..."
At that moment, Chen Yi also noticed the flurry of prompt sounds clamoring in his ears.
'Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for instant killing Jiang Chenglu, the player who created the first wonder of the Ninefold Planet, as a novice player. This wonder has now been selected as one of the 108 wonders of the upgraded game and is ranked first!'
'As a reward: Wonder Atlas*1.'
'Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for instant killing Jiang Chenglu, a player of the Mo Clan from the Ninefold Planet in Star System 17 of the Deity Starfield, as a novice. This action has been recorded into the annals of the upgraded game, and congratulations to player Chen Yi for once again capturing a milestone in the upgraded game!'
'Reward: 10 million Points, S-rank prop admission ticket*1.'
'...'
...
At the same time—
A public announcement echoed out of nowhere over the skies of the Annihilation Starfield!
'Ding, announcement throughout the whole Annihilation Starfield!'
'The planets covered by this announcement include the following: Logitech Star, Good Cat Star, Black Star, Turtle Star, Zhiwa Star, Egglet Star... totaling 853 planets.'
'From Star System 3 of the Annihilation Starfield, Chen Yi, a player of the Blue Star Race from the Zerofold Planet, instantly killed Jiang Chenglu, a player from the Ninefold Planet!'
'This action has shocked countless players; it has been recorded into the annals of the upgraded game where it will forever leave his name and mark, and he will receive a statue in the upgraded game's Hall of Honor to represent this event.'
'And he has seized an upgraded game milestone!'
'Milestone name: Solo Deicide!'
'Conditions to Achieve: The first player as a novice to single-handedly kill a player from the Ninefold Planet.'
'Let's congratulate Chen Yi for becoming the first player in the history of the upgraded game to achieve this milestone.'
'And for earning the Stellar Rank title, "Godslayer"!'
This announcement vibrated through the Annihilation Starfield, which had been silent for a long time.
Countless players looked up, somewhat bewildered, at the sky above. In the sky over the Annihilation Starfield, there were already two giant Monuments visible from any corner of the Annihilation Starfield.
And now.
A new Monument was slowly rising.
Massive and pitch-black, the imposing facade of the Monument, the lettering a brilliant scarlet.
The scarlet letters seemed to flow, and the Monument was surrounded by a shiny aura, making it extremely eye-catching.
One line was engraved on the Monument in prominent lettering.
'Annihilation Starfield Continent Monument!'
'Monument name': Solo Deicide.
'Conditions to Achieve': The first novice player to single-handedly kill a player from the Ninefold Planet.
'Owner': Chen Yi.
'Runner-Up Project Team': Snow Sea Project Team.
'Affiliated Project Team': Annihilation Starfield Project Team.
'The Runner-Up Project Team is awarded one S-rank prop with free use rights, all members are awarded 100 Achievement Points, and one exemption from punishment privilege.'
"The affiliated project team is awarded 100 Achievement Points, all members are awarded 50 Points, and granted promotion qualifications valid for ten years, with one chance to avoid punishment."
"..."
"..."
"..."
At the moment this announcement echoed through the Annihilation Starfield, countless people fell silent.
For a moment, it was as if everyone had lost the ability to speak.
...
On Blue Star, within the high-altitude office of the Snow Sea Project Team, Jin Buhuan, who was still pondering what to have for dinner tonight, was stunned when the announcement suddenly popped up.
He stood bewildered on the spot.
After disbelieving for quite some time,
he finally confirmed that Chen Yi had, unbeknownst to him, secured another game Monument for leveling up!
Without their project team having done anything, they had once again been awarded an S-class freedom privilege, 100 Points for each member, and one chance to avoid punishment.
This motherfucker...
Damn, as the old generation said, 'hard work leads to wealth' is all bullshit. Before meeting Chen Yi, their project team had worked so hard for so long, they had been also-rans on so many planets, all for nothing.
After encountering Chen Yi, without doing anything, they were drowning in rewards!
In the face of choices, effort doesn't count for shit!
Jin Buhuan, who slowly recovered from his shock, swallowed the saliva in his mouth and, with an excited and thrilled expression, jumped onto the desk, grabbed a water cup nearby, and smashed it to the ground.
"Bang!"
Accompanied by the sound of the shattering cup, an extremely excited roar echoed through the office as all the staff watched excitedly.
"Get me the champagne, we're having a damn celebration banquet tonight!"
"Fuck, this is insane!"
...
Li Yi, who was lying inside his own palace, turned to Wang Qi beside him with a grateful expression and said, "Brother, I owe you big time for the last time. I was a bit tight on cash then, but now that things are a bit better, I've had finance transfer the travel expenses and your fee."
The cost of interstellar teleportation isn't small, especially for so many people.
"It's nothing."
Wang Qi, somewhat distracted, shook his head: "I had come prepared to loot your inheritance if your race got annihilated. I didn't expect you to survive, kind of a wasted trip."
"..."
Li Yi, about to say something but struck speechless, suddenly paused, gazing at his personal panel with some astonishment at the system prompt: "Another new Monument for leveling up in the game has been achieved, there's quite a few rising players lately."
"Let me see."
"Uh..."
Li Yi fell silent with a blank expression. The one who obtained the Monument was Chen Yi, with the Conditions to Achieve being the killing of a Ninefold Planet player as a new player.
"Is that my Yi?"
Wang Qi first paused, then couldn't help but grin: "Awesome, Yi can already take on the Ninefold? That's fucking outrageous, has Yi's strength become so exaggerated?"
"..."
"Don't know."
Li Yi looked at the system prompt with bewilderment, unable to imagine how Chen Yi had managed to kill a Ninefold Planet player. Logically, a player from a Ninefold Planet should be an invincible existence for a new player.
Unless they happened to encounter a dying Ninefold player?
That might be possible.
"Hm?"
Just then, Li Yi noticed the Lisu Tribal Chief nearby, drenched in sweat, kneeling on the ground, trembling violently, and frowned, "What's happening to you? You're a tribal chief; how can you be like this at a time like this?"
"I..."
The Lisu Tribal Chief was full of fear, unable to utter a single word, even his teeth were chattering.
He wanted to contact Wang Zhiping, the Sixfold Planet player who promised to take care of Chen Yi.
But as he was about to reach out to Wang Zhiping, the chat panel showed Wang Zhiping's avatar fading to black, the system informing him that Wang Zhiping had permanently died, and his race was annihilated, with no possibility of contact, suggesting to delete the friend.
Where Wang Zhiping went, he knew very well.
But he never expected Wang Zhiping to die, let alone his Mozang Tribe to be annihilated.
If a Sixfold Planet could vanish into obscurity just like that, could his Threefold Planet hold on?

chapters.title: Chapter 522 357: "Congratulations to the Mo Clan on Advancing to the Tenfold Planet!
chapters.content:
"No... nothing's wrong?"
The Lisu Tribe forcefully suppressed the trembling in their hearts, praying for one thing—that Wang Zhiping wouldn't rat them out before he died.
Chen Yi probably still didn't know that they, the Lisu Tribe, challenged him to a duel just to mess with him.
As long as Chen Yi didn't know about this, as long as they gave him enough compensation, they should be able to resolve the matter.
Then, he immediately got up, his expression serious as he suppressed the fear in his heart and looked towards Li Yi, "Former Leader Li, I've reconsidered the whole duel thing with Yi, and suddenly feel it's somewhat inappropriate."
"We're willing to offer direct compensation."
"One... fifty million Points!!!"
The Lisu Tribal Chief, somewhat painfully, raised five fingers and said through gritted teeth, "As long as Yi is willing to let us off the hook, the fifty million Points will be sent immediately!!"
"Oh, not dueling anymore?"
Li Yi looked at the Lisu Tribal Chief with a half-smile, then earnestly said, "You see, if you had made this decision earlier, it would've been much better. I'll relay your message, but I can't make any guarantees, after all, it's Yi who has the final say."
He, of course, knew why the Lisu Tribal Chief suddenly chickened out.
If Yi could kill players from the Ninefold Planet, would the Lisu Tribe dare to jump out?
Still challenging him to a duel?
Do you think the strongest player of the Lisu Tribe could be stronger than the players from the Ninefold Planet?
And since he learned that Yi had killed players from the Ninefold Planet, he naturally started referring to Chen Yi as Yi.
It's not disgraceful.
"Oh right."
Suddenly remembering something, Li Yi looked towards his subordinate, "Go check how strong this Jiang Chenglu was in the Ninefold Planet."
"Understood!"
Jiang Chenglu? Never heard of him—the name was very unfamiliar.
But that was normal.
After all, he had never heard of any player's name from the Ninefold Planet, as he had no way of coming into contact with players from there.
...
The person in charge of the Annihilation Starfield Project Team looked at the notice in front of him, sighed with a complex expression, and said, "It's all fate."
"I didn't do anything and got another set of points. It's really annoying."
"Accidentally becoming the Starfield with three monuments, how irritating."
"What should I do? I had intended to keep a low profile."
What a coincidence it was.
After the map at 'Pharaoh's Tomb' ended, all of the Feng Family's points were used to pay Chen Yi the extra map Points rewards, plunging them into the negatives. The cost of what that entailed didn't need to be explained.
The game issued a direct order, within the stipulated time, to repay all the points owed to the game, or the whole Feng Family would stay in the depths of hell.
The Feng Family used all their connections, including contacting employees from other Starfield project teams.
In the end, they were still 700 points short of the amount they needed to borrow.
They asked them, but they didn't lend.
The Feng Family was too good at causing trouble, so they naturally sided with Chen Yi. But they couldn't act against the Feng Family—their petty actions could only be observed, and they couldn't do anything about it. Naturally, they wouldn't help the Feng Family then, just watching the entire Feng Family fall into hell.
Interestingly enough.
Ten minutes before Chen Yi claimed the 'Lone Deicide' monument, the Feng Family's stipulated time just expired, and they were cast down to hell.
Just missing it by those ten minutes.
If only they had lasted ten more minutes, everyone from their Annihilation Starfield Project Team, including the Feng Family, would have received a reward of 50 points each. With so many members in the Feng Family, they could easily make up for the 700-point gap, and they would have even had extra points to save.
Thereby escaping this disaster.
But as luck would have it, they fell short by just those ten minutes. As the sun was about to rise, the Feng Family forever closed their eyes.
If Chen Yi had claimed that title just ten minutes earlier, the Feng Family would have been brought back to life.
It must be said, in the mysterious workings of fate, connections are profoundly indescribable!
...
"Three monuments now."
Listening to the announcements echoing around him, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but remark, "Seems like Annihilation Starfield will become the first Starfield in the game to have four monuments."
"Isn't it just three?"
"Did you forget about mine, the one for enhancing the entire Air Food Series Props to Ultimate Props?"
"..."
Sword Without End was momentarily speechless, "Yours is just expected, and what's so difficult about that? How could that possibly warrant a monument?"
"What's so difficult?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit laughed bitterly in anger, "Do you know how many Zenith Radiance it takes to enhance a complete set of Air Food Series Props to Ultimate Props? A total of 289 Zenith Radiance. Which player in the Novice Period could gather up 289 Zenith Radiance?"
"And that's not even considered difficult."
"But the problem is, according to the current progress, you can't collect 289 Zenith Radiance either."
"You don't know shit, Lord Rabbit has his own brilliant plan."
"Oh right—"
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly thought of something, turned his head to look at Chen Yi nearby, "Yi, you haven't told us how you managed to kill that Jiang Chenglu?"
"Wasn't Jiang Chenglu the self-proclaimed first creator of the Wonder? I thought he was going to be tough, but he turned out to be easy to kill."
"..."
Chen Yi didn't respond, instead frowning as he looked at the system announcements popping up in front of him.
There were indeed too many announcements, one after another, impossible to keep up with.
'Ding, congratulations to player for surviving as the last player in the 'Children of the Forest' map, receiving the S-rank prop 'Blood Emperor'.'

chapters.title: Chapter 523 357: "Congratulations to the Mo Clan on Advancing to the Tenfold Planet!"_2
chapters.content:
The map was cleared, successfully rewarding an S-level prop.
This was normal.
It was his original purpose for entering this map, but upon seeing that Jiang Chenglu was also on this map, his purpose instantly shifted from obtaining an S-level prop to struggling to stay alive.
Unexpectedly, after a series of accidents and mistakes, he still managed to complete the task.
And at this point—
All announcements had been read, and now it was time to sort out the rewards.
The total gains from this map were.
An S-level prop 'Longevity as the Southern Mountains' added 11.28 million life value, 20 million points, random S-level prop given by the Mozang Tribe of the Sixfold Planet.
The Gleaming Star level title 'Instakill Clan', the Stellar Rank title 'Deicide'.
And another S-level prop admission ticket was given, plus the one he hadn't used, he now had a total of 2 S-level prop admission tickets.
Oh, and he also got another 'Wonder Atlas'.
"..."
After tallying up all of his gains from this time, Chen Yi stood in place with a strange expression on his face without speaking. He had gained much more than he had anticipated. His expected gains had originally been just one S-level prop, but he ended up receiving a whole bunch more after that.
What's this called?
This is called being the child of good fortune!
Chen Yi then closed his personal panel and looked over at Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was sitting next to a stone table, lighting a cigarette amidst the swirling smoke. He gently patted the table.
"There's a long story to tell at this point."
"The moment the map began, I was..."
...
Ten minutes later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyebrows slightly furrowed as he thought for a while before speaking, "Yi, are you saying that Jiang Chenglu actively sought his own death? To complete some task?"
"Yeah."
Chen Yi nodded lightly, "That Jiang Chenglu had a task chain with the final link requiring him to be killed by a new player, which is why he sought me out."
"How odd."
Sword Without End also seemed puzzled, leaning back in his chair, "Jiang Chenglu is, after all, one of the strongest players of the Ninefold Planet, almost the strongest player in the level-up game. Why would he go to such lengths just to complete a task chain?"
"Even if the reward for that task chain is a great prop, Jiang Chenglu shouldn't be lacking, right?"
"That's not clear."
Chen Yi shook his head, just as he was about to say something else, he suddenly heard a voice as if coming from the sky, accompanied by thunderous rumbling, resonating in every player's ears.
'Ding, an announcement for all players in the level-up game!!!'
'Let us congratulate, player Jiang Chenglu of the Mo Clan from Desert Star of the Ninefold Planet in the 17th star system of the Deity Starfield, for leading his planet to become the first and only Tenfold Planet in the level-up game!!!'
'This is the grandest achievement in the history of the level-up game, and a unique milestone!'
'Award to player Jiang Chenglu the title 'The Only God', a random MAX prop*1, random XL prop*10, random MAX skill*1, random XL skill*10, 100 billion points, the unique MAX prop 'Devouring Demon Wings', the unique MAX vehicle 'Gods and Demons Tomb', and the unique pass 'Gods and Demons Pass'.'
'All players of Desert Star will receive 10 million points, a random L prop*1, a random L skill*1, and the permanent title 'Pioneers of the Tenfold Planet'.'
'Furthermore, all players of Desert Star will follow Jiang Chenglu's lead to depart from the level-up game and delve into the depths of the universe to participate in the 'Life-and-Death Competition'!'
'Let us congratulate Jiang Chenglu as he returns in triumph!!!'
"..."
"..."
The entire level-up game, countless players as if they'd hit the pause button, suddenly fell into silence.
Utter silence.
This was the first time for all players to see an announcement for the entire level-up game!
Generally speaking, a regional announcement is already the limit for many players, as having an announcement made just for you, even if it's only a regional one, is quite strong. But a global announcement is something that only top players can achieve.
Like a star system announcement, a whole starfield announcement, that's on a whole different level of awesome!
As for Chen Yi, who triggered a Whole Starfield announcement, one might see none for years.
And someone like Jiang Chenglu, who triggered an announcement for the entire level-up game, can be said to be the first in the history of the level-up game, and maybe also the last.
A Tenfold Planet?! That's terrifying.
"..."
After keeping stiff for quite some time, Tuberculosis Rabbit swallowed hard, his body slightly tremoring as he said, "I finally understand why that Jiang Chenglu would go through so much trouble for a task chain."
```
"Could that quest chain be the one for ascending to the Tenfold Planet?"
"Wasn't the limit of this upgrade game supposed to be Ninefold Planet? How can we advance to the Tenfold Planet? And what does it mean to leave the upgrade game for that 'life and death match' after ascending to the Tenfold Planet?"
"Motherfucker..."
"We've actually come into contact with such a high-level existence?"
At this moment, Chen Yi was also somewhat stunned. He knew full well how powerful Jiang Chenglu was—even if Jiang Chenglu had removed all his defenses, it would take Chen Yi the use of the "Zigong" prop, triggering over 700,000 Fury of the Sea of Corpses just to blast him to death.
If Jiang Chenglu hadn't disarmed all his defenses, Chen Yi guessed that even if he just stood there, it would be impossible for him to kill him.
MAX prop?
What the hell level is that? He had never heard of it before. He had only heard of L-level props above SSS-level ones, he'd never ever heard of any MAX props.
If you don't understand, just ask—a good habit.
He activated the Requesting the Mandate of Heaven skill, which he hadn't used in a long time, ready to inquire with the Snow Sea Project Team about what rank MAX belonged to.
The other side responded quickly.
Above L-level props, there are XL and XXL-level props.
But XXL-level props are still not the end; above them, there are M-level props, above M is MX-level props, and above MX is MAX-level props.
MAX-level props are the strongest props in the upgrade game.
Any single MAX-level prop nearly possesses the same power as deities. It's no exaggeration to say they're like living deities, even suggesting that deities' power is inferior to MAX props wouldn't be an exaggeration, especially according to what the Snow Sea Project Team said.
To create one MAX-level prop, at least three deities must be consumed.
"..."
Chen Yi stood in silence, his face expressionless, not saying a word. He had heard from the White Phoenix Clan that props might be created by consuming the power of deities, but he had never imagined a single MAX prop would require the consumption of three deities.
Are they treating deities like cabbages?
His highest-level prop currently was an SSS-level one, and that Jiang Chenglu's MAX prop just crushed his by several grades. He finally understood why even with Jiang Chenglu just standing there, he couldn't penetrate his defenses.
Breaking through those defenses would be freaking miraculous!
His S-level props are already absurdly powerful, like Longevity as the Southern Mountains, which can stack Life Value infinitely. What kind of effect could a MAX-level prop have? It's not something crazy like snapping a finger and randomly killing off half of the upgrade game's players, is it?
Thanos living a second life?
Chen Yi took a deep breath, slowly suppressing the shock in his heart, and stopped thinking. If he thought about it any more, his Dao heart would shatter.
No matter how strong other people become.
It has nothing to do with him.
Building up his own strength step by step is the right path.
...
"Come back."
Inside the palace, Li Yi, with an expressionless face, called back the subordinate he had sent to investigate who Jiang Chenglu was. After a silent pause, he turned his head to look at Wang Qi, "Qi, I don't think I have offened Sir Yi in our daily interactions, have I?"
"Sir Yi?"
Wang Qi looked at Li Yi somewhat bizarrely, "How come your way of addressing him has changed three times in such a short period? From Chen Yi to Yi and now to Sir Yi?"
"It's nothing. Just feel it rolls off the tongue better like this."
"Do you really think it sounds better?"
"It does."
Li Yi nodded earnestly, his face serious. What was the need to investigate Jiang Chenglu? Was there still a need for investigation? The guy had already ascended to the Tenfold Planet, effectively becoming a god. The whole upgrade game knew about it, investigation be damned!
And such an incredible quest had just been taken down by Chen Yi.
Heh heh heh.
"Suddenly, I feel that the title 'Sir Yi' isn't quite smooth. What do you think about 'Grand Sir Yi'?"
"Or, 'Ancestor Yi'?"
"..."
Wang Qi looked at Li Yi with some speechlessness and rolled his eyes, "I think Yi is good enough. No matter how strong Chen Yi is, he's still our friend. Why are you so scared?"
"You don't understand. When the difference in status and identity is too great, you can't be friends anymore."
"I'll go make a statement in Club 33."
"Uh..."
Upon seeing the chat group of Club 33, Li Yi suddenly froze in disbelief, and unable to help it, he cursed, "Fuck, isn't this just shamelessly over the top?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 524 358: The New Generation Perpetual Motion Machine, Development Complete.
chapters.content:
In the chat group of Club 33, Elder Qian, who usually kept a low profile and didn't speak much in the group, was indeed the founder of Club 33. He was the only player from the Sixfold Planet and also the one with the deepest foundation in the group.
At this time, he had already posted several messages in a row.
They were from different timelines.
The first message was.
Elder Qian: "Young Brother Chen Yi, your strength has been increasing rapidly recently. The Mozang Tribe of the Sixfold Planet has also been a long-established tribe, and they have been recklessly dominating for a long time with the ability to share Life Value among all players within the race. I didn't expect them to fall into your hands, Chen Yi."
"When you have time, we should communicate more."
Well, this first message, looking at the time, seems to be when Chen Yi had just performed an Instant Kill on a player from the Mozang Tribe of the Sixfold Planet.
Upon receiving this message.
The usually aloof Elder Qian also came out, seeming like a junior approved by a senior, ready to have a chat with Chen Yi, planning on areas where they might mutually benefit each other.
And the second message was.
Elder Qian: "Sir Chen, I pay my respects to you. I didn't expect Sir Chen to be capable of killing players from the Ninefold Planet. I, the junior Qian, overstepped just now. I hope Sir Chen would not take offense."
"Should you ever visit my territory, I would make sure to take good care of you."
Well, at this point, the news had arrived that Chen Yi had slain Jiang Chenglu, a player from the Ninefold Planet, and achieved another milestone.
The third message was.
Elder Qian: "Ancestor Chen, feel free to command me for anything in the future. I won't bother Ancestor Chen any longer."
This is when the promotion of Jiang Chenglu to the Tenfold Planet was received.
"Look at this, look at this!!!"
Li Yi, somewhat in a fury, pointed at the chat group and complained to Wang Qi beside him: "Elder Qian usually acts so cool and aloof, he never spoke in the group when Yi joined, not even a blip, he just plays it mysterious and stable."
"And now?"
"He's turned into a total fawning dog. An ancestor indeed, why don't you claim to be the most ancient one, huh!!"
"This is just too much!!"
Then, cursing all the while, he composed a message and sent it to the group chat.
Li Yi: "Dad Yi, do you remember me? I'm Little Li who just met you recently."
"..."
Wang Qi was somewhat speechless and rolled his eyes at Li Yi: "You guys are too opportunistic. Yi just left you not too long ago, and he even sent you a message recently, how could he possibly forget you."
Then he looked at the chat group where various people who used to lurk without chatting were now popping up to greet Yi.
The nicknames were a medley of creativity.
There were those calling him Yi God, Sir Yi, Ancestor Chen, and even Grand Ancestor Yi.
In short, there was a wide variety of them.
"The world is going downhill!"
He sighed deeply and shook his head, helplessly expressing his bafflement at this group of people, and then he also composed a message to send to the group.
Wang Qi: "Mr. Chen, how have you been lately?"
Afterward, he looked at his own message with satisfaction. He had specifically researched the cultural background of Blue Star; the term 'Mr.' was a form of address that encapsulated the greatest respect for a man or woman.
Isn't this more elegant than those titles like Dad Yi?
...
Meanwhile—
Chen Yi was frowning as he looked at a system notification in front of him.
To be exact, it wasn't a system notification; it would be more accurate to call it a player's message.
Jiang Chenglu of the Mo Clan: "You and I must be fated. With your potential, advancing to the Tenfold Planet shouldn't be too difficult as long as you don't meet an early demise."
"Here's a piece of advice for you."
"Ignore everything else and focus all your efforts on reaching the Tenfold Planet."
"Only by becoming a Tenfold Planet and surviving the 'Life and Death Contest' in the depths of the universe can this nightmare come to an end, and that is a world everyone yearns for."
It was just a few short lines.
You could tell that Jiang Chenglu must know something about joining the Life and Death Contest somewhere deep in the universe after becoming a Tenfold Planet player, and it seems like if you survive that contest, everything will return to calm, right?
"..."
Chen Yi took a deep breath and remained silent, without saying anything. The Tenfold Planet was too far away from him; he hadn't even finished his Novice Period yet.
He had once roughly estimated the strength of Blue Star.
Blue Star's strength should be roughly comparable to that of a Threefold Planet, and of course, he alone accounted for ninety percent of that strength. With him around, they should at least be able to ensure a sure pass to the Threefold.
As for the advancement tasks beyond the Threefold, they were likely to be a bit harder.
It was not something he could pull through on his own.
There was still half a year until the end of the Novice Period.
In this half year, his strength would probably increase a bit more.
He shook his head, no longer thinking about these matters but instead started to carefully look over all of his gains.
The first was 20 million Points; there wasn't much to look at there, it went straight into his account, bringing him nearly 470 million in total, which was peak level.
The inadvertent extermination of the Mozang Tribe had added 11.28 million to his Life Value, bringing his Life Value to 143.98 million.
This amount of life was not low at all but, of course, it was nothing compared to Jiang Chenglu.
After looking through these less important things, Chen Yi seriously turned his attention to the random S-grade Prop he received for the Instant Kill of the Sixfold Planet Mozang Tribe player.

chapters.title: Chapter 525 358: The New Generation Perpetual Motion Machine, Development Complete._2
chapters.content:
This was his second S-class item obtained.
He had to take it extremely seriously!
"Item Name": Only One Sword.
"Item Level": S-class.
"Item Effect": When you equip this item, you will be able to activate 18 sword moves, each with immense power. However, each sword move can only be used once and cannot be replicated.
"Item Introduction": "One sword in hand, one thought in heart."
"This item..."
Chen Yi's brows slightly furrowed as he looked at the panel before him. It didn't seem quite fitting for an S-class item, a purely offensive item that was only one-time use. After 18 attacks, it would become a piece of scrap metal.
It seemed more suitable for Sword Without End.
He subconsciously looked up at Sword Without End standing nearby, only to realize that at some point Sword Without End had moved close to him, staring eagerly at him with eyes full of hope and pleading.
"..."
"What are you doing?"
"Nothing much, just suddenly remembered something. Yi, do you know I have a prop that can replicate all sword moves?"
"Even this one?"
"Should include it."
"Then what's there to talk about."
Chen Yi shook his head with a slight speechlessness and handed the miniature sword in his hand to Sword Without End: "Here you go, it's yours."
"Thank you, Yi!!!"
Sword Without End excitedly received the item and, after bowing deeply, ran off to a distance, fondly playing with it.
"..."
Seeing this, Chen Yi shook his head helplessly.
Sword Without End had been through quite a few hellish experiences for him lately. Naturally, he wouldn't hesitate to give him an item suited for Sword Without End, which should greatly enhance his battle power.
This way, returning from hell should be easier for Sword Without End.
Speaking of which, it was like an indirect enhancement of the strength of their team.
Only then did he turn to look at the S-class item that was the reward for surviving the map of "Children of the Forest."
"Item Name": Blood Emperor.
"Item Level": S-class.
"Item Effect": When the player is injured, the blood that flows out can be stored in this bracelet as life value data. Upon activating the item, the stored life values will instantly be fed back to the player until their health is fully restored.
Moreover, you can use the stored blood to activate a blood barrier.
Any player whose life value is below 10% of the stored blood, or whose life value is data-based, will not be able to pass through the blood barrier.
The size of the blood barrier depends on the stored life value and can last up to 24 hours, not consuming any stored life value.
There is no upper limit to the stored life values in the item.
"Item Restriction": Players with non-digitalized life value cannot use this item.
"Item Introduction": "Your personal blood bank, theoretically, this item is more suitable for females."
"..."
Chen Yi looked at the item panel before him and slightly arched his eyebrows. The item effect sounded complicated, but was actually easy to understand— it was like a personal blood pack that could instantly restore health.
But, it required prior storage.
That is, during non-combat times, he would need to cut himself, let the blood flow, and store life values in the bracelet-like "Blood Emperor". In battle, activating the item could instantly restore health.
It was a weakened version of the "Giant Heavy Armor" profession.
The Giant Heavy Armor profession does not require any storage, directly regenerating health by a percentage every second, whereas the "Blood Emperor" requires prior storage but the advantage is the ability to fully restore health instantly.
Planning to keep this item in his backpack for now, he had decided to wait until after checking the other title rewards before getting ready to store a certain amount of life value in this item.
There were two more title rewards to look at.
"Title Name": Instakill Clan.
"Title Level": Gleaming Star Level.
"Title Effect": Upon activating this title, you will become incomparably fast. Your running speed will be greatly enhanced, with a top speed of nearly 70 Mach. In this state, your body will be semi-transparent.
While your body will not disintegrate at high speed, walls, mountains, and other obstacles cannot stop you, and you can easily pass through them.
```
"Title Restriction": Activated once, enters a 24-hour cooldown, and this status can last up to 3 minutes. After the status ends, the player will be completely weakened and paralyzed on the ground for a full day.
"Title Introduction": "I am like the wind."
"Phew..."
Chen Yi looked at the panel with a slightly odd expression. The speed was certainly fast enough, at 70 Mach. With a few flails of his arms in the air, he could have flown right out of Blue Star.
It was even faster than the speed of his Christmas sleigh.
In terms of speed, this title was definitely the fastest one he had.
But he hadn't yet thought of what he would need such speed for.
He decided to put it on anyway.
As for the side effects of this title, he could completely ignore them. With "Forever Pure," the negative effects didn't affect him at all.
"Title Name": Deicide.
"Title Level": Stellar Rank.
"Title Effect": When you wear this title, for every player within a hundred li radius who harbors hostility towards you, you will recover 0.001% of your Life Value.
"Title Restriction": Only effective against players.
"Title Introduction": "The more enemies I have, the stronger I become."
A simple sentence of just five words.
This was his third Stellar Rank title, and this title had the shortest word count and a straightforward effect.
With just a thousand players around him harboring hostility, he would recover 1% of his Life Value every second.
So, if there were 100,000 players who were hostile to him, could he recover 100% of his Life Value every second?
"..."
A light glinted in Chen Yi's eyes as he nodded thoughtfully. This sounded much more impressive than the "Giant Heavy Armor" class.
...
October 16, four o'clock in the afternoon.
By now, it had been about ten or so hours since Chen Yi left the map.
Today's Yancheng was exceptionally lively.
A large number of players, rallied by Tuberculosis Rabbit, were gathered around the vicinity of the Garden District where Chen Yi was.
On the rooftop, there were only Jiaye and Chen Yi.
Chen Yi was lying on an ordinary beach chair, eyes closed, savoring a peaceful sunbath.
But on the femoral artery of his thigh, there were two deep cuts from which copious amounts of blood were endlessly gushing out. Before the blood could hit the ground, however, it was absorbed by the bracelet on Chen Yi's arm, "Blood Emperor."
As the blood kept flowing.
The Life Value stored in the "Blood Emperor" on Chen Yi's wrist was also increasing. It was his concealed power reserve for the times when he might be in trouble alone, without any hostile players around to activate the healing effect of "Deicide."
But here on Blue Star.
Finding players with hostility towards him, honestly, was quite difficult.
After so many events, Chen Yi had already become a pillar of spirit for Blue Star, symbolizing the planet. At this point, finding a Blue Star player who harbored hostility towards Chen Yi.
It wasn't that there weren't any.
But they were indeed hard to find, after all, no one would admit to this. It was tantamount to seeking death.
So...
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End brought together tens of thousands of people near the Garden District, and transported all the psychotherapists from several cities back via sled. Some props that could hypnotize the mind were also arranged.
They began to hypnotize these tens of thousands of players.
Chen Yi killed your families, you should hate Chen Yi!
And then.
Chen Yi's "Deicide" title began to activate, and the healing per second completely covered the blood loss and had plenty to spare. From then on—
The new generation of perpetual motion machine was complete.
Who says there are no perpetual machines in this world?
Until he had stored up ten billion Life Value in the "Blood Emperor," Chen Yi planned to go nowhere and just lie here.
The world was becoming more dangerous. The maps "Pharaoh's Tomb" and "Children of the Forest" had scared him twice in a row, nearly sending him off to hell to be a janitor twice. This forced him to become even more cautious.
His current mechanisms for survival were far from enough. He needed more!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 526 359: "The Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Gods, the Creator Tie Chui.
chapters.content:
Being in a state of significant blood loss for a long time was not a big deal for Chen Yi, but the sensation of continuously bleeding, especially from a major artery, was indeed strange.
This could only happen to Chen Yi.
Ordinary people, if their major artery were severed like this, wouldn't even wait for an ambulance to arrive before they were gone.
I remember a news report from my childhood where two kids were roughhousing, and one child stabbed the other's thigh artery with a pencil sharpener blade, causing blood to spurt out uncontrollably.
The speed of bleeding was frighteningly fast.
Before they could even get to the hospital, the child was dead.
Chen Yi, constantly losing blood, felt a drowsiness coming over him. He lay on an ordinary beach chair on the rooftop, eyes half-closed and in a daze, chatting with Jiaye in a hit-and-miss manner, enjoying this moment of peace.
Time passed by imperceptibly.
It was the crowing of a rooster that brought Chen Yi out of his haze.
"..."
Upon opening his eyes again, Chen Yi glanced at the time on his personal panel.
October 17th, 4 p.m.
He had been bleeding for nearly thirty hours.
Only after Chen Yi checked the "Blood Emperor's" stored Life Value and saw that it had reached 1 billion did he stop the bleeding process. He stretched lazily after getting up, and casually remarked, "It's already afternoon, why is that rooster crowing with such gusto?"
"And since when did the neighborhood have roosters?"
"The Blood Emperor" had already stored 1 billion Life Value, enough for now, so there was no plan to continue bleeding. The process was too torturous; he could do nothing but lie on the beach chair and wait.
It was so boring it could drive one to madness.
Just then—
Tuberculosis Rabbit, holding a rooster and a black donkey hoof in its arms, tentatively spoke up from the side, "Should I have the people downstairs stop then?"
"Yeah, stop it."
"Alrighty."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the chat box of Sword Without End on his personal panel and yelled, "Tell those people to stop, make sure to keep count of everyone, we may use them again next time, don't lose track."
Only after he saw Chen Yi looking at the rooster in his arms with a bizarre expression did he grin and explain, "Just now, a feng shui master said that gathering so much blood and resentment in the neighborhood could ruin the feng shui."
"Afraid of some evil spirits possess us."
"So, we got some roosters to bring in some yang energy to deal with these evil spirits."
"..."
Chen Yi, expressionless, was silent for a moment before he finally said, "Cook it for dinner tonight. I need to replenish my blood."
"Understood."
...
Unnoticed.
The night gradually deepened, and by mid-October, the weather was no longer so hot, especially at night on the rooftop, when you could even feel a hint of chill.
Normally, the most annoying thing about this weather was the insects.
But Yi had long ago obtained a title that kept all mosquitoes at bay, making this summer much more comfortable.
"You two received a quest requiring you to become number one?" Chen Yi frowned as he looked at Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit before him.
"Yes," they said.
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit exchanged glances before explaining, "You see, yesterday when Tuberculosis Rabbit and I were driving the sleigh to the neighboring city to pick up a psychologist, we spotted a golden treasure chest in the wild."
"Since we saw it, of course we had to open it, so we did."
"After opening the chest, Tuberculosis Rabbit and I each received a quest chain claiming there would be some sort of mysterious grand prize upon completion."
"This quest chain has nine tasks, and Tuberculosis Rabbit and I have completed the first eight. It's just the last one we haven't finished."
"Yi, look."
He projected the last part of the quest chain into the air.
'Quest Nine (Final): Become number one on any leaderboard or in any domain within 48 hours.'
"See."
Sword Without End sighed with a bit of frustration, "This quest chain couldn't have come at a worse time. There are no global events these two days, no leaderboards to top in order to become number one."
"We don't stand a chance with the existing leaderboards."
"Like the Global Vehicle Leaderboard, Yi, after the last enhancement, your sleigh is far ahead at the first place, completely unshakeable."
Just then I realized that the quest didn't specify that in-game leaderboards wouldn't count, so I immediately rushed to 'Sands of Time,' the map we previously cleared."
"You know that map has the 'Sands of Time Dried Corpse Player Infection Leaderboard!' and 'Sands of Time Human Player Kill Leaderboard!', right?"
"I thought, with my strength, wouldn't hitting first place on either leaderboard be a piece of cake?"
"But the moment I entered, I was stupefied. The insanely dedicated players around Yancheng, I don't know if they have nothing else to do or what, but they've inflated the figures on the two leaderboards to ridiculous levels."
"I calculated that to reach first place, I would have to kill non-stop in the map for ten days straight!"
"But the quest is only for 48 hours, and now there are less than 10 hours left."
"Besides, there's also the 'Global Fashion Scoring' leaderboard, no chance there either. I checked, even if I bought the most expensive outfit in the shop, the score wouldn't even be close to what others have. They have globally unique limited edition outfits, complete with all parts, scoring ridiculously high."
And over there, Tuberculosis Rabbit also sighed helplessly, "Tell me about it, I never knew being at the top of a leaderboard could be so tough. The remaining leaderboards have things like 'Global Couples Leaderboard,' which is useless to us."

chapters.title: Chapter 527 359: "The Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Gods, Maker Tie Chui." _2
chapters.content:
"Sword Without End and I are both single; we don't even qualify for participation,"
"However, on the 'Global Team Rankings,' our team is number one, but it turns out that doesn't count either. It has to be our personal rank that's first."
"It looks like this chain of quests is impossible to complete."
"..."
Chen Yi looked at the two sighing in front of him with a bizarre expression and lit a cigarette nonchalantly before saying, "If you can't complete it, then don't. The way you two are going back and forth, it's as if I have some solution to help you or something."
"Speak up if you have an idea, and I'll help if I can."
"Cough, cough."
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit exchanged glances, coughed embarrassedly, then reluctantly began, "Yi, didn't you kill Jiang Chenglu and take first place in the Wonder Atlas?"
"What we mean is..."
With a shifty look, Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced around and muttered under his breath, "Maybe we can snatch a number one Wonder too?"
"..."
Chen Yi, who was smoking, suddenly tensed up, let the pale blue smoke drift freely into the air, and after a moment of silence, slowly nodded, "I get it; are you staging a coup, pushing me towards my doom?"
"No need for complications; you might as well strike me down directly."
"Hey!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit quickly stood up, waving his hands, "Yi, what are you talking about? It's all Sword Without End's idea, I just mentioned it offhand. How could we possibly have you die once just for a quest chain?"
"It would be an act of rebellion, utterly unforgivable!"
Sword Without End, overhearing this, immediately became anxious, stood up, and vehemently defended himself, "Tuberculosis Rabbit, don't slander me, alright? It was your idea. You were the one who said that with Yi's strength, even a trip to the underworld wouldn't be a big deal."
"..."
Chen Yi slowly exhaled, feeling somewhat speechless.
...
Fifteen minutes later.
"Um, Yi..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked cautiously at Chen Yi, who was standing on the edge of the rooftop, as he gestured with his hands, "Lean a bit more to the right side, tilt your head slightly, and gaze toward the horizon to give off a sense of lonely aloofness."
"Good, good. Now, just hold that pose without moving."
With that, Tuberculosis Rabbit took a deep breath, with a cigarette dangling from his mouth in a rather disdainful manner, put on a wrinkled, gaudy floral shirt, and with a running start, swung his fist and smashed it toward the back of Chen Yi's head, laughing wickedly!
"Boom!!!"
Yi's body fell from the rooftop in response.
"Click!"
Excited, Sword Without End hurried over from the controls, "Perfect, perfect. This shot is just perfect. Quick, look, are you on the Wonder Atlas?"
"Yes, yes, yes!"
「Ding, congratulations to player Tuberculosis Rabbit for creating the Wonder 'Tomb of the Gods of the Gods of the Gods.'」
「You are hereby rewarded with a Wonder Atlas*1, and the title Wonder Creator*1.」
With the prompt ringing in his ears, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the Wonder Atlas in his trembling hands with excitement and saw that the number one ranked Wonder was the one he created!
And flipping open the Wonder Atlas.
On the left was the still image of him punching Yi's head from just moments ago!
In that photo, with the reddish glow of his cigarette end and the deliberately wrinkled floral shirt against the night, he looked wild and carelessly nonchalant, while Chen Yi stood calmly with his cane on the edge of the rooftop, gazing into the distance.
His posture exuded a weariness with the world.
The whole image was extremely captivating.
To the right of the photo was the introduction to his Wonder.
「Wonder Name」: Tomb of the Gods of the Gods of the Gods.
「Wonder Ranking」: 1st place.
「Wonder Effects」: This Wonder has been permanently recorded into the Annihilation Starfield's Star System number 3, Blue Star, and within this region, any player who witnesses this Wonder will be filled with sorrow, unable to calm down for a long time.
「Wonder Origin」: The Blue Star Race player Chen Yi, who once killed the player Jiang Chenglu, creator of the first-ranked Wonder Tomb of Slaying Gods, was instantly killed by Tuberculosis Rabbit from the Annihilation Starfield's Star System number 3, Blue Star Race, to form this Wonder.
「Wonder Location」: Annihilation Starfield's Star System number 3, Blue Star.
「Wonder Creator」: Tuberculosis Rabbit.
"So cool!"
Sword Without End expressed his envy with a compliment.
"Not bad, huh."
Tuberculosis Rabbit stroked the photo in the Wonder Atlas with satisfaction, saving screenshots from several different angles, not even bothering to check what the final reward for completing the quest chain was.
That didn't matter.
They primarily wanted to leave their mark in the Wonder Atlas, with their most handsome moment.
How cool was that?
In the future, they could show it off and make everyone shake in awe, right?
Do you know Jiang Chenglu? The one from Tenfold Planet, the one our Yi killed. Yi knows him, right? Couldn't withstand a single punch from me.
Yeah, he's a great thing for putting on airs.
When Yi's not around one day, we could take it out and have a good show off.
"It's my turn, it's my turn."
Sword Without End, brimming with enthusiasm, pushed Tuberculosis Rabbit to the edge of the rooftop and earnestly instructed, "I want a more tragic scene, like, can you make a hideous face and desperately try to block, but I effortlessly cut through with a single sword strike?"
"You get what I mean, right?"
"Got it, got it, let's do this."
...
Three minutes later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was seen kneeling on one knee with a tragic expression, silently howling with a hideous face, hysterically raising a long knife in both hands, attempting to block Sword Without End who remotely controlled Three-Foot Qingfeng while standing in place.
The next second—
Green Peak easily cut through and split it down effortlessly.
'Ding, congratulations to player Sword Without End for creating the Wonder "Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Gods."' '
'As a reward, Wonder Atlas*1, title Wonder Creator*1.'
"Not bad."
Sword Without End, satisfied, looked at the number one spot in his Wonder Atlas. In the image, he was in green robes with an indifferent expression, casually waving his hand, and Three-Foot Qingfeng, surrounded by sky-filled thunder and lightning, struck Tuberculosis Rabbit like the wrath of the heavens.
For this, he even specially used the S-grade Prop "Only One Sword" he just obtained.
The whole scene was indescribably cool.
The hideous, unwilling, and incredulous look on Tuberculosis Rabbit's face added a few dramatic touches to the whole picture.
"Sister-in-law, your turn."
"Yo?"
Standing aside the whole time and enjoying the spectacle, Jiaye raised an eyebrow and smiled, "I'm involved too? I don't have any quest chains to complete, though."
"Hey."
Sword Without End somewhat sheepishly scratched the back of his head, "The quest chain and all are secondary, the main thing is that being in the Wonder Atlas is like leaving an anchor in the river of time, right? So, in the future, when looking through the Wonder Atlas, we can feel the youth that has passed, right?"
"You still have youth?"
"A man is a boy until he dies."
"Sit there and get ready."
"Alrighty."
Three minutes later.
'Ding, congratulations to player Jiaye for creating the Wonder "Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Gods."' '
'As a reward, Wonder Atlas*1, title Wonder Creator*1.'
Another three minutes later.
'Ding, congratulations to player Tie Chui for creating the Wonder "Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Gods."' '
'As a reward, Wonder Atlas*1, title Wonder Creator*1.'
...
Half an hour later.
Chen Yi and his group all returned from hell and sat silently around the campfire, looking at the chicken that was thoroughly cooked in the pot without speaking.
"Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Gods."
Chen Yi looked at his Wonder Atlas and the corners of his mouth twitched slightly, somewhat unsure how to comment, "You guys sure know how to have fun, huh? Do the gods know they have so many tombs?"
"That's just because Jiang Chenglu is gone."
"If Jiang Chenglu was still in this game, seeing so many Tombs of the Gods popping up over his head, he'd probably die from an apoplectic fit and come kill us on the spot."
Now the Wonder Atlas looked extremely neat.
Rank one: 'Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Gods, creator Tie Chui.'
Rank two: 'Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb, creator Jiaye.'
Rank three: 'Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb, creator Sword Without End.'
Rank four: 'Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb, creator Tuberculosis Rabbit.'
Rank five: 'Tomb of the Tomb, creator Chen Yi.'
Rank six: 'Tomb of the Gods, creator Jiang Chenglu.'
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit sheepishly shrank his neck and whispered, "Jiang Chenglu isn't that great, huh? He has to rank last when facing us. Having all the members of our team on the list is quite a face-saving moment."
"It's a shame most people don't have a Wonder Atlas."
"Anyone in the know would be stunned to see this scene right now."

chapters.title: Chapter 528 360: "How did that little head of yours get so clever?
chapters.content:
"Former Leader."
On Awesome Starfield, a middle-aged man wearing a mask approached Li Yi and handed him a stack of documents, bowing with a respectful expression and rasped, "Here is some of the information about Jiang Chenglu that you asked me to investigate, please review it, Director."
"..."
Li Yi looked expressionlessly at his subordinate, who didn't seem to be very smart, and after a long silence finally said word by word, "Didn't I tell you that you didn't need to investigate any further?"
The moment the game announcement went live, who among the players didn't know Jiang Chenglu?
Was there still a need to investigate?
The only one from Tenfold Planet, crushing all players' existence, and you still went to investigate whatever force.
"Forget it, hand it over, what's this?"
"This is the Wonder Atlas, the Wonder Atlas is a prop only available to players who have created a Wonder, it clearly records the creators of the existing 108 Wonders in the game and their origins."
"But there are also some players who duplicate the information from the Wonder Atlas and sell it as data on the Star Map Platform."
"I went to a lot of trouble to find the latest version."
"Please, Former Leader, have a look."
Li Yi's brows furrowed slightly as he looked at the documents in his hand, and after a moment he let out a slow sigh, rubbing his temples and muttering, "This Yi is quite frightening."
On the Wonder Atlas, the second-ranked was Jiang Chenglu, who by himself had slain eleven Deities, and before this, Li Yi hadn't even known that the game had anything to do with Deities.
What's the deal with the Deities?
And the first-ranked was Chen Yi.
Jiang Chenglu attained the second rank by slaying eleven Deities.
And Chen Yi took the first rank by slaying Jiang Chenglu.
What else could one say but that it was a case of one thing subduing another, only Chen Yi's victory seemed quite outlandish.
"..."
Li Yi stared at the documents in his hands for a long time before turning his head towards his subordinate, "Last time, Chen Yi alone stopped the invasion of the Void Clan to save Awesome Starfield.
"We haven't shown any gesture yet."
"Send out the command."
"At the site of the Void Clan's invasion, build a grand temple with Chen Yi's likeness."
"In front of the temple, there must be a thousand-meter-high statue of Chen Yi, with the face left uncarved."
This was the custom of their planet, not to depict the facial details in statues erected for people of great achievement; only after the person died would they add the details to the statue's face, a practice known as 'one man's image lasting throughout his lifetime.'
"Hmm..."
The subordinate standing aside seemed a bit bewildered, was it Chen Yi alone who stopped the Void Clan? If he remembered correctly, many people had contributed at that time, right?
But he did not argue.
He was merely internally calculating how much this was all going to cost.
He was not only the most trusted confidant at Li Yi's side but also controlled Li Yi's finances, effectively serving as the treasurer.
"By the way—"
"Last time Chen Yi went to Sky City, didn't he say that he thought the city was quite nice?"
"Give them that newly built building, they temporarily can't come out yet, just get it decorated for him, and when they come out, they can move in immediately."
"Understood."
...
"Is it fun?"
Chen Yi lay on a beach chair, looking at the few people beside him who were excitedly poring over the Wonder Atlas, and said somewhat speechlessly, "Is it necessary to be so excited? It's just a ranking, with no useful rewards, why get so worked up."
"You'd think they were awarded a few million Points."
"Yi, you don't understand!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked excitedly at his own ranking on the Wonder Atlas, "This is a ranking even higher than Jiang Chenglu's, you can't call this merely a ranking, it's a symbol of face and status!"
"But just now, my clever little brain popped out a new idea."
"..."
Chen Yi remained expressionless and after a brief silence said in a quiet tone, "You're not thinking about having me kill Tie Chui next, are you?"
"Exactly!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit excitedly snapped his fingers, "If we do that, could there appear a Wonder called the Tomb of the Tombs of the Tombs of the Tombs of the Gods, and then we keep repeating this cycle, until we transform all 108 Wonders in the game into the Tomb of the Tombs of the Gods."
"That too would be a legendary accomplishment, wouldn't it."
"Get lost!"
Chen Yi couldn't help but explode with a curse word, looking at the Tuberculosis Rabbit beside him and feeling a headache brewing, "Just what are these brains of yours made of?"
"Before we talk about that, what about these Wonder statues filled with strong negative emotions? How do you plan to deal with them?"
At the moment, on the rooftop.
There were no less than four groups of Wonder statues, neatly arranged on the rooftop, each pair showcasing scenes vividly duplicated from the Wonder Atlas, looking extremely tragic and spectacular.
But the problem was, staring at these Wonders could bring about a lot of negative emotions—some extremely frightening, some incredibly sad, a mess of negative feelings, and since these things couldn't be destroyed, for the time being, it was a bit of a puzzle how to deal with them.
"No problem."
Tuberculosis Rabbit patted his chest, "Yi, you forgot about my art gallery outside the city? I've already figured out where to place these things, just put them all in the art gallery, they will be the finest works of art."
"...Do as you please."

chapters.title: Chapter 529 360: "How did that little brain of yours grow?" _2
chapters.content:
Chen Yi sighed weakly as he got up and walked toward his bedroom, "I'm going to sleep now, after casting all day I'm dead tired."
Tuberculosis Rabbit watched Yi's departing figure and after exchanging a glance, they continued their spirited discussion about the rankings in the Wonder Atlas.
...
The next day.
October 17th, 7 a.m.
Awaking from his slumber, Chen Yi went up to the rooftop, lazily stretched while looking at the sunrise, and let out an extremely satisfied yawn.
Perhaps he stretched too vigorously.
The yawn was so intense that he ended up with a cramp in his jaw, the excruciating pain made him grimace and sit down on the beach chair, massaging his chin.
All muddled...
He was a player with over a hundred million HP, how could his jaw cramp up?
But just as he considered whether to use "Forever Pure" to fix his spasming jaw, a panel suddenly appeared in front of him.
'Ding, you have been forcibly invited into an unknown plane, please prepare yourself, player Chen Yi.'
Chen Yi hadn't had a chance to react when the next moment he opened his eyes, he found himself in a vast white space, surrounded by what looked like tens of thousands of players staring blankly at him.
At some point, he had been bound by no less than four or five chains, completely immobilizing him.
Beyond these, there was one particularly thick chain, covered in rust.
Looking down at the chains on his body, Chen Yi's face darkened slightly, and a hint of fury flashed deep in his eyes.
He recognized these chains.
He had seen them during his time with the White Phoenix Clan, they were chains used to bind deities, and even a fragment was an SSS-grade prop with only the effect of binding.
Single and pure.
And now these things were once again used on him, not one but five of them.
Additionally, there was one chain he hadn't seen before, and the pop-up panel in front of his eyes also revealed the effect of this chain.
'Ding, you have been bound by the Magic-Binding Chains, all your titles, skills, and props will be unusable for one hour, and cannot be removed by any means.'
That's not right.
Chen Yi narrowed his eyes slightly, focusing on the especially large, rusty chain. He seemed to have seen it before too, on the deities bound at the White Phoenix Clan.
Although he didn't know what was happening, it seemed like someone was making a move against him again.
"Sigh."
He let out a long sigh, then raised his head to look calmly at the group in front of him, "I actually enjoy a peaceful life, and these sorts of unannounced invitations really bother me."
"No matter who you are, you and the race behind you are as good as dead."
As soon as he finished speaking,
a bald man, his upper body naked and covered with tattoos, walked over to Chen Yi with a smile that didn't quite reach his eyes. He proceeded to lightly press the long knife in his hand against Chen Yi's chest.
"You've killed players from the Ninefold Planet and yet you can still make such threats in such a predicament."
"Do you think you'll be able to leave here alive today?"
Chen Yi, bound in chains at the center of the space, twisted his neck to look at the bald man and chuckled, "Do you think I will die here today?"
"Maybe."
The bald man tossed aside the long knife casually, clapped his hands, then with his hands in his pockets, he looked at Chen Yi with an expressionless face and said, "There's something I need to ask you. If you answer truthfully, I might spare your life today."
"If the answers don't satisfy us, then you'll be leaving your life behind here today."
"Given that you can't use any titles, skills, or props, I can't understand where you're getting the confidence to speak to us like this. Maybe you're still hoping to resurrect through Heavy Hell?"
"Let me tell you, even if you die here today, not only will you be unable to resurrect from hell, but not even your status as a Seed Player will save you."
"..."
Chen Yi exhaled softly without speaking. The swagger of these Seed Players was too low; how come there were so many ways to counter them? "Go ahead, ask what you want."
"Sensible."
The bald man's eyes narrowed as he scrutinized Chen Yi closely for a moment before speaking slowly and deliberately, "When Jiang Chenglu last contacted you, did he say anything to you?"
"And how exactly did you kill Jiang Chenglu? Was it intentional for him to be killed by you?"
"Did he talk to you about any quest chains or anything like that?"
"..."
Chen Yi stared at the bald man in front of him, his face turning serious as he began to smile, "No, he didn't say anything. I was able to kill Jiang Chenglu purely because of my great strength. Jiang Chenglu was no match for me."
As his words ended,
a grating alarm sounded from within the arms of the bald man, who then pulled out something that looked like a lie detector from his chest and examined the panel for a long time before looking emotionlessly towards Chen Yi.
"Truthfulness 0%."
"Pretty good, I thought you might tell me at least half the truth."
"It seems like before we continue our conversation, we should first have some peaceful exchange."
The bald man took a pair of pliers from one of his subordinates, placed one of Chen Yi's fingers in them, and said word by word with a vicious tone, "I'll ask one more time, what did Jiang Chenglu tell you?"
"Um, can I ask a question first, just..."
Before Chen Yi's words could finish,
a sudden, crisp, breaking sound filled everyone's ears.
The bald man's face twisted with fury as he clamped the pliers with force. He then looked at Chen Yi's finger, now a bloody pulp in the center of the pliers, "I ask, you answer. One more word of nonsense and I'll waste your next finger."
"..."
Chen Yi fell silent for a long while before feeling the pain in his index finger and muttering resentfully, "Damn it, you really went for it, huh?"
"Did you think we were just trying to scare you?"
"No, that wasn't it. I just didn't expect you to be so decisive. It really hurts."
"It's supposed to hurt. If you don't cooperate nicely, it'll hurt even more!"
"Hmm... You guys have a funny way of talking. Answer a question for me first. Which planet are you from, and did someone from the Ninefold Planet approach you, wanting to know how to advance to the Tenfold Planet?"
"Looking for revenge?"
"Yes, there always has to be something on my mind. Living without a thought is pointless. I wouldn't think of answering even if you continue torturing me."
"Alright, I'll make it clear for you. We are from the Nissan Clan of Fivefold Planet. There was a player from Ninefold Planet who asked us to find you, but we don't know the name of that Ninefold player or from which planet he is."
"Understood."
Chen Yi nodded seriously, "So the props were also given by that Ninefold player."
"Yes."
"A Ninefold player taking me down shouldn't be difficult, theoretically there's no need to send you. Could it be some rule restriction or for some reason, the Ninefold player couldn't find me?"
Chen Yi tapped his forehead thoughtfully.
At that moment—
The impatient bald man in front of Chen Yi squeezed the pliers in his hand more tightly once again, "Stop digressing, answer my previous question. If the lie detector goes off again, pray that your bones are tough enough."
"Hiss!"
The renewed wave of intense pain made Chen Yi involuntarily inhale a breath of cold air, and then he looked rather unpleasantly at the bald man in front of him, "That's really rude, you know. I hate it when people use pliers on my fingers."
The next second!
The class 'Magic Thief Group Envoy' activated.
Suddenly, all the items, titles, and skills on tens of thousands of players including the bald man in front of him were forcibly rented to Chen Yi without a deposit.
Most of the players were instantly stripped bare, even their cosmetic outfits were rented by Chen Yi.
Including the chains that had bound him, they were rented by him as well.
"Ah, crap!"
Having regained his freedom, Chen Yi stretched his limbs before picking out some healing props from a pile of temporarily rented items, and without checking, smashed them all onto his mangled finger, which instantly healed.
Then Chen Yi slowly took out the pair of pliers he had rented from his virtual backpack, looked at the bald man in front of him with a smile curled on his lips,
"Like playing with pliers, huh?"
"That's really rude."
"Let me teach you how this thing should be played with."

chapters.title: Chapter 530 361: "I am Jiang Chenglu!
chapters.content:
"Yi?"
With a steamed bun in hand, Tuberculosis Rabbit climbed up to the rooftop and looked towards Chen Yi, who had suddenly appeared, and asked with some confusion, "Did you... just go out?"
"Yeah."
Chen Yi casually tossed aside the bloodied tiger pliers he was holding, letting it shatter after the rental period expired, and then said indifferently, "I was forcibly dragged into a space by some people, a Ninefold planet also wanted to advance to a Tenfold Planet."
"Since they couldn't find anyone else who had interacted with Jiang Chenglu, they came looking for me."
"The matter is already resolved."
He spoke lightly, but he knew that the issue would not be resolved that easily. For those players from the Ninefold planets, advancing to a Tenfold Planet was probably their obsession.
Perhaps...
Perhaps before this, they didn't even know of the existence of a Tenfold Planet and thought that Ninefold was the final stage. They may have been living quite contentedly, but ever since they learned that Jiang Chenglu had led his planet to advance to a Tenfold Planet, they would no longer be able to remain calm.
The unknown brought extreme fear, but also extreme yearning.
They were eager to know what would happen after advancing to a Tenfold Planet. Would they go to a peaceful world without rules, where they wouldn't possibly die at any moment, and enjoy their true lives?
After this failure.
They would definitely use countless methods to seek him out again, not resting until they found the answers in their hearts.
But the problem is...
He genuinely didn't know how Jiang Chenglu managed to advance to a Tenfold Planet. He only knew that the other party had completed a chain of tasks, the last of which was to be killed by a new player, and then there was no more after that.
As for the "Life-Death Battle" that unfolded after advancing to a Tenfold Planet, it didn't sound like a desirable place, nor did he understand why those people were so desperate to advance to a Tenfold Planet.
"Phew!"
After Chen Yi let out a long sigh, he shook his head and said, "It's fine, don't worry about it for now, everyone go to sleep."
...
Meanwhile—
In an extremely bustling city.
Skyscrapers hundreds of meters tall could be seen everywhere, with their façades uniformly made of glass walls and aluminum alloys, giving off a strong commercial vibe. Not a single peddler on a tricycle could be seen in the entire city.
Nor could a single cigarette butt or piece of trash be seen.
The whole city seemed to have completely abandoned those rule-breaking poor people.
And on a rooftop of a high-rise, Jiang Chenglu was standing at the edge in a suit and tie, looking somewhat awkward as he fumbled with his expensive tie.
The sky was growing dim.
In the distance, an enormously exaggerated blood moon loomed over the entire world.
"Emperor Jiang."
A man clad in armor, holding a weapon, quickly approached Jiang Chenglu from behind, bowed with his hands clasped and said with a respectful expression, "There are three hours left until the Life-Death Battle begins. All members of the Mo Clan are ready."
"Young and old have taken up arms."
"Every member of the Mo Clan possesses the courage to face death fearlessly."
"We only hope to elevate you, Jiang Huang, to a high enough position so that you can see on behalf of all of us what lies at the very top and just what sort of existence is toying with us."
"Hmm."
Jiang Chenglu nodded absentmindedly as if lost in thought, and only after a moment turned to look at the soldier behind him and asked in confusion, "Why are you wearing armor? Don't you think that in this city, wearing that would make you stand out awkwardly?"
"You should wear a suit. That way you appear more sophisticated."
"..."
After a moment of silence, the man said with a complicated voice, "Emperor Jiang, you once told us that we should only remove our armor at the moment of death."
"This place may be fine, but it's not our home after all."
"Please, Jiang Huang, don't let the distractions of this world cloud your judgment."
"Our top priority now is to rally the strength of all members of the Mo Clan, and wipe out the enemy in the Life-Death Battle."
"Oh?"
Jiang Chenglu casually took a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and as the smoke swirled around him, he casually stuffed his hand into his pocket and looked down at the city below, "Don't you like this city? I think it's quite nice."
"It's much better than the city we used to live in."
"If we could live here, that would be great."
"Wouldn't it?"
The man's voice gradually grew colder, "Yes, but don't forget, Emperor Jiang, that this is not our Mo Clan's home!"
"So many of our clan members, from Onefold to Ninefold, have built a path for you, Jiang Huang, with their lives, not so you could desert us at the moment of decisive battle."
