"If you, Emperor Jiang, continue to be so obstinate, the only path left for all the members of the Mo Clan would be to offer our necks to the enemy."
"Sigh."
Jiang Chenglu let out a somewhat helpless sigh, flicked the cigarette butt off the building, and rubbed his temples with a hint of irritation, "Why don't I have a single smart subordinate?"
Just as he was speaking—
A group of people, escorting a young man, walked slowly onto the rooftop. Smiling at Jiang Chenglu, they said, "It's because you're too strong. When one person is too strong, it often causes his subordinates to lack brains."
With the appearance of these people.
The armored man standing behind Jiang Huang immediately changed expression, stepped forward with his sword ready and said urgently to Jiang Chenglu, "Emperor Jiang, run! These are our enemies from the Life-Death Battle, the leader of the Sirius Tribe!"

chapters.title: Chapter 531 361: "I am Jiang Chenglu!"_2
chapters.content:
Sirius Tribe.
They were the enemies in this Life-Death Battle; as long as they defeated this race, victory would be theirs.
This race had also recently ascended to the Tenfold Planet.
They hadn't heard of them.
It was also at that time that they realized the universe was not limited to a single ascension game. There were, in fact, countless such games.
"Alright, alright."
Jiang Chenglu, somewhat helplessly, pulled his subordinate behind him, and then looked at the young man in front of him with raised eyebrows, "Well, have you agreed to my proposal?"
"Not bad."
The young man waved his hand to signal his followers to stay put, slowly walked up to Jiang Chenglu with his hands in his pockets, and beamed, "Pretty much what I expected. The main thing is that the strength of the people in this city is really weak. I don't know where they found the courage to watch the battle of two giant beasts."
"Do you know?"
"Mortals dare to watch the battle of two giant beasts only in one situation, and that's when they have a cage strong enough to imprison both beasts, ensuring a safe environment for the spectacle."
"But now, this environment doesn't seem safe."
Upon hearing this, Jiang Chenglu chuckled lightly and also looked towards the horizon, "Actually, whether you came or not, I would have taken action. If you hadn't come, you might have been able to win the Life-Death Battle without shedding any blood."
"And then what, continue to be treated like a lion in a play?"
"I'm naturally happy you could come, but I must remind you, the city before us may not be as feeble as it appears. Once we make our move, there's no turning back, and death is certain."
"Death?"
The young man paused, his face gradually revealing a sinister and excited grin, as he casually pulled one of Jiang Chenglu's subordinates into his arms.
"We are all players from the Tenfold Planet. Who among those who have made it this far would fear death?"
"Those who feared death have long perished!"
"Those who are alive now are the ones who do not fear death!"
And at that moment—
A drone slowly flew in front of Jiang Chenglu, a long gun barrel extended from beneath its body to Jiang Chenglu's forehead, and a hoarse voice announcement followed.
"The Solar Surveillance System has detected that you discarded a cigarette butt on the rooftop of Solar Tower 89 seconds ago. You have 10 minutes to locate the cigarette butt you threw away, or you will be shot on sight."
"Whoa."
Jiang Chenglu blinked in surprise, then lit another cigarette and placed it in his mouth, tilting his head to look at the drone in front of him with a somewhat amused expression, "No wonder I thought this city was so clean. Is it because those who don't follow the regulations get shot?"
"Interesting."
"No matter the size of the offense, it's dealt with by shooting?"
Then he turned to look at the chief of the Sirius Tribe, "Shall I begin?"
"Please."
"Good."
Jiang Chenglu took a deep breath, then fixed his gaze on the drone in front of him, his hands slowly tightening around the hilt of the broadsword behind him, and he closed his eyes.
"What are you planning to do? Please stop your actions immediately; you're making an enemy of the entire city. Do not persist in your delusion!"
As if sensing something off about Jiang Chenglu, the drone started issuing a warning.
"Your world is quite beautiful; I want to destroy it."
"So, I'm giving you a heads-up."
Jiang Chenglu opened his eyes unhurriedly, looking at the small drone and the gun barrel starting to glow, and chuckled softly.
The next second—
With the broadsword at Jiang Chenglu's back being violently unsheathed—
A loud noise suddenly rang through the sky, and then a Demon, towering a kilometer high, appeared abruptly behind Jiang Chenglu. It had a slender frame, entirely blood red, with a pair of striking Demon wings, and in its hand, it held a heavy sword bristling with barbs!
As Jiang Chenglu swung his broadsword, smashing the drone in front of him into pieces—
The colossal Demon behind him also began to slowly swing its heavy sword towards the entire city!
An extremely blinding crimson Sword Qi nearly split the whole city in two!
In an instant.
In a city that was incredibly commercialized, a myriad of jarring alarms suddenly rang out, plunging the whole city into extreme chaos. Numerous buildings began to crumble under the force of the Sword Qi, as vast clouds of dust and smoke enveloped half of the city.
Looking down from above, one could see countless red warning lights flashing non-stop.
"Enslave me?"
Wearing a freshly bought suit, Jiang Chenglu stood at the edge of the rooftop with his heavy sword, looking down at the chaotic city below and sneered ferociously, "Do you think I fear death?!"
"You think I'd be like a monkey, performing for your entertainment?!"
"I am Jiang Chenglu!"
"The only true god under this sky!"
"All Mo Clan members, heed my order, slaughter all these spectators right here, today I want to cleanse this place of all living beings that meet my gaze!"
As his voice fell—
Countless armored Mo Clan players who had received the order burst out from the numerous tall buildings behind and started the massacre indiscriminately. In an instant, the entire city seemed to be engulfed in a fierce hell, extremely bloody.
"Quite a thrill."
The one standing beside Jiang Chenglu from Sirius didn't say much as he watched this scene unfold, just casually waved his hand and immediately countless players from Sirius wielding various weapons rushed out from every corner of the city.
No matter men, women, elderly, or children.
As long as they were not their own people or the armored Mo Clan players, everyone else was to be executed without exception.
...
Three hours later.
Jiang Chenglu stood on the rooftop, looking at the city which had nearly turned to ruins, his pupils filled with distress. He had accidentally split the city in half in a fit of angst, and now it was destroyed.
He had even thought of occupying this city.
Looking at it now, that was futile.
But then he picked up a map handed to him by a subordinate, studied it carefully for a moment, and then pointed westward, "Go in that direction, there's another city fifty miles to the west, smash that city too."
In reality.
He wasn't very sure where he was.
He only knew this was the endgame of the leveling-up game; here, every year, more than a dozen survivors from the leveling-up game from Tenfold Planet would fight to the death, and the final victor would receive countless rewards.
One of the rewards was the chance to live successfully in this world and obtain a resident identity card from the federation.
Officially, it's called the 'Clark Federation'.
A colossal federation spanning tens of thousands of light-years and owning countless Commercial Planets, Residential Planets, Transfer Planets, Mineral Planets, Garbage Planets, and more.
He only knew that much.
As for the more detailed information, he didn't know, but what he did know was enough. The existence of the leveling-up game was crafted by the federation, and those who played with their lives at will were also from this so-called 'Clark Federation'.
That was enough.
He wasn't clear on which planet he was on right now; he only knew that those who had always seen him as a monkey were citizens of this so-called Clark Federation.
There was only one thing he needed to do.
Destroy this world!
Release the anger he had held for years!
...
In a certain white space, as Jiang Chenglu took action, a hoarse voice slowly echoed in the room.
'Ding, MAX level map 'Clark Federation,' specifically for Tenfold Planet's 'Mo Clan' in a Life-Death Battle, has been activated.'
'The targeted player, Jiang Chenglu, has chosen to refuse participation in the map's Life-Death Battle, begins a killing rebellion, and has requested enough processing power to maintain the normal operation of the map.'
Three seconds later.
'Request approved.'
As the notification sound ended.
In an area Jiang Chenglu could not see, on the edge of the city that was reduced to ruins, countless previously mist-like entities were rapidly materializing. Some became plants, some became federation citizens, and some became city buildings.
It was as if they were all waiting for Jiang Chenglu's arrival.
Those lifelike federation citizens and the glass facade skyscrapers were all the product of computational power evolution, not truly existing in reality.
Or to be precise.
They did not truly exist in the world, but indeed existed in this 'Clark Federation' MAX map.
MAX.
The highest-level map is both the conclusion and the endpoint.
...
ps: I've been experiencing a bit of a writer's block lately, and I just couldn't come up with any plot, so
I spent a few days re-reading the entire book and finally got a bit more inspiration. I will make up for the chapters I owe in these few days one after the other. The previous two chapters were from times when I was struck by writer's block but still had to force something out. They don't have much impact on the subsequent plot.
The update time is not fixed. I will post as soon as I finish writing. If I haven't posted, it means I haven't written it yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 532 362: "...This can't be my fault, right?
chapters.content:
At this point, Jiang Chenglu had not realized that he had already begun a life-and-death competition, in a MAX level map, and hadn't even noticed that he was already in the midst of it. It was a map that unfolded subtly without any clues.
As for Chen Yi on the other hand.
He had simply started his early retirement.
Since he couldn't leave the Novice Planet anyway, and there wasn't much to do aside from Tuberculosis Rabbit and others occasionally going out to enjoy a map, there weren't any pressing matters.
And so, time progressed neither too quickly nor too slowly until October 22nd.
...
The weather today was fairly decent.
Chen Yi, who had woken up early and was lying on a beach chair, lazily propped his arms behind his head and suddenly missed the days when he was invisible. It was a long time ago when he had been injured by an irremediable prop from the Terra Tribe.
His injury had never healed, but not long after, he had acquired a title that ensured he would not die due to blood loss.
As a result, he had become a Spiritual Body.
It was a rather peculiar feeling, and now he thought it was a pity that there was no chance to relive that feeling. He had no idea when an opportunity to experience that state again would arise.
Thinking about it, it felt like a wasted opportunity not to have taken advantage of that state to do something.
Like... exploring the deep sea.
"Right!"
Chen Yi, who had been wallowing in boredom, suddenly had an epiphany. Blue Star's exploration of the ocean had always been partial; the deepest parts of the ocean floor remained untouched.
No one knew what lay at the deepest depths of Blue Star's ocean.
The pressure there could crush anything deemed sturdy, and it was simply not a place humans could reach. But now, things were different—he had "Sea God's Boots," an SSS-ranked prop.
This prop could ensure that he completely ignored the pressure of the seawater, allowing him to move freely within it.
Exploring what lay in the depths of Blue Star's ocean might not be a bad idea after all.
Last time he took Jiaye to see the aurora, so this time, perhaps a vacation at the beach...
This time of year, the water was already not so warm and was starting to feel cool.
"Yi."
Just as Chen Yi was lost in his musings, Tuberculosis Rabbit walked up to the rooftop, bare chested with a white towel around his neck and dripping with sweat. He collapsed onto a nearby beach chair, opened a bottle of chilled cola and took a swig before finally gasping,
"Why can Sword Without End use that Three-Foot Qingfeng vehicle in the river too?"
"I was just competing with Sword Without End in the reservoir to see who could swim faster, but that guy was just floating on the Green Peak on the water surface as if he was walking on water. You should have seen the way the girls on the bank's eyes lit up, their screams nearly pierced my throat."
"He's just too showy."
"That's what I like the least about him."
After babbling a string of thoughts, Tuberculosis Rabbit paused to catch his breath and continued, "Yi, what are you doing here alone? Come join us."
"No thanks."
Having spent so many years with Tuberculosis Rabbit, Chen Yi had long since become accustomed to his incessant chatter, tuning out the previous conversation as if he had not heard it, as it was not of any importance.
"The reservoir isn't thrilling enough; I'll take you guys to the Maldives."
"Really?"
"Really."
"Then what are we waiting for!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit excitedly pulled out a giant water gun, seven to eight meters long, from his bosom and exclaimed, "I actually came back this time to retrieve this prop I had stored away a long time ago from my little treasury. It was meant for revenge against Sword Without End, but going to the Maldives is even better, as this prop could be used to its greatest effect."
"When do we set off, Yi?"
"In a bit, after my occupational panel updates."
Chen Yi lay back on the beach chair and slowly shut his eyes, basking in the sunlight, patiently waiting. Today was the day his "Faceless One" occupation would transition into a new profession, which he had been looking forward to.
He was curious to see what new occupation would appear.
One of the rules for October was no drinking alcohol.
This had diminished a lot of fun for them this month.
Alcohol wasn't necessarily tasty, but when there's a crowd, drinking always feels festive.
And just then—
"Ding, player Chen Yi's Faceless One occupation 'Magic Thief Group Envoy' has expired. The new occupation for this week will now be rotated randomly. Your new occupation for the week is 'Goblin Merchant'."
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi was briefly stunned, looking at the occupation with some confusion. Goblin Merchant sounded like a creature with a pointed nose and cheeks, full of bad ideas and yet with a wealth of treasures in his pocket.
The occupational panel was straightforward.
-
"Occupation": Goblin Merchant.
"Occupational Effect": You can randomly create a prop whose effect will be completely random, and its rank will be limited to E. However, the prop will definitely possess a unique trait not found in any other prop in the entire game, creating a singular prop requires 10k Points.
"Occupational Restriction": Only one prop can be created per day.
-
This was his new occupation for the week—the Goblin Merchant!
"This effect..."
Chen Yi looked thoughtfully at the panel, momentarily struggling to gauge the strength of the occupation. Being able to freely create props and even create props with unique traits seemed very strong indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 533 362: "...This can't be my fault, right?"_2
chapters.content:
Unfortunately, the effect couldn't be freely chosen, and the prop level was restricted to the lowest Grade E.
Only one could be created per day, and because of the "Faceless One"'s occupational effect, this occupational restriction was exempted, but the requirement to spend 10,000 points to create a prop wasn't listed under occupational restrictions; instead, it was under occupational effects.
In other words,
he could create an unlimited number of random, unique Grade E props each day, but each creation would cost him 10,000 points.
After contemplating for a moment, Chen Yi activated this week's new occupational effect.
A semi-transparent panel shaped like a furnace suddenly appeared in front of him, with a prompt beside it to confirm the investment of 10,000 points. After confirmation, the furnace was suddenly engulfed in flames and began to shake continuously.
Five minutes later.
A gleaming prop popped out of the furnace.
'Prop Name': A Spring Night Is Worth a Thousand Gold (Unique).
'Prop Level': Grade E.
'Prop Effect': Upon activating this prop, you can freely create any kind of beauty you have ever imagined in your dreams and manipulate them at will, enabling you to have an extremely wonderful dream.
'Prop Restriction': This prop can only be activated in a dream, and only when the player maintains a lucid state during the dream.
'Prop Introduction': "A gentleman talks of deeds, not of thoughts; when it comes to thoughts... there's no discussing them."
"..."
Gazing at the prop before him, Chen Yi remained expressionless and silent for a long time before casually tossing the prop into the hands of Tuberculosis Rabbit, "Here, it's yours. Have fun with it."
This prop was utterly useless.
That's right.
He couldn't expect much from a Grade E prop.
Even though it had the unique attribute of being the only one in the game, it was still useless, and being unique didn't make it valuable, or else people wouldn't mock it as junk.
...
After that, Chen Yi didn't experiment with this occupation's skill any further but went straight to a small island in the Maldives.
The weather was just right.
Neither hot nor cold, and the seawater was reasonably warm.
They visited two or three small islands, and, surprisingly, there were quite a few people in the Maldives at this time, many players vacationing here.
And when they saw Chen Yi, these players expressed their excitement and joy.
Since the arrival of the upgraded game, some players who obtained a vehicle or some other props liked to visit places they couldn't go to before because work and lack of time restrained them.
After the arrival of the upgraded game, they had no jobs.
Eventually, they settled on a small island that looked decent,
They stayed on the small island with no heavy commercial atmosphere, and everything was more natural.
Chen Yi, who had moved his beach chair over, lay on it and casually picked up a handful of sand to sprinkle on himself. After glancing at the umbrella above his head, he nonchalantly grabbed a chilled coconut juice from beside him and sipped it.
Sometimes, Grade E props weren't entirely useless.
For example, he had tried the "Goblin Merchant" occupation again, and acquired another new occupational effect.
'Prop Name': Only Iced Drinks (Unique).
'Prop Level': Grade E.
'Prop Effect': You will have a magical cup, and any liquid poured into this cup will be forced to maintain a temperature of 5 degrees Celsius.
'Prop Restriction': None.
'Prop Introduction': "Theoretically, that's how it should work, but putting certain temperature sensitive liquids into this constant temperature cup is not recommended as the result is unknown. It is best not to attempt this carelessly."
With this cup, you could enjoy ice-cold refreshing drinks anytime, anywhere.
October was almost at its end.
Lying on the beach chair, Chen Yi looked up at Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit, who were frolicking on the beach, and his lips curved slightly upwards without saying a word, peacefully enjoying the gradually setting sun over the sea.
Other players around were frolicking with beach volleyball, swimming near the shore with little duck floaties.
Some lay in the sand, digging a hole to bury themselves under the pretense of taking a sand bath.
A girl in a bikini kept applying something to herself on her beach chair—it was unclear whether it was sunscreen or something else.
And so on.
There were quite a few players on the beach; some had titles above their heads, and others didn't, while Chen Yi naturally was the player with the most titles.
There were none comparable to him.
On the entire Blue Star, no one had more titles than him.
It was getting late.
The night view of the Maldives was beautiful.
Perhaps, if it hadn't been for the arrival of the upgraded game, ninety percent of the people here would never have had the chance to come to the Maldives in their lifetimes.
"..."
Lying on the beach chair, Chen Yi looked at the scene before him and felt a profound sense of tranquility in his heart.
Before the arrival of the upgraded game, the accelerated development of the internet allowed people to see further afield, to encounter different lifestyles, and to experience more anxiety.
When you're exhausted on the bed after a hard day of work and suddenly stumble upon a video of a vlogger smiling while recounting their Maldives trip, perhaps there's a bit of bitterness in your heart.
After all, why should life be so different for people who are all human?
Suddenly struck by a thought, Chen Yi smiled and turned to Jiaye beside him, "Have you ever found it interesting that the few of us seem like orphans, never having seen our own parents from birth?"

chapters.title: Chapter 534 362: "...This Isn't My Fault, Right?"_3
chapters.content:
"That does seem to be the case."
Lying on a beach chair nearby in a bikini, Jiaye nodded thoughtfully, "But that's not entirely correct. Sword Without End wasn't born an orphan, his father died along the way, drank a sip of iced tea at the construction site and couldn't make it through; he died on the spot."
"I've heard a saying before."
Chen Yi, not sure what he was thinking of, casually took out a cigarette from his pocket and put it in his mouth, "There are two types of poor people who are the most likely to turn things around. Do you know which types they are?"
"The ones who endure hardships and work hard?"
"No, the first kind are those who are cold-blooded and heartless, and the second are orphans."
Jiaye blinked in confusion and swung her legs onto Chen Yi's beach chair, "Why is that?"
Then she took out a bottle of sunscreen from her bosom and passed it over.
"Could you help me apply the sunscreen?"
"Sure."
Chen Yi sat up straight on the beach chair, placing Jiaye's long legs in his lap, scooped up a bit of sunscreen from the bottle and started applying it while he casually spoke, "The person's argument goes like this."
"It's not that poor people can't earn money, it's that they earn money but can't save it. Often, just when they manage to save a little, ten or twenty thousand, enough to do something with."
"At that time, it's either their parents falling sick or a relative having an emergency and needing to borrow money."
"In short, it's like life is deliberately watching the small amount you have in your pocket, and the moment you have some savings, your family suddenly needs money."
"It forces you to spend that money, so your pocket ends up empty again, and after working hard for several years, you end up at year's end with no progress."
"At that time, if you're a cold-hearted person, you can keep the money to yourself, watching your relatives or siblings die from illness right before your eyes because they can't afford treatment, or if you're an orphan, you simply don't have to worry about these issues."
"This way, you at least have the capital to turn things around, instead of a sickness breaking your bank."
"..."
Jiaye frowned slightly in dissatisfaction, "What kind of rationale is that? It seems a bit far-fetched, and isn't that just too cold-blooded? Wouldn't you rather be without great wealth than watch your own family die before your eyes?"
"That's true."
Without arguing, Chen Yi carelessly stood up and stretched, handing the sunscreen back to Jiaye, "I just remembered someone else bringing up this viewpoint a while ago and felt somewhat reflective when I thought of it just now."
"I'm going to check out the sea bottom."
"Message me if you need anything."
With that,
he walked straight toward the sea without stopping.
As soon as his feet touched the water, he felt a tremendous lifting force, much stronger than the normal buoyancy of water, giving him the feeling he could freely float or sink in the ocean.
Even walking on the surface of the sea posed no problem.
Chen Yi lit a cigarette and slowly walked deeper into the sea; the water had reached a depth of about a meter, deep enough to drown a person.
In fact, for someone who can't swim, even a few dozen centimeters of water can be deadly.
In the sea, a person is completely powerless, unable to stand upright even if their feet can touch the bottom.
Unless both hands and feet can touch the ground, there is a risk of drowning.
Yet in such deep water, Chen Yi walked as naturally as if he were on solid ground.
The next second—
'Instakill Clan!'
Chen Yi activated the title he had just acquired, and in the blink of an eye, his running speed soared to dozens of times the speed of sound, hurtling toward the deepest part of the Blue Star ocean!
This title significantly enhanced his running speed.
It was even faster than the speed of a sled.
...
About half an hour later.
Chen Yi stopped at a calm stretch of sea, just at the juncture of day and night.
The sun had set, and the sunlight was no longer visible.
But the sky was not completely dark yet, still retaining a hint of light; the sky and the sea seemed to merge into one deep blue color. The sea where he was had gentle waves, and overall, it looked rather tranquil.
No ships were in sight.
Appearing in such an environment, it felt extremely desolate and brought an overwhelming sense of loneliness.
If Li Bai had the chance to come here, perhaps the legacy of Tang poetry would not be limited to the widely circulated three hundred poems.
Chen Yi didn't linger in this feeling for long; instead, he let himself plummet into the deep sea like a heavy weight.
This is the Mariana Trench.
Located in the Pacific Ocean.
It's said to be the deepest place on Blue Star, with the deepest part of the seafloor currently explored being more than ten thousand meters. This depth far surpasses the height of Mount Everest.
In the depths of over ten thousand meters, there is absolute darkness, extremely low oxygen content, and tremendous pressure.
This is a depth that humans have yet to reach.
When the depth reaches over ten thousand meters, the pressure of the ocean is like that of the Southern Heavenly Gate's weight pressing on a fingertip; any submarine would be crushed to a sheet of paper at this depth.
The creatures that can survive at this depth are far beyond ordinary.
Soon,
Chen Yi had reached a depth of 6000 meters. The Sea God's Boots allowed him to ignore the pressure, breathe freely underwater, and significantly improve his visibility while in the ocean.

chapters.title: Chapter 535 362: "...This can't be my fault, right?"_4
chapters.content:
Blue Star could ignore the darkness, even possessing better vision than on land.
While admiring the chaotic creatures around him, like the school of fish with glowing lanterns atop their heads, Chen Yi let himself freely descend.
Not long after.
Some increasingly ugly creatures appeared before Chen Yi.
How ugly were they?
Chen Yi, who always believed it wasn't right to judge others by their appearance and advised young people not to be anxious about their looks, couldn't help but frown. The seabed had become utterly dark by then, maybe these creatures thought they'd never be seen in their lifetimes.
So they grew somewhat willfully, growing however they wanted.
A head taking up two-thirds of the body was considered relatively normal.
It was getting more and more bizarre.
Any one of them pulled out could play the lead in a horror film.
With brows tightly furrowed, Chen Yi continued to dive.
The terrain here was very complex, with countless trenches. Diving in place wouldn't reach the deepest parts; he had to keep changing paths on the seabed to continue diving.
"Wait a second?"
Chen Yi, who hadn't been paying attention to his diving depth, glanced at his depth gauge and suddenly froze. Had he already descended 33,000 meters?
He felt nothing.
Yet the records in Blue Star indicated the deepest part of the ocean was only over 10,000 meters, right?
But the diving depth data was provided by his personal panel, there shouldn't be any chance of error. Chen Yi looked towards the sea beneath his feet, which seemed to have more room for descent, hesitated for a moment, and then continued diving.
This visit was precisely for this purpose, to see what lay at the deepest part of the sea.
With the Boots of the Sea God, he didn't have to worry about any danger at the depths of the sea.
Time passed unknown.
"Copper door?"
Chen Yi's eyes narrowed slightly as he gazed at an entrance on the deep trench wall, completely covered by this copper door, which wasn't the usual square shape.
It was irregular.
The shape matched the entrance exactly and could perfectly encompass it.
As if it was custom-made.
He suddenly swallowed, looking at his current diving depth. He was now at a depth of 34,000 meters. The sight of this seemingly copper door made his heart beat faster.
This thing was clearly not a natural formation.
These were traces of humans.
Whether it was the indigenous people of their Blue Star, or remnants left by aliens, it was all very strange.
This copper door seemed to have been washed by the sea for a long time, the whole thing turning green. Even without touching it, one could feel its slickness, and its material, robust enough to look uncrushed even under such horrific pressure, was unknown.
This was more than 30,000 meters deep in the sea.
Even the strongest material thrown here would instantly be compressed into a small ball.
"...huh."
Chen Yi took a deep breath, uncertain if there was anyone behind this copper door. It was inlaid in the rock wall and vertical to the seabed, resembling the tombs on cliffs above ground.
"Really a tomb?"
As he approached, Chen Yi saw three lines of characters remaining on the copper door.
"I am dead."
"Before dying, I carved a tombstone for myself."
"So annoying."
"..."
With an expressionless face, Chen Yi looked at the three lines carved into the irregular copper door in the rock wall. The sea must have eroded them for many years, yet they were still faintly visible, proof of the force used when they were carved.
From the intensity, one could tell that the person didn't want to die, at least not while carving the tombstone.
Should he go in and take a look?
He hesitated slightly within. Was this considered grave robbing? Who would put a tomb here, and to die in such a place? Besides, this copper door had been washed by the sea for so long without any damage; it looked very sturdy.
He didn't have any tools that could open it, although he had a Prop that could open any lock. But this copper door had no keyhole.
Chen Yi tentatively placed his hand flat on the copper door and applied a slight pressure.
The next second—
The seemingly extremely sturdy copper door instantly shattered, breaking into pieces that dissipated into the seawater.
"...This can't be blamed on me, can it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 536 363: "My guts are about to burst, hey!
chapters.content:
The scene before Chen Yi somewhat stupefied him, he was a bit unprepared for how this seemingly solid bronze door could be so fragile that it turned to powder upon a single touch and disappeared into the ocean.
And the sight beyond the door was even more wondrous.
At the entrance was a corridor akin to a tomb passage, and strangely, there was no seawater inside, as if an invisible thin film had separated it from the deep sea outside.
It looked extremely spectacular.
Chen Yi tentatively stepped into the corridor before him, where the interior walls clearly bore the traces of artificial excavation, with even the marks of pickaxes striking the walls.
Until he reached the end of the corridor, he saw an area that might be a burial chamber, where space suddenly opened widely.
But there was not a body nor a fragment of clothing in sight; as if with the passage of endless time, the bodies had disintegrated into dust and scattered into the air.
And on the wall, there was a line of characters.
"Record, Origin Year Four, the seventh God Slaughter plan organized by Senior Chen of Blue Star is hereby declared a failure."
"Senior Chen is dead, with nearly ninety percent of the remaining strong ones dead as well."
"Henceforth, the Origin Year resets to zero, and all planets shall enter a process of reckoning by the deities; Blue Star is to suffer yet another extinction. Till the power to resist is amassed next, it will be at least ten thousand years."
"Difficult, difficult, too difficult."
"The power of deities is nearly unstoppable."
"To succeed in God Slaughter led by Senior Chen and the powerful from various races is extremely difficult, with no chance of success."
"So be it."
"Only this time the deities' slumber will be short, and when they awaken this time, there likely won't be any opportunity to accumulate the power to fight against them."
"However, it is said that someone called the Emperor of Man has gathered the remaining strength to research a way to extract the divine power within the deities and distribute it among mortals, allowing them to grow stronger quickly and to select those capable of fighting the deities rapidly, albeit reportedly in a cruel manner, with many deaths."
"Anyway, time to sleep, I'm dead exhausted."
"—Qiu Di."
At the end of the last line, this man from who knows how many years ago left his own name, Qiu Di — a somewhat strange name.
Origin Year Four?
What kind of calendar is that?
Chen Yi wasn't entirely unfamiliar with Blue Star's history, although he couldn't say he knew it like the back of his hand. There had been many calendars throughout Blue Star's history, but there had certainly never been one called Origin Year Four. It seemed like the fourth year of the original gods, almost as though there'd be some sort of four-year anniversary event coming up?
...
Three hours later.
"What's up, Yi?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been playing beach volleyball with Sword Without End under the night sky, approached Chen Yi who had just returned: "I heard from sister-in-law that you went to play in the depths of the sea, to see what's at the bottom. How was it? Was it fun down there?"
"..."
Chen Yi remained expressionless and silent for a long time before finally revealing what he had just witnessed.
"The historical records of Blue Star might not be complete. Before us, there might have been one or more generations of human civilization on Blue Star, far more than simply evolving directly from ape-men to our current state."
"There are many gaps in the history."
"And the main reason is that the Blue Star Race has suffered several extinctions, with each being thoroughly clean, leaving virtually no traces. When human civilization reemerged, all that could be seen were the remains of the ape-men era."
"That passage stated that this was the seventh God Slaughter plan led by Senior Chen, and its failure resulted in a reckoning by the deities, ending in extinction; the Blue Star Race must have already been wiped out once by that point."
"But I have no idea when it happened."
"There's no record in history."
"Also..."
He paused before continuing, "Those last few lines mentioned that someone called the Emperor of Man began gathering the remaining forces to extract the power from within deities for the benefit of mortals, and that through some cruel but efficient means, they quickly selected beings capable of challenging the deities."
"Doesn't this operation seem a bit like leveling up in a game?"
"..."
Sword Without End, who had been listening intently, suddenly froze, his mouth slowly opening wide in shock as he murmured softly, "Damn, that's true. The two deities we saw at the White Phoenix Clan, weren't they summoning random Props by whipping them with their divine powers?"
"Moreover, the game hinted that these Props indeed originated from deities."
"Even some rare Props, a single one would require the existence of three deities."
"And isn't the game's maps and the monthly rule villages exactly about filtering out the weak to cultivate a group that's strong enough to oppose the deities?"
"Looking at it this way, it seems that what the Emperor of Man led and devised back then was quite successful; at least it appears to be working well now, bustling and lively."
"It's just... we don't know how long ago it was, there's no approximate time reference."
Tuberculosis Rabbit had been silently contemplative with a complex expression on his face ever since Chen Yi mentioned the deities, lost in thought.
"Yi."
At this point, Jiaye hesitantly spoke up, "Are you sure that line of text is about the game?"
"Certain."
Chen Yi took a deep breath before speaking in a hoarse, solemn voice, "I may not have been sure upon seeing that line of text, but when I saw another line of small characters deep within the burial chamber wall, I became completely certain."

chapters.title: Chapter 537 363: "My Guts Are About to Burst, Hey!"_2
chapters.content:
```
"The few lines of small characters stated that the plan of the Emperor was doomed to fail from the start. The most powerful force of the deities is the rules, like the God of Nightmares, who, if willing, can appear indiscriminately in everyone's dreams and manifest as the victim's worst fear."
"As soon as the victims feel even a hint of fear, they will die on the spot. Only those who keep their hearts from being too afraid can safely get through it."
"But how could a normal person not feel fear in such a situation?"
"How could mere mortals contend with such a god, one who possesses the power of rules?"
"These four sentences are the last few lines of small characters deep on the walls of the tomb chamber. Don't you all find this somewhat familiar? Do you remember the second monthly rule that came after the game Blue Star descended?"
"Calm and Cool: No ghosts allowed in your mind."
"Doesn't this rule seem to be a forced way of training the players to maintain their composure in the face of extreme fear, albeit a bit brutally? It weeded out many people but left a group of individuals who are greatly superior in mental resilience when facing fear."
"In this way, when facing the God of Nightmares in the future, perhaps they won't be so helpless."
"If I'm not mistaken, each of our monthly rules corresponds to a unique ability of a deity."
"..."
Chen Yi's speculation was logical and based on clues, not just empty talk; it was highly credible.
However, it was also too bizarre, and for a moment, everyone present found it hard to believe.
After hesitating for a moment, Sword Without End finally spoke up, "Does it mean that our two rules for October, one prohibiting alcohol and the other requiring 200 push-ups every day, also correspond to a deity's rules?"
"Like, could there be a deity whose rule is to kill anyone with alcohol remaining in their system?"
"There can't really be a deity with that kind of power, can there? That power is too strange."
"And then, because of that we're all forced into sobriety?"
"Then why do we have to do 200 push-ups every day? Surely there isn't a deity whose power is to kill anyone who does less than 200 push-ups a day? If these deities really have such powers, then I've really seen it all."
"Not sure,"
Chen Yi shook his head, "After all, it's just speculation. We can't be sure what it truly is, but perhaps the rule of doing 200 push-ups a day is meant to strengthen our bodies in some way?"
"Whether it's useful or not,"
"At the very least, our bodies won't be too weak."
"Alright."
Then Chen Yi waved his hand, putting an end to the conversation, "Let's not think about this for now. It's one of those things that you can't figure out by thinking about it. We'll find out what it is in time. I'm hungry, and it's getting late, so let's grill some meat."
"Everyone, have something to eat."
"Hey."
Sword Without End, who had been frowning in thought, suddenly relaxed his brows and smiled widely upon hearing this, "That's a great idea."
...
Under the night sky,
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat alone on the beach, a cigarette with a crimson glow between his lips, silently gazing at the sea's heavily fish-scented waters lapping at the shore, his face a complex mix of emotions without speaking.
The night sea always carried a profound sense of loneliness, solitude, and danger.
It involuntarily made one's mood melancholic.
That's why, in films and dramas, whether it's the male or female lead, they flock to the beach after a breakup, as the seaside is indeed an environment that easily evokes sadness.
Ever since Yi and Jiang Chenglu prepared for their decisive battle,
he had regained part of his memory.
He didn't recover much, only enough to know that he and Yi had reincarnated many times. Yi had slain many deities, and they had been good brothers for a very long time, with his primary role being to shield Yi from calamity.
This was to be their final lifetime; if they were to die this time, it would all be over.
Yi had invariably died at the hands of those deities in the past, and it looked like they were about to confront them again. If it weren't unavoidable, he truly wouldn't want Yi to face those deities; it always made him think of the aftermath of their failures.
In a daze, Tuberculosis Rabbit actually fell asleep on the beach like that.
```
```
Perhaps it was the first time that the mood had fallen a bit, which was quite different from the usual carefree and talkative personality. Under the seaside atmosphere, before I knew it, I had fallen asleep.
When I opened my eyes again.
Tuberculosis Rabbit appeared once more on that familiar mountain peak, looking towards the myriad little Tuberculosis Rabbits on the hillside, all sharing the same face but riddled with injuries. Sitting cross-legged on the summit, the Tuberculosis Rabbit fell into a long silence.
Only after a while did he turn his head to look at Chen Yi, solid as a rock on another nearby peak.
"Sigh."
Much later, Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a sigh, looking somewhat helplessly at those little Tuberculosis Rabbits on the hillside with the same face, "Don't look at me with that expectant stare, today Yi went to..."
After the daily report of what Yi had done that day.
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused briefly before speaking again.
"You've been hard done by all these years, just so happens today I got hold of a little trinket, let's taste something different for a change."
The next second—
E-grade Prop 'A Spring Night Is Worth a Thousand Gold' activated!
Suddenly, hundreds of variously styled beautiful women appeared out of the blue at the peak, some wearing white dresses, some in black lace nightgowns, some in office attire.
Tall ones, short ones, plump ones, slim ones.
Red, white, yellow, black.
They exhibited a kaleidoscope of forms.
Whatever you desired, you had.
The simultaneous appearance of hundreds of beautiful women immediately livened up the mountain peak, which had been somewhat oppressive, and it didn't take long for Tuberculosis Rabbit to hear a chorus of gulping sounds by his ears.
Then Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at those little Tuberculosis Rabbits on the middle of the mountainside, and seeing them in such a disgraceful state, he couldn't help but burst into laughter.
"A bunch of good-for-nothings."
"It's just some women, for heaven's sake, you're gaping as if you've seen the ultimate treasure. I don't remember being this lecherous, where did you pick up these bad habits?"
But very soon, Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded with a sense of poignancy.
"I suppose I can understand. After all, you've been confined in this dark place forever, unable to leave the mountain, unable to go anywhere. Over these many years, you've rightly grown bored."
"Especially my first life, I must have been trapped here for nearly ten thousand years, right?"
"Ten thousand years without touching a woman, it's somewhat understandable you'd be this excited. Uh, it's been over ten thousand years, can you still find the right hole?"
"Hey, hey, HEY! Whoever that is, slow down, will you? I know you're desperate but can you at least take a proper look? You've slammed your own intestines in there, you idiot!!!"
"Can you not tell the difference between your guts and your dick?"
"Your intestines are about to burst for Pete's sake!"
"And you over there, that's a belly button, you realize you can't get in, right? Oh, you carved a new hole with the knife, did you? Well, that's fine, as long as you like playing that way."
"Why are you arching your back? You're a man, aren't you? What are you doing lying face down on the ground? I don't recall having that kind of fetish. Which life are you from? Come talk to me, who the hell taught you these disgusting habits?"
At that moment, the mountain was buzzing with a rare and extreme liveliness.
After a bit more time passed.
Tuberculosis Rabbit returned somewhat helplessly to his usual seat, waving his hands dismissively, "Forget it, as long as you're happy, you can play however you like. Thank goodness no one knows, otherwise they'd really think Tuberculosis Rabbit was some kind of pervert."
These were all his past lives.
In other words, the behavior of these little Tuberculosis Rabbits here was a true reflection of himself.
Though each life experienced different things, and while the fundamental personality might not change, some things certainly would; it was impossible for every life to be exactly the same.
He could understand that.
But he still could not grasp why, in one lifetime, he would arch his back like that. What on earth happened in that life?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 538 364: What the Hell are These Crappy Jobs!!!
chapters.content:
"Sigh."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a long sigh, took a cigarette from his pocket, put it into his mouth, and looked towards the chaotic scene halfway up the hill without making any further noise to interrupt. These people were indeed about to go mad from being cooped up, so it was better to let them go wild for a bit when they finally had the chance.
...
Before realizing it,
the day had dawned.
Chen Yi stood on the beach and stretched vigorously, beginning to enjoy the new day. He had temporarily forgotten yesterday's events, regardless of what connection the promotion game had with that Godslaying plan.
It wasn't something he should be concerned about at this stage.
What he should be considering was getting through the Novice Period on Blue Star.
Next was his vacation time.
And time slowly passed by in such leisure moments, with many players on the Maldives just like Chen Yi, leisurely enjoying life. After the promotion game arrived, life had become significantly more relaxed.
Of course, even though these people seemed quite relaxed now, they weren't completely slacking off. After resting for a few days, they still had to fight hard on the map.
Those who genuinely slacked off had gone to hell early to enjoy their lives, without the monthly rules restricting them; as long as they didn't want to return to Blue Star, they didn't even need to enter the map. It was truly leisurely.
And there were not a few who rushed into that Dried Corpse map at the beginning and chose to retire as an undead Dried Corpse.
Just like that, without notice, time moved on to October 29.
Chen Yi, having stayed in the Maldives for 7 days, lay on the beach chair, waiting for the arrival of his new profession.
The last profession he randomly got was "Goblin Merchant."
This profession was almost useless; it could only craft E-rank Props, but the E-rank Props it crafted were unique to the promotion game, making their rarity greatly increase.
To craft such a Prop, it cost 1w Points.
He spent 2 billion Points to craft 20,000 of these E-rank Props.
No matter how smart one person is, they're definitely not as smart as a group of people.
He firmly believed in this principle.
So, he did some research to see how the players on Sixfold Planet who chose this profession utilized these Props. He didn't realize until he searched that the profession was a very strong support profession.
It could even be ranked as T1 level.
The randomly crafted E-rank Props might not be very useful, but by virtue of being unique in the promotion game, they could be sold on the Star Map Platform for at least a few hundred thousand Points each. If he got lucky with the effects, they could go for over a million Points.
Although the effectiveness of the Props was quite lackluster.
But considering their extreme rarity, naturally, their price soared.
1w Points to craft one, post it on Star Map, and it would sell for several hundred thousand Points immediately. You could craft one a day, which meant a sure gain of at least several hundred thousand Points each day. Isn't that what you'd expect from a T1 level support profession?
In terms of economy, it offered extraordinary and stable support to players.
He hadn't even thought about selling these items on the Star Map. After reading the strategy guide, he immediately invested 2 billion Points, crafting 20,000 Props.
Ready to make a big profit by posting them on the Star Map Platform after the Novice Period ended.
And today, his "Goblin Merchant" profession was about to expire, and the new profession was coming soon.
As for the Tuberculosis Rabbit...
Chen Yi lay on the beach chair, turned his head with an expression of disbelief towards the Tuberculosis Rabbit not far away: "There are a full 20,000 E-rank Props here; are you sure you want to look through the effects of all these 20,000 Props?"
Ever since the 20,000 Props came into his possession, the Tuberculosis Rabbit plunged into the pile like finding a treasure, beginning to check each one.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit had no other hobby than collecting these somewhat useful yet useless E-rank Props. Now that this batch was uniquely attributed to the promotion game, the Tuberculosis Rabbit was even more eager to check them.
At this moment, the Tuberculosis Rabbit had not slept for days and nights, with red bloodshot eyes, sitting in front of a mountain of Props, continuing to check each one.
Hearing Yi ask,
he replied in a hoarse voice without turning his head, "No, I won't be able to sleep until I've looked through all these Props, and among them, there are quite a few E-rank Props with extremely strong effects. If enhanced with Zenith Radiance, their effects will definitely not be weak."
After saying that,
the Tuberculosis Rabbit casually picked up an E-rank Prop from his lap and tossed it to Chen Yi: "Take this one, for example. Yi, take a look. I bet that if it's enhanced with Zenith Radiance, the power of this Prop will certainly not be small."
"Oh?"
Chen Yi raised his eyebrows lightly, taking the E-rank Prop from the Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand to check it.
'Prop Name': Cozy Desire.
'Prop Rank': E-rank.
'Prop Effect': When wearing this Prop, players within ten meters of you with low satiation will become extremely angry, while players who are overly full will fall into a state of uncontrollable desire.
'Prop Restriction': The player themselves will also be affected.
'Prop Introduction': "To manage people effectively, one must not let them be too full or too hungry; moderation is easiest to control."
"What's the use of this?"
Chen Yi didn't quite understand the purpose of this Prop.
"Have you forgotten my great plan, Yi? I plan to strengthen the entire series of Air Food Props into Ultimate Props. After enhancing Air Food Props into Ultimate Props, they will turn into a huge statue, causing all who see it to instantly feel full."

chapters.title: Chapter 539 364: What the Hell are These Crappy Jobs!!!_2
chapters.content:
"And with this prop,"
"Can you imagine that scene, Yi?"
"Hmm."
Sitting aside, Sword Without End nodded expressionlessly, "It would instantly create a huge Silver Party scene. Tuberculosis Rabbit, can't you have something normal in your head for once?"
"So you long to create a Silver Party that much?"
"You don't know shit. This is called a tactic for defeating the enemy."
Tuberculosis Rabbit rolled his eyes at Sword Without End and stopped paying him any attention, instead burying himself in reviewing the huge pile of E-grade items before him. It was a substantial task; he had to look through everything before he could sleep peacefully, or else it would haunt his dreams.
...
Lying beside him, Chen Yi let out a sigh and fell silent, letting Tuberculosis Rabbit busy himself. Given Tuberculosis Rabbit's physical condition, there was no risk of him dying suddenly from overexertion.
Even if he did die suddenly, it was a trivial matter; he'd just have to make another trip back from hell, which would be a bit of hassle at most.
With Tuberculosis Rabbit's strength, there was no question of not making it back from hell.
At that moment—
Chen Yi saw his personal panel vibrate slightly, and the 'Goblin Merchant' occupation began to fade away. Followed by the system notification sound, a new occupation name emerged on his personal panel.
'Ding, player Chen Yi's Faceless One occupation 'Goblin Merchant' has expired for this week. The new occupation for the upcoming week will now be randomized, and the new occupation is 'Playboy'.'
-
'Occupation Name': Playboy.
'Occupational Effect': Attracts the opposite sex more strongly as a passive effect, which cannot be toggled on or off.
'Occupational Restriction': Ineffective against the same sex and different races.
-
"..."
Chen Yi looked at his occupation panel expressionlessly and remained silent.
And just then—
Lying on a nearby beach chair, Jiaye seemed to sense something and suddenly looked up at Chen Yi, a hint of confusion in her eyes, "Yi, I don't know why, but why do I suddenly feel like you're even more handsome than usual?"
After saying that,
She subconsciously squeezed her legs together, seemingly out of control.
"I thought I was the only one who felt this way."
Sword Without End scratched his back uncomfortably, as if itching all over, and looked at Yi with a dark expression, "This feels wrong. I see Yi as a big brother, how can I have these feelings?"
"There must be a scoundrel scheming against us."
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit swallowed his saliva and murmured in a daze, "Are the aftereffects of not sleeping for three days this severe? Why do I find Yi so... delectable?"
"Could it be that my butt in a past life was meant for Yi?"
"That's disgusting... For the first time, I feel like I'm not completely obedient to Yi."
As for Tie Chui standing aside, although he didn't speak and showed little emotion, from his tensed posture, it was clear that the kid was stonier than usual...
"Scram!"
Chen Yi spat out a word, his face ashen as he shared his occupation panel and abruptly stood up from the beach chair to walk alone into his Crimson Palace, deciding not to show his face for the next seven days.
What the hell kind of shitty occupation is this!!!
Most importantly, he couldn't even turn off the effects of this occupation if he wanted to; the effects were passive and could not be toggled on or off.
This was the first time he felt there was a reason for occupational restrictions to exist.
His 'Faceless One' occupational effects granted him immunity to the 'Playboy' restrictions, but this made him feel even more repulsed. Originally, it would have only affected the opposite sex, but now, it worked on the same sex as well.
"Fuck!"
In the end, he couldn't hold back his curse.
Jiaye, her cheeks tinged with red, followed Chen Yi into the Crimson Palace, leaving Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others sitting on the sand.
...
"What kind of shitty occupation is this?"
Watching Yi's departing back, Sword Without End lay back down on the beach to bask in the sunlight. Resting his arms behind his head and closing his eyes leisurely, he casually said, "By the way, Tuberculosis Rabbit, have you ever had your back scrubbed at the bathhouse?"
"Specialty of the North, you can't find it in the South."
"I've been there."
Tuberculosis Rabbit continued to bury his head in his work without looking back.
And Sword Without End didn't care either; he just started recounting casually, "The most embarrassing thing in my life happened in a bathhouse. It was a large public bath, and I still remember the name of that place to this day."
"It's called Jinglong Bay."
"It really left a deep impression. That time, I went to that bathhouse specifically to enjoy the legendary Northern scrub down. Before going, I Googled a lot of things, like whether I should use skin scrubbing products, whether to apply salt or something."
"You really did your homework."
"But when I entered the bathhouse and saw so many naked men walking down a corridor into the hot spring, I knew I was being a bit presumptuous."
"But since I was already there, of course, I went in with gritted teeth."
"After soaking for a while, the most crucial part came—"
"Scrub down!"
Sword Without End, with a bit of lingering emotion, licked the corner of his mouth and exclaimed, "This experience is something I'll remember for the rest of my life. I was lying flat, and the bathhouse attendant, a man over fifty, started to apply the mud scrub on me."
"I don't know if it was because of scrubbing people every day that the attendant's hands were quite smooth, but they kept spreading bubbles on me."
"It felt very strange and uncomfortable."
"At that point, the only thing on my mind was the discomfort, and nothing else. But then the unfortunate thought popped into my head—if at this moment little brother decided to stand up, that would be a disaster."
"As soon as that thought crossed my mind, I knew it wasn't a good sign."
"Often, the more you don't want something to happen, the more likely it is to happen. What's that called, Murphy's Law, right?"
"Then I tried my best to control myself, to not feel anything, to not react."
"But the more I did so, the more uncontrollable it felt."
"Finally, after one minute, little brother, discontent with loneliness, stood up tall and proud. At that time, there were six beds, and every other bed had someone getting a scrub down. Everyone had been chatting with each other, and the noise was quite loud."
"But gradually, the voices died down, until there was a silence as still as death."
"Although I was lying with my eyes closed, I could feel the complex gazes from everyone around me."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was previously seriously selecting a Level E Prop, at some point had sat down next to Sword Without End, with a serious expression and a face full of anticipation, excitedly saying with an intense desire to hear gossip, "What happened next?"
"What happened next? Of course, I ran away."
Sword Without End sighed helplessly, "I just jumped off the bed and ran outside, even heading out of the bath center main hall without rinsing off the foam, wearing only my bathing suit."
"Do you know what that looked like?"
"A guy in a bathing suit holding his clothes, with skin still covered in soap, rushing out of the bath center lobby in a flurry. The receptionist didn't even ask me for my locker key or to pay; she just screamed and ran out with me."
"In an instant, there had been quite a few people sitting in the bath center lobby, and they all rushed out with me in a panic."
"Then someone shouted 'Fire!', and I saw countless bare-assed men and women wrapped in towels rushing out of the bath center..."
"It was only later that I found out they thought something had happened inside when they saw me running out like that. Just at that moment, some kid had the bad luck to hit the fire alarm button, which set off the wailing alarms."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Sword Without End, slightly disappointed, "That's it? Just this? I thought there would be a more interesting plot afterward."
"What else could have happened?"
Sword Without End rolled his eyes at Tuberculosis Rabbit in annoyance: "Weren't you busy fiddling with your thing just now? How come you're so enthusiastic about this gossip?"
"It's human nature."
...
Over the next few days, Chen Yi indeed stayed in his Crimson Palace, never leaving his residence. Given his current Occupational Effect, it was not suitable for him to go out and see people.
Nor could he see people.
What kind of messy Occupation is this? Lying on the beach, even the glances from players of the same sex gave him the creeps.
He was filled with aversion.
And so, time slowly moved into November.
When the clock struck midnight at the start of November, the monthly rule for November also descended.

chapters.title: Chapter 540 365: The first shutdown update!
chapters.content:
"Ding..."
Accompanied by a familiar notification sound, in the moment it resounded above Blue Star, all the players, regardless of what they were doing, promptly set aside their tasks and seriously looked at the lengthy pop-up that appeared before them.
So many months had passed.
The human race players on Blue Star had long reached a consensus: before the arrival of the new month, no one went to bed at night, everyone patiently waiting for the new rules to descend.
According to the old rules, the arrival of new rules often meant the kickoff of new activities.
"Ding!"
The abrupt notification sound captivated everyone's hearts!
"Game Update Announcement!"
"The new Blue Star 4.7 version will be offline for updates starting at 00:00 on November 1st. The main contents and adjustments of this update are as follows."
"1. Fixed several bugs, the bugs fixed this time are as follows"
...*Someone used certain props to break through the limits of Blue Star's atmosphere and escape from Blue Star; they have been recaptured, and the bug has been fixed.*...
...*Due to potential issues in the program's code, a bug that allowed players to get stuck inside rocks and even freely walk underground by squatting on the edges of cubic steps and shifting step by step has been fixed.*...
...*Fixed a loophole in the store where players discovered they could purchase items at zero cost; the bug has been fixed, all sold items have been fully recovered, and if items have vanished, players will need to compensate at the original price.*...
...*$%##%$#%%#*..."
"2. Added 'Beast Chess' gameplay, starting from November, a new permanent gameplay element will be introduced.
Beast Chess consists of several chess pieces: Elephant, Lion, Tiger, Leopard, Dog, Wolf, Cat, and Rat.
They possess relationships of natural prey and predators; for example, the Elephant can eat the Lion, the Lion can eat the Tiger, but the Rat can eat the Elephant, and so on.
In this gameplay, players will draw a random chess piece as their identity and may challenge any player they see; if the opponent's identity is lower than theirs, they gain 100 Points. Otherwise, they lose 100 Points.
Each player can accept an unlimited number of challenges per day but can only initiate one challenge.
And after a challenge, both parties will learn each other's identities."
"3: Added August's rules 'No Smoking,' 'No Thanking,'
'No Lying': All players are not allowed to smoke. As an adult, you should be conscious of your health and at the very least not affect the health of those around you with your secondhand smoke.
For each infraction, 1000 Points will be deducted, with no accumulations.
'Reject Thank You': We should be a bit rougher in facing the world; politeness is not a necessity, hence this month all players are forbidden from saying 'Thank You.'
For each infraction, 1000 Points will be deducted, non-accumulative.
PS: The definition of thank you is the words 'thank you.' Other substitutions such as gratitude won't trigger the rule.
The November rules will last for one month, expiring at 00:00 on September 1st."
"The Snow Sea Project Team wishes all players a happy gaming experience in version 4.7."
"PS: In the next update, the project team has decided to add monthly rules on the 'Do As One Pleases' element. Please look forward to it."
"It seems like this month's update content is quite simple,"
Yi, standing to the side with his hands in his pockets, looked at the panel that popped up before him and said nonchalantly, "Just three items were updated, much less than before, with only a dispensable Beast Chess gameplay added."
"This gameplay seems pretty weird."
"Once you initiate a challenge, you can discover the chess piece identities of each other; then, by simply spreading the word about the opponent's piece, every player with a higher-status piece will swarm in to challenge and easily claim 100 Points."
"Isn't this too targeted at players who aren't very popular?"
"It's a good thing that participation in this identity isn't mandatory, and you can choose freely whether to join this gameplay. Otherwise, if Yi's identity gets leaked, too many higher-status players would come to take advantage of Yi; they wouldn't shear him bald but would definitely annoy him to death."
"About that..."
Sword Without End, standing nearby, hesitated before speaking, "Actually, I think you really don't need to worry about this issue. Even if the identities were forcibly distributed to every player, I doubt anyone would dare to challenge Yi."
"Why? As soon as Yi's identity is known, it means a free pick-up of 100 Points for winning a challenge."
"That's true, but losing your life for 100 Points seems a bit uneconomical, doesn't it? After all, 100 Points seem rather trivial when compared to a life."
"That makes sense, you have a point,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement and then took out a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and put it in his mouth. He took a long drag before gazing at the smoke curling before him with a distracted look.
"I don't know why, but this cigarette seems to smoke better than usual."
"I always feel like there's a noble touch in the smoke."
The new rules for November: all players are forbidden to smoke. Each infraction results in a fine of 1000 Points, and Tuberculosis Rabbit, of course, completely ignored this rule—a mere 1000 Points for one cigarette, which he could easily afford.
Even if he smoked 20 cigarettes a day, that would be just 20,000 Points.
A total of only 600,000 for the month.
Barely a drizzle, as things stood—they were not the same as before, not lacking a few hundred thousand Points. The ear spoon in his pocket alone had cost him several hundred thousand Points; he wouldn't care about these few hundred thousand Points.

chapters.title: Chapter 541 365: The first shutdown update!_2
chapters.content:
```
Moreover, his backpack full of unique E-rank props could, once the "Star Map" platform launched on Blue Star, instantly convert to hundreds of billions of Points in a few minutes. Why would he care about a few hundred thousand Points?
As for the other rule, it was even more useless to him.
"Thanks?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't help but crack a smile, "Do I look like someone who says 'thanks'?"
"Ding, player Tuberculosis Rabbit has said 'thanks' twice, deducting 2000 Points."
"..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was previously smiling, suddenly fell silent and expressionless, and after a moment, hoarsely said, "What the fuck? That counts too?!"
Sword Without End, standing to the side, looked thoughtfully at the announcement, "What I'm more curious about is, how did those players even find these weird bugs? I'm really curious about what methods they used to actually escape from Blue Star."
"Even though they were caught and brought back, that's already quite impressive."
"And there were those who found out about the zero-cost purchases in the marketplace, what kind of operation is that? The marketplace even has zero-cost purchases? What surprises me the most is, who would squat on a step, moving back and forth, left and right, in an attempt to get stuck in the ground, huh!?"
"This is reality!"
"It's not CF where even a small cell phone can cause it to operate, so why would someone in reality do such a thing, and what's even more puzzling, why did that action actually succeed? It actually worked?!"
"What kind of mess is this!"
It was at this moment——
Sword Without End suddenly noticed that Yi had been quiet from the beginning, sitting still with an extremely calm demeanor. Slightly startled, he took a step forward and probed,
"Is Yi still troubled by the Playboy profession?"
He naturally knew that Yi's mood had not been very good these past few days, mainly because of the Playboy profession, which resulted in Yi occasionally receiving those disgusting looks from male players.
Of course, those male players must feel even more disgusted with themselves.
If you think it's hard to imagine, consider this: one day you walk down the street, see a passing man, and suddenly feel a kind of lust for him rising in your heart.
This unexpected feeling is enough to make one start questioning one's sexual orientation, instantly shattering many years of personal beliefs and causing a suffocating disgust within oneself.
You should know, even gays don't like every man; they only develop feelings for certain men who meet their specific criteria.
Chen Yi's profession, however, could make all those who looked at him feel a strange fondness towards Yi, whether male, female, or even a mosquito.
This feeling was torturous enough.
But... I have to say, these past few days Yi really did seem to become more handsome.
Sword Without End lowered his head, not daring to look directly at Yi. The world these days could really spring up any kind of ridiculous situation; never assume that the world you see couldn't become any more absurd.
The limit is still far off.
"..."
Chen Yi was silent for a while before softly saying, "Didn't you all notice the sentence in the third line?"
"Huh?"
Sword Without End was stunned, looking at the announcement board in front of him in confusion, "It's just an official statement, what's wrong with this sentence?"
Chen Yi did not explain further but softly repeated the sentence.
"The new Blue Star Version 4.7 will start its shutdown update at 00:00 on November 1st, the main content and adjustments of the update are as follows."
"Wait a minute!"
It was then that Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly noticed something unusual about this sentence, a shock flashing in his eyes, looking up at Chen Yi incredulously, "Shutdown update starting at 00:00 on November 1st? Shutdown update? What the hell is a 'shutdown update'?"
"Who the fuck's machine are they shutting down?"
"Our machine?"
"We can actually be shut down??!!"
This statement was something they had seen many times; they saw it at every version update. It was nothing special, and they had automatically skipped over it. They were accustomed to updates without shutdowns, not expecting a sudden shutdown update this time.
It completely baffled them.
Shutdown?
What does a shutdown entail?
Coming to his senses, Sword Without End, with a hint of fear in his eyes, quickly looked around before murmuring in shock, "But everything feels normal to me now, I don't sense any shutdown. Could it be that we wouldn't feel a shutdown?"
"What exactly does a shutdown mean?"
"Not clear."
Chen Yi was silent for a long time, his expression calm, before he continued, "I just asked Li Yi from Awesome Starfield to help us inquire. Li Yi told me there's never been such a thing as 'shutdown update' in the history of this game evolution."
"I spent several hundred thousand Points to activate the B-rank Skill 'Requesting the Mandate of Heaven', and the Snow Sea Project Team also told me they don't know what's going on. They set the announcement to be a non-shutdown update, but when it was released it became a shutdown update."
"This is the first-time event in the entire game evolution."
"There has never been an incident of shutdown update before."
"There are two possibilities, the first possibility is that there was a problem with the underlying code of the game evolution, causing bugs like missing or incorrect characters, making the 'non' in front of 'non-shutdown update' disappear."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 542 365: The first shutdown update!_3
chapters.content:
"If that's the case, the bug should be fixed very quickly, and the announcement panel will switch back from a server downtime update to a non-downtime update in a matter of minutes."
"But the Snow Sea Project Team told me that the likelihood of this happening is almost negligible because the underlying code of the game wouldn't have such a foolish error."
"Then there's only the second possibility."
"It means we've really caught up, the first ever server downtime update for the game just happened to be during our time."
"What exactly will happen is a total unknown."
"The Snow Sea Project Team is also clueless about what's going on, and they're frantically investigating the cause of this event — no one knows what's going to happen next."
The words fell into silence.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been enthusiastically discussing the rules of the month with Sword Without End, suddenly lost the bounce in his expression and frowned for a long time before saying, "Only games need to shut down for updates, and generally speaking, games that do shut down for updates often have a massive amount of changes to implement."
"And to take some time to sort through the shit mountain of code."
"What's most important now is what are we? Players? Will we lose our props when we log back in? Or are we NPCs? If we're NPCs, might we never get the chance to log in again and end up getting deleted as obsolete data during the update?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit clearly seemed anxious, and Sword Without End was wearing the same expression, everybody was filled with fear of the unknown for this server downtime update.
Good luck or bad luck...
No need to guess, this thing didn't look like it was about to bring any luck.
"Perhaps, we no longer need to guess."
Chen Yi stood on the seaside, taking a cigarette out of his pocket and bringing it to his lips. He lit it slowly and exhaled a stream of smoke before gazing at the ever-changing horizon and murmuring, "If I'm not mistaken, the whole of Blue Star might pause for a while, but there's no specific timing for it."
With that said,
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End, among others, looked in the direction Chen Yi was facing, and they all gaped, seemingly at a loss.
They only saw in the skyline,
A vast white ring of light was sweeping towards them at a high speed. Everything touched by the white ring of light became pixelated and frozen in place.
A three-meter-high sea wave suddenly stopped in mid-air, filled with pixel-like blocks, looking just like something out of Minecraft, and appeared quite unreal.
Including seagulls mid-flight and crabs struggling to climb the beach.
Even players sitting in beach chairs reading the rules.
Even the air hung motionless, pixelated into blocks.
The server downtime update has begun.
As the white light enveloped Chen Yi and others, he only had time to curse, "Fuck, it's a global time-stop, this is what a server downtime update is, don't fucking bring someone who can move freely during this!"
"I'm genuinely worried about this," he added.
Chen Yi was the first to pull Jiaye into his arms, guarding against the possibility that a player could ignore the rules and move freely while the world was frozen — it wasn't something that couldn't happen.
Before the arrival of the game update,
He knew there were quite a few movies with this theme, apparently popular with many viewers.
But as he was engulfed in the white light and lost a moment, an extremely terrifying possibility flashed through Chen Yi's mind, and he subconsciously covered his own backside.
Damn!
He was a Playboy now, his attractiveness to the same sex greatly increased!
He protected Jiaye, but he couldn't let himself be left unprotected, right!
Fuck, if anyone dared to touch him, he'd dig up their ancestors back to the eighteenth generation and soak them in copper water!
And then—
The white ring of light swiftly skimmed over Chen Yi and his companions, speeding towards the edge of the sky. Everything it passed fell still and turned pixelated, including the players.
November 1st.
Blue Star undertook its first ever server downtime update, which would also be the first server downtime update for the game itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 366: Pandora's Box.
chapters.content:
The white ring of light took less than a few minutes to envelop Blue Star completely.
And if someone could look down at Blue Star from high above at this moment, they would discover that Blue Star had been frozen in place like a two-dimensional picture, appearing as if it were a photograph.
Whether it be the surging waves of the sea or the hunting eagles soaring with outstretched wings.
Or a volcano erupting somewhere, as well as lightning frozen mid-air in a thunderstorm.
Everything had been frozen.
It looked incredibly eerie.
There were no living creatures wandering about on Blue Star.
But... in places unknown to all, some of the mountain ranges on Blue Star, the wilderness outside the cities, the hills, and so on, began to slowly creep and shift, and suddenly, a little house would emerge from the deserted landscape outside a city.
It was unclear what for.
On the edge of a cliff, a statue might suddenly appear out of nowhere.
And in some cities, in places unknown to many, a peach blossom tree might suddenly appear.
Each had its own peculiarity.
Each had its own bizarreness.
The whole world was undergoing these silent changes, looking extraordinarily odd.
...
It was unclear how much time had passed.
Chen Yi, holding Jiaye and standing in place, slowly regained consciousness and instinctively reached to check his own behind first. Seeing that his trousers showed no signs of being pulled down and that he felt no pain at all, he breathed a slight sigh of relief.
Then, immediately afterward, he checked Jiaye and found everything was normal, with nothing amiss.
He could not accept Jiaye being violated, but compared to Jiaye being violated, he found the thought of himself being violated even less bearable, even if... wait, he couldn't accept Jiaye being violated either!
Fuck!
Why the hell were these two things even being compared?
Was there something wrong with his brain?
Could it be that the recent downtime update had injected something dumb into his brain?
Chen Yi shook his head vigorously, casting away the messy thoughts from his mind, before immediately looking at the time on his personal panel.
"November 1st, 00:06."
"Hmm?"
He frowned slightly, puzzled and not uttering a word.
He had no concept of how long the downtime update had lasted. The moment it happened, his consciousness vanished instantly—it felt like having a general anesthesia done, his eyes closed, and then, when they opened, it was over.
But the time displayed here indicated that it had barely been a few seconds.
Could it be that the downtime update only took a few seconds?
Chen Yi carefully observed his surroundings and then looked at his own hands, feeling as if nothing had changed from before. What exactly was this downtime update for?
"Is that it?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit seemed puzzled as she scanned her surroundings, "This place looks exactly the same as before. What exactly did this downtime update do? Why is there not even an announcement?"
"Isn't there one?"
