Sword Without End glanced at the November version update notice in front of him and smirked, "Isn't it right here? They fixed some bugs, added the Beast Chess gameplay, and then there are two new November rules: no smoking and no saying thank you."
"Those things don't need a downtime update, do they? Weren't updates like this always done without shuttering the service before? Such a big fuss, I thought there would be something different this time."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked to Yi, as if waiting for Chen Yi to provide a reasonable explanation.
"Don't look at me."
Chen Yi shook his head calmly, "I just used 'Requesting the Mandate of Heaven' to contact the team; the Snow Sea Project Team over there said they also didn't know what was going on, only that this downtime update was of the highest authority in the game."
"Speculation is, it might have been triggered by a certain planet successfully upgrading to Tier 10, causing some special events to happen."
"As for why it appeared on our Blue Star, that's unknown."
"Whether the pros outweigh the cons, or vice versa, is completely unclear; we'll have to see how it develops."
Just at this moment—
Suddenly, a series of exceedingly noisy sounds reached the ears of Chen Yi and the others.
"What's that? Has it always been there?"
"Definitely not, this is which place, this is a beach, how can someone build a house on such sandy ground!"
"Absolutely not, I've been here for about seven or eight days, and I've never seen this house before."
"..."
The voices of a heated debate rose from not far away, and looking towards the source of the sound, they saw about a dozen players gathered in front of a low house, discussing something with one another.
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi's eyes narrowed slightly, and he turned and walked towards the group: "Let's go, take a look."
...
Accompanied by Chen Yi and his party, they arrived in front of the low house.
The players who had been surrounding the house quickly scattered, knowing their place, speaking in hushed, respectful tones, yet on closer inspection, one could see the confusion in their eyes, evidently not understanding the strange feeling in their hearts.
This was the charm of the "Playboy" profession.
Used correctly, ascending to the heavens in one step was no issue.
In Blue Star, almost all players recognized Chen Yi, and even if there were a few who were truly reclusive and indifferent to worldly affairs, not knowing Chen Yi, the series of titles above his head was nevertheless recognizable.
It was indeed quite eye-catching.
Anyone who wasn't a fool knew that this person in front of them could not be pushed aside.
Leaning on his cane, Chen Yi stood in front of the house, scrutinizing it closely, coming away with one impression – ordinary! Extremely ordinary!
It was just an average, low house with a floor area of about forty square meters.
Built with bricks.
The only peculiar feature was it had no windows, and... and that door was conspicuously made of solid copper, and it gave him an extremely familiar feeling; wasn't this precisely the copper door to the tomb he had seen at the bottom of the deep sea?
"..."
Chen Yi's expression gradually turned solemn; he had an ominous premonition, feeling as if by opening this door, it would be like opening Pandora's box.
Immediately, some dangerous creature would be released.
"Eh?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing to the side, looked thoughtfully at the house: "It does seem like it, this house definitely wasn't here before."
"It's just..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused for a moment, peering carefully at where the house met the beach: "It's just that, I don't know why, the appearance of this house here gives a very harmonious feeling, as though it was always meant to be here."
"It doesn't immediately strike one that there's an extra house here; this house must be part of the content from the recent server update."
After being silent for a while, Chen Yi said no more words but slowly walked up to the copper door of the house, placing his palm lightly on it and giving a push. The door, as well, bore thick traces of decay.
As if it had been soaked in seawater for many years.
He had been prepared for the copper door to disintegrate instantly, just like the one at the bottom of the deep sea, but oddly, that did not happen.
A light push conveyed instead a feeling of substantial heft, signifying the extreme weight of the copper door.
"Hmm?"
Chen Yi's eyebrows raised slightly in surprise, then he steadily increased his strength, and finally...the copper door that had not been opened for who knows how long gave a creaking sound.
"Boom!"
Following a somewhat deafening noise, the somewhat heavy copper door finally swing open, and Chen Yi instinctively covered his nose and mouth, but contrary to expectation, no long-sealed gases wafted out.
The air was, on the contrary, exceedingly fresh, fresh to the point of being like concentrated oxygen.
And the scene inside the house made all the present players' pupils contract sharply, their mouths gradually widening in disbelief as they murmured.
"Fuck..."

chapters.title: Chapter 544 367: "Come on, let's go!
chapters.content:
Inside the room was a scene that could immediately trigger a physiological reaction.
Seven or eight attractive men and women were draped over each other, their eyes filled with a suggestive gaze, their lips slightly biting as they embraced, their faces all smiling, exuding a highly erotic charm that made one want to take a longer look.
Normally, that would be the case.
But the scene before us wouldn't arouse anyone's primal desires; instead, it stirred an extreme disgust within, making one feel like vomiting.
Each of these attractive men and women seemed to be engaged in suggestive behavior, but in each person's hand was a bloodstained dagger plunged deep into the heart of the person they were embracing.
And on the floor.
There lay about a dozen bodies, all covered in wounds.
The seven or eight attractive women standing inside the room looked like wax figures, motionless, not reacting even when the door was opened, with no dust or cobwebs anywhere.
The room seemed as good as new.
The blood on the floor looked very fresh, it even seemed to be flowing, yet there was no smell of blood at all.
This scene was extremely eerie, and some players who were watching around started to have a psychological reaction, but not the kind of physiological one one might think of.
"Ugh!"
A player, who appeared to be slightly balding and dressed as a middle-aged man, couldn't hold back any longer, turned pale, and violently vomited toward the side of the beach. Although there was no smell of blood, the scene before him was still extremely nauseating.
When he saw Tuberculosis Rabbit and others looking over, panic flitted through his eyes and he hastily apologized, "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'll clean it up right now."
Disturbing the vacation mood of Chen Yi and others was no trivial offense.
After all, Chen Yi was not a man to be trifled with, his hands could stack into a mountain at the Nile River.
"No worries."
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head, not minding the incident, but looked at the middle-aged man with some confusion, "Coming to the Maldives for a vacation, and you're wearing a suit because?"
"Er..."
Although he didn't understand why Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly brought this up, the man still steeled himself and said in a low voice, "Well, Tuberculosis Rabbit, to be honest, I was an entrepreneur before the descent of the Reincarnation game. It was quite comfortable, but after the game came, I lost everything."
"I couldn't bear to see the business I'd fought for all my life disappear, so I wear this suit to constantly remind myself that I was once a boss, even if I'm down and out now, I can still make it big again someday."
"Oh?"
A hint of surprise flashed in Tuberculosis Rabbit's eyes, "I hadn't realized you were a boss before. What kind of project were you doing?"
"I opened a 3,000-square-meter gymnasium in the countryside. Those peasant uncles consume a lot of physical energy working in the fields and require good physical fitness; those with less strength just can't handle the farm work."
"I keenly sensed this market need and opened a gym in the countryside so that the farmer uncles could exercise in my gym for 2 hours before doing farm work each day. The exercise would make them more energetic for the work."
"As the saying goes, 'sharpening your axe will not delay the cutting of wood.' It seems like exercising before work might waste time, but actually, exercising can greatly improve one's physical fitness, making future farm work more efficient."
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly fell silent with an expressionless face, then after a moment murmured somberly, "Did it turn a profit?"
"Not yet, my gym had just been renovated when the Reincarnation game descended."
As he said these words, the middle-aged man's eyes filled with regret, "All my life's savings were invested in that gym. If the Reincarnation game hadn't come, I would definitely have made a fortune. I was the first to discover this blue ocean market!"
"I had it all planned out; I was going to rapidly open new branches by selling gym memberships and then offer franchises to quickly recover investment and expand across the globe. It's just a pity my road to riches hadn't even begun before it was abruptly cut off."
"..."
After a long sigh, Tuberculosis Rabbit took out a cigarette and put it into his mouth, murmuring, "It seems God is fair to everyone after all; giving you an abundance of wealth equips you with a brain that doesn't match."
Standing beside him, Sword Without End nodded deeply in agreement.
...
Meanwhile, Chen Yi was standing at the door, squatting down and narrowing his eyes to observe the scene inside the house. The door had been open for a while, but the statue-like corpses standing inside still showed no sign of reaction.
It seemed there was no risk of the corpses coming back to life.
He reached out and touched the blood with his finger; it was somewhat thick like normal blood, and although it wasn't clear which era the house belonged to, the blood seemed as fresh as new with no signs of drying.
Just then—
He suddenly noticed on the wall a row of blood-red words.
'Instance Name': One of Us Is a Ghost.
'Instance Content': On a certain night, a group of rebellious youths rented a bus and made plans to explore an abandoned house in the wilderness. However, these fearless teens did not know that somehow, a ghost had silently infiltrated their ranks.
The Reincarnators will play the roles of 17 rebellious youths and one ghost.
Only by killing the ghost can they leave the instance and return to Reincarnation.
'Number of Reincarnators': 18.
'Instance Introduction': "It is said that a ghost cannot laugh."
Following that, Chen Yi noticed that the wall was covered in numerous sanguine scribbles, the writing was so hasty it appeared as if someone on the brink of death and in emotional turmoil used their fingers to write on the wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 545 367: "Come on, let's go!"_2
chapters.content:
*"Hahaha, we've all been fooled, there are no ghosts at all!!!"*
*"Fooled, we've all been fooled, there are no ghosts at all!!!"*
*"This is a map where death is certain, there are no ghosts at all!!!"*
*"Hahaha, ridiculous, how ridiculous!!!"*
"..."
A trace of shock slowly passed through Chen Yi's eyes, as he realized that the room before him was a replica from an unknown time. Reincarnator? What was a Reincarnator?
It sounded a bit like those infinite loop novels he had read.
People needed to stay in a space and continually enter replicas to gain enough strength? This room gave him the feeling of something out of an infinite loop novel.
He even knew the content of this replica. There were a total of 18 players, with one being the ghost. The players needed to kill the ghost to successfully leave the replica and return to the Reincarnation space.
But obviously.
All the players in this map had been annihilated; all 18 were dead.
And according to the blood-red writing left under the wall, it seemed that there were traps in this replica; they were all players, with no ghost present.
A replica without a ghost, which led to mutual slaughter under the rules, resulting in complete annihilation?
Although he didn't know when this replica was created, for some reason, he had a premonition that the players in this replica were all from the Blue Star Race.
They just weren't from his batch of the human race players.
They were from even further back, from before the historical records of Blue Star. Ever since he discovered that tomb deep beneath the sea, he knew that there were signs of large-scale human existence before the recorded history of Blue Star.
It's just unknown why they became extinct and then, after an unknown period, humans evolved once again.
In the history of Blue Star, humans had never been completely extinguished. Since their birth, they gradually became the Overlords of Blue Star, but it seems now that in actuality, the Blue Star Race had been eradicated many times; they just managed to cling to life by a thread or, because of some other opportunities, a new Blue Star Race emerged.
—And then—
As Chen Yi tentatively stepped into the room, he saw additional writing on the wall that he couldn't see before, writing that was even more neat, standardized, and extremely square in block style.
It looked very cold.
"Inspector No. 02891, begin the backtrack."
"Map rules: Among the 18 players, one player is the ghost. Kill this ghost to leave the replica and return to the Reincarnators' space, but the prerequisite is that the ghost knows it is the ghost, and only then killing the ghost will be counted."
"The one chosen to be the ghost was a 26-year-old young woman from Qishan City."
"Under extreme fear, from the moment she entered the map she was in an emotional breakdown, weeping incessantly, never once checking her personal panel, nor knowing she was the ghost. Under these circumstances, she was killed by other players."
"Therefore, the map fell into a state without a ghost, leaving the remaining players trapped within, unable to leave, resulting in mutual slaughter until complete annihilation."
"Backtracking complete. No bugs appeared in this replica; no repairs necessary."
"The team wipeout is the autonomous choice of the players."
"This replica has been permanently sealed."
"..."
Chen Yi looked at the writing on the wall, his eyes narrowing slightly without speaking; these words likely explained why these players died here, but there was another question he had not cleared up: why did each player's eyes carry that ambiguous gaze, as if half-corroded by desire, huddled together?
He could understand the smiles on everyone's faces.
To prove they were not the ghost, after all, the replica's rules stated that a ghost could not smile.
But he couldn't comprehend why everyone was eroded by desire—that was something he couldn't understand. What was the reason for this?
After observing for a moment at the entrance of the room, Chen Yi stepped back out, his head bowed in thought without speaking. He had probably figured out the situation, or more accurately, he had a guess, but he felt this guess was likely accurate.
"Confirmed."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had also finished observing, nodded seriously and said, "This is the infinite loop, exactly like those infinite loop novels I've read. These Reincarnators linger on the brink of life and death in various replicas, then return to the Reincarnation space to become stronger."
"It's just that I didn't expect such a thing to actually exist."
"I always thought this thing only existed in novels, but when I think about it carefully, I can understand. After all, even game leveling up can exist; then a Reincarnation space that allows Reincarnators to become stronger is also quite normal," he said.
"One thing I'm very curious about is, if this game leveling up and the Reincarnation space were to meet, which one would be stronger?"
"There's no need to compare,"
Chen Yi said calmly, shaking his head, "If I'm not mistaken, both are created by the same group of people. Do you remember what I saw at the bottom of the sea?"
"There was someone called the Overlord who gathered the remaining power to start researching how to dissolve the power within Deities to distribute to mortals, allowing them to become stronger and to quickly screen for beings that could fight against Deities. However, I heard it's quite cruel; many people will have to die."
"If I'm not wrong, this Reincarnation space was created by the same people, using this method to screen for those who can stand against Deities."
"But obviously, they failed."
"Hence the game leveling up appeared, and whether it's the game leveling up or the Reincarnation space, the ultimate goal is to screen for the so-called God Slaughterers."
"But..."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit hesitated and then said, "Hasn't the screening already been done? Jiang Chenglu can already slaughter gods, right? And he has succeeded, which means isn't one enough?"
"Not sure about that,"
Chen Yi shook his head, "We still know too little."
...
In the following period, the entire Blue Star began to frequently discover ruins left behind by the Reincarnation space.
More precisely, these were permanently sealed copies.
But whether by accident or not, these copies, which had been permanently sealed at some unknown time, all burst out during the this update failure, and most copies contained only corpses, creating an extremely tragic scene. Besides that, there was nothing else.
But some curses, unknown to people, drifted toward the Blue Star.
For example...
In Black Trench City, at a barbecue stall, seven or eight men huddled around a table, which was cluttered with chilled beer and skewers. The burly man at the head of the table, looking somewhat excited, thumped his beer cup heavily on the table before raising it mid-air.
"Damn it, the no-drinking rule in October really stifled me, but finally it's November. Raise your glasses, for tonight, we shall not rest until we're drunk."
No sooner had he spoken than several bare-chested men around him echoed in agreement. However, one of the men hesitated and said, "I heard the update failure caused a lot of trouble, unfurling many curses from unearthed copies."
"Isn't it bad timing for us to be drinking now?"
"What's there to be afraid of?"
"Come on, cheers!"
No sooner had he spoken,
than one of the men at the table toppled over as if unable to hold his liquor, blurry-eyed and faint.
"This guy, what a lightweight. Come on, let's continue, cheers once more!"
Another man blurred and fell over.
"What's going on? Since when did these two become so weak? Come on, let's go again."
Yet another man likewise toppled over, unable to hold his liquor.
In just a short time, the table that had been surrounded by seven or eight men abruptly had only three men left.
At this moment, the burly leader who had been sitting in the place of honor also realized something was wrong. He looked toward his two remaining brothers and tentatively raised his cup, hesitating, "The three of us, cheers?"
"Thud!"
Almost as soon as he finished speaking, one of the last three men also thumped to the ground.
"Boss!"
The only remaining man, who had initially suggested that it was not a good time to drink, looked at the boss with a pale face and trembling voice, "Let's not continue, put down the cup. If we keep going like this, we'll all be down!"
"This isn't cheers; this is 'falling down'!"
"It's clear we've been cursed!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 546 368: "Ability Name": "The Toilet in the Dream is Fake.
chapters.content:
```
And this scenario was unfolding in many corners of Blue Star.
But it wasn't happening very frequently.
Probably just one or two instances per city.
Right next to this dining table, a man wearing a duckbill cap sat alone by the table drinking, not lifting his head at the commotion around him, just the corner of his mouth curving up into a strange arc.
The next second—
"Hey!"
A somewhat exasperated voice rang out beside his ear.
The man with the duckbill cap suddenly had his hat smacked off by a slap, and before he could react, his cheek met the table in an intimate encounter.
Tuberculosis Rabbit lifted his foot that was pinning the man's head down on the table, clenched his fist and took a breath, then yelled out and forcefully smashed it down on the man's head.
"I hit!"
Then,
he saw the man suddenly turn into a gust of wind and dissipate on the spot, his clothes and duckbill cap turning to ashes and vanishing, while a prompt also slowly sounded in Tuberculosis Rabbit's ear.
「Ding, congratulations on killing an unknown creature. The ability of this creature is: "Come, take one."」
「"Come, take one": When someone by a dining table says 'Come, take one,' one person at that table will randomly die.」
「This creature has been killed for the first time, and it needs to be killed 999 more times to be thoroughly exterminated.」
"What kind of ghost ability is this?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the popping up prompt panel with a bit of speechlessness and pursed his lips.
It was already November 4th today.
Four days had passed since the system update on November 1st, and they had gradually discovered the changes brought about by this shutdown update, which could roughly be understood as digging up some ancient graves that were left behind many years ago.
And among these, there were all sorts of messy stuff.
The game called them creatures, and they went along and called them that; creatures came in all forms—sometimes as a man, sometimes as a woman, sometimes as a completely ordinary-looking dog, and sometimes as a dustbin that would move stealthily by the roadside when people were not paying attention.
In short, appearances were varied.
Whether these creatures could freely change their appearance or if it was random, they were not clear, but these days they had also summarized some methods to identify these creatures.
And almost every creature had a unique ability, just like the one he had just killed. Left unchecked, simply letting it stay at a barbecue stall for a night could mean a lot of people.
If the game hadn't come, he would have really hated to kill this creature.
The ability of this creature could greatly increase the number of jobs he got as a funeral director.
In these four days, they had killed quite a few creatures and witnessed a number of special creature abilities.
For example, one creature's ability was "Don't steal my shit to eat."
The creature that owned this ability appeared as a harmless-looking dog; when they discovered it, this dog was lying in the middle of the sidewalk, lazily basking in the sun like other animals.
「Ability Name」: Don't steal my shit to eat.
「Ability Explanation」: "Any feces within my territory can only be enjoyed by me; if anyone else touches the feces, it will turn into a powerful sticky bomb that explodes instantly."
Hmm.
Although this ability seemed powerful, only one person died from it.
After all, most people still watch where they're walking and try not to step in dog shit. And nobody stands in a restroom bouncing around—just one unlucky player had bad luck and got into trouble.
Most other players were fine.
When they found this creature, it had already been killed 19 times.
All the creatures that appeared this time had to be killed once before being randomly teleported to any corner of Blue Star; any creature must be killed a thousand times before truly being exterminated.
"Yet another magical ability."
Sword Without End thoughtfully looked at the spot where the man had disappeared: "Isn't it said that Props come from powers extracted from Deities? Have you ever felt that these creatures are like experiments?"
"A long time ago, a group of people tried to steal the powers of Deities, thereby creating the existence of creatures."
And right at that moment—
"Excuse me, Tuberculosis Rabbit, if I may ask, are my friends dead?"
The man who had been toasting a moment ago, upon seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit and his group, roughly understood that he was definitely hit and sobered up instantly, his voice trembling as he spoke.
This was Yancheng.
In Yancheng, there weren't many players who wouldn't recognize Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Especially those among the dregs.
After all, they definitely had no chance of mingling with Yi on normal days, but interaction with Tuberculosis Rabbit was possible; occasionally, he would come to their lowly places seeking some fun.
"Hmm."
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a cigarette from his pocket, put it in his mouth, glanced around casually and said, "Dead, dead as they can be. How strong were these friends of yours? Can they crawl out of hell?"
"If they can't make it back, you're probably going to have a lot fewer drinking buddies."
And the young man standing beside him was now looking down at his friends lying on the ground with a pained expression. It was just a moment ago they were all happily drinking together, and now they were separated by life and death.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 547 368: "Ability Name": "The Bathroom in Dreams is Fake."_2
chapters.content:
He knew the strength of these friends of his well.
It would be difficult for them to crawl out of hell anytime soon, he estimated.
He had just casually mentioned that he had heard there were curses lately, so maybe they should stop drinking. He swore he had said it casually, not expecting the curse to actually come knocking so soon, and for such a random curse at that.
Say "one goes," and randomly, one goes.
This was even scarier than the phone killers in those horror novels.
"I..."
The middle-aged man's mouth slowly opened and closed without speaking, clearly the dominant figure among the group. Upon hearing that it would be very hard to see his friends again, the man took a deep breath.
He pulled a gun from his embrace and, without a second word, pressed it to the temple of the young man beside him.
"Bang."
The young man didn't have time to react before he fell into a pool of blood, his gaze vacant.
The middle-aged man then pressed the muzzle of the gun under his own chin, his voice hoarse, "Tuberculosis Rabbit, we brothers have been through life and death together. Since they can't come up, then I'll go down to continue drinking with them."
"I'm off."
"Bang."
The sound of the gun echoed once more.
The middle-aged man also fell.
"..."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the two bodies lying in pools of blood and fell silent for a long time before turning to Sword Without End at his side, "This is why guns are banned before leveling up in the game. Guns are too quick to kill; they don't even offer a chance for rescue."
"Get emotional, and you just shoot yourself."
"That's indeed true."
Sword Without End nodded with emotion, "I remember watching a video before. A father who ran a small store had an argument with his child. I forgot what the argument was about, but I remember the father pulling out a gun from his embrace and placing it on the counter, saying something like 'why don't you just die.'
"The child, without any hesitation, picked up the gun and shot himself in the temple."
"Dead on the spot."
"The whole process was smooth and fluid, with no chance for rescue. If someone decides to commit suicide with a gun, there really is no hope for rescue. But I'm more curious, did that man just now ask his little brother if he wanted to go to hell with him?"
"Um... I don't think so."
"Forget it, forget it."
Tuberculosis Rabbit casually waved his hand and left the barbecue stall, heading down an alley, "There are still many weird things to get rid of. Let's not bother with these for now and quickly eradicate those oddities."
These days, he and Sword Without End had been constantly clearing the weirdness in Yancheng.
The bodies of these oddities were very fragile, almost certain to be killed as soon as they were hit, but they hid too well, making them difficult to find.
For some reason, these oddities seemed curious about Yi, always looking for him. Although they could never hurt Yi, they did make him quite irritable.
The abilities of these oddities were not strong.
But they were enough to be a nuisance.
For example—
'Ability Name': "The toilet in dreams is fake."
'Ability Explanation': Can cause all sleeping people in an area to wet the bed.
An ability with no lethality.
But it made countless adults relive their childhood feelings, experiencing once again the sensation of desperately searching for a bathroom in a dream, finding relief, and then vaguely feeling the mattress becoming damp.
He only remembered.
Waking up that morning, Yi had nearly slaughtered the whole of Yancheng, and it was him who held Yi back.
He had never seen Yi so flustered and exasperated before—no, frustrated wasn't the right word to describe it. It was rage. After that incident, Yi issued a Must-Kill Order on these oddities that suddenly appeared after the game update.
Upon discovery,
They must be eradicated.
But these oddities were truly difficult to kill, and killing them once wouldn't do the job; it had to be done 1000 times. Fortunately, although killing them once didn't finish them off, it would cause the oddity to be randomly transported elsewhere, essentially driving them out of Yancheng.
But...
There were also quite a few strange creatures that were killed and transported to their Yancheng.
The entire process seemed to have become a closed loop that they couldn't escape from, unless they killed all these creatures a thousand times.
Strange creatures are very difficult to recognize.
Their biggest method of recognition was through common sense judgments, like the man wearing a duckbill hat just now, who didn't even turn his head to look at the commotion behind him, but instead sat alone eating barbecue.
This was abnormal, and abnormality meant there was something ghostly.
Another method to recognize strange creatures was that no matter what their appearance, they always acted alone—they would never move in pairs.
And then, it was down to instinct.
As long as one killed enough, they could always sense when something was off about a person.
They had originally been tracking a strange creature that looked like a woman, and they happened to pass by this barbecue stall, where they incidentally discovered and casually killed another creature.
The ability of the strange creature that looked like a woman was somewhat chilling.
"Ability Name": "You must be happy."
"Ability Explanation": It would make every creature within a certain area believe that it was a tree.
It had no killing power either.
But it could significantly affect the operation of the entire city—this was tantamount to turning a portion of the city's population into trees, how was one supposed to deal with that?
The most terrifying part was.
They couldn't understand the priority of the rules of this ability at all, Yi and the others were shrouded by this ability for an entire day, during which they all believed they were trees.
After standing quietly on the rooftop for a day and a night, they had no realization of what was happening.
Tuberculosis Rabbit still vaguely remembered standing devoutly on the rooftop, arms outstretched, wondering why it wasn't raining yet—he was almost dying of thirst—and pondering when he would bear fruit.
If it weren't for the fact that the strange creature, looking like that woman, had left their area after a day and a night.
They might not have realized what was happening even now, and would still be standing on the rooftop as tree stumps.
Even Yi had fallen prey.
The priority of the rules of this ability far surpassed any prop on Yi, not even "Forever Pure" had been activated passively—perhaps this prop didn't consider Yi's state to be a negative effect at all?
Just at that moment—
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End suddenly stopped walking, squinting their eyes and glancing at each other before pulling out their weapons from within their coats, slowly stepping onto the street in front of them.
Under the night sky, the street in front of them seemed unusually quiet, with numerous pedestrians standing still with arms outstretched to the heavens, devout in expression as if possessed by some cult.
But only Tuberculosis Rabbit knew that these people were waiting for the rain, already believing they were trees.
He even saw a cat standing still with arms outstretched to the sky—this cat also believed it was a tree.
This indicated that the female ghost, who could make people think they were trees, was nearby.
There was a magnetic field forming in the vicinity.
This magnetic field affected every living thing in the range.
But as they stepped into it, they remained unaffected. Over these days, they had already discovered a pattern: these area-of-effect abilities of the strange creatures had a cooldown period—they weren't passive skills and couldn't be reused repeatedly.
And they could only affect those who were initially within the ability's range.
For instance, if the people on this street were influenced by the strange creature to believe they were trees, they wouldn't be affected if they entered the area at that moment.
The ability to define the range only affected those initially caught by it, posing no threat to those who came later.
It has to be said, this was a piece of good news.
Otherwise, just by that strange creature sitting there without moving, these people would have to live their entire lives as trees, unable to do anything, and this area would become an absolute trap.
"Huh!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit took a deep breath, slowly tossed the nearly extinguished cigarette from his mouth to the ground beside him, and stomped it out forcefully before reversing his grip on the Claw Knife and slowly walking into the street ahead.
Any strange creature only had that unique special ability.
Physical strength was almost zero.
It was just that their ability to hide was too strong, not easy to find—once the strange creature's true body was found, even a rookie player could easily kill it, without any difficulty at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 369: "Do as you see fit, just call me when it's time to eat.
chapters.content:
Even a mischievous child could kill a supernatural entity if he could bring himself to do it. Although the Ascension game environment was harsh, it wasn't cruel enough to make a child kill without changing his expression.
Before the advent of the Ascension game, some remote countries indeed were capable of fostering such scenarios.
Right when Tuberculosis Rabbit cautiously stepped into the street ahead, weapon in hand.
...
Chen Yi, frowning, leaned back in his beach chair on the rooftop, closing his eyes in irritation without speaking.
"What's wrong?"
Jiaye snuggled into Chen Yi's embrace, raised her finger, and slowly drew irregular circles on his chest, asking softly, "What are you thinking about?"
"I'm thinking about my brother."
After a long silence, Chen Yi finally said, "I have a twin brother named Chen Zimu, a name chosen to reflect the humble aspiration to cultivate oneself. But it's been a long time since I've seen him, and I've lost contact."
"I wonder how he's doing now."
"Hm?"
A flicker of confusion crossed Jiaye's eyes as she asked a bit stunned, "Since when do you have a biological brother, Yi?"
"I've always had one."
"But how come I've never heard you mention him?"
"It's been many years since we've seen each other, so I've never talked about it."
"Oh..."
Jiaye nodded, seemingly lost in thought, before speaking softly after a moment, "Actually, I also have a twin sister named Peiqi, who I haven't seen for a long time. We were separated when we were very young."
"You have a sister?"
Chen Yi, who had been lost in thought, suddenly furrowed his brows, looking down at Jiaye in his arms, "How could you possibly have a twin sister? Didn't you grow up with Tie Chui?"
"If you had a twin sister, why have you never mentioned her before?"
"I haven't mentioned her? I might have forgotten to tell you, Yi, but I do have one."
"..."
Chen Yi, with an expressionless face, fell silent for a moment before turning his head to glance at Tie Chui: "You don't happen to have a twin brother too, do you?"
"Um..."
Tie Chui nodded vigorously, speaking with a resonant voice, "He... his name is Mote."
"I see."
Chen Yi nodded and fell silent again, then with dissatisfaction activated a Prop from his backpack. Instantly, the whole neighborhood appeared before him in a three-dimensional form, with every player in the neighborhood projected into the model.
This was clearly a 3D omnidirectional surveillance system.
Exceptionally detailed.
Immediately after, Chen Yi noticed something special—a peach tree in the neighborhood. He had lived there for a long time, residing in the neighborhood even before the Ascension game started.
He was certain.
There had never been a peach tree there, nor could it have been planted in the past few days.
Without any hesitation.
Chen Yi leapt down from the rooftop, the Buddha holding a Gatling gun appearing midair, knees bent, as countless bullets rained down on the peach tree like a torrential downpour.
The next second—
'Ding, congratulations on killing an unknown supernatural entity. The entity's ability was: "Twins."'
'"Twins": All players within a certain range will sincerely believe they have a long-lost twin.'
'This entity has been killed for the 9th time, it needs to be killed 991 more times to be completely eradicated.'
The instant the peach tree vanished, the strange sensation in Chen Yi's heart also disappeared, and he no longer believed he should have a twin brother.
"Will this ever end?"
Chen Yi frowned slightly in annoyance, scanning his surroundings as he considered how to quickly resolve the crisis.
In the past several days.
Countless supernaturals with various unique abilities had nearly run rampant across the globe. Moreover, the special abilities of these supernaturals had an extremely high priority; none of the Props on his body could block them.
'Absolute Purity,' a Prop that should be able to pull him out of any negative state, hadn't been triggered at all.
These supernatural abilities had altered his memory, while the one that made him believe he was a great tree had altered his cognition.
Both states were not considered negative.
How could believing oneself to be a tree be a negative state? Some people even believed they were trash bags—could that possibly be considered negative?
And then—
"Yi?"
A familiar voice came from nearby.
There came Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End, striding into the neighborhood through the gate. They saw Chen Yi, deep in thought inside the compound, and asked with some confusion, "Yi, what are you doing standing here alone?"
But then, noticing the Buddha with the Gatling gun's barrel still slowly rotating in midair, they suddenly realized and spoke up.
"Another supernatural entity came looking for trouble?"
"Yes."
Chen Yi shook his head in slight displeasure, "These supernaturals must be dealt with quickly, or we won't even be able to sleep peacefully."
Indeed.
Most supernatural entities did not possess overly strong aggressiveness.
For example, causing you to wet the bed in your dreams, or making you think you are a tree—these abilities were generally not powerful, and a supernatural would never stay in one place for too long, preventing people in an area from constantly believing they were trees.
But, they would completely disrupt one's life all the same.
So far.
They had not encountered any supernaturals with particularly strong aggression, the one with the power 'Come, take one' being the most aggressive they had encountered recently. Such vigorous supernaturals had never been seen by them.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 369: "Do as you see fit, call me when it's time to eat."_2
chapters.content:
"They're easy to kill but hard to find."
The Tuberculosis Rabbit somewhat helplessly spread his hands: "Their peculiar defensive abilities are pretty weak, and as long as you find them, you can kill them. However, searching for them in an endless sea of people is truly no easy task."
"Especially since some don't even look human."
"We must wait for them to create peculiar incidents before we can discover them right away; otherwise, there really isn't any good way to find them."
"Forget it."
Chen Yi shook his head and didn't say anything more. As long as you kill these peculiar creatures 1000 times, they will be completely dead. With so many players on Blue Star, killing these creatures 1000 times isn't too difficult."
Eventually, these peculiar creatures will naturally be eradicated.
"Let's head up first."
...
After returning to the roof, Chen Yi took out two chilled beers from the fridge and handed them to Sword Without End and the Tuberculosis Rabbit. Then, he turned to look at his profession panel.
Today was already October 4th.
His occupation had been updated again.
The Playboy occupation that had caused him such grief had finally been dropped randomly; he never wanted to randomly get such an occupation ever again in his life.
-
'Occupation Name': Cosmic Traveler.
'Occupational Effect': You can take your friends with you to various Starfields and planets. No matter the distance, you can bypass any barrier, even if it's from a cage or off the map. You can use this effect anywhere.
Nothing in this world can imprison you; you are a carefree being.
You should experience everything this world has to offer.
However, as a tradeoff, you cannot attack other players; all of your attacks will fail to affect other players.
'Occupational Restriction': You can bring up to 5 friends with you, and each time you teleport a friend, it will cost you 10k points, plus you'll be subjected to a 24-hour cooldown period after each teleport.
-
"Cosmic Traveler?"
Chen Yi thoughtfully looked at the occupation panel and after a moment, found Li Yi in the private chat panel, sending him a message.
'Li Yi bro, I'm bringing some friends to visit your Awesome Starfield. We'll play for a few days.'
'No problem, warmly welcome. I've arranged all your accommodations.'
'Thanks.'
The reply from the other side was quick and straightforward.
To Li Yi, the cost of housing a few people in terms of points wasn't even as high as what he pays his cleaning staff when he takes a dump; it was hardly money at all.
Similarly straightforward, Chen Yi immediately took out a global speaker.
The next second—
'Global Speaker': I'm Chen Yi. I'm taking you to roam the Awesome Starfield for seven days. During these seven days, you can move freely, but you should know that the players on the Awesome Starfield are all from the Threefold Planet and not ones you can afford to provoke.
The maps on the Awesome Starfield aren't something you can mess with given your current strength.
Just take it as a sightseeing trip to broaden your horizons.
Don't get too involved in anything else.
If you die, just head back to Blue Star Hell, and you're good. This trip is entirely voluntary. I will send an invitation to each person; those who want to take a stroll can confirm, while those who don't, can just decline.
'Global Speaker': ...
After a long absence, the global announcement echoed in every Blue Star player's ears.
The voice wasn't loud, but it was deafening.
Taking the whole of Blue Star's players on a trip?
"Yi bro? How are we going out?"
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who didn't know Yi's occupation had been updated, looked at Yi with complete bewilderment. "We can't even leave ourselves; how are we going to take the Blue Star players out?"
He naturally wanted to go out.
There were quite a few exciting things at that Sky City on Awesome Starfield, and the brothels there were also very advanced, with many things he had never seen before, much more fun than what was available in Yancheng.
But as new players, they fundamentally didn't have the means to leave Blue Star.
"Here."
Chen Yi didn't speak; he simply shared his occupation panel.
"So that's how it is!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End nodded their heads in sudden realization, and then they broke into excited grins, "Well what are we waiting for, let's get going!"
"Let's go!"
With no hesitation, Chen Yi invited all Blue Star players right away, Though originally only able to take five players through time-space travel, his "Faceless One" occupation lifted all Occupational Restrictions, allowing him to bring as many people as he wanted.
If only this occupation could exist forever.
Later on, just bring an army and drop into the enemy's bedroom.
A whole army falling from the sky, talk about thrilling!
The next second—
Almost ninety percent of Blue Star's population chose to leave with Yi, and in an instant, nearly all Blue Star players turned into beams of white light, leaving Blue Star barren.
Only a scattered few who were reluctant to venture out remained.
These past few days, everyone had enough of those weird creatures; they weren't too deadly, as these players had seen all sorts of things since the game's tier had been reduced, bringing them to the present.
In terms of danger, these creatures were nothing but child's play.
But they were unbearably annoying.
Just the perfect time to escape these weird creatures and travel with Yi.
As Blue Star emptied in an instant, those weird creatures started looking foolish, wondering where everyone had gone so suddenly, their instincts driving them towards the few players who hadn't gone traveling.
So...
"..."
A young man stood rooted to the spot, full of fear and resentment, with his arms high as if he were a large tree; thousands of these weird creatures had gathered around him.
Countless abilities acted upon him.
He hardly had the time to pose.
So busy.
The only thought in his mind was extreme regret. Why on earth did he refuse? He had stayed behind out of fear of death, and now it seemed like he was about to die even quicker!!!
...
Titles above the heads of new players are passively and forcibly displayed, unable to be turned off.
After Chen Yi acquired the status of Seed Player, all Blue Star players had received the title "Protection of the God Yi."
Every player had it.
Mandatorily obtained, and mandatory to wear.
So—
When a dense crowd of Blue Star players, each bearing the title "Protection of the God Yi," descended upon Awesome Starfield, Li Yi, who was chatting and joking with Wang Qi, was stunned in place.
And as more and more Blue Star players continuously surged out of the portal—
For some reason,
there was a moment when Li Yi felt like he was witnessing the scene of the Void Clan invading Awesome Starfield again.
"You really are hospitable..."
Wang Qi's mouth slowly opened, his expression shock as he murmured at the spectacle before him, "So many people, Chen Yi's bringing the entire Blue Star's players over, huh? This doesn't look like they're here for a visit, more like an invasion."
"That Li Yi, even though we're good friends, that's all I can do. When Yi moves against you, I won't kick you while you're down; you understand me, right?"
"I'm no match for Chen Yi."
"You... just take care of yourself, and call me when the feast is ready."
"Impossible!"
The previously flustered Li Yi instantly snapped back to reality, "It can't be an invasion. If it were, Chen Yi wouldn't have brought so many people. With Chen Yi's ability to slaughter Ninefold players, he could wipe out the whole Awesome Starfield alone."
"So many people, Chen Yi's bringing the entire Blue Star's players over, huh? This doesn't look like they're here for a visit, more like an invasion."
"That Li Yi, even though we're good friends, that's all I can do. When Yi moves against you, I won't kick you while you're down; you understand me, right?"
"I'm no match for Chen Yi."
"You... just take care of yourself, and call me when the feast is ready."
"Impossible!"
The previously flustered Li Yi instantly snapped back to reality, "It can't be an invasion. If it were, Chen Yi wouldn't have brought so many people. With Chen Yi's ability to slaughter Ninefold players, he could wipe out the whole Awesome Starfield alone."

chapters.title: Chapter 550 370: "I knew Chief Li was someone who appreciates art.
chapters.content:
However, the portal still didn't stop; a steady stream of Blue Star players continued to surge out.
Each Blue Star player's pupils brimmed with intelligent light, sizing up this magical world.
This was their first time stepping out of Blue Star to come to another world.
If it were before the level-up game had arrived, this would have counted as traveling to another world indeed.
"Brother Li Yi."
Chen Yi walked out of the crowd and approached Li Yi, standing with one hand on his cane and laughing, "Sorry for the trouble, everyone's been a bit bored lately, just coming out to take a break. There are quite a few people, so we'll have to trouble you a bit more."
Although his status was no longer what it once was, in the hearts of Li Yi and the others, he was an existence comparable to a player from the Ninefold Planet, the player who had once killed Jiang Chenglu.
They were no longer of the same rank.
But he still called Li Yi Brother Li Yi.
One reason was out of habit, since Li Yi had helped him quite a bit, and secondly because his own people knew his business—if not for Jiang Chenglu dropping all defenses and standing still for him to kill, he wouldn't have even been able to breach the defense, let alone kill Jiang Chenglu.
"That's not a problem... Ancestor Chen, you're too polite."
Li Yi looked bittersweetly at the throng behind Chen Yi. When had he ever seen such a sight? Since the inception of the level-up game, there had never been such a massive Starfield transfer scene!
The cost of Starfield shuttles was very high!
The Points it would take for such a big group to transit the Starfield were astronomical. Even players from the Sixfold or Sevenfold Planets might not be able to afford it, unless they used the power of their entire clan, with each player emptying out their Points.
"But... but I really can't come up with the Points needed for such a massive inter-Starfield travel," said Li Yi. "I didn't know you'd bring so many people, Ancestor..."
"No need."
Chen Yi shook his head casually, "I have a Prop that waives the fee, so there's no cost. Also, no need to call me Ancestor, calling me Yi as before is fine."
"Alright, Yi. Rest assured, I'll issue the order right now to have everyone on Awesome Starfield give way when they see your Blue Star players. They definitely won't harbor any ill intentions towards your players."
"That's also unnecessary."
Chen Yi shook his head again, "I'm not their fucking parent, can't always be looking after them. They're not flowers in a greenhouse. I brought them out this time with the intention of training them."
"If they die, they die. They can just crawl back out of Blue Star Hell anyway."
"It's not like they are permanently dead."
"Let them experience more early on, and then once the Novice Period is over, everything will be fine."
"Alright, whatever you say, Yi. Like last time, I'll arrange for a private vehicle to take you to Sky City first."
"No need."
Chen Yi sneered inwardly. The greatest insult he had suffered last time on Awesome Starfield was the indignity of requiring a transportation vehicle for his travel as a Seed Player—wasn't that mocking him for not having a decent Vehicle of his own? The Sacred Christmas Sled he had hammered out with billions of Points was made precisely for today!
The next second——
A gigantic sled abruptly materialized in mid-air, wrapped by thousands of protective shields, and at the rear of the sled, there were nearly a thousand helium engines. These engines were linked together like a massive dragon's tail.
It looked incredibly eye-catching.
"This..."
Li Yi was somewhat shocked as he gazed at this stunning Vehicle before him, momentarily losing his composure. He had never seen a vehicle that was... so, well, so hideous!
It lacked any design line of aesthetic beauty for a Vehicle.
The aerodynamics were nonexistent!
And the appearance was utterly lacking, it was just a hodgepodge of parts!
It looked like something a scavenger had cobbled together.
"Not bad,"
Chen Yi nodded in approval, "I named it the Chinese Dragon."
Then he turned to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others.
"Get on; we're heading to Sky City for a vacation."
...
Accompanied by a harsh roar, the Chinese Dragon slowly spewed blinding orange flames, accelerating toward the horizon at nearly seventy Mach, slicing through the sky.
"This..."
Long after Chen Yi and the others had gone, Li Yi finally snapped out of his shock, murmuring to Wang Qi at his side, "With Yi's strength so great, why is he using such a shabby Vehicle?"
Although the vehicle's power was indeed strong, it was just too ugly.
It somewhat didn't suit Yi's status.
"Maybe it's because Yi was on the Novice Planet, and due to rule restrictions, he couldn't get a stronger Vehicle. Or maybe Yi has grown fond of this Vehicle?"
"Forget it."
Li Yi shook his head, abandoning the thought, and turned to his subordinate, "Inform everyone to watch out when they see these Blue Star players and not to provoke them."
"Understood."
Wang Qi looked thoughtfully at the departing subordinate of Li Yi and said, "Didn't Chen Yi specifically instruct not to make arrangements, saying he came for training the Blue Star players this trip? Not afraid of death, why did you still go out of your way to instruct them?"
"What do you think... I don't want to hear news of Yi suddenly annihilating Awesome Starfield, it'd be terrifying."
...
In the following days, the Blue Star players had a wonderfully happy vacation.
It wasn't like what Yi had said it would be.
There were no random players from the Threefold Planet coming to challenge them; everyone coexisted peacefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 551 370: "I knew Chief Li was someone who appreciates art."_2
chapters.content:
"Everyone says that players of Alien Races have fiery tempers, but it looks like you guys love peace too,"
Li Yide wrapped his arm around a Minotaur and clicked his tongue in appreciation, "I've had such a great time chatting with you today. When I leave the Novice Planet later on, I'm definitely going to find you and we'll have a huge drink together."
"No problem."
The Minotaur smiled bitterly inside, feeling somewhat helpless.
It wasn't that they were fond of peace.
With that glaringly obvious "Yi God's Gecko" title above your heads, who would dare to mess with you? At this time, Chen Yi's reputation in the entire game was exceptionally loud—nobody would dare to touch a member of Yi God's clan.
Wouldn't that be asking for an extermination?
Just then—
A slightly drunken Minotaur stumbled over, pointed at Li Yide's nose with an indignant expression, and cursed loudly, "To hell with your peace! Do you have any idea how much you've held us up recently? If it wasn't for you..."
Before he could finish.
Dozens of machetes simultaneously pierced into the body of the Minotaur from every corner.
More Minotaur players quickly stepped forward to drag the corpse away and apologized to Li Yide with smiles, suggesting it was an accident.
"He had too much to drink."
The first Minotaur to speak wrapped his arm around Li Yide's shoulder and said earnestly, "He had too much, remembered an old TV show he used to watch, and got carried away with role-playing. Don't worry about this, brother; we'll sober him up."
"He'll be fine once he's sober."
"It's not about you."
"Sober him up?"
Li Yide looked bewilderedly at the dragged-away Minotaur corpse, sensing something was amiss, "Is this your special way of sobering up? He's probably never waking up again like this, right?"
"No, he'll sober up instantly in hell—the fastest way to come around."
"That makes sense..."
He didn't pay too much attention to the matter.
...
In the meantime, Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit were having a blast vacationing in Sky City over the past few days.
Shopping became Tuberculosis Rabbit and company's main theme.
They even bought a shopping mall.
"Deal."
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the Lisu Tribal Chief across the table with satisfaction, stood up, and collected the contract, "Then thank you for parting with this mall and selling it to us, honorable Chief of the Lisu Tribe."
To one side, the notary, seeing both parties had signed, stamped the document and announced loudly,
"On November 6th, the Lisu Tribe sold a six-floor shopping mall covering 60,000 square meters, located on the south street of Sky City, to Tuberculosis Rabbit for the price of 8.88 million Points. All Lisu merchants must vacate the mall within one day and may not remove any of the original scenery or decorations from the mall."
"The Chief of the Lisu Tribe is so generous,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up, took the contract, and reached out first in a gesture of friendship, smiling, "To sell such a profitable mall to us for merely 8.88 million Points, you might be taking too much of a loss. It's not too late to back out now."
"I won't back out, won't back out."
Although the Chief of the Lisu Tribe's face was a mask of pain, his voice trembled as if he were about to cry, "As long as Yi can spare us, that'll be enough. The Sixfold Planet player Yi God encountered in that S-ranked map last time wasn't sought out by us intentionally; they forced our hand."
"We really had no choice."
"The father and son who bothered Mr. Tuberculosis Rabbit last time have been dealt with by us."
At this moment, his heart was bleeding, the pain was indescribable, but he had no other option.
What's done was done and it had to be handled this way.
These days, he had been trying to get Chief Li to contact Chen Yi, wanting at all costs to make reparations and resolve past misunderstandings, but he never received a reply. Then news came that Chen Yi was bringing players from all over the world to Awesome Starfield.
He was so frightened that he nearly fell off the toilet, cut off in midstream.
It was clear they were coming to annihilate his Tribe!!!
Learning that Tuberculosis Rabbit was preparing to buy a mall in Sky City, he hurriedly approached them, offering to give Chen Yi their tribe's mall for free just to earn his forgiveness.
According to market value, the mall with all its fixtures was worth at least 2 billion Points.
8.88 million Points was an absolute giveaway.
Most importantly, this mall was a major source of income for the Lisu Tribe; without it, they would have to cancel many plans for a long time due to a shortage of Points.
But there was nothing else to be done.
After all, they knew well the difference between losing a commercial seat and being annihilated.
Originally, their intention was to just give it directly to Chen Yi, but then Tuberculosis Rabbit insisted that they must offer money. He told them to name their price, arguing that it shouldn't appear to the outside world like they were plundering; it should seem like a fair transaction. At that time, they actually thought Tuberculosis Rabbit was serious.
So they tentatively offered 2 billion.
Then they saw Tuberculosis Rabbit opening his personal panel to contact Yi, and they got so scared they quickly changed their offer, hastily saying that there was a promotion going on and they would only ask for 880,000 Points.
Only then did Tuberculosis Rabbit's face regain its smile, and he added another 8 million Points to their offer, settling on a price of 8.88 million Points.
The deal was thus formally concluded.
...
In the following days, Tuberculosis Rabbit was incredibly busy, pulling together all the renovation teams in Sky City to undertake a massive renovation of the shopping center, influenced by monetary and fame capabilities.
In just one day, the appearance of the shopping center underwent a major transformation.
And the shopping center was given a new name:
"Yi God Paradise."
Furthermore, Tuberculosis Rabbit nagged Chen Yi into shuttling back and forth between Blue Star and Awesome Starfield, bringing back a vast amount of specialty products from Blue Star to display in the shopping center.
Tea, ceramics, silk etc., countless specialty products from Blue Star.
He also spent a fortune to commission a designer to create an artistic logo with the characters "Yi God," which was printed on every product, and all the products were priced exorbitantly.
The cheapest porcelain started at 88,000 Points.
And those were the kind produced by modern industrial processes.
It was all about luxury goods; there wasn't a single item in the entire shopping center that was good value for money.
...
Two days later, on November 9.
They had been in Awesome Starfield for about four or five days.
The shopping center began its trial operation.
An instant influx of people crowded the entire shopping center; in fact, during these days of renovation, nearly half of Awesome Starfield's population learned that Chen Yi had opened a shopping mall in Sky City selling special products from Blue Star.
There was no ribbon-cutting ceremony.
But Li Yi still shamelessly barged in, earnestly taking Tuberculosis Rabbit's hand and sincerely said, "I have always been especially enamored with Blue Star's culture, especially these ceramics. I must buy some for myself."
Then he looked at a piece of porcelain on the first floor, priced at 880,000 Points, and said seriously, "I'll take all the porcelain here, please fulfill this wish of your younger brother."
"This one?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit pretended to have a sudden realization and nodded, "It's clear to see Former Leader Li is someone who truly appreciates porcelain, but the pieces here are actually not valuable. Come with me to the fourth floor; the items there are more fitting for someone of Former Leader Li's stature."
Li Yi followed Tuberculosis Rabbit to the fourth floor in silence, looking slightly startled.
Soon, they reached the fourth floor.
"Here."
Tuberculosis Rabbit pointed to an exquisite piece of porcelain on a countertop on the fourth floor, his face showing satisfaction, and remarked, "Even in Blue Star, this kind of porcelain is extremely rare, only the very top-tier wealthy can afford to have it in their homes."
"It's priced at 188 million Points, non-negotiable."
"Well, Former Leader Li, do you like this piece?"
"..."
Li Yi looked at the porcelain on the countertop in front of him in a daze, and after a long moment of confusion, turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit and murmured unconsciously, "Am I allowed to like it?"
188 million Points, was it really that expensive?
It wasn't that he couldn't afford it, he just couldn't see why it was worth 188 million Points.
"Of course you can like it,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit seriously pointed to the porcelain and explained, "This piece has Yi's handwritten signature. Anyone who owns porcelain with Yi's signature will receive his protection."
"Ten pieces!"
"What do you mean?"
"I want ten pieces!"
Li Yi said sternly, raising one finger, "This porcelain is too exquisite. I want to buy ten to decorate my home. 1.88 billion for ten pieces of such exquisite porcelain, now that's a bargain, an absolute steal."
"Really?"
Tuberculosis Rabbit grinned meaningfully, "I knew Former Leader Li is someone who truly appreciates art."

chapters.title: Chapter 552 371: "Brother, today I ask you for one thing.
chapters.content:
Today is already November 9th.
Not many days are left until the return trip; they had been out for six days now and were scheduled to head back to Blue Star on the 10th.
The opening of the mall hadn't caused a huge stir, but the setup was quite impressive.
Almost every clan leader from all the planets in the Awesome Starfield had come. On normal days, they had no chance to interact with Chen Yi, let alone offer gifts to cultivate a relationship, or even chat for a bit.
Finally, Chen Yi had opened a mall in Sky City.
Selling special products from Blue Star.
Did that even need to be said?
Anyone with a brain knew to come over and make an appearance, for opportunities to bribe so openly were rare. In reality, they didn't expect Chen Yi to actually do anything for them.
They only sought one thing.
That was, if a clueless player from their race suddenly attacked Chen Yi, he would spare their lives considering the many Points they had spent.
This wasn't about buying luxury goods!
It was essentially buying life-saving Golden Talismans, or from another perspective, it was the most expensive luxury of all!
Without exception!
...
"Tuberculosis Rabbit,"
One of the clan leaders from Fourfold Planet said earnestly, holding Tuberculosis Rabbit's hands, "It's such a shame not to be able to meet Yi today. But please, Tuberculosis Rabbit, you must relay that I am truly fascinated by Blue Star's culture."
"If there are more collectibles of this caliber, please make sure to contact me, I'll take as many as you have."
"Sure, sure,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit said with a cheerful smile, patting the clan leader's hands, before adding with profound meaning, "I'll certainly convey your message to Yi exactly as you said it. In Awesome Starfield, there are aficionados like you who are extremely obsessed with Blue Star culture."
"Great, great,"
Relieved by the response, the clan leader cautiously picked up the porcelain ware priced at 270 million Points from the counter, and after looking at it with a deeply fascinated and appreciative expression, he walked towards the door.
As soon as the clan leader turned to leave,
Tuberculosis Rabbit took out another identical porcelain piece from beneath the display counter, placed it on top, and turned to the queue that was long as a dragon: "Next!"
Without any attempt to hide, without any scruples.
They were openly and unabashedly candid.
The clan leader, who had not yet left, twitched slightly at the corner of his mouth upon hearing the sound behind him. His body involuntarily staggered before he hurried out of the mall without looking back.
270 million Points!
This was no small amount!
But it was worth it, so worth it. At least at a crucial moment, it could save the lives of all the players on his planet. If for some reason they angered Chen Yi, they wouldn't have to fear being annihilated. At the very least, there would be a chance for redemption, for them to seek out mediators to plead on their behalf.
Perhaps at times, it could even serve as a medium for Chen Yi to help them out a bit.
Actually.
In the game of leveling up, there were more than a few players capable of wiping out a Threefold or Fourfold Planet.
Those from Ninefold Planet, any one of them, might not be able to guarantee an easy annihilation of a Threefold Planet, but at least bullying one posed no problem whatsoever. Did they have to give gifts to each of these individuals stronger than them?
Of course not.
The reason they were paying Chen Yi heavy protection money was fourfold.
The first reason, those Ninefold players were strong but inaccessible to them, they didn't have any contact, and as strong as they were, they posed no threat to them. But Chen Yi was different; he was so close to them that they didn't even need to take a cab to reach his doorstep.
The second reason, Chen Yi's track record was not exactly shining. No player had wiped out so many races, stained their hands with so many lives as he had. If someone else said, "I'm gonna kill your entire race," nine times out of ten, it was an empty threat.
But if Chen Yi said, "I'm gonna kill your entire race," nine times out of ten, he was already on his way with a knife in hand.
The third reason was that Chen Yi seemed to have a fondness for coming to Awesome Starfield. As the saying goes, 'Fortune favors those close to the source.' Their proximity meant that, should Chen Yi be in a bad mood and willing to wipe out a race, they would naturally be the first ones targeted.
The fourth reason, and the most important, why would Chen Yi suddenly open a mall in Sky City and sell luxury goods at sky-high prices? The intention was clear. Any planet that did not send someone today would probably be immediately remembered by Chen Yi.
How could they dare not come? They had no choice but to come.
As more people arrived, the remaining planets that hadn't sent representatives grew increasingly panicked. This was because it meant that those planets that didn't buy anything would stand out glaringly in Chen Yi's eyes, and being remembered by Chen Yi was nothing good.
So...
Even if the price was a bit steep, they accepted it!
Initially, Tuberculosis Rabbit went through the motions, explaining the made-up story behind each porcelain ware to add a little narrative value before selling it. But when Tuberculosis Rabbit realized that the story wasn't even finished before the item was sold, and there was still a long line of people waiting,
He instantly understood.
So he stopped pretending, continuously taking out identical porcelain pieces from beneath the counter and placing them on display. It was a simple transaction: money in hand, goods in the other, as names and planets were registered at the counter.
It seemed no different from receiving bribes.
Exceptionally smooth-flowing.
...
Soon.
A day had passed, and as the sun went down,
"Yi God Paradise" also slowly closed its doors.

chapters.title: Chapter 553 371: "Brother, today I ask you for one thing." _2
chapters.content:
In a certain banquet hall.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, his face flushed with excitement, stood on a table, clutching a bottle of champagne, and looked at the paper in his hands as he roared with enthusiasm, "Yi God Paradise's trial opening day has come to a perfect close!"
"Sales volume: 89.1 billion Points!!!"
"Cost...0!!!"
"Net profit: 89.1 billion Points!!!"
"Roar!!!"
Sitting off to the side, Sword Without End was extremely supportive and waved his arm, sending out a howl like a ghost crying and a wolf howling.
"Nearly 90 billion Points."
Tuberculosis Rabbit hopped down from the table, rushed over excitedly, slung an arm around Chen Yi's shoulder, and hoisted the champagne high into the air, shaking with excitement, "This is 90 billion Points we're talking about, we could buy Blue Star over and over again with that!"
"Alright, alright."
Chen Yi, somewhat helplessly, pushed the inebriated Tuberculosis Rabbit to one side, lit a cigarette and put it in his mouth, and then couldn't help but start laughing too, "It is a lot, I didn't realize there were so many rich people in Awesome Starfield."
What exactly is the concept of 90 billion Points?
Let me put it this way.
He had stayed in the map full of mummies, "Pharaoh's Tomb," using the method of equipping "Giant Heavy Armor" and killing mobs without taking down the boss—practically exploiting a bug—for a good ten-plus days.
After all that effort, and with a bit of bug exploitation, he had only managed to earn around 4 billion Points.
Yet today, with just one casual day of operations, they had a net income of 90 billion Points, which was pretty astounding.
It had to be said, it was indeed an exorbitant profit.
They had no costs whatsoever, as the products were moved out from a warehouse of some processing plant on Blue Star that had likely been abandoned for god knows how long; they didn't even clean the dust off the pottery—that's what you call natural aging!
These were direct products from five thousand years ago.
This was the story value that Tuberculosis Rabbit had initially wanted to imbue, but later discovered that those people didn't care about the story value at all—they just wanted to pay.
The mall had no costs either—the chief of the Lisu Tribe almost gave it to them for the price of 8.88 million Points.
Electricity, water, property service fees, and all that should have been Li Yi's responsibility, but Li Yi waived them all and didn't dare to ask for them.
Originally, in Sky City, all the malls had to hand over 10% of their sales volume to Li Yi, which was one of Li Yi's major sources of income. And Li Yi also didn't want that part of the profits.
So... under almost zero-cost conditions, they had made nearly 90 billion in profit.
"This can't really be called profit, can it?"
Sitting to the side with a glass of red wine, Jiaye shook his head helplessly, "This feels more like protection money. There won't be this kind of sales volume tomorrow, right?"
"That's correct,"
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded seriously, "Today, about 300 planets paid protection money, and only one planet didn't send anyone, but Yi, have you noticed how this approach is even faster?"
"Sometimes we wouldn't profit a billion Points even after wiping out an entire tribe."
"After all, no matter how many players we kill, we can't directly transfer the Points balance in their pockets into our account, but with this method, we don't need to do anything; we just need to use our past reputation to earn a huge amount of Points."
"Once Awesome Starfield is done, we can move on to the next Starfield."
"What's the one thing a main game doesn't lack? It's Starfields!
"Isn't this way faster than going down maps and such?"
"..."
Chen Yi, who didn't speak, was holding 90 billion Points and started to scour the Star Map, preparing to do some shopping first.
The rules for novices were very clear in stating one point: novice players cannot acquire props through any means from other players, whether gifted or dropped; in other words, novice players are unable to buy props from other players.
But as they say, money talks.
'Prop Name': Forced Growth.
'Prop Level': A-Grade.
'Prop Effect': Possessing this prop allows you to break through the novice player restrictions and acquire props from players outside of Novice Planet that are given or dropped.
'Prop Restriction': Only for novice player use.
'Prop Price': 50 million Points.
An exorbitant price.
In the realm of A-grade props, this price was definitely sky-high, perhaps because the effect was average but extremely rare, it was the only one on the Star Map, and the price was consequently quite high.
But he couldn't buy the prop.
So, he entrusted Wang Qi to buy it for them. Wang Qi had once managed to send a prop into their place from the outside world. Although they didn't know how he had done it, Wang Qi indeed had his own ways, and in fact, he succeeded.
They also paid Wang Qi 10 million Points as a commission.
So...
The A-grade prop "Forced Growth" was now in their hands.
They could buy whatever they wanted on the Star Map without any hesitation.
"Hmm..."
After pondering for a moment, Chen Yi divided 90 billion points into five parts, giving Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others 15 billion points each, while he himself had nearly 30 billion points. Then, he shared the Star Map panel with everyone.
"You guys take a look, pick what you like and add it directly to the shopping cart, then I'll place the order."
"Sure thing."
Excited, Tuberculosis Rabbit didn't hesitate to type the words "Zenith Radiance" into the Star Map's search bar. Soon, a series of Zenith Radiance for sale appeared on the Star Map Platform, each priced at around 10 million points.
The cheapest ones were listed at the front.
In almost an instant,
Tuberculosis Rabbit added the top 139 Zenith Radiance items to his cart. No more, no less, the total price of these 139 Zenith Radiance items was exactly 15 billion points.
The ones at the front were priced at around 9 million points each, and those at the back were about 12 million points each.
A 3 million difference.
And Tuberculosis Rabbit swept away all 139 Zenith Radiance items in a single go.
"139 Zenith Radiance items?"
Sword Without End, who was watching the show from the side, was dumbfounded, his eyes widening in shock as he said, "Are you planning on building a house or laying a foundation with these things? Isn't that a bit much?"
"Plus, isn't it kind of irrational for us to buy Zenith Radiance? We have the World Tree, which can produce a Zenith Radiance every three days."
"There's no need to spend so many points on them, is there? Look at those last few Zenith Radiance, they're overpriced at 12 million each. That's completely beyond the normal market value, isn't it?"
"You don't know shit!"
Tuberculosis Rabbit said with eyes full of anticipation and excitement, "I want to upgrade all 289 of my Air Food Series Props to Ultimate Props as soon as possible, to complete my grand 'Heaven' plan!"
"I've done the math."
"Once these 139 Zenith Radiance are in hand, I only need 142 more to have enough."
"I've been looking forward to this for a long time, so the sooner, the better. A little extra expense doesn't matter."
"By the way, I need a favor from you."
Instantly realizing what was coming, Sword Without End jumped up like a cat whose tail had been stepped on, his voice shrieking, "Don't even think about touching my points! I'm going to take my time choosing, and I definitely won't lend them to you."
"Just hear me out,"
replied Tuberculosis Rabbit, leaning in to whisper a few words in Sword Without End's ear.
Sword Without End visibly tempted, hesitated before saying, "Really?"
"For sure."
"Deal!" said Sword Without End, gritting his teeth after a moment of thought, "I'll lend you a maximum of 14 billion points, but I have to keep 1 billion to buy my own things."
"Done deal."
Happy as a clam, Tuberculosis Rabbit hurried to the Star Map panel and contentedly selected another 116 Zenith Radiance items, spending all 14 billion points cleanly before muttering,
"142 minus 116 leaves 26 more Zenith Radiance needed."
"Just 26 more Zenith Radiance, and I can complete the Heaven plan."
At this moment,
all of the Zenith Radiance listed at the front of the Star Map had been added to the shopping cart, and the price for Zenith Radiance that could still be added to the cart had reached 15 million points each.
It was way beyond the market price.
"Yi..."
With red-rimmed eyes, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at Chen Yi, his voice hoarse, "Yi, you know I've never asked you for anything in my life, right?"
"I'm asking you as a brother, just this once."
"Get lost!"
Chen Yi looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a mixture of annoyance, "15 million points for a Zenith Radiance is just too expensive. Just wait a few days and the World Tree will produce enough."
"Yi..."
"Alright, alright, stop making that noise, it's disgusting. If you want to buy it, just buy it. Go pick them out."
"Okay, thanks Yi!"

chapters.title: Chapter 554 372: We Can't Really Let This Guy Succeed, Can We?
chapters.content:
After spending less than 500 million Points,
the debt-ridden Tuberculosis Rabbit finally purchased all the Zenith Radiance ranked at the top of the Star Map. The price of the last piece of Zenith Radiance had reached 20 million Points, which was already more than double the market price.
In the Star Map,
there were always those willing to sell Props at prices much higher than the market value. These people were usually not in a hurry for money or to liquidate assets.
By listing them at high prices, they could make a fortune if they chanced upon a buyer who wasn't short on money and needed the item urgently.
Clearly, such people had been waiting, and Tuberculosis Rabbit was indeed in a rush; he could no longer wait for the price of Zenith Radiance to drop back to market levels before buying.
After acquiring a total of 281 pieces of Zenith Radiance and adding the ones Tuberculosis Rabbit already owned, he had gathered enough Zenith Radiance to upgrade all 289 Air Food Series Props into Ultimate Props.
"What a luxury,"
Sword Without End commented with a hint of melancholy, "He's thrown hundreds of billions of Points just to upgrade a set of Air Food Series Props into Zenith Radiance. Even the players from the Ninefold planet wouldn't dare to play like this, right?"
