"With that many Points, you could buy a whole bunch of A-grade Props. Use one a day, and they'll last for freaking years..."
But Tuberculosis Rabbit seemed still not fully satisfied, his eyes dryly looking towards Yi, "Um, Yi, I still haven't completed the collection of Air Food Series Props, could I possibly..."
The Air Food Series Props consist of 289 pieces.
Each piece represents a food item, such as fish soup with flatbread, dry-fried shredded pork, pork with preserved vegetables, and so on.
The full set of 289 includes various cuisines, some of which aren't found on Blue Star, but were included in the Air Food Series Props.
On Blue Star,
one couldn't acquire the complete set of 289 Air Food Series Props; to be precise, no person could collect all 289 Air Food Series Props on the Novice Planet.
Of course, not many people would idle away their time trying to collect such things, considering these Props are practically useless. Aside from those crisis moments when there's no food available, and you could rely on these Props to fill your stomach, that's really all the use they have.
And even then, it doesn't truly satisfy hunger, it just gives a feeling of fullness while the stomach remains empty.
He once received a Prop that could produce one Air Food Series Prop a day and would do so based on the Air Food Series Props missing from his inventory. If given enough time, no more than three months of effort,
he could collect the entire set of Air Food Series Props.
But...
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn't wait to see his creation completed and didn't have the patience to wait that long. Although he could buy the entire set at once from the Star Map, it would cost some Points, but not too much, as the Air Food Series Props weren't worth much.
The cheaper ones in the Star Map were only about seventy or eighty Points each.
Unless some Air Food Props with Special Effects would be a bit pricier, the entire set wouldn't cost much overall.
"..."
Seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit's pitiful expression, Chen Yi was momentarily speechless and waved his hand, "I've already bought them for you, so stop looking at me with those eyes, it's freaking disgusting."
It probably cost around 300,000 Points in total.
Not much money.
Not even enough to buy the price of a Fragments of porcelain in a shopping mall.
"Thanks, Yi!"
With an excited expression, Tuberculosis Rabbit took the large bunch of Air Food Series Props that Chen Yi handed over and started packing them into his backpack, impatient to return to Blue Star and begin his Enhancement journey!
289 Air Food Series Props!
All upgraded into Ultimate Props, this would definitely be an epic masterpiece!
So far, there were a few Ultimate Air Food Props in the Star Map, created by some wealthy young masters showing off their wealth. After all, spending 10 million Points on a piece of Zenith Radiance on an Air Food Prop,
meant it was akin to throwing money down the drain.
And these young masters enjoyed that sensation, reveling in the feeling of wasting money. Don't ask why; just know they love it.
But even those self-proclaimed wealthy young masters usually only had one such Ultimate Air Food Prop, and they would often display it permanently on the Star Map Platform, showing it off to others. After all, even with their wealth, they couldn't afford to do this too many times.
...
The night passed quickly.
Everyone was sleepless that night.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was too excited to sleep, anticipating what would happen once he upgraded all the food Props into Ultimate Props.
Sword Without End, after no longer hearing Tuberculosis Rabbit's sleep talk, just suffered from a vague sense of insomnia.
A long time ago, Yi used to not sleep with Tuberculosis Rabbit but with Jiaye instead, so he would often share a room with Tuberculosis Rabbit. Half asleep, he would listen to Tuberculosis Rabbit's sleep talk and drift off, feeling an odd sense of security.
But now, without Tuberculosis Rabbit's sleep talk, he surprisingly found himself struggling with insomnia.
...
The morning of November 10th arrived.
The journey had ended.
With Li Yi and others watching reluctantly, Chen Yi waved goodbye and led the Blue Star players, who had been having a blast these past few days, back to Blue Star. The holiday was over, and it was time to go back to "prison."
Moreover, November 11th was approaching.
During the early November version update, a global event was announced for Singles' Day on November 11th, which seemed to be significant. Naturally, they couldn't miss out, especially since their seven days of holiday time were exhausted.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 372: We Can't Really Let This Guy Succeed, Can We?_2
chapters.content:
```
If he didn't come back ahead of time.
In case his "Faceless One" occupation started updating and his "Time-Space Traveler" occupation got refreshed away, the fun would really start then. Without this occupation, he wouldn't be able to bring back so many Blue Star players to Blue Star.
Not to mention bringing players back to Blue Star, he himself wouldn't be able to return.
From then on, they would become wandering players.
They would never get past the Novice Period and ascend to the Twofold Planet. As for the Snow Sea Project Team, they would be even more confused. They were cheerfully running alongside Blue Star, hoping that Blue Star would reach new heights, but, how come suddenly everyone disappeared?
Gone?
Upon arriving at Blue Star in an instant.
Tuberculosis Rabbit excitedly lit up a cigarette, blew the smoke onto his hands, and rushed to a corner of the rooftop to start enhancing his Ultimate Air Food Series Props.
He could have enhanced them while in Sky City.
But Tuberculosis Rabbit insisted that such critical moments must take place in Yancheng, for he didn't feel at home anywhere else.
And he didn't let anyone else intervene, not even Sword Without End, who tried to help with the enhancement, got scolded and sent packing.
"...Tch."
Sword Without End rolled his eyes in annoyance, "Who's eager, it's just a bunch of Air Food Props, even if they're Ultimate Props, they're still Air Food Props, of no damn use."
It must be said, Yi really indulged Tuberculosis Rabbit.
If... he's just saying if, if he wanted to spend hundreds of billions of Points to enhance a bunch of Air Food Series Props into Ultimate Props, would Yi be willing?
He didn't ask it out loud, he wasn't that foolish, nor did he contemplate it too much in his heart.
Some things can't be asked, nor thought about.
"By the way, Sword Without End."
Just then, Jiaye, who was sitting by the side, suddenly thought of something. His eyes narrowed into crescents as he looked at Sword Without End, "I seem to recall Tuberculosis Rabbit saying that if he breaks 289 Ultimate Air Food Props, you'll have to run naked from the North Pole to the South Pole?"
"Ah, yes, I..."
Just as Sword Without End was about to defiantly respond, he suddenly hesitated as if he thought of something that sapped his confidence, "That can't be possible, right? How could such a simple thing reward a game monument?"
"Whether it's Yi's Monument or Li Yi and their monuments, which one isn't tremendously difficult and almost impossible for ordinary players to complete?"
"It's just the enhancement of some Ultimate Props, how could that possibly get a monument...I guess."
The more he spoke, the more his confidence waned.
Damn it.
You can't really let this guy succeed!
Worried that your brother will suffer, but also worried that your brother will drive a Range Rover!
Driving a Range Rover would be acceptable, but why did he have to carelessly make such a bet!
Thinking of this, Sword Without End couldn't stay calm anymore and sat nervously on the side, watching Tuberculosis Rabbit who was continuously enhancing, dreading that Tuberculosis Rabbit might actually produce a Monument.
About half an hour later.
Tuberculosis Rabbit successfully enhanced all 289 Air Food Props into Zenith Radiance.
At the same time—
"Ding, Announcement to the Entire Star System No. 3!"
The moment the announcement sounded, Sword Without End felt a pang in his heart, his face turned ashen, sitting still, his mind went blank.
Damn it, does a dashing modern Sword Immortal really have to run naked from the North Pole to the South Pole!?
And the announcement continued.
"Ding, Announcement to the Entire Star System No. 3!"
"This notification includes the following planets: Blue Star, Neutron Star...and other planets."
"In Star System No. 3, the Zerofold Planet Blue Star player 'Tuberculosis Rabbit,' who during the Novice Period, collected 289 Air Food Props—the first player in years since the game update to collect an entire set of Air Food Series Props on the Novice Planet."
"For this, he is awarded with the Starry Level title 'Art Collector,' Points*1,000,000, and an A-Class Random Prop Chest*1."
"Let's give our most sincere respect to this player filled with the spirit of collection."
"Phew!!"
After hearing the announcement, Sword Without End heaved a sigh of relief. His face, which had lost color, regained its natural hue, and he walked over with a mischievously lifting corner of his mouth that he couldn't quite control, patted Tuberculosis Rabbit on the shoulder.
"Don't be disheartened, after all, monuments aren't that easy to get."
```
"A Starry Level title is enough."
"And... hahahahaha!!!"
He could no longer contain his laughter and burst out laughing, scared to death, thinking he was really about to capsize in the ditch, just like that, something this simple, how could it possibly merit a monument.
However, the next second—
A deafening and hoarse announcement sounded in his ears again like a voice from the heavens!
"Ding, Annihilation Starfield, notice to the Whole Starfield!"
"The planets in this announcement include the following: Black Star, Turtle Star, Zhiwa Star, Egglet Star... totaling 768 planets."
"Within affiliated Star System No. 3 of the Annihilation Starfield, player Tuberculosis Rabbit from Zerofold Planet Blue Star, within the Novice Period, has assembled a complete set of Air Food Series Props and enhanced them all to Ultimate Props!"
"He is the first player in the history of the leveling game to collect a set of 289 Air Food Series Props during the Novice Period, and also the first in the history of the leveling game to enhance all 289 Air Food Series Props into Ultimate Props during the Novice Period!"
"Unprecedented and never to be surpassed!"
"This feat has astonished countless players, and the event has been elected into the chronicle of significant events of the leveling game, where it will permanently leave its name and marks, and he will receive a statue representing this event in the Hall of Honor of the leveling game."
"And he has claimed a leveling game milestone!"
"Milestone Name: Collector!"
"Conditions to Achieve: The first as a newcomer player in the Novice Period to gather a whole set of 289 Air Food Series Props and enhances them all to Ultimate Props."
"Let us congratulate Tuberculosis Rabbit for being the first player in the leveling game's history to claim this milestone."
"And for obtaining the Stellar Rank title 'Leisure God'!"
Above the skies of Annihilation Starfield.
Therefore, players almost instinctively looked up toward the heavens, where there were already three gargantuan monuments, and now another monument was slowly rising.
The facade of the monument was immensely huge, pitch-black, with blood-red lettering.
The blood-red font seemed to flow like liquid, as if to hook one's soul into it.
There was also an exceptionally conspicuous line of text on the monument.
"Annihilation Starfield Continent Monument!"
"Monument name": Collector.
"Conditions to Achieve": The first as a newcomer player in the Novice Period to gather a whole set of 289 Air Food Series Props and enhances them all to Ultimate Props.
"Owner": Tuberculosis Rabbit
"Runner-up Project Team": Snow Sea Project Team.
"Affiliated Project Team": Annihilation Starfield Project Team.
"Runner-up Project Team, awarded a one-time S-class Unpaid Freedom Right, all members awarded 100 points, awarded a onetime exemption from punishment right."
"Affiliated Project Team awarded 100 Achievement Points, all members awarded 50 points, and granted promotion qualification, with a validity period of ten years, awarded a onetime exemption from punishment right."
"..."
"..."
The moment this announcement fell, countless players and members of the project teams across the entire Annihilation Starfield fell silent, not knowing what to say.
...
Especially the Snow Sea Project Team.
Jin Buhuan, the manager of the Blue Star Snow Sea Project Team, who was still pondering how to repay the debts owed to the leveling game and return to the status of Race Player at an early date, became expressionless and silent the moment he heard the announcement.
"Runner-up Project Team, awarded a one-time S-class Unpaid Freedom Right..."
Up to now, including this one, they had accumulated three S-class Unpaid Freedom Rights.
With three of such rights, they could instantly shed their employee identities and revert to Race Players, no longer confined here on a daily basis, able to enjoy freedom.
Suddenly... did they just complete it?
Jin Buhuan sat somewhat dazed in his chair, looking at the S-class Freedom Right that had suddenly appeared in the project team's account, somewhat at a loss for words.
They had done nothing, and after hundreds of years without achieving their goal, they suddenly completed it in a matter of months?
Can they go home now?

chapters.title: Chapter 556 373: "Yi, Yi, look at my Leisure God title!
chapters.content:
"Um..."
In the office of the Snow Sea Project Team floating above Blue Star.
An employee tentatively approached leader Jin Buhuan and started, "Boss, are we going home now?"
Last time Blue Star had captured the Monument, everyone was exhilarated.
But this time, suddenly, there was no such feeling, and the main reason was the lack of a sense of participation.
Feeling as if they hadn't done anything, the big prize had somehow just landed in their pockets, creating an unreal sensation that left the staff of the project team in a sort of mental daze.
"Going home..."
Shaken from his reverie, Jin Buhuan stood up and walked around the office, looking at each employee. They were all looking at him with expectant eyes. What had they all been striving for all these years?
Wasn't it to pay off their gaming debts as soon as possible and reclaim their player identities?
To regain the freedom that belonged to them?
But today.
Three unconditional S-grade Free Passes allowed them not to worry about repaying the debts at all; simply using these three opportunities would let them regain the player identities they had once lost.
It could be said that they were only a step away, just one step away from achieving their goal of many years.
Everyone was waiting, waiting for him to give the order to return; then, the office would erupt with excitement and roaring cheers, like a volcano on the verge of eruption. With just one word from him, it could burst forth instantly.
However...
"..."
After making eye contact with each of his excited employees, Jin Buhuan remained silent for a long while before finally saying, "I'm sorry, everyone, we can't go home yet."
As his words fell.
In the office, each employee's face registered an incredulous shock.
Why couldn't they go home?
They had all been working hard every day; wasn't this the day they had been waiting for? Now that the conditions were met, why couldn't they go home?
Why!
Before anyone could voice their questions, Jin Buhuan raised his voice again, "I know you all don't understand, but please, listen to me. We have reasons we can't leave."
"What will happen to Chen Yi and Blue Star if we leave?"
"The game has rules that state once a sponsoring project team leaves partway, there won't be a new team to take over. Everything will be managed by the game's automated procedures."
"First of all, wouldn't this possibly make Chen Yi resent us? When we reclaim our identities as players, we regain our freedom. But it also means that if Chen Yi wanted to take action against us, we would have no protections afforded by our status as project team employees."
"Do you think you can withstand Chen Yi?"
"Secondly, even if we go back home now and return to being players, what then? But if we can support Chen Yi until the end, and then return to our player identities, armed with Chen Yi's friendship, wouldn't we live much better lives?"
Jin Buhuan's powerful words echoed through the office.
The countless employees exchanged glances and returned to their seats in mute accord, clearly in agreement that Jin Buhuan's decision was the right one.
But... they still couldn't feel happy about it.
They had longed to go home for so long, and now, when they could finally go home, they just couldn't do it.
"..."
Seeing all the employees back at their stations, Jin Buhuan slowly took his own seat and, with a hint of fatigue, closed his eyes.
They couldn't possibly go home now.
Without the Snow Sea Project Team, Blue Star being automated by the game's procedures could lead to unpredictable events, and he had no idea what might happen.
He had to see Blue Star through to the end. Even if he couldn't earn Chen Yi's friendship, he at least couldn't let Chen Yi bear a grudge against them.
...
Outside the Annihilation Starfield, things were bustling.
Many players were eagerly admiring the newly erected Monument—the fourth one in the Annihilation Starfield. In the whole game, they were the only players who had four Monuments.
There was no one else.
They were unique.
This brought great pride to the players of the Annihilation Starfield when traveling across other starfields.
"289 Zenith-series Air Food Props..."
A Black Star player, holding a drumstick and chewing, began to count on his fingers as he mused over his calculations.
"A Zenith Radiance costs 10 million Points, and 300 of them would need 30 billion Points."
"With the premium on Zenith Radiance, it probably costs about 60 billion Points."
"Damn..."
This player looked at his last map earnings in a daze, less than 30,000 Points from a B-grade map that took him three days. By this progress, to earn 30 billion Points...
He was bad at math and couldn't figure out how long it would take.
But at the very least, it would probably take over a decade.
"..."
Thinking this, the player couldn't help but twitch at the corners of his mouth, filled with bewilderment, "Isn't Tuberculosis Rabbit a novice player? Where did he get so many Points from? 30 billion Points—damn, could all the maps during the Novice Period add up to that amount of earnings?"
"That's just too outrageous?!!"
...
On Awesome Starfield.
Sitting next to Li Yi, Wang Qi laughed upon hearing the announcement. "Li Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit is so much stronger than you. You earned a billion Points during your Novice Period, but Tuberculosis Rabbit must have earned hundreds of billions of Points."

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - 557 373 Yi Yi look at my Leisure God title_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 557: Chapter 373: “Yi, Yi, look at my Leisure God title!”_2 Chapter 557: Chapter 373: “Yi, Yi, look at my Leisure God title!”_2 “Just the Zenith Radiance from this Star Map has been bought out by the Tuberculosis Rabbit, and now the cheapest Zenith Radiance is also at 30 million Points,” Yi said.
“Those who still have Zenith Radiance saw the market so favorable and all started to raise their prices.”
“Can this even compare?”
Li Yi sighed helplessly, “During my Novice Period, I didn’t have such a bug-level boss. That market made 90 billion Points in a single day’s work.”
“90 billion Points!”
“I’ve been operating in the Awesome Starfield for so long, put in so much effort, and the net profit for one year is also about 90 billion Points.”
“And that Tuberculosis Rabbit, sold porcelain to make 90 billion Points in one day.”
“Simply outrageous!”
To say it’s outrageous is actually not an exaggeration, after all, there are several hundred planets in the Awesome Starfield, the economically sound planets pay up to a billion or two in protection fees, and the ones that aren’t as well off pay a few tens of millions in protection fees.
Add it all up, and getting 90 billion Points is a piece of cake.
Moreover, under Li Yi’s leadership, the Awesome Starfield had indeed achieved common prosperity. The creation of the famous site in Sky City allowed every race to make quite a bit of money through it.
They indeed had some property to their names.
If it were up to the Threefold Planet in the Annihilation Starfield to easily cough up hundreds of millions of Points without breaking a sweat, honestly, it would be quite difficult, virtually impossible without selling some assets.
This is no porcelain selling.
This is plainly collecting protection fees—no, that’s not right. It’s more accurate to say, “Yi remembers you. One day, when Yi wants to wipe out your race, in consideration of these hundreds of millions of Points, we might spare your race and let you live.”
Yes.
This isn’t protection money; it’s a fee for sparing your race.
But even so, countless races in the Awesome Starfield were still eager to pay up, fearing if they were too slow, they’d catch Chen Yi’s eye, a being who could kill Ninefold Planet players like Jiang Chenglu and who took pleasure in annihilating races.
Paying a bit of protection money is not too much to ask.
While Li Yi was internally lamenting how quickly Tuberculosis Rabbit was making money, he suddenly realized that Wang Qi’s expression was gradually becoming strange. He asked subconsciously, “What’s wrong?”
“Nothing.”
Wang Qi narrowed his eyes slightly as he looked at Li Yi and suddenly laughed, “You can earn 90 billion Points in a year?”
He had known before that Li Yi was wealthy, but he never knew Li Yi could earn so much in a year.
Li Yi suddenly realized he had spoken out of turn and quickly coughed lightly, waving his hand nonchalantly, “I do earn 90 billion Points, but after deducting costs, I get to keep maybe just over 3 billion.”
“Sigh, you don’t know, building this Sky City really consumes too many Points.”
“I’ve poured all of my assets into it.”
“Heh.”
Wang Qi sneered, then draped his arm around Li Yi’s shoulder, “Cut the crap. Today I’m butchering a big spender. Less talk, take me out to splurge, and today I must fleece you good!”
…
“…”
Meanwhile, on Blue Star.
Sword Without End stood expressionlessly on the spot, silent for a long time without speaking.
Jiaye, on the other hand, obediently returned to the house, as what would happen next wasn’t for him to see.
Tuberculosis Rabbit considerately took out a pair of running shoes and handed them over, “Wear these for your run later, an E-rank prop that will keep you from feeling tired while running.”
‘Prop Name’: Xtep Running Shoes.
‘Prop Rank’: E-rank.
‘Prop Effect’: When you wear these running shoes, you will never feel fatigue during exercise, but the moment you take off the shoes, the side effects of the body’s overload will instantly revert.
‘Prop Introduction’: A good helper for 100-meter dashes, a killer for hundred-mile marathons.
Tie Chui also considerately handed over 999 Cold Remedy with a serious expression.
“You… when you run… naked, you might catch a cold…”
“If you feel unwell on the way… just take some of this… it’s good for your health.”
“Mhm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit seriously accepted the 999 Cold Remedy, handing it to Sword Without End, “Go on, brother. Fulfill your promise. Run naked from the North Pole to the South Pole.”
“I…”
Sword Without End, looking as if he had stepped in dog shit, his face couldn’t be uglier as he stared at the 999 Cold Spirit pills and the sneakers handed to him, his mouth slowly opening and closing without a single word coming out.
At that moment, he just wanted to give himself a good slap.
Why did he have to go and set such a flag for no good reason!!
Why was he such a fucking loudmouth!!
The main thing was, he had never expected that Tuberculosis Rabbit would actually bring back a Monument, who could have thought that simply enhancing 289 Air Food Series Props to Ultimate Props would actually get you a Monument?
It was just too unreasonable!
This task was completely devoid of any difficulty. It’s just Enhancement; everyone knows how to do that!
The Monument could be completed by anyone; it almost had no requirements for the players themselves!
But what Sword Without End selectively ignored was.
For the average new player, it’s almost impossible to collect all the Air Food Series Props during the Novice Period. The 289 Air Food Series Props are scattered throughout the entire game; you can’t collect them all on a single planet.
And for new players, gathering all 289 Air Food Series Props is but a pipe dream!
Even if they received the “World Tree,” an artifact that produces one Zenith Radiance every three days, from the moment they entered the game, it would still take a total of 900 days, whereas the Novice Period lasts only 12 months.
These two conditions were almost absolutely impossible for any new player to fulfill.
It seems only Tuberculosis Rabbit could do it.
Apart from Tuberculosis Rabbit, who knows which newbie could achieve it.
Even Sword Without End couldn’t.
After all… even with the resources and the Points, not everyone is willing to spend billions of Points on a set of Air Food Series Props, even if it is… the Ultimate Edition.
All one can say is, due to a multitude of factors, Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t get the Monument undeservedly at all.
Seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui both watching eagerly on the side, Sword Without End gritted his teeth and refused to lose face. He started to take off his clothes, looking like he was really planning to run from the North Pole to the South Pole in his bare skin.
“Okay, that’s enough.”
Chen Yi, standing aside, couldn’t help but interrupt this farce with a touch of helplessness in his voice: “Tuberculosis Rabbit, that’s enough. Sword Without End is still one of our team members. If he truly runs naked from the North Pole to the South Pole, what would that look like?”
“It’s okay to joke around, but do you really want to force Sword Without End to do it?”
“Oh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, looking a tad disappointed as he licked his lips, then patted Sword Without End on the shoulder: “I’ll let you off this time. Don’t go around setting flags next time, you gotta remember, in the game anything is possible.”
“This place Yancheng is wicked indeed.”
“I, Sword Without End, stand by my word—when have I ever gone back on what I’ve said!”
Sword Without End, gritting his teeth, stripped off all his clothes on the spot, wearing just a pair of boxer shorts and riding on Green Peak, he shot off into the distance, looking like he really intended to run from the North Pole to the South Pole in his underwear.
Before he left, he even started a video call with Tuberculosis Rabbit.
To prove he hadn’t planned to cheat.
Tuberculosis Rabbit was somewhat stunned by the scene, a trace of shock and bewilderment flickering in his eyes: “That’s one tough guy.”
…
Standing aside, Chen Yi sighed with resignation and didn’t bother with the drama, instead, turning to Tuberculosis Rabbit: “Everyone in the group chat is welcoming you, don’t just play around, reply to the messages.”
“Ah? Oh, oh, sure thing.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, snapping to attention, excitedly opened the “33 Club” and started replying and chatting in the group.
Yes.
By acquiring this Monument, he not only received Points and the title as rewards but also got an invitation to the 33 Club, becoming the latest player from the Annihilation Starfield to join the 33 Club.
However, he didn’t have a debut map like Yi did.
Only the first player of a Starfield to grab a Monument gets a debut map representing that Starfield. For players like Tuberculosis Rabbit who weren’t the first to nab a Monument from the Starfield, there would be no debut map.
After all, the greatest significance of a debut map is to spread the name of the newly-renamed Starfield.
“Eh?”
After replying to messages in the group, Tuberculosis Rabbit finally took a moment to look at the newly-acquired “Leisure God” Stellar Rank title, a spark of shock and excitement flashing in his eyes as he quickly turned to Chen Yi.
“Yi, Yi, check out my Leisure God title!”

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - 558 377 Ive seen many Living Bodhisattvas but
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 558: Chapter 377: “I’ve seen many Living Bodhisattvas, but this is my first time seeing a Living Yama Chapter 558: Chapter 377: “I’ve seen many Living Bodhisattvas, but this is my first time seeing a Living Yama The Tuberculosis Rabbit approached Chen Yi with excitement and shared the panel of the “Leisure God” Stellar Rank Title in front of him.
Except for the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s Stellar Rank Title “Leisure God”.
Chen Yi had already gathered three Stellar Rank Titles related to Gods and Demons.
They were—
“Seems Like A Demon!”
“Like a Demon!”
“Deicide!”
And the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s was “Leisure God,” which didn’t sound all that powerful; it seemed that even the game itself thought that anyone who could collect all 289 Air Food Series Props and then enhance them all to Ultimate Props
must truly have too much time on their hands.
Thus, they were granted the title “Leisure God.”
–
“Title Name”: Leisure God!
“Title Level”: Stellar Rank Title.
“Title Effect”: Every time you complete a set of Props, that set will automatically be upgraded to Ultimate Props.
“Title Restriction”: When a player wears this title and completes a set of Props, the enhanced set of Ultimate Props can only be used by the player themselves, and cannot be transferred, leased, or gifted to other players; furthermore, the enhanced Props will never drop.
“Title Introduction”: “Collector’s personality of a hamster, really an insoluble existence.”
“…”
Seeing the effect of the title, Chen Yi was slightly stunned, a hint of surprise flashing in his eyes as he spoke, “Your title is pretty impressive.”
This meant.
Any set of Props that Tuberculosis Rabbit collected in the future, once complete, would turn into Ultimate Props.
Ultimate Props are vastly enhanced versions of ordinary Props.
Originally, a set of ordinary B-rank Props would, after being upgraded to a set of Ultimate Props, often demonstrate an unacceptably powerful combat capability.
“Hold on.”
Suddenly coming to a realization, Chen Yi spoke with a somewhat strange expression, “That’s not right, we now have tens of billions of Points, with hundreds of billions just sitting in the account.”
“300 Zenith Radiance only cost us 5 billion Points.”
“With our current Points Balance, even if the price of Zenith Radiance has skyrocketed to an outrageous 20 million each, we could still buy quite a few. So, looking at it this way, it seems like your title isn’t that useful after all.”
This title could be considered an economic class title.
Under certain conditions, it could bring in a large number of the valuable Zenith Radiance.
But the problem is, they don’t lack money now, do they?
In the absence of a money shortage, this economic class title completely loses its purpose. It’s like having a treasure that can earn you 10,000 yuan every day before the upgrade of the game.
To ordinary people, it’s considered a treasure.
But to the billionaires, ha? 10,000 yuan a day doesn’t even add up to the interest I owe daily, especially for those financing highways—the daily interest on their loans is an astronomical number.
It’s practically useless.
To Tuberculosis Rabbit now, this title has just that effect, tasteless to eat but a pity to discard.
If they didn’t have so many Points, this title would be quite valuable. But the problem is, without so many Points, they couldn’t afford so many Zenith Radiance, and without being able to afford them, they wouldn’t be able to get this title.
This is falling into a paradoxical cycle.
A Stellar Rank Title with such an effect can only be somewhat disappointing as it is the most powerful level of title they know of to date, entirely unattainable for average players.
Only those players who seize a Monument can obtain a Stellar Rank Title; trying to acquire one by other means is pie in the sky.
And in the entire upgrade of the game, players who have won a Monument can be counted on one hand—while exaggerated, only a few more would suffice. In the upgraded game, most of Starfield doesn’t even have a name for themselves.
Before he seized a Monument, Annihilation Starfield was still called something like Ding Qi Starfield.
“Hehe.”
However, no hint of disappointment showed on Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face. Instead, he smiled mysteriously, puckered his lips, and shared two panels with Chen Yi, “Yi, take a look at this.”
“Oh?”
Chen Yi, seeing the expression on Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face, looked towards the two panels that had been shared in front of him, puzzled.
–
“Manchu Han Imperial Feast Set Effects”:
When a player collects all 289 Air Food Series Props, they will receive Set Effects that ensure each Air Food Prop, when passed on to others, will be thoroughly cleaned and returned to a like-new state, without any remaining saliva, viruses, or other residuals.
They can be used to hold feasts without worrying about serving leftovers.
–
“Manchu Han Imperial Feast Ultimate Set Effects”:
Once a player has a complete set composed of Ultimate Air Food Series Props, they will receive the Set Effects, which allow the owner to place any Ultimate Air Food Prop anywhere along their historical path at will.
“Hmm…”
Chen Yi, staring at these two Set Effects, was somewhat confused about Tuberculosis Rabbit’s point and asked, “And then?”
Both Set Effects seemed rather useless.
The first Set Effect was even more so. Who would need that effect, and who the hell uses an Air Food Series Prop as a Manchu Han Imperial Feast to entertain guests? You can’t expect wedding halls to do it, right?
Now that would be perfect, not only the wedding decoration can be reused, but even the banquet itself can be reused at a greatly reduced cost!

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 559 377 Ive seen many Living Bodhisattvas but
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 559: Chapter 377: “I’ve seen many Living Bodhisattvas, but this is my first time seeing a Living Yama_2 Chapter 559: Chapter 377: “I’ve seen many Living Bodhisattvas, but this is my first time seeing a Living Yama_2 As for the second effect, it didn’t seem to be of much use either.
“Historical path” must refer to the route I have taken, which is akin to being able to place an Ultimate Air Food Prop at any location I’ve passed at will, even more useless.
“Hehe, follow me.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit grabbed Chen Yi and hopped onto a nearby sled, starting it and heading towards the Yancheng suburbs.
…
Soon after.
They arrived at a deserted rural area.
Before the game “Starfield” descended, the whole world had started bustling with urbanization. Hardly anyone was left in the countryside as most people were converging on the cities. After “Starfield” came, there were practically no people left on the outskirts of the cities.
Those who were still alive all gathered in the cities.
Humans are social animals, especially in times of disaster. Living alone in the wilderness significantly raises the danger factor, not to mention that many quests and maps could only be picked up in the cities, which effectively forced everyone to congregate there.
“Not bad.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit hopped off the sled onto an empty space, glanced around with a satisfied nod, “This is the place.”
Then, with a fierce wave of his hand!
“Boom boom!!!”
Accompanied by a thunderous boom, nearly 300 incredibly loud crashes followed, and colossal statues, ranging from a few kilometers to several hundred meters in height, descended from the sky, landing heavily across the area.
The varieties of these statues appeared exceedingly diverse.
There were ones that resembled French fries, others that looked like cola bottles, and some styled like braised pork with preserved vegetables. One could even smell the food aroma emanating from these statues.
When the Air Food Series Props are upgraded to Ultimate Props, they turn into gigantic statues like these, which provide an overwhelming feeling of satiety with just one look.
“Hm?”
Chen Yi looked up at the countless statues that enveloped him and the Tuberculosis Rabbit, feeling a sudden and intense fullness in his stomach, so strong that it felt as though he was pregnant.
It was as if he had eaten a buffet worth tens of thousands of Points in one go.
He even had to resist the urge to vomit.
Without any pause, he immediately activated the “Forever Pure” Prop, which allowed him to slowly recover from this state.
“Whew!”
Chen Yi breathed a sigh of relief, rubbing his belly, and spoke somewhat helplessly, “Your statues can indeed produce the extreme satiety as you said they would, but the feeling of fullness doesn’t seem to stack with the increasing number of statues.”
“At least, your nearly 300 statues only made me feel bloated but not to the point of being stuffed to death.”
He then glanced at his personal panel’s health bar, “My health hasn’t dropped, which means your Ultimate Food Props can at best cause discomfort to enemies, and cannot be used against them, let alone stuff them to death.”
“Hehe.”
A mysterious smile crossed Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, “Although they can’t stuff people to death, they can starve them, don’t forget the Air Food Series Props can only produce a feeling of fullness, not actually sate hunger.”
“After a continuous 7 days, these enemies will start to faint, hallucinate, and even die due to not having eaten food for a long time.”
“You have experienced that feeling of fullness yourself, Yi. Do you think you’ll be able to eat anything in that state? Unless it’s by injecting nutritional fluids or forcibly feeding through a gastronomy tube, one could only be starved to death.”
“Even if the enemies did resort to those methods, it would be enough to make their lives miserable.”
“You know what’s most important, Yi?”
“The most important thing is, my Stellar Rank title ‘Leisure God’ doesn’t limit the number of identical Ultimate Props I can have. Do you know what that means? It means I can absolutely collect another set of Ultimate Props!”
“Once a complete set of Ultimate Props is collected, it will automatically get an Enhancement!”
“That’s the correct way to use the title!”
“To collect a set of Air Food Series Props, if relying solely on purchasing from the ‘Star Map’ platform, how much would it cost? 200,000 Points? 300,000 Points? At most, 500,000 Points would be enough!”
“The Air Food Series Props are not like the Zenith Radiance; they’re not that rare. There’s plenty of them on the Star Map, so much so that we couldn’t possibly buy them all.”
“This is just one complete set of Ultimate Air Food Series Props.”
“Yi, can you imagine the scene if I had a hundred sets, a thousand sets, ten thousand sets, or even a million sets? I could let players on a planet or even an entire Starfield die a miserable death in a state of both starvation and satiation!”
“How so?”
“Now can you appreciate the power of this title, Yi?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Chen Yi with eyes full of anticipation
“…”
Chen Yi remained silent with an odd expression on his face. Indeed, as Tuberculosis Rabbit said, if he really had a million sets of Air Food Series Props, then tormenting a Threefold Planet would truly be like child’s play.
Without any pressure.
He also roughly understood how Tuberculosis Rabbit planned to use his title. Sure, it was an economic title, but if used like Tuberculosis Rabbit intended, its economic impact could be maximized!
A million sets of Ultimate Edition Air Food Series Props slamming down would indeed be terrifying.
It was only a pity that the Ultimate Edition of the Air Food Series Props had its limitations; although the statues were big, they couldn’t kill people. Otherwise, if they were dropped directly, their destructive power would be much greater than his Heavenly Fire Spreads Wildly.
The ground would sink a good chunk.
“I hear you’ve named your plan to collect 289 Ultimate Air Food Props ‘Heaven.’ What do you plan to name this venture of yours?”
“Of course, it’s ‘Heaven MAX Edition’!”
“Okay.”
Chen Yi looked at the excited Tuberculosis Rabbit and nodded expressionlessly, “Sounds good.”
…
A moment later, Chen Yi suddenly spoke up as if he had thought of something, “How come you don’t feel fullness yourself?”
“I’m the master of this prop, so naturally, I won’t be affected by it. But Yi, I have another idea.”
“What idea?”
“You know those players who’ve turned into cleaners in hell, don’t you? They have their bellies turn deformed and are constantly overwhelmed by an intense hunger as they devour corpses drifting through the Star Sea, right?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit began excitedly, “What if I took these treasures there and paid hell a visit? What effect would it have? Could it give them an intense sense of both hunger and fullness? That should be a very interesting experience, right?”
“And luckily, I also have the identity of a Seed Player, so even if I died, I’d have a chance to return from hell.”
“I’ve seen plenty of Living Bodhisattvas, but it’s the first time I’m seeing a Living Yama. Focus your thoughts on something proper and stop thinking about playing all day.”
“What’s something proper?”
“Have you forgotten that on the Awesome Starfield, there’s only one planet that hasn’t paid us protection fees, ah no, that hasn’t bought our porcelain?”
“That seems to be the case.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked down at his collection account, and then his expression turned serious as he nodded, “I checked the collection record, and that planet still hasn’t bought our porcelain.”
Before leaving Sky City,
Li Yi had assigned some people to work at the ‘Yi God Paradise’ mall during their absence. Of course, those extremely expensive Points worth hundreds of millions were certainly not going to sell.
But those porcelains worth tens of thousands or a hundred thousand were still getting plenty of buyers.
Although it’s unclear how the historical culture of each planet developed, it was true that other planets did not have porcelain, or if they did, it was only part of a small cultural circle and not highly valued by people.
Unlike Blue Star.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi looked down at his personal panel’s “Time-Space Traveler” job remaining time and casually said, “This job will expire in 6 hours. Do you think you can make a round trip to the Awesome Starfield within 6 hours?”
“To pay a visit?”
“Heh!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit crossed his palms, cracking his knuckles with a sinister laugh, “Understood!”
…
