chapters.title: Chapter 560 - 560 375 If not convinced fight
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 560: Chapter 375: “If not convinced, fight!!! Chapter 560: Chapter 375: “If not convinced, fight!!! “The ‘Time-Space Traveler’ profession had six hours left before rotation; there was no need for them to rush back on the dot. If Blue Star players couldn’t make it back, that would be quite the spectacle.”
They’d be directly abandoning their homes and shifting battlefields.
Today is November 10th. If they hurried, they could make a round trip and catch the Singles’ Day Special Event on November 11th.
Of course, this event was probably only effective for Tuberculosis Rabbit and a few others, given that they were the only singles. Chen Yi, on the other hand, was not.
…
Without any hesitation, Tuberculosis Rabbit followed Yi’s lead to the Awesome Starfield and landed within the territory of that planet. As for Chen Yi, he was the first to return to Blue Star.
When it was about time, he would come out to fetch Tuberculosis Rabbit.
After all, even though he was a figure with some status, he wouldn’t engage in such oppressive activities as extortion. However, if his subordinates did so, that was none of his concern.
As for any danger to Tuberculosis Rabbit’s life, he wasn’t the least bit worried.
Not to mention the array of powerful weapons he had on hand.
Even if he died, his status as a Seed Player would spare him one life.
Besides, he truly didn’t believe the people on this planet would dare to touch Tuberculosis Rabbit.
…
“Is this the place?”
After Yi left, Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled up the map from his personal panel and scrutinized it, “Hmm… North Maple Planet, it should be here, a Threefold Planet.”
“A Threefold Planet? Isn’t it usually Fourfold Planets that are this arrogant?”
The highest-level Starfields in the Awesome Starfield were Fourfold Planets.
Being relatively new, in comparison with some of the veteran Starfields, the lowest ones were Fivefold or Sixfold Planets, and even Sixfold or Sevenfold Planets were considered basic, akin to the difference between a new game server and an old one within an online game.
Generally, the new servers were livelier, more populous.
The old servers, after enduring the torturous process of server upgrades for so long, had mostly died out, with very few surviving.
After confirming he didn’t find the wrong person, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at his backpack with satisfaction.
Once a set of Props was complete, it would only occupy one slot.
And right now, his backpack was filled with 300 slots, each containing an entire set of Ultimate Edition Air Food Series Props—that is, a total of 300 sets of Ultimate Edition Air Food Series Props.
Just as he expected.
Once a set of Props was complete, it would automatically be enhanced to an Ultimate Prop, even if he already owned that set.
So…
Without the slightest hesitation, he had bought 300 sets of the regular Air Food Series Props, spending just shy of 200 million Points.
But the effect they brought was astonishing.
He couldn’t care less about negotiating with the people on this planet. After all, he didn’t come here for money. Even if he could get a few billion more Points, it wasn’t of much use to him: he had come to test his new toy and, besides, everyone was watching them now.
They had to do something about this planet. If they did nothing, then those Races who paid a hefty protection fee would feel they’d been ripped off. If they realized they could get away without teaching a lesson, then the impact would be significant.
Just now, Yi had taken Tuberculosis Rabbit on a sled ride through the entire airspace of ‘North Maple Planet,’ which meant he could now deploy any of the Air Food giant statues at any location on the North Maple Planet’s territory.
This was the Special Effect of the Ultimate Edition’s full-course feast.
Immediately following…
“BOOM BOOM BOOM!!!”
An ear-splitting array of impact sounds echoed through the skies above North Maple Planet’s territory.
The noise was so loud that Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t resist but dig at his ears with his fingers.
It felt as if his eardrums might give out.
At a glance.
Countless Air Food statues, some reaching thousands of meters in height, were crashing down onto the surrounding territory, forming what looked like a neatly laid out grid of Go pieces from a high-altitude view.
And these Air Food statues were the so-called Dragon Gate Formation.
A move that spoke volumes, allowing one to sit back and fish in peace.
…
“That’s more like it.”
Li Yi, who had been waiting nearby North Maple Planet, finally breathed a sigh of relief upon witnessing this scene, nodding with satisfaction, “I just knew Chen Yi wouldn’t just leave so easily without dealing with North Maple Planet.”
“See, didn’t he show up?”
He didn’t know Chen Yi would be making another visit, since Chen Yi hadn’t informed him, but he understood Chen Yi.
With such a public affront, how could Chen Yi contain himself?
Everyone else bought in, but you didn’t—what does that mean? Looking down on Chen Yi, or refusing to get your hands dirty with the others?
Right?
As expected, here he came.
“But I must say, Chen Yi seems to have undergone some changes recently; his temper appears to have improved a lot. I thought Chen Yi would come and directly extinguish a Race, but now it seems he has no intention to kill.”
Yes.
While the disturbance appeared significant.
With over 9,000 giant statues landing on the territory of North Maple Planet, not a single person was hurt, yet the impact was far from small.
All players who looked up at these giant statues suddenly felt an overwhelming sense of fullness.
They particularly felt like chewing on some digestive pills, that desire to ease digestion.
Extremely uncomfortable.
“This is probably just a warning.”
Wang Qi, hands in his pockets, standing beside Li Yi, casually remarked, “If the people of North Maple Planet don’t get the hint and continue to resist, then next time Yi himself might come.”

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 561 375 If Not Convinced Fight_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 561: Chapter 375: “If Not Convinced, Fight!!!”_2 Chapter 561: Chapter 375: “If Not Convinced, Fight!!!”_2 “Yi hasn’t arrived yet, which means there’s still a chance for things to turn around.”
“If Yi were here, then we could really start collecting the bodies of the people from North Maple Planet.”
“Hehe.”
The Lisu Tribal Chief standing to the side couldn’t help but smile smugly, “The people of North Maple Planet really don’t know what’s good for them. Look at us Lisu, how tactful we are, not saying a word and just giving away a priceless mall for free.”
“And we were the first to do so.”
“Without us, there probably wouldn’t have been any follow-up. What is this called? This is called being sharp-eyed.”
“Yi might even feel that I know what’s good for me.”
“By the way, Chief Li, when can we get another piece of land in Sky City to build a mall?”
“You guys?”
Li Yi scanned the Lisu Tribal Chief with a touch of scorn, “You really dare to dream, even daring to jump around in front of Yi. The things you’ve done, trying to murder Yi under the guise of a duel?”
“Yi has been in a good mood lately; otherwise, just for that, your Lisu tribe would have been wiped out a hundred times over.”
“Still want land?”
“Just wait. When Yi discusses it with me, I’ll approve it for you. If you’re really that great, go and please Yi. If you can really please him, it’s not just a piece of land I’ll give you — how about two?”
“This…”
The Lisu Tribal Chief looked away awkwardly, then with hopeful eyes, gazed towards the territory of North Maple Planet. He was somewhat looking forward to North Maple Planet being naive so that after Yi took care of them,
he could try to take the mall on North Maple Planet into his own hands.
It’s a shame that it was Tuberculosis Rabbit who came, not Yi.
Even though he held out hope, he was well aware that North Maple Planet was relying on sheer luck, and the chances of them resisting were almost nil. It was hopeless.
“Right.”
Suddenly, Li Yi remembered something and turned to Wang Qi with a puzzled look, “Aren’t you planning to return to your Starfield? Since the Void Clan invaded Awesome Starfield last time, you’ve been staying on my turf.”
“Is the food here more to your taste?”
“Or do you plan to settle down here?”
“Go back?”
Wang Qi snorted coldly, “How do I go back? You know how many people I brought last time. Do you have any idea how many Points it costs to shuttle all those people back to Qi Daddy Starfield across Starfields? Tell me, why don’t I go back?”
“But haven’t I reimbursed you for the travel expenses?”
“Yes, you have reimbursed them, indeed, but it still costs a lot of Points to go back. Besides, what’s there to do when I get back? What does it matter where I farm maps? Might as well stay here.”
After a pause, Wang Qi continued with a meaningful tone, “Besides, being here often lets us see Yi, which is great.”
“Yi has never gone to my Qi Daddy Starfield.”
“In this regard, Yi certainly takes special care of you.”
“That’s also true.”
Li Yi suddenly laughed, lifting a cup of wine to his lips. In this regard, Yi indeed took good care of him. Recently, the number of visitors to Awesome Starfield’s Sky City had spiked, all from other Starfields traversing space to get here.
After all, it was Yi’s mall.
The gimmick was certainly strong.
Yi’s fame in the levelling game was not small at all. With several large-scale live streams, Yi’s reputation soared incredibly high.
Moreover, Yi himself made occasional appearances on the Whole Starfield announcements.
Even for players from the furthest Starfields, Yi’s name was not unfamiliar.
This was the impact without even using Yi’s fame for marketing. If Yi allowed him to promote the name of Yi’s mall, he could guarantee that Sky City would be packed within a month.
Unfortunately,
Yi did not agree.
To be precise, it wasn’t that Yi didn’t agree, but that he never dared to ask.
“However…”
Li Yi, as if struck by a thought, rubbed his chin, “Maybe I could talk to Tuberculosis Rabbit about this.”
He felt that Yi really trusted Tuberculosis Rabbit, for instance, the idea for the mall itself was suggested by Tuberculosis Rabbit. If Tuberculosis Rabbit agreed, perhaps it would be possible.
If we promote Yi’s mall,
not only will it boost the reputation of Awesome Starfield, but it will also significantly increase the overall GDP of Awesome Starfield. Most importantly, Yi’s mall could see a huge surge in sales. Yi would be grateful, and my importance would be clear to him.
…
“Still haven’t found me?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, lying on the grass with legs crossed, glanced at his watch and muttered in confusion, “It’s been three hours now, come on. Even for a Threefold Planet, shouldn’t they at least be able to find someone?”
“I’m not even hiding.”
“Just lying here like this, is it really that hard to find me?”
This mission had been an easy one.
He hadn’t taken it seriously at all.
The main task was simply to test out the new toy, and now that the new toy had been trialed and he was satisfied with the results, he was ready to contact Yi to head home after the people of North Maple Planet paid their protection fee.
But what now?
It seems the people of North Maple Planet don’t want to pay?
Impossible.
Are the people of North Maple Planet really that stubborn?
…
At this moment, North Maple Planet’s territory was surrounded by a good number of players, most of whom were not just ordinary players, but influential figures from other planets in Awesome Starfield.
It could be said like this.
If someone suddenly slaughtered all the spectators here,
the political landscape of every planet in Awesome Starfield would undergo a complete overhaul overnight. It was as simple as day turning into night.
“Can’t be, right? Is North Maple really planning to be this hardheaded?”
“They shouldn’t be, although I’ve heard before that the leadership of North Maple Planet can be pretty stubborn, never listening to anyone else’s advice. But this time, surely they’re not thinking of playing tricks? That’s Chen Yi we’re talking about; with his battle record, is North Maple Planet really not afraid of being wiped out?”
“Yeah, it’s just a Threefold Planet, after all. Where do they get the courage? You know, Chen Yi has even annihilated Sixfold Planets before, and killed Ninefold Planet players like Jiang Chenglu.”
“Maybe they’re just raising the money? After all, a few billion Points is still a lot of pressure for a Threefold Planet, especially since it’s not given willingly but demanded. They probably have to cough up a few billion more.”
For a moment,
many onlookers began discussing animatedly.
Nobody seemed in the least bit anxious.
Far from feeling impatient, as time passed, they grew more and more excited, eagerly anticipating how Yi would bring this farce to an end.
Just when everyone was patiently waiting,
an announcement rang out.
Like a bolt from the blue, it exploded over the skies of Awesome Starfield, hammering on everyone’s chest like a heavy drum!
“Ding, North Maple Planet announcement!”
“North Maple Planet has survived and thrived in this game not by cowardice or sycophancy, but by having the courage to draw our swords in the face of danger—and the strength to do so!”
“Today, as the leader of North Maple Planet, I have just one thing to say!”
“At no time will North Maple Planet ever pay protection fees to any power!”
“If you disagree, battle!!!”
An announcement from within North Maple Planet spread rapidly across Awesome Starfield. The players standing outside North Maple Planet’s territory, upon hearing the announcement, were stunned.
Everyone stood there, faces blank, unsure what to say.
Could they be serious?
They suspected they might have heard wrong.
Could it be that they were hallucinating from not sleeping for too long?
That’s Chen Yi, Yi himself—do they really have such guts?
They also didn’t know whether to believe what they had heard.

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 562 376 What a good tea
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 562: Chapter 376: “What a good tea! Chapter 562: Chapter 376: “What a good tea! When the announcement sounded, everyone was stunned.
But immediately after, the players watching from outside the territory of North Maple Planet eagerly opened their personal panels, continuously notifying their subordinates to arrive at the scene.
It is well known!
Chen Yi never picks up a single Prop after exterminating a tribe!
To be precise, it’s not that he doesn’t want to pick them up, but that he can’t, as they all know that it’s difficult for newbie players to receive Props from other players, including those dropped at the moment of death—which is considered a form of indirect gift.
Although the North Maple Clan wasn’t particularly powerful,
the Props dropped from the extinction of a whole tribe could still provide a hearty meal for them.
They weren’t worried that Yi would come and wipe them out too since they had paid protection fees. Yi was just a powerful character with a big temper who liked to annihilate tribes on a whim, not a psychic going on a murderous rampage.
He hadn’t yet reached the point of killing anyone he saw.
The only uncertainty was whether Yi would forbid anyone from picking up the Props dropped here after a clan’s extinction. If that was the case, then there was nothing to be done.
They had heard that in the Annihilation Starfield, after Chen Yi had eradicated several tribes, their dropped Props couldn’t be picked up. Before leaving, Chen Yi had issued a warning that anyone who dared pick up a single Prop of his would have their entire family eradicated.
Well.
And so… even after so much time, there were still batches of unclaimed Props scattered across the Annihilation Starfield.
To this day, no one dared to pick them up.
They had become a local spectacle.
Of course, whether there were any daring souls secretly pocketing a Prop at the edge, nobody knew. After all, there weren’t that many Props scattered around and swiping one unnoticed would likely be hard for Yi to detect, unless he had left behind some Props with detection and surveillance capabilities.
…
“Tough, really tough!”
The moment he heard the announcement, Li Yi instantly contacted the Chief of North Maple Planet, only to receive a response of steadfast defiance. He couldn’t help but sigh resignedly, “When did the old guy become so unbending?”
“Here we go, Awesome Starfield is about to lose a chunk of its revenue.”
Before Chen Yi’s first visit to the Awesome Starfield, Li Yi’s control over it wasn’t so strong—it was more nominal. For example, tribes like the Lisu barely heeded his commands.
But after a few visits by Chen Yi, there gradually were no tribes on Awesome Starfield that defied his orders, and the chief reason was that everyone had seen the terrifying power of Chen Yi, as well as his relationship with Li Yi.
Armed with this relationship, he almost completely took control of the entire Awesome Starfield in a short time.
He had control over all the military forces of each race, and even got a cut from each of their financial revenues.
But now it seemed, there would be one less chunk of revenue from North Maple Planet in the future.
…
“Alright then.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, his frustration evident as he rose to his feet and stood hands on hips on the grassland empty of anyone else, “Wait here, I’m going to call Yi.”
The Lisu Tribe was giving no respect to Yi, making him want to obliterate them himself, without even needing Yi’s intervention.
But… he wasn’t quite capable of that.
To put it more accurately, it wasn’t that he had no capability.
He had a total of 301 Ultimate Edition Air Food Series Props, enough to cover the whole territory of North Maple Planet. If he wished, he could ensure that all players on North Maple Planet could see those giant statue-sized foods overhead.
But there was a significant cost to using these Ultimate Edition Air Food Series Props.
That is, they required a lot of time.
His Air Food Series Props could only force a feeling of fullness, preventing eating of food—to starve the Lisu players to death would take at least six to seven days, maybe even over ten days.
But Yi’s profession was about to change very soon.
Only a few hours were left.
There was simply no time for him to wield his methods.
But Tuberculosis Rabbit was oblivious to all this.
When that announcement echoed over the skies of North Maple Clan, a current of betrayal, no, rather a surge, began rampantly flowing within North Maple Clan’s territory.
Countless players armed with various weapons stormed into the supreme ruling council of the North Maple Clan.
Under the Former Leader’s shocked gaze, these players aimed their weapons at him and without any hesitation, they lunged forward.
This even included the Former Leader’s personal driver, subordinates, and most trusted confidants.
They also hated paying the protection fees, but they were more aware of the consequences of offending Chen Yi directly. When faced with the choice between clan extinction and momentary shame, they much rather bear the shame—and how could it be called shame when even the Former Leader had paid it?
Chief Li had paid the most, a whopping several billion.
Apart from them, the entire Awesome Starfield had paid up.
Just the thought of being assigned after death to the depths of hell as nauseating cleaners made them feel like throwing up. They would rather kneel than become creatures that only devoured corpses.
Before long,
another announcement rang out across the entire North Maple Sphere.
“Ding, announcement from North Maple Planet.”
“Dear Mr. Tuberculosis Rabbit, our leader has just spoken nonsense due to senility, and we have swiftly executed the old chief. We have already sent someone with Points to purchase porcelain from Yi God Paradise at Sky City.”
“We hope to receive understanding from Mr. Scar Dog and Mr. Chen Yi.”

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 563 376 What a good tea_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 563: Chapter 376: “What a good tea!”_2 Chapter 563: Chapter 376: “What a good tea!”_2 “All players on North Maple Planet hold Mr. Scar Dog and Mr. Chen Yi in the highest regard, respects to you!”
Hmm.
The time gap between this announcement and the previous one was no more than 5 minutes.
…
“What does this mean?”
Li Yi, who had been feeling regretful, was a bit confused when he heard the announcement, “Did they just betray us? That quickly? The leader was killed within 5 minutes?”
“Doesn’t the North Maple Planet have an army? Don’t they have any loyal followers?”
“He was the leader of a Threefold Planet, after all. Isn’t this a bit too weak for rule to be overthrown in just 5 minutes?”
“…”
Meanwhile, upon receiving the news, the Lisu Tribal Chief’s face twitched quizzically as he spoke in a faint voice, “I heard that all the military forces and loyal followers under the Former Leader of North Maple have betrayed him, without exception.”
The shock of this news was the greatest for him.
He suddenly remembered that some time ago, all the players of the Lisu tribe were forced by Chen Yi to wear the title “Target of God Yi”; this made their players obstructed everywhere they went for a long period.
Back then, Chief Li had suggested that he pay a large sum of money to Chen Yi to avoid disaster, saying that it might spare them from the danger of extinction later on.
But at that time, he was really reluctant to give away that money.
Later, he even reached out to a player from Sixfold Planet, attempting to take down Chen Yi in a beheading operation. And during that short time, he always felt that the looks in the eyes of his loyal followers were odd, occasionally surrounding him closely.
He had thought it was because these followers were afraid of Chen Yi’s arrival and thus acted unnaturally protective, ready to help him fend off the enemy at the first opportunity, which even moved him somewhat.
Deep down, he felt that with such a group of followers who trusted him so much, he certainly couldn’t just give in easily and diminish his own prestige in their eyes.
If it came to it, they would simply go down fighting!
Now he realized that those close followers were not afraid of Chen Yi’s arrival—they were probably ready to betray and get rid of him quickly, lest Chen Yi held them accountable and wiped out their race.
“…”
Thinking of this, the Lisu Tribal Chief couldn’t help but slightly twitch the corners of his expressionless mouth, having never considered he had been so close to death.
…
Meanwhile.
The onlookers around North Maple Planet were also speaking with sighs of reflection.
“The leader of North Maple Planet was pretty tough, but it’s clear that his people weren’t, too bad. I really thought North Maple Planet could keep up the resistance, you know. If they had, I would have admired North Maple Clan as a group of real men.”
“Give it a rest, stop making sarcastic comments. If you’re so great, why did you pay the protection fee? Go to Sky City now and say you want to return that porcelain and get a refund from Chen Yi. If you dare to do that, then I’ll admit you’ve got guts.”
“Alright, it seems this farce should come to an end now. It’s a pity; I was looking forward to seeing Yi wipe out a race. I’ve always heard about Yi wiping out races but never got the chance to witness it. They say Yi can annihilate a race in less than an hour.”
“About the same, I guess. Didn’t you see Yi’s firepower when the Void Clan invaded? That firepower directly covered half the sky, and even such a tough Race like the Void Clan was forced to flee. How long do you think your race could last?”
“No use.”
A player watching from the side shook his head, “No matter how tough you are, it won’t work. You know the player from Sixfold Planet that Yi wiped out, right? That Sixfold Planet had the ability to share life among their players, which means you could never kill any player of that race unless you wiped out the entire race.”
“And then?”
“Then one of their players went to trouble Chen Yi.”
“He was taken out by Chen Yi on the spot, and afterwards you all saw what happened. The damage Chen Yi dealt to that player was shared among all the players of Sixfold Planet, resulting in the extinction of the entire planet!”
“That planet had millions, maybe even tens of millions of people. It was wiped out like that without even seeing Chen Yi in person. Think about it, how terrifying was Chen Yi’s attack that killed that Sixfold Planet player?!”
“I bet it was the same attack that killed Jiang Chenglu!”
“Enough, can you just stop? I’ve already paid the protection fee, and your words are starting to scare me again.”
…
Meanwhile.
In a deep part of North Maple Clan’s territory.
Inside a tea room.
An old man was sitting cross-legged in front of a tea table, a smug smile playing around his brows as he lifted a cup of tea to his lips and took a sip before he couldn’t help but exclaim, “What a good tea!”
He was the former leader of the North Maple Clan.
He hadn’t wanted to pay the protection money, hoping to gamble on Chen Yi’s vanity not demanding it directly, as demanding protection money didn’t sound reputable. But to his surprise, Chen Yi didn’t care about saving face.
Not even a single day could he wait.
Men were sent on the very day.
What else could be done? He played the coward, but he didn’t want to give in so easily, as he sought to establish an image of resilience and strength. After all, surrending after being confronted seemed far too spineless.
So, he issued a tough public announcement first.
Right after the announcement, without any hesitation, he had his most trustworthy confidant organize a rebellion to kill him and publish the capitulating announcement.
The public and outsiders were oblivious to this; in everyone’s eyes, the old leader of the North Maple Clan was defiant until death, ultimately betrayed, and the citizens of the North Maple Clan raised the protection money.
Yes.
The citizens of the North Maple Clan raised the protection money.
The primary reason he was reluctant to pay out of the national treasury was that once spent, the treasury would be depleted, significantly reducing his quality of life. Therefore, he plotted the rebellion.
It would not only leave him with a good reputation.
It also allowed his confidant to take over as the North Maple Clan’s acting leader—the first order of business being to collect protection money from the people. Since he had already issued a tough public announcement, the North Maple citizens knew that they needed to raise the protection money immediately to avoid annihilation!
Therefore, no one delayed.
Even those who were usually the most avaricious contributed their share.
2.7 billion Points were quickly raised.
They were already en route to Sky City by this time.
It was a triple win! He had established an image of defying power to the death, used the money from the North Maple players instead of the national treasury, and had smoothly escaped the whirlpool of events.
In time.
After returning to North Maple Planet from hell and reclaiming his rights and position, Chen Yi wouldn’t pay any attention to him, nor would he notice that he had returned from hell alive. It might even be that Chen Yi wouldn’t care whether he was dead or alive.
After all, why would someone like Chen Yi bother with such trifles?
What was this?
This was the allure of cunning.
With that thought.
The old man couldn’t help but sip the tea from the book once more, sighing with appreciation, “Good tea, indeed. Our tea from the North Maple Clan is just as exquisite as that in the hands of Chen Yi.”
But just then—
A man in a black suit walked in, striding towards him and bending forward with a respectful expression.
“Leader, greetings.”
“Mhm, speak.”
The old man simply lifted his eyelids for a glance, then said nothing more, waiting patiently for the man to speak. This man was several ranks below his most loyal confidant, not yet worthy of idle chatter with him.
“Nothing much.”
The man in the suit spoke succinctly, pulling a silencer-equipped gun from his pocket and pressing it against the old man’s head, “It’s just a farewell.”
The next second—
Before the incredulous eyes of the North Maple Clan’s old leader, the trigger was pulled.
“Bang.”
A somewhat muffled sound echoed through the entire teahouse.
And the leader succumbed amidst unwillingness and despair, slowly collapsing into a pool of blood.
After doing all this.
The man in the black suit stepped out of the teahouse, removed the gun and white gloves, tossing them casually into the arms of a subordinate waiting at the door.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 564 377 Someone is hinting at you to propose
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 564: Chapter 377: “Someone is hinting at you to propose. Chapter 564: Chapter 377: “Someone is hinting at you to propose. “Yes.”
With the nod from the underling standing at the door, the man known as the acting leader’s confidant calmly walked towards the distance.
His boss had not given him this command.
What the boss had instructed him to do was to take good care of the old leader and, after this period had passed, and after Yi stopped paying attention to the matters on North Maple Planet, they would then bring the old leader out of hell.
Yes.
That was the command his boss had given him.
But he did not carry it out.
What good would it do him? None whatsoever, but if he got rid of the old leader, letting his boss truly assume the role of leader, then he, as the confidant, would become the second in command of the North Maple Clan.
The boss was blindly loyal to the old leader.
He was not.
He was only loyal to his own boss.
…
Meanwhile, within the North Maple Clan, the acting leader who had just breathed a sigh of relief, had finally sent Tuberculosis Rabbit away, and the North Maple Clan was at last free from the risk of annihilation.
What a mess this was.
He was also helpless about the old leader’s cooking antics; if you’re going to admit defeat, then just do it decisively, no need to put on such a performance.
Unwilling to touch the national treasury’s money, yet wanting to create a persona of being staunchly defiant until death.
Why bother?
Besides, amongst the entire Awesome Starfield, there were plenty of other Races stronger than theirs, and hadn’t they all paid the protection fee? What enemies could there be? Moreover, being able to bridge a connection with Yi through several hundred million Points was actually quite worthwhile.
If North Maple ever faced an existential crisis in the future, relying on this relationship, it wasn’t guaranteed that Yi would lend them a hand, but at least they could get a word in, and there would be a glimmer of hope, wouldn’t there?
And just then—
He saw his confidant walking over, and his brow immediately furrowed as he asked, “Why have you returned? Weren’t you supposed to be taking care of the old leader in hell?”
“The old leader has been killed by me.”
The confidant was quite blunt, coming forward to support the man’s arm, ushering him to sit on the leader’s chair, and then pushing him down before he knelt on both knees, bowing to the ground.
“From today on, boss, you are the only leader of the North Maple Clan!”
“Under your leadership, the North Maple Clan will thrive!”
Simultaneously.
Inside the hall, many of the man’s subordinates, who had already received the news, kneeled down in unison, facing the man seated in the leader’s chair and shouted in chorus, “We pay our respects to the Leader!”
“You… you all…”
The man, sitting in the chair representing the leader’s position, stuttered with pale lips and a trembling body, “You… you’re all misleading me!!”
“You’re misleading me!”
But following that—
As one salutation followed another, the man gradually sat up straight against his will, looked toward the kneeling crowd before him, and his mouth slowly began to curl into a smile before he began laughing uncontrollably.
“Good, good, good!”
The North Maple Clan, from this day forth, officially underwent a change of leadership!
Perhaps even the old leader of the North Maple Clan would never have thought that he would fake his death to hide in the depths of hell as a cleaner, and that no one would avenge him, because, apart from the old leader’s loyal followers, everyone else believed the old leader had been killed by the angry populace.
As for why he’d be killed again in hell?
Who knows?
Perhaps some angry citizens, in their rage, had ventured into hell to kill again, which wasn’t impossible.
…
“I could go for another hotpot meal…”
At this moment, deep in the galaxy’s hell, an old man with a weathered face sat absent-mindedly in his wicker chair, unconsciously licking his dry lips, yearning for that long-lost hotpot meal.
His name was Ping Ye.
He once thought he would have to spend his entire life in the depths of hell, serving as a janitor.
But last time, he was inadvertently taken by Chen Yi out of the deep hell via the Gold Miner category, and even though it was for less than a minute, he had still breathed the long-missed fresh air.
The surroundings no longer filled with the acrid stench of rotting corpses.
It excited him.
And he did not return empty-handed; he had brought back a hotpot meal, which he had eaten with great care over ten days, even finishing all the sour soup base in the end, reluctant to throw it away, pouring it into his stomach.
Of course.
Even if he wanted to throw it away, he couldn’t.
Because there are no trash bins in the depths of hell, well, it couldn’t exactly be said that there are no trash bins; they themselves served the role of mobile trash bins.
They were the trash bins.
If they wanted to throw something away, their stomachs were the only place to do it.
“Just don’t know when I can get out again…”
Ping Ye lay on his wicker chair in a daze, imagining when Chen Yi would take him out again; he wanted another round of hotpot, hopefully with more time so he could bring back more food.
Of course, if he could bring back a woman, that would be even better.
In the depths of hell, all people, including men and women, have their stomachs forcibly enlarged, so it’s impossible for men and women to mate here—not to mention.
If you’re a normal man with such a huge belly, mating successfully is out of the question for a simple reason: you can’t reach.
So…
They had to resort to some very disgusting, unspeakable means to solve some unmentionable physiological needs.
…
“You’re back?”
Elsewhere in the outside world, on Blue Star.
Sword Without End, who was sitting in a chair engrossed in something, looked towards Tuberculosis Rabbit and addressed them, “How’s everything, all went smoothly?”

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - 565 377 Someone is hinting at a marriage
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 565: Chapter 377: “Someone is hinting at a marriage proposal.”_2 Chapter 565: Chapter 377: “Someone is hinting at a marriage proposal.”_2 “Hmm.”
Chen Yi nodded slightly, didn’t say much, and casually sat down on his beach chair, looking at the countdown that was about to end, starting to anticipate what his new profession would be.
‘Occupation Name’: Cosmic Traveler.
‘Occupational Effect’: You can bring your friends along, to various Starfields and planets, no matter how far the distance. You can disregard any barriers, even if located in a cage or on a map, you can still use this effect.
Nothing in this world can imprison you, you are a carefree and untroubled being.
You should experience everything the world has to offer.
However, as a price, you cannot attack other players; any attack you make on other players will be ineffective.
‘Occupational Restriction’: You can bring up to five of your friends at most, and each time you teleport a friend, 10,000 Points will be deducted, and each teleport will trigger a 24-hour cooldown period.
This was the job randomly assigned to him by the ‘Faceless One’, which only had a few minutes left before ending the rotation.
And it was with this profession that he had just brought the Tuberculosis Rabbit back from the Awesome Starfield.
Just didn’t know what profession would be randomly assigned to him this time.
“Hey, stop talking about it.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit sat down angrily in Sword Without End’s arms, rolled up his sleeves unhappily, and said, “You know why I went there, right? It was to collect a protection fee, and to show a little lesson to this family that refused to pay up.”
“So I set off with my Ultimate Prop.”
“I thought the North Maple Clan would comply, but guess what? Their leader actually issued an unyielding notice, declaring they’d rather die than pay the protection fee.”
“Hey, isn’t it infuriating to hear that? Although we are the ones paying the protection fee, you can’t say we are the ones collecting it, right? Doesn’t it make us seem like what, remnants of an old era? The mob?”
“I was already preparing to have Yi take action, not to mention, at the very least, that we’d have to teach this race a lesson. If they really didn’t repent, we’d just eliminate them altogether.”
“In the end, it was Yi who didn’t want to waste more time, so I just came back like this. Otherwise, let me tell you, today the Awesome Starfield would’ve been a river of blood!”
“That tough?”
Sword Without End raised his eyebrows in surprise, “It’s been a long time since I’ve seen anyone dare to be that tough, provoking Yi like that.”
“Who’s to say otherwise?”
“How did it end up being resolved?”
“In the end, the people of that planet killed their own leader, and then they paid up. Yi didn’t want to waste too much time, so he came back. And take note, it’s also because the number of players on that planet wasn’t high; otherwise, Yi would have found the perfect reason to accumulate layers for his ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ prop.”
“I see.”
Sword Without End nodded thoughtfully, indicating he understood.
…
Meanwhile,
Chen Yi sat calmly on one side, peacefully looking at his ‘Faceless One’ occupation panel as he awaited his job rotation.
A few minutes later.
‘Ding…’
With the sound of a notification, the new occupation also descended.
‘Occupation Name’: Magician.
‘Occupational Effect’: You can see through any playing cards, even if they are SSS-ranked props. It’s as if you have a pair of x-ray vision glasses, easily seeing the backside of the cards.
You will be the only emperor of the casino!
The charming magician of every girl’s dreams!
In addition, you can conjure red roses, hats, shoes, and anything else you desire from any place – if you wish, you can even make a rose grow out of your hemorrhoids.
‘Occupational Restriction’: You will be forced to wear the ‘Magician’ occupational outfit, and your demeanor will be altered, becoming somewhat effeminate and filled with charm.
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi raised an eyebrow thoughtfully at his profession, having gone through so many random occupations, this one seemed to be the least useful. So far the only effect was being able to see through any playing cards?
To perform some simple magic tricks?
Like having a guest randomly draw a card from a deck and then being able to guess the number on that card?
Seems like a pretty decent skill,
But what’s the use of this thing for him?
As for the latter point, producing roses out of thin air from anywhere? Is it one or a bunch?
After a brief moment of contemplation, Chen Yi snapped his fingers lightly!
The next second—
The entire rooftop spread with countless roses in every corner, from the sand, chairs, crevices in the rocks, and so on, instantly enveloped by the extremely vibrant roses.
It looked incredibly romantic.
And each rose was exceptionally fresh, with visible droplets of water on them.
The unique scent of roses also instantly entered the nostrils of everyone present.
“Yi…”
Jiaye, who was originally sitting on a chair beside him, absorbed in reading a book, was suddenly interrupted by the scene before her, looked up in a daze, scanned her surroundings, then turned to Chen Yi with a happy expression, “It’s so beautiful…”
“If a girl could be proposed to in such an environment, that would definitely be romantically overwhelming!”
“Yi…”
Sword Without End held a fist to his mouth and coughed lightly before he spoke in a low voice, “Someone’s hinting at a proposal.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit kept laughing and waggling his eyebrows.
As usual, Tie Chui stood by with a goofy smile on his face, not saying anything, but everyone had grown accustomed to his presence—a kind of invisibility technique comparable to an SSS skill.
Even standing there doing nothing, it was hard for anyone to take notice of him.
“Not bad.”
Chen Yi looked around at the sea of roses, chuckled lightly without saying much. It looked pretty, but was that all there was to this occupation?
A rose sea for showing off or setting the mood, and a skill to see through playing cards that would sooner or later get one’s hands broken for cheating at a casino.
That’s all there was to the occupation’s effects.
This must be the lousiest, most useless occupation he’d ever stumbled upon.
No, there had been another one that was even worse.
That occupation that significantly increased one’s charm towards both males and other genders, that occupation was truly useless.
But as for the constraints of this occupation, maybe there was some use.
You must wear the “Magician” costume, and it changes your aura to be somewhat delicate, which might indeed produce a good effect at some comic conventions or cosplay events. After a glance around, she happily turned to Chen Yi and said, “It looks so beautiful… ”
“If a girl could be proposed to in such an environment, that would definitely be romantically overwhelming!”

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - 566 378 This promotional event is extremely
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 566: Chapter 378: This promotional event is extremely tempting. Chapter 566: Chapter 378: This promotional event is extremely tempting. “November 11th, early morning 07:51”
Struggling in a clubhouse, Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at the time and suddenly snapped to full alertness. He yanked Sword Without End down from a wall with a swift motion.
“Stop fucking around!!!”
“It’s almost 8 o’clock, the Singles’ Day limited-time event is about to start!”
“What?”
Sword Without End was stunned for a moment, but then quickly came to his senses. He tried to pull Tie Chui, who was plastered against another wall, but after several tugs failed to move him, he couldn’t help but curse in frustration.
“Are you fucking serious, man? You got barbs on you or something?”
It was only with Tuberculosis Rabbit’s help that they managed to forcibly strip Tie Chui off the wall and dash toward the Garden District.
On the wall where Tie Chui had been clinging, there was a hole of moderate size, and at the moment, a pair of jade legs were sticking out from it, trapped against the wall.
…
Panting and out of breath, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others finally managed to make it back to their base, the rooftop of the Garden District, just before 8 o’clock.
By that time, Chen Yi and Jiaye were already sitting there waiting for them.
Confronted with Chen Yi’s peculiar gaze, Tuberculosis Rabbit felt a chill down his spine and said, trying to sound nonchalant, “Uh, Yi, we went out to a map because Tie Chui wanted to earn some Points. We feared it was dangerous for him to go alone, so we accompanied him.”
But the instant after he spoke, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t resist slapping himself in the face.
What a shitty excuse that was.
After returning from Awesome Starfield, Yi had distributed over a hundred billion Points to each of them, making the lack of Points excuse seem rather far-fetched.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi didn’t say much but looked at his brother-in-law with a complex expression, wondering if these people would be a bad influence on him. His brother-in-law’s lifestyle was many times more disciplined than theirs.
He then spoke calmly, “Try to find a girlfriend, straighten out your lifestyle. As a man, you should have a sense of responsibility and not always be messing around outside.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded eagerly, looking rather sheepish as he replied, “Yes, yes, yes.”
At that moment, Jiaye, standing next to Chen Yi, suddenly said in a distant tone, “I just remembered, it’s been a while since I visited the White Phoenix Clan Empress.”
“Cough cough!!”
Chen Yi, who was about to add something else, instantly began coughing uncontrollably upon hearing this, feeling his scalp tingle as he prepared to change the subject.
He’d thought Jiaye had forgotten all about it.
Since their last visit to the White Phoenix Clan, he’d deliberately avoided mentioning the subject, and Jiaye hadn’t brought it up either. He assumed Jiaye had forgotten, but clearly, he remembered perfectly.
His lifelong reputation seemed to be doomed because of the White Phoenix Clan Empress.
Luckily, at that moment, the time reached 08:00.
An announcement rang out, conveniently extricating him from the awkward situation.
“Ding!”
“Game Event Announcement!”
“From November 11th to November 13th, the ‘Double Eleven Singles’ Day’ special limited-time event officially begins!”
“All players can participate in the event during these three days.”
“Event One: Gift Package.”
“Every player can purchase one event gift package priced at 1,298 Points, originally priced at 64,800 Points.”
“The package includes the following items: one C-grade random Prop, five random Skill Fragments, and one E-grade random Vehicle.”
“Each player is limited to one purchase.”
“Event Two: Half-Price Sale.”
“During the event, all direct-sale items in players’ individual panel stores will be sold at half price.”
“Event Three: GMV Battle Royale!”
“If the total GMV turnover of Blue Star Mall reaches 100 million Points during the event, all players will receive an E-grade gift package.”
“If the total GMV turnover reaches 1 billion Points, all players can receive a C-grade gift package.”
“If the total GMV turnover reaches 10 billion Points, all players can receive a random B-grade Prop.”
“If the total GMV turnover reaches 100 billion Points, all players can receive a random A-grade Prop, a random A-grade Skill, a Zenith Radiance, a random B-grade Vehicle, and the title ‘Power of the Group.'”
“Moreover, during the event, the top hundred contributors to the total turnover will receive special rewards, and the top three will obtain special rare titles and rewards.”
“Event Four: Single Noble Battle Royale.”
“During the event, all players who haven’t spent a romantic night with someone of the opposite sex within the last month will be forcibly bestowed the title ‘Single Dog.'”
“Players who have been single since birth will receive the limited edition title ‘Single Noble.'”
“We will also generate a Love Rankings based on the number of times all players have dated, with the top three players on the Love Rankings sharing a free tutorial on how to successfully pursue the opposite sex.”
“Additionally, every player’s head will display their own number of dates.”
“Event Five: Surprise Thank-You Event!”
“During the event, all players who have never dated and have never actively pursued love will receive a huge boost in luck, to experience the charm of the Goddess of Luck’s favor, along with an exclusive limited-time title—’Self-disciplined Natural-born Single Dog’!”
The event announcement echoed in the ears of all players.
That night, many players either stayed awake or woke up early.
It was a custom on Blue Star.
Whenever a new event announcement dropped or there was an update, players would set aside what they were doing the night before to be ready to hear the announcement first-hand. After all, both announcements and updates often signaled a minor upheaval.

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - 567 378 This promotion is extremely tempting
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 567: Chapter 378: This promotion is extremely tempting. _2 Chapter 567: Chapter 378: This promotion is extremely tempting. _2 “Love Ranking?”
Sword Without End immediately noticed the new feature of the updated event and first looked above his head.
There was a line of glaring large characters.
“Number of Romantic Encounters: 1!”
Yi and Jiaye also had the number 1 above their heads, while only Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui had “Number of Romantic Encounters: 0” above theirs.
Moreover, Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui also had an additional title forced upon them—
“Single Noble!”
“…Truly annoying.”
With an expressionless face, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at the title above his head and said discontentedly, “Do you know how easy it is for me to find a girlfriend? Without getting into details, if I just put the word out, the next day there would be a bunch of girls lining up at the entrance of the residential area waiting for me to choose.”
“I just don’t want to delay the girls, that’s the only reason I’ve been staying single.”
Afterward, he turned his head sideways to look at Tie Chui, who appeared rather dopey, and said with a touch of peculiarity, “Speaking of which, why do you also have the ‘Single Noble’ title? I’ve always thought ‘Self-disciplined Natural-born Single Dog’ would suit you better.”
Chen Yi turned his attention to the so-called Love Ranking.
“Global Love Ranking.”
“Top rank player: Ji Ruping.”
“Number of Romantic Encounters: 3878.”
“Second rank player: Bian Kelun”
“Number of Romantic Encounters: 1529.”
“Third rank…”
“…”
With an expressionless face, Chen Yi looked down at the Love Ranking and remained silent for a long time at the top position before he asked Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Can you calculate for me, if the number of romantic encounters is 3878—”
“Assuming one relationship a day, starting in the morning and ending at night, how long would it take to reach 3878 encounters?”
“Er…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was also bewildered, after fiddling with his fingers for a long time he finally replied cluelessly, “One year has 365 days, so it’s almost 11 years.”
“So it means one a day for 11 years.”
With his words finished,
Everyone fell silent.
The concept of 3878 romantic encounters, well, let’s put it this way, ninety-nine percent of people in their entire lives won’t even know that many names, and most people at most know a few hundred names at most.
And these few hundred names usually constitute the entire social circle of a person’s life from childhood to adulthood.
Counting people met at school, people met at work, people met in society,
The total number of people whose names you’d know is also probably just a few hundred.
For the majority of people, these few hundred individuals make up their entire lives.
And this top ranker has a staggering 3878 romantic encounters alone—they seriously doubted whether this top ranker could still remember the names of her past boyfriends. Not to mention remembering them all, could she even recall half of them?
Ji Ruping.
It sounded like a woman’s name.
Is there such a surname? It feels a bit unfamiliar.
…
At this moment, because of this announcement, some unexpected situations had arisen all over Blue Star.
For instance, inside a certain room.
A simple and honest-looking man was staring blankly at the numbers above his wife’s head—
“Number of Romantic Encounters: 71.”
“Little Liu,”
After a long silence, the man sighed weakly, “You’ve kept this quite secret, haven’t you? Didn’t you tell me I was your first love?”
“That… ”
Standing opposite the man, the woman began carefully, “Honey, listen to me, those were just for fun when I was in school, there were no real feelings involved, I was naive then, and I’d just get together with someone if they asked, I can’t even remember their names now.”
“It was all no feelings, just fooling around.”
“You have to believe me, husband, for me you’re the first love, the only person I’ve truly liked is you.”
“Mhm.”
The man nodded slightly, not saying much, and blankly took a cigarette out of his pocket, put it to his mouth, and lit it with a somewhat dazed look. In the pale blue smoke, he turned his head to look off into the distance.
…
As the saying goes, there are no doomed people in this world, only those who are more doomed.
For example.
At this moment in a certain room.
A man looks at the number above his wife’s head with a blank expression.
“Number of times in love, 3878 times.”
“Ji Ruping…”
Only after a long while did the man snap back to reality, his eyes filled with shock as he looked at the charming woman sitting in front of him and murmured, “Didn’t you tell me you’ve only been married twice?”
“What’s going on here?”
“I never knew that one day you could actually make it to the number one spot on the global list?”
“3878 times? Is this really love? It seems you’ve turned it into a business?”
“How come they haven’t locked you up?”
“…”
Ji Ruping suddenly didn’t know how to explain herself and felt as if she was sitting on pins and needles, somewhat blaming the game upgrade for launching such an event that might ruin their perfectly good life.
In such times, finding a safe and reliable man was not easy.
The moment the game upgrade descended.
The previously vocal advocates for independent women suddenly fell silent, and even fools realized that under these circumstances, a woman with poor physical health had a very slim chance of survival. The best way to live through it was to find a strong and capable partner.
…
“Title Name”: The Power of a Group.
“Title Level”: A-level.
“Title Effect”: Upon acquiring this title, you can connect your Life Value with that of other players who have also acquired this title, and you will share each other’s Life Values.
“Title Restriction”: None.
“Title Introduction”: The power of a group is beyond your imagination.
At this time, Chen Yi was sitting on a beach chair, thoughtfully looking at this title panel. This title would only be awarded to every player if the total GMV of the mall reached 100 billion within three days.
GMV refers to the total sales volume.
That is, the reward would only be given if all players combined spent over 100 billion Points within three days.
He even started to suspect whether this reward was targeted at him?
“During the event period, if the total GMV of Blue Star Mall reaches 100 million Points, all players can receive an E-level gift package.”
“If the total GMV of the Blue Star Marketplace reaches 10 billion Points, all players can receive a C-level gift package.”
“If the total GMV reaches 100 billion Points, all players can receive a random B-level prop.”
“If the total GMV reaches 1000 billion Points, all players will receive a random A-level prop, a random A-level Skill, a Zenith Radiance, a random B-level Vehicle, and the title ‘The Power of a Group.'”
Otherwise, for the average Novice Planet, reaching a total sales volume of 100 billion within three days?
What a joke?
Who are you kidding!
Keep in mind that even Li Yi reaching 10 billion Points on the Novice Planet was considered a milestone, so you can imagine how hard it is to earn Points there.
1000 billion Points!
It might sound easy, just needing 100 million people to each spend 1000 Points.
But after all the upheavals and setbacks, the population of Blue Star had long since dropped below 100 million, and though the exact number wasn’t clear, it was certainly not much; most Blue Star players had already settled in hell.
They had no intention or ability to return to Blue Star.
And even those who had the ability to return often chose not to, finding it too exhausting and preferring the stability in hell.
Besides, this event came with a particularly attractive discount offer.
“All players can each buy a promotional gift package for 1298 Points, originally priced at 64800 Points.”
“This package contains the following: 1 C-level random prop, 5 random Skill Fragments, and 1 E-level random Vehicle.”
“Limited to one purchase per player.”
This discount was extremely tempting.
Just by spending 1298 Points, you could get all these items, which were already well beyond the price of the Points needed to buy them.
Even if someone had over a thousand Points in their pocket, they would probably all go to buy this instead of spending it in the mall, as there wasn’t much of interest to buy there.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 568 379 One of Each Exactly Twins of Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 568: Chapter 379: One of Each, Exactly Twins of Dragon and Phoenix, Simply Perfect. Chapter 568: Chapter 379: One of Each, Exactly Twins of Dragon and Phoenix, Simply Perfect. “Is it worth it or not?”
Chen Yi was frowning, seriously pondering this question.
The Population Value of all Blue Star players was shared; he had seen this ability before, and it was consistent with the ability of that Sixfold Planet player he had killed.
For most planets,
this ability was extremely powerful.
It could greatly protect the safety of the planet’s players, one could say that as long as a planet had this ability, it could completely avoid any player deaths and advance to a Ninefold Planet.
With this ability, it was impossible for the players of that planet to die, even if they encountered a powerful enemy, they could still face it with a smile, since even the strongest attack would be spread out among countless people and felt like nothing more than mosquito bites.
A mere drizzle.
But there’s a fatal flaw to this ability!
That is… it all depends on luck.
If they really met a player whose damage value was off the charts, what originally would’ve been an incident where only one player needed to die now required the whole race to be buried with them.
Just like that Sixfold Planet he destroyed.
If that Sixfold Planet didn’t have this ability, he would have just killed that player at most, nothing more could’ve been done, particularly since he was inside the map at the time. But, coincidentally, that Sixfold Planet player had this ability, so in his own confusion, the players of the Sixfold Planet were annihilated.
He believed
that the players of the Sixfold Planet must have had a lot of powerful props and skills, but unfortunately, they had no idea and couldn’t react in time and just bit the dust.
Thinking of this,
Chen Yi immediately dismissed the idea of exchanging for this title. Putting aside whether it was worth the hundreds of billions of Points, the title just wasn’t suitable for them. Once Blue Star left the Novice Period, the enemies they attracted would definitely not be low-level.
After all, people from Low-Grade Planets wouldn’t dare to provoke them. Those who dared were at least from the Sixfold Planet.
If they happened to encounter someone with an insanely high single-target damage ability like him, it would turn an incident of just one Blue Star player dying into a major catastrophe with Blue Star facing annihilation.
Moreover, if all Blue Star players had this title, it would mean he could no longer kill Jiaye, and his Wife Killer title could not be activated again.
All players’ Life Values were shared, so how could he kill Jiaye?
Unless Blue Star was wiped out, Jiaye couldn’t be killed.
The final point was that there really wasn’t much in the shop, even if he were to spend hundreds of billions of Points, there wasn’t much to improve combat power, mostly just costumes.
A single costume was only a few hundred Points.
Using hundreds of billions of Points to buy costumes, that would be enough to buy one for every player in the world and still have plenty to spare.
After careful consideration,
Chen Yi decided to ignore the title reward obtainable after reaching a total GMV of 100 billion. Although the reward was good, it wasn’t suitable for him, and even less for Blue Star.
…
As for that limited-time gift pack for 1,298,
many players bought it.
Even the Tuberculosis Rabbit and a few others each got one, since it was cheap, and the gift pack also included a Vehicle, even if it was E-grade, it was still a Vehicle.
“Eh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, full of excitement, opened the gift pack and looked at the Vehicle in his hands, somewhat bewildered, “Isn’t this Vehicle a bit too strange?”
“Even though the Vehicle is random, shouldn’t it be within reasonable limits?”
「Vehicle Name」: Flat-ground Racer.
「Vehicle Level」: E-grade.
「Vehicle Effect」: Once you wear this Vehicle, wheels will sprout from your limbs and abdomen. When you lie flat on the ground and hold your breath, you will sprint forward at an extremely high speed.
Zero to hundred acceleration, 0.3 seconds.
Top speed, 11 Mach.
「Vehicle Restrictions」: Once this Vehicle is worn, it cannot be taken off. The throttle is controlled by breathing; holding your breath means continuous acceleration, and opening your mouth to breathe in starts the braking process – the faster you breathe in, the quicker you’ll brake.
「Vehicle Introduction」: “This is the only E-grade Vehicle capable of reaching a top speed of 11 Mach.”
Indeed.
From a certain perspective, this Vehicle was indeed strong.
After all, an E-grade Vehicle that doesn’t require enhancement could reach a speed of 11 Mach, comparable to a supersonic fighter jet, and all for the mere price of 1,298 Points – it definitely was a huge bargain.
The zero to hundred acceleration was only 0.3 seconds as well.
But the problem is…
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke with a puzzled expression, “Was this Vehicle designed just for insurance fraud? Lying flat on the ground already gives a low line of sight, and there are only five wheels and no shock-absorbing chassis or exterior.”
“The speed is indeed fast.”
“But isn’t this speed a bit too quick? Not to mention hitting a wall, even crossing a speed bump could send you flying, right?”
“If you crash into a wall, won’t you be black and blue?”
“…”
Standing to the side, Sword Without End looked at the Vehicle panel shared by Tuberculosis Rabbit, the corner of his mouth twitching, “At a speed of 11 Mach, hitting a wall might not just leave you black and blue.”
“It’s more likely you’ll turn into a purple mess.”
“Actually, whether you’ll have anything left to turn purple is debatable; I reckon you’ll just explode into a mist of blood.”
“When this Vehicle was designed, they probably never intended for players to use it a second time, unless it’s on a very flat road, the kind where you can’t see the horizon. In that case, this Vehicle can unleash its full potential.”
“Having such a high maximum speed for an E-grade Vehicle is quite something.”

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 569 379 One of Each A Perfect Set of Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 569: Chapter 379: One of Each, A Perfect Set of Dragon and Phoenix Twins. Chapter 569: Chapter 379: One of Each, A Perfect Set of Dragon and Phoenix Twins. The Tuberculosis Rabbit shook its head and denied, “Even under those special circumstances, this vehicle is completely unusable.”
“That’s true.”
Sword Without End also nodded in agreement, “After all, it doesn’t even have a shell; if it hits a sparrow, that would already call for a feast.”
“No, what I mean is that the wheels embedded in its limbs are too small. If it were me, using this vehicle while lying on the ground would cause it to wear out due to its size.”
Having said that.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit then put on a pretense and sighed, “Alas, you probably can’t understand my feelings—after all, never mind, it feels like I’m hitting you where it hurts, doesn’t it?”
“…”
Only then did Sword Without End, who finally grasped the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s meaning, respond expressionlessly after a long silence, “In that case, I’m even more suited for this prop. After all, mine is so hard it could actually serve as a hand brake.”
“With this, no matter how fast the speed, I could forcefully stop the vehicle.”
“And it’s also long enough that if I wanted to get over a bump or fix a tire or something, it could act as a jack, lifting things up over thirty centimeters into the air for maintenance.”
“Aren’t you just shameless?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Sword Without End with a stunned expression, for a moment not quite knowing what to say in rebuttal.
…
Meanwhile.
In a corner of Blue Star, a player was looking at the five identical Skill Fragments in his hand with confusion.
And above his head, he was bearing a grand title.
‘Self-disciplined Natural-born Single Dog!’
That’s right, indeed.
Only players who had never been in a relationship since birth and had never actively pursued love could obtain this temporary exclusive title.
It lasted for three days and would disappear after the event, being a temporary title, not a permanent one.
And when wearing this title, one would receive an extremely high Luck Points boost, allowing one to feel the charm of the Goddess of Luck’s favor.
And he!
A boy who had been a model student since childhood, lived up to expectations and received this title.
On Blue Star, there were not many players who obtained this title.
There were many who had never been in a relationship, but those who had never actively pursued love were few and far between.
Regardless of gender.
Even so, girls usually reached maturity earlier than boys.
Furthermore, this title had a restriction, one must be at least 20 years old.
Those who were just of age or still underage couldn’t participate in this event, let alone obtain this title.
Over 20 years old, naturally born single, and never actively pursued love.
Combining these three conditions, nearly ninety-nine percent of the players on Blue Star were excluded.
Only a very few lucky individuals managed to get this title.
And this boy was one of those lucky few!
At the moment, he was bewildered by the five identical Skill Fragments in his hand. He had just purchased a 1298 Points gift pack, which would randomly award five Skill Fragments. Upon opening the gift pack, he discovered that the rewarded Skill Fragments were all the same!
This meant that these five Fragments could be immediately combined into one Skill!
This was a situation he had never encountered before.
In the past, he had opened gift packs that randomly yielded Skill Fragments but obtaining even two identical Skill Fragments was a low probability event; in most cases, all five Skill Fragments were different.
Unexpectedly, this time he got five of the same kind straight away.
The man looked up at the title ‘Self-disciplined Natural-born Single Dog’ above his head and his eyes began to sparkle with excitement. Could it be that this title was providing him with such good Luck Points?
Doesn’t that mean within these three days, as long as he opens some gift packs or treasure boxes,
He would definitely get the best rewards?
Or at least the second-best prizes right below the top ones?
But his luck was far beyond just this. As he looked down at the Skill Name and Level he had just combined in his hand, his breath suddenly caught, his whole body began to shake uncontrollably, and his lips turned pale with tremors.
Pupils dilated in an instant, fingers gripping their own arm with excited force.
On the skill level display, a line of text boldly stood out.
“SSS-rank Skill!!!”
What kind of joke is this!!!
An SSS-rank skill!!!
Although the gift pack didn’t limit the rank of the skills that could be acquired, only vehicles and props were restricted; skill fragments were completely unrestrained. But he truly never expected to get fragments of an SSS-rank skill!
Moreover, he actually got 5, 5 SSS-rank skill fragments!
Most outrageous was the fact that these 5 SSS-rank skill fragments were all for the same skill!
The intense excitement left the man parched and thirsty.
Without the slightest pause, he looked at the skill panel, already anticipating just how powerful an SSS-rank skill could be. It might not wreak havoc on heaven and earth, but perhaps it could grant him strength like Chen Yi’s? The mere thought of Chen Yi’s power, and the possibility of becoming like him – basking in glory with beauties by his side – made him tremble with even greater excitement.
“Skill Name”: Reproductive Sharing.
“Skill Level”: SSS-rank.
“Skill Effect”: Once the skill is activated, all players from the affiliated planet will share its effects, which include the following:
1: Allows all women over the age of 18 to gain reproductive capabilities.
Regardless of previous infertility or being past their prime, they can give birth again.
2: Allows men over the age of 18 on the affiliated planet to also bear children.
3: Initiate asexual reproduction; no need for consummating marriage to conceive. A mere minute of kissing will suffice for both parties to become pregnant, with men sure to give birth to boys, and women, to girls like their mothers.
Boys born to men will call them dad, with no mom.
Girls born to women will call them mom, with no dad.
4: Furthermore, the gestation period is drastically reduced to just three months, after which a sweet and adorable baby can be successfully born, and the child will reach full maturity in just 10 years.
“Skill Limitation”: This skill is a wide-range passive effect; once activated, the entire planet will undergo irreversible transformation, with no way to turn off or pause the skill through any means.
Please think thrice before using this skill.
“Skill Introduction”: “Only with a sufficient population can a race truly become powerful.”
“…”
What the hell is this!!!
After reading the full skill introduction, the man stood there, pupils wide with shock, with just one thought in his mind: What the hell is this?
Is this an SSS-rank skill?
Do you even deserve to be called an SSS-rank skill?
Indeed, from a certain perspective, this skill might be potent, capable of ensuring the quick succession of a race. The core of a race’s legacy is always the next generation – he could understand that much.
But isn’t this a bit too outrageous?
Once this skill is active, all players around the globe can have children, including men. No more preferring boys over girls from now on. Want a boy? Just find a man to bear one for you. Want a girl? Well, find a woman. Easy.
Want both?
Have one each, just like a perfect pair of dragon and phoenix twins.
At this thought, the man’s mouth began to twitch uncontrollably. Without a moment’s hesitation, he jumped onto his vehicle and shot towards Yancheng.
…
“Hm.”
“Event Four: Battle of the Single Nobles.”
“During the event, all players who haven’t spent a romantic night with the opposite sex within a month will be forced to wear the title ‘Single Dog’.”
“Those who have been single since birth will receive the limited edition title ‘Single Noble’.”
“Moreover, we’ll release a love affair leaderboard based on the number of times all players have dated, and the top three players on the leaderboard will share a free tutorial on how to successfully court the opposite sex.”
“And every player will have their dating count displayed above their heads.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, still studying the new event, hadn’t had the chance to react when it suddenly saw something bang into something next to it.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 570 380 The Charm of the Single Noble You
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 570: Chapter 380: The Charm of the Single Noble, You Wouldn’t Understand. Chapter 570: Chapter 380: The Charm of the Single Noble, You Wouldn’t Understand. “What’s the matter?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glared at the man before him with some irritation, “What could be so urgent that you’re this flustered? Even if it’s something big, can’t you be a bit more composed?”
“Besides, you think you can just see Yi whenever you want?”
“Who do you think you are?”
“I really have an urgent matter!”
The man said anxiously, taking out a skill from his backpack and handing it to Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Tuberculosis Rabbit, take a look at this. Once you see it, you’ll understand.”
Once a skill is learned, it goes into the skill slot and cannot be removed at will.
It would be permanently embedded in the skill slot, and if one insists on removing it, the skill would shatter instantly and could never be learned again, and he had no intention of learning this skill.
After all, learning the skill wouldn’t impact his personal combat power at all, but it would affect all the players on Blue Star. No one, except those with antisocial personalities, would do something that was all harm and no benefit.
“Returning a skill?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit took a disdainful glance and impatiently took the skill, “Yi has seen it all before, it’s just a skill. Could it be an SSS-rated one or something?”
“Really, you think just because you’ve got the title of a disciplined single dog, you can be so arrogant?”
“No matter how lucky you are, can you dodge my fist?”
The next second—
Upon seeing the skill panel clearly, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face turned expressionless in silence, without a hint of hesitation, he stuffed the skill card into his chest and then quickly picked up the man by the collar and rushed towards the community!
This is really a big deal!
How big?
At least he, Tuberculosis Rabbit, did not want to be showing up in front of the players at Awesome Starfield with a big belly!
He couldn’t afford to lose face like that!
…
“…”
After taking the skill card, Chen Yi also wiped his forehead, which wasn’t actually sweating, with a somewhat relieved hand.
This skill was indeed terrifying.
With no means of defense.
Once activated, the players on Blue Star would begin to reproduce rapidly. Men and women alike would be able to have children, a scene too dreadful to imagine. Most importantly, this state of affairs would fundamentally alter everything.
Even if he activated “Forever Pure” the Purification God-level, it would be useless.
“…”
Chen Yi clenched the skill card in his hand, the corner of his mouth twitching slightly in relief that this man had brought it to him. Otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable— who would have thought he’d almost have to get pregnant.
That was a narrow miss indeed…
“Actually…”
Sword Without End, who was standing off to the side, spoke thoughtfully, “From a certain point of view, this skill really matches up to SSS-revel status. Look at this skill—it can make all men and women over 18 on Blue Star pregnant and accelerate the maturation process.”
“Adults could grow up in just 10 years.”
“You could go through a whole pregnancy in three months.”
“This means that if all the players on Blue Star started getting pregnant, the population could potentially double in just three months.”
“And you could have four offspring a year.”
“Repeat this for a few decades, and Blue Star could become the next Void Clan in the game.”
“Exactly!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly realized the implications, speaking with a bit of fear, “Thank goodness this skill ended up in our hands. If it had fallen into the Void Clan’s possession, it would’ve been thoroughly screwed. With the Void Clan’s population base, the number could multiply many times over within a year.”
“That’s terrifying.”
“Thanks for your hard work.”
Chen Yi ignored the conversation between Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit, turning his gaze to the somewhat anxious man before him, and said softly, “Bringing this skill directly to me shows you must understand the danger it poses to Blue Star.”
“Although the skill is not very useful, it’s still an SSS-ranked skill, so I can’t just take it from you for nothing.”
“You should have some compensation.”
“That said, how many Points do you want?”
The man did not speak but held up a finger tentatively, his voice trembling slightly, “Give… give me ten thousand… a million Points will do.”
He didn’t dare to ask for more.
Ten thousand Points was plenty.
After all, although the skill was SSS-rated, it was a trap that provided no real utility. It was a hot potato in his hands, of no practical value, and he’d rather give it to Chen Yi.
While ten thousand Points wasn’t a lot, it was like found money, better than nothing.
“Ten million Points?”
Chen Yi’s brows furrowed slightly—it was, in fact, a hundred million? Honestly, that was a lot of Points, but since it was an SSS-ranked skill, ten million Points really wasn’t too much and was worth the price.
He could easily sell it for much more than a hundred million Points.
For some races with sparse populations that struggled to reproduce, this skill was practically divine. Forget a hundred million Points, they’d sell the pots and pans if necessary to gather enough Points to buy this skill.
“That’s settled.”
With that thought, Chen Yi didn’t say much more, casually transferring a hundred million Points to the man in front of him, his words laden with meaning, “You’re sensible. You can tell others about this, anyone who comes to me, Chen Yi, with something useful won’t leave empty-handed.”
“I will offer a fair price. You may go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 571 380 The Charm of the Single Noble You
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 571: Chapter 380: The Charm of the Single Noble, You Wouldn’t Understand._2 Chapter 571: Chapter 380: The Charm of the Single Noble, You Wouldn’t Understand._2 “I…”
At that moment, the man felt his legs as heavy as lead, utterly unable to lift them. His body was rigid, and his eyes were filled with shock and disbelief. He gasped for air, gazing at the system notification that rang beside his ear.
“Ding, player Chen Yi has transferred 100,000,000 Points to your account!”
One zero, two zeros, three zeros, four zeros, five zeros, dad, grandpa…
He’d lost count of the zeros.
He only felt there were lots and lots of zeros.
Way too outrageous.
He clearly asked for ten thousand Points, but here he had a hundred million Points.
It took some time for the man to recover, and with a face filled with the excitement of sudden wealth, he deeply bowed to Chen Yi and then said with trembling excitement, “Thank you, Yi, thank you, Yi!!!!!”
“Then you all carry on with your business, I won’t disturb you any longer!”
“Thank you, Yi!”
Before leaving, he couldn’t help but thank Yi again.
November rule: no saying thank you, deduct 1000 Points each time.
But at this point, the man couldn’t care less about that rule.
It’s just deducting 1000 Points, right?
Who cares?
Who cares?
He was now a man with a fortune in the billions, so what if a few thousand Points were deducted?
…
After the man left, Chen Yi looked at the SSS-grade Skill in his hand, lost in thought without speaking.
For different Races, the demand and rarity of this Skill were completely different.
If he could find the right buyer, selling it for three to five billion Points wouldn’t be a problem at all.
But the problem was.
He didn’t really want to sell it.
It wasn’t that he wanted to use the Skill, but he was worried that if the Skill fell into the wrong hands, it could cause a certain Race to suddenly increase in strength, giving him a powerful new rival, which would be rather counterproductive.
After some thought, he decided to let the Skill lie in the Tuberculosis Rabbit’s warehouse and start gathering dust.
Not selling it.
Selling it might very well fund a powerful enemy.
Most importantly, he wasn’t short of those three to five billion Points. After all, he still had several hundred billion Points left unspent at home.
“Lucky me.”
After the man had left, the Tuberculosis Rabbit finally looked at the man’s retreating figure and said in a low voice, “An SSS-grade Skill, somehow landed in the hands of this kid. It’s an SSS-grade Skill! You know, even Yi doesn’t have an SSS-grade Skill, but this guy does.”
“It’s just outrageous.”
“This must be the first SSS-grade Skill on Blue Star, unmatched.”
“Is this the power of the ‘Self-disciplined Natural-born Single Dog’ Title?”
“It’s just a pity that this Title is pretty much useless.”
“It’s not as good as my ‘Single Noble’ Title.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked somewhat sentimentally at his ‘Single Noble’ Title panel.
‘Title Name’: Single Noble.
‘Title Level’: Red.
‘Title Effect’: When wearing this Title, your sweat will emit a unique fragrance, making your charm more irresistible and instantly conveying your single status to other players who might be interested, so they can know right away.
