‘Title Restriction’: Upon finding a girlfriend or wife, this Title will automatically disappear, and you will be permanently unable to wear it.
‘Title Introduction’: The charm of a Single Noble is something you wouldn’t understand.
‘PS: Players who wear this Title for more than ten years will receive an exclusive rare reward.’
To put it plainly.
This Title is basically useless, doing nothing more than making your sweat smell nicer without the like of body odor.
That’s all of its uses.
Of course, the words ‘Single Noble’ look pretty decent as a Title, so as a Title, it’s not bad. That’s the full extent of its use.
As for the hint about receiving an exclusive rare reward after wearing it for ten years, the Tuberculosis Rabbit outright ignored it.
First off, there was no way he wouldn’t find a girlfriend in ten years.
Secondly, ten years? In ten years, Yi would probably be on top of the structure of the game, doing whatever he wants. What use would an exclusive rare reward be then?
Don’t forget.
The Novice Period on Blue Star is about to end soon.
…
The following few days passed peacefully, with everything very tranquil.
It just seemed like something was missing.
“Right.”
Sitting on the rooftop, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly remembered something, slapping its forehead: “I knew something felt off. Weren’t there a bunch of bizarre creatures with all sorts of abilities on Blue Star before we left for the Awesome Starfield?”
“How come they’re all gone when we got back.”
“Yeah.”
Sword Without End also abruptly realized something and wondered: “If Tuberculosis Rabbit hadn’t mentioned it, I would have forgotten about this. Aren’t you supposed to kill each of those creatures 1000 times to totally eradicate them?”
“We were gone for no more than seven days, yet all those creatures have disappeared.”
“Could it be someone stealthily killed them all?”
Chen Yi shook his head to indicate he wasn’t sure and didn’t continue to focus on this matter. Instead, he lay on a beach chair, proceeding to enjoy his sunbathing.
…
Meanwhile, in a place unknown to Chen Yi and the others.
A creature of immense size lay motionless in a deep-sea cave as if it had gone into hibernation.
After the day Chen Yi and the others left.
Only a small number of players remained on Blue Star. After these bizarre creatures wiped out these few players who stayed on Blue Star, they completely lost their targets to attack.
The entire Blue Star was suddenly empty, without any players.
The creatures, having lost their targets, started to kill and devour each other.
Four days later.
All the creatures on Blue Star had died, leaving behind only one immense creature that quietly sank into the sea to begin its slumber.
From then on.
The whole planet returned to its former peace, without a creature in sight, as if nothing had ever happened, appearing very serene.
…
Time flew by quickly.
The following days were extremely leisurely, as if entering a lull.
During the day, everyone would gather on the rooftop and chat when there was nothing else to do.
Talking about the past, the future, dreams, and what comes after.
“Just about four or five months I guess.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at the sun overhead, lying lazily on a nearby beach chair. The weather was gradually getting cooler, and winter was approaching: “In another four or five months, the Novice Period will finally end.”
“At that time, we might even attempt to break the record of advancing from Onefold Planet to Threefold in a single day.”
Moving from Onefold, Twofold, to Threefold, etc.
Unlike the Novice Period.
There’s no time limitation; as long as your strength is sufficient, theoretically, you could advance from a Onefold Planet to a Ninefold Planet within one day.
Of course, that’s theoretical. In practice, in the history of advancing planets, no planet has ever moved up two levels in a single day.
But Blue Star is different—it’s truly a bit too special.
Theoretically, planet advancement looks at the average strength of all players on a planet. For example, to ascend to a Twofold Planet, there’d be a giant boss that all players must participate in fighting.
You must cooperate and have enough strength to defeat this boss.
But Yi’s power is a bit over the top.
Without needing any other Blue Star players to take action, just Yi alone going in could seconds-kill this boss. What’s the point in playing then?
It’s already been said that, a long time ago, Yi had taken on the role of the Twofold Planet trial’s boss himself.
If saying ascending to Fourfold in one day might be difficult, then ascending to Threefold within one day should be no problem at all.
“That, I don’t know about.”
Lying nearby, Sword Without End glanced at the calendar ‘November 30’ with a somewhat listless look: “It’s about to be December. Santa Claus is going to come out soon, and didn’t Santa Claus say that he wanted to seek revenge on Yi when he appears on Christmas Day?”
“I’m actually quite curious to see Santa Claus’s reaction when he comes out and sees Yi.”
“Tsk.”
He glanced at the little deer sprawled lazily on the rooftop beside him, soaking up the sun, and couldn’t help but laugh: “You’ll soon see your grandpa again and get to eat all those different flavors of carrots you’ve been longing for.”
“Happy?”

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 572 381 Far Ahead Far Ahead Far Ahead
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 572: Chapter 381: Far Ahead, Far Ahead, Far Ahead!!! Chapter 572: Chapter 381: Far Ahead, Far Ahead, Far Ahead!!! As the words fell,
the elk that had been lazily basking in the sun suddenly seemed as if it heard some earth-shattering news. Its fur bristled in an instant, panic flashing through its pupils, and it lay still without moving.
Obviously,
those carrots of different flavors had left quite a psychological shadow on the young elk.
“Alright, alright,”
the Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat annoyed, rolled its eyes at Sword Without End, “Stop scaring it. You know very well how long that Santa Claus has been feeding it all sorts of odd-flavored carrots, causing it to tremble all over at the mere mention of eating that kind of carrot.
“Indeed,”
Sword Without End glanced at the elk sympathetically and said no more.
Time always passes quickly.
And within just a dozen days, Chen Yi’s occupation had changed three times.
In between, he had switched to two occupations, “Card Shark” and “Janitor.”
The Card Shark occupation, just as the name suggests, possessed superb gambling skills. How strong? When you cheat in gambling, everyone subconsciously ignores you.
Well,
it’s also a useless occupation.
The remaining occupation, the Janitor, is a bit different from the one in the depths of hell. This Janitor is a real janitor, who needs to go to work after choosing the occupation.
Starting at 8 A.M. on the street, begin sweeping up garbage, and get off work at 10 P.M.
After a hard day’s work, you can earn a reward of 10,000 Points.
To be honest,
the salary is quite high, 10,000 Points a day. If other players from Blue Star knew about it, probably everyone would go sweep the streets. It’s relaxed, risk-free, and you can earn such a high reward—who wouldn’t want that?
No one would be unwilling.
But on second thought, only players from Sixfold Planet have occupations, and for them, a daily reward of 10,000 Points might not be considered too low, but it probably isn’t much either.
For ambitious players, 10,000 Points a day definitely wouldn’t be enough.
But for some younger players or those not adept at fighting, this occupation is definitely an easy and safe economic job. It’s just unclear how Sixfold Planet players choose their occupation and whether they can get the one they want most.
Or is it like these players who have obtained the Monument, entering a map and being presented with three occupations based on their performance in that map, allowing them to freely choose one?
As for Chen Yi’s current occupation, it’s one he switched to on 11.28, just a few days ago.
Occupation Name: “Dump Truck Driver”
“Occupation Name”: Dump Truck Driver.
“Occupational Effect”: When you drive any front four, rear eight dump truck, anyone unlucky enough to be hit and killed by you has a 1% chance of transiting to a random Another World.
You will become a saint in the hearts of countless people.
Countless individuals will kneel before you, begging you to drive your noble dump truck over them, allowing them to escape this damned world and move on to the next world, which is just as doomed but which they believe to be exceedingly wonderful.
“Occupational Restriction”: You can only send one unlucky soul to Another World per day.
This occupation,
let’s just say it left Chen Yi silent for a long while without speaking.
“By the way,”
just at that moment—
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly remembered the new occupation Yi had switched to a few days ago, “Yi, I got a new Prop today, want to try out your occupation?”
While speaking, Tuberculosis Rabbit shared the Prop panel in mid-air.
“Prop Name”: DJI Pocket Monitor.
“Prop Level”: B grade.
“Prop Effect”: Once activated, the Prop will exist as an invisible entity the size of a button and will follow any player around, no matter where that player goes. The Prop will always stick close like a shadow.
And it will transmit the sound and images in real-time to the Prop’s owner.
“Prop Introduction”: “For an outdoor livestreamer, this device, which doesn’t need signals or battery life, can be described as a perfect productivity tool.”
“How about it?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke excitedly, “All we need to do is activate this Prop and let it follow some player. Then, Yi, you drive your dump truck and kill that player, and we can watch a live Another World show in real-time.”
“Everyone’s read novels, right?”
“The leading man goes to Another World and begins an extraordinarily dazzling life. Aren’t you tired of reading about it and want to watch a real-life version?”
“And aren’t you curious about what’s in Another World?”
“…”
Sword Without End looked somewhat speechless and turned his head toward Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Yi’s occupation has only a 1% success rate. How do you know which player will successfully transit? On which player are you planning to place your Prop?”
“What a coincidence,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said seriously, pulling out a big handful of button-sized probes from his pocket, “I have no more no less, exactly one hundred of these gadgets. We just need to find 100 unlucky ones, and that’s it.”
“Besides, we’ll also uphold a spirit of democracy and volunteerism. I believe not just us, but many others wish to leave this world and be the protagonist in Another World.”
After finishing,
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked earnestly at Chen Yi and the others.
And Chen Yi, after pondering for a moment, chose to nod his head. To be honest, he was also quite curious about what was in Another World and whether this universe only contained their world.
…
And so,

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - 573 381 Far Ahead Far Ahead Far Ahead_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 573: Chapter 381: Far Ahead, Far Ahead, Far Ahead!!!_2 Chapter 573: Chapter 381: Far Ahead, Far Ahead, Far Ahead!!!_2 Three hours later.
In Blue Star, a pop-up prompt appeared almost simultaneously on the wristwatches of thousands of players.
“Want to understand the meaning of life? Want to truly be alive?”
“yes or no?”
The moment this prompt appeared, some players were dumbfounded, some were clueless, but of course, most were excited and thrilled. In an instant, hundreds chose yes.
The others chose no.
Immediately after.
Backstage, monitoring everything, Tuberculosis Rabbit carefully selected 100 players he considered to be in good physical condition, believing they would get a decent start in Another World. Without any delay, he and Sword Without End went out to prepare to bring these players back.
…
“Huh?”
At this moment, a player in Yancheng was looking around his room in bewilderment.
A pop-up had suddenly appeared in front of him, asking yes or no. As a seasoned fan of infinite flow novels, he knew exactly what it meant and, without hesitation, chose yes.
With his current strength and the three B-level Props on him.
As long as he entered the Main God Space, he was sure to become the strongest newcomer.
He would then charge through the Main God Space like the main character, unstoppable by anyone.
But more than an hour had passed.
Nothing had happened.
The pop-up that had appeared earlier was already gone, as if it had never appeared, which left him somewhat at a loss. Had he hallucinated it?
Just then, he suddenly heard a knock on the door.
“Thump, thump, thump.”
“Who is it!”
The man immediately got up with a wary expression, picked up a weapon, and slowly approached the door, ready to spring into action at any moment. His high level of vigilance was the reason he had survived this long in the Game without once visiting hell.
This was the foundation of his survival.
He had no family or friends and had been an orphan since childhood; he couldn’t imagine who would come looking for him.
The only girlfriend he ever had had left him before the Game’s descent.
Soon, he heard the hoarse voice of Tuberculosis Rabbit from outside the door.
“Zhou Yi, right? I’m a guide from the Main God Space. You chose yes earlier, and we’ve come to take you to the Main God Space,” Tuberculosis Rabbit said.
“The Main God Space?”
This man, Zhou Yi, was first stunned, then his face lit up with joy and excitement. It really was just as he had imagined!
The Main God Space had come for him!
He was about to embark on an infinite journey, traveling through countless domains until he became the strongest player!
The Props he possessed were his golden finger, the biggest variable as a new player!
He had already made up his mind inwardly.
The first domain wouldn’t be too difficult, likely involving zombies. As long as he wasn’t infected, there wouldn’t be much danger to his life.
In the first domain, there would definitely be veteran players serving as newbie instructors, probably giving them a tough time to make them realize where they were.
There would surely be the weeping young ladies, the arrogant officials’ children threatening to let themselves go, and trembling corporate executives trying to buy their life with money.
Perhaps there would even be a quiet and handsome young man sitting in a corner, observing everything around him—a man surely not to be underestimated, someone Zhou Yi would need to kill immediately to avoid future trouble.
Then he would stand up with a cold sneer, showing the newbie instructor the three B-grade Props from the Game he possessed.
In the end, he would take all the rewards from the first domain, secure the highest S-grade awards, and thoroughly start his rise to greatness!
In just an instant!
Zhou Yi’s mind raced with countless thoughts; he even figured out how to show off to other people looking up to him in admiration without being too obvious and yet profound.
Afterward—
He excitedly, without any hesitation, flung open the security door, looking eagerly at Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End at the doorway, bowing constantly and saying with a trembling voice, “Good day, guides. I’m Zhou Yi; I was the one who chose yes.”
“Do you know what number I am among the players?”
“Of course, I know my number must be really long, probably seven or eight digits, right?”
“But normally, when others are taken to the Main God Space in stories, there’s a flash of white light, and they just vanish. Why do we need the guides to come pick us up personally this time?” Zhou Yi asked, somewhat puzzled.
“I know now!”
But quickly, he convinced himself and voiced a sudden realization, “There’s a difference between novels and reality, right? In the real Main God Space, guides must come to fetch us.”
“I understand, I get it,” said Zhou Yi excitedly, rubbing his hands together. “So, guides, when do we set off?”
“…”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End exchanged expressionless glances, saw each other’s speechlessness, and then both turned and headed downstairs, “We set off now, be ready to follow.”
“Understood, teacher!”
…
The sky gradually darkened.
But at the wilderness of Yancheng.
There, on a road, a hundred players were bound up and standing in an open area while a dump truck, already ignited, loomed nearby with four wheels in the front and eight in the back.
“What’s the meaning of this?”
“Weren’t we supposed to go to the Main God Space?”
The hundred players had clearly realized that something was amiss and began to ask questions anxiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 574 381 Far Ahead Far Ahead Far Ahead_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 574: Chapter 381: Far Ahead, Far Ahead, Far Ahead!!!_3 Chapter 574: Chapter 381: Far Ahead, Far Ahead, Far Ahead!!!_3 “Stupid…”
With his hands bound, Zhou Yi scorned loudly with disdain, “Would you please look at what’s over there? It’s a dump truck! If you had read widely, you would know that most transmigrators are hit by a dump truck before they cross over!”
“This is just following the script!”
“I warn you, you better not run into me later in the newbies’ level of the Main God Space, or I won’t show any mercy!”
Then he cheekily turned his head towards Sword Without End and ingratiatingly smiled, “Eh, big brother, I’m right, aren’t I?”
He was a bit skeptical at first.
But when he saw Chen Yi, any doubts completely vanished. No wonder Chen Yi was so powerful; although they all started together in the same game, why was Chen Yi’s strength growing in such an outrageous manner?
So, Chen Yi was a Main God player who had returned.
Was it plausible?
Too plausible. There was no more reasonable explanation.
And Chen Yi’s two lackeys beside him were also Main God players who had returned, though they were still serving as mentor teachers in the Main God Space. Was there anything left to say? Time to get started!
“You’re not wrong.”
Sword Without End patted Zhou Yi’s shoulder with an odd expression, “Zhou Yi, is it? I think you’ll definitely become a qualified transmigrator.”
“Thank you for the encouragement. I believe so too.”
Zhou Yi nodded earnestly, full of vigor.
Just then—
“Boom!!!”
With a booming sound, Chen Yi had already started up the dump truck. With the accelerator floored and the high beams on, he was hurtling straight towards Zhou Yi and his party!
Like Mount Tai bearing down on them, carrying an immense intimidation.
Even though Tuberculosis Rabbit knew very well that with his current physical condition and the props in his backpack, it was impossible for him to be killed by the impact, he still couldn’t help but take a few subconscious steps back. It was as if it had become an instinctive reaction!
And in the moment before Zhou Yi was about to be struck, he looked up excitedly and roared!
“Way ahead! Way ahead! Way ahead!”
‘I, Zhou Yi, will definitely become a transmigrator who leads the pack!’
As soon as he finished his sentence!
“Boom, boom!!!”
A hundred players were hit by the high-speed dump truck; they were flung into the air, sucked into the wheel wells, or even had their bodies crushed.
In almost an instant, the majority of the players died on the spot.
And for those who didn’t die instantly, there was no need to worry.
Chen Yi drove the dump truck around a few more times, and now it was perfect—both those who should have died and those who should not had all met their end, clean and crisp.
…
And at that moment—
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was standing aside, had already started to activate all the surveillance probe panels placed on these 100 players, frantically and hastily sifting through them.
“This one won’t do, failed, off to Blue Star Hell.”
“Pass, this one’s also off to hell.”
“Next.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit kept turning off the monitor panels in front of him. Nearly all the hundred players ended up dead, going to Blue Star Hell, and so far, not a single one was found to have crossed over to Another World.
“Still no good.”
“Hmm?”
Soon, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes brightened, and he quickly shared one player’s panel with others: “This one’s triggered the probability, off to Another World.”
Shortly after, just a few seconds later, as if he had won a jackpot, Tuberculosis Rabbit shared Zhou Yi’s panel as well!
“We’ve hit the jackpot, Zhou Yi has actually managed to transmigrate successfully!”
“The rest are off to Blue Star Hell, out of 100 people, there are 2 who’ve transmigrated. The luck isn’t bad.”
At this time, Chen Yi also hopped down from the dump truck’s cabin and sat on a nearby rock, casually opening a bottle of Wang Laoji and taking a swig, looking with interest at the probe panels shared by Tuberculosis Rabbit.
He was curious about the kind of worlds these players would transmigrate to.
“Cultivation, eh!!!”
Sword Without End’s eyes flickered with extreme excitement as he jumped up from the ground, trembling with emotion as he pointed at the first transmigrator’s panel that was broadcasting the scene.
“There are really Sword Immortals, there really are Sword Immortals in this world!!!”
On this panel…
The player had transmigrated into a vast forest, where high above, two Cultivators were fighting. Countless Spiritual Skills were clashing against each other, looking like he was watching a big-budget special effects movie right off the bat.
So admirable!
Finally!
The battle came to an end.
A Cultivator with a flying sword circling around him in the air, pointed his icy-cold sword at the black-clothed Cultivator opposite him. A streak of light zipped out, bringing an end to this battle that had been raging for who knows how long.
The black-clothed Cultivator, with a trace of unwillingness in his eyes, slowly dropped down to the ground from the sky.
“Thud.”
There was a significant sound.
At this moment, the Sword Cultivator also noticed the Blue Star player who had just transmigrated below in the jungle. His brow furrowed as he looked over, and an immense pressure made the knees of the Blue Star player who had just crossed over go weak instantly.
As his knees trembled and collapsed to the ground, he said loudly.
“Immortal, spare my life, I was just passing by and saw nothing. I beg of you to spare me!”
…
“Take him as your master!!!”
The exasperated Sword Without End on the scene saw this and couldn’t help stamping his foot, “Damn it, take him as your master! That Sword Cultivator is clearly a righteous Cultivator; what are you waiting for if not to take him as your master?”
“This is an opportunity not to be missed!”
“Yi, you drive the dump truck and hit me too!”
“Let me go cultivate; this guy’s too stupid, if it were me, I’d cling to this big thigh no matter what, and set foot on the true path of Cultivation!”

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 575 381 Far Ahead Far Ahead Far Ahead
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 575: Chapter 381: Far Ahead, Far Ahead, Far Ahead!!! Chapter 575: Chapter 381: Far Ahead, Far Ahead, Far Ahead!!! It was clear that Sword Without End was truly in a hurry.
He was desperate to step in immediately.
Everyone knew that one of the dreams deep in Sword Without End’s heart was to become a Sword Immortal. From the beginning of his contact with Chen Yi and the others, he had been cosplaying as a Sword Immortal, and he still occasionally cosplayed as one up to now.
When the mood struck him, he would also recite a poem.
For Sword Without End, if he could choose, he would almost abandon everything to go to that world.
…
“Hmm?”
The Sword Cultivator, hovering in midair, inspected the transmigrator from Blue Star in the jungle with a hint of irony in his eyes, “A foreign devil dares beg for mercy?”
As soon as the words fell,
a flying sword shot straight towards the screen.
“Bang.”
The screen suddenly blacked out.
“Uh…”
Sword Without End froze for a moment and then instinctively asked, “Is this player still alive?”
“Probably dead.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit touched his nose with some embarrassment, “My personal monitoring probe doesn’t need a signal or battery power; it never goes out. It only goes out when the player it’s bound to dies.”
“So he’s really dead…”
Sword Without End murmured somewhat blankly, “He died right after crossing over? That Sword Immortal doesn’t seem very friendly, does he? Why did he attack so suddenly? And what does ‘foreign devil’ mean?”
“Does it mean that players who cross over will be considered foreign devils?”
“If that’s the case, the survival rate for those who cross over doesn’t seem very high…”
“Yi, pretend I didn’t say anything just now; I don’t really want to be a Sword Immortal that badly.”
He did want to be a Sword Immortal, but he wanted to stay alive even more, and he definitely didn’t want to cross over just to die at the hands of a Sword Immortal.
“However—”
Sword Without End suddenly rested his chin on his hand, thoughtfully saying, “This Sword Immortal actually speaks Mandarin? And it’s standard Mandarin? I wonder if we’ll ever have a chance to go to this world for a visit.”
This experiment proved at least one thing.
That is, in this vast universe, apart from their Blue Star game, there are other worlds; they just can’t reach them and have no chance to do so. Different worlds almost exist in parallel and independently in the entire universe.
Without some special means, there is no way, and no possibility, for two worlds to meet.
“Hey!”
It was at this moment that Tuberculosis Rabbit shifted his attention to another transmigrator, Zhou Yi, whose eyes were somewhat shocked as he lit a cigarette and took a drag, his voice filled with disbelief through the light blue smoke.
“This kid actually took a huge lead?”
“Damn outrageous!”
“What do you mean?”
Still caught in regret and emotion, Sword Without End heard Tuberculosis Rabbit’s voice and instinctively turned his head to look at another screen that was projected. He recognized the person in this screen, that Zhou Yi, right?
The most proactive one.
In the instant he was killed by the dump truck, he was still shouting something about taking a huge lead, as if possessed, having no idea what was on his mind.
But for Zhou Yi, perhaps transmigration was the best choice.
Being an orphan with no relatives or friends, staying in Blue Star really had no meaning for him.
In the screen, Zhou Yi was seen laughing arrogantly and killing all around him.
…
It was a city in ruins shrouded by dusk.
The streets were filled with rampant zombies.
These zombies, with their twisted and contorted bodies, looked extremely ferocious and terrifying. Inside a store, about seven or eight humans were hiding in a convenience store, eyes filled with fear, but it seemed their fear wasn’t just from the zombies, but also from Zhou Yi standing on the street…
Zhou Yi, holding a five-meter-long chainsaw, was laughing wickedly as he swung it relentlessly.
Not a single zombie could get within five meters of Zhou Yi, even electricity poles would snap at a touch.
“Come on!”
“I, Zhou Yi, am going to take a huge lead, get it?!”
With each spin of the chainsaw in his hand, another swarm of zombies was relentlessly knocked down.
At that moment, Zhou Yi’s heart was filled with excitement because a series of system notifications kept ringing in his ears.
“Ding, Main God player Zhou Yi has killed a zombie, earning 1 point.”
“Ding, Main God player Zhou Yi has killed a zombie, earning 1 point.”
“Ding…”
“Ding, Main God player Zhou Yi has completed the Hidden Mission ‘Zombie Siege’ of the E-level instance, killing 100 zombies, and is awarded an E-level random item and 1 Skill Point.”
“Ding…”
Taking advantage of the props accumulated in the game, this novice instance posed even less of a challenge to him than stumbling and hitting his head on the ceiling!
Meanwhile, the veteran player outside the convenience store, who was responsible for guiding the newcomers, first glanced down at the samurai sword in his hand in bewildered astonishment, then looked back at Zhou Yi’s exaggerated silhouette and that absurd chainsaw.
He swallowed subconsciously.
He subtly hid the samurai sword behind his back, squashing the urge to show off in front of the newbie players.
Are all newbies these days monsters?
Are you telling me this is a newbie?
At least it must be someone who has cleared seven or eight instances to have such terrifying strength, right?
Who the hell is considered a veteran player here?
Didn’t the Main God’s task say that he was the only old player in this instance? Or is it really possible for someone to bring in a five-meter-long chainsaw into the Main God Space? And why does that chainsaw emit light and can fire blade beams?
Is this really just an ordinary item?
Or is it an item born within the Main God Space?
…
“This…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, watching the battle from the outskirts of Yancheng on Blue Star, also swallowed silently and murmured, “Did he really travel through time? And did he really end up in an infinite flow world?”
They had only used the infinite flow as an excuse.
They had never really thought someone would actually travel to an infinite flow world.
After all, they didn’t truly believe such a world existed.
But now it seems…
Indeed, the universe is full of wonders.
“If things keep going like this, Zhou Yi might really become the protagonist of that world, right?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others exchanged glances, seeing the confusion in each other’s eyes.
Zhou Yi might have been average in strength, but after surviving in the enhancing game for so long, he certainly had his fair share of props. Going into a novice instance of an infinite flow world would be like a bloodbath.
As everyone knows.
Getting a head start means leading by leaps and bounds.
So…
Chen Yi also looked at his career panel with a somewhat weird expression.
“Dump Truck Driver.”
Suddenly, he felt this career might not be as useless as he had thought.
If there’s a chance in the future.
Maybe he could try driving a dump truck and run over an entire race of people, sending scores of them through to another world. He didn’t know what that scene would look like, but it might be quite amusing.
After all, there might be no useless careers, only careers that people don’t know how to use.
Wait a minute.
Chen Yi’s expression suddenly darkened. He had forgotten that there indeed was one completely useless career—the Playboy, what a crappy career!
The time was gradually approaching the early morning.
December was about to arrive.
The announcement for December’s new rules and version update would soon be broadcast. This month—unless there’s a surprise—Santa Claus, with his health regenerating one hundred percent per second, should be making an appearance.
Back when I first met Santa Claus, there was only a feeling of powerlessness. How was I supposed to kill him?
But now.
All I need to do is to stand there, and my sky-full of Gatling Buddhas will speak for me.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 576 382 Youre making this very difficult for
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 576: Chapter 382: “You’re making this very difficult for me. Chapter 576: Chapter 382: “You’re making this very difficult for me. Dawn.
To be exact, it was the dawn of November 30th, as the time gradually approached 23:57.
Winter had set in, and the wind was getting colder.
This night, countless players had not slept, waiting for the arrival of the new update.
Just that the tension and fear from the previous few months were no longer there. Since April 1st, when the game’s new version officially arrived, it had been almost 8 months.
There were only a few months left until the end of the Novice Period, and the players who had survived until now were no longer the newbies they were at the start.
They were all fearless now.
Especially that Zhou Yi, who kept shouting about being far ahead.
“…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting on the rooftop, gazed at the real-time surveillance projection he had cast onto the air, silent and with a complex expression, not knowing what to say.
What to say?
What could he say?
What should he say?
Yi’s Dump Truck Driver had directly sent this kid into a Main God Space, and afterward, the kid really started to dominantly kill everything in the novice instance. Just look at that smugness; he seriously seemed far ahead.
He had been slashing zombies from dusk till now, not seeming tired at all.
And all the while, he was excitedly shouting about being far ahead, afraid that others wouldn’t know he had some kind of cheat activated.
“Not bad at all.”
Sword Without End, sitting beside, indeed found it amusing and chuckled, “As long as Zhou Yi does not die, this live stream will continue without interruption, right?”
“Quite interesting. We can watch the live broadcast in real-time later on.”
“The real daily life of an actual transmigrator.”
“Hey, Tuberculosis Rabbit, what if we spread this live broadcast throughout the entire game?”
“Create a variety show, and just name it ‘A Transmigrator’s Brief Bloom!'”
“Starting from the whole Starfield, we begin recruiting people who voluntarily want to transmigrate, then we broadcast the brief lives of these transmigrators in real-time. If it’s made into a pay-per-view variety show, it should be quite interesting.”
“It’s just a pity that we can’t intervene with that transmigrator.”
“Otherwise, we could add some interaction, like donating 10,000 Points to give the transmigrator a little knife or something. Donate 1,000,000 Points, and send a transmigrator a B-grade Prop.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit rolled his eyes at Sword Without End somewhat speechlessly, “What nonsensical things are you thinking about all day? What’s the most important thing for us now? It’s enhancing our own strength!”
“It’s to quickly advance to the Ninefold Planet after the Novice Period ends!”
“Then aim for the Tenfold Planet and explore what truly lies behind this version update!”
“To restore peace to Blue Star!”
“To bring everyone back to a peaceful and carefree life like in the old days!”
“This is our main objective; all that variety show stuff you talk about is just crooked paths. We don’t have the time and energy to waste on that.”
“You can’t say that, though.”
Sword Without End spoke seriously, “I’m also aiming to make us strong enough. After all, if we have enough Points, doesn’t that mean we can boldly enhance our strength?”
“Like the Ultimate Edition Manchu Han Imperial Feast Set you crafted with those billions of Points.”
“If you didn’t have enough Points, you wouldn’t be able to own the Ultimate Set, right?”
“But what if we had hundreds of billions or even trillions of Points?”
“Yi, transmigrators, and live streaming, combining these three elements and adding streaming traffic, would definitely make this variety show explosive!”
“Earn a massive amount of Points.”
“Then, won’t we be able to buy whatever we want, unfettered on the ‘Star Map’?”
Chen Yi, who was originally just enjoying the show, suddenly stroked his chin and began to ponder deeply. It seemed to make sense; it was a good idea.
For instance,
He could upgrade all his Props into Ultimate Props.
No, the mindset was still too small; it was hardly costly enough.
And Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had planned to retort, paused briefly and then said somewhat vaguely, “That makes some sense, huh. If you put it that way, seems like we could make it work…?”
“It’s just that Yi’s ‘Dump Truck Driver’ job can only last seven days, and now there aren’t many days left.”
“After this job expires, what should we do?”
“Besides, jobs are something that Sixfold Planet players have, and although this job is quite rare, there should be other players who have obtained this job, right? Then why haven’t other players created such a variety show?”
“Even if there is a limitation of sending only one person to transmigrate per day, it doesn’t make much of a difference, right?”
“That seems true.”
After Sword Without End pondered for a moment and was just about to say something,
A system announcement interrupted their conversation.
The time had unknowingly reached 00:00.
This matter was temporarily set aside by everyone, as the version update was of more importance.
The last update announcement had forewarned that this update would include a special monthly rule about ‘Do As One Pleases’.
Honestly, over these months, they had seen monthly rules about life, combat, and the supernatural, but they had never seen anything about a rule for ‘Do As One Pleases’. What was that all about?
‘Ding!’
The prompt sound suddenly rang.
“Game Update Announcement!”
“The new Blue Star 4.8 version will start a non-stop update at 00:00 on December 1st. The main content and adjustments of this update are as follows.”
“1. We’re not fixing bugs this month.
The staff was a bit distracted this month, and nobody went to find bugs. We’ll find them next month.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 577 382 You are making it difficult for me._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 577: Chapter 382: “You are making it difficult for me.”_2 Chapter 577: Chapter 382: “You are making it difficult for me.”_2 This month has been quite a hassle, and your Yi has already gone nearly mad with killing out there.
Soon you all will graduate, it’s time for us to graduate too. Find it and just keep it on the down-low when using it, don’t get detected by the automatic systems.”‘
“2. New ‘Gomoku’ Gameplay
Yes, there’s no other gameplay, but per the game upgrade rules, the staff didn’t have the energy to think about that this month. However, the upgrade rules also require a new gameplay each month, so we just added Gomoku.
No need to talk about the rules, right?
Everyone should know them.
If you don’t, maybe don’t participate in this gameplay.”
The rewards are what they are, some points and a hodgepodge of props as prizes; just check out the Gomoku page. Rankings are based on victory points, with the first place earning the title of ‘Chess God’.”
“3. New August Rule: ‘Do As One Pleases’.
‘Do As One Pleases’: This month, all players will not truly die, nor will they fall into hell. You can brazenly do some things you wouldn’t dare before.
But, in return, every word you say must align with your true feelings, and speaking against your heart will cost you 1000 Points each time.
And an eye-catching pop-up will appear above your head.
‘Okay, I admit I was insincere.’
ps: Although players won’t die, some props, titles, and skills that are only triggered by death can be triggered smoothly. Any player who ‘dies’ will instantaneously be restored to perfect condition, and it won’t consume the ‘fall into hell’ cost, nor will it greatly increase the next return time.
This rule lasts for one month.
Next update preview: The project team has decided to add a rule based on the element of ‘getting a head start’ for the month, so stay tuned, players.”
…
The announcement lasted only a few dozen seconds before ending, simple and neat.
“Uh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit started with a strange expression: “Is the Snow Sea Project Team not wanting to do this anymore? Planning to run away?”
“What’s with this abrupt show, what are they trying to do?”
“Could they be any more perfunctory?”
“Can’t even be bothered to find a bug? And they don’t even want to think of a new gameplay? Just throw in Gomoku to make up the numbers? They might as well have added ‘Fight the Landlord’. If you’re going to do something, do it; if not, everyone might as well resign.”
“And what’s with ‘Yi has already gone mad with killing out there’? Have the version update announcements become so personalized?”
Yi’s name has appeared more than once in the update announcements.
But it’s always been very official.
Like killing a world boss, or seizing the top spot on the leaderboard, etc.
But something like this, being called out so personally in a version update, is truly unprecedented. It seems even the Snow Sea Project Team has become like Yi’s little fanboys to some extent.
You don’t even need to look at the first and second items of this update; just skip directly to the third.”
‘Do As One Pleases!’
“I have to say,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit grinned with satisfaction: “This rule is quite interesting. I’ve always thought that new monthly rules were meant to restrict players, who knew there’d be one that could help players?”
“Absolutely won’t die.”
“Does that mean in December, all Blue Star players absolutely won’t die?”
Suddenly thinking of something, Tuberculosis Rabbit laughed even more joyfully, his pupils filled with playfulness and anticipation: “If I remember correctly, isn’t Santa Claus supposed to pop up in December?”
“I’m very curious now.”
“What kind of face will Santa Claus make when he sees Yi’s over a hundred million health points and realizes that Yi can’t die no matter what this month?”
“The expression must be priceless.”
“Not bad at all.”
Even Chen Yi nodded with a smile, acknowledging that this rule was quite good. It was just a pity that it appeared in this month—if it appeared during a month when there was a risk of clan extermination, that would be excellent.
For example, next month their Blue Star would face a great enemy with a Sevenfold Planet incoming.
Then, having the ‘Do As One Pleases’ rule would be very appropriate.
After that, he yawned, wrapped his arms around Jiaye, turned around, and headed back into the house, waving his hand casually as he said: “Everyone take a rest, it’s late. We can talk about anything else tomorrow.”
Absolutely won’t die.
And can trigger all those skills, titles, and props that are due to death?
Doesn’t this perfectly match his ‘Wife-Killing Buff’?
Theoretically speaking, can he repeatedly unleash the Wife-Killing Buff non-stop for the entire month of December without any restrictions, the whole month long?
Damn.
It’s just too bad that the ‘Cosmic Traveler’ profession has expired.
Otherwise, he feels like he could half-wipe the entire upgradeable game this month.
Tonight, he should think carefully about how he can maximize the benefits of unleashing the Wife-Killing Buff non-stop for a month.
…
Inside the house.
Chen Yi, having finished washing up, wrapped his arms around Jiaye and whispered into her ear with his warm breath, “I won’t die this month, so how about tonight? You know, the kind with no restrictions?”
“No!”
After quickly and briskly replying, Jiaye slid down, burying her head under the quilt.
Only a glowing pop-up remained, flickering above the quilt.
“Okay, I admit I was lying.”
“…”
“…”
Silence fell in the room instantly, a kind of intangible, awkward, and ambiguous atmosphere gradually enveloping the entire space.
“Hey.”
Chen Yi’s mouth curved into a slight smile, as if wanting a bit more excitement, he couldn’t help but raise his voice as he lifted the quilt and wriggled inside, laughing even louder.
“Hehehe!”
“Lying kids must be punished.
“Your punishment will be that you can’t make a sound tonight!”
“I really don’t want to!”
A sound of indignation seeped through the quilt and filled the room. The pop-up that had disappeared appeared once more.
“Okay, I admit I was lying.”
“All right, I was a little bit tempted, but I mostly really don’t want to.”
Unwilling to accept defeat, Jiaye poked her head out from under the quilt, covering the busily fiddling Chen Yi with the quilt and looking hopefully towards the ceiling.
However…
“Okay, I admit I was lying.”
The pop-up appeared again.
“…”
After a moment of expressionless silence, Jiaye let out a light sigh and embraced Chen Yi without any symbolic struggle, “Alright, no more pretending, let’s start, from the neck up.”
This time.
The pop-up didn’t appear again.
…
And Sword Without End, seeing that Yi was off to rest, sat in a rocking chair on the rooftop and tentatively asked the Tuberculosis Rabbit and Tie Chui beside him, “Yi’s gone to sleep, shall we play again tonight?”
“Forget it, I’m not going.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head, “Just finished playing not long ago. It’s quite tiring, let’s do it another day.”
“Okay, I admit I was lying.”
The pop-up appeared.
“Leave now?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit tentatively asked.
The pop-up didn’t appear again.
“Alright then!”
A bit resigned, Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up, put on the jacket from the back of the chair, and headed downstairs, “What are you waiting for? Let’s go. You really do get me, don’t you? I was actually planning to go alone after you fell asleep.”
“Our tastes are too similar.”
“It annoys me every time.”
“No worries.”
Sword Without End, full of excitement, eagerly followed, “This time, we’ll decide by playing rock-paper-scissors.”
…
On Awesome Starfield.
“This makes things difficult for me,” Li Yi frowned at the Fourfold Planet chief who had come seeking help. “How could you guys provoke a player from Sixfold Planet? Sixfold Planet and Fivefold Planet are worlds apart, after all, players from Sixfold Planet have a profession for each hand.”
“I can’t help you.”
“Couldn’t you at least apologize more sincerely, maybe grovel a bit?”
“I know you’ve tried already, but I mean you could grovel even lower. Not to mention anything else, you could go to that Sixfold Planet’s turf and kowtow for three days and nights. As the chief of a clan, if you can do that much, their greatest anger would surely be appeased, right?”
“Yes, I know you’ve paid protection money to Yi.”
“But that’s just what we call it in private; in reality, it’s just money for buying porcelain. You can’t seriously think of taking a few billion Points and going to find Yi, right? It’s a difficult request to make.”
“Forget it.”
“I’ll indirectly inquire for you, but I can’t guarantee success. I still recommend you apologize if you need to. After all, Sixfold Planet has already exceeded our ability to cope, how could you provoke a player from Sixfold Planet?”

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 578 383 The entire planet has only one player
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 578: Chapter 383: “The entire planet has only one player? Chapter 578: Chapter 383: “The entire planet has only one player? Day broke.
A new month had arrived.
Chen Yi, who had slept soundly last night, walked sprightly to the rooftop. As he gazed into the distance and stretched with a long yawn, another new day began.
It had to be said.
The new rules of December really suited him.
What a “Do As One Pleases.”
Immortality.
As long as he wished, his Wife-Killing Buff could be renewed indefinitely. And under the buff of immortality last night, he felt refreshed for the first time, no longer needing to restrain himself.
Following that—
he saw that he had many unread messages last night.
He scanned through them quickly.
And understood what had happened.
On Awesome Starfield, a planet had paid him several hundred million Points as a protection fee—no, that’s not quite right—it had spent several hundred million Points on a rare and precious porcelain VCR, and now that planet had drawn the ire of a player from Sixfold Planet.
Via Li Yi’s relay.
They tentatively asked if he could step in to deal with the situation.
“…”
Chen Yi’s brows furrowed slightly as he stood there contemplating without speaking. To deal with this problem was indeed simple, too simple in fact. With the Wife-Killing Buff active without limits, let alone Sixfold Planet, he dared to touch even Sevenfold Planet.
But the main problem was that he couldn’t leave.
He no longer had the “Cosmic Traveler” profession, and for him to leave would be somewhat powerless. He couldn’t exactly fly out of Blue Star and run over to Awesome Starfield, right?
What could he do with his strength if he couldn’t leave?
Yet, to ignore this matter didn’t seem right either. After all, he had taken the money, so how could he continue to rake in points if he ignored this situation?
After much contemplation.
He sent a message back to Li Yi.
…
And upon receiving Chen Yi’s message, Li Yi read his instructions carefully and then waved over the standing Cast Steel Star Clan Leader from Fourfold Planet, saying, “Yi’s message just came through.”
“The current situation is that Yi can’t leave Blue Star for the time being, as you know, he’s still within his Novice Period.”
“Last time he came out through special means.”
“But Yi has replied to you, you just go and tell that Sixfold Planet player that you’re under Yi’s protection. To mess with you is to disrespect him, Chen Yi.”
“With Chen Yi’s clout, you should be able to survive this ordeal without an issue.”
“Really?”
The Cast Steel Clan Leader from Fourfold Planet was instantly filled with hope, saying, “That’s great, as long as I can say that, there’ll definitely be no problem.”
He had not dared to say it before.
After all, it wasn’t an official protection fee, and he didn’t dare to blatantly claim that he was under Yi’s protection and that to move against him was to disrespect Yi, lest eventually, he offends Yi as well.
After all, he had only purchased porcelain.
From a business standpoint, it was a transaction that was already completed.
No further obligation to deliver.
The supposed protection was all insinuation.
But now that Yi had given him the go-ahead to proceed as such, naturally, there would be no problems, and everything was resolved. He still trusted in Yi’s influence.
Having said that.
He hurriedly said his goodbyes, ready to return to his territory to handle the matter.
…
However.
Three hours later.
The Cast Steel Clan Leader came back crying and wailing, clinging to Li Yi’s legs and howled, “It’s no use, Chief Li, you didn’t see how arrogant the other party was. I’ve already mentioned Yi’s name, but they showed absolutely no respect.”
“Hmm?”
Li Yi frowned and said with some disbelief, “No respect at all? Impossible. Yi is someone who could kill Jiang Chenglu, has the other side gone mad?”
“Please watch the VCR.”
The Cast Steel Clan Leader waved his right hand with force, casting a video projection into the air.
In the video.
The Cast Steel Clan Leader knelt on the ground, an image of absolute submission, while standing opposite him was a humanoid creature with three eyes and a body continuously dripping with a sticky fluid.
The creature was relentlessly mocking, with both the Cast Steel Clan Leader and Chen Yi as the objects of scorn.
It was rather grating.
“…”
Li Yi watched the VCR, his mouth twitching slightly, momentarily at a loss for words, feeling his scalp tingle. He could even imagine that if the content made it to Chen Yi’s ears.
Chen Yi would probably rush over the next day and wipe out the entire family of the creature before him.
He indeed knew the creature.
The Three-Eyed Clan.
Although this Race Player was from Sixfold Planet, it was rumored they had the strength to reach Sevenfold Planet but had not yet taken action for some reason. All players from this race possessed an innate talent.
“Slippery.”
All attacks landing on them only caused 70% damage.
Except for mandatory death rule attacks.
This innate talent allowed the Race Players to dominate when the player leveling game had just begun. During the Novice Period, very few players perished, except for those who violated the monthly rules or the mandatory death rules of the map.
Most players could almost tank any damage from the maps and bulldoze their way through.
It was that simple, that mindless.
Their slimy, dripping skin made most attacks merely glide off the surfaces of their bodies, failing to inflict substantial harm on the players of this Race.
This resulted in the player behaving extremely arrogantly.
“What do we do?”
The Cast Steel Clan Leader holding Li Yi’s legs looked up at him with pleading eyes, saying, “Former Leader Li, you can’t just leave me to die. Think of something!”

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - 579 383 The Whole Planet Has Only One Player_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 579: Chapter 383: “The Whole Planet Has Only One Player?”_2 Chapter 579: Chapter 383: “The Whole Planet Has Only One Player?”_2 “Don’t rush.”
Li Yi frowned in thought for a moment before speaking, “I’ll send your video to Yi and see what he says, but there probably isn’t much that can be done. Just be patient for a bit.”
“Everything will be easier to handle once Yi’s new book release is over.”
“There’s nothing to be done about it now.”
…
At this moment, Chen Yi.
Was lying on a beach chair basking in the sun, it was already winter, and the winter sun was extremely comforting. It chased away the chill on his body, and lying under the sun, he felt warmly cocooned.
Jiaye had just gotten up.
She had finished washing up, sat beside him with sleepy eyes, and blankly stared into the distance. Clearly, she hadn’t fully awakened, her mind not yet switched on despite lacking morning grumpiness.
Just as Chen Yi was about to say something.
He suddenly received a VCR from Li Yi.
“…”
After watching the entire VCR with a blank expression, Chen Yi suddenly turned his head to Jiaye and said, “Jiaye, do you remember that I have a destiny battle to fight?”
“I do.”
Jiaye tilted her head as she dredged up memories from the deep recesses of her brain, “You mean that S-rank ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ destiny battle of yours, Yi? The opponent has the S-rank ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ prop.”
“It was to be after 90 days.”
“It’s happening at the end of this month.”
“Eh?”
Jiaye blinked, sudden excitement sparking in her eyes, “Yi, your destiny battle is at the end of December? This month has the ‘Do As One Pleases’ rule in effect, where your Wife-Killing Buff can be endlessly renewed.”
“Your combat power this month is at its strongest. Doesn’t this mean that your destiny battle this month is a sure win?”
She had always been a bit worried about this.
After all, the opponent had an extreme number of Luck Points.
An extreme number of Luck Points was truly hard to comprehend and hard to gauge how powerful it could be. Was it powerful because a high number of Luck Points meant owning countless S-rank items or because it allowed one to dodge attacks unwittingly?
But she had always been fearful that this enemy could bring an indelible danger to Yi.
Now, she was no longer worried.
After all, it was December.
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi’s eyes squinted slightly as he nodded, “Before the final battle begins, should we go out and stack up some Life Value?”
“Sure.”
Jiaye nodded emphatically but then hesitated, “But Yi, how do we leave Blue Star?”
“Let’s ask the Snow Sea Project Team.”
…
“Absolutely not!!!”
“Definitely not!!!”
Upon receiving Chen Yi’s request, the entire Snow Sea Project Team erupted in an uproar. Numerous employees surrounded Jin Buhuan, the team leader, their faces anxious as they hurriedly said, “Our three S-rank no-compensation permissions are just enough to get us home.”
“We already used one to let Chen Yi leave Blue Star last time; otherwise, we would have four. If we use another now, we won’t know when we can get home.”
“Boss, you wouldn’t want us to stay in this damn place forever as project team members, would you?”
“We also want to become players!”
“Boss, you know that although project team members nearly have no risk of death and don’t have to play the lower maps, only by becoming players do we have the chance to truly leave the base game like Jiang Chenglu.”
“And start a whole new life for our own kind!”
“What have we been striving for all this time? Not to constantly serve Chen Yi’s purposes but to regain our player status and then truly leave the base game!”
“Alright.”
Jin Buhuan said expressionlessly after a brief silence, “No need to say more, I have already made my decision. Let me clarify today that our main task now is to help Chen Yi.”
“That way, once we shed our identity as project team members and return to being players, we can gain Chen Yi’s protection.”
“It’s more advantageous for us to quickly escape the base game.”
“Listen to me.”
“Tell Chen Yi that we’re willing to offer one S-class freedom opportunity for Chen Yi to leave Blue Star, but he must return within three days.”
As the head of the Snow Sea Project Team.
Jin Buhuan had the full authority to make final decisions.
Seeing that Jin Buhuan had taken such a firm stance, the other employees had nothing more to say, exchanging helpless glances and sighing before beginning to activate an uncompensated S-class freedom opportunity and starting to write the application report for Chen Yi’s departure.
To tell the truth.
Chen Yi probably didn’t even realize the great price of going out just once.
The boss had never discussed the cost of leaving with Chen Yi either.
It could basically be understood that one could only leave Blue Star once they had won the Monument of the Ascension game, a requirement that could not be considered low.
And this was Chen Yi.
In other planets, which project group would waste such a precious opportunity on something as trivial as leaving Blue Star?
Of course, most importantly, players from other Novice Planets weren’t even aware that they could leave their own planets, much less knew about the existence of other planets beyond their own.
…
‘Game Update Announcement!’
‘The new version of Thrilling World 4.0 will start its non-stop update at 00:00 on December 1st, and the main content and adjustments of this update are as follows.’
‘1. Optimize the server to improve stability.’
‘2…..’
‘A bug has been detected, the number of surviving players on this planet is only one, *&*&&&*, bug has been fixed, the original Novice Period was 12 months, given that only one player remains on this planet, the Novice Period has been shortened to 1 month.’
‘The Novice Period of this planet will end at 00:00 on January 1st, the following year.’
‘Below is the official update version…’
A hoarse and robust voice, on December 1st, also echoed through a planet almost devoid of light, filled with a suffocating atmosphere.
Amid countless corpses.
A girl in a red robe was sitting in a chair, absent-mindedly biting her fingernails, “Has the Ascension game finally come? Does that mean I can see Li Yide soon?”
This girl was none other than Xiaoqian.
On August 1st, Blue Star had a global special event ‘Thrilling World’ descend, for those three days, countless strange events befell Blue Star, and besides her, all the strange phenomena were made based on her, emotionless, like the walking dead.
Only she had her own consciousness.
During those three days, she met Li Yide, who made her feel cherished, showed her that disliking someone meant you could kill them, and gave her tasty potato chips.
He took her to watch exciting TV shows, provided a warm sofa, and offered the masculine comfort of his embrace.
She missed Li Yide.
But her world was just a reserve for the Ascension game; she had no way to find Li Yide. Over these months, she killed everyone in this world, hating this world that determined one’s status by surname.
The more people she killed, the more Strange Qi she absorbed, the stronger she became.
The stronger she got, the more people she killed, and the more Strange Qi she could absorb.
Thus.
She was the only person left on the entire planet.
And now, the Ascension game had finally arrived.
Only after going through the Novice Period could she go find Li Yide.
Looking at the announcement that had popped up in front of her, Xiaoqian’s lips curved slightly upward – she could finally taste those delicious potato chips again.
…
Meanwhile.
In space above Guixing, the emotionless faces of many Guixing Project Team members were looking down at this planet littered with corpses, somewhat speechless: “How did we get assigned to accompany this one planet?”
“There’s only one player on the entire planet?”
“Then what’s the point?
“For some global events, Xiaoqian doesn’t even have to do anything, she just automatically takes the top spot.”
“Just lying there, she scoops up all the best rewards from all the events.”
“So many of us are serving just her alone, and isn’t this Xiaoqian a bit too brutal? It’s the first time I’ve seen someone wipe out their own race, what kind of thing is this.”

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - 580 384 The Pioneer
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 580: Chapter 384: “The Pioneer…? Chapter 580: Chapter 384: “The Pioneer…? “…”
Above Guixing, the entire staff of the Guixing project team stared emotionlessly at Xiaoqian sitting in the midst of corpses below, at a loss for what thoughts to express for a moment.
As members of the project team, they had no way of choosing which Novice Planet to accompany.
It was completely random.
But being randomly assigned to such a planet was just bad luck, and there was no use getting upset.
“It’s not too bad.”
After a long silence, a man spoke faintly, “It’s not without its benefits. At least the Gui Clan down there now only has Xiaoqian as a player. Once she dies, she won’t even have to go to the Gui Clan hell, as the extinction mechanism will be triggered directly.”
“From this perspective, it won’t delay us for too long.”
“Next, we basically have an update every three days, a global special event every day, a leaderboard every day, and new content every day; a month of high-intensity game updates with absolutely no time to adapt.”
“This girl probably won’t last very long.”
“Once this girl dies and the Gui Clan is extinct, we can re-randomize a new Novice Planet to accompany.”
The benefits for the project team and the planet they accompany are closely linked. In other words, the more powerful the planet they accompany, the more benefits the team reaps, and vice versa.
And the Gui Clan below.
Has only one player.
No matter how you look at it, it doesn’t seem promising. After all, many maps can’t be entered by just one person. Do they expect Xiaoqian to clear the planet upgrade assessment maps by herself? The bosses in the planet upgrade assessment maps are all designed for an entire planet’s players. Unless she has far more than the average person’s terrifying strength, it’s impossible for her to pass the assessment on her own.
Even the simplest, one assessment map.
“Wait a minute.”
Just then, an employee suddenly furrowed his brows and said, “Haven’t we all overlooked something? If the planet we’re assigned to accompany has its novice period end with extinction, then we’re all damned to go to hell with it!”
As these words fell.
The room suddenly fell into a lengthy and quiet silence.
Numerous employees exchanged glances, standing motionless and silent, speechless.
Damn it.
How could they have forgotten about this?
The person was right; if the planet they were accompanying faced extinction before the end of its Novice Period, the price they paid would be anything but small; it was no different than being exterminated themselves.
It had been a long while since such an event had occurred—they had almost forgotten about this rule.
Damn!
The entire Gui Clan consisted of only Xiaoqian. This meant that all the random crises, which were supposed to be spread out among various players, were now concentrating on Xiaoqian alone. How could a single woman withstand such pressure?
“Xiaoqian cannot die. At least not until the end of the Novice Period in a month. She cannot die!”
The leader of the Gui Clan project quickly set the tone for this situation.
Die?
Impossible. If Xiaoqian died, they would all have to go down with her. Even if death was inevitable, it had to happen after the Novice Period. Dying within the Novice Period was just damn bad luck!
But ensuring Xiaoqian survives this high-intensity crisis in December is another big problem.
As employees of the project team.
They hardly had any authority to interfere with the updates, and could only try their best to reduce the degree of crisis. But… it probably wouldn’t have much effect, given that there’s only one player.
“Sigh.”
Many employees of the project team heaved a collective sigh, leaving Xiaoqian’s fate to her own luck.
…
Meanwhile, Xiaoqian, completely unaware, sat tranquilly amidst a heap of corpses. Despite the littered body parts and blood around her, Xiaoqian’s red dress remained unblemished by blood, giving her an eerily peculiar appearance.
In her ears, numerous notification sounds kept ringing.
‘Ding, the global special limited-time event “Minghuo Festival” has commenced, lasting three days, and initiating the “Minghuo Leaderboard”…’
‘Ding, congratulations to player Xiaoqian for ranking first on the “Minghuo” leaderboard. Please continue to maintain…’
‘Ding…’
A mix of notification sounds buzzed in Xiaoqian’s ears, but after glancing at them indifferently, she continued to sit and stare into space, lost in thought.
Just then—
Suddenly, thousands of horrifying monsters, each three to four meters tall, emerged from the shadows. They let out piercing wails as they slowly approached Xiaoqian, seemingly ready to devour the distracted girl in mere seconds, leaving not even bone fragments behind.
…
“It’s over!”
Seeing the scene below, the employees above Guixing closed their eyes in sheer desperation. They were facing extinction right after the server opened—what the hell! They were so unwilling!
Why should they have to accompany the dead just because their project was extinct during the Novice Period? The rule was absurd!
Especially on a planet with only one player, it was beyond frustration.
Normally, such monsters would be distributed throughout a city, perhaps engaging hundreds or thousands of players at once for one creature, as a kind of appetizer to adapt to the environment without too much danger.
But now there was only Xiaoqian on the entire planet.
All the nearby monsters swarmed towards Xiaoqian.
Including the monsters from other corners of the planet and even further locales, they all sprinted towards Xiaoqian, as if she were their sole target, running wildly without care.

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - 581 384 The Pioneer..._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 581: Chapter 384: “The Pioneer…?”_2 Chapter 581: Chapter 384: “The Pioneer…?”_2 “She still hasn’t claimed the prop, damn, I’m really fucking done with this!!!”
An employee of the project team couldn’t help but curse aloud, “Hurry the fuck up and get the treasure chest, draw a useful prop, maybe there’s still a slim chance of escape!”
In the system notification just now, one of the notes was a reward of a random D-level treasure chest.
But I don’t know if Xiaoqian didn’t see it or saw it but didn’t understand it, this girl didn’t claim that D-level treasure chest at all but continued to sit there, looking lost in thought, as if she was in a daze.
However, time waits for no one.
It’s all too late now.
Thousands of ferocious monsters had already tightly surrounded Xiaoqian in the center, forming a seamless enclosure, not even a sparrow could be let out, and the nearest monster was only less than a meter away from Xiaoqian.
Even if Xiaoqian were to take a breath, she would probably be able to smell the stench from the monster’s mouth.
But perhaps memories were intoxicating.
At this moment, Xiaoqian slowly came back to her senses from her memories, pulling herself into reality, glanced at the countless monsters rushing towards her, and calmly waved her hand.
“I don’t like you.”
The next second—
“Boom!!!”
All of a sudden, a streak of scarlet flames erupted from beneath Xiaoqian’s feet, rapidly engulfing the surroundings at an almost sonic speed, and the monsters touched by the flames didn’t even have a chance to wail, melting instantly into gas without leaving even ashes behind.
Almost in an instant!
The thousands of terrifying monsters that had surrounded Xiaoqian disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.
Further away, the countless monsters that had been charging towards Xiaoqian suddenly seemed to sense something, slammed on the brakes, turned around, and ran back the way they came, their pupils filled with terror, looking extremely frightened.
The crisis that was here just a moment ago was almost instantly resolved.
…
“…”
“…”
Seeing this scene, the employees of the Snow Sea Project Team who were already filled with despair above Guixing suddenly froze in place, with a bewildered and incredulous look at Xiaoqian below, who seemed frail and weak, finding it hard to believe that the terrifying area attack just now had come from the hand of such an unremarkable woman.
“Walker…?”
One employee’s voice trembled slightly, speaking with uncertainty and hesitation.
Walker.
In the leveling game, this wasn’t something common; many race players on various planets, before the arrival of the leveling game, would use their innate abilities, such as the Three-Eyed Clan, naturally possessing the ability to reduce all damage received from behind by 70%.
Or like the Void Clan, naturally possessing strong fertility.
Such race players are collectively referred to as Walkers, and they are not considered very rare players; after all, there are billions, if not tens of billions, of Walkers in the leveling game, often appearing en masse as a race.
But—
Generally speaking, the abilities that Walkers come with tend not to be too overpowered and don’t completely dominate other races.
And… Walkers with strength like Xiaoqian’s, this was their first time seeing one, and the first time they heard of one. It’s estimated that in the entire history of the leveling game, there has never been a Walker as powerful as this one.
A novice player who’s just started the leveling game, almost comparing in strength with players from the Threefold Planet or even Fourfold Planet, is somewhat too preposterous, suggesting that she could recklessly kill at will during the Novice Period.
Just like Chen Yi.
Basically, no activity or rule for novices could pose even the slightest threat to Chen Yi.
He was seriously overpowered.
“Phew!”
The project team employees who had originally given up on Guixing now looked down at Xiaoqian with a complex glint in their eyes. If Xiaoqian could maintain this kind of power, perhaps Guixing would become the most successful planet they had accompanied after many years.
Indeed.
One person, one race, means having to endure more crises and disasters than other normal players, especially with only one month of Novice Period and the version updates changing so quickly, giving not a single opportunity to pause, as stopping would mean death.
But on the other hand,
If Xiaoqian could survive the Novice Period, that would mean she would definitely take the top spot on all leaderboards, receiving the best rewards from all leaderboards, and from all events, maps the best rewards.
Although the crisis is great, the rewards are even greater!
And… possibly not weaker than Blue Star’s Chen Yi!!!
Thinking of this.
Almost all members of the Guixing Project Team subconsciously exchanged glances with each other, these days, Blue Star’s Chen Yi had a hugely prominent reputation in their circle!
In the past.
There was a consensus among all of them: even if a player had strong individual strength, they were insignificant in front of an entire planet and simply couldn’t pull the whole planet forward. After all, each planetary upgrade tested the collective strength of all players, not the individual strength of any single player.
Before Chen Yi appeared, this was the consensus, and this was what everyone believed.
But after Chen Yi appeared, the consensus was broken.
It turned out that if the individual strength of a player was strong enough, strong to a certain bottom line, breaking through a certain limit, then it was entirely possible to drive the whole planet forward.
Now, many project teams had already started to tentatively pile all their resources onto a single player, attempting to initiate a godmaking project to create a player with strong individual strength like Chen Yi.
And now, they had the best opportunity!
Before the upgrade game descended, a trailblazer with already immense individual strength!
An extremely short Novice Period, rapid growth rate, countless Prop and Skill rewards, and rich yet cold-blooded combat experience!
All of these together.
Represented!
As long as they were willing, they could completely transform Xiaoqian into a being that could rival or even surpass Chen Yi!
For a moment.
Ambition began to slowly burn in their hearts. The Snow Sea Project Team had seized four upgrade game Monuments in less than a year—who didn’t know about it?
In their circle.
It was enough to make people green with envy and practically go insane!
…
Blue Star, within its borders.
At this moment, Li Yide was standing at his own doorstep with one hand on his waist, shouting at his minion, “How many times have I told you, no cilantro in the hot and sour rice noodles, no cilantro, and you still f**king put cilantro in it!”
“Go buy me another one!”
“Yes, yes, yes…”
The minion, slapped and not daring to retort, hurried downstairs to buy another serving of hot and sour rice noodles.
After sending off his minion, Li Yide snorted coldly, then disdainfully shook his pink Fox Tail and strode to the sofa to sit down, casually picking up the TV remote on the coffee table to find a show to watch while eating.
After flipping through several channels.
Li Yide suddenly froze in place.
Previously, he would never look for a show to watch while eating.
But… ever since that “Thrilling World” event descended and Xiaoqian appeared by his side, he had gradually gotten into the habit—Xiaoqian seemed to really enjoy watching television.
“…”
The scene playing on the TV was a variety show recorded before the upgrade game descended.
He had watched it countless times.
When he had nothing else to do, he would replay it, which made him feel as if Xiaoqian was still by his side, someone sitting on the sofa with him, leaning on his shoulder, munching on chips while watching those boring and embarrassing variety shows.
“…”
Li Yide looked expressionless at the coffee table full of chips, staying silent without speaking. He didn’t know when he would see Xiaoqian again, or if he would have the chance to see her in this lifetime.
He just hoped that when he saw Xiaoqian again.
He could hand her a bag of chips and say, “Long time no see.”
…
December 1st, 14:00.
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood on the rooftop of a tall building in Sky City, looking down at the bustling scene below, stretched leisurely with satisfaction, and grinned, “Finally, time to get moving.”
“If there’s no proper event soon, I’m going to rust from inactivity.”
“What do you think, Sword Without End?”

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 582 385 Today let me tell you
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 582: Chapter 385: “Today, let me tell you. Chapter 582: Chapter 385: “Today, let me tell you. “Indeed,”
Sword Without End nodded slightly, his expression somewhat thoughtful as he stood on the rooftop of a tall building, overlooking the bustling streets below, twisting his neck: “It’s been a long time since I’ve moved; I’m really getting the itch to take action.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled a card from his embrace and looked at the main quest number he had recorded on it.
‘Exterminate the Three-Eyed Clan of the Sixfold Planet, the entire race.’
‘Time limit: 3 days.’
The Three-Eyed Clan, that was the race from the Sixfold Planet that came to the Awesome Starfield to stir up trouble. Born with the innate talent “Slippery,” only 70% of any damage would take effect on their bodies, a Sixfold Planet with enough strength to impact the Sevenfold Planet.
Originally, this matter had nothing to do with them.
They didn’t need to make a special trip.
But who let them collect protection money? Since they took the money, they couldn’t just let it be. Indifference, no matter how little, would look rather bad, so they had to make the trip.
“What now?”
After checking the main quest, Tuberculosis Rabbit stuffed the card into his embrace and turned his head to speak to Chen Yi: “Yi, should we go there directly? Or what?”
“Simply wiping out the Three-Eyed Clan won’t have much effect,”
Chen Yi pondered for a moment before shaking his head: “It won’t serve as a strong enough deterrent. If we come forward this time because the Three-Eyed Clan provoked us, what about next time? We can’t come out every time, right?”
“There needs to be a powerful deterrent to tell some short-sighted races not to offend people who have paid us protection money.”
“Otherwise, we can’t keep running back and forth, right?”
“It’s not only tiring, but it also doesn’t look good, does it?”
“That’s true,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully: “So what should we do then?”
“There’s only one answer.”
Chen Yi squinted his eyes and smiled: “More than a powerful force, everyone fears a madman with great power even more.”
Jiang Chenglu died at his hands.
That was the only player from the Tenfold Planet who still ended up falling to him. Not to mention how he was killed—after all, the outside world didn’t know the specifics. Logically speaking, this incident alone should be enough to intimidate some players.
But… it didn’t work.
There are too many who are stubborn, just like this Sixfold Planet’s ‘Three-Eyed Clan’.
Therefore, this time, he needed to script a drama and craft a persona of sorts.
…
Three hours later.
The leader of the Cast Steel Clan from the Fourfold Planet looked uneasily behind at the live news broadcast team carrying various cameras, lacking confidence, he turned his head sideways to ask Li Yi: “Former Leader, what do you think Yi means by this?”
“What’s he planning to do with so many live broadcast teams?”
“Will this really work?”
“…”
Li Yi, somewhat speechless, turned his head sideways to look at the Cast Steel Clan’s leader: “What are you worried about? Since Yi himself is on the move, what is there for you to fear?”
“If Yi has come, it means he’s ready to take the lead for you.”
“What else are you afraid of?”
“Yi is someone who could even slay Jiang Chenglu, do you think he can’t handle a mere Sixfold Planet?”
“It’s not that… I just don’t feel confident inside,”
The leader of the Cast Steel Clan from the Fourfold Planet hesitated for a moment before speaking: “Many people outside are spreading rumors that Chen Yi was able to kill Jiang Chenglu only because there was a conspiracy, perhaps Jiang intentionally died by Chen Yi’s hand. One theory is that the final task in the chain for upgrading from Ninefold to Tenfold Planet is to die at the hands of a Novice Period player.”
“Otherwise, it’s impossible for a new player, no matter how powerful, to kill the strongest Ninefold Planet player.”
“It just doesn’t make sense.”
“Besides, although Yi showed extremely powerful abilities during the Void Clan invasion, it wasn’t overly exaggerated. With that kind of strength, it was far from enough to kill Jiang Chenglu. If Yi was holding back then, it would be somewhat unreasonable.”
“After all, if Yi truly had the power to slay Jiang Chenglu, he would’ve gone straight to the Void Clan and wiped them out.”
“Although Yi once exterminated a Sixfold Planet, that was because all the players from that planet shared a Life Value. Yi just killed one player from that Sixfold Planet, leading to the entire planet being wiped out.”
“Most importantly…”
“That map contained the Wonder of the Mummies, which is a marvel created by Chen Yi.”
“So now, the outside world’s assessment of Chen Yi’s strength is based on his performance within the map that holds the Mummy Wonder. He’s able to exert extreme single-target power. Jiang Chenglu’s death in Chen Yi’s hands was purely for completing a task. Yi’s real strength is just as he displayed against the Void Clan.”
“Very strong, but… limited in power.”
“Honestly, I’m not sure myself if he can take on the Sixfold Planet’s Three-Eyed Clan.”
“…”
Li Yi looked expressionless at the Cast Steel Clan’s leader in front of him and stayed silent, not speaking. In fact, he and the leader had long noticed this point, but both of them tacitly chose not to discuss it.
The reason is simple.
Even if Chen Yi’s current strength isn’t considered very strong,
what’s most terrifying about Chen Yi is his rapid growth rate. They hadn’t known him long, yet Chen Yi managed to challenge their perceptions every so often, a rate of growth far exceeding that of other players.
