Even if Yi’s current strength wasn’t enough to make them despair, it’s foreseeable that, given more time and the end of the Novice Period’s constraints, Yi’s strength would indeed see an exponential increase.

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - 583 385 Today let me tell you._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 583: Chapter 385: “Today, let me tell you.”_2 Chapter 583: Chapter 385: “Today, let me tell you.”_2 At that time—
Wanna fawn over them?
It’s over!
If you’re going to fawn, you need to start now, but there aren’t many who can see that, like the chief of the Cast Steel Clan who seems a bit blind to this point, probably already feeling in his heart that he’s paying too much for protection.
If he doesn’t pay,
perhaps that Chen Yi won’t take kindly to him.
“Sigh.”
Li Yi let out a long sigh, didn’t explain anything, but patted the Cast Steel Clan chief’s shoulder with a meaningful and heavy tone, “Sometimes, we need to take a longer-term view.”
Just as he was about to elaborate,
he saw Chen Yi and his entourage approaching from not far away.
He was momentarily stunned.
Then immediately put on a sycophantic smile and, while still at a distance, bowed and waved, “Yi, good day! Welcome to Sky City for some fun. How’s it going? Are you enjoying yourself?”
…
“Hmm.”
Having reached Li Yi, Chen Yi looked down at his wristwatch and said casually, “Has that guy from the Three-Eyed Clan arrived yet? Hurry it up. After this is over, I still need to make a trip to the Void Starfield.”
“By the way, to exterminate those bugs or something.”
December rules “Do As One Pleases”!
All players won’t die, and they can trigger props, titles, skills, etc., that are only activatable after death.
What does this mean?
In other words,
this means that in December, he is invincible. Since he’s invincible, why not go and annihilate the Void Clan while he’s at it?
Three days, honestly, it’s a bit difficult to wipe out a clan like the Void Clan because the Void Starfield is just too vast.
So before coming, he had already discussed it with Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others.
Quickly deal with this Three-Eyed Clan issue, then head to the Void Starfield. Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others will be responsible for luring and kiting the monsters, while he’ll handle the killing. In this way, his S-grade prop “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” should be able to reach a ridiculously high number.
Several billions of health, that should be the very least, it mainly depends on how many can be killed in these three days, which will depend on the kiting ability of Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others.
Now, Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End were standing behind Chen Yi, frantically purchasing on the Star Map Platform, with the main goal being to find a way to quickly gather monsters together.
“Ah?”
Standing across from Chen Yi, Li Yi was stunned for a moment, his eyes flashing with shock, and he said with some disbelief, “Exterminate… wipe out the Void Clan? Are you serious about this, Yi?”
After so many years,
having been immersed in the game for so long, he had seen clans being wiped out, but this was the first time he heard of someone planning to wipe out the Void Clan.
Not to mention anything else,
just the population size of the Void Clan, even if they stood there for you to kill, it would still take you a year and a half. If the killing speed is even slightly slower, it can’t keep up with the breeding speed of the Void Clan.
Killing them here can’t compete with their birth rate there,
The more you kill, the more they become.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi, unconcerned about Li Yi’s expression, simply nodded his head, “Not sure, we’ve only got three days. Whether the Void Clan can be exterminated within three days is hard to say.”
“Let’s not talk about that for now. Has anyone from the Three-Eyed Clan come yet?”
In the crowd,
a female assistant standing behind the cameraman, upon hearing Chen Yi’s big talk, couldn’t help but show a hint of disdain in her eyes.
She despised people who bragged and boasted the most.
They were from Massive Media Television Station, one of the many television stations invited by Chen Yi, responsible for live broadcasting the entire event.
The cameraman quickly noticed his assistant’s improper look and his face slightly changed. He stood in front of his assistant, trying to prevent Chen Yi from noticing the emotional change in her eyes, then turned his head and whispered urgently.
“Have you lost your mind?”
“Chen Yi will kill you!”
“What’s there to be afraid of.”
The female assistant spoke up with her neck stiffened, “In the past few months, our planet has advanced twice consecutively, having ascended from a Fivefold Planet to a Sevenfold Planet. With the strength of our planet, we simply don’t need to fear Chen Yi, okay?”
“Does Chen Yi even dare to wage war against a Sevenfold Planet?”
“…”
The cameraman, with an incredulous look on his face, lowered his voice once again and said word by word, “Whether Chen Yi dares to wage war against a Sevenfold Planet is not something I can say, but you must remember one thing, you’re just one player among the planet’s population, not the leader of the planet.”
“Targeting you doesn’t imply declaring war on the entire planet.”
“It might not be feasible to deal with a Sevenfold Planet, but killing you personally is definitely no pressure.”
“Don’t create trouble for yourself, do you understand?”
“Oh.”
The assistant pouted, still obviously not convinced, “I just can’t stand his boastful appearance, and even collecting protection money. Have you ever seen a genuinely powerful player who comes out to collect protection fees?”
“He might just be a complete fraud.”
At that moment—
A young man dressed in a suit slowly walked out from the crowd, stood in front of the Cast Steel Clan leader, calmly adjusted his tie, and spoke softly, “Let me introduce myself, my name is Xu Lei.”
“From the Sixfold Planet, of the Three-Eyed Clan.”
“Oh… I almost forgot.”
After saying that, the young man seemed slightly troubled as he lightly tapped his forehead, “I spoke out of habit, it’s kind of hard to change. As of an hour ago, our planet has risen from a Sixfold Planet to a Sevenfold Planet.”
“So now, introducing myself, I should say my name is Xu Lei, from the Sixfold Planet of the Three-Eyed Clan.”
“No need to ask what my status is.”
“You only need to know that in the entire Three-Eyed Clan, there is only one person standing above me, and that person’s surname is Lei.”
After that, the man named Xu Lei casually glanced around and said indifferently, “Speaking of which, weren’t you inviting me here to discuss the solution for the issue that cropped up last time your clan angered ours? Have you found a solution?”
“I…”
The presence of this young man was indeed strong, especially when he mentioned passing by that he came from a Sevenfold Planet, it made his aura even more intense. The Cast Steel Clan leader became somewhat unsteady and didn’t dare meet Xu Lei’s gaze.
He just lowered his head, looking in Chen Yi’s direction.
Seeking Chen Yi’s intervention.
“Hey.”
Xu Lei, who had witnessed all of this, seemingly only just noticed Chen Yi standing to the side, straightened his face, strode up to Chen Yi, sincerely grasped Chen Yi’s hands, and began to speak.
“This must be Mr. Chen Yi, right?”
“I heard that Your Excellency possesses not only superior strength but also no less skill in amassing wealth. In the Awesome Starfield alone, you’ve collected several tens of billions of Points.”
“Honestly speaking, our Three-Eyed Clan is very envious. We’re green with envy.”
“We never thought that Points could be so easy to earn. So, I’d like to discuss something with you. Would you lend me some of those Points?”
The young man’s expression was extremely sincere, as if he were seriously discussing this matter.
“Ha.”
Chen Yi slowly pulled away from the young man Xu Lei’s hands, stared at him for a long moment, and then suddenly chuckled, “So you’ve come for me, huh? Green with envy?”
“Yes, several tens of billions of Points indeed can make people envious.”
“Only—”
“Has no one told you what happens when you covet something of Chen Yi’s?”
He slowly stretched his limbs, then his right hand swiftly shot out, grabbed Xu Lei by the neck, and gradually lifted the young man into the air. He looked calmly at the man in mid-air struggling to activate various Props in an attempt to escape, all in vain, his face turning red, and spoke softly.
“Today, let me tell you.”
“And also tell everyone, if anyone dares to reach out to my territory, I will make sure to hunt down and kill his entire family.”
The next second—
Chen Yi, with one hand in his pocket, casually tossed the nearly asphyxiated and fainting Xu Lei to the ground, then slowly raised his foot and forcefully stomped down on Xu Lei’s head, effortlessly crushing it as if the protective shields Xu Lei had activated did not exist at all.
The body twitched a few times, then became completely motionless.
70% immunity to damage doesn’t mean invincibility.
The onlookers were suddenly silent, everyone somewhat dumbfoundedly looking at the already dead Xu Lei. They didn’t understand how Xu Lei died; in his final moments, Xu Lei had activated a number of Props that hit Chen Yi.
But there was no reaction at all.
It was like throwing water into a quagmire.

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 584 386 With this firepower who do you think
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 584: Chapter 386: With this firepower, who do you think can withstand it going in? Chapter 584: Chapter 386: With this firepower, who do you think can withstand it going in? “Cough…”
Standing behind Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked around at the stares from the people around, coughed lightly into his fist, and then spoke solemnly.
“Those who offend Yi,”
“will be pursued and punished, no matter the distance!!!!!”
“…”
Chen Yi turned his head slightly towards Tuberculosis Rabbit behind him, a bit at a loss for words. He had already felt that his previous statements were pretty awkward, and had he not needed to go through the motions to prevent further bother from every Tom, Dick, and Harry, he would definitely not have said all that nonsense.
Given his personality,
for things that could be dealt with directly, why babble about anything?
And Tuberculosis Rabbit’s two lines were even more juvenile, almost pushing the atmosphere to an extreme awkwardness.
But…
The people around did not seem to feel embarrassed at all.
Whether it was Li Yi, the people from the television station, or the Cast Steel Clan chief, not a single one felt embarrassed; instead, their pupils were filled with shock. Even though they had seen Chen Yi take action many times before, each look brought new amazement.
A player from Sixfold Planet,
with 70% damage immunity.
Even without having unlocked their own profession, they had perished just like that?
As effortlessly… as if stepping on an ant.
…
Chen Yi didn’t notice the shock in the eyes of the people around him, but instead walked slowly to the Cast Steel Clan chief with the support of his cane, patted his shoulder gently, and asked softly, “So it’s this person from the Three-Eyed Clan causing you trouble?”
“Yes… yes…”
The Cast Steel Clan chief stuttered tremulously, “I beg Yi to stand up for us; we Cast Steel Clan haven’t done anything, and this Three-Eyed Clan is bullying us simply because they are more powerful. We really had no other choice but to come to you, Yi.”
“If there was anything at all that we could do… we wouldn’t have bothered you, Yi.”
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi nodded calmly and spoke softly, “Point me in the direction.”
“Huh?”
“Point me in the direction.”
“Oh… oh… oh!”
The Cast Steel Clan chief quickly snapped out of his confusion, turned around a few times in place, then said with a tearful voice of uncertainty, “Yi, I don’t know which direction the Three-Eyed Clan is in. Should we open the map and check?”
“I know.”
Li Yi, unable to stand watching from the sidelines, ran over to Chen Yi’s side, appearing eager as he projected the Starfield map in the air, pointing to a location: “Here, this is the location of the Three-Eyed Clan, in the Three-Eyes Starfield.”
“There’s a player from the Three-Eyed Clan who has also seized a Monument in the upgrade game and has named the Three-Eyes Starfield.”
“Mhm.”
Without another word, Chen Yi took a slow step forward and disappeared on the spot.
Following behind him, Tuberculosis Rabbit also shrugged his shoulders, patted the Cast Steel Clan chief’s shoulder with a look of empathy, and said, “I’ve got a friend with the same problem as you, also a stutterer; used a ton of props to no avail. If you get a chance, you two should chat. Maybe you could even share some insights on your conditions.”
“Let’s go.”
After saying that, he, just like Chen Yi, took a step forward and vanished on the spot.
…
After Chen Yi had left,
the people from the television station and others exchanged glances, each seeing the shock in the others’ eyes. Chen Yi clearly seemed even more arrogant than they had imagined, and his strength appeared to be even greater.
Not to mention anything else,
just consider the method of departure; they hadn’t even understood what method Chen Yi and the others had used to disappear on the spot.
Did they instantly arrive at Three-Eye Starfield?
This kind of ability was truly astonishing!
Then, all the people, without even needing to communicate, began to open the map to prepare for Starfield Shuttle, unaware of how Chen Yi got to Three-Eye Starfield, but knowing the only way to travel to other Starfields.
It’s the Starfield Shuttle.
By paying a certain amount of Points to the upgrade game, one can freely travel to any other Starfield.
The cost of the Starfield Shuttle isn’t cheap; the least expensive starts at nearly a million. Unless there is something very pressing, a single trip would definitely be a loss. As for ordinary players, they don’t even get the chance to travel to other Starfields.
In fact—
For a player from Threefold Planet, earning a million Points is quite simple, since they’ve made their way from the Novice Planet all the way to Threefold Planet, and earning around a million Points is fairly common.
However, how many Points one has in their account, that is an unknown.
Buying props, skills, outfits, participating in events, etc.
Earning a million Points is completely different from having a million Points in an account.
This group of people was about to spend a significant amount of Points to go to Three-Eye Starfield, but the value they would bring back was certainly far greater than the travel costs. After all, this was a very captivating authorized broadcast by Chen Yi!
Just the ticket money for the streaming room would completely cover the travel costs!
Not to mention other indirect profits.
…
Meanwhile,
At a certain hilltop in Awesome Starfield, Chen Yi and his companions appeared one after another.
“Not bad.”
Chen Yi smiled and nodded, “This prop is pretty handy.”
Naturally, they did not possess the ability to instantly travel to Three-Eye Starfield. Their disappearance from the spot was made possible by activating a prop.
‘Prop Name’: Fixed Teleporter Gate.
‘Prop Level’: B-grade.
‘Prop Effect’: You can set a fixed anchor point anywhere. When you activate this prop, you can instantly teleport to the anchor point.
‘Prop Restrictions’: Cannot set anchor points within maps, event spaces, etc., cannot teleport across Starfields, and the fixed anchor point will dissipate after 48 hours.

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - 585 386 With this firepower who do you think
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 585: Chapter 386: With this firepower, who do you think can withstand it?_2 Chapter 585: Chapter 386: With this firepower, who do you think can withstand it?_2 “Prop Introduction”: As long as you’re willing, I will always be here waiting for you.
Just some little trinkets.
Bought from the Star Map, one for everyone.
They’re pretty good for posturing; after all, the purpose of his trip boils down to showing off and intimidating some random cats and dogs so they won’t bother or irritate him in the future.
If he stayed in place to begin Starfield Shuttle, although there wouldn’t be a problem, his cool factor would plummet.
But with this prop, his coolness would soar instantly.
What’s coolness?
Coolness is all about mystery and the unknown!
“Alright, no time to waste.”
Chen Yi glanced at his wristwatch and prepared to initiate Starfield Shuttle, then turned to Jiaye Cai Rabbit and his crew with a serious face, “When the time comes, everyone unleash your full power and wipe out the entire Three-Eyed Clan at top speed.”
“Don’t worry.”
Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit exchanged a look and grinned together, “Anyway, we can’t die by force this month, so what’s there to be afraid of?”
“It’s just a performance.”
“We must let the Three-Eyed Clan witness the power of Blue Star’s number one Sword Immortal!”
“Right, indeed.”
While arranging the props in his bag, Tuberculosis Rabbit habitually shot back, “Indeed, the number one Sword Immortal of Blue Star. After all, you’re the only Sword Immortal on Blue Star. No sane person would enjoy cosplaying as a Sword Immortal in everyday life.”
Chen Yi didn’t engage in their banter, instead turning his head to look at Jiaye, a touch of distress flashing in his eyes, “It’s going to be tough on you these days.”
“It’s no big deal.”
A hint of amusement flashed in Jiaye’s eyes as he pulled out a prop from his chest and held it aloft, “See what this is? I’ve got a whole bunch of Painless Needles, no knockout effect, but they immunize against pain.”
“Since I won’t die this month and don’t need to take a trip to hell, I can stay by Yi’s side all the time, what do I have to complain about?”
“And…”
Jiaye’s voice gradually lowered, “This is also the first time I have the opportunity to watch you fight beside Yi. Before, I could only watch Yi’s live broadcasts in hell. Sometimes, when there were no broadcasts, I had to rush back through the return map, and by that time, the fight was usually over.”
“…”
Chen Yi was slightly stunned, his mouth opening and closing for a moment, not quite sure what to say.
He had just come to realize this.
Indeed, this was the first time Jiaye would be accompanying him in battle. In the past, as soon as the fight began, Jiaye would run off to the depths of hell to comfortably watch the live broadcast or head to the clearance map, never fighting alongside him.
The battles warranting his intervention were always extremely difficult, and usually required the activation of the Wife-Killing Buff.
And the condition to activate the Wife-Killing Buff was Jiaye’s death.
After half a moment of silence, he pulled Jiaye into his arms and softly patted his back, but said nothing.
…
Thirty minutes later.
Chen Yi and his companions successfully reached the Three-Eyes Starfield, arriving in the territory above the Three-Eye Planet.
There are nearly a hundred planets in the Three-Eyes Starfield, and the Three-Eye Planet is just one of them. Sharing the name does not mean that the Three-Eye Planet has achieved domination over the entire Three-Eyes Starfield.
“Whew!”
Chen Yi, taking a deep breath and standing on the sled, flicked the cigarette butt in his hand aimlessly below and gently stroked the crimson bloodline on Jiaye’s neck, then instantly activated the sled and blasted off towards the distance in the territory above the Three-Eye Planet!
The speed wasn’t fast!
Merely under 200 kilometers per hour!
He didn’t push the sled to its maximum speed but rather slowed it down a lot to ensure that he could fill every corner with Buddha and meteors.
Everywhere it went!
“Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom (Ultimate Edition).”
“Buddha’s Fury (Ultimate Edition).”
“Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans (Ultimate Edition).”
“Wildfire (Ultimate Edition).”
“…”
Countless props and skills were instantly activated, sprouting like bamboo after a rain, filling every space the sled passed!
After obtaining a large amount of Zenith Radiance last time.
Almost all of Chen Yi’s props and skills had been enhanced into the Ultimate Edition by the Zenith Radiance.
For example, the skill Violators, Annihilate Nine Clans, which used to require firearms to kill the enemy and annihilate three clans, now any method of killing would annihilate three clans, with players annihilating three clans and monsters annihilating 999 clans.
And then there’s Wildfire.
He could call down dense, blazing meteorites in droves.
Before the enhancement, the meteorites took a full two to three minutes to fall, but once enhanced to Zenith Radiance, they could be unleashed instantaneously!
After most of his skills and props were enhanced to Zenith Radiance, Chen Yi’s combat power had reached an unprecedented apex.
At this moment, Chen Yi
was akin to a sunfish continuously laying eggs, leaving a trail of relentless attacks that roared down and swept across the land below.
Sunfish, also known as mola or ocean sunfish,
are known for their extraordinarily large number of eggs, up to 300 million, the most amongst fishes, quite intimidating indeed.
Whether it was unpopulated wastelands or bustling urban areas,
all were indiscriminately cleansed.
There was absolutely no need to know where the enemy was, let alone the location of their core cities or their supreme leadership; just cleanse the entire area indifferently and that was that.
…
The entire territory of the Three-Eyed Clan was undergoing baptism from the Land Beyond the Heavens.
Many players also wanted to counterattack.
But how could they?
Looking up, all they saw were falling meteorites and the gaps filled by Flowers of the Other Shore. Anyone touched by them would continuously bleed and lose their sense of direction, not even knowing where to flee.
Then there was Buddha’s Fury.
Before the enhancement to the Ultimate Edition, Buddha’s Fury, though powerful, was not excessively so.
The Buddha’s Fury enhanced to the Ultimate Edition had its power increase by more than just a notch.
“Enhancement Effect”: The power is greatly increased, the bullets fired from the Gatling in the Buddha’s hands are enhanced to High-Explosive Burning Air Bullets, with the power significantly boosted and an added explosive effect.
And for every 10 bullets shot, the 11th bullet will be changed to a ‘Gold-Reducing Bullet’.
Any enemy hit by the Gold-Reducing Bullet will see their Points balance reduced by 0.01% instantly.
The bullets’ power has been greatly enhanced, not to mention the explosive effects.
After all.
It wasn’t just a single Buddha with a Gatling in the air, but thousands or even tens of thousands of them, peppering the sky with countless High-Explosive Burning Air Bullets raining down like a wrathful god’s fury, leaving no patch of land unscathed.
Even the oxygen has become thin.
The sensation of countless explosions bursting in one’s head is unbearable for anyone.
The ‘Gold-Reducing Bullet’ effect, which would normally be noteworthy, was completely trivial here; basically none of the Three-Eyed Clan’s players cared about the 0.01% Points they lost after being hit.
Or rather.
Compared to the injuries inflicted by the bullets, the tiny amount of lost Points was negligible.
In most cases, the ‘Gold-Reducing Bullet’ effect was almost useless.
After all, though one could instantly empty someone’s Points balance if they wanted to, provided there were enough bullets, but then again, which player could withstand being hit by so many bullets at once?
The ones who could withstand such an onslaught of bullets were not the kind anyone could afford to provoke.
They were probably on the same level as Jiang Chenglu.
Meanwhile—
The television stations of the Awesome Starfield arrived belatedly, as they needed to transport equipment and staff, which took longer, and even before arriving at the domain of the Three-Eye Planet, they could see from a distance.
The skies above the Three-Eye Planet were filled with gunpowder smoke.
They could vaguely make out,
countless meteorites and bullets pouring down from the sky like a torrential downpour, with no better metaphor to describe it; it truly looked as though the attacks were spilled from the sky.
There was not a single clean spot left in the entire planet’s atmosphere.
The incessant crash and explosion sounds that filled the ears were so loud that they began to make one’s scalp tingle.
“…”
The onlookers exchanged glances, each seeing helplessness in the others’ eyes.
How could they continue to broadcast live under these conditions?
They couldn’t even find where Chen Yi was.
What? You say charge in, find Chen Yi, and stick the camera in his face?
Awesome.
With this firepower, forget about them; who do you think could withstand this?
Even if they could withstand it, their broadcasting equipment certainly couldn’t.

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - 586 387 Inconceivable
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 586: Chapter 387: “Inconceivable! Chapter 586: Chapter 387: “Inconceivable! For a moment—
These belated television crew members were astonished to find that they couldn’t enter the battlefield. Quite proud of their battlefield broadcast trucks in the past, they now dared not venture into such intense attacks.
Entering was death.
In desperation,
they could only stand outside the territory of the Three-Eyed Clan, lifting their cameras to start broadcasting live the scene resembling heavenly punishment before them.
Though they couldn’t see Chen Yi and the others, to be precise, they couldn’t see any other players from the Three-Eyed Clan either.
But it was enough.
Even so, a large number of players flooded into the live broadcast room to enjoy this rare grand spectacle.
…
“It’s okay, it’s okay!”
In a dimly lit small room deep underground in the Three-Eyed Clan territory, an old man looked at his wristwatch and shouted, “According to the data, Chen Yi’s attack intensity can only last for a maximum of three hours!”
“If we can withstand these three hours!”
“It will be our time to strike back!”
“Don’t be impulsive, everyone hide in concealed places, and wait for this intensity of attack to pass before making a move!”
Although Chen Yi didn’t attack very often, those who were intent on gathering data could still manage to do so. It wasn’t a very difficult task, and in that limited information, all of it showed that Chen Yi’s attacks of this intensity could only be maintained for a maximum of three hours.
Though they didn’t know what prop or skill it was.
But as long as they survived these three hours, their day of retaliation would come.
Just three hours!
…
At this moment—
Chen Yi and his companions had already sat down on the sled and started chatting leisurely.
“Speaking of which, are there no people from the Three-Eyed Clan?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned against the edge of the sled, holding a gently swaying glass of red wine, glancing at the mushroom-cloud-like smoke below, and grinned with satisfaction, “I still liked their unruly look from earlier.”
“Forget it.”
Sword Without End sighed helplessly, “With attacks of this level, which player could rush up? Not to mention the intensity of the attack, the sky is clogged with bullets, meteorites, and otherworld flowers, blocking all space.”
“To think of flying up through so many obstacles, even if their defense could withstand it, there’s no space for them to fly.”
Chen Yi leaned against the edge of the sled with a grin, didn’t speak, just lit a cigarette and brought it to his lips. Through the light blue smoke, he enjoyed the scene below; through the smoke of gunfire, he could clearly see the explosions.
A barrage of firepower.
The sensation it brought was always so comforting.
All the petty people would turn to ashes under the bombardment.
Building a city is difficult, it requires cooperation among many forces, and a vast amount of funds, but destroying a city is exceptionally simple; all one needs is overwhelming firepower.
Just then—
“Here comes death!!!”
From within the smoke, a man with a fierce look and covered in scars burst out with his sword, moving so fast it was hard for the naked eye to catch him. Before Chen Yi and the others could react, the man thrust his sword heavily against the outer shield of the sled…
What a joke!
When they enhanced the sled, they added thousands of semi-transparent shields on the outside.
Even though many shields were used up in the “Pharaoh’s Tomb” map, there were still thousands in perfect condition. The man’s speed was extremely fast, so fast that they had no time to react.
But clearly, he lacked power.
That seemed like a full-powered thrust, yet it only caused the outermost shield to lose 76% of its energy, without even damaging a single shield.
“…”
“…”
The abrupt incident left Chen Yi and the others somewhat stunned in place, obviously still not having reacted to the fact that someone had breached their barrage and reached them. The speed truly left them speechless.
Only about the power of the attack, it was a bit challenging to put into words.
The next second—
The Three-Eyed Clan man, who had just reduced the outer shield’s energy by 76%, appeared somewhat bewildered as he swallowed nervously, then, without any hesitation, turned his head to flee.
Clearly,
he had overestimated his own attack power and underestimated the defensive power of the sled’s outside shield.
It wasn’t just about attempting assassination—he couldn’t even break through the shield.
But Sword Without End obviously didn’t want to give the man a chance to escape and immediately opened the shield. His body turned into a streak of green light and shot forth. At the same time, he grasped the Three-Foot Qingfeng in one hand, and at some point, he had donned a green robe.
In the blink of an eye,
Sword Without End appeared in front of the assassin with Green Peak held diagonally, his expression calm as he looked at the man from the Three-Eyed Clan before him and spoke softly.
“Under heaven, I stand alone, for no one else dares wield a sword.”
The man from the Three-Eyed Clan didn’t pause for a second, not waiting to hear Sword Without End finish speaking, his brows tense with anxiety as he activated a prop hastily, his body accelerating by thrice the speed, streaking even farther away!
Then, Sword Without End simply pinched a sword technique casually.
The next moment.
The long sword gripped in the Three-Eyed Clan man’s hand suddenly veered beyond his control, flying in front of him. Without any delay, it turned back, its tip stabbing ferociously toward the eyes of the Three-Eyed Clan man.
“Whoosh!”
The sharp sword pierced out from the back of the man’s head without delay.
Almost instantly, it was evident that the man’s speed had dropped significantly, his body staggered midair as he flew off into the distance. Even after this severe strike, there was still no sign of death.

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - 587 387 Unimaginable Indeed_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 587: Chapter 387: “Unimaginable Indeed!”_2 Chapter 587: Chapter 387: “Unimaginable Indeed!”_2 I must say.
The Three-Eyed Clan’s ability to resist 70% of damage is indeed enviable.
But—
In the blink of an eye, the flying sword of the Three-Eyed Clan man repeatedly stabbed into his body and shot out from the other end in less than a second.
This man’s three eyes were rendered useless.
His body now bore more than a dozen blood holes the size of a baby’s fist.
What can one say?
There’s nothing to be said.
No longer able to stay airborne, even with 70% damage resistance, he couldn’t withstand such relentless onslaught, and the body of the Three-Eyed Clan man began to plummet straight to the ground, dead beyond any doubt.
If you’re quick enough, you might crawl out of hell before your clan is wiped out.
If you’re too slow, you’re simply annihilated, no need to bother crawling.
And Sword Without End, standing mid-air, only after seeing that Three-Eyed Clan man fall to the ground below, returned to his snow sled with a satisfied expression and smiled at Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others, “I haven’t made a move in a long time, was a bit itchy, sorry if I embarrassed myself in front of you.”
「Title Name」: I have a sword, who dares to answer?
「Title Level」: Black.
「Title Effect」:
1: You are the Master of Ten Thousand Swords, capable of controlling all sword-type props or vehicles at will.
2: Possessing the protection of Sword Tomb, no sword-type vehicle or prop can inflict any harm upon you.
3: With one sword echoing my will, any sword-type vehicle or prop you own will gain an extra enhancement effect.
「Title Restriction」: The way of the sword is supreme, it will not tolerate coexistence with others. After equipping this title, you will not be able to wear any other titles. Previous titles will be forcibly removed.
「Title Source」: In the B class ‘Sword Slashing Demon’ map, continuously slay your own Heart Demons a hundred times.
「PS: This title is unique.」
This is his title, uniquely belonging to Sword Without End, a unique title. Because of this title, he was also unable to gain any other titles, nor could he acquire others.
It was extremely overbearing.
One effect of this title was the ability to control all sword-type props, whether in his own hands or an enemy’s. He could unleash the full power of the sword and freely control it.
Most importantly,
any damage caused by sword-type props was ineffective against him, meaning truly no one dared to use a sword in his presence, no one could kill him, Sword Without End, with a sword.
In some situations,
this title, although merely a black title, could exhibit power far exceeding that of Falling Star Level titles.
He did indeed wish to enhance his title to an Ultimate Edition, like Yi’s ‘Wife-Killing Maniac (Ultimate Edition)’, but unfortunately, the range of Zenith Radiance enhancement only included S class and below titles, props, skills.
A red title is equivalent to an S class title.
And a black title is above a red title.
His title couldn’t be enhanced with Zenith Radiance, causing him regret for a time. If his title could be enhanced to an Ultimate Edition, his strength would greatly increase by several notches at least.
“Fellow Daoist…”
Sitting on the snow sled, Tuberculosis Rabbit swept a glance at Sword Without End, somewhat speechlessly, “Getting into character again, huh? Call me Dao Lord!”
“…Hehe.”
…
In the beginning—
Everyone thought this would be a quick battle, as no one believed the Three-Eyed Clan could survive such bombardment for long. It was simply not a war on the same level; the Three-Eyed Clan didn’t even have the capability to fight back.
No one doubted the Three-Eyed Clan would be exterminated,
Everyone was just guessing how long the Three-Eyed Clan could last.
But… as events slowly exceeded everyone’s expectations.
It was unclear if the overall strength of the Three-Eyed Clan players was just higher, or if their innate 70% damage resistance skill was genuinely a bit bugged, but incredibly after 14 hours, there still wasn’t any news of the Three-Eyed Clan’s annihilation.
They were still tenaciously struggling!
This was 14 hours, a continuous 14-hour intensive bombardment, and the Three-Eyed Clan players were still holding on until now, which was almost inconceivable.
Even some players were gradually beginning to believe that the scales of victory had already tipped toward the Three-Eyed Clan, and when Chen Yi could no longer sustain such intense bombing, it would be the Three-Eyed Clan’s turn to counterattack.
…
“Unimaginable!”
Outside the territory of the Three-Eyed Clan, a middle-aged man stood on the ground, looking up at the smog that nearly obscured the entire sky, muttering, “Is the power of the Three-Eyed Clan really that strong? I’m glad we didn’t go to war last time; otherwise, my clan would have been in danger!”
He was also a clan leader from the Three-Eyes Starfield, with his race’s territory located right next to the Three-Eyed Clan’s. On normal days, there was not a small amount of friction between them, but both sides had been restrained, avoiding large-scale wars, and engaging only in minor skirmishes.
In his opinion, an open war with the Three-Eyed Clan would surely lead to a situation where both parties would suffer damage.
But now it seemed,
far from both suffering losses, if the war had started last time, his clan would probably have been annihilated by now.
“The overall player strength of the Three-Eyed Clan is truly formidable, and we of the Black Ape Clan are indeed inferior…”
“Not so.”
The woman standing next to the middle-aged man slowly shook her head, “Shouldn’t we be more concerned about that Chen Yi? After all, the Three-Eyed Clan is a race, whereas Chen Yi is just one player.”
“And a player still in the novice period at that.”
“How can a player in the novice period maintain such a high level of attack intensity for 14 hours straight?”
“This has far exceeded the strength that a player in the novice period should have, hasn’t it? Not to mention, if this Chen Yi came to us, the Black Ape Clan, and treated us like he is treating the Three-Eyed Clan, do we have any means to counter?”
“None.”
The middle-aged man spoke with a complex expression after a long silence, “We don’t have any means, we can only beg for mercy or wait for death.”
Although it was somewhat embarrassing and irresponsible to say so, the reality was indeed as such. Also residing on a Sixfold Planet, they had previously considered their strength to be on par with the Three-Eyed Clan, only to realize today just how inferior the power of their Black Ape Clan was.
The Three-Eyed Clan had become mere players in the hands of Chen Yi.
The fate of their Black Ape Clan would only be worse, not better.
If Chen Yi really took action against them, other than begging for mercy or waiting for death, there was indeed no third option. However, fortunately, based on the information he had gathered about Chen Yi, so far, Chen Yi had not arbitrarily annihilated any race.
Which means—
as long as they didn’t offend Chen Yi, it was highly probable that Chen Yi wouldn’t come after them, but that couldn’t be said for certain, as no one could predict such unknowns.
Yet he did know why Chen Yi had come this time; the Three-Eyed Clan had provoked a race that had paid a protection fee to Chen Yi, and Chen Yi had come to retaliate on behalf of what’s-its-name, the Cast Steel Clan.
Perhaps…
they too could pay some protection fee.
They would rather spend a few billion points than witness the scene before them unfolding on the territory of the Black Ape Clan; they didn’t possess the innate ability of the Three-Eyed Clan to be immune to 70% of damage, and they could not hold out for so long.
They’d die faster, and their extermination would be swifter.
…
Finally—
When the bombing reached the 16th hour, many players heard an announcement in their ears.
‘Announcement from the Three-Eyes Starfield!’
‘We regret to inform everyone that the Sixfold Planet, Three-Eye Planet, has just been ‘annihilated by player Chen Yi from the Novice Planet Blue Star in the Annihilation Starfield Star System 3.’
‘Henceforth, the Three-Eye Star will no longer exist!’
‘Given that the Three-Eye Planet is the namesake of the Three-Eyes Starfield, the name of the Three-Eyes Starfield is hereby revoked and returned to the name ‘Type Seventy-Eight Starfield.’
‘…’
The announcements continued to sound.
But the players located outside the Three-Eyed Clan’s territory were not in the mood to listen to the announcement, instead looking somewhat stunned and lost toward the territory of the Three-Eyed Clan.
At a glance!
The original mountains, hills, and other terrain within the territory of the Three-Eyed Clan were all gone, and the entire territory had turned into a huge basin, then filled with slowly dissipating meteorites.
Indeed, the meteorites brought down by the sea of fire would dissipate, not staying forever, but the craters left by the meteorites were permanent.
It looked as if—
A face originally covered in acne had had its nose and cheeks, the raised areas, shaved flat, and then numerous small holes were dug out.
It was extremely shocking.

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - 588 388 Is There a Problem if I Want to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 588: Chapter 388: Is There a Problem if I Want to Annihilate Your Clan? Chapter 588: Chapter 388: Is There a Problem if I Want to Annihilate Your Clan? “…”
Chen Yi was silent, not quite sure what to say.
“Three-Eyes Starfield announcement!”
“…”
The only sound was the continuous announcements echoing in their ears, signifying that time hadn’t stopped; it was just that Chen Yi and the others on the sled had fallen into a deathly silence.
After an unknown amount of time.
“This is too hard to kill.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a long sigh, a bit frustrated as he gently massaged his temples, “Has it really been 16 hours? It took us 16 hours to exterminate them, the Three-Eyed Clan is too tenacious.”
Things were not as optimistic as they had imagined.
Nor as smooth.
It seemed mighty, with the entire territory of the Three-Eyed Clan covered in smoke, bomb blasts everywhere, countless attacks raining down from the sky as if it were the end of the world.
But—
The Three-Eyed Clan players naturally possessed a 70% damage immunity ability, which made them very hard to kill!
Fortunately, this month’s rule was that all Blue Star players were forcibly immortal, allowing Yi’s “Wife Killer” title to be activated without limit. Otherwise, the Three-Eyed Clan really might have been able to hold out until their vacuum period and then launch a counter-offensive!
They might have actually capsized in the gutter.
After all, if not for this month’s rule, to maintain the “Wife Killer” title for 16 hours, given that activating it could last an hour and a half, Jiaye would need to be killed at least ten times.
Each time they returned from hell, the difficulty level of the replicated instance would increase.
Ten consecutive increases.
Even Sword Without End couldn’t guarantee he could bring Jiaye out from the resurgence map within the designated time. Should there have been even a ten-minute gap, the Three-Eyed Clan’s counterattack might have already been assembled.
In this light, the Three-Eyed Clan didn’t provoke them without reason; they had done their research beforehand.
Unfortunately.
Just so happened that Blue Star randomly got a “Do As One Pleases” rule for the month, which could only be described as fate.
From then.
There were still over two days before they would return to Blue Star.
“…”
Chen Yi sat on the sled, glanced at the ruins below without speaking, and instead looked at the system announcement that popped up in front of him.
There were no rewards.
The system announcement only mentioned that the Three-Eyed Clan of the Sixfold Planet was exterminated by Chen Yi, and nothing else; not even an ordinary reward, let alone a game advancement monument.
Just like the last time they exterminated that Sixfold Planet that shared Life Value, there was no game advancement monument either.
It was unclear whether the conditions for obtaining the game advancement monument were too high, or whether Chen Yi had raised the threshold for game advancement.
Under such circumstances, it was impossible for a new player to obtain the game advancement monument, something they would otherwise never be able to do.
Of course.
He had more important things to do now.
…
Ten minutes later.
The sled slowly stopped on the edge of the Three-Eyed Clan’s territory.
By then, people from various TV stations had already gathered, and countless cameras were aimed at Chen Yi and his group, while numerous players who had come to watch took a subconscious step back after meeting Chen Yi’s gaze.
Although many of these players were leaders or key officials of the Sixfold Planet, or even the Sevenfold Planet.
After 16 consecutive hours of intense bombing, not just the Three-Eyed Clan, but no one among the players present dared to be bold enough to say their planets could withstand such a degree of bombardment.
Even if they could withstand it.
What about their families, their friends, their homelands, their comrades?
And… such intense attacks, they originally thought that Chen Yi only maintained them for an hour or two each time, because the limit of this Prop’s ability was just an hour or two.
Now it seems.
The reason why Chen Yi only maintained high-intensity attacks for such a short time in the past was not because the limit of this ability was one to two hours, it was entirely because the enemies’ tolerance was only one to two hours.
If he wished.
The duration could be extended to 16 hours, or even more.
Therefore, the danger level assessment for Chen Yi should be raised several grades in the future.
“…”
Chen Yi stood still and looked at the TV crew members holding cameras in front of him. After standing quietly with his cane for a while, he softly said, “In some ways, I’m a person who cherishes peace.”
“But the Three-Eyed Clan provoked me first.”
“Which has irritated me a lot.”
“I hope the next time someone decides to provoke me, they consider whether they have enough family members for me to kill.”
Having said that.
Chen Yi and his group didn’t stay long, but took a step forward and vanished from the spot.
…
Half an hour later.
Chen Yi and his group had returned to the Awesome Starfield and appeared in a diner in a small alley of Sky City.
“Let’s take a break.”
Chen Yi rolled up his sleeves, picked up the chopsticks from the table, looked at the bowl of fresh noodles that had just been served, took a deep sniff, and satisfied, he smiled and said, “The taste is not bad. After a rest, we’ll head to the Void Starfield.”
“This is a big job.”
“It’ll be quite tiring.”
If exterminating the Three-Eyed Clan was just a bit time-consuming and not very exhausting, then grinding Life Value in the Void Starfield was a big job.
After wiping out the Three-Eyed Clan, Chen Yi’s Life Value had reached—
190 million.
The S-grade Prop “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” granted one point of Life Value for each player killed, and with less than 50 million players in the Three-Eyed Clan, exterminating them brought his Life Value to 190 million.

chapters.title: Chapter 589 - 589 388 Is There a Problem if I Want to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 589: Chapter 388: Is There a Problem if I Want to Annihilate Your Clan?_2 Chapter 589: Chapter 388: Is There a Problem if I Want to Annihilate Your Clan?_2 It seems that the player population for planets beyond Sixfold is not very large.
It’s possible that during the advancement to Sixfold, the majority of players died, leaving only a few elites still alive.
At least so far, he hadn’t seen any high-grade planet with a large number of players, except for the Void Starfield of course. The innate ability of this race is a high reproduction rate, something unmatched by other races.
Of course, perhaps because of their rapid reproduction rate, the intelligence of most players of this race is not very high.
With the decisive battle, holding the S-tier prop “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,” about to commence and the time in Newbie Village drawing to a close, he had a premonition that his ultimate battle would arrive after the end of Newbie Village.
So.
The Void Starfield was a map he could not avoid; only by exterminating this race would his Life Value reach an exaggerated level, thereby granting him greater survivability in the future.
Of course… the most important thing right now was the bowl of noodles in front of him.
The weather was starting to get colder.
“Huff.”
Chen Yi exhaled a breath of cold air from his body and transported a chopstick full of noodles into his mouth, swallowing with satisfaction. In this sort of chilly weather, a bowl of steaming hot noodles was the definition of comfort.
The table was laden with various eating utensils.
There were chopsticks, knives and forks, gloves, sticks, and even some utensils he did not recognize.
These were specially prepared for race players to ensure that players of any race could find the appropriate utensil for themselves.
After all, Sky City wasn’t visited only by players from Awesome Starfield; players from nearby starfields would come to tour as well.
If this were on Blue Star.
It would be considered an international metropolitan city indeed, with a need for comprehensive and inclusive infrastructure to reflect the metropolis’s hospitality.
“Yi.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was not in a hurry to eat her noodles; instead, she was peeling garlic and asked, “With less than two days left, can we exterminate the Void Starfield?”
“Exterminate?”
Chen Yi swallowed the noodles in his mouth and shook his head, “Thinking of exterminating the Void Starfield in two days is wishful thinking. It is said that the Void Starfield has nearly hundreds of billions of monsters.”
“How could it be possible to exterminate the Void Starfield in two days? That’s utterly fantastic.”
“Although the talk of hundreds of billions of Void Monsters is just speculation by other players, and there’s no exact number on the actual count, it’s obvious that the numbers of the Void Clan are vast, and they cannot be eliminated in just two days.”
“Moreover, even if we had the capability to exterminate the Void Starfield within two days, we wouldn’t do it.”
“Eh…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit across from him was momentarily dumbfounded and hesitantly asked, “Why is that?”
“I ask you, what grade is the Void Clan’s planet?”
“Eh… I really don’t know that, nobody’s ever mentioned it.”
There’s only one race on the Void Starfield, the Void Clan, and when other players mention the Void Clan, they almost never talk about the grade of the Void Planet because it does not matter. The strength of this race isn’t associated with the grade of their planet—it’s insignificant.
“I’ll tell you, it’s Fivefold.”
“Would destroying a Fivefold planet yield us much benefit?”
“No.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook her head firmly; after all, they had just exterminated a Sixfold Planet and got no rewards. It was as if the game had grown accustomed to such feats—They had exterminated a Sixfold Planet, and yet there were no rewards at all!!
Is that appropriate?
Is that reasonable?
Is that justifiable?
Is that lawful?
If there were no rewards for exterminating a Sixfold Planet, it’s even less likely that there would be any for a Fivefold.
“Exactly.”
Chen Yi nodded with a smile, “Since there’s no reward, why should we be obsessed with exterminating the Void Clan?”
“But isn’t it possible to farm Life Value? And…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s words trailed off midway, but then she suddenly stopped short, quickly caught on, and broke into an enlightened grin, “Yi, I get it now, you’re planning to ‘raise pigs,’ so to speak. As long as the Void Clan isn’t extinct, their rapid reproduction rate will spawn even more monsters after a while.”
“If we wipe them out.”
“Finding another race like the Void Clan with low combat power, fast reproduction, and a large population would be almost impossible.”
“Exactly.”
Chen Yi nodded with a smile, “That’s right, our goal isn’t to eradicate the Void Clan, but to kill as many Void Monsters as we can within the time limit, and after we leave the Novice Period, we’ll take our time to grind.”
“We need to keep the Void Clan around.”
“Until we use them to push my Life Value over ten billion!”
“Yi, that’s brilliant!”
“Alright, let’s skip the flattery for now and have our meal. After eating, we all need to rest for a bit; we’ve got strenuous activities later, and if we’re tired, we won’t have the energy to do anything without some sleep.”
“Got it!”
After a hearty meal, Chen Yi and his companions didn’t dally or go sightseeing; they simply found a decent hotel and checked in, each to their own room to rest.
They slept soundly.
They weren’t at all worried about enemies finding and assassinating them; not only did they have virtually no enemies—since those they had crossed had mostly been killed already—even if someone did come after them, it wouldn’t matter. With the invulnerability rule in effect for the month, they had nothing to fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - 590 388 Is There a Problem if I Want to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 590: Chapter 388: Is There a Problem if I Want to Annihilate Your Clan?_3 Chapter 590: Chapter 388: Is There a Problem if I Want to Annihilate Your Clan?_3 It just hurts a bit.
…
“How should I put it?”
In a palace within the Awesome Starfield, Li Yi with a complex expression looked at the replay of the live broadcast in front of him, remaining silent for a long time before turning his head to look at the Chief of the Cast Steel Clan beside him, “With this, your crisis should be resolved, right?”
“Re…Resolved.”
The Chief of the Cast Steel Clan was trembling slightly at this moment, involuntarily swallowing his saliva before slowly regaining his composure, “That is, Chief Li, should I go and express… my regards?”
The crisis was more than resolved!
It was completely resolved!
From now on, there would no longer be the presence of the Three-Eyed Clan, and naturally, no one would come to provoke them on purpose.
Not to mention the Three-Eyed Clan, after this incident, not only the already exterminated Three-Eyed Clan but also the other races wouldn’t dare to mess with the Cast Steel Clan anymore. They would have to avoid them by three feet.
The level of protection Yi provided was unprecedented and unparalleled.
If every person who charged protection fees could provide such a level of protection, he couldn’t imagine how eagerly and happily those merchants would pay, he thought.
“Sigh.”
Li Yi sighed lightly, shaking his head somewhat speechlessly, “Your mind is too chaotic. You’re the Chief of a Fourfold Planet, you’ve come this far, you’re not so dim-witted that you need to ask me about such things, are you?”
“Whether you express regards or how you do it, that’s for you to go and think about slowly.”
“I have a mountain of issues to deal with over here.”
“Yes… understood, understood.”
The Chief of the Cast Steel Clan, who had finally come to a full realization, hurriedly nodded repeatedly, looking at Li Yi with a grateful face, “I also want to thank Former Leader Li for facilitating this. The gifts prepared by my people are already on their way, they will arrive soon. I hope Former Leader Li will be sure to accept them.”
He wasn’t stupid.
After all, to be able to sit in his position, one could say he might have certain flaws in his character, but he definitely wasn’t dumb.
It was just that the situation had completely overwhelmed him, causing his brain to be somewhat dumbfounded, unable to make the right choices for a moment.
“Hmm.”
…
After sending off the Chief of the Cast Steel Clan with a wave of his hand.
Li Yi sat silently in his place, not speaking. He indeed had many issues to address, after the Three-Eyed Clan was obliterated, many races from other starfields sought him out, testing his stance.
They wanted to know if they could purchase the porcelain from Chen Yi’s store in Sky City.
The undertone of their inquiries was whether they could also pay protection fees.
He was somewhat uncertain about how to reply.
The situation was definitely beneficial for him, as these people belonged to major clans. Although he wouldn’t receive a penny of the money, whether it was for the reputation of the Awesome Starfield or the capital brought by these individuals to Sky City, potentially investing in some industry or business, it was all purely beneficial for him.
But he couldn’t directly or indirectly respond to these inquiries, to avoid letting Chen Yi know, because he was aware Yi disliked others making decisions on his behalf.
After pondering for a long time.
He chose to cold-shoulder, to not reply to the messages.
It was better to let Yi handle this matter; he didn’t want to express an opinion too much.
…
Meanwhile, on Awesome Starfield.
All the races belonging to Awesome Starfield were now in a frenzy of celebration!
If just a short while ago, there were people cursing their leader for spending so many Points on a seemingly useless piece of porcelain, just to curry favor with Chen Yi, now nearly all the players were praising their racial governments for making such a correct decision.
Several billion Points, is that a lot?
Yes, it is!
A player with a rather good, even excellent standing on Sixfold Planet would find it difficult to come up with several billion Points in liquid assets.
The several billion Points here are not including the value of one’s Props and Skills, just the balance of Points in the account.
Not to mention players from Sixfold Planet, even those from Sevenfold or Eightfold Planets would struggle to produce several billion Points. After all, the vast majority of players tend to spend any Points they have as soon as they get them to improve their own strength.
Few people keep their Points accumulated in their accounts.
Only by strengthening oneself can one tread the true path.
But for a Race, whether it’s from Threefold Planet or Fourfold Planet, coming up with several billion Points might be a bit difficult, but it’s not impossible!
And now, all the players were relieved that their racial governments had once made such a correct decision!
Especially the players from the Cast Steel Clan, they were even more thankful!
If they hadn’t paid that protection fee back then, how could they have had Yi’s shelter? They could only have been oppressed to death by the Three-Eyed Clan, or even faced extermination without anyone to lend them aid.
Several billion Points, in exchange for such a powerful backer.
Who wouldn’t be happy?
At this moment, the leaders of the other races in Awesome Starfield were also sitting in their offices, repeatedly watching the replay of Yi obliterating the Three-Eyed Clan, the smiles on their faces growing wider with each view.
Such a person was the protective deity of their planets!
Truly an instant full sense of security.
Those billions of Points were incredibly well spent. Now, who else would dare trouble them? It would be good enough if they didn’t seek out trouble for others.
Now, looking at the porcelain they had spent several billion Points on, placed on their desks, the more they looked, the more pleasing it became, the more they liked it.
And for that last race that had paid the protection fee, even after the Tuberculosis Rabbit personally visited and they were still preparing to refuse payment, so much so that their leader faked death to escape, the newly appointed leader watching the replay in the live broadcast room couldn’t control the twitching at the corner of his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - 591 388 Is There a Problem if I Want to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 591: Chapter 388: Is There a Problem if I Want to Annihilate Your Clan?_4 Chapter 591: Chapter 388: Is There a Problem if I Want to Annihilate Your Clan?_4 Unimaginable.
Under the leadership of the old chief, they almost had to endure the fury of such a pervert.
Fortunately, he sent the chief, who faked his death in hell, to the depths of hell forever to work as a janitor; otherwise, if the chief really came back from hell, who knows what trouble he might cause.
They could only feel relieved.
They hoped Yi wouldn’t hold a grudge against them because of this incident or let it affect his view of their race. It seemed they should do something to make up for it.
And the best way to make amends?
Naturally, it was to go to God Yi Mall and spend some more money.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi, who was still sleeping, was unaware that Sky City within the Awesome Starfield had, at some unknown time, attracted a large number of high-grade planet players from other starfields, including those from the Sevenfold and even the Eightfold Planets.
Yes, Eightfold!
Outside the God Yi Mall, a deputy chief from a Sevenfold Planet looked incredulously at a middle-aged man next to him and said in confusion, “No way! You guys are all attacking the Ninefold Planet, and you still want to join this frenzy?”
He recognized the middle-aged man—he was the third in command from an Eightfold Planet called “air.”
His sudden appearance in Sky City of the Awesome Starfield, even standing outside the God Yi Mall, could have only one motive, and it didn’t need to be stated.
But what he couldn’t understand was this:
Did an Eightfold Planet, to be more precise, an Eightfold Planet that was attacking the Ninefold, still need Chen Yi’s protection?
With the strength they could muster, they were so much more powerful than Chen Yi; why would they come to pay this protection fee?
…
The middle-aged man just glanced indifferently at the man next to him who had initiated the conversation. He didn’t speak, standing patiently on the spot and seemingly deep in thought.
Yes.
He was indeed here to pay the protection fee.
It wasn’t that they desperately needed Chen Yi’s protection, but their goal was very clear.
First!
A few billion points were nothing for their planet, no pressure at all. Casting out a few billion points was almost like throwing money into the water, but it barely made a difference—it wasn’t much of an impact.
After all, it wasn’t a lot of money.
But the second point was what they valued most.
Chen Yi’s growth rate was just too fast. That was still during the Novice Period, where countless rules restricted his development. It was hard to imagine, once he left the Novice Period and the Newbie Village phase ended, to what extent his strength would grow.
Assuming he didn’t die prematurely.
It wouldn’t take long for Chen Yi’s strength to reach an extremely terrifying level.
And the few billion points they were spending were meant to curry favor.
Yes, to curry favor.
They didn’t care about Chen Yi’s protection at the current stage at all; Chen Yi’s strength at this phase couldn’t possibly protect them, let alone pose any threat to them. What they cared about was Chen Yi in the future.
When Chen Yi grew stronger in the future, as long as there were no irreconcilable conflicts, they hoped that out of regard for those few billion points, he would reconcile with them. Even if there were any serious conflicts, he would come to talk to them instead of getting into a fight straight away.
As for…
What if Chen Yi died prematurely?
Well, he would just have died, and they would have lost a few billion points, which wasn’t a big loss for them. Besides, which investment doesn’t have the risk of loss? For instance, a certain novelist—if they hadn’t lost money, why would they hurry back to writing?
Damn!
…
And so, a scene that even Li Yi found startling occurred.
At present, Sky City was filled with representatives from the Threefold, Fourfold, Fivefold, Sixfold, Sevenfold, and even Eightfold Planets, who had traveled from surrounding starfields to gather here, waiting for something.
Currently, not a single person had gone to the God Yi Mall to purchase the porcelain worth several billion points.
Mainly because…
Chen Yi had never accepted protection fees from races outside of the Awesome Starfield, leaving them somewhat uncertain if Chen Yi only protected races within the Awesome Starfield.
No one came forward to nod, and no one gave them a response.
They didn’t dare to buy either.
If Chen Yi not recognizing a loss of several hundred million Points was a minor issue, they feared their strong-arm purchase would make Chen Yi feel like he was being kidnapped, which would cause them to be resented. That was the real trouble.
Until—
Time passed, unknowingly how long.
A seemingly nonchalant young man stepped out of the mall.
…
“Hey,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit smiled with a hand in his pocket, looking at the group gathered at the entrance, “Everyone go in. Yi loves every player equally, whoever buys the porcelain is Yi’s friend.”
“It’s just that there might not be enough porcelain.”
As soon as he finished speaking,
the site instantly exploded into a frenzy!
Then, they saw those who were usually very serious seconds-in-command and thirds-in-command activate their Props and rush into the mall.
What are you waiting for?
They recognized this young man in front of them, Chen Yi’s closest confidant of late, and what this person said basically represented Chen Yi’s will. This statement was a clear indication that, no matter which Starfield, anyone who bought the porcelain could get protection.
“…”
Standing at the entrance of the mall, Tuberculosis Rabbit squinted and smiled at the group before him without speaking.
For them, it was definitely a no-lose situation.
Not to mention anything else,
this huge amount of Points was real cash flow, enabling them to go a very long time without ever running out of Points, so many Points that they wouldn’t even know where to spend them.
What about protection?
They couldn’t ask for more!
One of the key reasons Yi hadn’t exterminated any races at will was that doing so recklessly could easily provoke a concerted attack, which even Yi couldn’t withstand. But now, there was a perfectly justifiable reason.
You bullied my protected race.
Do I have a problem with annihilating your race?
No problem!
It’s perfectly reasonable.
It can be said to be all gains and no losses.
“So many people…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the endless stream of people entering the mall and couldn’t help but click his tongue and sigh, “So annoying, woke up from a nap and there’s so much Points coming in. How’s one supposed to spend all this money?”
Li Yi earned himself a Monument for ascending the game by making 1 billion Points during his Novice Period.
And the amount of Points they had made now in the Novice Period already had several zeroes added after the 1 billion Points.
Yet, there was no Monument for ascending the game.
This goes to show that the most important factor in getting the Monument for ascending the game isn’t about the difficulty, but about being the first in a particular field or, in other words, being the first.
At this moment—
Chen Yi stood on the rooftop terrace of God Yi Mall, gazing into the distance. They had slept for less than eight hours, initially planning to take a break, but the fatigue had gone straight to the depths of the brain as soon as they hit the bed.
Impossible to shake off.
Dizzy and drowsy, they fell asleep.
Just couldn’t get up.
He glanced down at the surging crowd below, only taking a casual look before falling silent again. There was no reason not to accept Points that were delivered right to his door.
Just couldn’t get up.
He glanced down at the surging crowd below, only taking a casual look before falling silent again. There was no reason not to accept Points that were delivered right to his door, just couldn’t get up.
