This prop is globally limited to 1,000 pieces, and after they are all claimed, an announcement will be made, and no more will be supplied.
The prop ‘Apple of Eden’ has unique effects, which players are encouraged to discover on their own.
‘Event Three: Oh, The Youth That Has Passed.’

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - 605 392 Prop Name The Apple of Eden._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 605: Chapter 392: “Prop Name”: The Apple of Eden._2 Chapter 605: Chapter 392: “Prop Name”: The Apple of Eden._2 “Event details”: Do you still remember how, during your youth, every Christmas Eve, you would go to the school gate to buy some apples, package them in gift boxes, and give them to your friends, as well as to someone you had a crush on?
These actions, which now seem incredibly foolish, are indeed the obscure and difficult-to-understand youth of many people.
Back then, we were all about pure love, simply wandering around the playground holding hands with the person we had a crush on, oblivious to the destination but feeling extremely romantic and content, like a dandelion seed floating on the wind, uncertain where it would land.
But after graduation and being tempered by society, we’ve turned into beings whose minds are filled only with how to see through people.
During the event, a limited-time gift box “Ambiguity on Christmas Eve” will appear in the shop.
The gift box is priced at 1888 Points.
Contents of the gift box: Random B-grade Prop Chest*1, Random B-grade Skill Fragment*5, Random B-grade Admission Ticket*1, Random B-grade Fashion Component*1.
If the player who purchases the gift box is still a virgin, then the gift box will score a critical hit, with all rewards doubled, and a very small chance to increase by one grade.
“Event four”: Snowball Fight.
“Event details”: How can there be a Christmas Eve without snowballs? Christmas Eve without snowballs is incomplete. During the event, the top hundred players who hit other players with snowballs the most will receive a special gift package as a reward.
The top three players in the ranking will receive gift box rewards and a special title.
“Event five”: Building Snowmen High.
“Event details”: After the event ends, based on the snowmen built by players, all players will vote to decide which ten snowmen are the most innovative and they will receive a special gift package reward and a special title.
I hope everyone hasn’t forgotten how to build a snowman.
Remember to pass down this craft.
The inheritance of a race is not just the passing on of life itself, nor is it merely the pretentious cultural inheritance; these fragmented childhood crafts that are not usually highlighted also deserve to be passed on.
“Event six”: Santa Claus’s Gift Bag Giveaway!
“Event details”: During the event, our Santa Claus will make a limited-time appearance, steering his exclusive sled, wandering in the skies above Blue Star, randomly dropping Christmas gift bags to players!
If you suddenly discover a Santa Claus driving a sleigh in front of you, please do not be afraid; that is our Santa Claus.
Warm reminder: Please do not think about killing Santa Claus to snatch all the gift bags. The combat power of Santa Claus is far beyond everyone’s imagination. Please do not take the wrong path.
“Lastly, wishing all players a Merry Christmas Eve and a Happy Christmas Day!!!”
…
The somewhat tedious system upgrade sound echoed in the ears of every player.
“Christmas Eve is here.”
Sitting on the rooftop, Tuberculosis Rabbit, listening to the system sound in his ears, looked a bit dazed. They had been looking forward to the day of Christmas for a very long time, as it meant that they would finally be able to encounter that Santa Claus who had chased them around for a whole day a few months ago.
This grudge had to be settled.
But when Christmas truly arrived, they felt a tinge of melancholy.
It meant that the Novice Period was really about to end. After Christmas, it would be New Year’s, and after the New Year’s, it would be over. What awaited them next was the journey from the first to the ninth scroll.
“Hey Yi, what do you hope lies beyond Ninefold?”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi, who was engrossed in looking over the event details, turned his head with a slight surprise upon hearing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s voice and asked, “What do you mean?”
“Never mind.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head with a complex look and suddenly fell silent. In these past days, perhaps because he had touched upon some trigger, he gradually began to regain a lot of memories and remembered things he and Yi had done in his previous life.
If possible, he hoped that after Tenfold, they could return to the carefree days of the past.
The days he spent with Yi on Blue Star before the leveling game arrived.
Although at that time they had no money or social status, and their greatest pleasure was playing games and reading novels, those days were extremely happy, with no responsibilities and no pressure, life was very comfortable.
When one has no responsibilities, life is at its happiest.
He knew that.
The gods were not yet dead.
To return to that kind of life, to go back to the moments before the leveling game came, they would have to kill all the gods after ascending to Tenfold Planet. Otherwise, a new cycle of Reincarnation would begin, and in this new cycle, he could not accompany Yi any longer.
This was his last time.
And at that moment—
The voice of Sword Without End interrupted Tuberculosis Rabbit’s thoughts.
“Tuberculosis Rabbit, what are you thinking about over there? Haven’t you noticed that this Christmas Eve event and the December rules collide? The core rule of December itself is that players absolutely cannot die, and now there’s an additional few hours of absolute survival on Christmas Eve, which clearly creates a rule conflict.”
“Is Snow Sea Project Team not planning to send someone to fix such a serious bug?”
“Ah?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was stunned for a moment before he came back to his senses and spontaneously replied, “Maybe it just happened to randomly coincide, the Christmas Eve event template was set up long ago, and they didn’t expect that December would also randomly get the ‘Do As One Pleases’ rule, so it turned out like this.”
“I see, I was just worried about a double negative turning positive.”
“That probably won’t happen.”
Sword Without End nodded in understanding, then turned to Yi beside him and spoke, “Yi, I’ve already bought all three of those limited-purchase ‘Apples of Eden’. You guys should hurry up and buy them too.”

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 606 392 Prop Name The Apple of Eden._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 606: Chapter 392: “Prop Name”: The Apple of Eden._3 Chapter 606: Chapter 392: “Prop Name”: The Apple of Eden._3 “Let’s see if I can draw that limited prop, there are only 1000 pieces, once they’re gone, they’re gone, and who knows what it’s good for.”
“Speaking of which, I’m a bit envious of that player who has the S-rank prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’. Having that prop means you can basically ignore the odds in any event, right, getting the best reward every time?”
“That’s just ridiculously overpowered.”
As he spoke, Sword Without End took a bite of an apple in his hand, chewed it a few times, then suddenly paused, and couldn’t help but take another big bite before closing his eyes in a daze, murmuring, “Suddenly, I feel so relaxed.”
Just like what the event announcement said.
After swallowing this apple, you’d get a feeling like never before.
No lies.
That’s what he was feeling now.
This sensation didn’t contain a trace of lust, it felt like your body suddenly became lighter and then you took a deep breath of highly pure oxygen, your head and consciousness felt a bit surreal, and all the everyday worries suddenly disappeared.
It’s like… like being in Eden, carefree.
However, this feeling didn’t last long, and disappeared with the apple that Sword Without End was swallowing into his stomach.
It only lasted for a dozen seconds or so.
“It’s over.”
Sword Without End took a deep breath, looking eagerly at the apple in his hand and swallowing his saliva, his tone slightly hastened as he said, “This thing is kind of addictive, three apples are too few, once they’re gone, they’re gone.”
“Yi, call me if you need anything.”
“I have to go buy apples from other players at a high price. I can hardly imagine how bad I’m going to feel when the event’s over and I can’t get these apples anymore.”
“Do you know, Yi?”
“I haven’t had such a carefree moment in a long time, my body feels lighter.”
Having said that.
Anxious Sword Without End didn’t even wait for a response before he mounted his Three-Foot Qingfeng and disappeared into the sky without looking back, with no clue where he was headed.
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit watched Sword Without End’s disappearing back, feeling somewhat speechless, staring skeptically at the apple before him and hesitating for a moment before taking a bite, then after chewing for a while commented strangely.
“Isn’t it just feeling a bit lighter and the air tasting a bit fresher?”
“There’s no other feeling.”
“Isn’t Sword Without End’s reaction a bit too exaggerated, like he’s had a brain orgasm or something?”
“All that anxiousness, for what?”
It’s not that he’s worried about Sword Without End wasting Points, after all, to say something a bit ugly, with their current Points reserve, they could buy all the apples from Blue Star players without any problem at all.
Of course, if they really did that, their savings would be almost depleted.
They’re not short on Points, so they’re not worried about Sword Without End overpaying to buy apples from other players, causing a waste of Points, and they’re even less worried about his safety; not to mention that this month’s rule means that Blue Star players simply can’t die.
Even without that rule, there aren’t many on Blue Star who can surpass Sword Without End in combat power.
Sword Without End has bought quite a few power-enhancing props from the ‘Star Map’.
Those props, which can only be owned after the Novice Period, are like a dimensional strike to the players on Blue Star, not even on the same level, not even in the same category.
After all, Sword Without End is someone who follows Yi, he is privy to many benefits, and his fame on Blue Star is not low. The players around Yi may not be recognized by all players, but it’s pretty much close.
As Tuberculosis Rabbit pondered absentmindedly, he swallowed all three apples in his hand.
Three thoughts came to mind.
First, the taste was not bad, quite delicious, just not very satiating, a bit like the Air Food Series Props, his stomach felt empty after three apples, just like he hadn’t eaten anything.
This was different from the Air Food Series Props, at least they give some sense of fullness.
This one didn’t even have that, it felt like you hadn’t eaten anything.
Second, quite comfortable, the body feels light, and the mind is also clearer, some of the past worries have been forgotten, it feels great, a bit like undergoing hydrotherapy. It is
Third, he’s pretty unlucky.
Swallowing this apple, there’s a certain chance to get the special prop ‘Apple of Eden’, but now he’s swallowed all three apples, no sound of improvement, sure enough, that’s the luck of a normal player.
And just then—
The alert had already sounded.
‘Ding, the special prop “Apple of Eden” is limited to 1000 pieces, and has been completely distributed. Players who swallow an apple after this will not be able to obtain this prop, please inform other players.’
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked incredulous and instinctively raised his voice, looking at his wristwatch, “The event just started five minutes ago and 1000 props have already been distributed?”
“Isn’t that too fast?”
“I thought we’d have to wait until the event was almost over to distribute all 1000 props.”
Then Tuberculosis Rabbit looked weakly at Chen Yi, “Yi, did you get one?”
Just now, Chen Yi finished his apples at the same time as him.
With his current wealth, he could afford any prop rewarded, anyway, he could buy it all, but this feeling of not winning the lottery, it made him feel a bit downhearted. Could his luck really be that bad?

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 607 392 Prop Name The Apple of Eden._4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 607: Chapter 392: “Prop Name”: The Apple of Eden._4 Chapter 607: Chapter 392: “Prop Name”: The Apple of Eden._4 “No.”
Chen Yi patted his stomach, let out a satisfied belch, and with a hint of regret, he pulled out a cigarette from his pocket and shook his head, “I didn’t get one either, but it’s fine. Later, we’ll have Sword Without End look for some players who did and buy a few to see what effects they have.”
Although those three apples didn’t have a satiating effect,
eating three apples in quick succession can still tire out the mouth, just like getting tired from eating on regular days.
It’s like eating tofu dipped in chili powder; you get tired before you get full.
“That’s true.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly broke into a grin, “Just buy some later, that’s the charm of having wads of cash.”
And at that moment—
Jiaye, sitting off to the side, raised an eyebrow and squinted his eyes like crescents, lifting a red apple in his hand that looked like a mold, his lips slightly curving up, “Are you talking about this?”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi looked at Jiaye with surprise and took the apple from his hand, breaking into a laugh, “You actually got one? There are only 1000 in the whole world, and you got one. You’re pretty lucky, huh?”
“Not bad, looks like you’re my little lucky star.”
And as the effect of the Prop was projected into the air,
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others suddenly started breathing heavily.
「Prop Name」: Apple of Eden.
「Prop Level」: None.
「Prop Effect」: This can force a player into an Illusory Realm, with an extremely high priority as an Absolute Rule, overriding everything, forcing a player into an Illusory Realm.
And this Illusory Realm can be freely crafted by the owner of the Prop.
It lasts for 6 hours.
After 6 hours, the Illusory Realm will automatically break apart.
It’s worth noting that while a player is pulled into the Illusory Realm, the player’s real body will be in an absolutely invincible state, unable to be harmed by any person or any Illusory Realm.
「Prop Restrictions」: (1/1) This Prop is a one-time use item and cannot be repaired or have its uses replenished by any means.
「Prop Introduction」: Long, long ago, on this continent there was a fatal Illusionist, who created Eden, telling people there was a place filled with happiness. Until one day in the future, that lie was shattered.
“This…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes flickered with disbelief, “It’s actually an Absolute Attribute Prop?”
“Are you kidding me? An Absolute Attribute Prop, just casually thrown out there? Set as the prize for some minor event? And they released a thousand of them?”
This was a Prop with Absolute Attributes.
Without exception, a Prop with Absolute Attributes was of absolutely invaluable worth.
Like Yi’s beach chair.
If you lay on it, you’d be absolutely unkillable, or like the wound Yi once had that was bound by the Bone-Eroding Worm, a wound that absolutely could not heal. In the end, Yi had to waste one of his Seed Player opportunities to descend to hell and come back before he could heal that wound.
Otherwise, that wound would never have healed.
That was the allure of an Absolute Attribute.
And now.
A Prop with an Absolute Attribute, tossed out like it was nothing.
“It’s not as exaggerated as you think.”
Jiaye, on the other hand, didn’t look too excited, “Although it’s an Absolute Attribute, it’s only about forcibly pulling a player into an Illusory Realm. Moreover, while the player is in the Illusory Realm, they’re in an absolutely invincible state and can’t be attacked.”
“Basically, it has no effect against enemies.”
“Compared to Yi’s absolutely unkillable beach chair and that wound that absolutely cannot heal, these two Absolute Attributes are not even on the same level.”
“This absolutely familiar prop is much weaker in level.”
“At most, it can be used when facing some effect that simply can’t be avoided; a teammate can use this prop to pull oneself into the Illusory Realm, thereby gaining half an hour of absolute invincibility.”
“The effect of this prop when used on teammates is far greater than when used on enemies.”
“Basically, you can consider this prop as having half an hour of absolute invincibility.”
“Eh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully, “Sis-in-law, you’ve actually given a new perspective; it does seem like it can only be used as a six-hour absolute invincibility. Viewing it this way, it indeed seems much less impressive than Yi’s effect where he can’t be killed as long as he’s lying on the chair.”
“It doesn’t seem that precious anymore.”
“No… ”
Chen Yi slightly squinted his eyes, as if suddenly having an idea, and grinned, “I suddenly have a great idea. What do you think about using this prop to pull that final battle opponent into the Illusory Realm when the decisive battle arrives?”
“Uh… ”
Tuberculosis Rabbit scratched his head in puzzlement, “Even if you pull them into the Illusory Realm, it doesn’t seem to be of any use, right? The player pulled in would be absolutely invincible, and Yi, you wouldn’t be able to kill him during that time either.”
“No.”
Chen Yi shook his head, his eyes gradually sparkling with shrewdness, “I don’t plan to kill him within this half-hour. I’m going to construct a story for him during this half-hour, a live-action VR story.”
“A story where he kills me in the final battle, then wins the ultimate victory and returns with the beauty, and then, on the night of newfound love, the beauty pulls out a knife—how about that?”
“Winning the beauty?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly realized, excitement swirling in his eyes, “I get your plan, Yi. You intend to make the final battle opponent believe he has killed you in the Illusory Realm, and then fabricate some system announcements or such.”
“Make the player think it’s all over.”
“After the decisive battle, the player will finally let down his guard, and then slowly you can have him fall in love with a woman. The most important factor in killing this player is to make him aware of the presence of danger, and then with this woman…”
“Exactly.”
Chen Yi smiled, interrupting Tuberculosis Rabbit, “The basic idea is there, but we still need to plan the details, details that make the Illusory Realm seem more real, as well as a script that can draw the player deeper into it.”
“We can’t kill him in the Illusory Realm.”
“My plan is that, as the woman draws the knife, the Illusory Realm just happens to end.”
“For example, we can design some scenes in the Illusory Realm where the woman likes to draw the knife and play SM with the rival player, then during the duration of the Illusory Realm, we can set up an identical scene around it. The moment the Illusory Realm ends, we can have our person there to seamlessly continue the live-action.”
“A perfect blend of the Illusory Realm and reality.”
“With this set-up, no matter how high their Luck Value is, it would be useless—they’ll have to die.”
Killing a player with maxed-out Luck Value is really difficult.
As long as the player is unaware of the danger, luck will forcibly help them evade all dangers, which leads to the necessity that if they want to kill this final battle opponent, they must first get the opponent to open their eyes to see the danger.
And SM is a perfect entry point for this.
It poses a certain danger, enough to bypass the judgement of Luck Value.
And yet it’s not too dangerous, not enough to make the rival player feel threatened.”
“But…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly hesitated and then spoke, “This prop can only last for six hours, isn’t six hours not enough?”
“Indeed.”
Chen Yi nodded with a smile, “Six hours is indeed not enough, so our next major task is to collect as many ‘Apples of Eden’ from other players’ hands as possible!”

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 608 I saw your tail move
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 608: I saw your tail move! Chapter 608: I saw your tail move! “Skywake”!
A name that had not been mentioned for a long time, many many many years ago, this organization was the strongest player organization on Blue Star.
Well.
It hasn’t been that long actually, just a few months, but these few months have seen such rapid development that this once highly regarded top player group on Blue Star has gradually been forgotten.
It’s not that the strength of this group has decreased, or that they’ve been caught up by others, or that they’ve been destroyed.
The players currently in the “Skywake” Guild are still the cream of the crop on Blue Star.
It’s just… Chen Yi’s popularity was too overwhelming.
It completely overshadowed the existence of this organization.
They were pretty much invisible.
And the president of this guild had been silent in Chen Yi’s contact list for a long time until today, when he finally got in touch again.
“No problem, I’ll arrange for someone to handle it right away.”
Soon.
A reply came from the other side.
Chen Yi looked at the other party’s message and chuckled without saying a word. He had only asked the President of Skywake to help him collect the prop “Eden’s Apple” and also collect the limited-purchase apples, to help Sword Without End gather some.
Although he didn’t understand why the apple, which only made them feel slightly lighter and comfortable without feeling too good when they ate it, seemed to have such a significant effect on Sword Without End, he seemed almost addicted to it.
Gathering stuff, naturally, the more, the merrier.
A long time ago, he had arranged for someone called Chu Ge to work as a vice president at Skywake. He had casually asked about it earlier and everything was developing smoothly without any hiccups.
“Yi, are we going to participate in the remaining events?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit tilted its head to look at Chen Yi, waiting for his response.
“Participate, of course we’re going to participate.”
Chen Yi looked at the event panel with a serious expression and nodded. The remaining events were basically entertainment activities, like throwing snowballs, building snowmen, and there was also a shop where you could buy limited-time gift packs.
They were pretty much standard activities.
But what he was most concerned about was the last thing.
It was that Santa Claus who came out to deliver Christmas presents.
Then, with a meaningful smile, Chen Yi suddenly grinned, “After so many years, I’ve finally waited for him, let’s go, let’s go meet an old friend.”
…
Looking out over the entire Starfield, and even the entire ascension game.
Blue Star is not too big.
It can even be said to be quite small.
Finding a boss on Blue Star that can move at high speed is not an easy task.
Especially since they have no idea where that Santa Claus actually is.
But—
They have an inside man, ah!
Chen Yi and the others all looked at the reindeer that had been restlessly pawing the ground on the rooftop ever since the event started, and they all grinned together.
It was apparent.
The reindeer was overjoyed at the prospect of soon seeing its old master, Santa Claus.
And most importantly, as the beloved little reindeer of the old master, it could sense the scent of his former owner, Santa Claus. With the reindeer leading the way, finding Santa Claus was going to be incredibly easy.
Just as they were preparing to leave—
“Yi!!!”
A loud shout rang out from the sky before they saw Sword Without End riding Three-Foot Qingfeng, shooting across the sky and landing directly on the rooftop, his chest heaving as he spoke anxiously.
“Do you know what I just saw?”
“Do you remember the weird invasion last time?”
“Hmm…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit opened its mouth somewhat confusedly, “I remember, what about it? Wasn’t that the time some messy weird creatures appeared? I remember some of them seemed to have tampered with Yi’s memory.”
“Didn’t we then take most of Blue Star’s players on a trip for seven days after that?”
“When we came back, all those weird creatures had disappeared.”
“We haven’t seen them since then, so why bring it up all of a sudden?”
“That’s exactly it!”
Sword Without End looked anxiously at Yi, “Yi, what’s the new occupation you randomly got this week?”
“New occupation, eh.”
Chen Yi casually glanced at his occupation panel.
‘Occupation Name’: Lone Angler on a Cold River.
‘Occupational Effect’: This occupation ensures that every time you cast your fishing line, you are guaranteed a catch, and you will definitely reap rewards, you will never come back empty-handed!
‘Occupational Restriction’: You must meet the conditions of the fishing hook entering the water, and there must be fish in that water.
This occupation is rather unique.
It can’t enhance any strength and doesn’t even provide any prop rewards.
It is virtually of no help to players’ abilities.
The only effect is that it ensures players will never go fish-less; there’s no need to worry about getting scolded by your wife for going fishing the night before and then coming home empty-handed the next day, only to get scolded even more severely.
“I told you not to go fishing, but you insisted, and you even tried to imitate others by night fishing. So what happened?”
“Every time you come back empty-handed, tell me what you’re good for? Can’t even catch a fish—what’s the use of buying such a good fishing rod?”
“Useless!”
After a long time, many fish-less fishermen had to pass by the market before going home, it was simply too embarrassing.
And this occupation could completely meet that need.
Moreover, in the hands of Chen Yi, it could have a greater effect; he could ignore occupational restrictions to utilize the occupational effect, just as if the occupation could only work when there is water and fish, while he could completely ignore these conditions.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - 609 The 393rd I saw your tail move_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 609: The 393rd: ‘I saw your tail move!’_2 Chapter 609: The 393rd: ‘I saw your tail move!’_2 For instance—
“Look.”
Chen Yi somewhat boastfully pulled out the jade-colored fishing rod he often used from his embrace, casually tossed the hook into the air, and then gave the rod a powerful jerk.
The fishing rod seemed to be drawn by some mysterious force in the air, and in mid-air, a carp roughly the length of a forearm suddenly appeared, lively flipping and thrashing, biting down on the hook and refusing to let go.
And he hadn’t even used any bait.
That was the charm of this occupation.
As long as he wished, he could throw his fishing hook into a latrine pit and still fish out a fish, let alone in the air.
Fishing in a vacuum was no problem either.
With this occupation, one could ensure they wouldn’t starve to death in the wilderness—it was a pretty fun but ultimately useless occupation. He had randomly obtained several such occupations this month, all quite useless but with amusing occupational effects.
Chen Yi seemed to be in a good mood, cheerfully swinging his fishing rod in the air, then tossing the fished-up carp aside to the moose that had been eagerly waiting. All he needed to do was throw the fish into the air, and the moose would automatically leap up and swallow the fish whole.
Not picky at all.
This moose would eat anything except for carrots.
No, that’s not right, it would eat carrots too. He had conducted experiments; the moose would indeed eat carrot-flavored carrots.
But it would not touch the weird tasting carrots received from Santa Claus, like the snail noodle and cold mixed buckwheat noodle flavored snail noodles.
“It’s over.”
After looking at Yi’s shared occupational panel, Sword Without End said helplessly, “That’s it. We’ve all overlooked it. Those bizarre creatures didn’t disappear; instead, they started killing each other when we left Blue Star.”
“Like raising gu, an ultimate gigantic bizarre creature has been reared.”
“This creature almost combines the abilities of all other bizarre creatures. It has been slumbering these days. Just now, when I went to collect apples, I discovered a coastal city had been destroyed, and many players had fallen victim to it. That creature is still resting in the deserted city!!”
“I couldn’t even get close!”
“I could only return from afar to report back!”
“Uh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit hesitated, then asked tentatively, “Did Yi block you? Why didn’t you message Yi, instead of running all the way back here?”
“Nonsense!”
Sword Without End said with some annoyance, “If I messaged Yi, wouldn’t that mean I had to wait there by myself for you guys?”
“You haven’t seen that bizarre creature up close. Its body was as tall as dozens of floors, just a huge meatball, covered with eyes, looking extremely creepy. Having me stay there alone is like asking me to die!”
“I definitely need to be by Yi’s side as soon as possible to feel safe!”
“It’s a big deal.”
Putting off his search for Santa Claus, Chen Yi walked briskly to the sleigh nearby and looked towards Sword Without End, “You lead the way, let’s go take a look.”
…
It was almost dawn.
With the speed of the sleigh, it only took a few minutes to reach the destination, not much slower than teleporting via tp—this was only because Sword Without End had to navigate at a slower pace to avoid overshooting.
Otherwise, if driven at full throttle, they would have arrived in a matter of seconds.
Top speed of dozens of Mach, are you kidding me?
“You just mentioned that quite a few players met with disaster?”
On the sleigh, Tuberculosis Rabbit said with a sense of oddness, “I didn’t react just now, but now I remember, isn’t the rule this month that all players can’t die? That’s an absolute rule, how did those players die?”
“You mean that bizarre creature is able to break the ‘Do As One Pleases’ rule of December and forcibly kill off players in the coastal city?”
“It couldn’t do that.”
Sword Without End shook his head with a complex expression, “But that’s exactly why the situation was a human tragedy. That bizarre creature would swallow people into its belly, which is translucent.”
“You could even see its constantly writhing esophagus and the stomach filled with gastric acid.”
“Do you realize what that means?”
“I watched as innumerable players struggled violently in the esophagus trying to escape, or to break through the esophageal walls, all in vain, as they were invariably pushed into the stomach by the constantly writhing muscles.”
“Then, these players would frantically struggle in the stomach, filled with brownish-yellow stomach acid.”
“They can’t die.”
“But their sense of pain isn’t diminished in the slightest!”
“Those players were like falling into a vat of sulfuric acid, terrifyingly lucid as they felt the agony on their body, not to mention asking for death, they couldn’t even faint from the pain.”
“Under the rules of December, everyone experienced relentless severe pain.”
“But it truly was survival impossible, death elusive!”
“Now, tell me, using the term ‘met with disaster’ for this scenario, do you see any problems?”
Fear lingered in Sword Without End’s eyes, grateful for his quick escape lest he be in the stomach of that creature right now, truly frightening.
“…”
A look of horror flashed in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, his mouth slowly agape, speechless, though he had yet to see it firsthand, he could already imagine the scene, no wonder Sword Without End was so spooked he ran back to seek the protection of Yi.
Not just Sword Without End.
Even Tuberculosis Rabbit would have immediately run back.

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 610 The 393rd I saw your tail move_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 610: The 393rd: ‘I saw your tail move!’_3 Chapter 610: The 393rd: ‘I saw your tail move!’_3 “Turn a bit to the left, then just drive straight ahead and we’ll be there.”
Even while commenting, Sword Without End didn’t forget to give directions.
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, having thought of something else, spoke again, “By the way, what did you mean when you asked Yi what his profession is this month?”
“Are you worried that Yi won’t be able to deal with that monster?”
“Do we really need to rely on the profession?”
“Aren’t you underestimating Yi a bit too much?”
“Not to mention anything else, but have you forgotten Yi’s move that one-shot the world boss? Just a barrage of percentage bullets directly down, who can’t he one-shot? Even Santa Claus with 100% Instant Recovery was taken down by him, right?”
“Do we really need to bother about professions and all that restrictive crap?”
Sword Without End shook his head and explained, “You’ll see for yourself when we get there. That monster has an extremely exaggerated defensive power. A lot of players have organized counterattacks; I even joined the battlefield, but no, we can’t break through its defense at all.”
“Furthermore, this weird boss doesn’t have a health bar like other bosses nor a boss panel.”
“It looks like a boss with unknown outputs from an updated game, not at all like a boss set by the game update. The bosses we’ve fought before all had health bars and boss panels.”
“Even if the defensive power is high, or they regenerate quickly, at least there’s a boss panel, right? But this weird thing has nothing, just…”
“Here we are, take a look for yourselves.”
The next second—
The sleigh braked instantly and stopped in midair.
I must say, the performance of this sleigh is quite good.
To be able to brake instantaneously at such a fast speed and remain perfectly suspended midair without any discomfort is completely against physics. If it were any other vehicle and you slammed the brakes under those conditions…
Most likely, people would fly out through the windshield.
Looking in the direction of Sword Without End’s gaze…
The first thing that caught their eyes was a boundless sea, with the sun slowly rising, painting a particularly beautiful scene. However, in the city along the coastline, many buildings were already sending up billowing smoke.
Large sections of the buildings collapsed.
The air was filled with the smell of gunpowder and the anxious roars of countless players.
And in the center of the city!
A massive monster, taller than many skyscrapers, was slowly moving, leaving nothing but ruins in its wake!
What kind of monster was this!
It was over a hundred meters tall, looking like an oversized slime with skin that appeared sticky as if it had just crawled out of mucus. Its eyes, each about a meter wide, were densely embedded in its skin.
A gigantic meatball.
It looked like a colossal tumor!
And around this monster, there was a huge pink magnetic field. Yes, looking down from high above, one could clearly see a giant pink magnetic field circling this monster, trailing it wherever it went.
All the players enveloped by the magnetic field stood there with stunned expressions, as if they had lost consciousness.
Shortly after, they were crushed to a pulp under its mass.
This monster had no arms or legs, just a huge meatball, propelling itself forward through the undulation of its body.
Being rolled over by such a thing was essentially like being crushed by hundreds of hundred-ton kings, and the monster’s skin was indeed translucent as Sword Without End had mentioned, revealing that its stomach and esophagus were filled with players.
They had even reached its throat.
Perhaps this was why the monster wasn’t eating any more players; it simply couldn’t fit anymore. It would wait for the digestion of the current meal before considering more.
However, under the influence of December’s rules, even though the monster’s stomach acid seemed highly corrosive, it couldn’t do a thing to these players who simply wouldn’t die. If left uninterrupted, this monster might continue like this till the end of December.
“Huh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, initially shocked, suddenly regained clarity in his pupils and spoke with a weird expression, “Since this monster has an esophagus and a stomach, that means it definitely needs to eat, right?”
“It’s already established that the players cannot be digested before the end of December.”
“Now, do you think there’s a possibility that, even if we don’t interfere with this monster, it might just starve to death in a few days?”
“Uh…”
Sword Without End was taken aback for a moment, not quite reacting at first. Theoretically, it seemed possible, but then he quickly recovered, gave Tuberculosis Rabbit a look, and urgently turned to Chen Yi to continue explaining.
“Yi, that pink magnetic field is the range within which this monster’s rules take effect. Before we came here, I talked to a player who escaped from right under the monster’s rear. That player had been crushed into a meat pie by the monster after it was full and then revived after the monster had moved away.”
“He said at that moment, all he could hear was the system notification sound clamoring in his ears, with hundreds of rules engulfing him. Then, he lost consciousness and when he woke up again, the monster was long gone.”
“As long as we don’t enter that pink magnetic field, the rules of this monster can’t affect us.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi didn’t speak but just lowered the sleigh onto a relatively intact skyscraper rooftop, looking towards the monster that was recklessly destroying the city center.

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - 611 The 393rd I saw your tail move_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 611: The 393rd: “I saw your tail move!”_4 Chapter 611: The 393rd: “I saw your tail move!”_4 And from below, one could clearly see.
Many players were organizing a counterattack, and not one showed any fear on their face; evidently, emboldened by the knowledge that they wouldn’t die this month, their courage had grown significantly.
They could only organize ranged attacks.
Melee combatants would lose consciousness if they got too close, making it impossible for them to fight.
However, those ranged attacks seemed to have little effect on this strange creature, like a light drizzle, causing no reaction and no damage.
Chen Yi, with his cane in one hand, stood still, observing for a moment without speaking.
He slowly raised the cane, aiming at the nearby monster. As the cane was lifted, it began to transform rapidly. After a series of high-tech and flashy effects, a sniper rifle, oozing with lethal intent, appeared in his hand.
He raised it level to his shoulder, aiming at the weird creature not far away.
Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle (Ultimate Edition)!
It was the first B-grade prop he had acquired, and it was the most helpful to him in the beginning, contributing greatly to his journey.
The next second—
Septagon Badge (Ultimate Edition) activated!
The effect of the Septagon Badge prop was that, upon activating its special effects, the Septagon Badge would harness the primary firearm prop you had installed and, instead of the original 100 gun muzzles, unleash a devastating assault that lasted 10 seconds on the enemy before you.
And the muzzles created were invisible, undetectable by the enemy.
Immediately afterward.
The air around Chen Yi began to distort faintly, and before the Tuberculosis Rabbit and others could react, they heard the piercing sound of a sonic boom. A hundred bullets, each with a forced percentage damage, shot at the monster at a speed invisible to the naked eye!
“Boom!!”
The moment the bullets hit, a huge cloud of gun smoke suddenly rose!
Each of his bullets carried 3% of the target’s maximum health value in damage. In theory, if all 100 bullets hit, there was not a single person in the world he couldn’t kill, nor any monster he couldn’t kill.
However—
This time, he might be disappointed.
When the gun smoke cleared quickly, the monster’s writhing steps did not stop; it was far from dead, and there weren’t even signs of serious injury, with only faint, temporary marks on its skin that healed quickly.
Absurd.
What was most absurd was that the monster seemed to either not notice or care to investigate the source of the damage. It glanced at Chen Yi but then continued to wriggle on its own, as if it had a destination in mind.
“Not bad,” Tuberculosis Rabbit remarked with a hint of astonishment in their eyes. “This boss’s defense isn’t ordinary at all. Plus, it probably has some sort of prop for immunity rules, or maybe a skill? It’s immune to percentage damage?”
“Could it be one of the rules acquired by swallowing those strange beings, one that just happens to grant immunity to percentage damage?”
“You’re right,” Chen Yi responded.
His eyes glimmered with a faint red light as he calmly transformed the sniper rifle back into a cane and, leaning on it, stood on the rooftop looking towards the monster without speaking.
Long ago, his Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle had been enchanted, and following that enchantment, it gained a new effect.
“Enchantment Special Effects: Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle can be transformed into the cane of Santa Claus at will; while in cane form, Snow Eagle Sniper Rifle loses its firing capabilities, but grants the user the ability to see through one barrier.”
This effect could help him see through some clothes or certain effects of a boss.
However, it had been a long time since he had used this effect; there was rarely a boss that required him to check for effects first. In the Martial World, if you have the power to wipe out the entire martial fraternity with a wave of your hand, you certainly wouldn’t ask your enemies for their names.
And according to the information he saw through this effect, this monster was indeed tricky.
“Boss Name”: God of Fibroids!
“Boss Level”: None.
“Boss Introduction”: This is a creature that should not exist. In an unusual turn of events, countless strange beings began to massacre each other, leaving behind a survivor that merged all of the strangeness. It was during the time this surviving oddity was recuperating from severe injuries in the depths of the sea.
Once again, by a stroke of fate, he burrowed into Blue Star’s tumor.
And merged with it.
He completely lost his sanity, turning into a creature that operated solely on instinct, but his battle strength was significantly increased.
ps: The tumor was self-carved by Blue Star, who intended to send it to the deep sea as usual, for the fish to digest. Blue Star’s tumors had some malignant effects; any creature that devoured the tumor would become extremely ugly, bloodthirsty, and lose its sanity. However, it just so happened to merge with a surviving oddity.
“Boss abilities”
1: …
67: Immune to all percentage-based damage.
78: …
…
Looking at the boss information shared by Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes were filled with disbelief as he inadvertently swallowed hard, his voice rising uncontrollably, “Isn’t this a bit too abstract?”
“Are you telling me that this thing before us used to be a combination of Blue Star’s tumor and a previously surviving oddity?”
“A tumor? And it’s Blue Star’s tumor?”
“Why would Blue Star have a tumor? Is this even reasonable? What is this messed-up stuff?”
“Hmm…”
Sword Without End, however, suddenly saw the light: “I was wondering why this ugly thing looked like a tumor; turns out it really is a tumor. Personally, I think it’s reasonable that Blue Star has a tumor?”
“By the way, Yi, that’s the only boss ability you can see, huh? What about the others?”
“Can’t see them anymore.”
Chen Yi shook his head: “We can only see that this boss has the ability to be immune to percentage-based damage. The rest are unseeable, considering it was an enchantment effect from a while ago, and it’s outdated now.”
“The reason we can see this information is probably because of the experiment I just did.”
Just as Chen Yi and the others were discussing!
The creature not far away suddenly came to a halt, and then its esophagus and stomach began to undulate violently and frantically.
The next second—
Like a shower of blossoms from the heavens!
Countless players who were in the creature’s stomach and esophagus were suddenly spewed into the sky, falling freely all over the city. Each player was covered in slime and stomach acid, looking utterly disgusting.
Clearly, the creature had grown impatient after realizing it couldn’t digest these things no matter how hard it tried.
It gave itself a gastric lavage.
As expected.
After clearing its stomach, the creature began eagerly scooping up players who had intruded into its magnetic field, clearly intending to feast. This time it was certain they were digestible. The previous batch must have been expired for too long and had hardened.
“Bang!”
And under the unwavering gaze of Chen Yi and the others, a player who had been ejected high into the air by the creature, covered in smears, traced a parabola across the sky and landed directly on the rooftop before them.
“Hey…!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the player before them, slathered in smears and lying on the floor, and tentatively asked, “Li Yide? Is that you?”
He couldn’t see the player’s face.
But the fox tail on the player’s butt was quite distinctive, hard to miss, and frankly, all too conspicuous.
“It’s got to be you, Li Yide!”
“I saw your tail move!”
“Weren’t you in Yancheng? How did you suddenly end up here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - 612 394 The Defense of This Boss Is Really
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 612: Chapter 394: The Defense of This Boss Is Really High! Chapter 612: Chapter 394: The Defense of This Boss Is Really High! Li Yide was not at all a stranger to them.
By a twist of fate, they had quite a few interactions with Li Yide.
Moreover, the last time they went to that race outside of the timeline, they even took Li Yide with them, so they had a bit of rapport.
Especially that conspicuous Fox Tail, it was just too easy to recognize.
The identification was indeed too high.
“Tsk…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit crouched down, picked up a small twig from the side, looked at Li Yide lying on the ground, and prodded his Fox Tail with the twig, a touch of emotion in his voice, “It’s clear that you must have endured some inhuman torture.”
At that moment, Li Yide lay on the ground, convulsing violently as if he would take his last breath the next second.
Of course, he was definitely not going to die.
It just looked a bit creepy.
At Chen Yi’s signal, Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a tube of painkillers from his bosom and jabbed it into Li Yide’s buttocks.
“Pzzt!”
Soon after the injection was finished, the previously convulsing Li Yide visibly calmed down, and after a while, he rolled over and sat up, looking up at Chen Yi and others standing to the side.
He was taken aback for a moment before his hoarse voice, somewhat unrecognizable, said, “Yi?”
“How come you’re here?”
Then he remembered what had just happened, felt the faint pain in his buttocks, glanced at the fallen syringe on the ground, and hoarsely said, “Thanks Yi, I feel much better now.”
“Mm…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit rummaged through the backpack for a moment, then excitedly pulled out a Prop from his bosom with a flourish, “Ta-da!!! Outdoor Bath Spray, let’s give you a wash.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit held the sprayer above Li Yide’s head, and soon a large amount of clear spring water gushed out.
…
Five minutes later.
The sticky substance on Li Yide’s body was basically washed away.
And Li Yide’s condition seemed much better, he looked a lot more normal, completely lacking the vacant stupor he had when he had just fallen to the ground.
“Feeling better?”
Seeing Li Yide feeling better, Tuberculosis Rabbit crouched down, lit a cigarette and put it to his lips, looking at Li Yide curiously, “If you’re feeling better, tell us about what it felt like just now, you seemed quite comfortable squirming in that stomach.”
“Like the head-banging youth in nightclubs.”
“…”
A single sentence immediately dragged the recovering Li Yide back to the haunting memories that had just passed, as he looked pale and with bruised lips towards that huge monster not far away and whispered.
“I had a mission to enter a map, and the entrance to that map was in this city, so I came.”
“I didn’t expect that after I arrived, I encountered that monster emerging from the sea and coming ashore.”
“At that time, everyone who saw this scene was excited; the monster looked like a hidden boss, and defeating this boss would surely bring rewards too large to fit in a backpack, right?”
“Besides, with no death this month, hardly any players were afraid!”
“At the moment the monster came ashore, we, the players who received the news first and were the fastest, had already rushed over, aiming to claim the rewards before other players could arrive.”
“However, we had just approached the pink magnetic field around the monster when suddenly we heard numerous promotions in our ears, alerting us that we were affected by dozens of bizarre rules, and then we lost consciousness.”
“When we came to again, we found ourselves in the midst of a fleshy wall, looking through the semi-transparent wall at the vague, illusory city outside, and we realized instantly that we had been swallowed into the monster’s belly.”
“Nearly all players immediately attacked the surrounding esophageal walls, trying to break through the monster’s body to escape!”
“However—”
“It was no use.”
“The defensive strength of the monster’s esophageal wall was shockingly high; no one, including me, could break it, and other players could only be helplessly pushed into the stomach by the movement of the esophageal muscles.”
“I was different; I had a Fox Tail, I had a Flight Prop, and I started flying up through the esophagus, planning to fly out of the monster’s mouth and then make other plans. But at the very upper end of the monster’s esophagus, there was something like a manhole cover.”
“It only opened when eating and was otherwise closed.”
“Extremely hard, utterly indestructible, not that it was hard per se—it felt like a flesh cap that was sticky to the touch, and when pressed with a finger, it felt like pressing waterlogged pork.”
“It didn’t look sturdy, but no matter how much force I exerted, I couldn’t inflict any damage at all on that flesh cap!”
“Then the monster suddenly stuck its tongue out from its mouth down into the esophagus for a poke, for fuck’s sake, how can a creature do that, using its own tongue for an endoscopy?”
“And just like that, I was poked down into the stomach.”
“The monster’s stomach was full of gastric acid, let alone the smell, the acidity was so strong that in an instant my limbs and belly were corroded to the point of seeing bones.”
“That was a pain I had never experienced in my life.”
Saying so, Li Yide, hugging his knees sitting on the ground, couldn’t help shivering, swallowed, then looked again at the monster not far away, his voice hoarse and eyes filled with fear, whispering.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 613 394 The Defense of This Boss Is Really
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 613: Chapter 394: The Defense of This Boss Is Really High!_2 Chapter 613: Chapter 394: The Defense of This Boss Is Really High!_2 “That kind of agonizing pain is unimaginable to you,” I said.
“Generally speaking, when we humans experience sudden severe headaches, our bodies secrete adrenaline to momentarily reduce the pain. If the body judges the pain too unbearable, it would cause us to faint,” I explained.
“It’s a protective mechanism to prevent us from literally dying of pain.”
“However, at that time, the little adrenaline that was secreted was instantly negated, and we felt every bit of the agony clearly; we bore it all without modification.”
“Especially under the rules of December, all players not only couldn’t die, they couldn’t even faint. Passing out from pain was out of the question. In an instant when our bodies were corroded and fell apart, they were instantly restored,” I recalled.
“It didn’t even take a blink of an eye.”
“Immediately after, the newly restored body was once again corroded by high concentrations of stomach acid to the point of decay!”
“All sensations, without missing a beat, reached the brain. I wanted to pass out but couldn’t. By then, many players had already broken down and sought death, because the pain was too much. Many would rather die than endure such extreme pain.”
“Yet, we had no way of dying, not even if we wanted to kill ourselves.”
“I don’t know about the others.”
“At that moment, I felt as if my body had lightened, my mind went blank, and countless waves of excruciating pain crazily assaulted my body and brain, leaving me longing to live yet unable to die,” I said with heaviness.
“In that instant, I experienced the fragility of life.”
“The moment I was swallowed by the monster, I knew it would be tougher than we imagined to beat. Unless Yi himself took action, there was no way this boss would be defeated in a short time here on Blue Star,” I stated.
“And staying in extreme agony for days, I couldn’t die due to the rules, but I was sure I’d end up like a mindless fool.”
When I said that,
Li Yide unconsciously raised his head to look at Tie Chui, who was standing nearby.
“What…what are you looking at me for!”
A wisp of anger rose between Tie Chui’s brows as he bellowed, “I’m…I’m brain-damaged, not stupid!!!”
“Right, I got you, Tie Chui,” I replied hastily.
Li Yide shrank his neck before he continued, “The only regret in my heart when I realized I might become a senseless, walking corpse for the rest of my life was…”
“That I had yet to bring home the woman I love.”
“To take her to my deceased parents’ graves and familiarize her with the way.”
“The person you like?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat up straight, propping her chin with one hand and mused, “Who do you like? I vaguely recall you were a major simp back then, chasing after quite a few.”
“Those were mere mortals.”
Li Yide shook his head solemnly, saying, “I don’t know if you remember the last time we had that strange Another World event, when countless horrors descended on Blue Star, and many female horrors were caught by some organizations in Yancheng, tied up to play Russian Roulette.”
“During that event, a ghost girl just barged into my home.”
“In those three days, she slept with me, watched TV with me, snacked on potato chips while nestled in my arms on the couch, and tried to mimic me as she brushed her teeth. Those three days felt like the happiest and most human I had ever been.”
“I fell for her.”
“It was a realization after much introspection.”
“I’ve hardly spoken about this to anyone; after all, it’s hard for ordinary people to understand my affection for a female ghost. But having gone through this, it made me face my feelings even more. I must find Xiaoqian in the future.”
“And bring her back home through a proper marriage ceremony.”
“To have her call out to my mother at her grave.”
“Uh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said with an odd expression, “You’ve mentioned this before, but are you sure there was real affection between you? The creatures that came with that Another World global event seemed to be without consciousness.”
“She was different.”
Li Yide shook his head with conviction, “I’d seen other female ghosts from that event, and Xiaoqian was completely different. Those ghosts didn’t have their own consciousness, but Xiaoqian had her own emotions. When she watched TV, I could keenly feel what she felt in her heart.”
“She listened intently when I spoke to her.”
“Xiaoqian had her own awareness.”
“Well, blessings to you.”
Sword Without End said with a sincere expression, but he hesitated before adding, “But, are you sure you want to take your Xiaoqian to meet your parents?”
“It’s quite strange.”
“Do your deceased parents know that their son’s wife is a ghost?”
“Though, it does seem fitting.”
“My parents will accept her,” Li Yide slowly straightened up, looking out towards the restless creature nearby, and in a tone tinged with relief from surviving ordeals, said, “I’m just grateful that the monster spit me out. Otherwise, I’m not sure how much longer I could’ve lasted.”
Chen Yi and the others followed Li Yide’s gaze.
The huge monster at that moment had just emptied its stomach of all the players it had recently swallowed, spitting out all the indigestible ‘food’. Clearly, the monster was extremely dissatisfied with not being able to digest its hard-earned prey.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 614 394 The Defense of This Boss Is Really
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 614: Chapter 394: The Defense of This Boss Is Really High!_3 Chapter 614: Chapter 394: The Defense of This Boss Is Really High!_3 By now, it had swallowed yet another batch of players into its stomach.
What made the monster even more irritable was that this batch of players also proved indigestible.
Two consecutive hunts had ended up with inedible food, stretching the monster’s patience to the limit. Its enormous body shook incessantly, cracks spread across the ground, and a collapse seemed imminent at any moment.
“Hmm…”
Suddenly, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned its head to Li Yide with curiosity, “You just said your flesh was corroded to the bone by stomach acid, and then it regrew because of the December rules, right?”
“Yeah, yeah.”
“If that’s the case, then this monster shouldn’t be starving. After all, the chunks of flesh from your body that were dissolved in the stomach acid have already been melted; the flesh regrows and dissolves again, essentially giving the monster an endless supply of food.”
“Turning into a perpetual motion machine, continuously feeding the monster.”
“The reason this monster is so frenzied now could be due to the fact that as soon as it gets a taste of your regrown flesh, it’s yanked back by the game’s mechanics.”
“In that light, it also explains why the boss is so irritated.”
“Anyone would struggle not to lose their temper under such constant provocation.”
…
“Aaagh!!!”
“It hurts, it hurts!!!”
“Kill me, I want to die, just kill me!!”
Finally, with a somewhat irritable toss of its head and an utterly open throat, the small flesh cap was flipped open too. The agonizing, struggling, and screaming voices of the countless players trapped in the monster’s stomach blended together, emerging from its throat.
It sounded extremely unnerving and screechy.
Not even the eighteenth layer of hell could compare.
From just these tormented screams, one could imagine the inhuman torture those players were currently enduring.
This caused the other players, who were still trying to dodge the monster’s path, to each feel a chill creep into their hearts as they imagined the excruciating agony that awaited if they were swallowed.
Especially since the monster’s skin was semi-transparent!
They could clearly see the players struggling in pain within the monster’s stomach.
The ones trapped at the very bottom were not only experiencing the torment of near-drowning and suffocation but also enduring the intense corrosion of highly concentrated stomach acid, all the while countless feet above relentlessly pressed down on them.
They couldn’t see, they couldn’t speak!
There was no hope of escape.
Under such circumstances, the will to survive is alarmingly low. If, at that moment, these players could freely decide their fate, a majority would likely choose death.
Death is indeed fearsome.
But under such intense and hopeless pain, those of weaker will might choose to prematurely end their lives.
…
The second batch of people swallowed had a slightly stronger desire to survive compared to the first.
After all, they had seen the first batch of players being spit out, so they waited with a faint hope that they might be expelled as well. The first batch, however, had no idea what would happen to them next, and not seeing an end to their situation could completely extinguish their will to live.
“What do you think?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood on the rooftop with a complex expression, looking towards the nearby monster, “Yi, shall we make a move?”
Truth be told, this was the most troublesome creature they had encountered yet.
No, to be precise, a boss.
And an unexpected boss at that.
A boss merged with a tumor; otherwise, it wouldn’t be this twisted with such exaggerated defensive power.
“We have to make a move, of course.”
Chen Yi, resting on his cane with one hand, faced the breeze and calmly said while looking at the monster blocking the view of the sea and the rising sun, “If we don’t handle it, nobody else can. We can’t just let this creature run rampant on Blue Star, right?”
Although this claim sounded a bit arrogant.
It was indeed the truth.
If they didn’t intervene, indeed no one could handle this monster.
It should be an unknown-level entity, one which logically shouldn’t appear during the Novice Period.
Currently, due to the December rules, there have been no player deaths, only some damage to the city and some unlucky souls in pain.
But if this drags on until the December rules end.
It won’t just be about pain.
The presumption is that you’d be dead the moment you were swallowed.
Never mind being eaten, just approaching that pink magnetic field is practically a one-way trip to hell.
He had tried it himself. Although there was essentially no damage after activating the Septagon Badge, mainly because the percentage damage was immune, the boss’s skin still suffered a bit.
Of course, it healed quickly.
But it still meant that a defense breach was possible.
And to him, as long as a defense could be breached, no matter how high it is, it’s killable; it’s just a matter of time.
When the number reaches a certain level, it incites a drastic change!
…
“Team leader, team leader, this is bad!!!”
In the Snow Sea project office above Blue Star.
An employee, with a frantic expression raced into the team leader’s office. Barely stabilizing himself, he began to gasp and shout urgently, “An accident has occurred on Blue Star, those weird survivors have fused with a tumor on Blue Star.”

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 615 394 The Defense of This Boss Is Really
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 615: Chapter 394: The Defense of This Boss Is Really High!_4 Chapter 615: Chapter 394: The Defense of This Boss Is Really High!_4 “The crisis level has already far exceeded the capacity of the Novice Period!”
“If it’s not resolved quickly, Blue Star might not hold on!!!”
“…”
Lying on the rocking chair, Jin Buhuan, who was also the leader of the Snow Sea Project Team, leisurely picked up a cup of tea from the office desk and brought it to his lips, taking a light sip before speaking in an unhurried tone, “Are you out of your mind?”
“Our project team is just working for the game’s promotion. We don’t have such high authority. Even if something unknown and unexpected like this happens, how are we supposed to deal with it?”
“We don’t have the authority or the ability to handle it, remember?”
“Besides watching as bystanders, what else can we do?”
“But…”
This employee of the Snow Sea Project Team paused slightly. Although he knew that was indeed the case, he still couldn’t help but say with a touch of unwillingness, “But Leader, Blue Star is the one we have accompanied through so many requirements, the one with the most potential.”
“It’s also the planet that holds the most hope for us to revive our race.”
“Are we just going to give up on it?”
“Give up?”
Jin Buhuan shook his head, slightly exasperated, and stretched his feet onto the office desk while swirling the tea cup in his hand, looking towards the large screen in the office. The screen prominently displayed the enormous monster and Chen Yi standing on the rooftop, prompting a smile from him.
“With Chen Yi there, do we need to worry about this?”
“Sure, this monster has already exceeded the limit that the Novice Period can handle; it’s an unknown emergency.”
“But don’t forget, Blue Star also has an even greater unknown emergency. Given Chen Yi’s current strength, he has long surpassed the limits of the Novice Period. With Chen Yi there, and since he even rushed over immediately…”
“What’s there to worry about?”
“Leave it to Chen Yi.”
“I trust him.”
“With him there, there will be no accidents.”
“Yes, Leader.”
The employee nodded with some trepidation and followed the Leader’s gaze to the large screen. Mainly because the monster was just too powerful, he was also unsure whether Chen Yi could handle it.
“…”
“Achoo!”
On a snowy wasteland where the snow was falling heavily, a Santa Claus driving a sleigh glanced at the wasteland turned white by the heavy snow, and couldn’t help but rub his eyes while murmuring, “I need to get out of here quickly, or I’ll suffer from snow blindness again.”
As an old man who had worked in heavy snow for many years,
Snow blindness was almost an occupational disease.
Others might not believe it if they heard it, but Santa Claus could suffer from snow blindness.
Santa Claus glanced at the gifts slowly piling up behind the sleigh, casually took out a bunch of carrots of various flavors from his pocket, and threw them to the reindeer pulling the sleigh in mid-air, then muttered,
“For some reason, I have a bad feeling.”
“By the way, I seem to have left a little reindeer on this planet, I need to claim it back. I don’t know if it’s still alive. If it’s dead, that would really make me angry.”
“Some people have to die, right?”
“Suddenly, I remember there’s an annoying gamer on this planet who stole my reindeer. Last time I chased them for a whole day and never caught up. They flew pretty fast. I wonder if I’ll be able to see them this time.”
A moment later,
Santa Claus suddenly shook his head and remarked with a sigh, “Hard to say, the difficulty of the game has been increasing lately. It’s been several months; they could have died in some corner by now.”
“Better they didn’t die.”
“If this kid died, wouldn’t my reindeer die along with it?”
“It’s still a young reindeer, it hasn’t yet experienced the wonders of the world. How could it just die like that.”
“…”
Meanwhile, at Chen Yi’s side—
Having made up his mind, the Wife-Killing Buff was activated on the spot without any hesitation.
One of the most advantageous points about the December rules for him was that the Wife-Killing Buff could be activated without any restrictions, essentially with no limits.
Immediately following,
the next second—
“Flowers of the Other Shore Bloom (Ultimate Edition).”
“Buddha’s Fury (Ultimate Edition).”
“Violators Annihilate Nine Clans (Ultimate Edition).”
“Wildfire (Ultimate Edition).”
“…”
Old rules.
All the props and skills in the backpack, every single one, were activated.
Even Violators Annihilate Nine Clans, a skill that was only necessary for group enemies, was activated by him. The birth of this boss had been an accident, and this boss definitely wouldn’t have any offspring—it was just activated in passing.
It was mainly done out of habit.
The moment the Wife-Killing Buff was activated, he subconsciously triggered all of the props and skills he commonly used right away.
Following that.
Meteors ablaze with flames, carrying the momentum to destroy heaven and earth, heavily shrouded the colossal monster!
Countless Buddhas, each wielding a Fire God Gatling, sat cross-legged on Lotus Platforms, all aiming at the boss. As they pulled the triggers in unison, a hail of bullets enveloped the boss, leaving virtually no gaps in the metallic storm.
Not even a mosquito could get through.
Numerous Other Shore Flowers fluttered in the air and landed on the boss.
This was the toughest boss they had encountered, but at the same time, it was the easiest to hit. The boss was over a hundred meters tall, a giant meatball, towering over many buildings, moving at an extremely slow pace, solely relying on its massive body to wriggle.
Without exaggeration,
even if a child were brought in to shoot with an uncalibrated rifle from hundreds of meters away on a tall building, they could still hit the target with virtually every bullet. In such a scenario, the chances of missing were far lower than the chances of hitting.
Very soon—
Bellowing gun smoke engulfed the massive and gigantic creature!
Amidst the continuous explosions, one could faintly hear the monster’s agonized roars, but there was no sign of retaliation, except that the pink halo around it glowed brighter.
It was as if all the boss’s offensive moves were rule-based attacks, and the rules would only take effect when stepping into that pink halo. Outside of the halo, whether in the esophagus or stomach, one was not subject to any rule effects.
When Chen Yi activated his props, he had already minimized the area of effect as close to the monster as possible, trying his best to preserve the integrity of the city to reduce the difficulty of rebuilding the city in the future.
However, most of his props were area-of-effect props.
Still, they more or less affected some nearby buildings and had enveloped quite a few players as well.
This was also inevitable.
Fortunately, it was December, and none of the players would die; otherwise, Chen Yi might have killed more people than the monster. Going out with the intention of saving people, he ended up killing more than the monster did—where could one even begin to argue that?
This boss’s defense was really high!
It could completely immunize even percentage-based damage!
But it wasn’t absolutely invincible!
After relentlessly bombarding the beast for over an hour, the monster finally couldn’t hold on any longer. After letting out one last roar, its body collapsed on the ground, limp as if it suddenly lost its spine or pillar of spirit.
There was a thunderous boom!
Immediately following that, a dense series of system notification sounds rang out in Chen Yi’s ears!
“Ding…”

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 616 395 Finally found it
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 616: Chapter 395: “Finally found it! Chapter 616: Chapter 395: “Finally found it! “Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for killing the unknown level boss ‘God of Fibroids’!”
“Reward: 100,000 Points, random B-level Skill Fragments*5.”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for helping Blue Star to solve a thorny problem, by removing a tumor, you have obtained the special title ‘Miracle Healer’ without a level!”
A cacophony of system notifications rang in Chen Yi’s ears.
Not far away, the giant monster slowly collapsed, crushing countless buildings. Its body fell like a boneless mass with a thunderous crash!
The surrounding players were fleeing in all directions.
The scene was chaotic for a moment.
Chen Yi did not check his rewards immediately but instead controlled his sleigh to jump down from the rooftop with the Tuberculosis Rabbit and others, stopping in front of the monster’s corpse for a close-up view that revealed the terrifying aspects of the creature.
Standing in front of it,
was like standing before a colossal mountain of flesh.
The mucous on the surface of the fleshball was extremely disgusting. Though it was already dead, the skin on its surface was still slowly writhing, somewhat unsettling.
Meanwhile, the players inside the monster’s stomach were still struggling violently.
The monster was indeed dead.
But with the flesh cap in its throat not yet open, they couldn’t crawl out. Moreover, even if the flesh cap in the monster’s throat did open, it was doubtful that many people could get out, given the pain they had suffered for so long. Even if they hadn’t died, their consciousness had been tormented beyond human recognition.
By now, the monster’s body was riddled with wounds, but its stomach and esophagus were still perfectly intact, while its head had been completely blown to smithereens—though no brain matter was seen.
It was unclear whether it didn’t have any or if the brain matter had drained out entirely, mixing with the slime on its body surface.
“First save the people,”
Chen Yi said calmly, leaning on his staff as he glanced at the players violently struggling in the stomach acid.
In fact, he didn’t need to say much.
Other players had already crowded around, working together to open the flesh cap in the monster’s throat. Then, a group of men unafraid of pain went straight down the esophagus and began to carry out each of the players, whose consciousness had already begun to scatter from the pain.
Originally, the flesh cap in the monster’s throat was extremely hard, impossible to open, but after the monster died and lost control, the flesh cap became just a cover, like a lid without mechanical function. Although still heavy, it wasn’t as exaggerated anymore.
With that—
This matter was more or less dealt with.
The aftermath of the last event had been resolved, and they helped Blue Star cut out a tumor by chance.
Speaking of this tumor, Chen Yi looked at the rewards he had just received and couldn’t help but check them one by one.
Firstly, the 100,000 Points were basically useless to him. As someone who had hundreds of billions of Points, would he care about these 100,000 Points?
As for the 5 B-level Skill Fragments, they were somewhat of a consolation.
But the Title seemed interesting; a Title without a level.
He had seen plenty of level-less Props before, but this was his first time encountering a level-less Title.
“Title Name”: Miracle Healer.
“Title Level”: Without level.
“Title Effect”: The player wearing this Title will never and absolutely never run out of spiritual power.
“Title Restriction”: None.
“Title Introduction”: Can be obtained by helping a planet remove a tumor.
“Spiritual power.”
Chen Yi stood still, thoughtfully looking at the title panel without speaking. It was interesting. Although the Title had no level, like the apple from Eden and his beach chair, it was an Absolute Attribute.
Spiritual power would never and absolutely never be exhausted.
Spiritual power wasn’t a stat on a player’s panel nor was it the mana bar for casting spells in some online games; it was something always manifest.
For example, spiritual power never running out means that…
“…”
Chen Yi fell silent for a moment. He wasn’t quite clear on what it meant for spiritual power to never be exhausted—perhaps that he would never feel tired? Or that he would never feel fatigue due to overexertion of spiritual power?
Or what?
He couldn’t figure out what exactly the never-exhausted spiritual power implied at the moment.
But then he took out something like a stone from his pocket.
Zenith Radiance.
He now had quite a lot of it, not only produced by the World Tree but also because he had enough Points to buy Zenith Radiance freely on the Star Map.
He tentatively smashed the Zenith Radiance onto the Title in his hand.
Zenith Radiance could only enhance Props or Titles below S-level, and since this Title was level-less, there was a chance it could be enhanced successfully.
“Ding, enhancement failed, Zenith Radiance cannot enhance level-less Titles or Props.”
“Alright then.”
Chen Yi shrugged helplessly, activated the Title, and wore it above his head. He didn’t dwell on it any further. Although he didn’t know what spiritual power was for the moment, it must be something good. He’d research it slowly later.
If starting today he no longer felt fatigue, that would prove that never-exhausted spiritual power indeed meant he wouldn’t feel tired.
It’s just… not feeling tired.
It didn’t seem like such a good thing.
He liked sleeping quite a bit, and if he didn’t need to sleep, it would feel like missing out on a form of entertainment.
And just then—
“Thank you, Yi!”
“Yi, thanks to you. If it weren’t for you, I might already be dead.”

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 617 395 Finally found it_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 617: Chapter 395: “Finally found it!”_2 Chapter 617: Chapter 395: “Finally found it!”_2 “Without words to convey my immense gratitude, I can only leave it unspoken!”
The players, who had been rescued from the monster’s belly, were nearly all awake and gathered around Chen Yi, bending at the waist to express their thanks.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi glanced at the players surrounding him and waved his hand dismissively, “No big deal, everyone disperse and find a clean place to rest.”
Without lingering any further, he dove into the sleigh with Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others, slowly ascended into the air, and then shot away into the distance.
“Whoosh!”
And just like that, he disappeared against the backdrop of the players.
He hadn’t forgotten that this was but a minor detour, he had important business to attend to that day and couldn’t afford to stay here too long.
…
“La la la la, I am the little artist who sells newspapers.”
“I must have told you I loved you hundreds of years ago, it’s just that you have forgotten…”
In the sky, beneath the veil of night.
Santa Claus sat in his sleigh, casually picked up a parcel from his seat, and tossed it into the city below, his voice filled with drunken bliss as he sang along with the music.
“Can’t see it at all~”
“Didn’t your mom teach you to say sorry when you bump into someone!”
“This was supposed to be a good day…”
He looked incredibly dashing.
The sleigh traveled leisurely through the sky above the dark clouds, leaving not a trace behind, save for the occasional packages that fell, thumping onto the heads of some lucky individuals below.
And the reindeer pulling the sleigh seemed to be quite into the spirit too, their limbs prancing through the void, twisting their bodies as if they were dancing.
…
“Hmm?”
Meanwhile, in the city below.
A player sitting on a couch munching on chips was fully engrossed in the short film playing on his television.
In that film.
The female lead, dressed in a character’s costume from Genshin Impact, knelt on the couch, wiggling her backside, while the male lead brandished a small whip with a villainous grin—the plot was tight, urgent, and brimming with anticipation.
It made one unable to resist looking forward to how the story would unfold.
As the plot progressed, the player’s breath gradually quickened as well.
And then—
“Thump!”
Suddenly, it seemed like something had hit him on the head.
“Hmm?”
The player looked up at his ceiling in a daze, momentarily unsure what could have fallen from there; his ceiling wasn’t broken, and it couldn’t possibly be a light fixture falling down, right? No, that can’t be it, the light in the bedroom was still on.
And if a light had fallen, it certainly wouldn’t have been so light.
His mind raced with thoughts.
Half-dazed, he turned his attention to the object that had fallen onto him and then onto the floor.
“Hey, is that a box wrapped in ribbon?”
The player picked up the box, slightly perplexed and as soon as his fingers touched the box, a panel popped up before him.
“Ding, congratulations, lucky one, you have become the focus of Santa Claus’s attention tonight.”
“You have received the lucky Christmas package that only a select few players could obtain.”
“What are you waiting for?”
“Open this gift box quickly, and welcome your Christmas surprise and good fortune on Christmas Eve!”
“A Christmas package!?”
The player was initially stunned, then suddenly realized what it was and leapt into the air with a shout of excitement, hastening to open the package in his hands. When he heard the system’s voice,
He was beyond excited!
“A B-level Prop!!!”
“Thank God, thank Santa Claus!!!”
…
“It’s about to start, ah… the final battle.”
At a coffee shop on Starfield.
Wen Ping, dressed in a magician’s costume, sat quietly by the window, gazing at the TV screen in the cafe, his thoughts drifting away!
“Awesome!!!”
“Chen Yi is just too awesome!!!”
“With that kind of firepower, who can get close?!”
A succession of exclamations suddenly erupted.
Pulling Wen Ping’s wandering thoughts swiftly back to reality.
The TV was showing Chen Yi slaughtering the Three-Eyed Clan of the Sixfold Planet, a sky full of firepower demonstrating to all the players what it meant for one man to decimate an entire race!
What concentrated, all-encompassing fire power looked like.
“…”
Wen Ping looked at the firepower in the screen and remained silent. It was strong,
But that was about it.
At least it couldn’t kill him.
With the S-level Prop “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” on his side, unless he wanted to die, no one could kill him.
And why would he want to die?
