As for his final battle opponent, a player who possessed the S-level Prop “Longevity as the Southern Mountains,” he didn’t know the strength of this player, which planet they were from, or even their name.
But he knew one thing for sure: he was going to win this time.
Because a few days ago, in that treasure map, he’d covered his last vulnerability.
Now, even if he closed his eyes and plunged into the deepest abyss, he would emerge unscathed.
The final battle.
He was certain to win!
He couldn’t think of anyone who could kill him. He was truly invincible!
And once he obtained the “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” Prop, with two S-level and infinitely growing rule-level Props in hand, he would rise to become the top player in Starfield. By then, even Chen Yi would have to call him “brother.”
However,
Just then—
A girl from the neighboring seat, who had been covertly observing Wen Ping for a long time, hesitated for a moment before finally stepping forward, speaking somewhat uncertainly, “Hello, may I get to know you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 618 395 Finally Found It_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 618: Chapter 395: “Finally Found It!”_3 Chapter 618: Chapter 395: “Finally Found It!”_3 “Heh.”
Wen Ping’s expression showed no significant ripples. He simply drained the last gulp of coffee from his cup, a hint of sneer emerging at the corner of his mouth, and, with considerable politeness, he pushed aside the woman in front of him and walked towards the coffee shop.
“Excuse me, please move aside, you’re blocking my way.”
Before the phenomenon of ascending to the game occurred, he was not without fantasies about women.
He had a woman he loved dearly, a woman from his student days, a woman he had never imagined possessing so completely. Until then, he had been a steadfast bachelor, which was a life principle of his.
But upon seeing that woman, he suddenly realized that the life principle he had clung to for 20 years was utter bullshit.
Not important at all.
It wasn’t even worth a pile of dog shit on the side of the street.
And that woman…
She had hurt him deeply.
He didn’t want to think any more about it, the events were long past, and mulling over them was pointless.
All he remembered was that, when he nervously prepared an expensive gift worth tens of thousands, and visited the woman’s family during the National Day holiday, both he and his gift were thrown out by the aunt.
Under the watchful eyes of many neighbors.
He stood there looking like a clown, staring blankly at the aunt, spitting words with lascivious fervor.
“You think you are worthy of my daughter?”
“Ah? No savings, no house, no car, you can’t even come up with the 300,000 dowry. In this day and age, you still want to find love?”
“No money?”
“I’ll tell you, poor people don’t have love rights, poor people should die, society isn’t for you poor people to carry on!”
“Get lost, if I ever see you with my daughter again, I’ll have someone break your legs!”
At that time, ah, he forgot many things, only remembered feeling utterly disgraced under the scrutiny of so many people, their gazes stabbing into him like knives.
He even forgot to run away.
He could only look imploringly at his girlfriend standing next to the aunt. But the girlfriend who had been quite decent to him in the past now wore a face that was utterly strange to him. Although she said nothing, it was as if she had said everything.
After that, he left.
He left the gift behind and walked away quietly.
Leaving what he thought was a dignified back view.
Each time he thought about it later, he regretted why he left the gift for those cs?
Afterward, he gave up on love, started going on arranged dates, but without exception, every woman asked about the dowry, the car, the house, his job, his savings, in great detail, very meticulously.
Yet none asked him what he liked to eat before ordering,
Or if he had any dietary restrictions.
Or if he was tired lately.
Was what he wanted too much?
Not much, just a bit of concern, and he would be willing to give his heart to the other party. But no, not a single one, no one wanted to listen to his old-woman-like stories.
None.
All anyone was concerned about was his income.
From that time on, he felt despondent towards women. Where in the world was a woman who sought a boyfriend for love?
Not one, all women just cared about money.
Lately, ah, the game of ascending came along, his era arrived, and he gradually began to gain some fame, while those women who had been on arranged dates with him were the first to reach out to him.
Saying they were willing to start over with him.
Even the woman who had chased him out was willing to start over. Back then, the aunt who was ferocious was now smiling at him with a beaming face, pulling her daughter in front of him as if she had completely forgotten what happened before.
Funny.
He just found it funny. He drove all these people away and from then on, he stopped believing in any woman. All the women who got close to him, he saw as trying to get something from him.
Love?
What damn love is there in this world?
Wen Ping left the coffee shop with a stoic expression, distrustful of any woman in his heart, only strength could give him a semblance of security.
…
“I have a premonition.”
On Blue Star, Chen Yi looked at the restless reindeer in front of the sleigh and grinned, “We should be able to meet this old friend very soon.”
By now, the sky had plunged into darkness.
The time was ten in the morning.
But clearly, this place was not the same as Yancheng. Although the time had been synchronized with the last update, the cycle of day and night was not.
Santa Claus could only move in the night.
The reindeer was quite reluctant to meet its former master. If they hadn’t forced the reindeer to come, it would have fled back to its backpack space by now. From this, one could tell how much those carrots of different tastes were a painful memory for the reindeer.
Now, the more restless and anxious the reindeer became, the closer Santa Claus was to them.
“Finally going to meet!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pulled out a cigarette, lit it, put it in his mouth with a vicious smile, “Today, I will show him why flowers are so red!!!”
And at that moment —
Chen Yi’s eyebrows suddenly rose, a flash of surprise in his eyes, “Li Yi has sent a message.”
“What’s up?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was momentarily stunned and said with some disbelief, “It couldn’t be another race coming to provoke us, right? It hasn’t been long since the Three-Eyed Clan was exterminated, do they not remember at all?”
“No.”
Chen Yi shook his head, his eyes revealing a hint of mischief, “Li Yi has sent me detailed information on a player, this player is very likely the one who obtained the prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 619 395 Finally Found It_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 619: Chapter 395: “Finally Found It!”_4 Chapter 619: Chapter 395: “Finally Found It!”_4 “According to Li Yi’s information, the last time this player showed up was at a casino in ‘Seven Carat Star Field,’ where he played a coin-toss game with the owner. He had the casino staff toss a coin six times, and each time, the coin landed on its edge, what they call the ‘wild card face.'”
“This player’s name is Wen Ping.”
“If the seventh coin also landed on its wild card face, then the owner would have to pay Wen Ping 10 million Points.”
“In the end, Wen Ping stopped the casino owner and took a necklace from him.”
“Later, when he was leaving the city, he was robbed by a gang of thugs, and according to them, when Wen Ping saw them, he just closed his eyes, and after that, all their attacks mysteriously failed.”
“Either their knives broke or they suddenly tripped over.”
“In any case, they could only stand there helplessly, watching Wen Ping leave with ease.”
“Moreover, this player isn’t very famous, but he’s not unknown either. He’s known for his luck and supposedly, during every global gift box opening event, this player has always ranked first. Before, he was just a minor figure, but over these past few months, he suddenly rose to prominence through his luck.”
“And these past few months just happen to coincide with the acquisition of the prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea.'”
“When this prop was acquired, the system even notified me.”
“With so much information, we can almost be 100 percent certain that Wen Ping is the owner of the ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ S-class prop, the player who will battle me on December 28th.”
“Ah?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was visibly shocked, standing still for a long while before recovering, not expecting they’d actually find information on this player before the duel. Excitedly, he exclaimed, “Then what are we waiting for!”
“Let’s rush to ‘Seven Carat Star Field’ and take him down!”
“Take out the opposition before the final battle!!!”
“There’s no need for that.”
Chen Yi shook his head, rejecting the idea: “First of all, it’s not good for us to go out. Every trip outside requires the Snow Sea Project Team to expend an authorization. It was after Jin Buhuan talked to me that I realized how costly a single trip could be.”
“Besides, if I kill the opponent before the final battle, what about the rewards I’m supposed to get?”
“If I kill the opponent on the day of the final battle, I can obtain his S-class prop, and these two S-class props will even form a set, yielding the ultimate set effects. If I kill the opponent before the final battle day, there are too many uncertainties.”
“Who knows if the ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ S-class prop will drop?”
“It’s too much trouble.”
“It’s not worth the risk.”
“Most importantly…”
Chen Yi looked at the messages Li Yi sent him and couldn’t help but grin: “Li Yi sent me a lot of messages. Wen Ping’s entire history isn’t hidden; even things from before the arrival of the main game update have been dug up.”
“Wen Ping has suffered a lot emotionally.”
“Before the main game update, he didn’t have much money, and he had a poor job. In the dating market, he was humiliated by numerous matchmaking dates.”
“From then on, he lost all trust in women.”
“This information is important, it means we can completely use ‘The Apple of Eden’ to create an absolutely exclusive and unique scenario for Wen Ping, for example, how about crafting him a pure love romance?”
“Kill him amid the things he longs for the most.”
“It’s quite a romantic way to die, isn’t it?”
This was the death plan he had chosen for Wen Ping after the event started.
Before that, he didn’t have many good methods, although he had a few, he wasn’t too confident about their success rate. However, with this method, if he hadn’t gotten this information, he would give himself a 60 percent chance of success.
And now—
He had at least a ninety percent certainty of success!
He could play Wen Ping to death right here.
And he wasn’t worried at all about Wen Ping seeing through the illusion or finding a way to come out of the hallucination, after all, his Illusory Realm had Absolute Attribute, not just anyone could escape from here.
“Who’s to say otherwise,”
With a reflective look, Sword Without End spoke, “From the messages sent by Li Yi, I’ve already figured out Wen Ping’s character—hurt by countless women, he doesn’t believe in true love in this world.”
“But deep down, he still yearns for a real love.”
“With such intense longing, Wen Ping must be incredibly conflicted inside.”
“At this time, in the Illusory Realm, creating a purely loving woman who is wholeheartedly in love with Wen Ping, to be honest, it’s hard to resist. Anyway, if it were me, I wouldn’t be able to withstand it.”
“Killing someone like this feels a bit too venomous.”
Indeed, it was a bit too venomous.
It targeted the heart first, then took the life.
“Heh.”
At this moment, Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly as he looked towards the end of his gaze and suddenly chuckled, “Let’s talk about this later. An old acquaintance is here; let’s go greet them first.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others followed Chen Yi’s gaze and saw, at the end of Yi’s line of sight, a giant Christmas sleigh many times larger than theirs, slowly approaching them in the night.
In front of that sleigh, there were nearly a hundred reindeer, looking like a whole herd.
Where the sleigh passed, it left behind a colorful trail.
In the front section of the sleigh, there sat a Santa Claus, twisting his body with a face full of ecstasy.
“Heh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was slightly stunned before cracking a smile, “Finally found it, huh!”
And just then—
The Santa Claus sitting in the giant sleigh seemed to have spotted them as well. The sleigh suddenly sped up, came right in front of them, and then they saw Santa Claus stand up furiously, pointing at Chen Yi’s nose and cursing.
“Kid, I remember you, you stole my reindeer!”
“Damn it, I chased you for a whole day last time and couldn’t catch you, just now I was wondering if you were dead!”
“Unexpectedly, I run into you here, indeed, it’s a small world after all, this is really ‘You don’t walk the path to Heaven but you…’ Hell… Hell…”
Santa Claus hadn’t finished speaking.
When his body suddenly stiffened in place.
All around, unbeknownst when, there appeared thousands of figures, each with a Fire God Gatling in hand, sitting on a Lotus Platform in a meditative posture—Buddhas, staring at him intently, ready to pull the trigger at any moment.
And that familiar player had a staff in his hands that gave off an extremely strong scent of danger.
Percentage?
But even a percentage-based damage couldn’t make him afraid; after all, he could instantly recover to a full hundred percent of health, completely ignoring any percentage-based weapons. But!

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 620 396 Just feels like it might be a bit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 620: Chapter 396: “Just feels like it might be a bit cruel. Chapter 620: Chapter 396: “Just feels like it might be a bit cruel. Snow blanketed everything.
On the Wasteland.
Under the night sky.
Chen Yi and his companions stood on the ground, facing a somewhat restrained Santa Claus.
Santa Claus was taller than them.
But at this moment, he seemed a mere child, standing there awkwardly, his face showing a faint embarrassment as his gaze flitted around. It’s no wonder he felt this way—it was indeed a case of a small world.
But it couldn’t really be called a small world.
He just never expected that the player he had tried to kill a few months ago not only survived but had become incredibly powerful.
Originally he was quite confident in his ability to recover 100% of his health instantly, but when this player revealed his prop panel, Santa knew he had met his nemesis. Forget about a 100% health recovery, even 800% health recovery speed was useless.
If you’re going to be taken out with a single shot, no matter how fast your health recovers, it’s meaningless.
However, he still felt a slight sense of relief.
If this player chose to reveal the panel instead of simply activating the prop to finish him, it indicated there was still room for negotiations—that it wasn’t a situation where he must die today.
“Have a seat and drink something,” Chen Yi said.
He pulled out a small stool from his embrace, sat down on the snow-covered plain, glanced at the stars above, then took out a few bottles of liquor to place on the stove, along with some snacks like peanuts and braised beef.
After gesturing for Santa Claus to sit down,
Chen Yi spoke nonchalantly, “It’s been a while. I didn’t expect you’d remember me.”
“Uh…”
After hesitating for a long time, Santa Claus replied with an embarrassed tone, “Well, I’ve always had a good memory since childhood.”
Jiaye and the others were also seated by now.
The massive sleigh belonging to Santa Claus remained still on the ground, and in front of the sleigh was a group of nearly a hundred sleighs standing quietly, occasionally pawing the ground with their forehooves, appearing utterly lazy.
The slightly smaller sleigh that Chen Yi and his group had, which had become very long after modifications, also rested on the ground. At this moment, their little reindeer seemed quite excited, running around among the herd, sniffing here and there as if to express the joy of reunion after several days.
And those reindeer would lower their heads to smell the scent on the little reindeer as it passed.
It seemed like a harmonious scene.
But only Santa Claus knew that the next second might bring the start of a battle.
“You came after me by crossing the timeline back then, didn’t you?”
After a pause, Chen Yi lifted his head to look at the Santa Claus before him, a curious smile twinkling in his eyes, “Is crossing timelines an easy ability for you?”
“How do you do it?”
“And from the looks of it, you seem less like a boss and more like someone with your own thoughts.”
“Uh…”
Santa Claus suddenly lost his reserve and seemed hesitant to speak. After scanning his surroundings, he carefully chose his words before saying, “I know what you want to ask.”
“There are many things I can’t say much about, can’t say at all, or can’t explain.”
“I can only roughly say some things.”
“In the upgrade game, only one type of person can cross timelines.”
“That is—”
“The dead.”
“Simply put, only those who have already died can cross back to a past timeline. Crossing timelines is an ability that shouldn’t exist; only those who are already dead can utilize it, and I am someone who has long since passed.”
“It’s impossible for any normal person to have the ability to cross back to a past timeline.”
“Including the ability to modify timelines granted after a planet advances to Sixfold Planet, it’s just a name and not an actual modification of timelines.”
“To be precise, it should be referred to as retrospective and precognitive.”
“After a planet’s successful promotion to Sixfold Planet, players can give their right eye one of two effects: retrospective or precognitive. If retrospective is chosen, looking at the world will show different images in each pupil.”
“The left eye still sees the normal world.”
“But the right eye sees the world as it was three seconds ago.”
“Retrospective time can be extended through the use of Points. If extended up to 24 hours, then upon seeing any unfamiliar player, one can see their actions from 24 hours prior in the right eye.”
“This isn’t truly traveling to a past timeline but rather seeing a past timeline, and even then, it’s not a complete view of the past timeline but one anchored to a specific player or object.”
“…”
Chen Yi’s eyes narrowed slightly, staring intently at Santa Claus before him. The latter looked extremely serious, not like he was lying. But while others might believe him, Chen Yi would not.
After all, he had actually traveled to a past timeline, and not only had he gone—Tuberculosis Rabbit Jiaye and Li Yide, among others, all traveled with him.
Indeed, the White Phoenix Clan.
The White Phoenix Clan was a hidden race from a timeline three months prior, and he had been there. Even more, he had experienced a one-night stand there.
“Is that so?”
Chen Yi did not call out the lie directly but instead casually asked, “I wonder if you have heard of a race called the White Phoenix Clan. I have been a guest of that race.”
“The White Phoenix Clan?”
After pondering for a long time, Santa Claus shook his head, “I haven’t heard of it, not at all. There are too many races in the upgrade game. Unless it’s a well-known race, it’s impossible for me to remember all of them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 621 396 Just feels like it might be a bit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 621: Chapter 396: “Just feels like it might be a bit cruel.”_2 Chapter 621: Chapter 396: “Just feels like it might be a bit cruel.”_2 “Old man!”
At this moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but sneer, pulling a knife from his bosom and plunging it into the snowy ground as he said coldly with sinister eyes, “Are you playing with us? If you haven’t heard then let me give you a full picture.”
“The White Phoenix Clan is a race hidden in the timeline three months ago.”
“And Yi took us to this race.”
“This race lives on the timeline three months prior.”
“You said that living people can’t go, right? Then how do the White Phoenix Clan players live on the timeline three months back? And how did we manage to go?”
“Ah?”
Santa Claus’s eyes flashed with confusion and he frowned incredulously, “That’s impossible, it’s simply not possible for any players to be living on a timeline three months previous. That’s just impossible.”
“Only the dead can do that, wait…”
Fear and revelation suddenly flashed through Santa Claus’s eyes as he said with a slight tremble in his voice, “You’re not talking about the Exorcist Clan, are you?”
“Damn!”
“That race is all dead, from the queen down to the citizens, all of them are deceased.”
“Not a single one is alive.”
“Of course, they can exist on the timeline three months before. Didn’t I just say that only the dead can travel through timelines? This race has existed for a very long time in the ‘Promotion Game’.”
“It’s an extremely special race!”
“There are many complex beings in the ‘Promotion Game’, such as neutral bosses like myself, and some, like the ‘Exorcist Clan’, who lurk in the timelines of the past, too afraid to show themselves. Of course, most have gone to the depths of hell to work as cleaners.”
“The dead?”
Chen Yi looked dazed. The entire White Phoenix Clan was made up of dead people? But wait, the body of the queen of the White Phoenix Clan didn’t seem icy cold, nor were there any maggots or the like.
“Mhm.”
Santa Claus nodded emphatically, “I’ve never heard of the White Phoenix Clan, but if you’re talking about the Exorcist Clan, I do know something. It’s a race that has been cursed, all of its members are dead, yet they can still reproduce, which means they’re dead but can still bear children.”
“They are forever imprisoned on the timeline three months prior, essentially a permanent cage.”
“They’ve found you?”
“Indeed, it’s about time they found you.”
Santa Claus took a deep breath, after a pause he continued softly, “Being novice players who could encounter the Exorcist Clan, which you refer to as the White Phoenix Clan, your channels for accessing information are a bit more extensive than I thought.”
“I just did a quick check, and you’ve actually killed a Ninefold player, Jiang Chenglu.”
“That’s beyond comprehension.”
“In this case, perhaps I can give you a bit more information.”
“One thing is for sure, the Tenfold Planet is the final destination to leave the ‘Promotion Game,’ and the essence of the ‘Promotion Game’ is essentially to develop beings capable of contending with the Gods and Demons.”
“The ‘Promotion Game’ is an organization composed of multiple powers.”
“In fact, the ‘Promotion Game’ hasn’t been around for too long, but its predecessor has been in existence for quite some time. The ‘Promotion Game’ has the ability to make a certain group of people stronger, but choosing who deserves to be empowered, thus the ‘Promotion Game’ was created to serve as a filter.”
“After ascending to the Tenfold Planet, it’s the final battle!”
“If you win this battle, everyone will return to that tranquil and peaceful life they once had, of course, apart from the unfortunate White Phoenix Clan. If they want to escape the curse, there’s only one way—by having a child with a living person.”
“And this living person can’t just be anyone; it must be someone who has made a significant contribution in the final battle.”
“Otherwise, even if the ‘Promotion Game’ ends, they won’t be able to break free from the curse.”
“Thinking this way, you can probably understand why the White Phoenix Clan would go to such trouble to find you. After all, allowing a few players in their Novice Period to travel to their imprisoned clan is honestly not a low-cost affair.”
“…”
“…”
Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, and the others didn’t speak immediately, digesting the information from Santa Claus’s words and trying to discern the truth of his statements.
“Do you know Jiang Chenglu?”
Chen Yi was the first to speak.
“Of course, I know him. After all, he’s the first player daring enough to rise to the Tenfold Planet. In the ears of many NPCs like us, his name is resounding.”
“Of course, he doesn’t know me, though.”
“Daring enough?”
Chen Yi’s eyebrows knitted slightly, keenly picking up on this key word in Santa Claus’s statement.
“Yes.”
Santa Claus exhaled deeply and nodded, “Advancing from the Onefold Planet to the Ninefold, one could say the difficulty doubles with each ascent, especially from the Eightfold Planet to the Ninefold, the difficulty multiplies.”
“But to ascend from the Ninefold to the Tenfold Planet there’s no difficulty at all, not even as much as from the Onefold to the Twofold Planet—a very simple task that can be completed quite casually.”
“Hm?”
Chen Yi questioned, “If, as you say, it’s so simple to ascend from the Ninefold to the Tenfold Planet, why then, for so long, has only Jiang Chenglu’s planet advanced to the Tenfold Planet?”
“Of course, it’s because the other planets don’t dare.”
“All the leaders of the Ninefold understand one thing very clearly, that is, once they ascend to the Tenfold Planet, they have to leave the ‘Promotion Game’ and face the final battle, a battle that’s a matter of life and death.”

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 622 396 Just feels like it might be a bit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 622: Chapter 396: “Just feels like it might be a bit cruel.”_3 Chapter 622: Chapter 396: “Just feels like it might be a bit cruel.”_3 “Unlike in the game of ascension where you can still go to hell upon death, or even if you fall into the depths of hell, you can use your identity as a Seed Player to climb back out again,”
“there, when you die, it’s truly the end.”
“Thus, over the years, not a single leader from the Ninefold Planet dared to ascend first to the Tenfold Planet. Jiang Chenglu was the first, which is why the game of ascension offered so many rewards on the day of his ascension—it’s all to encourage others to hasten their own ascensions.”
“But clearly, these leaders from the Ninefold Planets are much more timid than the game of ascension had anticipated. So many days have passed, and still, only the Mo Clan led by Jiang Chenglu has taken that step.”
“Dare not…”
Chen Yi’s eyes widened in shock, and his mouth slowly fell open.
This was the first time he had heard such a claim.
So, the reason the Ninefold Planets hadn’t ascended to the Tenfold was not because they couldn’t or didn’t have the ability, but simply because they didn’t dare?
Jiang Chenglu…
From his brief interaction with Jiang Chenglu, Chen Yi could tell that the man indeed had the courage.
“No, that’s not right.”
Chen Yi quickly came to his senses, “After Jiang Chenglu’s ascension, some players from the Ninefold Planets sent people to ask me about the methods to ascend to the Tenfold.”
“Tsk.”
Santa Claus couldn’t help but laugh: “Those must be either the higher-ups making a show of it, or the underlings acting without knowledge. How to ascend to the Tenfold Planet is something no one understands better than those higher-ups.”
“It doesn’t even take much effort.”
“Just a click of confirmation is all it takes.”
“How is Jiang Chenglu faring now, out there?” Tuberculosis Rabbit broke the silence by asking a question that concerned everyone.
“Um…”
After some hesitation, Santa Claus finally spoke, “I’m really not supposed to say this, but the situation doesn’t look too good. If no new Tenfold Planets emerge to fill the ranks, Jiang Chenglu and his people will likely be wiped out soon.”
As these words hung in the air,
Chen Yi and the others fell into a complex silence, no one speaking.
“That being the case,”
Chen Yi paused before speaking again, “then why did Jiang Chenglu make a point of coming to see me before he left, only to deliberately die at my hand? I thought he was trying to complete some kind of mission.”
“I’m not sure about that.”
Santa Claus shook his head, “To be honest, I don’t understand much myself. As I said at the start, I’m just a dead man, having died a long time ago, even before the game of ascension began.”
“I’m merely a lingering soul, barely holding on and making my final contribution.”
“If the game of ascension had ended successfully before my death, I might have had a chance at reincarnation.”
“But if during the execution of my tasks, I happen to be killed by a player who has suddenly become powerful, then I will completely dissipate in this universe.”
As he said this,
Santa Claus looked towards Chen Yi with a somewhat resentful gaze; clearly, he was suggesting that the player who had become suddenly powerful was none other than Chen Yi himself.
…
…
More than an hour passed.
Chen Yi stood up and parted ways with Santa Claus: “I still have use for the moose, so I won’t be returning it to you just yet.”
“It’s all right.”
Santa Claus looked sentimentally at the little moose nuzzling his right hand, “This moose has always been a loner. I even gave it a name a long time ago, but it’s been so long, I’ve forgotten what it was.”
“All the moose love my carrots.”
“Except him.”
“He’d rather eat other moose’s droppings than my carrots.”
“Without this little moose, I have to spend a lot of time every day clearing up the other moose’s excrement. To tell you the truth, it’s indeed inconvenient, but since we’re friends, I certainly wouldn’t take what brings you joy. I’m giving the moose to you.”
“Take good care of him.”
“This little guy is quite sentient.”
“Oh, by the way,”
Chen Yi suddenly remembered something and spoke up, “You said earlier that only the dead can travel back through the Timeline. If this moose came with you, is it alive or dead?”
“Of course, it’s dead,”
Santa Claus nodded as if it were obvious, “It died a long time ago, way before the game of ascension arrived. Back then, I had already begun preparing for my role as Santa Claus, but as I had no moose, I had to capture them from all over the universe.”
“First, I prepared some moose carcasses.”
“Then I captured some souls from the universe and stuffed them in. If I remember correctly, the former identity of this little moose seemed to be a Star Space Giant Crocodile.”
“It’s strange, do Star Space Giant Crocodiles have a habit of eating dung?”
With that,
Santa Claus sat on his sleigh and waved to Chen Yi and the others, “We’ll meet again if fate allows, I’ve got to deliver presents, that’s my duty. Maybe if the game of ascension ends successfully one day, I can be reborn and start a new romance.”
“Ah, it’s been so long since I’ve been in love.”
“I’ve almost forgotten the taste of persimmons.”
“I’m envious of sweet, tender, fragrant love like yours.”
“I’m off!”
With that,
Santa Claus didn’t linger but disappeared from everyone’s sight.
…
After Santa Claus left, Chen Yi and the others reflected on the conversation they had just had.
After a long while,
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke up with a strange expression, “It feels like we heard a lot, but after summing it all up, it seems like there wasn’t much at all.”

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 623 396 Just feels like it might be a bit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 623: Chapter 396: “Just feels like it might be a bit cruel.”_4 Chapter 623: Chapter 396: “Just feels like it might be a bit cruel.”_4 “So, it’s basically super simple to get promoted to a Tenfold Planet, Jiang Chenglu’s clan is nearly extinct, and the entire White Phoenix Clan is like the living dead?”
“What a mess of nonsense.”
“…”
Chen Yi’s eyes flickered with an indescribable hue. After a moment of silence, he shook his head, tidied up the things in front of him, and then sat down on his sled: “Let’s head back.”
…
The following days flew by quickly.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End, when idle, would go downstairs to have snowball fights or build snowmen.
They had a blast.
It wasn’t for the sake of participating in activities to win some rewards, but rather they were simply enjoying the game. Even Chen Yi and Jiaye were having a great time. The two were squatting in the middle of the community square, seriously rolling their snowballs.
It must be said.
Group activities are infectious.
For instance, if a person stood under a park tree, jumping on the spot trying to touch the leaves above, they’d definitely be considered to have a screw loose by passersby.
But if a bunch of people, say seven or eight guys, kept jumping under the park tree, passersby often would internally sigh at the charm of youth and even feel the urge to jump themselves.
Even if they were too self-conscious to join in, they’d wait until they reached a secluded spot to glance around, make sure nobody was watching, and hurriedly take a jump.
It’s not about grabbing the leaves overhead.
It’s about trying to touch that sense of youth once more.
Every father will use the excuse of playing with their child to rightfully and openly play those childhood games once again.
It’s an unspoken secret among all men.
And just like that.
This Christmas Day event passed by quickly amidst the joyful atmosphere.
Chen Yi and his friends didn’t win any prizes from the snowball throwing or snowman building activities. They no longer had a use for those rewards, preferring instead to let other players have them, enhancing the overall strength of Blue Star’s players.
But these few days.
They collected quite a few apples, about 300,000 in total.
Without any markup.
After all, once the “Apples of Eden” prop had been completely extracted, the apples were left with just the effect of making one feel comfortable for a while. Sword Without End had easily collected 300,000 of them for a little extra effort.
That was more than enough for him to eat for a long time.
If calculated at one a day, it would last him about 800 years or so.
If nothing unexpected happened, Sword Without End was unlikely to live that long.
The time quickly approached the evening of December 27th. Once midnight passed, it would be time for the decisive battle.
“Does it really feel that good?”
Seeing Sword Without End looking as if he was high on drugs, Tuberculosis Rabbit skeptically picked up an apple and bit a large chunk, chewing it thoughtfully and saying with surprise, “It just makes my body feel a bit lighter and my breathing a bit smoother, that’s all.”
“Why do you look like you’re on drugs when you eat it?”
“Not sure.”
Sword Without End lay in a rocking chair, indulging and savoring another apple as he chewed slowly: “I don’t know why, but every time I eat this apple, it gives me a very relaxed feeling, like I’m truly in the Garden of Eden, with nothing to worry about.”
“Especially after a meal.”
“Hits the spot.”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit swept a slightly speechless glance at Sword Without End and then stopped talking, instead turning to ask Chen Yi: “Yi, we only collected just over 500 of that prop, is that enough?”
‘Apples of Eden.’
This Christmas Day event was limited to 1,000 props.
With the ability to forcefully pull people into an illusory realm and possessing an Absolute Attribute, there are only a little over a thousand globally, and they had collected more than five hundred, for this they even used several global broadcasts.
The whereabouts of the remaining ones are unknown.
After all, not every player is willing to sell this prop, or they plan to use it themselves, or they intend to sell it at a higher price in the future.
In short, they could no longer collect any more.
“It’s enough, even more than enough.”
Chen Yi lay on the beach chair and said with a smile, “Theoretically, for a man who’s been hurt in love, it only takes 72 hours to become so intoxicated that he can’t extricate himself.”
“And one ‘Apple of Eden’ can forcefully pull someone into the illusory realm for six hours.”
“We have collected 520.”
“Together that’s 3120 hours, which is 130 days; it’s completely sufficient.”
“And we don’t even need that much time.”
Chen Yi shook his head somewhat helplessly, “We can’t possibly spend 130 days on this ultimate showdown, can we? By then, the Novice Period would be over. The Novice Period ends in late March next year, which by all accounts is just over 90 days.”
“A dozen days or so is the estimated time.”
“That should be about enough.”
“How is the script polishing going?”
“No problem at all!!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up seriously and said, “In these three days, we’ve gathered 13 novelists from Blue Star, 3 psychology professors, 4 criminal psychology experts, 2 emotional counseling psychologists, and 7 scriptwriters. We also interviewed several players who have been hurt by love, pinpointed their emotional weaknesses, and meticulously planned and designed many intense episodes.”
“We wrote a perfect script.”
“Without exaggeration,”
“this script is almost the pinnacle of Blue Star’s culture, and any man enveloped by this script can only end up willingly dying for the other person.”
“No exceptions.”
“Not to mention that Wen Ping.”
“It is indeed so.”
Sitting nearby, Jiaye said with a radiant smile, “I’ve read the script too. It’s incredibly heart-wrenching and is akin to an act of heart assassination. Any man who steps into this trap has to die.”
“It just feels a bit too cruel.”
Yi had killed many people, and he had eradicated clans too numerous to count.
But she had never felt cruelty, only that those people had brought it upon themselves.
But this script, this time, she thought it was somewhat cruel.
It really was an assault on the heart.
“It does seem like it…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said somewhat sheepishly, scratching his head, “Those people below said that in order to prevent this player from realizing he is in an illusory realm, they added some other elements.”
“They can ensure that even if the player discovers he is in an illusory realm, he will willingly end his own life for the woman in the realm.”
“I didn’t quite understand the specifics; maybe you could take another look, Yi.”
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi took the script passed by Tuberculosis Rabbit and read through it carefully. After a quick review, he chuckled, “This time it’s been supplemented quite a bit; not bad at all.”
He had read the script several times before, and this was the final revised version.
“It is a bit cruel, but this ultimate showdown is a matter of life and death. Any measure, no matter how cruel, is not excessive.”
He hadn’t planned to write the script himself; instead, he provided an idea and let the others run with it.
After all, it’s better to leave professional matters to the professionals.
These people knew better than he did how to assassinate the heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 624 397 End of Act One
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 624: Chapter 397: “End of Act One! Chapter 624: Chapter 397: “End of Act One! Chen Yi scanned the script in his hand once more and, after confirming there were no issues, he set it aside and poured himself a glass of ice-cold beer to toast with Tuberculosis Rabbit and a few others in the snowy weather.
Snow and ice-cold beer were a good match.
At least for him, they were quite nice.
The time that followed slowly passed as the group chatted.
Soon—
The clock struck midnight.
The moment it turned to the wee hours of December 28!
A notification sound rang out beside Chen Yi’s ear.
“Ding, special decisive battle task initiated!”
“Player Chen Yi, the sole possessor of the unique S-grade prop ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ in the entire Star System, and player Wen Ping, who holds the unique S-grade prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,’ will officially begin their battle of fate!”
“The victor will obtain the defeated player’s unique S-grade prop from the entire Star System.”
“And the Set Effects of the prop will be activated.”
“There are no time restrictions for the decisive battle; it will officially end when one of the players dies.”
“PS: During the battle, players will be in an invincible state and cannot be killed by any rules or other players, only by their designated nemesis.”
“PS2: Considering player Chen Yi was the first to acquire ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains,’ the dueling location will be Blue Star. Player Wen Ping, please prepare for teleportation.”
“PS3: If the battle has not concluded after 30 days, neither player will receive any rewards on any maps, nor will they be able to use Points for trading in the Prop Shop, the Star Map Platform, or with other players until the duel ends.”
“PS4: During this decisive battle, if a player is killed by the opposing player, they will not fall into hell, or trigger the rights of their seed identity, but will directly die.”
“One minute left until the battle commences. Please both players, prepare yourselves!”
Under the night sky.
Another sharp notification sound rang in Chen Yi’s ear.
And upon seeing the battle panel that Chen Yi had shared, Sword Without End thoughtfully pondered, “That’s rather thoughtful, if the battle isn’t resolved within 30 days, almost all privileges afforded to players will be restricted.”
“They won’t be able to obtain rewards on the maps, nor will they be able to buy items in the shop, and they can’t even trade with other players.”
“It’s basically like being stripped of all the player’s rights.”
He had noticed that particular PS the moment he saw the panel.
During the battle period, both players could only die by the other’s hand and not by any other player or rule. His first thought on seeing this was that if the two players agreed not to fight and to make peace.
Then that would essentially make them both invincible.
Immortal.
But clearly, the game developers had given this more thought than they did.
“Good luck.”
Jiaye leaned forward, tapped Chen Yi’s forehead with his, and earnestly said.
“Mm.”
Chen Yi took a deep breath. He pulled out a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and put it in his mouth to ease his tense nerves.
Yes, he was nervous.
If it were a matter of life-or-death combat, or a showdown of brute force, he wouldn’t feel the slightest bit of nervousness.
But the challenge was that he had to construct an Illusory Realm for Wen Ping based on his own imagination, and the biggest difference between reality and illusion is that reality has no flaws, whereas it’s impossible for an illusion to be detailed in every area—there are always loopholes.
For instance—
The particles on an asphalt road, the froth in the coffee at a roadside café, the catkins fluttering from the trees.
Etcetera.
All of these details require him to exhaust spiritual power to construct bit by bit.
“Wait a minute?”
Chen Yi suddenly paused, spiritual power? It seemed he had just thought of something; he looked towards the Title panel he had acquired not long ago.
‘Title Name’: Miracle Healer.
‘Title Level’: No level.
‘Title Effect’: The player wearing this Title will have spiritual power that shall never and absolutely never be exhausted.
‘Title Restriction’: None.
‘Title Introduction’: Awarded for helping excise a tumor from a certain planet.
A player who obtained this Title would have an inexhaustible supply of spiritual power; he was initially unclear about what this spiritual power meant, but now he understood, he knew.
With newfound confidence.
Chen Yi took another deep breath, exhaled a puff of smoke, flicked away the cigarette butt into the snow, and made all the necessary preparations. Now, all that was left was to wait for Wen Ping’s arrival.
This would be the most challenging enemy he faced since his debut.
Not because the enemy was mighty, but because the enemy was truly hard to kill.
And now the most important issue was—
They did not know where Wen Ping would descend, unable to pull him into the Illusory Realm immediately.
Before this, they also didn’t know that the duel would take place on Blue Star.
He had assumed it would be in a white space or inside some map.
But this problem was also easily solved.
Chen Yi quickly noticed a continuously flickering Greenpoint on the battle panel, representing his location. When the map was enlarged countless times, a continuously flickering red dot could be seen on a remote Starfield outside of the Blue Star Star System.
That is to say, during this decisive battle, the locations of both parties will be shared in real-time on the map.
In that case, there would be no worries.
Next, all he had to do was wait.
…
Meanwhile.
Atop a high-rise building on a certain Starfield, Wen Ping stood on the edge of the rooftop, gazing indifferently at the notification panel that had popped up before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 625 397 End of Act One_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 625: Chapter 397: “End of Act One!”_2 Chapter 625: Chapter 397: “End of Act One!”_2 “Ding, special final battle task initiated!”
“Possessing the Entire Star System’s unique S…”
“The final battle has started, huh.”
Wen Ping fell silent for a long time before letting out a light sigh, he hadn’t expected the final battle’s target to be the recently famous Chen Yi, he had watched plenty of Chen Yi’s videos, the other’s terrifying and suffocating area of effect attack ability, which almost stripped one of the will to resist.
It was terrifying to duel with such a person.
But he soon recovered.
Shaking his head, he reassured himself a bit.
Even if this Chen Yi was extremely powerful, he, with his blessing of Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea, was in an unbeatable position, he just had to wait for Chen Yi’s state to completely end, and then he could start his own counterattack.
Then—
He glanced at the mission panel where the teleportation countdown was about to end.
He took a slow step forward.
His whole body then plummeted towards the ground from high altitude as if in freefall.
In mid-air, Wen Ping took out the necklace from his chest and kissed it lightly: “Bless me.”
The next second.
Just before hitting the ground, Wen Ping’s body suddenly disappeared into thin air, already teleported to Blue Star.
…
“He’s appeared!”
Seated on a sled, Chen Yi, who had been staring intently at the live positions of both parties on the final battle panel, immediately launched the sled towards the target location upon seeing the flashing red dot appear on Blue Star!
Without the slightest delay!
The distance wasn’t too far, around several tens of kilometers.
He arrived within seconds.
Chen Yi brought the sled to a sharp halt in mid-air, didn’t even say another word, jumped down from the sky with a large saber in hand, and down on the ground below stood a man clad in sportswear with his eyes tightly closed.
‘Eden’s Apple’ activated!
He didn’t waste any words.
The fewer things Wen Ping saw in this world, the more he would trust the Illusory Realm he would later construct, and the less he would doubt it.
“Whew!”
As the Prop successfully activated and he saw a flash of white light over Wen Ping,
Chen Yi also landed on the ground, his legs piercing deep into a pit, his eyes shut tight as he started rapidly constructing the Illusory Realm that belonged to him and Wen Ping in his mind.
Wen Ping was already pulled into the Illusory Realm.
But now the real battle was just about to begin!
…
From Wen Ping’s perspective, as soon as the teleportation started, he had already cut off all senses, standing in place with eyes tightly closed, silent without uttering a word.
He knew nothing.
He even severed the touch of his skin.
He had no perception of the outside world.
In the Illusory Realm, Chen Yi was energetically activating numerous Props, unleashing a barrage of attacks on Wen Ping, but just as he had guessed at the start, even within the Illusory Realm, his attacks were unable to inflict the slightest damage on Wen Ping.
This was different from that weird creature he had killed on Christmas Day.
That creature only had frightful defensive power.
Wen Ping was all about rules-based defensive power, his main feature being absolute immortality.
As long as Wen Ping couldn’t see danger and couldn’t feel a threat, his absolute luck would shield him from all harm.
Wen Ping didn’t know whether Chen Yi had already found him, whether the attack had commenced, but he guessed that with Chen Yi’s speed it wouldn’t be too slow, and had prepared to stay completely still for three days.
Within these three days, he would wear down Chen Yi’s patience first.
When Chen Yi realized he couldn’t kill him no matter what, he must be filled with despair, and at that moment, it would be easy for Wen Ping to launch his attack and effortlessly win the final battle.
…
Soon.
Several days had already passed.
The time had moved from midnight on December 28 to four in the afternoon on December 31.
A good three to four days had gone by just like that.
And during these three to four days, Wen Ping and Chen Yi had been standing face to face about ten meters apart, eyes closed, standing still at their respective places.
Wen Ping’s complexion still looked alright.
But Chen Yi’s complexion didn’t look too good; his lips were a bit dry.
“Ah, darn it.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit felt somewhat regretful as he put away his Ultimate Edition Air Food series statues into his backpack: “It seems there’s a big drawback to my stuff, if players close their eyes, it can’t trigger the effect.”
His hundred-meter statue could instantaneously fill a player’s stomach just by looking at it.
He had intended to use this Prop to replenish some energy for Yi, but it seemed now to be a bit difficult.
“Speaking of which, they have stood here for days and nights, can their bodies take it?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked sympathetically towards Yi’s back, although this month’s rule was absolute immortality, and during the final battle, Chen Yi was certainly not going to die from anything other than at the hands of Wen Ping, but that was just about not dying.
The discomfort of the body was not a bit less.
Standing there for days and nights, not to mention anything else, the body was definitely suffering, and…he hadn’t taken a bathroom break, can he really hold it in?
“Should be okay.”
Sword Without End hesitated a bit before speaking: “Yi probably activated some Prop before the duel began that could take care of these physiological needs, I just thought that once Yi constructed the Illusory Realm, everything would be fine.”
“I didn’t expect it would have to continue constructing.”
“That sure is labor-intensive.”
“Not a simple task.”
“In a few more hours, the New Year will arrive, and I wonder if there’ll be any New Year’s Eve global event or something, but January’s new rule is definitely going to be updated.”

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - 626 397 End of Act One_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 626: Chapter 397: “End of Act One!”_3 Chapter 626: Chapter 397: “End of Act One!”_3 …
Tuberculosis Rabbit, Sword Without End, and the others were having a great time chatting outside.
Meanwhile, in the Illusory Realm, a new turning point was about to be reached.
Inside the Illusory Realm.
Wen Ping, who had held his position without making a move for several days, finally opened his eyes. The first scene he saw upon opening his eyes was Chen Yi, hunched over and gasping for air with his head down right in front of him.
At that moment, Chen Yi didn’t even realize Wen Ping had opened his eyes.
He simply seemed exhausted, continuously lowering his head and gasping for air while propping on his knees.
“Heh.”
A hint of disdain flashed in Wen Ping’s eyes as he silently pulled a card from his embrace, instantly activated it while looking at Chen Yi in front of him!
The next second—
The card shot out at an untraceable speed, striking Chen Yi straight in the neck.
“You… you…”
Chen Yi, unable to react in time, clutched his nearly severed neck, bubbles of blood forming in his mouth as he staggered on the spot, lifting his sniper rifle to aim at Wen Ping, prepared to pull the trigger in a final act of desperation.
“Hmm?”
Wen Ping did not resist; instead, he expressed surprise, “You can still move?”
“This card of mine is an S-grade Prop, which ignores defense and can instantly deal damage equal to 100% of the opponent’s hit points, a one-time use Prop. How can you still move?”
This Prop was one of his greatest sources of confidence.
Chen Yi had a high amount of hit points.
He knew that.
After all, Chen Yi owned an item like Longevity as the Southern Mountains, a unique item in the Entire Star System with unlimited growth potential. But he also had a one-time use Prop that could instantly deal damage ignoring hit points, attacking directly with 100% damage based on hit points.
A perfect counter.
But in his eyes, Chen Yi should have died from that attack; how could he still move?
As Wen Ping finished speaking.
The body of Chen Yi in front of him suddenly stiffened, a hint of unwillingness flashing in his eyes, then his pupils rapidly dilated as he slowly collapsed into a pool of blood, evidently dead beyond doubt.
…
Chen Yi, watching the scene from a god’s perspective, couldn’t help but wipe the cold sweat from his forehead.
That was a close call.
This was the biggest drawback of this Illusory Realm; he had absolutely no idea about the offensiveness of the other party’s Props. For instance, regarding the card that was thrown, he thought that dying so easily might seem a bit too fake.
After all, he had quite a reputation; dying so effortlessly would make people suspicious.
So he prepared his Tang Family’s performance principle.
He decided to first perform a scene of being severely injured but not dead, ready to retaliate at the brink of death. This also fit his identity — after all, being hard to kill was normal for the most hyped player of the latest game version, right?
It seemed reasonable, right?
But unexpectedly, the Prop that his opponent threw out could actually Instant Kill him. His not dying would have indeed seemed suspicious, so he arranged for the downstage Chen Yi’s fake death at the earliest moment.
After completing all this.
He didn’t delay any longer but hurriedly continued to construct the environment, starting to craft the system hints.
…
“Dead?”
Wen Ping narrowed his eyes slightly, looking at Chen Yi’s body lying in a pool of blood not far away. He pulled out another new Prop from his embrace, a hint of suspicion in his brows. He took this decisive battle very seriously and had prepared many Props.
He hadn’t expected that Chen Yi, who had been in the limelight since the game’s update, would be so easily killed by a single card of his.
And at that moment—
A system notification sounded in his ear.
「Ding, congratulations on killing player Chen Yi, obtaining the final victory in this decisive battle!」
「Congratulations on acquiring the unique item of the Entire Star System, ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains.’」
「And congratulations on unlocking the Set Effects, which will officially unlock in 30 days.」
「You will be transported back to your original Starfield in 10 seconds.」
As he heard the system voice in his ear, Wen Ping finally set aside the doubts in his heart, and he breathed a sigh of relief. It seems the past few days had exhausted all of Chen Yi’s strength and tricks, allowing him to seize an opportunity and deliver a lethal blow.
However…
Why would the Set Effects unlock only after 30 days?
So long?
Why did it seem as if the precise effects of this Set hadn’t been decided yet?
However, just as he was preoccupied with these thoughts, awaiting the teleportation.
A system notification suddenly sounded in his ear once again.
「Ding, a bug has occurred in the Starfield Shuttle System of the game upgrade; emergency repairs are in progress. Please wait patiently. Teleportation is currently unavailable, estimated waiting time is 48 hours.」
“Hmm?”
Wen Ping, opening his eyes again, glanced around at the wasteland that had been bombed into craters everywhere, his brows furrowing slightly. After pondering for a while, he still headed towards the nearest city indicated on the map.
Although he didn’t know why the Starfield Shuttle could have issues.
If he couldn’t go back,
He might as well take a tour of this planet, experience its local customs and culture; that wouldn’t be a problem.
After all, this was a Novice Planet, and apart from Chen Yi, no one could threaten him, a player from the Fivefold Planet, and Chen Yi was already dead. He was virtually invincible on this planet.
If there weren’t rules that bound him,
He could even slaughter this much weaker planet.
The game upgrade imposed many restrictions on slaughter, including when Blue Star was first invaded by a race called the God Race. The God Race didn’t dare to massacre the players of Blue Star extensively because the game upgrade limited them, requiring a significant cost.
But Chen Yi had wiped out entire races without receiving any notifications. The reason was simple.

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - 627 397 End of Act One_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 627: Chapter 397: “End of Act One!”_4 Chapter 627: Chapter 397: “End of Act One!”_4 The game protects the weak.
And every race Chen Yi slaughtered was many times more advanced than Blue Star, naturally, there were no restrictions.
…
From God’s perspective, Chen Yi watched as Wen Ping walked towards the nearest city just as he had scripted, and he couldn’t help but let out a long sigh, feeling deeply exhausted.
Damn it.
He had never thought constructing an Illusory Realm was such a task.
Yes, constructing an environment was theoretically simple; he just needed to imagine a city and there would be a city there.
But then what?
He had to perfect every detail of the city, even down to the broken circuits on billboards, and the kt boards that had been blown into the sewers, all of these details needed perfecting one by one.
If it wasn’t for his talent where his spiritual power would never be exhausted.
He would be dead by now.
Dead from exhaustion.
Dead from a brain short-circuit caused by the depletion of his spiritual power.
Like in this Illusory Realm, only a part was properly constructed; everywhere else was void, after all, he couldn’t possibly construct an entire Blue Star in the Illusory Realm, that was not something a human could do.
Even if his spiritual power wouldn’t run out, it was still impossible, as it required a great deal of time.
That is to say, if Wen Ping suddenly got a wild idea to start a vehicle and drove straight in one direction, he would discover that apart from the world around him, everything else was void.
His disguise would instantly be seen through.
Luckily, Wen Ping didn’t show any signs of doing that yet.
While designing the system’s notification panel just now, he thought for a long time and still hadn’t come up with a good Set Effect, partly because he was worried that the Set Effects he designed might not meet Wen Ping’s expectations, leading to some discrepancies.
On the other hand, he was worried, what if Wen Ping wanted to try out his Set Effects?
That would just create more work for himself, wouldn’t it?
As for why he let Wen Ping stay on Blue Star in the Illusory Realm rather than returning to his own Starfield.
The reason was simple.
He was not familiar with Wen Ping’s Starfield at all, and constructing that world would definitely be full of holes, but Blue Star was different. This was his home field where even if there were some flaws, Wen Ping would probably subconsciously ignore them.
After all, cultural differences are quite normal for an Alien Race.
…
“Is this a city on Blue Star?”
Wen Ping stood at an abandoned bus stop, looking around at the players coming and going, curiously observing that the players on Blue Star looked no different from him.
And at that moment—
A notification sound once again rang in his ear.
「Ding, all your Props, Titles, Skills, are temporarily sealed.」
「Since your strength has far exceeded the Novice Planet Blue Star’s power limit, some difficulties in starfield transportation are detected. After the transportation is completed, all Props, Titles, Skills, will be unsealed.」
“Huh?”
Wen Ping looked at the panel that popped up before him, his face wrinkling slightly with displeasure, but it didn’t bother him too much; in the past, whether he was finishing a task or leaving a map, the teleportation had always been smooth.
Why were there so many troubles this time?
But he didn’t have time to think about it now, several days of continuous lack of food and sleep made him feel very sleepy and famished.
He walked into the city on foot.
The scenery gradually became more bustling, the clean and tidy streets, the large screen advertisements on the office buildings, the systematic traffic lights, and the busy traffic.
Wen Ping looked around in slight surprise, not expecting Blue Star to recover its past prosperity so quickly during the Novice Period. His planet was like the end of days when they were in the Newbie Village, not to mention these skyscrapers.
The streets were filled with rotting bodies that no one had cleared away.
No scene like the current one existed before.
From the restaurants lining the streets, wafts of delicious aromas drifted out.
After picking a restaurant at random, he ordered their signature dish.
“Tomato and Egg Noodles.”
A simple bowl.
12 Points.
Thankfully, even though Props were restricted, Points could still be used normally; there was no worry about being unable to pay the bill.
“Delicious…”
Wen Ping, upon tasting his first bite, stood there stunned. Afterwards, without any interaction with the owner who came over to greet him, he wolfed down the bowl of noodles in front of him and then turned to leave.
He didn’t eat his fill.
It had been a long time since his last meal, and eating too much would make it uncomfortable to sleep later.
Besides this noodle shop, he glanced around and picked a hotel that seemed decent enough to check in, settling into room 418.
Upon stepping into room 418.
Wen Ping stripped off all his clothes, took a cold shower, then lay down on the soft double bed and slowly drifted off to sleep.
He quickly fell into a dream.
And started to snore softly.
…
“Cut!”
“End of Act One!”
Watching all this from a god perspective, Chen Yi finally let out a long sigh of relief once he saw Wen Ping had entered dreamland!
Not bad, up until now, everything had been going according to his plan.
Moreover, he had even added quite a bit of acting for himself.
For instance, in the noodle shop earlier, he had the owner ask Wen Ping how it tasted. Although he didn’t get a reply from Wen Ping, it was enough. It at least let Wen Ping know that the people in this city all had their own thoughts and didn’t appear like some artificial intelligence goofballs.
Next, it was time to enter the most crucial phase!
Dream planting!
Chen Yi took a deep breath, waited patiently for more than two hours, and then relentlessly began constructing a dreamscape for Wen Ping, which had a simple content: playing the roles of Wen Ping’s mother and relatives, urging Wen Ping to quickly find a girlfriend to show them.
This is commonly known as marriage pressure!
According to their information, Wen Ping was a rather filial person!
And the best way to exert influence over a filial person was marriage pressure!
…
At the same time.
Wen Ping, deep asleep in room 418, began to twitch his eyelids irregularly as if he was dreaming about something half the time, making his sleep uneasy.
Just like that.
After sleeping for more than 10 hours.
Wen Ping slowly opened his eyes, sat up on the bed, and stared blankly into the pitch-black room for a while before finally lighting up a cigarette and putting it to his lips, “Damn it, why do I feel like I’ve been dreaming all night.”
This sleep was truly uncomfortable.
Like being in prison.
He dreamt that his mother was pressuring him to get married quickly and to have a chubby little son for her, to grow sensible day by day, and to stop breaking his parents’ hearts.
“…”
After some time, Wen Ping, who had finally recovered, washed up hastily, dressed, and walked out of the room, ready to go downstairs to find something to eat.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - 628 398 Add the January rule One Step Ahead
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 628: Chapter 398: Add the January rule “One Step Ahead”. Chapter 628: Chapter 398: Add the January rule “One Step Ahead”. And at this moment,
Chen Yi, who viewed everything from a God-like perspective and controlled all that occurred within the Illusory Realm, frowned as he looked at the script in his hands. Why was the matchmaking club named Tu’er?
Wasn’t that name a bit too casual?
He hadn’t paid attention to these details when he had reviewed the script.
He just listened to what the experts said, that the matchmaking club’s name needed to be particularly conspicuous, the kind you would remember after hearing just once.
After pondering it for a long while, he nodded his head.
That was the rationale, yes.
…
Meanwhile, within the Illusory Realm,
Wen Ping didn’t do much that day. He just wandered around the streets a few times, taking in the culture of this planet. Not bad, but it was probably due to his Novice Period; the pressure was a bit too much.
He had a conversation with a Blue Star player. These Blue Star players didn’t realize he was not from this planet.
Only, this player seemed a bit dim-witted.
After exchanging a few words with this player, Wen Ping only then realized it seemed like the player’s muddled thoughts were due to the overwhelming difficulty of the Novice Period.
There were no other issues.
Wen Ping wandered around aimlessly for a day, casually eating something in the hotel lobby at dusk, then returned to the hotel once again, ready to sleep.
He now really wanted to return to his own Starfield.
The news of Chen Yi’s death at his hands hadn’t spread yet. Many people were unaware, and he wanted to quickly go back and spread the news. After that, his renown as Wen Ping would skyrocket as he rose up, stepping on the reputation Chen Yi had accumulated during that time.
But the system notified him that the Starfield Shuttle was still temporarily unusable, there was still a bug being repaired.
He didn’t know when it was going to be fixed.
What happened to the estimated time of 24 hours? Not accurate at all.
As the listless Wen Ping lay on the hotel bed looking at the TV in the room, he suddenly thought of something and subconsciously glanced at his chat channel. He had been missing for several days; how was it that no one sent him a message?
“Eh?”
Wen Ping looked at his chat channel panel with a slight frown and did not speak. His chat channel panel had been covered with a thick mosaic by the system, indicating it was temporarily unavailable.
Although he was somewhat puzzled, he didn’t think too much about it and just continued to watch the television, killing time.
…
“Insane, completely insane,”
“This is literally killing me!”
At this time, Chen Yi, who looked upon everything from a God-like perspective, was nearly at the brink of mental collapse. Wen Ping walked around, and he had to project his consciousness wherever Wen Ping went, ensuring not to reveal any flaws, especially when Wen Ping was about to speak with a player. He managed to focus his consciousness on that player immediately.
Yet even so, there were several close calls.
Everything in this Illusory Realm was his creation, meaning the players in this city within the Illusory Realm had no consciousness of their own; they could only act according to some basic rules he had set.
For more detailed actions, he had to project his own consciousness.
The Illusory Realm was primarily constructed based on his thoughts, and secondarily assisted by Wen Ping’s subconscious.
For instance, he had no idea what props were in Wen Ping’s backpack. How was he to guess what Wen Ping would throw away? And how was he to construct the information about the props in Wen Ping’s backpack? All these details formed according to Wen Ping’s subconscious.
That included the chat channel.
One main reason he also blocked the chat channel was that, in case Wen Ping sent a message to a friend, should he reply or not?
If he didn’t reply, it would be very strange and might arouse suspicion.
And if he did reply,
What should he say?
He had no idea what to respond with; it was simpler and more convenient to just shut down the chat channel.
So, that day passed by without arranging a date for Wen Ping. Boiling the frog slowly was the strategy; too fast, and the flavor wouldn’t develop properly, increasing the chance of failure.
…
The groggy Wen Ping, who had fallen asleep, had another dream that night.
In his dream,
his deceased parents constantly urged him to go on dates quickly, or else he would be unfilial, an incredible disgrace, and they would rest uneasy in their graves, warning him not to regard them as his parents if he refused to go on dates.
For a full 8 hours.
To up the dosage,
Chen Yi had arranged a full 8 hours of non-repeating marriage-promoting scenarios for Wen Ping that night.
As a result, when the groggy Wen Ping woke up with incredibly exaggerated dark circles under his eyes, his expression baffled as he stood in front of the mirror looking at his haggard self. It had been a long time since he had seen himself this disheveled.
Especially after acquiring the S-grade prop “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,” this was the first time he looked this haggard.
It seemed that even with maxed Luck Points, the pressure from his parents to get married couldn’t be avoided.
He felt as if he hadn’t slept at all last night, more like he had worked through the night. Far from his fatigue being relieved, he felt even more tired and weary.
He rarely dreamed before, and he didn’t understand why he had such frequent dreams these nights, and they were all of such long duration.
And bizarrely, the content of the dreams was consistent—his dead parents appearing in dreams urging him to marry.
Could it be…
that his mother beneath the Nine Springs truly wished for him to go on dates?
Wen Ping stood in front of the mirror, let out a sigh, and casually lit a cigarette, placing it to his lips, “If I needed a woman, why would I need to go on dates.”
“Mom,”
“Times have changed.”
Now, he was no longer the obscure Wen Ping of the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 629 398 Introduce the January Rule One Step
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 629: Chapter 398: Introduce the January Rule “One Step Ahead”. _2 Chapter 629: Chapter 398: Introduce the January Rule “One Step Ahead”. _2 In the marriage and dating market, he was the lowest of the low, where anyone passing by could spit on him twice.
But now, he possessed several S-rank Props, including two unique and infinitely growing S-rank Props in the Entire Star System, “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” and “Longevity as the Southern Mountains”. Moreover, he had just killed Chen Yi, the biggest name around these days.
Given his current situation,
Did he need to go on blind dates?
All he had to do was to let out a word, and countless women would rush to his side without a second thought.
And they would all be high quality, too. Those of lower quality didn’t even have the guts to come near him, how could he be lacking in women?
What a joke.
But perhaps because he had the same dream for two nights, Wen Ping hesitated for a moment. Maybe his deceased mother wasn’t aware of these things, and she was just worried about him being lonely, hoping he would find a companion.
What was wrong with that?
His mother was just missing him, after all.
Caught up in his thoughts, Wen Ping hastily washed up before continuing his aimless stroll on the streets below, just like yesterday.
“Good morning, sir.”
As Wen Ping stood at the traffic light intersection, unsure of which direction to head next, a voice sounded by his ear. He turned his head instinctively and saw a man in a suit looking at him with a sycophantic smile.
“I’m the Matchmaker from ‘Tu’er’ Blind Date Club. What do you think, sir? Are you in need of a date recently?”
“…”
Wen Ping, slightly speechless, withdrew his gaze, deciding not to bother with this salesman, and resolved that if the other party dared say one more word, he would lead him to a small alley and slaughter him. He had checked the day before; the official power in this city was not strong.
The hidden chaos here was ignored by all.
Even if his Props and such were blocked, killing a Novice Planet player would still be no issue.
These kinds of street salesmen were what he loathed the most in life.
Blind dates, no less.
What Novice Planet would be in the mood to develop a business like matchmaking?
Matchmaking? That only exists in situations where the numbers of men and women are balanced, or where there are more women than men. Since the ascent game arrived, the mortality rate among women, due to physical strength, has been far higher than that of men.
In such a situation where the numbers are completely unequal, how could matchmaking even exist?
Where would the women have the space to choose and select?
Or rather,
In a situation where the law has collapsed, how would these men, who hold power, opt to select their partners through matchmaking? He recalled that on their planet, it was all about wanton looting; if they captured several women, they would have several women.
When social order collapses, women almost instantaneously become a currency.
A possession to be seized at will.
Though it might sound impolite to say so, that was the reality. For instance, no era of extreme chaos and looting had matchmaking; it simply didn’t make sense.
However, he could understand.
It didn’t take long for Wen Ping to convince himself. With Chen Yi around, even though Chen Yi’s strength was no match for his, he was still far ahead as a leader on Blue Star. With such a leader, the players on this planet indeed lived a comparably comfortable life.
He could also understand.
In this case, the emergence of matchmaking didn’t seem that strange after all. From the towering skyscrapers of this city, it was evident that the society on this Star System hadn’t completely fallen apart yet. Consequently, women had not degraded into currency and still maintained some liberty in the marriage market.
But perhaps, it was the dream of his mother for two consecutive nights.
Or maybe it was the fact that the direction he intended to go was at a red light.
A multitude of reasons compelled Wen Ping to stop the foot he had lifted and leisurely accept a flyer from the young man next to him, asking nonchalantly, “How much does it cost?”
Before the ascent game arrived, he had gone on blind dates too.
Generally, there were two types of blind dates, one was the rural kind where you needed a matchmaker. The matchmaker would bring someone over, and whether it worked out or not, you owed the matchmaker a fee for their trouble.
The other kind was the specialized marriage and dating service companies in the cities, which usually required a down payment of 18,888, promising to arrange 12 dates for you within a year.
He could understand that.
After all, there’s no such thing as a free lunch in this world.
It’s just that many marriage and dating services were disgusting, promising that all the female profiles on their platform were top-notch, only to find out after the dates that they were a bunch of monstrosities.
“No fee.”
The man in the suit next to Wen Ping grinned, saying, “We offer our services to male members for free, but we do charge female members a small introduction fee.”
“Oh?”
Surprise flickered in Wen Ping’s eyes, but he quickly understood. It made sense, given that since the ascent game arrived, the number of women had drastically decreased, thus turning the dating market upside down.
“I see, what’s the specific process?”
“It’s very simple, sir. First of all…”
…
An hour later.
“…”
Wen Ping sat uneasily in a chair at a western restaurant, hands laid flat on his lap, the corners of his mouth twitching slightly. He had no idea what karma led him here, but by some devilish whimsy, he was actually on a blind date again.
And what’s even more infuriating, he felt nervous!
Damn it!
Nervous for what!
He, a future top player of the ascent game, who had killed Chen Yi, was doing these Novice Planet players a favor by participating in their blind dates, essentially giving these women some face.

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 630 398 Add the January rule One Step Ahead._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 630: Chapter 398: Add the January rule “One Step Ahead”._3 Chapter 630: Chapter 398: Add the January rule “One Step Ahead”._3 What did he have to be nervous about? He was the one with the dominant advantage.
But perhaps the blind dates from the past had left him with too many psychological shadows, causing him to be subconsciously nervous despite continually hypnotizing himself to the contrary.
Very soon.
He saw a tall woman in a black silk miniskirt, strutting in with a catwalk gait.
‘Not bad at all.’
Wen Ping was slightly taken aback, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes. The women of this planet were quite to his taste. Counting on his fingers, he realized the Novice Period for this planet was not far from ending. It seemed not entirely impossible to take a woman back with him.
But just as he was about to stand up.
He saw the woman, with a small bag on her arm, walking haughtily in front of Wen Ping: “I’ll keep it short since we’re pressed for time. You don’t look like someone with money.”
“My father is the vice chairman of the city’s third-level forces.”
“He has two B-grade Props and countless C-grade ones, Points in the seven-digit range.”
“If you want to be with me.”
“You must be obedient. My only demand for men is obedience. In the future, you will take over my father’s position. Can you do that?”
“If you can, kneel down now and kiss my foot, and if you satisfy me, I will consider you.”
“…”
With these words.
All the customers in the restaurant turned their eyes collectively onto Wen Ping, who stood frozen in place, about to pull out a chair for this woman, disbelief swelling in his eyes.
This woman in front of him instantly reminded him of the women he had encountered on blind dates when he first came to play the advanced game.
Almost exactly the same.
Even worse, if such a thing were possible.
Equally disgusting, repulsive!!
He knew it, only fools would go on blind dates!!
“Sigh.”
Wen Ping took a deep breath, forcibly suppressed his emotions, and then spoke softly, “Could you please tell me where you live? I’ll consider it and then, after giving it some thought, pay a visit.”
“No backbone in a man, still considering.”
The tall, black silk-clad woman in front of him sneered and casually threw out an address: “Changjing Road, number 73, Meimiao Community, Building 8, Unit 1, Apartment 1602.”
“Got it.”
“Hmm.”
Wen Ping nodded slowly, then fell silent and sat back down, ignoring the stares from those around him, quietly waiting for the next blind date candidate.
Since he had come for blind dates.
He wouldn’t back out halfway.
And following that—
Chen Yi, who controlled everything, arranged three or four more blind date candidates for Wen Ping one after another, all of them exceptionally nauseating types. None of them failed to either ridicule or insult—either greedy and selfish to the extreme, considering only themselves, with no thought for Wen Ping.
This was called a classic bait-and-switch tactic.
Chen Yi was following the script, first bringing some women to disgust Wen Ping so that when the real female lead appeared, Wen Ping would experience a strong contrast.
But that script was for tomorrow. Today’s script was all about making Wen Ping sick.
Soon, the day of blind dates was over.
Clearly, the blind dates were not very successful, and Wen Ping was not very satisfied with today’s candidates.
After leaving the restaurant alone, he went straight to a prop shop and started buying Props from the owner.
…
The omniscient shopkeeper projected his consciousness into that of the prop shop’s owner instantly, just playing for time, hesitating whether or not to sell Props to Wen Ping. He restricted Wen Ping’s use of all Props.
