Because he feared Wen Ping might suddenly start a killing spree and wreck his entire plan.
But outright refusal would make no sense.
That would be unjustifiable.
After pondering for a moment, he decided to sell Props to Wen Ping after all. The Props of the Novice Planet were relatively harmless, and Wen Ping bought the only two B-grade Props available.
Acting as if he had money to burn.
He really did have some plans.
After that, Wen Ping quietly returned to the hotel. Just as Chen Yi was preparing to rest and was getting ready to send a dream to Wen Ping tonight, he saw Wen Ping changing his clothes and leaving the hotel once again.
This caused Chen Yi, who was about to give his brain a short rest, to perk up again, following Wen Ping to make sure that every player Wen Ping passed by had his own consciousness and did not act like a robot.
“Wait a second!”
Chen Yi, realizing that something was amiss, saw the direction Wen Ping was heading and immediately tensed up—his eyelids uncontrollably twitching!!!
Damn it!
Wen Ping was already standing at the entrance of Meimiao Community!!
It was that black silk-clad woman from his first blind date of the day. What else could he be here for? Obviously, it was for revenge. Quite the character, taking revenge without waiting even a night, huh?
But the trouble was, he had constructed only the exteriors of all the communities. The insides were completely empty, not even up to the standard of bare-bones housing. After all, where would he find the time and energy to make the interiors of the communities perfect as well?
It seemed sufficient that they looked decent from the outside.
And now, with Wen Ping suddenly showing up, he caught him completely off guard!
He could only allow the community’s security guard to try to hold Wen Ping off with a gentle tone for a while longer, while he hastily began to construct the details of the furniture in Apartment 1602 of Building 8, Unit 1 of Meimiao Community based on his memory.
It was the home of that woman.

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - 631 398 Add the January rule One Step Ahead._4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 631: Chapter 398: Add the January rule “One Step Ahead”._4 Chapter 631: Chapter 398: Add the January rule “One Step Ahead”._4 Who could have thought that he’d suddenly turn up here?
Finally… three minutes later.
Chen Yi, observing from a God-like perspective and without a physical form, raised his arm to wipe away the nonexistent sweat on his forehead, took several deep breaths, and then allowed Wen Ping to enter the community.
Following that…
He saw Wen Ping take a pistol out of his chest pocket, hide it in his sleeve, and walk directly to the entrance of Building No. 8, Unit 1, with a clear target in mind.
Then he climbed up the stairs to the 16th floor.
Standing at the door to 1602, he took out a long piece of wire, bent it into the shape of a ‘7’, then used a pick to pry the cat-eye viewer from the security door. He inserted the wire through the cat-eye hole, jiggling it tentatively a couple of times before applying slight force.
The security door was successfully unlocked.
Effortlessly.
Chen Yi, observing everything from a God-like perspective, was somewhat speechless. You even have this skill? Were you a locksmith before the game began?
Under Chen Yi’s control, the woman in black stockings from the daytime was currently sleeping in the bedroom, utterly unaware of the commotion outside.
…
“Ah!!”
The woman’s scream suddenly erupted as the man she had met during the day was now coldly holding a pistol to her forehead, greedily looking her over with eyes like a starving wolf.
“What the hell are you doing!!”
Chen Yi projected his consciousness into the woman’s body and bellowed out the question, aiming for authenticity.
But what came next…
Wen Ping was much rougher than he had imagined, not even bothering to remove his clothes. He slapped the woman, cursed her as a “fucking bitch,” and then began.
“What the hell are you doing!!!”
“My father is…”
…
Chen Yi, from his God-like perspective, was staring blankly at some void, his mouth slowly opening and closing.
He had never done something so disgusting in his life.
Never!
He had projected his consciousness into the woman, and Wen Ping was… This made him feel like he was the victim!!!
Though there was no physical sensation, no touch!!
Yet the words the woman was speaking were controlled by him, and this eerie sense of embodiment made his stomach acid churn!
In his entire life!
He had never exerted so much effort, felt so wronged by killing someone!!!
It was utterly outrageous!!!
…
“Uh…”
On Blue Star, in the Wasteland,
Tuberculosis Rabbit was sitting on a chair in front of the barbecue grill, meticulously turning the skewers for even cooking, glanced up at the twilight sky, then looked at Chen Yi who still stood motionless next to him and spoke with a slight sense of emotion.
“Yi, you’ve really had it tough. All these days, you haven’t moved an inch.”
“It’s already January 2.”
“The new year has come. The New Year’s Eve event is over, but Yi still hasn’t responded.”
“Wait a minute!”
Just then, Tuberculosis Rabbit noticed that Yi’s expression was the same, and after hesitating for a while, said, “Yi, doesn’t your face look a bit off, as if you’ve encountered something really disgusting and distressing?”
He had lived with Yi for a long time, and in most cases, Yi was quite good at controlling his emotions.
He had hardly ever seen Yi with this kind of expression.
He didn’t know what had happened in the Illusory Realm to make Yi have such an expression.
“It must be because he hasn’t eaten for several days and looks bitter.”
“But it’s not a problem. Although the December rule ‘Do As One Pleases’ has ended, and players can no longer be invincible, Chen Yi definitely won’t die from other causes before the duel ends, so there’s no need to worry about that.”
“That’s not the important thing, the important thing is…”
Sword Without End, standing beside with a complicated expression, spoke up, “The rule for January seems to be about to crush Yi.”
On January 1, just after midnight, the version had been updated.
Indeed, just as the update had forecasted, the rule change in January introduced an element of gaining a head start, and it was bluntly called just that – “Gaining a Head Start”.
New January rule “Gaining a Head Start”.
“Gaining a Head Start”: To succeed, a slow bird must start flying early. In January, all players will be ranked in real-time according to their monthly step counts.
The players in the middle of the pack will see no difference.
Players who rank higher will experience reduced gravity from Earth’s core as they climb in rank, making their movements lighter and their jumps higher.
Conversely, players at the lower end of the rankings will face increasing gravitational pull as their rank drops, making them feel heavier, their movements slower, and their ability to move more difficult.
And, the sudden changes in gravity won’t cause accidents due to differences in players’ physical fitness.
Hmm.
This is the rule for January.
Simply put, it’s a global WeChat exercise ranking: the more you walk, the lighter you feel; on the contrary, the less you walk, the heavier you become.
A patch was also added to prevent people with poor physical fitness from being crushed to death by a sudden surge in gravity.
Since Yi had been standing motionless here since December 28th, he naturally ranked last in the global “Gaining a Head Start Leaderboard”.
The effect was as follows.
Yi’s body had already sunk two to three meters into the ground.
It was like steel rods placed on quicksand, sinking gradually downward.
The sight was somewhat horrifying.
This was a consequence of excessive gravity, causing the body to become very heavy.
They did try to lift Yi out of the deep pit; there were three other human-shaped deep pits nearby. They had pulled him out three times already, but he kept falling back in, so they were preparing to find a huge steel plate for Yi to stand on.
Otherwise, his legs would bore into the earth like probe heads, straight down towards its core.
“Sigh.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed helplessly and said, “This doesn’t affect much, but I wonder when Yi will finish. I thought he’d just need to wait patiently after setting up the Illusory Realm.”
“Who knew he would stay inside the entire time.”
“Is it really that complicated?”
“Should be over soon, I guess,” Sword Without End added uncertainly.
“Let’s hope so.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head, “If he doesn’t come out soon, this damn Novice Period will be over.”
…
Meanwhile, inside the Illusory Realm.
Wen Ping had finally finished.
Chen Yi, with a pallor of death and a clouded mind, breathed a sigh of relief upon seeing Wen Ping finally wrap things up. He was just about to make this woman say something ruthless when he saw Wen Ping pull out his gun, draw another from his chest, and without hesitation, shoot the woman in the forehead.
“Bang!”
The sound of the gunshot rang out.
The woman in black stockings lay forever in a pool of blood.
Chen Yi felt even more relieved; this was better, as he wouldn’t even have to think of any last words.
It was time to get back to the script, head back to the hotel as quickly as possible. He’d send her one last dream tonight; when the woman showed up for the blind date tomorrow, a sweet and romantic love drama would begin.
Don’t go off track again.
However—
What happened next left Chen Yi, observing from a god-like perspective, silently motionless with an expressionless face.
Wen Ping, gun in hand, didn’t hesitate for a second before walking out of the Meimiao Community and heading toward the community of his second blind date of the day.
It was clear he intended to repeat the same strategy.
“What does this mean?”
“Does it mean I have to replay this scene three or four more times??!”
“Damn!”
Chen Yi, viewing from a god-like perspective, finally lost his composure and became visibly angry. What did they take him for, a doll in a box?
He was the planner!
He wasn’t here to play this game.

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - 632 399 Ridiculous
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 632: Chapter 399: Ridiculous Chapter 632: Chapter 399: Ridiculous However…
Wen Ping seemed even more stubborn than he had imagined.
On Wen Ping’s route to other districts, he set up countless obstacles, including car accident scenes, construction sites, and even torrential thunderstorms, but Wen Ping unfailingly chose to take detours just to proceed regardless of the weather.
It was this kind of resolve.
This vengeful determination not to put off until tomorrow was so strong it was frightening.
And so—
Chen Yi, with the perspective of a god, after a long, expressionless silence, let out a slow, light sigh, somewhat helplessly giving up on continuing to obstruct Wen Ping. He could not obstruct him any longer. These sorts of accidents happening once or twice wouldn’t be a problem, but having too many would start to raise suspicions.
He had no temper to speak of.
It seemed that Wen Ping would not cease his efforts until he achieved his goal.
What could he do but quickly make last-minute arrangements, decorating the houses for several other matchmaking ladies? He was just thankful for the title that his spiritual power would never run dry. Otherwise, he would have fainted by now due to exhaustion from the depletion of his spiritual power.
…
And so it happened.
Chen Yi watched with wide eyes as Wen Ping dealt with the next several matchmaking women in the same manner.
Only then did he return to the hotel contentedly, freshening up and preparing to go to sleep.
He did not wish to express any opinion on the matter. All he hoped for now was that Wen Ping would quickly fall asleep and then follow the script he had already set in place, without further deviations. Why bother to add so many complications to each day?
Fortunately, everything went smoothly thereafter, without any hitches.
After returning to the hotel, Wen Ping briefly freshened up, washing away the bloody smell from his body, then lay down on the bed. He didn’t suffer from insomnia and soon fell asleep.
“Phew!”
Seeing this, Chen Yi let out a long breath of relief; at last, they were getting to the main story.
…
“Bang!”
Accompanying the rise of the sun, a loud noise erupted in the hotel room.
Wen Ping sat up from the bed, looked towards the light spilling through the curtain gap, and, feeling irritated, punched the wall. Last night, his mother had invaded his dreams again, still urging him to go on matchmaking dates.
He vaguely remembered arguing with her in the dream.
He said none of the women from the matchmaking were good, all selfish and vain, none truly loving him. He did not want to go on these dates, and he despised those wanting to be with him for his reputation or strength. He yearned for genuine love.
To find a woman who loved him.
But his mother wouldn’t listen, repeatedly insisting he try matchmaking again.
Eventually, he seemed to have made a bet with his mother: one more matchmaking session, and if it did not work out, she would no longer bother him.
Three consecutive days of dreaming about his mother rushing him to go on dates.
Perhaps the mother beneath the Nine Springs was genuinely anxious.
Longing for a grandson.
But even if he did find a woman and had a child, his mother still wouldn’t be able to hold them. Surely, he couldn’t have the child die right after birth to accompany his mother, right?
That would be too bizarre.
“Sigh.”
Sitting on the bed, lost in his thoughts for a while, Wen Ping finally came to his senses. After getting up and freshening up, he remembered the matchmaking agency that said they had arranged another date for him at noon today.
After hesitating for a long while.
He put on the slightly dirty clothes from yesterday and decided to get the date over with, so the next time his mother visited his dreams, he would have an excuse.
Speaking of which, although the dates introduced by this matchmaking company were rather poor, the agency was quite responsible, arranging so many in two days. Before the main game’s arrival, the company he had found took a good six or seven months to set up one or two dates.
They just kept postponing.
Only by topping up extra credits could more dates be arranged.
Not nearly as responsible.
…
After getting ready, Wen Ping looked at the time and saw it was about right. He stood up, left the hotel, and headed for the restaurant they had agreed upon yesterday. He had just seated himself, not yet having the chance to order, when he casually glanced at the entrance of the restaurant and suddenly froze.
“Huh?”
A flash of surprise crossed Wen Ping’s eyes as he saw a woman entering the restaurant—a woman who almost perfectly met his aesthetic tastes.
Around 167 cm in height.
Half a head shorter than himself.
No excess fat on her stomach, legs white and slender like jade, and her face free of any high-tech surgical marks, completely natural. Her dress and aura were not overly flamboyant, nothing like the women from nightclubs.
But neither did she have the immaturity of a young college girl.
There was a hint of life experience to her, not just a mere ornament.
She had allure.
“Gulp.”
Wen Ping subconsciously swallowed, his throat visibly moving, his heart set on a decision—the woman was too perfect. After she finished eating, he would follow her and spend a wonderful time outdoors.
To have such a woman for one night would be enough.
As for pursuing her?
Forget it.
If he took a wife on this planet, Novice Planet, it would mean he would pay a hefty price. The Novice Period had a long while to go before ending on this planet.
He would have to wait several months until this woman could leave the Novice Period and meet him.
Most importantly, Chen Yi was already dead, meaning the planet no longer had a protection deity. If the planet were to be annihilated, the woman would die too, and then he’d have to take on the role of the protection deity of Blue Star to prevent Blue Star’s destruction.

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - 633 399 Ridiculous_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 633: Chapter 399: Ridiculous_2 Chapter 633: Chapter 399: Ridiculous_2 This was a considerable sacrifice.
He was not about to leave himself with such a huge hidden risk for a moment of pleasure.
Moreover,
Based on his past experiences, these good-looking women were often extremely disgusting; they either looked down on people or had a strong mercenary heart, wanting to sell themselves for a good price. He despised these types of women the most.
Wen Ping snorted softly in his heart, already plotting how to shatter such a beautiful vase tonight.
But just at that moment—
The woman suddenly walked straight up to Wen Ping, leaned slightly forward, extended her right hand in mid-air, and, with a crescent-moon smile, said, “Is this gentleman here my blind date, Wen Ping?”
“Hello, I’m Sun Miaomiao.”
“Just call me Little Miao.”
“Ah? My name is Wen Ping, hello, hello.”
Wen Ping was momentarily stunned, and it took a while before he reacted. He hurriedly stood up to shake Little Miao’s extended right hand, only touching it lightly before withdrawing his hand, suddenly at a loss for words.
Unexpectedly, this woman was his blind date for today.
This…
While he pondered what to say,
“That is,”
Little Miao, already seated, casually flipped through the menu, and with a slight frown, started to speak, “Uncle Wen Ping, some things might sound unpleasant, but I think I still need to say them.”
“…”
Wen Ping, feeling somewhat nervous and uneasy, suddenly cooled his expression upon hearing those words, lit a cigarette, leaned back in the chair, lowered his head, and said indifferently, “Speak, I’m listening.”
He didn’t need to listen to know what the woman was going to say next.
It was all the same nonsense.
How many Points you have saved, how many Props, how many Skills, what kind of power you have, if there is any potential, and so on.
Issues so vulgar they made him anxious.
Ridiculous!
He knew it, all the good-looking girls, they all have that consistently disgusting personality!
“It’s like this.”
After hesitating for a while, Little Miao still spoke, “Judging by your attire, you don’t seem like someone with a lot of Points, which I can understand, since accidental occurrences are too many in this game of ascension.”
“But if you don’t have many Points, you should save up Points to buy stronger Props, to clear higher-level maps, instead of inviting me to such an expensive restaurant to spend.”
“Each dish here is too expensive, just this braised lion’s head alone costs over a hundred Points.”
“It’s too expensive.”
“If you say you’ll pay, I feel distressed, and if you ask me to pay, I also feel distressed, so… shall we go eat at a roadside stall instead?”
Little Miao blinked her eyes, full of hope and pleading.
“Ah?”
Wen Ping, who was lowering his head and pretending to be profound while smoking, froze in place upon hearing these words and looked up at the woman in front of him in disbelief. Seeing there was not a hint of mockery in her eyes, but rather sincerity, it appeared that she genuinely felt bad about spending his Points.
“This…”
Wen Ping was indeed at a loss for words now, completely uncertain of what to say.
For all these years,
This was the first time he invited a girl out for a meal and someone was willing to save money for him.
Not that he hadn’t treated girls to meals before the ascension game descended; he invited many girls for meals in his quest for a wife, but none would ever get upset for him. In fact, many girls would bring along their best friends, then order things they couldn’t normally afford.
Throughout the meal, the girls would eat and chat with high spirits, even asking him to keep taking photos.
He couldn’t even get a word in.
After finishing the meal and paying, he was left alone at the messy table, the kind-hearted ones would politely say it’s not suitable when they got home, the less kind-hearted ones wouldn’t show any sign and would ask him to treat them again.
And he was happy to do so.
“Don’t you want to?”
Little Miao’s voice pulled Wen Ping back from his thoughts.
“Willing, definitely willing, why wouldn’t I be?”
Bewildered, Wen Ping quickly stubbed out the cigarette in his hand as if worried about his image, and stammered an explanation: “I don’t usually smoke in public places, I have severe asthma, and this cigarette is actually a Prop that effectively suppresses asthma.”
“Is that so?”
Little Miao nodded thoughtfully, then suddenly couldn’t help but laugh, “Actually, I quite like guys who smoke; I think they’re especially charming.”
“And for some reason, the moment I saw you, I felt you were very safe to be with.”
“Especially your stubble and the faint smell of tobacco on you, it always gives me a feeling that you’re someone I can rely on.”
“Really?”
Wen Ping was startled and then immediately lit another cigarette, grinning as he put it in his mouth, “Actually, I love smoking, two packs a day is nothing to me.”
“But, are we really going to eat at a roadside stall?”
“Having a roadside stall on our first meeting, doesn’t that seem improper?”
“Actually, I have money.”
“I know.”
Little Miao stood up, gently looping her arm through Wen Ping’s, and as they walked towards the restaurant’s exit, she gave Wen Ping a meaningful glance, “I know you have money, which man would admit he’s broke? But you men have so many things to spend money on.”
“The burden of life weighs heavily on you, it’s exhausting. When I think about it, all these Points you’ve earned came from putting your life on the line.”
“How can I bear to use these Points to eat such fancy meals?”

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - 634 399 Ridiculous_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 634: Chapter 399: Ridiculous_3 Chapter 634: Chapter 399: Ridiculous_3 “…”
Wen Ping’s throat moved slightly as he was somewhat dazedly pulled by Little Miao towards the outside of the restaurant. This woman was actually feeling sorry for him?!!
This woman was actually concerned about how hard it was for him to earn Points?
Damn it!
After all these years, he had finally found a woman who didn’t think his Points were just blown in by the wind, but were hard-won!
But in reality, he did have a lot of Points, seven or eight hundred million Points, Points he truly didn’t lack.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi, observing from a god-like perspective, nodded in satisfaction at the scene below.
Everything was proceeding according to the script.
It was clear to see.
Just a bit of sweetness was enough to make Wen Ping, who had been hurt in the realm of love, somewhat unable to extricate himself.
But this was just the beginning.
There were still several steps to come.
– The preliminary establishment of trust.
– The building process of the suspension bridge effect.
– The active demolition of trust.
– Prolonged self-torment and shattering.
– The enlightened rebuilding of trust and the feeling of surviving a calamity.
-…
– The tolling of the bell of death.
“Tsk.”
Chen Yi, looking at the script in his hand, couldn’t help but feel a complicated sense of emotion as he remarked, “No wonder they say none of those who deal with words are any good, who the hell designed this script, it’s really screwing with people.”
“Go through a cycle like this, and who wouldn’t be destroyed?”
“Even if a god arrived, they’d fall right here.”
“It’s utterly a scheme to kill the heart.”
…
“Don’t move, you have some food on your face.”
Little Miao suddenly spoke up, carefully removing a grain of rice from Wen Ping’s face, then with a bloom-like smile, pinched the grain with her two fingers and put it into Wen Ping’s mouth, “Eat slowly, no one is competing with you.”
Feeling the gentle touch by his mouth, Wen Ping’s throat moved slightly, and he quickly nodded, then turned his gaze back to the pork rice in front of him.
He had never thought that such an ordinary meal
could give him a taste of happiness and fulfillment.
Only…
Everything in front of him felt somewhat unreal; was it truly possible for there to be a woman who cared about him, one that wasn’t bothered by his penniless state?
How could that be!
“That…”
After hesitating for quite some time, Wen Ping turned to Little Miao, who was sitting in the cramped storefront, and opened his mouth tentatively, “Little Miao, you’re so pretty, don’t other men chase after you?”
“They do,”
Little Miao replied somewhat discontentedly with a pout, “But I don’t like them. Those men, you can tell at first glance that they approach me because of some dirty desires. I hate such people the most.”
“But you, Uncle Wen Ping, are different.”
“The first time I saw you, I knew you were a down-to-earth person.”
“How could you tell?”
“Look, the clothes you’re wearing are old, and they even have blood stains on them that don’t look like they’ve dried for long. You must have just fought your way out of that map, and since you didn’t change into clean clothes before the blind date, it shows that you don’t care much about your appearance.”
“I don’t like men who care too much about their appearance, acting effeminate, like some fresh meat.”
“You, Uncle, you must be one of those down-to-earth men.”
“You look like you can provide security.”
Wen Ping looked down at his clothes blankly, vaguely remembering the blood stains seemed to have splattered from killing those women last night, but he quickly looked up again with a serious expression,
“That’s true, I also hate those men who spend all their time grooming themselves.”
In his heart, he felt somewhat guilty about the thought of following Little Miao later that evening, which had crossed his mind when he first saw her…
Compared to the woman in front of him, who seemed as pure as a blank sheet of paper,
he seemed too beastly.
…
In the half-day that followed,
Wen Ping and Little Miao had a delightful conversation, shopping and strolling, just like a pair of real sweethearts.
After nightfall,
the two sat in a dimly lit, quiet tavern with soft music enveloping their ears.
The atmosphere was very intimate.
And Wen Ping was elated, talking non-stop.
“Exactly, I’m just like that, I share your thoughts. If I had been there, I would’ve knocked them all down with one punch,”
After downing the drink in his glass, Wen Ping continued excitedly, “Not only that, I would also…”
It had been a long time since he had such a desire to converse.
Mainly because Little Miao was such a good conversationalist.
She never let a topic fall to the ground, never crashed his spirit, and whatever he said, her gaze never contained sarcasm or disdain—only admiration and yearning.
Nothing could arouse a man’s desire to talk more than an admiring gaze.
Even Wen Ping had not realized that he was talking much more than usual.
“That’s amazing…”
Little Miao sat on the same sofa as Wen Ping, her body turned towards him, eyes full of admiration under the dim light, waiting for Wen Ping’s side profile, which made Wen Ping speak even louder.
At that moment, Wen Ping really enjoyed the feeling.
He felt comfortable and didn’t want to think about anything; he had even forgotten he was waiting for the Starfield Shuttle event.
But just then,
Wen Ping suddenly noticed there had been no movement at his side for a long while and felt his mouth dry. Subconsciously picking up his glass to take a sip, he turned to speak to Little Miao next to him, but stopped, temporarily frozen.
Little Miao was leaning onto the sofa, her eyes already reddened, her cheeks still moist with tears.

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - 635 399 Ridiculous_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 635: Chapter 399: Ridiculous_4 Chapter 635: Chapter 399: Ridiculous_4 “Ah?”
Wen Ping immediately became flustered, and for a moment, he didn’t know what to do. He reached for the napkin on the table and carefully wiped the tears on Little Miao’s face, tentatively asking, “Did I say something wrong?”
“No.”
Little Miao bit her lip and shook her head, “It’s just… hearing you talk about the pain you encountered when you first started exploring the map, and how you were hurt by those women before the upgrade game came, it made me feel so suffocated inside.”
“Why did those women treat you like that.”
“You’re such a good person, why did those women feel so entitled to use you.”
“I…”
Wen Ping’s mouth slowly opened and closed, not knowing what to say, and tentatively placed his arm around Little Miao’s shoulder. Seeing that Little Miao did not resist, he slowly let her head rest against his shoulder.
“It’s all in the past.”
“It’s okay, it’s okay.”
At this moment, no words could describe what he was feeling inside; he only felt that he might have truly found his true love.
Although he didn’t want to admit it.
But after spending the day together, he might have really fallen for the girl in front of him.
“Mm-hmm.”
Little Miao nodded slowly, then suddenly her eyes turned red again as she forced a smile, “My bestie went on a blind date yesterday too. She said the guy she met was no good, so poor.”
“She is my best friend, although a bit snobbish, she was there for me during my lowest times, sticking with me all the way.”
“When I go back tonight, I’m going to tell her that the man I met on my blind date today was perfect.”
“This is my first blind date.”
“I didn’t expect to meet you.”
“If possible, I’d like to give us a try tomorrow, is that okay?”
“Go on,” Little Miao stood up and playfully ruffled Wen Ping’s hair, “So now, Uncle Wen Ping, will you take me home?”
“Ah?”
At this point, Wen Ping, who had completely lost his wits, stood up in a daze, paid the bill unconsciously, and then helped Little Miao walk out of the tavern.
What did Little Miao just say?
That she wants to give it a try tomorrow?
How many years have gone by, so many years! And now a woman has taken the initiative to say that he’s not bad!
All the way back, Wen Ping was in a daze, even when he dropped Little Miao off at the entrance of her community, he didn’t realize he had been there the previous night to kill someone.
…
Tonight.
Wen Ping was unusually sleepless.
Tossing and turning in bed, he could not sleep.
A sleepless night.
Until seven in the morning, Wen Ping abruptly got out of bed, his eyes were wide awake without a trace of sleepiness, he took a very serious bath, and shaved his beard.
Then he walked straight out of the hotel and ran to a clothing store that had not yet opened, stealing several fashionable items from inside.
Afterward, he chose the suit that suited him best.
Then he looked at Little Miao in his friends list, his eyes filled with tenderness.
Yesterday.
Little Miao had sent him her address, telling him to message her when he was ready to take her out.
Even though it’s still not dawn yet.
But he simply could not sleep anymore.
He was eager to see Little Miao again, to share his past stories, as he was someone with a strong desire to express himself. Regrettably, it seems no one has ever really listened to him speak.
Even those drawn to him for Points, who seemed to listen attentively, always showed boredom and disinterest in their eyes.
But Little Miao was different.
He could tell that Little Miao truly enjoyed listening to him talk. She would ride the emotional rollercoaster of his stories, her eyes filled with admiration and rapture, and even… she would feel sorry for his past.
…
From his godlike perspective, Chen Yi leisurely gazed down at Wen Ping, who was nervously sitting below, smiled without speaking.
Enjoy it.
This kind of happiness during an ambiguous phase is rare.
…
Just like that.
Wen Ping, who had gone out to buy a bouquet of roses at noon, sat by the bed waiting all day long, and by dusk, he still hadn’t received a message from Little Miao.
It was as if she had disappeared.
The Wen Ping who had been anxious all day finally caught on, scoffing at himself as if to mock his own naivety, then with an angry and ferocious expression, he smashed the roses onto the ground!
He just knew it.
How could a man like him ever be liked by other women!
Especially a perfect woman like Little Miao!
What did Little Miao mean by what she said yesterday before leaving? Was she mocking him? Was she playing with him?
Kill her, she must be killed!
Wen Ping, feeling insulted and overcome with emotion, glared fiercely at the friend list, at the address Little Miao sent last night— “Changjing Road, No. 73, Meimiao Community, Building 8, Unit 1, Room 1601.”
Just as he was preparing to go to this address, to destroy this beautiful work of art.
Wait.
A disbelieving possibility suddenly flashed through his mind, and his body sprang up from the bed, his eyes filled with horror.
This address, it seemed so familiar!
It was the exact address of the first woman he met for a blind date the day before yesterday, the woman in the black silk.
No, the black silk woman’s address was Changjing Road, No. 73, Meimiao Community, Building 8, Unit 1, Room 1602.
Little Miao was in 1601, and that woman was in 1602.
They were neighbors, right across the hall.
And suddenly, he remembered what Little Miao had said last night at the small bar—that she had a really good girlfriend who was a bit of a snob, who went on a blind date the day before with a man who turned out to be poor, and said she was going to tell her best friend, when she got back later that night, about her successful date that day.
“It’s over…”
Wen Ping suddenly turned ashen-faced with despair.
The woman he broke into and killed in bed the night before yesterday, wasn’t she Little Miao’s best friend?
With that thought.
He took a deep breath, not even sparing a glance at the roses he had trampled, and hurried toward the address.
…
Once again, at Meimiao Community.
Wen Ping walked straight into Building 8, Unit 1, and leaned by the door of Room 1601 on the 16th floor, which was Little Miao’s apartment, listened intently for a while, and after confirming there were no sounds inside, he felt somewhat relieved.
But just as he was about to go to 1602 to check if Little Miao had discovered the crime scene.
He suddenly heard faint noises from inside 1602.
The owner of 1602, the black silk woman, had already been killed by him, so there shouldn’t be anyone else there. If there was someone, it could only be one person, and that was Little Miao.
“…”
Wen Ping stayed silent with a dark expression on his face, at that moment he only hoped for one thing, that Little Miao didn’t know who killed her best friend!
Damn it!
How could he have known that the woman’s best friend would turn out to be Little Miao? If he had known earlier, he would never have killed her.
However, just as he was considering whether or not to go in and check.
Wen Ping stayed silent with a dark expression on his face, at that moment he only hoped for one thing, that Little Miao didn’t know who killed her best friend!

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - 636 400 Love isnt it just this kind of thing
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 636: Chapter 400: Love, isn’t it just this kind of thing? Chapter 636: Chapter 400: Love, isn’t it just this kind of thing? “Bang!”
Accompanied by a loud collision, the door was shut.
Only a grim-faced Wen Ping was left standing alone outside the house.
Who could have thought that such a melodramatic incident would occur.
Now, the only thing to do was consider if there were any chances for redemption.
Like… bringing them back from the dead?
After all, when he killed that woman, he hadn’t completely finished her off, and since he couldn’t go to Blue Star Hell himself, just a trip there to find that woman would allow him to bring her back with the help of a return map.
But the problem was his current lack of strength. All his props and titles were restricted, and he only had some temporarily purchased props on this planet, which were nowhere near enough to bring someone back from a return map.
That was a secondary issue, however.
The main problem was that he couldn’t even get to Blue Star Hell, as the hells of each planet were not interconnected.
Unless… unless he was willing to spend a large amount of Points to find a reliable mercenary squad on Blue Star, and then have their strongest player retrieve that woman from hell.
That might offer a glimmer of hope for redemption; after all, he had plenty of Points to spare.
But even so…
Wen Ping stood in place, his face dark. Even if he brought that woman back from hell, could that really mend his relationship with Little Miao?
Impossible.
Knowing that he had done such a thing would only make Little Miao despise him more.
Just as he stood there, breaking his head over the impossibility of finding any solution,
The door suddenly opened.
A haggard and red-eyed Little Miao stood at the door, looking at Wen Ping with tears welling up and said hoarsely, “I’m sorry, Uncle Wen Ping, I shouldn’t have lost my temper at you, but… she really was my best friend.”
“When I was going through the toughest times, it was her who stood by me.”
“She had her flaws, but she was always nice to me, no matter what imperfections she had, they were not deserving of death.”
“I shouldn’t have lashed out at you.”
“It’s just, I can’t imagine who this beast could be to act so cruelly. If I find him, I’ll tear him to pieces!”
“Ah?”
Wen Ping was slightly taken aback, but quickly realized that Little Miao only knew that her best friend was dead and not that she had died at his hands. This meant that Little Miao hadn’t watched the surveillance footage yet.
There might still be a chance!
Almost instantly,
Wen Ping’s expression turned into one of natural complexity, tinged with regret as he hugged Little Miao and murmured, “It’s okay, I don’t blame you. It’s my fault for being late. Maybe if I’d come sooner, the tragedy could have been avoided.”
“Condolences.”
And looking inside the house,
The body had already been placed in a body bag by Little Miao, and the bloodstains in the house were almost cleaned up. When Little Miao wasn’t looking, Wen Ping swiftly put the room’s camera into his pocket, ready to destroy all evidence.
Afterward—
After consoling her for a while, Wen Ping accompanied Little Miao downstairs to the residential complex, ready to bury the body in the backyard’s abandoned garden.
No need to call the police.
There was a Law Enforcement Bureau, but it was practically useless. With the situation as it was, there was no point expecting anyone to come out to uphold justice. If you truly died, you’d crawl out from hell; if you couldn’t crawl out, just settle down in hell.
…
The sky gradually darkened.
Standing at the simple grave in the abandoned garden, Little Miao wiped away tears from the corner of her eyes and leaned on Wen Ping’s shoulder, whispering word by word, “Uncle Wen Ping, I believe she can crawl out of hell and come back to me.”
“Don’t you think so?”
“Hmm, yes.”
Wen Ping nodded his head calmly, his heart set on spending money to hire someone to go to Blue Star Hell and silence that woman. As long as the woman was dead for good, everything could be as if nothing had ever happened.
But if by chance the woman managed to crawl out of hell alive, then everything would be exposed.
In these past few days, he wasn’t sure if he had started to like Little Miao. He just felt like he was beginning to care about her opinion of him. Being with Little Miao made him happy, and he felt like he had become more cheerful.
Once a doctor had told him the best treatment for his condition was the love of a woman.
Now, he thought he might be starting to understand what that meant.
…
“Whew!”
Finally waking up, Chen Yi shifted his body, only feeling his bones aching all over. Just as he was about to move his feet,
He suddenly found himself standing on a metal plate, and his body felt so heavy that he couldn’t even lift his feet.
“What’s happening?”
“Brother Yi, you’re awake?”
At this moment,
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been sitting aside in the wilderness grilling, saw Brother Yi waking up and hurriedly rushed over, excitement written all over his face: “Is it over? Many days have passed, Brother Yi, you’ve worked hard.”
“Here, have a skewer of grilled tendons.”
“…”
Chen Yi, still clueless about what had happened, saw a skewer of meat thrust in his face, retreating a bit and said with a touch of annoyance, “Take it away. I feel nauseated just looking at it.”
“Why do you eat barbecue every day?”
“Don’t you get sick of it?”
Immediately after, he noticed the public announcement for the January updates, which added a few game activities, introduced a new fusion feature, and unveiled a new monthly rule called ‘One Step Ahead.’
It was akin to a global movement leaderboard on WeChat.
And since the rule was implemented, he had not moved from that spot, naturally landing him at the bottom of the leaderboard. The gravity burdening him now was so immense, he couldn’t move at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - 637 400 Love isnt it just this kind of thing_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 637: Chapter 400: Love, isn’t it just this kind of thing?_2 Chapter 637: Chapter 400: Love, isn’t it just this kind of thing?_2 Since he couldn’t move, he stopped trying.
Although there was a solution, he didn’t have the time to worry about that now; there were more important things to do. He had just come out to take a break, and…to take a damn drag of his cigarette!
Chen Yi was then seen lighting up a cigarette with an intoxicated expression, taking a deep inhale, and slowly exhaling a pale blue smoke that shot out like an arrow.
In the past few days, he had accompanied Wen Ping in that Illusory Realm, where he didn’t smoke a single cigarette.
Although he could conjure up a cigarette to roughly satisfy the craving.
But the Illusory Realm had no real effect on him; it was only truly effective for Wen Ping, the one chosen by the prop, making him crave a smoke all these days.
Yet, he couldn’t find the time to do so as there were too many complications with Wen Ping’s situation. Now that things were finally on the right track, more or less following the script with no major issues, he could take a break to smoke a few cigarettes.
As for the rule of “being one step ahead.”
He would deal with that when he came out; there was no time to bother with it now. Anyhow, it wouldn’t affect anything for the moment, and his body wouldn’t feel any discomfort, it was just that his legs were too heavy to lift.
Even raising his arm to take a puff was quite an effort.
“Hehe.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit chuckled without picking up on the conversation, reporting the situation of the past few days: “Your wife comes over every day. I send her back at night. She wanted to stay with you, but after all, this is a wilderness, and nothing is convenient.”
“Tie Chui is responsible for safely escorting your wife to and fro.”
“As for Sword Without End, there he is.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pointed to the distance where Sword Without End, with arms turned into two ropes tied to a tree, was leisurely swinging below.
“This is?”
“Oh, Yi, did you forget? Last time Sword Without End bought a little gadget at the Star Map Platform that allows you to change your organs as you please? These past days he’s had nothing to do, so he’s been experimenting with ways to use the prop.”
“Just this one.”
‘Prop Name’: Autonomous Organs.
‘Prop Level’: A-Level.
‘Prop Effect’: You can freely manipulate any of your body’s organs, allowing them to form any shape, but you cannot alter their strength or size. For example, you could move an eye behind your head to achieve a 360-degree field of vision, and no matter how you arrange your organs, you will not die or get injured from it. Theoretically, you could even stuff your head into your own abdomen.
‘Prop Limitations’: No cooldown, no Points cost.
‘Prop Introduction’: “We long for freedom, even in our appearance. We want to have absolute freedom.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shared the prop panel in mid-air.
“This human swing is just something Sword Without End came up with to pass the time, not much use. Besides that, he’s developed a nice trick of launching swords simultaneously.”
“That’s shooting hundreds of flying swords at once.”
“Then Sword Without End turns his body into one of the flying swords, hiding amongst them as they shoot towards the enemy, and at the last moment, he delivers a sudden, heavy blow, catching the enemy off guard.”
“Come on, Sword Without End, show Yi how it’s done.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit waved to Sword Without End in the distance and called out.
“Forget it.”
Reverting to his normal posture from the human swing, Sword Without End jumped down from mid-air and walked over, sitting down on the ground somewhat bewilderedly: “I accidentally hit my head on a rock just now, hit it quite hard, and my head’s a bit foggy.”
“Right, Yi, how are things progressing over there?”
“Almost there.”
Chen Yi nodded: “Everything is basically on track, proceeding according to the script. A man who hasn’t had a proper romance is easy to go to extremes when he encounters his first love.”
“Almost there.”
“Such men are the easiest to deceive.”
“Indeed.”
Sword Without End nodded emphatically: “I still remember those naïve emotions from my student days, pretending to nap on the desk, then pretending to be sleepy and ‘accidentally’ touching my desk mate’s elbow with mine.”
“Just feeling like the spark of love had already begun to burn.”
“That sensation, like being electrified, all tingly through the body.”
“It’s really nice, and I envy Wen Ping for being able to feel this kind of emotion before he dies. Yi, you are kind-hearted.”
“Without Yi, Wen Ping probably wouldn’t have met such a perfect woman in his life, a woman that Wen Ping cares so much about.”
“Heh.”
On hearing this, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but laugh: “It reminds me of a joke I heard before, that perfect women or men are always made by liars, no exceptions. No one can be perfect.”
“Even someone as perfect as Yi has the flaw of not liking barbecue, doesn’t he?”
“…It’s not that I don’t like barbecue, it’s just that you make it too often.”
“Forget it.”
Chen Yi let out a resigned sigh and lit another cigarette, taking his time to indulge before he looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit and others and instructed: “I’m going back in to continue. If there’s any emergency…”
“Just shake my body violently. I’ll be able to feel it.”
“Alright, no problem.”
…
As Chen Yi discarded the cigarette butt and closed his eyes once more, standing still to resume his role as a scarecrow, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but speak with an emotional tone: “Yi’s addiction to smoking is quite serious it seems, stepping out just to have a smoke.”

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - 638 400 Love isnt it just this kind of thing_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 638: Chapter 400: Love, isn’t it just this kind of thing?_3 Chapter 638: Chapter 400: Love, isn’t it just this kind of thing?_3 “How can this stuff be addictive?”
“I smoke two packs a day, and I’m not addicted.”
“I don’t get it.”
“Um, Sword Without End, would you like some tendon? I just grilled it, it’s still hot.”
“No, thanks.”
Sword Without End shook his head and waved his hands, “I just can’t enjoy such blessings, you eat it yourself.”
…
“Well, then I’ll be leaving first.”
At the entrance of Meimiao Community, Wen Ping looked tentatively at Little Miao, whose eyes were still somewhat red, and spoke.
“Mm.”
After being silent and looking down for a long time, Little Miao finally raised her head and said in a hoarse voice that stirred pity, “I think we need to put our relationship on hold for a while. We both need to reconsider whether we are right for each other. I don’t know you well, and you don’t know me either.”
“Moreover, with what just happened.”
“I really can’t deal with these personal matters right after such an incident.”
“I hope you can understand.”
“…Understand.”
“Thank you.”
After speaking, Little Miao nodded slightly, then turned and left, no longer lingering or looking back.
“…”
The only thing left was Wen Ping watching Little Miao’s retreating figure, feeling somewhat unwilling and helpless. What the hell is this, why did he have to cheapen himself that night before? Everything could have flowed smoothly and logically, but he messed it all up.
…
The storyline seemed to hit the fast-forward button.
After waking up in the hotel, Wen Ping, without another word, took out a large sum of money to contact a player gang that claimed to be powerful. He anonymously commissioned them to go to Blue Star Hell, find the woman he had killed, and finish her off for good.
Of course, all of this was a plot added by Chen Yi.
Everybody but Wen Ping was a part of the setup; there was no Hell. Heaven forbid Wen Ping could access the underworld of other planets, or else Chen Yi would have had to construct one?
That would be quite an engineering feat.
And the experts who wrote this script knew well a profound truth: human understanding of emotion is quite shallow.
What emotions?
Emotions don’t exist.
In a lifetime, how many people can one really come into contact with, talk more than ten sentences with, or go through some experiences with?
It seems that many people pursue attractive women, and there’s a lot of competition. But in most cases, it’s all an illusion.
And how do emotions come about?
It’s when enough shared experiences, enough twists and turns, and enough emotional upheavals have occurred.
Emotions just fall into place naturally.
It’s less self-deception and more the brain fooling itself, making you think that since you’ve shared so many experiences with someone and they’ve consistently affected your emotions, they must be the most important person to you. Thus, the brain convinces you that you’ve found love.
So…
In the following days…
Little Miao gradually became distant from Wen Ping, responding coldly to his messages. Since Wen Ping didn’t have the courage to visit Little Miao in Meimiao Community, two days passed by like this until Little Miao took the initiative to invite him over.
She invited Wen Ping to her house for dinner.
The dinner was very enjoyable.
They ate in harmony, and Little Miao seemed to step out of the shadows, laughing brightly and tenderly feeding Wen Ping from time to time, looking every bit the good wife and wise mother.
And Wen Ping, feeling honored, kept responding throughout. His anxious heart from the past few days finally settled. It seemed that Little Miao didn’t dislike him anymore; it was just that her close friend had just been brutally murdered.
She was in no mood to engage in romance because of her grief.
After a few days, as Little Miao gradually put the incident behind her, she became as gentle, kind, and generous as before.
Throughout this meal, Wen Ping became more and more talkative, almost letting slip that he was a player from another planet.
He couldn’t help it.
Little Miao kept bringing it up.
…
“Yi is really amazing,” Little Miao said seriously and admiringly to Wen Ping, giving him a thumbs-up: “Most women are attracted to strength, and I’m no exception. Yi is the strongest player in my heart. While we were still mapping out the Novice Planet, Yi was already righting wrongs on other Starfields.”
“In my heart, Yi is the greatest hero.”
“No one could be stronger than Yi.”
At this, Little Miao seemed a bit downhearted as she whispered, “When I was little, I dreamed that when I grew up, I would marry the greatest hero in the world.”
“Growing up, I realized how foolish and delusional that was.”
“How could a man like Yi ever take a second look at me.”
Quickly realizing she might have misspoken, Little Miao hurriedly looked up at Wen Ping and urgently corrected herself, “Uncle Wen Ping, I’m not saying you’re not impressive. What I mean is, we are just ordinary people, and we can only live ordinary lives.”
“You’re already very impressive.”
“Managing to make over a million Points on your own in just a few months, that’s quite an achievement. Apart from Yi, you’re the person I admire the second most.”
“Phew…”
Wen Ping’s knuckles turned white as he gripped his glass tightly, struggling to suppress the surge of violent emotion inside him. Little Miao’s constant praise of other men in front of him made it difficult for him to contain his inner turbulence.

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - 639 400 Love Isnt That Just the Way It Is_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 639: Chapter 400: Love, Isn’t That Just the Way It Is?_4 Chapter 639: Chapter 400: Love, Isn’t That Just the Way It Is?_4 Especially since this man was his sworn enemy.
He wanted to kill this man.
However, the problem was, he had already killed this man a long time ago!
He really wanted to tell Little Miao that he was the greatest hero in the world, that he was even more formidable than Chen Yi, that he had personally killed Chen Yi, and he also wanted to tell Little Miao that Chen Yi was not the benevolent knight-errant he was made out to be in the outside world, but a wanton slaughterer.
Many races were exterminated at the hands of Chen Yi.
It would take an estimate in the billions to count the number of players that had died by Chen Yi’s hand.
How could such a person deserve the title of hero, how could you, Little Miao, adore him? He was a Demon.
In the conversation just now, he couldn’t help but reveal that he had a million Points in savings, though that was merely a tiny fraction of his actual deposits, not even one percent.
But for Little Miao, that was already shocking.
He clearly saw that after he showed Little Miao his account balance, the shock and admiration in her eyes grew even more intense, and he was internally reveling in this feeling.
Unexpectedly, Little Miao suddenly brought up Chen Yi.
This instantly snuffed out his good mood.
“Actually….”
In the end, Wen Ping couldn’t help himself, and, staring intently at Little Miao, he said word by word, “I am the most formidable man, I am even more formidable than Chen Yi.”
“Mhm, mhm.”
Leaning on Wen Ping’s shoulder, Little Miao opened her mouth somewhat tipsily and said, “Everyone says that Chen Yi is the most formidable person in this world, but in my heart, you are more formidable than Chen Yi.”
“After all, on that helpless night, as long as you were by my side, Chen Yi, no matter how formidable, had nothing to do with me.”
“Having you is enough.”
Wen Ping didn’t speak, merely took a deep breath and gently stroked Little Miao’s head, but in his heart, he made up his mind that he would find the right moment to tell Little Miao the truth that he was not a player of this planet.
And also to tell her that he had killed Chen Yi.
To let Little Miao know that he, Wen Ping, was the most formidable man in the world.
…
The tipsy Little Miao soon fell asleep dizzily, muttering meaningless syllables through her parted lips in her sleep, looking quite cute.
Wen Ping looked down at Little Miao with her delicate skin in his arms, a flicker of distress and tenderness in his eyes as he lightly caressed her lips.
A beauty in his embrace.
Uncharacteristically, he felt no physical desire.
He just wanted to take good care of the woman in his arms.
Since gaining power in his life, there had been no shortage of women climbing into his bed, even the prettiest of them, but his greatest regret was that he had never made love to someone he had feelings for.
It was an obsession in his heart.
He wouldn’t take advantage of Little Miao’s drunkenness to commit any beastly acts, tonight, he didn’t mind being a little romantic.
Carefully, he moved Little Miao into the bedroom and was tiptoeing out when he suddenly noticed a photo album on the vanity in the bedroom.
As if driven by some mysterious force, Wen Ping flipped through the album for a glance, yet this single look caused his body to immediately freeze, his pupils to become blood red, and the malicious aura uncontrollably began to emanate from him.
His body even started to tremble rapidly.
A moment later.
He took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and stuffed the album into his chest, before leaving Meimiao Community alone and heading to his hotel.
…
In the hotel.
Wen Ping sat on the bed, his eyes blazing as he looked at the photos in the album.
In this album, it was all pictures of Little Miao and her ex-boyfriend, no, that wasn’t even an ex-boyfriend, or perhaps it should be said it was her former master.
Little Miao, who always seemed so gentle and generous, was pictured in the album.
Wearing a dog collar, with a gag ball in her mouth.
And even…
And even…
All sorts…
Everything imaginable was in this album.
Little Miao in the album was not the same person he usually saw; he had never seen the expression on Little Miao’s face when she knelt on the ground, he couldn’t even begin to imagine that scene.
And that fat man!!
He was as fat as a pig, treating a woman as if she were nothing but a dog.
All of this in front of him made Wen Ping’s face contort in fury as he screamed with bloodshot eyes, “No!!!!”
“Why!!”
“Why!!!”
“On what grounds!!!”
In the dead of night, such a shout in the hotel quickly resulted in the people in the next room knocking on the wall.
“Knock again and I’ll kill your entire family!”
Wen Ping, having lost all reason, roared with a monstrous expression.
Soon after, the next room went quiet.
…
At this moment, from a God’s perspective, Chen Yi, witnessing the scene below, couldn’t help but nod with satisfaction, licking his lips. Such a perfect drama unfolding, and all that was needed now was a cigarette to make it even better.
What’s this called?
It’s called destruction.
Destruction is often the most effective means of controlling emotions, almost without equal.
Just like now.
Men who have been hurt by women, those who have never had a formal relationship, often have a very severe obsession with virgin purity, and it’s not your average severity. At a time like this, if they find out that the woman they cherish has had such a history.
They truly do break down.
Just like Wen Ping below.
Wen Ping was utterly unable to reconcile the image of Little Miao, who had been tipsily lying in his arms with her tender mouth half-open, with the Little Miao in the photographs. To Wen Ping, his worldview was about to collapse.
This was a severe blow indeed.
And this blow would plant a deep anchor in Wen Ping’s heart. Originally, they’d only known each other for a matter of days; how deep could their feelings be? But now it was different; if Wen Ping were to just walk away now.
It would take him three to five years to get over it.
And the next script.
Would involve Wen Ping agonizing over whether to leave in painful turmoil, to decisively give up, or to pretend he knew nothing, spending the rest of his life washing pots and pans daily.
This was not an easy decision to make.
And this entire struggle would cause Wen Ping’s brain to categorize this woman as the most important one in his life, and this feeling, is commonly referred to as love.
Love, huh.
It’s just this whole crap, it can’t be all that lofty.
…
Tonight, Wen Ping suffered from insomnia again.
Wen Ping, who had hardly ever experienced insomnia in his life, now found himself plagued by it nearly every night since arriving in Blue Star.
Late at night on the street.
Wen Ping sat alone at a barbecue stand, burying his head among a pile of empty beer bottles, his face streaked with tears as he drunkenly banged on the table and sobbed his heart out.
Completely disregarding his image.
Utterly indifferent to his own status.
At this moment, Wen Ping just wanted to let out all the emotions in his heart.
He didn’t know where to go next. He had finally met a woman he was willing to spend his life with, but why did she have to have a past he simply couldn’t accept?
What man could accept his beloved having such a history?
Perhaps some can.
But for now, he couldn’t.
He didn’t know where to go next. He had finally met a woman he was willing to spend his life with, but why did she have to have a past he simply couldn’t accept?
What man could accept his beloved having such a history?
Perhaps some can.
But for now, he couldn’t.

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - 640 401 Now that it has come to this I wont
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 640: Chapter 401: “Now that it has come to this, I won’t hide it anymore. Chapter 640: Chapter 401: “Now that it has come to this, I won’t hide it anymore. “This script…”
“Tsk tsk.”
At the barbecue stand, Chen Yi withdrew his gaze from Wen Ping and looked at the script in his hand, unable to help but remark with some emotion, “It’s really too melodramatic.”
The plot those screenwriters came up with was indeed a bit over the top.
The main angle is just uncomfortable.
If it were a veteran of love affairs, they’d probably just snort coldly at this point, even feeling a bit excited.
They love this kind of contrast the most.
Especially when it’s ready-made, just picking up on someone else’s benefits—after all, reaping the fruits from another’s labor is good, isn’t it?
They’d probably feel no discomfort at all on the inside.
As for whether they would feel upset or accept it if they recalled this experience after marriage?
What a joke!
It’s just dating, who said anything about marrying you!
But for someone like Wen Ping, a novice in the realm of romance, who was seriously planning to date for the first time, this was a deadly trap. The effect it had was exactly as Wen Ping saw it.
…
A drunken Wen Ping stumbled and staggered towards the hotel in the rainy night, his thoughts completely hazy and collapsed, not caring at all about the occasional glances from passersby.
He looked completely disheartened.
Back at the hotel, he didn’t even bother to wash up.
He just sat at the edge of the bed, soaking wet, staring blankly ahead, not knowing what he was thinking about.
Only after an indeterminate amount of time did he manage to sleep in a daze.
Soon, the day broke.
Half-awake, Wen Ping saw many messages from Little Miao asking if he took the photo album?
She said she could explain.
It wasn’t what he thought.
“Heh.”
Wen Ping just laughed, feeling as if his heart was being cut open. He lay pale-faced on the bed, emptying his mind, not wanting to think about anything. He now just wanted to quietly wait for the transfer back.
He wanted to go home.
To leave this heartbreaking place.
And Little Miao, he didn’t want to think about her anymore.
Just like that, two more days passed by.
The date had come to January 6th.
Seeing that the time was almost up, Chen Yi once again advanced the plot, while during these two days, Wen Ping didn’t step out of the hotel, just stayed inside, blankly staring at the ceiling, not knowing what his thoughts were.
As dusk approached, another day was coming to an end.
“Ding.”
The sound of a message from the friends list echoed.
Ever since he’d arrived at this broken place, he was completely unable to contact his old friends and could only reach out to those added on this planet. On this planet, he only added one friend, which was Little Miao.
He didn’t even need to open the panel; he knew who sent the message.
Ever since the first day, when Little Miao sent him dozens of messages which he did not reply to, Little Miao had not sent him any more messages. At first, he still held the thought that if Little Miao kept reaching out for a few more days to give him a proper explanation, maybe he could accept it.
But…
It was only on the first day that Little Miao said she wanted to explain, but ultimately she didn’t explain anything. She said she wanted to meet to explain, but after that, she never messaged him again.
This message was the first since that day.
After a moment of silence,
Wen Ping still looked somewhat dazedly at the chat panel, at that message from Little Miao.
“I admit I lied to you. Do you have time? Let’s talk. I’m waiting for you at home.”
“No matter what happens afterward,”
“I hope we can have a serious talk, at least so that we won’t have regrets in the future.”
“…”
Wen Ping stared at the message in silence. After a long while, he replied with an okay, then started to get up, wash up, changed into new clothes, and prepared to head to Meimiao Community.
Just as Little Miao had said.
He too had a lot to say, no matter what the outcome would be, at least he wanted to ask himself clear.
About that fat man who looked like a pig, who exactly was he.
…
And just as Wen Ping stepped out,
Chen Yi, from a god’s-eye view, just looked at the script in his hand, pondering for a moment. After verifying that Wen Ping shouldn’t encounter any issues for the time being, he quickly exited Illusory Realm.
Standing in the wasteland, Chen Yi slowly opened his eyes.
“Eh, Yi, you’re awake again?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was savoring the barbecue in the wilderness, looked surprised to see Yi opening his eyes, then excitedly rushed over with a skewer of tendons, “Fresh off the grill, want a taste? I added plum powder this time, a completely different flavor, it’s surprising, you have to try it.”
Chen Yi took it, put a strip of tendon in his mouth, chewed for a moment, then furrowed his brow and spat it out at the side, “This is the first time I’ve tasted such awful tendon. Why would you add plum powder?”
“Err… just experimenting. Is it really that bad? Okay, I also feel it’s not quite right.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sheepishly nodded.
At that moment though, Chen Yi didn’t have the time to discuss these matters with Tuberculosis Rabbit. He quickly called the team leader who was helping them with the script. Without wasting much time on small talk, he bluntly said, “The script has reached the point where Wen Ping’s faith has shattered, and the two are preparing to meet sincerely for a talk.”
“That would be the sixth scene.”
“But are you sure there won’t be any problems with the following plot? It’s a bit too melodramatic. You guys don’t really think we’re shooting a drama here, do you?”
“These purely coincidental and improbable plot lines, do they really give Wen Ping a sense of immersion?”
Soon, a confident voice came from the other end of the phone.
“Yi, don’t worry, there are no problems.”
“I’ve gone over it with several psychologists, and from a psychological perspective, any event that happens next is acceptable for Wen Ping. At this point, Wen Ping is essentially in a process where his worldview has been shattered and needs to be rebuilt. Adding a little spice during this process is fine.”

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 641 401 At this point theres no use hiding it
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 641: Chapter 401: “At this point, there’s no use hiding it anymore. Chapter 641: Chapter 401: “At this point, there’s no use hiding it anymore. “Is it really just because you found out the woman you like has such a past that your worldview collapses?”
“For most people, maybe not, but for someone like Wen Ping, it absolutely does, and even more serious than a worldview collapse. A little more seriously, there might be a very strong suicidal mood.”
“I see.”
Chen Yi nodded, ended the chat communication, and turned his head to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a slightly hurried voice, “We’ve reached the sixth act, and in a few more scenes, it’ll be time to close the net.”
“So far, Wen Ping hasn’t shown the slightest suspicion, everything should be fine, and the net closing should go smoothly.”
“You prepare something in advance.”
“Damn it, I haven’t eaten in days, and my mouth has lost all taste. Once I finish this, let’s all have a good meal.”
“Sure thing.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with an excited expression, patted his chest and drew out a long sound in agreement.
He hadn’t eaten in a long time, since the start of the Illusory Realm, he hadn’t had a meal even though all the props on him ensured he didn’t feel hunger and his body was supplemented with nutrients and energy.
But his mouth really hadn’t chewed on anything for a long time.
It felt very bland.
Just now, he bit into a string of meat tendons Tuberculosis Rabbit handed over, and the moment he bit down, because it had been so long since he had eaten, the sourness in his teeth twisted his face together.
Teeth are like muscles.
They both need to be used regularly. If you leave them idle for too long, they tend to get dull.
…
“Sit down.”
Soon, Wen Ping arrived at Meimiao Community and came to Little Miao’s house, the one right across from that of the woman he had killed.
Little Miao had already prepared a big table of food and two bottles of white liquor.
She was haggard but still forcefully squeezing out a smile, standing at the door to greet Wen Ping.
Seeing the pale weariness on Little Miao’s face, Wen Ping felt a bit of heartache for her, yet also relieved. It was clear that Little Miao had not eaten or slept well because of this incident in the past few days.
This at least showed that Little Miao cared about him, minded his opinion of her, and was even more concerned about whether he would leave.
This gave him a heart-throbbing feeling he had never experienced before.
It was as if… there was a mutual effort in their relationship.
It wasn’t just him, crying in a helpless rage like a rat in a gutter, hidden in the shadows while the other person acted as if nothing had ever happened, continuing to live a happy life as usual.
The weariness on Little Miao’s face made him feel respected, needed, and cared for.
“I…”
Wen Ping’s mouth slowly opened and closed a few times, but in the end, he didn’t say anything, just quietly changed into slippers, walked to the dining table, pulled out a chair, and sat down.
Maybe he was overwhelmed by his emotions.
He almost couldn’t restrain himself from saying that actually, he might be able to accept it.
A long, long time ago.
He didn’t remember where he had read a saying that all boys with a virginity complex who have never been in love will completely lose the concept of a virginity complex when they meet a girl who is not a virgin but whom they fall madly in love with.
Back then, he had scoffed at that statement; he could never fall in love with a girl who wasn’t ‘clean.’
He wasn’t an idiot.
To know the other person isn’t ‘clean,’ and yet unable to accept it, still falling madly in love, wasn’t that just tormenting oneself? Who would do that if they were in their right mind?
But now, he thought he might understand that statement.
Perhaps he really was sick in the head.
From the moment he resolved to leave Blue Star forever and never see Little Miao again, to these past few days when maybe it wasn’t that he couldn’t accept it, seeing Little Miao in such a worn state because of this matter made his heart even more pained, and he had softened even more.
After inviting Wen Ping to take a seat, Little Miao didn’t say anything else but silently took a few bites of food, kept pouring herself glass after glass of white liquor, and continued to drink alone.
Wen Ping didn’t know what to say.
He followed Little Miao’s rhythm, a bite of food, a sip of liquor.
Soon, both were slightly intoxicated.
And then—
Little Miao was the first to speak, her eyes reddened, looking directly at Wen Ping with an aggrieved tone, “Why did you suddenly disappear and stop replying to my messages? Is it just because you saw that photo album?”
“Because of what’s in that album, do you plan to forget about our time together as if it was nothing?”
“My best friend was brutally murdered, and the reason I could get over it so quickly is all because of you, giving a new direction to my life. But what have you been doing these days? What do you think of me?”
“I…”
Wen Ping’s mouth once again opened and closed slowly, again at a loss for what to say. If he were still acting as his old self, he would definitely have sneered and asked back, “So what?” But now, he could not bring himself to say those words no matter what.
He subconsciously defended himself, “No, I’ve been dealing with a stomach flu for the past few days, constantly running to the bathroom, with no time to reply to messages.”
“Heh.”
Little Miao shook her head, chuckled lightly, a hint of disappointment flickering in her eyes as she looked up at Wen Ping, “I’m very disappointed in you. Not because you saw that album and disappeared, but because you wouldn’t even listen to my explanation.”
“You didn’t even have the courage to come and ask me.”
“And just now, you didn’t even dare to admit that you’ve been avoiding me because of this incident.”
“Fine, since you don’t want to ask, let me tell you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - 642 401 At this point I wont hide it
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 642: Chapter 401: “At this point, I won’t hide it anymore.”_3 Chapter 642: Chapter 401: “At this point, I won’t hide it anymore.”_3 Wen Ping didn’t speak, but silently bowed his head and poured another glass of white liquor into his stomach.
In fact, he could guess what Little Miao would say.
It would either be that someone forced her, or that she desperately needed some Points and had no choice but to yield to someone, or maybe an ex-boyfriend had some special preferences, and for love, she did whatever he wanted.
Beyond these reasons, what else could there be?
Yet before he came, his heart had already begun to waver. Perhaps he could accept it, after all, if Little Miao could choose again, she definitely wouldn’t want such an experience.
“That woman in the photo album isn’t me.”
“Huh?”
Wen Ping, who had been prepared to hear what sort of excuse Little Miao would come up with, had his brain freeze at her words, and he looked up in bafflement, “Not you?”
Big sister.
I thought you were going to make excuses for yourself, but are you trying to find an ‘I’ve got bad eyesight’ excuse for me now?
Should he accept this excuse then?
If he just accepted this excuse like that, wouldn’t it make him seem exceedingly stupid?”
“Yes.”
Little Miao took a deep breath, her face serious as she spoke, “That woman isn’t me, you might not believe me when I say this, given that you are just an ordinary player on Blue Star.”
“But I, Little Miao, I am actually not a player from Blue Star.”
“I am a player from the Mo Clan on Tenfold Planet, the one led by Jiang Chenglu. In a battle in the future, I unfortunately perished, and in the battles on Tenfold Planet, those who die cannot descend to hell; they are utterly dead.”
“I thought I would fall into darkness forever, but when I opened my eyes, I found that I had been reincarnated.”
“I was reborn on Blue Star.”
“At that time, the game of advancing through the star systems had not yet reached Blue Star. Three months after my rebirth, the game came to Blue Star, and I suddenly realized, I had actually been reborn on a Novice Planet.”
“Using my experience from my previous life, I quickly became a very powerful player!”
“But then—”
Suddenly, intense hatred and ferocity appeared in Little Miao’s eyes, “I encountered Chen Yi. Back then, Chen Yi was also a strong player, but not as strong as he is now. He took a liking to a Prop I had and came to demand it.”
“I didn’t give it to him.”
“So he tortured me slowly until I couldn’t hold out any longer and handed over the Prop. Only then did he kill me, and after descending to hell, I’ve been hiding ever since, and sure enough, it wasn’t long before I heard that Chen Yi had sent someone to completely eradicate me in hell.”
“You can search this up online now; you should still be able to find bits and pieces of it. Chen Yi can’t shut everyone up.”
“Since then, instead of living a good life with the advantage of my previous life’s experience, I’ve had to hide from Chen Yi’s pursuit constantly.”
Afterwards, Chen Yi took a deep breath, looked at Wen Ping in front of him, and started to laugh at himself, “Actually, I shouldn’t have told you this because all Blue Star players have a blind worship towards Chen Yi.”
“Are you thinking now about going to report me to Chen Yi?”
“That’s understandable.”
“Actually, you’ve all been deceived by Chen Yi. That Chen Yi is not at all a hero, but a robber, freely taking others’ possessions, and moreover, a demonic beast who kills other Races at will!!!”
“Such a person, I don’t understand why people worship him!”
“Hiding for so many days, I’m tired too.”
Little Miao slowly closed her eyes, her expression calm as she leaned back in her chair and whispered, “Go ahead and report me, the rewards from Chen Yi should be more than enough for you to live comfortably for the rest of your life. I don’t want to hide anymore.”
“I have no family in this world. When I first came back from rebirth, I didn’t even have a home and had to wander the streets, until my best friend saw me by the roadside and took pity on me, bringing me back home and giving me a place to stay.”
“But now, even she is dead.”
“I have no relatives left in this world, nothing to hold on to anymore.”
“…”
“…”
“…”
If one could describe Wen Ping’s facial expression at that moment with a sentence, it would be that his mouth was agape wide enough to fit a dozen eggs.
Wen Ping, looking utterly incredulous, mouth wide open as if his jaw had hit the floor, held his glass of liquor in his hand, body frozen in place as he stared in shock at the woman in front of him!
Rebirth… Revenge…
What happened to having a sincere talk? He thought he was going to hear some reasons and excuses, but she went straight to telling him a story?
Rebirth?
Can people really be reborn after dying?
But… one thing Little Miao just said created some ripples in his heart. It was common knowledge among Blue Star players that the Mo Clan had advanced to become a Ninefold Star System; after all, the announcement was broadcast throughout the entire Star System.
Moreover, it was rumored that before the Mo Clan ascended to become the Tenfold Planet, their leader, Jiang Chenglu, was killed once by Chen Yi from Blue Star, something the players naturally wouldn’t know.
But—
After ascending to become the Tenfold Planet, death became permanent.
This was top-secret information.
In the entire game of advancement, only a very few with unique channels of information would know this, and even he had learned about it by luck, having stumbled upon the news at max level.
For a player from a Novice Planet to know this information was practically impossible.
“You… You really are reincarnated?”
“Yes, I know this is hard for you to accept, and I didn’t expect you to believe me. I wanted to fabricate a more convincing lie, but in the end, I chose to face you with sincerity. I haven’t told this to anyone; you are the first to know.”

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 643 401 At this point theres no need for me to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 643: Chapter 401: “At this point, there’s no need for me to hide it anymore.” -4 Chapter 643: Chapter 401: “At this point, there’s no need for me to hide it anymore.” -4 “What’s it like after advancing to Tenfold Planet? Is it difficult to advance?”
“It’s the end, the last stop, the final battle against the Gods and Demons. The difficulty of advancement is not great.” Little Miao shook her head as she spoke: “Actually, you’ve all been deceived. There is almost no difficulty in advancing from Ninefold Planet to Tenfold Planet. That’s why Mo Clan could become the first to advance to Tenfold Planet.”
“It’s because the other Ninefold Planets didn’t dare to advance, as everyone knew that once you advanced, you would have to face a fierce final battle once you left.”
“No one dared to go out.”
“Mo Clan dared.”
“So, Mo Clan became a player who advanced to Tenfold Planet.”
Little Miao quietly spoke of the secrets unknown to the rookie players, and even Wen Ping definitely didn’t know. Chen Yi, who controlled Little Miao’s actions, only licked the corner of her mouth with a wistful expression on her face.
All this stuff, really was quite bluffing.
If Santa Claus hadn’t told him these things, he would have been unaware too. Seeing the shocked expression on Wen Ping’s face at this moment, he knew that Wen Ping didn’t know either.
Hey.
Go figure it out.
…
“So that’s how it is, that’s how it is!!!”
Wen Ping incredulously lit a cigarette and brought it to his mouth, muttering to himself in sudden realization: “So that’s the way it is.”
