After Jiang Chenglu was killed by Chen Yi, Jiang Chenglu’s Ninefold Planet Mo Clan advanced.
At the time, he was puzzled. If he were the ruler of another Ninefold Planet, he would undoubtedly pay any price to capture Chen Yi and then force out what happened between Jiang Chenglu and Chen Yi before the advancement.
To find the path to advance to Tenfold Planet.
But the other Ninefold Planets didn’t do so. They just sent a few weaklings and then made no further moves. At that time, he wondered if it might be because the ascending game imposed too many restrictions on the Ninefold Planets.
Now it seemed that these Ninefold Planets had long known the way to advance to Tenfold Planet but were unwilling to go to the final battle, hence they delayed doing the task of advancing to Tenfold Planet.
“Then… did Jiang Chenglu win in the end?”
“I don’t know.”
Little Miao shook her head: “When I was resurrected, Mo Clan had been fighting for two years, with over eighty percent of the players dead. Only Emperor Jiang with some of the elite were still fighting. At that time, they hadn’t lost, but the tide of defeat was already very clear.”
“If nothing unexpected happened afterward, they probably lost.”
“I just didn’t see that scene.”
“Did… Jiang Chenglu mention Chen Yi beforehand?”
“It seems he mentioned once.” Little Miao tilted her head and pondered for a long time before speaking, “It seems that Emperor Jiang sighed shortly after he advanced, saying that this little guy’s fate wasn’t tough enough, just died like that.”
“I have quite a profound impression of Chen Yi because before I was resurrected, Emperor Jiang had once died at the hands of Chen Yi before his advancement. I don’t know the specific reasons, just know that after the advancement, Jiang Huang paid attention to Chen Yi’s recent movements twice, the last time was when Chen Yi died.”
“So when I realized that I was resurrected on Blue Star, I was so excited. With my talent for foresight, I could completely snatch all the opportunities that belonged to Chen Yi in my previous life and make myself into the likes of a hero like Chen Yi.”
“It’s just… it was I who got it first.”
“Yet Chen Yi still insisted on robbing it forcibly, without any reason, leading me to end up in such a plight.”
“Huff…”
Wen Ping slowly took a deep breath, calming the shock in his heart, and was about to say something when he suddenly realized: “Wait a minute, Little Miao, weren’t you explaining about that photo album?”
“Being reborn for half a day, what does that have to do with the photo album?”
“Oh, it’s like this.”
Little Miao started speaking somewhat tipsily, “I said I was a vagrant when I was reborn, right? At that time, this bestie of mine was a freelancer, which means she was an escort, but not like those working in clubs.”
“This bestie of mine took orders by herself and went out to meet clients on her own, no pimp involved, so she didn’t have to share her profits.”
“She rented a separate room just for me.”
“Since she often had clients coming to her place, it wasn’t convenient for us to live together, so she rented a room opposite hers for me to stay in. She needed to show her clients the portfolio often, but she wasn’t very photogenic.”
“So she took all her photos and photoshopped my face onto them, so that clients would be satisfied when they booked on the app, and even if they found out things didn’t match up in person, most wouldn’t opt for a change.”
“It’s all about being tactful.”
“There’s a famous saying on Blue Star, ‘Since you’re already here.’
“So…”
Wen Ping murmured in confusion, “So the person in that album, it’s actually not you? It’s your bestie? Only with your face photoshopped onto it?”
“That’s right.”
“Your bestie used your face to take orders? And then used her own body to fulfill them?”
“That’s the logic.”
“…”
“…”
After falling silent again, Wen Ping took a long time before he lit a cigarette, took a deep drag, and asked hoarsely, “Let me get this straight. So, have you had a history of living together, or maybe some sort of perverted ex-boyfriend?”
“No.”
Little Miao slowly hung her head and said softly, “In my past and present life, I’ve never been in a relationship. I don’t know how to love someone, nor how to reciprocate someone’s affection.”
“But after meeting you, I think that might change in this lifetime.”
“Huh.”
Wen Ping massaged his temples with a slight headache, “Well, that’s good news, I suppose.”
“And about this rebirth… did Jiang Chenglu tell you how Chen Yi died?”
“He didn’t mention that, and I didn’t ask. It just came up once when Emperor Jiang was talking to himself. It seemed like he was killed by a player.”
“You might not believe this, but…”
Little Miao poured herself another glass of wine, “During the days Chen Yi was hunting me, I was always fantasizing that the player who killed Chen Yi would come to fetch me on a cloud of seven colors under the setting sun, to rescue me from the sea of suffering.”
“Yet, he never came.”
“And I’ve been waiting all along.”
“I’m sorry, talking about this might make you uncomfortable, after all, Chen Yi is seen as the most admirable figure by players on Blue Star, but…” Little Miao hesitated for a long time before trying to broach the subject, “But it seems like you don’t really respect Chen Yi either?”
“…”
Wen Ping paused for quite some time before he picked up a glass of alcohol, finished it in one gulp, wiped his mouth, and stared at Little Miao with a serious and earnest expression.
“At this point, I won’t hide it anymore.”

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 644 402 Having Such a Wife What More Could a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 644: Chapter 402: Having Such a Wife, What More Could a Husband Ask For! Chapter 644: Chapter 402: Having Such a Wife, What More Could a Husband Ask For! “…”
Following Wen Ping’s words, Little Miao stood there, stunned, momentarily unsure how to respond.
…
Meanwhile.
Occupying the God’s eye view, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Chen Yi, Sword Without End, Tie Chui, and Jiaye were sitting with great interest on chairs suspended in midair, looking through the ceiling of the lower level at Wen Ping and his companions in the bedroom below.
Yes.
Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others had also come to watch the commotion.
Originally, Tuberculosis Rabbit wouldn’t have been able to enter, since the “Apple of Eden” could only be used on a single player, drawing that player into the Illusory Realm. However, Tuberculosis Rabbit had been clever, using the Prop on Chen Yi, dragging him into his own Illusory Realm.
Then Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t change anything in his Illusory Realm, taking Chen Yi’s as the standard, and in this way, Sword Without End and the others also entered the Illusory Realm one by one.
“Why bother.”
Chen Yi sighed softly, waving his hand to touch the air, feeling somewhat helpless. He was now within Tuberculosis Rabbit’s Illusory Realm. He hadn’t imagined Tuberculosis Rabbit would research for so long just to come in and watch the show.
“Yi,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said with slight excitement, “This is the most critical scene! If I missed this, I’d have so much regret!”
“Wen Ping is starting to believe Little Miao might be a Reincarnator.”
“Reincarnator, ah!”
“Such a fantastical term, and Wen Ping seems to have believed it so quickly.”
“Probably read too many novels in the past,”
Sword Without End said with a complex expression and an emotional click of his tongue. To be frank, he had once suspected Yi was a Reincarnator; after all, everyone was starting from the same point at Blue Star, so why did Yi suddenly get so far ahead?
It just didn’t make sense.
If Yi was a Reincarnator, then everything would make sense. Using memories from a past life to snatch up all the best rewards of the Novice Period, that would be rational.
But after further thought,
he realized this guess wasn’t quite right either. He had joined Yi’s team when Yi wasn’t very strong, and at that time, Yi’s power was indeed limited. Then gradually, Yi went on a killing spree.
From the God Race invasion, which was the first Race invasion of Blue Star, the wheels of fate had slowly started turning, opening Pandora’s box.
“Not right…”
Sword Without End’s expression suddenly became odd. If he remembered correctly, the real thing that propelled Yi’s rise was the “Title of Wife Kiler.” It was a powerful weapon that Yi used for a long time.
In many crises and disasters, Yi used that title to overcome difficulties.
And if he wasn’t mistaken, that title was given to Yi by him, wasn’t it?
It was during their first meeting when Yi had a costume set he needed, and he traded Yi an Admission Ticket for a dungeon that could award a “unique global character action.”
This dungeon Admission Ticket could only be cleared by a player once.
He had already cleared it once, so the ticket was practically useless to him, just like a piece of waste paper. Trading it for a costume set he needed seemed like a good deal.
In fact, at that time, he could have sold the ticket for a high price and given some Points to Yi. That way, he would have made some profit.
But at that time, he also felt Yi was worth befriending, sort of like doing a favor for Yi.
Back then, although Yi was strong, his strength was still limited, which made him think that with a bit of a struggle and a good opportunity, he could get a handle on things.
But now…
Everything had changed.
And it was in that dungeon which awarded the “unique global character action” that Yi obtained the “Title of Wife Killer” that would eventually dominate all sides.
Damn… Is this cause and effect?
Does it mean that a large part of Yi’s current status and strength is all because of him? If it weren’t for him, Yi never would have had the chance to obtain that title, and without it, during the first God Race invasion, he and Yi would have both gone to hell.
“…”
All of a sudden, Sword Without End’s expression became strange as he lapsed into silence. Thinking over it, it felt so weird; he also didn’t know why at the time he had impulsively sought out Chen Yi and then handed over the dungeon ticket.
Damn it…
He couldn’t be like some character in a fantasy novel, right? Was his actual role just to deliver that dungeon Admission Ticket to Yi?
That was absurd.
Sword Without End sighed softly and shook his head, not wanting to think about it anymore. Maybe he was overthinking it. But one thing was certain: Yi could not have reached today’s heights without him, Sword Without End. So, in the future, perhaps he could… be a bit more arrogant.
…
“What’s wrong?”
Looking at Little Miao who was still hesitating and undecided, Wen Ping said with a glint of disappointment and self-mockery in his eyes, “Is it hard to make a choice?”
“Have you ever heard a story?”
“One day, a farmer carrying his worn-out ax went to chop trees across the river, but while on the bridge, he accidentally dropped his ax into the water. The River God emerged from the water holding two axes, asking the farmer, is the ax you lost in my left hand, this iron one, or in my right hand, this golden one?”
“It’s hard to make a choice, right? Do you feel like you’re that farmer now?”
“It is indeed.”
“I actually compared myself with someone you regard as a great individual, that was overreaching on my part. Perhaps I’m just a passerby, simply someone who passed through your life.”

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 645 402 With such a wife what more could a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 645: Chapter 402: With such a wife, what more could a husband ask for?_2 Chapter 645: Chapter 402: With such a wife, what more could a husband ask for?_2 “It’s gotten a bit cold today.”
“Not cold in body, but cold in heart.”
…
“What’s all this,” Jiaye frowned as he looked down at the scene, “I hate boys who wallow in self-pity and speak in such an affected manner the most. Ugh, it’s so cringeworthy, what is he even saying?”
“That line is just too awkward.”
“If we were to actually produce a TV show like this, we’d lose so much money.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement, “It is indeed a bit awkward, but there’s nothing we can do. We can’t control Wen Ping’s lines, and those are the true feelings flowing from him.”
“Maybe Wen Ping is trying to create a sense of guilt in Little Miao’s heart at this moment, um… I can’t quite describe the feeling, perhaps he wants her to feel guilty?”
“Not sure.”
“Anyway, it seems many people in love are like this, especially those in their first relationship. Isn’t there a saying, ‘Men in their first love are so pathetic, even dogs would despise them.'”
“Basically, a guy’s first love is the time he loves to reminisce the most; it’s when feelings are the most genuine and pure. But often, it’s also the most embarrassing period. Just thinking back on how they acted during their first love makes most want to burrow into a hole and hide.”
“If Wen Ping were to live another decade or so and remember the words he’s saying now, he’d probably die of embarrassment without us lifting a finger.”
“True.”
Sword Without End smiled, lost in memories, “First love… a time so genuinely passionate and awkward yet pure in every boy’s heart, indeed worthy of being chronicled in the story of life.”
…
Meanwhile, in the living room below.
Upon hearing Wen Ping’s words, Little Miao paused and quickly started to explain, “No, no, you’ve got it wrong. I haven’t answered for so long, not because I was hesitating to make a choice.”
“If it really were a choice, I would definitely choose you, after all… after all, I do have feelings for you.”
“And that so-called hero is just someone I imagined. There’s really no such person; he’s just a beautiful wish of someone who could pull me out of misery.”
As she spoke, Little Miao shyly lowered her head.
“Rather affected, Yi needs to improve his acting skills,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit offered a scathing critique from the audience.
But for Wen Ping, this scene was extremely pleasing; his throat bobbed as if it could compete with a V8 engine.
“The reason I hesitated for so long is that I was pondering one thing, that is… as I’ve just confessed, I was not a Blue Star player in my past life. If I have the chance to leave, I might return to the Mo Clan, and find my old companions.”
“I wonder if you could accept a player from an alien race?”
“Phew!”
Wen Ping took a deep breath and laughed, “No more pretending, let’s lay our cards on the table!”
“Actually, I’m not a Blue Star player either. I’m Wen Ping, a player from Fivefold Planet. The reason I came to Blue Star is to complete a decisive mission, which I’ve successfully accomplished.”
“However, there’s been a slight problem with the Starfield Shuttle System; the system is still under maintenance. I temporarily can’t return to my own planet, so I have to stay on Blue Star for the time being.”
“Just at this time, sheer chance brought me here for a blind date, and then I met you.”
“I can be absolutely certain that you are the most important person in my life. I don’t see a single flaw in you.”
“I’m very grateful that I could come to Blue Star to participate in this decisive mission, grateful that I survived, even more grateful that the Starfield Shuttle System is under maintenance for now. Most importantly, sheer chance brought me to this blind date, which enabled me to meet you.”
“All of this, every bit of it, was for today.”
“Little Miao, if you’re willing to be with me, from now on, the rest of your life will be the most important to me. I will fulfill all your requests, without exception.”
“…”
Little Miao sat in shock for a long time before murmuring as she lifted her wine glass to her lips, “This is a bit too coincidental, isn’t it?”
“It is precisely this multitude of coincidences that brought us together, and that’s what makes our connection so precious and unique.”
Wen Ping declared with utter conviction, “The heavens themselves want us to be together.”
“…”
Little Miao sat in the chair for a long time without speaking. After a while, she lifted her wine glass to her lips and murmured, “You said you came to Blue Star to engage in a decisive battle?”
“With whom?”
“Chen Yi.”
“Chen Yi???”
“Yes, I won’t lie to you. He had a prop called ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains,’ and I had a prop called ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea.’ These two props are a set. The player possessing them must engage in a decisive battle.”
“The battle can only truly end when one party dies.”
“And in this battle, I killed Chen Yi to obtain the final Chen Yi.”
Little Miao’s mouth fell open, her face a mix of shock and disbelief, and after a moment she started searching rapidly on the Blue Star forums, “I can’t find any information about Chen Yi’s death.”
“The news hasn’t spread yet, there’s been no announcement.”
“But you must have noticed, Chen Yi hasn’t been active for a while, or is there some other movement?”
“Could it be that you really killed Chen Yi?”
“What else could it be?”
“So the hero who I imagined arriving on a rainbow cloud to defeat Chen Yi was you?”
“Exactly.” Wen Ping stood up, showing off his Points Balance with a face full of pride and self-satisfaction, and patted his chest saying, “So close yet so far!”

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - 646 402 Having Such a Wife What More Could a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 646: Chapter 402: Having Such a Wife, What More Could a Husband Ask For?_3 Chapter 646: Chapter 402: Having Such a Wife, What More Could a Husband Ask For?_3 “You… you’re the player from the future legend who killed Chen Yi?”
“That should be correct.”
Little Miao’s eyes gradually reddened, and after a few moments, she couldn’t hold back any longer and threw herself into Wen Ping’s arms, sobbing loudly, “Why did you only come now? Do you know how miserably Chen Yi has been hunting me down recently?”
“I can’t even sleep.”
“He’s really not human.”
“He’s an animal.”
“Alright, alright.”
Wen Ping, with a face full of compassion, hugged Little Miao close and gently patted her back, whispering words of comfort, “It’s okay now, it’s all okay, everything has been taken care of, I’m here so don’t worry.”
“Chen Yi will never bully you again.”
“Nor will anyone else ever bully you again.”
“With the two unique, growing S-grade artifacts in the Entire Star System in my hand, I can block most enemies for you.”
At that moment, Little Miao raised her head from Wen Ping’s chest, her face streaked with tears, “But what if we encounter an enemy you can’t block?”
Wen Ping smiled but did not speak, simply lowering his head to tenderly fix Little Miao’s bangs, gently wiping the tears from her face.
“If we encounter an enemy that we can’t block.”
“I’ll die with you.”
“In this lifetime, you will never die before me.”
“A man will never let his woman die before him. That Demon who gains power by killing his own wife, what right does he have to be called a man? He’s nothing more than a beast.”
“Even if you can be revived, how can you ever undo the psychological scars it leaves?”
“…”
Chen Yi, who was controlling Little Miao’s body, was about to say something when he heard these words, a direct hit to the face, and suddenly felt a crack in his defenses.
…
“Ahem.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, observing from a god-like perspective, cleared his throat with a slightly embarrassed cough and said, “Uh, don’t take what Yi said seriously, that kid is all talk.”
“Exactly.”
Jiaye also leaned into Chen Yi’s embrace to comfort him, “If it weren’t for Yi, I would have ended up cleaning the deepest pits of hell with Tie Chui. Being able to contribute to you, Yi, instead of just being a trophy, also makes me feel very happy.”
“If I had nothing to offer and just stood by your side like a trophy, then when you love me, I would feel overwhelmed and unworthy.”
“I actually enjoy it.”
“Every time you kill me, Yi, it gives me a sense of fulfillment, feeling like I’ve done something for you.”
“At first, I didn’t understand that feeling, but later I realized it’s the satisfaction of being able to help the one you love.”
“If a great danger came upon you, Yi, and I was completely useless, only able to stand by and watch, that would be truly despairing, wouldn’t it?”
“…”
Sword Without End sat upright and expressionless to one side, silent.
He didn’t know what to say.
That display of affection Wen Ping just put on, assuming his high-minded sentimentality, made him cringe. Wen Ping couldn’t possibly think he was channelling Cupid, believing every word he uttered was glittering with pink stars, the epitome of romance, could he?
And Jiaye’s declaration of love was equally cringe-inducing to him.
It was the first time he had seen someone express love by saying they actually enjoyed getting killed by the other person.
It was all too chaotic.
It was all too chaotic.
The world had become too chaotic; he no longer knew what to call it. As someone who cherished pure love, he felt like an outsider.
…
“I like you.”
Little Miao, her face full of love and shyness, buried her head in Wen Ping’s chest, and with that, the two were truly together. Actually, for a romantic relationship, a guy should generally not be the one to confess his love.
Confession is a very misguided action.
When a guy confesses, the girl will start to think rationally about many things instantly, such as whether the guy is handsome, if he has any bad habits, what’s his temper like, income, future career plans, social circles, family background. If she chooses to be with that guy, she will consider how her close friends might view it and so on.
So many complicated and troublesome questions will flood her mind.
And the answer often comes back as, “Sorry, we’re not suitable for each other.”
It’s not just an excuse—it truly is a matter of incompatibility, as there aren’t many who can meet all those criteria. Even scammers can’t create such a perfect boyfriend without sufficient information and intelligence.
But if a guy never confesses and just creates an ambiguous atmosphere, acting restless in his actions but reserved in his words, the likelihood of ending up together is much higher.
“Confession” is an aggressive action.
For most girls, due to the innate physical conditions of their bodies, they naturally lack a sense of security and will subconsciously counter or resist the “aggressive actions” of others, especially men.
Confession is just that, an aggressive action.
But if confession is replaced by creating ambiguity, it changes from an aggressive action to a softer mode of “boiling the frog in warm water.”
Thus, for many inexperienced male lovers, it is often a foolish thing to confess to the girl they like. They muster a lot of courage to confess after preparing mentally for it.
The result, in most cases, is rejection.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 647 402 Having Such a Wife What More Could a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 647: Chapter 402: Having Such a Wife, What More Could a Husband Ask For?_4 Chapter 647: Chapter 402: Having Such a Wife, What More Could a Husband Ask For?_4 Many boys often think that girls are too difficult to pursue, but in reality, it’s just because they are foolish.
Moreover, not confessing has a very powerful advantage, in that I will never lose. Even if the other person wants to reject you, they can’t bring themselves to speak. How do they put it, say “I actually don’t like you, you don’t need to pursue me”?
Then you could totally retort, “Who’s pursuing you? Aren’t we just ordinary friends? Did I ever say I liked you?”
A critical move that catches the other party completely by surprise.
I might not win, but I will never lose!
But just like all boys who fall in love for the first time, Wen Ping couldn’t wait to confess, crazily expressing his love. At this moment, Chen Yi didn’t manipulate Little Miao to reject Wen Ping, causing another emotional turmoil.
Instead, she just agreed and gave a passionate response.
Boys understand boys better.
Boy help boy.
He knew what Wen Ping needed most was a response, and as long as he provided it at that moment, Wen Ping’s love for Little Miao would escalate to a new level.
Afterward—
Wen Ping and Little Miao were seen dizzily and indulgently kissing each other’s dental plaque between their teeth.
Under the influence of alcohol.
The two collapsed onto the bedroom bed and began to intimately intertwine…
“Okay, cut.”
Chen Yi’s face calm, he cut off the projection: “The next scene is not suitable for children, forbidden for audiences under 108 years of age. You can’t watch anymore, if there’s nothing else, you all can disperse now.”
“What a bummer.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said with some displeasure: “I’ve only heard of 18+ restrictions, it’s the first time I’ve seen a 108+ one. Just getting to the good part and it’s not allowed, so annoying, Yi, let us have a peek.”
“No.”
No matter what Tuberculosis Rabbit said, Chen Yi remained unphased.
It’s a joke.
Jiaye is still here.
How could he possibly let Jiaye see another man’s junk.
Don’t even think about it.
“Alright…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed reluctantly…
The progress seemed to accelerate from there.
Wen Ping and Little Miao started dating formally, and Wen Ping moved from the hotel to Little Miao’s home. As for the hotel room, he didn’t bother to cancel it. There was plenty of rent left, and he didn’t care.
It wasn’t like he was short on cash.
Just a few hundred Points.
He could sneeze more than that amount.
Moreover, the most important thing now was to enjoy his romantic times.
Wen Ping, on his first love, stuck to Little Miao like fire, almost inseparable 24 hours a day—eating together, bathing together, sleeping together, shopping together, having fun together.
Apart from not going to the toilet together, they spent all other time with one another.
And through chatting, the two grew to understand each other’s pasts even better, deepening their affection.
Just like that.
Time leisurely moved on to January 12th.
Since December 28th a lot of time had passed, nearly 20 days. During these 20 days, Wen Ping hadn’t realized that he was in the Illusory Realm, that everything about him was fake.
‘Ding, do you choose to start the transport? If refused, a prompt will pop up again after 24 hours.’
Wen Ping glanced at the system prompt and almost without any hesitation chose to refuse.
In the beginning, he did look forward to the Starfield Shuttle being repaired soon so he could return home quickly, but now that it was fixed, he suddenly didn’t want to leave so soon.
If he went back now, it would be months before he could see Little Miao again, waiting until the Novice Period on Blue Star ends.
That would feel like a very long time.
He didn’t want to wait.
“Uncle Wen Ping.”
Little Miao leaned into Wen Ping’s arms as they sat on the balcony sofa, looking at the beautiful view outside, and said softly, “I really want to go to your planet with you, I don’t want to stay on Blue Star anymore.”
“What’s wrong?”
Wen Ping was slightly startled before laughing and said, “Aren’t you going back to your Mo Clan? Isn’t the Mo Clan your home?”
“I always thought the Mo Clan was my home, but after meeting you, I realized that you are my home. There’s an old saying on Blue Star, ‘to marry a chicken is to follow the chicken, to marry a dog is to follow the dog.’ If nothing unexpected happens, I want to follow you for the rest of my life.”
Wen Ping sighed softly, his face filled with tenderness as he gently stroked Little Miao’s hair.
To have such a wife, what more could a husband ask for!
Enough indeed.
Enough indeed!!!
He actually also wanted Little Miao to leave the Novice Planet, but the biggest problem was that, due to Chen Yi, Blue Star had made countless enemies. It wasn’t just one or two enemies, but dozens, hundreds even.
Not even mentioning the protection fees collected, there were countless races involved.
Now that Chen Yi was dead, once that news got out, once the Novice Period on Blue Star ended, it was predictable that on the very day, a massive number of race armies would convene in the Blue Star’s Star System No. 3 to launch a terrifying attack on Blue Star.
To retaliate for the past grievances.
And without Chen Yi, how could Blue Star defend? How could it possibly withstand such an onslaught?
Annihilation was almost certain, and if Blue Star was annihilated, Little Miao would die too. Although she was a player of the Mo Clan in her previous life, this life she was indeed a player of Blue Star; if Blue Star was annihilated, Little Miao would die too.
Could he protect Blue Star?
To be honest, even though he killed Chen Yi, his strength lay in his super high defensive power as long as he didn’t want to die, no one could kill him. In terms of attack power, he was far inferior to Chen Yi.
Chen Yi could have protected Blue Star.
He couldn’t.
Chen Yi could slaughter other races.
He couldn’t do that.
In this regard, no matter how arrogant he was by nature, he knew he was not as good as Chen Yi; there was nothing to be obstinate about here.
“If only…”
Wen Ping said in a trance: “If only you could leave Blue Star and join my planet.”
He did know of a Prop that could allow a player to leave their Race and join another one, but such Props were extremely rare; he had never seen one, just overheard it in some information channel.
He had never even laid eyes on it.
To acquire such a Prop would be extremely difficult.
“Huh?”

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 648 403 Occupation Gold Miner
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 648: Chapter 403: “Occupation”: Gold Miner! Chapter 648: Chapter 403: “Occupation”: Gold Miner! The next second—
A streak of white light flashed by, and a septagonal token appeared out of thin air in Wen Ping’s hand.
“Prop Name”: Race Change Command.
“Item Level”: A-grade.
“Prop Effect”: Upon successful activation of this prop, it will erase the player’s current racial bindings and the player may join any other race at will.
“Prop Restriction”: To prevent malicious use of the prop by players for purposes such as espionage within other races, the prop holder must successfully kill a player of the desired race who has a relatively high reputation in order to join that race.
Otherwise, joining is not permitted.
“Prop Explanation”: One’s background is not necessarily unchangeable.
“It worked!!!”
Wen Ping looked at the prop in his hand with satisfaction, grinning with excitement. His luck points never disappointed him; every time he opened any chest with a specific prop in mind, that prop would surely be inside.
If he didn’t know what the chest contained or what he could possibly get out of it, and he didn’t think about what he desired, the default would be the most valuable item in that chest.
Just now, when he was opening this chest, all he could think about was getting the “Race Change Command”.
And so—
It really did come true as he had wished, he obtained the “Race Change Command!”
“Did it really work?”
Little Miao excitedly kissed the token in her arms repeatedly before wrapping her arms around Wen Ping’s neck and said tenderly, her eyes full of love, “Finally, we can always be together, my unparalleled hero.”
“But…”
At that moment, Little Miao seemed to notice the restriction described on the prop panel: “There seems to be a restriction. To join a race, one must first kill a player of substantial reputation from that race.”
“Looks like there’s no hope for the Mo Clan. I can’t go back.”
With her current strength, she couldn’t compare to the Mo Clan at all; they weren’t even on the same level.
Besides, she couldn’t possibly kill a player of high standing within the Mo Clan. After all, the Mo Clan had upgraded to the Tenfold Planet, while she was still in the novice stage on Blue Star. The difference between them was just too great, and even if she had the strength, she lacked the time.
“I can understand this restriction.”
Wen Ping secretly rejoiced and heaved a sigh of relief. The prop’s restriction meant that Little Miao could never return to the Mo Clan, so naturally, she would have to obediently come home with him.
“After all, think about it. If you were to use this prop to infiltrate an opposing race, right?”
“But with this restriction, it’s different. Players who have some influence within a race are not weak. Killing such a player at least proves that the player has some strength or is accepted by the people of that race.”
“Like an influential player willingly offering themselves to die.”
“And—”
Wen Ping grinned, patted his chest, and said to Little Miao ,”I happen to have some prestige on my own planet, which should meet the criterion.”
“If you kill me once, you can activate the prop.”
“Then the two of us can leave Blue Star forever and enjoy our world for two.”
“Our beautiful future together is about to start.”
“How about it, you must pretty much believe what I’ve been saying now, right? After all, I nailed such a small chance at the first try.”
“What do you think?”
Moved, Little Miao pressed her face against his chest and spoke softly, her eyes filled with emotion, “The ‘Race Change Command’ has already notified me, saying that you meet the requirements.”
“You’re right, you do meet the criteria.”
“I just didn’t expect that you would be willing to sacrifice so much for me.”
“Hey, that’s nothing.”
Wen Ping, smitten during the throes of romance, waved his hand dismissively, “After all, I can crawl out of hell, it’s not permanent death. What’s there to fear? It’s just a trip to hell.”
“Perfectly timed, you send me back to our planet’s hell. Then you change your race; once you’ve changed your race, you’re no longer a Novice Planet player. At that time, you’ll directly initiate the Starfield Shuttle and come to my planet. From then on, we’ll live a life of inseparable love, wandering the ends of the universe.”
“Alright.”
“Then…”
After a moment of hesitation, Little Miao tentatively said, “Rather than picking another day, why not do it now? I really want to leave Blue Star as soon as possible.”
….
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit, observing from a god’s eye view, was enjoying the show. Seeing this unfold, it quickly turned its head to look at Chen Yi beside it, “Yi, isn’t this a bit too hasty?”
“Shouldn’t we build up the emotions a bit more?”
“It feels a bit abrupt. A lot of emotional moments didn’t unfold, like Little Miao’s reaction to Wen Ping killing Chen Yi and her role as a Reincarnator. These scriptwriters aren’t up to par, the plot feels quite mundane.”
“It’s fine by me,” Sword Without End nodded quite contentedly, “I think it’s quite interesting. If it drags on, what if they start quarreling?”
“What if there is something about Little Miao’s behavior that Wen Ping finds annoying, or he starts thinking maybe Little Miao isn’t worth liking after all? Right?”
“A man deep in love would dare to risk his life to save his girlfriend’s. But once they quarrel, that’s it—they’d rather kill each other themselves.”

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - 649 403 Profession Gold Miner_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 649: Chapter 403: “Profession”: Gold Miner!_2 Chapter 649: Chapter 403: “Profession”: Gold Miner!_2 Chen Yi at the center simply nodded his head. “The timing is almost right. Dragging this out is pointless. We can’t delay until marriage and childbirth, using a child as a threat would be meaningless.”
…
“Is it so urgent?”
Wen Ping felt a bit taken aback, standing by the window and looking down at the city with a sense of reluctance. He had spent a considerable amount of time in this city these days, and for some unknown reason, he had grown fond of it.
The thought that he might never come here again
made him feel rather down.
He suddenly understood a phrase someone had once said to him.
One day, you will fall in love with a city because of one person.
At this moment, the impression the city left him was very positive, like a mother’s womb, and the pedestrians on the streets were like amniotic fluid, wrapping around him and providing a steady stream of warmth.
But he still preferred to quickly take Little Miao back to his own planet. He took a deep breath and then looked straight at Little Miao in front of him, his face relaxed, “Let’s go.”
“When we get back, I’ll take you to try the special snacks of our planet.”
He could already picture it.
Staring intently at Little Miao as she thrust a long sword into his throat, his consciousness slowly fading away, he imagined himself dying in Little Miao’s arms, blood filling his mouth, looking into her eyes filled with panic, unease, and sorrow.
He reached out to gently caress her and attempted to comfort her, but after uttering just a few words, he died in Little Miao’s arms.
This exquisite desolation excited him even as he thought about it.
For a boy in his first romantic relationship, his mind was often filled with thoughts of how much he loved his partner and what he would be willing to do for them, using internal climaxes to numb himself.
However, at that moment—
“Wait!”
Wen Ping looked bewilderedly at the eight-barreled Gatling that Little Miao had fished out. With disbelief in his voice, he couldn’t help but raise its pitch, “A Gatling? What the hell??”
“Why is it a Gatling??”
“Shouldn’t it be a long sword or something like a Soft Sword? Isn’t a Gatling a bit too lacking in aesthetics?”
“Times have changed, Uncle. Nowadays, how many people on the battlefield use swords? Gatling has a higher lethality, doesn’t it?”
He was still thinking about dying in Little Miao’s arms, performing a tragic scene of beauty, even his Last Words were already planned out, but now… damn it, with a Gatling out, what Last Words could he have?
He wouldn’t even leave a whole corpse.
Immediately afterward, Wen Ping suddenly remembered something, gazing doubtfully at the gray, sealed Props in his backpack. He had just realized that not all his Props were temporarily sealed.
Including his title, Skill, and Props—all were temporarily sealed.
This was the situation he encountered after failing to shuttle through Starfield upon killing Chen Yi.
Just… why then, when he was opening the treasure chest earlier, could the Prop “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” be activated?
If it hadn’t been triggered, how could he have possibly drawn the “Race Change Command,” which had such a small probability? If it could be triggered, were his Props sealed or not?
As Wen Ping began to ponder over this, he noticed that the originally gray Props in his backpack started to flicker incessantly—alternating between the sealed gray state and the bright state of normal use, which looked very odd.
It was as if…
It was as if…
as long as he believed the Props could be used normally, they would indeed function.
As long as he believed the Props were unusable, they would become unusable.
It seemed entirely subject to his whims?
“Uncle Wen Ping!”
A somewhat tragic voice interrupted Wen Ping’s ramblings, and he saw Little Miao beside him, eyes full of tears and reluctance, aiming the gun at him and pulling the trigger fiercely. Countless bullet chains shot straight at Wen Ping.
“I love you!!”
“I want to be your wife forever!”
Upon hearing this voice, Wen Ping snapped out of his reverie, a content smile on his face. He was just about to say something.
But then, the bullets flying towards him
seemed to tear through the void, causing the surrounding air to twist and distort, while the high-rise buildings around him had become incredibly illusory. Even Little Miao, who stood opposite him, had somehow donned a veil on her face.
The next second—
Before Wen Ping could react, countless bullets pelted down on him like a thunderstorm.
Immediately after.
As if a thunderstorm ceased abruptly, everything quieted down.
…
In the vast Wasteland,
only Chen Yi stood in place, eyes tightly shut, gazing at the countless notification sounds popping up before him, dense and complicated.
Wen Ping lay in a pool of blood, his face filled with contentment and tinged with a hint of regret.
Dead for good.
The exceedingly lucky Wen Ping was thus killed in an ambush.
Yes, the only way to kill Wen Ping was to make him choose to accept death willingly. Only then could he be killed, any other circumstance would not suffice; his immense Luck Points would allow him to avoid nearly all traps and danger.
No, ‘nearly’ shouldn’t be used; rather, it was absolutely so. At least from what they had gathered about Wen Ping, they had never seen him lose on account of luck.

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 650 403 Profession Gold Miner_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 650: Chapter 403: “Profession”: Gold Miner!_3 Chapter 650: Chapter 403: “Profession”: Gold Miner!_3 “So he’s dead.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a look of sentimentality, held a cigarette in his mouth, squatting beside the pool of blood and prodded Wen Ping’s cheek with his finger, smacking his lips, “Yi, do you remember what I used to do? It’s been so long, my hands are still a bit itchy.”
“It wasn’t easy for him to die either. What day is it now, and didn’t even bother to check the time, making so many people waste so many days on him.”
“I’ve never been this exhausted even when wiping out a family, Yi.”
“Now it’s January 12th. If this drags on, the new rules in February will come into effect, and the Novice Period will damn well be over.”
Sword Without End also spoke with a complicated expression, “You can’t really say that. You’ve seen how difficult Wen Ping is to deal with. At the beginning, he withstood Chen Yi’s barrage for three days and nights without losing a single eyebrow.”
“To be honest, killing Wen Ping wouldn’t be easy without this strategy.”
“But Wen Ping’s attack power is not really up to par, probably couldn’t do anything to Yi in a short time. If this duel hadn’t had this twist, the end result would’ve been just a prolonged stalemate.”
At this, Tuberculosis Rabbit could only sneer with disdain, “He brought this on himself, who else can he blame? Do you still remember how we found Wen Ping before the decisive battle began?”
“It was Li Yi who told us. It was Wen Ping who bet on a joker six times in a row at a gambling house. He also took the owner’s necklace and when leaving the city, he let a group of people watch him walk away, unable to land a single attack on him.”
“It was these two things that confirmed for us that the player Wen Ping was the person we were going to face in the decisive battle.”
“That then led to an investigation into Wen Ping’s background information, a one-on-one bespoke script, designed for him. It might not have fit anyone else, but it was absolutely spot on for Wen Ping.”
“Without that script, just think how difficult it would’ve been to kill Wen Ping?”
“Plainly speaking, the reason Wen Ping died was all due to his own sloppy clean-up job and his penchant for showing off. If he hadn’t played the joker at the gambling house and simply killed the owner and taken the necklace and then vanished without a trace?”
“Could we have found any trace of him? Without his tracks, could we have come up with a one-on-one life story-based script tailored just for him?”
“Absolutely not.”
“What do you call this? This is fate, every peck and drink has its predestined time. You can’t blame others, nor can you blame yourself. It’s just that fate has arrived, and it was his time to die.”
“Indeed.”
Sword Without End heaved a long sigh and lamented, “That must be fate, then. Wen Ping probably never thought that just posing for affect would lead to his death today.”
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi was intently watching the system notification that popped up before the New Year.
‘Ding, special duel task completed!’
‘Chen Yi, the player possessing the only S-level prop ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ in the Entire Star System, and the player Wen Ping, holding the only S- level prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ in the Entire Star System, have officially ended their fated conflict!!!’
‘The victorious side is Blue Star player Chen Yi!’
‘Ding, as player Chen Yi emerged victorious in the duel, he gains the opponent’s only S-level growth prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ in the Entire Star System.’
‘Ding, due to player Chen Yi possessing both ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’, the set effect ‘Ascend to the Heavens in One Step’ is activated!’
‘Ding, as player Chen Yi already owns the complete versions of ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’, the levels of both props are restored to L-level.’
‘Ding, it’s detected that player Chen Yi has obtained an L-level prop during the Novice Period, so he is rewarded with the Falling Star Level title ‘So Closed Means Open?”
‘Ding, it’s detected that player Chen Yi has killed player Wen Ping during the duel period, thus he will inherit all of the opponent’s assets, including all props and Points Balance, excluding skills, as skills cannot be dropped or inherited.’
A barrage of notifications, like a waterfall, began to flood in one after the other.
Chen Yi then looked at the two prop panels in front of him.
One is Longevity as the Southern Mountains.
‘Prop Name’: Longevity as the Southern Mountains (A gift from Goddess Qianna 1/2).
‘Prop Level’: L-level.
‘Prop Effect’: Possession of this prop permanently increases your Life Value by 1 point for every creature you kill, with no upper limit.
‘Prop Restrictions’: Once obtained, this prop is automatically equipped, cannot be dropped, traded, transferred, gifted, or removed.
‘Prop Introduction’: “If I were to wish you something, I hope you’ll have longevity as the Southern Mountains and fortune as vast as the Eastern Sea.”
‘ps1’: This prop is part of a set. Acquiring the other S-level prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ will activate the set effects.
‘ps2’: This prop is unique in the Entire Star System, and so is the other prop. Once both props are obtained by a player, a fated conflict will begin, with the winner gaining the complete set.
The victor has been determined, and it is player Chen Yi.
–
The other is Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea.
‘Prop Name’: Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea (A gift from Goddess Qianna 1/2).
‘Prop Level’: L-level.
‘Prop Effect’: Possession of this prop adds 1 Luck Point for every treasure chest you open, with no upper limit.
‘Prop Restrictions’: Once obtained, this prop is automatically equipped, cannot be dropped, traded, transferred, gifted, or removed.

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - 651 403 Profession Gold Miner_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 651: Chapter 403: “Profession”: Gold Miner!_4 Chapter 651: Chapter 403: “Profession”: Gold Miner!_4 “Prop Introduction”: “If I could offer you a blessing, I hope you achieve Longevity as the Southern Mountains and Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea.”
‘ps1’: This prop is part of a set, and obtaining another S-class prop, ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,’ will activate the Set Effects.
‘ps2’: This prop is unique within the Entire Star System, and the other prop is the same. Once both props are acquired by a player, a fateful struggle will initiate, and the victor will possess the complete set of props.
‘Set Effects’: Ascend to the Heavens in One Step.
When a player owns both ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains,’ they can activate the Set Effects to obtain a slash of light that can slay anything and any existence
This slash of light, undeterred by distance, will home in on the target to strike and will not dissipate unless it hits.
It’s a forced Absolute Slay attack.
As long as the Set Effects are activated, the selected player will certainly die, regardless of the existence of Seed Players or any other resurrection methods, leading to a permanent slay, which is Absolutely Irresurrectible.
This attack holds three Absolute Attributes: ‘Absolute Slay,’ ‘Absolute Hit,’ and ‘Absolutely Irresurrectible.’
However, the precondition is that the player being slain must be younger than the user themselves.
This is a way to show respect and grant privileges to the elderly.
Every use of the Set Effects will result in a 10% decrease in the cumulative layers of both ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains.’
–
These are the effects of the two props.
Chen Yi silently inspected them without speaking. The most significant change was that they had shifted from S-class to L-class, but there was no alteration to the prop effects, and it didn’t seem as if the props had been promoted.
Rather, it seemed as if both props were originally L-class.
Perhaps for some reason, such as not being part of the same set, they fell to the S-class, then automatically restored to L-class when both were collected.
These were now the highest-level props he had on hand.
L-class sat above SSS-class. Above SSS-class props were L-class props. Before this, the highest-level prop he possessed was an SSS-class item, ‘Sea God’s Boots,’ which didn’t serve much purpose most of the time, except during sea battles, allowing him the upper hand as if it were his own territory.
Not much use at other times.
However, these two L-class props were different; they could be useful at any moment.
“It’s just…”
Chen Yi thoughtfully looked at the accumulation condition for ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,’ which wasn’t slaying someone to increase one luck point, but rather, opening a chest would increase one Luck Point.
He wasn’t sure if this was the same condition when Wen Ping had the prop.
Whether it had always been this condition or if it suddenly changed once it came into his possession.
Because this condition seemed far easier to achieve than that of ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains.’
It’s just opening chests, right?
There are plenty of chests for sale on the ‘Star Map’ platform, an abundance of them, no need to buy the ones that can contain many great things – just the cheapest ones will do.
After all, it’s just for stacking layers.
It wouldn’t cost even a few billion Points to stack up hundreds of thousands of Luck Points for oneself without any effort.
Surely it can’t be that simple to stack, can it?
Chen Yi hesitated slightly.
And this expenditure wouldn’t be a waste of money. It might be a bit of a loss at the beginning, but once the Luck Points started to increase, practically every chest opened would mean profit. As a result, not only would the Luck Points go up, but the chests would also turn a profit.
Is it that simple?
It felt like the accumulation condition for ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ wasn’t even on the same level. It wasn’t equitable. Wasn’t the gap in difficulty a bit too wide?
And at that moment—
The likes of Tuberculosis Rabbit also saw the prop panel that Chen Yi had shared.
They were all stunned, their mouths agape.
“No way, three Absolute Attributes?”
Sword Without End looked enviously at the Set Effects: “‘Absolute Slay,’ ‘Absolute Hit,’ ‘Absolutely Irresurrectible’!!!”
“Isn’t that a bit too exaggerated?”
“Not only does it possess three Absolute Attributes, but they are also three highly valuable Absolute Attributes. Does that mean if Wen Ping were to resurrect and appear before Yi now, with just one slash under the ‘Absolute Slay’ effect, Wen Ping would have to die?”
“Can’t say for sure.”
Chen Yi shook his head, “For instance, I have a prop with ‘Absolute Defense,’ and if I lie on this prop of ‘Absolute Defense’ and then use a sword with ‘Absolute Slay’ attribute to cut myself.”
“Would I die or not?”
“So far, the collision between Absolute Attributes has only occurred once, that is when the ‘Absolutely Healing-proof’ wound met ‘Absolute Defense.'”
It’s hard to say who would win or lose.
Anyway, he wouldn’t die as long as he lay on that beach chair with Absolute Defense. The wound couldn’t damage him, but he could only lie down. As soon as he dared to stand, the wound would rapidly fester and rot, almost as if afraid he would die too slowly.
So he truly wasn’t sure which was more powerful between ‘Absolute Slay’ and ‘Absolute Defense.’
But he’d probably never find out the answer in his lifetime. He wasn’t crazy enough to experiment with such a thing himself. Life was already complicated enough; there was no need to create trouble that would make it even harder.
“I feel like ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ is even more exaggerated.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked excitedly at the ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ prop panel: “Just opening one chest increases one Life Value point. Does that mean Yi can be like Wen Ping now?”
“As long as he doesn’t wish to die, he couldn’t possibly be killed?”
“Isn’t that nearly as good as Absolute Defense?”
“Think about how much effort it took to kill Wen Ping this time, and isn’t this accumulation condition easy to fulfill? Just buy chests in bulk from the ‘Star Map’ platform, right? How much can Points cost? And even if it takes a lot of Points, so what? All we have left now is Points.”
“With so much protection money coming in, I really don’t know how else to spend it.”
Chen Yi smiled and had no interaction with the Mart; just as he was about to say something, a system notification suddenly came to his ears. He turned his head instinctively and then froze, a look of disbelief and elation flashing in his eyes.
‘Ding, player Chen Yi’s weekly occupation ‘Nice Guy’ has reached its time limit and the new occupation is now in place.’
‘The new occupation has a one-week usage limit and is immune to Occupational Restriction effects.’
–
‘Occupation’: Gold Miner.
‘Occupational Effect’: Can randomly throw out a hook that will grab at random in the game world; it might catch various incredible and unknown things such as props, Skill Fragments, the project team’s staff, bosses from a certain map, stones, trash, Scavengers, and so on.
‘Occupational Restriction’: After using once, there will be a 24-hour cooldown.
–

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - 652 404 He bought 1 billion treasure chests
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 652: Chapter 404: He bought 1 billion treasure chests damn it!!! Chapter 652: Chapter 404: He bought 1 billion treasure chests damn it!!! “Gold Miner?”
While fiddling with something nearby, the Tuberculosis Rabbit saw Chen Yi suddenly project the Gold Miner profession panel into the air and was stunned for a moment. He quickly reacted with excitement and said.
“Yi, the profession you randomly got from Faceless One this week wasn’t the Random Miner, was it?”
“That’s right.”
“Hey, he’s fucking lucky!!”
Yi knew about the Gold Miner profession. You just had to sit on the ground and cast a fishing rod in front of you. Then, after five minutes, the fishing rod would return with an unknown item.
It could be a monster, an NPC, or even some broken props, or extremely rare SSS-level props.
When Yi obtained the Faceless One profession, the first one he randomly got was the Gold Miner.
He hooked many things over those seven days.
Even because of the Gold Miner profession, those days were filled with more fun.
Like hooking the egg of the Void Clan Queen, almost leading to the Void Clan’s invasion of Blue Star. In the end, the battlefield was set in Li Yi’s Awesome Starfield, where countless Void Clan monsters were slain.
Or like hooking up a raggedy-looking pair of boots, which seemed inconspicuous, but who would have thought it was actually a pair of SSS-level boots. These were Yi’s highest-level props before the props ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ were upgraded to L-level.
Most of the time they were useless, or to put it accurately, useless on land. But in the sea, they were dominant, utterly crushing all other creatures.
And now—
Just as Yi finally succeeded in obtaining the ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ prop, this profession was randomly chosen once again.
He was already looking forward to what would happen next.
“Then what are we waiting for?”
Excited, Tuberculosis Rabbit rubbed his hands together: “Hurry back home, stack up Luck Points, and get started?”
“Naturally.”
Chen Yi also smiled broadly.
…
Before the sky was completely dark.
Chen Yi and his group had returned to the long-missed rooftop. Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit hadn’t come back these past days and had been with him out in the wilderness. It was not because they were worried about him dying without an audience—after all, during the final battle, he could only die at the hands of Wen Ping, not by anyone else.
The main worry was that, in case Yi woke up and wanted to talk to someone nearby, discovering there was no one around would give him a sense of loneliness and the bleakness of fighting alone.
They really couldn’t help Yi much.
But companionship was the best role they could play.
At least let Yi know that he wasn’t fighting alone; he wasn’t alone.
Only Jiaye and Tie Chui came back every day, so after such a long absence from the rooftop, it was still dust-free and looked clean and tidy.
“Sister-in-law, oh.”
As Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced around, he spoke somewhat emotionally: “Actually, there’s no need to work so hard, we could just hire a cleaner. It wouldn’t cost much, and it’s not like we’re short on money. When you have money, you should spend it.”
“Hey, no need.”
Jiaye held her arms and smiled like a crescent moon: “I don’t trust others to clean. If I do it myself every day, it’s more comfortable for everyone.”
“Then I’ll trouble you, sister-in-law. I’ll make sure to keep Sword Without End in line and have him create less trash, to avoid causing you trouble.”
“…”
Tie Chui, standing on the side and being taller than everyone present, curled his lips in a sneer where no one could see.
Iron Nail was really hypocritical.
Every day she told them she cleaned herself, but it turned out housekeeping was hired to do it. Indeed, beautiful women tell nothing but lies.
Meanwhile—
Yi had already begun purchasing gift boxes on the Star Map Platform.
–
“Prop Name”: E-Level Random Prop Chest.
“Prop Level”: E-Level.
“Prop Effect”: You can randomly obtain an E-Level prop.
“Prop Introduction”: Once, a collector nearly gathered all the E-Level props.
“Prop Price”: 10 Points.
–
Chen Yi quickly found the most suitable gift box for stacking his Luck Points on the “Star Map” platform—the E-Level Random Prop Chest, which is one of the cheapest on the platform.
Starfield.
It is not an official game store platform, completely different from the prop mall in the player’s personal panel.
On Star Map, all the props on sale are priced by the players themselves.
The lowest price hung for this Prop Chest on Star Map was 7 Points, with about 100 consigned.
Above that were 8 Points, 9 Points.
The basic price was around 10 Points each.
Higher up, there were ones priced at 20 Points, 30 Points each, but those players weren’t really serious about selling at these prices. The players who really want to sell usually list at the consensus price or a little lower.
After all, the lower the price, the higher the ranking.
And of course, they sell faster.
But the highest price was 1 million Points for one—the idea of selling one E-Level Random Prop Chest for one million Points was insane, nobody would believe that. Yet, this kind of pricing could be seen under any prop on Star Map.
Some considered their junk priceless, recalling how difficult it was to get that prop and the length of time and emotional attachment they had with it. They felt selling for less would be a loss.
Unfortunately, when the market determines the price of an item, it never considers these factors, only the item’s actual value.

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 653 404 He Fucking Bought 1 Billion Treasure
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 653: Chapter 404: He Fucking Bought 1 Billion Treasure Chests!!!_2 Chapter 653: Chapter 404: He Fucking Bought 1 Billion Treasure Chests!!!_2 And then there are those who list items just for fun, not really intending to sell them at all.
As for those listing their items slightly above market price, they’re in a state of wanting to sell and not wanting to sell, just hanging the items up there and being done with it if someone buys them.
After Chen Yi set his sights on the “E-grade Random Prop Chest,” he made a swift and decisive move.
“Place the order!”
As soon as he said this—
‘Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully purchasing 1 billion E-grade Random Prop Chests on the Star Map Platform, spending a total of 610 billion Points.’
The next second—
‘Ding, insufficient inventory space detected for player. Unable to accommodate so many props temporarily. Would you like to purchase an Inventory Expansion Coupon?’
“No need.”
The corners of Chen Yi’s mouth twitched slightly as he shook his head. In fact, after numerous expansions, his inventory could already hold 5000 props. And since he had so many Points with no intention of not spending them, purchasing such things on the Star Map Platform wasn’t a big deal.
But the problem was…
He wasn’t crazy enough to expand his inventory to fit 1 billion props.
It’s not just unnecessary—it’s completely unnecessary.
After all, even though he could now store 5000 props, he only used a few hundred slots, and the rest were simply useless. A normal player couldn’t possibly use them all. After all, to put it bluntly, if you were given 5000 props, could you activate all 5000 items in the middle of a battle?
Would you be able to use them all?
“Let’s go.”
Chen Yi got up and walked towards the city outskirts, “Let’s find a patch of Wasteland. Actually, let’s just go back to where we were before and open these chests.”
Clearly, at this time, Blue Star was the biggest warehouse there could be.
Since it was all consumable items that were going to be used up immediately, it was a pure waste of Points to store them in a warehouse or inventory. It would be cheaper and more convenient to just pile them on the ground.
Speaking of which, the conditions for stacking the “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” were odd, I don’t know why it’s, “Open one chest, gain one Luck Point.”
I always thought it should be like my “Longevity as the Southern Mountains,” gaining one Luck Point for each person killed.
I wonder if it was the same when Wen Ping had it.
Maybe…
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully. He had an idea of what might be going on. If Wen Ping had emerged victorious in the decisive battle and taken his “Longevity as the Southern Mountains,” then its stacking condition might be changed to be different from “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea.”
To prevent one action from stacking effects on two items.
Getting a return greater than the sum of adding one to one.
Thinking like this, it’s easier to understand what that might mean.
…
“Phew!”
Just as the Tuberculosis Rabbit had set up the grill on the rooftop and hadn’t even warmed his seat, he was dragged back to the Wasteland by Yi again.
This time, everyone was there.
Just as the Tuberculosis Rabbit was preparing to say something to lift the spirits—
Suddenly, countless white portals opened up in the sky, and then, like hailstones, a dense rain of chests started smashing to the ground, creating an incredibly shocking sight!!!
“Boom!!!”
You could even hear the faint sound of explosions.
It looked like an airdrop.
Quickly.
The scene before their eyes vanished, leaving behind a mountain-like pile of giant chests.
“Magnificent…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit King muttered, looking at the scene before him: “Yi, in a way, you have to thank me. If it weren’t for me thinking about opening a chinaware store in Sky City, where would we have gotten so much money to buy these chests?”
“Right?”
“Without the Points, we would have just watched the conditions for “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” to level up, crying without tears.”
“Makes sense, doesn’t it?”
“It does.”
Chen Yi smiled, pleased, and nodded: “Then thanks to you, Tu’er.”
The mall in Sky City really had a strong ability to gather wealth.
It was really just collecting protection money. Chinaware, how much could those ceramics be worth?
But he thought it was a good deal. Not only was there money to be earned, but if someone came causing trouble, they could also stack data for “Longevity as the Southern Mountains.” And if they couldn’t beat them… well, if they couldn’t beat them, they just wouldn’t fight, what else could they do?
Isn’t there a limit to what protection money can cover? You’ve never seen people pay protection money to thugs and expect them to take on the army with ghost fire, have you?
As a result, even after spending a whopping 610 billion Points this time, he still had a good 900 billion Points left in his pocket.
Couldn’t spend it all.
Just couldn’t.
And that was just what he had. The Points in the pockets of Sword Without End and the others weren’t even counted.
Moreover, the mall in Sky City was still bringing in income every day. In just the dozen or so days of the decisive battle, he earned another 100 billion Points. Almost every day, someone came to pay protection money.
Not everyone came just to pay protection money, though.
Many players, out of admiration for Chen Yi, would buy little trinkets in the God Yi Mall in Sky City. The prices were affordable, ranging from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of Points, all bearing Yi’s signature and his personally designed logo.
They served as symbols of status.
These sales accounted for almost half of the income during those dozen days.
Of course, the bulk of the profit still came from protection fees. After all, those people really had the money to pay up, paying by the billions of Points. Chen Yi never disclosed specific prices publicly, so there were those who paid one billion and those who paid three billion.
They paid as much as they could afford based on their own strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 654 404 He Bought 1 Billion Treasure Chests_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 654: Chapter 404: He Bought 1 Billion Treasure Chests?!_3 Chapter 654: Chapter 404: He Bought 1 Billion Treasure Chests?!_3 But everyone has a sense of balance in their hearts, and even if they pay more, they won’t feel like they’ve been taken for a fool. If something really happens, they’re sure that Yi will be extra attentive since they’ve paid so much.
Especially after the example of the annihilation of the Three-Eyed Clan, everyone truly understood how Yi protects the races that pay him protection fees. They pay with complete peace of mind.
They pay with joy, they pay with comfort.
After all, Yi really shows up when there’s trouble.
It’s not like other races haven’t asked for protection fees before, but they’re mostly like Li Yi, who can only mediate or act as an intermediary when trouble arises.
Not like Yi. Someone’s bothering you, right? Wait, and I’ll wipe them out for you.
The term protection fees has a negative connotation because most of the time, it’s used as a euphemism for extortion—taking money and not doing anything. But when you take money and do the work, it’s a different story altogether.
For example, there used to be a convenience store before the level-up ascension happened.
Then a group of people came by and said, for 3k a year, they’d ensure no one from any agency would come and charge you randomly. They’d take care of anyone who came looking for trouble with fake cigarettes or expired products.
And, they could guarantee that there wouldn’t be another store within a five-hundred-meter radius of you.
Not to mention occasionally gifting you something during holidays and helping you with the annual tax review. Who wouldn’t want to pay under such circumstances, right?
After all, it’s a bang for the buck as elsewhere, you couldn’t ensure that there wouldn’t be a competing store within a five-hundred-meter radius even for three hundred thousand.
Except for in the countryside.
In many rural areas, there’s only one convenience store for the whole village— a complete monopoly.
…
Lost in his wild thoughts—
Chen Yi had already opened the treasure chest, completing the process both quickly and efficiently.
He swiftly picked up the nearest chest, confirmed it was ready to open, and as the chest turned into white light and vanished, he tossed aside the items that came out of it. It took him just about four to five seconds to open a chest.
“Ding, congratulations to the player for successfully opening a chest, obtaining xxx prop, and L-level prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ Luck Points +1…”
“Ding, congratulations to the player for successfully opening a chest, obtaining xxx prop, and L-level prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ Luck Points +1…”
“Ding, congratulations to the player for successfully opening a chest, obtaining xxx prop, and L-level prop ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ Luck Points +1…”
A series of notification sounds kept ringing in Chen Yi’s ears.
Just like that.
It wasn’t long before Chen Yi’s Luck Points reached an impressive 100.
Then, Chen Yi stopped opening chests, his face full of anticipation. He pulled out a dagger from his bosom, held it in his hand, spread out the fingers of his right hand close to the ground, took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and slammed the dagger toward his right hand on the ground.
“Sizz!”
The next second—
The sound of the blade piercing skin echoed.
The clear sensation of pain made Chen Yi open his eyes.
“…”
Chen Yi, with a somewhat expressionless face, looked at the dagger sticking out of the back of his right hand, silent without speaking. He had thought that even with his eyes closed, he would have hit between his fingers, which didn’t make sense.
Why did it still hit the back of the hand?
Is this the effect of having 100 Luck Points?
It doesn’t seem very useful.
“Eh…”
Seeing this, Tuberculosis Rabbit also felt a bit awkwardly embarrassed, touching its nose: “Maybe it’s because the Luck Points are too low, or maybe it’s because Sword Without End is nearby? After all, Yi, as you know, Sword Without End is exceptionally bad luck for people.”
“Staying with Sword Without End too long, no one survives.”
“The naturally bad luck that can be contagious to others.”
“Maybe 100 Luck Points are not enough to offset Sword Without End’s bad luck?”
“How about we ask Sword Without End to stay away and try again?”
“Go away!”
Sword Without End, with a gloomy expression, spoke: “Why are you so unpleasant as soon as you open your mouth? Aren’t all of you still alive and well?”
“That’s because Yi is tough,” said Tuberculosis Rabbit with a wistful expression. “Before he met you, Yi never got hurt. Look at how many times he’s been injured since meeting you. Not to mention our sister-in-law, nearly becoming an annual member of hell. Tie Chui and I aren’t doing much better either.”
“Wrong!”
Just then, Sword Without End’s pupils suddenly flashed with a spark of insight: “Yi, 100 Luck Points must have some effect. I have a prop that can see how severe someone’s injuries are.”
“Your injury, Yi, although it looks quite bad and there’s a lot of blood.”
“But in reality, the tendons and bones are fine, and even important blood vessels weren’t hit; it’s stuck in at an extremely minor angle, so it won’t affect the normal use of your right hand. This kind of injury will heal quickly.”
“It won’t cause much trouble; that must be the effect of having +100 Luck Points, otherwise it could have hurt the bone.”
“Is that so?”
Chen Yi thoughtfully looked at his right hand, feeling there might be some rationale to what Sword Without End said. Indeed, he didn’t feel an intense pain, and there was no hindrance or struggle in making a fist with his right hand—it all seemed smooth.
If it had been during a fight, an injury like this would hardly affect the battle at all; there would essentially be no impact.
He waved his right hand casually, and the injury on his hand instantly healed.
But he didn’t hurry to open more chests, instead, he fell into contemplation.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 655 404 He Fucking Bought 1 Billion Treasure
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 655: Chapter 404: He Fucking Bought 1 Billion Treasure Chests!!!_4 Chapter 655: Chapter 404: He Fucking Bought 1 Billion Treasure Chests!!!_4 A day is 24 hours, that is 86,400 seconds; with his speed, he could open a chest every four or five seconds. If he didn’t eat or drink, and did nothing else but maintain his fastest speed, dismantling chests at the highest frequency…
In a day, he could dismantle… up to 17,280 chests.
That is, not even 20,000 chests.
It seems like a lot, 20,000 chests, after all, most normal players couldn’t dismantle that many from the time they entered the game until their death, they wouldn’t even see that many chests.
But—
This motherfucker bought 1 billion chests!!!
Opening 20,000 chests a day, it would take 50,000 days to open 1 billion chests, which is 136 years.
136 years…
Forget about the novice period, by that time the game will probably be a thing of history books, and he still wouldn’t have finished opening chests.
That’s just fucking outrageous.
…
“Hey, Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi turned his head expressionlessly towards Tuberculosis Rabbit and asked, “I have a question for you, do you know how long it would take to spend 1 billion yuan if you spend 20,000 yuan every day?”
“Just spending without earning?”
“Yes, just spending without earning, spending a fixed 20,000 yuan every day, not counting any interest, just the 1 billion yuan in savings.”
“It shouldn’t take that long.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit lowered his head, fiddling with his fingers as he started calculating, “After all, sitting and eating away your fortune isn’t a sustainable strategy. Spending 20,000 yuan a day is a lot, that’s 2 million yuan in 100 days.”
“Ah…1,000 days for 20 million? 10,000 days for 200 million, 100,000 days for 2 billion…”
“Does it take 5 years?”
Confused, Tuberculosis Rabbit lifted his head to look at Chen Yi, “Just spending without earning takes over 100 years? Could the money really last that long?”
Quite normal.
When an amount reaches a certain level, humans lose their concrete grasp of it.
What concept is 1 billion?
This is that concept.
Even though his spiritual power would never tire because of his title, even if he never felt too tired to sleep, still, to open these 1 billion titles, he would need more than 100 years.
What a joke.
Who has the time to spend a whole century on this?
And the thing is, except for him personally opening them, it doesn’t count as opening a chest, so it’s impossible to delegate this task to other players. This accessory seems like an item that can grow without limits.
But actually, there is a clear limit.
It’s different from Longevity as the Southern Mountains; Longevity as the Southern Mountains truly has no upper limit, as long as you kill enough, the lifespan will indeed increase accordingly.
“So what should we do…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit weakly suggested, “How about returning some of these chests? It’s clear they can’t all be opened. I think keeping a few million chests should be enough, a few million Luck Points should suffice.”
“After all, with just 100 Luck Points, Yi, you’ve been able to minimize your injuries when hurt.”
“Several million Luck Points should also likely achieve what Wen Ping has, with Luck Points maxed out, his eyes closed and unable to die unless he wants to, making it impossible for anyone else to kill him.”
“Sigh!”
Chen Yi took a deep breath without speaking, instead he touched one of the chests, and immediately a panel popped up in front of him.
‘Ding, would you like to open the E-level random Prop Chest in front of you?’
When he moved his finger away, the panel disappeared.
As soon as his finger touched it again, the panel reappeared.
This is the first step in the process!
‘Contact!’
As long as any part of his hands touches the chest, this panel can pop up.
Then, as long as he silently thinks to himself to ‘open’ while the panel is up,
the chest will open, then the chest will turn into a burst of white light and vanish, and the items inside will scatter on the ground.
This is the second step in the process.
‘Open!’
Which means—
The whole process of opening a chest is actually composed simply of ‘contact’ and ‘open’ these two steps.
And speeding up the process is actually pretty straightforward.
——
One hour later.
Chen Yi was already lying on his beach chair, which was placed on the Wasteland. Lying on this beach chair, Chen Yi would have the attribute of Absolute Defense.
At the same time.
His hands were positioned on either side of him and open, looking like a tourist basking in the sun in Hawaii.
And above his head.
“Yi, here we come!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit can be seen yelling while standing on Sword Without End’s Three-Foot Qingfeng, aiming a huge vacuum cleaner nozzle straight at Chen Yi, and forcefully pulling the trigger!
The next second—
Numerous Prop Chests shot out of the vacuum cleaner’s nozzle like bullets, smashing hard towards Chen Yi below. All the chests that touched Chen Yi’s arms turned into white light and vanished.
Those chests that didn’t touch Chen Yi’s arms fell beneath the beach chair.
Beneath the chair, there was a huge hole they had dug out.
Inside was a vacuum cleaner intake, and those chests that hadn’t been opened would be sucked back into the vacuum cleaner through this inlet, ready for the next shot.
This was the new method thought up by Chen Yi.
It could speed up the time it took to open chests.
All he needed to do was keep thinking ‘open, open, open’ in his mind.
The speed at which the chests opened depended mainly on how quickly he silently thought ‘open’ in his heart; not every chest his arm touched would successfully open. If he didn’t think ‘open’ at the right time, that chest wouldn’t open either.

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 656 405 The Harvest of the First Strike
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 656: Chapter 405: The Harvest of the First Strike!!! Chapter 656: Chapter 405: The Harvest of the First Strike!!! ps: There was a miscalculation with some data in the last chapter, which a reader kindly pointed out and has been corrected for normal reading.
Old habits die hard, sorry for that.
Brain overload.
…
“Yi, do you want to check out the Star Map outside?”
Looking at the Star Map with a strange expression, Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t quite know what to say about the “E-class random Prop Chest” that kept rising.
The price of this prop was soaring like Mount Tai, straight up.
Not like the A-share market at all.
This was an absolutely pure trading market, with no precautions for fluctuations, to be exact, the reason for its rise was simple: there were no cheap ones left to sell.
At this moment, the cheapest E-class random Prop Chest on the Star Map was priced at 123 Points.
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi was somewhat dumbfounded, frowning, and couldn’t understand what had happened. He remembered after he cleared out the E-class random Prop Chests from the Star Map trading market, the lowest price should have been 97 Points.
How come there were so many all of a sudden?
A base price of 123 Points indicated that all E-class random Prop Chests priced from 97 to 123 Points had been sold out.
Nowadays…
Who would spend 100 Points on an E-class random Prop Chest?
Keep in mind that, during the Novice Period, this thing might be worth some money.
But once out of the Novice Period, even a player from the Threefold Planet wouldn’t possibly lack E-class props, especially since most E-class props were lifestyle ones, without much use.
Why would suddenly so many people buy E-class random Prop Chests?
“Here’s the thing,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, having a rough understanding of the situation, started to speak with some emotion: “Mainly because, Yi, your move was too sensational. Although people don’t know if the buyer is one person or who the buyer is—”
“But in less than an hour, the E-class random Prop Chest hit 97 Points, making a lot of people’s minds perk up.”
“Many began to suspect that there might be some hidden task with the E-class random Prop Chest and secretly stockpiled some.”
“Especially the panel for the E-class random Prop Chest—”
‘Prop Introduction’: Once there was a collector who had nearly collected all E-class props.
