“A lot of players are convinced that if they gather all E-class props, they can trigger some hidden tasks, and many major powers start to feel that if they gather all E-class props, they can achieve the Monument milestone of upgrading the game.”
“Because they searched and found out, so far there’s no Monument in the game that has been announced for collecting all E-class props.”
“Their frenzied buying has also caused the price of E-class random Prop Chests to skyrocket!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused before continuing.
“Aside from that, there are those speculators who think the price of E-class random Prop Chests will rise even higher in the future, and feeling the current price is still decent, they buy to stockpile and sell later for profit, especially with the news about ‘achieving a game Monument milestone.’ The buyers have increased.”
“Moreover, the surge in the price of E-class random Prop Chests from just a while ago has indeed attracted even more buyers; as the old saying goes, the faster the rise, the quicker the buying frenzy.”
“If the price rises fast enough, the brain doesn’t have time to think.”
“The last group of people is just joining the craze out of pure curiosity; a few hundred or thousand Points isn’t expensive, and with so many people buying, they too buy a few to join in the fun.”
“The revelry of these people has led the price of the E-class random Prop Chest to reach an astonishing 123 Points.”
“Oh, no, it is 131 Points now.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed somewhat helplessly: “In the time it takes to say a few words, it has gone up this much.”
“That quickly?”
A hint of surprise flashed in Chen Yi’s eyes as he looked at the pile beside him, resembling a small mountain of E-class random Prop Chests. Did that mean that his stash of props was now instantly worth over a hundred billion?
Of course, in theory, it was so.
If such a large stash were to be dumped, it would probably cause the market to halt in an instant.
One should never underestimate the value of ten billion.
“Hmm.”
With a nod, Tuberculosis Rabbit continued: “It’s still a relatively slow hike in price, after all, many people wouldn’t choose to list it on the Star Map, either they open it right away, or just toss it into the warehouse and forget about it.”
“So now, many people have stock in hand, and they are choosing to list their E-class random Prop Chests on the platform. Because most of these people want to quickly cash out for peace of mind, they tend to set lower prices, which leads to a slower price increase.”
“Once these people have sold out and everyone runs out of stock, the price will rise even faster. By then, it wouldn’t be surprising if an E-class Prop Chest reached 200 Points.”
“…”
Sword Without End spoke with a peculiar expression, “200 Points… Do you know how much the most expensive E-class prop is on the Star Map Platform? Think about your Air Food Series Props, how much they cost.”
“And the Air Food Series Props are already considered relatively strong among the E-class props.”
“Their prices are on the higher end.”
“But—”
“Besides that, I think there’s one speculation by some people that seems very insightful—maybe if we can collect a complete set of E-class props, it might actually activate a game milestone?”
“Yi!”
As the words fell.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 657 405 The Harvest from the First Move_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 657: Chapter 405: The Harvest from the First Move!!!_2 Chapter 657: Chapter 405: The Harvest from the First Move!!!_2 Sword Without End suddenly knelt down with a pitiable expression on his face, turned his head to Chen Yi, who was continuously opening treasure chests while lying on a beach chair, and said with a trembling voice, “Yi, can you give me this opportunity?”
“You know I don’t have many hobbies, Yi. I just love to show off and act cool.”
“You and Tuberculosis Rabbit are both Seed Players and have already gotten Monuments, but I haven’t.”
“If there’s a chance this time, could you please let me have it, Yi?”
“I will definitely risk my life to help you in the future!”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at Sword Without End with disdain, “I gambled for my Monument myself. Why are you kneeling and begging? Don’t you have any pride as a man?”
“I’m not like you.”
Sword Without End was kneeling on the ground. He took a deep breath, his eyes reddened, and he sincerely looked at Yi with a hoarse voice, “If it weren’t for meeting you, Yi, I don’t even know where I’d be dead by now.”
“I have to consider whether this is the only chance in my life to touch a Monument.”
“What’s the point of losing face in front of Yi?”
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit turned his head in silence to the side and had a new understanding of Sword Without End, to be honest, Yi was desperately opening those chests, and here you are, kneeling and making a statement.
How is this any different from rushing into the bathroom with a bunch of roses to confess to a goddess while she’s doing her business?
No words could describe this.
I hope Yi finishes him off.
“Okay.”
Chen Yi nodded casually: “I’ve thrown all the Props I’ve gotten to the side. You can go and pick them up.”
“See if you get lucky.”
“Understood!!!”
Sword Without End’s expression suddenly became excited as he jumped up from the ground and shouted, “Thank you, Yi!!! Thank you so much, Yi!!! Yi is the best!!! I, Sword Without End, love Yi the most!!!”
Chen Yi sighed lightly, somewhat helpless, closed his eyes, and lay back on the beach chair like a robot. He kept silently activating the chests without saying anything more.
A Monument wasn’t of much use to him anymore.
The biggest gain for a person is the first time they get a Monument. After that, the value it brings becomes lower, especially for someone with the Seed Player status—even though it’s cumulative.
Most of the time, the Race Player status is enough for once.
Like him.
He still has two chances left to use the Seed Player status, and he doesn’t know how to use them.
It’s frustrating, because it’s not like he can die.
The only time he used his Seed Player status was when he voluntarily sought death to go to hell, to lift the “Absolutely Unhealable” curse.
Speaking of which.
Ever since then.
He hadn’t encountered another Prop that naturally had the “Absolutely Unhealable” attribute.
This attribute had made him envious for a long time, it was practically invincible. Players with a Monument must consume a Seed status; for those without a Monument, it’s like a guaranteed kill as long as the hit lands.
How is this any different from his combo of “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” and “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,” the “Ascend to the Heavens in One Step”?
–
When a player owns both the ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ Props, they can activate the Set Effects to obtain a slice of light that can slay anything and everything, ignoring distance and homing in on the target, not dissipating until it makes a hit.
It is a compulsory slaying attack.
Once the Set Effects are activated, the selected player will inevitably die, ignoring all resurrection methods like the Seed Player status, resulting in permanent death, with no possibility of revival.
This attack has three Absolute Attributes: ‘Absolute Slay,’ ‘Absolute Hit,’ and ‘Absolutely Irresurrectible.’
However, the prerequisite is that the age of the player being slain must be younger than the user himself.
This is a sign of care for the elderly, as well as a privilege.
Every use of the Set Effects causes a 10% reduction in the layers of ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains.’
–
He had researched this Set Effect. It was powerful.
In a nutshell.
With one swing of his sword, it’s an Absolute Slay, an Absolute Hit, an Absolutely Irresurrectible strike that could slay even a god.
Or to put it accurately, he felt that this was meant for slaying gods.
Is there anything with a higher cost-effectiveness rate than slaying gods?
After all, the price to pay for a single use was indeed a bit too high.
1: It can only slay those younger than him, which means he has to hesitate if the target is over 30 years old.
This condition drastically limits him—forget about slaying gods.
What god isn’t older than he is?
2: Every use reduces the layering of ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ by 10%.
That’s like sabotaging one’s own future.
Using it ten times in a row
Wouldn’t that bring it down to 0%?
“No, that’s not right…”
At this thought, Chen Yi’s brow furrowed as he started to ponder. Assuming he had 1000 layers of each, a 10% drop wouldn’t reach zero.
For example, a 10% drop from 1000 would be 900.
And 10% off 900 is 810, not 800.
Lucky for him, he caught himself quickly or he would have fallen into yet another mathematical trap.
He dislikes math!
And Tuberculosis Rabbit, seeing Yi deep in thought, narrowed his eyes slightly and said nothing. He probably knew what Yi was thinking; after all, when Yi acquired this Set Effect, he just sighed and was too lazy to explain.
He simply projected the panel into the air for them to see and then skipped over it.

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 658 405 The First Strikes Harvest_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 658: Chapter 405: The First Strike’s Harvest!!!_3 Chapter 658: Chapter 405: The First Strike’s Harvest!!!_3 Subconsciously, Yi seemed to think this thing was no longer useful.
But… he didn’t think so.
In terms of lifespan, among the myriad gods, who could live longer than Yi,
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Sword Without End beside him, the corners of his eyes twitching slightly, and he remained silent. The more his memories recovered, the harder it became for him to look Sword Without End in the eye.
Who would have expected it?
Here was someone who appeared all over the place, spending his days playing Russian Roulette, yet he was once an infamous figure that could silence crying children just by mentioning his name.
And in the dreams.
The mountain belonging to Sword Without End, which he faced, seemed to have shown some activity recently, looking as if it were about to awaken.
“Sigh.”
All of a sudden, Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a sigh, his hand casually placed behind his back as he gazed at an angle into the sky, silent and unspoken, for the decisive battle was drawing near.
When the time comes,
how many people here would survive,
was yet to be known.
…
Soon, the date reached January 16th.
Five whole days had passed since Chen Yi started opening his treasure chests.
Since December 28th, the day the decisive battle with Wen Ping began, Chen Yi hadn’t slept a wink.
Although, with the effect of his spiritual power never tiring, he didn’t feel the pressure that might lead to sudden death or his heart deciding it was too tired and giving up suddenly after consulting with the brain, despite not sleeping for so long.
But…
His body might be fine, yet his mind wasn’t holding up as well.
The lack of sleep made Chen Yi feel as though he was no longer human, turned into a monster, even starting to hallucinate monsters emerging from the void, snarling and baring their teeth at him.
“I can’t take it anymore!”
Finally—
Lying on the beach chair, Chen Yi who had been continuously opening treasure chests without sleep, finally seemed to reach his limit. Raising his hand to signal Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others to stop, he sat up, his gaze falling hazily onto the Wasteland as he murmured.
“I’m going to sleep, the treasure chests will have to wait.”
“Let it be.”
“There’s no rush with this thing, it’s a long-term effort. It’s impossible to get everything done and stack up the Luck Points in just a few days.”
Then, he glanced at the mountain of Props beside him, which appeared hardly diminished. After a moment of silence, he hopped off the beach chair and headed to his sled without a second glance, flying toward the rooftop.
His determination was unmistakable.
Even… even though he had already tried so hard.
‘Open.’
This word had been silently repeated countless times in his heart. He was even getting unaccustomed to uttering those two simple syllables, trying every possible method to speed up the opening of the chests. Yet in five days, he had managed to open only 1.2 million of them.
That was, on average, about 250,000 a day.
This speed was already very fast.
Bear in mind, at the beginning, he could only manage 17,000 a day.
Yet even with this frightening speed, facing 1 billion Prop Chests, it still seemed like a drop in the ocean, almost futile.
…
“So…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit turned to look at Sword Without End: “Yi has gone to sleep, should we also go to sleep?”
In these past few days, he knew how Yi had figured out a way to speed up the chest opening process even further.
The answer was simple.
According to Yi’s logic, opening chests involved only two steps: ‘contact’ and ‘open.’
Physical contact couldn’t be avoided; it had to be done with the hands. If someone didn’t have hands, any other body part was permissible to use in replacement, as accommodation and support, perhaps even pity and help, for disabled players.
And what Yi did was straightforward.
One in each hand, swiftly and decisively.
“Bang bang.”
After two chopping sounds, both hands were severed, casually tossed aside. Then, he shut his eyes and lay on the beach chair, resting with his eyes closed.
This way, Prop Chests didn’t necessarily have to hit Chen Yi’s hands to be opened.
They could be opened by hitting any part of his body, like the arms, head, or abdomen—these parts could all open the chests.
The efficiency began to increase significantly.
Yi only needed to mentally command them to open. With such a large area of contact, the speed of opening naturally increased by a lot.
That scene.
Those who saw it felt a shiver down their spine, those unaware of what was happening thought Yi was being subjected to some torture.
But even so, the speed only increased to an average of 200,000 chests a day. Anything faster was impossible; this was already their fastest rate.
Yet…
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked toward the nearly 1 billion E-grade random Prop Chests piled nearby, sighing, “When the hell are we supposed to finish opening all these? Screw it, let’s just give up.”
…
This sleep.
Chen Yi slept for a long time, waking up feeling refreshed and clear-headed.
He also learned a lesson.
Just because his spiritual power would never exhaust, didn’t mean a person could go without sleep forever. Perhaps his body wouldn’t suddenly die from lack of sleep and wouldn’t greatly affect bodily functions, but his mind would inevitably start hallucinating. That was unavoidable.
Not even the title of ‘never exhausting spiritual power’ could compensate for that.
Waking from this sleep, it was now noon on January 17th.
Just in time for lunch.
After nearly 20 hours of sleep, Chen Yi, feeling hungry, got up, washed up, and was ready to find something to eat outside. Barely stepping out onto the rooftop, he saw Tuberculosis Rabbit rushing over excitedly, shouting,

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - 659 405 The First Strikes Harvest_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 659: Chapter 405: The First Strike’s Harvest!!!_4 Chapter 659: Chapter 405: The First Strike’s Harvest!!!_4 “It’s up, it’s up, Yi!”
“It rose to 240 Points!!!”
“What’s up?”
Chen Yi glanced at the Tuberculosis Rabbit, a bit baffled, but quickly grasped the situation, and said with sudden realization, “Oh, you’re talking about the price increase of the E-grade random Prop Chests?”
“Exactly!”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit projected the price trend chart of the E-grade Prop Chests excitedly into the air, pointing at the panel in front and said, somewhat agitated, “We bought these E-grade random Prop Chests at 61 Points each.”
“And now, the lowest price has climbed to 240 Points, and it’s still sliding.”
“Which means, if we could sell all our stock at the price of 240 Points, we would instantly gain 240 billion Points, that’s over 200 billion Points, a several-fold increase, becoming instantly rich—aren’t we talking about us here?”
“Yi, that’s over 200 billion Points. Aren’t you excited?”
“Not excited…”
Chen Yi gave the Tuberculosis Rabbit a somewhat speechless glance, “What’s the use of having so many Points? Is that what we need right now? Can’t you use your brain? I don’t even know what to say to you.”
“If we sell these Prop Chests, what will we open?”
“What will we use to stack Luck Points?”
“Sell them for what?”
“Useless!”
“Besides, if we suddenly put these 1 billion Prop Chests on the market, I bet the price would plummet instantly. Forget 240 Points, I’m worried we might not be able to keep it above 24 Points.”
“Alright, enough nonsense.”
Chen Yi, full of energy and excitement, rubbed his hands together, eyes shining, “The main event starts today!!!!”
After days of relentless effort.
His Luck Points had reached over a million.
He did not know how much Wen Ping’s Luck Points were, nor the effects of Luck Points under Wen Ping’s condition, but he had no time left for experiments; he needed to hurry up with something.
That was—
His “Gold Miner” role was about to expire.
The duration of this role was seven days, and five and a half had already gone by; there was only a day and a half left.
Why had he been stacking Luck Points without sleep for the past five days? Wasn’t it all for now?
It was like an angler who had spent the whole night preparing a big bag of bait, all for a frenzied nesting at the fish pond the next day, craving the sensation of constant bites.
He would definitely not come up empty!
“Sigh.”
Upon this thought, Chen Yi suddenly felt a pang of regret. The timing of this role’s appearance wasn’t perfect. If only it had appeared right after he obtained “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,” that would have been ideal.
Perhaps another seven days later.
Wait until his Luck Points were maxed out, and then have the role appear again, that would have been perfect.
But now was enough, a day and a half was plenty of time for him to operate.
…
“Whew!”
Without even eating, Chen Yi pulled out his Jade Fishing Rod and with a solemn and serious expression, cast his line forward, watching his hook disappear into a white portal.
The fishing line vanished in mid-air.
Like a born immortal, he sat on the clouds, fishing with his heart.
“Heh.”
Chen Yi’s lips curled into a slight smirk, letting out a cold chuckle, then began to wait with bated breath for his big catch. With his Luck Points at their peak, he did not believe he would still reel in any trash.
Soon—
Five minutes quickly passed by.
The hook was reeled back in automatically, one round of fishing was over, and tied to the hook was a Prop that he was very familiar with.
“Zenith Radiance!”
A gem worth tens of millions of Points, and even priceless to the market!
The first time!
The first cast, a magnificent catch!!!
“It went up, it went up, Yi!”
“It’s up to 240 Points!!!”
“What went up?”
Chen Yi felt a bit baffled as he glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit, but it didn’t take long for him to catch on and, with a sudden realization, he exclaimed, “Oh, are you talking about the price increase for the E-class random Prop Chests?”
“Exactly, that’s the one!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, brimming with excitement, projected the price trend chart of the E-class Prop Chests into midair and pointed at the panel in front of him, somewhat agitated, saying, “We bought this batch of E-class random Prop Chests at 61 Points.”
“And now the lowest price is at 240 Points, and it is still dropping.”
“That means, if we could sell all the stock we have in hand at the price of 240 Points, we’d instantly make 240 billion Points, which is over 200 billion Points in profit—several times what we invested, a sudden windfall. Doesn’t that sound like us?”
“Yi, we’re talking about over 200 billion Points here, aren’t you excited?”
“Not excited…”
Chen Yi rolled his eyes somewhat speechlessly at Tuberculosis Rabbit, “What’s the use of having so many Points? Is that what we need right now? Can’t you think a little? I don’t even know what to say to you.”
“If we sell these Prop Chests, what would we open then?”
“What would we use to stack our Luck Points?”
“Sell them for what?”
“Useless!”
“Besides, if we were to suddenly put these 1 billion Prop Chests on the market, I bet the price would immediately crash, not to mention 240 Points, I fear even 24 Points wouldn’t hold.”
“Okay, okay, no more nonsense.”
Chen Yi, full of energy and excitement, rubbed his hands together and his eyes shone brightly, “It’s time for today’s main event!!!”
After these days of relentless effort,
his Luck Points had reached over a million.
He didn’t know how many Luck Points Wen Ping had, nor the effects Wen Ping’s current status might have with those Luck Points, but now he had no time for experiments, he needed to hurry up with something.
That was—
His Gold Miner profession was about to expire.
This profession had a time limit of 7 days, and now five and a half days had passed; there was only a day and a half left.
Why had he stayed up all night for the past five days stacking Luck Points, if not for this moment?
It was like an angler who had toiled all night to prepare a massive bag of bait, just so he could rush to the fish pond the next day and furiously bait the spot. It was all for the sensation of constant bites on the line.
He must not come up empty![Air Force]
“Sigh.”
Thinking this, Chen Yi suddenly felt a bit regretful; the timing of this profession’s availability was still not ideal. It would have been better if it had appeared right after he had obtained the “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” prop.
Like, maybe waiting for another seven days.
Wait till his Luck Points were stacked full, then if the profession reappeared, that would be perfect.
But now was good enough, a day and a half was more than sufficient for him to have plenty of room to maneuver.
…
“Phew!”
Chen Yi didn’t even stop to eat, and took out his Jade Fishing Rod from his bosom, his expression devout and serious as he cast the fishing rod forward, watching the hook land in a white portal.
The fishing line vanished into thin air.
Sitting like a born immortal on a cloud, he fished with a tranquil heart.
“Heh.”
Chen Yi’s lips curled into a slight smirk, gave a cold chuckle, and then began to wait expectantly for his big catch. With maximum Luck Points, he couldn’t believe he would reel in any junk.
Suddenly—
Five minutes darted by.
The hook was automatically reeled back in, ending one round of fishing, and tied to the hook was a prop he knew all too well.
“Zenith Radiance!”
A jewel worth tens of millions of Points, even priceless on the market!
The first time!
The first cast’s harvest!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - 660 406 The Sea Gods Suit is Complete
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 660: Chapter 406: The Sea God’s Suit is Complete! Chapter 660: Chapter 406: The Sea God’s Suit is Complete! “Yi.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke emotionlessly, “I feel I must say this, but the Gold Miner hooked back a man on the verge of death, and it was impossible to tell which race he belonged to. After the man died, he dropped precisely five Skill Fragments.”
“Not a single other thing fell.”
“Moreover, these five Skill Fragments were all from the same skill, and that skill was even S-rank.”
“This matter—”
“It’s completely unreasonable!”
Yes.
It was like unreasonableness had opened the door for unreasonableness, reaching a new peak in irrationality!
It was simply preposterous.
This event should not even occur in children’s stories full of coincidences.
“But.” The Tuberculosis Rabbit paused for a moment, then cracked a smile with a somewhat excited expression, “I like it, is this what it’s like when Luck Points are maxed out?”
“An S-rank skill sounds awesome, Yi, hurry up and show me the panel.”
Chen Yi did not speak, but after merging the five Skill Fragments into one, he projected the Skill panel into mid-air.
‘Skill Name’: Turn Back from the Masses
‘Skill Level’: S-rank.
‘Skill Effect’: Once the skill is activated, you will obtain tremendous physical strength and some minor changes will occur to your body. As a trade-off, you cannot actively activate any Prop in this state.
Passive effects of equipped items will trigger as normal and the speed of your injury recovery will increase significantly.
It can be sustained for two hours and will enter a one-week cooldown period after use.
‘Skill Introduction’: When you acquire power, there’s always a price to pay.
“One week?”
Chen Yi thoughtfully looked at the skill panel before him; this was the first time he had seen a skill with a cooldown period of a whole week. Normally, skill cooldown times were either one day or 24 hours.
Well, that doesn’t seem to be quite the same thing.
Anyway, this was now the skill with the longest cooldown time among all his skills.
But the skill effect was indeed a bit baffling.
What does it mean by tremendous strength?
Just an ordinary sentence, I couldn’t see any skill effect, but after all, it’s an S-rank skill, so it shouldn’t be weak, right?
“Should we try it out? Otherwise, it seems hard to tell what it is.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit next to him suggested.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi, having the same intention, did not refuse. He took a deep breath and abruptly activated the skill.
The next second—
Chen Yi felt his perspective quickly elevating. When it stopped, he was already looking down upon the city. He gazed at his own body in a baffled way.
This is what you call a minor change?!
His body had grown to a height of over a hundred meters, even taller than the bizarre creature he had encountered before, which had crawled out of the deep sea. His muscles looked extremely intimidating.
Those huge and hard muscles seemed as if they were cast from concrete.
His skin had also turned a complete crimson red.
And…
He grew a tail from his back like a Nine-section Whip, covered in barbs and looking extremely sharp. Just swaying it casually, one could hear the sound of explosions.
The feeling of controlling the tail was strange; this was the first time he had ever felt the sensation of controlling an organ like a tail. Despite being his first time, it felt incredibly natural.
It was as if he was born knowing how to use it.
On his back grew a set of crimson, fleshy wings, large enough to completely envelope him.
He could feel the explosive and impactful strength inside his body, and if he wasn’t flying in mid-air, having moved slightly away from the rooftop’s surface, he likely would have crushed the entire building with his foot.
It might sound exaggerated.
But he felt it was no joke.
He tentatively swung a fist, and the air in front of him rapidly condensed, followed by a bleak, wolf-like howling as if the air had been violently compressed.
“Boom!!!”
“Phew.”
Chen Yi let out a sigh, looking at his fist that now measured in meters, feeling he could kill a cow with it—or rather, a god.
Although he couldn’t activate any Props.
Passive items like ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ were still usable, along with ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’.
That is to say, in this state, not only was his physical strength immense, an extra attack organ was added, his recovery speed was extremely high, his Life Value sky-high, Luck Points maxed out, he could also exit the state at any time to summon a sky full of Buddhas to attack enemies from afar.
It was simply perfect.
This Prop perfectly filled the gap in his close-combat deficiencies.
The only downside was that the transformation was way too drastic; it didn’t look human at all anymore. No human was over a hundred meters tall, with crimson skin, and that constantly twitching tail. The entire figure just looked like an oversized Demon.
As if it just crawled out from hell.
After getting a rough understanding of his skill, Chen Yi didn’t linger in mid-air. He undid the transformation and returned directly to the rooftop surface.
“Awesome!”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit happily gave a thumbs up, “If Yi met that monster from the deep sea now, you probably wouldn’t need any weapons. Just activate this Prop, swing your fists and smash that monster to pieces. Just thinking about it is satisfying.”
“Let’s not talk about that.”

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - 661 406 Sea Gods Suit Collection Complete_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 661: Chapter 406: Sea God’s Suit Collection Complete!_2 Chapter 661: Chapter 406: Sea God’s Suit Collection Complete!_2 Upon hearing Sword Without End’s words, his complexion turned ugly, “You’ve never been inside that monster’s belly; you have no idea how dangerous it is there. I barely spent fifteen minutes inside and I felt like I was almost cut off from the world.”
“Mainly, it’s the sense of powerlessness and despair that covers your whole being, it’s very uncomfortable.”
“If we do encounter it, I suggest that we avoid using our fists as much as possible, that’s not our strength.”
Chen Yi didn’t pay attention to the others’ conversation anymore, but sat on the edge of the roof again, throwing his fishing rod far into the distance, and started waiting patiently for his new prey to bite.
As a qualified hunter.
He had ample patience and experience.
…
At the same time.
A middle-aged man sat expressionlessly in a cafe, looking at the constant stream of phone notification pop-ups, sighing deeply before he picked up the phone and spoke softly, “I’m here, go ahead.”
“You’re with your mom!!!
An irate voice soon came through the phone, “Bring me back all the ‘Turn Back from the Masses’ Skill Fragments damn it, don’t you know I need them urgently here?”
“What the hell are you doing.
“…You might not believe what I’m about to say, but the moment before the deal was about to start, the other party turned on me and it got messy; I was up against dozens of them all by myself, it was brutal.”
“And then what?”
Still screeching harshly, the voice on the phone shouted, “You’re still able to answer the call, doesn’t that mean you’re alive and well? I don’t have time to talk nonsense with you right now, this skill is key to slaughtering the ‘Floor God’, do you think I’m joking with you?!!”
“So… I managed to escape from the encirclement, badly injured.”
“But——”
The man sitting in Hell’s Cafe spoke with a complex expression, “All of a sudden, I saw a white Void Portal appear before me, and before I could react, a golden hook flew out from it, grabbed me, and took me to a strange world.”
“It seemed to be on top of a roof, and there were several people around me staring at me with confused faces.”
“It seemed like they were also shocked by my appearance.”
“And I’ve just searched what that thing was; it’s an effect of the ‘Gold Miner’ profession, a profession that very few would choose. It’s said that this profession can randomly grab anything in the cosmos, including players. I was hooked by that hook.”
“The moment I was dropped, I died, and then…”
“Then what the fuck!!!”
On the phone, a voice now seemed furious and desperate, “I don’t have time to listen to this crap; I need the ‘Turn Back from the Masses’ Skill Fragments, do you get it? People are attacking my doorstep and without that prop, do you expect me to block with my head?”
“Don’t rush, boss.”
The man in the cafe didn’t quite know how to start, and after hesitating for a moment, he braved it, “When I revived in hell, that’s when I realized the ‘Turn Back from the Masses’ Skill Fragments had dropped.”
“Dropped.”
There was an obvious silence over the phone, and after a long while, the voice came back hoarse, tinged with anger, “If one is lost, then one is lost. There are still four ‘Turn Back from the Masses’ Skill Fragments. Hurry up and put the word out to buy a ‘Turn Back from the Masses’ Skill Fragment, there might still be a chance to collect five before the final battle.”
“That…”
The man shrank his neck a little and moved his wristwatch further away, “All five have been lost. All five ‘Turn Back from the Masses’ Skill Fragments have dropped. Aside from those items, nothing else dropped.”
As expected, the next second.
The voice on the phone screamed heartrendingly again, “What? All five Skill Fragments dropped? Are you fucking messing with an idiot?”
“Do you think I’d believe that?”
The odds of dropping a prop aren’t high, and the odds of dropping Skill Fragments are even lower, especially when it comes to dropping the same type of Skill Fragments, the probability is unimaginably low.
“It’s somewhat absurd, but it’s true.”
In the cafe, the man sighed deeply and with a bit of helplessness, in fact, he hadn’t even gotten a clear look at their faces, just a brief glance, and the next thing he knew, he had bitten the dust and ended up brought to hell on his own planet.
Actually, this man should be grateful that he died quickly; Chen Yi hadn’t even had the chance to act before the man had keeled over on the spot.
Otherwise, if he had died at Chen Yi’s hand, he wouldn’t have even had the chance to be revived; players killed by Chen Yi are not allowed to be revived.
…
Within Yancheng.
Li Yide was standing on a three-story building’s rooftop, his face full of longing as he reminisced about the scene he had just witnessed. He hadn’t expected Yi to share his hobby, also enjoying a tail.
The only difference was,
Yi’s tail seemed a bit sharper, and it was also larger.
He didn’t come up to watch on purpose; it was getting cold inside with winter coming, and the sun was good at noon, so he decided to come out and enjoy the sunlight, the best time. And then he just happened to see Yi, who had transformed and was unabashedly experimenting with his power in the open air on the rooftop.
Even after all this time, he could still hear the presence of the sonic boom.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - 662 406 Sea Gods Suit Collection Complete_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 662: Chapter 406: Sea God’s Suit Collection Complete!_3 Chapter 662: Chapter 406: Sea God’s Suit Collection Complete!_3 …
By this time, Chen Yi had all but forgotten about the skill “Turn Back from the Masses.” In his view, there were only a few specific scenarios where this skill would be useful; for the most part, it wasn’t needed.
After all, if he could bombard an area with firepower, why should he roll up his sleeves and personally enter the battlefield?
Especially since he couldn’t even understand the name of this skill.
Turn Back from the Masses?
At first, it sounded like one of those skills that granted a buff or a debuff when turning one’s back to an enemy or fellow clan members. However, the actual effect of the skill was completely different from what he had imagined.
It was almost the opposite.
It was simply a straightforward transformation skill. Why name a transformation skill “Turn Back from the Masses”?
As Chen Yi absentmindedly wondered about this, he sat quietly at the edge of the rooftop, fishing and waiting for the next five minutes to pass.
Perhaps it was a habit developed from spending too much mental effort on designing that environment recently; his mind found it difficult to relax, even when he was doing nothing, subconsciously pondering all kinds of random things.
It was as if his brain had forgotten how to rest, becoming accustomed to working round the clock every day and night.
This was not good news.
And at that moment—
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully…”
As the system’s notification sounded, Chen Yi looked at the Zenith Radiance he had pulled up in his hand, his expression dazed, the effect of the Luck Points seemingly more potent than he had anticipated.
With just over a million Luck Points, he already felt like a son of fortune.
If he managed to open all those billion treasure chests, what would he become? A father of fortune?
He didn’t understand.
But one thing he did understand was that going through all this trouble to deal with Wen Ping was necessary. It was a good thing he had prepared early; otherwise, he might have been the one lying in the Wasteland now.
Time passed swiftly.
The clock reached 11 p.m. on January 18th.
After 12 a.m.
The career of the “Gold Miner” had expired, and the wild joy from Luck’s Child was about to come to an end. It was the last hour of celebration before the next random career change, and who knew what it would be.
And his achievements in these two days were numerous.
Are S-class props rare?
Rare.
In two days, he reeled in four of them.
Are S-class skills rare? He pulled in three, two of which were Sword Cultivator Skills, fully arming Sword Without End from head to toe.
Are S-class costumes rare? Equally rare, he snagged one, and gave it to Jiaye.
Even the Hammer, he fished up an S-class prop called “Hammer of Thor,” now truly a hammer for Tie Chui.
As for A and B class props, they reeled in too many to bother counting; a rough estimate suggested over a hundred. And Zenith Radiance? They pulled up a total of 17.
Keep in mind,
This game operates on the principle of conservation of energy.
The things hooked back by the Gold Miner’s hook weren’t created out of thin air but were taken from other places or other players. This meant that as he pulled 17 Zenith Radiance across, there were 17 players, or fewer, who had lost Zenith Radiance in their possession.
And this situation had caused quite a commotion.
After all, it was truly brazen.
An item worth over ten million Points disappearing without a trace due to a claw hook? Total silence—it’s only natural for one to make a post and vent their frustration.
One couldn’t keep quiet about it, and as word spread, it turned out that many players had their Zenith Radiance hooked away while preparing for enhancement. More and more people joined the ranks, some claiming their wives were hooked away, others saying their loot dropped by bosses was snatched before they could collect it, and so on.
Among these, there were some just joining in for fun.
And some who had genuinely experienced it.
But such things were unimportant to Chen Yi, who was currently tallying his gains from the past two days. With less than an hour until the career change, “bountiful harvest” was the only way to describe it.
It left him quite satisfied.
Just then—
The hook suddenly retracted from the white teleportation circle, bringing back something new, a boot covered in seaweed and slightly battered.
Chen Yi looked at the boot and was momentarily taken aback before an excited gleam quickly erupted in his eyes and a smile involuntarily spread across his face as he considered the panel in front of him.
–
“Prop Name”: Sea God’s Boots (1/2)
“Prop Level”: SSS-class.
“Prop Effects”:
1: When wearing this prop, you possess the ability to walk on any water surface and can freely dive or surface, ignoring water pressure. You can also breathe easily underwater.
2: When wearing this prop, your field of vision in the deep sea will be greatly enhanced, and darkness will be no obstacle.
3: When wearing this prop, all fish, whales, and other creatures will avoid you.
4: You will gain the ability to converse with any undersea creature. If the creature’s intelligence is too low to use language, you can still roughly understand what they are trying to communicate.
5: This conversational ability is not limited by distance. As long as the other party is in the same body of water as you, conversation is possible, even if you’re millions of kilometers apart, provided there is a connection point between the waters.
6: While on the water’s surface or bottom, all of your props will be upgraded to “Ultimate Props.”
7: While on the water’s surface or bottom, your life will be linked to the body of water. As long as the sea is undying, so are you.

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - 663 406 The Sea Gods Suit is Complete_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 663: Chapter 406: The Sea God’s Suit is Complete!_4 Chapter 663: Chapter 406: The Sea God’s Suit is Complete!_4 8: When you are exposed to the air, you will suffer true damage, with 1% of your maximum health value deducted every minute. The instant you return to the surface, your health will be fully restored.
“Prop Limitation”: This prop is one of the components of the Sea God’s Shoes set; obtaining this prop alone only activates its first five effects. Only when you have the complete Sea God’s Suit can you activate all effects.
“Prop Introduction”: “I, Posidon, am the Eternal God who is immortal and indestructible!”
–
These are the complete attributes of this prop.
Prior to this, he had already obtained the other boot of the Sea God, but because he only had one boot, he could only activate the first five effects and couldn’t fully utilize the Sea God’s Suit.
As for now.
Both boots had been collected by him, meaning that all of the Sea God’s Suit boots’ effects could be used by him.
These included—
While in the water, all props on the body are upgraded to “Ultimate Props”, when in the water, life is connected to the sea and will never perish; when exposed to the air, true damage equal to 1% of maximum life value is deducted every minute, but as soon as you return to the surface, health can be instantly restored.
The first two are basically bugs within bugs.
The first needs no explanation, a divine Skill in finance management.
The second, a divine Skill for saving one’s life. As long as there is water, he will never die unless the water is drained or evaporated.
The third is a debuff. Wearing these boots will continuously drain health, but he won’t be wearing these boots all the time, only activating this prop when he needs to fight in water.
So in most cases, this debuff won’t affect him.
And this third point also has an ability to quickly regain health, no, not just quickly, but to instantly restore health.
That means, even if his health is almost depleted, he just needs to jump into the sea to instantly recover his health.
It doesn’t even need to be the sea.
In a lake, a river, a park pond, a hot spring, or the swimming pool in the backyard, all of these could work.
As long as there’s water, he can instantly regain health—it’s simply a divine Skill.
Next, he needs to make a judgment about this point to see how the activation mechanism works.
Otherwise, it feels like just letting Sword Without End douse him with a spray for twenty-four hours would count as being in water too! Wouldn’t he be invincible around the clock, able to infinitely and instantly restore health?
Of course, this is just a guess.
What exactly it is, he’ll have to test it out later.
…
Chen Yi did not rush to test it. Instead, he sat in place full of hope, looking expectantly at the rooftop and the fishing hook thrown into the void, curious to see what the next catch would be.
It’s almost over, yet an SSS-grade prop like this has shown up.
And it’s even part of a set—who could handle that?
Maybe in the next few minutes, even more incredible things will appear.
…
Meanwhile—
In some deep-sea location, at an unknown depth, the thick darkness was growing rampantly without restraint.
A corpse with closed eyes was slowly drifting with the currents, like a dandelion abandoned at birth, aimlessly floating without a destination in sight.
The body was deep blue all over, with many starry spots on the skin.
Approximately one meter eighty.
A man.
His features looked extremely tough, with very distinct angles. Although his body was motionless, he still exuded a strong sense of pressure.
However—
The clothes on this corpse were neat and tidy, yet on the left and right feet, there was nothing at all— as if there should have been two boots covered in seaweed.
After a long while.
“Is it over?”
The man slowly opened his eyes, as still as death, and looked down at his bare feet, his big toes restlessly rubbing against each other: “It’s so cold deep under the sea, not even a single boot left for me. My feet are going to be cold, and I won’t sleep well.”
“Hey!”
Having said that, the man looked up at the water above as if talking to someone: “Can we make a deal and get my boots back? At the very least give me…”
Before he could finish.
“Boom!”
A column of light from above the sea pierced straight down, striking the man and slamming him hard onto the ocean floor. The galaxy-like speckles on his skin began to flicker and turned into chains that bound him.
Almost at the same moment.
A hoarse voice rose in his ears.
‘The “Ultimate Two” map’s opening conditions have not yet been met. As the final boss of the “Ultimate Two” map, Sea God Posidon, you should remain obedient.’
‘Any more misconduct, and you will bear the consequences!’
‘You have been warned once already!’
“Ah, crap!”
The man shifted his body somewhat dazedly as if the previous attack hadn’t inflicted any damage on him, murmuring hazily: “Is it never going to end? I was just complaining about not having boots and how my feet would get cold.”
“This is the deep sea, for heaven’s sake.”
“Don’t you have any idea how cold it is down here?”
“So annoying. When is the map going to meet the conditions to open? Is it that hard to die these days?”
“Do I, the map boss, have to keep being frozen here before the map opens? That’s just…”
His voice abruptly stopped.
Seeing that another column of light was gathering above the ocean floor, the man wisely shut his mouth. The earlier strike wasn’t painless, he had just grown accustomed to the pain. But this strike seemed even more powerful, and he definitely didn’t want to endure another one like it.
It hurt a lot.
Forget it, I don’t even know the specific conditions for the “Ultimate Two” map to open now.
Two is the uppercase form of the number two.
Hopefully, someone will come and clear it soon; I’m exhausted.
Who knows how many years ago, he was a genius player, a genius to the extent that he could clear the “Ultimate Two” map by himself, defeating the boss and earning the full set of Sea God’s Suit fashion components as a reward.
The Sea God’s Shoes were just two of those components.
And… to serve as the copy boss until the next person cleared it.
Yes!
This map is a huge trap; whoever clears it gets to serve as the copy boss until replaced by the next person.
The infuriating thing is, after so much time, the map hasn’t even been opened to the public, and nobody has come to challenge him, the boss, let alone replace him and allow him to breathe a breath of freedom once again.
…
…
PS: I’ve been updating daily with 7k words for almost a month now. Because of some mental stress earlier, my updates were inconsistent, and I lost a lot of followers. After stabilizing updates for a month, many have returned.
It turns out that in the online fiction world, consistent updates are indeed core.
How much you update doesn’t matter; it’s the consistency that’s most important.
This book could have achieved better results, but frequent breaks and unfulfilled promises of extra updates have led to the loss of many readers, and the handling of the later plot wasn’t very good either.
My fault. I’ll take this lesson into the next book.
There are probably about 200,000 or maybe 300,000 words left until the end?
I’m not sure; I’ll keep advancing the plot until the characters reach Tenfold Planet and encounter…, and then it will end. About 300,000 words should be needed to push the story, I guess.
Currently, it’s at 1.4 million words, and the final word count will likely be around 1.6 million words.
It’s a pity, after so many years in the industry, I’ve never written a novel with over 2 million words. I really wanted to write one. Hopefully, the outline for the next book can be more detailed.
Lastly, thank you all for your patient support.

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - 664 407 Special Event—Gold Rain from the Sky
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 664: Chapter 407: “Special Event—Gold Rain from the Sky! Chapter 664: Chapter 407: “Special Event—Gold Rain from the Sky! “So annoying!!!”
The Sea God, who was initially sleeping rather peacefully, became agitated as his rest was mysteriously disturbed and the annoying matters came to mind, prompting him to scratch his own scalp in irritation.
“When can I get out of here!!!”
He wanted to return to Blue Star.
And that name, Posidon, absolutely speechless!!
Which boss uses the name of a down jacket brand for themselves?
…
In the following dozens of minutes, perhaps Chen Yi’s luck had been drained by the appearance of the Sea God’s Boots, as he didn’t manage to draw anything good afterward, at best a B-level Prop.
If it was during the last time when he randomly got the Gold Miner profession.
He might have been excited.
He might even have whipped up a small barbeque to celebrate, but now… forget it, the past couple of days had raised his threshold too high, a mere B-level Prop could no longer stir his spirit.
Soon—
Midnight arrived.
The Gold Miner profession once again slipped away from him.
“Is it gone?”
Seeing that the occupations were changing and refreshing this week’s new professions, Chen Yi, with a face full of regret and disappointment, put away the Jade Fishing Rod in his hand, having had a blast these past couple of days.
This feeling left him feeling fulfilled.
It reminded him of a small game he used to play where a bug had surfaced, allowing for endless daily login rewards instead of just one.
In fact, these were insignificant rewards.
Almost useless.
But the thrill of getting something for nothing was exhilarating, and even though these rewards were nearly worthless, he couldn’t resist clicking for several hours straight until he couldn’t take it anymore and had accumulated a pile of useless rewards in his storage. Even if he did nothing else, just having them there felt good.
The pleasure of getting something for nothing was truly the most comfortable.
That’s how he felt now.
As Chen Yi’s mind wandered, the new profession also descended.
‘Occupation Name’: Wandering Bard.
‘Occupational Effect’: Every sentence you speak must forcibly end in a single rhyme, and if the last word between two sentences does not rhyme, a special event will randomly trigger.
Additionally, every sentence you say will ooze with a scholarly cultural tone and contain a strong element of allure.
Beyond that, there’s a certain chance that what you say may appear in the description of some Prop.
‘Occupational Restriction’: You must speak at least 1000 sentences per day.
“…”
Chen Yi looked at this profession panel with a bemused expression, thinking that among all the professions he had randomly obtained, ‘Wandering Bard’ could probably rank third from the bottom.
Basically.
Useless, this so-called chance of appearing in the description of some Prop.
It was utterly meaningless, what use did it have for him?
However, now he understood why some Props’ descriptions ended with…
‘”The only way I can meet her is in my dreams, yet you insist it’s an illness.” —From a Wandering Bard of some planet.’
Now he got it.
The sentences spoken by the Wandering Bard had certain odds of ending up in that spot, but what use did this feature have? The least you could do is give the bard a name, right?
At least something like ‘From the Wandering Bard Chen Yi of Blue Star.’
In that case, he’d feel it had some use; at least it would seem somewhat fun. If one day he encountered a Prop with his name in the description, he might even get excited, as it would feel like leaving a trace of himself in this vast world.
But without even a name, it was truly useless.
So the only remaining effect was to make him seem a bit more scholarly and his words more alluring.
Can you believe it?
The Professional System that only Sixfold Planet could choose actually offered a job with just an alluring effect. What normal person would choose such a lousy job? If it was a forced allure, that might be something, but a hint of allure had such a negligible effect it was laughable.
Even politicians probably wouldn’t want this job.
Moreover, he needed to end every sentence on a rhyme, or else trigger a special event. Who knows what these so-called random special events could be, but certainly, they wouldn’t be anything good.
This feature should clearly be listed under Occupational Restriction, yet it was somehow included in the Occupational Effect.
“Let’s go out for a meal today, what do you guys think?”
Chen Yi said a piece of nonsense tentatively just to force a rhyme, and after uttering this nonsense, nothing happened, suggesting that no special event was triggered.
That’s when he grasped the cruelty within the Occupational Restriction.
To speak at least 1000 sentences a day, under the prerequisite that he had to rhyme, was similar to last April’s rule when the game first hit Blue Star—except that now, to think of 1000 sentences where the last words rhymed was not a simple task.
You could basically forget about doing anything else for the day.
Just pondering rhymes would be enough.
After all, if you weren’t seriously thinking and putting in the effort, managing 1000 rhyming sentences in one day was no easy feat.
Then Chen Yi wanted to test what the special event would be when the rhyme was not followed. After a brief pause, he opened his mouth to speak again, “Man conquers nature, nature conquers man.”

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - 665 407 Special Event - Rain of Gold_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 665: Chapter 407: “Special Event – Rain of Gold!”_2 Chapter 665: Chapter 407: “Special Event – Rain of Gold!”_2 His words had barely left his lips.
A prompt sounded next to his ear.
“Ding, it has been detected that player Chen Yi’s words did not meet the precondition that a ‘Wandering Bard’ must rhyme, hence a special event — Golden Rainfall — is randomly triggered.”
“Event Effect”: The Golden Rain will last for 5 minutes, and any player drenched by the rain will receive Points as a reward.
The next second—
The sky suddenly started to gather dark clouds, quickly turning the sky extremely dark, and this scene didn’t just happen in Yancheng. If Chen Yi’s view was high enough, he would have seen this scene happening globally.
Almost the entire globe was covered by these gloomy clouds.
Before the players had time to consult with each other, the rain began to patter down from the sky.
Soon.
A drop of rain fell on Chen Yi’s shoulder, and at the same moment, another prompt sounded by his ear.
“Ding, a drop of Golden Rain has fallen on your skin, your Points Balance +10”
Immediately after, as the rain grew heavier, similar notification sounds kept ringing.
“…”
A flash of shock crossed Chen Yi’s eyes; this was the random special event he triggered. Golden Rain falling all over Yancheng? Any player hit by the rain would receive Points as a reward.
Although the Points weren’t many.
It was, after all, something for nothing, and not just one drop of rain; the ground was awash with rain, and by merely standing in one place for a while, one could easily gain a few hundred or even a thousand Points.
Could there be an easier task?
What Chen Yi didn’t know at the moment was that the Golden Rain wasn’t limited to Yancheng but was a global event.
It was raining globally.
About five minutes later, the rain stopped, and Tuberculosis Rabbit swallowed his saliva, a bit stunned as he said, “Just in these five minutes, my Points increased by more than 2000. Isn’t that a bit too much?”
2000 Points were nothing to them as their assets were counted in tens of billions.
But don’t forget, Blue Star was still in the Novice Period. Having such a special event during the Novice Period, with each player drenched by the rain harvesting 2000 Points, in a way, this special event even enhanced the overall strength of all players on Blue Star.
Yes.
All over Blue Star.
He had just taken a look at the forum, and it was already exploding with discussions, and they found out from the forum that the wide coverage of the Golden Rain wasn’t just in Yancheng but all over Blue Star.
In every corner.
“Holy crap, I thought the system was bugging out, but it turned out to be real. Getting Points for being in the rain?”
“I thought it was just me alone. You guys got it too?”
“Stop it, if you keep talking, I’m going to become reclusive. I was sleeping in my room just now, didn’t get rained on at all, my Points didn’t go up!!! I’m so pissed!! Why did I have to sleep this evening!!”
“The notification told me it was Yi who triggered the special event, hence this Golden Rain thing.”
“Same here, I was still confused about the situation just now.”
At this moment on the forum, many players were discussing.
Especially since many had not been outside in the rain but were sleeping or resting in their homes, and it was only after the rain stopped that they learned being in the rain could actually reward them.
There were even some players who had just emerged from a map to discover that the rewards they worked hard for on the map weren’t even as much as what players got from standing in the rain; they were in despair.
Indeed, luck often outshines effort.
“Not bad.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said wistfully, flicking his tongue. These five minutes had provided him with more than 2000 Points. Each drop of rain that hit him was worth 10 Points; naturally, there were far more than just 200 drops in those five minutes. It seemed, however, that there was some protection mechanism in place.
So no matter how much rain he got drenched in, he would at most gain just over 2000 Points.
…
Looking at the special event section on his personal panel, Chen Yi thoughtfully pondered for a long while before saying another meaningless piece of drivel, “Hello, world.”
The next second—
“Ding, it has been detected that player Chen Yi’s words did not meet the precondition that a ‘Wandering Bard’ must rhyme, hence a special event — Daiyu Picking Flowers — is randomly triggered.”
“Event Effect”: A fresh flower will randomly spring up in the shadows. Picking the flower will reward one with a random outfit, lasting for half an hour.
The words concluded!
Tuberculosis Rabbit noticed that behind the rooftop’s security door, in the shadows, a flower resembling a morning glory brazenly poked its head out, not bothering to hide at all.
It was as obvious as it could be.
He hurriedly picked it and, sure enough, a notification declared he had obtained a D-grade costume, an earring. Its effect wasn’t too weak, but it was useless to them now as they had better luxury replacements.
“Goodness me…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit murmured in a shocked tone, “Yi, I think I understand what’s going on. Logically, since your Wandering Bard profession requires you to speak 1000 sentences a day, it clearly expects each of your sentences to rhyme, or a special event would randomly occur.”
“And most of these special events are probably negative.”
“No!”
“To be exact, the vast majority should be negative, but since your Luck Points are already maxed out, it led to the negative events you randomly get turning out to be all positive!”

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - 666 407 Special Event - Rain of Gold_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 666: Chapter 407: “Special Event – Rain of Gold!”_3 Chapter 666: Chapter 407: “Special Event – Rain of Gold!”_3 “And it’s global coverage!”
“Although these Points and costumes don’t mean much to us, they can enhance the strength of Blue Star players overall. For other players, this stuff is very useful.”
“Yeah!” Sword Without End’s eyes also lit up, “In that case, we can also boost the overall strength of the players by continuously creating special events.”
“After all, the stronger the overall power of Blue Star players, the easier it’ll be to advance to higher planets in the future, and the greater the success rate of upgrade will be.”
Upgrading a planet isn’t about the strength of a single player.
It is about the collective strength of all players on a planet.
Of course, that’s in theory.
In practice, for players like Chen Yi, who have exceptionally exaggerated individual strength, it’s possible to completely ignore the strength of other players and single-handedly lead the entire planet in advancing.”
In this case, the advancement speed is indeed quick; at least there should be no problem before the Fourfold Planet. However, it brings an apparent drawback: the overall strength of the players will be weak, far less than that of other players.
Most planets need about a year or even longer to advance from Onefold Planet to a Fourfold Planet.
But Chen Yi needs only two or three days.
This means that Blue Star players don’t really get a chance to build up their foundation. Even if they advance to a Fourfold Planet, if you don’t count Chen Yi’s strength, the overall strength of the players is probably not even up to a Twofold Planet.
“That’s the case.”
Chen Yi, who had long understood the situation, couldn’t help but smile silently.
He initially thought that the Wandering Bard was a useless profession that just restricted the way he spoke. Now, it seemed that the profession might be more bugged than Gold Miner.
Gold Miner only bolstered his own purse, while the Wandering Bard affected the purse of players worldwide.
And as the prompt sounded again.
The prompt echoed in his ears once more.
‘Ding, player Chen Yi’s statement has not satisfied the “Wandering Bard’s” prerequisite condition of rhyming, thus randomly triggering a special event… The previous special event has not ended, and no new special events can be triggered before the end of the previous one.’
The previous special event lasted half an hour, so it looks like he had to wait another half hour.
In this half-hour, Chen Yi didn’t waste time; instead, he launched another half hour of treasure chest opening, adding a bit more Luck Points before casually speaking a sentence to activate another special event.
‘Ding, player Chen Yi’s statement has not satisfied the “Wandering Bard’s” prerequisite condition of rhyming, thus randomly triggering the special event—Early Bidding.’
‘Event Effect’: Player Chen Yi can freely choose in his heart whether he wants a boy or a girl, and today’s first shot will definitely be a hit, and it will definitely be the gender of the child Chen Yi wants in his heart, with no duration limit.
“Eh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked confused at the event effect: “Leaving aside what kind of messy thing this event is, the previous two events were global in nature, but this one turned out to be for a single person.”
“I get it!”
Standing by, Sword Without End suddenly realized, “If I’m not mistaken, the special events that the Wandering Bard can trigger should be divided into four effects.”
“Global catastrophic events, individual catastrophic events, global lucky events, individual lucky events.”
“And because Yi’s Luck Points are too high, he basically can’t draw the first two, and the odds of drawing a global lucky event are smaller than an individual lucky event—after all, it’s global.”
“That means,” Yi could potentially trigger special events with either global or individual effects next time.”
“Blah blah blah.”
Chen Yi didn’t respond but continued to spontaneously utter a few words, preparing to trigger the next special event.
Since ‘Early Bidding’ had no duration, it meant he didn’t have to wait for the event to end to directly trigger a new special event.
As for this event, he didn’t plan to use it.
Putting aside whether he wanted a boy or a girl, he was simply not ready to have children. It wasn’t because he was worried they would suddenly perish in such an environment; they’d purchased a bunch of Props a long time ago that could ensure that children would not be affected by the rules until adulthood and could grow up smoothly.
It’s said that such Props could only be produced during the Novice Period, and there was no way to obtain them elsewhere, so they bought quite a few.
With these Props, there’s no need to worry about the children’s sudden death.
But the problem is, he didn’t plan on having children right now. Children are a topic for later; he didn’t even know when he might die himself, and he couldn’t let a child be born only to see their parents die right away.
They’ll talk about children and such when things get peaceful in the future. Thinking about it now would still be a bit premature.
As for whether it’s a boy or a girl, he wanted both, preferably twins, one of each—best of both worlds.
And with that nonsensical remark from Chen Yi, a new special event was triggered once more!
‘Ding, player Chen Yi’s statement has not satisfied the “Wandering Bard’s” prerequisite condition of rhyming, thus randomly triggering the special event—Brash Warrior Lighting Incense’
‘Event Effect’: For each somersault, receive 1000 Points (up to 3), lasting half an hour.

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - 667 407 Special Event - Rain of Gold_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 667: Chapter 407: “Special Event – Rain of Gold!”_4 Chapter 667: Chapter 407: “Special Event – Rain of Gold!”_4 Almost the very instant this event was triggered,
players all over the world received the message and instantly knew that Yi had triggered a special event once again, and this time the content was straightforward and brutal: just do three cartwheels to earn 3000 Points.
In no time—
many players immediately looked towards their beds and started doing cartwheels on them, as to why they didn’t do them on the ground? Naturally, because the bed is softer, and the ground is a bit too hard.
Even some of the older players were supporting their protruding lumbar discs as they started rolling on their beds.
The protruding lumbar discs are temporary, but 3000 Points are permanent.
As long as you have enough Points, buying a prop to treat a herniated lumbar disc couldn’t be simpler.
It’s worth mentioning that—
after so many months of development, the hospital system had been re-established, only that there were no public hospitals anymore; they all turned private. Modern medical technology was supplementary, while the primary methods involved purchasing props that could treat diseases.
For example, a prop for treating a herniated lumbar disc might sell for 300,000 Points.
The average player definitely couldn’t afford it.
But when a hospital purchases this prop and charges a player 3000 Points for treatment, it’s not only affordable for the player, but it also helps the hospital spread the cost, thus generating profits quickly after breaking even.
It’s beneficial in every way and harmful in none.
…
“Another global special event,”
After doing three cartwheels, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the 3000 Points that entered his account and grinned with satisfaction, “Yi, your profession can last for seven days, right? If you could trigger dozens of these global special events every day.”
“Not to sound too frank,”
“the overall player strength on Blue Star could at least multiply several times over. In the future, raising the planet’s level might not even need Yi’s inputs; the Blue Star players could finish the leveling tasks themselves.”
…
Soon—
the time reached 9 AM on January 20th.
A whole day and more had passed since the ‘Wandering Bard’ profession was updated early in the morning on January 19th, and during that day, there were 37 global special events and 12 individual special events in total.
Excited by these 37 global events, the players of Blue Star couldn’t even think of sleeping, let alone linger too long in the bathroom, for fear of missing any event, as delaying even a moment could mean missing the event’s duration.
Some special events could last for half an hour, some only three minutes, and they had even seen one that lasted just thirty seconds.
That particular global special event, which only lasted thirty seconds, required them to sneeze within that time frame, and as a reward, they would get a random Grade B prop.
This task wasn’t easy to complete, given the short time – they were unclear on how many people managed to do it.
But actually, there was a quick way to induce a sneeze.
That was to roll a napkin into a thin strip and then stick it up one’s nose, continuously pinching it – within a dozen seconds or so, a sneeze would come. Of course, if someone had a robust constitution, they might not be able to sneeze at all.
Some people find it very hard to sneeze, even with physiological stimulation.
And for others, just having a sip of hot soup can make them unable to resist sneezing.
People’s constitutions vary.
It’s like how, in a state of extreme rage, some people can punch a bear to death, which is not something everyone can do.
And as these numerous global special events kept being triggered one after another, it was as if the whole of Blue Star collectively used a cheat code, and all players saw their collective strength surge forward at breakneck speed.
…
The January rule was ‘Stay One Step Ahead’, which was essentially a global walking competition on WeChat. The players who ranked at the very bottom would find their bodies incredibly heavy, weighed down by multiple times the gravity, unable to move.
On the other hand,
Players with higher rankings will feel extremely light, to the point where even a small hop can make them feel like they’re about to take off.
However, Chen Yi, due to Wen Ping’s reason, stood in one place for the first ten or so days of the month, causing his ranking in this event to be extremely low, at the bottom.
This made the gravity on his body exceptionally heavy.
When he first came out of the Illusory Realm, he was almost too worn out to breathe, but later he played a trick by tying himself to a sleigh and letting the sleigh skim the ground while he ran behind it.
Soon he climbed up the ranks, not to a very high position, but at least he could move freely and didn’t feel like his hands were tied to lead balls, unable to move from the spot.
“It’s good that everyone’s strong.”
With a calm expression, Chen Yi said, “When the time comes for the planet to get promoted, I’ll have to exert less effort.”
Many people in the forums and other places thanked Yi for his contribution. Without Yi, it would’ve been a pipe dream for them to obtain so many rewards, especially considering so many global events happened in just one day.
And that one day was enough.
The duration of Chen Yi’s “Wandering Bard” class was now less than six days.
…
The good times are always fleeting, and time is always trickling away like this.
Soon, the date reached January 23rd.
The fifth day.
This was Chen Yi’s fifth day since randomly getting the “Wandering Bard” class, and in two more days, this class would expire.
During these days.
Chen Yi basically did two things—the first was to open treasure chests to accumulate Luck Points.
Every time he thought about his “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” Luck Points that had to be accumulated by opening treasure chests, Chen Yi couldn’t help but be full of complaints. He wondered if this was the same way the prop worked when Wen Ping had it. To obtain a single Luck Point for every chest opened seemed to take an eternity.
1 billion chests!!!
Although he had already opened more than a million chests, compared to the number of 1 billion, a million chests were practically negligible.
And during these days.
They had triggered over a hundred global special events, and after such feats, the players of Blue Star no longer looked vulnerable as they did a few days ago, they were completely capable of holding their own.
The Black Trench City forum had completely evolved into Yi’s fan club.
Out of ten posts, eight were about Yi.
Some were curious about what exactly Yi was doing to trigger special events continuously, while others were extremely grateful, saying that without Yi, they would never have earned so many Points.
Black Trench City, a city known for its critics.
It is also the most active city on Blue Star, and it’s almost becoming a global forum. The number of users discussing online on this forum has been surging.
It’s truly a remarkable place.
“These people do have a sense of gratitude after all.”
Sword Without End looked at the posts in the forum one after another, and couldn’t help but smile wryly with a sense of emotion, “See, Black Trench City does have something, right? Not to mention anything else, but the vitality of this forum is unmatched elsewhere.”
The posts roughly summarized the global special events of these past few days.
In terms of Points alone, it was around 150k. 150k Points, geez, most players probably haven’t even seen that many Points in their lifetime. This time it was really an unexpected windfall.
But for them, it didn’t mean much in terms of increasing their power.
…
“It seems there are no events in January anymore.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sat on the rooftop, flipping through the calendar, trying to figure out which days might have global limited-time events.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - 668 408 Will there really be no monument in
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 668: Chapter 408: Will there really be no monument in Starfield? Chapter 668: Chapter 408: Will there really be no monument in Starfield? “There shouldn’t be any left.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had been flipping through the calendar for quite some time, nodded with great confidence and said, “There aren’t any holidays in January, the only event for New Year’s has already ended, and at that time, Yi, you were still battling it out with that Wen Ping.”
“Next up should be the Spring Festival.”
“That doesn’t roll around until February 10th.”
“But Spring Festival is a major holiday, there should be a big event.”
As the Tuberculosis Rabbit said this, he continued flipping through the calendar.
“It’s such a shame about the New Year’s event; that was quite interesting.”
…
Chen Yi didn’t respond but instead looked towards his ‘Wandering Bard’ professional panel. Today was January 20th, and in two more days, this class would be over, along with all the special events it had been triggering these past five days.
To some extent, it had boosted the strength of all Blue Star players.
It had raised the foundation of every player on Blue Star by a notch.
That’s not right.
It shouldn’t be to some extent, but rather, to a great extent.
Time passed gradually, bit by bit.
Finally—
The date reached January 31st.
As of today, Chen Yi had opened a total of 5 million Grade E Prop Chests. Over this past half-month, they practically hadn’t done anything else but open chests.
The first thing they did upon waking up each day was to open chests.
Even so, they had only managed to open 5 million Grade E Prop Chests, with a whopping…995 million chests still remaining. It was like they’d barely made a dent.
Absurd.
“I can’t do this anymore.”
Chen Yi sighed lightly, sat down wearily on the beach chair, and gazed distractedly at the sky above. In nearly a month, he had mentally repeated the term ‘open’ in his brain countless times.
As a result, he now felt like he didn’t even know how to read those two words anymore.
It caused a serious mix-up.
He decided not to keep opening them.
5 million Luck Points should be enough; at least he felt there wasn’t much of a difference between 5 million and 4 million Luck Points.
He’ll take care of the rest slowly, there’s no way to finish opening these 1 billion chests anytime soon.
Not that he planned to keep all these 1 billion Grade E Prop Chests to himself. When he bought the chests, they cost him 61 billion Points, with each chest at about 61 Points.
But on the ‘Star Map’ platform, after days of soaring prices, the price of a Grade E Prop Chest had skyrocketed to 451 Points.
Truly absurd.
One must know that a month ago, the price of a Grade E Prop Chest was around 10 Points, with some even lower, and they might not even sell.
Only after advancing to Twofold Planet can one access ‘Star Map,’ the large trading platform.
And for players above Twofold Planet, a Grade E Prop didn’t hold much allure, so they wouldn’t buy chests. If they really needed a certain Grade E Prop, they would not resort to opening chests but would directly buy the desired prop, like the Air Food Series Props.
But now—
The price outrageously soared to a minimum of 451 Points per chest!!
The logic behind the price hike is simple.
The main reason is due to Chen Yi’s bottom-fishing, which essentially raised the lowest selling price of Grade E Prop Chests and led some people to speculate that there might be some special use for the Prop Chests.
Some guessed that continuously opening 1,000 Grade E Prop Chests might yield a hidden quest.
Others speculated there might be an NPC that, if given a Grade E Prop Chest, would provide a special reward.
There were even guesses that collecting all the Grade E Props might yield a Monument for leveling up in the game.
Amidst various speculation, the price of the chests began to inflate.
This attracted some opportunists, looking to make a profit on Points by buying low and selling high.
Eventually, the prices climbed higher and higher.
But wouldn’t the daily output of Grade E Prop Chests across the level-up game present a shock to the market?
No!
The reason is quite straightforward; put yourself in their shoes, and it becomes clear. If you’re a player from Threefold Planet and you find a Grade E Prop Chest on a map by chance, you recall that its price has been rising sharply, now up to 451 Points.
Would you choose to sell it?
If you sell, you’d make 451 Points, but as a player from Threefold Planet, you wouldn’t be short of that amount, so there’s no need to hurry. Besides, the price is continuously climbing; who knows, it might sell for even more later. Even if it increased to 1,000 Points, the profit wouldn’t be significant, and it wouldn’t affect your decision to hold onto it.
You might even buy a few more, just as a conversation piece.
This matter had become a hot topic throughout the entire level-up game, as it was something everyone could take part in. Unlike the previous Zenith Radiance event, where, for the vast majority of players, owning a Zenith Radiance was an unachievable dream in their lifetimes, regardless of its price increase, it had nothing to do with them.
But Grade E Prop Chests were different. Discussing with friends how much the price of chests had risen that day was quite interesting.
It was like the pre-Blue Star level-up game arrival of the World Cup, where many people bought sports lottery tickets.
Did all these people watch football?
No, of all those who bought sports lottery tickets, perhaps only one percent followed sports events regularly. So why did the remaining ninety-nine percent buy sports lottery tickets? Was it with the intention of getting rich?

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - 669 408 Is it really possible that Starfield
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 669: Chapter 408: Is it really possible that Starfield has not even one Monument?_2 Chapter 669: Chapter 408: Is it really possible that Starfield has not even one Monument?_2 No, it’s not.
In fact, it’s all for bragging rights, spending a few dozen or hundred bucks for a sense of participation makes watching football all the more interesting and provides a talking point with friends, whether you win or lose.
Whether you make money or lose it doesn’t really matter, what you’re buying is fun.
Similarly—
The E-Rank Random Prop Chest has also become like this.
And all of this was completely within Chen Yi’s expectations. Even Chen Yi was a bit dumbfounded when he saw the price of the E-Rank Random Prop Chest. How did the price get so high?
Will people actually buy it at such a high price?
Why is this chest so expensive?
Up to this point, besides his initial purchase, Chen Yi had not interfered at all, but the situation had developed in this way.
…
“…”
Glancing at the Star Map Platform, the lengthy list of purchase requests below the E-Rank Random Prop Chest made Chen Yi’s expression increasingly strange.
“Player Zhang**, offering 449 Points to buy 100 E-Rank Random Prop Chests.”
“Player Sun**, offering 430 Points to buy 100,000 E-Rank Random Prop Chests.”
“Player…”
