Request to purchase is a feature on the Star Map Platform where players can propose to buy goods at a price lower than the market price listed under the product. When a player urgently needs to sell, they can choose to fulfill these purchase requests.
Although the price is definitely lower than the market price,
the advantage is the quick speed and short transaction time.
After a quick estimate, Chen Yi’s eyes gradually lit up and without any hesitation, he began to offload frantically, constantly clicking on the purchase requests.
…
Six hours quickly passed.
Chen Yi had sold 900 million E-Rank Random Prop Chests, making a profit of 167 billion Points, and the price of the E-Rank Random Prop Chests had hit an all-time low of 101 Points.
In less than half a day,
after dumping 900 million chests on the Star Map Platform, which lacked a circuit breaker mechanism, the E-Rank Random Prop Chests faced the largest crash in history. As Chen Yi, the cunning operator, began to frantically offload, the price of the chests began to uncontrollably plummet.
At the beginning, as Chen Yi started to offload like crazy, causing the price of the chests to drop uncontrollably,
some operators who had hoarded a decent amount of E-Rank Random Chests started to release purchase orders at higher prices, frantically.
For instance, if Chen Yi put out a purchase request at “429 Points,”
these guys would immediately issue a purchase request at “460 Points.”
Surely this means taking a loss.
But their thinking was simple; they figured someone in the same business couldn’t resist the urge to offload early for a quick profit and run, which could not be allowed. They expected the price could surge to 900 Points, so they started to shore up the market.
Shoring up the market means boosting the market price of the chests.
Even if releasing a premium purchase order means taking a loss right now, as long as they could stabilize the price, they’d make more money selling later!
But… the amount of stock they had could not possibly match what was in Chen Yi’s hands.
When Chen Yi, without even blinking, dumped hundreds of millions of chests and prepared to run, all the other operators began to turn pale. This market was definitely not going to hold; on the contrary, every piece of meat they spat out ended up in Chen Yi’s pocket.
After all, the high-price purchase orders they had released to prop up the market had been fully absorbed by Chen Yi.
If there was fatty meat, surely you’d eat that first, but lean meat would do in its absence.
When the price hit 281 Points,
basically most of the operators had collapsed. If this continued, they would be left with nothing, clearly unable to hold the market. It would be better to cut their losses and run with the rest, maybe lose a little less.
So…
As the operators who started to panic also began to offload and run, the market’s negative sentiment exploded in an instant. Almost all the players chose to sell off their holdings, fearing running slow would mean losing more.
In the end, just as Chen Yi finished offloading his 900 million Prop Chests, the lowest price had already hit 101 Points, with a continuing downward trend.
Meanwhile, Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting aside, was looking at the scene unfolding before him and murmuring in amazement.
“Yi, you bought a total of 1 billion Prop Chests, sold 900 million, opened 5 million, and now you have 95 million left,” he murmured.
“You spent 610 Points each buying them, and now you’ve sold them for 167 billion Points.”
“Does this mean, Yi, that you’ve made a profit of 106 billion Points before and after, and got 100 million Prop Chests for free?”
“Yi!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s voice rose in shock and disbelief, “You have a talent for business!!!”
“Is it really so easy to make 100 billion Points? We’ve collected protection fees for so long, blasted through so many clans with great fanfare, to finally save up a few hundred billion in assets, and now, Yi, you just casually buy some chests and make 100 billion Points?”
“If we knew making money was so simple, why bother with protection fees? We could have just stormed in and took over!”
“You can’t say that.”
Chen Yi said with a chuckle, “It’s mainly good luck. I never expected that buying just 1 billion Prop Chests would cause so much upheaval. This is purely good fortune; I definitely didn’t consider this at the time.”
“Also, if it weren’t for the few hundred billion in assets we’d saved earlier, we couldn’t have bought 1 billion E-Rank Random Prop Chests in one go. Without buying 1 billion E-Rank Random Prop Chests at once, we wouldn’t have seen this effect, right?”
“That’s true,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit agreed, nodding. Then he glanced at the time, “It’s 8 o’clock at night already, and February is almost here; there’s going to be another update to the version.”

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - 670 408 Will there really be no monument in
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 670: Chapter 408: Will there really be no monument in Starfield?_3 Chapter 670: Chapter 408: Will there really be no monument in Starfield?_3 “Yeah.”
Sword Without End spoke with a somewhat complex expression, “We’re going to leave the Novice Period in just a few months. To be honest, I feel a bit reluctant, and I don’t know why. Maybe I’m just being sentimental again.”
“Alright then.” Tuberculosis Rabbit stood up and rolled his eyes at Sword Without End, “Stop thinking about all this nonsense and get ready to eat. We’ve been busy all afternoon and haven’t had the chance to eat yet. I’m starving.”
…
Just like that.
In a time filled with laughter and joy, the early hours of the morning quickly arrived.
And the game update arrived on schedule, never late.
‘Ding…’
A system notification sound faintly rang in the ears of all players.
‘Game Update Announcement!’
‘The new Blue Star version 5.0 will start its non-stop update at 00:00 on February 1st. The main contents and adjustments of this update are as follows.’
‘1. In the “Don’t Bully the Poor Youth” map, players will immerse themselves in the map. The villain will throw 10 Points vouchers on the ground before the map starts, mocking the player that bowing their head will earn them 10 Points.
The intention was just a transition in the story, hoping players would feel more involved and slap the villain’s face in the subsequent plot.
However, some players chose to keep bowing their heads repeatedly to keep getting 10 Points, opting to fail the map rather than save face, completely ignoring the villain’s mockery. This bug has been fixed; now when players enter this map and choose to bow, the villain will say, “Ha, you weaklings! You didn’t think I was actually going to give it to you, did you?”‘
‘2. Addition of the “Pictionary” gameplay
All players can sign up in pairs. One player is responsible for drawing on the back of the other player based on provided keywords. If the other player guesses the word, they score +1 point; if not, they move on to the next keyword.
There are a total of 100 keywords, and players are ranked based on points. The top hundred will receive special rewards. For details of the event, please see the VCR.’
‘3. Addition of the February rule “Eating Dumplings”.
“Eating Dumplings”: This month, while eating dumplings, all players will have a certain chance of triggering special events. The probability of positive special events is 5%, negative events 6%, and neutral events 3%.
PS: For the definition of dumplings, please see the VCR.
Buns, siu mai, potstickers, and other such items do not qualify as dumplings.
Furthermore, in February, the Prop Market food list in the player’s personal panel will feature ‘dumplings’ for a limited time, also including various flavors such as ‘Vegetarian Trio,’ ‘Chive and Egg,’ ‘Celery Pork,’ and ‘Sauerkraut Pork’ for players to choose from’
…
Accompanied by the stroke of midnight.
The announcement for the update came as promised.
“There isn’t much in the February version update.”
After quickly scanning the update announcement, Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke thoughtfully, “February’s rules aren’t harmful, similar to January’s rules, they are of a milder nature and won’t cause too many player deaths.”
“This is much better than the rules for May and June. Those two months saw quite a few deaths.”
“The fixed map bug this time is quite intriguing though. Did the map designers not anticipate this? Players might not bow for 10 Points, but it’s hard to say ‘no’ to bowing 10,000 times for 100,000 Points.”
“That’s the effect of quantitative change causing a qualitative change.”
“But we can eat dumplings now.”
Chen Yi casually glanced over the update announcement, looked at the snow starting to fall again in the sky, and laid back indifferently on the beach chair. He kept opening Prop Chests without even glancing at the props before tossing them into Sword Without End’s arms. “When the time comes, we won’t buy dumplings from the store. We’ll make our own.”
“Homemade ones have a better feel to them and it’s more enjoyable for everyone to eat.”
“We can also set off some fireworks and bring out the festive atmosphere.”
“After all, meeting each other is also a kind of destiny. This is the first New Year’s we’ll be spending together.”
He still had more than 90 million chests to open. Although he hadn’t planned on opening them all in a short time, this task had become a subconscious action, opening a few whenever he had nothing else to do.
Giving all the props to Sword Without End was something he had agreed upon with him a long time ago.
Sword Without End had seen some speculation online and thought it made some sense. Maybe collecting all E-grade props could earn a Monument in the main game, that’s why he had asked for all the props that were opened to be given to him.
But now, it seems more like an unfounded rumor, or perhaps false positive news released by those doggy merchants looking for a quick buck.
After all, after opening five million chests, he should have almost all E-grade props, yet there had been no movement.
“Hey.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit grinned, “Who says otherwise. Before the Ascension game came, Blue Star had restrictions on setting off fireworks, which took away some of the festive spirit. Now at least we can set off fireworks without any concerns.”
“Before the Ascension game came, there was a saying among the people.”
“They said the government was banning fireworks and shortening holidays, perhaps in preparation for reviving the ‘Year Beast.'”
“Back then, it seemed like nonsense, but not long after the Ascension game arrived, it kind of started to make sense.”
“Damn!”
Just at that moment—
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly froze, then looking bewildered, he looked up at Chen Yi, “Yi, take a look at the current price of the E-grade random Prop Chests, see how much it’s fallen?”

chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 671 408 Will there really be no monument in
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 671: Chapter 408: Will there really be no monument in Starfield?_4 Chapter 671: Chapter 408: Will there really be no monument in Starfield?_4 “This is simply outrageous!!”
The “Star Map” is a feature that can only be opened by players who have two books, and the main reason Chen Yi was able to freely purchase on the Star Map was that he recently acquired a prop that could break through the novice restrictions. Normally, that prop was in the hands of Tuberculosis Rabbit, and Chen Yi would only take it when he needed to use it.
A trivial little thing.
But very useful.
However, when Chen Yi saw the price of the E-rank Random Prop Chest, he also paused, slightly startled: “Has it really fallen back to 10 points again?”
Yes.
After the festivity fades, all that’s left is a messy ground.
They just had a barbecue and waited for a version update, which together only took a little over 4 hours, and the price of the E-rank Random Prop Chest had already fallen back to 10 points.
Just this speed.
It’s practically a miracle.
The rate of increase was fast enough; in just a matter of days, it rose to a price of 400, but the speed of the fall was even more terrifying: in just a dozen hours, it had dropped back to the starting point.
“…”
After a moment of weird silence, Chen Yi more or less understood what was happening.
After all, the E-rank Random Prop Chest itself wasn’t worth much. The main reason for its baffling price hike was due to his initial massive buying spree causing the price to skyrocket, followed by all sorts of messy rumors spreading at the same time.
A whole bunch of people, fully aware but pretending they knew nothing, were carefully protecting this bubble, hoping that it would grow larger so they could make more money.
Frantically trumpeting false positives to the outside world.
Like being able to achieve milestone accomplishments, triggering hidden quests, and so on.
However…
Under Chen Yi’s ruthless dumping, the bubble was instantly pricked, resulting in a collapse. As soon as it was clear that the bubble couldn’t be maintained, the rest of the people stopped pretending to be oblivious and began to exit the scene one after the other.
Like an avalanche, the price began to collapse instantly.
In just a few hours, it went from 101 points down to 10 points.
And seeing this familiar price,
Chen Yi’s expression gradually turned weird. This thing was useless to others, but for him, it was useful. Each chest represented a Luck Point.
Although he still had over 90 million chests that he couldn’t possibly open all at once, that didn’t mean he couldn’t stock up on more.
After all, they’d eventually come in handy.
The upgrade of the game wasn’t going to end anytime soon, so he’d have plenty of time to slowly open the chests.
With this thought,
Chen Yi pondered briefly before he began to sweep up the purchases again, and in no time, he bought another billion E-rank Random Prop Chests, this time spending fewer points.
Just 310 billion points.
Last time it was 610 billion points.
This time, due to extremely low market sentiment and various other conducive conditions, even as Chen Yi brazenly swept through the market, there was no other excess movement. The price of the E-rank Random Prop Chest remained at—
48 points.
And the price was still continuously falling. Even Chen Yi’s brazen large-scale purchasing couldn’t act as a market stimulant, instead prompting some who were still hesitant to sell to offload their shares quickly at this still-decent price.
Everyone knew ‘the wolf was coming.’
The first time, everyone happily played along and feasted together.
The second time, did they think everyone was a fool?
Although it wasn’t clear if the player or force behind the massive buying and selling was the same, many players who lost money in this farce had already grown resentful towards this anonymous force.
Someone’s starting to manipulate the market on the Star Map?
Especially some forces that followed Chen Yi to play the banker lost miserably. Luckily, they didn’t lose much because they sold off quickly, but a moment’s hesitation would have cost them a lot.
“Heh.”
Seeing Yi buy back another billion Prop Chests, Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help laughing.
“What is this?”
“Not spending a penny and scoring 10 billion Prop Chests, and on top of that, picking up several tens of billions of Points for free?”
“Is this how you play the game?”
Chen Yi also sighed with a sense of irony, “I finally understand why people always say the rich get richer—it’s because they simply can’t spend all their money. Just like me, I didn’t do anything, and suddenly, I have so much more money.”
“Think about the past when we had to work our butts off just to earn a few dozen Points by collecting corpses for others.”
“And now.”
“I made tens of billions of Points without doing anything — who do I even talk to about this?”
“It’s infuriating.”
As Chen Yi spoke, he casually tossed an E-rank Prop from a chest into Sword Without End’s lap, just as he was about to say something else.
Suddenly, Sword Without End, sitting nearby, jumped up from his chair, face flushed with excitement, and exclaimed!
“It’s done, it’s really done—Yi, you’ve made it!!!”
“Hahahaha, I’ve made it, I really have!!!”
“I truly made it!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, a bit dumbfounded, looked up at Sword Without End and couldn’t help but blurt out angrily, “What the hell are you going on about? What’s done?”
However—
The next second, a notification sound rang in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s ears.
Hearing the notification, Tuberculosis Rabbit also froze in place, face filled with disbelief as he muttered, “Is that even allowed??”
–
“Ding, Annihilation Starfield Whole Starfield Announcement!”
“The current announcement involves the following planets: Turtle Star, Zhiwa Star, Egglet Star…etc., totaling 612 planets.”
“In Star System No. 3 of the Annihilation Starfield, player Sword Without End from Zerofold Planet Blue Star has successfully collected all E-rank Props within the Novice Period!”
“He is the first player in the history of the game to collect all E-rank Props during the Novice Period!”
“Unprecedented, no one before and no one to come!”
“This action has shocked countless players and has been selected for entry into the game’s chronicle of major events, permanently leaving his name and trace in the game, and will obtain a statue in the game’s Hall of Honor to represent this achievement.”
“And has obtained a game milestone!”
“Milestone name: Number One Hoarder Rat!”
“Conditions to Achieve: The first player to collect the entire E-rank Prop series during the Novice Period as a new player.”
“Let us congratulate Sword Without End on becoming the first player to achieve this milestone in the game’s history.”
“And he has been awarded the Stellar Rank title ‘God of Mice’!”
…
And above the Annihilation Starfield—
All players looked up expressionlessly at the sky above, where four massive Monuments already stood, and now another Monument was rising slowly.
“…”
When the first one appeared, they were shocked! Proud and honored!
By the time the second and third ones appeared, they were even more excited, more fervent!
With the fourth, it still felt pretty cool.
But now the fifth…
They were starting to run out of words; was this really something players from other Starfields would envy? It didn’t seem all that valuable, and the sky was starting to get crowded.
Could there really be a Starfield without a single Monument?
Is it that hard to achieve?
If it comes down to it, we might as well give you one; there are a few of these things cluttering up the sky, and frankly, they’re kind of blocking the view.

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 672 409 Chief Li
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 672: Chapter 409: “Chief Li. Chapter 672: Chapter 409: “Chief Li. …
The monument’s face was immense and pitch black, with letters in crimson.
The crimson letters seemed to flow like blood, capable of ensnaring one’s very soul.
And on the face of the monument was a line of text that was particularly eye-catching.
“Annihilation Starfield Continent Monument!”
“Monument Name”: Top Rat.
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first to collect all E-class props as a rookie player within the Novice Period.
“Owner”: Sword Without End.
“Runner-up Project Team”: Snow Sea Project Team.
“Affiliated Project Team”: Annihilation Starfield Project Team.
“Runner-up Project Team is awarded one S-class complimentary free authority, all members are awarded 100 points, and one punishment evasion authority.”
“The affiliated project team is awarded 100 Achievement Points, all members are awarded 50 points, and are granted promotion eligibility, with a validity period of ten years, and one punishment evasion authority.”
“…”
“…”
Countless players on the Annihilation Starfield gazed blankly and silently at the fifth monument rising slowly above their heads, momentarily at a loss for words.
There weren’t a few players on this Starfield who had been killed by Chen Yi at least once.
It wasn’t intentional.
That was a complete disaster; people vaguely remember that Yi wasn’t as famous as he is now, practically unknown, and nobody had heard of it. Back then, they were still mocking a few people from the Threefold Planet for joining forces to pick on a Novice Planet, shamelessly at that.
But they didn’t get to mock for long before they saw Chen Yi emerge from the 3rd Star System on behalf of the Novice Planet, wiping out several Threefold Planets in one fell swoop.
After that, his fame skyrocketed!
Thus began Chen Yi’s journey through the Starfield.
And it was then that the Annihilation Starfield was renamed; it was also when the Annihilation Starfield received its first monument. It hasn’t been long since then, and Chen Yi’s reputation had already spread across several starfields. Moreover, the number of monuments on the Annihilation Starfield had increased greatly.
At the time, many players were watching the live broadcast and enjoying how Chen Yi was wiping out the Threefold Planets, when suddenly they were engulfed by Chen Yi’s area attack, vaguely remembering that it seemed like a hundred billion players had died then.
Fortunately… at that time, the Annihilation Starfield Project Team intervened to correct this mistake, allowing everyone to return to their own planets without any loss; otherwise, if I remember correctly, the Alien Race killed by Chen Yi was Absolutely Irresurrectible, going straight to the depths of hell to become janitors.
There would have been no chance for them to speak here again.
As for holding a grudge… of course, there was none. They held no enmity against Chen Yi, and to call such a small friction a grudge, what a joke – this was an accident, okay?
And since Chen Yi himself didn’t care about it, how could they hold on to this and intentionally bear a grudge?
Bear a grudge against someone like Chen Yi?
Was it because there was someone within their own race that they truly detested, but couldn’t get rid of, so they took advantage of Chen Yi’s hand to exact revenge for themselves?
You should know that when Chen Yi took revenge, it often involved clearing out the entire race.
He’s known for his efficiency and for leaving no loose ends.
…
“Boss, boss!!!”
In the Blue Star sky, within the Snow Sea Project Team!
An employee rushed into the chief’s office excitedly, waving a red handkerchief in his hand: “Boss, we just got another monument, and now we have another S-class complimentary free authority!!”
“Boss…”
“Alright.”
Jin Buhuan, whose calm face barely hid a smile, was leaning back in his chair, feet propped up on the desk, eyes twinkling as he casually spoke with feigned indifference: “Calm down, calm down, what’s there to be shocked about?”
“It’s just another monument, isn’t it?”
“We’ve already got four, what’s so exciting about getting another one?”
“After all this time with me, why can’t you be more composed?”
“I know, boss, what I mean is, didn’t we use our last authority for Chen Yi and them? That made us temporarily unable to leave the project team to return to player status, but now that we have this authority, we can return to player status again!”
“Got it, got it.”
Jin Buhuan slowly stood up, his face beaming with a smile as he straightened his clothes: “Seeing as everyone’s so fired up, let’s begrudgingly have a celebration.”
“Even though we don’t really have any merits to speak of.”
“Sigh.”
“I’m beginning to understand more and more the saying that choice is more important than effort.”
“I wonder how many monuments those colleagues who were with us in nurturing the Novice Planet have now?”
“Oh, none at all.”
“That’s really pitiful.”
…
“What are you doing!!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked up at Sword Without End in horror.
“What do you mean what am I doing.”
“Just taking a monument, that’s all.”
Sword Without End was grinning ear to ear, unable to hide his delight as he kept glancing at the panel before him. His grin was practically bulletproof – he was turning into the grinning War God, and this was his first monument.
A monument is practically the highest honor in an advanced game.
With this thing, you’re basically a famous figure in the advanced game.
The kind whose very actions are the subject of countless players’ discussions behind the scenes.
Every move made could cause significant ripples, and not to mention, once out of the Novice Planet, just post a marriage ad haphazardly, and the contenders who show up could fill up Blue Star.
Generally speaking.
The players who obtained a monument are often representative figures of a Starfield, and such a player even has the right to name their own Starfield. Their every action represents their Starfield.

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - 673 409 Chief Li._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 673: Chapter 409: “Chief Li.”_2 Chapter 673: Chapter 409: “Chief Li.”_2 He was also the representative and soul of his own Starfield.
Although he might not be the strongest in his Starfield, this relationship meant he was definitely the most well-known and respected by players there.
Just like Li Yi.
The Awesome Starfield under his name was Li Yi’s signature masterpiece.
Of course, to him, it now served only as a symbol of renown; he had nothing else to do with it, since there were too many talented people emerging from the Annihilation Starfield, and the naming rights had long been snatched away by Chen Yi, leaving him without a share.
And the representative figure of the Annihilation Starfield ahead.
It’s definitely considered to be Chen Yi, not Sword Without End, even though Sword Without End had also achieved a Monument.
After all, Chen Yi’s achievements were just too terrifying.
But even so, his mood remained excited. To have obtained the game’s Monument meant he had passed one of the most important milestones in the game, and he couldn’t help but be happy.
“Damn it, damn you, you really should die!!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, in a fit of rage, kept beating his chest, “Just look at yourself, do you deserve a Monument, huh? Why should you get a Monument, you really should die. If I had known that collecting E-grade Props really led to a Monument, why would I have let Yi give you those E-grade Props?”
“You really should die!!!”
“Heh.”
Sword Without End chuckled coldly, completely ignoring the frantic Tuberculosis Rabbit, and continued to indulge in his own emotions, especially his own title—yup, the effects were pretty damn good.
…
“No way.”
Seeing that Sword Without End had no intention of engaging with him, Tuberculosis Rabbit leaned back in his chair, his face hollow and tired, as he gazed up at the sky overhead in a dazed manner, “I can’t accept it, why should Sword Without End get a Monument?”
“To get my Monument, I really spent a good amount of genuine cash to buy Zenith Radiance.”
“This guy did nothing, just followed Yi around picking up trash, and he actually got a Monument?”
“Is there anything more deserving of death than this?”
Is there anything harder to bear than watching your brother drive a Range Rover?
If there is, it must be watching your brother get behind the wheel of a Cullinan.
“…”
Seeing Tuberculosis Rabbit’s expression, Chen Yi couldn’t help but laugh out loud. Of course, he knew Tuberculosis Rabbit wasn’t really that jealous; it was just that he was very expressive, both in actions and words.
Without Tuberculosis Rabbit, Sword Without End might not have felt comfortable expressing his joy, and the atmosphere would have been more oppressive.
With Tuberculosis Rabbit’s outburst, Sword Without End could more comfortably display his happiness.
It had to be said.
In terms of atmosphere control, Tuberculosis Rabbit had his own expertise.
After all, for a talkative person, keeping the conversation going and the atmosphere lively was their fundamental skill.
But then again.
He also hadn’t expected that such a thing could really lead to a Monument. Are Monuments that easy to obtain?
Is collecting E-grade Props difficult?
As long as one buys enough Prop Chests, shouldn’t they be able to obtain even the rarest and most obscure E-grade Prop?
No, that’s not right.
The difficulty must lie in the Novice Period, and in the Novice Period, there simply isn’t a way or means to obtain all the E-grade Props. To collect a complete set of E-grade Props during the Novice Period.
That would truly be a pipe dream.
At least, he couldn’t imagine how, without the aid of the Star Map Platform, one would gather a complete set of E-grade Props in the Novice Period—an environment virtually cut off from the outside world. There are E-grade random Prop Chests during the Novice Period.
But…
Unless you get your hands on most of the E-grade random Prop Chests from other players, it’s simply not possible. Or you’d have to be so lucky that every E-grade Prop you get from an E-grade random Prop Chest is one you don’t already own.
“Yi!”
At this moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke up with a strange look on his face, “Why don’t you check out the price of the E-grade random Prop Chest on the Star Map Platform again?”
“Hmm?”
Chen Yi frowned at first, but quickly caught on and a hint of suspicion flashed in his eyes as he looked at the price of the E-grade random Prop Chest on the Star Map.
Just as expected!
The original price of the E-grade random Prop Chest was around 400 Points, which he had smashed down to 10 Points with his aggressive panicking. Seeing how low the price was, he felt it was a good deal to buy them then.
So, he spent another 310 billion Points to buy 10 billion chests.
Effectively purchasing this batch of chests at an average price of 31 Points per chest.
Thereafter, the price of the E-grade random Prop Chest slowly but surely climbed back up to 40 Points, and it continued to drop, clearly indicating that the number of people offloading them was still increasing. If nothing unexpected happened and no external interventions occurred, this price would probably slowly fall to the original market price.
That is, around 10 Points.
Even some eager sellers would let go for 5 Points.
But—
The moment Sword Without End completed the collection of all E-grade Props and won the chest!
The entire market boiled over!
Almost immediately after the announcement went off, the price trend of the E-grade random Prop Chest shot up like a bungee jump, springing straight up to form a large green spike, skyrocketing from the ground! The price also climbed to the top like a bungee jump.
In just a few minutes from the announcement, not even five minutes had passed, and the price of the E-grade random Prop Chest had reached an exaggerated 318 Points!
In just a few minutes.
It went from 40 Points to 318 Points.

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - 674 409 Chief Li._3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 674: Chapter 409: “Chief Li.”_3 Chapter 674: Chapter 409: “Chief Li.”_3 The price had nearly increased tenfold, and it hadn’t even taken 10 minutes.
Even now, the price continued to rise steadily.
“This…”
Chen Yi looked at the price of the E-rank random Prop Chest in front of him, completely bewildered, and only after a while did he look up at Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others, “Does that mean the chests I just bought for over 30 billion could now be sold for another profit?”
He had never thought making money could be this simple.
He felt like he hadn’t done anything.
And yet a large number of people were rushing to hand him their money.
He had originally thought that maxing out Luck Points would only affect the outcomes within the game, who could have guessed that it would work in real life too?
Wasn’t this a bit too lucky?
“That’s right.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a look of emotion, clicked his tongue, “Yi, if we didn’t know what was going on, we might have thought that there was a manipulator playing the market, harvesting retail investors.”
In fact, Yi had initially only planned to buy a batch of chests to hoard Luck Points.
But then, finding the price of the chests too high, he figured he might as well sell a batch to make a bit of profit.
After selling that batch and noticing the price had plummeted, he thought about buying another batch to keep for later.
No sooner had he bought the last batch, than Sword Without End made an announcement, and the price suddenly skyrocketed, making the goods in Yi’s hands immeasurably valuable.
Yi, not a market manipulator.
But better than a market manipulator, more manipulative than a market manipulator.
Even for a market manipulator, it would be hard to engineer such a perfect situation.
“That doesn’t seem right.”
Sword Without End, still basking in the joy, didn’t forget to think and said with some confusion, “I remember my announcement very clearly stated that I got this Monument during the Novice Period after collecting all the E-rank Props.”
“The main difficulty lies in the Novice Period. They aren’t in the Novice Period, even if they do collect them all, they won’t get any rewards, so why the excitement?”
“Even if someone does manage to collect a full set of E-rank Props within the Novice Period again, the in-game Monument is unique—I’ve already gotten it, they definitely can’t get it, so why would the price rise so outrageously?”
“Well, about that…”
Chen Yi suddenly started laughing and said, “Actually, this question is easy to answer. The E-rank random Prop Chests have gone through several rounds of dramatic rises and falls, with many players making money because of it, and also losing money because of it.”
“In the hearts of many players, this item is no longer simply a Prop; it is a financial product.”
“Once you expect an item to skyrocket and make money for you, you start to subconsciously ignore its actual value and focus entirely on how much other people think it’s worth.”
“This is what’s called market sentiment.”
“Market sentiment is about consensus. Once the majority agrees on the value of something, even if it’s worthless, it will soar in price because of that consensus. And when you start thinking of the E-rank random Prop Chests as financial chests, you subconsciously start to think about the price others attribute to it.”
“So—”
“As soon as the announcement went out, these people rushed in, interpreting the announcement as good news, fully aware that it specifically mentioned within the Novice Period and that it’s a non-replicable event.”
“But when the announcement became a piece of good news, that’s different. These people didn’t charge in with a bunch of Points because they were certain that the price of E-rank Prop Chests would go up; they did so because they thought others would certainly think the price would go up, and so they took the lead.”
“These are the sentiment-driven investors.”
“At the first hint of good news, they rush in without a second thought, fearing they might be too late.”
“Interestingly, the price does often rise due to good news, but not because of the news itself, but because there are so many of these stubborn people that they push up the price temporarily.”
“Just like what’s happening now.”
Chen Yi looked at the soaring price of the E-rank random Prop Chest and sighed helplessly, “Right now, there are many types of people buying in. There are those who are too impatient to wait and rush in because of the perceived good news.”
“There are those who have witnessed the peak prices of E-rank random Prop Chests and also want to rush in for another profit. Once an item has reached a very high price, even if that price drops later, people will believe it can return to its peak value, regardless of whether the item is really worth that much. This is human nature.”
“There are those who buy in for the excitement and the talking points.”
“And then there are the gamblers, who think since collecting all E-rank Props during the Novice Period earns a Monument, perhaps collecting them outside of the Novice Period has some other reward too. Not all E-rank Props are sold on the Star Map; there are indeed some rare E-rank Props that can’t be found there, but as you can see, the price of other E-rank Props hasn’t really risen, it’s just the E-rank random Prop Chests that has a more exaggerated rate of increase.”
“This indicates that only a minority of people are thinking this way. The majority are still riding on the good news to cash in, hoping to make a buck.”
“Just watch.”
Chen Yi glanced at the price trend and casually said, “When the price hits around 450 Points, the rate of increase will significantly slow down, and there may even be a downward trend in prices. But once this trend stabilizes and the price bounces back to around 500 Points or so, it will face another explosive rise, and this increase will be extremely exaggerated.”

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - 675 409 Chief Li._4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 675: Chapter 409: “Chief Li.”_4 Chapter 675: Chapter 409: “Chief Li.”_4 “Really?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked pensively at the price trend, which had now reached 430 Points. Indeed, just as Yi had said, the increase in price had slowed down considerably.
It had been over ten minutes, and it had only risen by 3 Points.
This was nothing like the nearly tenfold surge in the first few minutes after the announcement.
Then, the price gradually climbed to 447 Points.
It stopped there, and the curve flattened into a straight line, with occasional minor fluctuations. After stagnating for over ten minutes, the price even started to slip.
445 Points.
440 Points.
When it fell below 440 Points, the upward trend suddenly accelerated downward—425, 420, 415, quickly dropping to 410 Points.
“What’s going on?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was confused; he couldn’t understand why the price was falling. The mood had been so optimistic; why was there suddenly a trend toward collapse?
“Because the last crash happened around 450 Points.”
Chen Yi, lying on a beach chair, lit a cigarette before speaking, “This means that market expectations are still cautious. Many players, after calculating their profits, sold their shares before they reached 450 Points.”
“To avoid getting trapped in a crash.”
“450 is a hurdle.”
“With these players selling, the price started to fall, and those who were already worrying and barely holding on panicked, selling off in haste. Hence, the downtrend accelerated.”
“But as soon as the price breaks through the 450-Point barrier, market expectations will soar, and that means the price will start rising quickly.”
“Is that so?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit pondered, “On Blue Star, indeed, some things of little value can be hyped to high prices with consensus, but at least those things are limited editions with controlled output. However, isn’t this E-class Prop Chest not that rare, with a large quantity produced every day? With such high output, can the price really be driven up?”
“Yes.”
Chen Yi nodded, “Even now, isn’t the price quite high? But it won’t last long. Everyone’s just testing the waters now, probing the emotions of those around them. As soon as there’s even a slight drop in price, they’ll all rush to sell.”
“It’s only good for a short-term play.”
“Now the price is already at 412. It all depends on whether ‘Prop’ dealers will enter the market and drive the price above 450. If they do, the price can continue to rise. If not, it might crash again.”
Upon hearing this, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes suddenly lit up, “Shall we enter the market then?”
“Don’t.”
Chen Yi firmly shook his head, “After all, we’re not professionals. We only have some theoretical knowledge. Although we have more Points than before, protecting the market requires substantial funds. If we get trapped, it’d be quite the spectacle.”
Actually, defending the market is quite simple.
All it takes is a large amount of capital to start buying up from the lowest price bracket.
As long as the selling is timely and the selling price is higher than the buying price, it’s profitable.
But…
The market sentiment is too fragile.
This market is clearly the kind that could crash at any moment. Everyone is extremely sensitive, ready to flee at the slightest disturbance, and I don’t want to commit funds only to fail to defend the market and end up catching the falling knife.
Although if successful, I could earn even more, the loss could be total if it went wrong.
Right now, I have over a hundred billion Points. If those Points double, it wouldn’t mean much to me. There’s little difference between having a hundred billion or two hundred billion Points on hand.
But if I lose all these Points in a market crash, the impact on me would be significant.
I would be left unable to do anything in an instant.
To earn another hundred billion Points—it’s not a simple task.
Just then—
“Hmm…”
Chen Yi’s eyelids twitched as he noticed the price suddenly and strangely rising against the market trend. The lowest price bracket was swept clean in an instant, and continuous large transactions kept appearing in the trading records.
“Hey.”
Seeing this, Chen Yi grinned, “Look, the ‘Prop’ dealers couldn’t help themselves and intervened again, obviously hoping to make a bit more.”
Obviously.
The ‘Prop’ dealer had also realized that as long as the price was pushed above 450 Points, the price could surge again.
…
“Chief Li.”
Inside Awesome Starfield.
Li Yi stood in his study with an ashen face, while the latest trend chart of the E-class Prop Chest price was projected on the wall. A man beside him was reporting in a low voice.
“As per your instructions, our funds have entered the market and started buying up. The downtrend has been halted.”
“But so far, only our funds are sweeping the market. We have not detected any other funds doing so. 400 billion of our funds have already gone in. Shall we continue to push?”

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - 676 410 Happy New Year to Everyone
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 676: Chapter 410: Happy New Year to Everyone!!! Chapter 676: Chapter 410: Happy New Year to Everyone!!! “Sell now?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was stunned for a moment, then responded in slight confusion, “Yi, didn’t you say that as long as the price breaks through 450 Points, the market’s determination would soar, and then prices would keep rising, even breaking through the major thresholds of 700, 1000 Points, before they start to decline slowly?”
“Isn’t it too early to sell now?”
“After all, selling Points now isn’t too high, wouldn’t it be better to sell around 1000 Points?”
Chen Yi shook his head and said casually, “Like you said, that’s in theory. My theoretical knowledge is shaky at best, I’m no professional. How could I predict exactly?”
“It’s just some rough guesses.”
“Who knows the specifics with how unpredictable the market is, money in hand is what counts.”
“Let’s see… hmm, it’s 489 Points now, let’s sell at 600 Points.”
…
“Alright, alright!!!”
Within Awesome Starfield, Li Yi looked at the price trend of the E-grade Random Prop Chest with a somewhat frenzied expression. Seeing the price reach 489 Points, he couldn’t help but smile contentedly.
“In this market, sometimes what’s lacking is determination.”
“As long as we show others our determination, the determination for the price to rise, everyone will join in with more determination, and the market will gain even more determination. Once this snowball gets rolling, we are almost in an unbeatable position.”
“What’s the situation now?”
The subordinate standing beside him spoke with a touch of respect on his face, “Former Leader, everything is as you expected. Other manipulators have re-entered the game, all supporting the price and jacking it up. The price has stopped falling and is climbing rapidly.”
“Especially after breaking through the threshold of 450 Points, the rate of increase suddenly spiked. It’s now at 501 Points, and many posts started appearing online about a ‘rebound,’ which seem to be orchestrated, likely by other manipulators preparing to further lure in retail investors.”
“Very good.”
Li Yi nodded in satisfaction, “With this trend, the price reaching at least 800 Points is no problem—it’s practically a sure win.”
“But…”
The subordinate hesitated for a moment before continuing, “Former Leader, do you remember the unknown trader who dumped shares before the announcement? It’s predicted they have at least a hundred billion Points in hand. If that unknown trader suddenly decides to dump, don’t you think it could crash again?”
“No!”
Li Yi spoke with full confidence, “This person hiding in the shadows, holding so many Points, obviously has a high understanding of the market. It’s clear to anyone with eyes that this price can rise to at least 700 Points.”
“Why would they dump now?”
“Wouldn’t they be making a lot less money for themselves?”
“Merchants are all greedy.”
“I understand them like I understand myself—no merchant is without greed. Those who aren’t greedy can’t do business.”
“Right.”
He suddenly thought of something and started muttering in his chat channel, “How could I not involve Yi in such a good deal?”
This is definitely going to be profitable.
Befriending Yi with this moneymaker, that favor would be worth a fortune.
…
“What’s up?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who was huddled up with Sword Without End analyzing the new title effects of Sword Without End, asked in curiosity after seeing Yi’s suddenly odd expression, “What’s the matter, Yi? Why that look?”
“Did something happen?”
“…”
Chen Yi, with a complex expression, remained silent for a long while before speaking softly, “Li Yi messaged me saying he is driving up the price of the E-grade Random Prop Chest, and it’s rising now. He predicts it can at least reach 700 Points.”
“He wants me to buy in now to make some money together.”
“The current price is 526 Points, and we’ll sell at the 700 Points price level.”
“And he guarantees, it’s almost certain there will be no loss.”
“What?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was taken aback for a moment, then after digesting the information, he spoke in disbelief, “An E-grade Random Prop Chest for 500 Points, and one that could crash anytime, he wants Yi to buy in big now?”
“Yi, isn’t he trying to trick you?”
“I don’t think so.”
Chen Yi silently shared Li Yi’s transaction record, and even Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End fell silent upon seeing it. It was apparent that Li Yi wasn’t trying to dupe Yi but truly believed that the item could go up to at least 700 Points.
The manipulator defending the price just now was none other than Li Yi and his associates.
Moreover, Li Yi was the one selling the fastest and with the most confidence.
Looking at that transaction record, it was clear that Li Yi had put nearly all his fortune into the game—not to trick Yi. After all, if things went south, inviting revenge supposedly from Yi, Li Yi himself would have wiped out his own fortune.
He’d be declaring GG.
“Alright.”
Chen Yi let out a resigned sigh, “What can I say, I’m just too kind-hearted. Tell him to run with me at 600 Points.”
“This kid has a really big heart.”
“How can he be so sure that the mysterious trader won’t run before 700 Points, why is he so convinced that the mysterious trader definitely wants to earn a bit more?”

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - 677 410 Happy New Year to Everyone_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 677: Chapter 410: Happy New Year to Everyone!!!_2 Chapter 677: Chapter 410: Happy New Year to Everyone!!!_2 “Can’t we let this mysterious tycoon who knows no more than some skin-deep theories panic sell to find safety on the ground?”
…
“…”
“…”
After staring blankly at the message from Yi on his panel for quite some time, Li Yi looked up expressionlessly at the rising trend of the price of an E-level Random Prop Chest displayed before him.
He should have thought of it earlier.
After all, it was Sword Without End who activated the announcement, and Sword Without End was one of Chen Yi’s people. Plus, with the massive cash flow of Points in Chen Yi’s hands, guessing that the mysterious tycoon was Yi wasn’t that difficult.
But maybe it was because Yi was, after all, a Novice player.
He always chose to ignore Yi’s existence in this regard, or more precisely, he couldn’t imagine that Yi would be willing to place such a large number of Points in the game.
After sitting still for a long time.
Li Yi suddenly bowed his head, chuckled, and murmured, “What a brilliant setup, excellent indeed!”
Now that he thought about it, everything suddenly made sense.
He finally understood Yi’s operation.
It started with buying a large amount of E-level Random Prop Chests, raising the price and the topic’s popularity. And the choice of the E-level Random Prop Chest was also very astute—even though the price of this Prop had risen several dozen times.
It sounded exaggerated.
But in reality, it was only about a hundred Points increase.
Everyone could afford these 100 Points. They wouldn’t sell off just because of the price hike but would rather hold or continue buying to see what was happening. Compared to a profit of a little over 100 Points, they were more interested in watching this spectacle unfold.
And Yi firmly grasped this aspect of human nature. When the price reached a satisfying peak, he resolutely resorted to aggressive dumping.
Yes, aggressive dumping.
Not by choosing a more stable staged withdrawal, which could potentially result in greater profits, but Yi, with deep foresight, opted for aggressive dumping. Although he made less profit, the price was crushed down with an exaggerated force.
It even crashed back to the original point.
Not only did it provoke intense market discussion, but it also prepared a very low market entry price for Yi’s second large-quantity purchase.
This time, Yi’s second big move into accumulating stock didn’t cause much of a price increase. Everyone was scared off, merely watching from the sidelines, and after Yi secured a large position at an extremely low price.
He unleashed his Finishing Move.
Sword Without End, during the Novice Period, collected all E-level Props and obtained the Monument of the game upgrade.
An outright checkmate.
This piece of positive news, with the hype from countless speculative players, pushed the price of the E-level Random Prop Chest again to around 450 Points–a horrific level. And the last crash happened at this price level. Many players started to sell as the price was about to reach this level.
But Yi clearly knew that if the price broke through 450 Points, market sentiment would surge, leading to a new round of price increase.
Yet Yi didn’t protect the market.
Because Yi knew that these tycoons would step in to defend the price. In doing so, he could maximize his profit, avoiding the losses of a market defense, and even take the tycoons’ money.
While these tycoons were single-mindedly trying to drive the price above 700 Points and flee the market, Yi withdrew at the 600 Points level.
“Phew!”
Li Yi suddenly took a sharp breath, feeling more and more frightened as he thought. Had he not sent that message to Yi, he might have been completely trapped now, clueless about how Yi would have taken him down.
Yi’s grasp of market sentiment and human nature was simply terrifying.
A person’s formidable individual strength is not scary.
What’s frightening is someone who is not only shrewd but also scheming.
Such a person must not be invincible!
Absolutely must not be an enemy!
He repeated this to himself again and again in his heart, his eyes full of the relief and gratitude of one who’s survived a great disaster.
And at that moment—
One of his subordinates suddenly spoke up, “Former Leader, the price has reached 598 Points, just as you anticipated. The market shows no signs of weakness, with buy orders far outnumbering sell orders.”
“Many people are buying.”
“SELL!!!”
Li Yi commanded loudly without the slightest hesitation, but then quickly spoke up again, “Wait, come back, not sell, I mean rapidly clear the inventory, got it?”
“Get rid of all our stock as fast as possible, supply anyone who’s buying, and hang all sell orders at the 590 Points level.”
“Ah?”
The subordinate was slightly stunned and somewhat confused. “Former Leader, this might cause the price to drop. The price is still holding strong, showing no signs of a downtrend.”
“Are you sure you want to dump and clear out now, Former Leader?”
“I’m sure. What are you waiting for, can’t you understand plain language?”
“Oh, okay, Former Leader, I’ll handle it right away.”
…
Three minutes later.
This subordinate returned with a somewhat troubled look, “Former Leader, all the goods are sold, the average selling price was 584 Points, but… the price keeps falling uncontrollably. The other tycoons are frantically defending the price and trying to push it up, but for some reason, it seems they can’t hold it.”
“Heh heh.”
Li Yi gave a cold laugh without saying a word. If they could defend it, that’d be a miracle. With Yi’s kind of heavy-handed dumping, what caliber of tycoons would be needed to defend the price? Even if they did manage to defend it, how much money would they have to splash out to do so?
Following that.
The price of the E-level Random Prop Chest plummeted like a roller coaster ride.

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - 678 410 Happy New Year to Everyone_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 678: Chapter 410: Happy New Year to Everyone!!!_3 Chapter 678: Chapter 410: Happy New Year to Everyone!!!_3 560.
540.
520.
The uncontrollable and frantic drop in value didn’t take many minutes to crash below 500, and it was still plummeting, looking as if you bought a Bitcoin for $170,000, went to take a dump, and came back to see it had turned into $17.
That was the speed of it.
No one could withstand this.
Not even an elevator plunges as fast.
Li Yi’s smile reappeared on his face. Thankfully he had Yi’s insider information. Though he didn’t earn much, not as much as he had anticipated, he still made a profit, without any loss.
As for the other big players, that was another story.
They had defended the price for over ten minutes, throwing in massive amounts of capital. By the time they realized the trend was too fierce, and large players were aggressively selling, it was too late to escape.
Apart from waiting for the inevitable, there was nothing they could do.
Li Yi’s subordinates standing beside him didn’t look too good either.
Damn it… the Former Leader might have fled, but he got deeply trapped since he also followed the Former Leader’s purchase. He believed the price would still rise when the Former Leader sold his stocks, but given the current rate of the fall—
It was impossible to sell now.
More accurately, it wasn’t just him who couldn’t sell; no player could.
In financial markets, this situation is known as an avalanche, and such a day is often named after “Black” followed by a day of the week.
To put it precisely, the collapse was too swift.
For instance, if he wanted to cut his losses and leave, he’d list the price at 460 Points, but… there were no takers. The price he listed at the lowest a second ago would become 440 the moment he tried to sell.
The speed of the drop was so rapid that not even cutting losses were possible.
Unless you drop several tiers at once, straight down to 350 Points.
In this way, you might sell quickly, though at a loss, certainly better than losing everything. However, if every player did this, it would only accelerate the uncontrollable speed of the price drop.
In such scenarios, the number of sellers vastly outweighs the buyers, panic takes over the market, and aside from the few diehards, who would buy at a time like this?
Then the avalanche occurs.
And that is the cost of aggressive selling.
But… clearly, Chen Yi didn’t care about that.
He was all about forceful selling.
That’s the vibe he played for.
…
“Sold out again.”
Chen Yi looked at his account contently, now between 300 and 400 billion Points. He finally sold the last E-grade random Prop Chest he’d bought for 310 Points for a total of 2.4 trillion Points.
It was much more than the last time.
After all, having gone through the last experience, there were quite a few stubborn ones who thought this was just a rebound, a chance to buy low and score big. The steeper the crash, the more fiercely they bought, mumbling phrases like—
“Buy on the dip, the more you buy, the more you earn.”
“Opportunity belongs to those who double down!”
“When others are greedy, we must be fearful; when others are fearful, we must be greedier!”
“If you don’t sell, it’s only a loss on paper!”
And so on and so forth.
This allowed him to sell at an average price much higher than the first time.
After this happened twice, his assets had more than quadrupled in value. This was way faster than collecting protection money.
“Not bad.”
Chen Yi couldn’t help but reveal a hint of a smile, turning his head to Tuberculosis Rabbit and said, “I’m going to take a rest. When the price drops to 10 Points, buy another billion as a backup.”
Perhaps due to the many who doubled down,
even after he had sold off everything, the price hadn’t fallen to 10 Points but was rather fluctuating around 70 Points, which seemed incredibly resilient.
“You’re buying more?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit’s pupils flashed with a tinge of pity, licking his lips for the first time, feeling sorry for those players who invested their lives into buying the dip, “Isn’t this too harsh? If we keep playing this way, I guess the number of people jumping off buildings would have to be counted in the hundreds of thousands.”
“Could this break them?”
“There are already many forum posts cursing the manipulative scumbag behind this.”
“Big player?”
Chen Yi shook his head seriously: “I’ve never thought about controlling the price of the E-grade random Prop Chests from the very beginning. The Star Map platform is accessible to the Whole Starfield, do you know how vast that is?”
“I only have a billion in stocks, how could I possibly control everything?”
“I just buy a bunch when the price is low to use later, sell them for Points when the price is high, and continue to buy when the price is low. As for market manipulation, that’s entirely because of people’s greed.
“Does the leveling-up game not have 10 billion E-grade random Prop Chests?”
“Come on, there are easily 100 billion available on the Star Map; these are worth almost nothing to begin with. If each of my chests were priced at 10 Points, would this happen?”
“No, it’s their greed to sell at high prices that caused the price hike, understand? The real cause of the price increase is not me, the so-called big player, but their own greed.”
“If everyone realized that the E-grade random Prop Chests are worthless, how could anyone end up bankrupt?”
“They’re not ruined by me.”
“It’s their greed.”
“You got that? If you understand, I’m off to sleep.”
Chen Yi yawned as he headed to his bedroom on the rooftop, muttering, “So sleepy, ever since that time I went days without sleep, I can’t stop wanting to sleep; it’s like I’m making up for it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - 679 410 Happy New Year to Everyone_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 679: Chapter 410: Happy New Year to Everyone!!!_4 Chapter 679: Chapter 410: Happy New Year to Everyone!!!_4 “….”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit stared blankly at the panel that Chen Yi had left through, not reacting for a long time.
Only after a while did he tilt his head towards Sword Without End and murmur, “Did you understand that?”
“No.”
Sword Without End shook his head seriously then spoke up, “But is that important? It’s not important, hey, tell me, after the Novice Period is over, how can I let others know that I am a Seed Player with a Monument? It’s not like I can write it on my face, can I?”
“…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced speechlessly at Sword Without End and didn’t speak further, striding towards the barbecue grill on the rooftop.
Getting ready to start the fire and grill meat.
What’s the cure for worries? Only grilling meat.
If you have to draw a hard line for grilling meat, it would be the grill lines on the meat.
…
Time quickly ticked away, and in the blink of an eye, it was February 9th.
Early in the morning.
Chen Yi and his companions had already gathered on the rooftop early on.
“How does it look?”
Jiaye, having changed into a new red outfit from the shop, twirled in front of Chen Yi with laughter in her crescent-moon eyes and a face full of anticipation, “Does it look good? They say you should wear new clothes for the New Year, right?”
“How do I look?”
“Is it festive enough?”
This was her first New Year wearing new clothes; in the past, when she was with her brother, the two of them depended on each other for survival, with no talk of new clothes—having something to cover their bodies was already good enough.
And today, February 9th, was already New Year’s Eve.
Tonight would be the last day of the lunar year.
Tomorrow is the Spring Festival, also known as the first day of the new lunar year, but people prefer to call it New Year’s, as if that brings a bit more festive atmosphere.
“Not bad at all.”
Chen Yi’s face also wore a smile, and just as he was about to say something, the time had come to 08:00 in the morning. At the same time, a prompt also rang in the ears of all Blue Star players.
「Ding, global announcement.」
「The special limited-time event ‘Spring Festival’ will begin from February 9th-February 11th. Let us congratulate all players for successfully getting through the Novice Period, and welcome the more serious challenges ahead. No matter what you encounter in the future, we hope that all players will join hands and together write the legends of Blue Star!」
「Event content one」: Fireworks.
During the event, all players will receive 3 bundles of free fireworks in their inventory. Lighting fireworks has a small chance to grant rewards, and identical fireworks will be on sale in the shop, priced at 10 Points per bundle.
For those players who can’t get enough, to play multiple times.
PS: The chance of getting a reward is really small.
「Event content two」: Defeat the Year Beast.
“Awoo, Awoo, Awoo!!” — from the fierce and grim Year Beast’s pre-battle declaration.
During the event, a certain number of Year Beasts will randomly descend upon various places on Blue Star, and players will need to defeat these Year Beasts to defend our homeland.
It’s worth noting that.
The Year Beast’s body defense is invincible, and only fireworks can damage it.
Let’s pick up our weapons and drive the Year Beast away to protect our homes.
「Event content three」: Spring Festival Gala.
During the event, every player can sign up to perform a show for all players. It could be a group sketch, a duo comedy act, a solo song, or even a dance, etc.
As long as you think it can be liked by other players, any form of artistic performance is welcome.
The Snow Sea Project Team will first assess the programs prepared by the players, and if deemed of high quality to showcase to all players, then at 23:59 on February 9th, the show will be presented to all players.
Let us celebrate New Year’s Eve together.
And a generous reward will be given to players who successfully participate in the show.
PS: For those who want Yi to prepare a program for everyone, please vote here “Voting Button”.
「Event content four」: Collecting Fortune Cards.
During the event, every time a player lights fireworks, attacks the Year Beast, or directly wishes another player ‘Happy New Year’, there is a chance to obtain one of the five cards ‘Happy’, ‘Family’, ‘New’, ‘Year’, ‘Good’.
Collecting all five cards will grant a hefty reward.
And the first 1,000 players to collect all five cards will receive additional rewards.
PS: The ‘New’ card will only drop starting at the Spring Festival Gala on February 9th at 23:59, by watching the programs and engaging in positive feedback actions like commenting and liking. Let’s give a little encouragement to those who are willing to prepare a show for everyone.
「Event content five」: Red Envelopes.
All players can give red envelopes to players younger than themselves.
The amount in the red envelopes can range from 1 to 1000 Points, at the sender’s discretion.
Players who send red envelopes will receive… gratitude.
PS: Lastly, we wish everyone a happy New Year! Happy New Year to all!!!
Happy New Year’s Eve!!
…
The event announcement’s voice slowly faded away.
All players heard this prompt. In fact, starting from a few days ago, looking down at Blue Star from high above, there were already countless red hues. It’s undeniable that there is a romantic streak in the bones of Blue Star’s players.
Even in a game like this.
They were still willing to take the time to tidy up their mood, to add a little festive flair to their cities and surroundings, and to celebrate the New Year with family and friends.

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - 680 411 Did Chen Yi just kill a deity
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 680: Chapter 411: Did Chen Yi just kill a deity? Chapter 680: Chapter 411: Did Chen Yi just kill a deity? After pondering for a while,
Chen Yi decided to do an experiment. After all, he had just got an answer from the system panel, and it might be a bug. Plus, if he really could send red envelopes to every player around the globe, it wouldn’t hurt to send everyone a red envelope and share some joy together.
The next second—
All players around the world, except for Chen Yi, received a system announcement.
“Ding, you’ve received a New Year red envelope from player Chen Yi, containing 88 Points.”
Almost instantaneously, players all over the world were in an uproar.
And on the forums, countless threads had already started flooding the screens.
“Holy shit, I got a New Year red envelope from Yi. I’ve never even met him, how did he suddenly send me one? How does he know my name?”
“I got one too, damn, does this mean it’s a hit order? That everyone who received a red envelope is going to be hunted down by Yi?”
“Shouldn’t be, I got it too, and everyone around me, friends and family, got it too. Do you guys think it’s possible that Yi sent a New Year red envelope to every player?”
“Confirmed, even my grandpa got a New Year red envelope, but aren’t these red envelopes supposed to be sent only to younger players? Why did my grandpa also get one? Could it be that Yi is older than my grandfather? Impossible, my grandpa is already 69 this year.”
“Wait a second!!! Could Yi be an Immortal?”
“It seems like you’ve uncovered some kind of divine secret. So the reason for Yi’s rapid rise is because he’s an Immortal who doesn’t die?”
For a moment!
Countless discussions around the globe, numerous players were talking about this phenomenal event.
Sending 88 Points to everyone amounted to at least tens of billions of Points being splurged. With Points being tossed around so casually, one could imagine how many Points Yi must have in his account, probably several tens of billions, right?
Otherwise, who would casually give away tens of billions of Points in red envelopes?
But that wasn’t the most important issue. The key question was why Yi could send red envelopes to every player around the world?
Soon.
The players reached a consensus.
Rather than the far-fetched idea of Yi being an Immortal, they believed that Yi must have applied for some kind of permission. They didn’t have the privilege to communicate directly with the Snow Sea Project Team, but Yi was different.
Applying for such a permission would have been easy, a simple matter.
Having reached this consensus, the discussions about the issue began to fade, and the forums were filled with threads thanking Yi.
88 Points wasn’t a huge amount.
In fact, most players didn’t care about the 88 Points, but it was a gesture of good wishes, a New Year blessing.
It also showed that Yi cared about Blue Star and was willing to share billions of Points to celebrate the Spring Festival with everyone.
This also represented strength, and eased the players’ anxiety about the upcoming end of the Novice Period just a bit.
…
Meanwhile, Chen Yi frowned as he looked at his panel; it had deducted over 120 billion Points, which wasn’t a lot to him. What concerned him was… was he really older than every player on Blue Star?
If that was the case…
He looked at the set effects of the “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” and “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” props.
“Set Effects”: Ascend to the Heavens in One Step.
When a player owns both “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” and “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” props, they can activate the set effects to obtain a blade light capable of slaying anything, any being,
This blade light, disregards distance, strikes with homing precision, and doesn’t dissipate until it hits its target.
It’s a mandatory slaying attack.
Once the set effect is activated, the selected player will definitely die, ignoring all methods of revival such as those available to Seed Players, delivering an eternal slay, without any chance of resurrection.
This attack has the ‘Absolute Slay,’ ‘Absolute Hit,’ ‘Absolutely Irresurrectible’ three Absolute Attributes.
But the prerequisite is that the target player’s actual age must be younger than the user’s.
This is a show of care for the elderly, as well as a privilege for them.
Every time the set effect is used, the stack count of “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” and “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” will decrease by 10%.
–
When he first saw these set effects, he was somewhat disappointed because, on the surface, they seemed powerful, capable of slaying anything and any being—theoretically, even deities.
But the cost was too great.
Activating such a blade light would decrease the stack count of “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” and “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” by 10%.
That wasn’t a decrease by a few hundred or a few thousand but a percentage-based drop, which made the cost of using it higher the more layers he stacked. He didn’t feel that there was any being worth such a sacrifice.
If it were a deity, perhaps the cost would be justified.
But here’s the catch—
The restriction that the target must be younger than the user himself pretty much rendered it useless—the younger ones couldn’t possibly pose any threat to him.
He thought it was a useless set effect.
But looking at it now, it might not be the case.
“Um…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit was hesitating, mouth opening and closing as if about to say something, only to see Chen Yi immediately stand up with a serious expression, “Contact the queen of the White Phoenix Clan, we’re going to the White Phoenix Clan.”
The White Phoenix Clan was imprisoning two deities.
He didn’t know how long his life really was, nor whether he was truly what they called an Immortal.
But now, he was going to do an experiment.

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - 681 411 Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 681: Chapter 411: Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity?_2 Chapter 681: Chapter 411: Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity?_2 Go see if I can really—
Slay the gods!
…
Within the White Phoenix Clan territory.
The White Wind Empress, Xu Yue, looked at Chen Yi and his party, who had entered her palace, with a slightly wistful expression and chided with a hint of reproach, “It’s been such a long time since we last met, hasn’t it? Jiaye, my sister, did you miss me?”
“It seems that Jiaye is the favored one after all. I almost thought she had been abandoned as well.”
“How could that be.”
With her arm looped through Xu Yue’s, Jiaye smiled warmly and said earnestly, “I’ve been here since the insignificant days of Yi, unlike you, sister.”
But at this moment, Chen Yi had no interest in such matters. Instead, he looked at Xu Yue with a dark expression and said word by word, “Take me to the two deities imprisoned by your White Phoenix Clan.”
“Furthermore.”
After a pause, Chen Yi stared at Xu Yue with an ugly expression and hoarsely said, “Is White Phoenix Clan the real name of your noble race? Perhaps Exorcist Clan would be more appropriate?”
“Someone told me it seems the entire nobility is composed of dead people.”
“Though you can pass on and continue the race, every player including you, the queen, is merely private property. Is this what you mean by the White Phoenix Clan’s queen being ‘Immortal and Indestructible’? Of course, the dead cannot die or be destroyed.”
“Are these statements mistaken?”
This was information disclosed to him by Santa Claus. According to Santa Claus, the original name of the White Phoenix Clan was the Exorcist Clan, and the whole clan was composed of the dead. They hid in the Timeline from three months ago. The only way to successfully escape from the endgame was by following one method.
That was to have a child with a living person.
And this living person couldn’t be just anyone. They had to be a player who made a huge contribution during the last battle. The conditions could be said to be extremely harsh.
As Chen Yi finished speaking, Xu Yue’s eyes suddenly began to flicker, and after a long while, she bit her lip and said, “Was it that damned Santa Claus who told you?”
“I saw his reindeer the last time I was at your side.”
“I knew it, that damned big mouth. There’s no secret he can’t spill.”
“These might be true, but Yi, at least I’ve never harbored any malice towards you. The World Tree that produces Zenith Radiance has been of great help to you, hasn’t it?”
As she spoke, Xu Yue forced a smile that wasn’t very pleasant to look at, and a hint of panic flickered in her pupils.
Indeed.
Chen Yi was the player she picked, and the one she believed could save the White Phoenix Clan from their suffering. With Chen Yi’s potential developing towards the final battle, he was likely to have no problems and was very likely to make a huge contribution.
But—
Chen Yi’s strength was improving too fast. She had watched his recent live streams, and the terrifying pace of his progress meant he could wipe out the entire White Phoenix Clan without any difficulty. That was why she had never sent messages to Chen Yi proactively.
Now, she dared not tease Chen Yi as she used to.
If she angered Chen Yi by any chance and led to the annihilation of her race, she would become the White Phoenix Clan’s sinner.
Originally, she had been quite happy to see Chen Yi’s sudden arrival today, even preparing several fitting outfits in her chamber upon receiving the message, planning to dress up nicely for Chen Yi and prepared generous gifts for Jiaye and the others.
But now, Chen Yi’s sudden change of attitude filled her with fear, terrified that he might start a massacre among the White Phoenix Clan in the next second.
After all, rumors can be terrifying.
Nobody knew whether Jiaye had been whispering anything into Chen Yi’s ears during this time.
“Yi, I…”
With these thoughts in mind, Xu Yue became even more anxious. Just as she was about to hastily speak again to explain something else.
Chen Yi interrupted her with an expressionless wave of his hand: “I’m not in the mood to hear this now, take me to the two deities imprisoned by your White Phoenix Clan.”
“Okay.”
Xu Yue refrained from any further idle talk. Her demeanor was no longer that of the hostess, and she lowered her posture significantly, turning around to lead the way.
It was the same familiar corridor.
And the same familiar murals on the walls.
At the end of the corridor, with Xu Yue gently tapping the wall with one hand, the wall in front of them slowly retracted into the ground. What came into view was a huge pit hidden deep underground.
In the pit, hundreds of fierce, roaring monsters were bound with iron chains.
Among these creatures, there were two colossal beings!
One of the beings, appearing male, was a thousand meters tall.
He was standing calmly in the center, with his eyes closed and yellowing hair, as though in a deep slumber.
Around this man’s body, hundreds of chains passed through, confining him to this place for millennia, rendering him immobile.
“This is the God of Knights.”
Xu Yue said in a low voice, introducing him.
She then looked over at the other deity standing beside the God of Knights, a deity just as tall, resembling a giant skeleton.
Its bones emitted a faint blue glow, with two weak fires of the undead burning in its eye sockets.
“This is the God of the Undead.”
“These two supreme spiritual deities are the gods imprisoned by our White Phoenix Clan.”
Having said that.
Xu Yue subconsciously glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End standing by her side.
“Hey.”
Resting his hand on his chin, Sword Without End gazed at the two giant deities in the pit thoughtfully and said, “If I remember correctly, the last time I was here, you mentioned that Tuberculosis Rabbit, Yi, and I all have the aura of god-slayers, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - 682 411 Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 682: Chapter 411: Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity?_3 Chapter 682: Chapter 411: Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity?_3 “Yes.”
Xu Yue hesitated for a moment before nodding, “That breath is the testament of killing deities, one that never fades, but it does fade gradually over time or with reincarnation.”
“Both you and Tuberculosis Rabbit have a strong scent of it. The deities that died by your hands are at least more than three.”
“As for Yi…”
She didn’t continue.
The aura on Chen Yi was so intense that it terrified her. She couldn’t quantify it, only knowing it was too dense to ignore. Perhaps it was for this reason that Santa Claus decided to build a good relationship in advance and sent his smartest little reindeer as a pet to Chen Yi.
How could such a person not catch one’s attention?
If she had to use a quantifier, at least nearly a hundred…
Yes, nearly a hundred.
If it were a single deity, the word “honorable” might be used to express respect and preciousness, but for a hundred deities, it feels more appropriate to use the word “heads.”
Chen Yi didn’t speak, just took a deep breath.
And slowly activated the skill “Ascend to the Heavens in One Step.”
The next second—
He suddenly felt the walking stick in his hand growing hot, and then the staff slowly began to deform, turning into a crimson long knife with an orange-red flame burning along its blade.
The scorching temperature forced Xu Yue and others standing nearby to retreat several steps.
“Yi!”
Guessing that Chen Yi might be about to do something, Xu Yue, with a trace of panic flashing in her pupils, urgently blurted out, “Yi, you mustn’t take action, once the deity awakes the consequences—”
However, before she finished speaking.
She felt the surroundings plunge into darkness—not because it was nightfall, but because the orange flame on the long knife in Chen Yi’s hand was so bright that it allowed no other object to be seen by those around him.
It was as if night had fallen.
Sensing his own body gradually heating up, Chen Yi gripped the long knife, closed his eyes slowly, and then, as his pupils burst open, the orange-red flames wildly ignited within.
Chen Yi swung the knife forcefully.
A streak of orange-red blade light drifted slowly and yet swiftly toward the God of Knights bound in chains at the center of the deep pit.
“Roar!”
As if sensing danger, the God of Knights, who had been standing with closed eyes, suddenly opened them, a barely detectable fear flashing in his eyes. Accompanied by a roar, the countless chains that had bound him suddenly all shattered!
He was about to lift the great sword in his hands to resist!
But it was too late!
The orange-red blade light fell on the God of Knights with a seemingly light touch, without leaving any wound, as if sunlight silently penetrated into the giant body of the God of Knights.
The next second—
The God of Knights’s body stiffened in place, the emotions in his eyes suddenly froze, as if his thoughts had ceased to function, the God of Knights—who stood thousands of kilometers tall.
His body began to crumble away slowly.
It was a complete disintegration.
Not even a shred of flesh or bone was left behind, turning into orange-red light and dissipating on the spot.
“Absolute Slay,” “Absolute Hit,” “Absolute Inability to Revive,” and several other Absolute Attributes combined made for a transcendent existence.
The God of Knights.
Today, dies!
As the God of Knights disintegrated.
A notification sound nearly echoed in the ears of countless players.
