‘Ding, announcement for the whole Starfield of the Annihilation Starfield!’
‘The planets involved in this announcement include Turtle Star, Zhiwa Star, Egglet Star… totaling 611 planets.’
‘Affiliated to Star System No. 3 of the Annihilation Starfield, player Chen Yi from the planet Blue Star on Zerofold Planet, has successfully killed the deity ‘God of Knights’ during the Novice Period!’
‘He is the first player in the history of Ascend game to kill a deity, and also the first to do so during the Novice Period!’
‘Unprecedented, with none to follow!’
‘Absolutely shocking!’
‘This event has shocked countless players, has been selected for the grand events of Ascend game, will permanently leave its mark in Ascend game, and a statue representing this event will be erected in the Hall of Honor of Ascend game.’
‘And achieved a milestone in Ascend game!’
‘Milestone Name: Heaven Cleaving Blade!’
‘Conditions to Achieve: The first player to kill a deity.’
‘Let us congratulate Chen Yi for being the first player to earn this milestone in the history of Ascend game.’
‘And has earned the Stellar Rank title ‘Heaven Cleaving Blade’!’
…
The continuous stream of notifications rang in the ears of countless players.
While Xu Yue, standing aside, had already become stupefied in place, her face filled with shock and disbelief, indifferent to the fact that she was greatly losing her composure!
Those chains were meant to absolutely bind the gods!
It had been this way for a thousand years, without any exceptions.
So why did the God of Knights suddenly break free from the chains before dying, does it mean that the God of Knights had always had the capability of escaping? How could this be possible?
And…
Did Chen Yi just kill a deity?
Although she had sensed a large amount of the scent left behind from killing deities on Chen Yi, she had always thought that was something from his past lives, that this life was still in its early stages, but… but…
…
Chen Yi looked down at the long knife in his hand as the flames slowly dissipated, then looked up at the deep pit where, due to the death of its comrade, the fire in the eyes of the undead blazed, roaring as it too broke free of the chains, smashing its fist into the ground in front of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - 683 411 Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 683: Chapter 411: Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity?_4 Chapter 683: Chapter 411: Did Chen Yi Just Kill a Deity?_4 Suddenly—
The chains that bound the hundreds of creatures began to buzz, ready to shatter at any moment.
He really could kill gods.
His age actually exceeded that of the God of Knights.
In actuality, was he an Immortal, or perhaps an old demon?
But there was no time to ponder, as he once again activated the set effects. The orange-red flames that had vanished from his blade now reconverged.
With that, another slash of orange-red sword light was unleashed.
The God of the Undead within the deep pit suddenly stiffened in place and followed the God of Knights into oblivion, transforming into an orange-red light that dissipated on the spot, along with the hundred creatures within the pit that had yet to break free.
In an instant.
The once bustling and intimidating pit was now spotless.
Not a trace of corpses, flesh, or debris remained, appearing incredibly empty, as if it had just been swept clean.
And the announcement rang out once again!
–
“Ding, Annihilation Starfield announcement to the Whole Starfield!”
“This announcement includes the following planets: Turtle Star, Zhiwa Star, Egglet Star… totaling 611 planets.”
“In the Star System No. 3 of the Annihilation Starfield, Blue Star player Chen Yi from Zerofold Planet, within the Novice Period, has successfully slain the deity ‘God of the Undead’!”
“He is the first player in the history of the ascent game to kill a deity, and equally, the first to kill two deities within the Novice Period!”
“Unprecedented, with no one to follow!”
“Absolutely stunning!”
“This act has astonished countless players and has been selected to enter into the chronicles of the ascent game, where he will forever leave his name and mark, and a statue representing this event will be added to the Hall of Honor in the ascent game.”
“And he has claimed a milestone in the ascent game!”
“Milestone Name: One Slash Two.”
“Conditions to Achieve: A player who kills two deities simultaneously.”
“Let us congratulate Chen Yi for being the first player in the history of the ascent game to claim this milestone.”
“And he has been awarded the Stellar Rank title ‘One Slash Two’!”
…
“Annihilation Starfield Continent Monument!”
“Monument Name”: Heaven Cleaving Blade.
“Conditions to Achieve”: The first player to kill a deity.
“Owner”: Chen Yi.
“Runner-up Project Team”: Snow Sea Project Team.
“Affiliated Project Team”: Annihilation Starfield Project Team.
“The runner-up project team is rewarded with one S-rank complimentary free privilege, all members receive 100 Achievement Points, and a one-time penalty avoidance privilege.”
“The affiliated project team is awarded 100 Achievement Points, all members receive 50 Achievement Points, and they are granted promotion eligibility, valid for ten years, along with a one-time penalty avoidance privilege.”
–
“Annihilation Starfield Continent Monument!”
“Monument Name”: One Slash Two.
“Conditions to Achieve”: A player who kills two deities simultaneously.
“Owner”: Chen Yi.
“Runner-up Project Team”: Snow Sea Project Team.
“Affiliated Project Team”: Annihilation Starfield Project Team.
“The runner-up project team is rewarded with one S-rank complimentary free privilege, all members receive 100 Achievement Points, and a one-time penalty avoidance privilege.”
“The affiliated project team is awarded 100 Achievement Points, all members receive 50 Achievement Points, and they are granted promotion eligibility, valid for ten years, along with a one-time penalty avoidance privilege.”
–
High above the sky of the Annihilation Starfield.
Numerous players, with stupefied looks, raised their heads to gaze at the sky above them. Just moments ago, two brand-new monuments had risen one after another.
Up until now.
There were already seven monuments above their heads.
Just two more, and it would be time to consider which monument Hou Yi should shoot down first.
Previously, the notion that monuments would block the view and sunlight was merely a joke, but now it had become a reality.
Numerous players exchanged wide-eyed stares, somewhat puzzled over the meaning of these monuments. Deities sounded impressive, only… did the ascent game have any deities?
What sort of power did these deities possess?
Most players were completely unaware of the existence of deities, let alone understand their power. Naturally, they had no clue what it meant to slay a deity.
Meanwhile, in the “33 Club Chat Group”.
The group fell silent.
Those at their level naturally knew what deities represented and understood what it meant to slay them.
This meant that strength had reached the pinnacle of the ascent game.
Before this, no player in the ascent game had ever killed a deity, including Jiang Chenglu, who had never slain a deity before ascending from the Tenfold Planet.
If previously Chen Yi’s obliteration of the Sixfold Planet had caused self-mockery in the group, with no more common topics with Yi, now they didn’t even have the courage for self-mockery.
Because they truly were no longer on the same level.
They couldn’t even muster a congratulatory message. The announcement had been sounding for quite some time, but as if they hadn’t heard it, no one dared to speak up in the group chat.
In the past, they would jovially call him “Yi Father”.
This time, they couldn’t even say that.
They couldn’t bring themselves to say it.
…
Meanwhile, Li Yi from Awesome Starfield, who had been gloating over his Points Balance, fell silent upon receiving the news. He had been smug about making a good deal and receiving insider information from Yi to leave the market early, but now suddenly, the self-satisfaction disappeared.
He suddenly understood why Yi didn’t wait for the price to increase before selling.
Because Yi simply didn’t care about that.
The current Yi might not care about Points at all, treating it as a casual pastime. Earning more or less didn’t make a difference to Yi, for how could a being capable of slaying deities lack Points?
Leaving aside other things, if Yi’s “God Yi Mall” continued to collect protection fees, beginning today, countless races from various Starfields would have to send envoys from afar to pay up.
A player from a Threefold Planet collecting protection fees would be scoffed at.
But for a player capable of God Slaughter, even twice, what remained was the fear of being too slow and not making it in time.

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - 684 412 Shall we go down and set off some
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 684: Chapter 412: “Shall we go down and set off some fireworks? Chapter 684: Chapter 412: “Shall we go down and set off some fireworks? “…”
Within the territory of the White Phoenix Clan, Chen Yi’s eyebrows slightly furrowed without speaking, as he took out the Wonder Atlas from his chest and looked towards the once top-ranked “Tomb of the Gods,” created by Jiang Chenglu.
“Wonder Name”: Tomb of the Gods.
“Wonder Ranking”: 6th place.
“Wonder Effects”: Eleven deities were slain by player Jiang Chenglu on Starfield, their flesh forever enduring, ceaselessly impacting the surroundings even in death. All players within the vicinity of the deities’ realm will feel an oppressive deterrent force, and within the deities’ domain, all props, skills, and titles will be drastically reduced.
“Wonder Origin”: It was accidentally unearthed by Jiang Chenglu, a player from the Mo Clan of Sky Desert Star in the 17th star system of the Deity Starfield, on the planet Ninefold. After battling for seven days and nights, player Jiang Chenglu single-handedly slew all eleven deities here.
The bodies of the deities do not decay but endure eternally, and the dignity of the deities insists that even in death they do not fall, thus creating this rare wonder.
“Wonder Location”: Deity Starfield, within the Mo Clan territory.
“Wonder Creator”: Jiang Chenglu.
This was once the top-ranked wonder, of course, but now the top rank has become “Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb of the Tomb, creator Tie Chui.” The last time this ranking was completely messed up by their team, dominating the top five places.
What puzzled him was,
Clearly stated in this wonder effect, eleven deities were killed by player Jiang Chenglu, but why did the recent announcement say he was the first player to kill a deity?
Yes.
He saw it very clearly.
That milestone was not about the first player to kill a deity during the Novice Period; the announcement also didn’t say it was the first player to kill a deity during the Novice Period, but the first player to kill a deity.
That is to say…
The one Jiang Chenglu killed was not a real deity?
But if so, why does the description on the wonder panel still refer to a deity?
While Chen Yi was frowning and pondering this issue, the White Phoenix Clan Empress Xu Yue suddenly knelt down with a plop, her eyes tearful and voice trembling, “Yi, for so many years, the White Phoenix Clan has imprisoned these two deities, expending a great deal of manpower and resources, but the occasional leakage of divine power has still brought great losses to the White Phoenix Clan.”
“Today, Yi, your slaying of these two deities has relieved the White Phoenix Clan of further worries.”
“Every member of the White Phoenix Clan is profoundly grateful and at a loss for how to repay your kindness. From now on, should you ever need the assistance of the White Phoenix Clan, we will not hesitate, even if it means going through fire and water!”
“…”
Chen Yi did not speak but casually said, “Didn’t you tell me before that once the deities are dead, you could return to the normal timeline?”
“I…”
Xu Yue suddenly became stuck, fumbling for words.
“Alright.”
Chen Yi shook his head and gestured for Xu Yue to get up, “Let’s not delve into the past, I need to return now; I have some matters to attend to.”
…
He did not stay with the White Phoenix Clan any longer but instead returned to Blue Star.
There were many things he didn’t understand.
He hadn’t even checked what effects the awarded title had, as his mind was almost a blank slate, still struggling to wake up from the concept of being an Immortal.
Lying on the beach chair, Chen Yi looked dazed and was silent for a long time before turning his head towards Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Do you know something?”
“Mhm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded, slightly embarrassed as he touched his nose, “I did recover some memory a while back but didn’t tell you, Yi. Mainly because it’s too fantastical, you wouldn’t believe me, and it wasn’t necessary. It would only disrupt your peace of mind.”
“You are indeed an Immortal.”
“But not quite an Immortal.”
“True Immortals have lived from thousands of years ago until now, whereas you, Yi, have gone through countless reincarnations, but unlike normal people’s reincarnation, you didn’t follow the process of reincarnation. Instead, you reincarnated directly out of the timeline.”
“This means your actual age is indeed very long, at least longer than those deities.”
“Longer than the deities.”
Chen Yi’s murmured in a trance, and after a long pause, he continued, “What about you? Tuberculosis Rabbit, are you an Immortal too?”
“Mhm mhm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded again, “If you insist on understanding it that way, it’s not incorrect. During the last God Slaughter War, we lost, and although the deities won, they too fell into slumber.”
“You could say both parties were injured.”
“And the survivors on our side gathered all their strength to create this game of level progression. There weren’t enough resources to satisfy everyone, so we had to filter out the most deserving of the resources through the level progression game. We then nurtured the strongest over time, to use against the deities.”
“My ability is to help you Yi, fend off calamities. You have not experienced a true reincarnation because of my ability. A true reincarnation would mean forgetting all memories, like Sword Without End who died completely and then lived a new life.”
“And when you, Yi, reach a certain juncture, you will recover all your memories. This is my last lifetime. If we lose again in this life, you won’t ever see me again.”
“If… we win this life, then it all ends.”
“We have lost many times, but this time we have the most hope of winning.”

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - 685 412 Shall we go down and set off some
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 685: Chapter 412: “Shall we go down and set off some fireworks?”_2 Chapter 685: Chapter 412: “Shall we go down and set off some fireworks?”_2 Chen Yi frowned slightly in confusion and asked, “Why?”
“Heh!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly revealed a grin, “Yi, in your previous life, you believed in equal distribution of resources, allocating all the available resources of our side to everyone, making everyone stronger. I’ve told you many times that resources must be accumulated on you alone in order to stand against the deities.”
“But you were too soft-hearted and couldn’t bring yourself to do it.”
“Before the last failure and the restart, you distributed the resources evenly again, granting us insiders a certain resource package at the beginning of the upgrade game.”
“It’s just… I fell asleep later. After you went to sleep, I canceled the status of all the other insiders who were set to fall asleep in the upgrade game before me, leaving only you as an insider.”
In the midst of speaking.
Tuberculosis Rabbit turned her head to glance at Sword Without End, smiling with her mouth wide.
Yes.
Sword Without End was also a leftover from the previous generation, an insider with a certain resource package, but she did something to terminate Sword Without End’s insider status, so naturally, he wouldn’t receive the resource package meant for him.
For instance, the title “Wife-Killing Maniac” was one of the items from Sword Without End’s resource package.
However, when entering the map, the unconscious upgrade game detected that Sword Without End was not a predetermined insider, so naturally, it wouldn’t grant him that title.
Actually, that title was created because of Sword Without End’s presence.
It was meant to be exclusive to him.
In his last life, Sword Without End cultivated the Ruthless Sword Path. All his relatives and friends would die one after another due to various accidents. In agony, he strived to sever all emotions and desires, thereby achieving absolute ruthlessness.
Even though his memory was gone.
But his subconscious still made Sword Without End feel that he should be a Sword Immortal and that in this life, his relatives and friends would inexplicably die around him.
And this title was also the result of Sword Without End condensing all his abilities and sending them into the upgrade game while he was asleep.
It was the most suitable title for Sword Without End.
For someone who had cultivated the path of detachment, killing his own wife wasn’t a difficult precondition to trigger.
“Why are you looking at me like that?”
Sword Without End, with a somber look, turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit, “You just mentioned my name, said I’m also an Immortal? What does that mean? I always feel like you know a lot, and that look in your eyes makes me uneasy.”
“I always feel like you might have ill intentions towards me.”
“It’s very uncomfortable to look at.”
“It’s nothing.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said with a grin, “I was just talking nonsense.”
The Sword Without End who hadn’t cultivated the Ruthless Sword Path seemed much more approachable this life, not like his last life where he always wore a deadpan face that made people want to throw a shoe at him. Indeed, the Ruthless Sword Path just wasn’t something people should cultivate.
“…”
“…”
“…”
After lying silently on the beach chair for a long time, Chen Yi finally sat up and turned to Tuberculosis Rabbit, “I think I understand what you mean. It means we’ve been fighting against the deities for a long time.”
“And last time, we lost.”
“Before our defeat, a handful of survivors set up the upgrade game; meanwhile, the deities recovered, and now the great battle is about to come again.”
“Hmm.”
As soon as Chen Yi finished speaking, a sudden voice chimed in his ears.
Everyone immediately turned their heads to look.
Santa Claus had, at some point, arrived on the roof with his little reindeer, sitting cross-legged in front of the barbecue grill and unceremoniously began to chew on a skewer of roasted meat, savoring it contentedly.
“This tastes really good, what meat is this?”
“Deer meat.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said with a remote expression.
“Deer meat?”
Santa Claus’ eyes lit up and he chewed more vigorously, “Deer meat, wonderful, I love deer meat the most. It’s so fragrant.”
“…”
The expression on Tuberculosis Rabbit’s face suddenly stiffened.
“What’s wrong, why such a strange expression? Or what did you think I meant by using reindeer as a mode of transportation? Why would I raise so many of them?”
“Of course, it’s because deer meat is delicious and the meat has a good texture.”
“Okay then.”
Santa Claus, who had been joking around with Tuberculosis Rabbit, wiped the grease from the corner of his mouth and spoke seriously, “Tuberculosis Rabbit has regained part of her memories, but not fully.”
“We can’t afford to dawdle, I’ll get right to the point.”
“After the last defeat, some highly potential individuals fell into a slumber, awaiting the advent of the upgrade game for reincarnation. Among these outstanding individuals were Tuberculosis Rabbit, you, Chen Yi, and Wang Qi from the neighboring Starfield.”
“And it’s reassuring to know that we’ve indeed sifted through many geniuses during the selection of races.”
“Such as Li Yi, such as Jiang Chenglu.”
“Especially Jiang Chenglu, who not only gains strength rapidly but also has a great spirit of sacrifice.”
“There’s something I’m not sure I should say, but after Jiang Chenglu learned about the origin of the upgrade game and what he would face after ascending to Tenfold Planet, he locked himself away for three days. When he came out, the first thing he did was to find you.”
“Because we told him that you were the only player predetermined by the upgrade game from the start.”
“Of course, originally it wasn’t just you, but as Tuberculosis Rabbit did, she made you the only insider, and you took all the resource packages that belonged to the other insiders.”

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - 686 412 Shall we go down and set off some
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 686: Chapter 412: “Shall we go down and set off some fireworks?”_3 Chapter 686: Chapter 412: “Shall we go down and set off some fireworks?”_3 “For example, ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains,’ these items are actually from Chang Shi. Oh, right, Chang Shi is the previous owner of the ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ prop, the same Wen Ping you guys plotted to kill.”
“His original name was Chang Shi, and in this lifetime, he’s called Wen Ping.”
“He has also come this time.”
With a snap of Santa Claus’ fingers, a very familiar young man slowly emerged from the shadows, his face full of resentment. If not the Wen Ping whom they had schemed to kill in the Illusory Realm, then who could it be?
“What the hell?”
Shock flashed in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes as he took two steps back. “Are you Chang Shi?”
He didn’t have much memory of Chang Shi since his memory hadn’t fully recovered, but he faintly remembered that there was a teammate named Chang Shi in their past life, just not that this Chang Shi was Wen Ping of this lifetime.
The player they had pitifully plotted to death?
“…”
Even Chen Yi couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth, not knowing what to say, especially upon seeing Chang Shi’s face full of deep resentment, he felt even less at ease.
“Yes!”
With some emotion, Santa Claus said, “The original plan was for Chang Shi to obtain ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and find some unlucky person to obtain ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains,’ and then have Chang Shi successfully acquire both props and merge them to get the final set effects.”
“But unexpectedly, by a twist of fate, the ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains’ prop ended up in your hands, Chen Yi.”
“In theory, Chang Shi, possessing the ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,’ should have been impossible to kill, but who could have thought that he would be so easily plotted against and killed within the Illusory Realm?”
“Um…” Tuberculosis Rabbit started somewhat awkwardly, “Sorry about that.”
“It’s fine.”
Chang Shi took a deep breath before shaking his head, “Actually, Tuberculosis Rabbit, you weren’t wrong either. It is indeed possible to oppose the deities by concentrating resources in one’s hands. What’s more, I don’t blame you. It’s you all who allowed me to experience what true love is for the first time in dozens of lifetimes.”
“Even if I died, I am content.”
“I am fulfilled, and do not feel this life has been in vain.”
“Eh?”
Suddenly remembering something, Tuberculosis Rabbit asked in confusion, “Wasn’t Wen Ping utterly slain? What’s this state now?”
“Hey!”
Exasperatedly slapping his forehead, Santa Claus exclaimed, “Look at me, I got so carried away I forgot! Chang Shi, ah, Chang Shi is already dead, in the same state as me, half-dead.”
“Back then, wasn’t part of those with potential asleep, preparing to reincarnate and join the core game upgrading?”
“The plan was for everyone to reincarnate and await the launching of the core game. We extracted nearly all the divine power of dozens of deities to maintain the normal operation of the core game, but still required some manual intervention.”
“However, afraid that the deities would exploit any loopholes, we set many rules. Once the core game started, it could only proceed according to the rules, with no one able to exploit loopholes, though we did leave some backdoors.”
“At the time, some people voluntarily chose to give up their lives, joining the core game as half-dead NPCs, you know, like me, after all, it’s a waste of resources for us with less potential to occupy them.”
“And Chang Shi is already dead. After all, being killed by Chen Yi and wanting to resurrect is quite difficult. If it’s by Chen Yi’s own hand, although Chen Yi has the title of ‘Absolutely Irresurrectible’ upon slaying members of an Alien Race, it’s not too hard.”
“Except that Chang Shi died under the rules of the core game, in the duel between the players holding ‘Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea’ and ‘Longevity as the Southern Mountains,’ it’s a rule we were afraid someone would abuse, which we set with very high authority,”
“Oh right, if I remember correctly, that part of the plan was set by Chang Shi himself.”
“Dying under that rule naturally meant he couldn’t be resurrected, leaving him only to become a spectator like me, accompanying you all to face the true final battle.”
“Also, about that Jiang Chenglu, I went off on a tangent earlier. After finishing his retreat, the first thing Jiang Chenglu did was to seek you out, Chen Yi, to die by your hand, using his own life to help you develop faster.”
“It is said that Jiang Chenglu had a woman he cherished dearly, and their child was about to be born. Jiang Chenglu hoped to end all the wars before his child’s birth, so that the first thing his child would see upon entering the world would be peace.”
“Worried that his own capabilities were insufficient, he made a gamble with you.”
“Unfortunately, dying at your hands, Chen Yi, and trying to revive later caused Jiang Chenglu to exert a lot of effort. Avoiding the ‘Absolutely Irresurrectible’ trait is not a simple matter, and perhaps for this reason, Jiang Chenglu suffered consecutive defeats on the battlefield outside.”
Frowning, Chen Yi spoke in a grave voice, “Dead?”
“Not quite, but it’s not going well for him. It looks like if no new planet ascends soon, he probably won’t last more than a week.”
“So your purpose for coming here was just to tell us this?”
“That’s about it.” Santa Claus paused for a moment before saying, “The gods that Jiang Chenglu slew during his last assault weren’t the true deities, but their spokespeople. However, at the climax of the battle, those twelve spokespeople became possessed by their respective deities, and despite their sudden surge in power, Jiang Chenglu still managed to cut them down.”

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - 687 412 Shall we go down and set off some
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 687: Chapter 412: “Shall we go down and set off some fireworks?”_4 Chapter 687: Chapter 412: “Shall we go down and set off some fireworks?”_4 “So, Chen Yi, you are the first person to have slain a deity.”
“While the original deities were still in slumber, Jiang Chenglu’s enemies were not the deities themselves, but their avatars. Now that a true deity has died today, all the other slumbering deities will sense it.”
“The remaining deities will soon begin to awaken.”
“The great battle is about to come, and this moment has arrived much earlier than we anticipated.”
“The main purpose of this trip was to inform you of these matters. With the protection of the ascent game, other deities can’t attack for now, but… I estimate it won’t last long. If possible, try to clear the maps from ‘Ultimate One’ to ‘Ultimate Nine’ as soon as you can.”
“These nine maps are the ultimate maps of the ascent game, and they are also the finale maps.”
“They are the nine most difficult maps in the ascent game.”
“And clearing each map will yield a set of ‘Godslaying Suit,’ the properties of each map’s ‘Godslaying Suit’ are different, a lot of divine power from the deities was consumed to create these nine sets.”
“They can give someone the power comparable to a deity instantaneously.”
“Originally, it was planned that each predestined player would receive a set, but… Tuberculosis Rabbit designated you as the sole predestined player, so only you can clear these maps and obtain the ‘Godslaying Suit,’ and only you are qualified to wear them.”
“Nine sets… Not sure how you’re going to wear them. Stacking them definitely won’t work—maybe change a set per day.”
“Anyway, no one else can wear them besides you.”
Chen Yi looked thoughtful as he glanced towards the Boots of the Sea God in his backpack and projected their panel info into the air: “Is this what you mean?”
“You’ve already obtained it?”
“Yes, one that the Gold Miner hooked back.”
“Tsk, the status of being a predestined player really does bring good fortune. Any other player could hook for a lifetime and still probably wouldn’t be able to get this thing.”
Santa Claus sighed softly and said, “This map is also accessible to newbie players. Over at the Snow Sea Project Team, there are quite a few S-rank free permissions. Spend a permission to leave Blue Star and clear those nine maps.”
“It’s not difficult.”
“Those nine maps were one of the few solid foundations at that time. For ordinary players, the difficulty isn’t that high, but if ordinary players succeed, they’ll have to stay there and play the role of the boss. That’s the rule; there has to be someone acting as the boss.”
“But for predestined players, as soon as they enter, they can take the suit away. This distinction is mainly there because we were worried the avatars of the deities would infiltrate the ascent game.”
“In fact—”
Santa Claus hesitated for a moment before continuing, “When we set up the ascent game, we didn’t establish so many complicated rules, but when we were almost done setting it up, we discovered that quite a few deities’ avatars had reincarnated into our realm in secret, waiting for the ascent game to begin.”
“Left with no choice, we had to establish all sorts of rules.”
“In design, within the Myriad Clans of the ascent game, there are quite a few avatars of deities now; it’s just that if they don’t expose themselves proactively, they also won’t be detected.”
…
Santa Claus and Chen Yi’s group chatted for a long time.
Until it got dark and then light again.
…
Time moved on, to 8 a.m. on the morning of February 10th.
Countless crackling firecracker sounds erupted outside; today was the first day of the New Year, the celebration had begun!
Numerous Blue Star players walked onto the streets with beaming smiles, endlessly greeting each other with clasped hands, clearly satisfied with having lived to see the Spring Festival.
“It’s the New Year, huh.”
Standing on the edge of the rooftop, Chen Yi gazed down at the bustling crowd below and murmured softly.
“Yeah.”
Standing behind Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded in agreement and said, “Indeed, shall we go set off some fireworks as well?”
“No need.”
Chen Yi seemed to think of something and suddenly turned his head to look at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a frown, asking, “How many lifetimes have we been partners?”
“Uh… A lot. I’ve forgotten many things. I just remember I’ve had many names, like Tuberculosis Rabbit, Scar Dog, Old Goat, Old Chicken, Ergou, Niu Mang, and so on.”
“All animals?”
“Yeah, not sure why. Maybe I don’t deserve a surname. Yi, you’ve had many names too, such as Chen Yi, Chen Jiang, Chen Ping, Chen Dao, Chen Gu, Chen Li, and so on. A lot, all with the surname Chen.”
“I see. What about Sword Without End?”
“Him? He’s been nothing but a bum in all the lifetimes we’ve known him, always a bum; he’s not important.”
“…”
Sword Without End maintained an expressionless face as if he heard nothing and remained silent.
“And Jiaye?”
“Jiaye and Tie Chui were an accident. Yi, you never had a woman before, nor a woman you liked, only in this life you met your sister-in-law by chance and ended up together. It’s a variable, but maybe it also means we might have a perfect ending this life.”
“Is that so?”
Chen Yi looked down at Jiaye leaning against him, her arms wrapped around his, his eyes gradually becoming peaceful; he said nothing.
After a long while.
Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke hesitantly again, “How about we go down and set off some firecrackers?”
“No.”
Chen Yi responded, rejecting the idea calmly, “These firecrackers are too small. We’re going to set off some big firecrackers. I’ve already talked to the Snow Sea Project Team; we’re going to have some fun with the people from Ninefold Planet.”
“What for?”
“Force them to ascend to Tenfold Planet, support Jiang Chenglu, and stabilize the battle situation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - 688 413 Its Pretty Good to Be a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 688: Chapter 413: It’s Pretty Good to Be a Good-for-Nothing Who Only Eats Chicken Legs. Chapter 688: Chapter 413: It’s Pretty Good to Be a Good-for-Nothing Who Only Eats Chicken Legs. “Time flies, and the years wait for no one.”
When would one use this opening? When a story draws to its close, there always seems to be someone who begins to reminisce about the very beginning.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit gazed into the void before him, his expression one of playful melancholy as he murmured.
It was almost over.
He had so much he wanted to say, but it never seemed like the right time to speak.
After all, battle was imminent.
Their group had already left Blue Star and had just arrived at Awesome Starfield. They had not greeted Li Yi, since they did not plan to stay long in Awesome Starfield; it was merely a stopover.
Their destination was “Five Chieftains Starfield,” which had a planet called “Five Chieftains Planet,” inhabited by the Kui Race, a Ninefold planet.
It was also the target of their planned extermination.
Convincing the nine Ninefold planets to advance to Tenfold planets seemed too wasteful of breath, and those people were unlikely to listen to him anyway.
If they could be easily persuaded, they would have done so already, not dawdling and dragging their feet without any reaction until now.
The simplest solution was to exterminate one race, and the remaining eight Ninefold planets would naturally make the right decision.
It was like managing 100 people with 10 bullets might be challenging, but managing 90 people with 9 bullets was significantly easier.
It was the same principle.
Chen Yi calmly looked at the portal in front of him. Beyond the portal was a rotating expanse of nothingness that seemed to suck in one’s gaze. Staring too long could even cause dizziness.
This was their first trip to a Ninefold planet and their first dealing with players from a Ninefold planet.
For players of Ninefold planets to travel to Starfields primarily composed of Threefold planets was difficult – at least most players from Ninefold planets found it challenging. This was to prevent these players from exterminating races on a whim and completely disrupting the balance of the game.
But there was no restriction on lower-level players travelling to higher-level Starfields; they could go if they wished.
In reality, no restriction was needed since few dared to do so.
And on his chat interface, there was a message from Santa Claus.
“According to our guess, the Kui Race on the Ninefold planet might be a snare left by the deities before the advancement game began.”
“This is not confirmed, just a speculation. If you intend to exterminate a race as a show of force, prioritize this one.”
“Though it’s speculation, even if it’s a mistake, it doesn’t matter. Among the Ninefold planets, only this race’s players are continually spreading the notion that advancing to Tenfold planets means certain death, always propagating negative comments. Even if they aren’t the deities’ snare, it’s not a mistake to eliminate them.”
“However, before that, I suggest you visit the Ultimate maps. Only with the Godslaying Suit will you have the real strength to confront the entire Ninefold planet. Otherwise, it’s unrealistic to oppose an entire Ninefold planet with your current strength.”
“On Ninefold planets, items of XL and L grades are plentiful, and any such item can change the outcome of a battlefield.”
…
Chen Yi found Santa Claus’s advice quite sound, so he silently looked at the portal before him without a word, instead turning his gaze to the Nine Chapters Map Pass in his hand.
He had them all, from Ultimate One Map to Ultimate Nine Map.
Complete.
They were not difficult to obtain. Although he hadn’t found them for sale on the Star Map, a single inquiry to Li Yi had him sending all nine map passes eagerly, with a worried look and numerous cautions.
The Ultimate series of maps were indeed the pinnacle of the advancement game. Successful completion was rumored to yield countless high-value rewards, yet over the years, no one had come out of the Ultimate series maps alive.
Not a single one.
This caused the Ultimate map passes, though exceedingly rare, to be virtually worthless. With only a slight overbid, he had acquired all nine passes from some collectors.
About this,
Chen Yi showed no particular reaction and didn’t engage in further discussion. After all, how could one explain such a thing with mere words? Could he say that his good brother had already set him up as the only predetermined player, and that he could clear the game simply by entering?
“Wait for me for a bit,” he said.
After pausing for a long moment, Chen Yi closed the Starfield Shuttle portal and turned to look at Jiaye Cai Rabbit and the others beside him. “I’m going to check out this Ultimate map.”
“Okay,” the Tuberculosis Rabbit said earnestly in a raspy voice, “Yi, be careful and take precautions.”
“Careful of what?”
Sword Without End looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a puzzled expression, “Didn’t you arrange the predetermined player thing? Didn’t we agree that there was no danger? You set it up, don’t you know? Why tell Yi to be careful? Your logic is flawed. If this was Werewolf Kill, you’d have exposed yourself, and everyone could vote you out, you know!”
“…”
Irritated yet speechless, Tuberculosis Rabbit rolled his eyes at Sword Without End, “You sure do talk a lot.”
“Hey, you’re calling me a chatterbox? Tuberculosis Rabbit, have you forgotten that even your dreams are filled with your incessant mumblings?”
“I arranged the predetermined player, but my memory isn’t complete. I’ve forgotten a lot of the details, so I can’t say for sure what unexpected things might happen. It’s best to be cautious,” Rabbit vaguely remembered adding something else at the time, but he really couldn’t recall what it was.

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - 689 413 Its Pretty Good to Be a Useless Person
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 689: Chapter 413: It’s Pretty Good to Be a Useless Person Who Only Knows How to Eat Chicken Legs. _2 Chapter 689: Chapter 413: It’s Pretty Good to Be a Useless Person Who Only Knows How to Eat Chicken Legs. _2 “Alright.”
Without paying attention to the bickering of the two, Chen Yi lightly nodded his head and then took the lead in activating the Map Access Pass for “Ultimate Two.” He didn’t start from the “Ultimate One” map because he had already obtained parts of the Sea God’s Suit from the two maps of “Ultimate Two.”
He was quite the regular customer by now.
First, he’d assemble the complete Sea God’s Suit in this map.
…
Meanwhile.
Within the “Ultimate Two” map.
In the depths of the sea, the man who had been engulfed in slumber now opened his eyes vacantly, allowing his body to drift aimlessly in the deep sea, his expression bewildered as if lost in thought.
It seemed like he had been asleep for a very long time.
He had always believed that no matter how much a person loved to sleep, at most they’d sleep for 48 hours at a stretch.
But ever since he entered this map, he realized he was wrong.
In this unchanging world, one could lose all sense of time, even forget their very existence. Thought itself would halt, and for a long while, he felt like he had been downgraded, from a three-dimensional being to a two-dimensional one.
During this time, things were basically as unvarying as ever.
The reason he used “basically” was mainly because there indeed had been some changes. For instance, a Thief, using the guise of a Gold Miner, had stolen two pairs of his boots.
Really…
The man’s expression gradually became more vacuous as his memory drifted back to the past.
He was born on Blue Star. When the leveling game descended upon Blue Star, he struggled bitterly for only a month before he died, died again in hell, only not to fall deeper into hell to take up some cleaning job.
Rather, he was reborn.
He came back to three years earlier.
But he was not reborn on Blue Star, but on another planet called “Beautiful Star.” When he was reborn, the leveling game had just begun there; society was not yet in chaos, and many people even took it lightly.
But taking advantage of his rebirth, although unclear about the maps and events of this new planet, he knew the harrowing nature of the leveling game. He immediately started buying up Points, then charged into the maps desperately.
He knew the Map Difficulty was easiest when the leveling game first descended. If he didn’t strive in the maps at that time, in a few months he wouldn’t even have the chance to struggle; he could only wait for death.
And so, seizing the initiative, he smoothly became the strongest player on that planet.
When the planet successfully advanced to Twofold Planet, he tried looking for Blue Star, but after paying a considerable price and searching through all Novice Planet names without finding Blue Star, he realized it had not yet faced the onset of a leveling game.
To be honest, he felt a bit smug inside. He believed he could keep enhancing his strength with his advantage. Then, when Blue Star was thrown into crisis by the leveling game, perhaps he could descend as a savior and rescue everyone from the brink.
At least, with him in this life, Blue Star would have fewer player deaths.
But before he could put any of this into action, he entered the “Ultimate Two” map. He swore it was not intentional; he had stumbled upon it by sheer coincidence.
Once inside, he found the Map Difficulty was not very high either.
All he needed to do was catch ten fish by the seaside and then hold his breath for two minutes underwater. This wasn’t much of a challenge for someone who grew up by the sea; he completed the task with ease.
Then…
“Task reward: Replace the original boss of ‘Ultimate Two,’ assume the role of the current ‘Ultimate Two’ map boss, until another player comes to replace you.”
Yes.
When that announcement sounded in his ears, he felt a murderous rage surge within him.
So, he stayed here, not knowing for how long. From initially hoping desperately for someone to quickly come and take over to eventually giving up hope altogether, so much time passed that he could not die even if he wished for it.
And at that moment—
A voice announcing a promotion abruptly rang in his ear.
“‘Ultimate Two’ map opening conditions have been satisfied. As the final boss, the Sea God Posidon of ‘Ultimate Two,’ you can now go home.”
“Thank you for everything!”
“We will remember you.”
“I get it, I get it,” the emotionally confused man muttered somewhat irritably. “You’ve said these platitudes over and over; don’t come to bother me again, or you’ll see if I…”
But before he could finish.
His speech came to an abrupt halt.
The man abruptly sat up in the sea, barefoot, his face filled with disbelief as he stared at the panel before him, his eyes wide with fear, like a drowning man spotting a straw but worried it’s just a mirage.
“Conditions have been met…you can go home…”
The man’s pallid lips, bleached by the brine, trembled uncontrollably as he read each word on the panel before him, making sure it truly meant he could go home.
And not the warning panel he had seen before.
“‘Ultimate Two’ map opening conditions are not yet satisfied, as the final boss, the Sea God Posidon of ‘Ultimate Two,’ you should behave yourself.”
“Any further misconduct will be at your own peril!”
It was truly the panel that meant he could go home.
Finally, unable to contain his joy, his face aglow with excitement and heedless of anything else, he shouted out loud, “Hahaha, I’m going home, I can finally go home. ”
…
Accompanied by a flash of white light.
The Map Access Pass for “Ultimate Two” had shattered, and Chen Yi had arrived at a beach. In front of the beach lay a boundless sea, and the beach itself was not very large; behind it were lush forests and thickets.

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - 690 413 Its Pretty Good to Be a Waste Who Only
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 690: Chapter 413: It’s Pretty Good to Be a Waste Who Only Knows How to Eat Chicken Legs. _3 Chapter 690: Chapter 413: It’s Pretty Good to Be a Waste Who Only Knows How to Eat Chicken Legs. _3 Not a single trace of commercial retouching.
It looked like the purest of nature.
While Chen Yi casually took action to study the situation of the map, he saw a barefooted man, looking abnormally excited and insane, burst out from the sea.
Heading straight for him.
The man even had a colorful luminescent prompt box floating above his head.
“Ultimate Two map boss, Sea God, Posidon!”
The man before him was the ultimate boss of this map. Yet, he didn’t look like a boss at all; in fact, he looked a bit like a lunatic, so agitated that one couldn’t help but wonder if he was having a manic episode.
“Here, take it, take them all!”
The man had no intention of speaking to him, his mind solely filled with the flickering light of excitement. After throwing all his scant clothing in front of Chen Yi, he stood with one hand on his hip, laughing wildly towards the sky before dissolving into a flash of white light on the spot.
Leaving behind his final words.
“I, dressed in white, am finally going home!”
“To hell with Posidon!”
“When I get back, I’m gonna smash all of Posidon’s stores!”
“…”
Chen Yi was still a bit slow to grasp what had happened when he saw the clothes the man had discarded onto the sand start to emit a rainbow of light, which shot straight into his backpack.
The next second—
A multitude of notification sounds began to ring incessantly in his ears.
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully acquiring the SSS grade prop, Sea God’s Suit, Necklace*1, gather all…”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully acquiring the SSS grade prop, Sea God’s Suit, Earrings*1, gather all…”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully acquiring the SSS grade prop, Sea God’s Suit, Cuirass*1, gather all…”
“…”
“Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully gathering all parts of the Sea God’s Suit, triggering the full effects of all components, with the entire suit of props upgraded to MAX level!”
“Ding, announcement for all players in the game”
“Congratulations to player Chen Yi of Zerofold Planet in the Annihilation Starfield, Sector 3, for successfully clearing the ‘Ultimate Two’ map, obtaining the MAX level Sea God’s Suit!!”
“This feat has astounded numerous players, and the event has been selected for inclusion in the game’s annals, permanently leaving his name and mark within the game, and a statue representing this event will be erected in the game’s hall of honor.”
“And he has achieved a game milestone!”
“Milestone name: Sea God!”
“…”
The eighth Monument of the game slowly rose into the skies of the Annihilation Starfield.
…
“…”
Chen Yi was silent with a peculiar expression on his face. He knew what MAX level props meant—they were the most powerful grade of props in the game, and even Jiang Chenglu, upon advancing to the Tenfold Planet, was only rewarded with a random MAX level prop.
He knew the rarity of this prop was beyond compare.
As Santa Claus used to say, creating this prop required a vast amount of Divine Power.
And now, he had obtained one so easily?
No, it should be said he obtained nine!
There were nine components of the Sea God’s Suit in total, each one a MAX level part of a MAX level suit.
They were—
“Boots”*2, “Gloves”*2, “Earrings”*1, “Necklace”*1, “Cuirass”*1, “Pants”*1, “Ring”*1.
After the upgrade to MAX level, the already outrageous effects became even more monstrous, adding a single Set Effect.
“Sea God’s Suit Effect”: Any prop, skill, or title that requires pre-conditions for activation can be triggered without pre-conditions, and all props worn, regardless of level, will be enhanced to the Ultimate Edition, including MAX level.
It was an excessively monstrous effect.
Ignoring pre-conditions meant that his Wife-Killing Buff no longer required Jiaye’s death to be activated, significantly strengthening his other props and skills as well.
For example, the Sea God’s Suit originally required being in the sea to unleash most of its effects.
Now, even on land, he could leverage the full effects of the Sea God’s Suit.
Right.
Now that the suit was MAXed to the Ultimate Edition, the effects were greatly enhanced. Not to mention anything else, just by being eternally linked to the Star Sea’s Life Value, making him Immortal and Indestructible, he dared to face the gods of a myriad worlds alone!
The boots he had originally obtained had an effect that linked his life to the life of the sea, granting him immortality.
After advancing to MAX level and becoming Ultimate Edition,
it was now linked to the life value of the Star Sea, rendering him Immortal and Indestructible. All he could say to that was, great!
It seemed like the difference of just one word.
But the resulting effect was night and day. This was like giving him an undying buff: He would never die. Now, going to the Ninefold Planet, he could say he had no worries at all.
But right now, he didn’t plan to set off for the Ninefold Planet right away. He decided to finish clearing the remaining ultimate maps first.
The next second—
Everything around him began to crumble, and he returned to the side of Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others. After exchanging a few words, he wasted no more time, crushed the “Ultimate One” Map Access Pass, and headed to the “Ultimate One” map.
Just as Tuberculosis Rabbit and Santa Claus had said.
There were no tasks, nor was there anything he needed to do.
As soon as he entered, the mission of the map was completed.
The loot was his.
He didn’t have to do anything. His presence alone was the reason for the existence of these maps, these items were prepared for him, and the moment he entered, they would automatically head to his backpack. All he had to do was stand there.

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - 691 413 Its pretty good to be a waste who only
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 691: Chapter 413: It’s pretty good to be a waste who only eats chicken legs. _4 Chapter 691: Chapter 413: It’s pretty good to be a waste who only eats chicken legs. _4 …
“…”
Meanwhile, in a city within the Annihilation Starfield.
A dark-skinned player, who was sitting on the curb gnawing on a chicken drumstick, sighed deeply and looked up at the eighth Monument rising slowly above him.
“Sea God!”
He tore off a juicy piece of chicken from the drumstick he held and said with a complex expression, “Damn, this is the eighth one already.”
“It really feels like these game Monuments are turning into Chen Yi’s achievement system. Whatever Chen Yi does, a Monument goes up in the sky.”
“Just one more, and that will make nine.”
“There should be a Hou Yi coming out to shoot the sun soon. Damn it, they can’t really complete a set of nine, can they?”
“A MAX suit? I wonder what rank that is. Probably a lot higher than SSS rank, sounds impressive.”
“Sigh.”
The man heaved another sigh and no longer dwelled on the subject, choosing instead to continue tearing at his chicken drumstick. Such matters were far beyond him, after all, he had no opportunity to even interact with Chen Yi.
Thinking about it was pointless.
Sometimes you have to admit, maybe in the game of life, you’re just an NPC. As an NPC, why bother thinking so much? Just enjoy your chicken drumstick, then get astonished when you’re supposed to be astonished.
Being a good-for-nothing who just eats chicken drumsticks isn’t so bad.
But just then—
A barrage of announcements kept ringing in his ears, the first time in many years he heard so many of them, so dense that he almost thought his computer had crashed.
“Ding, announcement to all players of the upgrade game”
“Congratulations to Chen Yi, player from planet Zerofold in Star System 3 of the Annihilation Starfield, for successfully clearing the ‘Ultimate One’ map and obtaining the MAX rank Soul Devouring God Suit!!”
“And for achieving a Milestone in the upgrade game!”
“Milestone name: Soul Devouring God!”
–
“Ding…”
“Milestone name”: Mouth-style Sword God!
–
“Ding…”
“Milestone name”: Eternal Joy God!
–
“…”
An announcement for all players of the upgrade game had only resounded in his memory once before, when Jiang Chenglu advanced to the Tenfold Planet.
He hadn’t thought about it since then.
The most recent time was when Chen Yi cleared the ‘Ultimate Two’ map and acquired the MAX rank ‘Sea God’ suit!
And just now!
These announcements for all players of the upgrade game had rang out eight times in succession!
Eight whole times!
The dense and deafening prompt tones nearly burst his eardrums!
“Gulp…”
The man’s body stiffened slightly as the chicken drumstick fell from his hand onto the ground, and he involuntarily swallowed saliva, his gaze stupefied and disbelieving as he stared at the eight Monuments rising gradually into the sky like a steep slope!
For the first time, he felt an unreal sensation!
This was the first time he thought Monuments in the upgrade game could be set off like fireworks!
Eight Monuments ascending all at once?
It’s over.
This time even Hou Yi can’t help.
…
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, Sword Without End, and the others exchanged bewildered glances. Just as the 8 Monuments simultaneously ascended, the entire game seemed to explode.
In one Starfield, 16 Monuments.
This was no longer unique.
It was unprecedented!
Even they felt it was a bit outrageous; the conditions for obtaining a Monument were extremely stringent, and none of the requirements were easily met.
But now, there were already 16 Monuments in the sky above the Annihilation Starfield.
It was a bit over the top.
“That…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit touched his nose with a somewhat embarrassed chuckle, “The cheat I enabled for Yi, isn’t it a bit too much? I won’t get flamed for being a cheat dog, will I?”
“What do you think?”
Sword Without End looked distractedly at the flood of system-wide announcements. For a moment, he didn’t quite know what to say. This was far from just a bit too much. Clearing nine maps, nine Monuments, those nine Monuments equated to nine Stellar Rank Titles.
With so many Title Effects, Yi would need at least ten minutes just to look them over.
“Oh, right.”
Jiaye, who had been standing to one side, suddenly seemed to think of something. Seated on Tie Chui’s arrow and lost in thought, she propped her chin with her tiny hand and looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Since you were put to sleep by Yi, why did you make him the only reserved player spot?”
“If you had the means.”
“Wouldn’t it be better to make it yourself? Then, everything Yi now has would’ve been yours, right?”
“Hey.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit laughed helplessly and shook his head, “What are you talking about? If I did that, how would I face Yi once he recovered his memory? How would I face him in the future?”
“I’d rather stand behind Yi and watch the flowers fall upon him than have all these things.”
“Alright, Yi should be back soon. Let’s think about how we’re going to celebrate later.”
…
“That… Jin Buhuan…”
In the skies above Blue Star, a member of the Snow Sea Project Team gazed blankly at the screen filled with rows of ‘S-rank Free Privileges’ and countless points. In a daze, they even called out the boss’s name directly.
“With so many privileges, it seems we can not only leave the project team but also return to being players, right?”
“I did some calculations, and it looks like we have enough to jump straight to Ninefold Planet.”
“Does it mean if we want, we could immediately become the tenth Ninefold Planet in the game?”
“Isn’t this a bit sudden… Why do I suddenly feel like ‘S-rank Free Privileges’ aren’t that valuable anymore?”
…
…
…
ps: The novel is about 50,000 to 60,000 words from ending, and I expect to finish around the 7th or 8th. On that day, I’ll release the grand finale chapter, and then I’ll write around a dozen extra chapters to wrap up some subplots and interactions of the supporting characters in the story.
Like the storyline between Li Yide and that female ghost.
Or like the events concerning Jiaye and Tie Chui before they met Chen Yi.
As well as some of the events before Sword Without End arrived in the game, these parts will not be included in the main text but in the extras. For the interested friends, you can look into it.
Finally, I must say, I updated 7,000 words daily in October, and it caused the original falling subscription rate to start climbing, even doubling…
It’s quite impressive.
But the story is almost done. Even with subscriptions doubling, I plan to conclude it. On the day of conclusion, I’ll release a new book, which will still be in the science fiction channel and will likely be a city-based martial arts game-style story.
Let’s just think of it that way for now.
Thank you for your support all this time. It has been 8 months since the book started in February. On the day it concludes, those interested in the new book can move seamlessly to it.
Based on the experience from this book, I’ve learned my lessons.
I will absolutely not again make promises to my readers about updates and then fail to deliver, as it really damages credibility and causes drops in readership. Also, from this book, I’ve learned a lot about writing methods, and I’m somewhat confident that the new book should be more interesting to read.
I hope that the ending of this book will be satisfactory to you. However, the last month of continuous daily updates of 7k words before the conclusion, along with not abandoning the story or running away, but seriously writing to the end, should at least somewhat redeem my integrity, right?
Hey, let’s get ready for the ending of Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit’s story journey.
Maybe the story is concluding, but Chen Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit’s journey hasn’t reached the end. Perhaps that’s one of the few joys of writing a novel, watching your characters grow up like a father watches his children, and then closing your eyes for the last time.

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - 692 414 You Die
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 692: Chapter 414: “You, Die! Chapter 692: Chapter 414: “You, Die! “…”
Jin Buhuan stood silently, expressionless, his gaze drifting to the rows of S-level freedom authority on the wall, his expression starting to become vacant as memories began to drift back to the past.
He vaguely remembered there was a time when they too were players of unlimited glory.
They had their own planets, their own territories.
After taking out a massive loan for player upgrades in the game and failing to elevate the level of their planet, all players of their race were thrown into hell to work as cleaners, and some top players were selected to form the Snow Sea Project Team.
They were to accompany run various planets, only to earn enough Contribution Points to restore their racial identity as players.
Live like individuals.
He remembered that it seemed like a very long time ago.
During the run of the first planet, they spent a lot of effort, but that planet was annihilated in a disaster shortly after it was upgraded to a Onefold Planet.
In the game of upgrades, being annihilated was not an uncommon scene, but it was relatively rare to be annihilated by players, especially by a single player.
For instance, the oddity that emerged from the sea of Blue Star, if it weren’t for Chen Yi, Blue Star might also have been annihilated in this sudden catastrophe.
After that.
They ran for one planet after another, but hardly any of the planets prospered; from the initial enthusiasm to gradual numbness and even selective ignorance of their clansmen still toiling as cleaners in hell.
So be it, it’s not bad to barely make a living as a project team member, at least they didn’t have to clean up a large amount of corpses and trash as cleaners.
Not until they encountered Blue Star.
From the moment Chen Yi secured the first monument of the upgrade game for the Snow Sea Project Team and obtained S-level freedom authority, they celebrated wildly all night, everyone screaming excitedly.
Waking up from numbness.
Everyone realized something, Chen Yi’s presence might actually help them successfully revert to player status and revive their race!
Until Chen Yi secured one monument after another, the number of S-level freedom authorities belonging to the Scholar Sea Project Team kept increasing, and a few times they granted Chen Yi the use of those S-level freedom authorities.
Finally…
The points of the Snow Sea Project Team were now sufficient for them to revive their race, bring their clansmen back from hell, regain their player status, and promote to a Ninefold Planet.
It could be said they reached the highest level of planets in the game of upgrades in an instant.
It sounds simple, much simpler than the process of planets constantly upgrading from Onefold to Ninefold.
But if you think about it, the difficulty of the project team getting more than a dozen S-level freedom authorities on their account doesn’t seem so surprising after all; this isn’t some exclusive upgrade path.
Other project teams can do exactly the same thing. It’s very simple, as long as the novice players you accompany get more than a dozen monuments of the upgrade game.
Oh right.
This S-level freedom authority is only rewarded to the Snow Sea Project Team, not to the Annihilation Starfield Project Team, which means that only when a player from below a Threefold Planet secures an upgrade game monument will the corresponding project team receive an S-level freedom authority once.
This difficulty…
Is enough for other project teams to instantly give up on this idea.
“Boss, so are we now going to promote to the Ninefold Planet?”
The words from a colleague beside him awakened Jin Buhuan from his memories, his eyes slightly moist.
“Huff!”
Jin Buhuan took a deep breath, chuckled, and shook his head as he said, “Not for now. Our clansmen and comrades have endured for so long; a little longer won’t hurt.”
“Chen Yi and the others are getting ready to force all Ninefold Planets into compulsory promotions to Tenfold Planets to go out and support Jiang Chenglu in the war.”
“If we promote to the Ninefold Planet now, wouldn’t we be putting ourselves directly in harm’s way? Even if we promoted to a Ninefold Planet, we would be the weakest among them. We would have the planet’s level, but the players’ foundation and strength wouldn’t be up to par; going out would be suicide.”
“Even if Chen Yi considered our circumstances, if he made an exception just for us, it would be difficult for him to satisfy everyone. The other Ninefold Planets would inevitably hold a grudge against Chen Yi.”
“The most important point—”
“If we go, who will accompany Chen Yi?”
Jin Buhuan lightly patted his confidant’s shoulder and said softly, “I know you are heartbroken for the suffering our clansmen are enduring in hell and want to bring them back soon, but remember one thing—we must accompany Blue Star to the very end.”
“That way we can ensure we never have to go back to that place.”
“Go on now.”
“Take the brothers and have a celebration.”
…
Meanwhile.
Chen Yi had just returned from the last “Ultimate Nine” map.
“Yi!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit approached with shining eyes, “How about these nine Godslaying Suits? Are they powerful?”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit,”
Chen Yi’s expression was complex as he frowned and looked at the panel only he could see, paused for a long while before he finally spoke, “Tuberculosis Rabbit, I remember you said, these nine Godslaying Suits were originally for nine designated players, but you tinkered with it to make them all mine, right?”
“Yeah, what’s up?”
“Besides that, did you do anything else?”
“Uh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was startled, his heart skipped a beat, and his gaze darted nervously, “There shouldn’t be anything else. If there are other issues, it might be a bug in the upgrade game, right? After all, such a huge thing has been running for so many years, it’s logical for some bugs to occur, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 693 - 693 414 You Die_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 693: Chapter 414: “You, Die!”_2 Chapter 693: Chapter 414: “You, Die!”_2 He remembered that he seemed to have added something.
But his memory hadn’t completely recovered, and he was a bit unclear on the details.
Surely he hadn’t really sneaked something in, had he?
Could it be that he had plotted against Yi before falling into slumber?
No, that’s impossible. Even though he didn’t have this part of his memory, he was certain that he would never have had such a thought—it wasn’t in his character at all.
Even Sword Without End, standing to the side, was somewhat flabbergasted. What if Tuberculosis Rabbit turned out to be the biggest villain in the end? Then what would he do? As someone who had always been playing with Tuberculosis Rabbit, he couldn’t let Yi take him down as well, could he?
That would be too unjust a death.
After a long silence, Chen Yi didn’t say anything but slowly shared a panel in mid-air.
‘Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for successfully activating the nine sets of the Godslaying Suit, now activating the ultimate quest!’
‘Quest name’: Unify the World Under One!
‘Quest objective’: Find Tuberculosis Rabbit, and sincerely say to him, “Tuberculosis Rabbit, knowing you is my, Chen Yi’s, honor.”
‘Quest reward’: The nine sets of the Godslaying Suit will merge into one, transforming into a higher-tier, more powerful Ultimate Godslayer Set.
…
“…”
Watching the panel shared by Yi, Sword Without End’s initial worried expression gradually became peculiar as he glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit beside him, sizing him up.
This kid always addressed Yi as brother, the picture of loyalty.
But in reality, there was a rebellious streak.
He even wanted Yi to call him ‘brother’, and to add ‘Tuberculosis Rabbit’ no less; that took some nerve.
“Uh…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was so embarrassed by now he wished he could bury his head in the ground. He had no memory of this at all and didn’t know what he had been thinking at the time to come up with something like this.
Right now, he just wanted to die.
“That… Yi, actually, this must be the Spokesperson of the Gods tampering with our game to stir up discord between us. These villains really are…”
Before Tuberculosis Rabbit could finish speaking.
He saw Chen Yi calmly look towards him and softly said.
“Tuberculosis Rabbit, knowing you is my, Chen Yi’s, honor.”
“Ah…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit froze in place, scratching the back of his head with unease: “That… Yi, you’ve completed the quest, so don’t keep looking at me like that, it makes me nervous. How about we go for barbecue instead?”
“I’m serious.”
After a brief pause, Chen Yi then turned to Sword Without End and the others and softly said, “Sword Without End, Jiaye, Tie Chui.”
“Knowing you guys is my, Chen Yi’s, honor.”
“You make me feel that I’m not alone.”
Sword Without End and the others were momentarily stunned, somewhat unaccustomed to Chen Yi’s sudden sentimentality, and it felt strange, as if they were about to march into brutal warfare.
For a moment, they didn’t know how to respond.
They just opened and closed their mouths slightly.
Only Jiaye’s eyes showed a hint of tears as he sat on Tie Chui’s shoulder, looking towards Chen Yi. His clean and delicate little feet dangled in the air, the corners of his mouth gently rising,
“Alright, let’s not talk about this now. Get ready; let’s talk to those Ninefold planetary players.”
Chen Yi suddenly laughed, looking at the new panel that had popped up in front of him.
‘Ding, congratulations to player Chen Yi for completing the ultimate quest. The nine sets of the Godslaying Suit have fused into the Ultimate Godslayer Set.’
‘Set Name’: Ninety-Nine Unified (Ultimate Edition).
‘Set Level’: MAX (The unique suit in the entire game).
‘Set Effects’:
1: Health limit increased by 100 billion, backpack space unlimited, personal skill page embedment quantity unlimited.
x:…
6: Any props, skills, titles that require preset conditions to trigger can be used disregarding such conditions, and all props on the body will be enhanced to Ultimate Edition, including MAX level.
x:…
11: All props, titles, and skills can be used on cooldown at will, and disregarding the number of uses.
x…
17: All props, skills, titles will be promoted to MAX level and will be enhanced to Ultimate Edition.
x:…
21: Ignore any control effects of MAX level and below, including Dizziness, Illusory Realm, Fatigue, Poisoning, etc.
x:…
27:…
‘Set Introduction’: The crafting of each Godslaying Suit consumed the Divine Power of at least three deities. This suit, a product of the merger of nine Godslaying Suits, contains the Divine Power of at least 27 deities.
We hope you can use the power of the suit to subjugate all deities.
And leave a clear and orderly world for posterity.
“…”
Chen Yi looked at the panel of the suit from the past, smiling without a word. With a total of 27 set effects, each effect on its own could almost be deemed invincible, and now they were all concentrated on him.
It could be said.
With this thing, slaying those two deities of the White Phoenix Clan would be countless times easier.
The simplest method of slaying would be to use the set effects “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” and “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea” to execute “Ascend to the Heavens in One Step” hundreds of times in an instant.
There’s no need to aim; the mere shockwaves would be enough to quell both deities.
Especially when the set effects require no preconditions, ignore consumption, and have no cooldown time.
It means that his originally costly Finishing Move has become a Basic Attack that can be used infinitely at will.
This state against the players of the Ninefold planetary systems is honestly a bit of bullying.

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - 694 414 You Die_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 694: Chapter 414: “You, Die!”_3 Chapter 694: Chapter 414: “You, Die!”_3 It was like when you started playing as Ashe online, ready to painstakingly farm for creeps, and suddenly found out the enemy Jinx was already level 18 with a full god-tier gear, hurling a nuclear bomb with every Basic Attack.
Ultimate Move as Basic Attack.
If it was just that, it would have been fine. It’s just high attack with low imitation, right? Maybe there would even be a chance to catch the enemy off guard and take them out.
But when you see a few unlimited Ultimate Move users like Gem, Angel, and Healer standing behind the enemy Jinx…
You’d completely despair.
At this moment, Chen Yi was in that exact state. One could say it was an instant Ascend to the Heavens in One Step. If before he was unrivaled on a Low-Grade Planet, now he was rampaging across the entire game world where one could upgrade their planet’s status!
Unstoppable!
…
Five Chieftains Starfield.
Chen Yi was hovering in midair, looking down at the brown land below, and after checking his status panel to confirm he wasn’t in the wrong place, he spoke out, “This is the Five Chieftains Starfield, right?”
“The Kui Race on a Ninefold Planet is here?”
“Does my map show that there’s only one planet with the Kui Race on this Starfield? I haven’t got it wrong, have I?”
He had arrived at the Five Chieftains Starfield, ready to kill to establish his dominance.
Naturally, the other Ninefold Planets probably didn’t know whom he was going to dominate since Chen Yi hadn’t actually told them about his plans to advance them to a Tenfold Planet.
But Chen Yi didn’t plan to talk about it now. He was too lazy to persuade others and even lazier to debate with anyone.
He just needed to show the other Ninefold Planets that he had the power to slaughter a Ninefold Planet, and then when it was time to negotiate, the whole process would be much smoother.
“It should be correct,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, standing behind Chen Yi with a serious expression, nodded seriously, “I’ve checked. There were other planets in this Starfield originally, but the Kui Race has grown too fast. Gradually, they’ve eroded or expelled the other planets.”
“Got it.”
Chen Yi nodded, about to take action, when a piercing voice came from nearby.
“Chen Yi!”
He looked towards the source of the voice.
He saw an old man standing with a few men by his side at some point, looking at him expressionlessly, “This is the Five Chieftains Starfield, the territory of the Kui Race. May I ask what brings Chen Yi, a player still in the Novice Period, to the territory of a Ninefold Planet?”
Chen Yi?
That’s hot lately, he knew.
But he had only just found out about it today even though Chen Yi had been famous for a while now. The celebrity from a Low-Grade Planet didn’t catch his attention before, but today, after passing through nine ultimate maps in succession and obtaining nine Monument rewards from the leveling game, he became fully aware of this young man.
A man still in the Novice Period.
He knew about the ultimate maps. Succeeding in an ultimate map brought incredibly rich rewards. Yet for many years, no one managed to clear an ultimate map, and those few lucky enough to survive the ordeal mostly came out mentally broken, constantly mumbling about being imprisoned for a long time, that it was a trap, and so on.
They didn’t bring back much useful information.
Their Deities had told them many times to find a way to clear the ultimate maps, and naturally, they took it very seriously. But after many years of failure, they didn’t expect that an obscure young man would clear them all today.
With that thought…
The old man’s eyes gradually narrowed, his eyes filled with greed that he could barely contain from spilling out.
The moment Chen Yi stepped into the Starfield, he had received the message. After all, Chen Yi came through a Starfield Shuttle, which was too conspicuous. He immediately informed the Sunflower Sovereign and shared his thoughts with the Sunflower Sovereign.
Although they were unable to clear the ultimate maps, it didn’t matter because there was someone right in front of them who had. As long as they captured him alive and tortured him, this young man would eventually hand over the rewards he got from the ultimate maps.
Now, a vast number of elite Kui Race players and their army were rushing towards this place. He was the closest, arriving first to hold Chen Yi back to prevent him from escaping and wasting their time.
…
“Mm.”
Chen Yi casually glanced at the few people in front of him without replying.
He was a soft-hearted person. Speaking too much with the person in front of him would make it hard for him to kill them afterward; how did that saying go? “A gentleman stays away from the kitchen.”
The idea is that a gentleman can eat meat but can’t bear to see the meat being butchered, or else he would become softhearted and lose his appetite.
That was his way.
He could kill a person, but he couldn’t talk to them too much, or he’d become softhearted.
Anyway, what a bunch of nonsense. While Chen Yi was rambling in his mind, he casually waved his hand in the air.
“Thump!”
An invisible ripple emanated from Chen Yi as the center, instantly covering the entire Starfield Continent.
The Kui Race players who had been floating in mid-air just a moment ago thumped to the ground, their faces deathly pale, unable to fly again no matter how hard they tried.
‘Set Effects 16’: Activate this set effect, and all entities except for those selected by player Chen Yi will be forcibly grounded.
Still want to fly?
Guess it’s time to sit down.
And at that moment—
An immense swarm of players was already rushing over from the ground.
Chen Yi just gave them a casual glance and then didn’t care anymore. He waved his hand again, and this time, a translucent white dome enveloped him and Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - 695 414 You Die_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 695: Chapter 414: “You, Die!”_4 Chapter 695: Chapter 414: “You, Die!”_4 “Set Effect Eighteen”: Activate this set effect to summon an impenetrable protective light barrier. As long as the player Chen Yi remains alive, this light barrier will absolutely not shatter.
And how could he possibly die?
Setting aside the fact that his Life Value has already broken through the skies, his Life Value is now shared with the Galaxy. Unless the universe perishes, he will not perish, which essentially means this light barrier is invincible, and players within it will never die.
…
“Um…”
Sword Without End, standing behind Chen Yi, looked bewilderingly at Tuberculosis Rabbit: “Tuberculosis Rabbit, if we had such powerful stuff before, how could we ever lose?”
He didn’t understand. This thing was more nuclear than nuclear weapons themselves; how could it possibly lose? Even deities would be crushed along its path.
“Well, I didn’t expect…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit also mumbled some bewildered words: “Resources were shared before, including the deities we captured. When we extracted their Divine Power, it was equally divided among us. Although it was powerful, it wasn’t this exaggerated. I didn’t know that concentrating all our resources could create such a monstrous set of equipment.”
“If I’d known it was this simple, anyone who shared resources in the last life was an idiot.”
…
Chen Yi exhaled softly, glanced at the ever-growing armies on the ground, and again waved his hand gently.
In an instant.
Every Prop and Skill, including his titles, in his inventory were activated simultaneously. He didn’t even need to activate the Wife-Killing Buff now; he could use Props and Skills with no cooldown restrictions. He was now thoroughly and completely in his ultimate form.
The next second—
The sky darkened.
Above, the view was obscured by countless Buddhas presenting a truly astonishing sight!
“Prop Name”: Buddha’s Fury (Ultimate Edition)
“Prop Level”: MAX!
This was one of his frequently used Props. Upon activation, a Buddha holding a Gatling gun would appear, seated cross-legged on the Lotus Platform fighting for him, but with the “Ninety-Nine Unified” Set Effects enhancing it, this Prop’s level had advanced to MAX level.
And it was the Ultimate Edition.
The most direct result was that.
The Buddha’s form grew tenfold in size, radiating golden light, and even the Lotus Platform under his bum increased in size correspondingly, turning into a disk of overwhelming firepower, with numerous gun barrels as thick as a dozen roadside power poles extending from it.
There were probably dozens of gun barrels on one Lotus Platform.
The Buddha no longer held the Gatling gun but began to bring his hands together and prayed softly.
The moment he appeared,
The Lotus Platform began to spin at high speed, and soon after, those incredibly thick gun barrels roared non-stop, firing missiles that nearly shattered the heavens and earth, raining down on the ground in endless barrages!
It had become a flying aircraft carrier in the sky.
The rate of fire was not inferior to the defensive guns on an actual aircraft carrier, and the caliber was much larger.
Most importantly, it wasn’t just one or two of these things, but hundreds of thousands!
A swarming multitude that blocked out all the sunlight, turning day to pitch-black in an instant.
Since ancient times, air-to-ground has been a crushing presence.
Especially when the air force stops counting the cost and roars without concern for ammunition, anything on land must retreat a great distance!
Then—
