Accompanied by the simultaneous spinning and roaring of the hundreds of thousands of MAX-level Ultimate Edition Buddha Platforms underneath the Buddhas!
Daylight returned.
Brighter than before.
The dazzling firelight had the world relearn how the word “light” should be written.
They couldn’t even see the hills in the distance, the enemies below, the skyline on the horizon, or the Buddhas radiating golden light.
Nothing but light filled their vision.
Only countless heavy missiles, roaring with orange-red flames and howling, formed lines as they smashed into the ground.
…
Such a close-up view left Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others behind him with their mouths gaping in stunned silence.
Wasn’t this firepower a bit too fierce?
Before the ascension game came upon Blue Star, with this thing, all living forces on the planet could be completely covered within an hour.
Yes, all living forces.
Let alone hiding hundreds of meters deep underground in concrete bunkers.
The missiles here weren’t your ordinary ground-piercing missiles; just randomly picking one, it was taller than a person, and with this frequency of strikes, hiding anywhere would make you the most accurate target, with hundreds of these things exploding right above your head every second.
Even if you were hiding deep underground in a bunker, you would still be gone in this barrage.
This thing’s power was many times greater than that of a nuclear bomb, which mainly explodes in the air and doesn’t have a massive explosive force. It’s the slow death by nuclear radiation that renders a city lifeless for decades.
But this thing has none of that messy stuff; it’s just pure explosion, the kind that blasts right in your face.
Just two words.
You’re dead!
…
However, this was just one of Chen Yi’s means of attack, but soon he found he didn’t need to use any other methods, because they were simply unnecessary.
“Eh?”
Just at that moment.
Chen Yi suddenly noticed that there was still a group of people on the ground, struggling to survive under a pink shield amidst the waterfall of missiles, looking like they temporarily weren’t dying. He was rather surprised—what kind of prop did they possess to survive such an intense barrage?
If it weren’t for his special prop allowing him to see through the missile waterfall to the players on the ground, he wouldn’t even have known there were players still alive.
But it didn’t matter.
He clicked his tongue, then activated the set effects of “Longevity as the Southern Mountains” and “Fortune as Vast as the Eastern Sea,” and Ascend to the Heavens in One Step.
-Only countless heavy missiles, roaring with orange-red flames and howling, formed lines as they smashed into the ground.
…

Chen Yi suddenly noticed that there was still a group of people on the ground, struggling to survive under a pink shield amidst the waterfall of missiles, looking like they temporarily weren’t dying. He was rather surprised—what kind of prop did they possess to survive such an intense barrage?

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - 696 415 On This Day All Immortals Ascend to
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 696: Chapter 415: On This Day, All Immortals Ascend to Heaven! Chapter 696: Chapter 415: On This Day, All Immortals Ascend to Heaven! This sudden war didn’t draw much attention from most people.
In the absence of announcements or live broadcasts,
the majority of players were unaware of what was happening to the “Kui Race” of Ninefold Planet, let alone the exceptionally inhumane slaughter they were undergoing.
Not to mention knowing about this situation.
In fact, a significant portion of players had never even heard of the “Kui Race,” nor did they know that this race was from a Ninefold Planet. It was quite normal for any randomly picked player not to know which were the Ninefold Planets.
After all, it was too remote.
So distant that it was beyond their comprehension, utterly unapproachable for them.
But after all, there were still those who could respond to the situation.
Almost the instant the war began,
leaders of the other Ninefold Planets got the message straight away. Upon seeing the “Kui Race” being beaten without any means of resistance, they almost immediately tried to add Chen Yi as a friend through various channels.
But to no avail—
Chen Yi didn’t accept these people’s friend requests at all.
But that couldn’t stump the Ninefold Planets. In the game of leveling up, there were too many ways to convey a message, like using announcement horns. They didn’t want to make a big fuss, preferring to sort things out privately as much as possible; after all, making the situation public would damage the dignity of their Ninefold Planets, and in future discussions, they would only serve as a backdrop to Chen Yi.
It didn’t take long.
Within the chat group of “Club 33,”
“Elder Qian”: Yi, the leader of the Sunflower Star of Ninefold Planet asked me to pass a message to you: “Chen Yi, what exactly do you want by waging war on a Ninefold Planet without any cause? Do you understand what this signifies?”
“Elder Qian”: Also, Yi, I’m just the messenger here. The leader of Sunflower Star personally came to me, and I didn’t dare refuse. Whatever happens has nothing to do with me, alright? Please don’t hold a grudge against me, we’re on the same side.
…
Elder Qian.
The founder of Club 33, and the only player from Sixfold Planet in the chat group.
The Club 33 he created gained recognition in the leveling up game and was included as one of the rewards for the Monument achievement. With such capability, he was no small figure. Wherever he went, who wouldn’t give him some respect?
But this time…
He really didn’t want to deliver this message.
But he had no choice; when the leader of the Sunflower Star of Ninefold Planet came to him, he dared not refuse. He couldn’t afford to offend the Ninefold Planets or Chen Yi. Luckily, it was just a small matter of passing a message. If it had been something more severe, he would have definitely had to turn down this Ninefold Planet.
Offending the Ninefold Planets meant at worst his own death.
But to offend Chen Yi would mean the annihilation of his entire race.
Although he seldom spoke in the group, he understood Chen Yi’s modus operandi very well.
At this moment, aside from Elder Qian, no one else in the group said a word. To be exact, since Chen Yi’s power had grown stronger and his reputation more prominent, the group had fallen silent.
They started another smaller group.
And chatted in that group instead.
It wasn’t so much about excluding Chen Yi, but rather the huge disparity in their statuses made them too intimidated to speak in front of him.
Now, in this smaller group “Club 33 Subgroup,” messages were flooding the chat.
“Li Yi”: “Elder Qian, have you gone mad? You can’t tell which is more serious, your death or your entire race’s?”
“Wang Qi”: “Exactly. Elder Qian, if I were you, I wouldn’t pass on the message. Just firmly stand by Yi’s side. Even if that Ninefold Planet wants to mess with you, Yi wouldn’t just watch and do nothing. Besides, the fact that the Ninefold Planets are attempting to communicate with Chen Yi this way at least indicates that the Ninefold Planet that got attacked by Chen Yi isn’t in a good situation. They probably can’t do anything about Yi and are likely suffering losses.”
“Elder Qian”: “You bunch just love to make snide remarks. Who wants to die? Just passing a message shouldn’t offend Yi, right?”
“Elder Qian”: “Besides, if a player from a Ninefold Planet wants to harm me, how could Yi protect me? There are too many ways for a player from Ninefold Planet to kill.”
“Wang Qi”: “Isn’t it simple? Yi could just wipe out the Ninefold Planet going after you, couldn’t he?”
“Elder Qian”: “Are you joking? Yi’s strong, alright, but how could he possibly exterminate a whole Ninefold Planet? The Ninefold Planets are the peak forces in the leveling up game.”
…
At this very moment, Chen Yi, who was leisurely carrying out a bombing run over the snowfields of the “Five Chieftains” Starfield, noticed Elder Qian’s message in the “Club 33” chat group, glanced at it casually, and then disregarded it.
What a mess.
Talking about it now is pointless. He couldn’t be bothered to communicate with these people. Later, once the “Kui Race” was exterminated, they would understand everything.
Talking about it now was utterly meaningless.
The “Kui Race” had no chance of resisting him anyways. With his invincible suit activated, Chen Yi was like a War God leveling everything in his path. The extermination of the race was almost an inevitable outcome—the real consideration was just the speed of extermination.
There was only one factor determining the speed of extermination: the top speed of the snow sled.
Fortunately, a speed of less than 100 mach was still considered usable.
Not too slow.
But soon, the chat in Club 33 began to light up again, and the leaders of other Ninefold Planets became even more persistent in sending him friend requests, including the leader of the “Kui Race” planet, who kept trying to add him as a friend.

chapters.title: Chapter 697 - 697 415 On This Day All Immortals Ascend_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 697: Chapter 415: On This Day, All Immortals Ascend!_2 Chapter 697: Chapter 415: On This Day, All Immortals Ascend!_2 It was evident that these people seemed to have a lot to say.
They were the type with a strong desire to pour out their hearts.
“Elder Qian”:”That Yi, the leader of the Ninefold Planet ‘Rapeseed Star’ asked me to convey this to you—’Chen Yi, your unwarranted declaration of war against a Ninefold Planet is causing panic among everyone. Please, stop your current actions immediately. We can sit down and talk things over slowly. Whatever the outcome, we promise to ensure a satisfactory response from the ‘Kui Race’ to you, Chen Yi.'”
“Elder Qian”:”Yi, the following message is from the Ninefold Planet ‘AR Star’—’Mr. Chen Yi, I must clarify to you that your unbridled warfare greatly risks prompting the remaining eight Ninefold Planets to join forces and expel you from the Five Chieftains Starfield. That would make us all lose face.'”
Chen Yi glanced at the message, ignored it, and continued what he was doing.
Soon, three hours had passed.
The 33 Club chat group began to flash again.
“Elder Qian”:”Yi, I have another message from the Ninefold Planet ‘Sunflower Star’—’Is that so, Yi? We all understand your style, but the least you could do is tell us your reason for declaring war on the ‘Kui Race,’ right? At least tell us if the ‘Kui Race’ players offended you, or if they once pursued you or something. At least give us a reason, please.'”
“Elder Qian”:”This message is also from AR Star—’Yeah, Yi, we all just want to get to the bottom of this; mainly, we’re now worried that you intend to purge all Ninefold Planets. If you could just elaborate on the grudge between you and the ‘Kui Race,’ we’ll disappear right away.'”
It was obvious.
The leaders of these Ninefold Planets had softened considerably and didn’t seem like the individuals with control over the largest forces in the game of ascension; they looked more like contractors who continually bowed and toasted, waiting for government construction assignments.
They were so humble, appearing ready to step down the moment they were offered an out, which was somewhat amusing and pitiful.
…
Meanwhile, in the Awesome Starfield.
Li Yi and Wang Qi, who were idly watching the group chat, exchanged glances, looking at each other in silence without a word, both deep in thought.
“That…”
Li Yi was the first to break the awkward silence, incredulously saying with some difficulty, “Has Yi’s strength become so exaggerated? These are Ninefold Planets, and they’ve already started calling him ‘brother’?!”
“Phew!”
Wang Qi took a deep breath, suppressing the shock in his heart before he said vaguely, “It’s only been three hours, and the leaders of these Ninefold Planets have drastically changed their tune. They went from veiled threats at the beginning to practically giving themselves a way out; they’re all calling him Yi now.”
“Something must have happened in these three hours, something that frightened all the Ninefold Planets.”
“Think about it, Yi is currently engaged in battle with the ‘Kui Race’ in the Five Chieftains Starfield, so it’s certain that Yi must have caused heavy casualties within the Kui Race, inflicting severe losses, which is why these other Ninefold Planet players started to fear Yi’s power, thus gradually softening their tone.”
“And maybe…”
“Could Yi actually wipe out the Kui Race?”
“He couldn’t, could he?” Li Yi’s voice trembled slightly: “But that’s a Ninefold Planet?!”
“Can’t say for sure.”
…
Another three or four hours passed.
Chen Yi’s ears were filled only with the sounds of relentless gunfire and the nearly incessant notifications, all of them alerts of his suit shielding him from various curses, attacks, control, tracking, and other negative effects, none of which affected him.
Finally.
After the last city was mercilessly engulfed by firepower,
An announcement resounded in all players’ ears.
‘Ding, public announcement for all players of the Ascension Game!’
‘Congratulations to Chen Yi of Zerofold Planet, Star System 3, Annihilation Starfield, for successfully exterminating the Ninefold Planet ‘Kui Race’ during the Novice Period!!!’
‘He is the first player in Ascension Game history to slay a Ninefold Planet during the Novice Period!’
‘Unprecedented, with no one before and no one to come after!’
‘Absolutely shocking!’
‘This action has stunned countless players and has been selected for inclusion in the Ascension Game chronicle, permanently leaving his name and mark in the game, and a statue representing this event will be erected in the Ascension Game Hall of Honor.’
‘And he has achieved a milestone in the Ascension Game!’
‘Milestone name: Mortal Slaying the Heavens!’
‘…’
–
In the skies above Annihilation Starfield, the 17th monument in memory of the Ascension Game belonging to Annihilation Starfield slowly rose, countless players looked up at this groundbreaking moment, and it felt as though they witnessed a great deal.
A child, just learning to speak, lay in his mother’s arms, innocently sucking his finger and muttered.
“Mommy, why are stars always flying up into the sky?”
“Because the sky is changing.”
With this event securing a monumental milestone in the Ascension Game, there was no doubt.
A novice player, not even past the Novice Period, had exterminated a Ninefold Planet.
How was it done?
No one knew.
But one thing was clear to everyone: if anyone had previously doubted Chen Yi’s killing of the Ninefold Planet player Jiang Chenglu could have been an insider’s job, or merely a coincidence, then after this extermination of a Ninefold Planet, there could be no more questions.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - 698 415 On This Day All Immortals Ascend_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 698: Chapter 415: On This Day, All Immortals Ascend!_3 Chapter 698: Chapter 415: On This Day, All Immortals Ascend!_3 From now on, Chen Yi will be the undisputed number one combat force in the advancement game.
…
“This…”
Li Yi, hearing the announcement beside his ear, found the happy tea he had just bought in God Yi Mall losing its appeal, his voice sharp with panic, “The Kui Race has been exterminated???”
“A whole Ninefold planet, just like that, gone??”
“Holy sh*t!!”
He didn’t know what to say anymore.
He knew Yi was strong, and he had never doubted that, but for a player from the Novice Period to exterminate a Ninefold planet seemed way too unreasonable, didn’t it? No matter from which angle, it didn’t seem to make any sense.
Not to mention, the privileges, activities, and resources that a Novice Planet and a Ninefold planet have are many times different.
A player from a Novice Planet killing a player from a Ninefold planet could still be forcibly explained from multiple angles.
But if a player from a Novice Planet exterminated a clan from a Ninefold planet.
There was only one answer.
This dude’s cheating.
Suddenly, he remembered the series of announcements to all players in the advancement game, stating that Yi had cleared all the maps from Ultimate One to Ultimate Nine. He was flabbergasted when he first received that message.
He hadn’t even found the chance to congratulate Yi when he received the announcement of the Ninefold planet’s extermination.
Could it be the power of the nine Ultimate Suits rewarded for clearing those nine maps?
…
Almost the instant the announcement sounded,
the “33 Club chat group” started blinking crazily again.
“Elder Qian”: “The leader of ‘Sunflower Star’ from a Ninefold planet has a report for you, Yi—’Thank you, Yi, for helping us eradicate the Kui Race on the Ninefold planet. That race was utterly despicable, and we have disliked them for a long time. With Yi’s help in eliminating this great enemy today, we will soon deliver a rich reward!'”
“Elder Qian”: “This is a message from ‘AR’ planet from the Ninefold—’Yi, you must have a vendetta against the Kui Race, right? Now that you’ve exterminated them, you won’t attack us anymore, right? We have no grudge against you, Yi, and we even cheered you on just now.'”
In the chat group,
other Ninefold planet leaders kept relaying messages through Elder Qian—it was their only way to communicate with Chen Yi.
At this moment, all leaders of the Ninefold planets were desperately trying to ascertain one thing: what was the conflict between Chen Yi and the Kui Race!
Being from the Ninefold planet themselves, gathering intelligence on one another was a necessary task. Based on their understanding of the Kui Race, they shouldn’t have any grievances with Chen Yi. After all, how could a Ninefold planet have any conflict with a Novice Planet?
That was an improbable event.
Yet without any grudges, why would Chen Yi mobilize such a targeted and ferocious attack on the Five Chieftains’ Starfield? It was irrational. According to their information on Chen Yi, although he was ruthless, at least every attack he made was justified; he wouldn’t massacre without a reason.
The only speculation was,
when Jiang Chenglu was promoted to the Tenfold planet and left, one Ninefold planet had symbolically sent someone to approach Chen Yi. They weren’t clear on which Ninefold planet it was and did not investigate further.
After all, they were all well aware that if they wanted to be promoted to the Tenfold planet, it could be done easily at any time. They postponed because they didn’t want to face the deadly battles that came with such a promotion. However, to account for their fellow players, they had to perform symbolic gestures.
Such actions were not convenient to be widely known.
Finally—
Perhaps it was the genuineness of these Ninefold planet leaders that moved Chen Yi. Having not spoken in the 33 Club chat group the whole time, Chen Yi finally sent a message.
“Chen Yi”: “Tell the other Ninefold planets that they have one hour to advance to Tenfold. After one hour, those who haven’t advanced to Tenfold will be exterminated.”
As this message reached the minds of the remaining eight Ninefold planet leaders,
the group suddenly fell silent.
And those eight Ninefold planet leaders also fell into silence in unison.
…
“Is Yi getting a bit too overconfident?”
A trace of concern flashed in Li Yi’s eyes, “Isn’t this blatantly forcing the remaining eight Ninefold planets to gang up on Yi?”
Yi’s words had nearly left these Ninefold planets with no way out.
To stay alive, these Ninefold planets had no other option but to unite against Yi.
Yi was backing himself into a corner.
Although Yi had just eliminated one Ninefold planet, fully proving his strength, the issue was that exterminating one Ninefold planet and facing eight united Ninefold planets were completely different concepts.
It was a world of difference!
It’s like a regular person might have fought off a hungry wolf barehanded, but when facing eight desperate hungry wolves fighting for their lives, success wasn’t guaranteed, and he would likely meet his end.
…
Meanwhile, in a certain chat channel of the advancement game,
eight glowing avatars gathered in this channel, each representing one of the eight Ninefold planets.
This was the first time they had appeared together in a small group.
Gathering in a small group was previously unthinkable since they were not on good terms.
However, this time was different; there was a formidable enemy.
Yes, a formidable enemy.
Finally, after a long silence, one avatar took the lead and spoke, “Shall we join forces and give it a try? We should…”

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 699 415 On This Day All Immortals Ascend_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 699: Chapter 415: On This Day, All Immortals Ascend!_4 Chapter 699: Chapter 415: On This Day, All Immortals Ascend!_4 The speaker didn’t finish the sentence, clearly not very confident in his own suggestion.
Afterward, another long silence followed.
They had just witnessed, from start to finish, how Chen Yi had annihilated the Kui Race. It was not the kind of fight where attacks went back and forth; it was a one-sided slaughter.
There was no ability to resist whatsoever.
Chen Yi was like a plow through a field; after he had methodically swept through the Five Chieftains Starfield, the Kui Race was exterminated just like that.
From beginning to end, no matter what kind of territory the Kui Race brought out, Chen Yi didn’t even get hurt, let alone slow down. To be honest, to Chen Yi, there wasn’t much difference between one Ninefold Planet and eight Ninefold Planets.
The only difference might be that killing eight Ninefold Planets would be a bit more troublesome.
“…”
Finally, after a long time, an avatar took the initiative to speak, “Forget it, I’ll go out first. Facing Chen Yi means certain death, at least if I go out there’s a chance of survival.”
“You guys take your time thinking, I’m off.”
“It’s been a while since I’ve seen Jiang Chenglu, I don’t even know if he’s still alive. I’m going out to have a drink with him.”
The next second——
An announcement rang in the ears of all players in the advancement game!
‘Ding, announcement to all players in the advancement game!!!’
‘Let us congratulate, under the leadership of player Wang Fei, the Ninefold Planet Sunflower Star in the Sunflower Starfield, Sector 6, for successfully advancing to become the second Tenfold Planet in the advancement game!!!’
‘This is the greatest feat in the history of the advancement game.’
‘Rewarding player Wang Fei…’
‘And all players of Sunflower Star, under the leadership of Wang Fei, will leave the advancement game and go to the depths of the universe to participate in the “Life and Death Match”!’
‘Let us congratulate Wang Fei for his triumphant return!!!’
The moment this announcement sounded,
the small chat group with only seven members fell into silence again, followed by several messages popping up.
“Forget it, I’ll go out too. You guys shouldn’t think about anything else. Anyone who has watched the whole process of the battle knows that it’s a slaughter without any ability to fight back. Staying here is waiting for death.”
“Let’s go out. It should be safer if we all do. Once outside, let’s put aside the grievances from the advancement game for now and train together. At least if we all survive, we will then have the right to settle old scores.”
“Yeah, that makes sense. Once we’re out, we all need to help each other.”
“It’s not that dangerous. Since Chen Yi has been forcing us to promote to Tenfold Planets, it means he knows a lot of inside information. Maybe Jiang Chenglu has a good relationship with him and found a way to tell Chen Yi about the unfavorable conditions outside, prompting Chen Yi to force us to promote and provide support to Jiang Chenglu.”
“But was it necessary to threaten us with the extinction of a race? Isn’t that a bit too radical?”
“If it wasn’t for that, would you choose to advance when you saw Chen Yi’s message?”
“That’s true…”
“Alright, don’t worry too much. As far as I know, Chen Yi’s Novice Period is going to end in a month or two. Since Chen Yi and Jiang Chenglu seem to be on good terms, Chen Yi will surely promote to a Tenfold Planet as soon as possible to assist Jiang Chenglu. You’ve seen Chen Yi’s strength; as long as he comes out, who can stop him?”
“So are you saying we just need to hold off the enemies outside and wait for Chen Yi to come out successfully?”
“That’s the idea.”
“Phew, you’ve reassured me quite a bit with that. It doesn’t seem too dangerous.”
“Enough talk, let’s hurry up and get out.”
…
Immediately following,
several announcements rang out in the ears of all the players in the Upgrade Game.
“Ding, announcement to all players of the Upgrade Game!!!”
“Let us congratulate, AR Planet for being promoted to Tenfold Planet…”
“Let us congratulate, Rapeseed Planet for being promoted to Tenfold Planet…”
“Let us congratulate, Pavilion External Planet for being promoted to Tenfold Planet…”
For a moment—
News of countless Ninefold Planets being promoted to Tenfold Planets flooded the screens, aggressively appearing before every player.
This day!
All Immortals returned to their rightful places!
In the entire Upgrade Game, not a single Ninefold Planet remained; one was annihilated by Chen Yi, while the rest, the other eight Ninefold Planets, were forced to ascend!
…
And the 33 Club chat group as well as its various subgroups, all fell into unanimous silence.
Especially Li Yi from the Awesome Starfield, who was utterly expressionless and silent where he stood.
In his heart,
Ninefold Planets were an existence of tremendous prestige, not to mention a leader of a Ninefold Planet, even a regular player from a Ninefold Planet would receive his full accompaniment as a sign of respect should they be fortunate enough to visit his territory.
Although he had never encountered such a situation.
But given the opportunity, he would definitely not neglect it.
And now, eight Ninefold Planets, simply because of a single sentence from Chen Yi, within just a few minutes, all of them decisively unified and ascended to Tenfold Planets, without even bargaining with Chen Yi, without asking why he demanded such a thing, let alone begging for mercy.
Perhaps these Ninefold Planets also understood that any attempt to negotiate with Chen Yi would result in losing even the chance to ascend and suffer the fate of the Kui Race.
“Huff!”
Li Yi, who had just recovered from his shock after a long while, let out a deep breath and muttered with a still dazed look, “Just a word was enough to scare eight Ninefold Planets into running away without daring to utter a word, tucking their tails between their legs. Yi’s power must be incredibly strong by now.”
Wang Qi, similarly shocked, hoarsely said, “They must have watched the entire process of Yi annihilating the Kui Race. Although we don’t know what that looked like, that battle surely must have left an indelible shadow on these several Ninefold Planets, making it very clear to them that even if they joined forces, they wouldn’t stand a sliver of chance of victory.”
“That’s why they made such a decisive move to ascend and flee.”
“Otherwise, if there was even the slightest hope of a Pyrrhic victory, these Ninefold Planets’ people wouldn’t have acted so promptly and cleanly. At least they would have negotiated a few words instead of leaving without a peep as they did now.”
“Moreover, these eight Ninefold Planets all ascended to Tenfold Planets within minutes, indicating that ascending to a Tenfold Planet wasn’t a difficult task for them, it might even have been a rather simple one.”
“But such an easy task, these Ninefold Planets had been reluctant to choose to ascend, which implies there must be some great danger after ascending to Tenfold Planet, probably the ‘cosmic life-and-death competition’ mentioned in the announcement.”
“The degree of danger in this competition must be far greater than we imagined, so much so that these Ninefold Planets, despite having the capability, were unwilling to ascend.”
“Yi’s goal in this mission must have been to force these people into the competition.”
…
Meanwhile—
Chen Yi and his group had already returned to Blue Star and to their base of operations.
Yancheng, on the rooftop of the Garden District.

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 700 416 Map Reward Promotion to Onefold Planet
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 700: Chapter 416: “Map Reward”: Promotion to Onefold Planet. Chapter 700: Chapter 416: “Map Reward”: Promotion to Onefold Planet. The year has already passed.
On the day of the Spring Festival, the first day of the new year, which should be a time for everyone to sit together and eat dumplings in a big reunion, they were delayed by some events and went to the Five Chieftains Starfield to send off that Kui Race player—everyone had their big reunion there.
Chen Yi glanced at the calendar.
Next up, there should be a few more global limited-time events.
Such as the upcoming Valentine’s Day on February 14th.
As well as the festival in February or March—Lantern Festival. It’s uncertain whether there will be any events, but what can be confirmed is that the end of March marks the end of the novice period.
There’s only a month or two left until the end of the novice period.
“…”
Chen Yi set down the calendar, silently not speaking, lost in thought.
Actually, he also doesn’t know what will happen after ascending to Tenfold Planet, nor what the so-called Universal Life and Death Competition is exactly. He only knows that it’s a very dangerous matter, and that if he can complete it successfully, everything will end.
The entire universe will return to peace.
If he fails,
He may have to start over, and this time, without Tuberculosis Rabbit accompanying him.
Seeing Yi lost in thought, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others exchanged glances and didn’t continue to speak. Instead, they quietly began preparing the barbecue ingredients.
…
Soon—
Time arrived at 8 a.m. on February 14th.
The sky hadn’t fully brightened yet; the winter days always cool down a little later, and perhaps it was the deep memory of waking up from bed while it was still dark during the school days, blindly washing and walking on the street lit by street lamps that brought back memories.
Every winter,
Waking up a little earlier in the morning and seeing the pitch-black sky would always remind me of those days.
Today is already several days past the Spring Festival, yet the festive atmosphere on Blue Star hasn’t faded at all, in fact, it has grown even stronger. For Blue Star players, they’re not clear on what they’ll face after the end of the novice period.
All they know is,
Their Yi just cleared nine ultimate enemy groups a few days ago and even destroyed a Ninefold Planet. Such strength already dominates the entire level-up game, and even after the novice period ends, Yi will protect them.
There’s nothing to worry about at all.
But they are not aware of Chen Yi’s plans. On the very day the novice period ends, he won’t stay for a moment longer; he will ascend to Tenfold Planet in one go and start a new chapter.
Indeed!
The ascension of a planet relies not on the strength of a single player. The strength of one player, no matter how strong, is of little use; it depends on the overall strength of all the players on the planet. The presence of one player can hardly affect the entire battle situation.
In theory, that’s the case.
But this doesn’t apply to Chen Yi at all. What does “overwhelming power breaks all methods” mean, and what does “one man holds the pass against a thousand” represent? That’s Chen Yi. With Chen Yi’s current power, the only thing that can stop him is the novice period’s restriction rule.
Other than that, no one can stand in his way.
Just then—
A notification sounded in the ears of all Blue Star players.
‘Ding, a special limited event has started!’
‘Valentine’s Day event runs from 08:00 on February 14th until 08:00 on February 16th. All players are encouraged to actively participate within the event period.’
‘Here are the specific details of the event.’
‘1: On Valentine’s Day, all players can purchase roses with Points to give to their beloved goddess, thereby helping her top the “Goddess Charm Leaderboard.” Both the man who sends the most roses and the goddess who receives the most will earn generous rewards.’
‘Players in the top one hundred of the leaderboard will also receive rewards.’
‘2: All players who have been together for over 10 years will receive a rich gift pack.’
‘3: All players who have been together for over 10 years, and during this time, neither party has physically cheated, will receive the Special Limited Title “Mutual Help and Comfort.”‘
‘4:…’
…
The event details span six or seven points.
It’s pretty standard with nothing special, just a routine special limited event, much like that 5.20 Valentine’s Day event when the level-up game first began—mostly the same.
There’s also this flower leaderboard and the young master reward ranking.
Matchmaker NPCs will randomly appear on Blue Star, and players who approach them can immediately receive a quest. Those who complete the quests will receive a certain number of Points or Prop rewards.
And so on; no particularly noteworthy activities.
Chen Yi, who had woken up early to wait for the event announcement, scanned through the event details and paid them no mind. There was nothing in this event worth noting, nor anything that needed his participation.
As for those leaderboard rewards, he didn’t need those.
He’ll leave the rewards for the younger players.
Give them some opportunities.
As for him, he no longer sees any significance in these rewards. With his current strength, these Props would be superfluous. They wouldn’t even count as icing on the cake.
“Tsk.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, sitting nearby with a slightly peculiar expression, clicked his tongue: “Isn’t this event obviously setting people up?”
“Gift packs for players who have been together for over 10 years?”
“And an additional title for those who haven’t cheated in those 10 years?”
“Alright, alright, that’s quite a ‘Heavenly Judgment’!”
“Now those who receive the gift pack but not the title will immediately know what happened in those 10 years, right? How can they continue living with that? Isn’t this event purely aimed at breaking people up?”

chapters.title: Chapter 701 - 701 416 Map Reward Promoting to Onefold
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 701: Chapter 416: “Map Reward”: Promoting to Onefold Planet._2 Chapter 701: Chapter 416: “Map Reward”: Promoting to Onefold Planet._2 “Who taught the Snow Sea Project Team to design events like that?”
“Alright, alright.”
Sword Without End spoke with an equally strange expression: “The Snow Sea Project Team doesn’t have that much authority, right? To directly design such an event? After all, it’s too much. Though it does seem a bit aimed at breaking people up, since marital infidelity is a really disgusting affair, it’s quite good if they split up.”
“Hey, Sword Without End, have you forgotten about your own dead wife buff?”
“I’m different, I’ve never cheated during my marriage.”
Sword Without End shook his head: “I only started to degenerate after she died, and besides, I’ve never claimed to be a good person anyway. You don’t have to hold me to such high moral standards.”
“Tch.”
…
“Yi.”
Jiaye leaned into Chen Yi’s arms, playing with the buttons on his shirt, and whispered: “Let’s get married once everything is over, okay?”
“Mhm.”
Chen Yi was silent for a moment before responding softly: “Once everything is over, I’ll come back to marry you and give you an exceptionally grand wedding.”
No sooner had he spoken.
The Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End standing to the side exchanged glances, both seeing unease in each other’s eyes.
“It’s over.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed lightly, speaking tiredly: “It looks like in the next life, I probably won’t be able to accompany you guys. Yi, the flag you’ve set makes me feel like this time there’s basically no chance of success. The things you said to your sister-in-law really are too strange.”
I’ll marry you when I return from the war.
After I pull off this one job, I’ll quit and stay with you forever.
This one last job, this last big score to pay for my mother’s medical treatment, then I’ll wash my hands clean and never do it again.
And so on.
According to his extensive reading experience, anyone who says these kinds of things is basically not coming back. Dying in a foreign land is considered a relatively good outcome. The worse outcomes involve being reduced to a pile of broken flesh, not even a whole corpse left behind.
Chen Yi glanced at the Tuberculosis Rabbit without a word, casually saying: “It’s just that after everything ends, things will still be chaotic, and stabilizing everything won’t be simple. Searching for a wedding planning company will probably not be easy.”
“But we could look around to see if there are any wedding halls that haven’t been destroyed. That might be an option.”
“It’s just that finding hosts and masters of ceremonies like the four heavenly kings might be a bit difficult.”
“That… ”
Jiaye’s eyes shone subtly as she spoke: “Yi, do you remember I once told you that I have a dream of starting a marriage proposal company?”
“I even thought of the name, it’s called Jiaye’s Proposal!”
“Once everything is over, Yi, would you like to be my first customer? I will personally design a perfect marriage proposal for you!”
Chen Yi couldn’t help but smile, gently stroking Jiaye’s hair: “You design a marriage proposal for me, to let me propose to you?”
“Yep yep.”
Like a woodpecker, Jiaye’s head nodded vigorously.
“In that case, where’s the surprise in the proposal? You’d already know everything, wouldn’t you?”
“Oh come on, just agree with me. I just want a proposal,” pouted Jiaye: “Are you expecting a straight guy like you to propose to me? I feel like instead of pulling out a bunch of Roses to propose, you’re more likely to blow up an entire Onefold Planet to set off fireworks for a proposal.”
“Mhm.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded seriously: “That’s something Yi could do. Sister-in-law, you really understand Yi.”
“Alright, alright.”
This was the first time Jiaye had made a request of him, so naturally, he couldn’t refuse. It was just a subconscious desire to tease Jiaye, the corners of his mouth slightly lifting: “I promise you, once everything is over, I’ll let you plan the perfect proposal for me, okay?”
“Yes!”
…
Time flew by quickly like this.
For the following period, nothing much happened.
There were no important time-limited events, nor were there any enemies looking for trouble.
Of course—
In the game where they leveled up, basically, there were no more enemies of Chen Yi alive. Of course, if there were a few fish that slipped through the net, as long as they were sane, they wouldn’t come looking for trouble with Chen Yi.
A man who could annihilate a Ninefold Planet, nobody dared to provoke him.
If previously Chen Yi was only well-known in a small scope within the leveling game,
After a series of nine consecutive leveling game announcements to all players, including one where Chen Yi annihilated a Ninefold Planet,
his name became so well-known throughout the leveling game that everyone knew of him, even children.
In such a short, peaceful, and warm time,
The date slowly arrived at March 31st, which was the last day of their Novice Period. After today, they would no longer be novice players, without so many restrictions and no rules to bind them.
It was as if the sky was the limit.
And there were quite a few events in March.
With Women’s Day and Arbor Day, both were routine events. The rewards weren’t considered small for other players, but for him, they were a bit lackluster. These two events took place in mid-March.
After mid-March, there were no activities to boost progress, and the month continued slowly.
Today, the last day,
was a special event!
“Easter!”
As the announcement echoed in the ears of all players, Chen Yi, standing on the rooftop, raised his brows slightly.
“Ding, a special limited-time event!”

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - 702 416 Map Reward Promoting to Onefold
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 702: Chapter 416: “Map Reward”: Promoting to Onefold Planet._3 Chapter 702: Chapter 416: “Map Reward”: Promoting to Onefold Planet._3 “The Easter event will start at 08:00 AM on March 31st and end at 08:00 PM on the same day.”
“Event content: fulfilling the following conditions, all deceased players can be resurrected (limited to players who died after the game’s upgrade and are still located on the Hell Map, players who have already fallen deep into hell and became cleaners cannot be resurrected).”
“Resurrected players can directly return to Blue Star, bypassing the hell return map.”
“It only costs 100,000 Points to resurrect a player.”
“Or, fulfill the following requirements—”
“1: 1000 push-ups.”
“2: 1000 sit-ups.”
“3: Spit out 1000 thick sputums onto the ground.”
“4: Perform 1000 deep squats.”
“There’s no time limit for the above requirements; as long as they are completed within the event period, a specified player can be resurrected.”
…
Past events lasted three days, but this one lasts only 12 hours.
Perhaps because today is the last day, the duration of this event has been significantly reduced. As for the content of the event, it is difficult to judge.
“…”
Chen Yi frowned and said nothing. With the number of Points he had, it definitely wasn’t enough to bring up all the players from hell.
What a joke.
100,000 Points to resurrect a player?
To resurrect 1000 players, that’s a billion Points.
To resurrect a million players, that’s a hundred billion Points!
Throwing all his possessions into it, at most he could resurrect around two million players, and that’s if he threw everything he owned. But in reality, there are far more than two million players on the Hell Map.
At least two billion players!
All in the Blue Star Hell Map!
Players on the Blue Star map only make up a very small part; the majority are in Blue Star Hell. After all, a long time ago everyone found out that although being in hell sounds bad, as if one were dead,
In the Hell Map, there are no mandatory maps, and one doesn’t have to take part in those high-risk events; the safety coefficient is significantly lower than that on Blue Star. For instance, during the last strange Another World invasion on Blue Star, hell was unaffected.
That monster that crawled out of the sea? Hell didn’t have a single problem.
Even if other Alien Races invade Blue Star, hell is still unaffected.
In other words,
Hell is a place with an extremely high safety coefficient, at least higher than Blue Star. Many people actively seek death to go to hell to do small business, like opening a family baozi shop, not aiming to earn much Points or to obtain props, just seeking to live a stable life.
Just surviving is enough.
These people never thought about taking part in any return maps. Especially in the hell cities, where there are NPCs responsible for maintaining public order, this is much better than on Blue Star where there aren’t many maintaining order. Under such circumstances, you can’t expect to trust your life in the hands of others.
This means—
These majority of players in hell have no intention of coming up. They are a group of ordinary people who barely survive without any fighting strength; for them, getting stronger isn’t necessary, but surviving is.
If these people are resurrected, not only would they be unwilling, but there’s also a great possibility they would commit suicide on the spot and return to hell.
Even if Blue Star faces extermination, the players on the surface of Blue Star would perish first before the players in hell would die together.
This event is basically meaningless.
Unless…
Unless there are some players who truly want to return to Blue Star, but are unable to pass the return map normally due to lost props or various other reasons, they would find this event very useful.”
…
After briefly considering, Chen Yi put the event out of his mind; the event had little to do with him.
And so,
On the rooftop of the Garden District, after finishing the last barbecue meal,
Time rapidly passed, and it came to 00:00 AM on April 1st.
All the players knew what would happen tonight. Not a single player slept; everyone was alert, preparing their weapons and props, whether sitting on the edges of rooftops, on sofas in their living rooms, or under the dim light of street lamps.
Each was waiting for the announcement in their own way.
At the moment the announcement sounded,
The battle would begin.
“Promotion to a Onefold Planet map!”
Most players on Blue Star were aware of one thing: with Chen Yi present, the map was sure to be cleared, but this might be their only chance to participate. If they didn’t act this time, they probably wouldn’t be able to join in the upcoming battles.
Finally!
At the precise moment when the hands of the clock pointed to 00:00 AM on April 1st,
The announcement echoed right on schedule!
“Ding!”
“Congratulations to all Blue Star players, you have successfully made it through one year of the Novice Period. During this time, together, you’ve created countless miracles!”
“Today marks the day! The Novice Period officially ends!”
“In the days to come, you will venture into the broader game of advancement.”
“As the person in charge of the Snow Sea Project Team, I am honored to have accompanied you on part of your journey, watching you emerge from the fires of battle, growing stronger!”
“Here are the highlights of this year!”

Smoke in the image was pierced by dozens of bullets, striking heavily against the body of a giant boss.
As the boss slowly fell, Chen Yi, dressed in a suit and leaning on a cane, walked out from the smoke with a calm expression on his face.
At the same time, a line of text appeared!
‘World boss instantly defeated! The rise of Chen Yi!’
…
“…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but click his tongue in admiration, “So cool, I must say that after processing, this image looks countless times more handsome.”
This image was exactly the one from when Yi defeated the world boss.
Almost identical.
But there was no white smoke at that time.
And this image, not only was some white smoke added along with some special effects, but there was also some silhouette backlighting which made Yi look very imposing, his features extremely sharp and striking.
…
One after another, images continued to flash.
There was Yi’s first ascent to the top of the player rankings, and the first time he brought back the Monument from the Zerofold Planet.
There was Yi’s first annihilation of an invading Alien Race, and the first time he took the initiative to venture into the Annihilation Starfield to exterminate a race.
The images kept blinking.
It was said to be the glorious return of outstanding players over the year, but in reality, it was only Chen Yi.
This was not to say that aside from Chen Yi, the other players on Blue Star were worthless and had no moment to shine.
It was just…
Just that the gap was too huge.
The highlight moments of the other players, when compared to Yi’s, were simply not on the same level and couldn’t compete.
…
When the last image gradually faded.
The announcement sounded once again.
‘Our journey has come to an end, but it is not over, we hope all players can carve out their own piece of sky in the new journey!’
‘Ding!’
‘Detecting Annihilation Starfield, System 3, Zerofold Planet Blue Star, the Novice Period has concluded, now initiating the promotion to Onefold Planet map.’
‘The map is forcibly opened, and it will be activated immediately after the Novice Period ends.’
‘Successfully passing it will promote it to Onefold Planet, unlocking all permissions of the Onefold Planet, and allowing free travel to other planets without the restrictions of the Novice Period.’
‘…Randomizing a onefold map.’
‘Randomized to—’Roaring Evil Dragon’!’
Very soon—
A panel popped up in front of all Blue Star players, naturally excluding those still in hell.
‘Map Name’: Roaring Evil Dragon.
‘Map Level’: Planet Onefold Promotion Map.
‘Map Requirements’: 13 stages in total, with the first 12 stages being minor monsters; defeating the final boss at stage 13 will allow for immediate successful passage.
‘Map Restrictions’: All Blue Star players over the age of 16 must participate compulsorily in battle.
‘Map Reward’: Promotion to Onefold Planet.
‘Map Penalty’: Annihilation.
‘The map is now initiating!’
…
The Blue Star players weren’t given much time to read the map panel; almost 30 seconds after the panel popped up, a flash of white light appeared before the eyes of all Blue Star players, and they vanished on the spot.
Just like that, in an instant.
The skies above Blue Star became eerily quiet, almost deserted.
So quiet that it was somewhat frightening.
If someone happened to travel through time at that moment, they might think they had arrived in a world that had just suffered an apocalypse and had been annihilated.
…
When they opened their eyes again.
All Blue Star players had already appeared on a vast plain that seemed endless, surrounded by surging crowds seemingly within a cavern, with rock walls above their heads.
And up ahead.
There was a massive screen, tens of thousands of meters high, with an extremely eye-catching line of glowing text on it.
“The first level!”
“Time limit of 3 hours to pass this level!”
“The map will open in 1 minute.”
The screen was enormous, and so were the characters displayed on it.
It wasn’t clear whether it was designed to be visible to all players, but Chen Yi, standing in the crowd, felt he was quite a distance from the screen, yet he could see the letters on it clearly.
The entrance on that screen also seemed incredibly wide, as if it could accommodate hundreds of thousands of people entering at the same time.
“Wow!”
Surprise flickered in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, “Are all Blue Star players really entering the same map at the same time? I thought there would be some other method; isn’t this a bit too chaotic?”
–
A panel popped up in front of all Blue Star players, naturally excluding those still in hell.
“Map Name”: Roaring Evil Dragon.

…
Blue Star players weren’t given much time to read the map panel. Almost 30 seconds after the panel appeared, every player saw a flash of white light and vanished on the spot.
Just like that, in a flash.
The sky above the whole Blue Star became extremely quiet, nearly devoid of people.
The silence was so profound that it was somewhat frightening.
If someone happened to cross over at this time, they might think they had arrived at a world that had just suffered an apocalypse and been wiped out.
…
When they opened their eyes again.

Ahead of them.
There was an immense screen stretching tens of thousands of meters, displaying a row of extremely eye-catching luminous letters.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 704 417 Wishing Everyone Safety
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 704: Chapter 417: “Wishing Everyone Safety! Chapter 704: Chapter 417: “Wishing Everyone Safety! Just as Blue Star advanced to be Onefold Planet!
Countless Race Players arrived at Blue Star almost simultaneously.
Advancing to Onefold Planet meant that interactions with the outside world were possible, and although it was still within the Star System, not on Starfield, traveling to a Onefold Planet within a Star System was not an easy task—it was rather cumbersome.
Far less convenient than traveling to a planet on Starfield.
But—
A large group of players still arrived at Blue Star at the first opportunity.
All of these players were renowned figures; there wasn’t a single ordinary player among them. They were all influential leaders or persons in charge on their own planets, basically the highest chiefs.
People like Li Yi, Wang Qi, Elder Qian, and the Race leaders who had paid protection fees to Chen Yi, and so on.
All of them brought heavy congratulatory gifts and came to convey their wishes at the first opportunity.
No one doubted whether Chen Yi would fail to clear this Onefold Map; everyone was only thinking about one thing: how to get to Blue Star as quickly as possible to be the first to offer their congratulations.
Frankly, no one cared when a Novice Planet’s Novice Period ended.
Not a single one.
But Blue Star was different, as it had Chen Yi.
When Blue Star’s Novice Period would end was etched in the minds of many who, while they might forget their own parents’ birthdays, remembered clearly when Blue Star’s Novice Period was to conclude.
However, no sooner had these people arrived at Blue Star, still searching for where Chen Yi was, they discovered that nearly all the players on Blue Star had vanished in an instant.
“This…”
Li Yi looked bewilderedly at the sudden disappearance of a large group of players, only coming to his senses after a long moment, “Are they advancing to Twofold Planet now?”
He then put down the exquisite package he was carrying and mumbled with some anxiety.
“I don’t know if Yi would take a fancy to my gift.”
These days, everyone was pondering over one matter.
And that was what gift to offer.
Points? Chen Yi short of that? Let’s not even go there, just a word from Chen Yi and droves of people would desperately offer him Points without expecting anything in return.
A Prop? Would someone who had cleared all nine Ultimate Maps, acquired nine Ultimate Suits, and single-handedly obliterated Ninefold Planet, lack any Props?
Offering tobacco and alcohol?
That was even more absurd; this wasn’t like visiting relatives.
So, the matter of gifting became a preoccupation for countless people, who pondered until their scalps tingled, finally coming up with gifts they felt could barely be presentable to attend the celebration.
“It must be,”
Wang Qi casually said with his hands in his pockets and shrugging his shoulders, “Apart from advancing to Twofold Map, there’s nothing else that would make players from Blue Star disappear in such large numbers. Just wait; advancing to Twofold Map does take some time.”
“Of course, with Yi’s ability, it will probably only take a few minutes to finish.”
“How many minutes it will take to finish depends entirely on how long the random waiting time for the Map Level is.”
…
Not much time was left for Blue Star players to be astonished, as a familiar prompt sounded in everyone’s ears the moment a white light flashed before their eyes.
‘Map Name’: Chessboard Expanse.
‘Map Level’: Planet Twofold Advancement Map.
‘Map Requirements’: There are a total of 7 levels; the first 6 involve lesser creatures, and successfully killing the final boss at Level 7 completes the Map.
‘Map Restriction’: All players on Blue Star aged 16 and over must participate in the battle mandatorily.
‘Map Reward’: Advancement to Twofold Planet.
‘Map Penalty’: None.
‘Map Now Begins!’
This time it was not a cave.
It was a vast grassland; the grass was not tall, roughly just past the heel of a shoe, and the sky was very blue, seeming perfect for building a holiday resort.
Above their heads, there was something resembling a pyramid.
Slowly descending towards the heads of all the players.
On the light screen at the bottom of the pyramid, there was a line of light text.
‘First Level Entrance’
‘Time Limit of 5 hours to clear the level!’
Obviously.
When this pyramid pressed down on the heads of all players, monsters would gush out, and when the layer above the pyramid fell down, the boss would appear. A straightforward and easily understood Map.
Just as all the players took a deep breath, gripped their weapons tightly, and braced for the bloody and brutal battle ahead…
Chen Yi calmly stepped into the air and deliberately collided with the light screen at the underside of the pyramid above.
The next second—
Countless Buddhas seated on the Firepower Lotus Platforms appeared abruptly beside Chen Yi, colliding with the light screen at the bottom of the pyramid.
Then…
‘Ding, Twofold Advancement Map’s first level is cleared, please…’
‘Ding, Twofold Advancement Map’s second level is cleared, please…’
‘..’
‘Ding, Twofold Advancement Map’s sixth level is cleared, please…’
‘Ding, The final boss of Twofold Advancement Map is dead!’
‘Congratulations to Blue Star for successfully advancing to Twofold Planet!’
–
The whole process didn’t last more than 1 minute.
“…”
All the players looked up with expressionless faces at the pyramid above their heads which, before it even landed, had been breached by Yi. Suddenly, they were at a loss for words, as they should have expected this outcome.
With Yi’s presence.
They were even thinking of taking action themselves.
It was simply… whether they had underestimated Yi or overestimated themselves.
Immediately after,
The white light flashed again.
All the Blue Star players reappeared on Blue Star as if they had just dozed off during class. It felt like time had passed, but in reality, it was merely an instant, just enough for the withered leaves outside the window to gently touch the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - 705 417 Wishing Everyone Safety_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 705: Chapter 417: “Wishing Everyone Safety!”_2 Chapter 705: Chapter 417: “Wishing Everyone Safety!”_2 “Phew!”
Having stepped back onto the ground of Blue Star, Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at the still perplexed Blue Star players and rubbed his temples somewhat helplessly, “Yi, isn’t it your birthday today? Do we really need to rush like this?”
“Ah?” Sword Without End was momentarily stunned, then he caught on, “It’s Yi’s birthday today? Yi’s birthday is on April 1st, April Fool’s Day?”
“Yeah.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit chuckled as he shook his eyebrows, “Yeah, didn’t you know? Ah, I guess I never told you. It was on the day when the level-up game initially descended, the very day of Yi’s birthday. We were outside eating hotpot at that time.”
“We were in the middle of eating when the level-up game descended.”
“It was a bit chaotic at first, felt like the end of the world, with panic quickly spreading among everyone. Of course, there were still many people who were excited and exhilarated, after all, the rules weren’t strict back then, and the completion conditions weren’t that tough. For a lot of people, it was like the games they played daily suddenly became real in the actual world, which was pretty interesting.”
“Of course, you also know what happened afterward, they didn’t find it so amusing soon afterward.”
“The rule for the next month was ‘Calm and Cool’, and it really did cool a lot of people off, that rule took down quite a few.”
“Why didn’t you say it earlier?”
Jiaye looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit with some grievance, “If you’d mentioned it sooner, I could have prepared a birthday gift for Yi. Now, there’s nothing I can prepare, making me seem so inattentive.”
“Well…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit clicked his tongue and after pausing for a while, he cautiously said, “I always thought, since your sister has been with Yi for so long, didn’t she ever ask Yi when his birthday was?”
“I did ask, but Yi said he didn’t know either.”
“Oh right, I almost forgot, Yi indeed doesn’t remember his own birthday. I’m not sure what’s going on with him, but it seems like Yi has some memory loss regarding this. Every year, I have to remind Yi of his birthday, otherwise, he doesn’t know. Even if we celebrate it every year, come April 1st next year, Yi still forgets that it’s his birthday.”
“So…”
Before Tuberculosis Rabbit could finish, the notification sound interrupted again.
“Ding, Blue Star player Chen Yi has activated the mission to advance to Threefold Planet!”
“Upon successful passage, he will be promoted to Threefold Planet, unlocking all the permissions of Threefold Planet.”
“…Randomizing Threefold Map.”
“Randomized to—’Good Cat Paradise’!”
“Please all players prepare, in 1 minute, all players over the age of 16 will be forcibly engaged in battle!”
Indeed.
Yi didn’t pause for a moment, the mission to level up to Threefold Planet had started once again.
This time, the Blue Star players got smarter. They put their weapons into their backpacks without a second thought, since they were of no use. Upon arriving at the level-up map, they didn’t do anything but just sat down cross-legged on the ground and started eating sunflower seeds and chatting.
They had no opportunity to take action anyway.
As they expected, it only took one or two minutes before they heard the familiar notification sound again.
“Ding, the first challenge of the Threefold Map has been cleared, please…”
“…”
“Congratulations, Blue Star has successfully leveled up to Threefold Planet!”
Following that, the notification sounded once more.
“Ding, Blue Star player Chen Yi has activated the mission to advance to Fourfold Planet!”
“…Randomizing Fourfold Map.”
“Randomized to—’Cumulus Realm’!”
“…”
“Ding, congratulations to Blue Star for successfully leveling up to Fourfold Planet.”
–
“Ding, Blue Star player Chen Yi has activated the mission to advance to Fivefold Planet!”
“…Randomizing Fivefold Map.”
“Randomized to—’Storm Strike’!”
“Ding, congratulations to Blue Star for successfully leveling up to Fivefold Planet.”
–
“Ding, Blue Star player Chen Yi has activated the mission to advance to Sixfold Planet!”
“…Randomizing Sixfold Map.”
“Randomized to—’Blazing Flame’!”
“Ding, congratulations to Blue Star for successfully leveling up to Sixfold Planet.”
–
“Ding, Blue Star player Chen Yi has activated the mission to advance to Sevenfold Planet!”
“…Randomizing Sevenfold Map.”
“Randomized to—’Rose Club’!”
“Ding, congratulations to Blue Star for successfully leveling up to Sevenfold Planet.”
–
“Ding, Blue Star player Chen Yi has activated the mission to advance to Eightfold Planet!”
“…Randomizing Eightfold Map.”
“Randomized to—’Martial God’s Tomb’!”
“Ding, congratulations to Blue Star for successfully leveling up to Eightfold Planet.”
–
Finally, after that announcement, there was a long silence with no notifications.
And at that moment—
Those players who had come to Blue Star to offer their congratulations were now staring blankly at the ground beneath their feet, the land of their own territory. Were they… were they actually standing on the soil of an Eightfold Planet?
What a joke!
Of those who came to congratulate, how many had never set foot on an Eightfold Planet in their lives? They had originally come just to celebrate Yi’s successful promotion to Onefold Planet, but who would have thought that Yi would drag them straight to an Eightfold Planet without any explanation?
This was the Eightfold Planet!!!
The highest power in the leveling game!
The highest power used to naturally be the Ninefold Planet, but now that Ninefold Planet had been sent to the Tenfold Planet by Yi, leading to the current situation where there’s no Ninefold Planet left in the leveling game, the strongest power is now the Eightfold Planet.
…
“Phew!”
Standing on the land of Blue Star, Li Yi took a deep breath and tried to suppress the shock in his heart, saying with a wry smile, “Embarrassing as it is to admit, this is the first time in my life I’ve been to Eightfold Planet’s territory without fearing for my life.”

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - 706 417 Wishing Everyone Safety_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 706: Chapter 417: “Wishing Everyone Safety!”_3 Chapter 706: Chapter 417: “Wishing Everyone Safety!”_3 If he were to go to the territories of the other Eightfold Planets, let’s not even talk about whether he was willing to go or whether that Eightfold Planet would allow him to go.
Even if he did go.
He would have to be extremely cautious, afraid that a single slip might cost him his life there.
But here, he had no such worries at all. Considering the relationship between him and Yi, unless he did something unforgivable, Yi probably wouldn’t kill him.
“It’s just…”
“I wonder if he can progress to the Ninefold Map. If possible, maybe Yi could achieve the ‘Day Nine’ milestone?”
“It should be possible, just not sure if there’s enough time.”
Wang Qi looked down at his watch. It was now 10:21 PM on April 1. There was an hour and a half left until midnight, approaching April 2.
Yi had started progressing through the levels since the early hours of April 1, almost a whole day had passed.
The initial progression through the Onefold, Two, and Threefold maps were all very quick, basically just a few minutes to clear, at most ten minutes. But the speed noticeably slowed down afterwards.
It wasn’t because Chen Yi lacked strength.
It was because, on their planets, the progression maps above Threefold often had many unpredictable elements.
The most common variable was the waiting time. After clearing the first stage, all players were forced to rest for thirty minutes. This rest period was mandatory and could not be skipped.
The intent was to give Race Players leveling up under normal conditions, time to adjust and reduce casualties to ensure a successful completion rate.
But for Chen Yi, it had the opposite effect.
Instead of helping Yi, it actually held him back, but there was nothing that could be done about it, as it was unavoidable.
Yi had already been in the Ninefold Map progression for three hours now, and he still hadn’t emerged, nor had they heard any notification of a successful clearance, but they fully believed Yi could make it.
They just weren’t sure if he could clear it before April 2.
That way he could achieve the ultimate milestone of progressing to a Ninefold Planet within a single day—a feat no one else in history had accomplished!
“Actually, it doesn’t need to be within a day. Even if it takes a bit more than a day to take a planet from Onefold to Ninefold, it would still be a unique milestone in the memory of the progression game,” Wang Qi tried to reassure him.
Li Yi kept glancing down at his watch impatiently, making Wang Qi feel somewhat helpless. They could not see what was happening on Yi’s end and had no information at all, just growing anxious with no way to assist Yi.
“Yes,” Li Yi said with some worry, nodding. “You’re right. Even if it takes two days, it would definitely be unique, but two days just don’t sound as good as one day, does it? ‘Progressed to Ninefold in a day’ sounds so much more impressive!”
“It’s like in a novel; when describing prodigious warriors, it’s often, ‘Within a single day, he went from Foundation Establishment to Divinity Transformation Stage!'”
“Who has ever heard of taking two days to go from Foundation Establishment to Divinity Transformation Stage?”
“…”
Wang Qi shrugged his shoulders and muttered in some speechlessness, “The novels I read never describe a master reaching the Divinity Transformation Stage from Foundation Establishment in a day. How could you even follow a power jump like that?”
And at this moment!
On Blue Star, countless players who had come to offer their congratulations were also frequently looking down at their watches, clearly everyone was anticipating whether Yi could achieve the ‘Day Nine’ milestone within a day!
Soon!
The time slowly reached 11:59 PM.
In one more minute it would be April 2, but there was still no sign of movement on Blue Star, the players had not returned, and they hadn’t heard any announcement either.
Most people were starting to sigh with resignation.
“No helping it.”
It seemed that Yi wouldn’t be able to accomplish this milestone. It was obvious to everyone it wasn’t due to a lack of strength; a player who could wipe out a Ninefold Planet in a few hours couldn’t possibly be stumped by a Ninefold progression map for so long.
The only reason was that the mandatory rest time for the map was too long.
And there was no way to skip that.
Apart from waiting patiently for the time to pass, there was nothing else that could be done.
“Aren’t you anxious anymore?”
Wang Qi looked at Li Yi in surprise. Li Yi had been very anxious until now, but at 11:59 PM, when everything seemed to be about to conclude, Li Yi suddenly became calm, full of anticipation as if waiting for something.
“You don’t understand.”
Li Yi said with a hopeful smile, “11:59 PM is a time when miracles can happen. Many stories end at this time, and Yi happens to be someone who believes in miracles.”
“He will see this time.”
“Might be too late,” Wang Qi said as he glanced at his watch. “Less than 10 seconds left.”
“6 seconds.”
“3 seconds.”
“1…”
Before he finished speaking!
An announcement suddenly echoed in the ears of all the players!
–
‘Ding, announcement to all players of the progression game!’
‘Chen Yi, a player from the Ninefold Planet Blue Star in the Annihilation Starfield, has within one day, led Blue Star from a Novice Planet to a Ninefold Planet!’
‘Creating the fastest progression to a Ninefold Planet in the history of the progression game, and the singular achievement of progressing from a Onefold Planet to a Ninefold Planet within a single day.’
‘Unprecedented, with no one to follow!’
‘Absolutely stunning!’
‘This action has shocked countless players and has been recorded in the annals of progression game history, where it will permanently leave its name and mark, and will receive a statue in the progression game Hall of Honor to represent this event.’

chapters.title: Chapter 707 - 707 417 Wishing Everyone Safety_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 707: Chapter 417: “Wishing Everyone Safety!”_4 Chapter 707: Chapter 417: “Wishing Everyone Safety!”_4 “And has achieved a milestone in the game upgrade process!”
–
“Milestone name: Day Nine.”
“Conditions to Achieve: Lead your planet from Zerofold Planet to Ninefold Planet within one day.”
“Let us congratulate Chen Yi for becoming the first player in the history of the game to achieve this milestone.”
“And he has been awarded the Stellar Rank title ‘Day Nine’!”
–
Meanwhile, all Blue Star players also heard a similar announcement in their ears.
“Congratulations to Blue Star for successfully advancing to Ninefold Planet, new privileges…”
Blue Star.
It had now advanced to a Ninefold Planet.
…
“Eh?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had just stepped out of the map, glanced at his wristwatch and nodded in satisfaction, “The timing is neither too early nor too late, just at the last second of 23:59 on April 1st, making it through right on the dot.”
“But Yi, you could have made it through much earlier.”
“Why wait until the very last second to wrap it up?”
Chen Yi said with a casual smile, “It’s more fun this way, otherwise it feels kind of meaningless.”
“Alright, everyone has worked hard all day, go and rest now, get ready to head out in a few days.”
Following that, another announcement rang out beside the ears of Blue Star players.
“Global Broadcast: Hello everyone, I am Chen Yi, we don’t have much time left, the battlefield outside urgently needs us to join, and the specific situation on the outside battlefield is unclear.”
“We don’t even know what level of danger it is, just that it’s an extremely brutal battlefield.”
“There’s not much time for everyone to develop, seven days, in these seven days try to familiarize yourselves with the ways Ninefold Players obtain resources, and improve your combat power as much as possible.”
“Of course, my advice is for you all to put more effort into survival and escape abilities, given that… we don’t lack for a bit of damage output, what matters is that you stay alive, don’t have me fighting at the front only to hear of our race being annihilated from behind.”
“And try to have more children.”
“I hope that after the war, the lineage of Blue Star People can continue unbroken.”
“I wish everyone safety!”
…
He decided to head to the cosmic battlefield for a life-and-death contest in seven days.
Actually, he even wanted to go right now, but he had to leave some time for Blue Star players to adapt, and he also needed to prepare during these few days; however, just at this moment—
Chen Yi suddenly noticed many fireworks burning in the sky.
They dyed the sky of Yancheng red.
Looking incredibly gorgeous.
Chen Yi, standing on the rooftop of Yancheng Garden District, was slightly stunned by the sight before him.
And Jiaye took the opportunity to lean into Yi’s embrace, muttering softly, “It’s so beautiful.”
“Yes, it is.”
After pausing for a moment, Chen Yi suddenly laughed, “It really is beautiful.”
Just as his gaze softened, and he was about to affectionately stroke Jiaye’s hair and say something, he noticed the distance fireworks unexpectedly formed a line of words.
“Yi, I am Li Yi!”
“This is the firework display I’ve prepared specially to congratulate Yi on successfully advancing to Ninefold Planet!”
“Here’s an early wish for Yi to return triumphantly from the cosmic contest, and no matter who Yi is up against, to kick their asses hard!”
“…”
Just as Chen Yi was getting ready to say some romantic words in the newly formed romantic atmosphere, seeing these lines caused his affectionate expression to stiffen.
After a silence,
he then turned, with Jiaye in his arms, toward the house behind him.
“I’m going to rest a bit. Tuberculosis Rabbit, you can go thank Li Yi for his gift on my behalf.”
“Got it!”

Meanwhile, Jiaye took the opportunity to lie in Yi’s arms, muttering softly, “So beautiful.”
“Yes, it is.”
Chen Yi paused for a long while and then suddenly laughed, “Indeed, it’s beautiful.”
Just as he grew tender-hearted, looking down and about to pet Jiaye’s hair indulgently, preparing to say something romantic, he saw the distant fireworks suddenly transforming into a line of text.
“Yi, it’s Li Yi!”
“I prepared this fireworks display especially to congratulate Yi on his successful promotion to the Zerofold Planet!”
“I wish Yi a triumphant return from the cosmic race in advance, no matter who he is, kick their butts hard!”
“…”
Chen Yi, who was about to say some sweet nothings in a romantic mood, stiffened upon reading those lines.
After a long silence.
He held Jiaye and turned to walk back into the house behind them.
“I’m going to rest a bit. Tuberculosis Rabbit, you go thank Li Yi properly for his gift on my behalf.”
“Understood!”
