chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 708 418 The human world truly fascinating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 708: Chapter 418: “The human world, truly fascinating. Chapter 708: Chapter 418: “The human world, truly fascinating. “Indeed.”
Wang Qi looked at Li Yi with some envy. Why hadn’t he thought of such a thoughtful gift?
It was far better than the gift he had prepared.
“Right,” Li Yi, who was standing with his hands on his hips and looking proud, suddenly remembered something. He turned to Wang Qi curiously and asked, “What gift did you prepare?”
“I prepared a jade token.”
Wang Qi took out the jade token he had prepared in advance from his backpack. “I was thinking of providing Yi with a protective jade for his future child. Although it isn’t very valuable, its effects are particularly suitable for a baby’s safe growth, and it has a good meaning too.”
“It also matches the cultural customs on Blue Star.”
“It should… according to my understanding.”
“But now that I think about it, it doesn’t seem quite as fitting as your fireworks show. When it comes to social niceties, I really need to learn more from Chief Li.”
Just then—
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End approached Li Yi with smirks on their faces.
“Here they come!”
Li Yi tilted his head to look at Wang Qi and raised an eyebrow. Then, with a smile in his eyes, he quickly went to meet them. “Tuberculosis Rabbit, Wuya, I…”
Before he could finish, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s arm was already on Li Yi’s shoulder. He said with a mock smile, “Thanks for the fireworks show, Yi was very pleased. He specifically asked me to repay the favor.”
“Let’s return the favor with a fireworks show for you too.”
Then Tuberculosis Rabbit exerted a little force, tossing Li Yi up high into the air.
“Ah!!!”
As Li Yi’s figure gradually vanished into the sky, the shrill scream also faded away.
“This…”
Wang Qi stood rooted to the spot with a stunned face, looking at where Li Yi had dwindled to a speck in the sky and disappeared, at a loss for words.
“It’s okay, don’t be scared.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit gently patted Wang Qi’s shoulder with a tender expression. “Just a little game with him. Yi said to rest tonight, we can talk about any issues tomorrow. Since you’re here, take a walk around and experience the customs and culture of Blue Star.”
“Oh… okay, sure.”
…
Soon.
The seven days flashed by, and the time had quickly come for Chen Yi to leave the main game world.
There was a 15-minute countdown left.
On the rooftop.
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at the rooftop’s sandy beach, the heavily used grill, and the few beach chairs with a complex expression. His eyes were full of reluctance and nostalgia. There was no telling when he would return, or if he would be able to come back at all.
They had spent a long time on this rooftop. At some point, the rooftop had become their base of operations, returning to it always felt like returning home.
It was as if being on the rooftop made them feel they were no longer orphans, but that they too had family.
They never moved to a bigger house or a villa, not for lack of means, but because they didn’t want to leave, or maybe it was due to nostalgia or plain laziness. From the start of the game world, they had always stayed right here.
“Aren’t you going to visit your art gallery one last time?”
Sword Without End looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit and said casually.
Over these seven days, Tuberculosis Rabbit had completed his art gallery outside Yancheng, filling it with what he considered perfect art pieces, such as those alien race beings transformed by Yi’s otherworldly flowers into creatures covered in roses, and so on.
And it was officially open to the public.
The ticket price was 19,800 points.
According to Tuberculosis Rabbit, it wasn’t that he hoped to make money from the art gallery, but it was necessary to set a threshold to avoid too many people making it noisy, and many wouldn’t appreciate his art anyway.
His painstakingly created works would be wasted on them.
So, he had to set a not-so-cheap point price.
However, to Tuberculosis Rabbit’s disappointment, the gallery attracted many visitors. Ordinary players couldn’t afford it, but the problem was, there were no commoners amongst Yi’s acquaintances now. Among those people, as well as those wishing to favor Yi, if they didn’t support his dearest brother’s art gallery, wouldn’t they look insensitive?
Moreover, many seemed to regret that the ticket price wasn’t higher; the best would be if it were set at 10 billion points. That would show their exceptionality and their support, and Tuberculosis Rabbit might remember them, right?
There were even those unable to get involved who invested in a shopping mall right opposite the art gallery, with plans to center it around the gallery, aiming to build the most bustling commercial district in the main game world.
Why was Sky City so prosperous?
One reason was that Li Yi’s budget was without limits, focused solely on making Sky City’s name known.
Another was the many races drawn by the fame, coming to Sky City to build malls, offices, and other structures, jointly creating this extremely famous commercial district.
In Blue Star, as the first business plan for the shopping mall across from the art gallery was laid down, more and more excited people rushed in waving their cash, resolved to build the biggest commercial district in the universe around the art gallery.
This wasn’t just to please Yi; there was also the realization that a lot of profit lay hidden here. Yi’s reputation was now the highest in the main game world, unparalleled, and more and more players would swarm this place.
Where people gather, profit follows.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 709 418 The human world truly fascinating._2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 709: Chapter 418: “The human world, truly fascinating.”_2 Chapter 709: Chapter 418: “The human world, truly fascinating.”_2 The most important thing was that Chen Yi didn’t stop this behavior. On the contrary, he tacitly approved and even showed a bit of appreciation. If not now at the forefront to make a positive statement, then when?
…
In the past few days, Tuberculosis Rabbit almost always stayed in his art gallery, clearly reluctant to leave, taking three steps and looking back after each one!
“…”
Sword Without End looked at the absent-minded Tuberculosis Rabbit with a hint of helplessness.
He didn’t know why.
Tuberculosis Rabbit seemed very attached to this art gallery, and he left a lot of instructions, such as insisting that once the area around the art gallery was fully developed, they must raise the admission price, preventing too many people from entering the gallery.
And to pay attention to regular upkeep and maintenance, among other things.
It sounded like he was making arrangements for his orphan.
“You don’t understand.”
After taking a deep breath, Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head with emotion and said, “In this world, I only have Yi and a few of you as family. I don’t have much of my own mark on the world, and I don’t really want to find a wife and have children. This art gallery is like my child, the only thing I’ll leave behind in this world.”
“I can’t let go of it.”
“Besides, haven’t you been hanging out in Black Trench City these past few days?”
“Hey!”
Sword Without End couldn’t help but laugh, “You’re right, though Black Trench City is full of monsters and trolls, I don’t know why, but maybe after being trolled by the people there so much, I’ve developed some sort of attachment to it.”
“I’ve been there for several days and it feels quite good. It’s just not very welcoming to outsiders.”
“The locals speak with such ferocity, it sounds almost like they’re scolding someone. If someone from outside goes there, they’re sure to end up arguing. Everyone is pretty straightforward, which makes things less tiring when interacting.”
“But the most important thing is—”
“No one in Black Trench City trolls me anymore.”
“Nonsense…”
Tuberculosis Rabbit muttered softly with his head down, “Ever since you saw someone insulting you online from Black Trench City and went straight down the internet to send them to hell as a janitor, there have been far fewer people cursing you.”
“Who else could be as ruthless as you.”
…
“…”
Meanwhile, Chen Yi sat on a beach chair on the rooftop patio, looking at the familiar scene in front of him in a calm silence without speaking.
Ever since Blue Star was promoted to a Threefold Planet, it had become integrated with the Annihilation Starfield, occupying nearly half of its territory. It wasn’t that he had seized it by force—rather, upon his ascension to a Ninefold Planet, the game automatically allocated this territory to him.
Interestingly enough.
During the Novice Period, he had visited the Annihilation Starfield once and annihilated a few races. A large number of props dropped by these Alien Race players could not be picked up by him due to the Novice Period rules that prevented Novice players from acquiring props held by non-Novice players through any means.
Consequently, he could only leave a message warning anyone who dared touch the props that once he was out of the Novice Period, he would annihilate their entire families.
Later, he forgot about the whole incident.
When Blue Star was promoted to a Threefold Planet and came to the Annihilation Starfield, he inadvertently discovered that the massive number of props had all been neatly lying around in various Wastelands for a year without a single one missing.
In fact, there were even more than before.
Originally, there were some bold players who, after pondering carefully and ensuring that Chen Yi couldn’t find them, stealthily stole some props from the edge of the Wasteland.
However, as Chen Yi’s fame grew louder and his battle achievements became more impressive,
These bold players returned all the props they had stolen.
Some worried about being settled with later, not only gave back the props they had stolen but also tossed in several more as a preemptive measure, providing themselves an opportunity for defense should they ever be called to account.
Others who forgot how much they had stolen and were afraid of returning too little ended up putting in a large excess of props, preferring to overcompensate rather than fall short.
As a result…
The props on these Wastelands didn’t decrease but increased significantly.
Of course, Chen Yi didn’t care about these things anymore. Upon learning about this, he merely smiled and allowed the Blue Star players to freely gather them, being threefold planet-level Props that were still quite decent. This also provided some benefits for the Blue Star players.
Additionally, during the annihilation of the races, he had earned billions of Points and numerous props as rewards. Due to the restrictions of the Novice Period, these couldn’t be claimed immediately but were deposited shortly after the period ended.
While these rewards were once astronomical to him, they had become of little significance to his current self.
He had done quite a few things in the past days.
One of them was to annihilate the Void Clan before leaving.
Leaving this Race behind unsettle him as a chance occurrence could have allowed these Void Monsters to reach other Starfields, leading to an immediate spread of disaster. The number of these Void Monsters was indeed not small, and it took him with his current strength a full 18 hours to completely exterminate the Void Clan.
Their aggregated Life Value added over 300 billion to his total.
In other words, that was the number of all the Void Clan monsters, more than he had expected. Of course, this amount of Life Value was trivial to him, especially since the Ultimate Suit had nearly maxed out his life value anyway.
Moreover, his Life Value was shared with the entire Galaxy, making him virtually Immortal and Indestructible.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 710: Chapter 418: “The human world, truly fascinating.”_3 Chapter 710: Chapter 418: “The human world, truly fascinating.”_3 These things are just a small bonus, I guess.
It’s all about settling these matters before leaving the level-up game. This battle might end soon, or it might last a long time.
No one knows for sure.
After all, he doesn’t even know what this so-called cosmic race is.
Just when Chen Yi and the others were lost in thought.
The time had come.
Chen Yi glanced at his watch and said softly, “Time’s up, get ready to set off. Let’s go.”
The next second—
A prompt sounded in the ears of all players in the level-up game.
“Ding, announcement to all players in the level-up game!!!”
“Let us congratulate, under the leadership of player Chen Yi, Blue Star from Annihilation Starfield’s number 3 Star System Ninefold, for successfully advancing to become the 11th Tenfold Planet in the level-up game!!!”
“And the players of Sunflower Star will leave the level-up game under the leadership of Chen Yi and head deep into the cosmos to participate in the ‘Life and Death Race’!”
“Let us celebrate Chen Yi’s triumphant return!!!”
Unlike Jiang Chenglu’s upgrade, where he received a lot of rewards, including even a random max Prop reward, Chen Yi received no rewards for his upgrade this time.
Perhaps it was because the upgrade ranking was too far back; there really was no need for a reward for the 11th place.
And the task of upgrading to a Tenfold Planet was even simpler than Chen Yi had thought.
–
“Mission Name”: The Ultimate God Slaughter.
“Mission Objective”: Hold breath for 3 seconds.
“Mission Reward”: The affiliated planet upgrades to a Tenfold Planet.
–
It was that simple, essentially posing no difficulty.
But “no difficulty” refers to those who wanted to complete the mission. For those who didn’t want to complete it, this task could be said to be incredibly difficult.
He even felt a bit sorry for those who hadn’t upgraded to a Tenfold Planet and had postponed it until now.
After all, holding one’s breath for 3 seconds is very easy to do inadvertently in daily life.
And this mission was a passive one, automatically accepted once the planet had been upgraded to Ninefold. In other words, if you accidentally held your breath for more than 3 seconds, the mission would be completed immediately, and everyone would ascend.
Those leaders of the Ninefold planet didn’t even dare to breathe heavily when speaking. They had to keep breathing constantly even when silent, lest they accidentally complete the task and be forced to GG.
This was an extremely difficult thing.
Even if you could control it during the day, what about at night?
For someone deep in sleep, holding one’s breath for 3 seconds in a dream is entirely normal.
One can imagine the costs incurred by the leaders of these few Ninefold planets for this very reason.
Even Chen Yi relied on some Props to keep from accidentally completing the task and ascending prematurely.
But even so, it was still somewhat sinful; after all, you had to keep most of your attention on this throughout the entire day.
…
Almost in an instant.
The moment the announcement about Blue Star’s upgrade to a Tenfold Planet was made, many people looked up with complex expressions.
On Blue Star.
Li Yi took a deep breath as he looked at Blue Star, which had suddenly lost a large number of players, and said without taking time for sentiment, “Proceed with the established plan!!!”
“Priority is the protection of buildings!”
“The sss-level Tuberculosis Rabbit’s art gallery and sss-level Yi’s Garden District!!!”
“These two areas are to be cordoned off first, no one allowed to enter!”
“The rest of the troops, head to the major cities of Blue Star for vigilance patrols!”
This was the plan he and Tuberculosis Rabbit had agreed on long ago.
After Blue Star’s ascension, no one would be left, and this place contained many of Tuberculosis Rabbit’s memories that he did not want to be destroyed, including the art gallery and Yi’s Garden District.
These places were particularly important.
He and Wang Qi, along with everyone in Club 33, were ordered to guard the old sites of Blue Star for Yi and others to prevent them from being damaged by petty thieves.
Not a single person refused.
Everyone was excited; after all, they could predict that when Yi returned victorious, they would all become the greatest heroes. Would they lack for rewards or status then?
Of course not!
“Wait!”
Just as Wang Qi was about to take action, he suddenly furrowed his brow and looked at Li Yi, “Are you sure you want to cordon off the art gallery, forbidding anyone from entering? I remember Tuberculosis Rabbit saying when he left, that the art gallery should be open to the public during this time and allow entry to anyone who purchases a ticket.”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit seemed to say that he did not wish art to be sealed away forever. Only art that is seen and appraised by people can truly become a legacy.”
“Are you going to just seal it off?”
“…”
Li Yi gave Wang Qi a look of disdain, “No brainer, Tuberculosis Rabbit said that, but do you think we can really do it like that? Not to mention anything else, what if a fire breaks out in the art gallery during this crowded period?”
“What if a stampede results in the destruction of the artworks?”
“Are you going to take the blame for this, or am I? Who can bear this responsibility?”
“Seal it off. When Tuberculosis Rabbit comes back, we’ll just unseal it. At that time, no matter what happens, I’ll take all the blame!”
…
“It’s finally ending.”
In the Snow Sea Project Team’s office above Blue Star, Jin Buhuan stood in place, his expression showing slight emotion as he looked at the overhead view of Blue Star on the panel in front of him; behind him, rows of employees stood filled with anticipation.
Today.
All these employees had put on their most treasured clothes, standing by, excited and ready, riveting their gaze on Jin Buhuan’s back. Although no one spoke, the scene felt as bustling as if it was filled with noise.

﻿Chapter 711: Chapter 418: “The human world, truly fascinating.”_4 Chapter 711: Chapter 418: “The human world, truly fascinating.”_4 Everyone knew that today was the most important day for them!
Blue Star had advanced to a Tenfold Planet, and the Snow Sea Project Team’s supporting role had come to an end. They had accumulated enough S-class Free Access to fully restore their player status and advance to a Ninefold Planet in one fell swoop.
Finally…
Finally, they could be real people, wander the continent, go on map explorations instead of being some ghostly office staff pounding away at some project.
Finally, they could rescue all the kin who toiled as janitors in hell and bring them back.
Reunite everyone together.
“Whew!”
Jin Buhuan took a deep breath, then turned to look at the employees behind him. After a brief pause, he suddenly started to laugh, “My friends, we’re going home!”
Right after that.
A notification instantly rang in everyone’s ears.
‘Ding, Jin Buhuan has activated 3 S-class Free Access, choosing to revive his race!’
‘And renaming the race “Dawn Clan”.’
‘Ding, Jin Buhuan has activated 1 S-class Free Access, “Dawn Clan” skips the Novice Period, successfully advancing to a Onefold Planet.’
‘Ding…’
A multitude of notification sounds buzzed incessantly.
After reviving their race, they would appear on a Novice Planet, go through the Novice Period once more, then slowly integrate into the promotion game, retracing the path they once took, essentially reliving life from the womb.
But if they had enough S-class Free Access.
They could skip the whole Novice Period and directly advance to a Onefold Planet, and even beyond…
Quickly.
The last notification sound fell.
‘Ding, congratulations to the “Dawn Clan” for successfully advancing to a Ninefold Planet.’
Then.
An announcement rang once more in the ears of all players in the promotion game.
–
‘Ding, an announcement for all players of the promotion game!’
‘Players of Annihilation Starfield’s Ninefold Dawn Star, Jin Buhuan, led the Dawn Star from a Novice Planet to a Ninefold Planet within 10 minutes!’
‘Successfully breaking the fastest promotion record for planets in the promotion game!’
‘Unprecedented, an achievement no future generation could surpass!’
‘Absolutely shocking!’
‘This event shook countless players and has now been included in the annals of the promotion game, where it will leave a permanent mark in the game and a statue representing this event will be erected in the promotion game’s Hall of Honor.’
‘And they’ve earned a milestone in the promotion game!’
–
‘Milestone name: God in the Blink of an Eye!’
‘Conditions to Achieve: within 10 minutes, lead your planet from a Zerofold Planet to a Ninefold Planet…’
‘Let us congratulate Jin Buhuan for being the first player in the history of the promotion game to win this milestone.’
‘And for obtaining the Stellar Rank title “Blink God”!’
…
“…”
In the Annihilation Starfield, standing in the Wasteland, Jin Buhuan looked back at his employees and the surrounding players who were popping up with dazed expressions, and his lips slowly curled into a smile.
Perhaps it was due to always being Blue Star’s runner-up.
They had also been placed in the Annihilation Starfield.
This rather ordinary Annihilation Starfield had probably never dreamt that one day it would simultaneously boast two Ninefold Planets.
This was an existence never before seen in the promotion game.
A single mountain can’t house two tigers.
It’s impossible for a Starfield to accommodate two Ninefold Planets, and no Ninefold Planet would simply watch its neighbor grow to the same height as itself.
But now, the Annihilation Starfield did it.
No, perhaps it didn’t quite manage it.
Before the Dawn Clan’s promotion, Blue Star had already advanced to a Tenfold Planet and left. In some ways, Annihilation Starfield still only had one Ninefold Planet, the Dawn Clan.
“…”
Jin Buhuan stood still, gazing at the rising sun on the horizon. After a long silence, he suddenly took a deep breath, the weariness of many days falling away. The furrow in his brow relaxed, and he couldn’t help but throw open his arms and burst into an exuberant laugh.
No matter what it was like before.
No matter what they used to call their race.
But from today on, they will be known as the Dawn Clan, a name imbued with the promise of dawn.
It seemed there would never be a day for turning the tides but who could have expected that just as darkness was about to engulf the land, a blinding light of dawn, unstoppable by its very nature, would forcefully and mercilessly break through!
The players appearing out of thin air around him with dazed expressions were his former kin.
But having been janitors in hell for too long, their thinking had become sluggish and unclear, for in the deep recesses of hell, to be a janitor is torment within torment.
A normal person wouldn’t last a year or two, let alone three days without becoming brain dead.
The body lives on, but the mind has committed suicide.

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - 712 419
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 712: Chapter 419: ? Chapter 712: Chapter 419: ? “Where are we?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit looked around somewhat blankly at the unfamiliar world before him.
They had been promoted to the Tenfold Planet, and had left the game of promotion, or rather, they hadn’t completely left it but had arrived at a new battlefield, a new world.
What came into view was an extremely vast expanse of Wasteland.
However, the ground was not barren soil and weeds but was covered with extremely thick steel plates, stretching as far as the eye could see without end. The dim sunlight filtering through the clouds onto the steel plates created an illusion of a disconnect.
It was as if this shouldn’t be a real world.
“Clang!”
Chen Yi struck the ground with his cane, and the sound of metal clashing echoed.
Solid.
The sound was very muffled, and the steel plates were tightly fitted to the ground without a single gap, indicating that the surface of this expanse of Wasteland had been artificially leveled to extreme flatness.
All these steel plates… If it were before the descent of the promotion game on Blue Star, how much would they cost?
He estimated they must be 10 millimeters thick.
“Here you go.”
Just then—
From a distance, a young man with his hands in his pockets casually said, “Welcome, everyone. I thought you all were cowards, but it seems you’ve become quite brave recently.”
“Let me give a brief introduction.”
“We’re in the midst of a very brutal battlefield, but don’t worry for now; we are at the rear, which is relatively safe. And these steel plates, they were laid out by Emperor Jiang.”
“The enemy essentially possesses a peculiar ability to move freely underground, much like those damned maggots beneath the earth.”
“When we first encountered them, they caused us significant casualties. After we finally managed to build a base, those damned maggots surged from underground at our rear and inflicted heavy losses once more, forcing us to cover all our territories with these steel plates. This can prevent those maggots from burrowing up from the ground effectively.”
“Tch.”
As he spoke, the young man suddenly looked towards the distant city of steel with fanaticism and reverence in his eyes: “See that? Before I came here, there was nothing but Wasteland, and all that met the eye were countless enemies, only enemies.”
“It was Emperor Jiang who led us to slowly conquer our own domain and then establish a base of operations, starting a war of attrition.”
“I must say, your timing is impeccable. Had you not joined the battle in time, we would probably suffer many casualties in the decisive battle three days from now.”
The young man suddenly paused, and after a long while he shook his head reluctantly, saying, “Alright, although admitting this fact feels a bit shameful, without your timely support, we’d probably be facing extinction in the decisive battle three days from now.”
“The number of enemies is indeed overwhelming.”
“Thank you. We misunderstood you before.”
“No problem.”
Chen Yi nodded thoughtfully without speaking. The person before him must be one of Jiang Chenglu’s people, belonging to the Mo Clan, the first to ascend to the Tenfold Planet. It seemed their arrival was quite timely?
The decisive battle was in three days?
If he hadn’t timely sent those nine Ninefold planets over, Jiang Chenglu might have really been unable to hold on?
“Hey, wait a minute.”
The young man suddenly came to a realization, stepping back with a strange expression, examining Chen Yi with doubt, “If I’m not mistaken, apart from our Mo Clan, there are only nine Ninefold planets in the promotion game, right?”
“And among these nine Ninefold planets, eight ascended to the Tenfold Planet seven days ago and have entered the main city.”
“Who are you?”
“A newly promoted Ninefold planet? Or the remaining Ninefold planet?”
Chen Yi scanned the surroundings without offering much explanation, and with one hand on his cane, he walked towards the steel city in the distance, “Didn’t those Ninefold planets tell you how they got promoted?”
“They did,” the young man hurriedly followed, adding, “They said they were worried that Emperor Jiang couldn’t hold on outside, conscience-stricken night and day during the promotion game, unable to bear the thought of Emperor Jiang fighting alone, so they decided to ascend together.”
“They’d rather die in battle with Emperor Jiang than live a cowardly existence in the promotion game.”
“Pretty good.”
Chen Yi chuckled and nodded, “My name is Chen Yi, a player from Blue Star. These people behind me are my kin. I’m going to take a look in the city. Would you mind arranging for these people here?”
“They don’t need to be sent to the front lines.”
“For the front lines, I alone am enough.”
Having said that,
he led the Tuberculosis Rabbit and a few others towards the city.
…
“What?”
Looking at Chen Yi’s retreating figure, the young man suddenly stiffened in place. It took him a while to catch his breath before he tremulously opened his friend list, found his superior, and spoke hastily, “Chen Yi, it’s Chen Yi, Chen Yi has come!!!”
He had never met Chen Yi.
During the promotion game, he had hardly heard the name.
After all, before he followed Emperor Jiang in ascending to the Tenfold Planet, Chen Yi didn’t have much of a reputation, being known only in small circles. Why would he, a proud Ninefold player, bother with a newcomer?
That would be demeaning himself, a total waste of time.
But after ascending to the Tenfold Planet, he had heard Emperor Jiang mention Chen Yi several times, leaving a deep impression of that name, even though he was unclear about its significance. If Emperor Jiang had mentioned it multiple times, surely this person was no ordinary individual.

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - 713 419 _2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 713: Chapter 419: ?_2 Chapter 713: Chapter 419: ?_2 And it seemed that he was the leader of this Ninefold Planet.
He had no idea who the leader of this group of players was, and the reason he had approached Chen Yi was a guess that Chen Yi might be the leader, partly because Chen Yi had an extraordinary demeanor. He simply stood in front of the crowd, with a few people who looked like subordinates by his side.
The surrounding players also looked at Chen Yi’s back with respect and adoration.
Such an aura couldn’t be feigned.
He was familiar with that look; it was the same one he had when looking at Emperor Jiang.
The second reason, and also the most important one, was that the man had so many titles above his head that it was nearly a hundred. The titles spanned tens of meters in height, shimmering in mid-air, emitting all sorts of glows.
And the names of those titles were each more intimidating than the last.
“One Man Exterminates a Clan!”
“Crushing Stars with Bare Hands!”
“…”
And so on.
In the crowd, he was incredibly conspicuous.
Then he took a deep breath before turning to look at the swarming players. He alone definitely couldn’t arrange the nearly hundred million players, but at this moment, his fellow clan members also received orders.
They started using megaphones to direct people batch by batch into the main city.
Fortunately, most of the players who had advanced to the Ninefold Planet were reasonable. No one caused trouble, and no one questioned why the process was so slow. Everything was progressing swiftly.
Especially since these people refrained from relieving themselves on the spot.
This was no joke.
With tens of millions gathered in one place, even if just one percent of them started to relieve themselves on the spot for various reasons, it would not be a small issue. Not to mention the spread of bacteria and such, just the experience alone could be said to be exceedingly poor.
…
And in the crowd.
“…”
Li Yide unconsciously swayed his Fox Tail, his face complex as he gripped the Jade Token in his arms tightly. His legs were trembling uncontrollably.
He was scared.
He feared the upcoming battle.
He knew what he would face, an exceedingly brutal and gruesome fight.
If it were any other time, he wouldn’t be scared at all. He wasn’t someone who feared death. When Blue Star was pulled into a Race Duel by a Threefold Planet in the Annihilation Starfield, he didn’t feel a hint of fear. Instead, he felt his blood boiling with rage!
He remembered that he was the first to charge out!
Such courage to disregarded life and death also garnered him a host of loyal followers. To be a leader, you must have personal charm, at the very least, you need courage.
But now he was afraid.
He had never before feared a battle as much as he did now.
When Blue Star advanced to a Ninefold Planet, he saw Xiaoqian, the one he longed for. Xiaoqian lay in his arms and talked to him about many things.
Xiaoqian talked about how she caused the annihilation of a world.
Xiaoqian explained that after the annihilation, as the Novice Period game descended, she was the only player, and it ended quickly.
Xiaoqian said she remembered he was on Blue Star, a Novice Planet. She searched innumerable places and finally found Blue Star in the Annihilation Starfield’s third star system but was unable to enter since Blue Star was still in its Novice Period.
Xiaoqian said she simply waited in the Annihilation Starfield, sitting in front of a calendar each day, awaiting the end of the Novice Period on Blue Star. When he asked if Xiaoqian found it boring, she said waiting for her brother was the second happiest thing in the world.
He remembered asking what the happiest thing was.
Xiaoqian replied that it was seeing him.
Ultimately, the Novice Period on Blue Star ended. On the day it was promoted to a Ninefold Planet, countless players came to Blue Star to congratulate Chen Yi and Blue Star. When countless gazes focused on Blue Star and on Chen Yi.
In the crowd.
Only Xiaoqian’s gaze, excited and fervent, never wavered from him.
Even when Chen Yi flew overhead, and everyone looked up at such a seldom scene legendary figure, Xiaoqian’s gaze remained fixed on him. That fervent look was the first time Li Yide felt truly cared for in this world.
But how could he deserve it?
He was just a man who went a little crazy and acted recklessly with his desires when the Thrilling World event came to Blue Star. How could he be deserving of such fervent admiration?
That day.
The fireworks of Yancheng burst forth.
Xiaoqian, her face full of happiness, stood on the rooftop with his arm around her, watching the fireworks outside Yancheng. He remembered her saying the fireworks were so beautiful, seeing her brother while watching the fireworks made life wonderful.
He had smiled and said the fireworks were prepared for Chen Yi; hadn’t she seen the words saying congratulations to Chen Yi?
Xiaoqian said, no matter, they were still beautiful to watch.
In the following seven days.
They stuck together all day. Xiaoqian had learned to speak, though not very fluently, they could communicate. Xiaoqian insisted he take her to all the places he had been.
Xiaoqian said she wanted to see how he had lived before.
Latter…
Later, just before they were about to leave, Xiaoqian suddenly hugged him from behind and whispered softly.
Brother, I found out half a month ago that I might be carrying your child. You must come back safely.
If there’s trouble, don’t try to be a hero, hide behind Chen Yi; he can protect you.
I want to tell the child all about your stories.
…
“Phew!”
In the crowd, Li Yide’s eyes reddened slightly, his body still trembling uncontrollably. Forget charging into battle, at this moment, he didn’t even have the courage to grasp a weapon; he was somewhat fearful of the imminent war.

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - 714 419 _3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 714: Chapter 419: ?_3 Chapter 714: Chapter 419: ?_3 He wanted to escape.
But he didn’t know where to escape to.
He didn’t want to die.
He couldn’t die, having lived a life in a daze, serving as a fool for quite a while, causing many jokes, and even embarrassing himself in anger, he discovered at the very end that someone in this world cared about him so much.
How could he possibly die, it was impossible for him to die!
Li Yide’s breathing became slightly hurried as he took a few deep breaths, forcibly calming himself down; his heart was too chaotic, it’s okay, it’s okay, everything would be okay.
With Chen Yi around, there wouldn’t be any problems.
He just needed to hide at the very back.
No matter what he saw, he just needed to keep hiding in the back, and never, ever step forward, never step forward, never step forward, never step forward, never step forward…
Li Yide repeated this to himself countless times, as if he were afraid of forgetting this important fact.
…
“Chen Yi!”
Just as they had arrived in front of the city, before Chen Yi had time to inspect the steel-built Great Wall before him, an excited voice reached his ears. Chen Yi instinctively turned his head, only to see Jiang Chenglu in a long robe, striding towards him with some haste.
“Good, good, good!!!”
Jiang Chenglu looked at Chen Yi, unable to help but let out a long sigh of relief, “It’s good that you’re here, after all, you were the ultimate weapon chosen long ago. With you here, there shouldn’t be a problem.”
“Time is pressing, there’s no time for a long chat, let’s keep it quick.”
“How strong are you now?”
“Strength?”
Chen Yi paused to think for a moment before responding, “Theoretically speaking, I should be an invincible being.”
“How invincible? Can you kill deities?”
“Yes.”
“Have you killed any?”
“I have, killed two of them, they were quite weak, died with just two slashes.”
“Deity projections?” Jiang Chenglu’s brows furrowed slightly, he found it hard to believe that deities could be killed off so easily, perhaps they were projections of spiritual deities, after all, he had also killed projections of spiritual deities, which even led to the first Wonder.
“They shouldn’t be.” Chen Yi shook his head: “According to a public announcement for all players of the Ascension game, I am the first player who has killed deities.”
“…”
A flicker of astonishment passed through Jiang Chenglu’s eyes, but then, without further thought, he turned and walked towards the entrance of the city wall beside him, “That’s good, time is of the essence, let’s talk while we walk.”
“Come with me.”
“You don’t have to worry about your clansmen, I’ve already arranged for them to stay in the residential area, they won’t be going to the frontline.”
“After all, according to what I know, you ascended from Ninefold to Tenfold Planet in just one day and then directly moved on to Tenfold Planet after seven days. Your clansmen, without much foundation, going into battle with such little strength would be a wasted effort.”
“Having you is enough.”
“The situation is somewhat complex, and when I say complex, it’s not that complex since it’s really just a question of one enemy. If we can just kill the enemy, that would be good, but the problem now is that the enemy can’t be killed, and that’s a big problem.”
“…”
Chen Yi, following behind Jiang Chenglu, was somewhat speechless; Jiang Chenglu had previously given off a very aloof impression, so why did it feel like he was being unnecessarily verbose this time? Weren’t they pressed for time? What was he talking about?
What did he mean by the situation being somewhat complex, but not complex, yet actually very complex?
This manner of speaking brought to mind a person from his past.
He glanced at Tuberculosis Rabbit by his side.
Sure enough, a glint flashed in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, seemingly sensing a kindred spirit.
…
Soon.
Jiang Chenglu led Chen Yi and the others to the highest point of the city, a small pavilion. This pavilion, also forged out of steel, looked quite sharp, reflecting a serious and solemn architecture.
Almost everything in the entire city was forged from steel, with not a hint of the feeling of life.
Of course, at this time, not many cared about a sense of life.
Compared to a sense of life, they were more concerned about whether they could continue to live.
And at that moment, there were already eight people standing in the little pavilion.
“Come, let me introduce everyone.”
Jiang Chenglu stood next to Chen Yi, pointing towards the eight individuals and spoke, “These eight are the leaders of the Eightfold Planets that you forced up here, I won’t go into the details of their names; even if I mentioned them, you, Chen Yi, wouldn’t remember them.”
“Just knowing who they roughly are is enough.”
The people below believed the nonsense spoken by these eight.
But he knew it clearly, if not for Chen Yi, these individuals would never have ascended to Ninefold Planet willingly, preferring to live in constant fear, lest they accidentally hold their breaths and ascend to Tenfold Planet, rather than actively moving to Tenfold Planet.
He knew these people had been pushed to ascend by Chen Yi.
What he didn’t know was exactly why these individuals were so obedient.
He could only guess a bit.
Before his ascension, there were in total ten Ninefold Planets in the Ascension game, including his Mo Clan and the other eight Ninefold Planets, but only eight had come up here, with the Kui Race missing.
Whenever he brought up the subject of Kui Race, these people would fall silent.
The strength of Kui Race was about the same as these Ninefold Planets’, there was no reason why these individuals were coerced by Chen Yi into ascending, while Kui Race could hold out until the end.
If nothing was out of the ordinary, Kui Race must have been made an example of.
In other words, they must have been wiped out.
However, this suspicion was something he found hard to confirm in his heart. After all, wiping out a Ninefold Planet was a notion that seemed too far-fetched, something he found difficult to accept.

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - 715 419 _4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 715: Chapter 419: ?_4 Chapter 715: Chapter 419: ?_4 Take our opponents this time, for example, are they strong?
Strong!
But we’ve been warring with the Mo Clan for so long, and they haven’t wiped us out, have they? Instead, they managed to fight their way to their own base?
A Ninefold Planet, especially one inhabited by a race as deeply grounded as the Kui Race, who would think it easy to annihilate them?
Just as Jiang Chenglu was preparing to introduce Chen Yi to these eight individuals,
he suddenly found that the worried frowns and the gloom on their faces had all disappeared, as they all breathed a sigh of relief, their eyes shining with light, looking towards Chen Yi with a sense of barely concealed excitement.
“Yi is here, now we’re secure!”
“Yi, you’ve finally come, we’ve been waiting for you for so long!”
“Wuu, Yi, do you still remember me? Right after you annihilated the Kui Race, I was the first one to send a message thanking you for relieving me of a great hatred.”
“Look at me, Yi, when you promoted us to the Tenfold Planet, I was the first to be upgraded. Yi gives an order, who would dare to disobey?”
“…”
Jiang Chenglu’s mouth slowly widened as he gazed, somewhat bemused, at these leaders who now seemed somewhat unfamiliar to him. They were now the leaders of the Tenfold Planet, officially holding the same rank.
Just a few days ago, they were still tangled up with him over which race to send to the most dangerous areas and were caught up in constant schemes against each other.
Every one of them was a seasoned schemer, irritating others with their craftiness and cunning.
Now, why had they suddenly turned into underlings, calling him brother Yi with such ease? The youngest among you is old enough to be Chen Yi’s uncle; does it come naturally for you to call him “brother” so affectionately?
And if he wasn’t mistaken,
did someone just say, after you annihilated the Kui Race? Indeed, the Kui Race was wiped out by Chen Yi? Annihilated?
Jiang Chenglu’s mouth twitched slightly, as he suddenly began to understand why the people before him had suddenly sighed with relief. Having someone capable of single-handedly annihilating a Ninefold Planet joining them would certainly make them feel much less pressured.
It made him feel like things weren’t so urgent anymore.
Yet he still couldn’t get his head around it—how could a Ninefold Planet be so easily wiped out? What about their heritage? Their props? Their rule system props? Their Absolute Attribute props? Couldn’t they use them to avoid just watching themselves be annihilated?
It couldn’t possibly be the case that no matter what attack hit Chen Yi, he wouldn’t react at all, right?
He suddenly felt that Chen Yi’s statement from earlier—”theoretically, invincible”—might not have been boasting after all.
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi, with one hand in his pocket, leaning on his cane, glanced over the people in front of him and said with a half-smile, “I just heard people saying that you were worrying about whether Emperor Jiang could hold up outside, feeling guilty day and night in the upgrade game and truly distressed about it.”
“That’s why you chose to advance to the Tenfold Planet.”
“Preferring to die in battle with Emperor Jiang rather than lingering on in the upgrade game.”
“Is that so?”
…
ps: Something’s not quite right, I might almost be gone. The new book had been scheduled to launch on November 8th since last month. I thought to myself, with over forty days left and updating seven thousand words a day, that amounts to two or three hundred thousand words. That should be enough to complete the end of this book.
But… somehow, something went wrong.
Could it be that I’ve been dragging my feet a bit?
That shouldn’t be the case.
The end has to provide a clear explanation for everything mentioned before. But judging by the current pace, it looks like I’ll need another ten to twenty thousand words to wrap things up properly, and then there’s likely another extra hundred thousand or so words for side stories.
I might be forced to work on two books at the same time for another seven or eight days.
No, that won’t do!
I can’t do two at once; trying to think about the plots for two books at the same time would overload my brain. I need to make an effort tonight and see if I can finish the ending.
Fuck.
Why does my PS always seem so lame? I really am a scrub!
–
Jiang Chenglu stood beside Chen Yi, pointing to the nine people as he spoke, “These eight are the leaders of the Ninefold Planets you forced to ascend, whose names need not be introduced in detail. With a total of eight names, even if I introduce them, Chen Yi, you wouldn’t remember them.”
“As long as I know roughly who they are.”
The people below believed the nonsense these eight spouted.
But he knew very clearly that if it weren’t for Chen Yi, these people would never ascend to the Ninefold Planet, preferring to live their whole lives in constant fear of accidentally holding their breath and ascending to the Tenfold Planet than to ascend voluntarily.
Although he was clear that these people were forced to ascend by Chen Yi,
he didn’t understand why they were so obedient.
He could still guess a bit, though.
Before his ascension, there were a total of ten Ninefold Planets, and aside from his Mo Clan, there were nine other Ninefold Planets. Yet only eight have ascended here; the Kui Race is missing.
As soon as the Kui Race was mentioned, these people would fall into silence.
The strength of the Kui Race was roughly similar to that of these Ninefold Planets; there was no reason Chen Yi could force these people to ascend, and the Kui Race could hold out until the end.
If nothing was out of the ordinary, the Kui Race must have been made an example of—a scarecrow tactic.
In other words, they were simply annihilated.
But this speculation was still hard for him to accept, obliterating a Ninefold Planet seemed too sci-fi; he found it hard to accept.
Like their current enemy, were they strong?
Strong!
But their Mo Clan had been in combat for so long, hadn’t they themselves wiped out tribes? Instead, they allowed their enemy to establish a stronghold?
A Ninefold Planet, especially a race as profound as the Kui Race, how could they be easily annihilated?
Just as Jiang Chenglu was about to introduce Chen Yi to these eight people,
he suddenly found that the worried and grim expressions on these people’s faces instantly vanished. They all took a deep breath, their eyes shining brightly, and when they looked towards Chen Yi, they even seemed somewhat excited.
“Yi’s here, now we’re secure!”
“Yi, you’re finally here. We’ve been waiting for you for so long!”
“Sniff, Yi, do you still remember me? After you eliminated the Kui Race, I was the first to send a message thanking you for ridding me of a great enmity.”
“Look at me, Yi. When you ordered us to ascend to the Tenfold Planet, I was the first to do so. Yi’s word is law—who would dare disobey?”
“…”
Jiang Chenglu’s mouth slowly gaped open, somewhat baffled as he looked at these leaders who now seemed a bit unfamiliar. Now they were the chiefs of the Tenfold Planet, and ostensibly, they held equal status.
In the past few days, they had been constantly engaged in disputes with him about which race should be sent to the most dangerous regions, each scheming and plotting.
Each one of them was a crafty old fox, cunning and exasperating.
How come they suddenly turned into subordinates, with a “Yi” coming out of their mouths so smoothly? The youngest among you could be Chen Yi’s uncle—how can you call him brother so naturally?
And if he wasn’t mistaken?
These people had been constantly engaged in disputes with him about which race should be sent to the most dangerous regions, each one scheming and plotting.
Each one was a crafty old fox, cunning and exasperating.
How come they suddenly turned into subordinates, with a “Yi” coming out of their mouths so smoothly? The youngest among you could be Chen Yi’s uncle—how can you call him brother so naturally?
And if he wasn’t mistaken?

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - 716 420 No need for coordinates just point a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 716: Chapter 420: No need for coordinates, just point a direction. Chapter 716: Chapter 420: No need for coordinates, just point a direction. “That…”
The eight looked at each other. Without speaking, they all saw the same thought in each other’s eyes.
Before Chen Yi’s arrival, although they were aware of the impending disaster, they had to save face to conserve their living forces; after all, whoever had the least manpower would be the first to be eliminated in this final battle.
None of them wanted to fail in the final battle, but…they also didn’t want to become the first race to be eliminated.
But Chen Yi came.
Perhaps the game could now be played differently. After all, Jiang Chenglu might not have been fully aware of Chen Yi’s strength. They had all watched how Chen Yi annihilated the Kui Race in an exceedingly overwhelming battle.
Facing Chen Yi’s sky-covering barrage, the Kui Race of Ninefold Planet didn’t even manage to organize a proper counterattack; they could only be on the receiving end of the beating throughout the process. It was a barefaced massacre.
In less than half a day, the Kui Race didn’t even understand why they were exterminated before they disappeared forever from the game of escalating planets.
It was a war that could make anyone who saw it despair.
To say the least, after watching that war, they deeply doubted more than once that even if all eight of their races teamed up, they might still be no match for Chen Yi. But soon, they stopped doubting and began to firmly believe it.
Although they were in agreement internally, they looked at each other, hesitating to speak.
More terrifying than Chen Yi’s strength was his disposition. Just to put them in their place and to make them listen, the Kui Race was wiped out with no prior quarrels with Chen Yi.
This situation.
It was even more frightening. It meant that Chen Yi could possibly exterminate someone’s entire race at any time if he took displeasure in them.
“Hm?”
Jiang Chenglu, standing still, gradually began to look dissatisfied, and with a hoarse voice, he declared word by word, “I’ll say it again, what are you looking at him for? The Blue Star player lacks deep roots. Could it be that you want to let the Blue Star player bet on plugging this hole?”
“Alright.”
Chen Yi, leaning on his cane, shook his head and interrupted Jiang Chenglu with a calm, soft voice, “Where is that place you were talking about just now?”
“I’ll go.”
“You’re going alone?”
Jiang Chenglu was slightly startled and then immediately shook his head, “No, this is no joke. The area is too large, and one person, no matter how strong, cannot control the entire situation.”
“This kind of battlefield requires a legion-style sweep to leave no stone unturned.”
“Let’s try.”
Chen Yi’s expression remained neutral, but confidence inadvertently seeped through his tone.
“This…”
After hesitating for a long while, Jiang Chenglu finally nodded, “Alright, after all, Chen Yi, you are one of the strongest forces on our side. You go ahead and try so that we can understand the extent of your combat power, which will make it easier to assign roles in subsequent actions.”
“I’ll send you the exact coordinates, and then…”
Chen Yi turned to look at the forest to the east, “You said those War Points were behind that forest in the east?”
“Is that the direction?”
He raised his hand toward the east.
“Yes, that direction,” Jiang Chenglu nodded in affirmation. “But it’s a vast area; I’ll send you the detailed coordinates.”
“Is there anyone of ours in that direction?”
“No.”
“Do you still want that forest?”
“Actually, I wouldn’t mind not having it, but that forest has its unique features. The trees are extremely hard, and it would take a lot of time to chop them down. Many believers take shelter in this forest and assassinate our people, causing many casualties.”
“Understood.”
Chen Yi tapped his cane lightly and caressed the ring on his thumb before lighting a cigarette and putting it to his mouth, “Then it’s much simpler.”
The next second—
It suddenly grew dark around them as if all the light were swallowed up!
Jiang Chenglu instinctively looked up to the sky, and almost immediately, they all stiffened in shock, holding their breath!
Above them,
Countless Buddha figures sat in the lotus position on top of massive flying disks with menacing firepower, with numerous flowers of the other shore fluttering around them. Additionally, through the gaps, a dense array of meteors burning fiercely could be seen heading toward the forest in the east!
For a moment,
An enormous array of attacks ready to be unleashed appeared out of nowhere in the sky, covering the entire sky and even blocking out the sunlight.
The sky mutated.
The scene before them did not last long, as these numerous attacks then sped towards the east with an unimaginable velocity!
“Boom!!!”
Along with countless deafening explosions, the smoke of gunpowder slowly dissipated.
When the smoke cleared,
The forest in the east was gone, revealing a Wasteland with an extremely clear view.
As for the so-called War Points hidden behind the forest, there was no need for speculation; they were gone too. No one could have survived under such a bombardment!
…
“That’s how it should be!”
The chieftain of the Ninefold Planet AR Race, standing behind Chen Yi, couldn’t help but excitedly punch the air, “That’s how we should crush them! Slaughter them! Leave them no chance to resist!”
“Yi is awesome!”
Just as they thought.
Although they had ascended to Tenfold Planet, they didn’t need to gamble their entire race’s strength to perish with the Deities. They just needed to ensure that they wouldn’t lose the war while preserving their living forces as much as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - 717 420 No need for coordinates just point a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 717: Chapter 420: No need for coordinates, just point a direction._2 Chapter 717: Chapter 420: No need for coordinates, just point a direction._2 Then just wait for Yi to arrive.
Just like that.
…
“I don’t need specific coordinates to kill.”
Chen Yi looked at the scene before him, turned his head to Jiang Chenglu and said with a light laugh, “Having a direction is enough, how about it? With me here, do you feel more confident about this war?”
…
Jiang Chenglu’s mouth slowly gaped as he looked at the scene before him, speechless, only feeling that Chen Yi’s strength might be excessively outrageous.
This was the strength of a solo player?
It was stronger than an entire group army!
But he soon recovered and let out a long sigh of relief, “Indeed, your strength is stronger than I imagined. Worthy of being a being who can slaughter gods. With you here, our hope for victory in this war is much greater.”
“But such an existence’s attack shouldn’t hurt deities, should it?”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi shrugged his shoulders and was just about to say something when he was suddenly interrupted by a deafening voice from the sky.
“Trash!”
The figure of a middle-aged man, a kilometer tall and shirtless, stepping on two massive ghostly heads, emerged from a war fissure in the sky, which nobody knew when had appeared, looking down at the battlefield to the east that had been wiped out.
And at Jiang Chenglu and the others standing at the top of the city.
His face slightly hidden as he cursed loudly.
“A bunch of ants, trying to block the glorious return of the God of Hell!”
“Since you wish to witness my power, then let me show you the strength of a god!”
“Ridiculous!”
“A bunch of sewer vermin, gaining strength by stealing divine power to create props, actually think they can match the power of deities.”
“How could you ants even hope to covet the power of deities!”
The moment this deity appeared, he captured everyone’s pupils, his body surrounded by a thick black aura that seemed extremely sinister, and his kilometer height was extremely oppressive.
Even if this weren’t a deity, just an ordinary monster, one stab.
Probably wouldn’t even penetrate the outer layer of skin.
The strength that comes with such a huge body size multiplies exponentially.
…
All the players inside the city who had settled down at their respective posts, as well as those still being settled, couldn’t help but flash a look of despair in their eyes when they saw the self-proclaimed God of Hell appearing above them.
They even felt their breathing stop.
Even though the deity hadn’t made a move yet, they all felt a strong sense of oppression.
This was a crisis of extinction.
Except for Chen Yi, it was the first time all other players were facing a deity directly!
Even the leaders from the Ninefold Planet had gone pale, forcefully calming themselves down, trying not to show weakness or embarrassment.
…
The moment the deity appeared, Jiang Chenglu fell silent. After listening to the deity’s declaration, he slowly took a deep breath, removed a string of jade beads from his wrist, and stuffed it into Chen Yi’s arms.
“My child is about to be born, give this to him.”
“It has been passed down from my ancestors.”
“I’ll handle him.”
Then he turned to his deputy, “The deities have joined the battle early, initiate Plan 1S. I’ll go hold off the deity. Command of the entire army is transferred to the leader from AR star; he is more capable of leading troops.”
“If…”
“Wait.”
Chen Yi stopped Jiang Chenglu, who was about to step forward, and frowned slightly, “Why sound like you’re giving last words? Do you need to go? Have you forgotten that I killed a deity in the ascension game?”
“It’s different.”
Jiang Chenglu sighed lightly, looking up at the deity who was temporarily motionless above them and spoke softly, “The deities in the ascension game were in a slumbering stage, their divine power not fully restored, quite weakened.”
“But the deity here is in his prime, different from those slumbering ones in the ascension game.”
“Chen Yi, you can’t withstand him.”
“I have a technique that might slay a deity in his prime, but the chance of survival isn’t high. It’s better that I go.”
…
Chen Yi glanced at Jiang Chenglu without speaking further and then looked at the despairing faces of the players inside the city, including those from Blue Star who were pale and weak-kneed standing in place, waiting for death. This made him somewhat displeased.
The next second—
An announcement rang in the ears of all players in the city.
「Area Announcement (Chen Yi)」: “I, Chen Yi, am the only true god in this world!”
“Anyone else who claims to be a deity shall meet death!”
Immediately after, everyone saw a blinding slash of light from the long sword raised by Chen Yi, its speed slow enough that everyone could clearly see the light moving slowly towards the deity in the sky.
And the deity, as if stunned, changed his expression but didn’t move, simply standing still as if wondering what to do.
Finally!
The crimson blade slowly hit the deity, and the moment the blade light vanished, the nearly kilometer-tall deity exploded into a shower of blood in mid-air.
And the announcement sounded again.
「Battlefront Bulletin」: Blue Star player Chen Yi from the Tenfold Planet successfully slew the God of Hell at the front lines, let us…
「Battlefront Bulletin」:…
Three consecutive announcements.
It made all the players realize one thing: the oppressive deity had died, just like that.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 718 420 No need for coordinates just point a
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 718: Chapter 420: No need for coordinates, just point a direction._3 Chapter 718: Chapter 420: No need for coordinates, just point a direction._3 Not a ripple stirred.
Not even a hint of resistance was put up before blood splattered high into the sky!
The entire city fell into a silent hush; after a brief silence, countless players roared with excitement, thrilled to have such a powerful leader on their side.
Especially the Blue Star players, who were particularly loud in their cheering!
Excitement!
This was their man from Blue Star!
It was their chief!
…
Meanwhile, Jiang Chenglu, who had already decided to go forward and fight to the death, looked at the scene before him, frozen in place, before finally coming to his senses. He looked towards Chen Yi with a face full of shock, “You… you killed a deity?”
“Hmm.”
“One-shot kill?”
“Yeah.”
“What did you use, a prop or a skill? How long is the cooldown? Or is it a one-time thing? Such secret moves should be kept for the finale of a decisive battle, now…”
Just as Jiang Chenglu was speaking with a hint of worry and hastiness.
Chen Yi casually lifted his hand, and immediately over a dozen scarlet blade lights, just like before, shot out, disappearing into the clouds out of sight.
“No cooldown, use as I please.”
“It’s not a secret move, just a basic attack, nothing more. Nothing worth calling a secret move.”
“…”
Jiang Chenglu, already shocked to the core, looked up at the dozen or so scarlet blade lights disappearing into the clouds and fell completely silent. He was expressionless and didn’t know what to say, it was only after quite some time that he spoke in a low voice.
“Are you really invincible?”
“Yeah, didn’t I say so when we first met?”
“I didn’t think you meant literally invincible. How about your defense? High offense, low defense?”
“Not at all, my defense is stronger than my attack. It’s called Absolute Defense.”
“And control abilities?”
“Absolutely immune to control.”
“Alright.” Chen Yi patted Jiang Chenglu on the shoulder, “Let’s not ask so many questions. I know you want to end the war quickly to go home and hug your wife and kids. Just tell me the plan, and how to execute it.”
“I’ll cooperate with you.”
“In this regard, I really don’t understand much. I have a good habit. In areas I don’t understand, I never try to take the lead.”
“Is that so?”
Jiang Chenglu said quietly as he looked up at the blood rain still falling from the sky, “What about this spotlight then?”
“Swish swish!”
Chen Yi casually flicked his hand, and again hundreds of scarlet blade lights, just like before, shot out. He looked seriously at Jiang Chenglu, “Can’t help it, I really understand this area.”
…
After some time passed.
Jiang Chenglu finally calmed his emotions down and turned to look at the eight leaders from Tenfold Planet behind him, realizing that everyone had a look of vicarious pride as if they had known this all along.
He finally understood why these people had been looking to Chen Yi from the start.
These people knew more than he did.
With the existence of Chen Yi.
All battle plans were superfluous; one simply needed to find the direction of the enemy and steamroll over them.
“I declare!”
Jiang Chenglu slowly raised his right hand, issuing a regional announcement with a sonorous and powerful voice, word by word, “All combat plans are cancelled, all corps retreat to the vicinity of the main city to assume a defensive posture.”
“We launch the total assault!”
“We officially declare war on the Deities!”
“Assault personnel—”
“Chen Yi, alone!”
“The end of the war is within sight, thank you all for your hard work!”
After finishing these words, Jiang Chenglu couldn’t help but let out a sigh of relief, shaking his head with a smile. It had been a long time since he had felt this relaxed; these past days, the Mo Clan’s players had been withstanding the tide-like attacks of the Divine Corps without a moment’s respite.
It was only after several other Ninefold Planets ascended that the situation slightly improved.
And with the arrival of Chen Yi, the problem was completely solved.
“Then the hard work is up to you,” Jiang Chenglu said to Chen Yi with a smile, “Doesn’t it seem a bit poor to broadcast it, with only you, Chen Yi, as the total personnel? It’s as if we are treating you like a hired hand.”
“Not at all.”
Chen Yi shook his head and said, “If it were not for your Mo Clan taking the lead in ascending to a Tenfold Planet and coming here to help us hold off the attacks from outside, our player progression in the game might have come under the attack of the Divine Corps, and I wouldn’t have been able to develop. Maybe I would have been exterminated during my Novice Period.”
“You have made many sacrifices.”
“You make it sound as if I am very noble, but in fact, I just want my unborn child to live in a peaceful world.”
“It’s all the same.”
“I’m off.”
Without further words, Chen Yi took a coordinate from the hand of Sword Without End, stepped out into the void with one foot, and disappeared on the spot.
This coordinate marked the location of the Divine Corps and the Deities. As long as these individuals were killed, the war would end.
The coordinate information was simple.
“All areas except for those surrounding the main city.”
…
This time.
He did not return for seven days.
On the eighth day, as the first rays of the morning sun slowly spilled onto the land, Chen Yi, unstained by blood, came from afar, trailing behind him nine chained Deities.
Each Deity was a kilometer tall.
In contrast, Chen Yi walking at the front appeared exceedingly small.
And yet, the faces of these Deities were etched with terror, lacking any of the fearful presence of Deities.
“Here.”
Chen Yi, leading the nine Deities and stopping on the pavilion, handed one of the Deities to Jiang Chenglu with a smile, “Here, you gave me a life before your last ascension, thanks for that. I got quite a few rewards from that encounter and was able to grow much faster.”
“This time, I bring you a Deity.”
“I got a bit carried away when fighting, and before I knew it, I was left with only this one. Here, have it for a bit of fun.”
“After all, the world is about to be peaceful, and you have not had the chance to kill a Deity before, which is quite a pity.”
“Do you like it?”
“I do,” Jiang Chenglu didn’t stand on ceremony and boldly took the Deity, whose heart was pierced by chains from Chen Yi’s hand, and couldn’t help letting out a loud laugh, “Hey, you’re right, this feeling is pretty strange.”
“Hmm.”
Chen Yi also smiled, handing the remaining eight spiritual deities over to Tuberculosis Rabbit, “Here, these eight are for you guys to have a bit of fun killing. And Tuberculosis Rabbit, don’t you like collecting art pieces?”
“These few Deities would make fine specimens for art collections, providing material for future historians to study.”
“After all, this is a history that’s quite astonishing.”
“In the history of Blue Star, this belongs to an exceptionally discontinuous batch.”

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 719 421 Lets Say Goodbye Then. (The Grand
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 719: Chapter 421: Let’s Say Goodbye Then. (The Grand Finale!) Chapter 719: Chapter 421: Let’s Say Goodbye Then. (The Grand Finale!) And just then—
A notification sound suddenly rang in the ears of all players!
“Ding, an announcement to all players of the Ascension game!”
“Let us congratulate the players of Tenfold Planet, Desert Star, Blue Star, AR Planet, and other planets, who, under the leadership of Chen Yi, achieved an absolutely crushing victory in the Universal Competition of Life and Death.”
“The deities are dead! The shackles have been broken!”
“A new world has finally arrived, to be written by all of us together!”
“We thank all players for their long-term companionship. As for whether the existence of the Ascension game was a boon or a bane, let posterity decide. This will be the final announcement to all players of the Ascension game; hereafter, the Ascension game will come to an end.”
“Before the official end of the Ascension game, all the reserved divine power of the Ascension game will be expended to execute the following measures!”
“1: All planets that have been infiltrated by the deities and turned into their lackeys, shall be eradicated.”
“2: All planets that have merged into the Starfield will revert to their planetary form and merge into the universe, canceling functions like the Starfield Shuttle. Henceforth, players will no longer be able to use this function to travel to other planets.”
“3: All functions of the Ascension game will be canceled, retaining only basic features such as chat channels, friends lists, and inventory warehouses. Functions like the Star Map, prop mart, and mission list will be permanently closed, and all props, skills, and titles obtained by players will retain their effects.”
“4: All maps will be closed, and players forcibly stranded in them will be sent back to their original planets in batches.”
“5: For all players deep in the depths of hell, regrettably, these players have already truly died. They were only granted a sliver of divine power to retain a semblance of consciousness and to clear crises that arose during the operation of the Ascension game. However, the Ascension game will grant them a little more divine power, allowing the players serving as janitors in the depths of hell to return freely to their home planets for 7 days to see their homeland, after which they will die permanently.”
“In 7 hours, the Ascension game will become history!”
“Thank you to all players for creating history together, and also to all who have made sacrifices in this process.”
“A special thanks to players Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, Jiang Chenglu, Sword Without End, among others.”
“So let’s say our goodbyes.”
…
With the fall of that notification.
All players of the Ascension game stared blankly upwards at the sky above their heads. It’s over? Did everything just suddenly end like this?
Are we at peace?
Players who were in the midst of life-and-death battles for a moment struggled to adapt to the peace that had come so quickly.
“It’s over?”
Standing in the middle of the city’s pavilion, Chen Yi, upon hearing the prompt by his ear, turned his head to the people beside him and raised an eyebrow, “The planets have returned to their original state, and the Starfield Shuttle can’t be used anymore. I guess we probably won’t be able to meet again. Our Blue Star technology hasn’t even developed to the point where we can travel to other lifeforms’ planets…”
“Actually, before the Ascension game arrived, we hadn’t precisely discovered any planets with dense life activity nearby.”
“We are the same.”
The leaders of several Tenfold Planets exchanged glances and saw the sentiment and complexity in each other’s eyes. The end of the war was good, but the thought that everyone might never see each other again filled them with an inexplicable rush of emotions.
“These years, we’ve been at odds with each other countless times. Now that we’re suddenly parting ways, to be honest, I’m a bit reluctant to let you go.”
“Tell me about it, I understand you guys better than my own wife. I even know that you wipe your ass with just your left hand when you go to the toilet. The thought of separating from you is a bit sad.”
“Damn, how do you even know that?”
“Are you kidding? Our AR Star’s intelligence infiltration has always been the strongest, okay?”
“Now that it’s all ending, tell me, who around me did you plant?”
“The chef.”
“The chef is your man?”
“Not him. Apart from your cook, everyone else is my man. I had a few others, but with a little manipulation, they all became my people.”
“…”
After a long silence, a voice emerged faintly, “Does that mean it would have been easy for you to kill me before?”
“Indeed, it wouldn’t have been very difficult.”
“Then why didn’t you do it?”
“Why kill you? I already understand you well. If you died and a new person took over, I’d have to start understanding them from scratch. Plus, it might cause severe conflict. It wasn’t worth it.”
“Thanks for sparing my life.”
“Don’t mention it.”
“It’s nothing, really. I forgot to tell you, your wife is one of my people; she’s my cousin.”
“Bullshit, my wife clearly belongs with me on AR Star. What does she have to do with you?”
“Races can be changed, didn’t you know?”
…
“Finally, we can go home.”
Jiang Chenglu stood at the edge of the pavilion, his hands resting on the railing as he gazed toward the increasingly illusory horizon, a faint smile playing on his lips, “Once everything is over, what are you guys going to do?”
“I plan to open a martial arts school and teach people martial arts.”
“Do you even know how to do that?”
Chen Yi, resting his arm on the railing, lit a cigarette and took a drag before handing another one to Jiang Chenglu, “I might just continue loafing around. I really enjoy those laid-back days. Either that or open a small clinic or something, be a doctor or something.”
“You know medicine?”
“Not really, but with all these props on me, treating an illness is pretty trivial, right?”
“That’s true.”
Jiang Chenglu nodded and looked around at the others before suddenly smiling again, “In a few more hours, everything will return to normal, and then who knows when we’ll see each other again. So how about it, let’s have a drink together?”
Chen Yi, Tuberculosis Rabbit, and the other leaders from Tenfold Planet exchanged glances and all started laughing together.
“Of course.”
…
“Cheers!”
Joyous celebration echoed within the pavilion in the city, as Jiang Chenglu raised his glass, devoid of his usual authority. Now that the war was over, he no longer needed to maintain that facade and could finally revert to his true self. Excited, he raised his voice.
“To celebrating our newfound peace!”
“Even though we won’t see each other again after this, we still have the chat channel. Let’s keep in touch regularly, share bits of our lives, and keep each other in mind. One day, once our Desert Star’s technology has advanced enough to cross the cosmos, I’ll come find you guys for another drink!”
“Damn, you guys. When it’s time to disobey orders, just disobey. Why do you have to talk back? Several times, I almost couldn’t hold back my laughter. I have a low threshold for laughter, okay? What if I burst out laughing? How could I lead the team after that?”
…
Soon.
Three hours had passed.
Everything had returned to how it was, and Chen Yi was back on Blue Star’s familiar rooftop. Everything had come back, and Blue Star had detached from Annihilation Starfield, resuming its spherical shape again.
Blue Star’s population had increased quite a bit.
Players from the depths of hell couldn’t return, but players from Blue Star who were in hell were indeed forcibly relocated back.
This made Blue Star suddenly much livelier, as most of its players had been in hell.
And on the table next to the rooftop lounge chair,
there was a letter.
It was left by Li Yi, who evidently found it very difficult to accept that he was being forcibly sent back like this and that he might never see the others again, so he left behind a letter thousands of words long, expressing his reluctance and gratitude for this period.
Wang Qi left a VCR message as well, also to say goodbye.
And there were many messages from people in the chat channel.
Jiaye leaned against Chen Yi’s chest, blissfully enjoying the silent moment.
Chen Yi stood quietly at the edge of the rooftop, looking down at the bustling Yancheng below. After a long while, the corners of his mouth lifted slightly.
“Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
“Hmm?”
“Shall we play a game for a bit?”
“Heh.” Tuberculosis Rabbit was momentarily startled before grinning, “Did your memories come back, Yi?”
Chen Yi smiled and didn’t reply, just wrapped an arm around Tuberculosis Rabbit’s shoulder and punched him lightly in the chest, “You’ve worked hard these years.”
“Hey, we’re all fucking brothers, there’s no need for that talk.”
The perspective slowly elevated.
Under the twilight, the laughter of Chen Yi and his companions standing on the rooftop gradually dispersed in the wind.
(The End.)
(The book is finished.)

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 720 Spin-off 1 Li Yide
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 720: Spin-off 1: Li Yide. Chapter 720: Spin-off 1: Li Yide. “Phew!”
Hiding among the crowd in the main city, Li Yide looked up at Chen Yi, who could kill a deity with a casual strike, and suddenly felt much more at ease in his heart. With Chen Yi here, they would definitely be able to win this war with peace of mind.
He would be able to go home smoothly.
Once this was over, everything would calm down, and he could officially marry Xiaoqian.
Nothing would stand in their way anymore.
At that moment, he also heard the announcement issued by Jiang Chenglu through his ears. They were about to launch a counterattack, and the only person going on the offensive was Chen Yi, yet everyone was brimming with boundless confidence in him. After witnessing that scene, not a single person doubted that Chen Yi could be defeated.
Li Yide felt the same way.
But as hours passed and Chen Yi had not returned, the main city was filled with disturbances.
Countless soldiers were running around quickly, as if rushing to a certain location.
Even the military forces that were originally in charge of settling them down had vanished without a trace, clearly indicating that manpower was insufficient.
Feeling a wave of unease, Li Yide hesitated for just a moment before he slipped away from the crowd, concealing himself in a residential house nearby.
…
“…”
In the house, Li Yide stood by the window, looking out at the chaos with a trace of worry in his heart, not knowing what was happening outside. No announcements were made, and he had no clue what was going on, only that everything had suddenly become chaotic.
And just then—
He suddenly heard some noise behind him.
Startled, he instinctively turned to look and saw that a steel plate on the floor of the room had developed cracks at some point. It seemed as if a torrential beast was ramming against it from below, causing the plate to vibrate violently. He could even see the dust undulating on the plate.
“Damn it!”
Seeing this, his expression dramatically changed!
He naturally knew what lay beneath the steel plates. The followers of the deities had the ability to travel underground and could launch an attack from any point on the ground. Only steel plates could stop them.
However, whether it was due to the poor quality of the steel plate or some other reason, this plate looked like it was about to shatter.
Without a moment’s hesitation.
Li Yide took a few quick steps back and then rushed outside to the chaotic crowd, his expression fierce and hurried as he shouted, “Help! Help! There is a steel plate here about to break!”
“Someone come quickly!!!”
He was aware of the consequences if this steel plate shattered—countless members of the Divine Corps would come pouring out of this entrance like a tidal wave, starting a slaughter with the players in this city.
Perhaps other players could survive.
But this area was full of Blue Star players. He was well aware of their capabilities, and the Blue Star players would definitely not make it. If this spot broke open, none of the Blue Star players settled here would survive.
They would all die!
However…
The scene was too chaotic, the noise too loud, and not a single person noticed him speaking. Everyone was so panicked that they could only focus on what was right in front of them, ignoring anyone else.
A few who heard Li Yide’s voice didn’t stop; instead, they ran even faster without looking back.
