The Mo Clan players responsible for settling them were nowhere to be found, apparently all called away due to some emergency.
“Damn it all!!”
Li Yide suddenly felt a sourness in his eyes as tears streamed down uncontrollably and took a trembling drag on a cigarette, not even bothering to inhale as he pinned all his hope on the dialogue box in front of him.
He was friends with Chen Yi.
As long as he could contact Chen Yi, even if he couldn’t get Chen Yi to come back and handle the crisis himself, at least Chen Yi could talk to Jiang Chenglu and have Jiang Chenglu send people to deal with it.
However.
After waiting for a dozen or so seconds, there was no response from Yi.
Li Yide, with a cigarette burning halfway through his fingers, stood at the doorway, turning sideways to look inside at the floor where the steel plate was about to break, calculating in his heart how long it would take for him to reach Jiang Chenglu through Fox Tail and how long the plate could last.
Standing there with red-rimmed eyes, he fell silent for a long time.
Panting heavily with a fierce expression, he thought.
Why? Why did it have to be like this? He was about to go home, about to live a peaceful and carefree life, about to enjoy the life he had envied all his life, and he finally had a girl who only had eyes for him.
But why? Why did he have to make this choice?
The lives of all Blue Star players put together didn’t weigh more in his heart than half a finger of Xiaoqian’s!
After a few breaths,
Li Yide stopped shouting for help, slowly closed the door, squatted on the ground with a long ash-laden cigarette dangling from his lips, staring blankly and vacantly at the steel plate that was about to break, and after a long while, he suddenly let out a bitter laugh.
He let the ash fall freely.
He suddenly realized he had no choice.
He could flee. Though he didn’t know how far he could get, there was always a slight chance of survival. But the other Blue Star players would most likely not make it. In the universal life-and-death game, death meant permanent death. There was no such thing as resurrection.
If these Blue Star players died, the Blue Star would be wiped out, and Chen Yi would die too.
Chen Yi had shown him kindness.
It would be tough on him if he died.
But it was just tough; he couldn’t possibly give up the blissful life that was about to come his way for the sake of Chen Yi. Even though his influence was small, he could see the pivotal role Chen Yi played in this decisive battle.
If Chen Yi died, they would lose the battle.
With just Jiang Chenglu’s few Tenfold Planet forces, they wouldn’t stand a chance against the Divine Corps’ assault. Chen Yi alone possessed nearly all the combat power; otherwise, they wouldn’t have asked only Chen Yi to go on the offensive.
The chaos in the main city was probably the deities realizing they were at a disadvantage and desperately sending troops to break through the main city at any cost, aiming to disrupt the rear and force Chen Yi to retreat. Yi’s lack of response must be because he was too busy to check his messages during the battle.
He was friends with the Tuberculosis Rabbit, but just now Tuberculosis Rabbit was also unreachable. Before ascending to the Tenfold Game, he had asked Tuberculosis Rabbit what would happen if they lost this final battle?
Tuberculosis Rabbit thought about it for a while, then cocked his head and said.
You will die, everyone must die.
All players within the leveling game must be slaughtered by the deities.
He said he knew.
But now, he couldn’t let these Blue Star players die, couldn’t let Chen Yi die, couldn’t let those who the deities killed be his Xiaoqian.
“Ahhhh!!!!”
Li Yide suddenly let out an emotionally charged roar, his frustration and rage and resentment—who could understand them?
He had lived his whole life in the lowest dust.
Nobody cared about him, nobody cared!
Finally, someone appeared like a dawn in the darkness, trudging through all sorts of difficulties to his side, just waiting for the battle to end so he could return home to his happy life, but why, why…
It was so close.
So close, the happiness he envied his whole life was almost within his grasp.
Why was it him who discovered the metal plate was shattered, and not someone else?
Why him?
Why?
And just then—
“Clang.”
A subtle crack sounded, and a large metal plate covering the entire room’s floor suddenly shattered in the middle, revealing a hole with solid ground beneath it, but countless black shadows were rapidly seeping out from the hole in the ground, seeming extremely terrifying!
But just as the shadows were about to burst forth from the ground, Li Yide, who was already prepared at the side, slammed a human-sized metal plate down heavily, but it was of no use. The small metal plate was nothing compared to the large plates covered by Jiang Chenglu, and it was knocked away after just a few bumps.
However, Li Yide didn’t give the shadows a chance, instead throwing his entire body on top of the plate.
Hands and feet pressed against the surrounding metal plates.
Prop activated.
In an instant, a powerful suction force was created, and Li Yide, like an octopus mouth, stuck the metal plate and the one with the hole together seamlessly.
“Bang, bang, bang!!”
However—
The shadows began to hit even harder in desperation, and countless thuds came from under the metal plate Li Yide was on. With each thud, it was as though a heavy hammer struck Li Yide in the chest!
Within a few seconds.
All of Li Yide’s defensive props were activated and rendered useless.
He could only resist with his flesh, and every heavy thud on his chest made his consciousness blur for a moment.
Blood was already blurring his mouth without him noticing when.
Li Yide, with his cheek on the ground, felt his Vitality rapidly draining. The relentlessness in his eyes suddenly weakened, and he chuckled as if resigned, his words unclear with a mouthful of blood.
“Damn it, I wasn’t doing it for some lofty human race cause.”
“I just wanted Xiaoqian to survive.”
“It’s just a pity…”
“I hadn’t named the child yet, it’s hard to imagine that someone like me, a Rat from the sewers, could ever have a child.”
“Life… it’s really hard.”
The next second—
The Fox Tail that had been shaking behind Li Yide’s back suddenly thrust fiercely into the steel plate on the floor inside the house.
From that moment on!
The two metal plates were completely and seamlessly linked together, no matter how much those shadows underneath Li Yide’s plate collided, the metal plate above his head didn’t move an inch, all the impact was borne by Li Yide without losing any strength.
…
God knows how much time passed.
Finally, the war ended.
Chen Yi, with a grin, led the nine deities back to the main city, declaring the complete annihilation of the Divine Corps. Everyone was celebrating the victory of the war, looking forward to the good life peace would bring.
Some were even impatiently preparing to set up banquet tables to celebrate.
For a time, the entire main city was filled with singing and dancing, countless players excitedly vented the suppression they felt over the days.
Even the usually serious Jiang Chenglu,
Until a player pushed open a room door saturated with the smell of blood.
They saw Li Yide with his body flat on the ground, Fox Tail thrust into the metal plate, using his flesh to link the two plates together, plugging the hole and halting one of the Divine Corps’ frenzied attacks.
Li Yide’s body was already limp, all his bones shattered.
Already devoid of life’s signs.
The blood on the ground had even dried.
Only the Fox Tail, often mocked as effeminate, was still rigidly stabbed into the metal plate, not moving at all, as determined as Li Yide’s resolve at the time, without the slightest falter.
With the opening of the door.
Chen Yi walked into the room, cradling Li Yide’s limp body in his arms, stepped outside, and faced the crowd of players gathered at the room door with an expressionless face, standing in silence without speaking.
The war was won.
Everyone could go home, but some could not return.
As the bone-chilling wind blew through, it also swept away the hope.

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - 721 Extra 2 Li Yide (Part 1)
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 721: Extra 2: Li Yide (Part 1). Chapter 721: Extra 2: Li Yide (Part 1). “Has the war finally ended?”
As the main city filled with the sounds of lively celebration, Li Yide tentatively pushed open the door and stepped outside. He saw the excited expressions on numerous players’ faces and heard the announcement resounding in his ears.
His body froze in place, and the corners of his eyes reddened, trembling continuously.
Finally…
The war had finally ended.
Soon after Chen Yi announced the counterattack and left, unrest began in the main city. Although he didn’t know what was happening, he unconsciously felt anxious.
He immediately found a room and hid inside.
And he stayed quietly hidden until the end of the war. At last, the war had ended, everything was peaceful.
He could go home now.
He hadn’t let Xiaoqian down; he had survived; he could be with Xiaoqian forever.
“Hehe.”
Standing there with reddened eyes, Li Yide suddenly cracked a foolish, joyful smile. He had already envisioned opening a small shop with Xiaoqian, running a modest business, not to make a lot of money. He might not have been invincible like Chen Yi,
but he was still significantly stronger than the average player. With the props in his backpack, and knowing Tuberculosis Rabbit and Chen Yi, even in the new world, he would live well.
During times of great upheaval, those who had excelled in the chaos were the ones who would be given a larger slice of the cake.
He might not be strong, but he wasn’t unknown.
If he wanted, he could surely become someone of decent social status in the new world, not a mover and shaker, but still notable.
But he didn’t want that.
He was tired, weary; he didn’t care about it and neither did Xiaoqian.
At that moment—
The announcement sounded.
‘…’
‘2: All planets merged with Starfield will return to their planetary forms and merge into the universe, canceling functions such as Starfield Shuttle, and players will no longer be able to use this function to travel to other planets.’
‘…’
In three hours, they would officially begin the return!
While other players hugged each other excitedly, Li Yide looked around frantically, feeling his eyes take on a blood red hue as his spirit began to collapse suddenly, unsure of what to do.
After so much hardship, everything had finally become peaceful; he could be with Xiaoqian forever.
But why!
But why!
All players had to return to their respective planets, and the Starfield Shuttle function was being canceled. Wouldn’t that mean he would never see Xiaoqian again in his life?
“Impossible!”
Standing motionlessly and appearing distraught, Li Yide looked down at the ground with a tormented expression and aimlessly mumbled to himself. The next second, he suddenly looked up, his pupils filled with a piercing brightness.
Right, the Race Transformation Coupon!
As long as he gave up his human identity and chose Xiaoqian’s Ghost Race, he could be sent back to Xiaoqian’s planet just like her.
He had heard Xiaoqian say that she had killed all her kin on her planet, that she was the only player there.
But he didn’t mind.
As long as he could be with Xiaoqian, what did it matter if they were the only two people in the whole world?
Without her, what did the hustle and bustle of the entire world mean to him?
“Race Transformation Coupon, Race Transformation Coupon…”
After finding a solution, Li Yide clung to it like a lifeline, messaging Tuberculosis Rabbit first. Tuberculosis Rabbit responded quickly, saying he had one and sent a coordinate to him.
…
“What do you want this for?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit furrowed his brows and handed over a Race Transformation Coupon. “You’re giving up being human? Going to find Xiaoqian? Think it through, you know. You’re not a ghost; living in the Ghost Realm alone might not be so comfortable.”
“It’s no trouble.”
Li Yide shook his head firmly, “I have no worries in this life, nor does anyone worry about me. Xiaoqian is the only one who cares for me; she’s the sole meaning of my existence. Without her, I don’t know what the purpose of living is.”
“I can’t be without her.”
“Tch.” Tuberculosis Rabbit, feeling a touch moved, grabbed a freshly grilled tendon and handed it over. “It’s quite touching, but you’re wrong about one thing. There are people who care about you. Sword Without End and I often talk about you; after all, you, Fox Tail, have left us with a significant impression.”
“Since you’ve made your decision, I won’t try to dissuade you. We can still use the friends channel, so keep in touch.”
“Here, have some freshly grilled tendons. You might not get the chance to enjoy this in the Ghost Realm. By the way, do they have pork over there in the Ghost Realm?”
…
And, as all the Blue Star players ascended to the Tenfold Planet to head for the cosmic battleground,
Xiaoqian curled up alone on the sofa in Li Yide’s house, hugging a pillow tightly with fear in her eyes. She shouldn’t wonder what she would do if Li Yide died on the battlefield.
She kept her eyes firmly on Li Yide’s avatar in the friends list.
It was the only avatar in her friends list.
At that moment—
‘…’
The announcement of victory sounded. The war had ended, everything was over!
War Victory!
Chen Yi had led Blue Star and the other ten planets to absolute victory. All the Divine Corps, utterly worn out, were annihilated. The ascension game was about to end, and everything would return to peace.
Cheers erupted from outside the window, a torrent of noise rising and falling without pause.
Countless people shouted excitedly, celebrating the victory.
“…”
“2: All planets integrated into the Starfield will revert to their planetary forms and merge into the universe, and functions such as the Starfield Shuttle will be canceled. Henceforth, players will not be able to use this function to travel to other planets.”
“…”
Curled up on the couch, Xiaoqian initially perked up excitedly, clenching her fist and swinging it hard through the air, as the war ended and her brother’s avatar was still lit, signifying her brother had survived.
He had made it through the war alive!
Next up was the happy life she and her brother would share!
But…
Upon seeing the announcement that all players would return to their respective planets, Xiaoqian suddenly froze, a hint of despair flashing in her eyes. She and her brother were of different races. If they both returned to their own planets and couldn’t use the Starfield Shuttle, would she ever be able to see her brother again?
No!
No!
This absolutely couldn’t happen!
In her emotional turmoil, Xiaoqian slowly floated into the air. Her crimson hair began to grow rapidly, soon spilling out the window. Xiaoqian, nearly losing her sanity, had only one thought: she needed to buy a Race Transformation Coupon.
But now, the Star Map Platform had closed.
There was no way to make a purchase.
She had no idea where to get a Race Transformation Coupon.
Just as she was about to lose her mind and was ready to slaughter the players in the city to steal a Race Transformation Coupon…
A voice suddenly rang out from outside the window.
“I’m Li Yi, Chen Yi’s friend, Li Yide’s good buddy. Umm, sister-in-law, maybe you could calm down a bit first, and we can talk it over slowly?”
Outside.
Li Yi floated in mid-air, wiping the cold sweat from his forehead. What sin had he committed? He was responsible for watching over important locations on Blue Star tied to Chen Yi and the Tuberculosis Rabbit.
Fortunately, he had investigated beforehand and found out that Li Yide had a decent relationship with Chen Yi and his crew. When his subordinates told him that Li Yide left his wife alone at home to take part in the cosmic life-and-death match,
He had thought it wise to also look after Li Yide’s wife.
If something happened, wouldn’t that count as a favor?
He just hadn’t expected real trouble to occur!
And the woman inside didn’t seem as gentle and meek as she appeared on the surface; this thick aura of killing intent made him a bit afraid.
“So…”
Li Yi looked through the window glass at the woman whose hair filled the room and bravely said, “Tell me what’s the matter, and I’ll help you solve it.”
“Let’s not be impulsive.”
“Take it slow.”
Perhaps the mention of Chen Yi and Li Yide’s names allowed Xiaoqian to regain some clarity in her nearly uncontrollable mind. Floating in the living room, she looked straight at Li Yi with bloodshot eyes and said word by word, “I… need a Race… Transformation Coupon.”
“I want… to stay on Blue Star… with my brother.”
“Phew!”
Hearing this, Li Yi took a deep breath, patted his chest and said, “No problem, no problem, I thought it was something serious. No issue, here, I have one. I’ll give it to you.”
He then took a Race Transformation Coupon from his chest, carefully handed it over, and as he contemplated whether to toss it through the window,
He saw the hair suddenly pierce through the glass and snatched the Race Transformation Coupon from his hand.
Before long,
The hair inside the house gradually disappeared, and Xiaoqian returned to her normal appearance, reverting to the girl of days past. Somewhat embarrassed, she lowered her head at the window and whispered, “Thank you… you’re a… good person.”
“I didn’t… scare you… did I?”
“Not at all, not at all.”
Upon seeing Xiaoqian back to normal, Li Yi finally sighed in relief, “All good, then I’ll be taking off. This is nothing. I was just writing a letter to Yi. Now that this is over, we probably won’t see each other again.”
“I have to write Yi a long letter.”
“Only then can I express my admiration for him all this time so he won’t forget me.”
“I’m off to be busy, just call me if you need anything.”
“How… do I… contact… you?”
“Oh, that’s easy, if something comes up, just transform like you did just now. My guys will rush to tell me immediately, and I’ll scurry over right away. It’s even better than a beacon fire. Alright, no more chitchat, I’m off to take care of things.”
“Okay…”
…
Meanwhile, over at the cosmic life-and-death match.
Just as Li Yide was expressing his grateful thanks and preparing to leave, Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly stopped him and furrowed his brows, “You and Xiaoqian have a good relationship?”
“Hmm?”
Li Yide was momentarily puzzled, unsure why he was being asked this and not knowing how to respond. But soon, he spoke firmly and deliberately, “Without her, I couldn’t live.”
“Alright then.”

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 722 Extra Story 3 Li Yide (Second Ending) (Part 2)
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 722: Extra Story 3: Li Yide (Second Ending) (Part 2). Chapter 722: Extra Story 3: Li Yide (Second Ending) (Part 2). Li Yide froze on the spot, a flicker of panic crossing his eyes. Perhaps his mind was too cluttered to have ever considered this point.
Right.
What if he transformed into the Ghost Race, and Xiaoqian did the same but went to the human race instead? Wouldn’t that mean they’d both gone their separate ways again?
Based on his understanding of Xiaoqian.
She would definitely do that, but he couldn’t guarantee it a hundred percent. What if Xiaoqian guessed he might stay in the human race and decided to wait for him there instead? Wouldn’t they have missed each other again?
He wanted to contact Xiaoqian, but he couldn’t reach her at all.
You simply couldn’t communicate in the Universe Life-and-Death Match or the Level-Up Game; the friend channel didn’t allow messages to be sent.
“I…”
Li Yide’s mind became a whirl of confusion, he looked up at Tuberculosis Rabbit with a tearful expression, feeling totally scattered and unsure of what to say. He had never felt so disheveled before.
“Alright, alright.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, somewhat helplessly, patted Li Yide on the shoulder: “This kid usually seems pretty sharp. How come his brain gets so scrambled over such a small matter? Sigh, you just can’t keep your cool.”
“The Starfield Shuttle is canceled, but you can still use props normally, right?”
“If I give you a few more Race Transformation Coupons, you’ll be fine, won’t you? After you’ve gone to the Ghost Race and discover Xiaoqian isn’t there, just activate another Race Transformation Coupon and become human again, right?”
“Such a simple matter, and you’re racking your brain over it!”
“I don’t even know what to say to you.”
“Plus, even if both you and Xiaoqian become Ghost Race members, based on what you said, if Xiaoqian has wiped out that planet, how are you two going to live? You think you’re Adam and Eve? The two of you are going to create a whole new race?”
“Forget about entertainment; it’d be hard for you to even survive. Surely, you can’t spend every day just making babies, right?”
“Why don’t you take a few more with you, and once you reunite with Xiaoqian, you both can transform back into the human race and come to Blue Star? Life on Blue Star is much more comfortable than that godforsaken place, right?”
Seeing that Li Yide still seemed dazed, Tuberculosis Rabbit let out a long sigh, rummaged in his chest pocket, and stuffed 10 Race Transformation Coupons in Li Yide’s arms: “Forget it, go and think it through yourself. Your mind really beats all. If it wasn’t for the interactions we’ve had before, I really wouldn’t want to bother explaining all this.”
“Alright, I’ve got to go and chat with Yi. You figure it out on your own.”
With that, Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t linger and turned around, walking away without looking back.
At this moment, Li Yide, who had finally caught on, tearfully and excitedly clutched the 10 Race Transformation Coupons in his arms. He knelt on both knees, looking at the retreating figure of Tuberculosis Rabbit, and shouted gratefully, “Thanks, Tuberculosis Rabbit.”
“When I get a chance, I’ll bring Xiaoqian to thank you in person!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, now far away, didn’t turn back, simply waved his hand casually, and soon disappeared from Li Yide’s sight.
Li Yide, meanwhile, stared intently at the 10 Race Transformation Coupons in his arms, his mind having been too cluttered earlier. He was preoccupied with thoughts of not being able to see Xiaoqian in his next life, completely unable to think straight.
He hadn’t grasped what Tuberculosis Rabbit meant at the moment.
Now he fully understood: one Race Transformation Coupon was like a one-way ticket, and these 10 Race Transformation Coupons were like 10 one-way tickets, 10 opportunities, enough for him to be with Xiaoqian in his next life, and even live on Blue Star.
Living on Blue Star would naturally be best.
Only then did he finally relax.
…
“What’s up?”
Sitting beside the stove, Sword Without End looked up at Tuberculosis Rabbit’s return and spoke.
“Nothing.” Tuberculosis Rabbit waved his hand nonchalantly, sat down, and resumed turning the skewers on the grill, speaking indifferently, “Li Yide came to me, that kid was worried about being separated from Xiaoqian in different worlds, so he borrowed a Race Transformation Coupon from me.”
“I gave him 10.”
“Told him to bring Xiaoqian to Blue Star once he finds her, since it’s a problem how to survive on that godforsaken planet she’s on.”
“But it’s funny, right before entering the universe match, I just happened to buy a bunch of Race Transformation Coupons. I thought that Yi gave me so many Points, it felt weird not using them, and now this item is exactly what I needed, and it’s priceless.”
“You won’t be able to buy them in the future, I still have seventy to eighty thousand of them.”
“When I shop, I buy enough to fill a warehouse. These seventy to eighty thousand just nicely filled one storage slot of a warehouse. In the future, you and your sister-in-law can also use these for a honeymoon trip.”
“For instance, you and your sister-in-law could transform your race to Li Yi’s race, take a honeymoon trip on Li Yi’s planet, and then transform back to the human race to automatically return, it’s quite a good item.”
“I plan to keep some for future generations to have a chance to use and play with.”
“Eh.”
Suddenly, a playful glint appeared in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, “Do you remember the guy we once knocked into an unlimited flow space in Another World with a bulldozer? I watched a live stream recently, and that guy has become a B-level Reincarnator.”
“His progress can be said to be lightning-fast.”
“I don’t know if he will come back this time. Finding out midway through his journey that he’s being sent back home against his will, I wonder how he feels. If we meet him, we should interview him properly.”
“In a few hundred years, Blue Star’s scientists will definitely be curious about these Race Transformation Coupons, so let them research it slowly.”
“Just thinking about it is fun.”
“…”
Sword Without End looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit somewhat speechlessly, at a loss for words for a moment, Tuberculosis Rabbit’s playful nature still as strong as ever.
…
Soon.
The final moments of the Level-Up Game were approaching.
All players prepared for their return.
And on Blue Star, Li Yi, who had also finished writing his letter and was preparing to leave, nodded satisfactorily, boasting proudly, “It still has to be me. If it were anyone else, could they have managed Yi’s rear as well as I did?”
After leaving the woman who was with Li Yide.
He suddenly remembered something.
If Li Yide went to the Ghost Race, wouldn’t it be a waste for Xiaoqian to remain alone in the human race?
So, in a stroke of inspiration, he sent Xiaoqian another 10 Race Transformation Coupons.
This way, if Xiaoqian and Li Yide switched places, she could also come back using the surplus Race Transformation Coupons.
Simply perfect.
Quickly!
It was time to teleport, and all other Race Players located on Blue Star turned into a burst of white light and disappeared from their spots.
Immediately following,
Blue Star once again burst into bustling voices.
The players from Blue Star who were on the universe’s life and death match had now returned to Blue Star.
…
Meanwhile, Li Yide went to the Ghost Race.
Xiaoqian stayed with the human race.
After discussing through the friendship channel, Xiaoqian stayed with the human race without moving, and Li Yide returned to Blue Star.
“…”
“…”
Finally meeting each other, Li Yide and Xiaoqian stood in place, looking into each other’s eyes with trembling lips that were reddened with emotion.
“Xiaoqian!”
“Brother!”
“Xiaoqian!!” (voice trembling~)
“Brother!!” (voice trembling just the same~)
“Xiaoqian!!!” (voice trembling once again~)
“Brother!!!” (voice trembling even more~)
Following that—
The two of them charged toward each other with eyes brimming with hot tears, just like the male and female protagonists in an anime who finally reunite after enduring countless hardships. The entire scene seemed to be in slow motion as they hugged each other tightly under the residential building.
Ignoring the peculiar looks of the people around them.
Just holding onto each other.
Releasing the love and concern in their hearts.
…
“Tsk.”
Standing on the nearby rooftop, Tuberculosis Rabbit gazed down at the scene below, took a deep sip of the iced coconut water in his hand, and couldn’t help but express his complex feelings, “I don’t know what to say, maybe only Xiaoqian could like Li Yide’s ‘Chuunibyou’ personality.”
“How does that phrase go again?”
“Everyone will meet someone who deeply loves them in this world, and if you haven’t met them yet, don’t hurry, the world is big and it takes time for the program to run?”
“Look, even Li Yide has found someone who loves him dearly.”

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 723 Extra 3 Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 723: Extra 3: Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit. Chapter 723: Extra 3: Sword Without End and Tuberculosis Rabbit. “…”
Sword Without End stared at Tuberculosis Rabbit with an expressionless face and said word by word, “I hope you swallow the rest of your words or I’ll fight you to the death.”
“Tsk tsk.”
Completely unfazed by the danger, Tuberculosis Rabbit slung an arm over Sword Without End’s shoulder and grinned, “You know, have you ever read a novel called ‘Zhuyan Blood’? What do you think would happen if we threw a female version of Sword Without End into ‘Zhuyan Blood’?”
“I’m actually quite looking forward to that scene.”
“Are you?”
Sword Without End stood in silence, his face darkened and he didn’t say a word.
Speaking honestly,
it wasn’t surprising Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke like this. When he regained all his memories and realized that the wife he had been sharing a bed with for years was also himself, his mood somewhat collapsed.
He vividly remembered every single night over those years.
Those were supposed to be beautiful memories.
Memories of love.
Memories of his deceased wife.
But now everything felt twisted. He couldn’t bear to face those images in his mind anymore. No wonder people often said they looked like a married couple, strikingly similar. They were indeed the same person; it would have been strange if they didn’t look alike!
If this had happened to Tuberculosis Rabbit, he would have mocked him just as mercilessly,
without a hint of hesitation, with no mercy!
But while jokes were jokes, reality had to be faced. After a long silence, Sword Without End shook his head, “I’m not searching anymore. I have bad karma; anyone involved with me is doomed to die, only a few of you have tough enough lives to survive.”
“Don’t use that as an excuse. The base game has ended, everything is over; your karma has long been broken. You no longer have any ability to affect the people around you.”
“Even so, forget it. You know I’m not a good person, especially with how I played around in the past. I don’t want to delay a good girl’s life.”
“There’s bound to be someone willing to accept your past, right?”
“But I want to continue playing in the future. How can I play if I have a wife?”
“…”
This time it was Tuberculosis Rabbit’s turn to fall silent. He had thought that Sword Without End’s resistance to this matter was due to some deeper reasons, not expecting it to be such a crudely simple one. After a long time, he couldn’t help but sigh deeply and said calmly,
“Sword Without End.”
“Huh?”
“You really are an animal.”
“Thank you.”
“Alright, then shall we go have some fun together?”
“Sure,” replied Sword Without End, his eyes lighting up as he jumped up from the chair, “I haven’t had enough of the Russian Roulette we played last time. Let’s continue!”
“Hey.”
The two exchanged a knowing smile, seeing the mischief in each other’s eyes, then walked off the rooftop arm in arm, heading into the distance.
…
After they had left,
“Ahem.”
Chen Yi coughed lightly with one hand over his fist and then looked towards Jiaye with trepidation, who was gazing unwaveringly at him, “Why are you looking at me like that? I’ve never been to those places with them, I guarantee it!”
“I’m not that kind of person!”
“Even though they’re my brothers, I’ve always despised such behavior from the bottom of my heart. I look down upon that, I’ve even criticized them many times, but to no avail!”
“These two really tarnish the reputation of all men!”
Chen Yi indignantly criticized.
“I believe you.”
Leaning in Chen Yi’s arms, Jiaye’s eyes twinkled with a mocking glint, and she smiled, her eyes curving like crescents, “I believe you haven’t been to those places or played Russian Roulette, but do you know what Russian Roulette is?”
“I don’t know!”
Chen Yi shook his head firmly with a serious expression, “Not only do I not know, but I also have no interest in it! Only the vulgar would engage in such things!”
“Vulgar! Childish! Boring! Detrimental to public morals!”
“I know.”
Jiaye spoke with a meaningful expression, “I heard they played something called Russian Roulette last time, so I specifically looked it up online. Russian Roulette is a game in which you load a bullet into a revolver and take turns firing. Whoever dies accepts their fate.”
“But, there is another way to play it.”
“You put the gun in a man’s hand, and then the girls…”
“Enough, don’t say anymore!”
Chen Yi’s voice was calm but raspy as he interrupted, “I have no interest in these things at all. I’ve never participated, and I don’t want to hear about it. I’m getting hungry now. I’m off to eat. Are you coming with me?”
“You don’t want to play?”
“No!”
“Really don’t want to? They say Russian Roulette can give men a great sense of conquest.”
“Totally uninterested.”
“Is that so?”
Jiaye arched her brow and gently turned Chen Yi’s head in a different direction, gesturing for him to look left, “It seems like someone over there is waiting for you. Do you recognize her?”
Chen Yi followed the direction indicated by Jiaye and looked to his left, only to see a tall woman in a queenly white dress standing there, looking toward them anxiously.
If not the queen of the White Phoenix Clan,
Who else could it be?
“…”
Chen Yi took a deep breath, feeling a tingling sensation in his scalp, “How did you get here?”
The queen of the White Phoenix Clan, the woman he had a one-night encounter with,
She always gave him a headache.
Jiaye kept using this woman to mock him.
“I…”
The Queen of the White Phoenix Clan, that is, Xu Yue, feeling somewhat uneasy, bowed her head and quietly clutched her dress, murmuring, “Thank you, Yi, the White Phoenix Clan’s curse of many years has been lifted, and we have now returned to the normal timeline.”
“And I… I no longer need to stand as the Queen of the White Phoenix Clan.”
“Blue Star is a very good planet.”
“I used a Race Transformation Coupon, I want to spend the rest of my life on Blue Star.”
“…”
Chen Yi remained expressionless and silent, unsure what to say, what could he say? Welcome or have a pleasant journey?
“Here.”
On the contrary, Jiaye’s eyes twinkled with a hint of amusement, “Another chamber has arrived; Yi, you can also play Russian Roulette now, though it only has 2 chambers. Won’t it feel a bit unfair to you?”
“Not as many as the Tuberculosis Rabbit and their group.”
“How about you make do for now? Later on I’ll find you more chambers?”
“Aiming to let you play Russian Roulette with six chambers?”
“…”
Chen Yi took a deep breath, feeling a slight chill down his back, first fixing his gaze on the somewhat uneasy Xu Yue before him, a very tall figure in a white empress’s dress, exuding the charm of a young married woman.
Not young-looking.
Yet giving off a very special feeling, which, if spoken vulgarly, would be described as incredibly enduring.

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 724 Extra 5 The whole familys honeymoon trip
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 724: Extra 5: The whole family’s honeymoon trip. Chapter 724: Extra 5: The whole family’s honeymoon trip. Not long after peace had returned to everything,
Blue Star lay in ruins awaiting revival. With everyone’s effort, abandoned buildings on Blue Star started to be cleared away, the previously desolate farmlands began to be reclaimed, and conquered cities started systematic demolition and rebuilding.
Everyone was trying their best.
Only a few slipped away stealthily.
This group included Chen Yi, Jiaye, and the White Phoenix Clan Empress Xu Yue.
…
“…”
Chen Yi, who had initially planned to visit Li Yi and hang out for a few days, suddenly fell silent. He realized that although he had sought out Li Yi many times, he always ended up at the Awesome Starfield.
He really didn’t know where Li Yi’s planet was.
Wanting to visit Li Yi’s planet, he didn’t even know which race to transform into.
That was indeed a bit troublesome.
After a while, he silently sent Li Yi a message.
Soon—
“Let’s go.”
After determining the destination, Chen Yi used a Race Transformation Coupon to transform into a ‘Red Star Race’ member. Yes, it was called the Red Star Race, which apparently wasn’t its original name.
But soon after Li Yi came into power, he forcibly changed the name.
He said that the original race name wasn’t very nice-sounding.
Of course, whatever it’s called doesn’t really matter; it’s not that important.
The instant he changed his race, he felt a powerful suction force from beneath his feet. The next second, a familiar white light flashed before his eyes. When his vision returned, he was already on Li Yi’s turf, also known as Red Star.
This guy…
He wouldn’t have named it Red Star just because his was Blue Star, would he?
The moment he landed, Chen Yi noticed some slight changes in his body. Nothing too strange, just an extra protrusion on his abdomen, said to be a unique anatomical feature of Red Star Race players.
If you have a stomachache, pressing on this protrusion will immediately relieve the pain.
It’s said that while in their mothers’ wombs, the mother secretes a lot of pain-relieving substances to this protruding part of the child’s abdomen. Red Star Race players seem to be very sensitive to pain, and a slight discomfort could be intolerable to them.
So, they evolved this feature.
As soon as they feel pain, they press on the protrusion, and just like having an anesthetic, the pain disappears instantaneously, without numbing the body or causing loss of consciousness.
Moreover, this feature can be reused.
After using it, with the replenishment of energy from eating, the anesthetic inside the protrusion will slowly refill to full. It seems that under the theory of evolution, no matter what strange features evolve, if you trace it back to the origin, there’s always a reasonable explanation.
A race particularly sensitive to pain evolving something to secrete its own pain medication seems quite rational, right?
Rational.
Although he knew about it, he had never seen it on Li Yi; after all, he couldn’t just lift up Li Yi’s clothes to see if it was there. Unexpectedly, he was the first to experience this feature on himself.
Chen Yi curiously touched the small protrusion on his abdomen.
Meanwhile, Jiaye, who had also come along, stood on tiptoes and draped an arm over Chen Yi’s shoulder, her eyes shining with excitement as she bit her lip and said, “Transforming into a different race gives you the corresponding physical organs of that race?”
“Um, Yi…”
“Don’t you want to try being a Centaur? Or a Cat Girl?”
“They say Cat Race women have four pairs of headlights, so that must be a unique experience. You just couldn’t handle it all. If Sister Xu Yue and I teamed up, that would be eight pairs of headlights.”
“That would definitely be a special experience.”
“What do you say, Yi? We’ve gone to all this effort to go out just this once, naturally we want to try something different, to make various attempts.”
Jiaye looked up at Chen Yi, her eyes glittering with anticipation.
Jiaye and Xu Yue were completely blithering, one moment Jiaye called Xu Yue ‘sister,’ the next Xu Yue called Jiaye ‘sister,’ and then they’d both end up calling each other ‘sister’ all over again. There seemed to be no rhyme or reason to it.
Just a mess.
It all seemed to come down to their mood.
“Sure,”
Chen Yi said expressionlessly, “We should try something different. Cat Girls and Centaurs are too boring though. Why not try the Cockroach Race? Let’s see what it’s like to be a cockroach?”
“That would be novel, wouldn’t it?”
“Aren’t you curious?”
“Just imagine me, a nearly two-meter-tall cockroach, sprawled on you. Isn’t the thought alone exciting?”
“…”
“…”
No sooner had his words fallen, Jiaye, who had been in high spirits, turned deathly pale. Standing frozen for thirty seconds, she finally couldn’t hold back and began to vomit profusely.
…
Not long after peace had returned to everything,
Blue Star lay in ruins awaiting revival. With everyone’s effort, abandoned buildings on Blue Star started to be cleared away, the previously desolate farmlands began to be reclaimed, and conquered cities started systematic demolition and rebuilding.
Everyone was trying their best.
Only a few slipped away stealthily.
This group included Chen Yi, Jiaye, and the White Phoenix Clan Empress Xu Yue.
…
“…”
Chen Yi, who had initially planned to visit Li Yi and hang out for a few days, suddenly fell silent. He realized that although he had sought out Li Yi many times, he always ended up at the Awesome Starfield.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 726: Extra 6: The Whole Family’s Honeymoon Trip (2) Chapter 726: Extra 6: The Whole Family’s Honeymoon Trip (2) Chen Yi and his companions didn’t ask Li Yi to join them anymore and wandered around Sky City alone for a day.
They measured the place with their steps, a place that had set the gears of their destiny in motion. Although not an important node, it was a significant one to remember.
But there truly wasn’t much to see.
At that time, Sky City was long abandoned, devoid of human presence. There wasn’t anything to explore, not even an open shop, making it look like a city frozen in time.
That day.
They visited many places.
At the parking lot, in the fitting rooms, at the movie theater, on the rooftop, in the alleys, in the bathrooms, in the backstage of a diner, at…
One day later.
After sharing a meal with Li Yi and having a good chat, they decided to leave Red Star for other races.
Persuaded by Jiaye and Xu Yue, Chen Yi’s mental defenses were gradually breaking down.
For some inexplicable reason, he chose the Catgirl Tribe.
…
“…”
Chen Yi looked at Jiaye, who had two cat ears on top of his head and a cat tail dangling behind, then those four sets of car lights hanging on his belly. The corners of his mouth started to twitch uncontrollably.
“One, two, three…”
Jiaye bowed his head, lifted his clothes to count the car lights on his stomach. After a moment, he looked up at Chen Yi with a hint of bewilderment, “How am I supposed to buy underwear? Four sets of underwear?”
“Must be a bit uncomfortable, right?”
“Does changing clothes every day take a long time?”
“…”
The corners of Chen Yi’s mouth kept twitching without uttering a word, while Xu Yue beside him looked at the car lights on her belly with the same expression of wonder.
Suddenly, Jiaye stopped his own contemplation and looked at Xu Yue. Together, they pounced onto Chen Yi, beginning to rub against him.
All eight sets of car lights were furiously rubbing against Chen Yi.
“…”
Chen Yi lay on the bed, his face pale as death, staring blankly at the ceiling. He didn’t know how to describe this feeling. How should he put it? It was a mix of discomfort and astonishment.
…
After spending two days with the Catgirl Tribe, Chen Yi resolutely chose to leave, this time for the Centaur Clan.
The upper body of a human, and the lower body of a horse.
Very round behinds.
After standing silently on all fours for a while, Chen Yi finally said with conviction, “This really won’t do.”
“Give it a try, life is about trying new things, constantly repeating the same old thing is boring.”
“This really won’t do!”
Chen Yi’s voice involuntarily rose in pitch again!
But moments later, not wanting to dampen Jiaye’s spirits, he still braced himself and walked over.
…
Two days later with the Centaur Clan, Chen Miao, his face a touch pale, arrived in Giant Country.
This was a marvelous race.
In this race, the women were typically around 3 to 4 meters tall, while the men were only about 1.4 meters.
The race was also a matriarchal society, where women controlled all the quality resources, and men were responsible for cooking and taking care of children at home.
The instant he transformed into this race, Chen Yi looked up at Jiaye, who now towered over him by more than twice his height. Xu Yue was already tall, but now she was shooting towards 5 meters.
Looking up at her was like looking at a giant.
But soon, these two giants bent down.
“…”
Chen Yi’s mouth twitched wildly once more, and that strange sensation inside him started to overflow even more. It was his first time feeling what it was like to pull a cart—such an unusual feeling, indeed remarkable.
This time, they stayed for four days.
And just about when they were about to leave, Chen Yi’s complexion turned paler, as if he had put on make-up.
…
Leaving Giant Country, their honeymoon journey continued, this time to the Tentacle Tribe.
This was a magical race.
The players of this race were no different from normal people, except that each person was covered with dozens of tentacles that felt quite nice to the touch and had sensitive sensory points.
The level of eeriness this race gave Chen Yi intensified even more.
The sight of those dozens of tentacles flailing wildly in the bedroom was magical.
In his lifetime, he never imagined he would experience such magical events.
…
They spent 2 days with the Tentacle Tribe. The honeymoon journey continued, and this time they went to the Long-Tongue Tribe.
This was a race with unique characteristics. Within this race, all females had tongues that were half a meter long, which were not only helpers in daily life but also a defensive weapon.
“Whew!”
Chen Yi drew in a breath of cool air, filled with shock and disbelief. This time, there was no weird sensation, only disbelief at how different the feeling of having a longer tongue could be!
…
Chen Yi and his companions didn’t ask Li Yi to join them anymore and wandered around Sky City alone for a day.
They measured the place with their steps, a place that had set the gears of their destiny in motion. Although not an important node, it was a significant one to remember.
But there truly wasn’t much to see.
At that time, Sky City was long abandoned, devoid of human presence. There wasn’t anything to explore, not even an open shop, making it look like a city frozen in time.
That day.
They visited many places.
At the parking lot, in the fitting rooms, at the movie theater, on the rooftop, in the alleys, in the bathrooms, in the backstage of a diner, at…
One day later.
After sharing a meal with Li Yi and having a good chat, they decided to leave Red Star for other races.

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 728 Extra 7 The conclusion of Li Peiqi’s life
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 728: Extra 7: The conclusion of Li Peiqi’s life. Chapter 728: Extra 7: The conclusion of Li Peiqi’s life. And just at that moment—
A young girl suddenly leaned in excitedly and whispered into her ear, “Peiqi, someone has taken out an E-grade prop to exchange for a throwing knife opportunity.”
“We’ve struck it rich this time!”
“This is an E-grade prop we’re talking about!”
In the past, an E-grade prop wouldn’t have been anything noteworthy, but things were different now. Even the worst E-grade props were still props, and any prop could play a pivotal role in modern society.
Especially when such props could no longer be produced and became vintage, their prices surged, and they became even rarer.
“Oh?”
Li Peiqi, her eyes covered with a cloth, couldn’t see who was beside her, but she knew it was her assistant, and a hint of surprise arose in her heart, “Really? Is this person that generous?”
“How could it be fake? I’ve already taken the prop, and it’s definitely not a counterfeit. The prop panel is crystal clear, but that person had two stunning women with him, so he’s probably not just anybody.”
“Perhaps it’s some young master trying to show off his generosity in front of beauties by giving away an E-grade prop.”
“However, this young noble clearly miscalculated.”
“Those two stunning women by his side are probably not ordinary either, because when the young noble took out an E-grade prop and said he wanted to exchange it for throwing knife opportunity, those two women showed not a trace of disbelief. Instead, they looked utterly calm.”
“He’s spent a fortune, but his attempt to impress has fallen flat. That young noble must be fuming by now.”
“It’s fine.”
Li Peiqi stood still, chuckling softly, “Let him play. By the way, don’t you recognize that young noble? Although we’ve been expelled by the Black Dragon Guild, we should have seen all the nobles from Neutron Star before, can’t you tell which family he’s from?”
She wasn’t worried about getting hit.
She had come across a stroke of luck that greatly increased her Luck Points. At first, she thought it would only increase the probability of getting good items from treasure chests, but later she discovered that Luck Points had more uses than just that. For instance—
In the face of lethal danger, even if she stood still, Luck Points would protect her from death by forcibly altering the trajectory of the attack.
It was unreasonable.
It defied logic.
But it was a fact; once she realized Luck Points also had this ability, she felt an overwhelming sense of security and no longer worried about the Last Words prophesying her death by Chen Yi’s hands.
It was all false.
The main game had ended, and she had never met Chen Yi; moreover, Chen Yi had not wiped out her clan. How could she possibly die by Chen Yi’s hand, especially now that the main game had ended and there was no animosity between Chen Yi and Neutron Star? Surely he wouldn’t make a long journey just to destroy her clan on Neutron Star?
Furthermore, all players had returned to their own planets, so even if Chen Yi wanted to, he couldn’t come.
If he was not out to destroy the clan—
Then surely Chen Yi couldn’t possibly go to all the trouble of finding a way to Neutron Star just to kill her alone? After all, Chen Yi might not have even heard her name,
But just then, she suddenly thought of something and asked instinctively, “What does that young noble look like?”
“Erm… He has a lot of charisma, and he’s using a cane.”
“A cane?”
Li Peiqi was startled for a moment, and immediately removed the cloth covering her eyes, looking up at Chen Yi who was standing in front of the crowd ready to throw a knife. However, before she could say anything, a throwing knife was already hurtling straight toward her forehead.
It was almost instantaneous.
Her face turned ashen and her body stiffened in place, her pupils shimmered with disbelief and extreme fear, as she let out a bitter laugh in her final moment.
Who else could that person be if not Chen Yi!
The moment she heard the word “cane,” she felt uneasy, and seeing the person herself only confirmed it—this was Chen Yi, whom she had watched countless times on live broadcast.
How could she forget that face?
She just didn’t expect her first encounter with Chen Yi to be under such circumstances, nor did she imagine dying at the hands of Chen Yi as prophesied by the Last Words would be like this.
Oh, the irony!
The main game was over, and yet Chen Yi had come all this way to Neutron Star just to kill her with a single knife throw? Really, Chen Yi, is there any reason why you absolutely must kill me?
Indeed!
This time, the Goddess of Luck did not bestow her favor; it was as if her Luck Points had failed her. She saw the throwing knife heading straight for her forehead, unable to avoid it, rigidly standing her ground.
However—
Just as the knife was about to hit Li Peiqi’s forehead, a faster knife thrown by Chen Yi shot out of his hand, catching up to and deflecting the knife headed for her.
As the two knives grazed Li Peiqi’s cheek, leaving a trail of blood, they hit the wooden board behind her.
There was silence for a few seconds.
Then the place erupted with deafening cheers of excitement.
Meanwhile, Li Peiqi remained ghostly pale, her legs gave way and she collapsed to the ground without uttering a word, instinctively feeling parched, wanting nothing more than a huge bucket of water, having narrowly escaped death.
Still alive…
Still not dead…
Had the Last Words failed again? Or was the prophecy once again delayed?

“It’s an E-class Prop after all!”
In the past, an E-class Prop wouldn’t be anything remarkable, but now things were different. Even the most worthless E-class Prop was still a Prop, and any Prop could play a pivotal role in modern society.
Especially now that these Props could no longer be produced, rendering them vintage, their prices had climbed a notch and had become even rarer.
“Oh?”
Li Peiqi, with her eyes covered by cloth, couldn’t see who was beside her, but she still recognized her assistant and was slightly surprised inside, “Really? Is this person that generous?”
“There’s no way it could be fake. I’ve already received the item, and there’s no way to fake it. The Prop panel is crystal clear. But that person brought two stunning women along, likely not just anybody.”
“Maybe it’s some young master trying to show off his wealth in front of beauties, which is why he gave away an E-class Prop.”
“But this young master clearly miscalculated.”
“Those two stunning women by his side are probably not ordinary either, because when the young master took out an E-class Prop and asked to exchange it for a chance at the throwing knife game, neither of those beautiful women showed any sign of disbelief. In fact, they seemed exceptionally calm.”
“He paid a hefty price, but his show didn’t impress. He’s probably fuming now.”
“It’s fine.”
Li Peiqi stood in her place and chuckled lightly, “Let him play. By the way, do you not recognize that young master? Although we’ve been expelled by the Black Dragon Guild, we should have seen all the young masters from Neutron Star before, right? Can’t you tell which family he’s from?”
She wasn’t worried about being hit.
She had a stroke of luck that had significantly increased her Luck Points; initially, she thought it would only improve the chances of getting good items from treasure chests, but she later discovered that Luck Points had more functions than that—for instance—
In the face of fatal danger, even if she stood still, Luck Points would ensure that she would not die, forcibly altering the trajectory of the attack.
It was entirely unreasonable.
It was entirely illogical.

That was all false.
The game of promotion was over, she had not met Chen Yi, and Chen Yi had not come to annihilate her clan. How could she possibly die at Chen Yi’s hands? Moreover, now that the promotion game was over, Chen Yi had no vendetta against Neutron Star, so he surely wouldn’t go out of his way to travel a long distance just to annihilate the Neutron Star clan, right?
Furthermore, now that all players had returned to their own planets, even if Chen Yi had such plans, he wouldn’t be able to execute them.
Unless he intended to wipe out her clan.
Chen Yi couldn’t possibly go to the trouble of traveling a long way to Neutron Star just to kill her, could he? Chen Yi might not have even heard her name.
But just then, she suddenly thought of something and asked subconsciously, “What does that young master look like?”
“Um… he looks very dignified and is holding a cane.”
“A cane?”
Li Peiqi paused for a moment, and immediately removed the cloth covering her eyes, lifting her gaze toward Chen Yi, who stood in front of the crowd ready to throw the knife. However, before she could say anything, a flying knife was already whizzing straight toward her forehead.
It was virtually in that instant.
Her face turned deathly pale, and her body stiffened in place, disbelief and extreme fear flashing in her eyes. In the last moment of her life, she let out a bitter laugh.
If that person wasn’t Chen Yi, who else could it be!
The moment she heard the word “cane,” she had a bad feeling, and when she finally saw the man in person, she was even more certain. She had watched his live broadcasts too many times to forget his face.
She just never expected that her first encounter with Chen Yi would be under such circumstances, nor did she anticipate that dying at Chen Yi’s hands, as stated in the Last Words, would happen in this manner.
Family, who could understand!
The game was over, and you, Chen Yi, travel all this way to Neutron Star just to have a flying knife stab her to death here?
Your elderliness must have had it tough, was there a reason you absolutely had to kill Li Peiqi?
Sure enough!
This time, the Goddess of Luck did not visit her again, her relied-upon Luck Points seemed to have lost half their effect. She saw the flying knife heading straight for her forehead, and she couldn’t even dodge in time, only able to stand there stiffly.
However—
Just as the flying knife was about to hit Li Peiqi’s forehead, a faster knife shot out from Chen Yi’s hand, catching up to the one about to hit its mark and knocking it aside.
As both knives grazed Li Peiqi’s cheeks, leaving behind a hateful gash, they embedded themselves directly into the wooden plank behind her.
The scene fell silent for a few seconds.
Then, an ear-shattering roar of excitement erupted.
Li Peiqi, still with a pale face, fell to the ground with weak knees, speechless, with an instinctual dry throat, her whole being only wanting to drink a huge bucket of water, having snatched back a life from the brink of death.
Still alive…
Not dead yet…
Had the Last Words failed again? Or was the premonition from the Last Words delayed once more?

A young girl suddenly approached her excitedly and whispered in her ear, “Peiqi, someone has offered an E-level Prop to exchange for a chance at the flying knives.”

“He paid a hefty price, but the act wasn’t convincing, that young master must be furious now.”
“No matter.”
Li Peiqi stood in place and chuckled lightly, “Let him play. By the way, don’t you recognize that young master? Even though we have been driven out by the Black Dragon Guild now, we should have seen the young masters on Neutron Star before. Can’t you tell which family he’s from?”
She wasn’t worried about getting hit.

In the face of mortal danger, even if she stood still, Luck Points would still ensure she wouldn’t die, forcibly altering the attack’s trajectory.
Utterly unreasonable.

Unless he intended to annihilate.

﻿Chapter 730: Extra 8: The Childhood Journey of Tie Chui and Iron Nail. Chapter 730: Extra 8: The Childhood Journey of Tie Chui and Iron Nail. “Setting up your stall so early today?”
A middle-aged man, grinning, approached a vegetable vendor in the market and handed him a cigarette, “I’ve never seen you out this early on a regular day. Give me three eggplants, a bunch of green onions, and half a pound of chili peppers.”
“Not at all.”
While chuckling, the vendor took the cigarette and tucked it by his ear, skillfully packing the man’s vegetables: “I always come this early, here you go.”
“That’ll be 17 yuan in total, but since you’re a regular, the green onions are on the house, no charge.”
“Alright.”
The man, without any fuss, cheerfully accepted the vegetables the vendor passed him and looked casually over to the neighboring stall where a simple-minded big fellow was staring eagerly in their direction, “That idiot is still here selling fish.”
“Yeah, he’s always here; shows up pretty early every day.
“He tries hard,” the vendor casually added, “It’s a pity his mind isn’t quite there, and he even has a little girl with him. No matter how hard he works, it’s useless in this unforgiving world. Never seen their parents, probably died early, just leaving an idiot and a little girl behind in this world. It’s really tough on them.”
“Apparently, they won’t be here much longer; the market is about to implement a new rule that won’t allow vendors selling seafood to stay. They’re going to be driven out soon.”
“Next time you come, they won’t be here.”
“So be it.”
The middle-aged man didn’t care much, the world was so big, with so many important things happening every day, who would worry about whether you could see an old fool of a fishmonger again or not.
“I’m off.”
“Sure, come by next time.”
…
…
Tie Chui sat on a bench behind his own stall, his gaze slightly vacant as he watched the middle-aged man talking to the owner of a neighboring stall. He wasn’t sure what he was thinking, but only after the man had left did he slowly turn his head to look at the cigarette tucked behind the man’s ear.
In this vegetable market, many regular customers would pass a cigarette to the vendors when interacting with them.
But… no one had ever passed one to him.
At first, he thought people simply didn’t know he smoked, so after much deliberation, he bought the cheapest pack of cigarettes he could find and, in front of many people, lit one up and put it to his lips only to cough incessantly from irritation.
Even so, still, no one offered him a cigarette.
From time to time, he could hear various other comments.
“Hey, look at that idiot, he’s even trying to smoke.”
“Might be dumb in the head, but not the mouth.”
“Exactly.”
His mind might not work well, but that didn’t mean he couldn’t tell who was kind to him and who bore ill will. He wasn’t clear about why they acted like that, he could only continue to sit on the bench behind the stall day after day, silently passing the time.
And that pack of cigarettes? He never smoked it again.
He left half a pack on the stall.
“Brother.”
Just then, a complaining voice came from nearby: “I told you at the time not to buy those cigarettes, but you insisted on getting them. You know we hardly have any money, cigarettes are so expensive and uneatable, why did you buy them?”
…
Tie Chui didn’t speak but turned to look at the little girl only a bit over a meter tall next to him and suddenly smiled foolishly, patting the two small braids at the back of her head. The braids didn’t look that great—they were his handiwork.
He had secretly practiced for a long time.
His sister once said she wanted braids like other little girls, but she didn’t know how to do them, so he learned in secret. But his mind was slow; no matter how hard he tried, he could never make them as pretty as the other girls.
But his sister didn’t mind.
In fact, she was delighted.
Seeing his sister happy made him happy too.
“Nevermind.”
Perhaps tired from the complaint, Iron Nail stopped her grumbling, no longer mentioning the unfinished pack of cigarettes. Instead, she proudly pulled out a flyer from her bosom, her eyes sparkling with excitement as she spoke enthusiastically.
“There’s a new seafood market opening soon, and they’re looking for vendors.”
“The manager of this market, knowing we’ve been running a stall here for a year, thinks we’re experienced fishmongers. They’re willing to give us a six-month rent deferral, allowing us to pay the first six months of rent after we’ve been there for half a year.”
…

﻿Chapter 734: Extra 10: The Childhood Journey of Tie Chui and Iron Nail (3) Chapter 734: Extra 10: The Childhood Journey of Tie Chui and Iron Nail (3) “Perhaps the Goddess of Luck had smiled upon them once again.
This time, no one found them, and no one even noticed them.
There wasn’t even a police report.
That man’s wife really thought her husband had run away. After cursing loudly at the vegetable market for three days, she took off with another man from Yancheng. Whatever happened after that, they had no idea.
But they knew one thing.
That was that life had truly gotten better.
From that point on, they re-learned the joys of being alive. Jiaye kept growing year after year, from a little girl to a tall and elegant young lady.
She learned how to do makeup.
They even had money to buy new clothes, so she could dress up beautifully.
No longer did she need to sit on the street, looking enviously at other friends wearing new clothes.
She also didn’t have to huddle next to other vendors to watch TV dramas anymore—they could afford smart phones to watch them on.
They could eat whatever they wanted.
They could do so many things.
Money really could do a lot, at least it allowed them to live with dignity, not known as the idiot or the jinx.
Tie Chui might not have been smart, but he was extremely honest in business. Although the profit margin was thin, he never used fraudulent scales, which earned him an increasingly good reputation at the seafood market, along with many regular customers.
People gradually preferred to buy fish from Tie Chui’s stall. Despite Tie Chui’s simplicity, many believed such a man would not cheat them in business, and indeed, it was the case, leading to a growing number of return customers.
They now had enough money to send Jiaye to school.
But Jiaye didn’t go.
She couldn’t go. If she did, what would Tie Chui do all by himself?
She had been with her brother all these years. She couldn’t imagine how he would live if she wasn’t there. Subconsciously, she didn’t realize that without her brother, she couldn’t live on her own either.
Over all these years.
The two of them had redeemed each other. Without either one, neither could live a normal life.
…
Grown-up Jiaye was now reclining on the sofa, with her legs on the coffee table, enjoying the air conditioning and watching a TV drama on the tablet, constantly giggling.
By now, she had long forgotten those bloody events of many years ago.
So many years had passed.
She and her brother had never mentioned those events again, and she had never told anyone about them. These memories had rotted away in her heart. She was satisfied with her current life, and looking back, she would still make the same choice.
The only thing that made her feel emotionally complex was,
She was unclear how her young self had managed to remain mentally intact in that situation and even took corrective measures.
How old was she back then?
They say a poor man’s child comes of age early, but they never said a poor man’s child is born knowing how to handle a crime scene.
But now everything was in the past, those things had never been brought up again. Over all these years, even the police never suspected them, never came to investigate, and there wasn’t even a case filed. Everything was seamless.
But soon.
The smile on her face gradually stiffened.
The TV drama was good, but its content no longer made her laugh.
.
A female protagonist who had once killed someone, and the male protagonist who was a police officer finally”

﻿Chapter 736: Side Story 10: The Funeral of Chen Yi’s Youngest Son, Chen Miao. Chapter 736: Side Story 10: The Funeral of Chen Yi’s Youngest Son, Chen Miao. “…”
Chen Yi leaned on his cane, standing in silence for a long while before he slowly removed the black top hat from his head and placed it on his chest, bowing in a salute.
In this moment, Chen Yi lacked his usual air of worldly detachment; he appeared extremely somber.
Standing beside him, Jiaye, already with reddened eyes barely able to stand, was propped up by the servants with great difficulty.
It was supposed to be…
It was supposed to be…
It was supposed to be the time when he could finally see his child, explain all the truths of these years to him, and finally allow his long-suffering child to enjoy a life of luxury.
But why did everything suddenly turn out this way?
Killed by a falling coconut!
Why the freak coincidence of a coconut falling at just that moment, hitting and killing him?
Even if he was struck by the coconut, how could it be fatal? If it was a severe injury that brought him close to death, they would have had ways to save him, but how could it lead to immediate death!?
“Swoosh!”
The countless people in black suits standing behind Chen Yi all bent forward with mournful and solemn expressions, bowing towards the black and white photograph in front of them!
The death of Chen Yi’s younger son was an incredibly shocking event on Blue Star, and countless people would be affected by it.
“It’s all your fault!”
An utterly grief-stricken Jiaye, with a hoarse voice, pounded Chen Yi’s arm, “If you hadn’t insisted that our son needed to toughen up, how would he have died? What did he need to toughen up for when this entire planet bears the Chen name? What did he need to strive for?”
“Why did he have to start a company? Why did he need to make his own way in life?”
“If our children must struggle from the bottom up like we did, what does all the effort we parents have put in over the years mean?”
“This whole planet belongs to the Chen Family; why couldn’t we allow our son to be a spoiled young master, to live a happy and carefree life?”
Having said this,
Jiaye turned to look at the group of people standing behind Chen Yi, with eyes red and bloodshot, and roared, “I said Blue Star belongs to the Chen Family; does anyone object?”
“Stand out!”
As the words fell,
those who had been bowing suddenly fell to their knees, placing their heads on the ground without uttering a word.
The scene was exceptionally uniform.
There was no dissenting opinion. Since the end of the ‘Sword Without End’ game decades ago, and shortly after the ‘Starfield Shuttle’ was reopened, Chen Yi had come to hold an absolute advantage during this new era of transformation.
He led Blue Star to become the most powerful planet among the Myriad Clans.
Whether it was military, cultural, or economic strength, they were first.
Without equal.
One could say that Chen Yi was the god of Blue Star, the Seal of the Sea God of Blue Star. As long as Chen Yi was present, nobody could ever turn the sky of Blue Star upside down.
To say that Blue Star belongs to the Chen Family was by no means an exaggeration.
None of these individuals standing in their current positions were unconnected to the Chen Family.
Although Chen Yi once said that he didn’t understand politics, that he wouldn’t get too involved in it and that they should manage on their own, just because Chen Yi said so didn’t mean they would actually do it.
Indistinctly, Chen Yi had essentially become the Retired Emperor of Blue Star.
“…”
Chen Yi’s face showed no expression as he looked long and silently at the black and white photograph of his younger son, not speaking a word even as Jiaye, somewhat agitated, kept hitting his arm. He remained motionless, ignoring everything.
The death of Chen Miao.
He was more devastated than anyone else.
He had always paid close attention to his child’s growth history. This child was smarter than him, more capable. Perhaps because he had a closer relationship with Jiaye, compared to his elder son, he favored his younger son more.
He had spent more time observing his younger son.
Just when he was full of anticipation to bring his son home, to tell him just how mighty his old man was, and looking forward to seeing the astonishment on his son’s face, he received the bad news of his son’s demise instead.
“Yi,”
Sword Without End stood aside, his face filled with remorse as he lowered his head, not knowing what to say, feeling extremely sad and ashamed to face Yi. It had been his responsibility to closely protect Chen Miao’s safety over the years.
Bearing the fear of any potential accident,
in fact, with his abilities and all the medical props prepared in his backpack, it might be unpleasant to say, but even if Chen Miao was run over by a train, his body split in two, as long as he still breathed, he could have been saved.
Without any complications, at that.
But—
At that moment, it all happened so fast that even he did not react. He remembered dark clouds suddenly appearing in the sky, the city oppressed by the blackness.
The wind was strong.
He had only looked down to light a cigarette, and by the time he looked up again, Chen Miao was already lying in a pool of blood, with a blood-stained coconut rolling beside him, and the surprised cries of passersby echoing amidst the wind.
He rushed over immediately. Despite the urgency, he wasn’t very panicked inside.
After all, how much damage could a coconut cause if it fell on someone’s head, enough to be fatal?
But when he got there, Chen Miao was already beyond saving, and even after activating all the props in his backpack, they couldn’t reverse the fact of Chen Miao’s on-the-spot death, nor could they bring him back to life.
According to the coroner’s report,
due to excessive psychological stress leading to cerebral congestion, his entire blood circulation became chaotic and he died instantly from the coconut strike, beyond all hope of revival.

How could a coconut kill a person? It seemed less like he was killed by a coconut and more as if Chen Miao was meant to die and merely found a method of death at hand.
Nevertheless, the dead cannot be brought back, and no matter how hard it was to accept, he had to.
What now worried him more were Yi’s mental state and Sword Without End’s mental state.
He knew how much Yi adored his younger son, having bragged to him countless times that the boy inherited his youthful grace and that he planned to have his son take over his position.
Although he also loved his elder son, the elder was too strict in his management to lead.
The one in charge should be a creator of rules, not a follower of them.
Those who adhere to rules often can’t create new ones. It is within one’s nature; only those who break the rules can understand how to create better ones when they do create.
But now…
Tuberculosis Rabbit took a deep breath, forcibly calming himself, planning to comfort Yi once he had slightly recovered.
…
Li Yide, standing among the crowd, looked at Chen Yi’s back which was normally very straight but today appeared somewhat weathered, and he sighed softly with a complex expression, not saying a word.
Yi had helped him a lot.
If not for Yi, he and Xiaoqian could never have been together.
For this, he had always been grateful to Yi.
But with today’s sudden incident, he felt truly sorry for Yi.
Perhaps this was the envy of the heavens towards the talented.

She should be happy about this.

So why did it suddenly turn out this way?
Killed by a falling coconut!
Why did it happen that just by coincidence, a coconut fell, and it struck him dead?
Even if he was hit by the coconut, how could it lead to death? Even if he were critically injured and near death, they would have found a way to bring him back. But how could it be an immediate death!
“Swoosh!”
The countless men in black suits standing behind Chen Yi, all with faces of grief and solemnity, bent forward to salute while looking at the black and white photograph before them!

This was definitely an extremely sensational event on Blue Star, and who knows how many people would be affected by it.

Jiaye’s voice, anguished and hoarse, kept pounding on Chen Yi’s arm: “If it wasn’t for you insisting that our son needed to toughen up, how would he have died, what was there to toughen up for, when the whole planet bears the Chen name? What did he need to toughen up for?”
“Why did he have to start a company, why did he have to carve out his own path in life?”
“If our children also have to struggle from the bottom just like we did, what does that mean for all the efforts us parents have made over these years?”
“When the entire planet belongs to the Chen Family, why couldn’t we let him be a carefree young master? To live a happy life.”
After saying that,

“Step forward!”
As the words fell,
those who had been bowing their heads in a greeting suddenly went down on their knees in unison, kneeling and bowing their heads to the ground without uttering a word.
The scene was extremely orderly and uniform.
No one opposed. Ever since the main game ended decades ago, and shortly after the “Starfield Shuttle” was reopened, in this new era of cleansing, Chen Yi had taken absolute advantage.
He led Blue Star to become the strongest planet among the Myriad Clans.
Whether it was military strength, cultural strength, or economic strength, all were first class.
Without equal.
