The boss’s words left Chen Yue standing in silence, his mouth slightly open as if he wanted to argue, but for a moment he didn’t know where to begin. It seemed that what he had heard did indeed make sense.
It just seemed a little off ethically.
He felt very strange.
“Alright.”
As if noticing Chen Yue’s expression, the boss leaned back in his chair and said with a smile, “These theories might indeed sound strange, especially to someone who has just graduated from school like you, but that’s how many things are. It’s not you who is wrong; it’s society.”
“Having a good set of values is a good thing.”
“But you can’t expect everyone to share your values. Asking others to align with your values is, in itself, the most misaligned thing one can do.”
“Moreover, you can’t be sure that your values are absolutely right. Not to mention, had Mr. Chen Yi’s values been as upright as yours, Blue Star would have been annihilated long ago and wouldn’t have survived to this day, and you certainly wouldn’t be standing here talking to me like this.”
Just as the boss was in a great mood today and ready to share more wisdom with this young man who had doubled the company’s performance, planning to nurture him further, he suddenly received a message from a business partner and casually glanced at it, chuckling.
His face instantly stiffened.
His body trembling with shock, he nearly slithered out of his chair like an eel, kneeling beside the boss’s desk, his body facing the still-standing Chen Yue, head buried in the floor, not saying a word.
“Boss?”
Chen Yue, who was about to argue, was dumbfounded by the scene and didn’t know what had happened. As he was about to step forward to help, the company’s main door was suddenly pushed open.
Dozens of expressionless men in black, wearing Thorny Flower badges on their chests, strode in to take control of all the company employees and cut off all signals, while standing on both sides of the path from the company entrance to the office door.
It was as if they were clearing the scene in anticipation of someone’s arrival.
Immediately after.
A middle-aged man walked straight in from the company entrance, ignoring the black-clad men on both sides, only to slow down at the office door and then drop to one knee, his voice hoarse as he said.
“I am Tao Ping, employed at ‘Tuberculosis Rabbit Limited Cultural Media Company,’ serving as the leader of the third group.”
“Today, I am ordered to welcome Young Master Chen Yue back home!”
“…”
“…”
The moment the words fell, the controlled employees outside the office all clasped their mouths in disbelief, their eyes filled with shock. Was Chen Yue actually the young master?
Although they didn’t know which family’s young master he might be.
But they certainly knew about ‘Tuberculosis Rabbit Limited Cultural Media Company,’ recognized the Thorny Flower as the company’s trademark, knew that Tuberculosis Rabbit was Mr. Chen Yi’s most trusted confidant, and that the company was one of the largest industries on Blue Star.
The company had tens of thousands of employees and its industrial chain touched all aspects of Blue Star’s various industries, and it also had a significant market share in foreign trade with other planets.
Especially the ‘Tuberculosis Rabbit Art Gallery’ business district, which the company had put all its efforts into, had become one of the top ten hottest attractions on Blue Star, drawing countless people from Blue Star and travellers from other planets at every moment.
And the company had a total of, twelve groups.
Each group leader had authority far exceeding a city’s head, and was a figure with high-reaching influence. To say they were among the most powerful people on Blue Star was no exaggeration.
But… such a high-reaching leader of the third group was now kneeling in front of Chen Yue?
And even talking about welcoming the young master back home?
Was he the son of Tuberculosis Rabbit?
But wasn’t Mr. Tuberculosis Rabbit single? And his son’s surname shouldn’t be Chen, wait… Chen? Almost instantly, everyone who realized this point felt a thud in their heart.
Damn!
Could it be the son of Mr. Chen Yi?
They had been working in the same company with Mr. Chen Yi’s son for so long?
What Chen Yi represented on Blue Star went without saying, and being his son was a matter of extreme significance—no one would dare raise their voice in front of Chen Yi’s son!
Even the most argumentative and unreasonable woman would have to speak quietly and lower her voice in front of Chen Yi’s son.
Several women in the office were already turning their thoughts swiftly, their eyes moving constantly.
Welcome Young Master Chen Yue home!
Such a pleasing phrase.
In the past, they had watched some short dramas about the return of the Dragon King and scoffed at this line, dismissing it as juvenile scripting. Did anyone actually think this phrase was cool?
But when this event happened right beside them in reality.
They found how truly gratifying it sounded.
…

﻿Chapter 739: Extra 13: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue. Chapter 739: Extra 13: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue. “Was he really killed by a falling coconut?”
Although Chen Yue hadn’t yet grasped what the video was all about, he still asked instinctively, because such a cause of death was too bizarre. Normally, it was rare for people to die this way.
It was true that each year, quite a few people were hit by falling coconuts.
But at most, they would be hospitalized, or perhaps knocked unconscious.
But how could someone be killed outright by a coconut?
After all, it was just a coconut, not something like a durian. If it had been a durian, he might have believed it, considering a durian tree’s height—easily over ten meters—plus the weight of a durian.
It would be entirely reasonable for someone to be killed if hit by a falling durian.
Never mind killing a person—brain matter being splattered by it seemed entirely possible to him.
But a coconut? That made him somewhat skeptical.
Moreover, given Chen Miao’s sensitive identity, according to palace drama conventions, he might have been a strong contender in the battle for favor and succession. For him to suddenly die outside, and in such a bizarre way, seemed highly suspicious whatever way one looked at it.
Almost instantly,
Chen Yue formed a rough guess in his mind.
His birth mother, in order to secure his inheritance of everything Chen Yi owned, had designed Chen Miao’s death in secret, clearing away all obstacles for him. Henceforth, he would be Chen Yi’s only son, with no one capable of shaking his position.
After realizing this,
Even though it had been a long time since he had seen his mother, he still felt a strong sense of love emanating from her.
Yet this method made it difficult for him to accept; he never knew he had a brother, and he had always wished for one. More than that, he wasn’t particularly keen on power, and the idea of killing a relative for gain made him want to distance himself from his mother.
The mingling of these two feelings left him unsure of what to do.
“Alright,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, noticing the constantly changing expressions on Chen Yue’s face, let out a small sigh inwardly, gently patted Chen Yue’s shoulder, and whispered as they walked inside, “Let’s go in and talk.”
His composure was somewhat lacking.
His inner thoughts were all too visible on his face.
In this respect, he was far behind Chen Miao. Chen Miao never wore his thoughts on his face like Chen Yue did. With a naturally kind appearance and an eternally cheerful face, no one could guess what he was thinking.
He was much more shrewd.
At least when faced with women, Chen Yue would still lose his composure, but Chen Miao, even in the presence of a heavenly beauty, would show no reaction whatsoever.
Indeed, no reaction at all.
Not just in his facial expression—there would be no physical reaction whatsoever. If he hadn’t seen Chen Miao frequenting brothels numerous times, he might have even thought Chen Miao was impotent.
Even Yi had high praise for Chen Miao.
“He is the child who is most like me.”
This was no small compliment—in fact, it was quite the opposite.
Perhaps due to a kind of affection towards the things one loves, he also held great fondness for the child Chen Miao, but… alas.
At this point, Tuberculosis Rabbit leading the way couldn’t help but sigh inwardly, perhaps this was a case of the good dying young.
Soon—
They reached the door of a house within the courtyard.
And there, Sword Without End stood with a complex expression, looking much aged, his pupils filled with deep shame and guilt.
Chen Miao’s death,
Sword Without End undoubtedly felt the most self-reproach.
Considering his capabilities, it should have been impossible for him to fail to protect Chen Miao, but with just a turn of the head, Chen Miao was dead, killed by a coconut.
“I really tried,”
“The resurrection tool really didn’t work,”
Sword Without End, standing at the door and looking towards his old friend, Tuberculosis Rabbit, said in a trembling voice choked with sobs, “I really did use it, I tried all the resurrection tools I had, but none of them worked.”
During these days,
He was the one tormented the most.
He carried a number of resurrection tools in his backpack, which could have been used to bring Chen Miao back to life even after being hit by a coconut. In fact, he did try to do that as soon as he confirmed Chen Miao’s death, immediately pulling out a resurrection tool to revive him.
But after he crushed all the resurrection tools in his backpack,
Chen Miao did not come back to life; there was no response.
When Chen Yi received the news and rushed back from another planet, what he saw was Chen Miao’s already cold body.
In the following days, many within the courtyard wondered if Sword Without End had sided with Xu Yue, planning to elevate Chen Yue to power by deliberately letting Chen Miao die and thus removing a powerful competitor.
It was even conceivable that Sword Without End may have personally killed Chen Miao.
“Alright,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit looked at his old friend, who exuded an aura of death, and after a long silence, patted his arm and said hoarsely, “Yi has never doubted you, and Yi has also tried. The resurrection tool simply doesn’t work.”
“Experiments have already been conducted on that day.”
“The resurrection tool works normally on others.”
“Only on Chen Miao’s body, the resurrection tool doesn’t function.”
“It’s as if the heavens are determined to take Chen Miao, and there’s no changing that. The man is dead and cannot be brought back to life.”
“Don’t be too saddened by this.”
“Yi doesn’t want to see you like this.”
“Cheer up.”
“Whew!”
Sword Without End slowly took a deep breath, then forced a smile and reassured, “It’s okay, I’m all right.”
“Hmm.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit did not chat too much with Sword Without End but simply led Chen Yue into the house.
…
There were only a few people in the house.
Chen Yi was sitting in the main seat.
Jiaye and Xu Yue were sitting on side seats.
As Chen Yue just stepped into the house and saw the tall, familiar-looking woman, he immediately remembered his mother from his childhood, who looked just like her, although with some slight differences—it must have been a disguise back then.
The man sitting in the center resembled his father from memory by seventy percent.
Aged a bit.
But he didn’t look overly aged, rather he seemed more composed and radiated a strong sense of oppression that made him afraid to act out of line.
“Dad.”
“Mom.”
After hesitating for a moment, Chen Yue looked towards the not-so-tall woman standing to the side, her eyes slightly reddened, and said hoarsely, “Stepmom.”
This woman must be Jiaye.
…
“Was it really a coconut that killed him?”
Although Chen Yue hadn’t quite grasped what the video was about, he still asked subconsciously as the manner of death was too bizarre—normally, it’s rare for someone to die this way.
Indeed, quite a few people are hit by falling coconuts every year.
But at most, they’re sent to the hospital or knocked unconscious.
How could one be directly killed by it?
After all, it’s a coconut, not something like a durian; if it were a durian, perhaps he might believe it, considering the height of durian trees and the weight of their fruit.
Falling from such a height and with that mass, it would make sense for it to kill someone.
It’s plausible not just for killing a person, but even for causing brains to splatter—he thought it was possible.
But with coconuts, he found it hard to believe.
Moreover, given how sensitive Chen Miao’s status was, according to palace drama cliches, he might have been a strong contender with whom he was competing for favor and inheritance; his sudden death outside in such a peculiar manner seemed highly suspicious.
Almost instantly,
Chen Yue had a rough speculation in his heart.
His birth mother had schemed to kill Chen Miao in order for him to inherit everything from Chen Yi, clearing all obstacles for him; he would then be Chen Yi’s only son, with no one to challenge his status.
After realizing this,
Despite not having seen his mother for a long time, he still felt a strong love from her.
However, this act was something he found difficult to accept; he never knew he had a brother and had always wished for one. What’s more, he wasn’t that passionate about power and influence; using such means to kill his own relative for personal gain made him feel like running away from his mother.
These mixed feelings left him uncertain about what to do.
“Alright.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Chen Yue, whose expression kept changing, sighed inwardly, patted Chen Yue’s shoulder, and walked inside, saying softly, “Let’s go, we’ll talk more inside.”
His composure needed work.
His inner thoughts were all too visible on his face.
In this aspect, he was far behind Chen Miao, who never showed his thoughts like Chen Yue did. With naturally pleasant features and a constant smile on his face, no one could guess his thoughts.
He was much more calculating.
At least when it came to women, Chen Yue might lose composure, but Chen Miao wouldn’t react at all even to an angel.
Yes, not at all.
Not just in terms of facial expressions showing no change, but also his body gave no physical reaction; if it weren’t for seeing Chen Miao frequent brothels often, he might even think Chen Miao was impotent.
Even Yi held Chen Miao in high esteem.
This was the child most like him.
It wasn’t a low evaluation, rather, it was very high.

﻿Chapter 740: Extra 14: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part 2) Chapter 740: Extra 14: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part 2) Chen Yi paused for a moment before chuckling lightly, “My son, Chen Miao, may not have died, he may have just traveled to another world.”
“Traveled to a different world.”
“Not dead?”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit blinked in surprise, then suddenly realized the possibility. Right, it wasn’t impossible—after all, someone who was hit and killed by their truck could transmigrate, so it wouldn’t be unreasonable for someone killed by a falling coconut to do the same.
But the likelihood was very small, that’s all.
After hesitating for a while, he couldn’t help but ask, “Yi, how did you think of this?”
He felt that Yi might be overly heartbroken and had concocted this story in his mind to console himself, as losing a child in one’s middle age is indeed one of life’s great sorrows. If only it had been the loss of a spouse in middle age—that would have been a cause for celebration.
Tsk tsk tsk.
He inwardly cursed several times, how could he curse his sister-in-law like that? She had been so kind to him, and besides, Yi and his sister-in-law had a very good relationship. After so many years, their affection hadn’t changed a bit.
“You all think about it.”
Chen Yi, lost in thought with a cigarette hanging from his mouth, tilted his head to gaze into the distance, “Why would the resurrection item fail to work?”
“Sword Without End can’t use his resurrection prop, and neither can I. Since the beginning of the game until now, when have we ever encountered a resurrection prop failing?”
“To say that it suddenly became unusable is also unreasonable.”
“Why does it work on everyone else, but just happens to fail on my son?”
“Don’t you all think that’s strange?”
“It’s as if fate was insisting on my son’s death, but my son hasn’t done anything bad, nor has he committed any outrageous acts. A few small faults here and there surely don’t warrant such a fate, do they?”
“Moreover, his father saved the world—doesn’t that count as immense merit? Even if the rest of his life is not entirely peaceful, shouldn’t he at least not die just like that?”
“So I thought of a possibility.”
“Why can it be used normally on everyone else, but it just fails to work on my son?”
“Don’t you find that strange?”
“It’s almost as if the heavens wanted my son to die, yet my son didn’t do anything bad or commit any atrocious acts; surely small faults shouldn’t warrant such punishment, right?”
“Moreover, his father saved the world, a feat of immeasurable merit. You can’t tell me that he should just die like this, not even considering half a lifetime of peace and safety.”
“So I thought of a possibility.” After a brief pause, Chen Yi said with a light chuckle, “My son, Chen Miao, might not be dead, he might have crossed over.”
“Crossed over to another world.”
“Not dead?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was slightly stunned before reacting fiercely, “Right, that’s not impossible. After all, a person hit to death by a truck could cross over, so it’s reasonable to think someone killed by a falling coconut might cross over too.”
But the chance of this is very slight.
After hesitating for a long while, he couldn’t help but ask, “Yi, how did you come up with this idea?”
He felt that Yi might be overwhelmed by grief, inventing such a story to comfort himself, as, indeed, the loss of a child in middle age is one of life’s greatest tragedies. If only it were the loss of a wife at middle age; that would have been considered one of the great joys instead.
Tsk tsk tsk.
He cursed inwardly a few times, how could he jinx his sister-in-law, who was so kind to him? Besides, Yi’s relationship with his wife was very good, and over the years there had been no change in their affections.
“Think about it.”
Chen Yi, with a thoughtful expression, took a drag of his cigarette and turned his gaze toward the horizon, “Why would the resurrection prop stop working?”
“The resurrection prop in Sword Without End’s hands doesn’t work, and the resurrection prop in my hands doesn’t work either. Since the beginning of this upgradeable game, when have we ever encountered a failure of the resurrection prop?”
“To say it suddenly stopped working doesn’t make sense.”
“Why can it be used normally on everyone else, but it just fails to work on my son?”
“Don’t you find that strange?”
“It’s almost as if the heavens wanted my son to die, yet my son didn’t do anything bad or commit any atrocious acts; surely small faults shouldn’t warrant such punishment, right?”
“Moreover, his father saved the world,” Chen Yi paused again before saying with a light chuckle, “My son, Chen Miao, might not be dead, he might have crossed over.”
“Crossed over to another world.”
“Not dead?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was slightly stunned before reacting fiercely, “Right, that’s not impossible. After all, a person hit to death by a truck could cross over, so it’s reasonable to think someone killed by a falling coconut might cross over too.”
But the chance of this is very slight.

He felt that Yi might be overwhelmed by grief, inventing such a story to comfort himself, as, indeed, the loss of a child in middle age is one of life’s greatest tragedies. If only it were the loss of a wife at middle age; that would have been considered one of the great joys instead.
Tsk tsk tsk.
He cursed inwardly a few times, how could he jinx his sister-in-law, who was so kind to him? Besides, Yi’s relationship with his wife was very good, and over the years there had been no change in their affections.
“Think about it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - 741 Extra 15 The Return of Chen Yis Eldest Son Chen
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 741: Extra 15: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Three) Chapter 741: Extra 15: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Three) “Don’t worry.”
“Chen Miao, I’ve watched this child grow up since he was young, smart he is, wherever he goes, he won’t have too bad a time.”
“After all, he has inherited some of your charms, Yi.”
“Yes.”
Chen Yi sighed deeply, leaning on his cane, he looked into the distance and murmured, “If that’s the case, I’d be a bit more at ease.”
“I’m not worried about Chen Miao’s safety, with his brains I believe he can survive well in whichever world he ends up.”
“I just regret not revealing my identity to him in advance, I should have at least let him know that he has a mom and dad, now he probably thinks he’s an orphan in another world.”
“Alone in a strange world, I don’t know if he will feel any loneliness.”
“But it’s also good, luckily I didn’t reveal my identity beforehand; this way, he won’t have much resistance to that world and can integrate quickly. The faster he integrates, the greater his chances of survival.”
“If he knew he had parents, he might always want to return to this world, and that could lead to hasty mistakes.”
“I wonder what kind of world it is.”
“A Cultivation World, an Urban World, or some Apocalyptic World?”
After a moment of silence, Chen Yi felt the coldness in the wind, shook his head, and turned to walk toward the house, sadly saying, “Let’s go, we’ve been outside long enough, it’s time to go back.”
But just as he turned around!
A strange excitement flashed in Chen Yi’s eyes, he turned his head and stared intently at Tuberculosis Rabbit, enunciating each word, “The people who were hit by our truck and crossed over, they were all forced to return to Blue Star after the level-up game ended, right?”
“Ah?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had never seen such a look in Chen Yi’s eyes, was instinctively stunned on the spot. After a long while, he dredged up that memory and instinctively blurted out, “It seems so, there was such an incident.”
“At the end of the level-up game, those players who had crossed over were indeed forced to return.”
“So…”
Chen Yi licked his lips, his eyes shining with madness, “Tell me, if I restart the level-up game, do you think Chen Miao would come back?”
“Restart?” Tuberculosis Rabbit gulped nervously, shocked in place, not quite sure how to respond.
Even Sword Without End next to him swallowed hard, not knowing what to say. Restarting the level-up game would mean that many people from various planets would die. He and Chen Yi had discussed the possibility of restarting the level-up game a long time ago.
The existence of the level-up game was to counter the Deities.
If one became a Deity, there was a high chance to restart the level-up game, and becoming a Deity only needed some devout faith from believers.
Theoretically, it was possible.
It would just result in many deaths…
“…”
As Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End exchanged glances, unsure of what to say,
Chen Yi suddenly laughed, “Look at how scared I’ve made you, I’m just joking. Everyone has worked hard to have the life we have now, how could we possibly restart the level-up game? And you two should settle down too.”
“Otherwise, when you’re old, there won’t be anyone to take care of you.”
“Don’t make it happen that I have to support you in your old age, it would be quite troublesome.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit was momentarily stunned, then hastily laughed along a few times, but deep in his pupils, he couldn’t stop a trace of worry from flowing out. Knowing Yi well, he suspected that Yi’s words might not have been spoken casually.
To restart the level-up game, he had no objections.
After all, apart from Yi, there was nothing else he cared about.
But he was concerned that Yi might become obsessed, and if something went wrong mentally because the possibility Yi talked about seemed very low to him, it was practically an impossible feat.
But Yi… might take it seriously.

“But when the restaurant owner served the beef noodles, they were filled with beef.”

“Father, you really don’t have to do this!”
Although he knew the power and reach of the Chen Family on Blue Star was immense, this seemed a bit too overboard and tyrannical, didn’t it?
Making it so no one on Blue Star could eat beef just because he didn’t like it?
That really wasn’t necessary.
“Boisterous and vaguely amused, hahahahahahaha!!!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit, who had walked in, caught sight of Chen Yue’s embarrassed expression and couldn’t help bursting into a fit of laughter: “How come you don’t have a single funny bone in your body, haven’t you seen that old TV drama before?”
“There’s a villain in it who goes to eat beef noodles and says the shop owner will definitely serve him beef noodles without any beef because the owner dislikes him. He says if the shop owner serves him beef noodles without any beef, he would kill the owner.”
“Since the owner doesn’t like the villain, the villain was so sure that there wouldn’t be any beef in his noodles.”
“But what the owner served was beef noodles full of beef.”
“The villain, in a fit of rage and humiliation, shoots the owner. Have you seen this drama? Since then, the phrase ‘I don’t eat beef’ has been used to indicate someone’s unreasonableness.”

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 744: Extra 18: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part 6) Chapter 744: Extra 18: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part 6) Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t bother with the shock in Chen Yue’s eyes, but rather proudly lead the way, eyes filled with pride as he introduced his own artworks.
Indeed, they were something to be proud of.
Every piece of art here was crafted by Tuberculosis Rabbit himself without any outside help, each infused with his painstaking efforts, all deserving of being passed down to future generations and displayed in a museum forever.
And it was Chen Yue’s first time seeing the true face of what the historical books called an art gallery.
His mouth was almost always agape.
Just then—
Tuberculosis Rabbit, with a nostalgic look, pointed at a fox tail hanging on the wall and said, “This artwork is a prop, from a very long time ago. It was quite famous, although most people are not aware of it, but it had a significant reputation in Yancheng.”
“During a great war long, long ago.”
“The owner of this prop had charged into the ranks of the Alien Race, proving to everyone the fearlessness and bravery of the Blue Star Race, but it’s a pity now, for the owner of the prop sold it not too long ago.”
“It’s unknown what happened to make this person sell his Life-Bound Artifact.”
“After several turns of events, however, the prop finally returned to my hands.”
“I brought it back.”
“After all, this is an artifact that has made its mark on history; maybe here is its home, here is where it ought to remain.”
After finishing these words.
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused for a while before again lamenting, “The hero’s solitude is the coldest of all.”
Li Yide couldn’t be considered a hero.
But at least he was a valiant man, and to think someone like that ended up in the desperate situation of having to sell his possessions to get by in his old age, was truly sorrowful. Tuberculosis Rabbit had considered helping Li Yide, with his current status, it would take but a little effort to secure a worry-free and prosperous life for Li Yide for the rest of his days.
However, since Li Yide had never approached him, Tuberculosis Rabbit did not bring it up either, to avoid injuring Li Yide’s pride. As a man, he knew how to maintain a man’s dignity.
He knew all too well that it’s often in the depths of poverty that a man most fiercely wishes to protect his self-respect.
It’s just that most people don’t understand one truth.
That is, self-respect is often lost in the very act of desperately trying to protect it.
Sword Without End, standing to one side and looking at the fox tail on the wall, didn’t speak. He was aware of this affair, having been the one to discover this prop in the hands of a Foreign Clansman and immediately went after it.
Although his relationship with Li Yide was just so-so.
Still, they knew each other, and if Li Yide had died at the hands of a Foreign Clansman, Sword Without End couldn’t just stand by; it would be a provocation against the status of the Blue Star people.
Only after some inquiries did he find out it wasn’t that the Foreign Clansman had killed Li Yide and taken his artifact but rather Li Yide had voluntarily sold it to them. Through their investigation, they found out that Li Yide had not thought about making money over the years, had no means of production, leading to his dire state in old age, even to the point of starvation.
Once a figure who had commanded great respect in Yancheng, now couldn’t even afford a meal in his old age.
It was indeed lamentable.
The closing act of the hero, the fair lady grown old.
The two most desolate things in the world had both befallen Li Yide; it has to be said that Li Yide’s life was indeed a hard one.
“Do you know?”
Gazing at the fox tail on the wall, Tuberculosis Rabbit, struck by some thoughts, continued in a somber voice, “Really, in this one life, you might as well always be an ordinary person, living a peaceful life, living your own way.”
“But once, if one day this person catches an opportunity to soar high, makes a fair amount of money.”
“If one could always soar it would be fine, but if, for some reason, one day falls down, not many can withstand this kind of disparity, most will spend the rest of their lives in an atmosphere of extreme negativity, never able to rise again.”
“Yi, to cultivate you, you’ve lived your own life up until now. Now that you’re officially returning to the Chen Family, it’s expected that you will take over the Chen Family in the future. You will have to view issues not solely from your perspective anymore, but from that of the entire Chen Family, the entire Blue Star Race.”
“Do you think you can do it?”
“I…”
Chen Yue hesitated for a moment before lowering his head and saying, “I don’t know.”
Though he was top of his class in school, and his performance was not bad when he first entered the workforce, he has never viewed the entire world from such a high perspective, and the Chen Family seemed too enormous to him, let alone considering his position as the eldest son of the Chen Family, much less whether he could successfully take over the family.
“No matter.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said nonchalantly, “How’s your history knowledge?”
“Very good.”
Talking about his studies, Chen Yue suddenly felt confident and proudly stated, “In school, I usually got perfect scores in history.”
“…”
Letting out a sigh, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned to Sword Without End and said helplessly, “That’s the end of it.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit didn’t pay attention to the shock in Chen Yue’s eyes, walking straight ahead with pride while introducing his artworks.
In fact, they truly warranted pride.
Every piece of artwork here was created by him without any assistance: Each piece infused with Tuberculosis Rabbit’s painstaking efforts, deserving to be passed down to posterity and permanently displayed in a museum.
And for Chen Yue, it was the first time he had seen the true face of what the history books referred to as an art gallery.
His mouth remained agape the entire time.
Just then—
Looking wistfully at a fox tail hanging on the wall, Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke, “This piece is a prop which was quite famous a very long time ago. Although most people are unaware, it still holds some renown in Yancheng.”
“During a great war a very long time ago.”
“The owner of this prop had led the charge against the Alien Race, proving to everyone the fearlessness and courage of the Blue Star Race. It’s just a pity now, the owner sold this prop a short while ago.”
“It’s unknown what happened for this person to sell their own Life-Bound Artifact.”
“But after several twists and turns, the prop has come back into my hands.”
“I have reclaimed it.”
“After all, this is an artifact that holds a place in history; perhaps this is its home, and being here is the best tie it could have.”
Having said that,
Tuberculosis Rabbit paused for a moment before once again musing, “The desolation of a fallen hero is the most profound.”
Li Yide might not be a hero,
but he was at least a good man, and for such a man to end up in a situation where he had to sell his possessions to get by in his old age was indeed a matter of melancholy. He had thought about helping Li Yide. With his current status, doing something for Li Yide would be trivial,
enough to ensure Li Yide would live the latter half of his life in ease and opulence.
But since Li Yide had never approached him, he had not brought it up, not wanting to injure Li Yide’s pride. As a man, he knew how to protect a man’s pride.
He understood even more so that when a man is poorest, he is most desperate to sustain his dignity.
It’s just a truth most people fail to grasp.
That pride is often lost in the very act of fiercely clinging to it.
Standing to the side, Sword Without End looked at the fox tail on the wall and remained silent. He knew about this matter; it was he who had discovered the prop in the hands of a Foreign Clansman, and he had rushed to its defense immediately.
Although his relationship with Li Yide was average,
the recognition was there, and if Li Yide were to die at the hands of a Foreign Clansman, Sword Without End couldn’t just stand by, as it would also be a challenge to the status of the Blue Star People.
Only after some inquiries did he learn that the Foreign Clansman had not killed Li Yide and stole the artifact, but that Li Yide had sold it to them willingly. Following their investigation, they found that Li Yide had never considered making money, and he had no means of production, leading to a point in his old age where he couldn’t even afford meals.
Once a formidable figure in Yancheng, he now couldn’t afford food in his old age.
One couldn’t help but lament the situation.
The end of a hero, the aging of a beauty.
These were the two most desolate occurrences in the world, and Li Yide had unfortunately experienced both. It could be said that Li Yide’s life had been particularly harsh.
“Do you know?”
Gazing at the fox tail on the wall, Tuberculosis Rabbit, being somewhat reminiscent, continued, “You see, in a lifetime, it’s better to be an ordinary person, peacefully living one’s own small life, in one’s own way.”
“But once, if that person seizes an opportunity one day and takes off, making a lot of money,”
“it would be well and good if the ascent could continue, but if one day there’s a fall, most people can’t bear such a drastic change. Many spend the rest of their lives in profound negativity, never able to rise again.”
“Yi, to nurture you, you have lived your life independently during the first half of your life. Now that you have officially returned to the Chen Family, you will definitely have to take the helm in the future. You can’t look at problems solely from your own perspective anymore. You need to consider them from the entire Chen Family angle, the whole Blue Star’s standpoint.”
“Do you think you can do that?”
“I…”
After hesitating for a moment, Chen Yue lowered his head and said, “I don’t know.”
Although he was top-ranked in academics at school and had a decent start in his career, he had never viewed the whole world from a high vantage point. The Chen Family was too vast for him, and he hardly dared to even think about the fact that he was the eldest son of the Chen Family, let alone whether he could successfully take over the Chen Family.
“No matter,”
Tuberculosis Rabbit said casually, “How well did you study history?”
“Very well.”
When it came to his studies, Chen Yue suddenly felt confident, puffing his chest proudly, “In school, I usually scored perfect marks in history.”
“…”
With a soft sigh, Tuberculosis Rabbit turned to Sword Without End and said helplessly, “That’s the end of it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 745: Extra 19: The Return of Chen Yi's Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part 7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 745: Extra 19: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part 7)
The first time he spoke up.
Tuberculosis Rabbit gave him a relatively decent job out of consideration for their past relationship and for the fact that they were from the same era.
But the second time he spoke up…
There would be no second time.
Li Yide stood in place with a complex expression. He wasn’t a stranger to the ways of the world; he knew very well that this was his only opportunity to speak up, and what made him grateful was that Tuberculosis Rabbit had responded to his request.
These nights, he had prayed to countless deities.
However, the only one who responded to him was Tuberculosis Rabbit.
“Thank you.”
Li Yide looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit sitting on the couch with a complex expression, not knowing what to say. He wanted to express his gratitude but found nothing seemed adequate to convey his thanks, especially considering the gaping disparity between his and Tuberculosis Rabbit’s status now.
“It’s nothing.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head, hesitating for a long moment before deciding to clarify, “Your Fox Tail…”
He had only just started to speak.
Li Yide lowered his head in embarrassment and said softly, “I ran into some financial trouble recently and sold the Fox Tail. After all, the world is at peace now, and there’s no need for such things anymore.”
He had found a reason that could deceive even himself.
And that was the reason he’d been using to numb himself these days.
Only he knew what the Fox Tail signified to him.
It wasn’t just his strongest prop, or the prop that had accompanied him the longest, but it also represented his past glory, his somewhat glorious past, and selling the Fox Tail meant he had sold out his former self.
Especially when his old friends from former days found out.
It made him feel even less able to hold his head high.
There was nothing more embarrassing than one’s old friends learning of one’s decline, especially if the friend was still doing impressively well. Many times, he had thought to himself:
If he, like Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End, had followed Yi’s lead, perhaps his current situation would have been entirely different.
Would he have had immense power, becoming one of the top figures on Blue Star or even in the entire universe?
“That’s not what this is about.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head and explained, “Your Fox Tail somehow ended up in my hands, and I’ve added it to my art gallery collection. After all, that prop had its moment of glory in the history of Blue Star.”
“It also represents our era, suggesting that some minor characters were also striving to burn brightly.”
“It holds great commemorative significance.”
“…”
Li Yide’s face stiffened with a touch of embarrassment as he stood still, what did it mean to say that it represented our era, suggesting that some minor characters were also striving to burn brightly? Was he… a minor character?
Back then, he was quite well-known in Yancheng.
He even formed his own team.
Many looked up to him.
Although compared to Yi and the others, he indeed was a minor character of the era.
After all, in the era, he was just a small grain of sand flowing with the current, while Yi and his clique were entities altering the era itself; indeed, not on the same level or dimension, even if it sounded a bit awkward to hear.
Unaware of Li Yide’s emotions, Tuberculosis Rabbit continued, “But when Yi learned of your situation, he told me to give the prop back to you. After all, you must have feelings for it.”
“It represents not only your past glory but also the stories you’ve lived through.”
“Compared to being collected in my art gallery,”
“Yi believes, this prop should stay with you.”
With that,
Tuberculosis Rabbit casually snapped his fingers.
Suddenly, a woman in a work uniform, looking graceful with white gloved hands holding a tray, entered the office. On the tray was prominently placed a red Fox Tail.
The woman walked up to Li Yide’s side.
She knelt on both knees and lifted the tray in midair.
“Here you go.”
Leaning on the couch with his arm draped over the side, Tuberculosis Rabbit casually drained the red wine from his glass and said, “The property returns to its master. This thing is more meaningful in your hands.”
Although he thought the prop had commemorative value deserving of his art gallery,
He never forgot how Li Yide used that prop.
It was, after all, something inserted into one’s backside.
He hadn’t touched it afterward, let alone put it in his backpack. He always had others handle such matters; he did not want to touch such an item himself – it felt somewhat unlucky.
“I…”
Seeing his familiar Fox Tail appear before him once more, Li Yide, who had been suppressing his emotions all along, finally couldn’t hold back as his eyes reddened and tears began to trickle down his cheeks. He looked at Tuberculosis Rabbit and hoarsely said with a tearful voice.
“Thank you!”
“Thank you, Yi!”

chapters.title: Chapter 746: Extra 20: The Return of Chen Yi's Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part 8)
chapters.content:
Chapter 746: Extra 20: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part 8)
“Resolved?”
Sword Without End stood at the edge of the rooftop, casually tossing a cigarette to Tuberculosis Rabbit as he gazed at the city’s outskirts.
“Yeah.”
After receiving the cigarette and taking a fierce drag, Tuberculosis Rabbit casually said, “It’s all taken care of. Gave Fox Tail back to him and made him the head of the seventh group in my company. Should be no problem now.”
“That guy’s not much of a gambler.”
“He’s just a bit too much of a lovebird, always sticking close to his wife, kind of annoying. He spends all his money on her without thinking about how to make more. That’s how he ended up here.”
“I remember he used to be quite proactive, but ever since the game of leveling up ended and he officially got together with Xiaoqian, he became like this. But I can understand it. After all, Li Yide wasn’t well-liked from childhood.”
“He made a bit of a name for himself when the game of leveling up came along, but wearing Fox Tail all the time, he was secretly mocked by many. Until he met Xiaoqian, a woman truly willing to abandon everything to follow him, to love him.”
“And naturally, he lost himself.”
“He’s never woken from that fall.”
Sword Without End chuckled lightly, extending his cigarette over the balcony railing, “It’s fine now, at least Li Yide turned out to be more devoted than I thought. Wasn’t it said he courted hundreds of girls before, even getting some kind of title for it? I really didn’t expect him to reform to this extent.”
“Those were probably purely to attract attention, to feel some sense of existence.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head and sighed, “People with unpleasant childhoods often have a complex personality: both inferior and arrogant. They want to attract attention, fearing to die unnoticed in society.”
“Actually, it’s quite pitiable.”
“What about you.” He paused for a moment before looking up at Sword Without End, “I heard you’re about to get married, to the Clone?”
“Yeah.”
Sword Without End smiled indulgently, “Everyone’s on the right track now. My life should also move into a new phase. The wedding is planned for these next few days. You’ve got to be there to support me.”
“Nonsense.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit gave Sword Without End a look, “With our relationship, how could I possibly not go? Eh, but you know, since your wife is a Clone, one cloned from you at that.”
“What if there’s a possibility, you clone another one based on you, I don’t have a wife yet, hey hey hey, why are you drawing your sword, I’m just saying.”
“Look at you, why so impatient?”
“Can’t you take a joke?”
“Clone, huh, I used to let you go first when we played Russian Roulette, and now you won’t even share a Clone, you really are… Alright, alright stop hitting me, I’ll stop being a smartass.”
“I give up, my bad, damn it, I admitted I was wrong, so why the hell are you still hitting me!”
Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End chased each other out, one after the other, and the balcony gradually quieted down again.
After pursuing for a while, Sword Without End stopped chasing and let Tuberculosis Rabbit run off while talking rubbish. Floating in mid-air for a long time, he couldn’t help but shake his head and laugh.
In fact, he knew that Tuberculosis Rabbit was just trying to cheer him up.
Because of Chen Miao’s affair, he indeed had been feeling terrible lately, unable to cheer up easily. He always thought that a big reason for Chen Miao’s death was because he was distracted. If he had been paying attention to Chen Miao at the time, maybe he could have saved him from that falling coconut.
But…
There’s no medicine for regret in life.
No matter how he replays it.
Chen Miao was still dead, unable to be brought back to life. He had planned to call off the wedding, but Yi forced him to go ahead with it. Yi said not to let Chen Miao’s incident affect everyone, and besides, Chen Miao didn’t die, he just traveled through time and space, and there would be a chance to meet again someday.
Ever since Yi firmly believed that Chen Miao was not dead, just hit by a time-traveling coconut, he has become much more cheerful, without the sense of grief, as if he were convinced his son would one day return to find him.
Letting the wedding proceed as scheduled was like rushing happiness.
Although they all clearly understood that saying Chen Miao didn’t die, just time-traveled, was probably only good for fooling children—after all, such convenient occurrences don’t exist in the world—they wouldn’t argue since it made Yi feel better, sparing him from dwelling on the incident every day and feeling so distressed.
“Phew!”
After a long while, Sword Without End floating in the air exhaled deeply and flew towards his house.
…
“Tch.”
After Sword Without End flew away, Tuberculosis Rabbit emerged from behind a building in the distance, looking at Sword Without End’s retreating figure and couldn’t help but sigh with a mix of emotions, “How self-obsessed does one have to be to marry oneself?”
Self-love, by definition, means liking oneself.
It generally has a derogatory connotation.
Suggesting that some people like themselves a bit too much, leading to excessive self-confidence.
But when it comes to self-love, if Sword Without End is first, probably no one dares to claim second. He straightforwardly fell in love with himself, taking the term self-love to a whole new level.
It’s beyond imagination.
Sword Without End created a clone based on his own image, virtually identical to himself, but with some female-specific organs added, and then stuffed an artificial intelligence chip into her brain.
Through learning, she could slowly possess a certain degree of autonomous intelligence.
Just like nurturing a newborn.
“However…”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit suddenly paused, as if deep in thought, and stood there, contemplating without speaking.
“Is it taken care of?”
Sword Without End, standing on the edge of the rooftop, casually tossed a cigarette to the Tuberculosis Rabbit, gazing into the distant city edge.
“Yeah.”
After receiving the cigarette and lighting it, taking a deep drag, the Tuberculosis Rabbit spoke casually, “It’s all settled. I returned Fox Tail to him and let him be the team leader of Group Seven in my company. It should be fine.”
“The guy isn’t much of a gambler.”
“It’s just that he’s a bit too romantic, always sticking with his wife and spending almost all his money on her without thinking about how to make money. That’s how he ended up here.”
“I remember he used to be quite persistent, but he changed after the game’s been upgraded and he officially got together with Xiaoqian. It’s understandable though, since Li Yide hasn’t been well-liked since he was young.”
“He gained some fame after breaking through in the upgraded game but was also mocked behind his back for wearing Fox Tail for too long. That is until he met Xiaoqian, a woman truly willing to abandon everything to follow and love him.”
“Naturally, he was lost to it.”
“And he never woke up from that fall.”
Sword Without End chuckled, extending his cigarette out over the balcony, “It’s alright. At least Li Yide is much more faithful than I thought. Wasn’t it said he chased after hundreds of girls before? He even got some kind of nickname back then. I never thought he’d reform to this extent.”
“All that was probably just to attract attention, to feel significant.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit shook his head with a sigh, “These people, with their unhappy childhoods, often have personalities that are both inferior and arrogant. They crave attention, fearing they’ll die unnoticed in this society.”
“It’s actually quite pitiful.”
“What about you?” After a pause, he looked up at Sword Without End, “I heard you are about to get married, with that clone?”
“Yeah.”
Sword Without End smiled affectionately, “Everyone’s getting on the right track. It’s time for me to enter a new phase of life too. The wedding’s expected to happen in a few days. You have to come and support me, alright?”
“Nonsense.”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit gave Sword Without End a disdainful look, “With our relationship, how could I not go? But hey, since your wife is a clone, created based on you…”
“What if there’s a possibility… you make another clone based on you for me since I don’t have a wife either—hey, hey, hey, why are you drawing your sword? I was just talking.”
“Look at you, why so irritated?”
“Can’t you take a joke?”
“A clone, huh? Back when I used to let you go first while we played Russian Roulette, and now you wouldn’t even share a clone with me. Really, you are… Alright, alright, stop hitting me, I won’t be annoying anymore.”
“I give up, I was wrong, dammit I said I was wrong, and you still hit me?!”
The Tuberculosis Rabbit and Sword Without End chased each other off the balcony, and it gradually became quiet again.
After pursuing for a while, Sword Without End didn’t continue, but let the Tuberculosis Rabbit run off while babbling. Hovering in the air for a while, he couldn’t help but shake his head with a laugh.
He knew the Tuberculosis Rabbit was just trying to cheer him up.
Because of Chen Miao’s incident, he had really been feeling awful lately, finding it hard to be happy. He always felt that Chen Miao’s death was largely due to his own distraction—if he had been keeping an eye on Chen Miao, he might have been able to save him the moment the coconut was about to fall.
But…
There are no remedies for regret.
No matter how much he replayed it in his mind.
Chen Miao was gone, never to be revived. He had planned to call off the wedding, but Yi insisted he go through with it, saying he shouldn’t allow Chen Miao’s incident to impact everyone else and arguing that Chen Miao wasn’t dead but had just time-traveled, and there would be other chances to meet.
Ever since Yi firmly believed that Chen Miao hadn’t died but was time-traveled by the coconut, he became much more cheerful, without the sense of sorrow, acting as if certain that his son would return to him someday.
Having the wedding as scheduled was like a blessing in disguise.
Although in their hearts they all knew that this story about Chen Miao not dying but time-traveling could only deceive children, such coincidences didn’t exist in the real world. However, since Yi firmly believed it, they wouldn’t speak against it. At least this belief offered Yi some comfort, sparing him the torment of dwelling on the incident every day.
“Whew!”
After hovering for a long time, Sword Without End exhaled and flew towards his own house.
…
“Tsk.”
After Sword Without End flew away, the Tuberculosis Rabbit reemerged from behind a building in the distance. Gazing at Sword Without End’s retreating figure, he couldn’t help but sigh emotionally, “How self-obsessed does one have to be, to marry a clone of oneself?”
The word “narcissism” literally means liking oneself.
It is generally pejorative.
Meaning it’s used to describe people who are disproportionately fond of themselves, leading to excessive confidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 747: Extra 21: The Return of Chen Yi's Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Nine)
chapters.content:
Chapter 747: Extra 21: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Nine)
“…”
Sword Without End remained silent for a long while, not speaking. Although he found it hard to believe that such coincidences could exist in this world, since Yi was so confident, he wouldn’t say much more.
On the contrary, Yi’s mental state had improved quite a bit.
It was exactly what he had hoped to see.

chapters.title: Chapter 748: Extra 22: The Return of Chen Yi's Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Ten)
chapters.content:
Chapter 748: Extra 22: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Ten)
There was silence on the other end of the phone for a while before Yi’s familiar chuckling came through, “Alright, I’ll bring the brothers over for some of your fire pot in the next few days. I haven’t had it for a while, indeed I’ve been missing that taste.”
“Good, good, good!!”
Old Huang, his voice trembling with excitement, didn’t dare to delay Yi’s time any longer, chatted a few sentences about family matters, and then shakily hung up the phone. Afterward, he turned to the old friends beside him with his cheeks flushed with excitement.
“Did you hear that?”
“Did all of you hear that? I’ve told you before, I’m tight with Yi, and you guys are not.”
“Back then, Yi almost came to eat my fire pot every day, everyone in Yancheng knew about it, only those who ran to play dead in the Sands of Time Map at the first opportunity didn’t know.”
“Now do you believe me?”
At this moment, Old Huang’s face was full of pride and excitement, his back even straightened up a lot, making him look much younger.
And then.
Only now did these old friends recover from their shock, exchanging glances, all seeing the amazement on each other’s faces. They didn’t expect that Old Huang, who bragged to them every day, actually had such a close friendship with Yi.
“It’s not like that, Old Huang,”
an elder couldn’t help but say, “Since you’re so close to Yi, why not ask him to get you a good job? Why are you hiding here with us, living aimlessly? Not to mention becoming some big shot, but at least you should have a status in Yancheng, right?”
“With your relationship with Yi, you might even become the deputy mayor of Yancheng.”
“Hmph,”
Old Huang scoffed disdainfully, “You make it sound like I’m doing terribly. When the game was still around, I had opened several fire pot restaurants, okay? Even in hell, I opened a few.”
“Back then, there weren’t many who were doing business in both Blue Star and hell at the same time, and I was one of them.”
“So, the business wasn’t small.”
“Lastly, when the game ended, I opened several more fire pot restaurants, started a catering company, and handed it over to my son to manage. Now I already have dozens of fire pot chain stores under my name, okay?”
“As far as I know, the goal for next year is to expand the branches to other races, sending people to investigate the tastes of different Alien Races, preparing to make some adjustments according to the tastes of each Race.”
“I’m not miserable, so why should I go begging to Yi? Besides, there must be plenty of people seeking Yi’s favor every day. If I bother Yi with such a trivial matter, how would Yi view me?”
“Huh?”
Old Huang, with his hands clasped behind him, leisurely made his way home with his little bench, ready to start preparing the fire pot base for Yi. At this moment, Old Huang seemed to be revitalized, his face free of any lifelessness, his whole being looking incredibly spirited.
…
“Whose call was that?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit casually asked, sitting beside Chen Yi.
After Chen Yi hung up the phone, he looked at the person he hadn’t been in contact with for many years, and also felt somewhat emotional, “The fire pot restaurant owner, the one we used to go to a lot, I have shares in it.”
–
“As far as I know, next year’s goal is to expand the branches to other Races. Right now, people are being sent to research the taste preferences of other Alien Races, preparing to make some adjustments based on the different tastes of each Race,” he said.
“I’m not doing too badly, so why should I go begging Yi for help? Besides, there are probably tons of people asking Yi for favors every day. If I go to him over something trivial like this, what would Yi think of me?”
“Hmm?”
Old Huang walked toward his home, hands clasped behind his back, carrying his little stool leisurely, preparing to go home and ready the firepot base for Yi. At this moment, Old Huang seemed rejuvenated, his face devoid of any pallor, looking in extremely high spirits.
…
“Whose call was it?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit asked casually, sitting next to Chen Yi.
After Chen Yi hung up, he looked at the person whom he hadn’t been in touch with for many years and said somewhat emotionally, “The owner of the firepot restaurant, the one we always go to eat at, I’ve even invested in it.” There was silence on the other end of the line for a while, before Yi’s familiar light laugh came through, “Alright, in the next few days I’ll bring the brothers over for a meal of your firepot, it’s been a while and I really miss that taste.”
“Good, good, good!!”
Old Huang’s voice trembled with excitement, and he didn’t dare to delay Yi’s time any longer. After a brief exchange of pleasantries, he shakily hung up the phone, then turned to look at the group of old friends next to him, his cheeks flush with excitement.
“Did you hear that?”
“Did you all hear that? I told you before that I’m on good terms with Yi, and you guys aren’t,” he boasted.
“Back then, Yi almost came every day to eat my firepot. Who in Yancheng didn’t know that? Only those of you who ran off to play dead in the Sands of Time Map the moment it came out wouldn’t know,” he taunted.
“Now do you believe me?”
At that moment, Old Huang’s face was full of pride and excitement, his back even straightened out a bit, making him look many years younger.
Just then.
The old friends around him had recovered from their shock, exchanged glances, and saw the astonishment on each other’s faces. They had not expected Old Huang, who had always bragged to them, to actually have such a strong friendship with Yi.
“It’s not that, Old Huang,” an old man couldn’t help but speak up. “Since you’re so close to Yi, why don’t you ask him to find you a good job? Why hide here and waste away with us? You might not become some big shot, but at least you’d have some status in Yancheng, right?”
“With your relationship with Yi, you could probably even become the deputy mayor of Yancheng.”
“Hmph.”
Old Huang scoffed disdainfully, “You make it sound like I’m in a bad situation. When the Ascension game was still around, I had already opened several firepot restaurants, alright? Even in hell, I opened quite a few.”
“At that time, there weren’t many people doing business in both Blue Star and hell simultaneously, and I was one of them.”
“That’s not a small business by any means.”
“After the Ascension game ended, I opened several more firepot restaurants, established a catering company, and left it to my son to manage. Now, I have dozens of firepot restaurant chains under my name, you know.”
“As far as I know, next year’s goal is to expand the branches to other Races, sending people to investigate the taste preferences of other Alien Races, preparing to make some adjustments based on the different tastes of each Race,” he continued.
“I’m not doing so badly, so why should I go begging Yi for help? Besides, the number of people asking Yi for favors every day must be overwhelming. If I were to bother Yi for something as trivial as this, how would Yi see me?”
“Hmm?”
Old Huang walked toward his home, hands clasped behind his back, carrying his little stool leisurely, ready to start preparing the firepot base for Yi. At this moment, Old Huang seemed rejuvenated, his face devoid of any pallor, looking in extremely high spirits.
…
“Whose call was it?”
Tuberculosis Rabbit asked casually, sitting next to Chen Yi.
And after Chen Yi hung up, looking at the person whom he hadn’t contacted in so many years, he felt somewhat emotional, “The owner of the firepot restaurant, the one we always went to, where I also invested.”

Chapter 751: Extra 25: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Thirteen)
Soon.
The dinner party slowly came to an end amidst everyone’s lively conversation.
Old Huang, standing on the rooftop with a beaming smile, waving goodbye to Chen Yi and the others, didn’t breathe a sigh of relief until the moment he saw their figures disappear. His previously erect posture instantly slumped.
His health was already very poor.
It was only out of a desire to appear in good physical condition that he had been forcing himself.
“Father.”
The young man quickly supported his father, subtly expressing his grievance, “Why did you suddenly bring up the matter of matchmaking? I don’t want to get married yet; I want to establish my career before starting a family.”
“…”
Old Huang shot the man a slightly speechless glance, “Who the hell is matchmaking for you? Get married if you love to or don’t if you don’t want to; it would be best to end our lineage, can’t you even understand hints? I was seeking opportunities for you.”
“Since Yi honored me by making the trip,”
“I, Old Huang, don’t mind losing face and must secure your future. This time might be the last time we see Yi, he won’t come again. Some people, one meeting is enough.”
“It’s not about getting annoyed, but no one reminisces about the past every day. We are just characters for Yi and Tuberculosis Rabbit to reflect on the past.”
“To meet again, we would have to wait until Tuberculosis Rabbit wants to reminisce again, but I probably won’t live that long.”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit’s intentions were already clear, just go directly to his company tomorrow. Li Yide will explain the specifics to you, and when the time comes, don’t be pretentious, quickly lay out your demands, like, what if you were given something now that could lead to rapid development of your company’s business.”
“Do you understand?”
…
Meanwhile, on Chen Yi’s side.
Before the party broke up, Li Yide whispered into Tuberculosis Rabbit’s ear, “How forcefully should we proceed tomorrow?”
He was the leader of the seventh group.
His main responsibility was to deal with various races; otherwise, the business trade affairs, these days he was still getting familiar with the procedures and wasn’t sure how to discuss with Little Huang without Tuberculosis Rabbit’s instructions, he truly didn’t dare to act recklessly.
Tuberculosis Rabbit considered for a moment before speaking, “Isn’t the company holding an event to promote Blue Star cuisine lately? Prepare to extend Blue Star’s iconic foods to other planets.”
“Isn’t hot pot catering one of the three brands selected?”
“Strike one off.”
“Replace it with Little Huang’s catering company.”
“This…”
Li Yide’s mouth dropped open slightly in shock, this event was a cultural invasion approved by Yi, costing a fortune to promote Blue Star cuisine. The company covered all the expenses for opening new restaurant outlets on Alien Race territories.
Each food brand had a quota of 1,000 outlets.
That is to say, it was equivalent to gifting Little Huang 1,000 hot pot restaurants. It took two generations to build a catering company with just tens of chained hot pot restaurants, but after this meal, it turned into over 1,000.
And that’s just on the surface. Deeper aspects like brand influence, being among the first batch of Blue Star cuisine to go to other races, guaranteed operational experience on Alien Race territories, and so on, are incalculable in monetary terms.
It can be said that Little Huang has soared to the heavens.

chapters.content:
Chapter 752: Yes
The sound ceased.
He knew he had misspoken, and just as he was about to open his mouth to fix it, Tuberculosis Rabbit and the others started to laugh uncontrollably.
“You’re quite interesting, kid. We’re setting you up on a blind date here, asking what your standards are, and you say anything goes, don’t even hesitate.”
“Got a good appetite.”
“Alright, then it’s settled.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at Yi, and upon seeing Yi nod slightly, he turned to introduce Li Yide who was standing beside him: “This is Li Yide, Old Huang, you should know him, a big name from Yancheng in the old days, right? He was the first to charge out during the Race Duel Battle; his courage and ability are both top-notch in Yancheng.”
Feeling a bit embarrassed, Li Yide looked at Old Huang with a smile and raised his glass in greeting,
It might have been so in the past, but now he had fallen on hard times and lost his ambition long ago; words like courage and ability had nothing to do with him anymore.
He should not have talked about those matters.
“He’s been traveling among other races for many years, and only recently came back to Blue Star to retire. He’s doing me a favor by taking a team leader position in my company’s Group Seven, helping me with some chores. So, you can just have your son come directly to my company to find him tomorrow.”
“Whatever kind of wife you want, no problem.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit couldn’t help but laugh, looking toward the young man who had stood up: “Alright, sit down. You know where my company is, right?”
How could he not see Old Huang’s intentions.
Saying he’d help find a wife was one thing, but the real message was whether he could give his son a boost. When smart people talk to each other, a single tone can reveal a different meaning. In reality, there was no need to say it at all; they understood what it meant the moment Old Huang brought his son over.
This was all quite harmless.
It was the child of an old acquaintance; if they could lend a hand, they would. What was a casual favor for them represented a social stratum that people like Old Huang could spend their entire lives struggling to reach and never attain.
Social class is determined by the generation of your parents.
The only way to change your class is a period of extreme social upheaval, during which a new class slowly emerges, taking over the position of the old class, and then passing that position down to their own descendants.
Until the next global upheaval.
This is the underlying principle of how the world operates; and undoubtedly, they would be the biggest beneficiaries after this global upheaval concludes, without equals, thanks to themselves, their children, and their friends, who will all enjoy certain social privileges.
This is perfectly normal.
Parents struggle and shed blood, not to let their children eat meager meals.
“Thank you, Yi, thank you Tuberculosis Rabbit, and thank you, everyone.”
Upon hearing this, Old Huang immediately showed his gratitude, continuously standing up and lifting his glass to toast from afar. He also grasped the meaning behind Tuberculosis Rabbit’s words, which were an offer to give his son a leg up. They’d first set the tone today and then discuss specifics at the company tomorrow.
It’s just that the task would be handled by subordinates, not by them personally, which signified that they could give a boost, but not too high.
But that was enough.
Group Seven’s team leader – that was a position in Tuberculosis Rabbit Company that commanded more respect than even a mayor in any place, wielding immense power. To have such a person aid his son was more than sufficient.
“No problem.”
Chen Yi smiled and waved his hand dismissively: “The kid’s grown up; it’s time he got married. I’m thinking of finding a wife for my eldest, Chen Yue, too.”
Soon.
The end of the dinner party gradually drew to a close amid everyone’s lively conversation.
Old Huang, standing on the rooftop with a smile on his face and waving goodbye to Chen Yi and the others, only let out a sigh of relief when they’d gone out of sight. His once upright posture instantly slumped.
His health was very poor.
He was only pretending to be in good shape out of sheer willpower.

Chapter 753: Extra 27: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Fifteen)
“This…”
Little Huang was visibly shaken as he looked at the contract Tuberculosis Rabbit had handed to him, his face filled with disbelief. He knew of this event; it was quite famous within the industry.

He recognized this person.
The owner of ‘One-Person Pot,’ his long-standing nemesis.
–
“Hey.”
Seeing his familiar nemesis appear here made Little Huang pause momentarily, as if some thought had suddenly brought a smile to his face. Ordinarily, whenever he encountered this man, he would typically go out of his way to avoid him to prevent being humiliated.
But today, he suddenly had no intention of avoiding him.
However, before he could say anything.
“This…”
Little Huang was visibly shaken as he looked at the contract Tuberculosis Rabbit had handed to him, his face filled with disbelief. He knew of this event; it was quite famous within the industry.
Tuberculosis Rabbit Company had partnered with several gourmet companies, selected the top contenders in each culinary category, and was planning to jointly open stores on Alien Race’s territory, aiming to promote Blue Star’s food culture abroad.

But for the companies that had been selected, it was an opportunity to make a fortune.

With just a few dozen hot pot restaurants to his name, and his own brand not even well-established, how could he have been selected?
Just…
Who would have thought, while dining, this opportunity would be offered to him?
And it wasn’t a done deal; the slot had already been set aside for him to simply pick one, then take their place? Was it really that straightforward and blunt?
“Mm.”
Seeing the shock on Little Huang’s face, Li Yide smiled and explained, “Originally, Tuberculosis Rabbit wanted me to make the call, but I figured since you’re all in the same line of business, there might be someone you don’t get along with, so I let you decide.”
“Can I really do that?”
“Of course, you can.”
Little Huang looked down at the three hotpot restaurants, “Ye Chang’an,” “Piao Piao Xiang,” “One-Person Pot.” Of these, he had little to no dealings with the first two brands, except for “One-Person Pot.”
He knew the owner of “One-Person Pot.” He was a college classmate of his, and ever since they were in class together, they had been at odds over a girl they both liked, turning into archenemies after graduating college, both opening hotpot restaurants and entering the competitive arena of the food industry.
However, his choice was mass-market dining, focusing on taste.

Afterwards, it was store openings one after another.
The brand’s influence grew increasingly stronger, and now it had become a dining company with over 900 hotpot restaurants.

…

As Little Huang descended the stairs, ready to chat more with the young lady from the day before, he heard a familiar mocking voice at his ear, “Hah, isn’t this Little Huang? I thought it was someone else.”

Yet…
He didn’t expect that while having a meal, this opportunity would fall into his lap? And it wasn’t a set-up; the spot was already secured. He just had to pick one to replace. Was it really that simple and crude?

chapters.title: Chapter 754: Extra 28: Grand Finale.
chapters.content:
Chapter 754: Extra 28: Grand Finale.
“Ah?”
Little Huang, in the midst of his excitement, had never considered this problem. It was only after his father’s reminder that he did some quick calculations and realized he couldn’t possibly afford so much money. A hot pot restaurant needs at least 7 people, including waitstaff, receptionists, doormen, kitchen staff, and so on.
That’s already the minimum staffing.
And for 1000 stores, that would mean at least 7000 people.
He couldn’t possibly manage these 1000 stores himself, and no one could, which means a large number of management personnel would be necessary. That would be at least another 100 people. The astronomical sums needed for their monthly salaries…
The average monthly income at Blue Star is around 11k.
The salary of a waiter goes for about 6k, varying by city.
The salary of the service staff going to other Alien Race territories should definitely be higher. After all, who would go to such a distant and unfamiliar place without a higher paycheck?
Tuberculosis Rabbit Company, on the other end, is willing to take on all the expenses for opening the stores, with the sole condition that the staff must be from Blue Star.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t serve the purpose of promoting Blue Star’s cuisine.
In that case, the salary for service personnel should be at least 10k to attract applicants.
The salaries for management and kitchen staff are even higher.
Even if we go by the lowest wage of 10k a month, the salaries for these 1000 stores would be… 70 million…
70 million…
He currently has just over 20 hot pot restaurants. Even if he sold all of them, he still couldn’t round up 70 million, not even enough to cover one month’s worth of wages. Even if he sold everything he owned, it would be useless.
And because it’s a trial run in Alien Race territories, he might not even make money in the first month.
If he doesn’t earn 70 million in the first month, he wouldn’t be able to pay the second month’s salaries.
“This…”
Little Huang, who had just been very excited, suddenly realized after crunching some numbers that he couldn’t seize this opportunity. With his current capabilities, he just couldn’t handle managing 1000 stores at the same time. With a minimum of 70 million each month, if the salaries for kitchen and management staff were calculated normally, that would be a personnel cost of roughly one billion.
It would crush him.
He had never thought that he could be paying out a billion in wages every month.
What a joke. He doesn’t even make ten million in a year, and now he’s expected to give out a billion every month? That’s ludicrous!
“It’s not over yet.”
Old Huang shook his head, “Besides these, you still have a multitude of problems to overcome. I’ve seen the announcement from Tuberculosis Rabbit Company, and the campaign is set to officially start this month, involving exactly 7000 related professionals.”
“Where are you going to find them?”
“Heading out to make a name for Blue Star, it’s not quite appropriate to use newbies, right? You’ll need experienced people.”
“Finding 7000 experienced professionals in such a short time, that would leave even headhunters clenching their teeth, clueless about how to handle it.”
“What about the raw materials?”
“Tuberculosis Rabbit Company suggests incorporating some local ingredients to better suit local tastes, but the basic ingredients still need to come from Blue Star, since the main goal is to promote Blue Star’s cuisine.”
“Okay, here comes a new problem. Do you have a supply chain that can transport so many ingredients daily? Do you have a group of mature and reliable procurement personnel? And can you ensure that this supply chain won’t break down? In case of a shortage, do you have a backup supply chain?”
“We’re not finished yet. Do these new staff members need training before starting work? Do you have experience with large-scale training? Do you know how to conduct training?”
“Do you know how to manage so many employees? Does your management have a set of reward and punishment systems in place?”
“Is there a metric for natural loss every day?”
“Now, your biggest trouble is how to handle employee wages, but that’s not your only problem. There are plenty of others. You have no experience in managing a thousand stores simultaneously. You will spend a lot of time just reviewing daily reports.”
With a calm expression, Old Huang shook his head, “Don’t get too excited too soon. The time for celebration hasn’t come yet. This opportunity is not just an opportunity for you but also a crisis, a crisis that could crush you.”
“If there is even a slight mishap.”
“These thousand stores could suffocate you for a lifetime.”
At this thought, Old Huang sighed with some emotion in his heart. Although he knew that Tuberculosis Rabbit would certainly offer some help to his son, he never expected it to be so substantial. The help was too great; his son simply couldn’t take it on.
To Tuberculosis Rabbit, it might not seem like a big deal. Just 1000 stores, could they really crush a person?
That must be the difference in levels between individuals.
With different levels come different perspectives. To Tuberculosis Rabbit, opening 1000 stores is a piece of cake since at that level, he doesn’t even need to think about it. He just needs to say the word, and his subordinates will take care of it.
The people at Tuberculosis Rabbit’s disposal are all elites.
Just like this gastronomy promotion plan, which started with Yi casually mentioning that the food on other planets tasted quite bad, wondering how they could stomach it. If they tried our cuisine, they’d be totally smitten.
After giving it some thought, Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded and then initiated the gastronomy promotion plan.
Just a mention of the idea to his think tank, and the next day they presented a detailed promotion process. Tuberculosis Rabbit took a look, saw no issues, and nodded for finance to start allocating the budget.
