chapters.content:
Chapter 755: Spin-off 28: Grand Finale. _2
Afterward, the grand plan that made waves outside had begun.
And it all started with Yi’s casual remark and Tuberculosis Rabbit’s nod of agreement.
In Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, perhaps it really wasn’t such a big deal.
“Should we… give up?”
“Should I go tell Tuberculosis Rabbit I don’t want to do it?”
Little Huang hesitated, his expression uncertain. He had completely lost the feeling of excitement, and it was only now that he fully grasped the enormity of the hot potato he was holding. Let alone a monthly payroll of 100 million, whether it was the 7,000 plus employees, a stable supply chain, brand building, or uniform flavor profiles—he had no experience with any of it.
To be precise, it wasn’t that he lacked experience.
He already had a stable supply chain; his twenty-odd hotpot restaurants all sourced from the same supplier. But if he told them he needed supplies for 1,000 restaurants, they would go insane. They simply couldn’t handle such an order.
He had all these experiences, but once the scale increased to this level, he felt completely blind and clueless about how to handle it.
At this point, other than giving up, he surprisingly could think of no other solution.
“You don’t necessarily need to give up, not only would it waste this opportunity, it would lower Tuberculosis Rabbit’s impression of you. If you want to ask again in the future, there won’t be a chance. If you handle this properly this time, perhaps even Tuberculosis Rabbit would take more notice of you,” Old Huang said.
“Moreover, even by selling the quota, you could make a considerable profit. The quota is indeed given to your company, but there are many large hotpot brands with the capacity but not the quota. You just need to sell your company to them, transfer the quota, and you could earn a lot.”
“But that’s a last resort.”
“Let me tell you a better plan.”
Old Huang pondered for a moment before speaking, “Do you know what the capital market favors the most now? It’s Yi. Anything related to Yi will be fervently pursued by the capital market, even though Yi himself is one of the biggest tycoons in the capital market.”
“The food promotion event this time has attracted countless capital investments. The reason is simple; the event is hosted by Yi. They trust Yi and nearly every Alien Race knows about Blue Star thanks to his fame.”
“When one day, Blue Star’s cuisine suddenly appears on their doorstep, tell me, wouldn’t they want to try it?”
“Relying on the trust in Yi’s influence and confidence in Blue Star’s food products, numerous capitals enter the scene. They invest and collaborate with companies that received the quota, aiming to make profits together.”
“You can let the news leak as well.”
“But it needs to be leaked in a different way.”
“We can reveal our connection with Yi. Once those capitals find out, they will frantically seek you out for collaboration. If everything goes as planned, you should already have some contacts, right?” Old Huang continued.
Little Huang was slightly taken aback, looking at his friend requests, he indeed found several unfamiliar ones with remarks such as ‘Business Cooperation, Wang Mei, Head of Market Department at Gao Fei Capital.’
“How should we leak it?”
“A too obvious leak isn’t good.”
Old Huang shook his head, “It would stand out too much and seem very purposeful.”
Then Old Huang looked at the veteran friends beside him, slightly stood up, clasped his hands and bowed with a smile, “It has been tough for all of you listening for so long. As you know, I, Old Huang, don’t have many dreams in this life, just this one son, Little Huang. With some effort and thick-skinned requests, we got him this opportunity.”
“It would be a bit regretful to let it go to waste.”
“Considering our many years of acquaintance, I’ll trouble you to leak the news out for me. Thank you all, and I’ll be sure to repay your kindness in the future,” he said.
As his voice fell,
the group of old men listening intently around him, coughed lightly and came back to their senses.
“Ah?”
Caught up in excitement, Little Huang had never considered this problem. It was only after his father mentioned it that he realized he couldn’t possibly afford such a large sum. A hotpot restaurant requires at least 7 staff members including waiters, reception, doormen, and kitchen staff.
That was already the bare minimum staffing.
And for 1,000 stores, that meant at least 7,000 employees.
He couldn’t possibly manage these 1,000 stores simultaneously, and nobody could. This would necessitate a massive number of managerial staff, adding at least another 100 people. The amount of salary to be paid to so many people every month was astronomical.
The average monthly salary on Blue Star was around 11,000.
The pay for waiters was generally 6,000, varying by city.
The salary for service staff going to Alien Race territories had to be even higher; after all, who would go to such a far and unfamiliar place if the pay wasn’t significantly more?
Tuberculosis Rabbit Company was willing to cover all the expenses for opening the stores, but the single requirement was that the staff must be from Blue Star.
Otherwise, it would not serve the purpose of promoting Blue Star’s cuisine.
Bearing this in mind, waiter salaries had to be at least 10,000 to attract anyone.
The salary for management and kitchen staff was even higher.
Even if calculated at the lowest monthly salary of 10,000, the cost for 1,000 stores would be… 70 million.
70 million…
With just over 20 hotpot restaurants in his hands, even if he sold all of them, he couldn’t raise 70 million—darkroom—couldn’t even cover a month’s payroll. Even if he were to liquidate everything he had, it would be pointless.
Moreover, since it was a trial run in Alien Race territories, they might not even make any profit in the first month.
If they didn’t earn 70 million in the first month, he wouldn’t be able to pay the second month’s salaries.

Perhaps in Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, this wasn’t a big deal. What’s a thousand stores? Could they really crush someone?
That’s just the difference in levels between people.
At different levels, people think differently. In Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, opening a thousand stores was a trivial matter – after all, in his position, he didn’t even need to think about it. With a casual remark, his subordinates would get it done.
The people at Tuberculosis Rabbit’s disposal were all elites.
Like in this culinary promotion plan, it began simply as a casual comment from Yi, expressing that the food on other planets was quite unpalatable and he had no idea how they could stomach it. He speculated that if they tried Blue Star’s food, they would be captivated by its deliciousness.
Tuberculosis Rabbit nodded thoughtfully and then initiated the culinary promotion plan.
Just by mentioning an idea to the think tank below him, the next day they presented a detailed promotion process. Tuberculosis Rabbit glanced at it and saw no issues, so he nodded and instructed finance to begin allotting the budget.
Afterwards, the expansive plan began to unfold in the outside world.
And all it took at the beginning was a casual remark from Yi and a nod from Tuberculosis Rabbit.
In Tuberculosis Rabbit’s eyes, perhaps this indeed wasn’t a big deal.
“Maybe… give it up?”
“Should I go and tell Tuberculosis Rabbit that I don’t want it?”
Little Huang hesitated, his expression uncertain. By now, his excitement had completely faded, and he truly realized how troublesome this hot potato was—let alone a billion yuan a month.

Chapter 757: Extra 29: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Seventeen)
So—
Little Huang, who was furrowing his brow with worry in the morning, was now sitting in his office in the afternoon with his legs crossed, leaning back in his office chair, casually flipping through the file that the person in charge from Gao Sheng Capital had handed over before the New Year.
“Hmm, you will bear all the staff salaries, and you’ll be responsible for all the branding, uniform training, and the creation of management systems for the staff, hmm, and you want to hold 49% of the shares?”
“That’s not enough commitment.”
“The guys at Gao Fei Capital next door only hold 45%, and they’re also in charge of the full-scale brand building.”
“…”
The person in charge from Gao Sheng Capital gritted his teeth in silence for a moment before hissing, “We only want 30%, but we need to add the words ‘Gao Sheng’ in front of the brand name. No matter what the brand name changes to in the future, it must include ‘Gao Sheng’, like ‘Gao Sheng Delicacy’ hotpot restaurant.”
“This is the biggest concession we’re willing to make.”
He naturally knew what the company was thinking—it was secondary whether the business made a profit.
The most important thing was that this hotpot restaurant was one that Chen Yi loved to eat at, and the way of capital is not the businessman’s way; It doesn’t matter whether these 1,000 stores are profitable or not.
If the game of capital was investing in a store and then waiting for it to make money and start paying dividends, then all capital firms would have gone bankrupt.
The only goal of capital is to create a bubble.
For example, by spending a hundred million to take a 41% stake in a company, then start inflating the ‘bubble’ of that company large enough to draw in more capital, and finally, as more capital comes in, cash out and exit the scene.
Even if from beginning to end, the company is always running at a loss, it doesn’t matter. As long as the bubble is big enough, as long as the prospects are broad enough, as long as the company is futuristic enough, as long as the company’s potential is high enough, that’s all that matters.
What capital considers is never whether a company can be profitable, but whether it can be hyped up.
And—
“Yi’s favorite hotpot restaurant.”
This gimmick is already enough to blow the hotpot restaurant sky-high.
What they needed to do next was to enter the scene, hold a certain percentage of shares, start promoting the company, until more capital came in, and then they would exit. This is also why before the arrival of the ‘capital game’, Blue Star had many large companies with at least ten million users.
The company clearly loses money year after year and doesn’t make a profit, but they continue to operate.
The company not making a profit doesn’t mean the shareholders don’t make a profit.
As long as the concept is in place, the money will come easily.
“…”
Little Huang, sitting at his desk, was silent for a while before standing up with a smile and proactively reaching out his right hand, “Congratulations, you will become the most loyal partner of the ‘Gao Sheng Delicacy’ brand.”
For him, being able to retain 70% of the shares was something he had never even considered.
After all, he had nothing but the offer.
The company not making a profit doesn’t mean the shareholders don’t make a profit.

chapters.title: Chapter 758: Extra 30: The Return of Chen Yi's Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Eighteen)
chapters.content:
Chapter 758: Extra 30: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Eighteen)
Another ten years had passed.
Chen Yi once again attended a funeral, this time it was for Li Yide and Xiaoqian, who both died on the same day.
“What a pity.”
Tuberculosis Rabbit sighed softly and gently placed a bouquet of white roses on the tombstone before her. Li Yide’s life had improved significantly since he had followed them. Over the past decade, his life had been quite prosperous, devoid of those miserable moments from before.
It was just that Xiaoqian’s lifespan had run out.
Although Xiaoqian had switched to the human race, her essence was still that of the Ghost Race, and the Ghost Race couldn’t use life-extending props. The lifespan of the Ghost Race was short, and when it came to an end, death naturally followed.
After Xiaoqian’s death, Li Yide joined them for one last hot pot meal, expressed his gratitude at the dining table for the care he’d received over the years, reminisced about the past, chatted for a while, and then went to accompany Xiaoqian in death.
In fact, they could all clearly sense Li Yide’s intention to die at that meal.
But not a single person spoke up to dissuade Li Yide.
Li Yide’s intention to die was so strong, almost solidifying into something tangible, everyone was aware that Xiaoqian was nearly all of Li Yide’s driving force in life, and without her, there really wasn’t much point for Li Yide to continue living.
Even though Chen Yi possessed resurrection props and could have brought Li Yide back to life after his suicide, he chose not to do so, because they all knew that Li Yide wanted to die. The years of Xiaoqian’s companionship had made it utterly unbearable for Li Yide to live alone in this world.
Xiaoqian could not be resurrected.
Those whose time had naturally come could not be resurrected with resurrection props.
When the lifespan is up, it’s time to go.

Chapter 759: Extra 31: The Return of Chen Yi’s Eldest Son, Chen Yue (Part Nineteen)
Time slowly passed, and with the passage of time, a lot of things happened.
The child of Sword Without End was also born.
“It’s truly miraculous,”
Standing outside the delivery room, Tuberculosis Rabbit looked toward the anxious Sword Without End and couldn’t help but exclaim, “These days, even Clones can have children; what else is there that can’t happen?”
At this moment, Sword Without End had no desire to argue with Tuberculosis Rabbit. He paced back and forth outside the delivery room with an anxious and restless expression, clearly waiting for news from inside.
Ever since Sword Without End married his own Clone, the relationship between the two had always been good, and the AI of the Clone had grown stronger. Starting from an initial state of confusion and ignorance, it had now become indistinguishable from normal humans.
But with that, it also developed quite a few small habits.
